verses.sanskrit: कालः सृजति भूतानि कालः संहरते प्रजाः | कालः सुप्तेषु जागर्ति कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः ||
verses.transliteration: kālaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ | kālaḥ supteṣu jāgarti kālo hi duratikramaḥ ||
verses.translation: Time creates all beings; time destroys all creatures. Time is awake even when they sleep. Time is indeed insurmountable.
verses.hindi: काल सभी प्राणियों की सृष्टि करता है; काल सभी का संहार करता है। जब वे सोते हैं, काल जागता रहता है। काल वास्तव में अतिक्रमण से परे है।
verses.commentary: The Vayu Purana opens with the most fundamental fact: time is primary. Before gods, before creation, before any narrative — kala (time). "Kālaḥ sṛjati" — time creates. "Kālaḥ saṃharate" — time destroys. "Supteṣu jāgarti" — while beings sleep, time is awake. This last image is particularly powerful: time does not pause for our unconsciousness. While we are distracted, forgetful, or asleep to the significance of our lives, time continues its movement. "Kālo hi duratikramaḥ" — time is insurmountable: no being, however powerful, transcends it. The appropriate response to this recognition is not despair but clarity: if time is primary and insurmountable, then using time wisely — for what is genuinely valuable — becomes the most urgent priority.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारि युगान्याहुः कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं कलिः | तेषां धर्मविशेषाश्च भवन्ति युगशः क्रमात् ||
verses.transliteration: catvāri yugānyāhuḥ kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ kaliḥ | teṣāṃ dharmaviśeṣāśca bhavanti yugaśaḥ kramāt ||
verses.translation: They speak of four yugas: Krita, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali. And the qualities of dharma in each occur sequentially in order.
verses.hindi: कृत, त्रेता, द्वापर और कलि — ये चार युग कहे जाते हैं। इनमें धर्म के विशेष लक्षण क्रमशः होते हैं।
verses.commentary: The four-yuga model is the Vayu Purana's most influential contribution to the Hindu understanding of history. Krita (Satya) Yuga: dharma stands on four feet — truth, compassion, austerity, and giving are fully operative. Treta Yuga: dharma on three feet — some decline. Dvapara: two feet. Kali Yuga: one foot — only the barest minimum of dharma remains functional. The model is not pessimistic resignation but a diagnostic framework: in each age, different dharmic practices are appropriate. The Puranas consistently teach that what was achieved through severe tapas in the Krita Yuga is achieved through bhakti and nama-smarana in Kali Yuga. The yuga model is an adaptive ethics framework.

verses.sanskrit: वायुः सर्वस्वरूपो वायुः सर्वगतः सर्वव्यापी | वायुं यो जानाति तत्त्वेन स वायुः स स्वयं भवति ||
verses.transliteration: vāyuḥ sarvasvarūpo vāyuḥ sarvagataḥ sarvavyāpī | vāyuṃ yo jānāti tattvena sa vāyuḥ sa svayaṃ bhavati ||
verses.translation: Vayu is the form of all, vayu is everywhere, vayu is all-pervading. He who knows vayu in truth becomes vayu himself.
verses.hindi: वायु सभी का स्वरूप है, वायु सर्वत्र है, वायु सर्वव्यापी है। जो वायु को तत्व से जानता है, वह स्वयं वायु हो जाता है।
verses.commentary: The Vayu Purana declares that vayu (wind/breath) is the form of all, everywhere, all-pervading. The verse then states that knowing vayu in truth leads to becoming vayu oneself. This is the Vayu Purana's ultimate teaching: liberation is the recognition that you are vayu — the cosmic breath that animates all existence. When you know vayu in truth, you become vayu.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते अस्तु भगवन् विश्वेश्वराय महादेव | त्र्यम्बकाय त्रिपुरान्तकाय त्रिकालाग्निकालाय कालाग्निरुद्राय ||
verses.transliteration: namaste astu bhagavan viśveśvarāya mahādeva | tryambakāya tripurāntakāya trikālāgnikālāya kālāgnīrudrāya ||
verses.translation: Salutation to You, O Bhagavan, Lord of all worlds, Mahadeva — the three-eyed one, destroyer of the three cities, fire of the three times, the Rudra who is the fire of time.
verses.hindi: हे भगवन्! हे विश्वेश्वर, महादेव! आपको नमस्कार — त्र्यम्बक, त्रिपुरान्तक, त्रिकालाग्निकाल, कालाग्निरुद्र को।
verses.commentary: The Shatarudriya salutation from the Vayu Purana — each epithet is a complete theology: "Tryambaka" (three-eyed): the third eye is not a mythological feature but the eye of wisdom (jnana-chakshus) that sees beyond the binary of past-future into the eternal present. "Tripurāntaka" (destroyer of the three cities): the three cities (Tripura) represent the three bodies (sthula, sukshma, karana — gross, subtle, causal) bound together by desire; their simultaneous destruction by a single arrow of pure awareness is the moment of liberation. "Kālāgni-Rudra" (Rudra who is the fire of time): Shiva is not merely within time but is the fire that consumes time itself — the principle that transcends all temporal limitation.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणो वायुः सर्वभूतानां जीवन्तुः सर्वभूतयोः | यो वायुं जानाति तत्त्वेन स पश्यति परं पदम् ||
verses.transliteration: prāṇo vāyuḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvantuḥ sarvabhūtayoḥ | yo vāyuṃ jānāti tattvena sa paśyati paraṃ padam ||
verses.translation: Prana is the wind of all beings, the life of all living things. He who knows the wind in truth sees the supreme state.
verses.hindi: प्राण सभी प्राणियों का वायु है, सभी जीवित प्राणियों का जीवन है। जो वायु को तत्व से जानता है, वह परम पद देखता है।
verses.commentary: The Vayu Purana identifies prana (life breath) with vayu (wind) as the fundamental animating principle of all beings. "Prāṇo vāyuḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ" — prana is the wind of all beings. "Jīvantuḥ sarvabhūtayoḥ" — the life of all living things. The verse then states that knowing vayu in truth leads to seeing the supreme state. This is the Vayu Purana's distinctive teaching: the breath is not merely physiological but the gateway to the divine. Knowing the breath as vayu — as the cosmic wind that animates all existence — is the path to liberation.

verses.sanskrit: शिवः प्राणः प्राणेश्चैव शिवः सर्वेषु भूतेषु | यो शिवं प्राणरूपेण जानाति स मुक्तो भवति ||
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇeścaiva śivaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu | yo śivaṃ prāṇarūpeṇa jānāti sa mukto bhavati ||
verses.translation: Shiva is prana, Shiva is the lord of prana, Shiva is in all beings. He who knows Shiva as the form of prana becomes liberated.
verses.hindi: शिव प्राण हैं, शिव प्राणेश हैं, शिव सभी प्राणियों में हैं। जो शिव को प्राण-रूप में जानता है, वह मुक्त हो जाता है।
verses.commentary: The Vayu Purana identifies Shiva with prana — the life breath. "Śivaḥ prāṇaḥ" — Shiva is prana. "Śivaḥ prāṇeśaḥ" — Shiva is the lord of prana. "Śivaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu" — Shiva is in all beings. The verse then states that knowing Shiva as the form of prana leads to liberation. This is the Vayu Purana's core teaching: Shiva is not a distant deity but the very breath that animates all life. Recognising Shiva in the breath is the most direct spiritual practice.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन् तिष्ठन् स्वपन् जाग्रन् उन्मिषन् निमिषन्नपि | यः स्मरेत् परमं ब्रह्म स मुक्तो नात्र संशयः ||
verses.transliteration: gacchan tiṣṭhan svapan jāgran unmiṣan nimiṣannapi | yaḥ smaret paramaṃ brahma sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
verses.translation: Whether walking, standing, sleeping, waking, opening the eyes, or closing them — whoever remembers the Supreme Brahman is liberated. Of this there is no doubt.
verses.hindi: चलते, ठहरते, सोते, जागते, आँखें खोलते या मूँदते — जो परम ब्रह्म का स्मरण करता है, वह मुक्त है। इसमें कोई संशय नहीं।
verses.commentary: The Vayu Purana's declaration of continuous remembrance (nitya-smarana) as the path of liberation. Six ordinary physical states — walking, standing, sleeping, waking, opening eyes, closing eyes — are listed to establish comprehensiveness: there is no state of life in which smarana is unavailable or inappropriate. "Paramaṃ brahma smaret" — remembers the Supreme Brahman. This is not intellectual recall but the deeper orientation of attention: the background awareness that the ground of one's being is the infinite. "Sa mukto" — that one is liberated. Not will be liberated after death, not will be liberated after spiritual progress — is liberated. Present tense. The remembrance itself is liberation.

verses.sanskrit: वायुरात्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च | यो विश्वे देवा देवानां सम्राट् | स एव रुद्रः स महान् महेशः | स एव विश्वं भुवनं बभूव ||
verses.transliteration: vāyurātmā jagatastaṣṭhuṣaśca | yo viśve devā devānāṃ samrāṭ | sa eva rudraḥ sa mahān maheśaḥ | sa eva viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ babhūva ||
verses.translation: Vayu is the Self (atma) of all that moves and stands still. He who is the emperor among all the gods — he alone is Rudra, the great Maheshvara. He alone has become the entire world.
verses.hindi: वायु ही जगत् के चर और अचर का आत्मा है। जो विश्वदेवों में देवों का सम्राट् है — वही रुद्र है, वही महान् महेश्वर है। वही सम्पूर्ण विश्व और भुवन बन गया है।
verses.commentary: "Vāyurātmā jagataḥ" — Vayu is the atman of the world. The breath/wind is the self of everything. This is a profound identification: the breath (vayu/prana) that animates each body is the same principle that moves through all creation — the wind that stirs leaves, the breath in lungs, the subtle prana that animates consciousness. All are one movement. "Sa eva Rudraḥ" — he alone is Rudra/Shiva. The wind is not merely a natural phenomenon but the self-disclosure of the divine in continuous, present-moment, life-sustaining activity. The Vayu Purana's theology of breath makes every breath an encounter with Shiva.

verses.sanskrit: शिवः प्राणः प्राणेश्चैव शिवः सर्वेषु भूतेषु | यो शिवं प्राणरूपेण जानाति स मुक्तो भवति ||

verses.translation: Shiva is prana, Shiva is the lord of prana, Shiva is in all beings. He who knows Shiva as the form of prana becomes liberated.

verses.commentary: The Vayu Purana identifies Shiva with prana — the life breath. "Śivaḥ prāṇaḥ" — Shiva is prana. "Śivaḥ prāṇeśaḥ" — Shiva is the lord of prana. "Śivaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu" — Shiva is in all beings. The verse then states that knowing Shiva as the form of prana leads to liberation. This is the Vayu Purana's core teaching: Shiva is not a distant deity but the very breath that animates all life. Recognising Shiva in the breath is the most direct spiritual practice.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन् तिष्ठन् स्वपन् जाग्रन् उन्मिषन् निमिषन्नपि | यः स्मरेत् परमं ब्रह्म स मुक्तो नात्र संशयः ||
verses.transliteration: gacchan tiṣṭhan svapan jāgran unmiṣan nimiṣannapi | yaḥ smaret paramaṃ brahma sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
verses.translation: Whether walking, standing, sleeping, waking, opening the eyes, or closing them — whoever remembers the Supreme Brahman is liberated. Of this there is no doubt.
verses.hindi: चलते, ठहरते, सोते, जागते, आँखें खोलते या मूँदते — जो परम ब्रह्म का स्मरण करता है, वह मुक्त है। इसमें कोई संशय नहीं।
verses.commentary: The Vayu Purana's declaration of continuous remembrance (nitya-smarana) as the path of liberation. Six ordinary physical states — walking, standing, sleeping, waking, opening eyes, closing eyes — are listed to establish comprehensiveness: there is no state of life in which smarana is unavailable or inappropriate. "Paramaṃ brahma smaret" — remembers the Supreme Brahman. This is not intellectual recall but the deeper orientation of attention: the background awareness that the ground of one's being is the infinite. "Sa mukto" — that one is liberated. Not will be liberated after death, not will be liberated after spiritual progress — is liberated. Present tense. The remembrance itself is liberation.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः | एतं सामासिकं धर्मं चातुर्वर्ण्येऽब्रवीन्मनुः ||
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ | etaṃ sāmāsikaṃ dharmaṃ cāturvarṇye'bravīnmanuḥ ||
verses.translation: Non-harm, truth, non-stealing, purity, and restraint of the senses — Manu declared this the condensed dharma for all four social orders.
verses.hindi: अहिंसा, सत्य, अस्तेय (न चुराना), शौच (पवित्रता) और इन्द्रिय-निग्रह — मनु ने यह संक्षिप्त धर्म चारों वर्णों के लिए कहा।
verses.commentary: The Vayu Purana's condensed ethical code: five principles that apply to all human beings regardless of social position. This "samāsika-dharma" (condensed dharma) is the common foundation beneath all the more specific role-based obligations. (1) Ahiṃsā — non-harm: the fundamental orientation of not reducing the life, dignity, or wellbeing of any being. (2) Satya — truth: alignment between inner reality and outer expression. (3) Asteya — non-stealing: not taking what belongs to another (extended to time, attention, credit, and opportunity — not just property). (4) Śauca — purity: clarity of body, speech, and mind. (5) Indriya-nigraha — sense-restraint: not being driven by sensory impulse but by conscious choice. These five are the minimal conditions for a coherent individual and a coherent society.

verses.sanskrit: वायुः सर्वस्वरूपो वायुः सर्वगतः सर्वव्यापी | वायुं यो जानाति तत्त्वेन स वायुः स स्वयं भवति ||
verses.transliteration: vāyuḥ sarvasvarūpo vāyuḥ sarvagataḥ sarvavyāpī | vāyuṃ yo jānāti tattvena sa vāyuḥ sa svayaṃ bhavati ||
verses.translation: Vayu is the form of all, vayu is everywhere, vayu is all-pervading. He who knows vayu in truth becomes vayu himself.
verses.hindi: वायु सभी का स्वरूप है, वायु सर्वत्र है, वायु सर्वव्यापी है। जो वायु को तत्व से जानता है, वह स्वयं वायु हो जाता है।
verses.commentary: The Vayu Purana declares that vayu (wind/breath) is the form of all, everywhere, all-pervading. The verse then states that knowing vayu in truth leads to becoming vayu oneself. This is the Vayu Purana's ultimate teaching: liberation is the recognition that you are vayu — the cosmic breath that animates all existence. When you know vayu in truth, you become vayu.

verses.transliteration: prāṇo vāyuḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvantuḥ sarvabhūtayoḥ | yo vāyuṃ jānāti tattvena sa paśyati paraṃ padam ||
verses.translation: Prana is the wind of all beings, the life of all living things. He who knows the wind in truth sees the supreme state.
verses.hindi: प्राण सभी प्राणियों का वायु है, सभी जीवित प्राणियों का जीवन है। जो वायु को तत्व से जानता है, वह परम पद देखता है।
verses.commentary: The Vayu Purana identifies prana (life breath) with vayu (wind) as the fundamental animating principle of all beings. "Prāṇo vāyuḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ" — prana is the wind of all beings. Knowing the breath as vayu — as the cosmic wind that animates all existence — is the path to liberation.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये मार्कण्डेयधर्मराजसंवादे कल्पक्षये मार्कण्डेयकृतपोतार्धारोहणवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम तृतीयो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो ऽर्णवात्समुत्तीर्य त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थितम् । महाकनकवर्णाभे नानावर्णशिलाचिते
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye mārkaṇḍeyadharmarājasaṃvāde kalpakṣaye mārkaṇḍeyakṛtapotārdhārohaṇavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 4 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato 'rṇavātsamuttīrya trikūṭaśikhare sthitam / mahākanakavarṇābhe nānāvarṇaśilācite
verses.translation: On hearing that, all the sages of the Naimisa forest re¬ plied to Suta with eyes excited with curiosity.
verses.hindi: स्तुप्प्टिप्रच्करणस्प्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that, all the sages of the Naimisa forest re¬ plied to Suta with eyes excited with curiosity.

verses.sanskrit: महाशृङ्गे समासीनं रुद्रकोटिसमन्वितम् । महादेवं महात्मानमीशानमजम् अव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: mahāśṛṅge samāsīnaṃ rudrakoṭisamanvitam / mahādevaṃ mahātmānamīśānamajam avyayam
verses.translation: "You, sir, are an expert in the knowledge of different dynasties and families as you have inherited it directly from Vyasa. Hence, please describe to us entirely the creation (etc.) of this world.
verses.hindi: भपषानने वंशकुशलो व्यासात्प्रत्यक्षद्शिवान्  तस्माक्ष्य॑ भचन॑ कृत्स्नं लोकस्यामुष्य चर्णय ॥
verses.wordMeaning: "You, sir, are an expert in the knowledge of different dynasties and families as you have inherited it directly from Vyasa. Hence, please describe to us entirely the creation (etc.) of this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: "You, sir, are an expert in the knowledge of different dynasties and families as you have inherited it directly from Vyasa. Hence, please describe to us entirely the creation (etc.) of this world.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतमयं तात मनुना सह सुव्रत । भूयो ववन्दे चरणौ सर्वदेवनमस्कृतौ
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtamayaṃ tāta manunā saha suvrata / bhūyo vavande caraṇau sarvadevanamaskṛtau
verses.translation: We wish to know the detailed c who's who ' (lit. the genea¬ logies) of them all, and also the diverse creation of the ancient sages, as also the primeval creation of Prajapati 33.
verses.hindi: प्रधान संसार की गति का वर्णन है। प्रकृतिस्थ अवस्था में कारणों की कैसी स्थिति रहती है तथा फिर कैसे. प्रदृत्ति होती है ये सब बातें शास्त्र की युक्ति और अपनी बुद्धि के अनुसार बुद्धिमानों के लिये प्रकाशित को गई हैं । ब्राह्मणों ! तदनुरूप ही पूर्व ऋषियों ने ज॑से कहा है, मैं कह रहा हूँ, आप लोग सुनिये
verses.wordMeaning: We wish to know the detailed c who's who ' (lit. the genea¬ logies) of them all, and also the diverse creation of the ancient sages, as also the primeval creation of Prajapati 33.

verses.sanskrit: तत्काले युगसाहस्रं सह रुद्रेण मानद । तस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे स्थितो ऽहं कुरुनंदन
verses.transliteration: tatkāle yugasāhasraṃ saha rudreṇa mānada / tasminnekārṇave ghore sthito 'haṃ kurunaṃdana
verses.translation: On being repeatedly requested by them the noble- souled Lomaharsana, the most excellent among the good, narrat¬ ed everything in detail and in due order.
verses.hindi: इतना सुनकर नैमिषारण्य के रहने वाले समस्त ऋषियों ने आँखों में आँसू भरकर सूतजी से कहा--- “आप वंशज्ञ हैं, आपने व्यास जी से सब कुछ प्रत्यक्ष रूप से प्राप्त कर लिया है इसलिये आप इस लोक की सारी उत्पत्ति का वर्णन कीजिये । जिसके जो-जो वंशज हैं उन सब को, प्रजापति की विचिन्न सृष्टि को तथा पूर्व ऋषियों की सृष्टि को जानने की हम लोगों की लालसा है” ।१-३॥ ऋषियों के बार-बार पूछने पर सत्पुरुष
verses.wordMeaning: On being repeatedly requested by them the noble- souled Lomaharsana, the most excellent among the good, narrat¬ ed everything in detail and in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being repeatedly requested by them the noble- souled Lomaharsana, the most excellent among the good, narrat¬ ed everything in detail and in due order.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु मे तात परं कौतूहलं हृदि । जातं तत्कथयस्वेति शृण्वतः सह बान्धवैः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: etacchrutvā tu me tāta paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hṛdi / jātaṃ tatkathayasveti śṛṇvataḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ
verses.translation: The story that you have asked me to narrate is divine, charming, meaningful and destructive of sins. What is being
verses.hindi: महात्मा लोमहषेण विस्तारपूर्वक क्रम से कहने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: The story that you have asked me to narrate is divine, charming, meaningful and destructive of sins. What is being

verses.sanskrit: का सा पद्मपलाशाक्षी तमोभूते महार्णवे । योगिवद्भ्रमते नित्यं रुद्रजां स्वां च याब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: kā sā padmapalāśākṣī tamobhūte mahārṇave / yogivadbhramate nityaṃ rudrajāṃ svāṃ ca yābravīt
verses.translation: He who retains this in memory, or listens r.o it cons¬ tantly or narrates it to Brahmanas and to recluses in particular, with pious mind and self-restraint, on festive occasions (or important lunar days) in holy centres and temples, enjoys a long life. By proclaiming this Purana, he up¬ holds his family and is honoured in the heaven.
verses.hindi: पृष्ठां चैतां कथा दिव्यां ऋछदर्ां पापप्रणाशिनीम्  कथ्यमारनां मया चित्रा बहा श्रुतिसमताम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who retains this in memory, or listens r.o it cons¬ tantly or narrates it to Brahmanas and to recluses in particular, with pious mind and self-restraint, on festive occasions (or important lunar days) in holy centres and temples, enjoys a long life.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who retains this in memory, or listens r.o it cons¬ tantly or narrates it to Brahmanas and to recluses in particular, with pious mind and self-restraint, on festive occasions (or important lunar days) in holy centres and temples, enjoys a long life.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: एतमेव मया प्रश्नं पुरा पृष्टो मनुः स्वयम् । तदेव ते ऽद्य वक्ष्यामि अबलायाः समुद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etameva mayā praśnaṃ purā pṛṣṭo manuḥ svayam / tadeva te 'dya vakṣyāmi abalāyāḥ samudbhavam
verses.translation: The glorification of all meritorious persons of well-esta¬ blished fame is conducive to wealth, reputation, heavenly plea¬ sure, destruction of foes and longevity.
verses.hindi: शुत्तिः पर्वंसु युक्तात्मा तीर्थेष्वायतनेषु च्र। दीवमायुरवाप्नोति स पुराणानुकीतेनात्
verses.wordMeaning: The glorification of all meritorious persons of well-esta¬ blished fame is conducive to wealth, reputation, heavenly plea¬ sure, destruction of foes and longevity.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorification of all meritorious persons of well-esta¬ blished fame is conducive to wealth, reputation, heavenly plea¬ sure, destruction of foes and longevity.

verses.sanskrit: व्यतीतायां निशायां तु ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः । ततः प्रभाते विमले सृज्यमानेषु जन्तुषु
verses.transliteration: vyatītāyāṃ niśāyāṃ tu brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / tataḥ prabhāte vimale sṛjyamāneṣu jantuṣu
verses.translation: Creation (of the universe, its) dissolution and re-crea¬ tion, genealogy of kings, Manvantaras and the description of the families of sages—these five constitute the characteristics of a Purana. 1
verses.hindi: स्ववशघाररण छकृत्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते। विस्तारावयर्व तेषां यथाशब्दं येथाशुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Creation (of the universe, its) dissolution and re-crea¬ tion, genealogy of kings, Manvantaras and the description of the families of sages—these five constitute the characteristics of a Purana. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Creation (of the universe, its) dissolution and re-crea¬ tion, genealogy of kings, Manvantaras and the description of the families of sages—these five constitute the characteristics of a Purana. 1

verses.sanskrit: मनुं प्रणम्य शिरसा पृच्छाम्येतद् युधिष्ठिर । केयं पद्मपलाशाक्षी श्यामा चंद्रनिभानना
verses.transliteration: manuṃ praṇamya śirasā pṛcchāmyetad yudhiṣṭhira / keyaṃ padmapalāśākṣī śyāmā caṃdranibhānanā
verses.translation: I shall (now) recount in details the Purana that was narrated by the Wind-god and is on a par with the Vedas. (I shall narrate the traditional history of) the Kalpa which is purer than any other Kalpas and is positively purer than other holy things.
verses.hindi: कीत्यैमानं॑ निबोधध्व॑ सर्व्धा कीतिव्ध॑नम्। धन्य यशस्य॑ शत्रुघ्न रुथग्यमायुर्ि चधनम' ।। कौन स्थिरकीर्तीनां स्ंर्षा पुण्यकारिणाम्। सर्गश्च प्रतिसगंश्च वंशों मन्चन्तराशि च
verses.wordMeaning: I shall (now) recount in details the Purana that was narrated by the Wind-god and is on a par with the Vedas. (I shall narrate the traditional history of) the Kalpa which is purer than any other Kalpas and is positively purer than other holy things.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall (now) recount in details the Purana that was narrated by the Wind-god and is on a par with the Vedas. (I shall narrate the traditional history of) the Kalpa which is purer than any other Kalpas and is positively purer than other holy things.

verses.sanskrit: एकार्णवे भ्रमत्येका रुद्रजास्मीति वादिनी । सावित्री वेदमाता च ह्यथवा सा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: ekārṇave bhramatyekā rudrajāsmīti vādinī / sāvitrī vedamātā ca hyathavā sā sarasvatī
verses.translation: The first section ( pada ) called Prakriya consists of the following: The Origin, dissolution, re-creation and susten¬ ance of the world.
verses.hindi: वंशान॒चरितं चेति पुराण पश्चलक्षणम्  कल्पेभ्यो5पि हि यः कल्पः शुचिभ्यों नियतः शुक्ति
verses.wordMeaning: The first section ( pada ) called Prakriya consists of the following: The Origin, dissolution, re-creation and susten¬ ance of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first section ( pada ) called Prakriya consists of the following: The Origin, dissolution, re-creation and susten¬ ance of the world.

verses.sanskrit: मन्दाकिनी सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा लक्ष्मीर्वा किमथो उमा । कालरात्रिर्भवेत्साक्षात् प्रकृतिर्वा सुखोचिता
verses.transliteration: mandākinī saricchreṣṭhā lakṣmīrvā kimatho umā / kālarātrirbhavetsākṣāt prakṛtirvā sukhocitā
verses.translation: The other sections constitute the Introductory ( JJpodg - hata ), Anusanga (thecentral) and Upasamhara (the conclusion). The Purana is conducive to virtue, fame and longevity. It dis¬ pels all sins.
verses.hindi: पुराणं संप्रवदयामभि मारुतं वेद्समितम्। प्रबोधः प्रलयश्चेच स्थितिरुत्पत्तिरेव च
verses.wordMeaning: The other sections constitute the Introductory ( JJpodg - hata ), Anusanga (thecentral) and Upasamhara (the conclusion). The Purana is conducive to virtue, fame and longevity. It dis¬ pels all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The other sections constitute the Introductory ( JJpodg - hata ), Anusanga (thecentral) and Upasamhara (the conclusion). The Purana is conducive to virtue, fame and longevity. It dis¬ pels all sins.

verses.sanskrit: एतदाचक्ष्व भगवन्का सा ह्यमृतसंभवा । चरत्येकार्णवे घोरे प्रनष्टोरगराक्षसे
verses.transliteration: etadācakṣva bhagavankā sā hyamṛtasaṃbhavā / caratyekārṇave ghore pranaṣṭoragarākṣase

verses.sanskrit: मनुरुवाच: शृणु वत्स यथान्यायमस्या वक्ष्यामि संभवम् । यया रुद्रसमुद्भूता या चेयं वरवर्णिनी
verses.transliteration: manuruvāca: śṛṇu vatsa yathānyāyamasyā vakṣyāmi saṃbhavam / yayā rudrasamudbhūtā yā ceyaṃ varavarṇinī
verses.translation: Thus the four sections 1 are briefly mentioned by me. I shall describe these in detail in due order. After making obeisance to the self-born god Brahma, Hiranyagarbha (a golden-fetus, born of golden egg), who is the lord, is the first and the last Purusa, who is the distinguished and superior Atman of the subjects and who governs the worlds, I shall relate in details the excellent creation without leaving anything in doubt. The creation starts with the principle of Mahal and ends with Visesa{ the gross body). 2 It is describ¬ ed in diversity of forms and characteristics with the five dimen¬ sions and six (dividing?) systems. It is presided over by Purusa.
verses.hindi: अज्ञाय प्रथमायेव विशिष्टाय. प्रजात्मने। ब्रह्मणे लोकतन्च्राय नमस्कृत्वा स्वयंभ्ुवे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the four sections 1 are briefly mentioned by me. I shall describe these in detail in due order. After making obeisance to the self-born god Brahma, Hiranyagarbha (a golden-fetus, born of golden egg), who is the lord, is the first and the last Purusa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the four sections 1 are briefly mentioned by me. I shall describe these in detail in due order. After making obeisance to the self-born god Brahma, Hiranyagarbha (a golden-fetus, born of golden egg), who is the lord, is the first and the last Purusa,…

verses.sanskrit: पुरा शिवः शान्ततनुश्चचार विपुलं तपः । हितार्थं सर्वलोकानामुमया सह शंकरः
verses.transliteration: purā śivaḥ śāntatanuścacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ / hitārthaṃ sarvalokānāmumayā saha śaṃkaraḥ
verses.translation: The unmanifest primary cause is of the nature of Sat (existent) and Asat (non-existent). It is eternal. Those who meditate on the Reality call it Pradhana and Prakrti.
verses.hindi: लोमहबंण ने कहा--यह जो दिव्य, मधुर, पाप-नाशिनीं और विचित्र, अनेकार्थयुक्त, वेद सम्मत कथा हमसे पूछी गई है, और जो कुछ हम कह रहे हैं उसे जो सदा स्मरण रखेगा या बार-बार सुनेगा, ब्राह्मणों एवं विशेषकर यतियों को पवित्रता से समाहित चित्त होकर पं के दिनों में तीथों और मन्दिरों में सुनावेगा वह इस पुराण कीत्त न के फलस्वरूप दीर्घ आयु प्राप्त करेगा। अपने बंश का जो धारण करता हैं; स्वर्गंलोक
verses.wordMeaning: The unmanifest primary cause is of the nature of Sat (existent) and Asat (non-existent). It is eternal. Those who meditate on the Reality call it Pradhana and Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The unmanifest primary cause is of the nature of Sat (existent) and Asat (non-existent). It is eternal. Those who meditate on the Reality call it Pradhana and Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षशैलं समारुह्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् । अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां सर्वभूतात्मको वशी
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣaśailaṃ samāruhya tapastepe sudāruṇam / adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtātmako vaśī
verses.translation: It is devoid of smell, colour, taste, sound and touch. It is unborn, steady, imperishable, eternal and stationed in its own Atman. It is the origin of the universe. It is the great Being, the great Brahman, the eternal. It is unmanifest and is indeed the extension of all elements.
verses.hindi: में उसकी पूजा होती है। जैसा सुने ठीक शब्दशः उसको कीत्त न करने से सभी की कीत्ति विस्तृत होती है
verses.wordMeaning: It is devoid of smell, colour, taste, sound and touch. It is unborn, steady, imperishable, eternal and stationed in its own Atman. It is the origin of the universe. It is the great Being, the great Brahman, the eternal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is devoid of smell, colour, taste, sound and touch. It is unborn, steady, imperishable, eternal and stationed in its own Atman. It is the origin of the universe. It is the great Being, the great Brahman, the eternal.…

verses.sanskrit: तपतस्तस्य देवस्य स्वेदः समभवत्किल । तं गिरिं प्लावयामास स स्वेदो रुद्रसंभवः
verses.transliteration: tapatastasya devasya svedaḥ samabhavatkila / taṃ giriṃ plāvayāmāsa sa svedo rudrasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: It is beginningless, endless, unborn, subtle, possessed of three attributes. It is the source and the immutable one. This timeless (lit. not belonging to the present), incomprehensible. Brahman was in the beginning.
verses.hindi: स्थिर कीत्ति वाले समस्त पुण्यात्माओं के गुणगान से धन, यश तथा स्वर्ग मिलता है, शत्रुओं का नाश होता और आयु बढ़ती है। सृष्टि, प्रलय, वंश, मन्वन्तर और वंशचरित्र यही पुराण के पाँच लक्षण हैं। यह न्याय से भी न्याय और शुचि से भी निश्चित ही शुचि है। वेद सम्मत वायु प्रोक्त पुराण मैं सुनाऊंगा। इस पुराण में प्रबोध और प्रलय, स्थिति और उत्पत्ति बणित हैं ।९-१२। कथनीय वस्तुओं का संग्रह पहला प्रक्रिया
verses.wordMeaning: It is beginningless, endless, unborn, subtle, possessed of three attributes. It is the source and the immutable one. This timeless (lit. not belonging to the present), incomprehensible. Brahman was in the beginning.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is beginningless, endless, unborn, subtle, possessed of three attributes. It is the source and the immutable one. This timeless (lit. not belonging to the present), incomprehensible. Brahman was in the beginning.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् आसीत् समुद्भूता महापुण्या सरिद्वरा । या सा त्वयार्णवे दृष्टा पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: tasmād āsīt samudbhūtā mahāpuṇyā saridvarā / yā sā tvayārṇave dṛṣṭā padmapatrāyatekṣaṇā
verses.translation: PurahavccepcSarJyAp..Z-lfi, Bd. P. I.lS.Sff, universe. Compare the CV ° 1 " t '° \ 3 j. 45. Mahadidyam viUf&nUm is ano- All this universe which was enveloped in darkness, was pervaded by the Atman when the Gunas were in equili¬ brium. But at the time of creation Tamas reached a subsi¬ diary state. The principle of Mahat appeared, due to the subsi¬ diary state of Pradhana, since it was presided over by the in¬ dividual soul.
verses.hindi: पाद, उपोद्घात पाद, अनुषद्ध पाद तथा उपसंहार पाद भी हैं। ये घम्मं यश आयु के देने वाले तथा सब पापों का नाश करने वाले हैं। इस प्रकार चारों पादों को संक्षेप में बतला दिया । अब इनको क्रम से विस्तार पूर्वक सुनाऊँगा ।१ ३-१४ उस हिरण्यगर्भ पुरुषेश्वर, अज, प्रथम, विशिष्ट, प्रजारूप, लोकतल्त्र स्वयम्भू ब्रह्मा को नमस्कार करके महत् तत्व से लेकर विशेष पयेग्त नाना रूपों और लक्षणों के साथ पाँच प्रमाणों तथा छः
verses.wordMeaning: PurahavccepcSarJyAp..Z-lfi, Bd. P. I.lS.Sff, universe. Compare the CV ° 1 " t '° \ 3 j. 45. Mahadidyam viUf&nUm is ano- All this universe which was enveloped in darkness, was pervaded by the Atman when the Gunas were in equili¬ brium.…
verses.commentary: Sense: PurahavccepcSarJyAp..Z-lfi, Bd. P. I.lS.Sff, universe. Compare the CV ° 1 " t '° \ 3 j. 45. Mahadidyam viUf&nUm is ano- All this universe which was enveloped in darkness, was pervaded by the Atman when the Gunas were in equili¬ brium.…

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीरूपं समवस्थाय रुद्रमाराधयत्पुरा । आद्ये कृतयुगे तस्मिन्समानामयुतं नृप
verses.transliteration: strīrūpaṃ samavasthāya rudramārādhayatpurā / ādye kṛtayuge tasminsamānāmayutaṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: It was enveloped by the subtle and unmanifest princi¬ ple of Mahat, which when Sattva becomes predominant, illuminates only Sattva. The mind should be understood as the Mahat because the mind is its cause.
verses.hindi: ढवेतों वाली, पुष्प से अश्रिष्ठि त वन्दनीय अनुत्तम भूतसृष्टि को निस्‍्सन्‍्देह बताऊंगा
verses.wordMeaning: It was enveloped by the subtle and unmanifest princi¬ ple of Mahat, which when Sattva becomes predominant, illuminates only Sattva. The mind should be understood as the Mahat because the mind is its cause.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was enveloped by the subtle and unmanifest princi¬ ple of Mahat, which when Sattva becomes predominant, illuminates only Sattva. The mind should be understood as the Mahat because the mind is its cause.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तुष्टो महादेव उमया सह शंकरः । ब्रूहि त्वं तु महाभागे यत्ते मनसि वर्तते
verses.transliteration: tatastuṣṭo mahādeva umayā saha śaṃkaraḥ / brūhi tvaṃ tu mahābhāge yatte manasi vartate
verses.translation: It is born of the subtle mind, presided over by the in¬ telligent consciousness. Dharma etc. and their various forms are the causes of the ingredients of creation. When urged by desire to create, the principle of Mahat performs the creation. The terms Manas, Mahat, Mali, Brahma, Puh, Buddhi, Khyati, livara, Prajha, Citi, Smrti, Samvit, and Vipura are synony¬ mous, 1 so say the learned people.
verses.hindi: असंशयात्मवक्ष्यामि भूतसगंमलुत्तमम् । अव्यक्तकारणं यत्तु नित्यं खद्सदात्मकम् ॥१ै८ प्रधान प्रकति चैवच यमाइुस्तरवचिन्तकाः  गन्धवर्ण रसैही नं शब्द्स्पर्शविचजितम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is born of the subtle mind, presided over by the in¬ telligent consciousness. Dharma etc. and their various forms are the causes of the ingredients of creation. When urged by desire to create, the principle of Mahat performs the creation. The terms Manas, Mahat, Mali,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is born of the subtle mind, presided over by the in¬ telligent consciousness. Dharma etc. and their various forms are the causes of the ingredients of creation. When urged by desire to create, the principle of Mahat performs the creation. The terms Manas, Mahat, Mali,…

verses.sanskrit: सरिदुवाच: प्रलये समनुप्राप्ते नष्टे स्थावरजंगमे । प्रसादात्तव देवेश अक्षयाहं भवे प्रभो
verses.transliteration: sariduvāca: pralaye samanuprāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame / prasādāttava deveśa akṣayāhaṃ bhave prabho
verses.translation: Since it conceives of the fruit of the activities that multiply in a subtle way, it is called Manas.
verses.hindi: अज्ञात घु वमक्षयय नित्य स्वात्मन्यवस्थितम् । जगद्योनि महृदूभूत॑ पर ब्रह्म सनातनम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since it conceives of the fruit of the activities that multiply in a subtle way, it is called Manas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since it conceives of the fruit of the activities that multiply in a subtle way, it is called Manas.

verses.sanskrit: सरित्सु सागरेष्वेव पर्वतेषु क्षयिष्वपि । तव प्रसादाद्देवेश पुण्या क्षय्या भवे प्रभो
verses.transliteration: saritsu sāgareṣveva parvateṣu kṣayiṣvapi / tava prasādāddeveśa puṇyā kṣayyā bhave prabho
verses.translation: It is termed as Mahat because it is born ahead of all the principles and is greater in dimension than other principles and attributes. It is called Mali because it bears (comprehends) the measure, thinks of the division and is considered to be the Purusa in view of its relationship in enjoyment.
verses.hindi: अखांप्रतमविश्षेय्र ब्रह्माग्रे समवतंत । तस्या5इत्मना सवंमिद व्याप्तमासीत्तमोमयम २२ गुणसाम्ये तदा तस्मिन्गुणभावे तमोमये । सर्वकाले प्रधानस्य क्षेत्रश्ञाधिष्ठटितस्य थै
verses.wordMeaning: It is termed as Mahat because it is born ahead of all the principles and is greater in dimension than other principles and attributes. It is called Mali because it bears (comprehends) the measure,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is termed as Mahat because it is born ahead of all the principles and is greater in dimension than other principles and attributes. It is called Mali because it bears (comprehends) the measure,…

verses.sanskrit: पापोपपातकैर्युक्ता महापातकिनो ऽपि ये । मुच्यन्ते सर्वपापेभ्यो भक्त्या स्नात्वा तु शंकर
verses.transliteration: pāpopapātakairyuktā mahāpātakino 'pi ye / mucyante sarvapāpebhyo bhaktyā snātvā tu śaṃkara
verses.translation: It is (etymologically) designated as Brahman be¬ cause of its bigness and because it creates the beings and lifts them up from their resting place, the cosmic water.
verses.hindi: सत्वोद्रिक्तो महानग्रे सरवमाज प्रकाशकम्  मनो महांश्व विशेयो मनस्तत्कारणं स्मुतम् २४५ लिड्ठ मात्रसमुत्पन्नः क्षेत्रश्नाधिष्ठितस्तु सः। धर्मादीनां तु रुपाणि लोकतर्त्वाथेद्देतवः
verses.wordMeaning: It is (etymologically) designated as Brahman be¬ cause of its bigness and because it creates the beings and lifts them up from their resting place, the cosmic water.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is (etymologically) designated as Brahman be¬ cause of its bigness and because it creates the beings and lifts them up from their resting place, the cosmic water.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे जाह्नवीदेशे महापातकनाशिनी । भवामि दक्षिणे मार्गे यद्येवं सुरपूजिता
verses.transliteration: uttare jāhnavīdeśe mahāpātakanāśinī / bhavāmi dakṣiṇe mārge yadyevaṃ surapūjitā
verses.translation: It is called Pah because it fills all the bodies by con- It is called Buddhi because through discriminates between the wholesome and makes him advise others too.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्त कारण जो सदा सत् असत् रूप में रहता है जिसे तत्त्वचिन्तक लोग प्रधान एवं प्रकृति तथा गन्ध, वर्ण से शून्य शब्द स्पर्श से रहित, अजात, प्रूव, अक्षय्य, नित्य, अपने में उपस्थित, जगत् का आदि कारण, भद्दत् भूत, पर-ब्रह्म, सनातन तथा समस्त भृतों के विग्रह (शरीर रूप) और अव्यक्त कहते हैं, जो आदि अन्त से रहित, सूक्ष्म, निर्गुणात्मक, सब की उत्पत्ति तथा प्रलय का स्थान, अंसाम्प्रत, अविज्ञेय ब्रह्म पहले हुआ उसी की
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Pah because it fills all the bodies by con- It is called Buddhi because through discriminates between the wholesome and makes him advise others too.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Pah because it fills all the bodies by con- It is called Buddhi because through discriminates between the wholesome and makes him advise others too.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गादागम्य गंगेति यथा ख्याता क्षितौ विभो । तथा दक्षिणगङ्गेति भवेयं त्रिदशेश्वर
verses.transliteration: svargādāgamya gaṃgeti yathā khyātā kṣitau vibho / tathā dakṣiṇagaṅgeti bhaveyaṃ tridaśeśvara
verses.translation: It is called Khyati because roenjoympnt is felt in the awareness of this principle when (real) enjoyment is based on knowledge.
verses.hindi: आत्मा से यह समस्त तपोमय जगत व्याप्त था ।१८-२२। उस ग्रुणों की साम्यावस्था, तमोमय वह केवल एक गुणन्भाव वाले सृष्टि काल में क्षेत्रज्ञ के अधिष्ठान से ग्रुणयुक्त महात् क््रमक तत्त्व प्रकट हुआ जो पहले सूक्ष्म महत् अव्यक्त से ढका था। पहले सत्त्व बहुल महान् प्रकट हुआ। सत्त्वमात्र प्रकाशरूप मन को ही महान् समझना चाहिए । उसका कारण भी मन ही कहलाता है क्षेत्रज्ञ के अधिष्ठान से वह लिज्ज मात्र उत्पन्न हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Khyati because roenjoympnt is felt in the awareness of this principle when (real) enjoyment is based on knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Khyati because roenjoympnt is felt in the awareness of this principle when (real) enjoyment is based on knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां सर्वतीर्थेषु स्नात्वा यल्लभते फलम् । तत्फलं लभते मर्त्यो भक्त्या स्नात्वा महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snātvā yallabhate phalam / tatphalaṃ labhate martyo bhaktyā snātvā maheśvara
verses.translation: It is proclaimed by its attributes and is known by differ¬ ent names. Hcnc cKhyali has been the epithet of Mahat. Since it knows everything directly, it is called the noble- souled favara. It is called Prajhd because organs of perception are born of it.
verses.hindi: लोक के तत्त्वों के कारण धरम आदि उसके रूप हैं 7३२६। सृष्टि की इच्छा से प्रेरित होने पर महान् ही सृष्टि करता है। उसी को पण्डित लोग मन, महान्, मति, ब्रह्मा, भू, बुद्धि, ख्याति, ईश्वर, प्रज्ञा, चिति, स्मृति, संविद् और विपुर कहते हैं। यह विभु, सूक्ष्मता से विवृद्ध समस्त भूतों की चेष्ठा के फल का मनन कर लेता अर्थात् उनको समझ जाता है इसलिये इसको मन कहते हैं ।२७-२६। तत्त्वों में सब से प्रथम उत्पन्न होने,
verses.wordMeaning: It is proclaimed by its attributes and is known by differ¬ ent names. Hcnc cKhyali has been the epithet of Mahat. Since it knows everything directly, it is called the noble- souled favara. It is called Prajhd because organs of perception are born of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is proclaimed by its attributes and is known by differ¬ ent names. Hcnc cKhyali has been the epithet of Mahat. Since it knows everything directly, it is called the noble- souled favara. It is called Prajhd because organs of perception are born of it.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापम् यदास्ते संचितं क्वचित् । मासमात्रेण तद्देव क्षयं यात्ववगाहनात्
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpam yadāste saṃcitaṃ kvacit / māsamātreṇa taddeva kṣayaṃ yātvavagāhanāt
verses.translation: It is called Citi because it collects the forms, knowledge etc. and the fruits of sacrificial rites for enjoyment.
verses.hindi: परिमाण में अथच्र शेष गुणों से बड़ा होने के कारण इसको महान कहते हैं। यह मान धारण करता जगत तथा पुरुष के भोग के सम्बन्ध से विभाग को समझता और जानता है इसलिए उसे मति कहते हैं। बृहत्
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Citi because it collects the forms, knowledge etc. and the fruits of sacrificial rites for enjoyment.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Citi because it collects the forms, knowledge etc. and the fruits of sacrificial rites for enjoyment.

verses.sanskrit: यत्फलं सर्ववेदेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु शंकर । अवगाहेन तत्सर्वं भवत्विति मतिर्मम
verses.transliteration: yatphalaṃ sarvavedeṣu sarvayajñeṣu śaṃkara / avagāhena tatsarvaṃ bhavatviti matirmama
verses.translation: It is declared as Smrti because it is mindful of all acti¬ vities and affects present, past and future. It is called Samvii (derived either from 's/vid or 's/vind) as it obtains complete knowledge and hence its greatness.
verses.hindi: रैफ वायुपुरांणम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is declared as Smrti because it is mindful of all acti¬ vities and affects present, past and future. It is called Samvii (derived either from 's/vid or 's/vind) as it obtains complete knowledge and hence its greatness.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is declared as Smrti because it is mindful of all acti¬ vities and affects present, past and future. It is called Samvii (derived either from 's/vid or 's/vind) as it obtains complete knowledge and hence its greatness.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदानोपवासेषु सर्वतीर्थावगाहने । तत्फलं मम तोयेन जायतामिति शंकर
verses.transliteration: sarvadānopavāseṣu sarvatīrthāvagāhane / tatphalaṃ mama toyena jāyatāmiti śaṃkara
verses.translation: It exists in everything and everything exists in it. Hence it is termed as Samvit by the ones possessing higher intelligence.
verses.hindi: तस्माज्जाता भ्रहश्चैव प्रज्ञा तेन स उच्यते  श्ञानादीनि ल रूपाणि क्रतुकमंफलानि च
verses.wordMeaning: It exists in everything and everything exists in it. Hence it is termed as Samvit by the ones possessing higher intelligence.
verses.commentary: Sense: It exists in everything and everything exists in it. Hence it is termed as Samvit by the ones possessing higher intelligence.

verses.sanskrit: मम तीरे नरा ये तु अर्चयन्ति महेश्वरम् । ते गतास्तव लोकं स्युर् एतद् एव भवेच्छिव
verses.transliteration: mama tīre narā ye tu arcayanti maheśvaram / te gatāstava lokaṃ syur etad eva bhavecchiva
verses.translation: That receptacle of knowledge, (the omniscient) lord, proclaimed that knowledge arises from knowledge, Mahat is called Vipura by the learned because the Dvandvas (mutually clashing pairs) are covered by it. Because of its being absolute controller of all worlds, it is called Isvaran. It is called Brahman because of its bigness. It is Bhava because of its existence.
verses.hindi: स्मस्ते सर्वकार्याणि तेनाखौं सुखति दचच्यते  रृत्स्ने च विन्दते ज्ञान तस्मान्माहात्स्यमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: That receptacle of knowledge, (the omniscient) lord, proclaimed that knowledge arises from knowledge, Mahat is called Vipura by the learned because the Dvandvas (mutually clashing pairs) are covered by it. Because of its being absolute controller of all worlds,…
verses.commentary: Sense: That receptacle of knowledge, (the omniscient) lord, proclaimed that knowledge arises from knowledge, Mahat is called Vipura by the learned because the Dvandvas (mutually clashing pairs) are covered by it. Because of its being absolute controller of all worlds,…

verses.sanskrit: मम कूले महेशान उमया सह दैवतैः । वस नित्यं जगन्नाथ एष एव वरो मम
verses.transliteration: mama kūle maheśāna umayā saha daivataiḥ / vasa nityaṃ jagannātha eṣa eva varo mama
verses.translation: It is called Ka (Prajapati) because of its knowledge of the physical body and of the soul also, due t.o its being absolutely one. It is Purusa because it lies in the body. It is Svayamblm because it is self-born and because it exists from the beginning.
verses.hindi: तस्प्रादधिन्देविंदश्चैव संविद्त्यभिधीयते  विद्यते स च स्ंस्मिनसव तस्मिश्व विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Ka (Prajapati) because of its knowledge of the physical body and of the soul also, due t.o its being absolutely one. It is Purusa because it lies in the body. It is Svayamblm because it is self-born and because it exists from the beginning.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Ka (Prajapati) because of its knowledge of the physical body and of the soul also, due t.o its being absolutely one. It is Purusa because it lies in the body. It is Svayamblm because it is self-born and because it exists from the beginning.

verses.sanskrit: सुकर्मा वा विकर्मा वा शान्तो दान्तो जितेन्द्रियः । मृतो जन्तुर्मम जले गच्छताद् अमरावतीम्
verses.transliteration: sukarmā vā vikarmā vā śānto dānto jitendriyaḥ / mṛto janturmama jale gacchatād amarāvatīm
verses.translation: The first excellent Tattva ( Mahat ) has been thus explain¬ ed through synonymous words by the knowers of truth and those who meditate on reality. Urged by the desire for creation, Mahat performs crea¬ tion. Its two-fold activities are conception and exertion.
verses.hindi: दंद्वानां विषुरीभावाद्धिपुरं प्रोच्यते बुचैः  सवंशत्वात्य लोकानामचश्यं च तथेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: The first excellent Tattva ( Mahat ) has been thus explain¬ ed through synonymous words by the knowers of truth and those who meditate on reality. Urged by the desire for creation, Mahat performs crea¬ tion. Its two-fold activities are conception and exertion.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first excellent Tattva ( Mahat ) has been thus explain¬ ed through synonymous words by the knowers of truth and those who meditate on reality. Urged by the desire for creation, Mahat performs crea¬ tion. Its two-fold activities are conception and exertion.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्याता महापातकनाशिनी । भवामि देवदेवेश प्रसन्नो यदि मन्यसे
verses.transliteration: triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī / bhavāmi devadeveśa prasanno yadi manyase
verses.translation: Dharma and other principles are the ingredients of creation. Mahat is three-fold by virtue of the three gunas y viz. sattva, rajas and tamas.
verses.hindi: और बृहण होने के कारण सलिल के आश्रय से भावों को बढ़ाता है अतएवं इसका नाम ब्रह्मा है ।३० ३१। समस्त देहों तथा नियत तत्त्व भावों को अनुग्रह द्वारा भरण करता है अतएव भू कहलाता है। इसी से पुरुष हित अहित सारे भावों का बोध करता तथा कराता है अतएवं इसकी बुद्धि संज्ञा हुई। भोग के ज्ञान-निष्ठ होने के कारण इसीसे ख्याति तथा प्रत्युपभोग हं।ता है एवं अपने गुणों वाले अनेक नामों से इसकी ख्याति है
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma and other principles are the ingredients of creation. Mahat is three-fold by virtue of the three gunas y viz. sattva, rajas and tamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma and other principles are the ingredients of creation. Mahat is three-fold by virtue of the three gunas y viz. sattva, rajas and tamas.

verses.sanskrit: एतांश्चान्यान्वरान्दिव्यान्प्रार्थितो नृपसत्तम । नर्मदया ततः प्राह प्रसन्नो वृषवाहनः
verses.transliteration: etāṃścānyānvarāndivyānprārthito nṛpasattama / narmadayā tataḥ prāha prasanno vṛṣavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: From Mahat of threefold Gunas, is born Ego when the rajoguna is predominant. The creation of Ego is secondary and is enveloped by Mahat. Thereafter, when the (cosmic) Ego is dominated by tamas-gima, the primary subtle element is born of the Ego char¬ acterized by lamas.
verses.hindi: अतएव मह॒त् को ख्याति कहते हैं। ये मद्गात्मा सबको साक्षात् जानते हैं अतएव इनका नाम ईदवर है
verses.wordMeaning: From Mahat of threefold Gunas, is born Ego when the rajoguna is predominant. The creation of Ego is secondary and is enveloped by Mahat. Thereafter, when the (cosmic) Ego is dominated by tamas-gima, the primary subtle element is born of the Ego char¬ acterized by lamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Mahat of threefold Gunas, is born Ego when the rajoguna is predominant. The creation of Ego is secondary and is enveloped by Mahat. Thereafter, when the (cosmic) Ego is dominated by tamas-gima, the primary subtle element is born of the Ego char¬ acterized by lamas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमहेश उवाच: एवं भवतु कल्याणि यत्त्वयोक्तमनिन्दिते । नान्या वरार्हा लोकेषु मुक्त्वा त्वां कमलेक्षणे
verses.transliteration: śrīmaheśa uvāca: evaṃ bhavatu kalyāṇi yattvayoktamanindite / nānyā varārhā lokeṣu muktvā tvāṃ kamalekṣaṇe
verses.translation: Ether is a perforated (void) extensive expanse and is characterized by the subtle element called sound and is again enveloped by the cosmic Ego ( Bhutadi ).
verses.hindi: इसी से ग्रह भी उत्पन्न हुए इसलिये इसका नाम प्रज्ञा है। ज्ञान आदि रूप तथा क्रतु, कर्मफल सब को भोग के लिये चयन करता है अतएवं इसे चिति कहते हैं। वर्तमान अतीत तथा अनागत सभी कार्यों का स्मरण रखता है इसलिये इसका नाम स्मृति है। समस्त ज्ञान को प्राप्त करता है अतएव इसको स॑ ज्ञा माहात्म्य है। विन्दन अर्थात् प्राप्त करने एवं वेदन अर्थात् ज्ञान के कारण तथा उसमें सब कुछ एवं यह सब में विद्यमान रहता है इसलिये
verses.wordMeaning: Ether is a perforated (void) extensive expanse and is characterized by the subtle element called sound and is again enveloped by the cosmic Ego ( Bhutadi ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ether is a perforated (void) extensive expanse and is characterized by the subtle element called sound and is again enveloped by the cosmic Ego ( Bhutadi ).

verses.sanskrit: यदैव मम देहात् त्वं समुद्भूता वरानने । तदैव सर्वपापानां मोचिनी त्वं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yadaiva mama dehāt tvaṃ samudbhūtā varānane / tadaiva sarvapāpānāṃ mocinī tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: It is reported that ether characterised by the subtle element sound created the subtle element touch. The Ego under¬ going a change created the subtle element sound. Wind grows powerful and is regarded as having the quality of touch. The powerful air is born of the subtle element of touch. Ether characterised by its subtle element of sound enveloped the subtle element of touch.
verses.hindi: भी इसे विशाल बुद्धि वाले संविद् कहते हैं । ज्ञाननिधि ने इसे ज्ञान रूप होने के कारण ज्ञान कहा है
verses.wordMeaning: It is reported that ether characterised by the subtle element sound created the subtle element touch. The Ego under¬ going a change created the subtle element sound. Wind grows powerful and is regarded as having the quality of touch.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is reported that ether characterised by the subtle element sound created the subtle element touch. The Ego under¬ going a change created the subtle element sound. Wind grows powerful and is regarded as having the quality of touch.…

verses.sanskrit: कल्पक्षयकरे काले काले घोरे विशेषतः । उत्तरं कूलमाश्रित्य निवसन्ति च ये नराः
verses.transliteration: kalpakṣayakare kāle kāle ghore viśeṣataḥ / uttaraṃ kūlamāśritya nivasanti ca ye narāḥ
verses.translation: Water (consisting) of the subtle element of taste is enveloped by the subtle element of colour. Water effecting a change in the subtle element of taste. created the subtle element of smell.
verses.hindi: दुल्दों के विपुर (विशिष्ट स्थान) होने के कारण इसे पण्डित गण विपुर कहते हैं। लोकों का सर्वक्ष होने से यह अवश्य ही ईषवर है। बुहत् होने से बह्मा एवं उद्भूत होने से भव” तथा क्षेत्र के विज्ञान एवं एकत्व के कारण इसे 'क' कहते हैं। पुरी में शयन करता है इस लिये पुरुष कहलाता है। किसी ने इसे उत्पन्न नहीं किया एवं सबसे पहले द्वोंने के हेतु इसे स्वयम्भू कहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Water (consisting) of the subtle element of taste is enveloped by the subtle element of colour. Water effecting a change in the subtle element of taste. created the subtle element of smell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Water (consisting) of the subtle element of taste is enveloped by the subtle element of colour. Water effecting a change in the subtle element of taste. created the subtle element of smell.

verses.sanskrit: अपि कीटपतङ्गाश्च वृक्षगुल्मलतादयः । आ देहपतनाद्देवि ते ऽपि यास्यन्ति सद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: api kīṭapataṅgāśca vṛkṣagulmalatādayaḥ / ā dehapatanāddevi te 'pi yāsyanti sadgatim
verses.translation: Formation of components takes place from that quality. With its particular 'smell', water with its subtle element of taste covered (the earth) consisting of the subtle element of smell. The subtle elements are so called because they have specialities. This is their special characteristic. They are also called Avifesas because they express non-distinguishing charac¬ ters. They are further called AvUesas because they are non- quiescent, non-vehement and non-in telligent.
verses.hindi: पर्यायचाचकैः शब्हैस्तत््वमायमनन॒त्तमम्। व्याख्यातं तरवभावज्ञरेव सद्धा वचिन्त के: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Formation of components takes place from that quality. With its particular 'smell', water with its subtle element of taste covered (the earth) consisting of the subtle element of smell. The subtle elements are so called because they have specialities.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formation of components takes place from that quality. With its particular 'smell', water with its subtle element of taste covered (the earth) consisting of the subtle element of smell. The subtle elements are so called because they have specialities.…

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि तव वाक्येन कस्मिंश्चित् कारणान्तरे । त्वत्तीरे निवसिष्यामि सदैव ह्युमया समम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ hi tava vākyena kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare / tvattīre nivasiṣyāmi sadaiva hyumayā samam
verses.translation: The five organs of knowledge and 'the five organs of Ear, skin, eye, tongue and the fifth nose are the cogni¬ tive organs for knowing sound etc. °
verses.hindi: तस्माच्च तमसोद्रिक्ताद्हंका रादुजायत । भूततन्मात्रसर्गस्तु भूतादिस्तामसस्तु सः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The five organs of knowledge and 'the five organs of Ear, skin, eye, tongue and the fifth nose are the cogni¬ tive organs for knowing sound etc. °
verses.commentary: Sense: The five organs of knowledge and 'the five organs of Ear, skin, eye, tongue and the fifth nose are the cogni¬ tive organs for knowing sound etc. °

verses.sanskrit: एवं देवि महादेवि एवमेव न संशयः । ब्रह्मेन्द्रचन्द्रवरुणैः साध्यैश्च सह विष्णुना
verses.transliteration: evaṃ devi mahādevi evameva na saṃśayaḥ / brahmendracandravaruṇaiḥ sādhyaiśca saha viṣṇunā
verses.translation: Legs, anus, organ of generation, hands and the tenth organ speech are the organs of action. Their functions are. movement, evacuation, pleasure seeking, manual work and speech.
verses.hindi: भूतादिस्तु विकुर्वाण: शब्दमाज ससर्ज ह। (+आकाश शुषिरं तस्मादुद्विक्त शब्द्लक्षणम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Legs, anus, organ of generation, hands and the tenth organ speech are the organs of action. Their functions are. movement, evacuation, pleasure seeking, manual work and speech.
verses.commentary: Sense: Legs, anus, organ of generation, hands and the tenth organ speech are the organs of action. Their functions are. movement, evacuation, pleasure seeking, manual work and speech.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे देवि ते कूले वसिष्यन्ति ममाज्ञया । दक्षिणे पितृभिः सार्द्धं तथान्ये सुरसुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: uttare devi te kūle vasiṣyanti mamājñayā / dakṣiṇe pitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ tathānye surasundari
verses.translation: Ether, the subtle element of which is sound, penetrates the subtle element of touch. Therefore, air consists of two attributes: sound and touch. When the two attributes, viz. sound and touch penet¬ rate the quality, 'colour', fire becomes endowed with three attributes, viz. sound, touch and colour.
verses.hindi: आंकाओ शब्दमाज्न तु भूतादिश्याउ5वबृणोत्पुनः  शब्दमात्र तदाकाश स्पशंमात्र ससज हू
verses.wordMeaning: Ether, the subtle element of which is sound, penetrates the subtle element of touch. Therefore, air consists of two attributes: sound and touch. When the two attributes, viz. sound and touch penet¬ rate the quality, 'colour', fire becomes endowed with three attributes, viz.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ether, the subtle element of which is sound, penetrates the subtle element of touch. Therefore, air consists of two attributes: sound and touch. When the two attributes, viz. sound and touch penet¬ rate the quality, 'colour', fire becomes endowed with three attributes, viz.…

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्यन्ति मया सार्द्धमेष ते वर उत्तमः । गच्छ गच्छ महाभागे मर्त्यान्पापाद्विमोचय
verses.transliteration: vasiṣyanti mayā sārddhameṣa te vara uttamaḥ / gaccha gaccha mahābhāge martyānpāpādvimocaya
verses.translation: Along with the (qualities) of sound, touch and colour it penetrated the subtle element of taste. Therefrom water characterised by taste should be known to possess four attributes.
verses.hindi: बलवाओआयते वायुः स थे स्पर्शयुणो मतः । आकाश शब्दमात्न॑ तु स्पशेमाज समाधुणोत्
verses.wordMeaning: Along with the (qualities) of sound, touch and colour it penetrated the subtle element of taste. Therefrom water characterised by taste should be known to possess four attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with the (qualities) of sound, touch and colour it penetrated the subtle element of taste. Therefrom water characterised by taste should be known to possess four attributes.

verses.sanskrit: सहिता ऋषिसंघैश्च तथा सिद्धसुरासुरैः । एवमुक्ता महादेव उमया सहितो विभुः
verses.transliteration: sahitā ṛṣisaṃghaiśca tathā siddhasurāsuraiḥ / evamuktā mahādeva umayā sahito vibhuḥ
verses.translation: The subtle element of smell entered them along with sound, touch and colour. Then (water) in conjunction with the subtle element of - smell produces earth. Among all gross elements, earth alone possesses five attri¬ butes. The gross elements are called Vifesas because they are quiescent, terrific and non-intelligent. These sustain one another because they penetrate one another.
verses.hindi: वायुश्राप विकुर्वाणों रूपमा्ज ससर्ज ह। ज्योतिरूत पद्यते वायोस्तद्वुपगुणमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: The subtle element of smell entered them along with sound, touch and colour. Then (water) in conjunction with the subtle element of - smell produces earth. Among all gross elements, earth alone possesses five attri¬ butes.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The subtle element of smell entered them along with sound, touch and colour. Then (water) in conjunction with the subtle element of - smell produces earth. Among all gross elements, earth alone possesses five attri¬ butes.…

verses.sanskrit: वन्द्यमानो ऽथ मनुना मया चादर्शनं गतः । तेन चैषा महापुण्या महापातकनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: vandyamāno 'tha manunā mayā cādarśanaṃ gataḥ / tena caiṣā mahāpuṇyā mahāpātakanāśinī
verses.translation: Within earth is this entire cosmos surrounded firmly" by Lokaloka. The ViSesas are perceivable by the sense organs and are limited (as they are fixed and determined) •
verses.hindi: संभवन्ति ततो ह्यापः पश्चात्तापै रखसात्मिकाः । रसमात्रस्तु ता ह्यापो रूपमात्राभिराक्षुणोत्
verses.wordMeaning: Within earth is this entire cosmos surrounded firmly" by Lokaloka. The ViSesas are perceivable by the sense organs and are limited (as they are fixed and determined) •
verses.commentary: Sense: Within earth is this entire cosmos surrounded firmly" by Lokaloka. The ViSesas are perceivable by the sense organs and are limited (as they are fixed and determined) •

verses.sanskrit: कथिता पृच्छ्यते या ते मा ते भवतु विस्मयः । एषा गंगा महापुण्या त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: kathitā pṛcchyate yā te mā te bhavatu vismayaḥ / eṣā gaṃgā mahāpuṇyā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā
verses.translation: 'Having sensed smell from fire, some, out of ignorance, (may believe it) as emanating from air. It should be know that it (smell) is only in earth (i.e. it is the exclusive quahty of earth). And they (the particles of earth) take resort to (i.e. are found in) air (hence its smell). Like a bubble out of water, the egg was born (sudden¬ ly) all at a time from Visesas. What was the vast mass of water therein performed the work of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: दशाभिः पञ्चभिः स्रोतैः प्लावयन्ती दिशो दश । शोणो महानदश्चैव नर्मदा सुरसा कृता
verses.transliteration: daśābhiḥ pañcabhiḥ srotaiḥ plāvayantī diśo daśa / śoṇo mahānadaścaiva narmadā surasā kṛtā
verses.translation: The Ksclrajna designated as Brahma (the cosmic prin¬ ciple of activity) woke up in the egg of Prakrti. He is verily the first embodied being. He is called Purusa.
verses.hindi: एवं तामस रूप से त्रिगुण है ऐसा जानना चाहिए ।०५-४७। त्रिगुण में रजोगुण की अधिकता से अहद्धार उत्पन्न हुआ, वह महान् से आवृत, आदि भूत और विक्षत था यह सृष्टि महत्तत्त्व से रुकी थी । उस तमोबहुल अहड्भार से भूततन्मात्र की सृष्टि हुई । वह भूता दि अहंकार तामस ही तो है । भूतादि के विकृत होने पर छाब्द तन्मात्रा की सृष्टि हुई और उससे शब्द लक्षण वाला महाविवर आकाझ उत्पन्न हुआ ।४८-५०। फिर भूतादि अहंकार
verses.wordMeaning: The Ksclrajna designated as Brahma (the cosmic prin¬ ciple of activity) woke up in the egg of Prakrti. He is verily the first embodied being. He is called Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Ksclrajna designated as Brahma (the cosmic prin¬ ciple of activity) woke up in the egg of Prakrti. He is verily the first embodied being. He is called Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: मन्दाकिनी दशार्णा च चित्रकूटा तथैव च । तमसा विदिशा चैव करभा यमुना तथा
verses.transliteration: mandākinī daśārṇā ca citrakūṭā tathaiva ca / tamasā vidiśā caiva karabhā yamunā tathā
verses.translation: He is the first creator of living beings. He existed in the very beginning manifesting himself as the four-faced Hiranyagarbha. In the primary and the secondary creation, the Ksetrajna is termed Bralima. Living beings are created along with the sense- organs which they give up at the time of dissolution. Living beings resort to bodies again in the transitional periods charac¬ terized by non-aggregation.
verses.hindi: ने शब्द मात्र आकाश को ढक लिया और उस दाब्दमात्र आकाश ने स्पशतन्मात्रा के. सृष्टि की । उससे बलवान वायु उत्पन्न हुआ उसका गुण स्पर्श है। शब्दमात्र आकाश ने स्पशंमात्र को ढक लिया। वायु ने विक्ृत होकर रूप तन्मात्रा की सृष्टि की । वायु से ज्योति की उत्पत्ति होती है । ज्योति का ग्रुण रूप कहा जाता है। वायु की स्पश्शतन्मात्रा को रूपतन्मात्रा ने आच्छादित कर लिया । फिर ज्योति की विक्ति से रस तन्मात्रा की उत्पत्ति
verses.wordMeaning: He is the first creator of living beings. He existed in the very beginning manifesting himself as the four-faced Hiranyagarbha. In the primary and the secondary creation, the Ksetrajna is termed Bralima.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the first creator of living beings. He existed in the very beginning manifesting himself as the four-faced Hiranyagarbha. In the primary and the secondary creation, the Ksetrajna is termed Bralima.…

verses.sanskrit: चित्रोत्पला विपाशा च रञ्जना वालुवाहिनी । ऋक्षपादप्रसूतास्ताः सर्वा वै रुद्रसंभवाः
verses.transliteration: citrotpalā vipāśā ca rañjanā vāluvāhinī / ṛkṣapādaprasūtāstāḥ sarvā vai rudrasaṃbhavāḥ
verses.translation: The golden Meru is the foetus of that grcat-souled one. The oceans constitute the embryonic liquid and the moun¬ tains, the embryonic membrane and the bones.
verses.hindi: हुई ।१५१-५४। तत्पश्चात्र ताप से रसमय जल की सृष्टि होती है। जल की यह तन्मात्रा भी रूप-तन्मात्रा से आवृत होती हैं। जलीय रसमात्रा की विक्ृति से गन्धमात्रा का उद्भव हुआ। इसी से संघात (पृथ्वी) होता है उसका गुण गन्ध है। रसमात्रा वाला तोय गन्ध मात्रा को भूतों में ढके रहा। उन उन शभूतों में वह बह
verses.wordMeaning: The golden Meru is the foetus of that grcat-souled one. The oceans constitute the embryonic liquid and the moun¬ tains, the embryonic membrane and the bones.
verses.commentary: Sense: The golden Meru is the foetus of that grcat-souled one. The oceans constitute the embryonic liquid and the moun¬ tains, the embryonic membrane and the bones.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापहराः पुण्याः सर्वमंगलदाः शिवाः । इत्येतैर्नामभिर्दिव्यैः स्तूयते वेदपारगैः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpaharāḥ puṇyāḥ sarvamaṃgaladāḥ śivāḥ / ityetairnāmabhirdivyaiḥ stūyate vedapāragaiḥ
verses.translation: The seven worlds and this earth with the seven conti¬ nents and seven oceans lie within the cosmic egg. The moon, the sun, along with the stars, planets, the air, the Lokaloka mountain and whatever exists is included (i.e. present) m the cosmic egg.
verses.hindi: +पनुश्चिह्नान्तगंतग्रन्थः ख- पुस्तके नास्ति   इदमर्ध ऊ. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: The seven worlds and this earth with the seven conti¬ nents and seven oceans lie within the cosmic egg. The moon, the sun, along with the stars, planets, the air, the Lokaloka mountain and whatever exists is included (i.e. present) m the cosmic egg.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven worlds and this earth with the seven conti¬ nents and seven oceans lie within the cosmic egg. The moon, the sun, along with the stars, planets, the air, the Lokaloka mountain and whatever exists is included (i.e. present) m the cosmic egg.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणज्ञैर् महाभागैराज्यपैः सोमपैस्तथा । इत्येतत्सर्वमाख्यातं महाभाग्यं नरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: purāṇajñair mahābhāgairājyapaiḥ somapaistathā / ityetatsarvamākhyātaṃ mahābhāgyaṃ narottama
verses.translation: Fire is externally enveloped by air ten times its size The air is surrounded externally by ether ten times its size. '
verses.hindi: ३० द वॉयुपुराणम रसमाज्ं तु तत्तोयं गन्धमातं समावुणोत् । तस्मिस्तस्मिस्तु तन्मात्रा तेन तन्मात्रता स्खुता
verses.wordMeaning: Fire is externally enveloped by air ten times its size The air is surrounded externally by ether ten times its size. '
verses.commentary: Sense: Fire is externally enveloped by air ten times its size The air is surrounded externally by ether ten times its size. '

verses.sanskrit: मनुनोक्तं पुरा मह्यम् अमृतायाः समुद्भवम् । पुण्यं पवित्रमतुलं रुद्रोद्गीतमिदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: manunoktaṃ purā mahyam amṛtāyāḥ samudbhavam / puṇyaṃ pavitramatulaṃ rudrodgītamidaṃ śubham
