verses.sanskrit: ये नराः कीर्तयिष्यन्ति भक्त्या शृण्वन्ति ये ऽपि च । प्रातरुत्थाय नामानि दश पञ्च च भारत
verses.transliteration: ye narāḥ kīrtayiṣyanti bhaktyā śṛṇvanti ye 'pi ca / prātarutthāya nāmāni daśa pañca ca bhārata
verses.translation: Thus generated mutually, they sustain one another as the sustainer and the sustained in their primary and secondary relationship.
verses.hindi: वैकारिकः स सर्गस्तु युगपत्संप्रवर्तते। बुद्धीन्द्रारि पश्चेच पश्च कर्मेन्द्रियाण्यपि
verses.wordMeaning: Thus generated mutually, they sustain one another as the sustainer and the sustained in their primary and secondary relationship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus generated mutually, they sustain one another as the sustainer and the sustained in their primary and secondary relationship.

verses.sanskrit: ते नराः सकलं पुण्यं लभिष्यन्त्यवगाहजम् । विमानेनार्कवर्णेन घण्टाशतनिनादिना
verses.transliteration: te narāḥ sakalaṃ puṇyaṃ labhiṣyantyavagāhajam / vimānenārkavarṇena ghaṇṭāśataninādinā
verses.translation: The unmanifest (unconscious principle) is called Kselra and Brahma (the conscious principle) is called Ksetrajna. Thus the creation of Prakrti is presided over by Ksetrajna. It existed in the beginning without intellect. It appeared all of a sudden like lightning. He who understands factually the manifestation of Brahma, becomes endowed with fame, longevity, wealth and progeny.
verses.hindi: साधकानीन्द्रियाणि स्युद्वा वैकारिका दश  एकाद््श मनस्तभ्र देवा वैकारिकाः स्खृताः
verses.wordMeaning: The unmanifest (unconscious principle) is called Kselra and Brahma (the conscious principle) is called Ksetrajna. Thus the creation of Prakrti is presided over by Ksetrajna. It existed in the beginning without intellect. It appeared all of a sudden like lightning.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The unmanifest (unconscious principle) is called Kselra and Brahma (the conscious principle) is called Ksetrajna. Thus the creation of Prakrti is presided over by Ksetrajna. It existed in the beginning without intellect. It appeared all of a sudden like lightning.…

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा मानुष्यकं भावं यास्यन्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā mānuṣyakaṃ bhāvaṃ yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Even if a man has renounced desires, he becomes pure- souled and attains his goal. By listening to this Purana every¬ day one can attain pleasure and welfare.
verses.hindi: भ्रोत्न त्वक्चज्षुषी जिह्डा नासिका चैव पश्चमी ॥ शब्दादीनामवाप्त्य्थ बुद्धियुक्तानि बच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Even if a man has renounced desires, he becomes pure- souled and attains his goal. By listening to this Purana every¬ day one can attain pleasure and welfare.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if a man has renounced desires, he becomes pure- souled and attains his goal. By listening to this Purana every¬ day one can attain pleasure and welfare.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदापञ्चदशनामवर्णनं नाम चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ५ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: आश्चर्यमेतदखिलं कथितं भो द्विजोत्तम । विस्मयं परमापन्ना ऋषिसंघा मया सह
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāpañcadaśanāmavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 5 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: āścaryametadakhilaṃ kathitaṃ bho dvijottama / vismayaṃ paramāpannā ṛṣisaṃghā mayā saha
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the period of time calculated by me for the creation (of the universe) should be known as one day of the supreme Lord.
verses.hindi: पादौ पायुरुपस्थश्व इस्तो चाग्द्शमी भवेत्  गतिविंसगों छ्यानन्दः शित्पं थाक्यं च कर्म च
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the period of time calculated by me for the creation (of the universe) should be known as one day of the supreme Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the period of time calculated by me for the creation (of the universe) should be known as one day of the supreme Lord.

verses.sanskrit: अहो भगवती पुण्या नर्मदेयमयोनिजा । रुद्रदेहाद्विनिष्क्रान्ता महापापक्षयंकरी
verses.transliteration: aho bhagavatī puṇyā narmadeyamayonijā / rudradehādviniṣkrāntā mahāpāpakṣayaṃkarī
verses.translation: The night of the great Lord should also be known as entirely of the same duration. The period of creation is his day and the period of dissolution is called his night.
verses.hindi: आकाश शब्दमाज च स्पशमाज समाविशत्  द्विगुणस्तु ततो वायुः शब्द्स्पर्शात्म को5भच त्
verses.wordMeaning: The night of the great Lord should also be known as entirely of the same duration. The period of creation is his day and the period of dissolution is called his night.
verses.commentary: Sense: The night of the great Lord should also be known as entirely of the same duration. The period of creation is his day and the period of dissolution is called his night.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तकल्पक्षये प्राप्ते त्वयेयं सह सुव्रत । न मृता च महाभागा किमतः पुण्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: saptakalpakṣaye prāpte tvayeyaṃ saha suvrata / na mṛtā ca mahābhāgā kimataḥ puṇyamuttamam
verses.translation: It is held that he (Brahma) has only the day and no night. But such assumption is made just for the benefit of the world.
verses.hindi: स शब्द्स्पशेख्पश्च रसमात्र॑ समाविशत्  तस्माच्चतुर्गुणा ह्यापो विज्लेयास्ता रसात्मिकाः
verses.wordMeaning: It is held that he (Brahma) has only the day and no night. But such assumption is made just for the benefit of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is held that he (Brahma) has only the day and no night. But such assumption is made just for the benefit of the world.

verses.sanskrit: के ते कल्पाः समुद्दिष्टाः सप्त कल्पक्षयंकराः । न मृता चेदियं देवी त्वं चैव ऋषिपुंगव
verses.transliteration: ke te kalpāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ sapta kalpakṣayaṃkarāḥ / na mṛtā cediyaṃ devī tvaṃ caiva ṛṣipuṃgava
verses.translation: The subjects, the patriarchs, the seers ofVedic Man¬ tras along with ascetics, eternally youthful sages like Sanat-
verses.hindi: परस्पराजुप्रवेशाद्धारयन्ति परस्परम् । भ्रूमेस्न्तर्त्विदूं स्च॑लोकालोकघनाबुतम् ॥६८ . विशेषा इन्द्रियप्राह्मा नियतत्वाच्च ते रुछुताः । गुर पूर्वंस्य पूर्व स्य प्राप्ु वन्त्युत्तरोत्तरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects, the patriarchs, the seers ofVedic Man¬ tras along with ascetics, eternally youthful sages like Sanat-
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects, the patriarchs, the seers ofVedic Man¬ tras along with ascetics, eternally youthful sages like Sanat-

verses.sanskrit: अपक्षिगणसंघाते जगत्येकार्णवीकृते । कीदृग्रूपः समभवन्महादेवो युगक्षये
verses.transliteration: apakṣigaṇasaṃghāte jagatyekārṇavīkṛte / kīdṛgrūpaḥ samabhavanmahādevo yugakṣaye
verses.translation: When the quality Saliva stays in itself and when the secondary creation is withdrawn, both Pradhana and Purusa become similar (i.e. inactive).
verses.hindi: (शब्द आदि) भात्रा रहती हैं इसलिये तन्मात्रा नाम पड़ा । नाम अविशेष होने तथा श्ान्त घोर एवं फिर मृढ़ न  होने के कारण इन तन्मात्राओं को अविशेष कहते हैं ।१५-४५८। इन भूतों ओर तन्मात्राओं की सृष्टि को पारस्परिक समझना चाहिए । अन्य सात्त्विक वेकारिक अहंकार से सत्त्व के उद्रेक के कारण वेकारिक सृष्टि एक साथ प्रवत्त होती है। पाँच ज्ञानेन्द्रियाँ तथा पाँच कर्मेन्द्रियाँ है। साधक या करण का नाम इन्द्रिय है। थे दश वेकारिक
verses.wordMeaning: When the quality Saliva stays in itself and when the secondary creation is withdrawn, both Pradhana and Purusa become similar (i.e. inactive).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the quality Saliva stays in itself and when the secondary creation is withdrawn, both Pradhana and Purusa become similar (i.e. inactive).

verses.sanskrit: कथं संहरते विश्वं कथं चास्ते महार्णवे । कथं च सृजते विश्वं कथं धारयते प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ saṃharate viśvaṃ kathaṃ cāste mahārṇave / kathaṃ ca sṛjate viśvaṃ kathaṃ dhārayate prajāḥ
verses.translation: The qualities Tamas and Sattva stay in a state of equilibrium. When there is equilibrium in the qualities mutually, it should be known as dissolution; when there is disequilibrium of the gunas, it is called creation (i.e. creation takes place).
verses.hindi: देव हैं । ग्यारहवाँ मन भी वेकारिक देव ही है। श्रोत्र, त्वचा, चक्षु, जिह्ना एवं पाँचवीं नासिका ये छाब्द आदि को प्राप्ति या बोध के निमित्त हैं, इन्हें ज्ञानेन्द्रिय कहते हैं। दोनों पाद, ग्रुदा, लिग, दोनों हाथ तथा दसवीं इन्द्रिय वाणी है । इनके कर्मगति, विसग आनन्द, शिल्प तथा वाक्य हैं। छाब्द मात्र आकाश ने स्पद्मं मात्र में प्रवेश किया अतएवं वायु शब्द एवं स्पर्ं दो गुणों वाला हु आ ।५६-६४। बैसे ही शब्द तथा स्पश ये दोनों गुण
verses.wordMeaning: The qualities Tamas and Sattva stay in a state of equilibrium. When there is equilibrium in the qualities mutually, it should be known as dissolution; when there is disequilibrium of the gunas, it is called creation (i.e. creation takes place).
verses.commentary: Sense: The qualities Tamas and Sattva stay in a state of equilibrium. When there is equilibrium in the qualities mutually, it should be known as dissolution; when there is disequilibrium of the gunas, it is called creation (i.e. creation takes place).

verses.sanskrit: कीदृग्रूपा भवेद्देवी सरिद् एकार्णवीकृते । किमर्थं नर्मदा प्रोक्ता रेवती च कथं स्मृता
verses.transliteration: kīdṛgrūpā bhaveddevī sarid ekārṇavīkṛte / kimarthaṃ narmadā proktā revatī ca kathaṃ smṛtā
verses.translation: Just as oil abides in the gingelly seeds or ghee in milk, so does the quality Rajas stay unmanifest in Sattva and Tamas.
verses.hindi: रूप में आविष्ट हुए और उससे शब्द, स्पशे तथा रूप इन तीनों गुणों वाली अग्नि हुई। शब्द, स्पर्श एवं रूप फिर रसमात्र में समांवष्ट हुए और उनसे चारों गुणों वाला रसमय जल हुआ । इन ग्रुणों से गन्ध संयुक्त हुआ ओर उससे यह पृथ्वी उत्पन्न हुई। इसीलिये स्थूल भूतों में पृथिवी पाँच गुणों वाली दीखती है। इसी हेतु ये स्थूल भूत शान्‍्त घोर तथा मूढ़ और विशेष कहे गये हैं (६५-६८। एक दूसरे में प्रविष्ट होने के कारण ये
verses.wordMeaning: Just as oil abides in the gingelly seeds or ghee in milk, so does the quality Rajas stay unmanifest in Sattva and Tamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as oil abides in the gingelly seeds or ghee in milk, so does the quality Rajas stay unmanifest in Sattva and Tamas.

verses.sanskrit: अञ्जनेति किमर्थं वा किमर्थं सुरसेति च । मन्दाकिनी किमर्थं च शोणश्चेति कथं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: añjaneti kimarthaṃ vā kimarthaṃ suraseti ca / mandākinī kimarthaṃ ca śoṇaśceti kathaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Entering the cosmic Egg, the great god caused, by his supreme Yoga, agitation in Pradhana and Purusa. 1
verses.hindi: एक दूसरे को भारण करते हैं । यह सब केवल लोकालोक से सम्पूर्णतया आच्छन्न भूमि के भीतर हैं । इच्द्रिय प्राह्म तथा नियत होने के कारण ये विशेष कहलाते हैं । पूव॑ं-पूर्व के गुण उत्तर उत्तर में मिलाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Entering the cosmic Egg, the great god caused, by his supreme Yoga, agitation in Pradhana and Purusa. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Entering the cosmic Egg, the great god caused, by his supreme Yoga, agitation in Pradhana and Purusa. 1

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकूटेति किमर्थं वा किमर्थं वालुवाहिनी । कोटिकोट्यो हि तीर्थानां प्रविष्टा या महार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: trikūṭeti kimarthaṃ vā kimarthaṃ vāluvāhinī / koṭikoṭyo hi tīrthānāṃ praviṣṭā yā mahārṇavam
verses.translation: From. Pradhana that was being agitated, Rajas was produced. It is Rajas that causes the activity even as water causes the activity in the seeds.
verses.hindi: नेर्षा यावच्च यद्यच्च तत्तत्तावदुगुर्ण स्म्तम्। उपलब्य शुच्चेगन्ध॑ केचिद्वायो रनैषुणात्
verses.wordMeaning: From. Pradhana that was being agitated, Rajas was produced. It is Rajas that causes the activity even as water causes the activity in the seeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: From. Pradhana that was being agitated, Rajas was produced. It is Rajas that causes the activity even as water causes the activity in the seeds.

verses.sanskrit: कियत्यः सरितां कोट्यो नर्मदां समुपासते । यज्ञोपवीतैरृषिभिर् देवताभिस् तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kiyatyaḥ saritāṃ koṭyo narmadāṃ samupāsate / yajñopavītairṛṣibhir devatābhis tathaiva ca
verses.translation: The Rajas quality became Sattva becomes Visnu. Brahma,
verses.hindi: नाशवलुवन्प्रजाः स्रष्ठुमसमागस्य रृत्काशः। ते समेत्य महात्मानों हान्योन्यस्येव संश्रयात् )।
verses.wordMeaning: The Rajas quality became Sattva becomes Visnu. Brahma,
verses.commentary: Sense: The Rajas quality became Sattva becomes Visnu. Brahma,

verses.sanskrit: विभक्तेयं किमर्थं च श्रूयते मुनिसत्तम । वैष्णवीति पुराणज्ञैः किमर्थमिह चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: vibhakteyaṃ kimarthaṃ ca śrūyate munisattama / vaiṣṇavīti purāṇajñaiḥ kimarthamiha cocyate
verses.translation: Ksobha 'agitation' is a process of contraction and cyclic. It is called * Samailcana-Prasdraiia' in Sat Br 8 I Vik&sa' in KP. I. 4. 15.
verses.hindi: (+एककार्ल, समुत्पन्न॑ जलबुदूबुृदवच्च तत् ।' विशेषेभ्यो डण्डमभवदब चइत्त दुदक च्त यत् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Ksobha 'agitation' is a process of contraction and cyclic. It is called * Samailcana-Prasdraiia' in Sat Br 8 I Vik&sa' in KP. I. 4. 15.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksobha 'agitation' is a process of contraction and cyclic. It is called * Samailcana-Prasdraiia' in Sat Br 8 I Vik&sa' in KP. I. 4. 15.

verses.sanskrit: केषु स्थानेषु तीर्थेषु पूजनीया सरिद्वरा । तीर्थानि च पृथग्ब्रूहि यत्र संनिहितो हरः
verses.transliteration: keṣu sthāneṣu tīrtheṣu pūjanīyā saridvarā / tīrthāni ca pṛthagbrūhi yatra saṃnihito haraḥ
verses.translation: Fire, the illuminator of Tamos, abides in the capacity of Kala. Visnu, the illuminator of Sattva, remains indifferent.
verses.hindi: तत्तस्मिन्कायेक रण संसिद्ध ब्रह्मणस्तदा  प्राकृतेडण्डे विच्वुद्धो सम्क्षेत्रशों अद्यसंहितः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Fire, the illuminator of Tamos, abides in the capacity of Kala. Visnu, the illuminator of Sattva, remains indifferent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fire, the illuminator of Tamos, abides in the capacity of Kala. Visnu, the illuminator of Sattva, remains indifferent.

verses.sanskrit: यत्प्रमाणा च सा देवी या रुद्रेण विनिर्मिता । कीदृशानि च कर्माणि रुद्रेण कथितानि ते
verses.transliteration: yatpramāṇā ca sā devī yā rudreṇa vinirmitā / kīdṛśāni ca karmāṇi rudreṇa kathitāni te
verses.translation: These alone are the three gods* and the three fires. The\ are mutually dependent, devoted and faithful to one an¬ other.
verses.hindi: स यै शरीरी प्रथमः स थे पुरुष उच्यते) । आदिकर्ता च भूतानां ब्रह्माउप्ते समचतत
verses.wordMeaning: These alone are the three gods* and the three fires. The\ are mutually dependent, devoted and faithful to one an¬ other.
verses.commentary: Sense: These alone are the three gods* and the three fires. The\ are mutually dependent, devoted and faithful to one an¬ other.

verses.sanskrit: कथं म्लेच्छसमाकीर्णो देशो ऽयं द्विजसत्तम । एतदाचक्ष्व मां ब्रह्मन्मार्कण्डेय महामते
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ mlecchasamākīrṇo deśo 'yaṃ dvijasattama / etadācakṣva māṃ brahmanmārkaṇḍeya mahāmate
verses.translation: They function jointly, sustain one another; they are ever in association with one another. They subsist on one another. There is no separation among them even for a moment. They do not leave off one another.
verses.hindi: करण सह राज्यन्ते प्रत्याहारे व्यजन्ति च। भजनते च॒ पुनदंहानसमाहारसंधिणु
verses.wordMeaning: They function jointly, sustain one another; they are ever in association with one another. They subsist on one another. There is no separation among them even for a moment. They do not leave off one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: They function jointly, sustain one another; they are ever in association with one another. They subsist on one another. There is no separation among them even for a moment. They do not leave off one another.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृण्वन्तु ऋषयः सर्वे त्वं च तात युधिष्ठिर । पुराणं नर्मदायां तु कथितं च त्रिशूलिना
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve tvaṃ ca tāta yudhiṣṭhira / purāṇaṃ narmadāyāṃ tu kathitaṃ ca triśūlinā
verses.translation: Isvara is the highest deity. Visnu is greater than Mahal. Brahma, with dominant Rajas, functions for the purpose of creation. Purusa is known as Para (the supreme) and Prakrtias Para (great).
verses.hindi: तस्मिश्नण्डे त्विमे लोका अस्तमूंतास्तु सप्त वै । सप्तद्वीपा च पृथिघी समुद्रैः सह सप्तभिः ।८रै
verses.wordMeaning: Isvara is the highest deity. Visnu is greater than Mahal. Brahma, with dominant Rajas, functions for the purpose of creation. Purusa is known as Para (the supreme) and Prakrtias Para (great).
verses.commentary: Sense: Isvara is the highest deity. Visnu is greater than Mahal. Brahma, with dominant Rajas, functions for the purpose of creation. Purusa is known as Para (the supreme) and Prakrtias Para (great).

verses.sanskrit: वायोः सकाशाच्च मया तेनापि च महेश्वरात् । अशक्यत्वान्मनुष्याणां संक्षिप्तम् ऋषिभिः पुरा
verses.transliteration: vāyoḥ sakāśācca mayā tenāpi ca maheśvarāt / aśakyatvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ saṃkṣiptam ṛṣibhiḥ purā
verses.translation: He (Brahma) functions on being presided over by Mahesvara and being urged all round. Mahat and other (creations ofPrakrti) long stationed in their respective objects due to attachment, function thereafter.
verses.hindi: प्॑तैः समहर्िश्ध नदीभिश्च सहस्तनशः । अन्तस्तस्मिरित्वमे लोका अन्तविश्वमिदं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: He (Brahma) functions on being presided over by Mahesvara and being urged all round. Mahat and other (creations ofPrakrti) long stationed in their respective objects due to attachment, function thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He (Brahma) functions on being presided over by Mahesvara and being urged all round. Mahat and other (creations ofPrakrti) long stationed in their respective objects due to attachment, function thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: मायूरं प्रथमं तात कौर्म्यम् च तदनन्तरम् । पुरम् तथा कौशिकं च मात्स्यं द्विरदम् एव च
verses.transliteration: māyūraṃ prathamaṃ tāta kaurmyam ca tadanantaram / puram tathā kauśikaṃ ca mātsyaṃ dviradam eva ca
verses.translation: Due to the disequilibrium of the qualities, Pradhana begins to function at the time of creation. From Pradhana, which is of the nature of Sat and Asat, presided over by Isvara, the pair Brahma and Buddhi{ cosmic intelligence) are born simultaneously.
verses.hindi: इन सबों के जितने जितने और जो जो गुण हैं उनके वे सब बताये गये हैं। किसी को शुद्ध वायु में अपने दोष के कारण गरध गुण मिलता है। वह गन्ध पृथिवी का ही समझना चाहिए, क्योंकि वहाँ वायु में पृथ्वी तत्व मिला है। ये सातों महाबली पृथक्-पृथक् अनेक होकर बिना पूर्णतया मिले प्रजाओं की सृष्टि नहीं कर सके ।७१-७२। तब महत् तत्त्व से लेकर विशेष पयेन्‍्त ये महत्तत्व एक दूसरे के आधार बनकर पुरुष के अधिष्ठान
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the disequilibrium of the qualities, Pradhana begins to function at the time of creation. From Pradhana, which is of the nature of Sat and Asat, presided over by Isvara, the pair Brahma and Buddhi{ cosmic intelligence) are born simultaneously.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the disequilibrium of the qualities, Pradhana begins to function at the time of creation. From Pradhana, which is of the nature of Sat and Asat, presided over by Isvara, the pair Brahma and Buddhi{ cosmic intelligence) are born simultaneously.

verses.sanskrit: वाराहं यन्मया दृष्टं वैष्णवं चाष्टमं परम् । न्यग्रोधाख्यम् अतः चासीद् आकाङ्क्षं पुनरुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vārāhaṃ yanmayā dṛṣṭaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ param / nyagrodhākhyam ataḥ cāsīd ākāṅkṣaṃ punaruttamam
verses.translation: Then the Kselrajha termed Brahma, of the nature of Tamas and the unmanifest, manifests himself in the beginning, fully equipped with sense-organs for all activities.
verses.hindi: तथा अव्यक्त के अनुग्रह से अण्ड की उत्पत्ति करते हैं। एक ही समय विशेषों से वह् अण्ड उस विपुल जल से पानी के बुलबुले की भाँति उत्पन्न हुआ। उससे ब्रह्मा का कार्यकरण सिद्ध हुआ  प्राकृत अण्ड के विकसित होने पर उसमें से सत् स्वरूप क्षेत्र ब्रह्मा हुए ।७३-७६) वही प्रथम शरीरी हैं उन्हीं कों पुरुष कहते हैं। भूतों के आदि कर्ता ब्रह्मा ही पहले रहे । सगे या प्रतिसर्ग में पहले पहल वही हिरिण्यगर्भ चतुर्मुख ब्रह्म नामक क्षेत्रज्ञ प्रकट होते
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Kselrajha termed Brahma, of the nature of Tamas and the unmanifest, manifests himself in the beginning, fully equipped with sense-organs for all activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Kselrajha termed Brahma, of the nature of Tamas and the unmanifest, manifests himself in the beginning, fully equipped with sense-organs for all activities.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मं च तामसं चैव संवर्तोद्वर्तमेव च । महाप्रलयमित्याहुः पुराणे वेदचिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration: padmaṃ ca tāmasaṃ caiva saṃvartodvartameva ca / mahāpralayamityāhuḥ purāṇe vedacintakāḥ
verses.translation: He, the unmanifest endowed with intellect shines forth with brilliance. He is verily the first embodied being abiding in the capacity of a cause.
verses.hindi: हैं। सृष्टि काल में करणों के साथ इनकी सृष्टि होती है फिर प्रलयकाल में करणों को त्याग देते हैं और (पुनः असमाहार सन्धियों में शरीरों को ग्रहण कर लेते हैं । जो स्वर्णमय मेरु है वही उस महात्मा का उल्ब (कलल) है। समुद्र उसका गर्भ-जल तथा पर्वत उसकी जरादि हडिडयाँ हैं ॥७७-८५०। उस अण्ड के भीतर ये सारे सातों लोक तथा सातों समुद्रों के साथ सात द्वीप।वली पूथिवी छिपी हुई है ।८१। सहसरों बड़ी नदियों और परवेतों के साथ
verses.wordMeaning: He, the unmanifest endowed with intellect shines forth with brilliance. He is verily the first embodied being abiding in the capacity of a cause.
verses.commentary: Sense: He, the unmanifest endowed with intellect shines forth with brilliance. He is verily the first embodied being abiding in the capacity of a cause.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्संक्षेपतः सर्वं संक्षिप्तं तैर्महात्मभिः । विभक्तं च चतुर्भागैर् ब्रह्माद्यैश्च महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: etatsaṃkṣepataḥ sarvaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ tairmahātmabhiḥ / vibhaktaṃ ca caturbhāgair brahmādyaiśca maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: Puranic writers identify Gunas with the triad of gods Brahma, Visnu and Rudra (cf. Bd. P. I. 1. 4-6 and my note on it), LP. I. 70. 77-78. In our text Agni represents Tamas Gupa. But since Vedic times Rudra is identified withAgni, e.g. 1) Tvam ague Rudro asuro maho divah /—RV. II. 1. 6, TS. 1-3.14.1; 2) Tasmai Rudraya namo astuagnayel —A. V. (Atharva Veda) VII.
verses.hindi: ये सब॒ लोक तथा यह समूचा जगत् उसी के भीतर है ।८२। चन्द्रमा, सूर्य, नक्षत्र, ग्रह ओर वायु जो कुछ लोक + धनुश्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रत्थो ड. पुस्तके नास्ति। धनुश्चिह्नान्तगंग्रन्थो ड« पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Puranic writers identify Gunas with the triad of gods Brahma, Visnu and Rudra (cf. Bd. P. I. 1. 4-6 and my note on it), LP. I. 70. 77-78. In our text Agni represents Tamas Gupa. But since Vedic times Rudra is identified withAgni, e.g. 1) Tvam ague Rudro asuro maho divah /—RV.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Puranic writers identify Gunas with the triad of gods Brahma, Visnu and Rudra (cf. Bd. P. I. 1. 4-6 and my note on it), LP. I. 70. 77-78. In our text Agni represents Tamas Gupa. But since Vedic times Rudra is identified withAgni, e.g. 1) Tvam ague Rudro asuro maho divah /—RV.…

verses.sanskrit: तदहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणार्थविशारद । सप्त कल्पा महाघोरा यैर् इयं न मृता सरित्
verses.transliteration: tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi purāṇārthaviśārada / sapta kalpā mahāghorā yair iyaṃ na mṛtā sarit
verses.translation: He is equipped with unobstructable knowledge and supreme lordship. He is endowed with unobstructed dharma and detachment.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रादित्यों सनक्षत्रौ सम्रहौ सह चायुना  लोकालोक॑ च यत्किचिच्चाण्डे तस्मिन्लमपिंतम ॥ अद्धिदंशगुणाभिस्तु बाह्यतो5०्डं समाघृतम्। आपो दशगुरणा होव॑ तेजसा बाह्यतो बता;
verses.wordMeaning: He is equipped with unobstructable knowledge and supreme lordship. He is endowed with unobstructed dharma and detachment.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is equipped with unobstructable knowledge and supreme lordship. He is endowed with unobstructed dharma and detachment.

verses.sanskrit: आ जङ्गमं तमोभूतम् अप्रज्ञातमलक्षणम् । नष्टचन्द्रार्ककिरणम् आसीद् भूतविवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: ā jaṅgamaṃ tamobhūtam aprajñātamalakṣaṇam / naṣṭacandrārkakiraṇam āsīd bhūtavivarjitam
verses.translation: The knowledge, characterised by detachment, of that lord is* unimpeded. The intellect of Brahma identifying himself with that Lord, is affected by Dharma and Aisvarya (supremacy).
verses.hindi: तेजो दशगुणनैव बाह्यतों वायुनाउश्वुतम्। वायुद॑शगुरणोनैलव बाह्यतो नभसा55कृतः
verses.wordMeaning: The knowledge, characterised by detachment, of that lord is* unimpeded. The intellect of Brahma identifying himself with that Lord, is affected by Dharma and Aisvarya (supremacy).
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowledge, characterised by detachment, of that lord is* unimpeded. The intellect of Brahma identifying himself with that Lord, is affected by Dharma and Aisvarya (supremacy).

verses.sanskrit: तमसो ऽतो महानाम्ना पुरुषः स जगद्गुरुः । चचार तस्मिन्नेकाकी व्यक्ताव्यक्तः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: tamaso 'to mahānāmnā puruṣaḥ sa jagadguruḥ / cacāra tasminnekākī vyaktāvyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Whatever he wishes menially is created out of the un¬ manifest naturally, due to its being controlled, due to absence of attributes (?) and due to his being the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: आकाशेन बूतो वायुः खं च भूतादिना55बुतम् । भूतादिमहता चापि अव्यक्ते न बृतो महान
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever he wishes menially is created out of the un¬ manifest naturally, due to its being controlled, due to absence of attributes (?) and due to his being the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever he wishes menially is created out of the un¬ manifest naturally, due to its being controlled, due to absence of attributes (?) and due to his being the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: स चौंकारमयो ऽतीतो गायत्रीमसृजद्द्विजः । स तया सार्द्धम् ईशानश्चिक्रीड पुरुषो विराट्
verses.transliteration: sa cauṃkāramayo 'tīto gāyatrīmasṛjaddvijaḥ / sa tayā sārddham īśānaścikrīḍa puruṣo virāṭ
verses.translation: In the capacity of Brahma, he becomes the four-faced creator; in the capacity of Kala, he is the destroyer; in the capacity ofPurusa (Visnu) he is the thousand-headed lord. These arc the three states of the self-born God. 1
verses.hindi: प्रसरगंकाले स्थित्वा च भ्रसन्त्येताः परस्परम्। पव परस्परोत्पक्षा घारयन्ति परस्परम्
verses.wordMeaning: In the capacity of Brahma, he becomes the four-faced creator; in the capacity of Kala, he is the destroyer; in the capacity ofPurusa (Visnu) he is the thousand-headed lord. These arc the three states of the self-born God. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: In the capacity of Brahma, he becomes the four-faced creator; in the capacity of Kala, he is the destroyer; in the capacity ofPurusa (Visnu) he is the thousand-headed lord. These arc the three states of the self-born God. 1

verses.sanskrit: स्वदेहादसृजद् विश्वं पञ्चभूतात्मसंज्ञितम् । क्रीडन्समसृजद्विश्वं पञ्चभूतात्मसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: svadehādasṛjad viśvaṃ pañcabhūtātmasaṃjñitam / krīḍansamasṛjadviśvaṃ pañcabhūtātmasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: Tn the capacity of Brahma, the creator, he possesses Saliva and Rajas predominantly; as destroyer (of the universe). Rajas and Tamos predominantly; and as ■ Purusa (Visnu), Saliva exclusively. Thus is the state or course of attributes of the self-born Lord.
verses.hindi: आधाराधेयभावेन विकारश्व विकारिणु । अव्यक्त क्षेत्रमुदिष्ट ब्रह्मा क्षेत्र) उच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Tn the capacity of Brahma, the creator, he possesses Saliva and Rajas predominantly; as destroyer (of the universe). Rajas and Tamos predominantly; and as ■ Purusa (Visnu), Saliva exclusively. Thus is the state or course of attributes of the self-born Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tn the capacity of Brahma, the creator, he possesses Saliva and Rajas predominantly; as destroyer (of the universe). Rajas and Tamos predominantly; and as ■ Purusa (Visnu), Saliva exclusively. Thus is the state or course of attributes of the self-born Lord.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडन् सृजद् विराट्संज्ञः सबीजं च हिरण्मयम् । तच्चाण्डम् अभवद् दिव्यं द्वादशादित्यसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: krīḍan sṛjad virāṭsaṃjñaḥ sabījaṃ ca hiraṇmayam / taccāṇḍam abhavad divyaṃ dvādaśādityasannibham
verses.translation: In the capacity of Brahma he creates; in the capacity of Kala he withdraws (destroys) the worlds; in the capacity of Purusa he remains unconcerned. These three are the states of the Lord of subjects.
verses.hindi: एतद्विरण्यगर्भस्य जन्म यो वेद तक्त्वतः । आयुष्मान्कीतिमान्धन्यः प्रजावांध्य भवचत्युत ॥€१ निवृत्तिकामो5पि नरः शुद्धात्मा लभते गतिम्  पुराशश्रवण्नित्यं सुख॑ च क्षेममाप्नुयात् ॥€२
verses.wordMeaning: In the capacity of Brahma he creates; in the capacity of Kala he withdraws (destroys) the worlds; in the capacity of Purusa he remains unconcerned. These three are the states of the Lord of subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the capacity of Brahma he creates; in the capacity of Kala he withdraws (destroys) the worlds; in the capacity of Purusa he remains unconcerned. These three are the states of the Lord of subjects.

verses.sanskrit: तद्भित्त्वा पुरुषो जज्ञे चतुर्वक्त्रः पितामहः । सो ऽसृजद्विश्वम् एवं तु सदेवासुरमानुषम्
verses.transliteration: tadbhittvā puruṣo jajñe caturvaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ / so 'sṛjadviśvam evaṃ tu sadevāsuramānuṣam
verses.translation: Brahma has the lustre of the interior of a lotus. Kala has the lustre of collyrium. Purusa is lotus-eyed. Thus is the form of the supreme soul.
verses.hindi: इंति महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते प्रक्रियापादे सृष्टिप्रकरणकथन नाम चतुर्थोज्ष्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma has the lustre of the interior of a lotus. Kala has the lustre of collyrium. Purusa is lotus-eyed. Thus is the form of the supreme soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma has the lustre of the interior of a lotus. Kala has the lustre of collyrium. Purusa is lotus-eyed. Thus is the form of the supreme soul.

verses.sanskrit: सतिर्यक्पशुपक्षीकं स्वेदाण्डजजरायुजम् । एतदण्डं पुराणेषु प्रथमं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: satiryakpaśupakṣīkaṃ svedāṇḍajajarāyujam / etadaṇḍaṃ purāṇeṣu prathamaṃ parikīrtitam
verses.translation: The Lord of Yogas who out of sportiveness has differ¬ ent creations, activities, forms, names and functions, creates and effects changes in (different) bodies.
verses.hindi: या आलोक है सब उस अण्ड में समपित हैं। वह अण्ड दशगुने जल से बाहर से घिरा हुआ है। और इसी प्रकार दसगुना जल बाहर ओ्रे तेज से आवृत है ।5३-८४। दसगुने वायु से तेज बाहर से आच्छादित है। वायु दसगुने आकाश से और आकाश से वायु ढका है। स्वयं आकाश भूतादि अहड्भार से ढका है। फिर भूतादि महत्तत्व से तथा महतृतत्व अब्यक्त से परिवेष्टित है। इन सात प्राकृत आवरणों से अण्ड आच्छादित है। ये
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord of Yogas who out of sportiveness has differ¬ ent creations, activities, forms, names and functions, creates and effects changes in (different) bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord of Yogas who out of sportiveness has differ¬ ent creations, activities, forms, names and functions, creates and effects changes in (different) bodies.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वकल्पे नृपश्रेष्ठ क्रीडन्त्या परमेष्ठिना । उमया सह रुद्रस्य क्रीडतश्चार्णवीकृतः
verses.transliteration: pūrvakalpe nṛpaśreṣṭha krīḍantyā parameṣṭhinā / umayā saha rudrasya krīḍataścārṇavīkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Since he functions in the world in three ways, he is called Tnguna. Since he is divided into four he is glorified as Caturvyuha (having four manifestations).
verses.hindi: आठ प्रकृतियाँ एक दूसरे को आच्छादित करके रहती हैं। ( सृष्टिकाल में ) स्थित रहकर फिर प्रलयकाल में एक दूसरे का ग्रास कर जाती हैं । इस प्रकार एक दूसरे से उत्पन्न होतीं तथा एक दूसरी को धारण करती हैं ।5५-५८। आधार और आधेय भाव से विक्ृति अपनी प्रकृति में रहती है । अव्यक्त को क्षेत्र तथा ब्रह्मा को क्षेत्रतर से अधिष्ठित प्राकृत सम॑ है। यह पहले अबुद्धि पूर्वक हुआ ज॑से तड़ित् उत्पन्न होती है। हिरण्यगर्भ की
verses.wordMeaning: Since he functions in the world in three ways, he is called Tnguna. Since he is divided into four he is glorified as Caturvyuha (having four manifestations).
verses.commentary: Sense: Since he functions in the world in three ways, he is called Tnguna. Since he is divided into four he is glorified as Caturvyuha (having four manifestations).

verses.sanskrit: हर्षाज्जज्ञे शुभा कन्या उमायाः स्वेदसंभवा । शर्वस्योरःस्थलाज्जज्ञे उमा कुचविमर्दनात्
verses.transliteration: harṣājjajñe śubhā kanyā umāyāḥ svedasaṃbhavā / śarvasyoraḥsthalājjajñe umā kucavimardanāt
verses.translation: Cf. Bd. P. I. i. 4. 18, KP. I, 2. 91-92. There, the Reality or supreme God is Mahadeva while in V 2.70, it is Visnu—a difference in, nomencla¬ ture only. Our author emphasizes that this supreme god assumes three forms for the creation etc. of the universe.
verses.hindi: उत्पत्ति को जो ठीक ठीक जानता है उसकी आयु, कीत्ति, धत और प्रजा सभी बढ़ती हैं। शुद्धात्मा निवत्ति का इच्छुक मनुष्य भी पुराण सुनने से गति पा जाता है एवं उसे सुख और क्षेम मिलता है
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Bd. P. I. i. 4. 18, KP. I, 2. 91-92. There, the Reality or supreme God is Mahadeva while in V 2.70, it is Visnu—a difference in, nomencla¬ ture only. Our author emphasizes that this supreme god assumes three forms for the creation etc. of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Bd. P. I. i. 4. 18, KP. I, 2. 91-92. There, the Reality or supreme God is Mahadeva while in V 2.70, it is Visnu—a difference in, nomencla¬ ture only. Our author emphasizes that this supreme god assumes three forms for the creation etc. of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: स्वेदाद्विजज्ञे महती कन्या राजीवलोचना । द्वितीयः संभवो यस्या रुद्रदेहाद् युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: svedādvijajñe mahatī kanyā rājīvalocanā / dvitīyaḥ saṃbhavo yasyā rudradehād yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: He is called Atman' because whatever he attains (Afmoli), takes up (AdaHe) and exists (Asti) for the (enjoyment of) objects, that is his permanent being.
verses.hindi: इदमर्ध ड. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: He is called Atman' because whatever he attains (Afmoli), takes up (AdaHe) and exists (Asti) for the (enjoyment of) objects, that is his permanent being.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is called Atman' because whatever he attains (Afmoli), takes up (AdaHe) and exists (Asti) for the (enjoyment of) objects, that is his permanent being.

verses.sanskrit: सा परिभ्रमते लोकान् सदेवासुरमानवान् । त्रैलोक्योन्मादजननी रूपेण ऽप्रतिमा तदा
verses.transliteration: sā paribhramate lokān sadevāsuramānavān / trailokyonmādajananī rūpeṇa 'pratimā tadā
verses.translation: He is called Rsi because he goes everywhere. He is Vism because he pervades everything. He has the lordship over everything. He is the lord of physical body etc.
verses.hindi: स्तुष्ल्टिप्रष्करणसल्त्
verses.wordMeaning: He is called Rsi because he goes everywhere. He is Vism because he pervades everything. He has the lordship over everything. He is the lord of physical body etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is called Rsi because he goes everywhere. He is Vism because he pervades everything. He has the lordship over everything. He is the lord of physical body etc.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा देवदैत्येन्द्रा मोहिता लभते कथम् । मृगयन्ति स्म तां कन्याम् इतश्चेतश्च भारत
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devadaityendrā mohitā labhate katham / mṛgayanti sma tāṃ kanyām itaścetaśca bhārata
verses.translation: He is Blngavcn because there are such (excellences) in him. He i sRdga (lord of passion) because he controls passion. He is Para (Supreme) because he is the cosmic being. He is Om because he protects (all).
verses.hindi: यहिसष्टेस्तु सख्यात॑ मया कालान्तर द्विजाः । एतत्कालान्तरं शेयमहवें पारमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: He is Blngavcn because there are such (excellences) in him. He i sRdga (lord of passion) because he controls passion. He is Para (Supreme) because he is the cosmic being. He is Om because he protects (all).
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Blngavcn because there are such (excellences) in him. He i sRdga (lord of passion) because he controls passion. He is Para (Supreme) because he is the cosmic being. He is Om because he protects (all).

verses.sanskrit: हावभावविलासैश्च मोहयत्यखिलं जगत् । भ्रमते दिव्यरूपा सा विद्युत्सौदामिनी यथा
verses.transliteration: hāvabhāvavilāsaiśca mohayatyakhilaṃ jagat / bhramate divyarūpā sā vidyutsaudāminī yathā
verses.translation: He is Sarvajna (omniscient) because he knows every¬ thing. He is Sarva because everything originates from him. As men emerge from him, he is known as Ndrayana.
verses.hindi: अहृश्व विद्यते तस्यथ न राजिरिति घारणा। उपचार: प्रक्रिते लोकार्ना हितकाम्यया
verses.wordMeaning: He is Sarvajna (omniscient) because he knows every¬ thing. He is Sarva because everything originates from him. As men emerge from him, he is known as Ndrayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Sarvajna (omniscient) because he knows every¬ thing. He is Sarva because everything originates from him. As men emerge from him, he is known as Ndrayana.

verses.sanskrit: मेघमध्ये स्थिता भाभिः सर्वयोषिदनुत्तमा । ततो रुद्रं सुराः सर्वे दैत्याश्च सह दानवैः
verses.transliteration: meghamadhye sthitā bhābhiḥ sarvayoṣidanuttamā / tato rudraṃ surāḥ sarve daityāśca saha dānavaiḥ
verses.translation: He divides his self into three and acts on the three worlds. He creates, surveys (protects) and devours through the three activities. In the beginning Hiranyagarbha manifested himself as four-faced lord.
verses.hindi: (+ प्रजा; प्रजानां पतय ऋषयों मुनिभिः सह । ऋषीन्सनत्कुमाराख्यान्त्रह्मसाधु ज्यगें:ः सह
verses.wordMeaning: He divides his self into three and acts on the three worlds. He creates, surveys (protects) and devours through the three activities. In the beginning Hiranyagarbha manifested himself as four-faced lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: He divides his self into three and acts on the three worlds. He creates, surveys (protects) and devours through the three activities. In the beginning Hiranyagarbha manifested himself as four-faced lord.

verses.sanskrit: वरयन्ति स्म तां कन्यां कामेनाकुलिता भृशम् । ततो ऽब्रवीन्महादेवो देवदानवयोर्द्वयोः
verses.transliteration: varayanti sma tāṃ kanyāṃ kāmenākulitā bhṛśam / tato 'bravīnmahādevo devadānavayordvayoḥ
verses.translation: Because he is first to manifest he is called the first god. He is called Aja because he is not born (is self-existent). Since he protects the subjects, he is called Prajdpali.
verses.hindi: स्वात्मस्यचस्थिते सरवे विकारे प्रतिसहते  साधमे (म्यं) णावतिष्ठेते प्रधानपुरुषाइभौ
verses.wordMeaning: Because he is first to manifest he is called the first god. He is called Aja because he is not born (is self-existent). Since he protects the subjects, he is called Prajdpali.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because he is first to manifest he is called the first god. He is called Aja because he is not born (is self-existent). Since he protects the subjects, he is called Prajdpali.

verses.sanskrit: बलेन तेजसा चैव ह्यधिको यो भविष्यति । स इमां प्राप्स्यते कन्यां नान्यथा वै सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: balena tejasā caiva hyadhiko yo bhaviṣyati / sa imāṃ prāpsyate kanyāṃ nānyathā vai surottamāḥ
verses.translation: He is called Mahadeva because he is the greatest deity among Devas. He is Isvara because he is the lord of worlds and because he is not subject to other's control.
verses.hindi: .. ि ट ््क्ि्नापापिप।भभफपकक्‍पभपभपभ भभः
verses.wordMeaning: He is called Mahadeva because he is the greatest deity among Devas. He is Isvara because he is the lord of worlds and because he is not subject to other's control.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is called Mahadeva because he is the greatest deity among Devas. He is Isvara because he is the lord of worlds and because he is not subject to other's control.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवासुराः सर्वे कन्यां वै समुपागमन् । अहमेनां ग्रहीष्यामि अहमेनामिति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tato devāsurāḥ sarve kanyāṃ vai samupāgaman / ahamenāṃ grahīṣyāmi ahamenāmiti bruvan
verses.translation: He is called Brahma due to his bigness. He is called Bhuta because of his (eternal) existence. He is Kselrajha because he knows the unmanifest cosmic nature. He is Vibhu because he is omnipresent.
verses.hindi: लोमहषण ने कहा- ब्राह्मणो ! जो सृष्टि समय की अवधि हमने बताई है वही परमेश्वर का दिन समझना चाहिए ।१। इतनी ही बड़ी परमेश की सम्पूर्णतया रात्रि भी जाननी चाहिए  जो सृष्टि है बही उसका दिन और प्रलय ही सत्रि है ।२। वस्तुत: उसका दिन ही दिन होता है। रात कभी नहीं होती किन्तु लोगों की हिंतकामना से रात का भी उपचार (आरोप) कर दिया जाता है ।३। प्रजाएँ, प्रणापतिवर्म, सनत्कुमार आदि
verses.wordMeaning: He is called Brahma due to his bigness. He is called Bhuta because of his (eternal) existence. He is Kselrajha because he knows the unmanifest cosmic nature. He is Vibhu because he is omnipresent.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is called Brahma due to his bigness. He is called Bhuta because of his (eternal) existence. He is Kselrajha because he knows the unmanifest cosmic nature. He is Vibhu because he is omnipresent.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यतामेव सर्वेषां सा कन्यान्तरधीयत । पुनस्तां ददृशुः सर्वे योजनान्तरधिष्ठिताम्
verses.transliteration: paśyatāmeva sarveṣāṃ sā kanyāntaradhīyata / punastāṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve yojanāntaradhiṣṭhitām
verses.translation: Because he lies in the subtle body (called Pur) he is called Purasa. He is called Svayaiiibhu because he.is not pro¬ created and because he exists before the creation.
verses.hindi: तथा ब्रह्मा-सायुज्य वालों के साथ ऋषि तथा मुनिगण, ज्ञानेन्द्रियाँ एवं उनके विषय पाँचो महाभूत, तथा तन्मात्रायें, कर्मे न्ियाँ, बुद्धि और मन ये सब धीमान् परमेश्वर के दिन में अवस्थित रहते और दिन के अन्त में उसी में लीन हो जाते हैं ।४-५। फिर रात्रि के बीतने पर विश्व की उत्पत्ति होती है।६। विका र का प्रतिसंहार होने पर जब सत्व अपने में स्थित रहता है उस समय प्रधात और पुरुष दोनों एक भाव से स्थिर रहते हैं ।:। ये दोनों तमो-
verses.wordMeaning: Because he lies in the subtle body (called Pur) he is called Purasa. He is called Svayaiiibhu because he.is not pro¬ created and because he exists before the creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because he lies in the subtle body (called Pur) he is called Purasa. He is called Svayaiiibhu because he.is not pro¬ created and because he exists before the creation.

verses.sanskrit: जग्मुस्ते त्वरिताः सर्वे यत्र सा समदृश्यत । त्रिभिश्चतुर्भिश्च तथा योजनैर्दशभिः पुनः
verses.transliteration: jagmuste tvaritāḥ sarve yatra sā samadṛśyata / tribhiścaturbhiśca tathā yojanairdaśabhiḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: He is called Tajha because worship or sacrifice is offered to him. He is Kavi because he is omniscient. He is
verses.hindi: गुण और सत्त्वगुण समभाव से स्थित रहते हैं ।८। फिर बढ़ घट कर एक दूसरे की विषमता से सृष्टि करते हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: He is called Tajha because worship or sacrifice is offered to him. He is Kavi because he is omniscient. He is
verses.commentary: Sense: He is called Tajha because worship or sacrifice is offered to him. He is Kavi because he is omniscient. He is

verses.sanskrit: धिष्ठितां समपश्यंस्ते सर्वे मातंगगामिनीम् । योजनानां शतैर्भूयः सहस्रैश्चाप्यधिष्ठिताम्
verses.transliteration: dhiṣṭhitāṃ samapaśyaṃste sarve mātaṃgagāminīm / yojanānāṃ śatairbhūyaḥ sahasraiścāpyadhiṣṭhitām
verses.translation: The author is fond of derivations. Some of them are grammatically correct, some ingenious, but most of them are popular. Thus here Atman is derived from \Zap t 's/ad % and <\Jas. Some others trace it to V an 'to breath*. Vat *to move*, 's/vd 'to blow' (MW. 135 a).
verses.hindi: + सूत उवाचेति घ. पुस्तके । +धनुश्चिह्लान्त्गंत नास्ति ड पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: The author is fond of derivations. Some of them are grammatically correct, some ingenious, but most of them are popular. Thus here Atman is derived from \Zap t 's/ad % and <\Jas. Some others trace it to V an 'to breath*. Vat *to move*, 's/vd 'to blow' (MW. 135 a).
verses.commentary: Sense: The author is fond of derivations. Some of them are grammatically correct, some ingenious, but most of them are popular. Thus here Atman is derived from \Zap t 's/ad % and <\Jas. Some others trace it to V an 'to breath*. Vat *to move*, 's/vd 'to blow' (MW. 135 a).

verses.sanskrit: तथा शतसहस्रेण लघुत्वात् समदृश्यत । अग्रतः पृष्ठतश्चैव दिशासु विदिशासु च
verses.transliteration: tathā śatasahasreṇa laghutvāt samadṛśyata / agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataścaiva diśāsu vidiśāsu ca
verses.translation: Even in hundreds of years, it is impossible to calculate the number of years that have elapsed since the self-born was manifested.
verses.hindi: गुणेभ्यः क्षोभ्यमाणेम्यस्रयो देवा विजज्षिरे। आश्रिताः परमा गुद्याः सर्वात्मानः शरीरिणः
verses.wordMeaning: Even in hundreds of years, it is impossible to calculate the number of years that have elapsed since the self-born was manifested.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even in hundreds of years, it is impossible to calculate the number of years that have elapsed since the self-born was manifested.

verses.sanskrit: तां पश्यन्ति वरारोहाम् एकधा बहुधा पुनः । दिव्यवर्षसहस्रं तु भ्रामितास्ते तया पुरा
verses.transliteration: tāṃ paśyanti varārohām ekadhā bahudhā punaḥ / divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu bhrāmitāste tayā purā
verses.translation: The time that has elapsed, the number of Kalpas that have passed after he had manifested is called Para. That much of time still remains for him. At its close, the subsidiary creation is to take place.
verses.hindi: रज़ो ब्रह्मा तमो छाश्रिः सरवे विष्णुरज्ञायत। रजः प्रकाशको ब्रह्मा नष्ट त्वेन व्यचस्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: The time that has elapsed, the number of Kalpas that have passed after he had manifested is called Para. That much of time still remains for him. At its close, the subsidiary creation is to take place.
verses.commentary: Sense: The time that has elapsed, the number of Kalpas that have passed after he had manifested is called Para. That much of time still remains for him. At its close, the subsidiary creation is to take place.

verses.sanskrit: न चावाप्ता तु सा कन्या महादेवाङ्गसंभवा । सहोमया ततो देवो जहासोच्चैः पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: na cāvāptā tu sā kanyā mahādevāṅgasaṃbhavā / sahomayā tato devo jahāsoccaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: Crores and crores of Kalpas have already passed. Yet so many more still remain.
verses.hindi: तमःप्रकाशको उश्निस्तु कालत्वेन व्यवस्थितः  सक्तवप्रकाशको विष्णु रौदासीन्ये व्यवस्थितः॥ +प॒त एवं त्रयो लोका एत एवं तयो गुणा:  एत एवं जयो चेदा एत एवं त्रयोउच्नयः
verses.wordMeaning: Crores and crores of Kalpas have already passed. Yet so many more still remain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Crores and crores of Kalpas have already passed. Yet so many more still remain.

verses.sanskrit: गणास्तालकसंपातैर् नृत्यन्ति च मुदान्विताः । अकस्माद्दृश्यते कन्या शंकरस्य समीपगा
verses.transliteration: gaṇāstālakasaṃpātair nṛtyanti ca mudānvitāḥ / akasmāddṛśyate kanyā śaṃkarasya samīpagā
verses.translation: The Kalpa that is current now, O Brahmanas, is called Varaha. That is the first of the Kalpas now current.
verses.hindi: परस्पराश्िता होते परस्परमनुत्रताः । परस्परेण वर्तन्ते घारयन्ति परस्परम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Kalpa that is current now, O Brahmanas, is called Varaha. That is the first of the Kalpas now current.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kalpa that is current now, O Brahmanas, is called Varaha. That is the first of the Kalpas now current.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा विस्मयापन्ना देवा यान्ति पराङ्मुखाः । तस्याश् चक्रे ततो नाम स्वयमेव पिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāpannā devā yānti parāṅmukhāḥ / tasyāś cakre tato nāma svayameva pinākadhṛk
verses.translation: It will have fourteen Manus, beginning with Svayambhuva and including those of the past, present and the future. By these rulers of men, this earth including the seven continents is to be protected along with the subjects, by means of penance. verses.translation: Ekarnava, 'the primeval watery flood' expresses the infinite unmanifest cause of the universe. Nilakantha on HV. 9. 1-4 calls it the Kararia Brahman from which all life comes into being. Puranas believe in this doctrine and -use ■ Maharnava y agddha, stabdha, salila (HV. 3. 10. 1), Yuganta-toya 'Water flood at the end of Yuga' (Bh. P. III. 8. 23) as synonyms for Ekarnava. This doctrine is very old and Brahma-Vadins (expounders of Vedas) have elaborated it to explain the process of creation and dissolution (VP. I. 2. 22 ).
