verses.commentary: Sense: The usual derivation of Narayana in other Puranas also. But Bd. P. I. 4. 27 traces it to Nara: Brahma causes the sleep (i.e. perfect rest) of Naras (men), hence he is remembered as Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: शिवश्च रौद्रेण मयूररूपिणा विक्षोभ्यमाणे सलिले ऽपि तस्मिन् । सह भ्रमन्तीं च महार्णवान्ते सरिन्महौघां सुमहान्ददर्श
verses.transliteration: śivaśca raudreṇa mayūrarūpiṇā vikṣobhyamāṇe salile 'pi tasmin / saha bhramantīṃ ca mahārṇavānte sarinmahaughāṃ sumahāndadarśa
verses.translation: The belief regarding the assumption of the form of Vayu for reconnais¬ sance before assuming the form of a boar, to.lift up the earth, is as old as Tait. Br. 1. 2. 1. 3 which says:
verses.hindi: महेश्वर के अधिष्ठान से वह चारों ओर से प्रेरित होकर कार्य में प्रवत्त होती है । वे चिरकाल तक प्रिय होने के कारण अपने विषय में रहकर फिर महान् को प्रवृत्त करते हैं ।२१। गुण की विषमता से सृष्टि काल में पहले प्रकृति प्रवृत्त होती है।२२। तब उस्त सत् असत् रूप से ब्रह्मा और बुद्धि दोनों उत्पन्न हुए । इसीलिये तम तथा अंब्यक्तमय क्षेत्रज्ञ ब्रह्मा कहा जाता है ।२३॥ का और करणों से सिद्ध ब्रह्मा पहले पहल
verses.wordMeaning: The belief regarding the assumption of the form of Vayu for reconnais¬ sance before assuming the form of a boar, to.lift up the earth, is as old as Tait. Br. 1. 2. 1. 3 which says:
verses.commentary: Sense: The belief regarding the assumption of the form of Vayu for reconnais¬ sance before assuming the form of a boar, to.lift up the earth, is as old as Tait. Br. 1. 2. 1. 3 which says:

verses.sanskrit: स तां महादेवमयूररूपो दृष्ट्वा भ्रमन्तीं सहसोर्मिजालैः । का त्वं शुभे शाश्वतदेहभूता क्षयं न यातासि महाक्षयान्ते
verses.transliteration: sa tāṃ mahādevamayūrarūpo dṛṣṭvā bhramantīṃ sahasormijālaiḥ / kā tvaṃ śubhe śāśvatadehabhūtā kṣayaṃ na yātāsi mahākṣayānte
verses.translation: Observing that the earth was overflowed with waters on all sides, (he thought to himself), cc Oh, what great form should I assume and uplift the earth?"
verses.hindi: थे। तेज से उस प्रथम बुद्धिमान अव्यक्त का प्रकाश होता है। वही प्रथम शरोरी कारण रूप से है । वह अप्रहित ज्ञान तथा ऐश्वर्य से युक्त है।२६। अप्रहित धर्मं तथा वैराग्य से भी वह सम्पन्न है ।२५। उसी ईश्वर का अप्रतिहत ज्ञान तथा बैराग्य स्वरूप है। इस अभिमानी ब्रह्मा के धर्म और ऐश्वरयं से बुद्धि प्रकट हुईं । यह जो अपने मन में चाहता है वही इस अव्यक्त से उत्पन्न होता है ।२७। वशीकार, वेगुण्य, सुरेशत्व तथा स्वभाव
verses.wordMeaning: Observing that the earth was overflowed with waters on all sides, (he thought to himself), cc Oh, what great form should I assume and uplift the earth?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Observing that the earth was overflowed with waters on all sides, (he thought to himself), cc Oh, what great form should I assume and uplift the earth?"

verses.sanskrit: देवासुरगणे नष्टे सरित्सरमहार्णवे । का त्वं भ्रमसि पद्माक्षि क्व गतासि च न क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: devāsuragaṇe naṣṭe saritsaramahārṇave / kā tvaṃ bhramasi padmākṣi kva gatāsi ca na kṣayam
verses.translation: He thought of the form of a Boar 1 charmingly comfor¬ table in sporting about in waters. It was unassailable by living beings. It was of the nature of speech and was dcsigxiated as Dharma*.
verses.hindi: के कारण ब्रह्मत्व में चतुर्मूख तथा कालत्व में अन्तक (मृत्यु) हुआ ।२५। सहस्रों शिरों वाला यह पुरुष है। इस स्वयम्भू की तीन अवस्थायें हैं। इस स्वयम्भू की ब्रह्मा होने पर सत्त्व तथा र जोमयी, काल होने पर रज और तमोमयी तथा पुरुष होने पर सत्त्वमयी गुणवृत्ति होती है ।३६। वह ब्रह्मा होंकर लोकों की सृष्टि करता, काल होकर संहार करता ।३०। तथा पुरुष होने १९ उदासीन रहता है। प्रजापति की तीन अवस्थाएँ भी हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: He thought of the form of a Boar 1 charmingly comfor¬ table in sporting about in waters. It was unassailable by living beings. It was of the nature of speech and was dcsigxiated as Dharma*.
verses.commentary: Sense: He thought of the form of a Boar 1 charmingly comfor¬ table in sporting about in waters. It was unassailable by living beings. It was of the nature of speech and was dcsigxiated as Dharma*.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदोवाच: तव प्रसादाद्देवेश मृत्युर्मम न विद्यते । सृज देव पुनर्विश्वं शर्वरी क्षयमागता
verses.transliteration: narmadovāca: tava prasādāddeveśa mṛtyurmama na vidyate / sṛja deva punarviśvaṃ śarvarī kṣayamāgatā
verses.translation: It hadagirth of ten and a height of a hundred Yojanas. It resembled a dark blue cloud in complexion. It grunted like the rumbling of thunder-clouds. It had a huge body like a mountain. Its curved fangs were white and sharp and terrible. The eyes were brilliant like lightning and fire. Its lustre was like that of the sun.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म कमल गर्भ के रंग के, काल अड्जनवर् के हैं ।३१। पुरुष की आँखें पुण्डरीक सी हैं । यही रूप परमात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: It hadagirth of ten and a height of a hundred Yojanas. It resembled a dark blue cloud in complexion. It grunted like the rumbling of thunder-clouds. It had a huge body like a mountain. Its curved fangs were white and sharp and terrible.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It hadagirth of ten and a height of a hundred Yojanas. It resembled a dark blue cloud in complexion. It grunted like the rumbling of thunder-clouds. It had a huge body like a mountain. Its curved fangs were white and sharp and terrible.…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो महादेवो व्यधुनोत्पक्षपञ्जरम् । तावत्पञ्जरमध्यान्ते तस्य पक्षाद्विनिःसृताः
verses.transliteration: evamukto mahādevo vyadhunotpakṣapañjaram / tāvatpañjaramadhyānte tasya pakṣādviniḥsṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Its shoulders were round, plump and large. It had the lion s valiant gait. Its buttocks were stout and lifted up (well developed). It had auspicious characteristics. It was charming.
verses.hindi: धनुदिथिह्वान्तंतग्रन्थो म. पुस्तके नास्ति । -« इृदमघं नास्ति घ. पुस्तके । ३ एतच्चिह्वान्तगंतो
verses.wordMeaning: Its shoulders were round, plump and large. It had the lion s valiant gait. Its buttocks were stout and lifted up (well developed). It had auspicious characteristics. It was charming.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its shoulders were round, plump and large. It had the lion s valiant gait. Its buttocks were stout and lifted up (well developed). It had auspicious characteristics. It was charming.

verses.sanskrit: तावन्तो देवदैत्येन्द्राः पक्षाभ्यां तस्य जज्ञिरे । तेषां मध्ये पुनः सा तु नर्मदा भ्रमते सरित्
verses.transliteration: tāvanto devadaityendrāḥ pakṣābhyāṃ tasya jajñire / teṣāṃ madhye punaḥ sā tu narmadā bhramate sarit
verses.translation: Assuming this large immeasurable form of a boar, Visnu entered the nether regions in order to lift up the earth. He was the guide for the propounders of the Vedas. 2
verses.hindi: : चुरुष। पुण्डरीकाक्षो रूप॑ तत्परमात्मनः । योगेश्बर। शरीराशणि करोति दिक रोति च
verses.wordMeaning: Assuming this large immeasurable form of a boar, Visnu entered the nether regions in order to lift up the earth. He was the guide for the propounders of the Vedas. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming this large immeasurable form of a boar, Visnu entered the nether regions in order to lift up the earth. He was the guide for the propounders of the Vedas. 2

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चान्यो महाशैलो दृश्यते भरतर्षभ । त्रिभिः कूटैः सुविस्तीर्णैः शृङ्गवानिव गोवृषः
verses.transliteration: tataścānyo mahāśailo dṛśyate bharatarṣabha / tribhiḥ kūṭaiḥ suvistīrṇaiḥ śṛṅgavāniva govṛṣaḥ
verses.translation: The day and the night constituted his eyes. The ancill- aries of the Vedas were his ear ornaments. The Ajya (ghee offer¬ ing in sacrifice) was his nose; the sacrificial ladle was his snout. The sound of the Saman hymns was his roaring grunt.
verses.hindi: नानाकृतिक्रियारूपनामधुत्तिः स्घलीलया  जिधा यद्चर्तते लोके तस्मात्विगुण उच्यते ॥३े३े चतुर्धा प्रविभक्तत्वाच्चतुव्यू हद प्रकीतितः । यदाप्तो।ते यदादुत्ते यच्चास्ति (्त) विषय प्रात ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The day and the night constituted his eyes. The ancill- aries of the Vedas were his ear ornaments. The Ajya (ghee offer¬ ing in sacrifice) was his nose; the sacrificial ladle was his snout. The sound of the Saman hymns was his roaring grunt.
verses.commentary: Sense: The day and the night constituted his eyes. The ancill- aries of the Vedas were his ear ornaments. The Ajya (ghee offer¬ ing in sacrifice) was his nose; the sacrificial ladle was his snout. The sound of the Saman hymns was his roaring grunt.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकूटस्तु इति ख्यातः सर्वरत्नैर्विभूषितः । ततस्तस्मात्त्रिकूटाच्च प्लावयन्ती महीं ययौ
verses.transliteration: trikūṭastu iti khyātaḥ sarvaratnairvibhūṣitaḥ / tatastasmāttrikūṭācca plāvayantī mahīṃ yayau
verses.translation: Endowed with glory as he was, he was an embodiment of truth and dharma and was established in virtuous valour. He was engaged in expiation. He was terrible. He had the huge form with the knees of an animal. His body was straightened up. The offerings of ghrta constituted his Linga (symbol). The (sacrificial) spot was his seed. He was the great medicinal herb (incarnate for curing distress). The altar was his inner soul. Mantras were his hips. The Soma mixed with clarified butter was his blood.
verses.hindi: स्वामेत्वमस्य तत्सव विष्णु: सलप्रवेशनात् । भगवान्भगस ह्राबाद्वागो रागस्ये शासनात् ३६
verses.wordMeaning: Endowed with glory as he was, he was an embodiment of truth and dharma and was established in virtuous valour. He was engaged in expiation. He was terrible. He had the huge form with the knees of an animal. His body was straightened up.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Endowed with glory as he was, he was an embodiment of truth and dharma and was established in virtuous valour. He was engaged in expiation. He was terrible. He had the huge form with the knees of an animal. His body was straightened up.…

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकूटी तेन विख्याता पित्ःणां त्रायणी परा । द्वितीयाच्च ततो गङ्गा विस्तीर्णा धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: trikūṭī tena vikhyātā pitḥṇāṃ trāyaṇī parā / dvitīyācca tato gaṅgā vistīrṇā dharaṇītale
verses.translation: The Vedas were his shoulders. He had the fragrance of sacrificial offering. The Havya (oblations for the Devas) and Kavya (oblations for the Pitrs) constituted his velocity. PragvamSa 1 (the room accommodating the sacrifices) was his body. He was lustrous and had undergone different initiations.
verses.hindi: देवेषु च मद्ान्देवो रदृदवस्ततः स्खृुतः । खबशत्घाच्च लाकानामच श्यत्याक्तथेभध्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedas were his shoulders. He had the fragrance of sacrificial offering. The Havya (oblations for the Devas) and Kavya (oblations for the Pitrs) constituted his velocity. PragvamSa 1 (the room accommodating the sacrifices) was his body.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas were his shoulders. He had the fragrance of sacrificial offering. The Havya (oblations for the Devas) and Kavya (oblations for the Pitrs) constituted his velocity. PragvamSa 1 (the room accommodating the sacrifices) was his body.…

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं च ततः शृङ्गं सप्तधा खण्डशो गतम् । जम्बूद्वीपे तु संजाताः सप्त ते कुलपर्वताः
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṅgaṃ saptadhā khaṇḍaśo gatam / jambūdvīpe tu saṃjātāḥ sapta te kulaparvatāḥ
verses.translation: The sacrificial fees constituted his heart. He was an all- pervading Yogin in the form of a great Sattva.. He was charm¬ ing with the sacrificial rites of Upakarman. Pravargya (a rite in which hot milk is poured in a vessel, thus giving rise to fumes) constituted the whorls of hair on his chest* 2. His gait and paths were the different Chandas. The secret Upanisads constituted his seat. He was accompanied by his consort Chaya. He was lofty like a jewelled peak. Having thus assumed the form of a sacrificial Boar, the lord entered the waters.
verses.hindi: भ्रदृत्वाच्च स्मुता ब्रह्म। भूतत्वाज्भ.त उच्यते। (चेत्नन्नः क्षेत्रांचश्ञानादिशुः सचगतों यतः
verses.wordMeaning: The sacrificial fees constituted his heart. He was an all- pervading Yogin in the form of a great Sattva.. He was charm¬ ing with the sacrificial rites of Upakarman. Pravargya (a rite in which hot milk is poured in a vessel,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sacrificial fees constituted his heart. He was an all- pervading Yogin in the form of a great Sattva.. He was charm¬ ing with the sacrificial rites of Upakarman. Pravargya (a rite in which hot milk is poured in a vessel,…

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रनक्षत्रसहिता ग्रहग्रामनदीनदाः । अण्डजं स्वेदजं जातमुद्भिज्जं च जरायुजम्
verses.transliteration: candranakṣatrasahitā grahagrāmanadīnadāḥ / aṇḍajaṃ svedajaṃ jātamudbhijjaṃ ca jarāyujam
verses.translation: The body of Varaha was so big and spacious as to accommodate many men, as PragvarhSa (the room in which the members of the sacrificer's family and friends stay) is spacious.
verses.hindi: का है। यह योगेदवर अपनी लीला से नाना आकृति, क्रिया, रूप तथा तामों द्वारा शरीरों को बनाते तथा बिगाड़ते हैं ।३२। संसार में ये तीन प्रकार से रहते हैं अतएव इनका नाम त्रिगुण है। चार प्रकार से प्रविभक्त होने के कारण इन्हें चतुर्व्यूह् कहा गया है। आप्ति तथा आदान करने तथा विषय का भोग करने से सदा उसका वही भाव हो जाता है अतः उसे आत्मा कहते हैं। सबंत्र गति होने भर्थात् सर्वेग्यापक, और आद्य
verses.wordMeaning: The body of Varaha was so big and spacious as to accommodate many men, as PragvarhSa (the room in which the members of the sacrificer's family and friends stay) is spacious.
verses.commentary: Sense: The body of Varaha was so big and spacious as to accommodate many men, as PragvarhSa (the room in which the members of the sacrificer's family and friends stay) is spacious.

verses.sanskrit: एवं जगदिदं सर्वं मयूरादभवत्पुरा । समस्तं नरशार्दूल महादेवसमुद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jagadidaṃ sarvaṃ mayūrādabhavatpurā / samastaṃ naraśārdūla mahādevasamudbhavam
verses.translation: He, the lord of the subjects, got at the Earth covered with the waters. He approached and lifted it quickly. He divert¬ ed the waters of the oceans in the oceans and of the rivers in the rivers. The lord, for the welfare of the worlds, lifted with his curved fangs, the Earth that had gone deep into the nether world. Holding the Earth in his hands he brought it to its place. The supporter of the Earth at first mentally supported the earth and then released it.
verses.hindi: शरीर धारण करने से ऋषि कहाते एवं स्वयं सब के स्वामी होने से प्रभु कहे जाते हैं ।३३-३५॥। सब में प्रविष्ट होने के कारण विष्णु कहलाते है। भग अर्थात् ऐश्वयं के होते से भगवान् तथा राग पर शासन करने के कारण-- इसको राग कहा जाता है ।३६॥। प्रकृष्ट होने से पर तथा भवन या रक्षण करने से इसे ओम कहते हैं । मरों का अयन होने से नारायण कहलाता है। अपने को तीन प्रकार से विभक्त करके भैलोबय को चलाता
verses.wordMeaning: He, the lord of the subjects, got at the Earth covered with the waters. He approached and lifted it quickly. He divert¬ ed the waters of the oceans in the oceans and of the rivers in the rivers. The lord, for the welfare of the worlds, lifted with his curved fangs,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He, the lord of the subjects, got at the Earth covered with the waters. He approached and lifted it quickly. He divert¬ ed the waters of the oceans in the oceans and of the rivers in the rivers. The lord, for the welfare of the worlds, lifted with his curved fangs,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो नदीः समुद्रांश्च संविभज्य पृथक्पृथक् । नर्मदामाह देवेशो गच्छ त्वं दक्षिणां दिशम्
verses.transliteration: tato nadīḥ samudrāṃśca saṃvibhajya pṛthakpṛthak / narmadāmāha deveśo gaccha tvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam
verses.translation: Over the flood of waters, the Earth floated like an immense boat. Due to the activities of the lord, it did not sink.
verses.hindi: है ।३७-३८। इन तीनों रूपों से वह सृष्टि, संहार तथा रक्षण करता है । पहले पहल वह द्वरिण्यगर्भ चतुर्मुख रूप से प्रकट हुआ ।३९। आदि होने से वह आदिदेव तथा अजन्मा होने से अज कहलाता है अतएवं उसे प्रजापति कहते हैं ।४०। सब देवों में यह बड़ा है इसलिये इसे महादेव कहते हैं। सब का ईश तथा लोको के वश में न होने के कारण यह ईश्वर कहलाता है ।४१।॥ बृहत् होने से ब्रह्मा तथा भूत कहा जाता है क्षेत्र के विज्ञान से क्षेत्रज्ञ तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Over the flood of waters, the Earth floated like an immense boat. Due to the activities of the lord, it did not sink.
verses.commentary: Sense: Over the flood of waters, the Earth floated like an immense boat. Due to the activities of the lord, it did not sink.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सा दक्षिणा गंगा महापातकनाशिनी । उत्तरे जाह्नवी देशे पुण्या त्वं दक्षिणे शुभा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sā dakṣiṇā gaṃgā mahāpātakanāśinī / uttare jāhnavī deśe puṇyā tvaṃ dakṣiṇe śubhā
verses.translation: With a desire to set up the universe, the lord lifted up the Earth. Then, he, the lotus-eyed lord, decided to divide the Earth. He levelled the Earth and created the mountains on it. Formerly when the creation was burnt by the Samvar- taka fire, all the mountains, being consumed by that fire, lay shattered and scattered all over the earth.
verses.hindi: सर्वेव्यापी होने से विभु इसका नाम है ।४२। पुर अर्थात् शरीर में सोता है इस लिये इसे पुरुष कहते हैं । किसी ने इसे उत्पन्न नहीं किया और रूप के पूर्व में वह रहता है अतएवं सब इसे स्वयम्भू कहते हैं ॥४३॥ इज्य (पूज्य)
verses.wordMeaning: With a desire to set up the universe, the lord lifted up the Earth. Then, he, the lotus-eyed lord, decided to divide the Earth. He levelled the Earth and created the mountains on it. Formerly when the creation was burnt by the Samvar- taka fire, all the mountains,…
verses.commentary: Sense: With a desire to set up the universe, the lord lifted up the Earth. Then, he, the lotus-eyed lord, decided to divide the Earth. He levelled the Earth and created the mountains on it. Formerly when the creation was burnt by the Samvar- taka fire, all the mountains,…

verses.sanskrit: यथा गंगा महापुण्या मम मस्तकसंभवा । तद्विशिष्टा महाभागे त्वं चैवेति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yathā gaṃgā mahāpuṇyā mama mastakasaṃbhavā / tadviśiṣṭā mahābhāge tvaṃ caiveti na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: In that Ekarijiava (the ocean of cosmic waters) the waters (solidifiedby cold) and collected by wind and were placed in a scattered manner here and there (wherever they were thus deposited); they became condensed into mountains.
verses.hindi: धनुभ्मिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थों ढ़. पुस्तके गास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: In that Ekarijiava (the ocean of cosmic waters) the waters (solidifiedby cold) and collected by wind and were placed in a scattered manner here and there (wherever they were thus deposited); they became condensed into mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that Ekarijiava (the ocean of cosmic waters) the waters (solidifiedby cold) and collected by wind and were placed in a scattered manner here and there (wherever they were thus deposited); they became condensed into mountains.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया सह भविष्यामि एकेनांशेन सुव्रते । महापातकयुक्तानाम् औषधं त्वं भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: tvayā saha bhaviṣyāmi ekenāṃśena suvrate / mahāpātakayuktānām auṣadhaṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: Since they became motionless after being (thus) sprin¬ kled, they were known as Acalas. 1 Since they are endowed with knots and joints, they were called Parvalas. Since they had been swallowed and hidden (formerly), they were called Giris. Since they had heen collected, they were called Siloccayas. Thus after the worlds, oceans and mountains are des¬ troyed at the end of a Kalpa, the Maker (Creator) of the uni¬ verse creates them again and again, in the beginnings of the Kalpas.
verses.hindi: इज्यत्वादुच्यतेथ्यज्ञ: कविधिक्रान्तद्शनात्। क्रमशः क्रमणी त्वाद्र्णकस्याभिपालनात्
verses.wordMeaning: Since they became motionless after being (thus) sprin¬ kled, they were known as Acalas. 1 Since they are endowed with knots and joints, they were called Parvalas. Since they had been swallowed and hidden (formerly), they were called Giris. Since they had heen collected,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they became motionless after being (thus) sprin¬ kled, they were known as Acalas. 1 Since they are endowed with knots and joints, they were called Parvalas. Since they had been swallowed and hidden (formerly), they were called Giris. Since they had heen collected,…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता तु देवेन महापातकनाशिनी । दक्षिणं दिग्विभागं तु सा जगामाशु विक्रमा
verses.transliteration: evamuktā tu devena mahāpātakanāśinī / dakṣiṇaṃ digvibhāgaṃ tu sā jagāmāśu vikramā
verses.translation: He again created this earth along with the ocean, seven continents and mountains, as well as the four worlds, viz. Bhur
verses.hindi: तस्माद्धि रण्यगर्भः स पुर,णे5स्मिन्निरुच्यते । स्वयंभुवो निवृत्तस्य कालो वर्षाश्नजस्तु यः
verses.wordMeaning: He again created this earth along with the ocean, seven continents and mountains, as well as the four worlds, viz. Bhur
verses.commentary: Sense: He again created this earth along with the ocean, seven continents and mountains, as well as the four worlds, viz. Bhur

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षशैलेन्द्रमासाद्य चन्द्रमौलेर् अनुग्रहात् । वार्यौघैः प्रस्थिता यस्मान्महादेवप्रणोदिता
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣaśailendramāsādya candramauler anugrahāt / vāryaughaiḥ prasthitā yasmānmahādevapraṇoditā
verses.translation: Note the Puranic etymologies of acala, panala, giri. Desirous of creating different species pf subjects, the self-born lord Brahma recreated the beings in the same form as they had in the previous Kalpas. 1
verses.hindi: न शक्यः परिखंख्यातुमपि वर्षशतैरपि ॥ कट्पसंख्यांनवृत्तस्तु पराख्यो ब्रह्मणः स्म्ुत:
verses.wordMeaning: Note the Puranic etymologies of acala, panala, giri. Desirous of creating different species pf subjects, the self-born lord Brahma recreated the beings in the same form as they had in the previous Kalpas. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Note the Puranic etymologies of acala, panala, giri. Desirous of creating different species pf subjects, the self-born lord Brahma recreated the beings in the same form as they had in the previous Kalpas. 1

verses.sanskrit: महता चापि वेगेन यस्माद् एषा समुच्छ्रिता । महती तेन सा प्रोक्ता महादेवान्महीपते
verses.transliteration: mahatā cāpi vegena yasmād eṣā samucchritā / mahatī tena sā proktā mahādevānmahīpate
verses.translation: When he was contemplating over the creation intellec¬ tually, the dark and gloomy creation manifested itself simultane¬ ously with Pradhana.* *
verses.hindi: ठावच्छेषोंडस्थ कालाउन्यस्तस्यान्त मांतेखज्यते । कोटिकोट्सइस्लाण अन्तभू तांन या।न वै समतीतान कलपानां तावच्छेषाः परस्तु ये। यस्त्वयं बतंते कल्पो वाशहं त॑ निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: When he was contemplating over the creation intellec¬ tually, the dark and gloomy creation manifested itself simultane¬ ously with Pradhana.* *
verses.commentary: Sense: When he was contemplating over the creation intellec¬ tually, the dark and gloomy creation manifested itself simultane¬ ously with Pradhana.* *

verses.sanskrit: तपतस्तस्य देवस्य शूलाग्राद्बिन्दवो ऽपतन् । तेनैषा शोणसंज्ञा तु दश सप्त च ताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: tapatastasya devasya śūlāgrādbindavo 'patan / tenaiṣā śoṇasaṃjñā tu daśa sapta ca tāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Nescience ( Avidya ) with five joints, viz. darkness, delusion, super-delusion, murkiness and super-murkiness**, be¬ came manifested out of the Supreme Soul. While he meditated, the creation became established in five ways. Just as a lamp is covered up with a pot, the creation was enveloped by darkness. Like a lamp lighted in a pitcher illuminated within and (dark) without, it was pure but devoid of feeling.
verses.hindi: प्रथमः सांप्रतस्तेषां कर्पो 5य॑ वर्तते (जा:  त।स्मन्स्वायंभुवाद्यास्तु मनवः स्युश्वतुदश ५० अतीता वर्तमानाश्व भांवेष्या ये च वे पुन; । तैरियं पृथिवो सचोा सप्ठतद्कीपा समन्ततः
verses.wordMeaning: Nescience ( Avidya ) with five joints, viz. darkness, delusion, super-delusion, murkiness and super-murkiness**, be¬ came manifested out of the Supreme Soul. While he meditated, the creation became established in five ways. Just as a lamp is covered up with a pot,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Nescience ( Avidya ) with five joints, viz. darkness, delusion, super-delusion, murkiness and super-murkiness**, be¬ came manifested out of the Supreme Soul. While he meditated, the creation became established in five ways. Just as a lamp is covered up with a pot,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां नर्मदा पुण्या रुद्रदेहाद्विनिःसृता । सर्वाभ्यश्च सरिद्भ्यश् च वरदानान्महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ narmadā puṇyā rudradehādviniḥsṛtā / sarvābhyaśca saridbhyaś ca varadānānmahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Its intellect and sense organs were concealed; it consis¬ ted of vegetation and since vegetation is declared to be primary it was called primary creation.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरेण चैकेन सर्वाण्येबान्तराणि वै । भांवेष्यारि भविष्येश्र॒ कदप: कल्पेन चैव ह
verses.wordMeaning: Its intellect and sense organs were concealed; it consis¬ ted of vegetation and since vegetation is declared to be primary it was called primary creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its intellect and sense organs were concealed; it consis¬ ted of vegetation and since vegetation is declared to be primary it was called primary creation.

verses.sanskrit: शंकरानुप्रहाद् देवी महापातकनाशिनी । यस्मान् महार्णवे घोरे दृश्यते महती च सा
verses.transliteration: śaṃkarānuprahād devī mahāpātakanāśinī / yasmān mahārṇave ghore dṛśyate mahatī ca sā
verses.translation: On seeing that the creation did not multiply, Brahma was dissatisfied and he went into contemplation. When he contemplated thus the Tirjaksrolas (tire animal world) came into being. Since this creation proceeded obliquely, it was called Tirjaksrolas. Predominated by Tamas, they were mainly ignorant. They took to wrong direction. They were self-swayed and devoted to self.
verses.hindi: अतीतानि च कल्पान सोदकानि सद्दानवयः  अनागतेघु तद्धच्च तकः कार्यों विजानता
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that the creation did not multiply, Brahma was dissatisfied and he went into contemplation. When he contemplated thus the Tirjaksrolas (tire animal world) came into being. Since this creation proceeded obliquely, it was called Tirjaksrolas. Predominated by Tamas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that the creation did not multiply, Brahma was dissatisfied and he went into contemplation. When he contemplated thus the Tirjaksrolas (tire animal world) came into being. Since this creation proceeded obliquely, it was called Tirjaksrolas. Predominated by Tamas,…

verses.sanskrit: सुव्यक्ताङ्गी महाकाया महती तेन सा स्मृता । तस्माद् विक्षोभ्यमाणा हि दिग्गजैरम्बुदोपमैः
verses.transliteration: suvyaktāṅgī mahākāyā mahatī tena sā smṛtā / tasmād vikṣobhyamāṇā hi diggajairambudopamaiḥ
verses.translation: The lord saw this second creation of Tiiyak-srotas, proud of themselves, conceited and divided into twenty-eight— eleven based on the sense organs, nine of Udaya and the eight of Taraka and other Saktis.
verses.hindi: होने से यज्ञ तथा क्रान्तिदर्शी होने के कारण कवि कहता है। क्रमणीय भर्थात् सबका गन्तव्य होने से क्रमण तथा वर्णों की रक्षा करने से आदित्य और कपिल कहलाता है। आगे उत्पन्न होने के कारण यह अग्नि कहा जाता है। हिरण्य इसका गर्भ तथा यह हिरण्य के गर्भ से उत्पन्न हुआ अतएवं इसे पुराण में हिरण्यगर्भ कहते हैं। व्यतीत स्वयम्भु के वर्ष आदि काल सेकड़ों वर्षों में भी नहीं गिनाये जा सकते। कल्प संख्या से युक्त
verses.wordMeaning: The lord saw this second creation of Tiiyak-srotas, proud of themselves, conceited and divided into twenty-eight— eleven based on the sense organs, nine of Udaya and the eight of Taraka and other Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord saw this second creation of Tiiyak-srotas, proud of themselves, conceited and divided into twenty-eight— eleven based on the sense organs, nine of Udaya and the eight of Taraka and other Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: कलुषत्वं नयत्येव रसेन सुरसा तथा । कृपां करोति सा यस्माल्लोकानामभयप्रदा
verses.transliteration: kaluṣatvaṃ nayatyeva rasena surasā tathā / kṛpāṃ karoti sā yasmāllokānāmabhayapradā
verses.translation: Puranas believe that despite the annihilation of everything at the end of a Kalpa, god Brahma recreates the universe on the model of the previous universe. They state this succinctly as follows: dhata yathopunam akalpayat' They were all illuminated within but covered exter¬ nally. Since their activity was oblique, they were called Tiryak- srotas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म का काल पर कहलाता है ।४४-४७॥ उतना ही (जितना बीत चुका है) उसका काल अभी शेष है । उसके अन्त में प्रलय होता है। कोटि सहख्र कल्प जो बोत गये उतने ही पर काल अभी शेष है। इस समय जो वतंमान वाराह कल्प है उसे सुनिये । ब्राह्मणों, उनमें से पहला यह साम्प्रत कल्प है । इसमें स्वांयभुव आदि चौदह मनु हैं ।४5-५०। उनमें व्यतीत वत्तमान, तथा भविष्य जो हैं वे ही नरेश भली भाँति
verses.wordMeaning: Puranas believe that despite the annihilation of everything at the end of a Kalpa, god Brahma recreates the universe on the model of the previous universe.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Puranas believe that despite the annihilation of everything at the end of a Kalpa, god Brahma recreates the universe on the model of the previous universe.…

verses.sanskrit: संसारार्णवमग्नानां तेन चैषा कृपा स्मृता । पुरा कृतयुगे पुण्ये दिव्यमन्दारभूषिता
verses.transliteration: saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ tena caiṣā kṛpā smṛtā / purā kṛtayuge puṇye divyamandārabhūṣitā
verses.translation: Having seen the second universe, the Tiryaksrotas, and having observed everything of it of that designation (nature), the Lord conceived of the (following) idea: Even as he was thinking uninterruptedly (nilyam), the Sattvika creation appeared (ofitself, automatically).
verses.hindi: इस सातों द्वीपों वाली पृथिवी का पूरे चार सहुख युग तक तप तथा प्रजोत्पत्ति से पालन करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Having seen the second universe, the Tiryaksrotas, and having observed everything of it of that designation (nature), the Lord conceived of the (following) idea: Even as he was thinking uninterruptedly (nilyam), the Sattvika creation appeared (ofitself, automatically).
verses.commentary: Sense: Having seen the second universe, the Tiryaksrotas, and having observed everything of it of that designation (nature), the Lord conceived of the (following) idea: Even as he was thinking uninterruptedly (nilyam), the Sattvika creation appeared (ofitself, automatically).

verses.sanskrit: कल्पवृक्षसमाकीर्णा रोहीतकसमाकुला । वहत्येषा च मन्देन तेन मन्दाकिनी स्मृता
verses.transliteration: kalpavṛkṣasamākīrṇā rohītakasamākulā / vahatyeṣā ca mandena tena mandākinī smṛtā
verses.translation: This third creation was called Ordhvasrotas, consisting of beings in which the stream of life passed upwards. Since life proceeded upwards it was called Ordhvasroias. The Ordhvasroias beings have abundance of comfort and pleasure. They are circumscribed outwardly and inwardly and are brilliant externally and internally.
verses.hindi: उनका विस्तार आप लोग सुनिये  ज्ञानी पुरुष को एक हो मन्वस्तर से सभी मन्वन्तरों का, एवं भविष्य से भविष्यों का तथा कल्प से कह्पों का, एवं वंश और देवों के साथ अतीत कल्प जंसे हैं बसे ही भविष्य में भी होंगे ऐसा पक कर लेना चाहिए ॥५३-५४।॥।
verses.wordMeaning: This third creation was called Ordhvasrotas, consisting of beings in which the stream of life passed upwards. Since life proceeded upwards it was called Ordhvasroias. The Ordhvasroias beings have abundance of comfort and pleasure.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This third creation was called Ordhvasrotas, consisting of beings in which the stream of life passed upwards. Since life proceeded upwards it was called Ordhvasroias. The Ordhvasroias beings have abundance of comfort and pleasure.…

verses.sanskrit: भित्त्वा महार्णवं क्षिप्रं यस्माल्लोकमिहागता । पूज्या सुरैश्च सिद्धैश्च तस्मादेषा महार्णवा
verses.transliteration: bhittvā mahārṇavaṃ kṣipraṃ yasmāllokamihāgatā / pūjyā suraiśca siddhaiśca tasmādeṣā mahārṇavā
verses.translation: These created beings are air etc. They are well settled after creating themselves. The Ordhvasroias being the third (in the series of creations), that creation is known after them.
verses.hindi: श्रीवायुमह्वपुराण का प्रकृतिवर्णन नाम का पाचवाँ अध्याय समाप्त ॥५॥।
verses.wordMeaning: These created beings are air etc. They are well settled after creating themselves. The Ordhvasroias being the third (in the series of creations), that creation is known after them.
verses.commentary: Sense: These created beings are air etc. They are well settled after creating themselves. The Ordhvasroias being the third (in the series of creations), that creation is known after them.

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रोत्पलसंघातैर् ऋक्षद्विपसमाकुला
verses.transliteration: vicitrotpalasaṃghātair ṛkṣadvipasamākulā
verses.translation: When gods with.upward stream (the divine creation of Ordhvasroias) were created god Brahma was satisfied. As he was the competent Over-Lord, he thought of and created beings that would be Sadhakas (aspirants after spiritual power). The first creation is of Mahal. It is known as Mahat- sarga. The second is the creation of TanmtVras and is called the creation of the Bhil/as.
verses.hindi: एकार्णवे तदा तस्मिन्न प्राज्लायत किचन । तदा स भगवानब्रह्मा सहस्नाक्ष सहस्रपात्
verses.wordMeaning: When gods with.upward stream (the divine creation of Ordhvasroias) were created god Brahma was satisfied. As he was the competent Over-Lord, he thought of and created beings that would be Sadhakas (aspirants after spiritual power). The first creation is of Mahal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When gods with.upward stream (the divine creation of Ordhvasroias) were created god Brahma was satisfied. As he was the competent Over-Lord, he thought of and created beings that would be Sadhakas (aspirants after spiritual power). The first creation is of Mahal.…

verses.sanskrit: भित्त्वा शैलं च विपुलं प्रयात्येवं महार्णवम् । भ्रामयन्ती दिशः सर्वा रवेण महता पुरा
verses.transliteration: bhittvā śailaṃ ca vipulaṃ prayātyevaṃ mahārṇavam / bhrāmayantī diśaḥ sarvā raveṇa mahatā purā
verses.translation: The third creation is that of Vikaras (the products of Prakfti) and is perceptible by the senses. Thus the Prakrta creation took place with conscious fore-knowledge.
verses.hindi: सत्वोद्रेकात्प्रबुद्धस्तु शूल्यं लोकमुदीकच्य सः  इमे चोदाहरन्त्यत्र ्छोक॑ नारायण प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: The third creation is that of Vikaras (the products of Prakfti) and is perceptible by the senses. Thus the Prakrta creation took place with conscious fore-knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: The third creation is that of Vikaras (the products of Prakfti) and is perceptible by the senses. Thus the Prakrta creation took place with conscious fore-knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: प्लावयन्ती विराजन्ती तेन रेवा इति स्मृता । भार्यापुत्रसुदुःखाढ्यान्नराञ्छापैः समावृतान्
verses.transliteration: plāvayantī virājantī tena revā iti smṛtā / bhāryāputrasuduḥkhāḍhyānnarāñchāpaiḥ samāvṛtān
verses.translation: The ' Mukhya' creation is the fourth in order. The Muk- hyas are the immobile beings. The creation of Tiryaksrolas is the fifth consisting of animals. The sixth creation of Ord/wasrotas consists of divine beings. The seventh creation of the Arvdksrolas is that of man¬ kind.
verses.hindi: तुल्यं युगसहस्नस्य नैशे कालमुपास्य सः। शव॑यन्ते प्रकुरुते बद्वत्वं सर्गकारणात्
verses.wordMeaning: The ' Mukhya' creation is the fourth in order. The Muk- hyas are the immobile beings. The creation of Tiryaksrolas is the fifth consisting of animals. The sixth creation of Ord/wasrotas consists of divine beings. The seventh creation of the Arvdksrolas is that of man¬ kind.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ' Mukhya' creation is the fourth in order. The Muk- hyas are the immobile beings. The creation of Tiryaksrolas is the fifth consisting of animals. The sixth creation of Ord/wasrotas consists of divine beings. The seventh creation of the Arvdksrolas is that of man¬ kind.

verses.sanskrit: विपापान्कुरुते यस्माद्विपापा तेन सा स्मृता । विण्मूत्रनिचयां घोरां पांशुशोणितकर्दमाम्
verses.transliteration: vipāpānkurute yasmādvipāpā tena sā smṛtā / viṇmūtranicayāṃ ghorāṃ pāṃśuśoṇitakardamām
verses.translation: The eighth creation is Aimgraha. It is characterised by Sattva and Tamas. These (latter) five are the Vaikrla creation and the (first) three are Prakrta.
verses.hindi: 'अकरोत्स तन हान्‍न्यां कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा । ततो महात्मा मनसा दिव्य॑ रूपमचिन्तयत्
verses.wordMeaning: The eighth creation is Aimgraha. It is characterised by Sattva and Tamas. These (latter) five are the Vaikrla creation and the (first) three are Prakrta.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eighth creation is Aimgraha. It is characterised by Sattva and Tamas. These (latter) five are the Vaikrla creation and the (first) three are Prakrta.

verses.sanskrit: पाशैर्नित्यं तु सम्बाधां यस्मान्मोचयते भृशम् । विपाशेति च सा प्रोक्ता संसारार्णवतारिणी
verses.transliteration: pāśairnityaṃ tu sambādhāṃ yasmānmocayate bhṛśam / vipāśeti ca sā proktā saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī
verses.translation: The ninth creation Kaumdra is both Prakrta and Vaikrla. The three Prakrta creations were brought about with¬ out planning or pre-meditation. The six creations of Brahma function intelligently. Now understand the Anugraha Sarga in detail. It is of four types found in all living beings thro¬ ugh contrariety, power, satisfaction and achievement. In the immobile beings there is Viparyasa (contrariety or loss of con¬ sciousness). In the animals, there is Sakli (power). Human be¬ ings are Siddhatmans (with souls capable of achieving spiritual progress). In Devas there is Tusti (satisfaction).
verses.hindi: सूत बोले-- पृथ्वी तल पर अग्नि के नष्ट हो जाने पर अग्नि से जल उत्पन्न हुआ  स्थावर जंग्रम सहित पृथ्वी जब उस जल में विलीनं हो गई, तब चारों ओर केवल समुद्र दिखाई पड़ने लगा। उस प्रलय पयोधि में कोई दूसरा पदार्थे दृष्टिगोचर नहीं,.होता था। उस समय सहस्र नेत्र, सहस्न पाद और सहस्रशीषं, रकम वर्ण और अतीन्द्रिय पुरुष भगवान् ब्रह्मा, जिनको नारायण कहा जाता हैं, उस सलिल राशि में सो गए
verses.wordMeaning: The ninth creation Kaumdra is both Prakrta and Vaikrla. The three Prakrta creations were brought about with¬ out planning or pre-meditation. The six creations of Brahma function intelligently. Now understand the Anugraha Sarga in detail.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ninth creation Kaumdra is both Prakrta and Vaikrla. The three Prakrta creations were brought about with¬ out planning or pre-meditation. The six creations of Brahma function intelligently. Now understand the Anugraha Sarga in detail.…

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा विमलाम्भा च विमलेन्दुशुभानना । तमोभूते महाघोरे यस्मादेषा महाप्रभा
verses.transliteration: narmadā vimalāmbhā ca vimalenduśubhānanā / tamobhūte mahāghore yasmādeṣā mahāprabhā
verses.translation: There are thus the nine creations including Prakrtas and Vaikrlas. By their mutual combination, the types are many.
verses.hindi: कुछ समय बाद सतोग्रुण के जागरित होने पर वे जाग गये उस समय उनको चतुदिक् शुन्य ही दिखाई पड़ता था ! उस नाराबण के प्रति यह इलोक कहा जाता है कि अपू, नार तनु ये जल की संज्ञायें हैं, अतः वे जल में सोते हैं इसलिए वे नारायण कहे जाते हैं ।४-५। वे ही हजारयुगों के बराबर निशा काल बीत जाते पर रात्रि के अन्त में सृष्टि के लिये ब्रह्म का रूप धारण करते हैं ।६॥ ब्रह्मा उस समय वायु का रूप धारण
verses.wordMeaning: There are thus the nine creations including Prakrtas and Vaikrlas. By their mutual combination, the types are many.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are thus the nine creations including Prakrtas and Vaikrlas. By their mutual combination, the types are many.

verses.sanskrit: विमला तेन सा प्रोक्ता विद्वद्भिर्नृपसत्तम । करैर् इन्दुकरप्रख्यैः सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभा
verses.transliteration: vimalā tena sā proktā vidvadbhirnṛpasattama / karair indukaraprakhyaiḥ sūryaraśmisamaprabhā
verses.translation: At the beginning, Brahma created three mental sons equal to himself, viz. Sanandana, Sanaka and the intelligent Sanatana who possessed great power and enlightenment - Those (sons) of great splendour and strength renounced When they had left, Brahma created other menial sons who could accomplish the object. They identified themselves with their position and abided till the final dissolution of the world. (Now) know them by their names:
verses.hindi: कर वर्षा काल के रात्रि के समय इघर उधर उड़ने वाले जुगनू की तरह इधर-उधर समुद्र तल पर घूमने लगे। “अनुमान से उस समुद्र में डूबी हुई पृथिवी का पता पाकर उसके उद्धार के लिये सच्चेष्ट हो गये । उन्होंने पूर्व कल्पों में जेसा शरीर धारण किया था वैसा ही दूसरा शरीर धारण कर लिया । पुन; वे महात्मा मन
verses.wordMeaning: At the beginning, Brahma created three mental sons equal to himself, viz. Sanandana, Sanaka and the intelligent Sanatana who possessed great power and enlightenment - Those (sons) of great splendour and strength renounced When they had left,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the beginning, Brahma created three mental sons equal to himself, viz. Sanandana, Sanaka and the intelligent Sanatana who possessed great power and enlightenment - Those (sons) of great splendour and strength renounced When they had left,…

verses.sanskrit: क्षरन्ती मोदते विश्वं करभा तेन चोच्यते । यस्माद् रञ्जयते लोकान्दर्शनादेव भारत
verses.transliteration: kṣarantī modate viśvaṃ karabhā tena cocyate / yasmād rañjayate lokāndarśanādeva bhārata
verses.translation: They are water, fire, earth, air, ether, quarters, heaven, firmament, oceans, rivers, mountains, plants, the 'souls' of medicinal herbs, trees and creepers, units of time, Lavas, Kas- ihas, A aids, Muhurtas, Sandhis (junctions of day and night like dusk, dawn etc.), night, day, fortnights, months, Ay anas, years and Yugas. These arc the positions with which they identify themselves.
verses.hindi: दशयोजनविस्ती् शतयोजनमुच्छितम्। नीलेमेघप्रतीकाश मेघस्तनितनिस्वनम् ।॥
verses.wordMeaning: They are water, fire, earth, air, ether, quarters, heaven, firmament, oceans, rivers, mountains, plants, the 'souls' of medicinal herbs, trees and creepers, units of time, Lavas, Kas- ihas, A aids, Muhurtas, Sandhis (junctions of day and night like dusk, dawn etc.), night, day,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are water, fire, earth, air, ether, quarters, heaven, firmament, oceans, rivers, mountains, plants, the 'souls' of medicinal herbs, trees and creepers, units of time, Lavas, Kas- ihas, A aids, Muhurtas, Sandhis (junctions of day and night like dusk, dawn etc.), night, day,…

verses.sanskrit: रञ्जनाद् रञ्जना प्रोक्ता धात्वर्थे राजसत्तम । तृणवीरुधगुल्माद्यास् तिर्यञ्चः पक्षिणस्तथा । तानुद्भूतान्नयेत्स्वर्गं तेनोक्ता वायुवाहिनी
verses.transliteration: rañjanād rañjanā proktā dhātvarthe rājasattama / tṛṇavīrudhagulmādyās tiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇastathā / tānudbhūtānnayetsvargaṃ tenoktā vāyuvāhinī
verses.translation: The classes of society are born of his limbs: Brah¬ ma 8 (were created) out of his mouth;' Ksatriyas out of his arms; Vaisyas out of his thighs; and Sudras out of his feet. The lord is beyond Avyakla (unmanifest Prakrti). The Cosmic Egg is born of the unmanifest. Brahma is born of the Cosmic Egg. The worlds are created by him.
verses.hindi: महापवतवर्ष्मा् श्वेत तीदणोग्रई ध्टिगम । विद्य॒ुदश्चिप्रकाशाक्षमाद्त्यलमतेजसम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The classes of society are born of his limbs: Brah¬ ma 8 (were created) out of his mouth;' Ksatriyas out of his arms; Vaisyas out of his thighs; and Sudras out of his feet. The lord is beyond Avyakla (unmanifest Prakrti). The Cosmic Egg is born of the unmanifest.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The classes of society are born of his limbs: Brah¬ ma 8 (were created) out of his mouth;' Ksatriyas out of his arms; Vaisyas out of his thighs; and Sudras out of his feet. The lord is beyond Avyakla (unmanifest Prakrti). The Cosmic Egg is born of the unmanifest.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं यो वेत्ति नामानि निर्गमं च विशेषतः । स याति पापविर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोकं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yo vetti nāmāni nirgamaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / sa yāti pāpavirmukto rudralokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus this first section has been narrated to you all very
verses.hindi: स वेदपाधूपदंष्टः: क्रत॒वक्षाश्वितीमुखः । अश्विजिह्ली दर्भरोमा ब्रह्मशीर्षों (रॉ) महातपाः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus this first section has been narrated to you all very
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus this first section has been narrated to you all very

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये सहैतुकरेवानाममाहात्म्यवर्णने मयूरकल्पसमुद्भवो नाम षष्ठो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ७ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुनरेकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजंगमे । सलिलेनाप्लुते लोके निरालोके तमोद्भवे
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye sahaitukarevānāmamāhātmyavarṇane mayūrakalpasamudbhavo nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 7 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: punarekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame / salilenāplute loke nirāloke tamodbhave
verses.translation: Thus this first Pcida (section) the main theme of which was prakriyd was narrated. On hearing it, Sanatana, the descen¬ dant of Kasyapa was much delighted in mind. Addressing Suta with (appreciative) words, he asked him the subsequent narrative. "O Knower of Kalpas, please narrate to us (the events during) the period of transition between the two ages. 1
verses.hindi: चेद्स्कन्घो ह॒विर्गस्धों हृव्यकव्यातिवेगवान् । प्राग्वंशकायो द्युतिमान्नानादीक्षाभिरन्वितः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus this first Pcida (section) the main theme of which was prakriyd was narrated. On hearing it, Sanatana, the descen¬ dant of Kasyapa was much delighted in mind. Addressing Suta with (appreciative) words, he asked him the subsequent narrative. "O Knower of Kalpas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus this first Pcida (section) the main theme of which was prakriyd was narrated. On hearing it, Sanatana, the descen¬ dant of Kasyapa was much delighted in mind. Addressing Suta with (appreciative) words, he asked him the subsequent narrative. "O Knower of Kalpas,…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मैको विचरंस्तत्र तमीभूते महार्णवे । दिव्यवर्षसहस्रं तु खद्योत इव रूपवान्
verses.transliteration: brahmaiko vicaraṃstatra tamībhūte mahārṇave / divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu khadyota iva rūpavān
verses.translation: We are desirous to know the difference between the two Kalpas, viz. the one that has gone and the other that is current. Let us also know the Pratisandhi (period of transition) between the two (Kalpas) as you are undoubtedly very intelligent." I shall describe to you here the difference between the two Kalpas: the one that has gone and the other that is current, and the period of transition between the two.
verses.hindi: में दिव्य रूप का ध्यान करने लगे ।७-८। वे चारों ओर से प्रथ्वी को जल से घिरी हुई देख कर सोचने लगे कि किस महान् शरीर को धारण कर इस पृथ्वी का उद्धार कहूँ ।॥९॥ इतने में जल क्रीड़ा के उपयुक्त वाराह रूप का उनको स्मरण हो गया । तब हरि ने, प्राणियों से अजेय, वाइमय और धर्ममृति वाराह रूप को धारण किया, जिसका शरीर दश योजन लम्बा और सौ योजन ऊँचा
verses.wordMeaning: We are desirous to know the difference between the two Kalpas, viz. the one that has gone and the other that is current.…
verses.commentary: Sense: We are desirous to know the difference between the two Kalpas, viz. the one that has gone and the other that is current.…

verses.sanskrit: शेते योजनसाहस्रम् अप्रमेयम् अनुत्तमम् । द्वादशादित्यसंकाशं सहस्रचरणेक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: śete yojanasāhasram aprameyam anuttamam / dvādaśādityasaṃkāśaṃ sahasracaraṇekṣaṇam
verses.translation: O sages of holy rites, now understand the Manvan- taras that are in the Kalpas. This auspicious Kalpa that is current now is (called the) Varaha Kalpa. The Kalpa that has gone before this Kalpa was (known as) Sana tana. Now understand the (condition of) the interim period between that Kalpa and the present one. Out of the five main characteristics of a Purana, description of Man- vantaras is one. Thus we find it in Bh. P. VIII. 1. 1-29, KP. I. 51, NP. I. 40. 17-37 and others. This chapter which textually corresponds to Bd. P. I. 2. 6 deals with Kalpas and the interim period between them.
verses.hindi: था। वें रंग में नीले मेघ के समान और घोद चीत्कार करने में भी मेघ के ही समान विशाल काय, श्वेत तीक्ष्ण और- कठोर दाँतों वाले उस वाराह की आँखे विद्युत और अग्नि के समान चमकीली थीं । सूये के समान तेजस्वी उसका स्कन्ध मोटा, लम्बा और गोल था । सिंह के समान ग़मन करने वाले उस देव का कटि भाग पीन और उन्नत था। इस प्रकार सुडौल शुभ लक्षण, अमित और विपुल
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of holy rites, now understand the Manvan- taras that are in the Kalpas. This auspicious Kalpa that is current now is (called the) Varaha Kalpa. The Kalpa that has gone before this Kalpa was (known as) Sana tana.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of holy rites, now understand the Manvan- taras that are in the Kalpas. This auspicious Kalpa that is current now is (called the) Varaha Kalpa. The Kalpa that has gone before this Kalpa was (known as) Sana tana.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रसुप्तं चार्णवे घोरे ह्यपश्यत्कूर्मरूपिणम् । तं दृष्ट्वा विस्मयापन्नो ब्रह्मा बोधयते शनैः
verses.transliteration: prasuptaṃ cārṇave ghore hyapaśyatkūrmarūpiṇam / taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāpanno brahmā bodhayate śanaiḥ
verses.translation: When the previous Kalpa recedes there is a period of transition. Another Kalpa sets in again and again from Jana- loka. This happens again and again when the period of transi¬ tion ends, the Kalpas are cut off from each other. At the end of a Kalpa, all the rites are completely annihilated. Hence it is called the period of transition between one Kalpa and another. The joints (transition) between the periods called Man- vantara and Yuga are also cut off. Manvantaras function with the inter-connectionsof Yugas.
verses.hindi: फ्ाय उस वाराह रूप को धारण कर भगवान् पृथ्वी का उद्धार करने के लिये रसातल में घुस गए
verses.wordMeaning: When the previous Kalpa recedes there is a period of transition. Another Kalpa sets in again and again from Jana- loka. This happens again and again when the period of transi¬ tion ends, the Kalpas are cut off from each other. At the end of a Kalpa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the previous Kalpa recedes there is a period of transition. Another Kalpa sets in again and again from Jana- loka. This happens again and again when the period of transi¬ tion ends, the Kalpas are cut off from each other. At the end of a Kalpa,…

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतिभिर्मंगलैश्चैव वेदवेदांगसंभवैः । वाचस्पते विबुध्यस्व महाभूत नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: stutibhirmaṃgalaiścaiva vedavedāṃgasaṃbhavaiḥ / vācaspate vibudhyasva mahābhūta namo 'stu te
verses.translation: The Kalpas that have been briefly narrated in the Prakriya Pdda [each Kalpa (out of them) has a Purva-ardha (earlier half) and a Para-ardha (later half) ]. When a Kalpa elapses, its later half is followed by the earlier half of the next Kalpa. The other Kalpas which follow in future are so tied with their later half. The Kalpa that is current, O Brahmanas, is the first among them.
verses.hindi: उस भगवान् वाराह के वेद चरण, यूप दंष्टू, यज्ञ वक्षःस्थल, चिति मुख, अग्नि जिद्वा, कुश रोमसमृह और ब्रह्मा ही शिर थे। उस महात्मा ने दिन रात को नेत्र के रूप में धारण किया था। वेदाजू उनके कानों के कुण्डल, आज्य नासिका के छिंद्र और खुवा उन का तुण्ड (नथुना) था। उनका दीघ॑ घोष : ही साम गान था। सत्य धर्ममय वे श्रीमान् धर्म और विक्रम की साक्षात् प्रतिमा थे। प्रायश्चित्त
verses.wordMeaning: The Kalpas that have been briefly narrated in the Prakriya Pdda [each Kalpa (out of them) has a Purva-ardha (earlier half) and a Para-ardha (later half) ]. When a Kalpa elapses, its later half is followed by the earlier half of the next Kalpa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kalpas that have been briefly narrated in the Prakriya Pdda [each Kalpa (out of them) has a Purva-ardha (earlier half) and a Para-ardha (later half) ]. When a Kalpa elapses, its later half is followed by the earlier half of the next Kalpa.…

verses.sanskrit: तवोदरे जगत्सर्वं तिष्ठते परमेश्वर । तद्विमुञ्च महासत्त्व यत्पूर्वं संहृतं त्वया
verses.transliteration: tavodare jagatsarvaṃ tiṣṭhate parameśvara / tadvimuñca mahāsattva yatpūrvaṃ saṃhṛtaṃ tvayā
verses.translation: In it the first (half) is called Purva ( Purvardha ) and the later half is called Para. This is the period of sustenance (of the world). The period after it is called the dissolution of the world. 1 The Kalpa which preceded the present Kalpa was Sanatana (by name). When at the end of one thousand sets of four Yugas along with the Manvantaras, the Kalpa came to an end, then the time of the destruction (of the universe) by fire arrived: 2
verses.hindi: उनका रथ, पशु उनका भयद्भूर जनु देश था। वे महान् आकार वाले थे, उद्गाता उनकी अतड़ियाँ, होम लिज्भ स्थान और महोषधियाँ बीज, ज्ञान उनका अन्तःकरण, मन्त्र स्फिगू, आज्य रक्त, सोम शोणित तथा वेद स्कन्‍्ध थे । हवि उनके शरीर की सगन्‍्ध, ह॒व्य उनका वेग, और प्राग्वश शरीर था
verses.wordMeaning: In it the first (half) is called Purva ( Purvardha ) and the later half is called Para. This is the period of sustenance (of the world). The period after it is called the dissolution of the world. 1 The Kalpa which preceded the present Kalpa was Sanatana (by name).…
verses.commentary: Sense: In it the first (half) is called Purva ( Purvardha ) and the later half is called Para. This is the period of sustenance (of the world). The period after it is called the dissolution of the world. 1 The Kalpa which preceded the present Kalpa was Sanatana (by name).…

verses.sanskrit: व्यतीता रजनी ब्राह्मी दिनं समनुवर्तते । निरीक्ष्य सर्वलोकेश येन संभवते जगत्
verses.transliteration: vyatītā rajanī brāhmī dinaṃ samanuvartate / nirīkṣya sarvalokeśa yena saṃbhavate jagat
verses.translation: The following verses describe the process of dissolution of the Uni¬ verse. In all the fourteen Manvantaras, there had been Devas, Pitrs, sages and Manus in the heaven.
verses.hindi: प्र6 गि वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: The following verses describe the process of dissolution of the Uni¬ verse. In all the fourteen Manvantaras, there had been Devas, Pitrs, sages and Manus in the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following verses describe the process of dissolution of the Uni¬ verse. In all the fourteen Manvantaras, there had been Devas, Pitrs, sages and Manus in the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: स निशम्य वचस्तस्य उत्थितः परमेश्वरः । समुद्गिरन् स लोकांस्त्रीन् ग्रस्तान् कल्पक्षये तदा
verses.transliteration: sa niśamya vacastasya utthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ / samudgiran sa lokāṃstrīn grastān kalpakṣaye tadā
verses.translation: The sons of Manus who are their followers, the res¬ pectable Devas who receive honour and praise from the people of all castes and stages of life and those heaven-dwellers who remain in the Devaloka—all these stand on equal footing along with their associates at the time of final dissolution. When the dissolution becomes due, the Devas residing in the three worlds realize their inevitable (fateful) turn which necessarily occurs in due course. 1 Characterized by unconcern and grief, they forsake their associated positions and fix their
verses.hindi: दक्षिणाहृद्यो योगी महासत्रमयों विश्ः । डपाकर्मेष्टिर्चिरः प्रवरग्यवित्तमूषणः
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Manus who are their followers, the res¬ pectable Devas who receive honour and praise from the people of all castes and stages of life and those heaven-dwellers who remain in the Devaloka—all these stand on equal footing along with their associates at the time of fina…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Manus who are their followers, the res¬ pectable Devas who receive honour and praise from the people of all castes and stages of life and those heaven-dwellers who remain in the Devaloka—all these stand on equal footing along with their associates at the time of fina…

verses.sanskrit: देवदानवगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः । सचन्द्रार्कग्रहाः सर्वे शरीरात्तस्य निर्गताः
verses.transliteration: devadānavagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / sacandrārkagrahāḥ sarve śarīrāttasya nirgatāḥ
verses.translation: They are endowed with bodies special to Maharloka. All of them abound in special purity and acquire mental achievement. They establish contact with the Brahmanas, Ksatri- yas, Vaisyas and others who have been devoted to that Kalpa. After fixing their minds on Maharloka, the fourteen groups o
verses.hindi: ततः स्वस्थानमानीय पृथिवीं पृथिवीकरः  मुमोच पूच मनसा घारयित्या घराघरः
verses.wordMeaning: They are endowed with bodies special to Maharloka. All of them abound in special purity and acquire mental achievement. They establish contact with the Brahmanas, Ksatri- yas, Vaisyas and others who have been devoted to that Kalpa. After fixing their minds on Maharloka,…
