verses.sanskrit: पुनर्दृश्या भविष्यन्ति सृजमानाः स्वयंभुवा । साहं लिङ्गार्चनपरा नर्मदा नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: punardṛśyā bhaviṣyanti sṛjamānāḥ svayaṃbhuvā / sāhaṃ liṅgārcanaparā narmadā nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: Those who were engaged in serving others, those who were lustreless and deficient in virility he called Sudras because they bewailed their lot, were miserable and adopted crooked ways. Lord Brahma assigned their duties and virtues when the system of castes was thus established. Out of delusion the people did not follow their duties. Not observing the (special) duties of castes, they clashed mutually. On realising that precisely, lord Brahma ordered strength, punishment and warfare as the means of sustenance for the Ksatriyas.
verses.hindi: ८ संबोध्य सूत॑ वचसा पश्रच्छाथोत्तरां कथाम् । अतः प्रभ्भति कत्पक्ष प्रतिसंधि प्रचच्च नः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who were engaged in serving others, those who were lustreless and deficient in virility he called Sudras because they bewailed their lot, were miserable and adopted crooked ways. Lord Brahma assigned their duties and virtues when the system of castes was thus established.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who were engaged in serving others, those who were lustreless and deficient in virility he called Sudras because they bewailed their lot, were miserable and adopted crooked ways. Lord Brahma assigned their duties and virtues when the system of castes was thus established.…

verses.sanskrit: कालं युगसहस्रस्य रुद्रस्य परिचारिका । अस्य प्रसादादमरस्तथा त्वं द्विजपुंगव
verses.transliteration: kālaṃ yugasahasrasya rudrasya paricārikā / asya prasādādamarastathā tvaṃ dvijapuṃgava
verses.translation: The lord assigned these as the duties of Brahmanas: presiding over sacrifice, teaching of the Vedas and the accept¬ ance of monetary gifts. The lord assigned breeding of cattle, trading and agriculture to the Vaisyas. He made the practice of arts and crafts as means of livelihood and service the duties of Stidras. The duties common to the three classes—Brahmanas Ksatriyas and Vaisyas include the performance of sacrifice, study of the Vedas and making gifts.
verses.hindi: प्रत्याहते पूबकाले श्रतिसंधि च तत्र वै। अन्यः प्रवत॑ते कल्पो जनाललोकात्पुन: पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: The lord assigned these as the duties of Brahmanas: presiding over sacrifice, teaching of the Vedas and the accept¬ ance of monetary gifts. The lord assigned breeding of cattle, trading and agriculture to the Vaisyas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord assigned these as the duties of Brahmanas: presiding over sacrifice, teaching of the Vedas and the accept¬ ance of monetary gifts. The lord assigned breeding of cattle, trading and agriculture to the Vaisyas.…

verses.sanskrit: सत्यार्जवदयायुक्तः सिद्धो ऽसि त्वं शिवार्चनात् । एवमुक्त्वा तु सा देवी तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: satyārjavadayāyuktaḥ siddho 'si tvaṃ śivārcanāt / evamuktvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: After prescribing the holy rites and duties as the means of livelihood, the lord gave them suitable regions in the other worlds achievable by means of Siddhi. The region of the Brahmanas who performed their sacred rites and duties is the world of Prajapati. The world of Indra is the region for Ksatriyas who flee not in battle. The region ofMaruts is assigned to Vaisyas who main¬ tain themselves as per their (ordained) duties. To the Sudras who abide by their duty of rendering service, the region of Gandharvas is assigned. These are the regions for different castes who observe
verses.hindi: हो गये ।१। इसके बाद सूत का प्रिय शब्दों से सम्मान कर उन्होंने पुतः आगे की कथा पूछी कि-हे कल्प की कथा जानने वाले ! आप अत्यन्त कुशल हैं अब इसके बाद प्रतिसन्धि के विषय में हम लोगों को बतलाइये । बीते हुये और वतंमान कल्प का जं मध्य काल है और उनकी जो प्रतिसन्धि है उसको हम लोग जानना चाहने हैं, आप अत्यन्त कुशल हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After prescribing the holy rites and duties as the means of livelihood, the lord gave them suitable regions in the other worlds achievable by means of Siddhi. The region of the Brahmanas who performed their sacred rites and duties is the world of Prajapati.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After prescribing the holy rites and duties as the means of livelihood, the lord gave them suitable regions in the other worlds achievable by means of Siddhi. The region of the Brahmanas who performed their sacred rites and duties is the world of Prajapati.…

verses.sanskrit: ताः स्त्रियः स च देवेशो बकरूपो महेश्वरः । तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा अवतीर्य महानदीम्
verses.transliteration: tāḥ striyaḥ sa ca deveśo bakarūpo maheśvaraḥ / tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā avatīrya mahānadīm
verses.translation: Formerly, the Lord established the four ASramas, viz. Brahmacarin (the religious student), Grhastha (the house¬ holder), Vanaprastha (the recluse) and Bhiksuka (the ascetic mendicant). Those who do not practise the duties assigned to their caste, they say, incurred the loss of the (fruit of) holy rites even if they maintained the activities of the ASramas. Brahma established these Airamas by name. 1 In order to guide them, he spoke to them about.[their duties, manners, restraints and observances.
verses.hindi: लोमहषंण बोले--'अब मैं अतीत और वर्तमान दोनों कल्पों की जो प्रतिसन्धियाँ हैं तथा जिन कलपों में जो मन्वन्तर होते हैं, है सुब्रत ! उसको बतला रहा हूं! यह जो वरतंमान कल्प है वह शुभ साम्प्रत या वाराह कल्प कहलाता हैं ।४३। इस कल्प से पूं का जो कल्प बीत गया है वह सनातन कल्प था । उस अतीत और इस वर्तमान वाराह कल्प की मध्य अवस्था के विषय में सुनिये ।५-६। पूर्व कल्प के बीत जाने
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the Lord established the four ASramas, viz. Brahmacarin (the religious student), Grhastha (the house¬ holder), Vanaprastha (the recluse) and Bhiksuka (the ascetic mendicant). Those who do not practise the duties assigned to their caste, they say,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the Lord established the four ASramas, viz. Brahmacarin (the religious student), Grhastha (the house¬ holder), Vanaprastha (the recluse) and Bhiksuka (the ascetic mendicant). Those who do not practise the duties assigned to their caste, they say,…

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा समर्चय त्वं हि विधिना मन्त्रपूर्वकम् । ततो ऽहं सहसा तस्मात् समुत्तीर्य जलाशयात्
verses.transliteration: snātvā samarcaya tvaṃ hi vidhinā mantrapūrvakam / tato 'haṃ sahasā tasmāt samuttīrya jalāśayāt
verses.translation: The ASrama of the householder is common to all the four castes. This stage is the very basis and support of the other three Asramas. I shall explain it in order along with the observances and restraints. The following are briefly the religious duties of the householders: Marriage, maintenance of the sacred fire, hospi¬ tality to guests, performance of sacrifices and continuation of the race (procreation of children). The characteristic duties of a Brahmacarin are: (bear¬ ing) the staff, wearing the girdle (of muhja grass), sleeping on the bare ground, having matted hair, service to the preceptor and begging alms. Wearing of bark garments, leaves or deer skin, diet of grains, roots, fruits or herbs (found in the forest), bathing at dawn and dusk and performing sacrifice are the characteristics of a forest-dweller.
verses.hindi: पर प्रतिसन्धि आती है, तब दूसरा कल्प जनलोक से आता है ॥७। बीच में प्रतिसन्धि के आ जाने से ही एक कल्प दूसरे कल्प से पृथक् होते हैं। पूर्व कल्प के बीत जाने पर उस अतीत कल्प को प्रतिसन्धि कहा जाता है। मन्वन्तर और युगों की अविच्छिन्न सन्धियाँ मन्वन्तर युभों के साथ परस्पर प्रवत्त होती हैं। जो प्रक्रिया पाद में संक्षेप में कहे गये हैं वे पूवें कल्प हैं ॥+-१०। उन पराधे कल्पों में इससे पूर्व जो प्रथम कल्प था
verses.wordMeaning: The ASrama of the householder is common to all the four castes. This stage is the very basis and support of the other three Asramas. I shall explain it in order along with the observances and restraints.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ASrama of the householder is common to all the four castes. This stage is the very basis and support of the other three Asramas. I shall explain it in order along with the observances and restraints.…

verses.sanskrit: न च पश्यामि तल्लिङ्गं न च तां निम्नगां नृप । तदैव लोकाः संजाताः क्षितिश्चैव सकानना
verses.transliteration: na ca paśyāmi talliṅgaṃ na ca tāṃ nimnagāṃ nṛpa / tadaiva lokāḥ saṃjātāḥ kṣitiścaiva sakānanā
verses.translation: Begging when the sound of pestles dies down, non¬ stealing, purity, non-negligence, refraining from sexual inter¬ course, mercy towards (all) beings, forebearance, absence of anger (control of temper), service to preceptors and the tenth truthfulness—This code of conduct of ten characteristics has been prescribed by the self-born god (Brahma). Five (of the above) are the main observances and five subsidiaries which constitute the sacred rites of the mendicant ascetic. Purity in the conduct of life, restraints, purity of the mind, counteraction of evil deeds and perfect vision these are They say that the holy course of conduct ( dhaivia ) of a man of renunciation consists of meditation (samadhi), con¬ trol of the mind and of the sense-organs, silence, taking of food voluntarily offered by others and endeavour for liberation (fiom sarhsara).
verses.hindi: वह तो व्यतीत हो चुका किन्तु द्वितीय पराधें कल्प अभी नहीं व्यतीत हुआ है ।११। अन्य जो भविष्य में आने वाले कल्प हैं वे अपराध से गुणीकृत (अपराद्ध नाम से प्रसिद्ध) हैं । द्विजो ! उनमें से पहला साम्प्रत नामक
verses.wordMeaning: Begging when the sound of pestles dies down, non¬ stealing, purity, non-negligence, refraining from sexual inter¬ course, mercy towards (all) beings, forebearance, absence of anger (control of temper),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Begging when the sound of pestles dies down, non¬ stealing, purity, non-negligence, refraining from sexual inter¬ course, mercy towards (all) beings, forebearance, absence of anger (control of temper),…

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षचन्द्रार्कविततं तदेव च नभस्तलम् । यथापूर्वम् अदृष्टं तु तथैव च पुनः कृतम् । नतोऽहं मनसा देवमपूजयं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣacandrārkavitataṃ tadeva ca nabhastalam / yathāpūrvam adṛṣṭaṃ tu tathaiva ca punaḥ kṛtam / nato'haṃ manasā devamapūjayaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: If a person is defiled in inner emotions, all his external actions never bear fruit even if he puts in his utmost effort. Even if a person donates all his possessions but with an impious inner soul, he shall not be virtuous. Piety is the true cause of perfection. It is said that the region attained by the persons who abide by this Dharma is that of the Devas, Pitys, sages and Manus. There are eighty-eight thousand sages of sublimated sexuality. It is their region that is assigned to those who live with their teachers.
verses.hindi: यस्मिन्पूर्वः पराध तु द्वितीयः पर उच्यते  एतावान्स्थितिकालस्य प्रत्याहारस्ततः स्म्तः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: If a person is defiled in inner emotions, all his external actions never bear fruit even if he puts in his utmost effort. Even if a person donates all his possessions but with an impious inner soul, he shall not be virtuous. Piety is the true cause of perfection.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person is defiled in inner emotions, all his external actions never bear fruit even if he puts in his utmost effort. Even if a person donates all his possessions but with an impious inner soul, he shall not be virtuous. Piety is the true cause of perfection.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं बके पुरा कल्पे मया दृष्टेयम् अव्यया । नर्मदा मर्त्यलोकस्य महापातकनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bake purā kalpe mayā dṛṣṭeyam avyayā / narmadā martyalokasya mahāpātakanāśinī
verses.translation: The sphere of the seven sages is the abode of heaven- dwellers. Prajapatya (the region of Prajapati) is the sphere of householders. The region of Brahma is the abode for Sannya- sins. The region of immortality is the abode for the Yogins. There is no abode for those who have mental worries. These are the regions for the people of different stages of life who abide by their allotted duties. The four paths called Devayana have been made by Brahma, 1 the controller of Verses 187-189: Puranic concept of Devayana and Pitryana paths after death.
verses.hindi: क्षीणे कल्पे तदा तस्मिन्दाहकाले ह्यपस्थिते। तस्मिन्कल्पे तदा देवा आसन्वैमानिकास्तु ये
verses.wordMeaning: The sphere of the seven sages is the abode of heaven- dwellers. Prajapatya (the region of Prajapati) is the sphere of householders. The region of Brahma is the abode for Sannya- sins. The region of immortality is the abode for the Yogins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sphere of the seven sages is the abode of heaven- dwellers. Prajapatya (the region of Prajapati) is the sphere of householders. The region of Brahma is the abode for Sannya- sins. The region of immortality is the abode for the Yogins.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्धर्मपरैर् विप्रैः क्षत्रशूद्रविशादिभिः । सदा सेव्या महाभागा धर्मवृद्ध्यर्थकारिभिः
verses.transliteration: tasmāddharmaparair vipraiḥ kṣatraśūdraviśādibhiḥ / sadā sevyā mahābhāgā dharmavṛddhyarthakāribhiḥ
verses.translation: Similarly the moon is the doorway to Pitryana (the path of the Pitrs). When these divisions of castes and stages oflife were made but when the people did not abide by their injunctions, he evolved another mental creation from his own body which was like himself. When the first Treta age reached the middle period, gradually he began to create another mind-born progeny. Then the lord created beings with (predominant) Sattva and Rajas gunas. They were competent to accomplish virtue, love, wealth, liberation and their means of livelihood. He created Devas, Pitrs, sages and Manus (i.e-. human beings) who were suitable for the Yuga. They have procreated these subjects as per Dharma.
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रग्नहतारास्तु चन्द्रसूयत्रहाश्व ये। अध्याविशतिरवैताः कोटअस्तु सुकृतात्मनाम
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly the moon is the doorway to Pitryana (the path of the Pitrs). When these divisions of castes and stages oflife were made but when the people did not abide by their injunctions, he evolved another mental creation from his own body which was like himself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly the moon is the doorway to Pitryana (the path of the Pitrs). When these divisions of castes and stages oflife were made but when the people did not abide by their injunctions, he evolved another mental creation from his own body which was like himself.…

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽपि भक्तया सकृत्तोये नर्मदाया महेश्वरम् । स्नात्वा ते सर्वं पापं नाशयन्त्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: ye 'pi bhaktayā sakṛttoye narmadāyā maheśvaram / snātvā te sarvaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayantyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: When the subjects abided by the Dharma prescribed by the self-born lord (Brahma) he meditated on the, mind-born beings of different forms. The persons who have been mentioned to you by me, as having resorted to Janaloka became devas and other subjects here, when the (previous) Kalpa passed away. While he meditated, the subjects appeared before him for creation. In the order of the Manvantaras, they are consi¬ dered the first or the last. They are imbued with the knowledge of discrimination, adjuncts and topics. Endowed with efficient and inefficient activities, they are restrained by the residue o the fruit of their actions. They attain the state of devas, Asuras, Pitrs, animals, birds, reptiles, trees, hellish beings and insects. He created them to be subservient to himself and his su jects.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरे तथैकस्मिश्वतुदशसख वै तथा। ज्ीणि कोटिशतान्यासन्कोटश्यों द्विनवतिस्तथा ।
verses.wordMeaning: When the subjects abided by the Dharma prescribed by the self-born lord (Brahma) he meditated on the, mind-born beings of different forms. The persons who have been mentioned to you by me, as having resorted to Janaloka became devas and other subjects here,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the subjects abided by the Dharma prescribed by the self-born lord (Brahma) he meditated on the, mind-born beings of different forms. The persons who have been mentioned to you by me, as having resorted to Janaloka became devas and other subjects here,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये बककल्पसमुद्भवो नामाष्टमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुनर्युगान्तं ते चान्यं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु । सूर्यैरादीपिते लोके जङ्गमे स्थावरे पुरा
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye bakakalpasamudbhavo nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 9 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: punaryugāntaṃ te cānyaṃ sampravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu / sūryairādīpite loke jaṅgame sthāvare purā
verses.translation: Even as he was meditating* mental progeny were born of him along with those causes and effects arising out ofhis body. There emerged from the limbs of that intelligent Being ICsctra- jfias (individual souls). Then, desirous of procreating the group of four living entities, Devas, Asuras, Pitrs, and mankind, he applied himself in the water. 1
verses.hindi: अष्टादिकाः सप्रशताः सहस्लाणां समता: पुरा। चैम्ानिकानां देवानाकल्पेडतीते तु येइसचन
verses.wordMeaning: Even as he was meditating* mental progeny were born of him along with those causes and effects arising out ofhis body. There emerged from the limbs of that intelligent Being ICsctra- jfias (individual souls). Then, desirous of procreating the group of four living entities,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as he was meditating* mental progeny were born of him along with those causes and effects arising out ofhis body. There emerged from the limbs of that intelligent Being ICsctra- jfias (individual souls). Then, desirous of procreating the group of four living entities,…

verses.sanskrit: सरित्सरःसमुद्रेषु क्षयं यातेषु सर्वशः । निर्मानुषवषट्कारे ह्यमर्यादगतिं गते
verses.transliteration: saritsaraḥsamudreṣu kṣayaṃ yāteṣu sarvaśaḥ / nirmānuṣavaṣaṭkāre hyamaryādagatiṃ gate
verses.translation: Then as the self-born god Brahma engaged himself in meditation on creation, exertion appeared on the part of the creator. Then, from his loins, the Asuras were born at the outset. O Brahmanas, the word Asu means 'the Vital Breath 5. Born of that, they were called Asuras. 2
verses.hindi: पकैकस्मिस्तु कल्पे यै देवा वैमानिकाः रखता; । अथ मन्वन्तरेष्वासंश्रतुदशस थैदिवयि
verses.wordMeaning: Then as the self-born god Brahma engaged himself in meditation on creation, exertion appeared on the part of the creator. Then, from his loins, the Asuras were born at the outset. O Brahmanas, the word Asu means 'the Vital Breath 5. Born of that, they were called Asuras. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Then as the self-born god Brahma engaged himself in meditation on creation, exertion appeared on the part of the creator. Then, from his loins, the Asuras were born at the outset. O Brahmanas, the word Asu means 'the Vital Breath 5. Born of that, they were called Asuras. 2

verses.sanskrit: नानारूपैस्ततो मेधैः शक्रायुधविराजितैः । सर्वमापूरितं व्योम वार्यौघैः पूरिते तदा
verses.transliteration: nānārūpaistato medhaiḥ śakrāyudhavirājitaiḥ / sarvamāpūritaṃ vyoma vāryaughaiḥ pūrite tadā
verses.translation: He abandoned that body from which Asuras were created; the body so abandoned by him became night immediately as it (the abandoned body) was dominated by Tamas. Verses 2-22 describe the creation of four entities of living beings, viz. Asuras, Devas, Pitrs and human beings from various parts of god Brahma's
verses.hindi: देवाश्व पितरश्चैव मुनयो मनवस्था । तेषामलुचरा ये च मलुपुत्नास्तथेव च
verses.wordMeaning: He abandoned that body from which Asuras were created; the body so abandoned by him became night immediately as it (the abandoned body) was dominated by Tamas. Verses 2-22 describe the creation of four entities of living beings, viz. Asuras, Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He abandoned that body from which Asuras were created; the body so abandoned by him became night immediately as it (the abandoned body) was dominated by Tamas. Verses 2-22 describe the creation of four entities of living beings, viz. Asuras, Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वेकार्णवीभूते सर्वतः सलिलावृते । जगत्कृत्वोदरे सर्वं सुष्वाप भगवान्हरः
verses.transliteration: tatastvekārṇavībhūte sarvataḥ salilāvṛte / jagatkṛtvodare sarvaṃ suṣvāpa bhagavānharaḥ
verses.translation: Human beings Vide v. 21 below. As MW 121-a notes, 'In later SK., Sura 'a god' has been formed from asura like sita is from asita\
verses.hindi: चर्णाश्रमिभिरीड््ाश्व तस्मिन्काले तु ये खुराः  सन्वन्तरेघु ये हयासन्देवलोके दिवौकसः
verses.wordMeaning: Human beings Vide v. 21 below. As MW 121-a notes, 'In later SK., Sura 'a god' has been formed from asura like sita is from asita\
verses.commentary: Sense: Human beings Vide v. 21 below. As MW 121-a notes, 'In later SK., Sura 'a god' has been formed from asura like sita is from asita\

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य योगात्मा स प्रजापतिः । शेते युगसहस्रान्तं कालमाविश्य सार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya yogātmā sa prajāpatiḥ / śete yugasahasrāntaṃ kālamāviśya sārṇavam
verses.translation: As it (the abandoned body) was dominated by Tamas, the night consisting of three watches was full of darkness. Hence the progeny of the self-born lord were enveloped by darkness at night. After creating the Asuras, the lord took up another body of unmanifest nature abounding in Sattva. The lord united himself with it. While engaged with it, they say, he felt plea- sure.
verses.hindi: ते तेः संयोजकैः साथ प्राप्त संकालने तथा। तुल्यनिष्ठास्तु ते स्व प्राप्ते ह्याभूतसंप्चे ॥
verses.wordMeaning: As it (the abandoned body) was dominated by Tamas, the night consisting of three watches was full of darkness. Hence the progeny of the self-born lord were enveloped by darkness at night. After creating the Asuras,…
verses.commentary: Sense: As it (the abandoned body) was dominated by Tamas, the night consisting of three watches was full of darkness. Hence the progeny of the self-born lord were enveloped by darkness at night. After creating the Asuras,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सुप्तं महात्मानं ब्रह्मलोकनिवासिनः । भृग्वादिऋषयः सर्वे ये चान्ये सनकादयः
verses.transliteration: tatra suptaṃ mahātmānaṃ brahmalokanivāsinaḥ / bhṛgvādiṛṣayaḥ sarve ye cānye sanakādayaḥ
verses.translation: Then Devas were born from his shining face. They were so called because they were born of his refulgent face. The root y/Div means 1 'to play'. Devas were so called because they were born of his playful (shining) body.
verses.hindi: ततस्तेडवश्यभावित्वाइ॒बुध्चा पर्यायमात्मनः । चेलोक्य वासिनों देवा (“इहस्थानाभिमानिनः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then Devas were born from his shining face. They were so called because they were born of his refulgent face. The root y/Div means 1 'to play'. Devas were so called because they were born of his playful (shining) body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Devas were born from his shining face. They were so called because they were born of his refulgent face. The root y/Div means 1 'to play'. Devas were so called because they were born of his playful (shining) body.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यङ्के विमले शुभ्रे नानास्तरणसंस्तृते । शयानं ददृशुर्देवं सपत्नीकं वृषध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: paryaṅke vimale śubhre nānāstaraṇasaṃstṛte / śayānaṃ dadṛśurdevaṃ sapatnīkaṃ vṛṣadhvajam
verses.translation: After creating Devas, the lord took up another body having only the Sattvic attribute. He abandoned the body after creating the Pitrs. As soon as he abandoned the body, it became evening.
verses.hindi: यह कल्प बीत रहा है ।१२। जो प्रथम पराढ़ं में पूर्व है और जो द्वितीय पराडे में पर कहा जाता है इतना काल परिमाण स्थितिकाल है इसके बाद का काल प्रत्याहार काल (प्रलय काल) कहा गया है अर्थात पूर्व और पर पराद्ध काल स्थितिकाल और इस द्विपरार्ड के बाद का प्रलय काल (प्राकृत प्रलयकाल) कहा जाता है ।१३। इस कल्प से पूर्व जो सनातन कल्प था वह बीत चुका है । वह सहस्र चतुयुगंं के अन्त में मन्वन्तर परि-
verses.wordMeaning: After creating Devas, the lord took up another body having only the Sattvic attribute. He abandoned the body after creating the Pitrs. As soon as he abandoned the body, it became evening.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating Devas, the lord took up another body having only the Sattvic attribute. He abandoned the body after creating the Pitrs. As soon as he abandoned the body, it became evening.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वरूपा तु सा नारी विश्वरूपो महेश्वरः । गाढमालिङ्ग्य सुप्तस् तां ददृशे चाहमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: viśvarūpā tu sā nārī viśvarūpo maheśvaraḥ / gāḍhamāliṅgya suptas tāṃ dadṛśe cāhamavyayam
verses.translation: Hence day is for Devas; night is meant for the Asuras; the body (meant for) Pitrs, evening which is between the two, is held to be important. Hence Devas, Asuras, all the sages and Manus, engaged in Yogic communion, worship the middle body (i.e. the twilight time) of Brahma.
verses.hindi: मित ब्राह्म दिवस के अन्त होने पर क्षीण हो गया।१४ उस समय कल्प के क्षीण होने पर और प्रलयकालीन-दाहकाल के आ जाने पर उस कल्प में जितने विमान-विहारी देवता, नक्षत्र, ग्रह, तारामण्डल तू और चन्द्रमा आदि ग्रह थे, वे सुकृतात्मा देव सब मिलाकर अट्टठाइस करोड़ थे ।१५-१६। यह एक मन्वन्तर के देवताओं की संख्या है । इस प्रकार चौदहों मन्वन्तरों के देवों की संख्या तीन सौ बानवे करोड़
verses.wordMeaning: Hence day is for Devas; night is meant for the Asuras; the body (meant for) Pitrs, evening which is between the two, is held to be important. Hence Devas, Asuras, all the sages and Manus, engaged in Yogic communion, worship the middle body (i.e. the twilight time) of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence day is for Devas; night is meant for the Asuras; the body (meant for) Pitrs, evening which is between the two, is held to be important. Hence Devas, Asuras, all the sages and Manus, engaged in Yogic communion, worship the middle body (i.e. the twilight time) of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: पादमूले ततस्तस्य श्यामां तां पद्मलक्षणाम् । कन्यां पश्यामि सुश्रोणीं चरणौ तस्य मृद्गतीम्
verses.transliteration: pādamūle tatastasya śyāmāṃ tāṃ padmalakṣaṇām / kanyāṃ paśyāmi suśroṇīṃ caraṇau tasya mṛdgatīm
verses.translation: Then Brahma took up another body again. The Lord created beings with his mind, in that body consisting of Rajas. Then he created mentally sons from his mind which was dominated by Rajas guna. Hence the subjects were born of his mind.
verses.hindi: हुई ।१७। पहले व्यतोत (बीते हुए) कल्प में जो वेमानिक देव थे उनकी संख्या सात सौ आठ हजार कही गई है। एक कल्प में जितने वमानिक देव होते हैं स्वर्ग में उतने ही चौदहों मन्वन्तरों में होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma took up another body again. The Lord created beings with his mind, in that body consisting of Rajas. Then he created mentally sons from his mind which was dominated by Rajas guna. Hence the subjects were born of his mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma took up another body again. The Lord created beings with his mind, in that body consisting of Rajas. Then he created mentally sons from his mind which was dominated by Rajas guna. Hence the subjects were born of his mind.

verses.sanskrit: विमलाम्बरसंवीतां व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनीम् । श्यामां कमलपत्राक्षीं सर्वाभरणभूषिताम्
verses.transliteration: vimalāmbarasaṃvītāṃ vyālayajñopavītinīm / śyāmāṃ kamalapatrākṣīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām
verses.translation: Having seen the subjects, he again cast off his body. The body so abandoned by him immediately became the moon¬ light. Putralvam would mean "His being a son unto them".
verses.hindi: उस मन्वन्तर या कल्प काल में जितने देवता, पितर, मुनि तथा मानव, उनके अनुचर, वर्णाश्रम धर्मावलम्बियों के पूज्य जितने देवता एवं मन्वन्तरों में जो देवलोक के रहने वाले देवता थे, वे अपने संयोजकों के साथ उस समय संहार काल में प्रलयकालीन लक्षणों के उपस्थित हो जाने पर समान भाव से अपने अवश्यंभावी पर्याय (स्थान-नाश) को जान गये ।२०-२-। अतएवं वे त्लोक्यवासी देवता जो कि अपने स्थान-
verses.wordMeaning: Having seen the subjects, he again cast off his body. The body so abandoned by him immediately became the moon¬ light. Putralvam would mean "His being a son unto them".
verses.commentary: Sense: Having seen the subjects, he again cast off his body. The body so abandoned by him immediately became the moon¬ light. Putralvam would mean "His being a son unto them".

verses.sanskrit: सकलं युगसाहस्रं नर्मदेयं विजानती । प्रसुप्तं देवदेवेशमुपास्ते वरवर्णिनी
verses.transliteration: sakalaṃ yugasāhasraṃ narmadeyaṃ vijānatī / prasuptaṃ devadeveśamupāste varavarṇinī
verses.translation: Hence the people are delighted when the moonlight comes out (and spreads). Thus these bodies abandoned by the lord instantly became night and day, the twilight and the moon¬ light. The three, viz. the moonlight, twilight as well as the day consist solely of the Saliva guna. The night comprises the nature of Tanias only; hence it has three watches. Hence Devas created from the mouth are possessed of shining fraits of the day and full of delight. Since they were born during the day, they are very powerful by day.
verses.hindi: महत्त्व पर अभिमान करने वाले थे--उस समय अपने स्थितिकाल को समाप्तप्राय और पर्चादुभावी प्रलय के
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the people are delighted when the moonlight comes out (and spreads). Thus these bodies abandoned by the lord instantly became night and day, the twilight and the moon¬ light. The three, viz. the moonlight, twilight as well as the day consist solely of the Saliva guna.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the people are delighted when the moonlight comes out (and spreads). Thus these bodies abandoned by the lord instantly became night and day, the twilight and the moon¬ light. The three, viz. the moonlight, twilight as well as the day consist solely of the Saliva guna.…

verses.sanskrit: हृतैर्वेदैश्चतुर्भिश्च ब्रह्माप्येवं महेश्वरः । भृग्वाद्यैर्मानसैः पुत्रैः स्तौति शङ्करमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: hṛtairvedaiścaturbhiśca brahmāpyevaṃ maheśvaraḥ / bhṛgvādyairmānasaiḥ putraiḥ stauti śaṅkaramavyayam
verses.translation: Since the lord created the Asuras at night from the loins of his body, through vital-breath, the night-born Asuras wield unbearable prowess during the night. These alone function as the causes for the creation of Devas, Asuras, Pitrs and human beings in the past and future Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रस्थ: क. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since the lord created the Asuras at night from the loins of his body, through vital-breath, the night-born Asuras wield unbearable prowess during the night. These alone function as the causes for the creation of Devas, Asuras,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the lord created the Asuras at night from the loins of his body, through vital-breath, the night-born Asuras wield unbearable prowess during the night. These alone function as the causes for the creation of Devas, Asuras,…

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या परमया राजंस्तत्र शम्भुम् अनामयम् । स्तुवन्तस्तत्र देवेशं मन्त्रैरीश्वरसम्भवैः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā paramayā rājaṃstatra śambhum anāmayam / stuvantastatra deveśaṃ mantrairīśvarasambhavaiḥ
verses.translation: The moonlight, the night, the day and the twilight, these four shine when illuminated. The word y/bha means 'to spread' and 'to shine'. 1 2 So say the wise scholars. The root y/bha is used in the sense of spreading and shining. After seeing (creating?) waters, the Lord created Devas, Danavas, human beings, Pitrs and his other divinities.
verses.hindi: श्प वायुपुराणम् ै
verses.wordMeaning: The moonlight, the night, the day and the twilight, these four shine when illuminated. The word y/bha means 'to spread' and 'to shine'. 1 2 So say the wise scholars. The root y/bha is used in the sense of spreading and shining. After seeing (creating?) waters,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The moonlight, the night, the day and the twilight, these four shine when illuminated. The word y/bha means 'to spread' and 'to shine'. 1 2 So say the wise scholars. The root y/bha is used in the sense of spreading and shining. After seeing (creating?) waters,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रसुप्तं देवमीशानं बोधयन्समुपस्थितः । उत्तिष्ठ हर पिङ्गाक्ष महादेव महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: prasuptaṃ devamīśānaṃ bodhayansamupasthitaḥ / uttiṣṭha hara piṅgākṣa mahādeva maheśvara
verses.translation: After casting off that body entirely, he created another form mostly constituted of Rajas and Tamas and united himself with it.. Feeling hunger and thirst in darkness, he created an¬ other body. The hungry creature created by him attempted to take (possess) the waters.
verses.hindi: स्थितिकाले तदा पूण ह्यासन्ने पश्चिमेउन्तरे। कल्पचासानिका देवा) तस्समिन्प्राप्ते ह्यपप्नवे २४ तेनौत्सक्यविषादेन त्यकत्वा स्थानानि भावतः  महलोकाय संविश्लास्ततस्ते दिरे मतिम्॥ ते युक्ता उपपचन्ते महसि स्थैः शरीरकेः  विशुद्धिबहुलाः सर्व मानसीं सिद्धिमास्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: After casting off that body entirely, he created another form mostly constituted of Rajas and Tamas and united himself with it.. Feeling hunger and thirst in darkness, he created an¬ other body. The hungry creature created by him attempted to take (possess) the waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: After casting off that body entirely, he created another form mostly constituted of Rajas and Tamas and united himself with it.. Feeling hunger and thirst in darkness, he created an¬ other body. The hungry creature created by him attempted to take (possess) the waters.

verses.sanskrit: मम वेदा हृताः सर्वे अतो ऽहं स्तोतुमुद्यतः । वेदैर्व्याप्तं जगत्सर्वं दिव्यादिव्यं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: mama vedā hṛtāḥ sarve ato 'haṃ stotumudyataḥ / vedairvyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ divyādivyaṃ carācaram
verses.translation: Some among them declared, "We shall protect these waters". They are known as Rdksasas in the v/orld. They are wrathful souls and night-walkers. Those among them who deli¬ ghtedly said to one another, "We shall destroy the waters'-' be¬ came, due to that activity, Yaksas and Guhyakas. They were cruel in their actions. The root y/raksa is considered to have the sense of protection. The root y/ksi is used in the sense of destroying.®
verses.hindi: मत्वा तु ते महलोंक॑ देवसंघाश्चतुदश । ततसरते जनलोकाय सोद्धेगा दूधिरे मातिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Some among them declared, "We shall protect these waters". They are known as Rdksasas in the v/orld. They are wrathful souls and night-walkers. Those among them who deli¬ ghtedly said to one another, "We shall destroy the waters'-' be¬ came, due to that activity,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Some among them declared, "We shall protect these waters". They are known as Rdksasas in the v/orld. They are wrathful souls and night-walkers. Those among them who deli¬ ghtedly said to one another, "We shall destroy the waters'-' be¬ came, due to that activity,…

verses.sanskrit: अतीतं वर्तमानं च स्मरामि च सृजाम्यहम् । तैर्विना चाहमेकस्तु मूको ऽधो जडवत्सदा
verses.transliteration: atītaṃ vartamānaṃ ca smarāmi ca sṛjāmyaham / tairvinā cāhamekastu mūko 'dho jaḍavatsadā
verses.translation: Verses 23-24 suggest the derivation of ambhas 'water* from y/bha. Verses 27-29 give the Puraijic etymology of 'Rakjasa' and ' Takfa '.
verses.hindi: पुतेन क्रमयोगेन (णु) यान्ति कव्पनिवासिनः । एवं देवयुगानां तु सहस्तराणि परस्परात्
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 23-24 suggest the derivation of ambhas 'water* from y/bha. Verses 27-29 give the Puraijic etymology of 'Rakjasa' and ' Takfa '.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 23-24 suggest the derivation of ambhas 'water* from y/bha. Verses 27-29 give the Puraijic etymology of 'Rakjasa' and ' Takfa '.

verses.sanskrit: गतिर्वीर्यं बलोत्साहौ तैर्विना न प्रजायते । तैर्विना देवदेवेश नाहं किंचित् स्मरामि वै
verses.transliteration: gatirvīryaṃ balotsāhau tairvinā na prajāyate / tairvinā devadeveśa nāhaṃ kiṃcit smarāmi vai
verses.translation: On seeing them with displeasure, the hairs of that As they move footlessly (without foot), they are pannagas and they are sarpas as they crawl. Their abode is below in the earth under the sun and the moon.
verses.hindi: गतानि ब्रह्मलोक वै अपरावतिनीं गतिम्। आधिपत्य॑ घिना,ते वे ऐेश्वयंण तु तत्समाः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing them with displeasure, the hairs of that As they move footlessly (without foot), they are pannagas and they are sarpas as they crawl. Their abode is below in the earth under the sun and the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them with displeasure, the hairs of that As they move footlessly (without foot), they are pannagas and they are sarpas as they crawl. Their abode is below in the earth under the sun and the moon.

verses.sanskrit: तान्वेदान्देवदेवेश शीघ्रं मे दातुमर्हसि । जडान्धबधिरं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: tānvedāndevadeveśa śīghraṃ me dātumarhasi / jaḍāndhabadhiraṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: The excessively terrible fiery foetus, born of his anger, entered those beings of poisonous nature—serpents who were born along with them. On seeing the serpents, he became angry and out of anger he created beings of furious nature. They were very fierce goblins whose diet is flesh and who were reddish-brown in colour.
verses.hindi: भवन्ति ब्रह्मण॒स्तुल्या रूपेण विषयेण च। तत्न ते छावतिष्ठन्ति (न्ते) प्रीतिय॒क्ताः प्रसंगभात्
verses.wordMeaning: The excessively terrible fiery foetus, born of his anger, entered those beings of poisonous nature—serpents who were born along with them. On seeing the serpents, he became angry and out of anger he created beings of furious nature.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The excessively terrible fiery foetus, born of his anger, entered those beings of poisonous nature—serpents who were born along with them. On seeing the serpents, he became angry and out of anger he created beings of furious nature.…

verses.sanskrit: स्थानादि दश चत्वारि न शोभन्ते सुरेश्वर । प्रणमाम्य् अल्पवीर्यत्वाद् वेदहीनः सुरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: sthānādi daśa catvāri na śobhante sureśvara / praṇamāmy alpavīryatvād vedahīnaḥ sureśvara
verses.translation: They were remembered as Bhutas as they came into existence. 2 They were called PiSacas because they ate flesh. Even as he was singing words, the Gandharvas were born. The root y/dhay means 'to drink'. 3 Since they were born from drinking the (musical) words, they are known as Gandharvas.
verses.hindi: उपद्रवों को निकट आया हुआ समझ गए ।२३-२४। अतएव अपने स्थानों को छोड़ कर उत्सुकता और विषादयुक्त हो महलॉंक जाने के लिये आतुरता के साथ सोचने लगे ।२५। उस समय वे सभी देवता अपनी परम आत्म- विशुद्धि के कारण महलोंक के उपयुक्त शरीर को पा गये, इस प्रक/र उस समय सबको मानसीसिद्धि प्राप्त हो गई ।२६। वे चौदह प्रकार के देवगण उस महलोंक में उन ब्राह्मणों, क्षत्रियों, वेश्यों, भक्तों और अपर जनों के
verses.wordMeaning: They were remembered as Bhutas as they came into existence. 2 They were called PiSacas because they ate flesh. Even as he was singing words, the Gandharvas were born. The root y/dhay means 'to drink'. 3 Since they were born from drinking the (musical) words,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were remembered as Bhutas as they came into existence. 2 They were called PiSacas because they ate flesh. Even as he was singing words, the Gandharvas were born. The root y/dhay means 'to drink'. 3 Since they were born from drinking the (musical) words,…

verses.sanskrit: वेदेभ्यः सकलं जातं यत्किंचित्सचराचरम् । तावच्छोभन्ति शास्त्राणि समस्तानि जगद्गुरो
verses.transliteration: vedebhyaḥ sakalaṃ jātaṃ yatkiṃcitsacarācaram / tāvacchobhanti śāstrāṇi samastāni jagadguro
verses.translation: When these eight classes of divine beings were created, the lord from his bodily energy created birds out of his own free will. Covering up those chandas (wilful acts) and the birds by his age (?) and seeing them void, he created groups of winged
verses.hindi: साथ जिन्होंने ' महान्” को प्राप्त कर लिया है--9ुछ समय रहकर जनलोक जाने के लिये उद्विग्न हो सोचने लगते हैं। २७ २५। तत्पश्चात् वे अति विश्युद्ध अन्तःकरण वाले जिन्होंने मानसी सिद्धि प्राप्त कर ली है, उन कल्प- वासियों के साथ जिन्होंने कि 'महान्' को प्राप्त कर लिया है--जनलोक को चले जाते हैं, वहाँ पर दश गुने समय तक (पूर्व काल के दशगुने अर्थात् दश कल्प तक) आनन्द भोगकर पुनः वहां से तपोलोक को चले जाते
verses.wordMeaning: When these eight classes of divine beings were created, the lord from his bodily energy created birds out of his own free will. Covering up those chandas (wilful acts) and the birds by his age (?) and seeing them void, he created groups of winged
verses.commentary: Sense: When these eight classes of divine beings were created, the lord from his bodily energy created birds out of his own free will. Covering up those chandas (wilful acts) and the birds by his age (?) and seeing them void, he created groups of winged

verses.sanskrit: यावद्वेदनिधिरयं नोपतिष्ठेत्सनातनः । यथोदितेन सूर्येण तमो याति विनाशताम्
verses.transliteration: yāvadvedanidhirayaṃ nopatiṣṭhetsanātanaḥ / yathoditena sūryeṇa tamo yāti vināśatām
verses.translation: He created goats from his mouth, birds from his chest, ' From his feet he created horses, elephants, Sarabhas, Gavayas, deer, camels, mules and other animals o vanou kinds.
verses.hindi: हैं। वहाँ पर भी दश कल्प तक रहकर पुनः सत्यलोक को चले जाते हैं ।२९-३०। इस क्रम से कल्पनिवासी ऊध्वे लोक जाते हैं। इस प्रकार एक के बाद एक लोक को प्राप्त करने में देवों के सहस्न युग बीत जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He created goats from his mouth, birds from his chest, ' From his feet he created horses, elephants, Sarabhas, Gavayas, deer, camels, mules and other animals o vanou kinds.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created goats from his mouth, birds from his chest, ' From his feet he created horses, elephants, Sarabhas, Gavayas, deer, camels, mules and other animals o vanou kinds.

verses.sanskrit: एवं समस्तपापानि यान्ति वेदस्य धारणात् । वेदे रहसि यत्सूक्ष्मं यत्तद्ब्रह्म सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ samastapāpāni yānti vedasya dhāraṇāt / vede rahasi yatsūkṣmaṃ yattadbrahma sanātanam
verses.translation: Some more.Purariic derivations: <hair * ah, < ht but Verses 35-36 derive the words 'BhUta, FtSaca ana
verses.hindi: वे देव ब्रह्मलोक में जाकर ऐसी गति को प्राप्त हो जाते हैं जहाँ से पुन: लौटते नहीं हैं । वहाँ वे आधिपत्य तो नहीं प्राप्त करते परन्तु रूप और विषय से ब्रह्म के ही अनुरूप होते हैं और उन्हीं के समान ऐद्वर्य का उपभोग करते हैं । प्रसन्नतापूर्वक वे वहाँ ब्रद्मानन्द को पाकर ब्रह्म के साथ मुक्ति (मोह-मुक्ति) प्राप्त करते हैं, पुनः जो स्वयं प्रकृति-सिद्ध अवश्यम्भावी सुष्टिप्रयोजनवश्य नानात्व से सम्बद्ध हो जाते हैं, उस काल से
verses.wordMeaning: Some more.Purariic derivations: <hair * ah, < ht but Verses 35-36 derive the words 'BhUta, FtSaca ana
verses.commentary: Sense: Some more.Purariic derivations: <hair * ah, < ht but Verses 35-36 derive the words 'BhUta, FtSaca ana

verses.sanskrit: हृदिस्थं देव जानामि गतं तद्वेदगर्जनात् । वेदानुच्चरतो मे ऽद्य तव शङ्कर चाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: hṛdisthaṃ deva jānāmi gataṃ tadvedagarjanāt / vedānuccarato me 'dya tava śaṅkara cāgrataḥ
verses.translation: yatrarl in the text is incorrect. A. reads 'panarthc, so » Bd. P. Plants or trees, fruits, and roots were born of his hair. After creating the cattle and plants thus, the lord applied himself to sacrifice. It was in the beginning of the Kalpa, in the Treta age. Cow, goat, man, 1 sheep, horse, mule and donkey—they call these rural domestic animals. Now know about the wild animals.
verses.hindi: सम्बद्ध उन देवों कक. ऐसी अ्रवस्था हो जाती है, जेसी जान ब्रझ्कर सोने का बहाना .करने वालों की होती
verses.wordMeaning: yatrarl in the text is incorrect. A. reads 'panarthc, so » Bd. P. Plants or trees, fruits, and roots were born of his hair. After creating the cattle and plants thus, the lord applied himself to sacrifice. It was in the beginning of the Kalpa, in the Treta age. Cow, goat, man,…
verses.commentary: Sense: yatrarl in the text is incorrect. A. reads 'panarthc, so » Bd. P. Plants or trees, fruits, and roots were born of his hair. After creating the cattle and plants thus, the lord applied himself to sacrifice. It was in the beginning of the Kalpa, in the Treta age. Cow, goat, man,…

verses.sanskrit: अकस्मात्ते गता वेदा न सृजेयं विभो भुवम् । ते ऽपि सर्वे महादेव प्रविष्टाः सम्मुखार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: akasmātte gatā vedā na sṛjeyaṃ vibho bhuvam / te 'pi sarve mahādeva praviṣṭāḥ sammukhārṇavam
verses.translation: Beasts of prey, cloven-hoofed animals, elephants, monkeys, birds constituting the fifth and the animals, mice—these were created. The seventh (in the series) were reptiles. From his front mouth 2 he created the metre Gayatri, Varuna 3, Trivrt 4, Soma, Ralhantara 5 6, and the Agnistoma among the sacrifices.
verses.hindi: नानात्वैनाभिसंबद्धास्तदा तत्कालभाविन। । स्वपतो बुछ्धिपूव हि यथा भवति जाप्मतः ॥रे४ तत्कालभावि तेषां तु तथा ज्ञार्न प्रचर्तते । प्रत्याहारे तु भेदानां येषां भिन्नाभिसूच्मणाम (१) । मै साथ प्रतिखज्यन्ते कार्याणि करणानि च  नानात्वदर्शनात्तेषां ब्रह्मलोकनिवासिनम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Beasts of prey, cloven-hoofed animals, elephants, monkeys, birds constituting the fifth and the animals, mice—these were created. The seventh (in the series) were reptiles. From his front mouth 2 he created the metre Gayatri, Varuna 3, Trivrt 4, Soma, Ralhantara 5 6,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Beasts of prey, cloven-hoofed animals, elephants, monkeys, birds constituting the fifth and the animals, mice—these were created. The seventh (in the series) were reptiles. From his front mouth 2 he created the metre Gayatri, Varuna 3, Trivrt 4, Soma, Ralhantara 5 6,…

verses.sanskrit: ते याच्यमाना देवेश तिष्ठन्तु स्मरणे मम । दुहितेयं विशालाक्षी सर्वः सर्वं विजानते
verses.transliteration: te yācyamānā deveśa tiṣṭhantu smaraṇe mama / duhiteyaṃ viśālākṣī sarvaḥ sarvaṃ vijānate
verses.translation: From his southern mouth he created the sacred hymns of (Yajurveda?), Trisfubh metre, the fifteenth stoma, the Brhat- saman, and the Uktha verses. From his western mouth he created the Saman hymns, Jagati metre, the fifteen hymns of praise, Vairupya Saman and Atiratra® rite.
verses.hindi: विनष्टस्वाधिकार्साणां स्वेन धर्म ए तिष्ठताम। ते तुल्यलक्ष णा/सिद्धा: शुद्धात्मानों नि रखना; ॥३े८ प्रकृती को रणातीताः स्वात्मस्येब व्यवस्थिताः प्रस्यापयित्वा ह्यास्मानं प्रकृतिस्तेषु सर्वशः
verses.wordMeaning: From his southern mouth he created the sacred hymns of (Yajurveda?), Trisfubh metre, the fifteenth stoma, the Brhat- saman, and the Uktha verses. From his western mouth he created the Saman hymns, Jagati metre, the fifteen hymns of praise, Vairupya Saman and Atiratra® rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his southern mouth he created the sacred hymns of (Yajurveda?), Trisfubh metre, the fifteenth stoma, the Brhat- saman, and the Uktha verses. From his western mouth he created the Saman hymns, Jagati metre, the fifteen hymns of praise, Vairupya Saman and Atiratra® rite.

verses.sanskrit: जायती युगसाहस्रं नान्या काचिद्भवेदृशी । ऋषिश्चायं महाभागो मार्कण्डो धीमतां वरः
verses.transliteration: jāyatī yugasāhasraṃ nānyā kācidbhavedṛśī / ṛṣiścāyaṃ mahābhāgo mārkaṇḍo dhīmatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: From his northern mouth he created twenty-first (stoma hymn), theAtharvan, the Aptoryaman, 7 * Anusthubh and Viraj metres. In the beginning of the Kalpa, the lord created lightnings, thunderbolts, clouds, red-coloured rainbows and birds.
verses.hindi: पुरुषाव्यवहत्वे (स्वे) न प्रतीता न प्रचर्तते। प्रवर्तिते पुनः सर्ग तेषां वा कारण पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: From his northern mouth he created twenty-first (stoma hymn), theAtharvan, the Aptoryaman, 7 * Anusthubh and Viraj metres. In the beginning of the Kalpa, the lord created lightnings, thunderbolts, clouds, red-coloured rainbows and birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his northern mouth he created twenty-first (stoma hymn), theAtharvan, the Aptoryaman, 7 * Anusthubh and Viraj metres. In the beginning of the Kalpa, the lord created lightnings, thunderbolts, clouds, red-coloured rainbows and birds.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पे कल्पे महादेव त्वामयं पर्युपासते । जगत्त्रयहितार्थाय चरते व्रतमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kalpe kalpe mahādeva tvāmayaṃ paryupāsate / jagattrayahitārthāya carate vratamuttamam
verses.translation: Bd. P. I. 2.8. 50 reads ream (the ftgoeda). Atiratra is a form of Soma-sacrifice.
verses.hindi: अभाव: पुनरुत्पत्तो शान्तानामचिंषामिव । ततसस्‍्तेजु गतेषृध्व॑ चैलोक्यात्खुमहात्मख
verses.wordMeaning: Bd. P. I. 2.8. 50 reads ream (the ftgoeda). Atiratra is a form of Soma-sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bd. P. I. 2.8. 50 reads ream (the ftgoeda). Atiratra is a form of Soma-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु देवेशो ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना । उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा नर्मदां सरितां वराम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu deveśo brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā / uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā narmadāṃ saritāṃ varām
verses.translation: As the patriarch Brahma created the progeny, living beings high and low were born of his limbs. After creating the four classes of beings—Devas, Asuras, Pitrs, and mankind, he next created the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: ने: सार्थ ये महलॉकात्तदा ना55सादिता जनाः । तच्छिष्टाश्चेह तिष्टन्ित कव्पाई हम्ुपासते
verses.wordMeaning: As the patriarch Brahma created the progeny, living beings high and low were born of his limbs. After creating the four classes of beings—Devas, Asuras, Pitrs, and mankind, he next created the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the patriarch Brahma created the progeny, living beings high and low were born of his limbs. After creating the four classes of beings—Devas, Asuras, Pitrs, and mankind, he next created the mobile and immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: कथयस्व महाभागे ब्रह्मणस्त्वं तु पृच्छतः । केन वेदा हृताः सर्वे वेधसो जगतीगुरोः
verses.transliteration: kathayasva mahābhāge brahmaṇastvaṃ tu pṛcchataḥ / kena vedā hṛtāḥ sarve vedhaso jagatīguroḥ
verses.translation: Pie created Yaksas, Pisacas, Gandharvas, groups or families of Apsaras-s, human beings, Kinnaras, Raksasas, birds, cattle, wild animals and snakes. Whether changing or unchanging, stationary of mobile, these beings created and re-created, adopted those activities which they had in the previous creation. 1
verses.hindi: है ।३२-३४। वे उस समय जैसे सोते हुये भी जागते रहते हैं उसी प्रकार उस समय उन मुक्त पुरुषों या देवों के मन में तत्काल सम्बन्धी नानात्व का ज्ञान उद्जुड़ हो जाता है ।१४६। जो भेद ज्ञान प्रत्याहार (प्रलय) काल में रहता है वही अब अपने भिन्न भिन्न सूक्ष्म रूपों में व्यक्त हो जाता है ।३६। उन ब्रह्मलोक निवासी, अपने धर्म का पालन करने वाले परन्तु सम्प्रति नानात्व दर्शन से अधिकारच्युत महापुरुषों के प्राकृत ज्ञान
verses.wordMeaning: Pie created Yaksas, Pisacas, Gandharvas, groups or families of Apsaras-s, human beings, Kinnaras, Raksasas, birds, cattle, wild animals and snakes. Whether changing or unchanging, stationary of mobile, these beings created and re-created,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Pie created Yaksas, Pisacas, Gandharvas, groups or families of Apsaras-s, human beings, Kinnaras, Raksasas, birds, cattle, wild animals and snakes. Whether changing or unchanging, stationary of mobile, these beings created and re-created,…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता तु रुद्रेण उवाच मृगलोचना । ब्रह्मणो जपतो वेदांस्त्वयि सुप्ते महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: evamuktā tu rudreṇa uvāca mṛgalocanā / brahmaṇo japato vedāṃstvayi supte maheśvara
verses.translation: Violent or non-violent, soft or cruel, virtuous or evil, true or false—all these things are adopted by them as they appeal to them. It is the creator who ordained diversity of forms in the great elements and their allotment to different physical bodies and the objects of different senses.
verses.hindi: के साथ ही काये और कारण की सृष्टि होने लगती है ।३ । वे (पहली कोटि के शुद्ध आत्मा), निरणञ्जन और तुल्य लक्षण कारणातीत सिद्ध पुरुष अपनी प्रकृति में ही व्यवस्थित रहते हैं ३८। प्रकृति उन द्वितीय कोटि के मुक्त पुरुषों पर सर्वधा अपनी धाक तो जमा लेती है परन्तु वह पुरुषों के बिना सहयोग के किसी कार्य को स्वयं नहीं प्रारम्भ करती है। अतः प्रलय काल में पुरुष में ही वह लीन रहती है १३९-४०।
verses.wordMeaning: Violent or non-violent, soft or cruel, virtuous or evil, true or false—all these things are adopted by them as they appeal to them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Violent or non-violent, soft or cruel, virtuous or evil, true or false—all these things are adopted by them as they appeal to them.…

verses.sanskrit: भवतश्छिद्रमासाद्य घोरे ऽस्मिन्सलिलावृते । पूर्वकल्पसमुद्भूतावसुरौ सुरदुर्जयौ
verses.transliteration: bhavataśchidramāsādya ghore 'sminsalilāvṛte / pūrvakalpasamudbhūtāvasurau suradurjayau
verses.translation: Some say that it is human effort and others say it is the karma, while still others, fatalist Brahmanas, call it the destiny that decides the nature of beings. Human activity and divine dispensation are decided by the nature of fruit. In fact either of the two alone does not suffice. They are inseparable from each other. Neither one is superior to the other. Neither one alone nor the two separately or collectively.
verses.hindi: सृष्टि प्रारम्भ होने पर था कारण उपस्थित होने पर उन योगी, तत्त्वदर्शी, युक्त, आवागमन के बन्धन से रहित पुरुषों की उस प्राकृत संयोग काल में भी (सृष्टि-काल में) शान्त अग्नि ज्वाला के समान पुनः उत्पत्ति नहीं होती ।५१६। इस प्रकार इस त्रैलोक्य से ऊध्वे अत्यन्त महान् लोकों में (तपः सत्य) उन महापुरुषों के चले जाने पर उनके साथ रहने वाले वे महापुरुष तपस्वीजन जिन्होंने कि अपनी तपस्या से महलोंक से
verses.wordMeaning: Some say that it is human effort and others say it is the karma, while still others, fatalist Brahmanas, call it the destiny that decides the nature of beings. Human activity and divine dispensation are decided by the nature of fruit.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Some say that it is human effort and others say it is the karma, while still others, fatalist Brahmanas, call it the destiny that decides the nature of beings. Human activity and divine dispensation are decided by the nature of fruit.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रियावृत्तौ महादेव त्वया चोत्पादितौ पुरा । सुरासुरसुदुर्जेयौ दानवौ मधुकैटभौ
verses.transliteration: śriyāvṛttau mahādeva tvayā cotpāditau purā / surāsurasudurjeyau dānavau madhukaiṭabhau
verses.translation: Persons of even vision abiding by Sattva say that the attainment of objects is due to their activities. He assigns names to the sages, the visions belonging to Devas and to other things that were brought forth at the end of the night.
verses.hindi: ऊपर के लोकों का अधिकार नहीं प्राप्त किया है, कल्पर्यन्त वहीं ( महलक में) शरीर धारणकर निवापत्त करते हैं। २-४३॥ उस समय गन्धरवों से लेकर पिशाच पर्यन्त, मानव (ब्राह्मण-क्षत्रिय आदि, पशु-पक्षी, स्थावर, सरीसृप (रेंग कर चलने वाले साँप आदि) जो जीव प्रृथ्बीतल पर रहते हैं, उनकों प्रलथ का सामना
verses.wordMeaning: Persons of even vision abiding by Sattva say that the attainment of objects is due to their activities. He assigns names to the sages, the visions belonging to Devas and to other things that were brought forth at the end of the night.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons of even vision abiding by Sattva say that the attainment of objects is due to their activities. He assigns names to the sages, the visions belonging to Devas and to other things that were brought forth at the end of the night.

verses.sanskrit: तौ वायुभूतौ सूक्ष्मौ च पठतो ऽस्मात्पितामहात् । तावाशु हृत्वा वेदांश्च प्रविष्टौ च महार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: tau vāyubhūtau sūkṣmau ca paṭhato 'smātpitāmahāt / tāvāśu hṛtvā vedāṃśca praviṣṭau ca mahārṇavam
verses.translation: Just as the indications and forms forboding the advent of seasons recur at their appropriate times, so also in the Yugas The inexorable law of Karma is advocated in vv. 52-56, for destiny or daiva is the Karma of a previous birth.
verses.hindi: तिष्ठत्ख तेषु तत्काल पृथिवीतलवबासिलु । सहस्त्र' यत्त रश्मीनां सूर्यस्थेह विभासते
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the indications and forms forboding the advent of seasons recur at their appropriate times, so also in the Yugas The inexorable law of Karma is advocated in vv. 52-56, for destiny or daiva is the Karma of a previous birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the indications and forms forboding the advent of seasons recur at their appropriate times, so also in the Yugas The inexorable law of Karma is advocated in vv. 52-56, for destiny or daiva is the Karma of a previous birth.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महातेजा ह्यमृतायास्ततो वचः । सस्मार स च देवेशं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā mahātejā hyamṛtāyāstato vacaḥ / sasmāra sa ca deveśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
verses.translation: The beings of such types created by resorting to his mental power (manasi siddki) by god Brahma born of the un¬ manifest, are seen manifestly at the end of (god Brahma's) night. Thus the living beings, the mobile and immobile came into being. But the progeny created by him did not multi¬ ply. He created some other mind-born sons equal to himself. These are known as Bhrgu, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Angiras, Marici, Daksa, Atri and Vasistha. They are known in the Puranas as nine Brahmas. These arc propounders of the Vedas and arc identical with Brahma himself.
verses.hindi: ते सप्त रश्मयों भूत्वा होकैको जायते रचिः  क्रमेणोसिष्ठमानास्ते त्रंललोकान्प्रदइन्त्युत ४६ जज्ञ्म स्थावर्र चैव नदीः सर्वाश्य पवतान्  पूर्व शुष्का छानावुश्चा सूर्येस्तैश्व प्रधूपषिंताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The beings of such types created by resorting to his mental power (manasi siddki) by god Brahma born of the un¬ manifest, are seen manifestly at the end of (god Brahma's) night. Thus the living beings, the mobile and immobile came into being.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The beings of such types created by resorting to his mental power (manasi siddki) by god Brahma born of the un¬ manifest, are seen manifestly at the end of (god Brahma's) night. Thus the living beings, the mobile and immobile came into being.…

verses.sanskrit: स विवेश महाराज भूतलं ससुरोत्तमः । दानवान्तकरो देवः सर्वदैवतपूजितः
verses.transliteration: sa viveśa mahārāja bhūtalaṃ sasurottamaḥ / dānavāntakaro devaḥ sarvadaivatapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma, the ancestor of ancients, created Rudra out of his anger, from his own self. (He created) Saiiikalpa and Dharma (also). At the beginning, Brahma created mental sons who were equal to himself, viz. Sanandana, Sanaka, the learned Sanatana and the eminent Sanatkumara. They are eternal, independant, unattached to worldly life and hence they do not procreate.
verses.hindi: तदा ते विवशाः खंब निर्दंग्धाः सूर्य रश्मिभिः । जहृनमाःस्थाचराः सर्व घर्माचर्मास्मकास्तु थै ॥ दग्धदेहास्ततस्ते वै गताः पापयुगात्यये  योन्‍्या तया हानिमनुक्ताः शुभपात्राज्नुबन्धया
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma, the ancestor of ancients, created Rudra out of his anger, from his own self. (He created) Saiiikalpa and Dharma (also). At the beginning, Brahma created mental sons who were equal to himself, viz. Sanandana, Sanaka, the learned Sanatana and the eminent Sanatkumara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma, the ancestor of ancients, created Rudra out of his anger, from his own self. (He created) Saiiikalpa and Dharma (also). At the beginning, Brahma created mental sons who were equal to himself, viz. Sanandana, Sanaka, the learned Sanatana and the eminent Sanatkumara.…

verses.sanskrit: मीनरूपधरो देवो लोडयामास चार्णम् । वेदांश्च ददृशे तत्र पाताले निहितान्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: mīnarūpadharo devo loḍayāmāsa cārṇam / vedāṃśca dadṛśe tatra pātāle nihitānprabhuḥ
verses.translation: They have the knowledge of the future. They are devoid of passions and rivalry. When they remained indifferent to the continuity of the world, the supreme lord Brahma contemp¬ lated (angrily). Out of his anger, a person as resplendent as the sun was boin. Half of his body was a man and half a woman. He was comparable to the fire in splendour. Eveiy thing has become full of lustre and equal to the sun in splendour. Divide yourself"—saying so he vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: उषित्वा रजनों तत्र बह्मणो5व्यक्तजन्मनः । पुनः सगे भवन्तीह ब्रह्मणी मानसीप्रजाः (?)
verses.wordMeaning: They have the knowledge of the future. They are devoid of passions and rivalry. When they remained indifferent to the continuity of the world, the supreme lord Brahma contemp¬ lated (angrily). Out of his anger, a person as resplendent as the sun was boin.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They have the knowledge of the future. They are devoid of passions and rivalry. When they remained indifferent to the continuity of the world, the supreme lord Brahma contemp¬ lated (angrily). Out of his anger, a person as resplendent as the sun was boin.…

verses.sanskrit: तौ च दैत्यौ महावीर्यौ दृष्टवान्मधुसूदनः । महावेगौ महाबाहू सूदयामास तेजसा
verses.transliteration: tau ca daityau mahāvīryau dṛṣṭavānmadhusūdanaḥ / mahāvegau mahābāhū sūdayāmāsa tejasā
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the man and the woman became se- parate; the man divided himself into eleven parts (out of the All the (eleven) great souls were addressed by the noble being: »Try energetically and vigilantly for the totality (continuity) of the world desiring the multiplication (increase m t e popu ation) of the world, (try) for the establishment, benefit and interest of the entire world."
verses.hindi: ततस्तेष्वप्रवृत्तेष जने अलोक्यवासिषु। निद॑ग्धेषु च लोकेषु तेघु सूर्येस्तु सप्तभिः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed, the man and the woman became se- parate; the man divided himself into eleven parts (out of the All the (eleven) great souls were addressed by the noble being: »Try energetically and vigilantly for the totality (continuity) of the world desiring the multiplication…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed, the man and the woman became se- parate; the man divided himself into eleven parts (out of the All the (eleven) great souls were addressed by the noble being: »Try energetically and vigilantly for the totality (continuity) of the world desiring the multiplication…

verses.sanskrit: वेदांस्तत्रापि तोयस्थानानिनाय जगद्गुरुः । चतुर्वक्त्राय देवायाददाच्चक्रविभूषितः
verses.transliteration: vedāṃstatrāpi toyasthānānināya jagadguruḥ / caturvaktrāya devāyādadāccakravibhūṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus addressed, they cried and ran about helter-skelter. Since they cried and ran about they arc known as Rudras. The three worlds including the mobile and immobile are pervaded by them. Their followers live in all the worlds.
verses.hindi: बजन्त्येकाणवत्वं हि सलिलाख्यास्तदाश्रिताः। आगतागतिक॑ तड्े यदा तु सलिलं बह
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed, they cried and ran about helter-skelter. Since they cried and ran about they arc known as Rudras. The three worlds including the mobile and immobile are pervaded by them. Their followers live in all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed, they cried and ran about helter-skelter. Since they cried and ran about they arc known as Rudras. The three worlds including the mobile and immobile are pervaded by them. Their followers live in all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टो भगवान् वेदांल्लब्ध्वा पितामहः । जनयामास निखिलं जगद्भूयश्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭo bhagavān vedāṃllabdhvā pitāmahaḥ / janayāmāsa nikhilaṃ jagadbhūyaścarācaram
verses.translation: They are the valorous lords of Ganas with the strength of ten thousand elephants. The highly fortunate one (the female) 1, forming half the body of Siva, who has been mentioned to you just before, was the woman born of Brahma's mouth. The right side of her body was fair (white) and the left black. She had been asked by Brahma to divide herself. O Brahmanas, thus requested, she bifurcated herself into black and white parts. I shall mention her names. Please listen very carefully: Svaha, Svadha, Mahavidya, Medha, LaksmI, Sarasvatl, Aparna, Ekaparna, Patala, Uma, Haimavatl, SasthI, Kaiyanl, Khyati, Prajna, Mahabhaga, and Gauri.
verses.hindi: करना पड़ता है। उस समय सूर्य की जो सहख्न किरणें चमकती रहती हैं; उनमें से प्रत्येक सप्तरश्मि होकर एक एक सूर्य बन जाती हैं ।४४-४५६४६। क्रमशः वे सूयं अधिकाधिक प्रज्वलित होते जाते और अपनी अपनी असह्य- ज्वाला से तीनों लोकों को जलाने लगते हैं। स्थावर, जंग्म, सब नदियाँ, सब पर्वत जो कि पहले अनावृष्टि के कारण सूख गये थे, वे अब सूर्य किरणों से जला दिये जाते हैं।४६-४८७ ॥। वे समस्त धर्मात्मक
verses.wordMeaning: They are the valorous lords of Ganas with the strength of ten thousand elephants. The highly fortunate one (the female) 1, forming half the body of Siva, who has been mentioned to you just before, was the woman born of Brahma's mouth.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the valorous lords of Ganas with the strength of ten thousand elephants. The highly fortunate one (the female) 1, forming half the body of Siva, who has been mentioned to you just before, was the woman born of Brahma's mouth.…

verses.sanskrit: सा च देवी नदी पुण्या रुद्रस्य परिचारिका । पावनी सर्वभूतानां प्रोवाह सलिलं तदा
verses.transliteration: sā ca devī nadī puṇyā rudrasya paricārikā / pāvanī sarvabhūtānāṃ provāha salilaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Know also in brief the universal forms assumed by the noble Lady (forms she assumed in the universe) through the formation of separate bodies: Prakfti, Niyata, RaudrI, Durga, Bhadra, Pramathini, Kalaratri, Mahamaya, Revatl, and Bhutanayika.
verses.hindi: अधर्मात्मक पाथिव पदार्थ अग॒त्या जल जाते हैं। तब वे सभी अपने पार्थिव शरीर के जल जाने के कारण निष्पाप हो जाते हैं और उनका आयुयुग के बीत जाने पर भी अपने शुभ ओर अशुभ कर्मों से सम्बन्ध रखने वाली योनि से सम्बन्ध बना ही रहता है। भत्यन्त विशुद्ध, मानसी सिद्धि प्राप्त करने वाले व्यक्ति जनलोक में वेसी ही (कर्मानुसा रिणी) तुल्याकृति प्राप्त करते हैं ।४घ८-५०। बे अव्यक्त-जन्मा
verses.wordMeaning: Know also in brief the universal forms assumed by the noble Lady (forms she assumed in the universe) through the formation of separate bodies: Prakfti, Niyata, RaudrI, Durga, Bhadra, Pramathini, Kalaratri, Mahamaya, Revatl, and Bhutanayika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know also in brief the universal forms assumed by the noble Lady (forms she assumed in the universe) through the formation of separate bodies: Prakfti, Niyata, RaudrI, Durga, Bhadra, Pramathini, Kalaratri, Mahamaya, Revatl, and Bhutanayika.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तीरे ततो देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः । यजन्ति त्र्यम्बकं देवं प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: tasyāstīre tato devā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ / yajanti tryambakaṃ devaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
verses.translation: Listen to her names atr the end of Dvapara age: GautamI, Kausiki, Arya, Gandi, KatyayanI, Satl. Kumarl, Yadavi, Devi, Varada, Krsnapingala, Barhi- rdhvaja, Suladhara, Paramabrahmacarinl.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म की रात्रि को वहाँ रह कर बिताते हैं  पूनः सृष्टि-काल में वे ब्रह्मा के मानसपुत्र के रुप में उत्पन्न होते हैं ।४१। तदनन्‍्तर जब त्रैलोक्यवासी जनलोक में जाने के लिये नहीं शेष रह जाते अर्थात् अपनी शक्ति के क्षीण हो जाने पर वे जनलोक के अधिकारी नहीं रहते, सप्तसुये की ज्वाला से वे सब लोक दग्ध हो जाते, सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वी वृष्टि से लबालब भर जाती और सब आवास स्थान नष्ट हो जाते हैं तब समुद्र,
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to her names atr the end of Dvapara age: GautamI, Kausiki, Arya, Gandi, KatyayanI, Satl. Kumarl, Yadavi, Devi, Varada, Krsnapingala, Barhi- rdhvaja, Suladhara, Paramabrahmacarinl.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to her names atr the end of Dvapara age: GautamI, Kausiki, Arya, Gandi, KatyayanI, Satl. Kumarl, Yadavi, Devi, Varada, Krsnapingala, Barhi- rdhvaja, Suladhara, Paramabrahmacarinl.

verses.sanskrit: एका मूर्तिर्महेशस्य कारणान्तरगता । त्रैगुण्या कुरुते कर्म ब्रह्मचक्रीशरूपतः
verses.transliteration: ekā mūrtirmaheśasya kāraṇāntaragatā / traiguṇyā kurute karma brahmacakrīśarūpataḥ
verses.translation: Mahendrl, Indrabhagini, Vrsakanya, EkavasasI, Aparajita, Bahubhuja, Pragalbha, Simhavahinl. Ekanasa, Daityahanl, Maya, Mahisamardini, Amogha, Vindhyanilaya, Vikranta, Gananayika.
verses.hindi: मेघ, सम्पूणं जल और सब प्ृृथिवी से सम्बद्ध जलराशि परस्पर एकाकार होकर एक महासागर के रूप में हो जाती है। इस प्रकार जब जलराशि एकाकार हो इस भूमि को चारों ओर से घेर लेती है तब इसका नाम 'अषंच।? हो जाता है ।(२-५४ह। जिससे सब प्रकाशित होते हैं, जिसके बिना कोई प्रकाश में नहीं आते जो
verses.wordMeaning: Mahendrl, Indrabhagini, Vrsakanya, EkavasasI, Aparajita, Bahubhuja, Pragalbha, Simhavahinl. Ekanasa, Daityahanl, Maya, Mahisamardini, Amogha, Vindhyanilaya, Vikranta, Gananayika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahendrl, Indrabhagini, Vrsakanya, EkavasasI, Aparajita, Bahubhuja, Pragalbha, Simhavahinl. Ekanasa, Daityahanl, Maya, Mahisamardini, Amogha, Vindhyanilaya, Vikranta, Gananayika.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां तु पृथग्भावं ये कुर्वन्ति सुमोहिताः । तेषां धर्मः कुतः सिद्धिर्जायते पापकर्मिणाम्
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ tu pṛthagbhāvaṃ ye kurvanti sumohitāḥ / teṣāṃ dharmaḥ kutaḥ siddhirjāyate pāpakarmiṇām
verses.translation: These are the names of her forms that have been mentioned to you in serial order. Those persons who recite accurately the epithets of goddess Bhadrakali as enumerated by me, will never have a failure or discomfiture. Whether in the forest, or in the outskirts, whether in the house or in the city; whether in water or on dry land, these names afford protection from tigers, robbers and thieves. One should repeat these names Verses 75-85 give a list of epithets of Sakti or the female form called Bhadrakali in v. 86. These epithets characterise the different forms of the goddess. An element of Sakti cult is found in w. 75-91.
verses.hindi: एकाणुवे भवन्त्यापो न क्षिघ्रास्तेन ते नराः। तस्मिन्युगसहस्रान्ते संस्थिते ब्रह्मणो 5हनि ।॥
verses.wordMeaning: These are the names of her forms that have been mentioned to you in serial order. Those persons who recite accurately the epithets of goddess Bhadrakali as enumerated by me, will never have a failure or discomfiture. Whether in the forest, or in the outskirts,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the names of her forms that have been mentioned to you in serial order. Those persons who recite accurately the epithets of goddess Bhadrakali as enumerated by me, will never have a failure or discomfiture. Whether in the forest, or in the outskirts,…

verses.sanskrit: एवमेता महानद्यस्तिस्रो रुद्रसमुद्भवाः । एका एव त्रिधा भूता गङ्गा रेवा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: evametā mahānadyastisro rudrasamudbhavāḥ / ekā eva tridhā bhūtā gaṅgā revā sarasvatī
verses.translation: An amulet with these names should be used for children afflicted by evil planets, goblins or by evil witches, such as Putana and others. The great goddess is glorified as Prajfia (intellect) and as Sri (glory). Thousands of goddesses have emerged out of these two and pervaded the universe.
verses.hindi: प्रशान्तवाते उन्धकारे निरालोके समन्‍ततः । येनैवाधिष्ठितं हीद॑ अह्मा स पुरुष: प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: An amulet with these names should be used for children afflicted by evil planets, goblins or by evil witches, such as Putana and others. The great goddess is glorified as Prajfia (intellect) and as Sri (glory).…
verses.commentary: Sense: An amulet with these names should be used for children afflicted by evil planets, goblins or by evil witches, such as Putana and others. The great goddess is glorified as Prajfia (intellect) and as Sri (glory).…

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गा तु वैष्णवी मूर्तिः सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी । रुद्रदेहसमुद्भूता नर्मदा चैवमेव तु
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā tu vaiṣṇavī mūrtiḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśinī / rudradehasamudbhūtā narmadā caivameva tu
verses.translation: She created Vyavasaya (industry) and Dharma (duty) bestowing happiness and thought in the beginning of the Kalpa. They were born of unmanifested womb. Ruci was the mental son of Brahma. He created Daksa from his vital breath and Marlci from his eyes.
verses.hindi: विभागमस्य लोकस्य पुनर्वे कतु मिच्छति । एकार्णिे तदा तस्मिन्नष्टे स्थावरजहुमे
verses.wordMeaning: She created Vyavasaya (industry) and Dharma (duty) bestowing happiness and thought in the beginning of the Kalpa. They were born of unmanifested womb. Ruci was the mental son of Brahma. He created Daksa from his vital breath and Marlci from his eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: She created Vyavasaya (industry) and Dharma (duty) bestowing happiness and thought in the beginning of the Kalpa. They were born of unmanifested womb. Ruci was the mental son of Brahma. He created Daksa from his vital breath and Marlci from his eyes.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मी सरस्वती मूर्तिस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता । दिव्या कामगमा देवी वाग्विभूत्यै तु संस्थिता
verses.transliteration: brāhmī sarasvatī mūrtistriṣu lokeṣu viśrutā / divyā kāmagamā devī vāgvibhūtyai tu saṃsthitā
verses.translation: Bhrgu was born of his chest. He created Angiras from his head and Atri from his ears. From the vital breath Udana, he created Pulastya; from Vyana, Pulaha; from Samana, Vasistha and from Apana, Kratu. He created Bhadra, NUalohita in the form of conceit. These are the twelve sons of Brahma born of his vital breath.
verses.hindi: तदा स भवति ब्रह्मा सहस्नाक्षः सहस्लरपात्। सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषो रुक्‍मचरों ह्यतीन्द्रिय: ६२ ब्रह्मा नारायणाख्यस्तु सुष्वाप सलिले तदा। सस्‍्चोद्रेकात्प्रबुद्धस्तु शन्यं लोकमर्वेक्ष्य च
verses.wordMeaning: Bhrgu was born of his chest. He created Angiras from his head and Atri from his ears. From the vital breath Udana, he created Pulastya; from Vyana, Pulaha; from Samana, Vasistha and from Apana, Kratu. He created Bhadra, NUalohita in the form of conceit.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhrgu was born of his chest. He created Angiras from his head and Atri from his ears. From the vital breath Udana, he created Pulastya; from Vyana, Pulaha; from Samana, Vasistha and from Apana, Kratu. He created Bhadra, NUalohita in the form of conceit.…

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा परमा काचिन्मर्त्यमूर्तिकला शिवा । दिव्या कामगमा देवी सर्वत्र सुरपूजिता
verses.transliteration: narmadā paramā kācinmartyamūrtikalā śivā / divyā kāmagamā devī sarvatra surapūjitā
verses.translation: These are the mental sons of Brahma. Bhrgu and others who were created were not the expounders of the Veda. They were the ancient householders. Dharma was established (and propagated) by them. These twelve create progeny along with Rudra.
verses.hindi: अपनी व्याप्ति एवं दीप्ति के कारण चारों ओर फैला रहता है उसको अम्भ कहते हैं। वह अम्भ (जल) सम्पूर्ण पृथिवी को चारों ओर विस्तृत करता है ओर तनु धातु विस्तार अथे में प्रयुक्त होता है इसलिये अम्भ को तनु भी कहा जाता है।!५-५७१। कर्वियों ने अर' इसको ज्ीघ्रार्थ द्योतक माना है, एकार्णव काल में जल शी ध्रगा मी नहीं होता इसलिये जल को “नर या तार! भी बहा जाता है। सहद्न युग काल परिणाम वाले ब्रह्मा के एक
verses.wordMeaning: These are the mental sons of Brahma. Bhrgu and others who were created were not the expounders of the Veda. They were the ancient householders. Dharma was established (and propagated) by them. These twelve create progeny along with Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the mental sons of Brahma. Bhrgu and others who were created were not the expounders of the Veda. They were the ancient householders. Dharma was established (and propagated) by them. These twelve create progeny along with Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: व्यापिनी सर्वभूतानां सूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतरा स्मृता । अक्षया ह्यमृता ह्येषा स्वर्गसोपानमुत्तमा
verses.transliteration: vyāpinī sarvabhūtānāṃ sūkṣmātsūkṣmatarā smṛtā / akṣayā hyamṛtā hyeṣā svargasopānamuttamā
verses.translation: Both Rbhu and Sanatkumara sublimated sexual virility. As they were born very early before (thetwelve sons), they were the eldest of all. When the first ancient Kalpa was over, both of them withdrew their splendour and occupied the Vairaja region achieving (the good of) the world.
verses.hindi: दिन की स्थिति के बाद उतने ही परिमाण वाली रात्रि के हो जाने पर जबकि चारों ओर केवल जल व्याप्त रहता है और अग्नि के नष्ट हो जाने पर पृथ्वी तल पर चारों ओर घना अन्धकार छा जाता, कहीं पर भी आलोक नहीं दिखाई देता तब उस सलिल में निवास करने वाले उस प्रभु पुरुष ब्रह्मा के हृदय में पुनः इस लोक को विभक्त करने की इच्छा हुई । / ८-६० २। स्थावर जज्जमात्मक सृष्टि के नष्ट हो जाने पर जब उस
verses.wordMeaning: Both Rbhu and Sanatkumara sublimated sexual virility. As they were born very early before (thetwelve sons), they were the eldest of all. When the first ancient Kalpa was over, both of them withdrew their splendour and occupied the Vairaja region achieving (the good of) the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both Rbhu and Sanatkumara sublimated sexual virility. As they were born very early before (thetwelve sons), they were the eldest of all. When the first ancient Kalpa was over, both of them withdrew their splendour and occupied the Vairaja region achieving (the good of) the world.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टा रुद्रेण लोकानां संसारार्णवतारिणी
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭā rudreṇa lokānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī
verses.translation: Both of them, practising Yogic virtue and concen¬ trating their self in the 'Atman maintained the dhavma and aspir¬ ation (kama) of the people by their great splendour. Sanat continues to have the same form and features as at the time of his birth. So he is called Kumara. Hence his name is mentioned Sanatkumara.
verses.hindi: समय केवल एक मात्र समुद्र ही शेष रह जाता है तब केवल इच्छा मात्र से वह ब्रह्मा सहस्नाक्ष (हजार आँखों वाला) सहस्रपाद ( हजार पैर वाला ) सहसख्रशीर्ष ( हजार शिर वाला ) सुबर्ण के समान वर्ण वाला और अतीन्द्रिय हो गया । उस समय ये नारायण नामक ब्रह्मा जल में ही सोते थे। ब्रह्मा के हृदय में उस समय जब सत्त्व गुण की वृद्धि हुई तब उनको ज्ञान-प्राप्ति हो गई, तब उन्होंने चारों ओर केवल शून्य को ही
verses.wordMeaning: Both of them, practising Yogic virtue and concen¬ trating their self in the 'Atman maintained the dhavma and aspir¬ ation (kama) of the people by their great splendour. Sanat continues to have the same form and features as at the time of his birth. So he is called Kumara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Both of them, practising Yogic virtue and concen¬ trating their self in the 'Atman maintained the dhavma and aspir¬ ation (kama) of the people by their great splendour. Sanat continues to have the same form and features as at the time of his birth. So he is called Kumara.…

verses.sanskrit: सीरजलं ये ऽपि पिबन्ति लोके मुच्यन्ति ते पापविशेषसङ्घैः । व्रजन्ति संसारमनादिभावं त्यक्त्वा चिरं मोक्षपदं विशुद्धम्
verses.transliteration: sīrajalaṃ ye 'pi pibanti loke mucyanti te pāpaviśeṣasaṅghaiḥ / vrajanti saṃsāramanādibhāvaṃ tyaktvā ciraṃ mokṣapadaṃ viśuddham
verses.translation: Their twelve races are divine and endowed with divine attributes. Performing holy rites and multiplying the race, they are embellished by great sages. Thus ends (the description of) the activity of the self-born lord in creating the worlds. The creation was born of his various organs. The creation beginning with Mahat and ending with ViSesas belongs to Prakrli itself.
verses.hindi: देखा ।६१०६३। नारायण के सम्बन्ध में इस प्रकार का इलोक प्रसिद्ध है कि जल का नर ओर तनु नाम है। उस जल में वे न।भि तक मग्न होकर रहते हैं अतः 'उसका नाम नारायण पड़ा ।६४-६५। इन सहस्रप्राण, मन, मुख, मस्तक, हस्त, पाद, चक्षु और कर्ण वाले, सर्वाग्रवर्ती, प्रजापति पुरुष के विषय में वेदों में विशेष उल्लेख है ।६६। यही महात्मा वेद में आदित्यवर्ण, भुवनपालक, अपूव, प्रथम प्रजापति इन्द्र तम से परे हिरण्यगर्म
verses.wordMeaning: Their twelve races are divine and endowed with divine attributes. Performing holy rites and multiplying the race, they are embellished by great sages. Thus ends (the description of) the activity of the self-born lord in creating the worlds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Their twelve races are divine and endowed with divine attributes. Performing holy rites and multiplying the race, they are embellished by great sages. Thus ends (the description of) the activity of the self-born lord in creating the worlds.…

verses.sanskrit: यथा गङ्गा तथा रेवा तथा चैव सरस्वती । समं पुण्यफलं प्रोक्तं स्नानदर्शनचिन्तनैः
verses.transliteration: yathā gaṅgā tathā revā tathā caiva sarasvatī / samaṃ puṇyaphalaṃ proktaṃ snānadarśanacintanaiḥ
verses.translation: The light of the sun and the moon illuminates the world which is further embellished with planets and stars. It is surrounded by rivers, oceans, mountains, and cities of various shapes and sizes, and happy countryside. In that unmanifest Brnhmavana, Brahma spends the night. This eternal tree of Brahma is born of the seed of Avyakla. It grows up through his blessings. Intellect constitutes its branches and the sense-organs its sprout and Dharma and Adharma its flowers, happiness and sorrow its fruits. It is the source of livelihood for living beings and its root is Brahman.
verses.hindi: आदित्यवर्णों भुवनस्य गोप्ता एको हयपूर्व: प्रथमं तुराषाट्। क्‍
