verses.wordMeaning: The light of the sun and the moon illuminates the world which is further embellished with planets and stars. It is surrounded by rivers, oceans, mountains, and cities of various shapes and sizes, and happy countryside. In that unmanifest Brnhmavana, Brahma spends the night.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The light of the sun and the moon illuminates the world which is further embellished with planets and stars. It is surrounded by rivers, oceans, mountains, and cities of various shapes and sizes, and happy countryside. In that unmanifest Brnhmavana, Brahma spends the night.…

verses.sanskrit: वरदानान्महाभागा ह्यधिका चोच्यते बुधैः । कारुण्यान्तरभावेन न मृता समुपागता
verses.transliteration: varadānānmahābhāgā hyadhikā cocyate budhaiḥ / kāruṇyāntarabhāvena na mṛtā samupāgatā
verses.translation: The unmanifest which is the cause of creation is eternal and of the nature of Sat and Asal. This is the Anugraha Sarga, the primary creation of Brahma. The six creations Mukhya etc. are secondary. They exist in all the three times in Brahma who identifies with them.
verses.hindi: कव्पादौ रजसोद्विक्तो ब्रह्म भूत्वाउज्जत्प्रजाः। कल्पान्ते तमसोद्रिक्तः कालो भूत्वाइप्रलत्पुनः स वै नारायणाख्यस्तु सर्वोद्विक्तो 5 वे स्वपन् । त्रिधा विभज्य चा55त्मानं अलोक्ये समचतत सज़ते प्रसते चैच चीक्षते च तिभिस्तु तान। एकार्णवे तदा लोके नष्टे स्थाचरजड्मे ।
verses.wordMeaning: The unmanifest which is the cause of creation is eternal and of the nature of Sat and Asal. This is the Anugraha Sarga, the primary creation of Brahma. The six creations Mukhya etc. are secondary. They exist in all the three times in Brahma who identifies with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The unmanifest which is the cause of creation is eternal and of the nature of Sat and Asal. This is the Anugraha Sarga, the primary creation of Brahma. The six creations Mukhya etc. are secondary. They exist in all the three times in Brahma who identifies with them.

verses.sanskrit: मुच्यन्ते दर्शनात्तेन पातकैः स्नानमङ्गलैः । नर्मदायां नृपश्रेष्ठ ये नमन्ति त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: mucyante darśanāttena pātakaiḥ snānamaṅgalaiḥ / narmadāyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha ye namanti trilocanam
verses.translation: It is known by the learned that the creations fun¬ ction as causes of one another. There are two divine trees growing together, having fine leaves and sprouts and branches. Only one knows the tree of the Atman and not the other. That incomprehensible Atman is the cause of creation of all living beings—he whose head the Brahmanas eulogise as heaven; the sky as the umbilicus; the sun and the moon as the eyes; the quarters as the ears; and the earth as his feet.
verses.hindi: चतुयुगसइस्त्रान्ते सर्वतः सलिलाबुते। ब्नह्मा नारायणाख्यस्तु अप्रकाशार्णवे स्वपन्
verses.wordMeaning: It is known by the learned that the creations fun¬ ction as causes of one another. There are two divine trees growing together, having fine leaves and sprouts and branches. Only one knows the tree of the Atman and not the other.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is known by the learned that the creations fun¬ ction as causes of one another. There are two divine trees growing together, having fine leaves and sprouts and branches. Only one knows the tree of the Atman and not the other.…

verses.sanskrit: उमारुद्राङ्गसम्भूता येन चैषा महानदी । लोकान्प्रापयते स्वर्गं तेन पुण्यत्वमागता
verses.transliteration: umārudrāṅgasambhūtā yena caiṣā mahānadī / lokānprāpayate svargaṃ tena puṇyatvamāgatā
verses.translation: From his mouth the Brahmanas were born; from his arms the Ksatriyas; from his thigh the Vaisyas and from his The great lord is beyond the unmamfest. The cosmic Egg is born of the unmanifest. From the cosmic Egg is born Brahma who created the universe.
verses.hindi: चतुर्विधाः प्रजा प्रस्त्वा ब्राह्मआं राज्यों महारंवे  पश्यन्ति त॑ं महलोंक।रखुण्त काल महर्षयः ।। द
verses.wordMeaning: From his mouth the Brahmanas were born; from his arms the Ksatriyas; from his thigh the Vaisyas and from his The great lord is beyond the unmamfest. The cosmic Egg is born of the unmanifest. From the cosmic Egg is born Brahma who created the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his mouth the Brahmanas were born; from his arms the Ksatriyas; from his thigh the Vaisyas and from his The great lord is beyond the unmamfest. The cosmic Egg is born of the unmanifest. From the cosmic Egg is born Brahma who created the universe.

verses.sanskrit: य एवमीशानवरस्य देहं विभज्य देवीमिह संशृणोति । स याति रुद्रं महतारवेण गन्धर्वयक्षैरिव गीयमानः
verses.transliteration: ya evamīśānavarasya dehaṃ vibhajya devīmiha saṃśṛṇoti / sa yāti rudraṃ mahatāraveṇa gandharvayakṣairiva gīyamānaḥ
verses.translation: An echo of RV X. 90 (Purusa Sukta).
verses.hindi: महलोंकस्थितैटष्टः कालः खुप्तस्तदा च तैः॥ खत्याद्याः सप्त ये छ्यासन्करपेडतीते महर्ष यः ७४ प॒व्व॑ ब्राह्लीषु राजीषु छातीतासु सहस्नशः  दृष्टवन्‍्ततस्था हान्‍ये सुप्तं काल महषेयः ।
verses.wordMeaning: An echo of RV X. 90 (Purusa Sukta).
verses.commentary: Sense: An echo of RV X. 90 (Purusa Sukta).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये नर्मदोत्पत्तितत्स्नानफलादिकथनं नाम नवमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १० युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कस्मिन्कल्पे महाभागा नर्मदेयं द्विजोत्तम । विभक्ता ऋषिभिः सर्वैस्तपोयुक्तैर्महात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye narmadotpattitatsnānaphalādikathanaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 10 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kasminkalpe mahābhāgā narmadeyaṃ dvijottama / vibhaktā ṛṣibhiḥ sarvaistapoyuktairmahātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: When the worlds came into existence thus by the acti¬ vity of Brahma, the creator, and when the progeny did not multiply by any means, Brahma, enveloped entirely by Tamas, became dejected. He then created intelligence which leads to a definite decision.
verses.hindi: और महापुरुष कहे जाते हैं ६७! यही कल्प के आदि में रजोगुण के उद्बेक होने से ब्रह्मा होकर प्रजा की सृष्टि करते हैं और कल्पान्तर काल में तमोगुण के उद्रेक होते से काल होकर सबको निगल जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: When the worlds came into existence thus by the acti¬ vity of Brahma, the creator, and when the progeny did not multiply by any means, Brahma, enveloped entirely by Tamas, became dejected. He then created intelligence which leads to a definite decision.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the worlds came into existence thus by the acti¬ vity of Brahma, the creator, and when the progeny did not multiply by any means, Brahma, enveloped entirely by Tamas, became dejected. He then created intelligence which leads to a definite decision.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्विस्तरतः सर्वं ब्रूहि मे वदतां वर । कल्पान्ते यद्भवेत्कष्टं लोकानां तत्त्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ brūhi me vadatāṃ vara / kalpānte yadbhavetkaṣṭaṃ lokānāṃ tattvameva ca
verses.translation: He then saw only the Tamas element moving within
verses.hindi: सत्त्वगुण के उद्रेक होने से वे एकाणँव में शयन करते हैं अंतः नारायण नाम से प्रसिद्ध होते हैं । वे अपने को तीन भागों में विभक्त कर तलोक्य में विराजमान रहते हैं ।६६। तीन मूतियों के द्वारा वे सृष्टि और पालन किया करते हैं । चार हजार युग के बाद जब स्थावर जड्भम विनष्ट हो जाते हैं दरों दिशाएँ जलमथ होकर एकार्णवाकार हो जाती है, जब ब्रह्मा कालरूप से चतुविध प्रजाओं को निगल कर प्रकाशहीन जलराशि के
verses.wordMeaning: He then saw only the Tamas element moving within
verses.commentary: Sense: He then saw only the Tamas element moving within

verses.sanskrit: अतीते तु पुरा कल्पे यथेयं वर्तते ऽनघ । अस्यान्त्यस्य च कल्पस्य व्यवस्थां कथय प्रभो । एवमुक्तः सभामध्ये मार्कण्डो वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: atīte tu purā kalpe yatheyaṃ vartate 'nagha / asyāntyasya ca kalpasya vyavasthāṃ kathaya prabho / evamuktaḥ sabhāmadhye mārkaṇḍo vākyamabravīt
verses.translation: The Tamas that was thus pushed out (dispelled), gave birth to a twin. Violence and sorrow were born of Adharma.* (?)
verses.hindi: मध्य में नारायण रूप में सोते रहते हैं, तब उन्हें कल्प के महलोकिवासी भरूगु आदि महंषिंगण देखते हैं। उन महर्षियों ने महान् पुरष का आश्रय प्राप्त किया है ।७०-७३। गमनार्थंक ऋष् धातु से सर्वश्रथम ऋषि शब्द बना है उसमें भी वे महान् हैं, अतः महर्षि कहे जाते हैं ।७४ महलकि में स्थित वे समस्त ऋषिगण उस समय सोये हुए काल को देखते हैं । पूर्व कल्प में जो सत्य प्रभृति महधिगण थे उन्होंने भी काल को इसी
verses.wordMeaning: The Tamas that was thus pushed out (dispelled), gave birth to a twin. Violence and sorrow were born of Adharma.* (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tamas that was thus pushed out (dispelled), gave birth to a twin. Violence and sorrow were born of Adharma.* (?)

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: वक्ष्ये ऽहं श्रूयतां सर्वैः कथेयं पूर्वतः श्रुता
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: vakṣye 'haṃ śrūyatāṃ sarvaiḥ katheyaṃ pūrvataḥ śrutā
verses.translation: When the twins were born of the foot, the lord felt pleased. And he resorted to this.
verses.hindi: प्रकार सुप्त देखा था  इस प्रकार ब्रह्मा की सहस्र-सहस्त्र रात्रि के बीत जाने पर अन्य मह्षियों ने भी काल को इसी प्रकार शयन करते हुए देखा है ।७५-७६॥ यतः कल्प के आदि में ब्रह्मा ने चौदह संस्थाओं के विभाग की कल्पना की इसलिये उस काल को कल्प कहते हैं। वही व्यक्ताव्यक्त महादेव कल्प के आदि में सर्वे-
verses.wordMeaning: When the twins were born of the foot, the lord felt pleased. And he resorted to this.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the twins were born of the foot, the lord felt pleased. And he resorted to this.

verses.sanskrit: महत्कथेयं वैशिष्टी कल्पादस्मात्परं तु या । लोकक्षयकरो घोर आसीत्कालः सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration: mahatkatheyaṃ vaiśiṣṭī kalpādasmātparaṃ tu yā / lokakṣayakaro ghora āsītkālaḥ sudāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: He abandoned his body which was non-radiant. He split it into two. With one half of his body he became a man.
verses.hindi: 'धमन-ननप-कन न“ वन कान» न न“ नन-लनननमन+- नम नन्‍नन-+ मन नत- क्‍ + मम 3++नममन++ मनन
verses.wordMeaning: He abandoned his body which was non-radiant. He split it into two. With one half of his body he became a man.
verses.commentary: Sense: He abandoned his body which was non-radiant. He split it into two. With one half of his body he became a man.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नपि महाघोरे यथेयं वा मृता सती । परितुष्टैर्विभक्ता च शृणुध्वं तां कथामिमाम्
verses.transliteration: tasminnapi mahāghore yatheyaṃ vā mṛtā satī / parituṣṭairvibhaktā ca śṛṇudhvaṃ tāṃ kathāmimām
verses.translation: With the other half he became a woman. The woman was named Satarupa. Then the lord created the earth (for the support of created beings). The lord created desires also.
verses.hindi: कल्पस्या5दौ तु बहुशो यस्मात्सस्थाश्वतुद्श  कल्पयामास वे ब्रह्मा तस्मात्कल्पोी निरूच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: With the other half he became a woman. The woman was named Satarupa. Then the lord created the earth (for the support of created beings). The lord created desires also.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the other half he became a woman. The woman was named Satarupa. Then the lord created the earth (for the support of created beings). The lord created desires also.

verses.sanskrit: युगान्ते समनुप्राप्ते पितामहदिनत्रये । मानसा ब्रह्मणः पुत्राः साक्षाद्ब्रह्मेव सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: yugānte samanuprāpte pitāmahadinatraye / mānasā brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ sākṣādbrahmeva sattamāḥ
verses.translation: Brahma created Viraj 1. That Viraj became the man ( purusa ). And as the king had been created mentally, he became known as Vairaja Manu.
verses.hindi: स स्रष्टा स्व भूतानां कल्पादिषु पुनः पुनः । व्यक्ताव्यक्तो महादेव स्त स्य सवेमिदं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma created Viraj 1. That Viraj became the man ( purusa ). And as the king had been created mentally, he became known as Vairaja Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma created Viraj 1. That Viraj became the man ( purusa ). And as the king had been created mentally, he became known as Vairaja Manu.

verses.sanskrit: सनकाद्या महात्मानो ये च वैमानिका गणाः । यमेन्द्रवरुणाद्याश्च लोकपाला दिनत्रये
verses.transliteration: sanakādyā mahātmāno ye ca vaimānikā gaṇāḥ / yamendravaruṇādyāśca lokapālā dinatraye
verses.translation: That creation (of subjects) is called Vairaja. In that creation, Manu is the man (the progenitor of human race). Satarupa bore to that valorous man Vairaja two excellent sons that persons possessing sons can expect.
verses.hindi: इत्येष प्रतिसंधिवः कीर्तितः कल्पयोडेयो: । सांप्रतातीतयोम॑भ्ये प्रगवस्था बभूब, या
verses.wordMeaning: That creation (of subjects) is called Vairaja. In that creation, Manu is the man (the progenitor of human race). Satarupa bore to that valorous man Vairaja two excellent sons that persons possessing sons can expect.
verses.commentary: Sense: That creation (of subjects) is called Vairaja. In that creation, Manu is the man (the progenitor of human race). Satarupa bore to that valorous man Vairaja two excellent sons that persons possessing sons can expect.

verses.sanskrit: कालापेक्षास्तु तिष्ठन्ति लोकवृत्तान्ततत्पराः । ततः कल्पक्षये प्राप्ते तेषां ज्ञानमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kālāpekṣāstu tiṣṭhanti lokavṛttāntatatparāḥ / tataḥ kalpakṣaye prāpte teṣāṃ jñānamanuttamam
verses.translation: The two auspicious daughters Akuti and Prasuti were born to Manu who gave Prasuti in marriage to Daksa.
verses.hindi: कीतिता तु खमासेन कल्पे कलपे यथा तथा। सांप्रत॑ त॑ प्रवचयांम कल्पमेत॑ निबोधत ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The two auspicious daughters Akuti and Prasuti were born to Manu who gave Prasuti in marriage to Daksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two auspicious daughters Akuti and Prasuti were born to Manu who gave Prasuti in marriage to Daksa.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां नश्यते चायुर्युगरूपानुसारतः । भूर्लोकं ते परित्यज्य अगमंश्च भुवं तदा
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ naśyate cāyuryugarūpānusārataḥ / bhūrlokaṃ te parityajya agamaṃśca bhuvaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Daksa should be known as Prana (thevital breath) and Manu, Sankalpa (will, determination). Manu gave Akuti' to the patriarch Ruci.
verses.hindi: ह क्‍ इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्‍ते प्रतिसंधिकीतंनं नाम सप्तमोउ5्ष्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: Daksa should be known as Prana (thevital breath) and Manu, Sankalpa (will, determination). Manu gave Akuti' to the patriarch Ruci.
verses.commentary: Sense: Daksa should be known as Prana (thevital breath) and Manu, Sankalpa (will, determination). Manu gave Akuti' to the patriarch Ruci.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्लोकं च महश्चैव जनश्चैव तपस्तदा । आश्रयं सत्यलोकं च सर्वलोकमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: svarlokaṃ ca mahaścaiva janaścaiva tapastadā / āśrayaṃ satyalokaṃ ca sarvalokamanuttamam
verses.translation: Auspicious twins were born to Akuti from Ruci, the mind-born son of Brahma. They were Yajha and Daksina.
verses.hindi: तुल्य युगसहस्तस्य नेश॑ कालसुपास्य सः । शर्वेर्यन्ते प्रकुरुते ब्रह्मत्व॑ सर्मकारणात्
verses.wordMeaning: Auspicious twins were born to Akuti from Ruci, the mind-born son of Brahma. They were Yajha and Daksina.
verses.commentary: Sense: Auspicious twins were born to Akuti from Ruci, the mind-born son of Brahma. They were Yajha and Daksina.

verses.sanskrit: कालं युगसहस्रान्तं पुत्रपौत्रसमन्विताः । सत्यलोके च तिष्ठन्ति यावत्संजायते जगत्
verses.transliteration: kālaṃ yugasahasrāntaṃ putrapautrasamanvitāḥ / satyaloke ca tiṣṭhanti yāvatsaṃjāyate jagat
verses.translation: Yajha begot of Daksina twelve sons. They were called Yamas, gods in the Svayarhbhuva Manvantara.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा तु सलिले तस्मिन्वायुभू त्वा तदा चरन् । अन्धकारे तदा तस्मिन्नष्टे स्थावरजड्जमे
verses.wordMeaning: Yajha begot of Daksina twelve sons. They were called Yamas, gods in the Svayarhbhuva Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yajha begot of Daksina twelve sons. They were called Yamas, gods in the Svayarhbhuva Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मपुत्राश्च ये केचित्कल्पादौ न भवन्ति ह । त्रैलोक्यं ते परित्यज्य अनाधारं भवन्ति च
verses.transliteration: brahmaputrāśca ye kecitkalpādau na bhavanti ha / trailokyaṃ te parityajya anādhāraṃ bhavanti ca
verses.translation: Being born as the sons of Yajha, one of the twins (Yama), they are known as Yamas. The two Ganas (groups) of
verses.hindi: भूतों की बार बार सृष्टि करते हैं; अतः यह जगत् उनका ही है ।७३-७८। अतीत और वर्तमान काल के मध्य भाग में जो कुछ घटित हुआ है वही प्रतिसन्धि वृत्तान्त है। मैंने आपके आगे उसे कह दिया है। कल्प-कल्प में जो घटना घटित होती हैं, उसे भी संक्षेप में कह दिया है। अब तक जो कुछ कहा गया है। अब आप लोगों से साम्प्रत कल्प के विषय में कह रहा हूँ इसको सुनिये
verses.wordMeaning: Being born as the sons of Yajha, one of the twins (Yama), they are known as Yamas. The two Ganas (groups) of
verses.commentary: Sense: Being born as the sons of Yajha, one of the twins (Yama), they are known as Yamas. The two Ganas (groups) of

verses.sanskrit: तैः सार्धं ये तु ते विप्रा अन्ये चापि तपोधनाः । यक्षरक्षःपिशाचाश्च अन्ये वैमानिका गणाः
verses.transliteration: taiḥ sārdhaṃ ye tu te viprā anye cāpi tapodhanāḥ / yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāśca anye vaimānikā gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: The Yamas occupied the heaven at the outset. Hence they are called 'heaven-dwellers.' The mothers of the worlds were born of Prasuti, the daughter of Svayarhbhuva Manu.
verses.hindi: है... कमाना या मं कनाण-।... नाम, जायनवशथमं।गगशशममाकनंधक,
verses.wordMeaning: The Yamas occupied the heaven at the outset. Hence they are called 'heaven-dwellers.' The mothers of the worlds were born of Prasuti, the daughter of Svayarhbhuva Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yamas occupied the heaven at the outset. Hence they are called 'heaven-dwellers.' The mothers of the worlds were born of Prasuti, the daughter of Svayarhbhuva Manu.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयश्च महाभागा वर्णाश्चान्ये पृथग्विधाः । सीदन्ति भूम्यां सहिता ये चान्ये तलवासिनः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgā varṇāścānye pṛthagvidhāḥ / sīdanti bhūmyāṃ sahitā ye cānye talavāsinaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Daksa begot of her twenty-four daughters. All of them were lotus-eyed and very fortunate.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--हजार युग के बराबर रात्रि काल को बिता कर वे आदि पुरुष रात्रि के अन्त में सृष्टि करनें की इच्छा से ब्रह्मा का रूप धारण करते हैं ।१। ब्रह्मा उस समय वायु रूप धारण कर उस अन्धकार में--जबकि स्थावरजंगमात्मक जगत् वष्ट हुआ रहता, सारा भूमण्डल चारों ओर से जलमग्न रहता, पंच महाभूतों का विभक्त रूप नहीं रहता अर्थात् पाँचों महाभूत प्ृथक्-इृथक् नहीं दिखाई पड़ते--इधर उधर जल के
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Daksa begot of her twenty-four daughters. All of them were lotus-eyed and very fortunate.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Daksa begot of her twenty-four daughters. All of them were lotus-eyed and very fortunate.

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्टिरभूत्तत्र महती शतवार्षिकी । लोकक्षयकरी रौद्रा वृक्षवीरुद्विनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭirabhūttatra mahatī śatavārṣikī / lokakṣayakarī raudrā vṛkṣavīrudvināśinī
verses.translation: These were wives of Yogins and Yogic mothers. The first thirteen were—Sraddha, Laksmi, Dhrti, Tusti, Pusti, Medha, Kriya, Buddhi, Lajja, Vapus, Santi, Siddhi and Klrti the thirteenth.
verses.hindi: ऊपर घमते रहते हैं ।३-३। वर्षा ऋतु के खद्योत की भाँति वे इधर उधर घूमते तो रहते परन्तु स्वयम्भू सवेदा
verses.wordMeaning: These were wives of Yogins and Yogic mothers. The first thirteen were—Sraddha, Laksmi, Dhrti, Tusti, Pusti, Medha, Kriya, Buddhi, Lajja, Vapus, Santi, Siddhi and Klrti the thirteenth.
verses.commentary: Sense: These were wives of Yogins and Yogic mothers. The first thirteen were—Sraddha, Laksmi, Dhrti, Tusti, Pusti, Medha, Kriya, Buddhi, Lajja, Vapus, Santi, Siddhi and Klrti the thirteenth.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यसंक्षोभकरी सप्तार्णवविशोषणी । ततो लोकाः क्षुधाविष्टा भ्रमन्तीव दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: trailokyasaṃkṣobhakarī saptārṇavaviśoṣaṇī / tato lokāḥ kṣudhāviṣṭā bhramantīva diśo daśa
verses.translation: Lord Dharma took these daughters of Daksa as his wives. They functioned as the doorways (of creation) as ordained by Brahma.
verses.hindi: निशायामिव खद्यो तः प्राचुटूकाले ततस्ततः । तदा55काशे चरन्सो5थ वीच्यमाणः स्वयंभुवः ॥ प्रतिष्ठाया ह्ुपाय॑ तु मार्गमाणस्तद प्रभु! । ततस्तु सलिले तस्मिकज्ञात्वा ह्न्तगंतां महीम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Dharma took these daughters of Daksa as his wives. They functioned as the doorways (of creation) as ordained by Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Dharma took these daughters of Daksa as his wives. They functioned as the doorways (of creation) as ordained by Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: कंदैर्मूलैः फलैर्वापि वर्तयन्ते सुदुःखिताः । सरितः सागराः कूपाः सेवन्ते पावनानि च
verses.transliteration: kaṃdairmūlaiḥ phalairvāpi vartayante suduḥkhitāḥ / saritaḥ sāgarāḥ kūpāḥ sevante pāvanāni ca
verses.translation: Besides them, the remaining younger ones were the eleven lovely-eyed daughters—Khyati, Sati, Sambhuti, Smrti, Prlti, Ksama, Sannati, Anasuya, Urja, Svaha and Svadha. Other great sages then accepted them. They were Rudra,
verses.hindi: अजुमानाक्तु सबुद्धों भूमेरुदएणं प्रति । चकारान्यां तन चैव पूर्वकल्पादिषु स्मुताम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Besides them, the remaining younger ones were the eleven lovely-eyed daughters—Khyati, Sati, Sambhuti, Smrti, Prlti, Ksama, Sannati, Anasuya, Urja, Svaha and Svadha. Other great sages then accepted them. They were Rudra,
verses.commentary: Sense: Besides them, the remaining younger ones were the eleven lovely-eyed daughters—Khyati, Sati, Sambhuti, Smrti, Prlti, Ksama, Sannati, Anasuya, Urja, Svaha and Svadha. Other great sages then accepted them. They were Rudra,

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि सर्वे शुष्यन्ति सरिद्भिः सह सागराः । ततो यान्यल्पसाराणि सत्त्वानि पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration: tatrāpi sarve śuṣyanti saridbhiḥ saha sāgarāḥ / tato yānyalpasārāṇi sattvāni pṛthivītale
verses.translation: The author uses Vairaja, Purusa, Manu (and Samrat) as synonyms here.
verses.hindi: पाथिवीस्तु स विन्यस्य पृथिव्यां सो5चिनोदि्गिरीन । प्राक्सगं दु्यमाने तु तदा संवर्तकाप्निना तेनाग्निना प्रलीनास्तें पव॑ंता शुचि सर्वशः । (शैत्यादेकार्ण वे तस्मिन्वायुनाउडपस्तु सहताः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The author uses Vairaja, Purusa, Manu (and Samrat) as synonyms here.
verses.commentary: Sense: The author uses Vairaja, Purusa, Manu (and Samrat) as synonyms here.

verses.sanskrit: तान्येवाग्रे प्रलीयन्ते भिन्नान्युरुजलेन वै । अथ संक्षीयमाणासु सरित्सु सह सागरैः
verses.transliteration: tānyevāgre pralīyante bhinnānyurujalena vai / atha saṃkṣīyamāṇāsu saritsu saha sāgaraiḥ
verses.translation: He gave (in marriage) Sati to Siva and Khyati to Bhrgu, Sambhuti to Marici, Smrti to Angiras, Prlti to Pulastya, Ksama to Pulalia, Sannati to Kratu, Anasuya to Atri, Urja to Vasistha, Svaha to Agni and Svndha toPitis. I shall mention the children born to them.
verses.hindi: स्वस्थाने स्थापयित्वा च विभागमकरोत्पुनः  सप्त सप्त तु वर्षाणि तस्या द्वीपेषु सप्सु
verses.wordMeaning: He gave (in marriage) Sati to Siva and Khyati to Bhrgu, Sambhuti to Marici, Smrti to Angiras, Prlti to Pulastya, Ksama to Pulalia, Sannati to Kratu, Anasuya to Atri, Urja to Vasistha, Svaha to Agni and Svndha toPitis. I shall mention the children born to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave (in marriage) Sati to Siva and Khyati to Bhrgu, Sambhuti to Marici, Smrti to Angiras, Prlti to Pulastya, Ksama to Pulalia, Sannati to Kratu, Anasuya to Atri, Urja to Vasistha, Svaha to Agni and Svndha toPitis. I shall mention the children born to them.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां षष्टिसाहस्रं कुरुक्षेत्रनिवासिनाम् । ये च वैखानसा विप्रा दन्तोलूखलिनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasraṃ kurukṣetranivāsinām / ye ca vaikhānasā viprā dantolūkhalinastathā
verses.translation: All these children were highly intelligent and very fortunate. They abide in all the Manvantaras till the final dissolution takes place.
verses.hindi: उनका निरीक्षण किया करते है ।४॥ उस समय प्रभु भू-प्रतिष्ठा (पृथ्वी को जल के ऊपर लाना) के उपाय को ढूंढ़ते रहते हैं। वे उस समय समुद्र में मरन पृथ्वी का अनुमान से ठीक पता पाकर पृथ्वी के उद्धार के लिये सचेष्ट हो गये । उन्होंने पूर्व कल्पों का स्मरण कर तदनुरूप ही दूसरा शरीर धारण कर लिया। तब प्रभ बाराह का रूप धारण कर उस समुद्र में घूस गये, भऔर जल से आच्छादित प्रथ्वी को भलीभाँति देखकर उसको
verses.wordMeaning: All these children were highly intelligent and very fortunate. They abide in all the Manvantaras till the final dissolution takes place.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these children were highly intelligent and very fortunate. They abide in all the Manvantaras till the final dissolution takes place.

verses.sanskrit: हिमाचलगुहागुह्ये ये वसन्ति तपोधनाः । सर्वे ते मामुपागम्य क्षुत्तृषार्तास्तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: himācalaguhāguhye ye vasanti tapodhanāḥ / sarve te māmupāgamya kṣuttṛṣārtāstapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: Sraddha (faith) gave birth to Kama (Desire); 1 Laksmi to Darpa (Arrogance); Dhrti (Firmness, self-command) toNiyama (Restraint); the son of Tusti (Satisfaction)is called Santosa (Contentment); Labha (Gain) was the son of Pusti (nourishment); Sruta (Learning) was the son of Medha(intelli¬ gence). (The sons of) Kriya (Activity) were Naya (Justice), Danda (Punishment) and Samaya (Law). Both Bodha (Know¬ ledge) and Apramada (Absence of errors) were the sons of Buddhi (intellect). Vinaya (Discipline) was the son of Lajja (Bashfulness); Vyavasaya (Exertion) was the son of Vapus (body); Ksema (welfare) was the son of Santi (Tranquility); Sukha (pleasure) was born of Siddhi (Achievement); Yasas (fame) was the son of KIrti (Renown). These are the sons of Dharma.
verses.hindi: उस जल के ऊपर स्थापित किया । जल को विभक्त कर भिन्न-भिन्न जलाशयों में स्थापित किया। समुद्र जल को समुद्रों में, नदी जल को नदियों में ओर पार्थिव जल को पृथ्वी में स्थापित कर दिया। पूर्व सर्ग के संवर्तक अग्नि से भस्म होने पर उस समय के पव॑त भी पृथ्वी में ही गलकर लीन हो गये थे । जलप्लावन के समय शीतलता के कारण, वे जहाँ जहाँ पहले गड़े हुये थे वहाँ वहाँ पुनः जमकर स्थिर
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha (faith) gave birth to Kama (Desire); 1 Laksmi to Darpa (Arrogance); Dhrti (Firmness, self-command) toNiyama (Restraint); the son of Tusti (Satisfaction)is called Santosa (Contentment); Labha (Gain) was the son of Pusti (nourishment);…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha (faith) gave birth to Kama (Desire); 1 Laksmi to Darpa (Arrogance); Dhrti (Firmness, self-command) toNiyama (Restraint); the son of Tusti (Satisfaction)is called Santosa (Contentment); Labha (Gain) was the son of Pusti (nourishment);…

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे सीदयामो महामुने । सरित्सागरशैलान्तं जगत्संशुष्यते द्विज
verses.transliteration: ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve sīdayāmo mahāmune / saritsāgaraśailāntaṃ jagatsaṃśuṣyate dvija
verses.translation: Harsa (pleasure) was the son of Kama from the god¬ dess Rati. Thus the progeny of Dharma resulted in happiness.
verses.hindi: हो गये । वाथु के द्वारा ऊपर का जल भी सूख गया। गतिहीन होने के कारण उनका नाम अचल, पर्व (गाँठ) के कारण पर्वत, जल से निगले जाने के कारण अर्थात् जल में ड्ब जाने के कारण गिरि, पत्थरों के चयन के कारण उसका नाम सिलोच्चय पड़ा ।१-११२। तदनन्तर प्रभु ने जल के भीतर पृथ्वी का उद्धार कर उसको निर्दिष्ट स्थान पर स्थापित किया और उसका फिरसे
verses.wordMeaning: Harsa (pleasure) was the son of Kama from the god¬ dess Rati. Thus the progeny of Dharma resulted in happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harsa (pleasure) was the son of Kama from the god¬ dess Rati. Thus the progeny of Dharma resulted in happiness.

verses.sanskrit: कुत्र यास्याम सहिता यावत्कालस्य पर्ययः । दीर्घायुरसि विप्रेन्द्र न मृतस्त्वं युगक्षये
verses.transliteration: kutra yāsyāma sahitā yāvatkālasya paryayaḥ / dīrghāyurasi viprendra na mṛtastvaṃ yugakṣaye
verses.translation: Himsa (Violence) bore to Adharma (Evil) the twins Nikrti (Wickedness) and Anrta (Falsehood). Bhaya (Fear) and Naraka (Hell) were born of Nikrti and'Anta. The twins Maya (Deceit) and Vedana (Pain) were born to them. Bhaya begot of Maya, Mftyu that takes away living beings.
verses.hindi: विभाग किया । पहले उसको सात द्वीपों में और प्रत्येक ढ्वीपों को सात सात वर्षों में बाँठा। विषम भूमि को समतल बनाकर शिलाखण्डों से चुनकर पव॑तों को बनाया ।१२-१३२। उत द्वीपों में चालीस वर्ष बनाये
verses.wordMeaning: Himsa (Violence) bore to Adharma (Evil) the twins Nikrti (Wickedness) and Anrta (Falsehood). Bhaya (Fear) and Naraka (Hell) were born of Nikrti and'Anta. The twins Maya (Deceit) and Vedana (Pain) were born to them. Bhaya begot of Maya, Mftyu that takes away living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Himsa (Violence) bore to Adharma (Evil) the twins Nikrti (Wickedness) and Anrta (Falsehood). Bhaya (Fear) and Naraka (Hell) were born of Nikrti and'Anta. The twins Maya (Deceit) and Vedana (Pain) were born to them. Bhaya begot of Maya, Mftyu that takes away living beings.

verses.sanskrit: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च सर्वं तव हृदि स्थितम् । तस्मात्त्वं वेत्सि सर्वं च कथयस्व महाव्रत
verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca sarvaṃ tava hṛdi sthitam / tasmāttvaṃ vetsi sarvaṃ ca kathayasva mahāvrata
verses.translation: From Raurava, Vedana gave birth to Duhkha (pain). From Mrtyu were born Vyadhi, Jvara, Soka, Krodha, and Asuya. These were characterised by Adharma and were condu¬ cive to misery.
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो ऊ पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: From Raurava, Vedana gave birth to Duhkha (pain). From Mrtyu were born Vyadhi, Jvara, Soka, Krodha, and Asuya. These were characterised by Adharma and were condu¬ cive to misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Raurava, Vedana gave birth to Duhkha (pain). From Mrtyu were born Vyadhi, Jvara, Soka, Krodha, and Asuya. These were characterised by Adharma and were condu¬ cive to misery.

verses.sanskrit: कीदृक्कालं महाभाग क्षपिष्यामो ऽथ सुव्रत । अनावृष्टिहतं सर्वं सीदते सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: kīdṛkkālaṃ mahābhāga kṣapiṣyāmo 'tha suvrata / anāvṛṣṭihataṃ sarvaṃ sīdate sacarācaram
verses.translation: Verses 33-40 personify virtues and vices and state their parentage. Out of these verses 38-41 describe the Tamasa creation.
verses.hindi: भूराख्यांश्चतुरों लोकांश्चन्द्रादित्यौ श्रहे! सह । पूर्व तु निर्ममे ब्रह्मा स्थानीनामानि सर्चशः ॥ कल्पस्य चास्य ब्रह्मा वे हारजत्स्थानिनः पुरा। आपोउग्निः पृथिवी चायुरन्तरिक्षं दिय॑ तथा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 33-40 personify virtues and vices and state their parentage. Out of these verses 38-41 describe the Tamasa creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 33-40 personify virtues and vices and state their parentage. Out of these verses 38-41 describe the Tamasa creation.

verses.sanskrit: परित्राहि महाभाग न यथा याम संक्षयम् । ततः संचिन्त्य मनसा त्वरन्विप्रान् अथाब्रवम्
verses.transliteration: paritrāhi mahābhāga na yathā yāma saṃkṣayam / tataḥ saṃcintya manasā tvaranviprān athābravam
verses.translation: They had no wives and no sons. They were known as Nidhanas. Thus the Tamasa creation that checked the growth of Dharma came into being.
verses.hindi: लवाः का (वान्का)ष्ठाः कलाश्चेव मुह्त संधिराज्यहम् । अधं॑मासांश्च मासांश्च अयनाब्द-
verses.wordMeaning: They had no wives and no sons. They were known as Nidhanas. Thus the Tamasa creation that checked the growth of Dharma came into being.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had no wives and no sons. They were known as Nidhanas. Thus the Tamasa creation that checked the growth of Dharma came into being.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रं त्यजध्वं च पुत्रदारसमन्विताः । त्यक्त्वोदीचीं दिशं सर्वे यामो याम्यामनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetraṃ tyajadhvaṃ ca putradārasamanvitāḥ / tyaktvodīcīṃ diśaṃ sarve yāmo yāmyāmanuttamām
verses.translation: They were neither superior nor inferior to him. They were mentally created and were equal to himself. He created thousands and thousands (such children) who were wearing elephants hides. - All were equal to him in form, splendour, strength and learning. Some were reddish brown. Some had quivers. Some had matted hair.
verses.hindi: प्रागुक्ता या मया तुभ्य॑ पूर्वकालं प्रजास्तु ताः  तस्मिन्संचतमाने तु कल्पे दग्धस्तदाउग्निना ॥ अप्राप्ता यास्तपोलोक॑ जनलोक॑ समाश्रिताः। प्रवर्तन्ति(न्ते) पुनः सं बीजार्थ ता भचन्ति हि॥
verses.wordMeaning: They were neither superior nor inferior to him. They were mentally created and were equal to himself. He created thousands and thousands (such children) who were wearing elephants hides. - All were equal to him in form, splendour, strength and learning. Some were reddish brown.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were neither superior nor inferior to him. They were mentally created and were equal to himself. He created thousands and thousands (such children) who were wearing elephants hides. - All were equal to him in form, splendour, strength and learning. Some were reddish brown.…

verses.sanskrit: नगरग्रामघोषाढ्यां पुरपत्तनशोभिताम् । गच्छामो नर्मदातीरं बहुसिद्धनिषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: nagaragrāmaghoṣāḍhyāṃ purapattanaśobhitām / gacchāmo narmadātīraṃ bahusiddhaniṣevitam
verses.translation: They were tawny-coloured, equipped with quivers (for arrows); they had matted hair and were deeply red ( vilohita ) in complexion. They were green-haired. They killed with eyes (by casting a glance) and held skulls (in their hands). They were multiformed, hideous in appearance, and cosmic-formed. They rode chariots and wore coats of mail. They were virtuous and put on armours. They had hundred* thousand arms. They could traverse through the heaven, firmament and the earth. They had big heads, eight fangs, two tongues and three eyes. (Some of them were) eaters of rice, (some) eaters of flesh, (some were) drinkers cf ghee and (some) of Soma juice; some drank fat. They were huge-bodied and blue-black-necked and of fierce fury..They were equipped with quivers, bows, swords and leather-shields. Some were seated, some were running, some were yawning and some occupying seats. Some were teaching the Vedas; some performing Japa, practising Yoga and some studying the Vedas. Some were blazing, some showering, some shining, while some were smoking. Some were awake (enlight¬ ened), some the most enlightened, some established in Brahman and some of auspicious vision. All of them were blue-necked, thousand-eyed and nocturnal wanderers. They were invisible to all beings. They were great yogins of brilliant splendour. Some were shouting and running. Rudra created

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राङ्गीं तां महापुण्यां सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् । पश्यामस्तां महाभागां न्यग्रोधावारसंकुलाम्
verses.transliteration: rudrāṅgīṃ tāṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm / paśyāmastāṃ mahābhāgāṃ nyagrodhāvārasaṃkulām
verses.translation: Verses 42-52 describe Raudri Sfffi (creation by Rudra).
verses.hindi: गये और प्रत्येक वर्षों में उतने ही पर्वत सृष्टि के आदि में प्रकृति की अनुकूलता के आधार पर स्थापित किये गये, उसमें कोई उलट फेर नहीं हुआ ।१४-१५। सातों द्वीप और सातों समुद्र एक दूसरे के मण्डल को प्रकृतित: घेरकर एक दूसरे के निकट स्थित हैं ।१६। ब्रह्मा सबसे पहले भूः आदि चार लोकों को, चन्द्रमा, सूर्य अन्य ग्रहों के सहित बनाया और उन पर भली भाँति स्थानों का भी विभाग किया ।१७। ब्रह्म ने सबसे पहले इस कल्प
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 42-52 describe Raudri Sfffi (creation by Rudra).
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 42-52 describe Raudri Sfffi (creation by Rudra).

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरैर्भागवतैः सांख्यैः सिद्धैः सुसेविताम् । अनावृष्टिभयाद्भीताः कूलयोरुभयोरपि
verses.transliteration: māheśvarairbhāgavataiḥ sāṃkhyaiḥ siddhaiḥ susevitām / anāvṛṣṭibhayādbhītāḥ kūlayorubhayorapi
verses.translation: A. reads: KfUi-vdsascim 'wearing elephants'hides*. Kpni-vasasd in the text is obviously a misprint.
verses.hindi: के स्थ नी (एक स्थान पर रहने वाले) जल, अग्नि, पृथ्वी, वायु, भन्‍्तरिक्ष, आकाश, स्वर्ग, दिशायें, समुद्र, नदी, सब पर्वत, अम्ृतमय ओषधियाँ, वक्ष लता आदि वनस्पतियाँ, लव, काष्ठ, कला, मुह्॒त, सन्‍्ध्या, रात, दिन, पक्ष, मास, अयथन, वर्ष, युग, प्रथकू-पृथक् स्थान एवं स्थानाभिभानी और स्थानात्माओं का निर्माण कर उन्होंने कृत, त्रेता, ढ्वापर और कलि आदि युगों का निर्माण किया  सबसे पहले कल्प के आदि में कृत युग को व्यवस्थित
verses.wordMeaning: A. reads: KfUi-vdsascim 'wearing elephants'hides*. Kpni-vasasd in the text is obviously a misprint.
