verses.sanskrit: आश्रमे ह्याश्रमान्दिव्यान्कारयामो जितव्रताः । एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे समेतानुचरैः सह
verses.transliteration: āśrame hyāśramāndivyānkārayāmo jitavratāḥ / evamuktāstu te sarve sametānucaraiḥ saha
verses.translation: On seeing them, Brahma said, "Do not create progeny like these. Beings equal or superior to yourself, should not be created by you. Create other offsprings. Prosperity be unto you. I am staying here (by you). You create the offsprings. "
verses.hindi: किया ।१८-२२। पहले मैने जिस काल और प्रजा की चर्चा की है और उस कल्प के अन्त में जो संवर्तक अग्नि से जलाये गये परन्तु तपोलोक को न जाकर जो जनलोक तक ही रह गये, वे पुनः नवीन सृष्टि कार्य में प्रवत्त होते हैं ओर वे ध्रृष्टि के कारण बनते हैं।२ -२४। वहाँ सृष्टिबीज के लिये स्थित वे पुनः सृष्टि के लिये देह धारण करते और सनन्‍्तानवृद्धि में सहायक होते हैं ।२५। वे प्रजा, देवता, पितर, ऋषि, मनु आदि धर्म-अथे-काम
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing them, Brahma said, "Do not create progeny like these. Beings equal or superior to yourself, should not be created by you. Create other offsprings. Prosperity be unto you. I am staying here (by you). You create the offsprings. "
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them, Brahma said, "Do not create progeny like these. Beings equal or superior to yourself, should not be created by you. Create other offsprings. Prosperity be unto you. I am staying here (by you). You create the offsprings. "

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातीरमासाद्य स्थिताः सर्वे ऽकुतोभयाः । किंचित् पूर्वम् अनुस्मृत्य पुरा कल्पादिभिर्भयम्
verses.transliteration: narmadātīramāsādya sthitāḥ sarve 'kutobhayāḥ / kiṃcit pūrvam anusmṛtya purā kalpādibhirbhayam
verses.translation: (Siva replied), "These hideous reddish blue beings created by me in thousands and thousands are definitely, com¬ parable to myself. These gods will become Rudras of great strength. They will be known on the earth and in the sky by the name Rudra.
verses.hindi: धर्माधकाममोक्षाणामिह ता; साध(थघि)कए स्घखता। । देवाश्च पितरश्चैच ऋषयो मनवस्तथा॥ ततस्ते तपसा युक्ताः स्थानान्यापूरयन्ति हि। ब्रह्मणो मानसास्ते वे सिद्धात्मानों भवन्ति हि॥ थे सद्भाहेषयक्तेन कर्मणा ते दिवं गताः। आवर्तमाना इच्द ते सभवन्ति युगे युगे
verses.wordMeaning: (Siva replied), "These hideous reddish blue beings created by me in thousands and thousands are definitely, com¬ parable to myself. These gods will become Rudras of great strength. They will be known on the earth and in the sky by the name Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Siva replied), "These hideous reddish blue beings created by me in thousands and thousands are definitely, com¬ parable to myself. These gods will become Rudras of great strength. They will be known on the earth and in the sky by the name Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तास्तु नर्मदातीरमादावेव कलौ युगे । ततो वर्षशतं पूर्णं दिव्यं रेवातटे ऽवसन्
verses.transliteration: prāptāstu narmadātīramādāveva kalau yuge / tato varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ divyaṃ revātaṭe 'vasan
verses.translation: These called Satarudra in the Veda will be worthy of sacrifices and will partake of sacrificial shares with the groups of gods.
verses.hindi: स्वकर्पतफलशेषेण ख्याताश्चैच तथात्मिकाः । संभवन्ति जनाज्नोकात्कमेसंशयबन्धनात्
verses.wordMeaning: These called Satarudra in the Veda will be worthy of sacrifices and will partake of sacrificial shares with the groups of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: These called Satarudra in the Veda will be worthy of sacrifices and will partake of sacrificial shares with the groups of gods.

verses.sanskrit: षड्विंशच्च सहस्राणि वर्षाणां मानुषाणि च । तत्राश्चर्यं मया दृष्टमृषीणां वसतां नृप
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍviṃśacca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi ca / tatrāścaryaṃ mayā dṛṣṭamṛṣīṇāṃ vasatāṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: They will stay till the period of dissolution, being worshipped with those Devas born of the Chandas (Vedas) in all the Manvantara ages."
verses.hindi: आशयः कारण तत्न बोहूव्य कर्मणां त सः । तैः कमभिस्तु जायन्ते जनाज्नोफा: शुभाशुभैः
verses.wordMeaning: They will stay till the period of dissolution, being worshipped with those Devas born of the Chandas (Vedas) in all the Manvantara ages."
verses.commentary: Sense: They will stay till the period of dissolution, being worshipped with those Devas born of the Chandas (Vedas) in all the Manvantara ages."

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्टिहते लोके संशुष्के स्थावरे चरे । भिन्ने युगादिकलने हाहाभूते विचेतने
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭihate loke saṃśuṣke sthāvare care / bhinne yugādikalane hāhābhūte vicetane
verses.translation: Thus addressed by the intelligent Lord Siva, the Pat¬ riarch Brahma, replied joyfully to the terrible Rudra:
verses.hindi: गूहून्ति ते शरीराशि दानारूपाणि योनिषु। देवाद्यस्थावरान्ते चर उत्पद्यन्ते परस्परम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed by the intelligent Lord Siva, the Pat¬ riarch Brahma, replied joyfully to the terrible Rudra:
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by the intelligent Lord Siva, the Pat¬ riarch Brahma, replied joyfully to the terrible Rudra:

verses.sanskrit: चातुर्वर्णे प्रलीने तु नष्टे होमबलिक्रमे । निःस्वाहे निर्वषट्कारे शौचाचारविवर्जिते
verses.transliteration: cāturvarṇe pralīne tu naṣṭe homabalikrame / niḥsvāhe nirvaṣaṭkāre śaucācāravivarjite
verses.translation: ct O Lord, let it be as it is spoken by you. Welfare unto you." When so assented by Brahma, everything happened accordingly.
verses.hindi: तेषा ये यानि कर्मा णि प्राक्सष्टे: प्रतिपेद्रि। (+ तान्येव प्रतिपद्यन्ते सज्यप्तानाः पुनः पुन
verses.wordMeaning: ct O Lord, let it be as it is spoken by you. Welfare unto you." When so assented by Brahma, everything happened accordingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: ct O Lord, let it be as it is spoken by you. Welfare unto you." When so assented by Brahma, everything happened accordingly.

verses.sanskrit: इयमेका सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा ऋषिकोटिनिषेविता । नान्या काचित्त्रिलोके ऽपि रमणीया नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: iyamekā saricchreṣṭhā ṛṣikoṭiniṣevitā / nānyā kācittriloke 'pi ramaṇīyā nareśvara
verses.translation: Thenceforth, the lord did not create offsprings. He stood with sublimated sexual virility till the final dissolution of living beings. Since he said "I am staying", he is known as <c i Sthanu"'
verses.hindi: हिस्लाहिसे सुदुकरे घमांथर्त ऋतानते । तस्भाविताः प्रपद्चन्ते तस्मात्तत्तस्थ रोचते
verses.wordMeaning: Thenceforth, the lord did not create offsprings. He stood with sublimated sexual virility till the final dissolution of living beings. Since he said "I am staying", he is known as <c i Sthanu"'
verses.commentary: Sense: Thenceforth, the lord did not create offsprings. He stood with sublimated sexual virility till the final dissolution of living beings. Since he said "I am staying", he is known as <c i Sthanu"'

verses.sanskrit: यथेयं पुण्यसलिला इन्द्रस्येवामरावती । देवतायतनैः शुभ्रैराश्रमैश्च सुकल्पितैः
verses.transliteration: yatheyaṃ puṇyasalilā indrasyevāmarāvatī / devatāyatanaiḥ śubhrairāśramaiśca sukalpitaiḥ
verses.translation: The following ten qualities are ever present in San¬ kara. They are: knowledge, non-attachment, glorious prosperity, penance, truth, forbearance, firmness, creativity, self-com¬ prehension, dominance.
verses.hindi: कल्पेष्वासन्व्यतीतेणषु रूपनामानि यानि च। तान्येवानागते काले प्रायशः प्रतिपेदिरे
verses.wordMeaning: The following ten qualities are ever present in San¬ kara. They are: knowledge, non-attachment, glorious prosperity, penance, truth, forbearance, firmness, creativity, self-com¬ prehension, dominance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following ten qualities are ever present in San¬ kara. They are: knowledge, non-attachment, glorious prosperity, penance, truth, forbearance, firmness, creativity, self-com¬ prehension, dominance.

verses.sanskrit: शोभते नर्मदा देवी स्वर्गे मन्दाकिनी यथा । यावद्वृक्षा महाशैला यावत्सागरसंभवा
verses.transliteration: śobhate narmadā devī svarge mandākinī yathā / yāvadvṛkṣā mahāśailā yāvatsāgarasaṃbhavā
verses.translation: By means of his brilliance the lord surpasses all. the Devas, sages and Asuras. So he is known as Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: और मोक्ष के साधन माने गये हैं।२६। तदनन्तर वे तपस्था में लीन होकर अपने स्थानों को (कार्यों को) पूरा करते हैं और सिद्धात्मा ब्रह्मा के मानसपुत्र के रूप में देह धारण करते हैं ।२७। और जो अपने शुभ और उद्बार कर्मों के प्रभाव से स्वर्ग को प्राप्त किये थे वे पुनः यहाँ प्रप्येझ युग में उत्पन्न होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: By means of his brilliance the lord surpasses all. the Devas, sages and Asuras. So he is known as Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of his brilliance the lord surpasses all. the Devas, sages and Asuras. So he is known as Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: उभयोः कूलयोस् तावन् मण्डितायतनैः शुभैः । हूयद्भिर् अग्निहोत्रैश्च हविर्धूमसमाकुला
verses.transliteration: ubhayoḥ kūlayos tāvan maṇḍitāyatanaiḥ śubhaiḥ / hūyadbhir agnihotraiśca havirdhūmasamākulā
verses.translation: He excels Devas by his glorious prosperity; Asuras by his strength; the sages by his knowledge; and all the Bhutas by his Yoga.
verses.hindi: अपने कर्मफल के शेष रहने के कारण वे ऐसा रूप धारण करते हैं और कर्मसंशय के बन्धन के कारण ही वे जनलोक से पुनः इस लोक में आते हैं ।२। इस उत्त्पत्ति में कर्मों के आशय को ही कारण समझना चाहिए । वे उन शुभ, अशुभ कर्मों के कारण ही। जतलोक से वहाँ उत्पन्न होते हैं ।३०। नाना योनियों में वे नाना रूप धारण कर देव योनि से लेकर स्थावर पर्यन्त योनियों से उत्पन्न होते हैं ।३१॥ उनमें से सृष्टि के पूर्व
verses.wordMeaning: He excels Devas by his glorious prosperity; Asuras by his strength; the sages by his knowledge; and all the Bhutas by his Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: He excels Devas by his glorious prosperity; Asuras by his strength; the sages by his knowledge; and all the Bhutas by his Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: बभूव नर्मदा देवी प्रावृट्काल इव शर्वरी । देवतायतनैर्नैकैः पूजासंस्कारशोभिता
verses.transliteration: babhūva narmadā devī prāvṛṭkāla iva śarvarī / devatāyatanairnaikaiḥ pūjāsaṃskāraśobhitā
verses.translation: O noble sage, explain to us the nature of the Yoga,
verses.hindi: जिनको जो जो कर्म प्राप्त थे, वे पुनः पुनः जन्म लेकर उन्हीं कर्मों को प्राप्त करते हैं। हिसा अहिंसा, सृदुता, करता घध्म, अधर्म, सत्य, असत्य आदि को कर्मानुसार आप्त करते हैं । इसलिये बे कर्म ही उनको अच्छे जान पड़ते हैं।३ -३३। बीते हुये कल्पों में उनके जैसे रूप और नाम रहते प्रायः उन्हीं नामरूपों को भविष्य कल्पों में प्राप्त करते हैं । इस नियम के अनुसार उन्हीं नाम रूपों को इस
verses.wordMeaning: O noble sage, explain to us the nature of the Yoga,
verses.commentary: Sense: O noble sage, explain to us the nature of the Yoga,

verses.sanskrit: सरिद्भिर्भ्राजते श्रेष्ठा पुरी शाक्री च भास्करी । केचित्पञ्चाग्नितपसः केचिदप्यग्निहोत्रिणः
verses.transliteration: saridbhirbhrājate śreṣṭhā purī śākrī ca bhāskarī / kecitpañcāgnitapasaḥ kecidapyagnihotriṇaḥ
verses.translation: We wish to hear completely all the different Dharmas comprising the Yoga of Mahesvara whereby the twice-born ones will attain Moksa.
verses.hindi: सृष्टि में भी प्राप्त किया  वे इस प्रकार प्रत्येक कल्प में नाम रूपों के अनुसार जन्म लेते हैं। तदनन्तर सृष्टि की इच्छा से विन्तनशील ब्रह्मा ने सृष्टि के प्रारम्भ में उन जनलोकवासी प्रजाओं का ध्यान किया । उस समप अपने मुख से एक सहस्न युग्त (नर-तारी' उत्पन्न किये । ३४-२६ १। सतोगुण के उद्रेक से वे पुरुष
verses.wordMeaning: We wish to hear completely all the different Dharmas comprising the Yoga of Mahesvara whereby the twice-born ones will attain Moksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: We wish to hear completely all the different Dharmas comprising the Yoga of Mahesvara whereby the twice-born ones will attain Moksa.

verses.sanskrit: केचिद् धूमकमश्नन्ति तपस्युग्रे व्यवस्थिताः । आत्मयज्ञरताः केचिदपरे भक्तिभागिनः
verses.transliteration: kecid dhūmakamaśnanti tapasyugre vyavasthitāḥ / ātmayajñaratāḥ kecidapare bhaktibhāginaḥ
verses.translation: Five Dharmas have been proclaimed by Rudra in the Puranas. They are called Mahesvarya 1 (Yoga of Mahesvara) by the Rudras of unimpaired activities.
verses.hindi: + धनुश्चिह्वान्तर्गतग्न॑ंथो ड. पुस्तके नास्ति  +इदम्ध नास्ति घ॒पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Five Dharmas have been proclaimed by Rudra in the Puranas. They are called Mahesvarya 1 (Yoga of Mahesvara) by the Rudras of unimpaired activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Five Dharmas have been proclaimed by Rudra in the Puranas. They are called Mahesvarya 1 (Yoga of Mahesvara) by the Rudras of unimpaired activities.

verses.sanskrit: वैष्णवज्ञानम् आसाद्य केचिच्छैवं व्रतं तथा । एकरात्रं द्विरात्रं च केचित्षष्ठाहभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: vaiṣṇavajñānam āsādya kecicchaivaṃ vrataṃ tathā / ekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ ca kecitṣaṣṭhāhabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: These Dharmas are practised by Adityas, Vasus, Sadhyas, and Asvins, so also by all Maruts, Bhfgus, heaven- dwellers of whom Yama, Indra are prominent and by Pitrs, Kala, Mrtyu and many others.
verses.hindi: परुआं सहस्नमन्यत्त मिथुनानां ससज हु। उद्रिक्तास्तमलसा सब निःश्नीका छाल्पतेजसः
verses.wordMeaning: These Dharmas are practised by Adityas, Vasus, Sadhyas, and Asvins, so also by all Maruts, Bhfgus, heaven- dwellers of whom Yama, Indra are prominent and by Pitrs, Kala, Mrtyu and many others.
verses.commentary: Sense: These Dharmas are practised by Adityas, Vasus, Sadhyas, and Asvins, so also by all Maruts, Bhfgus, heaven- dwellers of whom Yama, Indra are prominent and by Pitrs, Kala, Mrtyu and many others.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणविधानैश्च कृच्छ्रिणश्चातिकृच्छ्रिणः । एवंविधैस्तपोभिश्च नर्मदातीरशोभितैः
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇavidhānaiśca kṛcchriṇaścātikṛcchriṇaḥ / evaṃvidhaistapobhiśca narmadātīraśobhitaiḥ
verses.translation: The groups of sages, pure as the sky in the autumn, with all their Karmans exhausted, practise these after uniting the (individual) self with the (cosmic) self.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रभ्भति कल्पेडस्मिन्मिथुनोत्पक्तिरुव्यते । मासे(सि)मासे(स्या)त॑वं॑ यद्यत्तत्तदासीद्धि ह योषिताम
verses.wordMeaning: The groups of sages, pure as the sky in the autumn, with all their Karmans exhausted, practise these after uniting the (individual) self with the (cosmic) self.
verses.commentary: Sense: The groups of sages, pure as the sky in the autumn, with all their Karmans exhausted, practise these after uniting the (individual) self with the (cosmic) self.

verses.sanskrit: यजद्भिः शंकरं देवं केशवं भाति नित्यदा । एकत्वे च पृथक्त्वे च यजतां च महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yajadbhiḥ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ keśavaṃ bhāti nityadā / ekatve ca pṛthaktve ca yajatāṃ ca maheśvaram
verses.translation: Engaged in what is wholesome and pleasing to the preceptors, and desirous of achieving what is pleasing to their preceptor, they sport about like Devas, after giving up (i.e. completing their span of) human life.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्तदा न सुषुवुः सेवितैरपि मैथुनैः। आयुषोउन्ते प्रसूयन्ते मिथुनान्येव ते सकछत्
verses.wordMeaning: Engaged in what is wholesome and pleasing to the preceptors, and desirous of achieving what is pleasing to their preceptor, they sport about like Devas, after giving up (i.e. completing their span of) human life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Engaged in what is wholesome and pleasing to the preceptors, and desirous of achieving what is pleasing to their preceptor, they sport about like Devas, after giving up (i.e. completing their span of) human life.

verses.sanskrit: कलौ युगे महाघोरे प्राप्ताः सिद्धिमनुत्तमाम् । यस्य यस्य हि या भक्तिर्विज्ञानं यस्य यादृशम्
verses.transliteration: kalau yuge mahāghore prāptāḥ siddhimanuttamām / yasya yasya hi yā bhaktirvijñānaṃ yasya yādṛśam
verses.translation: Please know in the serial order as they are being narrated, the five eternal Dharmas ordained by the great lord.
verses.hindi: '(कुटकाः कुविकाश्चैव उत्पयन्ते मुसूर्षिताः  ततः प्रभुति कल्पे5स्मिन्मिथुनानां हि सभवः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Please know in the serial order as they are being narrated, the five eternal Dharmas ordained by the great lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Please know in the serial order as they are being narrated, the five eternal Dharmas ordained by the great lord.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्यस्मिंश्च देवे तु तांतामीशो ऽददात्प्रभुः । स्वभावैकतया भक्त्या तामेत्यान्तः प्रलीयते
verses.transliteration: yasminyasmiṃśca deve tu tāṃtāmīśo 'dadātprabhuḥ / svabhāvaikatayā bhaktyā tāmetyāntaḥ pralīyate
verses.translation: I shall expound, in their particular order, their charac¬ teristics, causes and principles as explained by Rudra.
verses.hindi: सरित्सरः समुद्रांश्ध सेवन्ते पर्वतानपि। तदा नात्यम्बुशीतोष्णा युगे तस्मिम्घरबन्ति वे
verses.wordMeaning: I shall expound, in their particular order, their charac¬ teristics, causes and principles as explained by Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall expound, in their particular order, their charac¬ teristics, causes and principles as explained by Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: संसारे परिवर्तन्ते ये पृथग्भाजिनो नराः । ये महावृक्षमीशानं त्यक्त्वा शाखावलम्बिनः
verses.transliteration: saṃsāre parivartante ye pṛthagbhājino narāḥ / ye mahāvṛkṣamīśānaṃ tyaktvā śākhāvalambinaḥ
verses.translation: The restraining of the speed (span?) of vital breath is also called Pranayama. It is of three kinds: Manda (slow), Madhya (middling) and Uttama (excellent).
verses.hindi: स्त्री बुद्धिमान और सतोगुणी हुये ।३७। वक्षस्थल से दूसरे एक हजार पुरुष स्त्री के जोड़े उत्पन्न किये। वे सभी रजोगुण की अधिकता से तेजस्वी और तेजविहीन दोनों प्रकार के थे ।३८। पुनः अपने उरू से अन्य एक हजार जोड़ों को उत्पन्न किया जो रज और तम दोनों कीं अधिकता से कामुक हुये ।३६। अपने चरणों से जिन हजार जोड़ों को उत्पन्न किया वे केवल तमोगुण की अधिकता के कारण तामसी, श्रीहीन और अल्प तेज वाले थे
verses.wordMeaning: The restraining of the speed (span?) of vital breath is also called Pranayama. It is of three kinds: Manda (slow), Madhya (middling) and Uttama (excellent).
verses.commentary: Sense: The restraining of the speed (span?) of vital breath is also called Pranayama. It is of three kinds: Manda (slow), Madhya (middling) and Uttama (excellent).

verses.sanskrit: पुनरावर्तमानास्ते जायन्ते हि चतुर्युगे । देवान्ते स्थावरान्ते च संसारे चाभ्रमन्क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: punarāvartamānāste jāyante hi caturyuge / devānte sthāvarānte ca saṃsāre cābhramankramāt
verses.translation: Controlling the vital breath is termed Pranayama. The
verses.hindi: वे मिथुन प्राणी एक दूसरे के प्रेम से आक्रृष्ट होकर मैथुन कर्म में प्रवृत्त हुए। इस कल्प में उसी समय से मंथुन- सृष्टि आरम्भ हुई  उस समय स्त्रियों को प्रतिमास रजोददांत नहीं होता था अतः मैथुन करने पर भी उनको सन्‍्तान नहीं होते थे ।४१-४२३। वे एक बार ही जीवन के अन्तिम भाग में एक बालक और बालिका को जनती थी ।४३। वे क्षुद्र और कुविक (१) मरणशील थे । उस समय से ही इस कल्प में मैथुनसृष्टि की उत्पत्ति हुई
verses.wordMeaning: Controlling the vital breath is termed Pranayama. The
verses.commentary: Sense: Controlling the vital breath is termed Pranayama. The

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्जन्म पुनः स्वर्गे पुनर्घोरे च रौरवे । ये पुनर्देवमीशानं भवं भक्तिसुसंस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: punarjanma punaḥ svarge punarghore ca raurave / ye punardevamīśānaṃ bhavaṃ bhaktisusaṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: Yoga of Mahesvara consisting of five Dharmas is a discussion on Yoga. The five Dharmas enumerated in vv. 70-71 below are the main stages in Patanjala Yoga, viz. Pranayama, Dhyana, Pratyahara, Dharariaand the only Saiva addition is Smarana while Patanjali's last stage Samadhi is droppod.
verses.hindi: उन प्रजाओं को मन से ध्यान करने पर (विचार करने पर) एक बार प्रत्येक को पंच लक्षण शुद्ध दब्द आदि
verses.wordMeaning: Yoga of Mahesvara consisting of five Dharmas is a discussion on Yoga. The five Dharmas enumerated in vv. 70-71 below are the main stages in Patanjala Yoga, viz. Pranayama, Dhyana, Pratyahara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Yoga of Mahesvara consisting of five Dharmas is a discussion on Yoga. The five Dharmas enumerated in vv. 70-71 below are the main stages in Patanjala Yoga, viz. Pranayama, Dhyana, Pratyahara,…

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ति नर्मदातीरे न पुनस्ते भवन्ति च । आ देहपतनात् केचिद् उपासन्तः परं गताः
verses.transliteration: yajanti narmadātīre na punaste bhavanti ca / ā dehapatanāt kecid upāsantaḥ paraṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: The Manda Pranayama has one stroke of twelve moments. The Madhya Pranayama has two strokes and has the span of twenty-four matras.
verses.hindi: जिससे यह जगत परिपूर्ण हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: The Manda Pranayama has one stroke of twelve moments. The Madhya Pranayama has two strokes and has the span of twenty-four matras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Manda Pranayama has one stroke of twelve moments. The Madhya Pranayama has two strokes and has the span of twenty-four matras.

verses.sanskrit: केचिद्द्वादशभिर्वर्षैः षड्भरन्ये तपोधनाः । त्रिभिः संवत्सरैः केचित्केचित्संवत्सरेण तु
verses.transliteration: keciddvādaśabhirvarṣaiḥ ṣaḍbharanye tapodhanāḥ / tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ kecitkecitsaṃvatsareṇa tu
verses.translation: The Uttama Pranayama has three strokes and the matras are thirty-six. This excellent Pranayama produces sweat, shiver- ing, languor and exhaustion.
verses.hindi: उस समय उस कृतयुग के आरम्भ काल में वे मानव नदी, सरोवर, समुद्र और पव॑तों के समीप रहते थे, उनको अधिक शीत और गर्मी से पीड़ा नहीं होती थी, वे इच्छानुसार इधर-उधर घूमते रहते थे ।/४७। उनको
verses.wordMeaning: The Uttama Pranayama has three strokes and the matras are thirty-six. This excellent Pranayama produces sweat, shiver- ing, languor and exhaustion.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Uttama Pranayama has three strokes and the matras are thirty-six. This excellent Pranayama produces sweat, shiver- ing, languor and exhaustion.

verses.sanskrit: षड्भिर्मासैस्तु संसिद्धास् त्रिभिर् मासैस् तथापरे । मुनयो देवमाश्रित्य नर्मदां च यशस्विनीम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍbhirmāsaistu saṃsiddhās tribhir māsais tathāpare / munayo devamāśritya narmadāṃ ca yaśasvinīm
verses.translation: Thus the three characteristics of Pranayama have been explained. Now listen to their span and other characteristics briefly.
verses.hindi: धनुविचह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थः ग. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the three characteristics of Pranayama have been explained. Now listen to their span and other characteristics briefly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the three characteristics of Pranayama have been explained. Now listen to their span and other characteristics briefly.

verses.sanskrit: छित्त्वा संसारदोषांश्च अगमन्ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् । एवं कलियुगे घोरे शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: chittvā saṃsāradoṣāṃśca agamanbrahma śāśvatam / evaṃ kaliyuge ghore śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: A lion or an elephant or any other wild animal of the forest on being captured and tamed becomes mild and quiet.
verses.hindi: भ्र्द वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: A lion or an elephant or any other wild animal of the forest on being captured and tamed becomes mild and quiet.
verses.commentary: Sense: A lion or an elephant or any other wild animal of the forest on being captured and tamed becomes mild and quiet.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातीरमाश्रित्य मुनयो रुद्रमाविशन्
verses.transliteration: narmadātīramāśritya munayo rudramāviśan
verses.translation: Similarly though the vital breath is difficult to be con¬ trolled in case of non-self-possessed persons, it can be controlled by practice of Yoga if done regularly.
verses.hindi: +पृथ्वी रसोरूच॑ नाम आहार छ्ाहरन्ति वै। ताः प्रजा; कामचारिण्यो मानसी सिद्धिमास्थिताः धर्माधर्मों न तास्वास्तां (+निविशेषाः प्रजास्तु ताः। त॒ल्यमायुः खु्ख॑ रूप॑ ताखां तस्मिन्कृते
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly though the vital breath is difficult to be con¬ trolled in case of non-self-possessed persons, it can be controlled by practice of Yoga if done regularly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly though the vital breath is difficult to be con¬ trolled in case of non-self-possessed persons, it can be controlled by practice of Yoga if done regularly.

verses.sanskrit: ये नर्मदातीरमुपेत्य विप्राः शैवे व्रते यत्नम् उपप्रपन्नाः । त्रिकालम् अम्भः प्रविगाह्य भक्त्या देवं समभ्यर्च्य शिवं व्रजन्ति
verses.transliteration: ye narmadātīramupetya viprāḥ śaive vrate yatnam upaprapannāḥ / trikālam ambhaḥ pravigāhya bhaktyā devaṃ samabhyarcya śivaṃ vrajanti
verses.translation: Just as a (captured) lion or an elephant becomes powerless and tamed by disciplining and lapse of time, similarly by placing the mind with the Manda (slow) type of Pranayama, it comes under control. Similarly the wind (life-breath) lives by being placed under mind-god (?).
verses.hindi: धर्माधर्मों न तास्वास्तां) कल्पादौ त छृते युगे । स्वेन स्वेनाधिकारेण जशिरे ते छते युगे
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a (captured) lion or an elephant becomes powerless and tamed by disciplining and lapse of time, similarly by placing the mind with the Manda (slow) type of Pranayama, it comes under control. Similarly the wind (life-breath) lives by being placed under mind-god (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a (captured) lion or an elephant becomes powerless and tamed by disciplining and lapse of time, similarly by placing the mind with the Manda (slow) type of Pranayama, it comes under control. Similarly the wind (life-breath) lives by being placed under mind-god (?).

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानार्चनैर्जाप्यमहाव्रतैश्च नारायणं वा सततं स्मरन्ति । ते धौतपाण्डुरपटा इव राजहंसाः संसारसागरजलस्य तरन्ति पारम्
verses.transliteration: dhyānārcanairjāpyamahāvrataiśca nārāyaṇaṃ vā satataṃ smaranti / te dhautapāṇḍurapaṭā iva rājahaṃsāḥ saṃsārasāgarajalasya taranti pāram
verses.translation: Just as the life-breath comes under control by resorting to Yoga, similarly he can take the life-breath wherever he pleases.
verses.hindi: पवतोद्धिसेविन्यों छानिकेताश्रयस्तु ताः। घिशोकाः सत्त्वबहुला प्रकान्तरुखित प्रजाः
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the life-breath comes under control by resorting to Yoga, similarly he can take the life-breath wherever he pleases.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the life-breath comes under control by resorting to Yoga, similarly he can take the life-breath wherever he pleases.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यमुत्क्षिप्य भुजम् उच्यते । इदमेकं सुनिष्पन्नं ध्येयो नारायणः सदा
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamutkṣipya bhujam ucyate / idamekaṃ suniṣpannaṃ dhyeyo nārāyaṇaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Just as a lion or elephant which comes under control provides protection to men from other animals;
verses.hindi: ता वै निकामचारिण्यो नित्य मुद्तिमानसाः  पशच:ः पक्षिणश्चेव न तदा55सनन्‍्स रीस्ूपाः
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a lion or elephant which comes under control provides protection to men from other animals;
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a lion or elephant which comes under control provides protection to men from other animals;

verses.sanskrit: यो वा हरं पूजयते जितात्मा मासं च पक्षं च वसेन्नरेन्द्र । रेवां समाश्रित्य महानुभावः स देवदेवो ऽथ भवेत्पिनाकी
verses.transliteration: yo vā haraṃ pūjayate jitātmā māsaṃ ca pakṣaṃ ca vasennarendra / revāṃ samāśritya mahānubhāvaḥ sa devadevo 'tha bhavetpinākī
verses.translation: Just as (so? ) the wind which blows in all directions, if controlled within the body by meditation, destroys all sins in the body.
verses.hindi: नोद्धिजा नारकाश्चेव ते छाथमेप्रसुतयः॥ न मसूलफलपुष्पं च नाउडतवम्॒तवों न च
verses.wordMeaning: Just as (so? ) the wind which blows in all directions, if controlled within the body by meditation, destroys all sins in the body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as (so? ) the wind which blows in all directions, if controlled within the body by meditation, destroys all sins in the body.

verses.sanskrit: कीटाः पतंगाश्च पिपीलिकाश्च ये वै म्रियन्ते ऽम्भसि नर्मदायाः । ते दिव्यरूपास्तु कुलप्रसूताः शतं समा धर्मपरा भवन्ति
verses.transliteration: kīṭāḥ pataṃgāśca pipīlikāśca ye vai mriyante 'mbhasi narmadāyāḥ / te divyarūpāstu kulaprasūtāḥ śataṃ samā dharmaparā bhavanti
verses.translation: All the blemishes of the Brahmana who is self-controlled and engaged in Pranayama perish. He becomes stable in the Sattva Guna.
verses.hindi: सर्वकामखुखः कालो नात्यथ ह्यष्णशीतता। (2(मनोमिलषिताः कामास्तासां सर्वत्र सबंदा ॥ उत्तिष्ठन्ति पृथिव्यां बै ताभिध्यांता रखोत्थिताः) । बलवर्णकरी तासां सिद्धि: सा रोगनाशिनी
verses.wordMeaning: All the blemishes of the Brahmana who is self-controlled and engaged in Pranayama perish. He becomes stable in the Sattva Guna.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the blemishes of the Brahmana who is self-controlled and engaged in Pranayama perish. He becomes stable in the Sattva Guna.

verses.sanskrit: कालेन वृक्षाः प्रपतन्ति ये ऽपि महातरंगौघनिकृत्तमूलाः । ते नर्मदांभोभिरपास्तपापा देदीप्यमानास्त्रिदिवं प्रयान्ति
verses.transliteration: kālena vṛkṣāḥ prapatanti ye 'pi mahātaraṃgaughanikṛttamūlāḥ / te narmadāṃbhobhirapāstapāpā dedīpyamānāstridivaṃ prayānti
verses.translation: Pranayama is equal to all the penances performed and performance of (all) holy rites and observances, and the fruits accorded by all sacrifices.
verses.hindi: पृथिवी से उत्पन्न वनस्पितियों या फल-मूल को खाते थे । उनको मानसिक सिद्धि प्राप्त थी और वे कामचारी थे ।४८। उनको धर्म अधर्म का विचार न था, कोई भेदभाव भी न था। उस कृत युग में वे आयु, रूप और सुखानुभूति में समान थे ।४६। कल्प के आदि में कृत युग में धर्म और अधर्म का विचार न था । लोग कृतयुग में अपने-अपने कर्मानुसार उत्पन्न होते थे (५०। उस कृत युग का वर्ष प्रमाण चार हजार दिव्य वर्ष है और संध्या
verses.wordMeaning: Pranayama is equal to all the penances performed and performance of (all) holy rites and observances, and the fruits accorded by all sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pranayama is equal to all the penances performed and performance of (all) holy rites and observances, and the fruits accorded by all sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: अकामकामाश्च तथा सकामा रेवान्तम् आश्रित्य म्रियन्ति तीरे । जडान्धमूकास् त्रिदिवं प्रयान्ति किमत्र विप्रा भवभावयुक्ताः
verses.transliteration: akāmakāmāśca tathā sakāmā revāntam āśritya mriyanti tīre / jaḍāndhamūkās tridivaṃ prayānti kimatra viprā bhavabhāvayuktāḥ
verses.translation: Pranayama is equal to the penance arid observance of the holy rite of drinking a drop of water from the tip of Kus'a grass once in a month and continuing it for a hundred years.
verses.hindi: तथा सन्ध्यांश का प्रमाण चार सौ वर्ष है ।५१। यद्यपि उस समय प्रजायें हजारों की संख्या में थीं तथापि उनमें किसी प्रकार का संघर्ष,प्रतिद्वष्द्षिता ओर क्रम का प्रश्न नहीं था ।१२। वे तो पबं॑तों और समुद्रों के निकट बसते थे। उनका कोई स्थायी घर भी नहीं था, वे एकान्त सुखी, शोक रहित और सतोगुणी थे ।१३॥ अपनी इच्छा के अनुसार इधर उधर घूमते और सरब्वदा प्रसन्न रहते थे, उस समय पशु, पक्षी, सरिसृप (रेंग कर चलने वाले)
verses.wordMeaning: Pranayama is equal to the penance arid observance of the holy rite of drinking a drop of water from the tip of Kus'a grass once in a month and continuing it for a hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pranayama is equal to the penance arid observance of the holy rite of drinking a drop of water from the tip of Kus'a grass once in a month and continuing it for a hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: मासोपवासैरपि शोषिताङ्गा न तां गतिं यान्ति विमुक्तदेहाः । म्रियन्ति रेवाजलपूतकायाः शिवार्चने केशवभावयुक्ताः
verses.transliteration: māsopavāsairapi śoṣitāṅgā na tāṃ gatiṃ yānti vimuktadehāḥ / mriyanti revājalapūtakāyāḥ śivārcane keśavabhāvayuktāḥ
verses.translation: One should burn off defects of the body through Prana *- yama, sins through Dharana, the sensual objects through Pratyd - hdra and ungodly qualities through Dhydna.
verses.hindi: आदि जीव नहीं थे ।५४ नव तो उस समय अधममम करने वाले कोई नारकीय जीव थे और न कोई उद्भिज्ज पदार्थ ही थे। मूल, फल, पुष्प का उस समय अभाव था (ये उपजाये नहीं जाते थे) ।५५॥ ऋतु और ऋतु संबन्धी परिवत्तन आदि भी नहीं थे, उनके लिये प्रत्येक क्षण सुखदाई थे, अति शीत और असह्य आतप नहीं था ।५६। उनको सवंत्र सबंदा अभीष्ट पदार्थ श्राप्त थे, उनकी इच्छा मात्र से पृथ्वी से रसमय पदार्थ मिल
verses.wordMeaning: One should burn off defects of the body through Prana *- yama, sins through Dharana, the sensual objects through Pratyd - hdra and ungodly qualities through Dhydna.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should burn off defects of the body through Prana *- yama, sins through Dharana, the sensual objects through Pratyd - hdra and ungodly qualities through Dhydna.

verses.sanskrit: नीवारश्यामाकयवेङ्गुदाद्यैर् अन्यैर् मुनीन्द्रा इह वर्तयन्ति । आप्रित्य कूलं त्रिदशानुगीतं ते नर्मदाया न विशन्ति मृत्युम्
verses.transliteration: nīvāraśyāmākayaveṅgudādyair anyair munīndrā iha vartayanti / āpritya kūlaṃ tridaśānugītaṃ te narmadāyā na viśanti mṛtyum
verses.translation: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: जाते थे । उनको बल और रूप को बढ़ाने वाली रोगनाशक ओषधियाँ प्राप्त थीं
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमन्ति ये तीरमुपेत्य देव्यास् त्रिकालदेवार्चनसत्यपूताः । विण्मूत्रचर्मास्थितिरोपधानाः कुक्षौ युवत्या न वसन्ति भूयः
verses.transliteration: bhramanti ye tīramupetya devyās trikāladevārcanasatyapūtāḥ / viṇmūtracarmāsthitiropadhānāḥ kukṣau yuvatyā na vasanti bhūyaḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: + इदमर्ध नास्ति ड. पुस्तके । + धनुश्चिल्लान्तगंतग्रन्यः ख. घ. पुस्तकयोर्नास्ति ।  घनुदचिह्वान्तगंत- ग्रन्थ: ख. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: किं यज्ञदानैर्बहुभिश्च तेषां निषेवितैस्तीर्थवरैः समस्तैः । रेवातटं दक्षिणमुत्तरं वा सेवन्ति ते रुद्रचरानुपूर्वम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ yajñadānairbahubhiśca teṣāṃ niṣevitaistīrthavaraiḥ samastaiḥ / revātaṭaṃ dakṣiṇamuttaraṃ vā sevanti te rudracarānupūrvam
verses.translation: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: अंसस्कायें: शरीरेश्च प्रशास्ताः स्थिरयौवनाः  तासां विशुद्धात्सकट्पाज्ञायन्ते मिथुना। प्रजा;
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: ते वञ्चिताः पङ्गुजडान्धभूता लोकेषु मर्त्याः पशुभिश्च तुल्याः । ये नाश्रिता रुद्रशरीरभूतां सोपानपङ्क्तिं त्रिदिवस्य रेवाम्
verses.transliteration: te vañcitāḥ paṅgujaḍāndhabhūtā lokeṣu martyāḥ paśubhiśca tulyāḥ / ye nāśritā rudraśarīrabhūtāṃ sopānapaṅktiṃ tridivasya revām
verses.translation: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: अप्रबृत्ति: कृतयुगे कर्मणोः शुभपापयोः  बणांश्रमव्यवस्थाश्न न तदाउउखन्न सकरः
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: युगं कलिं घोरमिमं य इच्छेद्द्रष्टुं कदाचिन्न पुनर् द्विजेन्द्रः । स नर्मदातीरमुपेत्य सर्वं सम्पूजयेत् सर्वविमुक्तसंगः
verses.transliteration: yugaṃ kaliṃ ghoramimaṃ ya iccheddraṣṭuṃ kadācinna punar dvijendraḥ / sa narmadātīramupetya sarvaṃ sampūjayet sarvavimuktasaṃgaḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: 'खुखप्राया ्मशोकाश्व उत्पयन्ते ऋते युगे। नित्यप्रहष्ममनसो महासरवा मह्ाबला:।
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: विघ्नैर् अनेकैर् अतियोज्यमाना ये तीरम् उझन्ति न नर्मदायाः । ते चैव सर्वस्य हितार्थभूता वन्द्याश्च ते सर्वजनस्य मान्याः
verses.transliteration: vighnair anekair atiyojyamānā ye tīram ujhanti na narmadāyāḥ / te caiva sarvasya hitārthabhūtā vandyāśca te sarvajanasya mānyāḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: प्रवृत्त द्वापरे यज्ञ(ज्ो) दान॑ कलियुगे वरम् । सरव॑ छत रजस्त्रेता द्वापर तु रजस्तमौो
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वत्रिगार्गेयवशिष्ठकङ्काः शतैः समेतैर् नियतास् त्वसंख्यैः । सिद्धिं परां ते हि जलप्लुताङ्गाः प्राप्तास्तु लोकान्मरुतां न चान्ये
verses.transliteration: bhṛgvatrigārgeyavaśiṣṭhakaṅkāḥ śataiḥ sametair niyatās tvasaṃkhyaiḥ / siddhiṃ parāṃ te hi jalaplutāṅgāḥ prāptāstu lokānmarutāṃ na cānye
verses.translation: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: कलौ तमस्त विज्ञेयं युगवृत्तवशेन तु।कालः छते युगे त्वेष तस्य संख्या निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं महत्पुण्यतमं पवित्रं पठन्त्यदो नित्यविशुद्धसत्त्वाः । गतिं परां यान्ति महानुभावा रुद्रस्य वाक्यं हि यथा प्रमाणम्
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ mahatpuṇyatamaṃ pavitraṃ paṭhantyado nityaviśuddhasattvāḥ / gatiṃ parāṃ yānti mahānubhāvā rudrasya vākyaṃ hi yathā pramāṇam
verses.translation: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: यद्यपि वे अपने ,शरीर का संस्कार (स्तान आदि) आदि नहीं करते थे तथापि वे स्थिर यौवन थे। उनके शुद्ध संकल्प से ही मिथुनप्रजा (सन्तति) उत्पन्न हो जाती थी ।५५। वे जन्म और रूप में समान थे मृत्यु भी साथ ही होती थी। उस समय सत्य, अलोभ, क्षमा, तुष्टि, सुख ओर संयम का ही प्रचार था
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, a practising Yogin should always be engaged in Pranayama. After purifying himself of all sins, he will attain the supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये नर्मदास्नानफलश्रुतिकथनं नाम दशमोऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ११ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: अहो महत्पुण्यतमा विशिष्टा क्षयं न याता इह या युगान्ते । तस्मात्सदा सेव्यतमा मुनीन्द्रैर् ध्यानार्चनस्नानपरायणैश्च
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye narmadāsnānaphalaśrutikathanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 11 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: aho mahatpuṇyatamā viśiṣṭā kṣayaṃ na yātā iha yā yugānte / tasmātsadā sevyatamā munīndrair dhyānārcanasnānaparāyaṇaiśca
verses.translation: Sages of noble souls observe with divine vision and worship the vital breath [Prana) by establishing themselves in penance, whether it be for a great day or a day and night or a fortnight, or a month or six months or a year or a Yuga or thousands of great Yugas.
verses.hindi: इनके रूप, आयु, शीत और चेष्ठाओं में पार्थकय या विशेषता नहीं थी। प्रजाओं के व्यापार ओर व्यवहार स्वाभाविक होते थे बुद्धिपुबक नहीं ।६०। कृत युग में शुभ और अशुभ कर्मों में प्रजा की श्रवृत्ति नहीं थी क्योंकि शुभ अशुभ का विभाग था ही नहों। उस समय वर्णाश्रम व्यवस्था न थी, न तो संकर दोष ही था ।६१। वे परस्पर अकाम और अनिच्छा पूर्वक व्यवहार करते थे । रूप, आयु में सभी तुल्य थे, उत्तम अधम
verses.wordMeaning: Sages of noble souls observe with divine vision and worship the vital breath [Prana) by establishing themselves in penance, whether it be for a great day or a day and night or a fortnight, or a month or six months or a year or a Yuga or thousands of great Yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages of noble souls observe with divine vision and worship the vital breath [Prana) by establishing themselves in penance, whether it be for a great day or a day and night or a fortnight, or a month or six months or a year or a Yuga or thousands of great Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: यामाश्रित्य गता मोक्षमृषयो धर्मवत्सलाः । ये त्वयोक्तास्तु नियमा ऋषीणां वेदनिर्मिताः
verses.transliteration: yāmāśritya gatā mokṣamṛṣayo dharmavatsalāḥ / ye tvayoktāstu niyamā ṛṣīṇāṃ vedanirmitāḥ
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shall explain the purpose and particularly the benefit of Pranayama as expounded by the Lord. 2
verses.hindi: का प्रश्न नहीं था, उस युग में तो सभी सुखी, विशोक, सदा प्रसंन्न, महासत्व ओर महाबलवान् थे
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, I shall explain the purpose and particularly the benefit of Pranayama as expounded by the Lord. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, I shall explain the purpose and particularly the benefit of Pranayama as expounded by the Lord. 2

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षावाप्तिर्भवेद्येषां नियमैश्च पृथग्विधैः । दशद्वादशभिर्वापि षड्भिरष्टाभिर् एव वा
verses.transliteration: mokṣāvāptirbhavedyeṣāṃ niyamaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ / daśadvādaśabhirvāpi ṣaḍbhiraṣṭābhir eva vā
verses.translation: Know that the objectives of Pranayama are four: §dnti y PraSantiy Prasada and Dipti (each term is explained in the following verses).
verses.hindi: उनमें लाभ-अलाभ, मित्र-अमिन्न, प्रिय-अप्रिय के व्यवहार न थे, वे निरीह थे और मन की प्राकृतिक प्रेरणा से ही :विषयों में प्रवत्त होते थे। एक दूसरे के प्र/ते किसी की. कोई इच्छा, स्वार्थ न था, नतो परस्पर के अनुग्रह की आवश्यकता थी। तयुग में ध्यान का ही महत्व है, त्रेता में ज्ञान, द्वापर में यज्ञ और कलि में दान ही श्रेष्ठ समझा जाता है ।६४-६ ९ ३। युगानुरूप क्ृतयुग में सतोगुण, द्वापर में रज और तम
verses.wordMeaning: Know that the objectives of Pranayama are four: §dnti y PraSantiy Prasada and Dipti (each term is explained in the following verses).
verses.commentary: Sense: Know that the objectives of Pranayama are four: §dnti y PraSantiy Prasada and Dipti (each term is explained in the following verses).

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिस्तथा चतुर्भिर्वा वर्षैर्मासैस्तथैव च । मुच्यन्ते कलिदोषैस्ते देवेशानसमर्चनात्
verses.transliteration: tribhistathā caturbhirvā varṣairmāsaistathaiva ca / mucyante kalidoṣaiste deveśānasamarcanāt
verses.translation: Actions whether terrible in form or auspicious in nature, if performed by oneself, do bear fruits here and hereafter in due course.
verses.hindi: और कलियुग में केवल तम की प्रधानता रहती है। कृतयुग का जो काल परिमाण है उसको सुनो ।६६-६७! चार हजार दिव्य वर्षों का कृतयुग है उसकी संध्या और संध्याशं का परिमाण आठ सो दिव्यवर्ष हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Actions whether terrible in form or auspicious in nature, if performed by oneself, do bear fruits here and hereafter in due course.
verses.commentary: Sense: Actions whether terrible in form or auspicious in nature, if performed by oneself, do bear fruits here and hereafter in due course.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं वा सुरश्रेष्ठ केशवं वा जगद्गुरुम् । अर्चयन्पापमखिलं जहात्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ vā suraśreṣṭha keśavaṃ vā jagadgurum / arcayanpāpamakhilaṃ jahātyeva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: But the quelling of evils and sins committed by parents, cousins or other relatives or a mixture of both is called Santi.
verses.hindi: उस युग में प्रजाओं की मृत्यु, क्लेश और विपत्तियों की आशंका नहीं । तदनन्तर उस इतथुग में संध्यांश काल के
verses.wordMeaning: But the quelling of evils and sins committed by parents, cousins or other relatives or a mixture of both is called Santi.
verses.commentary: Sense: But the quelling of evils and sins committed by parents, cousins or other relatives or a mixture of both is called Santi.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्विस्तरतः सर्वं कथयस्व ममानघ । यस्मिन्संसारगहने निमग्नाः सर्वजन्तवः । ते कथं त्रिदिवं प्राप्ता इति मे संशयो वद
verses.transliteration: etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha / yasminsaṃsāragahane nimagnāḥ sarvajantavaḥ / te kathaṃ tridivaṃ prāptā iti me saṃśayo vada
verses.translation: The present chapter is important as it throws a flood of light on the Pasupata Yoga as practised before the 10th cent. A.D. when the Va. P. came to be finally redacted.
verses.hindi: पादावशिष्टो भवति यगधर्मस्तु सर्चंशः  संध्यायाम्रप्यतीतायामन्तकाले युगसर्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: The present chapter is important as it throws a flood of light on the Pasupata Yoga as practised before the 10th cent. A.D. when the Va. P. came to be finally redacted.
verses.commentary: Sense: The present chapter is important as it throws a flood of light on the Pasupata Yoga as practised before the 10th cent. A.D. when the Va. P. came to be finally redacted.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: जन्मान्तरैरनेकैस्तु मानुष्यमुपलभ्यते । भक्तिरुत्पद्यते चात्र कथंचिदपि शङ्करे
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: janmāntarairanekaistu mānuṣyamupalabhyate / bhaktirutpadyate cātra kathaṃcidapi śaṅkare
verses.translation: Verses 3-11 describe the purpose or objectives of Pranayama, the first Dharma in this Yoga.
verses.hindi: सर्गादौ या मयाउष्टी त मानस्यो वै प्रकोतिताः। अष्ठी ताः क्रमयोगेन(ण) सिद्धयों यान्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 3-11 describe the purpose or objectives of Pranayama, the first Dharma in this Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 3-11 describe the purpose or objectives of Pranayama, the first Dharma in this Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थदानोपवासानां यज्ञैर्देवद्विजार्चनैः । अवाप्तिर्जायते पुंसां श्रद्धया परया नृप
verses.transliteration: tīrthadānopavāsānāṃ yajñairdevadvijārcanaiḥ / avāptirjāyate puṃsāṃ śraddhayā parayā nṛpa
verses.translation: The restraint of sins arising from covetousness is called Prafdnti. It is a form of penance that benefits both here and hereafter.
verses.hindi: वर्णाश्रभाचा रछृतः कर्मेसिद्धोऋवः स्मखतः। संध्या रुतस्य पादेन संध्यापादेन-चांशतः ७५ कतसंध्यांशका होते त्रींज्लीन्पादान्परस्परान् । हसन्ति युगधमस्ते तपः अ्रतबलायुचैः
verses.wordMeaning: The restraint of sins arising from covetousness is called Prafdnti. It is a form of penance that benefits both here and hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: The restraint of sins arising from covetousness is called Prafdnti. It is a form of penance that benefits both here and hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छ्रद्धा प्रकर्तव्या मानवैर्धर्मवत्सलैः । ईशो ऽपि श्रद्धया साध्यस्तेन श्रद्धा विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: tasmācchraddhā prakartavyā mānavairdharmavatsalaiḥ / īśo 'pi śraddhayā sādhyastena śraddhā viśiṣyate
verses.translation: Sages richly endowed with knowledge and perfect wisdom can reach the world of the sun, moon, planets and stars.
verses.hindi: प्रशश्यति तदा सिद्धि: कालयोगेन नान्यथा । तस्यां सिद्धों प्रनष्ठायामन्या सिद्धिरवर्तेत
verses.wordMeaning: Sages richly endowed with knowledge and perfect wisdom can reach the world of the sun, moon, planets and stars.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages richly endowed with knowledge and perfect wisdom can reach the world of the sun, moon, planets and stars.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा निष्फलं सर्वं श्रद्धाहीनं तु भारत । तस्मात् समाश्रयेद् भक्तिं रुद्रस्य परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: anyathā niṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ śraddhāhīnaṃ tu bhārata / tasmāt samāśrayed bhaktiṃ rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: To the enlightened, the vision of the past, present and future is possible. It is called Dipti. It is also a penance.
verses.hindi: बीत जाने पर उस समय का युगधर्म चौथाई शेष रह जाता है। इस प्रकार कृतयुग के बीत जाने पर उस युग की सिद्धि भी लुप्त हो गई ।६९-७१। उस मानसी सिद्धि के लुप्त हो जाने पर त्रेता ओर कृत युग के सन्धि-काल में दूसरी सिद्धि उत्पन्न हुई। मैंने सृष्टि के आरम्भ की जिन आठ भ्रकार की सिद्धियों को गिनाया है, वे आठों क्रमशः नष्ट हो जाती हैं। कल्प के आदि में कृतयुग में वह मानसी
verses.wordMeaning: To the enlightened, the vision of the past, present and future is possible. It is called Dipti. It is also a penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the enlightened, the vision of the past, present and future is possible. It is called Dipti. It is also a penance.

verses.sanskrit: तेषांहि सफलं जन्म येषां भक्तिरचञ्चला । सा चैव त्रिविधा भक्तिः सात्त्विकी राजसी तथा
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃhi saphalaṃ janma yeṣāṃ bhaktiracañcalā / sā caiva trividhā bhaktiḥ sāttvikī rājasī tathā
verses.translation: Thus the fourfold Prdndyama is the first Dharma. It should be known that it gives immediate fruit and results forth¬ with in composure (of mind).
verses.hindi: सिद्धि होती है। सब मन्वन्तरों में चारों युगों के विभाग के अनुसार वर्णाश्रम धर्म के आचार पालन के द्वारा कर्मों की सिद्धियाँ होती हैं। किन्तु युगशेष के साथ-ही-साथ वर्णाश्रमों के आधार ओर कमे- जन्य उनकी समस्त सिद्धियाँ भी विनष्ट हो जाती हैं। सत्य युग के सन्ध्याकाल में युगधर्म का एक पादु, सन्ध्यांशकाल में सन्ध्याकालीन धर्म का एक पाद् एवं त्रेता के प्रारम्भ में उस सन्ध्यांशकालीन
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the fourfold Prdndyama is the first Dharma. It should be known that it gives immediate fruit and results forth¬ with in composure (of mind).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the fourfold Prdndyama is the first Dharma. It should be known that it gives immediate fruit and results forth¬ with in composure (of mind).

verses.sanskrit: तामसी सर्वलोकस्य त्रिविधं च फलं लभेत् । ते कर्मफलसंयोगादावर्तन्ते पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: tāmasī sarvalokasya trividhaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet / te karmaphalasaṃyogādāvartante punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall explain the characteristics of Prdna- yama, the posture and the practice of Yoga precisely.
verses.hindi: धर्म का एक पाद नष्ट हो जाता है, इसी क्रम से तपस्या, शात्रज्ञान, बल और भायु भी क्षीण होती है। मुनिगण ! सत्ययुग और सन्ध्यांश के क्षीण हो जाने पर ज्ेता युग का प्रारम्भ होता है। जब प्रजाओं में युगादि कालीन वह सिद्धि नहीं रहती तब फिर उसमें दूसरी सिद्धि उत्पन्न होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth I shall explain the characteristics of Prdna- yama, the posture and the practice of Yoga precisely.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth I shall explain the characteristics of Prdna- yama, the posture and the practice of Yoga precisely.

verses.sanskrit: जन्मान्तरशतैस्तेषां ज्ञानिनां देवयाजिनाम् । देवत्रये भवेद्भक्तिः क्षयात्पापस्य कर्मणः
verses.transliteration: janmāntaraśataisteṣāṃ jñānināṃ devayājinām / devatraye bhavedbhaktiḥ kṣayātpāpasya karmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: One should utter the syllable Om at the outset and bow to the moon or the sun. Then he should sit in the postures of Svaslika or Ardhapadma. The 'two knees shall be level with each other or one knee should be slightly raised. He should sit com¬ fortably with firmness. The feet shall be brought closer. The mouth should be kept closed, the eyes half-closed, the chest raised forward. With the heels he should cover the scrotum and the penis; the head should be slightly raised, the neck be straightened. He should fix Iris gaze on the tip of his nose, and should not look elsewhere in any direction. He should cover Tamas by Rajas which he should envelop by Sattva. Then he should remain established in Sattva and practise Yoga with pure mind. He should then hold (control) the aggregate of his sense-organs and their objects, his mind and the five vital breaths. He shall then begin Pratydhara (withdrawing in himself these together).
verses.hindi: जल समूह की सूक्ष्मता विनष्ट हो जाती है और वह गजनकारी मेघ के रूप में परिणत हो जाता है,
verses.wordMeaning: One should utter the syllable Om at the outset and bow to the moon or the sun. Then he should sit in the postures of Svaslika or Ardhapadma. The 'two knees shall be level with each other or one knee should be slightly raised. He should sit com¬ fortably with firmness.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should utter the syllable Om at the outset and bow to the moon or the sun. Then he should sit in the postures of Svaslika or Ardhapadma. The 'two knees shall be level with each other or one knee should be slightly raised. He should sit com¬ fortably with firmness.…

verses.sanskrit: ईशानात्तु पुनर्मोक्षो जायते छिन्नसंशयः । ये पुनर्नर्मदातीरमाश्रित्य द्विजपुंगवाः
verses.transliteration: īśānāttu punarmokṣo jāyate chinnasaṃśayaḥ / ye punarnarmadātīramāśritya dvijapuṃgavāḥ
verses.translation: He who withdraws his passion and desires as the tortoise does its limbs, becomes delighted in the self. Fixed (established) in it, he sees the Self in his self. Filling the body with air and remaining pure within and without, he shall begin the withdrawal by the process of Yoga from the navel to the
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिह्वान्तर्गतग्रन्थों ग. पुस्तके नास्ति।
verses.wordMeaning: He who withdraws his passion and desires as the tortoise does its limbs, becomes delighted in the self. Fixed (established) in it, he sees the Self in his self. Filling the body with air and remaining pure within and without,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who withdraws his passion and desires as the tortoise does its limbs, becomes delighted in the self. Fixed (established) in it, he sees the Self in his self. Filling the body with air and remaining pure within and without,…

verses.sanskrit: त्रयीमार्गम् असन्दिग्धास्ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् । एकाग्रमनसो ये तु शङ्करं शिवमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: trayīmārgam asandigdhāste yānti paramāṃ gatim / ekāgramanaso ye tu śaṅkaraṃ śivamavyayam
verses.translation: All the defects (sins) of the Brahmana who is engaged in (i.e. practices) Pranayama and is self-controled are destroyed and he becomes established in Sattva.
verses.hindi: सकृंदेव तया वृष्ठद्या संयुक्‍ते पृथिवीतलले । प्रादुरासंस्तदा तासां वृक्षास्त गन से स्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: All the defects (sins) of the Brahmana who is engaged in (i.e. practices) Pranayama and is self-controled are destroyed and he becomes established in Sattva.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the defects (sins) of the Brahmana who is engaged in (i.e. practices) Pranayama and is self-controled are destroyed and he becomes established in Sattva.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयन्तीह निरताः क्षिप्रं सिध्यन्ति ते जनाः । कालेन महता सिद्धिर्जायते ऽन्यत्र देहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: arcayantīha niratāḥ kṣipraṃ sidhyanti te janāḥ / kālena mahatā siddhirjāyate 'nyatra dehinām
verses.translation: Thus, with due restriction in the diet a sage (observing silence) engaged in Pranayama, shall conquer Yogic stages and ascend higher and higher.
verses.hindi: ततः कालेन मद्ता तासामेव विपयेयात् । रागलोभमात्मकों भावस्तदा ह्याकस्मिको5भवत् ॥ यत्तक्ूवति नारीणां जीवितान्ते तदाउरतवम्। तदा तद्दे न भवति पुनयु गबलेन तु
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, with due restriction in the diet a sage (observing silence) engaged in Pranayama, shall conquer Yogic stages and ascend higher and higher.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, with due restriction in the diet a sage (observing silence) engaged in Pranayama, shall conquer Yogic stages and ascend higher and higher.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायाः पुनस्तीरे क्षिप्रं सिद्धिरवाप्यते । षड्भिर्वर्षैस्तु सिध्यन्ति ये तु सांख्यविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration: narmadāyāḥ punastīre kṣipraṃ siddhiravāpyate / ṣaḍbhirvarṣaistu sidhyanti ye tu sāṃkhyavido janāḥ
verses.translation: The great ground (i.e. stage) if not subdued (overcome) may generate many defects. It may increase delusion. Hence one cannot go to a higher stage unless the initial stage is over¬ come.
verses.hindi: ताखां पुनः भ्रवत्त॑ तु मासे मासे तदातंवम् । ततसस्‍्तेनैव योगेन वर्ततां मिथुने तदा ॥प८५ तासां तत्कालभावित्वान्मासि मास्युपगच्छताम्  अकाले हातंदोत्पत्तिगंर्भा त्पत्तिरजञायत ॥८दे विपयंयेण तासां त-तेन कालेन भाधिना। प्रणुश्यन्ति ततः सच चृक्षास्त ग्रहसस्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: The great ground (i.e. stage) if not subdued (overcome) may generate many defects. It may increase delusion. Hence one cannot go to a higher stage unless the initial stage is over¬ come.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great ground (i.e. stage) if not subdued (overcome) may generate many defects. It may increase delusion. Hence one cannot go to a higher stage unless the initial stage is over¬ come.

verses.sanskrit: वैष्णवा ज्ञानसम्पन्नास्ते ऽपि सिध्यन्ति चाग्रतः । सर्वयोगविदो ये च समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः
verses.transliteration: vaiṣṇavā jñānasampannāste 'pi sidhyanti cāgrataḥ / sarvayogavido ye ca samudramiva sindhavaḥ
verses.translation: Just as water is taken up by applying force through a pipe or mechanical device, so also the Yogin should drink in the wind with effort but conquering (without incurring) exhaustion.
verses.hindi: वेप्वेच जायते तासां गन्धवर्णरसान्वितम् । अमाक्षिक मद्दावीय पुटके पुटके मधु
verses.wordMeaning: Just as water is taken up by applying force through a pipe or mechanical device, so also the Yogin should drink in the wind with effort but conquering (without incurring) exhaustion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as water is taken up by applying force through a pipe or mechanical device, so also the Yogin should drink in the wind with effort but conquering (without incurring) exhaustion.

verses.sanskrit: एकीभवन्ति कल्पान्ते योगे माहेश्वरे गताः । सर्वेषामेव योगानां योगो माहेश्वरो वरः
verses.transliteration: ekībhavanti kalpānte yoge māheśvare gatāḥ / sarveṣāmeva yogānāṃ yogo māheśvaro varaḥ
verses.translation: The wind shall be retained gradually in the umbili¬ cus, in the heart, in the chest, in the throat, in the mouth, at the tip of the nose, in the eye, between the eyebrows and in the head. The retention of the breath a little above in the great lord is called Dharana. Since both the Prana and Apdna are obstructed, it is called Pranayama.
verses.hindi: पुनः कालान्तरेणव पुनर्लोभान्ुतास्तु ताः। वृश्वांस्तान्पर्य ग्रढब्त मधु वा माक्षिक बलात्ू
verses.wordMeaning: The wind shall be retained gradually in the umbili¬ cus, in the heart, in the chest, in the throat, in the mouth, at the tip of the nose, in the eye, between the eyebrows and in the head. The retention of the breath a little above in the great lord is called Dharana.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The wind shall be retained gradually in the umbili¬ cus, in the heart, in the chest, in the throat, in the mouth, at the tip of the nose, in the eye, between the eyebrows and in the head. The retention of the breath a little above in the great lord is called Dharana.…

verses.sanskrit: तमासाद्य विमुच्यन्ते ये ऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः । शिवमर्च्य नदीकूले जायन्ते ते न योनिषु
verses.transliteration: tamāsādya vimucyante ye 'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ / śivamarcya nadīkūle jāyante te na yoniṣu
verses.translation: It is the steadying of the mind that is called Dharana. The withdrawal from the sense-objects is Pratyahara.
verses.hindi: और वृष्टि की सृष्टि हो जाती है ॥५०। एक बार भी वृष्टि के हो जाने से प्रजाओं के वासस्थानों में वृक्षादि उग आते हैं। इससे प्रजाओं को विविध उपभोग प्राप्त हो जाते है। त्रेता युग की प्रथम अवस्था में प्रजाजन उसी से जीविका-निर्वाह करते हैं ।८१-५२। इसके बाद क्रम-क्रमसे उनके भावों में परिवर्तन होने लगता है। वे आकस्मिक राग और लोभ से आक्रान्त हो जाते हैं। सत्ययुग में स्त्रियों को आयु के शेषकाल में
verses.wordMeaning: It is the steadying of the mind that is called Dharana. The withdrawal from the sense-objects is Pratyahara.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the steadying of the mind that is called Dharana. The withdrawal from the sense-objects is Pratyahara.

verses.sanskrit: गतिरेषा दुरारोहा सर्वपापक्षयंकरी । मुच्यन्ते मङ्क्षु संसाराद्रेवामाश्रित्य जन्तवः
verses.transliteration: gatireṣā durārohā sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī / mucyante maṅkṣu saṃsārādrevāmāśritya jantavaḥ
verses.translation: If Sattva is not accomplished, the vision is not possible. If the Yoga is practised in a defective place or at the wrong time, the vision is not possible.
verses.hindi: ही गर्भ धारण करने की दाकिति उत्पन्न होती थी; किन्तु वह भाव युग प्रभाव से श्रेता में विलुप्त हो जाता है। इस युग में स्त्रियाँ प्रतिमास ऋतुमती होती हैं। सहवासकारी प्रजाओं के प्रतिमास॒ संगम करने से अकाल में ही गर्भात्पत्ति एवं आतंवोत्पत्ति होने लगती है । पुनः क्रमशः काल के परिवतेन-वश प्रजाओं के निवास में उगे हुए वृक्षादि विष्नट होने लगते हैं, इससे लोग विश्लान्त और व्याकुल चित्त होकर पहले
verses.wordMeaning: If Sattva is not accomplished, the vision is not possible. If the Yoga is practised in a defective place or at the wrong time, the vision is not possible.
verses.commentary: Sense: If Sattva is not accomplished, the vision is not possible. If the Yoga is practised in a defective place or at the wrong time, the vision is not possible.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्स्नायी भवेन्नित्यं तथा भस्मविलेपनः । नर्मदातीरमासाद्य क्षिप्रं सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsnāyī bhavennityaṃ tathā bhasmavilepanaḥ / narmadātīramāsādya kṣipraṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: A Yogi should not practice concentration near fire, in the forest, over a heap of dry leaves, in a place infested with
verses.hindi: का सिद्धि विषयक ध्यान करने लगते हैं। उनके सत्याभिध्यान के फल से फिर घरों में वृक्षादि उगने लगते । इस प्रकार वे उसी वृक्षों से वस्त्र, फल, आभरण एवम उत्तम् गन्ध वाला, देखने में सुन्दर, सरस और अत्यन्त वीर्यकारी अमाक्षिक मधु हरे पत्तों से प्राप्त करने लगे ।८३-६०। त्रतायुग में प्रजागण उसी के द्वारा सुख से जीवन व्यतीत करते थे । सभी उसी सिद्धि के द्वारा दृष्ट-पुष्ट और क्षोभरहित होकर कालयापन करते थे ।
verses.wordMeaning: A Yogi should not practice concentration near fire, in the forest, over a heap of dry leaves, in a place infested with
verses.commentary: Sense: A Yogi should not practice concentration near fire, in the forest, over a heap of dry leaves, in a place infested with

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकालं पूजयेच्छान्तो यो नरो लिङ्गम् आदरात् । सर्वरोगविनिर्मुक्तः स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: trikālaṃ pūjayecchānto yo naro liṅgam ādarāt / sarvarogavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: In spite of knowing decisively these faults, if a person inadvertently engages in the practice of Yoga, the three hum¬ ours in his body become deranged and put up obstacles in his path.
verses.hindi: फिर जब कालक्रम से प्रजावर्ग लोभ के वशीभूत होकर उन समस्त बुक्षों को और माक्षिक मधु को बलपूर्वक अपनाने लगे ॥९१-९२। तब उनके इस अपचार के कारण कहीं-कहीं वे कल्पवृक्ष मधु के साथ ही विनष्ट होने
verses.wordMeaning: In spite of knowing decisively these faults, if a person inadvertently engages in the practice of Yoga, the three hum¬ ours in his body become deranged and put up obstacles in his path.
verses.commentary: Sense: In spite of knowing decisively these faults, if a person inadvertently engages in the practice of Yoga, the three hum¬ ours in his body become deranged and put up obstacles in his path.

verses.sanskrit: षड्भिः सिध्यति मसैस्तु यद्यपि स्यात्स पापकृत् । ये पुनः शुद्धमनसो मासैः शुध्यन्ति ते त्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍbhiḥ sidhyati masaistu yadyapi syātsa pāpakṛt / ye punaḥ śuddhamanaso māsaiḥ śudhyanti te tribhiḥ
verses.translation: He develops sluggishness, deafness,muteness, blindness, loss of memory, old age and sickness.
verses.hindi: सस्यामेवाल्पशिष्ठायां संध्याकालवशात्तदा । प्राचर्तन्त तदा तासां दन्द्वान्यभ्युत्थितानि तु
verses.wordMeaning: He develops sluggishness, deafness,muteness, blindness, loss of memory, old age and sickness.
verses.commentary: Sense: He develops sluggishness, deafness,muteness, blindness, loss of memory, old age and sickness.

verses.sanskrit: यथा दिनकरस्पृष्टं हिमं शैलाद् विशीर्यन्ते । तद्वद्विलीयते पापं स्पृष्टं भस्मकणैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: yathā dinakaraspṛṣṭaṃ himaṃ śailād viśīryante / tadvadvilīyate pāpaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ bhasmakaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: The bodily humours of a person practising Yoga igno¬ rantly, become virulent. Hence a Yogin should practise Yoga with pure knowledge of the mind and body.
verses.hindi: रृत्वा दन्द्प्रतीकार्र निकेतानि हि भेजिरे। पूर्वा निकामचारास्ते अभिकेताश्रया भुशम्
verses.wordMeaning: The bodily humours of a person practising Yoga igno¬ rantly, become virulent. Hence a Yogin should practise Yoga with pure knowledge of the mind and body.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bodily humours of a person practising Yoga igno¬ rantly, become virulent. Hence a Yogin should practise Yoga with pure knowledge of the mind and body.

verses.sanskrit: वैनतेयभयत्रस्ता यथा नश्यन्ति पन्नगाः । तद्वत्पापानि नश्यन्ति भस्मनाभ्युक्षितानि ह
verses.transliteration: vainateyabhayatrastā yathā naśyanti pannagāḥ / tadvatpāpāni naśyanti bhasmanābhyukṣitāni ha
verses.translation: If he is alert and careful in the practice of Yoga, he will not suffer from any defects. I shall explain the remedy for the defects originating from the wrong performance of Prana- yama.
verses.hindi: यथायोग्यं यथाप्रीति निकेतेष्वचसन्पुनः । मरुधन्वखु निम्नेषु पबंतेषु नदीषु चर
verses.wordMeaning: If he is alert and careful in the practice of Yoga, he will not suffer from any defects. I shall explain the remedy for the defects originating from the wrong performance of Prana- yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he is alert and careful in the practice of Yoga, he will not suffer from any defects. I shall explain the remedy for the defects originating from the wrong performance of Prana- yama.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातोयपूतेन भस्मनोद्धूलयन्ति ये । सद्यस्ते पापसङ्घाच्च मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: narmadātoyapūtena bhasmanoddhūlayanti ye / sadyaste pāpasaṅghācca mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The enlargement of the spleen (due to the derange¬ ment of the wind humour) calms down, if the patient drinks thick, sticky gruel (while it is) very hot.
verses.hindi: संश्रयन्ति च दुर्गाणि घन्वार्न शाश्वतोदकम्  यथायोगं॑ यथाकामं समेथ्ु 'विषमेषु च ।€८ आरब्धास्ते निकेता (वै(न्वै) कतु शीतोष्णचारणम्  ततः संस्थापयामास खेंटानि पुराणि च ॥€र ग्रामांश्चेव यथासागं तथेबान्तःपुराणि च । तासामायाभविष्कस्मान्सनिवेशान्त राखि तर १००
verses.wordMeaning: The enlargement of the spleen (due to the derange¬ ment of the wind humour) calms down, if the patient drinks thick, sticky gruel (while it is) very hot.
verses.commentary: Sense: The enlargement of the spleen (due to the derange¬ ment of the wind humour) calms down, if the patient drinks thick, sticky gruel (while it is) very hot.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतं पाशुपतं भक्तया यथोक्तं पालयन्ति ये । शूद्रान्नेन विहीनास्तु ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: vrataṃ pāśupataṃ bhaktayā yathoktaṃ pālayanti ye / śūdrānnena vihīnāstu te yānti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: He shall fix firmly something in the mind and hold on to it as though observing some holy rite. If there is palpitation of the heart, the vital breath shall be retained in the cardiac region and near the throat.
verses.hindi: अष्टाडगगुलः प्रदेशिन्या व्यासः प्रादेश उच्यते। तालः रुखुतो मध्यमया गोकर्णाश्वाप्यनामया ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: He shall fix firmly something in the mind and hold on to it as though observing some holy rite. If there is palpitation of the heart, the vital breath shall be retained in the cardiac region and near the throat.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall fix firmly something in the mind and hold on to it as though observing some holy rite. If there is palpitation of the heart, the vital breath shall be retained in the cardiac region and near the throat.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतं ब्राह्मणस्यान्नं क्षत्रियान्नं पयः स्मृतम् । वैश्यान्नम् अन्नमेव स्याच्छूद्रान्नं रुधिरं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ kṣatriyānnaṃ payaḥ smṛtam / vaiśyānnam annameva syācchūdrānnaṃ rudhiraṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: If there is obsrruction to speech, the vital breath should be retained in the organ of speech; in deafness it shall be re¬ tained in the ears. In affliction by thirst, he shall (apply) oil or ghee to the tip of the tongue by means of threads. Concentrat¬ ing thus on the effect of the treatment, a Yogin achieves happi¬ ness.
verses.hindi: लगे । उस काल में कल्पव॒क्षों के क्षीण होने से प्रजाओं में शीतोष्णादि दन्द्र-क्लेश भी उत्पन्न हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: If there is obsrruction to speech, the vital breath should be retained in the organ of speech; in deafness it shall be re¬ tained in the ears. In affliction by thirst, he shall (apply) oil or ghee to the tip of the tongue by means of threads.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If there is obsrruction to speech, the vital breath should be retained in the organ of speech; in deafness it shall be re¬ tained in the ears. In affliction by thirst, he shall (apply) oil or ghee to the tip of the tongue by means of threads.…

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रान्नरससंपुष्टा ये म्रियन्ते द्विजोत्तमाः । ते तपोज्ञानहीनास्तु काका गृध्रा भवन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: śūdrānnarasasaṃpuṣṭā ye mriyante dvijottamāḥ / te tapojñānahīnāstu kākā gṛdhrā bhavanti te
verses.translation: In the state of consumption and leprosy, the Sattvika breath shall be centred on the parts affected. If a part is affected by Rajas, the Yoga shall be practised with respect to that particular part. If a Brahmana practising Yoga, suffers from illness the following treatment should be pursued. His head shall be beaten with a wedge of bamboo or the wedge shall be placed on his head and beaten with a wooden stick. Thus over¬ whelmed by fear, he will regain consciousness. Or if he has lost consciousness he can beheld with hands. After regaining con¬ sciousness he should retain Dharana in the head. He shall eat oily substance yet in small quantity. Thus the Yogin becomes happy.
verses.hindi: वायु, ठंडक और गर्मी से पीड़ित होकर लोग गात्रावरण (वस्त्र) धारण करने लगे । वे यथेच्छविहारी गृहहीन प्रजागण गात्रावास द्वारा वायु शीत और घाम के कष्ट का निवारण करने के लिये घर बना कर रहने लगे । यथायोग्य अपनी रुचि के अनुसार गृह निर्माण कर सुख से निवास करने लगे ।६५-६ ६स। उन्होंने मरु, उन्नत, निम्त, पव॑त, नदी, जलप्राय सम, विषम, दुर्गम, इत्यादि नाना स्थान में अपनी रुचि के अनुसार शीतातप-क्लेश
verses.wordMeaning: In the state of consumption and leprosy, the Sattvika breath shall be centred on the parts affected. If a part is affected by Rajas, the Yoga shall be practised with respect to that particular part. If a Brahmana practising Yoga,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the state of consumption and leprosy, the Sattvika breath shall be centred on the parts affected. If a part is affected by Rajas, the Yoga shall be practised with respect to that particular part. If a Brahmana practising Yoga,…

verses.sanskrit: दुष्कृतं हि मनुष्याणामन्नमाश्रित्य तिष्ठति । यो यस्यान्नं समश्नाति स तस्याश्नाति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: duṣkṛtaṃ hi manuṣyāṇāmannamāśritya tiṣṭhati / yo yasyānnaṃ samaśnāti sa tasyāśnāti kilbiṣam
verses.translation: When he is possessed by a non-human being, he should perform the Dharana of heaven, earth, wind and fire.
verses.hindi: से बचने के लिये दुर्ग भवनादि बनाना आरम्भ कर दिया । तब खेट (क्षुद्रग्राम), पुर, अन्तःपुर, ह्म्यादि बनाये गए ।६ ७-६ €। उनकी लम्बाई चोड़ाई यथाबुद्धि निश्चित की गयी, उनके दीघंप्रस्थादि परिमाण के लिये अडगुलि के माप द्वारा विविध परिमाण की संज्ञा भी निश्चित हुई। प्रादेश, हस्त, किष्कु, धनु इत्यादि संज्ञाये तभी से प्रचलित हुईं  दश अंगुलिपर्वों का एक प्रदेश, अड्गुष्ठा से लेकर तर्जनी तक के विस्तार-परिणाम को प्रादेश,
verses.wordMeaning: When he is possessed by a non-human being, he should perform the Dharana of heaven, earth, wind and fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he is possessed by a non-human being, he should perform the Dharana of heaven, earth, wind and fire.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषाद्यतिधर्मेण तपोलौल्यं समाश्रिताः । नरकं यान्त्यसन्दिग्धमित्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: viśeṣādyatidharmeṇa tapolaulyaṃ samāśritāḥ / narakaṃ yāntyasandigdhamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: Being burnt by Pranayama everything comes under control. Still if it enters the body, he should ward it off.
verses.hindi: मध्यमापयनत का ताल, अनामिका के अन्त तक गोकर्ण और कनिष्ठान्त परिमाण की एक वितस्ति (वित्ता) होंती है । वितस्ति का परिमाण बारह अंगुलियों का होता है ।! ००-१०३३। इक्कीस अंगुलियों के पर्वों की रत्नि, चौबीस अंगुलियों के पर्वों का हस्त और दो रत्नियों का भर्थात् बयालीस अंगुलियों का एक किष्कु होता है। चार हाथ का एक धनु, दण्ड था नालिका युग होता है। दो हजार धनुओं की एक गव्यूति और आठ हजार धनुओं का
verses.wordMeaning: Being burnt by Pranayama everything comes under control. Still if it enters the body, he should ward it off.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being burnt by Pranayama everything comes under control. Still if it enters the body, he should ward it off.

verses.sanskrit: ईदृग्रूपाश्च ये विप्राः पाशुपत्ये व्यवस्थिताः । ते महत्पापसंघातं दहन्त्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: īdṛgrūpāśca ye viprāḥ pāśupatye vyavasthitāḥ / te mahatpāpasaṃghātaṃ dahantyeva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Then after stupefying it with one's Yogic power, the fire of Pranayama be burnt over its head and it is completely perished.
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिह्वास्तर्गतग्रन्थः कः पुस्तके नास्ति।  धनुषिचिन्ान्तगंतग्रन्थो नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then after stupefying it with one's Yogic power, the fire of Pranayama be burnt over its head and it is completely perished.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after stupefying it with one's Yogic power, the fire of Pranayama be burnt over its head and it is completely perished.

verses.sanskrit: विडम्बेन च संयुक्ता लौलुप्येन च पीडिताः । असंग्राह्या इत्येवं श्रुतिनोदना
verses.transliteration: viḍambena ca saṃyuktā laulupyena ca pīḍitāḥ / asaṃgrāhyā ityevaṃ śrutinodanā
verses.translation: Drinking the fruit of the poison, he shall retain it but make it ineffective. He should perform Dharana conceiving in his mind the whole earth along with the mountains all round.
verses.hindi: चतुहंसस्‍त॑ घनुदंण्डो नालिकायुगमेव च। घनुःसइस्म दे तत्र गव्यूतिस्तैविंभाव्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Drinking the fruit of the poison, he shall retain it but make it ineffective. He should perform Dharana conceiving in his mind the whole earth along with the mountains all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drinking the fruit of the poison, he shall retain it but make it ineffective. He should perform Dharana conceiving in his mind the whole earth along with the mountains all round.

verses.sanskrit: मातापितृकृतैर्दोषैरन्ये केचित्स्वकर्मजैः । नष्टा ज्ञानावलेपेन अहङ्कारेण ऽपरे
verses.transliteration: mātāpitṛkṛtairdoṣairanye kecitsvakarmajaiḥ / naṣṭā jñānāvalepena ahaṅkāreṇa 'pare
verses.translation: After placing the oceans in the heart and remembering the deities therein, he should bathe with a thousand vessels.
verses.hindi: सौधोच्ववप्रप्राकारं सर्वतश्चातकाघृतम । तदेक॑ स्वस्तिकद्वारं कुमारीपुरमेव च ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After placing the oceans in the heart and remembering the deities therein, he should bathe with a thousand vessels.
verses.commentary: Sense: After placing the oceans in the heart and remembering the deities therein, he should bathe with a thousand vessels.

verses.sanskrit: शाङ्करे प्रस्थिता धर्मे ये स्मृत्यर्थबहिष्कृताः । क्लिश्यमानास्तु कलेन ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: śāṅkare prasthitā dharme ye smṛtyarthabahiṣkṛtāḥ / kliśyamānāstu kalena te yānti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: With waters upto the neck, Dhdrand shall be fixed the head. When afflicted by the back-current of poison he shall perform Dkdrana over all the parts of his body.
verses.hindi: परमाधांधेमायामं प्रागुद्कप्रवर्ण पुरम। छिन्नकर बिकरा त् व्यजञ्ञन कृतसस्थितम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: With waters upto the neck, Dhdrand shall be fixed the head. When afflicted by the back-current of poison he shall perform Dkdrana over all the parts of his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: With waters upto the neck, Dhdrand shall be fixed the head. When afflicted by the back-current of poison he shall perform Dkdrana over all the parts of his body.

verses.sanskrit: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा मूर्खा दम्भविवर्धिताः । न सिध्यन्ति दुरात्मानः कुदृष्टान्तार्थकीर्तनाः
verses.transliteration: aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā mūrkhā dambhavivardhitāḥ / na sidhyanti durātmānaḥ kudṛṣṭāntārthakīrtanāḥ
verses.translation: He shall drink in the clay from the ant-hill with the cups of the withered fallen leaves of the Arka plant. This Yogic mode of treatment is well known in the world.
verses.hindi: एक योजन होता है ।१०४-१०६३। इस योजन परिमाण के अनुसार से उन लोगों ने अपना-अपना वासस्थान बनाया था । उन लोगों ने चार तरह के दुर्गों का भी निर्माण किया। जिनमें तीन दुर्ग तो प्राकृतिक होते थे, परन्तु चौथा कृत्रिम होता था। इस कृत्रिम दुर्ग की भी विधि सुनिये--उसमें ऊँचे घेरे वाले कोठे, बहुजलपूर्ण परिखा, सेतु संयुक्त द्वारदेश और स्वतिक द्वार होते हैं । ढु्ग में कुमारिपुर भी रहता है ।( ०७-१० ६ परिखा को
verses.wordMeaning: He shall drink in the clay from the ant-hill with the cups of the withered fallen leaves of the Arka plant. This Yogic mode of treatment is well known in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall drink in the clay from the ant-hill with the cups of the withered fallen leaves of the Arka plant. This Yogic mode of treatment is well known in the world.

verses.sanskrit: महाभाग्ये ऽपि तीर्थस्य शाङ्करं व्रतमास्थिताः । वियोनिं यान्त्यसन्दिग्धं लौलुप्येन समन्विताः
verses.transliteration: mahābhāgye 'pi tīrthasya śāṅkaraṃ vratamāsthitāḥ / viyoniṃ yāntyasandigdhaṃ laulupyena samanvitāḥ
verses.translation: It has been- explained briefly in the manner found among the topics of Yoga. You should know the suitable traits of the Brahmana before you shall reveal it.

verses.wordMeaning: It has been- explained briefly in the manner found among the topics of Yoga. You should know the suitable traits of the Brahmana before you shall reveal it.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has been- explained briefly in the manner found among the topics of Yoga. You should know the suitable traits of the Brahmana before you shall reveal it.
