verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: साङ्गोपाङ्गांस् तथा वेदाञ्जपन्नित्यं समाहितः । न तत्फलमवाप्नोति गायत्र्या संयमी यथा
verses.transliteration: sāṅgopāṅgāṃs tathā vedāñjapannityaṃ samāhitaḥ / na tatphalamavāpnoti gāyatryā saṃyamī yathā
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: प्रियंगुसप्तमा होते अष्टमी तु कुलत्थिका  श्यामाकास्त्वथ नीवारा जतिलाः सगवेधुकाः
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राध्यायं सकृज्जप्त्वा विप्रो वेदसमन्वितः । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: rudrādhyāyaṃ sakṛjjaptvā vipro vedasamanvitaḥ / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: कुरुचिन्दा वेशुयवास्तथा मकटकाश्च ये । ग्रास्यारण्याः स्खता छोता ओष ध्यस्त चतुद श
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: अन्यद्वै जप्यसंस्थानं सूक्तमारण्यकं तथा । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: anyadvai japyasaṃsthānaṃ sūktamāraṇyakaṃ tathā / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: यदा प्रसष्ठा ओषध्यो न प्ररोहन्ति ता; पुनः  ततः ख ताखां चृत्त्यथ बार्तापा चकार है
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: यत्किंचित्क्रियते जाप्यं यच्च दानं प्रदीयते । नर्मदाजलमाश्रित्य तत्सर्वं चाक्षयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yatkiṃcitkriyate jāpyaṃ yacca dānaṃ pradīyate / narmadājalamāśritya tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा स्वयं भूभेगवान्दष्ठा सिद्धि त कमंजाम् । ततः प्रभ्ृत्यथोंष ध्यः कृष्टपच्यास्तु जज्निरे
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधैर्व्रतैर्नित्यं नर्मदां ये समाश्रिताः । ते मृता वैष्णवं यान्ति पदं वा शैवम् अव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhairvratairnityaṃ narmadāṃ ye samāśritāḥ / te mṛtā vaiṣṇavaṃ yānti padaṃ vā śaivam avyayam
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: ये वे परिग्रहीतार स्तामासामासन्विधात्मका। । इतरेषां छृतत्राणाः स्थापयामास क्षत्नरियान
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: सत्यलोकं नराः केचित्सूर्यलोकं तथापरे । अप्सरोगणसंवीता यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: satyalokaṃ narāḥ kecitsūryalokaṃ tathāpare / apsarogaṇasaṃvītā yāvadābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: ये चान्येडप्यबालास्तेषां चेशस कर्म संस्थिताः । कीनाशा नाशयबन्ति सम प्ृृथिव्या।
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: एवं वै वर्तमाने ऽस्मिंल्लोके तु नृपपुंगव । ऋषीणां दशकोट्यस्तु कुरुक्षेत्रनिवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vai vartamāne 'smiṃlloke tu nṛpapuṃgava / ṛṣīṇāṃ daśakoṭyastu kurukṣetranivāsinām
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: ग्रामीण और जंगली चोदह प्रकार की ओषधियाँ यज्ञसाधन हैं। ब्रीहिं, यव, माष, गोधूम, अणु, तिल, प्रियंगु, कुलथी, इ्यामाक, नीवार, जतिल गवेधुक, कुरुविन्द, वेणुयव और मर्कटक ये चौदह प्रकार की ओबषधियाँ ग्रामीण और आरण्यक दोनों हैं । त्रतायुग के आदि काल में पहले से उत्पन्न हुईं । बिना जोते ये ओषधियाँ जंगलों और ग्रामों में उत्पन्न हुईं । इनके अतिरिक्त वृक्ष, ग्रुलम, लता, वल्‍ली बीरुध तृण आदि
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: मया सह महाभाग नर्मदातटमाश्रिताः । फलमूलकृताहारा अर्चयन्तः स्थिताः शिवम्
verses.transliteration: mayā saha mahābhāga narmadātaṭamāśritāḥ / phalamūlakṛtāhārā arcayantaḥ sthitāḥ śivam
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: भी प्रादुर्भूत होकर मूल, फल, पृष्प आदि से प्रजाओं को सुख समृद्ध करने लगे। ब्रह्मा द्वारा दुहे जाने पर पृथ्वी ने जिन बीजों को उत्पन्न किया था, उनसे ऋतुओं के अनुकूल उनसे विविध प्रकार के फल उत्पन्न हुए  किन्तु जब वे ओषधियाँ अच्छी तरह उगीं नहीं तब तक के लिये उन्होंने उनकी जीविका का उपाय किया कि भूमि जोतकर अन्न उपजाया जाय  स्वयम्भू भगवान् ब्रह्मा ने उनकी कमंजन्य सिद्धि
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: तच्च वर्षशतं दिव्यं कालसंख्यानुमानतः । षड्विंशतिसहस्राणि तानि मानुषसंख्यया
verses.transliteration: tacca varṣaśataṃ divyaṃ kālasaṃkhyānumānataḥ / ṣaḍviṃśatisahasrāṇi tāni mānuṣasaṃkhyayā
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: को देखकर ऐसा किया । तभी से कर्षणज सस्योत्पत्ति आरम्भ हुई है। उनकी संदिग्ध वार्ता में यानी जीविकोपाय के विवाद-संवाद में ब्रह्मा ने बहुतेरी मर्यादा (व्यवस्था) स्थापित की। उनके बीच जो बलवानू और भूमिपति थे। उन क्षत्रियों को दूसरे की रक्षा का भार सौंपा। जो उन क्षत्रियों के निकट निर्भव होकर जाते थे, सत्यवादी और सवंभृतों में ब्रह्मज्ञानवान् थे वे ब्राह्मण बहलाये
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्यामतीतायां सन्ध्यायां नृपसत्तम । शेषं मानुष्यमेकं तु काले वर्षशतं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tatastasyāmatītāyāṃ sandhyāyāṃ nṛpasattama / śeṣaṃ mānuṣyamekaṃ tu kāle varṣaśataṃ sthitam
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: जो उनकी अपेक्षा निम्नक्र कर्म करने वाले और यमकी तरह जानबल्कर प्रथ्वी पर प्रजाओं
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽभवदनावृष्टिर्लोकक्षयकरी तदा । यया यातं जगत्सर्वं क्षयं भूयो हि दारुणम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'bhavadanāvṛṣṭirlokakṣayakarī tadā / yayā yātaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kṣayaṃ bhūyo hi dāruṇam
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: घौश्यन्येच तु तानाहु! की नाशान्वुक्तिसाधकान् । शोचन्तश्न द्वच-्तञ्व परिच्यांसु ये रताः १६४ निस्तेजसो 5पवीयांश्व शूद्धांस्तानअवीच खः  ठेषां कर्मांणि,घर्माश्च ब्लक्षा। तु व्यद्चात्प ॥
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: ये पूर्वमिह संसिद्धा ऋषयो वेदपारगाः । तेषां प्रभावाद् भगवान् ववर्ष बलवृत्रहा
verses.transliteration: ye pūrvamiha saṃsiddhā ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ / teṣāṃ prabhāvād bhagavān vavarṣa balavṛtrahā
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: वर्णधममं रजीवन्त्यो व्यरध्यन्त परस्परम् । ब्रह्मा तभर्थ बुदूष्चा त याथातथ्येन वे प्रभु:
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: महती भूरिसलिला समन्ताद्वृष्टिराहिता । ततो वृष्ट्या तु तेषां वै वर्तनं समजायत
verses.transliteration: mahatī bhūrisalilā samantādvṛṣṭirāhitā / tato vṛṣṭyā tu teṣāṃ vai vartanaṃ samajāyata
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: शिव्पाजीवं भ्ूर्ति चैव शूद्वाणां व्यद्धात्मभ्भुः  सामान्यानि त॒ कर्माणि ब्लक्षत्रविशां पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् युगान्ते सम्प्राप्ते किंचिच्छेषे कलौ युगे । निःशेषम् अभवत् सर्वं शुष्कं स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: punar yugānte samprāpte kiṃciccheṣe kalau yuge / niḥśeṣam abhavat sarvaṃ śuṣkaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: यजनाध्ययन दान॑ सामानन्‍्यानि त॒ तेषु च्। कर्माजीव॑ ततो द्र्वा तेभ्यश्वेव परस्परम्
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: निर्वृक्षौषधगुल्मं च तृणवीरुद्विवर्जितम् । अनावृष्टिहतं सर्वं भूमण्डलम् अभूद्भृशम्
verses.transliteration: nirvṛkṣauṣadhagulmaṃ ca tṛṇavīrudvivarjitam / anāvṛṣṭihataṃ sarvaṃ bhūmaṇḍalam abhūdbhṛśam
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: लोकान्तरेष स्थानानि तेषां सिद्धाद्दात्प्रभुः  प्राजापत्यं॑ ब्राझ्णानां रुखत॑ स्थान
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते ऋषयः सर्वे क्षुत्तृषार्ताः सहस्रशः । युगस्वभावमाविष्टा हीनसत्त्वा अभवन्नृप
verses.transliteration: tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve kṣuttṛṣārtāḥ sahasraśaḥ / yugasvabhāvamāviṣṭā hīnasattvā abhavannṛpa
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: स्थानमैन्द्र क्षत्रियाणां सडग्नामेष्वपलायिनाम्  चेश्यानां मारुत॑ स्थानं स्वधर्ममुपजीचिनाम् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: नष्टहोमस्वधाकारे युगान्ते समुपस्थिते । किं कार्यं क्व नु यास्यामः को ऽस्माकं शरणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: naṣṭahomasvadhākāre yugānte samupasthite / kiṃ kāryaṃ kva nu yāsyāmaḥ ko 'smākaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: तल स्थितेष वर्णंष स्थापयामास चा55भ्रमान् । ग्रहस्थो ब्रह्मचारित्व॑ वानप्रस्थं समिच्ुकम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: तानहं प्रत्युवाचेदं मा भैष्टेति पुनःपुनः । ईदृग्विधा मया दृष्टा बहवः कालपर्ययाः
verses.transliteration: tānahaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ mā bhaiṣṭeti punaḥpunaḥ / īdṛgvidhā mayā dṛṣṭā bahavaḥ kālaparyayāḥ
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: का नाश करते थे उन्हें कीनाश पद से अभिहितकर वेश्य कहा और उन्हें सर्व साधारण के वत्ति साधन कारये में लगाया । जो सोचते हुए शोक करते हुए इधर उधर भ्रमण करते थे और निस्तेज थे, उन्हें शूद्र कहा और उन्हें परिचर्या-कार्य में लगाया। इस तरह ब्रह्मा ने उनके धर्म-कर्म का प्रणयन किया और वे चतुर्वणं अपने - अपने कतेब्यों का पालन करने लगे। फिर वे क्रम क्रम से मोहवश होकर उन सकल
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातीरमाश्रित्य ते सर्वे गमिता मया । एषा हि शरणं देवी सम्प्राप्ते हि युगक्षये
verses.transliteration: narmadātīramāśritya te sarve gamitā mayā / eṣā hi śaraṇaṃ devī samprāpte hi yugakṣaye
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: वर्णधर्म नियमों का अनादर कर परस्पर विरुद्धाचरण में प्रवृत्त हुए । प्रभु ब्रह्मा ने यथाथेतः उनके आचरणों को जानकर क्षत्रियों को बल, शासन और युद्ध जीविकोपाय बताया, ब्राह्मणों को याजन, अध्यापन और प्रतिग्रह रूप तीन कर्म बतलाये, पशुपालन, वाणिज्य और क्ृषिकर्म रूप जीविकोपाय वैश्यों को दिया, एवं शुद्रों के लिये शिल्प तथा दास्तत्व की व्यवस्था की । ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय और वंश्यों के लिये यजन, अध्ययन
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: नान्या गतिरिहास्माकं विद्यते द्विजसत्तमाः । जनित्री सर्वभूतानां विशेषेण द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: nānyā gatirihāsmākaṃ vidyate dvijasattamāḥ / janitrī sarvabhūtānāṃ viśeṣeṇa dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: एवं दान की सामान्य रूप से व्यवस्था की । ब्रह्मा. ने उन्हें परस्पर कर्म और जीविका देकर उनकी सिद्धि के अनुरूप लोकान्तर में भी स्थानों का निर्देश कर दिया । क्रियाशील ब्राह्मणों के लिये प्राजापत्यस्थान, संग्राम में डटे रहने वाले क्षत्रियों के लिये ऐन्द्रस्थान, स्वधर्मनिष्ठ वैइयों के लिये मारुत नामक स्थान और अपने आचरण में निरत शूद्रों के लिये गान्धर्व स्थान का निरूपण किया। स्वधर्मनिष्ठ वर्णचतुष्टयों के लिये
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: पितामहा ये पितरो ये चान्ये प्रपितामहाः । ते समस्ता गताः स्वर्गं समाश्रित्य महानदीम्
verses.transliteration: pitāmahā ye pitaro ye cānye prapitāmahāḥ / te samastā gatāḥ svargaṃ samāśritya mahānadīm
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: उन्होंने इन स्थानों का विधान किया  इस तरह वर्णंधमे के प्रतिष्ठित हो जाने पर उन्होंने आश्रमों का स्थापन किया ।१६४-१७५३। ब्रह्मचर्य, गृहस्थ, वानत्रस्थ और भिक्षुक नामक चार आश्रमों को ब्रह्मा ने पहले स्थापित
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वाद्याः सप्त ये त्वासन्मम पूर्वपितामहाः । धौमृणी च महाभागा मम भार्या शुचिस्मिता । मनस्वती च या मता भार्गवोऽङ्गिरसस्तथा
verses.transliteration: bhṛgvādyāḥ sapta ye tvāsanmama pūrvapitāmahāḥ / dhaumṛṇī ca mahābhāgā mama bhāryā śucismitā / manasvatī ca yā matā bhārgavo'ṅgirasastathā
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: आश्रमांश्वत॒रों छेतास्पूर्वमास्थापयत्परभुः। चर्णकर्माण ये केचित्तेषामिह न कुचते
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यः पुलहश्चैव वसिष्ठात्रेयकाश्यपाः । तथान्ये च महाभागा नियमव्रतचारिणः । अन्ये च शतसाहस्रा अत्र सिद्धिं समागताः
verses.transliteration: pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva vasiṣṭhātreyakāśyapāḥ / tathānye ca mahābhāgā niyamavratacāriṇaḥ / anye ca śatasāhasrā atra siddhiṃ samāgatāḥ
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: कुतः कर्माक्षिति प्राइराश्रमस्थानधासिन। । बज्ञा तान्स्थापयामास भाश्रमान्नाम नामतः
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादियं महाभागा न मोक्तव्या कदाचन । नान्या काचिन्नदी शक्ता लोकत्रयफलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: tasmādiyaṃ mahābhāgā na moktavyā kadācana / nānyā kācinnadī śaktā lokatrayaphalapradā
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: निर्देशार्थ ततस्तेषां ब्रल्ला धर्मानमाषत  भ्रस्थानानि च तेषां वे यमांश्व नियमांस्य ह १७७
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: द्वन्द्वैरनेकैर्बहुभिः क्षुत्तृषाद्यैर् महाभयैः । मुच्यन्ते ते नराः सद्यो नर्मदातीरवासिनः
verses.transliteration: dvandvairanekairbahubhiḥ kṣuttṛṣādyair mahābhayaiḥ / mucyante te narāḥ sadyo narmadātīravāsinaḥ
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: उसे संध्ये चगाहृम्ध होमश्वारण्यवासिनाम । आसबन्नमुसले भैक्षमस्तेयं शौचमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन सेवितव्या सरिद्वरा । वाञ्छद्भिः परमं श्रेय इह लोके परत्र च
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sevitavyā saridvarā / vāñchadbhiḥ paramaṃ śreya iha loke paratra ca
verses.translation: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.hindi: दशलक्षणको छोष घर्मः प्रोक्त। स्वयंघ्रुवा  भिक्षोत्नेतानि पश्चात्न पश्चेधोपन्नतानि च
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees himselfand the earth blazing and one enter-

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्रीनर्मदामाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम एकादशोऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो राजन्संहृष्टा ऋषयो ऽभवन् । नर्मदां स्तोतुमारब्धाः कृताञ्जलिपुटा द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 12 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etacchrutvā vaco rājansaṃhṛṣṭā ṛṣayo 'bhavan / narmadāṃ stotumārabdhāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Such an afflicted person desires to perforin Mayic (deceptive) activities such as maintenance of sacrificial fire (Agniholra ), oblations in fire, performance of sacrifice, wealth and heaven. If a Yogin is engaged in such religious rites, he falls a victim to Nescience (Avidyd). One should know that one is affected and should deliberately avoid it. If he becomes per¬ manently devoted to Brahman, he is released from the evil effects.
verses.hindi: आचारशुद्धिविनयः शौच चाप्रतिकमें च। सस्यग्द्शंनभिस्येव॑ पश्चैबोपन्तान्यपि ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Such an afflicted person desires to perforin Mayic (deceptive) activities such as maintenance of sacrificial fire (Agniholra ), oblations in fire, performance of sacrifice, wealth and heaven. If a Yogin is engaged in such religious rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Such an afflicted person desires to perforin Mayic (deceptive) activities such as maintenance of sacrificial fire (Agniholra ), oblations in fire, performance of sacrifice, wealth and heaven. If a Yogin is engaged in such religious rites,…

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते पुण्यजले नमो मकरगामिनि । नमस्ते पापमोचिन्यै नमो देवि वरानने
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te puṇyajale namo makaragāmini / namaste pāpamocinyai namo devi varānane
verses.translation: But even though one has mastered breath-control and evils (obstructing Yoga), other evils arising from (and of the nature of) Sattva, Rajas and Tamas appear. Perspicuous intellect, hearing (spiritual) voices,vision of gods and circular motion of whirling flame—these are called the signs of (attainment of) Siddhi.
verses.hindi: ध्यान समाधिमेनसेन्द्रियाणां ससागरेभेंद्यमथोपगस्य ।
verses.wordMeaning: But even though one has mastered breath-control and evils (obstructing Yoga), other evils arising from (and of the nature of) Sattva, Rajas and Tamas appear. Perspicuous intellect,…
verses.commentary: Sense: But even though one has mastered breath-control and evils (obstructing Yoga), other evils arising from (and of the nature of) Sattva, Rajas and Tamas appear. Perspicuous intellect,…

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते पुण्यजलाश्रये शुभे विशुद्धसत्त्वं सुरसिद्धसेविते । नमो ऽस्तु ते तीर्थगणैर्निषेविते नमो ऽस्तु रुद्राङ्गसमुद्भवे वरे
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te puṇyajalāśraye śubhe viśuddhasattvaṃ surasiddhasevite / namo 'stu te tīrthagaṇairniṣevite namo 'stu rudrāṅgasamudbhave vare
verses.translation: All learning, literature, arts and other lores communic¬ able orally as well as the essence of all learning attend upon him (for service). It is the index of his superhuman power. 1 He hears words worth hearing even from the distance of a hundred Yojanas. The omniscient Yogin, even though know¬ ing the procedure of Yoga, may become like a lunatic.
verses.hindi: किया । उन आश्रमवासी प्रजाओं मैं कुछ वर्णधर्म को नहीं करते थे ओर कहने लगे कि पृथ्वीतल में हमारा कर्तव्य कर्म क्‍या है, कया करें  तब ब्रह्मा ने उन्हें कर्मंनिष्ठ करने के लिये चार आश्रमों का विधान किया । प्रभु ब्रह्मा ने तब प्रजावर्ग को शिक्षा देने के लिये धर्म, आचार और यम-नियमादि का उपदेश दिया १७६-१७६। चारों आश्रमों के मध्य ग॒ृहस्थाश्रम ही अन्य आश्रमों की उत्पत्ति और स्थिति का कारण है, अतः गृहस्थाश्रम
verses.wordMeaning: All learning, literature, arts and other lores communic¬ able orally as well as the essence of all learning attend upon him (for service). It is the index of his superhuman power. 1 He hears words worth hearing even from the distance of a hundred Yojanas. The omniscient Yogin,…
verses.commentary: Sense: All learning, literature, arts and other lores communic¬ able orally as well as the essence of all learning attend upon him (for service). It is the index of his superhuman power. 1 He hears words worth hearing even from the distance of a hundred Yojanas. The omniscient Yogin,…

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते देवि समुद्रगामिनि नमो ऽस्तु ते देवि वरप्रदे शिवे । नमो ऽस्तु लोकद्वयसौख्यदायिनि ह्यनेकभूतौघसमाश्रिते ऽनघे
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te devi samudragāmini namo 'stu te devi varaprade śive / namo 'stu lokadvayasaukhyadāyini hyanekabhūtaughasamāśrite 'naghe
verses.translation: If the great Yogi sees Yaksas, Raksasas, Gandharvas and divine beings and knows them, it is the sign of disturbance (in spiritual progress). One should recognize him specifically as insane if he sees Devas, Danavas, Sages and Pitrs all round.
verses.hindi: सारों आश्रमों का मूल है। अब हम यथाक्रम से यम-नियम के साथ आश्रम चतुष्टय का विधान करते हैं । स्त्रीपरिग्रह, अग्निहोत्रानुष्ठान, अतिथिसत्कार, यज्ञश्नाद्धांदि कार्य ओर सन्‍्तानोत्पादन यही संक्षेप में गहस्थों के कत्तंव्य-धर्ं हैं। दण्ड मेखला जठाधारण, भूतल दायन, गुरुशुश्रूषा और भिक्षा यह विद्यार्थी एवं ब्रह्मचारियों के लिये पालनीय धर्म है। चीर, पत्र और अजिन धारण; धान्य मूल और फल भक्षण; दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: If the great Yogi sees Yaksas, Raksasas, Gandharvas and divine beings and knows them, it is the sign of disturbance (in spiritual progress). One should recognize him specifically as insane if he sees Devas, Danavas, Sages and Pitrs all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the great Yogi sees Yaksas, Raksasas, Gandharvas and divine beings and knows them, it is the sign of disturbance (in spiritual progress). One should recognize him specifically as insane if he sees Devas, Danavas, Sages and Pitrs all round.

verses.sanskrit: सरिद्वरे पापहरे विचित्रिते गन्धर्वयक्षोरगसेविताङ्गे । सनातनि प्राणिगणानुकम्पिनि मोक्षप्रदे देवि विधेहि शं नः
verses.transliteration: saridvare pāpahare vicitrite gandharvayakṣoragasevitāṅge / sanātani prāṇigaṇānukampini mokṣaprade devi vidhehi śaṃ naḥ
verses.translation: The Yogi, being urged by his inner soul, flounders through delusion. All his knowledge is lost when his intellect is confounded. Professional activities can destroy his mental balance. If his mind is overcome (due to shock of financial loss) and urged by his inner soul, his knowledge is lost.
verses.hindi: सम्ध्या काल में डबकी लगाकर स्नान तथा होमानुष्ठान यह वानप्रस्थवालों का करणीय धम है। जिस समय मुसल का शब्द नहीं सुना जाता हो, उस समय भिक्षा करना, अस्तेय (चोरी न करना), शौच, सावधानता, सम्भोग से पराइमुख होना, प्राणियों के प्रति दया, क्षमा, अक्रोध, गुरुशुश्रूषा और इस तरह इस दस लक्षण धर्म को स्वयम्भू ने संन्‍्यासियों के लिये कहा है। इनमें ऊपर वाले पाँच भिक्षुकों के लिये मुख्य हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Yogi, being urged by his inner soul, flounders through delusion. All his knowledge is lost when his intellect is confounded. Professional activities can destroy his mental balance. If his mind is overcome (due to shock of financial loss) and urged by his inner soul,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogi, being urged by his inner soul, flounders through delusion. All his knowledge is lost when his intellect is confounded. Professional activities can destroy his mental balance. If his mind is overcome (due to shock of financial loss) and urged by his inner soul,…

verses.sanskrit: महागजैर् घमहिषैर् वराहैः संसेविते देवि महोर्मिमाले । नताः स्म सर्वे वरदे सुखप्रदे विमोचयास्मान्पशुपाशबन्धात्
verses.transliteration: mahāgajair ghamahiṣair varāhaiḥ saṃsevite devi mahormimāle / natāḥ sma sarve varade sukhaprade vimocayāsmānpaśupāśabandhāt
verses.translation: Verses 7-15 describe the disturbances in the path of Yogic progress. 16-25 describe the powers attained by different Dharanas. But these Biddhis are a trap (v. 26). The gist of the remaining chapter is that a Sfogi should not be attached to any exalted position even o go aimself. Then only he will be absorbed in Brahman. Covering himself with a white cloth or a blanket he should quickly meditate upon the great Brahman.
verses.hindi: और नीचे पाँच गोण । इनके अतिरिक्त सदाचार, विनय, शुद्धता, विलासहीनता और सम्यग्विवेचन ये पाँच उपब्रत कहे गये हैं। ध्यान, इंद्रिय-मत का संयम, सर्वत्र जाकर बिना कदु वचन कहे भिक्षा ग्रहण; शरीर या इंद्रिय को सुख पहुंचाने वाले उपचारों का निरादर संन्यासियों के लिये धर्म कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 7-15 describe the disturbances in the path of Yogic progress. 16-25 describe the powers attained by different Dharanas. But these Biddhis are a trap (v. 26).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 7-15 describe the disturbances in the path of Yogic progress. 16-25 describe the powers attained by different Dharanas. But these Biddhis are a trap (v. 26).…

verses.sanskrit: पापैरनेकैरशुभैर्विबद्धा भ्रमन्ति तावन्नरकेषु मर्त्याः । महानिलोद्भूततरङ्गभूतं यावत्तवाम्भो हि न संस्पृशन्ति
verses.transliteration: pāpairanekairaśubhairvibaddhā bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyāḥ / mahānilodbhūtataraṅgabhūtaṃ yāvattavāmbho hi na saṃspṛśanti
verses.translation: If the inelligent Yogi desires to attain his spiritual power, he should give up (overcome) his defects caused by the (spiritual) disturbances. Devas, Gandharvas, Sages, Yaksas, Serpents and Asuras, that are involved in creating obstruction, come again and again.
verses.hindi: ्ति बीयुपुराण॑म्
verses.wordMeaning: If the inelligent Yogi desires to attain his spiritual power, he should give up (overcome) his defects caused by the (spiritual) disturbances. Devas, Gandharvas, Sages, Yaksas, Serpents and Asuras, that are involved in creating obstruction, come again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the inelligent Yogi desires to attain his spiritual power, he should give up (overcome) his defects caused by the (spiritual) disturbances. Devas, Gandharvas, Sages, Yaksas, Serpents and Asuras, that are involved in creating obstruction, come again and again.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकदुःखौघभयार्दितानां पापैरनेकैरभिवेष्टितानाम् । गतिस्त्वम् अम्भोजसमानवक्रे द्वन्द्वैरनेकैरपि संवृतानाम्
verses.transliteration: anekaduḥkhaughabhayārditānāṃ pāpairanekairabhiveṣṭitānām / gatistvam ambhojasamānavakre dvandvairanekairapi saṃvṛtānām
verses.translation: A practising Yogin should always take light food and subdue the sense-organs. Similarly he should lie and repose in the subtle body and perform Dharana in the head. Then, if he conquers sleep after practising Yoga, Upasargas in the form of vital breaths are produced in the end.
verses.hindi: स्व ते श्रेयसे प्रोक्ता आश्रमा ब्रक्मणा स्वयम् । सत्याजे्च तपः क्षान्तियोंगेज्या दमपूर्चिका
verses.wordMeaning: A practising Yogin should always take light food and subdue the sense-organs. Similarly he should lie and repose in the subtle body and perform Dharana in the head. Then, if he conquers sleep after practising Yoga, Upasargas in the form of vital breaths are produced in the end.
verses.commentary: Sense: A practising Yogin should always take light food and subdue the sense-organs. Similarly he should lie and repose in the subtle body and perform Dharana in the head. Then, if he conquers sleep after practising Yoga, Upasargas in the form of vital breaths are produced in the end.

verses.sanskrit: नद्यश्च पूता विमला भवन्ति त्वां देवि सम्प्राप्य न संशयो ऽत्र । दुःखातुराणाम् अभयं ददासि शिष्टैरनेकैरभिपूजितासि
verses.transliteration: nadyaśca pūtā vimalā bhavanti tvāṃ devi samprāpya na saṃśayo 'tra / duḥkhāturāṇām abhayaṃ dadāsi śiṣṭairanekairabhipūjitāsi
verses.translation: He should then perform Dharanas of the earth, waters, fire, ether and the mind. Then the striving (aspiring) recluse should perform Dharana upon his intellect. He should discard instantly whenever he sees the indications of (coming) Siddhis.
verses.hindi: बेदाः सांगाश्व यज्ञाश्व ब्रतानि नियमाश्व ये। न सिध्यन्ति प्रदुष्रय भावदोष उपागते ।
verses.wordMeaning: He should then perform Dharanas of the earth, waters, fire, ether and the mind. Then the striving (aspiring) recluse should perform Dharana upon his intellect. He should discard instantly whenever he sees the indications of (coming) Siddhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should then perform Dharanas of the earth, waters, fire, ether and the mind. Then the striving (aspiring) recluse should perform Dharana upon his intellect. He should discard instantly whenever he sees the indications of (coming) Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: स्पृष्टं करैश्चन्द्रमसो रवेश्च तदैव दद्यात्परमं पदं तु । यत्रोपलाः पुण्यजलाप्लुतास्ते शिवत्वम् आयान्ति किमत्र चित्रम्
verses.transliteration: spṛṣṭaṃ karaiścandramaso raveśca tadaiva dadyātparamaṃ padaṃ tu / yatropalāḥ puṇyajalāplutāste śivatvam āyānti kimatra citram
verses.translation: While he performs the Dharana of the earth, the earth becomes subtle. While he performs the Dharana of waters, the waters become subtle. Cool juices, subtle and nectar-like, begin to function. While he performs the Dharana of fire, the subtle fire begins to function. He feels himself like fire and sees its subtle nature.
verses.hindi: बहिः कर्माणि सर्चाणि प्रसिध्यन्ति कदाचन । अन्तर्भावप्रदुष्ठस्थ कुवंतो5पि पराक्रमान्
verses.wordMeaning: While he performs the Dharana of the earth, the earth becomes subtle. While he performs the Dharana of waters, the waters become subtle. Cool juices, subtle and nectar-like, begin to function. While he performs the Dharana of fire, the subtle fire begins to function.…
verses.commentary: Sense: While he performs the Dharana of the earth, the earth becomes subtle. While he performs the Dharana of waters, the waters become subtle. Cool juices, subtle and nectar-like, begin to function. While he performs the Dharana of fire, the subtle fire begins to function.…

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमन्ति तावन्नरकेषु मर्त्या दुःखातुराः पापपरीतदेहाः । महानिलोद्भूततरङ्गभङ्गं यावत्तवाम्भो न हि संश्रयन्ति
verses.transliteration: bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyā duḥkhāturāḥ pāpaparītadehāḥ / mahānilodbhūtataraṅgabhaṅgaṃ yāvattavāmbho na hi saṃśrayanti
verses.translation: He considers himself to be wind and the universal sphere as made of that*. While he performs the Dharana of the ether, the subtle ether begins to function. He sees its subtle sphere and its sound begins to function. The Yogin who, after knowing the seven subtle elements abandons them, attains the highest point of intellect.
verses.hindi: सर्वस्वमपि यो दुष्यात्कलुषेणान्तरात्मना  न तेन धर्मभाकस स्याद्धाव एवात्र कारणम्
verses.wordMeaning: He considers himself to be wind and the universal sphere as made of that*. While he performs the Dharana of the ether, the subtle ether begins to function. He sees its subtle sphere and its sound begins to function. The Yogin who,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He considers himself to be wind and the universal sphere as made of that*. While he performs the Dharana of the ether, the subtle ether begins to function. He sees its subtle sphere and its sound begins to function. The Yogin who,…

verses.sanskrit: म्लेच्छाः पुलिन्दास्त्वथ यातुधानाः पिबन्ति ये ऽम्भस्तव देवि पुण्यम् । मुक्ता भवन्तीह भयात्तु घोरान्निःसंशयं तेऽपि किमत्र चित्रम्
verses.transliteration: mlecchāḥ pulindāstvatha yātudhānāḥ pibanti ye 'mbhastava devi puṇyam / muktā bhavantīha bhayāttu ghorānniḥsaṃśayaṃ te'pi kimatra citram
verses.translation: If he identifies with any of these elements characterised by Aisvarya (prosperity or mastery), he becomes entangled and thereby perishes. Hence he who knows the subtle elements attached to one another and abandons them deliberately, attains the supreme lord.
verses.hindi: पएुर्व देवा: सपितर ऋषयो मनवस्तथा। तेषां स्थानममुष्मिस्तु संस्थितारनां प्रचक्षते
verses.wordMeaning: If he identifies with any of these elements characterised by Aisvarya (prosperity or mastery), he becomes entangled and thereby perishes. Hence he who knows the subtle elements attached to one another and abandons them deliberately, attains the supreme lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he identifies with any of these elements characterised by Aisvarya (prosperity or mastery), he becomes entangled and thereby perishes. Hence he who knows the subtle elements attached to one another and abandons them deliberately, attains the supreme lord.

verses.sanskrit: सरांसि नद्यः क्षयमभ्युपेता घोरे युगे ऽस्मिन् हि कलौ प्रदूषिते । त्वं भ्राजसे देवि जलौघपूर्णा दिवीव नक्षत्रपथे च गङ्गा
verses.transliteration: sarāṃsi nadyaḥ kṣayamabhyupetā ghore yuge 'smin hi kalau pradūṣite / tvaṃ bhrājase devi jalaughapūrṇā divīva nakṣatrapathe ca gaṅgā
verses.translation: Indeed, even the noble-souled sages of divine vision are found entangled in the subtle elements. Those are regarded as defects in them. Hence no attachment should be had in regard to the subtle elements. Due to AUvarya (prosperity and glory) attach¬ ment is generated, while Brahman is called non-attached.
verses.hindi: अष्ठाशीतिसहुरताणि ऋषीणामूध्य॑ रेतलाम् । स्मखुत त॒तेषां तत्स्थान तदेव गुरुघासिनास्  सप्र्षीणां तु यत्स्थानं सख्त तडे द्वौकसाम्। प्राजापत्यं ग्रहस्थानां न्‍्यासिनां त्रह्मणः क्षयम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, even the noble-souled sages of divine vision are found entangled in the subtle elements. Those are regarded as defects in them. Hence no attachment should be had in regard to the subtle elements. Due to AUvarya (prosperity and glory) attach¬ ment is generated,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, even the noble-souled sages of divine vision are found entangled in the subtle elements. Those are regarded as defects in them. Hence no attachment should be had in regard to the subtle elements. Due to AUvarya (prosperity and glory) attach¬ ment is generated,…

verses.sanskrit: तव प्रसादाद् वरदे वरिष्ठे कालं यथेमं परिपालयित्वा । यामो ऽथ रुद्रं तव सुप्रसादाद् वयं तथा त्वं कुरु वै प्रसादम्
verses.transliteration: tava prasādād varade variṣṭhe kālaṃ yathemaṃ paripālayitvā / yāmo 'tha rudraṃ tava suprasādād vayaṃ tathā tvaṃ kuru vai prasādam
verses.translation: After knowing the seven subtle (elements etc.) and the excellent great god of six characteristics, he attains to the supreme Brahman. Those who know the procedure, declare the (following) six characteristics of the supreme Lord. These are: omniscience, contentment, beginning-less (external knowledge), independence, never-failing power and infinite power.
verses.hindi: चत्थार पते पन्थानों देवयाना विनिभिताः । ब्ह्मणा लोकतन्त्रेण आद्ये मन्वन्तरे झुचि ॥१€७ पन्‍्थानों देवयानाय तेषां द्वारं रविः सख्त; । तथैव पित्॒यानानां चन्द्रमा द्वारमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: After knowing the seven subtle (elements etc.) and the excellent great god of six characteristics, he attains to the supreme Brahman. Those who know the procedure, declare the (following) six characteristics of the supreme Lord. These are: omniscience, contentment,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After knowing the seven subtle (elements etc.) and the excellent great god of six characteristics, he attains to the supreme Brahman. Those who know the procedure, declare the (following) six characteristics of the supreme Lord. These are: omniscience, contentment,…

verses.sanskrit: गतिस्त्वमम्बेव पितेव पुत्रांस्त्वं पाहि नो यावदिमं युगान्तम् । कालं त्वनावृष्टिहतं सुघोरं यावत्तरामस्तव सुप्रसादात्
verses.transliteration: gatistvamambeva piteva putrāṃstvaṃ pāhi no yāvadimaṃ yugāntam / kālaṃ tvanāvṛṣṭihataṃ sughoraṃ yāvattarāmastava suprasādāt
verses.translation: The practising Yogin with Brahman as his permanent asset, becomes liberated from the Upasargas. To a Yogin who has conquered the vital breath, the Upasargas and passion, there remains only one Dharana inclusive of all desires in the external body. When the twice-born fixes his mind anywhere he enters it. He enters the elements and can.even shake (move) the three worlds.
verses.hindi: पव्व वर्णाभ्रमाणां ये प्रविभागे छूते तदा। यदा5सुय न व्यवर्तन्त प्रजा वर्णाश्रमात्मिकाः १८८
verses.wordMeaning: The practising Yogin with Brahman as his permanent asset, becomes liberated from the Upasargas. To a Yogin who has conquered the vital breath, the Upasargas and passion, there remains only one Dharana inclusive of all desires in the external body.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The practising Yogin with Brahman as his permanent asset, becomes liberated from the Upasargas. To a Yogin who has conquered the vital breath, the Upasargas and passion, there remains only one Dharana inclusive of all desires in the external body.…

verses.sanskrit: पठन्ति ये स्तोत्रमिदं द्विजेन्द्राः शृण्वन्ति ये चापि नराः प्रशान्ताः । ते यान्ति रुद्रं वृषसंयुतेन यानेन दिव्याम्बरभूषिताश्च
verses.transliteration: paṭhanti ye stotramidaṃ dvijendrāḥ śṛṇvanti ye cāpi narāḥ praśāntāḥ / te yānti rudraṃ vṛṣasaṃyutena yānena divyāmbarabhūṣitāśca
verses.translation: Be means of this Dharana, he can abandon his body and enter another. He should determine that the Sun is e mental door of the Yoga. The Yogin who has attained the status of Isvara and Gunas becomes Brahman himself. He withdraws himse rom the positions of Devas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा ने स्वयं कहा है कि, सभी आश्रय कल्याण के लिये है; किन्तु सत्य, सरलता, दया, क्षमा, योग, याग, दम, वेद, वेदाज़ू, यजन, ब्रत, नियम आदि कर्म सद्भावना रहित श्रद्धाहीन व्यक्तियों के लिये फलप्रद नहीं हैं, अन्तः- शुद्धि नहीं है, वह पराक्रम करके भी कभी सफल नहीं हो सकता  कलुषित हृदय से सर्वस्व दान करके भी कोई धर्मंभाजन नहीं हो सकता; क्योंकि उसकी भावना शुद्ध नहीं । धर्मंलाभ के विषय में मानसिकभावना
verses.wordMeaning: Be means of this Dharana, he can abandon his body and enter another. He should determine that the Sun is e mental door of the Yoga. The Yogin who has attained the status of Isvara and Gunas becomes Brahman himself. He withdraws himse rom the positions of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be means of this Dharana, he can abandon his body and enter another. He should determine that the Sun is e mental door of the Yoga. The Yogin who has attained the status of Isvara and Gunas becomes Brahman himself. He withdraws himse rom the positions of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ये स्तोत्रमेतत् सततं पठन्ति स्नात्वा तु तोये खलु नर्मदायाः । अन्ते हि तेषां सरिदुत्तमेयं गतिं विशुद्धाम् अचिराद् ददाति
verses.transliteration: ye stotrametat satataṃ paṭhanti snātvā tu toye khalu narmadāyāḥ / ante hi teṣāṃ sariduttameyaṃ gatiṃ viśuddhām acirād dadāti
verses.translation: He should eschew from the positions of PiSacas Raksasas, Gandharvas, Kubera, Indra, Soma and Prajapati b ' the processes specific to these. ■ He should give up the position of Brahma by the special Brahma procedure. He should take leave of the Lord But if he is attached thereto (to'Brahma's position), he becomes
verses.hindi: ही कारण है। देव पितर, ऋषि और मनुओं के लिये जो स्थान निर्दिष्ट हैं, वे ही स्थान संन्यासियों के लिये भी हैं ।( ८६-१९३। अठासी हजार उर््ध वरेता ऋषि हैं, इनके जो स्थान हैं वे ही गुरु के निकट रहने वाले ब्रह्मचारियों के लिये हैं। सप्तर्षि जहाँ निवास करते हैं, इनके जो स्थान हैं वही देवों का वासस्थान है। गृहस्थ प्रजापति लोक में वास करते हैं और संन्‍्यासी ब्रह्मलोक लाभ करते हैं। योगियों के लिये अमृत (केवल्य) नामक स्थान,
verses.wordMeaning: He should eschew from the positions of PiSacas Raksasas, Gandharvas, Kubera, Indra, Soma and Prajapati b ' the processes specific to these. ■ He should give up the position of Brahma by the special Brahma procedure.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He should eschew from the positions of PiSacas Raksasas, Gandharvas, Kubera, Indra, Soma and Prajapati b ' the processes specific to these. ■ He should give up the position of Brahma by the special Brahma procedure.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रातः समुत्थाय तथा शयानो यः कीर्तयेतानुदिनं स्तवं च । स मुक्तपापः सुविशुद्धदेहः समाश्रयं याति महेश्वरस्य
verses.transliteration: prātaḥ samutthāya tathā śayāno yaḥ kīrtayetānudinaṃ stavaṃ ca / sa muktapāpaḥ suviśuddhadehaḥ samāśrayaṃ yāti maheśvarasya
verses.translation: Being permanently absorbed in Brahman, he should give up the. aforesaid positions. Thus, being non-attached to these positions he shall acquire the power of going anywhere
verses.hindi: किन्तु नाना बुद्धिवालों के लिये कहीं स्थान नहीं है। ये स्थान आश्रमस्थ स्वथर्मनिष्ठ व्यक्तियों के लिए निर्दिष्ट हैं। देवयान महापथ के ये चार साधारण पथ हैं। लोक विस्तारार्थी ब्रह्मा ने आदि मन्वस्तर में देवयान प्राप्ति के लिये भूमण्डल में इनका निर्माण किया है । सूर्य इन सब पथों के द्वार रूप हैं। इसी तरह पितृयान के द्वार चन्द्रमा कहे जाते हैं। इस तरह वर्णाश्रम विभाग करने पर भी प्रजागण उस वर्णाश्रम
verses.wordMeaning: Being permanently absorbed in Brahman, he should give up the. aforesaid positions. Thus, being non-attached to these positions he shall acquire the power of going anywhere
verses.commentary: Sense: Being permanently absorbed in Brahman, he should give up the. aforesaid positions. Thus, being non-attached to these positions he shall acquire the power of going anywhere

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्रीनर्मदामाहात्म्ये नर्मदास्तोत्रकथनं नाम द्वादशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: एवं भगवती पुण्या स्तुता सा मुनिपुंगवैः । चिन्तयामास सर्वेषां दास्यामि वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmye narmadāstotrakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 13 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ bhagavatī puṇyā stutā sā munipuṃgavaiḥ / cintayāmāsa sarveṣāṃ dāsyāmi varamuttamam
verses.translation: The eightfold AiSvarya too functions in the' subtle elements. I shall explain its features as the lord has described.
verses.hindi: धर के पालन में शिथिलता दिखाने लगे । यह देखकर उन्होंने फिर अपने शरीर से उस शतेता युग में अपनी ही तरह कितनी ही मानसी प्रजा की सृष्ठि की ।१६४-२००। उस तेता युग के क्रम से मध्य काल प्राप्त होने
verses.wordMeaning: The eightfold AiSvarya too functions in the' subtle elements. I shall explain its features as the lord has described.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eightfold AiSvarya too functions in the' subtle elements. I shall explain its features as the lord has described.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसुप्तांस्ताञ्ज्ञात्वा रात्रौ देवी जगाम ह । एकैकस्य ऋषेः स्वप्ने दर्शनं चारुहासिनी
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasuptāṃstāñjñātvā rātrau devī jagāma ha / ekaikasya ṛṣeḥ svapne darśanaṃ cāruhāsinī
verses.translation: In all the three worlds, among all living beings, the power of Anima (becoming minute like an atom) is uncontrolled. It is unmanifest. It is the basis of all (powers).
verses.hindi: ततः सच्चरजोद्रिक्ताः प्रजा; सोडथाखजत्पभुः  घर्माथकाममोक्षाणां घातायाश्वैच साधिका। ॥ देवाश्व पितरश्चैव ऋषयो मनवस्तथा। युगालुरूपा धर्मेण येरिमा विच्विताः प्रजाः
verses.wordMeaning: In all the three worlds, among all living beings, the power of Anima (becoming minute like an atom) is uncontrolled. It is unmanifest. It is the basis of all (powers).
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the three worlds, among all living beings, the power of Anima (becoming minute like an atom) is uncontrolled. It is unmanifest. It is the basis of all (powers).

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽर्धरात्रे सम्प्राप्त उत्थिता जलमध्यतः । विमलाम्बरसंवीता दिव्यमालाविभूषिता
verses.transliteration: tato 'rdharātre samprāpta utthitā jalamadhyataḥ / vimalāmbarasaṃvītā divyamālāvibhūṣitā
verses.translation: What is stated to be inaccessible to living beings in the three worlds becomes accessible to the Yogins by virtue of this first power.
verses.hindi: पूर्वोक्ता या मया तुभ्यं जनलोक॑ समाश्चिताः। कल्पेडतीते तु ते द्यासन्देबाद्यास्तु प्रजा इद्
verses.wordMeaning: What is stated to be inaccessible to living beings in the three worlds becomes accessible to the Yogins by virtue of this first power.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is stated to be inaccessible to living beings in the three worlds becomes accessible to the Yogins by virtue of this first power.

verses.sanskrit: घृतातपत्रा सुश्रोणी पद्मरागविभूषिता । जगाद मा भैर् इति तान् एकैकं तु पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: ghṛtātapatrā suśroṇī padmarāgavibhūṣitā / jagāda mā bhair iti tān ekaikaṃ tu pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: The second power in Yoga consists of descending (hanging down) and floating. The Yogi possessed of thispower can move the fastest in all beings.
verses.hindi: तत्कर्मफलशेपेण उपध्टब्धा प्रजशिरे । देवासुरपितृत्वैश्व पशुपक्षिसरीखपैः ॥श्प्८ वृक्षनारकिकीटत्वैस्तैस्तै मांचेरपस्थिताः। अधीनार्थ प्रजानां च आत्मनों वे विनिर्ममे
verses.wordMeaning: The second power in Yoga consists of descending (hanging down) and floating. The Yogi possessed of thispower can move the fastest in all beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The second power in Yoga consists of descending (hanging down) and floating. The Yogi possessed of thispower can move the fastest in all beings.

verses.sanskrit: वसध्वं मम पार्श्वे तु भयं त्यक्त्वा क्षुधादिजम्
verses.transliteration: vasadhvaṃ mama pārśve tu bhayaṃ tyaktvā kṣudhādijam
verses.translation: The ability to obtain anything in the three worlds is called Prakamya (irresistible will). *What is Mahima also falls under this category. This is the third Yoga (Yogic power).
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते चतुराक्रमविभागकथन नामाष्टमोध्ष्याय!
verses.wordMeaning: The ability to obtain anything in the three worlds is called Prakamya (irresistible will). *What is Mahima also falls under this category. This is the third Yoga (Yogic power).
verses.commentary: Sense: The ability to obtain anything in the three worlds is called Prakamya (irresistible will). *What is Mahima also falls under this category. This is the third Yoga (Yogic power).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तदा देवी स्वप्नान्ते तान्महामुनीन् । जगामादर्शनं पश्चात्प्रविश्य जलम् आत्मिकम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tadā devī svapnānte tānmahāmunīn / jagāmādarśanaṃ paścātpraviśya jalam ātmikam
verses.translation: These three worlds are regarded as untraversable to ail beings (except Yogins) in the three w.orlds. It is theYogin who can enjoy all objects to the utmost satisfaction. He is not obstructed anywhere. Happiness and misery befall all living beings in the three worlds (but the Yogin escapes).
verses.hindi: €उरउ३ ३उठऐयटफ+ँ- नन्‍ननथनापापपपभिभ+भ प:पिपप/णआथ/ख/)तहह//
verses.wordMeaning: These three worlds are regarded as untraversable to ail beings (except Yogins) in the three w.orlds. It is theYogin who can enjoy all objects to the utmost satisfaction. He is not obstructed anywhere.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These three worlds are regarded as untraversable to ail beings (except Yogins) in the three w.orlds. It is theYogin who can enjoy all objects to the utmost satisfaction. He is not obstructed anywhere.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभाते मुनयो मिथ ऊचुर्मुदन्विताः । तथा दृष्टा मया दृष्टा स्वप्ने देवी सुदर्शना
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte munayo mitha ūcurmudanvitāḥ / tathā dṛṣṭā mayā dṛṣṭā svapne devī sudarśanā
verses.translation: The Yogin becomes the lord of everything. In the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings the living beings become submissive to him. They can be made to serve if he so wishes, not otherwise.
verses.hindi: पर उन्होंने दूसरी मानसी प्रजा की सृष्टि करने का प्रयत्न किया ।३०१। प्रभु ब्रह्मा ने उस समय सत्त्व-रजः प्रधान देव, ऋषि, पितर और मनु नामक चार प्रकार के सन्‍्तान को उत्पन्न किया। ये धर्म, अर्थ, काम, मोक्ष और जीवन-यात्रा के साधक हैं।२०२। ब्रह्मा के इन पुत्रों ने ही धर्म के अनुसार थुगानुरूप समन्‍्तानोत्यादन द्वारा सृष्टि-विस्तार किया है ।२०३। स्वयम्भू हारा निसित उस प्रजाधर्म के पूर्ण प्रभाव
verses.wordMeaning: The Yogin becomes the lord of everything. In the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings the living beings become submissive to him. They can be made to serve if he so wishes, not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogin becomes the lord of everything. In the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings the living beings become submissive to him. They can be made to serve if he so wishes, not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: अभयं दत्तमस्माकं सिद्धिश्चाप्यचिरेण तु । प्रशस्तं दर्शनं तस्या नर्मदाया न संशयः
verses.transliteration: abhayaṃ dattamasmākaṃ siddhiścāpyacireṇa tu / praśastaṃ darśanaṃ tasyā narmadāyā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Where there is the supernormal power called Kamava - sdyitva, by the mere will (of the Yogi), the sense-organs function or do not function according to his will.
verses.hindi: काल में सब मानसी प्रजा नाना रूप होकर ध्यान करने लगी ।२०४। हमने पहले ही कहा कि, जनलोक में जो अतीत कल्प में थे, वे देवादि यहाँ प्रजा होकर आये ।२०५। ब्रह्मा के ध्यान करने से ही इस तरह की प्रजासृष्टि हुईं। प्रथम या कनिष्ठ सभी मन्वन्तरों में सुकमं-कुकर्म, सुख दुःख, ख्याति, प्रतिपन्न रूपगुणादि सम्पूर्ण विषयों में एक प्रकार रहते हैं। प्राणियों को कर्म फल के अवशेष होने पर ही जन्म प्रहण करता
verses.wordMeaning: Where there is the supernormal power called Kamava - sdyitva, by the mere will (of the Yogi), the sense-organs function or do not function according to his will.
verses.commentary: Sense: Where there is the supernormal power called Kamava - sdyitva, by the mere will (of the Yogi), the sense-organs function or do not function according to his will.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यदिवसे राजन्मत्स्यानां रूपम् उत्तमम् । पश्यन्ति सपरीवाराः स्वकीयाश्रमसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: athānyadivase rājanmatsyānāṃ rūpam uttamam / paśyanti saparīvārāḥ svakīyāśramasannidhau
verses.translation: Objects of senses, viz. Sound, Touch, Taste, Smell and Colour as well as the mind function or do not function just in compliance of his will.
verses.hindi: पड़ता है। वे देव, असुर, पितर, पशु, पक्षी, सरीसृप रेंग कर चलने वाले) वृक्ष नारकीय कीट आदि नाना रूप से प्रादुर्भत होते हैं । अपने द्वारा रची गई प्रजाओं के सुख, स्वतन्त्रता के लिये ब्रह्मा ने ऐसा विधान बनाया
verses.wordMeaning: Objects of senses, viz. Sound, Touch, Taste, Smell and Colour as well as the mind function or do not function just in compliance of his will.
verses.commentary: Sense: Objects of senses, viz. Sound, Touch, Taste, Smell and Colour as well as the mind function or do not function just in compliance of his will.

verses.sanskrit: तान्दृष्ट्वा विस्मयाविष्टा मत्स्यांस्तत्र महर्षयः । पूजयामासुरव्यग्रा हव्यकव्येन देवताः
verses.transliteration: tāndṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭā matsyāṃstatra maharṣayaḥ / pūjayāmāsuravyagrā havyakavyena devatāḥ
verses.translation: He is neither born nor does he die. He is neither broken nor cut. He does not get burnt nor does he lose his sense. He is neither deficient nor attached.
verses.hindi: श्री वायु महापुराण में चतुराश्ठम विभाग कथन नामक आठवाँ अध्याय समाप्त ॥८।।
verses.wordMeaning: He is neither born nor does he die. He is neither broken nor cut. He does not get burnt nor does he lose his sense. He is neither deficient nor attached.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is neither born nor does he die. He is neither broken nor cut. He does not get burnt nor does he lose his sense. He is neither deficient nor attached.

verses.sanskrit: तान्मत्स्यसङ्घान्सम्प्राप्य महादेव्याः प्रसादतः । सपुत्रदारभृत्यास्ते वर्तयन्ति पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tānmatsyasaṅghānsamprāpya mahādevyāḥ prasādataḥ / saputradārabhṛtyāste vartayanti pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: He does not get diminished or waste away. He does not perish. He is never dejected. Anywhere he can do anything or undo it.
verses.hindi: अशााशंभगान-अमनइ+मान्‍ मा गपकम के
verses.wordMeaning: He does not get diminished or waste away. He does not perish. He is never dejected. Anywhere he can do anything or undo it.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not get diminished or waste away. He does not perish. He is never dejected. Anywhere he can do anything or undo it.

verses.sanskrit: दिने दिने तथाप्येवमाश्रमेषु द्विजातयः । मत्स्यानां सञ्चयं दृष्ट्वा विस्मिताश्चाभवंस्तदा
verses.transliteration: dine dine tathāpyevamāśrameṣu dvijātayaḥ / matsyānāṃ sañcayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāścābhavaṃstadā
verses.translation: He is not characterised by smell, taste, colour, touch and sound. He is castcless, but not inferior to any caste.
verses.hindi: ततो5भिध्यायतस्तस्य जज्ञिरे मानसी (स) प्रजा:  तच्छरीरससुत्पन्नेः कार्येस्ते: कारणः सहू॒
verses.wordMeaning: He is not characterised by smell, taste, colour, touch and sound. He is castcless, but not inferior to any caste.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is not characterised by smell, taste, colour, touch and sound. He is castcless, but not inferior to any caste.

verses.sanskrit: मृतांस्तांस्तु सुपुष्टाङ्गान् पाठीनांश्च विशेषतः । द्वारे द्वारे चाश्रमाणां तापसानां युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: mṛtāṃstāṃstu supuṣṭāṅgān pāṭhīnāṃśca viśeṣataḥ / dvāre dvāre cāśramāṇāṃ tāpasānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: He enjoys sensual objects but is not entangled by them. On realising the greatest and die subtlest Brahman, because of his subtlety, he attains salvation.
verses.hindi: क्षेत्रजा समवतंन्‍त गात्रेम्यस्तस्य धीमतः । ततो देवासुरपितुन्मानवं च चतुष्टयम् रे
verses.wordMeaning: He enjoys sensual objects but is not entangled by them. On realising the greatest and die subtlest Brahman, because of his subtlety, he attains salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He enjoys sensual objects but is not entangled by them. On realising the greatest and die subtlest Brahman, because of his subtlety, he attains salvation.

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टपुष्टास्तदा सर्वे नर्मदातीरवासिनः । ऋषयस्ते भयं सर्वे तत्यजुः क्षुत्तृषोद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstadā sarve narmadātīravāsinaḥ / ṛṣayaste bhayaṃ sarve tatyajuḥ kṣuttṛṣodbhavam
verses.translation: Because of salvation, he becomes all-pervading. Be¬ cause he pervades (everything), he is called Purus a. Due to his subtle form, the Purusa is established in Supremacy.
verses.hindi: सा5पविद्धा तनुस्तेन (सद्यो रात्रिरजायत । सा तमोबहुला यस्मात्ततो रात्रिल्रियामिका ६ आवृतास्तमसा रात्रो प्रजास्तस्मात्स्वयंभुवः। दृष्ट्वा सुरांस्तु देवेशस्तनुमन्यामपद्यत १७
verses.wordMeaning: Because of salvation, he becomes all-pervading. Be¬ cause he pervades (everything), he is called Purus a. Due to his subtle form, the Purusa is established in Supremacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because of salvation, he becomes all-pervading. Be¬ cause he pervades (everything), he is called Purus a. Due to his subtle form, the Purusa is established in Supremacy.

verses.sanskrit: ते जपन्तस्तपन्तश्च तिष्ठन्ति भरतर्षभ । अर्चयन्ति पित्ःन्देवान्नर्मदातटमाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: te japantastapantaśca tiṣṭhanti bharatarṣabha / arcayanti pitḥndevānnarmadātaṭamāśritāḥ
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: ततो मुखे समुत्पन्ना दीव्यतस्तस्य देवता: । यतोधस्य दीव्यतो जातास्तेन देवा: प्रकोतिताः ९
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: तैर्जपद्भिस्तपद्भिश्च सततं द्विजसत्तमैः । भ्राजते सा सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा ताराभिर् द्यौर् ग्रहैरिव
verses.transliteration: tairjapadbhistapadbhiśca satataṃ dvijasattamaiḥ / bhrājate sā saricchreṣṭhā tārābhir dyaur grahairiva
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--इसके अनन्तर ब्रह्मा के ध्यान करने से मानसी प्रजा उत्पन्न हुई  धीमान् ब्रह्मा के शरीर से कार्य-ऋरणों के साथ क्षेत्रज्समूह उत्पन्न हुआ। देव, असुर, पितू और मानव स्वरूप चतुविध प्रजा की सृष्टि के लिये जलराशि के बीच वे आत्मयोग में निरत हो गये । युक्तात्मा स्वम्यभ्ूं ब्रह्मा सर्ग के लिये ध्यान करने लगे, जिससे, सृष्टि-कार्य प्रारम्भ हुआ। उनके जघन से पहले असुर नामक सन्‍्तान की
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तैर्बहुलैः शुभ्रैर् ब्राह्मणैर् वेदपरागैः । नर्मदा धर्मदा पूर्वं संविभक्ता यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tairbahulaiḥ śubhrair brāhmaṇair vedaparāgaiḥ / narmadā dharmadā pūrvaṃ saṃvibhaktā yathākramam
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: उत्पत्ति हुई  विप्रगण प्राण को असुर कहते हैं; अतः उससे जन्म ग्रहण करने के कारण वे असुर कहलाये। ब्रह्मा ने जिस शरीर से असुरों को उत्पन्न किया, उस शरीर को उन्होंने छोड़ दिया । वह त्यक्त शरीर तुरच्त ही रात्रि रूप में परणित हो गया। वह शरीर तमोबहुल था, इससे रात्रि त्रियामा कहलाई। इसी से स्वयम्भू की समस्त प्रजा रात में तमोगुण से आवृत ही जाती है । देवेश ब्रह्मा ने अधुरों को देखकर अव्यक्त और
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिर् दशकोटिभिर् नर्मदातीरवासिभिः । विभक्तेयं विभक्ताङ्गी नर्मदा शर्मदा नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣibhir daśakoṭibhir narmadātīravāsibhiḥ / vibhakteyaṃ vibhaktāṅgī narmadā śarmadā nṛṇām
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: सत्त्वबहुल दूसरे शरीर को धारण किया  उस शरीर को घारण कर ब्रह्मा अत्यन्त प्रसन्‍तर हुए। तब आनन्द- मग्न ब्रह्मा के मुख से देवगण उत्पन्न हुये । उस आनन्दमय ब्रह्मा से उत्पन्न होने के कारण वे देव कहलाये
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञोपवीतैश्च शुभैर् अक्षसूत्रैश्च भारत । कूलद्वये महापुण्या नर्मदोदधिगामिनी
verses.transliteration: yajñopavītaiśca śubhair akṣasūtraiśca bhārata / kūladvaye mahāpuṇyā narmadodadhigāminī
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो घन पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: पृथगायतनैः शुभ्रैर्लिङ्गैर्वालुकमृन्मयैः । भ्राजते या सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा नक्षत्रैरिव शर्वरी
verses.transliteration: pṛthagāyatanaiḥ śubhrairliṅgairvālukamṛnmayaiḥ / bhrājate yā saricchreṣṭhā nakṣatrairiva śarvarī
