verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: अनुभूताः सप्तकल्पा मायूराद्या मया नृप । प्रसादाद् वेधसः सर्वे रेवया सह भारत
verses.transliteration: anubhūtāḥ saptakalpā māyūrādyā mayā nṛpa / prasādād vedhasaḥ sarve revayā saha bhārata
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: हो गया; इसलिये ज्योत्स्ना के प्रकट होने पर सभी लोग प्रसन्न होते हैं। उस महामना ब्रह्मा ने इस प्रकार शरी र- समुदाय का त्याग किया और वे तुरंत रात्रि, दिन, सन्ध्या और ज्योत्स्ना के रूप में हो गए । २०-२१। ज्योत्स्ना, संध्या तथा दिन सर्व गुणात्मक हैं और रात्रि तम: प्रधान है; इसीलिये वह त्रियामा कहलातो है । ब्रह्मा के दिव्य शरीर से उत्पन्न होने के कारण देवता सतत प्रसन्नचित्त रहते हैं और दिन में उत्पन्न होने के कारण
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: जन्मतोऽद्य दिनं यावन्न जाने ऽस्याः पुरास्थितिम्
verses.transliteration: janmato'dya dinaṃ yāvanna jāne 'syāḥ purāsthitim
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: बे दिन में ही अधिक बलवान् होते हैं ।२२-२३। यतः रात में जघन से असूरों को ब्रह्मा ने उत्पन्न किया है, इसीलिये रात्रिजात असुर गण रात में असह्य पराक्रम वाले हो जाते हैं। देव, असुर, पितृ, मनु आदि की भूत भविष्य सभी मन्वन्तरों में इसी प्रकार उत्पत्ति होती है। ज्योत्स्ना, रात्रि, दिन और सन्ध्या का भी प्रदुर्भाव इसी प्रकार होता है। उस एकाणंव जलरासि में ये चारों आभासित होते थे, इसीसे जल का नाम
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: इयं हि शांकरी शक्तिः कला शम्भोरिलाह्वया । नर्मदा दुरितध्वंसकारिणी भवतारिणी
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ hi śāṃkarī śaktiḥ kalā śambhorilāhvayā / narmadā duritadhvaṃsakāriṇī bhavatāriṇī
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: अम्भस् पड़ा । भा धातु व्याप्ति और दीप्तिवाचक है। विद्वानों ने और स्वयं ब्रह्म ने भी यही कहा है  उन्होंने इस जल को देखकर ही देव, दानव, मानव पितर और अग्यान्य विबुधादि प्रजाओं को बनाया है । ब्रह्म ने उस शरीर को भी सम्पूर्ण रूप से छोड़ दिया और फिर रजस्तम प्रधान दूसरे शरीर को धारण किया । उस अन्धकार में क्षूघाकुल होकर उन्होंने दूसरी प्रजा को उत्पन्न किया । उसके द्वारा उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: यदाहमपि नाभूवं पुराकल्पेषु पाण्डव । चतुर्दशसु कल्पेषु तेष्वियं सुखसंस्थिता
verses.transliteration: yadāhamapi nābhūvaṃ purākalpeṣu pāṇḍava / caturdaśasu kalpeṣu teṣviyaṃ sukhasaṃsthitā
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: वह प्रजा जल को ही खाने के लिये तैयार हो गयी। 'हम जल की रक्षा करते हैं', यह कहते हुये जो उत्पन्न हुये वे ऋधी निशाचर राक्षस कहलाये ।२४-३१। जिन्होंने कहा था कि हम जल को खा जायेंगे, नष्द कर देंगे, वे
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दश पुरा कल्पा न मृता येषु नर्मदा । तानहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि देवी प्राह यथा मम
verses.transliteration: caturdaśa purā kalpā na mṛtā yeṣu narmadā / tānahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi devī prāha yathā mama
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: बेउअ्वन्क्षिणु मो5स्भांसि तेषां हृष्टाः परस्परम् । तेन ते कमंणा यज्ञा गुह्ाकाः क्रकसिण:.
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: कापिलं प्रथमं विद्धि प्राजापत्यं द्वितीयकम् । ब्राह्मं सौम्यं च सावित्रं बार्हस्पत्यं प्रभासकम्
verses.transliteration: kāpilaṃ prathamaṃ viddhi prājāpatyaṃ dvitīyakam / brāhmaṃ saumyaṃ ca sāvitraṃ bārhaspatyaṃ prabhāsakam
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: तान्दृष्ट्वा ह्मप्रियेणास्य केशाः शीयं॑न्‍्त (?) धीमतः । शीतीष्णाभ्रोच्छिता हाूध्व॑ तदा5रोहन्त ्््ि ते प्रभम्
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: माहेन्द्रम् अग्निकल्पं च जयन्तं मारुतं तथा । वैष्णवं बहुरूपं च ज्यौतिषं च चतुर्दशम्
verses.transliteration: māhendram agnikalpaṃ ca jayantaṃ mārutaṃ tathā / vaiṣṇavaṃ bahurūpaṃ ca jyautiṣaṃ ca caturdaśam
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: तस्य क्रोधोडूवों योइसावग्निगर्भसुदारुणः । स तु सपंसहोत्पन्नानाविवेश विषात्मकान् ३७
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: एते कल्पा मया ख्याता न मृता येषु नर्मदा । मायूरं पञ्चदशमं कौर्मं चैवात्र षोडशम्
verses.transliteration: ete kalpā mayā khyātā na mṛtā yeṣu narmadā / māyūraṃ pañcadaśamaṃ kaurmaṃ caivātra ṣoḍaśam
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: अष्टास्वेतासु सुष्टासु देवयोनिषु स प्रभुः। ततः स्वच्छन्दतोब्ल्यानि वयांसि वबसोह्सुजतू. ४४१
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: बकं मात्स्यं च पाद्मं च वटकल्पं च भारत । एकविंशतिमं चैतं वाराहं सांप्रतीनकम्
verses.transliteration: bakaṃ mātsyaṃ ca pādmaṃ ca vaṭakalpaṃ ca bhārata / ekaviṃśatimaṃ caitaṃ vārāhaṃ sāṃpratīnakam
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: ऋरकर्मा गुह्मयक यज्ञ कहलाए ।३२। रक्ष धातु पालनार्थक है; इसी से उसका नाम राक्षस पड़ा और क्षि धातु क्षयाथंक इसी से उनका नाम यक्ष पड़ा । इस अप्रिय सृष्टि को देखकर धीमान् ब्रह्म की केशराशि स्खलित हो गयी। वह शीतोष्ण ग्रुणयुक्त सर्पाकार में परिणत होकर उन्हीं के ऊपर चढ़ने लगी । ब्रह्मा के सिर से हीन होकर अर्थात् स्खलित होकर उसने अपसपंण (टेढ़ा चलना) किया था इसीसे वह कालात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: इमे सप्त मया साकं रेवया परिशीलिताः । एकविंशतिकल्पास्तु नर्मदायाः शिवाङ्गतः
verses.transliteration: ime sapta mayā sākaṃ revayā pariśīlitāḥ / ekaviṃśatikalpāstu narmadāyāḥ śivāṅgataḥ
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: (खलस्वभाव), हीनत्व के कारण अहि और सपंण के कारण सप॑ं, पन्नत्व अर्थात् रूपान्तर प्राप्ति के कारण पन्नग उसका नाम पड़ा। पृथ्वी के मर्भ में (जहाँ चन्द्र-सूयं की किरणे नहीं पहुँच सकतीं वहीं उनका वास- स्थान निर्दिष्ट हुआ । उस समय ब्रह्मा को अग्नितुल्य अत्यन्त दारुण क्रोध हुआ । वह क्रोध साँपों के साथ ही उत्पन्न हुआ था अतः वह भी विष होकर साँपों में प्रवेश कर गया। ब्रह्मा साँपों को देखकर
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: संजाताया नृपश्रेष्ठ मया दृष्टा ह्यनेकशः । कथिता नृपतिश्रेष्ठ भूयः किं कथयामि ते
verses.transliteration: saṃjātāyā nṛpaśreṣṭha mayā dṛṣṭā hyanekaśaḥ / kathitā nṛpatiśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ kiṃ kathayāmi te
verses.translation: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.hindi: कुद्ध हुए, इसी से उन्होंने क्रोध परायण भूत-पिज्लाचों को भी बना दिया। भूमण्डल पर आवृत प्रायः होने से भूत, और पिश्चित यानी कच्चा माँस खाने के कारण पिशाच ये नाम क्रम से दोनों के लिये पड़े । ब्रह्मा के तेज के पान करने के कारण गन्धरवों की उत्पत्ति हुई। “थे! धातु पानार्थंक है और ग्ाः माने तेज, अतः तेज के पान करने से उनका नाम गन्कवे पड़ा। ब्रह्मा ने इस प्रकार अष्ट-विध देव योनि की सृष्टि कर
verses.wordMeaning: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another characteristic of his Supremacy is the all¬ round subtlety. After attaining the most excellent Yoga, of unobstructed supremacy, he goes to the subtlest region, the state of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्य एकविंशतिकल्पकथानकवर्णनं नाम त्रयोदशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १४ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: ततस्त ऋषयः सर्वे महाभागास्तपोधनाः । गतास्तु परमं लोकं ततः किं जातमद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmya ekaviṃśatikalpakathānakavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 14 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: tatasta ṛṣayaḥ sarve mahābhāgāstapodhanāḥ / gatāstu paramaṃ lokaṃ tataḥ kiṃ jātamadbhutam
verses.translation: A person who has come thus (to this stage) due to knowledge,.should not perform any action due to passion. After experiencing the Rajasic and Tamasic fruits, he becomes attached there.
verses.hindi: स्वच्छुन्द भाव से व्यवस्था द्वारा पक्षियों को बनाया ।३३-४१। वे छादन करते हैं, छन्‍्द और वयस् द्वारा सृष्टि
verses.wordMeaning: A person who has come thus (to this stage) due to knowledge,.should not perform any action due to passion. After experiencing the Rajasic and Tamasic fruits, he becomes attached there.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who has come thus (to this stage) due to knowledge,.should not perform any action due to passion. After experiencing the Rajasic and Tamasic fruits, he becomes attached there.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु नर्मदातीरवासिषु । बभूव रौद्रसंहारः सर्वभूतक्षयंकरः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tatasteṣu prayāteṣu narmadātīravāsiṣu / babhūva raudrasaṃhāraḥ sarvabhūtakṣayaṃkaraḥ
verses.translation: Similarly the man who has performed meritorious actions enjoys the fruits in heaven. Fallen from that region, he is born again as a human being.
verses.hindi: + घनुदिचल्वान्तगंतश्लोको न दृश्यते ख. ग. घ. पुस्तकेषु ।
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly the man who has performed meritorious actions enjoys the fruits in heaven. Fallen from that region, he is born again as a human being.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly the man who has performed meritorious actions enjoys the fruits in heaven. Fallen from that region, he is born again as a human being.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासशिखरस्थं तु महादेवं सनातनम् । ब्रह्माद्याः प्रास्तुवन् देवम् ऋग्यजुःसामभिः शिवम्
verses.transliteration: kailāsaśikharasthaṃ tu mahādevaṃ sanātanam / brahmādyāḥ prāstuvan devam ṛgyajuḥsāmabhiḥ śivam
verses.translation: Brahman is therefore, supreme and subtle. Brahman is. said to be eternal. One should devote oneself to Brahman as Brahman is the supreme bliss.
verses.hindi: छाद्यतस्तानि च्छुदांसि वयसो5पि वयांस्थपि । शुन्यान्दृष्ट्वा तु देवो वे सृजत्पक्षिगणानपि..
verses.wordMeaning: Brahman is therefore, supreme and subtle. Brahman is. said to be eternal. One should devote oneself to Brahman as Brahman is the supreme bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahman is therefore, supreme and subtle. Brahman is. said to be eternal. One should devote oneself to Brahman as Brahman is the supreme bliss.

verses.sanskrit: संहर त्वं जगद् देव सदेवासुरमानुषम् । प्राप्तो युगसहस्रान्तः कालः संहरणक्षमः
verses.transliteration: saṃhara tvaṃ jagad deva sadevāsuramānuṣam / prāpto yugasahasrāntaḥ kālaḥ saṃharaṇakṣamaḥ
verses.translation: There is great exertion in performing sacrifice requiring great deal of (expenditure of) wealth. Moreover he (the sacrificer) is subject to death. Salvation therefore is the greatest bliss.
verses.hindi: मुखतो5जान्ससर्जाथ वक्षसभ्र वयोउसुजत् । गाश्ववाथोदरादुब्रह्मा पार्शवाभ्यां च विनिमसे..
verses.wordMeaning: There is great exertion in performing sacrifice requiring great deal of (expenditure of) wealth. Moreover he (the sacrificer) is subject to death. Salvation therefore is the greatest bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is great exertion in performing sacrifice requiring great deal of (expenditure of) wealth. Moreover he (the sacrificer) is subject to death. Salvation therefore is the greatest bliss.

verses.sanskrit: मद्रूपं तु समास्थाय त्वया चैतद्विनिर्मितम् । वैष्णवीं मूर्तिमास्थाय त्वयैतत्परिपालितम्
verses.transliteration: madrūpaṃ tu samāsthāya tvayā caitadvinirmitam / vaiṣṇavīṃ mūrtimāsthāya tvayaitatparipālitam
verses.translation: But he who is engaged in meditation and devoted to the sacrifice of Brahman cannot be reached even in hundreds of Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: उन्दकाः पशवः सुष्टा: सप्तमास्तु सरोसुपाः । गायत्र॑ वरुणं चंव त्रिबृत्सोम्यं रथंतरम् ४८ अग्निष्टोमं च यज्ञानां निर्ममे प्रथमान्मुखात् । छन्दांसि त्रेष्टुभं कर्म स्तोम पश्चदर्श तथा ४६ बृहत्साममथोक्थं च दक्षिणात्सोइसुजन्मुखात् । (सामानि जगती छन्दःस्तोमं पत्चदर्श तथा
verses.wordMeaning: But he who is engaged in meditation and devoted to the sacrifice of Brahman cannot be reached even in hundreds of Manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: But he who is engaged in meditation and devoted to the sacrifice of Brahman cannot be reached even in hundreds of Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: एका मूर्तिस्त्रिधा जाता ब्राह्मी शैवी च वैष्णवी । सृष्टिसंहाररक्षार्थं भवेदेवं महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: ekā mūrtistridhā jātā brāhmī śaivī ca vaiṣṇavī / sṛṣṭisaṃhārarakṣārthaṃ bhavedevaṃ maheśvara
verses.translation: He visualizes the divine Purusa that is called the Vtiva (all-pervading). He appears in various forms. He has feet, heads and necks everywhere (pervades the Universe). He is the Lord and the creator of the Universe. He has the cosmic fragrance, is garlanded cosmically and robed in cosmic apparel. He is the Ruler of all.
verses.hindi: हुए हैं, इसलिये वे वयः पदवाच्य हैं। शुन्य को देखकर उन्होंने पक्षियों को बनाया ।४२। मुख से बकरे की सृष्टि हुई और वक्ष:स्थल से वयस् की। ब्रह्मा ने उदर के पाइ्वंद्य से गौओं को बनाया ।४३। उनके दोनों पुरों से अश्व, हस्ती, शरभ, गवय, मृग, ऊंट, अइवतर और इसी जाति के अन्य पशुगण उत्पन्न हुए ।४४। रोमों से ओषधि और फल-फूल उत्न हुए। प्रभ ब्रह्मा ने इस प्रकार उस त्रेतायुग के आदि कल्प में पशुओं और
verses.wordMeaning: He visualizes the divine Purusa that is called the Vtiva (all-pervading). He appears in various forms. He has feet, heads and necks everywhere (pervades the Universe). He is the Lord and the creator of the Universe. He has the cosmic fragrance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He visualizes the divine Purusa that is called the Vtiva (all-pervading). He appears in various forms. He has feet, heads and necks everywhere (pervades the Universe). He is the Lord and the creator of the Universe. He has the cosmic fragrance,…

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तथ्यं विष्णोश्च परमेष्ठिनः । सगणः सपरीवारः सह ताभ्यां सहोमया
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā vacastathyaṃ viṣṇośca parameṣṭhinaḥ / sagaṇaḥ saparīvāraḥ saha tābhyāṃ sahomayā
verses.translation: By means of their sense-organs people endeavour to visualize him who is the winged noble soul, the most excellent and the greatest Soul. But it is not with the eyes but with the mental concentration called Yoga that they can see the omni¬ scient, ancient governor (Teacher) who is subtler than the subt¬ lest, greater than the greatest, the Purusa of golden complexion, devoid of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: ओषधियों की सृष्टि करके यज्ञ काये में उनका विनियोग किया  गो, अज, पुरुष, मेष, अश्व, अश्वतर, गद्ंभ ये ग्राम्य पशु हैं । अब जंगली पशुओं को भी सूनिये ।४५-४६३। श्वापद, दिखुर, हस्ती, वानर, पक्षी, उन्दक (ऊदविलाव ) और सरीसूप ये जंगली पशु हैं । गायत्र, वरुण, त्रिवृत, सौम्य, रथन्तर, अग्निष्टोम आदि श्रेष्ठ यज्ञ उनके पूर्व मुख से उत्पन्न हुए। छन्दः सकल, त्रेष्टुभ, कर्म, स्तोम, पञ्चदश बृहत्साम, उक्थ्य इत्यादि उनके
verses.wordMeaning: By means of their sense-organs people endeavour to visualize him who is the winged noble soul, the most excellent and the greatest Soul. But it is not with the eyes but with the mental concentration called Yoga that they can see the omni¬ scient,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of their sense-organs people endeavour to visualize him who is the winged noble soul, the most excellent and the greatest Soul. But it is not with the eyes but with the mental concentration called Yoga that they can see the omni¬ scient,…

verses.sanskrit: समलोकान्विभिद्येमान्भगवान्नीललोहितः । भूराद्यब्रह्मलोकान्तं भित्त्वाण्डं परतः परम्
verses.transliteration: samalokānvibhidyemānbhagavānnīlalohitaḥ / bhūrādyabrahmalokāntaṃ bhittvāṇḍaṃ parataḥ param
verses.translation: They always see Purusa who is golden in colour, en¬ dowed with or without exterior symbols, devoid of attributes, conscious, eternal, all-pervading and pure. By means of Yoga, they see the steady light.
verses.hindi: दक्षिण मुख से उत्पन्न हुए। साम, जगती छुन्द के पन्द्रह प्रकार के भेद, वेरूप्य, अतिरात्र इत्यादि पश्चिम मुख से और इक्कीस प्रकार का अथवं, आप्तोर्यामाण, अनुष्ट्पू बेराज आदि उनके उत्तर मुख से सृष्टि हुए ।४७-४१३। प्रभु ब्रह्मा ने कल्प के आदि काल में बिजली, वज्ञ, मेघ, रोहितवर्ण इन्द्रधनूष ओर वयस् का सृजन किया एवं छोटे-बड़े जीव-जन्तु उनके शरीर से उत्पन्त हुए ।५२-५३। प्रजा की सृष्टि करने वाले प्रजापति
verses.wordMeaning: They always see Purusa who is golden in colour, en¬ dowed with or without exterior symbols, devoid of attributes, conscious, eternal, all-pervading and pure. By means of Yoga, they see the steady light.
verses.commentary: Sense: They always see Purusa who is golden in colour, en¬ dowed with or without exterior symbols, devoid of attributes, conscious, eternal, all-pervading and pure. By means of Yoga, they see the steady light.

verses.sanskrit: शैवं पदम् अजं दिव्यम् आविशत् सह तैर्विभुः । न तत्र वायुर् नाकाशं नाग्निस्तत्र न भूतलम्
verses.transliteration: śaivaṃ padam ajaṃ divyam āviśat saha tairvibhuḥ / na tatra vāyur nākāśaṃ nāgnistatra na bhūtalam
verses.translation: Manifested thereby He shines in his own refulgence. He is devoid of heads, feet, belly, sides and tongue, but he, though beyond the ken of senses, though still extremely subtle and alone, can see without eyes and hear without ears.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणस्तु प्रजासर्ग सृजतो हि प्रजापते: । सृष्ट्वा चतुष्टय्य पूर्व देवासुरपितृन्प्रजाः ५४
verses.wordMeaning: Manifested thereby He shines in his own refulgence. He is devoid of heads, feet, belly, sides and tongue, but he, though beyond the ken of senses, though still extremely subtle and alone, can see without eyes and hear without ears.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manifested thereby He shines in his own refulgence. He is devoid of heads, feet, belly, sides and tongue, but he, though beyond the ken of senses, though still extremely subtle and alone, can see without eyes and hear without ears.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र संतिष्ठे देव उमया सह शङ्करः । न सूर्यो न ग्रहास्तत्र न ऋक्षाणि दिशस्तथा
verses.transliteration: yatra saṃtiṣṭhe deva umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ / na sūryo na grahāstatra na ṛkṣāṇi diśastathā
verses.translation: There is nothing that is not known to him; yet he has no intellect. He knows all, yet he is not known to the Vedas. They call him the foremost or the first Purusa, the great, the sentient, all-pervading and very subtle.
verses.hindi: तेषां ये यानि कर्माणि प्रावसुष्ट्यां प्रतिपेविरे । तान्येब प्रतिपच्न्ते सुज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः ५७ हिल्लाहिल मृदुक्रे धर्मा ध्मावतानृते । तद्भाविताः प्रपद्चन्ते तस्मात्तत्तस्य रोचते ५८
verses.wordMeaning: There is nothing that is not known to him; yet he has no intellect. He knows all, yet he is not known to the Vedas. They call him the foremost or the first Purusa, the great, the sentient, all-pervading and very subtle.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is nothing that is not known to him; yet he has no intellect. He knows all, yet he is not known to the Vedas. They call him the foremost or the first Purusa, the great, the sentient, all-pervading and very subtle.

verses.sanskrit: न लोकपाला न सुखं न च दुःखं नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: na lokapālā na sukhaṃ na ca duḥkhaṃ nṛpottama
verses.translation: All sages call that Prakrti, which gives birth to living beings in this world. Those who are engaged in Yoga, can visualize it mentally.
verses.hindi: केचित्युरुषकारं तु प्राहः कमं च मानवाः । देवमित्यपरे विप्राः स्वभाव देवचिन्तकाः ३६० पौरुषं कर्म देव॑ च फलवृत्तिस्वभावतः। न चेक॑ न पृथग्भावमधिकं न तयोविदुः ६१ एतदेवं (कं) च नेक च न चोभे न च वाणप्युमे । कमस्थान्विषयान्त्र॒युः सत्त्वस्था ससमदर्शिन: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: All sages call that Prakrti, which gives birth to living beings in this world. Those who are engaged in Yoga, can visualize it mentally.
verses.commentary: Sense: All sages call that Prakrti, which gives birth to living beings in this world. Those who are engaged in Yoga, can visualize it mentally.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मं पदं यत्कवयो वदन्ति शैवं पदं यत्कवयो वदन्ति । क्षेत्रज्ञमीशं प्रवदन्ति चान्ये सांख्याश्च गायन्ति किलादिमोक्षम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti śaivaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti / kṣetrajñamīśaṃ pravadanti cānye sāṃkhyāśca gāyanti kilādimokṣam
verses.translation: Those who are engaged in Yogic meditation on the eternal Purusa who is endowed with hands and feet, eyes, heads and faces (mouths), ears on all sides and who stays after permeating everything in the world (who is both immanent and transcendent) and who governs everything, does not become deluded.
verses.hindi: नाम रूप च भूतानां कृतानां च प्रपच्चनम् । वेदशब्देस्थ एवा55दो निम॑से स महेश्वरः ६३
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are engaged in Yogic meditation on the eternal Purusa who is endowed with hands and feet, eyes, heads and faces (mouths), ears on all sides and who stays after permeating everything in the world (who is both immanent and transcendent) and who governs everything,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are engaged in Yogic meditation on the eternal Purusa who is endowed with hands and feet, eyes, heads and faces (mouths), ears on all sides and who stays after permeating everything in the world (who is both immanent and transcendent) and who governs everything,…

verses.sanskrit: यद्ब्रह्म आद्यं प्रवदन्ति केचिद्यं सर्वमीशानमजं पुराणम् । तम् एकरूपं तम् अनेकरूपम् अरूपम् आद्यं परम् अव्ययाख्यम्
verses.transliteration: yadbrahma ādyaṃ pravadanti kecidyaṃ sarvamīśānamajaṃ purāṇam / tam ekarūpaṃ tam anekarūpam arūpam ādyaṃ param avyayākhyam
verses.translation: One does not get deluded after meditating on the supreme Brahman, the Soul of all living beings, the imperish¬ able, noble, supreme soul, the soul of all.
verses.hindi: एवंविधासु सृष्टासु ब्रह्मणा5व्यक्तजन्मना  शबयन्ते प्रदृश्यन्ते सिद्धिमाश्रित्य मानसोम् ६६
verses.wordMeaning: One does not get deluded after meditating on the supreme Brahman, the Soul of all living beings, the imperish¬ able, noble, supreme soul, the soul of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: One does not get deluded after meditating on the supreme Brahman, the Soul of all living beings, the imperish¬ able, noble, supreme soul, the soul of all.

verses.sanskrit: अवर्णमप्यर्थम् अनामगोत्रं तुर्यं पदं यत्कवयो वदन्ति । ध्यानार्थविज्ञानमयं सुसूक्ष्मम् आत्मस्थम् ईशानवरं वरेण्यम्
verses.transliteration: avarṇamapyartham anāmagotraṃ turyaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti / dhyānārthavijñānamayaṃ susūkṣmam ātmastham īśānavaraṃ vareṇyam
verses.translation: Just as the (presence of the) wind is to be admitted as evident through its movement in clouds, so is that of the Atman that moves through the bodies of all. Since the Soul abides in the body, it is named Purusa. When the merit is ex¬ hausted due to specific Karmans he is born and re-born in the womb by the mixture of semen and blood as a result of the mixture of male and female flesh. 1
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा ने पहले देव, असुर पितर प्रजा नामक चार प्रकार की सृष्टि करके स्थावर-चरादि अच्यान्य भूतों को
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the (presence of the) wind is to be admitted as evident through its movement in clouds, so is that of the Atman that moves through the bodies of all. Since the Soul abides in the body, it is named Purusa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the (presence of the) wind is to be admitted as evident through its movement in clouds, so is that of the Atman that moves through the bodies of all. Since the Soul abides in the body, it is named Purusa.…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्रयस्ते भगवन्तमीशं सम्प्राप्य संक्षिप्य भवन्त्यर्थकम् । पृथक्स्वरूपैस्तु पुनस्त एव जगत् समस्तं परिपालयन्ति
verses.transliteration: tatastrayaste bhagavantamīśaṃ samprāpya saṃkṣipya bhavantyarthakam / pṛthaksvarūpaistu punasta eva jagat samastaṃ paripālayanti
verses.translation: Then, at the time of conception, Kalana, the embryo at its first stage (in the form of a drop) is formed. In due course the Kalana develops into bubbles.
verses.hindi: स्थावर, जंगम आदि समस्त पदार्थों को बनाया ।५४-५६। पहली सृष्टि में इन लोगों ने जेसा कम प्राप्त किया था, वेंसा ही कर्म इन लोगों ने बार-बार उत्पन्त किये जाने पर भी पाया ।५७। उसी कर्म-वासना के अनुरूप वे सब पृथक्-पृथक प्रवृत्ति वाले होते हैं ।५७। इसीसे वे सब हिस, अहिंख, मृदु, क्र, धमं, अधमें, सत्य, अनृतादि विविध कर्म में अपनी इच्छा के अनुसार प्रवृत्त होते हैं ।/८। विधाता ने स्वयं ही महाभूतों का
verses.wordMeaning: Then, at the time of conception, Kalana, the embryo at its first stage (in the form of a drop) is formed. In due course the Kalana develops into bubbles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, at the time of conception, Kalana, the embryo at its first stage (in the form of a drop) is formed. In due course the Kalana develops into bubbles.

verses.sanskrit: संहारं सर्वभूतानां रुद्रत्वे कुरुते प्रभुः । विष्णुत्वे पालयेल्लोकान्ब्रह्मत्वे सृष्टिकारकः
verses.transliteration: saṃhāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ rudratve kurute prabhuḥ / viṣṇutve pālayellokānbrahmatve sṛṣṭikārakaḥ
verses.translation: Just as a lump of clay pressed by the wind in the potter's wheel and shaped by the hands (of the potter) attains multifarious shapes, so also the foetus united with bones and impelled by the wind becomes a human body with proper forms, features and mind.
verses.hindi: नानात्व और मूत्ति तथा इन्द्रिया्थ समूहों की व्यवहार-रीति को निश्चित किया है ।६६। बिप्रगण ! कोई पुरुषाकार, कोई दंव और कोई स्वभाव को ही कमंफलदायक कहकर निरूपण करते हैं ।६०। किन्तु पुरुषाकार, दंव ओर कर्म ये तीनों ही स्वभाव के वश फलसाधक हैं। इनके बीच न्यूनाधिक भाव नहीं है; प्रत्येक समान भाव से प्रधान हैं। कोई कर्म इनमें एक के द्वारा सम्पन्त होता है, यह कहा नहीं जा सकता ।
verses.wordMeaning: Just as a lump of clay pressed by the wind in the potter's wheel and shaped by the hands (of the potter) attains multifarious shapes, so also the foetus united with bones and impelled by the wind becomes a human body with proper forms, features and mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a lump of clay pressed by the wind in the potter's wheel and shaped by the hands (of the potter) attains multifarious shapes, so also the foetus united with bones and impelled by the wind becomes a human body with proper forms, features and mind.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृत्या सह संयुक्तः कालो भूत्वा महेश्वरः । विश्वरूपा महाभागा तस्य पार्श्वे व्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration: prakṛtyā saha saṃyuktaḥ kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ / viśvarūpā mahābhāgā tasya pārśve vyavasthitā
verses.translation: The wind assembles them together. From the wind water is generated. From the water the vital breath is formed and through the vital breath the semen gets developed.
verses.hindi: कर्म स।बन समूह का एकत्व-द्वित्वादि भेद कर निर्वाचन भी नहीं किया जा सकता; इसलिये सत्त्वस्थ ब्रह्मनिष्ठगण
verses.wordMeaning: The wind assembles them together. From the wind water is generated. From the water the vital breath is formed and through the vital breath the semen gets developed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wind assembles them together. From the wind water is generated. From the water the vital breath is formed and through the vital breath the semen gets developed.

verses.sanskrit: यामाहुः प्रकृतिं तज्ज्ञाः पदार्थानां विचक्षणाः । पुरुषत्वे प्रकृतित्वे च कारणं परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yāmāhuḥ prakṛtiṃ tajjñāḥ padārthānāṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ / puruṣatve prakṛtitve ca kāraṇaṃ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The child in the womb is covered by the five vital breaths. From the father's body he inherits his forms and features..
verses.hindi: समूह के नाम, रूप और कर्मादि का निर्माण किया है। रात्रि के अवसान में और दिन के प्रारम्भ काल में भगवान् ब्रह्मा पूर्व काल के वेदों का प्रकाश करते हैं और ऋषिगण भी पू्वंकालीन नाम प्रगट करते हैं। विभिन्‍न ऋतुकाल में जिस प्रकार ऋतु-चिक्न विविध आकार में व्यक्त होते हैं, उसी प्रकार विभिन्‍न युग में
verses.wordMeaning: The child in the womb is covered by the five vital breaths. From the father's body he inherits his forms and features..
verses.commentary: Sense: The child in the womb is covered by the five vital breaths. From the father's body he inherits his forms and features..

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् एतज्जगत्सर्वं चराचरम् । तस्मिन्नेव लयं याति युगान्ते समुपस्थिते
verses.transliteration: tasmād etajjagatsarvaṃ carācaram / tasminneva layaṃ yāti yugānte samupasthite
verses.translation: The food of the mother, drunk or licked, enters through the umbilical cord and sustains the foetus in the womb.
verses.hindi: मरीतचि दक्षर्मात्न च वसिष्ठे चेव मानसम् । नव ब्रह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चय गताः ६६ तेषां ब्रह्मात्मकानां वे सर्वेषां ब्रह्मवादिनाम् । ततो5सुजत्पुनर्ब्रह्या रुद्रं रोषात्ससंभवम्॒ .
verses.wordMeaning: The food of the mother, drunk or licked, enters through the umbilical cord and sustains the foetus in the womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: The food of the mother, drunk or licked, enters through the umbilical cord and sustains the foetus in the womb.

verses.sanskrit: भगलिङ्गाङ्कितं सर्वं व्याप्तं वै परमेष्ठिना । भगरूपो भवेद्विष्णुर्लिङ्गरूपो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bhagaliṅgāṅkitaṃ sarvaṃ vyāptaṃ vai parameṣṭhinā / bhagarūpo bhavedviṣṇurliṅgarūpo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: For nine months the child suffers in the body with his neck encircled by the inner vessels of its mother. His limbs are covered in disorder. He remains there for nine months. He then comes out through the vaginal passage with the head downwards.
verses.hindi: संकल्प चेव धर्म च पुर्वेषामपि पूर्वजः । अग्रे ससर्ज व ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समान्ू ७१ सनन्‍दन ससनक॑ विद्वांस च सनातनम् । सनत्कुमारं च विभु सनक॑ च सननन्‍्दनम्
verses.wordMeaning: For nine months the child suffers in the body with his neck encircled by the inner vessels of its mother. His limbs are covered in disorder. He remains there for nine months. He then comes out through the vaginal passage with the head downwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: For nine months the child suffers in the body with his neck encircled by the inner vessels of its mother. His limbs are covered in disorder. He remains there for nine months. He then comes out through the vaginal passage with the head downwards.

verses.sanskrit: भाति सर्वेषु लोकेषु गीयते भूर्भुवादिषु । प्रविष्टः सर्वभूतेषु तेन विष्णुर्भगः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: bhāti sarveṣu lokeṣu gīyate bhūrbhuvādiṣu / praviṣṭaḥ sarvabhūteṣu tena viṣṇurbhagaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Then (in his life on the earth) he commits some sinful actions and as a result he goes to the hell (after death), Asipatravana or Salmali where he is cut or pierced. 2
verses.hindi: न ते लोकेषु सज्जन्ते निरपेक्षाः सनातनाः। सर्वे ते ह्यागतज्ञाना वीतरागा विमत्सराः ७३ तेष्वेब॑ निरपेक्षेषु लोकवृत्तानुकारणात् । हिरण्यगर्भो भगवान्परमेष्ठी ह्ाचिन्तयत् ७४ तस्य रोधात्समुत्पन्नः पुरुषो5केसमञुतिः । अर्धनारीनरवपुस्तेजसा ज्वलनोपमः
verses.wordMeaning: Then (in his life on the earth) he commits some sinful actions and as a result he goes to the hell (after death), Asipatravana or Salmali where he is cut or pierced. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Then (in his life on the earth) he commits some sinful actions and as a result he goes to the hell (after death), Asipatravana or Salmali where he is cut or pierced. 2

verses.sanskrit: विशनाद्विष्णुरित्युक्तः सर्वदेवमयो महान् । भासनाद्गमनाच्चैव भगसंज्ञा प्रकीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: viśanādviṣṇurityuktaḥ sarvadevamayo mahān / bhāsanādgamanāccaiva bhagasaṃjñā prakīrtitā
verses.translation: Verses 16-25 give Purajiic (Mediaeval) ideas on Embryology.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्‍्त्वा द्विधा सुतः पृथक्स्त्री पुदषः पृथक् । स चेकादशधा जज्ञे अर्धभात्मानमीश्वर:... ७७
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 16-25 give Purajiic (Mediaeval) ideas on Embryology.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 16-25 give Purajiic (Mediaeval) ideas on Embryology.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं यस्मिन्नेति लयं जगत् । एकभावं समापन्नं लिङ्गं तस्माद् विदुर्बुधाः
verses.transliteration: brahmādistambaparyantaṃ yasminneti layaṃ jagat / ekabhāvaṃ samāpannaṃ liṅgaṃ tasmād vidurbudhāḥ
verses.translation: Verses 25-31 describe the tortures in hell.
verses.hindi: भाव समूह भी विविध आकार में प्रकाशित होता है । अव्यक्त जस्मा ब्रह्मा रात्रि के अवसान में मानसी सिद्धि के द्वारा प्रतिदिन इसी प्रकार सृष्टि कर्म में भ्रवृत्त होते हैं। वे प्रत्येक दिन इसी प्रकार स्थावर जंगम आदि की सृष्टि करते हैं ॥ जब उन्होंने देखा कि इस प्रकार प्रजा वृद्धि नहीं हो रही है, तब भृगु, पुलस्त्य, पुलह, ऋ्रतु, अज्धिरा, मरीचि, दक्ष, अन्नि, और वस्तिष्ठ नामक दस मानस पुत्रों को उत्पन्त किया । ये ही नव ब्रह्माण
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 25-31 describe the tortures in hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 25-31 describe the tortures in hell.

verses.sanskrit: महादेवस्ततो देवीमाह पार्श्वे स्थितां तदा । संहरस्व जगत्सर्वं मा विलम्बस्व शोभने
verses.transliteration: mahādevastato devīmāha pārśve sthitāṃ tadā / saṃharasva jagatsarvaṃ mā vilambasva śobhane
verses.translation: In the hell, he is rebuked and threatened. He is forced to drink blood. These are the terrible tortures he has to undergo in Kumbhipaka. They are very unbearable.
verses.hindi: नाम से पुराणों में प्रसिद्ध हैं। ६३-६८। ये सभी ब्रह्मवादी और ब्रह्म चय निष्ठ हुए । तब ब्रह्मा ने फिर अपने रोष से रुद्र की सृष्टि की । सबके पुरोवर्ती ब्रह्मा ने सद्धूल्प और धर्म को भी बनाया  ब्रह्मा ने सबके आगे सनन्‍दन, समक, सनातन और सनत्कुमार नामक अपने समान ब्रह्मनिष्ठ पुत्रों को उत्पन्‍्त किया । किन्तु वे सब संसार में आसक्त नहीं हुए प्रत्युत निरपेक्ष, जिते रिद्रय, वीतराग, विमत्सर और भविष्य ज्ञान-सम्पन्न हुए । हिरण्यगर्भ
verses.wordMeaning: In the hell, he is rebuked and threatened. He is forced to drink blood. These are the terrible tortures he has to undergo in Kumbhipaka. They are very unbearable.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the hell, he is rebuked and threatened. He is forced to drink blood. These are the terrible tortures he has to undergo in Kumbhipaka. They are very unbearable.

verses.sanskrit: त्यज सौम्यमिदं रूपं सितचन्द्रांशुनिर्मलम् । रुद्रं रूपं समास्थाय संहरस्व चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: tyaja saumyamidaṃ rūpaṃ sitacandrāṃśunirmalam / rudraṃ rūpaṃ samāsthāya saṃharasva carācaram
verses.translation: Just as waters though parted regain their normal form, so also the hellish beings though cut and broken in torturing hells regain their original form.
verses.hindi: परमेष्ठी भगवान् ब्रह्मा उन पुत्रों को निरपेन ब्रह्मनिष्ठ होते देखकर चिन्ता करने लगे ।६६-७४। उनके ऋध करने से सूये के समान कान्तिवाली, अग्नि के समान जलती हुई एक मूर्ति उत्पन्त हुई जिसका आधा धरीर स्त्री का और आधा पुरुष का था। उसके उत्पन्न होते ही चारों ओर सूर्य के समान प्रकाश फल गया । वह मूर्ति बोल उठी-- अपने को विभक्त करो, यह कहकर वह पुरुष अन्तहित हो गया  इस तरह कहे
verses.wordMeaning: Just as waters though parted regain their normal form, so also the hellish beings though cut and broken in torturing hells regain their original form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as waters though parted regain their normal form, so also the hellish beings though cut and broken in torturing hells regain their original form.

verses.sanskrit: रौद्रैर्भूतगणैर्घोरैर्देवि त्वं परिवारिता । जीवलोकमिमं सर्वं भक्षयस्वाम्बुजेक्षणे
verses.transliteration: raudrairbhūtagaṇairghorairdevi tvaṃ parivāritā / jīvalokamimaṃ sarvaṃ bhakṣayasvāmbujekṣaṇe
verses.translation: Thus the living beings become agitated and tortured through their own sins. If there is anything left over, they take other, births.
verses.hindi: जाने पर भगवान ब्रह्मा ने अपने को दो भागों में विभक्त किया--एक स्त्री और एक पुरुष ॥७५-:६४। अपनी आधी आत्मा यानी पुरुष मूर्ति को उन्होंने ग्यारह भागों में विभकत किया और कहा कि महात्मन् ! तुम लोग संसार के हित-विधानाथ सृष्टि विस्तार एवं सृष्टि प्रजाओं की मज्धल व्यवस्था करने के लिये अनलस भाव से
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the living beings become agitated and tortured through their own sins. If there is anything left over, they take other, births.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the living beings become agitated and tortured through their own sins. If there is anything left over, they take other, births.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽहं मर्दयिष्यामि प्लावयिष्ये तथा जगत् । कृत्वा चैकार्णवं भूयः सुखं स्वप्स्ये त्वया सह
verses.transliteration: tato 'haṃ mardayiṣyāmi plāvayiṣye tathā jagat / kṛtvā caikārṇavaṃ bhūyaḥ sukhaṃ svapsye tvayā saha
verses.translation: Man must go alone to the abode of death. He must bear the punishments alone. Hence one should perform pious deeds.
verses.hindi: नवमीष्ध्यायः ७है
verses.wordMeaning: Man must go alone to the abode of death. He must bear the punishments alone. Hence one should perform pious deeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Man must go alone to the abode of death. He must bear the punishments alone. Hence one should perform pious deeds.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेव्युवाच: नाहं देव जगच्चैतत्संहरामि महाद्युते । अम्बा भूत्वा विचेष्टं न भक्षयामि भृशातुरम्
verses.transliteration: śrīdevyuvāca: nāhaṃ deva jagaccaitatsaṃharāmi mahādyute / ambā bhūtvā viceṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayāmi bhṛśāturam
verses.translation: None follows him who proceeds along the path of death. But the actions performed by him pursue him.
verses.hindi: लोकजृत्तान्तहेतोहि प्रयतध्वमतन्द्रिता । विश्व विश्वस्थ लोकस्य स्थापनाय हिताय च ७६९
verses.wordMeaning: None follows him who proceeds along the path of death. But the actions performed by him pursue him.
verses.commentary: Sense: None follows him who proceeds along the path of death. But the actions performed by him pursue him.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीस्वभावेन कारुण्यं करोति हृदयं मम । कथं वै निर्दहिष्यामि जगद् एतज्जगत्पते
verses.transliteration: strīsvabhāvena kāruṇyaṃ karoti hṛdayaṃ mama / kathaṃ vai nirdahiṣyāmi jagad etajjagatpate
verses.translation: The hellish beings always cry in the abode of Yama when they are pierced or when tortures are inflicted on their bodies. Their bodies being tortured get withered up and suffer extreme pain caused by evil harassments.
verses.hindi: यहि व्याप्तसिदं सर्वे त्रलोक्यं सचराचरम्। तेषामनुत्तरा लोके स्वलोकपरायण:: ॥८ १ नकनागायुतबला विक़रान्ताभ्र गणेश्वरा: । तत्र या सा सहाभागा शंकरस्यथाधंकायिनो ८२
verses.wordMeaning: The hellish beings always cry in the abode of Yama when they are pierced or when tortures are inflicted on their bodies. Their bodies being tortured get withered up and suffer extreme pain caused by evil harassments.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hellish beings always cry in the abode of Yama when they are pierced or when tortures are inflicted on their bodies. Their bodies being tortured get withered up and suffer extreme pain caused by evil harassments.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्वं स्वयमेवेदं जगत्संहर शङ्कर । अथैवमुक्तस्तां देवीं धूर्जटिर्नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tvaṃ svayamevedaṃ jagatsaṃhara śaṅkara / athaivamuktastāṃ devīṃ dhūrjaṭirnīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: The sin may forcibly remove everything desirable re¬ sorted to by him mentally, verbally or physically. Hence one should perform meritorious deeds.
verses.hindi: प्रागुक्ता न मया तुंभ्य॑ स्त्री स्वयंभोमुंखोद्गता । कायाधे दक्षिणं तस्या: शुक्ल वाम॑ तथाइसितम ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The sin may forcibly remove everything desirable re¬ sorted to by him mentally, verbally or physically. Hence one should perform meritorious deeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin may forcibly remove everything desirable re¬ sorted to by him mentally, verbally or physically. Hence one should perform meritorious deeds.

verses.sanskrit: क्रुद्धो निर्भर्त्सयामास हुङ्कारेण महेश्वरीम् । ॐ हुंफट् त्वं स इत्याह कोपाविष्टैर् अथेक्षणैः
verses.transliteration: kruddho nirbhartsayāmāsa huṅkāreṇa maheśvarīm / oṃ huṃphaṭ tvaṃ sa ityāha kopāviṣṭair athekṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: In accordance with the sinful actions committed by him previously, the embodied being undergoes six types of worldly transmigrations of Tdmasa nature. 1
verses.hindi: आत्मानं विभजस्वेति सोक्ता देवी स्वयंभुवा । सा तु प्रोक्ता द्विधा भृता शुक्ला कृष्णा च बे द्विजा:॥ तस्या नामानि वक्ष्यासि शुण॒ध्वं सुसमाहिताः । स्वाहा स्वधा महाविद्या मेधा लक्ष्मी: सरस्वती
verses.wordMeaning: In accordance with the sinful actions committed by him previously, the embodied being undergoes six types of worldly transmigrations of Tdmasa nature. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: In accordance with the sinful actions committed by him previously, the embodied being undergoes six types of worldly transmigrations of Tdmasa nature. 1

verses.sanskrit: हुंकारिता विशालाक्षी पीनोरुजघनस्थला । तत्क्षणाच्चाभवद्रौद्रा कालरात्रीव भारत
verses.transliteration: huṃkāritā viśālākṣī pīnorujaghanasthalā / tatkṣaṇāccābhavadraudrā kālarātrīva bhārata
verses.translation: They are: Birth as human beings; as domestic animals (Pa$u); from the state of Pastt (he becomes) a wild animal; from that stage (he goes to) the birds; from 'bird-hood* to reptiles; from reptilehood he certainly becomes an immobile. He who has attained the immobile state evolves into a human being. He thus rotates like one propelled by the potter's wheel.
verses.hindi: अपर्णा चेकपर्णा च तथा स्यादेव पाटला। उसा हैमवती षष्ठी कल्याणी चेव नामतः
verses.wordMeaning: They are: Birth as human beings; as domestic animals (Pa$u); from the state of Pastt (he becomes) a wild animal; from that stage (he goes to) the birds; from 'bird-hood* to reptiles; from reptilehood he certainly becomes an immobile.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are: Birth as human beings; as domestic animals (Pa$u); from the state of Pastt (he becomes) a wild animal; from that stage (he goes to) the birds; from 'bird-hood* to reptiles; from reptilehood he certainly becomes an immobile.…

verses.sanskrit: हुंकुर्वती महानादैर्नादयन्ती दिशो दश । व्यवर्धत महारौद्रा विद्युत्सौदामिनी यथा
verses.transliteration: huṃkurvatī mahānādairnādayantī diśo daśa / vyavardhata mahāraudrā vidyutsaudāminī yathā
verses.translation: Thus in this migration six types of birth beginning with that as man and ending with that as plant are known as Tamasa. He undergoes many changes there.
verses.hindi: र्यातिः प्रज्ञा महाभागा लोके गौरीति विश्वुता । विश्वरूपमथार्ब्यायाः प्रथग्देहविभावनात्ु.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus in this migration six types of birth beginning with that as man and ending with that as plant are known as Tamasa. He undergoes many changes there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus in this migration six types of birth beginning with that as man and ending with that as plant are known as Tamasa. He undergoes many changes there.

verses.sanskrit: विद्युत्सम्पातदुष्प्रेक्ष्या विद्युत्संघातचञ्चला । विद्युज्ज्वालाकुला रौद्रा विद्युदग्निनिभेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: vidyutsampātaduṣprekṣyā vidyutsaṃghātacañcalā / vidyujjvālākulā raudrā vidyudagninibhekṣaṇā
verses.translation: The life in hell and evolution through six stages upto that of man show the acceptance of the principle of redemption. No sinner is condemned to eternal hell.
verses.hindi: कालरात्रिमहामाया रेवती मृतनायिका । द्वापरान्तविकारेषु देव्या नामानि मे शणु ८६ गोतमी कौशिको आर्या चण्डी कात्यायनी सती । कुमारी यादवी देवी वरदा कृष्णपिह्गला
verses.wordMeaning: The life in hell and evolution through six stages upto that of man show the acceptance of the principle of redemption. No sinner is condemned to eternal hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: The life in hell and evolution through six stages upto that of man show the acceptance of the principle of redemption. No sinner is condemned to eternal hell.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तकेशी विशालाक्षी कृशग्रीवा कृशोदरी । व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरधरा व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनी
verses.transliteration: muktakeśī viśālākṣī kṛśagrīvā kṛśodarī / vyāghracarmāmbaradharā vyālayajñopavītinī
verses.translation: The transmigrations beginning.with Brahma and end¬ ing with Pifaca are known as Sattvika. Only in the celestial regions the embodied beings experience these.
verses.hindi: बहिध्वंजा शुलधरा परमब्रह्मचारिणी । माहेन्द्री चेनद्रभगिनी वृषकन्येकबाससी ॥६ १ अपराजिता बहुभूजा प्रगल्भा सिहवाहिनी । एकानंसा(शा) देत्यहनी साया सहिषमदिनी. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The transmigrations beginning.with Brahma and end¬ ing with Pifaca are known as Sattvika. Only in the celestial regions the embodied beings experience these.
verses.commentary: Sense: The transmigrations beginning.with Brahma and end¬ ing with Pifaca are known as Sattvika. Only in the celestial regions the embodied beings experience these.

verses.sanskrit: वृश्चिकैरग्निपुञ्जाभैर् गोनसैश्च विभूषिता । त्रैलोक्यं पूरयामास विस्तारेणोच्छ्रयेण च
verses.transliteration: vṛścikairagnipuñjābhair gonasaiśca vibhūṣitā / trailokyaṃ pūrayāmāsa vistāreṇocchrayeṇa ca
verses.translation: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn. It is due to the impressions of the previous pious actions that he attains human birth. Hence one should devote oneself entirely to Brahman.
verses.hindi: यत्न-परायण होओ । यह सुनकर वे रोने लगे और चारों ओर से द्रवित हो गये, अतः रोदन और प्रवण के कारण उनका नाम रुद्र पड़. ।७७-८०। ये रुद्रणण सम्पूर्ण चराचर और सृष्टि प्रपंच को व्याप्त करके विराजमान हैं। गणेश्वर रुद्रण सभी सिरजे हुए भूत प्रपंचों में श्रेष्ठ सर्वतोकपरायण अधिक विक्रमशील और अयुत नागों से भी अधिक बलवान हैं। हमने पहले ही कहा है कि दक्षिणारद्ध से शुक्लवर्ण और वामाडं से कृष्णवर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…

verses.sanskrit: भासुराङ्गा तु संवृत्ता कृष्णसर्पैककुण्डला । चित्रदण्डोद्यतकरा व्याघ्रचर्मोपसेविता
verses.transliteration: bhāsurāṅgā tu saṃvṛttā kṛṣṇasarpaikakuṇḍalā / citradaṇḍodyatakarā vyāghracarmopasevitā
verses.translation: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn. It is due to the impressions of the previous pious actions that he attains human birth. Hence one should devote oneself entirely to Brahman.
verses.hindi: दंकराद्ध शरीरिणी एक महाभागा देवी प्रादुभूत हुई। उस देवी से भगवान् ब्रह्मा ने देहविभाग करने को कहा। द्विजगण ! उन देवियों का नाम कहते हैं सुनिये। स्वाहा, स्वधा महाविद्या, मेधा, लक्ष्मी
verses.wordMeaning: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…

verses.sanskrit: व्यवर्धत महारौद्रा जगत्संहारकारिणी । सृक्किणी लेलिहाना च क्रूरफूत्कारकारिणी
verses.transliteration: vyavardhata mahāraudrā jagatsaṃhārakāriṇī / sṛkkiṇī lelihānā ca krūraphūtkārakāriṇī
verses.translation: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn. It is due to the impressions of the previous pious actions that he attains human birth. Hence one should devote oneself entirely to Brahman.
verses.hindi: इन आर्या देवियों ने ही पृथक्-पृथक् देह धारण कर सृष्टि को व्याप्त किया है ।5१-८७। संक्षेप से उनके और नामों को भी कहता हूँ--प्रकृति, नियता, रोद्री, दुर्गा, भद्रा, प्रमाथिनी, कालरात्रि, महामाया, रेवती भूत- नायिका । द्वापरादि युग में देवी जिन नामों से प्रसिद्ध होतो हैं उनको भो सुनिये ।८८-८९। गौतभी, कौशिकी, आर्या, चण्डी, कात्यायनी, सती, कुमारी, यादवी, देवी, वरदा, कृष्णा, पिंगला, बहिंध्वंजा, शूलधरा, परमन्रह्म-
verses.wordMeaning: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…

verses.sanskrit: व्यात्तास्या घुर्घुरारावा जगत्संक्षोभकारिणी । खेलद्भूतानुगा क्रूरा निःश्वासोच्छ्वासकारिणी
verses.transliteration: vyāttāsyā ghurghurārāvā jagatsaṃkṣobhakāriṇī / kheladbhūtānugā krūrā niḥśvāsocchvāsakāriṇī
verses.translation: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn. It is due to the impressions of the previous pious actions that he attains human birth. Hence one should devote oneself entirely to Brahman.
verses.hindi: चारिणी, भाहेन्द्री, इन्द्रभगिनी, वृषकन्या, एकब्राससी, क्षपराजिता, बहुभुजा, प्रगल्भा, सिहवाहिनी, एकानंशा,
verses.wordMeaning: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…

verses.sanskrit: जाताट्टअहासा दुर्नासा वह्निकुण्डसमेक्षणा । प्रोद्यत्किलकिलारावा ददाह सकलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: jātāṭṭaahāsā durnāsā vahnikuṇḍasamekṣaṇā / prodyatkilakilārāvā dadāha sakalaṃ jagat
verses.translation: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn. It is due to the impressions of the previous pious actions that he attains human birth. Hence one should devote oneself entirely to Brahman.
verses.hindi: अमोधा विन्ध्यनिलया विक्रान्ता गणनायिका  देवीनामविकाराणि इत्येतानि यथाक्रमम् ३६३ भद्गकाल्यास्तवोक्तानि देव्या नामानि तत्त्वतः  ये पठन्ति नरास्तेषां विद्यते न पराभवः ६४ अरण्ये प्रान्तरे बाउपि पुरे वाइपि गृहेईपि वा। रक्षामेतां प्रयुझजीत जले वाउपि स्थलेडपि वा
verses.wordMeaning: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…

verses.sanskrit: दह्यमानाः सुरास्तत्र पतन्ति धरणीतले । पतन्ति यक्षगन्धर्वाः सकिन्नरमहोरगाः
verses.transliteration: dahyamānāḥ surāstatra patanti dharaṇītale / patanti yakṣagandharvāḥ sakinnaramahoragāḥ
verses.translation: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn. It is due to the impressions of the previous pious actions that he attains human birth. Hence one should devote oneself entirely to Brahman.
verses.hindi: व्याप्रकुम्भी रचौरेभ्यो भूतस्थाने विशेषतः  आधिष्वि च॒ सर्वासु (बेंषु )देव्या नामानि कीतंयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…

verses.sanskrit: पतन्ति भूतसङ्घाश्च हाहाहैहैविराविणः । बुम्बापातैः सनिर्घातैर् उदितार्तस्वरैरपि
verses.transliteration: patanti bhūtasaṅghāśca hāhāhaihaivirāviṇaḥ / bumbāpātaiḥ sanirghātair uditārtasvarairapi
verses.translation: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn. It is due to the impressions of the previous pious actions that he attains human birth. Hence one should devote oneself entirely to Brahman.
verses.hindi: महादेवी कुले है तु प्रज्ञा श्रीश् प्रकीत्यंते । आभ्यां देवीसहस्नाणि यव्याप्तमखिल जगत् १६८ साउस॒जद्वसायं तु धर्म भुतसुखावहम् । संकल्पं चेब कल्पादो जशिरेः्व्यक्तयोनितः ६९ मानसश्र्व रुचिर्नाम विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणः सुतः । प्राणास्वादसृजद्॒क्षं चक्षुभ्यां च मरीचिनम् ११०० भुगुस्तु हृदयाज्जे ऋषि: सलिलजन्मन:  शिरसोज्धिरसं चेव श्रोत्रावत्रिस्तथव च १०१
verses.wordMeaning: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्तम् आसीत् तदा विश्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । संपतद्भिः पतद्भिश्च ज्वलद्भूतगणैर्मही
verses.transliteration: vyāptam āsīt tadā viśvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / saṃpatadbhiḥ patadbhiśca jvaladbhūtagaṇairmahī
verses.translation: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn. It is due to the impressions of the previous pious actions that he attains human birth. Hence one should devote oneself entirely to Brahman.
verses.hindi: पुलस्त्यं च तथोदानादृव्यानाच्च पुलहूं पुनः । समानज बशिष्ठ तु अपानान्निम॑से ऋतुम् १०२ अभिमानात्मक भवद्रं निमंसे नोललोहितम् । इत्येते ब्रह्मणः पुत्राः प्रणणजा द्वादश स्मृताः १०३ इत्येते मानसाः पुत्रा विज्ञेया ब्रह्मण: सुताः  भृग्वादयस्तु ये सुष्ठा नवते ब्रह्मवादिनः १०४ गृहमेधिनः पुराणास्ते धर्मस्तेः प्राकप्रवरतितः । द्वादशते प्रवर्तन्ते सह रुद्रेण व प्रजा: १०५
verses.wordMeaning: In the world of Brahma, there is only Sattva; in the world of immobile beings there is only Tamas. In between the two there is Rajas, that supports the fourteen lokas. How can he think of the great Brahman when he is distressed by pain and his vitals are being torn.…

verses.sanskrit: जातैश्चटचटाशब्दैः पतद्भिर्गिरिसानुभिः । तत्र रौद्रोत्सवे जाता रुद्रानन्दविवर्धिनी
verses.transliteration: jātaiścaṭacaṭāśabdaiḥ patadbhirgirisānubhiḥ / tatra raudrotsave jātā rudrānandavivardhinī

verses.hindi: देत्यहनी, माया, महिषमदिनी, अमोघा, विन्ध्यनिलया, विक्रान्ता और गणनायिका। ये समस्त यथाक्रम से उस देवी के नाम भेद हैं ।8०-६३। यह देवियों का नाम भद्रकालीका स्तव है । जो आदमी इसे पढ़ते हैं, उनका पराभव नहीं होता ।९४। जंगल, प्रान्तर, नगर, गृह, जल और स्थल में, बाघ-कुम्भी र-चौरादि द्वारा आक्रान्त होने पर एवं जितने भी मानप्र दुःख के अवसर हैं उनमें देवी के इन नामों का कीतेन और

verses.sanskrit: विहिंसमाना भूतानि चर्वमाणाचरानपि । तत्तद्गन्धम् उपादाय शिवारावविराविणी
verses.transliteration: vihiṃsamānā bhūtāni carvamāṇācarānapi / tattadgandham upādāya śivārāvavirāviṇī

verses.sanskrit: तारा ग्रहगणाः सर्वे ये च वैमानिका गणाः । शिवासहस्रैर् आकीर्णा महामातृगणैस्तथा

verses.sanskrit: सा चचार जगत् कृत्स्नं युगान्ते समुपस्थिते । भ्रमद्भिश्च ब्रुवद्भिश्च क्रोशद्भिश्च समन्ततः

verses.hindi: पर समानाकार और समानचारी दो दिव्य पक्षी निवास करते हैं। उनमें केवल एक को वृक्ष का शान है। उस सर्वात्मा के अतिरिक्त दूसरा कोई इस भू तत्व को जानने वाला नहीं है ।११६। विप्रगण ! भूलोक को जिसका शिर, आकाझ को नाभि, चन्द्र सूर्य को नेत्र, दिशाओं को कान और भूमि को चरण कहकर जिसकी स्तुति करते हैं। जिसके मुख से ब्राह्मण, छाती के पूर्ब भाग से क्षत्रिय, ऊरु से वैश्य और चरणों से शुद्र

verses.sanskrit: प्रमथद्भिर् ज्वलद्भिश्च रौद्रैर्व्याप्ता दिशो दश । विस्तीर्णं शैलसङ्घातं विघूर्णितगिरिद्रुमम्
verses.transliteration: pramathadbhir jvaladbhiśca raudrairvyāptā diśo daśa / vistīrṇaṃ śailasaṅghātaṃ vighūrṇitagiridrumam

verses.sanskrit: प्रभिन्नगोपुरद्वारं केशशुष्कास्थिसंकुलम् । प्रदग्धग्रामनगरं भस्मपुंजाभिसंवृतम्
