verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये कल्पानुकथने कालरात्रिकृतजगत्संहरणवर्णनं नाम चतुर्दशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो मातृसहस्रैश्च रौद्रैश्च परिवारिता । कालरात्रिर् जगत्सर्वं हरते दीप्तलोचना
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kalpānukathane kālarātrikṛtajagatsaṃharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 15 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato mātṛsahasraiśca raudraiśca parivāritā / kālarātrir jagatsarvaṃ harate dīptalocanā
verses.translation: After knowing the fourteen types of transmigrations a person overpowered by the fear of Sarhsdra (transmigration from birth to birth) should begin suitable action.
verses.hindi: तत्तमः प्रतिनुत्तं वे मिथुनं स व्यजायत । अधरमंचरणाज्जज्न हिसा शोकादजायत ५ ततस्तस्मिन्समुद्भृते मिथुने चरणात्मनि । ततश्र भगवानासीत्प्रीतश्चबमशिश्चियत् ६ स्वां तनुं स ततो ब्रह्मा तामपो(पौ)हदभास्वराम् । द्विधा5करोत्स त॑ देहमर्धेनपुरुषोभवत् ७ अर्धेन नारी सा तस्य शतरूपा व्यजायत  प्रकृतां भुतधात्रीं तां कामान्व सृष्टवान्विभुः ८
verses.wordMeaning: After knowing the fourteen types of transmigrations a person overpowered by the fear of Sarhsdra (transmigration from birth to birth) should begin suitable action.
verses.commentary: Sense: After knowing the fourteen types of transmigrations a person overpowered by the fear of Sarhsdra (transmigration from birth to birth) should begin suitable action.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ता मातरो घोरा ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मिकाः । वाय्विन्द्रानलकौबेरा यमतोयेशशक्तयः
verses.transliteration: tatastā mātaro ghorā brahmaviṣṇuśivātmikāḥ / vāyvindrānalakauberā yamatoyeśaśaktayaḥ
verses.translation: Then, being whirled round by the wheel of Samsara he remembers (about Yoga). Thenceforth, he is always engaged in meditation in communion with the Supreme. He should start the Togic practice in such a way as he would be able to visualize the Soul.
verses.hindi: सा दिव॑ पृथिवीं चेव महिम्ना व्याप्य धिष्ठिता। ब्रह्मणः सा तनुः पूर्वांदिदमावृत्य तिष्ठति
verses.wordMeaning: Then, being whirled round by the wheel of Samsara he remembers (about Yoga). Thenceforth, he is always engaged in meditation in communion with the Supreme. He should start the Togic practice in such a way as he would be able to visualize the Soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, being whirled round by the wheel of Samsara he remembers (about Yoga). Thenceforth, he is always engaged in meditation in communion with the Supreme. He should start the Togic practice in such a way as he would be able to visualize the Soul.

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्दक्रोडनृसिंहानां विचरन्त्यो भयानकाः । चक्रशूलगदाखड्गवज्रशक्त्यृष्टिपट्टिशैः
verses.transliteration: skandakroḍanṛsiṃhānāṃ vicarantyo bhayānakāḥ / cakraśūlagadākhaḍgavajraśaktyṛṣṭipaṭṭiśaiḥ
verses.translation: He is the first, the supreme light, the excellent bridge. He has grown up in living beings but this difference is not eternal.
verses.hindi: या त्वर्धात्सजते नारी शतरूयपा व्यजायत । सा देवी नियुतं तप्त्वा तपः परभदुश्चरम् १०
verses.wordMeaning: He is the first, the supreme light, the excellent bridge. He has grown up in living beings but this difference is not eternal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the first, the supreme light, the excellent bridge. He has grown up in living beings but this difference is not eternal.

verses.sanskrit: खट्वाङ्गैरुल्मुकैर्दीप्तैर्व्यचरन्मातरः क्षये । उमासंनोदिता सर्वाः प्रधावन्त्यो दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: khaṭvāṅgairulmukairdīptairvyacaranmātaraḥ kṣaye / umāsaṃnoditā sarvāḥ pradhāvantyo diśo daśa
verses.translation: Hence he who knows the procedure should worship this bridge, this Atman, this fire with its face in every direction, abiding in the heart of living beings.
verses.hindi: खत जी बोले- लोककर्ता ब्रह्मा ने इस प्रकार समस्त प्रजाओं की सृष्टि की; किन्तु किसी कारण वे प्रजागण विधिनिदिष्ट पथ में प्रवुत्त नहीं हुये ।!। इससे ब्रह्मा तमोगुण से आच्छन्न हो गये और दुखी रहने लगे । तब उन्होंने इष्ट्सद्धि का उपाय सोच निकाला और अपने में तामसी शक्ति की सृष्टि की ॥ प्रजा- गण राजस भाव को छोड़कर सत्त्वगुणावलम्बी होकर सन्‍्तप्त हो रहे हैं, यह देखकर जगत्पति पुनः शोक करने
verses.wordMeaning: Hence he who knows the procedure should worship this bridge, this Atman, this fire with its face in every direction, abiding in the heart of living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence he who knows the procedure should worship this bridge, this Atman, this fire with its face in every direction, abiding in the heart of living beings.

verses.sanskrit: तासां चरणविक्षेपैर् हुङ्कारोद्गारनिस्वनैः । त्रैलोक्यमेतत्सकलं विप्रदग्धं समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ caraṇavikṣepair huṅkārodgāranisvanaiḥ / trailokyametatsakalaṃ vipradagdhaṃ samantataḥ
verses.translation: After sipping water once only at the beginning, with purity and with the mind concentrated on Him, he should offer
verses.hindi: लगे। तब उन्होंने तमोभाव को छोड़कर रजोग्रण का अवलम्बन किया। उस रजोगुण ने उनके तमोग्रुण को ढक लिया । उस परित्यक्त तमोगुण से एक मिथुन की उत्पत्ति हुई। ब्रह्मा के चरण से अधर्म और शोक से हिंसा का जन्म हुआ । इससे ब्रह्मा अत्यन्त आनन्दित हो गये। अपने उस मलिन शरीर की मलिनता को ब्रह्मा ने दूर कर उस देह को दो भागो में विभक्त किया, जिसमें एक भाग पुरुष हो गया और दूसरा स्त्री
verses.wordMeaning: After sipping water once only at the beginning, with purity and with the mind concentrated on Him, he should offer
verses.commentary: Sense: After sipping water once only at the beginning, with purity and with the mind concentrated on Him, he should offer

verses.sanskrit: हाहारवाक्रन्दितनिस्वनैश्च प्रभिन्नरथ्यागृहगोपुरैश्च । बभूव घोरा धरणी समन्तात् कपालकोशाकुलकर्बुराङ्गी
verses.transliteration: hāhāravākranditanisvanaiśca prabhinnarathyāgṛhagopuraiśca / babhūva ghorā dharaṇī samantāt kapālakośākulakarburāṅgī
verses.translation: He should then strengthen and satisfy himself by repeat¬ ing the following mantra—"Om, Thou art the knot of the Pranas. Tou art the Atman. Rudra indeed is the Atman. That Rudra, the destroyer of the subjects. He is the Pranas of the Atman.
verses.hindi: उस स्त्री का नाम शतरूपा पड़ा  उस प्राकृत और जीवों को धारण करने वाली देवी को ब्रह्मा ने सृष्टि कामना से उत्पन्न किया ।5। उसने अपनी महिमा से द्यावापृथिवी को व्याप्त कर लिया। गगनव्यापिती उस ब्राह्मी तनु ने, जो ब्रह्मा के आधे शरीर से उत्पन्न हुई थी। और जिसका नाम शतरूपा पड़ा था, नियुत वर्षों तक
verses.wordMeaning: He should then strengthen and satisfy himself by repeat¬ ing the following mantra—"Om, Thou art the knot of the Pranas. Tou art the Atman. Rudra indeed is the Atman. That Rudra, the destroyer of the subjects. He is the Pranas of the Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should then strengthen and satisfy himself by repeat¬ ing the following mantra—"Om, Thou art the knot of the Pranas. Tou art the Atman. Rudra indeed is the Atman. That Rudra, the destroyer of the subjects. He is the Pranas of the Atman.

verses.sanskrit: यदेतच्छतसाहस्रं जम्बूद्वीपं निगद्यते । सर्वमेव तद् उच्छन्नं समाधृष्य नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: yadetacchatasāhasraṃ jambūdvīpaṃ nigadyate / sarvameva tad ucchannaṃ samādhṛṣya nṛpottama
verses.translation: You are the eldest among Devas. You are fierce, the skilful bull. You are the destroyer of death. Let this Havis obla¬ tion offered be propitious to us".
verses.hindi: विराजमसुजद्वह् सो5भवत्पुरुषो विराद। स सम्राट्सासरूपात्तु वेराजस्तु मनुः स्मृतः १४ स वेराजः प्रजासर्ग: स सर्गे पुरुषों मनुः  वेराजात्पुरुषाह्वीराच्छतरूपा व्यजायत
verses.wordMeaning: You are the eldest among Devas. You are fierce, the skilful bull. You are the destroyer of death. Let this Havis obla¬ tion offered be propitious to us".
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the eldest among Devas. You are fierce, the skilful bull. You are the destroyer of death. Let this Havis obla¬ tion offered be propitious to us".

verses.sanskrit: जम्बुं शाकं कुशं क्रौञ्चं गोमेदं शाल्मलिस्तथा । पुष्करद्वीपसहिता ये च पर्वतवासिनः
verses.transliteration: jambuṃ śākaṃ kuśaṃ krauñcaṃ gomedaṃ śālmalistathā / puṣkaradvīpasahitā ye ca parvatavāsinaḥ
verses.translation: Saying thus he shall touch the heart, the right toe and the navel with the right hand. Touching water once again, he shall touch the chest, eyes, nose, ears, heart and the head. The Prana and Apana both are declared as two Atmans.
verses.hindi: प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादों पुत्रो पुत्रवतां वरो । कन्ये द्वे च महाभागे याभ्यां जाताः प्रजास्त्विमा:.
verses.wordMeaning: Saying thus he shall touch the heart, the right toe and the navel with the right hand. Touching water once again, he shall touch the chest, eyes, nose, ears, heart and the head. The Prana and Apana both are declared as two Atmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying thus he shall touch the heart, the right toe and the navel with the right hand. Touching water once again, he shall touch the chest, eyes, nose, ears, heart and the head. The Prana and Apana both are declared as two Atmans.

verses.sanskrit: ते ग्रस्ता मृत्युना सर्वे भूतैर्मातृगणैस्तथा । महासुरकपालैश्च मांसमेदोवसोत्कटैः
verses.transliteration: te grastā mṛtyunā sarve bhūtairmātṛgaṇaistathā / mahāsurakapālaiśca māṃsamedovasotkaṭaiḥ
verses.translation: Of these Prana is the inner and Apana is the external Atman. Anna (food) is Prana, and Apana is both life and death.
verses.hindi: देवी नाम्ना तथा55क् तिः प्रसुतिश्र व ते शुभे। स्वायंभुवः प्रसूति तु दक्षाय व्यसृजत्प्रभ: १७
verses.wordMeaning: Of these Prana is the inner and Apana is the external Atman. Anna (food) is Prana, and Apana is both life and death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of these Prana is the inner and Apana is the external Atman. Anna (food) is Prana, and Apana is both life and death.

verses.sanskrit: रुधिरोद्गारशोणाङ्गी महामाया सुभीषणा । पिबन्ती रुधिरं तत्र महामांसवसाप्रिया
verses.transliteration: rudhirodgāraśoṇāṅgī mahāmāyā subhīṣaṇā / pibantī rudhiraṃ tatra mahāmāṃsavasāpriyā
verses.translation: Anna (food) should be known as Brahman. It is the source of origin of the people. The living beings are born thro¬ ugh Anna (food). The maintenance is sought through Anna (food). The living beings increase through Anna. Hence it is called Anna.
verses.hindi: आकुत्यां मिथुन जज्े मानसस्य रुचे: शुभम् )। यज्ञश्व दक्षिणा चेव यमको संबभुवतुः
verses.wordMeaning: Anna (food) should be known as Brahman. It is the source of origin of the people. The living beings are born thro¬ ugh Anna (food). The maintenance is sought through Anna (food). The living beings increase through Anna. Hence it is called Anna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Anna (food) should be known as Brahman. It is the source of origin of the people. The living beings are born thro¬ ugh Anna (food). The maintenance is sought through Anna (food). The living beings increase through Anna. Hence it is called Anna.

verses.sanskrit: कपालहस्ता विकटा भक्षयन्ती सुरासुरान् । नृत्यन्ती च हसन्ती च विपरीता महारवा
verses.transliteration: kapālahastā vikaṭā bhakṣayantī surāsurān / nṛtyantī ca hasantī ca viparītā mahāravā
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: यज्ञस्य दक्षिणायां च॒ पुत्रा द्वादश जज्ञिरे । यामा इति समाख्याता देवा: स्वायंभुवेष्न्तरे १२० यमस्य पुत्रा यज्ञस्य तस्माद्यामास्तु ते स्मुता:। अजिताश्व व शूकाश्च गणों द्वो ब्रह्मणः स्मुता
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यसंत्रासकरी विद्युत्संस्फोटहासिनी । सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रान्तां भक्षयित्वा च मेदिनीम्
verses.transliteration: trailokyasaṃtrāsakarī vidyutsaṃsphoṭahāsinī / saptadvīpasamudrāntāṃ bhakṣayitvā ca medinīm
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: यामाः पूर्व परिक्रान्ता यतः संज्ञा दिवोकसः । स्वायंभुवसुतायां तु प्रसुत्यां लोकमातरः
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वस्थानमगमद्यत्र देवो महेश्वरः । नर्मदातीरम् आश्रित्यावसन्मातृगणैः सह
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svasthānamagamadyatra devo maheśvaraḥ / narmadātīram āśrityāvasanmātṛgaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: जाप तू जी का जत+ 2 2 नज-त
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: अमराणां कटे तुङ्गे नृत्यन्ती हसितानना । अमरा देवताः प्रोक्ताः शरीरं कटमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: amarāṇāṃ kaṭe tuṅge nṛtyantī hasitānanā / amarā devatāḥ proktāḥ śarīraṃ kaṭamucyate
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: परम घोर तपरया की ।९-१०। उसने दीप्त यश वाले स्वायम्भूव मनु को पति के रूप में वरण किया । इकह॒त्तर युग का मन्वन्तर माना गया है। स्वयम्भु मनु उस अयोनिजा शतरूपा को पत्नी के रूप में प्राप्त कर उसके साथ रमण करने लगे। इसी से उसका एक नाम रति भी पड़ा। कल्प के आदि में वही प्रथम नर- नारी संयोग हुआ। ब्रह्मा ने विराट का सृजन किया है। विराद से ही वेराज मनु की उत्पत्ति है।
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: तैः कटैरावृतो यस्मात् पर्वतो ऽयं नृपोत्तम । छिन्नभिन्नास्थिनिकरैर् वसामेदोऽस्रविप्लुतैः
verses.transliteration: taiḥ kaṭairāvṛto yasmāt parvato 'yaṃ nṛpottama / chinnabhinnāsthinikarair vasāmedo'sraviplutaiḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: वीर सम्राद् वराज मनु ने शतरूपा के गर्भ से प्रियत्नत और उत्तानपाद नामक दो श्रेष्ठ पुत्रों और आकति तथा प्रसूति नाम्नी दो छुभ पुत्रियों को उत्पन्न किया। उन्हीं दो पृत्रियों से यह सारी प्रजा उत्पन्न हुई है ॥ स्वायम्भूव मनु ने प्रसूति को दक्ष के हाथ में सोंप दिया  जो प्राण है, वही दक्ष है और संकल्प को मनु कहा जाता है। मनु ने रुचि प्रजापति को आकृति नाम की कन्या दे दी ॥११-१५। ब्रह्मा के मानस पुत्र॒ रुचि को
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: अमरंकट इत्येवं तेन प्रोक्तो मनीषिभिः । महापवित्रो लोकेषु शम्भुना स विनिर्मितः
verses.transliteration: amaraṃkaṭa ityevaṃ tena prokto manīṣibhiḥ / mahāpavitro lokeṣu śambhunā sa vinirmitaḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: आकूति के गर्म से यज्ञ और दक्षिणा नामक मिथुन सन्‍्तान उत्पन्न हुये ।१९॥ उस स्वायम्भुव मब्वन्तर में दक्षिणा में बारह पुत्र हुये । उनका नाम याम पड़ा ।२०। यज्ञ का ही दूसरा नाम यम था। उनके पुत्र होने के कारण वे याम कहलाये । वे अजित ओर शूक नामक दो भागों में विभक्त हैं, किन्तु देवों के बीच वे याम नाम से ही प्रसिद्ध हूँ। दक्ष प्रभु ने स्वायम्भुव मनु की पुत्री प्रसूति के गर्भ से संसार की माता
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं संनिहितस्तत्र शङ्करो ह्युमया सह । ततो ऽहं नियतस्तत्र तस्य पादाग्रसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ saṃnihitastatra śaṅkaro hyumayā saha / tato 'haṃ niyatastatra tasya pādāgrasaṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: योगपत्न्यश्च ताः सर्वाः सर्वास्ता योगमातर:। श्सर्वाश्च ब्रह्मवादिन्यः सर्वा विश्वस्थ मातरः
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्वः प्रणतभावेन स्तौमि तं नीललोहितम् । ततस् तालकसम्पातैर् गणैर् मातृगणैः सह
verses.transliteration: prahvaḥ praṇatabhāvena staumi taṃ nīlalohitam / tatas tālakasampātair gaṇair mātṛgaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: श्रद्धा लक्ष्मीध तिस्तुष्टिः पुष्टिमेंधा क्रिया तथा । बुद्धिलेज्जा वपुःशान्ति: सिद्धि: की तिस्त्रयोदशी।
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: संप्रनृत्यति संहृष्टो मृत्युना सह शङ्करः । खट्वाङ्गैरुल्मुकैश्चैव पट्टिशैः परिघैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: saṃpranṛtyati saṃhṛṣṭo mṛtyunā saha śaṅkaraḥ / khaṭvāṅgairulmukaiścaiva paṭṭiśaiḥ parighais tathā
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: पत्यथ्थें प्रतिजाग्रह धर्मो दाक्षायणी:ः प्रभुः। द्वाराण्येतानि चेवास्य विहितानि स्वयंभुवा २६ ताभ्यः शिष्टा यवीयस्थ एकादश सुलोचनाः । ख्यातिः सत्यथ संभूतिः स्मृतिः प्रीतिः क्षमा तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: मांसमेदोवसाहस्ता हृष्टा नृत्यन्ति संघशः । वामना जटिला मुण्डा लम्बग्रीवोष्ठमूर्द्धजाः
verses.transliteration: māṃsamedovasāhastā hṛṣṭā nṛtyanti saṃghaśaḥ / vāmanā jaṭilā muṇḍā lambagrīvoṣṭhamūrddhajāḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: सतों भवाय प्रायच्छ॒त्ल्याति च भूगवे तथा । मरीचये च संभूर्ति स्मृतिमज्धिरसे ददो १३०
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: महाशिश्नोदरभुजा नृत्यन्ति च हसन्ति च । विकृतैराननैर् घोरैर् अर्भुजोल्बणमुखादिभिः
verses.transliteration: mahāśiśnodarabhujā nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca / vikṛtairānanair ghorair arbhujolbaṇamukhādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: श्रद्धा काम विजज्ञे वे दर्पो लक्ष्मीसुतः स्मृतः  धुत्यास्ट् नियमः पुत्रस्तुष्टया: संतोष उच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: अमरं कण्टकं चक्रुः प्राप्ते कालविपर्यये । तेषां मध्ये महाघोरं जगत्सन्त्रासकारणम्
verses.transliteration: amaraṃ kaṇṭakaṃ cakruḥ prāpte kālaviparyaye / teṣāṃ madhye mahāghoraṃ jagatsantrāsakāraṇam
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: स्वरूप चौबीस पुत्रियों को उत्पन्न किया । वे सभी अत्यस्त भागर्यशालिनी और कमल के समान आँखवाली, योगपत्नी, योगमाता और ब्रह्म बादिनों थी। वे सभी संसार की माता थीं ।२१-२४। श्रद्धा, लक्ष्मी, धृति, तुष्टि, पुष्टि, मेघा, क्रिया, बुद्धि, लज्जा, वषु शास्ति,।। सिद्धि और कीति इन समस्त दक्ष-कन्याओं को प्रभु धर्म ते पत्नी के रूप में वरण क्रिया स्वयम्भू ब्रह्मा ने धमंलाभ के लिये इन्हें द्वार रूप से निर्देश किया है।
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: मृत्युं पश्यामि नृत्यन्तं तडित्पिङ्गलमूर्द्धजम् । तस्य पार्श्वे स्थितां देवीं विमलाम्बरभूषिताम्
verses.transliteration: mṛtyuṃ paśyāmi nṛtyantaṃ taḍitpiṅgalamūrddhajam / tasya pārśve sthitāṃ devīṃ vimalāmbarabhūṣitām
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: इनकी कनिष्ठा सती, ख्याति, सम्भूति, स्मृति, प्रीति क्षमा, संनति, अनसूया, ऊर्जा, स्वाहा और स्वधा नामक एकादश कन्यकाओं को रुद्र, भूगु, मरीचि, अद्धिरा, पुलह, ऋतु, पुलस्त्य, अन्रि, वसिष्ठ, पितृगण और अग्नि ने यथाक्रम से वरण किया । सती भव को, ख्याति भृगु को, सम्भूति मरिचि को, स्मृति आज्िरा को, प्रीति पुलस्त्य को, क्षमा पुलह को, संनति ऋतु को, अनुसूया अन्रि को, ऊर्जा वशिष्ठ को स्त्राह्न अग्नि को और स्वधा पितृगण
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: कुण्डलोद्घुष्टगण्डां तां नागयज्ञोपवीतिनीम् । विचित्रैरुपहारैश्च पूजयन्तीं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kuṇḍalodghuṣṭagaṇḍāṃ tāṃ nāgayajñopavītinīm / vicitrairupahāraiśca pūjayantīṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: को दी गई  अब इनकी सन्ततियों को भी कहते हैं ।२५-३२। ये सब बुद्धितती और महाभा ग्यशालिनी दक्षकन्य- काएँ प्रलयकालपयेनन्‍्त सभी मन्वस्तरों में सदाचारों का प्रतिपालन करती हुईं स्थित रहती है । श्रद्धा ने काम, लक्ष्मी
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यं नर्मदां तत्र मातरं विश्ववन्दिताम् । नानातरङ्गां सावर्तां सुवेलार्णवसंनिभाम्
verses.transliteration: apaśyaṃ narmadāṃ tatra mātaraṃ viśvavanditām / nānātaraṅgāṃ sāvartāṃ suvelārṇavasaṃnibhām
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: अप्रमाद, लण्जा ने विनय, वपु ने व्यवसाय, शान्ति ने क्षोम, सिद्धि ने सुख एवं कीति ने यश नामक पुत्र को
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: महासरःसरित्पातैर् अदृश्यां दृश्यरूपिणीम् । वन्द्यमानां सुरैः सिद्धैर्मुनिसङ्घैश्च भारत
verses.transliteration: mahāsaraḥsaritpātair adṛśyāṃ dṛśyarūpiṇīm / vandyamānāṃ suraiḥ siddhairmunisaṅghaiśca bhārata
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: ८द् वाॉयुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे घोरां सप्तसप्तकसंज्ञिताम् । महावीच्यौघफेनाढ्यां कुर्वन्तीं सजलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare ghorāṃ saptasaptakasaṃjñitām / mahāvīcyaughaphenāḍhyāṃ kurvantīṃ sajalaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: क्षेमः शान्तिसुतभ्रापि सुखं सिद्धेव्यंजायत । यशः कीतें: सुतश्राषि इत्येते धर्मंसुनवः
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टवान्नर्मदां देवीं मृगकृष्णाम्बरां पुनः । सधूमाशनिनिर्ह्रादैर् वहन्तीं सप्तधा तदा
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭavānnarmadāṃ devīṃ mṛgakṛṣṇāmbarāṃ punaḥ / sadhūmāśaninirhrādair vahantīṃ saptadhā tadā
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: कामस्य हे: पुत्रो वे देव्यां रत्यां व्यजाथत । इत्येष वे सुखोदर्क:ः सर्गो धर्मस्प की तितः
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: इति संहारमतुलं दृष्टवान्राजसत्तम । नष्टचन्द्रार्ककिरणम् अभूद् एतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: iti saṃhāramatulaṃ dṛṣṭavānrājasattama / naṣṭacandrārkakiraṇam abhūd etaccarācaram
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: जज्ञे हिसा त्वधर्माह निकृतिभ्रानुतावुभो । निकृत्यनृतयोज॑जे भयं नरक एवं च
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: महोत्पातसमुद्भूतं नष्टनक्षत्रमण्डलम् । अलातचक्रवत् तूर्णम् अशेषं भ्रामयंस्ततः
verses.transliteration: mahotpātasamudbhūtaṃ naṣṭanakṣatramaṇḍalam / alātacakravat tūrṇam aśeṣaṃ bhrāmayaṃstataḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: इत्येष तामसः सर्गो जज्ञे धमनियामक:ः । प्रजा: सुजेति व्यादिष्टा ब्रह्मणा नीललोहित:....
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: विमानकोटिसंकीर्णः स किंनरमहोरगः । महावातः सनिर्घातो येनाकम्पच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: vimānakoṭisaṃkīrṇaḥ sa kiṃnaramahoragaḥ / mahāvātaḥ sanirghāto yenākampaccarācaram
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: सो5भिध्याय सतों भार्या निर्मम्रे ह्मात्मसंभवान्। नाधिकान्न च होनांस्तान्मानसानात्मनः समान्
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रवक्त्रात्समुद्भूतः संवर्तो नाम विश्रुतः । वायुः संशोषयामास विततन् सप्तसागरान्
verses.transliteration: rudravaktrātsamudbhūtaḥ saṃvarto nāma viśrutaḥ / vāyuḥ saṃśoṣayāmāsa vitatan saptasāgarān
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: पिड्भलान्संनिषड्भानां सकपर्दान्विलोहितान । विवासानन्‍्हरिकेशांश्च दृष्टिघ्नांश्य कपालिन:.
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धूलिताङ्गः कपिलाक्षमूर्द्धजो जटाकलापैर् अवबद्धमूर्द्धजः । महारवो दीप्तविशालशूलधृक्स पातु युष्मांश्च दिने दिने हरः
verses.transliteration: uddhūlitāṅgaḥ kapilākṣamūrddhajo jaṭākalāpair avabaddhamūrddhajaḥ / mahāravo dīptaviśālaśūladhṛksa pātu yuṣmāṃśca dine dine haraḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: अन्नादान्यिशितादांश्च आज्ययान्तो मपांस्तथा । मेढ्पांश्वातिकायांश्व शितिकण्ठोग्रमन्‍यवः. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: शूली धनुष्मान्कवची किरीटी श्मशानभस्मोक्षितसर्वगात्रः । कपालमालाकुलकण्ठनालो महाहिसूत्रैरवबद्धमौलिः
verses.transliteration: śūlī dhanuṣmānkavacī kirīṭī śmaśānabhasmokṣitasarvagātraḥ / kapālamālākulakaṇṭhanālo mahāhisūtrairavabaddhamauliḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: प्रसव किया । ये सब पुत्र धर्म के थे ।३३-३७। काम को रति के गर्भ से हर्ष नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ धर्म का यही सुखदायक वंश वर्णन है
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: स गोनसौघैः परिवेष्टिताङ्गो विषाग्निचन्द्रामरसिन्धुमौलिः । पिनाकखण्टूवाङ्गकरालपाणिः स कृत्तिवासा डमरुप्रणादः
verses.transliteration: sa gonasaughaiḥ pariveṣṭitāṅgo viṣāgnicandrāmarasindhumauliḥ / pinākakhaṇṭūvāṅgakarālapāṇiḥ sa kṛttivāsā ḍamarupraṇādaḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: अधर्म को हिसा के गर्भ से निकृति नाम की कन्या और अनृत नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ । अनूत को निकृति से भय ऑर नरक नामक दो पुत्र एवं वेदना तथा माया नाम की दो पुत्रियाँ पेदा हुईं। भय को माया से सब भूतों को नष्ट करने वाला मृत्यु नामक पुत्र हुआ। रौरव यानी नरक को बेदना से दुःख नामक पुत्र हुआ। मृत्यु को वेदना से जरा, शोक, क्रोध और असुया नामक चार सन्‍्तान हुए।
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: स सप्तलोकान्तरनिःसृतात्मा महभुजावेष्टितसर्वगात्रः । नेत्रेण सूर्योदयसन्निभेन प्रवालकाङ्कूरनिभोदरेण
verses.transliteration: sa saptalokāntaraniḥsṛtātmā mahabhujāveṣṭitasarvagātraḥ / netreṇa sūryodayasannibhena pravālakāṅkūranibhodareṇa
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: वेदना की यह सन्‍्तत्ति, दुःखमय और अधर्म लक्षणों से युक्त है। इन्हें दूसरी भार्या तथा पुत्रादि नहीं है एवं ये सभी अमर हैं। यह तामस-सर्यग धर्म का नियामक होकर प्रादुर्भूत हुआ है। ब्रह्म ने जब नील- लोहित यानी महादेव को प्रजाओं की सृष्टि करने के लिये कहा, तब उन्होंने भार्या सती का ध्यान करके समान ग्रुण स्वभाव वाले आत्मसम 'नेकानेक मालव सन्‍्तान को उत्पन्न क्रिया। महादेव के सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: सन्ध्याभ्ररक्तोत्पलपद्मरागसिन्दूरविद्युत्प्रकरारुणेन । ततेन लिङ्गेन च लोचनेन चिक्रीडमानः स युगान्तकाले
verses.transliteration: sandhyābhraraktotpalapadmarāgasindūravidyutprakarāruṇena / tatena liṅgena ca locanena cikrīḍamānaḥ sa yugāntakāle
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: पुत्र रूप, तेज, बल और ज्ञान में पिता के तुल्य थे ।१९-४४॥ सभी चर्म धारण किये हुये थे, वे पिज्भलवर्ण, निषद्भधारी, जटिल, कुछ लोहितवर्ण, वसनहीन, हरितकेश, क्र्रदुष्टि और कपालधारी थे। इसमें कोई बहुरूपधारी, विरूप, सुरूप, विश्वरूप रथी, वर्मी, (कवचवारी), चर्मी, बरूश्री, शतबाहु, सहस्रबाहु,
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्मयेनैव समुत्सृजन् स दण्डेन यद्वद् भगवान् समेरुः । पादाग्रविक्षेपविशीर्णशैलः कुर्वञ्जगत् सो ऽपि जगाम तत्र
verses.transliteration: hiraṇmayenaiva samutsṛjan sa daṇḍena yadvad bhagavān sameruḥ / pādāgravikṣepaviśīrṇaśailaḥ kurvañjagat so 'pi jagāma tatra
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: अयातयामानसजदुद्ररूपान्सुरोत्तमान्। ब्रह्मा दृष्ट्वाइश्रवीदेतान्मा स्राक्षीरीद्शीः प्रजा: ५४ स्रष्टव्या ना5मनसस्‍्तुल्या प्रजा नवाधिकास्त्वया । अन्या:सुज त्वं भद्ं ते(प्रजा व सृत्युसंयुताः
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: संहर्तुकामस्त्रिदिवं त्वशेषं प्रमुञ्चमानो विकृताट्टहासम् । जहार सर्वं त्रिदिवं महात्मा संक्षोभयन्वै जगदीश एकः
verses.transliteration: saṃhartukāmastridivaṃ tvaśeṣaṃ pramuñcamāno vikṛtāṭṭahāsam / jahāra sarvaṃ tridivaṃ mahātmā saṃkṣobhayanvai jagadīśa ekaḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: ना55रप्स्यन्ते हि कर्माणि प्रजा विगतम्ृत्यवः । एवमुक्तो5्ब्रवीदेन नाहं मृत्युसमन्विताः ५६ प्रजा: स्रकष्यामि भद्ं ते) स्थितो5हं त्वं सृज प्रजा: । एते ये वे मया सृष्ठा विरूपा नीललोहिताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: तं देवमीशानमजं वरेण्यं दृष्ट्वा जगत्संहरणं महेशम् । सा कालरात्रिः सह मातृभिश्च गणाश्च सर्वे शिवमर्चयन्ति
verses.transliteration: taṃ devamīśānamajaṃ vareṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagatsaṃharaṇaṃ maheśam / sā kālarātriḥ saha mātṛbhiśca gaṇāśca sarve śivamarcayanti
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: सहस्रार्णा सहल्न तु आत्मनोपसनिश्चिताः । एते देवा भविष्यन्ति रुद्रा नाम महाबला: ४८ पथिव्यामन्तरिक्षे च् रुद्रनाम्ता प्रतिश्र् ता:। शतरुद्रसमाम्नाता भविष्यन्तोह यज्ञियाः 0५६ यज्ञभाजो भविष्यन्ति सववें देवयुगं: सह । मन्वन्तरेषु ये देवा भविष्यन्तीह च्छन्दजा:ः (६०
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दी च भृङ्गी च गणादयश्च तं सर्वभूतं प्रणमन्ति देवम् । जागद्वरं सर्वजनस्य कारणं हरं स्मरारातिम् अहर्निशं ते
verses.transliteration: nandī ca bhṛṅgī ca gaṇādayaśca taṃ sarvabhūtaṃ praṇamanti devam / jāgadvaraṃ sarvajanasya kāraṇaṃ haraṃ smarārātim aharniśaṃ te
verses.translation: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.hindi: ते: सार्धमिज्यमानास्ते स्थास्यन्तीह (हा) युगक्षयात् । एवमुक्तस्तदा ब्रह्मा महादेवेन धीमता
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Danavas eat the food oblated in the (sacri¬ ficial) fire. Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas too par¬ take of it.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये सृष्टिसंहरणसंरम्भवर्णनं नाम पञ्चदशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: समातृभिर्भूतगणश्च घोरैर्वृतः समन्तात्स ननर्त शूली । गजेन्द्रचर्मावरणे वसानः संहर्तुकामश्च जगत्समस्तम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye sṛṣṭisaṃharaṇasaṃrambhavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 16 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: samātṛbhirbhūtagaṇaśca ghorairvṛtaḥ samantātsa nanarta śūlī / gajendracarmāvaraṇe vasānaḥ saṃhartukāmaśca jagatsamastam
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall explain the characteristics of purity and conduct of life, the observance of which purifies the Atman and leads a person to heaven after death.
verses.hindi: अतिकाय, शितिकण्ठ, नीलग्रीव, अन्नभोजी, मांसभोजी, घृतपायी, सोमपायी, अतिक्रोधी, धनुर्वाणादि नाना अस्त्रधारी आसीन, धावमान, जम्हाई लेने बाले, स्थित, अध्णपनशील, जप करने योग्य, ध्यान करनेवाले, ज्वलनशील, वर्षणशील, प्रकाशशील, धूप करने में असक्त, बुद्ध, बुद्धतम, ब्रह्रिष्ठ, शुभदशंन, तीलग्रीव, सहख्ललोवन, सर्वाज्जलोचन, रात्रिचारी, सबभूतों के लिये अदृश्य, महायोगयुक्त, स्थिर यौवन और
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth I shall explain the characteristics of purity and conduct of life, the observance of which purifies the Atman and leads a person to heaven after death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth I shall explain the characteristics of purity and conduct of life, the observance of which purifies the Atman and leads a person to heaven after death.

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरः सर्वसुरेश्वराणां मन्त्रैर् अनेकेखबद्धमाली । मेदोवसारक्तविचर्चिताङ्गस्त्रैलोक्यदाहे प्रणनर्त शम्भुः
verses.transliteration: maheśvaraḥ sarvasureśvarāṇāṃ mantrair anekekhabaddhamālī / medovasāraktavicarcitāṅgastrailokyadāhe praṇanarta śambhuḥ
verses.translation: Seeking of water for purity is the excellent state of sages. He who is not negligent in regard to these comes to no trou¬ ble.
verses.hindi: महातेजस्वी थे। हजार-हजार का दल बाँध कर वे सब रोदन और द्रवण कर रहे थे। रुद्ररूप सुरोत्तम की प्रजा सृष्टि देखकर ब्रह्मा ने कहा-आप इस तरह की प्रजा सृष्टि न करें ४५-५४। रुद्र आप का कल्याण हो। आप अब अपनी तरह इस आकार-प्रकार की प्रजाओं को मत उत्पन्न करें। आप मरणशील प्रजाओं +»ो सृष्टि करें। मृत्यु रहित प्रजा कर्मौनुष्ठान में प्रवृत्ति नहों होती हैं। यह
verses.wordMeaning: Seeking of water for purity is the excellent state of sages. He who is not negligent in regard to these comes to no trou¬ ble.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeking of water for purity is the excellent state of sages. He who is not negligent in regard to these comes to no trou¬ ble.

verses.sanskrit: स कालरात्र्या सहितो महात्मा काले त्रिलोकीं सकलां जहार । संवर्तकाख्यः सहभानुभावः शम्भुर्महात्मा जगतो वरिष्ठः
verses.transliteration: sa kālarātryā sahito mahātmā kāle trilokīṃ sakalāṃ jahāra / saṃvartakākhyaḥ sahabhānubhāvaḥ śambhurmahātmā jagato variṣṭhaḥ
verses.translation: Insult and honour, they say, constitute (what is called) poison and nectar. Insult is poison; honour is nectar.
verses.hindi: सुनकर नीललोहित रुद्र ने कहा--आपका कल्याण हो। हम मरणशील प्रजा की सृष्टि नहीं करते। हम इस कर्म से विरत होते हैं। आप ही प्रजा की सृष्टि करें। हमने जो इन नीललोहित, विरुप और अपने समान हजारों प्रजाओं को उत्पन्न किया है, वे महाबली देवगण भूलोक और अन्‍्तरिक्ष में रुद्र नाम से प्रसिद्ध होकर यज्ञीय देवों के मध्य में परिंगणित होंगे एवं शतरुद्र नाम से विख्यात होंगे। सब युगों के साथ
verses.wordMeaning: Insult and honour, they say, constitute (what is called) poison and nectar. Insult is poison; honour is nectar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Insult and honour, they say, constitute (what is called) poison and nectar. Insult is poison; honour is nectar.

verses.sanskrit: स विस्फुलिङ्गोत्करधूममिश्रं महोल्कवज्राशनिवाततुल्यम् । ततो ऽट्टहासं प्रमुमोच घोरं विवृत्य वक्त्रं वडवामुखाभम्
verses.transliteration: sa visphuliṅgotkaradhūmamiśraṃ maholkavajrāśanivātatulyam / tato 'ṭṭahāsaṃ pramumoca ghoraṃ vivṛtya vaktraṃ vaḍavāmukhābham
verses.translation: The sage who does not err in regard to these comes to no trouble. He should remain with the preceptor for a year enga¬ ged in what is pleasing and beneficial to him.
verses.hindi: ये यज्ञीय भाग का भोग करेंगे। प्रत्येक मन्वन्तर में छन्‍्दः समुत्पन्न जो यज्ञीय देवता प्रादूर्भूत होंगे, उनके साथ यज्ञीय होकर ये महाप्रलयपर्य॑न्त रहेंगे ।(५५-६०३। धोमान् महादेव द्वारा इस प्रकार कहे जाने पर ब्रह्मा अत्यन्त
verses.wordMeaning: The sage who does not err in regard to these comes to no trouble. He should remain with the preceptor for a year enga¬ ged in what is pleasing and beneficial to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage who does not err in regard to these comes to no trouble. He should remain with the preceptor for a year enga¬ ged in what is pleasing and beneficial to him.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रवज्राशनिसंनिभेन तेनाट्टहासेन हरोद्गतेन । आपूरितास्तत्र दिशो दशैव संक्षोभिताः सर्वमहार्णवाश्च
verses.transliteration: sahasravajrāśanisaṃnibhena tenāṭṭahāsena harodgatena / āpūritāstatra diśo daśaiva saṃkṣobhitāḥ sarvamahārṇavāśca
verses.translation: He should not be negligent in the observance of vows, major ( Tamas ) or minor ( Niyamas ). After attaining supreme knowledge, he should seek permission from his preceptor and move about the earth consistently with Dharma.
verses.hindi: ब्रहणा समनुज्ञाते सदा सर्वंमभूत्किल । तदा प्रभृति देवेशो न प्रासुयत वे प्रजा ६२
verses.wordMeaning: He should not be negligent in the observance of vows, major ( Tamas ) or minor ( Niyamas ). After attaining supreme knowledge, he should seek permission from his preceptor and move about the earth consistently with Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not be negligent in the observance of vows, major ( Tamas ) or minor ( Niyamas ). After attaining supreme knowledge, he should seek permission from his preceptor and move about the earth consistently with Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: स ब्रह्मलोकं प्रजगाम शब्दो ब्रह्माण्डभाण्डं प्रचचाल सर्वम् । किमेतदित्याकुलचेतनास्ते वित्रस्तरूपा ऋषयो बभूवुः
verses.transliteration: sa brahmalokaṃ prajagāma śabdo brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍaṃ pracacāla sarvam / kimetadityākulacetanāste vitrastarūpā ṛṣayo babhūvuḥ
verses.translation: This is the holy dictate of Dharma, viz. one should go along the path purified by (i.e. observed carefully by) the eyes; one should drink water filtered with a cloth; and one should utter words purified by truth i.e. state the truth only. 2
verses.hindi: अथ यानि दशेतानि नित्यं तिष्ठन्ति शंकरे। स्वान्दिवानुषींश्चव समेतानसुरःसह
verses.wordMeaning: This is the holy dictate of Dharma, viz. one should go along the path purified by (i.e. observed carefully by) the eyes; one should drink water filtered with a cloth; and one should utter words purified by truth i.e. state the truth only. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the holy dictate of Dharma, viz. one should go along the path purified by (i.e. observed carefully by) the eyes; one should drink water filtered with a cloth; and one should utter words purified by truth i.e. state the truth only. 2

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य सर्वे सहसैव भीता ब्रह्माणमूचुः परमेश्वरेशम् । भीताश्च सर्वे ऋषयस्ततस्ते सुरासुरैश्चैव महोरगैश्च
verses.transliteration: praṇamya sarve sahasaiva bhītā brahmāṇamūcuḥ parameśvareśam / bhītāśca sarve ṛṣayastataste surāsuraiścaiva mahoragaiśca
verses.translation: It is the considered opinion that the knower of Yoga should never accept hospitality in Sraddhas and Tajnas and that it is only thus that a Yogin becomes non-violent.
verses.hindi: अत्येति तेजसा देवो महादेवस्ततः स्मृतः । अत्येति दवानश्वर्यादुबलिन च महासुरान्
verses.wordMeaning: It is the considered opinion that the knower of Yoga should never accept hospitality in Sraddhas and Tajnas and that it is only thus that a Yogin becomes non-violent.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the considered opinion that the knower of Yoga should never accept hospitality in Sraddhas and Tajnas and that it is only thus that a Yogin becomes non-violent.

verses.sanskrit: विद्युत्प्रभाभासुरभीषणाङ्गः क एष चिक्रीडति भूतलस्थः । कालानलं गात्रमिदं दधानो यस्याट्टहासेन जगद्विमूढम्
verses.transliteration: vidyutprabhābhāsurabhīṣaṇāṅgaḥ ka eṣa cikrīḍati bhūtalasthaḥ / kālānalaṃ gātramidaṃ dadhāno yasyāṭṭahāsena jagadvimūḍham
verses.translation: An intelligent Yogin should go out (for alms) when the fires (in the kitchen) have become smokeless 3 and have been
verses.hindi: योगं तपश्च सत्यं च धर्म चापि महामुने । माहेश्वरस्य ज्ञानस्य साधन च प्रचक्ष्व नः ६८ मेन येन च धर्मेण गति प्राप्स्यन्ति वे द्विजाः । तत्सव श्रोतुसिच्छामि योग माहेश्वरं प्रभो ६६९
verses.wordMeaning: An intelligent Yogin should go out (for alms) when the fires (in the kitchen) have become smokeless 3 and have been
verses.commentary: Sense: An intelligent Yogin should go out (for alms) when the fires (in the kitchen) have become smokeless 3 and have been

verses.sanskrit: वित्रस्तरूपं प्रबभौ क्षणेन संहर्तुमिच्छेत्किमयं त्रिलोकीम् । सार्धं त्वया सप्तभिरर्णकैश्च जनस्तपः सत्यमभिप्रयाति
verses.transliteration: vitrastarūpaṃ prababhau kṣaṇena saṃhartumicchetkimayaṃ trilokīm / sārdhaṃ tvayā saptabhirarṇakaiśca janastapaḥ satyamabhiprayāti
verses.translation: This chapter prescribes the rules of conduct to be followed by Pasu- pata yogins. The term * Saucdcdra* corresponds to c Sadacara ' in Dharma Sastra. These are usages practised by one's ancestors (Manu) or by Sift™ under the belief that they are part of Dharma (JCumarila). Some of the rules (as noted below) are adopted from those prescribed for samnyasins. Some of the verses are adapted from Smrtis.
verses.hindi: पञ्च धर्माः पुराण तु रुद्रेण समुदाहृता: । माहेश्वर्य यथा प्रोक्‍्तं रुद्ररक्लिष्टकर्सशिः ' ७०
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter prescribes the rules of conduct to be followed by Pasu- pata yogins. The term * Saucdcdra* corresponds to c Sadacara ' in Dharma Sastra. These are usages practised by one's ancestors (Manu) or by Sift™ under the belief that they are part of Dharma (JCumarila).…
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter prescribes the rules of conduct to be followed by Pasu- pata yogins. The term * Saucdcdra* corresponds to c Sadacara ' in Dharma Sastra. These are usages practised by one's ancestors (Manu) or by Sift™ under the belief that they are part of Dharma (JCumarila).…

verses.sanskrit: संहर्तुकामो हि क एष देव एतत्समस्तं कथयाप्रमेय । न दृष्टमेतद् विषमं कदापि जानासि तत्त्वं परमो मतो नः
verses.transliteration: saṃhartukāmo hi ka eṣa deva etatsamastaṃ kathayāprameya / na dṛṣṭametad viṣamaṃ kadāpi jānāsi tattvaṃ paramo mato naḥ
verses.translation: An echo of Manu VI. 46. Cf. also Sankhasmrti. VII.7.-Visnu Dh. S.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न हये और भीममूर्ति महादेव से कहा-हैं प्रभु! आपका कल्याण हो  आपने ज॑सा कहा है, वसा हीं हों ।६१-६२। विधाता के आदेश से ही सब काये हुआ करते हैं  तब से महादेव ने प्रजासष्टि को बन्द कर दियां। उस समय से कल्पान्तपर्यन्त वे स्थाण और उद्धवरेता होकर रहे । यतः उन्होंने कहा था, कि हम इस कम से विरत होते हैं--(ठहर गये) इसीलिये उनके नाम स्थाणु पड़ा । ज्ञान, बराग्य, ऐश्वयें, तपस्या सत्य, क्षमा,
verses.wordMeaning: An echo of Manu VI. 46. Cf. also Sankhasmrti. VII.7.-Visnu Dh. S.
verses.commentary: Sense: An echo of Manu VI. 46. Cf. also Sankhasmrti. VII.7.-Visnu Dh. S.

verses.sanskrit: निशम्य तद्वाक्यमथाबभाषे ब्रह्मा समाश्वास्य सुरादिसङ्घान्
verses.transliteration: niśamya tadvākyamathābabhāṣe brahmā samāśvāsya surādisaṅghān
verses.translation: and KP. II. 28. 19.
verses.hindi: धृति, सृष्ट-योग्यता, शासन-गुण और आत्मसंबोध ये दश ग्रण शंकर में सदा वर्तमान रहते हैं। देवता, असुर और ऋषियों से भी वे अधिक तेजस्वी हैं, इसी से उनका नाम महादेव पड़ा । उन्होंने ऐश्वर्य से देवों को, बल से असुरों को और ज्ञान से ऋषियों को, तथा योग द्वारा सम्पूर्ण भूतों को पराजित किया है
verses.wordMeaning: and KP. II. 28. 19.
verses.commentary: Sense: and KP. II. 28. 19.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीब्रह्मोवाच: स एष कालस्त्रिदिवं त्वशेषं संहर्तुकामो जगदक्षयात्मा । पूर्णे च शेते परिवत्सराणां भविष्यतीशानविभुर्न चित्रम्
verses.transliteration: śrībrahmovāca: sa eṣa kālastridivaṃ tvaśeṣaṃ saṃhartukāmo jagadakṣayātmā / pūrṇe ca śete parivatsarāṇāṃ bhaviṣyatīśānavibhurna citram
verses.translation: Cf. Manu VI. 56, Sankha. VII. 2.
verses.hindi: ऋषि गण बोले-- महामुनि ! आपने हम लोगों से महेश्वर का ज्ञानसाधन, योग, तप, सत्य और
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Manu VI. 56, Sankha. VII. 2.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Manu VI. 56, Sankha. VII. 2.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरो ऽयं परिवत्सरश्च उद्वत्सरो वत्सर एष देवः । दृष्टो ऽप्यदृष्टः प्रहुतः प्रकाशी स्थूलश्च सूक्ष्मः परमाणुरेषः
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaro 'yaṃ parivatsaraśca udvatsaro vatsara eṣa devaḥ / dṛṣṭo 'pyadṛṣṭaḥ prahutaḥ prakāśī sthūlaśca sūkṣmaḥ paramāṇureṣaḥ
verses.translation: First of all, he should go to the houses of only those householders who maintain good conduct. Such begging for alms is said to be an excellent means of livelihood advised to the Yogin.
verses.hindi: धर्म कहा है। प्रभु ! जिस धर्माचरण से द्विजगण सद्गति प्राप्त करते हैं उस माहेश्वर योग को हम लोग सुनना चाहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: First of all, he should go to the houses of only those householders who maintain good conduct. Such begging for alms is said to be an excellent means of livelihood advised to the Yogin.
verses.commentary: Sense: First of all, he should go to the houses of only those householders who maintain good conduct. Such begging for alms is said to be an excellent means of livelihood advised to the Yogin.

verses.sanskrit: नातः परं किंचिदिहास्ति लोके परापरो ऽयं प्रभुरात्मवादी । तुष्येत मे कालसमानरूप इत्येवमुक्त्वा भगवान्सुरेशः
verses.transliteration: nātaḥ paraṃ kiṃcidihāsti loke parāparo 'yaṃ prabhurātmavādī / tuṣyeta me kālasamānarūpa ityevamuktvā bhagavānsureśaḥ
verses.translation: Secondly, he should go to the abodes of modest house¬ holders who arc faithful, self-controlled, learned and noble.
verses.hindi: वायु बोले-रुद् ने पाँच प्रकार के धर्मों को बताया है, जो पुराण में माहेश्वर धर्म के नाम से कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Secondly, he should go to the abodes of modest house¬ holders who arc faithful, self-controlled, learned and noble.
verses.commentary: Sense: Secondly, he should go to the abodes of modest house¬ holders who arc faithful, self-controlled, learned and noble.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारप्रमुखैः समेतः संतोषयामास ततो यतात्मा
verses.transliteration: sanatkumārapramukhaiḥ sametaḥ saṃtoṣayāmāsa tato yatātmā
verses.translation: Last of all he should go to the residence of non-defiled and unfallen people. Begging for alms in the abodes of lower caste is considered mean.
verses.hindi: यमशुक्रपुरोगश्च पितृकालान्तकंस्तथा । एतेश्चान्येश्व बहुभिस्ते धर्माः पर्युपासिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Last of all he should go to the residence of non-defiled and unfallen people. Begging for alms in the abodes of lower caste is considered mean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Last of all he should go to the residence of non-defiled and unfallen people. Begging for alms in the abodes of lower caste is considered mean.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच: नमो ऽस्तु सर्वाय सुशान्तमूर्ताये ह्यघोररूपाय नमोनमस्ते । सर्वात्मने सर्व नमोनमस्ते महात्मने भूतपते नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca: namo 'stu sarvāya suśāntamūrtāye hyaghorarūpāya namonamaste / sarvātmane sarva namonamaste mahātmane bhūtapate namaste
verses.translation: The alms received may be gruel, butter-milk, milk, barley-water, cooked or uncooked fruits, roots, oil-cake or any¬ thing offered in accordance with the householder's ability.
verses.hindi: ते वे प्रक्षीणकर्माणः शारदाम्बरनिमं ला: । उपसते सुनिगणाः संधाया55त्मानमात्मनि
verses.wordMeaning: The alms received may be gruel, butter-milk, milk, barley-water, cooked or uncooked fruits, roots, oil-cake or any¬ thing offered in accordance with the householder's ability.
verses.commentary: Sense: The alms received may be gruel, butter-milk, milk, barley-water, cooked or uncooked fruits, roots, oil-cake or any¬ thing offered in accordance with the householder's ability.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कार हुङ्कारपरिष्कृताय स्वधावषट्कार नमोनमस्ते । गुणत्रयेशाय महेश्वराय ते त्रयीमयाय त्रिगुणात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāra huṅkārapariṣkṛtāya svadhāvaṣaṭkāra namonamaste / guṇatrayeśāya maheśvarāya te trayīmayāya triguṇātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the foodstuffs conducive to the increase in Siddhis of Yogins have been proclaimed by me. Among these the most excellent is that which is received by way of alms.
verses.hindi: गुरुप्रियहिते युक्ता गुरूणां वे प्रियेप्सवः । विमुच्य मानुषं जन्म विहरन्ति च देववत् ७४ महेश्वरेण ये प्रोक्ताः पश्च धर्मा: सनातनाः । तान्सर्वान्क्रमयोगेन (ण )उच्चमानान्निबोधत ७४५ प्राणायामस्तथा ध्यान प्रत्याहारोड्थ धारणा । स्मरणं चेब योगेडस्मिन्पच्च धर्मा: प्रकीतिता:
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the foodstuffs conducive to the increase in Siddhis of Yogins have been proclaimed by me. Among these the most excellent is that which is received by way of alms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the foodstuffs conducive to the increase in Siddhis of Yogins have been proclaimed by me. Among these the most excellent is that which is received by way of alms.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं शङ्करत्वं हि महेश्वरो ऽसि प्रधानमग्र्यं त्वमसि प्रविष्टः । त्वं विष्णुरीशः प्रपितामहश्च त्वं सप्तजिह्वस्त्वमनन्तजिह्वः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ śaṅkaratvaṃ hi maheśvaro 'si pradhānamagryaṃ tvamasi praviṣṭaḥ / tvaṃ viṣṇurīśaḥ prapitāmahaśca tvaṃ saptajihvastvamanantajihvaḥ
verses.translation: He who begs alms in a righteous manner, is better than the person who drinks a drop of water from the tip of the hu$a grass once in a month.
verses.hindi: तेषां क्रमविशेषेण लक्षणं कारणं तथा। प्रवक्ष्यामि तथा तत्त्वं यथा रुद्रेण भाषितम् ७७ प्राणायामगतिश्रवापि प्राणस्याइ5याम उच्यते । स चापि त्रिविध:ः प्रोक्तो मनन्‍्दो मध्योत्तमस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: He who begs alms in a righteous manner, is better than the person who drinks a drop of water from the tip of the hu$a grass once in a month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who begs alms in a righteous manner, is better than the person who drinks a drop of water from the tip of the hu$a grass once in a month.

verses.sanskrit: स्रष्टासि सृष्टिश्च विभो त्वमेव विश्वस्य वेद्यं च परं निधानम् । आहुर्द्विजा वेदविदो वरेण्यं परात्परस्त्वं परतः परो ऽसि
verses.transliteration: sraṣṭāsi sṛṣṭiśca vibho tvameva viśvasya vedyaṃ ca paraṃ nidhānam / āhurdvijā vedavido vareṇyaṃ parātparastvaṃ parataḥ paro 'si
verses.translation: The observance of the Candrayaiia 1 vow is the most ex¬ cellent for the Yogin. He should perform it once, twice, thrice, four times successively or as many times as he can.
verses.hindi: इत्येतत्त्रिविधं प्रोक्‍्तं प्राणायामस्य लक्षणम् । प्रमाणं स समासेन लक्षणं च निबोधत ८२
verses.wordMeaning: The observance of the Candrayaiia 1 vow is the most ex¬ cellent for the Yogin. He should perform it once, twice, thrice, four times successively or as many times as he can.
verses.commentary: Sense: The observance of the Candrayaiia 1 vow is the most ex¬ cellent for the Yogin. He should perform it once, twice, thrice, four times successively or as many times as he can.

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मातिसूक्ष्मं प्रवदन्ति यच्च वाचो निवर्तन्ति मनो यतश्च
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ pravadanti yacca vāco nivartanti mano yataśca
verses.translation: Non-stealing, celibacy, non-covetousness and renun¬ ciation are the holy rites of recluses (Bhiksus ). The restraints {Myomas) are non-violence, truthfulness; non-furiousness, ser-
verses.hindi: सिहो वा कुजरो वाइपि तथान्यो वा मृगो वने  गृहीतः सेव्यमानस्तु मृदुः समुपजायते ८ रे
verses.wordMeaning: Non-stealing, celibacy, non-covetousness and renun¬ ciation are the holy rites of recluses (Bhiksus ). The restraints {Myomas) are non-violence, truthfulness; non-furiousness, ser-
verses.commentary: Sense: Non-stealing, celibacy, non-covetousness and renun¬ ciation are the holy rites of recluses (Bhiksus ). The restraints {Myomas) are non-violence, truthfulness; non-furiousness, ser-

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमहादेव उवाच: त्वया स्तुतोऽहं विविधैश्च मन्त्रैः पुष्णामि शान्तिं तव पद्मयोने । ईक्षस्व मां लोकमिमं ज्वलन्तं वक्त्रैरनेकैः प्रसभं हरन्तम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmahādeva uvāca: tvayā stuto'haṃ vividhaiśca mantraiḥ puṣṇāmi śāntiṃ tava padmayone / īkṣasva māṃ lokamimaṃ jvalantaṃ vaktrairanekaiḥ prasabhaṃ harantam
verses.translation: Just as an elephant is caught in the forest, is then controlled, so man with the seeds (of Karmas) as his source of birth, body as gwias, is bound by Karmas. Soon he is trapped and is disciplined like a (wild) elephant. In this way, with the seeds of his Karmas having been burnt by the fire of pure know¬ ledge, He becomes free from bondage and quiescent. He is called the liberated (soul).
verses.hindi: अक्लिष्टकर्मा रुद्रगण, आदित्य, वसु, साध्य दोनों अश्विनीकुमार, मछ्दगण, भृगुवंशीय गण, सुरपुर- वासी शुक्र, यम, पितृ, काल और अन्तक प्रभृति अनेकानेक धामिक व्यक्ति उस धर्म का प्रतिपालन करते हैं ।9१-७२। इस धर्म के उपासक वासता से रहित और शरद ऋतु के आकाश के समान निर्मल हो जाते हैं । मुनिगण आत्मा में मत को लगाकर उस धर्म की उपासना करते हैं ।७३। इस धर्म के उपासक गुरु के प्रिय
verses.wordMeaning: Just as an elephant is caught in the forest, is then controlled, so man with the seeds (of Karmas) as his source of birth, body as gwias, is bound by Karmas. Soon he is trapped and is disciplined like a (wild) elephant. In this way,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as an elephant is caught in the forest, is then controlled, so man with the seeds (of Karmas) as his source of birth, body as gwias, is bound by Karmas. Soon he is trapped and is disciplined like a (wild) elephant. In this way,…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स देवेशो देव्या सह जगत्पतिः । पितामहं समाश्वास्य तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa deveśo devyā saha jagatpatiḥ / pitāmahaṃ samāśvāsya tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: By Vedas, by means of eulogies, all rites in a sacrifice (are pei formed). Jap a is regarded more important than know¬ ledge. Meditation free from association with attachment is better than Juana. When that is achieved, the eternal (Moksa) is obtained.
verses.hindi: और हितकर कायं में निरत एवं गुरु के प्रियपात्र होकर मनुष्य जन्म की कुछ चिन्ता न कर देवता की तरह विहार करते हैं ७४। महेश्वर ने जिन सनातन पाँच धर्मों को कहा है उन्हें हम यथाक्रम से कहते हैं, आप लोग सुनें ।9५। माहेश्वर योग के प्राणायाम, ध्यान, प्रत्याहार, धारणा और स्मरण ये ही पाँच धर्म हैं उनका ऋरमशः लक्षण, कारण और तत्त्व, जैसा कि रुद्र ने बताया है, हम कहते हैं ।9६-७७। प्राण की विस्तार-गति को ही प्राणा-
verses.wordMeaning: By Vedas, by means of eulogies, all rites in a sacrifice (are pei formed). Jap a is regarded more important than know¬ ledge. Meditation free from association with attachment is better than Juana. When that is achieved, the eternal (Moksa) is obtained.
verses.commentary: Sense: By Vedas, by means of eulogies, all rites in a sacrifice (are pei formed). Jap a is regarded more important than know¬ ledge. Meditation free from association with attachment is better than Juana. When that is achieved, the eternal (Moksa) is obtained.

verses.sanskrit: इदं महत्पुण्यतमं वरिष्ठं स्तोत्रं निशम्येह गतिं लभन्ते । पापैरनेकैः परिवेष्टिता ये प्रयान्ति रुद्रं विमलैर्विमानैः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ mahatpuṇyatamaṃ variṣṭhaṃ stotraṃ niśamyeha gatiṃ labhante / pāpairanekaiḥ pariveṣṭitā ye prayānti rudraṃ vimalairvimānaiḥ
verses.translation: The Yogin possesses these attributes: control of sense- organs, quiescence, truthfulness, sinlessness, silence, straight¬ forwardness towards all living beings, knowledge of things be- yond the scope of sense-organs, uprightness etc. Those purified by means of knowledge have declared thus.
verses.hindi: याम कहते हैं । वह तीन प्रकार का है, उत्तम, मध्यम और मन्द ।७८। प्राण के निरोध को भी प्राणयाम कहते हैं। प्राणायाम का प्रमाण द्वादश मात्रात्मक है ।७६। मन्द प्राणायाम द्वादश मात्रात्मक है, इसके बारह उद्- घात हैं। मध्यम प्राणायाम चौबीस मात्रात्मक है । इसके दो उद्घात हैं ।६०। उत्तम प्राणायाम की तिरसठ मात्रायें हैं और इसके तीन उद्घात हैं स्वेद, कम्प और विषाद जिससे उत्पन्न हो, वह उत्तम प्राणायाम है ।5९। प्राणा-
verses.wordMeaning: The Yogin possesses these attributes: control of sense- organs, quiescence, truthfulness, sinlessness, silence, straight¬ forwardness towards all living beings, knowledge of things be- yond the scope of sense-organs, uprightness etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogin possesses these attributes: control of sense- organs, quiescence, truthfulness, sinlessness, silence, straight¬ forwardness towards all living beings, knowledge of things be- yond the scope of sense-organs, uprightness etc.…

verses.sanskrit: भयं च तेषां न भवेत्कदाचित्पठन्ति ये तात इदं द्विजाग्र्याः । सङ्ग्रामचौराग्निवने तथाब्धौ तेषां शिवस्त्राति न संशयो ऽत्र
verses.transliteration: bhayaṃ ca teṣāṃ na bhavetkadācitpaṭhanti ye tāta idaṃ dvijāgryāḥ / saṅgrāmacaurāgnivane tathābdhau teṣāṃ śivastrāti na saṃśayo 'tra
verses.translation: Composed in mind, absorbed in Brahma (or the Veda), un-erring and alert, pure, delighting in the Atman, with senses controUed-such pure, unsullied, highly intelligent, praise¬ worthy (un-censurable) and pure (yogins) achieve (master)
verses.hindi: याम का यह त्रिविध लक्षण हुआ । प्रमाण और लक्षण भी अब संक्षेप से सुनिए--सिंह, हाथीं, मृग या अन्य
verses.wordMeaning: Composed in mind, absorbed in Brahma (or the Veda), un-erring and alert, pure, delighting in the Atman, with senses controUed-such pure, unsullied, highly intelligent, praise¬ worthy (un-censurable) and pure (yogins) achieve (master)
verses.commentary: Sense: Composed in mind, absorbed in Brahma (or the Veda), un-erring and alert, pure, delighting in the Atman, with senses controUed-such pure, unsullied, highly intelligent, praise¬ worthy (un-censurable) and pure (yogins) achieve (master)

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मकृतशिवस्तुतिवर्णनं नाम षोडशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १७ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु ब्रह्माद्यैर् मुनिपुंगवैः । ब्रह्मलोकगतैस्तत्र संजहार जगत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye brahmakṛtaśivastutivarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 17 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu brahmādyair munipuṃgavaiḥ / brahmalokagataistatra saṃjahāra jagatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: He who wanders remaining satisfied with the discrimina¬ tion between knowledge and the knowable, will never attain the knowable even if he were to live for a thousand Kal- pas.
verses.hindi: बनैले पशुओं को पकड़कर पालने से जैसे धीरे-धीरे वे मृदुता घारण करने लगते हैं बसे ही अजितेन्द्रियों के लिये
verses.wordMeaning: He who wanders remaining satisfied with the discrimina¬ tion between knowledge and the knowable, will never attain the knowable even if he were to live for a thousand Kal- pas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who wanders remaining satisfied with the discrimina¬ tion between knowledge and the knowable, will never attain the knowable even if he were to live for a thousand Kal- pas.

verses.sanskrit: स तद्भीमं महारौद्रं दक्षिणं वक्त्रमव्ययम् । महादंष्ट्रोत्कटारावं पातालतलसंनिभम्
verses.transliteration: sa tadbhīmaṃ mahāraudraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vaktramavyayam / mahādaṃṣṭrotkaṭārāvaṃ pātālatalasaṃnibham
verses.translation: Giving up contacts and attachment, subduing one's wrath¬ fulness, subsisting on light food, he, with his sense-organs con¬ trolled, should close down all the portals of his intellect and should thus fix his mind in meditation.
verses.hindi: (तथा प्राणों दुराधर्ष: सर्वेधामकृतात्मनाम् । योगतः सेव्यमानस्तु स एवाम्यासतो बजेतू.
verses.wordMeaning: Giving up contacts and attachment, subduing one's wrath¬ fulness, subsisting on light food, he, with his sense-organs con¬ trolled, should close down all the portals of his intellect and should thus fix his mind in meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Giving up contacts and attachment, subduing one's wrath¬ fulness, subsisting on light food, he, with his sense-organs con¬ trolled, should close down all the portals of his intellect and should thus fix his mind in meditation.

verses.sanskrit: विद्युज्ज्वलनपिङ्गाक्षं भैरवं लोमहर्षणम् । महाजिह्वं महादंष्ट्रं महासर्पशिरोधरम्
verses.transliteration: vidyujjvalanapiṅgākṣaṃ bhairavaṃ lomaharṣaṇam / mahājihvaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ mahāsarpaśirodharam
verses.translation: He should always practise Yoga in uninhabited places, caves, forests or on the banks (sands) of rivers. 1
verses.hindi: स चंव हि यथा सिंहः कुझजरो बाडइपि दुर्बलः । कालान्तरवशाद्योगाद्गम्यते परिमर्दनात् (८४ प्रिधाय मनो मनन्‍्दं वश्यत्वं चाधिगचछति । परिधाय मनोदेवं तथा जीवति मारुतः ॥८द वश्यत्वं हि यथा वायुगंच्छते योगमास्थितः । तदा स्वच्छन्दतः प्राण नयते यत्र चेच्छति ८७
verses.wordMeaning: He should always practise Yoga in uninhabited places, caves, forests or on the banks (sands) of rivers. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: He should always practise Yoga in uninhabited places, caves, forests or on the banks (sands) of rivers. 1

verses.sanskrit: महासुरशिरोमालं महाप्रलयकारणम् । ग्रसत्समुद्रनिहितवातवारिमयं हविः
verses.transliteration: mahāsuraśiromālaṃ mahāpralayakāraṇam / grasatsamudranihitavātavārimayaṃ haviḥ
verses.translation: He who has control over his speech, action and mind and represents each by a long staff is declared as Tridandin 2
verses.hindi: यथा परिचितश्राय वायुवें विश्वतोमुखः । परिध्यायमान: संरुद्ध: शरीरे किल्विषं दहेत् ८६
verses.wordMeaning: He who has control over his speech, action and mind and represents each by a long staff is declared as Tridandin 2
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has control over his speech, action and mind and represents each by a long staff is declared as Tridandin 2

verses.sanskrit: वडवामुखसङ्काशं महादेवस्य तन्मुखम् । जिह्वाग्रेण जगत्सर्वं लेलिहानमपश्यत
verses.transliteration: vaḍavāmukhasaṅkāśaṃ mahādevasya tanmukham / jihvāgreṇa jagatsarvaṃ lelihānamapaśyata
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: तपांसि यानि तप्यन्ते ब्रतानि नियमाश्च ये  सर्वेयज्ञफलं चेव प्राणायामश्न तत्सम: १६ १ अब्बिन्दु यः कुशाग्रेण मासि सासि समश्नुते । संवत्सरशतं साप्र॑ प्राणायाम च तत्समम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्राणि सहस्राणां शतानि च । दिशो दश महाघोरा मांसमेदोवसोत्कटाः
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi sahasrāṇāṃ śatāni ca / diśo daśa mahāghorā māṃsamedovasotkaṭāḥ
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: तस्मायुक्तः सदा योगी प्राणायामपरों भवेत् । सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति ६४
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दंष्ट्रा व्यवर्धत शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । सासुरान्सुरगन्धर्वान् सयक्षोरगराक्षसान्
verses.transliteration: tasya daṃṣṭrā vyavardhata śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / sāsurānsuragandharvān sayakṣoragarākṣasān
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पाशुपतयोगे मन्वन्तरादिवर्णन॑ नाम दशमोध्याय: ।१०। ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दंष्ट्राग्रसंलग्नान्स ददर्श पितामहः । दन्तयन्त्रान्तसंविष्टं विचूर्णितशिरोधरम्
verses.transliteration: tasya daṃṣṭrāgrasaṃlagnānsa dadarśa pitāmahaḥ / dantayantrāntasaṃviṣṭaṃ vicūrṇitaśirodharam
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: प्राण भी दुराघर्ष है। योग और अभ्यास के द्वारा ही वह वशीभूत होता है ।५२-८५८। वे सिंह या हाथी जसे दुर्बंल हो जते हैं यानी खाने-पीने के अभाव से दुबंल होकर अहिसक हो जाते हैं, बसे ही प्राण भी कालकम से योगाग्यास द्वारा वशीभूत हो जाता है । वही प्राण वा यु मानस व्यापार द्वारा संयत होने पर मन्द और वश्य हो जाता और मन अधीन होंकर जीवित रहता है ।५५-८६। योगानुष्ठान के द्वारा जब प्राणवायु वश में हो
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: जगत् पश्यामि राजेन्द्र विशन्तं व्यादिते मुखे । नानातरङ्गभङ्गाङ्गा महाफेनौघसंकुलाः । यथा नद्यो लयं यान्ति समुद्रं प्राप्य सस्वनाः
verses.transliteration: jagat paśyāmi rājendra viśantaṃ vyādite mukhe / nānātaraṅgabhaṅgāṅgā mahāphenaughasaṃkulāḥ / yathā nadyo layaṃ yānti samudraṃ prāpya sasvanāḥ
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: जाता है, तब उसे इच्छानुसार जहाँ चाहे वहाँ ले जा सकते हैं। जैसे जब सिंह और हाथी वशीभूत हो जाते हैं, तो मनुष्यों का पशुभय दूर हो जाता है और वे मनुष्यों के कार्यंसाधक बन जाते हैं, उसी प्रकार यह परिचित प्राणवायु ध्याव द्वारा जब संयत और अनुकल हो जाता है, तब शरीरगत पाप का नाश कर देता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: तथा ततं विश्वमिदं समस्तमनेकजीवार्णवदुर्विगाह्यम् । विवेश रुद्रस्य मुखं विशालं ज्वलत्तदुग्रं घननादघोरम्
verses.transliteration: tathā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ samastamanekajīvārṇavadurvigāhyam / viveśa rudrasya mukhaṃ viśālaṃ jvalattadugraṃ ghananādaghoram
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: प्राणायाम करने वाले जितेन्द्रिय ब्राह्मणों के सभी पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं ओर वे सतोगुणी हो जाते हैं। जितनी तरह की तपस्याएँ, ब्रत, नियम और यज्ञफल आदि हैं प्राणायाम भी उन्हीं के समान है।६ ०-६१। सौ संबत्सरों तक प्रत्येक मास कुश के अग्रभाग से जलबिन्दु पान करने से जो फल होता है. वही फल प्राणायाम करने से होता है ।६२। प्राणायाम से दोषों का नाश होता है। घारणा से पाप का, प्रत्याहार से विषय समूह का
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालास्ततस्तस्य मुखात्सुघोराः सविस्फुलिङ्गा बहुलाः सधूमाः । अनेकरूपा ज्वलनप्रकाशाः प्रदीपयन्तीव दिशो ऽखिलाश्च
verses.transliteration: jvālāstatastasya mukhātsughorāḥ savisphuliṅgā bahulāḥ sadhūmāḥ / anekarūpā jvalanaprakāśāḥ pradīpayantīva diśo 'khilāśca
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: ओर ध्यान से अनीक्षवर गुणों का नाश होता है। इसलिये योगी को उचित है कि, वह प्राणायाम-निष्ठ हो। इससे वह विशुद्धात्मा होकर परब्रह्म को प्राप्त करता है ॥६ ३-६४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: ततो रविज्वालसहस्रमालि बभूव वक्त्रं चलजिह्वदंष्ट्रम् । महेश्वरस्याद्भुतरूपिणस् तदा स द्वादशात्मा प्रबभूव एकः
verses.transliteration: tato ravijvālasahasramāli babhūva vaktraṃ calajihvadaṃṣṭram / maheśvarasyādbhutarūpiṇas tadā sa dvādaśātmā prababhūva ekaḥ

verses.hindi: धनुदिचिन्वान्तग्रंतग्रन्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते द्वादशादित्या रुद्रवक्त्राद्विनिर्गताः । आश्रित्य दक्षिणामाशां निर्दहन्तो वसुंधराम्
verses.transliteration: tataste dvādaśādityā rudravaktrādvinirgatāḥ / āśritya dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ nirdahanto vasuṃdharām
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: एकार्देशी्ष्याय: 5१
