verses.sanskrit: भौमं यज्जीवनं किंचिन्नानावृक्षतृणालयम् । शुष्कं पूर्वमनावृष्ट्या सकलाकुलभूतलम्
verses.transliteration: bhaumaṃ yajjīvanaṃ kiṃcinnānāvṛkṣatṛṇālayam / śuṣkaṃ pūrvamanāvṛṣṭyā sakalākulabhūtalam
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: घोराकारशिवानां तु कमंणां फलसंभवम् । स्वयंक्ृतानि कालेन इहामुत्र च देहिनाम् ५ पित॒मातृप्रदृष्टानां ज्ञातिसंबन्धिसंकरे: । क्षपणं हि कषायाणां पापानां शान्तिरुच्यते १६ लोभमानात्मकानां हि पापानासपि संयमः । इहामुत्र हितार्थाय प्रशान्तिस्तप उच्यते १७
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दीप्यमानं सहसा सूर्यैस् तै रुद्रसम्भवैः । धूमाकुलमभूत्सर्वं प्रणष्टग्रहतारकम्
verses.transliteration: taddīpyamānaṃ sahasā sūryais tai rudrasambhavaiḥ / dhūmākulamabhūtsarvaṃ praṇaṣṭagrahatārakam
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: वायु बोले--महात्मा ऋषिगण एक महादिवस, अहोरात्र, अर्द्धभास, मास, अयन, वत्सर युग अथवा हजार महायुगों तक तपस्या करते हुये दिव्य चक्षु से प्राण की उपासना करते हैं। इसके आगे हम अब प्राणा- याम के प्रयोजन और फल को विशेष प्रकार से कहते हैं, जेसा कि स्वयं भगवान् प्रभु ने कहा है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: जज्वाल सहसा दीप्तं भूमण्डलमशेषतः । ज्वालामालाकुलं सर्वमभूदेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: jajvāla sahasā dīptaṃ bhūmaṇḍalamaśeṣataḥ / jvālāmālākulaṃ sarvamabhūdetaccarācaram
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: दान्ति, प्रशान्ति, दीप्ति और प्रसाद, इन चारों को प्राणामय का प्रयोजन समझिये। इस काल अथवा परकाल में देहधारियों द्वारा स्वयं किये हुये अथवा पिता-माता द्वारा, किवा भाइयों द्वारा किये हुये भयद्भुर अकल्याणकारक कम से उत्पन्न कृत्सित पाप समूह का जिससे नाश होता है, उसे शान्ति कहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रेषु सरित्सु च सरस्सु च अग्निरत्ति जगत्सर्वमाज्याहुतिमिवाध्वरे
verses.transliteration: saptadvīpasamudreṣu saritsu ca sarassu ca agniratti jagatsarvamājyāhutimivādhvare
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: इस लोक और परलोक में हित के लिये लोभ और अश्रेयस्कर अभिमानादि पापवृत्तियों का जिससे संयम हो, उस तपस्या को प्रशान्ति कहते हैं ।9७। तपपरायण थोगी की जिस प्रतिबुद्ध अवस्था में ज्ञान-विज्ञान युक्त प्रसिद्ध ऋषियों की तरह चन्द्र-सूर्य ग्रह तारकादि और भूत-भविष्य वत्तेमान का विषय प्रत्यक्ष हो अर्थात्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: विशालतेजसा दीप्ता महाज्वालासमाकुलाः । ददहुर् वै जगत्सर्वमादित्या रुद्रसम्भवाः
verses.transliteration: viśālatejasā dīptā mahājvālāsamākulāḥ / dadahur vai jagatsarvamādityā rudrasambhavāḥ
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.transliteration: ādityānāṃ raśmayaśca saṃspṛṣṭā vai parasparam / evaṃ dadāha bhagavāṃstrailokyaṃ sacarācaram

verses.hindi: ओंकारं प्रथम कृत्वा चन्द्रसुधों नमस्थ च। आसन स्वस्तिक कृत्वा पद्यमर्धासनं तथा...

verses.sanskrit: सुमेरुमन्दरान्तां च निर्दहुर् वसुधां तदा । भित्त्वा तु सप्तपातालं नागलोकं ततो ऽदहत्
verses.transliteration: sumerumandarāntāṃ ca nirdahur vasudhāṃ tadā / bhittvā tu saptapātālaṃ nāgalokaṃ tato 'dahat

verses.hindi: किचिदुन्नासितशिराः शिरो ग्रीवां तथव च। संप्रेक््य नासिकाग्र॑ स्व॑ दिशश्वानवलोकयन्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: भूम्यधः सप्तपातालान्निर्दहंस्तारकैः सह । चचाराग्निः समन्तात्तु निर्दहन्वै युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: bhūmyadhaḥ saptapātālānnirdahaṃstārakaiḥ saha / cacārāgniḥ samantāttu nirdahanvai yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: यस्‍्तु प्रत्याहरेत्कामान्क्मों5ज़ानीव स्वतः  तथा5त्मरतिरेकस्थः पश्यत्यात्मानमात्मनि

verses.sanskrit: धम्यमान इवाङ्गारैर् लोहरात्रिर् इव ज्वलन् । तथा तत्प्राज्वलत्सर्वं संवर्ताग्निप्रदीपितम्
verses.transliteration: dhamyamāna ivāṅgārair loharātrir iva jvalan / tathā tatprājvalatsarvaṃ saṃvartāgnipradīpitam
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: अलौकिक समथ्य॑ प्राप्त हो जाय, उसे दीप्ति कहते हैं ।5-९। इन्द्रिय, इन्द्रियाथं, मन और पंच वायु जिससे प्रसन्न हों, उसे प्रसाद कहते हैं । यह चार प्रकार का पहला प्राणायाम ध में हुआ । यह आशु फलदायक और काल भय निवारक है। इसके आगे हम प्राणायाम का लक्षण और योग के लिये योगियों के योग्य आसन कहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: निर्वृक्षा निस्तृणा भूमिर् निर्निर्झरसरः सरित् । विशीर्णशैलशृङ्गौघा कूर्मपृष्ठोपमाभवत्
verses.transliteration: nirvṛkṣā nistṛṇā bhūmir nirnirjharasaraḥ sarit / viśīrṇaśailaśṛṅgaughā kūrmapṛṣṭhopamābhavat
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: पहले ओंकार का उच्चारण करे और चर्द्र-सुयें को प्रणाम करे। फिर स्वस्तिक, पद्म अद्धें समज़ानु एकजानु, उत्तान, सुस्थित आदि किसी आसन को दृढ़ भाव से लगाकर समकाय हो जाय और दोनों चरणों को परस्पर मिला ले ।१३-१४। अथवा दोनों पर की एड़ियों द्वारा लिग तथा दोनों अण्डकोष को कुछ निपीड़ित करके ग्रीवा और मस्तक को कुछ ऊपर उठावे फिर मुँह बन्द कर और आँखों को मूंद कर बंठे । दिशाओं को न देखे केवल
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालाकुलं कृत्वा जगत्सर्वं चिदामकम् । महारूपधरो रुद्रो व्यतिष्ठत महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: jvālāmālākulaṃ kṛtvā jagatsarvaṃ cidāmakam / mahārūpadharo rudro vyatiṣṭhata maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: नासिका के अग्रभाग पर दृष्टि जमा दे ॥१५-१६। तमोग्रुण को रजोगुण से और रजोग्रुण को सत््वगुण से आच्छादित कर दे । तब सत्त्वमात्रा में स्थित होऋर एकाग्र मन से योगानुष्ठान करे। इन्द्रियों, विषयों, मन, और पंच वायु को समवाय द्वारा वश में कर प्रत्याहार का अभ्यास करे ।१७-१८। कछुआ जिस प्रकार अपने शरीर का आकूंचन करता है, उसी प्रकार योगी सम्पूर्ण कामों से अर्थात् विषय समूह से मन को हटा कर
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: समातृगणभूयिष्ठा सयक्षोरगराक्षसा । ततो देवी महादेवं विवेश हरिलोचना
verses.transliteration: samātṛgaṇabhūyiṣṭhā sayakṣoragarākṣasā / tato devī mahādevaṃ viveśa harilocanā
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: एकस्थ होकर आत्मरति करे और आत्मा में ही सब का निरोध करे। ऐसा ही करने से योगी आत्मा का दर्शन अपने में ही करते हैं ।१६। योगी बाहर भीतर से शुद्ध होकर प्राणायामकाल में वायु हारा नाभि से कण्ठ पर्यन्त पूर्ण करके प्रत्याहार का आरम्भ करे  निर्मेषोन्मेष (पलक गिरना और उठना) काल को कला या मात्रा कहते

verses.transliteration: ṛṣabhaṃ trisuparṇaṃ ca durgāṃ sāvitrameva ca / bṛhadāraṇyakaṃ caiva bṛhatsāma tathottaram

verses.hindi: प्राणायामसमारोधात्माणायामः स कथ्यते । मनसो धारणा चेब धारणेति प्रकोतिता २६

verses.transliteration: raudrīṃ paramagāyatrīṃ śivopaniṣadaṃ tathā / yathā pratirathaṃ sūktaṃ japtvā mṛtyuṃjayaṃ tathā

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रो मलयः सह्यो हेमकूटो ऽथ माल्यवान् । विन्ध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च सप्तैते कुलपर्वताः
verses.transliteration: mahendro malayaḥ sahyo hemakūṭo 'tha mālyavān / vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptaite kulaparvatāḥ
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: हैं। प्राणायाम के लिये बारह मात्रा का काल बताया गया है ।२०-२१। बारह प्राणायामों की एक धारणा होती है और दो धाराणाओं का एक योग होता है । इस तरह जो योग करता है, उसे ऐश्वर्य प्राप्त होता है, वह अपने तेज से प्रदीप्त होकर परमात्मा का दशशत करता है २२-२३। जितेख्द्रिय और. प्राणायाम करने वाले ब्राह्मण के सभी दोष नष्ट हो जाते हैं और बह सत्त्व गुण में प्रतिष्ठित हो जाता है । साधक आहार को नियत
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशादित्यनिर्दग्धाः शैलाः शीर्णशिलाः पृथक् । भस्मीभूतास्तु दृश्यन्ते न नष्टा नर्मदा तदा
verses.transliteration: dvādaśādityanirdagdhāḥ śailāḥ śīrṇaśilāḥ pṛthak / bhasmībhūtāstu dṛśyante na naṣṭā narmadā tadā
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: करके और प्राणायाम में आसक्त होकर एक-एक भूमि को जीतने के बाद आगे बढ़े यानी प्राणायाम सम्बन्धी पहली अंबस्था में पूर्ण करके बाद वाली अवस्था को साथे। पूर्वर्भाम ;कों बिना जीते पर भूमि के लिये उद्यम करने से सम्मोहादि बहुतेरे दोष उत्पन्न हो जाते हैं ।१४-२५। इसलिये बिना जीती हुई (अजिता) भूमि पर आरोहण न करे । यन्त्र नल के द्वारा जिस प्रकार जल बलपूर्वक लाये जाने पर पिया जाता है, उसी प्रकार परिश्रमी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवान्हेमकूटश्च निषधो गन्धमादनः । माल्यवांश्च गिरिश्रेष्ठो नीलः श्वेतो ऽथ शृङ्गवान्
verses.transliteration: himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho gandhamādanaḥ / mālyavāṃśca giriśreṣṭho nīlaḥ śveto 'tha śṛṅgavān
verses.translation: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.hindi: साधक प्राण वायु को भी ऊपर खींचे (यानी प्राणायाम करे) नाभि, हृदय, कण्ठ, वक्ष-स्थल, मुख, नासाग्र, नेत्र, भूमध्य, मस्तक और ब्रह्मरंध्र में मन को ध्थिर करे। प्राणापानादि वायु के निरोध को प्राणायाम कहते और मन की धारणा ही घारणा कही जाती है ।३६-२६! विषयों से निवृत्ति पाने को प्रत्याहार कहते हैं ओर इन सब की समष्टि रूप से सिद्धि हो जाने पर योगलक्षण प्रकाशित होता है ।१०। उससे उत्पन्न योग की सिद्धि
verses.wordMeaning: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus established, he who loves meditation, has subdued his sense-organs, gives up both auspicious and inauspicious acts. Even after abandoning this (physical) body, he is neither born nor dead from the standpoint of scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: एते पर्वतरा जानो देवगन्धर्वसेविताः । युगान्ताग्निविनिर्दग्धाः सर्वे शीर्णमहाशिलाः
verses.transliteration: ete parvatarā jāno devagandharvasevitāḥ / yugāntāgnivinirdagdhāḥ sarve śīrṇamahāśilāḥ

verses.transliteration: evaṃ mayā purā dṛṣṭo yugānte sarvasaṃkṣayaḥ / varjayitvā mahāpuṇyāṃ narmadāṃ nṛpasattama

verses.translation: Henceforth I shall explain decisively the expiations pres¬ cribed for ascetics for their (evil) actions done by them ion- Vaikhanasa Sutra VIII. 9 prescribes this for a Paramahamsa. Bud¬ dhist and Jaina mendicants have similar instructions.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मुखात् तस्य घना महोल्बणा निश्चेरुरिन्द्रायुधतुल्यरूपाः । घोराः पयोदा जगदन्धकारं कुर्वन्त ईशानवरप्रयुक्ताः
verses.transliteration: tato mukhāt tasya ghanā maholbaṇā niścerurindrāyudhatulyarūpāḥ / ghorāḥ payodā jagadandhakāraṃ kurvanta īśānavaraprayuktāḥ
verses.translation: Sin is proclaimed as threefold, according as it is born of (results from) speech, mind and body both by day or night continuously. By this the whole world is bound. The great Sruti declares that no man can stay without activities. In life every moment has to be spent in activity 1 for its sustenance.
verses.hindi: एतेन क्रमपोगेन (ण) वातगुल्मं प्रशाम्यति । (गु(उ) दावतंप्रतीकारमिदं कुर्याच्चिकित्सितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sin is proclaimed as threefold, according as it is born of (results from) speech, mind and body both by day or night continuously. By this the whole world is bound. The great Sruti declares that no man can stay without activities.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sin is proclaimed as threefold, according as it is born of (results from) speech, mind and body both by day or night continuously. By this the whole world is bound. The great Sruti declares that no man can stay without activities.…

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलाभाः क्वचिदंजनाभा गोक्षीरकुन्देन्दुनिभाश्च केचित् । मयूरचन्द्राकृतयस् तथा ऽन्ये केचिद्विधूमानलसप्रभाश्च
verses.transliteration: nīlotpalābhāḥ kvacidaṃjanābhā gokṣīrakundendunibhāśca kecit / mayūracandrākṛtayas tathā 'nye kecidvidhūmānalasaprabhāśca
verses.translation: One shall be self-possessed and un-erring. Yoga is the greatest strength. There is nothing seen to be greater than Yoga for men here. Hence, the wise who are endowed with piety praise Yoga. Intelligent and resolute men transcending ignorance through knowledge, attain excellent AiSvarya. Having discrim¬ inated between the greater and the lesser, they attain the highest region.
verses.hindi: भुक्‍त्वा दधि यवागूं वा वायुरूध्व॑ ततो ब्जेत्  वायुग्रन्थि ततो भित्त्वा बायुदेशे प्रयोजयेत्ु.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall be self-possessed and un-erring. Yoga is the greatest strength. There is nothing seen to be greater than Yoga for men here. Hence, the wise who are endowed with piety praise Yoga. Intelligent and resolute men transcending ignorance through knowledge,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall be self-possessed and un-erring. Yoga is the greatest strength. There is nothing seen to be greater than Yoga for men here. Hence, the wise who are endowed with piety praise Yoga. Intelligent and resolute men transcending ignorance through knowledge,…

verses.sanskrit: केचिन्महापर्वतकल्परूपाः केचिन्महामीनकुलोपमाश्च । केचिद्गजेन्द्राकृतयः सुरूपाः केचिन्महाकूटनिभाः पयोदाः
verses.transliteration: kecinmahāparvatakalparūpāḥ kecinmahāmīnakulopamāśca / kecidgajendrākṛtayaḥ surūpāḥ kecinmahākūṭanibhāḥ payodāḥ
verses.translation: Expiation is prescribed for the violation of any major or minor vow ordained for the mendicant. If he approaches a woman cut of lust, the expiation pres¬ cribed is that he shall perform the rite of Sdntapand 2 along with Pranayama.
verses.hindi: में सूखे पत्तों के ढेर पर, कीड़े-मकोड़ों वाली जगह में, श्मशान में, पुरानी गोशाला में, चौराहे पर, कोलाहल के स्थान पर डरावनी जगहों में, वक्ष के नीचे, दीमक की मिट्टी से बनी ऊंची भूमि, नदी और कुआँ आदि के समीप, भूखा रहकर, बे मन से और व्याकुल चित्त होकर योगी को ध्यान-योग में लीन नहीं होना चाहिए ।३३-३५। इन दोषों को बिना विचारे जो प्रमाद से योग साधने लगते हैं, उनके शरीर में बहुतेरे
verses.wordMeaning: Expiation is prescribed for the violation of any major or minor vow ordained for the mendicant. If he approaches a woman cut of lust, the expiation pres¬ cribed is that he shall perform the rite of Sdntapand 2 along with Pranayama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Expiation is prescribed for the violation of any major or minor vow ordained for the mendicant. If he approaches a woman cut of lust, the expiation pres¬ cribed is that he shall perform the rite of Sdntapand 2 along with Pranayama.

verses.sanskrit: चलत्तरङ्गोर्मिसमानरूपा महापुरोधाननिभाश्च केचित् । सगोपुराट्टालकसंनिकाशाः सविद्युदुल्काशनिमण्डितान्ताः
verses.transliteration: calattaraṅgormisamānarūpā mahāpurodhānanibhāśca kecit / sagopurāṭṭālakasaṃnikāśāḥ savidyudulkāśanimaṇḍitāntāḥ
verses.translation: He shall follow the prescribed courses (of conduct) at the end of that expiation with mental purity. He should return to the hermitage and move about carefully as a mendicant. The wise people opine that words piercing the heart 3 do not kill (?) However this should not be indulged in. For this results in cruelty.
verses.hindi: विध्नक्ारक दोष उत्पन्न हो जाते हैं ।३४। जड़ता, बहिरापन, मूकत्व, अन्धत्व, स्पृतिलोप, जरा प्रभूति नाना रोग उत्पन्न होकर योगी को सताने लगते हैं, जो अज्ञानवश योगकारय॑ में प्रवृत्त हो जाते हैं। इसलिये ज्ञान- पूर्वक शुद्ध चित्त से योगी योगसाधना करे ।३७-३८। जो सावधान रहते, उन्हें कोई दोष उत्पन्न नहीं होता । उन दोषों को भी हम यथाक्रम से कहते हैं ।३१६९। जिससे प्राणायाम-जनित दोष शान्त हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: He shall follow the prescribed courses (of conduct) at the end of that expiation with mental purity. He should return to the hermitage and move about carefully as a mendicant.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall follow the prescribed courses (of conduct) at the end of that expiation with mental purity. He should return to the hermitage and move about carefully as a mendicant.…

verses.sanskrit: समावृताङ्गः स बभूव देवः संवर्तकोनाम गणः स रौद्रः । प्रवर्षमाणो जगदप्रमाणमेकार्णवं सर्वमिदं चकार
verses.transliteration: samāvṛtāṅgaḥ sa babhūva devaḥ saṃvartakonāma gaṇaḥ sa raudraḥ / pravarṣamāṇo jagadapramāṇamekārṇavaṃ sarvamidaṃ cakāra
verses.translation: Gf.BG III. 5 Santapana is generally prescribed for pollution or falling off from caste ( Jfati-bhramja-kara ). It lasts for two days. One has to take Panca-gavycL on the first day and observe fast on the second day.
verses.hindi: स्निग्ध-पदार्थ-मिश्रित गर्म यवागू को खाकर कुछ काल तक उस स्थान पर धारणा करे ।४०। इससे वातगुल्म नष्ट होता है। गरुदावर्त को दूर करने के लिये यह चिकित्सा करे कि दही अथवा यवागू का भोजन करे और वायुग्रन्थिका भेदन करके उसे ऊद्ध वदेश में परिचालित करे ।४१-४२। अगर इससे श्ञान्त न हो तो मस्तक में धारणा करे । योगरत सत्त्वस्थ योगी की देह में अगर गुदावर्त की पीड़ा हो तो वह यही उपचार करे।
verses.wordMeaning: Gf.BG III. 5 Santapana is generally prescribed for pollution or falling off from caste ( Jfati-bhramja-kara ). It lasts for two days. One has to take Panca-gavycL on the first day and observe fast on the second day.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf.BG III. 5 Santapana is generally prescribed for pollution or falling off from caste ( Jfati-bhramja-kara ). It lasts for two days. One has to take Panca-gavycL on the first day and observe fast on the second day.

verses.sanskrit: ततो महामेघविवर्धमानम् ईशानम् इन्द्राशनिभिर् वृताङ्गम् । ददर्श नाहं भयविह्वलाङ्गो गङ्गाजलौघैश्च समावृताङ्गः
verses.transliteration: tato mahāmeghavivardhamānam īśānam indrāśanibhir vṛtāṅgam / dadarśa nāhaṃ bhayavihvalāṅgo gaṅgājalaughaiśca samāvṛtāṅgaḥ
verses.translation: marmayukta is emended as narmayukta jocular remark* in A. The emenda¬ tion deserves consideration. Violence is the greatest of evil deeds created by Devas and sages. What is called wealth is the veritable external life- breath of a man. He who deprives any man of his wealth verily takes away his vital breath (life).
verses.hindi: जिस योगी के सर्वाज्भ में कंप-कंपी प्रारम्भ हो जाय, वह इस प्रकार चिकित्सा करके सुखी हो सकता है। डारीए को स्थिर कर मन से किसी पंत की धारणा करे ।४३-४५॥ उरोदघात या वक्षोभ्रंश (छाती का रोग)
verses.wordMeaning: marmayukta is emended as narmayukta jocular remark* in A. The emenda¬ tion deserves consideration. Violence is the greatest of evil deeds created by Devas and sages. What is called wealth is the veritable external life- breath of a man.…
verses.commentary: Sense: marmayukta is emended as narmayukta jocular remark* in A. The emenda¬ tion deserves consideration. Violence is the greatest of evil deeds created by Devas and sages. What is called wealth is the veritable external life- breath of a man.…

verses.sanskrit: गजाः पुनश्चैव पुनः पिबन्तो जगत् समन्तात् परिदह्यमानम् । आपूरितं चैव जगत् समन्तात् सर्वैश्च तैर्जग्मुरदर्शनं च ते
verses.transliteration: gajāḥ punaścaiva punaḥ pibanto jagat samantāt paridahyamānam / āpūritaṃ caiva jagat samantāt sarvaiśca tairjagmuradarśanaṃ ca te
verses.translation: By committing theft a wicked person shatters off his good conduct. He falls off from his vow. After repenting for this sin, he should perform Candrayana vow for a year in accor¬ dance with the injunctions of the scriptures, says the Sruti. At the end of a year his sin will practically diminish. If he repents again he should vigilantly observe his vow of medicancy. If due to the weakness of his organ, a recluse emits semen on seeing a woman, he should perform sixteen Prana- yamas.
verses.hindi: एकादशो5ष्याय: 5५,
verses.wordMeaning: By committing theft a wicked person shatters off his good conduct. He falls off from his vow. After repenting for this sin, he should perform Candrayana vow for a year in accor¬ dance with the injunctions of the scriptures, says the Sruti.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By committing theft a wicked person shatters off his good conduct. He falls off from his vow. After repenting for this sin, he should perform Candrayana vow for a year in accor¬ dance with the injunctions of the scriptures, says the Sruti.…

verses.sanskrit: महार्णवाः सप्त सरांसि द्वीपा नद्यो ऽथ सर्वा अथ भूर्भुवश्च । आपूर्यमाणाः सलिलौघजालैर् एकार्णवं सर्वमिदं बभूव
verses.transliteration: mahārṇavāḥ sapta sarāṃsi dvīpā nadyo 'tha sarvā atha bhūrbhuvaśca / āpūryamāṇāḥ salilaughajālair ekārṇavaṃ sarvamidaṃ babhūva
verses.translation: In the case of a Brahmana who emits semen during day the observance of fast for three nights and performance of a hundred Pranayamai are prescribed for its expiation.
verses.hindi: क्षये कुष्ठे सकीलासे धारयेत्सबंसास्विकीम् । यस्मिन्यस्मिन्त्रजोदेशे तस्मिन्युक्तो विनिदिशेत्
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of a Brahmana who emits semen during day the observance of fast for three nights and performance of a hundred Pranayamai are prescribed for its expiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of a Brahmana who emits semen during day the observance of fast for three nights and performance of a hundred Pranayamai are prescribed for its expiation.

verses.sanskrit: न दृश्यते किंचिदहो चराचरं निरग्निचन्द्रार्कमये ऽपि लोके । प्रणष्टनक्षत्रतमोऽन्धकारे प्रशान्तवातास्तमितैकनीडेः
verses.transliteration: na dṛśyate kiṃcidaho carācaraṃ niragnicandrārkamaye 'pi loke / praṇaṣṭanakṣatratamo'ndhakāre praśāntavātāstamitaikanīḍeḥ
verses.translation: If he has nocturnal emission of semen, he should take bath and perform twelve Dharanas. He becomes pure in soul and free from sin by performing the Pranayama. Daily eating at the same house, use of honey, flesh and salt as well as feasting at Sraddha are forbidden for the asce- tics.
verses.hindi: योगोत्पन्नस्य विप्र(ध्न)स्य इदं कुर्याच्चिकित्सितम्। वंशकीलेन मूर्धानं धारयान(ण )स्य ताडयेत्।
verses.wordMeaning: If he has nocturnal emission of semen, he should take bath and perform twelve Dharanas. He becomes pure in soul and free from sin by performing the Pranayama. Daily eating at the same house, use of honey,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If he has nocturnal emission of semen, he should take bath and perform twelve Dharanas. He becomes pure in soul and free from sin by performing the Pranayama. Daily eating at the same house, use of honey,…

verses.sanskrit: महाजलौघे ऽस्य विशुद्धसत्त्वा स्तुतिर्मया भूप कृता तदानीम् । ततोऽहमित्येव विचिन्तयानः शरण्यम् एकं क्व नु यामि शान्तम्
verses.transliteration: mahājalaughe 'sya viśuddhasattvā stutirmayā bhūpa kṛtā tadānīm / tato'hamityeva vicintayānaḥ śaraṇyam ekaṃ kva nu yāmi śāntam
verses.translation: For the violation of each of these expiatory rite consist¬ ing of Prajapatya or Krcchra is prescribed. Then alone he becomes free from the sin.
verses.hindi: मृध्नि कौलं प्रतिष्ठाप्य काष्ठ काष्ठेन ताडयेत् । भयभीतस्य सा संज्ञा ततः प्रत्यागमिष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: For the violation of each of these expiatory rite consist¬ ing of Prajapatya or Krcchra is prescribed. Then alone he becomes free from the sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the violation of each of these expiatory rite consist¬ ing of Prajapatya or Krcchra is prescribed. Then alone he becomes free from the sin.

verses.sanskrit: स्मरामि देवं हृदि चिन्तयित्वा प्रभुं शरण्यं जलसंनिविष्टः । नमामि देवं शरणं प्रपद्ये ध्यानं च तस्येति कृतं मया च
verses.transliteration: smarāmi devaṃ hṛdi cintayitvā prabhuṃ śaraṇyaṃ jalasaṃniviṣṭaḥ / namāmi devaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye dhyānaṃ ca tasyeti kṛtaṃ mayā ca
verses.translation: Krcchra or Prajapatya is a general term for several kinds of expiations. If there is any other violation, mental, physical
verses.hindi: दिव्यं च पृथिवीं चेव वायुमग्नि च धारयेत् । प्रणायामेन तत्सवं दह्ममानं वशी भवेत् ५३ अथपि प्रविशेद्ेह॑ं ततस्त॑ प्रतिषेधयेत् । ततः संस्तभ्य योगेन धारयान(ण)स्य सुर्धनि
verses.wordMeaning: Krcchra or Prajapatya is a general term for several kinds of expiations. If there is any other violation, mental, physical
verses.commentary: Sense: Krcchra or Prajapatya is a general term for several kinds of expiations. If there is any other violation, mental, physical

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वा ततो ऽहं सलिलं ततार तस्य प्रसादादविमूढचेताः । ग्लानिः श्रमश्चैव मम प्रणष्टौ देव्याः प्रसादेन नरेन्द्रपुत्र
verses.transliteration: dhyātvā tato 'haṃ salilaṃ tatāra tasya prasādādavimūḍhacetāḥ / glāniḥ śramaścaiva mama praṇaṣṭau devyāḥ prasādena narendraputra
verses.translation: A Yogin of pure intellect, looking upon a clod of earth and lump of gold alike, behaving with purity of mind toward all livings, attains the region of saintly people which is un¬ shakable, eternal and imperishable. After reaching there he ' not born again (is liberated from Samsara ).
verses.hindi: प्राणायामाग्निना दग्धं तत्सवें विलय॑ ब्रजेत् । कृष्णसर्पापराध॑ तु धायरेद्धृदयोदरे ५५
verses.wordMeaning: A Yogin of pure intellect, looking upon a clod of earth and lump of gold alike, behaving with purity of mind toward all livings, attains the region of saintly people which is un¬ shakable, eternal and imperishable.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A Yogin of pure intellect, looking upon a clod of earth and lump of gold alike, behaving with purity of mind toward all livings, attains the region of saintly people which is un¬ shakable, eternal and imperishable.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टादशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततस्त्वेकार्णवे तस्मिन् मुमूर्षुरहमातुरः । काकूच्छ्वासस्तरंस्तोयं बाहुभ्यां नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 19 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tatastvekārṇave tasmin mumūrṣurahamāturaḥ / kākūcchvāsastaraṃstoyaṃ bāhubhyāṃ nṛpasattama
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall explain the evil omens. Know that
verses.hindi: स्वतः सनगां प्रृथ्वीं कृत्वा मनसि धारयेत् । हृदि कृत्वा समुद्रांश्र तथा सर्वाश्य देवता: ५७
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth I shall explain the evil omens. Know that
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth I shall explain the evil omens. Know that

verses.sanskrit: शृणोम्यर्णवमध्यस्थो निःशब्दस्तिमिते तदा । अम्भोरवमनौपम्यं दिशो दश विनादिनम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇomyarṇavamadhyastho niḥśabdastimite tadā / ambhoravamanaupamyaṃ diśo daśa vinādinam
verses.translation: He whose feet crack either in front or at the back or
verses.hindi: होने से उरःस्थान या कण्ठ देश में भी वंसी ही धारणा करे। वाग्रोध होने से वचन में और बधिरत्व होने से कानों में धारणा क्री जाती है ।४६। तृषाते होने से जिह्ा स्थान में स्नेहाक्त प्रज्वयलित अग्नि की धारणा करे  इन चिकित्साओं का जो फल हो, उसकी प्रतीक्षा करे । फिर तो वह सुखी हो जायगा ।४७। क्षय, कुष्ठ और कीला- सादि राजस रोग में सात्तिकी वत्ति की धारणा करे। जिस-जिस देश में जो विकार उत्पन्न हो, वहाँ-बहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: He whose feet crack either in front or at the back or
verses.commentary: Sense: He whose feet crack either in front or at the back or

verses.sanskrit: हंसकुदेन्दुसंकाशां हारगोक्षीरपाण्डुराम् । नानारत्नविचित्राङ्गीं स्वर्णशृङ्गां मनोरमाम्
verses.transliteration: haṃsakudendusaṃkāśāṃ hāragokṣīrapāṇḍurām / nānāratnavicitrāṅgīṃ svarṇaśṛṅgāṃ manoramām
verses.translation: He who is obstructed by rows of crows or by a dust storm, lives only for four or five months.
verses.hindi: सात्त्विकी धारणा करे ४५। जिस ब्राह्मण को इस प्रकार योग जनित दोष उत्पन्न हो उसको इसी प्रकार की चिकित्सा करती चाहिए जो भयभीत हो जाय बाँस की कील से उसके सिर पर ताड़ना करे अथवा भयभीत योगी के सिर पर लकड़ी की कील रखकर लकड़ी से खटखटावे । इससे उसकी संज्ञा लौट जाती है। जिसकी संज्ञा लुप्त हो गयी हो उसे सिर पर दोनों हाथों से धारणा करावे, इससे उसकी संज्ञा फिर जाती है - उसको
verses.wordMeaning: He who is obstructed by rows of crows or by a dust storm, lives only for four or five months.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is obstructed by rows of crows or by a dust storm, lives only for four or five months.

verses.sanskrit: सुरैः प्रवालकमयैर्लाङ्गुलध्वजशोभिताम् । प्रलम्बघोणां नर्दन्तीं खुरैर् अर्णवगाहिनीम्
verses.transliteration: suraiḥ pravālakamayairlāṅguladhvajaśobhitām / pralambaghoṇāṃ nardantīṃ khurair arṇavagāhinīm
verses.translation: He who sees lightning without clouds, in the southern direction, or water or the rainbow (without the existence of clouds) lives only for two or three months.
verses.hindi: पुनः मूर्डा में घारणा करनी चाहिए ।४६-५१। रोगी को स्निग्ध और थोड़ा भोजन करावे इससे वह सुख पाता है । योगी जब अमानुष तत्त्वों का अनुभव करने में समथे हो जाय, तब आकाश, वायु, अग्नि और पृथ्वी की धारणा करे । वैसी दशा में प्राणायाम के द्वारा सब तत्त्व दग्ध होकर वश्यीभूत हो जाते हैं ।६२-५३॥ फिर भी अगर कोई दोष दारीर में प्रवेश कर जाय, तो उसका निराकरण यह है कि, मस्तक में संस्तम्भन करके
verses.wordMeaning: He who sees lightning without clouds, in the southern direction, or water or the rainbow (without the existence of clouds) lives only for two or three months.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sees lightning without clouds, in the southern direction, or water or the rainbow (without the existence of clouds) lives only for two or three months.

verses.sanskrit: गां ददर्शाहमुद्विग्नो मामेवाभिमुखीं स्थिताम् । किंकिणीजालमुक्ताभिः स्वर्णघण्टासमावृताम्
verses.transliteration: gāṃ dadarśāhamudvigno māmevābhimukhīṃ sthitām / kiṃkiṇījālamuktābhiḥ svarṇaghaṇṭāsamāvṛtām
verses.translation: He who does not see his reflection either in water or in a mirror or who sees his reflection without the head does not survive a month.
verses.hindi: धारणा करे और प्राणायाम रूप अग्नि में सब को जला डाते । ऐसा करने से सभी दोष नष्ट होते हैं । अगर नाग ने डंस लिया हो, तो हृदय ओर उदर में धारणा करे ।५४-५५। महः, जन, तप, सत्य लोक की भी हृदय में धारणा करे । अगर विष पी लिया गया हो, तो हृदय में विशल्या धारण करे ।५६। मन में पव॑तमय पृथ्वी की धारणा कर हुदय में देवता और समुद्र की धारणा करे ।५७। योगी हजार घड़े जल से भी
verses.wordMeaning: He who does not see his reflection either in water or in a mirror or who sees his reflection without the head does not survive a month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who does not see his reflection either in water or in a mirror or who sees his reflection without the head does not survive a month.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्चरणविक्षेपैः सर्वमेकार्णवं जलम् । विक्षिप्तफेनपुञ्जौघैर्नृत्यन्तीव समं ततः
verses.transliteration: tasyāścaraṇavikṣepaiḥ sarvamekārṇavaṃ jalam / vikṣiptaphenapuñjaughairnṛtyantīva samaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: If the body smells like a corpse or like burning fat, death is imminent. He lives only for a fortnight.
verses.hindi: सहस्नण घटानां च युक्तः स्नायीत योगवित् । उदके कण्ठमात्रे तु धारणां मृध्नि धारयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: If the body smells like a corpse or like burning fat, death is imminent. He lives only for a fortnight.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the body smells like a corpse or like burning fat, death is imminent. He lives only for a fortnight.

verses.sanskrit: ररास सलिलोत्क्षेपैः क्षोभयन्ती महार्णवम् । सा मामाह महाभाग श्लक्ष्णगम्भीरया गिरा
verses.transliteration: rarāsa salilotkṣepaiḥ kṣobhayantī mahārṇavam / sā māmāha mahābhāga ślakṣṇagambhīrayā girā
verses.translation: If a biting wind seems to pierce the vulnerable points of one's body or if no sensation is experienced after touching water, death is imminent for him.
verses.hindi: प्रतिस्नोतोविषाविष्टो धारयेत्सवंगात्रिकीम् । शीर्णोइकंपत्रपुटक: पिबेहल्मीकमृत्तिकाम् ५६ चिकित्सितविधिहां ष विश्वुतो योगनिर्मित: । व्याख्यातस्तु समासेन योगदृष्टेन हेतुना ३६० ब्रवतो लक्षणं विद्धि विप्रस्य कथयेत्क्वचित् । अथापि कथयेन्मोहात्तद्चिज्ञानं प्रलोयते.. .
verses.wordMeaning: If a biting wind seems to pierce the vulnerable points of one's body or if no sensation is experienced after touching water, death is imminent for him.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a biting wind seems to pierce the vulnerable points of one's body or if no sensation is experienced after touching water, death is imminent for him.

verses.sanskrit: मा भैषीर् वत्स वत्सेति मृत्युस्तव न विद्यते । महादेवप्रसादेन न मृत्युस् ते ममापि च
verses.transliteration: mā bhaiṣīr vatsa vatseti mṛtyustava na vidyate / mahādevaprasādena na mṛtyus te mamāpi ca
verses.translation: If he dreams that he is singing and proceeding to the south on a chariot to which bears and monkeys are yoked, it shall be known as a sign of imminent death.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पाशुपतयोगो नामैकादशोध्ध्यायः ।
verses.wordMeaning: If he dreams that he is singing and proceeding to the south on a chariot to which bears and monkeys are yoked, it shall be known as a sign of imminent death.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he dreams that he is singing and proceeding to the south on a chariot to which bears and monkeys are yoked, it shall be known as a sign of imminent death.

verses.sanskrit: ममाश्रयस्व लाङ्गूलं त्वामतस्तारयाम्यहम् । घोराद् अस्माद् भयाद् विप्र यावत् संप्लवते जगत्
verses.transliteration: mamāśrayasva lāṅgūlaṃ tvāmatastārayāmyaham / ghorād asmād bhayād vipra yāvat saṃplavate jagat
verses.translation: If he dreams that he is being led to southern direction by a dark singing woman wearing black garment, he does not survive long.
verses.hindi: स्नान करे। कण्ठमात्र जल में बंठकर मस्तक में घारणा करे, नदी की विपरीत दिशा में रहकर, सम्पूर्ण शरीर में धारणा का अवलम्बन करे। अकवन के सूखे पत्ते की दोनिया बनाकर दीमक की मिट्टी भी पी सकता है । योगज रोग होने पर इस प्रकार की चिक्रित्सा करनी चाहिए। विख्यात योग निर्माता ने योग द्वारा प्राप्त ज्ञान के द्वारा संक्षेप में इस प्रकार की विधि कही है ।५८-६०। योग सम्बन्धी बातों को किसी से नहीं कहना
verses.wordMeaning: If he dreams that he is being led to southern direction by a dark singing woman wearing black garment, he does not survive long.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he dreams that he is being led to southern direction by a dark singing woman wearing black garment, he does not survive long.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुत्तृषाप्रतिघातार्थं स्तनौ मे त्वं पिबस्व ह । पयो ऽमृताश्रयं दिव्यं तत्पीत्वा निर्वृतो भव
verses.transliteration: kṣuttṛṣāpratighātārthaṃ stanau me tvaṃ pibasva ha / payo 'mṛtāśrayaṃ divyaṃ tatpītvā nirvṛto bhava
verses.translation: If he dreams that he wears black rags or that his ear is broken, it shall be known as a sign of imminent death.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। कहे भी तो ब्राह्मणों से ही। मोहबश अगर किसी से कह दिया जायगा, तो उसका विज्ञान लुप्त हो जायगा । इसलिये योग की प्रवत्ति किसी से नहीं कहनी चाहिए ।६१-६२। सत्त्व गुण की अधिकता, आरोग्य, लोभ का अभाव, कास्ति, सुन्दर स्वर, सुभगमूर्तति, उत्तम गन्ध, मृत्रपुरीष की अल्पता जब शरीर में हो जाय, तब समझना चाहिए कि योग की पहली प्रकृति सिद्ध हो गयी । अपने को और पृथ्वी को अगर जलता हुआ देखे और
verses.wordMeaning: If he dreams that he wears black rags or that his ear is broken, it shall be known as a sign of imminent death.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he dreams that he wears black rags or that his ear is broken, it shall be known as a sign of imminent death.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षात्पीतो मया स्तनः । न क्षुत्तृषा पीतमात्रे स्तने मह्यं तदाभवत्
verses.transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā harṣātpīto mayā stanaḥ / na kṣuttṛṣā pītamātre stane mahyaṃ tadābhavat
verses.translation: If he dreams that he is immersed in a marshy sea upto the head, he does not survive long after seeing the dream.
verses.hindi: सृष्ट पदार्थ में प्रवेश कर सके, तो सिद्धि को उपस्थित समझे
verses.wordMeaning: If he dreams that he is immersed in a marshy sea upto the head, he does not survive long after seeing the dream.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he dreams that he is immersed in a marshy sea upto the head, he does not survive long after seeing the dream.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं प्राणबलं जज्ञे समुद्रप्लवनक्षमम् । ततस्तां प्रत्युवाचेदं का त्वमेकार्णवीकृते
verses.transliteration: divyaṃ prāṇabalaṃ jajñe samudraplavanakṣamam / tatastāṃ pratyuvācedaṃ kā tvamekārṇavīkṛte
verses.translation: He who sees (in. dream) ashes, burning coals, hair, dry river and serpents will not survive ten nights.
verses.hindi: हादशो5ष्ष्याय: है७
verses.wordMeaning: He who sees (in. dream) ashes, burning coals, hair, dry river and serpents will not survive ten nights.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sees (in. dream) ashes, burning coals, hair, dry river and serpents will not survive ten nights.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमसे ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन विस्मयो मे महान्हृदि । भ्रमतो ऽत्र ममार्तस्य मुमूर्षोः प्रहतस्य
verses.transliteration: bhramase brūhi tattvena vismayo me mahānhṛdi / bhramato 'tra mamārtasya mumūrṣoḥ prahatasya
verses.translation: If he dreams that he is being beaten by hideous dark skinned men with weapons and stones in their hands, he dies soon.
verses.hindi: सानुष्यान्विविधान्कासान्कामयेत ऋतु स्त्रियः । विद्यादानफलं चेव अपसुष्टस्तु योगवित्
verses.wordMeaning: If he dreams that he is being beaten by hideous dark skinned men with weapons and stones in their hands, he dies soon.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he dreams that he is being beaten by hideous dark skinned men with weapons and stones in their hands, he dies soon.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि मे शरणं जाता भाग्यशेषेण सुव्रते
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi me śaraṇaṃ jātā bhāgyaśeṣeṇa suvrate
verses.translation: If a howling vixen rushes directly at him early in the morning at sunrise, his death is imminent.
verses.hindi: अग्निहोत्रं ह॒वियंज्ञमेतत्प्रतपन तथा । सायाकम धर्न स्वर्गंमुपसृष्टस्तु काइक्षति
verses.wordMeaning: If a howling vixen rushes directly at him early in the morning at sunrise, his death is imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a howling vixen rushes directly at him early in the morning at sunrise, his death is imminent.

verses.sanskrit: गौरुवाच: किमहं विस्मृता तुभ्यं विश्वरूपा महेश्वरी । नर्मदा धर्मदा न्ःणां स्वर्गशर्मबलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: gauruvāca: kimahaṃ vismṛtā tubhyaṃ viśvarūpā maheśvarī / narmadā dharmadā nḥṇāṃ svargaśarmabalapradā
verses.translation: If he feels acute pain in the chest and morbid sensiti¬ veness in the teeth immediately after taking bath, his death is immiment.
verses.hindi: नित्य ब्रह्मपरों युक्त उपसर्गात्प्रमुच्यते । जितप्रत्युपसर्गंस्थ जितश्वासस्य देहिनः प् उपसर्गाः प्रवर्तन्ते सात्वराजसतामसा:। प्रतिभा श्रवण चव देवानां चेव दर्शनम् ३६ अमावतंश्र इत्येते सिद्धिलक्षणसंज्ञिता: । विद्या काव्यं तथा शिल्पं सवंवाचाकृतानि तु ७ विद्यार्थाश्रोपतिष्ठस्ति प्रभावस्येव लक्षणम् । शूणोति शब्दार्श्रोतव्यान्योजनानां शतादपि.
verses.wordMeaning: If he feels acute pain in the chest and morbid sensiti¬ veness in the teeth immediately after taking bath, his death is immiment.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he feels acute pain in the chest and morbid sensiti¬ veness in the teeth immediately after taking bath, his death is immiment.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा त्वां सीदमानं तु रुद्रेणाहं विसर्जिता । तं द्विजं तारयस्वार्ये मा प्राणांस्त्यजतां जले
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ sīdamānaṃ tu rudreṇāhaṃ visarjitā / taṃ dvijaṃ tārayasvārye mā prāṇāṃstyajatāṃ jale
verses.translation: If he gasps for breath during night or day and is un¬ able to discern the smell of a oil lamp, know that his death is imminent.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--तत्त्वदृष्टि-सम्पन्न योगियों को जो उपसर्ग (रोग) होता है, उसे अब हम यथायोग्य इसके आगे कहते हैं। मनुष्योचित विविध कामना, स्त्री प्रसद्भ॒ भिलाष, पुत्रोत्पादनेच्छा, विद्यादान, अग्निहोत्र, ह॒वियेज्ञ, अन्य तपस्या आदि, कपट, धनार्जत, स्वगंस्पहा आदि वस्तुओं में यदि योगी पुरुष आसक्त हो गये तो वे अविद्या के वशीभूत हो जाय॑गे इन्हे उपसर्ग या विध्व समझकर योगिजत इनका विवेचन कर सिराकरण करे ।
verses.wordMeaning: If he gasps for breath during night or day and is un¬ able to discern the smell of a oil lamp, know that his death is imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he gasps for breath during night or day and is un¬ able to discern the smell of a oil lamp, know that his death is imminent.

verses.sanskrit: गोरूपेण विभोर्वाक्यात्त्वत्सकाशमिहागता । मा मृषावचनः शम्भुर्भवेदिति च सत्वरा
verses.transliteration: gorūpeṇa vibhorvākyāttvatsakāśamihāgatā / mā mṛṣāvacanaḥ śambhurbhavediti ca satvarā
verses.translation: If he were to see the rain-bow at night and the cluster
verses.hindi: प्रतिदिन ब्रह्मनिष्ठ होकर योगाम्यास करने से ये दोष नष्ट हो जाते हैं। इन उपसर्गों को और श्वास को जौतने वाले योगियों को साक्त्विक, राजस और तामस विघ्न उपस्थित होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: If he were to see the rain-bow at night and the cluster
verses.commentary: Sense: If he were to see the rain-bow at night and the cluster

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तयाहं तु इन्द्रायुधनिभं शुभम् । लाङ्गूलमव्ययं ज्ञात्वा भुजाभ्याम् अवलम्बितः
verses.transliteration: evamuktastayāhaṃ tu indrāyudhanibhaṃ śubham / lāṅgūlamavyayaṃ jñātvā bhujābhyām avalambitaḥ
verses.translation: He, one of whose eyes begins to water, whose ears are dislodged from their places and whose nose becomes crooked (and curved) should be known as approaching death.
verses.hindi: दूर की ध्वनि सुनने की शक्ति, देवताओं का दर्शन और अश्नान्ति, सिद्ध का लक्षण कहा गया है। विद्या, कवित्व, शिल्पनैपुण्य, सब भाषाओं का बोध और विद्या का तत्त्वज्ञान, सुनने, योग्य शब्दों को सो योंजन दूर से भी सुन ले, सब्ज्ञ हो, विधिज्ञ हो और उन्‍्मत की तरह रहता हो यह योग प्रभाव का लक्षण
verses.wordMeaning: He, one of whose eyes begins to water, whose ears are dislodged from their places and whose nose becomes crooked (and curved) should be known as approaching death.
verses.commentary: Sense: He, one of whose eyes begins to water, whose ears are dislodged from their places and whose nose becomes crooked (and curved) should be known as approaching death.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽतरं तं जलधिं लाङ्गूलध्वजमाश्रितः । असौ देवो महादेव इति मां प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: tato 'taraṃ taṃ jaladhiṃ lāṅgūladhvajamāśritaḥ / asau devo mahādeva iti māṃ pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: Death is imminent to him whose tongue is black and rough and whose face appears muddy and whose cheeks are ruddy and flattened.
verses.hindi: रद ,. वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Death is imminent to him whose tongue is black and rough and whose face appears muddy and whose cheeks are ruddy and flattened.
verses.commentary: Sense: Death is imminent to him whose tongue is black and rough and whose face appears muddy and whose cheeks are ruddy and flattened.

verses.sanskrit: ततो युगसहस्रान्तम् अहं कालं तया सह । व्यचरं वै तमोभूते सर्वतः सलिलावृते
verses.transliteration: tato yugasahasrāntam ahaṃ kālaṃ tayā saha / vyacaraṃ vai tamobhūte sarvataḥ salilāvṛte
verses.translation: A man who (in dream) goes to the southern direction with hair dishevelled, laughing, singing and dancing, meets with the imminent end of life.
verses.hindi: वेत्ति तांश्न महायोगी उपसर्गस्य लक्षणम् । देवदानवगन्धर्वानृषींश्रापि तथा पित॒न् १०
verses.wordMeaning: A man who (in dream) goes to the southern direction with hair dishevelled, laughing, singing and dancing, meets with the imminent end of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who (in dream) goes to the southern direction with hair dishevelled, laughing, singing and dancing, meets with the imminent end of life.

verses.sanskrit: महार्णवे ततस् तस्मिन् भ्रमन्गोः पुच्छमाश्रितः । निर्वाते चान्धकारे च निरालोके निरामये
verses.transliteration: mahārṇave tatas tasmin bhramangoḥ pucchamāśritaḥ / nirvāte cāndhakāre ca nirāloke nirāmaye
verses.translation: He who perspires frequently, the sweat drops being like white mustard seeds, dies very soon.
verses.hindi: ततस्तु परम ब्रह्म क्षिप्रमेवानुचिन्तयेत् । तस्माच्चेवा55त्मनो दोषांस्तुपसर्गानृपस्थितान
verses.wordMeaning: He who perspires frequently, the sweat drops being like white mustard seeds, dies very soon.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who perspires frequently, the sweat drops being like white mustard seeds, dies very soon.

verses.sanskrit: अकस्मात् सलिले तस्मिन्नतसीपुष्पसन्निभम् । विभिन्नांजनसङ्काशमाकाशमिव निर्मलम्
verses.transliteration: akasmāt salile tasminnatasīpuṣpasannibham / vibhinnāṃjanasaṅkāśamākāśamiva nirmalam
verses.translation: He who in dream, goes to the south in a chariot to which camels or donkeys are yoked does not live long. 1
verses.hindi: परित्यजेत मेधावी यदीच्छेत्सिद्धिमात्मनः  ऋषयो देवगन्धर्वा यक्षो रगमहासुराः १४५
verses.wordMeaning: He who in dream, goes to the south in a chariot to which camels or donkeys are yoked does not live long. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: He who in dream, goes to the south in a chariot to which camels or donkeys are yoked does not live long. 1

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलदलश्यामं पीतवाससमव्ययम् । किरीटेनार्कवर्णेन विद्युद्विद्योतकारिणा
verses.transliteration: nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ pītavāsasamavyayam / kirīṭenārkavarṇena vidyudvidyotakāriṇā
verses.translation: These are two extermely ill omens, viz. he does not hear loud noise with his ears and does not see bright light with his eyes.
verses.hindi: उपसर्गाः पुनश्चान्ये जायन्ते प्राणसंज्ञकाः। प्रथिवीं धारयेसर्त्वाँ ततभ्रापो हानन्तरम् १८ ततोरईग्न चेव सर्वेषामाकाश मन एवं च  ततः परां पुनर्बृद्धि धारयेद्यत्नतो यती ९६९
verses.wordMeaning: These are two extermely ill omens, viz. he does not hear loud noise with his ears and does not see bright light with his eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are two extermely ill omens, viz. he does not hear loud noise with his ears and does not see bright light with his eyes.

verses.sanskrit: भ्राजमानेन शिरसा खमिवात्यन्तरूपिणम् । कुण्डलोद्धष्टगल्लं तु हारोद्द्योतितवक्षसम्
verses.transliteration: bhrājamānena śirasā khamivātyantarūpiṇam / kuṇḍaloddhaṣṭagallaṃ tu hāroddyotitavakṣasam
verses.translation: If he sees in dream that he has fallen in a ditch and that there is no door to escape through and that he is unable to stand up from the ditch, that marks the end of his life.
verses.hindi: है ।६-५१। यक्ष, राक्षस गन्धवं आदि दिव्य दर्शन योगियों के लिये विष्नस्वरूप हैं। योगी जब सब दिद्याओं में देव, दानव, गन्धव ऋषि और पितरों को देखने लगते हैं, तब वे उन्मत्त हो जाते हैं ।६-१०२। भ्रान्त योगी भ्रमवश् अन्तरात्मा द्वारा विविध विषय की ओर प्रेरित होने पर भूल जाते हैं। भ्रम से उनकी बुद्धि मारी जाती है और उनका ज्ञान नष्ट हो जाता है। अन्‍्तरात्मा द्वारा प्रेरित होते पर वार्ता (?) चित्त को नष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: If he sees in dream that he has fallen in a ditch and that there is no door to escape through and that he is unable to stand up from the ditch, that marks the end of his life.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he sees in dream that he has fallen in a ditch and that there is no door to escape through and that he is unable to stand up from the ditch, that marks the end of his life.

verses.sanskrit: जाम्बूनदमयैर् दिव्यैर् भूषणैर् उपशोभितम् । नागोपधानशयनं सहस्रादित्यवर्चसम्
verses.transliteration: jāmbūnadamayair divyair bhūṣaṇair upaśobhitam / nāgopadhānaśayanaṃ sahasrādityavarcasam
verses.translation: One is definitely in difficult situation if the eye moves upward without steadiness, becomes red and begins to whirl round, if the mouth becomes hot, if the umbilicus is porous and the urine is very hot.
verses.hindi: कर देती है और उससे बुद्धि भ्रष्ट हो जाने पर सब ज्ञान नष्ट हो जाता है ।११-१०३। ऐसा होने पर शीक्र ही उज्ज्वल वस्त्र या कम्बल से शरीर को ढक कर मन ही मन परब्रह्म का ध्यान करे । इसलिये विद्ध चाहने वाला मेधावी योगी आत्मजनित दोष और उपस्थित उपसर्गों को दूर कर दे ।१३-१२४। ऋषि, देव, गन्धर्व, यज्ञ, उरग, मह।सुर आदि उपसर्ग के वशीभृत होकर बार-बार उसी में फँँसे रहते हैं; इसलिये योगी जिते-
verses.wordMeaning: One is definitely in difficult situation if the eye moves upward without steadiness, becomes red and begins to whirl round, if the mouth becomes hot, if the umbilicus is porous and the urine is very hot.
verses.commentary: Sense: One is definitely in difficult situation if the eye moves upward without steadiness, becomes red and begins to whirl round, if the mouth becomes hot, if the umbilicus is porous and the urine is very hot.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकबाहूरुधरं नैकवक्त्रं मनोरमम् । सुप्तमेकार्णवे वीरं सहस्राक्षशिरोधरम्
verses.transliteration: anekabāhūrudharaṃ naikavaktraṃ manoramam / suptamekārṇave vīraṃ sahasrākṣaśirodharam
verses.translation: If a man is directly hit during the day or night and sees t e attacking man (in dream), the man so hit does not live long.
verses.hindi: न्द्रिय होकर थोड़ा खाय, निद्रा को जीते और मूर्धा में सूक्ष् की धारणा फरे। इन्द्रिय को जीतनेवाले जो योगयुक्त योगी हैं उन्हें फिर प्राणसं्रक उपसर्ग होता है। ऐसा होने पर पहले योगी सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वी की धारणा करे । अनन्तर अग्नि, सम्पूर्ण आकाश, मन और परा बुद्धि की यत्नपूवक धारणा करे। सिद्धि-लक्षण को . देखकर उनका फिर एक-एक कर त्याग करता जाय ।१६-१६:॥।
verses.wordMeaning: If a man is directly hit during the day or night and sees t e attacking man (in dream), the man so hit does not live long.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man is directly hit during the day or night and sees t e attacking man (in dream), the man so hit does not live long.

verses.sanskrit: जटाजूटेन महता स्फुरद्विद्युत्समार्चिषा । एकार्णवं जगत्सर्वं व्याप्य देवं व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: jaṭājūṭena mahatā sphuradvidyutsamārciṣā / ekārṇavaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vyāpya devaṃ vyavasthitam
verses.translation: If a man dreams that he is entering fire but does not
verses.hindi: धनुदिचह्वान्तगंतग्रत्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति।
verses.wordMeaning: If a man dreams that he is entering fire but does not
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man dreams that he is entering fire but does not

verses.sanskrit: ग्रसित्वा शङ्करः सर्वं सदेवासुरमानवम् । प्रपश्याम्यहमीशानं सुप्तमेकार्णवे प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: grasitvā śaṅkaraḥ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānavam / prapaśyāmyahamīśānaṃ suptamekārṇave prabhum
verses.translation: Death is imminent to the man who sees his white covering cloth as red or black in dream.
verses.hindi: दांदशौष्ध्यार्य: है
verses.wordMeaning: Death is imminent to the man who sees his white covering cloth as red or black in dream.
verses.commentary: Sense: Death is imminent to the man who sees his white covering cloth as red or black in dream.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वव्यापिनमव्यक्तमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम् । तस्य पादतलाभ्याशे स्वर्णकेयूरमण्डिताम्
verses.transliteration: sarvavyāpinamavyaktamanantaṃ viśvatomukham / tasya pādatalābhyāśe svarṇakeyūramaṇḍitām
verses.translation: Cf. v. 12 above.
verses.hindi: (»आत्मानं मन्यते तेजस्त:ड्रावसनृपश्यति  + वायं धारयमाणस्य वायुः सुक्ष्म: प्रवतंते..
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. v. 12 above.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. v. 12 above.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वरूपां महाभागां विश्वमायावधारिणीम् । श्रीमयीं ह्रीमयीं देवीं धीमयीं वाङ्मयीं शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: viśvarūpāṃ mahābhāgāṃ viśvamāyāvadhāriṇīm / śrīmayīṃ hrīmayīṃ devīṃ dhīmayīṃ vāṅmayīṃ śivām
verses.translation: Verses 33-40 advise how
verses.hindi: आत्मानं मत्यते ब्राय वायुवन्मण्डलं भ्रमेत् । आकाश धारयमसाणस्य व्योम सुक्ष्मं प्रवतंते)
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 33-40 advise how
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 33-40 advise how

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धिं कीर्तिं रतिं ब्राह्मीं कालरात्रिमयोनिजाम् । ताम् एवाहं तदात्यन्तमीश्वरान्तिकमास्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: siddhiṃ kīrtiṃ ratiṃ brāhmīṃ kālarātrimayonijām / tām evāhaṃ tadātyantamīśvarāntikamāsthitām
verses.translation: His posture is comparable to a lamp in a windless place where it is steady (not flickering) 1. He should practise Yoga in a spot sloping to the east or north.
verses.hindi: पश्यते मण्डल सुक्ष्मं घोषश्रास्य प्रवर्बते । () आत्मान मन्यते नित्य वायुः सूक्ष्ः प्रवतते.
verses.wordMeaning: His posture is comparable to a lamp in a windless place where it is steady (not flickering) 1. He should practise Yoga in a spot sloping to the east or north.
verses.commentary: Sense: His posture is comparable to a lamp in a windless place where it is steady (not flickering) 1. He should practise Yoga in a spot sloping to the east or north.

verses.sanskrit: अद्राक्षं चन्द्रवदनां धृतिं सर्वेश्वरीमुमाम्
verses.transliteration: adrākṣaṃ candravadanāṃ dhṛtiṃ sarveśvarīmumām
verses.translation: He shall perform Dharand in the vital breath, eyes, skin, ears, mind, intellect and chest. He shall take particular delight in keeping Dharand in the vital breath.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वी की धारणा करने से पृथ्वीतत्त्व सूक्ष्म रूप से उसमें प्रविष्ट हो जाता है। योगी उस समय अपने को नित्य पृथ्वी मय समझे । ऐसा करने से उसके शरीर से उत्तम गन्ध निकलने लगती है। जल की धारणा  करने से जल का सूक्ष्म तत्त्व उसमें प्रवेश करता है ।२०-२१। और अमृततुल्य शीतल सूक्ष्म रस उसके शरीर से प्रवाहित होने लगता है । तेज की धारणा करने से तेज सृक्ष्म रूप से उसमें संक्रान्त हो जाता है।२२। योगी
verses.wordMeaning: He shall perform Dharand in the vital breath, eyes, skin, ears, mind, intellect and chest. He shall take particular delight in keeping Dharand in the vital breath.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform Dharand in the vital breath, eyes, skin, ears, mind, intellect and chest. He shall take particular delight in keeping Dharand in the vital breath.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तं प्रसुप्तं नवहेमवर्णमुमासहायं भगवन्तमीशम् । तमोवृतं पुण्यतमं वीरष्ठं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य नमस्करोमि
verses.transliteration: śāntaṃ prasuptaṃ navahemavarṇamumāsahāyaṃ bhagavantamīśam / tamovṛtaṃ puṇyatamaṃ vīraṣṭhaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskaromi
verses.translation: After realizing the advent of death and the groups (of ill omens) he shall perform Yoga-Dharanas in the parts of the bodies twelve times.
verses.hindi: अपने को तेजोमय समझने लगता है और उसी भाव को देखता भी है। वायु की धारणा से वायु सूक्ष्म भाव से संक्रान्त हो जाता है। योगी अपने को वायु समझता है और वायु की तरह वायुमण्डल में भ्रमण करने लगता है। आकाश की धारणा करने से सूक्ष आकाश संक्रान्त होता है ।१३-२४। और योगी नादसम्पन्न होकर उसके सूर्क्म मण्डल को देखने लगता है  वायु की धारणा करने वाला योगी अपने को वायुमय, नित्य
verses.wordMeaning: After realizing the advent of death and the groups (of ill omens) he shall perform Yoga-Dharanas in the parts of the bodies twelve times.
verses.commentary: Sense: After realizing the advent of death and the groups (of ill omens) he shall perform Yoga-Dharanas in the parts of the bodies twelve times.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसुप्तः सहसा विबुद्धो रात्रिक्षये देववरः स्वभावात् । विक्षोभयन् बाहुभिर् अर्णवाम्भो जगत्प्रणष्टं सलिले विमृश्य
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasuptaḥ sahasā vibuddho rātrikṣaye devavaraḥ svabhāvāt / vikṣobhayan bāhubhir arṇavāmbho jagatpraṇaṣṭaṃ salile vimṛśya
verses.translation: He shall perform hundred or hundred and eight Dhdrands on the head. Without Dharanas in the Yoga, the breath does not function properly (goes anywhere).
verses.hindi: समझने लगता है और वायु सूक्ष्म रूव से उसमें संक्रांत हो जाता है ।२५। मन की धारणा करने से मन सुक्ष्म होकर संक्रान्त होता हैं और योगी अपने मन से सब के मन में प्रवेश कर जाता है। बुद्धि द्वारा जब बुद्धि की धारणा की जाती है तब योगी समस्त तत्त्वबोध में स मर्थ होते हैं। इन सप्त सूक्ष्मों को जानकर भी: जो योगवित् मेधावी इनका परित्याग कर देते हैं, वे बुद्धिगुण से परम तत्त्व को प्राप्त करते हैं ।२९-२७३। योगी
verses.wordMeaning: He shall perform hundred or hundred and eight Dhdrands on the head. Without Dharanas in the Yoga, the breath does not function properly (goes anywhere).
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform hundred or hundred and eight Dhdrands on the head. Without Dharanas in the Yoga, the breath does not function properly (goes anywhere).

verses.sanskrit: किं कार्यमित्येव विचिन्तयित्वा वाराहरूपो ऽभवदद्भुताङ्गः । महाघनाम्भोधरतुल्यवर्चाः प्रलम्बमालाम्बरनिष्कमाली
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kāryamityeva vicintayitvā vārāharūpo 'bhavadadbhutāṅgaḥ / mahāghanāmbhodharatulyavarcāḥ pralambamālāmbaraniṣkamālī
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ vibhāgo na hi kartumarho mahātmanām ekaśarīrabhājām / mīmāṃsāhetvarthaviśeṣatarkair yasteṣu kuryāt pravibhedam ajñaḥ

verses.sanskrit: स याति घोरं नरकं क्रमेण विभागकृद्द्वेषमतिर्दुरात्मा । या यस्य भक्तिः स तयैव नूनं देहं त्यजन् स्वं ह्यमृतत्वमेति

verses.hindi: ऐश्वर्याज्जायते रागे बिरागं ब्रह्म चोच्यते । विदित्वा सप्त सुक्ष्माणि घडडगं च महेश्वरम् प्रधानं विनियोगज्ञः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति क्‍ ..-

verses.transliteration: saṃmohayan mūrtibhir atra lokaṃ sraṣṭā ca goptā kṣayakṛtsa devaḥ / tasmān na mohātmakamāviśeta dveṣaṃ na kuryāt pravibhinnamūrtiḥ

verses.hindi: नित्य॑ ब्रह्मधनों युक्त उपसगें: प्रमुच्यते । जितश्वासोपसर्गस्य जितरागस्य योगिनः

verses.sanskrit: वाराहमीशानवरो ऽप्यतो ऽसौ रूपं समास्थाय जगद्विधाता । नष्टे त्रिलोके ऽर्णवतोयमग्ने विमार्गितोयौघमये ऽन्तरात्मा
verses.transliteration: vārāhamīśānavaro 'pyato 'sau rūpaṃ samāsthāya jagadvidhātā / naṣṭe triloke 'rṇavatoyamagne vimārgitoyaughamaye 'ntarātmā
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: एका बहिः शरोरे5स्मिन्धारणा सार्वकामिकी । विशेद्यदा द्विजो युक्तों यत्र यत्रापंयेन्मन:ः

verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: भित्त्वार्णवं तोयमथान्तरस्थं विवेश पातालतलं क्षणेन । जले निमग्नां धरणीं समस्तां समस्पृशत्पङ्कजपत्रनेत्राम्
verses.transliteration: bhittvārṇavaṃ toyamathāntarasthaṃ viveśa pātālatalaṃ kṣaṇena / jale nimagnāṃ dharaṇīṃ samastāṃ samaspṛśatpaṅkajapatranetrām

verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: विशीर्णशैलोपलशृङ्गकूटां वसुंधरां तां प्रलये प्रलीनाम् । दंष्ट्रैकया विष्णुरतुल्यसाहसः समुद्दधार स्वयमेव देवः
verses.transliteration: viśīrṇaśailopalaśṛṅgakūṭāṃ vasuṃdharāṃ tāṃ pralaye pralīnām / daṃṣṭraikayā viṣṇuratulyasāhasaḥ samuddadhāra svayameva devaḥ

verses.hindi: एतेन विधिना योगी विरक्तः सुक्ष्मवजित:  प्रकृति समतिक्रम्य राद्रलोके महीयते (३८ ('ऐश्वयंगुणसंप्राप्तं ब्रह्ममृतं तु तं प्रभुम् । देवस्थानेषु सर्वेषु सबंतस्तु निवर्तते) ३३६
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: सा तस्य दंष्ट्राग्रविलम्बिताङ्गी कैलासशृङ्गाग्रगतेव ज्योत्स्ना । विभ्राजते साप्यसमानमूर्तिः शशाङ्कशृङ्गे च तडिद्विलग्ना
verses.transliteration: sā tasya daṃṣṭrāgravilambitāṅgī kailāsaśṛṅgāgragateva jyotsnā / vibhrājate sāpyasamānamūrtiḥ śaśāṅkaśṛṅge ca taḍidvilagnā
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: करते हैं। ऐसा देखा गया है कि, दिव्य चक्षु महात्मा ऋषिगण भी सूक्ष्म भाव-समूह में लिप्त होने के कारण दोष-दुष्ट हो गये हैं। इसलिये सूक्ष्म भावसमूह में एकान्त निष्ठावान् नहीं होना चाहिए । ऐश्व्य से राग उत्पन्न होता है और विराग का ही नाम ब्रह्म है । इन सप्त सूक्ष्म तत्त्वों को और षडंग महेश्वर को जान कर जो योगी क्रिया-कलाप में पटु होते हैं, वे ही परत्रह्म को प्राप्त करते हैं।२६९-३२। विधि तत्व को जानने वाले
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: तामुज्जहारार्णवतोयमग्नां करी निमग्नामिव हस्तिनीं हठात् । नावं विशीर्णामिव तोयमध्याद् उदीर्णसत्त्वो ऽनुपमप्रभावः
verses.transliteration: tāmujjahārārṇavatoyamagnāṃ karī nimagnāmiva hastinīṃ haṭhāt / nāvaṃ viśīrṇāmiva toyamadhyād udīrṇasattvo 'nupamaprabhāvaḥ
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: व्यक्तियों ने प्रभु महेश्वर के षडज् तत्त्व को इस प्रकार बताया है, सर्वज्ञता, तृप्ति, अनादि बुद्धि, स्वतन्त्रता, नियत अविनश्वर शक्ति और अनन्त शक्ति ।३३। जो योगो परब्रह्म को ही नित्य धन समझने लगते हैं, उनके सभी उपसर्ग ब्वान्त हो जाते हैं। जिसने राग और प्राणायाम जनित उपसर्गों को जीत लिया है, उसके लिये वहिः शरीर में सर्वेकायं-साधिका एकमात्र धारणा ही विहित है । योंगी जहां-जहाँ जिस भूत विद्येष में मन को
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: स तां समुत्तार्य महाजलौघात् समुद्रमार्यो व्यभजत्समस्तम् । महार्णवेष्वेव महार्णवाम्भो निक्षेपयामास पुनर्नदीषु
verses.transliteration: sa tāṃ samuttārya mahājalaughāt samudramāryo vyabhajatsamastam / mahārṇaveṣveva mahārṇavāmbho nikṣepayāmāsa punarnadīṣu
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: लगाते हैं, वहाँ वे प्रवेश कर जाते हैं ।२४-३५। वे तीनों लोकों को भी कपा सकते हैं। वे देह छोड़ कर दूसरी देह में भी प्रवेश कर सकते हैं। सब योगों का द्वार मत है। आदित्य को भी योग का द्वार कहते हैं। ये इन्द्रियों का आदान करते हैं भर्थात् इन्द्रिय-वुत्ति समूह का आकर्षण करते हैं, इससे वे भादित्य कहलाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: शीर्णांश्च शैलान्स चकार भूयो द्वीपान्समस्तांश्च तथार्णवांश्च । शैलोपलैर्ये विचिताः समन्ताच्छिलोच्चयांस्तान्स चकार कल्पे
verses.transliteration: śīrṇāṃśca śailānsa cakāra bhūyo dvīpānsamastāṃśca tathārṇavāṃśca / śailopalairye vicitāḥ samantācchiloccayāṃstānsa cakāra kalpe
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: इस विधि से योगी विषय से विरक्त होकर, सूक्ष्म तत्त्वों को त्याग कर और प्रकृति का अतिक्रमण करके रुद्र- लोक में निवास पाता है ।३५। ऐश्वर्य ग्रुण से संयुक्त होने पर योगी ब्रह्मत्व प्राप्त करता है। तब वे संपूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.transliteration: anekarūpaṃ pravibhajya dehaṃ cakāra devendragaṇānsamastān / mukhācca vahnirmanasaśca candraścakṣośca sūryaḥ sahasā babhūva
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिद्वातगंतग्रन्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञे ऽथ तस्येश्वरयोगमूर्तेः प्रध्यायमानस्य सुरेन्द्रसङ्घः । वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च तथैव वर्णास् तथा हि सर्वौषधयो रसाश्च

verses.hindi: वेशाचेन पिशाचांश्रव राक्षसेन च राक्षसान् । गान्धर्वेण च गन्धर्वास्कौबेरेण कुबेरजान ४० इन्द्रमैन्द्रेण स्थानेन सौम्यं सौस्येन चेव हि। प्रजापति तथा चेव प्राजापत्येन साधयेत् ॥४ १

verses.sanskrit: जगत्समस्तं मनसा बभूव यत्स्थावरं किंचिदिहाण्डजं वा । जरायुजं स्वेदजम् उद्भिज्जं वा यत् किंचिद् आ कीटपिपीलकाद्यम्
verses.transliteration: jagatsamastaṃ manasā babhūva yatsthāvaraṃ kiṃcidihāṇḍajaṃ vā / jarāyujaṃ svedajam udbhijjaṃ vā yat kiṃcid ā kīṭapipīlakādyam

verses.hindi: नित्य॑ ब्रह्मपरों युक्तः स्थानान्येतानि वे त्यजेत्ू । असज्जमानः स्थानेषु द्विजः सर्वंगतो भवेत्. ४४३

verses.sanskrit: ततो विजज्ञे मनसा क्षणेन अनेकरूपाः सहसा महेशा । चकार यन्मूर्तिभिर् अव्ययात्मा अष्टाभिर् आविश्य पुनः स तत्र
verses.transliteration: tato vijajñe manasā kṣaṇena anekarūpāḥ sahasā maheśā / cakāra yanmūrtibhir avyayātmā aṣṭābhir āviśya punaḥ sa tatra

verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ती योगोपसर्गनिरूप्ण नाम द्वादशोध्ध्याय:

verses.sanskrit: लीलां चकाराथ समृद्धतेजा अतो ऽत्र मे पश्यत एव विप्राः । तेषां मया दर्शनमेव सर्वं यावन्मुहूर्तात्समकारि भूप
verses.transliteration: līlāṃ cakārātha samṛddhatejā ato 'tra me paśyata eva viprāḥ / teṣāṃ mayā darśanameva sarvaṃ yāvanmuhūrtātsamakāri bhūpa
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: देवस्थानों से हो जायें यानी देवस्थानों में धारणा नहीं करें ।३६। तब वे अपने पिशाचगुण से पिशाचादि को, राक्षस गुण से राक्षसों को, गान्धवे गुण से गन्धरवों को, कौवेर गुण से कुबेर को, ऐन्द्र गुण से इन्द्र को, सोम्य गुण से सोम को, प्राजापत्य से प्रजापति को साथे ।४०-४१। ब्राह्म गुण से ब्रह्मै२ की साधना भी योगी करे । वे ही प्रभु सब कार्यों के प्रवतंक हैं। उनमें आसक्त होने से योगी उन्मत्त अर्थात् सिद्ध हो जाता है। उन्हीं से सब का
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा त्वशेषं किल लीलयैव स देवदेवो जगतां विधाता । सर्वत्रदृक्सर्वग एव देवो जगाम चादर्शनमादिकर्ता
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tvaśeṣaṃ kila līlayaiva sa devadevo jagatāṃ vidhātā / sarvatradṛksarvaga eva devo jagāma cādarśanamādikartā
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: प्रवर्तन होता है। इसलिये इन गुण स्थानों का त्यागकर योगी नित्य ब्रद्मा में रत हो जाय। इन स्थानों में अनासक्त योगी सकंत्रगामी हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: यत्तन्मुहूर्तादिह नामरूपं तावत् प्रपश्यामि जगत्तथैव । द्वीपैः समुद्रैर् अभिसंवृतं हि नक्षत्रतारादिविमानकीर्णम्
verses.transliteration: yattanmuhūrtādiha nāmarūpaṃ tāvat prapaśyāmi jagattathaiva / dvīpaiḥ samudrair abhisaṃvṛtaṃ hi nakṣatratārādivimānakīrṇam
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: अत ऊध्वें प्रवक्ष्यामि ऐश्वरयंगुणविस्तरम् । येन योगविशेषेण सर्वलोकानतिक़़मेत् ३१ तत्राष्टग्रुणमैश्वर्य योगिनां समुदाहृतम् । तत्सवें क्रमयोगेन(ण )उच्यमानं निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: वियत्पयोदग्रहचक्रचित्रं नानाविधैः प्राणिगणैर् वृतं च । तां वै न पश्यामि महानुभावां गोरूपिणीं सर्वसुरेश्वरीं च
verses.transliteration: viyatpayodagrahacakracitraṃ nānāvidhaiḥ prāṇigaṇair vṛtaṃ ca / tāṃ vai na paśyāmi mahānubhāvāṃ gorūpiṇīṃ sarvasureśvarīṃ ca
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: अणिमा लघिमा चेव महिमा प्राप्तिरेव च्। प्राकाम्यं चव सबंत्र ईशित्यं चेव सर्वतः ४३ वशित्वमथ सर्वत्र यत्र कामावसायिता । तच्चापि विविध ज्ञेयमे श्वर्थ सावकासिकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: क्व सांप्रतं सेति विचिन्त्य राजन्विभ्रान्तचित्तस्त्वभवं तदैव । दिशो विभागानवलोकयान् ऋते पुनस्तां कथमीश्वराङ्गीम्
verses.transliteration: kva sāṃprataṃ seti vicintya rājanvibhrāntacittastvabhavaṃ tadaiva / diśo vibhāgānavalokayān ṛte punastāṃ kathamīśvarāṅgīm
verses.translation: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.hindi: तन्न सुक्ष्मप्रवत्तस्तु पञ्चभूतात्मक पुनः । इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चव बुद्धयहंकारसंज्ञितः ७... तथा सर्वेस्यं चेब आत्मस्था ख्यातिरेव च। संयोग एवं त्रिविधः सुक्ष्मेष्वेब प्रवर्तते
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यामि तामत्र पुनश्च शुभ्रां महाभ्रनीलां शुचिशुभ्रतोयाम् । वृक्षैरनेकैरुपशोभिताङ्गीं गजैस्तुरङ्गैर्विहगैर्वृतां च
verses.transliteration: paśyāmi tāmatra punaśca śubhrāṃ mahābhranīlāṃ śuciśubhratoyām / vṛkṣairanekairupaśobhitāṅgīṃ gajaisturaṅgairvihagairvṛtāṃ ca

verses.hindi: पुनरष्टगुणस्थापि तेष्वेवाथ प्रवर्तते । तस्य रूप॑ प्रवक्ष्यासि यथा55ह भगवान्प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a purity of mind, he should fill the body with Omkdra. Thus full of Omkdra, he does not perish.He becomes imperishable.
