verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो मानसः पुत्रो मुख्यो ह्यग्निरजायत । मुख्यो वह्निरितिप्रोक्त ऋषिः परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro mukhyo hyagnirajāyata / mukhyo vahniritiprokta ṛṣiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: There is nothing in the three worlds which is not known
verses.hindi: तथा प्रयुक्तमोंकारं प्रति निर्वाति सूर्धनि । तथोंकारमयो योगी ह्क्षरे त्वक्षरी भवेत् (४ प्रणवों धनुः शरो ह्यत्मा ब्रह्म तल्‍लक्ष्यमुच्यते । अप्रमत्तन वेद्धव्यं शरवत्तन्मयों भवेत् ३५ ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म गुहायां निहित॑ पदम् । ओमिस्येतत्त्रयों वेदास्त्रयो लोकास्त्रयोडग्नयः ... ७६ विष्णुक्रमास्त्रयस्त्वेते ऋक्सामानि यजूंषि च। सात्राश्चास्य चतस्रस्तु विज्ञेया: परमाथतः ३७.
verses.wordMeaning: There is nothing in the three worlds which is not known
verses.commentary: Sense: There is nothing in the three worlds which is not known

verses.sanskrit: तस्य स्वाहाभवत्पत्नी स्मृता दाक्षायणी तु सा । तस्यां मुख्या महाराज त्रयः पुत्रास्तदा ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: tasya svāhābhavatpatnī smṛtā dākṣāyaṇī tu sā / tasyāṃ mukhyā mahārāja trayaḥ putrāstadā 'bhavan
verses.translation: I shall explain to you the number of Kalpas precisely and what constitutes the foremost Yugas and years to the supreme god Brahma.
verses.hindi: तत्र युक्तश्व यो योगी तस्य सालोक्यतां ब्रजेत् । आकारस्त्वक्षरों ज्ञेय उकारः स्वरितः स्वृतः ८ मकारस्तु प्लुतो ज्ञेयस्त्रिमात्र इतिसंज्ञित:। अकारस्त्वथ भूलोंक उकारो भुव उच्यते ६ सव्यञ्जनो मकारश्र्व स्व्लोकिश्व विधीयते  ओंकारस्तु त्रयो लोकाः शिरस्तस्य त्रिविष्टपम्
verses.wordMeaning: I shall explain to you the number of Kalpas precisely and what constitutes the foremost Yugas and years to the supreme god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall explain to you the number of Kalpas precisely and what constitutes the foremost Yugas and years to the supreme god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निराहवनीयस्तु दक्षिणाग्निस्तथैव च । गार्हपत्यस्तृतीयस्तु त्रैलोक्यं यैश्च धार्यते
verses.transliteration: agnirāhavanīyastu dakṣiṇāgnistathaiva ca / gārhapatyastṛtīyastu trailokyaṃ yaiśca dhāryate
verses.translation: One thousand (human) Kalpas constitute a year of god Brahma. Eight thousand such years make a Yuga of Brahma.
verses.hindi: भुवनान्तं च॒ तत्सवं ब्राह्म तत्पदसुच्यते  मात्रापद॑ रुद्रलोको ह्यमात्रस्तु शिवं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: One thousand (human) Kalpas constitute a year of god Brahma. Eight thousand such years make a Yuga of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: One thousand (human) Kalpas constitute a year of god Brahma. Eight thousand such years make a Yuga of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तथा वै गार्हपत्यो ऽग्निर्जज्ञे पुत्रद्वयं शुभम् । पद्मकः शङ्कुनामा च तावुभावग्निसत्तमौ
verses.transliteration: tathā vai gārhapatyo 'gnirjajñe putradvayaṃ śubham / padmakaḥ śaṅkunāmā ca tāvubhāvagnisattamau
verses.translation: His face was dreadful, extremely fierce and very much awe-inspiring. It was reddish white. He was blazing with a refulgent body. He had a huge mouth and a white form,
verses.hindi: यावच्चेव नु शक्‍्यन्ते धायन्ते तावदेव हि। इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धि ध्यायन्नात्मनि यः सदा.
verses.wordMeaning: His face was dreadful, extremely fierce and very much awe-inspiring. It was reddish white. He was blazing with a refulgent body. He had a huge mouth and a white form,
verses.commentary: Sense: His face was dreadful, extremely fierce and very much awe-inspiring. It was reddish white. He was blazing with a refulgent body. He had a huge mouth and a white form,

verses.sanskrit: वसन्नग्निर्नदीतीरे समाश्रित्य महत्तपः । रुद्रमाराधयामास जितात्मा सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: vasannagnirnadītīre samāśritya mahattapaḥ / rudramārādhayāmāsa jitātmā susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him, god Brahma, the glorious Purusa with faces all round and the grandfather of the world, paid obei¬ sance to that Kumara (youth), the supporter of the world, the omnipresent great Lord, the god of gods who was the refulgent ancient Purusa, the eternal universal soul of Yogins.
verses.hindi: स्वर से उत्पन्न गास्धर्वी मात्रा भी लक्षित होती है। इन मात्राओं से युक्त ओंकार जब मसुत्तक में लय प्राप्त करता है, तब योगी ओंकारमय हो जाता है और अक्षरत्व लाभ करता है ।२-४॥ ओंकार धनुष है, आत्मा बाण है और ब्रह्म लक्ष्य है। सावधान होकर लक्ष्य-भेद करना चाहिए। इसके लिये बाण की तरह तनन्‍्मयता आवश्यक है । ओंकार रूपी एकाक्षर ब्रह्म बुद्धि रूपी गुहा में निहित है, वही परम पद है। ओंकार ही तीनों
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him, god Brahma, the glorious Purusa with faces all round and the grandfather of the world, paid obei¬ sance to that Kumara (youth), the supporter of the world, the omnipresent great Lord, the god of gods who was the refulgent ancient Purusa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, god Brahma, the glorious Purusa with faces all round and the grandfather of the world, paid obei¬ sance to that Kumara (youth), the supporter of the world, the omnipresent great Lord, the god of gods who was the refulgent ancient Purusa,…

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि चचार विपुलं तपः । तमुवाच महादेवः प्रसन्नो वृषभध्वजः
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ / tamuvāca mahādevaḥ prasanno vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: God Brahma embraced him to his bosom—the great god (Mahadeva), the supreme soul, the ruler of all, who was newly-born (Saclyojata). x He, then, meditated upon Brahman, knowing him, the ruler of Devas. The Lord of the world became delighted and burst into laughter.
verses.hindi: बेद, तीनों लोक और तीनों अग्नि है। यह त्रिविक्रम के तीनों पाद ऋक, यजु: और साभ है। ओंकार में चार मात्रायें हैं, यह विचार करके ज/नना : चाहिए ।१-७। उस ओंकार में जो योगी युक्त होता है, वह ब्रह्म सा- रूप्य को प्राप्त करता है। आकार को अक्षर समझना चाहिए, उक।र स्वर कहा गया है और मकार प्लुत है। इस प्रकार इसके परमाथंतः तीन मात्राओं को समझना चाहिए। अकार भूलोक, उकार भुव:लोक और
verses.wordMeaning: God Brahma embraced him to his bosom—the great god (Mahadeva), the supreme soul, the ruler of all, who was newly-born (Saclyojata). x He, then, meditated upon Brahman, knowing him, the ruler of Devas. The Lord of the world became delighted and burst into laughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: God Brahma embraced him to his bosom—the great god (Mahadeva), the supreme soul, the ruler of all, who was newly-born (Saclyojata). x He, then, meditated upon Brahman, knowing him, the ruler of Devas. The Lord of the world became delighted and burst into laughter.

verses.sanskrit: भोभो ब्रूहि महाभाग यत्ते मनसि वर्तते । दाता ह्यहम् असंदेहो यद्यपि स्यात् सुदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: bhobho brūhi mahābhāga yatte manasi vartate / dātā hyaham asaṃdeho yadyapi syāt sudurlabham
verses.translation: Then, from his side weremanifesled noble-souled, white- complexioned sages refulgent with the splendour of Brahman, bedecked with white garlands and unctions (probably with holy ashes —Bhasman ).
verses.hindi: व्यंजन सहित मकार स्वलोक कहा गया है। ओंकार त्रिलोकमम है। इसका शिरोभाग स्वर्ग है
verses.wordMeaning: Then, from his side weremanifesled noble-souled, white- complexioned sages refulgent with the splendour of Brahman, bedecked with white garlands and unctions (probably with holy ashes —Bhasman ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, from his side weremanifesled noble-souled, white- complexioned sages refulgent with the splendour of Brahman, bedecked with white garlands and unctions (probably with holy ashes —Bhasman ).

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरुवाच: नर्मदेयं महाभागा सरितो याश्च षोडश । भवन्तु मम पत्न्यस्तास्त्वत्प्रसादान्महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: agniruvāca: narmadeyaṃ mahābhāgā sarito yāśca ṣoḍaśa / bhavantu mama patnyastāstvatprasādānmaheśvara
verses.translation: They were Sunanda, Nandaka, Visvananda and Nandana, the noble-souled disciples by whom Brahman was then surrounded.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण भाग भुवनमय ब्राह्मपद कहां गया हैं। मात्रापद रुद्रलोक है और अमात्रा यानी विन्दुस्वरहूप शिवपद है। इस प्रकार विशेष प्रकार के ध्यान से उस पद की उपासना करे । इसलिये ध्याननिष्ठ योगी शाश्वत पद की कामना से यत्नपुवंक उस नित्य, अविनाशोी और अमात्र की उपासना करे। इसकी प्रथम मात्रा हस्व है, दूसरी मात्रा दीघ और तीसरी मात्रा प्लुत है। इन मात्राओं को यथार्थ भोर आनृपूर्वी रूप से समझता
verses.wordMeaning: They were Sunanda, Nandaka, Visvananda and Nandana, the noble-souled disciples by whom Brahman was then surrounded.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Sunanda, Nandaka, Visvananda and Nandana, the noble-souled disciples by whom Brahman was then surrounded.

verses.sanskrit: तासु वै चिन्तितान् पुत्रान् अग्र्यान् उत्पादयाम्यहम् । एष एव वरो देव दीयतां मे महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: tāsu vai cintitān putrān agryān utpādayāmyaham / eṣa eva varo deva dīyatāṃ me maheśvara
verses.translation: In front of him, the great sage Sveta of brilliant white complexion, endowed with great splendour was born. Nara was born of him.
verses.hindi: चाहिए ।? १-१४। जहाँ तक सामथ्यं हो, वहाँ तक इनकी धारणा करनी चाहिए । इन्द्रिय, मन, बुद्धि का जो
verses.wordMeaning: In front of him, the great sage Sveta of brilliant white complexion, endowed with great splendour was born. Nara was born of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: In front of him, the great sage Sveta of brilliant white complexion, endowed with great splendour was born. Nara was born of him.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: एतास्तु धिष्णिनाम्न्यो वै भविष्यन्ति सरिद्वराः । पत्न्यस्तव विशालाक्ष्यो वेदे ख्याता न संशयः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: etāstu dhiṣṇināmnyo vai bhaviṣyanti saridvarāḥ / patnyastava viśālākṣyo vede khyātā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: All the sages, engrossed in Pranayama and absorbed (resolutely) in the realization of Brahman became absolved of sins, free from maid ('bondage'in Saivism). Endowed with the splendour of Brahman, they transcend the world of god Brahma, and go to the region of the (supreme) Brahman.
verses.hindi: अत्राष्टमात्रमपि चेच्छणुयात्फलमाप्नुयात् । मासे मासेउश्वमेघेन यो यजेत शत समाः १६ न स तत्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यं मात्रया यदवाप्नुयात् । अब्बिन्दुं यः कुशाग्रेण मासे मासे पिबेन्नरः ११७ संवत्सरशतं पूर्ण मात्रया तदवाप्नुयात् । इष्टापूतंस्य यज्ञस्य सत्यवाक्ये च यत्फलम् ॥ै१८ अब्भक्षणे च मां(मा)सस्य सात्रया तदवाप्नुयात् । स्वास्यर्थे युध्यमानानां शुराणमनिवर्तिनामु
verses.wordMeaning: All the sages, engrossed in Pranayama and absorbed (resolutely) in the realization of Brahman became absolved of sins, free from maid ('bondage'in Saivism). Endowed with the splendour of Brahman, they transcend the world of god Brahma,…
verses.commentary: Sense: All the sages, engrossed in Pranayama and absorbed (resolutely) in the realization of Brahman became absolved of sins, free from maid ('bondage'in Saivism). Endowed with the splendour of Brahman, they transcend the world of god Brahma,…

verses.sanskrit: तासां पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति ह्यग्नयो ये ऽध्वरे स्मृताः । धिष्ण्यानाम सुविख्याता यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ putrā bhaviṣyanti hyagnayo ye 'dhvare smṛtāḥ / dhiṣṇyānāma suvikhyātā yāvadābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: SadyojSta is one of forms (also faces) of Siva. This appeared in W lohita Kalpa. As in his incarnations, these forms also had four sons or dts- ciples.
verses.hindi: यड्भू वेत्तत्फलं दृष्टं मात्रया तदवाप्नुयात् । न तथा तपसोग्रेण न यज्ञभूरिदक्षिण:
verses.wordMeaning: SadyojSta is one of forms (also faces) of Siva. This appeared in W lohita Kalpa. As in his incarnations, these forms also had four sons or dts- ciples.
verses.commentary: Sense: SadyojSta is one of forms (also faces) of Siva. This appeared in W lohita Kalpa. As in his incarnations, these forms also had four sons or dts- ciples.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महादेवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । नर्मदा च सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा तस्य भार्या बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata / narmadā ca saricchreṣṭhā tasya bhāryā babhūva ha
verses.translation: The thirtieth Kalpa is well-known by the name Rakta where the Being of great splendour assumed red complexion.
verses.hindi: यत्फलं प्राप्नुयात्सम्यइसात्रया तदवाप्नुयात् । तत्र बे योअर्धमात्रो यः प्लुतो नामोपदिश्यते
verses.wordMeaning: The thirtieth Kalpa is well-known by the name Rakta where the Being of great splendour assumed red complexion.
verses.commentary: Sense: The thirtieth Kalpa is well-known by the name Rakta where the Being of great splendour assumed red complexion.

verses.sanskrit: कावेरी कृष्णवेणी च रेवा च यमुना तथा । गोदावरी वितस्ता च चन्द्रभागा इरावती
verses.transliteration: kāverī kṛṣṇaveṇī ca revā ca yamunā tathā / godāvarī vitastā ca candrabhāgā irāvatī
verses.translation: From Brahma, the supreme god who, being desirous of
verses.hindi: एषा एवं भवेत्कार्या गृहस्थानां तु योगिनाम् । एषा चेव विशेषेण ऐश्वर्यंसमलक्षणा
verses.wordMeaning: From Brahma, the supreme god who, being desirous of
verses.commentary: Sense: From Brahma, the supreme god who, being desirous of

verses.sanskrit: विपाशा कौशिकी चैव सरयूः शतरुद्रिका । शिप्रा सरस्वती चैव ह्रादिनी पावनी तथा
verses.transliteration: vipāśā kauśikī caiva sarayūḥ śatarudrikā / śiprā sarasvatī caiva hrādinī pāvanī tathā
verses.translation: On seeing that boy of red garments, he entered into deep meditation and realised that he was the great lord of the universe.
verses.hindi: आत्मा में ध्यान करता हुआ अष्ठमात्रा-विशिष्ट प्रणव की धारणा करता है, वह विश्व॑प फल प्राप्त करता है । सुनिये, प्रत्येक मास जो अश्वमेध से सो वर्षों तक यजन करता है, वह उतना पुण्य प्राप्त नहीं करता है, जितना कि मात्रा के ज्ञान से प्राप्त होता है। जो आदमी कुश के अग्र भाग से प्रति मास जलविन्दु पान करते हैं और सौ ब्षों तक ऐसा करते रहते हैं उसके उस कर्म के समान मात्रा के ज्ञान द्वारा फल प्राप्त होता
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that boy of red garments, he entered into deep meditation and realised that he was the great lord of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that boy of red garments, he entered into deep meditation and realised that he was the great lord of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: एताः षोडशा नद्यो वै भार्यार्थं संव्यवस्थिताः । तदात्मानं विभज्याशु धिष्णीषु स महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: etāḥ ṣoḍaśā nadyo vai bhāryārthaṃ saṃvyavasthitāḥ / tadātmānaṃ vibhajyāśu dhiṣṇīṣu sa mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: After bowing to him, Brahma became extremely self- controlled and meditated on the Vamadeva 1 form of Brah¬ man.
verses.hindi: है ।१५-१ ३। इष्टापूर्त यज्ञ का और सत्य बचन का जो फल है, एवं महीने भर जल पीकर रहने का जो फल है, वही फल मात्रा ज्ञान से प्राप्त होता है। स्वामी के लिये युद्ध में मर जाने वाले शूरों को जो फल प्राप्त होता है, वही फल मात्रा ज्ञान से होता है। मात्रा ज्ञान से जो फल प्राप्त होंवा है, वह उग्र तपस्या अथवा बहुत दक्षिणा वाले यज्ञ से भी नहीं प्राप्त होता है। उसकी जो अद्धमात्रा प्लुत के नाम से कही गयी है, वही
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing to him, Brahma became extremely self- controlled and meditated on the Vamadeva 1 form of Brah¬ man.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to him, Brahma became extremely self- controlled and meditated on the Vamadeva 1 form of Brah¬ man.

verses.sanskrit: व्यभिचारात् तु भर्तुर् वै नर्मदाद्यासु धिष्णिषु । उत्पन्नाः शुचयः पुत्राः सर्वे ते धिष्ण्यपाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: vyabhicārāt tu bhartur vai narmadādyāsu dhiṣṇiṣu / utpannāḥ śucayaḥ putrāḥ sarve te dhiṣṇyapāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The great god who was thus meditated upon by Brahma the Paramestltin, spoke to the grandfather of the world (Brahma' with mind full of affection. 1
verses.hindi: गृहस्थ योगियों के लिये विशेष रूप से उपादेय है। वही विशेष रूप से ऐद्वये-साधक है ।१८-२२। योगियों को अणिमादि आठ प्रकार के शेष ऐब्वर्य की प्राप्ति उसी से हं'ती है; अतएव ब्राह्मण उसी का साधन करे। इस प्रकार उस प्लुत मात्रा से संयुक्त होकर जो शुद्ध. शान्त और जितैन्द्रिय योगी अपने को जानता है, वह द्विज सब जान जाता है। ध्यानपरायण ब्राह्मण योगज्ञान से ही तीनों वेदों और उपनिषदों को जान जाते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: The great god who was thus meditated upon by Brahma the Paramestltin, spoke to the grandfather of the world (Brahma' with mind full of affection. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: The great god who was thus meditated upon by Brahma the Paramestltin, spoke to the grandfather of the world (Brahma' with mind full of affection. 1

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्च नर्मदायास्तु धिष्णीन्द्रो नाम विश्रुतः । बभूव पुत्रो बलवान्रूपेणाप्रतिमो नृप
verses.transliteration: tasyāśca narmadāyāstu dhiṣṇīndro nāma viśrutaḥ / babhūva putro balavānrūpeṇāpratimo nṛpa
verses.translation: "O most venerable god! Inasmuch as I was visua¬ lized by you with highestdevotion and Yoga of meditation while you were meditating with the desired having a son, you who
verses.hindi: वे सब भूतों के लयस्थान में लीन होकर लयस्‍्थान के रूप में परिणत हो जाते हैं। वे योगिजनोचित उत्क्रमण विधान से प्राण त्याग करके अविनाशी पद को प्राप्त करते हैं।२३-२६। जो दिव्य दृष्टि से ध्यान के द्वारा चतुर्मुखी, विश्वरूपाख्या प्रकृति देवी को देख कर यह समझते हैं कि, यही एक अजा है, जो रक्त-कृष्ण-
verses.wordMeaning: "O most venerable god! Inasmuch as I was visua¬ lized by you with highestdevotion and Yoga of meditation while you were meditating with the desired having a son, you who
verses.commentary: Sense: "O most venerable god! Inasmuch as I was visua¬ lized by you with highestdevotion and Yoga of meditation while you were meditating with the desired having a son, you who

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवासुरं युद्धम् अभवल्लोमहर्षणम् । मयतारकम् इत्येवं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tato devāsuraṃ yuddham abhavallomaharṣaṇam / mayatārakam ityevaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: १२६ वर्युपुराणमे
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दैत्यैर् महाघोरैर् मयतारपुरोगमैः । ताडितास्ते सुरास्त्रस्ता विष्णुं वै शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: tatra daityair mahāghorair mayatārapurogamaiḥ / tāḍitāste surāstrastā viṣṇuṃ vai śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: अजामेकां लोहितशुक्लकृषष्णां बह्दीः प्रजा: सृजमानां स्व॒(स)रूपाम् (पाः) ।
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: त्रायस्व नो हृषीकेशा घोरादस्मान्महाभयात् । दैत्यान्सर्वान्संहरस्व मयतारपुरोगमान्
verses.transliteration: trāyasva no hṛṣīkeśā ghorādasmānmahābhayāt / daityānsarvānsaṃharasva mayatārapurogamān
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: अजो ह्य को जुषमाणोश्नुशेते जहात्येनां भुक्तभोगामजो5न्यः ९८
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः स भगवान्दिशो दश व्यलोकयत् । ततो भगवता दृष्टौ रणे पावकमारुतौ
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ sa bhagavāndiśo daśa vyalokayat / tato bhagavatā dṛṣṭau raṇe pāvakamārutau
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: इत्येदक्षर ब्रह्म परमोंकारसंज्ञितम् । यस्तु वेदयते सम्यक्तथा ध्यायति वा पुनः १३० संसारचक़मुत्सुज्य मुक्तबन्धनबन्धन: । अचल निर्गुणं स्थान शिव प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: आहूतौ विष्णुना तौ तु सकाशं जग्मतुः क्षणात् । स्थितौ तौ प्रणतौ चाग्रे देवदेवस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: āhūtau viṣṇunā tau tu sakāśaṃ jagmatuḥ kṣaṇāt / sthitau tau praṇatau cāgre devadevasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: इत्येतद्व मया प्रोक्तमोंकारप्राप्तिलक्षणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: ततो धिष्णिः पावकेन्द्रो देवेनोक्तो महात्मना । निर्दहेमान् महाघोरान् नार्मदेय महासुरान्
verses.transliteration: tato dhiṣṇiḥ pāvakendro devenokto mahātmanā / nirdahemān mahāghorān nārmadeya mahāsurān
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: नमो लोकेश्वराय संकल्पकल्पग्रहणाय महान्तसुपतिष्ठते तद्दों हितं यद्ब्नह्मणे नमः । सर्वेत्रस्थानिने निर्गुणाय संभक्तयोगोश्वराय च। पुष्करपर्णमिवास्ि विशुद्धसिब ब्रह्ममुपतिष्ठत्पवित्र (? ) पवित्राणां पवित्र पवित्रेण परिपूरितेन पवित्रेण हस्वं दोघंप्लुतमिति तदेतमोंकारमशब्दम- स्पशेमरूपमरसमगन्ध॑ पर्युपासे(सी )त, अविद्येशानाय विश्वरूपो न तस्य, अविद्येशानाय नमो
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: अथैवमुकौ तौ देवौ रणे पावकमारुतौ । दैत्यान् ददहतुः सर्वान् मयतारपुरोगमान्
verses.transliteration: athaivamukau tau devau raṇe pāvakamārutau / daityān dadahatuḥ sarvān mayatārapurogamān
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: वरीयसो देवानां हृदयं विश्वकपो न तस्य प्राणापानोपस्थं चास्ति ओंकारो विश्वविश्वों वे यज्ञो यज्ञो व वेदों वेदों वे नमसस्‍्कारो नमस्कारो रुद्रो नमो रुद्राय योगेश्वराधिपतये नमः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: दह्यमानास्तु ते सर्वे शस्त्रैरग्निं त्ववेष्टयन् । दिव्यैरग्न्यर्कसङ्काशैः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: dahyamānāstu te sarve śastrairagniṃ tvaveṣṭayan / divyairagnyarkasaṅkāśaiḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: वर्ण की है और अपनी ही तरह अनेक प्रजाओं को उत्पन्न करने वाली है। जीव रूप एक अज उस्त अजा से मिलकर शायन करता है अर्थात् उसका उपभोग करता है; किन्तु दूसरा शिव स्वरूप अज उसे उपभुक्त समझ कर छोड़ देता है। वह प्रकृति स्वरूपा आदि अजा आठ अक्षरों वाली, सोलह पाणि-पादोंवाली, चतुमुखी, शिखाविहीन या विशिष्ट शिखाव्राली, एक श्लज्ुवाली और संसार का सृजन करने वालो है। इसके स्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: तांश्चाग्निः शस्त्रनिकरैर्निर्ददाह महासुरान् । ज्वालामालाकुलं सर्वं वायुना निर्मितं तदा
verses.transliteration: tāṃścāgniḥ śastranikarairnirdadāha mahāsurān / jvālāmālākulaṃ sarvaṃ vāyunā nirmitaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: को जानकर पंडित अमृतत्व प्राप्त करते हैं, जो ब्राह्मण प्रणब को जानते है, वे पुनः संसार-यात्रा नहीं करते हैं ।२७-२६। यह ओंकार रूप अक्षर ब्रह्म है। इसका जो ध्यान करता है और जो इसे समझता है, वही सभी बन्धनों से मुक्त होकर ओर संसार के आवागमन से रहित होकर निश्चय ही अचल, निर्गुण शिवस्थान को प्राप्त करता है। वह हमने ओंकार प्राप्ति का लक्षण बताया हैं ।३०-३२। सर्व सद्भुल्पाभिशे लोकेश्वर को
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: दह्यमानास्ततो दैत्या अग्निज्वालासमावृताः । प्रविश्य पातालतलं जले लीनाः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: dahyamānāstato daityā agnijvālāsamāvṛtāḥ / praviśya pātālatalaṃ jale līnāḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: नमस्कार है। उसी महात्मा की उपासना करनी चाहिए। उसी ब्रह्म को प्रणाम करना आप लोगों के लिये हितकर है। सर्वव्यापी, निर्गुण, भक्त योगियों के लिये ऐश्वयंदाता, जलयुक्त परन्तु उससे अलिप्त कमलपत्र की तरह शुद्ध ब्रह्य की उपासना करनो चाहिए । पवित्रों के बीच पवित्र, अतिशय पवित्र, पवित्रता से पृर्ण, दसस्‍्व, दीघे, प्लुतमात्राविशिष्ट, शब्द-स्पर्श-रूप-रस-गन्धवरजित ओंकार की उपासना करनी चाहिए। अविद्या-
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कुमारमग्निं तु नर्मदापुत्रमव्ययम् । पूजयित्वा सुराः सर्वे जग्मुस्ते त्रिदशालयम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kumāramagniṃ tu narmadāputramavyayam / pūjayitvā surāḥ sarve jagmuste tridaśālayam
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: इति सिद्धिप्रत्युपस्थानं साय॑ प्रातमंध्याह्न नम इति । सर्वकामफलो रुद्रः ३३ यथा वन्तात्फलं पक्‍वे पवनेन समोरितम् । नमस्कारेण रुद्रस्य तथा पाप॑ं प्रणश्यति (३४ यथा रुद्रनमस्कारः सर्वेधमंफलो ध्रवः । अन्यदेवनमस्कारो न तत्फलमवाप्नुयात् ३५ तस्मात्त्रिषवर्ण योगी उपासोत महेश्वरम् । दशविस्तारक ब्रह्म तथा च ब्रह्म विस्तरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: सशल्यस्तु महातेजा रेवापुत्रो वृतो ऽग्निभिः । नर्मदामागतः क्षिप्रं मातरं द्रष्टुमुत्सुकः
verses.transliteration: saśalyastu mahātejā revāputro vṛto 'gnibhiḥ / narmadāmāgataḥ kṣipraṃ mātaraṃ draṣṭumutsukaḥ
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: ओंकारं सबंतः काले सर्व विहितवान्प्रभुः । तेन तेन तु विष्णुत्वं नमस्कार महायशा (३७ नम॑स्कारस्तथा चव प्रणव: स्तुब॒ते प्रभुम् । प्रणवं स्तुब॒ते यज्ञों यज्ञ संस्तुबते मनः रे८ मनः स्तुव॒ति वे रुद्रो तस्माद्द्रपदं शिवम्  इत्येतानि रहस्यानि यतीनां वे यथाक्रमम् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रम् आयान्तं शस्त्रौघेण परिक्षतम् । नर्मदा पुण्यसलिला अभ्युत्थाय सुविस्मिता
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā putram āyāntaṃ śastraugheṇa parikṣatam / narmadā puṇyasalilā abhyutthāya suvismitā
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते ओंकारप्राप्तिलक्षणकथनं नाम विशोद्ष्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यष्वजत बाहुभ्यां प्रस्नवापीडितस्तनी । सशल्यं पुत्रमादाय कापिलं ह्रदमाविशत्
verses.transliteration: paryaṣvajata bāhubhyāṃ prasnavāpīḍitastanī / saśalyaṃ putramādāya kāpilaṃ hradamāviśat
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: घिपति योगीश्वर को नमस्कार है। अविद्याधिपति को नमस्कार करने वाले का विश्वरूप नहीं होता यानी उसे अविद्या नहीं सताती है। जिसने द्यूलोक को उन्नत, प्रृथ्वी को दृढ़, स्वलोक को स्तम्भित और स्व को अन्तरिक्ष में रखा है, जो देत्रों के हृदय स्वरूप हैं वही परम पुरुष विश्वरूप हैं। उन्हें प्राणापान नहीं हैं और न उनकी उपमा है। यही ओंकार नामक विव्वहूपी रुद्र, यज्ञ, वेद और नमस्कारादि रूप से परिणत हुये हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टमात्रे तु ह्रदे कापिले पापनाशिनि । सशल्यं तं विशल्यं च क्षणात्कृतवती तदा
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭamātre tu hrade kāpile pāpanāśini / saśalyaṃ taṃ viśalyaṃ ca kṣaṇātkṛtavatī tadā
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: उस योगेश्वराधिपति रुद्र को नमस्कार है। सिद्धिदायक रुद्रोपस्थानका सायं-मध्याह्ष और प्रातः काल में पाठ करने से रुद्र सभी कमनाओं को फलीभूत करते है ।३३। वायु के हल्के धक्के से ही जैसे पका फल गुच्छे से टपक पड़ता है, उर्स। प्रकार रुद्र को नमस्कार करने से सभी पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: स विशल्यो ऽभवद् यस्मात् प्राप्य तस्याः शिवं जलम् । कपिला नामतस् तेन विशल्या चोच्यते बुधैः
verses.transliteration: sa viśalyo 'bhavad yasmāt prāpya tasyāḥ śivaṃ jalam / kapilā nāmatas tena viśalyā cocyate budhaiḥ
verses.translation: Other excellent Brahmanas practising Yoga for their communion with Vamadeva attained the lord, as they are his devotees and attached to him. Becoming sinless and pure and attaining the splendour of Brahman, all of them reach Rudra- loka whence there is no return to Samsara.
verses.hindi: रुद्र को नमस्कार करने से सब धर्मों का फल प्राप्त होता है, दूसरे देवों को नमस्कार करने से वह फल नहीं मिलता है, इसलिये योगी त्रिकाल में जगद्विस्तारकारी ब्रह्मस्वरूप महेश्वर की उपासना करे। वह प्रभु सब समय ओंकार में निविष्ट है। इसलिये मह'यशस्वी विष्णु ही नमस्करणीय हैं। नमस्कार मूर्ति विष्ण का प्रणव स्तवन करता है। यज्ञ प्रणव का, मन यज्ञ का और रुद्र मन का स्तवन करते हैं इसलिये

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये विशल्यासम्भवो नाम द्वाविंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २३ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: तत्रैव सङ्गमे राजन्भक्त्या परमया नृप । प्राणांस्त्यजन्ति ये मर्त्यास्ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye viśalyāsambhavo nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 23 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tatraiva saṅgame rājanbhaktyā paramayā nṛpa / prāṇāṃstyajanti ye martyāste yānti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: The thirtyfirst Kalpa is known as Pitavasas 1 * * (yellow garmented). Here, god Brahma of great brilliance assumes a yellow complexion. While Brahma, the supreme god, was meditating with a desire for sons, a son of great splendour robed in yellow attire He was a mighty-armed young man with yellow ointment On seeing him engaged in meditation, Brahma mental1 y saluted him who was the supreme lord and the creator of the When god Brahma became absorbed in meditation, e On seeing that great goddess Mahesvari, t e go o immense splendour who was bowed to by Devas, spoke: "Come on. Come on," said he, eulogising her fre- quently by terms such as intellect 5, c memory an mow e ge. ''Enveloping the universe with Yoga, bring the whole world under (your) control. Or you will join with Rudra and become his consort. For the welfare of Brahmanas, you will be the highest truth." Then the lord of the chief of De% as gave the four- footed great goddess (Mahesvari) to Brahma who was meditat¬ ing with a desire to have sons. Then realising by his Yogic meditation that she was the supreme goddess, Brahma who deser¬ ves obeisance from all the world, sought refuge in her. Having- meditated on the Gayatrl pertaining to Rudra, god Brahma be° came self-controlled. When the Kalpa of yellow colour of the self-born deity passed away, another Kalpa called Sita 1 began to function.
verses.hindi: ऋषीणामग्निकल्पानां नेसिषारण्यवासिनाम्  ऋषिः श्रुतिधरः प्राज्ः सावर्णिनास नामतः १ तेषां सोप्प्यग्रतो भुत्वा वायुं वाक्यविशारद: । सातत्य॑ तत्र कुर्व॑न्तं प्रियार्थे सत्नयाजिनाम् विनयेनोपसंगम्य पप्रच्छ स सहाद्युतिम्

verses.sanskrit: संन्यस्तसर्वसंकल्पो यस्तु प्राणान्परित्यजेत् । अमरेश्वरमासाद्य स स्वर्गे नियतं वसेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃnyastasarvasaṃkalpo yastu prāṇānparityajet / amareśvaramāsādya sa svarge niyataṃ vaset
verses.translation: When the universe was turned into a single vast ocean and a thousand divine years had elapsed, the dejected Brahma desirous of creating the subjects began to think. Then he of great splendour saw that a boy of great powers, dark in complexion and shinning with his lustre had appeared. He wore dark garments, an excellent black turban, black sacred thread, black garlands and unguents and had a black head. On seeing the noble-souled, immortal one with terrible mantras, he (Brahma) paid homage to the dark and tawny Lord of the chief of the Devas and the universe. The glorious Brahma was engaged in Prandydma (breath control). With Maliesvara (the great god) in his heart, he men¬ tally sought refuge in the Lord of ascetics absorbed in medita¬ tion. Brahma then contemplated on Brahman as Aghora. While he was thus meditating Lord Rudra burst out in a boisterous laughter. Then from his sides four noble sons emerged. They were black in complexion and had black garlands and ungu¬ ents. ' They wore black garments, turbans, clothes and had black faces. They laughed aloud boisterously. They uttered great hissing sounds. They performed obeisance again and again. Then they worshipped him for a thousand years by means of Yoga and at the end of that period they transferied their activities to their disciples. Verses 20-32 describe the 32nd Kalpa called Sita (black). Complexion and dress suitable to the name of the Kalpa and birth of four sons a a boistrous laugh—all these are common features to other Avataras of biva. The avatdra or form of Siva here is Aghora.
verses.hindi: विभो पुराणसंबड़ां कथां वे वेदसंसिताम्। श्रोतुमिच्छामहे सम्यकप्रसादात्सवंदशिनः 0७३ हिरण्यगर्भो भगवॉल्ललाटान्नोललोहितम् । कथं तत्तजस देव लब्धवान्पुत्रमात्मनः ४ कथं च भगवाञजज्ञे ब्रह्म कमलसंभव: । रुद्रत्वं चेव शर्वस्थ स्वात्मजस्य कथ्थ पुनः

verses.sanskrit: शैलेन्द्रं यः समासाद्य आत्मानं मुञ्चते नरः । विमानेनार्कवर्णेन स गच्छेदमरावतीम्
verses.transliteration: śailendraṃ yaḥ samāsādya ātmānaṃ muñcate naraḥ / vimānenārkavarṇena sa gacchedamarāvatīm
verses.translation: Other Brahmanas too well-versed in the injunctions who meditate upon Rudra by means of Yoga attain the eternal lord. When that terrible black Kalpa elapsed, another Kalpa named Visvarupa 1 began to function. After the period of dissolution was over when the mobile and immobile beings were created and when Brahma desirous of sons began to meditate, the omnipresent Sarasvati of great sound manifested (herself). Brahma who had a Yogic communion with his Atman mentally meditated on Isana, the lord of all, the omnipresent, who was clad in universal garlands and robes and who wore universal sacred thread and universal turban and who had applied universal scents, who had mighty arms and had universe as his abode. Brahma bowed to the lord. To him who was thus meditating and saluting, with the words Otii to Isana, O Mahadeva, obeisance be to you," the Lord Isa (Siva) said, "I am pleased with you. Ask what you desire." Then, bowing and eulogising the lord with words, the delighted Brahma replied with a contented mind: O lord I wish to know your universal form that per¬ vades and rules over the universe. I wish to know who is this supreme god. Listen precisely to this holy and nourishing secret of all mantras. It is the great secret of the first creation. The Kalpa that is current now is known as Visvarupa, wherein Devas, Bhava and others and twenty-six Manus (are said to have existed). O Lord, this is the thirty-third Kalpa since you have occupied the position of Brahma.
verses.hindi: कथं च॒ विष्णो रुद्रेण साथ्थ प्रीतिरनुत्तमा। सर्वे विष्णुमया देवा सर्वे विष्णुमया गणाः ६

verses.sanskrit: नरं पतन्तमालोक्य नगाद् अमरकण्टकात् । ब्रुवन्त्यप्सरसः सर्वा मम भर्ता भवेदिति
verses.transliteration: naraṃ patantamālokya nagād amarakaṇṭakāt / bruvantyapsarasaḥ sarvā mama bhartā bhavediti
verses.translation: It should be known that Ananda (is your predecessor). In Ananda you will be ultimately dissolved. You are of the spiritual lineage of Galavya. By virtue of penance you have be¬ come my son. In you are firmly established Yoga, Sankhya, pen¬ ance, learning, sacred precepts, rites, order, truth, Brahman, non-violence, series of generations, meditation, the body for meditation, quiescence, Vidya and Avidya, mind, fortitude, splendour, calmness, memory, intellect, modesty, purity, speech, contentment; nourishment, rituals, shyness and forbearance. Know, O Brahma, that this great goddess is Prakrti, your mother. She possesses twenty-six attributes. She is called "thirty- two syllabled' 5. This venerable goddess is the mother of the self-born god. She has four faces. She is the origin of the universe. She is glorified as Prakrti, the cow whom the meditators of the reality call Prakrti and Pradhana. This unborn (Goddess) is red, white and black in complexion. She is beautiful in form and creator of the universe. While I, the unborn, am intelligent knower that, the universal-formed (all-pervading) Gayatrl, is the universal-formed cow." After saying thus, the great lord laughed boisterously. Moving clapping his hands loudly he produced 'Kahakaha' sound. Then from his sides divine sons of various forms were born, some with matted hair, some with shaven heads, some with tufts and some with half-shaven heads. Those sons of great prowess worshipped the lord for a thousand divine years by means of Yoga as mentioned (before), instructed decent pupils in righteousness and Yogic practice and restraint. Thereafter, they entered Lord Rudra. Then Brahma, the grandfather of the world was struck with wonder. He resorted to the great god (Mahadeva) with heart full of devotion. He spoke the words, "O Lord! How is this entire whiteness of yours?" When it was Svetakalpa, I became wholly white. I had white turban, white garlands and white garments, and was known as the auspicious. My bones, flesh, hair and skin were white. My blood too was white. Hence this Kalpa came to be known as Sveta.
verses.hindi: सूतज्ी बोल्लेे--नैमिषारण्य में रहने वाले अग्नितुल्य ऋषियों के बीच सावर्णि नाम के एक वेदज्ञ पण्डित ऋषि थे  बोलने में चतुर होने के कारण सब ऋषियों से आगे बढ़ कर उन्होंने विनयपूर्ण, अत्यन्त कान्तिवाले वायु से सत्रयाज्ञिकों के कल्याण के लिये पूछा

verses.sanskrit: समं जलं धर्मविदो वदन्ति सारस्वतं गाङ्गमिति प्रबुद्धाः । तस्योपरिष्टात् प्रवदन्ति तज्ज्ञा रेवाजलं नात्र विचारणास्ति
verses.transliteration: samaṃ jalaṃ dharmavido vadanti sārasvataṃ gāṅgamiti prabuddhāḥ / tasyopariṣṭāt pravadanti tajjñā revājalaṃ nātra vicāraṇāsti
verses.translation: Due to my grace, the lord of Dcvas possessed white limbs and white blood, The Gayatrl called Brahma Gayatrl 2 was of white complexion. O lord of Devas, I, the eternal Sadyojala, stationed in the secret region, have been realised by you by means of penance. So this secret Brahman is glorified as Sadyojata. In verses 57-74 Lord Siva recapitulates the names of the Kalpas and his appearance as follows: Lohita or Rakta Visvarupa As the importance of the so-called Gayatrl mantra became well-established, the Purana writers (devotees of one of the trinity of gods) had a Gayatrl Mantra pertaining to their own special deity. Thus AP 317. 7 gives the Siva (Rudra) Gayatrl as follows: Hence the Brahmanas who realize me hidden in secret (the heart) will approach me whence the return (tosamsara) is When I next became Lohita (red), theKalpatoo was known as Lohita through the colour assumed by me. Then Gayatri, the cow was glorified as endowed with red flesh, bones, blood, milk, eyes, and udder. Then I became Vamadeva as my colour changed into red. By the excellence of Yoga, I was known as Vamadeva.
verses.hindi: सावर्णि बोले--प्रभो ! आप सबवंदर्शी हैं। आपके प्रमाद से हम वेदतुल्य पौराणिक कथा को अच्छी तरह से सुनना चाहते हैं। भगव,न् हिरण्यगर्भ ने अपने ललाट से अत्यन्त तेजस्वी नीललोहित देव को किस प्रकार पुत्र रूप में प्राप्त किया ? ।३-४ कमलयोति ब्रह्मा किस प्रकार उत्पन्न हुये ? बअ्रह्मनन्दन नीललोहित को रुद्रत्व किस प्रकार प्राप्त हुआ ? रुद्र के साथ विष्णु की उत्तम प्रीति किस प्रकार हुई ? 'सभी देवता

verses.sanskrit: अनेकविद्याधरकिन्नराद्यैर् अध्यासितं पुण्यतमाधिवासैः । रेवाजलं धारयतो हि मूर्ध्ना स्थानं सुरेन्द्राधिपतेः समीपे
verses.transliteration: anekavidyādharakinnarādyair adhyāsitaṃ puṇyatamādhivāsaiḥ / revājalaṃ dhārayato hi mūrdhnā sthānaṃ surendrādhipateḥ samīpe
verses.translation: Still, O Mighty one, I have been known by you of res¬ trained soul as white-coloured that excels all colours. Henceforth I attained fame as Vamadeva. Those twice-born ones who realize my position as Vamadeva and who realise Mother RudranI, Gayatri, are liberated from sins. They become free from passion. They have the splendour of Brahman. They will attain Rudra's region from which the return is rarely possible. When this Kalpa became terribly black in colour through the colour assumed by me, the Kalpa was called There I am like Kala (God of death). I am black and I illuminate the worlds. O Brahma, I have been realised by you as terrible and of terrific exploit. Hence to those on the earth who realise me in this terri¬ ble form, I, the eternal god shall become non-terrible and quies¬ cent. To those on the earth who realize me in universal form, I always become propitious and gentle. Hence this Kalpa too is Vis'varupa. There Savitr! too is These sons of mine art omniformed. They are mention¬ ed to be four. Their feet are indeed worshipped by the worlds. Hence too in my subjects there will be all castes and colours. The subjects shall eat all sorts of foodstuffs. They will be pure according to caste. Salvation, virtue, wealth and love constitute a set ot four 1. Hence the knower and theknown too will become fourfold.
verses.hindi: विष्णमय हैं, सभी गण विष्णुमय हैं, विष्णु के समान कोई दूसरी गति नहीं है” देवगण सर्देव ऐसा नि:संदिग्ध

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा सर्वदा सेव्या बहुनोक्तेन किं नृप । यदीच्छेन्न पुनर्द्रष्टुं घोरं संसारसागरम्
verses.transliteration: narmadā sarvadā sevyā bahunoktena kiṃ nṛpa / yadīcchenna punardraṣṭuṃ ghoraṃ saṃsārasāgaram
verses.translation: Verses 75-77 speak of the sets of four (entities) such ttogharma, Artha, Kama and Moksa) and Yugas (Krta, Treta, Dvapar The living beings are of four categories. The stages in life are four. The feet of virtue are four. My sons are four. The universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings, exists in the four Yugas. Since it is four-fold, it becomes four-footed. Bhxir, Bhuvar, Svar, Mafias, Jana, Tapas and Santa are the seven regions. The region of Rudra is beyond these re¬ gions. Svar is the third and Mafias is the fourth. This region is very extensive. It is the great abode of Yogins. Those alone who practise Yoga, who know about it, who meditate upon it, who are in* communion with it, who are free from the feeling of c my-ness', who are devoid of egotism, lust or anger, can realize it. Since you saw the four-footed Sarasvati, all animals will' be four-footed and will have four teats. Since Soma charged with Mantras exuded from my mouth, O Brahma, the soul of all living beings will drink milk contained in her breasts. Hence (the milk) will be full of Soma and is designated as Amrla (nectar) and hence the quadrupeds have their whiteness therefrom. Thus being addressed by Rudra, Lord Brahma, the grandfather of the world bowed down to Rudra and spoke to him again with humility and restraint. O Lord Mahesvara, O chief of the lords of Devas, O omnipresent Mahadeva, these bodies of yours are revered by the people. verses.translation: In the third Dvapara age, when Bhargava is the Vyasa, I will be born as Damana at the end of that age. There also four sons will be born to me, viz. Vis'oka, Vikcsa, Visapa and Sapanasana. In the fourth Dvapara age, when Angiras is the Vyasa, I will be born and known as Suhotra. There also four excellent sons will be born to me. They will be great ascetics, excellent Brahmanas, steadfast in holy rites and endowed with Yogic souls. They will be Sumukha, Durmukha, Durdama and Duratikrama. They will attain the subtle goal of Yoga and be¬ come pure. Their sins will be burnt. They too will be going along the same path. In the fifth Dvapara age, when Savitr will be the Vyasa, I shall be born as a great ascetic (called) Kanga (Kaiika?). Then at the end of the age, some other noble Atmans too will become unsullied and pure. Attaining the holy Mahalaya, the region of the great lord, they will enable the people ten generations before and ten after, to cross the ocean of worldly existence. After making everyone (of the preceding ten and succeeding ten generations) including themselves as the twenty-first, cross the great ocean (ofworldly existence), they will attain, through my grace, the region of Rudra, free from (worldly) feverishness. verses.translation: When many Manvantaras pass off, the mighty devas of the Kalpa go up and attain Sayujya. When the time of withdrawal (dissolution) arrives, the fourteen Ganas leave Maharloxa. 1 Those gods in combin¬ ation with these (quit the Maharloka), when the elements and immobiles alone are left behind, when all the regions from the Bhuvar-loka to Svar-loka become void; when Devas whose duration of tenure is a Kalpa go upto Janaloka, god Brahma then collects (all) the groups of Devas, sages and Danavas and destroys them all through fire and showers when the Yuga comes to an end. In the seventh Kalpa that has just passed off and has been described to you by me, the seven oceans joined together and formed one vast limitless (and divisionless) ocean full of darkness. In the vast single ocean, the lord holding conch, discus and mace lay on the serpent couch. He had the colour of the cloud. He was lotus-eyed. He had a crown. He was the lord ofLaksmi. He was Hari, the eighth Purusottama born of the mouth of Narayana. He had eight arms, and a broad chest. He is the source of origin of the worlds. He was in communion with the self. Conversant with the process of Yoga, he had taken to meditation beyond the ken of thought, by his Maya. The serpent (his couch) had a thousand hoods; its body had an unparalleled splendour and the lustre of gold. While he was lying there, taking repose in the Atman, he, the mighty Visnu, created a lotus in his umbilicus just for a sport. The lotus extended to a hundred Yojanas. It had the splendour of the midday-sun. It was very high supported by an adamantine stalk. It was created sportively by the powerful lord. Verses 5-14 describe the dissolution of the universe and formation of one ocean (Ekdryana) of cosmic waters with god Visnu lying on the serpent couch and god Brahma born in the lotus-flower blooming on the lotus-plant issuing from Visnu's navel. On hearing the auspicious words of Brahma, Visnu got up from his couch, with eyes outstretched with wonder. He gave the reply, "Whatever is there (such as) the After saying this, Visnu continued, "Who are you, Sir? Where have you come from? Where have youtogo again? Where is your permanent abode? Who are you, sir? A universe-formed being? What can I do for you?" When Visnu said thus Brahma replied: "Just like you, I am the first creator Prajapati. I am called Narayana. Everything rests in me." But Visnu, the source of the universe, heard this with wonder. Being permitted by lord Brahma, the creator of the worlds, the great Yogin Visnu entered the mouth of Brahma, out of curiosity. After entering he saw in the belly of Brahma, these eighteen continents, along with oceans, and mountains, the living beings beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass, people of four castes and the eternal seven worlds. On seeing all these, Visnu of great renown and splendour, repeatedly exclaimed thus: "Oh, the prowess of the penance of this being!" Visnu wandered though different regions and different hermitages, but he could not see the end (of it) even after the expiry of one thousand years. Verses 15ff. The meeting of Brahma and Visnu leading to their quarrel Then the Garuqla-emblemed deity (Visnu) came out of his mouth. The enemy-less (lit. one whose enemy is not born) Lord addressed Brahma, the grandfather of the world: "O Lord, O sinless one, I do not see the beginning, the middle or the end of your belly. I do not see the end of time and space." After saying thus, Visnu spoke again to Brahma, "O excellent Brahmana, you too, enter my belly and see the uncom¬ parable world within." On hearing his words delightful to the mind and approv¬ ing of them, Brahma entered the belly of Visnu. Stationed within his body, he of unimaginable exploits, saw the same worlds. Though he wandered within he did not see the end of worlds in the body of the primordial lord. On seeing that Brahma was returning, Visnu closed all the pores of his body. The lord then wished to resume his happy deep sleep in the middle of the vast ocean. When Brahma saw all the openings closed, he made his form very subtle and discovered a small opening in Visnu s umbilicus. Through the stalk of the lotus he came out and then resumed his own form. The four-faced lord seated in the middle of the lotus, shone with a splendour like that of the interior of the lotus. In the meanwhile there arose a clash between them on the point of (individual) entirety (superiority) in the middle of the ocean. Then the trident-bearing Lord of unmeasurable soul, the Lord of all living beings, who was clad in gold-coloured bark garments, came where the eternal Lord Visnu was lying on the couch of the (Sesa's) serpent's body. While he was walking quickly, big drops of water kicked forcibly by his feet rose up in the sky. They were very hot and extremely chill. A violent wind also blew. On seeing that mysterious phenomenon, Brahma spoke to Visnu, "The drops of water are big and hot. The lotus is On hearing these words uttered by Brahma, the O Lord what have I done to you? Wherefore, O greates t of men, you speak to me thus, though I am your excellent friend? Speak precisely. 95 While the lord of Devas was speaking thus in accordance with the convention, lord Brahma of lotus-like brilliant com¬ plexion, the storehouse of the Vedas, replied. "O Lord, I entered your belly by your desire. Just as the worlds were seen by you in my belly, so also the worlds were seen by me in your belly. O sinless one! At the end of one thousand years, as I was returning (out of your belly), I found that due to rivalry you have closed all the openings 'wishing to bring me under control. O blessed one, then thinking within myself, I gained an entrance through the umbilicus and came out of your navel through the lotus stalk. Let there be no misgiving in your mind." On hearing these words of Brahma, Visnu spoke thus: "What I shall do afterwards has been thought over by me. It was only out of sportiveness that I quickly closed the openings and not to harass you. You shall not take it otherwise. You are worthy of my honour and worship. O gentle one, forgive whatever misdeed I may have committed. Hence O Lord, being urged by me, you shall get down from the lotus. O destroyer of enemies, please be my son. You will O Lord of all, from now onwards you will have a white turban as your crest ornament. You will be known as Padmayoni (one born out of a lotus). O Brahma, O Lord of the worlds, be my son." Then Lord Brahma accepted the boon from Visnu. Pleased in his mind and without any sense of rivalry, he said, "May it be so".

verses.translation: On seeing a wonderful being approaching with the lustre of the rising sun and with a huge face, he spoke to Narayana: "O Visnu, who is this person coming hither? He is incomprehensible with a huge mouth, curved fangs, dishevelled hair, ten arms, characterised by the trident, and faces all round with many eyes. He is the lord of the worlds, He is hideous in form. He wears a girdle of Muhja grass. His penis is lifted up. He is roaring terribly. He has great refulgence. He is a heap of splendour. He has pervaded all the quarters and heaven. 55 On being addressed thus, Visnu spoke in reply to Brahma, "He has been coming quickly wading through the ocean. Kicked by his feet, the whole ocean is agitated with profuse sprays of water raised in the sky. O lotus-born (god), you are being sprinkled by them. The great lotus coming out of my umbilicus is being shaken along with you by the wind ex¬ haled through his nose. He is the eternal lord Isa, the destroyer. Let us both eulogise the bull-bannered lord. 5 Then the infuriated Brahma spoke to Visnu, the illuminator of the lotus, "You do not know yourself the source of origin of all the worlds nor me Brahma, the eternal creator of the universe. Oh! Who is this being (called Sankara) excelling us both? 55 On hearing the furious words of Brahma, Vi?nu said, The ancient Purusa, the lord of Maya and Yoga is virtue (Dharma) itself. He cannot be thwarted. He is the best- ower of boons. He, the eternal lord, is the cause of this universe. "You are the womb. I am the seed. But how is he the sower of the seed? It behoves you to remove this subtle doubt of mine." On hearing this, Visnu explained to Brahma, the sus- tainerofthe worlds, their own origin and the origin of the worlds. He cleared the doubt of Brahma with a suitable analogy. "There is no other being greater than he or more subtle (unmanifest) than he. The region of the lord is the goal of the spiritualists. It is the abode of bliss. The supreme lord has split himself into two and entered the self. He is both possessed of and devoid of attributes. His form without attributes is subtle and unmanifest. He is the knower of Maya (Prakrti) and her activi¬ ties; he is deep and inaccessible. His penis deposited you as the seed in my womb, in the primary stage of creation. In due course of time that seed became the huge golden egg in my womb. For a thousand years, the egg was embedded in the waters. At the end of a thousand years, it was split into two by the elemental air. One of the (upper) parts of the crust turned into hea¬ ven and the other (lower) into the earth. The lofty foetus became the golden mountain Meru. It is from that, there woke up the golden-wombed lord (Hiranyagarbha) of Devasand I, the four-armed Visnu. Then, at the end of a thousand years, the egg was plit into two. Glorious Sanatkumara and Rbhu who were perpetually celibate, Sanatana, Sanaka, and Sanandanawere born simultane¬ ously. They could visualize objects even beyond the reach of sense-organs. They were born with controlled mind and devoid of three distresses. They said that they would not take up the work of creation. There is a great pain in this birth, O gentle one. It is attended by old age and sorrow. Life, death and birth occur again and again. This world is a dream. Even in heaven there are miseries. On realising the tortures of hell, the advent and the inevitability of events and seeing that Rbhu and Sanatana were under your control, the three sons Sanaka and others eschewed the three gunas (the creative ingredients) and attaining knowledge of the illusory nature of the world, they renounced the world. When they had renounced the world you were delud¬ ed by the Maya of Sankara. In this Kalpa, O sinless one, your consciousness is withdrawn and the subtle elements earth etc. remain intact (to the end of Kalpa). On hearing their nectar-like words, the supreme Lord asked lovingly what he himself knew before. "Who are you two, Sirs, of noble souls, desirous of mutual welfare, with eyes having the lustre of a lotus, and who have come together in the terrible watery expanse?" "O Visnu, I am desirous of having progeny. I wish to have a son who will bear my responsibility.". So spoke Lord Brahma who coveted to have a boon granting him (such) a Then Visnu said to Brahma who was desirous of progeny, "Since you wish for an incomparably valiant son who will carry out your task, you ask Lord Mahesvara, the god of gods, to be (born as your) son." < "O Supreme Lord, ifyou are so pleased with me who am desirous or a son, soul of the universe, you shall be my son or you shall grant me a son like you who will bear my burden. Ifyou are pleased to grant me this boon, I shall not choose any On hearing his request, the lord, the destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, piously and undeceitfully said: "So be it". "O Suvrala (one of good vows), when you will be overwhelmed by anger at the unsuecessfulness of an activity undertaken by you, I shall be born then from your tahead (as a friendly noble-souled sage Rudra), one of the eleven Rudras, the cause of the vital breaths. O Cloud-vehicled god, let my devotion y The entire universe, whether illuminated oruntllumma- I am the fire, you arc the moon. I am the day, you arc the night. I am the truth, you are the Order ( Rta ). You are the sacrifice, I am (its) fruit. You are the knowledge, I am the object of knowledge. Performing your Japa, pious people (lit. performers of meri¬ torious deeds) will enter me if you are pleased. At the end of the Yuga, there is no better goal than this (abiding with us). Know yourself as Prakrti. Know me as Purusa, Siva. You are one half of my body just as I am your other half. You are my left side which is dark and bears the mark of Srivatsa. I am your right side which is blue and red. O Visnu you are my heart. I am stationed in your heart. You are the doer of all activities. I am the activator. So, come, hail to you, my dear cloud-coloured one, adieu". After saying this to Visnu, the great Lord vanished. When the lord had vanished, the delighted Visnu, lord of the earth, entered water and lay on his couch. Then with a delighted mind Brahma, the lotus-born, lotus-eyed deity, resorted to his own seat in the lotus having the lustre of the interior of a lotus. After a long lapse of time, two brothers of great strength and energy, the unrivalled Madhu and Kaitabha spoke to laima, You will become our prey". After saying thus both of them vanished. Since you have utiered at the outset, there is a danger to me from Bhutas (spirits). You will therefore kill the Daityas through words Bhu etc." Bhur, Bhuvah, Svah (the earth, the firmament and the heaven) entered the self-born Lord. Having circumambulated, Brahma, returned to his (former) scat.

verses.translation: When Brahma had gone, Lord Visnu created two brothers Visnu and Jisnu out of his mouth, and instructed (them): "Both of you should protect Brahma after knowing the next arrival of Madhu and Kaitabha." Meanwhile, Madhu and Kaitabha assumed forms similar to those of Visnu and Jisnu. After assumption of similar forms, they stood in front of him facing him. Then they spoke terrible words to Brahma: "You should be the judge, while we fight." Then they entered water which they paralysed by their Maya. A tumultuous fight arose, when they fought with one A thousand divine years elapsed as they fought. Still their pride, arrogance and eagerness for mutual fight did not If they had different marks, they could have been dis¬ tinguished but they had similar forms. Agitated in the mind due to this similarity, Brahma began to meditate. By his divine vision he understood the distinction bet¬ ween them. He tied a subtle secret amulet of lotus filaments and also a girdle round their body. Tlienhe uttered the Mantra. While he uttered the Mantra, a virgin of universal form appeared there itself. The lustre of her face resembled the splendour of the lotus and the moon. The chaste lady held lotus in her hand. On seeing her the Daityas were distressed. Their faces turned pallid due to fear. With palms joined in reverence, the virgin P" Since you appeared breaking through the head, you will be called SdvitrL Though you are born of one part {mils a) you O auspicious-faced lady! Due to my grace, these and other minor names derived from your activities will be applicable The two demons pn being afflicted thus begged for his boon. "Our death' shall come in an uncovered place. We shall be born as your sons in future". Saying, "So be it", they were killed: Kaitabha by Visnu and Madhu by Jisnu. Thus with a desire for the welfare of the worlds the two Daityas were killed by Brahma, Visnu and Jisnu concer- tedly. Know how Isa (Siva) was born as the son of Brahma. When the fight of Madhu and Kaitabha with Visnu and Jisnu was over, Brahma spoke to Visnu: "Today a hundred years have elapsed. The time has come when I shall go to my abode, terrible due to congestion and flooding". At his instance, the lord effected Dissolution, making the earth devoid of immobile beings and making the mobile beings settled in Prakrti. O Visnu, O increaser of prosperity, welfare unto you. Verses 48 & 49 give popular etymology of Mahavyahjli and Savitrt. While he was performing penance thus, nothing hap¬ pened. When a long time elapsed, due to grief his anger increa¬ sed. From his eyes defiled by anger, drops of tears fell. From those drops of tears, poisonous serpents manifested them¬ selves. They had the elements of gas, bile and phlegm in their humour. They were of great strength. They were bedecked by the Svastika signs. They had scattered hairs. On seeing the serpents born at the outset, Brahma lamented. If the fruit is such, fie upon my penance. In the very beginning progeny has become destructive of the world. A severe senselessness born of anger and annoyance overtook him. Due to the heat (severity) of fainting, Brahma forsook his vital breaths (became unconscious).

verses.sanskrit: तर्पयित्वा पित्ःञ् श्राद्धे तिलमिश्रैर्जलैरपि । उद्धरेदात्मना सार्धं पुरुषानेकविंशतिम्

verses.translation: From his body of unequalled prowess eleven souls, the Rudras, manifested themselves, crying out of pity. Since they cried, they were known as Rudras. Their Rudra designation is due to that. Rudras are Pranas and Pranas are Rudras. The vital breaths are stationed in all living beings. To him who was great and fierce and who had per¬ formed good actions, the trident-bearing lord gave the vital breaths. Then out of the forehead of Brahma, there emerged a being identical with the eleven (Rudras). The Lord who gave to Brahma his vital breaths, be¬ came his son. When Brahma was revived to life, Rudra spoke to him delightfully: "O Brahma, you may express your desire. Think of yourself and know me as your son Rudra. Bless me with your favour." On hearing his words, mostly what he had felt in his mind, Brahma became delighted. His eyes shone with the lustre of full-blown lotus as he returned to life. Lord Brahma, attaining the lustre of unalloyed gold, spoke in charming majestic words: "O blessed one, you delight my mind. Speak who are "O Brahma, I was requested for a boon by you along with Visnu: 'O Lord, be my son, or grant me a son equal to you who would carry my burden'. Activities shall be pursued by all persons born in the universe. O Lord of Devas, cast off your gloom and create the worlds. Thus addressed, Brahma was delighted in his mind and spoke to Rudra thus: "In order to help me, create the subjects along with me. You are the sower of seeds of all living beings. Hence get ready for the task." Rudra accepted the suggestion and said "yes". Then Brahma, bedecked in deerskin created the mind at first and the retentive power of living beings (?) Thereafter he created Sarasvatl, the speech in multifold forms. Then he, of great lustre, created seven mental sons: Bhrgu, Angiras, Daksa, Pulastya,*Pulaha, Kratu and Vasistha. He created physical sons too, equal to himself. Pursuing their path again, the cows were born out of his mouth. Brahma, grandfather of the worlds, created the Vedas with Omhdra at the head. Then he created Devas worthy of honour and other beings as mentioned before. The Lord spoke to his mind-born sons, Daksa and others: "Welfare unto ye. Along with Rudra you create subjects." Approaching Rudra the Prajapatis said, "O Lord, O Mahesvara, we along with you, desire to create progeny. This is what Brahma has asked you too". Thus addressed Lord Rudra spoke to them: <c O Devas, Brahma's sons, take the vital breaths from me. Make these sons of mine, the Brahmanas, the foremost of the first born. Now you shall create, at my bidding, the seven species of people from Brahma onward to a blade of grass. They shall be of my nature. Hail unto ye all". Thus addressed by him they replied to Rudra, the tri ent> bearing primordial lord, "O Sir, everything will happen as you please." After getting permission from lord Rudra, the Prajapatis spoke to the noble Daksa, "Sir, you are the most excellent Prajapati. Keeping you ahead and by your favour, we will create progeny." Saying "So be it", Daksa accepted their suggestion. Desirous of progeny, he with his team, began the work of cre¬ ation. When Rudra stayed (away) from creation, Brahma took up the task. When the seventh Kalpa passed Rbhu and Sanat- kumara were born. They settled as residents in Tapoloka. Then the Lord created mind-born sages also.
