verses.hindi: शिशिरश्न वसन्तभ्न निदाघो वर्ष एव च । शरद्धेमन्‍्त इत्येते मानसा ब्रह्मण: सुताः ३३५
verses.wordMeaning: While he was contemplating thus, an eternal (imperish¬ able) syllable manifested itself. It was devoid of any sound, touch, form, taste or smell.
verses.commentary: Sense: While he was contemplating thus, an eternal (imperish¬ able) syllable manifested itself. It was devoid of any sound, touch, form, taste or smell.

verses.sanskrit: अवध्यो दानवः पापः सर्वेषां वै दिवौकसाम् । मुक्त्वा तु शङ्करं देवं न मया न च विष्णुना
verses.transliteration: avadhyo dānavaḥ pāpaḥ sarveṣāṃ vai divaukasām / muktvā tu śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ na mayā na ca viṣṇunā
verses.translation: Then he saw his own form, the most excellect one in the worlds. Meditating upon the lord, he saw it again.
verses.hindi: नमन 3-43 “33333. ७3-33 आम. -++क 3५ ..- 3७ कनन--बननपकपेगनननीनियनययट + “++ननननननान नम नमन सन ++-+-++ सन तजनाननतननियनायपी क्‍»न-ननननन-नक+मन न ननीनननमक॑ ॑न+-3-त 8 “न पिन पिनन-यन-नीय न पिननतीयन-नमकीनीनीनीनीनाननन नन+- अनजान
verses.wordMeaning: Then he saw his own form, the most excellect one in the worlds. Meditating upon the lord, he saw it again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he saw his own form, the most excellect one in the worlds. Meditating upon the lord, he saw it again.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव सर्वे गच्छामो यत्र देवो महेश्वरः । स गतिश्चैव सर्वेषां विद्यते ऽन्यो न कश्चन
verses.transliteration: tatraiva sarve gacchāmo yatra devo maheśvaraḥ / sa gatiścaiva sarveṣāṃ vidyate 'nyo na kaścana
verses.translation: He saw that it was white, red, yellow and black. He looked into the colour. It was neither a woman nor a eunuch.
verses.hindi: चायु बोले--वराह जिस प्रकार जिस प्रयोजन के लिये उत्पन्न हुये, कल्प का बराह नाम पड़ने का कारण, कल्प का स्वरूप, विवृत्ति और दोनों कल्पों का अन्तर जिस प्रकार कल्पित हुआ है, उसे हमने जैसे देखा है, और सुना है, बसे ही कह रहे हैं ।॥२६-२७। सृष्टि के पहले भवकल्प हुआ । इस कल्प में स्वयं ज्ञातव्य आनन्दमय साम्प्रत भगवान् थे। उन्होंने दिव्य सम्भव, आधारभूत ब्रह्म स्थान प्राप्त किया था।
verses.wordMeaning: He saw that it was white, red, yellow and black. He looked into the colour. It was neither a woman nor a eunuch.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw that it was white, red, yellow and black. He looked into the colour. It was neither a woman nor a eunuch.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा सुरैः सर्वैर्ब्रह्मा वेदविदांवरः । ब्राह्मणैः सह विद्वद्भिरतो यत्र महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā suraiḥ sarvairbrahmā vedavidāṃvaraḥ / brāhmaṇaiḥ saha vidvadbhirato yatra maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: After knowing it, he contemplated over the syllable for a pretty long time. While meditating thus, the syllable came out of his throat.
verses.hindi: चौदह॒वाँ गान्धार कल्प हुआ । इस कल्प में गान्धार स्वर उत्पन्न हुआ था ।२५-३२। उसी गान्धार स्व॒र से नाद और गनन्‍्धर्वों की उत्पत्ति हुई है। है ब्राह्मणो ! पन्द्रहवाँ कल्प ऋषभ हुआ, ऐसा जानिये। इसी कल्प में लोक मनोहर ऋषभ स्वर उत्पन्न हुआ। षडज नामक सोलह॒वाँ कल्प हुआ, जिसमें छः ऋषि प्रसिद्ध थे । शिशिर, वसन्‍्त, निदांघ, वर्षा, शरत् और हेमन्त नामक ये छवों ऋषि ब्रह्मा के मानस पुत्र थे
verses.wordMeaning: After knowing it, he contemplated over the syllable for a pretty long time. While meditating thus, the syllable came out of his throat.
verses.commentary: Sense: After knowing it, he contemplated over the syllable for a pretty long time. While meditating thus, the syllable came out of his throat.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतिभिश्च सुपुष्टाभिस्तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: stutibhiśca supuṣṭābhistuṣṭāva parameśvaram
verses.translation: It consisted of one single mdtra. Its sound was very loud. It was white in colour and very pure. That Omkdra would be the Veda. The syllable was verily Mahesvara himself. 1
verses.hindi: सोलहवें कल्प में वे पुत्र पडज से उत्पन्न हुए। यतः इन छवों के होने से ऐसा ज्ञात हुआ मानों महेश्वर ही सद्यः स्वयं उत्पन्न हो गए । इसलिये समुद्र की तरह गम्भीर ध्वनि वाला षड्ज स्वर उत्पन्न हुआ। सत्रहवाँ कल्प मार्जालीय नाम से ख्यात है इसलिये कि, इस कल्प में ब्रह्म सम्बन्धी मार्जालीय कर्म सृष्ट हुआ था
verses.wordMeaning: It consisted of one single mdtra. Its sound was very loud. It was white in colour and very pure. That Omkdra would be the Veda. The syllable was verily Mahesvara himself. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: It consisted of one single mdtra. Its sound was very loud. It was white in colour and very pure. That Omkdra would be the Veda. The syllable was verily Mahesvara himself. 1

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । जय त्वं देवदेवेश जयोमार्धशरीरधृक् । वृषासन महाबाहो शशाङ्ककृतभूषण
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ / jaya tvaṃ devadeveśa jayomārdhaśarīradhṛk / vṛṣāsana mahābāho śaśāṅkakṛtabhūṣaṇa
verses.translation: While the self-born Brahma was contemplating, the red
verses.hindi: १३२ द वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: While the self-born Brahma was contemplating, the red
verses.commentary: Sense: While the self-born Brahma was contemplating, the red

verses.sanskrit: नमः शूलाग्रहस्ताय नमः खट्वाङ्गधारिणे । जय भूतपते देव दक्षयज्ञविनाशन
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śūlāgrahastāya namaḥ khaṭvāṅgadhāriṇe / jaya bhūtapate deva dakṣayajñavināśana
verses.translation: The identification of Om, Brahman or Vedas biva s greatness in the minds oflisteners.
verses.hindi: ततस्त्वेकोर्नावशस्तु कल्पो बेराजकः स्मृतः । बराजो यत्र भगवान्मनुर्वे ब्रह्मण: सुतः (३४० तस्य पुत्रस्तु धर्मात्मा दधोचिरनाम धामिक: । प्रजापतिमंहातेजा बशुव त्रिदशेश्वर:  ..
verses.wordMeaning: The identification of Om, Brahman or Vedas biva s greatness in the minds oflisteners.
verses.commentary: Sense: The identification of Om, Brahman or Vedas biva s greatness in the minds oflisteners.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाक्षर नमो देव पञ्चभूतात्मविग्रह । पञ्चवक्त्रमयेशान वेदैस्त्वं तु प्रगीयसे
verses.transliteration: pañcākṣara namo deva pañcabhūtātmavigraha / pañcavaktramayeśāna vedaistvaṃ tu pragīyase
verses.translation: While he was contemplating, the Lord, due to his power of Lordship, turned it into a syllable of two malras.
verses.hindi: अकामयत गायत्री यजमानं प्रजापतिम् । तस्माज्जज्ञे स्व॒रः स्निग्धः पुत्रस्तस्य दधीचिनः ४२ ततो विशतिमः कल्पो निषादः परिकीतितः । प्रजापतिस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा स्वयंभुप्रभवं तदा
verses.wordMeaning: While he was contemplating, the Lord, due to his power of Lordship, turned it into a syllable of two malras.
verses.commentary: Sense: While he was contemplating, the Lord, due to his power of Lordship, turned it into a syllable of two malras.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टिपालनसंहारांस्त्वं सदा कुरुषे नमः । अष्टमूर्ते स्मरहर स्मर सत्यं यथा स्तुतः
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭipālanasaṃhārāṃstvaṃ sadā kuruṣe namaḥ / aṣṭamūrte smarahara smara satyaṃ yathā stutaḥ
verses.translation: Then he thought of the Aksara as consisting of two Mdtrds. It manifested itself as red. The Yajur-veda was born out of it.
verses.hindi: तमुबाचर महातेजा ब्रह्म लोकपितामहः । ऊध्वंबाहुं तपोग्लानं दुःखित॑ क्षुत्पिपासितम् (४४५
verses.wordMeaning: Then he thought of the Aksara as consisting of two Mdtrds. It manifested itself as red. The Yajur-veda was born out of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he thought of the Aksara as consisting of two Mdtrds. It manifested itself as red. The Yajur-veda was born out of it.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चात्मिका तनुर्देव ब्राह्मणैस्ते प्रगीयते । सद्यो वामे तथाघोरे ईशो तत्पुरुषे तथा
verses.transliteration: pañcātmikā tanurdeva brāhmaṇaiste pragīyate / sadyo vāme tathāghore īśo tatpuruṣe tathā
verses.translation: The Yajur mantra begins Hsetva urjelva vdyavastha devo vah savita punah (TS 1.1.1 and 1.1.15). TheRgveda is declared to be (consisting) of a single matra and the Yajurveda of two mdtrds.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणो मानसाः पुत्रा: पञ्चते ब्रह्मण: समाः । तेस्त्वर्थंवादिभियुकक्‍तरर्बवाग्भिरिष्टो महेश्वरः ४८
verses.wordMeaning: The Yajur mantra begins Hsetva urjelva vdyavastha devo vah savita punah (TS 1.1.1 and 1.1.15). TheRgveda is declared to be (consisting) of a single matra and the Yajurveda of two mdtrds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yajur mantra begins Hsetva urjelva vdyavastha devo vah savita punah (TS 1.1.1 and 1.1.15). TheRgveda is declared to be (consisting) of a single matra and the Yajurveda of two mdtrds.

verses.sanskrit: हेमजाले सुविस्तीर्णे हंसवत्कूजसे हर । एवं स्तुतो मुनिगणैर्ब्रह्माद्यैश्च सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: hemajāle suvistīrṇe haṃsavatkūjase hara / evaṃ stuto munigaṇairbrahmādyaiśca surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: On perceiving the Veda and the Aksara of two Mdtrds, lord Brahma contemplated over the Aksara of two Mdtrds.
verses.hindi: द्वाविशस्तु तथा कल्पो विज्ञेयो मेघबाहन: । यत्र विष्णुमहाबाहुमेंघी भृत्वा महेश्वरम्् ५०
verses.wordMeaning: On perceiving the Veda and the Aksara of two Mdtrds, lord Brahma contemplated over the Aksara of two Mdtrds.
verses.commentary: Sense: On perceiving the Veda and the Aksara of two Mdtrds, lord Brahma contemplated over the Aksara of two Mdtrds.

verses.sanskrit: प्रहृष्टः सुमना भूत्वा सुरसङ्घानुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭaḥ sumanā bhūtvā surasaṅghānuvāca ha
verses.translation: While he was contemplating Ornkara appeared. Then Brahma thought over the Aksara Ornkara.
verses.hindi: अठारहवें कल्प का नाम था मध्यम । जिसमें धेवत से भी श्रेष्ठ मध्यम स्वर उत्पन्न हुआ  ब्रह्मा की सृष्टि में वह मध्यम नाम से र्यात हुआ । उन्नीसवाँ कल्प वेराजक कहलाता है। जिसमें ब्रह्मा के पुत्र वेराज मनु हुए। उन्हें दधीचि नाम का धर्मात्मा पुत्र हुआ। ये ही अत्यन्त तेजस्वी अधिपति प्रजापति यजन कर रहे थे, कि गायत्री ने उनकी कामना की । जिससे दधीचि को पुत्रस्वरूप स्निग्ध स्वर उत्पन्न हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: While he was contemplating Ornkara appeared. Then Brahma thought over the Aksara Ornkara.
verses.commentary: Sense: While he was contemplating Ornkara appeared. Then Brahma thought over the Aksara Ornkara.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: स्वागतं देवविप्राणां सुप्रभाताद्य शर्वरी । किं कुर्मो वदत क्षिप्रं को ऽन्यः सेव्यः सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: svāgataṃ devaviprāṇāṃ suprabhātādya śarvarī / kiṃ kurmo vadata kṣipraṃ ko 'nyaḥ sevyaḥ surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: Then he observed the yellow Rk that rose up, beginn¬ ing with the words "agna dyahi vitaje grneno havja dalaye ". (RV VI. 16. 10, also Samaveda 1.1
verses.hindi: बीसवाँ निषाद कल्प कहलाता है। प्रजापति ने उस स्वयम्भू-संजात निषाद को देख कर सृष्टि कर्म से हाथ रोक लिया । निषाद भी तपस्या करने लगा । जितेन्द्रिय निषाद निराहार रहकर देवों के वर्ष से हजार वर्षों तक तप करता रहा ।४३-४४। महातेजस्वी लोक-पितामह ब्रह्मा ने तब उस निषाद से, जो कि तपस्या के कारण कृश, दुःखित, भूख प्यास से व्याकुल, शान्‍त और हाथ ऊपर उठाये तपस्या कर रहा था,
verses.wordMeaning: Then he observed the yellow Rk that rose up, beginn¬ ing with the words "agna dyahi vitaje grneno havja dalaye ". (RV VI. 16. 10, also Samaveda 1.1
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he observed the yellow Rk that rose up, beginn¬ ing with the words "agna dyahi vitaje grneno havja dalaye ". (RV VI. 16. 10, also Samaveda 1.1

verses.sanskrit: किं दुःखं को नु सन्तापः कुतो वो भयमागतम् । कथयध्वं महाभागाः कारणं यन्मनोगतम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ duḥkhaṃ ko nu santāpaḥ kuto vo bhayamāgatam / kathayadhvaṃ mahābhāgāḥ kāraṇaṃ yanmanogatam
verses.translation: It had the form of the self-born (deity). It saw the lord of fourteen faces of shining splendour. After creating Ornkara at the outset, the self-born deity Brahma became visible.
verses.hindi: कहा कि “निषीद' (बेंंठ जाओ)। इसलिये वह निषाद कहलाया और स्वर का नाम भी निषाद ही हुआ ।४५-४६। इक्कीसवें कल्प का नाौम पञ्चम है। इसमें ब्रह्मा को उन्हीं के समान प्राण, अपान, समान, उदान ओर व्यान नामक पाँच मानस पुत्र हुए । वे अर्थ सहित स्तुति बचनों से महेश्वर का स्तवन करने लगे । जिस कारण उन पाँचों महात्माओं ने पणञ्चम स्वर से गान किया; इसलिये वह कल्प पञ्चम कहलाया और उस
verses.wordMeaning: It had the form of the self-born (deity). It saw the lord of fourteen faces of shining splendour. After creating Ornkara at the outset, the self-born deity Brahma became visible.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had the form of the self-born (deity). It saw the lord of fourteen faces of shining splendour. After creating Ornkara at the outset, the self-born deity Brahma became visible.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तास्तु रुद्रेण प्रत्यवोचन्सुरर्षभाः । स्वान्स्वान्देहान्दर्शयन्तो लज्जमाना अधोमुखाः
verses.transliteration: evamuktāstu rudreṇa pratyavocansurarṣabhāḥ / svānsvāndehāndarśayanto lajjamānā adhomukhāḥ
verses.translation: Then, out of the four mouths of the four-faced god came out fourteen letters—various letters and vowels. That is the refulgent initial letter. From it sixty-three letters have the letter A at the beginning.
verses.hindi: स्निग्ध स्वर का नाम पञ्चम पड़ा ।४७-४९॥ बाईसवें कल्प का नाम मेघवाहन जानना चाहिए । इस कल्प में महाबाहु विष्णु ने मेघ के स्वरूप में चर्मंवसनधारी महेश्वर को दिव्य सहस्न वर्ष तक धारण किया था ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then, out of the four mouths of the four-faced god came out fourteen letters—various letters and vowels. That is the refulgent initial letter. From it sixty-three letters have the letter A at the beginning.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, out of the four mouths of the four-faced god came out fourteen letters—various letters and vowels. That is the refulgent initial letter. From it sixty-three letters have the letter A at the beginning.

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति घोरो महावीर्यो दानवो बलदर्पितः । बाणो नामेति विख्यातो यस्य तत्त्रिपुरं महत्
verses.transliteration: asti ghoro mahāvīryo dānavo baladarpitaḥ / bāṇo nāmeti vikhyāto yasya tattripuraṃ mahat
verses.translation: Hence for serving a common purpose for all letters, the self-born Brahma stood in the form of "A * 9 at the outset. It was the first vowel.
verses.hindi: दिव्यं वर्षपहस्न तु अवहत्कृत्तिवाससम् । तस्य विश्वससानस्य भाराक्तान्तस्थ वे मुखात्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence for serving a common purpose for all letters, the self-born Brahma stood in the form of "A * 9 at the outset. It was the first vowel.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence for serving a common purpose for all letters, the self-born Brahma stood in the form of "A * 9 at the outset. It was the first vowel.

verses.sanskrit: तेन वै सुतपस्तप्तं दशवर्षशतानि हि । तस्य तुष्टो ऽभवद्ब्रह्मा नियमेन दमेन च
verses.transliteration: tena vai sutapastaptaṃ daśavarṣaśatāni hi / tasya tuṣṭo 'bhavadbrahmā niyamena damena ca
verses.translation: Then from those vowels, fourteen Manus of big faces were born. They are the divine sounds in the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: निर्जगाम महाकायः कालो लोकप्रकालनः । यस्त्वयं पठचते विप्रविष्णुरवं कश्यपात्मज:
verses.wordMeaning: Then from those vowels, fourteen Manus of big faces were born. They are the divine sounds in the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then from those vowels, fourteen Manus of big faces were born. They are the divine sounds in the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणि तान्यभेद्यानि ददौ कामगमानि वै । आयसं राजतं चैव सौवर्णं च तथापरम्
verses.transliteration: purāṇi tānyabhedyāni dadau kāmagamāni vai / āyasaṃ rājataṃ caiva sauvarṇaṃ ca tathāparam
verses.translation: From the first face, Svayarhbhuva Manu was born. He is known as the letter ".4" of the self-born Brahma. Its colour is white. 2
verses.hindi: ध्यायतों ब्रह्मणश्चेव यस्माच्चिन्ता समुत्यिता । तस्मात्तु चिन्तकः सो व(कोसो ) कल्पः प्रोक्तः स्वयंभुवा
verses.wordMeaning: From the first face, Svayarhbhuva Manu was born. He is known as the letter ".4" of the self-born Brahma. Its colour is white. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: From the first face, Svayarhbhuva Manu was born. He is known as the letter ".4" of the self-born Brahma. Its colour is white. 2

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपुरं ब्रह्मणा सृष्टं भ्रमत्तत्कामगामि च । तस्यैव तु बलोत्कृष्टास्त्रिपुरे दानवाः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tripuraṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaṃ bhramattatkāmagāmi ca / tasyaiva tu balotkṛṣṭāstripure dānavāḥ sthitāḥ
verses.translation: The purana linguistics believes in the existence of vowel "A" in all letters.
verses.hindi: चतुर्विशतिमश्रापि ह्याकूति: कल्प उच्यते  आक्तिश्र तथा देवी मिथुन संबभूव ह
verses.wordMeaning: The purana linguistics believes in the existence of vowel "A" in all letters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The purana linguistics believes in the existence of vowel "A" in all letters.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यं सकलं देव पीडयन्ति महासुराः । दण्डपाशासिशस्त्राणि अविकारे विकुर्वते । त्रिपुरं दानवैर्जुष्टं भ्रमत्तच्चक्रसंनिभम्
verses.transliteration: trailokyaṃ sakalaṃ deva pīḍayanti mahāsurāḥ / daṇḍapāśāsiśastrāṇi avikāre vikurvate / tripuraṃ dānavairjuṣṭaṃ bhramattaccakrasaṃnibham
verses.translation: Verses 32-49 show a crude attempt to connect the 14 Manus to the vowels as follows:
verses.hindi: पठ”चबविशतिमः कल्पो विज्ञातिः परिकीरतितः । विज्ञातिश्च तथा देवी मिथुन संप्र (सम )सूयते
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 32-49 show a crude attempt to connect the 14 Manus to the vowels as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 32-49 show a crude attempt to connect the 14 Manus to the vowels as follows:

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्दृश्यमदृश्यं वा मृगतृष्णैव लक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: kvaciddṛśyamadṛśyaṃ vā mṛgatṛṣṇaiva lakṣyate
verses.translation: From his second face the letter "A" was born.' He is known as the Svarocisa Manu. His colour is yellowish white.
verses.hindi: ध्यायतः पुत्रकामस्य मनस्यध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् । विज्ञातं वे समासेन विज्ञातिस्तु ततः स्मृतः ४८ षर्डावशस्तु ततः कल्पो मन इत्यभिधीयते । देवी च शंकरी नाम मिथुन संप्रसुयते ५६ प्रजा व चिन्तमानस्य ख्रष्टुकामस्य वे तदा । यस्मात्प्रजासंभवनादुत्यन्नस्तु स्वयंभुवा ८०
verses.wordMeaning: From his second face the letter "A" was born.' He is known as the Svarocisa Manu. His colour is yellowish white.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his second face the letter "A" was born.' He is known as the Svarocisa Manu. His colour is yellowish white.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्पतति तद्दिव्यं दृप्तस्य त्रिपुरं महत् । न तत्र ब्राह्मणा देवा गावो नैव तु जन्तवः
verses.transliteration: yasminpatati taddivyaṃ dṛptasya tripuraṃ mahat / na tatra brāhmaṇā devā gāvo naiva tu jantavaḥ
verses.translation: From his third face was born the letter the most excellent of the Yajus. The sun consists of Yajus from which the Yajurveda manifested itself.
verses.hindi: पौर्णमासी तथा देवी मिथुन समपद्यत । प्रजा वे स्रष्टुकामस्य ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः ६२
verses.wordMeaning: From his third face was born the letter the most excellent of the Yajus. The sun consists of Yajus from which the Yajurveda manifested itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his third face was born the letter the most excellent of the Yajus. The sun consists of Yajus from which the Yajurveda manifested itself.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र दृश्यते किंचित्पतेद्यत्र पुरत्रयम् । नद्यो ग्रामाश्च देशाश्च बहवो भस्मसात्कृताः
verses.transliteration: na tatra dṛśyate kiṃcitpatedyatra puratrayam / nadyo grāmāśca deśāśca bahavo bhasmasātkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: That Manu is known as the letter He is valorous and of red colour. The Ksattras (the warrior caste) function from it. Hence a Ksattriya is red.
verses.hindi: कश्यप के पुत्र विष्णु भाराक्रान्त होकर दीघ निःश्वास ले रहे थे कि, उनके मुँह से लोक का नाश करने वाला विकराल काल उत्पन्न हुआ। ब्राह्मणों के द्वारा यह कथा इसी प्रकार कही गई है। तेईसवां कल्प चिन्तक है ।१५०-५२१। प्रजापतितनया चिन्तक के साथ विति नाम की एक पुत्री भी हुई। यतः ब्रह्मा को ध्यान करते समय वह हो गई इसी से उस कल्प को ब्रह्मा ने चिन्तक कहा । चौबीसतवाँ कल्प आकृति
verses.wordMeaning: That Manu is known as the letter He is valorous and of red colour. The Ksattras (the warrior caste) function from it. Hence a Ksattriya is red.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Manu is known as the letter He is valorous and of red colour. The Ksattras (the warrior caste) function from it. Hence a Ksattriya is red.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णं रजतं चैव मणिमौक्तिकमेव च । स्त्रीरत्नं शोभनं यच्च तत्सर्वं कर्षते बलात्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ caiva maṇimauktikameva ca / strīratnaṃ śobhanaṃ yacca tatsarvaṃ karṣate balāt
verses.translation: From his fourth face was born the vowel It is copper-coloured. It is known as Tamasa Manu.
verses.hindi: कहलाता है। इस कल्प में आकत और आकूति मिथुन उत्पन्न हुए ।५३-५१॥ प्रजापति ने आकूति को सृष्टि करने के लिये कहा; इसलिये उस कल्प का आकृति नाम पड़ा । पचीसर्वाँ कल्प विज्ञाति कहलाता है। विज्ञाति देवी भी विज्ञात के साथ जुड़वा उत्पस्त हुई थी । सृष्टि की इच्छा से ध्यान करते हुए ब्रह्मा को शीघ्र ही सब ज्ञात हो गया, इससे उस कल्प का नाम विज्ञाति पड़ा ।५६-४८। छब्बीसवे कल्प का नाम मन कहलाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: From his fourth face was born the vowel It is copper-coloured. It is known as Tamasa Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his fourth face was born the vowel It is copper-coloured. It is known as Tamasa Manu.

verses.sanskrit: न शस्त्रेण न चास्त्रेण न दिवा निशि वा हर । शक्यते देवसङ्घैश्च निहन्तुं स कथंचन
verses.transliteration: na śastreṇa na cāstreṇa na divā niśi vā hara / śakyate devasaṅghaiśca nihantuṃ sa kathaṃcana
verses.translation: From his fifth face the letter "£/" was born. It is yellow in colour. It is known as Carisnava Manu.
verses.hindi: शंकरी देवी ने एक मिथुन उत्पन्त किया । प्रजापति सृष्ठि की कामना कर रहे थे, प्रजा की चिन्ता कर रहे थे । उसी प्रजा-संभवन काल में यह कल्प उत्परन हुआ । इसी कारण प्रजाविषयक भावना होने से वह कल्प भावन- संभव कहलाया । सत्ताइसवाँ कल्प भाव कहलाता है।१६-६१॥ इस कल्प में भी पा्णमासिक देवी ने एक मिथुन उत्पन्त किया । प्रजा की सृष्टि के अभिलादी परमेष्ठी ब्रह्मा परमात्मा का ध्यान कर रहे थे कि उनका ज्योतिमण्डल
verses.wordMeaning: From his fifth face the letter "£/" was born. It is yellow in colour. It is known as Carisnava Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his fifth face the letter "£/" was born. It is yellow in colour. It is known as Carisnava Manu.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दहस्व महादेव त्वं हि नः परमा गतिः । एवं प्रसादं देवेश सर्वेषां कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: taddahasva mahādeva tvaṃ hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ / evaṃ prasādaṃ deveśa sarveṣāṃ kartumarhasi
verses.translation: Then from his sixth face, Omkara was born. It was tawny in colour. From the sixth was born the superior-most Vijaya (Victory) of great penance.
verses.hindi: १३२४ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then from his sixth face, Omkara was born. It was tawny in colour. From the sixth was born the superior-most Vijaya (Victory) of great penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then from his sixth face, Omkara was born. It was tawny in colour. From the sixth was born the superior-most Vijaya (Victory) of great penance.

verses.sanskrit: येन देवाश्च गन्धर्वा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः । परां धृतिं समायान्ति तत्प्रभो कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: yena devāśca gandharvā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ / parāṃ dhṛtiṃ samāyānti tatprabho kartumarhasi
verses.translation: From his seventh face was born the vowel It is
verses.hindi: आविष्टया सहोत्पन्नमपश्यत्सूयमण्डलम् । यस्माददृश्यों भृतानां ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना ६४५ दृष्टस्तु भगवान्देवः सुय्यः संपूर्णमण्डलः । सर्वे योगाश्च मन्त्राश्च मण्डलेन सहोत्थिताः ६६ यस्मात्कत्पो ह्यं दृष्टस्तस्मात्तं दर्शभुच्यते(? )। यस्मान्मनसि संपूर्णो ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिन: ,
verses.wordMeaning: From his seventh face was born the vowel It is
verses.commentary: Sense: From his seventh face was born the vowel It is

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: एतत्सर्वं करिष्यामि मा विषादं गमिष्यथ । अचिरेणैव कालेन कुर्यां युष्मत्सुखावहम्
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: etatsarvaṃ kariṣyāmi mā viṣādaṃ gamiṣyatha / acireṇaiva kālena kuryāṃ yuṣmatsukhāvaham
verses.translation: From his eighth face emerged the (long) "£"• Dpe to its dark blue colour and due to its being similar (in sibilant pronunciation?) in Sya-ma, it is called Savarni.
verses.hindi: पुरा वे भगवान्सोमः पौर्णमासी ततः स्मृता । तस्मात्तु पर्वद्श वे पोर्णमासं च योगिभिः ६८ उभयो:ः पक्षयोर्योज्यमात्मनों हितकाम्यया । दर्श च पौणणंमासं च ये यजन्ति द्विजातयः.. ४६  न तेषां पुनरावत्तिब्रह्मलोकात्कदाचन । यो5घनाहिताग्नि: प्रयतो वीराध्वानं गतोडपि वा ३०
verses.wordMeaning: From his eighth face emerged the (long) "£"• Dpe to its dark blue colour and due to its being similar (in sibilant pronunciation?) in Sya-ma, it is called Savarni.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his eighth face emerged the (long) "£"• Dpe to its dark blue colour and due to its being similar (in sibilant pronunciation?) in Sya-ma, it is called Savarni.

verses.sanskrit: आश्वासयित्वा तान्देवान्सर्वानिन्द्रपुरोगमान् । चिन्तयामास देवेशस्त्रिपुरस्य वधं प्रति
verses.transliteration: āśvāsayitvā tāndevānsarvānindrapurogamān / cintayāmāsa deveśastripurasya vadhaṃ prati
verses.translation: From his ninth face was born the ninth letter "L'\ It
verses.hindi: अग्नि प्रविशते यस्तु रुद्लोक॑ स गचछति  सोमश्चाग्निस्तु भगवान्कालो रुद्र इति श्रुतिः ७३
verses.wordMeaning: From his ninth face was born the ninth letter "L'\ It
verses.commentary: Sense: From his ninth face was born the ninth letter "L'\ It

verses.sanskrit: कथं केन प्रकारेण हन्तव्यं त्रिपुरं मया । तमेकं नारदं मुक्त्वा नान्योपायो विधीयते
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa hantavyaṃ tripuraṃ mayā / tamekaṃ nāradaṃ muktvā nānyopāyo vidhīyate
verses.translation: From his tenth face was born the letter (loftg) It
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मण: पुत्रकामस्य ख्रष्टुकास्य वे प्रजा: । ध्यायमानस्य मनसा बृह॒त्साम रथंतरम्
verses.wordMeaning: From his tenth face was born the letter (loftg) It
verses.commentary: Sense: From his tenth face was born the letter (loftg) It

verses.sanskrit: एवं संस्तभ्य चात्मानं ततो ध्यातः स नारदः । तत्क्षणादेव सम्प्राप्तो वायुभूतो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃstabhya cātmānaṃ tato dhyātaḥ sa nāradaḥ / tatkṣaṇādeva samprāpto vāyubhūto mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: From his eleventh face wa*5 born the letter E. It is called 'Manu'. It is reddish brown in colour. It is known as Pisanga (reddish brown) Manu.
verses.hindi: अग्नि रूप से भूलोक और घूुलोक में व्याप्त होकर प्रदीप्त हो उठा ।६२-६३३। हजार वर्ष बीत जाने पर वह ज्योतिमण्डल पूर्ण हुआ अर्थात् एकीभूत हुआ और सुयंमण्डल के रूप में परिणत हो गया। ब्रह्मा ने पूवव में अदृश्य उस सुर्यमण्डल को देखा और उस मण्डल से समस्त योग और मन्त्रसमृह उत्पन्त हुए; इसलिये उस कल्प का माम दर्श पड़ा  प्राचीन काल में उस समय भगवान् सोम ब्रह्मा के मन में पूर्ण रूप से प्र ःठ हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: From his eleventh face wa*5 born the letter E. It is called 'Manu'. It is reddish brown in colour. It is known as Pisanga (reddish brown) Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his eleventh face wa*5 born the letter E. It is called 'Manu'. It is reddish brown in colour. It is known as Pisanga (reddish brown) Manu.

verses.sanskrit: कमण्डलुधरो देवस्त्रिदण्डी ज्ञानकोविदः । योगपट्टाक्षसूत्रेण छत्रेणैव विराजितः
verses.transliteration: kamaṇḍaludharo devastridaṇḍī jñānakovidaḥ / yogapaṭṭākṣasūtreṇa chatreṇaiva virājitaḥ
verses.translation: From his twelfth face was born the letter ( Ai • It is reddish brown with the lustre of Bhasma (ashes). It is also known as Pisanga Manu.
verses.hindi: थे, इससे पौर्णमासी भी कहलाई ।६४-६८। इसलिये योगियों को चाहिए कि उभय पक्ष के पर्व दिन में याती दर्श-पौर्णमासी में अपनी भलाई के लिये योगानुष्ठान करें दर्श (अमावास्था) और पूर्णिमा में जो ह्विजाति यजन करते हैं, उनका बरह्मलोक से फिर आवागमन नहीं रहता है ।६६२। जो अनाहितःरिनि द्विज शुद्ध होकर वीर पथ में प्रवत्त होते हैं और चंचल मन का समाधान कर इस मन्त्र का शने: शर्त: पाठ करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: From his twelfth face was born the letter ( Ai • It is reddish brown with the lustre of Bhasma (ashes). It is also known as Pisanga Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his twelfth face was born the letter ( Ai • It is reddish brown with the lustre of Bhasma (ashes). It is also known as Pisanga Manu.

verses.sanskrit: जटाजूटाबद्धशिरा ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभः । त्रिधा प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य दण्डवत्पतितो भुवि
verses.transliteration: jaṭājūṭābaddhaśirā jvalanārkasamaprabhaḥ / tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi
verses.translation: The letter that was born from his thirteenth face was called the letter "0", which consisting of five colours, excels all.

verses.translation: The groups of letters are formed by their places of utterance ( slhanas ) as the distributions of castes by their profes¬ sional equity. This is the practice in regard to the junctions of vowels and the transition of Kalpas.
verses.hindi: मति हो, यहाँ आवो, यहाँ आाबो ।५-८३। महादेव के आ्वान को सुनकर वह देवी विनम्र होकर हाथ जोड़कर सामने खड़ी हो गयी। उसको सामने खड़ा देखकर महादेव ने कहा कि तुम अपनी योग माया से विश्व में व्याप्त होकर सारे संसार को वश में करो। देखो, तुम्हारा नाम भविष्य में रुद्राणी होगा । तुम्हारे द्वारा ब्राह्मणों का हित और परमार्थ-सिद्धि होगी ।९-१० इतना आदेश देने के अनन्तर उस

verses.sanskrit: विघ्नं न जायते क्वापि एवमाह पितामहः । पञ्चमीं तु ततः प्राप्य ब्राह्मणे तिलदा तु या
verses.transliteration: vighnaṃ na jāyate kvāpi evamāha pitāmahaḥ / pañcamīṃ tu tataḥ prāpya brāhmaṇe tiladā tu yā

verses.hindi: देवाधिदेव ने पुत्रेच्छ, ध्यानपरायण ब्रह्मा को वह माहेश्वरी गाय दे दी। तत्परचात् लोकपृज्य ब्रह्मा ध्यान योग से उस माहेश्वरी को जानकर उसकी शरण में आये, ।११-१३। और संयमपूर्वक उस रौद्री गायत्री का ध्यान कर शौद्री, महादेव से हुई, रुद्रलोक नमसस्‍्क्ृत वेदिकी विद्या ग्रायत्री का जपकर पुनः महादेव की शरण में गये । महादेव ने तब ब्रह्मा को दिव्य योग, ऐश्वर्य, ज्ञान-सम्पति और वैराग्य प्रदान किया
verses.wordMeaning: The groups of letters are formed by their places of utterance ( slhanas ) as the distributions of castes by their profes¬ sional equity. This is the practice in regard to the junctions of vowels and the transition of Kalpas.

verses.sanskrit: सा भवेद्रूपसम्पन्ना यथा चैव तिलोत्तमा । षष्ठ्यां तु या मधूकस्य फलदा तु भवेत्सदा
verses.transliteration: sā bhavedrūpasampannā yathā caiva tilottamā / ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu yā madhūkasya phaladā tu bhavetsadā
verses.translation: The groups of letters are formed by their places of utterance ( slhanas ) as the distributions of castes by their profes¬ sional equity. This is the practice in regard to the junctions of vowels and the transition of Kalpas.
verses.hindi: ।१३-१४। इसके अनन्तर महादेव ने भीषण अट्टृहास किया, जिससे उनके शरीर से ते जस्वी कुमार उत्पन्न हये; जो कि पीली माला, पीत वस्त्र, पीत अंगराग धारण किये हुये थे, जिनके शिर पर पीली पगड़ी थी, जिनके मुख और केश भी पीत वर्ण के थे। वे सब तेजस्व्री कुमार हजार वर्ष तक निव्रास करने के बाद रुद्र की देह में प्रवेश कर गये । इतने दिनों तक ये योगधारी, ब्राह्मणों के हिर्तेषी और स्नान करने

verses.transliteration: uddiśya cāgnijaṃ devaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage / tasyāḥ putro yathā skando devasaṅgheṣu cottamaḥ

verses.translation: The legend of Rudra crying for a name and god Brahma assigning a name to him and the recurrence of this granting of names or eig t times is an amplification of the same story in Salapalha Brahmaim (SBr.6.3.1-18). Then the following bodies for these names were created by Brahma. These were the sun, the earth, water, fire, •air, ether, the initialed Brahmana and themoon. These (eight) have their source in Brahma. Rudra should be worshipped and honoured in these bodies. Thus (honoured and worshipped) Rudra does not injure. 1 Then Brahma spoke to the lord Nxlalohita again: "To your second name declared as Bhava by me, the body shall be the waters". When this was said, the stable element of the nature of Rasa (the lymphatic constituent in his body) entered water. Hence water is known as Bhava. The living beings are born of waters and purified by them (they are named Bhavas ). Greation of beings is by means of production and purification.

He should not pass urine on his own He should evacuate the bowels after covering his head and the ground with grass. He who behaves thus to the earth is not injured by Sarva. Then Brahma addressed Lord Nilalohita: 'To your fourth name designated as Isana by me, the wind shall be the fourth body. As soon as this was said, the wind (vital breath) which was stationed in him in five forms and is term¬ ed Prana entered Vayu. Hence Vayu is called Isana. So one should not censure or revile the wind, the Lord himself, as it blows violently.

Hence Pasupati is called Agni. The moon is called Soma. The group of medicinal herbs is its Atman. Mahadeva does not kill a person who, during the full moon or the new moon day, worships the lord The sun protects people during the day and the moon at night. During one night (once in a month) the sun and t e moon come together and that is the new moon day. One shall always be in communion with the lord on that day.

verses.translation: That which digests the food and beverages eaten and drunk, in the bellies of living beings, is called Pasupati's power. It is called the digestive power. The pores within the bodies which are for facilitating the free movement of the wind,, constitute the body called Bhima. The propounders of the Vedas initiated in sacrifices have their bodies in the form ofUgra. Ugfa is, therefore, known as Diksita (initiated Yajamana). That which conceives and contemplates and exists equally among the people is the mental body. It is known as the moon abiding among beings.

verses.translation: To the third body of the lord known as Sarva and symbolized by the earth the wife is Vikesi and Ahgaraka (Mars) the son. To the fourth body of the lord known as Isana and symbolized by the wind, the wife is Siva and Manojava the son. The body of Pasuptati which is remembered (procla¬ imed) as Fire by the twice-borns, has Svaha for his wife and Skanda as the son. The ether (Akasa) is called the body Bhima, his sixth name. Quarters are remembered as his wives and Heaven (Svarga) as the son.
verses.hindi: प्रभुंति चार पाद के हैं ।८५३-८५। उनके मध्य भूलोंके प्रथम पाद, भुवर्लोक द्वितीय स्थान है, यही योगियों के
verses.wordMeaning: To the third body of the lord known as Sarva and symbolized by the earth the wife is Vikesi and Ahgaraka (Mars) the son. To the fourth body of the lord known as Isana and symbolized by the wind, the wife is Siva and Manojava the son.…
verses.commentary: Sense: To the third body of the lord known as Sarva and symbolized by the earth the wife is Vikesi and Ahgaraka (Mars) the son. To the fourth body of the lord known as Isana and symbolized by the wind, the wife is Siva and Manojava the son.…

verses.sanskrit: विवर्णा निष्प्रभा जाता नारदेन विमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: vivarṇā niṣprabhā jātā nāradena vimohitāḥ
verses.translation: To the seventh body of the Lord known as Ugra and symbolized by the sacrificer, the wife is Diksa (initiation) and Santana as the son. The eighth body of the great Lord is known as the Moon. His wife is Rohini and Budha is remembered as the son. They should be saluted and bowed with respective names to each body. By devotion to these bodies and the names of the Lord, viz. the Sun, the Waters, the Earth, Wind, Fire, Ether, Initiaited Priest and the Moon, the devotee attains Sayujya with the Lord himself. Thus the secret glory of the terrible lord has been narrated to you. Welfare be unto us the bipeds. Welfare be unto our quadrupeds. Thus the origin of the bodies of Lord Mahadeva along with their designations has been recounted. Now listen to progeny of Bhrgu.
verses.hindi: १९४८ द द वायुप्राणम्
verses.wordMeaning: To the seventh body of the Lord known as Ugra and symbolized by the sacrificer, the wife is Diksa (initiation) and Santana as the son. The eighth body of the great Lord is known as the Moon. His wife is Rohini and Budha is remembered as the son.…
verses.commentary: Sense: To the seventh body of the Lord known as Ugra and symbolized by the sacrificer, the wife is Diksa (initiation) and Santana as the son. The eighth body of the great Lord is known as the Moon. His wife is Rohini and Budha is remembered as the son.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये त्रिपुरक्षोभणवर्णनं नाम सप्तविंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २८ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे रुद्रो नर्मदातटमास्थितः । क्रीडते ह्युमया सार्द्धं नारदस् तत्र चागतः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye tripurakṣobhaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 28 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etasminn antare rudro narmadātaṭamāsthitaḥ / krīḍate hyumayā sārddhaṃ nāradas tatra cāgataḥ
verses.translation: Khyati bore to Bhrgu the holy lords Dhatr and Vidhatr living throughout the Manvantara. They were masters of happiness and misery and grant auspicious and inauspicious results to living beings.
verses.hindi: भूलोंक: प्रथमः पादो भुव्लोकस्ततः परम् ।) स्वलॉको हि तृतीयस्तु चतुर्थस्तु महः स्पृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Khyati bore to Bhrgu the holy lords Dhatr and Vidhatr living throughout the Manvantara. They were masters of happiness and misery and grant auspicious and inauspicious results to living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Khyati bore to Bhrgu the holy lords Dhatr and Vidhatr living throughout the Manvantara. They were masters of happiness and misery and grant auspicious and inauspicious results to living beings.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य देवदेवेशमुमया सह शङ्करम् । व्यज्ञापयत् तदा देवं यद् वृत्तं त्रिपुरे तदा
verses.transliteration: praṇamya devadeveśamumayā saha śaṅkaram / vyajñāpayat tadā devaṃ yad vṛttaṃ tripure tadā
verses.translation: Their eldest sister, the chaste goddess Sri, the purifier of worlds, attained theauspicious lordNarayana as her husband, and gave birth to two sons: Bala (Strength) and Utsaha (Energy).
verses.hindi: तत्र लोक: पर स्थान पर तथोगिनां स्मृतम् (८६ मिर्मंसा निरहंकाराः कामक़ोधविवर्जिता: । द्रक्ष्यन्ते तहिदो युक्ता ध्यानतत्परयुध््जकाः
verses.wordMeaning: Their eldest sister, the chaste goddess Sri, the purifier of worlds, attained theauspicious lordNarayana as her husband, and gave birth to two sons: Bala (Strength) and Utsaha (Energy).
verses.commentary: Sense: Their eldest sister, the chaste goddess Sri, the purifier of worlds, attained theauspicious lordNarayana as her husband, and gave birth to two sons: Bala (Strength) and Utsaha (Energy).

verses.sanskrit: गतो ऽहं स्वामिनिर्देशाद् यत्र तद्बाणमन्दिरम् । दृष्टा बाणं यथान्यायं गतो ह्यन्तःपुरं महत्
verses.transliteration: gato 'haṃ svāminirdeśād yatra tadbāṇamandiram / dṛṣṭā bāṇaṃ yathānyāyaṃ gato hyantaḥpuraṃ mahat
verses.translation: Those heaven-walkers who pilot the aerial chariots of Devas and meritorious beings, were born to her as mental sons.
verses.hindi: सोमश्च मन्त्रसंयुक्तो तस्मान्मम मुखाच्च्युतः  जीवः प्राणमृतां ब्रह्मन्सर्वः पीत्वा स्तनेध् तनू धैघ तस्मात्सोममर्थ चेंतदमृतं चेंब संज्ञितम् । चतुष्पादा भविष्यस्ति श्वेतत्वं चास्य तैेन तत्
verses.wordMeaning: Those heaven-walkers who pilot the aerial chariots of Devas and meritorious beings, were born to her as mental sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those heaven-walkers who pilot the aerial chariots of Devas and meritorious beings, were born to her as mental sons.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भार्यासहस्राणि दृष्ट्वा बाणस्य धीमतः । यथायोग्यं यथाकामम् आगतः क्षोभ्य तत्पुरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra bhāryāsahasrāṇi dṛṣṭvā bāṇasya dhīmataḥ / yathāyogyaṃ yathākāmam āgataḥ kṣobhya tatpuram
verses.translation: She had two daughters Ayati and Niyati who are remembered as the wives of Vidhatr and Dhatr. They had two sons Pandu and Mrkandu. They were firm in religious vows, eternal and the very storehouses of the Vedic learning. Mar- kandeya was born of Mrkandu from Manasvinl.
verses.hindi: यस्माच्चेवं क्रिया भृत्वा द्विपादा वे महेश्वरी । दृष्टा पुमस्त्थया चेषा सावित्री लोकभाँविनी 0.
verses.wordMeaning: She had two daughters Ayati and Niyati who are remembered as the wives of Vidhatr and Dhatr. They had two sons Pandu and Mrkandu. They were firm in religious vows, eternal and the very storehouses of the Vedic learning. Mar- kandeya was born of Mrkandu from Manasvinl.
verses.commentary: Sense: She had two daughters Ayati and Niyati who are remembered as the wives of Vidhatr and Dhatr. They had two sons Pandu and Mrkandu. They were firm in religious vows, eternal and the very storehouses of the Vedic learning. Mar- kandeya was born of Mrkandu from Manasvinl.

verses.sanskrit: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा साधु साध्विति पूजयन् । चिन्तयामास देवेशो भ्रमणं त्रिपुरस्य हि
verses.transliteration: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sādhu sādhviti pūjayan / cintayāmāsa deveśo bhramaṇaṃ tripurasya hi
verses.translation: Vedasiras was his son born of Murdhanya. The sons born to Vedasiras in Pivari established the family line. They were known as Markandeyas. They were seers and masters of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: तपसा भावितात्मानो ये वे द्रक्ष्यन्ति वे द्विजा:। ईशत्वे च शिवत्वें च स्बंगं सबंतः स्थिरमू
verses.wordMeaning: Vedasiras was his son born of Murdhanya. The sons born to Vedasiras in Pivari established the family line. They were known as Markandeyas. They were seers and masters of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vedasiras was his son born of Murdhanya. The sons born to Vedasiras in Pivari established the family line. They were known as Markandeyas. They were seers and masters of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: करमुक्तं यथा चक्रं विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना । महावेगं महायामं रक्षितं तेजसा मम
verses.transliteration: karamuktaṃ yathā cakraṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā / mahāvegaṃ mahāyāmaṃ rakṣitaṃ tejasā mama
verses.translation: Pandu begot of Pundarika a son, Dyutiman. Two sons were born to him, viz. Dyutimanta and Sjjavan. Their sons and grandsons had alliances with the descendants of Bhrgu.
verses.hindi: द्वारा प्राप्प है ।८६। जो निर्मम, निरहड्भार काम क्रोध-हीत, ध्यान-निष्ठ योगी हैं, वे ही उस लोक का अवलोकन कर संकते हैं। जिसलियें आपने चार पैर वाली सरस्वंती का साक्षात्कार किया है, इसी से आंपके सब पशु चार पैर वाले होंगे। इसी से उनके स्तन भी चार ही होंगे । ब्ह्मन् ! सभी प्राणियों का प्राणस्वरूप भन्त्रमय सोम हमारे मुख से व्युत हुआ है. इसी से जीवधारियों ते उसे पीकर स्तनों में धारण
verses.wordMeaning: Pandu begot of Pundarika a son, Dyutiman. Two sons were born to him, viz. Dyutimanta and Sjjavan. Their sons and grandsons had alliances with the descendants of Bhrgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pandu begot of Pundarika a son, Dyutiman. Two sons were born to him, viz. Dyutimanta and Sjjavan. Their sons and grandsons had alliances with the descendants of Bhrgu.

verses.sanskrit: स च मे भक्तिनिरतो बाणो लोके च विश्रुतः । भारती च मया दत्ता ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sa ca me bhaktinirato bāṇo loke ca viśrutaḥ / bhāratī ca mayā dattā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Viraja's son Sudhaman was famous as learned Vairaja. The son of Sudhaman resorted to (and settled in) the eastern quarter.
verses.hindi: किया है। इसी से वह सॉममय और अमृत भी कहुलाता है। सोम का वर्ण रवेत होता और उसके चार पाद होते हैं ।६७-९०। जिस कारण आपने लोकभात्रिनी महेश्वरी सावित्री को दो पेरों वाली देखा है, उसी प्रकार आपके द्वारा सृष्ट तरगण द्विपद और दो स्तन वाले होंगे ।९१। जौ सवंवर्णा, सर्वभूतधारिणी, महासत्त्वशालिनी, परम, जन्मरहित माहेश्वरी वेवी हैं, उत्तका आपने साक्षात्कार किया है, इसलियें अन्य देवगण विश्वरूप होगें द
verses.wordMeaning: Viraja's son Sudhaman was famous as learned Vairaja. The son of Sudhaman resorted to (and settled in) the eastern quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Viraja's son Sudhaman was famous as learned Vairaja. The son of Sudhaman resorted to (and settled in) the eastern quarter.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स सुचिरं कालं देवदेवो महेश्वरः । चिन्तयित्वा सुनिर्वाणं कार्यं प्रति जनेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa suciraṃ kālaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ / cintayitvā sunirvāṇaṃ kāryaṃ prati janeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He was the son of Gauri and a valorous, righteous ruler of the worlds. Parvasa had great fame and he was the most excellent of all Ganas.
verses.hindi: और महांतेजस्वी अज भी विश्वरूप धारण करेंगे ।६२-६३। इनके मुख में अमोघरेता हुताशन रहेंगे इसलिये पशु रूपी हुताशम संवंगत और मेध्य होंगे। जो तपसस्‍्वी द्विज हमें सर्वंगामी ईश्वर शिव रूप में देखेंगे, वे रज और तेमोंगुण से मुक्त होकर भानव शरीर को छोड़ने के बाद हमारे समीप आवेंगे, जहाँ से कि वे फिर
verses.wordMeaning: He was the son of Gauri and a valorous, righteous ruler of the worlds. Parvasa had great fame and he was the most excellent of all Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was the son of Gauri and a valorous, righteous ruler of the worlds. Parvasa had great fame and he was the most excellent of all Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽसौ मन्दरं ध्यात्वा चापे कृत्वा गुणे महीम् । विष्णुं सनातनं देवं बाणे ध्यात्वा त्रिलोचनः
verses.transliteration: tato 'sau mandaraṃ dhyātvā cāpe kṛtvā guṇe mahīm / viṣṇuṃ sanātanaṃ devaṃ bāṇe dhyātvā trilocanaḥ
verses.translation: Parvasabcgot of Parvasa two glorious sons Yajnavama and Kasyapa. These two righteous sons established their race.
verses.hindi: इत्येबमुक्तों भगवान्त्रह्मा रंद्रेण वे द्विजा:। प्रण॒म्य प्रयतों भृत्वा पुनराह पिलाभहः ६७ क्‍ ब्रह्मोवाच द ह भगवन्देवदेवेश विश्वरूपो (१) महेश्वरः(र) । इसास्तव महादेव तनवो लोकवन्दिता: 0६८ विश्वरूप महासत्त्व कस्मिन्काले महाभुज । कस्यां वा युगसंभृत्यां ब्रक्यन्ति त्वां हिजातयः १६६
verses.wordMeaning: Parvasabcgot of Parvasa two glorious sons Yajnavama and Kasyapa. These two righteous sons established their race.
verses.commentary: Sense: Parvasabcgot of Parvasa two glorious sons Yajnavama and Kasyapa. These two righteous sons established their race.

verses.sanskrit: फले हुताशनं देवं ज्वलन्तं सर्वतोमुखम् । सुपर्णं पुङ्खयोर् मध्ये जवे वायुं प्रकल्प्य च
verses.transliteration: phale hutāśanaṃ devaṃ jvalantaṃ sarvatomukham / suparṇaṃ puṅkhayor madhye jave vāyuṃ prakalpya ca
verses.translation: Smrti, the wife of Angiras, gave birth to two sons and four daughters who were pious and renowned in the world. They (the daughters) were Sinivali, Kuhu, Raka and Anumati. The sons were two, viz. Bharatagni and Kirtiman.
verses.hindi: केन वा तत्त्वयोगेन ध्यानयोगेन केन बा । तनवस्ते महादेव शक़्या व्रष्दु द्विजातिलिः
verses.wordMeaning: Smrti, the wife of Angiras, gave birth to two sons and four daughters who were pious and renowned in the world. They (the daughters) were Sinivali, Kuhu, Raka and Anumati. The sons were two, viz. Bharatagni and Kirtiman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Smrti, the wife of Angiras, gave birth to two sons and four daughters who were pious and renowned in the world. They (the daughters) were Sinivali, Kuhu, Raka and Anumati. The sons were two, viz. Bharatagni and Kirtiman.

verses.sanskrit: रथं महीमयं कृत्वा धुरि तावश्विनावुभौ । अक्षे सुरेश्वरं देवम् अग्रकील्यां धनाधिपम्
verses.transliteration: rathaṃ mahīmayaṃ kṛtvā dhuri tāvaśvināvubhau / akṣe sureśvaraṃ devam agrakīlyāṃ dhanādhipam
verses.translation: Samhuti gave birth to Agni's (Bharatagni's?) son, Lord Parjanya. Another Parjanya called Pliranyaroma was born of Marlci. He is known astheguardian of the world abiding upto the final dissolution of the world.
verses.hindi: तथसा नैव योगेन दानधर्मफलेन वा। न तोर्थंफलयोगेन ऋतुभिर्वा सदक्षिणः
verses.wordMeaning: Samhuti gave birth to Agni's (Bharatagni's?) son, Lord Parjanya. Another Parjanya called Pliranyaroma was born of Marlci. He is known astheguardian of the world abiding upto the final dissolution of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Samhuti gave birth to Agni's (Bharatagni's?) son, Lord Parjanya. Another Parjanya called Pliranyaroma was born of Marlci. He is known astheguardian of the world abiding upto the final dissolution of the world.

verses.sanskrit: यमं तु दक्षिणे पार्श्वे वामे कालं सुदारुणम् । आदित्यचन्द्रौ चक्रे तु गन्धर्वानारकादिषु
verses.transliteration: yamaṃ tu dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme kālaṃ sudāruṇam / ādityacandrau cakre tu gandharvānārakādiṣu
verses.translation: To Kirtiman, Dhenuka bore two pious sons—Varistha and Dhrtiman. They were the most excellent of the descedants of Angiras.
verses.hindi: साध्वो नारायणश्चेव विष्णुस्त्रिभुवनेश्वर:। भविष्यतीह नास्‍्ना तु वाराहो नाम विश्युतः ॥हण्३े
verses.wordMeaning: To Kirtiman, Dhenuka bore two pious sons—Varistha and Dhrtiman. They were the most excellent of the descedants of Angiras.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Kirtiman, Dhenuka bore two pious sons—Varistha and Dhrtiman. They were the most excellent of the descedants of Angiras.

verses.sanskrit: यन्तारं च सुरज्येष्ठं वेदान्कृत्वा हयोत्तमान् । खलीनादिषु चाङ्गानि रश्मींश्छन्दांसि चाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: yantāraṃ ca surajyeṣṭhaṃ vedānkṛtvā hayottamān / khalīnādiṣu cāṅgāni raśmīṃśchandāṃsi cākarot
verses.translation: Their sons and grandsons who were in thousands have passed away. Anasuya gave birth to five sinless sons y Atri, and to a daughter called Sruti, the mother ofSankhapada. She was the wife of Kardama, son of Pulaha, the Patriarch. The live sons of Atri are glorified (enumerated) thus: Satyanetra, Havva, Apomurti, Sanisvara and the fifth was Soma. t end of Svayambhuva Manvantara they passed away along
verses.hindi: चतुर्बाहुश्चतुष्पादश्चतुर्नेत्रश्चतुमुंखः । तदा संवत्सरो भृत्वा यज्ञरूपो भविष्यति ७
verses.wordMeaning: Their sons and grandsons who were in thousands have passed away. Anasuya gave birth to five sinless sons y Atri, and to a daughter called Sruti, the mother ofSankhapada. She was the wife of Kardama, son of Pulaha, the Patriarch.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Their sons and grandsons who were in thousands have passed away. Anasuya gave birth to five sinless sons y Atri, and to a daughter called Sruti, the mother ofSankhapada. She was the wife of Kardama, son of Pulaha, the Patriarch.…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा प्रतोदम् ॐकारं मुखग्राह्यं महेश्वरः । धातारं चाग्रतः कृत्वा विधातारं च पृष्ठतः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pratodam oṃkāraṃ mukhagrāhyaṃ maheśvaraḥ / dhātāraṃ cāgrataḥ kṛtvā vidhātāraṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ
verses.translation: The descendants of Atri, their sons and grandsons were in hundreds and thousands. They lived upto the end of Svaya-
verses.hindi: कभी नहीं लौटेंगे ।६४-६६। है द्विजगण ! जब रुद्र ने भगवान् ब्रह्मा से इस प्रकार कहां, तंब पितामह ने नम्न होकर फिर कहा ।६७। द द
verses.wordMeaning: The descendants of Atri, their sons and grandsons were in hundreds and thousands. They lived upto the end of Svaya-
verses.commentary: Sense: The descendants of Atri, their sons and grandsons were in hundreds and thousands. They lived upto the end of Svaya-

verses.sanskrit: मारुतात्सर्वतो दिग्भ्य ऊर्ध्वयन्त्रे तथैव च । महोरगपिशाचांश्च सिद्धविद्याधरांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: mārutātsarvato digbhya ūrdhvayantre tathaiva ca / mahoragapiśācāṃśca siddhavidyādharāṃstathā
verses.translation: Dattali was the son of Pulastya by his wife Priti. In his previous birth, in the Svayambhuva Manvantara, known as Agastya. Devabahu was themiddle and V.mta was the
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म बोले - “देव ! देवेश ! भगव॑ंन् ! आप विध्वरपधारी महेइवर हैं। महादेव ! आपके ये शरीर लोकपूज्य हैं; किन्तु हम जानने की इच्छा करते हैं कि, विश्वरूप ! महासरव, महाभुज ! कब किस काल में और किस युग में हिजातिगण आपको देख सकेंगे ? महादेव ! किस तर्वयोग से, किस ध्यान धारंणा से द्विजातिगण आपकी मूर्ति का दर्शन कर सकेंगे ?”” ।९८-१००। ड़
verses.wordMeaning: Dattali was the son of Pulastya by his wife Priti. In his previous birth, in the Svayambhuva Manvantara, known as Agastya. Devabahu was themiddle and V.mta was the
verses.commentary: Sense: Dattali was the son of Pulastya by his wife Priti. In his previous birth, in the Svayambhuva Manvantara, known as Agastya. Devabahu was themiddle and V.mta was the

verses.sanskrit: गणांश्च भूतसङ्घांश्च सर्वे सर्वाङ्गसंधिषु । युगमध्ये स्थितो मेरुर्युगस्याधो महागिरिः
verses.transliteration: gaṇāṃśca bhūtasaṅghāṃśca sarve sarvāṅgasaṃdhiṣu / yugamadhye sthito meruryugasyādho mahāgiriḥ
verses.translation: Their younger sister, via. Sadvad was well known. She is remembered as the splended and pure wife o g i ( • • Bharatagni) and mother of Parjanya.
verses.hindi: भगवान बंलि--' तपस्या, योग, दानधर्म के फल, तीर्थाटन, दक्षिणा सहित यज्ञ, वेदों का अध्यापन, धनों का दान आदि से नहीँ बल्कि केवल ध्यान के द्वारा ही मनुष्य हमें देख सकतें हैं १०१-१०२। : त्रिभवनपति नारायण विष्णु ही एक मातन्न साधनीय हैं। वे वाराह ताम से विश्रत होंगे ।१०३। उन्हें चार बाहु चार पैर, चार नेत्र और चार मुख होंगे। उस समय वे संवत्सर होकर यज्नस्वरूप होंगे । वे षडज़,
verses.wordMeaning: Their younger sister, via. Sadvad was well known. She is remembered as the splended and pure wife o g i ( • • Bharatagni) and mother of Parjanya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their younger sister, via. Sadvad was well known. She is remembered as the splended and pure wife o g i ( • • Bharatagni) and mother of Parjanya.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पा यन्त्रस्थिता घोराः शम्ये वरुणनैरृतौ । गायत्री चैव सावित्री स्थिते ते रश्मिबन्धने
verses.transliteration: sarpā yantrasthitā ghorāḥ śamye varuṇanairṛtau / gāyatrī caiva sāvitrī sthite te raśmibandhane
verses.translation: The wife of Dattali, the saintly and intelligent son o
verses.hindi: तिशीषे, त्रिस्थान और त्रिशरीौरवान् होंगे ।१०४॥ कृत, त्रेता, दापर और कलिये चारों युग उनके चार पाद होंगे। सकल यज्ञ उनके अज्भू, चारों वेद चारों भुजायें, ऋतु और ऋतु»सन्धि उनके मुख, दोनों अयन और दोनों अयनमुख उनकी चारों आँखें, पर्व यानी फाहंगुनी, आषाढ़ी, कृत्तिका उनके ठीनों सिर, दिव्य,
verses.wordMeaning: The wife of Dattali, the saintly and intelligent son o
verses.commentary: Sense: The wife of Dattali, the saintly and intelligent son o

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं रथध्वजे शौचं दमं रक्षां समन्ततः । रथं देवमयं कृत्वा देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ rathadhvaje śaucaṃ damaṃ rakṣāṃ samantataḥ / rathaṃ devamayaṃ kṛtvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Ksama gave birth to ilie sons of 1 ulaha. 1 hey had fiery refulgence and they established theii reputation,
verses.hindi: भुजाश्च वेदाश्चत्वार ऋतु: संधिमुखानि च । है मुखे है च अयने नेन्राश्च चत्रस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Ksama gave birth to ilie sons of 1 ulaha. 1 hey had fiery refulgence and they established theii reputation,
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksama gave birth to ilie sons of 1 ulaha. 1 hey had fiery refulgence and they established theii reputation,

verses.sanskrit: संनद्धः कवची खड्गी बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्रवान् । बद्धा परिकरं गाढं जटाजूटं नियम्य च
verses.transliteration: saṃnaddhaḥ kavacī khaḍgī baddhagodhāṅgulitravān / baddhā parikaraṃ gāḍhaṃ jaṭājūṭaṃ niyamya ca
verses.translation: Thcv were Kardama, Ambarlsa, Sahisnu, Rsi and Dhanakaplvan. An auspicious daughter, Pivari, was also born.
verses.hindi: शिरांसि त्रीणि पर्वाणि फाल्गुन्याबाढकृत्तिका:। दिव्यान्तरक्षिभौमानि त्रीणि स्थानानि यानि तु ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thcv were Kardama, Ambarlsa, Sahisnu, Rsi and Dhanakaplvan. An auspicious daughter, Pivari, was also born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thcv were Kardama, Ambarlsa, Sahisnu, Rsi and Dhanakaplvan. An auspicious daughter, Pivari, was also born.

verses.sanskrit: सज्जं कृत्वा धनुर्दिव्यं योजयित्वा रथोत्तमम् । रथमध्ये स्थितो देवः शुशुभे च युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: sajjaṃ kṛtvā dhanurdivyaṃ yojayitvā rathottamam / rathamadhye sthito devaḥ śuśubhe ca yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Kardama's wife Sruth daughter of Atri, gave birth to a son Sankhapada and a daughter Kamya.
verses.hindi: संभर्वः प्रलयश्चेव आश्रमो हो प्रकीतितौ द द १०७ स यदा कालरूपाभो वराहत्वे व्यवस्थित: । भविष्यति यदा साध्यो विष्णुर्नारायण: प्रभु:
verses.wordMeaning: Kardama's wife Sruth daughter of Atri, gave birth to a son Sankhapada and a daughter Kamya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kardama's wife Sruth daughter of Atri, gave birth to a son Sankhapada and a daughter Kamya.

verses.sanskrit: धनुषः शब्दनादेनाकम्पयच्च जगत्त्रयम् । स्थानं कृत्वा तु वैशाखं निभृतं संस्थितो हरः
verses.transliteration: dhanuṣaḥ śabdanādenākampayacca jagattrayam / sthānaṃ kṛtvā tu vaiśākhaṃ nibhṛtaṃ saṃsthito haraḥ
verses.translation: The glorious Sarikhapada was a Prajapati and the ruler of worlds. After giving Kamya (in marriage) to Priyavrata, he settled in the southern region.
verses.hindi: तदा त्वमपि देवेश चतुर्वकत्रो व्यवस्थित: । ब्रह्मलोकनमस्कार्यों विष्णुर्नारायण: प्रभुः...
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious Sarikhapada was a Prajapati and the ruler of worlds. After giving Kamya (in marriage) to Priyavrata, he settled in the southern region.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious Sarikhapada was a Prajapati and the ruler of worlds. After giving Kamya (in marriage) to Priyavrata, he settled in the southern region.

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य सुचिरं कालं कोपसंरक्तलोचनः । ध्यात्वा तं परमं मन्त्रम् आत्मानं च निरुध्य सः
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ / dhyātvā taṃ paramaṃ mantram ātmānaṃ ca nirudhya saḥ
verses.translation: The sons Dhanakaplvan and Sahisnu became famous. So also Yasodharin, Kamadcva and Sumadhyama.
verses.hindi: एकार्णवे प्लवे चेव शयान पुरुष हरिम्। यदा द्रक्यसि देवेशं ध्यानयुकतं सहामुनिम् ११०:
verses.wordMeaning: The sons Dhanakaplvan and Sahisnu became famous. So also Yasodharin, Kamadcva and Sumadhyama.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons Dhanakaplvan and Sahisnu became famous. So also Yasodharin, Kamadcva and Sumadhyama.

verses.sanskrit: मुमोच सहसा बाणं पुरस्य वधकाङ्क्षया । यदा त्रीणि समेतानि अन्तरिक्षस्थितानि तु
verses.transliteration: mumoca sahasā bāṇaṃ purasya vadhakāṅkṣayā / yadā trīṇi sametāni antarikṣasthitāni tu
verses.translation: From Rtu a son equal to Kratu was born and the progeny was auspicious. They did not marry and remained celibate. They were sixty thousand in number and known as Valakhilyas.
verses.hindi: एफकस्योदरस्थस्तु दृष्ट्वा लोकांश्वराचरान् । विस्म॒यं परम गत्वा ध्यानादृबुद्ध्वा तु समानुषो
verses.wordMeaning: From Rtu a son equal to Kratu was born and the progeny was auspicious. They did not marry and remained celibate. They were sixty thousand in number and known as Valakhilyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Rtu a son equal to Kratu was born and the progeny was auspicious. They did not marry and remained celibate. They were sixty thousand in number and known as Valakhilyas.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालनिमेषार्धं दृष्ट्वैक्यं त्रिपुरस्य च । त्रिपर्वणा त्रिशल्येन ततस्तान्यवसादयत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālanimeṣārdhaṃ dṛṣṭvaikyaṃ tripurasya ca / triparvaṇā triśalyena tatastānyavasādayat
verses.translation: They surround the sun and go ahead of Aruna. They will remain fellow-travellers with the sun till the universe is finally dissolved.
verses.hindi: ततस्तस्मिस्तदा कल्पे वाराहे सप्तमे प्रभो:। पुनविष्णुमंहातेजा: कालो लोकप्रकालन:
verses.wordMeaning: They surround the sun and go ahead of Aruna. They will remain fellow-travellers with the sun till the universe is finally dissolved.
verses.commentary: Sense: They surround the sun and go ahead of Aruna. They will remain fellow-travellers with the sun till the universe is finally dissolved.

verses.sanskrit: ततो लोका भयत्रस्तास् त्रिपुरे भरतोत्तम । सर्वासुरविनाशाय कालरूपा भयावहाः
verses.transliteration: tato lokā bhayatrastās tripure bharatottama / sarvāsuravināśāya kālarūpā bhayāvahāḥ
verses.translation: Two younger sisters were Punyatma and Sumati. They weie the daughters-in-law ofParvasa, son ofPurnamasa.
verses.hindi: तदा चतुर्युगावस्थे कल्पे तस्मिन्थुगान्तके । भविष्यामि शिखायुक्तः श्वेतो नाम महामुनिः ४११५ हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये छागले पव॑तोत्तमे । चतुःशिष्या: शिवयुक्ता भविष्यन्ति तदा मम
verses.wordMeaning: Two younger sisters were Punyatma and Sumati. They weie the daughters-in-law ofParvasa, son ofPurnamasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two younger sisters were Punyatma and Sumati. They weie the daughters-in-law ofParvasa, son ofPurnamasa.

verses.sanskrit: अट्टहासान् प्रमुञ्चन्ति कष्टरूपा नरास् तदा । निमेषोन्मेषणं चैव कुर्वन्ति लिपिकर्मसु
verses.transliteration: aṭṭahāsān pramuñcanti kaṣṭarūpā narās tadā / nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ caiva kurvanti lipikarmasu
verses.translation: Seven sons were born to Vasistha in Orja. Their eldest sister was the slender-waisted lady Puntjarika who was the mother of Dyutiman and the wife of Pandu. Her younger brothers were seven. They were famous as Vasisthas.
verses.hindi: अन्तरिक्ष और भौम ये तीनों स्थान उनके मस्तकत्रय एवं उत्पत्ति और प्रलय उनका आश्रम कहलाता है ।१०५-१०७। वही प्रभु नारायण जब काल रूप से वाराह देह में प्रतिष्ठित होकर सबके द्वारा आराधनीय होंगे, तब देवेश ! आप भी चतुरानन होंगे। भगवान् नारायण तब ब्रहालोक निवासियों के लिये भी नमस्करणीय होंगे ।१०८-१०६। जब संसार एकार्णवीभूत हो जायगा, तब आप उस शभ्रवह के
verses.wordMeaning: Seven sons were born to Vasistha in Orja. Their eldest sister was the slender-waisted lady Puntjarika who was the mother of Dyutiman and the wife of Pandu. Her younger brothers were seven. They were famous as Vasisthas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seven sons were born to Vasistha in Orja. Their eldest sister was the slender-waisted lady Puntjarika who was the mother of Dyutiman and the wife of Pandu. Her younger brothers were seven. They were famous as Vasisthas.

verses.sanskrit: निष्पन्दनयना मर्त्याश्चित्रेष्वालिखिता इव । देवायतनगा देवा रटन्ति प्रहसन्ति च । स्वप्ने पश्यन्ति चात्मानं रक्ताम्बरविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: niṣpandanayanā martyāścitreṣvālikhitā iva / devāyatanagā devā raṭanti prahasanti ca / svapne paśyanti cātmānaṃ raktāmbaravibhūṣitam
verses.translation: They were Rajas, Putra, Ardhabahu, Savana. Adhana, Sutapas and Sukla. They arc known as seven sages.
verses.hindi: बीच पुरुषोत्तम हरि को ध्यानस्थ महामुनि की तरह शयन करते हुये देखेंगे ।((१०। उस समय हमारी माया से मोहित होकर आपकी चेतना नष्ट हो जायगी। रात होने के कारण आप दोनों ही एक दूसरे को नहीं जान सकेंगे, आपस में स्पर्द्धा करंगे। उस समय आप दोनों ही एक दूसरे के उदर में चराचर लोक को देखकर अत्यन्त विस्मित हो जायेंगे और ध्यान द्वारा अपने को मनुष्य समझने लगेंगे ।१११-११२। उस कल्प में आप
verses.wordMeaning: They were Rajas, Putra, Ardhabahu, Savana. Adhana, Sutapas and Sukla. They arc known as seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Rajas, Putra, Ardhabahu, Savana. Adhana, Sutapas and Sukla. They arc known as seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तमाल्योत्तमाङ्गाश्च पतन्तः कार्दमे ह्रदे । पश्यन्ति नाम चात्मानं सतैलाभ्यङ्गमस्तकम्
verses.transliteration: raktamālyottamāṅgāśca patantaḥ kārdame hrade / paśyanti nāma cātmānaṃ satailābhyaṅgamastakam
verses.translation: The famous daughter of Markanqleya bore to Rajas a
verses.hindi: पद्मनाभि, पद्मजन्मा, पद्मार्धित भादि नामों से विपुल ख्याति प्राप्ति करंगे। प्रभु के उस सप्तम बाराह कल्प में विष्ण महातेजस्वी काल होकर संसार का संहार करेंगे। उस समय बैवस्वत मनु आपके पुत्र होंगे ।११३-११४। हम उस समय उस चतुर्युग के उपसंहारक कल्प में शिखायुक्त श्वेत नामक महामुनि होंगे
verses.wordMeaning: The famous daughter of Markanqleya bore to Rajas a
verses.commentary: Sense: The famous daughter of Markanqleya bore to Rajas a

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्ति यानमारूढं रासभैश्च नृपोत्तम । संवर्तको महावायुर्युगान्तप्रतिमो महान्
verses.transliteration: paśyanti yānamārūḍhaṃ rāsabhaiśca nṛpottama / saṃvartako mahāvāyuryugāntapratimo mahān
verses.translation: The famous daughter of Markanqleya bore to Rajas a
verses.hindi: और दइ्बेतलोहित नामक चार शिष्य होंगे। ये चारों ही महात्मा ब्राह्मण बेदपारम ओर शिवध्यानानुरक्त
verses.wordMeaning: The famous daughter of Markanqleya bore to Rajas a
verses.commentary: Sense: The famous daughter of Markanqleya bore to Rajas a

verses.sanskrit: गृहान् उन्मूलयामास वृक्षजातीननेकशः । भूमिकम्पाः सनिर्घाता उल्कापाताः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: gṛhān unmūlayāmāsa vṛkṣajātīnanekaśaḥ / bhūmikampāḥ sanirghātā ulkāpātāḥ sahasraśaḥ
