verses.sanskrit: प्राणांस् त्यजति यो मर्त्यस् तस्मिंस्तीर्थे विधानतः । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य इत्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: prāṇāṃs tyajati yo martyas tasmiṃstīrthe vidhānataḥ / anivartikā gatistasya ityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: "O Daksa, you shall not be angry due to this hind¬ rance. It is I, none else, who destroyed the sacrifice. You have seen that before. O you of good rites, again, accept this boon from me. With your face beaming with delight, you shall listen to me with attention. O Prajapati, by my grace, you will derive the merit of a thousand Asvamedha and a hundred Vajapeya sacrifices. Having established the Vedas with their six an- cillaries together with the Samkhya and Yoga and performmg O blessed one, you shall derive the bench 1 - of this holy rite. May your mental worry be over." After saying thus to Daksa, the valorous lord vanished along with his consort and his followers. O Brahmanas, after obtaining his due share as men¬ tioned by Brahma, the lord who was conversant with the holy rites, divided Jvara (fever) into many classes 1 for achieving calmness in living beings. Listen to it. For elephants it is excessive pain in the head; for mountains it is bitumen; for waters it is the bluish tinge; and in serpents it is the slough. It is Khour aka (cracks in the hoofs) for all cattle. It is banenness for the earth. O Knower of Dharma! to the ele¬ phants it is the obstruction to vision. It is the opening of pores to the horses, the splitting of the crest to the peacocks, the ailment of the eyes to the It is splitting 6f the bile to the goats. It is Himika \?) O Omniscient lord, it is fever to the human heiners It He who reads the story of the origin of Jvara with un¬ dejected and concentrated mind shall be freed from the ailment. He will rejoice, attaining all joys in accordance with his desires. lie who nairates or listens to the hymn of praise re¬ cited by Daksa, attains longevity. He will never face inauspicious results. Just as Siva endowed with Yogic power is the excellent of all Devas, so also this hymn of Brahma is the excellent of all hymns. The lord shall be eulogised with devotion by those who desire fame, kingdom, happiness, prosperity, riches, longevity, wealth and learning. The sick, the distressed, the indigent, the frightened, those afraid of thieves and those on the king's errand are liberated from dangers. He will attain all happiness here itself. He will become the chief of Ganas with this body itself. In a house where the lord is eulogised, neither the Yaksas nor the Pis'acas, neither the serpents nor the impediments create obstacles. A celibate woman who listens to this with devotion will become the object of respect of the families both from her father's and her husband's side. The affairs of the man who constantly listens to or narrates all these will become fruitful without impediments. By the repeated recitation of this hymn, whatever he thinks in his mind and whatever he speaks out, will become realised. After offering oblations to the lord, Guha, Goddess and Nandlsvara, as far as he can, practising mental control and restraint of the sense organs and united in Yogic communion, he shall repeat the names of the lord in the proper order. He will attain his desires, ambitions and enjoy pleasures. On death he will attain heaven surrounded by a thousand women. One who performs undesirable activities or one who is defiled by sins becomes free from sins on reading the hymn So said the holy lord Vyasa, son of Parasara. This episode is a secret that shall not be divulged to anyone. After hearing this secret, even the sinners, whether they be Vaisyas, Sudras or women, will attain Rudraloka. The Brahmana who recounts this to the other Brahmanas during Parvau days attains Rudraloka. There is no doubt about this.

verses.translation: Thus the sin-destroying* story in the context of Daksa as told by Siva, has been narrated to you. In the context of describing the race of Pitrs, this story has been narrated. In succession to the Pitf$, I shall describe Devas hereafter. Formerly, in the Svayambhuva Manvantara, in the beginning of thcTretaage, there were Devas known as Yamas. They were formerly the sons of Yajna. Those known as Ajitas were Brahma's sons. Those known as Jitas and Jitajitas were the mental sons of Brahma. They were known as Sukras. There were three groups of Devas, namely (Yama, Sukra and) Trptimanta. They were the chanters of the Samaveda and were thirty-three in all in Svayambhuva Manvantara (or born of Brahma).

verses.transliteration: tatra saṃnihito brahmā nityasevī yudhiṣṭhira / ūrdhvabāhurnirālambacakāra bhramaṇaṃ sadā
verses.translation: The Yamas are twelve in number, viz. Yadu, Yavati, Didhaya, Sravasa, Mati, Vibhasa, Kratu, Prajati, Visata, Dyuti, This chapter corresponds to Bd. 2.13.87-151. In addition to Devas, the chapter discusses the nature of Time etc. in w. 24 ff. In the Svayambhuva Manvantara a thousands of the offsprings of these passed away. They were endowed with pro¬ wess, beauty, longevity and vigour. They are not mentioned in detail so that no new topic be raised here. The creation of Svayambhuva should be under¬ stood (as similar to) the present Manvantara. The past creation should be seen through the present one, viz. Vaivasvata Manvantara in regard to progeny, gods, sages and Pitrs.

verses.transliteration: ekāhāravaśe 'tiṣṭhaddvādaśābdaṃ mahāvratī / atra tīrthe vidhānena cintayan vai maheśvaram
verses.translation: Now know the seven sages who existed before. They were Bhrgu, Angiras, Marici, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Atri and Vasistha. Svayambhuva Manu had ten valient sons, viz. Agnidhra, Atibahu, Medha, Medhatithi, Vasu, Jyotisman, Dyutiman, Havya, Savana and Putra. They have been mentioned by Vayu as kings of great valour in the first Manvantara. Their families, the Asuras, Gandharvas, Yaksas, serpents, Raksasas, Pisacas, human beings, Suparnas and groups ofApsaras-s cannot be enumerate in order, even in hundreds of years because the names are num¬ erous in their families. Those who were known by the name of Vrajakula and who were in the Svayambhuva Manvantara, passed away as much time elapsed in the order of Ayanas, years and Yugas. Who is this lord Kala, the annihilator of living beings? What is his source of origin? What is his beginning? What is his intrinsic essence? Who is his son? What is his eye? What is his form? What are his limbs? What is his name? Who is his Atman? Mention these in detail as we ask you. May the origin of the Kala be heard. After hearing it, may it be retained in memory. The sun is his source of origin. yimcsa is his beginning. He is called Sankhya-Cak?u (having Number as his eye).
verses.hindi: स एव भगवानीशो ह्ानादिश्वान्तकृद्विभुः । भवानहं च॒ स्तोत्रेण हा पतिष्ठाव गोध्वजम् ६०
verses.wordMeaning: Now know the seven sages who existed before. They were Bhrgu, Angiras, Marici, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Atri and Vasistha. Svayambhuva Manu had ten valient sons, viz. Agnidhra, Atibahu, Medha, Medhatithi, Vasu, Jyotisman, Dyutiman, Havya, Savana and Putra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Now know the seven sages who existed before. They were Bhrgu, Angiras, Marici, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Atri and Vasistha. Svayambhuva Manu had ten valient sons, viz. Agnidhra, Atibahu, Medha, Medhatithi, Vasu, Jyotisman, Dyutiman, Havya, Savana and Putra.…

verses.sanskrit: तेन तत्पुण्यमाख्यातं ब्रह्मावर्तमिति प्रभो । तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: tena tatpuṇyamākhyātaṃ brahmāvartamiti prabho / tatra snātvā vidhānena tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: His form is the day and night. The jYmesas are his limbs. A century constitutes his principle. Kala is his name. He is the Prajapati with the present, past and future as his Atman. Listen to the five divisions in which Kala is divided by means of days, fortnights, months, seasons and Ay anas. The first (year) is Sariivatsara. The second (is called) Parivalsara. The third is Idvaisara. The fourth is Anuvatsara and the fifth is Valsara. The group is called Yuga. 1 I shall explain their principle. Understand as it is being narrated. That which is mentioned as Kratu (sacrifice) and Agni (fire) is considered as Sariivatsara. 2 The fire of time which is the essence in the Sun-god is Parivatsara. He who quickens (lit. warms up) the worlds with his bodies seven times seven ( =49 Maruts) and who makes people to work actively (and quickly) that wind (god) is Vatsara.
verses.hindi: ततः क़द्धोःम्वुजाभास्क ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच केशवम् । न भवाचूनमात्मानं लोकानां योनिमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: His form is the day and night. The jYmesas are his limbs. A century constitutes his principle. Kala is his name. He is the Prajapati with the present, past and future as his Atman. Listen to the five divisions in which Kala is divided by means of days, fortnights, months,…
verses.commentary: Sense: His form is the day and night. The jYmesas are his limbs. A century constitutes his principle. Kala is his name. He is the Prajapati with the present, past and future as his Atman. Listen to the five divisions in which Kala is divided by means of days, fortnights, months,…

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयेद्देवमीशानं विष्णुं वा परमेश्वरम् । यत्फलं सर्वयज्ञानां विधिवद्दक्षिणावताम्
verses.transliteration: arcayeddevamīśānaṃ viṣṇuṃ vā parameśvaram / yatphalaṃ sarvayajñānāṃ vidhivaddakṣiṇāvatām
verses.translation: He who while being born out of Brahma, roared thrice egotistically is Rudra. That Rudra who was born red-blue (in complexion) out of them is Vatsara. Now I shall explain to you their essential nature. Understand it as it is being narrated. Due to the contact of limbs and minor parts of the body (divisions and sub-divisions), the Atman of Kala is the great-grandfather. He is the source of origin of Rk, Saman and Yajus. He is the lord of all the five (viz. day, fortnight etc...). That (identical with) Yajus, Soma, Bhuta (elements) and Prajapati is called Samvalsara by learned men. And what is Agni but Sfirya (the Sun-god)? The Sun-god is the arranger of the divisions of time such as days, months, seasons, equinoxes as well as of the activities of planets, stars, of cold, heat, rain, span of life, holy rites, (but himself) is an evolute (being born of Brahma) of kindly disposition, the son of Brahma, the Lord protector of subjects. He is only one.* He is day, month, season and grand-sire (Brahma).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणं लोककर्तारं मां च वेत्ति सनातनम् । को5यं भोः शंकरो नाम ह्यावयोव्यंतिरिच्यती
verses.wordMeaning: He who while being born out of Brahma, roared thrice egotistically is Rudra. That Rudra who was born red-blue (in complexion) out of them is Vatsara. Now I shall explain to you their essential nature. Understand it as it is being narrated.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्फलं समवाप्नोति तत्तीर्थस्य प्रभावतः । यस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यो देवो दानवो वा द्विजो ऽथ वा
verses.transliteration: tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tattīrthasya prabhāvataḥ / yasmiṃstīrthe tu yo devo dānavo vā dvijo 'tha vā
verses.translation: He is Aditya, Savitr, Bhanu, the enlivener of life, honoured by Brahma. He is called Bhaskara as he is the source of the origin and cause of destruction of all living beings and is hence designated as Bhaskara. The third Parivatsara should be known as the presiding deity of stars. As the moon is the Lord of medicinal herbs, he is called the great-grand-father. He is the life-bestower of living beings. He meets their needs and preserves them. By. his rays he surveys the universe and sustains it. The moon is the source of the origin of Tithis (days of the Lunar fortnight), junctions of Parvans, the Full Moon and the New Moon. He causes the night and is the Prajapati with nectarine soul. Hence he is fatherly soma of the nature of Rk,
verses.hindi: तस्य तत्कोधजं वाक्य भ्रुत्वा विष्णुरभाषत । मा मैवं वद कल्याण परिवादं महात्मनः ६६३ मायायोगेश्वरो धर्मो दुराधर्षों वरप्रदः। हेतुरस्थात्र जगतः पुराणः पुरुषोःव्ययः ३६४
verses.wordMeaning: He is Aditya, Savitr, Bhanu, the enlivener of life, honoured by Brahma. He is called Bhaskara as he is the source of the origin and cause of destruction of all living beings and is hence designated as Bhaskara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Aditya, Savitr, Bhanu, the enlivener of life, honoured by Brahma. He is called Bhaskara as he is the source of the origin and cause of destruction of all living beings and is hence designated as Bhaskara.…

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धस्तेनैव तन्नाम्ना ख्यातं लोके महच्च तत् । न जलं न स्थलं नाम क्षेत्रं वा ह्यूषराणि च
verses.transliteration: siddhastenaiva tannāmnā khyātaṃ loke mahacca tat / na jalaṃ na sthalaṃ nāma kṣetraṃ vā hyūṣarāṇi ca
verses.translation: He causes the unified and simultaneous activities of the five units of the physical body, viz. the sense-organs, the mind, the intellect, the memory and power". He is the source of origin of fire, water, earth, the sun and the moon. Hence he is Prajapati. He is the soul of existing worlds. He is the great-grandfather. When medicinal herbs decline, the Lord is worshipped byDevas, the chief of whom was Prajapati and who seek fruits eagerly desired bythem. He is worshipped (by offering Purotfaia) in three Kapalas (pots known as Arribaka). Hence he is called Tryarhbaka. The (Vedic metres) Gayatri, Tristubh and Jagau are remembered (known) by the term Tryambaka. They are the sources of the origin of sacrifice.
verses.hindi: प्रात:कलीन सूर्य के समान तेजस्वी, विशाल मुख वाले किसी अद्भुत जीब को अपनी ओर समीप आते देखकर उन्होंने नारायण से पूछा ।५४। विष्णो ! यह महामुख, बड़े-बड़े दाँतों बाला पुरुष कोन है जिसको मैं पहचान नहीं रहा हे, जिसके शिर के केश उधर-इधर बिखरे हुये है जो दशभज, त्रिशुलधारी, चारों ओर मुख और आंख वाला, साक्षात् लोकप्रभु, विक्ृत, मूंज की बनी मेखला पहने हुये है, जिसका लिंग ऊपर
verses.wordMeaning: He causes the unified and simultaneous activities of the five units of the physical body, viz. the sense-organs, the mind, the intellect, the memory and power". He is the source of origin of fire, water, earth, the sun and the moon. Hence he is Prajapati.…

verses.transliteration: pavitratvaṃ labhantyete pauruṣeṇa vinā nṛṇām / sāmarthyānniścayāddhairyātsidhyanti puruṣā nṛpa
verses.translation: It is remembered as Tri-Kapala as the Puroda§a offering consecrated for (achieving) three means by the repetition of those three metrical verses united into one and through their efficacy. Thus the Yuga as mentioned by the learned, is one consisting of five years. The samvatsara that has been mentioned by Brahmanas as one having five-fold selves became a set of six selves with the names of Madhu (spring) and otherseasons. The sons of the seasons are five. Thus this crea¬ tion is mentioned briefly. This wind (vital air) alone is the life of living beings. The destroyer Kala runs with the force of the current of a river with day and night for his hands. Hence he is called the wind. These are the Prajapatis (Lords of subjects) most im-
verses.hindi: उठा हुआ है और जो भयंकर गजंना कर रहे हैं। भगवन् ! ये  जोराशि कौन हैं जो अपने तेज से सब दिशाओं को और आकाश को व्याप्त करते हये उधर ही आ रहे हैं ।५५-५७। ब्रह्मा की इन बातों को सुनकर भगवान् विष्ण ने ब्रह्मा से कहा--जिनके पद-प्रहार से समुद्र में बड़े वेग से चंचल, उत्ताल तरग उठ रही हैं, जिसकी छुटा से पद्मसंभव ब्रह्मा भी आवत से हो गये हैं, और जिसके धवास से आपके सहित यह मेरी नाभि

verses.sanskrit: प्रमादात् तस्य लोभेन पतन्ति नरके ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: pramādāt tasya lobhena patanti narake dhruvam
verses.translation: The lord manifested himself by coming outof the mouth of Brahma, as he was meditating. Hence he (the great lord) Mahadeva, the sage, the Brahmana, the soul of all living beings is the great-grandfather. He, the lord of all living beings is identical with the Pranava. The creation of the limbs (major and minor) of living beings is due to the entry of the soul (into the body). Agni, Samvatsara. the sun, the moon, the wind—Lord Rudra, the soul of Kala, the all-pervader always condenses these. It is called Idvaisara when it causes exhilaration and blesses the world. In this universe everything is penetrated and permea¬ ted by Lord Rudra with his own brilliance, bodies and names by the relation of the supporter and the supported.
verses.hindi: से निकला हुआ कमल वेग से कपित हो रहा है वे भगवान् ईश हैं जो अनादि, लोकनाशक और विभु हैं  चलिये, आप और मैं, स्तुति से इस वृषभध्वज का समीप चलकर अभिनन्दन कर ।५८-६०। यह सुनकर ब्रह। ऋद्ध हो गये, और कमलनयन केशव से बोले---आप लोककर्ता अपने को और लोकपालक सनातन प्रभ मुझको ( ब्रह्मा को ) निश्चय ही नहीं जानते हैं। यह शंकर कौन है जो हम दोनों से बढ़कर है ? ब्रह्मा

verses.transliteration: saṃnirudhyendriyagrāmaṃ yatra yatra vasen muniḥ / tatra tatra kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca
verses.translation: Hence through his prowess u— second contact of welfare is the cause of supreme bliss to the worlds. Since he is the cause of tuo general distinction existing in Devas, Pitrs, and Kala, he is worshipped by the learned. The lord of lords, the Prajapati of the Prajapatis, the abode of living beings is Rudra, Nllalohita.He revives the growth of medicinal piants declining again and again. Thus the lineage of Devas cannot be enumerated due to their multiplicity. Their sons and grandsons are too many to mention. He who glorifies this lineage of great Prajapatis of noble deeds and stable renown will attain great Siddhi.

verses.translation: Henceforth I shall explain the decisive nature of oihkara as the imperishable Brahman. 1 It shall be remembered at the beginning that it consists of three letters. In accordance with the letters, the presiding deities are ordained.There areRk, Yajur, Saman(Vedas), Vayu (the Wind- god), the Fire-god and water.

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचित् सभामध्ये सर्वदेवसमागमे । मेनकानृत्यगीतेन मोहितः सुचिरं किल
verses.transliteration: sa kadācit sabhāmadhye sarvadevasamāgame / menakānṛtyagītena mohitaḥ suciraṃ kila
verses.translation: "This white face of his, seen with four tongues, is the face of Kala and is called Krta Yuga. This god Brahma, the most excellent among gods, and Vaivasvata is (this) face. What I called the third—this blood-red coloured (face) with three licking tongues, is the Treta Yuga, O Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: मयि योनौ समायुकतं तद्बीजं कालपयंयात् । हिरण्ययमपारं तदथ्योन्यासण्डमजायत
verses.wordMeaning: "This white face of his, seen with four tongues, is the face of Kala and is called Krta Yuga. This god Brahma, the most excellent among gods, and Vaivasvata is (this) face. What I called the third—this blood-red coloured (face) with three licking tongues, is the Treta Yuga,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "This white face of his, seen with four tongues, is the face of Kala and is called Krta Yuga. This god Brahma, the most excellent among gods, and Vaivasvata is (this) face. verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठते गतमर्यादो गतप्राण इव क्षणात् । तावत्सुरपतिर्देवः शशापाथाजितेन्द्रियम्
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhate gatamaryādo gataprāṇa iva kṣaṇāt / tāvatsurapatirdevaḥ śaśāpāthājitendriyam
verses.translation: In this age the institution of sacrifice is initiated from great Lord Siva and is worshipped in this age. The three tongues are the three fires (Garhapatya, Ahavanlya and Daksina). After worshipping the fires, O Brahmanas, the tongue of Kala begins to function. This fourth face of black colour and red eyes, the single-tongued, dark and huge, licking like a serpent again and again, is the terrible Kali age. It is terrifying to all the worlds. It is the fourth terrible face of the Kala.
verses.hindi: शतानि दशवर्षाणासष्ड चाप्सु प्रतिष्ठितम् । अन्ते क्षेंसहर्नस्यथ वायुना तदिद्वधाकृतम् ७४ कपालमेक थौज॑ज्ञे कपालमपरं क्षितिः  उल्बं तस्य महोत्सेधं योडसो कनकपबंत:ः ७५
verses.wordMeaning: In this age the institution of sacrifice is initiated from great Lord Siva and is worshipped in this age. The three tongues are the three fires (Garhapatya, Ahavanlya and Daksina). After worshipping the fires, O Brahmanas, the tongue of Kala begins to function.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In this age the institution of sacrifice is initiated from great Lord Siva and is worshipped in this age. The three tongues are the three fires (Garhapatya, Ahavanlya and Daksina). After worshipping the fires, O Brahmanas, the tongue of Kala begins to function.…

verses.transliteration: yasmāt tvaṃ svargasaṃstho 'pi martyadharmam upeyivān / tasmān martye ciraṃ kālaṃ kṣapayiṣyasyasaṃśayam

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः सुरेन्द्रेण चित्रसेनसुतो युवा । वेपमानः सुरश्रेष्ठः कृताञ्जलिरुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ surendreṇa citrasenasuto yuvā / vepamānaḥ suraśreṣṭhaḥ kṛtāñjaliruvāca ha
verses.translation: Dvapara... Brahma shall be worshipped in the Krta age; in the Treta, it is sacrifice; Visnu inDvapara; and I in all the four ages.
verses.hindi: विष्णु से बोले आप योनि हैं, मैं बीज हूँ और महेश्वर बीजी ( बीज बोने काले ) हैं. यह कंसे ? आप मेरे इस सूक्ष्म, अभथ्यक्त सन्देह को अवश्य दूर करें ।६७-६८। लोकश्ासक ब्रह्मा ने लोकसृष्टि सम्बन्धी बातों को जान कर भी इस प्रकार का सन्देह युक्त प्रश्न पूछा जिसको सुतकर भगवान् हरि ने उत्तर विया कि, 'इस महेश्बर से बढ़कर रहस्यमय दूसरा कोई भूत नहीं हैं। महान् से महान और अध्यात्मवादियों के ये परम
verses.wordMeaning: Dvapara... Brahma shall be worshipped in the Krta age; in the Treta, it is sacrifice; Visnu inDvapara; and I in all the four ages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dvapara... Brahma shall be worshipped in the Krta age; in the Treta, it is sacrifice; Visnu inDvapara; and I in all the four ages.

verses.sanskrit: पत्त्रेश्वर उवाच: मया पापेन मूढेन अजितेन्द्रियचेतसा । प्राप्तं वै यत्फलं तस्य प्रसादं कर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: pattreśvara uvāca: mayā pāpena mūḍhena ajitendriyacetasā / prāptaṃ vai yatphalaṃ tasya prasādaṃ kartum arhasi
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and sacrifice are the three parts of Kala itself. But in all ages, the four-formed great Lord is the very Kala itself. I am the progenitor of Kala, the initiator of Kala.
verses.hindi: प्राप्य पद हैं ।६९-७०। ये दो रूपों से आत्मा में प्रविष्ट होकर स्थित हैं, ये एक रूप में निष्कल, सूक्ष्म, अव्यक्त और दूसरे रूप में सकल ओर महेद्वर हैं। इस मायाविधिज्ञ, अविज्ञेयगति का पुर्बकाल में एक लिंग आदि सरगग के लिये ब्रह्मा रूपी बीज के सहित प्रकट हुआ। कालक्रम से मुझ सनातन योनि में वह बीज प्रविष्ट हुआ । उस योनि में वह बीज विशाल सुवर्णमय अण्ड के रूप में परिणत हो गया । वह अण्ड एक हजार वर्ष
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and sacrifice are the three parts of Kala itself. But in all ages, the four-formed great Lord is the very Kala itself. I am the progenitor of Kala, the initiator of Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and sacrifice are the three parts of Kala itself. But in all ages, the four-formed great Lord is the very Kala itself. I am the progenitor of Kala, the initiator of Kala.

verses.sanskrit: शक्र उवाच: नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य द्वादशाब्दं जितेन्द्रियः । आराधय शिवं शान्तं पुनः प्राप्स्यसि सद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: śakra uvāca: narmadātaṭamāśritya dvādaśābdaṃ jitendriyaḥ / ārādhaya śivaṃ śāntaṃ punaḥ prāpsyasi sadgatim
verses.translation: O Excellent Devas of great power, you need not Thus addressed, Devas and the sages bowed to the Lord of the universe with bent heads. They spoke to him again.
verses.hindi: तक जल पर स्थित रहा  हजारवं वर्ष के अन्त में वायु के द्वारा वह दो भागों में विभक्त हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: O Excellent Devas of great power, you need not Thus addressed, Devas and the sages bowed to the Lord of the universe with bent heads. They spoke to him again.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Excellent Devas of great power, you need not Thus addressed, Devas and the sages bowed to the Lord of the universe with bent heads. They spoke to him again.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यशौचरतानां च धर्मिष्ठानां जितात्मनाम् । लोकोऽयं पापिनां नैव इति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: satyaśaucaratānāṃ ca dharmiṣṭhānāṃ jitātmanām / loko'yaṃ pāpināṃ naiva iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ
verses.translation: How is this K5la, of great splendour, huge body, great prowess and four faces terrible to living beings? "This Kala has four forms, four fangs and four faces. For protecting the universe, he goes beyond, on all sides.
verses.hindi: उसके एक टुकड़े से स्वर्ग और दूसरे से पृथ्वी उत्पन्न हुई। उस अण्ड कपाल का जो विशाल, ऊँचा उल्ब ( आवरण ) था, उससे कनकाचल बना ।७५। तत्पश्चात् उसमें से देवाधिदेव, प्रबुद्धात्मा, प्रभु हिरण्यगर्भ और

verses.transliteration: evamukte mahārāja sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā / gandharvatanayo dhīmānpraṇamyāgāttu bhūtalam
verses.translation: All are subject to the control of Kala. Kala is not bekTs 1 t0 any ° ne ' Kila alwa 7 s reckons (controls) all living Hence in the Kali age, a Brahmana should perform penance strenuously. The fruit of the merit of a person resor¬ ting to the great Lord is very great. Hence abandoning the heaven and descending to the earth at the advent of the terrible Kali, Devas and the sages desire to perform penance. They are engrossed in holy rites. The Lord too takes incarnation frequ¬ ently in the Kali age.

verses.sanskrit: रेवाया विमले तोये ब्रह्मावर्तसमीपतः । स्नात्वा जप्त्वा विधानेन अर्चयित्वा च शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: revāyā vimale toye brahmāvartasamīpataḥ / snātvā japtvā vidhānena arcayitvā ca śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Thousands of Devas, saints and kings have passed away in course of time, in Vaivasvata Manvantara. Devapi, the king in the race of Puru, Manu and his descendants in the family of Iksvaku are endowed with great Yogic strength. They wait for the change in Kala. When the Kali age terminates, and Treta Yuga arrives, in that future Treta Yuga along with the seven sages, the gotras of Ksattriyas will be established. They are narrated.
verses.hindi: (ततो वर्षसहस्रान्ते वायुना तद्द्विधा क्तम् । ) अताराकंन्दुनक्षत्र शून्यं लोकमवेक्ष्य च॥ कोपमन्रेत्यभिध्याते कुमारास्ते5भव॑स्तदा ७७
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands of Devas, saints and kings have passed away in course of time, in Vaivasvata Manvantara. Devapi, the king in the race of Puru, Manu and his descendants in the family of Iksvaku are endowed with great Yogic strength. They wait for the change in Kala.…

verses.sanskrit: वाय्वम्बुपिण्याकफलैश्च पुष्पैः पर्णैश्च मूलाशनयावकेन । तताप पञ्चाग्नितपोभिर् उग्रैस्ततश्च तोषं समगात् स देवः
verses.transliteration: vāyvambupiṇyākaphalaiśca puṣpaiḥ parṇaiśca mūlāśanayāvakena / tatāpa pañcāgnitapobhir ugraistataśca toṣaṃ samagāt sa devaḥ
verses.translation: The Ksattriyas become firmly established at the end of Dvapara, along with the sages. When Krta, Treta and Dvapara pass away, the Kali age arrives, wherein sinful men pass their time. Srutis and Smrtis record the (completion and) passing away of the seven Manvantaras. The serial order of the termin¬ ation of yugas is the same in all these.
verses.hindi: भुवनानलसंकाशा: पदुमपत्रायतेक्षणा: ७८
verses.wordMeaning: The Ksattriyas become firmly established at the end of Dvapara, along with the sages. When Krta, Treta and Dvapara pass away, the Kali age arrives, wherein sinful men pass their time. Srutis and Smrtis record the (completion and) passing away of the seven Manvantaras.…

verses.translation: The rise of Brahmanas and Ksatriyas is mutual along with that of the Yugas. Just as they come into existence from them, those that have come into being pass away along with When the Ksattriyas were exterminated by Rama, son

verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te varado 'haṃ tavānagha / yamicchasi dadāmyadya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā

verses.sanskrit: पत्त्रेश्वर उवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम । अत्र त्वं सततं तीर्थे मम नाम्ना भव प्रभो
verses.transliteration: pattreśvara uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama / atra tvaṃ satataṃ tīrthe mama nāmnā bhava prabho
verses.translation: Ikjvaku kings were born in the race of Aila; full hundred kings of that family were crowned; the extent of the Bhoja family of kings is twice that number. There were three hundred Ksattriya kings divided into four lines as I have already mentioned (?)
verses.hindi: स्वप्नभूतं पुनः स्वर्ग दुःखानि नरकास्तथा। विदित्वा चाइ5गर्म सर्वभमवश्यं भवितव्यताम् ८२ ऋणभुं सनत्कुमारं थ दृष्ट्शा तव वशे स्थितो। त्रयस्तु त्रीन्गुणान्हित्वा आत्मजा: सनकादयः 4
verses.wordMeaning: Ikjvaku kings were born in the race of Aila; full hundred kings of that family were crowned; the extent of the Bhoja family of kings is twice that number. There were three hundred Ksattriya kings divided into four lines as I have already mentioned (?)

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महादेवो हर्षगद्गदया गिरा । तथेत्युक्त्वा ययौ हृष्ट उमया सह शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā mahādevo harṣagadgadayā girā / tathetyuktvā yayau hṛṣṭa umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Now hear about the kings that have gone before, as I mention about them. There were a hundred Prativindhyas, 1 a hundred Haihayas, a hundred Dhartarastras, eighty Jana- mejayas, a hundred families of very powerful kings. There were a hundred Paulas; Kasi, Kusa and others were a hundred. Sasabindus who have gone, constitute a thousand. These performed horse-sacrifices wherein thousands 'and thousands (of gold coins) were given as gifts.
verses.hindi: ततस्सेष्वप्रवत्तेषु सनकादिषु वे तजतिधु । भविष्यसि विमृढस्तु मायया शंकरस्य तु दा
verses.wordMeaning: Now hear about the kings that have gone before, as I mention about them. There were a hundred Prativindhyas, 1 a hundred Haihayas, a hundred Dhartarastras, eighty Jana- mejayas, a hundred families of very powerful kings. There were a hundred Paulas; Kasi,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Now hear about the kings that have gone before, as I mention about them. There were a hundred Prativindhyas, 1 a hundred Haihayas, a hundred Dhartarastras, eighty Jana- mejayas, a hundred families of very powerful kings. There were a hundred Paulas; Kasi,…

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि तत्तीर्थम् आप्लुत्य गते देवे दिवं प्रति । स्नात्वा जाप्यविधानेन तर्पयित्वा पित्ःन् पुनः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi tattīrtham āplutya gate deve divaṃ prati / snātvā jāpyavidhānena tarpayitvā pitḥn punaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, all the saintly kings who passed away in the previous Yugas, have been mentioned briefly. They cannot be mentioned in detail.
verses.hindi: ।नरकनमरनिनली----++ ०" कनल-त-कीनता तक कलन ५
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, all the saintly kings who passed away in the previous Yugas, have been mentioned briefly. They cannot be mentioned in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, all the saintly kings who passed away in the previous Yugas, have been mentioned briefly. They cannot be mentioned in detail.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयामास देवेशं तस्मिंस् तीर्थे विधानतः । पत्त्रेश्वरं तु विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत
verses.transliteration: sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ tasmiṃs tīrthe vidhānataḥ / pattreśvaraṃ tu vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhārata
verses.translation: These have made the race of Yayati flourish. Sustaining the worlds, these have been glorified as lustrous. Those who hear and retain in memory their account get the five rare boons of Brahmaloka, viz. longevity, sons, wealth, fame and prosperity and they go to the region of Brahma.
verses.hindi: चतुर्भुज भगवान् विष्णु प्रगट हुमे  तारा, नक्षत्र, सूय और चन्द्रमा से शुन्ब लोक को देखकर “यह क्या है' ऐसा आप सोचने लगे । उसी समय आपको कतिपय कुमार उत्पन्न हुये ।७६-७७। अतीत कल्प में पहले जो आपके प्रिय पुत्र उत्पन्न हुये थे वे ही पुनः सहस्न वर्ष के अस्त में आपके पुत्र हुमे, जो अग्नि के समान तेजस्वी और जिनके नेत्र कमल के समान घिश्ञाल थे ।७८। उनमें श्रीमान् सनत कुमार और ऋतु ऊद्ध वरेता थे। सनातन,
verses.wordMeaning: These have made the race of Yayati flourish. Sustaining the worlds, these have been glorified as lustrous. Those who hear and retain in memory their account get the five rare boons of Brahmaloka, viz. longevity, sons, wealth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These have made the race of Yayati flourish. Sustaining the worlds, these have been glorified as lustrous. Those who hear and retain in memory their account get the five rare boons of Brahmaloka, viz. longevity, sons, wealth,…

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रलोकं गतः शापान्मुक्तः सो ऽपि नरेश्वर । हृष्टः प्रमुदितो रम्यं जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः
verses.transliteration: indralokaṃ gataḥ śāpānmuktaḥ so 'pi nareśvara / hṛṣṭaḥ pramudito ramyaṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ
verses.translation: Four thousand years, they say, constitute the Krta Yuga. 2 Four hundred years constitute Sandhya (transitional period) and four hundred years the part of Sandhya (Sandhyamsa).
verses.hindi: सनक ओर सचन्दन भी उसी समय उत्पन्न हुये जो कि अपनी मेधा के प्रभाव से सुक्ष्मदर्शी हो गये ।७६। उत्पन्न होते ही उन कुमारों ने कहा हम कोई भी काय नही करेंगे हम तीनों प्रकार के ताप से पृथक् रह कर आत्मज्ञ बनेगे' क्योंकि इस बुढ़ापा और शोक ग्रस्त जीवन में सुख बहुत कम और क्लेश ही अधिक है, साथ ही जीवन मरण और पुनज॑न्म का मोरखब्नन्धा भी लगा है।६०-८१। जीवन में स्वगे-सुख स्वप्न है केवल
verses.wordMeaning: Four thousand years, they say, constitute the Krta Yuga. 2 Four hundred years constitute Sandhya (transitional period) and four hundred years the part of Sandhya (Sandhyamsa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Four thousand years, they say, constitute the Krta Yuga. 2 Four hundred years constitute Sandhya (transitional period) and four hundred years the part of Sandhya (Sandhyamsa).

verses.sanskrit: एष ते कथितः प्रश्नः पृष्टो यो वै युधिष्ठिर । तत्र स्नानेन चैकेन सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: eṣa te kathitaḥ praśnaḥ pṛṣṭo yo vai yudhiṣṭhira / tatra snānena caikena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: The Krta yuga, the Prakriyapada (the preliminary period) consists of four thousand years. Out of it, four hundred years constitute the transitional period (at the beginning and at the end of the yuga). Treta age, the Anusahgapada (of the Catuiyugi) consists of three thousand years and two thousand years period is pro¬ claimed for Dvapara Age.
verses.hindi: नरक और दुख का ही भोग करना है। इस प्रकार उन कुमारों को समस्त आगमम और अवश्यम्भावी भविष्य का ज्ञान था। ऋभ और सनत्कुमार को आपके वश में देखकर सनक आदि आपके तेजस्वी पूत्र
verses.wordMeaning: The Krta yuga, the Prakriyapada (the preliminary period) consists of four thousand years. Out of it, four hundred years constitute the transitional period (at the beginning and at the end of the yuga). Treta age,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Krta yuga, the Prakriyapada (the preliminary period) consists of four thousand years. Out of it, four hundred years constitute the transitional period (at the beginning and at the end of the yuga). Treta age,…

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वर्चयेन्महादेवं तस्मिंस्तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर । स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य पित्ःन् देवान् सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: yastvarcayenmahādevaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe yudhiṣṭhira / snātvābhyarcya pitḥn devān so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Persons expert in calculation opine one thousand years (as the period) of Kali age. Its Sandhya period is of hundred years and SandhySrfiia period is also of a hundred years.
verses.hindi: परम ज्ञान के कारण सृष्टि कर्म से विमुख हो गये ।5२-८५३। उमर समय इस प्रकार अपने पुत्रों को निवृत्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Persons expert in calculation opine one thousand years (as the period) of Kali age. Its Sandhya period is of hundred years and SandhySrfiia period is also of a hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons expert in calculation opine one thousand years (as the period) of Kali age. Its Sandhya period is of hundred years and SandhySrfiia period is also of a hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: मृतो वर्षशतं साग्रं क्रीडित्वा च शिवे पुरे । राजा वा राजतुल्यो वा पश्चान्मर्त्येषु जायते
verses.transliteration: mṛto varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ krīḍitvā ca śive pure / rājā vā rājatulyo vā paścānmartyeṣu jāyate
verses.translation: The fourth, Samhara (Upa-sariihara) pada, is stated to be in Kali Age. Four Yugas have (each of them) the twilight and transitional periods. (This totals upto twelve thousand.) Thus learned men knew that this Purana (also) consists of twelve thousand verses.
verses.hindi: के इंदमर्ध नास्ति ख. गे घ॒पुस्तकेष ।
verses.wordMeaning: The fourth, Samhara (Upa-sariihara) pada, is stated to be in Kali Age. Four Yugas have (each of them) the twilight and transitional periods. (This totals upto twelve thousand.) Thus learned men knew that this Purana (also) consists of twelve thousand verses.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fourth, Samhara (Upa-sariihara) pada, is stated to be in Kali Age. Four Yugas have (each of them) the twilight and transitional periods. (This totals upto twelve thousand.) Thus learned men knew that this Purana (also) consists of twelve thousand verses.

verses.sanskrit: वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो जीवेच्च शरदः शतम् । व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तः पुनः स्मरति तज्जलम्
verses.transliteration: vedavedāṅgatattvajño jīvecca śaradaḥ śatam / vyādhiśokavinirmuktaḥ punaḥ smarati tajjalam
verses.translation: Just as Vedas are divided into four Padas, a Yuga also has four Padas. Just as god Brahma ordained a Yuga to consist of four parts (feet), so he has ordained four parts (Padas-feet) to this Purana* as well.
verses.hindi: सा चेषा हां श्वरी माया जगतः समुदाहृता । स एष पर्वतो मेरुदेवलोकों हा दाहुतः ८६ तवेबेदं हि माहात्म्यं दृष्ट्वा चाउउ्मानमात्मना । ज्ञात्वा चेश्वरसद्भावं ज्ञात्वा मामम्बुजेक्षणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Just as Vedas are divided into four Padas, a Yuga also has four Padas. Just as god Brahma ordained a Yuga to consist of four parts (feet), so he has ordained four parts (Padas-feet) to this Purana* as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as Vedas are divided into four Padas, a Yuga also has four Padas. Just as god Brahma ordained a Yuga to consist of four parts (feet), so he has ordained four parts (Padas-feet) to this Purana* as well.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पत्रेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ३३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र अग्नितीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यत्र संनिहितो ह्यग्निर्गतः कामेन मोहितः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe patreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 33 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra agnitīrthamanuttamam / yatra saṃnihito hyagnirgataḥ kāmena mohitaḥ
verses.translation: In all the Manvantaras of the past and future, equallv identical persons, all of the same names and forms, are born. *
verses.hindi: महादेव महायोगं भुतानां वरदं प्रभु । प्रणवात्मानमासाद्य नमस्कृत्वा( त्य )जगदुगुरुम् ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: In all the Manvantaras of the past and future, equallv identical persons, all of the same names and forms, are born. *
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the Manvantaras of the past and future, equallv identical persons, all of the same names and forms, are born. *

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं देवो जगद्धाता कामेन कलुषीकृतः । कथं च नित्यदा वास एकस्थानेषु जायते
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ devo jagaddhātā kāmena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ / kathaṃ ca nityadā vāsa ekasthāneṣu jāyate
verses.translation: The creation of great sages has been narrated. Now ow an understand the family of Svayambhuva Manu being
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणमग्रतः कृत्वा ततः स गरुडध्वज: । अतीतेश्व भविष्येश्व वर्तमानस्तथब च ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of great sages has been narrated. Now ow an understand the family of Svayambhuva Manu being
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of great sages has been narrated. Now ow an understand the family of Svayambhuva Manu being
