verses.sanskrit: आसीत्कृतयुगे राजा नाम्ना दुर्योधनो महान् । हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पूर्णो मेदिनीपरिपालकः
verses.transliteration: āsītkṛtayuge rājā nāmnā duryodhano mahān / hastyaśvarathasampūrṇo medinīparipālakaḥ
verses.translation: Priyavrata crowned seven of them with due religious rites as kings over the seven continents. 1
verses.hindi: मार्ग की ओर उन्‍्मुख होते देखकर आप शंकर की माया के प्रभाव से मोहित हो गये। अनघ इसी प्रकार प्रत्येक कल्प में आपकी चेतना शक्ति लुप्त हो जाती है। कल्प के बीत जाने पर सब पार्थिव पदार्थ सूक्ष्म रूप में स्थित रहते हैं ।८४-८५। यही इस संसार ईश्वरीय माया कही जाती है । यह मेरु पंत ही देवलोंक कहा जाता है। यह सब कुछ आपका ही माहात्म्य है। अब आप स्वयं अपनी महत्ता को पहचाने, ईश्वर की स्थित,
verses.wordMeaning: Priyavrata crowned seven of them with due religious rites as kings over the seven continents. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Priyavrata crowned seven of them with due religious rites as kings over the seven continents. 1

verses.sanskrit: रूपयौवनसम्पन्नं दृष्ट्वा तं पृथिवीपतिम् । दिव्योपभोगसम्पन्नं प्रार्थयामास नर्मदा
verses.transliteration: rūpayauvanasampannaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ pṛthivīpatim / divyopabhogasampannaṃ prārthayāmāsa narmadā
verses.translation: He made Agnldhra the powerful lord over Jambudvipa and he made Medhatithi king of Plaksa Dvlpa.
verses.hindi: कमलनयन मुझको, ( विष्णु को ) महादेव महायोग, प्राणियों के वरद ता प्रभु, प्रणवात्मा महादेव को भली भाँति जानकर इस जगद््गुरु का नमस्कार कीजिये । नहीं तो ऋद्ध होकर ये महादेव एक ही साँस में हम दोनों को जला देंगे। महाबल ! इस रहस्य को जान ऋर अब आप उठिये, मैं आपको आगे करके अग्नि के समान तेजस्वी झंकर की स्तुति करूँगा
verses.wordMeaning: He made Agnldhra the powerful lord over Jambudvipa and he made Medhatithi king of Plaksa Dvlpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Agnldhra the powerful lord over Jambudvipa and he made Medhatithi king of Plaksa Dvlpa.

verses.sanskrit: स तु तां चकमे कन्यां त्यक्त्वा ऽन्यं प्रमदाजनम् । मुदा परमया युक्तो माहिष्मत्याः पतिर्नृप
verses.transliteration: sa tu tāṃ cakame kanyāṃ tyaktvā 'nyaṃ pramadājanam / mudā paramayā yukto māhiṣmatyāḥ patirnṛpa
verses.translation: In the Salmali continent, he crowned Vapusmat as the king. He made Jyotismat ruler over Kusa Dvlpa.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले-- इस प्रकार ब्रह्य को आगे कर गरुड़ध्वज विष्णु ने अतीत, भविष्य और वतंमान के नामों तथा विविध वैदिक ऋचाओों द्वारा इस स्तोत्र को कहा ।६०। “आप भगवान् सुत्रत और अनन्त तेज- वाले हैं आपको नमस्कार है। आप क्षेत्राधिपति बीजी और शुलधारी हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप लिज्- रहित, ऊर्ड बलिज्ज, और वैकुण्टरेता हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप ज्येष्ठ, श्रेष्ठ, अपूवे और प्रथम हैं भाप
verses.wordMeaning: In the Salmali continent, he crowned Vapusmat as the king. He made Jyotismat ruler over Kusa Dvlpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Salmali continent, he crowned Vapusmat as the king. He made Jyotismat ruler over Kusa Dvlpa.

verses.sanskrit: रमते स तया सार्द्धं काले वै नृपसत्तम । नर्मदा जनयामास कन्यां पद्मदलेक्षणाम्
verses.transliteration: ramate sa tayā sārddhaṃ kāle vai nṛpasattama / narmadā janayāmāsa kanyāṃ padmadalekṣaṇām
verses.translation: He granted Dyutiman the kingdom of Kraunca Dvlpa. He made Havya lord over Saka Dvlpa.
verses.hindi: को नमस्कार है ।६१-९२। आप हृव्य, पुज्य और सद्योजात हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप गह्र ( शद्धुर )
verses.wordMeaning: He granted Dyutiman the kingdom of Kraunca Dvlpa. He made Havya lord over Saka Dvlpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He granted Dyutiman the kingdom of Kraunca Dvlpa. He made Havya lord over Saka Dvlpa.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसम्पन्ना यस्माल्लोकेषु विश्रुता । तस्यां पिता च माता च चक्रतुः प्रेमबन्धनम्
verses.transliteration: aṅgapratyaṅgasampannā yasmāllokeṣu viśrutā / tasyāṃ pitā ca mātā ca cakratuḥ premabandhanam
verses.translation: He made Savana the overlord of Puskara. In Puskara Dvipa, Savana had two sons Mahavlta and Dhataki. These two sons were excellent among persons endowed with sons.
verses.hindi: घनुश्चिह्वान्तर्गतग्रन्थो ग. पुस्तके नास्ति।
verses.wordMeaning: He made Savana the overlord of Puskara. In Puskara Dvipa, Savana had two sons Mahavlta and Dhataki. These two sons were excellent among persons endowed with sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Savana the overlord of Puskara. In Puskara Dvipa, Savana had two sons Mahavlta and Dhataki. These two sons were excellent among persons endowed with sons.

verses.sanskrit: कालेनातिसुदीर्घेण यौवनस्था वराङ्गना । प्रार्थ्यमानापि राजन्वै नात्मानं दातुमिच्छति
verses.transliteration: kālenātisudīrgheṇa yauvanasthā varāṅganā / prārthyamānāpi rājanvai nātmānaṃ dātumicchati
verses.translation: In honour of the name of the noble soul, that continent (sub-Varsa) [is known] as Mahavlta. The subcontinent Dhataki Khanda is called after the name Dhataki. 2
verses.hindi: नमस्ते ह्ास्मदादीनां भुतानां प्रभवाय व । वेदकर्मावदातानां द्रब्याणां प्रभवे नमः
verses.wordMeaning: In honour of the name of the noble soul, that continent (sub-Varsa) [is known] as Mahavlta. The subcontinent Dhataki Khanda is called after the name Dhataki. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: In honour of the name of the noble soul, that continent (sub-Varsa) [is known] as Mahavlta. The subcontinent Dhataki Khanda is called after the name Dhataki. 2

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽन्यदिवसे वह्निर्द्विजरूपो महातपाः । राजानं प्रार्थयामास रहो गत्वा शनैः शनैः
verses.transliteration: tato 'nyadivase vahnirdvijarūpo mahātapāḥ / rājānaṃ prārthayāmāsa raho gatvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: King Havya begot (seven) sons as the rulers of Saka- dvipa. They were Jalada, Kumara, Sukumara, Manicaka, Vasu- moda, Sumodaka and the seventh son Mahadruma. 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 10
verses.hindi: नमश्रोषधिप्रभवे वक्षाणां प्रभवे नमः । धर्माध्यक्षाय धर्माय स्थितीनां प्रभवे नमः
verses.wordMeaning: King Havya begot (seven) sons as the rulers of Saka- dvipa. They were Jalada, Kumara, Sukumara, Manicaka, Vasu- moda, Sumodaka and the seventh son Mahadruma. 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 10
verses.commentary: Sense: King Havya begot (seven) sons as the rulers of Saka- dvipa. They were Jalada, Kumara, Sukumara, Manicaka, Vasu- moda, Sumodaka and the seventh son Mahadruma. 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 10

verses.sanskrit: भोभो रघुकुलश्रेष्ठ द्विजोऽहं मन्दसन्ततिः । दरिद्रो ह्य् असहायश्च भार्यार्थे वरयामि ताम्
verses.transliteration: bhobho raghukulaśreṣṭha dvijo'haṃ mandasantatiḥ / daridro hy asahāyaśca bhāryārthe varayāmi tām
verses.translation: The first sub-continent or country of ( = governed by) Jalada is called Jalada; the second of (= ruled by) Kumara is glorified as Kaumara.
verses.hindi: निर्मेषप्र भवे चव काए्ठानां प्रभवे नमः । अहो राज्ाधंमासानां मासानां प्रभवे नमः ११००
verses.wordMeaning: The first sub-continent or country of ( = governed by) Jalada is called Jalada; the second of (= ruled by) Kumara is glorified as Kaumara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first sub-continent or country of ( = governed by) Jalada is called Jalada; the second of (= ruled by) Kumara is glorified as Kaumara.

verses.sanskrit: कन्या सुदर्शना नाम रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि । तां ददस्व महाभाग वर्धते तव मन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: kanyā sudarśanā nāma rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi / tāṃ dadasva mahābhāga vardhate tava mandire
verses.translation: The third sub-continent of Sukumara is known as Sukumara and the fourth of Manicaka is called Manicaka.
verses.hindi: नमः पुराणप्रभवे युगस्य प्रभवे नमः  चतुविधस्य सर्गेस्य प्रभवेषनन्तचक्ष षे
verses.wordMeaning: The third sub-continent of Sukumara is known as Sukumara and the fourth of Manicaka is called Manicaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The third sub-continent of Sukumara is known as Sukumara and the fourth of Manicaka is called Manicaka.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्येण निर्विण्ण एकाकी कामपीडितः । याचमानस्य मे तात प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryeṇa nirviṇṇa ekākī kāmapīḍitaḥ / yācamānasya me tāta prasādaṃ kartumarhasi
verses.translation: The division of the earth among the sons of Priyavrata is as follows:
verses.hindi: कल्पोदयनिबद्धानां वर्तानां प्रभवे नमः । नमो विश्वस्य प्रभवे ब्रह्मादिप्रभवे नमः
verses.wordMeaning: The division of the earth among the sons of Priyavrata is as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: The division of the earth among the sons of Priyavrata is as follows:

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच: नाहं द्रव्यविहीनस्य असवर्णस्य कर्हिचित् । दास्यामि स्वां सुतां शुभ्रां गम्यतां द्विजपुंगव
verses.transliteration: rājovāca: nāhaṃ dravyavihīnasya asavarṇasya karhicit / dāsyāmi svāṃ sutāṃ śubhrāṃ gamyatāṃ dvijapuṃgava
verses.translation: Agnldhra Vapusmat
verses.hindi: धनेश और स्वर्ण चीराम्बरधारी हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप हम क्रूतों के प्रभभ ओर वेदकर्मा के समान शुभ द्रब्यों के प्रभु हैं, आपको नमस्कार है ' आप ग्रहों और ताराओं के प्रभु हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप योग के प्रभु, सांख्य के प्र; एवं धभ्रूव और निशीथ आदि ऋषियों के पति हैं, आपको नमस्कार है।€३-६५॥ आप विद्युत्. वज् मेघ और गजन के जनक हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप समुद्र और हीपों के प्रभु हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: Agnldhra Vapusmat
verses.commentary: Sense: Agnldhra Vapusmat

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तदा वह्निः परां पीडाम् उपागतः । न किंचिद् उक्त्वा राजानं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: evamuktastadā vahniḥ parāṃ pīḍām upāgataḥ / na kiṃcid uktvā rājānaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: Medhatithi
verses.hindi: आपको नमस्कार है। आप पव॑त और वर्षा के प्रभव हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप नद और नदी के उत्पत्ति- स्थान हैं, आपकों नमस्कार है। आप औषधि और वक्षों के उत्पादक है, आपको नमस्कार है। आप रस और सम्पूर्ण रत्नों के उत्पादक हैं, आपको नमस्कार है ! आप धर्माध्यक्ष ध्मं और स्थिति के प्रभु हैं, आपको नमस्कार है ।:६-६८०३। आप क्षण कला, निमेष, काष्ठा, भहोरात्र, अर्द्धमास और मास के, प्रभव हैं, आप-

verses.sanskrit: गते चादर्शनं विप्रे राजा मन्त्रिपुरोहितैः । मन्त्रयित्वाथ काले तु तुष्टो मखमुखे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: gate cādarśanaṃ vipre rājā mantripurohitaiḥ / mantrayitvātha kāle tu tuṣṭo makhamukhe sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Jyotismat Dyutimat
verses.hindi: को नमस्कार है। आप ऋतु और परा-परार्द्ध आदि संख्या के सृष्टिकर्ता हैं, अःपको नमस्कार है, आप पुराण, युग और चतुविधि सगे के जनक हैं, आप अनन्तचक्ष हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप कल्पादि से संबद्ध घटनाओं के कारण हैं, आप विश्व और ब्रह्मादि के भी जनक हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप विद्या के आदि कारण और विद्या के पति हैं, भापकोी नमस्कार है। आप ब्रतों और मन्सत्रों के पति हैं, आपको नमस्कार
verses.wordMeaning: Jyotismat Dyutimat
verses.commentary: Sense: Jyotismat Dyutimat

verses.sanskrit: यजतश्च मखे भक्त्या ब्राह्मणैः सह भारत । ततश्चादर्शनं वह्निः सर्वेषां पश्यतामगात्
verses.transliteration: yajataśca makhe bhaktyā brāhmaṇaiḥ saha bhārata / tataścādarśanaṃ vahniḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāmagāt
verses.translation: The Sub-Divisions of Puskara Dvipa.
verses.hindi: + इदमर्ख क. ख. ग. पुस्तकेष नाध्ति ।  धनुर्चिल्लान्तगंतग्रन्थो ड.. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Sub-Divisions of Puskara Dvipa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sub-Divisions of Puskara Dvipa.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रा दुर्मनसो भूत्वा गता राज्ञो हि मन्दिरम् । वह्निनाशं विमनसो राजानम् इदम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: viprā durmanaso bhūtvā gatā rājño hi mandiram / vahnināśaṃ vimanaso rājānam idam abruvan
verses.translation: Verses 16-20 enumerate the Sub-Divisions of Saka Dvipa, each named after the seven sons of Hawa. The fifth Varsa of Vasumoda is called Vasumodaka and the sixth of Modaka, is glorified as Modaka.
verses.hindi: पितुणां पतये चव पशूनां पतये नमः । वाग्वुषाय नमस्तुभ्यं पुराणवुषभाय च॑
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 16-20 enumerate the Sub-Divisions of Saka Dvipa, each named after the seven sons of Hawa. The fifth Varsa of Vasumoda is called Vasumodaka and the sixth of Modaka, is glorified as Modaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 16-20 enumerate the Sub-Divisions of Saka Dvipa, each named after the seven sons of Hawa. The fifth Varsa of Vasumoda is called Vasumodaka and the sixth of Modaka, is glorified as Modaka.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः । दुर्योधन महाराज श्रूयतां महदद्भुतम् । न श्रुतं न च दृष्टं वा कौतुकं नृपपुंगव
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ / duryodhana mahārāja śrūyatāṃ mahadadbhutam / na śrutaṃ na ca dṛṣṭaṃ vā kautukaṃ nṛpapuṃgava
verses.translation: The seventh of Mahadruma is named Mahadruma. All the seven countries were thus named after them.
verses.hindi: सुचारुचारुकेशाय ऊध्वेचक्षु:शिराय च। नमः पशुनां पतये गोवुषेन्द्रध्वजाय च ११०६
verses.wordMeaning: The seventh of Mahadruma is named Mahadruma. All the seven countries were thus named after them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seventh of Mahadruma is named Mahadruma. All the seven countries were thus named after them.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निकार्यप्रवृत्तानां सर्वेषां विधिवन्नृप । केनापि हेतुना वह्निर्दृश्यते न ज्वलत्युत
verses.transliteration: agnikāryapravṛttānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidhivannṛpa / kenāpi hetunā vahnirdṛśyate na jvalatyuta
verses.translation: The splendid regions situated in Kraunca Dvipa were called after the names of these (sons). The land* of XJsna is remembered as Usna and that of Pi vara, Pivara. Andhakaraka's land was called Andhakara, that of Muni was Muni and that of Dundubhi, Dundubhi. These seven flourishing lands were situated in Kraunca Dvipa.
verses.hindi: गोकर्णाय च॒ गोष्ठाय शडकुकर्णाय वे नमः । वराहायाप्रमेवाय रक्षोधिपतये नमः १०६९
verses.wordMeaning: The splendid regions situated in Kraunca Dvipa were called after the names of these (sons). The land* of XJsna is remembered as Usna and that of Pi vara, Pivara. Andhakaraka's land was called Andhakara, that of Muni was Muni and that of Dundubhi, Dundubhi.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The splendid regions situated in Kraunca Dvipa were called after the names of these (sons). The land* of XJsna is remembered as Usna and that of Pi vara, Pivara. Andhakaraka's land was called Andhakara, that of Muni was Muni and that of Dundubhi, Dundubhi.…

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा विप्रियं घोरं राजा विप्रमुखाच्च्युतम् । आसनात्पतितो भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā vipriyaṃ ghoraṃ rājā vipramukhāccyutam / āsanātpatito bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ
verses.translation: These seven sons of great strength were born to Jyotismat in Kus'a Dvipa. These were Udbhida, Venumat, Svairatha, Lavana, Dhrti, the sixth son Prabhakara and the seventh Kapila. 2
verses.hindi: दोर्धशूडगेकशूडुगाय वृषभाय ककुद्भिने । नमः स्थेर्याय वपुषे तेजसे सुप्रभाय च
verses.wordMeaning: These seven sons of great strength were born to Jyotismat in Kus'a Dvipa. These were Udbhida, Venumat, Svairatha, Lavana, Dhrti, the sixth son Prabhakara and the seventh Kapila. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: These seven sons of great strength were born to Jyotismat in Kus'a Dvipa. These were Udbhida, Venumat, Svairatha, Lavana, Dhrti, the sixth son Prabhakara and the seventh Kapila. 2

verses.sanskrit: आश्वस्य च मुहूर्तेन उन्मत्त इव संस्तदा । निरीक्ष्य च दिशः सर्वा इदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: āśvasya ca muhūrtena unmatta iva saṃstadā / nirīkṣya ca diśaḥ sarvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: The first country was called after Udbhida, the second after Venumandala, the third after Svairathakara, the lourth after Lavana, the fifth • after Dhrtimat, the sixth after Prabhakara and the seventh Varsa of Kapila is well-known as Kapila. Thus the countries in the Kusa Dvipa were known after their names. The subjects therein followed the conducts be¬ fitting the stages oflife.
verses.hindi: भूताय च् भविष्याय वतंमानाय वे नमः । सुवर्चेसेषय वीराय शूराय हातिगाय च
verses.wordMeaning: The first country was called after Udbhida, the second after Venumandala, the third after Svairathakara, the lourth after Lavana, the fifth • after Dhrtimat, the sixth after Prabhakara and the seventh Varsa of Kapila is well-known as Kapila.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The first country was called after Udbhida, the second after Venumandala, the third after Svairathakara, the lourth after Lavana, the fifth • after Dhrtimat, the sixth after Prabhakara and the seventh Varsa of Kapila is well-known as Kapila.…

verses.sanskrit: किम् एतद् आश्चर्यपरमिति भोभो द्विजोत्तमाः । कथ्यतां कारणं सर्वं शास्त्रदृष्ट्या विभाव्य च
verses.transliteration: kim etad āścaryaparamiti bhobho dvijottamāḥ / kathyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ śāstradṛṣṭyā vibhāvya ca
verses.translation: The mlers of the Salmali continent were the seven
verses.hindi: सर्वाय मह॒तेडजाय नमः सर्वगताय च । जनाय च नमस्तुभ्यं तपसे वरदाय च ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The mlers of the Salmali continent were the seven
verses.commentary: Sense: The mlers of the Salmali continent were the seven

verses.sanskrit: मम वा दुष्कृतं किंचिदुताहो भवतामिह । येन नष्टो ऽग्निशालायां हुतभुक् केन हेतुना
verses.transliteration: mama vā duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcidutāho bhavatāmiha / yena naṣṭo 'gniśālāyāṃ hutabhuk kena hetunā
verses.translation: Sveta was the land of Sveta, Rohita, of Rohita. imuta, o Jimuta, Harita, of Harita, Vaidyuta, of Vaidyuta, anasa, of Manasa and Suprabha, of Suprabha. All these seven were the rulers of the lands. I shall describe the seven countries after Jambudvipa.
verses.hindi: नमो वन्द्याय सोक्षाय जनाय नरकाय च॑
verses.wordMeaning: Sveta was the land of Sveta, Rohita, of Rohita. imuta, o Jimuta, Harita, of Harita, Vaidyuta, of Vaidyuta, anasa, of Manasa and Suprabha, of Suprabha. All these seven were the rulers of the lands. I shall describe the seven countries after Jambudvipa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sveta was the land of Sveta, Rohita, of Rohita. imuta, o Jimuta, Harita, of Harita, Vaidyuta, of Vaidyuta, anasa, of Manasa and Suprabha, of Suprabha. All these seven were the rulers of the lands. I shall describe the seven countries after Jambudvipa.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रच्छिद्रम् अथान्यद्वा नैव किंचिददक्षिणम् । क्रियाहीनं कृतं वाथ केन वह्निर् न दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: mantracchidram athānyadvā naiva kiṃcidadakṣiṇam / kriyāhīnaṃ kṛtaṃ vātha kena vahnir na dṛśyate
verses.translation: The subjects in the Plaksa-dvipa were made to follow the conduct of life according to their respective castes and stages of life by the sons of Medhatithi residing in their respec¬ tive seven countries.
verses.hindi: है। आप पितृपति और पशुपति हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप वाग्वुष और पुराण वृषभ हैं, आपको नमस्कार है ।६६-१०५। आप सुचारु सुन्दर केशवाले, ऊद् वचक्षु, ऊद'व शिखावाले पशुपति और बृषभध्वज हैं, ओपको नमस्कार है। आप प्रजापतियों के पति, सिद्धों के पति, दंत्य-दानव और राक्षसों के पति हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप गन्धवेपति, यक्षपति एवं गरुड़, सप॑ और पक्षियों के पति हैं, आपको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects in the Plaksa-dvipa were made to follow the conduct of life according to their respective castes and stages of life by the sons of Medhatithi residing in their respec¬ tive seven countries.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects in the Plaksa-dvipa were made to follow the conduct of life according to their respective castes and stages of life by the sons of Medhatithi residing in their respec¬ tive seven countries.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नहीनो दहेद् राष्ट्रं मन्त्रहीनस्तु ऋत्विजः । दातारं दक्षिणाहीनो नास्ति यज्ञसमो रिपुः
verses.transliteration: annahīno dahed rāṣṭraṃ mantrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ / dātāraṃ dakṣiṇāhīno nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ
verses.translation: In the five continents beginning with Plaksa and ending with Saka the sacred rite was known in accordance with the division of castes [Varnas) and stages of life (Airamas ). Happiness, longevity, forms (beauty), strength and Dharma were all common to everyone in the five Dvipas (continents) perpetually. Understand that the Jambudvipa is surrounded by the seven Dvipas. Priyavrata crowned the eldest son (the son of) Kamya 2, Agnidhra of great valour as the king of Jambudvipa.
verses.hindi: ।(०६-१०८5। आप गोकर्ण, गोष्ठ, शडःकुकर्ण बराह अप्रभेय और रक्षोधिपति हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप अप्सराओं के पति, गणों के पत्ति तथा जल और तेज के पति हैं, आपको नमस्कार है ॥!०€-११०। आप लक्ष्मीपत्ति, शोभा सम्पन्न और. लज्जावान् हैं, आपको नभसस्‍्कार है। आप बलाबल समूह अक्षोम्यक्षोभण, दीघेशू डर कशृज़, वृषभ और ककुद ( वृषभ स्कन्ध ) वाले हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप स्थिर रहने वाले
verses.wordMeaning: In the five continents beginning with Plaksa and ending with Saka the sacred rite was known in accordance with the division of castes [Varnas) and stages of life (Airamas ). Happiness, longevity, forms (beauty),…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the five continents beginning with Plaksa and ending with Saka the sacred rite was known in accordance with the division of castes [Varnas) and stages of life (Airamas ). Happiness, longevity, forms (beauty),…

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः । न मन्त्रहीना हि वयं न च राजन्व्रतैस्तथा । द्रव्येण च न हीनस्त्वमन्यत् पापं विचिन्त्यताम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ / na mantrahīnā hi vayaṃ na ca rājanvrataistathā / dravyeṇa ca na hīnastvamanyat pāpaṃ vicintyatām
verses.translation: He had nine sons equal in valour and strength to Prajapati. The eldest was known as Nabhi; his younger brother was Kirhpurusa; Harivarsa was the third; Ilavrta was the fourth; Ramya was the fifth; Harinmat was the sixth; Kuru was the seventh; Bhadrasva was the eighth; Ketumala was the ninth. Undestand their lands. 3
verses.hindi: वपुधारी और भ्षति प्रभाशाली हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप भूत, भविष्यत् और वर्तमान हैं, आप तेजस्वी शूर, वीर ओर अनतिक्रमणीय हैं, आपको नमस्कार है।१११-११३॥। आप वरद, (श्रेष्ठ ) बरेण्य और सर्वंगत हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप भूत, भव्य, भव और महान् हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप सर्व, महान, भज और स्वंगत हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप जन, तपः और वरद हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप
verses.wordMeaning: He had nine sons equal in valour and strength to Prajapati. The eldest was known as Nabhi; his younger brother was Kirhpurusa; Harivarsa was the third; Ilavrta was the fourth; Ramya was the fifth; Harinmat was the sixth; Kuru was the seventh; Bhadrasva was the eighth;…
verses.commentary: Sense: He had nine sons equal in valour and strength to Prajapati. The eldest was known as Nabhi; his younger brother was Kirhpurusa; Harivarsa was the third; Ilavrta was the fourth; Ramya was the fifth; Harinmat was the sixth; Kuru was the seventh; Bhadrasva was the eighth;…

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच: तथापि यूयं सहिता उपायं चिन्तयन्त्विति । येन श्रेयो भवेन् नित्यम् इह लोके परत्र च
verses.transliteration: rājovāca: tathāpi yūyaṃ sahitā upāyaṃ cintayantviti / yena śreyo bhaven nityam iha loke paratra ca
verses.translation: The father gave Nabhi the southern Varsa (sub¬ continent) called Hima. He gave to Kimpurusa the Var$a known as Hemakuta; to Harivarsa the Varsa remembered as Naisadha; to Ilavrta the central part of Sumeru. He (the father) gave to Ramya Nila-varsa; Sveta, which lay to the north of it, was given by the father to Harinmat. He gave to Kuru the Verses 32-34 enumerate the seven sub-continents of Plaksa-dvipa each of which was named after its ruler, the son of Medhatithi.
verses.hindi: वन्दनीय, मोक्ष जन और नरक हैं, आपको नमस्कार है ।११४-११५॥ आप भव, भजमान, दृष्ट याजक,
verses.wordMeaning: The father gave Nabhi the southern Varsa (sub¬ continent) called Hima. He gave to Kimpurusa the Var$a known as Hemakuta; to Harivarsa the Varsa remembered as Naisadha; to Ilavrta the central part of Sumeru. He (the father) gave to Ramya Nila-varsa; Sveta,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The father gave Nabhi the southern Varsa (sub¬ continent) called Hima. He gave to Kimpurusa the Var$a known as Hemakuta; to Harivarsa the Varsa remembered as Naisadha; to Ilavrta the central part of Sumeru. He (the father) gave to Ramya Nila-varsa; Sveta,…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तास्ततः सर्वे ब्राह्मणाः कृतनिश्चयाः । निराहाराः स्थिताः शर्वे यत्र नष्टो हुताशनः
verses.transliteration: evamuktāstataḥ sarve brāhmaṇāḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ / nirāhārāḥ sthitāḥ śarve yatra naṣṭo hutāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Kanyd in the text is a misprint.
verses.hindi: घनुश्चिह्नातगंतग्रन्थो क. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Kanyd in the text is a misprint.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kanyd in the text is a misprint.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वप्ने महातेजा हुतभुग्ब्राह्मणांस्तदा । उवाच श्रूयतां सर्वैर् मम नाशस्य कारणम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svapne mahātejā hutabhugbrāhmaṇāṃstadā / uvāca śrūyatāṃ sarvair mama nāśasya kāraṇam
verses.translation: Verses 38-45 enumerate the nine sub-division of India as understood by the author of the Va. P. For locations of mountains mentioned here vide Suptd p. ll t fn. 2. The righteous Agnldhra crowned his sons in these countries in due order and then engaged himself in penance.
verses.hindi: भवाय भजमानाय इष्टाय याजकाय व । अभ्युदीर्णाय दीप्ताय तत्त्वाय निर्गुणाय च १११६
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 38-45 enumerate the nine sub-division of India as understood by the author of the Va. P. For locations of mountains mentioned here vide Suptd p. ll t fn. 2. The righteous Agnldhra crowned his sons in these countries in due order and then engaged himself in penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 38-45 enumerate the nine sub-division of India as understood by the author of the Va. P. For locations of mountains mentioned here vide Suptd p. ll t fn. 2. The righteous Agnldhra crowned his sons in these countries in due order and then engaged himself in penance.

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थितो ऽयं मया राजा सुतां दातुं न चेच्छति । तेन नष्टो ऽग्निशरणादहं भो द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: prārthito 'yaṃ mayā rājā sutāṃ dātuṃ na cecchati / tena naṣṭo 'gniśaraṇādahaṃ bho dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Thus, the seven continents were established by the seven sons of Priyavrata, the grandsons of Svayarhbhuva (Manu).
verses.hindi: सदस्याय नमश्चेव दक्षिणावभूथाय च । अहिसायाथ लोकानां पशुमन्त्रवधाय च १११६ नमस्तुष्टिप्रदानाय व्यम्बकाय सुगन्धिने । नमो5स्त्विन्द्रियपतये परिहाराय स्रग्विण १२०
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the seven continents were established by the seven sons of Priyavrata, the grandsons of Svayarhbhuva (Manu).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the seven continents were established by the seven sons of Priyavrata, the grandsons of Svayarhbhuva (Manu).

verses.sanskrit: यदि मे स्वसुतां राजा ददाति परमार्चिताम् । तदास्य ज्वलमानो ऽहं गृहे तिष्ठामि नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: yadi me svasutāṃ rājā dadāti paramārcitām / tadāsya jvalamāno 'haṃ gṛhe tiṣṭhāmi nānyathā
verses.translation: The eight countries beginning with Kirhpurusa are very auspicious. There perfection is natural, wholly consisting of pleasure and without effort. There is no calamity or misfortune, no tear of old age and death. They have neither righteousness nor unrighteousness. There are neither high born nor low born nor middling. In all those areas there are no yuga cycles (with their classification, duties etc.).
verses.hindi: नमो ह॒ृव्याय कव्याय हृव्यकव्याय वे नमः । समः सिद्धाय सेध्याय चेष्टाय त्वव्ययाय च १२२ सुवीराय सुथोराय ह्वक्षोम्यक्षोभणाय च् । सुमेधसे सुप्रजाय दीप्ताय भास्कराय च १२३ नमो नमः सुपर्णाय तपनीयनिभाय च्। विखूयाक्षाय ध्यक्षाय पिड्गलाय महौजसे ३१२४ दृष्टिध्नाय नमश्चेव नमः सोम्येक्षणाय व । नसो धुम्राय श्वेताय कृष्णाय लोहिताय च
verses.wordMeaning: The eight countries beginning with Kirhpurusa are very auspicious. There perfection is natural, wholly consisting of pleasure and without effort. There is no calamity or misfortune, no tear of old age and death. They have neither righteousness nor unrighteousness.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight countries beginning with Kirhpurusa are very auspicious. There perfection is natural, wholly consisting of pleasure and without effort. There is no calamity or misfortune, no tear of old age and death. They have neither righteousness nor unrighteousness.…

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं विप्रा वैश्वानरमुखोद्गतम् । विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना राजानम् इदम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā vacanaṃ viprā vaiśvānaramukhodgatam / vismayotphullanayanā rājānam idam abruvan
verses.translation: I shall now describe the lineage of Nabhi in the Hima Varsa. Nabhi of great lustre begot of MerudevI a son (named) Rsabha, 1 the best among all kings and the ancestor of all Ksattriyas.
verses.hindi: अग्निष्टोम यज्ञ के ऋतिज, ऋतु, सत्य, भूताधिपति, सदस्य दक्षिणावभूथ, लोकों की अहिसा ओर पशुओं के लिये मन्त्रौषधि हैं, आपको नमस्कार है।११६-११६। आप तुष्टि के दाता, व्यम्बक, सुगन्धि, इन्द्रियपति  परिहार (? )और मालाधारी हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप विश्व, विध्वरूप, विश्वतोजिमुख, सबंत्र
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now describe the lineage of Nabhi in the Hima Varsa. Nabhi of great lustre begot of MerudevI a son (named) Rsabha, 1 the best among all kings and the ancestor of all Ksattriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now describe the lineage of Nabhi in the Hima Varsa. Nabhi of great lustre begot of MerudevI a son (named) Rsabha, 1 the best among all kings and the ancestor of all Ksattriyas.

verses.sanskrit: भवतो मतमाज्ञाय सर्वे गत्वाग्निमन्दिरम् । निराहाराः स्थिता रात्रौ पश्यामो जातवेदसम्
verses.transliteration: bhavato matamājñāya sarve gatvāgnimandiram / nirāhārāḥ sthitā rātrau paśyāmo jātavedasam
verses.translation: The heroic Bharata was born of R?abha. He was the eldest of his hundred sons. After crowning his son Bharata, Rsa¬ bha renounced the world. He entrusted the southern Varsa called Hima to Bharata. Hence learned people know it by the name Bharata Varsa. 2
verses.hindi: क्षोभण, सुमेधा, दीप्त, भास्कर, सुप्रज, सुपणं और तपनीय बस्तु तुल्य हैं, आपको नमस्कार है ।१२०-१२१ दे! आव विश्पाक्ष, व्यक्ष, पिड्जल, ओजस्वी, दृष्टिनाशक, और शुभदशत वाले हैं, आवको नमस्कार है। आप धुम्न, ब्वेत, कृष्ण, लोहित, पिशित, पीत और निषज्धी हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप सविशेष, निविशेष, इज्य, पूज्य, उपजीव्य, क्षेम्य, वृद्ध और वत्सल हैं, आप कृत, सत्य, सत्यासत्य हैं आपको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: The heroic Bharata was born of R?abha. He was the eldest of his hundred sons. After crowning his son Bharata, Rsa¬ bha renounced the world. He entrusted the southern Varsa called Hima to Bharata. Hence learned people know it by the name Bharata Varsa. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic Bharata was born of R?abha. He was the eldest of his hundred sons. After crowning his son Bharata, Rsa¬ bha renounced the world. He entrusted the southern Varsa called Hima to Bharata. Hence learned people know it by the name Bharata Varsa. 2

verses.sanskrit: तेनोक्ताः स्वसुतां चेत् तु राजा मे दातुम् इच्छति । ततो ऽस्य भूयो ऽपि गृहे ज्वले ऽहं नान्यथा द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tenoktāḥ svasutāṃ cet tu rājā me dātum icchati / tato 'sya bhūyo 'pi gṛhe jvale 'haṃ nānyathā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Bharata's son was the scholarly and righteous Sumati. After transferring his kingdom, the royal splendour and glory to the son, Bharata entered the forest.
verses.hindi: पद्मवर्ण, मृत्युन्न, मृत्यु, श्याम, गौर, कट, रोहित, कान्‍्त सन्ध्या, मेघवर्ण, बहुरूपी, कपालहस्त, दिग्वल्न,
verses.wordMeaning: Bharata's son was the scholarly and righteous Sumati. After transferring his kingdom, the royal splendour and glory to the son, Bharata entered the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bharata's son was the scholarly and righteous Sumati. After transferring his kingdom, the royal splendour and glory to the son, Bharata entered the forest.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा महाराज स्वसुतां दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā mahārāja svasutāṃ dātumarhasi
verses.translation: He is the first Tirthankara of Jairs. He is mentioned in Bh. P.V. Chs. 4 & 5 and in VP. II. 1.28. Brahmancial Puranas regard him as their own, an incarnation ofVisnu. Jain tradition supports this Purariic belief. But countries are named after the major tribes that settled in that particular lande.g. Malwa, Gujarat, England. Thus the country in which the tribe called Bharatas settled was the original Bharata.
verses.hindi: + इदमर्धघ ख. ग घ. ड. पुस्तकेषु नास्ति।. ः+अस्मिन्नधेस्थाने इदमर्ध दृश्यते ख. घ. ड. पुस्तकेषु ।
verses.wordMeaning: He is the first Tirthankara of Jairs. He is mentioned in Bh. P.V. Chs. 4 & 5 and in VP. II. 1.28. Brahmancial Puranas regard him as their own, an incarnation ofVisnu. Jain tradition supports this Purariic belief.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the first Tirthankara of Jairs. He is mentioned in Bh. P.V. Chs. 4 & 5 and in VP. II. 1.28. Brahmancial Puranas regard him as their own, an incarnation ofVisnu. Jain tradition supports this Purariic belief.…

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच: भवतां तस्य वा कार्यं देवस्य वचनं हृदि । समयं कर्तुम् इच्छामि कन्यादाने ह्यनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: rājovāca: bhavatāṃ tasya vā kāryaṃ devasya vacanaṃ hṛdi / samayaṃ kartum icchāmi kanyādāne hyanuttamam
verses.translation: His son, Tejasasa lord of the subjects and con¬ queror of enemies. Indradyumna, the son of Taijasa, was well- known as a scholar.
verses.hindi: ( « नमः कान्ताय सन्ध्याश्रवर्णाप वायुरूपिण ।) नमः कपालहस्ताय दिग्वद्नाय कपदिने
verses.wordMeaning: His son, Tejasasa lord of the subjects and con¬ queror of enemies. Indradyumna, the son of Taijasa, was well- known as a scholar.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son, Tejasasa lord of the subjects and con¬ queror of enemies. Indradyumna, the son of Taijasa, was well- known as a scholar.

verses.sanskrit: मम संनिहितो नित्यं गृहे तिष्ठतु पावकः । ददामि रुचिरापाङ्गीं नान्यथा करवाणि वै
verses.transliteration: mama saṃnihito nityaṃ gṛhe tiṣṭhatu pāvakaḥ / dadāmi rucirāpāṅgīṃ nānyathā karavāṇi vai
verses.translation: His son was Paramesthin. After his death Sobhana born in the family of Pratiharas 1 2 and related to him (ascended his throne). A son known as Pratihartr was born to him. Unnctr was the son of Pratihartr. Bhuva was his son. His son was Udgltha. Pratavi was his son.
verses.hindi: पिनाकिने प्रसिद्धाय स्फीताय प्रसुताय च। सुमेधसे5क्षमालाय दिग्वासाय शिखण्डिने .
verses.wordMeaning: His son was Paramesthin. After his death Sobhana born in the family of Pratiharas 1 2 and related to him (ascended his throne). A son known as Pratihartr was born to him. Unnctr was the son of Pratihartr. Bhuva was his son. His son was Udgltha. Pratavi was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was Paramesthin. After his death Sobhana born in the family of Pratiharas 1 2 and related to him (ascended his throne). A son known as Pratihartr was born to him. Unnctr was the son of Pratihartr. Bhuva was his son. His son was Udgltha. Pratavi was his son.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ते ब्राह्मणाः श्रुत्वा तथाग्निं प्राप्य सत्वरम् । कथयित्वा विवाहेन योजयामासुराशु वै
verses.transliteration: evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ śrutvā tathāgniṃ prāpya satvaram / kathayitvā vivāhena yojayāmāsurāśu vai
verses.translation: Vibhu was the son of Pratavi. His son was Prthu. Nakta was Prthu's son and Gaya was Nakta's son.
verses.hindi: नम: क्षान्ताय शान्ताय वज्शसंहननाय च। रक्षोघ्नाय मखध्नाय शितिकष्ठोध्वंरेतसे
verses.wordMeaning: Vibhu was the son of Pratavi. His son was Prthu. Nakta was Prthu's son and Gaya was Nakta's son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vibhu was the son of Pratavi. His son was Prthu. Nakta was Prthu's son and Gaya was Nakta's son.

verses.sanskrit: सुदर्शनाया लाभेन परितुष्टो हुताशनः । ज्वलते सन्निधौ नित्यं माहिष्मत्यां युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: sudarśanāyā lābhena parituṣṭo hutāśanaḥ / jvalate sannidhau nityaṃ māhiṣmatyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Nara was the son of Gaya. Virat was Nara's son. Virat's son was Mahavlrya and Dhlmat was his son. Mahat was the son of Dhlmat. Bhauvana was Mahat's son. Tvastr was Bhauvana's son and Arija was his son.
verses.hindi: प्रणवप्रणवेशाय भक्तानां शरमंदाय च्  मृगव्याधाय दक्षाय दक्षयज्ञहराय च
verses.wordMeaning: Nara was the son of Gaya. Virat was Nara's son. Virat's son was Mahavlrya and Dhlmat was his son. Mahat was the son of Dhlmat. Bhauvana was Mahat's son. Tvastr was Bhauvana's son and Arija was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nara was the son of Gaya. Virat was Nara's son. Virat's son was Mahavlrya and Dhlmat was his son. Mahat was the son of Dhlmat. Bhauvana was Mahat's son. Tvastr was Bhauvana's son and Arija was his son.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत्तीर्थमग्नितीर्थं प्रचक्षते । ये तत्र पक्षसन्धौ तु स्नानदानैस्तु भाविताः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamagnitīrthaṃ pracakṣate / ye tatra pakṣasandhau tu snānadānaistu bhāvitāḥ
verses.translation: Rajas was Arija's son. Satajit was the son of Rajas. He had a hundred sons and all of them were kings.
verses.hindi: पृष्णो दन्‍्तविनाशाय भगनेत्रान्तकाय च । कणादाय वरिष्ठाय कामाज्गदहनायथ च १३८ रबेः करालवक़ाय नागेद्ददसनाय च। देत्यानामन्तकायाथो दिव्याक्रन्दकराय च॒
verses.wordMeaning: Rajas was Arija's son. Satajit was the son of Rajas. He had a hundred sons and all of them were kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rajas was Arija's son. Satajit was the son of Rajas. He had a hundred sons and all of them were kings.

verses.sanskrit: तर्पयन्ति पित्ःन् देवांस्ते ऽश्वमेधफलैर्युताः । सुवर्णं ये प्रयच्छन्ति तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप
verses.transliteration: tarpayanti pitḥn devāṃste 'śvamedhaphalairyutāḥ / suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa
verses.translation: Out of them Visvajyoti was the chief. It is through them that these subjects flourished. They made this Bharata as consisting of seven Khanqlas. The country Bharata was enjoyed by those born of their race, for seventyone sets of ages consisting ofKrta, Treta etc.
verses.hindi: प्रहीणशोक॑विविधे भूत: परिष्दुताय च। नरनारीशरौराय देब्याः प्रियकराय च
verses.wordMeaning: Out of them Visvajyoti was the chief. It is through them that these subjects flourished. They made this Bharata as consisting of seven Khanqlas. The country Bharata was enjoyed by those born of their race, for seventyone sets of ages consisting ofKrta, Treta etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of them Visvajyoti was the chief. It is through them that these subjects flourished. They made this Bharata as consisting of seven Khanqlas. The country Bharata was enjoyed by those born of their race, for seventyone sets of ages consisting ofKrta, Treta etc.

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्वीदानफलं तत्र जायते नात्र संशयः । अनाशकं तु यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप
verses.transliteration: pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ tatra jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa
verses.translation: Along with those ages {yagas) which have gone, the kings of their race were hundreds and thousands in the Svayam- bhuva Manvantara.
verses.hindi: क्दी, अप्रमेय, झ्रर्व, अवध्य, वर, पुरोभाग या प्ृरष्ठ भाग से विश्रान्त क्ृष्णनु, महादुर्ग, रोध, कपिल, सूर्य की प्रभा की तरह शरीर वाले, बली, वेगवास, पिनाकी, प्रसिद्ध, स्फीत, प्रसृत, ( विस्तृत ) सुमेधा, अक्षमाली, दिग्वल्न, शिखण्डी, चित्रवर्ण विभिन्न, धर, चेकितान, तुष्ट और अनिहित हैं आपको नमस्कार है ।!२५-१३३। आप क्षान्त, शान्त, वज्प्रहारी, राक्षसविनाशी, यज्ञविनाशी, शितिकण्ठ, ऊध्वरेता,
verses.wordMeaning: Along with those ages {yagas) which have gone, the kings of their race were hundreds and thousands in the Svayam- bhuva Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with those ages {yagas) which have gone, the kings of their race were hundreds and thousands in the Svayam- bhuva Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: स मृतो ह्यग्निलोके तु क्रीडते सुरपूजितः । एष ते ह्यग्नितीर्थस्य सम्भवः कथितो मया
verses.transliteration: sa mṛto hyagniloke tu krīḍate surapūjitaḥ / eṣa te hyagnitīrthasya sambhavaḥ kathito mayā
verses.translation: This is the creation of Svayambhuva (Manu) by which this universe has been filled along with sages, deities, Pitrs, Gandharvas, Raksasas, Yaksas, Bhutas, Pis'acas, human beings, animals and birds. Their creation in the world revolves in cycles along with the Yugas. Reading in A accepted as 'Tejasas tu sulah' in the text contradicts
verses.hindi: शत्रनाशी, कृतान्त, तीक्ष्ण आयुधधारी, संमोव, प्रमोद और दूरिण्य (शून्य ) हैं, आपको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: This is the creation of Svayambhuva (Manu) by which this universe has been filled along with sages, deities, Pitrs, Gandharvas, Raksasas, Yaksas, Bhutas, Pis'acas, human beings, animals and birds. Their creation in the world revolves in cycles along with the Yugas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the creation of Svayambhuva (Manu) by which this universe has been filled along with sages, deities, Pitrs, Gandharvas, Raksasas, Yaksas, Bhutas, Pis'acas, human beings, animals and birds. Their creation in the world revolves in cycles along with the Yugas.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापहरः पुण्यः श्रुतमात्रो नरोत्तम । धन्यः पापहरो नित्यमित्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpaharaḥ puṇyaḥ śrutamātro narottama / dhanyaḥ pāpaharo nityamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: Bd. P. (v. 65-66) states that Pratihara is the name of the son of
verses.hindi: अधिक पराक्रमी, पुर हैत्य को मारने वाले, शानन्‍्त सुगन्ध, वराभिलाषी, पूषा के दाँत को तोड़नेवाले, सूर्य के नेत्न को फोड़नेवाले, कणाद, वरिष्ठ, मदन-दहन, सूर्य के कराल नामक चक्र, नागेन्द्रदमनकर्ता, देत्यों के विनाशी, दिव्य घोष करनेवाले, श्मशान में नित्य रमण करने वाले और निनेत्र हैं, आपको नमस्कार है ।7३६-१३६३। आप प्राण पालक, घवलमालाधारी शोकविहीन विविध जीवों से स्तुत, नरनारी उभय शरीर
verses.wordMeaning: Bd. P. (v. 65-66) states that Pratihara is the name of the son of
verses.commentary: Sense: Bd. P. (v. 65-66) states that Pratihara is the name of the son of

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे ऽग्नितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ३४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तत्रैव तु भवेदन्यद् आदित्यस्य महात्मनः । कीर्तयामि नरश्रेष्ठ यदि ते श्रवणे मतिः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe 'gnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 34 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tatraiva tu bhavedanyad ādityasya mahātmanaḥ / kīrtayāmi naraśreṣṭha yadi te śravaṇe matiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing of the establishment of the people, the clever and eminent sage asked Suta about the length and extent of the earth. O holy sir, how many continents, or oceans or moun¬ tains arc there? How many Varsas( sub-continents) are there and what are the rivers in them. Explain factually to us in details, the magnitude of the great elements and of the Lokaloka mountain, the circum¬ ference, the size and the course of movements of the sun and the moon.
verses.hindi: बाले, देवी पावंती के प्रियका रक, जटाधारी दण्डधारी, साँप का यज्ञीपवीत धारण करने वाले, नाचने वाले,
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing of the establishment of the people, the clever and eminent sage asked Suta about the length and extent of the earth. O holy sir, how many continents, or oceans or moun¬ tains arc there? How many Varsas( sub-continents) are there and what are the rivers in them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing of the establishment of the people, the clever and eminent sage asked Suta about the length and extent of the earth. O holy sir, how many continents, or oceans or moun¬ tains arc there? How many Varsas( sub-continents) are there and what are the rivers in them.…

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: एतदाश्चर्यमतुलं श्रुत्वा तव मुखोद्गतम् । विस्मयाद्धृष्टरोमाहं जातो ऽस्मि मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: etadāścaryamatulaṃ śrutvā tava mukhodgatam / vismayāddhṛṣṭaromāhaṃ jāto 'smi munisattama
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall explain the length and extent of the earth, the number of oceans and continents in details. I shall tell you how many countries ( Varfas ) there are and whatthe rivers (are) therein. (Now) I shall tell you the magnitude of the great elements, the Lokaloka mountain range, There are thousands of countries and islands in the seven continents. They cannot be described in details with sufficient evidence, even in hundreds of years.
verses.hindi: » धनुश्चित्वान्तगंतग्रन्यो क, पुस्तके नास्ति।
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth I shall explain the length and extent of the earth, the number of oceans and continents in details. I shall tell you how many countries ( Varfas ) there are and whatthe rivers (are) therein. (Now) I shall tell you the magnitude of the great elements,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth I shall explain the length and extent of the earth, the number of oceans and continents in details. I shall tell you how many countries ( Varfas ) there are and whatthe rivers (are) therein. (Now) I shall tell you the magnitude of the great elements,…

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रकिरणो देवो हर्ता कर्ता निरञ्जनः । अवतारेण लोकानाम् उद्धर्ता नर्मदातटे
verses.transliteration: sahasrakiraṇo devo hartā kartā nirañjanaḥ / avatāreṇa lokānām uddhartā narmadātaṭe
verses.translation: One shall not make conjectures about inconceivable objects and worlds. That which is beyond Prakj-ti is called eternal. I shall describe to you factually Jambudvipa consisting of nine Varsas. Understand its extent and zones in Yojanas. It extends to a hundred thousand Yojanas. It is full of different rural localities and various splendid cities. It is embellished with the (colonies of) Siddhas, Caranas and Gandharvas and with mountains as well. It has mountains abounding in minerals and variegated rocks. It has many rivers rising from mountains.
verses.hindi: जटिने दण्डिने तुभ्यं व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिने । नमोःस्तु नृत्यशोलाय वाह्यनुत्यप्रियाय च ।
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not make conjectures about inconceivable objects and worlds. That which is beyond Prakj-ti is called eternal. I shall describe to you factually Jambudvipa consisting of nine Varsas. Understand its extent and zones in Yojanas. It extends to a hundred thousand Yojanas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not make conjectures about inconceivable objects and worlds. That which is beyond Prakj-ti is called eternal. I shall describe to you factually Jambudvipa consisting of nine Varsas. Understand its extent and zones in Yojanas. It extends to a hundred thousand Yojanas.…

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषाकारो भगवानुताहो तपसः फलात् । कस्य गोत्रे समुत्पन्नः कस्य देवो ऽभवद् वशी
verses.transliteration: puruṣākāro bhagavānutāho tapasaḥ phalāt / kasya gotre samutpannaḥ kasya devo 'bhavad vaśī
verses.translation: Jambudvipa is immense, glorious and surrounded by nine (Khan<jlas Zones?) inhabited by living beings. It is encircled on all sides by salt-sea. All round Jambudvipa, extending to its entire length, the six mountain systems stretch to the east. 1 They have excellent ridges. They extend to both sides plunging into the eastern and The mountain Himavat is full of snow. Hemakuta is full of gold; Nisadha is golden having the lustre of the midday sun.
verses.hindi: मनन्‍्यवे गतिशीलाय सुगीति गायते नमः । कटककराय भीमाय चोग्ररूपधराय च
verses.wordMeaning: Jambudvipa is immense, glorious and surrounded by nine (Khan<jlas Zones?) inhabited by living beings. It is encircled on all sides by salt-sea. All round Jambudvipa, extending to its entire length, the six mountain systems stretch to the east. 1 They have excellent ridges.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: कुलिकान्वयसम्भूतो ब्राह्मणो भक्तिमाञ्छुचिः । ईक्ष्यामीति रविं तत्र तीर्थे यात्राकृतोद्यमः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kulikānvayasambhūto brāhmaṇo bhaktimāñchuciḥ / īkṣyāmīti raviṃ tatra tīrthe yātrākṛtodyamaḥ
verses.translation: The golden Meru of four colours is known as the highest. 2 Leaping up in symmetrical shapes on all sides it rises up. On its sides it has various colours. It is endowed with the attributes of Prajapati. It is born of the umbilical knot of Brahma, of unmanifest origin. It is white on the east, hence its Brahmanahood. It is yellow on the south, hence its Vaisyahood.
verses.hindi: चलते क़ीडते चव लम्बोदरशरीरिण । नमस्कृताय कम्पाय मुण्डाय विकराय च
verses.wordMeaning: The golden Meru of four colours is known as the highest. 2 Leaping up in symmetrical shapes on all sides it rises up. On its sides it has various colours. It is endowed with the attributes of Prajapati. It is born of the umbilical knot of Brahma, of unmanifest origin.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The golden Meru of four colours is known as the highest. 2 Leaping up in symmetrical shapes on all sides it rises up. On its sides it has various colours. It is endowed with the attributes of Prajapati. It is born of the umbilical knot of Brahma, of unmanifest origin.…

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां शतं साग्रं निराहारो गतोदकः । प्रस्थितो देवदेवेन स्वप्नान्ते वारितः किल
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ nirāhāro gatodakaḥ / prasthito devadevena svapnānte vāritaḥ kila
verses.translation: These are called Varfa parvatas as they divide one Vara (sub-continent or country) from another. For their location and modem name vide Supra Ch. 1, , note 2. Verses 15-23 describe.the pivotal mount Meru. About its shape and size there is a conscnus among Puranas like KP, Mt. P., Bd. P., Mk. P. M. Ali (AGP, p -50) points out that Persians, Greeks, Chinese, Jews and Arabs confirm the traditional nodality of Meru. After discussing the problems, he shows that Mt. Meru of Puranas is identical with the Pamirs in Central Asia. On the west it is black like the aloe leaf. It is very hard, and renders services to many.
verses.hindi: नम उन्मत्तवेषाय किकिणीकाय वे सनः । नमो विक्ृतवेबाय क़्रोग्रामषंगाय च

verses.sanskrit: भोभो मुने महासत्त्व अलं ते व्रतमीदृशम् । सर्वं व्याप्य स्थितं पश्य स्थावरं जङ्गमं च माम्
verses.transliteration: bhobho mune mahāsattva alaṃ te vratamīdṛśam / sarvaṃ vyāpya sthitaṃ paśya sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca mām
verses.translation: Its northern side has a natural red colour. Hence its Ksattriya-hood. Thus all its colours are described. Its manifest characteristic are described according to its colour and effects. The Nila mountain is full of Lapis lazuli; Svetasrhga, full of gold; Spigavan is of gold but variegated in colour like peacock feathers. These lordly mountains are resorted to by Caranas and Siddhas. Their inner girth is said to be nine thousand (Yojanas). It is in the centre of Ilavrta which surrounds it. It extends to nine thousand Yojanas. In the centre of the Meru, there is a smokeless fire.
verses.hindi: (+नमस्तोकाय तनवे गुणेरप्रतिमाय व । नमो गणाय गुह्माय गम्याय गमनाय च) १५० लोकधात्री त्वियं भूमि: पादो सज्जनसेवितों । सर्वेषां सिद्धयोगानामधि७ष्ठानं तवोदरस् १५१ मध्येडन्तरिक्ष॑ विस्तीर्ण तारागणविभुषितस् । तारापथ इवा55भाति श्रीमान्हारस्तवोरसि.
verses.wordMeaning: Its northern side has a natural red colour. Hence its Ksattriya-hood. Thus all its colours are described. Its manifest characteristic are described according to its colour and effects. The Nila mountain is full of Lapis lazuli; Svetasrhga, full of gold;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Its northern side has a natural red colour. Hence its Ksattriya-hood. Thus all its colours are described. Its manifest characteristic are described according to its colour and effects. The Nila mountain is full of Lapis lazuli; Svetasrhga, full of gold;…

verses.sanskrit: तपाम्यहं ततो वर्षं निगृह्णाम्य् उत्सृजामि च । न भृतं चैव मृत्युं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति
verses.transliteration: tapāmyahaṃ tato varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmy utsṛjāmi ca / na bhṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
verses.translation: The southern and the northern halves of Meru come together like the middle of the sacrificial altar. The seven mountain systems of the seven countries (Varsas) are two thousand Yojanas long and as much high. Their length is said to be similar to that of Jam- budvipa. The two middling mountains, Nila and Nisadha are a hundred thousand Yojanas in length; the other (four mountains) are shorter (in length) than these. (They are) Sveta, Hemakuta, Himavan, and Sfngavan. Out of these mountains Sveta and Hemakuta are each ninety thousand Yojanas long. (Mountains Himavan and Spigavan) are each eighty thousand in length. There are Janapadas (territories) in between them. The Varsas are seven in number. They are encircled by mountains that are difficult to cross on account of steep precipices. They are criss¬ crossed by different rivers. It was impossible to travel from one Varsa to another (lit. they were mutually unapproachable). Animals of different species live in them. This Varsa deriving its name fromHimavatis well known y the name Bharata. Hemakutais beyond this. It is remembered
verses.hindi: दिशा दश भुजास्ते वे केपूराज्धादभूषिताः । विस्तीर्णपरिणाहश्व नीलाम्बुदचयोपस: १५३ कण्ठस्ते शोभते श्रीमान्हेमसूत्रविभूषित: । दंष्ट्राकरालदुर्धष मनौपम्यं सुखं तव १४४
verses.wordMeaning: The southern and the northern halves of Meru come together like the middle of the sacrificial altar. The seven mountain systems of the seven countries (Varsas) are two thousand Yojanas long and as much high. Their length is said to be similar to that of Jam- budvipa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The southern and the northern halves of Meru come together like the middle of the sacrificial altar. The seven mountain systems of the seven countries (Varsas) are two thousand Yojanas long and as much high. Their length is said to be similar to that of Jam- budvipa.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि मे देव देयो यदि वरो मम । उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले सदा संनिहितो भव
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva deyo yadi varo mama / uttare narmadākūle sadā saṃnihito bhava
verses.translation: Vedyardha which is on the hitherside of Nisadha is known as southern Vedyardha and that which is beyond the Nilavan is the northern Vedyardha. On the southern side of Vedyardha there are three Varsas and three on the northern side. The mountain Gandhamadana should be known as situated to its west. In length and extent it is reputed to be like Malyavan. 2 This is the seven-continent concept of the earth in the Puranas. It may be diagrammatically represented as follows:
verses.hindi: प्रिय, वाद. नगवाली अंगूठी पहने हुये, स्तोक, तनु, अनृपम गुण वाले, गण, गुह्म, गम्य, गमन हैं, आपको नमस्कार है।!४६-१५०। है भगवन् ! यह लोकधात्री प्रृथ्वी, आपका सज्जन-सेवित पदयुगल है और नारायण से विभूषित जो विस्तीर्ण अन्तरिक्षमध्य है, वही आपका उदर है, जो सम्पूर्ण सिद्ध-योगियों का अधि- पठान है। आपकी छाती का हार तारापथ ( आकाश गंगा ) की तरह शोभायमान है। दसो दिशायें
verses.wordMeaning: Vedyardha which is on the hitherside of Nisadha is known as southern Vedyardha and that which is beyond the Nilavan is the northern Vedyardha. On the southern side of Vedyardha there are three Varsas and three on the northern side.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vedyardha which is on the hitherside of Nisadha is known as southern Vedyardha and that which is beyond the Nilavan is the northern Vedyardha. On the southern side of Vedyardha there are three Varsas and three on the northern side.…

verses.sanskrit: ये भक्त्या परया देव योजनानां शते स्थिताः । स्मरिष्यन्ति जितात्मानस् तेषां त्वं वरदो भव
verses.transliteration: ye bhaktyā parayā deva yojanānāṃ śate sthitāḥ / smariṣyanti jitātmānas teṣāṃ tvaṃ varado bhava
verses.translation: The Puranas differ about the location of these mountains. But here Mt. Malyavan due to its association with Gandhamadana and Meru may be identified with the Sarikol range, as Gandhamadana was the northern ridge of the great Hindukush arch with* its northern extension, the Khwaja Mahammad {AGP, p -59). In between the two, there is the four-coloured, golden four-cornered, lofty, excellent mountain Meru. From the unmanifest, the elements of water etc. are born. From the unmanifest the great lotus of the earth is evolved. Its pericarp is the four-cornered Meru that is five times great.
verses.hindi: आपकी भुजाये हैं, जो केयूर और अज्भद से विभूषित हैं। विशाल और विस्तोर्ण नील मेघों क। समृह आपका कण्ठ है, जो विद्युल्लता रूपी हेमसूत्र से विभूषित है ।११५१-१५३३। आपका अनृपम मुख दल्तपंक्ति से कराल
verses.wordMeaning: The Puranas differ about the location of these mountains. But here Mt. Malyavan due to its association with Gandhamadana and Meru may be identified with the Sarikol range, as Gandhamadana was the northern ridge of the great Hindukush arch with* its northern extension,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Puranas differ about the location of these mountains. But here Mt. Malyavan due to its association with Gandhamadana and Meru may be identified with the Sarikol range, as Gandhamadana was the northern ridge of the great Hindukush arch with* its northern extension,…

verses.sanskrit: कुब्जान्धबधिरा मूका ये केचिद्विकलेन्द्रियाः । तव पादौ नमस्यन्ति तेषां त्वं वरदो भव
verses.transliteration: kubjāndhabadhirā mūkā ye kecidvikalendriyāḥ / tava pādau namasyanti teṣāṃ tvaṃ varado bhava
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, then all the deities were bom. The noble Purusottama was born with his Atman purified by merits earned through many Kalpas previously. Then there was born Mahadeva, the great Yogin, the great lord who is elderly to the universe which he pervades, and who is infinite and formless. He has no form evolved out of Prakr-ti, that is to say no form of flesh, fat or bone; with his Yogic power and lordly nature, he pervades the universe. From him as the cause, was born the eternal lotus of the worlds. As the natural sequence of time, it occurred at the advent of the Kalpa (?)
verses.hindi: १७६ बायुपुराणमभ्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, then all the deities were bom. The noble Purusottama was born with his Atman purified by merits earned through many Kalpas previously. Then there was born Mahadeva, the great Yogin, the great lord who is elderly to the universe which he pervades,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, then all the deities were bom. The noble Purusottama was born with his Atman purified by merits earned through many Kalpas previously. Then there was born Mahadeva, the great Yogin, the great lord who is elderly to the universe which he pervades,…

verses.sanskrit: शीर्णघ्राणा गतधियो ह्यस्थिचर्मावशेषिताः । तेषां त्वं करुणां देव अचिरेण कुरुष्व ह
verses.transliteration: śīrṇaghrāṇā gatadhiyo hyasthicarmāvaśeṣitāḥ / teṣāṃ tvaṃ karuṇāṃ deva acireṇa kuruṣva ha
verses.translation: In that lotus was born the four-faced lord of Devas, Brahma, the chief of Prajapatis, the lord of the universe. Of its sides of different colours the eastern side is white; the southern is yellow; the western is black; and the northern is red. With variegated colours shining brightly, Meru is established like a king. It is as refulgent as the midday sun or the smokeless fire. It is eighty four thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: जपो जप्यो महायोगी महादेवों महेश्वरः । पुरेशयो गरुहाबासो खेचरो रजनोचरः ११५७ तपोनिधिर्गुहगुरुनंन्दनों नन्दिवर्धन: । हयशीर्षों धराधाता विधाता भूतियाहनः
verses.wordMeaning: In that lotus was born the four-faced lord of Devas, Brahma, the chief of Prajapatis, the lord of the universe. Of its sides of different colours the eastern side is white; the southern is yellow; the western is black; and the northern is red.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In that lotus was born the four-faced lord of Devas, Brahma, the chief of Prajapatis, the lord of the universe. Of its sides of different colours the eastern side is white; the southern is yellow; the western is black; and the northern is red.…

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽपि त्वां नर्मदातोये स्नात्वा तत्र दिने दिने । अर्चयन्ति जगन्नाथ तेषां त्वं वरदो भव
verses.transliteration: ye 'pi tvāṃ narmadātoye snātvā tatra dine dine / arcayanti jagannātha teṣāṃ tvaṃ varado bhava
verses.translation: Its depth below the surface of the earth is sixteen thousand Yojanas and at its base it extends also as much. It is situated like an arrow pointing to the east. Its diameter at the summit is thirtytwo thousand Yojanas. Its girth all round is thrice its lateral extent. The spherical curvature is half of it. It lies in three angles. Its extent all round is forty thousand Yojanas. In the angular calculation, it will be eight thousand more.
verses.hindi: बाँठ्वव्यो बोधनों नेता धूर्वहो दुष्प्रकम्पकः । वहद्रथो भीमकर्मा बृह॒त्कीतिधेनंजय:
verses.wordMeaning: Its depth below the surface of the earth is sixteen thousand Yojanas and at its base it extends also as much. It is situated like an arrow pointing to the east. Its diameter at the summit is thirtytwo thousand Yojanas. Its girth all round is thrice its lateral extent.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Its depth below the surface of the earth is sixteen thousand Yojanas and at its base it extends also as much. It is situated like an arrow pointing to the east. Its diameter at the summit is thirtytwo thousand Yojanas. Its girth all round is thrice its lateral extent.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रभाते ये स्तविष्यन्ति स्तवैर्वैदिकलौकिकैः । अभिप्रेतं वरं देव तेषां त्वं दद भोच्युत
verses.transliteration: prabhāte ye staviṣyanti stavairvaidikalaukikaiḥ / abhipretaṃ varaṃ deva teṣāṃ tvaṃ dada bhocyuta
verses.translation: In the quadrangular calculation the girth is fortyeight thousand Yojanas. That mountain is extremely rich in divine medicinal herbs. It is encircled by auspicious golden worlds. All the groups of Devas, Gandharvas,Uragas,Raksasas and splendid Apsaras-s, are seen on that lordly mountain. 1
verses.hindi: घप्टाप्रियो ध्वजी छत्री पताकाध्वजिनीपति:  कवची पट्टिसी शद्धी पाशहस्तः परश्वभृत्
verses.wordMeaning: In the quadrangular calculation the girth is fortyeight thousand Yojanas. That mountain is extremely rich in divine medicinal herbs. It is encircled by auspicious golden worlds. All the groups of Devas, Gandharvas,Uragas,Raksasas and splendid Apsaras-s,…

verses.sanskrit: तवाग्रे वपनं देव कारयन्ति नरा भुवि । स्वामिंस्तेषां वरो देय एष मे परमो वरः
verses.transliteration: tavāgre vapanaṃ deva kārayanti narā bhuvi / svāmiṃsteṣāṃ varo deya eṣa me paramo varaḥ
verses.translation: That Meru, the purifier of living beings, is encircled by worlds. Four lands are established on its different sides. 2 They are Bhadrasva (to the east), Bharata (in the south), Ketumala in the west, and the Kurus in the north. Sailarajaih is emended as Sailaraje as in A,
verses.hindi: अगस्त्वमनघः शूरो देवराजारिसर्दनः । त्वां प्रसाद्य पुरास्माभिद्विषन्तो निहेता युधि १६१ अग्निस्त्वं चारणवान्सर्वान्पिबन्नेव न तृप्यसे । क्रोधागारः प्रसब्नात्मा कामहा कासदः प्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: That Meru, the purifier of living beings, is encircled by worlds. Four lands are established on its different sides. 2 They are Bhadrasva (to the east), Bharata (in the south), Ketumala in the west, and the Kurus in the north. Sailarajaih is emended as Sailaraje as in A,

verses.sanskrit: एवमस्त्विति तं चोक्त्वा मुनिं करुणया पुनः । शतभागेन राजेन्द्र स्थित्वा चादर्शनं गतः
verses.transliteration: evamastviti taṃ coktvā muniṃ karuṇayā punaḥ / śatabhāgena rājendra sthitvā cādarśanaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Verses 56-57 state in a nutshell the # CaXur-duipi concept as follows The pericarp of- that lotus is spherical all round extending to ninety-six thousand Yojanas. The internal measure¬ ment is eighty-four thousand Yojanas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मण्यो ब्रह्मचारी च गोध्नस्त्वं शिष्टपूजित:  वेदानामव्ययः कोशस्त्वया यज्ञः प्रकल्पित:ः:
