verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरो भक्त्या गत्वा स्नानं समाचरेत् । तर्पयेत् पितृदेवांश्च सो ऽग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naro bhaktyā gatvā snānaṃ samācaret / tarpayet pitṛdevāṃśca so 'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Its filaments extend to three hundred thousand Yojanas in all directions. It has fourpetals to thefour quarters, ahundred thousand Yojanas in length and eighty thousand in width. Listen attentively to the description of what I had called before the pericarp and know it briefly.
verses.hindi: हव्यं च बेदं बहति वेदोक्त॑ हुव्यवाहन: । प्रीते त्वयि महादेव बय॑ प्रीता भवामहे
verses.wordMeaning: Its filaments extend to three hundred thousand Yojanas in all directions. It has fourpetals to thefour quarters, ahundred thousand Yojanas in length and eighty thousand in width. Listen attentively to the description of what I had called before the pericarp and know it briefly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its filaments extend to three hundred thousand Yojanas in all directions. It has fourpetals to thefour quarters, ahundred thousand Yojanas in length and eighty thousand in width. Listen attentively to the description of what I had called before the pericarp and know it briefly.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात्तस्मिंस् तीर्थे नराधिप । द्योतयन्वै दिशः सर्वा अग्निलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃs tīrthe narādhipa / dyotayanvai diśaḥ sarvā agnilokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Atri 1 thought it has a hundred angles or corners; sage Bhrgu, one thousand. According to Savarni; it is octangular, and a quadrangle according to Bhaguri. Varsayani opines that it is four-sided; Galava thinks it has the shape of a saucer; Gargya regards it as twisted braided hair; while Krostaki conjectures it to be spherical.
verses.hindi: भवानीशोष्नादिसान्धास राशिब्रह्या लोकानां त्वं कर्ता त्वादिसगं: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Atri 1 thought it has a hundred angles or corners; sage Bhrgu, one thousand. According to Savarni; it is octangular, and a quadrangle according to Bhaguri. Varsayani opines that it is four-sided; Galava thinks it has the shape of a saucer;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Atri 1 thought it has a hundred angles or corners; sage Bhrgu, one thousand. According to Savarni; it is octangular, and a quadrangle according to Bhaguri. Varsayani opines that it is four-sided; Galava thinks it has the shape of a saucer;…

verses.sanskrit: यस्तत्तीर्थं समासाद्य त्यजतीह कलेवरम् । स गतो वारुणं लोकमित्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: yastattīrthaṃ samāsādya tyajatīha kalevaram / sa gato vāruṇaṃ lokamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: Each of these sages knew only that side of this lordly mountain which was near him. Only Brahma knows the entire Know that Meru, the most excellent of mountains, The various quarters set up on the mountain contain thousands of great Devas capable of bestowing desired fruits. They have occupied the great regions there. Here is a glorious assembly-hall of Brahma, resorted to by several Brahmanical sages. It is known as Manovatl in all the worlds.
verses.hindi: एवं दुरउु्ष है। पद्ममाला से मण्डित भापके शिर पर पणड़ी की शोभा ऐसी हो रही है मानो सूर्यमण्डल में दीप्ति, चन्द्रमा में वायु, पृथ्वी में स्थैयं, वायु में बल, अग्नि में तीक्षणता, चन्द्रमा में प्रभा, आकाश में शब्द और जल में शीतलता हो । ये सब अधिसाशी, उत्तम और स्थिर जितने गुण हैं, वे आपके ही हैं, विद्वान लोग ऐसा ही कहते हैं ।१५४-१४५। आप जप, जप्य, महायोगी हादेव, महेश्वर, पुरेशय, ग्रुद्ावासी
verses.wordMeaning: Each of these sages knew only that side of this lordly mountain which was near him. Only Brahma knows the entire Know that Meru, the most excellent of mountains, The various quarters set up on the mountain contain thousands of great Devas capable of bestowing desired fruits.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Each of these sages knew only that side of this lordly mountain which was near him. Only Brahma knows the entire Know that Meru, the most excellent of mountains, The various quarters set up on the mountain contain thousands of great Devas capable of bestowing desired fruits.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित् संन्यासेन तनुं त्यजेत् । षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścit saṃnyāsena tanuṃ tyajet / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: The great aerial chariot of lord Isana, having the brilliance of a thousand suns, is there proclaiming its own glory. Devas and sages (stay there) near Brahma. The mass of splendour (god Brahma?) is glorified there. I shall describe it to you now.
verses.hindi: बोधन, नेता, धबं, दुष्प्ररम्पक, बृहद्रथ, भीमकर्मा, वृहत्कीति, घनड्जय, बण्टाप्रिय, ध्वजी, छ॑त्री, पताका रथवषति, कबची, पट्टिगी, झ्ंद्धी, पाशहस्त, परश्वभृत् अग, अनघ, शूर और इच्द्रशत्र बविनाशक हैं। आपको प्रसन्न करके हम लोगों ने पूव॑काल में युद्ध में शत्रुओं को मार। है ।१५६-१६१। आबष अग्नि हैं। सब समुद्रों को पीकर भी आप तुृप्त नहीं हुये हैं। आप क्रोधागार प्रसचन्नात्मा, काम को मारबैवाले. काम को देनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: The great aerial chariot of lord Isana, having the brilliance of a thousand suns, is there proclaiming its own glory. Devas and sages (stay there) near Brahma. The mass of splendour (god Brahma?) is glorified there. I shall describe it to you now.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great aerial chariot of lord Isana, having the brilliance of a thousand suns, is there proclaiming its own glory. Devas and sages (stay there) near Brahma. The mass of splendour (god Brahma?) is glorified there. I shall describe it to you now.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णे दिव्यशब्दानुनादिते । उषित्वायाति मर्त्ये वै वेदवेदाङ्गविद् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe divyaśabdānunādite / uṣitvāyāti martye vai vedavedāṅgavid bhavet
verses.translation: The glorious lord of riches, the thousand-eyed Indra, stays here honoured by Devas and the celestial sages of great Yogic prowess. Here alone is the region of lord Indra, the great monarch, the lord of the worlds. It is as refulgent as the sun. It is bowed to by all Siddhas. Here is the region of Indra endowed with the highest prosperity of the world. It is brightened by the excellent immortal Devas and is ever resorted to by them.
verses.hindi: स्रिय, ब्रह्मण्य, ब्रह्मचारी गोघ्न, झिध्टपूजित वेदों का अविनाशी कोष, प्रकल्पित यज्ञ और हब्यवाहव हैं। आप बेदोक्त हृव्य कों घारण करते हैं। आपके प्रसन्न होने से ही हम सब प्रसन्न होते हैं।१६२-१६३२। आप ईश, अनादि, तेजोराशि, लोककर्ता और लोकसृष्टि-कारक हैं। सांख्यज्ञाता योगिगण आपकी प्रकृति से श्रेष्ठ ज्ञान लाभ कर मृत्यु मुख से बचक्रर अमर हो जाते हैं।१६४। नित्ययुक्त योगिमण योगबल से आपको जानकर
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious lord of riches, the thousand-eyed Indra, stays here honoured by Devas and the celestial sages of great Yogic prowess. Here alone is the region of lord Indra, the great monarch, the lord of the worlds. It is as refulgent as the sun. It is bowed to by all Siddhas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious lord of riches, the thousand-eyed Indra, stays here honoured by Devas and the celestial sages of great Yogic prowess. Here alone is the region of lord Indra, the great monarch, the lord of the worlds. It is as refulgent as the sun. It is bowed to by all Siddhas.…

verses.sanskrit: व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो धनकोटिपतिर्भवेत् । पुत्रदारसमोपेतो जीवेच्च शरदः शतम्
verses.transliteration: vyādhiśokavinirmukto dhanakoṭipatirbhavet / putradārasamopeto jīvecca śaradaḥ śatam
verses.translation: In the second inner ridge, in the intermediate point between the east and the south, is the famous splendid assembly- The Fire-god is the intermediary and a distinguished deity of Brahmanas. Though he is indivisible, his splendour i s shared by all. He, the lord of splendour, assumes various forms His diversity both as the cause and effect is perceptible through concentrated mind. 5
verses.hindi: अप्रमेयस्य तत्त्वस्य यथा विद्मः स्वशक्तित:। कीतितं तब माहात्म्यमपारं परमात्मनः ॥ शिवो नो भव सत्र योईसि सो5सि नमोष्स्तु ते. ः १६७
verses.wordMeaning: In the second inner ridge, in the intermediate point between the east and the south, is the famous splendid assembly- The Fire-god is the intermediary and a distinguished deity of Brahmanas. Though he is indivisible, his splendour i s shared by all. He, the lord of splendour,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the second inner ridge, in the intermediate point between the east and the south, is the famous splendid assembly- The Fire-god is the intermediary and a distinguished deity of Brahmanas. Though he is indivisible, his splendour i s shared by all. He, the lord of splendour,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरुत्थाय यस्तत्र स्मरते भास्करं तदा । आजन्मजनितात् पापान् मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: prātarutthāya yastatra smarate bhāskaraṃ tadā / ājanmajanitāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: In the third inner ridge is a great assembly-hall of Vawasvata (god of death). It is known as Susamyama They are resorted to by the sages, Devas, Gandharvas, Apsaras-s and serpents, who come for worship. What is known and called by the synonyms of heaven, viz. Nakapjrstha, Diva and Svarga, by those who know the Vedas and their ancillaries is this. It is here where Devas live. It is so said in the Vedas. One attains this Devaloka by various observances, restraints, sacrifices or different sorts of meritorious deeds. It is called Svarga also.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते शार्वस्तवों नाम चतुविशोड्ध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: In the third inner ridge is a great assembly-hall of Vawasvata (god of death). It is known as Susamyama They are resorted to by the sages, Devas, Gandharvas, Apsaras-s and serpents, who come for worship. What is known and called by the synonyms of heaven, viz. Nakapjrstha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the third inner ridge is a great assembly-hall of Vawasvata (god of death). It is known as Susamyama They are resorted to by the sages, Devas, Gandharvas, Apsaras-s and serpents, who come for worship. What is known and called by the synonyms of heaven, viz. Nakapjrstha,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रवितीर्थवर्णनं नाम चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ३५ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: जलमध्ये महादेवः केन तिष्ठति हेतुना । उत्तरं दक्षिणं कूलं वर्जयित्वा द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ravitīrthavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 35 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: jalamadhye mahādevaḥ kena tiṣṭhati hetunā / uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kūlaṃ varjayitvā dvijottama
verses.translation: What is described as the root of the pericarp 1 is seventy thousand Yojanas beneath.
verses.hindi: भोगों का परित्याग कर देते हैं। जो मत्यं आपका साक्षात्कार करके विशुद्ध होते हैं, वे अपने कमंफल के अनुसार दिव्य भोगों का उपभोग करते हैं ।!६६। आप अप्रमेय तत्त्व हैं। अपनी शक्ति से जसे हमने आपको समझा वसा ही आपके अपार माहात्म्य का कीर्तन किया। आप हमारे लिये सवंत्र कल्याण-कारक हों। आप जो हैं, वही हैं अर्थात् आप अज्ञेय और अप्राप्य हैं आपको नमस्कार है!
verses.wordMeaning: What is described as the root of the pericarp 1 is seventy thousand Yojanas beneath.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is described as the root of the pericarp 1 is seventy thousand Yojanas beneath.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: एतदाख्यानमतुलं पुण्यं श्रुतिमुखावहम् । पुराणे यच्छ्रुतं तात तत्ते वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etadākhyānamatulaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutimukhāvaham / purāṇe yacchrutaṃ tāta tatte vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: It is heard that a sphere of fortyeight thousand Yojanas encompassed by the lord of mountains is what is called Merumula (Root of Meru).
verses.hindi: संपिबन्निव तो दृष्ट्वा सधुपिड्धायतेक्षण: । प्रहष्टवदनोउत्यर्थंभभवण्च स्थकीतेनात् १ उमायतिबिख्याक्षो दक्षयज्ञविनाशन: । पिनाकी खण्डपरशुभृतप्रान्तस्त्रिलोचनः
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard that a sphere of fortyeight thousand Yojanas encompassed by the lord of mountains is what is called Merumula (Root of Meru).
verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard that a sphere of fortyeight thousand Yojanas encompassed by the lord of mountains is what is called Merumula (Root of Meru).

verses.sanskrit: त्रेतायुगे महाभाग रावणो देवकण्टकः । त्रैलोक्यविजयी रौद्रः सुरासुरभयंकरः
verses.transliteration: tretāyuge mahābhāga rāvaṇo devakaṇṭakaḥ / trailokyavijayī raudraḥ surāsurabhayaṃkaraḥ
verses.translation: In all the quarters, there are boundary mountains, the loftiest among thousands of mountains.
verses.hindi: ततः स भगवान्देव: श्रुत्वा वाक्‍्यामृतं तयो: । जानन्नपि महाभागः प्रीतिपूर्व मथाब्रवीत् ॥ रे को भवन्तो महात्मानों परस्परहितषिणों । समेतावम्बुजाभाक्षो तस्मिन्धोरे जलप्लवे ४
verses.wordMeaning: In all the quarters, there are boundary mountains, the loftiest among thousands of mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the quarters, there are boundary mountains, the loftiest among thousands of mountains.

verses.sanskrit: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर् ऋषिभिश्च तपोधनैः । अवध्यो ऽथ विमानेन यावत्पर्यटते महीम्
verses.transliteration: devadānavagandharvair ṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ / avadhyo 'tha vimānena yāvatparyaṭate mahīm
verses.translation: They are beautified by hedges, caves, rivers and rivulets. They have many ridges like huge mansions shinmg with flowers. Their sides are beautified by minerals. Their flanks are decorated by clusters of flowers. Their peaks are golden brown. Many streams flow over them. All these mountains are richly decorated with gems; There are inimitable bowers with hundreds of birds resorting to them. Lions, tigers, Sarabhas (a mythological eight¬ footed animal)-, Camarl deer and elephants live there. They (boundary mountains) are bounded by mountain (ranges) of various shapes and colours.
verses.hindi: तयोस्तद्वचन श्रुत्वा ह्याभिनन्धयानुमान्य च। उबाच भगवान्देवों सधुरशुक्ष्णया गिरा ॥ भो भो हिरण्यगर्भ त्वां त्वां च कृष्ण वदास्यहम् का ा १६
verses.wordMeaning: They are beautified by hedges, caves, rivers and rivulets. They have many ridges like huge mansions shinmg with flowers. Their sides are beautified by minerals. Their flanks are decorated by clusters of flowers. Their peaks are golden brown. Many streams flow over them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are beautified by hedges, caves, rivers and rivulets. They have many ridges like huge mansions shinmg with flowers. Their sides are beautified by minerals. Their flanks are decorated by clusters of flowers. Their peaks are golden brown. Many streams flow over them.…

verses.sanskrit: तावद्धिन्ध्यगिरेर् मध्ये दानवो बलदर्पितः । मयो नामेति विख्यातो गुहावासी तपश्चरन्
verses.transliteration: tāvaddhindhyagirer madhye dānavo baladarpitaḥ / mayo nāmeti vikhyāto guhāvāsī tapaścaran
verses.translation: This is a continuation of the description of Mt. Meru. The author
verses.hindi: मधुकेटभ की उत्पत्ति और विनाश
verses.wordMeaning: This is a continuation of the description of Mt. Meru. The author
verses.commentary: Sense: This is a continuation of the description of Mt. Meru. The author

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पार्श्वगतो रक्षो विनयाद् अवनिं गतः । पूजितो दानसन्मानैर् इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tasya pārśvagato rakṣo vinayād avaniṃ gataḥ / pūjito dānasanmānair idaṃ vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Each of the ten mountains is marked by the sun r and the black deer. They have three streams (?) flowing in and
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--मधु की भांति पिड्जल और बड़ी बड़ी आँखों वाले विरूपाक्ष, दक्षयज्ञ विनाशक, पिनाकी, खण्डपरशु, भूतप्रान्त, जिलोचन, पहले तो इस प्रकार देखते थे मानो वे दोनों देवताओं) को पी जाय॑गे परन्तु पीछे अपनी स्तुति सुनकर उनको अपार हफष हुआ। उन देवों की सरस स्तुति-वाणी को सुनकर सब कुछ जानते हुये भी अनजान की भांति प्रेमपुवंक बोले--१-३॥ कमल के समान सुन्दर नेत्रों वाले आप दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: Each of the ten mountains is marked by the sun r and the black deer. They have three streams (?) flowing in and
verses.commentary: Sense: Each of the ten mountains is marked by the sun r and the black deer. They have three streams (?) flowing in and

verses.sanskrit: कस्येयं पद्मपत्राक्षी पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना । किंनामधेया तपति तप उग्रं कथं विभो
verses.transliteration: kasyeyaṃ padmapatrākṣī pūrṇacandranibhānanā / kiṃnāmadheyā tapati tapa ugraṃ kathaṃ vibho
verses.translation: To the east of Meru are the two mountains Jathara 1 and
verses.hindi: महत्मा कौन हैं जो उस घोर प्रलय समुद्र में एक दूसरे की हिताकांक्षा से यहाँ प्रकट हुये हैं। यह सुनकर वे दोनों एक दूसरे की ओर देखकर बोले--भगवनु् ! विभो ! सब रहस्य को जानते हुये भी आप क्‍यों इस प्रकार पूछ रहे हैं? आपके बिना कहाँ पर हम अत्यन्त सुख की आशा कर सकते हैं ।४-५। उन दोनों की विनीत वाणी को सुनकर भगवान् शंकर ले उनका अभिननन्‍्दन किया और उनकी सराहना करते हुये मधुर
verses.wordMeaning: To the east of Meru are the two mountains Jathara 1 and
verses.commentary: Sense: To the east of Meru are the two mountains Jathara 1 and

verses.sanskrit: मय उवाच: दानवानां पतिः श्रेष्ठो मयो ऽहं नाम नामतः । भार्या तेजोवती नाम तस्यास्तु तनया शुभा
verses.transliteration: maya uvāca: dānavānāṃ patiḥ śreṣṭho mayo 'haṃ nāma nāmataḥ / bhāryā tejovatī nāma tasyāstu tanayā śubhā
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, now I shall tell you the diameter of Meru, the mountain of gold.
verses.hindi: इृदमर्ध नास्ति क. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, now I shall tell you the diameter of Meru, the mountain of gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, now I shall tell you the diameter of Meru, the mountain of gold.

verses.sanskrit: मन्दोदरीति विख्याता तपते भर्तृकारणात् । आराधयन्ती भर्तारमुमाया दयितं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: mandodarīti vikhyātā tapate bhartṛkāraṇāt / ārādhayantī bhartāramumāyā dayitaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Meru has four great ranges (lees) in all the fx„-
verses.hindi: युवाभ्यां कि ददाम्यका चराणां वरशुससम् क्‍ द ७ वेबेशमुक्ते यचने ब्रह्माणं विष्णुरग्रवीत् । ब्रहि ब्रहि महाभाग वरो यस्‍्ते विवक्षित: . शाद प्रजाकामो स्म्यहूं विष्णो पुत्रसच्छामि धर्थहम्  ततः स भगवास्त्रह्मा बरेष्सु: पुत्न॒लिप्सयया .
verses.wordMeaning: Meru has four great ranges (lees) in all the fx„-
verses.commentary: Sense: Meru has four great ranges (lees) in all the fx„-

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य रावणो मदमोहितः । प्रसृतः प्रणतो भूत्वा मयं वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya rāvaṇo madamohitaḥ / prasṛtaḥ praṇato bhūtvā mayaṃ vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: They have thickly grown smooth dark leaves, with large fruits and flowers. They cover the ground with shade. They are very lofty.
verses.hindi: अथ विष्णुरवाचेद प्रजाकामं प्रजापतिम् । वोरमप्रतिमं पुत्र यत्वमिच्छसि धवहम्.. १० बुअल्वेंनाभियुटःक्ष्व त्वं वेबदेव॑ महेश्वरम् । स तस्य वाक्य संपुज्य केशवस्य पितामहः ..
verses.wordMeaning: They have thickly grown smooth dark leaves, with large fruits and flowers. They cover the ground with shade. They are very lofty.
verses.commentary: Sense: They have thickly grown smooth dark leaves, with large fruits and flowers. They cover the ground with shade. They are very lofty.

verses.sanskrit: पौलस्त्यान्वयसंजातो देवदानवदर्पहा । प्रार्थयामि महाभाग सुतां त्वं दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: paulastyānvayasaṃjāto devadānavadarpahā / prārthayāmi mahābhāga sutāṃ tvaṃ dātumarhasi
verses.translation: Four great trees which are the land-marks of the conti¬ nent, have grown there. They are resorted to bySiddhas, Yaksas and Gandharvas.
verses.hindi: ईशान बरदं र्मभिवाद कृताऊुजलिः । उवाच पुत्रकासस्तु वाब्यानि सह विष्णुना १२ बदि से भगवान्प्रीतः पुत्र॒कासस्य नित्यश:ः । पुत्रों से भव विश्वात्मन्स्वतुल्यों वाईपि धवेहः..
verses.wordMeaning: Four great trees which are the land-marks of the conti¬ nent, have grown there. They are resorted to bySiddhas, Yaksas and Gandharvas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four great trees which are the land-marks of the conti¬ nent, have grown there. They are resorted to bySiddhas, Yaksas and Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा पैतामहं वृत्तं मयेनापि महात्मना । रावणाय सुता दत्ता पूजयित्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: jñātvā paitāmahaṃ vṛttaṃ mayenāpi mahātmanā / rāvaṇāya sutā dattā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: On the peak of mountain Mandara, there is a great tree Keturdf (the king of banners) with hanging branches. There is a Kandara tree also.
verses.hindi: बहएदे वरमहं वज़े प्रीतें त्विय भहेश्वर ) तस्य तां प्रार्थनां भुत्वा भगवान्भगनेत्रहा
verses.wordMeaning: On the peak of mountain Mandara, there is a great tree Keturdf (the king of banners) with hanging branches. There is a Kandara tree also.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the peak of mountain Mandara, there is a great tree Keturdf (the king of banners) with hanging branches. There is a Kandara tree also.

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा तां तदा रक्षो ऽभ्यर्च्यमानो निशाचरैः । देवोद्याने विमानैश्च क्रीडते स तया सह
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā tāṃ tadā rakṣo 'bhyarcyamāno niśācaraiḥ / devodyāne vimānaiśca krīḍate sa tayā saha
verses.translation: It is splendid with excessive fragrant, full-blown flowers as big as a pitcher, with filaments spread out. They bloom inall seasons.
verses.hindi: निष्याल्मघम माय व बाठमित्यंत्रवीद्रय: । यदा कार्यसमारम्भे कस्मिश्रित्तव सुन्नत १५ अभिष्पत्तो च कार्यस्न क्रोधस्त्वां समुपष्यति । आत्मंकादश ये रुद्रा विहिताः प्राणहेतव:... ७४१६
verses.wordMeaning: It is splendid with excessive fragrant, full-blown flowers as big as a pitcher, with filaments spread out. They bloom inall seasons.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is splendid with excessive fragrant, full-blown flowers as big as a pitcher, with filaments spread out. They bloom inall seasons.

verses.sanskrit: केनचित्त्वथ कालेन रावणो लोकरावणः । पुत्रं पुत्रवतां श्रेष्ठो जनयामास भारत
verses.transliteration: kenacittvatha kālena rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ / putraṃ putravatāṃ śreṣṭho janayāmāsa bhārata
verses.translation: Wafted by the gentle wind, the fragrance fills up the quarters to more than a thousand Yojanas around.
verses.hindi: लोइहमेकावशात्मा थे शूलहस्तः सहानुगः । ऋषिभित्रों महात्मा वे ललाटाज़ूबिता तदा.
verses.wordMeaning: Wafted by the gentle wind, the fragrance fills up the quarters to more than a thousand Yojanas around.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wafted by the gentle wind, the fragrance fills up the quarters to more than a thousand Yojanas around.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव जातमात्रेण रावो मुक्तो महात्मना । संवर्तकस्य मेघस्य तेन लोका जडीकृताः
verses.transliteration: tenaiva jātamātreṇa rāvo mukto mahātmanā / saṃvartakasya meghasya tena lokā jaḍīkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the continent Bhadrasva 1 is well- known as Varakelu. Here Visnu is directly worshipped by groups of Siddhas. Formerly Hari (Indra), the most excellent among Devas, riding a white horse and accompanied by a group of Rudras, travelled over the entire continent. O leaders of Brahmanas, the continent is, therefore called Bhadrasva.
verses.hindi: और मृद्ु वाणी से बोले--"दिरण्यगर्भ और कृष्ण ! सुनो, तुम दोनों को इस नित्य अक्षरों से युक्त भक्ति से परम . प्रसन्न छू । आप दोनों मेरे मान्य और पूज्य हैं, आप लोगों को मैं कोन सा उत्तम वर दूं
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the continent Bhadrasva 1 is well- known as Varakelu. Here Visnu is directly worshipped by groups of Siddhas. Formerly Hari (Indra), the most excellent among Devas, riding a white horse and accompanied by a group of Rudras, travelled over the entire continent.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the continent Bhadrasva 1 is well- known as Varakelu. Here Visnu is directly worshipped by groups of Siddhas. Formerly Hari (Indra), the most excellent among Devas, riding a white horse and accompanied by a group of Rudras, travelled over the entire continent.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तन्नर्दितं घोरं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । नाम चक्रे तदा तस्य मेघनादो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tannarditaṃ ghoraṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / nāma cakre tadā tasya meghanādo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: There is a Jambu tree (Rose Apple) on the top of the southern mountain. It is resorted to by Devas. It ever blooms and bears fruits. It shines with garlands of flowers.
verses.hindi: द्विब की ऐसी बालें सुनकर विष्णु ब्रहा से कहा--महाभाग ! माँधो, जो वर तुमको अभीष्ठ हो उसको. माँगो। तदवन्धर वर चाहने वाले भगवान ब्ह्मा ने कहा--विष्णो ! मुझे पुत्र की इच्छा है, मैं ऐसा पुत्र चाहता हे जो मेरे आर को हल्का कर दे। विष्णु ने पुत्रेच्छ प्रजापति से कहा कि, यदि तुम अप्रतिम, वी” ओर धुरन्धर पुत्र को-चाहते हो तो देव-देव महेदबर को ही अपना पुत्र बनने के लिये कहो ।  उस पितामह ने केशव
verses.wordMeaning: There is a Jambu tree (Rose Apple) on the top of the southern mountain. It is resorted to by Devas. It ever blooms and bears fruits. It shines with garlands of flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a Jambu tree (Rose Apple) on the top of the southern mountain. It is resorted to by Devas. It ever blooms and bears fruits. It shines with garlands of flowers.

verses.sanskrit: एवंनामा कृतः सो ऽपि परमं व्रतमास्थितः । तोषयामास देवेशमुमया सह शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃnāmā kṛtaḥ so 'pi paramaṃ vratamāsthitaḥ / toṣayāmāsa deveśamumayā saha śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Its roots and branches are very extensive. Its branches are of pleasing colours. The tree is always bedecked with fresh flowers, fruits and branches.
verses.hindi: के उत बुझान को मान लिया और स्वयं ईशान, वरदाता, .रुद्र का अभिवादन कर हाथ जोड़कर पुत्रप्राप्ति की. इच्छा से-विष्णु के साथ कहा--भगवन् ! पुत्र की कामना करने वाले मुझ पर यदि आप प्रसन्न हैं तो विद्बात्मस  अपने समन धुरन्धर कार्यक्षम पुत्र दें। महेश्वर ! आपके प्रसन्न हो जाने पर दूसरा वर मैं नहीं कहता !' ।+११-१३६। भग के नेत्र को फोड़ देने वाले भगवान् ने ब्रह्मा की उस प्राथंना को सुनकर
verses.wordMeaning: Its roots and branches are very extensive. Its branches are of pleasing colours. The tree is always bedecked with fresh flowers, fruits and branches.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its roots and branches are very extensive. Its branches are of pleasing colours. The tree is always bedecked with fresh flowers, fruits and branches.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतैर्नियमदानैश्च होमजाप्यविधानतः । कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणैर्नित्यं कृशं कुर्वन्कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: vratairniyamadānaiśca homajāpyavidhānataḥ / kṛcchracāndrāyaṇairnityaṃ kṛśaṃ kurvankalevaram
verses.translation: The sweet and soft fruits of huge size falling on the peak of the mountain are nectar-like in taste.
verses.hindi: स्पष्ट शब्दों में कहा--'ऐसा ही होगा । सुब्रत ! तुम जब किसी काये को आरम्भ करोगे और उस काम में मड़चन भा ज/ने पर जब तुमको क्रोध होगा तो उस समय सब प्राणियों के जीवन के कारण जों एकादश रूह कहे भये हैं, जो-भेरे ही रूप हैं. उनके रूप में शुलवाणि महात्मा और ऋषि एकादझ्ात्मा मैं तुम्हरे ललाट से-प्रकट़ होऊँगा ।१४-१७॥ पहले ब्रह्मा के ऊपर इस प्रकार अपनी अनृपम प्रसन्नता दिखाकर फिर विष्णु से बोले;
verses.wordMeaning: The sweet and soft fruits of huge size falling on the peak of the mountain are nectar-like in taste.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sweet and soft fruits of huge size falling on the peak of the mountain are nectar-like in taste.

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अन्यद्दिने तात कैलासं धरणीधरम् । गत्वा लिङ्गद्वयं गृह्य प्रस्थितो दक्षिणामुखः
verses.transliteration: evam anyaddine tāta kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam / gatvā liṅgadvayaṃ gṛhya prasthito dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
verses.translation: From the table-land on the top of this excellent mountain, flows the river Jambu with currents of honey.
verses.hindi: प्रसादमतुल कृत्वा ब्रह्मणस्तादृ्श पुरा । विष्णु पुनरवाचेदं ददासि च वरं तब... शश्द स होवाच महाभागो विष्णुभंवमिदं वचः । स्वमेतत्कृतं देवं परितुष्टोईइसि मे यदि॥
verses.wordMeaning: From the table-land on the top of this excellent mountain, flows the river Jambu with currents of honey.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the table-land on the top of this excellent mountain, flows the river Jambu with currents of honey.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातटम् आश्रित्य स्नातुकामो महाबलः । निक्षिप्य पूजयन् देवं कृतजाप्यो नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: narmadātaṭam āśritya snātukāmo mahābalaḥ / nikṣipya pūjayan devaṃ kṛtajāpyo nareśvara
verses.translation: Gold known as Jarhbunada, with the lustre of burning fire, is formed here. It is the incomparable ornament of Devas and the destroyer of sins.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तस्ततो देवः समभाषत केशवम् । विष्णों शुणु यथा देव प्रीतोहहूं तब शाश्वत  २० प्रकाशं चाप्रकाशं च जहगमं स्थावरं च यत् । विश्वरूपसिदं सर्व रुद्रनारायणात्मकम् . ४२११ अहमग्निर्भवान्सोमों भवान्रात्रिरहं दिनम् । भवानृतमहं सत्यं भवान्क्रतुरहं फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Gold known as Jarhbunada, with the lustre of burning fire, is formed here. It is the incomparable ornament of Devas and the destroyer of sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gold known as Jarhbunada, with the lustre of burning fire, is formed here. It is the incomparable ornament of Devas and the destroyer of sins.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रायतनावासेन स्नातो हुतहुताशनः । कृतकृत्यमिवात्मानं मानयित्वा निशाचरः
verses.transliteration: tatrāyatanāvāsena snāto hutahutāśanaḥ / kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ mānayitvā niśācaraḥ
verses.translation: Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pannagas (serpents) drink the honey, the juice exuding from the Jambu tree which is as sweet as nectar.
verses.hindi: भवान्ज्ञानमहं ज्ञेयं यज्जपित्वा सदा जना: । मां विशन्ति त्वयि प्रीते जनाः सुकृतकारिण: ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pannagas (serpents) drink the honey, the juice exuding from the Jambu tree which is as sweet as nectar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pannagas (serpents) drink the honey, the juice exuding from the Jambu tree which is as sweet as nectar.

verses.sanskrit: गन्तुकामः परं मार्गं लङ्कायां नृपसत्तम । एकमुद्धरतो लिङ्गं प्रणतः सव्यपाणिना
verses.transliteration: gantukāmaḥ paraṃ mārgaṃ laṅkāyāṃ nṛpasattama / ekamuddharato liṅgaṃ praṇataḥ savyapāṇinā
verses.translation: Bhadrasva is the Tarim-Hwango-Ho basin or North China (AGP 64, 65, 73). That eternal Jambu tree which is well-known in the world is the landmark in the southern continent. 1 The continent is called Jariibudvipa after its name.
verses.hindi: आत्मानं प्रकृति विद्धि मां विद्धि पुरुष शिवम् । भवान्धंशरीरं मे त्वहूं तव तथेव च.
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadrasva is the Tarim-Hwango-Ho basin or North China (AGP 64, 65, 73). That eternal Jambu tree which is well-known in the world is the landmark in the southern continent. 1 The continent is called Jariibudvipa after its name.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadrasva is the Tarim-Hwango-Ho basin or North China (AGP 64, 65, 73). That eternal Jambu tree which is well-known in the world is the landmark in the southern continent. 1 The continent is called Jariibudvipa after its name.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं तु द्वितीयेन भक्त्या पौलस्त्यनन्दनः । तावद् एव महालिङ्गं पतितं नर्मदांभसि
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṃ tu dvitīyena bhaktyā paulastyanandanaḥ / tāvad eva mahāliṅgaṃ patitaṃ narmadāṃbhasi
verses.translation: A great Asvattha tree grows oil the peak of the great western mountain Vipula. 2
verses.hindi: वामपाश्व महन्महा' श्याम श्रीवत्सलक्षणम् । त्वं च बामेतरं पाश्वें त्वहं वे नलिलोहितः.
verses.wordMeaning: A great Asvattha tree grows oil the peak of the great western mountain Vipula. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: A great Asvattha tree grows oil the peak of the great western mountain Vipula. 2

verses.sanskrit: याहि याहीति चेत्युक्त्वा जलमध्ये प्रतिष्ठितः । नमित्वा रावणिस्तस्य देवस्य परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: yāhi yāhīti cetyuktvā jalamadhye pratiṣṭhitaḥ / namitvā rāvaṇistasya devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: It has hanging garlands, and golden platforms set with gems. Its trunk and branches are very lofty. It is the abode of many living beings. It abounds in good qualities. That tree is the landmark of the people of Ketumala. It is embellished with auspicious fruits growing in all seasons. They are of the size of big pots land very pleasing. The tree is resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas.
verses.hindi: त्वं च ते हृदयं विष्णो तब चाह हृदि स्थितः। भवास्सवंस्य कार्यस्य कर्ताउहइमधिदवतम्
verses.wordMeaning: It has hanging garlands, and golden platforms set with gems. Its trunk and branches are very lofty. It is the abode of many living beings. It abounds in good qualities. That tree is the landmark of the people of Ketumala.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It has hanging garlands, and golden platforms set with gems. Its trunk and branches are very lofty. It is the abode of many living beings. It abounds in good qualities. That tree is the landmark of the people of Ketumala.…

verses.sanskrit: जगामाकाशम् आविश्य पूज्यमानो निशाचरैः । तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं मेघनादेति विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: jagāmākāśam āviśya pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ / tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ meghanādeti viśrutam
verses.translation: How the continent came to be known as Ketumala, O great Bralunanas, hear. I shall tell you the etymology of the name.
verses.hindi: तवेहि स्वस्ति ते वत्स गमिष्याम्यम्बुदप्रभ  एवमुक्त्वा गतो विष्णोदेवोन्तर्धानमीश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: How the continent came to be known as Ketumala, O great Bralunanas, hear. I shall tell you the etymology of the name.
verses.commentary: Sense: How the continent came to be known as Ketumala, O great Bralunanas, hear. I shall tell you the etymology of the name.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं तु गर्जनं नाम सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् । तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र यस्तु स्नानं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṃ tu garjanaṃ nāma sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram / tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra yastu snānaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: After the churning of the milk ocean the Daityas were defeated; on being pressed in the tumult of the battle, when the trees shook, a garland wreathed by the thousand-eyed lord Indra was put round the trunk of that Asvattha tree (as a form of worship). It still retains its excessive fragrance. It never fades. It bestows all desires. That blessed garland is worshipped by Siddhas and Caranas.
verses.hindi: ततः सो5न्तहिते देवे संप्रहृष्टस्तदा पुनः । अशेत शयने भुयः प्रविश्यान्तजले हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: After the churning of the milk ocean the Daityas were defeated; on being pressed in the tumult of the battle, when the trees shook, a garland wreathed by the thousand-eyed lord Indra was put round the trunk of that Asvattha tree (as a form of worship).…
verses.commentary: Sense: After the churning of the milk ocean the Daityas were defeated; on being pressed in the tumult of the battle, when the trees shook, a garland wreathed by the thousand-eyed lord Indra was put round the trunk of that Asvattha tree (as a form of worship).…

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा अश्वमेधफलं लभेत् । पिण्डदानं तु यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप
verses.transliteration: ahorātroṣito bhūtvā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / piṇḍadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa
verses.translation: Symbolised with the two names (Ketu and Mala) joined together, the continent is known as Ketumala. 2 It lies in

verses.wordMeaning: Symbolised with the two names (Ketu and Mala) joined together, the continent is known as Ketumala. 2 It lies in
verses.commentary: Sense: Symbolised with the two names (Ketu and Mala) joined together, the continent is known as Ketumala. 2 It lies in

verses.sanskrit: यत्फलं सत्त्रयज्ञेन तद्भवेन्नात्र संशयः । तेन द्वादशवर्षाणि पितरः संप्रतर्पिताः
verses.transliteration: yatphalaṃ sattrayajñena tadbhavennātra saṃśayaḥ / tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi pitaraḥ saṃpratarpitāḥ
verses.translation: A popular etymology. On the northern peak of the mountain great fig tree grows up with extensive branches, area of many Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु भोजयते विप्रं षड्रसात्रेन भारत । अक्षयपुण्यम् आप्नोति तत्र तीर्थे नरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: yastu bhojayate vipraṃ ṣaḍrasātrena bhārata / akṣayapuṇyam āpnoti tatra tīrthe narottama
verses.translation: This tree is the landmark of the northern Kuru country It shines with fruits full of honey. The fruits resemble the coral cup.
verses.hindi: तुमको भी वर दूँगा ।” महाभाग विष्णु यह सुनकर शिव से बोले--दिव : यदि आप मेरे ऊपर प्रसन्न हैं तो आपने मेरे लिये सब कुछ कर दिया । मेघवाहन ! तुममें मेरी अचल भक्ति रहे ।' शद्भूर इन बातों को सुनकर फिर केशव से बोले--१5-१६ १। विष्णो ! देव ! शाइवत ! सुनो, मेरी जसी तुम्हारे ऊपर प्रीति है । प्रकाश भप्रकाश जख्म, स्थावर अथवा बहू सारा विद्व-रूप रुद्र और नारायणभय है।२०-२१। मैं अग्नि हूं तुम
verses.wordMeaning: This tree is the landmark of the northern Kuru country It shines with fruits full of honey. The fruits resemble the coral cup.
verses.commentary: Sense: This tree is the landmark of the northern Kuru country It shines with fruits full of honey. The fruits resemble the coral cup.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणत्यागं तु यः कुर्याद् भावितो भावितात्मना । स वसेच्छाङ्करे लोके यावद् आ भूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: prāṇatyāgaṃ tu yaḥ kuryād bhāvito bhāvitātmanā / sa vasecchāṅkare loke yāvad ā bhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: Seven mental sons of Brahma, the blessed younger brothers of Sanatkumara, stay there. They are known as Kurus. They attained (spiritual) knowledge in that region. They are characterised by piety and good qualities. They are of meritorious fame. This eternal, imperishable, great region has been actained by them.
verses.hindi: सोम हो, तुम रात्रि और मैं दिन हूँ । तुम ऋत हो मैं सत्य, तुम यज्ञ और मैं फल हु । तुम ज्ञान हो तो मैं ज्ञेय हें । सुकुत करने वाले जन तुम्हारा जपकर, तुमको प्रसन्न कर मुझमें भी प्रविष्ट हो जाते हैं। युगक्षय काल में हम दोनों को छोड़कर दूसरी कोई गति नहीं ।२२-२३। तुम अपने को प्रकृति समझो ओर मुझे पुरुष शिव । तुम जिस प्रक/र मेरे आधे शरीर हो, उसी प्रकार मैं भी तुम्हारा आधा शरीर हूं। तुम हमारे महान्
verses.wordMeaning: Seven mental sons of Brahma, the blessed younger brothers of Sanatkumara, stay there. They are known as Kurus. They attained (spiritual) knowledge in that region. They are characterised by piety and good qualities. They are of meritorious fame. This eternal, imperishable,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Seven mental sons of Brahma, the blessed younger brothers of Sanatkumara, stay there. They are known as Kurus. They attained (spiritual) knowledge in that region. They are characterised by piety and good qualities. They are of meritorious fame. This eternal, imperishable,…

verses.sanskrit: एषा ते नरशार्दूल गर्जनोत्पत्तिरुत्तमा । कथिता स्नेहबन्धेन सर्वपापक्षयकरी
verses.transliteration: eṣā te naraśārdūla garjanotpattiruttamā / kathitā snehabandhena sarvapāpakṣayakarī
verses.translation: This continent has derived its name from those seven great souls. The northern Kurus 1 are famous here and in the heaven for ever.
verses.hindi: और मैं तम्हारे हृदय में स्थिर हूँ। तुम सभी कार्यों के कर्ता और हम कार्याधिष्ठित देवता हैं
verses.wordMeaning: This continent has derived its name from those seven great souls. The northern Kurus 1 are famous here and in the heaven for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: This continent has derived its name from those seven great souls. The northern Kurus 1 are famous here and in the heaven for ever.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मेघनादतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ३६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेच्च राजेन्द्र दारुतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । दारुको यत्र संसिद्ध इन्द्रस्य दयितः पुरा
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe meghanādatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 36 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchecca rājendra dārutīrthamanuttamam / dāruko yatra saṃsiddha indrasya dayitaḥ purā
verses.translation: The place abounds in Sarikas (the bird Turdus Salica ), pea¬ cocks, inebriated Cakoras, parrots, kingly bees and leopards all round.
verses.hindi: वत्स ! जलदाभ ! तुम्हारा बल्याण हो । मैं अब जाता हु। यह कहकर देवाधिदेव महादेव अन्‍्तर्द्धान हो गये । महादेव जी के चले जाने पर प्रसन्न होकर विष्णु भगवान् फिर शयन करने के लिये जल में घुस गये ।२७ २८। तब पद्माक्ष, १द्मजन्मा बहा भी प्रसन्न होकर उस पद्मगर्भ की झाभातराले उपयुक्त पद्मासन पर
verses.wordMeaning: The place abounds in Sarikas (the bird Turdus Salica ), pea¬ cocks, inebriated Cakoras, parrots, kingly bees and leopards all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: The place abounds in Sarikas (the bird Turdus Salica ), pea¬ cocks, inebriated Cakoras, parrots, kingly bees and leopards all round.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: दारुकेण कथं तात तपश्चीर्णं पुरानघ । विधानं श्रोतुमिच्छामि त्वत्सकाशाद्द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: dārukeṇa kathaṃ tāta tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha / vidhānaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatsakāśāddvijottama
verses.translation: The spots are everywhere charming with the melodious sounds of the Jivarfijivaka(Cakora) birds, the sounds of Hemakas (?), the cooing notes of inebriated cuckoos and the bleating sounds
verses.hindi: अथ दीर्घेण कालेन तत्राप्यप्रतिमावुभा । महाबलौ महासत्त्वों आतरो मधुकेटभी.+“ +8० (+तत्पद्मं॑ तरुणार्काभ दीप्ताओ तमशालिनों । फम्पपामासतुर्वोरी हसनन्‍्ताबिव निर्भया  / «पड.
verses.wordMeaning: The spots are everywhere charming with the melodious sounds of the Jivarfijivaka(Cakora) birds, the sounds of Hemakas (?), the cooing notes of inebriated cuckoos and the bleating sounds
verses.commentary: Sense: The spots are everywhere charming with the melodious sounds of the Jivarfijivaka(Cakora) birds, the sounds of Hemakas (?), the cooing notes of inebriated cuckoos and the bleating sounds

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि विचित्रं यत्पुरातनम् । वृत्तं स्वर्गसभामध्ये ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi vicitraṃ yatpurātanam / vṛttaṃ svargasabhāmadhye ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām
verses.translation: The forest regions appear to be singing with the sweet humming sounds of the excessively lazy and intoxicated bees. They are resorted to by Kinnaras in some places.
verses.hindi: दारणं तु तयोर्भाव॑ ज्ञात्वा पुष्करसंभवः । माहात्म्यं चाघत्मनो बुद्ध्वा विज्ञातुमुपचक़्से.. ॥हे हैः कणिकाघटन भूयों नाभ्यजानाग्दा गतिम्॥। ततः स पद्मनालेन अवतीयय रसातलमू॥ 7४०7 +
verses.wordMeaning: The forest regions appear to be singing with the sweet humming sounds of the excessively lazy and intoxicated bees. They are resorted to by Kinnaras in some places.
verses.commentary: Sense: The forest regions appear to be singing with the sweet humming sounds of the excessively lazy and intoxicated bees. They are resorted to by Kinnaras in some places.

verses.sanskrit: सूतो वज्रधरस्येष्टो मातलिर्नाम नामतः । स पुत्रं शप्तवान्पूर्वं कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे
verses.transliteration: sūto vajradharasyeṣṭo mātalirnāma nāmataḥ / sa putraṃ śaptavānpūrvaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare
verses.translation: The trees, shaken by the gentle winds, rain flowers there. They shine with their charming tender sprouts.
verses.hindi: स च त॑ बोधयामास विबुद्धं चेदमब्रवीत् । भृतेभ्पों मे भय देव त्रायस्वोत्तिष्ठ शं कुरे. 5
verses.wordMeaning: The trees, shaken by the gentle winds, rain flowers there. They shine with their charming tender sprouts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The trees, shaken by the gentle winds, rain flowers there. They shine with their charming tender sprouts.

verses.sanskrit: शापाहतो वेपमान इन्द्रस्य चरणौ शुभौ । प्रपीड्य मूर्ध्ना देवेशं विज्ञापयति भारत
verses.transliteration: śāpāhato vepamāna indrasya caraṇau śubhau / prapīḍya mūrdhnā deveśaṃ vijñāpayati bhārata
verses.translation: They are equipped with bunches and clusters of flowers and copper-coloured tender sprouts swinging gently due to the mild wind.
verses.hindi: ततः स भगवान्विष्ण:ः सप्रहासमरिदमः । न भेतव्यं न भेतव्यमित्युबाच सुनिः स्वयमू 7? ॥रैेह
verses.wordMeaning: They are equipped with bunches and clusters of flowers and copper-coloured tender sprouts swinging gently due to the mild wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are equipped with bunches and clusters of flowers and copper-coloured tender sprouts swinging gently due to the mild wind.

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाचाभिशप्तं चाप्यनाथं च सुरेश्वरः । कर्मणा केन शापस्य घोरस्यान्तो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tamuvācābhiśaptaṃ cāpyanāthaṃ ca sureśvaraḥ / karmaṇā kena śāpasya ghorasyānto bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, hundreds of shining pebbles and diverse minerals get mixed with the barks of trees and rinds of fruits scattered splendidly.
verses.hindi: भर्भुवः स्वस्ततो देव॑ विविशुस्तमयो निजम् । तत:ः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा तमेवाउप्सीनमोगतम् 7 ॥रेछ: गते तस्मिस्तुतो5ननन्‍त उद्गीये भ्रातरों मुखात् । विष्णुं विष्णुं च प्रोवाच ब्रह्माणमभिरक्षताम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, hundreds of shining pebbles and diverse minerals get mixed with the barks of trees and rinds of fruits scattered splendidly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, hundreds of shining pebbles and diverse minerals get mixed with the barks of trees and rinds of fruits scattered splendidly.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य तोषयन्वै महेश्वरम् । तिष्ठ यावद् युगस्यान्तं पुनर्जन्म ह्यवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: narmadātaṭamāśritya toṣayanvai maheśvaram / tiṣṭha yāvad yugasyāntaṃ punarjanma hyavāpsyasi
verses.translation: There are four divine play-grounds. They are splen¬ did and charming. They arc resorted to by Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas, Nagas, Siddhas and Apsaras-s. Listen to their names.
verses.hindi: जा बैठे । इसके बहुत दिन बाद वहाँ मधुकैटम नाक दो अतुलनीय बलशाली ज्ाताओं ने तरुण सूे की तरह चमकनेवाले एस पद्म को हिलाना प्रारम्भ कर दिश ।२९-२१। उन दोनों की आँखें अन्धेकार में चमक रही थीं और वे दोनों ही वीर हँस-हंस कर निर्भगभाव से पद्मपत्रों को तोड़ रहे थे। उन दोनों ने ब्रह्मा से कहा -“तुम हमारे भक्ष्य बनो ” यह कह कर वे अन्तर्द्धान हो गये ।३२। पद्मयोनि ब्रहा ने उनके कंठोण
verses.wordMeaning: There are four divine play-grounds. They are splen¬ did and charming. They arc resorted to by Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas, Nagas, Siddhas and Apsaras-s. Listen to their names.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are four divine play-grounds. They are splen¬ did and charming. They arc resorted to by Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas, Nagas, Siddhas and Apsaras-s. Listen to their names.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्भूत्वा तु पूतस्त्वं दारुको नाम विश्रुतः । संसेव्य परमं देवं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्
verses.transliteration: punarbhūtvā tu pūtastvaṃ dāruko nāma viśrutaḥ / saṃsevya paramaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
verses.translation: On the eastern side is the forest named Gaitraratha, on the southern (mountain), the forest Nandana, on the western (mountain), the forest Vaibhraja and on the northern mountain, the forest of Savitr (the Sun-god). In these great forests (parks) charming adjuncts are fitted in due order. Here birds chirp melodiously.
verses.hindi: भाव को और अपने पराक्रम को जानकर तात्कालिक रहस्य जानना चाहा; किन्तु वे तब तक उनकी गंति: विधि या पद्मपत्रों का तोड़ा जाना नहीं समझ सके । वे उस कमलनाल के सहारे रसातले॑ में उंतेर गये। बहाँ जल के भीतर उन्होंने इष्णाजिन और उत्तरीयधारी विष्णु) देखा । उन्होंने विष्णु को जंगाया और उनके जागने पर कहा - "देव ! हमें भूतों से भय हो रहा है. उठिये हपे बचाइये हमारा कल्याणें कौणियें ।/
verses.wordMeaning: On the eastern side is the forest named Gaitraratha, on the southern (mountain), the forest Nandana, on the western (mountain), the forest Vaibhraja and on the northern mountain, the forest of Savitr (the Sun-god).…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the eastern side is the forest named Gaitraratha, on the southern (mountain), the forest Nandana, on the western (mountain), the forest Vaibhraja and on the northern mountain, the forest of Savitr (the Sun-god).…

verses.sanskrit: मानुषं भावमापन्नस्ततः सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि । एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन सहस्राक्षेण धीमता
verses.transliteration: mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāpannastataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi / evamuktastu devena sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā
verses.translation: Extensive holy centres and great sanctifying gardens are the residences of great Nagas and those are resorted to by noble souls.
verses.hindi: भगवान् विष्ण हँसते हुये बोले--कुछ चिन्ता नहीं । डरने की कि हमें भूतों से भय हो रहा है; इसलिये उन देत्यों और स्वलोंक प्रदक्षिणा करके बंठे
verses.wordMeaning: Extensive holy centres and great sanctifying gardens are the residences of great Nagas and those are resorted to by noble souls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Extensive holy centres and great sanctifying gardens are the residences of great Nagas and those are resorted to by noble souls.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमिम् आगतो ऽसौ ह्यचेतनः । नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य कर्षयन्निजविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: praṇamya śirasā bhūmim āgato 'sau hyacetanaḥ / narmadātaṭamāśritya karṣayannijavigraham
verses.translation: Sweet and pure waters are auspicious and very pleasing. They are drunk by Siddhas, Devas and Asuras. There are four great lakes shining with lotuses and lilies, with huge leaves, charming, fragrant' and full-blown. Ihese are umbrella-like in appearance and size. I shall mention their names.
verses.hindi: कोई बात नहीं है। जिसलिये पहले पहल आपने कहा का भूतादि वाक्य से आप ही विनाश करेंगे। अनस्तर भूलोंक, भुदर्लो हुये ब्रह्म में प्रवेश कर गये । उनके चले जाने पर अनन्त भगवात् ने विष्णु और जिष्णु नामक दो
verses.wordMeaning: Sweet and pure waters are auspicious and very pleasing. They are drunk by Siddhas, Devas and Asuras. There are four great lakes shining with lotuses and lilies, with huge leaves, charming, fragrant' and full-blown. Ihese are umbrella-like in appearance and size.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sweet and pure waters are auspicious and very pleasing. They are drunk by Siddhas, Devas and Asuras. There are four great lakes shining with lotuses and lilies, with huge leaves, charming, fragrant' and full-blown. Ihese are umbrella-like in appearance and size.…

verses.sanskrit: व्रतोपवाससंखिन्नो जपहोमरतः सदा । महादेवं महात्मानं वरदं शूलपाणिनम्
verses.transliteration: vratopavāsasaṃkhinno japahomarataḥ sadā / mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ varadaṃ śūlapāṇinam
verses.translation: On the east is the lake Arunoda; 1 in the south is the
verses.hindi: +घनुश्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थ: क. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: On the east is the lake Arunoda; 1 in the south is the
verses.commentary: Sense: On the east is the lake Arunoda; 1 in the south is the

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या तु परया राजन्यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् । अंशावतरणाद् विष्णोः सूतो भूत्वा महामतिः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā tu parayā rājanyāvadābhūtasamplavam / aṃśāvataraṇād viṣṇoḥ sūto bhūtvā mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: The mountains to the east of Arunoda are being narrated by me in detail. Please hear. On the east of Mandara are the mountains Sitanta, 1 Kumunja, the excellent mountain Suvlra, Vikahka, Manisila, Vi sabha the best of mountains, Malianlla, Rucaka, Sabindu Mandara, Venuman, Sumedha, Nisadha, Deva-Saila and others. They are the abodes of Siddhas.
verses.hindi: ततस्तों फ्रोचांहुडेट्यों ख्मा्णं दारुणं बच: । अस्माक युध्यमानानां मध्ये वे प्राश्निको भव कड१
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains to the east of Arunoda are being narrated by me in detail. Please hear. On the east of Mandara are the mountains Sitanta, 1 Kumunja, the excellent mountain Suvlra, Vikahka, Manisila, Vi sabha the best of mountains, Malianlla, Rucaka, Sabindu Mandara, Venuman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains to the east of Arunoda are being narrated by me in detail. Please hear. On the east of Mandara are the mountains Sitanta, 1 Kumunja, the excellent mountain Suvlra, Vikahka, Manisila, Vi sabha the best of mountains, Malianlla, Rucaka, Sabindu Mandara, Venuman,…

verses.sanskrit: तोषयन् वै जगन्नाथं ततो यातो हि सद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: toṣayan vai jagannāthaṃ tato yāto hi sadgatim
verses.translation: Understand that these great mountains lie on the south side of the Manasa lake. Listen to their names as narrated by me.
verses.hindi: कक्‍शकी जलमाविश्य संस्तम्यापः स्वमायया  चक्नतुस्तुम्ुुल युद्धं यस्य येनेप्सितं तदा पड
verses.wordMeaning: Understand that these great mountains lie on the south side of the Manasa lake. Listen to their names as narrated by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand that these great mountains lie on the south side of the Manasa lake. Listen to their names as narrated by me.

verses.sanskrit: एष तत्सम्भवस्तात दारुतीर्थस्य सुव्रत । कथितो ऽयं मया पूर्वं यथा मे शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: eṣa tatsambhavastāta dārutīrthasya suvrata / kathito 'yaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: Theexcellent mountains Trisikhara, Sisira,Kalinga, Patanga, Rucaka, Sanuman, Tamrabha, Visakha, Svetodara, Samula, Visadhara, mount Ratnadhara, Ekasfhga, Mahamula, Gajasaila, PiSacaka, Pancasaila, Kailasa and the excellent mountain Himavat lie on the southern side of Meru of divine splendour. These are excellent mountains of godly nature. O excellent Brahmanas, I shall mention in due order, those excellent great mountains which lie on the western side of lake Sitoda.
verses.hindi: केक तु पुध्यमान्ानां दिव्य वर्ग शलं गतम् । न च युद्धमदोत्सेको ह्म्योन्यं संन्यवतंत ३ जरतबहयसंस्थाभ्ाद्रफ्कम्तो स्थितेज्धितों । सादश्यादव्याकुलमना ब्रह्मा ध्यानसुपायमत् .. बडड४
verses.wordMeaning: Theexcellent mountains Trisikhara, Sisira,Kalinga, Patanga, Rucaka, Sanuman, Tamrabha, Visakha, Svetodara, Samula, Visadhara, mount Ratnadhara, Ekasfhga, Mahamula, Gajasaila, PiSacaka, Pancasaila,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Theexcellent mountains Trisikhara, Sisira,Kalinga, Patanga, Rucaka, Sanuman, Tamrabha, Visakha, Svetodara, Samula, Visadhara, mount Ratnadhara, Ekasfhga, Mahamula, Gajasaila, PiSacaka, Pancasaila,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो युधिष्ठिरः श्रुत्वा विस्मयं परमं गतः । भ्रात्ःन् विलोकयामास हृष्टरोमा मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śrutvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ / bhrātḥn vilokayāmāsa hṛṣṭaromā muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: Suvaksas, 2 Sikhisaila, Kala, Vaidurya, Kapila, Pingala, Rudra, Surasa, Mahacala, Kumuda, Madhuman, Anjanlmukuta, Krsna, Pandara, Sahasrasikhara, Pariyatra and Trisrnga. These are the leading mountains in the western region.
verses.hindi: बषःभोवाच ता कन्यां ब्रह्मा मधुरया गिरा । काउत्र त्वमवगन्तव्या ब्ृहि सत्यमनिन्दिते
verses.wordMeaning: Suvaksas, 2 Sikhisaila, Kala, Vaidurya, Kapila, Pingala, Rudra, Surasa, Mahacala, Kumuda, Madhuman, Anjanlmukuta, Krsna, Pandara, Sahasrasikhara, Pariyatra and Trisrnga. These are the leading mountains in the western region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suvaksas, 2 Sikhisaila, Kala, Vaidurya, Kapila, Pingala, Rudra, Surasa, Mahacala, Kumuda, Madhuman, Anjanlmukuta, Krsna, Pandara, Sahasrasikhara, Pariyatra and Trisrnga. These are the leading mountains in the western region.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा विधिपूर्वं नरेश्वर । उपास्य संध्यां देवेशमर्चयेद्यश्च शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhipūrvaṃ nareśvara / upāsya saṃdhyāṃ deveśamarcayedyaśca śaṅkaram
verses.translation: I shall name in due order, as before, the mountains on the north of the glorious lake Mahabhadra. 3 The Kashghar range, the last longitudinal range of the Pamir region. It is a climatic barrier separating the cold plateau on its west. Hence its name Sitanta. Kumunja is an offshoot of the Tien Shan. Mt. Vikahka (Kungur), Manisila <Mustagh range)—these mountains are associated in a way to the river Sita (Kizil-Su).
verses.hindi: लकमा शेंब्स्य सा कप्या ब्रह्मा प्राउजलिस्तदा । मोहिनीं विद्धि मां मायां विष्णो: संदेशकारिणीम् ॥ हक संकीत्य॑मश्नाएहँ अहन्याप्ता त्वरायुता। अस्याः प्रीतमना ब्रह्मा गोणं नाम चकार हू .
verses.wordMeaning: I shall name in due order, as before, the mountains on the north of the glorious lake Mahabhadra. 3 The Kashghar range, the last longitudinal range of the Pamir region. It is a climatic barrier separating the cold plateau on its west. Hence its name Sitanta.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall name in due order, as before, the mountains on the north of the glorious lake Mahabhadra. 3 The Kashghar range, the last longitudinal range of the Pamir region. It is a climatic barrier separating the cold plateau on its west. Hence its name Sitanta.…

verses.sanskrit: वेदाभ्यासं तु तत्रैव यः करोति समाहितः । सो ऽश्वमेधफलं राजंल्लभते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: vedābhyāsaṃ tu tatraiva yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ / so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ rājaṃllabhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: In this list, Trisrnga is a cluster of three peaks, viz. Vashan Tagh, Khan Thag and Chimtarga, all within a radius a radius of three miles. Ahjani corresponds to the spurs of the Hissar range. (AG ).
verses.hindi: को मुख्ध से उत्पन्त कर कहा--तुम दोतों ब्रह्मा की रक्षा करो ।३६-३९। इधर मधु-कीटभ नें विष्णु-जिष्णु सी ब्याययत दार्ताजानकर विष्ण-जिष्ण की ही तरह अपना रूप बना लिया और उसी रूप में श्रह्मा के कामुक “उप्क्षित होकर उन दोनों ( देत्यों ) ने ब्रह्मा से कठोर स्वर में कहा--हम दोनों परस्पर युद्ध करते हैं; .दीच में शुक्र निर्णायक बनो”” 4४०-४१। इसके बाद उन दोनों ने जल में प्रवेश कर अपनी माया से जल
verses.wordMeaning: In this list, Trisrnga is a cluster of three peaks, viz. Vashan Tagh, Khan Thag and Chimtarga, all within a radius a radius of three miles. Ahjani corresponds to the spurs of the Hissar range. (AG ).
verses.commentary: Sense: In this list, Trisrnga is a cluster of three peaks, viz. Vashan Tagh, Khan Thag and Chimtarga, all within a radius a radius of three miles. Ahjani corresponds to the spurs of the Hissar range. (AG ).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या भोजयेद् ब्राह्मणाञ्छुचिः । स तु विप्रसहस्रस्य लभते फलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe tu yo bhaktyā bhojayed brāhmaṇāñchuciḥ / sa tu viprasahasrasya labhate phalamuttamam
verses.translation: C. of the list of mauntains, north of the lake Mahabhadra (lake SonKul) cae following mountains are identifiable: Vrsabha, Satasrhga etc. (Ghatkal Range), Nila (Tien-Shan). Naga (Saila) is the Farghana Sankukuta, Mahasaila, Vrsabha, Harhsa, Naga Kapila, IndraSaila, Sanuman, Nila, Kanakasrnga, Satasrriga Puspaka, Meghasaila, the excellent mountain Viraja and the* leading mount Jarudhi. These are the mountains on the north
verses.hindi: करे: स्काब्क- कर दिया । इसके बाद वे दोनों विष्णु जिष्ण से अभिलषित रूप से युद्ध करने लगे। उनके युद्ध करके; हुरे- दिव्य सौ वर्ष बीत सये, किल्तु रणमद से मत्त उनमें से कोई भी युद्ध से विरत नहीं हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: C. of the list of mauntains, north of the lake Mahabhadra (lake SonKul) cae following mountains are identifiable: Vrsabha, Satasrhga etc. (Ghatkal Range), Nila (Tien-Shan). Naga (Saila) is the Farghana Sankukuta, Mahasaila, Vrsabha, Harhsa, Naga Kapila, IndraSaila, Sanuman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: C. of the list of mauntains, north of the lake Mahabhadra (lake SonKul) cae following mountains are identifiable: Vrsabha, Satasrhga etc. (Ghatkal Range), Nila (Tien-Shan). Naga (Saila) is the Farghana Sankukuta, Mahasaila, Vrsabha, Harhsa, Naga Kapila, IndraSaila, Sanuman,…

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम् । यत्कृतं शुद्धभावेन तत्सर्वं सफलं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam / yatkṛtaṃ śuddhabhāvena tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Understand the valleys and canyons and lakes in the inter-spaces of these chief mountains.
verses.hindi: उनका अधकाश अकार ओऔद संत्यानादि एक प्रकार का था एवं गति स्थिति भी उनकी समान ही थी तथा सतत दोकीं :का कम रूप भी एक प्रकार का ही था, इससे ब्रह्मा व्याकुल हो ध्यान करने लगे। ब्रह्मा ने तब दिफय कृष्टि के उनके रहस्य -को समझा ओर कमल-केसर के बने सूक्ष्म कवच द्वारा उन दोनों के ( विष्णु खिक्कूल्के ) नाश से उल्नर के शरीर को बाँधकर मन्‍्त्रों का पाठ करने लगे ।४४-४५। मन्त्र जपते हुये ब्रह्मा
verses.wordMeaning: Understand the valleys and canyons and lakes in the inter-spaces of these chief mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand the valleys and canyons and lakes in the inter-spaces of these chief mountains.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे दारुकतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षट्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ३७ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र देवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । येन देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशत् स्नात्वा सिद्धिं परां गताः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dārukatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 37 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gaccheta rājendra devatīrthamanuttamam / yena devāstrayastriṃśat snātvā siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: The valleys between Sitanta and Kumuflja* ranges are no:sy with birds and resorted to by innumerable creatures.
verses.hindi: को / पक: हस्तुकदना, परू-सुल्दरी, प्रियदर्शना, कमलहस्ता कन्या उतन्न हुई। उसे देखते ही दौनों दत्यों के प्रकद्व सूक्क गये. 4४६३-अह्या ने उस कन्या से मधुर शब्दों में कहा-- यथाथ सुन्दरि, कहो तुम कौन हो, मैं तुकदें+कका छमझ् ?' उस कन्या ने वेदोक्त विधि से ब्रह्मा की पूजा कर हाथ जोड़कर कहा--मुझे आप विध्णु की आज्ञानुवतिनी मोहिनी माया समझें। ब्रह्म ! आपने मेरा स्म'ण किया; इसलिये मैं शीघ्र ही यहाँ पहुँच
verses.wordMeaning: The valleys between Sitanta and Kumuflja* ranges are no:sy with birds and resorted to by innumerable creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valleys between Sitanta and Kumuflja* ranges are no:sy with birds and resorted to by innumerable creatures.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं तात सुराः सर्वे दानवैर्बलवत्तरैः । निर्जितास्तत्र तीर्थे च स्नात्वा सिद्धिं परां गताः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ tāta surāḥ sarve dānavairbalavattaraiḥ / nirjitāstatra tīrthe ca snātvā siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: The sacred lake called Srisaras is famous here and in
verses.hindi: गयी। सन्तुष्ट होकर ब्रह्मा ने उसका एक गौण नाम रखा ।४७-४६। हमारे द्वारा बुलायी जाने पर तुम
verses.wordMeaning: The sacred lake called Srisaras is famous here and in
verses.commentary: Sense: The sacred lake called Srisaras is famous here and in

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुरा दैत्यगणैरुग्रैर्युद्धे ऽतिबलवत्तरैः । इन्द्रो देवगणैः सार्द्धं स्वराज्याच्च्यावितो नृप
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā daityagaṇairugrairyuddhe 'tibalavattaraiḥ / indro devagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ svarājyāccyāvito nṛpa
verses.translation: It is always open and full blown. It never withers. It is tremulous and circular. It has many charming filaments. It is resonant with the buzzing sound of inebriated bees.
verses.hindi: उल्थिता व् शिरो भित्त्वा सावित्री तेन चोच्यते । एकानंशात्त यस्मात्त्वमनेक्रांशाः भविष्य
verses.wordMeaning: It is always open and full blown. It never withers. It is tremulous and circular. It has many charming filaments. It is resonant with the buzzing sound of inebriated bees.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is always open and full blown. It never withers. It is tremulous and circular. It has many charming filaments. It is resonant with the buzzing sound of inebriated bees.

verses.sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वरथयानौघैर्मर्दयित्वा वरूथिनीम् । विध्वस्ता भेजिरे मार्गं प्रहारैर् जर्जरीकृताः
verses.transliteration: hastyaśvarathayānaughairmardayitvā varūthinīm / vidhvastā bhejire mārgaṃ prahārair jarjarīkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The goddess Laksmi herself always abides in that lotus
verses.hindi: तथेल्युक्टबा ततस्तुर्णमनयद्यमसावनम् । अनयत्कटभं विष्णुजिष्णुश्वाप्यनय्स्तथुण
verses.wordMeaning: The goddess Laksmi herself always abides in that lotus
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess Laksmi herself always abides in that lotus

verses.sanskrit: जम्भशुम्भैश्च कूष्माण्डकुहकादिभिः । वेपमानार्दिताः सर्वे ब्रह्माणमुपतस्थिरे
verses.transliteration: jambhaśumbhaiśca kūṣmāṇḍakuhakādibhiḥ / vepamānārditāḥ sarve brahmāṇamupatasthire
verses.translation: On the eastern side of the lake resorted to by Siddhas, there is a charming Bilva forest which is full of flowers, and fruits.
verses.hindi: एवं तो मिहतो दत्यों विष्णुना जिष्णना सह । प्रीतेन ब्रह्मणा चाथ लोकसनां हितकाम्यक्त पुत्रत्वमीशैम यथा ह्यात्मा दसों नियोधत। विष्णुता जिष्णुना साथ मधुकदभबोस्तका संपराये व्यतिक़ान्ते ब्रह्मा विष्णमभाषत
verses.wordMeaning: On the eastern side of the lake resorted to by Siddhas, there is a charming Bilva forest which is full of flowers, and fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the eastern side of the lake resorted to by Siddhas, there is a charming Bilva forest which is full of flowers, and fruits.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम् । तदा विज्ञापयामासुर्देवा वह्निपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: praṇamya śirasā devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / tadā vijñāpayāmāsurdevā vahnipurogamāḥ
verses.translation: It is a hundred Yojanas in breadth and three hun¬ dred Yojanas in length. It is full of thousands of large trees with. big trunks and extensive branches and tops half a Yojan in height. The ground is littered with sweet smelling fruits as sweet as nectar, as huge as war-drums, some golden, some green, some pale, some white in colour, all falling down and shatter¬ ing themselves.
verses.hindi: अद्य व्षशतं पूर्ण समय: प्रत्युपस्थित:। संक्षेपसंप्लवं घोरं स्वस्थानं यामिः सापण्यहुन्
verses.wordMeaning: It is a hundred Yojanas in breadth and three hun¬ dred Yojanas in length. It is full of thousands of large trees with. big trunks and extensive branches and tops half a Yojan in height. The ground is littered with sweet smelling fruits as sweet as nectar, as huge as war-drums,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a hundred Yojanas in breadth and three hun¬ dred Yojanas in length. It is full of thousands of large trees with. big trunks and extensive branches and tops half a Yojan in height. The ground is littered with sweet smelling fruits as sweet as nectar, as huge as war-drums,…

verses.sanskrit: पश्य पश्य महाभाग दानवैः शकलीकृताः । वियोजिताः पुत्रदारैस्त्वामेव शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: paśya paśya mahābhāga dānavaiḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ / viyojitāḥ putradāraistvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: It is known as Srlvana. It is resorted to by Kinnaras, Yaksas and Mahanagas (big serpents).
verses.hindi: स तस्य बचसा देव: संहारमकरोत्तदा। महीं निस्थावरां कृत्वा प्रकृतिस्थांश्व जमा यवि गोविन्द भद्र ते क्षिप्रं ते यादसां प्रति  ब्ृहि यत्करणीयं स्पान्मया ते लक्मिकणेगरक
verses.wordMeaning: It is known as Srlvana. It is resorted to by Kinnaras, Yaksas and Mahanagas (big serpents).
verses.commentary: Sense: It is known as Srlvana. It is resorted to by Kinnaras, Yaksas and Mahanagas (big serpents).

verses.sanskrit: परित्रायस्व देवेश सर्वलोकपितामह । नान्या गतिः सुरेशान त्वां मुक्त्वा परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: paritrāyasva deveśa sarvalokapitāmaha / nānyā gatiḥ sureśāna tvāṃ muktvā parameśvara
verses.translation: It is resorted to by Siddhas who subsist on Bilva fruits. Various groups of living beings (or goblins— Bhutas) always reside in it.
verses.hindi: आयी हो इसलिये तुम्हारा एक नाम महाव्याहृति होगा ५०। तुम हमारे सिर को भेवकर उत्पन्न कई; हो इसलिये सावित्री भी कही जाओगी। एकानंशा) होने के कारण तुम्हारा नाम अनेंकांशा भी द्ोगा।५ ४१ मुखि ! इतने तो तुम्हारे गौण नाम हुये किन्तु हमारे प्रसाद से छुम्हारे क्मजनित और भी अद्चेध्य. बम: होंगे । इधर युद्ध करते-करते वे दोनों हैत्य थक गये और उन दोनों ने विष्णु-जिष्ण से वर माँगा कि, खले
verses.wordMeaning: It is resorted to by Siddhas who subsist on Bilva fruits. Various groups of living beings (or goblins— Bhutas) always reside in it.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is resorted to by Siddhas who subsist on Bilva fruits. Various groups of living beings (or goblins— Bhutas) always reside in it.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच: दानवानां विघातार्थं नर्मदातटम् आस्थिताः । तपः कुरुध्वं स्वस्थाः स्थ तपो हि परमं बलम्
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca: dānavānāṃ vighātārthaṃ narmadātaṭam āsthitāḥ / tapaḥ kurudhvaṃ svasthāḥ stha tapo hi paramaṃ balam
verses.translation: The goddess Laksmi herself dwells there perpetually. She is worshipped by (groups of) Siddhas.
verses.hindi: स्थान- में: हुमारी मृत्यु हो एवं आप दोनों हमारे पुत्र हों। 'ऐसा ही हो' कहकर विष्णु ने' कंद्भ को :कालसका पहुंचा दिया और जिव्ण ने भो मधु को मार डाला । इस प्रकार विष्ण-जिध्ण के द्वाश दोकों देश्यों'केः खरे जाने पर ब्रह्मा प्रसल्न होकर संघार की हितकामना में रत हो गये ।५२-५५। अबथ ईश्कर'ने जिस प्रकार' कुष- रूस से आसत्मक्षनःकिया, उसे सुनिये। कि्णु-जिष्णु के साथःजब मधुकटभः का युद्ध सभाप्कत होस्नया; सम
verses.wordMeaning: The goddess Laksmi herself dwells there perpetually. She is worshipped by (groups of) Siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess Laksmi herself dwells there perpetually. She is worshipped by (groups of) Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: नान्योपायो न वै मन्त्रो विद्यते न च मे क्रिया । विना रेवाजलं पुण्यं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: nānyopāyo na vai mantro vidyate na ca me kriyā / vinā revājalaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: In the midst of the leading mountain Vikahka and Manisaila, there is an extensive Campaka forest, 1 one hundred
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म ने विष्णु से कहा ।९६। आज सौ वर्ष पूरे हो गये और समय भी आ गया” अल्प इस “चोर संच्लक को समे्ठ लें। हम भी अपने स्थान' को:जातेः हैं। विष्णु ने ब्रह्म के कहनेःपर संब्यवकता सार कर दिया' ओर पृथ्वी: को स्थावरविहीन करके जंगलों को प्रकृतिस्थ कर दिया । फिर बह्ञा औले--भोकिल्द
verses.wordMeaning: In the midst of the leading mountain Vikahka and Manisaila, there is an extensive Campaka forest, 1 one hundred
verses.commentary: Sense: In the midst of the leading mountain Vikahka and Manisaila, there is an extensive Campaka forest, 1 one hundred

verses.sanskrit: दारिद्र्यव्याधिमरणबन्धनव्यसनानि च । एतानि चैव पापस्य फलानीति मतिर्मम
verses.transliteration: dāridryavyādhimaraṇabandhanavyasanāni ca / etāni caiva pāpasya phalānīti matirmama
verses.translation: This Campaka forest is located between Vikahka (Kungur) and MartiSaila. It corresponds to the Yarkand oasis.
verses.hindi: आधप्रकाः कल्याण हो।। आपने समुद्र को' शीघ्र ही सीमित कर दिया। लक्ष्मीवर्शन, कहिये हम आफकत कौस
verses.wordMeaning: This Campaka forest is located between Vikahka (Kungur) and MartiSaila. It corresponds to the Yarkand oasis.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Campaka forest is located between Vikahka (Kungur) and MartiSaila. It corresponds to the Yarkand oasis.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा ततश्चैव तपः कुरुत दुष्करम् । तथा चैव सुराः सर्वे देवा ह्यग्निपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā tataścaiva tapaḥ kuruta duṣkaram / tathā caiva surāḥ sarve devā hyagnipurogamāḥ
verses.translation: That forest appears to be yellow with trees with huge trunks and branches blooming with flowers and tops spread about half a Kros'a upwards.
verses.hindi: अत्रः स्‍्थले विष्णरवाचेति घ. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: That forest appears to be yellow with trees with huge trunks and branches blooming with flowers and tops spread about half a Kros'a upwards.
verses.commentary: Sense: That forest appears to be yellow with trees with huge trunks and branches blooming with flowers and tops spread about half a Kros'a upwards.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तथ्यं ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः । नर्मदाम् आगताः सर्वे देवा ह्यग्निपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tathyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / narmadām āgatāḥ sarve devā hyagnipurogamāḥ
verses.translation: The flowers measure two Hastas (cubits) in girth and three Hastas in length. Their pale yellow filaments contain pollen powder resembling red arsenic. They are always in bloom and sweet smelling. The forest shines with these flowers. It is resonant with the humming of inebriated bees.
verses.hindi: १--यहाँ मूल पाठ भ्रष्ट जान पड़ता है--एकामनंशात्तु के स्थान पर नैकांदाशु होंगा चाहिए । जिसका अथ हैं एकांश नः होगे के कारण । इस प्रकार अर्थ संगत हो जाता हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: The flowers measure two Hastas (cubits) in girth and three Hastas in length. Their pale yellow filaments contain pollen powder resembling red arsenic. They are always in bloom and sweet smelling. The forest shines with these flowers.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The flowers measure two Hastas (cubits) in girth and three Hastas in length. Their pale yellow filaments contain pollen powder resembling red arsenic. They are always in bloom and sweet smelling. The forest shines with these flowers.…

verses.sanskrit: चेरुर्वै तत्र विपुलं तपः सिद्धिमवाप्नुवन् । तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं देवतीर्थम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: cerurvai tatra vipulaṃ tapaḥ siddhimavāpnuvan / tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ devatīrtham anuttamam
verses.translation: It is resorted to by Danavas, Devas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas, Kinnaras, Apsaras-s and big serpents.
verses.hindi: त्तस्येबं तप्यमानस्य न किचित्समवर्तत । ततो दीघेंग कालेन दुःखात्क्रोधो व्यवर्धत
verses.wordMeaning: It is resorted to by Danavas, Devas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas, Kinnaras, Apsaras-s and big serpents.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is resorted to by Danavas, Devas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas, Kinnaras, Apsaras-s and big serpents.

verses.sanskrit: गीयते त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् । तत्र गत्वा च यो मर्त्यो विधिना संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: gīyate triṣu lokeṣu sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram / tatra gatvā ca yo martyo vidhinā saṃyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Here is also the hermitage of the holy Lord Kasyapa Prajapati, where Siddhas and Sadhyas are found in large num¬ bers and is (as if) decorated with the sound of Vedic recita¬ tions. In the midst of the mountains Mahanlla and Kumuiija, 1 on the banks of the great river Sukha, resorted to by Siddhas, there is a charming palm forest fifty Yojanas in length and thirty Yojanas in width, with the top reaching a height of half
verses.hindi: सक्तो(तत्क़ो )धाविष्टनेत्राभ्यामपतच्नभुबिन्दवः । ततस्तेभ्यो5श्रुबिन्दुभ्यो बातपित्तकफात्मकाः
verses.wordMeaning: Here is also the hermitage of the holy Lord Kasyapa Prajapati, where Siddhas and Sadhyas are found in large num¬ bers and is (as if) decorated with the sound of Vedic recita¬ tions. In the midst of the mountains Mahanlla and Kumuiija, 1 on the banks of the great river Sukha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Here is also the hermitage of the holy Lord Kasyapa Prajapati, where Siddhas and Sadhyas are found in large num¬ bers and is (as if) decorated with the sound of Vedic recita¬ tions. In the midst of the mountains Mahanlla and Kumuiija, 1 on the banks of the great river Sukha,…

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं समाचरेद्भक्त्या स लभेन्मौक्तिकं फलम् । यस्तु भोजयते विप्रांस्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ samācaredbhaktyā sa labhenmauktikaṃ phalam / yastu bhojayate viprāṃstasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa
verses.translation: The Kumuda and Ahjana trees have great roots and are very strong. They cluster together without anv interstices
verses.hindi: , अहाभोगा महास्तत्त्वाः स्वस्तिकरभ्यलंकृता: । प्रकोर्णकेशाः सर्पास्ति प्रादुभृंता महाबिषा:.
verses.wordMeaning: The Kumuda and Ahjana trees have great roots and are very strong. They cluster together without anv interstices
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kumuda and Ahjana trees have great roots and are very strong. They cluster together without anv interstices

verses.sanskrit: स लभेन्मुख्यविप्राणां फलं साहस्रिकं नृप । तत्र देवशिला रम्या महापुण्यविवर्धिनी
verses.transliteration: sa labhenmukhyaviprāṇāṃ phalaṃ sāhasrikaṃ nṛpa / tatra devaśilā ramyā mahāpuṇyavivardhinī
verses.translation: Similarly, north of the mountains Nisadha and Deva, there is a big rocky piece of land, a thousand Yojanas long and a hundi ed 'Vojanas wide. The ground is devoid of trees and creepers although it is moistened with ankle deep water. 1
verses.hindi: सर्पास्तथा5पग्रजानदुष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा5उत्मानमनिन्दत । अहो घिक्तपसा महा फलमीद्शक यदि ॥ क्‍
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, north of the mountains Nisadha and Deva, there is a big rocky piece of land, a thousand Yojanas long and a hundi ed 'Vojanas wide. The ground is devoid of trees and creepers although it is moistened with ankle deep water. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, north of the mountains Nisadha and Deva, there is a big rocky piece of land, a thousand Yojanas long and a hundi ed 'Vojanas wide. The ground is devoid of trees and creepers although it is moistened with ankle deep water. 1

verses.sanskrit: संन्यासेन मृता ये तु तेषां स्याद् अक्षया गतिः । अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस् तीर्थे नराधिप
verses.transliteration: saṃnyāsena mṛtā ye tu teṣāṃ syād akṣayā gatiḥ / agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃs tīrthe narādhipa
verses.translation: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.
verses.hindi: लोकवबनाशिकी जज्ञे आदावेव प्रजा मम रा ३६६
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोके वसेत् तावद् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम् । एवं स्नानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम्
verses.transliteration: rudraloke vaset tāvad yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam / evaṃ snānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam
verses.translation: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.
verses.hindi: तस्पाप्रतिमवीर्यस्थ देहात्कारुण्यपुर्वकम् । आत्मकादश ते रुद्रा: प्रोदभुता रुतदस्तथा: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.

verses.sanskrit: सुकृतं दुष्कृतं वा ऽपि तत्र तीर्थे ऽक्षयं भवेत् । एष ते विधिरुद्दिष्ट उत्पत्तिश्चैव भारत
verses.transliteration: sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vā 'pi tatra tīrthe 'kṣayaṃ bhavet / eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭa utpattiścaiva bhārata
verses.translation: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.
verses.hindi: ये रुद्राः खलु ते प्राणा ये प्राणास्‍्ते तवात्मकाः। प्राणाः प्राणभृतां ज्ेयाः सर्वेभुतेष्ववस्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.

verses.sanskrit: देवतीर्थस्य निखिला यथा वै शङ्कराच्छ्रुता । पठन्ति ये पापहरं सर्वदुःखविमोचनम्
verses.transliteration: devatīrthasya nikhilā yathā vai śaṅkarācchrutā / paṭhanti ye pāpaharaṃ sarvaduḥkhavimocanam
verses.translation: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.
verses.hindi: ललाटात्पदुमयोनेस्तु प्रभु रेकादशात्मकः ्््ि  ७०
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.

verses.sanskrit: देवतीर्थस्य चरितं देवलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: devatīrthasya caritaṃ devalokaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.

verses.wordMeaning: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, in due order, O leading Brahmanas, are des¬ cribed the valleys between the mountains. They are to the east of Meru and are of various shapes and sizes.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे देवतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तविंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ३८ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र गुहावासीति चोत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धो महादेवो गुहावासी समार्बुदम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 38 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gaccheta rājendra guhāvāsīti cottamam / yatra siddho mahādevo guhāvāsī samārbudam
verses.translation: I shall now describe the valleys of the southern quarter, frequented by the Siddhas. Listen to them in due order.
