verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu vakṣye'dya te rājankapilātīrthamuttamam / yena te vismayaḥ sarvaḥ śrutvā gacchati bhārata
verses.translation: By means of the excessively fragrant and charming flowers blazing like the midday sun, the excellent mountain is illuminated as it were all around.
verses.hindi: हिसा छार्व देवता नहीं करते हैं ।३०-३१। ब्रह्म ने फिर नीललोहित से कहा--आपका चोथा नाम हमने ईशान कहा है, उस चौथे शरीर की चौथी मूर्ति वायु होगी । ब्रह्मा के ऐसा कहते ही उनके शरीर में जो प्राणापानादि पंच वायु थे, उनमें सांसारिक वायु प्रवेश कर गयी; इसलिये ईशान वायु कहलाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: By means of the excessively fragrant and charming flowers blazing like the midday sun, the excellent mountain is illuminated as it were all around.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of the excessively fragrant and charming flowers blazing like the midday sun, the excellent mountain is illuminated as it were all around.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । उत्पादयित्वा सकलं भूतग्रामं चतुर्विधम्
verses.transliteration: purā kṛtayugasyādau brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / utpādayitvā sakalaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham
verses.translation: The wind blowing from that forest wafts the fragrance
verses.hindi: जो व्यक्ति इस विराट वायु की स्तुति करते हैं, ईशान देव उसकी हिंसा करते हैं ।३४। ब्रह्मा ने फिर धूम्र- लोहित देव से कहा--हमने आपका पाँचवाँ नाम पशुपति कहा है इसलिये उस पाँचवें शरीर की पाँचवीं .. मृति अग्ति होगी ३५। ऐसा कहते ही उनके शरीरस्थ उष्ण नामक तेज में अग्ति प्रवेश कर गबा । तब से द  अग्नि. का नाम पद्मुपति हुआ। चरद्रमा सोम कहलाते हैं, उनकी आत्मा ओषधियाँ है। जो विद्वान इस तत्त्व ह ः को प्रत्येक पर्व में हृदयज्भम करता है, महादेव उसकी हिंसा नहीं करते । इसलिये महादेव को वन्दना श्रेयस्कर है ।३६-३७। आदित्य दिन में और चन्द्रमा रात में प्रजाओं की रक्षा करते हैं। सूर्य और चन्द्रमा जिस रात्रि
verses.wordMeaning: The wind blowing from that forest wafts the fragrance
verses.commentary: Sense: The wind blowing from that forest wafts the fragrance

verses.sanskrit: जपहोमपरो भक्त्या क्षणं ध्यात्वा च तिष्ठति । ज्वलमानात् तु कपिला तावत् कुण्डात्समुत्थिता
verses.transliteration: japahomaparo bhaktyā kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā ca tiṣṭhati / jvalamānāt tu kapilā tāvat kuṇḍātsamutthitā
verses.translation: The tanks therein are adorned with blue lotuses resembling lapis lazuli with golden and diamond-like filaments, possessed of fragrance and resonant with the buzzing of bees." There are full-blown, hundred-pctallcd, charming, large-leafed red lotuses also.
verses.hindi: तत्रा5विष्टं सर्वर्भिदं तनुभिर्नामभिः सह । एकाकी यश्ररत्येष सूर्योश्सो चन्द्र उच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: The tanks therein are adorned with blue lotuses resembling lapis lazuli with golden and diamond-like filaments, possessed of fragrance and resonant with the buzzing of bees." There are full-blown, hundred-pctallcd, charming, large-leafed red lotuses also.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tanks therein are adorned with blue lotuses resembling lapis lazuli with golden and diamond-like filaments, possessed of fragrance and resonant with the buzzing of bees." There are full-blown, hundred-pctallcd, charming, large-leafed red lotuses also.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निज्वालोज्ज्वलैः शृङ्गैस्त्रिनेत्रा सुपयस्विनी । अग्निपूर्णा ह्यग्निमुखा अग्निघ्राणाग्निलोचना
verses.transliteration: agnijvālojjvalaiḥ śṛṅgaistrinetrā supayasvinī / agnipūrṇā hyagnimukhā agnighrāṇāgnilocanā
verses.translation: Thousands of fishes shine within the waters with un¬ winking eyes and decorated" with golden gems.
verses.hindi: सूर्यस्य यत्प्रकाशेन वीक्ष्यन्ते चक्षुषा प्रजा:। शुक्लात्मा संस्थितो रुद्र पिबत्यम्भो गर्भस्तिभिः अद्ते पीयते चेवाप्यन्नपात्मकानि या । तनुरात्मभवा सा ब॑ देहेष्वेवोपचीयते ॥४ १
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands of fishes shine within the waters with un¬ winking eyes and decorated" with golden gems.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands of fishes shine within the waters with un¬ winking eyes and decorated" with golden gems.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निखुरा ह्यग्निपृष्ठा अग्निसर्वाङ्गसंस्थितिः । सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णा घण्टाललितनिःस्वना
verses.transliteration: agnikhurā hyagnipṛṣṭhā agnisarvāṅgasaṃsthitiḥ / sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇā ghaṇṭālalitaniḥsvanā
verses.translation: With tortoises richly embellished with gold and occu¬ pying many positions, the water gets splashed all round and shines well.
verses.hindi: यावत्स्थिता शरीरेषु भूतानां प्राणवृत्तिभि: । वायूवात्मिका तु ऐशानी सा प्राणा प्राणिता सह
verses.wordMeaning: With tortoises richly embellished with gold and occu¬ pying many positions, the water gets splashed all round and shines well.
verses.commentary: Sense: With tortoises richly embellished with gold and occu¬ pying many positions, the water gets splashed all round and shines well.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तु तां महाभागां कपिलां कुण्डमध्यगाम् । ब्रह्मा लोकगुरुस्तात प्रणम्येदम् उवाच ह
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ mahābhāgāṃ kapilāṃ kuṇḍamadhyagām / brahmā lokagurustāta praṇamyedam uvāca ha
verses.translation: In that splendid iorest oi Indra Devas, Danavas, Pannagas, \ aksas, Raksasas, Guhyakas, Gandharvas of un¬ measured splendour, Vidyadharas, Siddhas and Kinnaras are joyous. Groups of Apsaras-s too are engaged in sports.
verses.hindi: पीताशितानि पचति भूतानां जठरेषु या। ततः पाशुपती तस्य पाचिका शक्तिरुच्यते . वैडेंड॑ यानीह सुषिराणि स्पुर्देहिष्वन्तर्गतानि वे । वायो: संचरणार्थाय सा भीमा चोच्यते तनु. बंतानदीक्षितानां तु या स्थितिब्रह्मवादिनाम् । तनुरुग्रात्मिकां सा तु तेनोग्रो दीक्षितः स्मृत:.
verses.wordMeaning: In that splendid iorest oi Indra Devas, Danavas, Pannagas, \ aksas, Raksasas, Guhyakas, Gandharvas of un¬ measured splendour, Vidyadharas, Siddhas and Kinnaras are joyous. Groups of Apsaras-s too are engaged in sports.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that splendid iorest oi Indra Devas, Danavas, Pannagas, \ aksas, Raksasas, Guhyakas, Gandharvas of un¬ measured splendour, Vidyadharas, Siddhas and Kinnaras are joyous. Groups of Apsaras-s too are engaged in sports.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते कपिले पुण्ये सर्वलोकनमस्कृते । मङ्गल्ये मङ्गले देवि त्रिषु लोकेष्वनुपमे
verses.transliteration: namaste kapile puṇye sarvalokanamaskṛte / maṅgalye maṅgale devi triṣu lokeṣvanupame
verses.translation: On the eastern side of that royal mountain is the lordly mountain of Kumunja with many streams and caves.
verses.hindi: नवो नवो भवति हि जायमानः पुनः पुनः  नीयते यो यथाकाम विबुधः पित्ृभि: सह ॥
verses.wordMeaning: On the eastern side of that royal mountain is the lordly mountain of Kumunja with many streams and caves.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the eastern side of that royal mountain is the lordly mountain of Kumunja with many streams and caves.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं लक्ष्मीस्त्वं स्मृतिर्मेधा त्वं धृतिस्त्वं वरानने । उमादेवीति विख्याता त्वं सती नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ smṛtirmedhā tvaṃ dhṛtistvaṃ varānane / umādevīti vikhyātā tvaṃ satī nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On the summit abounding in variegated minerals, there are eight big cities of noble-souled Danavas.
verses.hindi: महीदेवो5पृतात्माइसो ह्मम्मयश्चन्द्रमाः: स्पृतः . ड॑ंद तस्य वा प्रथमा नाम्ना तन् रौदी प्रकोतिता॥ पत्नी सुबर्धलो तस्य पुत्न॑स्तस्याः शर्नेश्वर: ॥ै४६ भवस्य या द्वितीया तु तनुरापः स्मृता तु वे । तस्योषाउच्र स्मृता पत्नी पुत्रश्चाप्युशना स्तृतः. में एकत्र तिवास करते हैं, उसे अमावास्या कहते हैं। इस अमावास्या तिथि में योग युक्त होकर रहने चाहिए क्योंकि ब्रह्म में नाम रूप के साथ सारा जगत् प्रविष्ट है। वही अकेले सूर्य और चरुद्र कंहलांतें हैं ।२५-३६। प्रजागण सूर्य के प्रकाश में चक्षु द्वारा देखते हैं और रुद्र देव शुक्लात्म रूप से सूर्य के मध्य में स्थित होकर किरण द्वारा जल का आकषंण करते हैं। जो अंन्नजल आदि भोजन द्वारा शरीर में जाते हैं वें उनका
verses.wordMeaning: On the summit abounding in variegated minerals, there are eight big cities of noble-souled Danavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the summit abounding in variegated minerals, there are eight big cities of noble-souled Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: वैष्णवी त्वं महादेवी ब्रह्माणी त्वं वरानने । कुमारी त्वं महाभागे भक्तिः श्रद्धा तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vaiṣṇavī tvaṃ mahādevī brahmāṇī tvaṃ varānane / kumārī tvaṃ mahābhāge bhaktiḥ śraddhā tathaiva ca
verses.translation: The abode of Raksasas crowded with men and women is situated on the mountain Vajraka with many peaks and cves.
verses.hindi: आत्मसम्भव शरीर होने के कारण प्रत्येक जीव शरीर में जाकर उसकों बढ़ाते हैं। भगधांन् स्थिर चित्त से - जिस शरीर द्वारा प्रजाओं को धारण करते हैं, वही उनकी शार्वी पार्थिव मूर्ति है। जो शरीर: प्राणे-बृत्ति के साथ भूतों के शरीर में निवास करता है, वही उनकी वायु रूप ऐशानी मूर्ति है और वहीँ प्राणियों का 'भ्रांणं है -४०-४९। जो शरीर जीवों के जठर में खाये पिये हुये को पचाता है, वहीं जठरॉग्नि उनकी शक्तिंशालिनी
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of Raksasas crowded with men and women is situated on the mountain Vajraka with many peaks and cves.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of Raksasas crowded with men and women is situated on the mountain Vajraka with many peaks and cves.

verses.sanskrit: कालरात्रिस्तु भूतानां कुमारी परमेश्वरी । त्वं लवस्त्वं त्रुटिश्चैव मुहूर्तं लक्षमेव च
verses.transliteration: kālarātristu bhūtānāṃ kumārī parameśvarī / tvaṃ lavastvaṃ truṭiścaiva muhūrtaṃ lakṣameva ca
verses.translation: These terrible Raksasas known as Nilakas can assume forms as they please. They are endowed with great strength and exploit. They live there for ever.
verses.hindi: पशुपति मूर्ति हैं। वायु के संचरण के लिये देह के भीतर जितने रन्प्र हैं, वे ही उनकी भौमा मूर्ति हैं ।४४-४५। यज्ञ दीक्षित ब्रह्मवादियों की जो स्थित ( वृत्ति ) हैं, वही उनकी उम्रात्मिका मृति है एवं उनका वह उग्र शरीर यजमान है। देव-देव का जो संकल्प सभी प्रजाओं में समभावत से वर्तेमाँन है. वही संकल्प उनका प्राणिस्थित सोमरूपी मानस शरीर है। इनका यह शरीर बार बार होनेवाला और नित्य नवीन है एवं देव-पितृगण के साथ इच्छानुकल ले जाया जाता है। इसलिये भगवान् महादेव ही अमृतात्मा जलमय चन्द्रमा कहे जाते हैं ।४६-४८। उनका जो पहला शरीर रौद्र नाम से कहा गया है, उसकी पत्नी सुवर्चला हैं, जिसका पुत्र शनेशचर है। दूसरा भव शरीर जो जलात्मक है, उसकी पत्नी ऊषा है और पुत्र उशना
verses.wordMeaning: These terrible Raksasas known as Nilakas can assume forms as they please. They are endowed with great strength and exploit. They live there for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: These terrible Raksasas known as Nilakas can assume forms as they please. They are endowed with great strength and exploit. They live there for ever.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरस्त्वं मासस्त्वं कालस्त्वं च क्षणस्तथा । नास्ति किंचित् त्वया हीनं त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarastvaṃ māsastvaṃ kālastvaṃ ca kṣaṇastathā / nāsti kiṃcit tvayā hīnaṃ trailokye sacarācare
verses.translation: On the great mountain Mahanlla, there arc fifteen famous cities of the horse-faced Kinnaras.
verses.hindi: है वायुपुराणम्र्
verses.wordMeaning: On the great mountain Mahanlla, there arc fifteen famous cities of the horse-faced Kinnaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the great mountain Mahanlla, there arc fifteen famous cities of the horse-faced Kinnaras.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुता तु मानेन कपिला परमेष्ठिना । तमुवाच महाभागं प्रहृष्य पद्मसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stutā tu mānena kapilā parameṣṭhinā / tamuvāca mahābhāgaṃ prahṛṣya padmasambhavam
verses.translation: Devasena, strong as Indra, is a powerful ruler. There the fifteen Kinnara lungs are very haughty.
verses.hindi: शर्वेस्थ या तुतोया तु नाम भामस्तनुः स्घपृता । पत्नी तस्य विकेशीति पुत्रश्चाड्रारकः स्घपुत: ईशानस्य चतुर्थस्य स्वर्ग तस्प च या तनु: । तस्य पत्नी शिवा नाम पुत्नश्चास्य सनोजवः
verses.wordMeaning: Devasena, strong as Indra, is a powerful ruler. There the fifteen Kinnara lungs are very haughty.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devasena, strong as Indra, is a powerful ruler. There the fifteen Kinnara lungs are very haughty.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्ना तव वाक्येन देवदेव जगद्गुरो । किं करोमि प्रियं ते ऽद्य ब्रूहि सर्वं पितामह
verses.transliteration: prasannā tava vākyena devadeva jagadguro / kiṃ karomi priyaṃ te 'dya brūhi sarvaṃ pitāmaha
verses.translation: The great mountain is decorated with the enclosed settlements which have golden flanks mostly and which possess people of different races.
verses.hindi: तासना षष्ठस्य या भीमा तनुराकाश उच्यते ।) दिशः पत्न्य: स्मृतास्तस्य स्वगंश्रास्य सुतः स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: The great mountain is decorated with the enclosed settlements which have golden flanks mostly and which possess people of different races.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great mountain is decorated with the enclosed settlements which have golden flanks mostly and which possess people of different races.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच: जगद्धिताय जनिता मया त्वं परमेश्वरि । स्वर्गान्मर्त्यं ततो याहि लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca: jagaddhitāya janitā mayā tvaṃ parameśvari / svargānmartyaṃ tato yāhi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: Hundreds of great Uragas (serpents) live there under the control of Garudas. They are terrible, fiery and inacce>sible and of venomous sight.
verses.hindi: इत्येतास्तनवस्तस्थ नामभिः परिकीर्तिता: । तास्तु वन्द्या नमस्याश्न प्रतिनाम तनुषु वे ५७ एतत्प्रोक्त॑ निदान वस्तननां नामभिः सह। महादेवस्य देवस्य भृगोस्तु शुणुत प्रजा: १६०
verses.wordMeaning: Hundreds of great Uragas (serpents) live there under the control of Garudas. They are terrible, fiery and inacce>sible and of venomous sight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hundreds of great Uragas (serpents) live there under the control of Garudas. They are terrible, fiery and inacce>sible and of venomous sight.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदेवमयी त्वं तु सर्वलोकमयी तथा । विधिना ये प्रदास्यन्ति तेषां वासस्त्रिविष्टपे
verses.transliteration: sarvadevamayī tvaṃ tu sarvalokamayī tathā / vidhinā ye pradāsyanti teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape
verses.translation: In the great mountain Sunaga, there arc thousands of abodes of Daityas. These consist of mansions and palaces with huge ramparts and archways.
verses.hindi: डति महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते महादेवतनुव्ण नं नाम सप्तविशो5ष्याय: ।
verses.wordMeaning: In the great mountain Sunaga, there arc thousands of abodes of Daityas. These consist of mansions and palaces with huge ramparts and archways.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the great mountain Sunaga, there arc thousands of abodes of Daityas. These consist of mansions and palaces with huge ramparts and archways.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ततो देवी ब्रह्माणं परमेश्वरी । वन्द्यमाना सुरैः सिद्धैर् आजगाम धरातलम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tato devī brahmāṇaṃ parameśvarī / vandyamānā suraiḥ siddhair ājagāma dharātalam
verses.translation: On the great mountain Venumanta, there arc three
verses.hindi: महादेव के शर्वें नाम की मूर्ति भूमि है, उसकी पत्नी विकेशी है और पुत्र अंगारक उनके चौथे स्वग्रेंगत ईशान दारीर कौ पत्नी शिवा है और पुत्र मनोजव है ।५१-५२। पाशुपत रूप अग्नि शरीर की पत्नी स्वाहा है और पुत्र स्कलद  छडे आकाश रूप भीम शरीर की पत्नी दिदशाएँ हैं और स्वर्ग पुत्र है।१३-५४। ब्राह्मणों द्वारा पुजित जो उनका सातवाँ उम्र नामक शरीर है, उसकी पत्ली दीक्षा है ओर पुत्र सम्तान है। चन्द्रमा रूप महान् आठवें शरीर की पत्नी रोहिणी है और पुत्र बुध है ।१५-५६। महादेव के ये शरोर हैं, जिनका नामोल्लेखपूर्वंक वर्णन किया गया है। ये सब शरीर अपने नामों के साथ वन्दनीय और नमस्करणीय हैं। जो मनुष्य सूबं, जल, प्रृथ्वी, वायु, अग्नि, व्योम, दीक्षित और चद्द्रमा रूपी महादंव के शरीर के प्रति भक्ति प्रदरशित करता है, वह निश्चय ही प्रजावान् होता है और शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है।५७-५६५। मैंने
verses.wordMeaning: On the great mountain Venumanta, there arc three
verses.commentary: Sense: On the great mountain Venumanta, there arc three

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: यदायातेह सा तात ब्राह्मणो वचनाच्छुभा । तदा देवाश्च लोकाश्च कथमङ्गेषु संस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: yadāyāteha sā tāta brāhmaṇo vacanācchubhā / tadā devāśca lokāśca kathamaṅgeṣu saṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: The rulers of the Vidyadharas, there, as valorous as Indra, are Uluka, Romasa and Mahanetra.
verses.hindi: आप लोगों के निकट इस गुह्य और यशदायक शिवतत्त्व को कहा । इसके फल से मनुष्यों और चतुध्पदों का मंगल हो । इस प्रकार आप लोगों को नामों के साथ महादेव के शरीर वर्णन को सुना दिय। । अब इसके बाद भृगुवंश का वर्णन सुनिये
verses.wordMeaning: The rulers of the Vidyadharas, there, as valorous as Indra, are Uluka, Romasa and Mahanetra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rulers of the Vidyadharas, there, as valorous as Indra, are Uluka, Romasa and Mahanetra.

verses.sanskrit: कथं वा संस्थितागत्य कपिला सा द्विजोत्तम । तीर्थे वा ह्यूषरे क्षेत्र एतन्मे कथय द्विज
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ vā saṃsthitāgatya kapilā sā dvijottama / tīrthe vā hyūṣare kṣetra etanme kathaya dvija
verses.translation: On the top of the great peak Vaikanka with caves and rivulets within, there lives Sugrlva, the fierce and power¬ ful, the unthwartable enemy of serpents and the son of Garuda with the great speed of the wind. This peak is of variegated colours due to jewels and minerals.
verses.hindi: धनुश्नि हान्तर्गतग्रन्थ: ७. पुस्तके नास्ति । ऋटष्पिजं छा च्तु व्की स्ते वक्त
verses.wordMeaning: On the top of the great peak Vaikanka with caves and rivulets within, there lives Sugrlva, the fierce and power¬ ful, the unthwartable enemy of serpents and the son of Garuda with the great speed of the wind. This peak is of variegated colours due to jewels and minerals.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the top of the great peak Vaikanka with caves and rivulets within, there lives Sugrlva, the fierce and power¬ ful, the unthwartable enemy of serpents and the son of Garuda with the great speed of the wind. This peak is of variegated colours due to jewels and minerals.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: सा तदा ब्रह्मणा चोक्ता धात्रा लोकस्य भारत । ब्रह्मलोकाद्गता पुण्यां नर्मदां लोकपावनीम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sā tadā brahmaṇā coktā dhātrā lokasya bhārata / brahmalokādgatā puṇyāṃ narmadāṃ lokapāvanīm
verses.translation: The whole ofthat mountain is teeming with birds which destroy serpents. They are of huge size, valorous and powerful.
verses.hindi: देवों धाताषिधातारो मन्वन्तरविचारिणो द
verses.wordMeaning: The whole ofthat mountain is teeming with birds which destroy serpents. They are of huge size, valorous and powerful.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole ofthat mountain is teeming with birds which destroy serpents. They are of huge size, valorous and powerful.

verses.sanskrit: तपः कृत्वा सुविपुलं नर्मदातटम् आश्रिता । चचार पृथिवीं सर्वां सशैलवनकाननाम्
verses.transliteration: tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ narmadātaṭam āśritā / cacāra pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saśailavanakānanām
verses.translation: Siva, the Lord of Yogins and Bhutas, whose emblem is the Bull, lives on the mountain Karanja.
verses.hindi: तयो ज्येंष्ठा तु भगिनी बेधी श्रीलोकभाविनी । सा तु नारायण देवं पतिमासाथझ शोभनम् ॥. नारायणात्मजों साध्वी बलोत्साहो व्यजायत तस्यास्तु मानसाः पुत्रा ये चान्ये दिव्यचारिण: । ये बहन्ति विमानानि देवानों पुण्यकर्मणामू
verses.wordMeaning: Siva, the Lord of Yogins and Bhutas, whose emblem is the Bull, lives on the mountain Karanja.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva, the Lord of Yogins and Bhutas, whose emblem is the Bull, lives on the mountain Karanja.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति राजेन्द्र कपिलातीर्थम् उत्तमम् । सर्वपापहरं ख्यातमृषिसङ्घैर् निषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti rājendra kapilātīrtham uttamam / sarvapāpaharaṃ khyātamṛṣisaṅghair niṣevitam
verses.translation: All round the ridges and slopes arc scattered the Bhutas, the unassailable Pramathas, with diverse dresses and features.
verses.hindi: पाण्डुश्चव मुकण्डुश्व अह्यकोशों सनातनौं  सनस्विन्‍्यां मुकण्डोशभ्व सार्फेण्डेयो बभूष ह
verses.wordMeaning: All round the ridges and slopes arc scattered the Bhutas, the unassailable Pramathas, with diverse dresses and features.
verses.commentary: Sense: All round the ridges and slopes arc scattered the Bhutas, the unassailable Pramathas, with diverse dresses and features.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तीर्थे विधिवत् स्नात्वा कपिलायाः प्रयच्छति । पृथ्वी तेन भवेद्दत्ता सशैलवनकानना
verses.transliteration: tattīrthe vidhivat snātvā kapilāyāḥ prayacchati / pṛthvī tena bhaveddattā saśailavanakānanā
verses.translation: They say that the eight illustrious abodes of the eight Vasus, the noble souls of unmeasured power, are situated on the mountain Vasudhara.
verses.hindi: सुतो वेदशिरास्तस्य सुर्धन्यायामजायत । पीवर्या वेदशिरसः पुत्रा बंशकराः स्मृताः ॥ मार्कण्डेया हति रूवाता ऋषयो वेदपारगाः सघूत जी घोले--भूगु से ख्याति के गर्भ में सुख दुःख के प्रभु, निखिल प्राणियों को शुभाशुभ देनेवाले, भन्वन्तर विहारी धाता और विधाता नामक दो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुये ।१। लोकभाविनी श्री देवी उनकी ज्येष्ठा भगिनी थीं, जिन्होंने नारायण को पति रूप में वरण किया। उस साध्वी के गर्भ से नारायण को बल और उत्साह नामक दो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुये ।२। ये ही क्‍यों इस साध्वी श्री देवी के वे सभी मानस पुत्र हैं, जो विव्यचारी
verses.wordMeaning: They say that the eight illustrious abodes of the eight Vasus, the noble souls of unmeasured power, are situated on the mountain Vasudhara.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that the eight illustrious abodes of the eight Vasus, the noble souls of unmeasured power, are situated on the mountain Vasudhara.

verses.sanskrit: तां तु पश्यति यो भक्त्या दीयमानां द्विजोत्तमे । तस्य वर्षशतं पापं नश्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ tu paśyati yo bhaktyā dīyamānāṃ dvijottame / tasya varṣaśataṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The seven holy hermitages of the seven sages and the abodes of the Siddhas are on the mountain Ratnadhatu.
verses.hindi: हैं और पुण्य कम करनेवाले देवों के विमानों का संचालन करते हैं । आयति और नियति नामक दो प्रसिद्ध कम्यकायें धाता और बविधाता की भार्या थीं, उन्हें पाण्ड और मृकण्डु नामक सनातन ब्रद्मकोश स्वरूप दो दृढ़ब्नत पुत्र उत्पन्न हुये ।३-४। मृकण्ड से मनस्विनी के गर्भ में मार्कण्डेय का जन्म हुआ  मार्केण्डेय को मूर्धन्या से वेदशिरा नामक पुत्र हुआ। फिर पीवरी के गर्भ से वेदशिरा को बहुत से वंश बढ़ानेवाले पुत्र हुये ।
verses.wordMeaning: The seven holy hermitages of the seven sages and the abodes of the Siddhas are on the mountain Ratnadhatu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven holy hermitages of the seven sages and the abodes of the Siddhas are on the mountain Ratnadhatu.

verses.sanskrit: भूर्भुवः स्वर्महश्चैव जनः सत्यं तपस्तथा । ते तत्पृष्ठं समाश्रित्य स्थिता लोका नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmahaścaiva janaḥ satyaṃ tapastathā / te tatpṛṣṭhaṃ samāśritya sthitā lokā nṛpottama
verses.translation: The abode of the four-faced lord, the great Prajapati (Brahma) is on the excellent mountain Hemasrriga. It is rever¬ ed by all living beings.
verses.hindi: वे सभी मार्कण्डेय नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं और सभी वेदपारग ऋषि हैं ।५-६। पाण्डु को पुण्डरीका के गर्भ से ३०० द वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of the four-faced lord, the great Prajapati (Brahma) is on the excellent mountain Hemasrriga. It is rever¬ ed by all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of the four-faced lord, the great Prajapati (Brahma) is on the excellent mountain Hemasrriga. It is rever¬ ed by all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: मुखे ह्यग्निः स्थितो देवो दन्तेषु च भुजङ्गमाः । धाता विधाता ह्योष्ठौ च जिह्वायां तु सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: mukhe hyagniḥ sthito devo danteṣu ca bhujaṅgamāḥ / dhātā vidhātā hyoṣṭhau ca jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī
verses.translation: On mountain Gajasaila, holy lord Rudras rejoice for ever along with (the groups of) Bhutas. They are respected by all living beings.
verses.hindi: पाण्डोश्र पुण्डरीकायां ग्ुतिमानात्मजो5भवत् । उत्पन्नौ द्युतिमन्तश्र सृजवानश्र तावुभो ७
verses.wordMeaning: On mountain Gajasaila, holy lord Rudras rejoice for ever along with (the groups of) Bhutas. They are respected by all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: On mountain Gajasaila, holy lord Rudras rejoice for ever along with (the groups of) Bhutas. They are respected by all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रकिरणौ देवौ चन्द्रादित्यौ सुलोचनौ । नासिकामध्यगश्चैव मारुतो नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: sahasrakiraṇau devau candrādityau sulocanau / nāsikāmadhyagaścaiva māruto nṛpasattama
verses.translation: The constructedabodesof Adityas, Vasus andRudras of unlimited splendour are on the great mountain Sumegha which resembles a cloud and is richly endowed with minerals. The mountain is beautified with many caves, bunds and hedges. The charming mansions of the Asvin gods too are there.
verses.hindi: पूर्णणास: सरस्वत्यां हो पुत्रावुदपादयत् । विरजं, चेव धर्मिष्ठं पव॑ंसं चेव तावुभो .. लोकपाल: सुधर्मात्मा गौरीपुत्र: प्रतापवान्  पर्बंसः सर्वंगणानां प्रविष्ट:ः स महायशा:
verses.wordMeaning: The constructedabodesof Adityas, Vasus andRudras of unlimited splendour are on the great mountain Sumegha which resembles a cloud and is richly endowed with minerals. The mountain is beautified with many caves, bunds and hedges.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The constructedabodesof Adityas, Vasus andRudras of unlimited splendour are on the great mountain Sumegha which resembles a cloud and is richly endowed with minerals. The mountain is beautified with many caves, bunds and hedges.…

verses.sanskrit: ललाटे तु महादेवो ह्यश्विनौ कर्णसंस्थितौ । नरनारायणौ शृङ्गे शृङ्गमध्ये पितामहः
verses.transliteration: lalāṭe tu mahādevo hyaśvinau karṇasaṃsthitau / naranārāyaṇau śṛṅge śṛṅgamadhye pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: The abodes of Devas have been established by Siddhas on the excellent mountain. Yaksas, Gandharvas and Kinnaras, are engaged in worship there for ever.
verses.hindi: पर्वंसः पर्बसायां तु जनयामास बे सुतौ। यज्ञवासं च श्रीमन्तं सुतं काश्यपसेव च् ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: The abodes of Devas have been established by Siddhas on the excellent mountain. Yaksas, Gandharvas and Kinnaras, are engaged in worship there for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abodes of Devas have been established by Siddhas on the excellent mountain. Yaksas, Gandharvas and Kinnaras, are engaged in worship there for ever.

verses.sanskrit: कम्बलो ऽधिगतस् तात पाशधृग् वरुणस् तथा । यमश्च भगवान्देव आश्रित्य चोदरं श्रितः
verses.transliteration: kambalo 'dhigatas tāta pāśadhṛg varuṇas tathā / yamaśca bhagavāndeva āśritya codaraṃ śritaḥ
verses.translation: There is the city of noble Sunabha, son of Garuda on the mountain Svetodara, embellished with great mansions!
verses.hindi: तयोगत्रक रो पुत्रों तो जातो धर्मनिश्चितों १३ स्मृतिश्चाज़िरसः पत्नी जज्ञे तावात्मसंभवों । पुत्रो कन्याश्वतस्नश्च पुण्यास्ता लोकविश्वताः सिनीवाली कुछृश्चेब राका चानुमतिस्तथा। तथेव भरताग्नि च कीतिमन्तं च तावुभो
verses.wordMeaning: There is the city of noble Sunabha, son of Garuda on the mountain Svetodara, embellished with great mansions!
verses.commentary: Sense: There is the city of noble Sunabha, son of Garuda on the mountain Svetodara, embellished with great mansions!

verses.sanskrit: खुरेषु पन्नगाश्चैवं पुच्छाग्रे सूर्यरश्मयः । एवम्भूतां हि कपिलां सर्वदेवमयीं नृप
verses.transliteration: khureṣu pannagāścaivaṃ pucchāgre sūryaraśmayaḥ / evambhūtāṃ hi kapilāṃ sarvadevamayīṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: There is a mansion embellished with palaces on the excellent mountain Pis'acaUa. That is the great abode ofKubera frequented by Yaksas and Gandharvas. '
verses.hindi: आभुतसंप्लवस्थायी लोकपालः स वे स्मृतः १६ जज्ञे कीतिमतश्चापि धेनुका तावकल्मषों । वरिष्ठ धृतिसनन्‍्त॑ चाप्युभावड्रिरसां बरो ३१७
verses.wordMeaning: There is a mansion embellished with palaces on the excellent mountain Pis'acaUa. That is the great abode ofKubera frequented by Yaksas and Gandharvas. '
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a mansion embellished with palaces on the excellent mountain Pis'acaUa. That is the great abode ofKubera frequented by Yaksas and Gandharvas. '

verses.sanskrit: ये धारयन्ति च गृहे धन्यास्ते नात्र संशयः । प्रातर् उत्थाय यस्तस्याः कुरुते तु प्रदक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: ye dhārayanti ca gṛhe dhanyāste nātra saṃśayaḥ / prātar utthāya yastasyāḥ kurute tu pradakṣiṇām
verses.translation: On the oeautifully peaked Pandura, with ramparts and archways the city of Vidyadharas is situated. It has a series of big houses.
verses.hindi: शतिमानू, धुतिमन्‍्त और सूृजवान् नामक तीन पुत्र हुये । उनके बीच द्यूतिमन्‍्त और सृजवान् के पृत्र-पोत्रों ने भागों से परस्पर सम्बन्ध स्थापित किया । इस प्रकार स्वायम्भुव मनु के बीत जाने पर मरीचि का वंश विस्तार सुनिये ७-८। मरीचि की पत्नी सम्भूति ने पूर्णमास नामक पुत्र और कुष्टि, पृष्टि, त्विषा और अपचिति नामक कन्याओं को उत्पन्न किया ॥६। पूर्णमास ने सरस्वती के ग भ से विरणज और पर्वंस नामक दो पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया । विरज को सुधामा नामक विद्वान् पुत्र हुआ। सूधामसुत वराज ने प्राच्यदेवा का आश्रय लिया । गौरीपुत्र पर्स सुधासिक, प्रतापवान् और महायशस्वी हुये । लोकपाल होकर ये स्वंगण में प्रविष्ट हुये ।१० १२ पर्वस ने पर्वसा के गर्भ के यज्ञवास और कश्यप नामक धर्मनिर्णायक और वंश वृद्धि करने वाले दो पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया। अज्िरा ने स्मृति के गर्भ से भरताग्नि और कीतिमान् नामक दो पुत्र और
verses.wordMeaning: On the oeautifully peaked Pandura, with ramparts and archways the city of Vidyadharas is situated. It has a series of big houses.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the oeautifully peaked Pandura, with ramparts and archways the city of Vidyadharas is situated. It has a series of big houses.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणा कृता तेन सशैलवनकानना । कपिलापञ्चगव्येन यः स्नापयति शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇā kṛtā tena saśailavanakānanā / kapilāpañcagavyena yaḥ snāpayati śaṅkaram
verses.translation: On the mountain Sahasra-sikhara, there are thousand cities ofDaityas oflierce activities, wearing gold necklaces.
verses.hindi: सिनीबाली, कुह, राका एवं अनुमति नामक चार पृत्रियों को उत्पन्न किया ।१३-१४। अग्नि को संहती से प्ज॑न्य नामक पुत्र हुआ । फिर हिरण्यरोमा पर्जन्य ने मारीची के गर्भ से एक पुत्र उत्पन्न किया, जो महाप्रलय तक रहने वाला लोकपाल हुआ ।१६। कीतिमान् ने धेतुका से वरिष्ठ मौर धृतिमानू नामक दो पुत्रों को उत्पन्न, किया, जो दोनों ही आंगिरस श्रेष्ठ थे।१७। इस दोनों को हजारों पृत्र-पौत्र हुये। अनसूया ने अन्ि
verses.wordMeaning: On the mountain Sahasra-sikhara, there are thousand cities ofDaityas oflierce activities, wearing gold necklaces.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the mountain Sahasra-sikhara, there are thousand cities ofDaityas oflierce activities, wearing gold necklaces.

verses.sanskrit: उपवासपरो यस्तु तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप । स्नात्वा ह्युक्तविधानेन तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: upavāsaparo yastu tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / snātvā hyuktavidhānena tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: here are residences'of Pannagas (serpents) on the Mukuta mountain and multitudes of sages always live happily on Puspaka mount,
verses.hindi: कन्यां चेव श्रत नाम साता शद्भूपदस्य या। कर्दंसस्य तु या पत्नी पुलहस्य प्रजापतेः १६ यामेइतीते सहाततीताः पच्आउत्रेया प्रकीतिताः.. ३२०.
verses.wordMeaning: here are residences'of Pannagas (serpents) on the Mukuta mountain and multitudes of sages always live happily on Puspaka mount,
verses.commentary: Sense: here are residences'of Pannagas (serpents) on the Mukuta mountain and multitudes of sages always live happily on Puspaka mount,

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते वंशजाः सर्वे दश पूर्वे दशापरे । तृप्ता रोहन्ति वै स्वर्गे ध्यायन्तो ऽस्य मनोरथान्
verses.transliteration: tasya te vaṃśajāḥ sarve daśa pūrve daśāpare / tṛptā rohanti vai svarge dhyāyanto 'sya manorathān
verses.translation: On the excellent mountain Supaksa, there are four mansions of Vaivasvata (Yama), Soma, Vayu and the king of serpents.
verses.hindi: क्षमा तु सुषुवे पुत्रान्युलहस्य प्रजापते:  ते चार्निवर्चस सर्वे येषां कीति: प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.wordMeaning: On the excellent mountain Supaksa, there are four mansions of Vaivasvata (Yama), Soma, Vayu and the king of serpents.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the excellent mountain Supaksa, there are four mansions of Vaivasvata (Yama), Soma, Vayu and the king of serpents.

verses.sanskrit: एष ते विधिरुद्दिष्टः सम्भवो नृपसत्तम । तीर्थस्य च फलं पुण्यं किमन्यत् परिपृच्छसि
verses.transliteration: eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ sambhavo nṛpasattama / tīrthasya ca phalaṃ puṇyaṃ kimanyat paripṛcchasi
verses.translation: In their respective places, their respective gods are highly worshipped by Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yaksas, Nagas (serpents) and excellent Vidyadharas and Siddhas.
verses.hindi: कर्दमभ्राम्वरीषश्च सहिष्णुश्चेति ते ञ्यः  ऋषिधंनकपीवांश्च शुभा कन्या च पीवरी २६ कर्दमस्य श्रुतिः पत्नी आत्रेय्यजनयत्सुतान् । पुत्र शद्भूपदं चेव कस्यां काम्यां तथेव च २७ से पाँच निष्पाप पुत्र और एक कन्या को उत्पन्न किया। इस कन्या का नाम श्रुति था, जो शब्लपादकी माता और प्रजातति कदम ऋषि की पत्नी थी। सत्यनेत्र, हृव्य, आपोमूर्ति, शनीर्वर और सोम वामक जिन पाँचों पुत्रों को अनसूया ने उत्पन्न किया था, वे स्वायम्भुव मनु के अधिकार काल में विद्यमान् थे। याम ( नामक देवगण ) के अतीत होने पर ये पाँचों अत्रिवंद्याधर भी विलुप्त हो गये ।7५-२०। स्वायम्भुव मनु के अधिकार
verses.wordMeaning: In their respective places, their respective gods are highly worshipped by Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yaksas, Nagas (serpents) and excellent Vidyadharas and Siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In their respective places, their respective gods are highly worshipped by Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yaksas, Nagas (serpents) and excellent Vidyadharas and Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं सर्वदुःखघ्नमुत्तमम् । यच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam / yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: In their respective places, their respective gods are highly worshipped by Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yaksas, Nagas (serpents) and excellent Vidyadharas and Siddhas.
verses.hindi: काल में उनके सैकड़ों हजारों पृत्र-पोत्रगणण महात्मा अनत्रि के साथ विद्यमान् थे। प्रीति के गर्भ के पुलस्त्य को दत्तालि नामक पुत्र हुआ। ये ही स्वायम्भुव मनु के समय पूर्व जन्म में अगस्त्य थे । उन्हें देवबाहु ओर बिनीत नामक दो भाई और हुये । इनकी छोटी बहन का नाम सद्गती था, जो अग्नि से ब्याही गयी थी और पर्जन्य की माता थी  पुलस्त्य ऋषि के ज्येष्ठ पुत्र धीमान् दत्तालि ने अपनी पत्नी में सुजंघ प्रभृत्रि बहुतेरे पुत्रों को
verses.wordMeaning: In their respective places, their respective gods are highly worshipped by Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yaksas, Nagas (serpents) and excellent Vidyadharas and Siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In their respective places, their respective gods are highly worshipped by Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yaksas, Nagas (serpents) and excellent Vidyadharas and Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्रीनर्मदामाहात्म्ये कपिलातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ४० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र करञ्जेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धो महाभागो दैत्यो लोकेषु विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmye kapilātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 40 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra karañjeśvaram uttamam / yatra siddho mahābhāgo daityo lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Know that the place of birth of the intelligent Suparna (Garuda), son of Vinata, extends to a hundred Yojanas
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न किया; जो स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तर में पौलस्त्य नाम से विख्यात थे ।२१-२४।॥ पुलह प्रजापति की पत्नी क्षमा ने अनेक पुत्रों को प्रसव किया, जो अग्नितुल्य तेजस्वी और कीतिमान् थे ।२५। उनके नाम कदंम, अम्बरीप ओर सहिष्णु थे। सहिष्णु का दूसरा नाम धनकपीवान् भी था। इनकी सुन्दरी भगिनों का नाम पीवरी था। कदंम की पत्नी अत्रिपुत्री श्रृति ने शद्धुपाद नामक पुत्र और काम्या नाम की एक कन्या को स व शहखपदः श्रीमांल्लोकपाल: प्रजापति: । दक्षिणस्थां दिशि रतः काम्यां दत्त्वा प्रियक्षेी
verses.wordMeaning: Know that the place of birth of the intelligent Suparna (Garuda), son of Vinata, extends to a hundred Yojanas
verses.commentary: Sense: Know that the place of birth of the intelligent Suparna (Garuda), son of Vinata, extends to a hundred Yojanas

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: यो ऽसौ सिद्धो महाभाग तत्र तीर्थे महातपाः । कस्य पुत्रः कथं सिद्धः कस्मिन्काले वद द्विज
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: yo 'sau siddho mahābhāga tatra tīrthe mahātapāḥ / kasya putraḥ kathaṃ siddhaḥ kasminkāle vada dvija
verses.translation: There is the first mansion of the noble king of birds who has the velocity of the wind and residence in Salmalx Dvipa.
verses.hindi: कास्या प्रियव्रताललेमे स्वायंभुवसमान्सुतान् । दशकन्याद्यं चेव ये: क्षत्रं संप्रवतितमू
verses.wordMeaning: There is the first mansion of the noble king of birds who has the velocity of the wind and residence in Salmalx Dvipa.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is the first mansion of the noble king of birds who has the velocity of the wind and residence in Salmalx Dvipa.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुरा कृतयुगे राजन्मानसो ब्रह्मणः सुतः । वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो मरीचिर्नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā kṛtayuge rājanmānaso brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ / vedavedāṅgatattvajño marīcirnāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: On the seven southern peaks of its charming hill, there arc seven cities of Gandharvas where men and women live. They are forty Yojanas in length and thirty Yojanas in breadth. The golden ramparts and archways rise up. They are built by Devas and beautified with a series of great mansions. They resemble clouds at dusk. The peaks are of variegated shapes and colours. They are prosperous.
verses.hindi: पुत्रों धनकपोवांश्च सहिष्णुर्नाम विश्वुतः यशोधारी विजल्ले वे कामदेव: सुमध्यमा अरुणस्याग्रतो यान्ति परिवायं दिवाकरम् । अभृतसंप्लवात्सवबें पतज्भरसहचारिणः ३२
verses.wordMeaning: On the seven southern peaks of its charming hill, there arc seven cities of Gandharvas where men and women live. They are forty Yojanas in length and thirty Yojanas in breadth. The golden ramparts and archways rise up.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the seven southern peaks of its charming hill, there arc seven cities of Gandharvas where men and women live. They are forty Yojanas in length and thirty Yojanas in breadth. The golden ramparts and archways rise up.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापि तपसो राशेः कालेन महतानघ । पुत्रो ऽथ मानसो जातः साक्षाद् ब्रह्मेव चापरः
verses.transliteration: tasyāpi tapaso rāśeḥ kālena mahatānagha / putro 'tha mānaso jātaḥ sākṣād brahmeva cāparaḥ
verses.translation: There are very powerful and valorous Agneya Gan¬ dharvas. They are the brilliant followers of Kubera. These are their excellent mansions.
verses.hindi: ऊर्जायां तु वसिष्ठस्य पुत्रा वे सप्त जन्षिरे । ज्यायसी च स्वसा तेषां पुण्डरीका सुमध्यमा ॥३े४
verses.wordMeaning: There are very powerful and valorous Agneya Gan¬ dharvas. They are the brilliant followers of Kubera. These are their excellent mansions.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are very powerful and valorous Agneya Gan¬ dharvas. They are the brilliant followers of Kubera. These are their excellent mansions.

verses.sanskrit: क्षमा दमो दया दानं सत्यं शौचम् अथार्जवम् । मरीचेश्च गुणा ह्येते सन्ति तस्य च भारत
verses.transliteration: kṣamā damo dayā dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucam athārjavam / marīceśca guṇā hyete santi tasya ca bhārata
verses.translation: On the northern peaks of the lofty mountain Bhu- vana, there is a city teeming with serpents. It is full of man¬ sions and palaces and is beautified with gardens and parks. It has great ramparts and archways. The interior of the parks is rendered pleasant by the sound of hundreds of musical instru¬ ments.
verses.hindi: रजसो वाध्प्यजनयन्मार्कंण्डेयो यशस्विनी । प्रतीच्यां दिशि राजन्यं केतुमन्तं प्रजापतिभ् १३३७ उत्पन्न किया । वही श्रीमान् लोकपाल प्रजापति शद्भपाद अपनी भगिनी काम्या को राजा प्रियश्रत से ग्याह् कर दक्षिण दिशा की ओर चले गये ।२६-२५। काम्या ने प्रियत्रत से स्वयम्भू तुल्य दस पुत्रों को और दो कन्याओं को प्राप्त किया। इन्हीं पुत्रों से क्षत्रकुल की वृद्धि हुई। पुलह के तीसरे पुत्र सहिष्णु या धनकपी- वानू ने सुमध्यमा नामवाली अपनी पत्नी से यशोधारी कामदेव नामक पृत्र को उत्पन्न किया । ऋतु को ऋतु
verses.wordMeaning: On the northern peaks of the lofty mountain Bhu- vana, there is a city teeming with serpents. It is full of man¬ sions and palaces and is beautified with gardens and parks. It has great ramparts and archways.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the northern peaks of the lofty mountain Bhu- vana, there is a city teeming with serpents. It is full of man¬ sions and palaces and is beautified with gardens and parks. It has great ramparts and archways.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं गुणगणाकीर्णं कश्यपं द्विजसत्तमम् । ज्ञात्वा प्रजापतिर् दक्षो भार्यार्थे स्वसुतां ददौ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇaṃ kaśyapaṃ dvijasattamam / jñātvā prajāpatir dakṣo bhāryārthe svasutāṃ dadau
verses.translation: Know that there is on the mount Devakuta the city of Saimhikeyas, the enemies of gods. It is unassailable by enemies. Its outer wall measures thirty Yojanas. It is frequented by Siddhas and divine sages.
verses.hindi: के तुल्य पुत्र हुआ। इसी से उनकी सन्‍्तति चली। इन्हें नभार्या थी और न पुत्र। सभी ऊध्बरेता थे। ये साठ हजार वालखिल्य कहलाते हैं ।२६-३१। ये दिवाकर को चारों ओर घेर कर अरुण के भागे आगे जाते हैं । जब तक प्रलय नहीं होता है, तब तक ये सूर्य के साथ चलते रहते हैं। इन्हें दो छोटी बहने थीं, जिनका ताम पुण्या और आत्मसुमती था। ये दोनों ही परूणंमास सुत पर्बंस की पुञ्र-वधुयें थीं। ऊर्जा के गर्भ से वसिष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: Know that there is on the mount Devakuta the city of Saimhikeyas, the enemies of gods. It is unassailable by enemies. Its outer wall measures thirty Yojanas. It is frequented by Siddhas and divine sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know that there is on the mount Devakuta the city of Saimhikeyas, the enemies of gods. It is unassailable by enemies. Its outer wall measures thirty Yojanas. It is frequented by Siddhas and divine sages.

verses.sanskrit: अदितिर्दितिर्दनुश्चैव तथाप्येवं दशापराः । यासां पुत्राश्च संजाताः पौत्राश्च भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration: aditirditirdanuścaiva tathāpyevaṃ daśāparāḥ / yāsāṃ putrāśca saṃjātāḥ pautrāśca bharatarṣabha
verses.translation: O Brahmana, there on the charming ridge of Deva¬ kuta is founded the invincible and inaccessible city of the demons known as Kalakeyas. It looks like a cluster of clouds. It is well- known as Sunasa. It is on the next boundary mountain. It has a series of great mansions of different colours. It is decorated in various ways with gold and precious stones. Its streets are broad.- It is full of joy, auspiciousness and teeming with men and wo¬ men. Its ramparts and archways are very high. The city is hundred Yojanas in length and sixty Yojanas in breadth.
verses.hindi: को सात बेठे और एक पुत्री हुई, जिसका नाम पुण्डरीक था ।३ २०३४ कृशकटि वह द्युतिमान् की माता और पाए्डु की प्रिय पत्नी थी । इसी के गर्भ से विख्यात सप्त वासिष्ठ ने भी जन्म ग्रहण किया । इनके नाम रज, पुत्र, अद्धंबाहु, सवन, अधन, सुतपा और शुल्क थे । ये सप्तर्षि कहलाते हैं ।३५-१६। मनस्विनी माक॑ण्डेयी ने रजस् से राजन्य, केतुमान् और प्रजापति को उत्पन्न किया । इन्होंने प्रतोीची दिशा में आश्रय प्राप्त किया था। महात्मा वासिष्ठों का वंश नाम के साथ स्वायम्भुव मन्वस्तर में लुप्त हो गया। अब अग्नि का वंश
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmana, there on the charming ridge of Deva¬ kuta is founded the invincible and inaccessible city of the demons known as Kalakeyas. It looks like a cluster of clouds. It is well- known as Sunasa. It is on the next boundary mountain.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmana, there on the charming ridge of Deva¬ kuta is founded the invincible and inaccessible city of the demons known as Kalakeyas. It looks like a cluster of clouds. It is well- known as Sunasa. It is on the next boundary mountain.…

verses.sanskrit: अदितिर्जनयामास पुत्रान् इन्द्रपुरोगमान् । जातास्तस्य महाबाहो कश्यपस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: aditirjanayāmāsa putrān indrapurogamān / jātāstasya mahābāho kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: On the southern peak of the same mountain, there is the jolly big city of Autkaca Raksasas. They are joyful, well- nourished, proud and can assume any form at will. The city is
verses.hindi: एकोन त्रिशोष्ष्यायः २०३ इत्येष ऋषिसगंस्तु सानुबन्धः प्रकीतितः । विस्तरेणा«नृपुर्ब्या चाप्यग्नेस्तु श्यणुत प्रजाः
verses.wordMeaning: On the southern peak of the same mountain, there is the jolly big city of Autkaca Raksasas. They are joyful, well- nourished, proud and can assume any form at will. The city is

verses.sanskrit: यैस्तु लोकत्रयं व्याप्तं स्थावरं जङ्गमं महत् । तथान्यस्य महाभागो दनोः पुत्रो व्यजायत

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं धन्यं दुःस्वप्ननाशनम् । पठतां शृण्वतां चैव तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam

The Pramathas, the enemy of the Tripuras too, are engaged in sports. Here lord Siva, the benefactor of the worlds is worshipped by Siddhas, Devas, sages, Gandharvas, Yaksas and Nagas.
verses.hindi: सोलह भागों में विभक्त कर उन धीष्णियों ( आधारभूत नदियों ) में आसक्त हुये । अग्नि स्वयं धिष्णुय हैं । और साध्वी नदियों से उन्हें अनेक पुत्र हुये, जो धिष्णी से उत्पद्य होने के कारण घि७ष्णय कहलाये ये नदी-पुत्र जो धिष्णयों में उत्पन्न हुये हैं भौर अग्नि हैं, उनके विहार योग्य स्थानों को सुनिये, हम संक्षेप में कहते हैं ।१५-१६। ऋतु, प्रवाहण, अग्नीध्र और अपरापर धीष्णिगण यज्ञ दिवस में सवनक्रम से यथास्थ।न सम्प्रुख भाग में स्थापित होते हैं। जो अग्नि अनिर्देशश और अवाच्य हैं अर्थात् जिनके स्थान आदि का निर्देश नहीं हुआ है, उनके क्रम को सुनिये ।१७-१८३। कृशानु नामक जो सम्राट् अग्नि हैं, वे यज्ञ के उत्तर द्वितीय बेदी

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु श्रावयते श्राद्धे पठेत् पितृपरायणः । अक्षयं जायते पुण्यमित्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: yastu śrāvayate śrāddhe paṭhet pitṛparāyaṇaḥ / akṣayaṃ jāyate puṇyamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: With the jingling sounds of instruments and high pitched vocal music, the leading Ganas are hectically engaged in worship. The Pramathas, the enemy of the Tripuras too, are engaged in sports. Here lord Siva, the benefactor of the worlds is worshipped by Siddhas, Devas, sages, Gandharvas, Yaksas and Nagas.
verses.hindi: पर निवास करते हैं। सम्राट अग्नि आठ प्रकार के हैं, जितकी ब्राह्मण लोग पूजा किया करते हैं। पर्बोक्त आठौं अग्नियों में पर्षत अग्नि द्वितीय हैं। ये वेदी के अधोभाग में रहते हैं। ग्रतक्नोच ( ? ) में तभ नामके अग्नि चार नामों से स्थित हैं। ब्रह्मज्योति वयु नामक अग्नि ब्रह्मस्थान में रहते हैं ।(९-२१। हन्य और सूर्यादि से जिनका कोई संसगे नहीं है, वह अग्नि झामित्र कर्म में स्थापित होते हैं। समुद्राग्ति का ताम बविश्वस्थाय

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये करञ्जेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ४१ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेच्च राजेन्द्र कुण्डलेश्वरमुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धो महायक्षः कुण्डधारो नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye karañjeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 41 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchecca rājendra kuṇḍaleśvaramuttamam / yatra siddho mahāyakṣaḥ kuṇḍadhāro nṛpottama
verses.translation: Kailasa is the abode of the devotees of the lord who are of meritorious souls. It has isolated, charming summits. It is full of vegetation. It has the lustre of the conch. This is a poetic description of the peak near Lake Manasa and not of the trans-Himalayan Kailasa range. The climatic conditions of those days. seem favourable for vegetation and human habitation.
verses.hindi: है । यह ब्रह्मस्थान में निहित होते हैं ।२२। ऋतुधामा सुज्योति अग्ति औदुम्बरी में स्थापित होते हैं । ब्रद्मज्योति वसु नामक अग्नि ब्रह्म स्थान में रहते हैं ।२३॥ अजेकपाद अश्नि पूजनीय हैं और यज्ञगालामुख में स्थापित होने हैं। अहिबुध्त अग्ति अनुदेष्य हैं और गृहपति कहलाते हैं। हांस्थ के सभी पुत्र ब्राह्मणों हारा पूजनीय कहे गये -+ भपनुद्िचह्वान्तगंग्रन्थो ड. पुस्तके तास्ति । धनुश्चित्नास्तम्रंतग्रन्थ: ख. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Kailasa is the abode of the devotees of the lord who are of meritorious souls. It has isolated, charming summits. It is full of vegetation. It has the lustre of the conch. This is a poetic description of the peak near Lake Manasa and not of the trans-Himalayan Kailasa range.…

verses.sanskrit: तपः कृत्वा सुविपुलं सुरासुरभयंकरम् । पौलस्त्यमन्दिरे चैव चिक्रीड नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ surāsurabhayaṃkaram / paulastyamandire caiva cikrīḍa nṛpasattama
verses.translation: In the central ridge, as beautiful as Kunda flower, there is the invincible city of the noble-souled Kubera, 1 the presiding deity of wealth. It is a hundred Yojanas in length and fifty Yojanas in breadth. It is beautified with a series of big mansions, set in diverse ways in gold and silver. It is very extensive, affluent and joyful. There is a charming assembly-hall in the centre, embe¬ llished with variegated pieces of gold. It is known as Vipuld be¬ cause it abounds in archways and pillars.
verses.hindi: तथाइग्निविश्वदेवस्तु ब्रह्मस्थाने स उच्यते । अवक्षरच्छावाकस्तु भुवः स्थाने विभाव्यते २८ उशीराग्नि: सवीयंस्तु नेष्ठीयः संविभाव्यते । अष्टमस्तु व्यरत्निस्तु मार्जालीयः प्रकीतितः..

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कस्मिन्युगे समुत्पन्नः कस्य पुत्रो महामतिः । तपस्तप्त्वा सुविपुलं तोषितो येन शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kasminyuge samutpannaḥ kasya putro mahāmatiḥ / tapastaptvā suvipulaṃ toṣito yena śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: The aerial chariot Puspaka, decorated in jewels, is there. It is very charming and endowed with all desirable qualities. As quick as the mind, it can reach any desired goal. It is decorated with clusters of gold pieces. It is the vehicle of Kubera, king of Yak§as.
verses.hindi: धिष्ण्या विहरणीया ये सोम्येना5०्येन चव हि। तयोये: पाचको नाम स चापां गर्भ उच्चते समुद्रवासिन:ः पुत्र: सहरक्षों विभाव्यते । सहरक्षसुतः क्षामो गृहाणि स वहेच्नणाम
verses.wordMeaning: The aerial chariot Puspaka, decorated in jewels, is there. It is very charming and endowed with all desirable qualities. As quick as the mind, it can reach any desired goal. It is decorated with clusters of gold pieces. It is the vehicle of Kubera, king of Yak§as.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्विस्तरतस्तात कथयस्व ममानघ । शृण्वतश्च न तृप्तिर् मे कथामृतमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: etadvistaratastāta kathayasva mamānagha / śṛṇvataśca na tṛptir me kathāmṛtamanuttamam
verses.translation: Lord Kubera the companion of Mahadeva lives there. He is the king of Yaksas revered and honoured by all living beings. Kubera, excellent among Devas, lives there along with Apsaras-s, Yaksas, Gandharvas, Siddhas and Caranas.
verses.hindi: क़व्यादो४ग्निः सुतस्तस्तस्य पुरुषानत्ति यो मृतान्  इत्येते पावकस्यास्नेः पुत्रा हां व॑ प्रकीतिता:

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: त्रेतायुगे ब्रह्मसमः पौलस्त्योनाम विश्रवाः । तपः कृत्वा सुविपुलं भरद्वाजसुतोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tretāyuge brahmasamaḥ paulastyonāma viśravāḥ / tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ bharadvājasutodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Here the Lord of Wealth has eight treasures: 2 Padma, Mahapadma, Makara, Kacchapa, Kumuda, Sankha, KJa and Nandana. These being inexhaustible, divine great Treasures hoarding jewels are kept in the assembly-hall. Similarly this mount Kailasa is the abode of Indra, ama, Devas and Apsaras-s where Kubera, the Lord of
verses.hindi: आयुर्नामाइथ भगवान्पशों यस्तु प्रणीयते । आयुषों महिमान्पुत्र: स शावान्नामतः सुतः हैं। अब विहरणीय अग्नि और उनके आठों पुत्रों को कहते हैं।२४-२५। ऋतु, प्रवाहन, अग्नीध और वहाँ रहने वाले घीष्णिगण यज्ञदिवस में सवनक्रम से यथास्थान विहार करते हैं। उनके सुत ह॒व्यवाहन अग्नि पंत्रेय कहे जाते हैं और शाम्ति नामक अग्नि प्रचेता स्वरूप हैं। सत्य अग्नि द्वितीय कहे जाते हैं अर्थात इनका दूसरा स्थान है ।२६-२७। विश्वदेव नामक अग्नि ब्रह्म स्थान में स्थापित होते हैं। अचक्षु एवं अच्छावाक अग्ति

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं पौत्रगणैर् युक्तं पत्न्या भक्त्या सुतोषितः । धनदं जनयामास सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: putraṃ pautragaṇair yuktaṃ patnyā bhaktyā sutoṣitaḥ / dhanadaṃ janayāmāsa sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam
verses.translation: The attendants of Devas first pay their respects to the king of Yaksa,s and then proceed to their respective lords. This city is Alaka immortalised by Kalidasa in the Meghaduta. Th city was either on or near the Kailasa peak.
verses.hindi: का भूमि में स्थापन होता है। सवीये उशीराग्नि नेष्ठीय कहे जाते हैं। अष्टम व्यरत्नि अग्नि मार्जालीय कहे जाते हैं ॥२५-२९। जो धिष्णय सौम्य और आज्य के विहार योग्य हैं, उन दोनों के बीच पावक तामक अग्नि जलराशि के गर्भ कहे जाते हैं।३०। जो अग्नि जल में अच्छी से डूबे रहते हैं, वह अवभूथ कहलाते हैं। इनके पुत्र. का नाम हृच्छय अग्नि है, जो मनुष्यों के जठर देश में वत॑मान हैं। जाठराग्नि के पृन्न विद्वान
verses.wordMeaning: The attendants of Devas first pay their respects to the king of Yaksa,s and then proceed to their respective lords. This city is Alaka immortalised by Kalidasa in the Meghaduta. Th city was either on or near the Kailasa peak.
verses.commentary: Sense: The attendants of Devas first pay their respects to the king of Yaksa,s and then proceed to their respective lords. This city is Alaka immortalised by Kalidasa in the Meghaduta. Th city was either on or near the Kailasa peak.

verses.sanskrit: जातमात्रं तु तं ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । चकार नाम सुप्रीत ऋषिदेवसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: jātamātraṃ tu taṃ jñātvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / cakāra nāma suprīta ṛṣidevasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: On the eastern peak of this lordly mountain, 1 there are ten famous cities of Gandharvas endowed with prosperity. They are one thousand Yojanas in length and thirty Yojanas in breadth. Theyare decorated with a series of great mansions. There are ten Gandharva kings as valorous as the; blazing fires. They are named as Subahu, Harikes'a, Citrasena,
verses.hindi: मन्युमान् अग्नि हैं। ये भूतों के प्रभु और परस्पर व्याप्त हैं। मन्युमान् अग्नि के पृत्र घोर संवतंक हैं। ये वड़वामुख होकर समुद्र में जल पोते हुये निवास करते हैं ।? १-३३। समुद्रवासी वड़वामुख के पुत्र सहरक्ष हैं । सहरक्ष के पुत्र क्षाम हैं, जो मनुष्यों के घर जलाते हैं। इनके पुत्र क्रव्याद अग्नि हैं, जो मृत पुरुषों को जलाते हैं। पावक अग्ति के इतने ही पुत्र हैं. जिनका वर्णन कर दिया। ३४-३५। शुचि सौरि अग्नि गन्धबं-असुरों द्वारा अरणिमन्थन करने से समिद्ध (प्रदीप्त। हुये । आयु नामक भगवान् अग्नि पशुशरीर में वर्तमान रहते हैं । आयु के पुत्र 'महिमान् हैं। इनके शावान नामक पुत्र हुये ।। ६-३७। जो अग्नि पाकयज्ञ में प्रतिष्ठित होते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: On the eastern peak of this lordly mountain, 1 there are ten famous cities of Gandharvas endowed with prosperity. They are one thousand Yojanas in length and thirty Yojanas in breadth. Theyare decorated with a series of great mansions.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the eastern peak of this lordly mountain, 1 there are ten famous cities of Gandharvas endowed with prosperity. They are one thousand Yojanas in length and thirty Yojanas in breadth. Theyare decorated with a series of great mansions.…

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद् विश्रवसो जातो मम पौत्रत्वम् आगतः । तस्माद् वैश्रवणो नाम तव दत्तं मयानघ
verses.transliteration: yasmād viśravaso jāto mama pautratvam āgataḥ / tasmād vaiśravaṇo nāma tava dattaṃ mayānagha
verses.translation: On the western peak of Kailasa, as lustrous as the Kunda flower, is theabodeof each of the Yaksas, eight Yojanas in length and forty in breadth. The place is resorted to by Siddhas and celestial sages. It abounds in various minerals and has long rows of lofty mansions. There are thirty rich and flourishing abodes of Maha- yaksas that are joyous and prosperous all round.
verses.hindi: एकोनत्रिशोष्ष्यायः ३२०७ पाकयज्ञेषप्वभिमानी सोइग्निस्तु सबनः स्मृतः । पुत्रश्व सवनस्याग्नेरदुभुतः स महाशया:. ॥३छ
verses.wordMeaning: On the western peak of Kailasa, as lustrous as the Kunda flower, is theabodeof each of the Yaksas, eight Yojanas in length and forty in breadth. The place is resorted to by Siddhas and celestial sages. It abounds in various minerals and has long rows of lofty mansions.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the western peak of Kailasa, as lustrous as the Kunda flower, is theabodeof each of the Yaksas, eight Yojanas in length and forty in breadth. The place is resorted to by Siddhas and celestial sages. It abounds in various minerals and has long rows of lofty mansions.…

verses.sanskrit: तथा त्वं सर्वदेवानां धनगोप्ता भविष्यसि । चतुर्थो लोकपालानामक्षयश्चाव्ययो भुवि
verses.transliteration: tathā tvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ dhanagoptā bhaviṣyasi / caturtho lokapālānāmakṣayaścāvyayo bhuvi
verses.translation: Thirty prosperous kings of Yaksas (e.g.) Mahamali, Thus have I mentioned Yaksas as lustrous as Vayu and Agni, whose ruler is the prosperous lord Kubera.
verses.hindi: विविचेस्तु सुतो ह्य्कों योडग्निस्तस्य सुतास्त्विसे । अनीकवान्वासुजवांध्र रक्षोहा पितृकृत्तथा ॥ शुच्तेरग्ने: प्रजा ह्य षा वह्लुयस्तु चतुर्देश । इत्येते बह्लयः प्रोक्ता: प्रणीयन्ते5ध्चरेषु ये ॥४ १
verses.wordMeaning: Thirty prosperous kings of Yaksas (e.g.) Mahamali, Thus have I mentioned Yaksas as lustrous as Vayu and Agni, whose ruler is the prosperous lord Kubera.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirty prosperous kings of Yaksas (e.g.) Mahamali, Thus have I mentioned Yaksas as lustrous as Vayu and Agni, whose ruler is the prosperous lord Kubera.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या महाराज ईश्वरीति च विश्रुता । यक्षो यक्षाधिपः श्रेष्ठस्तस्य कुण्डो ऽभवत् सुतः
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā mahārāja īśvarīti ca viśrutā / yakṣo yakṣādhipaḥ śreṣṭhastasya kuṇḍo 'bhavat sutaḥ
verses.translation: South ofHimavat, stretching from the eastern to the western sea, 2 hundreds of cities of -Kinnaras are established on the ridges abounding in hedges, bushes, fountains, caves and! precipices. Verses 19-25: It appears that in those days people were fond of hills. The eastern region of Kailasa still has a lot of sunshine, more fertile soil than its western region (AGP 5758).
verses.hindi: एते विहरणीयास्तु चेतनाचेतनेष्विह । स्थानाभिमानिनो लोके प्रागासन्ह॒व्यवाहना:
verses.wordMeaning: South ofHimavat, stretching from the eastern to the western sea, 2 hundreds of cities of -Kinnaras are established on the ridges abounding in hedges, bushes, fountains, caves and! precipices. Verses 19-25: It appears that in those days people were fond of hills.…
verses.commentary: Sense: South ofHimavat, stretching from the eastern to the western sea, 2 hundreds of cities of -Kinnaras are established on the ridges abounding in hedges, bushes, fountains, caves and! precipices. Verses 19-25: It appears that in those days people were fond of hills.…

verses.sanskrit: स च रूपं परं प्राप्य मातापित्रोरनुज्ञया । तपश् चचार विपुलं नर्मदातटमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: sa ca rūpaṃ paraṃ prāpya mātāpitroranujñayā / tapaś cacāra vipulaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Verse 27 gives a poetic yet accurate information about the Himalayan region, viz. location of the Himalaya to the south of the Kailasa range, its extension from sea to sea, having a large number ol peaks, tracts and lower cultural level of inhabitants, though a great number of hermitages were there (AGP 58). In the bosom of the lord of mountains with many peaks, men and women rejoice. The place is full of delighted and well-nourished people.
verses.hindi: काम्यनेसित्तिकाजञस्र ष्वेते कमंस्ववस्थिता: । पुर्वंमन्वन्तरेष्तीते शुक्लेयमि: सुत: सह ॥ देवमं हात्मभि: पुण्य: प्रथमस्थान्तरे मनोः
verses.wordMeaning: Verse 27 gives a poetic yet accurate information about the Himalayan region, viz. location of the Himalaya to the south of the Kailasa range, its extension from sea to sea, having a large number ol peaks, tracts and lower cultural level of inhabitants,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Verse 27 gives a poetic yet accurate information about the Himalayan region, viz. location of the Himalaya to the south of the Kailasa range, its extension from sea to sea, having a large number ol peaks, tracts and lower cultural level of inhabitants,…

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीष्मे पञ्चाग्निसंतप्तो वर्षासु स्थण्डिलेशयः । हेमन्ते जलमध्यस्थो वायुभक्षः शतं समाः
verses.transliteration: grīṣme pañcāgnisaṃtapto varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ / hemante jalamadhyastho vāyubhakṣaḥ śataṃ samāḥ
verses.translation: There are a hundred kings for these bright and power¬ ful people. They arc Druma, Sugrivasainya, Bhagadatta and others. It was here that the marriage of Rudra with the great goddess Uma took place. It was here that she, the great god¬ dess, performed penance.
verses.hindi: वर्तन्ते बरंमानेश्व देवरिह सहाग्नयः । अनागते : सुरः साथ वर्तन्तेषनागताग्नय:ः
verses.wordMeaning: There are a hundred kings for these bright and power¬ ful people. They arc Druma, Sugrivasainya, Bhagadatta and others. It was here that the marriage of Rudra with the great goddess Uma took place. It was here that she, the great god¬ dess, performed penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are a hundred kings for these bright and power¬ ful people. They arc Druma, Sugrivasainya, Bhagadatta and others. It was here that the marriage of Rudra with the great goddess Uma took place. It was here that she, the great god¬ dess, performed penance.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वर्षशते पूर्णे एकाङ्गुष्ठे ऽभवन् नृप । अस्थिभूतः परं तात ऊर्ध्वबाहुस्ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ varṣaśate pūrṇe ekāṅguṣṭhe 'bhavan nṛpa / asthibhūtaḥ paraṃ tāta ūrdhvabāhustataḥ param
verses.translation: It was here that Rudra sported as a hunter. It was from here that the couple surveyed Jambudvlpa. The play-grounds of Rudra abounding in flowers of manifold colours and fruits of various shapes and sizes are here. These, with the different groups of living beings, are delightful."
verses.hindi: वे सवन कहलाते हैं। सवन के पुत्र महायशा अद्भुत हैं। अद्भुत अग्नि के पुत्र महाविविचि हैं। ये प्रायद्चित्त होम में हुत हवन का भंक्षण करते हैं। विविचि के अक॑ हैं और अक के पुत्र अनीकवान, वासृजवान्, रक्षोहा, पित्तकृत ओर सुरभि हैं। यही स्व॒र्णवर्ण सुरभि अग्नि धन, रत्नादि में ज्योति रूप से प्रविष्ट हैं ।३८-३६। ये सभी शुचि अग्नि के सम्तान हैं और संख्या में चौदह हैं ।४०। ये सभी वह्ति कहलाते हैं और यज्ञ में प्रयुक्त होते हैं। जो सभी अभिमानी अग्नि अतीत स्वायम्भुव मनु के समय आदि सर्ग में याम वेदों के साथ बीत गये हैं, वे विहरणीय अग्नि कहलाते हैं। ये चेतनाचेतन सब में स्थिर हैं ।४१-४२१। पहले ये काम्य, नैमित्तिक और नित्य कर्म में स्थित रहकर स्थानाभिमानी हृव्यवाहन थे एवं पूवव मन्वच्तर के बीत जाने पर प्रथम मनु के अधिका र-काल में पुण्यशाली महात्मा उज्ज्वल याम देवों के साथ स्थित थे । यह मैंने स्थानधारियों के स्थानों
verses.wordMeaning: It was here that Rudra sported as a hunter. It was from here that the couple surveyed Jambudvlpa. The play-grounds of Rudra abounding in flowers of manifold colours and fruits of various shapes and sizes are here. These, with the different groups of living beings,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It was here that Rudra sported as a hunter. It was from here that the couple surveyed Jambudvlpa. The play-grounds of Rudra abounding in flowers of manifold colours and fruits of various shapes and sizes are here. These, with the different groups of living beings,…

verses.sanskrit: अतपच्च घृतश्वासः कुण्डलो भरतर्षभ । चतुर्थे वर्षशतके तुतोष वृषवाहनः
verses.transliteration: atapacca ghṛtaśvāsaḥ kuṇḍalo bharatarṣabha / caturthe varṣaśatake tutoṣa vṛṣavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: It is the place where the beautiful ICinnara maidens', the slendcr-bellied, bright-eyed, joyous dwellers of the mountain caves sport about. Similarly it is here that the long-eyed Yaksas, groups of Apsaras-s and Gandharvas of charming physique move about with pleasure.
verses.hindi: को कहा । अतीत और अनागत सभी मन्वन्तरों में अग्तियों का लक्षण इसी प्रकार कहा गया है। ये सभी तपस्वी अवशृथ, प्रजाओं के पति और ज्योतिष्मान् हैं ।४३-४६। स्वारोचिष मनु के समग्र से सार्वाण मनु के .
verses.wordMeaning: It is the place where the beautiful ICinnara maidens', the slendcr-bellied, bright-eyed, joyous dwellers of the mountain caves sport about. Similarly it is here that the long-eyed Yaksas, groups of Apsaras-s and Gandharvas of charming physique move about with pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the place where the beautiful ICinnara maidens', the slendcr-bellied, bright-eyed, joyous dwellers of the mountain caves sport about. Similarly it is here that the long-eyed Yaksas, groups of Apsaras-s and Gandharvas of charming physique move about with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: वरं वृणीष्व भो वत्स यत्ते मनसि रोचते । ददामि ते न सन्देहस्तपसा तोषितो ह्यहम्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bho vatsa yatte manasi rocate / dadāmi te na sandehastapasā toṣito hyaham
verses.translation: The famous garden of Uma is also there. It was here that Siva assumed the form of half-man and half-woman. Saravana where the six-faced Karttikeya was born and whence enthusiastically he started to the Krauhca forest, is also
verses.hindi: अधिकार तक सातों मन्वन्तरों में नाना प्रयोजनवश वर्तमान देवों के साथ अग्नि निवास करते हैं और २०८ वायुपुराणम इत्येष विनयोउग्नीनां मया प्रोक्तो यथातथम् । विस्तरेणा55नृपुर्व्या च पित्णां बक्ष्यते ततः.
verses.wordMeaning: The famous garden of Uma is also there. It was here that Siva assumed the form of half-man and half-woman. Saravana where the six-faced Karttikeya was born and whence enthusiastically he started to the Krauhca forest, is also
verses.commentary: Sense: The famous garden of Uma is also there. It was here that Siva assumed the form of half-man and half-woman. Saravana where the six-faced Karttikeya was born and whence enthusiastically he started to the Krauhca forest, is also

verses.sanskrit: कुण्डल उवाच: यक्षाधिपप्रसादेन तस्यैवानुचरः पुरे । विचरामि यथाकाममवध्यः सर्वशत्रुषु
verses.transliteration: kuṇḍala uvāca: yakṣādhipaprasādena tasyaivānucaraḥ pure / vicarāmi yathākāmamavadhyaḥ sarvaśatruṣu
verses.translation: Similarly, on the auspicious summit of Himavat abounding in living beings, there is a play-ground called Pantfu- sila, of the destroyer of Krauhca. On its beautiful eastern ridge is the residence of Siddhas. It is known as Kalapagrama.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्तेग्निवंशवणेन नार्मकोनत्रिशोध््याय:
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, on the auspicious summit of Himavat abounding in living beings, there is a play-ground called Pantfu- sila, of the destroyer of Krauhca. On its beautiful eastern ridge is the residence of Siddhas. It is known as Kalapagrama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, on the auspicious summit of Himavat abounding in living beings, there is a play-ground called Pantfu- sila, of the destroyer of Krauhca. On its beautiful eastern ridge is the residence of Siddhas. It is known as Kalapagrama.

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्युक्त्वा महादेवः सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः । जगामाकाशमाविश्य कैलासं धरणीधरम्
verses.transliteration: tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ / jagāmākāśamāviśya kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam
verses.translation: Theie aie hundreds and thousands of hermitages of the sages Mrkanda, Vasistha, Bharata, Nala, Visvamitra, Udda- laka and others, of severe penance and purified souls, on the mountain Himavat. This excellent mountain, the abode of many Siddhas, is decorated by their temples and holy spots. Yaksas and Gandharvas move about here and there. Several groups of Mlecchas too live there. It abounds in mines of jewels. It is resorted* to by different animals. It is the source of origin of thousands of rivers. O Brahmanas, now listen to the special features of the western lofty mountain Nisadha 1, as it is being narrated wholly and precisely.
verses.hindi: ग्रहण: सृजतः पुत्रासुर्वे स्वायंभुवेड्तरे । अभ्यांसि जज्ञिरे तानि मनुष्यासुरदेवता: १ पितृवन्मन्यमानस्य जज्ञिरे पितरोउस्य वे । तेषां निसर्गः प्रागुक्तो विस्तरस्तस्य बक्ष्यते अनागत देवों के साथ अनागत अग्नि  हमने यह यथाप्रकार अभ्तियों का निर्णय किया । अब क्रमपृबंक पितरों का विस्तार पूवंक वर्णन करते हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Theie aie hundreds and thousands of hermitages of the sages Mrkanda, Vasistha, Bharata, Nala, Visvamitra, Udda- laka and others, of severe penance and purified souls, on the mountain Himavat. This excellent mountain, the abode of many Siddhas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Theie aie hundreds and thousands of hermitages of the sages Mrkanda, Vasistha, Bharata, Nala, Visvamitra, Udda- laka and others, of severe penance and purified souls, on the mountain Himavat. This excellent mountain, the abode of many Siddhas,…

verses.sanskrit: गते चादर्शनं देवे सो ऽपि यक्षो मुदान्वितः । स्थापयामास देवेशं कुण्डलेश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: gate cādarśanaṃ deve so 'pi yakṣo mudānvitaḥ / sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ kuṇḍaleśvaramuttamam
verses.translation: On the extensive central summit embellished with gold and minerals is the brightly illuminated abode of Visnu. It is resorted to by multitudes of Siddhas, sages, Gandharvas and crowds of Yaksas, Apsaras-s. There the great lord, the yellow-robed Visriu, the bestower of boons, the eternal maker of the worlds, is served by Siddhas.
verses.hindi: खुतओऔ बोले--स्वायम्भव मन्वन्तर में भगवान् प्रजापति जब पहले प्रजा की सुष्टि करने लगे, तब पहले जल फिर देव, असुर ओर मनुष्यों की सृष्टि हुई ।!। अपने को पिता की तरह मानने वाले ब्रह्मा से पितरगण उत्पन्न हुये। इनकी सृष्टि के सम्बन्ध में पहले कुछ कहा जा चुका है। अब विस्तारपूर्वक कह रहे
verses.wordMeaning: On the extensive central summit embellished with gold and minerals is the brightly illuminated abode of Visnu. It is resorted to by multitudes of Siddhas, sages, Gandharvas and crowds of Yaksas, Apsaras-s. There the great lord, the yellow-robed Visriu, the bestower of boons,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the extensive central summit embellished with gold and minerals is the brightly illuminated abode of Visnu. It is resorted to by multitudes of Siddhas, sages, Gandharvas and crowds of Yaksas, Apsaras-s. There the great lord, the yellow-robed Visriu, the bestower of boons,…

verses.sanskrit: अलंकृत्वा जगन्नाथं पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः । विमानैश्चामरैश्छत्रैस् तथा वै लिङ्गपूरणैः
verses.transliteration: alaṃkṛtvā jagannāthaṃ puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ / vimānaiścāmaraiśchatrais tathā vai liṅgapūraṇaiḥ
verses.translation: On its interior peak embellished with different minerals, on the ridge of the Nisadha mountain where the rocky surface is smooth and charming, is 'the delightful city of Rak- sas.as (called) Ulanghis. The city extends to thirty Yojanas. There are series of gardens there. The city cannot be thwarted by enemies. It is full of (Raksasas) as cruel as poisonous snakes. The southern ridge of the Hindukush which merged into Northern Karakorum and the Kunlun (AGP 58-59).
verses.hindi: देवासुरामनुष्याणां दृष्ट्वा देबो5स्यभाषत। पितुवन्मन्यमानस्थ जज्ञिरे वोपयक्षिताः .. मध्वादयः षडुतवस्तान्पितुस्परिचक्षते । ऋतवः पितरो बेवा इत्येषा वेदिको भुतिः
verses.wordMeaning: On its interior peak embellished with different minerals, on the ridge of the Nisadha mountain where the rocky surface is smooth and charming, is 'the delightful city of Rak- sas.as (called) Ulanghis. The city extends to thirty Yojanas. There are series of gardens there.…

verses.transliteration: tarpayitvā dvijānsamyagannapānādibhūṣaṇaiḥ / prīṇayitvā mahādevaṃ tataḥ svabhavanaṃ yayau
verses.translation: South of the same mountain with many abodes of Daityas, there is an inaccessible city within the (belly of) the mountain, with only a cave as the main entrance. Similarly, on the western peak, on a lofty rock of Parijata, there arc flourishing cities of Dcvas, Danavas and Nagas.
verses.hindi: ऋतव: पितरो देवाः शास्त्रेइस्मिन्रिश्नयों मतः

verses.transliteration: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi maṇiṃ mauktikameva ca / dadyād bhojyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sa sukhī modate divi
verses.translation: Similarly, on die excellent mountain Trisniga, to the On 7 m hUndreds and thouands.
verses.hindi: अग्निष्वात्ता नाम के पितर अनाहिताग्नि अर्थात् अग्नि से सम्पर्क न रखने वाले हैं ।५-६। पितरों के बीच जो यज्वा औंर सोमपीथी हैं वे बहिषद् पितर अग्निहोत्री हैं। 'ऋतुगण ही पितरदेव हैं, यह शास्त्रों का निश्चित मत है ।७। चंत्र-वेशाख रस, ज्येष्ठ-आषाढ़ ग्रीष्म, श्रावण-भाद्रपद जीव, अ श्विन-कातिक सुधा, मार्गशीष॑-पौष मन्यु, माघ-फाल्युन घोर शिशिर' कहे जाते हैं। मासानुरूप षड् ऋतुओं की यही कालव्यवस्था हुई ये ऋतुगण चेतन एवम अचेतन कहे जाते हैं ।5-१०। ऋतुगण ब्रह्मा के अभिमानी पृत्र कहे गये हैं। मासाद्ध काल में
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, on die excellent mountain Trisniga, to the On 7 m hUndreds and thouands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, on die excellent mountain Trisniga, to the On 7 m hUndreds and thouands.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा ऋग्यजुःसामगो ऽपि वा । ऋचमेकां जपित्वा तु सकलं फलमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā ṛgyajuḥsāmago 'pi vā / ṛcamekāṃ japitvā tu sakalaṃ phalamaśnute
verses.translation: The fierce lord of Nagas, invincible Canda, with a hundred heads, the blessed one marked by Visnu's discus, resides here. There eight wonderful mountains arc known as Devapar- vatas. Thus, the earth is full of cities, abodes, excellent and sacred lakes of holy waters, silver and jewel mountains having the lustre of gems, mountains of yellow orpiment, vermilion and gold, vast expanses of pure red arsenic shining in their red hue* and mountains of precious stones with minerals of variegat¬ ed colours. There are very extensive mountains with the rivers, caves, ridges and precipices of variegated colours and many shapes.
verses.hindi: ऋतुगण आतंव रूप में परिणत होते हैं और नियत स्थान पर रहने के कारण स्थानाभिमानी होते हैं। भहोरात्र, मास, ऋतु, अयन, संवत्सर आदि अवस्था के अभिमानी काल के अवयव हैं । निमेष, कला, काष्दा, मुह॒ते
verses.wordMeaning: The fierce lord of Nagas, invincible Canda, with a hundred heads, the blessed one marked by Visnu's discus, resides here. There eight wonderful mountains arc known as Devapar- vatas. Thus, the earth is full of cities, abodes, excellent and sacred lakes of holy waters,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The fierce lord of Nagas, invincible Canda, with a hundred heads, the blessed one marked by Visnu's discus, resides here. There eight wonderful mountains arc known as Devapar- vatas. Thus, the earth is full of cities, abodes, excellent and sacred lakes of holy waters,…

verses.transliteration: gāṃ prayacchati viprebhyastatphalaṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍava / yāvanti tasyā romāṇi tatprasūtikuleṣu ca
verses.translation: These mountains are the abodes of Daityas, Raksa- sas, saints, Kinnaras, serpents, Gandharvas ot wonderful features, Siddhas, Caranas. These are resorted to by Gandharvas and divine damsels. They are extensive and are inhabited by merito¬ rious persons. They appear like filaments of lotuses.

verses.sanskrit: तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते । स्वर्गे वासो भवेत्तस्य पुत्रपौत्रैः समन्वितः
verses.transliteration: tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate / svarge vāso bhavettasya putrapautraiḥ samanvitaḥ
verses.translation: The circle of mountains of the-Meru (region) is known as the Siddhaloka. It has various Resorts for shelter. Meritorious persons frequent the place. The images of Siddhas of no fierce activities, stand in the middle. That place (also) is known as heaven. Its order is thus stated.
verses.hindi: ऋतुत्रयं चाप्ययन है ध्यने दक्षिणोत्तरे । संवत्सरः सुमेकस्तु स्थानान्येतानि स्थानिनाम् .

The images of Siddhas of no fierce activities, stand in the middle. That place (also) is known as heaven. Its order is thus stated.

verses.translation: This earth is declared as having four Dvipas. It is inhabited by people of all castes, statures, complexions and
verses.hindi: सुमेकात्तु प्रसुयन्ते ज्ियन्ते च प्रजातयः । तस्मात्स्तृतः प्रजानां वे सुमेकः प्रपितामहः १९ स्थानेषु स्थानिनो होते स्थानात्मानः प्रकीतिता:। तदाख्यास्तन्‍्मयत्वाच्च तदात्मानश्च ते स्मृता: हविपदां चतुष्पदां चेव पक्षिसंसपंतामपि । स्थाबराणां च पथ्चानां पुण्य कालातंव स्पृतम्

verses.transliteration: sa vai sukhī modate svargaloke gandharvasiddhāpsaraḥsampragīte / evaṃ tu te dharmasuta prabhāvastīrthasya sarvaḥ kathitaśca pārtha
verses.translation: The four big continents inhabited by many castes are known as Bhadra, Bharata, Western Ketumala (i.e. Ketumir to the western side) and the NorthernKuru. They are the abodes of meritorious people. O Brahmana, this earth, in the shape ofa lotus, and divided into four continents and many sub- continents has thus been described by me. S ' This wide earth along with the interspersed continents mountains, forests, and groves is called Padma (Jotus-shaped) ' It is very extensive. ' '
verses.hindi: और दिन-रात आदि काल की व्यवस्था में जों स्थानाभिमानी हैं, वे उसी स्वरूप में वर्तमान रहने के कारण उन्हीं के तृल्य हैं। इनके सम्बन्ध में भी मैं कहता हैं, सुनिये ।!१-१४। पर्व, तिथि, सन्ध्या, महीने का आधा पक्ष, निमिष, कला, काष्ठा, मुहुतें, दिन-रात, दो पक्षों का एक मास, दो महीने की एक ऋतु, तीन ऋतुओं का अयन, दक्षिणोत्तर भेद से दो अयन और संवत्सर अथवा सुमेक होता है ।१४-१६। ये सभी स्थानघारियों
