verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा स्तुवन्मुच्यते सर्वपापैः पुनस्त्रिलोकीम् इह तत्प्रभावात्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā stuvanmucyate sarvapāpaiḥ punastrilokīm iha tatprabhāvāt
verses.translation: The worlds of Brahma, Devas, Asuras and human beings are three. That which is heated by the moon and the sun is known as the world (the earth). It has the qualities of smell colour, taste, sound and touch. This lotus-shaped universe is known as Lotus in the Vedas. This is the accepted order in the Puranas as well.
verses.hindi: के स्थान हैं अर्थात् कालख्प अवयवी के अवयव हैं। ऋतुगण सुमेक के उृत्र हैं, जो छः या आठ भागों में विभक्त हैं। ऋतुओं के पाँच पुत्र हैं, जो प्रजागण के बीच आतंब नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं। यतः चर और अचर भार्तव से उत्तन्न हैं; अतः इनके पिता आतंव हुये और ऋतुगण पितामह ।१७-१८। सुमेक से जो प्रजागण उत्पन्न हथे वे मर गये; इसलिये सुमेक मृत प्रजाओं के प्रपितामह कहलाये  ये यथःस्थान-स्थित स्थानी हैं । अतः स्थानात्मक कहे जाते हैं। उसी रूप में वर्तमान रहने के कारण वे उन स्थानों के तुल्य हैं और उसी नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं। प्रजापति ही संवत्सर हैं और संवत्सर ही अग्नि या ऋत हैं, ऐसा विद्वानों ने कहा है। दंत से ऋतुओं का जन्म हुआ है, इसीलिये वे ऋतु कहलायों। छहों ऋतुओं में मासों का समावेश हो जाता है; इसलिये मास भी ऋतु स्वरूप हैं। ऋतुओं को आर्तव नामक पाँच पुत्र हैं।!-२३। द्विपद, चतुष्पद,
verses.wordMeaning: The worlds of Brahma, Devas, Asuras and human beings are three. That which is heated by the moon and the sun is known as the world (the earth). It has the qualities of smell colour, taste, sound and touch. This lotus-shaped universe is known as Lotus in the Vedas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The worlds of Brahma, Devas, Asuras and human beings are three. That which is heated by the moon and the sun is known as the world (the earth). It has the qualities of smell colour, taste, sound and touch. This lotus-shaped universe is known as Lotus in the Vedas.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये कुण्डलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ४२ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र पिप्पलेश्वरमुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धो महायोगी पिप्पलादो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kuṇḍaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 42 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra pippaleśvaramuttamam / yatra siddho mahāyogī pippalādo mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: The celestial river of sacred waters springs from it (the reservoir or nectar). That river of clear transparent water flows through the sky through the seventh path of the wind. 1
verses.hindi: बक्षी, सरीसुप और स्थावरादि पांचभौतिकों का जो पुष्पकाल है, वही आतंव कहलाता है। ऋतुत्व और
verses.wordMeaning: The celestial river of sacred waters springs from it (the reservoir or nectar). That river of clear transparent water flows through the sky through the seventh path of the wind. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: The celestial river of sacred waters springs from it (the reservoir or nectar). That river of clear transparent water flows through the sky through the seventh path of the wind. 1

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: पिप्पलादस्य चरितं श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं विभो । माहात्म्यं तस्य तीर्थस्य यत्र सिद्धो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: pippalādasya caritaṃ śrotumicchāmyahaṃ vibho / māhātmyaṃ tasya tīrthasya yatra siddho mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: It turns back on reaching the mass of brilliance. It is resorted to by luminary bodies. It extends to the full length of the sky, with thousands of crores of stars.
verses.hindi: इदमर्ध नास्ति क. पुस्तके । ऋतुत्वमार्तवत्वं च पितृत्व॑ च॑ प्रकीतितम् । इत्येते पितरो ज्ञेया ऋतवश्चा5डर्तवाश्च ये २४ सर्व भुतानि तेम्यो3थ ऋतुकालाद्विजज्ञिरे । तस्मादेतेडपि पितर आतंबा इति नः श्रुतम् २५ वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु स्थिताः कालामिमानिनः । स्थानाभिमानिनो होते तिष्ठन्तीह प्रसंयमात् २६ अग्निष्वात्ता बहिषदः पितरो द्विविधाः स्पृताः। जज्ञाते च पितृम्पस्तु द्वे कन्ये लोकविश्युते
verses.wordMeaning: It turns back on reaching the mass of brilliance. It is resorted to by luminary bodies. It extends to the full length of the sky, with thousands of crores of stars.
verses.commentary: Sense: It turns back on reaching the mass of brilliance. It is resorted to by luminary bodies. It extends to the full length of the sky, with thousands of crores of stars.

verses.sanskrit: कस्य पुत्रो महाभाग किमर्थं कृतवांस्तपः । एतद्विस्तरतः सर्वं कथयस्व ममानघ
verses.transliteration: kasya putro mahābhāga kimarthaṃ kṛtavāṃstapaḥ / etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha
verses.translation: While the lordly elephant of lord Indra moves about in the firmament, he sportively agitates the water within it.
verses.hindi: मेना च धारिणी चेवब याम्यां विश्वमिदं धृतम् । वितरस्ते निजे कन्ये धर्मार्थ प्रददुः शुभे ॥। ते उभे ब्रह्मवादिन्यों योगिन्यों चेव ते उभे र८ अग्निष्वात्तास्तु ये प्रोक्तास्तेषां मेना तु मानसो । धारणी मानसी चेब कन्या बहिषदां स्पृता
verses.wordMeaning: While the lordly elephant of lord Indra moves about in the firmament, he sportively agitates the water within it.
verses.commentary: Sense: While the lordly elephant of lord Indra moves about in the firmament, he sportively agitates the water within it.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: मिथिलास्थो महाभागो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः । याज्ञवल्क्यः पुरा तात चचार विपुलं तपः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mithilāstho mahābhāgo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / yājñavalkyaḥ purā tāta cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: WhenSiddhas pass through the sky in their aerial chariots (great many in number), they have a sip in the sacred and healing water of this river.
verses.hindi: हफहफ््््््ज् ॒ औााा न्‍ वकीऑििणज--++++/+8+++पैहतै/ैपप आतंवत्व पितृत्व कहलाता है; इसलिये ऋतु और आतेंब पितर कहे गये हैं ।२३-२४। सुना है कि सकल भूत ऋतुकाल में ऋतु और आतंव से उत्पन्न हुये हैं; इसलिये आतंव भी पितर हैं। सभी मन्वन्तरों में ये स्थानाभिमानी और कालाभिमानी संयमपूर्वक वतंमान रहते हैं। अग्निष्वात्ता और बहिषदू नामक दो तरह के पितर हैं। इन पितरों ने लोकप्रसिद्ध दो कन्याओं को उत्पन्न किया ।२५-२७। उनका नाम था मेना और
verses.wordMeaning: WhenSiddhas pass through the sky in their aerial chariots (great many in number), they have a sip in the sacred and healing water of this river.
verses.commentary: Sense: WhenSiddhas pass through the sky in their aerial chariots (great many in number), they have a sip in the sacred and healing water of this river.

verses.sanskrit: तापसी तस्य भगिनी याज्ञवल्क्यस्य धीमतः । सा सप्तमे ऽपि वर्षे च वैधव्यं प्राप दैवतः
verses.transliteration: tāpasī tasya bhaginī yājñavalkyasya dhīmataḥ / sā saptame 'pi varṣe ca vaidhavyaṃ prāpa daivataḥ
verses.translation: Just as the sun revolves everyday, so this river urged by the wind, flows through various places.
verses.hindi: धारिणी। इन्हीं दोनों ने इस संसार को धारण किया है। ब्रह्मवादि नी और परमयोगिनी उन कन्माओं को पितरों ने धर्म के लिये दान कर दिया । अग्निष्वात्ता की मानस पूतन्री मेना थी और बहिषद् की मानस कन्या धारिणी थी । सोमपीथी वहिषद पितर ने सुन्दरी धारिणी को मेरु से ब्याह् दिया और अग्निष्वात्ता ने हिमालय से मेना का ब्याह कर दिया। अब उनके पोत्नरों की कथा सुनिये ।२५-२१॥ हिमालय की पत्नी मेला से मैनाक
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the sun revolves everyday, so this river urged by the wind, flows through various places.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the sun revolves everyday, so this river urged by the wind, flows through various places.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वकर्मविपाकेन हीनाभूत्पितृमातृतः । नाभूत्तत्पतिपक्षे ऽपि कोऽपीत्येकाकिनी स्थिता
verses.transliteration: pūrvakarmavipākena hīnābhūtpitṛmātṛtaḥ / nābhūttatpatipakṣe 'pi ko'pītyekākinī sthitā
verses.translation: It extends to eighty-four Yojanas allround. It circumam¬ bulates the Meru with great velocity.
verses.hindi: नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न किया। उसे नदियों में श्रेष्ठ एक गंगा नाम की बेटी भी हुई जो लवण-सागर की पत्नी है! मैनाक का एक छोटा भाई भी था, जिसका नाम क्रोंच था। इसी के नाम पर क्रॉंच द्वीप हुआ है मेरुपत्नी धारणी ने दिव्य औषधियों से युक्त मन्दार नामक पुंत्र को उत्पन्न किया एवं बेला, नियति और आयति नामक तीन पृत्रियों को भी जन्म दिया।३३। इनमें आयति से धाता ने और नियति से विधाता ने
verses.wordMeaning: It extends to eighty-four Yojanas allround. It circumam¬ bulates the Meru with great velocity.
verses.commentary: Sense: It extends to eighty-four Yojanas allround. It circumam¬ bulates the Meru with great velocity.

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ भ्रमन्ती भ्रातुः सा समीपमगमच्छनैः । चचार च तपः सो ऽपि परलोकसुखेप्सया
verses.transliteration: bhūmau bhramantī bhrātuḥ sā samīpamagamacchanaiḥ / cacāra ca tapaḥ so 'pi paralokasukhepsayā
verses.translation: The water currents are split by the fiery wind and the river falls upon the four northern peaks of Meru.
verses.hindi: +घनुश्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थ: ड. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: The water currents are split by the fiery wind and the river falls upon the four northern peaks of Meru.
verses.commentary: Sense: The water currents are split by the fiery wind and the river falls upon the four northern peaks of Meru.

verses.sanskrit: चचार सापि तत्रस्था शुश्रूषन्ती महत्तपः । कस्मिंश्चित् समये साथ स्नाताहनि रजस्वला
verses.transliteration: cacāra sāpi tatrasthā śuśrūṣantī mahattapaḥ / kasmiṃścit samaye sātha snātāhani rajasvalā
verses.translation: After emerging on the excellent sides of ridges of these peaks of Meru, the waters, divided into four, flow thus.
verses.hindi: स्वायंभुवेषन्तरे पूर्व तयोर्बें फीतिताः प्रजा: । सुषुबे सागरादुबेला कन्यामेकामनिन्दिताम् इत्युक्तः कथयामास सुमो दक्षाश्ितां कथाम् ।. शांशपायनमामन्त्र्य ध्यम्बकाच्छापकारणम्
verses.wordMeaning: After emerging on the excellent sides of ridges of these peaks of Meru, the waters, divided into four, flow thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: After emerging on the excellent sides of ridges of these peaks of Meru, the waters, divided into four, flow thus.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्वासो धृतवती दृष्ट्वा कर्पटकं रहः । याज्ञवल्क्यो ऽपि तद्रात्रौ सुप्तो यत्र सुसंवृतः
verses.transliteration: antarvāso dhṛtavatī dṛṣṭvā karpaṭakaṃ rahaḥ / yājñavalkyo 'pi tadrātrau supto yatra susaṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After flowing through the supportless firmament for sixty thousand Yojanas, the glorious river falls through the four sides of Meru. 2
verses.hindi: ततस्त्वभ्यचिता: सर्वा न्यवसंस्ता पितुग है द द ४०
verses.wordMeaning: After flowing through the supportless firmament for sixty thousand Yojanas, the glorious river falls through the four sides of Meru. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: After flowing through the supportless firmament for sixty thousand Yojanas, the glorious river falls through the four sides of Meru. 2

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्नं दृष्ट्वात्यजच्छुक्रं कौपीने रक्तबिन्दुवत् । विराजितेन तपसा सिद्धं तदनलप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvātyajacchukraṃ kaupīne raktabinduvat / virājitena tapasā siddhaṃ tadanalaprabham
verses.translation: This splendid, sacred river flowing through the four bases (feet) of Meru, falls again on the eastern Mandara.
verses.hindi: अकरोत्स नति दक्षे न कदाचिन्महेश्वरः । जामाता श्वशुरे तस्मिन्स्वभावोत्तजसि स्थितः ४२ ब्याह किया ।३४। स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तर के समंय इनकी सन्‍्तत्तियों की चर्चा की गयी है। वेला ने सागर को पत्नी होकर एक अपूर्व सुन्दरी कन्या को उत्पन्न किथा। सावर्भि ने उस सामुद्री नाम की कन्या को प्राचीन वहिष् के हाथ में सौंपा । अपने पति से उस सामुद्री ते दस पुत्रों को प्राप्त किया  वे सभी प्रचेतस् धनुववेद के पारगामी विद्वान थे। चाक्षष मनु के अधिकार काल में भगवान् ध्यम्बक के अभिशाप से स्वायम्भुव दक्ष
verses.wordMeaning: This splendid, sacred river flowing through the four bases (feet) of Meru, falls again on the eastern Mandara.
verses.commentary: Sense: This splendid, sacred river flowing through the four bases (feet) of Meru, falls again on the eastern Mandara.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्प्रबुद्धो विप्रो ऽसौ वीक्ष्योच्छिष्टं तद् अंशुकम् । चिक्षेप दूरतो ऽस्पृश्यं शौचं कृत्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: yāvatprabuddho vipro 'sau vīkṣyocchiṣṭaṃ tad aṃśukam / cikṣepa dūrato 'spṛśyaṃ śaucaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: The eastern branch of the river flows over the Mandara which is the abode of Devas and all the groups of •Siddhas, which has many rivulets, caves, golden and variegated lands, ridges. It flows with the crystal clear water that subdues the arrogance and valour of the side-bunds. It flows round the beautiful Caitraratha overflowing the path. This river of the firmament then enters the excellent lake Arunoda (Kara Kul, NE Pamirs).
verses.hindi: उनके पृत्र रूप में उत्पन्न हुये थे ।३५-३७। शांशपायन ने यह कथा सुत कर सूत से पूछा--चाक्षुष मन्वच्तर में महादेव के शाप से दक्ष किस प्रकार उत्पन्न हुआ इसको कृपाकर केहिये। सूतजी शांशपायन को सम्बोधन करके महादेव जी ने जिस कारण दक्ष को शाप दिया, वह कथा कहने लगे। पहले कहा जा चुका है कि दक्ष को आठ कन्यायें थीं, उन्हें अपने घर में लाकर दक्ष ने उनका अच्छा सत्कार किया। इस प्रकार सत्कृत होकर
verses.wordMeaning: The eastern branch of the river flows over the Mandara which is the abode of Devas and all the groups of •Siddhas, which has many rivulets, caves, golden and variegated lands, ridges. It flows with the crystal clear water that subdues the arrogance and valour of the side-bunds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The eastern branch of the river flows over the Mandara which is the abode of Devas and all the groups of •Siddhas, which has many rivulets, caves, golden and variegated lands, ridges. It flows with the crystal clear water that subdues the arrogance and valour of the side-bunds.…

verses.sanskrit: निषिद्धं तु निशि स्नानमिति सुष्वाप स द्विजः । निशीथे सापि तद्वस्त्रं भगस्यावरणं व्यधात्
verses.transliteration: niṣiddhaṃ tu niśi snānamiti suṣvāpa sa dvijaḥ / niśīthe sāpi tadvastraṃ bhagasyāvaraṇaṃ vyadhāt
verses.translation: Verses 3-11: This poetic synthesis of the heavenly Gariga (Galaxy) as the source of glaciers and rivers of Asia is repeated in other Puranas like
verses.hindi: वे कन्यायें पिता के घर में रहने लगीं ।३८-४०। लेकिन दक्ष ने अपनी सबसे बड़ी लड़की सती को, जो कि महादेव से ब्याही हुई थी, नहीं बुलाया; क्योंकि दक्ष का महादेव से कुछ मनसुटाव था। बात यह थी कि किसी दिन महादेव ने दक्ष को प्रणाम नहीं किया था । यह दक्ष को बहुत बुरा लगा कि, जामाता होकर भी ये ससुर के सामने अभिमान करते हैं ।४१-४२। सती को जब यह मालूम हुआ कि हमारी सब बहने मायके » इदमर्ध नास्ति क. पुस्तके ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 3-11: This poetic synthesis of the heavenly Gariga (Galaxy) as the source of glaciers and rivers of Asia is repeated in other Puranas like
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 3-11: This poetic synthesis of the heavenly Gariga (Galaxy) as the source of glaciers and rivers of Asia is repeated in other Puranas like

verses.sanskrit: प्रातर् अन्वेषयामास मुनिर्वस्त्रमितस्ततः । ततः सा ब्राह्मणी प्राह किं अन्वेषयसे प्रभो । केन कार्यं तव तथा वदस्व मम तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: prātar anveṣayāmāsa munirvastramitastataḥ / tataḥ sā brāhmaṇī prāha kiṃ anveṣayase prabho / kena kāryaṃ tava tathā vadasva mama tattvataḥ

verses.sanskrit: याज्ञवल्क्य उवाच: अपवित्रो मया भद्रे स्वप्नो दृष्टो ऽद्य वै निशि । सक्लेदं तत्र मे वस्त्रं निक्षिप्तं तन्न दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: yājñavalkya uvāca: apavitro mayā bhadre svapno dṛṣṭo 'dya vai niśi / sakledaṃ tatra me vastraṃ nikṣiptaṃ tanna dṛśyate
verses.translation: After coming out from Arunoda, the gently-flowing river falls on the mountain Sltanta (Kashghar rang C )aboundiii
verses.hindi: ब्रहिष्ठाभ्य तपिष्ठाश्व महायोगाः सुधामिकाः । गुण श्ववाधिकाः शझाध्याः सर्वे ते श्यम्वकात्सति तथोक्ता पितरं सा ये क्द्धा देवीदमब्रवीत् । वाइमसनः कर्म भिर्यस्माददुष्टां मां विगहेसे ॥ तस्मात्त्यजाम्यहूं देहमिदं तात तवा55ससजम् है ५१ ततस्तेनावमानेन सती दुःखादमर्षिता । अब्रवीद्गचन देवी नमस्क्ृत्वा (त्य) महेश्वरम् ५२ यत्राहमुपपत्स्येहहूं पुनर्देहिन भात्वता । तत्राप्यहमसंसूढा संसूता धामिकी पुनः ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: After coming out from Arunoda, the gently-flowing river falls on the mountain Sltanta (Kashghar rang C )aboundiii
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming out from Arunoda, the gently-flowing river falls on the mountain Sltanta (Kashghar rang C )aboundiii

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा ब्राह्मणी वाक्यं भीतभीतावदन् नृप । तद्वस्त्रं तु मया विप्र स्नात्वा ह्यन्तः कृतं महत्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā brāhmaṇī vākyaṃ bhītabhītāvadan nṛpa / tadvastraṃ tu mayā vipra snātvā hyantaḥ kṛtaṃ mahat
verses.translation: The sacred and excellent river is called Slta. Beino- held within the various groves and bushes, it is further divided into several branches.
verses.hindi: गच्छेयं धर्मपत्नीत्व॑ ध्यम्बकस्येव धर्मतः ५३
verses.wordMeaning: The sacred and excellent river is called Slta. Beino- held within the various groves and bushes, it is further divided into several branches.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sacred and excellent river is called Slta. Beino- held within the various groves and bushes, it is further divided into several branches.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हाहेत्युक्त्वा महामुनिः । निपपात तदा भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः
verses.transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā hāhetyuktvā mahāmuniḥ / nipapāta tadā bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ
verses.translation: From the peek of Sltanta, 1 it falls on the mountain Sukunja. 1 From that mountain, it falls on the the mountain Sumanjasa. 1
verses.hindi: पहुँची हुई हैं, तो वह भी बिता बुलावे के ही वहाँ पहुंच गयी । सती वहाँ पहुंची तो सही; लेकिन पिता ने उनका वैसा सत्कार नहीं किया, जेसा कि उनकी और बहनों का किया था। क्रोध से तमक कर सती ने पिता से कहा --तात ! आप छोटी बहनों का तो बड़ा सत्कार कर रहे हैं; किन्तु मेरा निरादर कर रहे हैं ।४३-४४। मैं सब बहनों से बड़ी हे. इसलिये निरादर के योग्य नहीं हो सकती। यह सुनते ही लाल-लाल आँखें करके दक्ष ने सती से कहा - यह सत्य है कि तू मेरी ज्येष्ठ, श्रेष्ठ और आदरणीय पुत्री हो; किन्तु मैं अपनी और लड़कियों के पतियों को बहुत अच्छा समझता है । इसलिये कि वे सब के सब महादेव से ज्यादा गुणी; प्रशंसनीय; घारमिक, महायोगी. तपस्वी और ब्रह्मकर्म को जानने वाले हैं। वसिष्ठ, पुलस्त्य, अज्िरा, पुलह, ऋतु, भूगु और मरीचि आदि मेरे अच्छे जामाता हैं ॥४५-४८। महादेव मेरे विरुद्ध हैं और तू उन्हीं
verses.wordMeaning: From the peek of Sltanta, 1 it falls on the mountain Sukunja. 1 From that mountain, it falls on the the mountain Sumanjasa. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: From the peek of Sltanta, 1 it falls on the mountain Sukunja. 1 From that mountain, it falls on the the mountain Sumanjasa. 1

verses.sanskrit: किमेतदिति सेत्युक्त्वा ह्याकाशमिव निर्मला । आश्वासयन्ती तं विप्रं प्रोवाच वचनं तदा
verses.transliteration: kimetaditi setyuktvā hyākāśamiva nirmalā / āśvāsayantī taṃ vipraṃ provāca vacanaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Therefrom it falls on the mount Malyavan 2 and comes to Vaikanka and from Vaikanka it passes to Maniparvata and then falls on the mountain Rsabha full of caves.
verses.hindi: की आत्मा हो, एवं उनकी ही सेवा करती हो; इसलिये मैं तेरा सत्कार नहीं कर सकता। मूढ़चित्त दक्ष ने शाप पाने की इच्छा से सती से इस प्रकार कहा। परमर्षिगण भी ऐसा ही समझते हैं ।४६-५०। यह् सुनते ही सती ने क्रुढ होकर पिता से कहा-मन, वचन और कम से मैं पवित्र हे, फिर भी आप मेरा तिरस्कार करते हैं। इसलिये आपके द्वारा जो यह मेरा शरीर उत्पन्न हुआ है, उसे ही मैं छोड़ देती हैं। उस अपमान
verses.wordMeaning: Therefrom it falls on the mount Malyavan 2 and comes to Vaikanka and from Vaikanka it passes to Maniparvata and then falls on the mountain Rsabha full of caves.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefrom it falls on the mount Malyavan 2 and comes to Vaikanka and from Vaikanka it passes to Maniparvata and then falls on the mountain Rsabha full of caves.

verses.sanskrit: वदस्व कारणं तात गुह्याद् गुह्यतरं यदि । प्रतीकारो ऽस्य येनैव विमृश्य क्रियते त्वरा
verses.transliteration: vadasva kāraṇaṃ tāta guhyād guhyataraṃ yadi / pratīkāro 'sya yenaiva vimṛśya kriyate tvarā
verses.translation: Piercing through thousands of mountains thus, the river falls on the mountain Jathara resorted to by Siddhas*
verses.hindi: से सती को बड़ा दुःख हुआ। उसने मन ही मन महादेव को प्रणाम करके कहा--५१-१२। मैं जहाँ कहीं अपने इस तेजस्वी शरीर से जन्म ग्रहण करूँगी, वहाँ बिना किसी मोह-माया में फंसे ऐसा धर्माचरण करूँगी, २१४ द . वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Piercing through thousands of mountains thus, the river falls on the mountain Jathara resorted to by Siddhas*
verses.commentary: Sense: Piercing through thousands of mountains thus, the river falls on the mountain Jathara resorted to by Siddhas*

verses.sanskrit: ततः स सुचिरं ध्यात्वा लब्धवाग्वै ततः क्षणम् । प्रोवाच साध्वसमना यत्तच्छृणु नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā labdhavāgvai tataḥ kṣaṇam / provāca sādhvasamanā yattacchṛṇu nareśvara
verses.translation: From there the river again falls on the Devakuta mountain, the lower part of which extends upto the sea. In this way, the river gradually reaches the plains.
verses.hindi: तत आग्नेपीसमुत्येन वायुना समुदीरितः । सब'ड्ड भ्यो विनिःसृत्य वह्लिभेस्म चकार तामू
verses.wordMeaning: From there the river again falls on the Devakuta mountain, the lower part of which extends upto the sea. In this way, the river gradually reaches the plains.
verses.commentary: Sense: From there the river again falls on the Devakuta mountain, the lower part of which extends upto the sea. In this way, the river gradually reaches the plains.

verses.sanskrit: नात्र दोषो ऽस्ति ते कश्चिन्मम चैव शुभव्रते । तवोदरे तु गर्भो यस्तत्र दैवं परायणम्
verses.transliteration: nātra doṣo 'sti te kaścinmama caiva śubhavrate / tavodare tu garbho yastatra daivaṃ parāyaṇam
verses.translation: Thus flooding through thousands of valleys, hundreds
verses.hindi: तदुपश्रुत्य निधन सत्या देवो5थ शुलभूत् । संवाद च तयोर्बुद्धृवा याथातथ्येन शंकरः ॥ दक्षस्याथ ऋषीणां च चुकोप भगवान्प्रभुः  पशद
verses.wordMeaning: Thus flooding through thousands of valleys, hundreds
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus flooding through thousands of valleys, hundreds

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तत्त्वेन रक्षा च त्वया कार्या सदैव हि । विनाशी नैव कर्तव्यो यावत्कालस्य पर्ययः
verses.transliteration: tasya tattvena rakṣā ca tvayā kāryā sadaiva hi / vināśī naiva kartavyo yāvatkālasya paryayaḥ
verses.translation: Modern Mfagh Ate" m ° Untains - Ute Hwan ® H° o. Ellina was believed to be the

verses.sanskrit: तथेति व्रीडिता साध्वी दूयमानेन चेतसा । अपालयच्च तं गर्भं यावत्पुत्रो ह्यजायत
verses.transliteration: tatheti vrīḍitā sādhvī dūyamānena cetasā / apālayacca taṃ garbhaṃ yāvatputro hyajāyata
verses.translation: Falling from the peak of Kalinga, it flows on to the mountain Rucaka. From there it flows to Ni§adha and then to Tamrabha. Falling from the peak of Tamrabha, it flows to mount Svetodara, thence to the lordly mountain Sumula and then to the mountain Vasudhara.
verses.hindi: अहं तत्रापि ते विष्नमाचरिष्यासि दुमंते । धर्मर्थकामयुक्तेषु कमंस्विह पुनः पुनः .. दर ह॒त्वा5ःहुति ततः क्लूर अपस्त्यक्ष्यन्ति कमंसु । इहैव वत्स्यसि तथा दिव॑ हित्वाइध्युगक्षयात्ु.
verses.wordMeaning: Falling from the peak of Kalinga, it flows on to the mountain Rucaka. From there it flows to Ni§adha and then to Tamrabha. Falling from the peak of Tamrabha, it flows to mount Svetodara, thence to the lordly mountain Sumula and then to the mountain Vasudhara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Falling from the peak of Kalinga, it flows on to the mountain Rucaka. From there it flows to Ni§adha and then to Tamrabha. Falling from the peak of Tamrabha, it flows to mount Svetodara, thence to the lordly mountain Sumula and then to the mountain Vasudhara.

verses.sanskrit: जातमात्रं च तं गर्भं गृहीत्वा ब्राह्मणी च सा । अश्वत्थच्छायाम् आश्रित्य तम् उत्सृज्य वचो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: jātamātraṃ ca taṃ garbhaṃ gṛhītvā brāhmaṇī ca sā / aśvatthacchāyām āśritya tam utsṛjya vaco 'bravīt
verses.translation: From there it flows to Hemakuta and thence to Deva- srnga, thereafter it flows to Mahfisaila and then to Pisacaka mountain.
verses.hindi: जिससे कि मैं फिर महादेव की ही पत्नी होऊ। इस तरह कह कर सती वहीं पर धोगासन लगा कर बैंठ गयीं। मन ही मन उन्होंने अग्नि की धारणा की ।५३-५४॥ उस धारणा से आग्नेयी वाथु उत्पन्न हुई, जिसने समूची देह में आग भड़का कर उसे राख कर दिया । शूलधारी महादेव ने जब यह सुना और उस समाचार की सत्यता पर भी विश्वास हो गया, तब वे ऋषियों भौर दक्ष पर बहुत क्रुद्ध हुये ।१५-५६॥। उन्होंने
verses.wordMeaning: From there it flows to Hemakuta and thence to Deva- srnga, thereafter it flows to Mahfisaila and then to Pisacaka mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: From there it flows to Hemakuta and thence to Deva- srnga, thereafter it flows to Mahfisaila and then to Pisacaka mountain.

verses.sanskrit: यानि सत्त्वानि लोकेषु स्थावराणि चराणि च । तानि सर्वाणि रक्षन्तु त्यक्तं वै बालकं मया
verses.transliteration: yāni sattvāni lokeṣu sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca / tāni sarvāṇi rakṣantu tyaktaṃ vai bālakaṃ mayā
verses.translation: From the excellent mountain Pisacaka, it flows to Pahcakuta and from Paiicakuta to Kailasa, the mountain residence of Devas.
verses.hindi: कहा-दक्ष ! तुमने जिस कारण मेरे लिये सती का तिरस्कार किया और अपनी दूसरी सब बेटियों का पतियों के साथ सत्कार किया; इसलिये तुम्हारे पक्षपाती ऋषिगण मृत्यु मुख में प्राप्त होंगे एवं वेवस्वत मन्वन्तर में मेरे द्वितीय यज्ञ से उत्पन्न होकर वे अयोनिज कहलायेंगे ।५७-५८। चाक्षुष मनु के अधिकार काल में ब्रह्मा इन्द्र का यज्ञ करा रहे थे कि, ऋषियों को वैसा कहते हुये महादेव दक्ष के समीप पहुंचे ओर कहा--चाक्षुष न्वन्तर में ही चाक्षुप नाम का एक राजा होगा, जो प्राचीनबहिष् का और प्रचेता का पुत्र होगा। वही राजा तुम्हें वृक्षकत्या मार्षा के गर्भ से उत्पन्न करेगा और तुम्हारा नाम दक्ष ही रखेगा ।५९-६!१  दक्ष बोले--हे दुमंति ! मैं तुम्हारे धर्मार्थयुक्त कर्म में उस जन्म में भी बार-बार विधघ्न उपस्थित करूँगा । जिस लिये तुमने मेरे कारण ऋषियों के प्रति क्रूरता का व्यवहार किया है; इसलिये ह्विजगण यज्ञ
verses.wordMeaning: From the excellent mountain Pisacaka, it flows to Pahcakuta and from Paiicakuta to Kailasa, the mountain residence of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the excellent mountain Pisacaka, it flows to Pahcakuta and from Paiicakuta to Kailasa, the mountain residence of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा गता सा तु ब्राह्मणी नृपसत्तम । तथागतः स तु शिशुस् तत्र स्थित्वा मुहूर्तकम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā gatā sā tu brāhmaṇī nṛpasattama / tathāgataḥ sa tu śiśus tatra sthitvā muhūrtakam
verses.translation: Whirling about in its bowels of caves and ridges, it falls on the excellent mountain Himavat.
verses.hindi: में देवों के साथ तुम्हारी पूजा नहीं करेंगे । वे भाहुति देने के बाद कम में यानी यज्ञकुण्ड में जल छोड़ दिया करेंगे और तुम स्वर्ग छोड़ कर इसी भूलोक में युगक्षय पर्यन्‍्त निवास करोगे ।६२-६४ . ता
verses.wordMeaning: Whirling about in its bowels of caves and ridges, it falls on the excellent mountain Himavat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whirling about in its bowels of caves and ridges, it falls on the excellent mountain Himavat.

verses.sanskrit: पाणिपादौ विनिक्षिप्य निकुञ्च्य नयने शुभे । आस्यं तु विकृतं कृत्वा रुरोद विकृतैः स्वरैः
verses.transliteration: pāṇipādau vinikṣipya nikuñcya nayane śubhe / āsyaṃ tu vikṛtaṃ kṛtvā ruroda vikṛtaiḥ svaraiḥ
verses.translation: Piercing through thousands of mountains thus, it flows quickly irrigating hundreds of land surfaces. Then it flows through thousands of forests and hundreds of caves and falls into the southern sea.
verses.hindi: सर्वेषासेव लोकानां भूर्जोकस्त्वादिसच्यते । तमहूं धारयिष्यासि निदेशात्परमेष्ठिनः . ६५ अस्यां क्षितौ बृता लोका: सर्वे तिष्ठन्ति भास्कराः-। तानहं धारयामीह सतत न तवा5ज्षया ६६ चातुर्व््य हि देवानां ते चाप्येकत्र भुझ्जते। नाहं तेः सह भोक्ष्यामि ततो दास्यन्ति ते पृथक् ॥ ततो देवे: स ते: सार्ध नेज्यते पृथमिज्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Piercing through thousands of mountains thus, it flows quickly irrigating hundreds of land surfaces. Then it flows through thousands of forests and hundreds of caves and falls into the southern sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: Piercing through thousands of mountains thus, it flows quickly irrigating hundreds of land surfaces. Then it flows through thousands of forests and hundreds of caves and falls into the southern sea.

verses.sanskrit: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ताः स्थावरा जङ्गमाश्च ये । आकम्पिता महोत्पातैः सशैलवनकानना
verses.transliteration: tena śabdena vitrastāḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāśca ye / ākampitā mahotpātaiḥ saśailavanakānanā
verses.translation: This river is one Yojana in breadth; it is hidden in the bowels of the peaks of mountain. It is held on head by noble-souled Sankara, lord of Devas. It is sanctifying,Oleading Brahmana. It quells even terrible sins. By virtue of the contact with the body of lord Sankara, the great river has its waters rendered doubly sanctimonious in all the worlds.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा गृहपति दक्ष ज्ञानानामीश्वरं प्रभुम् । दक्षो नाम महायज्ञ:ः सो5पयजदवतेः सह॒.. ऐई६ अथ देवी सती या तु प्राप्ते बेजस्वतेडत्तरे  मेनायां तामु्मां देवों जनयामास शलराद् (७० या तु देवी सती पुर्व॑ ततः पश्चादुमाइभवत् । सहक़्ता भवस्थैषा न तथा मुच्यते भवः ॥। हि
verses.wordMeaning: This river is one Yojana in breadth; it is hidden in the bowels of the peaks of mountain. It is held on head by noble-souled Sankara, lord of Devas. It is sanctifying,Oleading Brahmana. It quells even terrible sins. By virtue of the contact with the body of lord Sankara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This river is one Yojana in breadth; it is hidden in the bowels of the peaks of mountain. It is held on head by noble-souled Sankara, lord of Devas. It is sanctifying,Oleading Brahmana. It quells even terrible sins. By virtue of the contact with the body of lord Sankara,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो ज्ञात्वा महद्भूतं क्षुधाविष्टं द्विजर्षभम् । न जहाति नगश्छायां पानार्थाय ततः परम् । अपिबच्च सुतं तस्मादभृतं चैव भारत
verses.transliteration: tato jñātvā mahadbhūtaṃ kṣudhāviṣṭaṃ dvijarṣabham / na jahāti nagaśchāyāṃ pānārthāya tataḥ param / apibacca sutaṃ tasmādabhṛtaṃ caiva bhārata
verses.translation: From all round that mountain Himavat, through its many openings, thousands of rivers spring forth. They are known by other names. The river Ganga is resorted to by Siddhas and its waters are drunk by Rudras, Sadhyas, Anilas and Adityas. Blessed are the lands through which this great and reputed river flows.
verses.hindi: मरीच॑ कश्यपं देवी यथाउदितिरनुत्रता । साध्यं नारायणं श्रीस्तु मघबन्तं श्री यथा 0 .. विष्णुं कीर्ती रुचिः सुर्य दसिष्ठं चाप्यरुन्धती । नेतास्तु विजह॒त्येतान्भत॒ न्देव्यः कर्थंचन ॥ द
verses.wordMeaning: From all round that mountain Himavat, through its many openings, thousands of rivers spring forth. They are known by other names. The river Ganga is resorted to by Siddhas and its waters are drunk by Rudras, Sadhyas, Anilas and Adityas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: From all round that mountain Himavat, through its many openings, thousands of rivers spring forth. They are known by other names. The river Ganga is resorted to by Siddhas and its waters are drunk by Rudras, Sadhyas, Anilas and Adityas.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं स वर्धितस् तत्र कुमारो निजचेतसि । चिन्तयामास विश्रब्धः किं मम ग्रहगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa vardhitas tatra kumāro nijacetasi / cintayāmāsa viśrabdhaḥ kiṃ mama grahagocaram
verses.translation: Now I shall describe the western side of Meru mountain which is holy and contains several mines of precious stones and
verses.hindi: रुठ़ बोले-- सब लोकों में यह भूलोक ही श्रेष्ठ कहा गया है। इसका धारण मैं परमरेष्ठी की आज्ञा से ही कर रहा हूँ  इस क्षितितल में भास्क्रोपम लोक विराजमान हैं। उन्हें मैं सदा धारण किये रहता हूँ, वह कुछ तुम्हारी आज्ञा से नहीं ।६५-६६। देवों के बीच भी चतुर्व्ण व्यवस्था है; पर वे सभी एक साथ ही बैठ कर खान-पान कर लिया करते हैं और मैं उनके साथ नहीं खाता; इश्नलिये मुझे पृथक किया जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Now I shall describe the western side of Meru mountain which is holy and contains several mines of precious stones and
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall describe the western side of Meru mountain which is holy and contains several mines of precious stones and

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रूरसभाचारः क्रूरं दृष्ट्वा निरीक्षितः । पपात सहसा भूमौ शनैश्चारी शनैश्चरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ krūrasabhācāraḥ krūraṃ dṛṣṭvā nirīkṣitaḥ / papāta sahasā bhūmau śanaiścārī śanaiścaraḥ
verses.translation: Meru, the lord of mountains, is very massive witn large bowels and caves. Its central region is embellished with table-lands, ridges and bushy growths. The water of this river is used by Devas and the river is held by the three-eyed deity. Urged by the wind, it flows far and wide, and whirls again like a creeper. It falls from the peak of Meru. Its water is used by many living beings. It is pure like the spotless silk and is
verses.hindi: इसीलिये वे लोग देवों के साथ मेरी पूजा न कर पृथक पूजा करते हैं (६७। इस तरह अत्यन्त तेजस्वी रुद्र से शप्त होकर स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तर के बाद मनुष्यलोक में दक्ष प्रजापति ने जन्म ग्रहण किया । अपने को ज्ञानवान् समर्थ और गृहपति जानकर दक्ष ने देवों के साथ मिल कर एक महायज्ञ आरम्भ किया। इधर वेवस्वत मन्वस्तर के आने पर दौलाधिराज हिमालय ने मेना के गर्भ से देवी सती को उमा के रूप में उत्पन्न किया ।६८-७०। वही देवी जो पहले सती थी, पीछे उमा 'हुई। मह॒देव के साथ रहना ही उसका ब्रत है। वह कभी भी मन्वन्तर में महादेव को उसी प्रकार नहीं छोड़तीं, जैसे अनुन्नता भदिति देवी मरीच कश्यप को, लक्ष्मी नारायण को, शी इन्द्र को, रुचि सूर्य को, अरुन्धती वरिष्ठ को किसी भी तरह नहीं छोड़ती हैं । टसरे कल्पों के लौटने पर भी ये देवियाँ उन्हीं के साथ उत्पन्न होती हैं ।७१-७३। इधर दक्ष प्रजापति भी
verses.wordMeaning: Meru, the lord of mountains, is very massive witn large bowels and caves. Its central region is embellished with table-lands, ridges and bushy growths. The water of this river is used by Devas and the river is held by the three-eyed deity. Urged by the wind,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Meru, the lord of mountains, is very massive witn large bowels and caves. Its central region is embellished with table-lands, ridges and bushy growths. The water of this river is used by Devas and the river is held by the three-eyed deity. Urged by the wind,…

verses.sanskrit: उवाच च भयत्रस्तः कृताञ्जलिपुटस्तदा । किं मयापकृतं विप्र पिप्पलाद महामुने
verses.transliteration: uvāca ca bhayatrastaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭastadā / kiṃ mayāpakṛtaṃ vipra pippalāda mahāmune
verses.translation: This blessed river of many flowers and fruits irri
verses.hindi: देवस्य महतो यज्ञे वारुणों बिश्नतस्तनुम्
verses.wordMeaning: This blessed river of many flowers and fruits irri
verses.commentary: Sense: This blessed river of many flowers and fruits irri

verses.sanskrit: चरन्वै गगनाद् येन पातितो धरणीतले । सौरिणा ह्येवमुक्तस्तु पिप्पलादो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: caranvai gaganād yena pātito dharaṇītale / sauriṇā hyevamuktastu pippalādo mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: From Sitoda is goes to mount Supaksa. Again this river of holy clear water which is used by divine sages, falls
verses.hindi: तस्मान्नातुशयः कार्यो वेरिष्विह् कदाचन । जात्यन्तरगतस्यापि भोवितस्य शुभाशु्भः ॥ जन्तुं न मुश्चति रुयातिस्तन्न कार्य विजानता देव्या मृत्युं कृतं मत्वा कुद्ध सर्वात्मक प्रभुम् । कथं प्रासादयद्ृक्षः स यज्ञ:साधितः कथम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: From Sitoda is goes to mount Supaksa. Again this river of holy clear water which is used by divine sages, falls
verses.commentary: Sense: From Sitoda is goes to mount Supaksa. Again this river of holy clear water which is used by divine sages, falls

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधरूपो ऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप । पितृमातृविहीनस्य मम बालस्य दुर्मते । पीडां करोषि कस्मात् त्वं सौरे ब्रूहि ह्यशेषतः
verses.transliteration: krodharūpo 'bravīdvākyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa / pitṛmātṛvihīnasya mama bālasya durmate / pīḍāṃ karoṣi kasmāt tvaṃ saure brūhi hyaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: (The river flows from one mountain to another:) Thereafter the river flows from mountain Sikhi to mount
verses.hindi: पुरा मेरोह्िजश्रेष्ठाःशुड्र' त्रेलोक्यविश्ुतम् । ज्योतिष्क नाम सावित्न॑ सर्वरत्नविभूषितम्
verses.wordMeaning: (The river flows from one mountain to another:) Thereafter the river flows from mountain Sikhi to mount
verses.commentary: Sense: (The river flows from one mountain to another:) Thereafter the river flows from mountain Sikhi to mount

verses.sanskrit: शनैश्चर उवाच: क्रूरस्वभावः सहजो मम दृष्टिस्तथेदृशी । मुञ्चस्व मां तथा कर्ता यद्ब्रवीषि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: śanaiścara uvāca: krūrasvabhāvaḥ sahajo mama dṛṣṭistathedṛśī / muñcasva māṃ tathā kartā yadbravīṣi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Then it drops from the ridges of the peaks resorted to by Devas and sages, with its waters scattered by flowery rafts. The blessed river irrigates and circumambulates the forest of the Sun-god which is the sylvan place of origin of variegated jewels. It then falls into the sacred lake Mahabhadra resorted to by blessed people. The beneficent white river is called Bhadrasoma. It flows rapidly and its shores arc far apart. The great and holy river Mahabhadra flows thereafter.
verses.hindi: रुद्र के शाप से चाक्षुष मन्वन्तर में प्राचीनबहिष् के पौनत्र होकर दश प्रचेता से मार्षा के गर्भ से फिर उत्पन्न हुये यह. हम लोगों ने सुना है। भृगु आदि जो महषि थे, वे भी बंवस्वत मनु के पूर्व भेतायुग के आदि में वरुण-सद्श शरीर को धारण कर महान् देवता के यज्ञ में उत्पन्न हुये ।७४-७६। दक्ष प्रजापति और धोमान् महादेव का विद्वेष इस प्रकार जन्मान्तर में भी चलने लगा। इसलिये बंरियों के प्रति कभी भी विद्वेष नहीं करना चाहिए। शुभाशुभ कंम से परिचालित जन्तु के आन्तरिक भाव दूसरे जन्म में भी नहीं उठते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Then it drops from the ridges of the peaks resorted to by Devas and sages, with its waters scattered by flowery rafts. The blessed river irrigates and circumambulates the forest of the Sun-god which is the sylvan place of origin of variegated jewels.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then it drops from the ridges of the peaks resorted to by Devas and sages, with its waters scattered by flowery rafts. The blessed river irrigates and circumambulates the forest of the Sun-god which is the sylvan place of origin of variegated jewels.…

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलाद उवाच: अद्यप्रभृति बालानां वर्षाद् आ षोडशाद्ग्रह । पीडा त्वया न कर्तव्या एष ते समयः कृतः
verses.transliteration: pippalāda uvāca: adyaprabhṛti bālānāṃ varṣād ā ṣoḍaśādgraha / pīḍā tvayā na kartavyā eṣa te samayaḥ kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Flowing rapidly with many rivulets flowing into it, and dashing against many bunds, the river falls on the ridges ofSankhakuta.
verses.hindi: इसी लिये यह जानकर विद्वेष नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Flowing rapidly with many rivulets flowing into it, and dashing against many bunds, the river falls on the ridges ofSankhakuta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Flowing rapidly with many rivulets flowing into it, and dashing against many bunds, the river falls on the ridges ofSankhakuta.

verses.sanskrit: एवमस्त्विति चोक्त्वा स जगाम पुनरागतः । देवमार्गं शनैश्चारी प्रणम्य ऋषिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: evamastviti coktvā sa jagāma punarāgataḥ / devamārgaṃ śanaiścārī praṇamya ṛṣisattamam
verses.translation: Falling down the ridges of Sankhakuta, it proceeds to Vfsa Parvata. From Vrsa Parvata, it flows then to Vatsagiri and then to Nagasaila.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले--सूत ! वैवस्वत मन्वन्तर में प्राचेतस दक्षप्रजापति का अश्यमेध किस प्रकार नंष्ट हुआ ? दक्ष ने सती की मृत्यु से कुंद्ध सर्वात्मक महादेव को किस प्रकार प्रसन्न किया और अपने यज्ञ को किस प्रकार सम्पन्न किया ? यह हम जानना चाहते हैं कृपा कर कहिये
verses.wordMeaning: Falling down the ridges of Sankhakuta, it proceeds to Vfsa Parvata. From Vrsa Parvata, it flows then to Vatsagiri and then to Nagasaila.
verses.commentary: Sense: Falling down the ridges of Sankhakuta, it proceeds to Vfsa Parvata. From Vrsa Parvata, it flows then to Vatsagiri and then to Nagasaila.

verses.sanskrit: गते चादर्शनं तत्र सो ऽपि बालो महाग्रहः । विचिन्तयन्वै पितरं क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः
verses.transliteration: gate cādarśanaṃ tatra so 'pi bālo mahāgrahaḥ / vicintayanvai pitaraṃ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: From Nagasaila, it reaches the excellent mountain Nila, the Varsa mountain. From Nila, it flows to Kapinjala, and then the river flows to Indranlla, thereafter it flows to Mahanlla, and Hemasrnga. From Hemasrnga it flows to Sveta, and from Sveta to Sunaga. From Sunaga, it flows to Satasrnga. Then the great river flows from Satasrhga to the flower-carpet¬ ed Puskara. From Puskara to Dviraja, the great mountain of great strength ( Sumahabala ). From there, it flows to Varaha Parvata and the mountain Mayura. From the mountain Mayura the rapid river flows to Ekasikhara bedecked with caves and crevasses, and then to the peak of the Jarudhi mountain.
verses.hindi: सूत जी बोले--द्विजगण ! पूर्व काल में मेर के विश्व-विश्वुत स्रत्नों से विभूषित ज्योतिष नामंक
verses.wordMeaning: From Nagasaila, it reaches the excellent mountain Nila, the Varsa mountain. From Nila, it flows to Kapinjala, and then the river flows to Indranlla, thereafter it flows to Mahanlla, and Hemasrnga. From Hemasrnga it flows to Sveta, and from Sveta to Sunaga. From Sunaga,…
verses.commentary: Sense: From Nagasaila, it reaches the excellent mountain Nila, the Varsa mountain. From Nila, it flows to Kapinjala, and then the river flows to Indranlla, thereafter it flows to Mahanlla, and Hemasrnga. From Hemasrnga it flows to Sveta, and from Sveta to Sunaga. From Sunaga,…

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयीं धारणां ध्यात्वा जनयामास पावकम् । कृत्यामन्त्रैर्जुहावाग्नौ कृत्या वै संभवत्विति
verses.transliteration: āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ dhyātvā janayāmāsa pāvakam / kṛtyāmantrairjuhāvāgnau kṛtyā vai saṃbhavatviti
verses.translation: After piercing (forcing its way) through thousands of mountains thus, the great river reaches Trisrnga, the boundary mountain with many peaks.
verses.hindi: हूद तास्ति ख्. भ. ढ. पुस्तकेषु  अप्रमेयमनाधृष्यं स्वबलोकनसस्कृतम् । तस्मिन्देवों गिरिश्रेष्ठ सर्वंधातुविभुषिते ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After piercing (forcing its way) through thousands of mountains thus, the great river reaches Trisrnga, the boundary mountain with many peaks.
verses.commentary: Sense: After piercing (forcing its way) through thousands of mountains thus, the great river reaches Trisrnga, the boundary mountain with many peaks.

verses.sanskrit: तावज्झटिति सा कन्या ज्वालामालाविभूषिता । हुतभुक्सदृशाकारा किं करोमीति चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tāvajjhaṭiti sā kanyā jvālāmālāvibhūṣitā / hutabhuksadṛśākārā kiṃ karomīti cābravīt
verses.translation: Falling from the ridges of Tris'rhga inhabited by blessed people this river of pure water falls off the ridges of Meru, and urged by the wind flows to the excellent mountain Viruddha. After irrigating the mountain the river flows into the western ocean.
verses.hindi: तथव च महात्मानावश्विनो भिषजां वरो । तथा बेश्रवणो राजा गुह्कंः परिवारितः ॥ै८४ यक्षाणामब्विर: श्रीमान्केलासनिय: प्रभुः । उंपासते महात्मानमुशना च सहामुनिः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Falling from the ridges of Tris'rhga inhabited by blessed people this river of pure water falls off the ridges of Meru, and urged by the wind flows to the excellent mountain Viruddha. After irrigating the mountain the river flows into the western ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Falling from the ridges of Tris'rhga inhabited by blessed people this river of pure water falls off the ridges of Meru, and urged by the wind flows to the excellent mountain Viruddha. After irrigating the mountain the river flows into the western ocean.

verses.sanskrit: शोषयामि समुद्रान् किं चूर्णयामि च पर्वतान् । अवनिं वेष्टयामीति पातये किं नभस्तलम्
verses.transliteration: śoṣayāmi samudrān kiṃ cūrṇayāmi ca parvatān / avaniṃ veṣṭayāmīti pātaye kiṃ nabhastalam
verses.translation: On the wonderful great foot of Meru inhabited by living beings, on the northern mountain Suparsva whose sides are the sources of gold, the river falls into the bowels of caves,
verses.hindi: अप्सरोगणसंघाश्र समाजस्मुरनेफकशः । ववो शिव: सुखो वायुर्नानागन्धवहः शुचिः भहादेव॑ पशुर्पात प्यु पासन्ति तत्र बे। भुतानि च तथाइन्यानि नानारूपधरान्यथ ८६
verses.wordMeaning: On the wonderful great foot of Meru inhabited by living beings, on the northern mountain Suparsva whose sides are the sources of gold, the river falls into the bowels of caves,
verses.commentary: Sense: On the wonderful great foot of Meru inhabited by living beings, on the northern mountain Suparsva whose sides are the sources of gold, the river falls into the bowels of caves,

verses.sanskrit: कस्य मूर्ध्नि पतिष्यामि घातयामि च कं द्विज । शीघ्रमादिश्यतां कार्यं मा मे कालात्ययो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: kasya mūrdhni patiṣyāmi ghātayāmi ca kaṃ dvija / śīghramādiśyatāṃ kāryaṃ mā me kālātyayo bhavet
verses.translation: In this way the four great rivers of pure waters, falling down the ridges of great mountains, flow into the four directions.
verses.hindi: देवस्थानुचरास्तत्र तस्थुवेश्वानरोपमाः । नन्‍दीश्वरश्व भगवान्देबस्थानुमते स्थित: ॥६ १
verses.wordMeaning: In this way the four great rivers of pure waters, falling down the ridges of great mountains, flow into the four directions.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this way the four great rivers of pure waters, falling down the ridges of great mountains, flow into the four directions.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पिप्पलादो महातपाः । क्रोधसंरक्तनयन इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā pippalādo mahātapāḥ / krodhasaṃraktanayana idaṃ vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Thus the earth of vast expanse I have almost explained to you. It is surrounded on all sides by Meru and other mountains.
verses.hindi: पर्युपासत त॑ देवरूषिणी द्विजसत्तमा: ज---+++ जाएगा कल -। हल प्रकाशक तन - “नीम चक पल + ८२ २०प्परनणन बे जे ५-००,  जनम बन -34 ० अल 30 पउप. हजाृ(“+ज०४-+-०२०3+-००4त.+-+- सम के न-नन++ पा ० + मम आक-+ ५ +पम0५.3..
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the earth of vast expanse I have almost explained to you. It is surrounded on all sides by Meru and other mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the earth of vast expanse I have almost explained to you. It is surrounded on all sides by Meru and other mountains.

verses.sanskrit: महता क्रोधवेगेन मया त्वं चिन्तिता शुभे । पिता मे याज्ञवल्क्यश्च तस्य त्वं पत माचिरम्
verses.transliteration: mahatā krodhavegena mayā tvaṃ cintitā śubhe / pitā me yājñavalkyaśca tasya tvaṃ pata māciram
verses.translation: The earth has four great continents, four forests of sports, four great trees as the four land-marks and lour excellent lakes.
verses.hindi: पवित्र शिखर पर महादेब जी इस प्रकार बैठे थे, मानो कोई पलंग पर बैठा हो ।६१-८२। गिरि हिमालय का वह शाज्ज सत्र का पूज्य, अत्यन्त विस्तृत और किसी प्रकार भ्रे उल्लंघन के योग्य न था। पावंती भी उनकी बगल में बंठी हुई थीं। उस समय आदित्यगण, अत्यन्त पराक्रमी बसुगण, दोनों भाई वैद्यराज अश्विनी- कुमार, गुह्मकों को साथ लेकर राजा वेश्रत्रण, सनत्कुमार आदि परम, अज़्िरा भादि देवधि विश्वावसु
verses.wordMeaning: The earth has four great continents, four forests of sports, four great trees as the four land-marks and lour excellent lakes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earth has four great continents, four forests of sports, four great trees as the four land-marks and lour excellent lakes.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वागमच्छीघ्रं स्फोटयन्ती नभस्तलम् । मिथिलास्थो महाप्राज्ञस्तपस्तेपे महामनाः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvāgamacchīghraṃ sphoṭayantī nabhastalam / mithilāstho mahāprājñastapastepe mahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: गन्धर्व, नारद पव॑त कैलास निवासी यक्षराज महामुनि उशना और अप्सरायें बार-बार आकर उनकी पूजा- उपासना करने लगीं 5३-८४ उस समय कल्याणकरारक, सुखद, सुगन्धित शीतल बायु चल रही थी, सब ऋतुओं के फूलों से युक्त होकर विटप सुशोभित हो रहे थे और सिद्ध, विद्याधर तथा तपस्वी आदि महादेव पशुपति की उपासना कर रहे थे। विविध स्वरूपों को ध।रण करने वाले नाना प्रकार के भूत, महाभयदूर राक्षत, महाबली पिशाच आदि बहुविध रूपों को धारण करके और नाना प्रकार के अस्त्रों से सज्जित होकर अभ्नि के समान दीप्ति को धारण कर सेवा कार्य करने लगे ।८५-६०)। भगवान् नन्‍्दीश्वर चमकते हुये प्रज्वलित त्रिशुल को लेकर उनके निकट आदेश पालन करने जा बैठे । द्विजगण ! उस समय सब तीथों के
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्पश्यति दिग्भागं ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभम् । याज्ञवल्क्यो महातेजा महद्भूतमुपस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: yāvatpaśyati digbhāgaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham / yājñavalkyo mahātejā mahadbhūtamupasthitam
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: एवं स भगवांस्तन्न दीप्यमान:ः सुरधिभिः । देखेश्व सुमहाभागे महादेवो व्यवस्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: तद् दृष्ट्वा सहसायान्तं भीतभीतो महामुनिः । अनुयुक्तो ऽथ भूतेन जनकं नृपतिं ययौ
verses.transliteration: tad dṛṣṭvā sahasāyāntaṃ bhītabhīto mahāmuniḥ / anuyukto 'tha bhūtena janakaṃ nṛpatiṃ yayau
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: पुरा हिमवतः पृष्ठ दक्षो वे यज्ममारभत् । गदगाद्वारे शुभे देश ऋषिसिद्धनि्ेबिते ६४ ततस्तस्य मजे देवः शतक्रतुपुरोगभा: । गसनाय समागम्य बुद्धिमापेदिरे तदा ६५ स्वविमाने मं हात्मानो ज्वलसण्दिज्वेलनप्रभा: । देवस्यानुमते5गच्छन्गइगाद्वार इति श्रुति: १६६ गन्धर्वाप्सरसाकीर्ण नानादुमलतावुतम् । ऋषिसंधे: परिवृत॑ दक्ष धर्मभ्ृतां वरम् ३६७ आदि्त्या बसवो रुद्रा: साथ्या: सह मरुदगणः । जिष्णुना सहिताः सर्वे आगता यज्ञभागिनः
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: शरण्यं माम् अनुप्राप्तं विद्धि त्वं नृपसत्तम । महद्भूतभयाद्रक्ष यदि शक्नोषि पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: śaraṇyaṃ mām anuprāptaṃ viddhi tvaṃ nṛpasattama / mahadbhūtabhayādrakṣa yadi śaknoṣi pārthiva
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: उष्मपा: सोसपाश्चेव आज्यया धमपास्तथा ' अश्चिनों पितरश्चेब आगता ब्रह्मणा सह १०० एते चान्ये च बहवो भुतग्रामास्तर्थव च। जरायुजाण्डजाश्चव स्वेदजोज्ि ज्ञकास्तथा ३१०१
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मतेजोभवं भूतमनिवार्यं दुरासदम् । न च शक्नोम्यहं त्रातुं राजा वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: brahmatejobhavaṃ bhūtamanivāryaṃ durāsadam / na ca śaknomyahaṃ trātuṃ rājā vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: आहूता मंत्रतः सर्वे देवाश्व सह पत्निभि: ( । विराजन्ते विपानस्था दीप्यमाना इबाग्तयः नरः पापसवाप्नोति सहद्े नाञ् संशयः ३१०३
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चान्यं नृपश्रेष्ठं शरणार्थी महातपाः । जगाम तेन मुक्तो ऽसौ चेन्द्रस्य सदनं भयात्
verses.transliteration: tataścānyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ śaraṇārthī mahātapāḥ / jagāma tena mukto 'sau cendrasya sadanaṃ bhayāt
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: जल को उत्पन्न करनेबाली नदीश्रेष्ठ और देवस्वरूप को धारण करनेवाली गंगा भी उनकी सेवा करने लगीं । इस प्रकार देव्धथियों और महाभ ग्यशाली देवताओं से घिरे हुये भगवान् महादेव वहाँ बैठे थे ।६१-६३। उसी समय दक्ष ने हिमालय के पृष्ठ देश में यज्ञ आरम्भ किया । यज्ञस्थान सिद्ध-ऋषियों से सेवित, मंगलकारक गंगाद्वार में बनाया गया। ऐसा सुना जाता है कि अग्नि के तुल्य तेजस्वी इन्द्र प्रमुख देवगण उस यज्ञ में जाने
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: देवराज नमस्ते ऽस्तु महाभूतभयान्नृप । कम्पमानो ऽब्रवीद् विप्रो रक्षस्वेति पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: devarāja namaste 'stu mahābhūtabhayānnṛpa / kampamāno 'bravīd vipro rakṣasveti punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: का विचार करने लगे और अग्नि के समान अपने चमक्रीले विमानों पर चढ़ कर वे सब भहात्मा गंगाद्वार पहुँचे ।8४-६६। भिन्न-भिन्न प्रकार की द्वुम-लताओं से आवृत, गन्धवं-अप्सराओं से व्याप्त, ऋषि समूहों से घिरे हुये: धर्मध्वज दक्ष प्रजापति की पृथ्वी, अन्तरिक्ष और स्वर्गलोक के निवासी हाथ जोड़ कर स्तुति और प्रशंसा करने लगे ।६७-६८। आदित्य, वसु, रुद्र, साध्य, मरुदगण और विष्णु आदि यज्ञ में भाग पाने वाले वहाँ पहुंचे । उष्म, सोम, आज्य और धूम पीने वाले अध्विनीकुमार, पितर और ब्रह्मा आदि देवगण भी आये ।६९ ६-१००। इनके अतिरिक्त बहुतेरे जरायुज, अण्डज, स्वेदज और उद्भिज्ज आदि प्राणी, सभी देव
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवराजो ऽब्रवीद् इदम् । न शक्नोमि परित्रातुं ब्रह्मकोपादहं मुने
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devarājo 'bravīd idam / na śaknomi paritrātuṃ brahmakopādahaṃ mune
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: उन सब को देख कर सुखपूर्वक बंठ हुये दधीचि ने दक्ष से कहा--अपूज्यों को पूजने और पृज्यों को न पूजने
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स ब्रह्मभवनं ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवित्तमः । जगाम विष्णुलोकं च तेनापीत्युक्त एव सः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa brahmabhavanaṃ brāhmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ / jagāma viṣṇulokaṃ ca tenāpītyukta eva saḥ
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: एचमुक्त्वा तु विप्रषिः पुनर्देक्षमभाषत । पूज्य तु पशुभर्तारं कस्मान्ना55छयसे प्रभुम॒ सन्ति मे बहवो रुद्रा: शुलहस्ता: कपिल: । एकादशावस्थगता नान्‍्य॑ वेद्ि महेश्वरम
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
