verses.transliteration: atha yo bhojayed viprān pitḥn uddiśya bhārata / tasya te dvādaśābdāni modante divi tarpitāḥ
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: देवी बोलौ--स्त्रियों के बीच तो मामूली आदमी भी अधिक ५ शंसा कर दिया करता है और अपनी कमजोरी छिपा लिया करता है। यह पक्की बात है । क्‍या आप भी वही कर रहे हैं? १२०।
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: संन्यासेन तु यः कश्चित् तत्र तीर्थे तनुं त्यजेत् । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य रुद्रलोकात् कदाचन
verses.transliteration: saṃnyāsena tu yaḥ kaścit tatra tīrthe tanuṃ tyajet / anivartikā gatistasya rudralokāt kadācana
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: भगवान बोले--देवेशि ! हम झूठमूठ अपनी प्रशंसा नहीं कर रहे हैं। वरारोहे ! वरबणिनि ! तुम आकर देखो कि, अपने भाग के लिये हम किसकी सृष्टि कर रहे हैं। प्राण से भी प्रिय पत्नी को भगवान् ने ऐसा कह कर अपने मुंह से जाज्वल्यमान अग्नि की तरह एक भूत को उत्पन्न किया, जिसे हजार सिर, हजार पर और हजार आँखें थीं। वह हजारों मुद्गर और हजारों बाणों को हाथों में रखे हुये था, शइलचक़गदापाणि दीप्तकामुंकधारिणम् । परश्वसिधरं देवं महारौद्व भयावहम्
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं समाख्यातं यत्पृष्ठे हि त्वयानघ । माहात्म्यं पिप्पलादस्य तीर्थस्योत्पत्तिरेव च
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭhe hi tvayānagha / māhātmyaṃ pippalādasya tīrthasyotpattireva ca
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: दंष्ट्राकरालं विश्रान्तं महावकत्र महोदरम् । विश्युज्जिल्ल प्रलम्बोष्ठं लम्बकर्ण दुरासदम॒
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं धन्यं दुःस्वप्ननाशनम् । पठतां शृण्वतां चैव सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet
verses.translation: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.hindi: कुलिशोद्योतितकरं भाभिज्वलितमुर्धंजम् । ज्वालामालापरिक्षिप्तं मुक्तादामविभूषितम् तेजसा चेव दीप्यन्तं युगान्‍्तमिथ पावक्म् । आकर्णदारितास्यान्त चतुदंष्टें भयानकम्
verses.wordMeaning: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has four great mountains and has four serpents for support, eight superior mountains and eight inferior.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये पिप्पलादतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ४३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र विमलेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । तत्र देवशिला रम्या स्वयं देवैर् विनिर्मिता
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye pippalādatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 43 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra vimaleśvaram uttamam / tatra devaśilā ramyā svayaṃ devair vinirmitā
verses.translation: Near Gandhamadana there is a large and bulky boulder above, thirty-four thousand Yojanas long, and thirty- two thousand Yojanas wide, east to west. The residents of this area perform auspicious rites. They are well-known as Ketu- malas. The men are black in complexion. They are vigorous and powerful. The women have the lustrous complexion of the petals of a lotus. All of them have pleasing appearances.
verses.hindi: महाबलं महातेज॑ महापुरुषमीश्चरम् । विश्वह॒त् महाकाय॑ महान्यग्रोधमण्डलम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Near Gandhamadana there is a large and bulky boulder above, thirty-four thousand Yojanas long, and thirty- two thousand Yojanas wide, east to west. The residents of this area perform auspicious rites. They are well-known as Ketu- malas. The men are black in complexion.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Near Gandhamadana there is a large and bulky boulder above, thirty-four thousand Yojanas long, and thirty- two thousand Yojanas wide, east to west. The residents of this area perform auspicious rites. They are well-known as Ketu- malas. The men are black in complexion.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा तु यो भक्त्या ब्राह्मणान्पूजयेन् नृप । स्वल्पेनापि हि दानेन तस्य चान्तो न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇānpūjayen nṛpa / svalpenāpi hi dānena tasya cānto na vidyate
verses.translation: There is a great divine Panasa (Jack-fruit) tree there. It has six tastes. It is the son of Brahma, capable of moving about according to its pleasure. It has the speed of mind. It is veritable svara himself. Imbibing its juice, the people there live for ten thousand years.
verses.hindi: युगान्तसूर्याग्निसह्रभासं सह्नचद्धामलकान्तिकान्तम् ॥ युगार्काभ सहावीय चारुनासं महाननम् । प्रचण्डगण्ड दीप्ताक्षमग्निज्वालाविलाननम् १३१ मृमेन्द्रकृत्तिदसन महाभुजगवेष्टित म् । उष्णीषिणं चन्द्रधरं क्यक्तिदुग्न क्यचित्समम्
verses.wordMeaning: There is a great divine Panasa (Jack-fruit) tree there. It has six tastes. It is the son of Brahma, capable of moving about according to its pleasure. It has the speed of mind. It is veritable svara himself. Imbibing its juice, the people there live for ten thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a great divine Panasa (Jack-fruit) tree there. It has six tastes. It is the son of Brahma, capable of moving about according to its pleasure. It has the speed of mind. It is veritable svara himself. Imbibing its juice, the people there live for ten thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कानि दानानि विप्रेन्द्र शस्तानि धरणीतले । यानि दत्त्वा नरो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kāni dānāni viprendra śastāni dharaṇītale / yāni dattvā naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Tiie men are fajr-complexioned, vigorous and powerful.
verses.hindi: ।१३१-१२३। शंख, चक्र, गदा ओर पालिश किये हुये धनुष को भी धारण किये हुये था । उसऊे हाथ में फरसा ओर खज़ू भी था। उसका रौद्र रूप देखने में भयावह जान पड़ता था; किल्तु उसका घोर रूप देदीप्यमान हो रहा था। वह अ्द्ध चन्द्र से भूषित था, रक्तमय बाघंबर पहने हुये था, उसके बड़े विकराल दाँत थे, ऊसका पेट और मुँह दोनों ही विशाल थे लम्बे ओठों के बीच उसकी जीभ बिजली की तरह लपलपा रही
verses.wordMeaning: Tiie men are fajr-complexioned, vigorous and powerful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tiie men are fajr-complexioned, vigorous and powerful.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: सुवर्णं रजतं ताम्रं मणिमौक्तिकमेव च । भूमिदानं च गोदानं मोचयत् पशुभान्नरम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ maṇimauktikameva ca / bhūmidānaṃ ca godānaṃ mocayat paśubhānnaram
verses.translation: They have the complexion and lustre cf the moon and their faces resemble the full moon. Their bodies are as cool as tncmoon. They have the fragrance of lotuses.
verses.hindi: थी। उसके कान भी बड़े-बड़े थे और वह दुरासद था ।१२४-१२६। वज्र॒से उसके हाथ चमक रहे थे और प्रभाधिकय के कारण केशराशि भी प्रदीप्त हो रही थी। ज्वालमाला की भाँति वह मुक्तामाला पहने हुये ओर प्रलयकालीन अग्नि की तरह अपनी कान्ति से दीप्त हो रहा था। उ्चधके मुंह कान तक फटे हुये थे, जिसमें चार भयानक दाँत दिखाई देते थे ।१२७-१२८। वह महाबली, महातेजस्वी महापुरुष ईश्वर, विश्वहर्ता और विशाल शरीर वाला था। महान् वटव॒क्ष की तरह उसका देह विस्तार था। यह शतचन्द्र के समान उज्ज्वल और कामाग्नि की तरह दीप्यमान था।१२  उसे चार बड़े बड़ मूँह थे जिसमें चमकते हुये दाँत थे । तेज, बल और पौरुष की अधिकता से वह अत्यन्त उग्र था। प्रलयक'लीन हजारों सूं और अग्नि की तरह वह भास्कर, सुमेरु कैलाश और हिमालय की तरह विशाल था. हजारों चन्द्र की निर्मल कान्ति की
verses.wordMeaning: They have the complexion and lustre cf the moon and their faces resemble the full moon. Their bodies are as cool as tncmoon. They have the fragrance of lotuses.
verses.commentary: Sense: They have the complexion and lustre cf the moon and their faces resemble the full moon. Their bodies are as cool as tncmoon. They have the fragrance of lotuses.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित्कुरुते प्राणसंक्षयम् । रुद्रलोके वसेत् तावद् यावद् आ भूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitkurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam / rudraloke vaset tāvad yāvad ā bhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: Their span of ale is ten thousand years. They are free from ailments. Imbibing the juice of the black mangoes, they enjoy perpetual youth.
verses.hindi: तरह वहू कमतीय था और निखिल ओषधियों से युक्त मन्दराचल की तरह प्रदीष्ण था।!३०। वह युगास्त- कालीन सूर्य की तरह आभावाला, महाबली, सुन्दर नासिका युक्त, महानन प्रचण्ड-गण्ड, दीप्ताक्ष, ज्वालामुखी की तरह मुखगह्नरवाला, व्याप्न चर्मधारी, विशाल साँपों से वेष्टित, पगड़ी पहने हुये, चन्द्रधारी, उच्चावच,
verses.wordMeaning: Their span of ale is ten thousand years. They are free from ailments. Imbibing the juice of the black mangoes, they enjoy perpetual youth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their span of ale is ten thousand years. They are free from ailments. Imbibing the juice of the black mangoes, they enjoy perpetual youth.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुष्करिणीं गच्छेत् सर्वपापक्षयंकरीम् । तत्र स्नात्वार्चयेद्देवं तेजोराशिं दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchet sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarīm / tatra snātvārcayeddevaṃ tejorāśiṃ divākaram
verses.translation: The magnitude, lustre and the span of life oT the people of all the four great continents have been explained precisely ancl succinctly, but not in detail.
verses.hindi: कर्णिकारखजं दीप्तं क्रोधादुद्श्रान्ततोचनम् । क्वचिश्रृत्यति चित्राइुर्ग क्वचिद्ददति सुस्वरम ॥ जानुभ्यामर्वान गत्वा प्रणतः प्राज्जलिः स्थित: । आज्ञांपय त्वं देवेश कि कार्य करवाणि ते
verses.wordMeaning: The magnitude, lustre and the span of life oT the people of all the four great continents have been explained precisely ancl succinctly, but not in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: The magnitude, lustre and the span of life oT the people of all the four great continents have been explained precisely ancl succinctly, but not in detail.

verses.sanskrit: ऋचमेकां जपेत् साम्नः सामवेदफलं लभेत् । यजुर्वेदस्य जपनाद् ऋग्वेदस्य तथैव च
verses.transliteration: ṛcamekāṃ japet sāmnaḥ sāmavedaphalaṃ labhet / yajurvedasya japanād ṛgvedasya tathaiva ca
verses.translation: O Sages of enhancing reputation! The characteristics of the people of Bhadrasva mentioned by me are what have been cited by earlier Siddhas. Now listen to them in detail.
verses.hindi: तमुवाचा55क्षिप मख्ख॑ दक्षस्येह महेश्वर:। देवस्यानुमति श्रुत्वा बीरभद्रों महाबलः ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Sages of enhancing reputation! The characteristics of the people of Bhadrasva mentioned by me are what have been cited by earlier Siddhas. Now listen to them in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sages of enhancing reputation! The characteristics of the people of Bhadrasva mentioned by me are what have been cited by earlier Siddhas. Now listen to them in detail.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षरं वा जपेन् मन्त्रं ध्यायमानो दिवाकरम् । आदित्यहृदयं जप्त्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: akṣaraṃ vā japen mantraṃ dhyāyamāno divākaram / ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: I shall narrate fully and in detail what I have seen and heard, of the five principal mountain ranges, countries and rivers which surround the famous Devakuta mountain.
verses.hindi: प्रणभ्य शिरशा पादो देवेशस्य उमापते: ततो बन्धात्प्रमुक्तेन सिहेनेवेह लीलया । देव्या मन्युक्ृतं मत्वा हतो दक्षस्थ स क़तुः १३६ मन्युना च महाभोमा भद्रकालोी महेश्वरी । आत्मन: सर्वंसाक्षित्वे तेन सार्थ सहानुगा
verses.wordMeaning: I shall narrate fully and in detail what I have seen and heard, of the five principal mountain ranges, countries and rivers which surround the famous Devakuta mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall narrate fully and in detail what I have seen and heard, of the five principal mountain ranges, countries and rivers which surround the famous Devakuta mountain.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा विधिना जपेद्द्विजान् । तस्य कोटिगुणं पुण्यं जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vidhinā japeddvijān / tasya koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The five principal mountains are Saivala, Varnama- lagra, the excellent mountain Koranja, Svetavarna and Nila.
verses.hindi: स एव भगवान्क़द्धः प्रेतावासकृतालयः । वीरभद्र इति ख्यातो देव्या मन्युप्रमाजंक: ....
verses.wordMeaning: The five principal mountains are Saivala, Varnama- lagra, the excellent mountain Koranja, Svetavarna and Nila.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five principal mountains are Saivala, Varnama- lagra, the excellent mountain Koranja, Svetavarna and Nila.

verses.sanskrit: अनाशकेनाग्निगत्या जले वा देहपातनात् । तस्मिंस्तीर्थे मृतो यस्तु स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: anāśakenāgnigatyā jale vā dehapātanāt / tasmiṃstīrthe mṛto yastu sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: There are hundreds, thousands and crores of small mountains besides, which are offshoots of these five ranges.
verses.hindi: रंग-विरंगे फूलों से शिर को सजाये हुये, बहुविध गन्ध-चन्दन को लगाये हुये, विविध रत्नों से और कितने ही प्रकार के आभरणों से भूषित था ।१३१-१३३। वह कनेर की माला पहने हुये था और क्रोध से छसकी आँखें नाच रहो थीं। कभी वह विचित्र भाव भड़ी से नाच उठता था तो कभी मथुर स्वर में बोल उठता था, कभी वह योगावलम्बन करके ध्यान करता था, तो कभी मोटी चीजों को इधर-उधर हटाता था, कभी वह विद्वात्मा गाता था, तो कभी सिसकियाँ भरता था ।१३४-१३१५। ज्ञान, वेराग्य, ऐश्वयं, तप, सत्य, क्षमा, धघृति, प्रमुत्व, आत्मसंबोध और अधिष्ठान गुण से युक्त उसने भूमि पर घुटने टेक दिये और हाथ जोड़कर बोला -देवेश ! आज्ञा दीजिये कि, मैं आपका कौन सा कार्ये करूँ ।१३६-१३७। ह
verses.wordMeaning: There are hundreds, thousands and crores of small mountains besides, which are offshoots of these five ranges.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are hundreds, thousands and crores of small mountains besides, which are offshoots of these five ranges.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रो वा नृपसत्तम । विहितं कर्म कुर्वाणः स गच्छेत् परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā nṛpasattama / vihitaṃ karma kurvāṇaḥ sa gacchet paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: (In and near these mountains) there are many lands and countries where a great variety of people live, which abound in various types of animals and which are looked after by many kings,
verses.hindi: प्रहादेव ने कह--तुम दक्ष के यज्ञ का विध्वंस करो ।
verses.wordMeaning: (In and near these mountains) there are many lands and countries where a great variety of people live, which abound in various types of animals and which are looked after by many kings,
verses.commentary: Sense: (In and near these mountains) there are many lands and countries where a great variety of people live, which abound in various types of animals and which are looked after by many kings,

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: व्याधिं सत्त्वक्षयं मोहं ज्ञात्वा वर्णा द्विजोत्तम । पापेभ्यो विप्रमुच्यन्ते केन तत्साधनं वद
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: vyādhiṃ sattvakṣayaṃ mohaṃ jñātvā varṇā dvijottama / pāpebhyo vipramucyante kena tatsādhanaṃ vada
verses.translation: Many kingdoms are established between the mountains in the lands whether plain or rugged and uneven. Their names are as follows:
verses.hindi: महादेव की आज्ञा पाकर वह महाबली वीरभद्र देवेश उमापति के चरणों की वन्दना करके पिज्जरमुक्त पिह की तरह लीनापूर्वंक यह सोचता हुआ चला कि, “भगवती क्रद्ध हैं। अतः दक्ष के उस यज्ञ को विनष्ट ही समझना चाहिए, उसी समय देवी के क्रोध से एक महाभयद्भूर महेश्वरी भद्रकाली उत्पन्न हुई, जो साथी की भाँति वीरभद्र के साथ चली ।१३८-१४०। प्रेतावास में रहने वाले और उम। के क्रोध कारण को दूर करने वाले भगवान् वीरभद्र ने अपने रोमकप से रौद्र नामक असंख्य गणेद्वरों की सृष्टि को। वे रुद्र के अनुगामी, महाबली, रुद्र के तुल्य पराक्रमी, रुद्र के अनुचर और रुद्र के तुल्य कान्ति वाले थे । वे सौ-सो और हजार-हजार की संख्या में दल बाँध कर श्षीत्र ही यज्ञ दिशा की ओर दौड़ पड़े ।१४६-१४३। उनकी
verses.wordMeaning: Many kingdoms are established between the mountains in the lands whether plain or rugged and uneven. Their names are as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: Many kingdoms are established between the mountains in the lands whether plain or rugged and uneven. Their names are as follows:

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तिलोदकी तिलस्नायी कामक्रोधविवर्जितः । ब्राह्मणो ऽनशनैः प्राणांस् त्यजल्लभति सद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tilodakī tilasnāyī kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ / brāhmaṇo 'naśanaiḥ prāṇāṃs tyajallabhati sadgatim
verses.translation: Sumahgalas, Suddhas, Candrakantas, Sunandanas, Vrajakas, Nllasaileyas, Sauvlras, Vijayasthalas, Mahasthalas,
verses.hindi: ततः किलकिलाशब्द आकाश पुरयन्निव । तेन शब्देन महता त्रस्ता: सर्वे दिवौकसः (१४४
verses.wordMeaning: Sumahgalas, Suddhas, Candrakantas, Sunandanas, Vrajakas, Nllasaileyas, Sauvlras, Vijayasthalas, Mahasthalas,
verses.commentary: Sense: Sumahgalas, Suddhas, Candrakantas, Sunandanas, Vrajakas, Nllasaileyas, Sauvlras, Vijayasthalas, Mahasthalas,

verses.sanskrit: सङ्ग्रामे सद्गतिं तात क्षत्रियो निधने लभेत् । तदभावान्महाप्राज्ञ सेवमानो लभेद् इति
verses.transliteration: saṅgrāme sadgatiṃ tāta kṣatriyo nidhane labhet / tadabhāvānmahāprājña sevamāno labhed iti
verses.translation: They drink from the holy river Mahaganga 2 which was, in the beginning, known in the three worlds as Slta bearing down volumes of cold water.
verses.hindi: अग्नयो नव दीप्यन्ते न च दीप्यति भास्कर: । ग्रहा नेव प्रकाशन्ते नज्ञत्राणि न तारका: ऋषयो नाभ्यभाषन्त न देवा न च दानवाः  एवं हि तिमिरीभुते निदहन्ति बिमभानिता:ः
verses.wordMeaning: They drink from the holy river Mahaganga 2 which was, in the beginning, known in the three worlds as Slta bearing down volumes of cold water.
verses.commentary: Sense: They drink from the holy river Mahaganga 2 which was, in the beginning, known in the three worlds as Slta bearing down volumes of cold water.

verses.sanskrit: व्याधिग्रहगृहीतो वा वृद्धो वा विकलेन्द्रियः । आत्मानं दाहयित्वाग्नौ विधिना सद्गतिं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: vyādhigrahagṛhīto vā vṛddho vā vikalendriyaḥ / ātmānaṃ dāhayitvāgnau vidhinā sadgatiṃ labhet
verses.translation: The other rivers are Hariisavasati, Mahacakra, Cakra, Vaktra, Kaiici, the excellent river Surasa, Sakhavatl, IndranadI, Megha, Maiigaravahini, Kaveri, Haritoya, Soma- varta, Satahrada, Vanamala, Vasumatl, Pampa, Pampavati, Suvarna, Paiicavarna, the holy Vapusmati, Manivapra, Suva- pra, Brahmabhaga, Silasinl, Kpsnatoya, Punyoda, the auspi¬ cious Nagapadi, SaivalinI, Manitata, Ksaroda, Arunavatl, Visnupadx, Mahapunyil, Mahanadi, Hiranyavahinl, Nila, Skandamala, Suravatl, Vamoda, Pataka, Vetali and Mahanadi Ganga and these rivers are glorified as the heroines (important rivers). Besides there are other rivers small and innumerable— hundreds and thousands.
verses.hindi: प्रमदंन्ति तथा चान्ये बिनुत्यन्ति तथा5परे । आधावन्ति प्रधादन्ति वायुबेगा मनोजवाः
verses.wordMeaning: The other rivers are Hariisavasati, Mahacakra, Cakra, Vaktra, Kaiici, the excellent river Surasa, Sakhavatl, IndranadI, Megha, Maiigaravahini, Kaveri, Haritoya, Soma- varta, Satahrada, Vanamala, Vasumatl, Pampa, Pampavati, Suvarna, Paiicavarna, the holy Vapusmati, Manivapra,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The other rivers are Hariisavasati, Mahacakra, Cakra, Vaktra, Kaiici, the excellent river Surasa, Sakhavatl, IndranadI, Megha, Maiigaravahini, Kaveri, Haritoya, Soma- varta, Satahrada, Vanamala, Vasumatl, Pampa, Pampavati, Suvarna, Paiicavarna, the holy Vapusmati, Manivapra,…

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यो ऽपि हि त्यजन्प्राणानेवं वै शुभभाग् भवेत् । जले वा शुद्धभावेन त्यक्त्वा प्राणाञ्छिवो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vaiśyo 'pi hi tyajanprāṇānevaṃ vai śubhabhāg bhavet / jale vā śuddhabhāvena tyaktvā prāṇāñchivo bhavet
verses.translation: Thus the holy rivers in the eastern continent have been enumerated to you. A person becomes sanctified by merely enumerating them.
verses.hindi: चण्यंन्ते यज्ञपात्राणि यागस्थाइड्यतनानि अल । शीर्येमाणानि दृश्यन्ते तारा इब नभसस्‍्तलात्ू मधुमण्डोदका दिव्या: खण्डशर्क रवालुका:
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the holy rivers in the eastern continent have been enumerated to you. A person becomes sanctified by merely enumerating them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the holy rivers in the eastern continent have been enumerated to you. A person becomes sanctified by merely enumerating them.

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रो ऽपि द्विजशुश्रूषुस्तोषयित्वा महेश्वरम् । विमुच्य नान्यथा पापः पतते नरके ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: śūdro 'pi dvijaśuśrūṣustoṣayitvā maheśvaram / vimucya nānyathā pāpaḥ patate narake dhruvam
verses.translation: The kingdom is flourishing and prosperous. It consists of many provinces where trees and forests grow in abundance. These are encircled by many hills.
verses.hindi: पडसाप्निवहन्त्यन्या गुडकुल्या मनोरमाः । उच्चावचानि मांसानि भक्ष्यणि विविधानिच
verses.wordMeaning: The kingdom is flourishing and prosperous. It consists of many provinces where trees and forests grow in abundance. These are encircled by many hills.
verses.commentary: Sense: The kingdom is flourishing and prosperous. It consists of many provinces where trees and forests grow in abundance. These are encircled by many hills.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा प्रणवाशक्तो द्विजेभ्यो गुरवे तथा । पञ्चाग्नौ शोषयेद्देहमापृच्छ्य द्विजसत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: athavā praṇavāśakto dvijebhyo gurave tathā / pañcāgnau śoṣayeddehamāpṛcchya dvijasattamān
verses.translation: It is teeming with groups of men and women. The king¬ dom is auspicious and joyous. People are governed by many kings. They are rich in money and foodgrains. There are many mines of jewels, glorified in many ways.
verses.hindi: पानकानि च दिव्यानि लेहां चोष्यं तथाउपरे  भुजते विविधवंक्त्रविलुण्ठन्ति( क्षिपन्ति च किलकारियों से आकाश गूंज उठा और उस बिकट शब्द से सभी देवगण भयभीत हो गये  पहाड़ टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो गये, धरती काँप उठी, मेरु चंचल हो गया, समुद्र क्षुब्ध हो गये, अग्नि दीप्तिह्वीन, सूर्थ तेजोहीन और ग्रह-तक्षत्र तारकादि प्रकाशहीन हो गबे ।१४४-१४६॥। यज्ञ में उपस्थित ऋषि, देब, दानव आदि चुप हो गये, घना अन्धकार छा गया और विमानित उन रुद्र गणों ने सब को कष्ट देना प्रारम्भ किया । ने घोर रूप महा-
verses.wordMeaning: It is teeming with groups of men and women. The king¬ dom is auspicious and joyous. People are governed by many kings. They are rich in money and foodgrains. There are many mines of jewels, glorified in many ways.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is teeming with groups of men and women. The king¬ dom is auspicious and joyous. People are governed by many kings. They are rich in money and foodgrains. There are many mines of jewels, glorified in many ways.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तदान्तजितक्रोधाञ्छास्त्रयुक्तान् विचक्षणान् । तेषां चैवोपदेशेन करीषाग्निं प्रसाधयेत्
verses.transliteration: śāntadāntajitakrodhāñchāstrayuktān vicakṣaṇān / teṣāṃ caivopadeśena karīṣāgniṃ prasādhayet
verses.translation: In that country, men are said to be lustrous in complc-
verses.hindi: बली रुद्रगण सिहनाद करने लगे। किंसी ने यजश्ञागार को उखाड़ फेंका, तो कोई यज्ञयूप को पीड़ित करने लगा, तो कोई ताण्डव करने लगा। वायु और मन के तुल्य वेग धारण कर कितने तो कदने और दौड़ने लगे ।१४७-१४६। कितनों ने यज्ञ-पात्रों को और यज्ञशालाओं को तोड़-मरोड़ दिया, इससे बह बज्ञभूमि उसी प्रकार दिखाई पड़ने लगी, जिस प्रकार कि आकाझ्ष में तारागण बिखरे दीख पड़ते हैं।१५०। उन लोगों ने
verses.wordMeaning: In that country, men are said to be lustrous in complc-
verses.commentary: Sense: In that country, men are said to be lustrous in complc-

verses.sanskrit: एवं वर्णा यथात्वेन मूढाहङ्कारमोहिताः । पतन्ति नरके घोरे यथान्धो गिरिगह्वरे
verses.transliteration: evaṃ varṇā yathātvena mūḍhāhaṅkāramohitāḥ / patanti narake ghore yathāndho girigahvare
verses.translation: They can meet, talk and associate with Devas and occupy the same seats with them.
verses.hindi: दिव्य भक्ष्य अन्नों के ढेर को, जलराशि को, क्षीर-नदी को, कीचड़ की तरह पड़े हुये घी और उसी तरह पड़ी हुई खीर को, दिव्य मधु और मण्डोदक को, बालुकाराशि की तरह चीनी को, षड्रसवाहिनी असंख्य गुड़कुल्या ( बड़े-बड़े नाद ) को, मांस के छोटे-बड़े ढेर को, विविध प्रकार के भक्ष्य वस्तुओं को, बढ़िया से बढ़िया पीने की चीजों को और चाटने चूसने की चीजों को अपने नाना प्रकार के मुखों से खाना प्रारम्भ कर दिया। उन्होंने कुछ को फेंक दिया और कुछ को उलट दिया ।१५१-१५३। रुद्र के कोप से उत्पन्न वे विशाल शरीर
verses.wordMeaning: They can meet, talk and associate with Devas and occupy the same seats with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: They can meet, talk and associate with Devas and occupy the same seats with them.

verses.sanskrit: ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तन्ते कामचारतः । कृमियोनिं प्रपद्यन्ते तेषां पिण्डो न च क्रिया
verses.transliteration: ye śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartante kāmacārataḥ / kṛmiyoniṃ prapadyante teṣāṃ piṇḍo na ca kriyā
verses.translation: Their span oflife is ten thousand years. There is no difference of Dharma and Adharma among them (all people are equal). They are naturally truthful and non-violent.
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिद्वान्तगं तग्रन्थ: क. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Their span oflife is ten thousand years. There is no difference of Dharma and Adharma among them (all people are equal). They are naturally truthful and non-violent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their span oflife is ten thousand years. There is no difference of Dharma and Adharma among them (all people are equal). They are naturally truthful and non-violent.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं धर्मं त्यक्त्वा यथेच्छाचारसेविनः । अष्टाविंशतिर्वै कोट्यो नरकाणां युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ tyaktvā yathecchācārasevinaḥ / aṣṭāviṃśatirvai koṭyo narakāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.hindi: रुद्रकोपान्महाकाया: कालाग्निसद्शोपभाः । सुरसंन्यानि मर्दन्‍्तो भीषयन्ति) च स्वंशः ॥॥ क़ीडन्ति विविधाकाराश्रिक्षिपु: सुरयोषितः १५४ रुद्रकोपप्रयुक्तास्तु सर्वेदेवः सुरक्षितम्। त॑ यज्षमहञ्शी क्र' रुद्रकल्या: समोपत: १५५ चक़्रन्ये तथा नाद'न्सवेभुतभयंकरान्ू । छित्त्वा शिरोष्न्ये यज्षस्थ विनदन्ति भयंकरा: १५६ दक्षो दक्षपतिश्चव देवो यज्ञपतिस्तथा । सृगरूपेण चा55काशे प्रपलायितुमारभत् ७१५७
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्येकं वा पतन्त्येते मग्ना नरकसागरे । दुर्लभं मानुषं जन्म बहुधर्मार्जितं नृप
verses.transliteration: pratyekaṃ vā patantyete magnā narakasāgare / durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma bahudharmārjitaṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.hindi: त्यस्त्रिशहेबतानां ताः कोटयो विमलात्मिकाः । पशेनाग्निबलेना5डशु बद्धा: सिहबलेन च.

verses.sanskrit: तल्लब्ध्वा मदमात्सर्यं यो वै त्यजति मानवः । संनियम्य सदात्मानं ज्ञानचक्षुर् नरो हि सः
verses.transliteration: tallabdhvā madamātsaryaṃ yo vai tyajati mānavaḥ / saṃniyamya sadātmānaṃ jñānacakṣur naro hi saḥ

verses.hindi: ततो जम्मुमंहात्मानं सबें देवा महाबलस् । प्रसीद भगदन्‍्रुद्र भृत्यानां मा क्रुधः प्रभो १६१ ततो ब्रह्मादयो देवा दक्षश्चव प्रजापति: । ऊचुः प्रा्जलयो भृत्वा कथ्यता को भवानिति
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानतिमिरान्धस्य ज्ञानांजनशलाकया
verses.transliteration: ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāṃjanaśalākayā
verses.translation: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.hindi: न॒ च देवो न चा55दित्यो न च भोक्तुमिहा55गतः । नेब द्रष्टुं हि देवेन्द्रान्न च कौतृहलान्बितः:
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: यस्य नोन्मीलितं चक्षुर्ज्ञेयो जात्यन्ध एव सः । एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं यत्पृष्टं नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: yasya nonmīlitaṃ cakṣurjñeyo jātyandha eva saḥ / etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ nṛpasattama
verses.translation: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.hindi: वाले, कालाभ्नि सदृश रुद्रगण देव सेना को रोदते हुए डराने लगे और विविध देह ध।रण कर कीड़ा करते हुए देव-पत्नियों को भी घसीटा ।१५४। रुद्रकोपोत्पन्न उन रुद्र तुल्य गणों ने देवों से रक्षित उस यज्ञ को उनके सामने ही नष्ट कर दिया। उनमें कुछ सब को त्रास उत्पन्न करने वाले भयद्भूर हाब्द करने लगे और किसी ने यक्ष के सिर को काट कर भयद्धूर चीत्कार क्रिया ।१५५-१५६। इस ध्वंस लाला में यज्ञपति दक्ष मृग रूप धारण कर आकाश की ओर भागे; किन्तु अप्रमेयात्मा वीरभद्र ने दक्ष की शक्ति को समझ लिया और आकाश में ही जाकर उनके सिर को काट लिया ।१५७-१४५८। दक्ष प्रजापति नष्ट हो गये, उनकी चेतना विलुप्त हो गई और क्रुद्ध वीरभद्र ने उनके सिर को पैरों से रौंद दिया । वृद्ध दक्ष प्रजापति पृथ्वी पर लोट गये ।१५६। इधर विमल आत्मा वाले तेंतीस करोड़ देवता भी भग्नि तुल्य प्रदीप्त दढ़ पाश में बंध गये । तब
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: तथानिष्टतराणां हि रुद्रस्य वचनं यथा । नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा रुद्रदेहाद् विनिःसृता
verses.transliteration: tathāniṣṭatarāṇāṃ hi rudrasya vacanaṃ yathā / narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā rudradehād viniḥsṛtā
verses.translation: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.hindi: वे सब देवता महाबली महात्मा वीरभद्र के पास गये और बोले--भगवन् ! रुद्र प्रसन्न हो जाये। प्रभु! दासों पर क्रोध मत करें। तब ब्रह्मदि देवता और दक्ष प्रजापति हाथ जोड़ कर बोले--महाराज, आप कौन हैं!
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: तारयेत् सर्वभूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च । सर्वदेवाधिदेवेन ईश्वरेण महात्मना
verses.transliteration: tārayet sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca / sarvadevādhidevena īśvareṇa mahātmanā
verses.translation: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.hindi: बीरभद्र बोले--न हम देब हैंत आदित्य हैं, न भोजन की इच्छा से आये हैं और न कुतृहलवश दक्षयज्ञविनाशार्थ संप्राप्त विद्धि भामिह्त । वीरभद्र इति ख्यातं रुद्रकोपाहिनिरगंतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: लोकानां च हितार्थाय महापुण्यावतारिता । मानसं वाचिकं पापं स्नानान्नश्यति कर्मजम्
verses.transliteration: lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya mahāpuṇyāvatāritā / mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ snānānnaśyati karmajam
verses.translation: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.hindi: भद्राकाली च विज्ञेया देव्या: क्रोधाहिनिगंता  प्रेषिता देवदेबेन यज्ञान्तिकसिहाइ5गता १६५ शरण गच्छ राजेन्द्र देवं तं त्वमुमापतिभ् । दर क्रोधो5पि रुद्रस्थ वरदानं न देवत:ः

verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रदेहाद्विनिष्क्रान्ता तेन पुण्यतमा हि सा । प्रातरुत्थाय यो नित्यं भूमिमाक्रम्य भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: rudradehādviniṣkrāntā tena puṇyatamā hi sā / prātarutthāya yo nityaṃ bhūmimākramya bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.hindi: वीरभद्रवच: श्र॒त्वा दक्षो धरंभृतां वर:। तोषायामास देवेशं शुलपाणि महेश्वरम् ॥ प्रदष्टे यज्ञवाटे तु विद्वतेषु द्विजातिषु । तारामृगमये दीप्ते रोदे भीममहानले १६८
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: एतन्मन्त्रं जपेत्तात स्नानस्य लभते फलम् । नमः पुण्यजले देवि नमः सागरगामिनि
verses.transliteration: etanmantraṃ japettāta snānasya labhate phalam / namaḥ puṇyajale devi namaḥ sāgaragāmini

verses.hindi: उत्पतदधि: पतड्िश्च गश्नरासिषगुध्नुभि: । पक्षपातविनिधूतेः शिवाशतनिनादिते: ११७०
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: नमोऽस्तु पापनिर्मोचे नमो देवि वरानने
verses.transliteration: namo'stu pāpanirmoce namo devi varānane
verses.translation: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.hindi: सहसा देवदेवेशस्त्वस्निकुण्डादुपागतः । चन्द्रसुयंसहस्नस्य तेज: संवर्तकोषमम् १७२ प्रहस्य चेन भगवानिदं वचनमत्नवीत् । नष्टस्तेज्ञानतो दक्ष प्रीतिस्ते मयि सांप्रतम् १७३ स्मितं कृत्वाइब्रवीद्ाक्य ब्रृहि कि करवाणि ते। श्रावितं च समाख्याय देवानां गुरुभिः सह॒ तमुवाचाञुजाल कृत्वा दक्षो देव प्रजापति: । भीतशड्धितवित्रस्त: शबाष्पवदनेक्षण:
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते ऋषिवरसङ्घसेविते नमो ऽस्तु ते त्रिनयनदेहनिःसृते । नमो ऽस्तु ते सुकृतवतां सदा वरे नमो ऽस्तु ते सततपवित्रपावनि
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te ṛṣivarasaṅghasevite namo 'stu te trinayanadehaniḥsṛte / namo 'stu te sukṛtavatāṃ sadā vare namo 'stu te satatapavitrapāvani
verses.translation: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.hindi: हमारा नाम वीरभद्र है ओर हम महादेव के कोप से उत्पन्न हुए हैं १६४।॥ यह भद्गकाली है जो देवी के क्रोध से उत्पन्न हुई है और महादेव द्वारा यह भी इस यज्ञभूमि की ओर भेजी गई है ।१६५। राजेन्द्र  आप उन्हों उमापति की शरण में जाइये, जिनका क्रोध भी अन्य देवों के वरदान से उत्तम है ।१६६। वीरभद्र के वचन को सुन कर घर्मनिष्ठ दक्ष ने देवाधिदेव शुलधाणि महेश्वर को प्रसन्न किया ।१६७॥ उस समय यज्ञभूप्ति नष्ट-
verses.wordMeaning: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday they perform sacrifices, worships and obei¬ sance with devotion to Lord Sankara and Gauri, the great Vaisnavi (Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे विमलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ४४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप । रेवाया दक्षिणे कूले निर्मितं शूलपाणिना
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vimaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 44 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa / revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle nirmitaṃ śūlapāṇinā
verses.translation: The natural characteristics of the Bhadrasvas have been narrated precisely. Now Listen to a detailed description of Ketumala. 1 2
verses.hindi: भ्रष्ट हो चुकी थी, यजत्र में दीक्षित द्विजातिगण भाग चुके थे, यज्ञीय महाअनल बुझ चुका था, तिश्यूल से चोट खाये हुए अनुचरगण इधर उधर कराह रहे थे, गाड़ा गया यज्ञयूप उखड़ा हुआ पड़ा था, मांस के लोभी गृध्र नौचे-ऊपर मंडरा रहे थे और जोर-जोर से डेने ( पंख ) हिला रहे थे तथा झुंड के झूंड गीदड़ चिल्ला रहे ये ।१६८-१७०। उसी समय शत्रु को दमन करने वाले बहुदुष्टि देवदेवेश प्राणापान को यत्नपूर्षक अपने स्थान में रोक कर ऑर इधर-उधर देखते हुए सहसा अग्निकुण्ड से बाहर निःल आये। संवर्तकतुल्य हजार सूर्य के समान तेजोमय शंकर ने हँस कर कहा--वक्ष, तुम्हारे अज्ञान से यज्ञ नष्ट हुआ। अब तुम्हारी प्रीति मुझसे हुईं। कहो, अब तुम्हारे लिये मैं क्या करू ? ।१७१-१७३३२। देवों और गुरुओं के साथ आपबीती को सुनाकर दक्ष प्रजापति ने जिनकी आँखों से आँसू टपक कर गालों पर आ रहे थे और वे भय तथा सन्देश से
verses.wordMeaning: The natural characteristics of the Bhadrasvas have been narrated precisely. Now Listen to a detailed description of Ketumala. 1 2
verses.commentary: Sense: The natural characteristics of the Bhadrasvas have been narrated precisely. Now Listen to a detailed description of Ketumala. 1 2

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षार्थं मानवेन्द्राणां निर्मितं नृपसत्तम । युधिष्ठिर उवाच: श्रुता मे विविधा धर्मास्तीर्थानि विविधानि च । दानधर्माः समस्ताश्च त्वत्प्रसादाद्द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: mokṣārthaṃ mānavendrāṇāṃ nirmitaṃ nṛpasattama / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: śrutā me vividhā dharmāstīrthāni vividhāni ca / dānadharmāḥ samastāśca tvatprasādāddvijottama
verses.translation: It behoves you to hear in detail the description of the seven principal mountain ranges, countries and rivers in parti¬ cular, situated in all the quarters to the west of the western lordly mountain Nisadha.
verses.hindi: घबराये हुये थे, दोनों हाथ जोड़ कर महादेव से कहा १७४-१७५॥ अगर भगवान हम पर प्रसनन्‍्त हैं. हम
verses.wordMeaning: It behoves you to hear in detail the description of the seven principal mountain ranges, countries and rivers in parti¬ cular, situated in all the quarters to the west of the western lordly mountain Nisadha.
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you to hear in detail the description of the seven principal mountain ranges, countries and rivers in parti¬ cular, situated in all the quarters to the west of the western lordly mountain Nisadha.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि संसारश्छिद्यते यथा । पुनरागमनं नास्ति मोक्षप्राप्तिर्भवेद् यथा
verses.transliteration: anyacca śrotumicchāmi saṃsāraśchidyate yathā / punarāgamanaṃ nāsti mokṣaprāptirbhaved yathā
verses.translation: The seven ranges of Kulaparvatas are Visala, Kambala, Krsna, Jayanta, Hariparvata, Asoka and Vardhamana.
verses.hindi: यदि प्रसन्नो भगवान्यदि वा5हं तब प्रियः । यदि वाहहमनुग्राह्मो यदि देयो बरो मम यहग्धं भक्षितं पीतमशितं यच्च नाशितम् । चूर्णोकृतं चापबिद्धं यज्ञसंभारमीदृशम्
verses.wordMeaning: The seven ranges of Kulaparvatas are Visala, Kambala, Krsna, Jayanta, Hariparvata, Asoka and Vardhamana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven ranges of Kulaparvatas are Visala, Kambala, Krsna, Jayanta, Hariparvata, Asoka and Vardhamana.

verses.sanskrit: एतदाख्याहि मे सर्वं प्रसादाद् द्विजसत्तम
verses.transliteration: etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasādād dvijasattama
verses.translation: There are other hills by hundreds, thousands and crores of other massive and extensive mountains, the offshoots of the seven ranges of Kulaparvatas.
verses.hindi: दीघंकालेन महता प्रयत्नेन च संचितम् । तन्न मिथ्या भवेन्मह्य बरमेत॑ वृणोम्पहंम् १७८ तथा5स्त्वित्याह भगवान्भगनेत्रहरों हरः। धर्माध्यक्ष महादेव॑ तज्यक्षं तं वे प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: There are other hills by hundreds, thousands and crores of other massive and extensive mountains, the offshoots of the seven ranges of Kulaparvatas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other hills by hundreds, thousands and crores of other massive and extensive mountains, the offshoots of the seven ranges of Kulaparvatas.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा तीर्थात् तीर्थान्तरं महत् । श्रुते यस्य प्रभावे तु मुच्यते चाब्दिकादघात्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā tīrthāt tīrthāntaraṃ mahat / śrute yasya prabhāve tu mucyate cābdikādaghāt
verses.translation: Verses 35-38 describe the people of Bhadras'va (N. China, Smkiang).
verses.hindi: नमस्ते देवदेवेश देवारिबलसुदन । देवेन्द्र ह्वामरश्रेष्ठ देवरानवपूर्जित सर्वतःअभुतिमाल्लोके सर्वानावृत्य तिष्ठसि १८२ शदकुकर्ण महाकऋर्ण कुम्भकर्णाणंवालय । गजेन्द्रकर्ण गोकर्ण पाणिकर्ण नमोथ्स्तु ते
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 35-38 describe the people of Bhadras'va (N. China, Smkiang).
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 35-38 describe the people of Bhadras'va (N. China, Smkiang).

verses.sanskrit: वाचिकैर्मानसैर्वापि शारीरैश्च विशेषतः । कीर्तनात् तस्य तीर्थस्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: vācikairmānasairvāpi śārīraiśca viśeṣataḥ / kīrtanāt tasya tīrthasya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Roughly Ketumala corresponds to old Bactria, the basin of the Oxus. The latitudinal range Nisadha (i.e. Hindukush-Kunlun) is to its south and the Nila (Zarafshan-Tien shan) range is to the north and to the west is the Western Sea (the Caspian). For the mountains, valleys, settlements on mountains and the rivers of Ketumala vids supra chs. 36,38,39,42.
verses.hindi: देवदानवगोप्ता च ब्रह्मा च त्वं शतक्रतुः । मुर्तीश त्वं महासूरते समुद्राम्बुधराय च १८५
verses.wordMeaning: Roughly Ketumala corresponds to old Bactria, the basin of the Oxus. The latitudinal range Nisadha (i.e. Hindukush-Kunlun) is to its south and the Nila (Zarafshan-Tien shan) range is to the north and to the west is the Western Sea (the Caspian). For the mountains, valleys,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Roughly Ketumala corresponds to old Bactria, the basin of the Oxus. The latitudinal range Nisadha (i.e. Hindukush-Kunlun) is to its south and the Nila (Zarafshan-Tien shan) range is to the north and to the west is the Western Sea (the Caspian). For the mountains, valleys,…

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चक्रोशप्रमाणं तु तच्च तीर्थं महीपते । भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं दिव्यं प्राणिनां पापकर्मिणाम्
verses.transliteration: pañcakrośapramāṇaṃ tu tacca tīrthaṃ mahīpate / bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ prāṇināṃ pāpakarmiṇām
verses.translation: In and near them, there are. lands and kingdoms where people of various castes and creeds dwell and which are govern¬ ed by many rulers.
verses.hindi: सर्वा ह्यस्मिन्देवतास्ते गावो मोष्ठा इवा55सते । शरीर ते प्रपश्यासि सोसमसम्न जलेश्वरस्ू .............. 3०-४० नन-नान ५---बनल---न "9 प०कक्‍४ ०० 3०3०० ०+त न । जन न गन "नाना पक बनना पा निनागनननाननीननन हा ऑनीधरननकाण तय "पा पक पनितणि-ह न वर नञञे चक---+ज-
verses.wordMeaning: In and near them, there are. lands and kingdoms where people of various castes and creeds dwell and which are govern¬ ed by many rulers.
verses.commentary: Sense: In and near them, there are. lands and kingdoms where people of various castes and creeds dwell and which are govern¬ ed by many rulers.

verses.sanskrit: रेवाया दक्षिणे कूले पर्वतो भृगुसंज्ञितः । तस्य मूर्ध्नि च तत्तीर्थं स्थापितं चैव शम्भुना
verses.transliteration: revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle parvato bhṛgusaṃjñitaḥ / tasya mūrdhni ca tattīrthaṃ sthāpitaṃ caiva śambhunā
verses.translation: They are famous on the earth, well-known by their names and valour. They arc embellished (as it were) by the praises of their exploits (sung) by the people of the country they occupy.
verses.hindi: आपके प्रिय हुए, अनुग्रह के पात्र और वर पाने के योग्य हुए, तो हमारी जो यज्ञीय सामग्री नष्ट हुई है, भोज्य पदार्थ खा-पी लिया गया है, नष्ट-भ्रष्ट कर दिया गया है या बिगाड़ दिया गया है और जिसका बहुत दिनों में घोर परिश्रम करके संग्रह किया था, वह व्यर्थ न जाय। यही वर चाहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They are famous on the earth, well-known by their names and valour. They arc embellished (as it were) by the praises of their exploits (sung) by the people of the country they occupy.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are famous on the earth, well-known by their names and valour. They arc embellished (as it were) by the praises of their exploits (sung) by the people of the country they occupy.

verses.sanskrit: शूलभेदेति विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु भूपते । तत्र स्थिताश्च ये वृक्षास्तीर्थाच्चैव चतुर्दिशम्
verses.transliteration: śūlabhedeti vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhūpate / tatra sthitāśca ye vṛkṣāstīrthāccaiva caturdiśam
verses.translation: Their kingdoms are established on even and uneven lands among mountains. They are known by their own respec¬ tive and varied names.
verses.hindi: भग के नेत्र को हरण करने वाले महादेव ने कहा--ऐसा ही हो । इस प्रक्रार महादेव से बर प्राप्त कर दक्ष प्रजापति घुटने के बल जमीन पर बैठ गये और उन्होंने त्रिनयत, धर्माध्यक्ष, वृषभध्वज महादेव की स्तुति आठ हजार नामों से की दक्ष बोले - देव-देवेश ! आपको नमस्कार है। आप देवारिबलसूदन, देवेर्द्र, अमरश्रेष्ठ, देवंदानव-
verses.wordMeaning: Their kingdoms are established on even and uneven lands among mountains. They are known by their own respec¬ tive and varied names.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their kingdoms are established on even and uneven lands among mountains. They are known by their own respec¬ tive and varied names.

verses.sanskrit: पतिता निलयं यान्ति रुद्रस्य नात्र संशयः । मृतास्तत्रैव ये केचिज् जन्तवो भुवि पक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: patitā nilayaṃ yānti rudrasya nātra saṃśayaḥ / mṛtāstatraiva ye kecij jantavo bhuvi pakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The nationalities are: 1 Gomanusya, Kopataka, Tatsukhas, Bhramara, Yutha, Maheya, Acalakutaka, Sumaula, Stavaka, Krauhca, Krsnanga, • Manipunjaka, Kutakambala, Mauslya, Samudrantaraka, Karariibhava, Kuca, Sveta, Suvarna- kataka, Subha, Svetanga, Krsnapada, Viha, Kapilakarnika, Atyakarala, Gojvala, Hinana, Vanapataka, Mahisa, Kumuda- bha, Karavata, Sahotkaca, Sukanasas, Mahanasa, Vanasa, Gaja- bhumika, Karanja, Manjama, Vaha, Kiskindi, Pandubhhmika, Kubera, Dhumaja, Janga, Vahga, Rajiva, Kokila, Vacahga, Mahanga, Madhaureya, Surecaka, Pittala, Kacala, Sravana,
verses.hindi: संसार को आप ढेके हुए हैं।१५१-१८२। शडकुकर्ण ! आप महाकर्णे, कुम्भकर्ण, समुद्रवासी, गजेन्द्रकर्ण, गोकर्ण, और पाणिकर्ण हैं, आपको नमस्कार है ।१८३। है शतोदर ! शतावत, शतजिल्न और शतानन, गाय- त्रीजपकर्ता आपकी स्तुति का गाने करते हैं और पूजक आपकी पूजा करते हैं ।१८४ आप देवदानवों के पालयिता, ब्रह्मा, इन्द्र; मूृर्तीश, महामूरति और समुद्राम्बुधर हैं ।१८५। गोष्ठ में जैसे गोगण रहते हैं, उसी प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: The nationalities are: 1 Gomanusya, Kopataka, Tatsukhas, Bhramara, Yutha, Maheya, Acalakutaka, Sumaula, Stavaka, Krauhca, Krsnanga, • Manipunjaka, Kutakambala, Mauslya, Samudrantaraka, Karariibhava, Kuca, Sveta, Suvarna- kataka, Subha, Svetanga, Krsnapada, Viha, Kapilakarnika,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The nationalities are: 1 Gomanusya, Kopataka, Tatsukhas, Bhramara, Yutha, Maheya, Acalakutaka, Sumaula, Stavaka, Krauhca, Krsnanga, • Manipunjaka, Kutakambala, Mauslya, Samudrantaraka, Karariibhava, Kuca, Sveta, Suvarna- kataka, Subha, Svetanga, Krsnapada, Viha, Kapilakarnika,…

verses.sanskrit: ते यान्ति परमं लोकं तत्र तीर्थे न संशयः । पातालान् निःसृता गङ्गा भोगवतीतिसंज्ञिता
verses.transliteration: te yānti paramaṃ lokaṃ tatra tīrthe na saṃśayaḥ / pātālān niḥsṛtā gaṅgā bhogavatītisaṃjñitā
verses.translation: These blessed people drink the holy waters of the river Suvapra resorted to by Nagas.
verses.hindi: देवगण आप में ही अवस्थित हैं। सोम, अग्नि, जलेश्वर, आदित्य, विष्णु, ब्रह्मा और ब्रहस्पति आपके शरीर अघोर रूपरूपाय घोरघोरतराय च् । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय नम्तः शान्ततराय च॒
verses.wordMeaning: These blessed people drink the holy waters of the river Suvapra resorted to by Nagas.
verses.commentary: Sense: These blessed people drink the holy waters of the river Suvapra resorted to by Nagas.

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रान्ता शूलभेदाच् च सर्वपापक्षयंकरी । या सा गीर्वाणनाम्न्यन्या वहेत् पुण्या महानदी
verses.transliteration: niṣkrāntā śūlabhedāc ca sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī / yā sā gīrvāṇanāmnyanyā vahet puṇyā mahānadī
verses.translation: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: हुंहुछाराय पाराय हुंहुकारप्रियाय च । नमश्व शम्भवे नित्यं गिरिवृक्षकलाय च गर्भमांसशुगालाय तारकाय तराय च्। नमो यज्ञाधिपतये द्रुतायोपद्रुताय च यज्ञवाहाय दानाय तप्याय तपनाय च। तसस्तटाय भव्याय तडितां पतये नमः
verses.wordMeaning: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: पतिता कुण्डमध्ये तु यत्र भिन्नं त्रिशूलिना । शम्भुना च पुरा तात उत्पाद्य च सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: patitā kuṇḍamadhye tu yatra bhinnaṃ triśūlinā / śambhunā ca purā tāta utpādya ca sarasvatī
verses.translation: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: बालानां चेव गोप्न्रे च बालक्कीडनकाय च। नमः शुद्धाय बुद्धाय क्षोभणायाक्षताय च तधर, विक्रतवक्ष, खड्गजिल्न, उप्रदंष्ट्री, पक्‍त्राममांसलुब्ध, तुम्बबीणाप्रिय, वृष, वुष्य, वृष्णि, वृषण, कर्टंकट, चण्ड, सावयब, कृष्ण, वर वरद, वरगन्धमाल्यवस्त्र, वरातिवर, वर्ष, वात, छाया, आतप हैं । आपको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: सा तत्र पतिता राजन् प्राचीनाघविमोचिनी । भास्वत्या त्रितयं यत्र शिला गीर्वाणसंज्ञिता
verses.transliteration: sā tatra patitā rājan prācīnāghavimocinī / bhāsvatyā tritayaṃ yatra śilā gīrvāṇasaṃjñitā
verses.translation: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: शिव, शान्‍्त, शान्ततर, एकपाद, बहुनेत्र, एकशीषं, वृद्ध, लुब्ध, संविभागप्रिय, पच्चमालाचिताजूु, पाशुपत, चण्ड, घण्ट, घण्टा से जख्धगृसक्री।, सहस्न-शतघण्ट, घंटामालाप्रिय, प्राणदण्ड, त्याग, हिलिहिल हैं । आपको नमस्कार है ।२०६-२१०। हुंहुद्धा र, पार, हुंहुद्भारप्रिय, शम्भु, गिरिवृक्षफल, गर्भमांस, श्वगाल, तारक, तर, यज्ञाधिपति, द्रुत, उपद्रुत यज्ञवाह, दान, तप्य, तपन, तट, भव्य, तड़ितृपति ।२११-२१३। अन्नद, अन्नपति, अन्तभव,
verses.wordMeaning: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे च तत्तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति । केदारं च प्रयागं च कुरुक्षेत्रं गया तथा
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe ca tattīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / kedāraṃ ca prayāgaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ gayā tathā
verses.translation: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: क्रीडनक, शुद्ध, बुढ, क्षोमण, अक्षत, तरज्जांकितकेश, मुक्तकेश, षट्क्मनिष्ठ, त्रिकर्मनिरत, वर्णाश्रमियों के १--घधण्टाघ्वनि से अभिलाषाओं को प्रदान करने वाले ।
verses.wordMeaning: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यानि च सुतीर्थानि कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् । पञ्च स्थानानि तीर्थानि पृथग्भूतानि यानि च
verses.transliteration: anyāni ca sutīrthāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm / pañca sthānāni tīrthāni pṛthagbhūtāni yāni ca
verses.translation: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: अधोररूपरूपाय घोरधोरतराय व । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय नमः शान्ततराय च॑
verses.wordMeaning: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.

verses.hindi: इच्छा हषश्व रागश्व मोह: क्षामों दमः शमः । व्यवसायों धुतिलोभिः कामक़ोधों जयाजयो. त्वं सदी त्वं शरी चापि खट्वाड़ी भु्तरी तथा। छेत्ता भेत्ता प्रहर्ता च त्व॑ नेता5प्यन्तकों मतः
verses.wordMeaning: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: एवं हि प्रत्ययस् तत्र शूलभेदप्रभावजः । यः स्मरेच्छूलभेदं तु त्रिकालं नित्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi pratyayas tatra śūlabhedaprabhāvajaḥ / yaḥ smarecchūlabhedaṃ tu trikālaṃ nityameva ca
verses.translation: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: दशलक्षणसंयुक्तो धर्मोडर्थ: काम एवं च। इन्द्र: समुद्रा: सरितः पल्वलानि सरांसिच..

verses.transliteration: sa pūtaśca bhavetsākṣāt sabāhyābhyantaro nṛpa / na kasyacin mayā khyātaṃ pṛṣṭo 'haṃ tridaśairapi
verses.translation: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: लतादली तृणौषध्यः पशवों मृुगपक्षिण: । द्रव्यकमंगुणारम्भः कालपुष्पफलप्रदः २३६ उत्फुल्लश्रित्र मानुश्न स्वर्भानुर्भानुरेव च । होत्रे होता च होमस्त्व॑ हुतं च प्रहुत॑ प्रभुः ॥२४ ३

verses.sanskrit: गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं तीर्थं सदा गोप्यं कृतं मया । सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वदोषघ्नमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ sadā gopyaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadoṣaghnamuttamam
verses.translation: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: ओंकार कहा करते हैं। सूरक्षेष्ठ ! साम गाने वाले ब्रह्मवादी आपको ह॒विद्धानी, हव, हवि और होम की आहुति कहा करते हैं। ब्रह्मादिगण कल्पवासियों के साथ आपको ऋक्-यजु-साम और अथर्वमय कहा करते
verses.wordMeaning: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थमयं तीर्थं शूलभेदं जनेश्वर । श्रुते यस्य प्रभावे तु मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrthaṃ śūlabhedaṃ janeśvara / śrute yasya prabhāve tu mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: हैं ।२२९-२३०। आप ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैक्षय, शूद्र अन्यान्यव्र्ण, मेघसंग विश्वस्तनितगर्जित, संवत्सर, ऋतु, मास, मासार्ड, कला, काष्ठा, निमेष, नक्षत्र, युग, ग्रह, वृषककुद, गिरिशिखर, भूृगों के मध्यसिह, पक्षियों के बीच गरुड़, सर्प में अनन्त, समुद्रों में क्षीससागर, यन्त्रों में धनुष् हैं ।२२१-२ ३४१ प्रहरणों में बज, त्नतों में सत्य, इच्छा, हेष, राग मोह, क्षाम, दम, शम, व्यवसाय, धृति, लोभ, काम, क्रोध, जय, अजय, गदी, शरी, चापी. खट्वाड्री भुभरी; छेत्ता, भेत्ता, प्रहर्ता, नेता, अन्तक दश लक्षण संयुक्त धर्म, अर्थ, काम, इन्द्र, समुद्र, सरित्, पल्वल, सर लतावली, तृण, ओषधि, मृग, पक्षी, द्रव्य, कर्म, गरुणारम्भ, कालपुष्प, फलश्रद, आदि, अन्त, मध्य, गायत्री, ओंकार, हरित, लोहित, कृष्ण, नील, पीत, अरुण हैं ।२३५-२४०। आप कहर, कपिल,
verses.wordMeaning: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: शूलभेदं मया तात संक्षेपात् कथितं तव । यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: śūlabhedaṃ mayā tāta saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ tava / yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: चित्रभानु, भानु होत्र, होता, होम, हुत, प्रहुत, भ्रभु, सुपर्ण, ब्रह्मा, शतरुद्रिय, पवित्रों में पवित्र, मद्लों में
verses.wordMeaning: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole continent is prosperous with wealth, food- grams, and other artzcles and abodes of human beings spread a aiound. This is the abode of pious persons. Thus the natural characteristics of Ketumala have been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शूलभेदप्रशंसावर्णनं नाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ४५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: एष एव पुरा प्रश्नः परिपृष्टो महेश्वरम् । राज्ञा चोत्तानपादेन ऋषिदेवसमागमे
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|| rkv adhyāya 45 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: eṣa eva purā praśnaḥ paripṛṣṭo maheśvaram / rājñā cottānapādena ṛṣidevasamāgame
verses.translation: O holy lord, the two continents in the east and the west have been narrated to us. Now tell us about the people dwelling in the northern and southern continents as well as those on the mountains. South of the Sveta mountain and north of the Nila, there is a sub-continent called Ramanaka 1 where human beings are born. Animals (thereof) fulfill desires in all seasons. People are free from the stink of old age (They do not become senile or decrepit). They are a good-looking people descended from a noble, fair-complexioned race.
verses.hindi: + इदमर्ध नास्ति ख. पुस्तके ।. “धनुदिचन्नान्तगंतप्रन्थो ख. पुस्तके नास्ति सुपर्ण च तथा ब्रह्म यजूषां शतरुद्वियम् । पवित्राणां पवित्र च मद्भलानां च मड़भलम्
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, the two continents in the east and the west have been narrated to us. Now tell us about the people dwelling in the northern and southern continents as well as those on the mountains. South of the Sveta mountain and north of the Nila,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, the two continents in the east and the west have been narrated to us. Now tell us about the people dwelling in the northern and southern continents as well as those on the mountains. South of the Sveta mountain and north of the Nila,…

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपाद उवाच: इदं तीर्थं महापुण्यं सर्वदेवमयं परम् । गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं स्थानं न दृष्टं न श्रुतं हर
verses.transliteration: uttānapāda uvāca: idaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ param / guhyādguhyataraṃ sthānaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ hara
verses.translation: There is a great divine Nyagrodha tree (the Indian fig tree) called Rohina. The people subsist on the juice of its fruit. Those excellent people are always delightful and happy. They live for eleven thousand five hundred years. To the north of the Sveta and to the south of the moun¬ tain called Sriigavan, there is a sub-continent called Hiranyata 2 {Hiranvat in A) where a river Hairanyatl (Hairanvati in A) flows.
verses.hindi: प्राणो5पानः समानश्र उदानो व्यान एवं च। उन्सेषश्चेव मेषश्न तथा जुस्भितमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: There is a great divine Nyagrodha tree (the Indian fig tree) called Rohina. The people subsist on the juice of its fruit. Those excellent people are always delightful and happy. They live for eleven thousand five hundred years.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a great divine Nyagrodha tree (the Indian fig tree) called Rohina. The people subsist on the juice of its fruit. Those excellent people are always delightful and happy. They live for eleven thousand five hundred years.…

verses.sanskrit: शूलभेदं कथं जातं केनैवोत्पादितं पुरा । माहात्म्यं तस्य तीर्थस्य विस्तराच्छंस मे प्रभो
verses.transliteration: śūlabhedaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ kenaivotpāditaṃ purā / māhātmyaṃ tasya tīrthasya vistarācchaṃsa me prabho
verses.translation: Identified with ancient Sogdiana (AGP 8S-84). This Varsa is closely associated with the river Hiranvati (mod. Zarafshan). Both forms of the name mean 'possessor or scatterer of gold*. Due to its association with this river, this Varsa must be presumed to be adjacent to Sogdiana—AGP 84-85. Very strong and brilliant men are born there who are Sattvic in quality, bestowcr of desires in all seasons. They are rich and comely in appearance.
verses.hindi: लोहिताइगो गदी दंष्ट्री महावक्‍त्रो महोदरः  शुचिरोमा हरिछ्मश्रुरूध्वंकेशस्न्रिलोचन: २४७ गोतवादित्रन॒त्याइगो गीतवादनकप्रियः । मत्स्यो जली जलो जल्यो जबः काल: कली कल: निकालश्व सुकालश्न दुष्काल: कालनाशन:। मृत्युश्चेव क्षयोडन्तश्व क्षमापायकरों हर: ३२४९६ संवर्तकोउन्तकश्चेब संवतंकबलाहकौ । वटो घटोको घण्टीको चूडालोलबलो बली (२५० ब्रह्मकालो 5ग्निवक़श्न दण्डी सुण्डी च दण्डधुक् । चतुयुगश्नतुवेदर्श्नतुहत्रिश्वतुष्पथः २५१ चतुराश्रमवेत्ता च चातुर्वण्यंकरश्व ह। क्षराक्षरप्रियों धर्तो्गण्यो5्गप्यगणाधिप: २५२

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: आसीत्पुरा महावीर्यो दानवो बलदर्पितः । मर्त्ये न तादृशः कश्चिद् विक्रमेण बलेन वा
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: āsītpurā mahāvīryo dānavo baladarpitaḥ / martye na tādṛśaḥ kaścid vikrameṇa balena vā
verses.translation: These people of unlimited splendour live upto twelve thousand five hundred years. In that country there is the great Lakuca tree (Bread¬ fruit tree) yielding six tastes. Men maintain themselves on the juice of its fruits. There the Spigavan mountain has three great and lofty peaks. Out of them one is full (lit. consists) of diamonds, the second, of gold and the third, full of all kinds of precious stones. They are embellished with mansions.
verses.hindi: भगनेत्रान्तकश्चन्द्र: पृष्णो दन्‍्तविनाशनः । + स्वाहा स्वधा वषद्कार बमस्कार नमोःस्तु ते ॥
verses.wordMeaning: These people of unlimited splendour live upto twelve thousand five hundred years. In that country there is the great Lakuca tree (Bread¬ fruit tree) yielding six tastes. Men maintain themselves on the juice of its fruits.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These people of unlimited splendour live upto twelve thousand five hundred years. In that country there is the great Lakuca tree (Bread¬ fruit tree) yielding six tastes. Men maintain themselves on the juice of its fruits.…

verses.sanskrit: सूनुर् ब्रह्मसुतस्यायम् अन्धको नाम दुर्मदः । निजस्थाने वसन् पापः कुर्वन् राज्यम् अकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: sūnur brahmasutasyāyam andhako nāma durmadaḥ / nijasthāne vasan pāpaḥ kurvan rājyam akaṇṭakam
verses.translation: On the southern shore of the northern sea is the holy country of the Kurus 1 which is resorted to by the Siddhas. The trees there provide sweet fruits and flowers throughout the year. They put forth clothes and ornaments along with fruits. Many are the charming trees that bear fruits desired by all. They exude excellent honey of exquisite taste, colour and fragrance.
verses.hindi: तपो ब्रह्म च॒ सत्यं च ब्रह्मचयंमथा55जंबम् । भुतात्मा भूतकृद्भुतो घ्रतभव्थभवो-दू वः मड़ूल, गिरि, स्तोक, वृक्ष, जीव, पुद्ुल, सत्त्व, रज, तम, प्रजन हैं ।२४१-२४५। आप प्राण, अपान, समान,
verses.wordMeaning: On the southern shore of the northern sea is the holy country of the Kurus 1 which is resorted to by the Siddhas. The trees there provide sweet fruits and flowers throughout the year. They put forth clothes and ornaments along with fruits.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the southern shore of the northern sea is the holy country of the Kurus 1 which is resorted to by the Siddhas. The trees there provide sweet fruits and flowers throughout the year. They put forth clothes and ornaments along with fruits.…

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टपुष्टो वसन् मर्त्ये स सुरैर्नाभिभूयते । भवनं तस्य पापस्य वह्नेरुपवनं यथा
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭapuṣṭo vasan martye sa surairnābhibhūyate / bhavanaṃ tasya pāpasya vahnerupavanaṃ yathā
verses.translation: There are other charming trees called ICsirin. They always yield milk like nectar yet presenting six types of tastes. The entire ground is full of jewels, even the fine sand being gold which is pleasant to touch. It is auspicious, free from impurities and thorns. Descending from the world of Devas, people are born as auspicious men. They are born in fair complcxioned families and have perpetual youth.
verses.hindi: ऊध्वंकेश, जिलोचन ग्रीलवादित्रनुत्याजु, गीतवादनक्प्रिय, मत्स्य, जली, जल, जल्य, जब, काल, कली कल, निकाल, सुकाल, दुष्काल, कालनाशन, सृत्यु, क्षय, अन्त, क्षमापायकर, हर, संवर्तक, अन्तक, संवतंक, वलाहक, वट, घटिक, घटण्टीक, चूड़ाल, बल, बली, हैं ।२४६-२५०। आप ब्रह्मकाल, अग्निवक्र, दण्डी, मुण्डी, दण्डधुक्, चतुर्यूग, चतुवेद, चतुहोंत्र, चतुष्पण, चतुराश्रमवेत्ता, चातुव॑ष्यंकर, क्षराक्षरत्रिय, धूतं, अगण्य, अगरण्यगणाधिप,
verses.wordMeaning: There are other charming trees called ICsirin. They always yield milk like nectar yet presenting six types of tastes. The entire ground is full of jewels, even the fine sand being gold which is pleasant to touch. It is auspicious, free from impurities and thorns.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other charming trees called ICsirin. They always yield milk like nectar yet presenting six types of tastes. The entire ground is full of jewels, even the fine sand being gold which is pleasant to touch. It is auspicious, free from impurities and thorns.…

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्धकः काले चिन्तयामास भारत । तोषयामि महादेवं येन सानुग्रहो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: etasminn andhakaḥ kāle cintayāmāsa bhārata / toṣayāmi mahādevaṃ yena sānugraho bhavet
verses.translation: The charming women give birth to twins who imbibe the nectarine juice of the Ksirin (milk-yielding) tree. The twins are born simultaneously and grow up to- They have great vigour and vitality. They live upto fourteen thousand five hundred years. They never lesortto others' women.

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थयामि वरं दिव्यं यो मे मनसि वर्तते । परं स निश्चयं कृत्वा सो ऽन्धको निर्गतो गृहात्
verses.transliteration: prārthayāmi varaṃ divyaṃ yo me manasi vartate / paraṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā so 'ndhako nirgato gṛhāt
verses.translation: North of Jarudhi, the king of mountains, are the north¬ ern Kurus. 1 he land is glorified in all directions. Now listen to its detailed description. There are two lofty Kula-Parvatas, Candrakanta and Suiyakanta. 1 They arc embellished by many caves, crevasses, cavities and rivulets; they possess many bushes and hedges.' They arc decorated with minerals of various colours. They con¬ tain many kinds of metals; they are adorned with all kinds of mineral ores. They have trees with perpetual fruits, flowers and roots; they are resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas. The whole of that country is pervaded by hundreds of their peaks and ridges. The great river Bhadrasoma 2 flows in between the two mountains, Candrakanta and Suryakanta.
verses.hindi: -+इदमध नास्ति क. पुस्तके ।

verses.transliteration: revātaṭaṃ samāsādya dānavastapasi sthitaḥ / ugraṃ tapaścacārāsau dāruṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: There are thousands of other rivers with pure and tasty water, sufficient for the Kuru people for drinking. Similarly there are thousands of great rivers flowing with milk, honey, butter and the intoxicant beverage Maireya. There are hundreds of pools full of curds. There is a huge mountain rich in tasty food, nectarine, ripe fruits of diffe¬ rent kinds.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मावर्त सुरावरत कामावर्त नमोउस्तु ते । कासबिस्बनिहर्ता च कणिकाररजःप्रियः २५८ हिरण्यगर्भ: शक्ुनिर्महोदधिः परो विराटू । अधर्महा महादण्डो दण्डधारो रणप्रियः २६० गौतमो गोप्रतारश्व गोवुयेश्वरवाहनः । “धर्मकृठ्ठमंस्रष्टा च॒ धर्मो धर्मविदोत्तम:

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं स निराहारो ऽभवत् ततः । द्वितीयं तु सहस्रं स न्यवसद्वारिभोजनः
verses.transliteration: divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ sa nirāhāro 'bhavat tataḥ / dvitīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ sa nyavasadvāribhojanaḥ
verses.translation: There are roots and fruits of sweet fragrance, taste and colour. Their fragrance can be smelt from a distance of five Yojanas. There are thousands of flowers of different colours and shapes, large, pleasant and conducive to welfare. There are forests ofTamala, Aguru and sandal-wood pleasant to touch and rich in fragrance, colour and taste.
verses.hindi: तत्लोक्यगोप्ता गोविन्दो मानदों मान एवं च्। तिष्ठंस्थिरश्व स्थाणुश्र निष्कम्प: कम्प एव च
verses.wordMeaning: There are roots and fruits of sweet fragrance, taste and colour. Their fragrance can be smelt from a distance of five Yojanas. There are thousands of flowers of different colours and shapes, large, pleasant and conducive to welfare. There are forests ofTamala,…

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं तु सहस्रं स धूमपानरतो ऽभवत् । चतुर्थं वर्षसाहस्रं योगाभ्यासेन संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ sa dhūmapānarato 'bhavat / caturthaṃ varṣasāhasraṃ yogābhyāsena saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: The forests are in full bloom. Bees hum and hover round. The forests abound in pleasant trees, hedges and creepers. O excellent Brahmana, there are thousands of lakes abounding in lotuses and lilies wherein bees Hum and birds chirp. Identified with mod. Tarbagatai and Jingar—Ala Tau mountains.
verses.hindi: सह्यो यज्ञों घुगव्याधों व्याधीनामाकरोकरः । शिखण्डो पुण्डरीकाक्षः पुण्डरीकावलोकन:. बृषभश्चेव विख्यातो लोकानां लोकसत्कृतः:। चन्द्रादित्यो चश्नुबी ते हृदयं च पितामह ॥

verses.sanskrit: कोपीह नेदृश चक्रे तपः परमदारुणम् । अस्थिचर्मावशेषो ऽसौ यावत्तिष्ठति भारत
verses.transliteration: kopīha nedṛśa cakre tapaḥ paramadāruṇam / asthicarmāvaśeṣo 'sau yāvattiṣṭhati bhārata
verses.translation: Mod. Irtysh river. There are many charming grounds of sports afford¬ ing pleasure in all the seasons. There foodstuffs, garlands, un¬ guents, beds, seats and other articles of enjoyment are ever available. Birds of beautiful shape and variegated colours chirp there.
verses.hindi: अग्निरापस्तथा देवो धर्मकमप्रसाधित:

verses.sanskrit: तस्य मूर्ध्नि ततो राजन् धूमवार्त्तिर् विनिःसृता । देवलोकमतीत्यासौ कैलासं व्याप्य संस्थिता
verses.transliteration: tasya mūrdhni tato rājan dhūmavārttir viniḥsṛtā / devalokamatītyāsau kailāsaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitā
verses.translation: The grounds of sports are flourishing and richly em¬ bellished in gold and jewels. There are bowers and grottos of plantain and other trees as well as rocks. There are thousands of bowers of creepers all around They are very pleasant. There are hundreds of underground houses as lustrous and pure as conch shells. The windows are made of gold adorned with a net¬ work of diamonds. They are very large and of various sizes with wonderful workmanship in gold and gems.

verses.sanskrit: तावद्देवसमीपस्था उमा वचनम् अब्रवीत् । को ऽस्त्ययं मानुषे लोके तपसोग्रेण संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: tāvaddevasamīpasthā umā vacanam abravīt / ko 'styayaṃ mānuṣe loke tapasogreṇa saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: There are thousands of excellent trees. The clothes are of various shapes (and fashions). They are of fine texture and very pleasant (to the sight). There are various musical instruments like Mrdanga, Venn, flute, Panava which are widely used. There are hundreds and thousands ofKalpa trees bearing fruits.
verses.hindi: महोदधि, पर विराद, अधर्महा, महादण्ड, दण्डघार, रणप्रिय हैं ।२१५४-२६०॥ आप गौतम, गोभ्रतार, गोवुषेश्वरवाहन, धर्मकृत्, धर्म्रष्ठा, धर्म, धर्ंविद, उत्तम, त्रेलोक्यगरोषप्ता, गोविन्द, मानद, मान, तिष्ठन्,

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्वर्षसहस्राणि व्यतीयुः परमेश्वर । न केनापीदृशं तप्तं तपो दृष्टं श्रुतं तथा
verses.transliteration: caturvarṣasahasrāṇi vyatīyuḥ parameśvara / na kenāpīdṛśaṃ taptaṃ tapo dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ tathā
verses.translation: There are parks of that description everywhere and so They never grow old. They have perpetual youth. They are fond, affectionate and comely in appearance. They live upto many thousand years. They do not procreate nor do they decline in numbers. Pairs arc born of the tree unlike each other but befitting each other.
verses.hindi: दशशादूव शमन, शीतो््ण, दुजं रा, तृटू, आधि, व्याधि, व्याधिहा, व्याधिग, सह्य, यज्ञ, मृग-व्याध, व्याधि- आकर, अकर, शिखण्डी, पुण्डरीकाक्ष, पुण्डरीकाव-लोकन हैं ।२६१-२६५। आप दण्डधर, सदण्ड, दण्ड-मुण्ड--- विज्यात, वृषभ और लोकसत्कृत हैं। चन्द्र और आदित्य आपके नयन हैं तथा पितामह आपका हुदय हैं ।२६६-२६७१। अग्नि, जल, देव, क्रमंकर्म-असाधित हैं। ब्रह्मा, गोविन्द, पुराण और ऋषि आदि आपके
verses.wordMeaning: There are parks of that description everywhere and so They never grow old. They have perpetual youth. They are fond, affectionate and comely in appearance. They live upto many thousand years. They do not procreate nor do they decline in numbers.…

verses.sanskrit: अवज्ञां कुरुषे देव किमत्र नियमान्विते । सर्वस्य दत्से शीघ्रं त्वमल्पेन तपसा विभो
verses.transliteration: avajñāṃ kuruṣe deva kimatra niyamānvite / sarvasya datse śīghraṃ tvamalpena tapasā vibho
verses.translation: The riches arc common to all. They do not have the sense of possession. There is no virtue, no vice, no sickness, no old age, no mental confusion, no feeling of exhaustion. On completing their full length of time, they disappear like bubbles of water. They are extremely happy, devoid of all miseries. Be¬ ing passionately attached, they do not observe (the restrictions of) Dharma. For Dharma grows from misery.
verses.hindi: इंदमर्थ नास्ति ख. ग॒. घ. पुस्तकेषु ।
verses.wordMeaning: The riches arc common to all. They do not have the sense of possession. There is no virtue, no vice, no sickness, no old age, no mental confusion, no feeling of exhaustion. On completing their full length of time, they disappear like bubbles of water. They are extremely happy,…

verses.sanskrit: नाक्षक्रीडां करिष्ये ऽद्य त्वया सह महेश्वर । यावन्नोत्थाप्यते ह्येष दानवो भक्तवत्सल
verses.transliteration: nākṣakrīḍāṃ kariṣye 'dya tvayā saha maheśvara / yāvannotthāpyate hyeṣa dānavo bhaktavatsala
verses.translation: To the southern side of Northern Kurus, there is the famous country called Candradvipa 1 shaped like the disc of the moon. It is at a distance of five thousand Yojanas beyond the region of gods. (Being a seaside land) it is ever decorated with garlands of sea waves and is resonant with many sounds. It extends to one thousand Yojanas in area and is full of fruits and flowers. It is fertile and flourishing. It is one hundred Yojanas in breadth and so much in height. There is an excellent mountain Kumudaprabha in its centre, inhabited by Siddhas and Garanas. It has various gems equal in lustre to the moon. These have all good traits and shine in their lunar shape. There are lilies of diverse colours, parks and gardens of variegated hues. There are many rivulets and caves. It is deco¬ rated with great ridges, precipices,.crevasses and bushy hedges. The excellent river of many waves, Candravarta flows from this mountain. It is full of pure and holy water, bright like the moon's rays.
verses.hindi: न ब्रह्मा न च गोविंद: पुराणऋषयो न च। माहात्म्यं वेदितुं शक्ता याथातथ्येन ते शिव रक्ष मां रक्षणीयो5हूँ तवानघ नमोउस्तुते। भक्तानुकम्पी भगवान्भक्तश्नाहं सदा त्वयि
verses.wordMeaning: To the southern side of Northern Kurus, there is the famous country called Candradvipa 1 shaped like the disc of the moon. It is at a distance of five thousand Yojanas beyond the region of gods.…
verses.commentary: Sense: To the southern side of Northern Kurus, there is the famous country called Candradvipa 1 shaped like the disc of the moon. It is at a distance of five thousand Yojanas beyond the region of gods.…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: साधु साधु महादेवि सर्वलक्षणलक्षिते । अहं तं न विजानामि क्लिश्यन्तं दानवेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: sādhu sādhu mahādevi sarvalakṣaṇalakṣite / ahaṃ taṃ na vijānāmi kliśyantaṃ dānaveśvaram
verses.translation: There is the excellent abode of the moon, the lord of stars. The moon, the lord of planets, always resides there. There is a famous mountain known by the'name of the moon. The great land called Candradvipa is famous both in this world as well as in heaven.
verses.hindi: यः सह्खाण्यनेकानि पुंसामाहत्य दुदंशः । तिष्ठत्येकः समुद्रान्ते स में गोप्ताउस्तु नित्यशः.
verses.wordMeaning: There is the excellent abode of the moon, the lord of stars. The moon, the lord of planets, always resides there. There is a famous mountain known by the'name of the moon. The great land called Candradvipa is famous both in this world as well as in heaven.
