verses.sanskrit: योगाभ्यासे स्थितो भद्रे ध्यायंस्तत्परमं पदम् । तत्रागच्छ मया सार्द्धं यत्र तप्यत्यसौ तपः
verses.transliteration: yogābhyāse sthito bhadre dhyāyaṃstatparamaṃ padam / tatrāgaccha mayā sārddhaṃ yatra tapyatyasau tapaḥ
verses.translation: The Tuva region in southern Siberia where the river Yenisi flows. All the people here shine like the moon. They resemble the moon, with their faces shining like the moon. They are free from dirt and consider the moon their deity. The people there, are very virtuous, gentle, truthful and brilliant. Their conduct is good and their span of life ex¬ tends to a thousand years.
verses.hindi: ये समुद्र नदीदुर्गं पवतेषु गुहासु च। वक्षसुलेषु गोष्ठेषु कान्तारगहनेषु व .. माहात्म्य को 'ठीक तरह से नहीं जान पाते हैं। है शिब ! आपकी जो सूक्ष्म पूतियाँ हैं वे हमारे दृष्टिपथ में नहीं आती हैं। उनसे आप हमारी सदा रक्षा उसी प्रकार करें, जिस प्रकार कि, पिता अपने औरस पुत्र की रक्षा करता है ।7६८-२७०। अनघ ! हमारी रक्षा करें। हम सदा रक्षणीय हैं। आपको नमस्कार है। आप भक्तों पर दया करने वाले भगवान् हैँ और हम आपके भक्त हैं। आप हजारों पुरुषों को लेकर समुद्रगर्भ
verses.wordMeaning: The Tuva region in southern Siberia where the river Yenisi flows. All the people here shine like the moon. They resemble the moon, with their faces shining like the moon. They are free from dirt and consider the moon their deity. The people there, are very virtuous, gentle,…

They are free from dirt and consider the moon their deity. The people there, are very virtuous, gentle,…

verses.sanskrit: उमया सहितो देवो गतस्तत्र महेश्वरः । अस्थिचर्मावशेषस्तु दृष्टो देवेन शम्भुना
verses.transliteration: umayā sahito devo gatastatra maheśvaraḥ / asthicarmāvaśeṣastu dṛṣṭo devena śambhunā
verses.translation: To the west of this western continent is the land called Bhadrakara four thousand Yojanas from the ocean. It is a circular zone ten thousand Yojanas in diameter. It looks splendid with different kinds of flowers. The place is rich and abounds in foodgrains. It is ruled over by many kings. It is joyous, prosperous and beauti¬ ful on account of the great mountains.
verses.hindi: में एकान्त शयन करते हैं, ऐसे आप हमारे रक्षक हों। निद्राविहीन होकर निश्वास वायु को जीतने वाले सत्वस्थ समदर्शी योगिगण आपकी ज्योति को देखते हैं उसी योगात्मा को प्रणाम है ।३७१-२७३॥ जो प्रलय उपस्थित होने पर सब जीवों का भक्षण कर जल के मध्य स्थित होकर शयन करते हैं उन्हीं जलशायी को प्रणाम है। जो राहु के शरीर में प्रवेश कर रात को सोम का ग्रास करते हैं और स्वर्भानु एवं सोमारिन होकर
verses.wordMeaning: To the west of this western continent is the land called Bhadrakara four thousand Yojanas from the ocean. It is a circular zone ten thousand Yojanas in diameter. It looks splendid with different kinds of flowers. The place is rich and abounds in foodgrains.…
verses.commentary: Sense: To the west of this western continent is the land called Bhadrakara four thousand Yojanas from the ocean. It is a circular zone ten thousand Yojanas in diameter. It looks splendid with different kinds of flowers. The place is rich and abounds in foodgrains.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नो ऽसौ देवदेवो महेश्वरः । भोभोः कष्टं कृतं भीमं दारुणं लोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: pratyuvāca prasanno 'sau devadevo maheśvaraḥ / bhobhoḥ kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ bhīmaṃ dāruṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: There is a very splendid seat of Vayu there, embellish¬ ed with various jewels. There, the embodied form of Vayu is The natural traits of the Kurus have been precisely recounted. Now I shall mention the features of Bharata. 1 Understand them. O excellent Brahmanas, in the sacred centre to the south of the southern mountain Himavat, extending from east to west is the Bharata sub-continent. It behoves you to listen now to the details of the countries in the Bharata Varsa and of the people there.
verses.hindi: सूयं को निगलते हैं तथा जो अंगुष्ठ मात्र पुरुष देहधारियों की देह में रहते हैं, वे हमारी सदा रक्षा करें और हमें तृप्त करें ।१७४-२७६। जो अडगुष्ठमात्र पुरुष गर्भ से उत्पन्न हैं, स्वाहा और स्वधा उन्हें तृप्त करें, उनके लिये रुचिकर हों। जो देहस्थ होकर भी स्वयं नहीं रोते हैं, किन्तु प्राणियों को रुलाते हैं, स्वयं हृष्ट नहीं होते; किन्तु प्राणियों को प्रसन्न करते हैं, उन्हें नित्य प्रणाम है ।२७७-२७८। जो समुद्र में, नदी-दुर्ग में, पव॑त में, गुहा में, वृक्ष मूल में, गोष्ठ में, गहन कानन में, चतुष्पथ में, गली में, चबूतरे पर, सभा में, हाथी-घोड़ा-

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशं च तपो घोरं कस्माद्वत्स त्वया कृतम् । वरं दास्याम्यहं वत्स यस्ते मनसि वर्तते
verses.transliteration: īdṛśaṃ ca tapo ghoraṃ kasmādvatsa tvayā kṛtam / varaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ vatsa yaste manasi vartate
verses.translation: With its diverse features giving rise to auspicious and inauspicious results, this sub-continent is in the middle, to the north of the ocean and to the south of Himavat. Since the country ( Var$a ) is called Bharata the people are Bharatls. Since Manu ruled over the people, he is called Bharata. 2 Etymoligically derived thus the Varsa (country) is called Bharata.
verses.hindi: + धनुश्चिह्वास्तगंतग्रन्थ: क. ख. घ॒पुस्तकेष नाध्ति ।

verses.sanskrit: अन्धक उवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि मे देव वरदो यदि शङ्कर । सुरान् सर्वान् विजेष्यामि त्वत्प्रसादान् महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: andhaka uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva varado yadi śaṅkara / surān sarvān vijeṣyāmi tvatprasādān maheśvara
verses.translation: It is from here alone that one goes to heaven or attains salvation. 3 The middle course—heaven as well as the end, the final emancipation—is attained from here. Rituals for human beings are not ordained anywhere else on earth. There are stated to be nine divisions of this Bharata Varsa. 4 Being separated by oceans, they are mutually inacces¬ sible. The description of Bharata is repeated in other Puranas also e.g. A , Bd. 2.16, VP.II.3.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: स्वप्ने ऽपि त्रिदशाः सर्वे न योद्धव्याः कदाचन । असंभाव्यं न वक्तव्यं मनसो यन्न रोचते
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: svapne 'pi tridaśāḥ sarve na yoddhavyāḥ kadācana / asaṃbhāvyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ manaso yanna rocate
verses.translation: This etymological explanation of 'Bharata* attributing its credit to Manu who is called 'Bharata' due to his act of maintaining (and feeding) the people, supersedes the Jaina tradition which attributes it to Bharata, the Due to this special importance of Bharata, it is called Karma- umi.
verses.hindi: अथ वा मायया देव सोहितः सुक्ष्मया त्वया । एतस्मात्कारणाद्वाइपि तेन त्वं न निमन्त्रितः

verses.transliteration: anyaṃ kimapi yācasva yaste manasi vartate / svarge vā yadi vā martye pātāleṣu ca saṃsthitān
verses.translation: Cf. Mk. 5, Mt. 7-9. The names of the nine regional They are Indradvipa, Kaseru, Tamravarna, Gabha- stiman, Nagadvlpa, Saumya, Gandharva and Varuna. This Bharata, the ninth among them, is surrounded by the sea. From south to north it extends to a thousand Yojanas, from Kumar! to the source of Gaiiga. Sideways in the north it extends to nine thousand Yojanas. On the eastern boundary are Kiratas and Yavanas at the western boundary.
verses.hindi: प्रसोद मम देवेश त्वमेव शरणं मम । त्वं गतिस्त्वं प्रतिष्ठा च न चान्याइस्ति न मे गतिः . स्तुत्वेव स महादेव॑ विरराम प्रजापति:। भगवानपि सुप्रीतः पुनर्दक्षमभाषत

verses.sanskrit: मर्त्येषु विविधान् भोगान् भोक्ष्यसि त्वं यथेप्सितान् । कुरु निष्कण्टकं राज्यं स्वर्गे देवपतिर्यथा
verses.transliteration: martyeṣu vividhān bhogān bhokṣyasi tvaṃ yathepsitān / kuru niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ svarge devapatiryathā
verses.translation: Within it dwell Brahmanas, Ksattriyas and Vaisyas attending to sacrifices, war and trade respectively. The Sudras live in different parts. There are mutual dealings among these based on virtue, wealth and love. The different castes are engaged in their own functions.
verses.hindi: अथनमब्रवीद्वाक्य त्रलोक्याधिपतिभंवः । कृत्वाउएश्वासकरं वाक्य वाक्यज्ञों वाक्यमाहतम
verses.wordMeaning: Within it dwell Brahmanas, Ksattriyas and Vaisyas attending to sacrifices, war and trade respectively. The Sudras live in different parts. There are mutual dealings among these based on virtue, wealth and love. The different castes are engaged in their own functions.

verses.sanskrit: देवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा सो ऽन्धको विमनाः स्थितः । वृथा क्लेशश्च मे जातो न किंचित् साधितं मया
verses.transliteration: devasya vacanaṃ śrutvā so 'ndhako vimanāḥ sthitaḥ / vṛthā kleśaśca me jāto na kiṃcit sādhitaṃ mayā
verses.translation: People perform the duties of the five stages of life, the fifth being that of Saiikalpa. They possess the human tendency to endeavour to attain heaven and salvation. He who conquers this ninth Dvlpa entirely, along with the countries extending sideways, is declared an emperor ( Samraf ). He who conquers this world is remembered as Samrat, the conquerer of Antariksa as Viriit, while the conquerer of the other world is called Soaraf 1. I shall explain this later on.
verses.hindi: दक्ष दक्ष न कतंव्यों मन्युविध्नमिमं प्रति । अहूं यज्ञहा न त्वन्यों दृश्यते तत्पुरा त्वया भुयश्व तं वरमिमं मत्तो गह्लीष्व सुब्रत । प्रसन्नवदनों भुत्वा त्वमेकाग्रमनाः शूणु २६१ अश्वमेधसहस्नस्थ वाजपेयशतस्थ च् । प्रजापते मत्प्रसादात्फलभागी भविष्यसि
verses.wordMeaning: People perform the duties of the five stages of life, the fifth being that of Saiikalpa. They possess the human tendency to endeavour to attain heaven and salvation. He who conquers this ninth Dvlpa entirely, along with the countries extending sideways,…

verses.sanskrit: निश्वासं परमं मुक्त्वा निपपात धरातले । मूलच्छिन्नो यथा वृक्षो निरुच्छ्वासस् तदाभवत्
verses.transliteration: niśvāsaṃ paramaṃ muktvā nipapāta dharātale / mūlacchinno yathā vṛkṣo nirucchvāsas tadābhavat
verses.translation: There are seven great mountain systems with excellent knot-like ridges in this Varsa. They are Mahendra, Malaya, There are other thousands of mountains adjacent to these. They are endowed with all qualities, and have broad and variegated summits.
verses.hindi: रथ आदि के निवासस्थान में, पुरानी वाटिका और भवनों में, पंच-त्त्वों में, भूतों में, दिशा विदिशा में, चन्द्र- सूर्य की रष्मि में, रसातल में और इन स्थानों के आ तिक्त भी अवस्थित हैं, वे युक्ष्म, स्थूल, कृश, हस्व आदि सब आप ही हैं। आपको बारम्बार नमस्कार है ।२७६-२८३। है देव ! आप सब हैं, सवंग हैं, सर्वेभूतपति हैं और सब जीवों के अन्तरात्मा हैं, इसी से हमने आपको निमन्त्रित नहीं किया । विविध दक्षिणावले यज्ञ

verses.sanskrit: मूर्च्छापन्नं ततो दृष्ट्वा देवी वचनम् अब्रवीत् । यं कामं कामयत्येष तमस्मै देहि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: mūrcchāpannaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā devī vacanam abravīt / yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayatyeṣa tamasmai dehi śaṅkara
verses.translation: The chief of them 2 are the excellent mountain Mandara, Vaihara, Dardura, Kolahala, Surasa, Mainaka, Vai- dyuta, Patandhama, Pandura, Gantuprastha, Krsnagiri, God- hana, Puspagiri, Ujjayanta, Raivataka, Sriparvata, Karu and Kutasaila. There are other smaller mountains with thin popula¬ tion. The land strips between them have a mixed population consisting of Aryas and Mlecchas. The rivers rising from the foot of Himavat, 3 of which those people drink the water are: Ganga, Sindhu, Sarasvad, Satadru, Candrabhaga, Yamuna, Sarayu, Iravati, Vitasta, Vipasa, Devika, Kuhu,Gomati, Dhutapapa, Bahuda, Drsadvati, KausikI, Trtiya, Nisclra, Gandaki, Iksu and Lohita.

verses.hindi: रे६... वायुपुराणम् वेदान्षडड्भानुद्धत्य सांख्यान्योगांश्व कृत्स्नशः । तपश्च विपुल तप्त्वा दुःश्वरं देवदानज: ॥२€६३ अर्थेदंशार्धसंयुक्तेर्गूढमप्राज्निभितम् । वर्णाश्रमकरतैधेर्मे विषरोत॑ क्वचित्समम्

verses.sanskrit: उच्चत्वमाप्तो देवेशि अन्यानपि सुरासुरान्
verses.transliteration: uccatvamāpto deveśi anyānapi surāsurān
verses.translation: The rivers of the southern land rising from the slopes The rivers issuing from the Malaya mountains 1 are Krtamala, Tamravarna, Puspajatl and Utpalavatl. All of them arc very splendid. Their waters are very cool.
verses.hindi: श्रत्यथेरध्यवसितं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम् । सर्वेषासाश्रमाणां तु सया पाशुपत॑ त्रतम् ॥

verses.commentary: Sense: The rivers of the southern land rising from the slopes The rivers issuing from the Malaya mountains 1 are Krtamala, Tamravarna, Puspajatl and Utpalavatl. All of them arc very splendid. Their waters are very cool.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच: कमप्युपायमाश्रित्य उत्थापय महेश्वर । विष्णुवर्जं सुरान्सर्वाञ्जयस्वेति वरं वद
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca: kamapyupāyamāśritya utthāpaya maheśvara / viṣṇuvarjaṃ surānsarvāñjayasveti varaṃ vada
verses.translation: The rivers originating from Mahendra mountains 2 are Trisama, Rtukulya, Iksula, Tridiva, Langulini and Vamsa- dhara. Tne rivers issuing from the mountain Suktiman 3 are Rsika, Sukumari, Mandaga, Mandavahini, Kupa and Palasiiu. All of them are sacred like Sarasvatl. All of them flowing into the sea are (holy like) Ganga. These are the mothers of the world and are declared as removers of the sins of the world.
verses.hindi: उत्पादितं शुभ दक्ष स्वंपापविभोक्षणम् द ॥२€५ अस्य चोर्णस्य यत्सम्यक्फलं भवति पुष्कलम्। तदस्तु ते महाभाग मानसस्त्यज्यतां ज्वरः. एवमुक्त्वा महादेव: सपत्नीकः सहानुग: । अदर्शनमनृप्राप्तोी दक्षस्यासितविक्रमः ३२६७ अवाष्य च तदा भाग यथोक्‍तं ब्रह्मणा भव: । ज्वरं च सर्वधमंज्ञों बहुआा व्यभजत्तदा ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: The rivers originating from Mahendra mountains 2 are Trisama, Rtukulya, Iksula, Tridiva, Langulini and Vamsa- dhara. Tne rivers issuing from the mountain Suktiman 3 are Rsika, Sukumari, Mandaga, Mandavahini, Kupa and Palasiiu. All of them are sacred like Sarasvatl.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The rivers originating from Mahendra mountains 2 are Trisama, Rtukulya, Iksula, Tridiva, Langulini and Vamsa- dhara. Tne rivers issuing from the mountain Suktiman 3 are Rsika, Sukumari, Mandaga, Mandavahini, Kupa and Palasiiu. All of them are sacred like Sarasvatl.…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: उपायः शोभनो देवि यो मे मनसि वर्तते । तमेवास्मै प्रदास्यामि यस्त्वया कथितो वरः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: upāyaḥ śobhano devi yo me manasi vartate / tamevāsmai pradāsyāmi yastvayā kathito varaḥ
verses.translation: The modern names are bracketed: Modern names of these and explanatory remarks are siven in the brackets.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽमृतेन संसिक्तः स्वस्थो ऽभूत् तत्क्षणाद् अयम् । तथा पुनर्नवो जातः सर्वावयवशोभितः
verses.transliteration: tato 'mṛtena saṃsiktaḥ svastho 'bhūt tatkṣaṇād ayam / tathā punarnavo jātaḥ sarvāvayavaśobhitaḥ
verses.translation: Modern names of these rivers arc brackated. The branches and tributaries of these rivers are hundreds and thousands. The countries in Central Region (Madhyadesa) 1 are chiefly Kurupancalas, Salvas, Jahgalas, Surasenas, Bhadrakaras, Bodhas, Satapathesvaras, Vatsas, Kisasnas, Kulyas, Kuntalas, Kasikosalas, Tilahgas in the border- land, Magadhas and Vrkas. Now along the northern half of Saliva mountains where the river Godavari flows is the most delightful region within the whole of this earth.
verses.hindi: रन्श्रोद्युतं तथा5श्वानां शिखो:द्रदश्थ वहिणाम्। नेत्रराग: कोकिलानां ज्वरः प्रोक्तो सहात्मभि: अजानां पित्तभेदाश्च सर्वेबामिति नः श्रुतम् । शुकानामपि सर्वेषां हिमिका प्रोच्यते ज्वरः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Modern names of these rivers arc brackated. The branches and tributaries of these rivers are hundreds and thousands. The countries in Central Region (Madhyadesa) 1 are chiefly Kurupancalas, Salvas, Jahgalas, Surasenas, Bhadrakaras, Bodhas, Satapathesvaras, Vatsas, Kisasnas,…

verses.sanskrit: शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा गृहाण वरमुत्तमम् । विष्णुवर्जं प्रदास्यामि यत्तवाभिमतं प्रियम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā gṛhāṇa varamuttamam / viṣṇuvarjaṃ pradāsyāmi yattavābhimataṃ priyam
verses.translation: There is a heavenly city named Govardhana. 2 It was built by the king of Devas for Rama s spouse. Trees and herbs were planted by the sage Bharadvaja for the sake of Rama's spouse. He made this delightful wooded tract the private part of the palace. The colonies of Ksattriyas 3 are Vahlikas, Vadha- dhanas, Abhiras, Kalatoyakas, Aparitas, Sudras, Pahlavas,
verses.hindi: सौ वाजपेय यज्ञों के फलभागी होओगे ।२६३। दक्ष ! छवों अद्भों के साथ वेदों का उद्धार करके एवं पूर्ण, सांख्य-योग का उद्धार करके देव-दानवों से साथ बड़ी कठिन तपस्या करके, पाँच अर्थों से संयुक्त होने के कारण जो गूढ़ सामान्य जनों की समझ के बाहर है, वह वर्णाश्रमप्रतिपादक धर्म से कहीं विपरीत और कहीं अनुकूल है, वेदाभिप्राय से संपादित करके मैंने सभी आश्रमवासियों के लिये पशुपाण विमोचन पाशुपत ब्रत
verses.wordMeaning: There is a heavenly city named Govardhana. 2 It was built by the king of Devas for Rama s spouse. Trees and herbs were planted by the sage Bharadvaja for the sake of Rama's spouse. He made this delightful wooded tract the private part of the palace.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a heavenly city named Govardhana. 2 It was built by the king of Devas for Rama s spouse. Trees and herbs were planted by the sage Bharadvaja for the sake of Rama's spouse. He made this delightful wooded tract the private part of the palace.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं च सफलं तुभ्यं मा धर्मस्ते ऽन्यथा भवेत् । ददामीति वरं तुभ्यं मन्यसे यदि चासुर
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ ca saphalaṃ tubhyaṃ mā dharmaste 'nyathā bhavet / dadāmīti varaṃ tubhyaṃ manyase yadi cāsura
verses.translation: At the time of the final redaction of the Purana, the following parts of India were included in "Madhyadesa". These are originally the names of the tribes applied to the land where they were then settled: Now a village in Nasik district of Maharashtra. Formerly it was an important centre of learning. Brahraaijas coming from' that place formed a sub-caste 'Govardhana Brahmanas". It is mentioned sevei al times in the famous Nasik inscription of Usavadata (100 B.G.) (Epigraphica Indica VIII, ). Generally realms or countries are named after the names of tribes or peoples who colonise them. The identification of these realms is based on AGP p -147. D.G. Sircar's GAMI is also referred to and only the page no. is mentioned.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न किया है, जों शुभ और सभी पापों को नष्ट करने वाला है। इस ब्रत के करने से जो समीचीन फल होता है, उसका सम्पूर्ण फल तुम्हें हो। महाभाग ! तुम मानसिक संताप को छोड़ दो ।२६४-२६६। इस प्रकार कहकर अतिपराक्रमी महादेव अपनी पत्नी और अनुचरों के साथ दक्ष की आँखों से ओझल हो गये । उस समय ब्रह्मा द्वारा यथोक्त भाग को प्राप्त कर अखिल धर्मवेत्ता महादेव ने ज्वर को कई भागों में बिभक्त किया । ब्राह्मणों ! सब जीबों के शान्त्यथं उसे सुनिये ।१९७-२९९। नागों के लिये ज्ञीर्षाभिताप पवेतों के लिये शिलारोग, जल के लिये श॑वाल और साँपों के लिये केंचुल ज्वर समझना चाहिए । गौओं के लिये खुरका रोग, पृथ्वी के लिये ऊसर, हाथियों के लिये दृष्टि-व्याधात, घोड़ों के लिये रम्ध्रजनित रोग, मयूरों के लिये शिखा ( चन्द्रक ) विकाश का काल और कोकिलों के लिये नेत्नरोग महात्माओं के द्वाआ ज्वर कहा गया
verses.wordMeaning: At the time of the final redaction of the Purana, the following parts of India were included in "Madhyadesa". These are originally the names of the tribes applied to the land where they were then settled: Now a village in Nasik district of Maharashtra.…

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुवर्जं सुरान् सर्वाञ्जेष्यसि त्वं च मां विना
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuvarjaṃ surān sarvāñjeṣyasi tvaṃ ca māṃ vinā
verses.translation: Apagas, Alimadras, Tomaras, Harhsamargas, Kasmi- ras and Tahganas are the tribes of Kiratas. These along with Culikas, Ahukas and Purnadarvas are the northern peoples. Now hear from me the people in the East.
verses.hindi: है ।३००-३०२। है विप्रो ! हम लोगों ने सुना है कि, सब बकरों के लिये पित्तमेद और सब शुकों के लिये
verses.wordMeaning: Apagas, Alimadras, Tomaras, Harhsamargas, Kasmi- ras and Tahganas are the tribes of Kiratas. These along with Culikas, Ahukas and Purnadarvas are the northern peoples. Now hear from me the people in the East.

verses.transliteration: andhaka uvāca: bhavatvevam iti prāha balamāsthāya kevalam / viṣṇuvarjaṃ vijeṣye 'haṃ svabalena maheśvara
verses.translation: People in the east Andhravakas, Sujarakas, The ancient tribes and their locations from Eastern Indm are identified as follows: Now the other people who dwell in the southern region * 1 are: Pandyas,Keralas, Caulyas (Colas),Kulyas, Setukas,

verses.transliteration: kṛtārtho 'haṃ hi saṃjāta ityuktvā praṇatiṃ gataḥ / gaccha devomayāsārddhaṃ kailāsaśikharaṃ varam
verses.translation: The following identifications are based on De, (page no. indicated in notes) and Sircar (GAMI). Some identifications proposed:

verses.sanskrit: वृषपुंगवम् आरुह्य देवो ऽसावुमया सह । वरं दत्त्वा स तस्यैवं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: vṛṣapuṃgavam āruhya devo 'sāvumayā saha / varaṃ dattvā sa tasyaivaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: The Malavas=Though Malavas settled in Avanti (around Ujjain) finally and gave their name to the ancient Avanti desa, it is possible that they were in south Marwar (in Rajasthan) at the time of this Purana. Malavas, Karusas, Mekalas, Utkalas, Uttamarnas Dasarnas, Bhojas, KLiskindliakas, Tosalas, KoscilaSj Tiaipuras, Vaidikas, Tumuras, Tumburas, Satsuras, Nisadhas, Anupas, Tundikeras, Vitihotras, Avantis. These are the kingdoms on the Vindhya mountains. Now I shall mention mountainous territories. 1 These are: Nigarharas, Hamsamargas, Ksupanas, Tanganas, Khasas, Kusapravaranas, Hunas, Darvas, Hudakas, Trigartas, Malavas, Kiratas and Tamasas. The learned know of four ages in this Bharata, viz. Krta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali. I shall explain their natural features later.
verses.hindi: व्याधितो दुःखितो दीनश्रौरत्रस्तो भयादितः  राजकार्यनियुक्तो वा मुच्यते महतो भयात् अनेन चेव देहेन गणानां स गणाधिपः । इह लोके सुख प्राप्य गण एवोपपशते

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अन्धकवरप्रदानवर्णनं नाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ४६ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: स दानवो वरं लब्ध्वा जगाम स्वपुरं प्रति । ददर्श स्वपुरं राजञ्छोभितं चित्रचत्वरैः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe andhakavarapradānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 46 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sa dānavo varaṃ labdhvā jagāma svapuraṃ prati / dadarśa svapuraṃ rājañchobhitaṃ citracatvaraiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing this and desirous of hearing further, the delighted sages asked Lornaharsana:
verses.hindi: न च यक्षा: विशाचा वा न नागा न विनायका: । कुर्युविध्न॑ गृहे तस्य यत्र संस्तुयते भवः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this and desirous of hearing further, the delighted sages asked Lornaharsana:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this and desirous of hearing further, the delighted sages asked Lornaharsana:

verses.sanskrit: उद्यानैश्चैव विविधैः कदलीखण्डमण्डितैः । पनसैर्बकुलैश्चैवाम्रातैराम्रैश्च चम्पकैः
verses.transliteration: udyānaiścaiva vividhaiḥ kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ / panasairbakulaiścaivāmrātairāmraiśca campakaiḥ
verses.translation: The sub-continent of Bharata has been described by you. Now describe the Kimpurusa 1 and Hari Varsas. 2 Thus requested by the Brahmanas, Lornaharsana replied suitably this question as follows (lit. in the manner indicated in this Purana).
verses.hindi: शुणुयाद्वा इदं नारी सुभक्तद्ा ब्रह्मचारिणी । पितृभिभंतृ पक्षाभ्यां पुज्या भवति देववत् ३१२ शुणुयाद्वा इदं सर्व कीतंयेद्वाउप्पभीक्षणशः । तस्य सर्वाणि कार्याणि सिद्धि गच्छुन्त्यविध्नतः ७३१३ मनसा चिन्तितं यच्च यच्च वाचाःप्युदाहतम् । सर्व संपद्यते तस्थ स्तवनस्यानुकीतेनात् ॥ रे १४  छल /+ हट ज--फैफप-भनकहैहफ-फः।/थ,-।/पडपहह है ियण।णएए
verses.wordMeaning: The sub-continent of Bharata has been described by you. Now describe the Kimpurusa 1 and Hari Varsas. 2 Thus requested by the Brahmanas, Lornaharsana replied suitably this question as follows (lit. in the manner indicated in this Purana).
verses.commentary: Sense: The sub-continent of Bharata has been described by you. Now describe the Kimpurusa 1 and Hari Varsas. 2 Thus requested by the Brahmanas, Lornaharsana replied suitably this question as follows (lit. in the manner indicated in this Purana).

verses.sanskrit: अशोकैर्नालिकेरैश्च मातुलिङ्गैः सदाडिमैः । नानावृक्षैश्च शोभाढ्यं तडागैरुपशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: aśokairnālikeraiśca mātuliṅgaiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ / nānāvṛkṣaiśca śobhāḍhyaṃ taḍāgairupaśobhitam
verses.translation: Please listen, O Brahmanas, to what you are pleased to hear. In the Kimpurusa country, there is a big grove of Plaksa trees comparable to the Nandana forest.
verses.hindi: विभिका ज्वर है एवं इसी प्रकार सिंहों के लिये भी परिश्रम ज्वर कहा गया है ।३०३। स वेज्ञ ! मनुष्यों के लिये वह ज्वर नाम से कहा गया है, जो जन्म-मरणकाल में और बीच में भी मनुष्यों के शरीर में प्रवेश करता है । यह जो अत्थन्त कठोर ज्वर हैं, वह महेश्वर का तेज है; अतएवं यह ईश्वर ज्वर सब प्राणियों हारा माननीय और वन्दनीय है ।३०४-३०५। जो मनुष्य सुप्रसन्नचित्त से एकाग्र होकर इस ज्वरोत्पत्ति को सदा पढ़ता है,
verses.wordMeaning: Please listen, O Brahmanas, to what you are pleased to hear. In the Kimpurusa country, there is a big grove of Plaksa trees comparable to the Nandana forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Please listen, O Brahmanas, to what you are pleased to hear. In the Kimpurusa country, there is a big grove of Plaksa trees comparable to the Nandana forest.

verses.sanskrit: देवतायतनैर् दिव्यैर् ध्वजमालासुशोभितैः । वेदाध्ययननिर्घोषैर् मङ्गलाद्यैर् विनादितम्
verses.transliteration: devatāyatanair divyair dhvajamālāsuśobhitaiḥ / vedādhyayananirghoṣair maṅgalādyair vināditam
verses.translation: The span of life in the Kimpurusa land is said to be ten thousand years. The men are gold-complexioned and the women resemble Apsaras-s.
verses.hindi: वह रोग से छटकारा पाकर आनन्द लाभ करता है और अपनी अभिलषित कामना को प्राप्त करता है दक्ष द्वारा कहे गये स्तव को भी जो सुनता है या कहता है, उसका कोई अनिष्ट नहीं होता और वह दीर्घायु प्राप्त करता है। जैसे सब देवों में योगी महादेव श्रेष्ठ हैं, उसी प्रकार सतवों के बीच यह ब्रह्मानिर्मित स्तव श्रेष्ठ है ।३०७-३०८५। यश, राज्य, सुख, ऐश्वयं, धन, आयु, वित्त और विद्या की कामना करने वाले यत्नपूर्वक, भक्ति पूर्वक इस स्तोत्र का पाठ करें । जो पीड़ित, ढुंःखी, दीन, चोर से डरे हुए और राजकायं में नियुक्त हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: The span of life in the Kimpurusa land is said to be ten thousand years. The men are gold-complexioned and the women resemble Apsaras-s.
verses.commentary: Sense: The span of life in the Kimpurusa land is said to be ten thousand years. The men are gold-complexioned and the women resemble Apsaras-s.

verses.sanskrit: प्राविशद्भवने दिव्ये काञ्चने रुक्ममालिनि । अपश्यत्स सुतान् भार्याम् अमात्यान् दासभृत्यकान्
verses.transliteration: prāviśadbhavane divye kāñcane rukmamālini / apaśyatsa sutān bhāryām amātyān dāsabhṛtyakān
verses.translation: They do not suffer from ailments; they are devoid of sorrows; they are pure in mind; they possess the lustre of molten gold.
verses.hindi: वे बड़े भय से भी मुक्त हो जाते हैं ।३०६-३१०। इसी देह से वे गणों के बीच गणाधिप हो जाते हैं ओर इस लोक में सुख प्राप्त कर शिवगण हो जाते हैं। जिस घर में इस स्तव से महदेव की स्तुति होती है, वहाँ यक्ष, पिशाच, नाग और विनायक आदि कोई विन्न नहीं करते हैं, ब्रह्मचारिणी हो ऋर भक्ति श्रद्धा से जो स्त्री इस स्तबराज का श्रवण करती है, वह पितृकुल और भ्रातृकुल में देवता को तरह पूज्य होती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They do not suffer from ailments; they are devoid of sorrows; they are pure in mind; they possess the lustre of molten gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: They do not suffer from ailments; they are devoid of sorrows; they are pure in mind; they possess the lustre of molten gold.

verses.sanskrit: ततो जयप्रदान् सर्वान् इतश्चेतश्च धावतः । हृच्छोभां च प्रकुर्वाणान् वै जयन्तीभिरुच्चकैः
verses.transliteration: tato jayapradān sarvān itaścetaśca dhāvataḥ / hṛcchobhāṃ ca prakurvāṇān vai jayantībhiruccakaiḥ
verses.translation: In this holy country Kimpurusa, there is a fig tree exuding honey. All the inhabitants of Kimpurusa Varsa drink its excellent juice.
verses.hindi: जो इस सम्पूर्ण स्तोत्र का श्रवण करता है या बार-बार पाठ करता है, उसके सभी कार्य निविन्न रूप से शस््ृषध. वायुपु राणम्
verses.wordMeaning: In this holy country Kimpurusa, there is a fig tree exuding honey. All the inhabitants of Kimpurusa Varsa drink its excellent juice.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this holy country Kimpurusa, there is a fig tree exuding honey. All the inhabitants of Kimpurusa Varsa drink its excellent juice.

verses.sanskrit: केचित् तोरणम् आबध्य केचित् पुष्पाण्यवाकिरन् । मातुलिङ्गकराश्चान्ये धावन्ति ह्यन्धकं प्रति
verses.transliteration: kecit toraṇam ābadhya kecit puṣpāṇyavākiran / mātuliṅgakarāścānye dhāvanti hyandhakaṃ prati
verses.translation: Adjoining Kimpurusa, there is Harivarsa where the people are yellow as gold in complexion.
verses.hindi: देवस्प सगुहस्याथ देव्या नन्‍्दीश्वरस्य तु। बलि विभवतः क्ृत्वा दमेन नियमेन च
verses.wordMeaning: Adjoining Kimpurusa, there is Harivarsa where the people are yellow as gold in complexion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Adjoining Kimpurusa, there is Harivarsa where the people are yellow as gold in complexion.

verses.sanskrit: पुरे जनाश्च दृश्यन्ते भाजनैरन्नपूरितैः । पूर्णहस्ताः प्रदृश्यन्ते तत्रैव बहवो जनाः
verses.transliteration: pure janāśca dṛśyante bhājanairannapūritaiḥ / pūrṇahastāḥ pradṛśyante tatraiva bahavo janāḥ
verses.translation: All the people there are descended from Devaloka and
verses.hindi: ततः स शुल्को गृह्लीयान्नामान्याशु यथाक्रमम् । ईप्सितॉल्लभतेध्त्यर्थ कामान्भोगांश्व मानवः॥ सर्वकमंसु युक्तो वा युक्तो वा सर्वंपातक: । पठन्दक्षकृतं स्तोत्र स्बपापेः प्रमुच्यते ॥ क्‍ मृतभ्न गणसालोक्य॑ पुज्यमानः सुरासुरे:
verses.wordMeaning: All the people there are descended from Devaloka and
verses.commentary: Sense: All the people there are descended from Devaloka and

verses.sanskrit: साक्षतैर् भाजनैस् तत्र शतसाहस्रयोषितः । मन्त्रान् पठन्ति विप्राश्च मङ्गलान्यपि योषितः
verses.transliteration: sākṣatair bhājanais tatra śatasāhasrayoṣitaḥ / mantrān paṭhanti viprāśca maṅgalānyapi yoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Kimpuru§7 Var? a a mythical land-GAMI, ; Kimpurusa
verses.hindi: इत्याह भगवान्व्यासः पराशरसुतः प्रभु:ः। नतद्वेदयते कश्चिन्नेदं श्राव्यं तु कस्यचित्
verses.wordMeaning: Kimpuru§7 Var? a a mythical land-GAMI, ; Kimpurusa
verses.commentary: Sense: Kimpuru§7 Var? a a mythical land-GAMI, ; Kimpurusa

verses.sanskrit: अमात्याश्चैव भृत्याश्च गजांश्चाढौकयन्ति च । वर्धापयन्ति ते सर्वे ये केचित् पुरवासिनः
verses.transliteration: amātyāścaiva bhṛtyāśca gajāṃścāḍhaukayanti ca / vardhāpayanti te sarve ye kecit puravāsinaḥ
verses.translation: In the central sub-continent Ilavrta 1 which I have mentioned before, the sun does not blaze fiercely and men do not get aged (pre-maturely).
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वेतत्परमं गुह्य येडपि स्थुः पापकारिण: । वेश्या स्त्रियश्व शूद्राश्व रुद्लोकसवाप्नुयुः श्रावयेच्स्तु विप्रेम्यः सदा परवं॑सु पव॑सु । रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति द्विजो वे नात्र संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: In the central sub-continent Ilavrta 1 which I have mentioned before, the sun does not blaze fiercely and men do not get aged (pre-maturely).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the central sub-continent Ilavrta 1 which I have mentioned before, the sun does not blaze fiercely and men do not get aged (pre-maturely).

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टस्तुष्टो ऽवसत्तत्र सचिवैः सह सो ऽन्धकः । ददर्श स जगत्सर्वं तुरङ्गांश्च पदातिकान्
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭastuṣṭo 'vasattatra sacivaiḥ saha so 'ndhakaḥ / dadarśa sa jagatsarvaṃ turaṅgāṃśca padātikān
verses.translation: In Ilavrta the moon, the sun and the stars are dim. Men have the colour, lustre and fragrance of the lotus flower. Their eyes are as wide as the lotus leaf.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोत्त दक्षप्रोक्तस्तवों नाम त्रिशोध्ध्याय: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: In Ilavrta the moon, the sun and the stars are dim. Men have the colour, lustre and fragrance of the lotus flower. Their eyes are as wide as the lotus leaf.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Ilavrta the moon, the sun and the stars are dim. Men have the colour, lustre and fragrance of the lotus flower. Their eyes are as wide as the lotus leaf.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव विविधान् कोशांस् तत्र काञ्चनपूरितान् । महिषीर्गा वृषांश्चैवापश्यच्छत्राण्यनेकधा
verses.transliteration: tathaiva vividhān kośāṃs tatra kāñcanapūritān / mahiṣīrgā vṛṣāṃścaivāpaśyacchatrāṇyanekadhā
verses.translation: They feed on the juice of Jambu fruit. They neither grow aged nor decay. They have fragrance. They are cultured and polished. They enjoy pleasures as the fruit of their aus- pioious rites.
verses.hindi: सम्पन्न हो जाते हैं। जो इस स्तोत्र को जोर-जोर से पढ़ता है या मन-हौ-मन पढ़ता है, उसके सभी कार्य स्तोत्र पढ़ने के कारण सिद्ध हो जाते है।३१४ ३१५। कारतिकेय के साथ नन्दीश्वर मह.देव और देवी को धन के अनुरूप नैवेद्य चढ़ाकर यम-नियम पूव॑ंक दक्षिणा देकर स्तोत्र में आये हुए नामों का शीघ्रता से पाठ करे। इस विधि से जो मानव इस स्तोत्र का पाठ करता है, वह अभिलषित कामनाओं को और सकल भोगों को प्राप्त करता है एवं मरने पर सहस्र स्त्रियों के साथ स्वर्ग को जाता द्वे।३१६-३१७। जो सप्ती प्रकार के
verses.wordMeaning: They feed on the juice of Jambu fruit. They neither grow aged nor decay. They have fragrance. They are cultured and polished. They enjoy pleasures as the fruit of their aus- pioious rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: They feed on the juice of Jambu fruit. They neither grow aged nor decay. They have fragrance. They are cultured and polished. They enjoy pleasures as the fruit of their aus- pioious rites.

verses.sanskrit: स एवमन्धकस् तत्र कियन्तं कालमावसत् । हृष्टस्तुष्टो वसन् मर्त्ये स सुरैर् नाभ्यभूयत
verses.transliteration: sa evamandhakas tatra kiyantaṃ kālamāvasat / hṛṣṭastuṣṭo vasan martye sa surair nābhyabhūyata
verses.translation: They are fallen from Devaloka. They are non-senile and deathless. These excellent men live for thirteen thousand years.
verses.hindi: हो जाते हैं और मरने पर देव-दानवों से पूजित होकर गण-सालोक्य प्राप्त करते, सुसज्जित विमान पर वह इन्द्र की तरह शोभित होते और रुद्र के अनुचर होकर युगान्त पर्यन्‍्त वरतंमात रहते हैं, पराशरसुत भगवान् व्यास ने ऐसा कहा है ।३१८-३१६२। बिना विचारे सहसा किसी को बतलाना नहीं चाहिए और न तो सुनाना ही चाहिए। इस परम गुह्म स्तोत्र को सुनकर सभी पापात्मा वंश्य, स्त्री, शूद्र आदि रुद्रलोक
verses.wordMeaning: They are fallen from Devaloka. They are non-senile and deathless. These excellent men live for thirteen thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are fallen from Devaloka. They are non-senile and deathless. These excellent men live for thirteen thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: वरं लब्धं तु तं ज्ञात्वा शङ्किताः स्वर्गवासिनः । एकीभूताश्च ते सर्वे वासवं शरणं गताः
verses.transliteration: varaṃ labdhaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā śaṅkitāḥ svargavāsinaḥ / ekībhūtāśca te sarve vāsavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: In the sub-continent Ilavfta, they live the full span of life. The sub-continent is twenty six thousand Yojanas in length and nine thousand Yojanas in breadth around Meru. It is fashioned like a saucer.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करते हैं । जो ब्राह्मण प्रति पव में इसे विप्रों को सुनाता है, वह नि.सन्देह रुद्रलोक प्राप्त करता है इत्येषा समनुज्ञाता कथा पापप्रणाशिनी । दक्षमधिकृत्येह कथा शर्वादृपागता ११ पितृबंशप्रसहगेन कथा ह्य वा प्रकोतिता। पितुणामानृपृव्येण देवान्वक्ष्याम्पतः परम् २ त्रेतायुगमुखे पुर्वंमासन्स्वायंभुवेउन्तरे। देवा यामा इति ख्याताः पूर्व ये यज्ञसुनवः .
verses.wordMeaning: In the sub-continent Ilavfta, they live the full span of life. The sub-continent is twenty six thousand Yojanas in length and nine thousand Yojanas in breadth around Meru. It is fashioned like a saucer.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the sub-continent Ilavfta, they live the full span of life. The sub-continent is twenty six thousand Yojanas in length and nine thousand Yojanas in breadth around Meru. It is fashioned like a saucer.

verses.sanskrit: शक्र उवाच: कथमागमनं वो ऽत्र सर्वेषाम् अपि नाकिनाम् । कस्माद्वो भयमुत्पन्नमागताः शरणं कथम्
verses.transliteration: śakra uvāca: kathamāgamanaṃ vo 'tra sarveṣām api nākinām / kasmādvo bhayamutpannamāgatāḥ śaraṇaṃ katham
verses.translation: Nine thousand Yojanas to the west of Meru lies the mountain Gandhamadana, thirtyfour thousand Yojanas long.
verses.hindi: अजिता ब्रह्मण: पुत्रा जिता जिदजिताश् ये । पुत्राः स्वायंभुवस्येते शुक्रनाम्ता तु मानसाः. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Nine thousand Yojanas to the west of Meru lies the mountain Gandhamadana, thirtyfour thousand Yojanas long.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nine thousand Yojanas to the west of Meru lies the mountain Gandhamadana, thirtyfour thousand Yojanas long.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते ह्यमराः सर्वे शक्रम् एतद् वचो ऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: tataste hyamarāḥ sarve śakram etad vaco 'bruvan
verses.translation: To the north and south, it stretches upto Nila and Nisadha mountains. Its height is forty thousand Yojanas. It penetrated downwards to a thousand Yojanas.
verses.hindi: तृप्तिमन्तो गणा हाय ते देवानां तु त्रयः स्मृताः । छन्दोगास्तु त्रयस्त्रिशत्सवें स्वायंभुवस्य ह ३५ यदुयंयातिद्वों देवी दीधयः ख़बसो सतिः  विभासश्र क्तुश्चेव प्रजातिविशतो द्युतिः ६ वायसो मड्भलश्चेव यामा द्वादश कीतिता: । अभिमस्युरुग्रदृष्टि: समयोडथ शुचिश्रवाः ॥ कवलो विश्वरूवश्न सुपक्षो मधुपस्तथा सूत जी बोले-यह पापनाशिनी कथा आप लोगों को अब ज्ञात हो गई । यह दक्ष से सम्बन्ध रखने
verses.wordMeaning: To the north and south, it stretches upto Nila and Nisadha mountains. Its height is forty thousand Yojanas. It penetrated downwards to a thousand Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north and south, it stretches upto Nila and Nisadha mountains. Its height is forty thousand Yojanas. It penetrated downwards to a thousand Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । सुरनाथान्धको नाम दैत्यः शम्भुवरोर्जितः । अजेयः सर्वदेवानां किं नु कार्यमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ / suranāthāndhako nāma daityaḥ śambhuvarorjitaḥ / ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ kiṃ nu kāryamataḥ param
verses.translation: The mountain Malyavan lies in the east. Its magnitude has already been mentioned. It is to the south of Nila and to the north of Nisadha. The great mountain Meru of extensive magnitude lies in the centre of these mountains, which seem to penetrate it.
verses.hindi: वाली कथा महादेव से प्राप्त हुई है, जो पितरों के बंश-वर्णन के प्रसंग में कह दी गई है। पितृबंश वर्णन की ही तरह अब आगे हम देव वंश का वर्णन करते हैं ।१-२। पहले स्वायम्भुव मनु के अधिकार काल में त्रेता युग के आदि में याम नाम के विख्यात देव थे, जो पहले यज्ञ-्तनय थे । उनमें अजित ब्रह्मा कै पुत्र थे ओर जित, जित् तथा अजित स्वायम्भुव के पुत्र थे। ये शुक्र नामक मानस पुत्र कहलाते थे ।३-४। देवों के तोन
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain Malyavan lies in the east. Its magnitude has already been mentioned. It is to the south of Nila and to the north of Nisadha. The great mountain Meru of extensive magnitude lies in the centre of these mountains, which seem to penetrate it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain Malyavan lies in the east. Its magnitude has already been mentioned. It is to the south of Nila and to the north of Nisadha. The great mountain Meru of extensive magnitude lies in the centre of these mountains, which seem to penetrate it.

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वं चिन्तय देवेश क उपायो विधीयताम् । इत्थं वदन्ति ते देवाः शक्राग्रे मन्त्रणोद्यताः
verses.transliteration: tattvaṃ cintaya deveśa ka upāyo vidhīyatām / itthaṃ vadanti te devāḥ śakrāgre mantraṇodyatāḥ
verses.translation: A river of Jambu juice resembling liquified collyrium flows from the south of Meru to the north of Nisadha.
verses.hindi: गण कहे गये हैं, जिनमें ये तृप्तिमान् गण कहलाते हैं। स्वायम्भूव मनु के तेतीस पुत्र छनन्‍्दोग कहलाते हैं यदू, ययाति नामक दो देव एवं दीध्रयः. स्वत, मति, विभास, कतु, प्रजापति, विशत, युति, वायस और मज्भल नामक बारह देव याम कहलाते हैं ।६-६३। अभिमन्यु, उम्रदृष्टि, समय, शुचिश्रवा, केवल विश्वरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: A river of Jambu juice resembling liquified collyrium flows from the south of Meru to the north of Nisadha.
verses.commentary: Sense: A river of Jambu juice resembling liquified collyrium flows from the south of Meru to the north of Nisadha.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रयन्ति च यावद् वै तावच्चारमुखेरितम् । ज्ञात्वा तत्र स देवौघं दानवो निर्गतो गृहात्
verses.transliteration: mantrayanti ca yāvad vai tāvaccāramukheritam / jñātvā tatra sa devaughaṃ dānavo nirgato gṛhāt
verses.translation: IJavrja The country surrounding the Pamirs (AGP, , fig 2).
verses.hindi: +घनुद्चित्वान्तगंतग्रन्थ: ख. ग. ध. पुस्तकेषु नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: IJavrja The country surrounding the Pamirs (AGP, , fig 2).
verses.commentary: Sense: IJavrja The country surrounding the Pamirs (AGP, , fig 2).

verses.sanskrit: एकाकी स्यन्दनारूढ आयुर्धैबहुभिर् वृतः । दुर्गमं मेरुपृष्ठं स लीलयैव गतो नृप
verses.transliteration: ekākī syandanārūḍha āyurdhaibahubhir vṛtaḥ / durgamaṃ merupṛṣṭhaṃ sa līlayaiva gato nṛpa
verses.translation: There is an everlasting Jambu tree called Sudarsana. It blooms and bears fruits perpetually. It 13 resorted lo by Siddhas and Caranas. It is the biggest tree in Jambudvlpa, a hundred thousand Yojanas high. This lordly tree touches heaven. The length of the fruit is eight hundred and sixty one Aratnis. This is determined by sage r. who know the truth.
verses.hindi: तुरीयो निह॑युश्चेव युक्तो ग्रावाजिनस्तु ते । यमिनो विश्वदेववा्य यविष्ठो5 वृतवानपि ८ अजिरो विभुविभावश्न मृलिको5थ दिदेहक: । श्रुतिशुणों बृहच्छुक्रो देवा द्वादश कीतिताः  ६ आसन्‍्त्वायंभुवस्येते अन्तरे सोमपायिनः । स्विषिमस्तो गणा हा ते दीयंबन्तो महाबला: सुपर्णयक्षगन्धर्वा: पिशाचोरगराक्षसा:। अष्टो ते पितृभ्निः सार्थ नासत्या देवयोनयः १२
verses.wordMeaning: There is an everlasting Jambu tree called Sudarsana. It blooms and bears fruits perpetually. It 13 resorted lo by Siddhas and Caranas. It is the biggest tree in Jambudvlpa, a hundred thousand Yojanas high. This lordly tree touches heaven.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is an everlasting Jambu tree called Sudarsana. It blooms and bears fruits perpetually. It 13 resorted lo by Siddhas and Caranas. It is the biggest tree in Jambudvlpa, a hundred thousand Yojanas high. This lordly tree touches heaven.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्णप्राकारसंयुक्तं शोभितं विविधाश्रमैः । दुर्गमं शत्रुवर्गस्य तदा पार्थिवसत्तम
verses.transliteration: svarṇaprākārasaṃyuktaṃ śobhitaṃ vividhāśramaiḥ / durgamaṃ śatruvargasya tadā pārthivasattama
verses.translation: When the fruits fall on the ground, they make a loud noise. The juice of the Jambu fruits develops into a flowing river.
verses.hindi: अतीते वर्तमाने न दृष्टो वेवस्वतेन सः। प्रजाभिदेंबताभिश्व ऋषिभिः पितृनिः सह ३१५
verses.wordMeaning: When the fruits fall on the ground, they make a loud noise. The juice of the Jambu fruits develops into a flowing river.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the fruits fall on the ground, they make a loud noise. The juice of the Jambu fruits develops into a flowing river.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविवेशासुरस्तत्र लीलया स्वगृहे यथा । वृत्रहा भयमापन्नः स्वकीयं चासनं ददौ
verses.transliteration: praviveśāsurastatra līlayā svagṛhe yathā / vṛtrahā bhayamāpannaḥ svakīyaṃ cāsanaṃ dadau
verses.translation: The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambu inula and the people there drink of it. They are delighted and surrounded by the tasty Jambu fruits.
verses.hindi: वायुप्रोक्ता महासत्त्वा राजानः प्रथमेबन्तरे । सासुरं तत्सगन्धर्व सयक्षोरगराक्षसम् ॥ सुयक्ष, ( सुरक्ष ) मधुप, तुरीय, निहयुं युक्त, ग्रावाजिन, यमी, विश्वेदेवादि, यविष्ठ, मृतवानू, अजिर, विशभु, मुलिक, दिदेहक, श्रुतिशुण, बृहच्छुक और ऊःर कहे गये बारह देव स्वायम्भव मन्वन्तर के काल में वर्तमान ये ।७०३४। ये सोम-पीने वाले महाबली और वीयेशाली थे। ये त्विषिमान गण के कहलाते थे । विश्वभुक् प्रथम विभु उन लोगों के इन्द्र थे । उस समय जो असुर गण थे, वे भी इनके जाति-भाई थे । सुपर्ण, यक्ष, गन्धव,
verses.wordMeaning: The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambu inula and the people there drink of it. They are delighted and surrounded by the tasty Jambu fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambu inula and the people there drink of it. They are delighted and surrounded by the tasty Jambu fruits.

verses.sanskrit: उपविष्टो ऽन्धकस्तत्र शक्रस्यैवासने शुभे । आस्थानं कलयामास सर्वतस्त्रिदशावृतम्
verses.transliteration: upaviṣṭo 'ndhakastatra śakrasyaivāsane śubhe / āsthānaṃ kalayāmāsa sarvatastridaśāvṛtam
verses.translation: Imbibing the juice they conquer old age. Certainly they never fall sick or die.
verses.hindi: पिजश्ञाच, उरग, राक्षस और पितरों के साथ नासत्य ये आठों देवयोनि कहलाते थे । इनके प्रभाव और रूप से संयुक्त एवं आयुष्मान् तथा बलवान् सन्‍्तानें हजारों की संख्या में स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तर में बीत चुके हैं (०-१ ३। उसको विस्तार पूर्बक नहीं कहा जा रहा है; क्योंकि उसका प्रसंग भी यहाँ नहीं है । स्वायम्भुव मनु के काल का सृष्टि विस्तार वतंमान मनु की ही तरह समझना चाहिए । अतीत मन्वन्तर में प्रजा सृष्ठि या स्वभावादि
verses.wordMeaning: Imbibing the juice they conquer old age. Certainly they never fall sick or die.
verses.commentary: Sense: Imbibing the juice they conquer old age. Certainly they never fall sick or die.

verses.sanskrit: शक्र उवाच: किं तवागमनं चात्र किं कार्यं कथयस्व मे । यदस्मदीयं वित्तं हि तत्ते दास्यामि दानव
verses.transliteration: śakra uvāca: kiṃ tavāgamanaṃ cātra kiṃ kāryaṃ kathayasva me / yadasmadīyaṃ vittaṃ hi tatte dāsyāmi dānava
verses.translation: The gold called Jambunada which Devas wear as ornaments is found there. It appears as splendid as the glow¬ worm.
verses.hindi: वर्तमान बैवस्वत मनु के काल की ही तरह देखा जाता है । प्रजाओं, देवताओं, ऋषियों और पितरों के साथ पहले जो उनमें सप्तर्ि थे, उनको सुनिये -भूगु. अंगिरा, मरीचि, पुलस्त्य, पुलह, ठु, अनञ्रि और बसिष्ठ ।१४-१६३। स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तर में अग्नी प्र, अतिबाहु, मेघा, मेधातिथि, वसु, ज्योतिष्मान्, द्यतिमान, हव्य और सवन आदि ये महाबल शाली दस पुत्र स्वायम्भु मनु के थे  वायु ने कहा है कि, प्रथम मन्वन्तर में ये ही मह.बलशाली राजा थे !१७-१५६३। असुर, गन्धवे, यज्ञ, उरग, राक्षस, पिशाच और मनुष्यों के साथ सुपर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: The gold called Jambunada which Devas wear as ornaments is found there. It appears as splendid as the glow¬ worm.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gold called Jambunada which Devas wear as ornaments is found there. It appears as splendid as the glow¬ worm.

verses.sanskrit: अन्धक उवाच: नाहं वै कामये कोशं न गजांश्च सुरेश्वर । स्वकीयं दर्शयस्वाद्य स्वर्गशृङ्गारभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: andhaka uvāca: nāhaṃ vai kāmaye kośaṃ na gajāṃśca sureśvara / svakīyaṃ darśayasvādya svargaśṛṅgārabhūṣitam
verses.translation: The splendid juice of the fruits of all Varsa -trees (Jariibu) strengthens the people (of the continent). It is the gold that is used for ornaments of Devas.
verses.hindi: या बे ब्रजकुलास्पास्तु आसन्स्वायंभुवेउन्तरे । कालेन बहुनाइतोता अयनाब्दयुगक्त नेः (३२१
verses.wordMeaning: The splendid juice of the fruits of all Varsa -trees (Jariibu) strengthens the people (of the continent). It is the gold that is used for ornaments of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The splendid juice of the fruits of all Varsa -trees (Jariibu) strengthens the people (of the continent). It is the gold that is used for ornaments of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ऐरावतं महानागं तं चैवोच्चैःश्रवोहयम् । उर्वश्यादीनि रत्नानि मम दर्शय गोपते
verses.transliteration: airāvataṃ mahānāgaṃ taṃ caivoccaiḥśravohayam / urvaśyādīni ratnāni mama darśaya gopate
verses.translation: Their excretions (faeces and urine) are scattered all round. Thanks to the blessings of the Lord, the earth absorbs the refuge and the dead bodies.
verses.hindi: क एव भगवान्कालः सर्वभुतापहारकः । कस्य योनिः किमादिश्व कि तत्त्वं स क्रिमात्मज: किमस्य चल्लुः का सूर्तिः के चास्यावयवा: स्मपृुता: । किनामधेयः को5स्यात्मा एतत्प्रत्रहि पृ-छताम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Their excretions (faeces and urine) are scattered all round. Thanks to the blessings of the Lord, the earth absorbs the refuge and the dead bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their excretions (faeces and urine) are scattered all round. Thanks to the blessings of the Lord, the earth absorbs the refuge and the dead bodies.

verses.sanskrit: पारिजातकपुष्पाणि वृक्षजातीननेकशः । वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि दर्शयस्व शचीपते
verses.transliteration: pārijātakapuṣpāṇi vṛkṣajātīnanekaśaḥ / vāditrāṇi ca sarvāṇi darśayasva śacīpate
verses.translation: The Raksasas, Pisacas and Yaksas reside on Himavat. The Gandharvas and Apsaras-s live on mountain Hemakuta.
verses.hindi: श्रयतां कालस:्भाव: श्रुट्वा चेवावधायंताम् । सूर्ययोनिरनिभेषादिः संख्याचक्षु: स उच्यते ३२४ मृतिरस्य त्वहोरात्रे निमिषावयवश्च सः। संवत्सरशतं त्वस्थ नाम चास्य कलात्मकस् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Raksasas, Pisacas and Yaksas reside on Himavat. The Gandharvas and Apsaras-s live on mountain Hemakuta.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Raksasas, Pisacas and Yaksas reside on Himavat. The Gandharvas and Apsaras-s live on mountain Hemakuta.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शक्रश् चिन्तितवान् इदम् । यो ऽमुं निहन्ति पाप्मानं न तं पश्यामि कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śakraś cintitavān idam / yo 'muṃ nihanti pāpmānaṃ na taṃ paśyāmi karhicit
verses.translation: The Nagas including Sesa, Vasuki and Taksaka live on Nisadha. The thirtythree groups of Devas, the Yajnikas, wander over the great Meru. On the Nila, full of lapis lazuli, Siddhas and Brahmarsis live.
verses.hindi: सांप्रतानागतातीतकालात्मा स प्रजापति: २५ पच्आानां प्रविभक्तानां कालावस्थां निबोधत । दिनाधंमासमासस्तु ऋतुभिस्त्वयनेस्तथा २६ व॒त्सरः पत्चमस्तेषां कालः स युगसंज्ञित:  तेषां तु तत्त्वं वक्ष्यामि कीत्यंसानं निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: The Nagas including Sesa, Vasuki and Taksaka live on Nisadha. The thirtythree groups of Devas, the Yajnikas, wander over the great Meru. On the Nila, full of lapis lazuli, Siddhas and Brahmarsis live.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Nagas including Sesa, Vasuki and Taksaka live on Nisadha. The thirtythree groups of Devas, the Yajnikas, wander over the great Meru. On the Nila, full of lapis lazuli, Siddhas and Brahmarsis live.

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति रक्षाप्रदः कश्चित्स्वर्गलोकस्य दुःखिनः । भयत्रस्तो ददावन्यद्वादित्राद्यप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: nāsti rakṣāpradaḥ kaścitsvargalokasya duḥkhinaḥ / bhayatrasto dadāvanyadvāditrādyapsarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: The mountain Sveta is the abode of. Daityas and Danavas. The mountain Srngavan is the place which the Pitrs
verses.hindi: तथा अप्सराओं का जो गण था, उसका अनुक्रम से कहा जाता सौ वर्षों में भी सम्भव नहीं है, क्योंकि उन राजकुलीनों के नामों की संख्या बहुत अधिक थी। स्वायम्भुव मन्वस्तर में जो ब्रजकुलनामक प्रजाजन थे, वे अयन, वर्ष और युगक्रम से बहुत दिन व्यतीत हो चुके हैं ।१ ६-२१।

verses.translation: Splendid, auspicious, cool water flows from the foot of Kailasa into a lake called Manda. It is full of lilies and is sparkling like autumnal clouds. From that (lake) proceeds the auspicious, heavenly river Mandakinl. 2 On its bank stands a great.celestial forest called Nandana. To the north-east of Kailasa, there is a mountain called Candraprabha near mount Suvarna which abounds in celestial animals, medicinal herbs and minerals for the use of Devas. The mountain Candraprabha 3 is like a pure jewel. There is a divine lake Acchoda at its foot.

verses.translation: The Raksasa Brahmapata, an attendant of Kuberaand son of Prahctr lives there. He has infinite valour (yet) he is self-controlled. Fie is surrounded by hundreds of Yatudhanas capable of traversing aerial regions. To the west of Kailasa, there is the excellent mountain Aruna 3 It is full of important animals, medicinal herbs, gold and other minerals. Nearby is the mountain Munjavat, a glorious mountain resembling clouds. This is a favourite haunt of the great Lord Sankara. It is surrounded by clusters of rocks, pure and golden. It appears (as if) to brush the heaven with its hundreds of golden peaks. This great divine mountain is snow-capped and inaccessible.

verses.transliteration: kimatrāgamanaṃ devāḥ sarveṣāṃ vai vivarṇatā / kenāpamānitāḥ sarve śīghraṃ me kathyatāṃ svayam
verses.translation: This is the peak Gurla Mandhata, since lake Manasa Sarovar lies This is the Ladakh or Leh range (Ibid ). •, Arp
verses.hindi: पर्वंसन्धि, पूणिमा, अमावास्या के ये ही उत्पादक, निश्ाकर और प्रजापति हैं ।३८-४०। इसीलिये ये सोम पितुमान् एवं ऋक, यजुर्वेद के स्त्ररूप हैं। ये प्राण, अपान, समान उदान और ब्यानात्मक कर्म द्वारा लोक में निखिल प्राणियों की सम्पूर्ण चेष्ठाओं के प्रवर्तक हैं । ये ही प्राण, अपान और समान वायु के प्रवर्तक हैं ' इन णँचों के अर्थात् इन्द्रिय, मन बुद्धि, स्पृति और जल के यथाकाल पोषण कर्ता और इनकी क्रियाओं के सम्पादक हैं। ये प्रभंजन सर्वात्मा हैं। आवह प्रवह आदि के द्वारा सब लोकों के तथा सब भूततों के विधाता एवं पृथ्वी को घारण करने वाले हैं । ये ही प्रभंअनन जल, अग्नि, भूमि, रवि और चन्द्रमा के उत्तादक हैं। ये ही वायु प्रजापति, लोकात्मा और प्रपितामह हैं ।४३-४४५। प्रजापति आदि देवगण अपने अभीष्ट फलों को पाने के

verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ / andhakākhyo mahādaityo balavān padmasambhava / tena devagaṇāḥ sarve dhanaratnair viyojitāḥ
verses.translation: According to M.AIi, it is the Nanga Parbat (for detatls vide AGP The famous divine forest Surabhi lies on its banks. North ofKailasa there lies a mountain Gaura byname, which is the resort of auspicious beings and abounds in medicinal herbs and yellow orpiment. It is a splendid bejewelled moun¬ tain having golden peaks.
verses.hindi: लिये ओषधियों के क्षय हो जाने पर त्रिकपाल और व्यम्बका हारा भगवान् की पूजा करते हैं इसलिये वे वज्यम्बक कहलाते हैं । गायत्री, त्रिष्युप् और जगती त्यम्बका नाम से ख्यात हैं, जो यज्ञयोनि या सवन की उत्पादिका है। ये ही तीनों छन्द जब अपने पराक्रम से एकत्र हो जाते हैं, तब वे ही त्रिसाधन, पुरोडाश और त्रिकपाल कहे जाते हैं ।४६-४८। विद्वानों ने इस प्रकार पाँच वर्षों का युग कहा है। विप्रों ने जो इन पांच प्रकार के

verses.transliteration: hatvā devagaṇāṃs tāvad asicakraparaddviśvadhaiḥ / gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ sa dānavo 'pi gato balāt
verses.translation: At the foot of the mountain, there is a splendid lake called Bindusaras. 1 Even its sands are of gold. It was to this lake that Bhagiratha came. For the sake of the river Ganga, that saintly king lived there for many years (thinking to himself:) "My ancestors will go to heaven, if they are bathed in the waters of the Ganga." The goddess Ganga (lit. a river flowing through three paths, viz. the heaven, the earth and the nether-world) 2 was first initiated there. Rising from the foot of Soma mountain, she divides herself in seven streams.
verses.hindi: संवत्सरों कों बताया है, उनमें प्रत्येक बसन्‍त आदि छः ऋतुओं वाले हैं ।४६। ऋतु-पुत्र, आतंव गण पांच प्रकार के हैं। संक्षेप में यही कथा है। यह वायु प्राणियों के जीवन को काल रूप से संहार करती हुई नदी नदविगेसमायुक्तं कालो धावति संहरन् । अहोरात्रकरस्तस्मात्स वायुरभवत्युनः ५१

verses.sanskrit: देवानां वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । चिन्तयामास राजेन्द्र वधार्थं दानवस्य ह
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / cintayāmāsa rājendra vadhārthaṃ dānavasya ha
verses.translation: There the sacrificial posts are made of precious stones. The citis (oblong quadrilateral sacrificial pits) are golden. It was after performing a sacrifice there that Indra along with attending Devas attained to Siva. The innumerable stars of the milky way in the clear sky, which look very close to each other and glitter brightly at night are nothing but the goddess Ganga.

verses.translation: Having flowed through the sky and the heaven, the Ganga came down upon the earth. When she fell down on the head of Siva, he held (up) her with his Yogic Maya power. As the river became furious, some drops (of her water) fell an the earth and created a lake of drops and hence came to be known as Bindusaras. The name is explained in two wavs •

The Lord thought to himself, "I have been propitiated by him (this king) earlier for this river." Becoming aware of the boon granted to him earlier, he controlled his anger (against the river).

verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ / jaya tvaṃ devadeveśa lakṣmyā vakṣaḥsthalāśritaḥ / asurakṣaya deveśa vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the request of God Brahma to keep up his promise, the Lord released the river held up b.y him by his prowess, for the sake of Bhaglratha by whose severe penance he felt satisfied. As the river was being released, the flow of the river started in seven currents. Three of them flowed to the east and three to the west. The entire course of the river Ganga was divided into seven parts. NalinI, Hradini and PavanI * 1 flowed to the east. Sita, Caksu and Sindhu flowed to the west. The seventh current led by Bhaglratha flowed to the south. Hence it is known as the Bhaglrathl. That river entered

They are as follows rSirindhras, Kuntalas, Cinas, Barbaras. Yavasas, Druhas Rusanas, Kunindas and Angalokavaras. The river Slta divides the desert ofSindhu into two and flows into the western ocean.

verses.transliteration: śrīvāsudeva uvāca: svāgataṃ devaviprāṇāṃ suprabhātādya śarvarī / kiṃ kāryaṃ procyatāṃ kṣipraṃ kasya ruṣṭā divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: The river Caksu flows through these countries: Clnamarus (Chinese desert?), Nanganas, Sarvamiilikas, Sadhras, Tusaras The Ganga sanctifies the auspicious Aryan coun¬ tries: Daradas, Kasmiras, Gandharas, Varapas, Hradas, Siva- Obstructed by the Vindhya mountain, it falls into the southern sea. The holy river Ahladini (one of its eastern branches) flows to the cast. eastern

verses.sanskrit: किं दुःखं कश्च संतापः कुतो वा भयम् आगतम् । कथयन्तु महाभागाः कारणं यन्मनोगतम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ duḥkhaṃ kaśca saṃtāpaḥ kuto vā bhayam āgatam / kathayantu mahābhāgāḥ kāraṇaṃ yanmanogatam
verses.translation: On the banks of the river Vasvokasa, on the peak Harisrnga famous for its fragrant waters, lives the scholar Kauberaka of self-control. Yajnopeta, Sumahan, Amitaujas and Suvikrama are his attendants. They are on par with him. Kauberaka is sur¬ rounded by scholarly Brahma-raksasas of the family of Agastya.
verses.hindi: इस वंश प्रजेशानां महतां पुण्यकर्मंणाम् । कीतंयन्स्थिरकीर्तोनां महतीं सिद्धिमाप्नुयात् ३६१
verses.wordMeaning: On the banks of the river Vasvokasa, on the peak Harisrnga famous for its fragrant waters, lives the scholar Kauberaka of self-control. Yajnopeta, Sumahan, Amitaujas and Suvikrama are his attendants. They are on par with him.…

verses.sanskrit: पराभवः कृतो येन सो ऽद्य यातु यमालयम् । एवमुक्तास्तु कृष्णेन कथयामासुरस्य तत्
verses.transliteration: parābhavaḥ kṛto yena so 'dya yātu yamālayam / evamuktāstu kṛṣṇena kathayāmāsurasya tat
verses.translation: The prosperity of the inhabitants of mountains should be known thus. Through mutual cooperation their prosperity arising from Dharma (Virtue), Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love) becomes doubled. Behind Hemakuta there is the lake Sayana. 1 The rivers ManasvinI and Jyotismatl emerge from this lake. They flow into the eastern and western oceans res¬ pectively. On the excellent mountain Nisadha is the lake Visnupada. 2
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्‍्ते देववंशवर्णनं नार्मकरत्रिशोःध्यायः अत ऊर्ध्व॑ प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रणवस्य विनिश्चयम् । ओंकारमक्षरं ब्रह्म त्रिवर्ण चा5४दितः ह्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The prosperity of the inhabitants of mountains should be known thus. Through mutual cooperation their prosperity arising from Dharma (Virtue), Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love) becomes doubled. Behind Hemakuta there is the lake Sayana.…

verses.transliteration: darśayantaḥ svakāndehān lajjamānā hyadhomukhāḥ / hṛtarājyā hyandhakena kṛtā nistejasaḥ prabho
verses.translation: The two rivers, Gandharvi and Nanvali rise from it. There is a great eddy called Candraprabha rising to the west of Meru. The holy river of Jambu juice, the source of the splendid gold (called Jambunada) flows from here. The lake Payoda, 3 as splendid as the white lotus, is on the mount Nila.
verses.hindi: यो यो यस्य यथा वर्णो विहतो देवतास्तथा। ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि वायुरग्निस्तथाज«्लम्

verses.sanskrit: श्रीवासुदेव उवाच: पाताले यदि वा मर्त्ये नाके वा यदि तिष्ठति । तं हनिष्याम्यहं पापं येन संतापिताः सुराः
verses.transliteration: śrīvāsudeva uvāca: pātāle yadi vā martye nāke vā yadi tiṣṭhati / taṃ haniṣyāmyahaṃ pāpaṃ yena saṃtāpitāḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: M. Ali believes that the lakes in w. 68-70 were in S.bena-AGP There are twelve famous lakes full of lotuses, fishes and birds. They are named as Rudrajayas and they arc (big) like seas. From these lakes there emerge the rivers Santa and Madhvi. There is no rainfall in the Kimpurusa continent.
verses.hindi: नात्राध्यायपरिसमाप्तिः ख. पुस्तके । + जलमित्यस्तेःध्यायपरिसमाप्तिदु श्यते ख. पुस्तके । तस्मात्त अक्षरादेव पुनरन्ये प्रजज्ञिरे । चतुदंश महात्मानो देवानां ये तु देवताः

verses.sanskrit: स्वं स्थानं यान्तु गीर्वाणाः संतुष्टा भावितौजसः । विष्णोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्माद्यास्ते सवासवाः
verses.transliteration: svaṃ sthānaṃ yāntu gīrvāṇāḥ saṃtuṣṭā bhāvitaujasaḥ / viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmādyāste savāsavāḥ
verses.translation: Excellent rivers flow here with waters from the sub¬ terranean regions. These blessed rivers flow through the moun¬ tains Rsabha, Dundubhi, Dhumra and Mahagiri, to the east and fall into the briny sea. Others flow to the north over the moun¬ tains Candrakahka, Prana, Mahan and Agni and merge into the great ocean. The mountains Somaka, Varaha and Narada extend to the west upto the briny sea.
verses.hindi: तेषु सर्वंगतश्चेव सर्वंग: सर्वेयोगवित् । अनुग्रहाय लोकानामादिमध्यान्त उच्यते ४ सप्तर्षयस्तथेन्धा ये देवाश्र पितृभिः सह । अक्षरात्रि:सृताः सर्वे देवदेवान्महेश्वरात् ३५ इहामुत्र हितार्थाय वदन्ति परम परम् । पुर्बंमेव मयोक्तस्ते कालस्तु युगसंशितः ६ कृत त्रेता द्वापरं च युगादिः कलिना सह । परिवतंमानेस्तेरेव भ्रममाणेषु चक्रवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Excellent rivers flow here with waters from the sub¬ terranean regions. These blessed rivers flow through the moun¬ tains Rsabha, Dundubhi, Dhumra and Mahagiri, to the east and fall into the briny sea. Others flow to the north over the moun¬ tains Candrakahka, Prana,…

verses.sanskrit: स्वयानैस्तु हरिं नत्वा हृदि तुष्टा दिवं ययुः
verses.transliteration: svayānaistu hariṃ natvā hṛdi tuṣṭā divaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: The great mountains Cakra, Balahakaand Mainaka extend to the southern ocean. In between Candra and Mainaka, to the south, there is the great fire Samvartaka which consumes the waters of the ocean. It is known asAurvaand Vadavamukha. The twelve mountains entered the ocean because they feared Mahendra who would have cut off their wings. What is seen reflected in the form of a black hare on the white (orb of the) moon is the replica of Bharatavarsa divided into nine regions. It is seen in the moon that rises here and not elsewhere. These countries become more and more flourishing in respect of good qualities, health, longevity and magnitude based on virtue, love and wealth. Different kinds and castes of people and other living beings endowed with good qualities live in the different countries. Thus the Earth holds the entire universe.
verses.hindi: तदा ते वाग्यता भुत्वा आदौ मन्वन्तरस्य वे । ऋषयश्चेव देवाश्र इन्द्रश्बेव महातपा: १६ समाधाय मनस्तीत्र॑ं सहल्न परिवत्सरान् । प्रपन्नास्ते महादेवं भीताः कालस्थ वे तदा १० अय॑ हि कालो देवेशश्रतुम् त्तिश्नतुर्मुखः । को5स्य विद्यान्महादेव अगाधस्य महेश्वर ११ अथ दुष्ट्वा महादेवस्तं तु काल॑ चतुर्मुखभ् । न भेतव्यमिति प्राह को वः कामः प्रदीयताम॒ तत्करिष्याभ्यहूं सर्व न वथाउ्यं परिश्रम: । उवाच देवो भगवान्स्वयं काल: सुदुर्जयः ११३ यदेतस्य सुखं श्वेतं चतुजिह्न हि लक्ष्यते । एतत्कृतयुगं नाम तस्य कालस्य वे सुखम् ।।
verses.wordMeaning: The great mountains Cakra, Balahakaand Mainaka extend to the southern ocean. In between Candra and Mainaka, to the south, there is the great fire Samvartaka which consumes the waters of the ocean. It is known asAurvaand Vadavamukha.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे गीर्वाणस्वर्गमनवर्णनं नाम सप्तचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ४८ उत्तानपाद उवाच: कस्मिन्स्थाने ऽवसद् देव सो ऽन्धको दैत्यपुंगवः । सर्वान्देवांश्च निर्जित्य कस्मिन्स्थाने समास्थितः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gīrvāṇasvargamanavarṇanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 48 uttānapāda uvāca: kasminsthāne 'vasad deva so 'ndhako daityapuṃgavaḥ / sarvāndevāṃśca nirjitya kasminsthāne samāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: In the many long and wide caves, and crevasses of that mountain there are many prosperous jolly men and women of various shapes and features. In the many spacious and long and wide cavities (valleys?) are established hundreds and thousands of cities built into the mountain. These houses are joined to one another and have only a door each.
verses.hindi: असौ देव: सुरश्रेष्ठो ब्रह्म ववस्‍्वतों मुखः
verses.wordMeaning: In the many long and wide caves, and crevasses of that mountain there are many prosperous jolly men and women of various shapes and features. In the many spacious and long and wide cavities (valleys?) are established hundreds and thousands of cities built into the mountain.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमहेश उवाच: प्रविष्टो दानवो यत्र कथयामि नराधिप । पाताललोकमाश्रित्य कन्या विध्वंसते तु सः
verses.transliteration: śrīmaheśa uvāca: praviṣṭo dānavo yatra kathayāmi narādhipa / pātālalokamāśritya kanyā vidhvaṃsate tu saḥ
verses.translation: The subjects thereof have long beards and moustache. They are black and shining like clouds. They have the maximum life span of eighty years.
verses.hindi: से फिर दूसरे भी उत्पन्न हुए  देवों के बीच जो चौदह महात्मा देवता हैं, उनके भी मध्य जो सबको पाने वाले, सभी जगह जाने वाले और सब योगों को जानने वाले हैं, वे ही लोकोंपर अनुग्रह करने के लिये ओंकार के आदि, मध्य और अन्त कहे जाते हैं ।३-४। सप्तषि गण, इन्द्र और पितरों के साथ देव गण आदि कअक्षर- स्वरूप देव-देव महादेव से उत्पन्न हुए हैं। इस लोक ओर परलोक में कल्याण के लिये ओंकार परम पद कहा गया है। मैंने पहले ही कहा है कि, काल का नाम युग भी है ।५-६। कृत, त्रेता, द्वापर और क्जियुग के साथ युग आदि चक्रकी तरह नोचे-ऊपर घूमते रहते है। देव गण तब काल के वशीभूत होकर व्यग्न हो गये और स्वयं उसकी इयतता (सीमा) परिमाण को निर्धारित करने में असमर्थ हो गये ७-७। आदि मन्वन्तर में वे ऋषि, देवता और इन्द्र आदि मोनावलम्बन क्र हजारों वर्ष पयनत चंचल मन को एक्राग्र करके कठित
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects thereof have long beards and moustache. They are black and shining like clouds. They have the maximum life span of eighty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects thereof have long beards and moustache. They are black and shining like clouds. They have the maximum life span of eighty years.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थितं तं विज्ञाय चापमादाय केशवः । व्यसृजद्बाणमाग्नेयं दह्यतामिति चिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration: tatra sthitaṃ taṃ vijñāya cāpamādāya keśavaḥ / vyasṛjadbāṇamāgneyaṃ dahyatāmiti cintayan
verses.translation: They cat fruits and roots and live like monkeys. Like cattle, they follow promiscuous, unconcealed sexual habits. They are devoid of bodily and mental purity and they have no fixed rules or conventions.
verses.hindi: तपस्या करने लगे। तब काल से डरे हुए वे देवादि महादेव की शरण में महुंचे ।६-१०। वे बोले--महेश्वर ! महादेव ! इस चार मुँह और मूर्ति धारण करने वाले देवेश अग्राध काल का पार कौन पा सकता है ? महादेव जी ने उस नतुर्मंख काल को देखा और कहा--डर्ते की कोई बात नहीं है। कहिये आपकी क्रिस अभिलाषा को पूर्ण कहूँ ? ।११-१२। आप के सब काये हो जायेगें, आप का यह परिश्रम व्यथे है । फिर स्वयं काल
verses.wordMeaning: They cat fruits and roots and live like monkeys. Like cattle, they follow promiscuous, unconcealed sexual habits. They are devoid of bodily and mental purity and they have no fixed rules or conventions.
verses.commentary: Sense: They cat fruits and roots and live like monkeys. Like cattle, they follow promiscuous, unconcealed sexual habits. They are devoid of bodily and mental purity and they have no fixed rules or conventions.

verses.sanskrit: दह्यमानो ऽग्निना सो ऽपि वारुणास्त्रं स संदधे । वारुणास्त्रेण महता आग्नेयं शमितं तदा
verses.transliteration: dahyamāno 'gninā so 'pi vāruṇāstraṃ sa saṃdadhe / vāruṇāstreṇa mahatā āgneyaṃ śamitaṃ tadā
verses.translation: That continent is full of worthless men. Similarly other countries and islets shall be known in due order.
verses.hindi: स्वरूप अजेय महादेव जी बोले--काल का जो यह चार जिद्ऑावाला रवेत मुख दीख पड़ता है, वह काल का कृतयुग नामक मुख है और यही मुख देवश्रेष्ठ ब्रह्मा और वेवस्वत भी कहलाता है १३-१४ ब्राह्मणो । यह अत्र यज्ञप्रवत्तिस्तु जायते हि महेश्वरात् । ततोत्र इज्यते यज्ञस्तिस्रो जिह्दास्त्रयो5्नयः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: That continent is full of worthless men. Similarly other countries and islets shall be known in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: That continent is full of worthless men. Similarly other countries and islets shall be known in due order.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽसौ चिन्तयामास केन बाणो विसर्जितः । कस्यैषा पौरुषी शक्तिः को यास्यति यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'sau cintayāmāsa kena bāṇo visarjitaḥ / kasyaiṣā pauruṣī śaktiḥ ko yāsyati yamālayam
verses.translation: The groups of islands known as Peacock islands are extending to twenty, thirty, fifty, sixty, eighty and hundred Yojanas. Theie are a few, extending to a thousand Yojanas. They are long, wide and full of various living beings. Besides Jambu-dvipa there are six islands. These islands are amous over the earth for their mines of gems and precious stones T y are known as Ahga, Yama, Malaya, Sankha.Kusa and \ araha
verses.hindi: दृष्टवा चैआग्नयों विप्रा: कालजिद्धा प्रवर्तते क्‍
verses.wordMeaning: The groups of islands known as Peacock islands are extending to twenty, thirty, fifty, sixty, eighty and hundred Yojanas. Theie are a few, extending to a thousand Yojanas. They are long, wide and full of various living beings. Besides Jambu-dvipa there are six islands.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The groups of islands known as Peacock islands are extending to twenty, thirty, fifty, sixty, eighty and hundred Yojanas. Theie are a few, extending to a thousand Yojanas. They are long, wide and full of various living beings. Besides Jambu-dvipa there are six islands.…

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽन्धको मृधे क्रुद्धो बाणमार्गेण निर्गतः । स दृष्ट्वा बाणमार्गेण चापहस्तं जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'ndhako mṛdhe kruddho bāṇamārgeṇa nirgataḥ / sa dṛṣṭvā bāṇamārgeṇa cāpahastaṃ janārdanam
verses.translation: The Vidyutvan mountain is obviously the Arakan Yom ® ofBu p The islands dotting the Arakan coast are ment.oned m vv. 11-12-AGr
verses.hindi: ततः कलियुग घोर स्वंजोकभयंकरम् । कल्पस्य तु मुख हां तच्चतुर्थ नाम भीषणम् ११६ न सुख नापि निर्वाणं तस्मिन्भवति वे युगे। कालग्रस्ता प्रजा चापि युगे तस्मिन्भविष्यति ब्रह्मा कृतयुगे पुज्यस्त्रेतायां यज्ञ उच्यते । द्वापरे पूज्यते विष्णुरहं पूज्यश्चतुष्बंषि २१ ब्रह्म विष्णभश्व यज्ञश्न कालस्येव कलास्त्रयः । सर्वेष्वेव हि कालेषु चतुर्म तिमहेश्वरः २२ अडु जनो जनयथिता वः कालः कालप्रवर्तकः । युगकर्ता तथा चेब पर परपरायण:
verses.wordMeaning: The Vidyutvan mountain is obviously the Arakan Yom ® ofBu p The islands dotting the Arakan coast are ment.oned m vv. 11-12-AGr
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vidyutvan mountain is obviously the Arakan Yom ® ofBu p The islands dotting the Arakan coast are ment.oned m vv. 11-12-AGr

verses.sanskrit: अन्धक उवाच: न शर्म लप्स्यसे ह्यद्य मया दृष्ट्याभिवीक्षितः । न शक्नोषि तथा गन्तुं नागः शार्दूलदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: andhaka uvāca: na śarma lapsyase hyadya mayā dṛṣṭyābhivīkṣitaḥ / na śaknoṣi tathā gantuṃ nāgaḥ śārdūladarśanāt
verses.translation: These are the lands around India.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्कलियुएं प्राप्य लोकानां हितकारणात् । अभयार्थ च देवानामुभयोलोॉकियो रपि ३२४ तदा भवश्च पज्यश्च भविष्यामि सुरोत्तमाः । तस्माजूय॑ न कार्य च कॉलि प्राप्प महोजसः १२५ एवमुक्तास्ततः सर्वा देवता ऋषिभिः सह । प्रणम्य शिरसा देख पुनरूचज गत्पतिम् ७२६
verses.wordMeaning: These are the lands around India.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the lands around India.

verses.sanskrit: आगच्छति यथा भक्ष्यं मार्जारस्य च मूषिकः । न शक्नोषि तथा यातुं संस्थितस् त्वं ममाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: āgacchati yathā bhakṣyaṃ mārjārasya ca mūṣikaḥ / na śaknoṣi tathā yātuṃ saṃsthitas tvaṃ mamāgrataḥ
verses.translation: Know ye that the Ahga Dvlpa 1 comprises islands, and many people of the Mleccha tribes live there. That continent is very large.
verses.hindi: जो लाल रंग का, लपलपाती तीन जिह्ना वाला दूसरा मुख कहा गया है, वह त्रेता युग है। इस युग में महादेव के द्वारा ही यज्ञ करने में लोगों की प्रवृत्ति होती है। इनसे ही यज्ञ का प्रारम्भ होता है। इस्हें तीन जिल्वाएँ हैं और तीन अग्नि  ये ही अग्नि काल की जिह्वाएँ हैं ।१५-१६।! यह जो दो जिल्ा! वाला भयडूर लाल और पिज्रल वर्ण का मुख है, वह द्वापर नाम का युग है। इस युग में हम दो पर वाले होंगे। यह जो चौथा कले रज़ का एवं लाल आँखों वाला मुँह है, जिसमें काले रंग की एक मोटी जिह्ना बार-बार लपलपा रही है, वह सम्पूर्ण लोकों को भयत्रस्त करने वाला घोर कलियुग है। यह कल्पों का भीषण चोथा मुख है
verses.wordMeaning: Know ye that the Ahga Dvlpa 1 comprises islands, and many people of the Mleccha tribes live there. That continent is very large.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know ye that the Ahga Dvlpa 1 comprises islands, and many people of the Mleccha tribes live there. That continent is very large.

verses.sanskrit: अहं त्वां प्रेषयिष्यामि यममार्गे सुदारुणे । अहमन्वेषयिष्यामि किल यास्यामि ते गृहम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ tvāṃ preṣayiṣyāmi yamamārge sudāruṇe / ahamanveṣayiṣyāmi kila yāsyāmi te gṛham
verses.translation: There are mines of gems, corals and gold in that land here. It is variegated with rivers, mountains and forests. It resembles ill'* vast expanse of the briny sea.
verses.hindi: इस युग में न सुख है और न मुक्ति एवं प्रजाजन भी इस युग में काल से ग्रस्त होकर रहेंगे। कृतयुग में ब्रह्मा पूजित होते हैं, त्रेता में यज्ञ, द्वापर में विष्णु और मैं चारों युगों में पूर्जित रहता हूँ । ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और यज्ञ ये काल की तीन कलाएँ या अंश हैं; किन्‍्तु चार मूरति वाले महेश्वर सभी कालों में हैं ।२०-२२। मैं ही जन हूँ और आप लोगों का उत्पादक भी मैं हूँ । मैं ही काल हूँ और काल का प्रवतंक भी । मैं ही युगों का
verses.wordMeaning: There are mines of gems, corals and gold in that land here. It is variegated with rivers, mountains and forests. It resembles ill'* vast expanse of the briny sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are mines of gems, corals and gold in that land here. It is variegated with rivers, mountains and forests. It resembles ill'* vast expanse of the briny sea.

verses.sanskrit: उपनीतो ऽसि कालेन सङ्ग्रामे मम केशव । ये त्वया निर्जिताः पूर्वं दानवा अप्यनेकशः
verses.transliteration: upanīto 'si kālena saṅgrāme mama keśava / ye tvayā nirjitāḥ pūrvaṃ dānavā apyanekaśaḥ
verses.translation: What is called Yamadvlpa 2 is also full of mines of gems. There is a mountain called Dyutiman, embellished with minerals and is the source of many rivers and gold (mines).
verses.hindi: करने वाला, परम एवं श्रेष्ठ हैँ ।२३॥ इसलिये कलि युग के आने पर सांसारिकों के कल्याण के लिये और देवों को अभय देने के लिये मैं दोनों लोकों में मंगलकारक और पुजनीय रहेगा । है महाबली देवगण ! आप लोग कलियुग को देखकर मत डरें । ऋषियों के साथ उन देवगणों से जब महादेव ने इस प्रकार कहा, तब उन लोगों ने सिर नवाकर महादेव को प्रणाम किया और कहा महातेजा महाकायो महावीरयों महाद्युतिः। भीषणः सबंभुतानां कथं कालश्रतु्म् खः २७
verses.wordMeaning: What is called Yamadvlpa 2 is also full of mines of gems. There is a mountain called Dyutiman, embellished with minerals and is the source of many rivers and gold (mines).
verses.commentary: Sense: What is called Yamadvlpa 2 is also full of mines of gems. There is a mountain called Dyutiman, embellished with minerals and is the source of many rivers and gold (mines).

verses.sanskrit: न भवन्ति पुमांसस्ते स्त्रियस्ताश् चैव केशव । परं न शस्त्रसङ्ग्रामं करिष्यामि त्वया सह
verses.transliteration: na bhavanti pumāṃsaste striyastāś caiva keśava / paraṃ na śastrasaṅgrāmaṃ kariṣyāmi tvayā saha
verses.translation: ' Similarly, the Malaya Dvlpa 3 is also surrounded by the ocean. It is the source of gems, jewels and gold. It is very prosperous. It is the place of origin of sandalwood and is surrounded by gulfs (lit. seas). Many kinds of Mleccha tribes live there. There are many rivers and mountains.
verses.hindi: एष कालश्चतुमूं तिश्चतुर्द॒ष्ट्श्चतुमुंखः । लोकसंरक्षणार्थाय अतिक्रामति सबंशः २८ नासाध्यं विद्यते चास्प सर्वस्मिन्सचराचरे  काल: सृजति भृतानि पुनः संहरति क्रमात् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: ' Similarly, the Malaya Dvlpa 3 is also surrounded by the ocean. It is the source of gems, jewels and gold. It is very prosperous. It is the place of origin of sandalwood and is surrounded by gulfs (lit. seas). Many kinds of Mleccha tribes live there.…
verses.commentary: Sense: ' Similarly, the Malaya Dvlpa 3 is also surrounded by the ocean. It is the source of gems, jewels and gold. It is very prosperous. It is the place of origin of sandalwood and is surrounded by gulfs (lit. seas). Many kinds of Mleccha tribes live there.…

verses.sanskrit: वदतो दानवेन्द्रस्य न चुकोप स केशवः । अयुध्यमानं तं दृष्ट्वा चिन्तयामास दानवः
verses.transliteration: vadato dānavendrasya na cukopa sa keśavaḥ / ayudhyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa dānavaḥ
verses.translation: The glorious mountain Malaya is the source of origin of silver. This excellent moutain is famous as Mahamalaya.
verses.hindi: सर्वे कालस्य वशगा न कालः कस्यचिद्वशे। तस्मात्तु सर्वभुतानि कालः कलयते सदा ३० एक पद परिक्रम्य पदानामेकसप्तति: । यदा कालः प्रक़मते तदा मन्वन्लरक्षयः ३२ एवमुक्‍त्वा तु भगवान्देवषिपितृदानवान् । नमस्कृतश्च तेः सर्वेस्तत्रवान्लरभधीयत ॥३ रे एवं स कालो भगवान्देवधिपितृदानवान् । पुनः पुनः संहरते सृजते च पुनः पुनः ३३४ अतो मन्वन्तरे चेव देवषिपितृदानबे: । पृज्यते भगवानीशों भयात्कालस्य तस्य वे
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious mountain Malaya is the source of origin of silver. This excellent moutain is famous as Mahamalaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious mountain Malaya is the source of origin of silver. This excellent moutain is famous as Mahamalaya.

verses.sanskrit: द्वन्द्वयुद्धं करिष्यामि निश्चित्य युयुधे नृप । स कृष्णेन पदाक्षिप्तः पतितः पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration: dvandvayuddhaṃ kariṣyāmi niścitya yuyudhe nṛpa / sa kṛṣṇena padākṣiptaḥ patitaḥ pṛthivītale
verses.translation: It is known as the second Mandara mountain. The abode of Agastya, bowed to by Devas and Asuras, is also there.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्सवंप्रयत्नेन कलो कुर्यात्तपो द्विजा: । प्रपन्नस्य महादेव तस्य पुण्यफल महत् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is known as the second Mandara mountain. The abode of Agastya, bowed to by Devas and Asuras, is also there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is known as the second Mandara mountain. The abode of Agastya, bowed to by Devas and Asuras, is also there.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तात्स समाश्वस्य उत्थायेदं व्यचिन्तयत् । अशक्तो द्वन्द्वयुद्धाय ततः साम प्रयुक्तवान् । पाणिभ्यां सम्पुटं कृत्वा साष्टाङ्गं प्रणतः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: muhūrtātsa samāśvasya utthāyedaṃ vyacintayat / aśakto dvandvayuddhāya tataḥ sāma prayuktavān / pāṇibhyāṃ sampuṭaṃ kṛtvā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇataḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: There is another mountain Kancanapada which is a second Malaya. There are many hermitages there, resorted to by pious persons and full of hedges of grass and Soma plants. It abounds in flowers and fruits of all kinds. It excels even the heaven. On festive occasions, on all Parvan days, heaven descends to that place.
verses.hindi: और सब जीवों के लिये भयंकर काल चार मुख वाले कंसे हुए महादेव जी बोलें--ये काल चार मुँह वाले, चार दाँत वाले और चार मूर्ति वाले हैं। संसार की रक्षा के लिये ये सब का अतिक्रमण कर जाते हैं अर्थात् किसी की अपेक्षा नहीं करते हैं ।२८। इस चराचरमय संसार में इनके लिये असाध्य कुछ नहीं हैं! काल की सृष्टि करते है और फिर क्रम सै उनका संहार भी कर डालते हैं।२६। सभी काल के वह्ष में हैं; किन्तु काल किसी के भी वश में नहीं हैं । इसलिये काल ही
verses.wordMeaning: There is another mountain Kancanapada which is a second Malaya. There are many hermitages there, resorted to by pious persons and full of hedges of grass and Soma plants. It abounds in flowers and fruits of all kinds. It excels even the heaven. On festive occasions,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is another mountain Kancanapada which is a second Malaya. There are many hermitages there, resorted to by pious persons and full of hedges of grass and Soma plants. It abounds in flowers and fruits of all kinds. It excels even the heaven. On festive occasions,…

verses.sanskrit: अन्धक उवाच: जय कृष्णाय हरये विष्णवे जिष्णवे नमः । हृषीकेश जगद्धात्रे अच्युताय महात्मने
verses.transliteration: andhaka uvāca: jaya kṛṣṇāya haraye viṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ / hṛṣīkeśa jagaddhātre acyutāya mahātmane
verses.translation: There is a great city Lanka on the beautiful ridge and peak of the mountain Trikuta decorated with different
verses.hindi: सभी जीवों का संकलन (शासन) करते हैं। पहले कहे गये इक्करीस युग काल का एक डम हैं। घूमने वाले युगों के क्रम से वे ही मन्वन्तर कहलाते हैं। एक-एक पर चलकर जब काल इक्कौस डग रखते हैं, तब मन्वम्तर का क्षय होता है ।३०-३२। शंकर ने इस प्रकार देवता, ऋषि, पितर और दानवों से कहा  यह सुनकर प्रसन्न हो श्रोताओं ने भगवान् को नमस्कार किया तब भगवान् वहीं अन्तहित हो गये ।३३। भगवान् काल
verses.wordMeaning: There is a great city Lanka on the beautiful ridge and peak of the mountain Trikuta decorated with different
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a great city Lanka on the beautiful ridge and peak of the mountain Trikuta decorated with different

verses.sanskrit: नमः पङ्कजनाभाय नमः पङ्कजमालिने । जनार्दनाय श्रीशाय श्रीपते पीतवाससे
