verses.sanskrit: मित्रध्रुक् पिशुनः सोमविक्रयी परनिन्दकः । पितृमातृगुरुत्यागी नित्यं ब्राह्मणनिन्दकः
verses.transliteration: mitradhruk piśunaḥ somavikrayī paranindakaḥ / pitṛmātṛgurutyāgī nityaṃ brāhmaṇanindakaḥ
verses.translation: I shall now describe the rotation of the sun and the moon. 1 These are stationed in the ether along with their discs and shine with their lustre as long as they move. The extent of the earth is half of the extent of the seven oceans and continents (?). The sun and the moon illumi- This is a new section dealing with Puranic astronomy. Bd. P. has given a separate chapter (1,2.21) to this and the text corresponds to our text to a great extent. Revolving all round, the Sun illuminates and protects the three worlds. Hence on account of illumination and protec¬ tion, he is called * Ravi \ The root /ao means 'illumination' (and protection )}
verses.hindi: और उन्होंने सम्पूर्ण ढ्वीप को देखा था, इसी से उत्त देश का नम भद्राश्व पड़ा ।२५। दक्षिण शैल के शिखरु पर देवों द्वारा सेवित, माला से शोभित और सदा फलने-फूलने वाला एक जम्बू वक्ष है जिसकी जड़ें और तना विशाल हैं। जो चिकने और नये पत्तों से सुशोभित हैं। जिसमें सदा फल-फूल लगे रहते हैं और जो अपनी विशाल शाखाओं से शोभित है। उसके सुस्वादु, कोमल अमृत तुल्य बड़ें-बड़े फल पहाड़ के शिखर से
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now describe the rotation of the sun and the moon. 1 These are stationed in the ether along with their discs and shine with their lustre as long as they move. The extent of the earth is half of the extent of the seven oceans and continents (?).…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now describe the rotation of the sun and the moon. 1 These are stationed in the ether along with their discs and shine with their lustre as long as they move. The extent of the earth is half of the extent of the seven oceans and continents (?).…

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रान्नं मन्त्रसंयुक्तं यो विप्रो भक्षयेन्नृप । सो ऽस्पृश्यः कर्मचाण्डालः स्पृष्ट्वा स्नानं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: śūdrānnaṃ mantrasaṃyuktaṃ yo vipro bhakṣayennṛpa / so 'spṛśyaḥ karmacāṇḍālaḥ spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: Now I shall mention the magnitude of the moon and The extent of Bharata is equal to the extent of the vastly extensive disc of the sun. Now listen to the number of Yojanas it covers. The extent of the sun is nine thousand Yojanas. The girth or the extent of its disc is thrice its diameter. The lunar disc is twice the solar disc (in diameter as well as girth).
verses.hindi: टपकते रहते हैं ।२६-२८। जिस कारण उस पवं॑त श्रेष्ठ के एक गण्ड देश से जम्बू नाम की नदी बह निकली है, जिसमें मधुतुल्य रस प्रवाहित होता रहता है। उस नदी से अग्नि के समान कान्ति वाला जाम्बूनद नाम का पापविनाशी सुवर्ण उत्पन्न होता है. जो देवों के अनृपम अलड्ूार के काम आता है ।२६-३०। देव, दानव, गन्धवं, राक्षस, पन्नग आदि अमृत तुल्य मधुर उस जम्बू रस को पीते रहते हैं। दक्षिण द्वीप में वह केतुस्वरूप जम्बू वक्ष निखिल जम्बूलोक में विख्यात है, जिसके नाम पर ही वह द्वीप सदा से जम्बू द्वीप कहा जा रहा है ।३१-३२। महात्मा स्वरूप उस विशाल शैल के पश्चिम छुद्ध पर एक बहुत बड़ा पीपल का वक्ष है। उसमें लटकती हुईं एक माला टंगी है उसका तना और शाखाएँ बहुत बड़ी-बड़ी और ऊँची हैं। भाँति-भाँति के जीव
verses.wordMeaning: Now I shall mention the magnitude of the moon and The extent of Bharata is equal to the extent of the vastly extensive disc of the sun. Now listen to the number of Yojanas it covers. The extent of the sun is nine thousand Yojanas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall mention the magnitude of the moon and The extent of Bharata is equal to the extent of the vastly extensive disc of the sun. Now listen to the number of Yojanas it covers. The extent of the sun is nine thousand Yojanas.…

verses.sanskrit: कुनखी वृषली स्तेयी वार्द्धुष्यः कुण्डगोलकौ । महादानरतो यश्च यश्चात्महनने रतः
verses.transliteration: kunakhī vṛṣalī steyī vārddhuṣyaḥ kuṇḍagolakau / mahādānarato yaśca yaścātmahanane rataḥ
verses.translation: Now I shall recount the extent of the earth in Yojanas. The extent and girth (circumference) of the earth consisting of seven continents has been reckoned in proper mea¬ sure in the Puranas. I shall recount that after enumerating the current Abhimanins (Deities etc. who preside or have the sense of possession etc.). Those Abhimanins who have gone were on a par with the current ones. The Devas who have gone are on a par with, the current ones in forms and names. Hence, I shall describe the surface of the earth through the current Devas. (I shall recount) the situation of the heavenly world entirely through the current (Devas). The entire earth is known as fifty crores (of Yojanas) in extent. From the middle of Meru on all four sides is half
verses.hindi: कुम्भप्रमाणः सुस्वाद: फल: सर्वतुकेः शुभ: । सकेतुः केतुमालानां देवगन्धवसेवितः
verses.wordMeaning: Now I shall recount the extent of the earth in Yojanas. The extent and girth (circumference) of the earth consisting of seven continents has been reckoned in proper mea¬ sure in the Puranas. I shall recount that after enumerating the current Abhimanins (Deities etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall recount the extent of the earth in Yojanas. The extent and girth (circumference) of the earth consisting of seven continents has been reckoned in proper mea¬ sure in the Puranas. I shall recount that after enumerating the current Abhimanins (Deities etc.…

verses.sanskrit: भृतकाध्यापकः क्लीबः कन्यादूष्यभिशस्तकः । एते विप्राः सदा त्याज्याः परिभाव्य प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: bhṛtakādhyāpakaḥ klībaḥ kanyādūṣyabhiśastakaḥ / ete viprāḥ sadā tyājyāḥ paribhāvya prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Half the extent of the earth is stated in terms of Yojanas. The extent of the earth towards all the sides (quarters) from the middle of Meru is said to be eleven crores and eighty- nine lakhs (of Yojanas) and fifty thousand * 2 ). It is considered as the radius of the circular zone. The sphere at the extremity is thrice this in extent. On being calculated thus the spherical zone of the extremity of the earth has the overall area of eleven crores one hundred and thirty-seven thousand Yojanas. Thus the measurement upto the extremity of the earth has been specified:
verses.hindi: केतुमालेति च यथा तस्या नाम प्रकोतितम् । तन्निबोधत विप्रेन्द्रा निस्‍क्‍्त नाम कर्मेतः सहल्ाकेण विहिता माला तस्प सुतानिता । तस्य स्कन्चे समासकत्या द्यश्वत्थस्थ वनस्पतेः. ३८ सा तथैव महागन्धा ह्यम्लाना सर्वकामिकी । इज्यते सुमहाभागा विविधेः सिद्धचारणः ३३६ तस्य केतोः सदा माला देवदत्ता विराजते  पवनेनेरिता दिव्यं वाति गन्ध मनोरमसम् (३४० ताभ्यां नामाडितो द्वीप: पश्चिमे बहुविस्तर: । केतुमाल इति ख्यातो दिवि चेह च सर्वेंश: . ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Half the extent of the earth is stated in terms of Yojanas. The extent of the earth towards all the sides (quarters) from the middle of Meru is said to be eleven crores and eighty- nine lakhs (of Yojanas) and fifty thousand * 2 ).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Half the extent of the earth is stated in terms of Yojanas. The extent of the earth towards all the sides (quarters) from the middle of Meru is said to be eleven crores and eighty- nine lakhs (of Yojanas) and fifty thousand * 2 ).…

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिग्रहं गृहीत्वा तु वाणिज्यं यस्तु कारयेत् । तस्य दानं न दातव्यं वृथा भवति तस्य तत्
verses.transliteration: pratigrahaṃ gṛhītvā tu vāṇijyaṃ yastu kārayet / tasya dānaṃ na dātavyaṃ vṛthā bhavati tasya tat
verses.translation: The outer surface of the globular sphere of the earth is co-extensive with the sphere of the stars in the firmament. In regard to the magnitude of the outer surface the firmament is equal to the earth. The same is the measure of all the seven worlds. The worlds arc situated above oneanother spreading like an umbrella with their outer spheres. They are all populat¬ ed. Thus the cauldron of the Cosmic Egg has been explained. These seven worlds shaped in the form of umbrellas are severally supported by their own subtle outer coverings, which are ten times bigger in order. They are created with specific attributes and they support the seven worlds.
verses.hindi: साल्यदामकलापेश्च विविधर्गेन्‍्थशालिशि: । शाखाविलम्बी शुशुभ सिद्धवारणसेवितः १३४ ३ प्रवालकुम्भसदू मंधुपृणें: फलेः सदा । स ह्युतरकुरूणां तु केतृवक्ष: प्रकाशते ४४ सनत्कुमारा वरजा मानसा ब्रह्मणः सुताः। सप्त तत्र महाभागाः कुरबो नाम विश्वुताः ३४४
verses.wordMeaning: The outer surface of the globular sphere of the earth is co-extensive with the sphere of the stars in the firmament. In regard to the magnitude of the outer surface the firmament is equal to the earth. The same is the measure of all the seven worlds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The outer surface of the globular sphere of the earth is co-extensive with the sphere of the stars in the firmament. In regard to the magnitude of the outer surface the firmament is equal to the earth. The same is the measure of all the seven worlds.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रुताध्ययनसम्पन्ना ये द्विजा वृत्ततत्पराः । तेषां यद्दीयते दानं सर्वमक्षयतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: śrutādhyayanasampannā ye dvijā vṛttatatparāḥ / teṣāṃ yaddīyate dānaṃ sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet
verses.translation: All round this Cosmic Egg there is a solid ocean. The entire sphere of the earth is supported by the solid water. 1 Beyond the solid ocean is the solid fire by which the sphere of the world is supported. Beyond and outside the solid fire is the sphere of solid wind that covers the earth on all sides round and above. Beyond the solid wind is the firmament which is surrounded by Cosmic Ego entirely. That Ego is surrounded by Mahat (the Great Principle or Intellect) which again is surrounded by the infinite Unmanifest Prak r ti of un¬ changing form. I shall enumerate in order the cities of the guardians
verses.hindi: उसके नीचे और ऊपर बसेरा लिये हुये हैं। उसके नीचे की भूमि सुवर्ण और मणियों से खचित है। सभी ऋतुओं में घड़े के समान बड़े बड़े सुस्वादु फल उसमें लगे रहते है। देव-गन्धर्वे भी उस वृक्ष की सेवा किया करते हैं ।३३-३५। वह वृक्ष केतुमाल देश की ध्वजा के समान है। विप्रो ! सुनिये उस देश का नाभ केतुमाल क्यों पड़ा । क्षीर सागर के मथन काल में जब हैत्य पक्ष पराजित हो गया, तब इन्द्र ने अपने गले से माला उत्तार कर इसी पीपल वृक्ष के स्कन्ध॑ में लटका दी, वह माला समर में देत्यों द्वारा फेंके गये वक्षों से चोट खाकर मुर्शा गई थी ।३६-३७। सर्व॑ सिद्धिप्रदाथिनी वह अति सुरिभित माला अम्लान भाव से से अब तक वहाँ टेंगी है । उस महाभाग्यशालिनी माला की पूजा अभी भी सिद्ध चोरण आदि करते हैं। उस केतु रूप ब॒क्ष पर देवराज द्वारा टाँगी हुई माला सदा विराजती रहती है और वायु के भोंके से हिंलने पर उससे मनोहर
verses.wordMeaning: All round this Cosmic Egg there is a solid ocean. The entire sphere of the earth is supported by the solid water. 1 Beyond the solid ocean is the solid fire by which the sphere of the world is supported.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All round this Cosmic Egg there is a solid ocean. The entire sphere of the earth is supported by the solid water. 1 Beyond the solid ocean is the solid fire by which the sphere of the world is supported.…

verses.sanskrit: दरिद्रान्भर भूपाल मा समृद्धान् कदाचन । व्याधितस्यौषधं पथ्यं नीरुजस्य किमौषधैः
verses.transliteration: daridrānbhara bhūpāla mā samṛddhān kadācana / vyādhitasyauṣadhaṃ pathyaṃ nīrujasya kimauṣadhaiḥ
verses.translation: This Puranic concept of seven protective sheaths of our Cosmic Egg shows the influence of Sankhya Tattoos. To the east of Meru and above Manasa is the holy city of Mahendra abounding in all essential riches and richly inlaid with gold. To the south of Meru and above Manasa lives Yama son of Vivasvan, in his city Samyamana. To the west of Meru and above Manasa is the charm¬ ing city of the intelligent Varuna. It is called Sukha.
verses.hindi: गंध निकलती रहती है ।२८-४०। इसलिये केतु और माला से चिह्नित होने के कारण पद्चिचम में विस्तृत द्वीप स्वर्ग तथां मृत्युलोक में केतुमाल नाभ से प्रसिद्ध है। उसी के पाइ्ब॑ में उत्तर शिखर पर एक बड़ा वट वक्ष भी है, जो अनेक योजनों में फैला हुआ है। विविध गरन्धयुक्त माला-कलाप से सुशोभित उस वृक्ष की सिद्ध- चारण सदा सेवां करते रहते हैं।४१-४३। घड़े के सदेश लाल-लाल मीठे फलों से वह सदा युक्त रहता है
verses.wordMeaning: This Puranic concept of seven protective sheaths of our Cosmic Egg shows the influence of Sankhya Tattoos. To the east of Meru and above Manasa is the holy city of Mahendra abounding in all essential riches and richly inlaid with gold.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This Puranic concept of seven protective sheaths of our Cosmic Egg shows the influence of Sankhya Tattoos. To the east of Meru and above Manasa is the holy city of Mahendra abounding in all essential riches and richly inlaid with gold.…

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपाद उवाच: कीदृशो ऽथ विधिस्तत्र तीर्थश्राद्धस्य का क्रिया । दानं च दीयते यद्वत् तन्ममाख्याहि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: uttānapāda uvāca: kīdṛśo 'tha vidhistatra tīrthaśrāddhasya kā kriyā / dānaṃ ca dīyate yadvat tanmamākhyāhi śaṅkara
verses.translation: To the north of Meru and above Manasa is the city Vibhavari of Soma (the moon) which is comparable to the city of Mahendra. Above Manasa in all the four quarters the guardians of the worlds are stationed for the establishment of virtue (Dharma) and protection of the worlds. Understand the solar movement when the sun reaches south during the southern transit all round above the guardians of the worlds.
verses.hindi: और उत्तर कुंछ का केतु वृक्ष कहलाता है। सनंत्कुमारं आदि महाभाग श्रेष्ठ ब्रह्मपुत्रों के नामानुसार ही उसका कुरु नाम पड़ा है ।४४-४५। उन पुण्य बौौतिवाले बअहज्ञानी महात्माओं ने उस अविनाशी, मंगलास्पद तथा तत्न तेरागतज्ञाने: सत्त्वस्थेः पुण्यकीतिभिः । अक्षय हेमसपरं लोक प्राप्त सनातनम् ४६
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Meru and above Manasa is the city Vibhavari of Soma (the moon) which is comparable to the city of Mahendra. Above Manasa in all the four quarters the guardians of the worlds are stationed for the establishment of virtue (Dharma) and protection of the worlds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Meru and above Manasa is the city Vibhavari of Soma (the moon) which is comparable to the city of Mahendra. Above Manasa in all the four quarters the guardians of the worlds are stationed for the establishment of virtue (Dharma) and protection of the worlds.…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: श्राद्धं कृत्वा गृहे भक्त्या शुचिश्चापि जितेन्द्रियः । गुरुं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य भोज्य सीमान्तके ततः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhe bhaktyā śuciścāpi jitendriyaḥ / guruṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhojya sīmāntake tataḥ
verses.translation: In his transit to the south, the sun moves fast like a discharged arrow. It takes the group of luminary bodies with it and revolves always. When the sun is in miclday in Sukha, the city of Varuna, it rises in Vibhavarl, the city of Soma. It is midnight in Amaravatl and the sun sets in the city of Yaraa. Then the sun is in midday in Vibha, thecitv of Soma. When the sun rises in Amaravatl, it is midnight in Samyamana and the sun sets in the city of Varuna. Making the stars (and planets) whirl and revolving itself like a fiicbiand, the sun sots and then rises quickly.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते जम्बूद्वीपवर्णनं नाम पश्चबिंशोडष्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: In his transit to the south, the sun moves fast like a discharged arrow. It takes the group of luminary bodies with it and revolves always. When the sun is in miclday in Sukha, the city of Varuna, it rises in Vibhavarl, the city of Soma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In his transit to the south, the sun moves fast like a discharged arrow. It takes the group of luminary bodies with it and revolves always. When the sun is in miclday in Sukha, the city of Varuna, it rises in Vibhavarl, the city of Soma.…

verses.sanskrit: वाग्यतः प्रव्रजेत् तावद् यावत् सीमां न लङ्घयेत् । शूलभेदं ततो गत्वा स्नानं कुर्याद् यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: vāgyataḥ pravrajet tāvad yāvat sīmāṃ na laṅghayet / śūlabhedaṃ tato gatvā snānaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Thus the sun moves in the four continents ending with the southern one. It rises and sets again and again. The sun gives warmth to two abodes of Devas in the forenoon and two in the afternoon. With its rays alone it heats one of them during midday. After rising the sun blazes with its rays of increasing heat till midday. Thereafter with its rays of decreasing heat it sets.
verses.hindi: तेषां चतुर्णा वक्ष्यामि शलेन्द्राणां यथाक्रमम् । अनुबन्धानि रभ्याणि सर्वेकालर्तुकानि च॑ १११ सारिकाभिमंयूरेश्च चकोरंश्र मदोत्कटे: । शुकेश्व भूडराजैश्व चित्रकेश्व समन्‍्ततः जीवडजी वकनादेश्य हेमकानां च नादित: । मत्तकोकिलनादंश्व वल्गुनां च निनादिते: 0३
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the sun moves in the four continents ending with the southern one. It rises and sets again and again. The sun gives warmth to two abodes of Devas in the forenoon and two in the afternoon. With its rays alone it heats one of them during midday.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the sun moves in the four continents ending with the southern one. It rises and sets again and again. The sun gives warmth to two abodes of Devas in the forenoon and two in the afternoon. With its rays alone it heats one of them during midday.…

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चस्थानेषु च श्राद्धं हव्यकव्यादिभिः क्रमात् । पिण्डदानं च यः कुर्यात् पायसैर् मधुसर्पिषा
verses.transliteration: pañcasthāneṣu ca śrāddhaṃ havyakavyādibhiḥ kramāt / piṇḍadānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāt pāyasair madhusarpiṣā
verses.translation: Where the sun appears rising, it is known as sunrise to the people thereof; (while) where the sun vanishes, it is called sunset in regard to the people there. Due to the far distant position of the sun and being covered up by the line (horizon) of the earth, its rays become invisible (being obstructed from sight). Hence it is not seen at night. The appearance of the planets, stars and the sun as well as their rising and setting should be known by the magni¬ tude of their height. Fire and water have white lustre and the earth ha? black shadow. Since the sun is at a great distance at the time of rising, it appears to be without rays. Since it is without rays, it has the red lustre, and the absence of heat is due to its redness.
verses.hindi: शाश्वत लोक को प्राप्त किया । उन्हीं सातों महात्माओं के वाम पर उस द्वीप का नामकरण हुआ है और वेहं इस लोक तथा स्वगे में उत्तर कुरु के नाभ से विख्यात है
verses.wordMeaning: Where the sun appears rising, it is known as sunrise to the people thereof; (while) where the sun vanishes, it is called sunset in regard to the people there. Due to the far distant position of the sun and being covered up by the line (horizon) of the earth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Where the sun appears rising, it is known as sunrise to the people thereof; (while) where the sun vanishes, it is called sunset in regard to the people there. Due to the far distant position of the sun and being covered up by the line (horizon) of the earth,…

verses.sanskrit: पितरस्तस्य तृप्यन्ति द्वादशाब्दानि पञ्च च । अक्षतैर् बदरैर् बिल्वैर् गुदमधुसर्पिषा
verses.transliteration: pitarastasya tṛpyanti dvādaśābdāni pañca ca / akṣatair badarair bilvair gudamadhusarpiṣā
verses.translation: Wherever the sun is seen to be stationed on the line (of horizon) it is seen a thousand Yojanas above. When the sunsets, the brilliance of the sun partially enters fires. Hence fire shines more brilliantly at night, even from a distance. When the sun rises again, the brilliance of fire enters the sun. This together with the brilliance left in the sun at the time of sunset, makes it all the more brilliant. So the sun blazes during the day.
verses.hindi: सुतजी बोले--अब हम यथाक्रम से उन चारों प्वतों के रमणीय स्थानों का वेंणेन करते हैं। संभी कालों में वहाँ ऋतुकालीन फल पुष्प लगे रहते हैं।१। वहाँ सवंत्र सारिका, मयूर, मदोत्कट चक्रीर, णुक और
verses.wordMeaning: Wherever the sun is seen to be stationed on the line (of horizon) it is seen a thousand Yojanas above. When the sunsets, the brilliance of the sun partially enters fires. Hence fire shines more brilliantly at night, even from a distance. When the sun rises again,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherever the sun is seen to be stationed on the line (of horizon) it is seen a thousand Yojanas above. When the sunsets, the brilliance of the sun partially enters fires. Hence fire shines more brilliantly at night, even from a distance. When the sun rises again,…

verses.sanskrit: सापि तत्फलमाप्नोति तीर्थे ऽस्मिन्नात्र संशयः । उपानहौ च यो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: sāpi tatphalamāpnoti tīrthe 'sminnātra saṃśayaḥ / upānahau ca yo dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: The light and heat of the sun and fire getting mixed together nourish people during day and night. In the northern and southern halves of the earth when the sun rises, night enters waters. Hence, during day waters are copper-coloured as a result of the entry of night. When the sun sets, day enters waters. Hence during night, water appears white and bright as a result of the entry In this manner, in the southern and northern halves of the earth, day and night enter waters at the time of sunset and sunrise.
verses.hindi: चित्र-विचित्र भृज़॑राज विचरंण करते रंहते हैं ।२। जीवंजीवक, हेमक, मत्तकोकिल, बल्गु, सुकण्ठ काञ्चन,
verses.wordMeaning: The light and heat of the sun and fire getting mixed together nourish people during day and night. In the northern and southern halves of the earth when the sun rises, night enters waters. Hence, during day waters are copper-coloured as a result of the entry of night.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The light and heat of the sun and fire getting mixed together nourish people during day and night. In the northern and southern halves of the earth when the sun rises, night enters waters. Hence, during day waters are copper-coloured as a result of the entry of night.…

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि स्वर्गम् अवाप्नोति हयारूढो न संशयः । शय्यामश्वं च यो दद्याच्छत्त्रिकां वा विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi svargam avāpnoti hayārūḍho na saṃśayaḥ / śayyāmaśvaṃ ca yo dadyācchattrikāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Day is the time when there is sunlight and night is the time when there is darkness. Hence, night is established (independently) due to this, while day is dependent on the sun. When the sun passes through the middle of the sky, it traverses one-thirtieth of the diameter of the earth in a Muhurta (forty-eight minutes). In regard to the distance traversed in Yojanas, f a! 111 1S three million one hundred and fifty thousand in lull. This is the distance traversed by the sun in one Muhurta.
verses.hindi: २७० ...वायुपुराणम् सुग्रीवकाचतरबः कलविड्धू-रुतेस्तथा । कूजितान्तरशब्दश्व सुरम्याणि च सबृशः ४ मदोत्कटमंधुकरेशञ्न मरेश्व महालसे: । उपगीतवनान्तानि किन्नरेश्व क्वचित्क्वचित् क्‍ ५
verses.wordMeaning: Day is the time when there is sunlight and night is the time when there is darkness. Hence, night is established (independently) due to this, while day is dependent on the sun. When the sun passes through the middle of the sky,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Day is the time when there is sunlight and night is the time when there is darkness. Hence, night is established (independently) due to this, while day is dependent on the sun. When the sun passes through the middle of the sky,…

verses.sanskrit: गच्छेद् विमानमारूढः सो ऽप्सरोवृन्दवेष्टितः । उत्तमं यो गृहं दद्यात् सप्तधान्यसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: gacched vimānamārūḍhaḥ so 'psarovṛndaveṣṭitaḥ / uttamaṃ yo gṛhaṃ dadyāt saptadhānyasamanvitam
verses.translation: The extent of the zone in the northern quarter in Yojanas as calculated by the Brahmanas is one crore eight million and fiftyeight Yojanas. The northern orbit is called Nagavlthl 1 and the southern one is called Ajavlthl. When the sun rises in the constellations Mula, Purvasadha and Uttarasadha it is called Ajavlthl. When the sun rises during the rise of the three stars after Abhijit (i.e. Asvini, Bharani and Krttika) it is called Nagavlthl. I shall mention the distance in Yojanas between these two quarters. This distance is three million one hundred and three thousand three hundred and thirtythree Yojanas. Now I shall mention the distance between the south¬ ern cardinal points and meridians in Yojanas. Understand it.
verses.hindi: नानाधातुविचित्रेश्च कान्तरूपे: शिलाशते: । शल्लें: क्वचिव्हिजश्रेष्ठा विन्यस्तं: शोभितानि च.
verses.wordMeaning: The extent of the zone in the northern quarter in Yojanas as calculated by the Brahmanas is one crore eight million and fiftyeight Yojanas. The northern orbit is called Nagavlthl 1 and the southern one is called Ajavlthl. When the sun rises in the constellations Mula,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The extent of the zone in the northern quarter in Yojanas as calculated by the Brahmanas is one crore eight million and fiftyeight Yojanas. The northern orbit is called Nagavlthl 1 and the southern one is called Ajavlthl. When the sun rises in the constellations Mula,…

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छया मे वसेल्लोके काञ्चने भवने हि सः । तिलधेनुं च यो दद्यात् सवत्सां वस्त्रसंप्लुताम्
verses.transliteration: svecchayā me vaselloke kāñcane bhavane hi saḥ / tiladhenuṃ ca yo dadyāt savatsāṃ vastrasaṃplutām
verses.translation: The magnitude of this zone is twentyone thou¬ sand two hundred and twentyone Yojanas. This is the measure¬ ment of the zone calculated in Yojanas. The diameter of the zone is laid obliquely. Everyday the sun traverses those (zones) indue order. Just as the outer rim of the potter's wheel comes back (revolves) quickly, so also the sun returns quickly during its southern transit.
verses.hindi: देवदानवगन्धर्वेयक्षराक्षसपन्नग: । सिद्धाप्सरोगणश्चेब सेदितानि ततस्ततः ... ॥ मनोहराणि चत्वारि देवाक़ीडनकान्येथ । चतुदिशमुदाराणि नाग्ना श्रुणुत तानि से नेविस्तीर्णतीर्थानि महापुण्यवनानि च । महानागाधिवासानि सेवितानि महात्मभिः १३ सुरसामलतोयानि शिवानि सुसुखानि च । सिद्धदेवासु रबर रुपस्पृष्टजलानि च १४
verses.wordMeaning: The magnitude of this zone is twentyone thou¬ sand two hundred and twentyone Yojanas. This is the measure¬ ment of the zone calculated in Yojanas. The diameter of the zone is laid obliquely. Everyday the sun traverses those (zones) indue order.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The magnitude of this zone is twentyone thou¬ sand two hundred and twentyone Yojanas. This is the measure¬ ment of the zone calculated in Yojanas. The diameter of the zone is laid obliquely. Everyday the sun traverses those (zones) indue order.…

verses.sanskrit: नाकपृष्ठे वसेत् तावद् यावद् आभूतसम्प्लवम् । गृहे वा यदि वारण्ये तीर्थवर्त्मनि वा नृप
verses.transliteration: nākapṛṣṭhe vaset tāvad yāvad ābhūtasamplavam / gṛhe vā yadi vāraṇye tīrthavartmani vā nṛpa
verses.translation: According to Varahamihira's B r hat-Samhitd, Vithi is a particular division of the planetary sphere comprising of three astensms. Thus Naga- vlthi is constituted of asterisms Asvini, Bharani and Krtti a w i e javi formed of Mula; Purvasadha and Uttarasadha. Tlie sun passes through tliirtccn and a half constella¬ tions of stars during the day. During the night in eighteen Muhurtas it passes through as many (i.e. thirteen and a half) of stars. Just as the central region of the potters wheel moves slowly, so also in the course of the northern transit the sun moves slowly. The sun passes through thirteen and a half stars. Hence it covers less extent of the earth in longer time.
verses.hindi: कलविक आदि पक्षियों के मधुर निनाद से उनके प्रान्तर भाग सदा गुृंजित और सुरम्य बने रहते हैं। मतवाले अतएव अलसाये मधुकरों, श्रमरों से तथा किन्नरों से भी कहीं-कहीं वह वन मुखरित रहता है। कोमल पल्‍लवों से सुशोभित सब वृक्ष वहाँ मनन्‍्द यारुतसे कंपाये जाने पर सदा पुष्पवृष्टि करते हुये देखे जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: According to Varahamihira's B r hat-Samhitd, Vithi is a particular division of the planetary sphere comprising of three astensms. Thus Naga- vlthi is constituted of asterisms Asvini, Bharani and Krtti a w i e javi formed of Mula; Purvasadha and Uttarasadha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: According to Varahamihira's B r hat-Samhitd, Vithi is a particular division of the planetary sphere comprising of three astensms. Thus Naga- vlthi is constituted of asterisms Asvini, Bharani and Krtti a w i e javi formed of Mula; Purvasadha and Uttarasadha.…

verses.sanskrit: तोयमन्नं च यो दद्याद् यमलोकं स नेक्षते । सर्वदानानि दीयन्ते तेषां फलम् अवाप्यते
verses.transliteration: toyamannaṃ ca yo dadyād yamalokaṃ sa nekṣate / sarvadānāni dīyante teṣāṃ phalam avāpyate
verses.translation: In the later part of the northern transit, a day has the duration of eighteen Muhurtas. Then also the sun proceeds very slowly. The sun passes through thirteen and a half stars dur- ing half the time (i.e. the daytime). During night, it passes through as many stars in the course of eighteen Muhurtas. Just as a ball of clay placed on the middle of the wheel whirls slowly, so also does the Pole Star.
verses.hindi: फूलों के गुच्छे, मंजरियाँ और लाल-लाल पत्तें मन्दवायु के झोंके से सदा हिलते हुये ऐसे जान पड़ते हैं मानों हिंडोले पड़े हों । ब्राह्मणों ! नाना धातुओं से विचित्र अतएवं रमणीय शत-शत शिलाएं और हल्ल ( पपड़ियाँ ) इध र-उधघर पड़े हुये हैं, जिससे सारा वन-प्रान्त सुशोभित रहता है ।७-८। जहाँ-तहाँ सिद्ध, देव, दानव, गन्धर्वे, पक्ष, राक्षस, पतन्नग, सिद्ध और अप्सरागण भी वहाँ घमते-फिरते रहते हैं । वहाँ देवताओं के चार क्रीड़ावन हैंजो रमणीय और विस्तृत हैं। उनके नामों को सुनिये ।६-१०। पूर्व में चेत्रथवन, दक्षिण में नन्‍्दनवन, पश्चिम में वेश्राज और उत्तर में सवितृवन है। इन चारों वनों का भीतरी स्थान-संनिवेश बड़ा ही मनोहर है। वहां सदा ही पक्षिकुल कलरव करता रहता है। उन वनों में बड़े-बड़े तीथं, पुथ्यस्थान हैं। जहाँ बड़े-बड़े नाग निवास करते हैं और महात्मा भी विराजते रहते हैं।११-१३। वहाँ के जलाशयों, का जल सुमधुर,
verses.wordMeaning: In the later part of the northern transit, a day has the duration of eighteen Muhurtas. Then also the sun proceeds very slowly. The sun passes through thirteen and a half stars dur- ing half the time (i.e. the daytime). During night,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the later part of the northern transit, a day has the duration of eighteen Muhurtas. Then also the sun proceeds very slowly. The sun passes through thirteen and a half stars dur- ing half the time (i.e. the daytime). During night,…

verses.sanskrit: उदकं चात्र दानं च दद्याद् अभयम् एव च । अन्नदानात् परं दानं न भूतं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: udakaṃ cātra dānaṃ ca dadyād abhayam eva ca / annadānāt paraṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: They say that day and night together constitute thirty Muhurtas. The whirling Pole between the two quarters revolves in a circle. Just as the nave of the potter's wheel remains there only, similarly it should be known that the Pole Star whirls there only (without changing its place). Thus the rotation of the sun in a circle between the two quarters is slow during day and fast during night. During the northern transit, the movement of the moon (?) is slow during day and fast during night.
verses.hindi: निर्मल, सुखद और मंगलकर हैं, क्‍योंकि वहाँ की जलराशि सिद्धों, देवों और राक्षसों आदि के द्वारा स्पर्श की गई है। छाते की तरह बड़े-बड़े मनोहर, सृगन्धित और बड़ी पंखड़ियों वाले पुण्डरीक और उत्पलों से वे जलाशय शोभायमान हैं  वहाँ बड़े-बड़े चार सरोवर भी हैं। उनके नामों को भी सुनिये ।१४-१५। पूव में
verses.wordMeaning: They say that day and night together constitute thirty Muhurtas. The whirling Pole between the two quarters revolves in a circle. Just as the nave of the potter's wheel remains there only,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that day and night together constitute thirty Muhurtas. The whirling Pole between the two quarters revolves in a circle. Just as the nave of the potter's wheel remains there only,…

verses.sanskrit: कन्यादानं तु यः कुर्याद् वृषं वा यः समुत्सृजेत् । तस्य वासो भवेत् तत्र यत्राहम् इति नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: kanyādānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryād vṛṣaṃ vā yaḥ samutsṛjet / tasya vāso bhavet tatra yatrāham iti nānyathā
verses.translation: Dividing nights and days thus by its special diverse movements, the sun traverses the path by its even (regular) and uneven (irregular) movement. Agastya (the star Canopus) traverses quickly over the guar lans of the worlds stationed in the four quarters over the mountain o aloka. He divides days and nights by diverse He is the protector of the worlds to the south of Naga-
verses.hindi: अरुणोदं च पूर्वेण ये च शेलास्ततः स्घृताः । तास्कीत्य॑मानांस्तत्त्वेन श्रृणुध्व॑ बविस्तरान्मम महानीलो5थ रुचकः सबिन्दुमंन्दरस्तथा । वेणुमांश्व सुमेधश्च निषधो देवपर्वत ११६ इत्येते पर्वतवरा अन्ये च गिरयस्तथा । पुर्वेण मन्दरस्यते सिद्धवासा उदाहता:
verses.wordMeaning: Dividing nights and days thus by its special diverse movements, the sun traverses the path by its even (regular) and uneven (irregular) movement.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Dividing nights and days thus by its special diverse movements, the sun traverses the path by its even (regular) and uneven (irregular) movement.…

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपाद उवाच: कन्यादानं कथं स्वामिन् कर्तव्यं धार्मिकैः सदा । परिग्रहो यथा पोष्यः कन्योद्वाहस् तथैव च
verses.transliteration: uttānapāda uvāca: kanyādānaṃ kathaṃ svāmin kartavyaṃ dhārmikaiḥ sadā / parigraho yathā poṣyaḥ kanyodvāhas tathaiva ca
verses.translation: There is as much of sunlight at the sides, behind and all round Lokaloka as there is on its top in front. This mountain is above ten thousand Yojanas in height. It ispartlybright and partly unilluminated. It is circular all round. The stars, the moon, the sun and planets shine within the internal part of mount Lokaloka. The world is only so far and no further. Beyond this there is darkness. The Lokaloka is single but Niralokas (the darker sides) are numerous.
verses.hindi: सरसो मानसस्नेह दक्षिण ये महाचला: । ये कीतिता मया ते व नामतस्तान्निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: There is as much of sunlight at the sides, behind and all round Lokaloka as there is on its top in front. This mountain is above ten thousand Yojanas in height. It ispartlybright and partly unilluminated. It is circular all round. The stars, the moon,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is as much of sunlight at the sides, behind and all round Lokaloka as there is on its top in front. This mountain is above ten thousand Yojanas in height. It ispartlybright and partly unilluminated. It is circular all round. The stars, the moon,…

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्पृच्छामि देवेश कस्य कन्या न दीयते । दातव्यं कुत्र तद्देव कस्मै दत्तम् अथाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: anyatpṛcchāmi deveśa kasya kanyā na dīyate / dātavyaṃ kutra taddeva kasmai dattam athākṣayam
verses.translation: Since the sun in its circular movement unites the Lokaloka, the wise call the inter-space between Usa and Vyusti by the name Sandhya. Usa is night and Vyusti is day. A curse was cast on the wicked demons who were bent on devouring the sun at the time of twilight that they would have imperishability of bodies but they would be made to die (everyday). Three crores of demons who are well-known as Mandehas seek everyday the rise of the sun. The wicked ones harass and desire to devour the blazing sun.
verses.hindi: सुवक्षा: शिखिशेलश्च कालो बेदूर्यपर्वृतः  कपिल: पिड्गलो रुद्र: सुरसश्च महाचल: (२७ अरुणोद. दक्षिण में मानस, परिचम में शीतोद और उत्तर में महाभद्र नामक चार सरोवर हैं।१६। अरुणोद सरोवर के पूर्व में जो पव॑ंत आदि हैं, उनके तत्त्व का हम बिस्तार से वर्णन करते हैं, सुनिये ।१७। शज्ञीतान्त॑, कुमुञ्ज, सुवीर, विकद्धू, मणिशील, कृष्ण, महानील सविन्दु. मन्दर, रेणुमासू सुमेध निषध और देवाचल । इतने तथा अन्यान्य और भी पर्वतगण मन्दर के पूरब में वर्तमान हैं, जो सिद्धों के आवास हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Since the sun in its circular movement unites the Lokaloka, the wise call the inter-space between Usa and Vyusti by the name Sandhya. Usa is night and Vyusti is day.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the sun in its circular movement unites the Lokaloka, the wise call the inter-space between Usa and Vyusti by the name Sandhya. Usa is night and Vyusti is day.…

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमं मध्यमं वापि कनीयः स्यात् कथं विभो । राजसं तामसं वापि निःश्रेयसम् अथापि वा
verses.transliteration: uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ vāpi kanīyaḥ syāt kathaṃ vibho / rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ vāpi niḥśreyasam athāpi vā
verses.translation: Then there was a t errific fight between them and the sun. The excellent Brahmanas, Devas and Brahma who had been performing the worship of Sandhya sprinkled the holy water sanctified by Omkara and Gayatri. As the water became adamantine, the Daityas were burnt. Then the sun of great splendour, excessive lustre and valour rises up a hundred thousand Yojanas. Then goes forth the Lord (the Sun-god) with his bril¬ liant rays. He is surrounded by Brahmanas and Valakhilya Sages who have achieved their object (of protecting the Sun). verses.translation: The period of three Muhurtas from the early morning is called Safigava (forenoon). The period of three Muhurtas after forenoon is called Madhyahna (midday). The period of three Muhurtas from midday is called Aparahna (afternoon). When the sun is in the equinox, day and the night each consists of fifteen Muhurtas. During the transit of the sun to the north and south the duration of day increases and decreases accordingly. Day swallowst night and night swallows day.

verses.translation: The equinox occurs between autumn and spring. The moon attains his seven 2 (?) Kalas during the day and the night. Fifteen days make one Paksa (half of a month). Two halves make one month and two months make a Rtu (season). Three Rtus (seasons) make one Ayana and two Ay an as make a year. The unit of time constituted by fifteen Nimesas is Kdffha. Thirty Kaslhas make a Kald. It consists of one hundred and sixty Matras.

verses.translation: Forty thousand and eight hundred and seventy Metros make the unit of time called Vidyuti. 1 To be precise, it is ninety (instead of seventy). In Vaidliasaihyuga (?) they say that there are only four hundred Malras in a Vidyuti. This is known as Cararhsa. The cause is Nalika [Ghatika = 24 minutes]. The five units of time, Samvatsara etc., have four alternative calculations. 2 3 * * * 7 The fixation 2 of Yugais decisively done on this basis in all the units of time.

verses.translation: The first year is Sarhvatsara; the second is P.vivatsara; the third is Idvatsara\ the fourth is Aniwalsarcr, the fifth is Vat- sara. Thus the various units of time are termed. Twenty hundreds of Parvans (i.e. a thousand months) constitute a Yuga of the sun. These eighteen plus thirty (i.e. 48) Yugas make one Udaya of the sun. Thirty Rtus of the sun make ten Ayanas. Three thousand five hundred Ayanas make sixty months of the sun. Thirty days and nights make one month of the sun. Sixtyone days and nights make one Danu. One hundred and eightythree days constitute the time of one transit of the sun over the world.

verses.translation: Its eastern peak in the middle is golden. The south¬ ern peak consists of silver. It has crystalline lustre. The excellent peak in the north consists of precious stones and jewels. Thus with the three peaks the mountain is well known as Srngavan. Betwixt autumn and spring, the sun proceeds with medium velocity, neither fast nor slow. It reaches that peak of the mountain which is near the equinoctical line. The Dispeller of darkness, i.e. the sun, makes the night equal to the day.

verses.translation: Divine green-coloured horses are yoked to his great chariot. They appear (shining) as though they are smeared with the (solar) rays red like lotus. During the Mesa and -Tula zodiacal transit of the sun days and nights contain fifteen Muhurtas beginning with sunrise. When the sun is in the first quarter of the constella¬ tion Krttika (Pleiades), the moon is known to be in the fourth part of the constellation Visakha. When the sun traverses through the third part of Viiakha, know that the moon has occupied the top of Krttika.

During equinoctical transit oblations to the Pitrs and charitable gifts to the Brahmanas should be made. Brahmanas are the mouths of Devas. verses.hindi: सिद्धश्वेव समाकोर्ण नित्यं बिल्वफलाशिभि: । विविधेर्भूतसंघेश्च नित्यमेव निषेवितम् तस्मिन्वने भगवती सांक्षाच्छीनित्यमेव हि। देवी संनिहिता तत्र सिद्धसंघेन मस्कृता १५ विकद्धूस्पाचलेन्द्रस्य मणिशलस्य चान्तरे । शतयोजनबिस्तीणं द्वियोजनशतायतम
verses.wordMeaning: The sages call that as equinox. Equinox shall be known through the (position of the) sun and the time through (that of) the moon. When days and nights are equal it is equinox.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages call that as equinox. Equinox shall be known through the (position of the) sun and the time through (that of) the moon. When days and nights are equal it is equinox.…

verses.sanskrit: असमर्थे ततो दानं न प्रदेयं कदाचन । दातारं नयते ऽधस्तादात्मानं च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: asamarthe tato dānaṃ na pradeyaṃ kadācana / dātāraṃ nayate 'dhastādātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The six months, viz. Magha, Phalguna, Caitra, Vaisa- kha, Jyestha and Asadha are the months oWttardjana (northern transit of the sun). The six months, viz. Sravana, Bhadrapada, Asvina, Karttika, Margasirsa and Pausa are the months of Dcknnayana (southern transit of the sun). These months make a year. The five years are the sons of Brahma. Rlus are born of them. These are their parts. Hence the New Moon Day (Amavasya) is known as the leader of the Parvans. More than that the equinox should be known as favourable to Devas and Pitrs. After knowing this, a man should not get deluded regarding rites concerning Devas and Pitps. Hence equinox is remembered as all-pervasive by the people.
verses.hindi: विपुलं चम्पकव्न सिद्धधारणसेवितम् । पुष्पलक्ष्म्याबृतं भाति ज्वलन्तसिव नित्यदा

verses.sanskrit: समर्थस्तारयेद्द्वौ तु काष्ठं शुष्कं यथा जले । यथा नौश्च तथा विद्वान्प्रापयेदपरं तटम्
verses.transliteration: samarthastārayeddvau tu kāṣṭhaṃ śuṣkaṃ yathā jale / yathā nauśca tathā vidvānprāpayedaparaṃ taṭam
verses.translation: The worlds (Lokos )should be known (toexist) as far as light (the space illuminated by the sun) extends. The end of the world is also called Loka (of the Lokaloka mountain). The guardians of the worlds are stationed there in the middle of the Loklaoka mountain. They (the Lokapalas) are the four noble souls who stay till the final dissolution of the world. They are Vairajaof good (brilliant) splendour, Kardama of good and merciful dis¬ position, Parjanya of golden hair, and Ketuman of fixed deter¬ mination. The guardians of the worlds are stationed in the four •quarters in Lokaloka, free from Dvanduas (mutually clashing opposites), devoid of arrogance, without an attendant, and absolutelyuncontrolled by anyone else.
verses.hindi: हद्विबाहुपरिणाहैस्तैल्रिहस्तायामविस्तरं :। मनःशिलाचणंनि्ः पाण्डकेशरशालिभिः ३१६ पुष्प॑म॑नो हरेव्याप्तं व्याकोशेगेन्धशालिभिः: । विराजते वन सर्वे मत्तश्रमरनादितम् ... ॥ तद्न दानवदेवर्गन्धर्वेयक्षराक्षस:  किनरेरप्सरोभिश्व महानागेश्व सेबितम्

verses.sanskrit: आहिताग्निश्च गृह्णाति यः शूद्राणां प्रतिग्रहम् । इह जन्मनि शूद्रो ऽसौ मृतः श्वा चोपजायते
verses.transliteration: āhitāgniśca gṛhṇāti yaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ pratigraham / iha janmani śūdro 'sau mṛtaḥ śvā copajāyate
verses.translation: The path that is to the north of Agastya, south of Ajavlthl and outside the path of Vaisvanara is called Pilryana. According to Nirukta XI-29, Pauqiainasi (the full moon day) when. mixed with the 14th Tithi, is Anumati and when mixed with the 1st day When Amavasya (the new maon day) is mixed wit., the 14 h Tithi, it is Sinivali and when mixed with the 1st Tithi of the next(i.e. bright) fortnight it is Kuhu. Stationed there in the path of Pitryam are the sages blessed with progeny who perform Agnihotras and who perpe¬ tuate the lineage of the world.
verses.hindi: तत्राअ्रमं भगवतः कश्यपस्य प्रजापते: । सिद्धसाध्यगगाकीर्ण नानाश्रुतिविभूषितम् ॥ द महानीलकुमुञ्जाम्यासन्तरे5प्यचलावथ

verses.sanskrit: वृथा क्लेशश्च जायेत ब्राह्मणे ह्यग्निहोत्रिणि । असत्प्रतिग्रहं कुर्वन्गुप्तं नीचस्य गर्हितम्
verses.transliteration: vṛthā kleśaśca jāyeta brāhmaṇe hyagnihotriṇi / asatpratigrahaṃ kurvanguptaṃ nīcasya garhitam
verses.translation: Desirous of the welfare of the worlds, they bless the activities of living beings and begin the activities of Rtviks. Theirs is the southern path. In every Yuga they re-establish Dharma that has gone astray (being rudely shocked and shaken) by their progeny, penance, adherence to the bound of decency and persuit of learning. The earlier ones on their death are reborn in the houses of the later ones. This series of births and deaths makes them live upto the hour of final dissolution of the universe.
verses.hindi: ये पक कर घरती पर गिरते हैं, तो वनप्रान्त भर जाता है। संसार में वह श्रीवन के नाम से प्रसिद्ध है, जहाँ गन्धवं, किन्नर, यज्ञ और महानाग सदा विचरण किया करते हैं ।( २-१३। बिल्व फल की आशा से सिद्धनण ओर विविध भाँति के जीव वहाँ पड़े रहते हैं। उस वन में साक्षात् भगवती लक्ष्मी देवी स्वयँ नित्य निवास करतो हैं, उन्हें सिद्धगनण प्रणाम किया करते हैं ।!४-१५। विकंक और मणिशल पव॑ंतों के बीच में सौ योजन लम्बा और दो योजन चौड़ा बड़ा सा चम्मक वन है। यहाँ भी सिद्ध-चारण निवास किया करते हैं। फलों कौ शोभा से वह वन सदा जलता हुआ सा मालम पड़ता है।१६१७। विशाल तनेवाले उन बक्षों के पत्तों के भार से झकी शाखाएँ आधे कोस तक ऊपर फंली हुई हैं, जिनमें सदा फल खिले र हत हैं। इससे वहु॒ वन पिजढ़े की तरह शोभित रहता है १5५। पाण्डु वर्ण के केसरो से युक्त और मनःशिला के चण की तरह वर्णवाले,
