verses.sanskrit: बहुध्वजसमाकीर्णा वेदध्वनिनिनादिता । वणिग्जनैर् बहुविधैः क्रयविक्रयशालिनी
verses.transliteration: bahudhvajasamākīrṇā vedadhvaninināditā / vaṇigjanair bahuvidhaiḥ krayavikrayaśālinī
verses.translation: By means of the ray (Susumna), the Sun develops the Moon in the bright half (of the month) day by day and it is complete (full on the full-moon days). Devas imbibe its nectar during the dark half. Thus he propitiates Devas with the nectar. After being sucked thus, the moon has only two Kalas (digits) left. Pitrs take it as Kavya offering. Devas and Saumyas consider it as nectar and drink it. Men conquer (satisfy) hunger by means of foodstuffs, beverages and medicinal herbs developed by means of rains, with water lifted up and released as rain-showers by means of his rays by the Sun, For half a month Devas are propitiated through nec¬ tar. For half a month Pitrs are propitiated by Svadha food. The Sun sustains human beings perpetually through food. The Sun sustains them through his rays.
verses.hindi: कन्दराएँ हैं। उनकी धातुओं से चित्रित चोटी पर दानवों के अतिविस्तृत आठ पुर हैं। अनेक शिखर-कन्दराओं से युक्त वज्चक पर्वत पर भी राक्षसों के स्थान हैं, जिनमें स्त्री-पुरुष रहते हैं ।२८-३०। वहाँ महाबली ओर पराक्रमी भयंकर कामरूपी नौलक नाम के राक्षस भी नित्य निवास करते हैं। उस महानील पव॑त पर घोड़े की तरह मूँहवाले महात्मा किन्नरों के भी पदन्धह पूर हैं। महाबाहु देवसेन और बली इन्द्रादि गर्वीले पन्द्रह किन्नर- राज वहाँ के अधिपति हैं ।३१-३३। उस पर्व॑तराज पर जो नगर बसे हुये हैं. उनमें कितने ही गरुप्तद्वार हैं और विविध वर्णों की सोने की परिखासे वह नगर घिरा है। उस नगर में सेकड़ों विषले अजगर (साँप निवास करते हैं जिनके देखते ही विष चढ़ जाता है। वे अत्यन्त भयज्भूर, दुर्धध॑ और क्रोधित होने पर अग्नि की तरह देदीप्यमान हो जाने वाले हैं। परन्तु वे सुवर्ण के वशवर्ती भी हैं। सर्पों के रहने पर भी वहाँ उस

verses.sanskrit: यन्त्रादानैः प्रतोलीभिरुच्चैश्चान्यैः सुशोभिता । देवतायतनैर् दिव्यैर् आश्रमैर् गहनैर् युता
verses.transliteration: yantrādānaiḥ pratolībhiruccaiścānyaiḥ suśobhitā / devatāyatanair divyair āśramair gahanair yutā
verses.translation: The Sun moves ahead in his chariot of green horses. Through his rays he takes up waters. At the time of their release he discharges them. Thus the Sun sustains the mobile and immobile beings perpetually. He is carried by green horses. By means of his thou¬ sands of rays he drinks water. While being carried by green horses he showers it again. Thus the Sun moves ahead quickly in his celestial sphere by means of his single-wheeled chariot dragged by the unim¬ paired gentle horses. In the course of a day and night he traverses over the world of seven continents and oceans by means of his single- wheeled chariot dragged by the seven horses.
verses.hindi: पर्वतपर हजारों देत्यपण निवास करते हैं. जिनकी अट्वालिकाओं और कोठों पर तोरण लगे हैं एवं जो ऊँची परिखाओं से घिरे हैं। वेणमान नामक पर्वत पर पचास योजन लम्बे और तीस योजन चौड़े विद्याधरों के तीन पुर हैं। उनके इन्द्र के तुल्य पराक्रमी महाबली उलूक, रोमश और महानेत्र नामक विद्याधर अधिपति हैं ।३४-३८। वैकंक नामक एवंत के शिखर पर गरुडपुत्र सुप्रीव निवास करते हैं। उस पवत का शिखर ऊँचा,
verses.wordMeaning: The Sun moves ahead in his chariot of green horses. Through his rays he takes up waters. At the time of their release he discharges them. Thus the Sun sustains the mobile and immobile beings perpetually. He is carried by green horses.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sun moves ahead in his chariot of green horses. Through his rays he takes up waters. At the time of their release he discharges them. Thus the Sun sustains the mobile and immobile beings perpetually. He is carried by green horses.…

verses.sanskrit: नानापुष्पफलैर् रम्या कदलीखण्डमण्डिता । पनसैर् बकुलैस् तालैर् अशोकैर् आम्रकैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: nānāpuṣpaphalair ramyā kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitā / panasair bakulais tālair aśokair āmrakais tathā
verses.translation: The Vedic metres that have assumed the form of horses are yoked to the chariot near the wheel. They can assume any form they please. They are yoked but once. They have the un- limited speed of the mind. They (are accompanied) by tawny coloured masters expounding the Brahman (or the Vedas). They cover one hund¬ red and eighty zones within one year. The Sun is eulogised by the sages through well-known words of prayer. He is served by Gandharvas and Apsaras-s by means of songs and dances. The lord of the heaven, the Sun thus traverses by means of his horses. The Moon too moves among the stars that stay in the pathway of heaven (vlthx). The increase and decrease of its rays are similar to the increase and decrease of the Sun.
verses.hindi: रत्न-धातुओं से चित्रित और निर्शर कन्दराओं से युक्त है। वहाँ सुग्रीव. नामक अत्यन्त बली, वायु के सामन शीकघ्रगामी, दुर्धध और साथों के निहन्ता गरुड़-पुत्र हैं। वह पर्वत महाबली, पराक्रमी एवं विशालकाय स्पहन्ता एकोनचत्वारिशोड्ध्यायः २६१
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedic metres that have assumed the form of horses are yoked to the chariot near the wheel. They can assume any form they please. They are yoked but once. They have the un- limited speed of the mind.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedic metres that have assumed the form of horses are yoked to the chariot near the wheel. They can assume any form they please. They are yoked but once. They have the un- limited speed of the mind.…

verses.sanskrit: राजवृक्षकपित्थैश्च दाडिमैर् उपशोभिता । वेदाध्ययननिर्घोषैः पवित्रीकृतमङ्गला
verses.transliteration: rājavṛkṣakapitthaiśca dāḍimair upaśobhitā / vedādhyayananirghoṣaiḥ pavitrīkṛtamaṅgalā
verses.translation: The chariot of the Moon has three wheels. 1 The horses are tied in pairs on either side. The chariot along with the horses and the charioteer has come out of the womb of the waters. The threewheels have a hundred spokes. Excellent white horses have been yoked thereto. They are ten in number. They are slender and divine. They are unimpeded and have the velo¬ city of the mind. They are yoked but once (in the beginning of the Kalpa) and they travel till the end of the Yugas. A white serpent acts as therein in that chariot. All the horses are of the same colour. They carry the conch-coloured Moon. The names of the ten horses are—Yayu, Trimanas, y. r?a > Jf j ' ivala ' Ha y a = y araa, Turanya, Harftsa, Vyomin and Mrga. They carry the Moon till the close of the day(?) The gentle Moon goes ahead surrounded by Devas and Pitrs. In the beginning of the bright half when the Sun is m front, the interior of the city of the Moon is filled duly every¬ day The Sun develops the Moon drunk by Devas in the declin¬ ing ortnig t. The Moon is drunk for fifteen days and the Sun
verses.hindi: करणञ्जेड्मिरतो नित्यं साक्षादृभूतपतिः प्रभुः। वृबभाडुगे महादेव: शंकरों योगियां प्रभु:
verses.wordMeaning: The chariot of the Moon has three wheels. 1 The horses are tied in pairs on either side. The chariot along with the horses and the charioteer has come out of the womb of the waters. The threewheels have a hundred spokes. Excellent white horses have been yoked thereto.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्या उत्तरदिग्भागे आश्रमो ऽभूत्सुशोभनः । तन्मन्दारवनं नाम त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tasyā uttaradigbhāge āśramo 'bhūtsuśobhanaḥ / tanmandāravanaṃ nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: Verses 50-83 describe chariots etc. Mercury (Budha) and others. Beginning with the second day in the dark half and ending with the fourteenth day Devas drink the watery wine, the nectar of the Moon that is essentially made up of water and that by nature consists of tasty essence. By the brilliance of the Sun the nectar is collected and prepared in the course of a fortnight. On the full moon night Devas, Pitrs and the Sages attend the Moon facing the Sun. The digits being drunk decline gradually in the dark half and become refilled in the bright half.
verses.hindi: महाप्रजापतेः स्थान हेमशुद्भा नगोत्तमे । चतुर्वक्त्रस्य देवस्य सर्वभृतनमस्क्ृतम् १४६ सुमेधे धातुधित्राड्थ शैलेद्े मेवसंनिभे । नेकोदरदरीवप्रनिकुजझ्जश्रोपशोभिते ४८ आदित्यानां वुरां च रात्गाणां चामितौजसानू। तत्रा55प्रतनविन्धासा रम्पाश्चववाश्यिनोरवि.
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 50-83 describe chariots etc. Mercury (Budha) and others. Beginning with the second day in the dark half and ending with the fourteenth day Devas drink the watery wine,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 50-83 describe chariots etc. Mercury (Budha) and others. Beginning with the second day in the dark half and ending with the fourteenth day Devas drink the watery wine,…

verses.sanskrit: बहुमन्दारसंयुक्तं तेन मन्दारकं विदुः । विप्रो दीर्घतपा नाम सर्वदा तत्र तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: bahumandārasaṃyuktaṃ tena mandārakaṃ viduḥ / vipro dīrghatapā nāma sarvadā tatra tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: When days pass on gradually Devas drink the Moon for half a month until the new-moon day and go away. On the new-moon day Pitrs resort to the Moon. When the fifteenth part of the digits is left over in the later part of the day, that part is used up by the groups of Pitrs. The remaining digit is drunk by Pitrs during the period of two Kalas. From the lunar rays the nectar of Svadha comes out on the new-moon night. They drink the nectar and remain content for a month. They attain immortality. All these (following) are Pitrs: Saumyas, Barhisads, Agnisvattas and Kavyas. The years, which are enumerated by Brahmanas as five, are Kavyas. Saumyas should be known as Rtus (Seasons) and Barhisads are remembered as Masas (Months). Agnisvat¬ tas are Artavas (Fertility period?) and these are the creations of the Pitrs, O Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: स्थानानि सिद्धंदेंवानां स्थापितानि नगोसमें । तत्न पुजापरा नित्य॑ यक्षगन्धर्वेकिनरा: ३४५० गन्धबनगरी स्फोता हेमकक्षे नगोत्तमे । अशीत्यमरपुर्याभा भहाप्राक्ारतोरणा
verses.wordMeaning: When days pass on gradually Devas drink the Moon for half a month until the new-moon day and go away. On the new-moon day Pitrs resort to the Moon. When the fifteenth part of the digits is left over in the later part of the day, that part is used up by the groups of Pitrs.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When days pass on gradually Devas drink the Moon for half a month until the new-moon day and go away. On the new-moon day Pitrs resort to the Moon. When the fifteenth part of the digits is left over in the later part of the day, that part is used up by the groups of Pitrs.…

verses.sanskrit: तपस्तपति सो ऽत्यर्थं तेन दीर्घतपाः स्मृतः । स तिष्ठति सपत्नीकः ससुतः सस्नुषस् तथा
verses.transliteration: tapastapati so 'tyarthaṃ tena dīrghatapāḥ smṛtaḥ / sa tiṣṭhati sapatnīkaḥ sasutaḥ sasnuṣas tathā
verses.translation: When the digit is being drunk by Pitrs on the fifteenth night i.e. Amavasya, the last digit is left and it is re¬ filled. The increase and decrease of the Moon are on the six¬ teenth day (at the beginning of each next half). Thus the in¬ crease' and the decrease of the Moon are caused by the Sun. I shall now mention the increase and decrease of the stars and planets; and also describe the chariot ofRahu later. The chariot of the son of the Moon (Budha, The chariot resembles cloud. It has the frontal The chariot of Bhargava ( Venus) is glorious. In refulgence it resembles the Sun. It is yoked with excellent horses born of the earth and having various colours. They are white (tawny), brown, blue, yellow, red, black, green, spotted and variegated. All the ten are highly blessed. They are not lean. They have the speed of the wind.
verses.hindi: सिद्धा ह्पत्तता नाम गन्चर्वा युद्धशालिन: । येबामधिपतिदेवों राजराजः कपिञ्जल:ः ५२ अनले राक्षसावासा: पः्चकटेषपि दानवा:। ऊर्जिता देवरिपवों महाबलपराक्तमाः ५३ पक्षियों से आवत है ।३६-४१। करंत्र शैल पर साक्ष त् भूतपति योगियों के प्रभु. वृषभा कु, भगवान् महादेव शंकर निवास करते हैं ।४२। उस करंज पर्वत पर नाना प्रकार के वेश धारण करने वाले, दुध॑ष प्रमथगण चारों और विराजमान हैं। वसुधार पर्वत पर अमित तेजस्वी महात्मा वसुगुणों के पुज्यतवम आठ आयतन (घर) विद्यमान हैं। गिरिवर रलघातु के ऊपर महात्मा सप्तर्षियों के सात आश्रम हैं, जो सिद्धों के भवनों
verses.wordMeaning: When the digit is being drunk by Pitrs on the fifteenth night i.e. Amavasya, the last digit is left and it is re¬ filled. The increase and decrease of the Moon are on the six¬ teenth day (at the beginning of each next half).…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the digit is being drunk by Pitrs on the fifteenth night i.e. Amavasya, the last digit is left and it is re¬ filled. The increase and decrease of the Moon are on the six¬ teenth day (at the beginning of each next half).…

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रूषन्ति सदा तस्य पुत्राः पञ्च प्रयत्नतः । तस्य पुत्रः कनीयांस्तु ऋक्षशृङ्गो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: śuśrūṣanti sadā tasya putrāḥ pañca prayatnataḥ / tasya putraḥ kanīyāṃstu ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: The chariot of Mars is glorious and golden. It is yoked with eight red, unimpeded horses. They are born of fire, and they can go everywhere. (Mars) traverses the signs of zodiac in straight, curved and circular lines. Then the scholarly preceptor of Devas, Bjrhaspati (Jupiter) of the family of Angiras, moves ahead in his golden chariot yoked with red horses. Eight horses as speedy, as the wind and divine in nature, are yoked to it. In a constellation this planet stays for a year; then he traverses quickly. Sanaiscara (Saturn) rides in a chariot made of black iron and traverses slowly. His horses are variegated in colour. They are born of the ether. Rahu's chariot is of Tamasic nature (dark-coloured). Eight black horses, as speedy as the mind, are yoked to it.
verses.hindi: से युक्त और पवित्र हैं ।४३-४५। हेमश्वज्ज पर्वत पर महाप्रजापति चतुर्मुख ब्रह्मा का निव.स स्थान है, जो सब जीवों के पूज्य हैं। गजशल पर भगवान् रुद्र नाना भूतगणों से युक्त होऋर प्रसन्न मन से नित्य निवास करते हैं। सभी जीव इनको नमस्कार करते हैं। शलेन्द्र सुमेध विविध धातु रंगों से रजित है, वह देखने में मेघ को तरह मालूम पड़ता है। उस पर कितनी ही कन्दराएँ, बन और कूंज हैं ।४६-४८। वहाँ अत्यन्त पराक्रमी
verses.wordMeaning: The chariot of Mars is glorious and golden. It is yoked with eight red, unimpeded horses. They are born of fire, and they can go everywhere. (Mars) traverses the signs of zodiac in straight, curved and circular lines. Then the scholarly preceptor of Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The chariot of Mars is glorious and golden. It is yoked with eight red, unimpeded horses. They are born of fire, and they can go everywhere. (Mars) traverses the signs of zodiac in straight, curved and circular lines. Then the scholarly preceptor of Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: वेदाध्ययनसम्पन्नो ब्रह्मचारी गुणान्वितः । योगाभ्यासरतो नित्यं कन्दमूलफलाशनः
verses.transliteration: vedādhyayanasampanno brahmacārī guṇānvitaḥ / yogābhyāsarato nityaṃ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Leaving the Sun, Rahu rushes at the Moon during the lunar Parvan (i.e. the Full-Moon). Leaving the Moon it rushes at the Sun during the solar Parvan (i.e. the New-Moon day). Horses yoked to the chariot of Ketu are eight. They are as speedy as the wind. They have the colour like smoke from burning straw. They are strong. They are tawny (and variegated in colour) like donkeys. These horses of the planets I have explained along with their chariots. They are fastened to Dhruva by gaseous- rays. Being fastened by invisible gaseous rays, these (planets) being whirled, revolve in an orderly manner.
verses.hindi: आदित्य, वसु. रुद्र और अश्विनीकुमार के उत्तमोत्तम महल बने हुये हैं। इस श्रेष्ठ पवेत पर ओर भी विद्ध देवों के कितने ही निवासस्थान हैं, यक्ष, गन्धवबं, किन्नर, आदि नित्य ही जिनको पूजा किया करते हैं ।४६-५०। हेमकक्ष नामक पर्वतराज पर एक सुसमृद्ध गन्धर्व नगरी है, जो अस्सी देवपुर की तरह शोभाशालिनी, विशालाकार परिखा और तोरण से युक्त है। अपत्तन नामक सिद्ध गण और युद्ध प्रेमी गन्धवेगण यहाँ निवास करते हैं, जितके अधिपति राजराज कपिजल हैं ।५१-५२॥ अनल पव॑त पर राक्षसों का और पंचकट पर दानवों का निवास है। ये राक्षत और दानव मदाबली, पराक्रमी और देबों के शत्रु हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Leaving the Sun, Rahu rushes at the Moon during the lunar Parvan (i.e. the Full-Moon). Leaving the Moon it rushes at the Sun during the solar Parvan (i.e. the New-Moon day). Horses yoked to the chariot of Ketu are eight. They are as speedy as the wind.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Leaving the Sun, Rahu rushes at the Moon during the lunar Parvan (i.e. the Full-Moon). Leaving the Moon it rushes at the Sun during the solar Parvan (i.e. the New-Moon day). Horses yoked to the chariot of Ketu are eight. They are as speedy as the wind.…

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठते मृगरूपेण मृगयूथचरस्तदा । दिनान्ते च दिनान्ते च मातापित्रोः समीपगः
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhate mṛgarūpeṇa mṛgayūthacarastadā / dinānte ca dinānte ca mātāpitroḥ samīpagaḥ
verses.translation: Being bound to Dhruva, the Moon, the Sun and the planets move about in the firmament. The planetary system united to Dhruva follows it as it whirls. Jusc as a boat is carried along by the water in a river, so the abodes of Devas are carried by the gaseous rays. Hence all the groups of Devas are seen in the firmament by everyone. 1 here are as many gaseous rays as there are stars. They are tied to Dhruva. They whirl Dhruva and whirl by themselves. Just as oil-crushers whirl and cause the wheel (of an oil-mill) to whirl, so also do the luminaries fixed (to Dhruva) on all sides by gaseous rays (bonds). They move about like a fire-brand on being urged by the whirling wind. Since the wind bears the luminary bodies, it is called Pravaha.
verses.hindi: शतशड्भे पुरशतं यक्षाणाममितौजसाम् ' ताम्रासे काह्वेयस्य तक्षफस्थ पुरोत्तमम् ५४ विशाखे पर्वतश्षेष्ठ नेकवप्रदरीशुभे । गुहानिरतवासस्य गुहस्यथाइप्यतनं महत्

verses.commentary: Sense: Being bound to Dhruva, the Moon, the Sun and the planets move about in the firmament. The planetary system united to Dhruva follows it as it whirls. Jusc as a boat is carried along by the water in a river, so the abodes of Devas are carried by the gaseous rays.…

verses.sanskrit: अभिवादयते नित्यं भक्तिमान् मुनिपुत्रकः । पुनर्गच्छति तत्रैव कानने गिरिगह्वरे
verses.transliteration: abhivādayate nityaṃ bhaktimān muniputrakaḥ / punargacchati tatraiva kānane girigahvare
verses.translation: Thus the cluster of the luminary bodies united to Dhruva traverses the firmament. The Gangetic porpoise-like appearance in the sky made up of the stars is Dhruva. If it is seen in the night, the sin committed during the day is quelled. Persons looking at Dhruva regularly live for as many years, or even more, as there are stars in the "Gangetic porpoise" in the firmament. 1 This permanent Gangetic porpoise shall be realised in its various divisions. Its upper jaw is known as Uttanapada. Its lower jaw is Yajna. Dharma resorts to the top of its head. Narayana abides in its heart and Asvins stay in its forelegs.
verses.hindi: पिशाचके गिरिवरे हर्म्य प्रासादमण्डितम् । यक्षगन्धवंचरितं कुबेरभवन महत् हरिकठे हरिदेवः सर्वभुतनमस्कृत: । प्रभावात्तस्थ शैलोइसो महानाभ:ः प्रकाशते ५८
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the cluster of the luminary bodies united to Dhruva traverses the firmament. The Gangetic porpoise-like appearance in the sky made up of the stars is Dhruva. If it is seen in the night, the sin committed during the day is quelled.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the cluster of the luminary bodies united to Dhruva traverses the firmament. The Gangetic porpoise-like appearance in the sky made up of the stars is Dhruva. If it is seen in the night, the sin committed during the day is quelled.…

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडन्बालमृगैः सार्द्धं प्रत्यहं स मुनेः सुतः । कदाचिद्दैवयोगेन ऋक्षशृङ्गो ममार सः
verses.transliteration: krīḍanbālamṛgaiḥ sārddhaṃ pratyahaṃ sa muneḥ sutaḥ / kadāciddaivayogena ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mamāra saḥ
verses.translation: Varuna and Aryaman are its hind thighs. Samvatsara is its penis and Mitra resorts to its anus. In its tail are Agni, Mahendra, Marici, Kasyapa and Dhruva. The four stars (?) and the Gangetic porpoise do not set. The stars, Moon, Sun, planets and constellations stay in the sky with face up or in front. They are in the form of a wheel. These are presided over by Dhruva. They circum¬ ambulate Dhruva which acts like the pivotal peg in the firmament. Verses 91-95 describe the heavenly Gangetic porpoise with various stars forming parts of its body.
verses.hindi: पाण्डरे चारशिखरे महाप्राकारतोरणे । विद्याधरपुरं तत्र महाभवनशालिनम् (? ) ६० सह्श्नशिखरे शैले दंत्यानासुग्रकमंणास् । पुराणि समुदीर्णानां सहल् हमसालिनाम् ३६१ मुकुटे पन्नगावासा अनेकाः पर्वतोत्तमाः । पुष्पके वे मुनिगणा लित्यमेव सुदा युताः (१६२

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शूलभेदमाहात्म्ये ऋक्षशृङ्गचरित्रे दीर्घतपोमुन्याख्यानवर्णनं नाम द्विपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ५३ उत्तानपाद उवाच: आश्रमे वसतस् तस्य स दीर्घतपसो मुनेः । कनीयांस् तनयो देव कथं मृत्युमुपागतः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye ṛkṣaśṛṅgacaritre dīrghatapomunyākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 53 uttānapāda uvāca: āśrame vasatas tasya sa dīrghatapaso muneḥ / kanīyāṃs tanayo deva kathaṃ mṛtyumupāgataḥ
verses.translation: Hearing this the sages became doubtful. They asked Lomaharsana again for its clarification. Sir, you have mentioned the famous abodes of Devas. How are these abodes? How are these luminaries? Please describe.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते भुवनविन्यासों नामकोनचत्वारिशोध्ध्याय:  रे८।॥ शतश्यृंग पर्वत पर अत्यन्त बली यक्षों के सौ पुर हैं और ताम्राभ पब॑तपर कद्रुनन्दन तक्षक की उत्तम पुरी है ।५३-५४। अनेक परिखा और कन्दराओं से युक्त विशाख पर्वत पर गुहा में रहने वाले युह (कार्तिकेयजी) का एक विशाल निवास स्थान है। व्वेतोदर महाशलपर गरुड़पुत्र महात्मा सुनाभ का पुर है, जिसमें अनेक भवन बने हुये हैं। पिशाच नामक गिरिवर पर कुबेर का विशाल भवन है, जिसमें कोठे और छत भी हैं एवं
verses.wordMeaning: Hearing this the sages became doubtful. They asked Lomaharsana again for its clarification. Sir, you have mentioned the famous abodes of Devas. How are these abodes? How are these luminaries? Please describe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hearing this the sages became doubtful. They asked Lomaharsana again for its clarification. Sir, you have mentioned the famous abodes of Devas. How are these abodes? How are these luminaries? Please describe.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा कथां दिव्यां महीपते । श्रवणादेव यस्यास्तु मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā kathāṃ divyāṃ mahīpate / śravaṇādeva yasyāstu mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Please say everything precisely about luminaries. I shall explain to you what has been mentioned by great intellectuals of perfect knowledge, in connection with the origin of the Sun, the Moon, how the Moon and the Sun are the abodes of gods.
verses.hindi: यक्ष-गन्धर्व॑ जहाँ विचरण किया करते हैं ।५५-५७। हरिक्८ शैलपर सर्वभूत-नमस्क्ृत हरिदेव विराजमान हैं । उनके प्रभाव से वह प॑त देदीप्यमान हो रहा है। कुमुद पर्वतपर किन्नरों का आवास है, अंजन पर्वत पर उरगगण रहते हैं और कृष्ण पवेत पर विशाल भवन बनाकर गन्धवंगण निवास करते हैं। मनोहर शिखरवाले पाण्ड्र पवेत पर विशाल भवनों से युक्त विद्याधरों का पुर है, जिसमें चारों ओर ऊँची परिखाएंँ और तोरण लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Please say everything precisely about luminaries. I shall explain to you what has been mentioned by great intellectuals of perfect knowledge, in connection with the origin of the Sun, the Moon, how the Moon and the Sun are the abodes of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Please say everything precisely about luminaries. I shall explain to you what has been mentioned by great intellectuals of perfect knowledge, in connection with the origin of the Sun, the Moon, how the Moon and the Sun are the abodes of gods.

verses.sanskrit: काशीराजो महावीर्यो महाबलपराक्रमः । चित्रसेन इति ख्यातां धरण्यां स नराधिप
verses.transliteration: kāśīrājo mahāvīryo mahābalaparākramaḥ / citrasena iti khyātāṃ dharaṇyāṃ sa narādhipa
verses.translation: Now I shall mention the origin of three fires 1: celestial, elemental (atmospheric) and terrestrial. When the great night came (lit. dawned) on Brahma, born of the Unmanifest, the universe became undefined and enveloped by nocturnal darkness.
verses.hindi: हैं ।(८-६०। सहुस्रशिखर नामक पर्वबतपर भयंकर कम करने वाले हैत्यों की सुवर्ण मण्डित सहख्नपुरी है। मुकुट पर्वतपर पन्नगों के अनेक शेलावास हैं। पुष्पक पर्वत पर मुनिगण नित्य आनन्द से युक्त होकर रहते हैं । सुपक्ष नामक पर्वत पर वैवस्वत, सोम, वायु और नगाधिप के चार निवास-स्थान हैं। इन पूर्वोक्त स्थानों या पुर-भवनों के गन्धवे, किन्नर, यक्ष, नाग, विद्याधर और सिद्ध आदि अपने-अपने इष्ट देवों की पूजा किया करते हैं सर्वादापर्वते शुक्र देवकटे निबोधत । विस्तीर्ण शिखरे तस्य कूटे सिरिवरस्थ ह ११
verses.wordMeaning: Now I shall mention the origin of three fires 1: celestial, elemental (atmospheric) and terrestrial. When the great night came (lit. dawned) on Brahma, born of the Unmanifest, the universe became undefined and enveloped by nocturnal darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall mention the origin of three fires 1: celestial, elemental (atmospheric) and terrestrial. When the great night came (lit. dawned) on Brahma, born of the Unmanifest, the universe became undefined and enveloped by nocturnal darkness.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य राज्ये सदा धर्मो नाधर्मो विद्यते क्वचित् । वेदधर्मरतो नित्यं प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्
verses.transliteration: tasya rājye sadā dharmo nādharmo vidyate kvacit / vedadharmarato nityaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan
verses.translation: Vedic Aryans regarded Agni (Fire-god) as a great deity and it was given designations according to its functions. Puraias amplified the tradition and attributed cosmic functions in verses 5-18. Heating being the common factor between the Sun and fire, they are in a way identified. The credit of creating seasons through the rays of the Sun is given to Fire-god also. Only four elements were there. That which blazed at first is called terrestrial fire. The fire that blazes in the Sun is called Suci (celestial).
verses.hindi: पक्षिराजस्थ भवन प्रथम तस्महात्मनः  महावायुप्रवेगस्य शाल्मलिद्वीपवासिन: ४ तस्पेव चास्मुध्व॑त्तु क्टेषु च सहथिषु । दक्षिणेषु विचित्रेषु सप्तस्वषि तु शोभिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Vedic Aryans regarded Agni (Fire-god) as a great deity and it was given designations according to its functions. Puraias amplified the tradition and attributed cosmic functions in verses 5-18. Heating being the common factor between the Sun and fire,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vedic Aryans regarded Agni (Fire-god) as a great deity and it was given designations according to its functions. Puraias amplified the tradition and attributed cosmic functions in verses 5-18. Heating being the common factor between the Sun and fire,…

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मनिरतश्चैव युद्धातिथ्यप्रियः सदा । क्षत्रधर्मं समाश्रित्य भोगान्भुङ्क्ते स कामतः
verses.transliteration: svadharmanirataścaiva yuddhātithyapriyaḥ sadā / kṣatradharmaṃ samāśritya bhogānbhuṅkte sa kāmataḥ
verses.translation: I shall now mention the characteristics of the fire called Vaidyuta (atmospheric) fire. Three fires—Vaidyuta (lightning), Jathara (gastric) and Saura (solar) are born of the womb of waters. Hence by drinking water the Sun blazes in the sky with his rays. The fire from lightning that burns trees cannot be quelled by water. Nor the fire in human bellies can be quenched by it.
verses.hindi: संध्याभ्राभाः समुदिता रुक्‍्मप्राकारतोरणाः । महाभवनमालाभिः शोभिता देवनिर्मिताः सूतजी बोले--इ्वेतवर्ण के देवकूट नामक मर्यादा पवंत के विस्तृत शिखर पर श्रीमान् विवतानन्दन सुपर्ण का स्थान है ।१। वह जन्म क्षेत्र चारों ओर से सौ योजन के विस्तार में है जहाँ अनेक विद्याल भवन बने हये हैं। शाल्मलिद्वीप में निवास करनेवाले, वायु की तरह महवेगशाली महात्मा पक्षिराज गरुंड़ का वही प्रथम भवन है, जहाँ महाबली, सपंनिहंता शीघ्रगामी अनेकानेक गझड़ के बंदज विशाल पक्षिगण निवास करते
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now mention the characteristics of the fire called Vaidyuta (atmospheric) fire. Three fires—Vaidyuta (lightning), Jathara (gastric) and Saura (solar) are born of the womb of waters. Hence by drinking water the Sun blazes in the sky with his rays.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now mention the characteristics of the fire called Vaidyuta (atmospheric) fire. Three fires—Vaidyuta (lightning), Jathara (gastric) and Saura (solar) are born of the womb of waters. Hence by drinking water the Sun blazes in the sky with his rays.…

verses.sanskrit: कोशस्यान्तो न विद्येत हस्त्यश्वरथपत्तिमान् । इतिहासपुराणज्ञैः पण्डितैः सह संकथाम्
verses.transliteration: kośasyānto na vidyeta hastyaśvarathapattimān / itihāsapurāṇajñaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ saha saṃkathām
verses.translation: The fire existing in the belly is full of rays. It is a great fire. The diffused light of the Sun devoid of heat is white and spreads everywhere. It partially (with its quarter part) enters the fire at night, when the Sun sets. So the fire is seen blazing from a distance.
verses.hindi: हैं ।२-४। सुन्दर शिखायुक्त उस "्वंतराज की दक्षिण दिशा में विचित्र प्रकार के सात खनन हैं, जिन पर सन्ध्या कालीन मेघ की तरह देवों द्वारा बनाये गये कितने ही बड़े-बड़े भव्य भवन हैं जो सोने के प्राकार-- तोरण से सुशोभित हैं। चालीस योजन लम्बे और तीस योजन चौंडे वहाँ गन्धर्वों के सात नगर हैं, जिनमें स्त्री-पुरुष निवास करते हैं ५-७। आग्नेय नामक महाबली और पराक्रमी कुबेर के अनुचर गन्धर्वगण उन
verses.wordMeaning: The fire existing in the belly is full of rays. It is a great fire. The diffused light of the Sun devoid of heat is white and spreads everywhere. It partially (with its quarter part) enters the fire at night, when the Sun sets. So the fire is seen blazing from a distance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fire existing in the belly is full of rays. It is a great fire. The diffused light of the Sun devoid of heat is white and spreads everywhere. It partially (with its quarter part) enters the fire at night, when the Sun sets. So the fire is seen blazing from a distance.

verses.sanskrit: कथयन्राजते राजा कैलास इव शङ्करः । एवं स पालयन्राज्यं राजा मन्त्रिणम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: kathayanrājate rājā kailāsa iva śaṅkaraḥ / evaṃ sa pālayanrājyaṃ rājā mantriṇam abravīt
verses.translation: The heat of the fire permeates the Sun when he rises again. With a quarter of the heat the terrestrial fire blazes forth. The light and heat of the Sun and fire develop by day and night, thanks to this mutual permeation.
verses.hindi: बनुश्चिह्वाश्तगंतग्रन्थः ग॒. पुस्तके नास्ति । पुरमाशीबिधेः पूर्ण महाप्राकारतो रणभ्  । वादित्रशतनिर्धोषेरानन्दितवनान्तरभ १० दुष्प्रसह्मममित्राणां त्रिशद्योजनमण्डलम् । नगर संहिकेयानामुदी्ण देवजिद्ठिष:म् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The heat of the fire permeates the Sun when he rises again. With a quarter of the heat the terrestrial fire blazes forth. The light and heat of the Sun and fire develop by day and night, thanks to this mutual permeation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heat of the fire permeates the Sun when he rises again. With a quarter of the heat the terrestrial fire blazes forth. The light and heat of the Sun and fire develop by day and night, thanks to this mutual permeation.

verses.sanskrit: मृगयायां गमिष्यामि तिष्ठध्वं राज्यपालने । गम्यतां सचिवैः प्रोक्ते गतो ऽसौ वसुधाधिपः
verses.transliteration: mṛgayāyāṃ gamiṣyāmi tiṣṭhadhvaṃ rājyapālane / gamyatāṃ sacivaiḥ prokte gato 'sau vasudhādhipaḥ
verses.translation: In the northern or southern hemisphere, when the Sun rises, the night enters the water. Hence the water becomes copper-coloured during the day, because of the entry of the night. When this Sun sets again, the day enters the water. So during the night the water sparkles due to the entry of day.
verses.hindi: सिद्धदेवरषिचरितं देवकूटे निबोधत (११ द्वितोये द्विजशादूला भर्थादापबंते शुभे । सहाभवनमालाभिरननावर्गाभिरावुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: In the northern or southern hemisphere, when the Sun rises, the night enters the water. Hence the water becomes copper-coloured during the day, because of the entry of the night. When this Sun sets again, the day enters the water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the northern or southern hemisphere, when the Sun rises, the night enters the water. Hence the water becomes copper-coloured during the day, because of the entry of the night. When this Sun sets again, the day enters the water.…

verses.sanskrit: अश्वारूढाश्च धावन्तो राजानो मण्डलाधिपाः । छत्रैश्छत्राणि घृष्यन्तो ऽनुजग्मुः काननं प्रति
verses.transliteration: aśvārūḍhāśca dhāvanto rājāno maṇḍalādhipāḥ / chatraiśchatrāṇi ghṛṣyanto 'nujagmuḥ kānanaṃ prati
verses.translation: That which blazes in the Sun drinking the waters through the rays is the celestial fire mixed with the terrestrial one. The celestial fire of a thousand rays is circular and shaped like a jar. With its thousand rays it takes up the water of the rivers, oceans, wells, desert lands, both mobile, i.e. flowing, and stationary. The Sun of golden form has a thousand rays that exude rain, chillness and heat.
verses.hindi: सुवर्णनणिचित्राभिरनेकाभिरलंकृतभ् । विशालरथ्यं दुचर्ष नित्य प्रसुदित शिवम् ५१३ नरनारोगणाकीर्ण प्रांशुप्राकारतोरणभ् । बषष्टियोजनविस्तीर्ण शतथी जबमायत म् नगरं कालकेयानामसुराणां दुरासदम् । देवकूठतटे रम्ये संनिविष्ट सुदुजबन् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: That which blazes in the Sun drinking the waters through the rays is the celestial fire mixed with the terrestrial one. The celestial fire of a thousand rays is circular and shaped like a jar. With its thousand rays it takes up the water of the rivers, oceans, wells,…
verses.commentary: Sense: That which blazes in the Sun drinking the waters through the rays is the celestial fire mixed with the terrestrial one. The celestial fire of a thousand rays is circular and shaped like a jar. With its thousand rays it takes up the water of the rivers, oceans, wells,…

verses.sanskrit: रजस्तत्रोत्थितं भौमं गजवाजिपदाहतम् । तेनैतच्छादितं सर्वं सदिङ्मार्तण्डमंलम्
verses.transliteration: rajastatrotthitaṃ bhaumaṃ gajavājipadāhatam / tenaitacchāditaṃ sarvaṃ sadiṅmārtaṇḍamaṃlam
verses.translation: Four hundred of those rays having variegated forms shower rain. The rays that generate rain are called Vandanas, Vandyas, Rtanas, Nutanas and Amrtas. Apart from these, there are three hundred rays that exude chilliness. These are called Drsyas, Medhyas, Vahyas and Hradinis.
verses.hindi: महाभ्रचयसंकाशं सुनासं नाम विश्वुतम् ७४१५ तस्येव दक्षिण कटे विशद्योजनविस्तरम् । ह्विंषष्टियोजनायाम हेसप्राकारतोरणम् १६ हष्टपुष्टावलिप्तानामावासा: कामरूपिणास् । ओत्कचानां प्रसुदितं राक्षसरानां महापुरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Four hundred of those rays having variegated forms shower rain. The rays that generate rain are called Vandanas, Vandyas, Rtanas, Nutanas and Amrtas. Apart from these, there are three hundred rays that exude chilliness. These are called Drsyas, Medhyas, Vahyas and Hradinis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four hundred of those rays having variegated forms shower rain. The rays that generate rain are called Vandanas, Vandyas, Rtanas, Nutanas and Amrtas. Apart from these, there are three hundred rays that exude chilliness. These are called Drsyas, Medhyas, Vahyas and Hradinis.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र दृश्यते सूर्यो न काष्ठा न च चन्द्रमाः । पादपाश्च न दृश्यन्ते गिरिशृङ्गाणि सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: na tatra dṛśyate sūryo na kāṣṭhā na ca candramāḥ / pādapāśca na dṛśyante giriśṛṅgāṇi sarvataḥ
verses.translation: These are called Candras. All these rays are yellow- coloured. He gratifies human beings through medicinal herbs; the Pitrs by means of Svadha;and Devas by means of nectar.
verses.hindi: मध्यमे तु महाकूदे देवकूठस्थ वे गिरेः । सुवर्णमणिपाषाणे श्रित्रे: खुक्ष्णतरे: शुभ: ॥ शाखाशतसहल्लाढय नेंकारोहसमाकुलस् ३१८ उत्तम भवनों के अधिपति हैं। ब्राह्मणों ! सुतिये । उस भुवन महागिरि के उत्तर शिखर पर देवशत्रु धहिक्रेयों का निवास है। उस वैभवशाली नगर का परिमण्डल तीस योजन का है, वह शात्रुओं के लिये अगम्य है  वहाँ कितने ही कोठे, अद्टालिकाएँ, उद्यान और वन हैं। वहाँ बड़ी-बड़ी परिखाएँ हें, चारों ओर तोरण लगे हुये हैं, सेकड़ों प्रकार के बाजे बजते रहते हें, जिससे वाठिकाओं में आनन्द उमड़ता रहता है। नागों से वह नगर
verses.wordMeaning: These are called Candras. All these rays are yellow- coloured. He gratifies human beings through medicinal herbs; the Pitrs by means of Svadha;and Devas by means of nectar.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are called Candras. All these rays are yellow- coloured. He gratifies human beings through medicinal herbs; the Pitrs by means of Svadha;and Devas by means of nectar.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परं न पश्यन्ति निशार्द्धे वार्षिके यथा । तत्रासौ सुमहद्यूथं मृगाणां समलक्ष्यत
verses.transliteration: parasparaṃ na paśyanti niśārddhe vārṣike yathā / tatrāsau sumahadyūthaṃ mṛgāṇāṃ samalakṣyata
verses.translation: During spring and the summer he blazes with the three hundred rays. During rains and autumn he generates rain by the four (hundred rays). The Sun creates mist and fog by means of the three (hundred rays) during early and late winter. He deposits energy on the medicinal herbs. By means of Svadha he propiti¬ ates Pitrs. By means of nectar of three varieties he bestows immortality.
verses.hindi: भरा हुआ है। देवकूट पर स्थित वह नगर सिद्ध और देव्ियों का विहार-स्थल है ।८११। ब्राह्मणश्रष्ठ ! दूसरे मर्यादा पर्वत पर विविध वर्ण के विशाल भवत समूह से युक्त कालिकेय नामक असुरों का एक दुर्गम नगर है जिसमें सुवर्ण और मणियों से चित्रित तथा अलंइत अनेक भवन और बड़े बड़े राजपथ हैं, जिनमें सदा मंगल, उत्सव होता है, जो सदा नर-नारियों से भरे रहते हैँ जिनकी परिख्ताओं से तोरण लटकते रहते हैँ । वह
verses.wordMeaning: During spring and the summer he blazes with the three hundred rays. During rains and autumn he generates rain by the four (hundred rays). The Sun creates mist and fog by means of the three (hundred rays) during early and late winter. He deposits energy on the medicinal herbs.…
verses.commentary: Sense: During spring and the summer he blazes with the three hundred rays. During rains and autumn he generates rain by the four (hundred rays). The Sun creates mist and fog by means of the three (hundred rays) during early and late winter. He deposits energy on the medicinal herbs.…

verses.sanskrit: अधावत्सहितः सर्वैः स राजा राजपुत्रकैः । वृन्दास्फोटो ऽभवत् तेषां शीघ्रं जग्मुर्दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: adhāvatsahitaḥ sarvaiḥ sa rājā rājaputrakaiḥ / vṛndāsphoṭo 'bhavat teṣāṃ śīghraṃ jagmurdiśo daśa
verses.translation: Thus thousand rays of the Sun achieve the purpose of the worlds. They differ according to the season by exuding water, chilliness and heat. Thus the bright and sparkling solar zone is described. It is the support and source of origin of the stars, planents and the Moon. All these, the stars, the Moon and the planets should be known to have originated from the Sun.
verses.hindi: सौ योजन लम्बा और साठ योजन चौड़ा सुनास नामक नगर महामेघ के समूह को तरह दीख पड़ता है उसी के दक्षिण शिखर पर बासठ योजन लम्बा और बीस योजन चौड़ा औत्कच नामक राक्षसों का महापुर है। इस्छा के अनुसार शरीर धारण करने वाले, हृष्ट-पुष्ट और सगवे राक्षस वहाँ निवास करते है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus thousand rays of the Sun achieve the purpose of the worlds. They differ according to the season by exuding water, chilliness and heat. Thus the bright and sparkling solar zone is described. It is the support and source of origin of the stars, planents and the Moon.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus thousand rays of the Sun achieve the purpose of the worlds. They differ according to the season by exuding water, chilliness and heat. Thus the bright and sparkling solar zone is described. It is the support and source of origin of the stars, planents and the Moon.…

verses.sanskrit: एकमार्गगतो राजा चित्रसेनो महीपतिः । एकाकी स गतस्तत्र यत्र यत्र च ते मृगाः
verses.transliteration: ekamārgagato rājā citraseno mahīpatiḥ / ekākī sa gatastatra yatra yatra ca te mṛgāḥ
verses.translation: The Moon is the lord of stars; the Sun is the king of planets. The remaining five planets are known as Isvaras having forms as they please. It is said that the fire is Sun and (the source of) water is the Moon. Now listen to the source of other planets as explained in detail.
verses.hindi: वह पुर सुवर्ण की परिखा और तोरण से युक्त है, जो देवकूट पवंत के मध्य शिखर पर सुशोभित है जो सुवर्ण सणिमसय हिलाखण्डों से चित्रित, चिकन और भव्यतम हैं । उस महापुर के ऊँचे भवनों में सौसो और
verses.wordMeaning: The Moon is the lord of stars; the Sun is the king of planets. The remaining five planets are known as Isvaras having forms as they please. It is said that the fire is Sun and (the source of) water is the Moon. Now listen to the source of other planets as explained in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Moon is the lord of stars; the Sun is the king of planets. The remaining five planets are known as Isvaras having forms as they please. It is said that the fire is Sun and (the source of) water is the Moon. Now listen to the source of other planets as explained in detail.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टो ऽसौ ततो दुर्गं काननं गिरिगह्वरम् । वल्लीगुल्मसमाकीर्णं स्थितो यत्र न लक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭo 'sau tato durgaṃ kānanaṃ girigahvaram / vallīgulmasamākīrṇaṃ sthito yatra na lakṣyate
verses.translation: The commander-in-chief of the army of Devas, Skanda, is said to be the origin of Angaraka (Mars). Those who have perfect knowledge know that Narayana is the origin of Lord Budha. Lord Rudra himself who is the prototype of Dharma, the son of Vivasvat, in the world, is the origin of the great planet Saturn, the slowest of all planets. He is the most excellent among Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: तत्र भुतवर्ट नाम नानाभुवगणालयम् । महादेवस्थ प्रथितं ध्यम्बकस्य महात्मनः 0 दीप्तमायतनं तत्र सर्वलोकेषु विश्वुतम् २० बराहगर्जातहक्षेशादलकरभाननेः । गृझोलूकमुखेश्चेव मेषोष्टराजमहामुख: २१ कदस्बेविकट: स्थलेलेस्बकेशतन्रुहैः । नानावर्णाकृतिधरेनानसंस्थानसंस्थितः २२ दीप्ते रनेकेरुग्रास्येर्भूतेरुप्रपराक्रमैः । अशुन्यमभवल्नित्यं महापरिषदेस्तथा २३
verses.wordMeaning: The commander-in-chief of the army of Devas, Skanda, is said to be the origin of Angaraka (Mars). Those who have perfect knowledge know that Narayana is the origin of Lord Budha. Lord Rudra himself who is the prototype of Dharma, the son of Vivasvat, in the world,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The commander-in-chief of the army of Devas, Skanda, is said to be the origin of Angaraka (Mars). Those who have perfect knowledge know that Narayana is the origin of Lord Budha. Lord Rudra himself who is the prototype of Dharma, the son of Vivasvat, in the world,…

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यांस्तु मृगान्मत्वा दिशो राजा व्यलोकयत् । कां दिशं नु गमिष्यामि क्व मे सैन्यसमागमः
verses.transliteration: adṛśyāṃstu mṛgānmatvā diśo rājā vyalokayat / kāṃ diśaṃ nu gamiṣyāmi kva me sainyasamāgamaḥ
verses.translation: The two great planets with bright rays are Sukra (Venus) and Brhaspati (Jupiter), the preceptors of Asuras and Devas. They are the sons of Prajapati. There is no doubt that the' entire universe, all the worlds including Devas, Asuras and human beings, have their roots in the Sun.
verses.hindi: तत्र भृतपते पता नित्य॑ पुजां प्रयुछजते । भरे: शद्भूपटहैभेंरीडिण्डिमगोमुखः २४
verses.wordMeaning: The two great planets with bright rays are Sukra (Venus) and Brhaspati (Jupiter), the preceptors of Asuras and Devas. They are the sons of Prajapati. There is no doubt that the' entire universe, all the worlds including Devas, Asuras and human beings, have their roots in the Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two great planets with bright rays are Sukra (Venus) and Brhaspati (Jupiter), the preceptors of Asuras and Devas. They are the sons of Prajapati. There is no doubt that the' entire universe, all the worlds including Devas, Asuras and human beings, have their roots in the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कष्टं गतो राजा चित्रसेनो नराधिपः । वृक्षच्छायां समाश्रित्य विश्राममकरोन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kaṣṭaṃ gato rājā citraseno narādhipaḥ / vṛkṣacchāyāṃ samāśritya viśrāmamakaronnṛpaḥ
verses.translation: It is his universal splendour, O leading Brahmanas, that shines as the refulgence of all heaven-dwellers such as Rudra, Indra, Visnu and the Moon. He is the Atman of all, the lord of all the worlds. He is the primordial great deity. Everything originates from him and merges in him.
verses.hindi: सिद्धदेव्षिगन्धवंयक्षनागेन्द्रपुजितः । स्थाने तस्घिन्महादेवः साक्षाल्लोकशिवः शिव: ॥ इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्‍्तेउनुषह्गपादे भुवनविन्यासो नाम चत्वारिशो5्ध्यायः ।
verses.wordMeaning: It is his universal splendour, O leading Brahmanas, that shines as the refulgence of all heaven-dwellers such as Rudra, Indra, Visnu and the Moon. He is the Atman of all, the lord of all the worlds. He is the primordial great deity.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is his universal splendour, O leading Brahmanas, that shines as the refulgence of all heaven-dwellers such as Rudra, Indra, Visnu and the Moon. He is the Atman of all, the lord of all the worlds. He is the primordial great deity.…

verses.sanskrit: क्षुत्तृषार्तो भ्रमन्दुर्गे कानने गिरिगह्वरे । ततो ऽपश्यत्सरो दिव्यं पद्मिनीखण्डमण्डितम्
verses.transliteration: kṣuttṛṣārto bhramandurge kānane girigahvare / tato 'paśyatsaro divyaṃ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the creation and dissolution of the worlds arose from the Sun formerly. The Universe is known as a planet. The Sun is the most excellent and refulgent planet. From him are born again and again and into him merge after death, all the moments, Muhurtas, days, nights, fortnights, months, seasons, years, sets of five years and Yugas.
verses.hindi: हजार-हजार डगोवाली सीढ़ियाँ बनी हुई हैं ।१८। उसी देवकूट पर्बंत पर दस योजन विस्तृत एक भूतवट नाम का वक्ष है, जिसके पत्ते चिकने, जड़ें विशाल, अनेक तने और जिसकी घनी छाया है। उस महावक्ष पर नीवे-ऊपर अनेक जीव निवास करते हैं । त्रिनयन महात्मा महादेव का वहाँ तीनों लोकों में विर्यात एक भास्वर स्थान है ।१६-२०। सुअर, हाथी सिंह, भालू. बाघ, करभ, गीध, उलल, भेड़ा, ऊंट और बकरे को
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the creation and dissolution of the worlds arose from the Sun formerly. The Universe is known as a planet. The Sun is the most excellent and refulgent planet. From him are born again and again and into him merge after death, all the moments, Muhurtas, days, nights,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the creation and dissolution of the worlds arose from the Sun formerly. The Universe is known as a planet. The Sun is the most excellent and refulgent planet. From him are born again and again and into him merge after death, all the moments, Muhurtas, days, nights,…

verses.sanskrit: हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णं चक्रवाकोपशोभितम् । ततो दृष्ट्वा स राजेन्द्रः सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः
verses.transliteration: haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam / tato dṛṣṭvā sa rājendraḥ samprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ
verses.translation: Their time-calculation is impossible without the Sun. Without time there is no sacred scripture, no initiation, and no daily routine. Without him how can the seasons be named and clas¬ sified? How can the foodgrains and plants grow? How can there be medicinal herbs of good quality? Without the Sun, the thief of water, the scorcher of the Universe, all the affairs of Devas here and in heaven cannot go on.
verses.hindi: तरह मुंहवाले उम्र पराक्रमी तथा अनेक प्रकार के भयक्कूर मँहवाले, विकट, स्थल, लम्बे केशोंवाले, नाना वर्ण और आकृति धारण करनेवाले, देदीप्यमान भूत प्रेतादि से और महापरिषदों से वह स्थान सदा भरा रहता है ।२१-२३। भूतगण वहाँ भूतपति महादेव की पूजा नित्य किया करते हैं। झाँझ, शद्भ, नगाड़ा, भेरी, डमरू, गोमुख आदि बाजे बजाकर नाच-्गाना और भयजक्कूर कोलाहल के साथ प्रथमादि गणेश्वर वहाँ महादेव की पूजा करके प्रसन्नता प्राप्त करते और कीड़ा किया करते है। इस प्रकार साक्षात् लोककल्याण कारक महादेव की उस स्थान में सिद्ध, देव, गन्धवं, यक्ष और नाग सदा पूजा किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Their time-calculation is impossible without the Sun. Without time there is no sacred scripture, no initiation, and no daily routine.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Their time-calculation is impossible without the Sun. Without time there is no sacred scripture, no initiation, and no daily routine.…

verses.sanskrit: कमलानि गृहीत्वा तु ततः स्नानं समाचरत् । तर्पयित्वा पितृदेवान्मनुष्यांश्च यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: kamalāni gṛhītvā tu tataḥ snānaṃ samācarat / tarpayitvā pitṛdevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathāvidhi
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, he alone is Kala (Time) and fire. He is the twelve-souled Prajapati. He blazes the three worlds including mobile and immobile beings. He alone is a mass of splendour. He is the entire world and benefactor of all the worlds. Resorting to the uppermost path of Vayu, he blazes this Universe by means of his splendour at the sides, above and below.
verses.hindi: श्री वायुपुराण का भुवनविन्यास नामक चालीसवाँ अध्याय समप्त (४०॥
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, he alone is Kala (Time) and fire. He is the twelve-souled Prajapati. He blazes the three worlds including mobile and immobile beings. He alone is a mass of splendour. He is the entire world and benefactor of all the worlds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, he alone is Kala (Time) and fire. He is the twelve-souled Prajapati. He blazes the three worlds including mobile and immobile beings. He alone is a mass of splendour. He is the entire world and benefactor of all the worlds.…

verses.sanskrit: आच्छाद्य शतपत्रैश्च पूजयामास शङ्करम् । ययौ पानीयममलं यथावत्स समाहितः
verses.transliteration: ācchādya śatapatraiśca pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram / yayau pānīyamamalaṃ yathāvatsa samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Seven among the thousand of the Sun already The Sun's ray called Susumna develops the declining Moon. It is said to be exerting power laterally and from The ray Harikesa is said to be the primordial cause
verses.hindi: विविक्तचारुशिखरं पत्रितं शद्धुवर्चंसम् । कलासं देवभक्तानामालय सुकृतात्मनाम् सुबर्णणणिचित्राभिरनेकाभिरलंकृतम् । सहाभवनमालाभिर्भूषितं नेकविस्लरस् धनाध्यक्षस्य देवस्य कुवेरस्प महात्मनः । नगर तदनाधृष्यमृद्धियुक्तं घुदा बुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Seven among the thousand of the Sun already The Sun's ray called Susumna develops the declining Moon. It is said to be exerting power laterally and from The ray Harikesa is said to be the primordial cause
verses.commentary: Sense: Seven among the thousand of the Sun already The Sun's ray called Susumna develops the declining Moon. It is said to be exerting power laterally and from The ray Harikesa is said to be the primordial cause

verses.sanskrit: उत्तीर्य सलिलात्तीरे दृष्ट्वा वृक्षं समीपगम् । उत्तरीयमधः कृत्वोपविष्टो धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: uttīrya salilāttīre dṛṣṭvā vṛkṣaṃ samīpagam / uttarīyamadhaḥ kṛtvopaviṣṭo dharaṇītale
verses.translation: The sixth ray Arvavasu is the source of origin of Brhaspati (Jupiter). The ray Svarat develops Sanaiscara (Saturn). Thus all the planets, stars and constellations flourish by the energy of the Sun. The entire Universe too flourishes thereby. The Naksatra-hood (i.e. the term Naksatra) is so called due to (fact that) they do not decline. 1 2
verses.hindi: तत्र तत्पुष्पकं नाम नानारत्नविभुषितम् । सहाविमानं रुचिरं सर्वकामगुणयुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The sixth ray Arvavasu is the source of origin of Brhaspati (Jupiter). The ray Svarat develops Sanaiscara (Saturn). Thus all the planets, stars and constellations flourish by the energy of the Sun. The entire Universe too flourishes thereby. The Naksatra-hood (i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तयन्नुपविष्टो ऽसौ किमद्य प्रकरोम्यहम् । तत्रासीनो ददर्शाथ वनोद्देशे मृगान्बहून्
verses.transliteration: cintayannupaviṣṭo 'sau kimadya prakaromyaham / tatrāsīno dadarśātha vanoddeśe mṛgānbahūn
verses.translation: The Sun too is a Naksatra because he falls into their Ksetras (spheres) and then by means of his rays he takes them The constellations ( Tarakas) are so called because they have crossed (the ocean of existence) by means of merit, be¬ cause [they resort to the planets at the end of their pious actions. They are called Tarakas because they enable others to cross (the ocean of existence) and because they are sparkling. Verses 45-49 trace the origin of planets to the specificfays of the Sun.
verses.hindi: मनोजवं कामगमं हेमजालविभूषितम् । वाहन यक्षराजस्थ कुबेरस्य महात्मन:ः तत्रेकपिज्भलो देवों महादेवसखः स्वयम् । वसति सम स यक्षेन्द्र: सर्वभुतनमस्क्ृतः सूतजी बोले-- उस देवकूट पर्वत के कुन्द तुल्य उज्ज्वल रमणीय मध्यम शिखर पर कलश बसा हुआ है । यह सौ योजन लम्बा और पचास योजन चौड़ा है। इसका शिखर श्ध की तरह उज्ज्वल, विस्तृत, दान्त और मनोहर है। अनेक सुकृतकर्मा भक्त वहाँ निवास करते हैं ।१-२। सुवर्ण-मणियों से चित्रित अनेक विशाल भवन पंक्तियों से भूषित वहाँ एक लम्बा-चौड़ा नगर है, जो धनाधिपति महात्मा कुबेर देव का दे । वह
verses.wordMeaning: The Sun too is a Naksatra because he falls into their Ksetras (spheres) and then by means of his rays he takes them The constellations ( Tarakas) are so called because they have crossed (the ocean of existence) by means of merit,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sun too is a Naksatra because he falls into their Ksetras (spheres) and then by means of his rays he takes them The constellations ( Tarakas) are so called because they have crossed (the ocean of existence) by means of merit,…

verses.sanskrit: केचित्पूर्वमुखास्तत्र चापरे दक्षिणामुखाः । वारुण्यमिमुखाः केचित् केचित् कौबेरदिङ्मुखाः
verses.transliteration: kecitpūrvamukhāstatra cāpare dakṣiṇāmukhāḥ / vāruṇyamimukhāḥ kecit kecit kauberadiṅmukhāḥ
verses.translation: Our author gives popular etymologies which are not tenable, e.g. in w. 51-55 we have derivations as follows: The Sun is called Aditya, because it always removes (lit. takes away \/a-cld) darkness of the night both celestial and terrestrial. He is great by his refulgence.
verses.hindi: नगर शत्रु के आक्रमण से सुरक्षित होते हुये भी भव्य और वंभवसम्पन्न है। उस नगर के बीच अनेक स्तम्भ वाला, तोरणों से युक्त और बहुविध सुवर्ण से भूषित एक मनोहर विपुला नामक सभा-भवन है ।३ ४॥। वहीं नाना रत्नों से विभूषित प्ुष्पकत नामक एक सुन्दर सा महाविमान है, जो सभी भोग्य पदार्थों से युक्त, मन की तरह शीघ्रगामी, इच्छामात्र से चलने वाला और सोने के तारों से मेंढ़ा हुआ है। यही विमान यक्षराज
verses.wordMeaning: Our author gives popular etymologies which are not tenable, e.g. in w. 51-55 we have derivations as follows: The Sun is called Aditya, because it always removes (lit. takes away \/a-cld) darkness of the night both celestial and terrestrial. He is great by his refulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Our author gives popular etymologies which are not tenable, e.g. in w. 51-55 we have derivations as follows: The Sun is called Aditya, because it always removes (lit. takes away \/a-cld) darkness of the night both celestial and terrestrial. He is great by his refulgence.

verses.sanskrit: केचिन् निद्रापराः केचिदूर्ध्वकर्णाः स्थिताः परे । मृगमध्ये स्थितो योगी ऋक्षशृङ्गो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: kecin nidrāparāḥ kecidūrdhvakarṇāḥ sthitāḥ pare / mṛgamadhye sthito yogī ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: The root y/su means 'to throb' and 'to exude.' Since it diffuses light and exudes water it is called " Savilr ". The root \/cad which gives the word 'Candra' has many meanings: 'to delight,' 'to sparkle','to act as nectar' and 'to be cool.' The divine and sparkling orbs of the Sun and the Moon are in the sky. They sparkle like blazing fire. They are auspicious and they resemble a circular jar. The orb of the Moon is of solid water and the orb of the Sun is of solid reful¬ gence.
verses.hindi: महात्मा कुबेर की सवारी में काम आता है। वहाँ सब भूतों के पूज्य यक्षेन्द्र एकपिंगल देव स्वयं निवास करते तत्राप्सरोगणवंक्षे्गन्धवें: सिद्धधारणैः । वसति सम महात्माधसो झुबेरो देवसत्तमः ६ तत्र पद्ममहापद्मौ तथा मकरकच्छपों । कुमुदः शडःखनीलस्य नन्‍दनो निधिसत्तमः १०
verses.wordMeaning: The root y/su means 'to throb' and 'to exude.' Since it diffuses light and exudes water it is called " Savilr ".…
verses.commentary: Sense: The root y/su means 'to throb' and 'to exude.' Since it diffuses light and exudes water it is called " Savilr ".…

verses.sanskrit: मृगान्दृष्ट्वा ततो राजा आहारार्थम् अचिन्तयत् । हत्वैतेषु मृगं कंचिद्भक्षयामि यदृच्छया
verses.transliteration: mṛgāndṛṣṭvā tato rājā āhārārtham acintayat / hatvaiteṣu mṛgaṃ kaṃcidbhakṣayāmi yadṛcchayā
verses.translation: Devas resorting to the stars, the Sun and the planets enter these spots in all the Manvantaras. These abodes of Devas are named after them. The Sun enters the abode Saura; the Moon enters the abode Saumya.
verses.hindi: तथेस्वाग्नियमादीनां देवानामप्सरोगणैः । तेषा केलास आवासो यत्र यक्षेश्वरः प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: Devas resorting to the stars, the Sun and the planets enter these spots in all the Manvantaras. These abodes of Devas are named after them. The Sun enters the abode Saura; the Moon enters the abode Saumya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas resorting to the stars, the Sun and the planets enter these spots in all the Manvantaras. These abodes of Devas are named after them. The Sun enters the abode Saura; the Moon enters the abode Saumya.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्थावस्थो भविष्यामि मृगमांसस्य भक्षणात् । काशीं प्रति गमिष्यामि मार्गमन्विष्य यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: svasthāvastho bhaviṣyāmi mṛgamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt / kāśīṃ prati gamiṣyāmi mārgamanviṣya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: The valorous sixteen-rayed Sukra (Venus) enters ihe abode Soukra. Brhaspati (Jupiter) enters the abode Brhat; Lohita (Mars) enters the abode Lauhila; Sanaiscara (Saturn) enters the abode SanaiScara. The planets are brightly illuminated due to their contact with the rays of the Sun. 1 The diameter of the Sun is nine thousand Yojanas. The girth of the Sun is three times its diameter. The width of the Moon is twice that of the Sun.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा पूर्वमुपस्थान यक्षेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः । पश्चाद्गच्छन्ति ये यस्य बिहिताः परिचारिका: १३ तत्र मन्दाकिनी नाम सुरम्या विपुलोदका । सुवर्गमणिसोपाना नानापुष्पोत्कटोत्कटा तथा अलकनन्दा च नन्‍्दा च सरितां वरा। एतरेव गुणर्युक्ता नद्यो देवषिसेविता: १८
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous sixteen-rayed Sukra (Venus) enters ihe abode Soukra. Brhaspati (Jupiter) enters the abode Brhat; Lohita (Mars) enters the abode Lauhila; Sanaiscara (Saturn) enters the abode SanaiScara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous sixteen-rayed Sukra (Venus) enters ihe abode Soukra. Brhaspati (Jupiter) enters the abode Brhat; Lohita (Mars) enters the abode Lauhila; Sanaiscara (Saturn) enters the abode SanaiScara.…

verses.sanskrit: विचिन्त्यैवं ततो राजा वृक्षमूलमुपाश्रितः । चापं गृह्य कराग्रेण स शरं संदधे ततः
verses.transliteration: vicintyaivaṃ tato rājā vṛkṣamūlamupāśritaḥ / cāpaṃ gṛhya karāgreṇa sa śaraṃ saṃdadhe tataḥ
verses.translation: Equal to them, Svarbhanu (Rahu) goes beneath. The planet Rahu is created in globular form out of the shadow of the earth. The dark abode of Svarbhanu is fashioned out of darkness. During full moon days he comes out of the Sun and goes to the Moon. From the Moon he goes to the Sun (during the new-moon days) and again he goes to the Moon. He dispels (the brilliance of) the heaven with his refulgence and. is, therefore, called Svarbhanu.
verses.hindi: दश गन्धर्वेनगराः समृद्धया परया युताः । महाभवनमालाभिरनेकासिविभुषिता: २०
verses.wordMeaning: Equal to them, Svarbhanu (Rahu) goes beneath. The planet Rahu is created in globular form out of the shadow of the earth. The dark abode of Svarbhanu is fashioned out of darkness. During full moon days he comes out of the Sun and goes to the Moon.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Equal to them, Svarbhanu (Rahu) goes beneath. The planet Rahu is created in globular form out of the shadow of the earth. The dark abode of Svarbhanu is fashioned out of darkness. During full moon days he comes out of the Sun and goes to the Moon.…

verses.sanskrit: विचिक्षेप शरं तत्र यत्र ते बहवो मृगाः । तेषां मध्ये स वै विद्ध ऋक्षशृङ्गो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: vicikṣepa śaraṃ tatra yatra te bahavo mṛgāḥ / teṣāṃ madhye sa vai viddha ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: The magnitude of the diameter and girth of Bhargava (Venus) is one sixteenth of that of the Moon. Scientifically correct observation but the rest (vv. 62-102)is imaginary. Bfhaspati (Jupiter) is three-fourths of the planet Venus in size. ICuja (Mars) and Saura (Saturn) are three- fourths of Jupiter in the size. Budha (Mercury) is three-fourths of each of them in width and girth.
verses.hindi: हैं, जो महादेव के सखा हैँ । देवोत्तम वह महात्मा कुबेर, यक्ष, गरधर्े, किन्नर, सिद्ध, चारण और अप्सराओं के साथ सतत निवास करते रहते हैँ ।६-६। महात्मा कुबेर की सभा में पद्म, महापद्म, मकर, कच्छप, कुमुद, शब्भ, नील और निधि-श्रंष्ठ नन्‍्दन नामक आठ अक्षय दिव्य महानिधि (कोषागार) स्थित हैं जहाँ रत्न संचित रहते हैं । जहाँ वकेश्वर कुबेर का आवास स्थान है, उसी के पास इन्द्र, अग्ति, यम भादि देवों और अप्सराओं का निवास है ।१०-१२। सब से पहले महात्मा यक्षेन्द्र की पूजा करके परिचारकगण उनके पीछे-पीछे चला करते हैं। वहाँ गंभीर जल वाली एक मनोरम मन्दाक्रिनी नामक नदी भी है जिसमें मणियों के घाट बँधे हैं और तरह-तरह के सुगन्धित फूल खिले हैं जो गन्ध और स्पश्च ग्रुण से युक्त सुवर्ण के पद्मों से तथा नील-बेंदूर्य के पत्र वाले गंधयुक्त महाप्मयों और असंरूय कुमुद खण्ड एवं महापक्मों से अलंकृत है। उसमें यक्ष
verses.wordMeaning: The magnitude of the diameter and girth of Bhargava (Venus) is one sixteenth of that of the Moon. Scientifically correct observation but the rest (vv. 62-102)is imaginary. Bfhaspati (Jupiter) is three-fourths of the planet Venus in size.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The magnitude of the diameter and girth of Bhargava (Venus) is one sixteenth of that of the Moon. Scientifically correct observation but the rest (vv. 62-102)is imaginary. Bfhaspati (Jupiter) is three-fourths of the planet Venus in size.…

verses.sanskrit: जग्मुस्त्रस्तास्तु ते सर्वे शब्दं कृत्वा वनौकसः । स ऋषिः पतितस् तत्र कृष्ण कृष्णेति चाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: jagmustrastāstu te sarve śabdaṃ kṛtvā vanaukasaḥ / sa ṛṣiḥ patitas tatra kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti cābravīt
verses.translation: (Heavenly) bodies, and constellations seen in the sky are equal to Mercury in width and girth. One conversant with reality should know that the stars are usually in conjunction with the Moon. The stars and constellations differ from one another by five hundred, four hundred, three hundred and two hundred Yojanas as well. The spheres of the stars are lesser than the earlier ones. There is no star smaller than the ones with one and a half Yojanas.
verses.hindi: गन्धवोँ की स्त्रियाँ और अप्सरायें सदा स्‍्तान करती हैं; उस मन्दाकिनी के जल को देव, दानव, गन्धवे यक्ष, राक्षस और पन्नग सदा पिया करते हैं ।(३-१७। इसके अतिरिक्त अलकनन्दा और नन्‍्दा नामकी भी दो नदियाँ वहाँ बहती हैं, जो सुधा के समान जल से युक्त हैं ओर जिनका सेवन सदा देवधिगण किया करते हैं । उसी शैलराज के पूर्व शिखर पर हजार योजन लम्बे और तीस योजन चोड़े गन्धर्व के दस नगर हैं। उन नगरों
verses.wordMeaning: (Heavenly) bodies, and constellations seen in the sky are equal to Mercury in width and girth. One conversant with reality should know that the stars are usually in conjunction with the Moon. The stars and constellations differ from one another by five hundred, four hundred,…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Heavenly) bodies, and constellations seen in the sky are equal to Mercury in width and girth. One conversant with reality should know that the stars are usually in conjunction with the Moon. The stars and constellations differ from one another by five hundred, four hundred,…

verses.sanskrit: हाहा कष्टं कृतं तेन येनाहं घातितो ऽधुना । कस्यैषा दुर्मतिर्जाता पापबुद्धेर् ममोपरि
verses.transliteration: hāhā kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ tena yenāhaṃ ghātito 'dhunā / kasyaiṣā durmatirjātā pāpabuddher mamopari
verses.translation: The three planets Saturn, Mars and Jupiter, move far above the other planets. They go slowly and their movements are crooked as well. The four great planets—the Sun, Moon, Mercury and Venus, have their orbits below. They move swiftly. There are crores of constellations and as many stars too. The way (orbit) of the stars is well arranged through the control of Vi this.
verses.hindi: की समृद्धि का कोई ठिकाना नहीं है। वहाँ बड़े-बड़े महलों की कितनी ही श्र णियाँ हैं। तप्त अज्भार के सदृश र्दप वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: The three planets Saturn, Mars and Jupiter, move far above the other planets. They go slowly and their movements are crooked as well. The four great planets—the Sun, Moon, Mercury and Venus, have their orbits below. They move swiftly.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The three planets Saturn, Mars and Jupiter, move far above the other planets. They go slowly and their movements are crooked as well. The four great planets—the Sun, Moon, Mercury and Venus, have their orbits below. They move swiftly.…

verses.sanskrit: मृगमध्ये स्थितश्चाहं न कंचिद् उपरोधये । तां वाचं मानुषीं श्रुत्वा स राजा विस्मयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: mṛgamadhye sthitaścāhaṃ na kaṃcid uparodhaye / tāṃ vācaṃ mānuṣīṃ śrutvā sa rājā vismayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: In the order of his transit, the movement of the Sun is either above or below. When the Moon is in the northern sphere during Parvans, Budha and Svarbhanu occupy their own abodes. The stars occupy their own abodes. These luminaries are the abodes of pious persons.
verses.hindi: सुबाहुहरिकेशाद्ाध्वित्रसेनज रादय: । दश गन्धवंराजानो दीप्तवक्लिपराक़माः
verses.wordMeaning: In the order of his transit, the movement of the Sun is either above or below. When the Moon is in the northern sphere during Parvans, Budha and Svarbhanu occupy their own abodes. The stars occupy their own abodes. These luminaries are the abodes of pious persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the order of his transit, the movement of the Sun is either above or below. When the Moon is in the northern sphere during Parvans, Budha and Svarbhanu occupy their own abodes. The stars occupy their own abodes. These luminaries are the abodes of pious persons.

verses.sanskrit: शीघ्रं गत्वा ततो ऽपश्यद् ब्राह्मणं ब्रह्मतेजसा । हाहा कष्टं कृतं मे ऽद्य येनासौ घातितो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: śīghraṃ gatvā tato 'paśyad brāhmaṇaṃ brahmatejasā / hāhā kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ me 'dya yenāsau ghātito dvijaḥ
verses.translation: The abodes are created by the Self-born Deity at the beginning of the Kalpa. They stay upto the dissolution of all living beings. These are the abodes of the deities in all Manvantaras. These deities identify themselves with these abodes and stay till the final dissolution. Tvisimat, the son of Dharma, known as Vasu is the lord Moon. The lord Sukra, king of Asuras, is known as Bhargava (Venus).
verses.hindi: तस्येव पश्चिमे कटे कुन्देन्दुसद्शप्रभे । नानाधातुशतंश्रित्रे: सिद्धदेवर्षिसिविते महामालिसुनेत्राद्यात्तथा समणिवरादयः । उदीर्णा यक्षराजानस्तत्र त्रिशत्सदा बभुः २५ इत्येते कथिता यक्षा वाय्वग्निसमतेजस: । येषामधिपतिदेंवः श्रीमान्वेश्रवण:ः प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: The abodes are created by the Self-born Deity at the beginning of the Kalpa. They stay upto the dissolution of all living beings. These are the abodes of the deities in all Manvantaras. These deities identify themselves with these abodes and stay till the final dissolution.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The abodes are created by the Self-born Deity at the beginning of the Kalpa. They stay upto the dissolution of all living beings. These are the abodes of the deities in all Manvantaras. These deities identify themselves with these abodes and stay till the final dissolution.…

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेन उवाच: अकामाद्घातितस्त्वं तु मृगभ्रान्त्या मयानघ । गृहीत्वा बहुदारूणि स्वतनुं दाहयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: citrasena uvāca: akāmādghātitastvaṃ tu mṛgabhrāntyā mayānagha / gṛhītvā bahudārūṇi svatanuṃ dāhayāmyaham
verses.translation: The excessively refulgent lord Brhaspati, son of Angiras, is the preceptor of Devas. Budha is charming and is known as the son of Tvisi. Agni was alternatively born as the youthful lord of Lohita (Mars). The daughters of Daksa resort to the stars and constellations.
verses.hindi: विवाहो यत्र रुद्रस्य महादेव्योमया सह । तपस्तप्तवती चेब यत्र देवी वराहइगना (३३९१ किरातरूपिणा चेव तत्र रुद्रेण क्रीडितम् । यत्र चेब कृतं ताभ्यां जम्बृद्वीपावलोकनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The excessively refulgent lord Brhaspati, son of Angiras, is the preceptor of Devas. Budha is charming and is known as the son of Tvisi. Agni was alternatively born as the youthful lord of Lohita (Mars). The daughters of Daksa resort to the stars and constellations.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excessively refulgent lord Brhaspati, son of Angiras, is the preceptor of Devas. Budha is charming and is known as the son of Tvisi. Agni was alternatively born as the youthful lord of Lohita (Mars). The daughters of Daksa resort to the stars and constellations.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टादृष्टं तु यत्किंचिन्न समं ब्रह्महत्यया । अन्यथा ब्रह्महत्यायाः शुद्धिर् मे न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaṃ tu yatkiṃcinna samaṃ brahmahatyayā / anyathā brahmahatyāyāḥ śuddhir me na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Svarbhanu is the son of Simhika-, who, being a demon, harasses all living creatures. Thus the deities identifying them¬ selves with the Moon, the Sun, planents and stars have been recounted. Thus the abodes and their resident deities are mention¬ ed. The abode of the thousand-rayed Sun is full of fire and sparkling. The abode of the thousand-rayed Moon is full of water and sparkling white. The abode of the five-rayed charming planet Budha is dark in colour.
verses.hindi: तेजस्वी, पराक्रमी सुबाहु, हरिकेश, चित्रसेन और जर आदि दस गन्धवे राज वहाँ के अधिपति हैं ।(८-२१। इस शैल के सिद्ध तथा सुरसेबित शत-शत धातुरंजित कुन्द तथा इन्दु तुल्य शुश्रकान्तिमय पदिचम शज्ध पर अलग अलग यक्षों के भवन बने हैं। वह स्थान अस्सी योजन लम्बा और तीस योजन चौडा है। वहाँ कितने बड़े-बड़े भवन हैं ।२२-२३। युनिये, यहाँ महाशयों के ऋद्धि-सम्पन्न तीस भवन हैं। उन भवनों में सदा आनन्द की धारा बहती रहती है । महामाली, सुनेत्र और मणिवर आदि तीस यक्षराज वहाँ के उदार प्रभु हैं। वायु और अग्नि के समान तेजस्वी उपर्युक्त यज्ञों के अधिपति श्रीमान वेैश्नवण हैं ।२४-२६। उसी कैलास के दक्षिण पाश्वे में नगाधिराज हिमालय स्थित है। जिसमें कितने हैं कंज हैं ।झरनों और ग्र॒फाओं की भी गिनती तहीं है। चोटियाँ, दर ओर मेडन भी अनगिनत हैं  यह हिमालय पूर्वीय समुद्र से लेकर पश्चिमीय समुद्र तक
verses.wordMeaning: Svarbhanu is the son of Simhika-, who, being a demon, harasses all living creatures. Thus the deities identifying them¬ selves with the Moon, the Sun, planents and stars have been recounted. Thus the abodes and their resident deities are mention¬ ed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Svarbhanu is the son of Simhika-, who, being a demon, harasses all living creatures. Thus the deities identifying them¬ selves with the Moon, the Sun, planents and stars have been recounted. Thus the abodes and their resident deities are mention¬ ed.…

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षशृङ्ग उवाच: न ते सिद्धिर् भवेत् काचिन्मयि पञ्चत्वमागते । बह्व्यो हत्या भविष्यन्ति विनाशे मम साम्प्रतम्
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣaśṛṅga uvāca: na te siddhir bhavet kācinmayi pañcatvamāgate / bahvyo hatyā bhaviṣyanti vināśe mama sāmpratam
verses.translation: The abode of the sixteen-rayed Venus is full of water. The abode of the nine-rayed Mars is full of water and red in colour. The abode of the twelve-rayed Brhaspati is big and green.' It is full of water. The abode of the light-rayed Saturn is dark in colour. It is full of water.
verses.hindi: फला हुआ है। इसके किसी किसी स्थान पर किन्नरों के नगर बसे हुए हैं, जो गिनती में सौ के लगभग हैं अनगिनत शिखरों वाले शलाधिराज हिमालय के मध्य-उदर में ये सब नगर विराजमान हैं, जहाँ के स्त्री पुरुष सदा प्रसन्न भर प्रजा हृष्ट पुष्ट रहती है ।२७-२६। द्व॒म, सुग्रीव, सैन्य और भगदत्त प्रमुख सौ राजा उन बलशाली तेजस्वी किन्नरों के अधिपति हैं। इसी पव॑त पर महादेव रुद्र का उमा के साथ ब्याह हुआ था ।
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of the sixteen-rayed Venus is full of water. The abode of the nine-rayed Mars is full of water and red in colour. The abode of the twelve-rayed Brhaspati is big and green.' It is full of water. The abode of the light-rayed Saturn is dark in colour. It is full of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of the sixteen-rayed Venus is full of water. The abode of the nine-rayed Mars is full of water and red in colour. The abode of the twelve-rayed Brhaspati is big and green.' It is full of water. The abode of the light-rayed Saturn is dark in colour. It is full of water.

verses.sanskrit: जननी मे पिता वृद्धो भ्रातरश्च तपस्विनः । भ्रातृजाया मरिष्यन्ति मयि पञ्चत्वम् आगते
verses.transliteration: jananī me pitā vṛddho bhrātaraśca tapasvinaḥ / bhrātṛjāyā mariṣyanti mayi pañcatvam āgate
verses.translation: The abode of Svarbhanu is dark. It is the abode harassing all living beings. The constellations are single-rayed and full of water. They are the abodes of persons of pious fame. They are bright and white in colour. They are of the nature of solid water. They are created in the beginning of the Kalpa m accordance with the Vedas. Because of his loftiness, the Sun is seen quickly by his bright rays. The Sun stationed in the Mgavithi, the path of southern transit, is encompassed by the line of the Earth during full moon and new moon days. He is not seen at the usual time and he sets early.
verses.hindi: वराज़ना उमा देवी ने यहीं कठोर तप किया था। किरात के वेश में महादेव ने यहीं क्रीड़ा की थी। इसी पबंत पर से महादेव और पाती ने समस्त जम्बूद्वीप का अवलोकन किया था ।३०-३२। वहाँ जो रुद्र देव की तत्रेवोमावन नाम सर्वलोकेयु विश्वुतम् । अधनारीनरं रूप धृतवान्यत्र शंकरः क्‍ ३६
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of Svarbhanu is dark. It is the abode harassing all living beings. The constellations are single-rayed and full of water. They are the abodes of persons of pious fame. They are bright and white in colour. They are of the nature of solid water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of Svarbhanu is dark. It is the abode harassing all living beings. The constellations are single-rayed and full of water. They are the abodes of persons of pious fame. They are bright and white in colour. They are of the nature of solid water.…

verses.sanskrit: एता हत्या भविष्यन्ति कथं शुद्धिर्भवेत् तव । उपायं कथयिष्यामि तं कर्तुं यदि मन्यसे
verses.transliteration: etā hatyā bhaviṣyanti kathaṃ śuddhirbhavet tava / upāyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi taṃ kartuṃ yadi manyase
verses.translation: Hence, the Moon stationed in northern path is not By virtue of the movement of luminaries, the Sun and the Moon rise and set at the same time during the equinox.
verses.hindi: ध्वजावताकिन चेव किड्िणीजालमालिनम् । यत्र सिंहरथं युक्त कारतिकेयस्प धीमतः ३८ चित्रपुष्पनिक्रुजस्य कौ चस्य च गिरेस्तटे । देवारिस्कन्दनः स्करदो यत्र शक्ति विभुक्तवान् ११३६ यत्राभिविक्तश्न गुहः सेन्द्रोपेन्द्रं: सुरोत्तमै:  सेवापत्ये च देत्यारिददिशाकंग्रतापवान् ४० भूतसंघावकीर्णानि एतान्यन्यानि च द्विजा:। तत्र तत्न कुमारस्य स्थानान्यायततानि च ४१
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the Moon stationed in northern path is not By virtue of the movement of luminaries, the Sun and the Moon rise and set at the same time during the equinox.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the Moon stationed in northern path is not By virtue of the movement of luminaries, the Sun and the Moon rise and set at the same time during the equinox.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेन उवाच: उपायः कथ्यतां मे ऽद्य यस्ते मनसि वर्तते । करिष्ये तमहं सर्वं यत्नेनापि महामुने
verses.transliteration: citrasena uvāca: upāyaḥ kathyatāṃ me 'dya yaste manasi vartate / kariṣye tamahaṃ sarvaṃ yatnenāpi mahāmune
verses.translation: In the northern pathways, they rise and set at different times. During the new moon and full moon days they follow the circle of luminaries. When the Sun is stationed in the southern path, he moves beneath the planets. Making his orb extensive, the Moon traverses the orbit above (the Sun). The entire multitude of stars moves above the Moon.
verses.hindi: तथा पाण्डुशिला नाम ह्माक्तीडा क्रौश्वधातिनः । नानामृतगणाकोीणें पृष्ठ हिसवतः शुभे ४२ क्रीड़ा भूमि है, वह विविध भूतगणों से युक्त विचित्र पुष्प-फल-सम्पन्न और आनन्दमय है। इस शलदेश में गिरि गुहा-निव।सिनी मनोहारिणी, प्रसन्नददवा, सुनयना, क्शोदरी, सुन्दरी किन्नरियाँ सदा रमण किया करती हैं ।२३-३४। जहाँ विशालाक्ष यक्ष, सुन्दर गन्धर्व और अन्यान्य अप्सराएँ सदा आनन्द मनाती रहती हैं। वहीं सब लोगों में विख्यात उमावन है । जहाँ भगवान् शद्भधुर ने आधे शरीर से नर और आधे से नारी का रूप
verses.wordMeaning: In the northern pathways, they rise and set at different times. During the new moon and full moon days they follow the circle of luminaries. When the Sun is stationed in the southern path, he moves beneath the planets. Making his orb extensive,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the northern pathways, they rise and set at different times. During the new moon and full moon days they follow the circle of luminaries. When the Sun is stationed in the southern path, he moves beneath the planets. Making his orb extensive,…

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षशृङ्ग उवाच: पृच्छामि त्वां कथं को वा कुतस्त्वमिह चागतः । ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां मध्ये को भवानुत शूद्रजः
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣaśṛṅga uvāca: pṛcchāmi tvāṃ kathaṃ ko vā kutastvamiha cāgataḥ / brahmakṣatraviśāṃ madhye ko bhavānuta śūdrajaḥ
verses.translation: Mercury is above the stars; Jupiter is above Mercury; Saturn is above Jupiter; and still above is the zone of Seven Sages (Great Bear). Dhruva (Pole Star) is above the Seven Sages. The intermediate distances between the stars and the planets are above two hundred thousand Yojanas and vary in individual cases (obscure Text).
verses.hindi: धारण किया था । वहीं शरवन भी हैं, जहाँ कातिकेय उत्पन्न हुए । यहीं रहकर उन्होंने क्रोंच शलबन को विदारण करने के लिये उत्साह प्रकट किया था ।३५-३७। श्रीमान् कतिकेय का इसी स्थान पर एक सिहरथ है, जो ध्वजापताका से युक्त और किकिणी जाल से सुशोभित है। चित्र विचित्र पुष्प कूजों से युक्त फ्रोंच पर्वत प्रान्त में देवशत्रुओं के संहारकत्ता कारतिकेय ने यहीं अपनी शक्ति छोड़ी थी। यहीं पर इन्द्रादि श्रेष्ठ देवों के सेनापति
verses.wordMeaning: Mercury is above the stars; Jupiter is above Mercury; Saturn is above Jupiter; and still above is the zone of Seven Sages (Great Bear). Dhruva (Pole Star) is above the Seven Sages.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Mercury is above the stars; Jupiter is above Mercury; Saturn is above Jupiter; and still above is the zone of Seven Sages (Great Bear). Dhruva (Pole Star) is above the Seven Sages.…

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेन उवाच: नाहं शूद्रो ऽस्मि भोस्तात न वैश्यो ब्राह्मणो न वा । न चान्त्यजो ऽस्मि विप्रेन्द्र क्षत्रियो ऽस्मि महामुने
verses.transliteration: citrasena uvāca: nāhaṃ śūdro 'smi bhostāta na vaiśyo brāhmaṇo na vā / na cāntyajo 'smi viprendra kṣatriyo 'smi mahāmune
verses.translation: The planets,'the Sun and the Moon come into contact with the stars everyday in the sky by their divine splendour and they separate also in the due order. The Sun, stars and the planets may be either below or above or in the middle. When they come together or separate from one another, people see them simultaneously. They stay in juxtaposition with one another coming into mutual contact. But their communion is free from inter¬ mixture.
verses.hindi: बनाये गये थे और उनका अभिषेक हुआ था। वे बारह सूर्य की तरह देदीप्यमान थे ।३८-४०। ब्राह्मणों  भूत-यूथों से व्याप्त यहाँ कातिकेय के कितने ही स्थान और भवन हैँ । हिमालय के मनोहर पृष्ठ भाग में जो नाता भूतों से संकुल है. कुमार कतिकेय की पाण्डु शिला नामक एक क्रौड़ाभूमि है। उसके रमणीय पूर्वीय प्रान्त में सिद्धों का निवास-स्थान कहा गया है, जिसका नाम विद्वानों ने कलापग्राम रखा है ।४१-४३। मृकंड़, वसिष्ठ भरत, नल, विश्वामित्र, उद्दालक आदि विप्रषियों के तथा कठोर तपस्या करने वाले कितने ही पवित्रात्मा ऋषियों के उस हिमालय पर संकड़ों हजारों आश्रम हैँ । वहाँ बहुतेरे सिद्धों के आवासस्थान और आयतन हूं। यज्ञ
verses.wordMeaning: The planets,'the Sun and the Moon come into contact with the stars everyday in the sky by their divine splendour and they separate also in the due order. The Sun, stars and the planets may be either below or above or in the middle.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The planets,'the Sun and the Moon come into contact with the stars everyday in the sky by their divine splendour and they separate also in the due order. The Sun, stars and the planets may be either below or above or in the middle.…

verses.sanskrit: धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च सर्वसत्त्वहिते रतः । अकामात् पातकं जातं कथं शुद्धिर्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca sarvasattvahite rataḥ / akāmāt pātakaṃ jātaṃ kathaṃ śuddhirbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Thus I have described to you the position of the luminaries on the earth and that also of the continents, oceans, mountains, sub-continents and rivers where they are situated*. These self-same planets formerly originated from the stars. Vivasvan, the son of Aditi, the first among the planets, le. the Sun-god, was born under the constellation Visakha in the Cak§usa Manvantara.
verses.hindi: ३०० " वायुपुराणम्
