verses.wordMeaning: Thus I have described to you the position of the luminaries on the earth and that also of the continents, oceans, mountains, sub-continents and rivers where they are situated*. These self-same planets formerly originated from the stars. Vivasvan, the son of Aditi,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have described to you the position of the luminaries on the earth and that also of the continents, oceans, mountains, sub-continents and rivers where they are situated*. These self-same planets formerly originated from the stars. Vivasvan, the son of Aditi,…

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षशृङ्ग उवाच: मां गृहीत्वा आश्रमं गच्छ यत्र तौ पितरौ मम । आवेदयस्व चात्मानं पुत्रघातिनम् आतुरम्
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣaśṛṅga uvāca: māṃ gṛhītvā āśramaṃ gaccha yatra tau pitarau mama / āvedayasva cātmānaṃ putraghātinam āturam
verses.translation: The brilliant Moon-god Vis'vavasu, the son ofDharma, After the Sun, Sukra (Venus), sonofBhrgu, endowed with sixteen rays, who is next to the Sun is the most excellent among constellations and planets. He is born in the constellation Tisya (Pusya). The planet Brhaspati (Jupiter) of twelve fiery flames, who is the son of Angiras and is the preceptor of the universe was born under the constellation PhalgunI (Purva Phalgum in Bd. P).
verses.hindi: नानारत्नाकरापूर्ण नानासत्त्वनिषेवितम् । नानानदीसहस्राणां संभवं वरपवंतम् बिस्‍्तीणं मध्यमे कटे हेमधातुविभूषिते । दीप्तमायतन विष्णो: सिद्धधिगणसेवितम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The brilliant Moon-god Vis'vavasu, the son ofDharma, After the Sun, Sukra (Venus), sonofBhrgu, endowed with sixteen rays, who is next to the Sun is the most excellent among constellations and planets. He is born in the constellation Tisya (Pusya).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The brilliant Moon-god Vis'vavasu, the son ofDharma, After the Sun, Sukra (Venus), sonofBhrgu, endowed with sixteen rays, who is next to the Sun is the most excellent among constellations and planets. He is born in the constellation Tisya (Pusya).…

verses.sanskrit: ते दृष्ट्वा मां करिष्यन्ति कारुण्यं च तवोपरि । उपायं कथयिष्यन्ति येन शान्तिर्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: te dṛṣṭvā māṃ kariṣyanti kāruṇyaṃ ca tavopari / upāyaṃ kathayiṣyanti yena śāntirbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: It is reported that the nine-rayed, red-bodied planet (Mars), son of Prajapati, is born under the constellation Purvasadha. The seven-rayed planet, Saturn, son of the Sun, is born under the constellation Revatl. The planets harassing the Sun and the Moon are born under the constellation Rohini.
verses.hindi: यक्षाप्सरः समाकीर्णं गन्धवंगणसेवितम् द (४६ तत्र साक्षान्महादेवः पीत्ामबरधरो हरि: । वरदः सेव्यते सिद्धेलीकिकर्ता सनातन: ३५०
verses.wordMeaning: It is reported that the nine-rayed, red-bodied planet (Mars), son of Prajapati, is born under the constellation Purvasadha. The seven-rayed planet, Saturn, son of the Sun, is born under the constellation Revatl.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is reported that the nine-rayed, red-bodied planet (Mars), son of Prajapati, is born under the constellation Purvasadha. The seven-rayed planet, Saturn, son of the Sun, is born under the constellation Revatl.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चित्रसेनो नृपोत्तम । स्कन्धे कृत्वा तु तं विप्रं जगामाश्रमसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā citraseno nṛpottama / skandhe kṛtvā tu taṃ vipraṃ jagāmāśramasannidhau
verses.translation: These stars and planets beginning with Sukra (Venus) should be comprehended (properly) because they attain evil propensities when the constellation of nativity is afflicted. They are affected by that defect (and are redeemed) due to devotion to the planets. Aditya (the Sun) is called the first among these planets. Among the stellar planets Sukra is the first. Among the comets (Ketu) is the first. Dhruva (Pole Star) is the pivotal peg among the planets divided in the four quarters. Among the stars, Sravistha (Dhanistha) is the most excellent; among the Ayanas (Transits) the Uttarayana (northern transit) is the most excellent.
verses.hindi: रुक्मकाध्चननियंहूं तप्तकाब्चनतो रणम् । अनेकबलभीक्टप्रतोलीशतसंकट म् ५२ हम्येप्रासादमतुलं तप्तकाल्‍चनभूषितम् । हम्यंप्रासादबद्धं च सुदितं चातिविस्तरम् ५३२ तथव पश्चिमे कटे पारिजातशिलोच्चये । देवदानवनागानां समृद्धानि पुराणि तु १५६
verses.wordMeaning: These stars and planets beginning with Sukra (Venus) should be comprehended (properly) because they attain evil propensities when the constellation of nativity is afflicted. They are affected by that defect (and are redeemed) due to devotion to the planets.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These stars and planets beginning with Sukra (Venus) should be comprehended (properly) because they attain evil propensities when the constellation of nativity is afflicted. They are affected by that defect (and are redeemed) due to devotion to the planets.…

verses.sanskrit: न शक्नोति यदा वोढुं विश्राम्यति पुनःपुनः । तावत् पश्यति तं विप्रं मूर्छितं विकलेन्द्रियम्
verses.transliteration: na śaknoti yadā voḍhuṃ viśrāmyati punaḥpunaḥ / tāvat paśyati taṃ vipraṃ mūrchitaṃ vikalendriyam
verses.translation: Among the five years the first is Samvatsara; among the seasons Sisira (late winter) is the first; among months Magha is the first.* Among the fortnights the bright half is excellent; among the Tithis (days of the lunar fortnight) Pratipat (the first day) is excellent; in the divisions of days and nights day is declared excellent.
verses.hindi: गन्धर्थ वहां विचरण करते हैं, विविध स्लेच्छ जातियों का भी वहाँ निवास है । यह गिरिराज कितने ही प्रकार के रत्नों कौ खजानों से परिपूर्ण है। कितने ही प्रकार के जीव-जन्तु वहां रहा करते हैं। उस श्रेष्ठ पंत से अनगिनत हजारों नदियाँ निकलती हैँ ।४४-४७। ब्राह्मणों  सुनिये । परश्चिमाचल निषध का अब हम यथार्थ रूप से वर्णन करते हैं । स्वर्ण-धातु से विभूषित उसके विस्तृत मध्यम छिखरपर विष्ण का देदीप्यमान
verses.wordMeaning: Among the five years the first is Samvatsara; among the seasons Sisira (late winter) is the first; among months Magha is the first.* Among the fortnights the bright half is excellent; among the Tithis (days of the lunar fortnight) Pratipat (the first day) is excellent;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the five years the first is Samvatsara; among the seasons Sisira (late winter) is the first; among months Magha is the first.* Among the fortnights the bright half is excellent; among the Tithis (days of the lunar fortnight) Pratipat (the first day) is excellent;…

verses.sanskrit: मुमोच चित्रसेनस् तं छायायां वटभूरुहः । वस्त्रं चतुर्गुणं कृत्वा चक्रे वातं मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: mumoca citrasenas taṃ chāyāyāṃ vaṭabhūruhaḥ / vastraṃ caturguṇaṃ kṛtvā cakre vātaṃ muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: Among the Muhurtas, the first is excellent. It has Rudra for its deity.. Yimvw (the lime taken in the winking of the eyes) is excellent among the units of time. So is the opinion oi those who know Time. Hence the Sun is remembered as Kala (Time). Know that he is the Isvara (Lord), the activiser of the four types of living beings and their destroyer as well. Thus, this is the regulated arrangement of luminaries as a decisive feature of the affairs of the world. It is evolved by the Lord for the regular functioning of the world.
verses.hindi: मन्दिर है जो सिद्ध ऋषियों से सेवित और यक्ष, अप्सरा, गन्त्रवे आदि से व्याप्त है ।४८-४६। वहाँ साक्षात् पीताम्बरध री देवाधिदेव हरि भगवान् निवास करते है. जो सनातन, सृष्टिकर्ता और वरदाता हैं सिद्ध जिनकी सदा सेवा किया करते हैं । उसी निषध पर्वत के नाना धातु से विभूषित और चिकने शिलातल वाले भीतरो शिखर पर उल्लंघी नामक राक्षसों का एक सुन्दर नगर है ! वहाँ चाँदी-सोने के निर्यूह (हार) और चमकीले सोने के तोरण हैं, ओलती, गली, कूटागार आदि से वह नगर भरा है ।१०-५२। कोठे और महल खरे सोने की भाँति जगमगा रहे हैं, महलों और कोठों का ताँता लगा हुआ है, स्थान-स्थात पर विविध वाहढिकायें सुशो- भित हैं । साँपों से वह नगर पा पूर्ण है । (साँप ही प्रवेश द्वार पर रखवाली करते हैं) इसीसे शत्रु वहाँ प्रवेश नहीं कर सकते हैं। वह नगर तीस योजन का है और सदा हरा-भरा आनन्दमय रहता है।५३-५४। उसके
verses.wordMeaning: Among the Muhurtas, the first is excellent. It has Rudra for its deity.. Yimvw (the lime taken in the winking of the eyes) is excellent among the units of time. So is the opinion oi those who know Time. Hence the Sun is remembered as Kala (Time).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the Muhurtas, the first is excellent. It has Rudra for its deity.. Yimvw (the lime taken in the winking of the eyes) is excellent among the units of time. So is the opinion oi those who know Time. Hence the Sun is remembered as Kala (Time).…

verses.sanskrit: पश्यतस् तस्य राजेन्द्र ऋक्षशृङ्गो महातपाः । पञ्चत्वमगमच्छीघ्रं ध्यानयोगेन योगवित्
verses.transliteration: paśyatas tasya rājendra ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ / pañcatvamagamacchīghraṃ dhyānayogena yogavit
verses.translation: It is born ofSravana and consolidated in Dhruva. It extends all round in the form of a circle.* It was told (ordained) so intelligently at the beginn¬ ing of Kalpa by the Lord. He is the supporter and the Abhimdnin (the identifier) with all. He is the Soul of luminary bodies. He is the cosmic form, a miraculous transformation o tPradhana.
verses.hindi: दक्षिण पारव में बहुतेरे दंत्य निवास करते हैं भौर उसी शेल के मध्य उदर में दुष्प्रवेशय नगर हैं। इस नगर में प्रवेश करने का मार्ग एक गफा है । उसी के पश्चिम पारिजात-शिलाखण्ड वाले शिखर पर देव, दानव
verses.wordMeaning: It is born ofSravana and consolidated in Dhruva. It extends all round in the form of a circle.* It was told (ordained) so intelligently at the beginn¬ ing of Kalpa by the Lord. He is the supporter and the Abhimdnin (the identifier) with all. He is the Soul of luminary bodies.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is born ofSravana and consolidated in Dhruva. It extends all round in the form of a circle.* It was told (ordained) so intelligently at the beginn¬ ing of Kalpa by the Lord. He is the supporter and the Abhimdnin (the identifier) with all. He is the Soul of luminary bodies.…

verses.sanskrit: दाहयामास तं विप्रं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा । स्नानं कृत्वा स शोकार्तो विललाप मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: dāhayāmāsa taṃ vipraṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā / snānaṃ kṛtvā sa śokārto vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: The movement of the luminaries among human beings cannot be precisely observed by the physical eve, nor can it be narrated exactly by anyone. By means of scriptures, inference, perception and reasoning, after scrutinizing intelligently and carefully, a learn¬ ed man should entertain sufficient faith in it. O excellent among intelligent beings, these five func¬ tions are the means for ascertaining the true positions of the lumi¬ nary bodies, viz. the eye, scriptures, water, written documents and mathematical calculations.
verses.hindi: उपासतेषत्र श्रीमन्‍्तं तारापतिमनिन्दितम् । ऋषिकिन्नरगन्धर्वाः साक्षाहेवं तमोनुदस् ४८ तत्रव चोत्तरे कटे ब्रह्मगाश्वंसिति स्मृतम् । स्थान तत्र सुरेशस्य ब्राह्मण: प्रथितं दिवि ५६ इज्यापजानमस्कारस्तन्न सिद्धाः स्वयंभुवम् । उपासते महात्मानं यक्षगन्धवंदानवा: १६० तथवा5ध्यतनं वह्नेः सर्वलोकेषु विश्र॒तम् । तत्र विग्रहवान्वह्लिः सेव्यते सिद्धचारण: (६१ तथव चोत्तरे रम्ये त्रिशुढगे वरपरव॑ते । ऋषिसिद्धानुचरिते नानाभूतगणालये ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: The movement of the luminaries among human beings cannot be precisely observed by the physical eve, nor can it be narrated exactly by anyone. By means of scriptures, inference, perception and reasoning, after scrutinizing intelligently and carefully,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The movement of the luminaries among human beings cannot be precisely observed by the physical eve, nor can it be narrated exactly by anyone. By means of scriptures, inference, perception and reasoning, after scrutinizing intelligently and carefully,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शूलभेदमाहात्म्ये ऋक्षशृङ्गस्वर्गगमनवर्णनं नाम त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ५४ ईश्वर उवाच: ततश्चानन्तरं राजा जगामोद्वेगम् उत्तमम् । कथं यामि गृहं त्वद्य वाराणस्याम् अहं पुनः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye ṛkṣaśṛṅgasvargagamanavarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 54 īśvara uvāca: tataścānantaraṃ rājā jagāmodvegam uttamam / kathaṃ yāmi gṛhaṃ tvadya vārāṇasyām ahaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: O excessively refulgent sage, in which land has this holy and excellent incident happened in regard to persons progressing in Brahman? At what time? Narrate this exactly in the manner it happened.
verses.hindi: पुर तत्त्रिषु लोकेषु हेमचित्र तु विश्वुतम् ६२ त्रयाणां देवमुख्यानां जोण्येवाउडयतनानि व । नारायणस्याइब्यतन पूवेक्टे द्विजोत्तसाः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O excessively refulgent sage, in which land has this holy and excellent incident happened in regard to persons progressing in Brahman? At what time? Narrate this exactly in the manner it happened.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excessively refulgent sage, in which land has this holy and excellent incident happened in regard to persons progressing in Brahman? At what time? Narrate this exactly in the manner it happened.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यासमाविष्टो जुहोम्यग्नौ कलेवरम् । अथवा तस्य वाक्येन तं गच्छाम्याश्रमं प्रति
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāsamāviṣṭo juhomyagnau kalevaram / athavā tasya vākyena taṃ gacchāmyāśramaṃ prati
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas of pure rites, I shall narrate what had been heard by me before, when it was being narrated by Vayu, the very breath of the Universe, at the sacrifice lasting for a thousand years. It refers to how the throat of Siva, the lord ofDevas, attained blueness. * 1
verses.hindi: मध्यमे ब्रह्मणः स्थानं शंकरस्य तु पश्चिमे ६३ दत्यदानवगन्धर्वेश्नक्षराक्षसपन्नग: । इं(ई)जाता अभिपुज्यते देवदेवा महाबला: दि तथा पुराणि रम्पाणि देशे चेव क्वचित्ववचित् । यक्षगन्धर्वप्रागानां त्रिशु गे वरपवव॑ते १६४५ तथब चोत्तरे देशे जातुधों देवपर्वबते। अनेकशद्भकलिते सिद्धसाधुनिषेविते १६६ और नागों के वैभव सम्पन्न नगर हैं ।१५-५६। उस पंत की महातट-भूमि पर एक सोमशिला है, जिस पर प्रत्येक मास में चन्द्रमा उतरा करते हैं । ऋषि, किन्नर और गन्धवंगण अन्धकारविनाशी, सुन्दरतम, श्रीमान् साक्षात् तारापति चन्द्र की वहाँ उपासना किया करते हैं। उस पंत का शिखर ब्रह्मपादब॑ कहलाता है । स्वर्ग में वह सुरश्रेष्ठ ब्रह्मा का स्थान कहा जाता हैं ।६७-५६। यक्ष, गन्धर्व और दानव आदि भजन-पूजन और
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas of pure rites, I shall narrate what had been heard by me before, when it was being narrated by Vayu, the very breath of the Universe, at the sacrifice lasting for a thousand years. It refers to how the throat of Siva, the lord ofDevas, attained blueness. * 1
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas of pure rites, I shall narrate what had been heard by me before, when it was being narrated by Vayu, the very breath of the Universe, at the sacrifice lasting for a thousand years. It refers to how the throat of Siva, the lord ofDevas, attained blueness. * 1

verses.sanskrit: कथयामि यथावृत्तं गत्वा तस्य महामुनेः । एवं संचिन्त्य राजासौ जगामाश्रमसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: kathayāmi yathāvṛttaṃ gatvā tasya mahāmuneḥ / evaṃ saṃcintya rājāsau jagāmāśramasannidhau
verses.translation: On the north of the king of mountains Himavat, there are lakes, rivers and eddies, where in sacred parks, holy centres, temples, high peaks of mountains, caves and gardens noble sages of pure rites and devotion eulogise the great Lord in due manner.
verses.hindi: नमस्कार के द्वारा वहां महत्मा ब्रह्मा की उपासना किया करते हैं। वहीं वक्ति देव का निवास स्थान है, जो सब लोकों में विख्यात है । सिद्ध चारण आदि देहधारी वक्लि की उपासना किया करते हैं। उसी श्रेष्ठ प॑त के उत्तर रमणीय त्रिक्रूट पर जहाँ ऋषि, सिद्ध और नाना प्रकार के भूतगण निवास करते हैं, हेमचित्र नामक एक त्रिलोक-विख्यात नगर है ।६०-६२। वहाँ तीनों देवों के तीन स्थान हैं । ब्राह्मणो ! पूवे शिखर पर नारायण का,
verses.wordMeaning: On the north of the king of mountains Himavat, there are lakes, rivers and eddies, where in sacred parks, holy centres, temples, high peaks of mountains, caves and gardens noble sages of pure rites and devotion eulogise the great Lord in due manner.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the north of the king of mountains Himavat, there are lakes, rivers and eddies, where in sacred parks, holy centres, temples, high peaks of mountains, caves and gardens noble sages of pure rites and devotion eulogise the great Lord in due manner.

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षशृङ्गस्य चास्थीनि गृहीत्वा स नृपोत्तमः । दृष्टिमार्गे स्थितस्तस्य महर्षेर् भावितात्मनः
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣaśṛṅgasya cāsthīni gṛhītvā sa nṛpottamaḥ / dṛṣṭimārge sthitastasya maharṣer bhāvitātmanaḥ
verses.translation: By means of Rk, Yajus and Saman Mantras, dances, songs and worships, by Omkara and obeisance they always worship Siva.
verses.hindi: बीच में ब्रह्मा का और परिचम में महादेव का स्थान है। पूज्य वे बलशाली दंत्य, दानव, गन्ध्व और यक्ष- राक्षसों द्वारा सदा पूजे जावे हैं । श्रेष्ठ पव॑त के उन तीनों शिखरों पर कहीं-कहीं किसी स्थान में यक्ष-गन्धरववें और नागों के भी रमणीय पुर हैं ।६१-६५। उसी के उत्तर जातुधि नामक देवपवंत पर जिसके अनेक शशड्भ हैं और जिन पर साधु विराजते रहते हैं--हजारों यक्षों, किन्नरों, गन्धर्वों, नागों, राक्षसों और देत्यों के भी अनेक कटे तु मध्यमे तस्य सिद्धसंघनिषेविते। रम्ये देवषिचरिते रत्नधातुविभूषिते ६८ पद्योत्पलवन: फुल्ले:ः सौगन्धिकवनेस्तथा । तथा कुसुदखण्डश्च विकचेरुपशोभते
verses.wordMeaning: By means of Rk, Yajus and Saman Mantras, dances, songs and worships, by Omkara and obeisance they always worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of Rk, Yajus and Saman Mantras, dances, songs and worships, by Omkara and obeisance they always worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घतपा उवाच: आगच्छ स्वागतं ते ऽस्तु आसने ऽत्रोपविश्यताम् । अर्घं ददाम्यहं येन मधुपर्कं सविष्टरम्
verses.transliteration: dīrghatapā uvāca: āgaccha svāgataṃ te 'stu āsane 'tropaviśyatām / arghaṃ dadāmyahaṃ yena madhuparkaṃ saviṣṭaram
verses.translation: The popular legend attributing the blue colour of Siva's throat to the drinking of Kalakuta poison appears in the Mbh. Adi. 11.41.43 and in other Puranas. The text of this chapter in vv. 10 ff. corresponds to Bd. P.
verses.hindi: विहडगसंघसंघुष्टं नानासत्त्वनिषेवितस् । हंसकारण्डवाकीर्ण मत्तषट्पदसेवितम् ७० नानासत्त्वगणाकीण विह॒ड्गेरपशोभितम् । चारुतीथंसुसंबाध त्रिशदुयोजनसण्डलम्
verses.wordMeaning: The popular legend attributing the blue colour of Siva's throat to the drinking of Kalakuta poison appears in the Mbh. Adi. 11.41.43 and in other Puranas. The text of this chapter in vv. 10 ff. corresponds to Bd. P.
verses.commentary: Sense: The popular legend attributing the blue colour of Siva's throat to the drinking of Kalakuta poison appears in the Mbh. Adi. 11.41.43 and in other Puranas. The text of this chapter in vv. 10 ff. corresponds to Bd. P.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेन उवाच: अर्घस्यास्य न योग्यो ऽहं महर्षे नास्मि भाषणे । मृगमध्यस्थितो विप्रस् तव पुत्रो मया हतः
verses.transliteration: citrasena uvāca: arghasyāsya na yogyo 'haṃ maharṣe nāsmi bhāṣaṇe / mṛgamadhyasthito vipras tava putro mayā hataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Vayu, what has been uttered by you as Nilakantha is a great secret. It is the holiest ofall sacred things. O most excellent one among pious persons, O Wind-god, we wish to hear about it by your favour, what made the throat of the lord of Ambika blue!
verses.hindi: तत्र नागपतिश्चण्डश्चण्डो नाम दुरासदः । शतशीर्षो महाभागो विष्णुचक्रादू:चिह्नितः।॥ इत्येबमष्टो विज्ञेया विचित्रा देवपवंता: १७३ पुरेरायतनेः पुण्य: पुण्योदेश्व सरोवर: । सुवर्णपर्वतनेंकेस्तथा रजतपव॑त: ७४ नानारत्नप्रभासं श्च नेकेश्च मणिपवंतेः । हरितालपवंतनेंकेस्तथा हिहुगुलकाच्चन:ः ७५
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Vayu, what has been uttered by you as Nilakantha is a great secret. It is the holiest ofall sacred things. O most excellent one among pious persons, O Wind-god, we wish to hear about it by your favour, what made the throat of the lord of Ambika blue!
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Vayu, what has been uttered by you as Nilakantha is a great secret. It is the holiest ofall sacred things. O most excellent one among pious persons, O Wind-god, we wish to hear about it by your favour, what made the throat of the lord of Ambika blue!

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रघ्नं विद्धि मां विप्र तीव्रदण्डेन दण्डय । मृगभ्रान्त्या हतो विप्र ऋक्षशृङ्गो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: putraghnaṃ viddhi māṃ vipra tīvradaṇḍena daṇḍaya / mṛgabhrāntyā hato vipra ṛkṣaśṛṅgo mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: We wish to hear it particularly from your mouth. What¬ ever is uttered by you, whatsoever words come out of your mouth are full of meanings.
verses.hindi: मन्दिर हैं। उस पव॑त के रमणीय रत्न-धातुओं से विभूषित मध्यमशिखर पर सिद्ध-संघ देवथि सदा निवास करते हैं ।६६-६८। वहां अत्यन्त पवित्र जलवाला आनन्द जल नामक एक सरोवर है। उसका जल सदा निमंल रहता है, सिद्धगण उसमें स्नान करते हैं, विविध भांति के जीवों से वह भरा हुआ है। बह पक्षियों के समृह से भरा हुआ और अति शोभा श्वाली है। हंस, कारण्ड और मतवाले श्रमर वहाँ विचरण करते हैं। वह
verses.wordMeaning: We wish to hear it particularly from your mouth. What¬ ever is uttered by you, whatsoever words come out of your mouth are full of meanings.
verses.commentary: Sense: We wish to hear it particularly from your mouth. What¬ ever is uttered by you, whatsoever words come out of your mouth are full of meanings.

verses.sanskrit: इति मत्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ कुरु मे त्वं यथोचितम् । माता तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा गृहान् निष्क्रम्य विह्वला
verses.transliteration: iti matvā muniśreṣṭha kuru me tvaṃ yathocitam / mātā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gṛhān niṣkramya vihvalā
verses.translation: When breath touches the proper place of articula¬ tion, then the activity of speech begins. Knowledge at the outset and desire afterwards gets activated from you, O Vayu.
verses.hindi: विकसित पद्म, उत्पल, सौगन्धित और कुमुद से दयोभित है और उसमें बढ़िया घाट बंधे हुये है। वह लम्बाई- चौड़ाई में तीस योजन का है ।६९-७२। वहाँ चण्ड नामक एक अत्यन्त दुधंषं और भयंकर नागपति निवास करते हैं, वे महाभाग सौ सिरवाले हैं और उन सिरों पर विष्णचक्र चिह्नित हैं। इन्हीं आठों को विचित्र देवपवंत समझना चाहिए ।७३। अनेकानेक पवित्रपुर, मन्दिर, पवित्र जलवाले सरोवर, अनेक सोने-चाँदी के पर्वत, नाना रत्नप्रभा मण्डित अगणित मणिपवंत, बहुत से हरिताल शेल, असंख्य हिंगुल कांचल, अरुणाभ
verses.wordMeaning: When breath touches the proper place of articula¬ tion, then the activity of speech begins. Knowledge at the outset and desire afterwards gets activated from you, O Vayu.
verses.commentary: Sense: When breath touches the proper place of articula¬ tion, then the activity of speech begins. Knowledge at the outset and desire afterwards gets activated from you, O Vayu.

verses.sanskrit: हा हतास्मीत्युवाचेदं पपात धरणीतले । विललाप सुदुःखार्ता पुत्रशोकेन पीडिता
verses.transliteration: hā hatāsmītyuvācedaṃ papāta dharaṇītale / vilalāpa suduḥkhārtā putraśokena pīḍitā
verses.translation: If you are motionless, the functions of sound cease. Where speech has ceased, the sustenance of body becomes difficult..
verses.hindi: विचित्र शिखरों से युक्त अनेक पर्वत से यहाँ की सम्पूर्ण भूमि परिपूर्ण है ।७४-७७। उन नाना वर्ण के हजारों पर्वतों पर दत्य, दानव, गन्धव और यक्षों के भव्य भवन बने हुये हैं। इन शेलों पर दत्य, राक्षस, साधु,
verses.wordMeaning: If you are motionless, the functions of sound cease. Where speech has ceased, the sustenance of body becomes difficult..
verses.commentary: Sense: If you are motionless, the functions of sound cease. Where speech has ceased, the sustenance of body becomes difficult..

verses.sanskrit: हा हता पुत्र पुत्रेति करुणं कुररी यथा । विललापातुरा माता क्व गतो मां विहाय वै । मुखं दर्शय चात्मीयं मातरं मां हि मानय
verses.transliteration: hā hatā putra putreti karuṇaṃ kurarī yathā / vilalāpāturā mātā kva gato māṃ vihāya vai / mukhaṃ darśaya cātmīyaṃ mātaraṃ māṃ hi mānaya
verses.translation: Even there, there is your excellence, O Vayu, you are all-pervasive. O Wind-god, there is no god other than you who is all-pervasive.
verses.hindi: घनुश्चिह्नान्तगतग्रन्थ: क. ग डः. पुस्तकेषु नास्ति । गन्धंवें रप्सरोभिश्च सेविता नेकविस्तरा: । पुण्यक्रस्धिः समाकीर्णा: केसराकृतयों नगाः गिरिजाल तु तन्मेरो सिद्ध लोकमिति स्घृतम् । चित्र नानाश्रयोपेत॑ प्रचार॑ सुकृतात्मनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Even there, there is your excellence, O Vayu, you are all-pervasive. O Wind-god, there is no god other than you who is all-pervasive.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even there, there is your excellence, O Vayu, you are all-pervasive. O Wind-god, there is no god other than you who is all-pervasive.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुताध्ययनसम्पन्नं जपहोमपरायणम् । आगतं त्वां गृहद्वारे कदा द्रक्ष्यामि पुत्रक
verses.transliteration: śrutādhyayanasampannaṃ japahomaparāyaṇam / āgataṃ tvāṃ gṛhadvāre kadā drakṣyāmi putraka
verses.translation: O Vayu, this world of living beings is directly visible to you from everywhere. You know the lord of speeches, Isvara, the leader (controller) of the mind.
verses.hindi: नात्युग्रकर्म सिद्धानां प्रतिमा मध्यमाः स्मृता । स हि स्वर्ण इति ख्यातः क़मस्त्वेष प्रकीतितः
verses.wordMeaning: O Vayu, this world of living beings is directly visible to you from everywhere. You know the lord of speeches, Isvara, the leader (controller) of the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vayu, this world of living beings is directly visible to you from everywhere. You know the lord of speeches, Isvara, the leader (controller) of the mind.

verses.sanskrit: लोकोक्त्या श्रूयते चैतच्चन्दनं किल शीतलम् । पुत्रगात्रपरिष्वङ्गश्चन्दनाद् अपि शीतलः
verses.transliteration: lokoktyā śrūyate caitaccandanaṃ kila śītalam / putragātrapariṣvaṅgaścandanād api śītalaḥ
verses.translation: Tell us how was the deformity of the neck of Siva brought about?
verses.hindi: चतुर्महाद्वीपव॒ती सेवमुर्वो प्रकीतिता । नानावर्णप्रमाणेहि नानावर्णबलेस्तथा नानाभक्ष्यान्नपानश्र नत्नाच्छादनभूष णैः । प्रजाविकारं विविधेश्रित्ररध्युषितेः सह चत्वारो नंकवर्णांदद्या महाद्वीपाः परिश्रुता: । भद्राश्व भरताश्चेव केतुमालाश्र पश्चिमा: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Tell us how was the deformity of the neck of Siva brought about?
verses.commentary: Sense: Tell us how was the deformity of the neck of Siva brought about?

verses.sanskrit: किं चन्दनेन पीयूपबिन्दुना किं किमिन्दुना
verses.transliteration: kiṃ candanena pīyūpabindunā kiṃ kimindunā
verses.translation: Formerly, in the Kjrtayuga there was a Brahmana Vasi§tha. He was a mental son of Brahma. He was a righteous soul interested (expert) in deciding the (meaning of the) Vedas.
verses.hindi: संषा चतुमंहाद्वीपा नानाह्ीपसमाकुला । पृथिवी कीतिता कृत्स्ना पद्माकारा मया हिजाः तदेषा सान्तरद्वीपा सशैलवनकानना । पद्म त्यभिहिता कृत्स्ना प्रथिवी बहुविस्तरा सब्रह्मसदनं लोक॑ सदेवासुरमानुषम् । त्रिलोकमिति विख्यात॑ यत्सत्त्वेव्यंवहार्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, in the Kjrtayuga there was a Brahmana Vasi§tha. He was a mental son of Brahma. He was a righteous soul interested (expert) in deciding the (meaning of the) Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, in the Kjrtayuga there was a Brahmana Vasi§tha. He was a mental son of Brahma. He was a righteous soul interested (expert) in deciding the (meaning of the) Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रगात्रपरिष्वङ्गपात्रं गात्रं भवेद्यदि
verses.transliteration: putragātrapariṣvaṅgapātraṃ gātraṃ bhavedyadi
verses.translation: He asked Karttikeya whose excellent vehicle was the peacock and who stole collyrium from the eyes of the womenfolk of Mahi§a (i.e. made them widows by killing Mahisasura), a great soul. His voice resembled the thundering sound of the clouds He assumed the guise of a boy to delight the mind of Uma. He had killed Kraunca and delighted the heart of ParvatT Vasi¬ na devoutly asked Karttikeya of great power:
verses.hindi: किन्नर, उरग. गन्धवे, सिद्ध, चरण, अप्सरा आदि निवास करते हैं। सारांश यह कि, ये विस्तृत पर्वत पुण्या- त्माओं से परिपूर्ण हैं ।35-७६। मेरु के केसर की तरह बिखरे हुये ये पर्वत-जाल ही सिद्धलोक कहलाते हूँ । ये विचित्र विविध आश्रमयुक्त और सुक्ृतात्माओं के बिहारस्थल हैँ । यह उदार कर्मा सिद्धों की मध्यमा प्रतिमा कहा गया है। यह मेरु ही स्वर कहा गया है। उसके संस्थान-क्रम का वर्णन इस प्रकार किया गया है ।5०-८३। नाना वर्ण-प्रमाण, नाना वर्णबल, नाना भक्ष्य, अन्न, पान, आच्छादन, भूषण और विविध भाँति के निवासी प्रजाजनों से युक्त यह पृथ्वी चार द्वीपों वाली कही गई है। अनेक वर्णों से युक्त भद्द, भरत, केतुमाल और उत्तर कुरु नामक चार महाद्वीप विख्यात हैँं। इन द्वीपों में पुण्यात्मा लॉक निवास करते है ।5३-८५। ब्राह्मणो ! यहाँ हमने चारों महाद्वीपों और नाना द्वीपों से युक्त पद्माकार संपूर्ण पृथ्वी का वर्णन किया
verses.wordMeaning: He asked Karttikeya whose excellent vehicle was the peacock and who stole collyrium from the eyes of the womenfolk of Mahi§a (i.e. made them widows by killing Mahisasura), a great soul.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He asked Karttikeya whose excellent vehicle was the peacock and who stole collyrium from the eyes of the womenfolk of Mahi§a (i.e. made them widows by killing Mahisasura), a great soul.…

verses.sanskrit: परिष्वजितुम् इच्छामि त्वामहं पुत्र सुप्रिय । पञ्चत्वम् अनुयास्यामि त्वद्विहीनाद्य दुःखिता
verses.transliteration: pariṣvajitum icchāmi tvāmahaṃ putra supriya / pañcatvam anuyāsyāmi tvadvihīnādya duḥkhitā
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you, O son of Hara; salute to you, O one born of the womb of Uma; Hail to you, O one born of the womb of Agni. Bow to you, O one born of the womb of Ganga.
verses.hindi: है । इस प्रक्नार की अन्तर द्वीप, शेल, वन, कानन से युक्त अत्यन्त विस्तृत सम्पूर्ण प्रथ्वी पद्मा कही गई है । ब्रह्मलोक से लेकर देव असुर और मनृष्यलोक तक यह सब जीव-जन्तुओं के द्वारा त्रिलोक कहा जाता है ।5६-८५। चन्द्र-युयं से जो आलोकित होता है और रूप-रस-गन्ध-स्पर्श और शब्द गुणों से जो युक्त है, वही
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance to you, O son of Hara; salute to you, O one born of the womb of Uma; Hail to you, O one born of the womb of Agni. Bow to you, O one born of the womb of Ganga.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance to you, O son of Hara; salute to you, O one born of the womb of Uma; Hail to you, O one born of the womb of Agni. Bow to you, O one born of the womb of Ganga.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विलपती दीना पुत्रशोकेन पीडिता । मूर्छिता विह्वला दीना निपपात महीतले
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vilapatī dīnā putraśokena pīḍitā / mūrchitā vihvalā dīnā nipapāta mahītale
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, O one born of Sara (grove). Obeisance to you, O son of Krttikas; salute to you O twelve-eyed lord; obeisance to you, O six-faced god.
verses.hindi: २०४ वायुपुराणम् ते लोकपद्म श्रुतिभिः पद्ससित्यभिधीयते । एव सर्वपुराणेषु क्षमः सुपरिनिश्चितः इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते3नु ष ज्भपादे भुवनविन्यासो नाम चत्वारिश्योध्ध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, O one born of Sara (grove). Obeisance to you, O son of Krttikas; salute to you O twelve-eyed lord; obeisance to you, O six-faced god.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, O one born of Sara (grove). Obeisance to you, O son of Krttikas; salute to you O twelve-eyed lord; obeisance to you, O six-faced god.

verses.sanskrit: भार्यां च पतितां दृष्ट्वा पुत्रशोकेन पीडिताम् । चुकोप स मुनिस्तत्र चित्रसेनाय भूभृते
verses.transliteration: bhāryāṃ ca patitāṃ dṛṣṭvā putraśokena pīḍitām / cukopa sa munistatra citrasenāya bhūbhṛte
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, having Sakti in your hand, and a divine bell or a flag staff".
verses.hindi: सरोवरेभ्यः पुण्योदा देवनद्यो विनिर्गंताः । महौघतोया नद्यश्न ताः शुणुध्व॑ यथाक्रमम् ३१ आकाशाम्भोनिधेयोंडसों सोम इत्यभिधीयते । आधारः सर्वेभूतानां देवानामसृताकरः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, having Sakti in your hand, and a divine bell or a flag staff".
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, having Sakti in your hand, and a divine bell or a flag staff".

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घतपा उवाच: याहि याहि महापाप मा मुखं दर्शयस्व मे । किं त्वया घातितो विप्रो ह्यकामाच्च सुतो मम
verses.transliteration: dīrghatapā uvāca: yāhi yāhi mahāpāpa mā mukhaṃ darśayasva me / kiṃ tvayā ghātito vipro hyakāmācca suto mama
verses.translation: "What is this auspicious colour as'bright as collyrium, on the throat of Lord Siva, which is lustrous as the Kunda flower or the Moon? How did it happen?
verses.hindi: तस्मात्प्रवत्ता पुण्योदा नदी ह्याकाशगामिनी । सप्तसेनानिलपथा प्रयाता बविसलोदका ३ सा ज्योतिषि निवर्तन्ती ज्योतिगंणनिषेविता। ताराकोटिसहल्ाणां नभसश्न समायता ४ जगत है । इसी को लोकपनञ्म कहते हैँ और श्रुति इसकों प्र कहती है। सभी पुराणों में पृथ्वी के वर्णन का क्रम इसी प्रकार है 5६-६०।
verses.wordMeaning: "What is this auspicious colour as'bright as collyrium, on the throat of Lord Siva, which is lustrous as the Kunda flower or the Moon? How did it happen?
verses.commentary: Sense: "What is this auspicious colour as'bright as collyrium, on the throat of Lord Siva, which is lustrous as the Kunda flower or the Moon? How did it happen?

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या भविष्यन्ति बह्व्यस्ते वसुधाधिप । सकुटुम्बस्य मे त्वं हि मृत्युरेष उपस्थितः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā bhaviṣyanti bahvyaste vasudhādhipa / sakuṭumbasya me tvaṃ hi mṛtyureṣa upasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Please narrate this to me who am a faithful devotee with self-control. I request you, O blessed one. It behoves you to narrate the holy auspicious story quelling sins, for my pleasure."
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-- सरोवरों से जो-जो जिस प्रकार पवित्र जलवाली देवनदियाँ और गम्भीरजल वाली नदियाँ प्रवाहित हुई हैं, उनका वर्णन यथाक्रम से कर रहा हूँ सुनिये--जो आकाश-समुद्र के चन्द्र कहे जाते हैं, जो जीवों के आधार ओर जो देवताओं के सुधारक हैं, उन्हीं से एक विमल जलवाली पुण्य सलिला आकाश- गामिनी नदी निकलकर सप्तम वायुपथ की ओर गई है ।१-३। यह नदी ज्योतिष्मण्डल पर्यन्त प्रवाहित होती
verses.wordMeaning: Please narrate this to me who am a faithful devotee with self-control. I request you, O blessed one. It behoves you to narrate the holy auspicious story quelling sins, for my pleasure."
verses.commentary: Sense: Please narrate this to me who am a faithful devotee with self-control. I request you, O blessed one. It behoves you to narrate the holy auspicious story quelling sins, for my pleasure."

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ततो विप्रो विचिन्त्य च पुनःपुनः । परित्यज्य तदा क्रोधं मुनिभावाज्जगाद ह
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tato vipro vicintya ca punaḥpunaḥ / parityajya tadā krodhaṃ munibhāvājjagāda ha
verses.translation: On hearing the words of noble-souled Vasistha, Kartti- keya. the lord of great splendour, the destroyer of the armies of the enemies of Suras replied:
verses.hindi: है और करोड़ों तारिकाओं तथा ज्योतिष्क पिण्डों से व्याप्त है। अककाश में फैली हुई आकाशपथ में विचरण साहेन्द्रेण गजेन्द्रेण नाह्ाशपथवायिना । क्रीडिता ह्यन्तरतले या सा विक्षोभितोदका १५ नेकेविमानसंधातें: प्रक्रामज्डू नं भस्तलम् । सिद्धेरुपस्पृष्टजला महापुण्यजला शिवा
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of noble-souled Vasistha, Kartti- keya. the lord of great splendour, the destroyer of the armies of the enemies of Suras replied:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of noble-souled Vasistha, Kartti- keya. the lord of great splendour, the destroyer of the armies of the enemies of Suras replied:

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घतपा उवाच: उद्वेगं त्यज भो वत्स दुरुक्तं गदितो मया । पुत्रशोकाभिभूतेन दुःखतप्तेन मानद
verses.transliteration: dīrghatapā uvāca: udvegaṃ tyaja bho vatsa duruktaṃ gadito mayā / putraśokābhibhūtena duḥkhataptena mānada
verses.translation: "Listen to the words as narrated by me, O excellent one among eloquent persons. (I am repeating) what has been heard by me formerly as I sat on the lap of Uma.
verses.hindi: बायुना प्रेयंमरणा च अनेकाभोगगामिनों । परिवतंत्यहरहो य (हुये) था सूर्यस्तथव सा ७
verses.wordMeaning: "Listen to the words as narrated by me, O excellent one among eloquent persons. (I am repeating) what has been heard by me formerly as I sat on the lap of Uma.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Listen to the words as narrated by me, O excellent one among eloquent persons. (I am repeating) what has been heard by me formerly as I sat on the lap of Uma.

verses.sanskrit: किं करोति नरः प्राज्ञः प्रेर्यमाणः स्वकर्मभिः । प्रागेव हि मनुष्याणां बुद्धिः कर्मानुसारिणी
verses.transliteration: kiṃ karoti naraḥ prājñaḥ preryamāṇaḥ svakarmabhiḥ / prāgeva hi manuṣyāṇāṃ buddhiḥ karmānusāriṇī
verses.translation: O great sage, this is the dialogue between the great Atman Siva and Parvatl. I shall narrate it to you (for your delight).
verses.hindi: विभिद्यमाना सलिलेस्ते जसेनानिलेन व। मेरोरुत्तरक्टेषु पतिताथ चतुष्वंधपि द (६ मेरक्टतटान्तेम्य उत्कृष्टेभ्यों निवरतिता  विकीयेमाणसलिला चतुर्धा संयृतोदका १० पवेणांशेन देवानां सर्वंसिद्धभणणालयम् । सुवर्णवित्रकटक नेकलनि्ेरकन्दरस् १३ प्लावयन्ती सशैलेन्द्रं मन्दर चारुकन्दरम् । वप्रप्रतापशमनेरनेकः स्फादिकोदक:
verses.wordMeaning: O great sage, this is the dialogue between the great Atman Siva and Parvatl. I shall narrate it to you (for your delight).
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, this is the dialogue between the great Atman Siva and Parvatl. I shall narrate it to you (for your delight).

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव विधानेन पञ्चत्वं विहितं मम । हत्यास्तव भविष्यन्ति पूर्वमुक्ता न संशयः
verses.transliteration: anenaiva vidhānena pañcatvaṃ vihitaṃ mama / hatyāstava bhaviṣyanti pūrvamuktā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On the beautiful peak of Kailasa Lord Siva who had destroyed Madana (god of love) was comfortably seated on a charming golden rocky slab embellished with pearls, jewels and gems. The peak of the mountain appeared wonderful with varie¬ gated minerals. It was over-grown with many trees and creepers. It was beautified by the Gakravaka birds. It was resonant with the humming of the bees and the continuous sound of water¬ falls. The interior of the caves was resounded with the sounds of inebriated Kraunca birds and peacocks. The peak was full of Apsaras-s, Kinnaras and Jivanjivaka birds. It was beautified byjati creepers. It was sweetened with the cooings of cuckoos. It was resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas. The sound of the celestial cow Saurabheyl spread everywhere. The place beneath
verses.hindi: करने वाले इन्द्र के ऐराबत द्वारा क्रीड़ाकाल में इस नदी का जल विक्षब्ध हो जाता है।४-५। सिद्धयण जब विमानों पर चढ़कर आकाझ्ष में विचरण करते हैं, तब इनके पवित्र जल का वे सब आचमन और स्पर्श किया करते हैं । सूर्य जिस प्रकार प्रत्येक दिन परिवर्तित होते हैं उसी प्रकार बायुद्वारा प्रेरित होने पर यह नदी भी अनेक स्थानों में घमती रहती है ' वह नदी चौरासी योजनों की है और यह सदा वेग से मेरु की प्रदक्षिणा
verses.wordMeaning: On the beautiful peak of Kailasa Lord Siva who had destroyed Madana (god of love) was comfortably seated on a charming golden rocky slab embellished with pearls, jewels and gems. The peak of the mountain appeared wonderful with varie¬ gated minerals.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the beautiful peak of Kailasa Lord Siva who had destroyed Madana (god of love) was comfortably seated on a charming golden rocky slab embellished with pearls, jewels and gems. The peak of the mountain appeared wonderful with varie¬ gated minerals.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां मध्ये शूद्रचण्डालजातिषु । कस्त्वं कथय सत्यं मे कस्माच्च निहतो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: brahmakṣatraviśāṃ madhye śūdracaṇḍālajātiṣu / kastvaṃ kathaya satyaṃ me kasmācca nihato dvijaḥ
verses.translation: "O lord, lord of past and future creations, O bull- emblemed one, O Mahadeva, there is something resembling a dark cloud shining on your throat. It is neither too bright nor too clear. It resembles the heap of blue collyrium. O destroyer of Kama's body, O lord, what is this that shines on your throat?
verses.hindi: किया करती है ।६-८। तेजोमथ अनिल और अन्यान्व प्रकार के सलिल द्वारा छिन्न होने पर मेछ के उत्तरीय चार शिखरों पर गिरती है। मेहर के उत्तम शिखरों से टकरा कर जब वह पुनः लौटती है तब इसका जल तितर-बितर हो जाता है, जिससे यह चार भागों में विभक्त होकर बहने लगती है। मेर के चारों ओर साढठ हजार योजनों में यह महाभागा पवित्र नदी बिता आलम्ब के आकाश घूमती हुईं मेह के पादप्रान्त में चार भागों में विभक्त होरर मनोहर रूप से मन्दर के पूर्व भाग में गिरती है ६-१२। यह सुन्दर गतिवाली नदी पूर्व भाग से सिद्धों और देवों के आवासवाले अनेक नि र, कन्दराओं तथा सुवर्ण चित्रित कंठकों से युक्त पर्वतराज मेरु के साथ सुन्दर-कंन्दरा वाले मन्दर को और वन देवों के ताप को मिटाने वाले स्फटिक निमेल जलसमृह से रमणीय चेत्ररथ को सींचती हुई और प्रदक्षिणा करती हुई अरुणोद सरोवर में प्रवेश करती है। वही आकाश-
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, lord of past and future creations, O bull- emblemed one, O Mahadeva, there is something resembling a dark cloud shining on your throat. It is neither too bright nor too clear. It resembles the heap of blue collyrium. O destroyer of Kama's body, O lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, lord of past and future creations, O bull- emblemed one, O Mahadeva, there is something resembling a dark cloud shining on your throat. It is neither too bright nor too clear. It resembles the heap of blue collyrium. O destroyer of Kama's body, O lord,…

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेन उवाच: विज्ञापयामि विप्रर्षे क्षन्तव्यं ते ममोपरि । नाहं विप्रो ऽस्मि वै तात न वैश्यो न च शूद्रजः
verses.transliteration: citrasena uvāca: vijñāpayāmi viprarṣe kṣantavyaṃ te mamopari / nāhaṃ vipro 'smi vai tāta na vaiśyo na ca śūdrajaḥ
verses.translation: What is the cause of this blue tinge? What is the rea¬ son for the blueness of your throat, O lord. Please nan ate this duly to me. I am interested in it".
verses.hindi: नदी अरुगोद से सरोवर निकलने के बाद सिद्ध सेवित रम्य निमझृ॑र वाले श्ीतान्त शैल पर गिरती है
verses.wordMeaning: What is the cause of this blue tinge? What is the rea¬ son for the blueness of your throat, O lord. Please nan ate this duly to me. I am interested in it".
verses.commentary: Sense: What is the cause of this blue tinge? What is the rea¬ son for the blueness of your throat, O lord. Please nan ate this duly to me. I am interested in it".

verses.sanskrit: न व्याधश्चान्त्यजातो वा क्षत्रियो ऽहं महामुने । काशीराजो मृगान् हन्तुम् आगतो वनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: na vyādhaścāntyajāto vā kṣatriyo 'haṃ mahāmune / kāśīrājo mṛgān hantum āgato vanamuttamam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Parvat!, Siva, the consort of Parvati, narrated the auspicious story.
verses.hindi: “धनुश्चिह्नान्तगंतग्रन्थो: डः, पुस्तके नास्ति । ३०६ द वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of Parvat!, Siva, the consort of Parvati, narrated the auspicious story.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Parvat!, Siva, the consort of Parvati, narrated the auspicious story.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रान्त्या निपातितो ह्येष मृगरूपधरो मुनिः । इदानीं तव पादान्ते संश्रितः पातकान्वितः
verses.transliteration: bhrāntyā nipātito hyeṣa mṛgarūpadharo muniḥ / idānīṃ tava pādānte saṃśritaḥ pātakānvitaḥ
verses.translation: "Formerly when the ocean of milk was being churned for extracting Amrta, by Devas and Danavas, the poison as lustrous as the deadly fire, rose up in front.
verses.hindi: सीता नाम महापुण्या नदीनां प्रवरा नदी । सा निकुञ्जनिरुद्धा तु अनेकाभोगगामिनी ३१७
verses.wordMeaning: "Formerly when the ocean of milk was being churned for extracting Amrta, by Devas and Danavas, the poison as lustrous as the deadly fire, rose up in front.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Formerly when the ocean of milk was being churned for extracting Amrta, by Devas and Danavas, the poison as lustrous as the deadly fire, rose up in front.

verses.sanskrit: किं कर्तव्यं मया विप्र उपायं कथयस्व मे
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā vipra upāyaṃ kathayasva me
verses.translation: O splendid-faced lady, on seeing it the groups of Devas and Daityas became pale-faced and dejected. They approached god Brahma.
verses.hindi: एवं शैलसहस्नाणि दारयन्ती महानदी । पतिता5थ महाशैले जठरे सिद्धसेविते २० तस्मादपि महाशैलं देवकूट॑ तरहगिणी । तस्थ कुक्षिसमुद्रान्ता क़मेण पृथिवीं गता २१ सैव॑ स्थलीसहर्लाणि शैलराजशतानि च्। वनानि च विचित्राणि सरांसि विविधानि च स्रावयन्ती महाभागा विस्फारेष्ववलोकदा । नदीसहस्नानुगता प्रवृत्ता च महानदी ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O splendid-faced lady, on seeing it the groups of Devas and Daityas became pale-faced and dejected. They approached god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: O splendid-faced lady, on seeing it the groups of Devas and Daityas became pale-faced and dejected. They approached god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घतपा उवाच: ब्रह्महत्या न शक्येताप्येका निस्तरितुं प्रभो । दशैका च कथं शक्यास्ताः शृणुष्व नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: dīrghatapā uvāca: brahmahatyā na śakyetāpyekā nistarituṃ prabho / daśaikā ca kathaṃ śakyāstāḥ śṛṇuṣva nareśvara
verses.translation: On seeing the groups of Devas frightened, Brahma of excessive lustre spoke: "O blessed ones, why are you frighten¬ ed? Why arc you dejected in mind?
verses.hindi: दक्षिणेषपि प्रपन्ना या शैलेन्द्रे गन्धमादने । चित्रेः प्रपातविविधनेकविस्फालितोदका २५ तद्गन्धमादनवन ननन्‍दन देवनन्दनम् । प्लावयन्ती महाभाग! प्रयाता सा प्रदक्षिणम् २६ नाम्ना हालकनन्देति सर्वलोकेषु विश्वुता। प्रविशत्युत्तरसरो मानस देवसानसम् २७ मानसाच्छेलराजान रम्यं त्रिशिख॒रं गता। त्रिक्टाच्छेलशिखरात्कलिड्भशिखरं गता
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the groups of Devas frightened, Brahma of excessive lustre spoke: "O blessed ones, why are you frighten¬ ed? Why arc you dejected in mind?
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the groups of Devas frightened, Brahma of excessive lustre spoke: "O blessed ones, why are you frighten¬ ed? Why arc you dejected in mind?

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारो मे सुता राजन् सभार्या मातृपूर्वकाः । मया सह न जीवन्ति ऋक्षशृङ्गस्य कारणे
verses.transliteration: catvāro me sutā rājan sabhāryā mātṛpūrvakāḥ / mayā saha na jīvanti ṛkṣaśṛṅgasya kāraṇe
verses.translation: O excellent gods! Eightfold AUvarya (Lordship and prosperity) has been assigned to you by me. By whom were you deprived of that AUvatya?
verses.hindi: तब उसका नदियों में श्रेष्ठ पृष्यमलिला सीता नाम पड़ता है। फिर निकांजों में रक्त जाने के कारण उसकी अनेक घाराएँ हो जाती हैं ! णीतान्त पव॑त के शिखर से निकलकर वह श्रेष्ठ पर्वत मुकुंज पर गिरती है । फिर यह महाभागा वहाँ से सुमंज पर गिरतों है। वहाँ से निकलकर माल्यवान् पर्वत को प्लावित करती हुई यह श्रेष्ठ नदी बैंकंक पर्वत पर आती है। वैकंक पर्वत से मणिशल पर और मणिशल से अनेक कन्दराओं वाले महाशल ऋषभ पर यह निपतित होती है ।(७-१६। इस प्रकार यह महानदी हजारों शैलों को फाडती हुई सिद्ध सेवित महाशैल जठर के ऊपर गिरती है। वहाँ से भी वह तरज्भुशालिनी नदी पर्वतराज देवकूट पर गिरती है। इस देवकूट का पाश्वेभग समुद्र तक फैला हुआ है; इस प्रकार यह नदी क्रम से पृथ्वी पर उतरती है। वह महाभाषा नदी सहस्रों स्थलियों, सैकड़ों, पर्वतों, विचित्र वनों और विविध सरोवरों को प्लाबित करके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent gods! Eightfold AUvarya (Lordship and prosperity) has been assigned to you by me. By whom were you deprived of that AUvatya?
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent gods! Eightfold AUvarya (Lordship and prosperity) has been assigned to you by me. By whom were you deprived of that AUvatya?

verses.sanskrit: उपायं शोभनं तात कथयिष्ये शृणुष्व तम् । शक्रो ऽपि यदि तं कर्तुं सुखोपायं नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: upāyaṃ śobhanaṃ tāta kathayiṣye śṛṇuṣva tam / śakro 'pi yadi taṃ kartuṃ sukhopāyaṃ nareśvara
verses.translation: You are the lords of the three worlds. You are free from ailments and worries. Among my creations there is no one who dares flout my behests.
verses.hindi: हजारों नदियों से मिलकर विमल तरज्भूमाला धारण करती हुई बहती है। वह श्रष्ठ सरिता महानदी प्रधान- प्रधान द्वीपों की और भद्राइववर्ष को सींचती हुई पहले पूर्व सागर से मिलती है ।२०-२४। दक्षिण दिग्वर्ती पर्वत राज गन्धमादन पर जो नदी उतरती है, वह्॒ विचित्र प्रपातों और अनेक तरंग मालायुक्त जल प्रवाह को धारण करती हुई देवराज के नन्‍्दनवन को सींचती है एवं गन्धमादन की प्रदक्षिणा करती हुई चलती है ।
verses.wordMeaning: You are the lords of the three worlds. You are free from ailments and worries. Among my creations there is no one who dares flout my behests.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the lords of the three worlds. You are free from ailments and worries. Among my creations there is no one who dares flout my behests.

verses.sanskrit: सकुटुम्बं समस्तं मां दाहयित्वानले नृप । अस्थीनि नर्मदातोये शूलभेदे विनिक्षिप
verses.transliteration: sakuṭumbaṃ samastaṃ māṃ dāhayitvānale nṛpa / asthīni narmadātoye śūlabhede vinikṣipa
verses.translation: You move about on aerial chariots as you please. You are capable of activising people in spiritual, physical and godly rites and assign the fruits thereof.
verses.hindi: सभी लोग उसे अलकनन्दा कहा करते हैं। यह देवों के मानस रूप उत्तर मान सरोबर में प्रवेश करती है ।२५-२७  वहाँ से रमणीय तीन शिखरवाले शलराज त्रिकूट पर गिरती है और त्रिकूट के शिखर से कलिग कलिड्भशिखराद्श्रष्टा रुचके निपषात सा। रुचकाह्निषधं प्राप्ता ताम्नाभं निषधादपि
verses.wordMeaning: You move about on aerial chariots as you please. You are capable of activising people in spiritual, physical and godly rites and assign the fruits thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: You move about on aerial chariots as you please. You are capable of activising people in spiritual, physical and godly rites and assign the fruits thereof.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले शूलभेदं हि विश्रुतम् । सर्वपापहरं तीर्थं सर्वदुःखघ्नमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle śūlabhedaṃ hi viśrutam / sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam
verses.translation: Hence, wherefore are you frightened like the deer harassed by lions? What is your alTliction? Whereby is your helplessness and distress? What is the source of your fear? Vou narrate all this precisely and immediately".
verses.hindi: हेमक्टं गता तस्मादेवशुड्रः ततो गता। तस्माद्गता महाशैलं ततभ्रापि पिशाचकम् ३ १ पिशाचकाच्छे लव रात्यच्चक्ट गता पुनः । पच्चकूटालु कलासं देवावासं शिलोच्चयम् ..
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, wherefore are you frightened like the deer harassed by lions? What is your alTliction? Whereby is your helplessness and distress? What is the source of your fear? Vou narrate all this precisely and immediately".
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, wherefore are you frightened like the deer harassed by lions? What is your alTliction? Whereby is your helplessness and distress? What is the source of your fear? Vou narrate all this precisely and immediately".

verses.sanskrit: शुचिर्भूत्वा ममास्थीनि तत्र तीर्थे विनिक्षिप । मोक्ष्यसे सर्वपापैस् त्वं मम वाक्यान्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: śucirbhūtvā mamāsthīni tatra tīrthe vinikṣipa / mokṣyase sarvapāpais tvaṃ mama vākyānna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma, the great Atman, the leaders of Devas, Daityas and Danavas spoke thus in the com- pany of sages:
verses.hindi: तस्य कुक्षिषु विश्वान्ता नेककन्दरसानुषु ।  + हिमवत्युत्तमनदी निपपाताचलोत्तसे ३३ सेव शेलसहत्राणि दारयन्ती महानदी । स्थलीशतान्यनेकानि प्लावयन्त्याशुगामिनी ३४ रम्या योजनविस्तीर्णा शैलकुक्षिषरु संवृता  या धुता देवदेवेन शंकरेण महात्मना २६ पावनी ह्विजशार्दल घोराणामपि पाप्मनाम् । शंकरस्याज्रसंस्पर्शान्भहादेवस्थ धीमतः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Brahma, the great Atman, the leaders of Devas, Daityas and Danavas spoke thus in the com- pany of sages:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Brahma, the great Atman, the leaders of Devas, Daityas and Danavas spoke thus in the com- pany of sages:

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच: आदेशो दीयतां तात करिष्यामि न संशयः । समस्तं मे ऽस्ति यत्किंचिद्राज्यं कोशः सुहृत्सुताः
verses.transliteration: rājovāca: ādeśo dīyatāṃ tāta kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ / samastaṃ me 'sti yatkiṃcidrājyaṃ kośaḥ suhṛtsutāḥ
verses.translation: "When the ocean was being churned by the noble Devas and Asuras, the poison resembling serpents, bees and blue clouds appeared before us. It was terrible and bright as the fire at dissolution of the Universe.
verses.hindi: द्विगुणं पवित्रसलिला सर्वलोके महानदी .
verses.wordMeaning: "When the ocean was being churned by the noble Devas and Asuras, the poison resembling serpents, bees and blue clouds appeared before us. It was terrible and bright as the fire at dissolution of the Universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: "When the ocean was being churned by the noble Devas and Asuras, the poison resembling serpents, bees and blue clouds appeared before us. It was terrible and bright as the fire at dissolution of the Universe.

verses.sanskrit: तवाधीनं महाविप्र प्रयच्छामि प्रसीद मे । परस्परं विवदतोर्विप्र राज्ञोस्तदा नृप
verses.transliteration: tavādhīnaṃ mahāvipra prayacchāmi prasīda me / parasparaṃ vivadatorvipra rājñostadā nṛpa
verses.translation: It has come up like Black Death; it has the splendour of the sun at the close of Yugas; it has the refulgence of the sun about to destroy the three worlds; it sparkles allround.
verses.hindi: तस्माद्धिमवतों गड़ा गता सा तु महानदी । एवं गडगेति नाम्ना हिं प्रकाशा सिद्धसेविता ३६ अनिनिफिनीन+-ी3न नमन अननत- पन-ज-बनकी+ “»-आजनानमान-नानक »क४+ मनन बन-ननननन था पी लिन थ “एक विनर निनपनानानननना आ०+++ कनन-म नानक कब ननननन-न-न- पथ /कान“+-म छः छछछछ ७ 8३ ......०+त5-जल- जता ४7
verses.wordMeaning: It has come up like Black Death; it has the splendour of the sun at the close of Yugas; it has the refulgence of the sun about to destroy the three worlds; it sparkles allround.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has come up like Black Death; it has the splendour of the sun at the close of Yugas; it has the refulgence of the sun about to destroy the three worlds; it sparkles allround.

verses.sanskrit: स्फुटित्वा हृदयं शीघ्रं मुनिभार्या मृता तदा । पुत्रशोकसमाविष्टा निर्जीवा पतिता क्षितौ
verses.transliteration: sphuṭitvā hṛdayaṃ śīghraṃ munibhāryā mṛtā tadā / putraśokasamāviṣṭā nirjīvā patitā kṣitau
verses.translation: Visnu whose complexion was fair and reddish has been burnt by the poison that rises with lustre of black fire. He has turned black (in complexion).
verses.hindi: के शिखर पर गिरती है। वहाँ से उतर कर रुचक पर गिरती है  रुचक से निषध पर और निषध से ताम्राभ पर गिरती है ।२५-२६। फिर ताम्नाभ से इवेतोदर पर्वत पर, वहाँ से सुमूल पर्वत पर, सुमूल से वसुधार पर, वसुधार से हेमकट, पर हेमकट से देवश्यूद्भ पर देवश्वज्भध से शैलश्रेष्ठ पिशावक पर, पिशाचक से पंचकूट पर और पंचकट से देवनिवास कैलाश पर गिरती हुई एवं उसके शिखरकन्दरामय पाइवे देश से बहती हुई अचलो
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu whose complexion was fair and reddish has been burnt by the poison that rises with lustre of black fire. He has turned black (in complexion).
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu whose complexion was fair and reddish has been burnt by the poison that rises with lustre of black fire. He has turned black (in complexion).

verses.sanskrit: पुत्राश्च मातृशोकेन सर्वे पञ्चत्वमागताः । स्नुषाश्चैव तदा सर्वा मृताश्च सह भर्तृभिः
verses.transliteration: putrāśca mātṛśokena sarve pañcatvamāgatāḥ / snuṣāścaiva tadā sarvā mṛtāśca saha bhartṛbhiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the whitish red-complexioned Janardana rendered black, all of us got frightened. We seek refuge in you".
verses.hindi: त्तम हिमालय पर गिरती है ।३०-३३। वह महातदी हजारों शैलों को फाड़ती हुई, से कड़ों स्थलों को सींचती हुई, हजारों वनों को और सैकड़ों कन्देराओं को भिगोती हुई तीत्र वेग से दक्षिण समुद्र में गिरती है ।३४३ ९ जो रम्य नदी योजन परिमित चौड़ी और इलकुक्षि में घिरी हुई है, महात्मा देवाधिदेवशद्भुर ने जिसको अपने सिर पर धारण किया है, वह घोर प पियों को भी पवित्र करने बाली एवं धीमान् शद्भूर के अंग-स्पशे से द्विगण पवित्र, पत्रित्रसलिला महानदी गंगा है ।३६-३७। ब्राह्मणो ! यह हिमालय पंत के चारों ओर से निकलकर अनेक शाखाओं में विभक्‍त हो गयी है,.जो भिन्न-भिन्न नामों से सहख्न-सहुख्र नदी रूपों में विख्यात है  यह महानदी गंगा नाम से प्रश्तिद्ध है। जो सिद्धों से सेवित है। जिन देशों के बीच से होकर यह रुद्र,
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the whitish red-complexioned Janardana rendered black, all of us got frightened. We seek refuge in you".
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the whitish red-complexioned Janardana rendered black, all of us got frightened. We seek refuge in you".

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चत्वं च गताः सर्वे मुनिमुख्या नृपोत्तम । विप्रान् आह्वापयामास ये तत्राश्रमवासिनः
verses.transliteration: pañcatvaṃ ca gatāḥ sarve munimukhyā nṛpottama / viprān āhvāpayāmāsa ye tatrāśramavāsinaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Devas and Asuras, (Brahma) of great splendour replied, desiring the welfare of the worlds:
verses.hindi: + धनुश्चिह्नान्तगंतग्रन्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Devas and Asuras, (Brahma) of great splendour replied, desiring the welfare of the worlds:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Devas and Asuras, (Brahma) of great splendour replied, desiring the welfare of the worlds:

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यो निवेदयामास यथावृत्तं नृपोत्तमः । स तैस्तदाभ्यनुज्ञातः काष्ठान्यादाय यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: tebhyo nivedayāmāsa yathāvṛttaṃ nṛpottamaḥ / sa taistadābhyanujñātaḥ kāṣṭhānyādāya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: "O ye Devas, sages and saints, all of you listen. The poison, resembling black fire, that rose up when the great ocean was being churned is known as Kalakuta. Even as it rose Neither Visnu nor I nor the leading Devas can bear the
verses.hindi: महापादं प्रवक्ष्यात्रि मेरोरपि हि पश्चिमम् । नातारत्नाकर पुण्य॑ पुण्यक्रज्द्ू निषेवितभ ॥४ १ विपुलं शैलराजानं विपुलोदरफन्द रम् । नितम्बकुञजकटकंविमलमंण्डितोदरम् अपि या ध5यंबकस्येषा त्रिदशः सेवितो दका । वायुवेगा गताभोगा लतेव आपमिता पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: "O ye Devas, sages and saints, all of you listen. The poison, resembling black fire, that rose up when the great ocean was being churned is known as Kalakuta. Even as it rose Neither Visnu nor I nor the leading Devas can bear the
verses.commentary: Sense: "O ye Devas, sages and saints, all of you listen. The poison, resembling black fire, that rose up when the great ocean was being churned is known as Kalakuta. Even as it rose Neither Visnu nor I nor the leading Devas can bear the

verses.sanskrit: दाहं संचयनं चक्रे चित्रसेनो महीपतिः । ऋक्षशृङ्गादिसर्वेषां गृहीत्वास्थीनि यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: dāhaṃ saṃcayanaṃ cakre citraseno mahīpatiḥ / ṛkṣaśṛṅgādisarveṣāṃ gṛhītvāsthīni yatnataḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, the lotus-born Brahma, gran at er of the worlds, the deity who has the lustre of the interior of the lotus and he who is not born of a womb, began to pray:
verses.hindi: सेहक़टतटाद अ्रष्टा प्रहले: स्वादितोदका । विस्तीयंमाणसलिला निर्मलांशुकसंनिभा ४४ तस्य कटेडम्बरनदी सिद्धचारणसेविता । प्रदक्षिणमथा55व॒त्य पतिता सानुगामिनि ४५ देवभ्राजं महाअआजं सर्वेश्राज॑ महावनम् । प्लावयन्ती महाभागा नानापुष्पफलोदका
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, the lotus-born Brahma, gran at er of the worlds, the deity who has the lustre of the interior of the lotus and he who is not born of a womb, began to pray:
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the lotus-born Brahma, gran at er of the worlds, the deity who has the lustre of the interior of the lotus and he who is not born of a womb, began to pray:

verses.sanskrit: याम्याशां प्रस्थितो राजा पादचारी महीपते । न शक्नोति यदा गन्तुं छायामाश्रित्य तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: yāmyāśāṃ prasthito rājā pādacārī mahīpate / na śaknoti yadā gantuṃ chāyāmāśritya tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: "O Virupaksa, obeisance to you of many eyes, who wields Pinaka bow and thunderbolt in the hands. Obeisance to you, Lord of the three worlds. Hail to you, Lord of living beings, the destroyer of Asuras, the three eyed sage.
verses.hindi: सा सितोदाहिनिष्क़ान्ता सुपक्षं पर्वत गता। सुपक्षतस्तु पुण्योदात्ततो देवषिसेविता .. ४८ सुपक्षक्टतटगा तस्माच्च संशितोदका । निपपात महाभागा रमण्यं शिखिपवेतम् ॥३४ ६ तस्मादिगरिवरात्पाप्ता पिज्ज॒रं वरपर्वबंतम् । पिञ्जरात्सरसं याता तस्माच्च कुमुदाचलमू
verses.wordMeaning: "O Virupaksa, obeisance to you of many eyes, who wields Pinaka bow and thunderbolt in the hands. Obeisance to you, Lord of the three worlds. Hail to you, Lord of living beings, the destroyer of Asuras, the three eyed sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Virupaksa, obeisance to you of many eyes, who wields Pinaka bow and thunderbolt in the hands. Obeisance to you, Lord of the three worlds. Hail to you, Lord of living beings, the destroyer of Asuras, the three eyed sage.

verses.sanskrit: विश्रम्य च पुनर् गच्छेद् भाराक्रान्तो महीपतिः । सचैलं कुरुते स्नानं मुक्त्वास्थीनि पदे पदे
verses.transliteration: viśramya ca punar gacched bhārākrānto mahīpatiḥ / sacailaṃ kurute snānaṃ muktvāsthīni pade pade
verses.translation: Obeisance to you who are Brahma, Rudra and Visnu. Bow to you (the deity of) Samkhya and Yoga and (to you)
verses.hindi: साध्य, वायु और आदित्य से सेवित यशहिविनी गंगा प्रताहित होती है, वह देश धन्य श्रेष्ठ है ।३८-४०॥ अब हम मेरु से पश्चिम दिद्या में स्थित सुविस्तृत प्रत्यन्त पर्वत की कथा कहते हैं। वह नाना रत्नों का आकर, पुण्पमय, पृष्यकर्ताओं से सेवित, अतिविस्तृत एवं विपुल कुक्षि और कन्दराओं द्वारा सुशोभित है। उसका भीतरी. प्रदेश नितम्बस्थित कजों और विमल कटकों (पर्वत का मध्य भाग) से मंडित है। १-४२। भगवान् त्रिलोचन ने
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you who are Brahma, Rudra and Visnu. Bow to you (the deity of) Samkhya and Yoga and (to you)
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you who are Brahma, Rudra and Visnu. Bow to you (the deity of) Samkhya and Yoga and (to you)

verses.sanskrit: पिबेज्जलं निराहारः स गच्छन् दक्षिणामुखः । अचिरेणैव कालेन संगतो नर्मदातटम्
verses.transliteration: pibejjalaṃ nirāhāraḥ sa gacchan dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ / acireṇaiva kālena saṃgato narmadātaṭam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the destroyer of (the body) of Kama, the slayer of Kala. Hail to you, Rudra, the Lord and god (Obeisance to you) with matted hair, terrible (yet) propititious, bearer of a skull, the multiformed (yet) single- formed Siva, the bestower of boons.
verses.hindi: जिसको धारण किया है, देवगण जिसके जल का उपयोग करते हैं जो वायु की तरह वेगगामिनी, बहुदेश- व्यापिनी और लता की तरह घूमती हुई मेरु के श्वुग से मिरती है, जिसके जल का आस्वाद कितने ही जीवों ने किया है, जिसका जल अत्यन्त विस्तृत और निमंल वस्त्र की तरह है, वह स्वर्णनदी मेर शिखर पर सिद्ध- चरणों द्वारा सेवित हो इस प्रकार बहती है मानो प्रदक्षिणा करती है ।४३-४५। वह शैल शिखर के मध्य से होकर बहती हुई अन्त में देवभ्राजवन में गिरती है। नाना पुष्प-फलों से युक्त जलवाली यह महाभागा नदी क्रम से देवभ्राज, महाभ्राज और बंश्राज्य प्रभूति महावनों को प्रदक्षिणा क्रम से सींचकर एवं नाना बनों का
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the destroyer of (the body) of Kama, the slayer of Kala. Hail to you, Rudra, the Lord and god (Obeisance to you) with matted hair, terrible (yet) propititious, bearer of a skull, the multiformed (yet) single- formed Siva, the bestower of boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the destroyer of (the body) of Kama, the slayer of Kala. Hail to you, Rudra, the Lord and god (Obeisance to you) with matted hair, terrible (yet) propititious, bearer of a skull, the multiformed (yet) single- formed Siva, the bestower of boons.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमस्थान् द्विजान् दृष्ट्वा पप्रच्छ पृथिवीपतिः
verses.transliteration: āśramasthān dvijān dṛṣṭvā papraccha pṛthivīpatiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the destroyer of Tripuras, the lord of Mothers and worthy of respect. Obeisance to you the enlight¬ ened, pure, liberated and absolute one.
verses.hindi: मनन्‍्थन करके पश्चिम दिग्वर्ती विमल जल सितोद सरोवर में प्रविष्ट होती है। सितोद से निकलकर वह सुपक्ष- पर्वत पर जाती है। देवियों द्वारा सेवित वह पुण्यसलिला महाभागा सुपक्षशिखरगामिनी महानदी फिर बहाँ से रमणीय शिखिपवंत पर गिरती है ।४६-४६। शिखि पव॑त से कंक पर, कंक से वेदूये पर्वत पर, बदूर्य से कपिल शल पर, कपिल से गन्धपादन पर, फिर श्रेष्ठ गन्धमादन पंत से दौलश्रेष्ठ पिजर पर पिंजर से
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the destroyer of Tripuras, the lord of Mothers and worthy of respect. Obeisance to you the enlight¬ ened, pure, liberated and absolute one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the destroyer of Tripuras, the lord of Mothers and worthy of respect. Obeisance to you the enlight¬ ened, pure, liberated and absolute one.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेन उवाच: कथ्यतां शूलभेदस्य मार्गं मे द्विजसत्तमाः । येन यामि महाभागाः स्वकार्यार्थस्य सिद्धये
verses.transliteration: citrasena uvāca: kathyatāṃ śūlabhedasya mārgaṃ me dvijasattamāḥ / yena yāmi mahābhāgāḥ svakāryārthasya siddhaye
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the lord holding lotus in the hand, the quarter-clad, the tufted lord, the maker of'three worlds. Bow to Candra and Varuna. Obeisance to you, the foremost of the fierce, the sage, of. many eyes, possessed of Rajas, Sattva and Tamas and to one of unmanifest source of origin.
verses.hindi: द्विचत्वा रिशोष्ष्या य: ३०है अनेकामि: खवबन्तीभिराष्यायितजला शिवा । एवं शैलसह्राणि सादयन्ती महानदी ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the lord holding lotus in the hand, the quarter-clad, the tufted lord, the maker of'three worlds. Bow to Candra and Varuna. Obeisance to you, the foremost of the fierce, the sage, of. many eyes, possessed of Rajas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the lord holding lotus in the hand, the quarter-clad, the tufted lord, the maker of'three worlds. Bow to Candra and Varuna. Obeisance to you, the foremost of the fierce, the sage, of. many eyes, possessed of Rajas,…

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । इतः क्रोशान्तराद् अर्वाक् तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले ततो द्रक्ष्यसि नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: munaya ūcuḥ / itaḥ krośāntarād arvāk tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tato drakṣyasi nānyathā
verses.translation: This eulogy is practically a string of names or adjectives. Siva is equated with Para-Brahman & the highest encomium is offered to him. We find Siva so glorified in Tait. Sarii. IV. 5 (Rudradhyaya). It can be claimed as a source of Puranic Sahasra-namas.
verses.hindi: अनेफनि्ंरनदी गुहासानुषु राजते । तस्य कुक्षिष्वनेकासु अन्ततोया तरज्िणी
verses.wordMeaning: This eulogy is practically a string of names or adjectives. Siva is equated with Para-Brahman & the highest encomium is offered to him. We find Siva so glorified in Tait. Sarii. IV. 5 (Rudradhyaya). It can be claimed as a source of Puranic Sahasra-namas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This eulogy is practically a string of names or adjectives. Siva is equated with Para-Brahman & the highest encomium is offered to him. We find Siva so glorified in Tait. Sarii. IV. 5 (Rudradhyaya). It can be claimed as a source of Puranic Sahasra-namas.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिवाक्येन राजासौ शीघ्रं गत्वा नरेश्वरः । स ददर्श ततः शीघ्रं बहुद्विजसमाकुलम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣivākyena rājāsau śīghraṃ gatvā nareśvaraḥ / sa dadarśa tataḥ śīghraṃ bahudvijasamākulam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the eternal, non-eternal and eternal-cum- non-eternal one; to the manifest, unmanifest and manifest-cum- unmanifest. Obeisance to the comprehensible, incomprehensible and comphrehensible-cum-incomprehensible one, to the Deity quell¬ ing the distress of devotees. Obeisance to you who are Nara- Narayana. 1
verses.hindi: केतुमाल महाद्वीपं नानाम्लेच्छगर्णयुतम् । प्लावयन्ती महाभागा प्रयाता पश्चिमारणवम् मेरुकूटतटाद्श्रष्टा पवनेनेरितोदका । अनेकाभोगवरक्काड़री क्षिप्पमाणे नभस्तले १५६ घष्टियोजनसाहलत निरालस्बेउम्बरे शुभे । विकीर्यभाणा मालेव निपपात महानदी ३४६० एवं क्टतटश्र ष्टा नेकेदेबरषिसेवितें: । विकीयमाणसलिला नेकपुष्पोडुपोत्कचा १६१
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the eternal, non-eternal and eternal-cum- non-eternal one; to the manifest, unmanifest and manifest-cum- unmanifest. Obeisance to the comprehensible, incomprehensible and comphrehensible-cum-incomprehensible one, to the Deity quell¬ ing the distress of devotees.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the eternal, non-eternal and eternal-cum- non-eternal one; to the manifest, unmanifest and manifest-cum- unmanifest. Obeisance to the comprehensible, incomprehensible and comphrehensible-cum-incomprehensible one, to the Deity quell¬ ing the distress of devotees.…

verses.sanskrit: बहुद्रुमलताकीर्णं बहुपुष्पोपशोभितम् । ऋक्षसिंहसमाकीर्णं नानाव्रतधरैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: bahudrumalatākīrṇaṃ bahupuṣpopaśobhitam / ṛkṣasiṃhasamākīrṇaṃ nānāvratadharaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the lover of Uraa, obeisance to Sarva; obeisance to you, the deity marked by Nandicakra; obeisance to you who are fortnight, month and half a month; obeisance to you who are Sathvatsara.
verses.hindi: सरोबरं महापुण्यं महाभागनिषेवितम् । तत्रा5:विवेश कल्याणी महाभद्रं सितोदका ३६३
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the lover of Uraa, obeisance to Sarva; obeisance to you, the deity marked by Nandicakra; obeisance to you who are fortnight, month and half a month; obeisance to you who are Sathvatsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the lover of Uraa, obeisance to Sarva; obeisance to you, the deity marked by Nandicakra; obeisance to you who are fortnight, month and half a month; obeisance to you who are Sathvatsara.

verses.sanskrit: एकपादास्थिताः केचिदपरे सूर्यदृष्टयः । एकाङ्गुष्ठ स्थिताः केचिद् ऊर्ध्वबाहुस्थिताः परे
verses.transliteration: ekapādāsthitāḥ kecidapare sūryadṛṣṭayaḥ / ekāṅguṣṭha sthitāḥ kecid ūrdhvabāhusthitāḥ pare
verses.translation: Hail to you, the multi-formed, shaven-headed, staff- bearing, armoured god. Obeisance to the bearer of a skull, the quarter-clad (naked), tuft-bearing god. Obeisance to you with flagstaff and chariot. Obeisance to you the self-controlled and the celibate. Obeisance to you who are Rk, Yajus and Saman. Obeisance to you O god, of such activities as these".
verses.hindi: सरोवर में, उससे कुमुदाचल पर, वहाँ से मधुमान पर, प्रधुमान से मुकुट पर, मुकुट से कृष्णषरबंत पर, कृष्ण से महानाग विभूषित व्वेतशल पर और श्वेत शैल से हैलेम्द्र सहस्न-शिखर पर उतरती है। इस प्रकार यह नदी सहस्त- सहस्र खण्ड, शत-शत पव॒त श्रेष्ठ, बहुत से विचित्र बन एवं सरोवर को प्लावित करके, अनेक नदियों के जल से पूर्ण होकर बड़े वेग से महाशैल परिजात पर गिरती है ।१०-५४। अनेक निश्लेर, नदी, गृहा और शिखरों से युक्त उस महाशैल परिजात के मध्य उदर में घूमती हुई यह नदी गण्डशलों से ठकराती हुई पृथ्वी पर उतरती है और नाना म्लेच्छों के आवास स्थान केतुमाल महाद्वीप को सींचती हुई पर्चिम समुद्र से मिल जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to you, the multi-formed, shaven-headed, staff- bearing, armoured god. Obeisance to the bearer of a skull, the quarter-clad (naked), tuft-bearing god. Obeisance to you with flagstaff and chariot. Obeisance to you the self-controlled and the celibate.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to you, the multi-formed, shaven-headed, staff- bearing, armoured god. Obeisance to the bearer of a skull, the quarter-clad (naked), tuft-bearing god. Obeisance to you with flagstaff and chariot. Obeisance to you the self-controlled and the celibate.…

verses.sanskrit: दिनैकभोजनाः केचित् केचित् कन्दफलाशनाः । त्रिरात्रभोजनाः केचित्पराकव्रतिनो ऽपरे
verses.transliteration: dinaikabhojanāḥ kecit kecit kandaphalāśanāḥ / trirātrabhojanāḥ kecitparākavratino 'pare
verses.translation: Thus I had been eulogised by Devas who bowed to me, O splendid-faced lady.
verses.hindi: पवनान्दोलित जलशालिनी पूर्वोक्त महनदी हेमकूटतट से गिरकर मेरु गिरि के उत्तर दिग्वर्ती सुबर्ण-चित्रित सुपाइवं शोभित विशाल, विचित्र, महास स्वसंकुल पाददेश में पतत होती है । आकाश में यह विस्तृताकार और टेढ़ीमेढ़ी होकर साठ हजार योजनों में निरालम्ब भाव से बहती है। वहां से माला की तरह जल को बिखेरती हुई वह महानदी गिरती है ।५८-६०। अनेक देवियों से सेवित विविध कूट तठों से गिरकर अनेक पृष्प
verses.wordMeaning: Thus I had been eulogised by Devas who bowed to me, O splendid-faced lady.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I had been eulogised by Devas who bowed to me, O splendid-faced lady.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणरताः केचित् केचित् पक्षोपवासिनः । मासोपवासिनः केचित् केचिदृत्वन्तपारणाः
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇaratāḥ kecit kecit pakṣopavāsinaḥ / māsopavāsinaḥ kecit kecidṛtvantapāraṇāḥ
verses.translation: "On realising my devotion, the lord of Devas whose hair and tresses are flooded with Ganga water still remains subtle. Thanks to the surpassing Yogic power, he is inconceivable. He remains invisible like the moon that has been hidden (by the clouds)." Thus I had been eulogised by lord Brahma, the creator of the Universe, by means of diverse hymns taken from the Vedas and Vedangas.
verses.hindi: नौकाओं को धारण करनेवाली एजं जल को बिखेरने वाली यह नदी नाना-रत्नमय देश अरण्य, सवितृषन और अन्याय महावन को प्रदक्षिणा क्रम से प्लावित करती हुई यह महाभागा कल्याणी शुश्रसलिला नदी महाभद्र नामक एक महापुण्य सरोवर में मिलती है ।६१-६३। वहाँ से निकलने पर वह महापुण्या महानदी ३१० द वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: "On realising my devotion, the lord of Devas whose hair and tresses are flooded with Ganga water still remains subtle. Thanks to the surpassing Yogic power, he is inconceivable.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "On realising my devotion, the lord of Devas whose hair and tresses are flooded with Ganga water still remains subtle. Thanks to the surpassing Yogic power, he is inconceivable.…

verses.sanskrit: योगाभ्यासरताः केचित् केचिद्ध्यायन्ति तत्पदम् । शीर्णपर्णाशिनः केचित् केचिच्च कटुकाशनाः
verses.transliteration: yogābhyāsaratāḥ kecit keciddhyāyanti tatpadam / śīrṇaparṇāśinaḥ kecit kecicca kaṭukāśanāḥ
verses.translation: Then I became delighted with Brahma, the great and noble Atman. After that I spoke to him in subtle words.
verses.hindi: सुनगाच्छतशुगं च॒ संप्राप्ता सा महानदी। शतशुदूगन्महाशैलं पुष्करं पुष्पमण्डितम् ६६ पुष्करःच्च महाशेलं द्िराजं सुमहाबलम् । वराहपबंतं तस्मान्मयूरं च शिलोच्चयम् ३७०
verses.wordMeaning: Then I became delighted with Brahma, the great and noble Atman. After that I spoke to him in subtle words.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then I became delighted with Brahma, the great and noble Atman. After that I spoke to him in subtle words.

verses.sanskrit: शैवालभोजनाः केचित् केचिन्मारुतभोजनाः । गार्हस्थ्ये च स्थिताः केचित् केचिच्चैवाग्निहोत्रिणः
verses.transliteration: śaivālabhojanāḥ kecit kecinmārutabhojanāḥ / gārhasthye ca sthitāḥ kecit keciccaivāgnihotriṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Olord, lord of past and future, lord of the worlds, lord of the Universe, O Brahma of good rites, what shall I do for you?" Purarias try to synthesize Vaisnavism and Saivism by identifying Siva with Vi|nu.
verses.hindi: त्रिशदृगतटविश्रष्ठा महाभागनिषेबिता। मेरकूटतटाद्श्रष्टा पबनेनेरितोदका वीरुधं प्बतवरं पपात विमलोदका । प्लावयन्ती महाभागा प्रयाता पश्चिमार्णवम् ७४
verses.wordMeaning: "Olord, lord of past and future, lord of the worlds, lord of the Universe, O Brahma of good rites, what shall I do for you?" Purarias try to synthesize Vaisnavism and Saivism by identifying Siva with Vi|nu.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Olord, lord of past and future, lord of the worlds, lord of the Universe, O Brahma of good rites, what shall I do for you?" Purarias try to synthesize Vaisnavism and Saivism by identifying Siva with Vi|nu.

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधान् द्विजान् दृष्ट्वा जानुभ्यामवनिं गतः । प्रणम्य शिरसा राजन्राजा वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhān dvijān dṛṣṭvā jānubhyāmavaniṃ gataḥ / praṇamya śirasā rājanrājā vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: On hearing my words, the lotus-eyed Brahma replied: «q Is vara, O lord of the past, present and future, may this be listened.
verses.hindi: भद्रसो मा नाम से विख्यात होती है  वह भद्गरसोमा बहुविस्तृत और अत्यन्त वेबबती है ।६४। यह शी घ्रगाभिनी नदी शंखकट तट के अनेक निझेंरों और वप्रों को पार करती हुई उसी हांद्वकट गिरि के तट पर गिरती है. फिर वहाँ से नागशल पर जाती है और नाग शल से पबंतश्रेष्ठ व्षपवंत नील १र उतरती है। वहाँ से वह नदी कर्पषिजल पर और करपिजल से नीचे की ओर बहकर इन्द्रनील पर एवं इन्द्रनील से महानदी हेमश्ंग पर
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing my words, the lotus-eyed Brahma replied: «q Is vara, O lord of the past, present and future, may this be listened.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing my words, the lotus-eyed Brahma replied: «q Is vara, O lord of the past, present and future, may this be listened.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेन उवाच: कस्मिन्देशे च तत् तीर्थं सत्यं कथयत द्विजाः । येनाभिवाञ्छिता सिद्धिः सफला मे भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: citrasena uvāca: kasmindeśe ca tat tīrthaṃ satyaṃ kathayata dvijāḥ / yenābhivāñchitā siddhiḥ saphalā me bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: O lotus-eyed lord, when the ocean was being churned by Devas and Asuras, the terrible poison, resembling a cloud, shining like a blue cloud, having the lustre of the Samvarta fire, refulgent like the sun at the end of the Yugas, appeared in front like the Black Death. It has the brilliance of the sun capable of destroying the three worlds. It sparkles all round. The poison having the lustre of deadly fire has risen in front.
verses.hindi: गिरती है ।६५-६७३। हेमश्यंग से ब्वेत पर, बवेत से सुनगपर और सुनग से वह महानदी शत श्वंग पर जाती है। शतभ्शंग से पुष्पमण्डित महाशल पुष्कर पर, पुष्कर से महाबली महाशल द्विजराज पर, वहाँ से वराह पंत पर, वहाँ से शिलोच्चय मयूर पर, मयूर से अनेक कन्दराओं वाले, एक शिखर जातुधि नामक पव॑त के शिखर पर वह शी घ्रगामिनी नदी गिरती है । इस प्रकार यह महानदी सहसझ्नों पव॑ंतों को विदी्णं करती हुई शिखर सेयुक्तत्रिश्यृंग नामक मर्यादा पर्वत पर गिरती है ।६८-७२। इसके बाद महाभागा नदी त्रिश्वृंग के तट से भ्रष्ट होकर पवन द्वारा प्रेरित होने पर मेरकूट के तट से भ॑। च्यूत होती है।यह विमल जलशालिनी पंत श्रेष्ठ वीरुध पर गिरती है ओर वहाँ के प्रदेश को प्लावित करती हुई यह महाभागा पश्चिम समुद्र में मिलती है ।७३-७४। मेरु के उत्तर पाश्व में सुपाश्व॑ न;मक, नानाजीवसंकुल सुवर्गमय पाद देश में वह अनेक भागों
verses.wordMeaning: O lotus-eyed lord, when the ocean was being churned by Devas and Asuras, the terrible poison, resembling a cloud, shining like a blue cloud, having the lustre of the Samvarta fire, refulgent like the sun at the end of the Yugas, appeared in front like the Black Death.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lotus-eyed lord, when the ocean was being churned by Devas and Asuras, the terrible poison, resembling a cloud, shining like a blue cloud, having the lustre of the Samvarta fire, refulgent like the sun at the end of the Yugas, appeared in front like the Black Death.…

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । धन्वन्तरशतं गच्छ भृगुतुङ्गस्य मूर्धनि । कुण्डं द्रक्ष्यसि तत्पूर्णं विस्तीर्णं पयसा शिवम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ / dhanvantaraśataṃ gaccha bhṛgutuṅgasya mūrdhani / kuṇḍaṃ drakṣyasi tatpūrṇaṃ vistīrṇaṃ payasā śivam
verses.translation: On seeing it we are much frightened and agitated. O Mahadeva, desiring the welfare of the worlds, you will please drink it. O Sir, you are the enjoyer of the most splendid, you are the excellent lord.
verses.hindi: में विभक्त होकर और फैलकर गिरती है। अनस्तर कन्दरा के बीच से निकलकर वह विज्ञाल आकारवाली ओर कल्याणकारी नदी पुष्पों की विचित्र नौका को धारण करती हुई पृथ्वी पर उतरकर उत्तर कुरु को
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing it we are much frightened and agitated. O Mahadeva, desiring the welfare of the worlds, you will please drink it. O Sir, you are the enjoyer of the most splendid, you are the excellent lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing it we are much frightened and agitated. O Mahadeva, desiring the welfare of the worlds, you will please drink it. O Sir, you are the enjoyer of the most splendid, you are the excellent lord.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा गतः कुण्डस्य सन्निधौ । दृष्ट्वा चैव तु तत् तीर्थं भ्रान्तिर्जाता नृपस्य वै
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gataḥ kuṇḍasya sannidhau / dṛṣṭvā caiva tu tat tīrthaṃ bhrāntirjātā nṛpasya vai
verses.translation: O Mahadeva, excepting you, there is no one to en¬ dure the poison. No other person is sung about (= glorified) as capable of it, in the three worlds". On hearing these words of Brahma, O splendid¬ faced lady, I concurred and said "So be it". Then I began to drink the poison that resembled death. As I drank the terrible poison frightening even the gods, O lady of excellent comple¬ xion, my throat immediately turned black.
verses.hindi: एवं तास्तु महानद्यश्नतत्नो विमलोदका:  महागिरितट भ्रष्टाः संप्रयाताश्रतुरदिशम् . ७८ तत्सेयं कथितप्राया पृथिवी बहुविस्तरा । मेरशैलमहाकोर्णा£विशच्च सर्वतोदिशम् ७६ चतुर्महादहीपवती चतुराक्रीडकानना  चतुष्केतुमहावृक्षा चतुर्वरसरस्व॒ती ८० इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते भुवनविन्यासो नाम ट्विंचत्वारिशोथ्ध्याय: ।
verses.wordMeaning: O Mahadeva, excepting you, there is no one to en¬ dure the poison. No other person is sung about (= glorified) as capable of it, in the three worlds". On hearing these words of Brahma, O splendid¬ faced lady, I concurred and said "So be it".…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mahadeva, excepting you, there is no one to en¬ dure the poison. No other person is sung about (= glorified) as capable of it, in the three worlds". On hearing these words of Brahma, O splendid¬ faced lady, I concurred and said "So be it".…

verses.sanskrit: ततो विस्मयमापन्नश्चिन्तयन्वै मुहुर्मुहुः । आकाशस्थं ददर्शासौ सामिषं कुररं नृपः
verses.transliteration: tato vismayamāpannaścintayanvai muhurmuhuḥ / ākāśasthaṃ dadarśāsau sāmiṣaṃ kuraraṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the poison that had the lustre of the petal of blue lotus and that had appeared like the king of Serpents, Taksaka, clinging to my throat and putting out its tongues, Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, possessor of excessive splendour, spoke: "O Mahadeva, of good rites, really you shine due to this throat".
verses.hindi: गन्धमादनपाश्वें तु स्फीता चोपरि गण्डिका। द्वात्रिशतं सहस्नाणि योजनेः पुववपश्चिमा
