verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the poison that had the lustre of the petal of blue lotus and that had appeared like the king of Serpents, Taksaka, clinging to my throat and putting out its tongues, Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, possessor of excessive splendour, spoke: "O Mahadeva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the poison that had the lustre of the petal of blue lotus and that had appeared like the king of Serpents, Taksaka, clinging to my throat and putting out its tongues, Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, possessor of excessive splendour, spoke: "O Mahadeva,…

verses.sanskrit: भ्रममाणं गृहीताहिं वध्यमानं निरामिषैः । परस्परं च युयुधुः सर्वे ऽप्यामिषकाङ्क्षया
verses.transliteration: bhramamāṇaṃ gṛhītāhiṃ vadhyamānaṃ nirāmiṣaiḥ / parasparaṃ ca yuyudhuḥ sarve 'pyāmiṣakāṅkṣayā
verses.translation: O daughter of the king of mountains, on seeing the Kalakuta, that poison of fierce potency, being retained by me in the throat, Devas and Daityas were wonder-struck. Then, O fair lady with the gait of inebriated elephant,
verses.hindi: प्लावित करती हुई मह।द्वीपों के बीचों बीच बहकर उत्तर समुद्र में जाकर मिल जाती है ।७५-७७। इस प्रकार विमल जल वाली वे चारों नदियाँ महागिरि तट से निकलकर चारो दिशाओं में प्रवाहित हुई है । विप्रगण ! इन शब्दों में अत्यन्त विस्तृत पृथ्वी की कथा प्रायः कह दी गयी । यह पृथ्वी मेरु आदि शैलों द्वारा चारों ओर से व्याप्त है ।9८-८६। इसमें चारों महाद्वीप और चार क्रीड़ा कानन हैं। केतुस्वरूप चार महावृक्ष और चार सरोवर भी हैं। इस पृथ्वी पर चार महाशल हैं और आठ उत्तर महाबैल तथा आठ अबर पव॒॑तों से युक्त यह भूमण्डल चार महानागों के आधार पर ठिकी है
verses.wordMeaning: O daughter of the king of mountains, on seeing the Kalakuta, that poison of fierce potency, being retained by me in the throat, Devas and Daityas were wonder-struck. Then, O fair lady with the gait of inebriated elephant,
verses.commentary: Sense: O daughter of the king of mountains, on seeing the Kalakuta, that poison of fierce potency, being retained by me in the throat, Devas and Daityas were wonder-struck. Then, O fair lady with the gait of inebriated elephant,

verses.sanskrit: हतश्चञ्चुप्रहारेण स ततः पतितो ऽंभसि । शूलेन शूलिना यत्र भूभागो भेदितः पुरा
verses.transliteration: hataścañcuprahāreṇa sa tataḥ patito 'ṃbhasi / śūlena śūlinā yatra bhūbhāgo bheditaḥ purā
verses.translation: "Wonderful is your strength, prowess and valour. Oh, wonderful is the strength of your Yoga. O lord of Devas', wondeiful is your lordship, O lord, whose dishevelled hair is flooded with Ganga water.
verses.hindi: श्री वायुमह/पुराण का भुवनविन्यास नामक बयालीसवाँ अध्याय समाप्त ॥४ ९॥
verses.wordMeaning: "Wonderful is your strength, prowess and valour. Oh, wonderful is the strength of your Yoga. O lord of Devas', wondeiful is your lordship, O lord, whose dishevelled hair is flooded with Ganga water.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Wonderful is your strength, prowess and valour. Oh, wonderful is the strength of your Yoga. O lord of Devas', wondeiful is your lordship, O lord, whose dishevelled hair is flooded with Ganga water.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तीर्थस्य प्रभावेण स सद्यः पुरुषो ऽभवत् । विमानस्थं ददर्शासौ पुमांसं दिव्यरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: tattīrthasya prabhāveṇa sa sadyaḥ puruṣo 'bhavat / vimānasthaṃ dadarśāsau pumāṃsaṃ divyarūpiṇam
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu, the., four-faced Brahma and Yama, the god of death; you alone are the bestower of boons; you alone are the sun, the moon, the earth and the water. You alone are sacrifice, the rites and observances; you alone are the past and future. You alone are the origin and end; you alone are both gross and subtle Purusa.
verses.hindi: सतजी बोले-- गन्धमादन पर्वत के बगल में एक परिण्क्ित गण्डशिला है। पूरब-पश्चिम में यह बत्ती अस्या5ध्यामश्रतुस्श्रिशत्सहुल्लाणि प्रमाणतः । तत्र ते शुभकर्माणः केतुमालाः परिश्रुताः ...
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu, the., four-faced Brahma and Yama, the god of death; you alone are the bestower of boons; you alone are the sun, the moon, the earth and the water. You alone are sacrifice, the rites and observances; you alone are the past and future.…
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu, the., four-faced Brahma and Yama, the god of death; you alone are the bestower of boons; you alone are the sun, the moon, the earth and the water. You alone are sacrifice, the rites and observances; you alone are the past and future.…

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यक्षास्तं यान्तं तुष्टुवुर् दिवि । अप्सरोगीयमाने तु गते सूर्यस्य मूर्धनि । चित्रसेनस् ततस्तस्मिन्नाश्चर्यं परमं गतः
verses.transliteration: gandharvāpsaraso yakṣāstaṃ yāntaṃ tuṣṭuvur divi / apsarogīyamāne tu gate sūryasya mūrdhani / citrasenas tatastasminnāścaryaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: You alone are the subtlest of the subtle; you alone are the fire and the wind; you alone are the creator, protector and annihilator of the world, both mobile and immobile.*'
verses.hindi: तत्र काला नराः सर्वे महासत्त्वा महाबलाः। स्त्रियश्रोत्पलपत्राभाः सर्वास्ताः प्रियदर्शनाः ३
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are the subtlest of the subtle; you alone are the fire and the wind; you alone are the creator, protector and annihilator of the world, both mobile and immobile.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are the subtlest of the subtle; you alone are the fire and the wind; you alone are the creator, protector and annihilator of the world, both mobile and immobile.*'

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिणा कथितं यद्वत्तद्वत्तीर्थं न संशयः । हृष्टरोमाभवद् दृष्ट्वा प्रभावं तीर्थसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiṇā kathitaṃ yadvattadvattīrthaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / hṛṣṭaromābhavad dṛṣṭvā prabhāvaṃ tīrthasambhavam
verses.translation: After saying these words and bowing their heads, the leading Devas, the noble souls, went to Meru in their aerial chariots. Thus the greatest of secrets, the holiest of holy things, the story of what is famous as Nilakantha has been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: वाश्वें माल्यव॒तश्रवापि पूर्वे पूर्वा तु गण्डिका । आयामतो5थ विस्ताराद्यथवापरगण्डिका  ५ भद्राश्वास्तत्र विज्ञेया नित्यं मुदितमानसाः । भद्दे सालबन तत्र कालाम्राश्र महाद्रमाः ६ चन्द्रप्रभाभ्रनद्रवर्णा: पूर्ण चद्धनिभानना: । चन्द्रशोतलगात्यश्न स्त्रियोश्रोत्पलगन्धिका: द ८ दश वर्षसहल्लाणि तेषामायुनिरामयम् । कालाम्रस्य रसं पीत्वा सदा स्थिरयौवन:: ६
verses.wordMeaning: After saying these words and bowing their heads, the leading Devas, the noble souls, went to Meru in their aerial chariots. Thus the greatest of secrets, the holiest of holy things, the story of what is famous as Nilakantha has been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying these words and bowing their heads, the leading Devas, the noble souls, went to Meru in their aerial chariots. Thus the greatest of secrets, the holiest of holy things, the story of what is famous as Nilakantha has been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: ममाद्य दिवसो धन्यो यस्माद् अत्र समागतः । अस्थीनि भूमौ निक्षिप्य स्नानं कृत्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: mamādya divaso dhanyo yasmād atra samāgataḥ / asthīni bhūmau nikṣipya snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: This story has been narrated by the self-born deity. It is the sacred story that quells sins. I shall now mention the fruit ' accruing to that person who retains this story recounted by Brahma.
verses.hindi: प्रमाणं वर्णमायुश्च याथातथ्येन कीतितम् । चतुर्णापि द्वीपानां समासान्न तु बिस्तरात् १०
verses.wordMeaning: This story has been narrated by the self-born deity. It is the sacred story that quells sins. I shall now mention the fruit ' accruing to that person who retains this story recounted by Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: This story has been narrated by the self-born deity. It is the sacred story that quells sins. I shall now mention the fruit ' accruing to that person who retains this story recounted by Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तिलमिश्रेण तोयेनातर्पयत् पितृदेवताः । गृह्यास्थीनि ततो राजा चिक्षेपान्तर्जले तदा
verses.transliteration: tilamiśreṇa toyenātarpayat pitṛdevatāḥ / gṛhyāsthīni tato rājā cikṣepāntarjale tadā
verses.translation: O fair lady of good loins, on reaching his body, poison from mobile and immobile things becomes ineffective immediately. It quells inauspiciousness and removes (the effect of) bad dreams. The person attains the love of women and leader¬ ship in royal assembly.
verses.hindi: हजार योजनों में फैली है एवं इसका विस्तार प्रमाण चौंतीस हजार योजनों का है। वहाँ शुभ कम करनेवाले केतुमाल देशवासी निवास करते हैं ।१-२। वहाँ के रहने वाले पुरुष महावीयशाली, बलशाली ओर काले रंग के होते है; किस्तु स्त्रियाँ कझमल-दल-सी कोमल और देखने में मनोहर लगती हैं  बहाँ कटहल का एक दिव्य विशाल वक्ष है, जिसके फलों में छवों रसों का स्वाद है  वह वृक्ष ब्रह्मा का पुत्र, ईश्वर, कामचारी और मन के समान वेगशाली है। वहाँ के निवासी उसके फलों के रस को पीकर हजारों वर्ष जीते हैं ।रे-४। उसी प्रकार माल्यवान के पूर्व भाग में दूसरी पूव॑-गण्डशिला है; जिसकी लम्बाई-चौड़ाई भी पहली गण्डशिला के ही बराबर है ।५। भद्गाश्ववासी लोग वहाँ नित्य प्रसन्नता पूर्वक रहते हैं। वहाँ भद्र नामक एक सालवन हैं, जहाँ के विशाल वक्ष कालाम्र नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं  वहाँ के पुरुष स्वेतवर्ण के महाबवीयंशाली और बलशालो हो! हैं। स्त्रियाँ भी
verses.wordMeaning: O fair lady of good loins, on reaching his body, poison from mobile and immobile things becomes ineffective immediately. It quells inauspiciousness and removes (the effect of) bad dreams. The person attains the love of women and leader¬ ship in royal assembly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O fair lady of good loins, on reaching his body, poison from mobile and immobile things becomes ineffective immediately. It quells inauspiciousness and removes (the effect of) bad dreams. The person attains the love of women and leader¬ ship in royal assembly.

verses.sanskrit: क्षणमेकं ततो वीक्ष्य राजोर्द्ध्ववदनः स्थितः । तान् ददर्श पुनः सर्वान् दिव्यरूपधराञ्छुभान्
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇamekaṃ tato vīkṣya rājorddhvavadanaḥ sthitaḥ / tān dadarśa punaḥ sarvān divyarūpadharāñchubhān
verses.translation: In disputes he becomes victorious; in battle he attains valour; on expedition he attains welfare; he has perpetual riches in his house.
verses.hindi: कुमुद के रंग की, सुन्दरी और देखने में भली मालूम पड़ती है । वे स्त्रियाँ चन्द्र के समान आभा पूर्ण, गौर वर्ण की, शौतलांगी कमल-गन्धा और पूर्ण चन्द्र की तरह मनोहर मुख वाली हैं। वहाँ के लोग दम हजार वर्षों तक स्वस्थ और नि:शंक्र होकर जीते हैं और कालाम्र के रस को पीकर सदा युवक बने रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In disputes he becomes victorious; in battle he attains valour; on expedition he attains welfare; he has perpetual riches in his house.
verses.commentary: Sense: In disputes he becomes victorious; in battle he attains valour; on expedition he attains welfare; he has perpetual riches in his house.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यवस्त्रैश्च संवीतान् दिव्याभरणभूषितान् । विमानैर् विविधैर् दिव्यैर् अप्सरोगणसेवितैः
verses.transliteration: divyavastraiśca saṃvītān divyābharaṇabhūṣitān / vimānair vividhair divyair apsarogaṇasevitaiḥ
verses.translation: I shall tell his goal at the dissolution of his body, O excellent-faced lady. He becomes blue-throated, green-mous¬ tached and moon-crested; he attains three eyes; he holds the tri¬ dent in his hand, and has bull as his vehicle; he holds the Pinaka O beautiful lady, I shall now mention the goal both here and hereafter of those persons who are my devotees and who hear this story.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने कद्ा--आपने चारों द्वीपों के निवासियों के वर्ण, आयु और प्रमाण को यथार्थ रूप में बता दिया है; किन्तु विस्तार पूवंक न कहकर संक्षेप में कहा है भद्राश्वानां तथा चिह्न कीतितं कोतिवर्ध ना: । तच्छ॒णुध्य॑ तु कात्स्य्येन पूर्व॑सिद्धधदाहुतम्.
verses.wordMeaning: I shall tell his goal at the dissolution of his body, O excellent-faced lady. He becomes blue-throated, green-mous¬ tached and moon-crested; he attains three eyes; he holds the tri¬ dent in his hand, and has bull as his vehicle; he holds the Pinaka O beautiful lady,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall tell his goal at the dissolution of his body, O excellent-faced lady. He becomes blue-throated, green-mous¬ tached and moon-crested; he attains three eyes; he holds the tri¬ dent in his hand, and has bull as his vehicle; he holds the Pinaka O beautiful lady,…

verses.sanskrit: पृथग्भूतांश्च तान् सर्वान् विमानेषु व्यवस्थितान् । उत्पत्तिवत्समालोक्य राजा संहर्षी सो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: pṛthagbhūtāṃśca tān sarvān vimāneṣu vyavasthitān / utpattivatsamālokya rājā saṃharṣī so 'bhavat
verses.translation: ABrahmanasecures (attains mastery over) Vedas; a Ksattriya conquers the earth; a Vaifya derives profit; and a Sudra attains happiness.
verses.hindi: देवक्टस्य सर्वेस्य प्रथितस्येह्ठ यत्परम् । पुर्वेण दिक्षु सर्वासु यथावच्च प्रकीतितम् १२ कुलाचलानां प"च्चानां नदीनां च विशेषतः  तथा जनपदानां च यथादृष्टं यथाशरुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: ABrahmanasecures (attains mastery over) Vedas; a Ksattriya conquers the earth; a Vaifya derives profit; and a Sudra attains happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: ABrahmanasecures (attains mastery over) Vedas; a Ksattriya conquers the earth; a Vaifya derives profit; and a Sudra attains happiness.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिर्विमानम् आरूढश्चित्रसेनम् अथाब्रवीत् । भोभोः साधो महाराज चित्रसेन महीपते
verses.transliteration: ṛṣirvimānam ārūḍhaścitrasenam athābravīt / bhobhoḥ sādho mahārāja citrasena mahīpate
verses.translation: A sick man is freed from ailments; a man in bondage attains release; a pregnant woman gets a son; and a virgin gets a good husband. Everyone regains everything he loses in this world as in the other. On hearing this divine story of the Lord, one obtains the same fruit as is obtained when one hundred thousand cows are duly gifted away.
verses.hindi: सवालों वर्णमालाग्र: कोरञ्जश्बाचलोत्तम: । श्वेत॒वर्ण श्र नोलश्व पञ्चेते कुलपर्बताः ६१४ तेषां प्रसुतिरन्येषपि पता बहुविस्तरा:  कोटिकोटिः क्षिताौ ज्ञेयाः शतशोषइथ सहस्रशः तेविमिश्ञा जनपदर्नानासत््वसमाकुला: । नानाप्रकारजातीयास्त्वनेकनपपालिता:..
verses.wordMeaning: A sick man is freed from ailments; a man in bondage attains release; a pregnant woman gets a son; and a virgin gets a good husband. Everyone regains everything he loses in this world as in the other. On hearing this divine story of the Lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A sick man is freed from ailments; a man in bondage attains release; a pregnant woman gets a son; and a virgin gets a good husband. Everyone regains everything he loses in this world as in the other. On hearing this divine story of the Lord,…

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्प्रसादान्नृपश्रेष्ठ गतिर्दिव्या ममेदृषी । जातेयं यत्त्वया कार्यं कृतं परमशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: tvatprasādānnṛpaśreṣṭha gatirdivyā mamedṛṣī / jāteyaṃ yattvayā kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ paramaśobhanam
verses.translation: He who commits to memory one verse or half of it, one quarter of a verse or even half of it, attains Rudra's Loka.
verses.hindi: नामधेयेश्रन विक्रान्ते: श्रीमस्िः षुरुषए में: । अध्यासिता जनपदाः कौर्तनीयाश्व शोभिता:..
verses.wordMeaning: He who commits to memory one verse or half of it, one quarter of a verse or even half of it, attains Rudra's Loka.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who commits to memory one verse or half of it, one quarter of a verse or even half of it, attains Rudra's Loka.

verses.sanskrit: स्वसुतो ऽपि न शक्नोति पित्ःणां कर्तुमीदृशम् । मदीयवचनात् तात निष्पापस्त्वं भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: svasuto 'pi na śaknoti pitḥṇāṃ kartumīdṛśam / madīyavacanāt tāta niṣpāpastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: After recounting this story of pious fruits to the God¬ dess, the Lord with the moon embellishing his crest, the Lord be¬ loved of Guha, went along with Uma to the cave of Kiskindha seated on his bull. After recounting this story of great length quelling sins, Vayu went away. After studying everything, the excellent Brah- marias went to the auspicious path of Aditya.
verses.hindi: तेषां तु नामधेयानि राष्ट्राणि विविधानि च। गिर्यन्तरनिविष्टानि समेघ्चु विषसेषु च १८ तथा सुमइगला: शुद्धाश्रन्द्रकान्ताः सुनन्‍्दना: । ब्रजका नीलमौलेया: सौवीरा विजयस्थलाः. महास्थलए सुकामाश्न महाकेशाः सुमृधंजा: । वातरंहा: सोपसडगा: परिवायाः पराचका:
verses.wordMeaning: After recounting this story of pious fruits to the God¬ dess, the Lord with the moon embellishing his crest, the Lord be¬ loved of Guha, went along with Uma to the cave of Kiskindha seated on his bull. After recounting this story of great length quelling sins, Vayu went away.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After recounting this story of pious fruits to the God¬ dess, the Lord with the moon embellishing his crest, the Lord be¬ loved of Guha, went along with Uma to the cave of Kiskindha seated on his bull. After recounting this story of great length quelling sins, Vayu went away.…

verses.sanskrit: फलं प्राप्स्यसि राजेन्द्र कामिकं मनसेप्सितम् । आशीर्वादांस् ततो दत्त्वा चित्रसेनाय धीमते । स्वर्गं जगाम ससुतस् ततो दीर्घतपा मुनिः
verses.transliteration: phalaṃ prāpsyasi rājendra kāmikaṃ manasepsitam / āśīrvādāṃs tato dattvā citrasenāya dhīmate / svargaṃ jagāma sasutas tato dīrghatapā muniḥ
verses.translation: This type of liberation is called SirUpya, 'similarity of appearance'.
verses.hindi: संभववत्रा महानेत्रा: सेवालास्तनपास्तथा । कुमुदाः शाकमुण्डाश्व उरःसंकीर्णभौमका: ..
verses.wordMeaning: This type of liberation is called SirUpya, 'similarity of appearance'.
verses.commentary: Sense: This type of liberation is called SirUpya, 'similarity of appearance'.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चमावन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे दीर्घतपसः स्वर्गारोहणवर्णनं नाम चतुःपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ५५ उत्तानपाद उवाच: माहात्म्यं तीर्थजं दृष्ट्वा चित्रसेनो नरेश्वरः । किं चकार क्व वा वासं किमाहारो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamāvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dīrghatapasaḥ svargārohaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 55 uttānapāda uvāca: māhātmyaṃ tīrthajaṃ dṛṣṭvā citraseno nareśvaraḥ / kiṃ cakāra kva vā vāsaṃ kimāhāro babhūva ha
verses.translation: O eloquent one, who is the greatest in regard to attri¬ butes, activities and power? We wish to hear clearly the descrip¬ tion of his good, wonderful qualities in detail.
verses.hindi: सोदका वत्सकाश्चका बाराहा हारवासकाः । शड्भूगरुवा भाविचन्द्राश्न उत्तरा हैमभोौमकाः खूतजी बोले--महायशस्वियों ! ऋषियों ! भद्राष्ववासियों का जो स्वरूप हमने बताया है, उसे पहले सिद्धों ने जंसा कहा है, उसी के अनुरूप हम विस्तार के साथ कहते हैं उसे आप सब सुनें। प्रसिद्ध देवकूट गिरि के पूर्व की ओर से चारों ओर वतंमान पाँचों कुल पबंतों, नदियों और देशों का वर्णन जेसा हमने देखा और सुना है वेसा कह दिया है ।११-१३। शैवाल, वर्णमालाग्र, कोरज्ज, ब्वेत और नील ये पाँच कुल पर्वत
verses.wordMeaning: O eloquent one, who is the greatest in regard to attri¬ butes, activities and power? We wish to hear clearly the descrip¬ tion of his good, wonderful qualities in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: O eloquent one, who is the greatest in regard to attri¬ butes, activities and power? We wish to hear clearly the descrip¬ tion of his good, wonderful qualities in detail.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: भृगुतुङ्गं समारुह्य ऐशानीं दिशमाश्रितः । तपश्चचार विपुलं कुण्डे तत्र नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: bhṛgutuṅgaṃ samāruhya aiśānīṃ diśamāśritaḥ / tapaścacāra vipulaṃ kuṇḍe tatra nṛpottamaḥ
verses.translation: In this connection they cite this ancient anecdote about the greatness and omnipotence of the great Atman, Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: हैं। इनके सन्‍्तान के रूप में सैकड़ों हजारों और करोड़ों विशाल-विशाल परत हैं। इन पव॑तों से युक्त कितने ही देश हैं जहाँ भाँति-भाँति की जातियाँ और जीव निवास करते हैं, जिसका पालन अनेक राजाओं द्वारा होता है ।१४-१६। उन देझ्षों में कितने ही स्वतामघन्य बल-विक्रमशाली, श्रीमान्, पुरुषपुगव लिवास करते हैं जिनसे सुशोभित वे देश सवंत्र प्रसिद्ध हो रहे हैं। पर्व॑तों के बीच में सम और विषम स्थानों में स्थित उन
verses.wordMeaning: In this connection they cite this ancient anecdote about the greatness and omnipotence of the great Atman, Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this connection they cite this ancient anecdote about the greatness and omnipotence of the great Atman, Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् देवान् हृदि ध्यात्वा ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरान् । विचिक्षेप यदात्मानं प्रत्यक्षौ रुद्रकेशवौ । करे गृहीत्वा राजानं रुद्रो वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sarvān devān hṛdi dhyātvā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān / vicikṣepa yadātmānaṃ pratyakṣau rudrakeśavau / kare gṛhītvā rājānaṃ rudro vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Formerly this was narrated by Visnu when he had con¬ quered the three worlds after binding Bali. The deity of great prowess became the lord of the three worlds formerly.
verses.hindi: विविध देझों के नाम इस प्रकार हैं--युमद्भल, शुद्ध, चन्द्रकास्त, सुनन्दन ब्रजक, नीलमौलेय सोदीौर, विजयस्थल, महास्थल, सुकाम, महाकैश, सुपूर्डज बातरह, सोपासद्भ, परिवाय, पराचक्र, समवक्र महानेन्न, शवाल, स्तनप, कुमुद, शाकमुण्ड, उर:संकीर्ण भौमक, योमक, वत्सक्, वाराह, हारबाहुक शझ्भू, भाविमन्द्र, उत्तर हैमभोम, कृष्णभौमाः सुभोमश्र महाभोमाश्च कीतिता: । एते चान्ये च बिख्याता नानाजनपदा मया. हर रे ते पिवन्ति महापुण्यां महागड्भां महानदीम्  आदों त्लोक्यविख्याता शीता शीताम्बुवाहिनी ४२४ तथा च हुंसवसतिमंहाचक़ा च निम्नगा। घक़ा वक्‍त्रा च फाची च सुरसा चापगोत्तमा
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly this was narrated by Visnu when he had con¬ quered the three worlds after binding Bali. The deity of great prowess became the lord of the three worlds formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly this was narrated by Visnu when he had con¬ quered the three worlds after binding Bali. The deity of great prowess became the lord of the three worlds formerly.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: प्राणत्यागं महाराज मा काले त्वं कृथा वृथा । अद्याप्यसि युवा त्वं वै न युक्तं मरणं तव
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: prāṇatyāgaṃ mahārāja mā kāle tvaṃ kṛthā vṛthā / adyāpyasi yuvā tvaṃ vai na yuktaṃ maraṇaṃ tava
verses.translation: When the Daityas were destroyed, when the Lord of Sac! was delighted, all the Devas including Indra came to see the Lord. They came near the ocean of milk where Visnu, the Atman of cosmic form, stayed. After approaching the noble-souled, the Purusa, Visnu, all the Siddhas, Brahmanas, Yaksas, Gandhar- vas, Apsaras-s, Nagas, celestial sages, rivers and mountains eulo¬ gised him.
verses.hindi: शाखावती चेन्धनदी मेघा मड्भारवाहिनी । कावेरी हरितोया च सोमावर्ता शतह्दा २६ वनमाला वसुमती पम्पा पम्पावती शुभा। सुवर्णा पश्चवर्णा च तथा पुण्या वपुष्मती
verses.wordMeaning: When the Daityas were destroyed, when the Lord of Sac! was delighted, all the Devas including Indra came to see the Lord. They came near the ocean of milk where Visnu, the Atman of cosmic form, stayed. After approaching the noble-souled, the Purusa, Visnu, all the Siddhas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Daityas were destroyed, when the Lord of Sac! was delighted, all the Devas including Indra came to see the Lord. They came near the ocean of milk where Visnu, the Atman of cosmic form, stayed. After approaching the noble-souled, the Purusa, Visnu, all the Siddhas,…

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्थानं गच्छ शीघ्रं त्वं भुक्त्वा भोगान्यथेप्सितान् । कुरु निष्कण्टकं राज्यं नाके शक्र इवापरः
verses.transliteration: svasthānaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān / kuru niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ nāke śakra ivāparaḥ
verses.translation: "O Lord, you are the creatorandsustainer of theworlds. By your grace the three worlds attain imperishable welfare. The Asuras have been conquered and Bali has been bound by you".
verses.hindi: सणिवतप्रा सुवष्रा च ब्रह्मभागा शिलाशिनी । कृष्णतोया च पुण्योदा तथा नागनदी शुभा शैवालिनी मणितटा क्षारोदा चारुणावती । तथा विष्णुपदी चंव महापुण्या महानदी २६ हिरण्यवाहिनी नीला स्कन्‍्दमाला सुरावती । वासोदा च पताका च बेताली च महानदी ॥
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord, you are the creatorandsustainer of theworlds. By your grace the three worlds attain imperishable welfare. The Asuras have been conquered and Bali has been bound by you".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, you are the creatorandsustainer of theworlds. By your grace the three worlds attain imperishable welfare. The Asuras have been conquered and Bali has been bound by you".

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेन उवाच: न राज्यं कामये देव न पुत्रान् न च बान्धवान् । न भार्यां न च कोशं च न गजान् न तुरंगमान्
verses.transliteration: citrasena uvāca: na rājyaṃ kāmaye deva na putrān na ca bāndhavān / na bhāryāṃ na ca kośaṃ ca na gajān na turaṃgamān
verses.translation: On being thus addressed by Devas, Siddhas and the sages, Visnu, the excellent of Purusas, replied to them.
verses.hindi: एता गड़ा महानद्यों नायिकाः परिकोतिता:। क्षुद्रनच्यस्त्वसंख्याताः शतशोडथ सहस्नशशः .. ३१ पुर्वद्वीपस्थ बाहिनयः पुण्यवत्यश्र फीतिता: । कीर्तनेनापि चेतासां पूतः स्थादिति में गतिः
verses.wordMeaning: On being thus addressed by Devas, Siddhas and the sages, Visnu, the excellent of Purusas, replied to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being thus addressed by Devas, Siddhas and the sages, Visnu, the excellent of Purusas, replied to them.

verses.sanskrit: मुञ्च मुञ्च महादेव मा विघ्नः क्रियतां मम । स्वर्गप्राप्तिर् ममाद्यैव त्वत्प्रसादान्महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: muñca muñca mahādeva mā vighnaḥ kriyatāṃ mama / svargaprāptir mamādyaiva tvatprasādānmaheśvara
verses.translation: "May this be heard, O excellent Devas, I shall mention the cause; the achievement has come at the very outset, thanks to the grace of that Lord alone who is the creator of all living beings, who is Time ( Kala ), the creator of Time, and by whom the worlds have been created along with Brahma by means of his Maya power.
verses.hindi: नरनारीगणाकीर्ण नित्य॑ प्रमुदितं शिवम् । बहुधान्यवनोपेत॑ नानानपतिपालितम् ॥ उपेतं कीत॑नशतेर्नानारत्नाफराकरम् ॥ रेड तस्मिन्देशे समाख्याता हेसशडखदलप्रभाः । कहाकाया महावीर्या: पुरुषाः पुरुषषेभा:
verses.wordMeaning: "May this be heard, O excellent Devas, I shall mention the cause; the achievement has come at the very outset, thanks to the grace of that Lord alone who is the creator of all living beings, who is Time ( Kala ), the creator of Time,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "May this be heard, O excellent Devas, I shall mention the cause; the achievement has come at the very outset, thanks to the grace of that Lord alone who is the creator of all living beings, who is Time ( Kala ), the creator of Time,…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: यस्याग्रतो भवेद् ब्रह्मा विष्णुः शम्भुस् तथैव च । स्वर्गेण तस्य किं कार्यं स गतः किं करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: yasyāgrato bhaved brahmā viṣṇuḥ śambhus tathaiva ca / svargeṇa tasya kiṃ kāryaṃ sa gataḥ kiṃ kariṣyati
verses.translation: Rudra and Agni (Fire-god) have been identified in Vedic times. Lihga worship is not Phallus-worship but the Puranic transformation of Vedic fire worship. The origin of or manifestation of the Lihga of Siva is told in different Puranas, e.g. Lihga 17, KP II. 38, Bd. 26.
verses.hindi: कृष्णभौम, सुभौम और महाभौम । इन देशों के अतिरिक्त वहाँ कितने ही दूसरे भी विख्यात देश हैं ।१७-२३॥। उन देशों के निवासी महापृण्या महानदी महागंगा का जल पीते हैं। वह महागंगा पहले शीतलजल वाहिनी शीता नाम से विख्यात थी ।२४। गंगा की ही तरह वहाँ और भी महानदियाँ हैं जो नायिका कहलाती हैं । जैसे-हंसवसति, महाचक्रा, चक्रा, बकक्‍त्रा, कांची, सूरसा, आपगौत्तमा, शाखावती इस्द्रनदी. मेघा, मंज्भारवाहिनी,
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra and Agni (Fire-god) have been identified in Vedic times. Lihga worship is not Phallus-worship but the Puranic transformation of Vedic fire worship. The origin of or manifestation of the Lihga of Siva is told in different Puranas, e.g. Lihga 17, KP II. 38, Bd. 26.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra and Agni (Fire-god) have been identified in Vedic times. Lihga worship is not Phallus-worship but the Puranic transformation of Vedic fire worship. The origin of or manifestation of the Lihga of Siva is told in different Puranas, e.g. Lihga 17, KP II. 38, Bd. 26.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टा वयं त्रयो देवा वृणीष्व वरमुत्तमम् । यथेप्सितं महाराज सत्यम् एतद् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭā vayaṃ trayo devā vṛṇīṣva varamuttamam / yathepsitaṃ mahārāja satyam etad asaṃśayam
verses.translation: Formerly, when the three worlds were plunged in un¬ manifest darkness and when the living beings had been retained inside my belly, I lay myself down.
verses.hindi: कावेरी, सोमावर्ता, हरितोया, सुवर्णा, पंचवर्णा, वपुष्मती, मणिवतश्रा. सुवप्रा, ब्रह्मभागा, शिलाशिनी, कृष्णतोया, अरुणावती, विष्णुपदी, महापुण्या, महानदी, हिरण्यवाहिनी, नीला, स्कच्दमाला, सूरावती, घामोदा, पताका और वेताली । इनके अतिरिक्त वहाँ सैकड़ों और क्षुद्र नदियाँ हैं ।२७-३१। पूर्व द्वीप में बहनेवाली इन पुण्य नदियों को हमने कहा  इनके नाम-कीतन से लोग पवित्र हो जाते हैं ऐसी मेरी धारणा है। उस भव्राइववर्ष के राष्ट्र समृद्ध, स्फीत, विविध जनपदों से युक्त हैं जिनमें विविध प्रकार  के वृक्ष, घने वन और विविध पंत
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, when the three worlds were plunged in un¬ manifest darkness and when the living beings had been retained inside my belly, I lay myself down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, when the three worlds were plunged in un¬ manifest darkness and when the living beings had been retained inside my belly, I lay myself down.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेन उवाच: यदि तुष्टास्त्रयो देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । अद्यप्रभृति युष्माभिः स्थातव्यम् इह सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: citrasena uvāca: yadi tuṣṭāstrayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / adyaprabhṛti yuṣmābhiḥ sthātavyam iha sarvadā
verses.translation: Assuming the form of the thousand-headed, thousand- eyed thousand-legged deity, holding the conch, discus and mace in the hands, I lay down in the pure limpid waters.
verses.hindi: हैं। वहाँ की प्रसन्नमुल नर- नारियाँ सदा मंगलोत्सव मनाया करती हैं। उस भद्गाइव वर्ष में सदा फलने-फ्लने वाले कितने ही वन हैं, अनेक राजा राज्य कर रहे हैं और वहाँ बहुमूल्य-प्रशंसनीय रत्नों की अनेकों खदाने भी हैं। उस देश में सुवर्ण-कमल-दल के समान प्रभा धारण करने वाले पुरुष-पुंगव निवास करते हैं  वे पुरुष विशाल
verses.wordMeaning: Assuming the form of the thousand-headed, thousand- eyed thousand-legged deity, holding the conch, discus and mace in the hands, I lay down in the pure limpid waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming the form of the thousand-headed, thousand- eyed thousand-legged deity, holding the conch, discus and mace in the hands, I lay down in the pure limpid waters.

verses.sanskrit: गयाशिरो यथा पुण्यं कृतं युष्माभिर् एव च । तथैवेदं प्रकर्तव्यं शूलभेदं च पावनम्
verses.transliteration: gayāśiro yathā puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ yuṣmābhir eva ca / tathaivedaṃ prakartavyaṃ śūlabhedaṃ ca pāvanam
verses.translation: In the meantime, from a distance I espied a person of unmeasured splendour who blazed with his brilliance resembl¬ ing a hundred suns.
verses.hindi: संभाषणं दर्शनं च समस्थानोपसेवनम् । देव: सह महाभागाः कुव॑ते तन्र बे प्रजा: दश वर्षसहत्राणि तेषामायुः प्रकोतितम् । धर्माधमंविशेषश्च न तेष्वस्ति महात्मसु ॥
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, from a distance I espied a person of unmeasured splendour who blazed with his brilliance resembl¬ ing a hundred suns.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, from a distance I espied a person of unmeasured splendour who blazed with his brilliance resembl¬ ing a hundred suns.

verses.sanskrit: यत्रयत्र स्थिता यूयं तत्रतत्र वसाम्यहम् । गणानां चैव सर्वेषाम् आधिपत्यम् अथास्तु मे
verses.transliteration: yatrayatra sthitā yūyaṃ tatratatra vasāmyaham / gaṇānāṃ caiva sarveṣām ādhipatyam athāstu me
verses.translation: Then he who was Brahma, who was bowed to by the worlds, spoke to me—"O lord, who arc you? Whence have you come? Why do you stay here. Tell me. I am the maker of the worlds. I am self-born. I have faces all round". Thus addressed by Brahma, I spoke to him.
verses.hindi: ते भक्‍त्या शंकर देवं गौरी परमवेष्णवी म् । इज्यापुजानमस्कारांस्ताभ्यां नित्य॑ प्रयुअुजते
verses.wordMeaning: Then he who was Brahma, who was bowed to by the worlds, spoke to me—"O lord, who arc you? Whence have you come? Why do you stay here. Tell me. I am the maker of the worlds. I am self-born. I have faces all round". Thus addressed by Brahma, I spoke to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he who was Brahma, who was bowed to by the worlds, spoke to me—"O lord, who arc you? Whence have you come? Why do you stay here. Tell me. I am the maker of the worlds. I am self-born. I have faces all round". Thus addressed by Brahma, I spoke to him.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: अद्यप्रभृति तिष्ठामः शूलभेदे नरेश्वर । त्रिकालां हि त्रयो देवाः कलांशेन वसामहे
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: adyaprabhṛti tiṣṭhāmaḥ śūlabhede nareśvara / trikālāṃ hi trayo devāḥ kalāṃśena vasāmahe
verses.translation: "I am the creator and destroyer of the worlds again and
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते भुवनविन्यासो नाम त्रिचत्वारिशोः्ष्यायः निसर्ग एव विख्यातों भद्राश्वानां यथार्थंवत् । शुणुध्व॑ केतुमालानां विस्तरेण प्रकौतंनम्
verses.wordMeaning: "I am the creator and destroyer of the worlds again and
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am the creator and destroyer of the worlds again and

verses.sanskrit: नन्दिसंज्ञो गणाधीशो भविष्यति भवान्ध्रुवम् । मत्समीपे तु भवत आदौ पूजा भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: nandisaṃjño gaṇādhīśo bhaviṣyati bhavāndhruvam / matsamīpe tu bhavata ādau pūjā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On seeing that flame we two were surprised. By that splendour all the waters sparkled.
verses.hindi: काय ओर महाबली हैं ।३२-३५। वहां के पृण्यशाली मनुष्य देवों के साथ बैठते, बात-चीत का आनन्द लट्ते और उनका दशन सुख प्राप्त करते हैं। उनकी आयु दस हजार वर्षों की कही गयी है। उन मभहांत्माओं में धर्मांधमं की कुछ भी विशेषता नहीं है । वे स्वभावतः संत्यवक्ता और अईहसक होते हैं। वे सब भक्तिपूर्वक प्रतिदिन देव-देव शंकर और परम बैष्णवी गौरी देवी की पूजा-अर्चा और नमस्कार किया करते हैं ।३ ६-३८।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that flame we two were surprised. By that splendour all the waters sparkled.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that flame we two were surprised. By that splendour all the waters sparkled.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षिप्य तानि चास्थीनि यत्र दीर्घतपा ययौ । सकुटुम्बो विमानस्थः स्वर्गतस् त्वं तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: prakṣipya tāni cāsthīni yatra dīrghatapā yayau / sakuṭumbo vimānasthaḥ svargatas tvaṃ tathā kuru
verses.translation: When that excessively surprising and mysterious flame began to increase in size, Brahma and I hastened towards that
verses.hindi: श्री बायुमहापुराण का भुवनविन्यास नामक तैंतालीसवाँ अध्याय समाप्त सूतजी बोले--भंद्राध्ववासियों का धह स्वाभाविक वर्णन हमने यथार्थ रूप से कर दिया। अंब॑ क्रेतुमाल देसवासियों का बर्णन विस्तार से सुनिये  पश्चिम दिग्वर्ती महात्मा निषधाचल से परदिचम सं म्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: When that excessively surprising and mysterious flame began to increase in size, Brahma and I hastened towards that
verses.commentary: Sense: When that excessively surprising and mysterious flame began to increase in size, Brahma and I hastened towards that

verses.sanskrit: एवं देवा वरं दत्त्वा चित्रसेनाय पार्थिव । कुण्डमूर्धनि याम्यायां त्रयो देवास् तदा स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ devā varaṃ dattvā citrasenāya pārthiva / kuṇḍamūrdhani yāmyāyāṃ trayo devās tadā sthitāḥ
verses.translation: The massive column of flame stood touchim
verses.hindi: विशाल: कम्बलः कृष्णो जयन्तो हरिपर्वतः ॥ अशोकों वर्धमानश्व सप्तेते कुलपबंताः . ४ तेषां प्रसुतिरन्येषपि पता बहुविस्तराः । कोटिकोटिशता ज्ञेबयाः शतशो5थ सहस्नरशः (३५. तेविमसिल्रा जनपदा नानाजातिसमाकुलाः । नानाप्रकारविज्ञेयास्व्वनेकनूपपालिताः ६ ने नामधेयेविक्वान्ता विविधाः प्रथिता भुवि । अध्यासिता जनपदेः कीतंनेश्व विभूषिताः ३७
verses.wordMeaning: The massive column of flame stood touchim
verses.commentary: Sense: The massive column of flame stood touchim

verses.sanskrit: परस्परं वदन्त्येवं पुण्यतीर्थमिदं परम् । यथा हि गयाशिरः पुण्यं पूर्वमेव पठ्यते । तथा रेवातटे पुण्यं शूलभेदं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: parasparaṃ vadantyevaṃ puṇyatīrthamidaṃ param / yathā hi gayāśiraḥ puṇyaṃ pūrvameva paṭhyate / tathā revātaṭe puṇyaṃ śūlabhedaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Who can reach the limits of this terrible looking Linga, the cause of Mantra (Vedas), which was piercing through the heaven and the earth?
verses.hindi: यथेह कथिताः पौरा गोमनुष्यकपोतका:  तत्सुखा भ्रमरा यूथा माहेयावलकूटका: ६ सुमौलाः स्तावका: क़रोचाः कृष्णाज्रमणिपुञजका: । कूठटक म्ब॒लमौषीया:ः समुद्रान्तरकास्तथा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Who can reach the limits of this terrible looking Linga, the cause of Mantra (Vedas), which was piercing through the heaven and the earth?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who can reach the limits of this terrible looking Linga, the cause of Mantra (Vedas), which was piercing through the heaven and the earth?

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: इदं तीर्थं तथा पुण्यं यथा पुण्यं गयाशिरः । सकृत्पिण्डोदकेनैव नरो निर्मलतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: idaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ yathā puṇyaṃ gayāśiraḥ / sakṛtpiṇḍodakenaiva naro nirmalatāṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Then Brahma told me 3 "You go down cautiously. Let us know the limits of this Linga, the great Atman.
verses.hindi: अत्याकरालगोज्वाला हीनाना वनपातका: । महिवाः कुमुदाभाश्व करवाटाः सहोत्कचाः १२
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma told me 3 "You go down cautiously. Let us know the limits of this Linga, the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma told me 3 "You go down cautiously. Let us know the limits of this Linga, the great Atman.

verses.sanskrit: एकं गयाशिरो मुक्त्वा सर्वतीर्थानि भूपते । शूलभेदस्य तीर्थस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ gayāśiro muktvā sarvatīrthāni bhūpate / śūlabhedasya tīrthasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: I shall go up as far as the limit is reached". Thus we came to an agreement and went up and down. Similarly Brahma too was exhausted. He could not see the limit. There itself in that great expanse of water, Brahma met me again.
verses.hindi: कुबेरा धूमजा जहगा वडगा राजीवकोकिलाः । वाचाहगाश्य महाज़ाश्न मधौरेयाः सुरेचकाः पित्तला: काचलाश्चेव श्रवणा मत्तकासिकाः  गोदावा वकुला वाद्धा वडःगकामोदकाः कलाः
verses.wordMeaning: I shall go up as far as the limit is reached". Thus we came to an agreement and went up and down. Similarly Brahma too was exhausted. He could not see the limit. There itself in that great expanse of water, Brahma met me again.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall go up as far as the limit is reached". Thus we came to an agreement and went up and down. Similarly Brahma too was exhausted. He could not see the limit. There itself in that great expanse of water, Brahma met me again.

verses.sanskrit: कुण्डम् उदीच्यां याम्यायां दशहस्तप्रमाणतः । रौद्रवारुणकाष्ठायां प्रमाणं चैकविंशति
verses.transliteration: kuṇḍam udīcyāṃ yāmyāyāṃ daśahastapramāṇataḥ / raudravāruṇakāṣṭhāyāṃ pramāṇaṃ caikaviṃśati
verses.translation: Both of us were surprised. We were deluded by the Maya of that great Atman. We stood there (as if) we had lost our consciousness.
verses.hindi: दिशाओं में जो सात कुलपव॑त, नदियाँ और देश आदि हैं, उनका वर्णन विस्तार पूर्वक सुनिये (१०३) विशाल, कंबल, कृष्ण, जयन्त, हरिपवंत, अद्योक और वर्धमान ये सात कुल पव॑त हैं।४। इनसे उत्पन्न अनेकानेक सेकड़ों, हजारों और करोड़ों बड़े बड़े पवेत वहाँ भी हैं। इन पव॑तों से युक्त क्रितने ही देश हैं, जहाँ विविध प्रकार की जातियाँ बसी हुई हैं और जिनका पालन अनेक राजओं द्वारा हो रहा है। स्वनाम घन्य बलपराक्रमशाली अनेक
verses.wordMeaning: Both of us were surprised. We were deluded by the Maya of that great Atman. We stood there (as if) we had lost our consciousness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both of us were surprised. We were deluded by the Maya of that great Atman. We stood there (as if) we had lost our consciousness.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्प्रमाणं तत्तीर्थं पिण्डदानादिकर्मसु । नाधर्मनिरता दातुं लभन्ते दानमत्र हि
verses.transliteration: etatpramāṇaṃ tattīrthaṃ piṇḍadānādikarmasu / nādharmaniratā dātuṃ labhante dānamatra hi
verses.translation: We bowed to the Lord engaged in meditation—the Lord who is the source of origin and the cause of (destruction) of all the worlds. With palms joined in reverence Brahma (and I) paid obeisance to the trident-bearing Sarva (Siva), the unmanifest, the mighty god of terrible roar and a frightening form having curved fangs.
verses.hindi: जनपदवासियों के वे देश सुशोभित और बसे हुए हैं; अतः वे संसार में प्रसिद्ध हैं। पर्वतों के बीच के सम-विषम स्थानों में स्थित वहाँ से विविध देशों के नाम इस प्रकार कहे गये हैं ।५-८०३। सुख, अमर, यूथ के माहेय, सुवर्णकटक. शुभ, र्वेतांग, ई८्णापद, विह कपिलकर्णिक, अन्‍्याकराल, गोज्वाल, हीनान, वनपातक, महिव, कुमुदाभ, सहोत्कच, शुकनासा, महानास्त, वनास, गजभूमिक, करंज, मंजम, वाह, किष्किण्डी, पाण्डुभूमिक, कुबेर, धमज, जंग, वंग राजीव-कोकिल, वाचांग, महांग, मधौरेय, सुरेचक, पित्तल, काचल, श्रवण, मत्तकासिक, गोदाब, वकुल, वांग, वंगकामोद और कला । ये देश गो, मनुष्य कपोतों से यानी चतुष्पद द्विपद और पक्षियों
verses.wordMeaning: We bowed to the Lord engaged in meditation—the Lord who is the source of origin and the cause of (destruction) of all the worlds. With palms joined in reverence Brahma (and I) paid obeisance to the trident-bearing Sarva (Siva), the unmanifest,…
verses.commentary: Sense: We bowed to the Lord engaged in meditation—the Lord who is the source of origin and the cause of (destruction) of all the worlds. With palms joined in reverence Brahma (and I) paid obeisance to the trident-bearing Sarva (Siva), the unmanifest,…

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुस्तु पितृरूपेण ब्रह्मरूपी पितामहः । प्रपितामहो रुद्रो ऽभूदेवं त्रिपुरुषाः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇustu pitṛrūpeṇa brahmarūpī pitāmahaḥ / prapitāmaho rudro 'bhūdevaṃ tripuruṣāḥ sthitāḥ
verses.translation: "O lord of the worlds and Devas, obeisance be to you. O great lord of Bhutas, obeisance be to you. Hail to you, O external one, the cause of origin of the Siddhas. O lord, the support of the universe, obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: टटमर्ध तास्ति ग. पस्तके । + धनुश्थचित्वान्तगंतग्रन्थों घ. पुस्तके नास्ति।
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord of the worlds and Devas, obeisance be to you. O great lord of Bhutas, obeisance be to you. Hail to you, O external one, the cause of origin of the Siddhas. O lord, the support of the universe, obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord of the worlds and Devas, obeisance be to you. O great lord of Bhutas, obeisance be to you. Hail to you, O external one, the cause of origin of the Siddhas. O lord, the support of the universe, obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: कदा पश्यति तीर्थं वै कदा नस्तारयिष्यति । इति प्रतीक्षां कुर्वन्ति पुत्राणां सततं नृप । शूलभेदे नरः स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वा शूलधरं सकृत्
verses.transliteration: kadā paśyati tīrthaṃ vai kadā nastārayiṣyati / iti pratīkṣāṃ kurvanti putrāṇāṃ satataṃ nṛpa / śūlabhede naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā śūladharaṃ sakṛt
verses.translation: You are the great Brahman, the Supreme Lord and the imperishable. You are the great region and the excellent Vamadeva. You are Lord Rudra, Siva and Skanda. You are Yajna (Sacrifice), Vasatkara, Omkara, the great goal. You are Svahakara and Namaskara. You are the purifier of all sacred rites.
verses.hindi: कम्बलां तामसीं श्यामां सुमेधां बकुलां नदीम् । विकीर्णा शिखिमालां च तथा दर्भावतीमपि भद्रानदीं शुकनदों पलाशां च महानदीम् । भीमां प्रभञ्जनां काओं पुण्यां चच कुशावतीमू
verses.wordMeaning: You are the great Brahman, the Supreme Lord and the imperishable. You are the great region and the excellent Vamadeva. You are Lord Rudra, Siva and Skanda. You are Yajna (Sacrifice), Vasatkara, Omkara, the great goal. You are Svahakara and Namaskara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the great Brahman, the Supreme Lord and the imperishable. You are the great region and the excellent Vamadeva. You are Lord Rudra, Siva and Skanda. You are Yajna (Sacrifice), Vasatkara, Omkara, the great goal. You are Svahakara and Namaskara.…

verses.sanskrit: नापुत्रो नाधनो रोगी सप्तजन्मसु जायते । एकविंशतिं पितुः पक्षे मातुश्वैवेकविंशतिम्
verses.transliteration: nāputro nādhano rogī saptajanmasu jāyate / ekaviṃśatiṃ pituḥ pakṣe mātuśvaivekaviṃśatim
verses.translation: You alone are Svadhakara. You are the Mantra for repetition. You are the sacred rites, observances, the Vedas, the worlds and all the Devas.
verses.hindi: नदीं समुद्रमालां च तथा चम्पावतीमपि । एकाक्षां पुष्कलां वाहां सुवर्णा नन्दिनोसपि
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Svadhakara. You are the Mantra for repetition. You are the sacred rites, observances, the Vedas, the worlds and all the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Svadhakara. You are the Mantra for repetition. You are the sacred rites, observances, the Vedas, the worlds and all the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: भार्यापक्षे दशैवेह कुलान्येतानि तारयेत् । शूलभेदवने राजञ्छाकमूलफलैरपि
verses.transliteration: bhāryāpakṣe daśaiveha kulānyetāni tārayet / śūlabhedavane rājañchākamūlaphalairapi
verses.translation: You are the sound (the quality) of Akasa; you are the eternal source of living beings. You are the attribute of smell in You arc the attribute of touch in vayu. You arc the lord Moon in the embodied form. You are the perfect knowl¬ edge in Budha. O lord of Devas, you are the seed in the Prakrti.
verses.hindi: कालिन्दीं चेव पुण्योदां भारतों च महानदीम् । सीतोदापातिकां ब्राह्मीं विशालां च महानदोम् पोवरीं कुम्भकारीं च रुषां चंव्रापगोत्तमाम् । महिषों सानुषीं दण्डां तथा नदनदीं शुभाम् २२ एताश्रान्याश्च पीयन्ते बह्मयों हि सरितोत्तमाः + । देवषिसिद्धचरिताः पुण्योदाः पापहाः शुभाः
verses.wordMeaning: You are the sound (the quality) of Akasa; you are the eternal source of living beings. You are the attribute of smell in You arc the attribute of touch in vayu. You arc the lord Moon in the embodied form. You are the perfect knowl¬ edge in Budha. O lord of Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the sound (the quality) of Akasa; you are the eternal source of living beings. You are the attribute of smell in You arc the attribute of touch in vayu. You arc the lord Moon in the embodied form. You are the perfect knowl¬ edge in Budha. O lord of Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्भोजिते विप्रे कोटीर् भवति भोजिता । पञ्चस्थानेषु यः श्राद्धं कुरुते भक्तिमान् नरः
verses.transliteration: ekasminbhojite vipre koṭīr bhavati bhojitā / pañcasthāneṣu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute bhaktimān naraḥ
verses.translation: O lord, you arc the maker of living beings. You are Kala, Mrtyu, Yam a, the destroyer. You support the three worlds. You alone create them.
verses.hindi: नानाजनपदास्फीतं महापगाविभूषितम् । नानारत्नौघसंपुर्ण नित्य॑ प्रमुदितं शिवम् २४ उदीर्ण धनधान्याद्येनेरवासे: समनन्‍्ततः । संनिविष्टं महाद्वीपं पश्चिम सुकृतात्मनाम् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, you arc the maker of living beings. You are Kala, Mrtyu, Yam a, the destroyer. You support the three worlds. You alone create them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you arc the maker of living beings. You are Kala, Mrtyu, Yam a, the destroyer. You support the three worlds. You alone create them.

verses.sanskrit: कुलानि प्रेतभूतानि सर्वाण्यपि हि तारयेत् । द्विजदेवप्रसादेन पित्ःणां च प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: kulāni pretabhūtāni sarvāṇyapi hi tārayet / dvijadevaprasādena pitḥṇāṃ ca prasādataḥ
verses.translation: By means of your eastern face, you manifest Indra-hood. O lord, by means of your southern face you annihilate the worlds (as Yama). By means of the western face you exhibit your Varuna- hood. Your Moon-hood is established by means of your northern face.
verses.hindi: निसगः केतुमालानामेष वः परिकीरतितः २५ इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते भुवनविन्यासों नाम चतुश्चत्वा रिशो5्ष्यायः ।॥॥४४।॥।
verses.wordMeaning: By means of your eastern face, you manifest Indra-hood. O lord, by means of your southern face you annihilate the worlds (as Yama). By means of the western face you exhibit your Varuna- hood. Your Moon-hood is established by means of your northern face.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of your eastern face, you manifest Indra-hood. O lord, by means of your southern face you annihilate the worlds (as Yama). By means of the western face you exhibit your Varuna- hood. Your Moon-hood is established by means of your northern face.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धदो निवसेत् तत्र यत्र देवो महेश्वरः । स्युरात्मघातिनो ये च गोब्राह्मणहनाश्च ये
verses.transliteration: śrāddhado nivaset tatra yatra devo maheśvaraḥ / syurātmaghātino ye ca gobrāhmaṇahanāśca ye
verses.translation: OLord having the lustre of ten thousand suns, obeis¬ ance be to you. Bow to you, O Lord having the lustre of thou¬ sand moons. Hail to you, O Lord assuming the form of a moun- tam. Obeisance to you, O reservoir of all good qualities
verses.hindi: से परिपूर्ण हैं ।8-१५॥ यहाँ के भाग्यशाली लोग विज्ञाल पव॑तों से उत्पन्न पवित्र सलिला, सुतट वाली महा- नदियों का जल पिया करते हैं ।१६। उन नदियों के ताम ये हैं-कंवला, तामसी, द्यामा, सुमेघा, वकुला, विकीर्णा शिखिमाला, दर्भावती, भद्रानदी, शुकनदी, पलाशा, महानदी, भीमा, प्रभंजना, कोची, पुण्या,
verses.wordMeaning: OLord having the lustre of ten thousand suns, obeis¬ ance be to you. Bow to you, O Lord having the lustre of thou¬ sand moons. Hail to you, O Lord assuming the form of a moun- tam. Obeisance to you, O reservoir of all good qualities
verses.commentary: Sense: OLord having the lustre of ten thousand suns, obeis¬ ance be to you. Bow to you, O Lord having the lustre of thou¬ sand moons. Hail to you, O Lord assuming the form of a moun- tam. Obeisance to you, O reservoir of all good qualities

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्रिभिर् जलपाते च विद्युत्पातेषु ये मृताः । न येषाम् अग्निसंस्कारो नाशौचं नोदकक्रिया
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭribhir jalapāte ca vidyutpāteṣu ye mṛtāḥ / na yeṣām agnisaṃskāro nāśaucaṃ nodakakriyā
verses.translation: Obeisance be to you, O gold-complexioned Lord. Hail to vou, O gold-wombed Lord. Obeisance be to you, O Lord with gold bark-garments. Obeisance be to you, O lord, the bestower of gold. Obeisance be to you e O Lord with golden necklace. Obeisance be to you, O Lord roaring terrifically.
verses.hindi: एकाक्षा, पुृष्कला वाहा, सुवर्णा, नन्दिनी, कालिन्दी, पृण्योदा, भारती, नदी सीतोदा पातिका, ब्राह्मी. महानदी विशाला, पीवरी, कंभकारी, रुषा, महिषी, दण्डा और नदनदी इन नदियों का तथा अन्यान्य श्रेष्ठ नदियों का जल वहाँ के लोग पिया करते हैं । ये नदियाँ पवित्र जलवाहिनी शुभकारक, पाप विनाशिनी और देव- देवषियों द्वारा सेवित हैं !७-२३। वह पश्चिम दिग्वर्ती महाहवीप केतुमाल धन-धान्यों से परिपूर्ण, सत्कर्म करने वाले नरनारियों से व्याप्त, उदार, विविध देशों से मनोहर महानदियों से विभूषित, नाना रत्न से समृद्ध, सदा आनन्द मय और नित्य मंगलकारक है। केतुमालवासियों का उपर्य॑क्त चरित्र वर्णन जो कि अभी आप लोगों को सुनाया गया है स्वभावसिद्ध है ।२४-२५॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be to you, O gold-complexioned Lord. Hail to vou, O gold-wombed Lord. Obeisance be to you, O Lord with gold bark-garments. Obeisance be to you, O lord, the bestower of gold. Obeisance be to you e O Lord with golden necklace. Obeisance be to you,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be to you, O gold-complexioned Lord. Hail to vou, O gold-wombed Lord. Obeisance be to you, O Lord with gold bark-garments. Obeisance be to you, O lord, the bestower of gold. Obeisance be to you e O Lord with golden necklace. Obeisance be to you,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यस्तेषां श्राद्धं कुर्वीत भक्तितः । मोक्षावाप्तिर् भवेत् तेषां युगमेकं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yasteṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ kurvīta bhaktitaḥ / mokṣāvāptir bhavet teṣāṃ yugamekaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance be to you, OLord of terrific speed. Bow to you, O Sankara, O blue-throated one. Obeisance be to you, O Lord with a thousand arms. Hail to you, O Lord, fond of dance and playing on instruments."
verses.hindi: घनुश्चित्नान्तगंतग्रन्थो ध. पुस्तके नास्ति। + भार्षो5यं पाठः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be to you, OLord of terrific speed. Bow to you, O Sankara, O blue-throated one. Obeisance be to you, O Lord with a thousand arms. Hail to you, O Lord, fond of dance and playing on instruments."
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be to you, OLord of terrific speed. Bow to you, O Sankara, O blue-throated one. Obeisance be to you, O Lord with a thousand arms. Hail to you, O Lord, fond of dance and playing on instruments."

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानाद् यत्कृतं पापं बालभावाच्च यत्कृतम् । तत्सर्वं नाशयेत् पापं स्नानमात्रेण भूपते
verses.transliteration: ajñānād yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bālabhāvācca yatkṛtam / tatsarvaṃ nāśayet pāpaṃ snānamātreṇa bhūpate
verses.translation: On being eulogised thus, the lord, the great Yogin of great intellect, became manifest. He had the lustre equal to that of a crore suns. Then the delighted Mahadeva, appeared worthy of being addressed. He seemed to be devouring the sky with his thousands and crores of mouths, though he had only a single neck and a single mass of hair. He was bedecked in different kinds of ornaments. His body looked wonderful and variegated. He wore different (kinds of) garlands and (besmeared himself) with unguents. He held Pinaka bow in his hand. The Lord wielding a spear was seated on a bull. He wore the hide of a black antelope. He assumed a terrible form with a skull in his hand. Wearing a serpent for the sacred thread, he offered pro¬ tection to Devas. He laughed boisterously producing sound like a kettle-drum and the rumbling cloud wherewith the sky was reverberated.
verses.hindi: सर्वेतुंकामदाः सत्त्वा जरादुर्गन्धवर्जिता:। शुक्लाभिजनसंपन्नाः सर्वे च॒ प्रियदर्शनाः है उत्तरेण तु श्वेतस्थ शुद्धसाह्नस्य दक्षिणे । वर्ष हिरण्वतं नाम यत्र हैरण्वली नदी ३६
verses.wordMeaning: On being eulogised thus, the lord, the great Yogin of great intellect, became manifest. He had the lustre equal to that of a crore suns. Then the delighted Mahadeva, appeared worthy of being addressed. He seemed to be devouring the sky with his thousands and crores of mouths,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On being eulogised thus, the lord, the great Yogin of great intellect, became manifest. He had the lustre equal to that of a crore suns. Then the delighted Mahadeva, appeared worthy of being addressed. He seemed to be devouring the sky with his thousands and crores of mouths,…

verses.sanskrit: रजकेन यथा धौतं वस्त्रं भवति निर्मलम् । तथा पापो ऽपि तत्तीर्थे स्नातो भवति निर्मलः
verses.transliteration: rajakena yathā dhautaṃ vastraṃ bhavati nirmalam / tathā pāpo 'pi tattīrthe snāto bhavati nirmalaḥ
verses.translation: At that loud sound of the great Atman, we became frightened. Then the great Yogin said: cc O excellent Devas, I am greatly delighted.
verses.hindi: शांशपायन बोले--हे महाराज ! आपने पूर्व और पद्िचम दिशा के दो देशों का वर्णन किया । अब उत्तर तथा दक्षिण दिशा के देशों का और वहाँ के पर्वतों पर रहने वाले लोगों का क्रमदय: पूर्णहप से वर्णन कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: At that loud sound of the great Atman, we became frightened. Then the great Yogin said: cc O excellent Devas, I am greatly delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that loud sound of the great Atman, we became frightened. Then the great Yogin said: cc O excellent Devas, I am greatly delighted.

verses.sanskrit: संन्यासं कुरुते यो ऽत्र तीर्थे विधिसमन्वितम् । ध्यायन् नित्यं महादेवं स गच्छेत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yo 'tra tīrthe vidhisamanvitam / dhyāyan nityaṃ mahādevaṃ sa gacchet paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Both of you, see this Maya. Give up fear. Both of you are born of my body. You are ancient and former beings. This Brahma, grandfather of the worlds, is my right arm. Visnu is my left arm. He always stands by me in times of war. I am delighted with you. I shall grant whatever you desire."
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--इवेत पर्वत के दक्षिण और नील पंत के उत्तर रमणक नामक एक देश है। वहाँ जो मनुष्य उत्पन्न होते हैं वे सभी अनुकूल कामफल का उपयोग करते हैं। वे बूढ़े नहीं होते न तो उनके शरीर से दुर्गग्ध निकलती है। उनका परिवार भी विशुद्ध होता और वे स्वयं सुन्दर होते हैं ।२-३॥ वहां रोहिण नामक एक महान् और दिव्य वट वृक्ष है, जिसके फलों के रस को पीकर वहाँ के निवासी जीवन धारण करते हैं। वे महाभाग्यशाली नरभ्रंष्ठ सदा श्रसन्न रहते हैं भौर दस हजार दस सो पाँच वर्ष को आयु के होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Both of you, see this Maya. Give up fear. Both of you are born of my body. You are ancient and former beings. This Brahma, grandfather of the worlds, is my right arm. Visnu is my left arm. He always stands by me in times of war. I am delighted with you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Both of you, see this Maya. Give up fear. Both of you are born of my body. You are ancient and former beings. This Brahma, grandfather of the worlds, is my right arm. Visnu is my left arm. He always stands by me in times of war. I am delighted with you.…

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडित्वा स यथाकामं स्वेच्छया शिवमन्दिरे । वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो जायते ऽसौ शुभे कुले
verses.transliteration: krīḍitvā sa yathākāmaṃ svecchayā śivamandire / vedavedāṅgatattvajño jāyate 'sau śubhe kule
verses.translation: Then both of us were delighted in the mind. We fell at his feet again. Then we, the pious great souls, spoke again.
verses.hindi: इरवेताचल के उत्तर और श्रृंगाचल के दक्षिण हिरण्वत नामक एक देश है, जहाँ हैरण्वती नदी बहती है। वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: Then both of us were delighted in the mind. We fell at his feet again. Then we, the pious great souls, spoke again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then both of us were delighted in the mind. We fell at his feet again. Then we, the pious great souls, spoke again.

verses.sanskrit: रूपवान्सुभगश्चैव सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः । राजा वा राजपुत्रो वाचारसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: rūpavānsubhagaścaiva sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ / rājā vā rājaputro vācārasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: "If you are pleased and if boons are to be bestowed on us, O Lord of Devas, let there be devotion in us for you." "O blessed ones, may it be thus. Both of you create different kinds of subjects". After saying thus the Lord vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: महाबला: सुतेजस्का जायन्ते तत्र मानवाः । सबंतुकासदाः सत््वा धनिनः प्रियदर्शनाः १७ एकादश सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तेडमितोजसः । आयुष्प्रमाणं जीवन्ति शतानि दश पन्च च ८ सर्वकामफलास्तत्र केचिद्वुक्षा मनोरमा: । गन्धवर्ण रसोपेतं प्रक्षरन्ति मधत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: "If you are pleased and if boons are to be bestowed on us, O Lord of Devas, let there be devotion in us for you." "O blessed ones, may it be thus. Both of you create different kinds of subjects". After saying thus the Lord vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: "If you are pleased and if boons are to be bestowed on us, O Lord of Devas, let there be devotion in us for you." "O blessed ones, may it be thus. Both of you create different kinds of subjects". After saying thus the Lord vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं राजंस्तीर्थस्य फलमुत्तमम् । यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवो नित्यं मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ rājaṃstīrthasya phalamuttamam / yacchrutvā mānavo nityaṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the great power of that Yogin has been narrated to you. All this has been created by him. We are only nominal causes.
verses.hindi: सर्वा सणिमयी भूमिः सुक्ष्षकाय्नवालुका । सवंतः सुखसंस्पर्शा निष्पद्धा नीरुजा शुभा
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great power of that Yogin has been narrated to you. All this has been created by him. We are only nominal causes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great power of that Yogin has been narrated to you. All this has been created by him. We are only nominal causes.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं श्रावयेन् नित्यमाख्यानं द्विजपुंगवान् । श्राद्धे देवकुले वापि पठेत्पर्व्णि पर्व्णि
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śrāvayen nityamākhyānaṃ dvijapuṃgavān / śrāddhe devakule vāpi paṭhetparvṇi parvṇi
verses.translation: This form termed 'Siva' is unknown and unmanifest. It is incomprehensible and unpcrceivable. Persons with intellectual vision alone can perceive it. . Perform obeisance to that Lord of Devas by whose grace persons with intellectual vision can perceive subtle and incomprehensible tilings.
verses.hindi: देवलोकाच्च्युतास्तनत्र जायन्ते मानवाः शुभा: । शुक्लाभिजनसंपन्नाः सर्वे च स्थिययौवनाः. के लोग महावली, तेजस्वी, जीवट के धनी, सुरूप और सभी ऋतुओं में समान काम फल का उपभोग करनेवाले हैं । वहाँ के पराक्रमी लोग ग्यारह हजार दस सौ पाँच वर्ष की आयु तक जीवित रहते हैं ।६-८। उस देश में छवों रसों से युक्त बड़हर का एक महान् व॒क्ष है। वहाँ के मानव उसी के फल के रस को पीकर जीते हैं । वहाँ श्ंगवान् गिरि के तीन बड़े और ऊंचे शख्ज़ हैं, जिनमें एक मणि का है, दूसरा सोने का और तीसरा
verses.wordMeaning: This form termed 'Siva' is unknown and unmanifest. It is incomprehensible and unpcrceivable. Persons with intellectual vision alone can perceive it. .…
verses.commentary: Sense: This form termed 'Siva' is unknown and unmanifest. It is incomprehensible and unpcrceivable. Persons with intellectual vision alone can perceive it. .…

verses.sanskrit: गीर्वाणास्तस्य तुष्यन्ति मनुष्याः पितृभिः सह । पठतां शृण्वतां चैव नश्यते सर्वपातकम्
verses.transliteration: gīrvāṇāstasya tuṣyanti manuṣyāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva naśyate sarvapātakam
verses.translation: O Mahadeva, obeisance be to you. O Mahesvara, obeisance be to you. O most excellent one among Devas and Asuras, U swan of the mind, obeisance be to you."
verses.hindi: भाँति-भाँति के रत्नों से भरा है। उन पर महल भी बने हुए हैं ।९-१०। उत्तर समुद्र के अन्त में दक्षिण ओर सिद्धों से सेवित पुष्य शाली कुरुअषे है। वहाँ के व॒क्षों में मीठे फल लगे रहते और फल खिले रहते हैं । वे वृक्ष फलों के साथ-साथ वस्त्र और भूषण भी दिया करते हैं ।११-१२। कितने ही मनोहर वृक्ष तो वहाँ सभी कामनाओं को पूर्ण करने वाले हैं और सुगन्धित मनोहर मधु टपकाते रहते हैं  दूध देने वाले भी वहाँ दूसरे
verses.wordMeaning: O Mahadeva, obeisance be to you. O Mahesvara, obeisance be to you. O most excellent one among Devas and Asuras, U swan of the mind, obeisance be to you."
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mahadeva, obeisance be to you. O Mahesvara, obeisance be to you. O most excellent one among Devas and Asuras, U swan of the mind, obeisance be to you."

verses.sanskrit: लिखित्वा तीर्थमाहात्म्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददाति यः । जातिस्मरत्वं लभते प्राप्नोत्यभिमतं फलम्
verses.transliteration: likhitvā tīrthamāhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadāti yaḥ / jātismaratvaṃ labhate prāpnotyabhimataṃ phalam
verses.translation: On hearing this, Devas paid homage to the great Atman, Siva and went to their abodes. He who recites this hymn of Is vara, the great Atman, obtains all desires and becomes free from sins.
verses.hindi: वृक्ष हैं, जो देखने में मनोहर हैं और सदा अमृत तुल्य षड्रसमय दूध बहाया करते हैं। वहाँ की भूमि मणियों से युक्त है. जहाँ सोने की बालू बिखरी रहती है। कीचड़ का कहीं पता नहीं है। कहीं पर धलि का पता नहीं, धरातल छुने पर अत्यन्त कोमल जान पड़ता है। देवलोक से च्युत होने पर ही वहाँ मानव जन्म ग्रहण करते हैं। वहाँ भी चिर युवक और शुद्ध परिवार वाले हैं ।३-१६। वहाँ की सुन्दर नारियाँ जुड़वा सन्‍्तान पंदा करती हैं, जो दूध-वृक्ष के अमृततुल्य दूध को पिया करते हैं । वहाँ वाले जुड़वा जनमते हैं साथ हीं बढ़ते, स्वभाव-रूप में भी एक से होते है और साथ ही मरते भी हैं। वे रोग-शोक से रहित होकर सदा सुखी रहते
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this, Devas paid homage to the great Atman, Siva and went to their abodes. He who recites this hymn of Is vara, the great Atman, obtains all desires and becomes free from sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this, Devas paid homage to the great Atman, Siva and went to their abodes. He who recites this hymn of Is vara, the great Atman, obtains all desires and becomes free from sins.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोके वसेत् तावद् यावद् अक्षरम् अन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: rudraloke vaset tāvad yāvad akṣaram anvitam
verses.translation: All this in respect to the ancient Brahman was men¬ tioned by the mighty Visnu only due to the grace of Mahadeva. Everything in respect of the power of Mahesvara has been thus recounted to you.
verses.hindi: अस्योन्यमनुरक्ताश्व चक्वाकसर्धाभण:। अनामया ह्यशोकाश्च नित्यं सुखनिषेविणः
verses.wordMeaning: All this in respect to the ancient Brahman was men¬ tioned by the mighty Visnu only due to the grace of Mahadeva. Everything in respect of the power of Mahesvara has been thus recounted to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: All this in respect to the ancient Brahman was men¬ tioned by the mighty Visnu only due to the grace of Mahadeva. Everything in respect of the power of Mahesvara has been thus recounted to you.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शूलभेदमाहात्म्ये काशीराजमोक्षगमनं नाम पञ्चपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ५६ उत्तानपाद उवाच: अन्यच्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि केन गङ्गावतारिता । रुद्रशीर्षे स्थिता देवी पुण्या कथमिहागता
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye kāśīrājamokṣagamanaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 56 uttānapāda uvāca: anyacca śrotumicchāmi kena gaṅgāvatāritā / rudraśīrṣe sthitā devī puṇyā kathamihāgatā
verses.translation: O Samsapayana, I shall now recount to you the super¬ human power of (Pururavas), the son of Ila. I shall mention how he contacted with the Sun and the noblc-souled Moon.
verses.hindi: दिश्लु सर्वासु यद्यत्र कीत्यंमानं विबोधत (२१ अनेककन्दरदरीगुहानिर्भरसण्डितो । नेककुञ्जवनोपेतो चित्रधातुविभुषितों अनेकधातुकलिलो सर्वधातुविभुषितों । पुष्पमुलफलोपेतो सिद्धचारणसेवितों
verses.wordMeaning: O Samsapayana, I shall now recount to you the super¬ human power of (Pururavas), the son of Ila. I shall mention how he contacted with the Sun and the noblc-souled Moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Samsapayana, I shall now recount to you the super¬ human power of (Pururavas), the son of Ila. I shall mention how he contacted with the Sun and the noblc-souled Moon.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्या देवाशिला नाम तस्या माहात्म्यम् उत्तमम् । एतदाख्याहि मे सर्वं प्रसन्नो यदि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: puṇyā devāśilā nāma tasyā māhātmyam uttamam / etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasanno yadi śaṅkara
verses.translation: I shall mention all these things in order—the increase and decrease of the Moon consisting of the essence of the waters during the bright and the dark halves of the month, the fixation (decision) about the fortnight dedicated to Pitrs, the acqui¬ sition of nectar from the Moon, the Tarpana offerings to Pitis, the vision of the Pitrs who had extracted the Soma juice from the Kavya fire, and how Pururavas, the son of Ila, propitiated Pitrs. I shall mention the Parvans also (all in due order).
verses.hindi: चन्द्रकान्तश्व॒ शैलश्र सुयंकान्तश्व सानुमान् । ययोसेध्येन सा याता भव्रीसीभा महानदी ३२५ सहुस्नशश््व नद्योइन्याः प्रसन्नसुरसोदकाः । पर्याप्तोदा: कुरूणां हि स्‍्नानपानावगाहनः
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention all these things in order—the increase and decrease of the Moon consisting of the essence of the waters during the bright and the dark halves of the month, the fixation (decision) about the fortnight dedicated to Pitrs, the acqui¬ sition of nectar from the Moon,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention all these things in order—the increase and decrease of the Moon consisting of the essence of the waters during the bright and the dark halves of the month, the fixation (decision) about the fortnight dedicated to Pitrs, the acqui¬ sition of nectar from the Moon,…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा यथा गङ्गावतारिता । देवैः सर्वैर्महाभागा सर्वलोकहिताय वै
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā yathā gaṅgāvatāritā / devaiḥ sarvairmahābhāgā sarvalokahitāya vai
verses.translation: When both the Moon and the Sun come into conjunction with the same constellation, on the same night, in the same orbit, it shall be known as Amavasya (the New Moon).
verses.hindi: नानावर्णप्रकाराणि पुष्पाणि च सहस्नशः । उपभोगसहस्नाणि भद्राणि च सहान्ति च हैं और आपस में उसी प्रकार अनुरक्त रहते हैं, जंसे चकवा-चकई। वहाँ बालों को पराई स्त्री की चाह नही रहती है । वे महाबली तेरह हजार दस सौ पाँच वर्ष तक जीवित रहते है ।१७-२०। शलराज जादरधि के उत्तर जो उत्तर कुरु है, उसका वर्णन विस्तार से सुनिये । यह उत्तर कुरु सभी दिल्लाओं में प्रसिद्ध हैं। वहाँ बड़े ऊँचे-ऊँचे दो कुल पर्वत हैं, जो अनेक कन्दराओ, दरियों, गृहाओं और झरनों से मण्डित हैं, अनेक कुज और
verses.wordMeaning: When both the Moon and the Sun come into conjunction with the same constellation, on the same night, in the same orbit, it shall be known as Amavasya (the New Moon).
verses.commentary: Sense: When both the Moon and the Sun come into conjunction with the same constellation, on the same night, in the same orbit, it shall be known as Amavasya (the New Moon).

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति विन्ध्यो नगो नाम याम्याशायां महीपते । गीर्वाणास्तु गताः सर्वे तस्य मूर्ध्नि नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: asti vindhyo nago nāma yāmyāśāyāṃ mahīpate / gīrvāṇāstu gatāḥ sarve tasya mūrdhni nareśvara
verses.translation: He (Pururavas) used to go to see his maternal and paternal grand-fathers, the Moon and the Sun, on every Amavasya. After making obeisance to them, he used to keep waiting. For the sake of the Pitrs, he used to extract exudation from the de¬ lighted Moon. In every month Pururavas, son of Ila, stayed in the heaven and worshipped the Moon with devotion along with Pitrs.
verses.hindi: बनों से युक्त, विचित्र धातुओं से विभूषित वे अनेक श्रकार की विविध धातुओं से रंजित, पृष्प मूल और फलों से युक्त और सिद्ध चरणों से सुशोभित हैं ।२१-२३॥ उन दोनों पब॑तों के सेकड़ों शिखरों से वह द्वीप शोभित हो रहा है । इन दोनों पवेतों के नाम चन्द्रकान्त और सूर्यकान्त है जिनके बीच से महानदी भद्गसीमा बहती है । और भी वहाँ हजारों नदियाँ हैं। जिनके जल को कुरु देशवासी स्तान-पान आदि के कामों में लाते
verses.wordMeaning: He (Pururavas) used to go to see his maternal and paternal grand-fathers, the Moon and the Sun, on every Amavasya. After making obeisance to them, he used to keep waiting. For the sake of the Pitrs, he used to extract exudation from the de¬ lighted Moon.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He (Pururavas) used to go to see his maternal and paternal grand-fathers, the Moon and the Sun, on every Amavasya. After making obeisance to them, he used to keep waiting. For the sake of the Pitrs, he used to extract exudation from the de¬ lighted Moon.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र चाह्वानिता गङ्गा ब्रह्माद्यैरखिलैः सुरैः । अभ्यर्च्येशं जगन्नाथं देवदेवं जगद्गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: tatra cāhvānitā gaṅgā brahmādyairakhilaiḥ suraiḥ / abhyarcyeśaṃ jagannāthaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum
verses.translation: Pitrs and the Moon partake of the Kavya offerings for two lavas. 1 Worshipping Sinivali 1 during the time of its appearance, Pururavas understood the duration of the new moon called Kuhu and worshipped Kuhu too. 2 Biding his time he used to see the Moon in conjunction with the Sun (.)
verses.hindi: हैं ।२४-२६। इन नदियों में निमंल मीठा जल पर्याप्त मात्रा से भरा रहता है। वेसे भी हजारों महानदियाँ है, जिनमें दूध, मधु, मदिरा ओर घी बहा करता है। दही के सैकड़ों तालाब हैं सुस्वादु अन्नों के पर्वत की तरह ढेर लगे हुये हैं ॥ अमृत की तरह स्वादवाले सुन्दर फल तो भाँति-भाँति के पड़े है। वहाँ गन्ध, वर्ण और रसों से युक्त ऐसे-ऐसे फल मूल हैं, जिनकी सुगन्‍्ध बीस कोस दूर से जान पड़ने लगती है, भाँति-भाँति के रंग बिरंगे हजारों फूल खिले रहते हैं. जो उपभोग के योग्य और महान् कल्याणकारक हैं ।२७-३०। गन्ध, वर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: Pitrs and the Moon partake of the Kavya offerings for two lavas. 1 Worshipping Sinivali 1 during the time of its appearance, Pururavas understood the duration of the new moon called Kuhu and worshipped Kuhu too.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitrs and the Moon partake of the Kavya offerings for two lavas. 1 Worshipping Sinivali 1 during the time of its appearance, Pururavas understood the duration of the new moon called Kuhu and worshipped Kuhu too.…

verses.sanskrit: जटामध्यस्थितां गङ्गां मोचयस्वेति भूतले । भास्वन्ती सा ततो मुक्ता रुद्रेण शिरसा भुवि
verses.transliteration: jaṭāmadhyasthitāṃ gaṅgāṃ mocayasveti bhūtale / bhāsvantī sā tato muktā rudreṇa śirasā bhuvi
verses.translation: Whence will the nectar ooze out from Soma for the satisfaction for a period of a month? It is by (replenishment) for fifteen days (of the bright half) by the flow of nectar. After drinking it in the dark half, it is being milked by the rays with
verses.hindi: महावक्षसह॒ल्लाणि वरेण्यानि स सवंश: । नानाकाराणि वासांसि सुक्ष्माणि सुसुखानि च
verses.wordMeaning: Whence will the nectar ooze out from Soma for the satisfaction for a period of a month? It is by (replenishment) for fifteen days (of the bright half) by the flow of nectar. After drinking it in the dark half, it is being milked by the rays with
verses.commentary: Sense: Whence will the nectar ooze out from Soma for the satisfaction for a period of a month? It is by (replenishment) for fifteen days (of the bright half) by the flow of nectar. After drinking it in the dark half, it is being milked by the rays with

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थाने महापुण्या देवैरुत्पादिता स्वयम् । ततो देवनदी जाता सा हिताय नृणां भुवि
verses.transliteration: tatra sthāne mahāpuṇyā devairutpāditā svayam / tato devanadī jātā sā hitāya nṛṇāṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: L<wa=the 60th part of twinkling of the eye.— MW 898.
verses.hindi: ओर रसों से युक्त तथा सुख स्पशे वहाँ तमाल, अगरु तथा चन्दनों के बन हैं, जहाँ भ्रमर प्रसन्न हो गाते रहते है । प्रफुल्लित वृक्षयुल्म और लताओं से युक्त कितने ही और सुखदायक बन हैं, जहाँ भौंरे गूंजार करते रहते और चिड़ियाँ चहचहाती रहती हैं । ब्राह्मणों  वहाँ हजारों सरोवर हैं. जहाँ असंख्य पद्म और उत्पल के. बन हैं ।११-३३। सभी ऋतुओं में सुख देनेवाली रमणीय विहार भूमि में खाने की वस्तुयें, माला, अनुलेपन, शयन, आसनादि उपभोग सामग्रियाँ प्रस्तुत रहती हैं, मनोहर मुख वाले चित्र-विचित्र पक्षियों का कलरब होता रहता है और वे विहारभूमि अनेक भ्रुणों से युक्त हैं ।३४-३५' बहाँ स्वर्ण और मणियों से परिष्कृत एवं सभी प्रकार से सम्पन्न उद्यान, शिलागृह, वक्षगृहू और श्रेष्ठ कदलीगृह हैं। सभी प्रकार के सख देने वाले कितने ही लतागृह हैं। शट्भू की तरह उज्ज्बल कितने ही भूमिगृह भी हैं, जिनमें सोने और मणियों से चित्र बने हैं
verses.wordMeaning: L<wa=the 60th part of twinkling of the eye.— MW 898.
verses.commentary: Sense: L<wa=the 60th part of twinkling of the eye.— MW 898.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ति ये तटे तस्याः स्नानं कुर्वन्ति भक्तितः । पिबन्ति च जलं नित्यं न ते यान्ति यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: vasanti ye taṭe tasyāḥ snānaṃ kurvanti bhaktitaḥ / pibanti ca jalaṃ nityaṃ na te yānti yamālayam
verses.translation: Verses 9-10 etc. state, Amavasya is of two kinds: (i) when Amavasya
verses.hindi: एवं सोने ओर मणियों को ही खिड़कियाँ हैं । वे भवन भी बड़े-बड़े हैं ।१६-३८। वहाँ बड़े-बड़े हजारों वक्ष, विविध प्रकार के मूल्यवान और सुख पहुंचानेवाले महीन कपड़े हैं। म्ृदद्भ, वेणू, पणव, वीणा आदि बाजे बजते रहते हैं । वहाँ हजारों सकड़ों कल्पवृक्ष हैं, जो इच्छानुसार फल देते हैं ॥१६-४०। सभी जगह उद्यान हैं, सभी जगह नगर हैं, सम्पूर्ण द्वीप आनन्ददायक है, जहाँ सुखी नर-नारी निवास करते हैं। वहाँ वा यु में विविध फूलों की
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 9-10 etc. state, Amavasya is of two kinds: (i) when Amavasya
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 9-10 etc. state, Amavasya is of two kinds: (i) when Amavasya

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सा पतिता कुण्डे शूलभेदे नराधिप । देवनद्याः प्रतीच्यां तु तत्र प्राची सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: yatra sā patitā kuṇḍe śūlabhede narādhipa / devanadyāḥ pratīcyāṃ tu tatra prācī sarasvatī
verses.translation: Rtu (Season) which is spoken of as Agni is considered as Samvatsara, since Rtus are born of it. Artavas (smaller division of time such as a fortnight) are born of Rtus (Seasons).
verses.hindi: रे२२ वायूपुराणम् चन्द्रकान्ता नरवराः श्यामाडुा: पूर्वकूलजा: । श्यामावदाताः सुखिनः सुयंकान्ता वराः प्रजा:
verses.wordMeaning: Rtu (Season) which is spoken of as Agni is considered as Samvatsara, since Rtus are born of it. Artavas (smaller division of time such as a fortnight) are born of Rtus (Seasons).
verses.commentary: Sense: Rtu (Season) which is spoken of as Agni is considered as Samvatsara, since Rtus are born of it. Artavas (smaller division of time such as a fortnight) are born of Rtus (Seasons).

verses.sanskrit: याम्यायां शूलभेदस्य तत्र तीर्थमनुत्तमम् । तत्र देवशिला पुण्या स्वयं देवेन निर्मिता
verses.transliteration: yāmyāyāṃ śūlabhedasya tatra tīrthamanuttamam / tatra devaśilā puṇyā svayaṃ devena nirmitā
verses.translation: Artavas are called half-months. Pitrs are the sons of the year. Rtus are grandfathers. The months and the Rtus are the sons of the year.
verses.hindi: तस्मिन्देशे नराः श्रेष्ठा देवसत्वपराक्रमा: । सदा विहारिणः सर्वे कामवृत्त्या सुब्चंसः
verses.wordMeaning: Artavas are called half-months. Pitrs are the sons of the year. Rtus are grandfathers. The months and the Rtus are the sons of the year.
verses.commentary: Sense: Artavas are called half-months. Pitrs are the sons of the year. Rtus are grandfathers. The months and the Rtus are the sons of the year.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा तु यो भक्त्या तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः । पितरस्तस्य तृप्यन्ति यावद् आभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / pitarastasya tṛpyanti yāvad ābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: Devas are the great-grandfathers. The five years (forming a Yuga) are the sons of Brahma. Saumyas are born of the Moon. Kavyas are the sons ofKavi.
verses.hindi: वलयाइ-गदकेयू रहारकुण्डलमूषिताः । स्नग्विणश्रित्रमुकुटाश्रित्राच्छादनवासस: ४५ न ता: प्रसवधर्मिण्यो न वंशप्रक्षयो विधिः । मिथुन जायते वृक्षादुपक्षमसमनीद्शम्
verses.wordMeaning: Devas are the great-grandfathers. The five years (forming a Yuga) are the sons of Brahma. Saumyas are born of the Moon. Kavyas are the sons ofKavi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas are the great-grandfathers. The five years (forming a Yuga) are the sons of Brahma. Saumyas are born of the Moon. Kavyas are the sons ofKavi.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा तु यो भक्त्या ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेन्नृप । स्वल्पान्नेनापि दत्तेन तस्य चान्तो न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇān bhojayennṛpa / svalpānnenāpi dattena tasya cānto na vidyate
verses.translation: Devas born of Soma, and the imbibers of the Soma juice, are known as Upahutas. The Kavyas are known as Ajyapas. (All) the classes of Pitrs become satisfied thus.
verses.hindi: सामान्यविभवाः सर्वे मसत्वपरिवर्जिताः । न तन्न विद्यते धर्मो नाधर्म: संप्रवतंते ४८ न व्याधिर्न जरा तत्न न दुर्मेधा न च क्लमः । पूर्ण काले विनश्यन्ति जलबुद्बुदबच्च ते ४६ एवमत्यन्तसुखिनः सर्वदुःखबिवर्जिता: । रक्ता धर्म न पश्यन्ति दुःखाद्धमोभिजायते
verses.wordMeaning: Devas born of Soma, and the imbibers of the Soma juice, are known as Upahutas. The Kavyas are known as Ajyapas. (All) the classes of Pitrs become satisfied thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas born of Soma, and the imbibers of the Soma juice, are known as Upahutas. The Kavyas are known as Ajyapas. (All) the classes of Pitrs become satisfied thus.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपाद उवाच: कानि दानानि दत्तानि शस्तानि धरणीतले । यानि दत्त्वा नरो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: uttānapāda uvāca: kāni dānāni dattāni śastāni dharaṇītale / yāni dattvā naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Pitrs are classified into three (only): Kavyas, Barhisads and Agnisvattas. Rtus who are householders and performers of sacrifices are definitely Barhisads. Agni¬ svattas are also householders and performers of sacrifices. They are Artavas. Understand that Kavyas are Atfakdpatis (Lords of Astakas). Now understand the five years.
verses.hindi: सुगन्धि रहती है, जिसके स्पर्श से शरीर में सुख और आलह्लाद उत्पन्न हो जाता है। क्लान्ति नाशक उस द्वीप में स्व से भ्रष्ट होकर मानव जनमते हैं, क्योंकि बह द्वीप उत्तम गुणों के कारण भूमि का स्व्रगम कहलाता है ।४१-४२। पूर्वतट में चन्द्रकान्त पर्वत के निकट रहने वाले नरपुगत्र ध्याम वर्ण के और सूययेकान्त पव॑त के निकट रहने वाले इ्याम-अवदात वर्ण के होते हैं। वहाँ के उत्तम निवासी सदा सूखी रहते हैं। उस देश के श्रेष्ठ मनुष्य देवता की तरह पराक्रमी, तेजस्वी और इच्छाधीन विहार करनेवाले हैं  वलय, अंगद, केयूर, हार, कुण्डल, माला, चित्रकारी किये हुये मुकुट और रंग-बिरंगी चादर पहनने वाले वहाँ के सदा युवक बने रहने वाले लोग हजारों वर्षों तक जीवित रहते हैं  वहाँ की प्रजा देखने में सुन्दर और भली है  प्रजा को न प्रसव होता है और न उनको वंशक्षय होता है; क्योंकि वहाँ के वृक्ष ही नर-नारियों के जोड़े को उतनन्न करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Pitrs are classified into three (only): Kavyas, Barhisads and Agnisvattas. Rtus who are householders and performers of sacrifices are definitely Barhisads. Agni¬ svattas are also householders and performers of sacrifices. They are Artavas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitrs are classified into three (only): Kavyas, Barhisads and Agnisvattas. Rtus who are householders and performers of sacrifices are definitely Barhisads. Agni¬ svattas are also householders and performers of sacrifices. They are Artavas.…

verses.sanskrit: देवशिलाया माहात्म्यं स्नानदानादिजं फलम् । व्रतोपवासनियमैर् यत्प्राप्यं तद्वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: devaśilāyā māhātmyaṃ snānadānādijaṃ phalam / vratopavāsaniyamair yatprāpyaṃ tadvadasva me
verses.translation: Among them Agni is Samvatsara and the Sun is Parival - sara. The Moon is Idvatsara and Vayu is Anuvatsara.
