verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: तया च सत्वरं गत्वा यथावृत्तं निवेदितम् । शबर्युक्तं पुरस्तस्याः सविस्तरपरं वचः
verses.transliteration: tayā ca satvaraṃ gatvā yathāvṛttaṃ niveditam / śabaryuktaṃ purastasyāḥ savistaraparaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: सतजी बोले--हिमालय के वाम पादइव में क्लास नामक पर्वत है। वहाँ श्रीम।न् कुबेर राक्षसों के साथ निवास करते हैं। अलकाधिपति वहाँ अप्सराओं के साथ आमोद किया करते हैं ।१। कलास पर्वत के पाद देश से शरत्॒कालीन मेघ के समान पवित्र, सुखद शीतल कुमुदों से युक्त मन्द नामक जल उत्पन्न होता है ।२। उससे दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा राज्ञी तत्र स्वयं गता । उवाच शबरीं प्रीत्या देहि पद्मानि मूल्यतः
verses.transliteration: tasyāstu vacanaṃ śrutvā rājñī tatra svayaṃ gatā / uvāca śabarīṃ prītyā dehi padmāni mūlyataḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: प्रागुत्तरेण केलासाहिव्यसत्त्वोषध गिरिम् । सुरधातुमयं चित्र सुवर्ण पव॑तं प्रति ४ पुण्या मन्दाकिनों चेव निम्नगाच्छोदिका तथा। महोमण्डलमध्येन प्रविष्टे ते महोदधिम् ८ कैलासाइक्षिणप्राच्यां शिवसत्त्वौर्षाध गुरुप । मनःशिलामयं दिव्यं पिशज्भ परवेतं प्रति ३९
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: शबर्युवाच: न मूल्यं कामये देवि फलपुष्पसमुद्भवम् । श्रीफलानि च पुष्पाणि यथेष्टं मम गृह्यताम्
verses.transliteration: śabaryuvāca: na mūlyaṃ kāmaye devi phalapuṣpasamudbhavam / śrīphalāni ca puṣpāṇi yatheṣṭaṃ mama gṛhyatām
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्पुण्यः प्रभवति लौहित्यः सदनो महान्। देवारण्यं विशोक॑ च तस्य तीरे महावनम् ११
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चां कुरु यथान्यायं वासुदेवे जगत्पतौ
verses.transliteration: arcāṃ kuru yathānyāyaṃ vāsudeve jagatpatau
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: कंलासाहक्षिणे पाश्वें क्रसत्वौषधं गिरिम् । वृत्रकायात्किलोत्पन्नमज्जनं त्रिककुं प्रति ११३ सर्वंधातुमयस्तत्र सुमहान्वेद्युतोी गिरिः । तस्य पादे सरः पुण्य मानस सिद्धसेवितम् और शुभावह मन्दाकिनी नाम की नदी उत्पन्न होती है । उसी के किनारे नन्‍्दन नाम का एक दिव्य महावन है
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञ्युवाच: विना मूल्यं न गृह्णामि कमलानि तवाधुना । धान्यस्य खारिकामेकां ददामि प्रतिगृह्यताम्
verses.transliteration: rājñyuvāca: vinā mūlyaṃ na gṛhṇāmi kamalāni tavādhunā / dhānyasya khārikāmekāṃ dadāmi pratigṛhyatām
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: केलाश के पूरंब-उत्तर ओर दिव्य सत्व और औषधियों से युक्त, देवोचित धातुओं से मण्डित और विचित्र सुवर्ण पबत के पास शुद्धरत्न के तुल्य चन्द्रप्रभ नाम का एक पबंत है। उसी के मूलदेश में अच्छोद नाम का सरोवर है ।४-५। जिस सरोवर से आच्छोदा नाम की नदी निकलती है। इस आच्छोद के.तीर पर एक चैत्ररथ नाम का महादिव्य बन है। उस चन्द्रप्रभ पव॑त पर यक्ष सेनापति मणिभद्र अपने अनुचरों के साथ निवास
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: दश विंशत्यथ त्रिंशच् चत्वारिंशद् अथापि वा । गृहाण वा खारिशतं दुर्भिक्षां बोधिमुत्तर
verses.transliteration: daśa viṃśatyatha triṃśac catvāriṃśad athāpi vā / gṛhāṇa vā khāriśataṃ durbhikṣāṃ bodhimuttara
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: करते हैं। वहाँ ऋर प्रकृति गुह्मक भी उसके परिवार की भाँति रहते हैं। पवित्र मन्दाकिनी और अच्छोदा नाम की नदी महीमडल के बीच से बहती हुई महासमुद्र में प्रविष्ट हुई है ।६-०। कैलाश के दक्षिण पश्चिम शिवभक्त जीवों और औषधियों से युक्त, मन:शिलामण्डित एवं विशाल और दिव्य जो पिशज्जपर्बंत है, उसके आसपास सुवर्णश्यज्ध से युक्त रक्तवर्ण का सूयंप्रभ नामक एक महान् पर्वत है। उसी के मूलदेश में लोहित नामक महादिव्य सरोवर है ।६-१०। इसी सरोवर से लोहित नामक एक पुण्यशील महानद प्रवाहित हुआ है । उसी के तट पर विशोक नामक एक महांवत है, जो देवों का लीलावन है । उसी पर्बत पर जितेन्द्रिय मणिवर नामक कोई नामक कोई यक्ष निवास करता है, जो द्ान्त धमिक गुह्मकों से पारिवारिक सद्भाव रखता है ।१ १-१२। कैलास के दक्षिण भाग में कर जीव और ओषधों से युक्त एवं तीन शिखरवाले वृत्रासुर की
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: वसु रत्नं सुवर्णं च अन्यत्ते यदभीप्सितम् । तत्सर्वं सम्प्रदास्यामि कमलार्थे न संशयः
verses.transliteration: vasu ratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca anyatte yadabhīpsitam / tatsarvaṃ sampradāsyāmi kamalārthe na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: देह से उत्पन्न अंजनाचल के समीप सर्वधातु संपन्न बद्युत नामक एक महान् पवंत है, जिसके मूलदेश में सिद्ध- सेवित और पवित्र मानस नाम का सरोवर है ।१३-१४। इससे लोकपावनी पवित्र सरयथु प्रवाहित होती है,
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: शबर्युवाच: नाहारं चिन्तयाम्यद्य मुक्त्वा देवं वरानने । देवकार्यं विना भद्रे नान्या बुद्धिः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: śabaryuvāca: nāhāraṃ cintayāmyadya muktvā devaṃ varānane / devakāryaṃ vinā bhadre nānyā buddhiḥ pravartate
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: कुबेरानुचरस्तन्न प्रहेतृतनयों वशी । ब्रह्मपातो निवसति राक्षसोउनन्तविक्रम: ॥ तस्यास्तीरे वन दिव्यं विश्वुतं सुरभीति वे। अस्त्युत्तरेण केलासाच्छिवसत्त्वौषधो गिरिः
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञ्युवाच: न त्वयान्नं परित्याज्यं सर्वमन्ने प्रतिष्ठितम् । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन ममान्नं प्रतिगृह्यताम्
verses.transliteration: rājñyuvāca: na tvayānnaṃ parityājyaṃ sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena mamānnaṃ pratigṛhyatām
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: तस्य पादे महद्वव्यं शुभं काश्वनबालुकस् । रम्यं बिन्दुसरो नाम यत्र यातो भगीरथः
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: तपस्विनो महाभागा ये चारण्यनिवासिनः । गृहस्थद्वारि ते सर्वे याचन्ते ऽन्नम् अतन्द्रिताः
verses.transliteration: tapasvino mahābhāgā ye cāraṇyanivāsinaḥ / gṛhasthadvāri te sarve yācante 'nnam atandritāḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: गदगानिमित्तं राजपिदवास बहुलाः समाः। दिव॑ यास्यन्ति से पूर्वे गहगातोयपरिष्लुता: ततन्न त्रिपथगा देवी प्रथम तु प्रतिष्ठिता । सोमपादप्रसुता सा सप्तधा प्रतिपच्यते २६
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: शबर्युवाच: निषेधश्च कृतः पूर्वं सर्वं सत्ये प्रतिष्ठितम् । सत्येन तपते सूर्यः सत्येन ज्वलते ऽनलः
verses.transliteration: śabaryuvāca: niṣedhaśca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam / satyena tapate sūryaḥ satyena jvalate 'nalaḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: जिसके तीर पर बे भ्राज नाम का एक दिव्य वन है। वहाँ एक अत्यन्त पराक्रमी ब्रह्मपात नामक राक्षस निवास करता है। वह कुबेर का अनुचर और प्रहेता का पृत्र है। वह स्वयं इच्द्रियजित्ु और अन्‍्तरिक्षगामी संकड़ों भयानक निशिचरों से घिरा रहता है ।१५-१६। कैलास के परिचिम प्रान्त में मुख्य-मुख्य जीवों और औषधियों से युक्त एक सुवर्णमय अरुण नामक श्रेष्ठ पंत है, जिसके पास सुवर्णमय, विशुभश्र शिलाओं से आउच्छन्न,
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: सत्येन तिष्ठत्य् उदधिर्वायुः सत्येन वाति हि । सत्येन पच्यते सस्यं गावः क्षीरं स्रवन्ति च
verses.transliteration: satyena tiṣṭhaty udadhirvāyuḥ satyena vāti hi / satyena pacyate sasyaṃ gāvaḥ kṣīraṃ sravanti ca
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: मेघतुल्य, शिव-प्रिय श्रीमान् पंत अवस्थित है ।(७-१५। हतसंख्य हेमश्वज्ों से युक्त यह स्वर्ग को छू रहा है। शिव से युक्त यह दुर्गम विशाल पर्वत देवभोग्य और हिममय है । इस पर्वत पर गिरीक्ष धृम्रलोहित निवास करते हैं। उस पर्वत के मूलदेश में शैलोद नामक सरोवर उत्पन्न हुआ ।१६-२०। जिससे दिव्य शैलोदा नाम की एक नदी निकलती है। यह चक्ष् और शीता नामको नदियों के मध्य से लवण-सागर में प्रविष्ट हुई है। उसके तीर पर दिव्य और प्रसिद्ध सुरभि नामक वन है। कलास के उत्तर मड्भलमय प्राणी और औषधियों से युक्त गौर नामके एक पर्वत है । हरितालमय इस पवत के शिखर सुवर्णमय हैं । वह् एक महान् स्वर्गीय मणिमय पर्वत है
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: सत्याधारम् इदं सर्वं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम् । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन सत्यं सत्येन पालयेत्
verses.transliteration: satyādhāram idaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena satyaṃ satyena pālayet
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: उसके पाददेश में एक रमणीय सुवर्ण-बालुकामय विन्दु सरोवर है, जहाँ राजा भागीरथ गये हुये थे। उस राज्षि ने गड्भा के लिये वहाँ बहुत दिनों तक इसलिये निवास किया था कि गज्भाजल से पवित्र होकर उनके पूर्वंज स्वगंगमन करें। गड्जा देवी वहाँ पहले से ही प्रतिष्ठत थीं । यह सोमपाद से उत्पन्न होकर सात भागों
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: देवकार्यं तु मे मुक्त्वा नान्या बुद्धिः प्रवर्तते । गृहाण राज्ञि पुष्पाणि कुरु पूजां गदाभृतः
verses.transliteration: devakāryaṃ tu me muktvā nānyā buddhiḥ pravartate / gṛhāṇa rājñi puṣpāṇi kuru pūjāṃ gadābhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: दिवि चउछायापथो यस्तु अनुनक्षत्रमण्डलम् । दृश्यते भास्व॒रो राज्रो देवी त्रिपथगा तु सा २८ तस्या ये बिन्दवः केचित्कुद्धाया: पतिताः क्षितां । कृतं बिन्दुसरस्तश्न ततो बिन्दुसरः स्मृतमू. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयते द्विजवाक्यैस्तु न दोषो विद्यते क्वचित् । कुशाः शाकं पयो मत्स्या गन्धाः पुष्पाक्षता दधि । मांसं शय्यासनं धानाः प्रत्याख्येया न वारि च
verses.transliteration: śrūyate dvijavākyaistu na doṣo vidyate kvacit / kuśāḥ śākaṃ payo matsyā gandhāḥ puṣpākṣatā dadhi / māṃsaṃ śayyāsanaṃ dhānāḥ pratyākhyeyā na vāri ca
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: ततो निरुद्धा देवी सा भवेन स्मयता किल । चिन्तयामास मनसा शंकरक्षेपण्ण प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञ्युवाच: आरामोपहृतं पुष्पमारण्यं पुष्पमेव च । क्रीतं प्रतिग्रहे लब्धं पुष्पमेवं चतुर्विधम्
verses.transliteration: rājñyuvāca: ārāmopahṛtaṃ puṣpamāraṇyaṃ puṣpameva ca / krītaṃ pratigrahe labdhaṃ puṣpamevaṃ caturvidham
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: भित्त्वा विशामि पाताल स्रोतसा55गुह्म शंक रम्  ज्ञात्वा तस्या अभिन्नायं क्र देव्याश्विकीधितम् तिरोभावयितु बुद्धिरासीदड्गेषु तां नदीम्। तस्या बलेपं त॑ बुद्ध्वा नद्याः क्ुद्धस्तु शंकरः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमं पुष्पमारण्यं गृहीतं स्वयमेव च । मध्यमं फलमारामे त्वधमं क्रीतमेव च । प्रतिग्रहेण यल्लब्धं निष्फलं तद्विदुर्बुधाः
verses.transliteration: uttamaṃ puṣpamāraṇyaṃ gṛhītaṃ svayameva ca / madhyamaṃ phalamārāme tvadhamaṃ krītameva ca / pratigraheṇa yallabdhaṃ niṣphalaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु दष्टा राजानमग्रतः । धमनीसंततं क्षीणं क्षुध्राएरि गतेन्द्रियम्
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: पुरोहित उवाच: गृहाण राज्ञि पुष्पाणि कुरु पूजां गदाभृतः । उपकारः प्रकर्तव्यो व्यपदेशेन कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: purohita uvāca: gṛhāṇa rājñi puṣpāṇi kuru pūjāṃ gadābhṛtaḥ / upakāraḥ prakartavyo vyapadeśena karhicit
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: अनेन तोषितश्राहूं नद्यर्थ पुवंमेव हि। बुद्ध्वापस्य वरदान तु कोपं नियतवांस्तु सः ब्रह्मणो हि वचः श्रुत्वा प्रतिज्ञाधारणं प्रति । ततो विसर्जेयामास संरुद्धां स्‍्वेन तेजसा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: श्रीफलानि सपद्मानि दत्तानि शबरेण तु । गृहीत्वा तानि राज्ञी सा पूजां चक्रे सुशोभनाम्
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: śrīphalāni sapadmāni dattāni śabareṇa tu / gṛhītvā tāni rājñī sā pūjāṃ cakre suśobhanām
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: में विभक्‍त हुई हैं ॥२४-२६। वहाँ मणिमय यज्ञयूप और सोने की चितियाँ हैं। वहाँ इन्द्र ने सब देवों के साथ मिलकर यज्ञ कर स्वग प्राप्त किया था  अन्तरिक्ष में नक्षत्र मण्डल के बीच रात में जो चमकीला छायापथ दीख पड़ता है. वह त्रिपथगा ही है। वही त्रिपयगा जब अन्तरिक्ष और स्वर्ग को प्लवित करती हुई प्रथ्वी पर आयी, तब वह पहले महादेव के ही सिर पर गिरी और महादेव ने उसे योगमाया से वहीं रोक रखा
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: क्षपाजागरणं चक्रे श्रुत्वा पौराणिकीं कथाम् । शबरस्तु ततो भार्याम् इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ cakre śrutvā paurāṇikīṃ kathām / śabarastu tato bhāryām idaṃ vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: क्रोध से तमतमाई गड्भा की कुछ बूंद उछल कर पृथ्वी पर गिरी, उन्हीं से बिन्दुसर बन गया ।३०। गंगा मन में कह रही थीं कि, मैं अपने प्रवाहवेग में शद्भूर को बहाती हुई सब कुछ तोड़ती फोड़ती पाताल चली जाऊँगी । महादेव गड्भा देवी के क्र कम और अभिप्राय को समझ कर वेग से पृथ्वी पर गिरने वाली गंगा को सिरपर रोक रखा । उस नदी के गये को समझ कर महादेव क्रुद्ध हो गये और अपने सिर में छिपा लेना चाहा ।३१०३ ३। इस बीच महादेव ने राजा भगीरथ को सामने खड़ा देखा, जिसकी धमनी क्षीण हो चली थी और भूख से इन्द्रियाँ वकल हो रही थीं । गड्भा के निमित्त राजा ने पहले ही महादेव को प्रसन्न कर लिया था; अत: उनके वरदान का ध्यान कर महदेव ने क्रोध को शान्त कर दिया । इसी बीच ब्रह्मा ने भी महादेव को प्रतिज्ञापालन के लिये स्मरण कराया । तब उन्होंने अपने तेजसे निरुद्ध गड़ा नदी को छोड़ दिया; क्योंकि कठोर तपस्या के
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: दीपार्थं गृह्यतां स्नेहो यथालाभेन सुन्दरि । कृत्वा दीपं ततस्तौ तु कृत्वा पूजां हरेः शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: dīpārthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ sneho yathālābhena sundari / kṛtvā dīpaṃ tatastau tu kṛtvā pūjāṃ hareḥ śubhām
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: द्वारा वे सनन्‍्तुष्ट होकर भगीरथ की भलाई करने के लिये कृतसंकल्प थे ।३४-३६। छूटने पर गंगा सात धाराओं में
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रतुर्जागरं रात्रौ ध्यायन्तो धरणीधरम् । ततः प्रभातसमये दृष्ट्वा स्नानोत्सुकं जनम्
verses.transliteration: cakraturjāgaraṃ rātrau dhyāyanto dharaṇīdharam / tataḥ prabhātasamaye dṛṣṭvā snānotsukaṃ janam
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: रुषाणांश्च कुणिन्दांश्व अहुगलोकवराय ये। कृत्वा द्विधा सिन्धुमरुं सोताध्गात्पश्चिमोदधिम् अथ चीनमरूंश्चेव तडःगणान्सवंमुलिकान् । सान्प्रांस्तुषारांस्तम्पाकान्पह्॒वान्दरदाज्छकान् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: स्नाति वै शूलभेदे तु देवनद्यां तथापरे । सरस्वत्यां नराः केचिन्मार्कण्डस्य ह्रदे ऽपरे
verses.transliteration: snāti vai śūlabhede tu devanadyāṃ tathāpare / sarasvatyāṃ narāḥ kecinmārkaṇḍasya hrade 'pare
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: दरदांश्च सकाश्मीरान्गान्धारान्वरपान्ह्ृदान् । शिवपोरानिद्रहासान्वदातींश्च विसजंयान्
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रतीर्थं गताश्चक्रुः स्नानं केचिद्विधानतः । शुचयस्ते जनाः सर्वे स्नात्वा देवाशिलोपरि
verses.transliteration: cakratīrthaṃ gatāścakruḥ snānaṃ kecidvidhānataḥ / śucayaste janāḥ sarve snātvā devāśilopari
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: सेन्धवान्रन्ध्रकरकारभश्रमराभोररोहकान् । शुनामसुखांश्रोध्वेमनून्सिद्धचा रणसेवितान् १४६ गन्धर्वान्किन्नरान्यक्षान्रक्षो विद्याधरो रगान् । कलापग्रामकांश्चेव परदान्सीगणान्खसान् किरातांश्व पुलिन्दांश्र कुरूत्सभरतानपि । पश्चालकाशिमात्स्यांश्व मगन्धाड्भरगस्तथव च ४८ ब्रह्मोत्तरांश्र वदगांश्व ताम्रलिप्तांस्तथेव च । एताआजनपदानार्यान्‍्गइूगा भावयते शुभान् ४६
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं चक्रुः प्रयत्नेन श्रद्धया पूतचेतसा । तान्दृष्ट्वा शबरो बिल्वैः पिण्डांश्चक्रे प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ cakruḥ prayatnena śraddhayā pūtacetasā / tāndṛṣṭvā śabaro bilvaiḥ piṇḍāṃścakre prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: बहीं  उनमें तीन घाराएँ पूरव की ओर और तीन पश्चिवम की ओर चलीं । इस प्रकार गज्जा का स्रोत सात भागों में विभकत हुआ  नलिनी, ह्ादिनी और पावनी नामक तीन धाराएँ पूरब की तरफ भयीं एवं सीता, चक्षु और सिन्धु नामक तीन धाराएँ पश्चिम को  सातवीं धारा भागीरथ के पीछे दक्षिण तरफ चली ३७-३६। इसलिये उस घारा का नाम भागीरथी हुआ और वह लवण-सागर में प्रविष्ट हुई ये सातों धाराएँ हिमवर्ष
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: भानुमत्या तथा भर्तुः पिण्डनिर्वपणं कृतम् । अनिन्द्या भोजिता विप्रा दम्भवार्द्धुष्यवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: bhānumatyā tathā bhartuḥ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kṛtam / anindyā bhojitā viprā dambhavārddhuṣyavarjitāḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: को प्लचित करती हैं ।४०-४१। ये सभी वहाँ जाती हैं, जहाँ भेघ बरसता रहता है, जेसे सिरिन्ध्र, कुन्तल, चीन, बर्बर, यवस, द्रुह, रुषाण, कुणिन्द और श्रेष्ठ अढृगलोक  सिन्धु मरु को दो टुकड़ों में विभकक्‍त कर सीता नदी पद्चिम समुद्र में गिरी है ।४२-४३। चीन मरु, तझ्भगुण, सर्वंमुलिक, सान्ध्र तुषार, तम्पाक, पहुव, दरद, और शक नामक जनपद को प्लावित करके चल्षु समुद्र में गिरी है।४४। दरद, काश्मीर, गांधार, बरप, हद, शिवपौर, इन्द्रहास, वदाति, विसजंय, सैन्धव, रन्प्रकरक, भ्रमर, आभीर, रोहक, शुनामुख, उद्धव मनु, सिद्धचारणसेवित देश, गान्धवेकिन्नरयक्ष-राक्षस-विद्याधर-उरग आदि के निवास देश, कलापग्राम, पारद, सीगण, खस, किरात, पुलिन्द, कुछ, भारत, पांचाल, काशि, मत्स्य, मगध अंग, ब्रह्मोत्त र, बंग और ताम्र- लिप्त आदि ब॒भ आय॑ देशों को प्लावित करती है ।४५-४६॥ फिर वह विन्ध्य पर्वत से ठकरा कर दक्षिण सागर
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: हविष्यान्नैस्तथा दध्ना शर्करामधुसर्पिषा । पायसेन तु गव्येन कृतान्नेन विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: haviṣyānnaistathā dadhnā śarkarāmadhusarpiṣā / pāyasena tu gavyena kṛtānnena viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: प्लावयन्त्युपभोगांश्व निषादानां च जातयः । धीवरानृषिकांश्चेच तथा नीलमुखानपि ५१ केरलानुष्ट्कर्णाश्व किरातानपि चेव हि। कालोदरास्विवर्णाश्च कुमारान्स्वर्णमूषितान् ५२
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: भोजयित्वा तथा राज्ञी ददौ दानं यथाविधि । पादुकोपानहौ छत्रं शय्यां गोवृषमेव च
verses.transliteration: bhojayitvā tathā rājñī dadau dānaṃ yathāvidhi / pādukopānahau chatraṃ śayyāṃ govṛṣameva ca
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: मध्येनोद्यानमकरान्कुथप्रावरणान्ययों । इन्द्रद्वीपसमुद्रे तु प्रविष्टा लवणोदधिम् ५५ ततश्च नलिनी चागात्प्राचीोमाशां जबेन तु। तोमरान्प्लावयन्तीह हंसमार्गन्सहूहुकान् पूर्बान्दिशांश्च सेवन्ती भित्वा सा बहुधा गिरीन् । कर्णप्रावरणांश्चेब प्राप्प चाश्वसुखानपि (५७ सिकतापबंतसरून्गत्वा विद्याधरान्ययों  नेमिमण्डलकोष्ठे तु प्रविष्टा सा महोद्धिम् ५८

verses.transliteration: vividhāni ca dānāni hemaratnadhanāni ca / cakratīrthe mahārāja kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / pṛthvī tena bhaved dattā saśailavanakānanā

verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपाद उवाच: यानि यानि च दत्तानि शस्तानि जगतीपतेः । तानि सर्वाणि देवेश कथयस्व प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: uttānapāda uvāca: yāni yāni ca dattāni śastāni jagatīpateḥ / tāni sarvāṇi deveśa kathayasva prasādataḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: में प्रवेश करती है । वहाँ से वह॒ पवित्र आह्लादिनी धारा पूरब की ओर बहती है ।५०। कितने ही देश और निषधों, धीवरों, ऋषिकों, नीलमुखों, केरलों, उष्ट्रकणों. किरातों, कालोदरों, विवर्णो और स्वणंभूषित कुमारों को प्लावित करती हुई वह समुद्रमण्डल में पूव की ओर विलीन हो गई है। पावेती धारा भी पूरब दिशा को ही बही है ५१-५१ यह भअपथों को, इख्ध्युम्त सरोवर को, खरापथ को, इन्द्रशडःकुपथ को ओर कुथश्रावरण प्रभति स्थानों को प्लावित करती हुई इस्द्रढ्दीप समुद्र के निकट लवण-सागर में प्रविष्ट हुई है। नलिनी भी पूरब की ओर वेग से बहती है। यह भी तोमर, हंसमागं, हुहुक और अन्याय पूर्वीय देशों को प्लाबित करती हुई, अनेकानेक पर्वतों को फोड़ती हुई, कर्णप्रावरण, अश्वमुख, सिकतापबंत मद प्रभ्नति स्थानों में गमन करती हुई विद्याधर के देश में उपस्थित हुई है। यह नेमिमण्डल कोष्ठ के पास महासाभर में प्रविष्ट हुई
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: तिलप्रदः प्रजामिष्टां दीपदश्चक्षुरुत्तमम् । भूमिदः स्वर्गमाप्नोति दीर्घम् आयुर् हिरण्यदः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: tilapradaḥ prajāmiṣṭāṃ dīpadaścakṣuruttamam / bhūmidaḥ svargamāpnoti dīrgham āyur hiraṇyadaḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: है ।१४-५८। इन नदियों की सैकड़ों हजारों उपनदियाँ है । वे इनसे ही निकल कर फिर इनमें ही इस प्रकोर- मिलती हैं, जिस प्रकार मेघ समुद्र से जल लेकर बरसाता है और वह जल फिर समुद्र में ही मिल जाता है। वस्वोकसा के तीर पर प्रसिद्ध सुरभि वन में हरिश्वद्ध के ऊपर विद्वान वशी कौबेरक रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: गृहदो रोगरहितो रूप्यदो रूपवान् भवेत् । वासोदश्चन्द्रसालोक्यम् अर्कसायुज्यम् अश्वदः
verses.transliteration: gṛhado rogarahito rūpyado rūpavān bhavet / vāsodaścandrasālokyam arkasāyujyam aśvadaḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: बहाँ जितेन्द्रिय यज्ञोपेत, अमितोजा, सुमहान और सुविक्रम नामक कुबेर के चार अनुचर निवास करते हैं । ये अगस्त्य वंशीय विद्वान ब्रह्मराक्षगों द्वारा सेवित और कुबेर के ही समान है ।६?। पर्वतवासियों की एवमेव तु विज्ञेया ऋद्धिः पर्वतवासिनाम् । परस्परेण द्विगुणा धर्तः कामतोडथंतः..
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: वृषदस्तु श्रियं पुष्टां गोदाता च त्रिविष्टपम् । यानशय्याप्रदो भार्याम् ऐश्वर्यम् अभयप्रदः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣadastu śriyaṃ puṣṭāṃ godātā ca triviṣṭapam / yānaśayyāprado bhāryām aiśvaryam abhayapradaḥ

verses.hindi: अवगाहा हाभयतः समुद्रौ पर्वपश्चिमौं। सरो विष्णुपदं नाम निषधे पदवंतोत्तमे
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: पुण्डरीका पयोदा च तस्मान्नद्यो विनिगंते । श्वेतात्प्रभवते पुण्यं सरस्तृत्तरसानसम्् ६७ ज्योत्स्ना च म्रगकान्ता च तस्मादह संबभूवतुः  मधुमत्सरः पुण्यं च पद्ममीनद्विजाकुलम् कल्पवृक्षसमाकीर्ण मधुवत्सवबंत: सुखम् । रुद्रकानवसिति ख्यातं निर्मितं तज़ूबेन तु १६६९
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ brahmadānaṃ viśiṣyate / yena yena hi bhāvena yadyaddānaṃ prayacchati

verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.transliteration: śrutaṃ ca tanmayā sarvaṃ dānadharmaphalaṃ śubham / pūrvajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ snānadānavratādibhiḥ

verses.hindi: इससे गान्धर्वी और नत्वली नामक नदियाँ निकली हैं । मेरु के पीछे चन्द्प्रभ नामक एक महान हद है। वहाँ पावनी जम्बू नदी बहती है, जिसमें शुभावह सुबर्ण होता है। नीलाचल पर शुश्र पुण्डरीकयुक्त पर्योद नाम का सरोवर है। उसीसे पुण्डरीका और पयोदा नामकी नद्वियाँनिकली हैं। दवेत पर्वत से उत्तर मानस नामक - पुण्य सरोवर उत्पन्न हुआ है ।६५-६७। ज्योत्स्मा और गमृगकान्ता नामक नदियाँ उससे निकली हैं। शिव ढ्वारा निर्मित रुद्रकान्‍्त नामक वहाँ एक और सरोवर है, जो मधुरस से परिपूर्ण, पद्म-मीन-पक्षियों से युक्त, कल्पव॒क्षों से व्याप्त, सुखसम्पन्न और पवित्र है।ओऔर भी पद्ममीन-पक्षियों से यूक्त यहाँ कितने ही हृद हैं। वे सब जय कहलाते हैं ओर मालूम पड़ते हैं ज॑से बारह समुद्र हों ।६८५-७०। उनसे शान्ती और साध्वी नामक दो नदियाँ निकली हैं । किपूरुषादि देझ्षों में वृष्टि नहीं होती है।७१। वहाँ की श्रेष्ठ नदियाँ उद्धिज्ज
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: शरीरं दुस्त्यजं मुक्त्वा लभते गतिमुत्तमाम् । संसारसागराद्भीतः सत्यं भद्रे वदामि ते
verses.transliteration: śarīraṃ dustyajaṃ muktvā labhate gatimuttamām / saṃsārasāgarādbhītaḥ satyaṃ bhadre vadāmi te
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: जलराशि को बहाया करती हैं। ये भाग्यशालिनी नदियाँ पूरव की तरफ लम्बी होकर लवण-सागर में गिरी हैं। ऋषभ, दुन्दुभि, महागिरि धूम्र, चन्द्रकंक तथा प्राणादि छिलोच्चयों के उत्तर बहती हुई ये नदियाँ उत्तरी सीमा तक जाकर महासमुद्र में गिरी हैं ।७२-०७३। सोमक, वराह और नारद नामक महीधर परिचम
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकानि च पापानि कृतानि बहुशो मया । घातिता जन्तवो भद्रे निर्दग्धाः पर्वताः सदा

verses.sanskrit: तेनाहं दुःखितो भद्रे दारिद्र्यम् अनिवर्तिकम् । मातुर्गृहं प्रयाहि त्वं त्यज स्नेहं ममोपरि । नगशृङ्गं समारुह्य मोक्तुम् इच्छाम्यहं तनुम्
verses.transliteration: tenāhaṃ duḥkhito bhadre dāridryam anivartikam / māturgṛhaṃ prayāhi tvaṃ tyaja snehaṃ mamopari / nagaśṛṅgaṃ samāruhya moktum icchāmyahaṃ tanum
verses.translation: The creation of Svayambhuva Manu has indeed been described by me in detail and in accordance with the sequence.
verses.hindi: की ओर लम्बायमान होते हुए लवणसागर में मिल गये हैं ।७४। बक, बलाहक, ओर मैनाक पत्रत दक्षिण दिशा में लम्बायमान होकर दक्षिण सागर में मिल गये हैं, दक्षिण दिंशा में चन्द्र और मैनाक पव॑त के बीच संवतंक नामक एक अग्नि है, जो समुद्रजल को पिया करता है। इस अग्नि का नामान्तर समुद्रप, वड़वामुख और श्रीमान है है ।७ -दृ। ये बारह पंत इस भय से कि कहीं इन्द्र उनके पक्ष न काट डाले लवणोदषि में प्रविष्ट हैं 4-इवैंत चन्द्र में यह जो काला शशांक देखा जाता है ।७७। वहू नवधा भिन्न भारतवषे का ही प्रतिबिम्ब है । इस देह में ही उदित चन्द्र के मध्य यह देखा जाता है, दूसरी जगह नहीं ।७८। उत्तरोत्तर क्रम से इन देशवासियों के प्राणी आरोग्य, आयु, घर्मं, अर्थ और काम आदि गुणों में उत्तरोत्तर पूर्व-पूत्र देशस्थ लोगों की अपेक्षा अधिक समृद्ध हैं। नाना जातियों के प्राणिसमृह उल्लिखित देशों में निवास क'ते हैं। इसी

verses.transliteration: śabaryuvāca: mātrā pitrā na me kāryaṃ nāpi svajanabāndhavaiḥ / yā gatistava jīveśa sā mamāpi bhaviṣyati

verses.transliteration: sarvadevānnamaskṛtya bhukto 'pi ca tayā saha / caitryāṃ tu viṣuvaṃ jñātvā tasthau tatra dinatrayam

verses.hindi: शाखामृगसधर्माणः फलमुलाशिनस्तथा । गोधर्माणो ह्यनिदिष्टा: शौचाचारविवर्जिताः ६

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे व्याधवाक्योपदेशकथनपूर्वकदानादिफलवर्णनं नाम षट्पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ५७ ईश्वर उवाच: भानुमती द्विजान्भोज्य बुभुजे भुक्तशेषतः । भुक्त्वा सुसुखमास्थाय तदन्नं परिणाम्य च
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe vyādhavākyopadeśakathanapūrvakadānādiphalavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 57 īśvara uvāca: bhānumatī dvijānbhojya bubhuje bhuktaśeṣataḥ / bhuktvā susukhamāsthāya tadannaṃ pariṇāmya ca
verses.translation: We wish to know the nature and reality of the (sets of) four \ ugas which occurred formerly in the Svayambhuva Man- vantara. Although this Purana accepted the Vedic tradition and regarded a Yuga period as consisting of five years (vide supra ch. 50 , fn. 3), here it follows Manu I 61-74, 79-86. According to Manu, the 1st Yuga, K r ta, has a duranonof 4000years ofDevas with 400 divine years of the dawn {Sandhyi) of the A g e and 400 d, vin e years of transition from K r ta to the next Age {SandhyamSa). The o.hc Y viz.Treta, Dvapara ahd Kali consist respecti- In the context of the description of the earth etc. I have already said about the four Yugas. Now I shall recount them in detail. (Listen and) understand them.
verses.hindi: बोले--भारतवर्ष के दक्षिण दस हजार योजन का एक महासागर है जिसमें तीन हजार बोजन विस्ती्ण तीन भागों में विभक्त एक द्वीप है जो नाना भाँति के फल पुष्पों से समृद्ध है ।१-२। वहाँ विद्युत्वान् नामक एक महाशेल कुल पर्वत है, जिसके अनेक शिखरों से वह द्वीप सुशोभित है, वहाँ हजारों नदियाँ हैं, जिनका जल निर्मल और उुस्वादु है। उस द्वीप की बापियों का जल भी निर्मल है !३-४॥ उस पर्वत के

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदश्यां ततो गत्वा मदनाख्यतिथौ तदा । मार्कण्डस्य ह्रदे स्नात्वानर्च्य देवं गुहाशयम्
verses.transliteration: trayodaśyāṃ tato gatvā madanākhyatithau tadā / mārkaṇḍasya hrade snātvānarcya devaṃ guhāśayam
verses.translation: Calculating everything and mentioning in detail, I shall narrate in full the six aspects viz.: Yuga, Yugabheda (differ¬ ence in Yugas), Yugadharma (the particular characteristics of each Yuga), Yugasandhi (thejunction of Yugas), YugamSa (the parts of Yugas) and Yugasandhana (the joints of Yugas). The human year can be understood (calculated) by means of valid working knowledge. Calculating on the basis of that year, I shall explain the four Yugas. The time taken to utter a short syllable is equal to a Nimesa. Nimesa, Kastha, Kala and Muhurta are the units of time. 1
verses.hindi: अनेकों विस्तीर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: Calculating everything and mentioning in detail, I shall narrate in full the six aspects viz.: Yuga, Yugabheda (differ¬ ence in Yugas), Yugadharma (the particular characteristics of each Yuga), Yugasandhi (thejunction of Yugas),…

verses.sanskrit: कृतोपवासनियमा स्नापयित्वा महेश्वरम् । पञ्चामृतसुगन्धेन धूपदीपनिवेदनैः
verses.transliteration: kṛtopavāsaniyamā snāpayitvā maheśvaram / pañcāmṛtasugandhena dhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ
verses.translation: Fifteen Nimesas constitute a Kastha, thirty Kasthas make one ICala, thirty Kalas make one Muhurta. Thirty Muhur- tas make one full day and night. The sun demarcates the human as well as the divine days and nights. The day is intended for activity and the night is meant for sleep. A (human) month constitutes the day and night of the Pitrs. Its division is thus: The dark half is the day for them and the bright half is their night for sleep.
verses.hindi: और चौड़े दर्रों में विभिन्न वर्ण और आक्रृति के अनेकों प्रसन्न हृदय स्‍्त्री-पुरुष रहा करते हैं । उस पव॑त के बीच तलदेश में उनके संकड़ों-हजारों पुर हैं, जो परस्पर एक में एक मिले और एक ही द्वार वाले हैं ।५-७। वहाँ वाले बड़ी-बड़ी दाढ़ी और मूछ रखते हैं तथा मेघ के समान नीलवर्ण के होते हैं। और सभी अस्सी वर्ष की आयु वाले होते हैं। वानरों की तरह फल-मूल खाकर जीवन यापन करते हैं ओर पशुओं की तरह शौच आदि आचार-विचार से विहीत हैं. ।८-६। इस भ्रकार के असम्य मनुष्यों से वह द्वीप
verses.wordMeaning: Fifteen Nimesas constitute a Kastha, thirty Kasthas make one ICala, thirty Kalas make one Muhurta. Thirty Muhur- tas make one full day and night. The sun demarcates the human as well as the divine days and nights.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Fifteen Nimesas constitute a Kastha, thirty Kasthas make one ICala, thirty Kalas make one Muhurta. Thirty Muhur- tas make one full day and night. The sun demarcates the human as well as the divine days and nights.…

verses.sanskrit: आर्चयद्विविधैः पुष्पैर्नैवेद्यैश्च सुशोभनैः । क्षपाजागरणं कृत्वा श्रुत्वा पौराणिकीं कथाम्
verses.transliteration: ārcayadvividhaiḥ puṣpairnaivedyaiśca suśobhanaiḥ / kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śrutvā paurāṇikīṃ kathām
verses.translation: Thirty human months make one month of the Pitrs. On Verses 6-20 give the units of Time, the smallest unit being Nimesa, the time required to utter one mdtrd (a short vowel). The following are the terms to denote the particular periods. A hundred human years constitute three years and four months of Pitrs.
verses.hindi: जम्बद्दी पप्रदेशास्तु षडन्ये विविधाश्रया: । अन्न हीपाः समाख्याता नानारत्नाकराः क्षितो
verses.wordMeaning: Thirty human months make one month of the Pitrs. On Verses 6-20 give the units of Time, the smallest unit being Nimesa, the time required to utter one mdtrd (a short vowel). The following are the terms to denote the particular periods.…

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यगीतैस्तथा स्तोत्रैर्दध्यौ देवं महेश्वरम् । अन्नं विस्तारितं सर्वं देवस्याग्रे यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: nṛtyagītaistathā stotrairdadhyau devaṃ maheśvaram / annaṃ vistāritaṃ sarvaṃ devasyāgre yathāvidhi
verses.translation: A human year in accordance with the human calcu¬ lation is one day and one night of the Devas. This is the conclu¬ sion in this scripture. The divine day and night together make a human year. A further classification is that the Uttarayana period (northern transit of the sun) is the day and the Daksinayana period (southern transit of the sun) is the night (of Devas), Thirty of the days and nights of the gods or thirty human years make one divine month.
verses.hindi: अद्भाद्वीपं निबोध त्वं नानासंघसमाकुलम्  नानम्लेच्छगणाकीर्ण तद्द्वीपं बहुविस्तरम् ३१५ हेमविदुमपुर्णानां रत्नानामाकरं क्षितो । नदीशलवनेश्चित्रं संनिभं लवणास्भसा १६ स मध्ये नागदेशस्य नेकदेशों सहागिरि: । कोटिभ्यां नागनिलयं प्राप्तो तदनदोपतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: A human year in accordance with the human calcu¬ lation is one day and one night of the Devas. This is the conclu¬ sion in this scripture. The divine day and night together make a human year.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A human year in accordance with the human calcu¬ lation is one day and one night of the Devas. This is the conclu¬ sion in this scripture. The divine day and night together make a human year.…

verses.sanskrit: चातुर्वर्ण्यसुताः सर्वे भोजिताः सपरिच्छदाः । चतुर्दश्यां दिनं यावत्सम्पूज्य वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: cāturvarṇyasutāḥ sarve bhojitāḥ saparicchadāḥ / caturdaśyāṃ dinaṃ yāvatsampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: One hundred human years make three divine months and three divine days. Thus is the divine reckoning for division of time. Three hundred and sixty years according to the human calculation constitute one divine year. Three thousand and thirty years according to human calculation constitute one year of the Seven Sages (Saptarsis) or the Great Bear. Nine thousand and ninety human years make one Krauncanyear (Dhruva year in Bd. P.I. 2.29,18).
verses.hindi: यमद्वीपसिति प्रोक्‍्तं नानारत्नाकराचितम् । ( + तत्रापि झुतिमान्नास पव॑तों धातुमण्डितः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: One hundred human years make three divine months and three divine days. Thus is the divine reckoning for division of time. Three hundred and sixty years according to the human calculation constitute one divine year.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One hundred human years make three divine months and three divine days. Thus is the divine reckoning for division of time. Three hundred and sixty years according to the human calculation constitute one divine year.…

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खवादित्रभेरीभिः पटहध्वनिनादितम् । क्षपाजागरणं कृत्वा प्रभूतजनसंकुलम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhavāditrabherībhiḥ paṭahadhvanināditam / kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prabhūtajanasaṃkulam
verses.translation: Persons well versed in calculation say that three hund¬ red and sixty thousand years reckoned on the basis of human time units constitute a thousand divine years, It is thus that the sages sang about the divine calcula¬ tion. They have formulated reckoning of the Yugas and their duration on the basis of the divine calculation. Wise people know that there are four Yugas in Bharata Varsa. 1 The first one is Kfta, then follow Treta, Dvapara and Kali. One should reckon these Yugas in this order.
verses.hindi: समुद्रगानां (णां) प्रभवः प्रभवः काचनस्य तु परिपूर्ण है । इसी प्रकार इन अन्तर द्वीपों के विषय में यथा क्रम वर्णन किया गया है। ये बोस, तीस, पचास, साठ अस्सी, सौ और हजार योजन लम्बे चौड़े अन्तर द्वीप हैं। वहाँ भाँति-भाँति के प्राणी निवास करते हैं। जम्बू द्वीप में विविध वस्तुओं को धारण करने वाले और भी छः ढीप, वहिण द्वीप-पुज्ज तथा हजारों क्षुद्र द्वीप भी हैं ।१०-१२। यहाँ के द्वीप पृथ्वोतल में विविध रत्नों को धारण करने के कारण विख्यात हैं। कुछ द्वीपों के
verses.wordMeaning: Persons well versed in calculation say that three hund¬ red and sixty thousand years reckoned on the basis of human time units constitute a thousand divine years, It is thus that the sages sang about the divine calcula¬ tion.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons well versed in calculation say that three hund¬ red and sixty thousand years reckoned on the basis of human time units constitute a thousand divine years, It is thus that the sages sang about the divine calcula¬ tion.…

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यगीतैस्तथा स्तोत्रैः प्रेरिता सा निशा तदा । प्रभाते भोजिता विप्राः पायसैर्मधुसर्पिषा
verses.transliteration: nṛtyagītaistathā stotraiḥ preritā sā niśā tadā / prabhāte bhojitā viprāḥ pāyasairmadhusarpiṣā
verses.translation: They say that Kpta Yuga consists of four thousand years. The Sandhya (Transition period) consists of as many (i.e. It is strange that the yuga-system should be restricted to India only. In the other Yugas, their Sandhyas and SandhyamSas there is gradual reduction of thousand and hundred years. Treta contains three hundred years. Its Sandhya and Sandhyamsa consist of three hundred years.
verses.hindi: नाम हैं-अंग, यम, मलय, शद्भू, कुश और वराह ।१४३-१४। अज़ुद्भीप नाना प्राणी-संघ से व्याप्त, विभिन्न स्लेच्छों से युक्त और अत्यन्त विस्तृत है। वहाँ पृथ्वीतल में सुबर्ण विद्रुम आदि रत्नों की खाने हैं । वह नदी, वनों से सुशोभित एवं लवण सागर की तरह है। जिसकी गुफा में नाना प्रकार के जीव निवास करते हैं । १५-१७। नाग देश के मध्य में वह महागिरि अनेक प्रदेशों में फैला है। उसके कटि देश में अनेकों पंत
verses.wordMeaning: They say that Kpta Yuga consists of four thousand years. The Sandhya (Transition period) consists of as many (i.e. It is strange that the yuga-system should be restricted to India only. In the other Yugas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that Kpta Yuga consists of four thousand years. The Sandhya (Transition period) consists of as many (i.e. It is strange that the yuga-system should be restricted to India only. In the other Yugas,…

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा दानानि विप्रेभ्यः शक्त्या विप्रानुसारतः । अर्चयित्वा महापुष्पैः सुगन्धैर् मदनेन च
verses.transliteration: dattvā dānāni viprebhyaḥ śaktyā viprānusārataḥ / arcayitvā mahāpuṣpaiḥ sugandhair madanena ca
verses.translation: The wise say that Dvapara contains two thousand years. The Sandhya consists of two hundred years and the San- dhyamSa is equal to Sandhya. The learned say that Kaliyuga consists of a thousand years. Its Sandhya is of a hundred years and the SandhyathSa is equal to Sandhya. This period of twelve thousand (divine) years is known as (Maha) Yuga. The four Yugas are Kfta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali.
verses.hindi: हैं जो समुद्र तक फैले हुए हैं। घमद्वीप के नाम से जो द्वीप कहा गया है, वह भी नाना रत्नों की खानों से पूर्ण है, वहाँ धातुओं से मण्डित द्युतिमान् नाम का एक पव॑त है। इसी पंत से वहाँ को नद-नदियाँ निकलती हैं और सूवर्ण भी इसी से उत्पन्न होता है। १८-१६। इसी प्रकार मलय द्वीप भी हैं। वहाँ मणि, रत्न और इदमर्ध॑ नास्ति ख. पुस्तके । + धनुध्चिल्वान्तमंतग्रन्थो ड. एुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: The wise say that Dvapara contains two thousand years. The Sandhya consists of two hundred years and the San- dhyamSa is equal to Sandhya. The learned say that Kaliyuga consists of a thousand years. Its Sandhya is of a hundred years and the SandhyathSa is equal to Sandhya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The wise say that Dvapara contains two thousand years. The Sandhya consists of two hundred years and the San- dhyamSa is equal to Sandhya. The learned say that Kaliyuga consists of a thousand years. Its Sandhya is of a hundred years and the SandhyathSa is equal to Sandhya.…

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रैः सूक्ष्मवस्त्रैश्च देवः सम्पूज्य वेष्टितः । स्रग्दामलम्बमानैश्च बहुदीपसमुज्ज्वलैः
verses.transliteration: vicitraiḥ sūkṣmavastraiśca devaḥ sampūjya veṣṭitaḥ / sragdāmalambamānaiśca bahudīpasamujjvalaiḥ
verses.translation: In this world the calculation of years is based on human level. Now I shall mention the duration of Kj-ta Yuga in accor¬ dance with that type of calculation. 1 The duration is one million four hundred and forty thousand years. As for Kali Yuga, it is one-fourth of the adove. Thus the specific duration of time of the four Yugas excluding the Sandhyas and Sandhyarhfas is declared. Including the Sandhyas and Sandhyariiias the duration of the four yugas is four million three hundred and twenty thousand human years.
verses.hindi: तथेव मलयद्वीपमेबमेव सुसंवृुतम् ।) सणिरत्नाकरं स्फीतमाकरं कनकस्य च २० आकर चन्दनानां च समुद्राणां तथा5:करम्  नानास्लेच्छगणाकीर्णं नदीपवबंतमण्डितम्
verses.wordMeaning: In this world the calculation of years is based on human level. Now I shall mention the duration of Kj-ta Yuga in accor¬ dance with that type of calculation. 1 The duration is one million four hundred and forty thousand years. As for Kali Yuga, it is one-fourth of the adove.…

As for Kali Yuga, it is one-fourth of the adove.…

verses.sanskrit: पक्वान्नैर् विविधैर् भक्ष्यैः सुवृत्तैर् मोदकादिभिः । ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे वेदाध्ययनतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: pakvānnair vividhair bhakṣyaiḥ suvṛttair modakādibhiḥ / tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve vedādhyayanatatparāḥ
verses.translation: Thus seventyone sets of Caturyugas consisting of Kfta, Treta etc., constitute a Manvantara. Now understand the unmber of human years consti¬ tuting a Manvantara. It will be thirty crores, six millions and seven hundred and twenty thousand human years (306720000 years). The number of years constituting a Manvantara has been cal¬ culated by Dvijas, the experts in calculating time. Thus the duration of a Manvantara and that of Yugas has been stated. The first (Krta) Yuga has four thousand years. The remaining Yugas, viz. Treta, Dvapara and Kali, I shall explain.
verses.hindi: तंत्र श्रीमांस्तु मलयः पर्वतो रजताकरः  महामलय इत्येवं विख्यातो वरपवंतः द्वितीय मन्दरं वाम प्रथितं च सदा क्षितो । +नानापुष्पफलोपेतं रम्थं देवषिसेवितम् ॥। अगस्त्यभवन तत्र देवासुरनमस्कृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus seventyone sets of Caturyugas consisting of Kfta, Treta etc., constitute a Manvantara. Now understand the unmber of human years consti¬ tuting a Manvantara. It will be thirty crores, six millions and seven hundred and twenty thousand human years (306720000 years).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus seventyone sets of Caturyugas consisting of Kfta, Treta etc., constitute a Manvantara. Now understand the unmber of human years consti¬ tuting a Manvantara. It will be thirty crores, six millions and seven hundred and twenty thousand human years (306720000 years).…

verses.sanskrit: तत्पर्व कीर्तयांश्चक्रुः पद्मकं नाम नामतः । आदित्यस्य दिनं त्वद्य तिथिः पञ्चदशी तथा
verses.transliteration: tatparva kīrtayāṃścakruḥ padmakaṃ nāma nāmataḥ / ādityasya dinaṃ tvadya tithiḥ pañcadaśī tathā
verses.translation: Previously, while engrossed in describing the lineage of the sages, the two Yugas have been mentioned to you as they had come in due order. It is not possible to describe separately the two connected Topics coming in the same context simul¬ taneously. The Seven Sages expatiated on the Vedic sacred rites such as Marriage, Agnihotra and the like on the basis of Rk, Yajur and Saman. The Svayambhuva Manu expatiated on the conduct of life based on Smrti injunctions, traditionally handed down and referring to the duties of the different castes and stages of life. The Seven Sages and Manu were endowed with truthfulness, celibacy, learning and penance. They had perform¬ ed penace in accordance with the order of sages. Hence in the beginning of Treta Yuga, the Mantras manifested themselves to them without their undergoing physical or mental effort. In the first Kalpa those Mantras along with Tar aka (Omkara) and others had already appeared before the Devas.
verses.hindi: तथा काचनपादस्य मलयस्यापरस्य हि। निकुञ्जस्तृणसोमाजडु राश्रमं पुण्पसेवितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Previously, while engrossed in describing the lineage of the sages, the two Yugas have been mentioned to you as they had come in due order. It is not possible to describe separately the two connected Topics coming in the same context simul¬ taneously.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Previously, while engrossed in describing the lineage of the sages, the two Yugas have been mentioned to you as they had come in due order. It is not possible to describe separately the two connected Topics coming in the same context simul¬ taneously.…

verses.sanskrit: त्वाष्ट्रमेव च नक्षत्रं संक्रान्तिर् विषुवन्तथा । व्यतीपातस्तथा योगः करणविष्टिरेव च
verses.transliteration: tvāṣṭrameva ca nakṣatraṃ saṃkrāntir viṣuvantathā / vyatīpātastathā yogaḥ karaṇaviṣṭireva ca
verses.translation: When the (original) Siddhis'ceased to exist, these (others) began to function. Thousands of those Mantras which existed in the past Kalpas manifested themselves in their intellect once again. The Seven Sages popularised the Rk, Yajus, Saman and the Atharvan mantras and Manu propagated the rites in accord¬ ance with Smylis. In the beginning of Treta, the Vedas were one un¬ divided and unified whole, because Dharma alone prevailed. But they are classified in Dvapara age due to the shortage of life.
verses.hindi: तथा त्रिकूटनिलये नानाधातुविभूषिते । अनेकयोजनोत्सेथे चित्रसानुदरीगृहे २६ तस्य कूटतटे रम्ये हेमप्राकारतोरणा । नियूं हव॒लभी चित्रा हम्यप्रासादमालिनोी सा कामरूपिणां स्थान राक्षसानां महात्मनाम् । आवासो बलवुृष्तानां तद्विद्याहेबविद्विषाम् ॥ सानुषाणामसंबाधा ह्मगम्था सा महापुरी द

verses.sanskrit: पद्मकं नाम पर्वैतद् अयनादिचतुर्गुणम् । अत्र दत्तं हुतं जप्तं सर्वं भवति चाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: padmakaṃ nāma parvaitad ayanādicaturguṇam / atra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
verses.translation: In the Kali and Dvapara ages, divine sages and Devas Verses 39-85 describe the happy life in Tretayuga (cf. Mt. ). Following their righteous conduct, along with their lineage, they perform their respective duties in different Yugas. The'Vedic texts, with ancillaries, function* with uniform mean¬ ing in every age. Arambha (expedition or enterprise) was a sacrifice for Ksattriyas. Havis (offering of ghee etc.) was the Yajiia to Vaisyas. Sudras had service as Yajiia and excellent Brahmanas had Japa (chanting of Mantras) as their Yajiia.
verses.hindi: सुवर्ण की खानें हैं। चन्दन के वृक्ष भी अधिकाधिक होते हैँ और समुद्र भी वहाँ अनेकों हैं। उस द्वीप में विभिन्न प्रकार के म्लेच्छ रहते हैं और नदी-पर्वतों से वह ढ्वीप भरा हुआ है । वहाँ मलय नामक एक शोभार सम्पन्न पव॑त है, जिसमें चाँदी की खाने हैं महामलय नाम का भी एक विख्यात और श्रेष्ठ पर्वत है ।२०-२२॥। दूसरा मन्दर नाम का एक पव॑त है, जो इस पृथ्वी तल पर विख्यात है। यह रमणीय पर्वत अनेक फले-पुष्पों

verses.sanskrit: ते द्विजा भानुमत्याथ शूलभेदं गताः सह । ददृशुः शबरं कुण्डे भार्यया सह संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: te dvijā bhānumatyātha śūlabhedaṃ gatāḥ saha / dadṛśuḥ śabaraṃ kuṇḍe bhāryayā saha saṃsthitam
verses.translation: All the castes rejoiced in Treta age. They were protected righteously. They performed holy rites. They were happy and flourishing. They were blessed with progeny. Ksattriyas obeyed the (advice etc. of) Brahmanas, Vaisyas obeyed Ksattriyas, Sudras followed Vaisyas. People cooperated and collaborated with one another. Their activities were auspicious. Their holy rites and duties of castes and stages of life too were auspicious, in thought, mind, words and actions. Thus in Treta age their activities remained unimpaired.
verses.hindi: से युक्त, है जहाँ देवाषि निवास करते हैं । यहाँ अगस्त्य ऋषि का भवन है, जिसकी वन्दना देवता और असुर दोनों ही किया करते हैं (१३॥ मलय की तरह वहाँ एक और कांचनपाद नाम का पवृत है, जहाँ महात्माओं के अनेक आश्रम हैं जो निकंज, तृण और सोमलता से बने हुए हैं।२४॥ वह पर्वत नानाविध फलपुष्पों से युक्त और स्वर्ग से भी बढा-चढ़ा है। वहाँ प्रत्येक पंत पर मानो स्वगं सदा उतरा करता है। इसके अनन्तर वहाँ नाना धातुओं से विभूषित त्रिकूट परत हैं, जिसके शिखर अनेक योजन ऊंचे हैं जिनमें गृह तुल्य भनेक विचित्र कन्दराएँ हैं । इस त्रिकूट के रमणीय शिखर पर सुबर्णमय परकोटे, तोरणों में से सजाये गए द्वारों, वलभियों, कोठों और अटारियों से सुशोभित सौ योजन लम्बी तथा तीस योजन चौड़ी लंका नामक महापुरी है ।२५-२८। यह पुरी धन धान्य से समृद्ध और प्रसन्न नर नारियों से स्वयं हंसती सी जान
verses.wordMeaning: All the castes rejoiced in Treta age. They were protected righteously. They performed holy rites. They were happy and flourishing. They were blessed with progeny. Ksattriyas obeyed the (advice etc. of) Brahmanas, Vaisyas obeyed Ksattriyas, Sudras followed Vaisyas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All the castes rejoiced in Treta age. They were protected righteously. They performed holy rites. They were happy and flourishing. They were blessed with progeny. Ksattriyas obeyed the (advice etc. of) Brahmanas, Vaisyas obeyed Ksattriyas, Sudras followed Vaisyas.…

verses.sanskrit: ऐशानीं स दिशं गत्वा पर्वते भृगुमूर्धनि । पतितुं च समारूढो भार्यया सह पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: aiśānīṃ sa diśaṃ gatvā parvate bhṛgumūrdhani / patituṃ ca samārūḍho bhāryayā saha pārthiva
verses.translation: In Tretayuga, people were equally endowed with the same span of life, good intellect, strength, beauty, health and righteousness. Brahma had stipulated the duties of the different castes and different stages of life. But out of delusion the sub¬ jects strayed away from sacred rites. They argued and quarrelled with one another. They approached Prajapati Manu. Manu, the son of Brahma, realized the state of affairs. He, the creator, the Man, begot ofSatarupa two sons Priyavrata and Uttana- pada. These two were the first kings. Thence arose a line of kings wielding the staff of power of punishment. Since they delighted the subjects, kings were called "Rajana/t ". In order to check and control those men who com¬ mit sins in secret and (hence) are difficult to be subdued, and in order to establish righteousness on the earth, the divisions of
verses.hindi: पड़ती है। यह लंका इच्छानुरूप स्वरूप धारण करने वाले देवशत्रु बलशाली महात्मा राक्षसों का निवास स्थान
verses.wordMeaning: In Tretayuga, people were equally endowed with the same span of life, good intellect, strength, beauty, health and righteousness. Brahma had stipulated the duties of the different castes and different stages of life.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In Tretayuga, people were equally endowed with the same span of life, good intellect, strength, beauty, health and righteousness. Brahma had stipulated the duties of the different castes and different stages of life.…

verses.sanskrit: भानुमत्युवाच: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ महासत्त्व शृणुष्व वचनं मम । किमर्थं त्यजसि प्राणानद्यापि च युवा भवान्
verses.transliteration: bhānumatyuvāca: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mahāsattva śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ mama / kimarthaṃ tyajasi prāṇānadyāpi ca yuvā bhavān
verses.translation: (The institution of) Yajna has been initiated by Devas, namely Yamas, Suklas and Japas all fully equipped with the requisites. Formerly, in the Svayambhuva Manvantara, Yajnas were set in vogue by Devas under the leadership of Indra, the enjoyer of the universe. Truthfulness, Japa, penance and charity are the main virtues in Treta age. The practice of holy rites and rituals declines and the virtue of truthfulness prevails.
verses.hindi: +- इदमर्ध नास्ति क. ख. ग. पुस्तकेषु । तस्य द्वीपस्य बे पूर्वे तोरे नदनदीपते:  गोकणंनामधेयस्य शंकरस्याउब्लयं महत् ३० तथकराज्यं विज्ञेपं शहुखद्वीपसमास्थितम । शतयोजनबिस्तीर्ण नानाम्लेच्छुगणालयम् १३१ तत्र शइ्खगिरिरनाम धोतशडखदलप्रभः । नानारत्नाकरः पुण्यः पुण्यकद्ूू निष वितः 0३२

verses.sanskrit: कः सन्तापः क उद्वेगः किं दुःखं व्याधिरेव च । शिशुः संदृश्यसे ऽद्यापि कारणं कथ्यतामिदम्
verses.transliteration: kaḥ santāpaḥ ka udvegaḥ kiṃ duḥkhaṃ vyādhireva ca / śiśuḥ saṃdṛśyase 'dyāpi kāraṇaṃ kathyatāmidam
verses.translation: Renouncing their staff (of punishment due to its super¬ fluity?) those excessively fortunate kings became performers of sacrifice and expounders of the Vedas. Their eyes were as large as lotus petals. Their chests were broad, and their bodies were well-built. They were vigorous and capable of slaying lions. They walked majestically like the elephants in rut. They wielded great bows. They were endowed with all good characteristics. They were Nyagrodha-parimatidalas (as ex- plained in the next verse). The following seven', viz. a discus, a chariot, a jewel, a spouse, a treasure, a horse and an elephant, are regarded as super-gems (ati-ratna ).
verses.hindi: तथेव कुसुदद्वीपं नानापुष्पोषशोभितम् । नानाग्रामसमाकीर्ण नानारत्नाकरं शिवम् ३४ कुमुदा नाम महाभागा दुष्टवित्तनिबहेणी । सहादेवस्य भगिनी प्रभाभिस्ताभिरिज्यते

verses.transliteration: śabara uvāca: kāraṇaṃ nāsti me kiṃcinna duḥkhaṃ kiṃcideva tu / saṃsārabhayabhīto 'haṃ nānyā buddhiḥ pravartate
verses.translation: The seven jewels (of an emperor) possessing life are mentioned as follows: queen, family-priest, commander- in-chief, chariot-maker, minister, horse and elephant (lit. elephant-cub). These fourteen jewels arc divine. They have been naturally acquired by the noblc-souled ones. These fourteen jewels should be assigned to all emperors (i.e. all emperors should possess these). In all the Manvantaras of the past and future, the emperors are born on the earth with a part of Visnu. 1
verses.hindi: तथा वराहद्वीपे व नानाम्लेच्छगणाकुले । नानाजातिसमाकीणें नानाधिष्ठानपत्तने धनधान्ययुते स्फीते धर्मिष्ठजनसंकुले । नदीशेलवनश्रिन्रबंह॒पुष्पफलोपमै: .

verses.sanskrit: दुःखेन लभ्यते यस्मान्मानुष्यं जन्म भाग्यतः । मानुष्यं जन्म चासाद्य या न धर्मं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: duḥkhena labhyate yasmānmānuṣyaṃ janma bhāgyataḥ / mānuṣyaṃ janma cāsādya yā na dharmaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: The precious gems are conducive to the welfare of all emperors of the past, present and future born in the Yugas Treta etc. These four are very wonderful, viz. strength, piety, happiness and wealth (among the emperors). Wealth, dharma, love, fame and victory attained by kings without any conflict are on a par with one another. They excel even the sages by means of (spiritual powers such as) Anima (minuteness) and others the power of Lordship, learning and penance. They overpower Devas, Danavas and human beings by their strength and austere They are born with super-human marks visible on their bodies. They have a circle of hair on their forehead (between the eyebrows); their tongue sweeps their mouths. Their teeth and lips are copper-coloured; their hair stand facing up; and they have the Srlvatsa scar (on the chest).
verses.hindi: वाराहरूपिणे तत्र विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे । अनन्यदेवतास्तस्मे नमस्कुबन्ति वे प्रजाः ॥४ ०

verses.transliteration: sa gacchennirayaṃ ghoramātmadoṣeṇa sundari / tasmātpatitumicchāmi tīrthe 'sminpāpanāśane
verses.translation: Their arms extend to their knees; their palms are marked with net and bull; they are very tall ( Nyagrodha-parina - has ); they have shoulders like those of lions; their penises are well shaped. Their gait is as stately as that of a lordly ele¬ phant. Their chin bones are broad. There are lines of wheel and fish on the soles of their Verses 72-80 state the then idea about a model emperor.
verses.hindi: है। यहाँ कोई राक्षसों को बाधा नहीं पहुंचा सकता । मनुष्य लोग इस महापुरी में किसी भी प्रकार नहीं जा सकते हैं। उस द्वीप के पूर्वी समुद्रतट पर मोकर्ण महादेव का विशाल मन्दिर है ।३९-३०। इसके बाद शट्डद्नीप में सौ योजन विस्तीर्ण एक विशाल राज्य है जहाँ बहुतेरे म्लेच्छों का निवास स्थान है। वहाँ निर्मल धले गद्ध॒ की तरह उज्ज्वल एक दाद्भमिरिनामक पविन्न पर्वत है। उस पर विविध रत्नों की खानें हैं. जिस पर पुण्यश,ली जन निवास करते हैं।३१-३२। उसी पर्वत से शद्भूनागा नाम की एक पवित्र नदी निकली है  जहाँ शद्भमुख नामक नागराज निवास करते हैं। कुमुदद्वीप में तरह-तरह के फूल खिले रहते हैं। अनेका- नेक ग्राम और रघध्नों की अनेकों खानें हैं। वहाँ महादेव की महाभागा कुमुदा नाम की भगिनी हैं जो अपनी ज्योति के कारण स्बंपूजित हैं। जिनके दर्शन से चित्त-दोष दूर हो जाते हैं ।३३-३५।॥ वराह द्वीप में नाना

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञ्युवाच: अद्यापि वर्तते कालो धर्मस्योपार्जने तव । कृतापकृतकर्मा वै व्रतदानैर् विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: rājñyuvāca: adyāpi vartate kālo dharmasyopārjane tava / kṛtāpakṛtakarmā vai vratadānair viśudhyati
verses.translation: They have unimpeded movement in four places, viz. in the firmament, in the ocean, in the nether regions and on the mountains. Sacrifice, charity, penance and truthfulness are the holy rites in Treta Age. During this age, Dharma func¬ tions in accordance with the division of castes and stages of life. Only a single unified Veda with four sub-divisions pre¬ vails in Treta Age. People live upto three thousand years. Surrounded by sons and grandsons, people die in due order (of seniority in age). This is the characteristic feature of Treta Age. (Now) understand the Treta-Sandkyd (Transition from Treta Yuga'j.
verses.hindi: प्रकार के म्लेच्छ लोग और कितनी ही जाति के लोग शहर-गाँवों में घर बनाकर बसे हुए हैं। वह द्वीप धन-धास्पों से समृद्ध और धामिक जनों से व्याप्त है । वहाँ नदी पवृत-वनों में रमणीय और फल पुष्पों से युक्त मनोहर शिला वाला एक वाराह नाम का पव॑ंत है, जिसमें अनेक कन्दरा, दरी, गृहा और झरने हैं

verses.transliteration: ahaṃ dāsyāmi dhānyaṃ vā vāsāṃsi draviṇaṃ bahu / nityamācara dharmaṃ tvaṃ dhyāyannityaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: The traits of Treta Age continue to one-fourth of the Sandhya and the traits in the Sandhya continue to one-fourth of the Yuga. How did Yajna function in the beginning of Treta age formerly in the Svayambhuva Manvantara? Please explain it precisely. How did they again make the classification and arrangement of the castes and stages of life when the Sandhya too had elapsed along with Kjrta Age and a fraction of it alone remained, and Treta age set in? How was Yajfia made to func¬ tion, after gathering all the requisites.
verses.hindi: उससे निर्मल जल वाली वा ही नाम की पवित्र तीर्थ तथा तरज़्जुंधारण करने वाली नदी निकली है। वाराह रूपधारी विष्ण को ही वहाँ की प्रजा नमस्कार करती है और किसी भी देव को नहीं इस प्रकार मैंने चारों दिशाओं में वबतंमान छः अनुद्वीपों का वर्णन किया। भारतद्वीप दक्षिण दिशा में अति

verses.transliteration: śabara uvāca: naivāhaṃ kāmaye vittaṃ na dhānyaṃ vastrameva ca / yo yasyaivānnamaśnāti sa tasyāśnāti kilbiṣam
verses.translation: I shall mention how in the beginning of Treta Age Yajna was set in vogue. When there was plenty of rain, the plants grew and agriculture became established. People set about building houses, hermitages and cities. Then Indra the, Thus, Indra, the enjoyer of the universe, along with other Devas, initiated Tafia (the institution of sacrifice) together with all its requisites. When the horse-sacrifice was instituted, the sages arrived there and began to perform sacrifices with the holy sacrificial beasts. On hearing about it, people assembled there to witness it. When the Rtviks were busily engaged in sacrificial rites, when the Vedic mantras were recited, when the leading Adhvaiyus moved about hurriedly and quickly, when the holy sacrificial beasts were being killed, when the offerings of ghee were poured into the fire by the divine Hotfs, when the noble Devas were invoked and when they partook of their shares in the sacrifice, the sages began to worship Devas in the form of sense-organs (i.e. their presiding deities) who existed m the beginning of the Kalpas. The Adhvaryus who were great sages got ready at the time of praisa to slay the animals. On see¬ ing the animals in their pitiable condition, the great sages col¬ lectively asked Indra 1 —"What is this sacrificial rite of yours?
verses.hindi: ३४६ - वायुपुराणम्

verses.transliteration: rājñyuvāca: kandamūlaphalāhāro bhramitvā bhaikṣyamuttamam / avagāhya sutīrthāni sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Desirous of a rite involving violence to life you have If Your Honour wishes to perform the Yajlia do Verses 97-102 record the Brahmanical protest against arumahsacrificc. verses.transliteration: tato vimuktapāpastu yatkiṃcitkurute śuciḥ / karmaṇā tena pūtastvaṃ sadgatiṃ prāpsyasi dhruvam
verses.translation: In this way Indra, the enjoyer of the universe, was asked by the sages, the seers of Reality: 'Say with what objects, mobile (living) or immobile (inanimate), Yajna shall be performed?' The great sages eagerly seeking truth got tired of the dispute. Coming to a compromise with Indra they asked lord Vasu: "O excessively intelligent king, O son of Uttanapada, how was the procedure of Yajna seen by you? Please tell us. O lord, clear our doubts." On hearing their words, the king remembered the Vedic texts and, without pondering over the strong or weak points, he explained the facts about. Yajna. The king said: "The Yajna shall be performed as laid down in the sacred texts.
verses.hindi: तेना55वृतः समुद्रोई्यं हीपेन लवणोदकाः २ तत्र पुण्या जनपदाध्िराच्च प्रियते प्रजा । कुत एवं हि दुर्भिक्ष्यं जराव्याधिभयं कुतः ॥

verses.translation: Glancing at the world below they said-"For that purpose be quiet. Though a king, you have uttered a lie. So enter the nedier world". As soon as this was uttered, die king entered the nether world. Having been a resident of the No person, even if he be very learned, should express a decisive opinion all by himself, in regard to the disputed points of Dharma. The way of Dharma is very subtle. It has many loopholes and is inscrutable. Excepting Svayambhuva Manu, none of Devas and sages can pronounce a judgment on Dharma. So, violence was not approved as a means to Dharma by the great sages. 2 Thousands and crores of sages have attain¬ ed heaven by means of their activities.
verses.hindi: इसकी सौमा की लम्बाई तिगुनी अधिक है। लवण सागर को यह द्वीप चारों ओर से घेरे हुए है
verses.wordMeaning: Glancing at the world below they said-"For that purpose be quiet. Though a king, you have uttered a lie. So enter the nedier world". As soon as this was uttered, die king entered the nether world. Having been a resident of the No person, even if he be very learned,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Glancing at the world below they said-"For that purpose be quiet. Though a king, you have uttered a lie. So enter the nedier world". As soon as this was uttered, die king entered the nether world. Having been a resident of the No person, even if he be very learned,…

verses.sanskrit: भार्यया सहितो व्याधो हरिं ध्यात्वा पपात ह । नगार्धात् पतितो यावद्गतजीवो नराधिप
verses.transliteration: bhāryayā sahito vyādho hariṃ dhyātvā papāta ha / nagārdhāt patito yāvadgatajīvo narādhipa
verses.translation: Adroha (absence of ill-feeling), Alobha (absence of covetousness), Dama (self-control), Bhutadaya (kindness to living beings), Tapas (penance), Brahmacarya (celibacy), Satya (truthfulness), Anukrosa (compassion and tenderness), Ksama (forgiveness) and Dhrti (fortitude)—these are roots of Dharma but extremely difficult to achieve. Yajna consists of piety and Mantras; Tapas is of the nature of observance of fast; one attains Devas through Yajna and Vairagya (detachment) through penace. Brahmanhood is attained through Kannasannydsa (re¬ nunciation of the fruits of Karman). Assimilation (in the supreme Atman) is obtained through detachment. Kaivalya (complete identity with Brahman) is obtained through perfect knowledge. These are the five goals of life.
verses.hindi: यहाँ के निवासी अत्यन्त पवित्र और दीर्घायु होते हैं। न वहाँ दुर्भिक्ष होता है औौर न किसी को बुढ़ापा एकोनपञ्चाशत्तमोअध्याय: द क्‍ ३४७
verses.wordMeaning: Adroha (absence of ill-feeling), Alobha (absence of covetousness), Dama (self-control), Bhutadaya (kindness to living beings), Tapas (penance), Brahmacarya (celibacy), Satya (truthfulness), Anukrosa (compassion and tenderness),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Adroha (absence of ill-feeling), Alobha (absence of covetousness), Dama (self-control), Bhutadaya (kindness to living beings), Tapas (penance), Brahmacarya (celibacy), Satya (truthfulness), Anukrosa (compassion and tenderness),…

verses.sanskrit: चूर्णीभूतौ हि तौ दृष्ट्वा कुण्डस्योपरि भूमिप । त्रिमुहूर्ते गते काले शबरो भार्यया सह
verses.transliteration: cūrṇībhūtau hi tau dṛṣṭvā kuṇḍasyopari bhūmipa / trimuhūrte gate kāle śabaro bhāryayā saha
verses.translation: Thus, formerly, in the Svayambhuva Manvantara, a The fall of Vasu for supporting animal-sacrifice* shows that violence to life even for religious purpose was condemned at the time of the Puraa. The legend is found in Mbh.Santu 337. 13-16. Verses 114-118 establish the superiority of the path of knowledge (jfiana-marga) over karma-marga including sacrifices. Then, after witnessing that wonderful procedure (of Yajfia) through violence and disregarding the suggestions of Vasu, the sages returned to the place whence they had come.
verses.hindi: तत्रापि पव॑ताः शुञ्नाः सप्तेव सणिभुूषणा: । रत्नाकरास्तथा नच्मस्तासां नामानि वक्ष्यते ( व्म्यहम्) ४४
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, formerly, in the Svayambhuva Manvantara, a The fall of Vasu for supporting animal-sacrifice* shows that violence to life even for religious purpose was condemned at the time of the Puraa. The legend is found in Mbh.Santu 337. 13-16.…

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं विमानमारूढो गतश्चानुत्तमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: divyaṃ vimānamārūḍho gataścānuttamāṃ gatim
verses.translation: When the sages had gone away, Devas completed the Yajna and attained the fruits. It is heard that many Brah- mana-Ksatriya kings had attained Siddhis through penance. These include Priyavrata, Uttanapada, Dhruva, Medhatithi, Vasu, Sumedhas, Virajas, Sankhapat, Rajas, Praclnabarhis, Parjanya, Havirdhana and other kings. These and many other kings attained Siddhis and went to heaven. They were saintly kings of great prowess whose fame was well-established. Hence by all means, in regard to everything, penance surpasses Yajiia. It was by penance that the universe was created by Brahma. So, Yajna can never excel penance. All this (visible universe) has its roots in penance. In this manner Yajna was set in vogue in the Svayambhuva Manvantara. From that time on¬ wards the performance of Yajnas continued as Yugas rolled on.
verses.hindi: प्लक्षेद्वीपे तु बक्ष्यात्रि सप्तद्वीपान्महा चलान् ॥ गोमोदको5त्र प्रथमः पबंतो मेघसंनिभः ॥ ख्यायते तस्य नाञ्रा वे वर्ष गोमेदक तु तत् कर ३६
verses.wordMeaning: When the sages had gone away, Devas completed the Yajna and attained the fruits. It is heard that many Brah- mana-Ksatriya kings had attained Siddhis through penance. These include Priyavrata, Uttanapada, Dhruva, Medhatithi, Vasu, Sumedhas, Virajas, Sankhapat, Rajas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sages had gone away, Devas completed the Yajna and attained the fruits. It is heard that many Brah- mana-Ksatriya kings had attained Siddhis through penance. These include Priyavrata, Uttanapada, Dhruva, Medhatithi, Vasu, Sumedhas, Virajas, Sankhapat, Rajas,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे व्याधस्वर्गगमनवर्णनं नाम सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ५८ उत्तानपाद उवाच: अथातो देवदेवेश भानुमत्यकरोच्च किम् । एष मे संशयो देव कथयस्व प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vyādhasvargagamanavarṇanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 58 uttānapāda uvāca: athāto devadeveśa bhānumatyakarocca kim / eṣa me saṃśayo deva kathayasva prasādataḥ
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall explain the traits of Dvapara 1 age. When Treta Yuga ends, Dvapara sets in. In the beginning of Dvapara, the attainment of Siddhis by the people is as it was in Treta Yuga. But as the Yuga advances, the Siddhis disappear. This chapter describes the state of society, religion, religious texts etc. in Dvapara Age. The deterioration and confusion in social, religious and other conditions in Dvapara show how a backround of chaotic conditions was developing for Kali Age. Then the following vices begin to appear in the people at the time of Dvapara.: covetousness, lack of fortitude, trading mentality, war-mindedness, indecision about principles, inter-mixture of castes, indecision about duties, destruction of sacrificial plants and animals, pride, arrogance, impatience and weakness. These vices provoked by Rajas and Tamas Gunas prevail in Dvapara Age.
verses.hindi: पत्चमः सोमको नाम देवेयंत्रामृतं पुरा । संभूतं संहतं चेव मातुरर्थ गरुत्मता द

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं सा गता कुण्डस्य सन्निधौ । दृष्ट्वा कुण्डस्य माहात्म्यं राज्ञी हर्षेण पूरिता
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: cintayitvā muhūrtaṃ sā gatā kuṇḍasya sannidhau / dṛṣṭvā kuṇḍasya māhātmyaṃ rājñī harṣeṇa pūritā
verses.translation: In Krta Age Dharma is natural; in Treta it is sought and attained. In Dvapara it becomes agitated and intensly affected, and in Kali it perishes. In Kali Age the order of the castes gets destroyed. The discipline of the different stages of life is disturbed and confused. Doubts (due to variance) in Srutis and Smjtis begin to rise. Owing to the difference between Srutis and Smrtis, no decision is arrived at. Due to indecision, principles of Dharma cannot be declared. When the principles diverge, there is diffe¬ rence of opinion among men. In view of the defects in the causes and the indecisions therein, differences in opinion arise leading to these peculiarities of outlook (or philosophy).
verses.hindi: वेश्राजः सप्तमस्तत्न अ्राजिष्णः स्फाटिको महान् । यस्माद्वि श्राजतेर्धचिभियेंश्राजस्तेन स स्मृतः: या रोग सताता है। वहाँ मणियों से भूषित छुश्र वर्ण के सात पव॑त और रत्नों को उत्पन्न करने वाली नदियाँ हैं। इनके नामों को भी कह रहा हूँ, सुनिये ।३-४॥ इन प्लक्षादि सात द्वीपों में सीधे-सीधे ओर बड़े-बड़े सात पव॑त चारों ओर वतंमान हैं! पहले हम प्लक्ष द्वीप के सातों महाचलों को कहेंगे । यहूं मेघ के तुल्य पहला गोमेदक नाम का पर्वत है । उसी के नाम पर वह देश गोमेदक कहलाता है ।१-६। दूसरे पर्वत
verses.wordMeaning: In Krta Age Dharma is natural; in Treta it is sought and attained. In Dvapara it becomes agitated and intensly affected, and in Kali it perishes. In Kali Age the order of the castes gets destroyed. The discipline of the different stages of life is disturbed and confused.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In Krta Age Dharma is natural; in Treta it is sought and attained. In Dvapara it becomes agitated and intensly affected, and in Kali it perishes. In Kali Age the order of the castes gets destroyed. The discipline of the different stages of life is disturbed and confused.…

verses.sanskrit: विप्रान् बहून् समाहूय पूजयामास तत्क्षणात् । दत्त्वा तु विधिवद्दानं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नृपात्मज
verses.transliteration: viprān bahūn samāhūya pūjayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt / dattvā tu vidhivaddānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nṛpātmaja
verses.translation: Multiplicity of scriptures has been created by the people of different (philosophical) outlooks. A single unified Veda is divided into four in Treta Age. Due to the short span of life as found in Dvapara Yuga, the Veda is classified into four by Vedavyasas (in Dvapara Yugas). The Vedas are further sub-divided into Mantras and Brahmanas by the descendants of sages by alterations on ac¬ cents, syllables etc. in accordance with their different outlooks. The Samhitas of the Rk, Saman and Yajur Vedas were compiled by sages expert in Srutis occasionally with general and special (known as Vedic Ft krtis) changes according to different standpoints.
verses.hindi: का नाम है चन्द्र । इस पर सब ओषधियाँ मिलती हैं। अप्ृत के लिये सब ओषधियाँ यहाँ अश्विनी कुमारों के द्वारा स्थापित हुई हैं। तीसरे पर्वत का नाम नारद है। यह ऊँचा पव॑त दुर्गंशल नाम से भी प्रसिद्ध है। इसी पहाड़ पर पूर्व काल में नारद और पर्वत ऋषि उत्पन्न हुए थे। चौथे पर्वत का नाम है दुर्दुभि । इसी पर्वत पर पहले देवों ने वह नगाड़ा बजाया था, जिसकी ध्वनि सुनते ही जीव मर जाते थे । रज्जुदार, और
