verses.sanskrit: निश्चयं परमं कृत्वा स्थिता शान्तेन चेतसा । ततः सम्पूज्य विधिवत्पित्ःन्देवान् नराधिप
verses.transliteration: niścayaṃ paramaṃ kṛtvā sthitā śāntena cetasā / tataḥ sampūjya vidhivatpitḥndevān narādhipa
verses.translation: Consequently Brahmana (works), Kalpa Sutras and Mantra-Pravacanas (different scriptural texts) came into existence. In Dvapara Age Brahmanas began to disregard the rules of conduct and stages of life. Formerly there was one Yajurveda; later it was bifurcated (into &ukla and ICrsna Yajurveda). This entire scriptural lore became confused by the general and perverted interpretations. By the discourses on (the interpretation of) the Yajurveda, it was greatly impaired. So also, by means of innumerable alterations and variations, the Atharvan, Rk and Saman have been confused in Dvapara by the people of different views.
verses.hindi: शाल्मल आदि अधुर यहीं मारे गये हैं ।७-९६। पांचवाँ सोमक नामक परत है, जिस पर प्राचीन काल में देवों ने अमृत रखा था और गदड़ ने उसे अपनी माता के लिये हर लिया था। छठें पर्वत का नाम सुमना या ऋषभ है । यहीं वराह भगवान् ने हिण्ण्याक्ष को मारा था। सातवें पंत का नाम है वैश्राज। यह महा पर्वत दीप्तिमान् और स्फटिकमय है । अपनी प्रभा से ही भासमान होने के कारण इसका नाम वैश्नाज पड़ा ।१०-१२॥। बहाँ के देशों को भी हम यथाक्रम कहते हैं । प्रथम गोमेद पर्व॑त का प्रदेश शान्तमय कहा गया है।१३॥ चन्द्र का
verses.wordMeaning: Consequently Brahmana (works), Kalpa Sutras and Mantra-Pravacanas (different scriptural texts) came into existence. In Dvapara Age Brahmanas began to disregard the rules of conduct and stages of life. Formerly there was one Yajurveda;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Consequently Brahmana (works), Kalpa Sutras and Mantra-Pravacanas (different scriptural texts) came into existence. In Dvapara Age Brahmanas began to disregard the rules of conduct and stages of life. Formerly there was one Yajurveda;…

verses.sanskrit: क्षपयित्वा पक्षमेकं मधुमासस्य सा स्थिता । अमावास्यां ततो राज्ञी गता पर्वतसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: kṣapayitvā pakṣamekaṃ madhumāsasya sā sthitā / amāvāsyāṃ tato rājñī gatā parvatasannidhau
verses.translation: These diverse and different versions do not perish in spite of alterations in Dvapara Age. They continue to function but in Kaliyuga they perish. Effects of these contrarieties and errors take shape in Dvapara itself as calamities such as draughts, premature deaths, epidemics. Due to miseries born of verbal, mental and physical acts, despondency and indifference to worldly life sets in, as a result of which they begin to ponder over the ways of relief from misery. The pondering.leads to detachment; from detach¬ ment, defects (of the worldly life) are seen. As a result of seeing defects, there is the possibility of spiritual knowledge in Dvapara Age.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रस्य शिखरं नाम नारदस्य सुखोदयम् । आमरनदं दुन्दुसेवंर्ष सोमकस्य शिव स्मृतम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: These diverse and different versions do not perish in spite of alterations in Dvapara Age. They continue to function but in Kaliyuga they perish. Effects of these contrarieties and errors take shape in Dvapara itself as calamities such as draughts, premature deaths, epidemics.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These diverse and different versions do not perish in spite of alterations in Dvapara Age. They continue to function but in Kaliyuga they perish. Effects of these contrarieties and errors take shape in Dvapara itself as calamities such as draughts, premature deaths, epidemics.…

verses.sanskrit: नगशृङ्गं समारुह्य कृत्वा मुकुलितौ करौ । विज्ञाप्य ब्राह्मणान् सर्वान् इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: nagaśṛṅgaṃ samāruhya kṛtvā mukulitau karau / vijñāpya brāhmaṇān sarvān idaṃ vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: In Dvapara Age, rival (scriptures and sects) crop up against the scriptures which were honoured formerly in the first Svayambhuva Manvantara. There are variations and alterations in the science of Ayurveda, Jyotisa and the ancillaries of the Vedas; there are doubts and variations in regard to the texts on political economy and logic. There are diversities and variations in the Smrti texts. Separate systems and schools (of theology and philosophy) are established. In Dvapara Yuga difference of opinion starts among men. The life of all living beings in Dvapara Age be¬ comes arduous involving bodily strain. Livelihood is possible only by mental, verbal and physical strain.
verses.hindi: एतेषु देवगन्धर्वा: सिद्धाश्र सह चारणेः । विहरन्ति रमस्ते च दृश्यमानास्तु ते: सह १५ (अनुतप्ता सुतप्तेव निष्पापा भुदिता क़तुः । असृता सुकृता चेव सप्तेताः सरितां वराः) ३१७ अभिगच्छन्ति ता नद्यस्ताभ्यश्रान्याः सहस्नशः । बहृदकाभ्रौघवत्यो यतो वर्षति बासवः ११८ ताः पिबन्ति सदा हृष्टा नदीज॑नपदास्तु ते। शुभाः शान्तवहाश्चेव प्रमोदा ये च ते शिवा: ॥१€ आनन्दाश्र श्रुवाश्चेव क्षेमकाश्न शिव: सह । वर्णाभ्रमाचारयुक्ताः प्रजास्तेष्वथ सर्वशः
verses.wordMeaning: In Dvapara Age, rival (scriptures and sects) crop up against the scriptures which were honoured formerly in the first Svayambhuva Manvantara. There are variations and alterations in the science of Ayurveda, Jyotisa and the ancillaries of the Vedas;…
verses.commentary: Sense: In Dvapara Age, rival (scriptures and sects) crop up against the scriptures which were honoured formerly in the first Svayambhuva Manvantara. There are variations and alterations in the science of Ayurveda, Jyotisa and the ancillaries of the Vedas;…

verses.sanskrit: मम माता पिता भ्राता ये चान्ये सखिबान्धवाः । क्षमापयित्वा सर्वांस्तान्वचनं मम कथ्यताम्
verses.transliteration: mama mātā pitā bhrātā ye cānye sakhibāndhavāḥ / kṣamāpayitvā sarvāṃstānvacanaṃ mama kathyatām
verses.translation: Covetousness, lack of fortitude, mercantile activi¬ ties, wars, indecision in regard to philosophical principles, handling and editing of the Vedic texts, inter-mixture of holy rites, diseases, - sickness, greed, slaughter, breakdown in the system and rules of castes and stages of life, and susceptibility to passion and hatred —all these are rampant in Dvapara Age. The traits of Dvapara are evident in the Sandliya period but a little. They become deficient in quality. In the quarter of the Sandhya period, a part of it persists. Now listen and understand the traits of Kaliyuga 1. At the close of transitional period of Dvapara, Kaliyuga begins. These are the characteristics of Kaliyuga: violence, jealousy, falsehood, deception and slaughter of ascetics. These are the characteristics of Kali Age which people inherit.
verses.hindi: न तत्रास्ति युगावस्था चतुर्युगक्ृता कवचित् । त्रेतायुगसमः काल: सर्वंदा तत्र बतंते २२ प्लक्षद्वोपादिषु शेयः पञ्चस्वेतेषु सबंशः । देशस्यानुविधानेन कालस्यानुविधाः स्मृताः २३ पत्च॒ वर्षसहल्लाणि तेषु जीवन्ति मानवाः । सुरूपाश्च सुवेधाभ्वय अरोगा बलिनस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Covetousness, lack of fortitude, mercantile activi¬ ties, wars, indecision in regard to philosophical principles, handling and editing of the Vedic texts, inter-mixture of holy rites, diseases, - sickness, greed, slaughter,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Covetousness, lack of fortitude, mercantile activi¬ ties, wars, indecision in regard to philosophical principles, handling and editing of the Vedic texts, inter-mixture of holy rites, diseases, - sickness, greed, slaughter,…

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्पुत्री शूलभेदे तु तपः कृत्वा स्वशक्तितः । विसृज्य चैव सात्मानं तस्मिंस्तीर्थे दिवं ययौ
verses.transliteration: tvatputrī śūlabhede tu tapaḥ kṛtvā svaśaktitaḥ / visṛjya caiva sātmānaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe divaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Affected by the traits of the Age, entire Dharma de¬ teriorates. It is doubtful whether the livelihood (of the people) can be achieved even by putting up mental strain, physical exertion or prayers. In Kali Age, there are fatal diseases. There is perpetual fear of hunger. There is terrible danger of drought. Vision is blurred and rendered perverse. In Kaliyuga, people do not accept the authority of Smrtis. Some die in the womb, others die in youth. Some die in old age and some in childhood, in Kali Yuga. In Kali age people are unrighteous, unmindful of the rules of conduct, fierce in anger but deficient in power and splendour. They always utter falsehood.
verses.hindi: सुखमायुबलं रूपमारोग्यं धर्म एवं च। प्लक्षद्वीपादिषु ज्ञेयं शाकद्वीपान्तकेषु च शिखर, नारद का सुखोदय, दुन्दुभि का आनन्द, सोम का शिव, ऋषभ का क्षेमक और वंशञ्राज का प्रदेग प्र्व कहा गया ।१४। इन स्थानों में देव गन्धव सिद्ध और चारणगण रमण करते हुए और विहरते हुए देखे जाते हैं। इन सातों देशों में समुद्रगामिनी सात नदियाँ हैं। इन महानदियों को सप्त गंगा कहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Affected by the traits of the Age, entire Dharma de¬ teriorates. It is doubtful whether the livelihood (of the people) can be achieved even by putting up mental strain, physical exertion or prayers. In Kali Age, there are fatal diseases. There is perpetual fear of hunger.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Affected by the traits of the Age, entire Dharma de¬ teriorates. It is doubtful whether the livelihood (of the people) can be achieved even by putting up mental strain, physical exertion or prayers. In Kali Age, there are fatal diseases. There is perpetual fear of hunger.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः । संदेशं कथयिष्यामस्त्वयोक्तं शोभनव्रते । मातापितृभ्यां सुश्रोणि मा ते ऽभूदत्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ / saṃdeśaṃ kathayiṣyāmastvayoktaṃ śobhanavrate / mātāpitṛbhyāṃ suśroṇi mā te 'bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: There is danger and fear to people owing to wrong performance of sacrifices, neglect of (Vedic) studies, evil con¬ duct, misleading religious scriptures and faults in the perform¬ ance of holy rites of Brahmanas. This gloomy picture of Kali Age is found in almost all Purajjas e.g. Mbh. Vana. chs. 188i 190, Br. P. chs. 229-230, Mt. 32-47, VP. VI. 1. There is much of agitation and turbulence at the advent of Kaliyuga. There is no regular study of the Vedas. The Braha- manas do not perform Yajnas. All men inclusive of Ksattriyas and Vaisyas gradually decay. Kings are mainly Sudras propagating heretic ideas. People never hesitate to kill a child in the womb. They behave in such a way.
verses.hindi: इनके नाम हैं--अनुतप्ता, सुतप्ता, निष्पापा, मुदिता, ऋतु, अमृता और सुकृता । ये सातों द्वीप सब नदियों में श्रेष्ठ हैं। इनमें हजारों नदियाँ निकल कर बहती रहती हैं। ये नदियाँ विपुल जलवाली और वेगवती हैं इसलिये कि देवराज यहीं अधिक वृष्टि किया करते हैं। वहाँ के निवासी उन्हीं नदियों के जल को पीकर प्रसन्न रहते हैं ।(७-१८। शुभ, शान्तवहा, प्रमोदा, शिवा, आनन्दा, ध्रूवा और क्षेमका यथाक्रम से उन देशों
verses.wordMeaning: There is danger and fear to people owing to wrong performance of sacrifices, neglect of (Vedic) studies, evil con¬ duct, misleading religious scriptures and faults in the perform¬ ance of holy rites of Brahmanas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is danger and fear to people owing to wrong performance of sacrifices, neglect of (Vedic) studies, evil con¬ duct, misleading religious scriptures and faults in the perform¬ ance of holy rites of Brahmanas.…

verses.sanskrit: ततो विसृज्य तांल्लोकान् स्थिता पर्वतमूर्धनि । अर्धोत्तरीयवस्त्रेण गाढं बद्धा पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: tato visṛjya tāṃllokān sthitā parvatamūrdhani / ardhottarīyavastreṇa gāḍhaṃ baddhā punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: Longevity, intellect, strength, beauty and familyprestige decline. Sudras behave like Brahmanas and Brahmanas adopt the ways of Sudras. When the end of the Yuga approaches, thieves and robbers administer kingdoms like kings; kings adopt the methods of thieves and robbers. Servants are bereft of love, friendship and loyalty (to their masters). Women become unchaste and disinterested in holy rites. They become fond of wine and meat. When Kali Age sets in, they resort to deceptive means. In Kali Age beasts of prey become more numerous and owerful. Cattles die and dwindle. Saintly men withdraw and keep aloof.
verses.hindi: की नदियाँ हैं । यहाँ की प्रजा वर्णाश्रम धर्म से युक्त, नीरोग, बलिष्ठ और आधिव्याधि से रहित हैं। उनके विचार न अत्युच्च हैं और न अति नीच। प्लक्ष आदि पाँच द्वीपों में सदा ज्रेता युग के समान काल व्यतीत होता है ।!६-२२। वहाँ सत्ययुग आदि चारों युग नहीं होते हैं। देशाचार और कालन-माहात्म्य से बहाँ के निवासी पाँच हजार व्ं जीवित रहते हैं। वहाँ वाले सुरूप, सुवेष, मीरोग और बली होते हैं। प्लक्ष आदि द्वीपों की ही भाँति शाक द्वीप में भी सुख, आयु, बल, रूप आदि सभी गुण-धर्म हैं ।२३-२५। श्रीसम्पन्न प्लक्ष
verses.wordMeaning: Longevity, intellect, strength, beauty and familyprestige decline. Sudras behave like Brahmanas and Brahmanas adopt the ways of Sudras. When the end of the Yuga approaches, thieves and robbers administer kingdoms like kings; kings adopt the methods of thieves and robbers.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Longevity, intellect, strength, beauty and familyprestige decline. Sudras behave like Brahmanas and Brahmanas adopt the ways of Sudras. When the end of the Yuga approaches, thieves and robbers administer kingdoms like kings; kings adopt the methods of thieves and robbers.…

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चिक्षेप सात्मानम् एकचित्ता नराधिप । नगार्द्धे पतिता यावत्तावद्दृष्टाः सुराङ्गनाः
verses.transliteration: tataścikṣepa sātmānam ekacittā narādhipa / nagārddhe patitā yāvattāvaddṛṣṭāḥ surāṅganāḥ
verses.translation: At that time excessively fruitful but very subtle Dharma becomes difficult of access. Since the conduct of life of those who enjoy, in the various stages of life, is loose and un¬ bridled, Dharma gets shaken. Then, when the end of the age approaches, even the great goddess like the earth will yield but little fruit. Sudras will begin to perform penance. But piety practised for one day (in Kali Yuga) is equal to that practised for a month in Dvapara and a year in Treta Age. The kings never protect the subjects. They appro¬ priate their shares in oblations. Towards the end of the Yuga, they become eager solely to protect themselves.
verses.hindi: धनुदिच्वान्तंगतग्रन्थः क. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: At that time excessively fruitful but very subtle Dharma becomes difficult of access. Since the conduct of life of those who enjoy, in the various stages of life, is loose and un¬ bridled, Dharma gets shaken. Then, when the end of the age approaches,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time excessively fruitful but very subtle Dharma becomes difficult of access. Since the conduct of life of those who enjoy, in the various stages of life, is loose and un¬ bridled, Dharma gets shaken. Then, when the end of the age approaches,…

verses.sanskrit: भोभो वत्से महाभागे भानुमत्यतितापसि । दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य कैलासं प्रति गम्यताम्
verses.transliteration: bhobho vatse mahābhāge bhānumatyatitāpasi / divyaṃ vimānamāruhya kailāsaṃ prati gamyatām
verses.translation: The kings do not belong to the Ksattriya clan. Vaisyas maintain themselves with the help of Sudras. The noble Brahmanas perform obeisance to Sudras at the end of Kali Age. In Kali Age there will be (wicked) persons in the guise of sages. When the Yuga is about to come to a close, the god of rains will shower in a mysteriously haphazard manner. In this base Yuga, people will have trading propensity, By false measures, the buyers will be deceived of their due share in the commodities. The whole society abounds in Heretics of foul conduct and activity with their false appearance. Men will be in a minority and women will be many, when the end of Kaliyuga is imminent.
verses.hindi: एकोनपञ्चाशत्तमोध्ध्याय: द ३४५ प्लक्षद्वीपस्य चबेह वेपुल्याविद्वस्तरेण तु । इत्येष संनिवेशों वः प्लक्षद्वीपस्थ कीतितः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The kings do not belong to the Ksattriya clan. Vaisyas maintain themselves with the help of Sudras. The noble Brahmanas perform obeisance to Sudras at the end of Kali Age. In Kali Age there will be (wicked) persons in the guise of sages.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The kings do not belong to the Ksattriya clan. Vaisyas maintain themselves with the help of Sudras. The noble Brahmanas perform obeisance to Sudras at the end of Kali Age. In Kali Age there will be (wicked) persons in the guise of sages.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा पश्यतां तेषां जनानां त्रिदिवं गता
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ janānāṃ tridivaṃ gatā
verses.translation: No one helps in return for the help received. People will get emaciated and weak. They will indulge unhesitatingly in the activities causing downfall. That is the characteristic of the Yuga coming to a close. The earth will be devoid of good men. It will be deso¬ late. In countries and cities, there will be groups and cliques. The earth will be deficient in water and less fertile. Protectors (i.e. those who ought to protect) will not protect. They will not exercise control over the administration. People will take away others' gems and jewels. They will molest other men's wives. They will be passionate with a wicked heart. They will revel in violent sinful activities,
verses.hindi: आनुषुर्व्या समासेन शाल्मलं त॑ं निबोधत २६
verses.wordMeaning: No one helps in return for the help received. People will get emaciated and weak. They will indulge unhesitatingly in the activities causing downfall. That is the characteristic of the Yuga coming to a close. The earth will be devoid of good men. It will be deso¬ late.…
verses.commentary: Sense: No one helps in return for the help received. People will get emaciated and weak. They will indulge unhesitatingly in the activities causing downfall. That is the characteristic of the Yuga coming to a close. The earth will be devoid of good men. It will be deso¬ late.…

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: इति ते कथितः सर्वः शूलभेदस्य विस्तरः । यः श्रुतः शङ्करात्पूर्वमृषिदेवसमागमे
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: iti te kathitaḥ sarvaḥ śūlabhedasya vistaraḥ / yaḥ śrutaḥ śaṅkarātpūrvamṛṣidevasamāgame
verses.translation: The men have unlikeable consciousness (?) They keep their hair untied and dishevelled. Towards theclose of the Yuga, men less than sixteen years will begin to procreate. When theclose of Yuga is imminent, Sudrasexhibiting their white teeth, with clean shaven heads and wearing ochre- coloured robes will perform sacred rites, proclaiming that they have conquered the sense-organs. 1 Probably a reference to Buddhist monks, as Buddhism prevailed all over India at the time of these Puranas. There will be thieves stealing foodcrops and garments. There will be looters robbing other robbers and abductors of murderers.
verses.hindi: तत्रापि पता: सप्त विज्ञेया रत्नयोनयः । रत्नाकरास्था नचस्तेषु वर्षेषु सप्तसु (३१ चतुर्थ: पब॑तो द्रोणो यत्रोषध्यों महाबलाः। विशल्यकरणी चेव मृतसंजीवनी तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The men have unlikeable consciousness (?) They keep their hair untied and dishevelled. Towards theclose of the Yuga, men less than sixteen years will begin to procreate. When theclose of Yuga is imminent, Sudrasexhibiting their white teeth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The men have unlikeable consciousness (?) They keep their hair untied and dishevelled. Towards theclose of the Yuga, men less than sixteen years will begin to procreate. When theclose of Yuga is imminent, Sudrasexhibiting their white teeth,…

verses.sanskrit: य इदं पठते भक्त्या तीर्थे देवकुले ऽपि वा । स मुच्यते महापापादपि जन्मशतार्जितात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ paṭhate bhaktyā tīrthe devakule 'pi vā / sa mucyate mahāpāpādapi janmaśatārjitāt
verses.translation: When perfect knowledge and holy rites disappear in Abundance, welfare, good health and ability will be¬ come rare. Owls will begin to infest the countries afflicted by the fear of hunger. The maximum life expectation of the people afflicted by misery will be a hundred years. In Kali Yuga, the Vedas will be seen in some places and not seen in some places. Yajnas are forsaken when Dharma receives a setback. There will be many types of heretics like wearers of ochre-coloured robes (Buddhists), Jainas and Kapalikas (skull-bearing mendicants). There will be sellers of the Vedas and of the sacred places. Heretics antagonistic to the discipline and arrangement of different castes and stages oflife will be born. When Kali Yuga sets in, the Vedas will not be studied. Sudras will be experts and authorities in the affairs of Dharma.
verses.hindi: दीप, कीतिमानू, और धत धान्य से सभी प्रकार पूर्ण है । ब्राह्मणो ! प्लक्ष द्वीप दिव्यौषधि, और फलों से युक्त तथा सर्वषधि वनस्पतियों से पूर्ण है। हजारों ग्राम्य और जंगली पश्ु वहाँ पाये जाते हैं। जम्बू वक्ष की ही तरह उस देश के भी मध्य में प्लक्ष नामक एक महावक्ष है। उसी के नाम से वह प्लक्ष द्वीप कहलाता है ।२६-२७। उस देश के पूज्य देवता हैं स्थाणु । वह प्लक्ष द्वीप ईख-रस के स,गर से घिरा हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: When perfect knowledge and holy rites disappear in Abundance, welfare, good health and ability will be¬ come rare. Owls will begin to infest the countries afflicted by the fear of hunger. The maximum life expectation of the people afflicted by misery will be a hundred years.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When perfect knowledge and holy rites disappear in Abundance, welfare, good health and ability will be¬ come rare. Owls will begin to infest the countries afflicted by the fear of hunger. The maximum life expectation of the people afflicted by misery will be a hundred years.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महा च सुरापी च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः । गोघाती स्त्रीविघाती च देवब्रह्मस्वहारकः
verses.transliteration: brahmahā ca surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ / goghātī strīvighātī ca devabrahmasvahārakaḥ
verses.translation: Kings born of Sudra women will not perform Yajnas. The subjects will murder women and slaughter cows. Coming to mutual clash, they will kill one another. And in this way, people will try to accomplish (their object). This is the condition in Kali Age. Now under¬ stand the condition in the part of the junction ( Sandhyariifa) from me. In every Yuga the achievements ( Siddkis ) shrink and dwindle by three-fourths. In accordance with the nature of the Yuga, the Sandhyas stay by a quarter. In accordance with the nature of the Sandhyas they are established in their parts by a quarter. Thus when the period of junction ( Sandhyaihia ) approaches at the close of the (Kali)Yuga, a king, the chastiser of the wicked people, will be bom after the death (fall) of Bhrgus. He (will be) Candramas by Golra (of the Lunar race). lie will be called Pramiti. He was born of a part of Visnu formerly in the Svayarhbliuva Manvantara. He was surrounded by hundreds and thousands of Brahmanas armed with weapons. He killed Mlecchas in thousands.
verses.hindi: है। ब्राह्मणो ! आप लोगों के निकट हमने प्लक्ष द्वीप की विपुलता और देश विभाग को विस्तार के साथ कह दिया । अब शाल्मल द्वीप का वर्णन संक्षेत्र में सुनिये ।२८-२६। द्वीपों में उत्तम तीसरा शाल्मल द्वीप है। ईख रस के सागर को यह शाल्मल द्वीप घेरे हुए है। प्लक्ष द्वीप से यह दुगुना अधिक बड़ा है ।३०। यहाँ भी रत्नों को उत्पन्न करने वाले सात पव॑त हैं और उन सातों वर्ष-प्॑तों से रत्न को उत्पन्न करने वाली सात नदियाँ निकली हैं। पहला सूर्य की तरह तेजोमय कुमुद पर्वत है। इसके अनेक धातुमय शिबरों से अतेकानेक शिलामालायें उत्पन्न हुई हैं।३१-२३२। दूसरा फ्वेत उन्नत नाम से विख्यात है। इसके आकाश छुने वाले शिखर हूरिताल के हैं। तीसरे पर्वत का नाम वलाहक है। यह अपने अञ्जनतुल्य शिखरों से आकाश को छ रहा है ३३-३४। चौथे परत का नाम द्रोग है। इस पर विशल्यकरणी और मृत संजीवनी
verses.wordMeaning: Kings born of Sudra women will not perform Yajnas. The subjects will murder women and slaughter cows. Coming to mutual clash, they will kill one another. And in this way, people will try to accomplish (their object). This is the condition in Kali Age.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Kings born of Sudra women will not perform Yajnas. The subjects will murder women and slaughter cows. Coming to mutual clash, they will kill one another. And in this way, people will try to accomplish (their object). This is the condition in Kali Age.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वामिद्रोही मित्रघाती तथा विश्वासघातकः । परन्यासापहारी च परनिक्षेपलोपकः
verses.transliteration: svāmidrohī mitraghātī tathā viśvāsaghātakaḥ / paranyāsāpahārī ca paranikṣepalopakaḥ
verses.translation: He went everywhere. After killing the kings born of Siidra women, he exterminated the heretics. He killed thousands of persons who were not religious and righteous. He killed those born of mixed castes as well as those who depended on them. He killed the Udicyas (northerners), Madhya Deiyas (people of the Middle Land), mountain-dwellers, easterners, westerners, dwellers in Vindhya and Aparanta. He killed the southerners, Dravidas, Simhalas, Gandharas, Paradas, Pahlavas, Yavanas, Tusaras, Barbaras, Cxnas, Sulikas, Daradas, Khasas, Lampakas, Ketas, and the different tribes of Kiratas. Setting his wheel (of religious victory) inmotion, the powerful lord, the destroyer of Mlecchas, roamed over the earth. He could not be thwarted by any living being.
verses.hindi: हैप० द वायुपूराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: He went everywhere. After killing the kings born of Siidra women, he exterminated the heretics. He killed thousands of persons who were not religious and righteous. He killed those born of mixed castes as well as those who depended on them. He killed the Udicyas (northerners),…
verses.commentary: Sense: He went everywhere. After killing the kings born of Siidra women, he exterminated the heretics. He killed thousands of persons who were not religious and righteous. He killed those born of mixed castes as well as those who depended on them. He killed the Udicyas (northerners),…

verses.sanskrit: रसभेदी तुलाभेदी तथा वार्द्धुषिकस्तु यः । यः कन्याविघ्नकर्ता च तथा विक्रयकारकः
verses.transliteration: rasabhedī tulābhedī tathā vārddhuṣikastu yaḥ / yaḥ kanyāvighnakartā ca tathā vikrayakārakaḥ
verses.translation: He was born of a part of Lord Visnu. This valorous hero was known as Pramiti by people knowing what happened in the previous birth. When he thus passed away along with his ministers and faithful soldiers, after exterminating all the kings and Mle- cchas in thousands, when the period of the part of Sandhya arrived at the end of the Yuga, and when only a few of the people remained scattered here and there, the unchecked people became active in the world in groups. They harassed one another and sought help of one another. When anarchy prevailed as a result of the Yuga (com¬ ing to a close), and when there was doubt and suspense every¬ where among the subjects, they became frightened of one an¬
verses.hindi: बष्ठस्तु पर्वतस्तत्र महिषो सेघसबन्निभ: । यस्मिन्सो5ग्निनिवसति सहिषो नास वारिजः सप्तमः पबंतस्तत्र ककुझन्नाम भाष्यते । तत्र रत्नान्यनेकानि स्वयं वर्षति वासवः ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: He was born of a part of Lord Visnu. This valorous hero was known as Pramiti by people knowing what happened in the previous birth. When he thus passed away along with his ministers and faithful soldiers, after exterminating all the kings and Mle- cchas in thousands,…

verses.sanskrit: परभार्या भ्रातृभार्या गौः स्नुषा कन्यका तथा । अभिगामी परद्वेषी तथा धर्मप्रदूषकः
verses.transliteration: parabhāryā bhrātṛbhāryā gauḥ snuṣā kanyakā tathā / abhigāmī paradveṣī tathā dharmapradūṣakaḥ
verses.translation: They wear bark garments and deer skins. They have no wives or sons. They fall off from the system of castes and stages of life. They resort to a terrible promiscuous intermixture of castes. They reach the limit of misery. Only a few of them survive. They arc oppressed by old age, sickness and hunger. Due to misery they become indifferent to worldly existence. Due to this despondency and indifference, they begin to ponder. By pondering over they attain the state of equani¬ mity. In the state of equanimity they are enlightened. Due to enlightenment they become pious. When those subjects surviving at the end of Kali Age are thus enlightened, in a single day and night the Yuga is
verses.hindi: प्रजापतिमुपादाय प्राजापत्ये विधिः स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: They wear bark garments and deer skins. They have no wives or sons. They fall off from the system of castes and stages of life. They resort to a terrible promiscuous intermixture of castes. They reach the limit of misery. Only a few of them survive.…

verses.sanskrit: मुच्यन्ते सर्वे एवैते शूलभेदप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: mucyante sarve evaite śūlabhedaprabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: After making their minds enchanted Krtayuga sets in due to the power of the inevitable destiny. When Krtayuga begins to function again, the few subjects surviving from Kaliyuga become the subjects of Krtayuga. Those Siddhas who stay move about and are seen clearly. The Seven Sages are also ever present there.
verses.hindi: इत्येष संनिवेशों वः शाल्मलस्थापि कोतितः। प्लक्षवुक्षेण संख्यातस्तस्य मध्ये महाद्रुमः ॥४४ड आदि बलदायिनी ओऔषधियाँ हैं। पाँचवें पर्वत का नाम कंक है। यह दिव्य फल-पुंष्ष वाले व॒क्षों और लताओं से घिरा हुआ है ।३५-३६। छठा मेघ की तरह महिष नाम का पव॑त है। इस पर जेल से उत्पन्न महिष नामक अग्नि निवास करते हैं। सातवें ककुझान नामक रत्नमय पर्वत पर वासव उस समय स्वयं वर्षा करते हैं जब कि प्रजापति पहले पहल प्रजा उत्पन्न करना चाहते हैं ।३७-३५। शाल्मल द्वीप में ये ही
verses.wordMeaning: After making their minds enchanted Krtayuga sets in due to the power of the inevitable destiny. When Krtayuga begins to function again, the few subjects surviving from Kaliyuga become the subjects of Krtayuga. Those Siddhas who stay move about and are seen clearly.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After making their minds enchanted Krtayuga sets in due to the power of the inevitable destiny. When Krtayuga begins to function again, the few subjects surviving from Kaliyuga become the subjects of Krtayuga. Those Siddhas who stay move about and are seen clearly.…

verses.sanskrit: य इदं श्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे विप्राणां भुञ्जतां नृप । मुदं प्रयान्ति संहृष्टाः पितरस्तस्य सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe viprāṇāṃ bhuñjatāṃ nṛpa / mudaṃ prayānti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ pitarastasya sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Brahmanas, Ksattriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras who are to serve as seeds for future generation become non-differen- tiated from those who are born of Kali. The Seven Sages instruct them and the others too in the two types ofDharma prescribed by Srutis and Smrtis as well as in the conduct pertaining to the castes and stages of life. Then in Krta Yuga, people (subjects) perform the sacred rites. To the subjects of the Krta Age Dharma based on Srutis and Smrtis is laid down by the Seven Sages. For establishment of Dharma among the subjects, the Sages remain in authority over the whole of Manvantara and stay on (live) to the end of the Yuga.
verses.hindi: सात मणिभूषित पव॑त हैं यहाँ के सातों शुभ देशों को भी अब बता रहे हैं। कुमुद का देश श्वेत, उन्नत का लोहित ।३६। वलाहक का जीमूत; द्रोण को हरित, कंक का वैद्यत,। महिष का सानस ओर ककुद का सुप्रभ देश है। ये सातों सात भागों में विभक्त हैं। इतने ही देश और परत हैं, अब नदियों" का नाम सुनिये । पानीतोया, वितृष्णा, चन्द्रा, शुक्रा, विमोचनी और निवृत्ति, ये ही सात नदियाँ उन देशों की हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmanas, Ksattriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras who are to serve as seeds for future generation become non-differen- tiated from those who are born of Kali.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmanas, Ksattriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras who are to serve as seeds for future generation become non-differen- tiated from those who are born of Kali.…

verses.sanskrit: यश्चेदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या पठ्यमानं नरो वशी । स मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः सर्वकल्याणभाग् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā paṭhyamānaṃ naro vaśī / sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ sarvakalyāṇabhāg bhavet
verses.translation: Just as new shoots grow from the roots of grasses that are burnt during the summer in the forest-fire, so also the new Yuga grows out of the old Yuga. Till the end of the Man¬ vantara this series goes bn without break. In the parts of junctions of Yugas (Sandhyamsas) the Siddhis of Dharma become almost extinct. Thus, O Brahmanas, the Pratisandki (the period of transition between Yugas) has been narrated to you. By means of this alone should all the sets of four Yugas be known. When the set of four Yugas repeats a thousand times, it is the day of god Brahma. His night is also of the same duration. In it, there is simplicity and inactiveness of the Bhutas (elements).
verses.hindi: श्रद्धेय ब्राहणो ! उन नदियों के समीप में बहनेवाली और भी सैकड़ों नदियाँ हैं। उनकी गणना नहीं की जा सकती हैं । इस प्रकार शाल्मल द्वीप की स्थिति के विषय में आप लोगों को कह दिया + प्लक्ष वक्ष की ही तरह यहाँ भी बीच में सेमल (शाल्मलि) का एक वक्ष है, जिसका तता खूब-मोटा है। इसीके नाम से यह देश शाल्मल द्वीप कहलाता है। यह द्वीप सुरासागर से चारों ओर घिरा हुआ है और विस्तार में भी चारों ओर से शाल्मलि के ही अनुरूप है ।४३०-४५॥ धर्मज्ञ ब्राह्मणों ! इससे उत्तर द्वीप में प्रजागण जिस
verses.wordMeaning: Just as new shoots grow from the roots of grasses that are burnt during the summer in the forest-fire, so also the new Yuga grows out of the old Yuga. Till the end of the Man¬ vantara this series goes bn without break.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as new shoots grow from the roots of grasses that are burnt during the summer in the forest-fire, so also the new Yuga grows out of the old Yuga. Till the end of the Man¬ vantara this series goes bn without break.…

verses.sanskrit: इदं यशस्यमायुष्यमिदं पावनमुत्तमम् । पठतां शृण्वतां नृणाम् आयुःकीर्तिविवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamidaṃ pāvanamuttamam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛṇām āyuḥkīrtivivardhanam
verses.translation: This alone is the trait of all Yugas. Seventy-one cycles of the sets of four Yugas occurring successively constitute a Manvantara. In a single set of four Yugas everything happens in the manner you have heard now. In the other sets of four Yugas also the same thing happens in the same order. The differences that occur in the various creations are confined to twentyfive, neither more nor less. So also the Kalpas and the Yugas are similar in characteristics. This alone is the characteristic sign of all the Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: एकोनपञ्चाशत्तमोष्ष्याय: ३५१
verses.wordMeaning: This alone is the trait of all Yugas. Seventy-one cycles of the sets of four Yugas occurring successively constitute a Manvantara. In a single set of four Yugas everything happens in the manner you have heard now.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This alone is the trait of all Yugas. Seventy-one cycles of the sets of four Yugas occurring successively constitute a Manvantara. In a single set of four Yugas everything happens in the manner you have heard now.…

verses.sanskrit: इति कथितमिदं ते शूलभेदस्य पुण्यं महिमन हि मनुष्यैः श्रूयते यत्सपापैः । मदनरिपुतटिन्या याम्यकूलस्थितस्य प्रबलदुरितकन्दोच्छेदकुद्दालकल्पम्
verses.transliteration: iti kathitamidaṃ te śūlabhedasya puṇyaṃ mahimana hi manuṣyaiḥ śrūyate yatsapāpaiḥ / madanariputaṭinyā yāmyakūlasthitasya prabaladuritakandocchedakuddālakalpam
verses.translation: So also the transitions of the Yugas occur naturally. They are eternal as well. But the living beings that undergo modifications in the form of dissolution and re-creation cannot be permanent. The Lord arranges for the creation and the division of castes and stages in the different Yugas in accordance with the nature of those Yugas for the purposes of fulfilling the functions, in the respective Yugas. The topic has been narrated in brief. Now listen to and understand the creation of the world. I shall explain the situation in different Yugas in details and in proper order.
verses.hindi: उत्तरेषु तु धर्मज्ञा द्वीपेषु शुणुत प्रजा:  ययाश्रुतं यथान्यायं ब्रुवतो से निबोधत तेषामन्तरविष्कस्भों द्विगुण: परिवारितः । उद्धिदं प्रथम वर्ष द्वितीयं वेणुमण्डलम् करशर तृतीय॑ स्व॒रथाकारं चतुर्थ लवणं स्पृतम् । पश्चमं धृतिमद्र्ष षष्ठ वर्ष प्रभाकरम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: So also the transitions of the Yugas occur naturally. They are eternal as well. But the living beings that undergo modifications in the form of dissolution and re-creation cannot be permanent.…
verses.commentary: Sense: So also the transitions of the Yugas occur naturally. They are eternal as well. But the living beings that undergo modifications in the form of dissolution and re-creation cannot be permanent.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शूलभेदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः॥ शूलभेदमाहात्म्यं समाप्तम् र्क्व् अध्याय ५९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततः पुष्करिणीं गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् । श्रुते यस्याः प्रभावे तु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| śūlabhedamāhātmyaṃ samāptam rkv adhyāya 59 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchet sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm / śrute yasyāḥ prabhāve tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Listen to and understand the details of those subjects who are born in the different Yugas. I shall mention in which Yuga demons, serpents, cattles, birds, Pisacas, Yaksas and Raksasas are born and how long they live. Pisacas, Asuras, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas and The span of life of human beings, animals, birds and immobile beings fluctuates everywhere in accordance with the Instability in regard to the span of life of living beings is seen in Kali Yuga. verses.hindi: एतेषु देवगन्धर्वाः प्रभास जगदीश्वरा: । विहरन्ति रमन्‍्ते व दृश्यमानास्तु वर्षशः . 0५४

verses.sanskrit: रेवाया उत्तरे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । यत्रास्ते सर्वदा देवो वेदमूर्तिर्दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: revāyā uttare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / yatrāste sarvadā devo vedamūrtirdivākaraḥ
verses.translation: He who is nine Talas high from foot to head with arms extending upto the knees when they are close together, is worshipped even by Devas. In every Yuga the height of cows, horses, elephants, buffaloes and immobile beings varies as follows: The height of horses is fifty Angulas and that of trees is a thousand Angulas less by forty Angulas (i.e. nine hundred sixty). The constitution of the bodies of Devas is as a matter of fact similar to that of human beings. It is said that the body of Devas is endowed with ex¬ ceptional intellect. The human body is said to be equipped with less intelligence than that of Devas. Thus the life of gods and human beings has been ex¬ plained. Now listen to the description of animals, birds and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: तत्रापि नद्यः सप्तेव धुतपापाः शिवाल्तथा । पवित्रा संततिश्चेव द्युतिगर्भा मही तथा ५६ प्रकार निवास करते हैं, उसको जैसा हमने सुना है, वंसा ही कहते हैं, सुनिये । चौथे कुझ द्वीप का वर्णन हम संक्षेप में कहते हैं । यह कुशढ्ीप चारों ओर से सुरासागर को घेरे हुए है। यहाँ भी सात पर्वत हैं। उनका वर्णन सुनिये ।४६-४७३। शाल्मलि द्वीप से यह दूना बड़ा है। कुश द्वीप का पहला पर्वत विद्रमोच्चय है दूसरा
verses.wordMeaning: He who is nine Talas high from foot to head with arms extending upto the knees when they are close together, is worshipped even by Devas. In every Yuga the height of cows, horses, elephants,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is nine Talas high from foot to head with arms extending upto the knees when they are close together, is worshipped even by Devas. In every Yuga the height of cows, horses, elephants,…

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रं यथा पुण्यं सार्वकामिकमुत्तमम् । इदं तीर्थं तथा पुण्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetraṃ yathā puṇyaṃ sārvakāmikamuttamam / idaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: I shall now explain the remaining ones (Sistas or cultured people ) constituting teudiSfc (sains V The Those who are neither infuriated nor elated in regard to the tenfold object of senses and eight types of causes of bondage, are called Jitalmans (who are self-controlled). Inasmuch as Brahmanas, Ksattriyas and VaiSyas are engaged in two types of Dharma, the general and the special, they are called Dvijatis. The knowledge of Srauta and Smarta rites utilised by the different castes in their different stages of life and leading to heaven or salvation is called Real Dharma. A Brahmacarin acting in the interest ofhis preceptor is an ascetic because he amasses learning. A householder is an ascetic because he accomplishes holy rites. A Vaikhanasa is called an ascetic, because he performs penance in the forest. The aspiring ascetic is called Sadhu, because he practises Yogic exercises. Thus all these—the religious student, the house¬ holder, the forest-dwelling hermit and the recluse are called Sadhus because they perform the Airama Dharmas (duties of their stage oflife). Neither Devas, nor Pitrs, nor sages nor human beings can be of different views if they correctly say "This is Dharma", "This is not".
verses.hindi: मन्दराचल है ।४८-५०२  जल का एक नाम मन्दा है और जल का भेदन कर यह परवंत निकला है, इसी से इसका ताम इन पव॑तों के बीच का विस्तार दूने परिमाण का है। पहला उदज्धिद, दूसरा बेणुमण्डल, तीसरा स्वेरथाकार, चौथा लवण, पाँचवाँ धृतिमान्ू, छठा प्रभाकर, सातवाँ कपिल नामक देश वहाँ बसे हैं

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रे यथा वृद्धिर्दानस्य जगतीपते । पुष्करिण्यां तथा दानं वर्धते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetre yathā vṛddhirdānasya jagatīpate / puṣkariṇyāṃ tathā dānaṃ vardhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The two words, " Dharma " and " Adharma " refer to rites. Auspicious rites are Dharmas and inauspicious rites are Adharmas. The word Dharma is derived from V dhr 'to hold' or c to support. If Dharma does not sustain or if it is not con¬ ducive to greatness it is Adharma. The Dharma that leads a person to achieve his desire is taught by preceptors. They call these persons Acaryas pre¬ ceptors: old persons devoid of greediness, self-possessed, non- arrogant, well disciplined and straightforward. A preceptor practises those principles himself; he esta¬ blishes a code of good conduct; he collects (and masters) mean¬ ings of scriptures and is endowed with (practices) restraints and observances. After learning the Vedas from the ancients, the Seven After remembering the code of conduct of life current in the previous Manvantara, they explained it once again. Hence that Dharma is known as Smarta Dharma. It refers to different castes and stages of life.
verses.hindi: इन पव॑तों या पार्वत्य प्रदेशों में ईश्वरीय शक्तिसम्पन्न देव-गन्धर्व रमण करते और विहरते हुए देखे जाते हैं । इन देशों में दस्यु या म्लेचछ कोई भी नहीं है। वहाँ के निवासी गौर वर्ण के होते हैं और उनकी मृत्यु ऋ्रमानुसार ही होती है ।५४-५५। वहाँ भी पापों को दूर करनेवाली और शुभ सात नदियाँ हैं। जिनकी शाखा नदियों भी पविन्न हैं। वहाँ की प्ृत्तिका पवित्र और पृथ्वी तेजोमय है। इन नदियों से और भी संकड़ों-हजारों नदियाँ निकली हैं। इन नदियों में वासव सदा बरसते रहते हैं, इसी से ये सदा बहा करती हैं ।५६-५७। यह कुछ द्वीप घृतसागर से चतुदिक घिरा हुआ है। उसका विस्तार भी कुशद्वीप के समान है। इस प्रकार हमने

verses.sanskrit: यवमेकं तु यो दद्यात् सौवर्णं मस्तके नृप । पुष्करिण्यां तथा स्थानं यथा स्थानं नरे स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: yavamekaṃ tu yo dadyāt sauvarṇaṃ mastake nṛpa / puṣkariṇyāṃ tathā sthānaṃ yathā sthānaṃ nare smṛtam
verses.translation: Both the types of Dharma are called " Sistacara " (the conduct of the cultured). The word Sis fa has come from the word Sesa (survivor, remainder). 1 Hence Sistacara is the conduct of life for those who remain (i.e. survived the Manvantara). The righteous persons who survive after a Manvan¬ tara are Manu and the Seven Sages. They remain for the con¬ tinuity of the people and for the purpose of establishing virtue (Pharma). Manu and other Sistas have been enumerated by me before. That which has been practised regularly in every Yuga by those Sis fas (shall be known as Sistacara). Study of the three Vedas, agriculture, administration of justice and government, sacrifice, adherence to the (the duties of) castes and stages of life—all these are practised by the Sisfas including Manu and his predecessors. That Sistacara is eternal. The following eight are characteristic Sistacaras: charity, truthfulness, penance, absence of greed, learning, sacri¬ fice, procreation and sympathy. Since the Sisfas (survivors), Manu and the Seven Sages, practise this in all the Manvantaras, it is known as Sistacara. That [which is heard (i.e. refers to gratis) shall be known as Srauta (Dharma); that which is remembered (i.e. refers to Sm T lis) is called Smarta (Dharma). Performance ofsacri-

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यग्रहे तु यः स्नात्वा दद्याद् दानं यथाविधि । हस्त्यश्वरथरत्नादि गृहं गाश्च युगंधरान्
verses.transliteration: sūryagrahe tu yaḥ snātvā dadyād dānaṃ yathāvidhi / hastyaśvaratharatnādi gṛhaṃ gāśca yugaṃdharān
verses.translation: After seeing and on being asked about it (if) a person does not conceal facts and states them in proper sequence Celibacy, Japa, silence and fasting—these are the roots of penance. Penance is hard and very difficult of achievement. The sacrificial animals, the requisite materials, the ghee offerings, the Rk, Saman and Yajus Mantras, Rtviks and the sacrificial gifts—the collection of all these constitutes Yajha*. Viewing all living beings as one's own self, looking impartially towards friends and foes is called Dayd (sympathy, mercy). One shall not strike back or rebuke when struck or rebuked. Restraint in thought, speech and action and forgive¬ ness is called endurance. Refraining from taking other man's belongings left unprotected by the master, or thrown out on the ground, is called here as non-covetousness.
verses.hindi: तस्समिन्द्वीपे नगश्नेष्ठः क़ौथ्वस्तु प्रथमो गिरिः । क्ौचात्परो वामनकों वासनादन्‍्धकारकः अन्धकारात्परश्चापि दिवावन्नाम पवंतः । विवावृतः परश्रापि दिविन्दों गिरिरुच्यते ६२ दिविन्दात्परतश्रवापि पुण्डरीको महागिरिः। पुण्डरीकात्परश्रापि प्रोच्यते दुन्दुभिस्वनः ३६३

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णं रजतं वापि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददाति यः । त्रयोदश दिनं यावत्त्रयोदशगुणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi brāhmaṇebhyo dadāti yaḥ / trayodaśa dinaṃ yāvattrayodaśaguṇaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Abstinence from sexual acts, neither brooding nor imagining about it and complete sexual detachment is called celibacy (Brahmacarya ). If the sense-organs do not adopt a wrong path either for oneself or for others, it is the sign of quiescence or restraint. He who does not get infuriated when thwarted in the ten-fold sensual object and in theeight causes of worldly bondage is considered a conqueror. If a person feels that he must give unto a deserving person whatever is liked by him most or the money (or things) that has come to him duly and justly, that is the characteristic sign of jDa/ztf (Charity). Charity is of three types: the lowest, superiormost, and middling. That which leads to liberation (from Samsara) is of the highest type; that which is given for the achievement of one's selfish ends is the lowest; that which is given to all beings out of pity or their proper sharing with the kins is the middling (type of Dana). That which is enjoined by Srutis and Smrtis, that which conforms to the observance of the duties of castes and stages of
verses.hindi: उष्णात्पर: प्रावरकः प्रावरादन्‍्धकारक:ः । अन्धकारकदेशात्तु घुनिदेश: परः स्मृतः ६७ मुनिदेशात्परश्चैव प्रोच्यते ढुन्दुभिस्वनः। सिद्धचारणसंकीर्णों गौरमायो जबः स्मृतः

verses.sanskrit: तिलमिश्रेण तोयेन तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः । द्वादशाब्दे भवेत् प्रीतिस्तत्र तीर्थे महीपते
verses.transliteration: tilamiśreṇa toyena tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / dvādaśābde bhavet prītistatra tīrthe mahīpate
verses.translation: Absence of hatred for what is not liked, abstention from undue praise of what is liked, refraining from overdelighted¬ ness, repentance and dejection is called detachment. Sannyasa means eschewing the fruits of actions performed or intended to be performed. Abandonment of what is good and what is not good is called Tyaga. The knowledge of the transformation from the unmani¬ fest and undifferentiated into the non-sentient and the difference and distinction between the sentient and non-sentient is called jFidna (real knowledge). These are the characteristic signs of the various ancil- lanes ofDharma as mentioned by the sages who knew the I shall now mention the procedure of the Manvantara and the mode of behaviour of the people of one caste with the members of the other castes and among themselves. In every Manvantara, the system of the Vedas differs. (The Vedic Mantras of) Rk, Yajus and Saman remain the same in respect of every deity as before. In spite of e lss °lution of elements, fiatarudriya, the procedure of sacrificial offerings as well as Stotra (hymns or prayers) function as before.
verses.hindi: ख्यातिश्न पुण्डरीका च गड्भा सप्तविधा स्मृता ६६ तासां ससुद्रगाश्वान्या सद्यो यास्तु समीपगाः। अनुगच्छन्ति ताः सर्वा विपुलाः सुबहुदकाः क्रौ्चद्वीप: समुद्रेण दधिमण्डोदकेन तु । आवृतः सर्वतः श्रीमान्क्रौशचद्वीपसमेन तु ७१

verses.sanskrit: यस्तत्र कुरुते श्राद्धं पायसैर् मधुसर्पिषा । श्राद्धदो लभते स्वर्गं पित्ःणां दत्तम् अक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ pāyasair madhusarpiṣā / śrāddhado labhate svargaṃ pitḥṇāṃ dattam akṣayam
verses.translation: When the Gunas were in (a state of) equilibrium, there was the annihilation of everything. There were no Devas anywhere. As if due to their assimilation (rj tideSo) it {Ptadhana) unintelligcntly functions for the sake of Cctana (the conscious one). Thereby it was presided over by Celana (the conscious principle) without its awareness. Both of them function like the fish and the water. The Tattoo (Pradhana) presided over by consciousness (the con¬ scious Purusa) functions through Gunas. Since the cause is present the effect functions in the same way. The object functions due to the subject. The Artha (meaning) functions due to its meaningfulness (state of possessing meaning). The differences which are materialised by Kala (Time) are due to the intrinsic nature of the cause. They become ex¬ plicitly manifest in due course as Mahatand other principles. From Mahal, Ahathkara (Cosmic Ego) is evolved; from Ego the (Subtle) elements. The different elements are evolved due to mutual interaction. The cause immediately transforms (itself) into action. Just as a burning fire-brand spreads its sparks all round simultaneously while falling, so also the conscious Principle {Ksetrajna) that transforms itself due to the action of Time manifests himself.
verses.hindi: कृश द्वीप की स्थिति को कह दिया ।५८-५६। इसके बाद अब हम क्रॉँंच ढ्ीप के विस्तार को कहते हैं ! कुशद्ीप से यह क्रौंचढ्वीप दूना बड़ा है । यह द्वीप घुत सागर को घेरे हुये है ।६०। इस ढ्वीप का पहला पंत क्रौॉँच है और यह सबसे श्रेष्ठ है। क्रोंच के बाद वामनक, वासनक के बाद अन्धकारक, अख्धकारक के बाद दिवावृत, दिवावुत के बाद दिविन्द, दिविन्द के बाद पुण्डरीक और पृण्डरीक के बाद दुन्दुभिस्वन नामक पर्वत है । ६१-६३॥।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षतैर्बदरैर्बिल्वैरिङ्गुदैर्वा तिलैः सह । अक्षयं फलमाप्नोति तस्मिंस्तीर्थे न संशयः
verses.transliteration: akṣatairbadarairbilvairiṅgudairvā tilaiḥ saha / akṣayaṃ phalamāpnoti tasmiṃstīrthe na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Just as a glow-worm is suddenly seen in blinding dark¬ ness, so also Mahal is evolved out of the unmanifest and shines like a glow-worm. The Principle of Consciousness stays at the entrance to the great chamber where the embodied principle Mahat stays. Mahal is seen beyond Tamas (the dark principle) on account of its distinct disparity. The fSruti says, "The con- All these are its evolutes and well-shaped too. It is called Siddhi (Evolute) as it is effected through the transformation of embodied Maliat. He (Puma) stays in the body (Pur) and possesses the knowledge of the body. He is called Pumsa as he dwells in the Pur (body), and is called Kseirajna due to his knowledge of the body. Since he has knowledge of the Kselra (body), he is called Kseirajna. Therefore the Lord is called Intellect (Mali). Since he abides with Buddhi (Intellect), he is of the nature of knowledge (Bodha). For the accomplishment (of task of the world?) this non-intelligent entity, both manifest and unmainfest, is pervad¬ ed (by the Intelligent Principle).
verses.hindi: क्रॉंचद्वीप के ये सातों पवंत रत्नमय हैं। इन पव॑तों पर अनेक फल-पुष्पवाले व॒क्ष और लताएं हैं। इन पर्वतों के मध्य की भूमि क्रमशः दूनी अधिक है। यहाँ के देशों के नाम को भी कहते हैं, सुनिये ।६४-६५। क्रौंच का देश कुशल है, वामन का मनोनुग, मनोनुग के बाद तीसरा देश उष्ण, उष्ण के बाद प्रावरक, प्रावरक के बाद अन्धका रक, अन्धकारक के बाद मुनिदेश और मुनिदेश के बाद दुन्दुभिस्वत नामक देश हैँ। ये देश सिद्ध- चारणों से भरे हैं और यहाँ के निवासी गौर वर्ण के होते हैं ।६६-६८। यहाँ भी सातों देशों में गौरी, कुमुढ्ठती , सन्ध्या, रात्रि, मनोजवा, ख्याति और पुण्डरीका ये सातों नदियाँ बहती हैं। इन नदियों के समीप में बहनेवाली और भी कितनी ही अधिक जलवाली बड़ी-बड़ी नवियाँ हैं, जो समुद्र में जाकर गिरतो हैं। ऋचद्वीप दर्धिमण्डोदक समुद्र से घिरा हुआ है। यह समुद्र भी क्रोंचद्वीप के ही बराबर है। प्लक्ष आदि इतने

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा तु यो देवं पूजयेच् च दिवाकरम् । आदित्यहृदयं जप्त्वा पुनरादित्यम् अर्चयेत् । स गच्छेत् परमं लोकं त्रिदशैरपि वन्दितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā tu yo devaṃ pūjayec ca divākaram / ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā punarādityam arcayet / sa gacchet paramaṃ lokaṃ tridaśairapi vanditam
verses.translation: Thus it is the conscious principle that dissociates itself from the objects of sense-organs. It is this very principle that cognizes the objects as worthy of being enjoyed. The root V rs means c to go 5. It refers to the Vedas, truthfulness and penance. He who is devoted to these three and attains Brahman is called c Rsi\ 1 The Rsi who attains the knowledge of the great un¬ manifest principle and abstains from worldly attachment simultaneously is called Paramarsi. From the root rs meaning "to go", the name Rsi has been derived. Since the mental sons of Brahma are self- born, they are Isvaras (endowed with spiritual power). He who is not restricted or delimited by measures is called great. Those who attain the Great Principle by means of attributes are called Maharsis. They are the seers who can penetrate beyond intellect. The hearts of those powerful (mental sons) are auspi¬ cious. Eschewing ego and ignorance ( Tamas ), they have attained sagehood.

verses.sanskrit: ऋचमेकां जपेद्यस्तु यजुर्वा साम एव च । स समग्रस्य वेदस्य फलमाप्नोति वै नृप
verses.transliteration: ṛcamekāṃ japedyastu yajurvā sāma eva ca / sa samagrasya vedasya phalamāpnoti vai nṛpa
verses.translation: Hence those who have a real insight and knowledge ofthe Bhutadi (Cosmic Ego) are called Risis (Sages). The sons of Rsis (Sages) who are born of womb through sexual inter¬ course are called R.sikas. Those (spiritually) powerful ones realize the Tanmatras (subtle elements) and Salya (the truth). The Seven Sages, there¬ fore, are the supreme realizer of the Truth. They are of live classes. Their names are Avyaktatma, Mahatma, Ahamkaratma,, Bhutama and Indriyatma. They practise five kinds of knowledge. Listen to the five classes of sages by their names. As they are born of the sage and are hence (spiritually great), they are called Maharsis. Know the names of the sages who were the sons of these great sages ( Maharsis ). Kavya, Bfhaspati, Kasyapa, Usanas, Utathya, Vamadeva, Apojya, Aisija, Kardama, Visravas, Sakti, Vala- khilya and Dhara. These are called sages because they had attained that stage through their knowledge. Understand that the Rsikas, sons of sages, were born of wombs. Vatsara, Nagrahu, Bharadvaja, Brhaduttha, Sarad- van, Agastya, Ausija, Dlrghatamas, Brhaduktha, Saradvata, Vajasravas, Suvitta, Suvak, Vesaparayana, Dadhlca, Sankha- man and king Vaisravana—these are called R$ikas. They attain¬ ed Rsihood (status of Rsis) through truthfulness. Isvaras, Rsikas and others are the seers (creators of Mantras). Now listen to their names.
verses.hindi: प्लक्षद्वीपादयों हा ते समासेन प्रकीतिताः । तेषां निसर्गों द्वीपानामानृपृव्यंण स्वशः ७२ न शक्‍य॑ विस्तराहक्तुमपि वर्षशतेरपि । निसर्गोष्यं प्रजानां तु संहारो यश्व तासु बे तत्रापि पर्वताः शुत्राः सप्तेव परिमूषिताः । रत्नाकरास्तथा नचस्तासां नामानि से शूणु
verses.wordMeaning: Hence those who have a real insight and knowledge ofthe Bhutadi (Cosmic Ego) are called Risis (Sages). The sons of Rsis (Sages) who are born of womb through sexual inter¬ course are called R.sikas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence those who have a real insight and knowledge ofthe Bhutadi (Cosmic Ego) are called Risis (Sages). The sons of Rsis (Sages) who are born of womb through sexual inter¬ course are called R.sikas.…

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्र्यक्षरं जपेन्मन्त्रं ध्यायमानो दिवाकरम् । आदित्यहृदयं जप्त्वा मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: yastryakṣaraṃ japenmantraṃ dhyāyamāno divākaram / ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Bhfgu, Kavya, Pracetas, Dadhlca, Atmavan, Aurva, Jamadagni, Vida, Sarasvata, Advisena, Arupa, Vltahavya, Sumedhasa, Vainya, Prthu, Divodasa, Prasvara, Grtsaman and Nabha: these nineteen sages were the expounders of Mantras. Kasyapa, Vatsara, Vibhrama, Raibhya, Asita and Devala these six belong to the family of KaSyapa and they are the expounders of Brahman. Atri, Arcisana, Syamavan, Nisthura, the intelligent sage Valgutaka and Purvatithi—these are the descendants of Atri. They are great sages ( Maharsis) and seers of Mantras. Vasistha, Sakti, Parasara, (the fourth one) Indrapramati, (the fifth) Bharadvasu, (the sixth) Maitra- varuna, (the seventh) Kundina, (the eighth) Sudyumna, the ninth Brhaspati and the tenth Bharadvaja—these ten are the composers of Mantras and Brahmanas. These are the creators (seers of Mantras) and destroyers of unrighteousness. This characteristic of the Vedas is prescribed for all the branches of the Veda. The word Hetu (reason of inference) is derived from y/hi to destroy'. 1 'That which destroys what is argued by the opponent' is called Hetu. Or it may be from sjhi 'to go'— that which enables one to the acquisition of the meaning' is Hetu. It helps to arrive at a definite (decisive) meaning of a statement after refuting the opponent's standpoint. Preceptors say that it means Hindu (censure) when the statements (of the opponents) are censured due to their defects.
verses.hindi: देवधिगन्धर्वयुतः प्रथमो मेरुरुच्यते । प्रायायतः ससौवर्ण उदयो नाम प्ब॑तः (७८
verses.wordMeaning: Bhfgu, Kavya, Pracetas, Dadhlca, Atmavan, Aurva, Jamadagni, Vida, Sarasvata, Advisena, Arupa, Vltahavya, Sumedhasa, Vainya, Prthu, Divodasa, Prasvara, Grtsaman and Nabha: these nineteen sages were the expounders of Mantras. Kasyapa, Vatsara, Vibhrama, Raibhya,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhfgu, Kavya, Pracetas, Dadhlca, Atmavan, Aurva, Jamadagni, Vida, Sarasvata, Advisena, Arupa, Vltahavya, Sumedhasa, Vainya, Prthu, Divodasa, Prasvara, Grtsaman and Nabha: these nineteen sages were the expounders of Mantras. Kasyapa, Vatsara, Vibhrama, Raibhya,…

verses.sanskrit: यस्तत्र विधिवत्प्राणांस्त्यजते नृपसत्तम । स गच्छेत्परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: yastatra vidhivatprāṇāṃstyajate nṛpasattama / sa gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ
verses.translation: The word 'PraSarfisa' (Praise) is derived from the root Vsams with the prefix Pra-. A statement is praised by virtue of its merits. 'This is this', 'This is not this'-this sort of indecision is called SarhSayd (Doubt). The concept of Purakalpa is due to its having taken place in the past. The events of ancient times cannot be decided by -Mantras, Brahmanas, Kalpas and Nigamas, howsoever genuine Verses 108-117 explain some terms such as Hetu, Pratamsi, Sutra etc. Just as this, so also is that; this is also so, this is the tenth instruction of the Brahmana. The utility of the antras is in the prescribed rites through injunctions. The word ' Mantra ' is derived from y/mantr The knowers of Sutras called that (statement) as Sutra which consists of very few syllables, is free from ambi¬ guity, full of essence, which is comprehensive in application yet devoid of superfluous adjuncts and contains no objectionable word.
verses.hindi: तस्यापरे रेबतको यत्र नित्य प्रतिष्ठितः । रेवती दिवि नक्षत्र पितामहकृतो गिरिः ॥८ १ तस्पापरेण सुमहाज्श्यामो नाम महागिरि: । तस्माच्छुयामत्वमापज्नाः प्रजा पु्वेमिसा: किंल.
verses.wordMeaning: The word 'PraSarfisa' (Praise) is derived from the root Vsams with the prefix Pra-. A statement is praised by virtue of its merits. 'This is this', 'This is not this'-this sort of indecision is called SarhSayd (Doubt).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The word 'PraSarfisa' (Praise) is derived from the root Vsams with the prefix Pra-. A statement is praised by virtue of its merits. 'This is this', 'This is not this'-this sort of indecision is called SarhSayd (Doubt).…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पुष्करिण्याम् आदित्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ६० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: भूयोऽप्यहं प्रवक्ष्यामि आदित्येश्वरमुत्तमम् । सर्वदुःखहरं पार्थ सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe puṣkariṇyām ādityatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 60 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: bhūyo'pyahaṃ pravakṣyāmi ādityeśvaramuttamam / sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ pārtha sarvavighnavināśanam
verses.translation: On hearing his words the sages said to Suta of wide knowledge—"O intelligent Sir, how were the Vedas classified before? Please tell us that."
verses.hindi: द्वीपों का वर्णन हमने संक्षेप से कर दिया ।६६-७१२। इन द्वीपों की स्वाभाविक अवस्था का ऋणमिक वर्णन और प्रजाजन की उत्पत्ति या संहार का विस्तार के साथ सांगोपाँग वर्णन सौ वर्षों में भी नहीं किया जा सकता है। इसके अनन्तर अब हम शाकद्वीप का वर्णन करते हैं । सम्पूर्ण शाकद्वीप के विषय में जो यथार्थ रूप से कहते हैं आप सब सूुनें। क्रौंचद्रीप से शाकद्वीप दूता बड़ा है। द्िमण्डोदक समुद्र को यह घरे
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words the sages said to Suta of wide knowledge—"O intelligent Sir, how were the Vedas classified before? Please tell us that."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words the sages said to Suta of wide knowledge—"O intelligent Sir, how were the Vedas classified before? Please tell us that."

verses.sanskrit: आयुःश्रीवर्द्धनं नित्यं पुत्रदं स्वर्गदं शिवम् । यस्य तीर्थस्य चान्यानि तीर्थानि कुरुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: āyuḥśrīvarddhanaṃ nityaṃ putradaṃ svargadaṃ śivam / yasya tīrthasya cānyāni tīrthāni kurunandana
verses.translation: O highly intelligent sage, in the Svayambhuva Man- vantara, when Dvapara had set in, Brahma said this to Manu. I shall repeat it.
verses.hindi: हुए है ॥७२-७५। वहाँ के निवासी पवित्र ओर चिरायु होते हैं। हाँ न दुभिल्ष होता है और न रोग-कोक का ही भय होता है। मणियों से भूषित शुत्र वर्ण के सात पर्वत हैं और मणियों को उत्पन्न करनेवाली नदियाँ है। इनके नामों को हमसे सुनिये ।७६-७७। देवियों और गन्धर्वों से युक्त प्रथम भेरु नामक पर्वेत है । दूसरा सुवरणमय उदय नामक पर्वत है । यह पृरब की ओर लम्बा है । यहाँ ही मेष उत्पन्न होते हैं और वृष्टि करने के लिये दूसरे स्थानों को जाते हैं। उसके पश्चात् विशालकाय जलधार नामक महागिरि है ।७८-७९। इसी पर्वत से बासव अत्युत्तम जल को नित्यग्रहण करते हैं और वर्षाकाल में प्रजाजन के बीच उसे बरसाते हैं। जलधार के बाद रैबतक नामक पव॑त है। इस पर्वत पर रेवती नक्षत्र सदा वतंमान रहता है । यह स्वर्ग के समान हैं और पितामह ब्रह्मा के द्वारा बनाया गया है। रवतक के बाद अति विज्ञाल
verses.wordMeaning: O highly intelligent sage, in the Svayambhuva Man- vantara, when Dvapara had set in, Brahma said this to Manu. I shall repeat it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly intelligent sage, in the Svayambhuva Man- vantara, when Dvapara had set in, Brahma said this to Manu. I shall repeat it.

verses.sanskrit: नालभन्त श्रियं नाके मर्त्ये पातालगोचरे । कुरुक्षेत्रं गया गङ्गा नैमिषं पुष्करं तथा
verses.transliteration: nālabhanta śriyaṃ nāke martye pātālagocare / kurukṣetraṃ gayā gaṅgā naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: "O dear one, when a Yuga passes away, Brahmanas be¬ come deficient in energy and vigour. All of them become enve¬ loped by the defects of the new Yuga.
verses.hindi: इ्याम नामक महागिरि है। यहीं प्रजाओं ने सबसे पहले व्यामता को पाई है ।६८०-८२। इस गिरि के बाद
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear one, when a Yuga passes away, Brahmanas be¬ come deficient in energy and vigour. All of them become enve¬ loped by the defects of the new Yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear one, when a Yuga passes away, Brahmanas be¬ come deficient in energy and vigour. All of them become enve¬ loped by the defects of the new Yuga.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणसी च केदारं प्रयागम् रुद्रनन्दनम् । महाकालं सहस्राक्षं शुक्लतीर्थं नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasī ca kedāraṃ prayāgam rudranandanam / mahākālaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ śuklatīrthaṃ nṛpottama
verses.translation: Only very little (of the previous glory) remains to be seen. Only a ten-thousandth part of what existed originally at the beginning of Krta Age remains.
verses.hindi: ३५४ .. आयुपुराणम तस्यापरेण रजतो महानस्तो गिरिः स्मृतः । तस्थापरेणा5स्बिकेयो दुर्ग: शलो हिमाचितः. ॥८रे आम्बिकेयात्परों रम्यः सर्वोषधिसमन्वितः । स चंब केशरोत्युक्तो यतो वायुः प्रवायति (८४
verses.wordMeaning: Only very little (of the previous glory) remains to be seen. Only a ten-thousandth part of what existed originally at the beginning of Krta Age remains.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only very little (of the previous glory) remains to be seen. Only a ten-thousandth part of what existed originally at the beginning of Krta Age remains.

verses.sanskrit: रवितीर्थस्य सर्वाणि कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् । रवितीर्थे हि यद्वृत्तं तच्छृणुष्व नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: ravitīrthasya sarvāṇi kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm / ravitīrthe hi yadvṛttaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpottama
verses.translation: Power, splendour, strength and eloquence—everything
verses.hindi: अस्तस्यापि शुम॑ वर्ष विज्ञेयं कुसुमोत्तरम् । आस्विकेयस्य मोदाक केसरेषु सहादुमम् '.' ७८७
verses.wordMeaning: Power, splendour, strength and eloquence—everything
verses.commentary: Sense: Power, splendour, strength and eloquence—everything

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहात्ते कथयिष्यामि वार्द्धकेनातिपीडितः । शृण्वन्तु ऋषयः सर्वे तपोनिष्ठा महौजसः
verses.transliteration: snehātte kathayiṣyāmi vārddhakenātipīḍitaḥ / śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve taponiṣṭhā mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: The original Vedas consisted of four Padas and a hund¬ red thousand Mantras. It has increased ten times. The entire Yajn,a yields all desires 51.
verses.hindi: शाको नाम महावुक्षस्तस्य पुजां प्रयुअजते द प्रथमा सुकुमारीति गड़गा शिवजला तथा। अनुतप्ता च नाम्नेव नदी संपरिकीतिता....
verses.wordMeaning: The original Vedas consisted of four Padas and a hund¬ red thousand Mantras. It has increased ten times. The entire Yajn,a yields all desires 51.
verses.commentary: Sense: The original Vedas consisted of four Padas and a hund¬ red thousand Mantras. It has increased ten times. The entire Yajn,a yields all desires 51.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतं मे रुद्रसांनिध्ये नन्दिस्कन्दगणैः सह । पार्वत्या पृष्टः शम्भुश्च रवितीर्थस्य यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: śrutaṃ me rudrasāṃnidhye nandiskandagaṇaiḥ saha / pārvatyā pṛṣṭaḥ śambhuśca ravitīrthasya yatphalam
verses.translation: It was at the instance of Brahma and with a desire for the well-being of the world (that he divided the Veda). It is by the present classification of the Vedas that you have to imagine the (extent etc. of) the Vedas.
verses.hindi: कुमारी नामतः सिद्धा द्वितीया सा पुनः सती । नन्‍दा च पार्वती चेव तृतीया परिकोतिता 0 श्र शिवेतिका चतुर्थो स्यात्त्रिदिवा च पुनः स्मृता  इश्षुश्र प्चमी ज्ञेया तथव च॒ पुनः क़तु ६३
verses.wordMeaning: It was at the instance of Brahma and with a desire for the well-being of the world (that he divided the Veda). It is by the present classification of the Vedas that you have to imagine the (extent etc. of) the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was at the instance of Brahma and with a desire for the well-being of the world (that he divided the Veda). It is by the present classification of the Vedas that you have to imagine the (extent etc. of) the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: शम्भुना च यदाख्यातं गिरिजायाः ससम्भ्रमम् । तत्सर्वमेकचित्तेन रुद्रोद्गीतं श्रुतं मया
verses.transliteration: śambhunā ca yadākhyātaṃ girijāyāḥ sasambhramam / tatsarvamekacittena rudrodgītaṃ śrutaṃ mayā
verses.translation: In this Yuga, the son of Parasara who is glorified as a part of Visnu and who is well-known as Dvaipayana, the scorcher (vanquisher) of enemies, was made Vyasa 1 (the arranger of the Vedas).
verses.hindi: बहुदाकार अस्तगिरि है । यह चाँदी का पर्वत हैं। हिममग्र और दुर्गंभ आम्बिकेय पर्वत अध्तगिरि के बाद स्थित है। आम्बिकेय पर्वत के बाद सम्पूर्ण ओषधियों से युक्त रम्य पर्वत है। इस परत को लोग केशरी भी कहते हैं। वायु यहीं से बहा करती है ।६३-८४। अब यहाँ के प्रदेशों का भी अक्षरशः वर्णन और नाम सुनिये । उदय का जलद, जलधार का सुकुमार, रवतक का कौमार, द्याम का मणीचक्र, अस्त का शुभ कुसुमोत्तर और अम्बिकेय का मोदाक और केशर का महात्रुम वर्ष या देश है । इस द्वीप के बड़ "छोटे का परिमाण भी शाकद्वीप के ही समान है। इसके बीच एक विख्यात वनस्पति है, जिसका नाम शाक है। वहाँ वाले इस वैक्ष को आदर की दृष्टि से देखते हैं ।६५०८८। देवता, गन्धव सिद्ध, चांरण आदि इन स्थानों में विहार और रमण क्या करते हैं। वहाँ के पविन्न देशों में चारों वर्णों के लोग बसे हुए हैं । वहाँ के सातों
verses.wordMeaning: In this Yuga, the son of Parasara who is glorified as a part of Visnu and who is well-known as Dvaipayana, the scorcher (vanquisher) of enemies, was made Vyasa 1 (the arranger of the Vedas).
verses.commentary: Sense: In this Yuga, the son of Parasara who is glorified as a part of Visnu and who is well-known as Dvaipayana, the scorcher (vanquisher) of enemies, was made Vyasa 1 (the arranger of the Vedas).

verses.sanskrit: तत्ते ऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु यत्नेन पाण्डव । दुर्भिक्षोपहता विप्रा नर्मदां तु समाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: tatte 'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena pāṇḍava / durbhikṣopahatā viprā narmadāṃ tu samāśritāḥ
verses.translation: Urged bygod Brahma, he undertook the work of classifying the Veda. He adopted four disciples for (preserva¬ tion and continuity of) of the Vedas. (They were) Jaimini, Sumantu, Vaisampayana, Paila (was the fourth of them) and the fifth Lomaharsana.
verses.hindi: देशों में सात नदियाँ हैं, जो समुद्र की ओर बहा करती हैं। वे नदियाँ सप्त गंगा कहलाती हैं । उनके नामों को सुनिये ।८६-६ ०) शिवजला सुकुमारी गंगा है। यह नदी अनुतप्ता नाम से भी विख्यात है। इसी प्रकार दूसरी कुमारी या सिद्धा, तीसरी नन्‍्दा या पावंती, चौथी छशिवेतिका या त्रिदिवा, पाँचतीं इक्ष या ऋतु, छठी धेनका या म्रता ये सप्त गंगा नाम की नदियाँ वहाँ प्रति देश में कल्याणकारक जल को धारण कर
verses.wordMeaning: Urged bygod Brahma, he undertook the work of classifying the Veda. He adopted four disciples for (preserva¬ tion and continuity of) of the Vedas. (They were) Jaimini, Sumantu, Vaisampayana, Paila (was the fourth of them) and the fifth Lomaharsana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged bygod Brahma, he undertook the work of classifying the Veda. He adopted four disciples for (preserva¬ tion and continuity of) of the Vedas. (They were) Jaimini, Sumantu, Vaisampayana, Paila (was the fourth of them) and the fifth Lomaharsana.

verses.sanskrit: उद्दालको वशिष्ठश्च माण्डव्यो गौतमस्तथा । याज्ञवल्क्यो ऽथ गर्गश्च शाण्डिल्यो गालवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: uddālako vaśiṣṭhaśca māṇḍavyo gautamastathā / yājñavalkyo 'tha gargaśca śāṇḍilyo gālavastathā
verses.translation: He formally made the Brahmana Paila the propounder of the Rgveda and Vaisampayana the expounder of the Yajur- veda.
verses.hindi: एकोनपञ्चाशत्तमोष्ष्याय: क्‍ ३५५ घेनुका ल मृता चेव षष्ठी संपरिकोतिता। एताः सप्त महागड्भाः प्रतिवर्ष शिवोदकाः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He formally made the Brahmana Paila the propounder of the Rgveda and Vaisampayana the expounder of the Yajur- veda.
verses.commentary: Sense: He formally made the Brahmana Paila the propounder of the Rgveda and Vaisampayana the expounder of the Yajur- veda.

verses.sanskrit: नाचिकेतो विभाण्डश्च वालखिल्यादयस्तथा । शातातपश्च शङ्खश्च जैमिनिर्गोभिलस्तथा
verses.transliteration: nāciketo vibhāṇḍaśca vālakhilyādayastathā / śātātapaśca śaṅkhaśca jaiminirgobhilastathā
verses.translation: He accepted Jaimini as the propounder of the Sama Veda. Similarly he took the excellent sage Sumantu as the ex¬ pounder of the Atharva Veda.
verses.hindi: सर्वधातुविचित्रेश्न मणिविद्रमभूषितः । पुरेश्व विविधाकारेः स्फीतेजनपदरपि ६८
verses.wordMeaning: He accepted Jaimini as the propounder of the Sama Veda. Similarly he took the excellent sage Sumantu as the ex¬ pounder of the Atharva Veda.
verses.commentary: Sense: He accepted Jaimini as the propounder of the Sama Veda. Similarly he took the excellent sage Sumantu as the ex¬ pounder of the Atharva Veda.

verses.sanskrit: जैगीषव्यः शतानीकः सर्व एव समागताः । तीर्थयात्रा कृता तैस्तु नर्मदायाः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: jaigīṣavyaḥ śatānīkaḥ sarva eva samāgatāḥ / tīrthayātrā kṛtā taistu narmadāyāḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: The saintly Lord accepted me as the narrator of Iti- hasa and Puranas.
verses.hindi: तल्मिञ्जनपदाः पुण्या: पर्वतान्तरिते शुभा:। वर्णाश्रमसमाकोर्णा देशास्ते सप्त बे स्मृताः न संकरश्न तेष्वस्ति वर्णाश्रमक्ृतः क्वचित् । धर्मस्य चाव्यभीचारादेकान्तसुखिताः प्रजा:
verses.wordMeaning: The saintly Lord accepted me as the narrator of Iti- hasa and Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The saintly Lord accepted me as the narrator of Iti- hasa and Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्येश्वरमायाताः प्रसङ्गादृषिपुंगवाः । वृक्षैः संछादितं शुभ्रं धवतिन्दुकपाटलैः
verses.transliteration: ādityeśvaramāyātāḥ prasaṅgādṛṣipuṃgavāḥ / vṛkṣaiḥ saṃchāditaṃ śubhraṃ dhavatindukapāṭalaiḥ
verses.translation: The Yajurveda was one single compilation. He divided it into four. There were four sacrificial priests. He organised sacrifice through them.
verses.hindi: करोत्पत्तिन तेष्वस्ति न दण्डो न च दण्डकाः । स्वधर्मेणव धर्मज्ञास्ते रक्षन्ति परस्परम् १०३ एतावदेव शक्यं वे तस्सिंद्वोपे निवासिनाम् । पुष्करं सप्तमं द्वीपं प्रवक्यासि निबोधत १०४
verses.wordMeaning: The Yajurveda was one single compilation. He divided it into four. There were four sacrificial priests. He organised sacrifice through them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yajurveda was one single compilation. He divided it into four. There were four sacrificial priests. He organised sacrifice through them.

verses.sanskrit: जम्बीरैरर्जुनैः कुब्जैः शमीकेसरकिंशुकैः । तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महापुण्ये सुगन्धिकुसुमाकुले
verses.transliteration: jambīrairarjunaiḥ kubjaiḥ śamīkesarakiṃśukaiḥ / tasmiṃstīrthe mahāpuṇye sugandhikusumākule
verses.translation: He ordained the work of the priest Adhvaiyu by means of Yajur Mantras, that of Holr by Rk mantras, that of Udgalr by the Saman Mantras and. that of Brahma (the presiding priest) by Atharvan Mantras. He established Brahma in the Yajna by means of the Atharvana (Veda).
verses.hindi: बहा करतो हैं और द्ञाकद्वीपियों को पवित्र किया करती हैं ।९२-६४। विपुल जल को धारण करनेवाली हजारों नदियाँ इनमें सम्मिलित हुई हैं; क्योंकि मेघ यहाँ सदा वृष्टि किया करते हैं। इन नवियों के नामों और परिमाणों का वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता है; किन्तु वे सभी नदियाँ श्रेष्ठ और पवित्र हैं। इन नदियों के जल को पीकर वहाँ वाले सदा प्रसन्न रहा करते हैं ।९५-९६। धांशपायन ! नदियों के जल से आबृत और मेघतुल्य पव॑तों से घिरा हुआ यह विस्तीर्ण द्वीप चक्र की तरह स्थित है। विविध धातुओं स्ले विचित्र, मणि-विद्रुमों से मण्डित, विविध भाँति के समृद्ध पुरों और देझों से तथा फल-फूल वाले बक्षों से धनधान्य- वान् छ्वाकद्रीप चारों ओर से क्षीरसागर से घिरा हुआ है। इस सागर का विस्तार ज्ञाकद्वीप के ही समान है ।६७-९६। पर्वतों के अन्तराल में बसे हुए वहाँ के पवित्र देशों की संख्या सात है। वहाँ व्यभिचार का
verses.wordMeaning: He ordained the work of the priest Adhvaiyu by means of Yajur Mantras, that of Holr by Rk mantras, that of Udgalr by the Saman Mantras and. that of Brahma (the presiding priest) by Atharvan Mantras. He established Brahma in the Yajna by means of the Atharvana (Veda).
verses.commentary: Sense: He ordained the work of the priest Adhvaiyu by means of Yajur Mantras, that of Holr by Rk mantras, that of Udgalr by the Saman Mantras and. that of Brahma (the presiding priest) by Atharvan Mantras. He established Brahma in the Yajna by means of the Atharvana (Veda).

verses.sanskrit: पुन्नागनालिकेरैश्च खदिरैः कल्पपादपैः । अनेकश्वापदाकीर्णं मृगमार्जारसंकुलम्
verses.transliteration: punnāganālikeraiśca khadiraiḥ kalpapādapaiḥ / anekaśvāpadākīrṇaṃ mṛgamārjārasaṃkulam
verses.translation: Thereafter, he picked up (selected) Rk Mantras and compiled the R§ Veda. He ordained the duties of Hott, the per¬ former of a sacrifice and the benefactor of the world.
verses.hindi: नाम तक नहीं है; अतः धर्म का पालन करने के कारण वहाँ की प्रजा अत्यन्त सुखी है। वहाँ के लोगों को को न लोभ है, न माया, न ईएया, नडाह, न अयीरता है और न कतंव्व्शंकरता । ऐसा ही उन लोगों का स्त्रभाव है। वहाँ वाले कर (मालगुजारी) नहीं देते । उन लोगों को न कोई दंड लेता है और न कोई दंड देनेवाला ही है। वे सब धर्म को जानते हैं अतः धामिक आचार-विचार के ही द्वारा वे एक दूसरे की रक्षा
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he picked up (selected) Rk Mantras and compiled the R§ Veda. He ordained the duties of Hott, the per¬ former of a sacrifice and the benefactor of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he picked up (selected) Rk Mantras and compiled the R§ Veda. He ordained the duties of Hott, the per¬ former of a sacrifice and the benefactor of the world.

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षहस्तिसमाकीर्णं चित्रकैश्चोपशोभितम् । प्रविष्टा ऋषयः सर्वे वने पुष्पसमाकुले
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣahastisamākīrṇaṃ citrakaiścopaśobhitam / praviṣṭā ṛṣayaḥ sarve vane puṣpasamākule
verses.translation: He, an expert in the meanings of the Puranas, com¬ posed the compendiums of Puranas by compiling narratives, sub-narratives, poems and songs, and the traditional conduct of the ancient races.
verses.hindi: करते हैं (९ ००-१०३। शाकद्वीपवासियों का वर्णन यहाँ तक मैंने अपनी ज्ञानशक्ति के अनृप्तार किया। सातर्थो ३५६ ... वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: He, an expert in the meanings of the Puranas, com¬ posed the compendiums of Puranas by compiling narratives, sub-narratives, poems and songs, and the traditional conduct of the ancient races.
verses.commentary: Sense: He, an expert in the meanings of the Puranas, com¬ posed the compendiums of Puranas by compiling narratives, sub-narratives, poems and songs, and the traditional conduct of the ancient races.

verses.sanskrit: वनान्ते च स्त्रियो दृष्ट्वा रक्ता रक्ताम्बरान्विताः । रक्तमाल्यानुशोभाढ्या रक्तचन्दनचर्चिताः
verses.transliteration: vanānte ca striyo dṛṣṭvā raktā raktāmbarānvitāḥ / raktamālyānuśobhāḍhyā raktacandanacarcitāḥ
verses.translation: He gathered the scattered Yajur Mantras duly, with
verses.hindi: पुष्करेण तु द्वीपेन बुतः क्षीरोदकों बहिः। शाकद्वीपस्य विस्ताराद्द्ििगुणेन समन्‍्ततः १०५ पुष्करे पर्वेतः श्रीमानेक एव सहाशिल: । चित्रेम॑णिमये: शेले: शिखरंस्तु समुच्छिते:.
verses.wordMeaning: He gathered the scattered Yajur Mantras duly, with
verses.commentary: Sense: He gathered the scattered Yajur Mantras duly, with

verses.sanskrit: रक्ताभरणसंयुक्ताः पाशहस्ता भयावहाः । तासां समीपगा दृष्टाः कृष्णजीमूतसन्निभाः
verses.transliteration: raktābharaṇasaṃyuktāḥ pāśahastā bhayāvahāḥ / tāsāṃ samīpagā dṛṣṭāḥ kṛṣṇajīmūtasannibhāḥ
verses.translation: Taking up the Rk Mantras, Paila divided them into two groups. 1 He handed them oyer to his two disciples, one
verses.hindi: एक एवं महासानुः संनिवेशादिद्वधा कृत: । स्वादृदकेनो दधिना स्वतः परिवारित १११ पुष्करद्वीपविस्ताराद्विस्तीणोइसो समन्‍्ततः । तंस्मिन्द्वीपे स्मृतो दो तु पुण्यौ जनपदो शुभी....... महावीतं तु यहर्ष बाह्यतो मानसस्य तत् । तस्येवाभ्यन्तरे यत्तु धातफीखण्डमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Taking up the Rk Mantras, Paila divided them into two groups. 1 He handed them oyer to his two disciples, one
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking up the Rk Mantras, Paila divided them into two groups. 1 He handed them oyer to his two disciples, one

verses.sanskrit: महाकाया भीमवक्त्राः पाशहस्ता भयावहाः । अनावृष्ट्युपमा दृष्टा आतुराः पिङ्गलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: mahākāyā bhīmavaktrāḥ pāśahastā bhayāvahāḥ / anāvṛṣṭyupamā dṛṣṭā āturāḥ piṅgalocanāḥ
verses.translation: Verses 24-31 describe the division of the Rgveda & the line of
verses.hindi: न तत्र वच्चको नेष्या न स्तेया(यं) न भय॑ तथा। निग्रहो न च दण्डोस्ति न लोभो न परिग्रहः॥
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 24-31 describe the division of the Rgveda & the line of
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 24-31 describe the division of the Rgveda & the line of

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घजिह्वा करालास्या तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रा दुरासदा । वृद्धा नारी कुरुश्रेष्ठ दृष्टान्या ऋषिपुंगवैः
verses.transliteration: dīrghajihvā karālāsyā tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrā durāsadā / vṛddhā nārī kuruśreṣṭha dṛṣṭānyā ṛṣipuṃgavaiḥ
verses.translation: He taught the first branch (compilation) to Bodha, the second to Agnimathara, the third to Parasara and the last to Yajnavalkya.
