verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the greatest of secrets, the holiest of holy things, the story of what is famous as Nilakantha has been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: यदि उच्चैःश्रवाः श्वेतो ऽहं दासी च तवैव तु । एवं परस्परं द्वाभ्यां संवादो ऽयं व्यवर्धत
verses.transliteration: yadi uccaiḥśravāḥ śveto 'haṃ dāsī ca tavaiva tu / evaṃ parasparaṃ dvābhyāṃ saṃvādo 'yaṃ vyavardhata
verses.translation: This story has been narrated by the self-born deity. It is the sacred story that quells sins. I shall now mention the fruit ' accruing to that person who retains this story recounted by Brahma.
verses.hindi: किया करते हैं। केतु के रथ के घोड़े बायु की तरह वेगशाली, गधे को तरह धूसर वर्ण, चितकबरे और धान के भूसे के धुएं को तरह हैं। ये गिनती में चौंसठ हैं। यह हमने ग्रहों के घोड़ों और रथों का वर्णन किया । ये सभी वायु किरणों द्वारा ध्रूव से संलग्न हैं ।७६-८३॥ अदृश्य वायुकिरणों द्वारा ये रथ-घोड़े या ग्रहगण घुमाये जाते हैं और यथावकाश भ्रमण करते हैं। वायुक्रिरणों द्वारा भाबद्ध चन्द्र सूर्यादि ग्रहगण आकाश्ष में घूमते है
verses.wordMeaning: This story has been narrated by the self-born deity. It is the sacred story that quells sins. I shall now mention the fruit ' accruing to that person who retains this story recounted by Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: This story has been narrated by the self-born deity. It is the sacred story that quells sins. I shall now mention the fruit ' accruing to that person who retains this story recounted by Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमेषु गता बाला रात्रौ चिन्तापरा स्थिता । बन्धुवर्गस्य कथितं समस्तं तद्विचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: āśrameṣu gatā bālā rātrau cintāparā sthitā / bandhuvargasya kathitaṃ samastaṃ tadviceṣṭitam
verses.translation: O fair lady of good loins, on reaching his body, poison from mobile and immobile things becomes ineffective immediately.
verses.hindi: और घूमते हुये. ध्रूव का अनुगसन करते हैं। नदी-जल में जैसे नौका जल पर स्थित रहती है, उसी श्रकार ये देवालय वायुकिरणों के आधार पर रुके रहते हैं। इसी कारण आकाश में देवगण का दर्शन सभी कर सकते हैं ॥ यथा नद्य॒दके नौस्तु सलिलेन सहोह्यते । तथा देवालया होते उह्ान्ते वातरश्मिभिः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O fair lady of good loins, on reaching his body, poison from mobile and immobile things becomes ineffective immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: O fair lady of good loins, on reaching his body, poison from mobile and immobile things becomes ineffective immediately.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्राणां कथितं पार्थ पणं चैव मया कृतम् । हाहाकारः कृतः सर्पैः श्रुत्वा मात्रा पणं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: putrāṇāṃ kathitaṃ pārtha paṇaṃ caiva mayā kṛtam / hāhākāraḥ kṛtaḥ sarpaiḥ śrutvā mātrā paṇaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: It quells inauspiciousness and removes (the effect of) bad dreams. The person attains the love of women and leader¬ ship in royal assembly.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्सवेंण दृश्यन्ते व्योम्नि देवगणास्तु ते ८७
verses.wordMeaning: It quells inauspiciousness and removes (the effect of) bad dreams. The person attains the love of women and leader¬ ship in royal assembly.
verses.commentary: Sense: It quells inauspiciousness and removes (the effect of) bad dreams. The person attains the love of women and leader¬ ship in royal assembly.

verses.sanskrit: जाता दासी न सन्देहः श्वेतो भास्करवाहनः । उच्चैःश्रवा हयः श्वेतो न कृष्णो विद्यते क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: jātā dāsī na sandehaḥ śveto bhāskaravāhanaḥ / uccaiḥśravā hayaḥ śveto na kṛṣṇo vidyate kvacit
verses.translation: In disputes he becomes victorious; in battle he attains valour; on expedition he attains welfare; he has perpetual riches in his house.
verses.hindi: तेलपीडाकरं चक्र अ्रमदत्रामयते यथा। तथा म्रमन्ति ज्योतोंषि वातबद्धानि सर्वशः ८६ अलातचक्वद्यान्ति वातचक़ेरितानि तु। यस्माज्ज्योतींषि वहते प्रवहुस्तेन स स्मृतः १९० एवंश्रुवनिबद्धोइसोौ सपंते ज्योतिषां गण: । सेष तारामयो ज्ञेयः शिशुमारो ध्रुवो दिवि ॥ द यदद्वा कुरुते पाप॑ दृष्ट्वा तं निशि मुच्यते द ॥€ १ यावत्यश्वेव तारास्ता: शिशुमाराश्चिता दिवि । तावन्त्येव तु वर्षाणि जीवन्त्यभ्यधिकानि तु ॥€२ शाश्वत: शिशुमारोइसौ विज्ञेयः प्रविभागश: । उत्तानपादस्तस्याथ विज्ञेयों हाय त्तरो हनुः ॥६€ रे यज्ञो5धरस्तु विज्ञेयों धर्मों मूर्धानमाश्रितः। हृदि नारायणः साध्य(ध्या) अश्विनों पूर्वपादयों: हेड द
verses.wordMeaning: In disputes he becomes victorious; in battle he attains valour; on expedition he attains welfare; he has perpetual riches in his house.
verses.commentary: Sense: In disputes he becomes victorious; in battle he attains valour; on expedition he attains welfare; he has perpetual riches in his house.

verses.sanskrit: कद्रूर् उवाच: यथाहं न भवे दासी तत्कार्यं च विचिन्त्यताम् । विशध्वं रोमकूपेषु ह्युच्चैःश्रवहयस्य तु
verses.transliteration: kadrūr uvāca: yathāhaṃ na bhave dāsī tatkāryaṃ ca vicintyatām / viśadhvaṃ romakūpeṣu hyuccaiḥśravahayasya tu
verses.translation: I shall tell his goal at the dissolution of his body, O excellent-faced lady. He becomes blue-throated, green-mous¬ tached and moon-crested; he attains three eyes; he holds the tri¬ dent in his hand, and has bull as his vehicle; he holds the Pinaka
verses.hindi: पुच्छेडरिनश् महेन्द्रश्न मरीचि: कश्यपो श्रुवः  तारकाः शिशुमारश्च नास्तमेति चतुष्टयमू
verses.wordMeaning: I shall tell his goal at the dissolution of his body, O excellent-faced lady. He becomes blue-throated, green-mous¬ tached and moon-crested; he attains three eyes; he holds the tri¬ dent in his hand, and has bull as his vehicle; he holds the Pinaka
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall tell his goal at the dissolution of his body, O excellent-faced lady. He becomes blue-throated, green-mous¬ tached and moon-crested; he attains three eyes; he holds the tri¬ dent in his hand, and has bull as his vehicle; he holds the Pinaka

verses.sanskrit: एकं मुहूर्तमात्रं तु यावत् कृष्णः स दृश्यते । क्षणमात्रेण चैकेन दासी सा भवते मम
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ tu yāvat kṛṣṇaḥ sa dṛśyate / kṣaṇamātreṇa caikena dāsī sā bhavate mama
verses.translation: O beautiful lady, I shall now mention the goal both here and hereafter of those persons who are my devotees and who hear this story.
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रचन्द्रसूर्याश्च ग्रहस्तारागणः सह । उन्मुखाभिसुखाः सर्वे चक्की भृताश्रिता दिवि ३६७ जितने तारे हैं, उतनी ही वायु की किरणें हैं। ये सभी ध्रूव से संलग्न हैं, स्वयं घूमते और श्र्ब को घुमाते हैं ।+४-८७। कोल्ह का चक्‍का जेंसे स्वयं घूमता हुआ दूसरे को घुमाता है उसी प्रकार वायु द्वारा आबद्ध ज्योति- मंण्डल सर्वत्र घूमता है। वायुचक्र द्वारा चालित होकर ज्योतिमंडल अलातचक्र की तरह घूमता है यतः वायुचक्र ज्योतिमंण्डल का वहन करता है, इसोसे वह प्रवहनु कहलाता है ।८८-८९। इस प्रकार प्र से मिलकर ज्योतिः
verses.wordMeaning: O beautiful lady, I shall now mention the goal both here and hereafter of those persons who are my devotees and who hear this story.
verses.commentary: Sense: O beautiful lady, I shall now mention the goal both here and hereafter of those persons who are my devotees and who hear this story.

verses.sanskrit: दासीं कृत्वा तु तां तन्वीं विनतां सत्यगर्विताम् । ततः स्वस्थानगाः सर्वे भविष्यथ यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: dāsīṃ kṛtvā tu tāṃ tanvīṃ vinatāṃ satyagarvitām / tataḥ svasthānagāḥ sarve bhaviṣyatha yathāsukham
verses.translation: ABrahmanasecures (attains mastery over) Vedas; a Ksattriya conquers the earth; a Vaifya derives profit; and a Sudra attains happiness.
verses.hindi: समूह चला करता है। वह तारामय ध्व शिकशुमार (ज्योतिर्मण्डल) की तरह आकाझ में प्रतिष्ठित है। रात में ध्रुव को देखने से दिनभर का किया हुआ पाप नष्ट हो जाता है। आकाश में जितने तारे उस ज्योतिमंष्डल में हैं, उतने बरसों तक श्रूव को देखने वाला जीवित रहता है। यह शिशुमार सब काल में रहने वाला है, नित्य है। इस प्रकार विभाग द्वारा इसे जानना चाहिए ।६०-६१३। उत्तानपाद इसकी निचली ठंड्डी, यज्ञ, अधर,
verses.wordMeaning: ABrahmanasecures (attains mastery over) Vedas; a Ksattriya conquers the earth; a Vaifya derives profit; and a Sudra attains happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: ABrahmanasecures (attains mastery over) Vedas; a Ksattriya conquers the earth; a Vaifya derives profit; and a Sudra attains happiness.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पा ऊचुः । यथा त्वं जननी चाम्ब सर्वेषां भुवि पूजिता । तथा सापि विशेषेण वञ्चितव्या न मातरः
verses.transliteration: sarpā ūcuḥ / yathā tvaṃ jananī cāmba sarveṣāṃ bhuvi pūjitā / tathā sāpi viśeṣeṇa vañcitavyā na mātaraḥ
verses.translation: A sick man is freed from ailments; a man in bondage attains release; a pregnant woman gets a son; and a virgin gets a good husband. Everyone regains everything he loses in this world as in the other.
verses.hindi: पूँछ अग्नि, महेन्द्र, मरीचि, कश्यप, तथा श्र्व हैं। इस संवत्सरात्मक शिशुमार का अस्तोदय नहीं होता है । ग्रहताराओं के साथ चद्ध-सूर्यादि नक्षत्र आकाश में नीचे या ऊपर मुंहकर मंडलाकार स्थित हैं ।९२०६६। ये सभी ध्र्व के द्वारा धारण किये गये हैं और सभी मेघधिस्तम्भ (दौँनी का ख्म्भा) स्वरूप श्रेष्ठ ध्रुव की ही प्रदक्षिणा करते हैं । प्रूव, अग्नि और करश्यपों में प्र्व ही श्रेष्ठ हैं। यही एक ध्रव ही मेरु पर्वत के मस्तक ज्योतिषां चक्रमेतद्धि सदा कर्षत्यवाइसुखः । मेरुमालोकयत्येष प्रयातीह प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.wordMeaning: A sick man is freed from ailments; a man in bondage attains release; a pregnant woman gets a son; and a virgin gets a good husband. Everyone regains everything he loses in this world as in the other.
verses.commentary: Sense: A sick man is freed from ailments; a man in bondage attains release; a pregnant woman gets a son; and a virgin gets a good husband. Everyone regains everything he loses in this world as in the other.

verses.sanskrit: माता च पितृभार्या च मातृमाता पितामही । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा हितं तासां समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: mātā ca pitṛbhāryā ca mātṛmātā pitāmahī / karmaṇā manasā vācā hitaṃ tāsāṃ samācaret
verses.translation: On hearing this divine story of the Lord, one obtains the same fruit as is obtained when one hundred thousand cows are duly gifted away.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते श्षुवचर्या नाम द्विपचाशोडष्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this divine story of the Lord, one obtains the same fruit as is obtained when one hundred thousand cows are duly gifted away.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this divine story of the Lord, one obtains the same fruit as is obtained when one hundred thousand cows are duly gifted away.

verses.sanskrit: सा ततस्तेन वाक्येन क्रुद्धा कालानलोपमा । मम वाक्यम् अकुर्वाणा ये केचिद्भुवि पन्नगाः
verses.transliteration: sā tatastena vākyena kruddhā kālānalopamā / mama vākyam akurvāṇā ye kecidbhuvi pannagāḥ
verses.translation: He who commits to memory one verse or half of it, one quarter of a verse or even half of it, attains Rudra's Loka.
verses.hindi: यदेतदुक्तं भवता गृहाण्येतानि विश्वुतम् । कथं देवगृहाणि स्युः कर्थ ज्योतीषि वर्णय पर अधोमुख होकर भेरु को देखते हुये भ्रमण करते हैं ओर साथ-ही-साथ सदा ज्योतिमंण्डल का भी आकर्षण
verses.wordMeaning: He who commits to memory one verse or half of it, one quarter of a verse or even half of it, attains Rudra's Loka.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who commits to memory one verse or half of it, one quarter of a verse or even half of it, attains Rudra's Loka.

verses.sanskrit: हव्यवाहमुखे सर्वे ते यास्यन्त्य् अविचारितम् । मातुस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वे चैव भुजङ्गमाः
verses.transliteration: havyavāhamukhe sarve te yāsyanty avicāritam / mātustadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve caiva bhujaṅgamāḥ
verses.translation: After recounting this story of pious fruits to the God¬ dess, the Lord with the moon embellishing his crest, the Lord be¬ loved of Guha, went along with Uma to the cave of Kiskindha seated on his bull.
verses.hindi: शांशपायन बोले--यहं सुनकर मुप्तियों ने संशय युक्त होकर फिर लोमहर्षण सूत से कहा
verses.wordMeaning: After recounting this story of pious fruits to the God¬ dess, the Lord with the moon embellishing his crest, the Lord be¬ loved of Guha, went along with Uma to the cave of Kiskindha seated on his bull.
verses.commentary: Sense: After recounting this story of pious fruits to the God¬ dess, the Lord with the moon embellishing his crest, the Lord be¬ loved of Guha, went along with Uma to the cave of Kiskindha seated on his bull.

verses.sanskrit: केचित्प्रविष्टा रोमेषु उच्चैःश्रवहयस्य च । नष्टाः केचिद् दशदिशं कद्रूशापभयात् ततः
verses.transliteration: kecitpraviṣṭā romeṣu uccaiḥśravahayasya ca / naṣṭāḥ kecid daśadiśaṃ kadrūśāpabhayāt tataḥ
verses.translation: After recounting this story of great length quelling sins, Vayu went away. After studying everything, the excellent Brah- marias went to the auspicious path of Aditya.
verses.hindi: ऋष्िगण बोले--आपने जो देवों के विख्यात गृहों का वर्णन किया है, वे घर र्कसे ४०४ द वायूपुराणस्
verses.wordMeaning: After recounting this story of great length quelling sins, Vayu went away. After studying everything, the excellent Brah- marias went to the auspicious path of Aditya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After recounting this story of great length quelling sins, Vayu went away. After studying everything, the excellent Brah- marias went to the auspicious path of Aditya.

verses.sanskrit: केचिद्गङ्गाजले नष्टाः केचिन् नष्टाः सरस्वतीम् । केचिन्महोदधौ लीनाः प्रविष्टा विन्ध्यकन्दरे
verses.transliteration: kecidgaṅgājale naṣṭāḥ kecin naṣṭāḥ sarasvatīm / kecinmahodadhau līnāḥ praviṣṭā vindhyakandare
verses.translation: This type of liberation is called SirUpya, 'similarity of appearance'.
verses.hindi: एतत्सवं समाचक्षव ज्योतिषां चेव निश्चयम् । श्रुत्वा तु बचन तेषां तदा सूतः समाहितः
verses.wordMeaning: This type of liberation is called SirUpya, 'similarity of appearance'.
verses.commentary: Sense: This type of liberation is called SirUpya, 'similarity of appearance'.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रित्य नर्मदातोये मणिनागोत्तमो नृप । तपश्चचार विपुलमुत्तरे नर्मदातटे
verses.transliteration: āśritya narmadātoye maṇināgottamo nṛpa / tapaścacāra vipulamuttare narmadātaṭe
verses.translation: O eloquent one, who is the greatest in regard to attri¬ butes, activities and power? We wish to hear clearly the descrip¬ tion of his good, wonderful qualities in detail.
verses.hindi: यथा देवगृहाणीह सूर्याचन्द्रमसोग हम चतुर्भूतावशिष्टेइस्मिन्पाथिवः सोग्निरच्यते । यश्चा55दौ तपते सूर्ये शुचिरग्निस्तु स स्मृत:..
verses.wordMeaning: O eloquent one, who is the greatest in regard to attri¬ butes, activities and power? We wish to hear clearly the descrip¬ tion of his good, wonderful qualities in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: O eloquent one, who is the greatest in regard to attri¬ butes, activities and power? We wish to hear clearly the descrip¬ tion of his good, wonderful qualities in detail.

verses.sanskrit: मातृशापभयात्पार्थ ध्यायते कामनाशनम् । अच्छेद्यमप्रतर्क्यं च विनाशोत्पत्तिवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: mātṛśāpabhayātpārtha dhyāyate kāmanāśanam / acchedyamapratarkyaṃ ca vināśotpattivarjitam
verses.translation: In this connection they cite this ancient anecdote about the greatness and omnipotence of the great Atman, Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: अचिष्मान्परमः सोडग्निः प्रभवो जाठरः स्मृतः । यश्चायं सण्डली शुक्रो निरूष्मा संप्रकाशते.
verses.wordMeaning: In this connection they cite this ancient anecdote about the greatness and omnipotence of the great Atman, Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this connection they cite this ancient anecdote about the greatness and omnipotence of the great Atman, Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: वायुभक्षः शतं साग्रं तदर्धं रविवीक्षकः । एवं ध्यानरतस्यैव प्रत्यक्षस्त्रिपुरान्तकः
verses.transliteration: vāyubhakṣaḥ śataṃ sāgraṃ tadardhaṃ ravivīkṣakaḥ / evaṃ dhyānaratasyaiva pratyakṣastripurāntakaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly this was narrated by Visnu when he had con¬ quered the three worlds after binding Bali. The deity of great prowess became the lord of the three worlds formerly.
verses.hindi: प्रभा हि सोरी पादेन ह्यस्तं याति दिवाकरे । अग्निमाविशते रात्रौ तस्माद्दूरात्प्रकाशते ११ ा/"”७।/हैिण,:/:प5?)03”:थ:प:खआयथ:थ:७०/+-++हन-न्‍जन्‍.हकहईॉजह/्/॒॒॒/॒ ॒॒/ ख/   ॥॥र्र्रज्-यञपख़ख़ख़ख़ख़््
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly this was narrated by Visnu when he had con¬ quered the three worlds after binding Bali. The deity of great prowess became the lord of the three worlds formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly this was narrated by Visnu when he had con¬ quered the three worlds after binding Bali. The deity of great prowess became the lord of the three worlds formerly.

verses.sanskrit: साधु साधु महाभाग सत्त्ववांस्तु भुजंगम । त्वया भक्त्या गृहीतो ऽहं प्रीतस्ते ह्युरगेश्वर । वरं याचय मे क्षिप्रं यस्ते मनसि वर्तते
verses.transliteration: sādhu sādhu mahābhāga sattvavāṃstu bhujaṃgama / tvayā bhaktyā gṛhīto 'haṃ prītaste hyurageśvara / varaṃ yācaya me kṣipraṃ yaste manasi vartate
verses.translation: When the Daityas were destroyed, when the Lord of Sac! was delighted, all the Devas including Indra came to see the Lord. They came near the ocean of milk where Visnu, the Atman of cosmic form, stayed. After approaching the noble-souled, the Purusa, Visnu, all the Siddhas, Brahmanas, Yaksas, Gandhar- vas, Apsaras-s, Nagas, celestial sages, rivers and mountains eulo¬ gised him.
verses.hindi: कान्ति कसी है? यह सब और ज्योतिमण्डल का वृत्तान्त हमें कहिये। ऋषियों के वचन को सुनकर सुस्थिर होकर सूतजी बोले--“इस विषय में ज्ञान-बुद्धि वाले महापण्डितों ने जेसा कहा है, तदनुसार हम आप लोगों से कहते हैं। देवों का और चन्द्र-सूये का जेसा घर है एवं चन्द्र- सूर्थ का जेसा संस्थान है, सब कुछ आप लोगों को सुना रहे हैं ।२-४। किन्तु इसके पहले हम त्रिविध अग्नि की उत्पत्ति बताते हैं। अग्नि तीन तरह
verses.wordMeaning: When the Daityas were destroyed, when the Lord of Sac! was delighted, all the Devas including Indra came to see the Lord. They came near the ocean of milk where Visnu, the Atman of cosmic form, stayed. After approaching the noble-souled, the Purusa, Visnu, all the Siddhas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Daityas were destroyed, when the Lord of Sac! was delighted, all the Devas including Indra came to see the Lord. They came near the ocean of milk where Visnu, the Atman of cosmic form, stayed. After approaching the noble-souled, the Purusa, Visnu, all the Siddhas,…

verses.sanskrit: मणिनाग उवाच: मातृशापभयान्नाथ क्लिष्टो ऽहं नर्मदातटे । त्वत्प्रसादेन मे नाथ मातृशापो भवेद्वृथा
verses.transliteration: maṇināga uvāca: mātṛśāpabhayānnātha kliṣṭo 'haṃ narmadātaṭe / tvatprasādena me nātha mātṛśāpo bhavedvṛthā
verses.translation: "O Lord, you are the creatorandsustainer of theworlds. By your grace the three worlds attain imperishable welfare. The Asuras have been conquered and Bali has been bound by you".
verses.hindi: के हैं--दिव्य, भौतिक और पाथिव । अव्यक्तजन्मा ब्रह्मा की रात्रि के बीत जाने पर, जब नैश अन्धकार से सब आच्छन्न था, कहीं कुछ सृष्टि नहीं हुई थी, केवल चार भूत ही अवशिष्ट थे, उस समय जो सर्वप्रथम अग्नि हुए वे पार्थिव कहलाये । जो अग्नि सूर्य में रहकर तपते हैंया ताप दान करते हैं, वे शुत्चि अग्नि कहलाते हैं ।५-७। वैद्युत अग्नि भी इन्हीं का नाम है। इनका अब लक्षण कहते हैं। वद्चत जाठर और सौर अग्नि जल से उत्पन्न हुए हैं; इसीलिये जब किरणों द्वारा सूयं जल का पान करते हैं तब ये आकाश में अधिक प्रकाशमान हो जाते हैं। वैद्यात अग्ति अगर वृक्ष में चले जाते हैं, तो पानी से नहीं बुझते हैं । उसी प्रकार मनुष्यों के पेट में अग्नि देव हैं, वे भी पानी से नहीं बुझते हैं । पेट में रहने वाले जो जाठर अग्नि हैं, वे अतिशय ज्योतिष्मान् हैं, और जो यह मण्डलाकार बिता गर्मी बाला गुक्त नामक अग्नि प्रकाशित
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord, you are the creatorandsustainer of theworlds. By your grace the three worlds attain imperishable welfare. The Asuras have been conquered and Bali has been bound by you".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, you are the creatorandsustainer of theworlds. By your grace the three worlds attain imperishable welfare. The Asuras have been conquered and Bali has been bound by you".

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: हव्यवाहमुखं वत्स न प्राप्स्यसि ममाज्ञया । मम लोके निवासश्च तव पुत्र भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: havyavāhamukhaṃ vatsa na prāpsyasi mamājñayā / mama loke nivāsaśca tava putra bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On being thus addressed by Devas, Siddhas and the sages, Visnu, the excellent of Purusas, replied to them.
verses.hindi: होता है, वह दिन की अपेक्षा रात में दूर से हो प्रकाशित होता है, इसलिये कि सूयं की किरण अस्तकाल में एक एक चरण से उसमें प्रवेश कर जातौ है ।८-१ १। फिर सूर्योदय होने पर पाथिव अग्नि की उष्णता
verses.wordMeaning: On being thus addressed by Devas, Siddhas and the sages, Visnu, the excellent of Purusas, replied to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being thus addressed by Devas, Siddhas and the sages, Visnu, the excellent of Purusas, replied to them.

verses.sanskrit: मणिनाग उवाच: अत्र स्थाने महादेव स्थीयतामंशभागतः । सहस्रांशेन भागेन स्थीयतां नर्मदाजले । उपकाराय लोकानां मम नाम्नैव शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: maṇināga uvāca: atra sthāne mahādeva sthīyatāmaṃśabhāgataḥ / sahasrāṃśena bhāgena sthīyatāṃ narmadājale / upakārāya lokānāṃ mama nāmnaiva śaṅkara
verses.translation: "May this be heard, O excellent Devas, I shall mention the cause; the achievement has come at the very outset, thanks to the grace of that Lord alone who is the creator of all living beings, who is Time ( Kala ), the creator of Time, and by whom the worlds have been created along with Brahma by means of his Maya power.
verses.hindi: प्रकाशश्च तथोष्ण्यं च सौराग्नेये तु तेजसी । परस्परानृप्रवेशादाप्यायेते दिवानिशम् अस्तें याति पुनः सूर्य अहें प्रविशत्यपः । तस्मान्नक्तं पुनः शुक्ला आपो विशन्ति भास्करे
verses.wordMeaning: "May this be heard, O excellent Devas, I shall mention the cause; the achievement has come at the very outset, thanks to the grace of that Lord alone who is the creator of all living beings, who is Time ( Kala ), the creator of Time,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "May this be heard, O excellent Devas, I shall mention the cause; the achievement has come at the very outset, thanks to the grace of that Lord alone who is the creator of all living beings, who is Time ( Kala ), the creator of Time,…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: स्थापयस्व परं लिङ्गम् आज्ञया मम पन्नग । इत्युक्त्वान्तर्हितो देवो जगाम ह्युमया सह
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: sthāpayasva paraṃ liṅgam ājñayā mama pannaga / ityuktvāntarhito devo jagāma hyumayā saha
verses.translation: Rudra and Agni (Fire-god) have been identified in Vedic times. Lihga worship is not Phallus-worship but the Puranic transformation of Vedic fire worship. The origin of or manifestation of the Lihga of Siva is told in different Puranas, e.g. Lihga 17, KP II. 38, Bd. 26.
verses.hindi: एक चरण से सूर्य में प्रवेश कर जाती है इस कारण सथ तृप्त होते हैं। प्रकाश और उष्णता गुण सम्पन्न सूर्य ओर अग्ति का तेज परस्पर प्रवेश करके एक दूसरे को दिन-रात तृप्त करते हैं। उत्तरीय भूगोलाड॑ं में अथवा दक्षिणीय भूमोलार्द्ध में जब सूर्य उदित होते हैं, तब रात्रि जल में प्रवेश कर जाती है; इस कारण दिन में रात्रि के प्रवेश कर जाने से जल ताम्र वर्ण का हो जाता है ।१२०१४ फिर सूर्य के अस्त होने पर
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra and Agni (Fire-god) have been identified in Vedic times. Lihga worship is not Phallus-worship but the Puranic transformation of Vedic fire worship. The origin of or manifestation of the Lihga of Siva is told in different Puranas, e.g. Lihga 17, KP II. 38, Bd. 26.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra and Agni (Fire-god) have been identified in Vedic times. Lihga worship is not Phallus-worship but the Puranic transformation of Vedic fire worship. The origin of or manifestation of the Lihga of Siva is told in different Puranas, e.g. Lihga 17, KP II. 38, Bd. 26.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: तत्र तीर्थे तु ये गत्वा शुचिप्रयतमानसाः । पञ्चम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यामष्टम्यां शुक्लकृष्णयोः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tatra tīrthe tu ye gatvā śuciprayatamānasāḥ / pañcamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, when the three worlds were plunged in un¬ manifest darkness and when the living beings had been retained inside my belly, I lay myself down.
verses.hindi: दिन जल में प्रवेश कर जाता है, इस कारण रात को जल उज्ज्बल हो जाता है। इसी तरह दक्षिणोत्तर भूगोलार्द्ध में सूये के उदय-अस्त होने पर क्रमपृवंक रात और दिन जल में प्रवेश किया करते हैं। ताप वितरण करने वाले सूथं की किरणों से जो जल पिया करते हैं, वे विमिश्न पाथिव अग्नि हैं। ये ही दिव्य शुति अग्नि भी कहलाते हैं ।१५-१७। ये हजार किरण वाले और घड़े की तरह गौल हैं। ये हमार किरणों से चारों ओर का जल खींचा करते हैं। नदी, समुद्र, कूप, बिल, स्थावर ज॑गम आदि के जल को ये खींच लिया करते हैं। हिरण्मय सूर्थ गर्मी, शीत और वर्षा बरसाने वाली हजार किरणों से युक्त है। उनमें विचित्र रूप वाली चार सौ किरणें वृष्टि किया करती हैं। वृष्टि करने वाली वें सभी किरणें वन्दन, वन्ध, ऋतन,
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, when the three worlds were plunged in un¬ manifest darkness and when the living beings had been retained inside my belly, I lay myself down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, when the three worlds were plunged in un¬ manifest darkness and when the living beings had been retained inside my belly, I lay myself down.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयन्ति सदा पार्थ नोपसर्पन्ति ते यमम् । दध्ना च मधुना चैव घृतेन क्षीरयोगतः
verses.transliteration: arcayanti sadā pārtha nopasarpanti te yamam / dadhnā ca madhunā caiva ghṛtena kṣīrayogataḥ
verses.translation: Assuming the form of the thousand-headed, thousand- eyed thousand-legged deity, holding the conch, discus and mace in the hands, I lay down in the pure limpid waters.
verses.hindi: नूतन और अमृत नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं।१८-२०। उनके बाद तीन सौ दूसरी शीतल किरणें हैं, जो पीले रंग की हैं। इन्हों से शीत उत्पन्न होता है। इनके नाम दृश्य मेध्य, बाह्य, ह्वादिनी और चन्द्र हैं। फिर
verses.wordMeaning: Assuming the form of the thousand-headed, thousand- eyed thousand-legged deity, holding the conch, discus and mace in the hands, I lay down in the pure limpid waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming the form of the thousand-headed, thousand- eyed thousand-legged deity, holding the conch, discus and mace in the hands, I lay down in the pure limpid waters.

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयन्ति विरूपाक्षमुमादेहार्धधारिणम् । कामाङ्गदहनं देवमघासुरनिषूदनम्
verses.transliteration: snāpayanti virūpākṣamumādehārdhadhāriṇam / kāmāṅgadahanaṃ devamaghāsuraniṣūdanam
verses.translation: In the meantime, from a distance I espied a person of unmeasured splendour who blazed with his brilliance resembl¬ ing a hundred suns.
verses.hindi: शुक्लास्ता नामतः सर्वास्त्रिशता धर्मंसर्जनाः । सम॑ बिभति नाभिस्तु मनुष्यपितृदेवताः बसन्ते चेव ग्रीष्से जे स तेः सुतपते त्रिभिः । वर्षास्वथों शरदि च चतुर्भिः संप्रकर्षति २५
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, from a distance I espied a person of unmeasured splendour who blazed with his brilliance resembl¬ ing a hundred suns.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, from a distance I espied a person of unmeasured splendour who blazed with his brilliance resembl¬ ing a hundred suns.

verses.sanskrit: स्नाप्यमानं च ये भक्त्वा पश्यन्ति परमेश्वरम् । ते यान्ति च परे लोके सर्वपापविवर्जितैः
verses.transliteration: snāpyamānaṃ ca ye bhaktvā paśyanti parameśvaram / te yānti ca pare loke sarvapāpavivarjitaiḥ
verses.translation: Then he who was Brahma, who was bowed to by the worlds, spoke to me—"O lord, who arc you? Whence have you come? Why do you stay here. Tell me. I am the maker of the worlds. I am self-born. I have faces all round". Thus addressed by Brahma, I spoke to him.
verses.hindi: एवं रश्मिसहत्न' तत्सोरं॑ लोकार्थशाधकम् । भिद्यते ऋतुमासाद्य जलशीतोष्णनिद्नवम् २७ इत्येतन्मण्डलं शुक्ल भास्कर सूर्यंसंज्ञितम् । ( तक्षत्रप्रहसोमानां प्रतिष्ठा योनिरेव च ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then he who was Brahma, who was bowed to by the worlds, spoke to me—"O lord, who arc you? Whence have you come? Why do you stay here. Tell me. I am the maker of the worlds. I am self-born. I have faces all round". Thus addressed by Brahma, I spoke to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he who was Brahma, who was bowed to by the worlds, spoke to me—"O lord, who arc you? Whence have you come? Why do you stay here. Tell me. I am the maker of the worlds. I am self-born. I have faces all round". Thus addressed by Brahma, I spoke to him.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं प्रेतेषु ये पार्थ चाष्टम्यां पञ्चमीषु च । ब्राह्मणैश्च सदा योग्यैर् वेदपाठकचिन्तकैः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ preteṣu ye pārtha cāṣṭamyāṃ pañcamīṣu ca / brāhmaṇaiśca sadā yogyair vedapāṭhakacintakaiḥ
verses.translation: "I am the creator and destroyer of the worlds again and
verses.hindi: नक्षत्राधिपतिः सोमों ग्रहराजों दिवाकरः। शेषाः प्च ग्रहा ज्ञेया ईश्वराः कामरूपिण:ः २६ सुरसेनापतिः स्कन्दः पठचते5ज्भारको ग्रहः । नारायण बुधं प्राहुर्देवे ज्ञानविदो बिदुः ३३१
verses.wordMeaning: "I am the creator and destroyer of the worlds again and
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am the creator and destroyer of the worlds again and

verses.sanskrit: स्वदारनिरतैः श्लक्ष्णैः परदारविवर्जितैः । षट्कर्मनिरतैस् तात शूद्रप्रेषणवर्जितैः
verses.transliteration: svadāranirataiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ paradāravivarjitaiḥ / ṣaṭkarmaniratais tāta śūdrapreṣaṇavarjitaiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that flame we two were surprised. By that splendour all the waters sparkled.
verses.hindi: शुक्ल, ककुम, विश्वभृत् आदि शुक्ल वर्ण का ताप बरसाने वाली तीन सौ किरणें हैं। सूर्य इन किरणों से मनुष्य, देवता और पितरों का समान भाव से पोषण करते हैं ।२१०२३। औषधों से मनुष्यों को, स्वधा से पितरों को और अमृत द्वारा देवों को इस प्रकार त्रिविध किरणों से सब को तृप्त करते हैं। वे हैमन्त और शिशिर में तीन सौ किरणों द्वारा शीत बरसाते हैं, वसनन्‍्त और ग्रीष्म में तीन सौ किरणों द्वारा ताप
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that flame we two were surprised. By that splendour all the waters sparkled.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that flame we two were surprised. By that splendour all the waters sparkled.

verses.sanskrit: खञ्जाश्च दर्दुराः षण्ढा वार्द्धुष्याश्च कृषीवलाः । भिन्नवृत्तिकराः पुत्र नियोज्या न कदाचन
verses.transliteration: khañjāśca dardurāḥ ṣaṇḍhā vārddhuṣyāśca kṛṣīvalāḥ / bhinnavṛttikarāḥ putra niyojyā na kadācana
verses.translation: When that excessively surprising and mysterious flame began to increase in size, Brahma and I hastened towards that
verses.hindi: वितरण करते हैं और बरसात तथा शरद में चार सौं किरणों द्वारा वृष्टि संपादन करते हैं। वे औषधियों को बल देते, स्वधा द्वारा पितरों को तृप्त करते ओर अमृत द्वारा अमरत्व का विधान करते हैं। इस प्रकार वे तीनों किरणों से तीनों को तृप्त करते हैं।२४-२६। इस तरह सूयं की हजारों किरणों से केवल लोकों का उपकार ही होता है। वे किरणें ऋतुक्रम से उत्ताप, शीतलता और जल प्रदान किया करती हैं। शुक्ल और प्रभावान् सूर्य मण्डल नक्षत्र, ग्रह और चन्द्रमा का प्रतिष्ठा-स्थान तथा उद्भव-स्थान है । नक्षत्र, ग्रह और चन्द्र सभी सूर्य से ही उत्पन्न हुए हैं। चन्द्रमा नक्षत्राधिपति हैं। और सूर्थ ग्रहराज हैं। शेष पाँचों ग्रह इच्छाधीन शरीर वाले ओर सर्वंसमर्थ हैं। ऐसा कहा जाता है कि अग्नि आदित्य हैँ और जल चन्द्रमा हैं। शेष ग्रहों की प्रकृति का भी वर्णन करते हैं, सुनिये ।२७-३०। देव सेनापति
verses.wordMeaning: When that excessively surprising and mysterious flame began to increase in size, Brahma and I hastened towards that
verses.commentary: Sense: When that excessively surprising and mysterious flame began to increase in size, Brahma and I hastened towards that

verses.sanskrit: वृषलीमन्दिरे यस्य महिषीं यस्तु पालयेत् । स विप्रो दूरतस्त्याज्यो व्रते श्राद्धे नराधिप
verses.transliteration: vṛṣalīmandire yasya mahiṣīṃ yastu pālayet / sa vipro dūratastyājyo vrate śrāddhe narādhipa
verses.translation: The massive column of flame stood touchim
verses.hindi: कारतिकेय मज़ल॒ ग्रह कहे जाते हैं । ज्ञानवात् लोग नारायण को बुध कहते हैं।३१। लोक में रुद्र
verses.wordMeaning: The massive column of flame stood touchim
verses.commentary: Sense: The massive column of flame stood touchim

verses.sanskrit: काणाष्टुंटाश्च मण्टाश्च वेदपाठविवर्जिताः । न ते पूज्या द्विजाः पार्थ मणिनागेश्वरे शुभे
verses.transliteration: kāṇāṣṭuṃṭāśca maṇṭāśca vedapāṭhavivarjitāḥ / na te pūjyā dvijāḥ pārtha maṇināgeśvare śubhe
verses.translation: Who can reach the limits of this terrible looking Linga, the cause of Mantra (Vedas), which was piercing through the heaven and the earth?
verses.hindi: धनुध्चिह्नास्तर्गतग्रन्थ: ख. पुस्तके नास्ति । रुद्रो ववस्वतः साक्षाद्धमों लोके प्रभु: स्वयम् । महाग्रहो द्विजश्रेष्ठो मन्दगासी शनेश्ररः
verses.wordMeaning: Who can reach the limits of this terrible looking Linga, the cause of Mantra (Vedas), which was piercing through the heaven and the earth?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who can reach the limits of this terrible looking Linga, the cause of Mantra (Vedas), which was piercing through the heaven and the earth?

verses.sanskrit: यदीच्छेदूर्ध्वगमनमात्मनः पितृभिः सह । सर्वाङ्गरुचिरां धेनुं यो दद्यादग्रजन्मने
verses.transliteration: yadīcchedūrdhvagamanamātmanaḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha / sarvāṅgarucirāṃ dhenuṃ yo dadyādagrajanmane
verses.translation: Then Brahma told me 3 "You go down cautiously. Let us know the limits of this Linga, the great Atman.
verses.hindi: देवासुरगुरू दो तु भानुमन्तो महाग्रहां। प्रजापतिसुतावेताबुभौ शुक्रबुहस्पती ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma told me 3 "You go down cautiously. Let us know the limits of this Linga, the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma told me 3 "You go down cautiously. Let us know the limits of this Linga, the great Atman.

verses.sanskrit: स याति परमं लोकं यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् । ततः स्वर्गाच्च्युतः सो ऽपि जायते विमले कुले
verses.transliteration: sa yāti paramaṃ lokaṃ yāvadābhūtasamplavam / tataḥ svargāccyutaḥ so 'pi jāyate vimale kule
verses.translation: I shall go up as far as the limit is reached". Thus we came to an agreement and went up and down.
verses.hindi: आदित्यमूलमखिलं त्रिलोक नात्र संशय: । भवत्यस्य जगत्कृत्स्नं सदेवासुरमानुषम् सर्वात्मा स्वबलोकेशों मूलं परमदेबतम् । ततः संजायते सर्व तत्र चेव प्रलोयते
verses.wordMeaning: I shall go up as far as the limit is reached". Thus we came to an agreement and went up and down.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall go up as far as the limit is reached". Thus we came to an agreement and went up and down.

verses.sanskrit: ये पश्यन्ति परं भक्त्या मणिनागेश्वरं नृप । न तेषां जायते वंशे पन्नगानां भयं नृप
verses.transliteration: ye paśyanti paraṃ bhaktyā maṇināgeśvaraṃ nṛpa / na teṣāṃ jāyate vaṃśe pannagānāṃ bhayaṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: Similarly Brahma too was exhausted. He could not see the limit. There itself in that great expanse of water, Brahma met me again.
verses.hindi: भावाभावों हि लोकानामादित्यान्निःसृतौ पुरा । जगज्ज्ञेयों ग्रहो विप्रा दीप्तिमांसुग्रहो रचिः.
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly Brahma too was exhausted. He could not see the limit. There itself in that great expanse of water, Brahma met me again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly Brahma too was exhausted. He could not see the limit. There itself in that great expanse of water, Brahma met me again.

verses.sanskrit: पन्नगः शङ्कते तेषां मणिनागप्रदर्शनात् । सौपर्णरूपिणस्ते वै दृश्यन्ते नागमण्डले
verses.transliteration: pannagaḥ śaṅkate teṣāṃ maṇināgapradarśanāt / sauparṇarūpiṇaste vai dṛśyante nāgamaṇḍale
verses.translation: Both of us were surprised. We were deluded by the Maya of that great Atman. We stood there (as if) we had lost our consciousness.
verses.hindi: तदादित्यादृते तेषां कालसंख्या न विद्यते । कालादूते न निगमो न दीक्षा नाह्लिकक्नमः ३६ अभावो व्यवहाराणां देवानां दिवि चेह च्  जगत्प्रतापनमृते भास्करं बारितस्करम् १४ १ स एवं कालश्राग्निश्व द्वादशात्मा प्रजापति: । तपत्येष द्विजश्रेष्ठास्त्रेलोक्यं सचराचरम् ॥४ २
verses.wordMeaning: Both of us were surprised. We were deluded by the Maya of that great Atman. We stood there (as if) we had lost our consciousness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both of us were surprised. We were deluded by the Maya of that great Atman. We stood there (as if) we had lost our consciousness.

verses.sanskrit: फलानि चैव दानानां शृणुष्वाथ नृपोत्तम । अन्नं संस्कारसंयुक्तं ये ददन्ते नरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: phalāni caiva dānānāṃ śṛṇuṣvātha nṛpottama / annaṃ saṃskārasaṃyuktaṃ ye dadante narottamāḥ
verses.translation: We bowed to the Lord engaged in meditation—the Lord who is the source of origin and the cause of (destruction) of all the worlds.
verses.hindi: देवगुरु और असूरगुरु दोनों ही प्रकाशवान् महाग्रह हैं । ये दोनों ही शुक्र बृहस्पति प्रजापति के पृत्र हैं। इन दोनों के प्रभाव से ही हैत्यपति और सुरपति प्रतापवान् हैं । तीनों लोकों का मूलकारण सूर्य ही हैं, इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं है। देवता, असुर और मनुष्यों से पूर्ण यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् सूथे का ही है ।३२-३४। विप्रों ! रुद्र, हरद्र, उपेन्द्र और चन्द्रादि देवों का जो तेज है, वह से का ही तेज है। ये ही सर्वात्मा, सर्बलोकेश और
verses.wordMeaning: We bowed to the Lord engaged in meditation—the Lord who is the source of origin and the cause of (destruction) of all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: We bowed to the Lord engaged in meditation—the Lord who is the source of origin and the cause of (destruction) of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तोयं शय्यां तथा छत्रं कन्यां दासीं सुभाषिणीम् । पात्रे देयं यतो राजन् यदीच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः
verses.transliteration: toyaṃ śayyāṃ tathā chatraṃ kanyāṃ dāsīṃ subhāṣiṇīm / pātre deyaṃ yato rājan yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence Brahma (and I) paid obeisance to the trident-bearing Sarva (Siva), the unmanifest, the mighty god of terrible roar and a frightening form having curved fangs.
verses.hindi: प्रलभूत परम देवता हैं। सूर्य से ही सब उत्पन्न हुए हैं और सूय॑ में ही सब लीन होते हैं । पूर्वकाल में लोकों की उत्पत्ति और विनाश सूर्य से ही हुआ है। विप्रो ! इमलिये यह जगत् ही ग्रहमय है और सूर्य दीप्तिमान् सुन्दर ग्रह हैं। ३५-३७। जहाँ से बारम्बार क्षण, मुह॒र्त, दिन, रात, पक्ष मास, संवत्सर ऋतु, वर्ष और युग आदि उत्पन्न होकर जिसमें लय प्राप्त करते हैँ, वह सूर्य ही हैं। सू्ं को छोड़कर दूसरे से काल की संख्या नहीं की जाती है । और बिना काल और समय के न शास्त्र, न दीक्षा और न हैविक कृत्य हो सकते हैं ।३८-२९। तब न ऋतुओं का विभाग होगा, न पुष्प खिलेंगे, न फलन्मूल की उत्पत्ति होगी, न ससय होगा, न ओषधियाँ बढ़ेगी । संसार को प्रतप्त करने वाले और जल का अपहरण करने वाले सूर्य के बिना यहाँ क्या, स्वगें में भी देवों का व्यावहारिक कार्य रुक जायगा। विप्रो ! सर्य ही काल हैं, अग्नि हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: With palms joined in reverence Brahma (and I) paid obeisance to the trident-bearing Sarva (Siva), the unmanifest, the mighty god of terrible roar and a frightening form having curved fangs.
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence Brahma (and I) paid obeisance to the trident-bearing Sarva (Siva), the unmanifest, the mighty god of terrible roar and a frightening form having curved fangs.

verses.sanskrit: सुरभीणि च पुष्पाणि गन्धवस्त्राणि दापयेत् । दीपं धान्यं गृहं शुभ्रं सर्वोपस्करसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: surabhīṇi ca puṣpāṇi gandhavastrāṇi dāpayet / dīpaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhaṃ śubhraṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam
verses.translation: "O lord of the worlds and Devas, obeisance be to you. O great lord of Bhutas, obeisance be to you. Hail to you, O external one, the cause of origin of the Siddhas. O lord, the support of the universe, obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: प्ण्द वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord of the worlds and Devas, obeisance be to you. O great lord of Bhutas, obeisance be to you. Hail to you, O external one, the cause of origin of the Siddhas. O lord, the support of the universe, obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord of the worlds and Devas, obeisance be to you. O great lord of Bhutas, obeisance be to you. Hail to you, O external one, the cause of origin of the Siddhas. O lord, the support of the universe, obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: ये ददन्ते परं भक्त्या ते व्रजन्ति त्रिविष्टपम् । मणिनागे नृपश्रेष्ठ यच्च दानं प्रदीयते
verses.transliteration: ye dadante paraṃ bhaktyā te vrajanti triviṣṭapam / maṇināge nṛpaśreṣṭha yacca dānaṃ pradīyate
verses.translation: You are the great Brahman, the Supreme Lord and the imperishable. You are the great region and the excellent Vamadeva. You are Lord Rudra, Siva and Skanda.
verses.hindi: सुधुम्नो हरिकेशश्च विश्वकर्मा तथव च। विश्वश्षवाः पुनश्चान्यः संयसुद्वरतं परम् । अर्बाग्वसु: पुनश्चान्यों मया चात्र प्रकीतितः ३४४५ सुषुम्तः सूर्य रश्सिस्तु क्षीणं शशिनमेधयन् । तियंगुध्ब॑प्रचारोसो सुषुम्नः परिकीत्यंत ४६ हरिकेश: पुरस्त्वाद ऋक्षयोनि: प्रकीत्य॑ते । दक्षिणे विश्वकर्मा तु रश्मिवेधंयते बुधम्
verses.wordMeaning: You are the great Brahman, the Supreme Lord and the imperishable. You are the great region and the excellent Vamadeva. You are Lord Rudra, Siva and Skanda.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the great Brahman, the Supreme Lord and the imperishable. You are the great region and the excellent Vamadeva. You are Lord Rudra, Siva and Skanda.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दानस्य भावेन स्वर्गे वासो भवेद्ध्रुवम् । पातकानि प्रलीयन्ते आमपात्रे यथा जलम्
verses.transliteration: tasya dānasya bhāvena svarge vāso bhaveddhruvam / pātakāni pralīyante āmapātre yathā jalam
verses.translation: You are Yajna (Sacrifice), Vasatkara, Omkara, the great goal. You are Svahakara and Namaskara. You are the purifier of all sacred rites.
verses.hindi: एवं सूर्यप्रभावेण ग्रहनक्षत्रतारका: । वर्धन्ते विदिताः सर्वा विश्व॑ चेदं पुनर्जगत्॥
verses.wordMeaning: You are Yajna (Sacrifice), Vasatkara, Omkara, the great goal. You are Svahakara and Namaskara. You are the purifier of all sacred rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Yajna (Sacrifice), Vasatkara, Omkara, the great goal. You are Svahakara and Namaskara. You are the purifier of all sacred rites.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातोयसंसिद्धं भोज्यं विप्रे ददाति यः । सो ऽपि पापैर्विनिर्मुक्तः क्रीडते दैवतैः सह
verses.transliteration: narmadātoyasaṃsiddhaṃ bhojyaṃ vipre dadāti yaḥ / so 'pi pāpairvinirmuktaḥ krīḍate daivataiḥ saha
verses.translation: You alone are Svadhakara. You are the Mantra for repetition. You are the sacred rites, observances, the Vedas, the worlds and all the Devas. You are the sound (the quality) of Akasa; you are the eternal source of living beings. You are the attribute of smell in
verses.hindi: तोर्णानां सुकतेनेह सुकृतान्ते प्रहाक्यांत्। ताराणां तारका हाय ताः शुक्लत्वाच्चेब तारकाः ३५२ द्वादशात्मा प्रजापति हैं।ये ही तीनों लोकों के चराचर को प्राप्त किया करते हैं। सूययदेव परमतेजस्वी हैं और समस्त लोकों के आत्मा हैं । ये उत्तम वायुमागं का अवलम्बन करके किरणों द्वारा ऊपर-नीौचे पाइवे भाग और सभी जगहों में ताप दान करते हैं ।४०-४३॥ हमने पहले सुये की जिन हजार किरणों को बताया है, उनमें ग्रहों को उत्वन्न करने वाली सात किरणें प्रधान हैं। सातों किरणें ये हैं -सुषुम्तन, हरिकेश, विश्वकर्मा,
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Svadhakara. You are the Mantra for repetition. You are the sacred rites, observances, the Vedas, the worlds and all the Devas. You are the sound (the quality) of Akasa; you are the eternal source of living beings. You are the attribute of smell in
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Svadhakara. You are the Mantra for repetition. You are the sacred rites, observances, the Vedas, the worlds and all the Devas. You are the sound (the quality) of Akasa; you are the eternal source of living beings. You are the attribute of smell in

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वर्गच्युतानां हि लक्षणं प्रवदाम्यहम् । दीर्घायुषो जीवपुत्रा धनवन्तः सुशोभनाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svargacyutānāṃ hi lakṣaṇaṃ pravadāmyaham / dīrghāyuṣo jīvaputrā dhanavantaḥ suśobhanāḥ
verses.translation: You arc the attribute of touch in vayu. You arc the lord Moon in the embodied form. You are the perfect knowl¬ edge in Budha. O lord of Devas, you are the seed in the Prakrti.
verses.hindi: विद्वश्रवा, संयद्वसु, अर्वाग्वसु और स्वराड्  सूर्य की सुषुम्न किरण क्षीण हुए चन्द्रमा को बढ़ाती है। यह् सुषुम्न किरण वक्र होकर ऊपर की ओर जाती हैं। हरिकेश किरण आगे की ओर रहती है। ये नक्ष त्रों की उत्पत्ति स्थान कहलाती हैं। दक्षिण ओर रहकर विश्वकर्मा किरण बुध को परिपुष्ट करती करती है
verses.wordMeaning: You arc the attribute of touch in vayu. You arc the lord Moon in the embodied form. You are the perfect knowl¬ edge in Budha. O lord of Devas, you are the seed in the Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc the attribute of touch in vayu. You arc the lord Moon in the embodied form. You are the perfect knowl¬ edge in Budha. O lord of Devas, you are the seed in the Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वव्याधिविनिर्मुक्ताः सुतभृत्यैः समन्विताः । त्यागिनो भोगसंयुक्ता धर्माख्यानरताः सदा
verses.transliteration: sarvavyādhivinirmuktāḥ sutabhṛtyaiḥ samanvitāḥ / tyāgino bhogasaṃyuktā dharmākhyānaratāḥ sadā
verses.translation: O lord, you arc the maker of living beings. You are Kala, Mrtyu, Yam a, the destroyer. You support the three worlds. You alone create them. By means of your eastern face, you manifest Indra-hood. O lord, by means of your southern face you annihilate the worlds (as Yama).
verses.hindi: पश्चाउड्भाग में रहने वाली विश्वक्षवा किरण शुक्र का उद्धवस्थान है। संयद्वसु किरण मंगल को उत्पन्न करने वाली है। छठी अर्वाग्वसु किरण से बृहस्पति उत्पन्न हुए हैं और स्वराद् किरण शर्नेश्चर को तृप्त करने बाली है। इस प्रकार सूर्य के प्रभाव से ही ग्रह-नक्षत्र तारा आदि वृद्धि प्राप्त करते हैं, यह सर्वविदित है। यह सम्पूर्ण संसार ही सर्य के द्वारा प्रकट हुआ है। यतः ये क्षीण नहीं होते हैं, उसीसे इनका नाम नक्षत्र पड़ा हैं पहले किरणों द्वारा इन क्षेत्रों में पतित होते हैं, और उनके क्षेत्रों को ग्रहण करते हैं; अतः सूर्य भी नक्षत्र कहलाते हैं । ये तारागण सुकर्म द्वारा विस्तृत हैं ओर सुकर्म द्वारा ही ग्रहों का आश्रय लेते हैं, इसी से ये तारका
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, you arc the maker of living beings. You are Kala, Mrtyu, Yam a, the destroyer. You support the three worlds. You alone create them. By means of your eastern face, you manifest Indra-hood. O lord, by means of your southern face you annihilate the worlds (as Yama).
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you arc the maker of living beings. You are Kala, Mrtyu, Yam a, the destroyer. You support the three worlds. You alone create them. By means of your eastern face, you manifest Indra-hood. O lord, by means of your southern face you annihilate the worlds (as Yama).

verses.sanskrit: देवद्विजगुरोर्भक्तास् तीर्थसेवापरायणाः । मातापितृवशा नित्यं द्रोहक्रोधविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: devadvijagurorbhaktās tīrthasevāparāyaṇāḥ / mātāpitṛvaśā nityaṃ drohakrodhavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: By means of the western face you exhibit your Varuna- hood. Your Moon-hood is established by means of your northern face.
verses.hindi: सुबति स्पनदना्थे चर धातुरेष विभाव्यते । सबनासेजसो5पां च तेनासो सविता मत:
verses.wordMeaning: By means of the western face you exhibit your Varuna- hood. Your Moon-hood is established by means of your northern face.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of the western face you exhibit your Varuna- hood. Your Moon-hood is established by means of your northern face.

verses.sanskrit: एभिरेव गुणैर् युक्ता ये नराः पाण्डुनन्दन । सत्यं ते स्वर्गादायाताः स्वर्गे वासं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: ebhireva guṇair yuktā ye narāḥ pāṇḍunandana / satyaṃ te svargādāyātāḥ svarge vāsaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: OLord having the lustre of ten thousand suns, obeis¬ ance be to you. Bow to you, O Lord having the lustre of thou¬ sand moons. Hail to you, O Lord assuming the form of a moun- tam. Obeisance to you, O reservoir of all good qualities Obeisance be to you, O gold-complexioned Lord. Hail to vou, O gold-wombed Lord. Obeisance be to you, O Lord with gold bark-garments. Obeisance be to you, O lord, the bestower of gold.
verses.hindi: घनतोयात्मक तत्र मण्डलं शशिनः स्मृतम् । घनतेजोमयं शुक्ल मण्डल भास्करस्य तु ३५७ विशन्ति सर्वदेवास्तु स्थानान्येतानि सर्वशः । सन्बन्तरेषु सर्वेषु ऋक्षसूर्यग्रहाश्याः ५८ तानि देवगृहाण्येब तदाख्यास्ते भवन्ति च। सोरं सूर्यो विशः स्थान सोम्यं सोमस्तथंव च शानश्चरं तथा स्थान देवश्चेव शनेश्चरः १६० आवित्यरश्मिसंयोगात्संप्रकाशात्मिकाः स्थ॒ता: । नवयोजनसाहस््री विष्कम्भः सवितुः स्मृतः:.
verses.wordMeaning: OLord having the lustre of ten thousand suns, obeis¬ ance be to you. Bow to you, O Lord having the lustre of thou¬ sand moons. Hail to you, O Lord assuming the form of a moun- tam. Obeisance to you, O reservoir of all good qualities Obeisance be to you,…
verses.commentary: Sense: OLord having the lustre of ten thousand suns, obeis¬ ance be to you. Bow to you, O Lord having the lustre of thou¬ sand moons. Hail to you, O Lord assuming the form of a moun- tam. Obeisance to you, O reservoir of all good qualities Obeisance be to you,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थवरं तीर्थं मणिनागं नृपोत्तम । तीर्थाख्यानमिदं पुण्यं यः पठेच्छृणुयाद् अपि
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthavaraṃ tīrthaṃ maṇināgaṃ nṛpottama / tīrthākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād api
verses.translation: Obeisance be to you e O Lord with golden necklace. Obeisance be to you, O Lord roaring terrifically.
verses.hindi: कहल'ते है और शुक्ल होने के कारण भी इनका नाम तारका पड़ा है। दिव्य, पाथिव और निशा सम्बन्धी अन्धकार का सब प्रकार से विनाश करने के कारण महान् तेजोराशि का नाम आदित्य हुआ है ।५१-५३।॥ “सु”! धातु का अर्थ होता है, स्फुरण या क्षरण  तेज और जल का क्षरण करने के कारण सूर्य सब्रिता भो कहलाते हैं। 'चदि धातु का आह्वादन, शुब्लत्व, अमृतत्व और शीतत्व आदि अनेक अथे हैं । इसी धातु से चन्द्र छाब्द
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be to you e O Lord with golden necklace. Obeisance be to you, O Lord roaring terrifically.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be to you e O Lord with golden necklace. Obeisance be to you, O Lord roaring terrifically.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽपि पापैर्विनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोके महीयते । न विषं क्रमते तेषां विचरन्ति यथेच्छया
verses.transliteration: so'pi pāpairvinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate / na viṣaṃ kramate teṣāṃ vicaranti yathecchayā
verses.translation: Obeisance be to you, OLord of terrific speed. Bow to you, O Sankara, O blue-throated one. Obeisance be to you, O Lord with a thousand arms. Hail to you, O Lord, fond of dance and playing on instruments." On being eulogised thus, the lord, the great Yogin of great intellect, became manifest. He had the lustre equal to that of a crore suns.
verses.hindi: बना है । चन्द्र और सूर्य का दिव्य मण्डल, आकाश में वतंमान है देदीप्यमान, तेजोमय, जाज्बल्यमास, शुक्ल ओर घड़े की तरह ग्रोल है ।५४-५६। उन मण्डलों में जलप्रधान चन्द्रमडल और तेज: प्रधान उज्ज्वलाकार सूर्यमंडल है । सभी मन्वन्तरों में नक्षत्र-ग्रहों के साथ देवगण इन स्थानों में प्रवेश करते हैं। इसी लिये ये देवगह कहलाते हैं । जो जिस घर में आश्रय प्राप्त करते, उसका कही नाम कहलाता है। सूर्य सौर स्थान में, सोम सोम्य स्थान में, झुंक़ शोक स्थान में प्रवेश करते हैं। शुक्र सोलह किरण वाले और प्रतापवान् हैं। बृहस्पति बृहत् स्थान में, लोहित (मंगल) लोहित स्थान में और शर्नेश्चर देव श नैदचर स्थान में प्रवेश करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be to you, OLord of terrific speed. Bow to you, O Sankara, O blue-throated one. Obeisance be to you, O Lord with a thousand arms. Hail to you, O Lord, fond of dance and playing on instruments." On being eulogised thus, the lord, the great Yogin of great intellect,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be to you, OLord of terrific speed. Bow to you, O Sankara, O blue-throated one. Obeisance be to you, O Lord with a thousand arms. Hail to you, O Lord, fond of dance and playing on instruments." On being eulogised thus, the lord, the great Yogin of great intellect,…

verses.sanskrit: भाद्रपद्यां च यत्षष्ठ्यां पुण्यं सूर्यस्य दर्शने । तत्फलं समवाप्नोति आख्यानश्रवणेन तु
verses.transliteration: bhādrapadyāṃ ca yatṣaṣṭhyāṃ puṇyaṃ sūryasya darśane / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ākhyānaśravaṇena tu
verses.translation: Then the delighted Mahadeva, appeared worthy of being addressed. He seemed to be devouring the sky with his thousands and crores of mouths, though he had only a single neck and a single mass of hair. He was bedecked in different kinds of ornaments. His body looked wonderful and variegated. He wore different (kinds of) garlands and (besmeared himself) with unguents. He held Pinaka bow in his hand. The Lord wielding a spear was seated on a bull. He wore the hide of a black antelope. He assumed a terrible form with a skull in his hand. Wearing a serpent for the sacred thread, he offered pro¬ tection to Devas. He laughed boisterously producing sound like a kettle-drum and the rumbling cloud wherewith the sky was reverberated.
verses.hindi: के सभी स्थान सूर्य किरण द्वारा प्रकाशित हो रहे है । सूर्य मेंडल का विष्कस्भ-विस्तार नौ हजार योजतनों का है और मण्डल का विस्तार-प्रमाण उससे तिगुना भधिक है! सूर्य के विस्तार से चन्द्रमा का विस्तार दूना है। इसके बराबर राहु भी इन दोनों के नीचे-तीचे चलता है। बहू मंडलाकार राहु पृथ्वी की छाया द्वारा निर्मित हुआ है ।६१-६३। राहु का अस्धकारमय बृहत् स्थान है। यह पूणिमा को सयमंडल से तिकलकर
verses.wordMeaning: Then the delighted Mahadeva, appeared worthy of being addressed. He seemed to be devouring the sky with his thousands and crores of mouths, though he had only a single neck and a single mass of hair. He was bedecked in different kinds of ornaments.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted Mahadeva, appeared worthy of being addressed. He seemed to be devouring the sky with his thousands and crores of mouths, though he had only a single neck and a single mass of hair. He was bedecked in different kinds of ornaments.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मणिनागेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ७३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । सर्वपापहरं पार्थ गोपारेश्वरमुत्तमम् । गोदेहान्निःसृतं लिङ्गं पुण्यं भूमितले नृप
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe maṇināgeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 73 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / sarvapāpaharaṃ pārtha gopāreśvaramuttamam / godehānniḥsṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ puṇyaṃ bhūmitale nṛpa
verses.translation: It is said (in Dharma-Sastra) that the vessels of (meant for) Pitrs should be made of gold, silver or copper. A silver or
verses.hindi: शतानि पत्च चत्वारि त्रीणि है चेव योजने। पूर्वापरनिकृष्टानि तारकामण्डलानि तु ॥ द यावन्त्यस्तारकाः कोटघस्तावदक्षाणि सर्वंश: । वीथीनां नियमाच्चवसृक्षमार्गों व्यवस्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: It is said (in Dharma-Sastra) that the vessels of (meant for) Pitrs should be made of gold, silver or copper. A silver or
verses.commentary: Sense: It is said (in Dharma-Sastra) that the vessels of (meant for) Pitrs should be made of gold, silver or copper. A silver or

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: गोदेहान्निःसृतं कस्माल्लिङ्गं पापक्षयंकरम् । दक्षिणे नर्मदाकूले मणिनागसमीपतः । संक्षेपात्कथ्यतां विप्र गोपारेश्वरसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: godehānniḥsṛtaṃ kasmālliṅgaṃ pāpakṣayaṃkaram / dakṣiṇe narmadākūle maṇināgasamīpataḥ / saṃkṣepātkathyatāṃ vipra gopāreśvarasambhavam
verses.translation: Showing or gifting away of silver is proclaimed to be
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमण्डल में जाता है और पुनः चन्द्रमण्डल से निकलकर सू्यमण्डलमें चला आता है। जिस कारण यह अपनी किरणों को प्रेरित करता है, इसीसे स्वर्भानु कहलाता है ।६४-६५॥। चन्द्रमा का सोलह॒बाँ भाग शुक्र है  बृहस्पति शुक्र से एक चौथाई छोठा और विस्तार मण्डल में एक योजन बड़ा है फिर शर्नेश्चर और मंगल बृहस्पति से एक चरण (चतुर्थाश) कम हैं। उसी तरह इन दोनों से बुध विस्तार-परिमाण में एक
verses.wordMeaning: Showing or gifting away of silver is proclaimed to be
verses.commentary: Sense: Showing or gifting away of silver is proclaimed to be

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: कामधेनुस्तपस्तत्र पुरा पार्थ चकार ह । ध्यायते परया भक्त्या देवदेवं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kāmadhenustapastatra purā pārtha cakāra ha / dhyāyate parayā bhaktyā devadevaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: O dear one, it was in silver vessel that Svadha was
verses.hindi: चरण कम है ।६६-६७। जो तारा नक्षत्रादि स्थलाकार देखे जाते हैं, उनका विस्तार-मण्डल प्रायः बुध के समान ' है। ये नक्षत्रादि प्रायशः चन्द्रमा के ह॒ ही निकटवर्ती हैं । इस विषय को तत्त्वज्ञानी ऐसा ही समझें  तारा-नक्षत्रादि परस्पर दो, तीन, चार-पाँच सौ योजनों के व्यवधान पर स्थिर हैं। इनमें कोई बड़े हैं और कोई छोटे । एक दूसरे से कोई भी आधा योजन. के भीतर नहीं है ।६८-७०। शनि, गुरु और मंगल सभी ग्रहों के ऊपर धीरे- धीरे विचरण करते हैं। ये दूर तक गमन करने वाने और इनकी गति वक्त होती है। इनके नीचे सूर्य, सोम, बंध भोर शुक्र बामक और भी चार महाग्रह हैं, जो शीघ्रगामी हैं। साधारण बात तो यह है कि, जितने तारे दीक्ष पड़ते हैं, उतने ही नक्षत्र हैं। वीयी के नियम से नक्षत्रों का मार्ग भी व्यवस्थित है। अयनक्रम से सं उसी मार्ग से अधः, ऊध्व॑ होकर गमन करते हैं। पर्व में जब चन्द्रमा उत्तरायण मार्थ पर वर्समाब
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one, it was in silver vessel that Svadha was
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, it was in silver vessel that Svadha was

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टस्तस्या जगन्नाथ कपिलाय महेश्वरः । निःसृतो देहमध्यात्तु अच्छेद्यः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭastasyā jagannātha kapilāya maheśvaraḥ / niḥsṛto dehamadhyāttu acchedyaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Cf. V, 5 ouDh.S 79.14-15. Yajnavalkya I. 236 specially recommends silver vessels. Cf also Mt. 19-22, Bd. 3.11-1.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु देवतायतनानि वे । अभिमानिनो्वतिष्ठन्ति स्थानानि तु पुनः पुनः ७७ अतोतेस्तु सहातीता भाव्या भाव्य: सुरासुरे: । वर्तन्ते बतंमानेश्च स्थानानि स्व: सुरैः सह.
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. V, 5 ouDh.S 79.14-15. Yajnavalkya I. 236 specially recommends silver vessels. Cf also Mt. 19-22, Bd. 3.11-1.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. V, 5 ouDh.S 79.14-15. Yajnavalkya I. 236 specially recommends silver vessels. Cf also Mt. 19-22, Bd. 3.11-1.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो देवि जगन्मातः कपिले परमेश्वरि । आराधनं कृतं यस्मात् तद् वदाशु शुभानने
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭo devi jaganmātaḥ kapile parameśvari / ārādhanaṃ kṛtaṃ yasmāt tad vadāśu śubhānane
verses.translation: Vessels made of gold, silver or copper, gingelly seeds Kutapa (i.e. the eighth muhurta of the day) or Kusa grass' sesamum seeds, garments and Tridanfi Toga (i. e. the Yoga of mind, speech and body)—all these are holy, objects.
verses.hindi: अस्मिन्म्न्वन्तरे चेव ग्रहा बेमानिकाः स्पृता: । विवस्वानदितेः पुत्रः सर्यो बेबस्वतेःन्तरे ७६ त्विषिसान्धमंपुत्रस्तु सोमदेवो वसुः स्मृतः । शुक्रो देवस्तु विज्ञेगो भागबो5सुरयाजकः बृहत्तेजा: स्मृतो देवो देवाचार्योड्भिरःसुतः  बुधो मनोहरश्चेव त्विषिपुत्नस्तु सस्मृतः.
verses.wordMeaning: Vessels made of gold, silver or copper, gingelly seeds Kutapa (i.e. the eighth muhurta of the day) or Kusa grass' sesamum seeds, garments and Tridanfi Toga (i. e. the Yoga of mind, speech and body)—all these are holy, objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vessels made of gold, silver or copper, gingelly seeds Kutapa (i.e. the eighth muhurta of the day) or Kusa grass' sesamum seeds, garments and Tridanfi Toga (i. e. the Yoga of mind, speech and body)—all these are holy, objects.

verses.sanskrit: सुरभ्युवाच: लोकानाम् उपकाराय सृष्टाहं परमेष्ठिना । लोककार्याणि सर्वाणि सिध्यन्ति मत्प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: surabhyuvāca: lokānām upakārāya sṛṣṭāhaṃ parameṣṭhinā / lokakāryāṇi sarvāṇi sidhyanti matprasādataḥ
verses.translation: In the holy rite of Sraddha, the following ritual prescribed by god Brahma is the most excellent and eternal. It is conducive to increase in fame, longevity, progeny,' intellect and lineage. In the south-east direction, especially at the intermedi¬ ate point (corner) between them, (should be the place—altar inBd. P.—for Sraddha). It should be well-situated and square shaped with sides equal to an Aratni (the distance between the tip of the fist and the elbow).
verses.hindi: अग्निविकल्पात्संजन्ने युवाइसों लोहिताधिपः । नक्षत्रऋक्षगामिन्यों दाक्षायण्यः स्मृतास्तु ता:
verses.wordMeaning: In the holy rite of Sraddha, the following ritual prescribed by god Brahma is the most excellent and eternal. It is conducive to increase in fame, longevity, progeny,' intellect and lineage. In the south-east direction,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the holy rite of Sraddha, the following ritual prescribed by god Brahma is the most excellent and eternal. It is conducive to increase in fame, longevity, progeny,' intellect and lineage. In the south-east direction,…

verses.sanskrit: लोकाः स्वर्गं प्रयास्यन्ति मत्प्रसादेन शङ्कर । तीर्थे त्वं भव मे शम्भो लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: lokāḥ svargaṃ prayāsyanti matprasādena śaṅkara / tīrthe tvaṃ bhava me śambho lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: I shall mention the proper spot for the holy rites of Pitrs in accordance with the injunctions of the scriptures. It is conducive to the attainment of wealth, health and longevity. It enhances strength and brightness of complexion.
verses.hindi: स्वर्भानुः सिहिकापुत्रों भूतसंतापनो5सुरः । सोमक्षग्रहस्यं तु कीतितास्त्वभिमानिनः स्थानान्येतान्यथोक्तानि स्थानिन्यश्चेव देवता: । शुक्लमग्निमयं स्थान सहस्लांशोविवस्व॒तः ८४ सहल्रांशोस्त्विष: स्थानमम्मयं शुक्लमेव च। आप्यं श्याम मनोज्ञस्य पञुचरश्मेग हूं स्‍्तृतम॒
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention the proper spot for the holy rites of Pitrs in accordance with the injunctions of the scriptures. It is conducive to the attainment of wealth, health and longevity. It enhances strength and brightness of complexion.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the proper spot for the holy rites of Pitrs in accordance with the injunctions of the scriptures. It is conducive to the attainment of wealth, health and longevity. It enhances strength and brightness of complexion.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति भगवानुक्त्वा तीर्थे तत्रावसन्मुदा । तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं विख्यातं वसुधातले । स्नानेनैकेन राजेन्द्र पापसङ्घं व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: tatheti bhagavānuktvā tīrthe tatrāvasanmudā / tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ vasudhātale / snānenaikena rājendra pāpasaṅghaṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: At the place (intended for Sraddha), three pits (should be dug) and three sticks of Khadira wood should be placed. They (the sticks) should be an Aratni (distance between the tip of the fist and the elbow) in length and should be embellished with silver (bands). (The pits) should be a Vitasti (the span or the distance between thumb and little finger when they are extend¬ ed on either side) in depth* and the four sides should be four Angulas (fingers) each. The sticks should not be hollow and they must be plac¬ ed on the ground with their faces pointing to the south-east. (The performer of Sraddha) should be pure and should wash them with holy waters or water rendered holy by the use of the ring of Darbha grass (called Pauitra ) worn by the per¬ former of Sraddha.
verses.hindi: रहते हैं, तब बुध बधस्थान में, राह राहुस्थान में और सब॒ नक्षत्र-नक्षत्र-स्थान में वर्तमान रहते हैं। पुण्पात्मा . ग्रहों के ही सब ज्योति स्वरूप घर हैं ।9१-७५। ब्रह्मा ने कल्प के आदिकाल में इन स्थानों का निर्माण किया है और ये प्रलय काल तक वर्तमान रहते हैं। सभी मन्‍्वन्तरों में ये देवगृह अभिमानी देवों के साथ वर्तमान रहते हैं ये स्थान बारंबार होते और बिनष्ट होते हैं । बोते हुए देवों के साथ वे स्थान बीत गये, आने वालों
verses.wordMeaning: At the place (intended for Sraddha), three pits (should be dug) and three sticks of Khadira wood should be placed. They (the sticks) should be an Aratni (distance between the tip of the fist and the elbow) in length and should be embellished with silver (bands).…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the place (intended for Sraddha), three pits (should be dug) and three sticks of Khadira wood should be placed. They (the sticks) should be an Aratni (distance between the tip of the fist and the elbow) in length and should be embellished with silver (bands).…

verses.sanskrit: गोपारेश्वरगोदानं यस्तु भक्त्या च कारयेत् । योग्ये द्विजोत्तमे देया योग्या धेनुः सकाञ्चना
verses.transliteration: gopāreśvaragodānaṃ yastu bhaktyā ca kārayet / yogye dvijottame deyā yogyā dhenuḥ sakāñcanā
verses.translation: The purification (Sodhana) may be carried out with goat's milk or cow's milk and water. By means of this Tarpana ( holy water-offering) the satisfaction (of Pitrs) will be permanent.
verses.hindi: के साथ उत्पन्न होंगे और बतंमान देवगण उन स्थानों में निवास कर रहे हैं। इस मन्वन्तर में प्रहगण विमानों पर रहा करते हैं ।७६-७६५३। वंवस्वत॑ मन्वतर में अदिति के पुत्र विवस्वान् सूर्य धर्मपुत्र त्विषिमान् वसु चन्द्रमा, असुरों के पुरोहित भृमुपुत्र शुक्र देव, देवों के पुरोहित अंगिरा के पुत्र महातेजस्वी बृहस्पति, त्विषिपुत्र मनोहर बुध, अग्ति के विकल्प से उत्पन्न युवा मज्जुल और नक्षत्रों का अनुगमन करने वाले दाक्षायणीगण एवं भूतों को पीड़ित करने वाले सिंहिका पुत्र असुर राहु हैँ ७६-०२३। इस तरह हमने चन्द्र-सूये नक्षत्रादि अभिमानी देवों के सम्बन्ध में कहा । ये ही इन स्थानों के. देवता हैं और ये ही इनके स्थान हैं। सहस्न किरण विवस्वान् का स्थान अग्निमय शुक्लवर्ण है और हजार किरणवाले चन्द्रमा का भी स्थान शुक्लवर्ण है; लेकिन जलमय है । पाँच किरणवाले बुध का स्थान जलमय और क्रृष्णवर्ण है ।६३-५५। सोलह किरणवाले शुक्र का भी स्थान
verses.wordMeaning: The purification (Sodhana) may be carried out with goat's milk or cow's milk and water. By means of this Tarpana ( holy water-offering) the satisfaction (of Pitrs) will be permanent.
verses.commentary: Sense: The purification (Sodhana) may be carried out with goat's milk or cow's milk and water. By means of this Tarpana ( holy water-offering) the satisfaction (of Pitrs) will be permanent.

verses.sanskrit: सवत्सा तरुणी शुभ्रा बहुक्षीरा सवस्त्रका । कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्याम् अष्टम्यां वा प्रदापयेत्
verses.transliteration: savatsā taruṇī śubhrā bahukṣīrā savastrakā / kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyām aṣṭamyāṃ vā pradāpayet
verses.translation: He will be prosperous here and hereafter. He will be (blessed with the fruits of) all holy rites. If a person always takes bath three times a day and worships Pitrs with Mantras as per prescribed procedure, he gets the fruit of (performance) of a horse-sacrifice {Asvamedha '). On the New Moon day, the Sraddha materials should be placed in the pit in the ground four Angulas square. These rituals are called Trih-sapla-yajna (Three-times seven Yajiia). All the three worlds are sustained by them.
verses.hindi: जलमय है। नौ किरणवाले मज्भुल का स्थान लाल रंग का और जलमय है। बारह किरणवाले बृहस्पति का स्थान बृहत् और हरिद्वर्ण है। आठ किरणवाले शनि का स्थान जलमय ओर क्ृष्णवर्ण है। राहु का स्थान
verses.wordMeaning: He will be prosperous here and hereafter. He will be (blessed with the fruits of) all holy rites. If a person always takes bath three times a day and worships Pitrs with Mantras as per prescribed procedure, he gets the fruit of (performance) of a horse-sacrifice {Asvamedha ').…
verses.commentary: Sense: He will be prosperous here and hereafter. He will be (blessed with the fruits of) all holy rites. If a person always takes bath three times a day and worships Pitrs with Mantras as per prescribed procedure, he gets the fruit of (performance) of a horse-sacrifice {Asvamedha ').…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषु चैव मासेषु कार्त्तिके च विशेषतः । दापयेत् परया भक्त्या द्विजे स्वाध्यायतत्परे
verses.transliteration: sarveṣu caiva māseṣu kārttike ca viśeṣataḥ / dāpayet parayā bhaktyā dvije svādhyāyatatpare
verses.translation: He will attain nourishment, prosperity, longevity and progeny. Various types of fortune will resort to him and he will gradually attain liberation (from Samsara).
verses.hindi: स्वर्भानोस्तामसं स्थान भूतसंतापनालयम् । विज्ञेयास्तारकाः सर्वास्त्वस्मयास्त्वेकरश्मयः ८८ आश्रय: पुण्यकीर्तीतां सुशुक्लाश्च॑व बर्णतः । घनतोयात्सिका ज्ञेया: कल्पादों वेदनिर्भिताः ८९ मुमिलेखावृतः सूर्य: पुणिमाधास्ययोस्तथा । न दृश्यते यथाकाल शीघ्रमस्तमुपति च ॥६ १ तस्मादुत्तरमार्गस्थों ह्ममावास्यां मिशाकर:। दृश्यते दक्षिणे सार्गे नियमादश्यते न च ६२ ज्योतिषां गतियोगेन सूर्याच॑द्रमसावुभौ । समानकालास्तमयों विषुवत्सु सभोदयों ६३ उत्तरासु च वीथीषु व्यन्तरास्तमयोदयों । पौणि (पूर्णा )मावास्थयोजशेंयों ज्योतिश्वक्रानुबतिनो
verses.wordMeaning: He will attain nourishment, prosperity, longevity and progeny. Various types of fortune will resort to him and he will gradually attain liberation (from Samsara).
verses.commentary: Sense: He will attain nourishment, prosperity, longevity and progeny. Various types of fortune will resort to him and he will gradually attain liberation (from Samsara).

verses.sanskrit: विधिना च प्रदद्याद् यो विधिना यस्तु गृह्णते । तावुभौ पुण्यकर्माणौ प्रेक्षकः पुण्यभाजनम्
verses.transliteration: vidhinā ca pradadyād yo vidhinā yastu gṛhṇate / tāvubhau puṇyakarmāṇau prekṣakaḥ puṇyabhājanam
verses.translation: It removes sins. It sanctifies. It has the same fruit as a horse-sacrifice. I shall mention that Mantra composed by Brahma. It is the Amrla (immortal or nectarine) and it is honoured and worshipped by Brahmanas and grants (the fruit of) Asvamedha. The Mantra: "Obeisance to all the deities, to Pitrs, to the great Yogins, to Svadha. Obeisance for ever to Svaha.". 1
verses.hindi: जीव-जस्तुओं को पीड़ा पहुँचाने वाला और तमोमय है। इनके बाद जो तारे हैं, वे एक किरणवाले हैं और उनका स्थान जलमय है। ये तारे पवित्र कीतिबालों के आश्रय हैं, शुक्ल्वण हैं जलमय हैं, और कल्प के आदि काल में विधाता द्वारा वेदोक्त विधान से निर्मित हुए हैं ।६६-८९। ये बहुत दूर रहने पर भी स्पष्ट किरणों द्वारा शीक्ष दीखने लगते हैँ । सूयं जब दक्षिणायन होकर नागवीथी में विचरण करते हूँ, तब भूमि
verses.wordMeaning: It removes sins. It sanctifies. It has the same fruit as a horse-sacrifice. I shall mention that Mantra composed by Brahma. It is the Amrla (immortal or nectarine) and it is honoured and worshipped by Brahmanas and grants (the fruit of) Asvamedha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It removes sins. It sanctifies. It has the same fruit as a horse-sacrifice. I shall mention that Mantra composed by Brahma. It is the Amrla (immortal or nectarine) and it is honoured and worshipped by Brahmanas and grants (the fruit of) Asvamedha.…

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डदानं प्रकुर्याद् यः प्रेतानां भक्तिसंयुतः । पिण्डेनैकेन राजेन्द्र प्रेता यान्ति परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: piṇḍadānaṃ prakuryād yaḥ pretānāṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ / piṇḍenaikena rājendra pretā yānti parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: At the beginning and the conclusion of the Sraddha, this Mantra shall always be repeated three times. The devotee shall repeat tins with purity of mind, when he offers the balls of rice also. Pitrs arrive quickly and Raksasas flee.
verses.hindi: लेखा द्वारा आवृत होकर अमावास्या और पूर्णिमा में नहीं मालूम पड़ते हैं; क्‍योंकि इनका अस्त शीक्र ही हो जाता है ।६९०-६ १। चन्द्रमा जब उत्तरीय मार्ग में विचरण करते हँ, तब ये दीख पड़ते हैं; किन्तु दक्षिण होते ही कभी ये दीख पड़ते हैं और कभी नहीं ।६२। नक्षत्रों की गति के अनुसार सूर्य और चन्द्र दोनों ही जब विषुवत् रेखा पर आते है; तब दोनों का ही अस्त और उदय समान काल में ही होता है। फिर उत्तरवीधी में जब बे वर्तमान रहते हैं, तब पूृणिमा और अमावास्या में ज्योतिर्चक्र का अनुवत्तेन करने वाले उन दोनों के अस्त और उदय काल में अन्तर आ जाता है। जब तेजस्वी सये दक्षिण दिशा के मार्ग में गमन करते हें, तब वे सब ग्रहों के नीचे से चलते हैं ६९ ३-६५॥ उस समय चन्द्रमा सूये के ऊपरी भाग में अपने मण्डल का विस्तार कर गभन करते हैं ओर नक्षत्र मण्डल चन्द्रमा से और ऊपर बिचरण करता है। नक्षत्र से ऊपर बुध, बुंध से ऊपर
verses.wordMeaning: At the beginning and the conclusion of the Sraddha, this Mantra shall always be repeated three times. The devotee shall repeat tins with purity of mind, when he offers the balls of rice also. Pitrs arrive quickly and Raksasas flee.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the beginning and the conclusion of the Sraddha, this Mantra shall always be repeated three times. The devotee shall repeat tins with purity of mind, when he offers the balls of rice also. Pitrs arrive quickly and Raksasas flee.

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या प्रणामं रुद्रस्य ये कुर्वन्ति दिने दिने । तेषां पापं प्रलीयेत भिन्नपात्रे जलं यथा
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā praṇāmaṃ rudrasya ye kurvanti dine dine / teṣāṃ pāpaṃ pralīyeta bhinnapātre jalaṃ yathā
verses.translation: ' Regularly repeated at the time of Sraddha by expoun¬ ders of Brahman, this Mantra enables Pitrs to cross (hell) in the three worlds. I shall mention the Mantra Saptarcis that is auspicious and that bestows all desires. By repeating it regularly, Pitrs are propitiated. 6 1 1
verses.hindi: बृहस्पति, बृहस्पति से ऊपर शनि, शनि से ऊपर सप्तरि भण्डल और सप्सर्षिमण्डल से ऊपर पश्र्व रहते हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: ' Regularly repeated at the time of Sraddha by expoun¬ ders of Brahman, this Mantra enables Pitrs to cross (hell) in the three worlds. I shall mention the Mantra Saptarcis that is auspicious and that bestows all desires. By repeating it regularly, Pitrs are propitiated. 6 1 1
verses.commentary: Sense: ' Regularly repeated at the time of Sraddha by expoun¬ ders of Brahman, this Mantra enables Pitrs to cross (hell) in the three worlds. I shall mention the Mantra Saptarcis that is auspicious and that bestows all desires. By repeating it regularly, Pitrs are propitiated. 6 1 1

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो राजन्वृषभं च समुत्सृजेत् । पितरश्चोद्धृतास् तेन शिवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanvṛṣabhaṃ ca samutsṛjet / pitaraścoddhṛtās tena śivaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: The Saptarcis 1 Mantra: "I always make obeisance to those who are engaged in meditation by means of the yogic
verses.hindi: ९६-९७। तारा-ग्रहों का अन्तर ऊपर की ओर यथाक्रम से दो लाख योजनों का है । चर्द्र, सूर्य और ग्रह आदि परस्परस्थिता छा ते युज्यन्ते च परस्परम् । असंकरेण विज्ञेयस्तेषां योगस्तु थे बुधः ११० १
verses.wordMeaning: The Saptarcis 1 Mantra: "I always make obeisance to those who are engaged in meditation by means of the yogic
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saptarcis 1 Mantra: "I always make obeisance to those who are engaged in meditation by means of the yogic

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: वृषोत्सर्गे कृते तात फलं यज्जायते नृणाम् । तत्सर्वं कथयस्वाशु प्रयत्नेन द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: vṛṣotsarge kṛte tāta phalaṃ yajjāyate nṛṇām / tatsarvaṃ kathayasvāśu prayatnena dvijottama
verses.translation: I bow to the Seven Sages and Pitrs who fulHl all desires and who are the progenitors of Indra and other (Dcvas) and of Bhrgu and Marlca (Kasyapa). After bowing to all the Pitrs who bestow welfare on Manu and other lords of Suras and on the sun and the moon, I bow down with palms joined in reverence to Pitamahas, the progenitors of the constellations, the mobile (and the immobile beings) and of the heaven and the earth.
verses.hindi: त्विषिमान्धमंपुत्रस्तु सोमो विश्वावसुस्तथा । शोतरश्मिः समुत्पन्नः कृत्तिकासु निशाकर:.
verses.wordMeaning: I bow to the Seven Sages and Pitrs who fulHl all desires and who are the progenitors of Indra and other (Dcvas) and of Bhrgu and Marlca (Kasyapa). After bowing to all the Pitrs who bestow welfare on Manu and other lords of Suras and on the sun and the moon,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow to the Seven Sages and Pitrs who fulHl all desires and who are the progenitors of Indra and other (Dcvas) and of Bhrgu and Marlca (Kasyapa). After bowing to all the Pitrs who bestow welfare on Manu and other lords of Suras and on the sun and the moon,…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णे वृषे चैव तु यत्फलम् । तदहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व धर्मनन्दन
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇe vṛṣe caiva tu yatphalam / tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva dharmanandana
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence I bow down to those who bestow fearlessness, to those who are revered by all the worlds and to the progenitors of the divine sages.
verses.hindi: दिव्य तेज के द्वारा आकाश में नियमक्रम से नित्य संयुक्त होते हैं और प्रथक द्वीते हैं। ग्रह, नक्षत्र, सूर्याद समागमकाल में या निम्न-उच्च होने के समय में मृदुभाव धारण कर लेते हैं, जिससे सब कोई उन्हें एक बार देख लेते हैं ।९८-१००। यदि परस्पर में इनका संयोग भी होता है, तो ये तिल-तण्डूल की तरह प्रथक् ही रहते हैं। विद्वानों को ऐसा ही समझना चाहिए। यह हमने पृथिवी, ज्योतिश्चक्र, द्वीप, सागर, पवेत, वर्ष, नदी, और इनके निवासियों का वर्णन किया। ये सब ग्रह पहले नक्षत्र-समूह में समुत्यन्न हुए हैं ।(०१-१०३॥ अदितिपुत्र विवस्वान् सूर्य जो ग्रहों में आदि ग्रह हैं, वे चाक्षब मन्वस्तर में विशाखा में उत्पन्न हुये हैं। धर्मपुत्र, त्विषिमानू, सोम, विश्वावसु, शीतरश्मि, निशाकर कृत्तिका में उत्पन्न हुए हैं  सूयं की उत्पत्ति के बाद सोलह किरण वाले भूृगुपुत्र शुक, जो तारामग्रहों
verses.wordMeaning: With palms joined in reverence I bow down to those who bestow fearlessness, to those who are revered by all the worlds and to the progenitors of the divine sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence I bow down to those who bestow fearlessness, to those who are revered by all the worlds and to the progenitors of the divine sages.

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तिके चैव वैशाखे पूर्णिमायां नराधिप । रुद्रस्य सन्निधौ भूत्वा शुचिः स्नातो जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: kārttike caiva vaiśākhe pūrṇimāyāṃ narādhipa / rudrasya sannidhau bhūtvā śuciḥ snāto jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence, I bow down to Praja- pati, Kasyapa, Soma, Varuna and to the lords of all Yoga. Obeisance to the seven groups of Pitrs in the seven worlds. Obeisance to the self-born Brahma of Yogic vision."
verses.hindi: में श्रेष्ठ हैं, वे पुष्य नक्षत्र में उत्पन्न हुए हैं। अंगिरा के पृत्र बारह किरणवाले जगद्गुरु बृहस्पति फल्युनी में ' उत्पन्न हुये हैं ।! ०४-१०७। नौ किरणवाले प्रजापति तनय मज्भल पूर्वाषाढ़ में उत्पन्न हुए । श्रूति ऐसा ही कहती. है । सात किरणवाले सूयेपुत्र शनि रेवती में उत्पन्न हुए हैं एवं चन्द्र-सूर्य को पीड़ा पहुंचाने वाले राहु-केतु भी रेवती में ही उत्पन्न हुए हैं । शुक्र प्रमुख ये तारा ग्रह आदि जन्मकालिक नक्षत्र के वश यदि विगुण या दुष्ट ही जाते
verses.wordMeaning: With palms joined in reverence, I bow down to Praja- pati, Kasyapa, Soma, Varuna and to the lords of all Yoga. Obeisance to the seven groups of Pitrs in the seven worlds. Obeisance to the self-born Brahma of Yogic vision."
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence, I bow down to Praja- pati, Kasyapa, Soma, Varuna and to the lords of all Yoga. Obeisance to the seven groups of Pitrs in the seven worlds. Obeisance to the self-born Brahma of Yogic vision."

verses.sanskrit: वृषस्यैव समुत्सर्गं कारयेत् प्रीयतां हरः । सांनिध्ये कारयेत् पुत्र चतस्रो वत्सिकाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣasyaiva samutsargaṃ kārayet prīyatāṃ haraḥ / sāṃnidhye kārayet putra catasro vatsikāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the Mantra honoured by the groups of Brahmar-?is along with the Seven Sages has been mentioned. It is highly holy and sanctified. It is conducive to prosperity and destruc¬ tive of Raksasas.
verses.hindi: हैं, तब वे उसी दोष के कारण क्लेश पहुंचाने लगते हैं। बह पीड़ा उन्तमें भक्ति करने से ही शान्‍्त हो जाती सर्वग्रहाणामेतेषामादिरादित्य उच्यते । ताराग्रह्मणां शुक्रस्तु केतुनां चेव धमवान् क्‍
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the Mantra honoured by the groups of Brahmar-?is along with the Seven Sages has been mentioned. It is highly holy and sanctified. It is conducive to prosperity and destruc¬ tive of Raksasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the Mantra honoured by the groups of Brahmar-?is along with the Seven Sages has been mentioned. It is highly holy and sanctified. It is conducive to prosperity and destruc¬ tive of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा तु विप्रमुख्याय सर्वलक्षणसंयुताः । प्रीयतां च महादेवो ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: dattvā tu vipramukhyāya sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ / prīyatāṃ ca mahādevo brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The man who (performs Sraddha) according to these injunctions attains three boons. Pitrs grant food, longevity and childern (to the people) on the earth. He who is endowed with great devotion, who has faith, who has controlled his senses and who always repeals this Sap¬ tarcis Mantra with purity, becomes the sole Emperor on the earth consisting of seven continents and oceans.
verses.hindi: श्रुवः कीलो ग्रहाणां तु विभक्तानां चतुदिशम् नक्षत्राणां श्रविष्ठा स्थादयनानां तथोत्तरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The man who (performs Sraddha) according to these injunctions attains three boons. Pitrs grant food, longevity and childern (to the people) on the earth. He who is endowed with great devotion, who has faith,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who (performs Sraddha) according to these injunctions attains three boons. Pitrs grant food, longevity and childern (to the people) on the earth. He who is endowed with great devotion, who has faith,…

verses.sanskrit: वृषभे रोमसंख्या या सर्वाङ्गेषु नराधिप । तावद्वर्षप्रमाणं तु शिवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: vṛṣabhe romasaṃkhyā yā sarvāṅgeṣu narādhipa / tāvadvarṣapramāṇaṃ tu śivaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: If any thing is cooked in the house, whether a dainty or ordinary eatable, it should never be eaten in that house with¬ out first offering it (to deities).
verses.hindi: मुहूर्तानां तथवा55दिमुहू्तों रुद्रदेबतः । अक्ष्णोश्वापि निमेषादिः काल: कालबिदों मत: श्रवणान्तं प्रविष्टादि युगं स्थातृपश्चवाषक्म् । भानोग तिविशेषेण चक्रवत्परिवतंते ११६ दिवाकरः स्मृतस्तस्मात्कालस्तं विद्धि चेश्वरम्  चतुरविधानां भूतानां प्रवर्तंकनिवर्तंक: ११७ इत्येष ज्योतिषामेव संनिवेशो5थनिश्वयात् । लोकसंव्यवहारार्थमीश्वरेण विनिर्मित: ११८
verses.wordMeaning: If any thing is cooked in the house, whether a dainty or ordinary eatable, it should never be eaten in that house with¬ out first offering it (to deities).
verses.commentary: Sense: If any thing is cooked in the house, whether a dainty or ordinary eatable, it should never be eaten in that house with¬ out first offering it (to deities).
