verses.translation: Washing the feet after applying clay, he should duly perform Acamana (sipping of water). He should then pour water down three times with (invocation of) the sun, fire and water. A sensible man should always keep a water-pot handy. Subsidiary actions and washing of the feet shall be done by means of this pot. The performance of Acamana and divine duties shall be done by means of a second (vessel). If such actions are per¬ formed with a defiled hand, one should observe fast for three nights. In protracted cases of default, the rite of Krcchra is prescribed for expiation. After touching a dog or a Candala one should perform Taptakrcchra rite. If human bones are touched, fasting is the purification (for it). It is prescribed that if (the bones are) touched delibera- After dealing with the purification of things or materials for Sraddha, the aut hor deals with the purification of the man performing the Sraddha in w. 59 to the end of the Chapter. The Purana-writers (in fact the whole tribe of writers on Dharma-Sastra in the mediaeval period) appear to have been so much obsessed with 'purity-psychosis' that they lost sight of the social necessity of assimilating foreigners or backward people in Hinduism and prohibited their own followers from going beyond the contrac¬ ting geographical limits of Brahmanism (vide w. 69-71), By going to unholy places, one acquires all sorts of One who has no faith in purificatory rites is born among Mlecchas. Those who do not perform Yajnasand sinners are born among the lower strata of animals. A man gets released from sins through purificatory rites and attains heaven. Devas indeed desire purity. This has been declared by Devas themselves. Suras always forsake the hideous and the unclean. Men of auspicious rites perform three types of purificatory rites justifiably.
verses.hindi: तत्किमर्थ भयोदिर्ना मृगाः सिहादिता इव । कि दुःख केन संतापः कुतो वा भयमागतम् ॥। श्रुत्वा बाक्यं ततस्तस्य ब्रह्मणो वे महात्मनः । ऊचुस्ते ऋषिभिः साथ सुरबेत्येन्द्रदानवाः ५६
verses.wordMeaning: Washing the feet after applying clay, he should duly perform Acamana (sipping of water). He should then pour water down three times with (invocation of) the sun, fire and water. A sensible man should always keep a water-pot handy.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Washing the feet after applying clay, he should duly perform Acamana (sipping of water). He should then pour water down three times with (invocation of) the sun, fire and water. A sensible man should always keep a water-pot handy.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भीमेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ७८ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र नरदेश्वरमुत्तमम् । तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं निर्मितं नारदेन तु
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhīmeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 78 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra naradeśvaramuttamam / tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ nāradena tu
verses.translation: O intelligent Suta, the Sniddhakalpa has been recounted by you. The Sraddhakalpa glorified by sages, has been heard by us. Its extensive details have been particularly narrated. O extremely intelligent one, please mention the remaining topics too, according to the opinion of that sage.
verses.hindi: सुरासुरेमंथ्यमाने पायोधो च महात्मभिः  भुजज़भूहगसंकाशं नीलजीसृूलतसंनिभम् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: O intelligent Suta, the Sniddhakalpa has been recounted by you. The Sraddhakalpa glorified by sages, has been heard by us. Its extensive details have been particularly narrated. O extremely intelligent one, please mention the remaining topics too,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O intelligent Suta, the Sniddhakalpa has been recounted by you. The Sraddhakalpa glorified by sages, has been heard by us. Its extensive details have been particularly narrated. O extremely intelligent one, please mention the remaining topics too,…

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: नारदेन मुनिश्रेष्ठ कस्मात्तीर्थं विनिर्मितम् । एतदाख्याहि मे सर्वं प्रसन्नो यदि सत्तम
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: nāradena muniśreṣṭha kasmāttīrthaṃ vinirmitam / etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasanno yadi sattama
verses.translation: O blessed Brahmanas, I shall recount the opinion of that sage in detail, in regard to Sraddha. Listen to it from me. The Sraddha rite as well as the mode of its performance have been previously mentioned by me. I shall also mention what remains in the proper order as regards the Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: कालमृत्युरिवोद्भुतं युगाष्तादित्यपचेसम् । त्रलोक्योत्साविसुर्थाभिं प्रस्फुरन्तं समन्‍्ततः ७४८ विषेणोत्तिष्ठमानेन कालानलसमत्बिषा । नि्ंग्धो रक्तगोंराइुग:ः कृतः कृष्णो जनादंनः ३५६
verses.wordMeaning: O blessed Brahmanas, I shall recount the opinion of that sage in detail, in regard to Sraddha. Listen to it from me. The Sraddha rite as well as the mode of its performance have been previously mentioned by me.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O blessed Brahmanas, I shall recount the opinion of that sage in detail, in regard to Sraddha. Listen to it from me. The Sraddha rite as well as the mode of its performance have been previously mentioned by me.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: परमेष्ठिसुतः पार्थ नारदो मुनिसत्तमः । रेवायाश्चोत्तरे कूले तपस्तेन पुरा कृतम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: parameṣṭhisutaḥ pārtha nārado munisattamaḥ / revāyāścottare kūle tapastena purā kṛtam
verses.translation: It is not that Brahmanas should always be (subjected to) tests and investigation. But in regard to rites pertaining to gods and Pitrs (employment of) tests has been laid down in the Sruti. 1 One shall scrupulously avoid that person in whom de¬ fects are seen or who is shunned by good men or who, through contacts or staying together, is known to be wicked.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्वा त॑ रक्तमौराडगं कृत कृष्णं जनाईनम् । भीताः सर्वे बय॑ देवास्व्यामेब शरणं गताः ३६०
verses.wordMeaning: It is not that Brahmanas should always be (subjected to) tests and investigation. But in regard to rites pertaining to gods and Pitrs (employment of) tests has been laid down in the Sruti.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is not that Brahmanas should always be (subjected to) tests and investigation. But in regard to rites pertaining to gods and Pitrs (employment of) tests has been laid down in the Sruti.…

verses.sanskrit: नवनाडीनिरोधेन काष्ठावत्यां गतेन च । तोषितः पशुभर्ता वै नारदेन युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: navanāḍīnirodhena kāṣṭhāvatyāṃ gatena ca / toṣitaḥ paśubhartā vai nāradena yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: A sensible man should always test a Brahmana who is not known before, at the time of Sraddha. 2 Since the days of Grhya Sutras, there was insistence on the antecedents learning, character of the invitees (Brahmanas) for rites nertainim* in
verses.hindi: सुराणामसुराणां च श्रुत्वा वाक्य पितामहः। भप्रत्युवाच महातेजा लोकानां हितकाम्यया ।६ १ चित्त उद्विग्न क्‍यों हो रहा है ? सुरसत्तन ! हमने आप लोगों के ही लिये अष्ट गुण ऐश्वर्य की सृष्टि की है। फिर किसने आपके उस ऐश्वर्य का अपहरण किया है ? आप सब श्रेल्लोक्य के ईदवर हैं, आप सब्को कीई सस्ताप नहीं होता है। हम यह भी देख रहे हैं कि, हमारी सृष्टि में कोई भी ऐसा नहीं है. जो हमारी आज्ञा का उल्लंघन करे ।५१-५३। आप सब स्वच्छन्द गामी विमान-विहारी हैं और प्रजाजन के आध्यात्मिक,
verses.wordMeaning: A sensible man should always test a Brahmana who is not known before, at the time of Sraddha. 2 Since the days of Grhya Sutras, there was insistence on the antecedents learning, character of the invitees (Brahmanas) for rites nertainim* in
verses.commentary: Sense: A sensible man should always test a Brahmana who is not known before, at the time of Sraddha. 2 Since the days of Grhya Sutras, there was insistence on the antecedents learning, character of the invitees (Brahmanas) for rites nertainim* in

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: तुष्टो ऽहं तव विप्रेन्द्र योगिनाथ अयोनिज । वरं प्रार्थय मे वत्स यस्ते मनसि वर्तते
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: tuṣṭo 'haṃ tava viprendra yoginātha ayonija / varaṃ prārthaya me vatsa yaste manasi vartate
verses.translation: Cf. Visnu Dh.S. 82-1-2. Devas and the masters of Yoga roam about the ocean-girt earth in various guises, virtuously protecting the subjects. A man should worship and offer a Brahmana guest different types of food and vegetable dishes and fruits as well. 1
verses.hindi: आधिभौतिक और आधिदेविक कर्म विपाक को भी बदल देने में समर्थ हैं। यह सत्र होते हुए भी फिर क्यों आप इस तरह डरे हुए हैं, जसे सिंह से पीड़ित हरिण हो । कया दुःख है, कौन शोक है यह भय कहाँ से आया है? यह सब आप हमें शीक्ष बतलाबें ।१४-५५। महात्मा ब्रह्मा की बातों को सुनकर ऋषि प्रमुख देव-दानवगण बोले--“महात्मा देव-दानवों द्वारा क्षीर-सागर मथा जा रहा था कि एक भणड्ूर विष
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Visnu Dh.S. 82-1-2. Devas and the masters of Yoga roam about the ocean-girt earth in various guises, virtuously protecting the subjects. A man should worship and offer a Brahmana guest different types of food and vegetable dishes and fruits as well. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Visnu Dh.S. 82-1-2. Devas and the masters of Yoga roam about the ocean-girt earth in various guises, virtuously protecting the subjects. A man should worship and offer a Brahmana guest different types of food and vegetable dishes and fruits as well. 1

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच: त्वत्प्रसादेन मे शम्भो योगश्चैव प्रसिध्यतु । अचला ते भवेद्भक्तिः सर्वकालं ममैव तु
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca: tvatprasādena me śambho yogaścaiva prasidhyatu / acalā te bhavedbhaktiḥ sarvakālaṃ mamaiva tu
verses.translation: A devout person who feeds Brahmanas faithfully, offering them all desired objects, obtains the fruit thereof. He who offers all his possessions to all guests and Brahmanas enjoys for ever the fruit of Sarvamedha sacrifice. He who slights a guest after his coming at the time of Sraddha or in a rite for Devas, is shunned by Devas in the manner a Hotr disregards another man's wealth.
verses.hindi: निकला, जो संवर्तंक अग्नि की भाँति प्रभावाला और भूजज्, भूज़ एवं नील मेष की तरह काला है। वह विष काल मृत्यु की तरह, युगान्त काल में तोनों लोकों को जलाने बाली सूर्य की प्रतप्त किरण की तरह सभी दिशाओं में प्रस्फुरित हो रहा है. उस बविंध से जो कालाग्नि के समान कान्ति निकल रही है; उससे लाल और गोरे शरीर वाले विष्णु काले हो गये हैं। लाल और गोरे विष्णु को काला होते देखकर हम सभी देवगण डर गये हैं और आपकी शरण में आये हैं ।५६-६०। महातेजस्त्री ब्रह्मा ने देव-दानवों को बात सुनकर संसार के कल्याण के लिये कहा--है तपोधन ऋषियों ! और सभी देवों ! आपलोग सुनें. सागर के मथे
verses.wordMeaning: A devout person who feeds Brahmanas faithfully, offering them all desired objects, obtains the fruit thereof. He who offers all his possessions to all guests and Brahmanas enjoys for ever the fruit of Sarvamedha sacrifice.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A devout person who feeds Brahmanas faithfully, offering them all desired objects, obtains the fruit thereof. He who offers all his possessions to all guests and Brahmanas enjoys for ever the fruit of Sarvamedha sacrifice.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छाचारी भवे देव वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः । त्रिकालज्ञो जगन्नाथ गीतज्ञो ऽहं सदा भवे
verses.transliteration: svecchācārī bhave deva vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / trikālajño jagannātha gītajño 'haṃ sadā bhave
verses.translation: For the purpose of blessing the worlds Devas, Pitys and Fire-god enter those Brahmanas and take food. If they are not worshipped, they burn; if they are worshipped, they grant all desires. Hence one should always worship guests by offeringone's entire possession.
verses.hindi: शणुध्व॑ देवताः सर्वे ऋषयश्न तपोधना: । तत्तदग्रे समुत्पन्न॑ मथ्यमाने महोदधो
verses.wordMeaning: For the purpose of blessing the worlds Devas, Pitys and Fire-god enter those Brahmanas and take food. If they are not worshipped, they burn; if they are worshipped, they grant all desires. Hence one should always worship guests by offeringone's entire possession.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the purpose of blessing the worlds Devas, Pitys and Fire-god enter those Brahmanas and take food. If they are not worshipped, they burn; if they are worshipped, they grant all desires. Hence one should always worship guests by offeringone's entire possession.

verses.sanskrit: दिने दिने यथा युद्धं देवदानवमानुषैः । पाताले मर्त्यलोके वा स्वर्गे वापि महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: dine dine yathā yuddhaṃ devadānavamānuṣaiḥ / pātāle martyaloke vā svarge vāpi maheśvara
verses.translation: A forest-dweller, a householder, a person who visits the house, children, distressed persons and an ascetic—all there are to be known as Alithis (guests). An Abhydgata is the guest who begs for something. An Atithi will not beg. An Atithi is the most excellent because he
verses.hindi: विष कालानलप्रस्यं कालक्टेति विश्वुतम् । येन प्रोद्भृतमात्रेण क्ृतः क्ृष्णो जनादंनः तस्य विष्णुरहूं चापि सर्वे ते सुरपुडुगवा:। न शक्‍्नुवन्ति वे सोढुं बेगमन्ये तु शंकरातु ६४ इत्युक्त्वा पद्मगर्भाभः पद्सयोनिरयोनिज: । ततः स्तोतुं समारब्धो ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ६५ नमस्तुम्यं विरूपाक्ष नमस्तेःनेकचक्षषे । नम: पिनाकहस्ताय वज्जहस्ताय वे नमः

verses.sanskrit: पश्येयं त्वत्प्रसादेन भवन्तं पार्वतीं तथा । तीर्थं लोकेषु विख्यातं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: paśyeyaṃ tvatprasādena bhavantaṃ pārvatīṃ tathā / tīrthaṃ lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: Such cheap promises of getting the fruits of sacrifices like Agnisjoma or Atiratra by offering ordinary things like milk or ghee to Brahmanas have adversely affected the Vedic institution of sacrifice. For the distinction between Atithi and Abhydgata vide w. 16-18 below. A real guest is neither terrible nor of a mixed caste, neither devoid oflearning nor a very learned specialist, neither has he too many children nor is he servile. He is of good conduct.
verses.hindi: नमस्त्रेलोक्यनाथाय भूतानां पतये नमः । नमः सुरारिसंहत्रें तापसाय त्रिचक्षषे ६७ ब्रह्मणे चेव रुद्राय विष्णवे चेब ते नमः । सांख्याय चेव योगाय भृतग्रामाय थे नमः ६८ मन्‍्मथाइूगविनाशाय कालकालाय वे नमः । रुद्राय च्र सुरेशाय देवदेवाय ते नमः
verses.wordMeaning: Such cheap promises of getting the fruits of sacrifices like Agnisjoma or Atiratra by offering ordinary things like milk or ghee to Brahmanas have adversely affected the Vedic institution of sacrifice. For the distinction between Atithi and Abhydgata vide w. 16-18 below.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Such cheap promises of getting the fruits of sacrifices like Agnisjoma or Atiratra by offering ordinary things like milk or ghee to Brahmanas have adversely affected the Vedic institution of sacrifice. For the distinction between Atithi and Abhydgata vide w. 16-18 below.…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: एवं नारद सर्वं तु भविष्यति न संशयः । चिन्तितं मत्प्रसादेन सिध्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: evaṃ nārada sarvaṃ tu bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ / cintitaṃ matprasādena sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: A person who wishes (the fruit of) the performance of a Yajna should hospitably receive and give (food etc.) to a guest who has wandered a lot, is thirsty, tired and extremely hungry. A woman in menses in all the castes becomes pure in three nights. It is laid down that by touching a woman in her menses, a woman lying-in-chamber, a dog, a Gandala, a nudist like a Digambara Jaina and similar people and those who have borne a dead body, one gets polluted. He must take bath along with his clothes and smear clay twelve times on himself. Then he becomes pure.
verses.hindi: कपदिने करालाय शंकराय कपालिने । विरूपायेकरूपाय शिवाय वरदाय च +त्रिपुरध्नाय वन्द्याय मातृणां पतये नमः । बुद्धाय चेव शुद्धाय मुक्ताय केवलाय च ..
verses.wordMeaning: A person who wishes (the fruit of) the performance of a Yajna should hospitably receive and give (food etc.) to a guest who has wandered a lot, is thirsty, tired and extremely hungry. A woman in menses in all the castes becomes pure in three nights.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who wishes (the fruit of) the performance of a Yajna should hospitably receive and give (food etc.) to a guest who has wandered a lot, is thirsty, tired and extremely hungry. A woman in menses in all the castes becomes pure in three nights.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छाचारो भवेर्वत्स स्वर्गे पातालगोचरे । मर्त्ये वा भ्रम वै योगिन्न केनापि निवार्यसे
verses.transliteration: svecchācāro bhavervatsa svarge pātālagocare / martye vā bhrama vai yoginna kenāpi nivāryase
verses.translation: The same purificatory rite should be followed in the case of sexual intercourse. Clay is to be applied nine times. After washing hands with clay (and water), a person shall perform the purificatory rite. After washing the hands with water and taking bath, a sensible man shall apply clay to the private parts twice. This is themode of purification to be observed by all the castes for ever. One should smear hands and feet three times and sprinkle them with water.
verses.hindi: नमः कमलहस्ताय विग्वासाय शिखण्डिने । लोकत्रयविधाज्रे च रुद्राय वरुणाय च
verses.wordMeaning: The same purificatory rite should be followed in the case of sexual intercourse. Clay is to be applied nine times. After washing hands with clay (and water), a person shall perform the purificatory rite. After washing the hands with water and taking bath,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The same purificatory rite should be followed in the case of sexual intercourse. Clay is to be applied nine times. After washing hands with clay (and water), a person shall perform the purificatory rite. After washing the hands with water and taking bath,…

verses.sanskrit: सप्त स्वरास्त्रयो ग्रामा मूर्च्छनाश्चैकविंशतिः । ताना एकोनपञ्चाशत्प्रसादान्मे तव ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: sapta svarāstrayo grāmā mūrcchanāścaikaviṃśatiḥ / tānā ekonapañcāśatprasādānme tava dhruvam
verses.translation: Verses 226-30 deal with personal purification Clay shall be applied fifteen times to the hands and other unclean parts. Clay shall be applied to the uncleaned parts and it shall be washed with water.
verses.hindi: अग्राय चेव चोग्राय विप्रायानेकचक्षुषे । रजसे चेव सत्त्वाय तमसे 5व्यक्तयो नये (७३ जाते पर आपके आगे ही जो कालाग्ति के समान कालकूट विष निकला है और जिसने निकलते ही विष्णु को काला बना दिया है, उस विषके वेग को हम, विष्णु या आप देवगण नहीं सह सकते हैं। हाँ, उसके वेग को शद्धूर भगवान् सहन कर सकते हैं ।६१-६४। यह कहकर पद्मगर्भ की तरह आभावाले प्मयोनि होने पर भी अयोनि, लोकपितामह ब्रह्म ने स्तुति करना प्रारम्भ किया। है अनेक नेत्र वाले विरूपाक्ष, है पिनाक
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 226-30 deal with personal purification Clay shall be applied fifteen times to the hands and other unclean parts. Clay shall be applied to the uncleaned parts and it shall be washed with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 226-30 deal with personal purification Clay shall be applied fifteen times to the hands and other unclean parts. Clay shall be applied to the uncleaned parts and it shall be washed with water.

verses.sanskrit: मम प्रियंकरं दिव्यं नृत्यगीतं भविष्यति । कलिं च पश्यसे नित्यं देवदानवकिन्नरैः
verses.transliteration: mama priyaṃkaraṃ divyaṃ nṛtyagītaṃ bhaviṣyati / kaliṃ ca paśyase nityaṃ devadānavakinnaraiḥ
verses.translation: After tying a cloth round the neck or the head, if any- one walks on foot along the street, he shall wash the feet. With¬ out washing the feet, even if he performs Acamana, he shall be unclean. After washing the feet and setting the waterpot down, he should perform Acamana and then sprinkle it with water. The materials of Sraddha etc. shall be sprinkled again.
verses.hindi: ओर वज्ञ धारण करने वाले ! आपको नमस्कार है ।६५-६६॥। है त्रलोक्यनाथ ! है भूतपति ! है त्रितयन ! आप तपस्त्री और देव-शत्रुओं के विनाशकर्ता हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप ब्रह्मा, विषण्ण और रुद्र हैं । सांख्य-योग और भूतग्राम आपसे ही प्रतिष्ठित हुआ है, आपको नलस्कार है। आप कामदेव के शरीर का दहन करने वाले, कालकाल, रुद्र, सुरेश और देवदेव हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप कपर्दी, कपाली,
verses.wordMeaning: After tying a cloth round the neck or the head, if any- one walks on foot along the street, he shall wash the feet. With¬ out washing the feet, even if he performs Acamana, he shall be unclean. After washing the feet and setting the waterpot down,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After tying a cloth round the neck or the head, if any- one walks on foot along the street, he shall wash the feet. With¬ out washing the feet, even if he performs Acamana, he shall be unclean. After washing the feet and setting the waterpot down,…

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तीर्थं भूतले पुण्यं मत्प्रसादाद् भविष्यति । वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो ह्यशेषज्ञानकोविदः । एकस्त्वमसि निःसङ्गो मत्प्रसादेन नारद
verses.transliteration: tvattīrthaṃ bhūtale puṇyaṃ matprasādād bhaviṣyati / vedavedāṅgatattvajño hyaśeṣajñānakovidaḥ / ekastvamasi niḥsaṅgo matprasādena nārada
verses.translation: Sprinkling is recommended on flowers etc., grass and Havis. Objects brought by others should be placed down and sprinkled with water. In a Sraddha and rites for Devas only, those articles that are sprinkled with water should be used. Whatever is brought to the altar should be brought at the northern end and taken away from the southern end.
verses.hindi: कराल, शझ्भूर, विरूप, एकरूप, शिव और वरद हैं, आपको नमस्कार है ।६७-७०। आप त्रिपुरारि, वन्दनीय, माताओं के पत्ति, बुद्ध, शुद्ध, मुक्त और आपके अतिरिक्त कोई दूसरा नहीं हे, आपको नमस्कार है । आप कमल धारण करने बाले, नग्न, शिखण्डी, तीनों लोकों के विधाता, चन्द्रमा और बरुण हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप अग्र उग्र, विप्र, अनेक चक्ष, सत्त्व, रज, तम और अव्यक्त योनि हैं, आपको नमस्कार + तास्त्ययं बलोको घ॒पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sprinkling is recommended on flowers etc., grass and Havis. Objects brought by others should be placed down and sprinkled with water. In a Sraddha and rites for Devas only, those articles that are sprinkled with water should be used.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sprinkling is recommended on flowers etc., grass and Havis. Objects brought by others should be placed down and sprinkled with water. In a Sraddha and rites for Devas only, those articles that are sprinkled with water should be used.…

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवो नारदस्तत्र शूलिनम् । स्थापयामास राजेन्द्र सर्वसत्त्वोपकारकम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvāntardadhe devo nāradastatra śūlinam / sthāpayāmāsa rājendra sarvasattvopakārakam
verses.translation: If the procedure is altered in the rites pertaining to Devas or Pitrs, it (the rite) becomes fruitless. With the right hand, one should touch the southern altar*. when one spits; after taking food; when feet are not washed; after conversing with a person excommunicated (by others); after working in unclean places (?); in all doubtful acts such as when the tuft of hair is untied and/or one is with¬ out the sacred thread; when the lips touch the teeth; when one
verses.hindi: ध्वजिने रथिने चेब यमिने ब्रह्मचारिणे । ऋग्यजुःसामवेदाय पुरुषायेश्वराय च ॥ द
verses.wordMeaning: If the procedure is altered in the rites pertaining to Devas or Pitrs, it (the rite) becomes fruitless. With the right hand, one should touch the southern altar*. when one spits; after taking food; when feet are not washed;…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the procedure is altered in the rites pertaining to Devas or Pitrs, it (the rite) becomes fruitless. With the right hand, one should touch the southern altar*. when one spits; after taking food; when feet are not washed;…

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यामुत्तमं तीर्थं निर्मितं नारदेन तु । तत्र तीर्थे नृपश्रेष्ठ यो गच्छेद्विजितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ nāradena tu / tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha yo gacchedvijitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: He should perform Marjana (cleansing with water) twice and then Abhyuksana (sprinkling with water) once over the sense organs, head, hands and feet as well. Anything not considered properly, shall besprinkled with water. In tin's manner his Acamana, Vedas (Vedic Study) Yajnas, penance, charitable gifts and vow of celibacy become fruitful. If an atheist performs holy rites without performing Acamana out of delusion, all those rites shall undoubtedly be futile. All these following should be known pure—that which is pure in words, that which is cleaned, that which is undefiled and that which is not censured. The opposite of these is impure. A hungry Brahmana should never be told—"There is nothing". If anything is given to him after duly honouring him, it is called a sacrifice without erecting a sacrificial post. During Sraddhas, an indigent but non-begging, solitary and shy Brahmana should always be fed with food neither over-cooked nor watery. He who offers food to the low castes only, is a wicked soul, a Brahmana-slayer.
verses.hindi: ओीमहादेव उवाच एवं स्तुत्वा ततो देव: प्रणिपत्य बरानने ज्ञात्वा तु भक्ति मम देवदेवों गहगाजलाप्लावितकेशदेश: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He should perform Marjana (cleansing with water) twice and then Abhyuksana (sprinkling with water) once over the sense organs, head, hands and feet as well. Anything not considered properly, shall besprinkled with water. In tin's manner his Acamana, Vedas (Vedic Study) Yajnas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He should perform Marjana (cleansing with water) twice and then Abhyuksana (sprinkling with water) once over the sense organs, head, hands and feet as well. Anything not considered properly, shall besprinkled with water. In tin's manner his Acamana, Vedas (Vedic Study) Yajnas,…

verses.sanskrit: मासि भाद्रपदे पार्थ कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी । उपोष्य परया भक्त्या रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम्
verses.transliteration: māsi bhādrapade pārtha kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī / upoṣya parayā bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram
verses.translation: Even if he takes a hundred births, he does not be¬ come free from that sin. A Brahmana who feeds the nobler and less dignified Brahman as in the same row, whether urged by others or not, incurs sin immediately. Even his merit resulting from digging wells and tanks becomes destroyed. In a festival, an ascedc is the leader of all Brah- manas. 1 An excellent Brahmana who reads all the Vedas with Itihasa constituting their fifth (Veda), should be kept next
verses.hindi: एवं भगवता पूर्व ब्रह्मणा लोककतृ णा । स्तुतोऋहं विविधस्तोत्रेवेंदवेदाइगसंभवे:ः
verses.wordMeaning: Even if he takes a hundred births, he does not be¬ come free from that sin. A Brahmana who feeds the nobler and less dignified Brahman as in the same row, whether urged by others or not, incurs sin immediately.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if he takes a hundred births, he does not be¬ come free from that sin. A Brahmana who feeds the nobler and less dignified Brahman as in the same row, whether urged by others or not, incurs sin immediately.…

verses.sanskrit: छत्रं तत्र प्रदातव्यं ब्राह्मणे शुभलक्षणे । शस्त्रेण तु हता ये वै तेषां श्राद्धं प्रदापयेत् । ते यान्ति परमं लोकं पिण्डदानप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: chatraṃ tatra pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe śubhalakṣaṇe / śastreṇa tu hatā ye vai teṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ pradāpayet / te yānti paramaṃ lokaṃ piṇḍadānaprabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: Then a man of a single Veda and after him comes a per¬ son who studies the Nyaya System. For the purity of the row, I am mentioning them. Understand. I shall mention those who sanctify the row (?). Those who are mentioned before, are mentioned in their order. The Panktipavanas 1 (those who sanctify the row of diners) arc the following:—Sadangl (a person who has learnt all the six ancillary subjects of the Veda), Vinayl (the discipli¬ ned one), Yogin, Sarvatantrasvatantra (he who has mastered all systems of philosophy) and Yaydvara (a wandering mendicant saint). All these five should be known as Panktipavanas. He who has mastered completely one of the eighteen lores, he who ful¬ fills his duty duly—all of them are also so. The Trinaciketas 2 (a Brahmana who learns the three Vidyas of Naciketas), the Traividya (he who has mastered three Vidyas), the Brahmana who learns Dharmasastras, the Brahmana who has mastered the Barhaspatya scripture—all these Brahmanas are said to be those who sanctify the row.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रीतो5ह्ाहूं तस्मे ब्रह्मणे सुमहात्मने । ततो5हूं सूक्ष्मया वाचा पितामहमथान्रुवम् ८२ भगवस्भृतभव्येश लोकनाथ जगत्पते । कि कार्य ते मया ब्रह्मन्कतंव्यं बद सुब्रत परे है। आप नित्य, अनित्य, नित्यानित्य, व्यक्त, भव्यक्त व्यक्ताव्यक्त, चिन्त्य, अचिन्त्य, चिन्त्याचित्य और भक्तों की पीड़ा नाश करने वाले नर-नारायण हैं।७१-७५। आप उमा प्रिय, शर्ब, नन्दिचक्र से भूत
verses.wordMeaning: Then a man of a single Veda and after him comes a per¬ son who studies the Nyaya System. For the purity of the row, I am mentioning them. Understand. I shall mention those who sanctify the row (?). Those who are mentioned before, are mentioned in their order.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a man of a single Veda and after him comes a per¬ son who studies the Nyaya System. For the purity of the row, I am mentioning them. Understand. I shall mention those who sanctify the row (?). Those who are mentioned before, are mentioned in their order.…

verses.sanskrit: कपिला तत्र दातव्या पित्ःन् उद्दिश्य भारत । इत्युच्चार्य द्विजे देया यान्तु ते परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: kapilā tatra dātavyā pitḥn uddiśya bhārata / ityuccārya dvije deyā yāntu te paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: If a Brahmana invited in a Sraddha indulges in sexual intercourse with a woman, the Pitrs lie down in his semen virile for the period of that month (?) It was believed that persons of specially high character, merit, learning etc. purify excommunicated or degenerate members of the society by associating with them, by sitting in their row for dining or even by their beneficent look (v 91 below). The belief was probably current before the time of Dharma Sutras: vide Apartamba Dh. S.II. 7.17-22. Curiously enough, Gautama (15.28), Baudhayana Dh.S. II. 8.2, Manu III. 185-186, Yajnavalkya Smfti (I. 219) use the same words about these sanctifiers of diners ( Panktipavanas ). We get a long list of such sanctifiers in Mbh. Anuiasana 90.25-31, Mt. 7-23, KP. II.21-1-14. Bd. 3.15.28-
verses.hindi: शिखण्डी हैं। भाप ध्वजी, रथी, यमी, ब्रद्मचारी, ऋग्यजुझ, सामवेद, पुरुष और ईश्वर हैं। देव ! आप इस प्रकार के अन्याय गुणों से विभूषित हैं, आपको नमस्कार हैं ।७६-७५। द
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana invited in a Sraddha indulges in sexual intercourse with a woman, the Pitrs lie down in his semen virile for the period of that month (?) It was believed that persons of specially high character, merit, learning etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana invited in a Sraddha indulges in sexual intercourse with a woman, the Pitrs lie down in his semen virile for the period of that month (?) It was believed that persons of specially high character, merit, learning etc.…

verses.sanskrit: अस्य श्राद्धस्य भावेन ब्राह्मणस्य प्रसादतः । नर्मदातोयभावेन न्यायार्जितधनस्य च । तेषां चैव प्रभावेन प्रेता यान्तु परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: asya śrāddhasya bhāvena brāhmaṇasya prasādataḥ / narmadātoyabhāvena nyāyārjitadhanasya ca / teṣāṃ caiva prabhāvena pretā yāntu parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Our text practically repeats the same lines. Trindciketa is alternately explained as:
verses.hindi: महादेवजी बोले--“पार्बती ! ब्रह्मा ने इस प्रकार स्तुति और प्रणाम कर फिर कहा--जिनका मस्तक मंगाजल से प्लावित हो रहा है वही अति सूक्ष्म और योग द्वारा अचिन्त्य देव-देव महादेव हमारी भक्ति जानकर आविर्भृत हों, जैसे चन्द्रमा प्रत्यक्ष रहने पर भी किसी का आह्वान नहीं चाहते हैं ।३६-८०। इस प्रकार लोककर्ता ब्रह्मा द्वारा विविध प्रकार के वेद-वेदाज़ से अनुमोदित स्तोत्रों द्वारा स्तुति किये जाने पर हम प्रसस्‍न हो गये और महात्मा पितामह ब्रह्मा से सुक्ष्म वचन में कहा-- भगवन् भूतबभव्येज्ञ ! लोकनाथ ! जयत्पति ! सुब्रत ! ब्रह्मा! आपका कौन सा कार्य है, जिसे हम करे ॥५१-८३॥ इस
verses.wordMeaning: Our text practically repeats the same lines. Trindciketa is alternately explained as:
verses.commentary: Sense: Our text practically repeats the same lines. Trindciketa is alternately explained as:

verses.sanskrit: इत्युच्चार्य द्विजे देया दक्षिणा च स्वशक्तितः । हविष्यान्नं विशालाक्ष द्विजानां चैव दापयेत्
verses.transliteration: ityuccārya dvije deyā dakṣiṇā ca svaśaktitaḥ / haviṣyānnaṃ viśālākṣa dvijānāṃ caiva dāpayet
verses.translation: If the performer of a Sraddha or he who takes food in a 3raddha, indulges in sexual intercourse, undoubtedly the Pitrs are stationed in his semen virile that month. Hence a Dana (religious gift) is to be made to the guest and a Brahmacarin (celibate person) is to be fed. The Dana is to be made to one engrossed in meditation and having sympathetic feelings. In the Sraddha rite, a righteous ascetic or a Valakhilya (a mendicant who docs not hoard anything) should be fed. A Vanaprastha (forest-dweller) and an Upakur- vdiia (Brahmacarin who completes his studies and pays his teacher and is about to be a householder) is propitiated by mere worship.
verses.hindi: ४२४ रा वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: If the performer of a Sraddha or he who takes food in a 3raddha, indulges in sexual intercourse, undoubtedly the Pitrs are stationed in his semen virile that month. Hence a Dana (religious gift) is to be made to the guest and a Brahmacarin (celibate person) is to be fed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the performer of a Sraddha or he who takes food in a 3raddha, indulges in sexual intercourse, undoubtedly the Pitrs are stationed in his semen virile that month. Hence a Dana (religious gift) is to be made to the guest and a Brahmacarin (celibate person) is to be fed.…

verses.sanskrit: दीपं भक्त्या प्रदातव्यं नृत्यं गीतं च कारयेत् । अवाप्तं तेन वै सर्वं यः करोतीश्वरालये
verses.transliteration: dīpaṃ bhaktyā pradātavyaṃ nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca kārayet / avāptaṃ tena vai sarvaṃ yaḥ karotīśvarālaye
verses.translation: If a householder is fed, Visvedevas are worshipped. By worshipping a Vanaprastha, sages are worshipped. By worshipping Valakhilyas, Purandara (i.e. Indra) is wor¬ shipped. In worshipping ascetics, Brahma himself is wor¬ shipped. These Asramas are holy. There are five Anasramas through deceitfulness (?)
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा वाक्य ततो बहा प्रत्युवाचाम्बुजेक्षण:  भुतभव्यभवज्ञाघ भ्रुयतां कारणेश्वर पड सुरासुरमंथ्यमामे पयोभावम्वुजेक्षण । भगवन्मेघसंकाशं नीलजीसूतसंनिभस् ... ८४ प्रादुर्भूतं विष घोरं संवर्ताग्तिसमप्रभम् । कालसृत्युरिधोद्मुतं युगास्तादित्यवंसम्. अ्लीक्योत्सादसूर्याभ विस्फुरन्तं समन्‍्ततः । अग्ने समुत्यितं तस्सिस्बियं कालानलप्रभम
verses.wordMeaning: If a householder is fed, Visvedevas are worshipped. By worshipping a Vanaprastha, sages are worshipped. By worshipping Valakhilyas, Purandara (i.e. Indra) is wor¬ shipped. In worshipping ascetics, Brahma himself is wor¬ shipped. These Asramas are holy.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If a householder is fed, Visvedevas are worshipped. By worshipping a Vanaprastha, sages are worshipped. By worshipping Valakhilyas, Purandara (i.e. Indra) is wor¬ shipped. In worshipping ascetics, Brahma himself is wor¬ shipped. These Asramas are holy.…

verses.sanskrit: स याति रुद्रसांनिध्यम् इति रुद्रः स्वयं जगौ । विद्यादानेन चैकेन अक्षयां गतिम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sa yāti rudrasāṃnidhyam iti rudraḥ svayaṃ jagau / vidyādānena caikena akṣayāṃ gatim āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Four Asramas (i. e. people in the four stages of life) are to be worshipped in the rites ot Devas and Pitrs. A Sraddha Even if he stays hungry, let him stay so outside the four stages of life. The non-ascetic and the Salvationist—both of them are the defilers of the row. 1
verses.hindi: ते दृष्ट्वा तु बयं सर्वे भीताः संश्रान्तचेतसः । तल्पिबस्थ महादेव लोकानां हितकास्यया ,।

verses.sanskrit: धूर्वहास्तत्र दातव्या भूमिः सस्यवती नृप । चित्रभानुं शुभैर्मन्त्रैः प्रीणयेत् तत्र भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: dhūrvahāstatra dātavyā bhūmiḥ sasyavatī nṛpa / citrabhānuṃ śubhairmantraiḥ prīṇayet tatra bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: Those who shave off their hair in vain, those who wear matted hair, those who wear all sorts of robes, those who are devoid of mercy, those who break all codes of good con¬ duct and those who are indiscriminate in eating—are to be avoided. In the matter of Havya and Kavya, one shall avoid Karukas (a Saiva sect) and men of no disciplined conduct of life, men ostracised from the Vedic Society, musicians and actors (who imitate deities). A person who has social and other contacts with these, attains black complexion (taint). He who dines with Sudras—all these are defilers of the row (of diners).
verses.hindi: त्वामृतेबन्यों महादेव विष सोढूं न विद्यते । नास्ति कश्रित्पुमाञ्शक्तस्त्रेलोक्येषु च गीयते ॥॥ एवं तस्य बच: श्र॒त्वा ब्रह्मण: परसेष्ठिनः । बाढमित्येव तद्वाक्‍्य॑ प्रतिगह्य वरानने ॥ै८६ ततोहूं पातुमारब्धो विषमनन्‍्तकसंनिभम् । पिबतो से महाघोरं वियं सुरभयंकरम् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Those who shave off their hair in vain, those who wear matted hair, those who wear all sorts of robes, those who are devoid of mercy, those who break all codes of good con¬ duct and those who are indiscriminate in eating—are to be avoided. In the matter of Havya and Kavya,…

In the matter of Havya and Kavya,…

verses.sanskrit: आज्येन सुप्रभूतेन होमद्रव्येण भारत । ये यजन्ति सदा भक्त्या त्रिकालं नृत्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: ājyena suprabhūtena homadravyeṇa bhārata / ye yajanti sadā bhaktyā trikālaṃ nṛtyameva ca
verses.translation: Killing (of animals etc.), destruction with force, agriculture, trading activities, animal husbandry, secret service to a person other than the preceptor—these should not be followed by a Brahmana. Those who are real Brahmanas, pursue knowledge and meditation. Even if they are born as Brahmanas, those who have false conceptions are of evil conduct.
verses.hindi: त॑ दृष्ट्वोत्पलपत्राभ कण्ठे सक्तमिबोीरगम्  तक्षकं नागराजामं लेलिहानभिव स्थितम् ६ १ अथोवाच भहातेजा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । शोभसे त्वं महादेव कण्ठेयानेस सुत्रत (६२ ततस्तस्य बच: श्रुत्वा मया गिरिवरात्मजे । पश्यतां देवसंघारना देत्यानां च बरानने
verses.wordMeaning: Killing (of animals etc.), destruction with force, agriculture, trading activities, animal husbandry, secret service to a person other than the preceptor—these should not be followed by a Brahmana. Those who are real Brahmanas, pursue knowledge and meditation.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Killing (of animals etc.), destruction with force, agriculture, trading activities, animal husbandry, secret service to a person other than the preceptor—these should not be followed by a Brahmana. Those who are real Brahmanas, pursue knowledge and meditation.…

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थे नारदनामाख्ये रेवायाश्चोत्तरे तटे । चित्रभानुमुखा देवाः सर्वदेवमय ऋषिः
verses.transliteration: tīrthe nāradanāmākhye revāyāścottare taṭe / citrabhānumukhā devāḥ sarvadevamaya ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: The preachers of wrong/heretic doctrines should be avoided. So also the arrogant, the scandal-monger, and people defiled by minor sins and great sins should be avoided. Those who make use of Vedas as a means of em¬ ployment out of greed and delusion or for profit are the sellers of Vedas. They are to be avoided in the Sraddha rite. A person hired to teach the Vedas and one who is taught by such a person—both of them do not deserve invit¬ ation to a Sraddha as the sellers and buyers of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: तरह की बात सुनकर कमल तयन ब्रह्मा ने उत्तर दिया--नाथ ! चराचर के कल्याणकर्ता कारण रूप ईश्वर ! सुनिये--देव-दानव मिलकर क्षीरसागर का मनन्‍्थन कर रहे थे कि, नीले मेघ की तरह भयद्धुर विष उत्पन्न हुआ । उसकी कान्ति चारों ओर छिटक रही थी, संवर्तक अग्नि कीं तरह वह प्रज्वलित हो रहा था, जान पड़ता था कि, प्रलयकाल आ गया है और सूर्य की किरणें तीनों लोकों को जलाने के लिये उद्यत हो चुकी हैं। काल ओर मृत्यु सामने खड़ी है। इस तरह काल और अग्नि की तरह प्रभावाले विष को उपस्थित देखकर हम सभी डर से विह्वल हो गये हैं। अतः कमल-नयन महादेव ! आप संसार के कल्याण के लिये उसे पीजिये । आप श्रेष्ठ हैं, प्रभु हैं और आप ही पंक्तिपावन हैं ।६४-८८। महादेव ! आपके अतिरिक्त कोई दूसरा पुरुष तीनों लोकों में समर्थ नहीं कहा जा सकता है, जो इस बिष के वेग को सहन
verses.wordMeaning: The preachers of wrong/heretic doctrines should be avoided. So also the arrogant, the scandal-monger, and people defiled by minor sins and great sins should be avoided.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The preachers of wrong/heretic doctrines should be avoided. So also the arrogant, the scandal-monger, and people defiled by minor sins and great sins should be avoided.…

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिणा प्रीणिताः सर्वे तस्मात् प्रीत्यो हुताशनः । पूजिते हव्यवाहे तु दारिद्र्यं नैव जायते
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiṇā prīṇitāḥ sarve tasmāt prītyo hutāśanaḥ / pūjite havyavāhe tu dāridryaṃ naiva jāyate
verses.translation: Those (Brahmanas) who buy and sell for the purpose of livelihood are despicable ones. This is the profession of a Vaisya but a sin unto Brahmanas. They say that he who depends for his livelihood upon the Vedas and he who depends upon those who know Vedas for livelihood do not deserve invitation to a Sraddha. The husband of one's daughter also shall not be invited.
verses.hindi: करे ! वरानने ! परमेष्ठी ब्रह्मा के वचन को सुनकर हमने स्वीकार कर लिया ओर देधों के लिये भी भयदायक काल की तरह महाघोर विष को पी गया । उसके पान से हमारा कण्ठ लरक्षण कृष्ण वर्ण का हो गया ।८५९-६ ०। कमलपनत्र के समान और लपलपाते नागराज तक्षक की तरह उस घिष को कण्ठ में लगा देखकर लोकपितामह ब्रह्मा ने कहा--सुब्रत ! महादेव इस कष्ठ के द्वारा आप अस्यधिक शोभा पा रहे
verses.wordMeaning: Those (Brahmanas) who buy and sell for the purpose of livelihood are despicable ones. This is the profession of a Vaisya but a sin unto Brahmanas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those (Brahmanas) who buy and sell for the purpose of livelihood are despicable ones. This is the profession of a Vaisya but a sin unto Brahmanas.…

verses.sanskrit: धनेन विपुला प्रीतिर् जायते प्रतिजन्मनि । कुलीनाश्च सुवेषाश्च सर्वकालं धनेन तु
verses.transliteration: dhanena vipulā prītir jāyate pratijanmani / kulīnāśca suveṣāśca sarvakālaṃ dhanena tu
verses.translation: He who goes unto his wife in vain (i.c. an issueless person) and he who performs Yajna in vain—both of these do not deserve an (invitation to) a Sraddha. A Brahmana (who is) an atheist also shall not be invited. He who cooks food for himself only and he who does not offer anything to Dcvas and guests—both of them are fallen and they are Brahmaraksasas. They do not deserve (invitation to) a Sraddha. Those whose wives eagerly await the nights and those who run after other men's wives, as well as those who are mad after wealth and love should not be invited to a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: हैं (६१-६२। ब्रह्मा के बचन को सुनकर देव-दामवों, यक्ष-भन्धवे-भूलों और पिशाच-उरग एवं राक्षसों के समने यक्षगन्धबंसूतानां पिशाचोरगरक्षसास् । धुतं कष्ठ विष घोरं तीलकण्ठस्ततो हाहम् .. ॥€४ तत्कालक्टं विषमुग्रतेजः कण्ठे मया परबंतराजपुत्रि । निवेश्यसान सुरदेत्यसंघो दुष्ट्व्रा परं बिस्सयमाजगास .
verses.wordMeaning: He who goes unto his wife in vain (i.c. an issueless person) and he who performs Yajna in vain—both of these do not deserve an (invitation to) a Sraddha. A Brahmana (who is) an atheist also shall not be invited.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who goes unto his wife in vain (i.c. an issueless person) and he who performs Yajna in vain—both of these do not deserve an (invitation to) a Sraddha. A Brahmana (who is) an atheist also shall not be invited.…

verses.sanskrit: प्लवो नदीनां पतिरङ्गनानां राजा च सद्वृत्तरतः प्रजानाम् । धनं नराणामृतवस्तरूणां गतं गतं यौवनमानयन्ति
verses.transliteration: plavo nadīnāṃ patiraṅganānāṃ rājā ca sadvṛttarataḥ prajānām / dhanaṃ narāṇāmṛtavastarūṇāṃ gataṃ gataṃ yauvanamānayanti
verses.translation: Those who are opposed to the discipline andtbe duties of the four castes and stages of life, a thief and he who indiscri¬ minately performs Yajna for everyone—all these are defilers of the row in the rite ofSraddha. The leavings of the Sraddha food should not be given to women or a Sudra unless he is an attendant. If anyone gives out of passion or delusion, it never reaches Pitrs.
verses.hindi: अहो प्रभुत्वं तब देवदेव गडगाजलास्फालितमुक्तकेश १६७ त्वमेब विष्णुश्नतुराननस्त्वं त्वसेव सृत्युव रदस्त्वमेव । द त्वमेत्र सूर्यो रजनीकरश््य त्वसेव सुमि: सरलिल त्वसेव ॥€८ त्वमेव यज्ञों नियमस्त्वमेव त्वमेव भुतं भविता स्वमेव । क्‍
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are opposed to the discipline andtbe duties of the four castes and stages of life, a thief and he who indiscri¬ minately performs Yajna for everyone—all these are defilers of the row in the rite ofSraddha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are opposed to the discipline andtbe duties of the four castes and stages of life, a thief and he who indiscri¬ minately performs Yajna for everyone—all these are defilers of the row in the rite ofSraddha.…

verses.sanskrit: धनदत्वं धनेशेन तस्मिंस्तीर्थे ह्युपार्जितम् । यमेन च यमत्वं हि इन्द्रत्वं चैव वज्रिणा
verses.transliteration: dhanadatvaṃ dhaneśena tasmiṃstīrthe hyupārjitam / yamena ca yamatvaṃ hi indratvaṃ caiva vajriṇā
verses.translation: Hence in a Sraddha rite, the leavings of food should never be given except curds and ghee and that too to a disciple and a son; not otherwise. Only that which is not left over should be given, such as food particularly. Pitrs are propitiated with flowers, ' roots and fruits too as with food. The foodstuffs served are sanctified as long as they are warm. Pitrs partake of the food as long as the invited Brahmanas take their food, with control over their speech.
verses.hindi: त्वभ्ेव चा5५दिनिधन त्वमेव स्थुलश्च्॒ सुक्ष्स: पुरषस्त्वसेव ॥६€ त्वम्रेव सक्ष्मस्प परः परस्य त्वमेव वल्तिः पबनस्त्वसेव । त्वमेव स्वस्थ चराचरस्य लोकस्य कर्ता प्रलये च गोप्ता ११०० गता विमानरनिगह्मवेगेमंहात्मनो सेससुपेत्य सर्वे .
verses.wordMeaning: Hence in a Sraddha rite, the leavings of food should never be given except curds and ghee and that too to a disciple and a son; not otherwise. Only that which is not left over should be given, such as food particularly. Pitrs are propitiated with flowers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence in a Sraddha rite, the leavings of food should never be given except curds and ghee and that too to a disciple and a son; not otherwise. Only that which is not left over should be given, such as food particularly. Pitrs are propitiated with flowers,…

verses.translation: All these rites and particularly the rite of gifting away, Those who are steadfast in their holy rites, those who

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थवरं तीर्थं निर्मितं नारदेन तु । पृथिव्यां सागरान्तायां रेवायाश्चोत्तरे तटे । तद्वरं सर्वतीर्थानां महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthavaraṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ nāradena tu / pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ revāyāścottare taṭe / tadvaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam
verses.translation: The whole of the three worlds is pervaded or ever by the masters of Yoga. Hence they (can) observe whatever there is in the universe. The noble souls keep both the manifest and the un¬ manifest under their control. They control even that which is greater than all. Truth and falsehood have been perceived by them. Sat, Asat have been seen by them. All knowable things, absolution etc. are' seen by the noble souls. Hence one who is devoted to them attains everything auspicious. He who knows the Rks knows the Vedas. He who knows the Yajur Mantras knows Yajna. He who knows Saman Mantras knows Brahman. He who knows Manasa (? mind) knows everything.
verses.hindi: ही हमने उस घोर विध को कण्ठ में क्ररण कर लिया। सुमुद्लि ! गिरिराज पृत्रि ! तब से हम नीलकण्ठ कहलाते हैं। पव॑तराजपुन्नि ! उस कालकट के समात तेज विष को जब हमने कण्ठ में रख लिया तब देव और द्वानव यह देखकर अत्यन्त विस्मित हो गये ।६३०-६५॥ गजगामिनि ! तब सभी हैत्य-उरग-राक्षस और देवगण हाथ जोड़कर बोले--अहो, आपका बल, वीये और पराक्रम घन्य है, आपका योगबल और अ्रभृत्व धन्य है। देवदेव ! गंगाजल की तरज्ज से आपके मस्तक का केक्षपाद् खुल गया है। आप विष्ण हैं, ब्रह्मा हैं मृत्यु हैं भोर बरदाता भी हैं। आप सूर्य, चन्द्र, भूमि, जल, यज्ञ, नियम, भूत, भविष्य, भादि, अन्त, स्थूल, सूक्ष्म और पुरुष हैं। आप सूक्ष्मातिसूक्ष्म, परात्पर, वक्ति, पवन, चराचरात्सक जगत के कर्ता क्षोर प्रलग्र काल में सब के रक्षक हैं ।६६-१००। वेबों ने इस श्रकार स्तुति की और सिर झुका कर महादेव
verses.wordMeaning: The whole of the three worlds is pervaded or ever by the masters of Yoga. Hence they (can) observe whatever there is in the universe. The noble souls keep both the manifest and the un¬ manifest under their control. They control even that which is greater than all.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole of the three worlds is pervaded or ever by the masters of Yoga. Hence they (can) observe whatever there is in the universe. The noble souls keep both the manifest and the un¬ manifest under their control. They control even that which is greater than all.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नारदेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ७९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थद्वयमनुत्तमम् । दधिस्कन्दं मधुस्कन्दं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nāradeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 79 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthadvayamanuttamam / dadhiskandaṃ madhuskandaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall recount the various types of religious gifts and the benefits thereof. 1 A religious gift enables all living beings to cross (the ocean of worldly existence). It is the pleas¬ ing pathway unto heaven. Though ancient works on Dharma Sastra insist upon avoidance of lavishness in Sraddha, later Puraijas encourage profuse expenditure on Sraddha, e.g. Pd. P. Srsti-Khada 9.179-181, Varaha 50-51, VP. III. 14.22-23. Pitrs are reported to have two Gathas expressing their desire to have a descendant who would bestow on Brahmanas (for the benefit of Pitrs) jewels, clothes, land, costly vehicles. This text encourages That which is the most excellent in the world, that which is conducive to the attainment of heaven, nay, everything that is pleasing to oneself, must be offered to Pitrs by one who seeks one's own eternal salvation. A person who offers cooked rice, derives the benefit of attaining a divine golden chariot dazzling like the sun and filled with divine Apsaras-s. Pie who gifts a cloth fresh from the loom at the time of the Sraddha rite attains longevity, ample wealth, beauty and a son. The knower of Dhannas who gives a sacred thread at the time of Sraddha and offers water to all Brahmanas attains the fruit of Brahmadana (the gift of Vedic learning).
verses.hindi: को प्रणाम किया । फिर वे सब महात्मा अपने-अपने वेगमासी विमानों पर चढ़कर मेरुप्रस्थ की ओर चले गये ।१०१। यह लोक विश्वत, विद्यात नीलक्रण्ठोपार्यान परम गुह्य और पवित्रतम है

verses.sanskrit: दधिस्कन्दे नरः स्नात्वा यस्तु दद्याद् द्विजे दधि । उपतिष्ठेत्ततस्तस्य सप्तजन्मनि भारत
verses.transliteration: dadhiskande naraḥ snātvā yastu dadyād dvije dadhi / upatiṣṭhettatastasya saptajanmani bhārata
verses.translation: If anyone offers a good waterpot at the time of Sraddhas to the Brahmanas, a cow exuding honey and milk approaches the donor. He who gives a circular waterpot at the time of Sraddha obtains a milk-yielding divine cow that can be milked for whatever he wishes. If anyone gives a complete bed-equipment decorated with garlands of flowers, it becomes a palace and follows him as he goes (to heaven). By giving a house full of gems, furnished with bed, seats and food, at the time of Sraddha to ascetics, one rejoices in heaven. He obtains pearls, lapis lazuli, garments, varieties of precious stones, divine vehicles, hundred thousands and trillions in number and a divine aerial chariot that dazzles like a great blazing fire, that;has the lustre of the moon and the sun and that is furnished with jewels according to one's desire. The aerial chariot has the speed of the mind and can go anywhere as per his pleasure. It is surrounded by Apsaras-s. He remains at the head of the aerial chariot eulogised by eveyone allround. The Gandharva-s and Apsaras-s sprinkle him with divine scents and showers of flowers. They sing and play on the instruments. by the gilts ol a thousand horses, a hundred chariots and a thousand elephants, a man lives with a Yogint,

verses.transliteration: na vyādhirna jarā tasya na śoko naiva matsaraḥ / daśacandraśataṃ yāvajjāyate vimale kule
verses.translation: He who offers water (and) lamp to Pitrs and Yogins, attains the fruit of the gift of thousands of gold coins. No other gift is more excellent than the gift of life. Hence, by all means protection to life should be given. At the time of Sraddha, one should give golden vessels having good characteristics. Sweet (divine) juices and bevera¬ ges, good foodstuffs and good fortune approach him. In the Sraddha rite, one should give a silver or gold vessel. By giving it, the donor gets ample virtue (as reward). He who makes a gift of a cow that has calved but once, along with a milking pot, at the time of a Sraddha, obtains several cows and the nourishment of the cows. He who gives the above-mentioned articles at a Sraddha, attains the benefit of a horse-sacrifice. In ordinary Sraddhas or at the time of Darsa Sraddha, one should give to the Brahmanas of good qualities, vessels full of ghee with.very great respect. He shall attain good memory and fine intellect.

verses.sanskrit: मधुस्कन्दे ऽपि मधुना मिश्रितान्यस्तिलान्ददेत् । नासौ वैवस्वतं देवं पश्येद् वै जन्मसप्ततिम्
verses.transliteration: madhuskande 'pi madhunā miśritānyastilāndadet / nāsau vaivasvataṃ devaṃ paśyed vai janmasaptatim
verses.translation: He obtains the benefit of many cows yielding potfuls By giving the thing wished for, at the time of Sraddha, one gets the benefit of the sacrifice called Pundarlka. By giving a beautiful residential place, one attains the fruit of Rajasuya sacrifice. By giving a forest full of flowers and fruits, one obtains sweet smelling substances. By giving wells, parks, tanks, fields, cowsheds and houses, one rejoices in heaven as long as the moon and the stars stay. By giving beds and bedsheets embellished with jewels, one attains endless heavenly pleasure. Pitps are pleased with him. He is worshipped (honoured) by kings. He flourishes with wealth and grain. Woollen and silk garments, excellent blankets, deer-skin, gold brocade, coloured cloth and wool—these should be given to Brahmanas after duly feeding them. A person who has faith then gets the benefit of a hundred Vajapeya Yajiias. 1 Many beautiful women, sons, servants and attendants, nay all living beings, become submissive to him in this world. He becomes free from all ailments. He who gives silk, woven silk, cotton and velvet cloth, in Sraddhas obtains the fulfilment of all his cherished desires.
verses.hindi: मम भक्ता वरारोहे ये च शण्वन्ति मानवाः । तेषां गति प्रवक्ष्यासि इह लोके परत्र च ११० ब्राह्मणों वेदमाप्नोति क्षत्रियों जयते महीम् । वेश्यस्तु लभते लाभं शूद्र: सुखभवाप्नुयात्ु नष्टं वे लभते सर्वंरभिह लोके परत्र ज॑

verses.translation: He dispels all inglorious things and misfortunes im¬ mediately like the darkness at the time of sunrise. He shines on an aerial chariot like the moon among stars. A garment is praised by all Devas; garment belongs to all the deities. In the absence af cloth, no holy rite—neither Yajiias nor (study of) Vedas nor penances, can be performed. Hence clothes should be given at the time of Sraddha particularly. He obtains all those things—Yajiias, the Vedas and the penances. verses.transliteration: dadhibhiḥ saha saṃmiśraṃ piṇḍaṃ yastu pradāpayet / tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhivaddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
verses.translation: Fried grain-powder, fried rice, pies, cooked horse-gram dishes all mixed with curds-He who gives all these in Sraddha obtains the treasure of Kubera. The man who offers the most excellent foods and edibles, beverages, lambatives and juicy things, becomes the most excel¬ lent of all. The devotee, with palms joined in reverence, should offer the best seat to the guests while feeding. He shall then attain the excellent fruit of all the rites and Yajnas. A dish consisting of sesamum and grain (mixture of rice peas with a few spices)— MW, The person who ofTers food attains an aerial chariot resembling the mid-day sun and fitted with swans for three crores ofKalpas (crores of maidens in Bd. P.). There is nothing here greater than the gift of food and they are sustained by it without any doubt.
verses.hindi: में और स्त्रियों के बीच सम्मान देती है, विवाद में जय प्राप्त कराती है, युद्ध में बीरता आती है, मार्ग सुख- कर होता है और घर घास्य-धन्य से परिपूर्ण हो जाता है। वरानने ! जो व्यक्ति नौलकण्ठ, हरितष्म श्रु, शहांकांकितमूधज, व्यक्ष, त्रिशुलपाणि, वृषयान और पिनाकधक नाम को शरीर में धारण करता है, वह नन्दि के तुल्य बलवान और पराक्रमी होकर श्री सम्पन्न हो जाता है ।१०५-१०८। वह हमारी आज्ञा से सम्पूर्ण लोकों में विचरण करता है। उसकी गति को कोई नही रोक सकता है, जैसे आकाश में वायु का वेग कहीं नहीं रुकता । वह मेरे तुल्य बलवान होकर प्रलय काल तक रहता है ।१०९। वरारोहे ! जो मनुष्य हममें भक्ति रखकर हमारी कथ। का श्रवण करता है, इस लोक और उस लोक में वह कंसा सामथ्य वान् हो जाता है उसको सुनो । ब्राह्मण वेदाध्यायी होता है, क्षत्रिय जय लाभ करता है, वैद्य धन लाभ प्राप्त

verses.sanskrit: पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः । द्वादशाब्दानि तुष्यन्ति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ / dvādaśābdāni tuṣyanti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: There is no gift nobler than the gift of life. The set of the three worlds lives by means of food. That is the fruit of offering cooked rice. All the worlds are founded (dependent) on food. It is the fruit of the gift of the worlds. Food is Prajapati himself. All these worlds are pervaded by it. Hence a gift on par with that of food has never been before nor will there be any ever in future. A man devoted to Pitrs immediately attains all the jewels, vehicles and women on the earth. One should with palms joined in reverence, always offer- shelter to the guests. They are the Devas awaiting in thousands, for the divine hospitality. He who makes all gifts (mentioned before) shall be the sole emperor on the earth. He shall become happy even if he makes three, two or even one of those gifts. Making gifts is the greatest virtue (Dharma). It is honourd and revered by good men. The Lordship of the three worlds is to be attained only through Dana. A king regains his kingdom; a poor man gets excell¬ ent wealth; a man about to die, attains longevity. Whatever a man devoted to Pitrs desires in his mind, will be granted by his Pitrs.
verses.hindi: करता है ओर शूद्र सूख पाता है। रोगी रोग-मुक्त और वन्दी बन्धन-मुक्त हो जाता है। ग़रभिणी पूत्र-प्रसव करती है और कन्या सुभ्दर पति पाती है। इस लोक और परलोक में नष्ट द्रव्य प्राप्त होता है

verses.translation: There are three sets of Asfakas* (the 7th, 8th and 9th days of the dark half of a month) that bring about marriage, birth of a son and acquisition of wealth. The dark half of a month is the most excellent. The first Asfaka is called Citri. The second Asfaka, shall be Prajapatya (with Prajapati as its deity) and the third one (is) Vaisvadevikl. The first Asfaka shall always be performed with flour cakes. The second should always be performed with meat. The third Asfaka shall be per¬ formed with greens and vegetables. This is the injunction regar¬ ding the articles (for Sraddha ). The Anoasfaka (the ninth day in the dark half of Pausa, Magha and Phalguna) of the Pitrs is also laid down permanently. If there happens to be a fourth As / (ihd 9 a learned person should perform a special Sraddha therein, even by spending his entire possession.

verses.translation: The word c Asfaka* is formed from 'asfan*. But according to Vartika 9 on Panini VII. 3.45, it means f a rite with Pitre as deities'. Afualayana Gr. S. II. 4-1 informs that the 8th day in the dark halves of seasons Hemanta and Sisira are Asfakas. As a season consists of two months there are (and should be) four Atfakas. But most other Grhya Sutras differ and regard the 8th day in the dark halves of Margasirsa, Pausa and Magha as Asfaka days. This Purana does not follow As'valayana. Though the above- mentioned Vartika regards Pitrs as the deities on these days, our Puraria regards the first Asfaka as Citri (Aindrl? as in Bd.P.), the second has Prajapati and the third has Visvedevas as the deities and Pitrs are cons¬ picuous by their non mention. He (the performer of a Sraddha ) shall always be happy both here and hereafter. The worshippers shall attain progress and the non-believers, downfall. Like cows approaching a water-trough, all these Pitps and gods approach the man (who performs a Sraddha)—Pitrs during the Parvan days and deities on different Tithis.
verses.hindi: क़ान्तं मया पापहरं महापद॑ निवेद्य तेम्यः प्रददो प्रभ्जनः ।

verses.commentary: Sense: The word c Asfaka* is formed from 'asfan*. But according to Vartika 9 on Panini VII. 3.45, it means f a rite with Pitre as deities'. Afualayana Gr. S. II. 4-1 informs that the 8th day in the dark halves of seasons Hemanta and Sisira are Asfakas.…

verses.sanskrit: दधिस्कन्दं मधुस्कन्दं यावत्त्यक्त्वा तु गच्छति । तावत्तुष्टो महादेवो नन्दिनाथमुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: dadhiskandaṃ madhuskandaṃ yāvattyaktvā tu gacchati / tāvattuṣṭo mahādevo nandināthamuvāca ha
verses.translation: Let them not return without being worshipped during Asfakas. The world (worldly life) will be in vain in regard to him (who does not worship). Even what is obtained by him, perishes. Those who offer worship attain Devas. Those who do not offer are reborn as lower animals. A person who performs a Sraddha on the Full Moon day obtains progeny, nourishment, memory, intellect, sons and prosperity. 1 2 3 4 5 6 He enjoys to the full. (The Sraddha performed on) Pralipad (the first day of a fort¬ night) is conducive to the acquisition of wealth. What he has acquired does not perish. He who performs a Sraddha on the second day of the lunar fortnight, becomes the lord of bipeds. The third day (is to be selected for Sraddha) by one who seeks excellent things, (for) Trtiya (third day) is destructive of sins.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्त नीलकण्ठस्तवों नाम चतुष्पठ्चाशोश्ष्याय: विधान पूर्वक एक लाख गौओं के दान करने से जो पृण्य होता है, वह महादेव की इस दिव्य कथा को सुनने से प्राप्त होता है। सम्पूर्ण, आधा या एक चरण ही जो इस कथा का नित्य पाठ करता है, वह शिवलोक़ को जाता है ।!१३-११४। पार्वती ! हमने चतुरामन ब्रह्मा के प्रति प्रसन्न होकर पुण्य फल देने वाली इस कथा को कहा था। वही आज तुम्हारे आगे भी कही गई है। इसके बाद कार्तिकेय को प्यार
verses.wordMeaning: Let them not return without being worshipped during Asfakas. The world (worldly life) will be in vain in regard to him (who does not worship). Even what is obtained by him, perishes. Those who offer worship attain Devas. Those who do not offer are reborn as lower animals.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Let them not return without being worshipped during Asfakas. The world (worldly life) will be in vain in regard to him (who does not worship). Even what is obtained by him, perishes. Those who offer worship attain Devas. Those who do not offer are reborn as lower animals.…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: भोभोः प्रसन्नो नन्दीश वरं वृणु यथेप्सितम् । तपसा तेन तुष्टो ऽहं तीर्थयात्राकृतेन ते
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: bhobhoḥ prasanno nandīśa varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam / tapasā tena tuṣṭo 'haṃ tīrthayātrākṛtena te
verses.translation: Verses JO-19 state the benefit accruing from performance of Sraddha on different Tithis from the 1st to the 15th. Apastamba Dh. S. II. 7.16-22, Mbh. Anuttsana 87, Bd. 3.9-20, BM. 15-21, KP.II. 20.17.22 state the reward a man gets for performance of Sraddha on these Tithis. But there is difference of opinion among these about the benefits. For example, see the comparative table of rewards of Sraddha performance on various Tithis. Acquisition of wealth Lordship over bipeds
verses.hindi: करने वाले चन्द्रशखर महादेव इस पुण्य फल देने वाली कथा को पावंती से कहकर और उनके साथ नन्दी पर सवार होकर किष्किन्धक गुहा की ओर चले गये । ब्राह्मणों ! वायुदेव पाप नाश करने वाली, महापद देने वाली, सुलक्षण इस कथा को मुनियों से कहकर आदित्य पथ की और चले गये ओर हमने भी इस कथा को
verses.wordMeaning: Verses JO-19 state the benefit accruing from performance of Sraddha on different Tithis from the 1st to the 15th. Apastamba Dh. S. II. 7.16-22, Mbh. Anuttsana 87, Bd. 3.9-20, BM. 15-21, KP.II. 20.17.22 state the reward a man gets for performance of Sraddha on these Tithis.…
