Anuttsana 87, Bd. 3.9-20, BM. 15-21, KP.II. 20.17.22 state the reward a man gets for performance of Sraddha on these Tithis.…

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वर उवाच: न चाहं कामये वित्तं न चाहं कुलसन्ततिम् । मुक्त्वा न कामये कामं तव पादाम्बुजात्परम्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvara uvāca: na cāhaṃ kāmaye vittaṃ na cāhaṃ kulasantatim / muktvā na kāmaye kāmaṃ tava pādāmbujātparam
verses.translation: Destroys sins Discovers weak points of his enemies Attains prosperity and glory
verses.hindi: तदनुरूप ही आप लोगों से कह दिया श्रीवा युमहापुराण का नीलकण्ठं-स्तुतिं नामक चौंवनवाँ अध्याय सेंमाप्ते
verses.wordMeaning: Destroys sins Discovers weak points of his enemies Attains prosperity and glory
verses.commentary: Sense: Destroys sins Discovers weak points of his enemies Attains prosperity and glory

verses.sanskrit: कृमिकीटपतङ्गेषु तिर्यग्योनिं गतस्य वा । जन्म जन्मान्तरे ऽप्यस्तु भक्तिस्त्वयि ममाचला
verses.transliteration: kṛmikīṭapataṅgeṣu tiryagyoniṃ gatasya vā / janma janmāntare 'pyastu bhaktistvayi mamācalā
verses.translation: Reverence from Brahmanas He who performs a Sraddha on Caturthi (fourth day) finds the weak points of his enemies. A performer of a Sraddha on the fifth day attains great prosperity and glory.
verses.hindi: +धनुश्चिह्नास्तगतग्रन्थः क. पुस्तके नास्तिं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Reverence from Brahmanas He who performs a Sraddha on Caturthi (fourth day) finds the weak points of his enemies. A performer of a Sraddha on the fifth day attains great prosperity and glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Reverence from Brahmanas He who performs a Sraddha on Caturthi (fourth day) finds the weak points of his enemies. A performer of a Sraddha on the fifth day attains great prosperity and glory.

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्युक्त्वा महादेवः परया कृपया नृप । गृहीत्वा तं करे सिद्धं जगाम निलयं हरः
verses.transliteration: tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ parayā kṛpayā nṛpa / gṛhītvā taṃ kare siddhaṃ jagāma nilayaṃ haraḥ
verses.translation: Brahmanas revere him who performs a Sraddha on the sixth day. The man who performs a Sraddha on the seventh day regularly attains the fruit of Mahdsalra (great Soma sacri¬ fice). He becomes the lord of Ganas (followers of Siva). The man who performs a Sraddha on the eighth day attains complete prosperity. He who performs a Sraddha on the ninth day, attains prosperity and a beloved wife. He who performs a Sraddha on the tenth day, attains the glory of Brahman-hood. He shall attain (mastery over) all the Vedas and the destruction of sins. The Dana (religious gift) offered on the ele¬ venth day yields prosperity for ever.
verses.hindi: गुणकमंप्रभावश्व कोईघिको बदतां वरः। श्रोतुमिच्छामहे सम्यगंश्व्यंगुणविस्तरम् । अन्राप्युदाहरन्तीमसितिहासं पुरातनम् । महादेवस्य माहात्म्यं विभुत्वं च महात्मनः २ पूर्व त्रलोक्यविजये विष्णुता समुदाहुतम् । बलि बद्ध्वा महौजास्तु तलोक्याधिपंतिः पुरा ३३ प्रनष्टेषु च दत्येषु प्रहष्टे च शच्चीपतो । अथा55जम्मुः प्रभु द्रष्ट सर्वे देवाः सवासवा:ः
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmanas revere him who performs a Sraddha on the sixth day. The man who performs a Sraddha on the seventh day regularly attains the fruit of Mahdsalra (great Soma sacri¬ fice). He becomes the lord of Ganas (followers of Siva).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmanas revere him who performs a Sraddha on the sixth day. The man who performs a Sraddha on the seventh day regularly attains the fruit of Mahdsalra (great Soma sacri¬ fice). He becomes the lord of Ganas (followers of Siva).…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा भक्त्या त्र्यक्षं प्रपूजयेत् । अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktyā tryakṣaṃ prapūjayet / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: They say that he who performs a Sraddha on the twelfth day acquires wealth, a kingdom and becomes victorious. He who performs a Sraddha on the thirteenth day attains progeny, intellect, cattle, wisdom, freedom, excellent nourishment, long life and prosperity. One shall offer a Sraddha on the fourteenth day to those young men of the house who have met premature death and to those who have been killed by weapons.
verses.hindi: नागा देव्षयश्चेत्र नद्यः सर्वे च पर्वंता: । अभिगम्य महात्मानं स्तुवन्ति पुरुष हरिस्
verses.wordMeaning: They say that he who performs a Sraddha on the twelfth day acquires wealth, a kingdom and becomes victorious. He who performs a Sraddha on the thirteenth day attains progeny, intellect, cattle, wisdom, freedom, excellent nourishment, long life and prosperity.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that he who performs a Sraddha on the twelfth day acquires wealth, a kingdom and becomes victorious. He who performs a Sraddha on the thirteenth day attains progeny, intellect, cattle, wisdom, freedom, excellent nourishment, long life and prosperity.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा प्राणत्यागं करोति चेत् । शिवस्यानुचरो भूत्वा मोदते कल्पमक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti cet / śivasyānucaro bhūtvā modate kalpamakṣayam
verses.translation: With purity one should always offer a Sraddha on the New Moon day to those children unfavourably born (e.g. a son after three daughters or a daughter after three sons) as well as to twin children. One who regularly performs a Sraddha attains all cheris¬ hed desires and infinite heavenly pleasures. One shall always perform on the New Moon day the rituals and those great rites that involve extraction of Soma Juice (or that are conducive to the development of the Moon (?) ) Thus developed, the Moon sustains the three worlds, being regularly eulogised by Siddhas, Caranas and Gand- harvas.
verses.hindi: ऋषणिगरा बोक्षे--बोलने वालों में श्रेष्ठ ! गुण, कर्म और प्रभाव में कौन श्रेष्ठ हैं एवं किनका ऐद्वर्य सबसे अधिक है ? इस बात को हम लोग अच्छी तरह से सूनना चाहते हैं सूतजी बोले---इस विषय में भी हम एक प्राचीन इतिहास बतलाते हैं। देव-देव महादेव का क्या महात्म्य है और उनका क्या प्रभत्व है इस सम्बन्ध में विष्णु ने भी त्रलोक्य-विजय-काल में पहले इस प्रकार कहा है। त्रलोक्याधिपति महाबली विष्णु ने जब बलि को बाँध दिया, तब इन्द्र अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हो गए; क्योंकि राक्षक सब मारे जा चके थे। उस समय भगवान् को देखने के लिये इन्द्र प्रभृत्ति देवगण क्षीर
verses.wordMeaning: With purity one should always offer a Sraddha on the New Moon day to those children unfavourably born (e.g. a son after three daughters or a daughter after three sons) as well as to twin children.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With purity one should always offer a Sraddha on the New Moon day to those children unfavourably born (e.g. a son after three daughters or a daughter after three sons) as well as to twin children.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालेन महता जायते विमले कुले । वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālena mahatā jāyate vimale kule / vedavedāṅgatattvajño jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam
verses.translation: (The Moon) is eulogised by thousands of Apsaras-s danc¬ ing, singing and playing on instruments, by means of eulogies, flowers of great beauty and all the requisites for the fulfilment of desires. Devas and Gandharvas and the groups of Siddhas eulogise that devotee of thePi/w, steady in his holy rites. They serve him by means of aerial, chariots for sport.
verses.hindi: सागर के समीप मये ।२-४। वहाँ जाकर विश्वरूपात्मा आदि पुरुष हरि की वे सब स्तुति करने लगे। वहाँ सिद्ध, ब्रह्मषि, यक्ष, गन्धवं, अप्सरा, नाग; देवषि, तदी और पर्वत आदि सभी स्तवन काल में उपस्थित थे । विष्ण! आप घाता हैं, कर्ता हैं, लोकों के स्रष्टा हैं और आपके ही प्रसाद से तीनों लोकों को अविनाशी
verses.wordMeaning: (The Moon) is eulogised by thousands of Apsaras-s danc¬ ing, singing and playing on instruments, by means of eulogies, flowers of great beauty and all the requisites for the fulfilment of desires. Devas and Gandharvas and the groups of Siddhas eulogise that devotee of thePi/w,…
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Moon) is eulogised by thousands of Apsaras-s danc¬ ing, singing and playing on instruments, by means of eulogies, flowers of great beauty and all the requisites for the fulfilment of desires. Devas and Gandharvas and the groups of Siddhas eulogise that devotee of thePi/w,…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं तात तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । दुर्लभं मर्त्यसंज्ञस्य सर्वपापक्षयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ tāta tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam / durlabhaṃ martyasaṃjñasya sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: The devotee of Pitrs shall attain all cherished desires on the' Amavasya (New Moon) day, for Pitrs are worshipped by him directly always. The constellation Magha has Pitrs for its deities Hence a Sraddha on that day yields everlasting benefit. The wise per¬ form the rites for Pitfs particularly on that day. Hence the Pitrs always desire Magha. Those who are devoted to Pitrs and deities attain the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: त्वं धाता त्वं च कर्ताउस्‍्थ त्व॑ लोफान्सजसि प्रभो । त्वत्प्रासादाच्च कल्याण प्राप्त त्रेलोक्यमव्ययम् ॥। एबमुक्तः सुरंविष्णु: सिद्धेश्न परम्िभिः । प्रत्युवाच ततो देवान्सवं स्तान्पुरुषोत्तमः ८ श्रूयतामभिधास्यासि कारण सुरसत्तमा:  यः खष्टा स्व॑भूतानां कालः कालकरः प्रभुः ३६ येनाहं ब्रह्मणा सार्ध सुष्ठा लोकाश्न सायया । तस्पेब च प्रसादेन आदो सिद्धत्वसागतम् १० पुरा तमसि चाब्यक्ते त्लोक्ये प्रासिते मया। उदरस्थेषु भूतेषु लोके5हूं शयितस्तदा
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee of Pitrs shall attain all cherished desires on the' Amavasya (New Moon) day, for Pitrs are worshipped by him directly always. The constellation Magha has Pitrs for its deities Hence a Sraddha on that day yields everlasting benefit.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee of Pitrs shall attain all cherished desires on the' Amavasya (New Moon) day, for Pitrs are worshipped by him directly always. The constellation Magha has Pitrs for its deities Hence a Sraddha on that day yields everlasting benefit.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नन्दिकेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ८१ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज वरुणेश्वरमुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धो महादेवो वरुणो नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nandikeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 81 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja varuṇeśvaramuttamam / yatra siddho mahādevo varuṇo nṛpasattama
verses.translation: Listen to a detailed account of all those Sraddhas which Yama mentioned to Sasabindu. They are to be performed under different constellations severally. 2 He who maintains the sacrificial fires for ever and per¬ forms a Sraddha (when the Moon is) in conjuction with the Krttika constellation, becomes free from worries and ailments along with his children.
verses.hindi: एतस्मिश्नन्तरे द्रात्पश्यामि ह्ामितप्रभम् । शतसुर्यप्रतीकाशं ज्वलन्तं स्बेन तेजसा .
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to a detailed account of all those Sraddhas which Yama mentioned to Sasabindu. They are to be performed under different constellations severally.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to a detailed account of all those Sraddhas which Yama mentioned to Sasabindu. They are to be performed under different constellations severally.…

verses.sanskrit: पिण्याकशाकपर्णैश्च कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादिभिः । आराध्य गिरिजानाथं ततः सिद्धिं परां गतः
verses.transliteration: piṇyākaśākaparṇaiśca kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ / ārādhya girijānāthaṃ tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: A person desirous of children should perform a Sraddha under Rohini.By performing a Sraddhaundcr theSaumya (Mrga- This chapter is incorporated from Mbh. AnuSasana 89.
verses.hindi: चतुर्वक्त्र महायोग॑ पुरुष काचअनभम् । कृष्णाजिमधर देव॑ कमण्डलविभूषितम् ॥। ततो मामश्नवीद्ब्रह्मा स्वतलोकनमस्कृतः । कस्त्वं कुतो वा किचेह तिष्ठसे बद मे विभो
verses.wordMeaning: A person desirous of children should perform a Sraddha under Rohini.By performing a Sraddhaundcr theSaumya (Mrga- This chapter is incorporated from Mbh. AnuSasana 89.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person desirous of children should perform a Sraddha under Rohini.By performing a Sraddhaundcr theSaumya (Mrga- This chapter is incorporated from Mbh. AnuSasana 89.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः । पूजयेच्छङ्करं भक्त्या स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ / pūjayecchaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Vi§nu Dh.S. (78.8-15) mentions the rewards obtained by performing iriddha under different constellations from Krttika to Bhararu. Yajnavalkya I. 265-268, MK. 8-16, BM. 33-42, KP.II. 20.9-15, Bd.P..2.3.18 deal with the same topic though there is some disagreement about the benefits promised. One performing a Sraddha under the Punarvasu conste¬ llation becomes the possessor of fields and begets sons. He will be blessed with wealth and food-grains as well as sons and grand¬ sons. A man who desires satisfaction and contentment should perform Sraddha under Pusya constellation. One shall attain heroic sons by worshipping Pitfs under Aglesa.
verses.hindi: अहूं कर्ताइस्सि लोकानां स्वयंप्रूविश्वतोमुखः । एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन ब्रह्मणा5हमुवाच तम्
verses.wordMeaning: Vi§nu Dh.S. (78.8-15) mentions the rewards obtained by performing iriddha under different constellations from Krttika to Bhararu. Yajnavalkya I. 265-268, MK. 8-16, BM. 33-42, KP.II. 20.9-15,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vi§nu Dh.S. (78.8-15) mentions the rewards obtained by performing iriddha under different constellations from Krttika to Bhararu. Yajnavalkya I. 265-268, MK. 8-16, BM. 33-42, KP.II. 20.9-15,…

verses.sanskrit: कुण्डिकां वर्धनीं वापि महद्वा जलभाजनम् । अन्नेन सहितं पार्थ तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: kuṇḍikāṃ vardhanīṃ vāpi mahadvā jalabhājanam / annena sahitaṃ pārtha tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: He who performs a Sraddha under Magha becomes the most excellent among his kinsmen. A man worshipping Pitrs in the (Purva) Phalgunl constellation attains good fortune. He who performs a Srdddha under Uttaraphalguni
verses.hindi: कल्याण प्राप्त होता है। आपने बलि को बाँध कर सब असुरों को जीत लिया है ।५-७। इस प्रकार जब देवों ओर छिद्धों के द्वारा विष्णु को स्तुति की गई तब वे पुरुषोत्तम सब देबों से बोले देवों ! हम इसका कारण बताते हैं, आप सब सुनें । जो सब जीवों के न्ष्टा हैं, काल हैं, काल के भी खष्टा प्रभु हैं और जिन्होंने माया का विस्तार कर ब्रह्मा के साथ सब लोगों की सृष्टि की है, उन्हीं के प्रसाद से हमने समर में जय लाभ किया है ।८-१०। प्र काल में जब तीनों लोक अन्धकार से व्याप्त था और जीवगण हमारे उदर में निवास कर रहे थे, उस समय हम भी हजार सिर, हजार नयन और हजार चरण धारण कर एबं शद्भ, चक्र, गदा से सुझोभित होकर विमल जल में शयन कर रहे थे। उसी समय हमने एक योगी पुरुष को दूर से देखा । वे अत्यन्त प्रभा से युक्त, सौ सूर्य की तरह दीप्तिमानू, अपनी प्रभा से प्रकाशवान् चढुरान्ा,
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Sraddha under Magha becomes the most excellent among his kinsmen. A man worshipping Pitrs in the (Purva) Phalgunl constellation attains good fortune. He who performs a Srdddha under Uttaraphalguni
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Sraddha under Magha becomes the most excellent among his kinsmen. A man worshipping Pitrs in the (Purva) Phalgunl constellation attains good fortune. He who performs a Srdddha under Uttaraphalguni

verses.sanskrit: यत्फलं लभते मर्त्यः सत्रे द्वादशवार्षिके । तत्फलं समवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: yatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ satre dvādaśavārṣike / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: He who performs a Sraddha in the Citra constel¬ lation sees (has) handsome sons. He who performs a Sraddha A man wishing for sons shall perform a Sraddha in the Visakha constellation. He who performs a Srdddha in the Anu- radha constellation extends his realm.
verses.hindi: सुवर्ण की तरह दीप्तिमान् तथा कृष्ण चर्म और कमण्डलु से विभूषित हैं। वे पुरुषोत्तम एक निमेष के भीतर ही हमारे निकट उपस्थित हो गए। तब सब लोकों के द्वारा नमस्कृत ब्रह्म ने हमसे कहा -विभो ! आप कौन हैं और कहाँसे आकर यहाँ निवास करते हैं? यह आप हमसे कहें । हम चतुरानन, लोकों के कर्ता और स्वयम्भू हैं ।(१०१५। इस प्रकार ब्रह्मा द्वारा कहे जाने पर हमने ब्रह्मा से कहा- हँम सभी लोकों
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Sraddha in the Citra constel¬ lation sees (has) handsome sons. He who performs a Sraddha A man wishing for sons shall perform a Sraddha in the Visakha constellation. He who performs a Srdddha in the Anu- radha constellation extends his realm.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Sraddha in the Citra constel¬ lation sees (has) handsome sons. He who performs a Sraddha A man wishing for sons shall perform a Sraddha in the Visakha constellation. He who performs a Srdddha in the Anu- radha constellation extends his realm.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव दानानामन्नदानं परं स्मृतम् । सद्यः प्रीतिकरं तोयमन्नं च नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva dānānāmannadānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam / sadyaḥ prītikaraṃ toyamannaṃ ca nṛpasattama
verses.translation: He who performs a Srdddha under the Jyestha constella¬ tion attains lordship and excellence for ever. Those who desire health shall perform a Srdddha under the Mula constellation. Those who desire great fame should perform a Srdddha under Purvasadha. A man performing a Srdddha under the Uttarasadha con¬ stellation shall be free from grief. By performing a Srdddha under the Sravana constellation, one shall attain the greatest goal in excellent worlds.
verses.hindi: के कर्ता और बार-बार संहार करने वाले हैं। इस प्रकार हम दोनों बोल रहे थे और परस्पर जय पाने ४२३० वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Srdddha under the Jyestha constella¬ tion attains lordship and excellence for ever. Those who desire health shall perform a Srdddha under the Mula constellation. Those who desire great fame should perform a Srdddha under Purvasadha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Srdddha under the Jyestha constella¬ tion attains lordship and excellence for ever. Those who desire health shall perform a Srdddha under the Mula constellation. Those who desire great fame should perform a Srdddha under Purvasadha.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्रतीर्थे मृतानां तु नराणां भावितात्मनाम् । वरुणस्य पुरे वासो यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tatratīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām / varuṇasya pure vāso yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: A man who performs a Srdddha under the Dhanistha constellation gains a kingdom and attains enormous wealth. By performing a Srdddha under the Abhijit constellation, (he) ob¬ tains goats and sheep as fruit. He who performs a Srdddha in the Satabhisak constel¬ lation attains success as a great physician. He who performs a. Srdddha in the Purva-Bhadrapada (Prosthapada) constellation attains goats and sheep as the fruit.
verses.hindi: अहूं कर्ता च लोकानां संहर्ता च॒ पुनः पुनः । एवं संभाषमाणाभ्यां परस्परजयेषिणाम् ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: A man who performs a Srdddha under the Dhanistha constellation gains a kingdom and attains enormous wealth. By performing a Srdddha under the Abhijit constellation, (he) ob¬ tains goats and sheep as fruit.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who performs a Srdddha under the Dhanistha constellation gains a kingdom and attains enormous wealth. By performing a Srdddha under the Abhijit constellation, (he) ob¬ tains goats and sheep as fruit.…

verses.sanskrit: पश्चात्पूर्णे ततः काले मर्त्यलोके प्रजायते । अन्नदानप्रदो नित्यं जीवेद् वर्षशतं नरः
verses.transliteration: paścātpūrṇe tataḥ kāle martyaloke prajāyate / annadānaprado nityaṃ jīved varṣaśataṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: He who performs a Sraddha unfailingly under Uttara Bhadrapada shall obtain thousands of cows. He who per¬ forms a Sraddha under the Revatl constellation gets much wealth. By performing a Sraddha under the Asvini constellation one at¬ tains horses. He who performs a Sraddha in the BharanI constel¬ lation attains long life. By performing a Sraddha according to these injunctions SaSabindu attained the entire earth. After attaining the entire earth he praised him (Yaraa).
verses.hindi: ज्वालां ततस्तामालोक्य विस्मितो च तदाइनघाः । तेजसा चच तेनाथ सर्व ज्योतिष्कृतं जलम् वर्धमाने तदा बह्नावत्यन्तपरमादमुते । अतिदुद्राव तां ज्वालां ब्रह्मा चाहं स सध्वरो
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Sraddha unfailingly under Uttara Bhadrapada shall obtain thousands of cows. He who per¬ forms a Sraddha under the Revatl constellation gets much wealth. By performing a Sraddha under the Asvini constellation one at¬ tains horses.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Sraddha unfailingly under Uttara Bhadrapada shall obtain thousands of cows. He who per¬ forms a Sraddha under the Revatl constellation gets much wealth. By performing a Sraddha under the Asvini constellation one at¬ tains horses.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे वरुणेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ८२ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल वह्नितीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धो महातेजास्तपः कृत्वा हुताशनः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe varuṇeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 82 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla vahnitīrthamanuttamam / yatra siddho mahātejāstapaḥ kṛtvā hutāśanaḥ
verses.translation: O foremost one among the eloquents, what is it that offered to the Pitj-s, delights them to a little extent? What deli¬ ghts (them) for a long time? What is it that is conducive to delight them infinitely 7 1 The first topic discussed is about the vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes liked by Pitxs and therefore should be served to Brahmanas while dining at a Sraddha (vide w. 3-9). Listen to those sacrificial offerings which are to be made at the time of Sraddha as the knowers of Sraddha have under¬ stood. Listen also to the benefit of these in accordance with their strength. Grandfathers are pleased for a month by a Sraddha in which gingelly seeds, grains of rice, barley, black gram, water, fruits and roots are offered. They are pleased for two months if fishes are offered; for three months if venison is offered; for four months if the meat of hare is offered; and forfive months if the meat of birds is offered. They are delighted for six months with the flesh of boars, for seven months with goats' flesh and for eight months with the flesh of a spotted doe.
verses.hindi: प्रादेशमात्रमव्यक्तं लिड्भ! प्रमदीपितम् । न च तत्का-चन सध्ये न शेलं न च राजतम् २१
verses.wordMeaning: O foremost one among the eloquents, what is it that offered to the Pitj-s, delights them to a little extent? What deli¬ ghts (them) for a long time? What is it that is conducive to delight them infinitely 7 1 The first topic discussed is about the vegetarian and non-vegetarian d…
verses.commentary: Sense: O foremost one among the eloquents, what is it that offered to the Pitj-s, delights them to a little extent? What deli¬ ghts (them) for a long time? What is it that is conducive to delight them infinitely 7 1 The first topic discussed is about the vegetarian and non-vegetarian d…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभक्ष्यः कृतो यो ऽसौ दण्डके मुनिना पुरा । नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य पूतो जातो हुताशनः
verses.transliteration: sarvabhakṣyaḥ kṛto yo 'sau daṇḍake muninā purā / narmadātaṭamāśritya pūto jāto hutāśanaḥ
verses.translation: The manes are delighted for nine months with the meat of the Ruru deer. They will have contentment lasting for ten months with the meat of Gauaya (a kind of ox). They are propitiated for eleven months with the meat of a tortoise. Know that Sraddha with (products of) cow's milk lasts for a year. So also in the case of milk-pudding along with milk pro¬ ducts, honey and ghee. The satisfaction with the meat of a Vadhririasa (a rhino-like animal?) lasts for twelve years. With the meat of Khadga (rhinoceros) during the rites of Pitrs, the pleasure is everlasting. So also with the meat of a black goat and an alligator provides endless pleasure. In this connection, those who know the ancient lores mention about the gathas (traditional verses) sung by Pitrs. (Pitrs sing) "Will a son be bom in our own family who will give us on the Trayodafi (thirteenth) day, cooked food, milk pudding, honey and ghee on the occasion of Gaja- cchaya Parvan P * 1 Or give the same with the meat of a goat that is
verses.hindi: ज्वालामालायतं न्यस्तं सर्वभुतभयंकरम् द २२ अस्य लिड्भस्य योष्न्तं व गच्छुते मन्त्रकारणम् । घोरकिपिणमत्यर्थ भिन्‍्दन्तमिव रोदसो २३ ततो मामब्रवोद्ब्नह्मा अधो गच्छत्वतन्द्रित:। अन्तमस्य विजानीमो लिज्भधस्य तु महात्मनः. की अभिलाषा कर ही रहे थे कि, हम दोनों ने उत्तर की ओर एक जलती हुई ज्योति को देखा
verses.wordMeaning: The manes are delighted for nine months with the meat of the Ruru deer. They will have contentment lasting for ten months with the meat of Gauaya (a kind of ox). They are propitiated for eleven months with the meat of a tortoise.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The manes are delighted for nine months with the meat of the Ruru deer. They will have contentment lasting for ten months with the meat of Gauaya (a kind of ox). They are propitiated for eleven months with the meat of a tortoise.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् । अग्निप्रवेशं कुरुते स गच्छेदग्निसाम्यताम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram / agnipraveśaṃ kurute sa gacchedagnisāmyatām
verses.translation: The conjunction that occurs when the Moon is in the Magha constel¬ lation, the Sun is in Hasta and the Tithi is the 13th in the rainy season, it is called Gajacchdya or Kunjaracchaya. O dear one, recount the benefit of the holy centres Gaya etc. to me who ask. Please mention the merit entirely that is derived by performing the rites of Pitrs. O son, a Sraddha performed in Gaya yields endless benefit. Japas, Homas and penances (performed there) 'are also beneficial endlessly. Hence on the anniversary day of the death of father, Sraddha performed there is remembered as everlasting, A son begot after marrying a girl of eight years sanctifies twentyone generations. Moreover, he sanctifies six generations in the family of his maternal uncle. This is remem¬ bered as the benefit (of such a marriage). I shall recount the benefit derived from (discharging) a bull. Even as I recount listen and understand. The discharger of the bull sanctifies ten previous generations and ten succeeding generations. At the time of letting free the bull whatever is sprinkled with water as it emerges from water on to the ground, is said to yield endless benefit.
verses.hindi: पवित्र मुन्ियों, उस ज्वाला को देखकर हम दोनों ही विस्मित हो गये; क्योंकि उस तेज के प्रभाव से समृूची जलराशि जगमगा उठी । वह अद्भुत तेज धीरे-धीरे बढ़ने लगा और हम दोनों शीघ्र ही उसका अन्त देखने के लिये उत्सुक हो उधर गये । हम दोनों ने देखा कि, वह ज्वालामाला पृथ्वी और स्वलोंक को पार कर रही है। उस ज्वाला-मण्डल के मध्य में अन्यन्त प्रभा-पूणं चमकता हुआ एक वितस्ति परिमाण का
verses.wordMeaning: The conjunction that occurs when the Moon is in the Magha constel¬ lation, the Sun is in Hasta and the Tithi is the 13th in the rainy season, it is called Gajacchdya or Kunjaracchaya. O dear one, recount the benefit of the holy centres Gaya etc. to me who ask.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The conjunction that occurs when the Moon is in the Magha constel¬ lation, the Sun is in Hasta and the Tithi is the 13th in the rainy season, it is called Gajacchdya or Kunjaracchaya. O dear one, recount the benefit of the holy centres Gaya etc. to me who ask.…

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या स्नात्वा तु यस्तत्र तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः । अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाप्नोत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā snātvā tu yastatra tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that all those things touched by water tossed about by its tail etc., give endless satisfaction to Pitrs. This is called'the rite of letting free a bull* ( Vrsotsarga-vidhi). For the details vide Vifliu Dh. S. 86.1-20. Vimdharmottara 1.147. 1-19 repeat the same procedure. Though the words ' nilam vam' are translated as 'blue bull* the bull is not blue in colour. Though the adjective 'blue* (Mla) is variously defined, Mt. 38 defines it as 'a bull having white legs, face & tail and the rest of the body as red* I could not trace the verse lohilo yastu varpena etc. in Bd. P. though Kane quotes it as ascribed to it (HD, IV , fn 1215). • The ground dug up by the bull by means of its hoofs or horns, serves as canals of honey perpetually feeding Pitrs. The satisfaction derived by Pitrs at the rite of letting free the bull is more than that when they hear that a tank, a thousand Nalvas square, has been dug (a Nalva =400 hands). If anyone gives gingelly seeds mixed with honey and jaggery, it yields everlasting benefit. One should not test Brahmanas always in order to give them anything. But testing is heard about (i.e. prescribed in £rutis) in regard to the rites of Devas (gods) and Pitrs. 1
verses.hindi: अस्पष्ठ शिक-लिज्धु था। मध्य में सुशोभित वह लिड्भध न तो सोने का था, न चाँदी का और न तो पत्थर का ही । वह अपरिचित, अचिन्त्य, कभी लक्ष्य तो कभी भलक्ष्य होने बाला, अत्यन्त ओजपूर्ण, महाधी र, प्रतिक्षण अधिकाधिक बढ़ने वाला, सब प्राणियों को भय-त्रस्त करने वाला और अपनी ज्वाला की अधिकता से विशाल जान पड़ता था ।१८-२२। यह देखकर मैंने कहा कि इस भयंकर रूपवाले लिंग का जो कि अपनी ऊँचाई से आकाश को फोड़ता साजान पड़ता है--पता लगाता चाहिए। यह सुनकर ब्रह्मा ने मुझसे कहा--आप आलस्य-त्याग कर इसके निम्ने भाग की ओर जाइये, किसी न किसी प्रकार इस रहस्यमय लिंग का अन्त जानना चाहिए। मैं स्वयं इसका पता लगाने के लिये ऊपर की ओर जा रहा हूं जब तक इसका अन्त न होगा, ऊपर की ओर बढ़ता ही जाऊँगा। इस प्रकार संकल्प कर दोनों ऊपर ओर
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that all those things touched by water tossed about by its tail etc., give endless satisfaction to Pitrs. This is called'the rite of letting free a bull* ( Vrsotsarga-vidhi). For the details vide Vifliu Dh. S. 86.1-20. Vimdharmottara 1.147.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवानन्तरं राजन्कौबेरं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । कुबेरो यत्र संसिद्धो यक्षाणामधिपः पुरा
verses.transliteration: tasyaivānantaraṃ rājankauberaṃ tīrthamuttamam / kubero yatra saṃsiddho yakṣāṇāmadhipaḥ purā
verses.translation: One should invite these for the Sraddha rite: Those who have studied all the Vedas and who have performed all rites; the Brahmanas who are the sanctifiers of the row; important Brahmanas who know the Bhasyas (Glosses on Aphorisms); those who regularly study Grammar; those who study Puranas and Dharmasastras; those who are conversant with the three-Naci- ketas-Vidyas; the worshippers of five fires; the Trisuparnas, the knowers of the six ancillary subjects of the Vedas; a son of the Brahma form of marriage; a master of Vedic Prosody (or chanter of the Vedas); a singer of the Jycstha Saman; one who has taken baths in sacred waters (at holy places); those who have taken part in important Yajnas and taken the concluding (Avabhrtha) ablutions; those who observe rites immediately; those who stri¬ ctly adhere to their own duties; those who are not wrathful and those who are always calm and quiescent. And those who perpetually observe the ten meritorious deeds shall also be invited. Whatever is offered to these, yields everlasting benefit. These are the sanctifiers of the row. Those Brahmanas who observe Yogic rites and duties should be revered faithfully. They are the foremost due to their adherence to the duties of their (specific) stages of life. In regard to the offering Verses 22-31 state the qualifications of the Brahmins eligible for in¬ vitation to Sraddha, though it has been already discussed in Gh. 17. Yogins are given the first preference as Yoga-dharma was regarded as the foremost among Dharmas. One who worships these, worships all the worlds along with the Pitrs. ( Togadharma ) is the holiest of all holy things, the most auspicious of all auspicious things. Togadharma is mentioned as the first among all Dharmas.
verses.hindi: नीचे की ओर गये ।२३-२५। ततृपच्चात् मैं (विष्ण) एक सहस्न वर्ष तक नीचे की ओर चलता ही गया
verses.wordMeaning: One should invite these for the Sraddha rite: Those who have studied all the Vedas and who have performed all rites; the Brahmanas who are the sanctifiers of the row; important Brahmanas who know the Bhasyas (Glosses on Aphorisms); those who regularly study Grammar;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should invite these for the Sraddha rite: Those who have studied all the Vedas and who have performed all rites; the Brahmanas who are the sanctifiers of the row; important Brahmanas who know the Bhasyas (Glosses on Aphorisms); those who regularly study Grammar;…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य जगद्गुरुम् । उमया सहितं भक्त्या सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā samabhyarcya jagadgurum / umayā sahitaṃ bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: A rogue, a drunkard, a patient of pulmonary con¬ sumption, a cattle breeder, an ugly person, a common servant of all in the village, a usurer, a professional musician, a merchant, an incendiary, an administerer of poison, a pimp, a seller of Soma juice, a person who undertakes sea voyage, one whose skin is defiled, a dealer in oil, a deceitful person, one who quarrels with his father, one who has a co-husband at home, a calumnia¬ ted person, a thief, a person whose livelihood is arts and crafts, a tale-bearer, a person giving wrong information about holy days, one who is malicious to his friends, a group-beggar, an atheist, a discarder of the Vedas, a mad fellow, a eunuch, a knavish fellow, a destroyer of foetus, a defiler of the preceptor's bed, a follower of the physician's profession for livelihood, a messenger and an adulterer. He who sells the Vedas, religious observances, holy rites and penances—all these are defilers of the row. What is given to a trader is not beneficial here or here¬ after. The same is the case in regard to a person who misappro¬ priates (deposits), who is knavish and who hates the Vedas. Verses 31-42 give a list of persons unfit for invitation to a Sraddha. Long lists of such unfit persons are given by Gautama Dh.S. XV. 16-19, Manu III. 150-166, Yajiiavalkya I. 222-224, Mbh. Anuiasana 90.6-11, Mt. 14-17, KP.II. 21.23-43. Dogs and demons should not see the performance of a Sraddha. 1 Hence it should be screened out all round, and gingelly seeds should be strewn around. It is to ward off Raksasas that gingelly seeds are strewn and the screen is to prevent the dogs. Boars destroy the effect of a Sraddha by having a look at it and a cock by fluttering its wings (or by the fall of its feathers within).
verses.hindi: ततो ध्यानगतं तन्न ईश्वरं स्वंतोमुखम् । प्रभवं निधन चेव लोकानां प्रभुमव्ययम् २६ ब्रह्माउडजलिपुटो भृत्वा तस्मे शर्वाय शूलिने। महाभरवनादाय भीमरूपाय दंष्ट्रिणे ॥
verses.wordMeaning: A rogue, a drunkard, a patient of pulmonary con¬ sumption, a cattle breeder, an ugly person, a common servant of all in the village, a usurer, a professional musician, a merchant, an incendiary, an administerer of poison, a pimp, a seller of Soma juice,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A rogue, a drunkard, a patient of pulmonary con¬ sumption, a cattle breeder, an ugly person, a common servant of all in the village, a usurer, a professional musician, a merchant, an incendiary, an administerer of poison, a pimp, a seller of Soma juice,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा दद्याद् विप्राय कांचनम् । नाभिमात्रे जले तिष्ठन्स लभेतार्बुदं फलम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā dadyād viprāya kāṃcanam / nābhimātre jale tiṣṭhansa labhetārbudaṃ phalam
verses.translation: A woman in her monthly course destroys the Sraddha by touching. If the performer of a Sraddha becomes angry, he destroys the benefit derived. If anyone gets his friends to offer Sraddha and Havis, they do not please Pitrs or Devas. Nor does he attain heaven. Grandfathers (manes) are delighted with what is given on the beautiful banks of the rivers and streams as well as of the lakes and in secluded places. One shall not shed tears while performing a Sraddha, nor should he take active part in irrelevant conversation. One should not munch or crunch anything while performing a Srad¬ dha. One should avoid mutual rivalry too. Since the period of Dharma Sutras, people believed that food for Sraddha got polluted even by being looked by certain animals and.certain categories of people. The list of such unvvorthies is given in vv. 44-46—an echo of Gautama Dh.S. 15.25-28, Manu III. 239-242, and Purarias like KP. II. 22.34-35, VP. III.16.12-14, Bd. 3.19, 43-44. While performing a Sraddha the sacred thread should be worn from right to left and the Darbhas should be held duly in the hands. One should perform a Sraddha till one's death. Thus one delights Pitrs. At the outset, he should formally take permission of the preceptor or the invited Brahmanas. He should then kindle a fire duly. The articles to be offered to Pitrs should be placed on the ground over a winnowing basket or on a Kusa mat.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्ताय महान्ताय नमस्कार प्रकुम है द ३०
verses.wordMeaning: A woman in her monthly course destroys the Sraddha by touching. If the performer of a Sraddha becomes angry, he destroys the benefit derived. If anyone gets his friends to offer Sraddha and Havis, they do not please Pitrs or Devas. Nor does he attain heaven.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A woman in her monthly course destroys the Sraddha by touching. If the performer of a Sraddha becomes angry, he destroys the benefit derived. If anyone gets his friends to offer Sraddha and Havis, they do not please Pitrs or Devas. Nor does he attain heaven.…

verses.sanskrit: दधिस्कन्दे मधुस्कन्दे नन्दीशे वरुणालये । आग्नेये यत्फलं तात स्नात्वा तत्फलमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: dadhiskande madhuskande nandīśe varuṇālaye / āgneye yatphalaṃ tāta snātvā tatphalamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: During the bright half (of the month), the Sraddha is to be performed in the forenoon by the skilful performer of a Sraddha. During the dark half, it should be performed in the afternoon. In any case the Rauhina period (the 4th Muhurta of the day), should not be transgressed. Thus the great and noble souls, the seers of time and place, the Pitrs of great Yoga (yogic power) and great virility should be worshipped. A person always devoted to Pitrs attains the excellent Yoga. After eschewing both auspicious and inauspicious actions they attain salvation through meditation. It is for the sake of (promotion of) sacrifices that after deluding the universe, it (Yoga) was eschewed and kept in the cavity (of the heart, i.e. kept secret) by the noble-souled Kasyapa. O excellent one among the knowers of Yoga, that nectarine (or immortal) Yoga, the eternal great Dharma was promulgated by Sanatkumara. It is a great esoteric secret of the Devas. It is the grea¬ test resort of the sages. It can always (be attained) by the devo¬ tees of Pitrs through filial devotion, piety and endeavour.
verses.hindi: नमोस्तु ते लोकसुरेश बेव नमोस्तु ते भूतपते महान्त । परमेष्ठ (एठी) पर ब्रह्म अक्षरं परम पदम् । श्रेष्ठस्त्वं वामदेवश्च रुद्र: स्‍्कन्दः शिवः प्रभुः.
verses.wordMeaning: During the bright half (of the month), the Sraddha is to be performed in the forenoon by the skilful performer of a Sraddha. During the dark half, it should be performed in the afternoon. In any case the Rauhina period (the 4th Muhurta of the day), should not be transgressed.…

During the dark half, it should be performed in the afternoon. In any case the Rauhina period (the 4th Muhurta of the day), should not be transgressed.…

verses.sanskrit: ते वन्द्या मानुषे लोके धन्याः पूर्णमनोरथाः । यैस्तु दृष्टं महापुण्यं नर्मदातीर्थपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: te vandyā mānuṣe loke dhanyāḥ pūrṇamanorathāḥ / yaistu dṛṣṭaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ narmadātīrthapañcakam
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that one who is devoted to Pitrs shall, with endeavour, attain everything of that Yoga in essence. To whom are the Sraddhas to be offered; which are the things that yield great benefits when given; what are the holy centres and sacred rivers wherein the Sraddha offered bears everlasting benefits; by what means does one attain heaven—all these have been mentioned to you in brief. The man who after hearing this explanation of the procedure of Sraddhas, becomes malicious, is an atheist envelo¬ ped in darkness. He will drown himself in the terrible hell. He who has perfectly controlled his mind, finds all his great ailments terminated. He who is not mindful of the Airamas (stages in life) stated in the Vedas attains the Kumbhlka hell. He attains the status of a thief and gets his tongue cut. Those who censure Yoga become lumps of clay in the ocean 1 and decay as long as the earth exists. Hence, this is the Dharma (virtue) intended in the Sraddha that it should be per¬ formed by a man with faith (in it). Scandalisation of Yogins should be scrupulously avoided. By scandalising (them), a person becomes a worm and rolls there itself.
verses.hindi: त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वघट्कारस्त्वमोंकारः परं पदम् । स्वाहकारों नमस्कार: संस्कार: सर्वकमंणामू
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that one who is devoted to Pitrs shall, with endeavour, attain everything of that Yoga in essence. To whom are the Sraddhas to be offered; which are the things that yield great benefits when given;…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that one who is devoted to Pitrs shall, with endeavour, attain everything of that Yoga in essence. To whom are the Sraddhas to be offered; which are the things that yield great benefits when given;…

verses.sanskrit: ते यान्ति भास्करे लोके परमे दुःखनाशने । भास्करादैश्वरे लोके चैश्वराद् अनिवर्तके
verses.transliteration: te yānti bhāskare loke parame duḥkhanāśane / bhāskarādaiśvare loke caiśvarād anivartake
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that he who censures Yoga, the cause of salvation unto those who meditate, goes to terrible hell. He who listens to it (the censure), also falls into the hell. By denigrating masters of Yoga, a man certainly falls into the hell surrounded by darkness and terrible to behold. There is no doubt about it that he who pays heed to the vilification of masters of Yoga of fully controlled selves, be¬ comes submerged in the Kumbhlpaka hell for a long time. One should eschew hatred for Yogins mentally, verbally and physically. He will reap the benefit of the same here itself A person who has mastered (all lores) does not get (realize) the Atman. He wanders within the three worlds due to his own actions. A person who has mastered Rgveda, Yajurveda, Samaveda and all their ancillary subjects does not attain Brahman which is devoid of changes and aberrations ( avikaram ) and therefore, becomes distressed. Verses 54-57, and vv. 61-71 show the blind faith of Puranic writers in Yogins. Since the times of Vasisjha Dh.S. XI. 17, Yatis (recluses) and Yogins had a special place of honour among the invitees to a Sraddha. But Purana writers have prohibited denigration of Yogis even orally.
verses.hindi: स्वधाकारश्च जाप्यश्च ब्रतानि नियमास्तथा। वेदा लोकःश्च देवाश्व भगवानेव सर्वशः आकाशस्य च शदब्दस्त्वं भतानां प्रभवाव्ययम् । भूमेगंन्धो रसश्चापां तेजोरूपं महेश्वर ३४५ वायो: स्पर्शश्च देवेश वपुश्चन्द्रसम (मस ) स्तथा  बुधो ज्ञानं च देवेश प्रकृतो बीजममेैव च
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that he who censures Yoga, the cause of salvation unto those who meditate, goes to terrible hell. He who listens to it (the censure), also falls into the hell. By denigrating masters of Yoga,…

verses.sanskrit: नीयते स परे लोके यावद् इन्द्राश्चतुर्दश । ततः स्वर्गाच्च्युतो मर्त्यो राजा भवति धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: nīyate sa pare loke yāvad indrāścaturdaśa / tataḥ svargāccyuto martyo rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective verse) 1 * * * He who has crossed the bounds of effects (of Prakrti) goes beyond Prakrti. Mastery, of the three Vedas leads to the crossing (of the limits?) of three gunas The (highest) principle is beyond the twentyfour Yogas (?). He is the master of all, who has passed beyond worldly existe¬ nce. (?) 2 (Defective verse) By means of his Yogic power, a knower of Yogas withdraws unto himself the dissolution of the Atman, in the same manner as the entire creation of the princi¬ ples by the Atman. He alone becomes the master of all. It is the knower of Yogas who knows the Vedas and at¬ tains the knowable. They call him the knower of the Vedas, and the master of Vedas. After duly knowing the knowable and what should be known (one becomes the knower of Vedas). They call him the knower of the Vedas. All others are thinkers of the Vedas. A person devoted to Pitrs attains the (fruit of) Yajfias, Vedas, all cherished desires, different kinds of knowledge, longevity, progeny and riches. He who invariably reads this Sraddhakalpa during Sraddha, in the end, gets all these (benefits) and the benefits of charitable gifts at the holy centres.
verses.hindi: परन्तु उसका अन्त न देख सका। तब तो सचमुच ही मैं डर गया। उधर ब्रह्मा की भी यही गति थी। वे भी चलते-चलते थक गये परन्तु पारन पा सके। तब विवद् हो वे भी लौट पड़े और मेरे ही साथ उसी महासागर में निर्दिष्ट स्थान पर पहुँचे। हम दोनों उस महात्मा शिव की माया से मोहित कि कत्तव्य विमूढ़ से हो गये, चेतना लुप्त सी हो गई । निदान उस विश्वतोमुख, अव्यय, शक्तिशाली लोक के स्नष्टा
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) 1 * * * He who has crossed the bounds of effects (of Prakrti) goes beyond Prakrti. Mastery, of the three Vedas leads to the crossing (of the limits?) of three gunas The (highest) principle is beyond the twentyfour Yogas (?). He is the master of all,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वरोगविनिर्मुक्तो भुनक्ति सचराचरम् । विष्णुश्च देवता येषां नर्मदातीर्थसेविनाम्
verses.transliteration: sarvarogavinirmukto bhunakti sacarācaram / viṣṇuśca devatā yeṣāṃ narmadātīrthasevinām
verses.translation: He shall be the sanctifier of the row (of diners). He shall be given priority in being fed among the Brahmanas. Or he shall (be eligible to) teach all the Brahmanas and attain all cherished desires. The text is defective and requires slight modifications as per the same verse printed in the Bd. 3.19.64 which means: "One who has mastered all created things, the products of Prakrti (the nature known as AvidyS), one He who always listens to this after subduing anger, being without malice and becoming free fromgreed and delusion' attains endless heavenly pleasure. He attains the entire benefit of visiting holy centres, and making charitable gifts etc. This is the most excellent means to liberation. This is the greatest means of attaining heaven. He shall have the greatest contentment in this world too. Hence he should assiduously perform this. He who reads these injunctions about (performance of) Sraddha attentively and with purity of mind, in the assembly (of the learned) during Parvan days, becomes endowed with children. With great brilliance, he attains the same region as that of the heaven-dwellers. Obeisance to that self-born deity by whom this Kalpa has been prescribed. I always bow down to the great masters of Yoga.
verses.hindi: एवं विनाशक प्रभु शंकर का ध्यान करने लगे और अड्जलि बाधकर उस शर्वं. शुली, महाभेरव शब्द करने वाले, भीमरूप, दंष्ट्री, अव्यक्त और महान् शंकर की स्तुति करने लगे ।२६-३०। है देव  लोक ओर देव दोनों के ईश ! आपको नमस्कार है, भूतपति ! महान्त ! आपको नमस्कार है, शाइवत ! पिद्ध योनि ! आपको नमस्कार है। सब जगत् की प्रतिष्ठा करने वाले ! नमस्कार हैं।३१। आप परमेष्ठी, परब्रह्ा, अक्षर और परम पद हैं। आप श्रेष्ठ हैं, वामदेव, रुद्र-स्कन्द शिव और प्रभु आपही हैं, यज्ञ, वषद्कार, ओंकार और परमपद हैं, स्वाहाकार, नमस्कार, सब कर्मों के संस्कार, स्वधाकार, जपनीय, त्रत, नियम, वेद, लोक, देव और स्वव्यांपी भगवान् आप ही हैं। आकाश का शब्द गुण, समस्त प्राणियों के अव्यय आदि कारण आप ही हैं ।३२-३४३। महेश्वर ! आप भूमि में गन्धस्वरूप, जल में रस और तेजोहूप
verses.wordMeaning: He shall be the sanctifier of the row (of diners). He shall be given priority in being fed among the Brahmanas. Or he shall (be eligible to) teach all the Brahmanas and attain all cherished desires.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be the sanctifier of the row (of diners). He shall be given priority in being fed among the Brahmanas. Or he shall (be eligible to) teach all the Brahmanas and attain all cherished desires.…

verses.sanskrit: अखण्डितप्रतापास्ते जायन्ते नात्र संशयः । गङ्गा कनखले पुण्या कुरुक्षेत्रे सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: akhaṇḍitapratāpāste jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ / gaṅgā kanakhale puṇyā kurukṣetre sarasvatī
verses.translation: O dear one, these Pitrs are the deities of Devas. Pitrs are stationed in these seven abodes for ever. They are free from pain. All these noble souls are the sons of Prajapati. The first group is that of Yogins. That is eternal and is ever conducive to the increase in the Yogic Power (of Yogins). All Devas worship them. They are stationed in them (Pitrs). The four Airamas too successively worship them. The four castes also worship them in accordance with the injunc¬ tions. Similarly the mixed castes and the Mlecchas (alien out- castes) also worship them. Pitrs revere him who devotedly worships Pitrs. Pitrs in the form of grandfather grant nourishment, progeny and heavenly pleasure to him who desires nourishment or who desires progeny. To a son, the rite for Pitrs is preferable to the rite for Devas. Pitrs are to be propitiated even before Devas.
verses.hindi: हैं । वायु का स्पर्श गुण एवं चन्द्रमा रूप आप ही हैं। देवेश ! आप प्रकृति के बीजरूप से वत्तमान हैं। आप ही ज्ञानखप और ज्ञानी भी हैं, आप समस्त भूतों के बनानेवाले और अन्त करनेवाले काल अन्तक (यम) हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one, these Pitrs are the deities of Devas. Pitrs are stationed in these seven abodes for ever. They are free from pain. All these noble souls are the sons of Prajapati. The first group is that of Yogins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, these Pitrs are the deities of Devas. Pitrs are stationed in these seven abodes for ever. They are free from pain. All these noble souls are the sons of Prajapati. The first group is that of Yogins.…

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामे वा यदि वारण्ये पुण्या सर्वत्र नर्मदा । रेवातीरे वसेन्नित्यं रेवातोयं सदा पिबेत्
verses.transliteration: grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā / revātīre vasennityaṃ revātoyaṃ sadā pibet
verses.translation: The subtle movement of the Yogic power of Pitrs is in- To all of them a silver vessel or one accompanied with silver is ordained. It is said to be sanctifying and excellent (for the rites) of Devas along with (those of) Pit r s. The three Pindas which the kinsmen offer invoking the names and Gotra, which they place on the ground strewn with Kusa grass after wearing the sacred thread from right to left, delight the respective parents who are present everywhere. What constitutes the diet of the creature (i.e. the devotee who offers) is the diet of Pitrs as well. Just as in a cowpen the calf finds out its lost mother, so also the Mantra takes those articles where the Janlu (the man for whom the pin<la is intended) stays. The name, Gotra and Mantra take the food offered to him. Even if they had taken a hundred births, the satisfaction follows them. (They are satiated by the Sraddha offering.) Thus this convention is established by Brahma, the supreme god. This first creation of Pitrs is for the worlds that seek everlasting bliss.
verses.hindi: त्वं कर्ता स्व भूतानां कालो सृत्युमंयोध्त्तकः । त्वं धारयस्ि लोकांस्त्रीस्त्वमेव सृुजसि प्रभो. पूर्वेण वदनेन त्वमिद्द्रत्वं, (स्त्वं) च प्रकाशसे । दक्षिणेतर व वक्‍त्रेण लोकान्संक्षियसि प्रभो ॥३द्र पश्चिमेण तु वक्‍त्रेण बरुणत्वं करोषि वे। उत्तरेण तु वच्त्रेण सोम्यत्वं च ब्यवस्थितम् (३६ राजसे बहुधा देव लोकानां प्रभवाव्यप: । आदित्या बसवो झद्रा सस्तश्चाश्व्रिनीसुतो ॥४ ० साध्या विद्याधरा नागाश्रारणाभ्र तपोधना: । वालखिल्या महात्मानस्तपःसिद्धाश्च सुत्रताः
verses.wordMeaning: The subtle movement of the Yogic power of Pitrs is in- To all of them a silver vessel or one accompanied with silver is ordained. It is said to be sanctifying and excellent (for the rites) of Devas along with (those of) Pit r s.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The subtle movement of the Yogic power of Pitrs is in- To all of them a silver vessel or one accompanied with silver is ordained. It is said to be sanctifying and excellent (for the rites) of Devas along with (those of) Pit r s.…

verses.sanskrit: स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु सोमपानं दिने दिने । गङ्गाद्याः सरितः सर्वाः समुद्राश्च सरांसि च । कल्पान्ते संक्षयं यान्ति न मृता तेन नर्मदा
verses.transliteration: sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu somapānaṃ dine dine / gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāśca sarāṃsi ca / kalpānte saṃkṣayaṃ yānti na mṛtā tena narmadā
verses.translation: Thus these Pitrs are Devas and Devas are Pitrs. O sinless ones, all these (following) have been recounted by me— Dauhilras, (i.e. daughter's sons), Yajamanas, worlds, daughters, grandsons, sons, charitable gifts, along with the mode of purity, holy centres, fruit thereof, everlasting nature of the benefit, (the different types of) Brahmanas and the rules governing Yayavaras (wandering ascetics). Everything has been mentioned in the manner that Brahma prescribed formerly. This, Angiras explained in an assembly while the sages sat listening when he had been asked to clear the doubts regard¬ ing Pitrs. It was formerly in the course of an extensive Satra (sacri¬ fice) lasting for a thousand years wherein the lord of the house was the deity. Lord Brahma. It is heard that Brahma presided over it for hundreds Brhaspati who had been asked by his intelligent son formerly, told thus. He recounted the family of Pitrs. What he said has been mentioned (by me). Henceforth I shall' recount (the race) ofVaruna. Understand (it).
verses.hindi: त्वत्तः प्रसुता देवेश ये चान्ये नियतश्नता: । उमा सीता सिनीवाली कुहर्सायत्रिरेव ऋ ?
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these Pitrs are Devas and Devas are Pitrs. O sinless ones, all these (following) have been recounted by me— Dauhilras, (i.e. daughter's sons), Yajamanas, worlds, daughters, grandsons, sons, charitable gifts, along with the mode of purity, holy centres, fruit thereof,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these Pitrs are Devas and Devas are Pitrs. O sinless ones, all these (following) have been recounted by me— Dauhilras, (i.e. daughter's sons), Yajamanas, worlds, daughters, grandsons, sons, charitable gifts, along with the mode of purity, holy centres, fruit thereof,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे दधिस्कन्दादिपञ्चतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्व्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ८३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । ब्रह्महत्याहरं प्रोक्तं रेवातटसमाश्रयम् । हनूमताभिधं ह्यत्र विद्यते लिङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dadhiskandādipañcatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 83 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / brahmahatyāharaṃ proktaṃ revātaṭasamāśrayam / hanūmatābhidhaṃ hyatra vidyate liṅgamuttamam
verses.translation: The sages to whom this ( Sraddha Kalpa ) was narrated became very much delighted. Extremely eager to hear further, they asked him thereafter.
verses.hindi: लक्ष्मी: कीतिधृतिमेंधा लज्जा क्षान्तिवेपु: स्वधा  तुष्टिः पुष्कि: क्रिया चेव बाचां वेधी सरस्वती ॥ त्वत्त: प्रसुता देवेश संध्या राधिस्तथेत्र च ४ ३ सुर्वायुतानामयुतप्रभाव नमोस्तु ते चन्द्रसहल्नगोचर । द
verses.wordMeaning: The sages to whom this ( Sraddha Kalpa ) was narrated became very much delighted. Extremely eager to hear further, they asked him thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages to whom this ( Sraddha Kalpa ) was narrated became very much delighted. Extremely eager to hear further, they asked him thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: हनूमन्तेश्वरं नाम कथं जातं वदस्व मे । ब्रह्महत्याहरं तीर्थं रेवादक्षिणसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: hanūmanteśvaraṃ nāma kathaṃ jātaṃ vadasva me / brahmahatyāharaṃ tīrthaṃ revādakṣiṇasaṃsthitam
verses.translation: Please narrate (to us) in proper sequence the condition of the races of the kings of unmeasured spledour as well as valour. We implore you.
verses.hindi: नमोइस्तु ते पर्वंतरूपधारिणे नमो5स्तु ते सबंगुणाकराय ४४
verses.wordMeaning: Please narrate (to us) in proper sequence the condition of the races of the kings of unmeasured spledour as well as valour. We implore you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Please narrate (to us) in proper sequence the condition of the races of the kings of unmeasured spledour as well as valour. We implore you.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: साधु साधु महाबाहो सोमवंशविभूषण । गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं तीर्थं नाख्यातं कस्यचिन्मया
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sādhu sādhu mahābāho somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇa / guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā
verses.translation: Thus entreated, Suta Lomakarfana an expert in the narration of tales and proficient in the art of speech, (observed) the desire of the sages to hear the story and spoke these words:
verses.hindi: नमोष्स्तु ते भस्मविभुताभूषिताड़ु नमो5स्तु ते कामशरोरनाशन । नमोस्तु ते देव हिरण्यवाससे नमोस्तु ते देव हिरण्यबाहवे १४६
verses.wordMeaning: Thus entreated, Suta Lomakarfana an expert in the narration of tales and proficient in the art of speech, (observed) the desire of the sages to hear the story and spoke these words:
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus entreated, Suta Lomakarfana an expert in the narration of tales and proficient in the art of speech, (observed) the desire of the sages to hear the story and spoke these words:

verses.sanskrit: तव स्नेहात्प्रवक्ष्यामि पीडितो वार्द्धकेन तु । पूर्वं जातं महद्युद्धं रामरावणयोरपि
verses.transliteration: tava snehātpravakṣyāmi pīḍito vārddhakena tu / pūrvaṃ jātaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayorapi
verses.translation: Even as I recount, listen, and understand the state and position of the dynasties of the kings of unmeasured splendour, in the proper order and their prowess.
verses.hindi: आप ही तीनों लोकों को धारण करते और सृष्टि भी करते हैं ।३५-३७। अपने पूर्व मुख से तुम इन्द्र रूप में प्रकाशित होते हो, प्रभो ! दक्षिण मुख से सभी लोकों का विनाश करते हो अर्थात् यम रूप में विद्यमान हो, पश्चिममुख से वरुण का कार्य करते हो एवं उत्तर मुख से चन्द्रमा का धर्म तुममें व्यवस्थित है
verses.wordMeaning: Even as I recount, listen, and understand the state and position of the dynasties of the kings of unmeasured splendour, in the proper order and their prowess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as I recount, listen, and understand the state and position of the dynasties of the kings of unmeasured splendour, in the proper order and their prowess.

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रो विश्रवास्तस्य वै सुतः । रावणस्तेन संजातो दशास्यो ब्रह्मराक्षसः
verses.transliteration: pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ putro viśravāstasya vai sutaḥ / rāvaṇastena saṃjāto daśāsyo brahmarākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: This chapter corresponds to Bd. 3.59; only verse numbers from that chapter are quoted in notes.
verses.hindi: देव ! इस प्रकार तुम अनेक रूपों द्वारा इस समस्त जगत् के उत्वादक रूप में शोभित होते हो, तुम्हारा कभी नाश नहीं होता । देवेश ! बारह आदित्य, आठों वसु, ग्यारहों रुद़्, उनचासों मरुत्, दोनों अश्विनीकुमार एवं इनके अतिरिक्त जो साध्य, विद्याधर, नाग, चारण, तप्स्वी, बालखिल्य प्रभृति महात्मा तपोनिष्ठ हैँ, वे सभी तुमसे उत्पन्न हुए हैं। अन्य जितने जगत् में तपोनिष्ठ ब्रतधारी हैं, वे सब भी तुमसे उत्पन्न हुए हैं । उमा, सीता, सिनीवाली, कुह, गायत्री, लक्ष्मी, कीति, धृति, मेधा लज्जा, शान्ति, वषु, सवा, तुष्टि, पुष्टि क्रिया, वाग्देवी सरस्वती, संध्या, राज्ि-ये सभी तुमसे उत्पन्न हुई हैं।४०-४३। दस सहल॒ सूर्य से भी अधिक प्रभावशाली तुम्हें हमारा नमस्कार है। है सहस्रों चन्द्रमा के समान कःन्तिशालिन् ! तुम्हें हम नमस्कार करते हैं। पर्वत के समान विशाल स्वरूप धारण करने वाले, सबंगुणों के आकर स्वरूप तम्हें हम
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter corresponds to Bd. 3.59; only verse numbers from that chapter are quoted in notes.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter corresponds to Bd. 3.59; only verse numbers from that chapter are quoted in notes.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यविजयी भूतः प्रसादाच्छूलिनः स च । गीर्वाणा विजिताः सर्वे रामस्य गृहिणी हृता
verses.transliteration: trailokyavijayī bhūtaḥ prasādācchūlinaḥ sa ca / gīrvāṇā vijitāḥ sarve rāmasya gṛhiṇī hṛtā
verses.translation: Varuna's wife was the daughter of the ocean and was called "Sunodevi". She had two sons Kali and Vaidya and a daughter Surasundarl.
verses.hindi: नमस्कार करते हैं। है पट्टिश के धारण करने वाले, चर्म एवं विभूति से विभूषित तुम्हें हमारा नमस्कार
verses.wordMeaning: Varuna's wife was the daughter of the ocean and was called "Sunodevi". She had two sons Kali and Vaidya and a daughter Surasundarl.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varuna's wife was the daughter of the ocean and was called "Sunodevi". She had two sons Kali and Vaidya and a daughter Surasundarl.

verses.sanskrit: वारितः कुम्भकर्णेन सीतां मोचय मोचय । विभीषणेन वै पापो मन्दोदर्या पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: vāritaḥ kumbhakarṇena sītāṃ mocaya mocaya / vibhīṣaṇena vai pāpo mandodaryā punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: Kali had two very powerful sons (namely): Jaya and Vijaya. Vaidya too had two sons of great strength, viz. Ghrni and Muni.
verses.hindi: नमोस्तु ते देव हिरण्यरूप नमो5स्तु ते देव हिरण्यनाभ । नमोस्तु ते नेत्रसहस्मचित्र नमो5स्तु ते देव हिरण्यरेतः (१४७ “ नमोस्तु ते देंब हिरण्यवर्ण नमोस्तु ते देव हिरण्यगर्भ ।
verses.wordMeaning: Kali had two very powerful sons (namely): Jaya and Vijaya. Vaidya too had two sons of great strength, viz. Ghrni and Muni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kali had two very powerful sons (namely): Jaya and Vijaya. Vaidya too had two sons of great strength, viz. Ghrni and Muni.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं जितः कार्तवीर्येण रैणुकेयेन सो ऽपि च । स रामो रामभद्रेण तस्य संख्ये कथं जयः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ jitaḥ kārtavīryeṇa raiṇukeyena so 'pi ca / sa rāmo rāmabhadreṇa tasya saṃkhye kathaṃ jayaḥ
verses.translation: When the subjects became desirous of eating, they ate each other. Devouring each other, they perished.
verses.hindi: नमोस्तु ते देव हिरण्यचीर नमोःस्तु ते देव हिरण्यदायिने ध४८
verses.wordMeaning: When the subjects became desirous of eating, they ate each other. Devouring each other, they perished.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the subjects became desirous of eating, they ate each other. Devouring each other, they perished.

verses.sanskrit: रावण उवाच: वानरैश्च नरैरृक्षैर्वराहैश्च निरायुधैः । देवासुरसमूहैश्च न जितो ऽहं कदाचन
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇa uvāca: vānaraiśca narairṛkṣairvarāhaiśca nirāyudhaiḥ / devāsurasamūhaiśca na jito 'haṃ kadācana
verses.translation: Kali begot ofSura (a son). That son of his is remembered as Mada. Himsa, the daughter of Tvastr, was the eldest wife of Kali. She was known as Nikfti (too).
verses.hindi: नमोस्तु ते देव हिरण्यमालिने नमोउस्तु ने देव हिरण्यवाहिने । नमोस्तु ते देव हिरण्यवत्मंने नमोस्तु ते भेरवनादनादिने .
verses.wordMeaning: Kali begot ofSura (a son). That son of his is remembered as Mada. Himsa, the daughter of Tvastr, was the eldest wife of Kali. She was known as Nikfti (too).
verses.commentary: Sense: Kali begot ofSura (a son). That son of his is remembered as Mada. Himsa, the daughter of Tvastr, was the eldest wife of Kali. She was known as Nikfti (too).

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: सुग्रीवहनुमद्भ्यां च कुमुदेनाङ्गदेन च । एतैरन्यैः सहायैश्च रामचन्द्रेण वै जितः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sugrīvahanumadbhyāṃ ca kumudenāṅgadena ca / etairanyaiḥ sahāyaiśca rāmacandreṇa vai jitaḥ
verses.translation: She bore four other man-eating sons to Kali, viz. Naka, the famous Vighna, Sadrama and Vidhama.
verses.hindi: नमो5स्तु ते भेरवबेगवेग नमोस्तु ते शंकर नीलकण्ठ ।
verses.wordMeaning: She bore four other man-eating sons to Kali, viz. Naka, the famous Vighna, Sadrama and Vidhama.
verses.commentary: Sense: She bore four other man-eating sons to Kali, viz. Naka, the famous Vighna, Sadrama and Vidhama.

verses.sanskrit: रामचन्द्रेण पौलस्त्यो हतः संख्ये महाबलः । वनं भग्नं हताः शूराः प्रभञ्जनसुतेन च
verses.transliteration: rāmacandreṇa paulastyo hataḥ saṃkhye mahābalaḥ / vanaṃ bhagnaṃ hatāḥ śūrāḥ prabhañjanasutena ca
verses.translation: Among them Vighna was devoid of head; Naka had no body; Sadrama was single-handed; and Vidhama had a single foot.
verses.hindi: एवं संस्तृयमानस्तु व्यक्तो भूत्वा महासतिः। भाति देवों महायोगी सुर्यकोटिसमप्रभ: १५१ अभिभाष्यस्तदा हृष्टो महादेवों महेश्वरः । वक्‍त्रकोटिसहुल्न ण ग्रसमान इवास्बरस् ॥५२ , एकग्रीवस्त्वेकजटों नानाभूषणभूषितः । नाचारत्नावचित्राड्रों नानामाल्यानुलेपन:  9 ््फफरफर छरछ ॒ ॒॒रऑरऑढररऑझउ्जछ नननन्‍ानााासससससससॉअकीरॉसस ॉनॉ5पपाघपपप+++++ है । तुम रुद्र हो, पिनाकपाणि हो, सायक तथा चक्र धारण करने वाले हो, तुम्हें हमारा नमस्कार है। हे भस्म से विभूषित अंगों वाले ! कामदेव के शरीर को नष्ट करने वाले ! तुम्हें हम नमस्कार करते हैं। देव ! तुम स्वणिम वस्त्र धारण करने बाले हो, हिरण्यंबाहु हों  है हिरण्यरूप, तुम्हें हमारा बारम्बार नमस्कार है,
verses.wordMeaning: Among them Vighna was devoid of head; Naka had no body; Sadrama was single-handed; and Vidhama had a single foot.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among them Vighna was devoid of head; Naka had no body; Sadrama was single-handed; and Vidhama had a single foot.

verses.sanskrit: रावणस्य सुतो जन्ये हतश्चाक्षकुमारकः । आयामो रक्षसां भीमः सम्पिष्टो वानरेण तु
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya suto janye hataścākṣakumārakaḥ / āyāmo rakṣasāṃ bhīmaḥ sampiṣṭo vānareṇa tu
verses.translation: Sadrama's wife was remembered as Putana. She had Tamasic qualities. Revat! was the wife of Vidhama. Their sons were in thousands.
verses.hindi: हे हिरण्यनाभ ! तम्हें हम नमस्कार करते हैं। है सहस्रों नेत्रों से विचित्र आकृति वाले, हिरण्यरेता देव ! तुम्हें हमारा नमस्कार है, नमस्कार है ।४४-४७। है देव ! तुम हिरण्य के समान वर्णवाले हो, हिरण्यगर्भ हो । है देव ! तुम हिरण्य का चीर धारंण करने वाले हो, हिरण्प दान करने वाले हो, तुम्हें हम नमस्कार करते हैं । हें हिरण्य की माला धारण करने बालें देव  तुम्हें हमारा नमस्कार है, देव ! तुम हिरण्यवाही हो, तुम्हें हम
verses.wordMeaning: Sadrama's wife was remembered as Putana. She had Tamasic qualities. Revat! was the wife of Vidhama. Their sons were in thousands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sadrama's wife was remembered as Putana. She had Tamasic qualities. Revat! was the wife of Vidhama. Their sons were in thousands.

verses.sanskrit: एवं रामायणे वृत्ते सीतामोक्षे कृते सति । अयोध्यां तु गते रामे हनुमान्स महाकपिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ rāmāyaṇe vṛtte sītāmokṣe kṛte sati / ayodhyāṃ tu gate rāme hanumānsa mahākapiḥ
verses.translation: Sakuni was the wife of Naka and AyomukhI was the wife of Vighna. Raksasas of huge heads roaming about at dawn and dusk (were born of them).
verses.hindi: नमस्कार करते हैं। है देव ! तुम हिरण्यवर्श्मा हो, अतिभीषण नाद करने बाले तुम्हें हमारा नमस्कार है, नमस्कार है। है भीषणवेगशाली ! शंकर ! नीलकण्ठ ! तुम्हें हमारा नमस्कार है। है दिव्य सह बाहु धारण करने वाले ! नृत्य एवं वाद्य को पसन्द करने वाले ! तुम्हें हमारा बारम्बार तमस्कार है ।४५-४०। इस प्रकार है स्तुति किये जाने पर महाबुद्धिमान्, कोटि सूर्य के समान कान्ति वाले, महायोगी भगवान् प्रकट हुए  उस समय प्रसन्‍्नचित्त महेश्वर महादेव प्राथियों की ओर मुख कर कुछ बोलते हुए शतकोटि मुर्खों द्वारा आकाश को निगलते हुए से शोभित हो रहे थे । उस समय भंगवान् पिनाकपाणि अति शोभायुत हो रहे थे। उनके एकमात्र कण्ठ था जटा एक थी, शरीर विविध आभूषणों से विभूषित था, विविध रत्नों से अज्ों की.शोभा
verses.wordMeaning: Sakuni was the wife of Naka and AyomukhI was the wife of Vighna. Raksasas of huge heads roaming about at dawn and dusk (were born of them).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sakuni was the wife of Naka and AyomukhI was the wife of Vighna. Raksasas of huge heads roaming about at dawn and dusk (were born of them).

verses.sanskrit: कैलासाख्यं गतः शैलं प्रणामाय महेशितुः । तिष्ठ तिष्ठेत्यसौ प्रोक्तो नन्दिना वानरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kailāsākhyaṃ gataḥ śailaṃ praṇāmāya maheśituḥ / tiṣṭha tiṣṭhetyasau prokto nandinā vānarottamaḥ
verses.translation: The sons of Revat! and Putana are remembered by the name of Nairrtas. All these Raksasas were evil demons known as Grahas. They particularly harassed children (by haunting them). With the permission of Brahma, lord Skanda became their overlord.
verses.hindi: ४२४ द वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Revat! and Putana are remembered by the name of Nairrtas. All these Raksasas were evil demons known as Grahas. They particularly harassed children (by haunting them). With the permission of Brahma, lord Skanda became their overlord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Revat! and Putana are remembered by the name of Nairrtas. All these Raksasas were evil demons known as Grahas. They particularly harassed children (by haunting them). With the permission of Brahma, lord Skanda became their overlord.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यायुतस्त्वं हि राक्षसानां वधेन हि । भैरवस्य सभा नूनं न द्रष्टव्या त्वया कपे
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāyutastvaṃ hi rākṣasānāṃ vadhena hi / bhairavasya sabhā nūnaṃ na draṣṭavyā tvayā kape
verses.translation: Brhaspati's sister was a noble lady (named) Yogasiddha. Observing celibacy and being detached, she roamed over the whole universe.
verses.hindi: व्यालयज्ञोपवीती च सुराणामभयंकरः । दुष्दुभिस्वननिर्धोषषर्जन्यनिनदोपमः ॥॥ अय॑ मे दक्षिणों बाहुब्ंह्मा लोकपितामहः । बामो बाहुश्व मे विष्णुनित्यं युद्धेषु तिष्ठति ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Brhaspati's sister was a noble lady (named) Yogasiddha. Observing celibacy and being detached, she roamed over the whole universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhaspati's sister was a noble lady (named) Yogasiddha. Observing celibacy and being detached, she roamed over the whole universe.

verses.sanskrit: हनुमान् उवाच: नन्दिनाथ हरं पृच्छ पातकस्योपशान्तिदम् । पापो ऽहं प्लवगो यस्मात् संजातः कारणान्तरात्
verses.transliteration: hanumān uvāca: nandinātha haraṃ pṛccha pātakasyopaśāntidam / pāpo 'haṃ plavago yasmāt saṃjātaḥ kāraṇāntarāt
verses.translation: She became the wife of the eighth of the Vasus, vizi Prabhasa. Visvakarma, the creator of arts and crafts was born as her son.
verses.hindi: यदि प्रीति: समुत्पन्ना यदि देयो बरश्न नो । भक्तिभंवतु नो नित्य॑ त्वयि देव सुरेश्वर १६०
verses.wordMeaning: She became the wife of the eighth of the Vasus, vizi Prabhasa. Visvakarma, the creator of arts and crafts was born as her son.
verses.commentary: Sense: She became the wife of the eighth of the Vasus, vizi Prabhasa. Visvakarma, the creator of arts and crafts was born as her son.

verses.sanskrit: नन्द्युवाच: रुद्रदेहोद्भवा किं ते न श्रुता भूतले स्थिता । श्रवणाज्जन्मजनितं द्विगुणं कीर्तनाद् व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: nandyuvāca: rudradehodbhavā kiṃ te na śrutā bhūtale sthitā / śravaṇājjanmajanitaṃ dviguṇaṃ kīrtanād vrajet
verses.translation: (He was known as) Tvastr. He created many forms. He was the grandson of Dharma. He was liberal-minded. He was the creator of thousands of arts and crafts. He was the Architect of Devas.
verses.hindi: चित्र विजित्र हो रही थी, शरीर पर विविध प्रकार के पुष्प चन्दन सुशोभित हो रहे थे । वृषभ पर समासीन थे, हाथ में शुल धारण किये थे, दण्ड एवं कृष्णमृग का चमं धारण किये कपाल लिये हुए थे। उस समय उनकी आकृति अतिघोर थी, सप का यज्ञोपवीत धारण किया था; परु ऐसा स्वरूप होते हुए भी वे भोषण तथा गम्भीर थे । उस समय शद्भूर ने भीषण अट्वहास किया जिससे आकाझ्षमण्डल व्याप्त हो गया ।१५१-५५। महात्मा शंकर के उसः भीषण नाद से हम लोग भयभीत हो गये । तदनन्‍्तर महायोगी शंकर ने कहा, देवताओं में श्रेष्ठ ! मैं तुम दोनों पर प्रसश्त हूं । भय को छोड़कर मेरी महामाया को देखों, पूवंकाल में तुम दोनों सनातन पुरुष मेरे शरीर से ही उत्पन्न हुए हो। यह लोकपितामह ब्रह्मा मेरे दाहिने हाथ हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: (He was known as) Tvastr. He created many forms. He was the grandson of Dharma. He was liberal-minded. He was the creator of thousands of arts and crafts. He was the Architect of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He was known as) Tvastr. He created many forms. He was the grandson of Dharma. He was liberal-minded. He was the creator of thousands of arts and crafts. He was the Architect of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिंशज्जन्मार्जितं पापं नश्येद् रेवावगाहनात् । तस्मात् त्वं नर्मदातीरं गत्वा चर तपो महत्
verses.transliteration: triṃśajjanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ naśyed revāvagāhanāt / tasmāt tvaṃ narmadātīraṃ gatvā cara tapo mahat
verses.translation: He made aerial chariots for all the Devas. Human beings
verses.hindi: और यह नित्य युद्ध में स्थित रहने वाले विष्ण मेरे बाएँ हाथ हैं। मैं तुम दोनों पर अति प्रसन्न हूँ और मनोअभिलाषित वरदान दे रहा हैँ । शिव की ऐसी बातें सुनकर निष्पाप महात्मा ब्रह्मा, विष्णु अति प्रसन्‍्त मन से शिव के चरणों पर बारम्बार प्रणत हुए और बोले  देव ! यदि सचमृच हम पर आपकी प्रीति उत्पन्न हुई है और वरदान देने के लिए प्रस्तुत हैं तो सुरेश्वर ! आपमें हमारी भक्ति सबंदा बनी रहे ।१५६-६०।॥
verses.wordMeaning: He made aerial chariots for all the Devas. Human beings
verses.commentary: Sense: He made aerial chariots for all the Devas. Human beings

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाहसुतो ऽप्येवं नन्दिनोक्तं निशम्य च । प्रयातो नर्मदातीरम् और्व्यादक्षिणसङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvāhasuto 'pyevaṃ nandinoktaṃ niśamya ca / prayāto narmadātīram aurvyādakṣiṇasaṅgamam
verses.translation: Tvastr's wife was the famous daughter of Prahlada and was the sister of Virocana and the mother of Trisiras
verses.hindi: भगवान् बोले--महाभाग्यशाली ! जेसा तुम दोनों कह रहे हो, वैसा ही हो, विविध प्रकार की प्रजाओं की सृष्टि करते जाओ । भगवान् शंकर इतना कहकर वहीं अन्तहित हो गये । मैंने उन योगी क्षकर के प्रभाव का यह वर्णन तुम लोगों को सुना दिया उन्हीं भगवान् ने इस समस्त चराचर जगत् की एतद्विरूपमज्ञातमव्यक्तं शिवसंज्ञितम्। अचिन्त्यं तददृश्यं च पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः
verses.wordMeaning: Tvastr's wife was the famous daughter of Prahlada and was the sister of Virocana and the mother of Trisiras
verses.commentary: Sense: Tvastr's wife was the famous daughter of Prahlada and was the sister of Virocana and the mother of Trisiras

verses.sanskrit: दध्यौ सुदक्षिणे देवं विरूपाक्षं त्रिशूलिनम् । जटामुकुटसंयुक्तं व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनम्
verses.transliteration: dadhyau sudakṣiṇe devaṃ virūpākṣaṃ triśūlinam / jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyuktaṃ vyālayajñopavītinam
verses.translation: Maya, the son of the intelligent preceptor of Devas in craftsmanship of all kinds, is remembered as Visvakarma also
verses.hindi: तस्मै देवाधिपत्याय नमस्कार प्रयुझज्वहे । येन सुक्ष्ममचिन्त्यं च पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः .
verses.wordMeaning: Maya, the son of the intelligent preceptor of Devas in craftsmanship of all kinds, is remembered as Visvakarma also
verses.commentary: Sense: Maya, the son of the intelligent preceptor of Devas in craftsmanship of all kinds, is remembered as Visvakarma also

verses.sanskrit: भस्मोपचितसर्वाङ्गं डमरुस्वरनादितम् । उमार्द्धाङ्गहरं शान्तं गोनाथासनसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmopacitasarvāṅgaṃ ḍamarusvaranāditam / umārddhāṅgaharaṃ śāntaṃ gonāthāsanasaṃsthitam
verses.translation: His younger sister, the daughter of Tva lt r (originally) famous by the name of Surenu, became the wife of the Sun and was well known as Samjna.
verses.hindi: महादेव नमस्तेःस्तु महेश्वर नमोःस्तु ते । सुरासुरवरश्रेष्ठ मनोहंस नमोषस्तु ते ॥........ ७४६५ एतच्छ त्वा गताः सर्वे सुराः स्व स्व॑ निवेशनम् । नभस्कारं प्रयुअजाना: शंकराय महात्मने
verses.wordMeaning: His younger sister, the daughter of Tva lt r (originally) famous by the name of Surenu, became the wife of the Sun and was well known as Samjna.
verses.commentary: Sense: His younger sister, the daughter of Tva lt r (originally) famous by the name of Surenu, became the wife of the Sun and was well known as Samjna.

verses.sanskrit: वत्सरान् सुबहून् यावद् उपासांचक्र ईश्वरम् । तावत्तुष्टो महादेव आजगाम सहोमया
verses.transliteration: vatsarān subahūn yāvad upāsāṃcakra īśvaram / tāvattuṣṭo mahādeva ājagāma sahomayā
verses.translation: Assuming the form of a mare, the noble lady went to the land of Kurus. The blessed lady bore two sons to the Sun who had assumed the form of a horse. She gave birth to them through nostrils. They were the twin gods, the Asvins Nasatya and Dasra. Both of them were the sons of Martanda (the Sun-god). ' v
verses.hindi: इमं स्तवं पठेद्चस्तु ईश्वरस्य महात्मनः । कामांश्व लभते सर्वान्पापेभ्यस्तु विमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Assuming the form of a mare, the noble lady went to the land of Kurus. The blessed lady bore two sons to the Sun who had assumed the form of a horse. She gave birth to them through nostrils. They were the twin gods, the Asvins Nasatya and Dasra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming the form of a mare, the noble lady went to the land of Kurus. The blessed lady bore two sons to the Sun who had assumed the form of a horse. She gave birth to them through nostrils. They were the twin gods, the Asvins Nasatya and Dasra.…

verses.sanskrit: उवाच मधुरां वाणीं मेघगम्भीरनिस्वनाम् । साधु साध्वित्य् उवाचेशः कष्टं वत्स त्वया कृतम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ meghagambhīranisvanām / sādhu sādhvity uvāceśaḥ kaṣṭaṃ vatsa tvayā kṛtam
verses.translation: Why is (the Sun) called Martanda by learned men? Why did she, in the form of a mare, give birth to them through the nostrils? We wish to know this. Please explain this to us who ask you.
verses.hindi: एतत्सवं सदा तेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णना । महादेवबप्रसादेन उकत॑ ब्रह्म सनातनम् १ इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते लिड्भरोड्रवस्तवों नाम पञ्चपञ्चाशोड्ध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: Why is (the Sun) called Martanda by learned men? Why did she, in the form of a mare, give birth to them through the nostrils? We wish to know this. Please explain this to us who ask you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Why is (the Sun) called Martanda by learned men? Why did she, in the form of a mare, give birth to them through the nostrils? We wish to know this. Please explain this to us who ask you.

verses.sanskrit: न च पूर्वं त्वया पापं कृतं रावणसंक्षये । स्वामिकार्यरतस्त्वं हि सिद्धो ऽसि मम दर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: na ca pūrvaṃ tvayā pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ rāvaṇasaṃkṣaye / svāmikāryaratastvaṃ hi siddho 'si mama darśanāt
verses.translation: Fora long time, the egg did not break (did not get hatched). It was broken open by Tvastr. On seeing it, Kas'yapa became sad as he feared that the foetus was killed.
verses.hindi: सृष्टि की है, हम लोग तो हेतुमात्र हैं। ये भगवान् स्वरूप रहित हैं, अज्ञात हैं, बव्यक्त हैं, लोक में उनकी 'शिव नाम से प्रसिद्धि है, वे अचिन्त्य हें, अदृश्य हैं, ज्ञान चक्ष पण्डितजन ही उन्हें देख सकते हैं। उन देवाधि- पति को हम नमस्कार करते हैं जिनके द्वारा ज्ञान चक्षु पण्डितजन सूक्ष्म एवं अचिन्त्य पदार्थों का दर्शन करते हैं। है महादेव ! तुम्हें हमारा नमस्कार है। महेश्वर ! हम तुम्हें तमस्कार करते हैं, सभी सुरासुरों में श्रेष्ठ !
verses.wordMeaning: Fora long time, the egg did not break (did not get hatched). It was broken open by Tvastr. On seeing it, Kas'yapa became sad as he feared that the foetus was killed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fora long time, the egg did not break (did not get hatched). It was broken open by Tvastr. On seeing it, Kas'yapa became sad as he feared that the foetus was killed.

verses.sanskrit: हनुमांश्च हरं दृष्ट्वा उमार्द्धाङ्गहरं स्थिरम् । साष्टाङ्गं प्रणतो ऽवोचज्जय शम्भो नमो ऽस्तु ते । जयान्धकविनाशाय जय गङ्गाशिरोधर
verses.transliteration: hanumāṃśca haraṃ dṛṣṭvā umārddhāṅgaharaṃ sthiram / sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇato 'vocajjaya śambho namo 'stu te / jayāndhakavināśāya jaya gaṅgāśirodhara
verses.translation: When the egg was broken into two parts, he looked into it and said to Tvastr, "This is certainly not an (ordinary)egg". (Then to the child he said) "O Sinless one, be Martanda".
verses.hindi: मनोहंस ! तुम्हें हमारा नमस्कार स्वीकार हो ।६१-६५ ! खूत बोले--इस प्रकार की बातें सुनकर सभी देव्गण महात्मा शंकर को नमस्कार करते हुए अपने-अपने वास-स्थान को चले गये ! जो मनुष्य महात्मा हंकर के इस उपयुक्त स्तोत्र का पांठ करता है, बह सभी मनोरथों को प्राप्त करता है तथा सभी पापों से विमुक्त होता है। इस प्रकार महामहिमामय सनातन ब्रह्म भगवान् विष्णु ने महादेव की कृपा से इन उपर्युक्त बातों की चर्चा की। और वह सब महेद्वर की पराक्रम
verses.wordMeaning: When the egg was broken into two parts, he looked into it and said to Tvastr, "This is certainly not an (ordinary)egg". (Then to the child he said) "O Sinless one, be Martanda".
verses.commentary: Sense: When the egg was broken into two parts, he looked into it and said to Tvastr, "This is certainly not an (ordinary)egg". (Then to the child he said) "O Sinless one, be Martanda".

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुतो महादेवो वरदो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । वरं प्रार्थय मे वत्स प्राणसम्भवसम्भव
