verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchana Karopanita-vitala was sung by Maruts in Svara-Mandala. That is Kalofianitd. Hence its presiding deity is Maruta. 7
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchana Karopanita-vitala was sung by Maruts in Svara-Mandala. That is Kalofianitd. Hence its presiding deity is Maruta. 7

verses.sanskrit: तावद्वृक्षसमारूढां स्त्रियं रक्ताम्बरावृताम् । रक्तमाल्यां तदा बालां रक्तचन्दनचर्चिताम् । रक्ताभरणशोभाढ्यां पाशहस्तां ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: tāvadvṛkṣasamārūḍhāṃ striyaṃ raktāmbarāvṛtām / raktamālyāṃ tadā bālāṃ raktacandanacarcitām / raktābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ pāśahastāṃ dadarśa ha
verses.translation: The Murcchana Suddha-madhyama originated in the Manu (ru?) desa.
verses.hindi: उत्पच्चन्त तथा ते व संप्राप्ते तु कलो युगे । नाधोयन्‍्ते तदा वेदाः शूद्रा धर्मार्थंकोविदाः
verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchana Suddha-madhyama originated in the Manu (ru?) desa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchana Suddha-madhyama originated in the Manu (ru?) desa.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्र्युवाच: संदेशं श्रूयतां विप्र यदि गच्छसि सङ्गमे । मद्भर्ता तिष्ठते तत्र शीघ्रमेव विसर्जय
verses.transliteration: stryuvāca: saṃdeśaṃ śrūyatāṃ vipra yadi gacchasi saṅgame / madbhartā tiṣṭhate tatra śīghrameva visarjaya
verses.translation: Since it moves along with the deer for the guidance of
verses.hindi: का सर्वथा अन्त हो जायगा। वे दुष्ट नृपतिगण दूसरे लोगों के रत्नों के छीननेबाले तथा दूसरों की स्त्रियों के साथ बलात्कार करने वाले होंगे। अधम में साहस दिखानेवाले वे दुरात्मा नृपति अति कामुक तथा विद्या- बुद्धि से सवंथा शून्य होगे। उस युगान्त के समय के पुरुष अपने केशों को बिखराये हुए चूल धारण करनेवाले होंगे, सोलह बर्ष से भी अल्प अवस्था में वे सन्तानोत्पत्ति करेंगे ।५५-४८। युगान्त के आने पर श्वेत दातों- वाले, अपने को जितेन्द्रिय प्रकट करनेवाले शुद्र लोग, मुण्डित शिर हो काषाय वस्त्र धारण कर धर्मकाये करेंगे। उस समय अन्न की चोरी करनेवाले तथा वस्त्र की चोरी करने वाले चोर होंगे, चोरों के घर में भी चोरी करने वाले तथा डाकुओं को भी लूटनेबाले लोग उत्पर्त होंगे । इस प्रकार बुद्धि एवं सत्कर्म के स्वंथा निबृत्त हो जाने पर सभी लोग अकमंण्य हों जायंगे, उस समय कीट पलंग, मूस और सर्पादि जीव भी मनुष्यों
verses.wordMeaning: Since it moves along with the deer for the guidance of
verses.commentary: Sense: Since it moves along with the deer for the guidance of

verses.sanskrit: एकाकिनी च ते भार्या तिष्ठते वनमध्यगा । इत्याकर्ण्य गतो विप्रः सङ्गमं सुरदुर्लभे
verses.transliteration: ekākinī ca te bhāryā tiṣṭhate vanamadhyagā / ityākarṇya gato vipraḥ saṅgamaṃ suradurlabhe
verses.translation: As the Murcchana is associated with hermitages and also with the various (human) voices of citizens, it is called Rajani due to its association with rajas (dust/atmosphere).
verses.hindi: को पीड़ित करेंगे ।५६-६१५१। सुभिक्ष, कल्याण, आरोग्य एबं सामथ्यें, ये सभी चीजें लोगों को दुलेभ हो जायेगी, ऐसे समय में जब कि सारा देश क्षुधा के कारण सन्तप्त एवं भयभीत रहेगा, उल्लू के समृह वहाँ निवास करंगे। इन दुःखों से पीड़ित कलियुग के मनुष्यों की अधिक से अधिक आयु सौ वर्ष को होगी, सभी वेद शास्त्र कहीं परु तो दिखाई पड़ेंगे, कहीं पर नहीं। धर्म कार्य के स्बंधा बिलोप हो जाने के कारण बन्ञों
verses.wordMeaning: As the Murcchana is associated with hermitages and also with the various (human) voices of citizens, it is called Rajani due to its association with rajas (dust/atmosphere).
verses.commentary: Sense: As the Murcchana is associated with hermitages and also with the various (human) voices of citizens, it is called Rajani due to its association with rajas (dust/atmosphere).

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षच्छायान्वितः कण्वो ब्राह्मणेनावलोकितः । उवाच तं प्रति तदा वचनं ब्राह्मणोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣacchāyānvitaḥ kaṇvo brāhmaṇenāvalokitaḥ / uvāca taṃ prati tadā vacanaṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ
verses.translation: The Tala (beating time) is known as having Satjlja as its deity. Hence Uttara-t&la is known first as well extended.
verses.hindi: की परम्परा नष्ट हो जायगी । उस समय गेरुआ वस्त्र धारणकर, बिना पढ़े-लिखे, कापालिक, धर्म की व्यवस्था देंगे, कोई वेदों का विक्रय करेगा तो कोई तीथ्थों का ।६२९-६५। इसी प्रकार अन्यान्य वर्णाश्रम धर्म के विरोधी पाषाण्डी उस कलियुग के आने पर उत्पन्न होंगे, उस समय ब्राह्मण लोग वेदशास्त्रों का अध्ययन छोड़ देंगे। “ धनश्चित्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो घ पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Tala (beating time) is known as having Satjlja as its deity. Hence Uttara-t&la is known first as well extended.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tala (beating time) is known as having Satjlja as its deity. Hence Uttara-t&la is known first as well extended.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच: वनान्तरे मया दृष्टा बाला कमललोचना । रक्ताम्बरधरा तन्वी रक्तचन्दनचर्चिता
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa uvāca: vanāntare mayā dṛṣṭā bālā kamalalocanā / raktāmbaradharā tanvī raktacandanacarcitā
verses.translation: Since it is after Apana (?), Uttarayana having Dha (Dhaivata) as the starting point, is the Murcchana the deities of which are Pitrs (manes), the deities (worshipped in) Sraddhas.
verses.hindi: घजन्ते ताश्वमेधेन राजानः शुद्रयोनयः । स्त्रीवर्ध योवर्ध कृत्वा हत्वा चैव परस्परम् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Since it is after Apana (?), Uttarayana having Dha (Dhaivata) as the starting point, is the Murcchana the deities of which are Pitrs (manes), the deities (worshipped in) Sraddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since it is after Apana (?), Uttarayana having Dha (Dhaivata) as the starting point, is the Murcchana the deities of which are Pitrs (manes), the deities (worshipped in) Sraddhas.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तमाल्या सुशोभाढ्या पाशहस्ता मृगेक्षणा । वृक्षारूढावदद्वाक्यं मद्भर्ता प्रेष्यतामिति
verses.transliteration: raktamālyā suśobhāḍhyā pāśahastā mṛgekṣaṇā / vṛkṣārūḍhāvadadvākyaṃ madbhartā preṣyatāmiti
verses.translation: The great sages worship the Fire-god with the Suddha- Sadja (pure Sa-) note; it should be known as $uddha-Sa<jljika.
verses.hindi: दृश्यन्ते नाभिदृश्यन्ते बेदाः कलियुगेडखिला: । उत्सीदन्ते तदा यज्ञाः केवला धर्मपीडिताः ७० तदा त्वल्पेन कालेन सिद्धि यास्यन्ति मानवाः । धन्या धर्म चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते द्विजसत्तमाः ७४७१ श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं धर्म ये चरन्त्यनसूथकाः । त्रेतायां बाधिको धर्मों द्वापरे मासिकः स्मृतः ॥ शुद्र लोग धर्म के पण्डित माने जायेंगे । शूद्र कुल में उत्पन्न होनेवाले राजा जोम अश्वमेध यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान नहीं करेंगे। उस कलियुग में प्रजावर्ग स्त्री हत्या, गोहत्या, परस्पर मारपीट एवं एक दूसरे का बंध करके किसी प्रकार जीवनयापन करता है। इन सब घोर पापों से होनेवाले दुःखों की अधिकता से लोग अल्पायु होते हैं देश का विनाश हो जाता है, अनेक प्रकार की व्याधियाँ, रुणणता, अज्ञान, ग्लानि, कृत्रिम सुख की
verses.wordMeaning: The great sages worship the Fire-god with the Suddha- Sadja (pure Sa-) note; it should be known as $uddha-Sa<jljika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great sages worship the Fire-god with the Suddha- Sadja (pure Sa-) note; it should be known as $uddha-Sa<jljika.

verses.sanskrit: कण्व उवाच: कस्मिन्स्थाने तु विप्रेन्द्र विद्यते मृगलोचना । कस्य सा केन कार्येण सर्वमेतद्वदाशु मे
verses.transliteration: kaṇva uvāca: kasminsthāne tu viprendra vidyate mṛgalocanā / kasya sā kena kāryeṇa sarvametadvadāśu me
verses.translation: It starts from the Pahcama note causing delight to the good people.
verses.hindi: अभिलाषा और तामसिक मनोवृत्ति,इन सब की कलियुग में प्रधानता कही गई है ६६-६८ श्रजावग्ग में गर्भहत्या का घोर पाप अन्धाधुन्ध होता है, इन्हीं सब घोर पापों के कारण उस युग में आयु, बल, एवं . रूप, इन सब का विनाश हो जाता है। उस समय बनेक दुःखों से पीड़ित लोगों की अधिक आयु सौ वर्ष की होती है। उस घोर कलिकाल में सभी वेद शास्त्र कहीं तो दिखाई पड़ेंगे और कहीं नहीं। घोर
verses.wordMeaning: It starts from the Pahcama note causing delight to the good people.
verses.commentary: Sense: It starts from the Pahcama note causing delight to the good people.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच: सङ्गमाद् अर्धक्रोशे सा उद्यानान्ते हि विद्यते । वचनाद् ब्रह्मणस्यैषा न ज्ञाता पार्थिवेन तु
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa uvāca: saṅgamād ardhakrośe sā udyānānte hi vidyate / vacanād brahmaṇasyaiṣā na jñātā pārthivena tu
verses.translation: (Defective) That Murcchana which serpents of poiso¬ nous eyes do not approach and the serpent-deities become as it
verses.hindi: अधर्म के कारण यज्ञादि सत्कर्मों का विलोप हो जाता है। किन्तु उस युग में थोड़े समय में ही सिद्धि प्राप्त करते हैं, उस युगान्त में धर्मांचण करनेवाने उत्तम द्विजगण धश्य हैं, जो श्रुतियों एवं स्मृत्तियों से अनुमोदित कर्म का बिना किसी प्रकार की निन्‍दा किये अनुष्ठान करते हैं। भेता युग में एक वर्ष में प्राप्त होनेवाला जो धर्मफल है वह द्वापर युग में एक मास में प्राप्त किया जाता है, किन्तु उसी धर्मफल को अपनी शक्ति के अनुरूप कलियूग में अनुष्ठान करने पर मनुष्य केवल एक दिन में प्राप्त करता है। यह कलियुग की अवस्था है। अब सम्ध्यांश का वर्णन मुझसे सुनिये ।६९-७२। प्रत्येक युगों में सिद्धियाँ पृव युग की अपेक्षा पिछले यूग में अपने तीन चरणों से हीन हो जाती हैं, अर्थात् केवल एक चरण मात्र विद्यमान रहती हैं इसी प्रकार युम के स्वभाव से उसकी सिद्धियाँ सन्ध्या में एकपाद रहती हैं और सन्ध्यांश में सन्ध्या के स्वभाव
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) That Murcchana which serpents of poiso¬ nous eyes do not approach and the serpent-deities become as it
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) That Murcchana which serpents of poiso¬ nous eyes do not approach and the serpent-deities become as it

verses.sanskrit: तदा स कण्वभूपालः स्वकं दूतं समादिशत् । कण्व उवाच: गच्छ त्वं पृच्छतां तां क्वागता क्वच गमिष्यसि । प्रेषितस्त्वरितो दूतो गतो नारीसमीपतः
verses.transliteration: tadā sa kaṇvabhūpālaḥ svakaṃ dūtaṃ samādiśat / kaṇva uvāca: gaccha tvaṃ pṛcchatāṃ tāṃ kvāgatā kvaca gamiṣyasi / preṣitastvarito dūto gato nārīsamīpataḥ
verses.translation: The Murcchana with which Kinnaras (sing) in imitation of birds, is the excellent ( Ultama) MQrcchand. Its deity is the Lord of Birds (Garutfa).
verses.hindi: एवं संध्यांशके काले संप्राप्ते तु युगान्तिके  तेषां शास्ता हासाधूनां भुगूणां निधनोत्यितः
verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchana with which Kinnaras (sing) in imitation of birds, is the excellent ( Ultama) MQrcchand. Its deity is the Lord of Birds (Garutfa).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchana with which Kinnaras (sing) in imitation of birds, is the excellent ( Ultama) MQrcchand. Its deity is the Lord of Birds (Garutfa).

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षस्थां ददृशो बालामुवाच नृपसत्तम । मन्नाथः पृच्छति त्वां तु कासि त्वं क्व गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣasthāṃ dadṛśo bālāmuvāca nṛpasattama / mannāthaḥ pṛcchati tvāṃ tu kāsi tvaṃ kva gamiṣyasi
verses.translation: By the sound of Gandhara Raga, the earth (or cow?) is held in support. Hence it is called Visuddha-Gandharl (of pure Go). And Gandharva is its presiding deity.
verses.hindi: समाः स॒ विशति पूर्णाः पयंटन्वे वसुंधराम् । आचकर्ष स वे सेनां सवाजिरथकुरजराम् ७७ नात्यर्थ धामिका ये च तान्सर्बान्हन्ति स्वंश: । वर्णव्यत्यासजातांश्र ये च तानृपजीबिनः (८० उदीच्यान्मध्यदेशांश्व पावंतीयांस्तथव च । प्राच्यास्प्रतीच्यांश्व तथा विन्ध्यप्रष्ठापरान्तिकान॒
verses.wordMeaning: By the sound of Gandhara Raga, the earth (or cow?) is held in support. Hence it is called Visuddha-Gandharl (of pure Go). And Gandharva is its presiding deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the sound of Gandhara Raga, the earth (or cow?) is held in support. Hence it is called Visuddha-Gandharl (of pure Go). And Gandharva is its presiding deity.

verses.sanskrit: कन्योवाच: गुरुरात्मवतां शास्ता राजा शास्ता दुरात्मनाम् । इह प्रच्छन् न पापानां शास्ता वैवस्वतो यमः
verses.transliteration: kanyovāca: gururātmavatāṃ śāstā rājā śāstā durātmanām / iha pracchan na pāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ
verses.translation: The Murcchana Uttara-Gandharl is so called as it was created after Gandhara. Its (presiding) deities are Vasus.
verses.hindi: तुषारान्वबेरांश्वीनाञजशुलिकान्दरदान्खसान । लम्पाकानथ केतांश्च किरातानां च जातयः.
verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchana Uttara-Gandharl is so called as it was created after Gandhara. Its (presiding) deities are Vasus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchana Uttara-Gandharl is so called as it was created after Gandhara. Its (presiding) deities are Vasus.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या च संजाता मृगरूपधरद्विजात् । मया युक्तो ऽपि ते राजा मुक्तस्तीर्थप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā ca saṃjātā mṛgarūpadharadvijāt / mayā yukto 'pi te rājā muktastīrthaprabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: The Satfja Murcchana first approached god Brahma (Pitamaha). Hence its greatness. Its deity is the Fire-god.
verses.hindi: माधवस्य तु सोंडशेन देवस्य हि विजज्िवान् । पूर्वजन्मविधिज्ञेश्र प्रसितिर्नाम वीयबानू... गोत्रेण वे चल्रमसः पूर्वे कलियगे प्रभुः । द्वात्रिशेड््युदिते वर्षे प्रकानते विशात समाः
verses.wordMeaning: The Satfja Murcchana first approached god Brahma (Pitamaha). Hence its greatness. Its deity is the Fire-god.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Satfja Murcchana first approached god Brahma (Pitamaha). Hence its greatness. Its deity is the Fire-god.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धक्रोशान्तरान् मध्ये ब्रह्महत्या न संविशेत् । सोमनाथप्रभावो ऽयं वाराणस्याः समः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ardhakrośāntarān madhye brahmahatyā na saṃviśet / somanāthaprabhāvo 'yaṃ vārāṇasyāḥ samaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The Murcchana called Mandasastha is divine and extensive. The names of its equalities cannot be described. Its deity is Paflcama (the note Pa).
verses.hindi: से एक पाद शेष रहती हैं। इस नियम के अनुसार स्वायम्भव मम्वन्तर के आदि कलियुग के सन्ध्यांश के समुपस्थित होने पर उन असत्पुरुषों को दण्ड देने वाला भूगु वंशियों की मृत्यु के उपरान्त उसी वंश में उत्पन्न हुआ, चन्द्रमा के गोत्र का प्रमति नामक राजा भगवान् विष्णु के अंश से उत्पन्न होता है, वह स्मस्त पृथ्वी मण्डल पर संकड़ों सहस्न शस्त्रास्त्रधारी ब्राह्मणों को साथ लेकर एक विशाल वाहिनी की
verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchana called Mandasastha is divine and extensive. The names of its equalities cannot be described. Its deity is Paflcama (the note Pa).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchana called Mandasastha is divine and extensive. The names of its equalities cannot be described. Its deity is Paflcama (the note Pa).

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ त्वं प्रेष्यतां राजा शीघ्रम् अत्र न संशयः । गतो भृत्यस्ततः शीघ्रं वेपमानः सुविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: gaccha tvaṃ preṣyatāṃ rājā śīghram atra na saṃśayaḥ / gato bhṛtyastataḥ śīghraṃ vepamānaḥ suvihvalaḥ
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: सहायता से पूरे बीस वर्ष तक भ्रमणकर सहम्रों म्लेच्छों का संहार करता है ।७३-७८५। सभी स्थलों पर जाने वाले उस अमित तेतस्वी ने उन शूद्र कुल में उत्पन्न होने वाले राजाओं को मारकर सभो प्रकार के फैले हुए पाषण्डों का निराकरण कर जो लोग धर्म में अधिक विध्वास करने वाले नहीं थे उन सब को एक दम से विनष्ट करता है । इसके अतिरिक्त वर्णसंकर एवं उनके सहायकों का भी समूल विनाश कर देता है ।७६-८०। उदीच्य, मध्यदेशीय, पावंतीय, प्राच्य, प्रतीच्य तथा विन्ध्यगिरि के पृष्ठ पर बसने वाले,
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: समस्तं कथयामास यद्वृत्तं हि पुरातनम् । तस्य वाक्यादसौ राजा पतितो धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: samastaṃ kathayāmāsa yadvṛttaṃ hi purātanam / tasya vākyādasau rājā patito dharaṇītale
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: चीन, शूलिक, दरद, खस, लम्बक, केत और किरात प्रभृति स्लेच्छ जातियों को, वह सभी भूतों से न पर।जित होने वाला, म्लेच्छों का धोर शत्र प्रमिति अपनी अपनी सेना को साथ ले विनष्ट करता है
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: भृत्य उवाच: कस्मात् त्वं शोचसे नाथ पूर्वोपात्तं शुभाशुभम् । इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य राजा वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: bhṛtya uvāca: kasmāt tvaṃ śocase nātha pūrvopāttaṃ śubhāśubham / ityākarṇya vacastasya rājā vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमा के गोत्र में उत्पन्न, विष्ण का अंशीभूत, पूव॑जन्म की विधियों को जानने वाला, प्रमिति नामक परम पराक्रमी वह अमित तेजस्वी प्रभ अपनी बत्तीस वर्ष की अवस्था में बीस बषं तक अनवरत पथ्वी प्रदक्षिणा परस्परनिमित्तेन कोपेनाइकस्मिकेन तु ८७ स साधयित्वा वृबलास्थायशस्तानधामिकान् । गड्भायमुनयोमंध्ये निष्ठां प्राप्तः सहानुगः ..
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणत्यागं करिष्यामि सोमनाथसमीपतः । शीघ्रमानीयतां वह्निरिन्धनानि बहूनि च
verses.transliteration: prāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi somanāthasamīpataḥ / śīghramānīyatāṃ vahnirindhanāni bahūni ca
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: ततो व्यतोते तस्मिस्तु अमात्ये सत्यसेनिके । उत्साद्य पारथ्थिवान्सवन्स्लिच्छांश्चेब सहल्नशः ८६ तत्र संध्यांशके काले संप्राप्ते तु युगान्तिके । स्थितास्वल्पावशिष्टासु प्रजास्विह क्वचित्ववचित् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: आनीतं तत्क्षणात्सर्वं भृत्यैस् तद्वशवर्तिभिः । स्नानं कृत्वा शुभे तोये सङ्गमे पापनाशने
verses.transliteration: ānītaṃ tatkṣaṇātsarvaṃ bhṛtyais tadvaśavartibhiḥ / snānaṃ kṛtvā śubhe toye saṅgame pāpanāśane
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: अप्रग्रहास्ततस्ता वे लोकचेष्टास्तु वुन्दशः । उर्पाहिसन्ति चान्योनय॑ प्रपद्यचन्ते परस्परम् ६ ९ अराजके युगववशात्संशये समुपस्थिते । प्रजास्ताः व॑ ततः सर्वा: परस्परभयादिता: ९२ व्याकुलाश्र परिभ्रान्तास्त्यवत्वा दारान्गुह्रणि च्। स्वान्प्राणान्समवेक्षन्तों निष्कारुण्या: सुदु:ःखिता:॥॥€३ नष्टे श्रौते स्मृते धर्में परस्परहृतास्तदा । निर्मर्यादा निराक़न्दा निस्‍्नेहा निरपत्रपाः ' ६४ नष्टे वर्ष प्रतिहता हस्वकाः पन्चाविशका: । हित्वा दारांभ्र पुत्रांश्व विषादव्याकुलेन्द्रिया: ९५ अनावृष्टिहताश्चव वार्तामुत्सुज्य दुःखिता: । प्रत्यन्तांस्तान्निषेवन्ते हित्वा जनरदानस्वकानू
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चितः परया भक्त्या सोमनाथो महीभृता । त्रिःप्रदक्षिणतः कृत्वा ज्वलन्तं जातवेदसम्
verses.transliteration: arcitaḥ parayā bhaktyā somanātho mahībhṛtā / triḥpradakṣiṇataḥ kṛtvā jvalantaṃ jātavedasam
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: सरितः सागरान्पान्तेवन्ते पर्वतांस्तदा । मधुमासेमू लफलबंतेंयन्ति सुदुःखिताः .
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टः कण्वराजासौ हृदि ध्यात्वा जनार्दनम् । पीताम्बरधरं देवं जटामुकुटधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭaḥ kaṇvarājāsau hṛdi dhyātvā janārdanam / pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: कर सभी जीव जन्तुओं एबं मनुष्यों का विनाश करता है और इस प्रकार अपने प्रचण्ड कम द्वारा समस्त प्रृथ्वी मण्डल को पराक्रम शून्य कर निर्मित्त वश एवं आकस्मिक क्रोध से उन अधामिक शूद्रों को दण्ड दे गज्ञा और यमुना के मध्य भाग में अपने अनुगामियों समेत शरीर त्याग करता है ।६५-८८। तदुपरास्त उस सन्ध्यांश काल में सहस्रों शूद्रवंशीय राजाओं एवं सभी म्लेच्छों को ध्वस्त कर सैनिकों एवं मंत्रियों के समेत प्रमिति के स्वगंस्थ हो जाने पर यत्र तत्र स्थान स्थान पर थोड़ी संख्या में प्रजाएँ शेष बच रहती हैं। किसी शासक के अभाव में बिना नियन्त्रण के उन सभी लोगों की चेष्टाएँ एक दूसरे के मारने लूटने खसोटने की ओर हो जाती हैं। इस प्रकार उस युगान्त में अराजकता के समय जब कि जीवन का संशय उपस्थित हो जाता है, सभी गैंग एक दूसरे के भय से विह्नल एवं परिभ्रान्त होकर घर द्वार स्त्री बच्चों को छोड़कर अपने अपने प्राणों
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: श्रिया युक्तं सुपर्णस्थं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् । सुरारिसूदनं दध्यौ सुगतिर् मे भवत्विति
verses.transliteration: śriyā yuktaṃ suparṇasthaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam / surārisūdanaṃ dadhyau sugatir me bhavatviti
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: का ध्यान करते हये इधर उधर भटकते हुए करुणा से रहित होकर अति दुश्ख का अनुभव करते हैं ।८६-६ ३। उस समय श्रौत स्मात॑ धर्मों के विनष्ट हो जाने पर मर्यादा, दया, लज्जा एवं स्नेह रहित सारे लोग एक दूसरे से युद्ध करते हुये मृत्यु प्राप्त करते हैं। उस समय के लोग लघ॒काय के तथा पचीस वर्ष की छोटी उम्न वाले होते हैं, वे अपने पुत्र स्त्री प्रभूति परिवार के लोगों को छोड़कर विषाद ९ससे व्याकुलेन्द्रिय रहते हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: पपात पुष्पवृष्टिस्तु साधु साधु नृपात्मज । आश्चर्यमतुलं दृष्ट्वा निरीक्ष्य च परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: papāta puṣpavṛṣṭistu sādhu sādhu nṛpātmaja / āścaryamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirīkṣya ca parasparam
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: हैं। घोर अनावृष्टि से पीड़ित होकर वे जीविका की आशा छोड़ देते हैं और अपने अपने जनपदों को छोड़कर समीपस्थ देशों में निवास करते हैं। उस समय वे प्राणी नदियों, सागरों; जलप्राय स्थलों एवं पर्वतों पर अति दुःखित जीवन बिताते हुए मधु, मांश मुल तथा फलों से जीविका निर्वाहित करते हैं ए७० बॉयुंपुराणंयू..
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: मृतं तैः पावके भृत्यैर्हृदि ध्यात्वा गदाधरम् । विमानस्थास् ततः सर्वे संजाताः पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: mṛtaṃ taiḥ pāvake bhṛtyairhṛdi dhyātvā gadādharam / vimānasthās tataḥ sarve saṃjātāḥ pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: चौरवस्त्राजिनधरा निष्पत्ना निष्परिग्रहा:  वर्णाश्रमपरिभ्रष्ठाः संकरं घोरमास्थिताः.... दे: एता काष्ठामनृप्राप्ता अल्पशेषाः प्रजास्तथा । जराव्याधिक्षुधाविष्टा दुःखाप्निवेंदमागमन् ३९६ विचारणं तु निर्वेदात्साम्यावस्था विचारणात् । साम्यावस्थासु संबोधः संबोधाद्मंशीलता
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: निष्पापास्ते दिवं याताः सोमनाथप्रभावतः । ब्राह्मणे सङ्गमे तत्र ध्यायमाने वृषध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: niṣpāpāste divaṃ yātāḥ somanāthaprabhāvataḥ / brāhmaṇe saṅgame tatra dhyāyamāne vṛṣadhvajam
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: प्रवत्ते तु पुनर्स्तास्मस्ततः कृतयुगे तु वे। उत्पन्ना: कलिशिष्टास्तु कार्तंयुग्यः प्रजास्तदा तेषां सप्तर्षयो धर्म कथयन्तीतरेषु घ्। वर्णाश्रमाचारयुक्तः भोतः स्मार्तों द्विधा तु सः
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: सोमनाथप्रभावो ऽयं शृणुष्वैकमना विधिम् । अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां सर्वकालं रवेर्दिने
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: somanāthaprabhāvo 'yaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vidhim / aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ sarvakālaṃ raverdine
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: ततस्तेषु क्रियावत्सु वर्तन्‍्ते वे प्रजा: छृते । भौतः स्मार्तः छृतानां तु धर्म: सप्तषिदर्शितः 0१०७ तासु धर्मष्यवस्थार्थ तिष्ठन्तीहाध्युगक्षयात् । मन्वन्तराधिकारेघु तिष्ठन्ति मुनयस्तु दे १०८
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषाच्छुक्लपक्षे चेत्सूर्यवारेण सप्तमी । उपोष्य यो नरो भक्त्या रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम्
verses.transliteration: viśeṣācchuklapakṣe cetsūryavāreṇa saptamī / upoṣya yo naro bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: चीर चर्म को धारण कर स्त्री पत्रादि से विरहित, निमर्याद वर्णाअम धर्म से च्युत घोर संकरवर्ण में उत्पन्न होने वाले वे प्राणीं जो कि बहुत थोड़ी संख्या में शेष रह जाते हैं, इस कष्ट की अन्तिम सीमा को पंहुँचकर जरा व्यांधि एवं क्षुधा की पीड़ा से अतिशंय सन्तप्त होकर दुःख के कारण जीवन से विरक्त हो जाते हैं। इस प्रकार जीवन से विरक्त होने पर उन्हें विवेक उत्पन्न होता है, विवेक से सभी जीवों पंर समानता का व्यवहार करते हैं, इस साम्यावस्था में उन्हें संबोध (वास्तविक ज्ञान) की प्राप्ति होती हैं और संबोध से उनकी प्रवृत्तियाँ धर्म की ओर उन्मुख होती हैं। ओर इस प्रकार कलियुग की उन अल्प धर्मशील प्रजाओं के शेष प्रजाओं के चित्त में संमोह उत्पन्न करके / भवितव्यता वश संतयुग की प्रवृत्ति होती है, सतयुग के प्रवृत्त हो जाने पर कलियुग की शेष अल्पसंख्यक उन प्रजाओं
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चामृतेन गव्येन स्नापयेत् परमेश्वरम् । श्रीखण्डेन ततो गुण्ठ्य पुष्पधूपादिकं ददेत्
verses.transliteration: pañcāmṛtena gavyena snāpayet parameśvaram / śrīkhaṇḍena tato guṇṭhya puṣpadhūpādikaṃ dadet
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: से ही सतयुग की प्रजाओं की उत्पत्ति होती हैं। उस समय ब्राह्मण क्षत्रिय बैइय शुद्र---इन चारों वर्णों की उत्पत्ति के बीज स्वरूप जो स्मरण किये गये हैं, वे लोग तथा वे सिद्धशजण जो अतिहर्ष के साथ सदा विचरण किया करते हैं, तथा वे सातों ऋषिगण --उन अवशेष कलियुगीन प्रजाओं के साथ निविशेष भाव से संम्मिलित होकर परस्पर व्यवहार करते हैं उन में वे सप्तषि गण अन्य सभी लोगों को वर्णाश्षम।चार युक्त इन
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: घृतेन बोधयेद् दीपं नृत्यं गीतं च कारयेत् । सोमवारे तथाष्टम्यां प्रभाते पूजयेद् द्विजान्
verses.transliteration: ghṛtena bodhayed dīpaṃ nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca kārayet / somavāre tathāṣṭamyāṃ prabhāte pūjayed dvijān
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: दी प्रकार के श्रौत एवं स्मात॑ धर्मों का उपदेश करतें हैं ।१०२-१०७। जिससे सतयुग की वे प्रथाये उनके उंपदेशॉनुसार श्लोत-स्मातं धर्मों का पालन करती हैं। इस प्रकार सतयुग में उत्पन्न होने वाले लोगों का श्रौत स्मार्त धर्म उन्ही सप्तर्षियों द्वारा प्रदर््षित होता है। प्रत्येक मन्वन्तरों में सप्तषिगण युगक्षय पयेन्त सखमायुब॑ल रूप धर्मायों काम एवं च। युगेष्बेतानि हीयन्ते न्नीणि पादक़मेण तु
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: जितक्रोधानात्मवतः परनिन्दाविवर्जितान् । सर्वाङ्गरुचिराञ्छस्तान् स्वदारपरिपालकान्
verses.transliteration: jitakrodhānātmavataḥ paranindāvivarjitān / sarvāṅgarucirāñchastān svadāraparipālakān
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: ससंध्यांशेषु होयन्ते युगानां धर्म सिद्धयः। इत्येष प्रतिसंधिर्व: फीतितस्तु सया ह्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीपाठमात्रांश्च विकर्मविरतान् सदा । पुनर्भूवृषलीशूद्री चरेयुर् यस्य मन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: gāyatrīpāṭhamātrāṃśca vikarmaviratān sadā / punarbhūvṛṣalīśūdrī careyur yasya mandire
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणस्तदहः प्रोक्‍्तं रात्रिश्व तावती स्घृता । अन्नाउप्जंबं जडीभावो भृतानामायुगक्षयात्. एतदेव तु सर्वेषां युगानां लक्षणं स्मृतम् । एषां चतुयुंगानां (णां) तु गणना हा कसप्ततिः ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: दूरतो ऽसौ द्विजस्त्याज्य आत्मनः श्रेय इच्छता । हीनाङ्गान् अतिरिक्ताङ्गान् येषां पूर्वापरं न हि
verses.transliteration: dūrato 'sau dvijastyājya ātmanaḥ śreya icchatā / hīnāṅgān atiriktāṅgān yeṣāṃ pūrvāparaṃ na hi
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: सर्गे सगें यथा भेदा उत्पद्चन्ते तथेव तु । पश्चविशत्परिसिता न न्यूना नाधिकास्तथा ११७
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: व्रते श्राद्धे तथा दाने दूरतस्तान् विवर्जयेत् । आयसी तरुणी तुल्या द्विजाः स्वाध्यायवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: vrate śrāddhe tathā dāne dūratastān vivarjayet / āyasī taruṇī tulyā dvijāḥ svādhyāyavarjitāḥ
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: घमं की व्यवस्था के लिये उन प्रजाओं में विद्यमान रहते हैं। जिस प्रकार ग्रीष्म ऋतु में भस्म हुए तृण समूहों के मूल भाग से वर्षाऋतु में पुनः नवाडकुर उत्पन्न होते हैं, उसी प्रकार उन अल्पशेष कलियुगी धार्मिक प्रजाओं से सतयुग की प्रजाओं की उत्पत्ति होती है। इस प्रकार मत्वस्तर के अवसान पर्थन्त एक युग के समाप्त हो जाने पर दूसरे युग की प्रजाओं का उन्हीं आधद्य युगीन प्रजाओं से उत्पत्ति एवं विस्तार होता है ।( ०८-११०। सुख आयु, बल, रूप, धर्म, अर्थ, काम--ये सभी प्रत्येक यगों में अपने अपने स्वभाव के अनुरूप एक एक चरण न्यून होते जाते हैं। और युगों की भर्मसिद्धियाँ अपने संध्या एवं सन्ध्यांश में तो प्रायः विलुप्त हो जाती हैं। है ऋषिगण ! यह यूगों की प्रतिसन्धि मैं आप लोगों को बतला चका  इसी के द्वारा सभी यूगों के स्वभावादि का तात्त्विक ज्ञान होता है। इन चारों युगों के एक सहख वार
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं सह याज्येन पातयन्ति न संशयः । शाल्मलीनावतुल्याः स्युः षट्कर्मनिरता द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ saha yājyena pātayanti na saṃśayaḥ / śālmalīnāvatulyāḥ syuḥ ṣaṭkarmaniratā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: व्यतीत हो जाने पर ब्रह्मा का एक दिन और उतने ही बार व्यतीत होने पर एक रात्रि होती है ।१११-११३३। यग परयेसत उसमें सरलता एवं जड़ता सभी जौवों में विद्यमान पाई जाती हैं । यही' सभी युगों का लक्षण कहा गया है। इन्हों चारों यूगों की आवृत्ति जब इकदृत्तर बार समाप्त हो जाती है तब मन्वन्तर कहा जाता है। एक चतुर्यग में जिस प्रकार की घटनाएँ जिस क्रम से घटित होती हैं, उसी
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: दातारं च तथात्मानं तारयन्ति तरन्ति च । श्राद्धं सोमेश्वरे पार्थ यः कुर्याद्गतमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: dātāraṃ ca tathātmānaṃ tārayanti taranti ca / śrāddhaṃ someśvare pārtha yaḥ kuryādgatamatsaraḥ
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: प्रकार की घटनाएँ उसी क्रम से दूसरे चतुर्युग में घटित होती हैं । परन्तु एक सृष्टि की अपेक्षा दुसरौ सृष्टि इृदम्ध नास्ति डः. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेतास्तस्य हि सुप्रीता यावद् आभूतसम्प्लवम् । अन्नं वस्त्रं हिरण्यं च यो दद्याद् अग्रजन्मने
verses.transliteration: pretāstasya hi suprītā yāvad ābhūtasamplavam / annaṃ vastraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca yo dadyād agrajanmane
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: तथा कल्पयुगः सार्व भवन्ति समलक्षणा:। मन्वन्तराणां सर्वेधामेतदेव तु लकक्षणम.....
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: स याति शाङ्करे लोक इति मे सत्यभाषितम् । हयं यो यच्छते तत्र सम्पूर्णं तरुणं सितम्
verses.transliteration: sa yāti śāṅkare loka iti me satyabhāṣitam / hayaṃ yo yacchate tatra sampūrṇaṃ taruṇaṃ sitam
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: तथा न संतिष्ठति जीवलोकः क्षयोदयाभ्यां परिवतंमानः ११६ इत्येतल्लक्षणं प्रोक्‍्त युगानां वे समासतः । अतीतानतीतानां वे सर्वमन्‍्वन्तरेष्विह । अनागतेषु तद्बच्च तकें: कार्यो विजानता। मन्वस्तरेषु सर्वेषु अतीतानागतेष्विह
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तं वा पीतवर्णं वा सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् । कुङ्कुमेन विलिप्ताङ्गावग्रजन्महयावपि
verses.transliteration: raktaṃ vā pītavarṇaṃ vā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam / kuṅkumena viliptāṅgāvagrajanmahayāvapi
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरेण चेकेन सर्वाण्येबान्तराणि वे  व्याख्यातानि विजानीध्वं कल्पे कल्पेन चेव हि.
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: स्रग्दामभूषितौ कार्यौ सितवस्त्रावगुण्ठितौ । अङ्घ्रिः प्रदीयतां स्कन्धे मदीये हयमारुह
verses.transliteration: sragdāmabhūṣitau kāryau sitavastrāvaguṇṭhitau / aṅghriḥ pradīyatāṃ skandhe madīye hayamāruha
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: अस्याभिमानिनः सर्वे नासरूपभंवन्त्युत । देवा हाष्टविधा ये च इह मन्वन्तरेश्वरा: . इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते चतुर्युगाख्यान॑ नामाष्टपज्चाशोअध्यायः ।१५५॥ द
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: आरूढे ब्राह्मणे ब्रूयाद् भास्करः प्रीयतामिति । स याति शांकरं लोकं सर्वपापविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: ārūḍhe brāhmaṇe brūyād bhāskaraḥ prīyatāmiti / sa yāti śāṃkaraṃ lokaṃ sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: में जो भेद पाये जाते हैं, वे संख्या में पच्चीस होते हैं, न इससे न्‍्यूबन अधिक और कल्प तथा युग ये भी समान लक्षण वाले होते हैं इसी प्रकार सभी मन्वन्तरों का भी यही लक्षण जानना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: उपरागे तु सोमस्य तीर्थं गत्वा जितेन्द्रियः । सत्यलोकाच् च्युतश्चापि राजा भवति धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: uparāge tu somasya tīrthaṃ gatvā jitendriyaḥ / satyalokāc cyutaścāpi rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार स्वभाववश सभी युगों का परिवत्तन भी चिर प्रवृत्त सनातन जानना चाहिए, विनाश एवं उत्पत्ति--इन दो विशेष अवस्थाओं में परिवर्तित जीवसमृह सबंदा एक अवस्था में अवस्थित नहीं रह सकता । बीते हुए एवं भविष्य में आने वाले सभी मन्वन्तरों में यूगों के लक्षणों का मैं संक्षेप में वर्णत कर चुका । बीते हुये भन्‍्वन्तरों की घटनाओं द्वारा बुद्धिमान् मनुष्य भविष्य में आने वाले सभी मन्वन्तरों की घटनाओं का भी वर्णन हो चुका समझना चाहिए। इसी प्रकार एक कल्प के वर्णन से अन्य कल्पों की घटनाओं का भी अतुमान कर लेना चाहिए ।११९-२२२। इनके अभिमानी जो मन्वन्तरों के स्वामी भाठ प्रकार के देव, ऋषि तथा मनु गण हैं, वे सभी नाम तथा रूप से समान प्रयोजन सिद्ध करने वाले होते हैं। इसी प्रकार प्रत्येक्त युगों में वर्णाभ्रमों का विभाग होता है। भगवान् विधाता सवंदा युगों के स्वभाव के अनुसार तत्तद्युग
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वासः सदा राजन्न नश्यति कदाचन । दीर्घायुर्जायते पुत्रो भार्या च वशवर्तिनी
verses.transliteration: tasya vāsaḥ sadā rājanna naśyati kadācana / dīrghāyurjāyate putro bhāryā ca vaśavartinī
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: की कार्यसिद्धि के लिए वर्णाश्रम के आचार व्यवहार से थृक्त सृष्टि का विधान सम्पादित करते हैं। य॒गों के पारस्परिक सम्बन्ध आदि का वर्णन मैं कर चुका अब सृष्टि का वृत्तान्त सुनिये। मैं विस्तार पूवेक्र क्रमशः सभी युगों की स्थिति का विवरण बतला रहा हूं ।!२३-१२६।
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः । सोपवासो जितक्रोधो धेनुं दद्याद्द्विजन्मने
verses.transliteration: jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ / sopavāso jitakrodho dhenuṃ dadyāddvijanmane
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: श्रीबायुमहापुराण का नीलकण्ठ-स्तुति नामक अट्टावनवाँ अध्याय समाप्त ॥५5५॥। गगांधशााकामनक भा भ 93!
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: सवत्सां क्षीरसंयुक्तां श्वेतवस्त्रावलोकिताम् । शबलां पीतवर्णां च धूम्रां वा नीलकर्बुराम्
verses.transliteration: savatsāṃ kṣīrasaṃyuktāṃ śvetavastrāvalokitām / śabalāṃ pītavarṇāṃ ca dhūmrāṃ vā nīlakarburām
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: मनुष्याणां पशूुनां च पक्षिणां स्थावरें: सह । तेषामायुः परिक्रान्तं युगधर्मेषु सबंशः
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: कपिलां वा सवत्सां च घण्टाभरणभूषिताम् । रूप्यखुरां कांस्यदोहां स्वर्णशृङ्गीं नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: kapilāṃ vā savatsāṃ ca ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām / rūpyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ nareśvara
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: देवासुरप्रमाणात्तु सप्तसप्ताइगुलं हसत् । अडगुलानां शत पूर्णमष्टपश्चाशदुत्तरम् ३५ ' हैवासुरप्रमाणं तबुच्छायं कलिजे: स्मृतम् । चत्वारश्रवाप्यशीतिश्र कलिजरडगुल: स्मृतम् ६ स्वेनाइूगुलप्रमाणन ऊर्ध्वमापादमस्तकम् । इत्येष मानुषोत्सेधो हसतोह युगान्तिके ७ सूतजी बोले--प्रत्येक युगों में प्रो प्रजाएँ उत्पन्न होती हैं, उनका विवरण सुनिये । असुर संपे, गो, पक्षी, पिश्ञाच, यक्ष, राक्षसादि प्रजावर्ग जिस युग में जन्म लेकर जितने दिनों तक जीवन धारण करते हैं, उसे बतला रहा हूँ । पिशाच, असुर, गन्धर्व, यक्ष, राक्षस और सर्प “इन सब प्राणधारियों का यदि कोई बध न करे तो ये पूरे युग भर जीवित रहते हैं ।२। मनुष्य, पशु, पक्षी और स्थावर॑ जीव गण अपने युग
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतया वर्धते वंशो रक्ता सौभाग्यवर्धिनी । शबला पीतवर्णा च दुःखघ्न्यौ संप्रकीर्तिते
verses.transliteration: śvetayā vardhate vaṃśo raktā saubhāgyavardhinī / śabalā pītavarṇā ca duḥkhaghnyau saṃprakīrtite
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: धर्म के अनुसार सभी युगो में पूर्ण आयु तक जीवित रहते हैं ।३॥ केवल कलियुग में मनुष्यों की आयु में अस्थिरता (अनिश्चितता) देखी जाती है। इस कलियुग में मनुष्य की अधिक से अधिक आयु केवल सौ वर्ष की कही गई है ।४-५। और असुरों की ऊँचाई प्रमाण से मानव की ऊँचाई सांत-सांत अंगुल न्यून होती है। कलियुग में उत्पन्न होने वाले मनुष्यों के एक सौ बद्गावन भंगुल की ऊँचाई देवताओं और असुरों की होती
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: कपिला नाशयेत् पापं सप्तजन्मसमुद्भवम् । सत्यलोकमवाप्नोति गोप्रदायी नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: kapilā nāśayet pāpaṃ saptajanmasamudbhavam / satyalokamavāpnoti gopradāyī nareśvara
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: है । कलियूग में उत्पन्न मनुष्य के चरण से लेकर मस्तक तक की ऊँचाई अपने चौरासी अँगुल की होती है । सर्वेषु युगकालेषु अतीतानागतेष्विह । स्वेनाइ-गुलप्रमाणेन अष्टतालः स्थृतों नरः ८
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: पक्षान्ते ऽथ व्यतीपाते वै धृतौ रविसंक्रमे । दिनक्षये गजच्छायां ग्रहणे भास्करस्य च
verses.transliteration: pakṣānte 'tha vyatīpāte vai dhṛtau ravisaṃkrame / dinakṣaye gajacchāyāṃ grahaṇe bhāskarasya ca
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: गवाश्वह॒स्तिनां चने सहिषस्थावरात्मनाम । क्रमेणैतेन योगेन ह्वासबृद्धी युगे युगे ११० घट्सप्तत्यडःगुलोत्सेध: पशुनां ककुदस्तु वे । अडगुलाष्टश्त पूर्णमुत्सेषः करिणां स्मुतः:.. ४११ अडगुलानां सहस्न' चत्वारिशाइगुल बिना । पत्चाशतं हयानां च उत्सेधः शाखिनां स्पृतः
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: ये व्रजन्ति महात्मानः सङ्गमे सुरदुर्लभे । मृदावगुण्ठयित्वा तु चात्मानं सङ्गमे विशेत्
verses.transliteration: ye vrajanti mahātmānaḥ saṅgame suradurlabhe / mṛdāvaguṇṭhayitvā tu cātmānaṃ saṅgame viśet
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: मानुषस्य शरीरस्य संनिवेशस्तु यादृशः । तल्लक्षणस्तु देवानां पक्षिणां वृश्यते तत््वदशंनात्ू ४१३ बुद्धयाइतिशययुक्‍त च देवानां कायमुच्यते । देवानतिशयं चेव मानुष कायमुच्यते गावो हाजा महिष्यो5श्वा हस्तिनः पक्षिणो नगा:। उपयुक्ता: क्षिपास्वेते यज्ञियास्विह सर्वश!
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: हृदयान्तर्जले जाप्या प्राणायामो ऽथवा नृप । गायत्री वैष्णवी चैव सौरी शैवी यदृच्छया । ते ऽपि पापैः प्रमुच्यन्त इत्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: hṛdayāntarjale jāpyā prāṇāyāmo 'thavā nṛpa / gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī caiva saurī śaivī yadṛcchayā / te 'pi pāpaiḥ pramucyanta ityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: देवस्थानेषु जायन्ते तद्॒पा एवं ते पुनः । यथाशयोपभोगास्तु देवानां शुभमूरतयः १७
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: जगतीं सोमनाथस्य यस्तु कुर्यात् प्रदक्षिणाम् । प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन सप्तद्वीपा वसुंधरा
verses.transliteration: jagatīṃ somanāthasya yastu kuryāt pradakṣiṇām / pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: मनुष्यों की ऊँचाई का यह मान युगान्‍्त में और भी न्यून हो जाता है व्यतीत एवं भविष्यत्कालीन सभी यगों में मानव अपने अंगुलों से आठ ताल! ऊँचाई का बतलाया जाता है ।६-५। जो व्यक्ति चरण से लेकर मस्तक तक अपने अंगुल मान से नव ताल ऊँचा हो, और जिसके बाहु घुटने पयंन्त लम्बे एवं सघन हों, वह क्रमशः निम्नलिखित परिमाणगत ह्ासवृद्धि होती है। गौओं की ऊंचाई पाद से लेकर ककुद् (डिल) पयेन्‍्त छिहत्तर अंगुल की होती है  हाथियों की ऊँचाई पूरी एक सौ अ'्ठ अंगुल की कही गई है ।६-११। अश्वों को ऊँचाई पचास अंगुल की तथा वृक्षों की ऊँचाई नव सौ साठ अँगुल की स्मरण कौ जाती है। मनुष्यों के शरीद का गठन एवं अवयव संस्थात जिस प्रकार का होता है उसी प्रकार का गठन देवताओं के शरीर का भी
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं गुरुदारनिषेवणम् । भ्रूणहा स्वर्णहर्ता च मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ gurudāraniṣevaṇam / bhrūṇahā svarṇahartā ca mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: समाधि द्वारा देखा जाता है इसके अतिरिक्त देवताओं का शरीर अतिशय बुद्धि एवं चेतना से संयुक्त बतलाया जाता है. मनुष्यों का शरीर देवताओं की अपेक्षा अल्प-चेतना युक्त एवं लघुशक्ति सम्पन्न कहा गया है।
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थाख्यानमिदं पुण्यं यः शृणोति जितेन्द्रियः । व्याधितो मुच्यते रोगी चारोगी सुखमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tīrthākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti jitendriyaḥ / vyādhito mucyate rogī cārogī sukhamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: जीवों के बारे में सुनिये ।१२-१५॥ इस संसार में उत्पन्न होने वाले गो, बकरे-भेंसे, अश्व, हस्ती. पक्षी एवं बक्षादि जीवगण यज्ञादि क्रियाओं के साधनभूत हैं और इनका सामान्य नाम यज्ञिय (यज्ञादि कार्यों के उपकरण) है । देवताओं को अतिप्रिय लगने वाले अतिकमनीय स्वरूप सम्पन्न ये जीव तद्रप होकर उनके (देवताओं) निवास स्थानों में पुनः उत्पन्न होते हैं और इनका पुनः देवताओं द्वारा उपभोग होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: यत्ते संदह्यते चेतः शृणु तन्मे युधिष्ठिर । नैकापि नृप लोके ऽस्मिन् भ्रूणहत्या सुदुस्त्यजा
verses.transliteration: yatte saṃdahyate cetaḥ śṛṇu tanme yudhiṣṭhira / naikāpi nṛpa loke 'smin bhrūṇahatyā sudustyajā
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: १. देशी भाषा में उसे बित्ता कहते हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: किमु षड्विंशतिं पार्थ प्राप याः क्षणदाकरः । सो ऽपि तीर्थमिदं प्राप्य तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुश्चरम्
verses.transliteration: kimu ṣaḍviṃśatiṃ pārtha prāpa yāḥ kṣaṇadākaraḥ / so 'pi tīrthamidaṃ prāpya tapastaptvā suduścaram
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: एकोनषश्टितमी5घ्याय: ४७ अतः शिष्टान्प्रवक्यामि सतः साधुंस्तथेव च् । सदिति ब्रह्मण: शब्दस्तद्वन्तो ये भवनत्युत ॥
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः शीतरश्मिरभूत्सुखी । श्रूयते नृप पौराणी गाथा गीता महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śītaraśmirabhūtsukhī / śrūyate nṛpa paurāṇī gāthā gītā maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: सायुज्यं ब्रह्मणोष्त्यन्तं तेन सन्‍्तः प्रचक्षते १६ दशात्मके ये विषये कारण चाष्टलक्षणे  न क्ुध्यन्ति न हृष्पन्ति जितात्मानस्तु ते स्मृताः.
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गं प्रतिष्ठितं ह्येकं दशभ्रूणहनं भवेत् । अतो लिङ्गत्रयं सोमः स्थापयामास भारत
verses.transliteration: liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ hyekaṃ daśabhrūṇahanaṃ bhavet / ato liṅgatrayaṃ somaḥ sthāpayāmāsa bhārata
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: सामान्येषु च धर्मेषु तथा वेशेषिकेषु च । ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशों युक्ता यस्मात्तस्मादिजातयः वर्णाश्रमेषु युक्तस्य स्वर्गगोमुखचारिण: । श्रौतस्मातेस्य धर्मस्थ ज्ञानाद्धमं: स उच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: रेवौरिसंगमे ह्याद्यं द्वितीयं भृगुकच्छके । ततः सिद्धिं परां प्राप्य प्रभासे तु तृतीयकम्
verses.transliteration: revaurisaṃgame hyādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ bhṛgukacchake / tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāpya prabhāse tu tṛtīyakam
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: एवसाश्रमधर्माणां साधनात्साधवः स्मृताः । गहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी व वानप्रस्थो5थ भिक्षुकः
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं सर्वं तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । धर्म्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वर्ग्यं संशुद्धिकृन्नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam / dharmyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ saṃśuddhikṛnnṛṇām
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: न च देवा न पितरो मुनयों न च मानवाः । अयं धर्मो ह्ययं नेति ब्रुवते भिन्नदर्शनाः २६ स्थावर एवं जंगम जीवो के उपर्युक्त प्रमाणों के अनुरूप तथा उन्हीं के स्वरूप के अनुसार मनोहारि स्वरूप धारण कर ये जीवगण सुख का तात्त्विक अनुभव करते हैं ।१६-१८। अब इसके उपरान्त मैं सम्तों, साधुओं एवं शिष्ट पुरुषों के बारे में बतला रहा हू । 'सत्” यह ब्रह्मवाची शब्द है, जो लोग ब्रह्मवान (ब्रह्मतिष्ठ) होते हैं तथा ब्रह्म का अत्यन्त सायज्य प्राप्त करते हैं, वे सन्‍त कहलाते हैं। जो लोग दस प्रकार के विषयों एवं
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रान्निष्कामः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यस् तीर्थं कृत्वा परं नृप

verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचर्य त्रत परायण विद्यार्थी विद्या की साधना में तन्‍्मंय रहने के कारण साधु कहा जाता है सत्कियाओं के साधन में लीन रहने से गृहस्थाश्रम में रहने वाला व्यक्ति साधु कहाता है। घोर जज्भल में तपस्या की साधना में निरत रहने वाला वेखानस साधु कहा जाता है । योंगाम्यास में परायण यत्ति योग की साधना में लीन रहने के कारण साधु कहा जाता है। इसी प्रकार आश्रम धर्म के पालन करने वाले अपने अपने धर्मों के पथ पर अडिग रहने के कारण साधु कहे जाते हैं, वे चाहे ग॒हस्थ हों, चाहे ब्रह्मचयं ब्रत में विद्याभ्यास करने वाले विद्यार्थी हों चाहे वानप्रस्थाशत्रम में दीक्षित होकर भिक्षाटन पर निर्भर हों । तो न देवता, न पितर, ने मुनिगण ओर न मनुष्य--इनमें से कोई भी-भिस्न-मतों के कारण “यह धर्म है, यह अधम है” ऐसा कहने में समर्थ नहीं हो सकते ।२३-२६। इस जगत् में धर्म तथा अधर्म ये दो शब्द जो कहे गये हैं, वे क्रियात्मक

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सोमनाथतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ८६ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज पिङ्गलावर्तम् उत्तमम् । सङ्गमस्य समीपस्थं रेवाया उत्तरे तटे । हव्यवाहेन राजेन्द्र स्थापितः पिङ्गलेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somanāthatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 86 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja piṅgalāvartam uttamam / saṅgamasya samīpasthaṃ revāyā uttare taṭe / havyavāhena rājendra sthāpitaḥ piṅgaleśvaraḥ
verses.translation: After knowing the views of earlier teachers, I shall explain in due order, the thirty embellishments of music. Listen to them while I am expounding. The Alankaras (embellishments of music) are to be explained along with their Varnas (movements of notes such as 'steady', 'ascending' and others) as their specific basis and also along with their associated configuration ( Samsthana ), always in regard to dramatic performance 2 etc. The SSdharana Svaras are: Vide Bharata's NafyaSastra Volume. IV, p -92 (Baroda Edition) The fulfilment of embellishment is achieved by the implications of sentences and connotations of the word-com- binations. One should understand that there are three place of utterance. They are the chest, the throat and the head. The best procedure (of production of notes) begins in these three places. In the original stage (Prakftau), there are four varnas (tone-patterns) with fourfold movement. The alternative movement is eightfold; 1 and gods know it as sixteenfold. [ The designations of Varnas: ] There is one (Varna viz. Sthayin) which has steady employment. Sancara is a mixed movement. One should indicate the descent of Varnas (i.e. Svaras) as Avarohana. There are four embellishments, viz. Sthapani, These are mentioned in the Puranas, only later writers do not refer to them. The exigencies of the metre have led to the change in the order of Vardas. The order should have been: Although I have referred to the section on Alankdras in Sangita Ratnakara (I.VI) only a few Alankaras like Sycna ( of S. R.) shed some light. Though S.R. is much later than Va.P or Bd.P., I consulted it m S.R. preserved some of the PurAuic traditions. (Names of Alankaras still continue as follows:) Visoara, Asfakala 2 3 which has an interval of one place (from its original place?). Avarta and Kramolpalti —these two should be effected according to their proportion.

verses.translation: Syena is originated as having one interval and situated in the midst of Matras of a Kala. In it there abides the increase in the order of the note different from it (e.g. Sa~ Pa, Ri—Dha, Ga—Ni). The descent of the Syena AlankSra is called Uttara. The The Alankara called Prenkholita has the twelfth place of Kala having one interval. Thus it is endowed with Svaras (Notes). Some verses after this must have been lost as neither our text nor Bd.P. explains these anywhere. Uffrakala in the text being obscure, is emended as per Bd. P. The text is obscure both here and in the Bd. P. Just as in the case of beautification (of one's person; it is extremely censured if it is used at the wrong place, similarly unfavourable (discordant) embellishment of the Varners also (is censurable) as it is produced by oneself. Just as with the use of various ornaments, a woman gets herself beautified, so are the (musical) embellishments to a Varna, (but) if discordantly used, it is bitterly denounced. The ear-ring is not seen (worn) on the feet; nor a girdle round the neck. So also the embellishment (in music) if used in the wrong place, is reproached. When the embellishment is effected, it should indicate the Raga (melody); just as the path intended to be undertaken is characterised. If the reading from Bd.P. is referred to the name of this Alankara is Vdpa. But I am not sure of the correctness of the reading in the Bd.P. Vide Sangita-ratndkara I, 6.64 which enumerates Rakfilabha etc. Obscure*..,.. The songs which have been mentioned with particular emphasis on the form should be effected with seven notes and the Kaifiki [-Aa] of the sevenfold form.

The first, the eighth, the third and second are esta- blished with Graha (!) (Obscure) With half of the equivalent of a Pada and in the one-fifth portion of the Pada, the Pada-bhdga (one fourth of the Pada) also along with the one and a quarter (of a pada) (?) is established in the original form) In the Uttara and Mandraka songs in their original form, the Kala exists as explained of the Daksina Marga (way of the Tala—procedure).* When there is the use of one and the use of two, O best of Brahmanas, and when there is the combination of many Pataka 3 etc. are declared. Some lines are perhaps missing ( vide Bd. 3-62.40-41). (Tentative translation): The two feet and their Ahara(ia(?) beyond this are not laid down. Patdkd was one of eight mdtrds, which was indicated by moving the hand upwards. These mdtrds were to be employed in the mdrgas as specifically directed. The Vjrttis are the styles of rendering songs. They were three in number viz. Citrd, Vftti and Dakfipa. The hundred brothers of that noble-soulcd virtuous king, on being harassed by the Raksasas, fled away in great terror. Fleeing in terror, those Ksatriyas established their families in different places. 2 3 O excellent Brahmanas, these families were very great. As they were virtuous, they were famous in all the quarters as '■'Prayalas" 2 (the pure ones). The family of Dhpsta, the Ksatriyas named Dharstakas, became quite invinci¬ ble in war. verses.translation: Though the chapter is mainly concerned with the Iksvaku dynasty, w. 3-7 mention a dynasty of the pre-Yayati period, before circa 3000 B.C. (The Vedic Age, , BVB's The History and Culture of the Indian People Vol. 1.) Saryata in Bd. P. ibid v. 5 Arhbarisa was the son of Nabhaga. His son was Virupa. Virupa s son was Prsadasva and his son was Rathltara. These (Rathitaras), though born as Ksatriyas, were known as Angiras-s. The prominent members (descendants) of Rathltara were Brahmanas with Ksatriya-like (heroic) prowess. 1 Formerly when Manu sneezed, Iksavaku was bom. 2 Iksvaku had hundred sons. All of them were liberal-minded (distributing enormous wealth as Daksina). The eldest son was Vikuksi. His younger brothers, Nemi and Danda (two were famous). He had five hundred sons, the chief of them being Sakuni. They were the kings and protectors of the land of Uttarapatha (northern region). Forty-eight of them ruled in the southern region. Twenty of them were very important. They protected the whole of the southern region. The king said: O powerful one, kill deer and bring the meat worthy of the Sraddha. Undoubtedly the A?fakd Sraddha has to be performed today. Vikuksi who went a-hunting at the instance of the intelligent (king) killed thousands of deer. Though very powerful, he became very tired. He then (killed and) ate a hare. When Vikuksi returned with the meat along with the army, the king urged Vasi$tha, "May the meat be sprinkled with the holy water". This indicates the fluidity of the caste-system in ancient India. From v. 8, the Purana describes the Iksvaku dynasty. His three sons—Vikuksi, Nemi and Dan<Ja—founded separate dynasties at Ayodhya (U.P.), Videha (Bihar) and Dantfaka (North Deccan) respectively. Nemi is mentioned as 'Nimi* in Buddhist Jatakas. The Sraddha performed on the 7th, 8th and 9th days after the Full Moon in the three months of Pausa, Magha and Ph&lguna.

verses.translation: The infuriated Iksvaku then spoke thus to Vikuksi: "Commanded by me for the purpose of the rites of Pitrs, you went for hunting the deer. In the forest you mercdessly ate the flesh of a hare before the Sraddha. Hence I banish you. Go away along with your fate (as a result of your own action)." Thus at the instance of Vasistha the son was abandoned by Iksvaku. When Iksvaku passed away, the hare-eater attained this earth. He was a very virtuous-souled king of Ayodhya. Urged and guided by Vasistha, he ruled over the kingdom. Thereafter, being full of that sin, the king, ruling over the king¬ dom declined in power as time elapsed. 1 After understanding (the import of) this story, no one shall eat (meat) outside the injunction. Learned men explain the etymology of Mdriisa (Meat) thus—'In the other world that will eat me, Marti Sa (Bhaksayita) the flesh of which I eat here now'. 2 Sasada's successor was Kakutstha, the powerful. Formerly he had sat on the hump of Indra who had assumed the form of a bull, in the course of the war named Adibaka. 3 or went to an inferior world (hell) after death. Quoted from Manu V. 55. Kalidasa, however, explains the epithet Kakutstha as 'one who Vfsadasva was Prthu's son. From him was born the powerful Andhra. YavanaSva was Andhra's son. Sravasta was his son. Sravasta was the king by whom SravastI * 1 was built. Sravasta's successor was BfhadaSva of great fame. It is heard that Kuvalasva was the son of BrhadaSva. By killing Dhundhu that king became known as Dhundhu- mara. O highly intelligent one, we wish to hear how Dhundhu was slain, whereby Kuvalasva attained the title of Dhundhumara. Bfhadasva had twentyone thousand sons. All of them were experts in Vidyas. They were powerful and invin¬ cible. All of them were righteous. All of them were performers of Yajnas with profuse Dak§ina. Bfhadasva, the king, crowned. Kuvalasva who was very powerful, heroic, excellent and virtuous, in that kingdom. After transferring the royal position and glory to his son, the king went to the forest. Uttahka, the Brahmana sage, prevented the great heroic king Bfhadasva who was excellent and virtuous and who was proceeding to the forest (for penance). "O King, protection must be offered by you. It be¬ hoves you to do it. I am unable to perform penance un¬ disturbed. Modern Sahet-Mahet on the Rapti (ancient Airavatl or Aciravau)

verses.translation: In the wild desert region near my hermitage, there is He breathes out (once) at the end of a year. But when he exhales the whole earth along with forests quakes and A great column of dust is raised by the air exhaled by him. It covers up the path of the sun and the earth — quake continues for a week. It is accompanied by very terrible flames of fire, sparks and smoke. O King, I am not therefore able to stay in my own hermitage. O brawny-armed king, restrain him with a desire for the welfare of the worlds. The great deity Vi$nu will further develop your prowess by means of his own splendour. The worlds will be happy and relieved today when the Asura is killed. O King, you are hence competent to kill him. O Sinless one, a boon has been granted to me (that you would help me by killing him) formerly by Visnu. Hence Dhundhu of great virility cannot be slain by anyone of less splendour even in hundreds of years. His virility is so great that it cannot be brooked even by the Devas." Thus requested by the noble-souled Uttanka, that saintly king entrusted his son Kuvalasva with the job of restrain¬ ing Dhundhu. The King said, "I have already laid aside iny weapons. Here is my son. O Excellent Brahmana, he will undoubtedly become the slayer of Dhundhu." After ordering his son who was ready to slay Dhundhu, the king of praise-worthy holy observances retired to the mountains for performing penance. The righteous-souled king Kuvalasva, obeying the behest of his father, went ahead to Dhundhu's haunt, accom¬ panied by his twentyone thousand sons and Uttanka, in order to restrain Dhundhu. Due to the imploring entreaty of Uttanka, and with a desire for the welfare of the worlds, lord Visnu entered him with his own brilliance. When that invincible (king) started, a loud voice arose in heaven—"This king shall be the slayer of Dhundhu (Dhundhumara) with effect from today." The Devas honoured him with divine flowers. It was a wonderful thing. That tiger-like man (the king) of great prowess went to that vast sea of sand accompanied by his sons and dug it up without any waste (of time). That saintly king had already been developed (empowered) extra-ordinarily by the splendour of Narayana.
verses.hindi: अर्थात् वैसा आचरण 7रने पर निष्पन्न होते हैं कुशलता एवं अकुशलता सम्पादित करने वाले कर्म ही धर्म और अधम के नाम से विख्यात हैं. अर्थात् जिसके आचरण करने से कुशल हो उसे धर्म तथा जिसके आचरण से अमंगल की प्राप्ति: हो उसे अधमे कहते हैं। घारणार्थंक 'ध” धातु से धर्मं शब्द की निष्पत्ति होती है। जो धारण करने योग्य नहीं है, जिसके आचरण से महत्व की प्राप्ति नहीं होती उसे अधम कहते हैं। इस  प्रसज्भ में आचाय॑ लोग उसे धर्म कहते हैं. जिसके आचरण से इष्ट की प्राप्ति हो। जो बुद्ध लोभ बिहीन  आत्मनिष्ठ, दम्भरहित, विपुल विद्यावानू, विनम्र तथा सरल हों. उन्हें आचार्य कहते हैं ।२७-२९। यतः वे. आचाये गण सभी नियमों एवं संयमों के साथ स्वयम उन आचरणीय धर्म कार्यों का अनुष्ठान करते हैं, तथा लोक को प्रवत्त करने के लिए मर्यादा स्थापित करते हैं, शास्त्रों के अर्थों को संगहीत करते हैं, अत उन्हें
