verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा देवो वचस्तेषां देवानामातुरात्मनाम् । अचिन्तयद्गरुत्मन्तं शत्रुसङ्घविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā devo vacasteṣāṃ devānāmāturātmanām / acintayadgarutmantaṃ śatrusaṅghavināśanam
verses.translation: "O lord, if you are satisfied, be pleased to be born as my righteous son." After agreeing to it saying "So be it he vanished there itself. God Dhanvantari was born in his house. The great king, king of Ka$I became the destroyer of all ailments.
verses.hindi: जाओ !१०८-११२। आप लोगों का गोत्र ग्यारह शाखाओं में विभक्त होगा, और विवाह के अवसर पर आप लोगों के यहाँ चबूतरे के ऊपर मंगल स्नान सम्पन्न होगा । उस स्नान के अवसर पर म्यान रहित नंगी तलबारें हाथ में लेकर बलवान् मनुष्यों को बाहर रखवाली के कार्य पर नियुक्त करना चाहिए, जिससे इस मांगलिक विधि को अन्य लोग न देख सकें। उस अवसर पर अपने गोत्र में उत्पन्न स्त्रियों को अलग-अलग नवेद्य से पूजित

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं करेण संगृह्य गदाचक्रधरः प्रभुः । शार्ङ्गं च मुशलं सीरं करैर्गृह्य जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: cakraṃ kareṇa saṃgṛhya gadācakradharaḥ prabhuḥ / śārṅgaṃ ca muśalaṃ sīraṃ karairgṛhya janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: Sage Bharadvaja created the science of Ayurveda along with its therapeutics. 1 The king divided it into eight parts and taught them to his disciples. Dhanvantari's son was famous by the name Ketuman. Ketuman's son was the powerful king Bhimaratha. He was famous by the name Divodasa 2 and he was the king of Varanasi.
verses.hindi: करे तथा चार अन्य सुन्दरियों द्वारा आदर पू्वेक कुण्डन (क्डनिर्माण) कार्य सम्पन्न कराये ।११३-११५॥ आप लोगों के कुलाचार के सम्बन्ध में ये कुछ बातें मैंने आप लोगों को बतलाई हैं। यह बावली स्नान करने पर सांसारिक सस्तापों को शान्‍्त कःने वाली है। है नरपुद्भव वृस्द ! इस बावली में स्नान करने का अधिकार किसी अन्य को नहीं है। मेरे नाम से प्रसिद्ध छः स्थानों का दर्शन करके मतलुष्य पवित्र हो जाते हैं। वह पावन तीर्थ समस्त पृथ्वी मण्डल में विख्यात है, जहाँ पर हनुमान् ने जीवन ग्रहण किया था। ब्रद्मवादी वायु देवता ने उस स्थान पर धर्म की रक्षा के लिये तीनों देवताओं के आदेश से उन ब्राह्मणों कौ स्थापना की' थी ।११६-११८५। उसी स्थान पर भगवान् रुद्र स्थायी रूप से सभी दिशाओं में मूर्तिमन रहते हुए अवस्थित रहते हैं। वायु ने उसी अवसर पर वहाँ देवताओं में ऐश्वयंशाली वाडादित्य की प्रतिष्ठा की थी। वे परम
verses.wordMeaning: Sage Bharadvaja created the science of Ayurveda along with its therapeutics. 1 The king divided it into eight parts and taught them to his disciples. Dhanvantari's son was famous by the name Ketuman. Ketuman's son was the powerful king Bhimaratha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sage Bharadvaja created the science of Ayurveda along with its therapeutics. 1 The king divided it into eight parts and taught them to his disciples. Dhanvantari's son was famous by the name Ketuman. Ketuman's son was the powerful king Bhimaratha.…

verses.sanskrit: आरूढः पक्षिराजेन्द्रं वधार्थं दानवस्य च । दानवस्य पुरे पेतुरुत्पाता घोररूपिणः
verses.transliteration: ārūḍhaḥ pakṣirājendraṃ vadhārthaṃ dānavasya ca / dānavasya pure peturutpātā ghorarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: In the meanwhile, the city of Varanasi had become desolate and a Raksasa named Ksemaka occupied it. Though our text does not mention it, Bd. 3.67. 23-24 informs us that Dhanvantari learnt Ayurveda (ihz science of medicine) along with its therapeutics from Bharadvaja. Dhanvantari divided it into eight sections and taught them to different disciples.
verses.hindi: प्रतापशाली भगवान् सूर्य सभी मनोरथों कों पूर्ण करनेवाले, सर्वंदायी, ऐश्वर्य॑युक्त एवं परम प्रभु हैं। सभी
verses.wordMeaning: In the meanwhile, the city of Varanasi had become desolate and a Raksasa named Ksemaka occupied it. Though our text does not mention it, Bd. 3.67. 23-24 informs us that Dhanvantari learnt Ayurveda (ihz science of medicine) along with its therapeutics from Bharadvaja.…

verses.sanskrit: गोमायुर्गृध्रमध्ये तु कपोतैः सममाविशत् । विना वातेन तस्यैव ध्वजदण्डः पपात ह
verses.transliteration: gomāyurgṛdhramadhye tu kapotaiḥ samamāviśat / vinā vātena tasyaiva dhvajadaṇḍaḥ papāta ha
verses.translation: He is regarded as the contemporary of Dasaratha of the Iksvaku dynasty of Ayodhya. It was during his reign that god Siva occupied it by first making it desolate through crafty machination of one of his chief Ganas (aptly called demon) Ksemaka. To get a flourishing capital city vacated for one's honey-moon in the manner described later (w. 36-53) is not creditable to a great god ie. Siva. Formerly that city had been cursed by the noble-souled Nikumbha, 'The city (of Varanasi) will be desolate for a thousand years'. He had repeated the curse many times.
verses.hindi: सहस्रकरसंयुक्त: सर्वायुधविभूषितः । रत्नादेवोयुत: श्रीमांस्त्रयाधारस्त्रयीमय: सुर्यकुण्ड च तत्रा55सोद्ब्रह्मकुण्डमतः परम् । रुद्रकुष्ड हरेः कुण्डमेतत्कुण्डचतुष्टयम् ११२२ ( नव दुर्गाः स्थितास्तत्र क्षेत्रसंरक्षणाय च । हरिद्वयं त्रिगुण्येशं तथा यज्ञचतुष्टयम् ) १२३ विवाहब्रतचूडासु कर तेषां प्रदीयते । आचारा विविधाः पोक्ता वाडवानां प्रप्रत्नतः ११२४
verses.wordMeaning: He is regarded as the contemporary of Dasaratha of the Iksvaku dynasty of Ayodhya. It was during his reign that god Siva occupied it by first making it desolate through crafty machination of one of his chief Ganas (aptly called demon) Ksemaka.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्पसूषकयोर् युद्धं तथा केसरिनागयोः । उन्मार्गाः सरितस्तत्रावहन्रक्तविमिश्रिताः । अकालतरुपुष्पाणि दृश्यन्ते स्म समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: sarpasūṣakayor yuddhaṃ tathā kesarināgayoḥ / unmārgāḥ saritastatrāvahanraktavimiśritāḥ / akālatarupuṣpāṇi dṛśyante sma samantataḥ
verses.translation: As soon as the city was cursed, Divodasa the king, founded a beautiful city on the banks of Gomatl, near the extremities of his realm. Why did Nikumbha curse Varanasi in the days of yore? Nikumbha was a righteous soul. Why did he curse the holy centre of Siddhas?
verses.hindi: सन्त्रमन्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठ: कृता वे शास्त्रकोविंदें: । वापीकृपतडागानि देवतायतनानि च
verses.wordMeaning: As soon as the city was cursed, Divodasa the king, founded a beautiful city on the banks of Gomatl, near the extremities of his realm. Why did Nikumbha curse Varanasi in the days of yore? Nikumbha was a righteous soul. Why did he curse the holy centre of Siddhas?

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राप्तो जगन्नाथो हिमवन्तं नगेश्वरम् । पाञ्चजन्यश्वसहसा पूरितः पुरसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prāpto jagannātho himavantaṃ nageśvaram / pāñcajanyaśvasahasā pūritaḥ purasannidhau
verses.translation: After gaining the city, King Divodasa, the saintly king of great splendour lived in that flourishing city. In the meantime, Mahesvara who had married (Uma) stayed near the Devas* and desired to do what was pleasing to the goddess.
verses.hindi: धरमंशाला5पि बहुला वायुस्थाने महापुरे  रत्नावती स्वर्गंसयी गज़्ग चाम्ृतवाहिनो कलो दुषद्गवती नाम महापातकनाशिनी । वायुना स्थापितं हां तच्छासनं पापनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: After gaining the city, King Divodasa, the saintly king of great splendour lived in that flourishing city. In the meantime, Mahesvara who had married (Uma) stayed near the Devas* and desired to do what was pleasing to the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: After gaining the city, King Divodasa, the saintly king of great splendour lived in that flourishing city. In the meantime, Mahesvara who had married (Uma) stayed near the Devas* and desired to do what was pleasing to the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: तेन शब्देन महता ह्यारूढो दानवेश्वरः । उवाच च तदा वाक्यं तालमेघो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: tena śabdena mahatā hyārūḍho dānaveśvaraḥ / uvāca ca tadā vākyaṃ tālamegho mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: His attendants and the saints assuming various forms continued to delight the great godddess by means of their diverse forms mentioned before. (She said to Uma) "Your husband Mahesvara is carrying on ill-mannered activities in (my) presence. O sinless girl, he is by all means very indigent. Without wearying him¬ self out, he sports and dallies".
verses.hindi: सुबन्दन बन ततन्न रम्यं राजषिसेवितम् । एत्तत्स्थानं मया प्रोक्‍्तं सर्वेधा च समासतः १२६९
verses.wordMeaning: His attendants and the saints assuming various forms continued to delight the great godddess by means of their diverse forms mentioned before. (She said to Uma) "Your husband Mahesvara is carrying on ill-mannered activities in (my) presence. O sinless girl,…
verses.commentary: Sense: His attendants and the saints assuming various forms continued to delight the great godddess by means of their diverse forms mentioned before. (She said to Uma) "Your husband Mahesvara is carrying on ill-mannered activities in (my) presence. O sinless girl,…

verses.sanskrit: तालमेघ उवाच: को ऽयं मृत्युवशं प्राप्तो ह्यज्ञात्वा मम विक्रमम् । धुन्धुमाराज्ञया ह्याशु स्वसैन्यपरिवारितः
verses.transliteration: tālamegha uvāca: ko 'yaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ prāpto hyajñātvā mama vikramam / dhundhumārājñayā hyāśu svasainyaparivāritaḥ
verses.translation: On being thus taunted by her mother, she did not brook it as was but natural to women. After smiling (at the words of her mother) the goddess, the granter of boons, went With a dejected face the goddess spoke to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: प्रकार के दास्त्रात्रों से विभूषित, सहस्न किरण वाले, रत्नादेवी से संय्क्त वे श्रीमान भगवाय सूर्य त्रयीमय (सत््व, रज, तमोगुणयुक्त) तथा समस्त त्रिलोकी के आधारभूत हैं। उसी परम पुनीत स्थल में ऐसे भगवान् सूर्य का एक कुण्ड है, उसी के समीप ब्रह्म कुण्ड तथा विष्णु कुण्ड, रुद्र कुण्ड भी हैं, इस प्रकार ये चार कुण्ड वहाँ विराजमान हैं ।११६-१२२। उस पावन क्षेत्र की रक्षा के लिए वहाँ नव दुर्गा स्थित हैं, उनमें से विष्णु की दो, रुद्र की तीन और ब्रह्मा की चार हैं। विवाह कार्य ब्रत एवं चूड! संस्कार में उनको कर दिया जाता हेै। वहाँ के निवासी उन वाडवों के लिये प्रयत्न साध्य अनेक आचार कहे गये हैं । शुद्रगण उन ब्राह्मणों के द्विगुणित क्या उतने भी नहीं रह गये जितनी संख्या ब्राह्मणों की थी  पहले ब्राह्मण लोग कुश रूप में थे, उसके अनन्तर वे शरीर धारण कर रहने लगे ।!२३-१२५॥ शास्त्रों के पारभामी
verses.wordMeaning: On being thus taunted by her mother, she did not brook it as was but natural to women. After smiling (at the words of her mother) the goddess, the granter of boons, went With a dejected face the goddess spoke to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being thus taunted by her mother, she did not brook it as was but natural to women. After smiling (at the words of her mother) the goddess, the granter of boons, went With a dejected face the goddess spoke to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: बलादानय तं बद्ध्वा ममाग्रे बहुशालिनम्
verses.transliteration: balādānaya taṃ baddhvā mamāgre bahuśālinam
verses.translation: Thus requested, the great god, Mahesvara of great splendour, surveyed all the worlds. O excellent Bra a$as, Nikumbha then went to the city of Varanasi and revealed himself to a barber named Mankana in his dream and said, "O sinless one, I shall bring welfare unto you. Assign a place for me. Make an image of my form and place it at the outskirt of the city."
verses.hindi: एवं मंत्रकर्ताओं में श्रेष्ठ उन ब्राह्मणों ने अपने अमोध मंत्रों व्रारा वहाँ अनेक बावली, कूप, तडाग, देवमन्दिर आदि का निर्माण किया। वायु के उस महान् पुर में धमंशालाओं की भरमार थी, उसमें सुबर्ण एवं रत्नों से पृर्ण अभ्त जलवःहिनी गंगा की धारा बहा करती थी। उस पुनीत गंगा का नाम कलियुग में दघदती हुआ, जो घोर पाप-समूहों का नाश करने वाली है। पापों को विनष्ट करने वाले उस परम
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested, the great god, Mahesvara of great splendour, surveyed all the worlds. O excellent Bra a$as, Nikumbha then went to the city of Varanasi and revealed himself to a barber named Mankana in his dream and said, "O sinless one, I shall bring welfare unto you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested, the great god, Mahesvara of great splendour, surveyed all the worlds. O excellent Bra a$as, Nikumbha then went to the city of Varanasi and revealed himself to a barber named Mankana in his dream and said, "O sinless one, I shall bring welfare unto you.…

verses.sanskrit: धुन्धुमार उवाच: आनयामि न सन्देहः सुरो यक्षो ऽथ किन्नरः । स्यन्दनौघैः समायुक्तो गजवाजिभटैः सह
verses.transliteration: dhundhumāra uvāca: ānayāmi na sandehaḥ suro yakṣo 'tha kinnaraḥ / syandanaughaiḥ samāyukto gajavājibhaṭaiḥ saha
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the barber did everything m accordance with what he was told in dream. After getting the permission of the king, he did everything duly at the gate of the city. He used to grant thousands of boons to the people of the city, such as sons, gold, longevity and similar desires.
verses.hindi: पुनीत क्षेत्र की स्थापना इस प्रकार वायु देवता ने की थी। उसी क्षेत्र में राजषियों द्वारा सेवित अति रमणीक सुनन्दन नामक वन है। इस प्रकार उस स्थान के विविध तीर्थों का परिचय मैंने संक्षेप में कह दिया ।६२६-१२९। वायू द्वारा स्थापित उत्त ब्राह्मणों की उपमा किसी से नहीं दी जा सकती । है देवेशि ! धनुश्चिद्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the barber did everything m accordance with what he was told in dream. After getting the permission of the king, he did everything duly at the gate of the city. He used to grant thousands of boons to the people of the city, such as sons, gold,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the barber did everything m accordance with what he was told in dream. After getting the permission of the king, he did everything duly at the gate of the city. He used to grant thousands of boons to the people of the city, such as sons, gold,…

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टस्ततो जगद्योनिः सुपर्णस्थो महाबलः । गृह्यतां गृह्यतामेष इत्युक्तास्तेन किंकराः
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭastato jagadyoniḥ suparṇastho mahābalaḥ / gṛhyatāṃ gṛhyatāmeṣa ityuktāstena kiṃkarāḥ
verses.translation: The senior queen-consort of the king was well-known by the name Suyasa. That chaste lady was urged by the king and she came (to that deity) with a desire to have a son. She performed (his) worship on a grand scale and requested him for sons. She frequented (the shrine) again and again for (the boon of getting) a son.
verses.hindi: एकोनषष्टितमीअध्याय: श्८७
verses.wordMeaning: The senior queen-consort of the king was well-known by the name Suyasa. That chaste lady was urged by the king and she came (to that deity) with a desire to have a son. She performed (his) worship on a grand scale and requested him for sons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The senior queen-consort of the king was well-known by the name Suyasa. That chaste lady was urged by the king and she came (to that deity) with a desire to have a son. She performed (his) worship on a grand scale and requested him for sons.…

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दिक्षु प्रधावन्त इतश्चेतश्च सर्वतः । सुपर्णेनाग्निरूपेण दग्धास्ते शलभा यथा
verses.transliteration: caturdikṣu pradhāvanta itaścetaśca sarvataḥ / suparṇenāgnirūpeṇa dagdhāste śalabhā yathā
verses.translation: There was a reason behind Nikumbha's not granting sons. If the king were to be infuriated something could be done. After the lapse of a long period, the king became furious. (He thought) 'This spirit at the main gate delightedly bestows hundreds of boons on the town-people but does not do anything (for me). In my city he is worshipped by my people. He has been worshipped by my queen there for that specific reason. Though he eats much, he does not grant me a son. He is ungrateful. Hence he does not deserve further
verses.hindi: निरू(रु)पमाश्र ते विप्रा वायुना स्थापिताश्व ये । उपभा चेव देवेशि विधेया ब्राह्मणस्य तु (+ सुथ्यस्नाभ्राष्टमश्चेब नवमो5थ बृहस्पति:  दशमस्तु भरद्वाजों मन्त्रत्राह्मणकारकाः.
verses.wordMeaning: There was a reason behind Nikumbha's not granting sons. If the king were to be infuriated something could be done. After the lapse of a long period, the king became furious.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There was a reason behind Nikumbha's not granting sons. If the king were to be infuriated something could be done. After the lapse of a long period, the king became furious.…

verses.sanskrit: धुन्धुमारो ऽपि कृष्णेन शरघातेन ताडितः । हतो वक्षःस्थले पापो मृतावस्थो रथोपरि
verses.transliteration: dhundhumāro 'pi kṛṣṇena śaraghātena tāḍitaḥ / hato vakṣaḥsthale pāpo mṛtāvastho rathopari
verses.translation: On seeing the shrine shattered, the lord (of Ganas) approached the king (and said), "O king, since, without any offence on my part, my shrine has been destroyed by you, the city will be void and desolate all of a sudden". Then, due to that curse Varanasi became desolate. Nikumbha brought Mahadeva to that desolate cursed city. Mahadeva rebuilt that desolate city by means of (the powers of) his great soul.
verses.hindi: एते चेव हि कर्तारों विधमंध्वंसकारिणः )। लक्षणं ब्रह्मणश्चेतद्विहितं सर्वशाध्विनाम् ३१३२ हेतुहितेः स्घृतो धातोय॑ बिहन्त्युदितं परे: । अथ वार्थंपरिप्राप्तेहिनोतेगतिकर्म णः ११३३ तथा निर्वचनं ब्याद्राकयार्थस्थावधा रणम् । निन्‍दां तामाहुराचार्या यहोषा तिन्धते वच:ः १३४ प्रपूर्वाच्छंसतेर्धातो: प्रशंसा ग्रुणवत्तया । इदं त्विदर्मिदं लेदमित्यनिश्चित्य संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the shrine shattered, the lord (of Ganas) approached the king (and said), "O king, since, without any offence on my part, my shrine has been destroyed by you, the city will be void and desolate all of a sudden". Then, due to that curse Varanasi became desolate.…

verses.sanskrit: हाहाकारं ततः सर्वे दानवाश्चक्रुरातुराः । तालमेघस् ततः क्रुद्धो रथारूढो विनिर्गतः । ददृशे केशवं पार्थ शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्
verses.transliteration: hāhākāraṃ tataḥ sarve dānavāścakrurāturāḥ / tālameghas tataḥ kruddho rathārūḍho vinirgataḥ / dadṛśe keśavaṃ pārtha śaṅkhacakragadādharam
verses.translation: The city was befitting the Vibhuti (prosperity and glory) of the goddess and the lord. The goddess sported there, even as lord Mahesvara too sported there. But the goddess did not derive (permanent) pleasure due to her surprise at the (peculiar) house. For the sake of playing with the goddess, lord Isana spoke these words.
verses.hindi: इदसेव विधातव्यमिमित्ययं विधिरुच्यते । कंस्यस्यान्यस्य चोक्तत्वाद्बुधा: परक्ृति: स्युता केवल उन्हीं ब्राह्मणों से ही उनकी उपमा दी जा सकती है, अर्थात् उनके समान वे स्वयम् हैं. अन्य कोई नहीं” । उन मंत्रकर्त्ता ऋषियों में सुद्यम्न आठवें, बृहस्पति नवें तथा भरद्वाज दसवें ऋषि हैं, जो सब के सब मंत्र एवं ब्राह्मण भाग की रचना करने वाले तथा विधरमम के विध्वंस करने वाले हैं । सब शास्त्रों के मर्मन्न मनीषियों ने ब्राह्मण के यहीं लक्षण कहे हैं ॥!३०-१३२। हि धादु से हेतु शब्द की निष्पत्ति कही जाती
verses.wordMeaning: The city was befitting the Vibhuti (prosperity and glory) of the goddess and the lord. The goddess sported there, even as lord Mahesvara too sported there. But the goddess did not derive (permanent) pleasure due to her surprise at the (peculiar) house.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The city was befitting the Vibhuti (prosperity and glory) of the goddess and the lord. The goddess sported there, even as lord Mahesvara too sported there. But the goddess did not derive (permanent) pleasure due to her surprise at the (peculiar) house.…

verses.sanskrit: तालमेघ उवाच: अन्ये ते दानवाः कृष्ण ये हताः समरे त्वया । हिरण्यकशिपुप्रख्यानपुमांसो हि ते ऽच्युत
verses.transliteration: tālamegha uvāca: anye te dānavāḥ kṛṣṇa ye hatāḥ samare tvayā / hiraṇyakaśipuprakhyānapumāṃso hi te 'cyuta
verses.translation: "I shall not abandon my abode. My abode is Avimukta 1 (unabandonedl ". He laughed and spoke again to her: "My abode is Avimvkta. O Goddess, I shall not go away (from here). You may go. I shall sport here". Hence indeed it is Avimukta since it was said so by the lord himself. This is the story of how the city of Varanasi was cursed and then glorified as 'Avimukta'. In it lives the lord revered by all Devas in the three Yugas. The pious-souled Mahesvara is accompained by the goddess also.
verses.hindi: है, जिसका अर्थ है, दूसरे के व्यक्त किये गये मत का प्रतिवाद या खण्डन करना, अथवा एक दूसरे हि धातु से, जिसका अर्थ गमन करना है, हेतु शब्द की निष्पत्ति होती है; जिसके द्वारा दूसरे के व्यक्त किये गये मत में दोषारोपण करके अपने मत का निश्चय किया जाय, वह हेतु है। आचाये लोग केवल दोष प्रदर्शन पृवंक दूसरे के वाक्य की भर्त्सना या स्पष्ट शब्दों में निन्‍दा करने को निनन्‍दा कहते हैं। प्र उपसगे

You may go. I shall sport here". Hence indeed it is Avimukta since it was said so by the lord himself.…

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा दानवः पार्थ वर्षयामास सायकैः । दानवस्य शरान् मुक्तान् छेदयामास केशवः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā dānavaḥ pārtha varṣayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ / dānavasya śarān muktān chedayāmāsa keśavaḥ
verses.translation: He vanished during the Kali age. That city of the great soul is reoccupied by the people when the lord vanishes. Thus Varanasi was cursed and was re-inhabited. King Divodasa killed king Bhadrasrenya's one hundred sons who were noted for their mastery in archery and occupied (his capital). The kingdom of Bhadrasrenya was usurped by that powerful king. But the son of Bhadrasrenya named Dur- dama was let off by Divodasa, out of mercy, t in 'ing a
verses.hindi: पूर्वक शंस धातु से प्रशंसा शब्द की निष्पत्ति होती है. जिसका अर्थ है ग्रुणवत्ता प्रकट करना । यह वस्तु यह है यह वस्तु यह नहीं है, इस प्रकार का अनिश्चय करना संजय कहा जाता है। यही करना चाहिए-इस प्रकार के निशचयात्मक वाक्य को विधि कहते हैं। किसी दूसरे द्वारा उक्त होने के कारण उसको (उस विधि को) विद्वानों ने परकृति कहा है ।१३३-१३६। जो अत्यन्त प्राचीनकाल व्यतीत हो च॒का है, उसे पुराकल्प कहते हैं, पुरा शब्द के प्राचीन अर्थ के द्योतक होने के कारण पुराकल्प शब्द की निष्पत्ति हुई  उप्त पुराकल्प में घटित होनेवाली घटनाएँ शुद्ध, सुविस्तृत मंत्र ब्राह्मणकल्प निगम आदिं द्वारा निश्चित
verses.wordMeaning: He vanished during the Kali age. That city of the great soul is reoccupied by the people when the lord vanishes. Thus Varanasi was cursed and was re-inhabited.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He vanished during the Kali age. That city of the great soul is reoccupied by the people when the lord vanishes. Thus Varanasi was cursed and was re-inhabited.…

verses.sanskrit: गरुत्मानवधीत्सैन्यमवध्यं यत्सुरासुरैः । कृष्णेन द्विगुणास्तस्य प्रेषिताः स्वशिलीमुखाः
verses.transliteration: garutmānavadhītsainyamavadhyaṃ yatsurāsuraiḥ / kṛṣṇena dviguṇāstasya preṣitāḥ svaśilīmukhāḥ
verses.translation: Heroic Pratardana was born of Divodasa and Drsa- This explains why Varanasi is called 'Avimukta.
verses.hindi: +धनुव्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थ: नास्ति ख. ग॒घ॒. ड. पुस्तकेषु नास्ति।
verses.wordMeaning: Heroic Pratardana was born of Divodasa and Drsa- This explains why Varanasi is called 'Avimukta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Heroic Pratardana was born of Divodasa and Drsa- This explains why Varanasi is called 'Avimukta.

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणं द्विगुणीकृत्य प्रेषयामास दानवः । तानप्यष्टगुणैः कृष्णश्छादयामास सायकैः
verses.transliteration: dviguṇaṃ dviguṇīkṛtya preṣayāmāsa dānavaḥ / tānapyaṣṭaguṇaiḥ kṛṣṇaśchādayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ
verses.translation: It is heard that Suketu's son was Dharmaketu. Heroic Satyaketu's son was the king named Vibhu. Suvibhu was the son of Vibhu and Sukumara was his son.
verses.hindi: १. कई मूल पुस्तकों में “ ” चिक्नों से अद्धित तक का पाठ नहीं है, जो समुचित प्रतीत होता है। क्योंकि ऋषियों की सातवीं संख्या के बीच में इस कथा का कोई सम्बन्ध ठीक-सा नहीं जंचता । पर अधिकांश पुस्तकों के पाठ के अनुरोध पर मैंने इस असम्बद्ध अंश का भी अनुवाद कर दिया है । अनुवादक । मन्‍त्राणां कल्पनं चेव विधिदृष्टेषु कमंसु । मन्त्रो मन्त्रयतेर्धातोब्नाहाणो ब्रह्मणोइबनात् १४१९
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard that Suketu's son was Dharmaketu. Heroic Satyaketu's son was the king named Vibhu. Suvibhu was the son of Vibhu and Sukumara was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard that Suketu's son was Dharmaketu. Heroic Satyaketu's son was the king named Vibhu. Suvibhu was the son of Vibhu and Sukumara was his son.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रुद्धेन दैत्येन ह्याग्नेयं बाणमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddhena daityena hyāgneyaṃ bāṇamuttamam
verses.translation: Sukumara's son was Dhrstaketu. He was very virtuous. Dhfstaketu's successor was the king Venuhotra. Venuhotra's son was Gargya. He was very famous. Vatsya was the son of the intelligent Vatsa.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते ऋषिलक्षणं नामोनषष्टितमो्ध्याय: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sukumara's son was Dhrstaketu. He was very virtuous. Dhfstaketu's successor was the king Venuhotra. Venuhotra's son was Gargya. He was very famous. Vatsya was the son of the intelligent Vatsa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukumara's son was Dhrstaketu. He was very virtuous. Dhfstaketu's successor was the king Venuhotra. Venuhotra's son was Gargya. He was very famous. Vatsya was the son of the intelligent Vatsa.

verses.sanskrit: वारुणं प्रेषयामास त्वाग्नेयं शमितं ततः । वारुणेनैव वायव्यं तालमेघो व्यसर्जयत्
verses.transliteration: vāruṇaṃ preṣayāmāsa tvāgneyaṃ śamitaṃ tataḥ / vāruṇenaiva vāyavyaṃ tālamegho vyasarjayat
verses.translation: The sons of these two were very virtuous Brahmanas and Ksatriyas. They were strong, valorous and famous for their Thus these kings of Kail have been enumerated. Now listen and understand the (descendants) of Raji. Raji had a hundred sons. Two of them were very powerful and well-known on the earth as the group of kings "Rajeya". Those Ksatriyas caused terror to Indra too.
verses.hindi: ऋषपयसस्‍्तहचः श्रुत्वा सुतमाहुः सुदुस्तरभ् । कर्थ बेदा: पुरा व्यस्तास्तन्नो ब्रहि महामते १ नहीं होती, केवल अनिरंचय भाव से ही उनके निश्चय की कल्पना की जाती है । जिस प्रकार इस (वरतंमान) कल्प में घटित हो रहा है, उसी प्रकार वह प्राचीन कल्प भी है, और जैंसा कल्प था वैसा ही यह भी है-- यह ब्राह्मण का दसवाँ उपदेश है ।१३७-१३६। प्राचीनकाल में बुद्धिमानों ने ब्राह्मण का यही लक्षण बतलाया है, और पीछें से ब्रह्मणों ने उसकी व्याख्या भी वृत्ति रूप में कल्पित की । इसके अतिरिक्त उन्हीं ब्राह्मणों ने
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of these two were very virtuous Brahmanas and Ksatriyas. They were strong, valorous and famous for their Thus these kings of Kail have been enumerated. Now listen and understand the (descendants) of Raji. Raji had a hundred sons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of these two were very virtuous Brahmanas and Ksatriyas. They were strong, valorous and famous for their Thus these kings of Kail have been enumerated. Now listen and understand the (descendants) of Raji. Raji had a hundred sons.…

verses.sanskrit: सार्पं चैव हृषीकेशो वायव्यस्य प्रशान्तये । नारसिंहं नृसिंहो ऽपि प्रेषयामास पाण्डव
verses.transliteration: sārpaṃ caiva hṛṣīkeśo vāyavyasya praśāntaye / nārasiṃhaṃ nṛsiṃho 'pi preṣayāmāsa pāṇḍava
verses.translation: When a terrible war broke out between Devas and Asuras 1, both of them spoke to Pitamaha (god Brahma). "O lord of all the worlds, O great lord, who will be victorious in the battle between us. Please tell us. We all wish to hear."
verses.hindi: विधि पूर्वक सम्पन्न होंनेवाले कर्मों में मंत्रों की कल्पना की। मंत्र धातु से मंत्र शब्द की निष्पत्ति होती है, ब्रह्मा के आदेशों को पालन करने के कारण ब्राह्मण नाम पड़ा। थोड़े-से अक्षरों में सन्‍्देह रहित व्यर्थ के आडम्बरों एवं दोषों से शून्य विस्तृत सार अथ्थ को प्रकट करने वाले वाक्य को सूत्रवेत्ता लोग सूत्र कहते हैं ।६४०-१४२। द
verses.wordMeaning: When a terrible war broke out between Devas and Asuras 1, both of them spoke to Pitamaha (god Brahma). "O lord of all the worlds, O great lord, who will be victorious in the battle between us. Please tell us. We all wish to hear."
verses.commentary: Sense: When a terrible war broke out between Devas and Asuras 1, both of them spoke to Pitamaha (god Brahma). "O lord of all the worlds, O great lord, who will be victorious in the battle between us. Please tell us. We all wish to hear."

verses.sanskrit: नारसिंहं ततो दृष्ट्वा तालमेघो महाबलः । उत्तीर्य स्यन्दनाच्छीघ्रं गृहीत्वा खड्गचर्मणी
verses.transliteration: nārasiṃhaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā tālamegho mahābalaḥ / uttīrya syandanācchīghraṃ gṛhītvā khaḍgacarmaṇī
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that they on whose behalf This is the twelfth (and the last) war between Devas and Asuras as far as Puraic records are concerned.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने कहा--इस प्रकार की बातें सुनने के उपरास्त ऋषियों ने परमज्ञानी सूतजी से पूछा कि हे महामते ! प्राचीन काल में वेदों के विभाग किस प्रकार हुये--वह वृत्तान्त हम लोगों को बतलाइये १, यह अयक्त है ।
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that they on whose behalf This is the twelfth (and the last) war between Devas and Asuras as far as Puraic records are concerned.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that they on whose behalf This is the twelfth (and the last) war between Devas and Asuras as far as Puraic records are concerned.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्ण त्वां प्रेषयिष्यामि यममार्गं सुदारुणम् । इत्युक्त्वा दानवः पार्थ आगतः केशवं प्रति
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa tvāṃ preṣayiṣyāmi yamamārgaṃ sudāruṇam / ityuktvā dānavaḥ pārtha āgataḥ keśavaṃ prati
verses.translation: Where there is Raji, there will be LakcmT if. On hearing about the victorious (-ness of) Raji, Devas
verses.hindi: द्वापरे तु परावत्ते मनोः स्वायंभुवेषन्तरे । ब्रह्मा मनुमुवाचेदं तद्गदिष्ये महामते
verses.wordMeaning: Where there is Raji, there will be LakcmT if. On hearing about the victorious (-ness of) Raji, Devas
verses.commentary: Sense: Where there is Raji, there will be LakcmT if. On hearing about the victorious (-ness of) Raji, Devas

verses.sanskrit: खड्गेनाताडयद्दैत्यो गदापाणिं जनार्दनम् । मण्डलाग्रं ततो गृह्य केशवो हृष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: khaḍgenātāḍayaddaityo gadāpāṇiṃ janārdanam / maṇḍalāgraṃ tato gṛhya keśavo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: With a delighted heart, all Devas and Danavas requested the king. Please take up your excellent bow for enabling us to be victorious." I will defeat you all in the battle, as well as Devas led by Sakra. I shall become the righteous-souled Indra and then shall I fight in the battle.
verses.hindi: वीर्य तेजो बल॑ वाक्य सर्व चेव प्रणश्यति । वेदवेदा हि कार्या: स्पुर्मा भद्दे दविनाशनप्म् ४५ वेदे नाशमनृप्राप्ते यज्ञो नाशं गमिष्यति । यज्ञे नष्टे देवनाशस्ततः सर्व प्रणश्यति १६ आद्यो वेदचतुष्पादः शतसाहल्नसंज्ञितः । पुनर्देशगुणः कृत्स्नो यज्ञो वे सर्वकामधुक् ७ एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा मनुलोकिहिते रतः । वेदमेक॑ चतुष्पादं चतुर्धा व्यभजत्प्रभुः ८ ब्रह्मणो वचनात्तात लोकानां हितकाम्पया । तदिदं वर्तेमानेन युण्माक॑ बेदकल्पनम् ६
verses.wordMeaning: With a delighted heart, all Devas and Danavas requested the king. Please take up your excellent bow for enabling us to be victorious." I will defeat you all in the battle, as well as Devas led by Sakra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With a delighted heart, all Devas and Danavas requested the king. Please take up your excellent bow for enabling us to be victorious." I will defeat you all in the battle, as well as Devas led by Sakra.…

verses.sanskrit: जघनोरःस्थले पार्थ तालमेघं महाहवे । जनार्दनस् तदा दैत्यं दैत्यो हरिमहन्मृधे
verses.transliteration: jaghanoraḥsthale pārtha tālameghaṃ mahāhave / janārdanas tadā daityaṃ daityo harimahanmṛdhe
verses.translation: Our Indra is Prahlada. We shall be victorious on his behalf. O king, please stand by this agreement urged by our Lord. Even as he was about to say, "So be it" he was urged by Devas also. He was invited by Devas saying, "After conquering you will become Indra."
verses.hindi: सूत ने कहा--परम बुद्धिमान् ऋषिवृन्द ! स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तर में द्वापर युग में इसी वृत्तांत को ब्रह्मा ने मनु से कहा था, उप ही बतला रहे हैं। ( ब्रह्मा ने मनु से कहाः-- ) है तात ! युग परिवर्तन होने पर ब्राह्मणों का पराक्रम एवं तेज अल्प हो जाता है, क्योंकि युग दोष के कारण सभी ब्राह्मणादि वर्ण क्रमशः पराक्रमी तथा अल्प तेजस्वी हो जाते हैं और इस प्रकार एक युग की अपेक्षा दूसरे युग में और दूसरे युग की अपेक्षा तीसरे
verses.wordMeaning: Our Indra is Prahlada. We shall be victorious on his behalf. O king, please stand by this agreement urged by our Lord. Even as he was about to say, "So be it" he was urged by Devas also. He was invited by Devas saying, "After conquering you will become Indra."
verses.commentary: Sense: Our Indra is Prahlada. We shall be victorious on his behalf. O king, please stand by this agreement urged by our Lord. Even as he was about to say, "So be it" he was urged by Devas also. He was invited by Devas saying, "After conquering you will become Indra."

verses.sanskrit: जनार्दनस् ततः क्रुद्धस्तालमेघाय भारत । अमोघं चक्रमादाय मुक्तं तस्य च मूर्धनि
verses.transliteration: janārdanas tataḥ kruddhastālameghāya bhārata / amoghaṃ cakramādāya muktaṃ tasya ca mūrdhani
verses.translation: He killed all the Danavas in front of Indra (who was armed with thunderbolt). He was endowed with self-con¬ trol and the greatest prosperity. Lord Raji killed all Dana¬ vas and redeemed the lost glory of Devas. Accompanied by Devas, Satakratu (Indra) spoke to Raji, "I am Raji's son", and continued as follows, "O king, there is no doubt in this that you are Indra of all Devas. O destroyer of enemies, O, Indra, I shall become renowned as your son". On hearing the words of Sakra, he was deceived by him by means of his Maya. The delighted king said, c So be it".
verses.hindi: युग में क्रशः अल्प होते-होते उनके वे पराक्रमादि अन्तिम युग में तो बहुत ही अल्प परिमाण में शेष रह जाते हैं ।२-४। इस प्रकार सतयुग की अपेक्षा लोगों के पराक्रम, तेज, बल और वाक्य--ये सभी दस सहसख्र॒वें भाग में शेष रहते हैं और अन्त में तो एक दम से विनष्ट हो जाते हैं। अतः वेदों का विनाश जिस प्रकार न हो उसके लिये एक वेद का अनेक भागों में विभाग होता चाहिए । क्‍योंकि वेदों के विनष्ट हो जाने पर यज्ञ-विनाद हो जायगा, और यज्ञों के विनष्ट होने पर देवताओं का विनाश हो जायगा--जिससे सभी का घिनाश हो जायगा ।५-६। पहले यह वेद चार पादों तथा एक लाख युक्तों में पूर्ण कहा जाता था, उमके बाद सभी मनोरथों को पूर्ण करने वाले यज्ञों के लिये उन सब की दस गृनी वृद्धि हुई ।७। बंह्मा की ऐसी बातें सुनक्र लोकहित में तिरत भगवान् मनु ने 'बैसा हो होगा! कहकर उस चार पांद वाले एक वेद को चार भागों में विभक्त किया
verses.wordMeaning: He killed all the Danavas in front of Indra (who was armed with thunderbolt). He was endowed with self-con¬ trol and the greatest prosperity. Lord Raji killed all Dana¬ vas and redeemed the lost glory of Devas. Accompanied by Devas, Satakratu (Indra) spoke to Raji,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He killed all the Danavas in front of Indra (who was armed with thunderbolt). He was endowed with self-con¬ trol and the greatest prosperity. Lord Raji killed all Dana¬ vas and redeemed the lost glory of Devas. Accompanied by Devas, Satakratu (Indra) spoke to Raji,…

verses.sanskrit: निपपात शिरस् तस्य पर्वताश्च चकम्पिरे । समुद्राः क्षुभिताः पार्थ नद्य उन्मार्गगामिनीः
verses.transliteration: nipapāta śiras tasya parvatāśca cakampire / samudrāḥ kṣubhitāḥ pārtha nadya unmārgagāminīḥ
verses.translation: When that king who was on par with Devas attain¬ ed heaven, Raji's sons took away all the legacies from Indra. They became haters of Brahmanas. Hence they became deprived of their virility and exploit. So (Indra) regained the glory of Suras and his former excellent position (of Indra-hood).
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार आप लोगों के सामने जो वेद समूह विद्यमान हैं, उसे ब्रह्मा के कथनानुमार लोक कल्याण की भावना से मनु जी ने चार भागों में विभक्त किया । इसी मन्वन्तर द्वारा जिसे बतला रहा हें, अन्यान्य मन्वन्तरों के बारे में भी वेद विभाग, एवं उनके कर्त्ताओं को जानना चाहिए। इस युग में परमतपस्वी पराश्वर के पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: When that king who was on par with Devas attain¬ ed heaven, Raji's sons took away all the legacies from Indra. They became haters of Brahmanas. Hence they became deprived of their virility and exploit.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When that king who was on par with Devas attain¬ ed heaven, Raji's sons took away all the legacies from Indra. They became haters of Brahmanas. Hence they became deprived of their virility and exploit.…

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पवृष्टिं ततो देवा मुमुचुः केशवोपरि । अवध्यः सुरसङ्घानां सूदितः केशव त्वया
verses.transliteration: puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tato devā mumucuḥ keśavopari / avadhyaḥ surasaṅghānāṃ sūditaḥ keśava tvayā
verses.translation: He killed all the sons of Raji who were overwhelmed with lust and anger. He who listens to this story of Raji or the holy rehabilitation of Satakratu will never meet with evil. Endowed with great splendour yet desirous of food, the king performed the sacrifice Marul-Soma to Prajesvara every month, for sixty years.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणा चोदितः सोस्मिन्वेदं व्यस्तुं प्रचक्तमे । अथ शिष्पान्स जग्राह चतुरो वेदकारणात् १२ इतिहासपुराणस्य वक्तारं सम्यगेव हि। मां चेव प्रतिजग्राह भगवानीश्वरः प्र ... . १५६ एक आसीदचजुर्वेदस्तं चतुर्धा व्यकल्पत् । चतुहोत्रमभ्त्तरस्मिस्तेन यज्ञमकल्पयत ॥ ... बह आध्वयव यज्ुभिस्तु ऋग्भिहात्रं तथेव च। उदगात्र सामभिश्रचक्रे ब्रह्मत्वं चाप्यथवेधिः ॥ ब्रह्मत्वमकरोचजन्ञे वेदेनाथवंणेन तु क्‍ ,.
verses.wordMeaning: He killed all the sons of Raji who were overwhelmed with lust and anger. He who listens to this story of Raji or the holy rehabilitation of Satakratu will never meet with evil. Endowed with great splendour yet desirous of food,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He killed all the sons of Raji who were overwhelmed with lust and anger. He who listens to this story of Raji or the holy rehabilitation of Satakratu will never meet with evil. Endowed with great splendour yet desirous of food,…

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्थाश्चैव ततो देवास्तालमेघे निपातिते । जनार्दनो ऽपि कौन्तेय नर्मदातटमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: svasthāścaiva tato devāstālameghe nipātite / janārdano 'pi kaunteya narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Thereby the Marut-gods were pleased by the Marut- Soma sacrifice of that king, and granted him never-ending food with requisites for the fulfilment of all desires. Mitrajyoti was born of the daughter of the intelligent Maruta. From him were born (sons) of great strength, knowers of Dharma and seers of salvation.
verses.hindi: ततः स ऋतमुद्धृत्य ऋग्वेद समकल्पयत् । होतृक॑ कल्प्यते तेन यज्ञवाहुं जगद्धितम... १६ सामभिः सामवेदं व तेनोद्गात्रमरोचयत् । राज्ञस्त्वथवंवेदेन सर्वकर्माण्यकारयत  ॥२ ० आख्यानेश्राप्युपास्यानेगथिशिः कुलकभृभिः । पुराणसंहिता चक्रे पुराणार्थविशारदः ;
verses.wordMeaning: Thereby the Marut-gods were pleased by the Marut- Soma sacrifice of that king, and granted him never-ending food with requisites for the fulfilment of all desires. Mitrajyoti was born of the daughter of the intelligent Maruta. From him were born (sons) of great strength,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereby the Marut-gods were pleased by the Marut- Soma sacrifice of that king, and granted him never-ending food with requisites for the fulfilment of all desires. Mitrajyoti was born of the daughter of the intelligent Maruta. From him were born (sons) of great strength,…

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदां नर्मदां मत्वा अनन्तभुजगोपरि । लक्ष्म्या समन्वितः कृष्णो निलीनश्चोत्तरे तटे
verses.transliteration: kṣīrodāṃ narmadāṃ matvā anantabhujagopari / lakṣmyā samanvitaḥ kṛṣṇo nilīnaścottare taṭe
verses.translation: This chapter corresponds to Bd. 3.68. For comparison or reference only the verse number is quoted. This immortal story with a profound moral is repeated in many Puranas. The story is originally given in details in Mbh Adi. Ghs. 84 and
verses.hindi: यच्छिष्टं तु यजुर्वेद तेन यज्ञमथायजत् । यठजान: स यजुर्वेद इति शास्त्रबिनिश्चयः.. ढपायन व्यास जी ने, जो भगवान् विष्णु के अंश कहे गये हैं, ब्रह्मा. के अनुरोध पर इस बेद का विभाभग किया व्यास ने वेद का प्रचार करने के लिये अपने प्रमुख चार शिष्प बनाये, जिनके नाम हैं जैमिनि सुमन्तु, वशम्पायन और पल  इन शिष्यों के अतिरिक्त. लोमहर्षण. नामक एक-पाँचवाँ शिष्य भी था ।९-१8। परम तेजस्वी भगवान् वेद-ग्यास ने द्विजवय पैल को ऋग्वेद का व्याख्याता, वैशम्पायन को यजुवंद का, जमिलि को
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter corresponds to Bd. 3.68. For comparison or reference only the verse number is quoted. This immortal story with a profound moral is repeated in many Puranas. The story is originally given in details in Mbh Adi. Ghs. 84 and
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter corresponds to Bd. 3.68. For comparison or reference only the verse number is quoted. This immortal story with a profound moral is repeated in many Puranas. The story is originally given in details in Mbh Adi. Ghs. 84 and

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं विभीषणं मर्त्ये ज्वालामालासमन्वितम् । पतितं नर्मदातोये जलशायिसमीपतः
verses.transliteration: cakraṃ vibhīṣaṇaṃ martye jvālāmālāsamanvitam / patitaṃ narmadātoye jalaśāyisamīpataḥ
verses.translation: The immortal verse uttered by Yayati: Verses 1-11 speak of Maruta and Mitrajyoti and his descendants. But they are unrelated to the main story of this chapter.
verses.hindi: सामवेद का तथा ऋषिवय्यें सुमन्‍्तु को. अथवंबेद- का अंगीकार कियाः। इतिहास और पुराण की व्याख्या' के लिये उन्होंने मुझे निग्रक्त किया+ पहिले यजुर्वेद एक ही था, उसे पीछे चलकर चार भागों में विभक्त किया गया, इस प्रकार उसमें :चातुहोत्र की कल्पना हुई, जिससे यज्ञों का प्रचलन किया १४-१७। यजुर्वेद के मन्‍्त्रों से आध्वयंव, ऋग्वेद के मन्त्रों से हवन, सामवेद के मन्त्रों से उदगात्र और अथव॑बेद के मन्त्रों से ब्रह्मत्व की प्रतिष्ठा
verses.wordMeaning: The immortal verse uttered by Yayati: Verses 1-11 speak of Maruta and Mitrajyoti and his descendants. But they are unrelated to the main story of this chapter.
verses.commentary: Sense: The immortal verse uttered by Yayati: Verses 1-11 speak of Maruta and Mitrajyoti and his descendants. But they are unrelated to the main story of this chapter.

verses.sanskrit: निर्धूतकल्मषं जातं नर्मदातोययोगतः । तालमेघवधोत्पन्नं यत्पापं नृपनन्दन
verses.transliteration: nirdhūtakalmaṣaṃ jātaṃ narmadātoyayogataḥ / tālameghavadhotpannaṃ yatpāpaṃ nṛpanandana
verses.translation: The reading jdtdmarutakanyakdh in the text tianslated above is contra¬ dictory and obscure. If emended: jdtd maruta-kanyayd (as inBd. 3.68.1) meaning '(of what heroic ability were the noble -soulcd persons) born of the daughter of Maruta\ it gives cogentness. The references to the Bd.P. are to the above-mentioned chapter. Only verse number is quoted in t ese notes. They were Yati. Yayati, Sarhyati, Ayati and the twins Viyati, Krti, (Bd. P.) who were the fifth-born (?) Yati was the eldest of them and Yayati was the younger brother.
verses.hindi: की। इस प्रकार यज्ञों में जितने ब्रह्मकायेकै. वे अथवंवेद द्वारा प्रतिष्ठित हैं। तदतन्तर उन्होंने ऋचाओं का उद्धार करके ऋग्वेद का सम्पादन:किश्रा 4 जिसके द्वारा जगत के कल्याण करने वाले हनीय पदार्थों के वाहक होताओं की कल्पना हुई । साम के स्फुट - मन्त्रों के संग्रह से सामवेद- का सं ग्रह एंव सम्पादत किया, जो उदगान्रों ( सामवेद के गान करने वाले वट समूह ) को विशेष रुचिक्र हुआ, अथवंबेद द्वारा राजाओं के परमावश्यक समस्त कमकाण्डों का विधान कराया + इसी प्रकार पुराणों के तात्पयं- को भलीभाँति समझने वाले' ढेपायस ने आश्यान, उपाख्यान, गाथाओं एवं कुलाचार की परम्परा द्वारा: पुराणों की ब्रिस्तृत कथाओं की रचना की ।१५-२१। यजुर्वेद में जो भाग शेष रहा उससे यज्ञों का विधान किया । जिसके द्वारा यज्ञों की क्रियायें

verses.sanskrit: तत्स्रवं क्षालितं सद्यो नर्मदांभसि भारत । तदाप्रभृति लोके ऽस्मिञ्जलशायी महीपते
verses.transliteration: tatsravaṃ kṣālitaṃ sadyo narmadāṃbhasi bhārata / tadāprabhṛti loke 'smiñjalaśāyī mahīpate
verses.translation: Yati attained Ga (Gau), the daughter of Kakutstha as wife. Samyati became a sage. Attaining absolution, he became Among the (other) five, Yayati became a king. He attained Devayanx, the daughter of Usanas, as his wife.
verses.hindi: बष्टिकेमाध्ध्यार्ये: ४४
verses.wordMeaning: Yati attained Ga (Gau), the daughter of Kakutstha as wife. Samyati became a sage. Attaining absolution, he became Among the (other) five, Yayati became a king. He attained Devayanx, the daughter of Usanas, as his wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yati attained Ga (Gau), the daughter of Kakutstha as wife. Samyati became a sage. Attaining absolution, he became Among the (other) five, Yayati became a king. He attained Devayanx, the daughter of Usanas, as his wife.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रतीर्थं वदन्त्यन्ये केचित् कालाघनाशनम् । विख्यातं भारते वर्षे नर्मदायां महीपते
verses.transliteration: cakratīrthaṃ vadantyanye kecit kālāghanāśanam / vikhyātaṃ bhārate varṣe narmadāyāṃ mahīpate
verses.translation: He married the Asura lady Sarmistha, the daughter of Vrsaparvan. Devayani gave birth to Yadu and Turvasu. Sarmistha, the daughter of Vrsaparvan, gave birth to very powerful sons comparable to divine sons, viz. Druhyu, Anu and Puru.
verses.hindi: प्रयुज्यते ह्श्वमेघस्तेन वा. युछ्यते तु स:ः (४75८ ३. है 75.0 5छ 5 7 १३ इन्द्रप्रमतये चैकां द्वितोयां बाष्कलाय च । चतस्र: संहिता: ऋृत्व़रः बाष्कलिद्विजसत्तमः ॥ हे
verses.wordMeaning: He married the Asura lady Sarmistha, the daughter of Vrsaparvan. Devayani gave birth to Yadu and Turvasu. Sarmistha, the daughter of Vrsaparvan, gave birth to very powerful sons comparable to divine sons, viz. Druhyu, Anu and Puru.
verses.commentary: Sense: He married the Asura lady Sarmistha, the daughter of Vrsaparvan. Devayani gave birth to Yadu and Turvasu. Sarmistha, the daughter of Vrsaparvan, gave birth to very powerful sons comparable to divine sons, viz. Druhyu, Anu and Puru.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तीर्थस्य प्रभावो ऽयं श्रूयतामवनीपते । यथा ऽनन्तो हि नागानां देवानां च जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: tattīrthasya prabhāvo 'yaṃ śrūyatāmavanīpate / yathā 'nanto hi nāgānāṃ devānāṃ ca janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: The delighted Rudra gave him a divine golden chariot that shone brilliantly and that could never get stuck up (im¬ peded). He gave him two great inexhaustible quivers also. That chariot was fitted with horses as fast as the mind It was in this chariot that he drove at the time of his marriage. With the same important chariot he conquered the earth.
verses.hindi: इच्द्प्रमतिरेकां तु संहिता द्विजसत्तेम:। अध्यापयन्महाभागं माकेण्डेयें यशस्विनसू .
verses.wordMeaning: The delighted Rudra gave him a divine golden chariot that shone brilliantly and that could never get stuck up (im¬ peded). He gave him two great inexhaustible quivers also.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted Rudra gave him a divine golden chariot that shone brilliantly and that could never get stuck up (im¬ peded). He gave him two great inexhaustible quivers also.…

verses.sanskrit: मासानां मार्गशीर्षो ऽस्ति नदीनां नर्मदा यथा । मासि मार्गशिरे पार्थ ह्येकादश्यां सिते ऽहनि
verses.transliteration: māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo 'sti nadīnāṃ narmadā yathā / māsi mārgaśire pārtha hyekādaśyāṃ site 'hani
verses.translation: Yayati was invincible in battle to Devas, Danavas and human beings. That chariot belonged to all the Paurava kings.
verses.hindi: सह्यश्रंवसमग्रयं तु पुत्र स तु महायशा: । सत्याश्रवाः सत्यहित॑ पुनरध्यापयव्द्ज: ॥रद सो5पि संत्यतर पुत्र पुनरध्यापयहिंसु: । संत्यश्रियं महोत्मानं सत्यधमंपरायणम्... शाकल्प: प्रथमस्तेषों तस्मांदन्यों स्थान्तरः । बाष्कलिंश्व भरद्वाज इति शाखाप्रवतेकाः...
verses.wordMeaning: Yayati was invincible in battle to Devas, Danavas and human beings. That chariot belonged to all the Paurava kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yayati was invincible in battle to Devas, Danavas and human beings. That chariot belonged to all the Paurava kings.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा यो मनुजो भक्त्या कामक्रोधविवर्जितः । वैष्णवीं भावनां कृत्वा जलेशं तु व्रजेत वै
verses.transliteration: gatvā yo manujo bhaktyā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ / vaiṣṇavīṃ bhāvanāṃ kṛtvā jaleśaṃ tu vrajeta vai
verses.translation: It remained with them upto the time ofKaurava Jana- mejaya born of a good land(?) The chariot got lost through the curse of the son of Garga, the intelligent sage, when Pariksit's son became a king. The unwise king Janamejaya (the first) who was evil- minded and was known as Loha-gandhin 1 (having the odour of iron) killed the (young) son of Gargya.
verses.hindi: देघैंमित्रस्त शाकल्यपो ज्ञानाहुंकारगवितः। जनकस्य स यज्ञ के विनाशरंगंमद्दिज:. रा ३२
verses.wordMeaning: It remained with them upto the time ofKaurava Jana- mejaya born of a good land(?) The chariot got lost through the curse of the son of Garga, the intelligent sage, when Pariksit's son became a king.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It remained with them upto the time ofKaurava Jana- mejaya born of a good land(?) The chariot got lost through the curse of the son of Garga, the intelligent sage, when Pariksit's son became a king.…

verses.sanskrit: एकभुक्तं च नक्तं च तथैवायाचितं नृप । उपवासं तथा दानं ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनम्
verses.transliteration: ekabhuktaṃ ca naktaṃ ca tathaivāyācitaṃ nṛpa / upavāsaṃ tathā dānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam
verses.translation: The saintly king with iron odour began to run here and there. He was abandoned by the citizens and the people of the land. Nowhere did he derive happiness.
verses.hindi: सम्पन्न होती हैं, वही यजुर्वेद है, शास्त्रों का यही निचोड़ है। वेदों के पारगामी अन्यान्य विद्वान् ऋषियों के संसर्ग से स्फुट यजुर्वेद के मन्त्र एवं पद समूहों को एकत्र संगृहीत किया और उनका विधिवत संकलन किया  उन्हीं यजवेंद के मन्‍्त्रों दवरा अश्वमेध यज्ञ का प्रचलन हुआ । परम तेजस्तव्री पेल ऋषि ने- ऋक् समूहों को एकत्र संगहीत कर दो भागों में विभक्त क्रिया, और उनमें से एक-एक भाग को दो शिष्यों को सौपा एक इन्द्रप्रमति- को. दूसरा बाष्कल को  द्विजश्रेष्ठ बाष्कलि ने सेवा में निरन्तर निरत रहने वाले, कल्याण भाजन अपने चार शिष्यों को, उसेका चार संहिताओं में विभाग करके पढ़ाया ।२२-२५। जिनमें से पहली शाखा को बाध्य को
verses.wordMeaning: The saintly king with iron odour began to run here and there. He was abandoned by the citizens and the people of the land. Nowhere did he derive happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The saintly king with iron odour began to run here and there. He was abandoned by the citizens and the people of the land. Nowhere did he derive happiness.

verses.sanskrit: करोति च कुरुश्रेष्ठ न स याति यमालयम् । यमलोकभयाद्भीता ये लोकाः पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: karoti ca kuruśreṣṭha na sa yāti yamālayam / yamalokabhayādbhītā ye lokāḥ pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: He was extremely miserable. He did not get peace anywhere. Excessively dejected, he sought refuge in the sage who was the cause of his curse. 1 2 The sage of liberal mind was famous by the name Indrota. This Indrota, the excellent Brahmana, a descendant of Sunaka, made the king perform an Asvamedha for the sake of purification.
verses.hindi: दूसरी शाखा की अग्निमाठर को, तीसरी शाखा की पाराशर को और चोथी शाखा को याज्ञवल्क्य को शिक्षा दी । "ब्राह्मणों में श्रेष्ठ इन्द्रप्रमति ने एक संहिता का सम्पादंत कर पंरम यशस्वी और भाग्यशाली मार्क॑ण्डेय मुनि को 'उसकी शिक्षा दी। महात् यशस्वी 'मार्कण्डेय मुनि ने उसे सत्यश्षवा नामक अपने ज्येष्ठ पुत्र को और सत्येश्षवा ने सत्यहित नामक शिष्य को उसकी शिक्षा दी ।३६-२८। परम ऐव्वर्यशाली संत्यहित ने अपने पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: He was extremely miserable. He did not get peace anywhere. Excessively dejected, he sought refuge in the sage who was the cause of his curse. 1 2 The sage of liberal mind was famous by the name Indrota. This Indrota, the excellent Brahmana, a descendant of Sunaka,…

verses.sanskrit: ते पश्यन्तु श्रियः कान्तं नागपर्यङ्कशायिनम् । गोपीजनसमावृत्तं योगनिद्रां समाश्रितम् । विश्वरूपं जगन्नाथं संसारभयनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: te paśyantu śriyaḥ kāntaṃ nāgaparyaṅkaśāyinam / gopījanasamāvṛttaṃ yoganidrāṃ samāśritam / viśvarūpaṃ jagannāthaṃ saṃsārabhayanāśanam
verses.translation: After reaching his abode, the iron-ore odour was quelled. 3 That divine chariot left him and reached Vasu, the king of Cedi.
verses.hindi: सत्थतर (सत्यरत) को और सत्यतर ने सत्यपरायण धर्मश्रेष्ठ महात्मा सत्मश्री को उसकी शिक्षा दी। विंद्वान् सत्येश्री के शास्त्राभ्यास में तत्पर रहने वाले परम तेजस्वी तीन शिष्य हुये जिनमें से प्रथम का नाम शाकल्य, दूसरे का नाम रथान्तर और तीसरे का नाम वाष्कल का पुत्र भरद्वाज था । ये ही ऋषिगण वेदें की शाखाओं के प्रवत्तक कहे गये हैं। अपने ज्ञान के अहंकार से गवित होकर शाकल्य वेदमित्र नांमक द्विज राजा जनके के यज्ञ विताश को प्राप्त हये ।२६०३२॥  हाय का हक.
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching his abode, the iron-ore odour was quelled. 3 That divine chariot left him and reached Vasu, the king of Cedi.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching his abode, the iron-ore odour was quelled. 3 That divine chariot left him and reached Vasu, the king of Cedi.

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयेत् परया भक्त्या क्षौद्रक्षीरेण सर्पिषा । खण्डेन तोयमिश्रेण जगद्योनिं जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: snāpayet parayā bhaktyā kṣaudrakṣīreṇa sarpiṣā / khaṇḍena toyamiśreṇa jagadyoniṃ janārdanam
verses.translation: Emend as in Bd.P. v. 22, as syntactically the text here is obscure. Thetext: Lohagandham naradhipam is Amended as Lohagandhx naradhipah, as in Bd.P. The text is confusing. The king did not take resort to Gargya who cursed him (see v. 22above) but Indrota Saunaka (see the next verse). The reading in Bd. 24: sa priyicchaunakam rfim-'hc resorted to the sage Saunaka* is relevant and deserves adoption.
verses.hindi: ४८5२ वायुपुराणम्

verses.sanskrit: स्नाप्यमानं च पश्यन्ति ये लोका गतमत्सराः । ते यान्ति परमं लोकं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: snāpyamānaṃ ca paśyanti ye lokā gatamatsarāḥ / te yānti paramaṃ lokaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam
verses.translation: Bd. P. v. 26 reads avabhrtha for avasatha hereof and means, 'The king died when he reached the Avabhrtha stage of the sacrifice'. The Bd. P. reading is preferable for if the curse of iron odour was removed and the king was rehabilitated, the divine chariot should have continued with him.
verses.hindi: कर्थं विनाशमगमत्स मुनिश्ननिगवितः  जनकस्याश्वमेथेन कथं वादों बभूव ह ३३ किमर्थ चाभवद्वादः केन सार्थभथापि वा। सर्वमेतद्यथावृत्तमाचक्ष्ब विदितं तब ॥

verses.sanskrit: घृतेन बोधयेद् दीपमथवा तैलपूरितम् । रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा दैवस्याग्रे विमत्सराः
verses.transliteration: ghṛtena bodhayed dīpamathavā tailapūritam / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā daivasyāgre vimatsarāḥ
verses.translation: I ha« promised to give alms to Brahmanas but have not given. That can be achieved only by exertion. (So) In the prime of youth, Ido not wish to become a pitiable figure with white moustache and beard, shattered (in every limb) by old age, (skin) with many a wrinkle, with the body bent down, faced with a miserable state, the very form
verses.hindi: राजषंज॑नकस्याथ त॑ यज्ञ हि दिदुृक्षबः
verses.wordMeaning: I ha« promised to give alms to Brahmanas but have not given. That can be achieved only by exertion. (So) In the prime of youth, Ido not wish to become a pitiable figure with white moustache and beard, shattered (in every limb) by old age, (skin) with many a wrinkle,…

verses.sanskrit: ये कथां वैष्णवीं भक्त्या शृण्वन्ति च नृपोत्तम । ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि नश्यन्ते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: ye kathāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ bhaktyā śṛṇvanti ca nṛpottama / brahmahatyādipāpāni naśyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O King, O knower of virtues, you do have many sons even more beloved than lam. May they take it up. Please request some other son".
verses.hindi: आगतान्त्राह्मणान्दृष्ट्वा जिज्ञासाधस्थाभवत्तत: । को न्वेषां ब्राह्मण: श्रेष्ठ: कथ्थं मे निश्चयों भवेत् ॥ सर्वानहूं प्रसन्नोइस्मि शिरसा श्रेष्ठभागिन: द ३७.
verses.wordMeaning: O King, O knower of virtues, you do have many sons even more beloved than lam. May they take it up. Please request some other son".
verses.commentary: Sense: O King, O knower of virtues, you do have many sons even more beloved than lam. May they take it up. Please request some other son".

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणन्ति ये मर्त्या जलशायिजगद्गुरुम् । प्रदक्षिणीकृता तैस्तु सप्तद्वीपा वसुंधरा
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇanti ye martyā jalaśāyijagadgurum / pradakṣiṇīkṛtā taistu saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā
verses.translation: On getting this rebuff from Yadu, (Yayati) the fore¬ most among the most eloquent ones, became infuriated. Censur¬ ing his eldest son, he said thus: "What other Asrama do you have? What other holy rite do you have for which you disregard me and say thus? O evil-minded one, O new instructor!" After saying this the angry king cursed Yadu: "Since you, though born of my bosom, do not pass on your (youthful) age unto me, O fool, your progeny shall not get the kingdom." (Then he said to Turvasu) "O Turvasu, accept my sin along with my old age'.
verses.hindi: शाशपायन ने कहा-सूतजी ! ज्ञान के गव॑ से गवित वे मुनि किस प्रकार विनाश को प्राप्त हुये, राजा जनक के अइ्वमेध यज्ञ में क्यों कर वादविवाद उठा था। ? किस लिये वह बेकार का वादविवाद बढ़ा था और किसके साथ हुआ था ? ये सभी बातें आपको विस्तार पूवक ज्ञात हैं, हमें बतलाइये । सूत ने ऋषियों की बातें सुनने के बाद कहा ।३३-३४। द

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभाते विमले पित्ःन् संतर्पयेज् जलैः । श्राद्धं च ब्राह्मणैस्तत्र योग्यैः पाण्डव मानवाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte vimale pitḥn saṃtarpayej jalaiḥ / śrāddhaṃ ca brāhmaṇaistatra yogyaiḥ pāṇḍava mānavāḥ
verses.translation: O father, I do not like old age that destroys the
verses.hindi: सूत ने कहा-- ऋषिवन्द ! राजधि जनक के उस अदवमेध यज्ञ में महान जनसमागम एकत्र हुआ था, विविध देशों एवं स्थानों से यज्ञ के दशेनार्थी ऋषिगण सहसख्रों की संख्या में आ-आकर उसमें सम्मिलित हुये थे। समागत विशाल ब्राह्मण समुदाय को देखकर राजा जनक के मन में यह स्वाभाविक जिज्ञासा उत्पन्न हुई कि इन तमाम ब्राह्मणों में कौन सर्वश्रेष्ठ है--इसका निश्चय मुझको किस प्रकार होगा ? राजा ने ऐसा मन में विचार कर' एक युक्ति का सहारा लिया। एक सहस्र गौयें, एक सहस्न से अधिक सुवर्ण, अनेक प्राम, बहुमूल्य रत्न और दास-दासियों के समूह को साथ लेकर मुनियों से राजा ने कहाः--परमभाग्यशाली ऋषिवृन्द  आप सब लोगों को मैं शिर झुकाकर नमस्कार कर रहा हूँ ।१५-३७। आप लोगों में से जो मुनि सर्वश्र ष्ठ हों, वे मेरे इस लाये हुये द्रव्यादि समूह को ग्रहण करें, क्योंकि श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मण लोग एक मात्र षिच्या के

verses.sanskrit: स्वदारनिरतैः शान्तैः परदारविवर्जकैः । वेदाभ्यसनशीलैश्च स्वकर्मनिरतैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: svadāranirataiḥ śāntaiḥ paradāravivarjakaiḥ / vedābhyasanaśīlaiśca svakarmanirataiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: You, though born of my bosom, do not exchange your (youthful) age with me; O Turvasu, your progeny will meet with utter ruin. O deluded one, you will be a king among people of mixed religious rites and practices*, born of anti-caste marriages and other mixed castes, who are meat-eaters and others. There is no doubt that you will be a ruler of the brutish Mlecchas, barbarians and oulcastes who are after outraging the modesty of their preceptors' wives and who (are destined to be) born as loweranimals.
verses.hindi: तथा5न्यस्तत्र वे विद्वान्त्रह्मगाहुसुतः कवि: । याज्ञवल्क्यों महातेजास्तपस्वी ब्रह्मवित्तम: ४ १ ब्रह्मणो5ड्भगत्समुत्पन्नो वाक्य प्रोवाच सुस्व॒र॒म् । शिष्य ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठो धनसेतद्गृहाण भोः.
verses.wordMeaning: You, though born of my bosom, do not exchange your (youthful) age with me; O Turvasu, your progeny will meet with utter ruin. O deluded one, you will be a king among people of mixed religious rites and practices*, born of anti-caste marriages and other mixed castes,…
verses.commentary: Sense: You, though born of my bosom, do not exchange your (youthful) age with me; O Turvasu, your progeny will meet with utter ruin. O deluded one, you will be a king among people of mixed religious rites and practices*, born of anti-caste marriages and other mixed castes,…

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं यजनशीलैश्च त्रिसन्ध्यापरिपालकैः । श्रद्धया कारयेच्छ्राद्धं यदीच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ yajanaśīlaiśca trisandhyāparipālakaiḥ / śraddhayā kārayecchrāddhaṃ yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: After cursing his own son Turvasu thus, Yayati spoke these words to his son Druhyu born of Sarmistha:
verses.hindi: नयस्व च गृहंवत्स ममैतन्नात्र संशय: । सर्ववेदेष्वहुं वक्ता नान्‍यः कश्चित्तु मत्समः ॥ ततो ब्रह्मार्णव: क्षुब्धः समुद्र इब संप्लबे । तानुबाच ततः स्वस्थों याज्ञवक्यों हसश्निव
verses.wordMeaning: After cursing his own son Turvasu thus, Yayati spoke these words to his son Druhyu born of Sarmistha:
verses.commentary: Sense: After cursing his own son Turvasu thus, Yayati spoke these words to his son Druhyu born of Sarmistha:

verses.sanskrit: ते धन्या मानुषे लोके वन्द्या हि भुवि मानवाः । ये वसन्ति सदाकालं पादपद्माश्रया हरेः
verses.transliteration: te dhanyā mānuṣe loke vandyā hi bhuvi mānavāḥ / ye vasanti sadākālaṃ pādapadmāśrayā hareḥ
verses.translation: "O Druhyu, you accept my old age that destroys your complexion and beauty. Give unto mein exchange your youth fora period of one thousand years. When the thousand years are completed, I shall return your youth and take back again my sin along with the old age."
verses.hindi: क़ोध मा कार्षविद्वांसो भवन्‍तः सत्यवादिनः  वदामहे यथायुकक्‍तं जिज्ञासन्तः परस्परम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O Druhyu, you accept my old age that destroys your complexion and beauty. Give unto mein exchange your youth fora period of one thousand years. When the thousand years are completed, I shall return your youth and take back again my sin along with the old age."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Druhyu, you accept my old age that destroys your complexion and beauty. Give unto mein exchange your youth fora period of one thousand years. When the thousand years are completed, I shall return your youth and take back again my sin along with the old age."

verses.sanskrit: जलशायं प्रपश्यन्ति प्रत्यक्षं सुरनायकम् । पक्षोपवासं पाराकं व्रतं चान्द्रायणं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: jalaśāyaṃ prapaśyanti pratyakṣaṃ suranāyakam / pakṣopavāsaṃ pārākaṃ vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ śubham
verses.translation: An old man does not enjoy (a ride on) elephants, chariots and horses, nor can he enjoy a woman. He has no one to be in contact. Hence I do not like the old age.
verses.hindi: धनी होते हैं, अर्थात् उनकी श्रेष्ठता का परिचय विद्या से होता है। राजरषि जनक की ये बातें सुनकर वेद विशारद उन मुनियों ने उस बहुमूल्य धनराशि को अपनाने की अभिलाषा से अपने-अपने वेद ज्ञान के मद से उनन्‍्मत्त होकर एक दूसरे को वादविवाद के लिये ललकारा  उस समय अनेक के मन में यह भाव उठ रहे थे कि यह सब धन हमारा है, कोई-कोई यह सोच रहे थे कि सब कुछ मेरे ही लिये है। कोई अपने दूसरे साथी से पूछ रहा था कि बोलो यह हमारे ही लिये है न, अथवा किसी दूसरे के लिये । बोलो, क्या विकल्प कर रहे हो । इस प्रकार उन ऋषियों में उस धनराशि के लोभ के कारण अनेक तरह के वादविवाद उठ खड़े हये ।३५-४०। ठीक इसी अवसर पर वहाँ ब्रह्मवाहसुत, कवि, परमतेजस्वी, ब्रह्माज्ञानियों में श्रेष्ठ, महान् तपस्वी याज्ञवल्क्य नामक एक दूसरे ऋषि, जो ब्रह्मा के अंग से समुत्पन्न हुये थे, अपने शिष्यों से उच्च स्वर में बोले-अरे जी!
verses.wordMeaning: An old man does not enjoy (a ride on) elephants, chariots and horses, nor can he enjoy a woman. He has no one to be in contact. Hence I do not like the old age.
verses.commentary: Sense: An old man does not enjoy (a ride on) elephants, chariots and horses, nor can he enjoy a woman. He has no one to be in contact. Hence I do not like the old age.

verses.sanskrit: मासोपवासमुग्रं च षष्ठान्नं पञ्चमं व्रतम् । तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कुर्यात् सो ऽक्षयां गतिम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: māsopavāsamugraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhānnaṃ pañcamaṃ vratam / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kuryāt so 'kṣayāṃ gatim āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Since you, though born out of my own bosom, do not (Defective verse ) 1 2 An old man gives (the gift of age) to a child. (If I give up my youth) I shall become impure with your old age. An old man does not perform Homas at the proper time. I do not like that (type of) old age.
verses.hindi: जाकर इस धनराशि को उठा लो ।४१-४२। बत्स ! जाओ सब को उठाकर घर ले चलो, भरे, यह सब हमारे हो हैं, इसमें सन्देह मत करो। सभी वेदों में मैं ही एकमात्र अधिकारी प्रवक्ता हूँ, मेरे समान वेदों पर अधिकार रखने वाला दूसरा कोई नहीं है। जिस किसी ब्राह्मण को मेरी यह बात अच्छी न लगती हो वह सामने आ जाय, विलम्ब करने की कोई आवध्यकता नहीं है ? याज्ञवल्क्य की बातें सुनकर ब्राह्मण समुदाय प्रलय कालीन
verses.wordMeaning: Since you, though born out of my own bosom, do not (Defective verse ) 1 2 An old man gives (the gift of age) to a child. (If I give up my youth) I shall become impure with your old age. An old man does not perform Homas at the proper time. I do not like that (type of) old age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since you, though born out of my own bosom, do not (Defective verse ) 1 2 An old man gives (the gift of age) to a child. (If I give up my youth) I shall become impure with your old age. An old man does not perform Homas at the proper time. I do not like that (type of) old age.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि तिलधेनोश्च यत्फलम् । यथा यस्मिन्यदा देया दाने तस्याः शुभं फलम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tiladhenośca yatphalam / yathā yasminyadā deyā dāne tasyāḥ śubhaṃ phalam
verses.translation: Since you, though born out of my own bosom do not give unto me your (youthful) age, all those defects of old age mentioned by you will visit (afflict) you. Your children will die on attaining youthful age. You will have to devote to the scattering of fire like this (after cremating your children).
verses.hindi: समुद्र की भाँति क्षब्ध हो गया; पर स्वस्थ मनोवृत्ति सम्पन्न मुनिवर याज्ञवलक्य हँसते हुये से बोलते रहे । वे फिर बोले:-विहृद्वुन्द ! आप लोग हमारे ऊपर क्रुद्ध न हों, आप सभी सत्यवादी हैं। मैं सच कह रहा हूँ; भाप लोग परस्पर विचार कर इसका निश्चय करें ।४३-४५। तदनन्तर वहाँ पर उन में परम्पर अनेक वादविवाद करने लगे, धन लोभ से युक्त उन महात्मा ऋषियों में लोकिक, बंदिक तथा आध्यात्मिक विषयों पर सूक्ष्म दर्शन मं त्मैं . ह दद्यास्थों है... 400“ कक. हक न्डानक 4 कण लोके वेदे तथांउध्योत्में विद्यास्थानरलंकृ्ता । शापोत्तमगुणयुक्ता नपोर्भपरिवंजनी: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Since you, though born out of my own bosom do not give unto me your (youthful) age, all those defects of old age mentioned by you will visit (afflict) you. Your children will die on attaining youthful age.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since you, though born out of my own bosom do not give unto me your (youthful) age, all those defects of old age mentioned by you will visit (afflict) you. Your children will die on attaining youthful age.…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्कथान्तरं पुण्यमृषेर्द्वैपायनात्पुरा । श्रुतं हि नैमिषे पुण्ये नारदाद्यैरनेकधा
verses.transliteration: etatkathāntaraṃ puṇyamṛṣerdvaipāyanātpurā / śrutaṃ hi naimiṣe puṇye nāradādyairanekadhā
verses.translation: (He then spoke to Puru) O Puru, you accept my sin along with the old age. O dear one, old age, wrinkles and greyish hairs have overwhelmed me as a result of the curse of Kav-ya Usanas (Sukra). I am not satiated with the pleasures of youth. I shall enjoy the worldly pleasures with your youth. When a period of thousand years is completed I shall return you your youthful age. I shall also take back my own sin along with the old age. Thus requested, the son immediately replied to his father, "O father, I shall do as you wish.
verses.hindi: तास्विजित्य पुतीस्सर्वान्त्रह् राशिमहाओतिं: । शाकल्यमिति होवांच वादकर्तारंमअजसा ४६ शॉकल्य वद वक्तव्य कि ध्यायन्नेवतिष्ठसे । पूर्ण स्त्वे जडमानेन वाताध्मातो यथा दृतिः.... ५० एवं स धर्षितस्तेन रोषात्ताम्रास्थलोचनः । प्रोवाच योज्ञवल्क्य त॑ं परुषं सुनिसनिधी...
verses.wordMeaning: (He then spoke to Puru) O Puru, you accept my sin along with the old age. O dear one, old age, wrinkles and greyish hairs have overwhelmed me as a result of the curse of Kav-ya Usanas (Sukra). I am not satiated with the pleasures of youth.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (He then spoke to Puru) O Puru, you accept my sin along with the old age. O dear one, old age, wrinkles and greyish hairs have overwhelmed me as a result of the curse of Kav-ya Usanas (Sukra). I am not satiated with the pleasures of youth.…

verses.sanskrit: इदं परममायुष्यं मङ्गल्यं कीर्तिवर्धनम् । विप्राणां श्रावयन्विद्वान्फलानन्त्यंसमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: idaṃ paramamāyuṣyaṃ maṅgalyaṃ kīrtivardhanam / viprāṇāṃ śrāvayanvidvānphalānantyaṃsamaśnute
verses.translation: ardjabhrdjaoamias tvam in the text is obscure. Bd.P. v. 51 reads: ardjd rdjavamSas tvam which is better and is accepted here.

verses.transliteration: bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śayanaṃ striyaḥ / vibhaktadakṣiṇā hyetā dātāraṃ nāpnuvanti ca
verses.translation: yVrpaJ iiSuvaram dalle is obscure though translated above. For this Bd. read s: O king, I shall accept your sin along with your old age. Take from me my youthful age. Enjoy the pleasures as you wish.

verses.sanskrit: एकमेतत्प्रदातव्यं न बहूनां युधिष्ठिर । सा च विक्रयमापन्ना दहत्यासप्तमं कुलम्
verses.transliteration: ekametatpradātavyaṃ na bahūnāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / sā ca vikrayamāpannā dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam
verses.translation: I shall become disguised by your old age, assuming your form and age. Giving up my youthful age, I shall carry out what would be suitable (to the age assumed) ".
verses.hindi: (अनुभूति) जेनित सहुख्नों कल्याणकारी अर्थों के नवीत-नवीन- आविष्कार से युक्त विवाद होने।लगे,- उस समय? कोई किसी की बुद्धि की निन्‍्दा'कर रहे थे तो कोई किसी की युक्ति की उत्तम गुणों से प्रशंसा कर रहे थे ।- वे विस्तृत वादविवाद राजाओं के समूहों को नष्ट करने बाले थे। उस महान् वादत्विवाद में एक ओर सब के सब ऋषि सम्मिलित हये थे और दूसरी ओर अकेले- याज्ञवल्क्य-थे । उन सभी ऋषियों से -एक-एक करके - याज्ञमलकय ने प्रश्न किये. किन्तु किसी ने भी ठीक उत्तर नहीं. दिया ।४६-४८। तदुपरान्त ब्रह्मराशि, परम शोभा . सम्पन्न याज्ञवल्क्य ने उन सभी ऋषियों को पराजित कर विवाद करने में प्रमुख भाग लेने वाले शाकल्य नामक. ऋषि से शीघ्रता पूवेंक कहाः--शाकल्य ! कया विचांर कर रहे हो, अपनी जड़ता के कारण: तुम वाबु से भरी हुई. भाथी की तरह अभिमान से फूले हुये हो, बोलो, चुप क्यों बैठे हो । याज्ञवल्क्य-द्वारा इस प्रकार अपमानित होने
verses.wordMeaning: I shall become disguised by your old age, assuming your form and age. Giving up my youthful age, I shall carry out what would be suitable (to the age assumed) ".
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall become disguised by your old age, assuming your form and age. Giving up my youthful age, I shall carry out what would be suitable (to the age assumed) ".

verses.sanskrit: यथालाभा तु सर्वेषां चतुर्द्रोणा तु गौः स्मृता । द्रोणस्य वत्सकः कार्यो बहूनां वापि कामतः
verses.transliteration: yathālābhā tu sarveṣāṃ caturdroṇā tu gauḥ smṛtā / droṇasya vatsakaḥ kāryo bahūnāṃ vāpi kāmataḥ
verses.translation: O Puru, I am pleased with you. Welfare unto you. Delightedly I grant this unto you. All the subjects in your kingdom shall flourish and enjoy all pleasures (or your progeny will realise their desires, be affluent and rule over a kingdom). By means of the youthful age, Yayati, the son of Nahusa, became highly delighted and enjoyed all worldly plea-
verses.hindi: पर शोकल्य का मुख और नेत्र क्रोध से लाल हो गये । सभी ऋषियों के समीप में ही उन्होंने कठोर वाणी में: कहा. याज्वेल्क्य ! तुम हमें और इन श्रेष्ठ ऋषियों को तृणकी भाँति जीत कर इंस अतिमूल्यवान् विद्याधक
verses.wordMeaning: O Puru, I am pleased with you. Welfare unto you. Delightedly I grant this unto you. All the subjects in your kingdom shall flourish and enjoy all pleasures (or your progeny will realise their desires, be affluent and rule over a kingdom). By means of the youthful age, Yayati,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Puru, I am pleased with you. Welfare unto you. Delightedly I grant this unto you. All the subjects in your kingdom shall flourish and enjoy all pleasures (or your progeny will realise their desires, be affluent and rule over a kingdom). By means of the youthful age, Yayati,…

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्देशे तु यन्मानं विषये वा विचारितम् । तेन मानेन तां कुर्वन्नक्षयं फलम् अश्नुते
verses.transliteration: yasmindeśe tu yanmānaṃ viṣaye vā vicāritam / tena mānena tāṃ kurvannakṣayaṃ phalam aśnute
verses.translation: In the parks with (the celestial dam
verses.hindi: को अकेले अपने ही लेना चाहते हो' ।४६-५२। शाकल्य' के ऐसा कहने पर थाज्ञवेल्क्य ते सभी मुन्ियों के सामने कहा. अच्छे ब्रह्मज्ञानी ब्राह्मण का बल उनका विद्या का तत्त्वा्थ ज्ञान समझो, यतः काम (इच्छा ) का सम्बन्ध : अर्थ (धन) से पड़ता है, इसीलियें मैं भी धन की कामना करता हूँ । ब्राह्मण लोग इच्छानुकूल 'प्रइन करने: वाले होंते हैं, मैंने भी अपनी-अपनी इच्छा के अनुकूल प्रइन आप लोगों से किया । राजषि जनक का भ्रण भी यहीं था कि जो विंग्रे विद्या आदि में सरवेश्रेष्ठ सिद्ध हीं, वहीं पूज्य है, इसीलिये मैंने इस धनराशि को ग्रहण:

verses.transliteration: sukhapūrvaṃ śucau bhūmau puṣpadhūpākṣataistathā / karṇābhyāṃ ratne dātavye dīpau netradvaye tathā

verses.transliteration: śrīkhaṇḍamurasi sthāpyaṃ tābhyāṃ caiva tu kāñcanam / ūrdhve madhu ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ kuryāt sarṣaparomakam
