verses.sanskrit: कम्बले कम्बलं दद्याच्छ्रोण्यां मधु घृतं तथा । यवसं पायसं दद्याद् घृतं क्षौद्रसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: kambale kambalaṃ dadyācchroṇyāṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ tathā / yavasaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyād ghṛtaṃ kṣaudrasamanvitam
verses.translation: King Yayati, the son of Nahusa, took back his old age and Puru regained his own youthful age. When the king evinced his desire to crown his youngest son Puru, people of all castes with Brahmanas as the chief of them, spoke these words. 1 2
verses.hindi: देवमित्रस्तु शाकल्यों महात्मा द्विजसत्तमः  चकार संहिता: पत्च बुद्धिमान्पदवित्तम:.... ॥६ ३. तच्छिष्या अभवन्तच् मुद्गलो गोलक्स्तथा । खलीयश्न तथा मत्स्य: शेशिरेयस्तु पच्चम:.
verses.wordMeaning: King Yayati, the son of Nahusa, took back his old age and Puru regained his own youthful age. When the king evinced his desire to crown his youngest son Puru, people of all castes with Brahmanas as the chief of them, spoke these words. 1 2
verses.commentary: Sense: King Yayati, the son of Nahusa, took back his old age and Puru regained his own youthful age. When the king evinced his desire to crown his youngest son Puru, people of all castes with Brahmanas as the chief of them, spoke these words. 1 2

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्णशृङ्गी रूप्यशिफारुक्मलाङ्गूलसंयुता । रत्नपृष्ठी तु दातव्या कांस्यपात्रावदोहिनी
verses.transliteration: svarṇaśṛṅgī rūpyaśiphārukmalāṅgūlasaṃyutā / ratnapṛṣṭhī tu dātavyā kāṃsyapātrāvadohinī
verses.translation: "O lord, why do you set aside (the claim of) your eldest son, the excellent Yadu, the grandson of Sukra, the son of De.vayani, and bestow the kingdom on Puru?
verses.hindi: किया । याज्ञवेल्क्य की ऐसी बातें सुनकर शाकल्य मुनि ने क्रोध से मूच्छित होकर अपनी इच्छा के अनुरूप उनस प्रइन किया ।५३-१५५। अब मेरे पूछे प्रश्नों का यथार्थ उत्तर बोलो । तदनन्तर उन दोनों ब्रह्मज्ञामी ऋषियों में महान् विवाद हुआ  शाकल्य ने याज्ञवल्कय से एक सहख्र प्रइन कियें, जिनका उसी अवसर पर याजवल्क्य ने सभी ऋषियों को सुवते हुये उत्तर दिया। इस प्रकोर प्रश्त कर चकने पर जब शाकल्य च॒प हो गये तन याज्ञवत्क्य ने कहा, शाकल्य ! अब तुम मेरे केवल एक अभीष्ट प्रश्न का उत्तर दो किन्तु इस झास्त्रार्थ में एक वाजी यह रहेगी कि यदि प्रश्न का उत्तर न दे सकोगे तो मृत्यु को प्राप्त होगे  परम बुद्धिमान याज्वल्क्य के प्रघत कः तात्पर्य शाकल्य की बुद्धि में नहीं आया; परिणाम स्वरूप वेजश्ञीत्र ही मृत्यु को प्राप्त हो गये। याज्नवल्क्य के प्रन्‍त्त और व्याख्यान से पीड़ित होकर शाकल्य मुनि की मृत्यु हुई थी। इस प्रंकारं उस घन राशि
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, why do you set aside (the claim of) your eldest son, the excellent Yadu, the grandson of Sukra, the son of De.vayani, and bestow the kingdom on Puru?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, why do you set aside (the claim of) your eldest son, the excellent Yadu, the grandson of Sukra, the son of De.vayani, and bestow the kingdom on Puru?

verses.sanskrit: यत्स्याद्बाल्यकृतं पापं यद्वा कृतमजानता । वाचा कृतं कर्मकृतं मनसा यद्विचिन्तितम्
verses.transliteration: yatsyādbālyakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yadvā kṛtamajānatā / vācā kṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ manasā yadvicintitam
verses.translation: Yadu is your eldest son. Turvasu was born next to him. Sarmistha's eldest son is Druhyu, then comes Anu and then only Puru. How can the younger son deserve the kingdom super¬ seding (the claims of) the elder ones? Hence we urge you to abide by the (traditional) Dharma. 5>
verses.hindi: के चाहने वाले ऋषियों एवं मुनियों के सांथ याज्ञव्ल्क्य का महान विंवाद हुआ थां। उस अवसर पर उन सभी मुनियों के सेकड़ों क्या सहंस्रों जटिल प्रश्नों की भली भाँति व्याख्या करके महाबुद्धिमान, जितेन्द्रिय याशवल्क्य
verses.wordMeaning: Yadu is your eldest son. Turvasu was born next to him. Sarmistha's eldest son is Druhyu, then comes Anu and then only Puru. How can the younger son deserve the kingdom super¬ seding (the claims of) the elder ones? Hence we urge you to abide by the (traditional) Dharma. 5>
verses.commentary: Sense: Yadu is your eldest son. Turvasu was born next to him. Sarmistha's eldest son is Druhyu, then comes Anu and then only Puru. How can the younger son deserve the kingdom super¬ seding (the claims of) the elder ones? Hence we urge you to abide by the (traditional) Dharma. 5>

verses.sanskrit: जले निष्ठीवितं चैव मुशलं वापि लङ्घितम् । वृषलीगमनं चैव गुरुदारनिषेवणम्
verses.transliteration: jale niṣṭhīvitaṃ caiva muśalaṃ vāpi laṅghitam / vṛṣalīgamanaṃ caiva gurudāraniṣevaṇam
verses.translation: Bd. P.v. 69 reads: alad-dofa-nidarfanal 'because he failed to notice the defects (of passionate indulgence)'. This is a better reading as it states why he went with Visvaci.
verses.hindi: समुचित उत्तर दिया था और अपने यश का विस्तार कर सभी शिष्यों के साथ उस धनराशि को लेकर प्रसन्न मन से अपने विवा्स की ओर प्र॑संथान किया था। परम बुद्धिमान, पदों के अर्थों को जानने बाले मुनियों में सवश्रेष्ठ विप्रवय्य देवमित्र शाकल्य ने पाँच संहिताओं का प्रणयन किया था, उनके मुद्गल, गोलक, खलीय, मत्स्य और शेशिरेय तामक पाँच शिष्य थे ।५६-६४। द्विजश्र5 शाकपूर्ण रथीतर ने. तीन संहिताओं का-उपद्रेश किया तस्य शिष्यास्तु चत्वारः केतवों दालकिस्तथा । धर्मंशर्मा वेवशर्मा सर्वे ब्रतघरा ह्विजाः ३६६ शाकल्ये तु मृते सर्वे ब्रह्मध्नास्ते बभुविरे । तदा चिन्ता परां प्राप्य गतास्ते ब्रह्मणोन्तिकनसू.
verses.wordMeaning: Bd. P.v. 69 reads: alad-dofa-nidarfanal 'because he failed to notice the defects (of passionate indulgence)'. This is a better reading as it states why he went with Visvaci.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bd. P.v. 69 reads: alad-dofa-nidarfanal 'because he failed to notice the defects (of passionate indulgence)'. This is a better reading as it states why he went with Visvaci.

verses.sanskrit: कन्याया गमनं चैव सुवर्णस्तेयमेव च । सुरापानं तथा चान्यत्तिलधेनुः पुनाति हि
verses.transliteration: kanyāyā gamanaṃ caiva suvarṇasteyameva ca / surāpānaṃ tathā cānyattiladhenuḥ punāti hi
verses.translation: Verses 75-86 show that subjects did notallow injustice even if commit¬ ted by the king. Some sort of public sanction seems to be necessary for appointing a new king. O people of all castes with Brahmanas as leaders! Let all of you listen to my speech why I do not intend to give the kingdom to the elder ones.
verses.hindi: ताउज्ञात्वा चेतसा ब्रह्मा प्रेषित: पवने पुरे । तन्न गच्छत यूयं वः सचद्यः पाप॑ प्रणश्यति ६८ दादशार्क नमस्कृत्य तथा बे वालुकेश्वरम् । एकादश तथा रुद्रान्वायुपुत्रं बिशेषतः ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 75-86 show that subjects did notallow injustice even if commit¬ ted by the king. Some sort of public sanction seems to be necessary for appointing a new king.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 75-86 show that subjects did notallow injustice even if commit¬ ted by the king. Some sort of public sanction seems to be necessary for appointing a new king.…

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्रोपवासेन विधिवत्तां विसर्जयेत् । या सा यमपुरे घोरे नदी वैतरणी स्मृता
verses.transliteration: ahorātropavāsena vidhivattāṃ visarjayet / yā sā yamapure ghore nadī vaitaraṇī smṛtā
verses.translation: Only that son who carries out the words (orders) of his father and mother is considered praiseworthy. My behest was not obeyed by the eldest son Yadu.
verses.hindi: कुण्डे चतुष्टये स्नात्वा ब्रह्मह॒त्यां तरिष्यथ ३६६ सर्वे शीघ्रतरा भुत्वा तत्पुरं समुपागतः । स्नान कृत विधानेन देवानां दर्शन कृंतम् ३७० उत्तरेश्वरं ममस्कृत्य वाडवानां प्रसादतः । सर्वे पापविनिम्मुक्ता गतास्ते सुर्यंमण्डलम् ७१ अञ्जनोग सं भूतो हनुमान्पवनात्मजः । यदा जातो सहादेव हनुमान्सत्यविक्रमः ।।
verses.wordMeaning: Only that son who carries out the words (orders) of his father and mother is considered praiseworthy. My behest was not obeyed by the eldest son Yadu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only that son who carries out the words (orders) of his father and mother is considered praiseworthy. My behest was not obeyed by the eldest son Yadu.

verses.sanskrit: वालुकायोऽश्मस्थला च पच्यते यत्र दुष्कृती । अवीचिर्नरको यत्र यत्र यामलपर्वतौ
verses.transliteration: vālukāyo'śmasthalā ca pacyate yatra duṣkṛtī / avīcirnarako yatra yatra yāmalaparvatau
verses.translation: That son who is antagonistic to his father is not honoured or approved by good men. He is the real son who does his duties to his parents. I have been slighted by Yadu and also by Turvasu. Much discourtesy was shown by Druhyu and Anu too.
verses.hindi: तदेव निर्मितं तीर्थ वायुना ब्रह्मयोनिना.. 0७३ उ्व्याँ जातास्तु ये शुद्रा ब्राह्मणानां निवेदिता: । वृत्त्यर्थ ब्रह्मयज्ञार्थ करस्तेषु कृतो महान ७४
verses.wordMeaning: That son who is antagonistic to his father is not honoured or approved by good men. He is the real son who does his duties to his parents. I have been slighted by Yadu and also by Turvasu. Much discourtesy was shown by Druhyu and Anu too.
verses.commentary: Sense: That son who is antagonistic to his father is not honoured or approved by good men. He is the real son who does his duties to his parents. I have been slighted by Yadu and also by Turvasu. Much discourtesy was shown by Druhyu and Anu too.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र लोहमुखाः काका यत्र श्वानो भयंकराः । असिपत्त्रवनं चैव यत्र सा कूटशाल्मली
verses.transliteration: yatra lohamukhāḥ kākā yatra śvāno bhayaṃkarāḥ / asipattravanaṃ caiva yatra sā kūṭaśālmalī
verses.translation: I have been specially honoured by Puru who had carried out my behest. Though he is the youngest, he shall be my successor. It was he who accepted my old age. It was he who fulfilled all my desires. Everything has been done by Puru who carried out his duties as a son.
verses.hindi: था और फिर निरुक्त का प्रणययन किया, जो उनकी चौथी रचना थी । उनके केतव, दालकि, धर्म-शर्मा और देवशर्मा नामक चार हिंज शिष्य थे, जो सब के सब तपस्वी एवं विद्याब्रती थे ।६५-६६९। शाकल्य की मृत्यु के उपरान्त सभी ऋषियों को ब्रह्महत्या का पाप लगा, जिससे अति विन्तित होकर वे ब्रह्मा के समीप गये । मन से ही उन सबों की अभिलाषाओं को समझकर ब्रह्मा ने उन्हें पवनपुर को भेज दिया और कहा तुम लोग बहाँ जाओ, वहाँ जाने से शीघक्ष ही तुम सबों का पाप नष्ट हो जायगा । वहाँ पर बारहों सूर्य, बालुकेश्वर, ग्यारह एंद्र, विशेषतया वायुपुत्र॒ को नमस्कार करके तथा चारों कुण्डों में स्ताव कर ब्रह्महत्या से तुम लोग मुक्त हो जायेगे। ब्रह्मा की बातें सुत ऋषिगण वायुपुर के लिये प्रस्थित हुये और वहाँ जाकर उन्होंने विधिपु्वक स्तान एवं
verses.wordMeaning: I have been specially honoured by Puru who had carried out my behest. Though he is the youngest, he shall be my successor. It was he who accepted my old age. It was he who fulfilled all my desires. Everything has been done by Puru who carried out his duties as a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been specially honoured by Puru who had carried out my behest. Though he is the youngest, he shall be my successor. It was he who accepted my old age. It was he who fulfilled all my desires. Everything has been done by Puru who carried out his duties as a son.

verses.sanskrit: तान्सुखेन व्यतिक्रम्य धर्मराजालयं व्रजेत् । धर्मराजस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा सूनृतं वक्ति भारत
verses.transliteration: tānsukhena vyatikramya dharmarājālayaṃ vrajet / dharmarājastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā sūnṛtaṃ vakti bhārata
verses.translation: This boon has been granted by Sukra, Kavya, Usanas, himself—'O highly intelligent one, that son who is favourable to you shall be the king to succeed you.' Permitted by you all, may Puru be crowned as the ruler of the kingdom. The son who is endowed with all qualities and who is always loyal to his parents deserves all welfare. He is to be the lord (the king), though he may be the youngest.
verses.hindi: सूर्यभण्डल को चले गये । तभी से वह वायुपुर तामक पावन तीर्थ पापों का विनाश करने वाला हो गया, जिसका पृ्वेकाल में वायु ने निर्माण किया था। जिस समय अज्जनी के गर्भ से उत्पन्न होनेवाले पवनपुत्र हनूभान्, जिनका पराक्रम कभी भिथ्या (व्यथे) नहीं होता, उत्पन्न हुये थे, उसी समय ब्रह्मयोनि वायु ने उस पावन तीर्थ का निर्माण किया था ।६७-७३। पृथ्वी से उत्पन्न होने वाले, ब्राह्मणों के सेवक जो शुद्रगण उस पुर में उत्पन्त
verses.wordMeaning: This boon has been granted by Sukra, Kavya, Usanas, himself—'O highly intelligent one, that son who is favourable to you shall be the king to succeed you.' Permitted by you all, may Puru be crowned as the ruler of the kingdom.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This boon has been granted by Sukra, Kavya, Usanas, himself—'O highly intelligent one, that son who is favourable to you shall be the king to succeed you.' Permitted by you all, may Puru be crowned as the ruler of the kingdom.…

verses.sanskrit: विमानमुत्तमं योग्यं मणिरत्नविभूषितम् । अत्रारुह्य नरश्रेष्ठ प्रयाहि परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: vimānamuttamaṃ yogyaṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitam / atrāruhya naraśreṣṭha prayāhi paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Thus addressed by the delighted citizens and the
verses.hindi: हुए थे, उनके ऊपर ब्राह्मणों ने अपने जीवन-निर्वाह तथा ब्रह्मययज्ञ को सम्पन्न करने के लिये महानू कर धनुध्चिह्ान्तगंतग्रन्थो ग. ड. पुस्तकेयोर्नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed by the delighted citizens and the
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by the delighted citizens and the

verses.sanskrit: मा च चाटु भटे देहि मैव देहि पुरोहिते । मा च काणे विरूपे च न्यूनाङ्गे न च देवले
verses.transliteration: mā ca cāṭu bhaṭe dehi maiva dehi purohite / mā ca kāṇe virūpe ca nyūnāṅge na ca devale
verses.translation: The whole of this earth consisting of the seven "Never can lust subside by enjoyment of pleasures. Just as the fire gets ablaze all the more by ghee-oblations, so also desires get increased by indulgence.
verses.hindi: बाडादित्यं नमस्कृत्य सर्वेपापे: प्रसुच्यते ७५
verses.wordMeaning: The whole of this earth consisting of the seven "Never can lust subside by enjoyment of pleasures. Just as the fire gets ablaze all the more by ghee-oblations, so also desires get increased by indulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole of this earth consisting of the seven "Never can lust subside by enjoyment of pleasures. Just as the fire gets ablaze all the more by ghee-oblations, so also desires get increased by indulgence.

verses.sanskrit: अवेदविदुषे नैव ब्राह्मणे सर्वविक्रये । मित्रघ्ने च कृतघ्ने च मन्त्रहीने तथैव च
verses.transliteration: avedaviduṣe naiva brāhmaṇe sarvavikraye / mitraghne ca kṛtaghne ca mantrahīne tathaiva ca
verses.translation: All the grains and barley seeds, all the gold, all the cattle and all the women in the world are not sufficient for even one (person). He who realises this, does not become deluded.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते महास्थानतीर्थवेदशाखाप्रणयवर्णनं नाम षष्टितमोड्ष्याय: प्रनज़ा प्नल्लिल्यं छा च्तुव्की स्से स्‍्वम्त
verses.wordMeaning: All the grains and barley seeds, all the gold, all the cattle and all the women in the world are not sufficient for even one (person). He who realises this, does not become deluded.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the grains and barley seeds, all the gold, all the cattle and all the women in the world are not sufficient for even one (person). He who realises this, does not become deluded.

verses.sanskrit: वेदान्तगाय दातव्या श्रोत्रियाय कुटुम्बिने । वेदान्तगसुते देया श्रोत्रिये गृहपालके
verses.transliteration: vedāntagāya dātavyā śrotriyāya kuṭumbine / vedāntagasute deyā śrotriye gṛhapālake
verses.translation: When one maintains the purifying (auspicious) atti¬ tude to all living beings in thought, speech and action, one attains (realizes) Brahman. When one is not afraid of others, when others are not afraid of him, when one neither desires nor hates (anything),
verses.hindi: बाष्कलिश्व भरद्वाजस्तिस्रः प्रोवाच संहिता: । रथीतरो निरुकतं च पुनश्नक्के चतुर्थंकम्
verses.wordMeaning: When one maintains the purifying (auspicious) atti¬ tude to all living beings in thought, speech and action, one attains (realizes) Brahman. When one is not afraid of others, when others are not afraid of him, when one neither desires nor hates (anything),
verses.commentary: Sense: When one maintains the purifying (auspicious) atti¬ tude to all living beings in thought, speech and action, one attains (realizes) Brahman. When one is not afraid of others, when others are not afraid of him, when one neither desires nor hates (anything),

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गरुचिरे विप्रे सद्वृत्ते च प्रियंवदे । पूर्णिमायां तु माघस्य कार्त्तिक्याम् अथ भारत
verses.transliteration: sarvāṅgarucire vipre sadvṛtte ca priyaṃvade / pūrṇimāyāṃ tu māghasya kārttikyām atha bhārata
verses.translation: Happiness comes to one who eschews Trsna (cove¬ tousness), which cannot be got rid of by evil-minded ones, which does not subside even when one grows old and which is a foul disease full of fatal faults.
verses.hindi: लगाया था । इस प्रकार उस पुर में ब्राह्मणों की महती शासन व्यवस्था प्रचलित हुई थी, गोहसया करने वाला, कृतन्न, मद्यप अथवा गुरुस्त्री गामी ऐसे कठोर पाप करने वाले भी वाडादित्य को नमस्कार करके सभी पापों से मुक्त हो जाते हैं ऋषियों ने कहा--भारद्वाज, याज्वल्क्यथ गालकि, सालकि, बुद्धिमान् शतबलाक, ब्राद्मणश्रेष्ठ नेगेम॑,
verses.wordMeaning: Happiness comes to one who eschews Trsna (cove¬ tousness), which cannot be got rid of by evil-minded ones, which does not subside even when one grows old and which is a foul disease full of fatal faults.
verses.commentary: Sense: Happiness comes to one who eschews Trsna (cove¬ tousness), which cannot be got rid of by evil-minded ones, which does not subside even when one grows old and which is a foul disease full of fatal faults.

verses.sanskrit: वैशाख्यां मार्गशीर्ष्यां वाषाढ्यां चैत्र्याम् अथापि वा । अयने विषुवे चैव व्यतीपाते च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: vaiśākhyāṃ mārgaśīrṣyāṃ vāṣāḍhyāṃ caitryām athāpi vā / ayane viṣuve caiva vyatīpāte ca sarvadā
verses.translation: When one grows old, the hairs grow old; the teeth decay along with old age; but the hope for longevity and acquisition of wealth never grow old. The happiness arising from enjoyment of lust or by attaining the great pleasure in heaven does not deserve even a sixteenth part of the happiness resulting from-the destruction of covetousness".
verses.hindi: ओर बाष्कल के पुत्र भारद्दाज इन लोगों ने तीन संहिताओं का निर्माण किया था। रथीतर ने पुनः जिस निरुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: When one grows old, the hairs grow old; the teeth decay along with old age; but the hope for longevity and acquisition of wealth never grow old.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When one grows old, the hairs grow old; the teeth decay along with old age; but the hope for longevity and acquisition of wealth never grow old.…

verses.sanskrit: षडशीतिमुखे पुण्ये छायायां कुंजरस्य वा । एष ते कथितः कल्पस्तिलधेनोर् मयानघ
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍaśītimukhe puṇye chāyāyāṃ kuṃjarasya vā / eṣa te kathitaḥ kalpastiladhenor mayānagha
verses.translation: Verses 94-100 are the immortal verses quoted in various works and they constitute the moral of this episode.
verses.hindi: की रचना की थी, वह चतुर्थ था ।१-२। उसके महान्, सर्वगुणसम्पन्न, तीन शिष्य हुये. जिनमें से परम षडशीतिश्च तस्यथापि संहितानां विकल्पका: ६ सर्वेषामेव तेषां बे त्रिधा भेदाः प्रकीतिता:। त्रिधा भेदास्तु ते प्रोक्ता भेदेइस्मिन्नवमे शुभे ७
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 94-100 are the immortal verses quoted in various works and they constitute the moral of this episode.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 94-100 are the immortal verses quoted in various works and they constitute the moral of this episode.

verses.sanskrit: व्रजन्ति वैष्णवं लोकं दत्त्वा पादं यमोपरि । प्राणत्यागात् परं लोकं वैष्णवं नात्र संशयः । भित्त्वाशु भास्करं यान्ति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: vrajanti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ dattvā pādaṃ yamopari / prāṇatyāgāt paraṃ lokaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / bhittvāśu bhāskaraṃ yānti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: After saying this, the saintly king went to the forest along with his wife. He performed a great penance on Bhrgu- tunga 1 and performed hundreds of holy rites. Earning great fame, he attained,Svarga. His races are five thus. They are holy and rever¬ ed by Devas and sages. The whole earth is pervaded by them as if with the rays of the sun.
verses.hindi: इत्येते चरकाः प्रोक्ता: संहितावादिनों द्विजा:। ऋषयस्तद्चः श्रुत्वा सुतं जिज्ञासवो5बुबन् १० चरकाध्वयंव: केन कारण ब्रहि तत््वतः । कि चीर्ण कस्य हेतोश्व चरकत्वं च भेजिरे ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, the saintly king went to the forest along with his wife. He performed a great penance on Bhrgu- tunga 1 and performed hundreds of holy rites. Earning great fame, he attained,Svarga. His races are five thus. They are holy and rever¬ ed by Devas and sages.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the saintly king went to the forest along with his wife. He performed a great penance on Bhrgu- tunga 1 and performed hundreds of holy rites. Earning great fame, he attained,Svarga. His races are five thus. They are holy and rever¬ ed by Devas and sages.…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं चक्रतीर्थफलं नृप । यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवो भक्त्या सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ cakratīrthaphalaṃ nṛpa / yacchrutvā mānavo bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: An excellent Brahmana who reads this entire narra¬ tive of Yayati or listens to it, shall become wealthy, long-lived and renowned. He will be blessed with children.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्तः प्राह तेषां स चरकावमभूद्यथा ११ शिष्य बीतराग, महातेजस्वी तथा संहिताओं के पारगामी विद्वान थे, यतः इन्होंने संहिताओं का विस्तार-पूर्वक प्रवतंन किया था। भ्रतः बहवृच् के नाम से भी विख्यात हैं। यजुर्वेद की परम कल्याणप्रद छियासी संहिताओं का प्रणयन करने वाले वेशम्पायन जी यजुर्वेद के उद्धारक कहे गये हैं ।४-५। वैश्वम्पायन ने उस संहिताओं की शिक्षा अपने समस्त शिष्ष्यों को दी और उन लोगों ने विधिपूर्वक उन्हें ग्रहण किया, महातपस्वी मुनिवर याज्ञवल्क्य
verses.wordMeaning: An excellent Brahmana who reads this entire narra¬ tive of Yayati or listens to it, shall become wealthy, long-lived and renowned. He will be blessed with children.
verses.commentary: Sense: An excellent Brahmana who reads this entire narra¬ tive of Yayati or listens to it, shall become wealthy, long-lived and renowned. He will be blessed with children.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे जलशायितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम नवतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ९१ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल तीर्थपरमपावनम् । चण्डादित्यं नृपश्रेष्ठ स्थापितं चण्डमुण्डयोः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe jalaśāyitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 91 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaparamapāvanam / caṇḍādityaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha sthāpitaṃ caṇḍamuṇḍayoḥ
verses.translation: In all the changes of Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (the same) even for a moment. Due to the nature of destiny, it (the world) undergoes changes by way of decrease or increase.
verses.hindi: ही केवल एकमात्र उनकी शिक्षा से बच रहे । वे भी यजुर्वेद की छियासी संहिताओं की रचना करनेवाले हुये । इसके अतिरिक्त उनके सभो शिष्यगणों में भी तीन भेद कहे जाते हैं। इस प्रकार नव भेद युक्त संहिता के उदीच्य (उत्तरी) मध्यदेशीय और प्राच्य (पूर्वीय) ये तीन प्रमुख भेद कहे गये हैं। उनमें से उत्तर देसवासियों में ब्यामायनि, मध्यदेशवासियों में आरुणि और त्रयोदह्य्रादि, पूर्वीय देशवासियों में आलम्बि प्रधान माने गये
verses.wordMeaning: In all the changes of Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (the same) even for a moment. Due to the nature of destiny, it (the world) undergoes changes by way of decrease or increase.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the changes of Manvantaras that have been functioning for a long time, the world of living beings does not remain (the same) even for a moment. Due to the nature of destiny, it (the world) undergoes changes by way of decrease or increase.

verses.sanskrit: आस्तां पुरा महादैत्यौ चण्डमुण्डौ सुदारुणौ । नर्मदातीरमाश्रित्य चेरतुर् विपुलं तपः
verses.transliteration: āstāṃ purā mahādaityau caṇḍamuṇḍau sudāruṇau / narmadātīramāśritya ceratur vipulaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: It is highly meritorious to eulogise the lords born
verses.hindi: हैं ।६-९। वे सभी संहिताओं के जानने वाले द्विज गण चरक नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं। ऋषियों ने इस प्रकार सूत की बातें सुन कर जिज्ञासा प्रकट की किये अध्वर्युगण किस कारण चरक नाम से पुकारे जाते हैं। इसका वास्तविक कारण हमें बतलाइये कि इन्होंने ऐसे कौन से आचरण किये थे, जिसके कारण चरकत्व की प्राप्ति हुई। ऋषियों के इस प्रकार पूछने पर सूत ने बहु कथा बतलाई जिस प्रकार उन्हें चरकत्व की प्राप्ति के आषेत्वादेकवचनम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is highly meritorious to eulogise the lords born
verses.commentary: Sense: It is highly meritorious to eulogise the lords born

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायन्तौ भास्करं देवं तमोनाशं जगत्त्रये । तुष्टस्तत्तपसा देवः सहस्रांशुरुवाच ह
verses.transliteration: dhyāyantau bhāskaraṃ devaṃ tamonāśaṃ jagattraye / tuṣṭastattapasā devaḥ sahasrāṃśuruvāca ha
verses.translation: It is conducive to the attainment of heaven. It is very holy, highly esoteric, capable of granting progeny. It should be recited during great parvan days. It is conducive to the removal of the effects of bad dreams and is conducive to longevity.
verses.hindi: कार्यमासीदूषीणां च किचिद्ब्राह्मणसत्तमा: । सेरुपृष्ठं तदा गत्वा सम्पत्त्यर्थ तु मस्त्रितम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is conducive to the attainment of heaven. It is very holy, highly esoteric, capable of granting progeny. It should be recited during great parvan days. It is conducive to the removal of the effects of bad dreams and is conducive to longevity.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is conducive to the attainment of heaven. It is very holy, highly esoteric, capable of granting progeny. It should be recited during great parvan days. It is conducive to the removal of the effects of bad dreams and is conducive to longevity.

verses.sanskrit: साधु साध्विति तौ पार्थ नर्मदायाः शुभे तटे । वरं प्रार्थयतं वीरौ यथेष्टं चेतसेच्छितम्
verses.transliteration: sādhu sādhviti tau pārtha narmadāyāḥ śubhe taṭe / varaṃ prārthayataṃ vīrau yatheṣṭaṃ cetasecchitam
verses.translation: Resort to the great principle Sumahesa for attaining Siddhis. Resort to this Purana which contains the narratives of Prajapatis, Devas, Sages, the well-known yet sacred origination of the unborn Lord and for the fulfilment of my narration.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणानां तु बजनादब्रह्मवध्यां चकार सः । शिष्यानथ समानीय स वेशम्पायनो5ब्रबीत् १५ ब्रह्मवध्यां चरध्वं वे सत्कृते द्विजसत्तमाः  सर्वे यूयं समागम्य ब्रूत सेतद्धितं बचः १६ एवमुक्तस्ततः कद्धों याज्ञवल्क्यमथात्रवीत् । उवाच यक्त्वया5धीत॑ सर्वे प्रत्यपंयस्व से १८ एवमुक्तः स रूपाणि यजुंषि प्रददो गुरोः। रुघिरेण तथाक्तानि छरदित्वा ब्रह्मवित्तमाः ११६
verses.wordMeaning: Resort to the great principle Sumahesa for attaining Siddhis. Resort to this Purana which contains the narratives of Prajapatis, Devas, Sages, the well-known yet sacred origination of the unborn Lord and for the fulfilment of my narration.
verses.commentary: Sense: Resort to the great principle Sumahesa for attaining Siddhis. Resort to this Purana which contains the narratives of Prajapatis, Devas, Sages, the well-known yet sacred origination of the unborn Lord and for the fulfilment of my narration.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डमुण्डावूचतुः । अजेयौ सर्वदेवानां भूयास्वावां समाहितौ । सर्वरोगैः परित्यक्तौ सर्वकालं दिवाकर
verses.transliteration: caṇḍamuṇḍāvūcatuḥ / ajeyau sarvadevānāṃ bhūyāsvāvāṃ samāhitau / sarvarogaiḥ parityaktau sarvakālaṃ divākara
verses.translation: Thus I have described the Svayambhuva Manvantara in detail and in the proper order. What more shall I describe to you?
verses.hindi: खूत ने कहा--ब्राह्मणश्रेष्टवृन्द ! प्राचीन काल में एक समय ऋषियों को कोई एक ऐसा कार्य आ पडा जिसमें सुमेरु पर्वत पर जाकर वे सब सम्पत्ति के लिये उपस्थित हुयें थे। उस समय उन्होंने यह् प्रण॑ किया था कि जो ब्राह्मण सात रात के बीच में हमारी इस मन्त्रणा में सहयोग देने के लिये नहीं आ जाता है वह ब्रह्महत्या का पाप ग्रहण करेगा, ऐसी हम लोगों की प्रतिज्ञा है। ऋषियों की ऐसी प्रतिज्ञा सुतकर सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus I have described the Svayambhuva Manvantara in detail and in the proper order. What more shall I describe to you?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have described the Svayambhuva Manvantara in detail and in the proper order. What more shall I describe to you?

verses.sanskrit: एवमस्त्विति तौ प्राह भास्करो वारितस्करः । इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे भानुर्दैत्याभ्यां तत्र भास्करः
verses.transliteration: evamastviti tau prāha bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ / ityuktvāntardadhe bhānurdaityābhyāṃ tatra bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: I wish to know precisely the order of Manvantaras 1 and all the respective deities pertaining to the different Manvan¬ taras.
verses.hindi: ऋषिमुनि अपने-अपने दिष्यादि को साथ ले लेकर वहीं उपस्थित हुये, जहाँ पहुँचने के लिये प्रतिज्ञा की गई थी केवल वैशम्पायन ऋषि वहाँ नहीं गये ।१२-१४। और इस प्रकार समान ब्र।ह्ाणों के बचनानुसार वे ब्रह्महत्या के भागी हुये । वेशम्पायल ने उस अवसर पर अपने शिथ्यों को बुलाकर कहा-+द्विजवयव॒न्द  तुम सब लोग मिलकर मेरे लिये इस ब्रद्माहत्या के पाप का भोग करो, कहो, क्या यह मेरी बात हितकर नहीं है याज्षवलक््य बोले--“मैं इस ब्रह्महत्या का अनुभव करूँगा ये मुनिगण आपके साथ ही रहें । अपनी तपस्या द्वारा पराक्रम संचय करके मैं उसका अनुभव करने में समर्थ होऊंगा ।”” याज्ञवल्क्य के ऐसा कहने पर वैशम्पायन ने क्रद्व होकर उनसे कहा- तुमने जो कुछ मुझसे अंध्ययन किया है वह सब लौटा दो
verses.wordMeaning: I wish to know precisely the order of Manvantaras 1 and all the respective deities pertaining to the different Manvan¬ taras.
verses.commentary: Sense: I wish to know precisely the order of Manvantaras 1 and all the respective deities pertaining to the different Manvan¬ taras.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापितः परया भक्त्या तं गच्छेदात्मसिद्धये । गीर्वाणांश्च मनुष्यांश्च पित्ःंस् तत्रापि तर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: sthāpitaḥ parayā bhaktyā taṃ gacchedātmasiddhaye / gīrvāṇāṃśca manuṣyāṃśca pitḥṃs tatrāpi tarpayet
verses.translation: Listen to and understand as I recount succinctly and in detail, the Manvantaras which have gone and which are yet to come.
verses.hindi: बेशम्पायन के इस प्रकार कहने पर ब्रह्मज्ञानियों में सर्वश्रेष्ठ मुनिव॒र याज्ञवल्क्य ने वन द्वारा रुधिर से भींगे हुये समस्त यजुर्वेद को मूते रूप में गुरु के सम्मुख प्रत्यंपेण कर दिया । ह्विजवुन्द ! तदनन्तर याज्ञवल्क्य मुनि ने ध्यान लगाकर सूर्य की आराधना की, उस समय आकाश मण्डल में जितने ऊपर जाकर सूर्य रूप ब्रह्म
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to and understand as I recount succinctly and in detail, the Manvantaras which have gone and which are yet to come.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to and understand as I recount succinctly and in detail, the Manvantaras which have gone and which are yet to come.

verses.sanskrit: स वसेद् भास्करे लोके विरिञ्चिदिवसं नृप । घृतेन बोधयेद्दीपं षष्ठ्यां स च नरेश्वर । मुच्यते सर्वपापैस्तु प्रतियाति पुरं रवेः
verses.transliteration: sa vased bhāskare loke viriñcidivasaṃ nṛpa / ghṛtena bodhayeddīpaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sa ca nareśvara / mucyate sarvapāpaistu pratiyāti puraṃ raveḥ
verses.translation: The first Manu was Svayambhuva and then there was Svarocisa Manu. Thereafter the Manus wereAuttama, Tamasa, They arc the five Savarnas, Raucya, Bhautya and Vai- vasvata. I shall explain them after Vaivasvata Manu.
verses.hindi: ततो यानि गतास्यूध्व॑ यजुंष्यादित्यमण्डलम् । तानि तस्मे ददौ तुष्ठः सूर्यो वे ब्रह्मरातये ॥ प्जूध्यधीयन्ते यात्रि ब्राह्मणा येन केन च । अश्वरूपाय दत्तानि ततस्ते बाजिनोउभवन् २२ ब्रह्महत्या तु येश्चीर्णा चरणाच्चरका: स्पृता: । वेशम्पायनशिष्यास्ते चरका: समुदाहताः
verses.wordMeaning: The first Manu was Svayambhuva and then there was Svarocisa Manu. Thereafter the Manus wereAuttama, Tamasa, They arc the five Savarnas, Raucya, Bhautya and Vai- vasvata. I shall explain them after Vaivasvata Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first Manu was Svayambhuva and then there was Svarocisa Manu. Thereafter the Manus wereAuttama, Tamasa, They arc the five Savarnas, Raucya, Bhautya and Vai- vasvata. I shall explain them after Vaivasvata Manu.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पत्तिं चण्डभानोर्यः शृणोति भरतर्षभ । विजयी स सदा नूनमाधिव्याधिविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: utpattiṃ caṇḍabhānoryaḥ śṛṇoti bharatarṣabha / vijayī sa sadā nūnamādhivyādhivivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: Know the five Manus who have passed away to be Manavas. The Manvantara of Svayambhuva Manu which lias already passed has been described by me.
verses.hindi: इत्येते चरकाः प्रोक्ता बाजिनस्तान्निबोधत । याज्ञवल्क्यस्य शिष्पास्ते कण्ववेधेयशालिनः (२४
verses.wordMeaning: Know the five Manus who have passed away to be Manavas. The Manvantara of Svayambhuva Manu which lias already passed has been described by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know the five Manus who have passed away to be Manavas. The Manvantara of Svayambhuva Manu which lias already passed has been described by me.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे चण्डादित्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकनवतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ९२ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र यमहास्यमनुत्तमम् । सर्वपापहरं तीर्थं नर्मदातटमाश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe caṇḍādityatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 92 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra yamahāsyamanuttamam / sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritam
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shall describe briefly the activity of crea¬ tion by Svarocisa, the second Manu of noble soul."
verses.hindi: इत्येते वाजिन: प्रोक्ता दश पत्च घ्॒ संस्मृता:। शतमेकाधिक कृत्स्नं यजुर्षां वे विकल्पका: +सुकर्माणं सुत॑ सुत्वा पुत्रमध्यापयत्प्रभुः १२७ स सहल्नमधीत्याउश्शु सुकर्माध्प्यथ संहिता: । प्रोवाचाथ सहस्नस्य सुकर्मा सुर्यवर्चसः
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, I shall describe briefly the activity of crea¬ tion by Svarocisa, the second Manu of noble soul."
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, I shall describe briefly the activity of crea¬ tion by Svarocisa, the second Manu of noble soul."

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: यमहास्यं कथं जातं पृथिव्यां द्विजपुंगव । एतत्सर्वं ममाख्याहि परं कौतूहलं हि मे
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: yamahāsyaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ dvijapuṃgava / etatsarvaṃ mamākhyāhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
verses.translation: In the Svarocisa Manvantara, there were the Devas called Tusitas and the learned scholars called Paravatas. Only these two are remembered as the groups of Devas.
verses.hindi: अनध्यायेष्वधोयानांस्ताअुजघान शतक़तुः । प्रायोपवेशमक रोत्ततोइसौ शिष्पकारणात् ...
verses.wordMeaning: In the Svarocisa Manvantara, there were the Devas called Tusitas and the learned scholars called Paravatas. Only these two are remembered as the groups of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Svarocisa Manvantara, there were the Devas called Tusitas and the learned scholars called Paravatas. Only these two are remembered as the groups of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञ पृष्टो ऽहं नृपनन्दन । स्नानार्थं नर्मदां पुण्यामागतस्ते पिता पुरा
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sādhu sādhu mahāprājña pṛṣṭo 'haṃ nṛpanandana / snānārthaṃ narmadāṃ puṇyāmāgataste pitā purā
verses.translation: They were born of Tusita as the sons of Kralu, the Svarocisa (Manu). The Paravatas and the remaining ones—these two Ganas (groups) consist of twelve each. (Thus) all these Devas together are remembered as chandajas and they are twen¬ ty-four (in number).
verses.hindi: प्रतिष्ठित था उतने ही ऊपर उठ उठकर वह समस्त यजुत्रद सूर्य मण्डल में आश्रय लेने लगा । जिससे सन्तुष्ट होकर मार्तण्ड सूथं-देव ने सभी यजुवंद को अश्वरूप धारण करने वाले, ब्रद्मश्ञानी परम बुद्धिमान् याज्ञवल्क्य को प्रदान किया ।१९-२१। अइवरूप धारण करने वाले याज्ञवल्क्य को दिये गये उस यजुवंद का अध्ययन करने वाले ब्राह्मण अद्वरूपधारी हुये । जिन वेशम्पायन के शिष्यों ने उनके साथ ब्रह्महत्या का अनुभव किया था, वे चरण (अनुभव करने) के कारण चरक नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुये । चरकों का वृत्तान्त वर्णन कर चुका अब याज्ञवस्तय के शिष्यों का जो अश्वरूपधारी थे, वत्तान्त सुनिये । कण्व, वेधेयशाली, मध्यन्दिन, शापेयी, विदिग्ध, आप्य,
verses.wordMeaning: They were born of Tusita as the sons of Kralu, the Svarocisa (Manu). The Paravatas and the remaining ones—these two Ganas (groups) consist of twelve each. (Thus) all these Devas together are remembered as chandajas and they are twen¬ ty-four (in number).
verses.commentary: Sense: They were born of Tusita as the sons of Kralu, the Svarocisa (Manu). The Paravatas and the remaining ones—these two Ganas (groups) consist of twelve each. (Thus) all these Devas together are remembered as chandajas and they are twen¬ ty-four (in number).

verses.sanskrit: रजकेन यथा धौतं वस्त्रं भवति निर्मलम् । तथासौ निर्मलो जातो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: rajakena yathā dhautaṃ vastraṃ bhavati nirmalam / tathāsau nirmalo jāto dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Dhaivasyasa, Vamanya, Gopa, Devayata, lord Aja, the powerful lord Durona, Apa of powerful arms, the vigorous Mahaujas, C.ikitvan, Nibhrta, Viryavan, and Amsa: these were the sons of Kratu. They were then the imbibers of Soma.
verses.hindi: धारी) जन कहे गये हैं । समस्त यजुर्वेद में एक सौ एक विकल्पक (संहिता भाग) देखे जाते हैं ।२२-२६। ज॑मिनि ने अपने पुत्र सुमन्‍्त को समस्त यजुर्वेद का अध्ययन कराया था। परम ऐश्वर्यशाली सुमन्‍्तु ने अपने पुत्र सुत्वा को उसे पढ़ाया । प्रभु सुत्वा ने अपने पुत्र सुकर्मा को उसकी शिक्षा दी । सुकर्मा ने इन सहस्र संहिताओं का अल्प समम में अध्ययन कर सूर्य के समान तेजस्वी अपने एक सहस्र शिष्यों को उसका अध्ययन कराया ।
verses.wordMeaning: Dhaivasyasa, Vamanya, Gopa, Devayata, lord Aja, the powerful lord Durona, Apa of powerful arms, the vigorous Mahaujas, C.ikitvan, Nibhrta, Viryavan, and Amsa: these were the sons of Kratu. They were then the imbibers of Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhaivasyasa, Vamanya, Gopa, Devayata, lord Aja, the powerful lord Durona, Apa of powerful arms, the vigorous Mahaujas, C.ikitvan, Nibhrta, Viryavan, and Amsa: these were the sons of Kratu. They were then the imbibers of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: स पश्यन्निर्मलं देहं हसन्प्रोवाच विस्मितः
verses.transliteration: sa paśyannirmalaṃ dehaṃ hasanprovāca vismitaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Pracetas, Visvedeva, Samanja who was well known, Ajihma the suppressor of enemies, Ajihmana and Mahl- yana endowed with learning, the blessed Aja and Usa, Yavxya of great strength, Hotr and Yajva were the Paravatas of great exploit. These all were the deities whofunctioned in the Svaro¬ cisa Manvantara.
verses.hindi: किन्तु अनध्याय के दिन अध्ययन करने के कारण इन्द्र ने उन सभी शिष्यों का संहार कर डाला, जिससे दुःखी इत्युक्टवा बासवः श्रीमान्सुकर्माणं यशस्विनम् । शान्तक्रोध॑ं द्विजं दृष्ट्वा तत्रवान्तरधीयत ३२
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Pracetas, Visvedeva, Samanja who was well known, Ajihma the suppressor of enemies, Ajihmana and Mahl- yana endowed with learning, the blessed Aja and Usa, Yavxya of great strength, Hotr and Yajva were the Paravatas of great exploit.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Pracetas, Visvedeva, Samanja who was well known, Ajihma the suppressor of enemies, Ajihmana and Mahl- yana endowed with learning, the blessed Aja and Usa, Yavxya of great strength, Hotr and Yajva were the Paravatas of great exploit.…

verses.sanskrit: यम उवाच: मत्पुरं कथम् आयान्ति मनुजाः पापबृंहिताः । स्नानेनैकेन रेवायाः प्राप्यते वैष्णवं पदम्
verses.transliteration: yama uvāca: matpuraṃ katham āyānti manujāḥ pāpabṛṃhitāḥ / snānenaikena revāyāḥ prāpyate vaiṣṇavaṃ padam
verses.translation: At that time these twenty-four Devatas (deities) were the imbibers of Soma. Their Indra (ruler and leader) was Vaidha who was world-famous.
verses.hindi: लोकाक्षी कुथुमिश्चेव कुशीती लाज्भलिस्तथा । पौष्यञ्जिशिष्याश्रत्वारस्तेषां भेदान्चिबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: At that time these twenty-four Devatas (deities) were the imbibers of Soma. Their Indra (ruler and leader) was Vaidha who was world-famous.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time these twenty-four Devatas (deities) were the imbibers of Soma. Their Indra (ruler and leader) was Vaidha who was world-famous.

verses.sanskrit: समर्था ये न पश्यन्ति रेवां पुण्यजलां शुभाम् । जात्यन्धैस्ते समा ज्ञेया मृतैः पङ्गुभिरेव वा
verses.transliteration: samarthā ye na paśyanti revāṃ puṇyajalāṃ śubhām / jātyandhaiste samā jñeyā mṛtaiḥ paṅgubhireva vā
verses.translation: The Saptarsis (the Seven Sages) were Orja the son of Vasistha, Stambha the son ofKasyapa, Drona the sonofBhrgu,
verses.hindi: सकंतिपुत्र: सहसात्यपुत्र एतान्मेदान्वित्त लोकाक्षिणस्तु ॥३ ७ अयस्तु कुथुमे: पुत्रा औरसो रसपासर: । भागवित्तिश्न तेजस्वी त्रिविधाः कोथुमाः स्मृताः ॥रे८ होकर शिष्यों के लिए सुकर्मा प्रायोपवेश) करने पर उतारू हो मये। सुकर्मा को इस प्रकार क्र देखकर इन्द्र ने उन्हें फिर वरदान दिया कि तुम्हारे अग्नि के समान परम तेजस्वी एवं महान् पराक्रमी दो शिष्य होंगे ।३७-३०। है द्विजसत्तम ! वे आपके दोनों महाभाग्यशाली शिष्य महान पण्डित होंगे और इन सहख् संहिताओों का विधिवत् अध्ययन करेंगे आप क्रोध न करें। परम यशस्वी द्विजश्रेष्ठ से ऐसी बातें कहकर
verses.wordMeaning: The Saptarsis (the Seven Sages) were Orja the son of Vasistha, Stambha the son ofKasyapa, Drona the sonofBhrgu,
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saptarsis (the Seven Sages) were Orja the son of Vasistha, Stambha the son ofKasyapa, Drona the sonofBhrgu,

verses.sanskrit: समर्था ये न पश्यन्ति रेवां पुण्यजलां नदीम् । एतस्मात् कारणाद् राजन्हसितो लोकशासनः
verses.transliteration: samarthā ye na paśyanti revāṃ puṇyajalāṃ nadīm / etasmāt kāraṇād rājanhasito lokaśāsanaḥ
verses.translation: There are some variations in the names of future Manus in some Puranas. Our Purana gives some different names (such as Raucya and Bhautya) of future Manus.
verses.hindi: और उनके क्रोध को शान्‍्त देखकर श्रीमान् इन्द्र वहीं पर अस्तर्धान हो गये  है द्विजवय्य॑व॒न्द ! उन सुकर्मा के परम बुद्धिमान् पौष्यझजी नामक प्रथम और हिरण्यनाभ राजा कौशिल्य नामक द्वितीय शिष्य हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: There are some variations in the names of future Manus in some Puranas. Our Purana gives some different names (such as Raucya and Bhautya) of future Manus.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are some variations in the names of future Manus in some Puranas. Our Purana gives some different names (such as Raucya and Bhautya) of future Manus.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयित्वा यमस्तत्र देवं स्वर्गं जगाम ह । यमहासेश्वरे राजञ्जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: sthāpayitvā yamastatra devaṃ svargaṃ jagāma ha / yamahāseśvare rājañjitakrodho jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Verses 6-22 enumerate and describe the fuiicuonaries (gods, Indra etc.) during the second Manvantara.
verses.hindi: जिनमें से पौष्यञ्जी ने पाँच सौ संहिताओं को अपने शिष्यों को पढ़ाया। पौष्यञ्जी के वे कल्याणभाजन शिष्य सामान्यतः उदीच्य के नाम से विख्यात थे  पराक्रमी कौशिल्य ने भी पाँच सौ सहिताओं की शिक्षा अपने शिष्यों को दी। हिरण्यनाभ नराधिप कौशिल्य के शिष्यगण प्रान्‍्य सामग के नाम से विख्यात दुए । अब पीष्यञ्जी के लोकाक्षी, कुथुमि, कुशीती और लाज्भलि नामक जो चार शिष्य हो गये हैं, उनके भेदों को सुनिये ।३४-३६॥। तण्डिपुत्र, राणायनीय, सुविद्वान् मूलचारी, कैतिपुत्र, और सात्यपुत्र-ये सभी लोकाक्षी के शिष्यों के नाम हैं। कुथमि के औरस, रसपासर और तेजस्वी भागवित्ति नामक तीन पुत्र थे, जी तीनों कोथम नाम से प्रसिद्ध थे। शौरिद्य और श्रजद्धिपुत्र ये दो परम तपस्वी एवं ब्रतपरायण थे, राणायनीम और सोमित्रि ये दो सामवेद के विशारद थे ।३७-३६। महान् तपस्वी शज्भपुत्र ने तीन संहिताओं का उपदेश
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 6-22 enumerate and describe the fuiicuonaries (gods, Indra etc.) during the second Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 6-22 enumerate and describe the fuiicuonaries (gods, Indra etc.) during the second Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषाच्चाश्विने मासि कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् । उपोष्य परया भक्त्या सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: viśeṣāccāśvine māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm / upoṣya parayā bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Caitra, Kaviruta,Krtanta, Ravi, Brhat, Guha, Nava and Subha 1: these nine are rememberd as the sons of Svarocisa Manu who established his race. They have been enumerated in the Purana. Such is the second Manvantara.
verses.hindi: १. किसी घोर पाप का प्रायदिचत्त पूवंकाल में बिना कुछ खाये पीये एक स्थान पर बेठकर प्राण त्याग कर के किया जाता था, उसी को प्रायोपवेश कहा जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Caitra, Kaviruta,Krtanta, Ravi, Brhat, Guha, Nava and Subha 1: these nine are rememberd as the sons of Svarocisa Manu who established his race. They have been enumerated in the Purana. Such is the second Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Caitra, Kaviruta,Krtanta, Ravi, Brhat, Guha, Nava and Subha 1: these nine are rememberd as the sons of Svarocisa Manu who established his race. They have been enumerated in the Purana. Such is the second Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याद्दीपं देवस्य बोधयेत् । घृतेन चैव राजेन्द्र शृणु तत्रास्ति यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāddīpaṃ devasya bodhayet / ghṛtena caiva rājendra śṛṇu tatrāsti yatphalam
verses.translation: The Seven Sages, Manu, Devas and Pitrs—these four constitute theroot (and foundation)of a Manvantara. All the subjects are subsidiary to them.
verses.hindi: भालुकिः कामहानिश्च जेमसिनिलोमिगायिनि: । कण्डुश्व कीहलश्चंव षडेते लाज्भला: स्मृताः ॥॥ ततो हिरण्पनाभस्य कृतशिष्यो नृपात्मजः । सो5करोच्च चतुविशत्संहिता द्विपदां बरः॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Seven Sages, Manu, Devas and Pitrs—these four constitute theroot (and foundation)of a Manvantara. All the subjects are subsidiary to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Seven Sages, Manu, Devas and Pitrs—these four constitute theroot (and foundation)of a Manvantara. All the subjects are subsidiary to them.

verses.sanskrit: मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैर् अगम्यागमनोद्भवैः । अभक्ष्यभक्षणोद्भूतैर् अपेयापेयजैर् अपि
verses.transliteration: mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvair agamyāgamanodbhavaiḥ / abhakṣyabhakṣaṇodbhūtair apeyāpeyajair api
verses.translation: Deities are the sons of Sages, Pitrs are the sons of Devas and the Sages are the sons of Devas—This is the conclusion of the Sastras (Scriptures).
verses.hindi: राड्श्न मह॒वीय॑श्व पत्चमो वाहनस्तथा। तालकः पाण्डकश्चव कालिको राजिकस्तथा ॥। गोतमश्चाजबस्तश्च सोमराजा5पतत्ततः
verses.wordMeaning: Deities are the sons of Sages, Pitrs are the sons of Devas and the Sages are the sons of Devas—This is the conclusion of the Sastras (Scriptures).
verses.commentary: Sense: Deities are the sons of Sages, Pitrs are the sons of Devas and the Sages are the sons of Devas—This is the conclusion of the Sastras (Scriptures).

verses.sanskrit: अवाह्यवाहिते यत्स्याद् अदोह्यादोहने यथा । स्नानमात्रेण तस्यैवं यान्ति पापान्यनेकधा
verses.transliteration: avāhyavāhite yatsyād adohyādohane yathā / snānamātreṇa tasyaivaṃ yānti pāpānyanekadhā
verses.translation: Ksatriyas and Vaisyas were born of Manu and Brahmanas were born of the Seven Sages. Thus the Manvan¬ tara has been described in brief, not in details.
verses.hindi: पृष्टघ्नः परिक्ृष्श्च उलूखलक एवं च। यवीयसश्च वशालो अहगुलीयश्च कोशिकः सालिसञ्जरिसत्यश्च कापीयः कानिकश्च यः । पराशरश्च धर्मात्मा इति क्रान्तास्तु सामगाः
verses.wordMeaning: Ksatriyas and Vaisyas were born of Manu and Brahmanas were born of the Seven Sages. Thus the Manvan¬ tara has been described in brief, not in details.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksatriyas and Vaisyas were born of Manu and Brahmanas were born of the Seven Sages. Thus the Manvan¬ tara has been described in brief, not in details.

verses.sanskrit: यमलोकं न वीक्षेत मनुजः स कदाचन । पित्ःणां परमं गुह्यमिदं भूमौ नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: yamalokaṃ na vīkṣeta manujaḥ sa kadācana / pitḥṇāṃ paramaṃ guhyamidaṃ bhūmau nareśvara
verses.translation: The detailed description of the Svarocisa Manvantara should be understood through (thatof) Svayambhuva Manvan¬ tara. It is impossible to describe it in detail even in hundreds of years, since the progenies are many in every family and they are oft-repeated.
verses.hindi: सामगानां तु सर्वेषां श्रेष्ठो द्वो तु प्रकीतितों । पौष्यजिश्च कृतिश्चव संहितानां विकल्पको ४८ अथर्वाणं द्विधा कृत्वा सुमन्तुरददाद्द्िजा: । कबन्धाय गुरु: कृत्स्तं स च विद्याद्यथाक्रमम्
verses.wordMeaning: The detailed description of the Svarocisa Manvantara should be understood through (thatof) Svayambhuva Manvan¬ tara. It is impossible to describe it in detail even in hundreds of years, since the progenies are many in every family and they are oft-repeated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The detailed description of the Svarocisa Manvantara should be understood through (thatof) Svayambhuva Manvan¬ tara. It is impossible to describe it in detail even in hundreds of years, since the progenies are many in every family and they are oft-repeated.

verses.sanskrit: ददताम् अक्षयं सर्वं यमहास्ये न संशयः । अमावास्यां जितक्रोधो यस्तु पूजयते द्विजान्
verses.transliteration: dadatām akṣayaṃ sarvaṃ yamahāsye na saṃśayaḥ / amāvāsyāṃ jitakrodho yastu pūjayate dvijān
verses.translation: The Manvantara of Auttama is the third among the Manvantaras. 2 There are five Ganas. I shall recount them. Under¬ stand them.
verses.hindi: किया । है द्विजसत्तम ! चल, प्राचीन योग, सुराल और कुथुमि के शिष्य पाराशय ने छः संहिताओं का उपदेश किया । आसुरायण, वैशज्याख्य, वेदबुद्ध परायण, प्राचीन योगपुत्र, बुद्धिमान् पतब्जलि ये कुथुमि के शिष्य पाराशयं के छः भेद कहे गये हैं। लाज़रलि और श्ालिहोत्र ने छः छः संहिताओं का उपदेश किया ।४०-४२। भालुकि, कामहानि, जैमिनि, लोमगायिनि, कण्डु और कीहल“-ये छः लाज्ञल नाम से स्मरण किये जाते हैं। ये सब के सब लाजुूलि के द्िष्य हैं, जिन्होंने संहिताओं का प्रचार क्रिया । हिरण्यनाभ ने, जो राजा का पुत्र एवं अति उत्तम प्रकृति का मनुष्य था-- चौंबीस संहिताओं का प्रणयत किया और उन सब को अपने जिन शिष्यों को पढ़ाया, उन्हें सुनिये । राड, मह॒वीयें, पञुचम, वाहन, तालक, पाण्डक, कालिक, राजिक, गौतम, आजवस्त, सोमराज, पृष्ठन्न, परिकृष्ट, उलूखलक, यवीयस, वेशाल, अडगुलीय,
verses.wordMeaning: The Manvantara of Auttama is the third among the Manvantaras. 2 There are five Ganas. I shall recount them. Under¬ stand them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Manvantara of Auttama is the third among the Manvantaras. 2 There are five Ganas. I shall recount them. Under¬ stand them.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यभूमिदानेन तिलदानेन भूयसा । कृष्णाजिनप्रदानेन तिलधेनुप्रदानतः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyabhūmidānena tiladānena bhūyasā / kṛṣṇājinapradānena tiladhenupradānataḥ
verses.translation: The Devas are Sudhamans, Vasavartins, Pratardanas, Sivas, and Satyas. Each of these groups (< Ganas ) consists of twelve (Devas).
verses.hindi: कौशिक, सालिमज्जरि, सत्य, कापीय, कानिक और पधर्मात्मा पराशर, ये सभी अतीत कालीन ऋषिगण सामवेद के उपदेशक थे ।४२०४७। समस्त सामवेदीय ऋषियों में पौष्यञ्जि और क्ृति-ये दो श्रेष्ठ कहे गये हैं, जो विविध संहिताओं के प्रवतंक थे । विप्रवुन्द ! आचाये सुमन्तु ने अथवेवेद के दो विभाग कर सब की कबन्ध नामक शिष्य को शिक्षा दी, अब क्रमशः उप्तका वर्णन सुनिये। कबन्ध ने पुनः उसके दो विभाग
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas are Sudhamans, Vasavartins, Pratardanas, Sivas, and Satyas. Each of these groups (< Ganas ) consists of twelve (Devas).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas are Sudhamans, Vasavartins, Pratardanas, Sivas, and Satyas. Each of these groups (< Ganas ) consists of twelve (Devas).

verses.sanskrit: विधानोक्तद्विजाग्र्याय ये प्रदास्यन्ति भक्तितः । हयं वा कुंजरं वाथ धूर्वहौ सीरसंयुतौ
verses.transliteration: vidhānoktadvijāgryāya ye pradāsyanti bhaktitaḥ / hayaṃ vā kuṃjaraṃ vātha dhūrvahau sīrasaṃyutau
verses.translation: The names of the twelve constituting Sudhamans are Satya, Dhrti, Dama, Danta, Ksama, Ksama, Dhrti (Dhvani— Bd.P.), Suci, Isa, Orjas, Jyestha and Vapusman the twelfth.
verses.hindi: कबन्धस्तु द्विधा कृत्वा पथ्यायक पुनदंदो । द्वितीय वेदस्पर्शाय स चतुर्धाश्करोत्पुनः ३४५० मोदो ब्रह्मबलश्चेव पिप्पलादस्तथव च् । शौष्कायनिश्च धर्मज्ञश्चतुर्थस्तपनः स्मृतः॥ शौनकस्तु द्विधा कृत्वा ददावेक तु बच्रवे । द्वितीयां संहितां धीमान्सेन्धवायनसंजिते ५३ सेन्धवों मुञ्जकेशाय भिन्ना सा च द्विधा पुनः । नक्षत्रकल्पो बतानस्तृतीयः संहिताबिधि: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The names of the twelve constituting Sudhamans are Satya, Dhrti, Dama, Danta, Ksama, Ksama, Dhrti (Dhvani— Bd.P.), Suci, Isa, Orjas, Jyestha and Vapusman the twelfth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The names of the twelve constituting Sudhamans are Satya, Dhrti, Dama, Danta, Ksama, Ksama, Dhrti (Dhvani— Bd.P.), Suci, Isa, Orjas, Jyestha and Vapusman the twelfth.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यां वसुमतीं गां च महिषीं वा पयस्विनीम् । ददते ये नृपश्रेष्ठ नोपसर्पन्ति ते यमम्
verses.transliteration: kanyāṃ vasumatīṃ gāṃ ca mahiṣīṃ vā payasvinīm / dadate ye nṛpaśreṣṭha nopasarpanti te yamam
verses.translation: The Vamsakarin Devas (Vasavartins) were Sahasra- dhara, Visvatman, Samitara, Brhadvasu, Visvadha, ViSvakarma Manasvanta, Virad. Yasas, Jyotis, Vibhavya and Klrtiman.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठास्त्वथ्रणों हां ते संहितानां विकल्पना: । षट्शः कृत्वा मया5प्युक्तं पुराणसषिसत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: The Vamsakarin Devas (Vasavartins) were Sahasra- dhara, Visvatman, Samitara, Brhadvasu, Visvadha, ViSvakarma Manasvanta, Virad. Yasas, Jyotis, Vibhavya and Klrtiman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vamsakarin Devas (Vasavartins) were Sahasra- dhara, Visvatman, Samitara, Brhadvasu, Visvadha, ViSvakarma Manasvanta, Virad. Yasas, Jyotis, Vibhavya and Klrtiman.

verses.sanskrit: यमो ऽपि भवति प्रीतः प्रतिजन्म युधिष्ठिर । यमस्य वाहो महिषो महिष्यस्तस्य मातरः
verses.transliteration: yamo 'pi bhavati prītaḥ pratijanma yudhiṣṭhira / yamasya vāho mahiṣo mahiṣyastasya mātaraḥ
verses.translation: Pramardana (Pratardana) gods are glorified. They
verses.hindi: आत्रयः सुमतिर्धो मान्काश्यपो ह्ाकृतन्नण:  भारद्वाजोइस्निवर्चाश्व॒ वसिष्ठों मित्रयुभ्य यः ।। एते शिष्या मम ब्रह्मन्पुराणेषु दृढब्ताः। त्रिभिस्तित्नर: कृतास्तिस्र: संहिता: पुनरेव हि
verses.wordMeaning: Pramardana (Pratardana) gods are glorified. They
verses.commentary: Sense: Pramardana (Pratardana) gods are glorified. They

verses.sanskrit: तासां दानप्रभावेण यमः प्रीतो भवेद् ध्रुवम् । नासौ यममवाप्नोति यदि पापैः समावृतः
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ dānaprabhāveṇa yamaḥ prīto bhaved dhruvam / nāsau yamamavāpnoti yadi pāpaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: As per A.
verses.hindi: काश्यपः संहिताकर्ता सावरणि: शांशपायन: । सामिका च चतुर्थों स्थात्सा चंबा पूवंसेहिता 0५८

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मात् कारणाद् अत्र महिषीदानमुत्तमम् । तस्याः शृङ्गे जलं कार्यं धूम्रवस्त्रानुवेष्टिता
verses.transliteration: etasmāt kāraṇād atra mahiṣīdānamuttamam / tasyāḥ śṛṅge jalaṃ kāryaṃ dhūmravastrānuveṣṭitā
verses.translation: Verses 23-36 describe the Auttama or Uttama's Manvantara. As noted in v. 36 the activities of creation etc. are the same as in the previous Man¬ vantara.
verses.hindi: किये, जिनमें से एक को पथ्य नामक शिष्य को तथा दूसरे को वेदस्पर्श नामक शिष्य को उपदेश दिया । तदनन्तर वेदस्पश ते उसके चार भाग किये ।४८-५०। मोद, ब्रह्मयल, पिप्पलाद तथा धर्मेज्ञ शौष्कायनि-- ये चार वेवस्पर्श के सुप्रसिद्ध शिष्य हैं जो सभी दृढ़ ब्रतधारी थे। पथ्य के उत्तम शिष्यों की संख्या तीन जानिये उनके जाजलि, कुमुदादि और शौनक नाम प्रसिद्ध हैं। विद्वात् शौनक ने दो विभाग कर एक संहिता को बशन्नू को दिया और दूसरी को सैन्धवायन नामक शिष्य को समपित किया । सेन्धव ने मुझ्जकेश को उपदेश दिया, जिसके द्वारा वह पुनः दो भागों में विभक्त हुई। प्रथम नक्षत्रकल्प, द्वितीय बेतान, तृतीय संहिता- विधि, चतुर्थ अज्िरस कल्प तथा पंचम झ्ान्तिकल्प हैं ।११-५४। अथवंवेद की संहिताओं के ये विकल्प श्रेष्ठ माने गये हैं। है ऋषिवध्य॑वृुन्द ! मैंने भी पुराणों का छः प्रकार के विभागों में उपदेश किया हैं। अत्रि
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 23-36 describe the Auttama or Uttama's Manvantara. As noted in v. 36 the activities of creation etc. are the same as in the previous Man¬ vantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 23-36 describe the Auttama or Uttama's Manvantara. As noted in v. 36 the activities of creation etc. are the same as in the previous Man¬ vantara.

verses.sanskrit: आयसस्य खुराः कार्यास् ताम्रपृष्ठाः सुभूषिताः । लवणाचलं पूर्वस्यामाग्नेय्यां गुडपर्वतम्
verses.transliteration: āyasasya khurāḥ kāryās tāmrapṛṣṭhāḥ subhūṣitāḥ / lavaṇācalaṃ pūrvasyāmāgneyyāṃ guḍaparvatam
verses.translation: The reading anyanaradhito dtvo c God not worshipped by others' is mean¬ ingless, as this is a list of Pratardana gods.— c Pramardana * in the text is an
verses.hindi: गोन्नोत्पन्त बुद्धिमान सुमति, कश्यपगोत्रीय अक्लतन्नण, अग्नि के समात तेजस्वी भरद्वाज, वशिष्ठ मित्रयु, सावर्णि सोमदत्ति और सुशर्मा शांशपायन हैं ! है विप्रवुन्द । ये हमारे पुराणों में शिष्य हैं, जों सब के सब दृढ़ ब्रतधारी हैं। इनमें से तीन शिष्यों ने संहिता के तीन विभागकर पुनः तीन भाग किये, जो संहिताकर्ता काइयप, सार्वाण और शांशपायन के नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं। सामिका नामक चौंथी संहिता है जो पूर्व संहिता
verses.wordMeaning: The reading anyanaradhito dtvo c God not worshipped by others' is mean¬ ingless, as this is a list of Pratardana gods.— c Pramardana * in the text is an
verses.commentary: Sense: The reading anyanaradhito dtvo c God not worshipped by others' is mean¬ ingless, as this is a list of Pratardana gods.— c Pramardana * in the text is an

verses.sanskrit: कार्पासं याम्यभागं तु नवनीतं तु नैरृते । पश्चिमे सप्तधान्यानि वायव्ये तंदुलाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: kārpāsaṃ yāmyabhāgaṃ tu navanītaṃ tu nairṛte / paścime saptadhānyāni vāyavye taṃdulāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Understand the names of those constituting the Satya category of Devas, as agreed (by sages of yore). They are Dikpati, Vakpati, Visva, Sarnbhu, Svamrdika, Adhi- pa, Varcodhas, Muhyasarvas'a (?), Vasava, Sadasva, Ksema and Ananda. These are those sacrifice-worthy other twelve (Devas) famous as Satyas. These are the deities who lived in the Manvantara of Auttama.
verses.hindi: के नाम से विख्यात है ।५५-५८। ये सभी संहिताएँ चार-चार पादों वाली एवं एक अर्थ को वाचिका हैं । सर्वास्ता हि चतुष्पादाः सर्वाश्वेकार्थवाचिका: । पाठान्तरे पृथर्भुता वेदशाखा यथा तथा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Understand the names of those constituting the Satya category of Devas, as agreed (by sages of yore). They are Dikpati, Vakpati, Visva, Sarnbhu, Svamrdika, Adhi- pa, Varcodhas, Muhyasarvas'a (?), Vasava, Sadasva, Ksema and Ananda.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand the names of those constituting the Satya category of Devas, as agreed (by sages of yore). They are Dikpati, Vakpati, Visva, Sarnbhu, Svamrdika, Adhi- pa, Varcodhas, Muhyasarvas'a (?), Vasava, Sadasva, Ksema and Ananda.…

verses.sanskrit: सौम्ये तु काञ्चनं दद्याद् ईशाने घृतमेव च । प्रदद्याद्यमराजो मे प्रीयतामित्युदीरयन्
verses.transliteration: saumye tu kāñcanaṃ dadyād īśāne ghṛtameva ca / pradadyādyamarājo me prīyatāmityudīrayan
verses.translation: Aja, Parasu, Divya, Divyausadhi, Naya, the un¬ equalled Devanuja, Mahotsaha, Ausija, Vinlta, Suketu, Sumitra, Subala and Suci—these thirteen were the noble-souled sons of the Manu Auttama. These were the progenitors of the race of Ksatriyas and made them flourish. Such is the third Manvan- tara.
verses.hindi: चतुःसाहसनिकाः सर्वाः शांशपायनिकासृते द ५६ लोमहर्षणिका मूलास्ततः काश्यपिकाः पराः । सावरणिकास्तृतीयास्ता यजूवक्यार्थेपण्डिला:.
verses.wordMeaning: Aja, Parasu, Divya, Divyausadhi, Naya, the un¬ equalled Devanuja, Mahotsaha, Ausija, Vinlta, Suketu, Sumitra, Subala and Suci—these thirteen were the noble-souled sons of the Manu Auttama. These were the progenitors of the race of Ksatriyas and made them flourish.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Aja, Parasu, Divya, Divyausadhi, Naya, the un¬ equalled Devanuja, Mahotsaha, Ausija, Vinlta, Suketu, Sumitra, Subala and Suci—these thirteen were the noble-souled sons of the Manu Auttama. These were the progenitors of the race of Ksatriyas and made them flourish.…

verses.sanskrit: इत्युच्चार्य द्विजस्याग्रे यमलोकं महाभयम् । असिपत्त्रवनं घोरं यमचुल्ली सुदारुणा
verses.transliteration: ityuccārya dvijasyāgre yamalokaṃ mahābhayam / asipattravanaṃ ghoraṃ yamacullī sudāruṇā
verses.translation: The activity of creation etc. in the course of the Auttama Manvantara has been explained through (that of) Svarocisa Manvantara. Now listen and understand the creation etc. in the Tamasa Manvantara in detail and in the proper order.
verses.hindi: एता: पत्चदशान्वाश्च दशान्या दशभिस्तथा। वालखिल्याः सहप्रेषा: ससावर्णा: प्रकीतिताः. सप्राम्यारण्पक तत्स्यात्समन्त्रकरणं तथा । अतः परं कथानां तु पूर्वा इति विशेषणम् ६५
verses.wordMeaning: The activity of creation etc. in the course of the Auttama Manvantara has been explained through (that of) Svarocisa Manvantara. Now listen and understand the creation etc. in the Tamasa Manvantara in detail and in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: The activity of creation etc. in the course of the Auttama Manvantara has been explained through (that of) Svarocisa Manvantara. Now listen and understand the creation etc. in the Tamasa Manvantara in detail and in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: रौद्रा वैतरणी चैव कुम्भीपाको भयावहः । कालसूत्रो महाभीमस् तथा यमलपर्वतौ
verses.transliteration: raudrā vaitaraṇī caiva kumbhīpāko bhayāvahaḥ / kālasūtro mahābhīmas tathā yamalaparvatau
verses.translation: In the fourth period of Manvantara * 1 2 of the Manu Tamasa, the Ganas were four, viz. Satyas, Svarupas, Sudhls and Haris.
verses.hindi: दे सहन शते न्‍्यूंने वेदे वाजसनेयके  ऋग्गणः परिसंख्यातो ब्राह्मण तु चतुर्गुणम्
verses.wordMeaning: In the fourth period of Manvantara * 1 2 of the Manu Tamasa, the Ganas were four, viz. Satyas, Svarupas, Sudhls and Haris.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the fourth period of Manvantara * 1 2 of the Manu Tamasa, the Ganas were four, viz. Satyas, Svarupas, Sudhls and Haris.

verses.sanskrit: क्रकचं तैलयन्त्रं च श्वानो गृध्राः सुदारुणाः । निरुच्छ्वासा महानादा भैरवो रौरवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: krakacaṃ tailayantraṃ ca śvāno gṛdhrāḥ sudāruṇāḥ / nirucchvāsā mahānādā bhairavo rauravastathā
verses.translation: In the Manvantara of Tamasa, the gardsons of Pulastya (manifested themselves). Each of these Devaganas consisted of twentyfive (gods). If Vitta, Kratu and Rathormi from the readings in Bd. P. is accepted, the list will have twelve names (the expected number of this group of Devas).
verses.hindi: वेद शाखाओं की भाँति पाठास्तर में भिन्‍न-भिन्‍न हैं। शांशपायन की संहिता को छोड़कर इत सब की संख्या चार सहख्र है। इन समस्त वेद शाखाओं में लोमहषंण की शाखा ही मुख्य है, उसके बाद कश्यप की शाखा की महत्ता मानी गई है, सावणिक शाखा का तृतीय स्थान है, ये शाखाएँ यजुर्वेद की हैं जिन्हें उसके पण्डित लोग जानते हैं ।५६-६०। इनके अतिरिक्त जो शांशपायन की शाखा है वह प्रेरणात्मक अर्थ से विभूषित है, उसकी ऋचाओं की संख्या आठ सहस्न छः सौ है। ये समस्त संहिताएँ, इसके अतिरिक्त परन्द्रह यथा दस-दस संहिताएँ, जो बालखिल्य सहप्रेष एवं सार्वाण की संहिताओं के नाम से कही गई हैं, आठ सहस्न॒ साम, चौदह सहस्र साममंत्र हवनमंत्र समेत आरण्यक--इन सब को साम के गायत करने वाले ऋषि लोग गाते हैं । इसके अति- रिक्त व्यासदेव ने यजुः और ब्राह्मण के बारह सहस्न छन्दों का विभाग किया, जो ग्राम्य एवं आरण्यक संहिताओं
verses.wordMeaning: In the Manvantara of Tamasa, the gardsons of Pulastya (manifested themselves). Each of these Devaganas consisted of twentyfive (gods). If Vitta, Kratu and Rathormi from the readings in Bd. P. is accepted,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Manvantara of Tamasa, the gardsons of Pulastya (manifested themselves). Each of these Devaganas consisted of twentyfive (gods). If Vitta, Kratu and Rathormi from the readings in Bd. P. is accepted,…

verses.sanskrit: एते घोरा याम्यलोके श्रूयन्ते द्विजसत्तम । त्वत्प्रसादेन ते सोम्यास्तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: ete ghorā yāmyaloke śrūyante dvijasattama / tvatprasādena te somyāstīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: Verses 37-43 deal with Tamasa Manvantara.
verses.hindi: एवं मंत्रकरणक के साथ आध्वयंव के नाम से स्मरण किये जाते हैँ । इसके उपरान्त कथाओं का पूर्वा यह विशेषण कहा जाता है ।६१-६५। ऋक्, ब्राह्मण और यजु ये तीन मंत्रों के साथ ग्राम्य और आरण्य के नाम से स्मरण किये जाते हैं। हारिद्रवीय के खिल उपखिल तथा तैत्तिरीय के पर और क्षुद्र भाग भी दो-दो प्रकार के स्मरण किये जाते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त दो सहस्न में एक सो कम वाजसनेयी संहिता की ऋचाओं
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 37-43 deal with Tamasa Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 37-43 deal with Tamasa Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: दानस्यास्य प्रभावेण यमराजप्रसादतः । नरके ऽहं न यास्यामि द्विज जन्मनि जन्मनि
verses.transliteration: dānasyāsya prabhāveṇa yamarājaprasādataḥ / narake 'haṃ na yāsyāmi dvija janmani janmani
verses.translation: The hundred Indriyas (sense-organs) and the eighth Tamas (Darkness) which the top-most sages who value truth as life, enunciate, are remembered as the Devas in that Manvan- tara. Sibi the lord of (great) exploit, was the Indra of those Devas. O excellent ones, understand the seven sages of that Manvantara.
verses.hindi: को तथा उसके चतग्रणित ब्राह्मण को परिगणित किया। आठ सहस्॒ आठ सौ अस्सी थजु ओर ऋक की एतावदधिक तेषां यजुः कार्म विवक्ष्यति ६९ एकादश सहस्नाणि दश चान्‍्या दशोत्तरा: । ऋचां दश सहल्नाणि अशीतित्रिशतानि च
verses.wordMeaning: The hundred Indriyas (sense-organs) and the eighth Tamas (Darkness) which the top-most sages who value truth as life, enunciate, are remembered as the Devas in that Manvan- tara. Sibi the lord of (great) exploit, was the Indra of those Devas. O excellent ones,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The hundred Indriyas (sense-organs) and the eighth Tamas (Darkness) which the top-most sages who value truth as life, enunciate, are remembered as the Devas in that Manvan- tara. Sibi the lord of (great) exploit, was the Indra of those Devas. O excellent ones,…

verses.sanskrit: यमहास्यस्य चाख्यानम् इदं शृण्वन्ति ये नराः । ते ऽपि पापविनिर्मुक्ता न पश्यन्ति यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: yamahāsyasya cākhyānam idaṃ śṛṇvanti ye narāḥ / te 'pi pāpavinirmuktā na paśyanti yamālayam
verses.translation: Harsa, the son of Kavi; Pfthu, the son of Kasyapa; Agni, the son of Atri; Jyotirdhaman, the son of Bhrgu; Vanapltha, the son of Pulaha, Gotra, the son ofVasistha; and Caitra, the son ofPulastya were the (seven) sages in theTamasa Manvan¬ tara.
verses.hindi: कर्तारश्चेब शाखानां भेदे हेतुस्तथेव च। सर्वेमन्वन्तरेष्बेबं शाखाभेदाः समा: स्मृताः ७४ प्राजापत्या श्रुतिनित्या तद्विकल्पास्त्विमे स्मृता: । अनित्यभावाहेवानां मन्त्रोत्पत्ति: पुनः पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: Harsa, the son of Kavi; Pfthu, the son of Kasyapa; Agni, the son of Atri; Jyotirdhaman, the son of Bhrgu; Vanapltha, the son of Pulaha, Gotra, the son ofVasistha; and Caitra, the son ofPulastya were the (seven) sages in theTamasa Manvan¬ tara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harsa, the son of Kavi; Pfthu, the son of Kasyapa; Agni, the son of Atri; Jyotirdhaman, the son of Bhrgu; Vanapltha, the son of Pulaha, Gotra, the son ofVasistha; and Caitra, the son ofPulastya were the (seven) sages in theTamasa Manvan¬ tara.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे यमहास्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विनवतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ९३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र कल्होडीतीर्थमुत्तमम् । विख्यातं भारते लोके गङ्गायाः पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe yamahāsyatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvinavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 93 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra kalhoḍītīrthamuttamam / vikhyātaṃ bhārate loke gaṅgāyāḥ pāpanāśanam
verses.translation: I shall recount the race of the eldest (son of Yayati) Yadu, of excellent splendour. Listen and understand, even as I recount it in detail and in the proper order. Yadu had five sons, all comparable to the sons of Devas. Sahasrajit was the eldest. (The others were) Krostu, Nila, Jita and Laghu. Sahasrajit's son was the glorious king named Satajit. Satajit had three sons who were well known as very virtuous. They were Haihaya, Haya and the king Venuhaya. It is heard that Haihaya's successor was Dharmatattva.
verses.hindi: सन्वस्तराणां क्वियते सुराणां नामनिश्चय: । द्वापरेषु पुनभंदाः भुतीनां परिकीरतिता: ७६ एवं वेदं तदा न्यस्थ भगवान षिसत्तमः । शिष्येभ्यश्च पुनर्देत्वा तपस्तप्तुं गतो बनम् ॥ अड्गानि वेदाश्चत्वारो मीमांसा न्यायविस्तर: । धर्मंशास्त्र पुराणं च विद्यास्त्वेताश्चतुदंश.
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount the race of the eldest (son of Yayati) Yadu, of excellent splendour. Listen and understand, even as I recount it in detail and in the proper order. Yadu had five sons, all comparable to the sons of Devas. Sahasrajit was the eldest. (The others were) Krostu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount the race of the eldest (son of Yayati) Yadu, of excellent splendour. Listen and understand, even as I recount it in detail and in the proper order. Yadu had five sons, all comparable to the sons of Devas. Sahasrajit was the eldest. (The others were) Krostu,…

verses.sanskrit: दुर्लभं मनुजैः पार्थ रेवातटसमाश्रितम् । प्राणिनां पापनाशाय ऊषरं पुष्करं तथा
verses.transliteration: durlabhaṃ manujaiḥ pārtha revātaṭasamāśritam / prāṇināṃ pāpanāśāya ūṣaraṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: Dharmatattva's son was Kirti and his son was Samjneya. Samjfieya's successor was the king named Mahisman. Mahisman's son was the valorous Bhadrasrenya who was the king of Varanasi and has already been mentioned. A mountain in Nepal on the eastern bank of Gandak. Here was the hermitage of Bhygu. (De 34). This chapter describes the Haihaya line of Yadu in which the greatest ruler of the Narmada valley, Kartavirya Arjuna, was born. This chapter is captioned after that illustrious king. This chapter corresponds to Bd. 3.69 & verse-numbers in the notes refer to that chapter.
verses.hindi: संख्याये कही गई है । इसके उपरान्त चरणविद्या की सहिता तथा उसके प्रमाण को सुनिये । इस चरणविद्या की कथाओं की संख्या छः सहस्न छब्बीस है। अब इसके उपरान्त यजुः के विषय में विस्तारपूृवंक बतला रहा हूं (६६-६६। ग्यारह सहस्न बीस यज्जुबंद की ऋतक संख्या है, दस सहस्न तीन सौ अस्सी ऋचाओं की तथा एक सहस्न मनन्‍्त्रों की ऋक् संख्या का प्रमाण है। इतनीं ही भ्रम द्वारा विस्तारित बहुतेरी अथर्बे की

verses.sanskrit: तत्तु तीर्थमिदं पुण्यमित्येवं शूलिनो वचः । जाह्नवी पशुरूपेण तत्र स्नानार्थमागता
verses.transliteration: tattu tīrthamidaṃ puṇyamityevaṃ śūlino vacaḥ / jāhnavī paśurūpeṇa tatra snānārthamāgatā
verses.translation: The entire earth consisting of seven continents and many towns and surrounded by seven oceans, was conquered by him in a manner befitting a Ksatriya. 1 2 When he started fighting in a battle, banners and chariots befitting it and a thousand arms used to appear by means of the Maya of that intelligent one. It is heard that without any difficulties ten thousand Yajiias had been performed by that intelligent king in all the seven continents. All the Yajnas performed by that mighty-armed king were profoundly splendid. All of them were provided with golden altars with golden sacrificial posts. All of thorp were graced by the presence of blessed Devas seated in aerial
verses.hindi: संहिताएँ हैं। अथर्व की ऋक संख्या पाँच सहुत्न निश्वित हुई है, एक सहर्न में बीस कम अन्य ऋचाओं की संख्या ऋषि लोग और बतलाते हैं। यह अंगिरा ऋषि के कहे हुए अयव के मंत्रों की तथा आरण्यक की संख्या है। इस प्रकार वेदों के मंत्रों एवं ऋचाओं की संख्या शाखा भेद, शाखाओं के कर्त्ता एवं उनके पारस्परिक भेद के कारण आदि को मैं बतला चका  सभी मन्‍्वन्तरों में वेदों के शाखाविभाग एक समान स्मरण किये गये हैं ।७०-७४। प्रजापति की श्रुति नित्य है, उसके विकल्प ये ही कहे जाते हैं । देवताओं के अनित्य (विनश्वर) होने के कारण पुनः पुनः मंत्रोत्वत्ति होती है, मन्वन्तरों के भेद से देवताओं के नाम का निश्चय होता है । ये जो ऊपर श्र॒ति के भेद बतलाये गये हैं, वे प्रत्येक द्वापर युग में कहे गये हैं। उस द्वापर युग में इस प्रकार वेदों का विभाग करके ऋषिश्नेष्ठ व्यास अपने शिष्यों को उसे सौंपने के बाद तपस्या

verses.sanskrit: अतस्तद्विश्रुतं लोके कल्होडीतीर्थमुत्तमम् । त्रिरात्रं कारयेत्तत्र पूर्णिमायां युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: atastadviśrutaṃ loke kalhoḍītīrthamuttamam / trirātraṃ kārayettatra pūrṇimāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Bd. 3.69. reads: ability to prevent one from evil the moment he plans it. Verses 14-37 describe the exploits, munificence, righteousness and glory of Kartavirya. The Gathas sung by Narada about him (vv. 20-22) record in a nutshell Arjuna's achievements. Generally these Gathas are quotations from ancient traditional verses. After observing the conduct and the grandeur of that saintly king, Narada and Gandharvas sang the following verse(s) of glory of that king. "Certainly no man can emulate (none can attain) the goal or status of Kartavlrya by means of Yajnas, Danas, penances, exploits and learning. In all the seven continents he is seen moving about with his sword drawn and the excellent bows and arrows kept ready as well as seated in his chariot. Though he is the king, he behaves as though he is the follower.*
verses.hindi: करने के लिए जज्ुल को प्रस्थित हुए। उनके शिष्यों तथा शिथ्यों के शिष्यों ने इन उपर्युक्त बंदिक शाखाओं का इस प्रकार विभाग किया। छह वेदाज्भु (शिक्षा, कल्प, व्याकरण, निरुकत, छन्‍्द ओर ज्योतिष) चारों

verses.sanskrit: रजस्तमस्तथा क्रोधं दम्भं मात्सर्यमेव च । एतांस्त्यजति यः पार्थ तेनाप्तं मोक्षजं फलम्
verses.transliteration: rajastamastathā krodhaṃ dambhaṃ mātsaryameva ca / etāṃstyajati yaḥ pārtha tenāptaṃ mokṣajaṃ phalam
verses.translation: While he was protecting the subjects righteously, none of his subjects lost his wealth, no one was grief-stricken and no one had any confusion, thanks to the prowess of that great king". That king became the sole monarch and emperor of the seven continents for eightyfive thousand years. (In his realm) he himself was the protector of cattle and the fields. As a Yogin, Arjuna became Parjanya (Lord of clouds and rains) and showered in plenty. With his thousand arms rendered tough by frequent contact with the bowstring, he shone like the Sun with his thousands of autumnal rays.
verses.hindi: 7०५६ वधायुपुराणम् तेम्य ऋषिप्रकृतयों भुनिभिः संशितव्रतः ८० कश्यपेषु वसिष्ठेबु तथा भृग्वद्धिरोडतिषु । पचस्वेतेषु जायन्ते गोत्रेषु ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥

verses.sanskrit: पयसा स्नापयेद् देवं त्रिसन्ध्यं च त्र्यहं तथा । पयो गोसम्भवं सद्यः सवत्सा जीवपुत्रिणी
verses.transliteration: payasā snāpayed devaṃ trisandhyaṃ ca tryahaṃ tathā / payo gosambhavaṃ sadyaḥ savatsā jīvaputriṇī
verses.translation: Having conquered the royal assembly of (the serpent king) Karkotaka in Mahismall with a thousand elephants, he established his capital there. (Defective) The lotus-eyed king used to check the for¬ ceful (speedy) waves of the sea during the rainy season (when the sea is stormy). In a happy mood, he sportingly spewed out water and made an (artificial) rainy season. Shaken and tossed about by him during his (water- sports), Narmada, wearing garlands with golden fillets approached the king in an apprehensive mannar, with eyebrows like waves producing the gentle (murmuring) soun Giant fishes and great serpents concealed under great billows were crushed and scattered in the flood of foam, the eddies and whirlpools which were unbearably furious. Agitating it by means of his thousand arms, the king made the ocean resemble the milky sea churned by Devas and Asuras.
verses.hindi: यस्मादुषन्ति ब्रह्माणं तेन ब्रह्मषयः स्थृताः

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा तत्ताम्रजे पात्रे क्षौद्रेण चैव योजिते । ॐ नमः श्रीशिवायेति स्नानं देवस्य कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tattāmraje pātre kṣaudreṇa caiva yojite / oṃ namaḥ śrīśivāyeti snānaṃ devasya kārayet
verses.translation: (Defective verse) On seeing the terrible, prominent king, the (aquatic beings) were afraid that the ocean was once again being churned by the Mandara mountain for the sake of Amrla (nectar) and at once felt uprooted (utpafita in A ). Great serpents bent down their heads and stood mo¬ tionless like the stumps of the plantain trees standing still in the evening hours, when the wind does not blow. (Defective verse) Proudly he went to Lanka. With his bow and five hundred arrows he overpowered Ravana along with his army. He defeated and brought him to Mahismatl and imprisoned him there. (Sage) Pulastya himself went to Arjuna and propitiat¬ ed him. The king released Paulastya (Ravana) at the request of Pulastya.
verses.hindi: धर्मस्याथ पुलस्त्यस्य क्रतोश्व पुलहस्य च्। प्रत्यूषस्थ प्रभासस्य कश्यपस्य तथा पुनः ८२ देवष॑यः सुतास्तेषां नामतस्ता जियो धत । देवर्षो धर्मपुत्रो तु नरनारायणावुभो (रे पर्वतो नारदश्वेव कश्यपस्यात्मजावुभो । ऋषत्ति देवान्यस्मात्ते तस्माईवर्षयः स्मृताः ८५ मानवे वेदपये बंशे ऐडवंशे व ये त॒वा: । ऐड ऐक््वाकनाभागा ज्ञेया राजषंयस्तु ते

verses.sanskrit: स याति त्रिदशस्थानं नाकस्त्रीभिः समावृतः । यस्तत्र विधिवत्स्नात्वा दानं प्रेतेषु यच्छति
verses.transliteration: sa yāti tridaśasthānaṃ nākastrībhiḥ samāvṛtaḥ / yastatra vidhivatsnātvā dānaṃ preteṣu yacchati
verses.translation: The sound produced by the twang of the bowstrings by his thousand arms was like the thunder at the time of the close of the Yugas, when the trees* of the clouds of dissolution seem to burst. Sad indeed that his thousand powerful arms were cut off by Bhargava (Parasurama) in battle, as though they were gol¬ den palm trees. Once upon a time, the thirsty Sun-god begged alms of him.. The Lord of the people bestowed on the Sun-god the seven continents as alms. With a desire to consume (everything), the Sun-god blazed at the tips of his arrows and burnt cities, cowherd colonies, villages and all the towns. Thanks to the prowess of that chief of men (Arjuna) the (Sun-god) of great fame burnt the mountains and forests of Kartavirya.
verses.hindi: ऋषन्ति रझजनाञस्मात्प्रजा राजर्षयस्तत: । ब्रह्मलोकप्रतिष्ठास्तु स्पृता ब्रह्मणेयो मताः (८७ देवलोकप्रतिष्ठाश्र ज्ञेया देवरषयः शुभाः । इन्द्रलोकप्रतिष्ठास्तु सर्वे राजषंयो मताः ८८
verses.wordMeaning: The sound produced by the twang of the bowstrings by his thousand arms was like the thunder at the time of the close of the Yugas, when the trees* of the clouds of dissolution seem to burst.…
