The obscure reading dtveSinucare is probably a scribal error and should be emended as deoe sinucare 'God (Siva) along with his retinue'.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: साधु साधु महाबाहो धर्मवान्साधुवत्सल । स्वकर्मनिरतः पार्थ तीर्थयात्राकृतादरः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sādhu sādhu mahābāho dharmavānsādhuvatsala / svakarmanirataḥ pārtha tīrthayātrākṛtādaraḥ
verses.translation: "O beautiful lady, whose (daughter) are you? When I was distressed, you too were distressed. Who are you? What for did you take care of me when I was performing the great penance? O lady of beautiful hips, O fair-complexioned one, I am delighted with your steady devotion, humility, self-control and affection.
verses.hindi: भी नहीं किया जा सकता । मन्वच्तर की संख्या मनुष्य के वर्षों से बतला रहा हूं, सुनिये ।११६-१३७। देवताओं तथा ऋषियों की संख्या को भली भाँति जानने वाले द्विंजगण म्रन्वन्तर के वर्ष की संख्या इस प्रकार बतलाते हैं। तीस करोड़, सड़सठ नियुत ( एक नियुत को दस लाख माना गया है। ) बीस सहस्न वर्ष संधिकाल के बिना एक मन्वन्तर की अवधि मानी गई है ।!३८-१२६।॥ मन्वन्तर की यह संख्या मानव परिमाणों से बतलाई
verses.wordMeaning: "O beautiful lady, whose (daughter) are you? When I was distressed, you too were distressed. Who are you? What for did you take care of me when I was performing the great penance? O lady of beautiful hips, O fair-complexioned one, I am delighted with your steady devotion,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O beautiful lady, whose (daughter) are you? When I was distressed, you too were distressed. Who are you? What for did you take care of me when I was performing the great penance? O lady of beautiful hips, O fair-complexioned one, I am delighted with your steady devotion,…

verses.sanskrit: दुर्लभं सर्वजन्तूनां व्यासतीर्थं नरेश्वर । पीडितो वृद्धभावेन अकल्पो ऽहं नृपात्मज
verses.transliteration: durlabhaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ vyāsatīrthaṃ nareśvara / pīḍito vṛddhabhāvena akalpo 'haṃ nṛpātmaja
verses.translation: O beautiful damsel, what do you wish? What is your cherished desire which should be fully gratified? Even if it be very difficult to be fulfilled, I shall get it realised (for you) On being asked thus, JayantI said: "O sage merged in Brahman, it behoves you to know it by means of the power of your penance. In fact, you already know precisely what I have desired to achieve".
verses.hindi: गई है, अब दिव्य (देवताओं के) वर्षों से मन्वन्तर का प्रमाण बतला रहा हूँ  आठ लाख बावन सहख्न दिव्य वष की संख्या स्मरण की जाती है। इस कालावधि का चोदह गुना काल महाप्रलय का है जब कि एक सहस युग बीत जाते हैं-इसे ब्रह्मा का एक दिन कहा गया है ।१४०-१४२॥ उस समय सभी जीव समूह सूर्य की' किरणों से जब भस्म होने लगते हैं तब देवताओं, ऋषियों और दानवों के साथ ब्रह्मा को आगे कर सुरश्रेष्ठ देवदेव महादेव के शरीर में प्रविष्ट होते हैं। वे देवदेव महेद्वर प्रत्येक कल्प के प्रारम्भ में सभी जीव-समूहों की पुनः पुनः सृष्टि करते हैं। देवताओं और ऋषियों के साथ मनु की स्थिति की वह कालांवधि मैं बतला चका अब सभी मन्वन्तरों में होनेवाली श्रतिसंधि को सुनिये। निष्पाप ऋषिगण उस प्रतिसंधि को सतयुग,
verses.wordMeaning: O beautiful damsel, what do you wish? What is your cherished desire which should be fully gratified? Even if it be very difficult to be fulfilled, I shall get it realised (for you) On being asked thus, JayantI said: "O sage merged in Brahman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O beautiful damsel, what do you wish? What is your cherished desire which should be fully gratified? Even if it be very difficult to be fulfilled, I shall get it realised (for you) On being asked thus, JayantI said: "O sage merged in Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: विसंज्ञो गतवित्तस्तु संजातः स्मृतिवर्जितः । गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं तीर्थं नाख्यातं कस्यचिन्मया
verses.transliteration: visaṃjño gatavittastu saṃjātaḥ smṛtivarjitaḥ / guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā
verses.translation: On being told thus, the sage saw everything by means of his divine vision and said: <c O beautiful maiden, you are the daughter of Mahendra. You have come here to render service to me. O woman of beautiful lips, O lustrous woman, you desire to live in contact with me for ten years without being seen by any other living being.
verses.hindi: सनो रेतमधीकारं प्रोवाच भगवान्ध्रभुः द १४६
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the sage saw everything by means of his divine vision and said: <c O beautiful maiden, you are the daughter of Mahendra. You have come here to render service to me. O woman of beautiful lips, O lustrous woman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the sage saw everything by means of his divine vision and said: <c O beautiful maiden, you are the daughter of Mahendra. You have come here to render service to me. O woman of beautiful lips, O lustrous woman,…

verses.sanskrit: कलिस्तत्रैव राजेन्द्र न विशेद्व्याससंश्रयात् । अन्तरिक्षे तु संजातं रेवायाश्चेष्टितेन तु
verses.transliteration: kalistatraiva rājendra na viśedvyāsasaṃśrayāt / antarikṣe tu saṃjātaṃ revāyāśceṣṭitena tu
verses.translation: O beautiful lady with (brilliant) complexion of the Lord of Devas and of fire*! O lady of beautiful eyes, you choose (the fulfilment of your) desire from me, O lady of sweet voice. Let it be, O fascinating woman, we shall go home". Thereafter the holy lord returned to his abode, accompanied by Jayanti.
verses.hindi: इत्येष कीतितः सर्यो सनोः स्वायंमुवस्य हू । प्रतिसंधि तु वक्ष्यासि तस्य चेवापरस्य तु १४८ सन्वन्तरं यथा पृर्वमृषिभिदेवतेः सह । अवश्यंभाविनाअरथेंन यथा तद्ठ निव्तते अस्मिन्मन्वन्तरे पूर्व त्रेलोक्यस्येश्वरास्तु ये। सप्तर्षयश्न देवास्ते पितरो सनवस्तथा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O beautiful lady with (brilliant) complexion of the Lord of Devas and of fire*! O lady of beautiful eyes, you choose (the fulfilment of your) desire from me, O lady of sweet voice. Let it be, O fascinating woman, we shall go home".…
verses.commentary: Sense: O beautiful lady with (brilliant) complexion of the Lord of Devas and of fire*! O lady of beautiful eyes, you choose (the fulfilment of your) desire from me, O lady of sweet voice. Let it be, O fascinating woman, we shall go home".…

verses.sanskrit: विरिञ्चिर्नैव शक्नोति रेवाया गुणकीर्तनम् । कथं ज्ञास्याम्यहं तात रेवामाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: viriñcirnaiva śaknoti revāyā guṇakīrtanam / kathaṃ jñāsyāmyahaṃ tāta revāmāhātmyamuttamam
verses.translation: He stayed along with her for ten years. Being envelop¬ ed with Maya (illusive power), he was invisible to all living beings. On seeing (learning) that Kavya had returned after realising his desires, all Daityas delightedly came to his house desirous of seeing him.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरस्य काले तु संपूर्ण साधकास्तथा ११५०
verses.wordMeaning: He stayed along with her for ten years. Being envelop¬ ed with Maya (illusive power), he was invisible to all living beings. On seeing (learning) that Kavya had returned after realising his desires, all Daityas delightedly came to his house desirous of seeing him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He stayed along with her for ten years. Being envelop¬ ed with Maya (illusive power), he was invisible to all living beings. On seeing (learning) that Kavya had returned after realising his desires, all Daityas delightedly came to his house desirous of seeing him.

verses.sanskrit: व्यासतीर्थं विशेषेण लवमात्रं ब्रवीम्यतः । प्रत्यक्षः प्रत्ययो यत्र दृश्यते ऽद्य कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: vyāsatīrthaṃ viśeṣeṇa lavamātraṃ bravīmyataḥ / pratyakṣaḥ pratyayo yatra dṛśyate 'dya kalau yuge
verses.translation: Sukra said: "O gentle lady, let us go to see your disciples, O lady of sweet smiles and of tremulous eyes, O chaste lady, O lady of large eyes of three colours". The lady replied: "O sage of great holy rites, please resort to your disciples. It is the sacred Dharma, O Brahmana. I shall not make you swerve from it."
verses.hindi: क्षीणाधिकाराः संवृत्ता बुद्ध्वा पर्यायमात्मनः  महलोंकाय ते सर्वे उन्सुखा दधिरे गतिमू ततो मन्वन्तरे तस्मिन्प्रक्षीणा देवतास्तु ता: । संपूर्ण स्थितिकाले तु तिष्ठन्त्येकं कृतं मुगभू
verses.wordMeaning: Sukra said: "O gentle lady, let us go to see your disciples, O lady of sweet smiles and of tremulous eyes, O chaste lady, O lady of large eyes of three colours". The lady replied: "O sage of great holy rites, please resort to your disciples. It is the sacred Dharma, O Brahmana.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukra said: "O gentle lady, let us go to see your disciples, O lady of sweet smiles and of tremulous eyes, O chaste lady, O lady of large eyes of three colours". The lady replied: "O sage of great holy rites, please resort to your disciples. It is the sacred Dharma, O Brahmana.…

verses.sanskrit: विहङ्गो गच्छते नैव भित्त्वा शूलं सुदारुणम् । तस्योत्पत्तिं समासेन कथयामि नृपात्मज
verses.transliteration: vihaṅgo gacchate naiva bhittvā śūlaṃ sudāruṇam / tasyotpattiṃ samāsena kathayāmi nṛpātmaja
verses.translation: Then he went to Asuras and saw that they had been deceived by the intelligent preceptor of Devas by assuming the form ofKavya. He spoke to Asuras: "O dear ones, know me to be the (real) Kavya. This is the son of Angiras. O Danavas, in spite of my power, you have been deceived".
verses.hindi: उत्पश्चन्ते भविष्याश्व यपावन्मस्वन्तरेश्वरा:  देवता: पितरश्चेव ऋषयो मनुरेव च औश्श३ मन्बन्तरे तु संपूर्ण यद्यन्यद्व कलो युगे । संपच्यते कृत तेषु कलिशिष्टेषु बे तदा
verses.wordMeaning: Then he went to Asuras and saw that they had been deceived by the intelligent preceptor of Devas by assuming the form ofKavya. He spoke to Asuras: "O dear ones, know me to be the (real) Kavya. This is the son of Angiras. O Danavas, in spite of my power, you have been deceived".
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he went to Asuras and saw that they had been deceived by the intelligent preceptor of Devas by assuming the form ofKavya. He spoke to Asuras: "O dear ones, know me to be the (real) Kavya. This is the son of Angiras. O Danavas, in spite of my power, you have been deceived".

verses.sanskrit: आसीत्पूर्वं महीपाल मुनिर्मान्यः पराशरः । तेनात्युग्रं तपश्चीर्णं गङ्गाम्भसि महाफलम्
verses.transliteration: āsītpūrvaṃ mahīpāla munirmānyaḥ parāśaraḥ / tenātyugraṃ tapaścīrṇaṃ gaṅgāmbhasi mahāphalam
verses.translation: On hearing him speak thus, Daityas were confused. They looked at both of them smiling pleasantly.* They stood there utterly confused. They were unable to understand anything. When they were (seen) confused like this, Kavya spoke to them again:
verses.hindi: त्रेता, द्वापर, कलियुम के नाम से पहिले ही मैं इसी प्रसंग में बतला चुका हूँ ! सतयुग, त्रेता, ढ्वापर तथा कलियुम --ये चार युग स्मरण किये गये हैं--इसका इकह॒त्तर गुना काल एक मनु का अधिकार काल भगवान् ने बतलाया है ।१४२-१४६। इसी प्रकार सभी मन्वन्तरों के लक्षण बतलाये गये हैं, वतमान द्वारा अतात एवं भविष्य में होनेवाले मन्वन्तरों का वर्णन भी हो चुका। स्वायम्भुव मनु का सृष्टिक्रम इस प्रकार कहा जा चका। अब उस स्वायम्भव मन्वन्तर तथा अन्याय मन्वन्तरों की श्रतिसन्धि का वर्णब कर रहा हूँ। अवश्य घटित होनेवाली विधि की इच्छा ( भवितव्यता ) से प्रेरित ऋषियों और देवताओं के साथ पूर्वकाल में जिस प्रकार मस्वन्तर व्यतीत हो चुके है उसी प्रकार भविष्य में भी होंगे । प्राचीव काल में इस मन्वन्तर में समस्त त्रलोक्य के ऐश्वयंशाली जो सप्तरषि, देवगण, पितर तथा मनुगण रहते हैं वे
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing him speak thus, Daityas were confused. They looked at both of them smiling pleasantly.* They stood there utterly confused. They were unable to understand anything. When they were (seen) confused like this, Kavya spoke to them again:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing him speak thus, Daityas were confused. They looked at both of them smiling pleasantly.* They stood there utterly confused. They were unable to understand anything. When they were (seen) confused like this, Kavya spoke to them again:

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामेन संतस्थौ प्रविष्टो जाह्नवीजले । पूर्णे द्वादशमे वर्षे निष्क्रान्तो जलमध्यतः
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmena saṃtasthau praviṣṭo jāhnavījale / pūrṇe dvādaśame varṣe niṣkrānto jalamadhyataḥ
verses.translation: "I am your preceptor Kavya. This is the praceptor of On being addressed thus, all the Asuras stood gazing at them. They could not see any difference between them.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तर के समस्त काल में सृष्टि व्यापार के साधक होते हैं, तदनन्तर अपने समय का दूसरा पक्ष आया जान अधिकार से च्युत हो महलोंक की ओर बमन करते हैं ।१४७-१५१। मन्वन्तर में अधिकारच्युत होने वाले वे देवगण सम्पूर्ण स्थितिकाल में एक सतथुग तक विद्यमान रहते हैं। इसी प्रकार अन्यान्य मन्वन्तरों में होनेवाले ऐश्वर्यशाली जितने देवता, पितर, ऋषि और मानवगण हैं, वे भी उत्पन्न होंगे।
verses.wordMeaning: "I am your preceptor Kavya. This is the praceptor of On being addressed thus, all the Asuras stood gazing at them. They could not see any difference between them.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am your preceptor Kavya. This is the praceptor of On being addressed thus, all the Asuras stood gazing at them. They could not see any difference between them.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षार्थी संचरेद् ग्रामं नावा यत्रैव तिष्ठति । तत्र तेन परा दृष्टा बाला चैव मनोहरा
verses.transliteration: bhikṣārthī saṃcared grāmaṃ nāvā yatraiva tiṣṭhati / tatra tena parā dṛṣṭā bālā caiva manoharā
verses.translation: Unperturbed by anything, Brhaspati told them: "O Daityas, this is Anginas. I am Kavya, your preceptor. This is Brhaspati in my guise. O Asuras, he deludes you all by assum¬ ing my form". On hearing his words, they consulted one another and spoke these words: Then all those Danavas bowed to and paid respects to him (Brhaspati in the guise of Kavya). Deluded by a long practice they accepted only his words.
verses.hindi: सभी मस्वन्तरों में कलियुग में में उत्पन्न होनेवाली उन शेष प्रजाओं में ही सतयुग को प्रवत्ति होती है । जिस प्रकार बुद्धिमान लोग सत्ययूग की श्रजाओं के यूर्थ कलियुग को भ्रजाओं का अस्तित्व मानते हैं, उसी प्रकार एक मन्वस्तर के पूर्व दुसरे मन्वन्तर की सृष्टि का अस्तित्व रहता है ।१५२-१५५। पूर्व मस्वन्तर सप्तर्षयों मनुश्चेव कालावेक्षास्तु ये स्थिताः। मन्वन्तरं प्रतीक्षन्ते क्षीघन्ते तपसि स्थिता:... १५७ मन्वन्तरव्यवस्थार्थ संतत्यर्थ च स्वंशः । पूर्ववत्संप्रवर्तन्ते प्रवृत्ते वृष्टिसजने
verses.wordMeaning: Unperturbed by anything, Brhaspati told them: "O Daityas, this is Anginas. I am Kavya, your preceptor. This is Brhaspati in my guise. O Asuras, he deludes you all by assum¬ ing my form". On hearing his words,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Unperturbed by anything, Brhaspati told them: "O Daityas, this is Anginas. I am Kavya, your preceptor. This is Brhaspati in my guise. O Asuras, he deludes you all by assum¬ ing my form". On hearing his words,…

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा स च कामार्त उवाच मधुरं तदा । मां नयस्व परं पारं कासि त्वं मृगलोचने
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa ca kāmārta uvāca madhuraṃ tadā / māṃ nayasva paraṃ pāraṃ kāsi tvaṃ mṛgalocane
verses.translation: All the infuriated Asuras spoke to him (the real Kavya) (staring at him) with reddened eyes: "This is our preceptor and benefactor. You may go. You are not our precep¬ tor. Whether heisBhargava (son ofBhrgu) or Angirasa (son of Ahgiras) let him be our preceptor. Wc shall abide by his guidance. Do not tarry (here any longer). That will be in your interest."
verses.hindi: इन्द्ेषु संभ्रवृत्तेषु उत्पन्नास्वोषधीषु च । प्रजासु च निकेतासु संस्थितासु क्वचित्ववचित्
verses.wordMeaning: All the infuriated Asuras spoke to him (the real Kavya) (staring at him) with reddened eyes: "This is our preceptor and benefactor. You may go. You are not our precep¬ tor. Whether heisBhargava (son ofBhrgu) or Angirasa (son of Ahgiras) let him be our preceptor.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All the infuriated Asuras spoke to him (the real Kavya) (staring at him) with reddened eyes: "This is our preceptor and benefactor. You may go. You are not our precep¬ tor. Whether heisBhargava (son ofBhrgu) or Angirasa (son of Ahgiras) let him be our preceptor.…

verses.sanskrit: नावारूढे नदीतीरे मम चित्तप्रमाथिनि । एवमुक्ता तु सा तेन प्रणम्य ऋषिपुंगवम्
verses.transliteration: nāvārūḍhe nadītīre mama cittapramāthini / evamuktā tu sā tena praṇamya ṛṣipuṃgavam
verses.translation: After saying this, all the Asuras resorted to Brhaspati (as their teacher). When the Asuras did not accept his sugges¬ tion for their great benefit, Bhargava became angry at their arrogance. He told them again: "O Danavas, although I had apprised (and instructed) you, you are not resorting to me. Hence, you will become deficient in sense and will attain defeat after defeat". After saying this to them, Kavya went away the way he had come. Then the Asuras became extremely frightened of the Devas and fled from that place. Keeping Prahlada at the head, they approached Kavya again. On approaching him, they stood there with heads bent down. On seeing his disciples (lit. ones for whose benefit he performed Yajiias) Kavya said to
verses.hindi: वार्तायां तु प्रवृत्तायां सद्धम॑ शषिभाविते । निरानन्दे गते लोके नष्टे स्थावरजड्भमे अग्रामनगरे चंव वर्णाश्रमविवर्जिते । पूर्व मन्वन्तरे शिष्टे ये भवन्तीह धामिकाः ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, all the Asuras resorted to Brhaspati (as their teacher). When the Asuras did not accept his sugges¬ tion for their great benefit, Bhargava became angry at their arrogance. He told them again: "O Danavas, although I had apprised (and instructed) you,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, all the Asuras resorted to Brhaspati (as their teacher). When the Asuras did not accept his sugges¬ tion for their great benefit, Bhargava became angry at their arrogance. He told them again: "O Danavas, although I had apprised (and instructed) you,…

verses.sanskrit: कथयामास चात्मानं दृष्ट्वा तं काममोहितम् । कैवर्तानां गृहे दासी कन्याहं द्विजसत्तम
verses.transliteration: kathayāmāsa cātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ kāmamohitam / kaivartānāṃ gṛhe dāsī kanyāhaṃ dvijasattama
verses.translation: "In spite of being cautioned by me at the proper Then Prahlada entreated him: "O Bhargava, (please) give up (forget) your wounded sense of honour. O Bhargava, do not forsake us, your own disciples, particularly attached to you with devotion and prayerfulness.
verses.hindi: देवासुरा: पितृगणा मुनयो मनवस्तथा। सर्पा भृता: पिशाचाश्व गन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसाः ३१६३
verses.wordMeaning: "In spite of being cautioned by me at the proper Then Prahlada entreated him: "O Bhargava, (please) give up (forget) your wounded sense of honour. O Bhargava, do not forsake us, your own disciples, particularly attached to you with devotion and prayerfulness.
verses.commentary: Sense: "In spite of being cautioned by me at the proper Then Prahlada entreated him: "O Bhargava, (please) give up (forget) your wounded sense of honour. O Bhargava, do not forsake us, your own disciples, particularly attached to you with devotion and prayerfulness.

verses.sanskrit: नावासंरक्षणार्थाय आदिष्टा स्वामिना विभो । मया विज्ञापितं वृत्तमशेषं ज्ञातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: nāvāsaṃrakṣaṇārthāya ādiṣṭā svāminā vibho / mayā vijñāpitaṃ vṛttamaśeṣaṃ jñātumarhasi
verses.translation: When asked by you, we had been deluded by the preceptor of Devas. Knowing this by means of your long- ranged vision, it behoves you to save us. O son of Bhrgu, ifyou are not going to favour us, we are (no belter than) cursed by you. So we shall enter Rasalala (the nether worlds) to-day." On being thus implored, eulogised and informed Kavya realised the truth. Out of mercy and sympathy, he controlled his anger.
verses.hindi: प्रारभन्‍्ते च कर्माणि मनुष्या देवले: सह १६४ मन्वन्तरादो प्रागेव त्रेतायुगमुखे ततः । पूर्व देवास्ततस्ते बे स्थिते धर्म तु स्वशः १६४५ की समाप्ति होने पर जब कि पिछला मन्वन्तर प्रारम्भ होता है, सत्ययूग के प्रारम्भ में जो कलि यूग के शेष सप्तरषि गण तथा मनु मन्वन्तर की व्यवस्था तथा सृष्टि के विस्तार के लिए काल की प्रतीक्षा करते हुए स्थित रहते हैं तथा तपस्या में निरत हा अगले मन्उन्तर की प्रतीक्षा में अपना काल यापन करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: When asked by you, we had been deluded by the preceptor of Devas. Knowing this by means of your long- ranged vision, it behoves you to save us. O son of Bhrgu, ifyou are not going to favour us, we are (no belter than) cursed by you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When asked by you, we had been deluded by the preceptor of Devas. Knowing this by means of your long- ranged vision, it behoves you to save us. O son of Bhrgu, ifyou are not going to favour us, we are (no belter than) cursed by you.…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तया सो ऽथ क्षणं ध्यात्वाब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktastayā so 'tha kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvābravīd idam
verses.translation: He spoke these words: <c Do not be afraid. Do not go to Rasatala. Even though I was alert this incident befell you because it was inevitable. Destiny which is very powerful cannot be altered. The sense that you have lost, you will regain now.
verses.hindi: उस समय पहिले की तरह सृष्टि हो जाने पर जब ओषधियाँ पृथ्वी पर उत्पन्न हो जाती हैं, स्त्री पुरुष अपने . अपने कर्मों में पूव॑क्‍त् प्रवृत्त हो जाते हैं, कहों कहीं पर प्रजाएँ अपना अपना निवास स्थान बनाकर तिवास करने लगती हैं, जीविका का प्रइन चलने लगता है, स्थावर जज्जम जगत् के नष्ट हो जाने पर सब लोग आनन्द रहित जीवन बिताने लगते हैं, वर्णाश्रम की व्यवस्था नहों रह जाती ग्राम एवं नगरों का
verses.wordMeaning: He spoke these words: <c Do not be afraid. Do not go to Rasatala. Even though I was alert this incident befell you because it was inevitable. Destiny which is very powerful cannot be altered. The sense that you have lost, you will regain now.
verses.commentary: Sense: He spoke these words: <c Do not be afraid. Do not go to Rasatala. Even though I was alert this incident befell you because it was inevitable. Destiny which is very powerful cannot be altered. The sense that you have lost, you will regain now.

verses.sanskrit: पराशर उवाच: अहं ज्ञानबलाद्भद्रे तव जानामि सम्भवम् । कैवर्तपुत्रिका न त्वं राजकन्यासि सुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: parāśara uvāca: ahaṃ jñānabalādbhadre tava jānāmi sambhavam / kaivartaputrikā na tvaṃ rājakanyāsi sundari
verses.translation: Brahma too had mentioned that the period adverse lo you had arrived. It was due to my favour that you had enjoyed the great pleasures of the three worlds (so long). For full ten Yugas you have reigned over Dcvas. Brahma has ordained your rulcrship only for that length of period.
verses.hindi: अस्तित्व नहीं रह जाता, तब पूर्व मन्वन्तर के बचे हुए परम धामिक प्रधृत्ति वाले सप्ताधि तथा मनु,-सन्ता- नोत्पत्ति के लिए उद्यमश्चील होते हैं, और इसके लिए परम कठोर तप करते हैं। सब का विनाश हो जाने पर इस प्रथ्वी! पर देवता, अदुर, पितर, मुनि, मनुष्य, सपं, भूव, पिशाच, गन्धर्व, यक्ष, राक्षसादि की उत्पत्ति होती है ।!५६९-१६३। इस प्रकार उस समय मन्वन्तर के प्रारम्भ में उन बची हुई प्रजाओं में जो शेष रह जाते हैं वे शिष्टाचार का उपदेश करते हैं, तथा सातों ऋषिमण, मनु और मनुष्यगण देवताओं के साथ सृष्टि का कार्य प्रारम्भ करते हैं, तदनन्तर त्रेता युग के प्रारम्भ होने पर जब चारों ओर धर्म की प्रतिष्ठा हो चुकती है, सबे- प्रथम देवगण तदनन्तर वे अवशिष्ट मानव गण ब्रह्मचयं व्रत द्वारा ऋषियों के ऋण से, सन्तानोत्पत्ति करके
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma too had mentioned that the period adverse lo you had arrived. It was due to my favour that you had enjoyed the great pleasures of the three worlds (so long). For full ten Yugas you have reigned over Dcvas. Brahma has ordained your rulcrship only for that length of period.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma too had mentioned that the period adverse lo you had arrived. It was due to my favour that you had enjoyed the great pleasures of the three worlds (so long). For full ten Yugas you have reigned over Dcvas. Brahma has ordained your rulcrship only for that length of period.

verses.sanskrit: कन्योवाच: कः पिता कथ्यतां ब्रह्मन्कस्या वा ह्युदरोद्भवा । कस्मिन्वंशे प्रसूताहं कैवर्ततनया कथम्
verses.transliteration: kanyovāca: kaḥ pitā kathyatāṃ brahmankasyā vā hyudarodbhavā / kasminvaṃśe prasūtāhaṃ kaivartatanayā katham
verses.translation: In the Savarnika Alanvantara you will again have suzerainty. Your grandson Bali will become the lord of all the worlds. It has been mentioned by Brahma himself to me that when later on the worlds will be seized from him, his power of penance will not be of any avail.
verses.hindi: ऋषोणां ब्रह्मचर्येष गत्वाइनृत्यं तु बे ततः। पितुणां प्रजया चेष देवानासिज्यथा तथा ॥ै१६६ शर्त वर्षसहर्नाणि धर्मे बर्णात्मके स्थिता:। त्रयीं वार्ता दण्डनोति धर्मान्वर्णाश्रमांस्तथा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: In the Savarnika Alanvantara you will again have suzerainty. Your grandson Bali will become the lord of all the worlds. It has been mentioned by Brahma himself to me that when later on the worlds will be seized from him, his power of penance will not be of any avail.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Savarnika Alanvantara you will again have suzerainty. Your grandson Bali will become the lord of all the worlds. It has been mentioned by Brahma himself to me that when later on the worlds will be seized from him, his power of penance will not be of any avail.

verses.sanskrit: पराशर उवाच: कथयामि समस्तं यत्त्वया पृष्टमशेषतः । वसुर्नामेति भूपालः सोमवंशविभूषणः
verses.transliteration: parāśara uvāca: kathayāmi samastaṃ yattvayā pṛṣṭamaśeṣataḥ / vasurnāmeti bhūpālaḥ somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Since his activities will be devoid of undue attachment, Brahma will be pleased with him and (the kingdom) will be bestowed on him in the Savarnika Manvantara. The lord has told me, 'The kingdom of Devas will come to Bali'. Hence he bides his time remaining invisible to all living beings.
verses.hindi: पूर्व देवेषु तेष्वेव स्वर्गाय प्रभुखेषु च । पूर्व देवास्ततस्ते वे स्थिता धर्मेण कृत्स्नशः (१६८ विनित्रत्तविका रास्ते मानसीं सिद्धिमाश्थिता:  अवेक्ष्यमाणा वशिनस्तिष्ठन्त्याशृतसंप्लयलमू
verses.wordMeaning: Since his activities will be devoid of undue attachment, Brahma will be pleased with him and (the kingdom) will be bestowed on him in the Savarnika Manvantara. The lord has told me, 'The kingdom of Devas will come to Bali'.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since his activities will be devoid of undue attachment, Brahma will be pleased with him and (the kingdom) will be bestowed on him in the Savarnika Manvantara. The lord has told me, 'The kingdom of Devas will come to Bali'.…

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूद्वीपाधिपो भद्रे शत्रूणां भयवर्धनः । शतानि सप्त भार्याणां पुत्राणां च दशैव तु
verses.transliteration: jambūdvīpādhipo bhadre śatrūṇāṃ bhayavardhanaḥ / śatāni sapta bhāryāṇāṃ putrāṇāṃ ca daśaiva tu
verses.translation: You have been granted immortality by the delighted self-born deity. Hence, without exhibiting undue curiosity and agitation you have to bear with the change. Before the (proper) time, it is not possible for me to save you. O lord, I have been forbidden by Brahma who knows the future.
verses.hindi: ततस्तेषु व्यतीतेषु सर्वेष्वेतेषु सबवंद। । शुन्येश्रु देवस्थानेषु त्रलोक्ये तेषु सर्वशः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: You have been granted immortality by the delighted self-born deity. Hence, without exhibiting undue curiosity and agitation you have to bear with the change. Before the (proper) time, it is not possible for me to save you. O lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: You have been granted immortality by the delighted self-born deity. Hence, without exhibiting undue curiosity and agitation you have to bear with the change. Before the (proper) time, it is not possible for me to save you. O lord,…

verses.sanskrit: धर्मेण पालयेल्लोकानीशवत्पूज्यते सदा । म्लेच्छास्तस्याविधेयाश्च क्षीरद्वीपनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: dharmeṇa pālayellokānīśavatpūjyate sadā / mlecchāstasyāvidheyāśca kṣīradvīpanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: These two are my disciples. They are equal to me.* and Brhaspati. They will sustain you all when attacked by Devas." When the Daityas, the chief of whom was Prahlada, were given this advice by Kavya of indefatigable energy and activity, they went away along with those two (disciples i.e. Sanda and Amarka).
verses.hindi: उपस्थिता इहैवान्ये देवा ये स्वर्ग वासिन ततस्ते तपसा युक्ता स्थानान्यापुरयन्ति वे। सत्येत ब्रह्मचयेंण श्रुतेन च समन्विता १७२ सप्तर्षीणां मनोःचैव देवानां पित॒भिः सह । निधनानीह पूर्वेषामादिना व भविष्यताम्
verses.wordMeaning: These two are my disciples. They are equal to me.* and Brhaspati. They will sustain you all when attacked by Devas." When the Daityas, the chief of whom was Prahlada, were given this advice by Kavya of indefatigable energy and activity,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These two are my disciples. They are equal to me.* and Brhaspati. They will sustain you all when attacked by Devas." When the Daityas, the chief of whom was Prahlada, were given this advice by Kavya of indefatigable energy and activity,…

verses.sanskrit: तेषामुत्सादनार्थाय ययावुल्लङ्घ्य सागरम् । संयुक्तः पुत्रभृत्यैश्च पौरुषे महति स्थितैः
verses.transliteration: teṣāmutsādanārthāya yayāvullaṅghya sāgaram / saṃyuktaḥ putrabhṛtyaiśca pauruṣe mahati sthitaiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing about the inevitability of future events They equipped themselves with various weapons and the coats of mail and challenged Devas for fighting. On seeing Asuras advanced for jattlc, Devas got ready with all equipments and fought them in return. The battle between Devas and Asuras continued for a hundred years. Asuras defeated Devas. The beaten and distressed Devas spoke thus among themselves.
verses.hindi: पितरों के ऋण से, और यज्ञ द्वारा देवताओं के ऋण से मुक्त होते हैं। उन लोग ने इस प्रकार एक लाख वर्ष तक बर्णाश्रम धर्म की व्यवस्था में व्यवस्थित रह त्रयी, वार्ता, दण्डनीति, वर्णात्रम धर्म आदि की प्रतिष्ठा कर तथा चारों आश्रमों के विधिवत् स्थापवा कर स्वर्ग गमन के लिए विचार किया  १६४-१६७। पूवकाल में उन्हीं प्रमुख देवताओं के स्वर्गलोक के लिए प्रस्थित हो जाने पर पहिले देवगण तदनन्तर वे लोग धर्म के साथ पूर्णतः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing about the inevitability of future events They equipped themselves with various weapons and the coats of mail and challenged Devas for fighting. On seeing Asuras advanced for jattlc, Devas got ready with all equipments and fought them in return.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about the inevitability of future events They equipped themselves with various weapons and the coats of mail and challenged Devas for fighting. On seeing Asuras advanced for jattlc, Devas got ready with all equipments and fought them in return.…

verses.sanskrit: समरं तैः समारब्धं म्लेच्छैश्च वसुना सह । जिता म्लेच्छाः समस्तास्ते वसुना मृगलोचने
verses.transliteration: samaraṃ taiḥ samārabdhaṃ mlecchaiśca vasunā saha / jitā mlecchāḥ samastāste vasunā mṛgalocane
verses.translation: Devas said: "We do not know the (extent of the) power of San<ja and Amarka on Asuras. Hence, what is conducive to our welfare must be done by preparing for a Yajha. After knowing about and capturing those two, we will defeat Asuras". In this manner, Sanda and Amarka thereafter forsook Asuras. Devas were victorious and Danavas suffered disastrous defeat.
verses.hindi: यूक्त हए। मन्वन्तर के समाप्त हो जाने पर वे सब लोग अपना स्थान छोड़कर मंत्रों के साथ अनामय महलोंक को प्रस्थित हो जाते हैं। विक्रार-विहीन म/नसिक्र सिद्धियों से सम्पन्न, जितेन्द्रिय वे लोग इस प्रकार मह प्रलय पर्यन्त अवस्थित रहकर मन्वन्तर का १रिवतेन देखते हैं। तदनस्तर उन सभी देवताओं के विगत हो जाने पर त्रैलोक्य में सभी देवताओं के स्थान शून्य में परिणत हो जाते हैं तब उनमें अन्य जो स्वयंवासी देवगण हैं वे उपस्थित होते हैं ।१६८४-१७१। और अपने सत्य, ब्रह्मचये, शास्त्रज्ञान तथा तपस्या के बल पर उन शून्य स्थानों की पूति करते हैं! सातों कृषि, मनु, देवमण ओर पितरगण इनमें से पू्ंकाल में जो हो चुके हैं, वे भी भविष्य में होनेवालों के साथ ही मृत्यु को प्राप्त करते हैं। उन सबों का अत्यन्त विच्छेद इस लोक में एक मस्वन्तर के व्यतीत होने पर घटित होता है। मब्वन्तरों में इस प्रकार पूर्व के मनन्‍्वन्तरों
verses.wordMeaning: Devas said: "We do not know the (extent of the) power of San<ja and Amarka on Asuras. Hence, what is conducive to our welfare must be done by preparing for a Yajha. After knowing about and capturing those two, we will defeat Asuras". In this manner,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas said: "We do not know the (extent of the) power of San<ja and Amarka on Asuras. Hence, what is conducive to our welfare must be done by preparing for a Yajha. After knowing about and capturing those two, we will defeat Asuras". In this manner,…

verses.sanskrit: करदास्ते कृतास्तेन सपुत्रबलवाहनाः । प्रधाना तस्य सा राज्ञी तव माता मृगेक्षणे
verses.transliteration: karadāste kṛtāstena saputrabalavāhanāḥ / pradhānā tasya sā rājñī tava mātā mṛgekṣaṇe
verses.translation: After defeating Asuras, Devas approached Sanda and Amarka. Asuras who had already been over¬ whelmed by the curse of Kavya had no support now. Hai assed by Devas, they entered Rasatala. Thus Danavas were crippled and rendered inactive by Sakra. Lord Brahma pronounced that all those Asuras who did not follow the directions of Prahlada would be killed by human beings.
verses.hindi: के समान प्रलयकाल पर्यन्त निश्चित परिवर्तन के साथ सृष्टि की स्थिति होती है । इस प्रकार व्यतीत एवं भविष्य में आनेवाले मन्वन्तरों के प्रतिसंधान का लक्षण स्वायम्भव ने बतलाया है ।१७२-१७५। बीते हुए मन्वन्तरों में
verses.wordMeaning: After defeating Asuras, Devas approached Sanda and Amarka. Asuras who had already been over¬ whelmed by the curse of Kavya had no support now. Hai assed by Devas, they entered Rasatala. Thus Danavas were crippled and rendered inactive by Sakra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After defeating Asuras, Devas approached Sanda and Amarka. Asuras who had already been over¬ whelmed by the curse of Kavya had no support now. Hai assed by Devas, they entered Rasatala. Thus Danavas were crippled and rendered inactive by Sakra.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रवासस्थे महीपाले संजाता सा रजस्वला । नारीणां तु सदाकालं मन्मथो ह्यधिको भवेत्
verses.transliteration: pravāsasthe mahīpāle saṃjātā sā rajasvalā / nārīṇāṃ tu sadākālaṃ manmatho hyadhiko bhavet
verses.translation: Hence Narayana was born of Dharma in the Caksusa At the time of the manifestation of the other (i.e. Prthu) Brahma himself was the priest. In the fourth Yuga.when Asuras 2 were in distress, he was born within the ocean for the purpose of killing Hiranyakasipu 3.
verses.hindi: सन्वन्तराणां परिवतनानि एकान्ततस्तानि महर्गतानि ॥। मह॒जंनं चव जन तपश्नच एकान्तगानि सम भवन्ति सत्ये सत्ये स्थितानीह तदा तु तानि प्राप्ते बिकारे प्रतिसर्गकाले १७८
verses.wordMeaning: Hence Narayana was born of Dharma in the Caksusa At the time of the manifestation of the other (i.e. Prthu) Brahma himself was the priest. In the fourth Yuga.when Asuras 2 were in distress, he was born within the ocean for the purpose of killing Hiranyakasipu 3.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence Narayana was born of Dharma in the Caksusa At the time of the manifestation of the other (i.e. Prthu) Brahma himself was the priest. In the fourth Yuga.when Asuras 2 were in distress, he was born within the ocean for the purpose of killing Hiranyakasipu 3.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषेण ऋतोः काले भिद्यन्ते कामसायकैः । मन्मथेन तु संतप्ताचिन्तयत्सा शुभेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: viśeṣeṇa ṛtoḥ kāle bhidyante kāmasāyakaiḥ / manmathena tu saṃtaptācintayatsā śubhekṣaṇā
verses.translation: The third incarnation, that of Vamana, took place in the seventh Tretayuga when all the three worlds had been overrun by Daityas and were ruled over by Bali. Withdrawing all the limbs within himself (Assum¬ ing the form of a Dwarf) the son of Aditi approached the son of Virocana, Bali, the king of Daityas, who was performing a Yajna. Brhaspati too accompanied him. Assuming the form of a Brahmana on an auspicious occasion, he requested Bali: "O king, you are the lord of the three worlds. Everything is in you. It behoves you to grant me (the space covered by) three paces".
verses.hindi: ततोभियोगाद्विषमप्रमाणं विशन्ति नारायणमेव देवम ११७६
verses.wordMeaning: The third incarnation, that of Vamana, took place in the seventh Tretayuga when all the three worlds had been overrun by Daityas and were ruled over by Bali.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The third incarnation, that of Vamana, took place in the seventh Tretayuga when all the three worlds had been overrun by Daityas and were ruled over by Bali.…

verses.sanskrit: दूतं वै प्रेषयाम्यद्य वसुराज्ञः समीपतः । आहूतः सत्वरं दूत गच्छ त्वं नृपसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: dūtaṃ vai preṣayāmyadya vasurājñaḥ samīpataḥ / āhūtaḥ satvaraṃ dūta gaccha tvaṃ nṛpasannidhau
verses.translation: "I will give", promised the king Bali, the son of Viro¬ cana. On knowing that he was a Vamana (dwarf), he was delighted much. But, O excellent Brahmanas, that lord Vamana measured the entire Universe, the Earth, the Heaven and the Sky by means of three paces.
verses.hindi: क्षणं रसं तिष्ठति जीवलोक: क्षपोदयाभ्यां परिवनन्‍्दमान: इत्युत्तराण्येबपषिस्तुतानां धर्मात्मनां दिव्यदर्शां मनूनाम् ॥। वायुप्रणीतान्युपलभ्य दृश्यं दिव्यौजसा व्याससमासयोगे:
verses.wordMeaning: "I will give", promised the king Bali, the son of Viro¬ cana. On knowing that he was a Vamana (dwarf), he was delighted much. But, O excellent Brahmanas, that lord Vamana measured the entire Universe, the Earth, the Heaven and the Sky by means of three paces.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I will give", promised the king Bali, the son of Viro¬ cana. On knowing that he was a Vamana (dwarf), he was delighted much. But, O excellent Brahmanas, that lord Vamana measured the entire Universe, the Earth, the Heaven and the Sky by means of three paces.

verses.sanskrit: दूत उवाच: परतीरं गतो देवि वसुराजारिशासनः । तत्र गन्तुम् अशक्येत जलयानैर्विना शुभे
verses.transliteration: dūta uvāca: paratīraṃ gato devi vasurājāriśāsanaḥ / tatra gantum aśakyeta jalayānairvinā śubhe
verses.translation: That Bhutatman (the immanent soul of all living beings) of great fame excelled even the sun by means of his brilliance. He illuminated all the quarters and the intermediate directions with his refulgence. 'Vainya* i.e. King Prthu in Bel. P. v. 72. It-is a better reading as this and other sources give the credit of Yajna to Prthu in this Manvantara.
verses.hindi: सर्वाणि राजधिसुरधिमन्ति ब्रह्मधिदेवो रगवन्ति चेव ॥॥ सुरेशसप्त्षिपितृप्रजेशयक्तानि सम्यक्परिवरतंनानि
verses.wordMeaning: That Bhutatman (the immanent soul of all living beings) of great fame excelled even the sun by means of his brilliance. He illuminated all the quarters and the intermediate directions with his refulgence. 'Vainya* i.e. King Prthu in Bel. P. v. 72.…
verses.commentary: Sense: That Bhutatman (the immanent soul of all living beings) of great fame excelled even the sun by means of his brilliance. He illuminated all the quarters and the intermediate directions with his refulgence. 'Vainya* i.e. King Prthu in Bel. P. v. 72.…

verses.sanskrit: तानि यानानि सर्वाणि गृहीतानि परे तटे । दूतवाक्येन सा राज्ञी विषण्णा कामपीडिता
verses.transliteration: tāni yānāni sarvāṇi gṛhītāni pare taṭe / dūtavākyena sā rājñī viṣaṇṇā kāmapīḍitā
verses.translation: Suras (in Bd. P. v. 74) is the correct reading. It implies Varaha incarnation, but Varaha killed Hiraijyaksa and Nrsiriiha incarnation was for killing Hiranyakasipu.
verses.hindi: कोतिद्युतिस्यातिभिरन्वितानां पुण्यं हि विख्यापनभोश्वराणाम् १८३ भविध्यत्कालीन मन्वन्तरों का साधन इस प्रकार महाप्रलय पर्यन्त अत्यन्त विच्छिन्न होता है। मन्वन्तरों के परिवर्तन होने पर सभी महलोंक को प्राप्त होते हैं, फिर महलोंक के बाद क्रमशः जनलोक, तपोलोक तथा सत्यलोक में प्राप्त होते हैं ।(७६०१७७। उतन्त उनके नानात्व दर्शन एवं प्रत्यय के कारण भन्वन्तरों के परिवर्तन के उपरान्त थे उस सत्यलोक को छोड़ देते हैं और तदनन्तर प्रमाण रहित (अप्रमेय) बारायण भगवान् के
verses.wordMeaning: Suras (in Bd. P. v. 74) is the correct reading. It implies Varaha incarnation, but Varaha killed Hiraijyaksa and Nrsiriiha incarnation was for killing Hiranyakasipu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suras (in Bd. P. v. 74) is the correct reading. It implies Varaha incarnation, but Varaha killed Hiraijyaksa and Nrsiriiha incarnation was for killing Hiranyakasipu.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सखी तामुवाचाथ कस्मात्त्वं परितप्यसे । स्वलेखः प्रेष्यतां देवि शुकहस्ते यथार्थतः
verses.transliteration: tatsakhī tāmuvācātha kasmāttvaṃ paritapyase / svalekhaḥ preṣyatāṃ devi śukahaste yathārthataḥ
verses.translation: Madhava, the immanent soul of all living beings showed, the Brahmanas there a great miracle, viz. all the great elements' with their special features and the entire Time. They saw the entire Universe and themselves in his cosmic body. There was nothing in the worlds which was not pervaded by thenoble-souled lord.
verses.hindi: शरीर में प्रविष्ट होते हैं। विधि की इच्छा से चिरकाल से प्रवृत्त मन्वन्तरों के इन परिवतंनों में विनाश और उत्पत्ति द्वारा बंधा हुआ परिवबतंनशील जीवसमूह एक क्षण भी कहीं पर स्थिर नहीं रहता। इस प्रकार ऋषियों द्वारा सम्मानित, दिव्यदुष्टिसम्पन्न धर्मात्मा मनुगण के जीवन विवरण को, जिसका वायु ने वर्णन किया है, कहीं पर व्यास ( बिस्तारपूर्वक ) और समास (संक्षेप ) शैली में वर्णन किया जा चुका, इसे
verses.wordMeaning: Madhava, the immanent soul of all living beings showed, the Brahmanas there a great miracle, viz. all the great elements' with their special features and the entire Time. They saw the entire Universe and themselves in his cosmic body.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Madhava, the immanent soul of all living beings showed, the Brahmanas there a great miracle, viz. all the great elements' with their special features and the entire Time. They saw the entire Universe and themselves in his cosmic body.…

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रं लङ्घयित्वा तु शकुन्ता यान्ति सुन्दरि । सखिवाक्येन सा राज्ञी स्वस्था जाता नराधिप
verses.transliteration: samudraṃ laṅghayitvā tu śakuntā yānti sundari / sakhivākyena sā rājñī svasthā jātā narādhipa
verses.translation: Seeing that form of Upendra (i.e. Vamana) Devas, Danavas and human beings were fascinated. All of them were enchanted by Visnu's refulgence. Bali was bound with great nooses along with his kinsmen, friends and followers. The entire race of Virocana was consigned to Patala.
verses.hindi: दिव्य बल से लोग देख सकते हैं । ये सारे विवरण राजषियों, देवधियों, ब्रह्मषियों, देववाओं तथा सर्पों के कथानक से संयुक्त हैं, सुरेश्वर इन्द्र सातों ऋषि, पितरों, प्रजापतियों एबं भली तरह होनेवाले परिवततंनों से युक्त हैं ।१७८-१८२। अति उदार वंश एबं कुल में उत्पन्न होनेवाले, परम कान्ति, सूक्ष्म बुद्धि, सत् कौति, छुति, स्याति आदि से सम्पन्न ऐश्वर्यशाली महापुरुषों का यशोगान अति पुण्यप्रद है। अति गोपनीय परम पवित्र, प्रजेशदेवर्षिमनृप्रधानां पृण्यप्रसूति प्रथितामजस्य ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing that form of Upendra (i.e. Vamana) Devas, Danavas and human beings were fascinated. All of them were enchanted by Visnu's refulgence. Bali was bound with great nooses along with his kinsmen, friends and followers. The entire race of Virocana was consigned to Patala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing that form of Upendra (i.e. Vamana) Devas, Danavas and human beings were fascinated. All of them were enchanted by Visnu's refulgence. Bali was bound with great nooses along with his kinsmen, friends and followers. The entire race of Virocana was consigned to Patala.

verses.sanskrit: व्याहृतो लेखकस्तत्र लिख लेखं ममाज्ञया । त्वद्धीना सत्यभामाद्य वसो राजन्न जीवति
verses.transliteration: vyāhṛto lekhakastatra likha lekhaṃ mamājñayā / tvaddhīnā satyabhāmādya vaso rājanna jīvati
verses.translation: After handing back the entire riches and glory of Devas to the noble-souled Indra, the mighty-armed Janardana manifested himself before the human world. These three incarnations of the lord were divine and auspicious. Listen and understand the seven incarnations as human beings as a result of the curse.
verses.hindi: इस्येतदन्तरं प्रोक्तं मनोः स्वायंभुवस्य तु । विस्तरेणा5ःनृपुर्व्य च भूयः कि वर्णयास्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: After handing back the entire riches and glory of Devas to the noble-souled Indra, the mighty-armed Janardana manifested himself before the human world. These three incarnations of the lord were divine and auspicious.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After handing back the entire riches and glory of Devas to the noble-souled Indra, the mighty-armed Janardana manifested himself before the human world. These three incarnations of the lord were divine and auspicious.…

verses.sanskrit: ऋतुकालो ऽद्य संजातो लिख लेखं तु लेखकं । लिखिते भूर्जपत्रे तु लेखे वै लेखकेन तु
verses.transliteration: ṛtukālo 'dya saṃjāto likha lekhaṃ tu lekhakaṃ / likhite bhūrjapatre tu lekhe vai lekhakena tu
verses.translation: In the tenth Tretayuga when Dharma had been ruined he had his fourth incarnation as Dattatreya with Markandeya as his preceptor. His fifth incarnation was in the fifteenth Tretayuga as Mandhatr, the Emperor. Tathya (Utathya?) was his preceptor.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्‍्ते प्रजापतिबंशानुकीतन॑ नामैकषश्टतिमोअध्याय: ।६१॥। क्रमं मन्वन्तराणां त् ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः । देवतानां च॒ सर्वेषां ये च यस्यान्तरे सनोः ॥१ १
verses.wordMeaning: In the tenth Tretayuga when Dharma had been ruined he had his fourth incarnation as Dattatreya with Markandeya as his preceptor. His fifth incarnation was in the fifteenth Tretayuga as Mandhatr, the Emperor. Tathya (Utathya?) was his preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the tenth Tretayuga when Dharma had been ruined he had his fourth incarnation as Dattatreya with Markandeya as his preceptor. His fifth incarnation was in the fifteenth Tretayuga as Mandhatr, the Emperor. Tathya (Utathya?) was his preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: शुकः पञ्जरमध्यस्थ आनीतोद्धैव सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: śukaḥ pañjaramadhyastha ānītoddhaiva sannidhau
verses.translation: The sixth incarnation was that as the son of Jamadagni in the nineteenth Tretayuga. He annihilated all the Ksatriyas. He had Visvamitra as his preceptor (Purohita). In the twentyfourth Tretayuga, he took his seventh incarnation as Rama, the son of Dasaratha. In his sacrifice Vasistha was his priest. It was for the purpose of killing Ravana.
verses.hindi: स्व प्रदान करनेवाले, पृन्रप्रद एवं सर्वश्रेष्ठ इस चरित्र को बड़े-बड़े पर्वों के अवमरों पर जपना चाहिए, ऐसा करने से दुस्वप्नों की शास्ति एवं दीर्घायु की प्राप्ति होती है। प्रजापति, मनु, देवषिगण एवं अजन्मा ब्रह्मा की पृण्यप्रद सुप्रसिद्ध सस्तानों के उत्पत्ति-त्रिवरण से संयुक्त महेश्वर के तत्त्वपूर्ण आख्यान से संवलित, हमारे यश को बढ़ानेवाले इस महापुराण के श्रवण से आप लोग सिद्धियाँ प्राप्त करें । स्वायम्भूव मन्वन्तर का
verses.wordMeaning: The sixth incarnation was that as the son of Jamadagni in the nineteenth Tretayuga. He annihilated all the Ksatriyas. He had Visvamitra as his preceptor (Purohita). In the twentyfourth Tretayuga, he took his seventh incarnation as Rama, the son of Dasaratha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sixth incarnation was that as the son of Jamadagni in the nineteenth Tretayuga. He annihilated all the Ksatriyas. He had Visvamitra as his preceptor (Purohita). In the twentyfourth Tretayuga, he took his seventh incarnation as Rama, the son of Dasaratha.…

verses.sanskrit: सत्यभामोवाच: नीत्वा लेखं गच्छ शीघ्रं वसुराज्ञः समीपतः । शकुनिः प्रणतो भूत्वा गृहीत्वा लेखमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: satyabhāmovāca: nītvā lekhaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ vasurājñaḥ samīpataḥ / śakuniḥ praṇato bhūtvā gṛhītvā lekhamuttamam
verses.translation: In the twentyeighth Dvapara Yuga, Visnu took his eighth incarnation as Vedavyasa born of ParaSara. He had Jatukarna as the preceptor. Vi$nu who had been born earlier as the son of Aditi andKasyapa took his ninth incarnation as the son of DevakI an asudeva with the Brahmana Gargya as his preceptor.
verses.hindi: बृत्तान्त इस प्रकार क्रमशः विस्तारपूर्वक कहा जा चुका अब इसके बाद क्या कर्णन करूं ? ।!८३-१८६। श्री बायुमहापुराण में प्रजापति वंशानुकीर्तत नामक इकसठवाँ अध्याय समाप्त
verses.wordMeaning: In the twentyeighth Dvapara Yuga, Visnu took his eighth incarnation as Vedavyasa born of ParaSara. He had Jatukarna as the preceptor.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twentyeighth Dvapara Yuga, Visnu took his eighth incarnation as Vedavyasa born of ParaSara. He had Jatukarna as the preceptor.…

verses.sanskrit: उत्पत्य सहसा राजञ्जगामाकाशमण्डलम् । ततः पक्षी गतः शीघ्रं वसुराजसमीपतः
verses.transliteration: utpatya sahasā rājañjagāmākāśamaṇḍalam / tataḥ pakṣī gataḥ śīghraṃ vasurājasamīpataḥ
verses.translation: The lord is Aprameya (one whocannot be measured). He is Niyojya* (freely ordered about and employed bydevotees). He moves about as he pleases. He has full self-control. He sports about in the world like a boy playing with toys. This mighty-armed ladhusudana cannot be measured. There is nothing greater than the cosmic form of the Lord. In the twentycighth Dvapara Yuga, when a slight portion of the end of Dvapara remained and when Dharma had been destroyed, Lord Visnu was born in the family of Vi'?nis in order to establish Dharma and destroy Asuras. By means of his Yogic Maya, the Yogic soul fascinated all living beings.
verses.hindi: शाॉंशपायन ने कहा--भ्ब मैं मन्वन्तरों का कम एवं उन मन्‍्वन्तरों में होनेवाले समान देवताओं

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्ते लेखे शुकेनैव सत्यभामाविसर्जिते । वसुराज्ञा ततो लेखो गृह्य हस्ते ऽवधारितः
verses.transliteration: kṣipte lekhe śukenaiva satyabhāmāvisarjite / vasurājñā tato lekho gṛhya haste 'vadhāritaḥ
verses.translation: Entering human womb, he moved about on the Earth fully concealed (from the view of ordinary mortals) for the sake of the sport among the human beings. He was accom¬ panied by Sandipani as his preceptor. In that incarnation, the powerful lord slew the following Daityas who had taken human bodies: Kamsa, Salva, Dvivida the great Asura, Arista, Vrsabha, Kesin the horse, Kuvalayaplda the elephant, the chief of wrestlers, the officer in-charge of the abode (ofKarhsa) (Canura) and the demoness Putana.
verses.hindi: के विषय में जानना चाहता हूं अत ऊध्व प्रवक्ष्यासि मनोः स्वारोचिषस्य च् । प्रजासगं समासेन द्वितीयस्य महात्मनः ६ +आसन्व तुषिता देवा मनुस्वारोचिषेउ्तरे । पारावताश्च विद्वांसो द्वावेब तु गणौ स्मृतो
verses.wordMeaning: Entering human womb, he moved about on the Earth fully concealed (from the view of ordinary mortals) for the sake of the sport among the human beings. He was accom¬ panied by Sandipani as his preceptor. In that incarnation,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Entering human womb, he moved about on the Earth fully concealed (from the view of ordinary mortals) for the sake of the sport among the human beings. He was accom¬ panied by Sandipani as his preceptor. In that incarnation,…

verses.sanskrit: लेखार्थं चिन्तयित्वा तु गृह्य वीर्यं नरेश्वरः । अमोघं पुटिकां कृत्वा प्रतिलेखेन मिश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: lekhārthaṃ cintayitvā tu gṛhya vīryaṃ nareśvaraḥ / amoghaṃ puṭikāṃ kṛtvā pratilekhena miśritam
verses.translation: The thousand arms of Bana of wonderful exploits were cut ofTby him. The Asura Naraka and the powerful (Kala-) Yavana were killed by him in battle. All the precious gems and jewels of kings were con¬ fiscated by him through his splendid refulgence. All the kings of evil conduct in Rasiitala were killed by him.
verses.hindi: धेवस्यशो5थ वाभान्यों गोपा देवायतस्तथा । अजश्च भगवान्देवा दुरोणश्च महाबलः ३६
verses.wordMeaning: The thousand arms of Bana of wonderful exploits were cut ofTby him. The Asura Naraka and the powerful (Kala-) Yavana were killed by him in battle. All the precious gems and jewels of kings were con¬ fiscated by him through his splendid refulgence.…

verses.sanskrit: शुकस्य सो ऽपयामास गच्छ राज्ञीसमीपतः । प्रणम्य वसुराजानं बीजं गृह्योत्पपात ह
verses.transliteration: śukasya so 'payāmāsa gaccha rājñīsamīpataḥ / praṇamya vasurājānaṃ bījaṃ gṛhyotpapāta ha
verses.translation: These incarnations of the noble-souled lord were for the sake of the benefit of the worlds. He will be leading all the armies consisting of elephants, horses and chariots. He will be surrounded by hundreds and thousands of Brahmanas armed with weapons. He will be killing those who are not very religious and those who hate religion, viz. the northerners, those of the middle lands, those who live to the west of the Vindhya mountain, the southerners (such as) Dravitfas along with Simhalcse, Gandharas, Paradas, Pahlavas, Yavanas, Sakas, Tusaras, Barbaras, Pulindas, Daradas,Khasas, Lampakas, Andhakas, Rudras and Kiratas. The powerful lord will destroy Mlecchas making his discus whirl. He will be invisible to all living beings and move about on the Earth.
verses.hindi: » अजश्र द्वादशस्तेषां तुषिता: परिकोरतिता: । इत्येते क्रतुपुत्नास्तु तदाइब्सन्सोमपायिनः ११ खूत ने कहा--अतीत एवं भविष्यत्काल में होनेवाले जितने मन्वन्तर हैं, उनका यथासम्भव संक्षेप और विस्ता रपूर्वक मैं वर्णन कर रहा हूँ, सुनिये । मनुओं में सर्वप्रथम स्वायम्भुव मनु हैं, तदनम्तर स्वारोचिष मनु वा कार्यकाल आता है इसी प्रकार उनके बाद औत्तम, तामस, रेवत, एवं चाक्षुष मनु के कार्यकाल ये छः अतीतकालीन मनु हैं, आठ भविष्यकालीन मनुओं के बारे में बतला रहा हूँ ।२-३। साव्ं, पउचरौच्य,
verses.wordMeaning: These incarnations of the noble-souled lord were for the sake of the benefit of the worlds. He will be leading all the armies consisting of elephants, horses and chariots. He will be surrounded by hundreds and thousands of Brahmanas armed with weapons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These incarnations of the noble-souled lord were for the sake of the benefit of the worlds. He will be leading all the armies consisting of elephants, horses and chariots. He will be surrounded by hundreds and thousands of Brahmanas armed with weapons.…

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रोपरि सम्प्राप्तः शुकः श्येनेन वीक्षितः । सामिषं तं शुकं ज्ञात्वा श्येनस् तम् अभ्यधावत
verses.transliteration: samudropari samprāptaḥ śukaḥ śyenena vīkṣitaḥ / sāmiṣaṃ taṃ śukaṃ jñātvā śyenas tam abhyadhāvata
verses.translation: Visnu will be born as a human being with a part of the intelligent god. In the previous birth he would have been born as the powerful Pramiti. In bodily splendour he was (will be) like the moon and will be born when the Kaliyuga is complete. Thus the ten incarnations of the lord have been recounted.
verses.hindi: भौत्य और वेवस्वत---इन चार मन्वन्तरों का बिवरण वंवस्वत मनु के वर्णन के साथ करूँगा। पूर्व वणित उन पाँच मनुओं का वर्णन सुनिये, जो व्यतीत हो चुके हैं। उनमें से सर्वप्रथम स्वायम्भुव मनु का वर्णन कर रहा हूं जो दूसरे मनु हैं ।४-६। उस स्वारोचिष मन्वन्तर में तुषित तथा विद्वान् पारावत नामक देवगण थेये दो गण उक्त मन्वन्तर के स्मरण किये गये हैं। तुषित के गर्भ से समुत्पन्न स्वारोचिष ऋतु के पुत्र पारावत
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu will be born as a human being with a part of the intelligent god. In the previous birth he would have been born as the powerful Pramiti. In bodily splendour he was (will be) like the moon and will be born when the Kaliyuga is complete.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu will be born as a human being with a part of the intelligent god. In the previous birth he would have been born as the powerful Pramiti. In bodily splendour he was (will be) like the moon and will be born when the Kaliyuga is complete.…

verses.sanskrit: हतश्चञ्चुप्रहारेण शुकः श्येनेन भारत । मूर्च्छया तस्य तद्बीजं पतितं सागराम्भसि
verses.transliteration: hataścañcuprahāreṇa śukaḥ śyenena bhārata / mūrcchayā tasya tadbījaṃ patitaṃ sāgarāmbhasi
verses.translation: The lord takes incarnations in the different periods with a part of his powerful splendour in the three worlds for different purposes and ends in view. He is born in different wombs in accordance with the function he has to perform. When the twentyfifth Kalpa has started and twenty- five years have elapsed, he will be killing all living being and men.
verses.hindi: और शिष्ट हैं, जो बारह बारह के गण रूप में कहे गये हैं, छन्‍्दज देवगण स्वारोचिष मन्वन्तर में चौबीस स्मरण किये गये ।७ ८। धेवशस्यस, वामान्य, गोप, देवायत, देव भगवान्, अज, महाबलवान् दुरोण, महाबाहु आप महापराक्रमा महोजा, चिकित्वान् निभृत एवं अंश ये बारह तुषित नाम से पुकारे जाते हैं, इनमें अज बारह हैं। ये सभी ऋतु के पुत्र स्वारोचिष मन्वन्तर में सोमपान करते थे ।६-११। प्रचेता, विश्वदेव, समजञ्ज,
verses.wordMeaning: The lord takes incarnations in the different periods with a part of his powerful splendour in the three worlds for different purposes and ends in view. He is born in different wombs in accordance with the function he has to perform.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord takes incarnations in the different periods with a part of his powerful splendour in the three worlds for different purposes and ends in view. He is born in different wombs in accordance with the function he has to perform.…

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्येन गिलितं तच्च बीजं वसुमहीपतेः । कन्या मत्स्योदरे जाता तेन बीजेन सुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: matsyena gilitaṃ tacca bījaṃ vasumahīpateḥ / kanyā matsyodare jātā tena bījena sundari
verses.translation: By means of his ruthless activities he will make the Earth left with only the seeds. He would have (then) mas¬ sacred all Vrsalas and almost all impious persons. Then Kalki will have achieved his object along with
verses.hindi: +इदमर्ध नास्ति घ॒ पुस्तके ।  इदमर्ध नास्ति क. पुस्तके ।

verses.commentary: Sense: By means of his ruthless activities he will make the Earth left with only the seeds. He would have (then) mas¬ sacred all Vrsalas and almost all impious persons. Then Kalki will have achieved his object along with

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तो ऽसौ लुब्धकैर्मत्स्य आनीतः स्वगृहं ततः । यावद् विदारितो मत्स्यस् तावद् दृष्टा त्वम् उत्तमे
verses.transliteration: prāpto 'sau lubdhakairmatsya ānītaḥ svagṛhaṃ tataḥ / yāvad vidārito matsyas tāvad dṛṣṭā tvam uttame
verses.translation: They will be resorting to rivers and mountains. Leaves, roots and fruits will constitute their diet. They will be wearing leaves and barks of trees or hides. There will be a highly indiscriminate fusion of castes. In the last junction of the Kali age they will be short-lived and highly distressed. Their means of sustenance will be destroyed. They will be overwhel¬ med with many adversities. They will undergo sufferings. The people will be completely extinct along with the Kali age. When the Kali age lapses and the Krta Yuga starts again, all objects will regain their original forms.naturally and not other¬ wise. Thus I have recounted the activities of Devas and Asuras. In the context of the narration of Yadu race the great fame of Visnu has been recounted. I shall now recount the race of Turvasu, Puru and Druhvu. Vahni was the son of Turvasu. Gobhanu was the son of Vahni 3. The unconquered heroic Trisanu was Gobhanu's son.
verses.hindi: प्रचेताश्चेव यो देवो विश्वदेवास्तथेव च। समञ्जो विश्लुतों यश्व अजिह्मभ्रारिमदंनः होता यज्वा च इत्येते पराक्रानता: परावताः । इत्येता देवता ह्यासन्मनुस्वारोचिषेःन्तरे (१४ सोमपास्तु तदा हाय ताश्रतुविशतिदेवता: । तेषामिद्धस्तदह॑ ह्यासीहृधश्न लोकविश्वतः ३१५ अर्जो वसिष्ठपुत्नस्तु स्तम्भ: काश्यप एवं च। भागंवश्च तदा द्रोगो ऋषभोडज्िरसस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: They will be resorting to rivers and mountains. Leaves, roots and fruits will constitute their diet. They will be wearing leaves and barks of trees or hides. There will be a highly indiscriminate fusion of castes.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They will be resorting to rivers and mountains. Leaves, roots and fruits will constitute their diet. They will be wearing leaves and barks of trees or hides. There will be a highly indiscriminate fusion of castes.…

verses.sanskrit: शशिमण्डलसङ्काशा सूर्यतेजःसमप्रभा । दृष्ट्वा त्वां हर्षिताः सर्वे कैवर्ता जाह्नवीतटे
verses.transliteration: śaśimaṇḍalasaṅkāśā sūryatejaḥsamaprabhā / dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ harṣitāḥ sarve kaivartā jāhnavītaṭe
verses.translation: These verses (to the end of the chapter) describe a gloomy picture of the society at the end of Kali Yuga. All Puranas are unanimous in depicting the terrible state of the public as Kali advances. This chapter correspond to Bd. 3.74. Reference are to verse numbers.
verses.hindi: मनोः स्वारोचिषस्यते पुत्रा बंशकराः स्मृता: । पुराणे परिसंख्याता द्वितीयं चेतदन्तरभ् १६ सप्तषयों मनुर्देवा: पितरश्र चतुष्टयम् । मूल॑ मन्वन्तरस्येते तेषां चेवान्तरे प्रजा: २० ऋषोणां देवता: पुत्रा: पितरो देवसुनवः । ऋषयो देवपुतन्राश्च इति शाह्त्रविनिश्चय: २१
verses.wordMeaning: These verses (to the end of the chapter) describe a gloomy picture of the society at the end of Kali Yuga. All Puranas are unanimous in depicting the terrible state of the public as Kali advances. This chapter correspond to Bd. 3.74. Reference are to verse numbers.
verses.commentary: Sense: These verses (to the end of the chapter) describe a gloomy picture of the society at the end of Kali Yuga. All Puranas are unanimous in depicting the terrible state of the public as Kali advances. This chapter correspond to Bd. 3.74. Reference are to verse numbers.

verses.sanskrit: हर्षितास्ते गताः सर्वे प्रधानस्य च मन्दिरम् । स्त्रीरत्नं कथयामासुर्गृहाण त्वं महाप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: harṣitāste gatāḥ sarve pradhānasya ca mandiram / strīratnaṃ kathayāmāsurgṛhāṇa tvaṃ mahāprabham

verses.hindi: होता एवं यज्वा--ये परम पराक्रमी पारावतगण हैं । ये स्वरोचिष मन्वन्तर के देव समृह थे । ये उपर्यक्त चोबीस देवता उस समय सोमपान करने वाले थे । लोकप्रसिद्ध वैध इन देवताओं का इच्द्र (स्वामी) था ।!२-१५। पुत्र ऊजं, कश्यप के पुत्र स्तम्भ, भूृगु के पुत्र द्रोण, अंगिरा के पुत्र ऋषभ, पुलस्त्य के पुत्र दत्तात्रि, अत्रि के पुत्र निश्चल तथा पुलह के पुत्र धावान् - ये सात ऋषि कहे गये हैं ।१६-१७। चेत्र कविरुत, कृतास्त, विभृत, रवि, वहत् द्रह, वव और शुभ ये नव स्वारोचिष मनु के वंश वृद्धि करने वाले पुत्र पुराणों में परिगणित कह्दे जाते हैं यह द्वितीय मस्वन्तर का वृत्तान्त है। सातों ऋषि, मनु, देवगण और पितर--ये चार प्रत्येक मन्वन्तर के मूल माने गये हैं, इनके अतिरिक्त जो प्रजाएँ हैं, वे सब इन्हों के अवान्तरभूत हैं । देवगण ऋषियों के, पितरगण देवताओं के तथा ऋषिगण देवताओं के पुत्र केहे गये हैं--ऐसा शास्त्रों का निश्चय

verses.commentary: Sense: Genealogy orTurvasu as recorded in AITH, shows Garbha as the predecessor of Gobhanu. Thus, due to the curse of Yayati in connection with the

verses.sanskrit: गृहीता तेन तन्वङ्गी ह्यपुत्रेण मृगेक्षणा । भार्यां स्वामाह तन्वङ्गि पालयस्व मृगेक्षणे
verses.transliteration: gṛhītā tena tanvaṅgī hyaputreṇa mṛgekṣaṇā / bhāryāṃ svāmāha tanvaṅgi pālayasva mṛgekṣaṇe
verses.translation: The successor of Duskrta was the king named Sarutha. After Sarutha came Janapltfa and he had four sons. They were Pantfya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya with their kingdoms named after them, viz. Pandya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya.
verses.hindi: है ।१५-२१। भनु से क्षत्रिय और वबेश्यों की तथा सातों ऋषियों से द्विजातियों की उत्पत्ति कही मई है--यही
verses.wordMeaning: The successor of Duskrta was the king named Sarutha. After Sarutha came Janapltfa and he had four sons. They were Pantfya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya with their kingdoms named after them, viz. Pandya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The successor of Duskrta was the king named Sarutha. After Sarutha came Janapltfa and he had four sons. They were Pantfya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya with their kingdoms named after them, viz. Pandya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा चिन्तयामास पराशरवचस्तदा । एवमुक्त्वा तु सा तेन दत्तात्मानं नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā cintayāmāsa parāśaravacastadā / evamuktvā tu sā tena dattātmānaṃ nareśvara
verses.translation: Druhyu had two heroic sons well known as Babhru and Setu. Aruddha was the son of Setu and Ripu was the son of Babhru. This strong (king) Ripu was killed in war with very great difficulty by Yauvanasva. Their great war lasted conti¬ nuously for fourteen months.
verses.hindi: विस्तार हुआ है, उसी प्रकार स्वारोचिष मनु द्वारा भी सृष्टि विस्तार समझना चाहिए। प्रत्येक कुलों में + धनुध्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Druhyu had two heroic sons well known as Babhru and Setu. Aruddha was the son of Setu and Ripu was the son of Babhru. This strong (king) Ripu was killed in war with very great difficulty by Yauvanasva. Their great war lasted conti¬ nuously for fourteen months.
verses.commentary: Sense: Druhyu had two heroic sons well known as Babhru and Setu. Aruddha was the son of Setu and Ripu was the son of Babhru. This strong (king) Ripu was killed in war with very great difficulty by Yauvanasva. Their great war lasted conti¬ nuously for fourteen months.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच साधु मे ब्रह्मन्मत्स्यगन्धो ऽनु वर्तते । ततस्तेन तु सा बाला दिव्यगन्धाधिवासिता
verses.transliteration: uvāca sādhu me brahmanmatsyagandho 'nu vartate / tatastena tu sā bālā divyagandhādhivāsitā
verses.translation: Aruddha's successor was the king named Gandhara after whom the great lan d of Gandhara took its name. 2 The horses bred in Gandhara land are the most excel¬ lent horses. Gandhara's son was Dharma and Ghrta (Dhrta) was his son.
verses.hindi: तृतीयस्त्वथ पर्याय ऑत्तमस्यान्तरे मनोः । पतच देवगणा: प्रोक्तास्तान्वक्ष्यामि निबोधत ४
verses.wordMeaning: Aruddha's successor was the king named Gandhara after whom the great lan d of Gandhara took its name. 2 The horses bred in Gandhara land are the most excel¬ lent horses. Gandhara's son was Dharma and Ghrta (Dhrta) was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aruddha's successor was the king named Gandhara after whom the great lan d of Gandhara took its name. 2 The horses bred in Gandhara land are the most excel¬ lent horses. Gandhara's son was Dharma and Ghrta (Dhrta) was his son.

verses.sanskrit: कृता योगबलेनैव ज्वालयित्वा विभावसुम् । कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं वह्निमूढा तेन रसात्तदा
verses.transliteration: kṛtā yogabalenaiva jvālayitvā vibhāvasum / kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ vahnimūḍhā tena rasāttadā
verses.translation: Durdama was born to Ghrta (Dhrta) and his son was Pracetas. A hundred sons were born to Pracetas. All of them were kings. All of them were the rulers of the Mleccha territory in the northern direction (region). Anu had three noble-souled sons. All of them were highly righteous.
verses.hindi: सुधामानश्न देवाश्व ये चान्‍्ये वशर्वातनः । प्रत्दंनाः शिवा: सत्वा गणा द्वादश वे स्मृताः सहलस्नधारों विश्वात्मा शमितारो बृह॒द्वसु:। विश्वधा विश्वकर्मा च मनस्वन्तो विराड्यशाः
verses.wordMeaning: Durdama was born to Ghrta (Dhrta) and his son was Pracetas. A hundred sons were born to Pracetas. All of them were kings. All of them were the rulers of the Mleccha territory in the northern direction (region). Anu had three noble-souled sons. All of them were highly righteous.
verses.commentary: Sense: Durdama was born to Ghrta (Dhrta) and his son was Pracetas. A hundred sons were born to Pracetas. All of them were kings. All of them were the rulers of the Mleccha territory in the northern direction (region). Anu had three noble-souled sons. All of them were highly righteous.

verses.sanskrit: जलयानस्य मध्ये तु कामस्थानान्यसंस्पृशत् । ज्ञात्वा कामोत्सुकं विप्रं भीता सा धर्मनन्दन
verses.transliteration: jalayānasya madhye tu kāmasthānānyasaṃspṛśat / jñātvā kāmotsukaṃ vipraṃ bhītā sā dharmanandana
verses.translation: They were Sabhanara, Paksa and Parapaksa. The son of Sabhanara was the scholarly king Kalanala. Kalanala's son was the pious-souled Spijaya who was righteous. The heroic king Puranjaya was the son of Srnjaya. Janamejaya of great strength and vitality was the son of the saintly king Puranjaya.
verses.hindi: ज्योतिश्चेव विभाव्यश्च कीतिमान्वंशकारिण: । अन्यानाराधितो देवो बसुधिष्णो विवस्वसुः
verses.wordMeaning: They were Sabhanara, Paksa and Parapaksa. The son of Sabhanara was the scholarly king Kalanala. Kalanala's son was the pious-souled Spijaya who was righteous. The heroic king Puranjaya was the son of Srnjaya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Sabhanara, Paksa and Parapaksa. The son of Sabhanara was the scholarly king Kalanala. Kalanala's son was the pious-souled Spijaya who was righteous. The heroic king Puranjaya was the son of Srnjaya.…

verses.sanskrit: हसन्ती तमुवाचाथ देव त्वं लोकसन्निधौ । न लज्जसे कथं धीमन्कुर्वाणः पामरोचितम्
verses.transliteration: hasantī tamuvācātha deva tvaṃ lokasannidhau / na lajjase kathaṃ dhīmankurvāṇaḥ pāmarocitam
verses.translation: This king was equal to Indra. His fame was established (even) in heaven. Mahamanas was the son of MahaSala. He was very pious. He was the lord of the seven continents. He was an emperor of great fame. Mahamanas procreated two famous sons.
verses.hindi: दिनक्रतुः सुधर्मा च धूतवर्मा यशस्विनः । केतुमांश्चेब इत्येते कीतितास्तु प्रमदंनाः यत्तु वाहयतिश्चेव सुवित्तसुनयस्तथा । शिवा होते तु विज्ञेया यज्ञिया द्वादशापराः ३०
verses.wordMeaning: This king was equal to Indra. His fame was established (even) in heaven. Mahamanas was the son of MahaSala. He was very pious. He was the lord of the seven continents. He was an emperor of great fame. Mahamanas procreated two famous sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: This king was equal to Indra. His fame was established (even) in heaven. Mahamanas was the son of MahaSala. He was very pious. He was the lord of the seven continents. He was an emperor of great fame. Mahamanas procreated two famous sons.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेन क्षणं ध्यात्वा संस्मृता हृदि तामसी । आगता तामसी माया यया व्याप्तं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: tatastena kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā saṃsmṛtā hṛdi tāmasī / āgatā tāmasī māyā yayā vyāptaṃ carācaram
verses.translation: They were Usinara the knower of Dharma and Titiksu the righteous. Uslnara had five wives. They were born of the races of saintly kings. They were Mrga (Nrga in Bd. P.), Krmi, Nava, Darva and Drsadvatl the fifth. Usinara had five sons from them. They made his race flourish. They were virtuous and grew old with the performance of great penance. Mrga (Nrga in Bd. P.) was the son of Mrga (Nrga), Nava was the son of Nava. Krmi was the son of KrmI and Suvrata, the virtuous, was the son of Darva.
verses.hindi: स्वमृडीको5धिपश्चेव वर्चोधा मुहासबेश: । वासवश्च सदाश्वश्च क्षेमानन्दो तथेव च
verses.wordMeaning: They were Usinara the knower of Dharma and Titiksu the righteous. Uslnara had five wives. They were born of the races of saintly kings. They were Mrga (Nrga in Bd. P.), Krmi, Nava, Darva and Drsadvatl the fifth. Usinara had five sons from them. They made his race flourish.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Usinara the knower of Dharma and Titiksu the righteous. Uslnara had five wives. They were born of the races of saintly kings. They were Mrga (Nrga in Bd. P.), Krmi, Nava, Darva and Drsadvatl the fifth. Usinara had five sons from them. They made his race flourish.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा विस्मिता तेन कर्मणैव तु रञ्जिता । ब्रह्मचर्याभितप्तेन स्त्रीसौख्यं क्रीडितं तदा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā vismitā tena karmaṇaiva tu rañjitā / brahmacaryābhitaptena strīsaukhyaṃ krīḍitaṃ tadā
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the son of Drsadvatl was (popular¬ ly called) Auslnara Sivi. The city ofSiviwas famous as Siva- pura * 1 (II) (III) (IV) and that of Mrga was the Yaudheya city. Navarastram belonged to Nava and the city Krmila to Krmi. That of Suvrata was Vrsta (Ambastha). Now listen and understand Sivi's sons. The four sons of Sivi called Sivis were very popular among the people. They were Vrsadarbha, Suvlra, Kekaya and Madraka.
verses.hindi: सत्या होते परिक्रान्ता यज्ञिया द्वादशापराः । इत्येता देवता झासन्नोत्तमस्यान्तरे मनोः ३३३ प्रजाओं के उत्पन्न होने के कारण तथा एक ही प्रकार के नाम पड़ने के कारण विस्तारपृर्वक उसका वर्णन सैंकड़ों वर्षों में भी नहीं किया जा सकता । २२-२३॥ अब इसके उपरान्त तृतीय मनु औत्तम की कार्य विधि का वर्णन कर रहा हूँ । इस मन्वस्तर में पाँच देवगण कहे गये हैं, सुनिये । सुधामा, देंव, प्रददंन, शिव ओर सत्य थे पाँच देवगण कहे गये हैं, जिनमें प्रत्येक की संख्या बारह है। सत्य, धृति, दम, दास्त, क्षाम्र, धृति, शुचि,
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the son of Drsadvatl was (popular¬ ly called) Auslnara Sivi. The city ofSiviwas famous as Siva- pura * 1 (II) (III) (IV) and that of Mrga was the Yaudheya city. Navarastram belonged to Nava and the city Krmila to Krmi. That of Suvrata was Vrsta (Ambastha).…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the son of Drsadvatl was (popular¬ ly called) Auslnara Sivi. The city ofSiviwas famous as Siva- pura * 1 (II) (III) (IV) and that of Mrga was the Yaudheya city. Navarastram belonged to Nava and the city Krmila to Krmi. That of Suvrata was Vrsta (Ambastha).…

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा तत्क्षणादेव गर्भभारेण पीडिता । प्रसूता बालकं तत्र जटिलं दण्डधारिणम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā tatkṣaṇādeva garbhabhāreṇa pīḍitā / prasūtā bālakaṃ tatra jaṭilaṃ daṇḍadhāriṇam
verses.translation: Their territories were very flourishing. They were Vrsadarbhas, Sucldarbhas, Kekayas and Madrakas. Now listen to the progeny of Titiksu. These places are located as follows: The mighty-armed son of Titiksu named Us'adratha was the well-known king in the eastern quarter. His son was Hema.
verses.hindi: ईब, ऊज्ज, ज्येष्ठ, और वपुृष्मानू--ये बारह सुधामा नामक देवगण कहे गये हैं ।२४-२५। सहलधार, विश्वात्मा, शतधार (झमितार) बुह॒तू, वसु, विश्वकर्मा, मनस्वस्त, विराटू, यश्य, ज्यों ति, विभाक, ओर कीतिमान् ये वंश की वृद्धि करने वाले हैं। अन्य, अनाराधित, देव, वसु, धिष्णु विवस्वसु, दिन, क्रतु, सुधर्मा, धृतवर्मा, यशस्वी और केतुमान्ये प्रतदंन गण नाम से कहे गये हैं ।२६-२५। हंस, स्वर, अहिहा, श्रतदंन,

verses.sanskrit: कमण्डलुधरं शान्तं मेखलाकटिभूषितम् । उत्तरीयकृतस्कन्धं विष्णुमायाविवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: kamaṇḍaludharaṃ śāntaṃ mekhalākaṭibhūṣitam / uttarīyakṛtaskandhaṃ viṣṇumāyāvivarjitam
verses.translation: Sutapa was born to Hema and Bali was the son of Sutapas* (Bd. P.). The noble-minded Bali who was a great Yogin was bound (by Vamana). He took birth in the human womb, being desirous of children, as the family was ncarin extinction due to absence of issues. He begot sons who established the discriplines of four castes on this earth. He procreated the sons Ahga, Vanga, Sulha, Pundra and ICalinga. These are called Baleya Ksatras (the Ksatriyas born of Bali). That lord had Brahmana sons also called Baleya Brah- manas. They established the line (of Bali). Many boons were granted to the intelligent Bali by the delighted Brahma. The boons granted were Mahayogitva (the state of being a great Yogin), longevity of life lasting for a Kalpa, invincibility in war, great inclination towards righteousness and piety, the vision of the three worlds, importance among his descendants unrivalled state in strength as the ability to see the true prin¬ ciples of Dharma. "You will establish the (discipline of) four castes"—on being thus told by the lord, king Bali attained great peace (of mind). After a long period the scholarly Bali went back to his own abode. The territories of the sons were Angas, Vangas, Sulhakas (Suhma), Pundras and Kalirigas. They were very flourishing territories.
verses.hindi: यशस्कर, सुदान, वसुदान, सुमझ्ञस, विष, हव्यवाहू, सुवित्त और सुनय- इन्हें शिव के नाम से जानना चाहिए। यज्ञिय बारह दूसरे हैं। अब सत्य के अनुगामियों के नाम सूनिये, दिक्‍्पति, वाक्‍पति, विश्व, शम्भ, स्वमृडीक, अधिप, वर्चोधा, मुह, वासव, सदाशव, क्षेम और आनन्द--ये बारह सत्यगण के नाम से विख्यात हैं। थज्ञिय बारह दूसरे हैं। ये उपर्युक्त देवगण औत्तम मनु की कार्यावधि में कह्ढे गये हैं ।१६-३३। अज, परशु, अजश्च परशुश्चेव दिव्यों दिव्यौषधिनंयः । देवानुजश्याप्रतिमों महोत्साहोशिजस्तथा ३४ विनोतश्च सुकेजुश्व॒ सुभित्र: थुबल: शुचिः । औत्तमस्य सनोः पुत्रास्त्रयोदश सहात्मन: ॥

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽपि शङ्किता पार्थ दृष्ट्वा तं कलबालकम् । वेपमाना ततो बाला जगाम शरणं मुनेः
verses.transliteration: tato 'pi śaṅkitā pārtha dṛṣṭvā taṃ kalabālakam / vepamānā tato bālā jagāma śaraṇaṃ muneḥ
verses.translation: O holy lord, how were these five Ksetraja sons of Formerly there was an intelligent and renowned sage named Asija. The wife of this noble-souled sa-e was named Mamata. Not desirous of having sexual intercourse with him, Mamata spoke thus to Brhaspati: "I am pregnant due to my contact with your elder brother. This is the eighth (month). O Brhaspati, this great child in the womb cries much. The son of Asija that he is, he has learned the Vedas with their six ancillaries and he repeats the Vedic Mantras.

verses.sanskrit: रक्ष रक्ष मुनिश्रेष्ठ पराशर महामते । जातं मे ऽत्यद्भुतं पुत्रं कौपीनवरमेखलम् । दण्डहस्तं जटायुक्तम् उत्तरीयविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: rakṣa rakṣa muniśreṣṭha parāśara mahāmate / jātaṃ me 'tyadbhutaṃ putraṃ kaupīnavaramekhalam / daṇḍahastaṃ jaṭāyuktam uttarīyavibhūṣitam
verses.translation: Though emphatically told thus by her, the noble- soulcd Brhaspati of excessive refulgence did not restrain him- self, as he was overwhelmed by passion. The virtuous-souled Brhaspati did have his sexual intercourse with her. Even as he was discharging the semen virile; the child in the womb spoke thus:
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियाणि तदा देवा मनोस्तस्यान्तरे स्मृताः ३६ तेषां च प्रभुदेवानां शिविरिन्द्र: प्रतापवान् । सप्तर्यथोष्न्तरे चव ताबन्निबोधत सत्तमाः ४० काव्यो हर्षस्तथा चेब काश्यप: प्रथुरेव व । आत्रेयश्चाग्निरित्येब ज्योतिर्धामा! च भागवः ४१ पौलड्ो वनपीठश्च गोत्रवासिष्ठ एबं च। चेत्रस्तथा5वि पौलस्त्य ऋषयस्तामसेःन्तरे दिव्य, दिव्यौषधि, नय अनृपम वीर देवानुज, महोत्साह औशिज, विनीत, सुकेतु, सुमित्र, सुबल, और शुचि--ये तेरह महात्मा औत्तम मनु के पुत्र कहे गये हैं, जो क्षत्रियवंश की वृद्धि करने वाले थे--यह तृतीय

verses.sanskrit: पराशर उवाच: मा भैषीः स्वसुते जाते कुमारी त्वं भविष्यसि । नाम्ना योजनगन्धेति द्वितीयं सत्यवत्यपि
verses.transliteration: parāśara uvāca: mā bhaiṣīḥ svasute jāte kumārī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi / nāmnā yojanagandheti dvitīyaṃ satyavatyapi
verses.translation: "No Snatakn (a Brahmana who just had his sacred ablution after completing his Vedic study) shall deposit his (semen virile) here. There is no space here for two. You too are one with never-failing semen virile. I have come here first." Brhaspati, the sage of divine attributes, became in¬ furiated on being told thus. He cursed the son of Asija, his brother, who was yet in the womb: "You have spoken thus to me on an occasion coveted by all living beings. Since you have spoken thus out of delusion, you will enter a long period of darkness".
verses.hindi: प्रकार औत्तम मनु की सृष्टि का भी विस्तार हुआ कहा गया है। अब इसके उपरान्त तामस मनु की सृष्टि का विवरण विस्तारपुबेक क्रमश: सुनिये  चतुर्थ तामस नामक मन्वन्तर में सत्य, स्वरूप, सुधी और हरि, इन चार नामों वाले देवगण थे। इनमें से एक-एक गण में पच्चीस देवता थे ।३४-३८५। इस तामस मनु की कार्यावधि में पुलस्त्य पुत्र के पुत्रों का प्रादुर्भाव हुआ था। सत्यप्राण, परम श्रेष्ठ सुनिगण जिन एक सौ इन्द्रियों को

verses.sanskrit: शंतनुर् नाम राजा यः स ते भर्ता भविष्यति । प्रथमा महिषी तस्य सोमवंशविभूषणा
verses.transliteration: śaṃtanur nāma rājā yaḥ sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati / prathamā mahiṣī tasya somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇā
verses.translation: Due to that curse, the sage thereafter came to be called Dlrghatamas. Asija's brother, his uncle, had built a house for him. While he was staying there, a bull came there casually.
verses.hindi: तथा आठवें तम कौ स्वीकार करते हैं, उनमें से वे ही इन्द्रिय समूह उस मन्वन्तर के देवगण स्मरण किये गये हैं। और जो उनका प्रभु प्रतापशाली शिवि था वही उस मन्वन्तर का इन्द्र था। है सत्तम ! इसके अनन्तर उस मन्वन्तर के सप्त ऋषियों को मुनिये ।३६-४०। कवि के पुत्र हर्ष, कश्यप के पुत्र पृथ, अत्रि के पुत्र अग्नि, भगु के पुत्र ज्योतिर्धामा, पुलह के पुत्र वनपीठ, गोत्र वासिष्ठ और पुलस्त्य के पूत्र चेत्र--ये तामस मन्वन्तर के सात ऋषि हैं। है ऋषिगण ! जनघण्ट, शान्ति, नर, ख्याति, भय, प्रियभृत्य, अविक्ष, दृढ़ और उद्यमशील

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ त्वं स्वाश्रयं शुभ्रे पूर्वरूपेण संस्थिता । मा विषादं कुरुष्वात्र दृष्टं ज्ञानस्य मे बलम्
verses.transliteration: gaccha tvaṃ svāśrayaṃ śubhre pūrvarūpeṇa saṃsthitā / mā viṣādaṃ kuruṣvātra dṛṣṭaṃ jñānasya me balam
verses.translation: Surrounded by cows he grazed the Darbha grass that had been brought for the DarSa 1 rituals. DIrghatamas caught hold of the quivering bull by its horns. Caught by him, the bull could not move even a step. Then the bull spoke to him: "O foremost one among the strong persons, leave me off. o dear one, a strong one like you has not been met with by me anywhere, even though I had been bearing the three-eyed lord (everywhere), as a result of which I have come down to the earth.

verses.transliteration: ityuktvā prayayau vipraḥ sā bālā putramāśritā / natvoce mātaraṃ bhaktyā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ vinayānataḥ
verses.translation: O most excellent one among strong persons, leave me off. I am pleased with you. Choose a boon". On being told thus, the sage told the bull: "Where will you go alive, away from me? Hence I will not release you, the quadruped that eats others' wealth". Then that bull replied to DIrghatamas:
verses.hindi: पत्चमे त्वथ पर्याये मनोश्वारिष्णवेष्न्तरे । गणास्त सुसमाख्याता देवतानां त्रियोधत वैदिक: प्रविराशी च वादश्च प्राशश्येति चतुदंश। अम्तताभा: स्मृताः होते देवाश्चारिष्णवेडन्तरे - - ॥४७ -
