verses.sanskrit: क्षम्यतां मातरुक्तं मे प्रसादः क्रियताम् अपि । ईश्वराराधने यत्नं करिष्याम्यहमम्बिके
verses.transliteration: kṣamyatāṃ mātaruktaṃ me prasādaḥ kriyatām api / īśvarārādhane yatnaṃ kariṣyāmyahamambike
verses.translation: "O dear one, to us nothing is sinful. There is no theft. We do not distinguish between what should be eaten or what should not be eaten or what should be drunk or should not be drunk. We do not know what should be done or what should not be done, what should be approached or what should not be approached. O Brahmana, we are not sinners. This is remembered as the Dharmaofcows and bulls". 1 2 On hearing the name of cows mentioned, he became confused and released him. Thanks to his devotion to the cows as ordained by the Vedas, he propitiated the bull.

verses.translation: The sacrificial rite to be performed on the New Moon Day.. This practice of open and unconcealed sexual intercourse is men¬ tioned in the M.Bh. (MW 365A) and seems to have been followed by Dirghatamas. The Buddha mentions this Dharma in derision.

verses.sanskrit: योजनगन्धोवाच: मा त्यक्त्वा गच्छ वत्साद्य मातरं मामनागसम् । त्वद्वियोगेन मे पुत्र पञ्चत्वं भाव्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: yojanagandhovāca: mā tyaktvā gaccha vatsādya mātaraṃ māmanāgasam / tvadviyogena me putra pañcatvaṃ bhāvyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: Considering it to be his arrogance, Saradvan did not brook it Using force and following Godharma (the practice of cattle), he had approached his daughter-in-law (the wife of younger brother). On seeing this trespass, Saradvan reflected. The noble- souled (Saradvan) knew what was destined to happen. So he did not confer death on him (Dlrghatamas). With eyes turned red due to anger, he shouted to Dlrghatamas: You do not distinguish between whom to approach and whom not to. Following Godharma you have solicited your daughter-in-law.
verses.hindi: मास, प्रत्येतिष्ठ अमृतं, सुमति वाविराव, उद श्रवा, प्रविराशी, वाद और प्राश - ये देवगण चारिष्ण नामक मज्बन्तर में अमृता नाम से विख्यात थे। मति, सुंमति, ऋत, सत्य आवति, विवि, मद्र बिनेय, जेता जिष्णू, सह, द्युतिमान, और श्रव, ये नाम आभूतरज नामक गण के विख्यात हैं। वषभेत्ता, जय, भीम शुचि, दान्त, दद, दम नाथ विद्वान, अजेय कुश, गौर, और, श्र व, ये विकुण्ठ नामक देवगण हैं अब
verses.wordMeaning: Considering it to be his arrogance, Saradvan did not brook it Using force and following Godharma (the practice of cattle), he had approached his daughter-in-law (the wife of younger brother). On seeing this trespass, Saradvan reflected.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Considering it to be his arrogance, Saradvan did not brook it Using force and following Godharma (the practice of cattle), he had approached his daughter-in-law (the wife of younger brother). On seeing this trespass, Saradvan reflected.…

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति पुत्रसमः स्नेहो नास्ति भ्रातृसमं कुलम् । नास्ति सत्यपरो धर्मो नानृतात्पातकं परम्
verses.transliteration: nāsti putrasamaḥ sneho nāsti bhrātṛsamaṃ kulam / nāsti satyaparo dharmo nānṛtātpātakaṃ param
verses.translation: You are a man of despicable conduct. I am casting you o(T. Go away along with your evil action. In spite of being blind, old and dependent on others for maintenance you have committed a deplorable, sinful action. Therefore, you are for¬ saken. I am convinced that you are a person of evil conduct". Thereafter he thought of a ruthless action. After rebuking Dlrghatamas many times, he caught hold of him by his arms, put him in a sealed casket and hurled it into the waters of Gariga.
verses.hindi: सुमेधागण को सूनिये ४४-४०। मेधा, मेघातिथि. सत्यमेधा, प्ृषश्िममेधा, अल्पमैधा भूयोमेधा प्रभृति ऐश्वयं- सुमेधा नाम से पुकारे जाते हैं। उन पाँचवें मन्वन्तर में उन देवमणों- में परम पराक्रमी तथा पुरुषार्थी विभ
verses.wordMeaning: You are a man of despicable conduct. I am casting you o(T. Go away along with your evil action. In spite of being blind, old and dependent on others for maintenance you have committed a deplorable, sinful action. Therefore, you are for¬ saken.…

verses.sanskrit: बालभावे मया जात आधारः किल जायसे । न मे भर्ता न मे पुत्रः पश्य कर्मविडम्बनम्
verses.transliteration: bālabhāve mayā jāta ādhāraḥ kila jāyase / na me bhartā na me putraḥ paśya karmaviḍambanam
verses.translation: For seven days the sealed casket was wafted by the current. King Bali, the knower of the principles of Dharma, who was in the company of his wife, saw the sinking casket borne towards him by the current. Bali, the righteous-souled son of Virocana, saved him and took him to his harem where he propitiated him with different kinds of food and drinks, and looked after him. The delighted sage asked Bali to choose a boon accord¬ ing to his desire. The leading Danava chose the boon for (blessing him with) a son.
verses.hindi: महापुराणसंभाव्य: प्रत्यद्गयहरा शुंचि: । बेजबन्धुनिरामित्रः केतु भूछगो दढव्तः ॥। द रा चरिष्णवस्य पुत्रास्ते पत्चमं चेंतदन्‍्तरमू .

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच: मा विषादं कुरुष्वान्तः सत्यम् एतन्मयोरितम् । आपत्काले ऽस्मि ते देवि स्मर्तव्यः कार्यसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca: mā viṣādaṃ kuruṣvāntaḥ satyam etanmayoritam / āpatkāle 'smi te devi smartavyaḥ kāryasiddhaye
verses.translation: The righteous-souled sage ot good sell-control begot of that Sudra woman two sons of great prowess, Kakslva and Caksus. They studied the Vedas duly and be¬ came masters and expounders of Vedas, great enlightened Siddhasand excellent ones with direct vision of Dharma. On seeing them, Kakslva and Cak§us, the king, Bali, the son of Virocana, asked the sage, "Are these my sons?" The sage said, "O excellent Asura, no, that is not the case. They ai e mine. Due to your deception, these god-like children are born of Sudra womb. Considering me blind and old, Sudesna, your queen, sent the Sudra servant-maid unto me and disrespected me.
verses.hindi: षष्ठ खल्वंथ पययि देया ये चाक्षुषेल्त्तरे। आश्राः पसुता भाव्याश्च प्रथुकाश्च दिघौकस: ॥ सह्टानुभावः लेखाश्च पत्च देवगणाः स्मृता कर . गंणश्च तेषां देवानामेकको ह्मष्टकः सता: -- .
verses.wordMeaning: The righteous-souled sage ot good sell-control begot of that Sudra woman two sons of great prowess, Kakslva and Caksus. They studied the Vedas duly and be¬ came masters and expounders of Vedas, great enlightened Siddhasand excellent ones with direct vision of Dharma.…

verses.sanskrit: आपदस्तारयिष्यामि क्षम्यतां मे दुरुत्तरम् । इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ व्यासः कन्या सापि गता गृहम्
verses.transliteration: āpadastārayiṣyāmi kṣamyatāṃ me duruttaram / ityuktvā prayayau vyāsaḥ kanyā sāpi gatā gṛham
verses.translation: Bali, thereupon propitiated the excellent sage again. The lord rebuked his wife Sudesna. He bedecked her in ornaments and gave her unto the sage. The sage DIrghatamas spoke thus to the queen: "O splendid lady, if, without showing aversion, you lick from head to foot my naked body smeared well with curds mixed with salt, you will obtain those sons mentally desired by you". The queen, thereupon, carried out all his instructions. When she reached the anus, her aversion was so great that she avoided it. Thereupon that sage said to her: <c O auspicous lady, since you avoided the anus, the eldest son you will give birth to will be without anus".
verses.hindi: अन्तरोक्षो बसुहयो ह्यतिथिश्च प्रियन्नत:) श्रोता मन्‍्ता घुमन्ता च आय्या होते प्रकोतिताः..

verses.sanskrit: पराशरसुतस्तत्र विषष्णो वनमध्यतः । त्रेतायुगावसाने तु द्वापरादौ नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: parāśarasutastatra viṣaṣṇo vanamadhyataḥ / tretāyugāvasāne tu dvāparādau nareśvara
verses.translation: This Purana has mixed up two different Balis—Bali or Mahabali, the rival of Indra, who donated three feet of land to Vamana, was not childless. Bana, Usa*s father, was his son. This Bali is another East Indian King who being childless requested thus to Dirghatamas. Then the queen replied to the sage Dirghatamas, "O blessed one, it does not behove you to give me a son like that".
verses.hindi: दतिश्चत महासंत्व: प्रयुत्या: परिकीतिता: “ द भाव्याह्म ते स्वृता देवा; पृथुकांस्तुनिबोधत ..... . ......

verses.sanskrit: व्यासार्थं चिन्तयामासुर्देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः । आख्यातो नारदेनैव पुत्रः पराशरस्य सः
verses.transliteration: vyāsārthaṃ cintayāmāsurdevāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ / ākhyāto nāradenaiva putraḥ parāśarasya saḥ
verses.translation: The sage said: "O gentle lady, this is your own fault. It will not be otherwise. O queen of good rites, I shall bestow a son unto you. Even without anus, he will perform all bodily functions". Touching her belly, the sage Dirghatamas continued— "O lady of sweet smiles, since' you have licked up the curds from my body, your womb is filled like the ocean on the Full Moon Day. Five splendid sons comparable to the sons of Devas will be born to you. They will be refulgent, valiant and righteous and performer of sacrifices." Then Anga, the eldest son of Sudesna, was born. The other sons born to her thereafter were Vanga, Kalinga, Punclra and Brahma (Suhma in Bd. P. v. 87).
verses.hindi: ऊध्वबाहुं, पुलहपुत्र पजन्य, तथा अत्रिपुत्र सत्यनेत्र --ये सात ऋषि उस रबत नामक पाँचवें मन्वन्तर में थे । महापुराण सभाव्य-प्रत्यड़ परहा शुचि, बलबन्धु, निरामित्र, केतुभद्भ, दुृढव्रत--ये चरिष्णव के पूत्र थे--- पाँचव मच्वन्तर के वृत्तारंत का वर्णन कर चुका ।५१-५४४५। स्वारोचिष, औत्तम, तामस और रैवत-ये चार मनु प्रियत्रत के चंश में उत्पन्न हुए हैं। अब पर्याय क्रम से छठे चाक्षष नामक मन्वन्तर में जो देवगण हो

verses.transliteration: kaivartaputrikājāto jñānī jahnusutātaṭe / tato nāradavākyena āgatāḥ surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: For certain reasons, his (Bali's) progeny had been prevented by Brahma, saying, "Let there not be any off¬ spring of this nobie-soulcd (king) by his own wives"* That was why he begot children of human wombs. Then the delighted bull, the son of Kamadhenu, spoke these words to Dirghatamas: "Since you have done this after pondering over Godharma, I am pleased with you. I shall release you (from the curse).
verses.hindi: गये हैं. उनका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ  आश्र, प्रसृत, भाव्य प्रथुक और लेख ये पाँच महानुभाव देवगण उस मन्वन्तर के स्मरण किये गये हैं। देवताओं की यह सृष्टि माताओं के नाम से पुकारी जाती है। प्रजापति अत्रि के पुत्र आरण्य ऋषि'के' ये समस्त देवगण नाती माने गये हैं उन देवताओं के पाँचों गणों में एक-एक गण के अन्तगंत आठ देवता. स्मरण किये गये हैं ६-५८। अस्तरिक्ष, बसु, हय, अतिथि, प्रियत्रत, श्रोता, मन्ता क्‍ और सुमन्‍्ता--ये आद्य के नाम से विख्यात हैं। श्येनमद्र, पहय, महायशस्वी पथ्यनेत्न, सुमना, संवेता, रेवत, सुप्रचेता, ओर महाबलवान् द्युति--ये प्रयूति के पुत्रगण कहे गये हैं ।(५६-६०। विजय, सजय, मन, उद्यान, समति सूपरि, विसात, और अरथंपति+-ये भाव्य नामक देवगण के नाम से विख्यात हैं,” अब पृथुक्ों को सुनिये  अजिष्ट,

verses.sanskrit: रामः पितामहः शक्रो मुनिसङ्घैः समावृताः । आस्यादिकं पृथग्दत्त्वा साधु साध्वित्युदीरयन्
verses.transliteration: rāmaḥ pitāmahaḥ śakro munisaṅghaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ / āsyādikaṃ pṛthagdattvā sādhu sādhvityudīrayan
verses.translation: Hence, look, I shall remove your long period of dark¬ ness and gloom, as well as the curse of Brhaspati along with the other sins that may be lingering, sticking to your body. After sniffing at you, I shall remove your fear of death and old age." As soon as he was sniffed at, the darkness was destroyed and he began to see. He regained his eye-sight. He became a young man
verses.hindi: अजिष्ट: शाक्यनो देवों वानपृष्ठस्तथव ले। शांकरः सत्यधुष्णुश्च विष्णुश्य विजयस्तथा ॥

verses.transliteration: pitāmahena vai bālo garbhādhānādisaṃskṛtaḥ / dvīpāyano dvīpajanmā pārāśaryaḥ parāśarāt
verses.translation: Thereafter Kakslvan went to Giripraja (Girivraja_Bd. After a long period, he became purified through his penance. After shaking off his defects, the lord (sage) attained Brahmanahood along with his younger brother.
verses.hindi: अजितश्च महाभागः प्रथकास्ते दिशोकसः: लेखांस्तथा प्रवक्ष्याि ब्रृबतो से निबोधत । मनोजव:ः प्रघासस्त प्रचेतास्त महायशाः ॥६ ३ . बातो भ्रवक्षितिश्चेध अद्भुतश्चेब वीयंवान् । अबनो बृहस्पतिश्चेब लेखा: संपरिकीर्तिताः ६४
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter Kakslvan went to Giripraja (Girivraja_Bd. After a long period, he became purified through his penance. After shaking off his defects, the lord (sage) attained Brahmanahood along with his younger brother.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णांशात्कृष्णनामायं व्यासो वेदान्व्यसिष्यति । विरञ्चिनाभिषिक्तो ऽसौ मुनिसङ्घैः पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṃśātkṛṣṇanāmāyaṃ vyāso vedānvyasiṣyati / virañcinābhiṣikto 'sau munisaṅghaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: Then spoke his father: "O Lord, now I am (really) one blessed with a son. By having a famous and good son (like you), 1 have achieved my objective (and am happy and con¬ tented) in life." With his soul united in Yogic practice, he attained Brahman-hood and extinction of (worldly bondage). After obtaining Brahmana-hood Kakslvan procreated a thousand sons. Those dark-skinned Gautamas (descendants of Gautama) are remembered as the sons of Kakslvan. Thus the association of DIrghatamas and Bali, the son of Virocana, has been narrated. So also the progeny of both. After the corona¬ tion of his five sinless sons, the contented Bali resorted to Yogic practice. The lord of Yogic soul bides his time roaming (on the earth) while remaining invisible to all living beings.
verses.hindi: सुधामा काश्यपश्चेब बसिष्ठों जिरजस्तथा  अतिमानश्च पौलस्त्यः सहिष्णु: पोलहस्तथा ॥

verses.transliteration: vyāsastvaṃ sarvalokeṣu ityuktvā prayayuḥ surāḥ / tīrthayātrā samārabdhā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanena tu

verses.hindi: शाक्यन, वानपृष्ठ, शांकर, सत्यधष्ण विष्णु, विजय तथा महाभाग्यवान् अजित ये पथुक नामक देवगण हैं अब लेख नामक देवताओं का वर्णन कर रहा हूँ, सुनिये । मनोजव प्रधास महायहास्व्री प्रचेता, वात, थ्र॒वक्षिति, पराक्रमी अद्भुत, अवन और बृहस्पति --ये लेख नाम से पुकारे जाते हैं। उस छठे मन्वन्तर में उन देवगणों का स्वामी इन्द्र सहापराक्रमी मनोजब था। भगु गोत्रोत्यन्न उन्नत, अंगिरापुत्र हविध्मान, कश्यपपुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Some words missing herein the text are supplied here. The elephant of Sakra was bom as his elephant
verses.commentary: Sense: Some words missing herein the text are supplied here. The elephant of Sakra was bom as his elephant

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गावगाहिता तेन केदारश्च सपुष्करः । गया च नैमिषं तीर्थं कुरुक्षेत्रं सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāvagāhitā tena kedāraśca sapuṣkaraḥ / gayā ca naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ kurukṣetraṃ sarasvatī
verses.translation: Haryanga's successor was the king Bhadraratha. Bhadraratha's son was Brhatkarma, the lord of subjects. Bjhadratha was his son and Brhanmana was born of him. Brhanmana procreated the son Rajendra. He was otherwise known as Jayadratha and from him was born king Drdharatha. The son of Drdharatha was Janamejaya, the conqueror of the universe.
verses.hindi: मधु ये चाक्षुष मन्वन्तर के सात ऋषि हैं ।६३-६६। उरु, पुरुशतद्यम्त, तपस्वी सत्यवाक्, कृति, अग्निष्णत्, अतिरात्र और सूद्युम्न ये नव तथा दसवें अभिमन्यु --ये चाक्षपष मनु के दस पुत्र हैं जो नाइलेय नाम से भी विख्यात हैं, छठवें मन्वन्तर का यही विवरण है। इस महात्मा चाक्ष॑ंषमनु का सृष्टि क्रम वेवस्वत मनु को भाँति कहा जाता है। दिजगण  उसका विस्तृत बत्तान्त मैं क्रशः आप लोगों को सूना चुक्रा
verses.wordMeaning: Haryanga's successor was the king Bhadraratha. Bhadraratha's son was Brhatkarma, the lord of subjects. Bjhadratha was his son and Brhanmana was born of him. Brhanmana procreated the son Rajendra. He was otherwise known as Jayadratha and from him was born king Drdharatha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Haryanga's successor was the king Bhadraratha. Bhadraratha's son was Brhatkarma, the lord of subjects. Bjhadratha was his son and Brhanmana was born of him. Brhanmana procreated the son Rajendra. He was otherwise known as Jayadratha and from him was born king Drdharatha.…

verses.sanskrit: उज्जयिन्यां महाकालं सोमनाथं प्रभासके । पृथिव्यां सागरान्तायां स्नात्वा यातो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: ujjayinyāṃ mahākālaṃ somanāthaṃ prabhāsake / pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ snātvā yāto mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: His successor, the king of Ahgas, was Kama. Kama's son was Surasena and Dvija is remembered'as his son. How was Karna known as the son of a charioteer and how did he become a member of the family of kings of Ahgas? This we wish to hear. Indeed you are very efficient (in narra¬ tion).
verses.hindi: ऋषियों दे कहा--सूतजी ! चाक्षष मनु के उत्तराधिकारी कद्यप के गोत्र में उत्पन्न हुए/उसके गोत्र में जो अन्य लोग उत्पन्न हुए, उन्हें यथार्थतः बतलाइये खूत थे कहा- ऋषिव॒न्द ! चाक्षुष मनु का वंश वर्णन मैं कर रहा हूँ, सुनिये। उसके बंश में बेन का पुत्र प्रतापी पृथ्ु नामक एक सम्राट उत्पन्न हुआ  इसके अतिरिक्त अन्यान्य प्रजापति गण प्रादुभत हुए।
verses.wordMeaning: His successor, the king of Ahgas, was Kama. Kama's son was Surasena and Dvija is remembered'as his son. How was Karna known as the son of a charioteer and how did he become a member of the family of kings of Ahgas? This we wish to hear.…
verses.commentary: Sense: His successor, the king of Ahgas, was Kama. Kama's son was Surasena and Dvija is remembered'as his son. How was Karna known as the son of a charioteer and how did he become a member of the family of kings of Ahgas? This we wish to hear.…

verses.sanskrit: अमृतां नर्मदां प्राप्तो रुद्रदेहोद्भवां शुभाम् । साह्लादो नर्मदां दृष्ट्वा चित्तविश्रान्तिमाप च
verses.transliteration: amṛtāṃ narmadāṃ prāpto rudradehodbhavāṃ śubhām / sāhlādo narmadāṃ dṛṣṭvā cittaviśrāntimāpa ca
verses.translation: They were Yasodevi and Satya. The race is bifurca¬ ted on account of these two wives. Jayadratha otherwise known as Rajendra was born of Yasodevi. That noble-minded heroic son of Das'aratha, Caturanga, the pro¬ motor of his family, was born through the grace of Rsyasrriga. It is reported that Prthulasva was Caturanga's son. The son of Prthulas'va was (?) of Campa. The (capital) city of Campa was beautiful. It became the beautiful Malini (real name of Campa).
verses.hindi: दक्षकस्य तु पुत्रोउस्य राजा ह्यासीत्पजापतेः । स्वायं भुवेन सनुना दत्तोञचत्रे: कारण प्रति ॥
verses.wordMeaning: They were Yasodevi and Satya. The race is bifurca¬ ted on account of these two wives. Jayadratha otherwise known as Rajendra was born of Yasodevi. That noble-minded heroic son of Das'aratha, Caturanga, the pro¬ motor of his family, was born through the grace of Rsyasrriga.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Yasodevi and Satya. The race is bifurca¬ ted on account of these two wives. Jayadratha otherwise known as Rajendra was born of Yasodevi. That noble-minded heroic son of Das'aratha, Caturanga, the pro¬ motor of his family, was born through the grace of Rsyasrriga.…

verses.sanskrit: तपश्चचार विपुलं नर्मदातटमाश्रितः । ग्रीष्मे पञ्चाग्निमध्यस्थो वर्षासु स्थण्डिलेशयः
verses.transliteration: tapaścacāra vipulaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ / grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyastho varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ
verses.translation: The city of Campavati (alias) Campa was inhabited by people of four Varnas (castes). They lived in Campavati for sixty thousand years. By Brahmanas, Ksattriyas, Vais'yas, by all, their own duty (Dharma) was followed. All were devoted to Visnu by performing penance and following the duties of their (respective) caste. (Defective verse) Satya gave birth to the famous Vijaya who was of mixed Brahmana-Ksatriya caste (?) Vijaya's son was Dlijli and his son was Dhrtavrata.
verses.hindi: उत्तानपादाच्चतुरा सूनृता वित्तभाविनी । धर्मस्य कन्या धर्मज्ना सूनृता नाम विश्वुता उत्पन्ना चाधिधर्मेण भ्रुवस्थ जननी शुभा। धर्मस्य पत्न्यां लक्ष्यां वे उत्पन्ना सा शुचिस्मिता
verses.wordMeaning: The city of Campavati (alias) Campa was inhabited by people of four Varnas (castes). They lived in Campavati for sixty thousand years. By Brahmanas, Ksattriyas, Vais'yas, by all, their own duty (Dharma) was followed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of Campavati (alias) Campa was inhabited by people of four Varnas (castes). They lived in Campavati for sixty thousand years. By Brahmanas, Ksattriyas, Vais'yas, by all, their own duty (Dharma) was followed.…

verses.sanskrit: सार्द्रवासाश्च हेमन्ते तिष्ठन्दध्यौ महेश्वरम् । स्वान्तर्हृत्कमले स्थाप्य ध्यायते परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sārdravāsāśca hemante tiṣṭhandadhyau maheśvaram / svāntarhṛtkamale sthāpya dhyāyate parameśvaram
verses.translation: Dhrtavrata's son was Satyakarma of great fame. Satyakarma's son was Adhiratha, the charioteer. He adopted and looked after Karna. Hence Karna was known as the son of a charioteer. Thus everything that had been asked about Karna has been mentioned to you. Thus all the kings in the family of Ariga have been recounted by me. Now listen to the progeny of Puru in detail and in the proper order.
verses.hindi: थ्रुवं च कीतिमन्तं च अयस्मन्तं वबसूं तथा। उत्तानपादो5जनयत्कन्ये है च शुचिस्मिते ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Dhrtavrata's son was Satyakarma of great fame. Satyakarma's son was Adhiratha, the charioteer. He adopted and looked after Karna. Hence Karna was known as the son of a charioteer. Thus everything that had been asked about Karna has been mentioned to you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhrtavrata's son was Satyakarma of great fame. Satyakarma's son was Adhiratha, the charioteer. He adopted and looked after Karna. Hence Karna was known as the son of a charioteer. Thus everything that had been asked about Karna has been mentioned to you.…

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टिसंहारकर्तारम् अछेद्यं वरदं शुभम् । नित्यं सिद्धेश्वरं लिङ्गं पूजयेद्ध्यानतत्परः
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartāram achedyaṃ varadaṃ śubham / nityaṃ siddheśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayeddhyānatatparaḥ
verses.translation: The mighty-armed son of Puru, Janamejaya became a king. His son was Aviddha who conquered the eastern region. From Aviddha was born as son the great hero Manasyu. King Jayada was the son of Manasyu.
verses.hindi: मनस्विनी स्वरां चेब तयोः पुत्राः प्रकोतिता: तस्मै ब्रह्म ददौ प्रीतो ज्योतिषां स्थानमुत्तमम् । आभुतसंप्लवं हृद्यमस्तोदयविवर्जितस् ८० तस्यातिमात्रार्तिद्ध च महिमानं निरीक्षय ह। देत्यासुराणामाचार्य: श्लोकमप्युशना जगो १८ १
verses.wordMeaning: The mighty-armed son of Puru, Janamejaya became a king. His son was Aviddha who conquered the eastern region. From Aviddha was born as son the great hero Manasyu. King Jayada was the son of Manasyu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mighty-armed son of Puru, Janamejaya became a king. His son was Aviddha who conquered the eastern region. From Aviddha was born as son the great hero Manasyu. King Jayada was the son of Manasyu.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चनात्सिद्धलिङ्गस्य ध्यानयोगप्रभावतः । प्रत्यक्षः शङ्करो जातः कृष्णद्वैपायनस्य सः
verses.transliteration: arcanātsiddhaliṅgasya dhyānayogaprabhāvataḥ / pratyakṣaḥ śaṅkaro jātaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya saḥ
verses.translation: His successor was the king named Dhundhu. Bahu- gavl was the son of Dhundhu. Sanjati was his son. Sanjati's son was Raudrasva. Understand his sons. Raudrasva begot ten sons of the celestial damsel GhrtacT. They were Rajeyu, Krteyu, Vakseyu, Sthandileyu, Ghrtcyu, Jaleyu, Sthaleyu the seventh, Dharmeyu, Sannatcyu and the tenth son Vaneyu. He had ten daughters also, viz. Rudra, Sudra, Madra, Subha, Jamalaja, Tala, Khala (these seven and then), the daughter who is remembered as Gopajala, then, Tamrarasa and Ratnakutl. The husband of all of them was Prabhakara by name. He belonged to the Atreya line (Gotra).
verses.hindi: जिनमें प्रावेतस दक्ष नामक प्रजापति थे । प्रजापति अत्रि ने उत्तानपाद नामक पूत्र को ग्रहण किया । इस दक्ष प्रजापति का पृत्र राजा था। स्वायम्भूव मनु ने उसे अन्रि के लिए दिया था। है द्विजगण ! चाक्षुष नामक भविष्यत्कालीन मन्वन्तर का, जो कि छठाँ मन्वन्तर माना गया है, मैं व्रिस्तार पूर्वक पुन. वर्णत कर रहा हैँ ।७१-७४। घ॒र्मं की विख्यात धर्मज्ञा सुनुता नामक जो कन्या थी, उस परम चतुर, वित्तभाविनी सूनृता के
verses.wordMeaning: His successor was the king named Dhundhu. Bahu- gavl was the son of Dhundhu. Sanjati was his son. Sanjati's son was Raudrasva. Understand his sons. Raudrasva begot ten sons of the celestial damsel GhrtacT. They were Rajeyu, Krteyu, Vakseyu, Sthandileyu, Ghrtcyu, Jaleyu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: His successor was the king named Dhundhu. Bahu- gavl was the son of Dhundhu. Sanjati was his son. Sanjati's son was Raudrasva. Understand his sons. Raudrasva begot ten sons of the celestial damsel GhrtacT. They were Rajeyu, Krteyu, Vakseyu, Sthandileyu, Ghrtcyu, Jaleyu,…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: तोषितो ऽहं त्वया वत्स वरं वरय शोभनम्
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: toṣito 'haṃ tvayā vatsa varaṃ varaya śobhanam
verses.translation: Riveyu's wife named Jvalana was the daughter of Taksaka. That saintly king begot of that gentle lady a son named Ranti. Ranti, the king, begot splendid sons of his wife Sarasvati. They were Trasu, Praliratha and Dhruva, who was exceedingly righteous. His daughter Gaurl is famous as the splendid mother of Mandhata. Dhurya was Pratiratha's son and his son was Kantha.
verses.hindi: संयोग से राजा उत्तानपाद को श्रूव नामक पृत्र उत्पन्न हुआ  वह सूनृता परम घामिक तथा श्रूव की कल्याणी माता थी, वह सुन्दर हँसने वाली धर्म की लक्ष्मी नामक पत्नी में उत्पन्न हुई थी। राजा उत्तानपाद ने ध्रव, कीतिमानू, अयस्मान् तथा वसु नामक पूत्रों को तथा दो परम सुन्दरी मनस्विती और स्वरा नामक कत्याओं को उत्पन्न किया- जिनके पत्रों का वर्णन पहिले किया जा चुका है ।७५-७७। परम पराक्मी प्र.व ने देवताओं के दस सहस्न वर्षों तक विपुल यश की कामना से निराहार रहकर घोर तप किया। स्वायम्भुव मनु के पौत्र ध्रूव प्रथम त्रेता युग में योगबल से आत्मा को स्ववक्ष रख महान् यश की लिप्सा से परम कठोर तप में जब निरत थे, तब प्रसन्न हो ब्रह्म ने उन्हें ज्योतिगंणों का परम श्रेष्ठ स्थान प्रदान किया, जो महाप्रलय पर्यन्त स्थायी, हृदय को हरने वाला तथा अस्त एवं उदय से विवजित है। ध्रूव की इस परम
verses.wordMeaning: Riveyu's wife named Jvalana was the daughter of Taksaka. That saintly king begot of that gentle lady a son named Ranti. Ranti, the king, begot splendid sons of his wife Sarasvati. They were Trasu, Praliratha and Dhruva, who was exceedingly righteous.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Riveyu's wife named Jvalana was the daughter of Taksaka. That saintly king begot of that gentle lady a son named Ranti. Ranti, the king, begot splendid sons of his wife Sarasvati. They were Trasu, Praliratha and Dhruva, who was exceedingly righteous.…

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम । प्रत्यक्षो नर्मदातीरे स्वयमेव भविष्यसि । अतीतानागतज्ञो ऽहं त्वत्प्रसादादुमापते
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama / pratyakṣo narmadātīre svayameva bhaviṣyasi / atītānāgatajño 'haṃ tvatprasādādumāpate
verses.translation: (Defective verse) His son was Mcdhatithi from whom the Brahinanas Kanthayanas originated. Itina (?) was the daughter of Anuyama (?). She gave birth to sons. Trasu obtained his favourite son Malina who was an expounder of Brahman. Thereafter he obtained Upadata and the (following) four sons of Itina (?): Susmanta, Du?yanta, Pravlra and Anagha. The son born to Dusyanta was an excellent king and he became an emperor. That son Bharata was born of Sakuntala. It is from him that (the land) took its name Bharata. A disembodied (celestial) voice spoke to king Dusyanta.
verses.hindi: उन्नति, सम्पत्ति एवं महिमा को देख समस्त असुरु तथा दानवों के आचाये शुक्र ने उतका यशोगान किया ।3८-५१। अहो ध्व की परम कठोर तपस्या और पराक्रम धन्य है, इसके शास्त्रज्ञान, एवं इसके
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) His son was Mcdhatithi from whom the Brahinanas Kanthayanas originated. Itina (?) was the daughter of Anuyama (?). She gave birth to sons. Trasu obtained his favourite son Malina who was an expounder of Brahman.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) His son was Mcdhatithi from whom the Brahinanas Kanthayanas originated. Itina (?) was the daughter of Anuyama (?). She gave birth to sons. Trasu obtained his favourite son Malina who was an expounder of Brahman.…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: एवं भवतु ते पुत्र मत्प्रसादादसंशयम् । त्वयि भक्तिगृहीतो ऽहं प्रत्यक्षो नर्मदातटे
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: evaṃ bhavatu te putra matprasādādasaṃśayam / tvayi bhaktigṛhīto 'haṃ pratyakṣo narmadātaṭe
verses.translation: <c O Dusyanta, the mother is but a leathern pouch (or bellows). The son belongs to the father. He is identical with him by whom he is begotten. Sakuntala tells the truth. Maintain your son. O lord of men, he who discharges the semen virile redeems the son from the abode of Yama. You are the progenitor of this child in the womb. Do not dishonour Sakuntala'h Bharata begot of his three wives nine sons. "These arc not befitting me". Saying this, the king did not approve of them. (Pie disowned them).
verses.hindi: कइदमध नास्ति क. पुस्तके । है  -वीयुपुराणस्, -
verses.wordMeaning: <c O Dusyanta, the mother is but a leathern pouch (or bellows). The son belongs to the father. He is identical with him by whom he is begotten. Sakuntala tells the truth. Maintain your son. O lord of men,…
verses.commentary: Sense: <c O Dusyanta, the mother is but a leathern pouch (or bellows). The son belongs to the father. He is identical with him by whom he is begotten. Sakuntala tells the truth. Maintain your son. O lord of men,…

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रांशार्धभावेन प्रत्यक्षो ऽहं त्वदाश्रमे । इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ देवः कैलासं नगमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṃśārdhabhāvena pratyakṣo 'haṃ tvadāśrame / ityuktvā prayayau devaḥ kailāsaṃ nagamuttamam
verses.translation: Then those infuriated mothers slew their sons. Thus the births of those sons to the king were futile. Then the powerful son Bharadvaja, the son of Bfha- spati, was brought over there by the Maruts in the course of the sacrifices and handed over to him. In this connection, they cite this story of the intelli¬ gent Bharadvaja, his birth and the transfer unto Bharata by the Maruts.

verses.translation: On seeing the son instantaneously born Mamata said, "O Brhaspati, I am going to my house. Bhara (Nurture), Dvaja (that which is born of two)." When she went away after saying this, he (too) for¬ sook the son instantaneously." "Bharasva (Nurture). Dadham (very well)". Since this was said, he came to be known as 'Bharadvaja'. On seeing the infant abandoned by both the mother and the father, the Maruts took away the child Bharadvaja out of mercy.

verses.translation: The successors of Gagra were born of Sinibaddha. Therefore the Gagryas (descendants of Gagra) are remembered as Brahmanas with the traits of Ksatriyas. Kapi's descendants were excellent Ksatriyas and those of the other two arc said to be great sages.

verses.sanskrit: न्यमन्त्रयत तान्सर्वान्प्रत्येकं प्रणिपत्य च । ततस्ते प्रणतं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णद्वैपायनं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: nyamantrayata tānsarvānpratyekaṃ praṇipatya ca / tataste praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ munim
verses.translation: Ajamidha's sons were splendid. They perpetua¬ ted the auspicious line. They were very pious. They were The following additional verse numbered 167 in A, is translated as follows: Medhatithi was his son and from him were born the Brahmanas called Kanthayanas. King Brhadvasu was born to Ajamidha and (his second wife) Dhumini.
verses.hindi: इति ख. गम घ. छः. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Ajamidha's sons were splendid. They perpetua¬ ted the auspicious line. They were very pious. They were The following additional verse numbered 167 in A, is translated as follows: Medhatithi was his son and from him were born the Brahmanas called Kanthayanas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajamidha's sons were splendid. They perpetua¬ ted the auspicious line. They were very pious. They were The following additional verse numbered 167 in A, is translated as follows: Medhatithi was his son and from him were born the Brahmanas called Kanthayanas.…

verses.sanskrit: वर्धयित्वा जयाशीर्भिरवलोक्य परस्परम् । पराशरः समस्तैश्च वीक्षितो मुनिपुंगवैः
verses.transliteration: vardhayitvā jayāśīrbhiravalokya parasparam / parāśaraḥ samastaiśca vīkṣito munipuṃgavaiḥ
verses.translation: Brhadvasu's son was Brhadvisnu who was very strong. His son was Brhatkarma whose son was Brhadratha. His son was Visvajit, whose son was Senajit. The four sons of Senajit were well known in the world.
verses.hindi: विस्तरेण प्रथोजन्म कीतंयस्व महामते । यथा महात्मना दुग्धा पूर्व तेन वसुंधरा यथा देवेश्च नागश्व यथा ब्रह्मषिभि: सह । यथा यक्षे: सगन्धर्वेरप्सरोभियेथा पुरा ७
verses.wordMeaning: Brhadvasu's son was Brhadvisnu who was very strong. His son was Brhatkarma whose son was Brhadratha. His son was Visvajit, whose son was Senajit. The four sons of Senajit were well known in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhadvasu's son was Brhadvisnu who was very strong. His son was Brhatkarma whose son was Brhadratha. His son was Visvajit, whose son was Senajit. The four sons of Senajit were well known in the world.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरं दीयतां तात कृष्णद्वैपायनस्य च । एवमुक्तस्तु तैः सर्वैर्भगवान्स पराशरः । प्रोवाच स्वात्मजं व्यासमृषीणां यच्चिकीर्षितम्
verses.transliteration: uttaraṃ dīyatāṃ tāta kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya ca / evamuktastu taiḥ sarvairbhagavānsa parāśaraḥ / provāca svātmajaṃ vyāsamṛṣīṇāṃ yaccikīrṣitam
verses.translation: They were Rucirasva, Kavya, Rama of steady bow and Vatsa, the king of Avant! from whom the Parivatscira (era started). Paicirasva's successor was Prtlmscna of great fame. Para was the son of Pythusena and Nipa was born of Para. We have heard that a hundred sons were horn to Nipa. They are called 'Nlpas'. All of them were kings.
verses.hindi: यस्मिश्च कारणे पाणिवेंनस्य मथितः पुरा । क्ुद्धमंहषिशिः पूर्व तत्सवें कथयस्व नः १०४
verses.wordMeaning: They were Rucirasva, Kavya, Rama of steady bow and Vatsa, the king of Avant! from whom the Parivatscira (era started). Paicirasva's successor was Prtlmscna of great fame. Para was the son of Pythusena and Nipa was born of Para.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Rucirasva, Kavya, Rama of steady bow and Vatsa, the king of Avant! from whom the Parivatscira (era started). Paicirasva's successor was Prtlmscna of great fame. Para was the son of Pythusena and Nipa was born of Para.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीपराशर उवाच: नेच्छन्ति दक्षिणे कूले व्रतभङ्गभयादथ । भोजनं भोक्तुकामास्ते श्राद्धे चैव विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: śrīparāśara uvāca: necchanti dakṣiṇe kūle vratabhaṅgabhayādatha / bhojanaṃ bhoktukāmāste śrāddhe caiva viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The most glorious king among them who raised the fame of the race and stabilised the race was Samara with his capital in Kathpilya. He was fond of war. Samara had three sons endowed with all good qualities. They were Para, Para and Sattvadasva. Para's son Vrsu shone well.
verses.hindi: वर्णयिष्यामि वो विप्राः प्रथोवेंनस्थ संभवम् । एकाग्राः प्रयताश्चेव शुश्रृषध्व॑ द्विजोत्तमाः.. नाशुचेर्नापि पापाय नाशिष्यायाहिताय च। वर्णयेयमिम पुण्यं नान्नताय कथंचन
verses.wordMeaning: The most glorious king among them who raised the fame of the race and stabilised the race was Samara with his capital in Kathpilya. He was fond of war. Samara had three sons endowed with all good qualities. They were Para, Para and Sattvadasva. Para's son Vrsu shone well.
verses.commentary: Sense: The most glorious king among them who raised the fame of the race and stabilised the race was Samara with his capital in Kathpilya. He was fond of war. Samara had three sons endowed with all good qualities. They were Para, Para and Sattvadasva. Para's son Vrsu shone well.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच: करोमि भवतामुक्तमत्रैव स्थीयतां क्षणम् । यावत्प्रसाद्य सरितं करोमि विधिमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca: karomi bhavatāmuktamatraiva sthīyatāṃ kṣaṇam / yāvatprasādya saritaṃ karomi vidhimuttamam
verses.translation: A son named Sukrii endowed with all good qualities was born to Vrsu, thanks to his meritorious activities. Vibhraja was his son. Vibhraja's successor was the king named Anuha who was very famous. He was the husband ofRcI and so the son-in- law of $uka. Anuha s successor was Brahmadatta of great penance. "Vogasunu was his son and his son Visvaksena became a king.
verses.hindi: ऋ षियों ने कहा--महामते सूतजी  आप प्ृथु के जन्म व॒त्तान्त का वर्णन विस्तार पूर्वक कीजिये और वह समस्त वृत्तान्त बतलाइये जिस तरह उस महात्मा ने प्राचीन काल में वसुन्धरा का दोहन किया ।
verses.wordMeaning: A son named Sukrii endowed with all good qualities was born to Vrsu, thanks to his meritorious activities. Vibhraja was his son. Vibhraja's successor was the king named Anuha who was very famous. He was the husband ofRcI and so the son-in- law of $uka.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A son named Sukrii endowed with all good qualities was born to Vrsu, thanks to his meritorious activities. Vibhraja was his son. Vibhraja's successor was the king named Anuha who was very famous. He was the husband ofRcI and so the son-in- law of $uka.…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा नर्मदातटमास्थितः । स्तोत्रं जगाद सहसा तन्निबोध नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā śucirbhūtvā narmadātaṭamāsthitaḥ / stotraṃ jagāda sahasā tannibodha nareśvara
verses.translation: Vibhraja's sons became kings, thanks to their merito¬ rious activities. Visvaksena's son was Udaksena. Whose son was Ugrayudha? In which family was he born and glorified? What for were all the Nipas destroyed by him?
verses.hindi: किया गया, उनके जो जो विशेष पात्र रहे, उन-उन समूहों में जो प्रमुख दोग्धा (दुहने वाला) रहा, जिस प्रकार का क्षीर हुआ, जो-जो वत्स (बछड़े) बने सब का वर्णन हमें बतलाइये, जानने की इच्छा है । जिस कारण से प्राचीन काल में राजा वेन का हाथ मथा गया, तथा क्रुद्ध महर्षियों ने जिस कारण बच्य उसे मृत्यु का शाप दिया है-- वह सब हम लोगों को बतलाइये सूतजी वोले--विंप्रवुन्द ! वेनपुत्र राजा पृथ के जन्म वृत्तान्त का वर्णन मैं कर रह हूँ, द्विजोत्तमगण ! आप लोग एकाग्र और शास्तंचित्त हो सुनिये । यह पविन्न जीवन चरित कभी किसी अपविन्रात्मा, अशिष्य, अहितकारी, एवं ब्रतादि से उन्मुख रहनेवाले व्यक्ति को नहीं बतलाऊंगा। कषियों द्वारा वणित यह पवित्र वत्तान्त स्वर्ग प्रदान करनेबाला, यशोवर्दक, आयुप्रद, वेदसम्मत, एवं परमगोपनीय है, जो अनसूयक (कभी
verses.wordMeaning: Vibhraja's sons became kings, thanks to their merito¬ rious activities. Visvaksena's son was Udaksena. Whose son was Ugrayudha? In which family was he born and glorified? What for were all the Nipas destroyed by him?
verses.commentary: Sense: Vibhraja's sons became kings, thanks to their merito¬ rious activities. Visvaksena's son was Udaksena. Whose son was Ugrayudha? In which family was he born and glorified? What for were all the Nipas destroyed by him?

verses.sanskrit: जय भगवति देवि नमो वरदे जय पापविनाशिनी बहुफलदे । जय शुम्भनिशुम्भकपालधरे प्रणमामि तु देवनरार्तिहरे
verses.transliteration: jaya bhagavati devi namo varade jaya pāpavināśinī bahuphalade / jaya śumbhaniśumbhakapāladhare praṇamāmi tu devanarārtihare
verses.translation: The scholarly Yavinara was the son and succes¬ sor of DvimJdha. Dhrtiman was his son. His son was Satya- dhrti. Satyadhrti's son was the valorous Drdhanemi. The king named Suvarma was Drclhanemi's son. The valorous Sarvabhauma (lord of the entire earth) was Suvarma's son. He shone as the sole lord of the earth and he became famous as Sarvabhauma. In his great family was born (a king named) Mahat- pauravanandana. King Rukmaratha is remembered as the son of Mahatpaurava.
verses.hindi: कसी की घिन्‍दा न करनेवाला तथा ग्रुण को गुण रूप में स्वीकार कर उसकी प्रशंसा करनेवाला) इसे सुनता है, अथवा जो मनुष्य वेनपुत्र राजा पृथु के जन्म वृत्तान्त को ब्राह्मणों को नमस्कार कर किसी को सुनाता है,
verses.wordMeaning: The scholarly Yavinara was the son and succes¬ sor of DvimJdha. Dhrtiman was his son. His son was Satya- dhrti. Satyadhrti's son was the valorous Drdhanemi. The king named Suvarma was Drclhanemi's son. The valorous Sarvabhauma (lord of the entire earth) was Suvarma's son.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The scholarly Yavinara was the son and succes¬ sor of DvimJdha. Dhrtiman was his son. His son was Satya- dhrti. Satyadhrti's son was the valorous Drdhanemi. The king named Suvarma was Drclhanemi's son. The valorous Sarvabhauma (lord of the entire earth) was Suvarma's son.…

verses.sanskrit: जय चन्द्रदिवाकरनेत्रधरे जय पावकभूषितवक्त्रवरे । जय भैरवदेहनिलीनपरे जय अन्धकरक्तविशोषकरे
verses.transliteration: jaya candradivākaranetradhare jaya pāvakabhūṣitavaktravare / jaya bhairavadehanilīnapare jaya andhakaraktaviśoṣakare
verses.translation: Rukmaratha's son was the king named Suparsva. Suparsva's son named Sumati was very virtuous. The son of Sumati was lord Sannatiman, the right- eous-souled king. His son was named Sanati and Krta was his
verses.hindi: न इंदमर्ध नास्ति क. पुस्तके । गोप्ता धर्मस्य राजाइसौ बभूवात्रिसमः प्रभुः १०८ अत्रिवंशसमुत्पन्नों ह्यड्भो नाम प्रजापति: । यस्य पुत्रो भवद्वेनो वात्यर्थ धर्ममकस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Rukmaratha's son was the king named Suparsva. Suparsva's son named Sumati was very virtuous. The son of Sumati was lord Sannatiman, the right- eous-souled king. His son was named Sanati and Krta was his
verses.commentary: Sense: Rukmaratha's son was the king named Suparsva. Suparsva's son named Sumati was very virtuous. The son of Sumati was lord Sannatiman, the right- eous-souled king. His son was named Sanati and Krta was his

verses.sanskrit: जय महिषविमर्दिनि शूलकरे जय लोकसमस्तकपापहरे । जय देवि पितामहरामनते जय भास्करशक्रशिरोऽवनते
verses.transliteration: jaya mahiṣavimardini śūlakare jaya lokasamastakapāpahare / jaya devi pitāmaharāmanate jaya bhāskaraśakraśiro'vanate
verses.translation: He was a disciple of the noble-souled Hiranyanabhi of the Kauthuma branch (of Samavedic study). Twenty four Saman-Sariihitas were expounded by him. The sons of Krta, the singers of Saman hymns, are re¬ membered by the name 'Pracyas' (Easterners). The heroic Ugrayudha was one of the sons of Krta. He was the scion of the family of Puru.. The mighty-armed lord of Paiicalas named Nila, who was the grandfather of Prsata, was killed by him (Ugrayudha) (and thereby) he exhibited his valour.
verses.hindi: जातो मृत्युसुतायां वे सुनोथायां प्रजापति: । स मातामह॒दोषेण बेनः कालात्मजात्मज: ११० स धर्म पृष्ठतः कृत्वा कामाल्‍लोमे हवतंत । स्थापनं स्थापयामास धर्मपितं स पाथिव: १११ वेदशपस्त्राण्पतिक्र मय ह्धर्मे निरतो5भवत् । निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारा: प्रजास्तस्मिन्प्रशासति ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He was a disciple of the noble-souled Hiranyanabhi of the Kauthuma branch (of Samavedic study). Twenty four Saman-Sariihitas were expounded by him. The sons of Krta, the singers of Saman hymns, are re¬ membered by the name 'Pracyas' (Easterners).…
verses.commentary: Sense: He was a disciple of the noble-souled Hiranyanabhi of the Kauthuma branch (of Samavedic study). Twenty four Saman-Sariihitas were expounded by him. The sons of Krta, the singers of Saman hymns, are re¬ membered by the name 'Pracyas' (Easterners).…

verses.sanskrit: जय षण्मुखसायुध ईशनुते जय सागरगामिनि शम्भुनुते । जय दुःखदरिद्रविनाशकरे जय पुत्रकलत्रविवृद्धिकरे
verses.transliteration: jaya ṣaṇmukhasāyudha īśanute jaya sāgaragāmini śambhunute / jaya duḥkhadaridravināśakare jaya putrakalatravivṛddhikare
verses.translation: Ugrayudha's son (successor) was a very famous king named Ksema. Suvira was born of Ksema. Suvira's son was Nrpanjaya. Viraratha was born of Nrpanjaya. Thus these are remembered as Pauravas (descendants of Puru). Purujanu was the son of Susanti. Riksa was born of Purujanu. The following were the sons and successors of Riksa.
verses.hindi: आसन्नं च पपुः सोम॑ हुत॑ यक्षेषु देवता: ११२ न यष्टव्यं न होतव्यमिति तस्य प्रजापतेः । आसीस्प्रतिज्ञा क़्रेयं विनाशे प्रत्युपस्थिते अहमिज्यश्र पृज्यश्च सर्वयज्ञे दिजातिभिः  सयि यज्ञों विधातव्यो मयि होतव्यमित्यपि..
verses.wordMeaning: Ugrayudha's son (successor) was a very famous king named Ksema. Suvira was born of Ksema. Suvira's son was Nrpanjaya. Viraratha was born of Nrpanjaya. Thus these are remembered as Pauravas (descendants of Puru). Purujanu was the son of Susanti. Riksa was born of Purujanu.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ugrayudha's son (successor) was a very famous king named Ksema. Suvira was born of Ksema. Suvira's son was Nrpanjaya. Viraratha was born of Nrpanjaya. Thus these are remembered as Pauravas (descendants of Puru). Purujanu was the son of Susanti. Riksa was born of Purujanu.…

verses.sanskrit: जय देवि समस्तशरीरधरे जय नाकविदर्शिनि दुःखहरे । जय व्याधिविनाशिनि मोक्षकरे जय वाञ्छितदायिनि सिद्धवरे
verses.transliteration: jaya devi samastaśarīradhare jaya nākavidarśini duḥkhahare / jaya vyādhivināśini mokṣakare jaya vāñchitadāyini siddhavare
verses.translation: They were: Mudgala, Srrljaya, the king Brhadisu, Vikranta who was younger to him and Karnpilya, the fifth. For the sustenance and the upkeep of all the five the father spoke to them thus: "Know that there are five flouri¬ shing territories for all the five of you." Since the five were sufficient, all the territories were together well known as Paiica- las.* Maudgalyas, the descendants of Mudgala,were Brahmanas endowed with Ksatriya traits. These were known ns Kanthamudgalas and they mer¬ ged into the Atigirasa Gotra. Mudgala's eldest son was very famous. He was engrossed in the meditation of Brahman.
verses.hindi: व दीक्षां प्रवक्ष्याम: संवत्सरशतान्ब॒हुन् । माइध्म बेन कार्षास्त्वं नेष धर्म: सनातन: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: They were: Mudgala, Srrljaya, the king Brhadisu, Vikranta who was younger to him and Karnpilya, the fifth.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were: Mudgala, Srrljaya, the king Brhadisu, Vikranta who was younger to him and Karnpilya, the fifth.…

verses.sanskrit: एतद्व्यासकृतं स्तोत्रं यः पठेच्छिवसन्निधौ । गृहे वा शुद्धभावेन कामक्रोधविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: etadvyāsakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhecchivasannidhau / gṛhe vā śuddhabhāvena kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: From him Indrasena conceived Badhyasva. We have heard that Mcnaka bore to Badhyasva twins. They were Divodasa the saintly king and Ahalya of great fame. Ahalya bore Satananda the excellent sage to Saradvata. His son was Satyadhrti of great fame. He was a master of the science of archery.
verses.hindi: निधने च प्रसूतोइसि प्रजापतिरसंशयः द १११६ उसे अपने कृताकृत ( पुण्य-पाप अथवा जो कुछ किया है और जो कुछ नहीं किया है। ) का शोच नहीं करना पड़ता  अत्रि के समान परमप्रभावजश्ञाली वह राजा धर्म का सर्वेतोभावेन रक्षक तथा परमऐश्वयंशाली था ।(०५-१०८। महृषि अन्रि के वंश में उत्पन्न अंग नामक एक प्रजापति हुए, जिसका पुत्र वेन हुआ। वेन परम धार्मिक राजा नहीं था। वेन मृत्यु की पुत्री सुनीधा में उत्पस्त हुआ था अतः अपने नाता के दोषों के
verses.wordMeaning: From him Indrasena conceived Badhyasva. We have heard that Mcnaka bore to Badhyasva twins. They were Divodasa the saintly king and Ahalya of great fame. Ahalya bore Satananda the excellent sage to Saradvata. His son was Satyadhrti of great fame.…
verses.commentary: Sense: From him Indrasena conceived Badhyasva. We have heard that Mcnaka bore to Badhyasva twins. They were Divodasa the saintly king and Ahalya of great fame. Ahalya bore Satananda the excellent sage to Saradvata. His son was Satyadhrti of great fame.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य व्यासो भवेत्प्रीतः प्रीतश्च वृषवाहनः । प्रीता स्यान्नर्मदा देवी सर्वपापक्षयंकरी
verses.transliteration: tasya vyāso bhavetprītaḥ prītaśca vṛṣavāhanaḥ / prītā syānnarmadā devī sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī
verses.translation: On seeing an Apsaras (celestial damsel) in front, the semen virile of Satyadhrti was emitted in the bush of Sara-grass and twins were born. Santanu who had come that way ahunting took them out of mercy (Krpa). The boy is remembered as Krpa and the girl Krpi. She was also known as Gautaml. Thus the race of Gautama, known as Saradvatas and Rtathyas, has been recounted. The intelligent Sudasa was born of Cyavann was born as the son of Sudasa. Somalia was his son
verses.hindi: कारण वह क्रूर प्रकृति का था। धम्म को पीछे रखकर कामनाओं से घिरकर बह लोभी हो गया और धर्म विरुद्ध मतों की उसने स्थापना की । वेदशास्त्र की आज्ञा का उल्लंघन कर अधर्म में रत हो गया। उस विधर्मी राजा के शासनकाल में प्रजाएँ रवाध्याय एवं वषदकार से विहीन हो गईं। देवता यज्ञों में होमे गये हवनीय द्रव्यों का भक्षण एवं सोम रस का पान करने को तरस उठे ।१०९-११२। उस प्रजापति वेतन के
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing an Apsaras (celestial damsel) in front, the semen virile of Satyadhrti was emitted in the bush of Sara-grass and twins were born. Santanu who had come that way ahunting took them out of mercy (Krpa). The boy is remembered as Krpa and the girl Krpi.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing an Apsaras (celestial damsel) in front, the semen virile of Satyadhrti was emitted in the bush of Sara-grass and twins were born. Santanu who had come that way ahunting took them out of mercy (Krpa). The boy is remembered as Krpa and the girl Krpi.…

verses.sanskrit: न ते यान्ति यमालोकं यैः स्तुता भुवि नर्मदा । पितामहो ऽपि मुह्येत देवि त्वद्गुणकीर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: na te yānti yamālokaṃ yaiḥ stutā bhuvi narmadā / pitāmaho 'pi muhyeta devi tvadguṇakīrtanāt
verses.translation: When the race was about to be extinct, Ajamidha was born again. That was Somalia. Somalia's son was Tanm When he was killed hundred other sons were born to the noble- soulcd lord Ajamidha in his birth as Somaka. The youngest of them, Prsata was Drupada's father. } ° 1 His son was Dhystadyumna and Dhrstaketu was his son. Dhuminl, the queen of Ajamidha, was desirous of a son In her rebirth she performed a very difficult penance for a hun¬ dred years. She performed Homas in the fire. She kept awake She ate but little and that too only the holy food. She perform¬ ed great holy rites. Day and night she stayed on the Kusa mattress alone. By these rigorous activities, she became smoke- coloured. The powerful Ajamidha begot of her Rksa, asmoke- coloured son, who was elder brother of Sita (one of white colour). Sam vara na was born of Rksa. Kuru was bom of Sam- varana.
verses.hindi: राजत्वकाल में विनाश का अवसर उपस्थित होने पर यह क्र प्रतिज्ञा हुई कि कोई भी प्रजा न तो यज्ञ कर सकती है--न हवन कर सकती है। यह भी प्रतिज्ञा उसकी थी कि ब्राह्मण लोग सभी प्रकार के यज्ञों में एकमात्र मेरी पूजा करें, मेरा सम्मान करें, मेरे ही उद्देश्य से यज्ञों की क्रियाएँ सम्पत्न करें, मेरे ही उद्देश्य से हवनादि करें। इस प्रकार प्राचीन मर्यादा के अतिक्रमण करनेवाले, अनुचित ढंग से पूजा आदि प्रहण करनेवाले अत्याचारी वेतन से मरीचि आदि प्रमुख महषियों ने कहहा--है वेन ! हम लोग अनेक सौ वर्षों तक तुम्हें ध्मं का उपदेश तथा दीक्षा देंगे अतः तुम अब अधर्म मत करो, जो तुम करते हो वह सनातन
verses.wordMeaning: When the race was about to be extinct, Ajamidha was born again. That was Somalia. Somalia's son was Tanm When he was killed hundred other sons were born to the noble- soulcd lord Ajamidha in his birth as Somaka. The youngest of them, Prsata was Drupada's father.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the race was about to be extinct, Ajamidha was born again. That was Somalia. Somalia's son was Tanm When he was killed hundred other sons were born to the noble- soulcd lord Ajamidha in his birth as Somaka. The youngest of them, Prsata was Drupada's father.…

verses.sanskrit: वाक्पतिर्नैव ते वक्तुं स्वरूपं वेद नर्मदे । कथं गुणानहं देवि त्वदीयाञ्ज्ञातुमुत्सहे
verses.transliteration: vākpatirnaiva te vaktuṃ svarūpaṃ veda narmade / kathaṃ guṇānahaṃ devi tvadīyāñjñātumutsahe
verses.translation: After treading on (conquering) Prayaga, he built Kuruksctra. The cxcessive-splendoured king ploughed it for many years. While it was being ploughed, Sakra shone there and granted this boon: Your (Kuruksetra) shall be beautiful, holy and resorted to by meritorious persons. Persons born in his family were excellent kings famous as Kurus. Kuru's beloved sons were Sudhanvan, Jahnu, Pariksita the great king, Putraka and Arimardana. It is remem¬ bered that the intelligent Suhotra was the successor of Sudhan¬ van.
verses.hindi: पालयिष्ये प्रजाश्चेति त्वया पूर्व प्रतिश्ुतम् । तांस्तथा बादिन:ः सर्वान्ब्रह्मषोंनब्रवीत्तदा ११७ स प्रहस्य तु दुर्बृद्धरिदं वचनकोविदः । ख्रष्टा धर्मस्प कश्चान्य: श्रोतव्यं कस्य वे मया ११८
verses.wordMeaning: After treading on (conquering) Prayaga, he built Kuruksctra. The cxcessive-splendoured king ploughed it for many years. While it was being ploughed, Sakra shone there and granted this boon: Your (Kuruksetra) shall be beautiful, holy and resorted to by meritorious persons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After treading on (conquering) Prayaga, he built Kuruksctra. The cxcessive-splendoured king ploughed it for many years. While it was being ploughed, Sakra shone there and granted this boon: Your (Kuruksetra) shall be beautiful, holy and resorted to by meritorious persons.…

verses.sanskrit: इति ज्ञात्वा शुचिं भावं वाङ्मनःकायकर्मभिः । प्रसन्ना नर्मदादेवी ततो वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: iti jñātvā śuciṃ bhāvaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ / prasannā narmadādevī tato vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Cyavana was his son. The king was an expert in religious affairs. Krta was the son of Cyavana. He performed great penance and many Yajnas. The king procreated his famous son Vidyoparicara who claimed friendship of Indra. He was a great hero who could traverse the sky and was known as Vasu too. Girika bore seven sons to Vidyoparicara—Brhad- ratha, a great warrior, who became famous as the king of Magadha, Pratyagjrha, Kusa, one whom they call Manivahana Mathailya, Lalittha and Matsyakala the seventh.
verses.hindi: प्रभवः सर्वलोकानां धर्माणां च विशेषतः । इच्छन्वहेयं पृथिवीं प्लावयेयं जलेन वा ॥ सुजेय॑ वा ग्रसेयं वा नात्र कार्या विचारणा १२०
verses.wordMeaning: Cyavana was his son. The king was an expert in religious affairs. Krta was the son of Cyavana. He performed great penance and many Yajnas. The king procreated his famous son Vidyoparicara who claimed friendship of Indra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Cyavana was his son. The king was an expert in religious affairs. Krta was the son of Cyavana. He performed great penance and many Yajnas. The king procreated his famous son Vidyoparicara who claimed friendship of Indra.…

verses.sanskrit: सत्यवादेन तुष्टाहं भोभो व्यास महामुने । यदीच्छसि वरं किंचित्तं ते सर्वं ददाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: satyavādena tuṣṭāhaṃ bhobho vyāsa mahāmune / yadīcchasi varaṃ kiṃcittaṃ te sarvaṃ dadāmyaham
verses.translation: Bfhadratha's successor was famous by the name of Kusagra. Kusagra's son was a powerful king named Rsabha. Rsabha's successor was a virtuous king named Puspa- van. King Satyahita is remembered as his valoious successor. His son was Sudhanvan. From him the valorous Drja was born. Orja's son was Nabhasa and from him was born that powerful king Jarasandha. He was born in two pieces and he was joined by Jara. Jarasandha was mighty-armed because he was joined by Jara.
verses.hindi: निगृह्य तं॑ महाबाहुं विस्फुरन्तं यथाइनलम्  ततोथ्स्य वामहस्तं ते ममन्थुभ शकोपिता:ः
verses.wordMeaning: Bfhadratha's successor was famous by the name of Kusagra. Kusagra's son was a powerful king named Rsabha. Rsabha's successor was a virtuous king named Puspa- van. King Satyahita is remembered as his valoious successor. His son was Sudhanvan. From him the valorous Drja was born.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bfhadratha's successor was famous by the name of Kusagra. Kusagra's son was a powerful king named Rsabha. Rsabha's successor was a virtuous king named Puspa- van. King Satyahita is remembered as his valoious successor. His son was Sudhanvan. From him the valorous Drja was born.…

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच: यदि तुष्टासि मे देवि यदि देयो वरो मम । आतिथ्यमुत्तरे कूले ऋषीणां दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca: yadi tuṣṭāsi me devi yadi deyo varo mama / ātithyamuttare kūle ṛṣīṇāṃ dātumarhasi
verses.translation: This Jarasandha of great strength was the conqueror of all Ksatriya kings. Jarasandha's son was the valorous Saha- deva. Sahadeva's son was the glorious Somadhi of very great penance. Srutasruva was the son of Somadhi and is glorified as Magadha.
verses.hindi: निषादवंशकर्ताइसौ बभ्वानन्तविक्रम: । धीवरानसृजत्सो5पि वेनकल्मषसंभवान् ये चान्ये विन्ध्यनिलयास्तुम्बुरां स्तुवराः खसा:। अधर्मरुचयश्चापि संभूता वेनकल्मघात्ू
verses.wordMeaning: This Jarasandha of great strength was the conqueror of all Ksatriya kings. Jarasandha's son was the valorous Saha- deva. Sahadeva's son was the glorious Somadhi of very great penance. Srutasruva was the son of Somadhi and is glorified as Magadha.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Jarasandha of great strength was the conqueror of all Ksatriya kings. Jarasandha's son was the valorous Saha- deva. Sahadeva's son was the glorious Somadhi of very great penance. Srutasruva was the son of Somadhi and is glorified as Magadha.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदोवाच: अयुक्तं याचितं व्यास विमार्गे यत्प्रवर्तनम् । इन्द्रचन्द्रयमैः शक्यम् उन्मार्गे न प्रवर्तितुम्
verses.transliteration: narmadovāca: ayuktaṃ yācitaṃ vyāsa vimārge yatpravartanam / indracandrayamaiḥ śakyam unmārge na pravartitum
verses.translation: Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksita. Sruta- sena's successor was named Bhlmasena. (lines missing). Jahnu begot a son named Suratha who became a king. Suratha's successor was the heroic king Viduratha. It is well known that Viduratha's son too was Sarva- bhauma. Jayatsena was bom of Sarvabhauma and Aradhi was his son.
verses.hindi: धर्म नहीं है, तुम निश्चय यह मान लो कि अपने पिता की मृत्यु के उपरान्त उत्पन्न हुए हो । तुम पहिले ही प्रतिज्ञा कर चुके हो कि में प्रजाओं का पालन करूँगा ।११३-११६१। इस प्रकार की बातें करनेवाले सभी ब्रह्मषियों से उस समय उंस परम दुर्बृद्धि एवं बातें करने में निपुण बेन ने हँस कर कहा, धर्म का बनाने बाला मेरे सिवा इस जगत् में दूसरा कौन है ? मैं किसकी बातें सुनूं। अथवा इस संसार में पराक्रम,
verses.wordMeaning: Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksita. Sruta- sena's successor was named Bhlmasena. (lines missing). Jahnu begot a son named Suratha who became a king. Suratha's successor was the heroic king Viduratha. It is well known that Viduratha's son too was Sarva- bhauma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksita. Sruta- sena's successor was named Bhlmasena. (lines missing). Jahnu begot a son named Suratha who became a king. Suratha's successor was the heroic king Viduratha. It is well known that Viduratha's son too was Sarva- bhauma.…

verses.sanskrit: याचस्वान्यं वरं पुत्र यत्किंचिद्भुवि दुर्लभम् । एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो देव्या व्यासो मूर्च्छां यतस्तदा
verses.transliteration: yācasvānyaṃ varaṃ putra yatkiṃcidbhuvi durlabham / etacchrutvā vaco devyā vyāso mūrcchāṃ yatastadā
verses.translation: Mahasattva was born of Aradhi and Ayutayu came thereafter. Akrodhana was the son of Ayutayu. It is remember¬ ed that Devatithi was born of him. It was Rksa who became the successor of Devatithi. Bhlmasena was born of Rksa and Dilipa was his son.
verses.hindi: शास्त्रज्ञान, तपस्या तथा सैन्य आदि साधनों में मेरे समान भला इस पृथ्वी पर कौन है। तुम लोग मुझे यथार्थत:ः सभी साधनों से परिपूर्ण त्तथा महात्मा जानो। मुझे सभी लोगों का तथा विशेषकर सभी प्रकाय के धर्मों का उत्पत्ति-कर्त्ता समझो । मैं अपनी इच्छा मात्र से इस सारी पृथ्वी को चाहूँ तो जला दूँ, या इसकी अभिनव सृष्तिट कर दू या निगल जाउऊँ-इसमें तनिक भी सन्देह मत करो ॥११७-१२०। इस प्रकार जब असेक बार के समझाने बुझाने पर भी, दम्भ, एवं अभिमान के कारण मोहित वेन ठीक मार्म पर धहीं लाया जा सका तब क्रुद्ध होकर महर्षियों ने अग्ति की लपटों की तरह फड़कते हुए उस महाबाहु को पकड़कर उसके बायें हाथ का अत्यन्त कुपित हो मत्थन किया। है द्विजगण ! मन्थन करते समय उसके बाएँ हाथ से एक अति अल्पकाय, क्ृष्णवर्ग एवं दीन-हीन चेष्टावाला पुरुष पहिले उत्पन्न हुआ  अति भयभीत दशा में वह हाथ जोड़े
verses.wordMeaning: Mahasattva was born of Aradhi and Ayutayu came thereafter. Akrodhana was the son of Ayutayu. It is remember¬ ed that Devatithi was born of him. It was Rksa who became the successor of Devatithi. Bhlmasena was born of Rksa and Dilipa was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahasattva was born of Aradhi and Ayutayu came thereafter. Akrodhana was the son of Ayutayu. It is remember¬ ed that Devatithi was born of him. It was Rksa who became the successor of Devatithi. Bhlmasena was born of Rksa and Dilipa was his son.

verses.sanskrit: वृथा क्लेशो ऽद्य मे जात इति मत्वा पपात ह । धरणी चलिता सर्वा सशैलवनकानना
verses.transliteration: vṛthā kleśo 'dya me jāta iti matvā papāta ha / dharaṇī calitā sarvā saśailavanakānanā
verses.translation: Pratlpa was the son of Dilipa. It is remembered that. three sons were born to him. Those three were Devapi, Santanu and Bah lika. King Saptabahlisvara should be known as (the son) of Bahllka. Somadatla too, of great fame, was the son of Bahllka. Bhuri, Bhurisravas and Sala were born of Somadatta. With a desire to accumulate virtue Devapi (renounced every¬ thing and) went to the forest.
verses.hindi: हुए स्थित था. सभी इन्द्रियाँ व्याकुल थीं। उसे इस प्रकार आर्त दशा में देख सुनियों ने कहा निषौद, बैठ जाओ ।' फलस्वरूप अनन्त विक्रम सम्पन्न वह पुरुष निषाद बंध का कर्त्ता हुआ और बेन के पापों से उत्पन्न होनेवाले धीवरों को उत्पन्न किया ।१२१-१२५। जो विश्ध्यपर्वत पर निवास करनेवाले, तुम्बुर, खस, स्तुवर जाति वाले अधर्मी लोग हैं, उसी वेन के पाप से उत्पन्न हुए हैँ। तदनन्तर पुत्र: महर्षियों ने बेन के दाहिने हाथ
verses.wordMeaning: Pratlpa was the son of Dilipa. It is remembered that. three sons were born to him. Those three were Devapi, Santanu and Bah lika. King Saptabahlisvara should be known as (the son) of Bahllka. Somadatla too, of great fame, was the son of Bahllka. Bhuri,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Pratlpa was the son of Dilipa. It is remembered that. three sons were born to him. Those three were Devapi, Santanu and Bah lika. King Saptabahlisvara should be known as (the son) of Bahllka. Somadatla too, of great fame, was the son of Bahllka. Bhuri,…

verses.sanskrit: मूर्च्छापन्नं ततो व्यासं दृष्ट्वा देवाः सवासवाः । हाहाकारमुखाः सर्वे तत्राजग्मुः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: mūrcchāpannaṃ tato vyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ savāsavāḥ / hāhākāramukhāḥ sarve tatrājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Sage Devapi became the preceptor of Dcvas. To this noble-souled sage, two sons Cyavana and Istaka were born. Santanu became king. He was a scholar and a great physician ( MahabhUa ). About this Mahabhisa they cite this verse.
verses.hindi: पृथुस्तस्मात्समुत्पन्न: करास्फालनतेजसः । पृथो: करतलाद्वापि यस्माज्जातः पृथुस्तत: ॥। समुत्पश्नेन राजधिः स सत्पुत्रेण धीमता । त्रातः स पुरुषव्यात्नः पुन्नाम्नो नरकात्तदा
verses.wordMeaning: Sage Devapi became the preceptor of Dcvas. To this noble-souled sage, two sons Cyavana and Istaka were born. Santanu became king. He was a scholar and a great physician ( MahabhUa ). About this Mahabhisa they cite this verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sage Devapi became the preceptor of Dcvas. To this noble-souled sage, two sons Cyavana and Istaka were born. Santanu became king. He was a scholar and a great physician ( MahabhUa ). About this Mahabhisa they cite this verse.

verses.sanskrit: व्यासमुत्थापयामासुर् वेदव्यसनतत्परम् । ब्राह्मणार्थे च संक्लिष्टो नात्महेतोः सरिद्वरे
verses.transliteration: vyāsamutthāpayāmāsur vedavyasanatatparam / brāhmaṇārthe ca saṃkliṣṭo nātmahetoḥ saridvare
verses.translation: "Whomsoever docs the king touch, be he very old due to the efflux of time, becomes a youth again. Therefore they know him as Samtanu (Sam —happiness, Tanu —body)/' Therefore the quality of his being Sarhtanu was well known among the subjects. That righteous king Samtanu married Jahnavx (Ganga). The lord begot a son of her, named Devavrata (who later became) Bhlsma. That Bhlsma became famous as the grandfather of the Pantfavas.
verses.hindi: त॑ नद्यच्र समुद्रांश्र र॒त्नान्यादाय सर्वशः । अभिषेकाय तोयं च सर्व एबोपतस्थिरे १३२ पितामहश्च भगवानड्िरोभि: सहामरेः । स्थावराणि च भूतानि जद्भमानि च स्वशः
verses.wordMeaning: "Whomsoever docs the king touch, be he very old due to the efflux of time, becomes a youth again. Therefore they know him as Samtanu (Sam —happiness, Tanu —body)/' Therefore the quality of his being Sarhtanu was well known among the subjects.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Whomsoever docs the king touch, be he very old due to the efflux of time, becomes a youth again. Therefore they know him as Samtanu (Sam —happiness, Tanu —body)/' Therefore the quality of his being Sarhtanu was well known among the subjects.…

verses.sanskrit: गवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे च सद्यः प्राणान्परित्यजेत् । एवं सा नर्मदा प्रोक्ता ब्रह्माद्यैः सुरसत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe ca sadyaḥ prāṇānparityajet / evaṃ sā narmadā proktā brahmādyaiḥ surasattamaiḥ
verses.translation: After some time Samtanu begot his most favourite son Vicitravlrya who as king did much for the welfare of the subjects. Krsnadvaipayana begot of Vicitravlrya's wife (< ksetra ), Dhrtarastra, Pandu and Vidura. Gandharl bore to Dhrtarastra a hundred sons. Duryodhana was the eldest among them. He became the lord of all Ksatriyas. Madri and the queen Prtha became the wives of Pandu.
verses.hindi: का अतिशय कुषपित हो वेगपूर्वक्कष अरणी की भाँति मन्‍्थन किया । तब हाथों के झीघ्रतापूर्वक घंण के कारण समुत्पन्न तेज से पृर्णं उस दाहिने हाथ से पृथ उत्पन्न हुआ  पथु के 'करतल' अथ होते हैं, उसी करतल से उत्पन्न होने के कारण उसका नाम भी पृथु पड़ा । वह अपने शरीर को अनृपम कान्ति से साक्षात् अग्नि की तरह देदीप्यमान हो रहा था। सर्वप्रथम उसने प्रचण्ड ध्वनि करनेवाले, आजगव नामक महाधनुष को तथा बाणों को प्रजा के रक्षार्थ ग्रहणकर अतिशय द्यूति से दमकते हुए कवच को धारण किया। उसके उत्पन्न होने पर सभी जीव समूह अतिह॑बित हुए। महाराज पृथु के उत्पन्न होने पर बेन का स्वर्गवास हो गया ।१२६-१३०। इस प्रकार परम बुद्धिमान एवं सच्चरित्र पुन्न प्रथु के उत्पन्त होने के कारण पुरुषव्याध्र राजबि बेन पुम् नामक नरक में जाने से बच गया  सभी नदी तथा समुद्रगण सभी प्रकार के बहुमूल्य रत्नादि
verses.wordMeaning: After some time Samtanu begot his most favourite son Vicitravlrya who as king did much for the welfare of the subjects. Krsnadvaipayana begot of Vicitravlrya's wife (< ksetra ), Dhrtarastra, Pandu and Vidura. Gandharl bore to Dhrtarastra a hundred sons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After some time Samtanu begot his most favourite son Vicitravlrya who as king did much for the welfare of the subjects. Krsnadvaipayana begot of Vicitravlrya's wife (< ksetra ), Dhrtarastra, Pandu and Vidura. Gandharl bore to Dhrtarastra a hundred sons.…

verses.sanskrit: सुशीतलैस्तं बहुभिश्च वातैर् रेवाभ्यषिञ्चत्स्वजलेन भीता । सचेतनः सत्यवतीसुतो ऽपि प्रणम्य देवान्सरितं जगाद
verses.transliteration: suśītalaistaṃ bahubhiśca vātair revābhyaṣiñcatsvajalena bhītā / sacetanaḥ satyavatīsuto 'pi praṇamya devānsaritaṃ jagāda
verses.translation: Sons bestowed by gods were born of them on behalf of Pandu. Yudhisthira was born, thanks to the grace of Dharma; Vrkodara was born of Vayu; Dhananjaya whose valour was equal to that of Sakra was born of Indra. Sahadcva and Nakula were born to Madri, thanks to the grace of Asvins. Five sons were born to DraupadI from the (five) Pandavas. DraupadI bore Srutividdha, the eldest of them, to Yudhisthira. Hidarhba bore her son Ghatotkaca to Bhlmasena. Kasya too bore her son Sarvavrka to Bhlmasena.
verses.hindi: तथा पवित्र जल को ले लेकर अभिषेक के लिए प्रथु के समीप उपस्थित हुए  तदनन्तर सभी देवताओं तथा अगिरा आदि मुनियों के साथ भगवान् ब्रह्मा ने विपुल राजकीय समग्रियों ढारा आकर वेनपुतन्र राजा पथु का अभिषेक किया। इसी प्रकार सभी स्थावर जजद्भम जीवों ने भी उस अमित तेजस्वी कान्तिमान् राजाघिराज उथु का अभिषेचन किया। देवताओं और अंगिरा के पुत्रों द्वारा अभिषेक किये जाने पर वेनपुत्र आदिराज
verses.wordMeaning: Sons bestowed by gods were born of them on behalf of Pandu. Yudhisthira was born, thanks to the grace of Dharma; Vrkodara was born of Vayu; Dhananjaya whose valour was equal to that of Sakra was born of Indra. Sahadcva and Nakula were born to Madri,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sons bestowed by gods were born of them on behalf of Pandu. Yudhisthira was born, thanks to the grace of Dharma; Vrkodara was born of Vayu; Dhananjaya whose valour was equal to that of Sakra was born of Indra. Sahadcva and Nakula were born to Madri,…

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच: तीर्थैः समस्तैः किल सेवनाय फलं प्रदिष्टं मम मन्दभाग्यात् । यद्देवि पुण्या विफला ममाशा आरण्यपुष्पाणि यथा जनानाम्
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca: tīrthaiḥ samastaiḥ kila sevanāya phalaṃ pradiṣṭaṃ mama mandabhāgyāt / yaddevi puṇyā viphalā mamāśā āraṇyapuṣpāṇi yathā janānām
verses.translation: The heroic Abhimanyu was born of Subhadra as the son of Partha. Parlksit was born of Uttara, the princess of Virata, as the son of Abhimanyu. King Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksit. H e established Vajcsaneyika Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: महाराज पृथु क्रा प्रताप अधिक बढ़ गया। पिता से अप्रसन्‍त रहनेवाली प्रजाओं को उसने अतिप्रसन्‍न किया, जिससे प्रजा के ऊपर अधिक अनुराग रखने के कारण उसका 'राजा' यह नाम पड़ा ।१३१-१३६। समुद्र पर एतदर्धस्थाने---पुरुषव्या त्रः पुंनाम्नो तरकास्‍्त्रायते ततः”” इति क. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: The heroic Abhimanyu was born of Subhadra as the son of Partha. Parlksit was born of Uttara, the princess of Virata, as the son of Abhimanyu. King Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksit. H e established Vajcsaneyika Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic Abhimanyu was born of Subhadra as the son of Partha. Parlksit was born of Uttara, the princess of Virata, as the son of Abhimanyu. King Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksit. H e established Vajcsaneyika Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदोवाच: यतो यतो मां हि महानुभाव निनीषते चित्तमिलातले ऽत्र । विन्ध्येन सार्द्धं तव मार्गमद्य यास्याम्यहं दण्डधरस्य पृष्ठे
verses.transliteration: narmadovāca: yato yato māṃ hi mahānubhāva ninīṣate cittamilātale 'tra / vindhyena sārddhaṃ tava mārgamadya yāsyāmyahaṃ daṇḍadharasya pṛṣṭhe
verses.translation: The infuriated Vaisariipayana (said to him), «q evil-minded one, your directions (rule) will not remain long here in this world without an enemy (without being protested against). As long as I am alive in this world, this (act of yours) cannot be praised." Thereupon, Janamejaya was faced with difficulties all round. He worshipped lord Prajapati by offering Havis in the Paurnamasa Yajfia. He saw that the different materials were offered in the sacrifice of the lord. Still he was in difficulties? Janamejaya, the son of Parlksit, the descendant of Puru, then performed Asvamedha twice. Thereafter, he made those Vajasaneyaka Brahmanas function. Janamejaya was crippled (defeated) three times.
verses.hindi: रेरे वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: The infuriated Vaisariipayana (said to him), «q evil-minded one, your directions (rule) will not remain long here in this world without an enemy (without being protested against). As long as I am alive in this world, this (act of yours) cannot be praised." Thereupon,…
