verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो महातेजा व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः । दक्षिणे चालयामास स्वाश्रमस्य सरिद्वराम्
verses.transliteration: evamukto mahātejā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / dakṣiṇe cālayāmāsa svāśramasya saridvarām
verses.translation: Crippled at the hands of As'vakomukhyas, crippled at the hands of the residents of Angas, and crippled at the hands of the people of MadhyadeSa (Middle Lands)! Janame¬ jaya became Trikharvi (crippled three times). He was distres¬ sed. Being cursed along with those Brahmanas, he suffered ruin. Satanlka of truthful exploit and strength was his son. After him (Janamejaya), the Brahmanas crowned his son Satanlka.
verses.hindi: अक्ृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सिध्यन्त्यन्नानि चिन्तया। सर्वेकामबुघा गाव: पुटके पुटके सधु १३८ एतस्मिन्नेव काले च यह्ञे पतामहे शुभे । सुतः उुत्यां समुत्पक्चः सोत्येडहनि महामतिः॥ तस्मिच्नेव महायज्ञे जज्ञ प्राज्ञोौपध मागधः
verses.wordMeaning: Crippled at the hands of As'vakomukhyas, crippled at the hands of the residents of Angas, and crippled at the hands of the people of MadhyadeSa (Middle Lands)! Janame¬ jaya became Trikharvi (crippled three times). He was distres¬ sed. Being cursed along with those Brahmanas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Crippled at the hands of As'vakomukhyas, crippled at the hands of the residents of Angas, and crippled at the hands of the people of MadhyadeSa (Middle Lands)! Janame¬ jaya became Trikharvi (crippled three times). He was distres¬ sed. Being cursed along with those Brahmanas,…

verses.sanskrit: दण्डहस्तो महातेजा हुङ्कारमकरोन्मुनिः । व्यासहुङ्कारभीता सा चलिता रुद्रनन्दिनी
verses.transliteration: daṇḍahasto mahātejā huṅkāramakaronmuniḥ / vyāsahuṅkārabhītā sā calitā rudranandinī
verses.translation: The powerful As'vamedhadatta was the son of Satanlka. Adhisamakrsna was born as the son of Asvamedha- datta. He conquered the cities of his enemies. He is the present ruler, of righteous soul and great fame. It is under his rule that you have been able to perform this Dirghasatra (sacri¬ fice of long duration) for three years. It is very difficult to be • performed. O excellent Brahmanas, (besides) there is another a ra lasting for two years, which is being performed in Kuru- ksetra on the banks of the river Drsadvati. We wish to hear all these—the activities that will be undertaken by them, and their names, the kings who will be born, their time calculated in years, the extent of theYugas, their good points and their defects, their happiness and misery and those of the subjects, their religious activities and their passionate pursuits as well as their monetary dealings. Enu¬ merate all these to us who ask you. Even as I recount listen and understand the future events, 1 the Kaliyuga and the Manvantaras in the manner they had been described to me by Vyasa of wonderful activities. Henceforth, I shall mention the kings who will be born in future.
verses.hindi: +सामगेषु तु गायत्सु स्र् ग्भाण्ड वेश्वदेवके । सामगाने समुत्पन्नस्तस्मान्मागध उच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: The powerful As'vamedhadatta was the son of Satanlka. Adhisamakrsna was born as the son of Asvamedha- datta. He conquered the cities of his enemies. He is the present ruler, of righteous soul and great fame.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful As'vamedhadatta was the son of Satanlka. Adhisamakrsna was born as the son of Asvamedha- datta. He conquered the cities of his enemies. He is the present ruler, of righteous soul and great fame.…

verses.sanskrit: दण्डेन दर्शयन्मार्गं देवी तत्र प्रवर्तिता । व्यासमार्गं गता देवी दृष्टा शक्रपुरोगमैः
verses.transliteration: daṇḍena darśayanmārgaṃ devī tatra pravartitā / vyāsamārgaṃ gatā devī dṛṣṭā śakrapurogamaiḥ
verses.translation: I shall mention the descendants of Aila, Iksvaku, Sudyumna and other kings in whom this splendid territory of the Iksvakus will be vested. I shall mention all other kings also besides these who will be born in future, viz. Ksatriyas, Parasavas, Sudras and Brahmanas, Andhas (Andhras), Sakas, Pulindas, Tulikas, Yavanas, Kaivartas, Abhiras, Sabaras, and all other Mleccha (outcaste) tribes. This present king Adhisamakrsna is a king belonging to the Puru dynasty. I shall mention all the future kings in his family.
verses.hindi: ऐन्द्रेण हविषा चापि हि: पृक्‍त बृहस्पति: । जुहावेन्द्राय देवेन ततः सुतो व्यजायत १४० प्रमादस्तत्र संजज्ञे प्रायश्चित्त च कमंसु । शिष्यह॒थ्येन यत्पृक्तमभिभुतं गुरोहेवि: ॥ यच्च क्षत्रात्समभवद्ब्ाह्मण्पं हीनथोनितः । सुतः पूर्षेण साधर्म्यालुल्यधर्मः प्रकीतितः
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention the descendants of Aila, Iksvaku, Sudyumna and other kings in whom this splendid territory of the Iksvakus will be vested. I shall mention all other kings also besides these who will be born in future, viz. Ksatriyas, Parasavas, Sudras and Brahmanas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the descendants of Aila, Iksvaku, Sudyumna and other kings in whom this splendid territory of the Iksvakus will be vested. I shall mention all other kings also besides these who will be born in future, viz. Ksatriyas, Parasavas, Sudras and Brahmanas,…

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पवृष्टिं ततो देवा व्यमुञ्चन् सह किंकरैः । किं कुर्मो ब्रूहि मे पुत्र कर्मणा ते स्म रञ्जिताः
verses.transliteration: puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tato devā vyamuñcan saha kiṃkaraiḥ / kiṃ kurmo brūhi me putra karmaṇā te sma rañjitāḥ
verses.translation: Nirvaktra will be the son of Adhisamakrsna. When his city Hastinapura is swept away by Ganga he will abandon it and live happily at Kausambl. His son will be Usna. Citraratha will be born of Usna. Sucidratha will be born of Citraratha, and Vj-timan will be born of Sucidratha. Suscna of great fame and prowess will be born there¬ after. To Suscna will be born the king named Sutlriha.
verses.hindi: मध्यमों ह्यंष सुतस्य धर्म: क्षत्रोपजीवनम् । रथनागाश्व चरितं जधन्यं च चिकित्सितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Nirvaktra will be the son of Adhisamakrsna. When his city Hastinapura is swept away by Ganga he will abandon it and live happily at Kausambl. His son will be Usna. Citraratha will be born of Usna. Sucidratha will be born of Citraratha, and Vj-timan will be born of Sucidratha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Nirvaktra will be the son of Adhisamakrsna. When his city Hastinapura is swept away by Ganga he will abandon it and live happily at Kausambl. His son will be Usna. Citraratha will be born of Usna. Sucidratha will be born of Citraratha, and Vj-timan will be born of Sucidratha.…

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच: तपश्च विपुलं कृत्वा दानं दत्त्वा महाफलम् । एतदेव नरैः कार्यं साधूनां यत्सुखावहम्
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca: tapaśca vipulaṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ dattvā mahāphalam / etadeva naraiḥ kāryaṃ sādhūnāṃ yatsukhāvaham
verses.translation: Ruca will be born of Sutlrtha. Then Tricak?a will be born. Tricaksa's successor will be Sukhibala. Sukhibala's son will be the king Paripluta. King Sunaya will be born as the son of Paripluta.
verses.hindi: अभियान (आक्रमण) करते समय जल समूह स्तम्मित हो जाते-थे, पर्वत समूह विशीर्ण हो जाते थे । कभी घ्वजाओं का भंग नहीं होता था । पृथ्वी बिना किसी कष्ट के ही केवल चिन्तनमात्र से प्रचुर परिमाण में अन्त उत्पन्त करती थी । गौएँ सभी मनोरथों को पूर्ण करने वाली थीं, पत्रों के प्रत्येक पुटकों में मथु मिलता था । ठोक इसी समय पितामह के पवित्र महायज्ञ का प्रारम्भ हुआ था जिसमें उसी दिन सूती के गर्भ से परम बुद्धिमान सूत उत्पर्त हुए  उसी महायज्ञ में बुद्धिमान मगध भी उत्पल्त हुए । जिस समय सामवेद का गायन हो रहा था उस समय असावधानी के कारण विश्वदेत के खुक् और पात्र में इन्द्र की हवि के साथ बृहस्पति की हवि मिल मिल गईं, और देवताओं ने उस ह॒वि को इन्द्र के लिए हवन किया जिससे सूत की उत्पत्ति हुई ।१२७-१४०। सामगान के अवसर पर उत्पन्न होने के कारण वे लोग मागध कहे गये । इस प्रकार को
verses.wordMeaning: Ruca will be born of Sutlrtha. Then Tricak?a will be born. Tricaksa's successor will be Sukhibala. Sukhibala's son will be the king Paripluta. King Sunaya will be born as the son of Paripluta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ruca will be born of Sutlrtha. Then Tricak?a will be born. Tricaksa's successor will be Sukhibala. Sukhibala's son will be the king Paripluta. King Sunaya will be born as the son of Paripluta.

verses.sanskrit: यदि तुष्टा महाभागा अनुग्राह्यो ह्यहं यदि । तस्मान्ममाश्रमे सर्वैः स्थीयतां नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: yadi tuṣṭā mahābhāgā anugrāhyo hyahaṃ yadi / tasmānmamāśrame sarvaiḥ sthīyatāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: King Mcdhavi will be the son of Sunaya and Medha- vin's son will be Dantfapani. Dandapani's son will be Niramitra and Ksemaka will be the son of Niramitra. These twentyfive kings (?) will be born in the race of Puru. In this connection the following verse describing the subsequent race has been cited by Brahmanas who know ancient lore. "This race which has produced Brahmanas and Ksatriyas, and which is honoured by Devas and sages, will be extinct in the Kali age after coming to Ksemaka". Thus the race of Puru has been enumerated precisely.
verses.hindi: असावधानी से शिष्य की हथि के साथ गुरु की हवि मिल जाने के कारण वह तिरस्कृत हुई और नीच ऊंच के पारस्परिक संयोग से पापाचरण समझा गया, जिससे सृत और मागधों के वर्णो में विकार आ गया। हीन योनि क्षत्रियों की हृवि के साथ ब्राह्मण की हवि का यतः संयोग हुआ था अतः पूर्व (ब्राह्मण) जाति के साधम्यं के कारण सूृत उसी के तुल्य धमंवाले कहे जाते हैं। सूत का मध्यम धर्म क्षत्रियों के समान जीविका
verses.wordMeaning: King Mcdhavi will be the son of Sunaya and Medha- vin's son will be Dantfapani. Dandapani's son will be Niramitra and Ksemaka will be the son of Niramitra. These twentyfive kings (?) will be born in the race of Puru.…
verses.commentary: Sense: King Mcdhavi will be the son of Sunaya and Medha- vin's son will be Dantfapani. Dandapani's son will be Niramitra and Ksemaka will be the son of Niramitra. These twentyfive kings (?) will be born in the race of Puru.…

verses.sanskrit: आतिथ्यं शाकपर्णेन रेवामृतविमिश्रितम् । प्रतिपन्नं समस्तैर्वः पराशरमुखैर्मम । स्थातव्यं स्वाश्रमे सर्वैर् रेवाया उत्तरे तटे
verses.transliteration: ātithyaṃ śākaparṇena revāmṛtavimiśritam / pratipannaṃ samastairvaḥ parāśaramukhairmama / sthātavyaṃ svāśrame sarvair revāyā uttare taṭe
verses.translation: (The race) of the intelligent son of Pandu, the noble- souled Arjuna (has been narrated). Brhadratha's successor was the heroic king Brhatksaya. His son was Ksaya. Vatsavyuha was the son of Ksaya. After Vatsavyuha, Prativyuha became king. His son is Divakara and this king is ruling over the city of Ayodhya now.
verses.hindi: अरजन करना हुआ, रथ और हाथियों का परिचालन और ओषधि आदि निन्द कामों को भी वे करने लगे । धनुश्चिह्नान्तगंतग्रन्थो क. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: (The race) of the intelligent son of Pandu, the noble- souled Arjuna (has been narrated). Brhadratha's successor was the heroic king Brhatksaya. His son was Ksaya. Vatsavyuha was the son of Ksaya. After Vatsavyuha, Prativyuha became king.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (The race) of the intelligent son of Pandu, the noble- souled Arjuna (has been narrated). Brhadratha's successor was the heroic king Brhatksaya. His son was Ksaya. Vatsavyuha was the son of Ksaya. After Vatsavyuha, Prativyuha became king.…

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: स्नानतर्पणनित्यानि कृतानि द्विजसत्तमैः । व्यासकुण्डे ततो गत्वा होमः सर्वैः प्रकल्पितः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: snānatarpaṇanityāni kṛtāni dvijasattamaiḥ / vyāsakuṇḍe tato gatvā homaḥ sarvaiḥ prakalpitaḥ
verses.translation: Divakara s son will be the renowned Sahadeva. Brhadasva will become the successor of Sahadeva. Bhanuratha will be his son. His son will be Pratitasva. Suprallta will become the son of Pratitasva. Sahadeva will be his son and his son will be Sunaksatra. Kinnara, the oppressor of his enemies, will become the son of Sunaksatra. Antariksa, the son of Kinnara, will be a great (king).
verses.hindi: कर्सेतदनुरूपं वा पात्र स्तोत्रस्य चाप्ययम्
verses.wordMeaning: Divakara s son will be the renowned Sahadeva. Brhadasva will become the successor of Sahadeva. Bhanuratha will be his son. His son will be Pratitasva. Suprallta will become the son of Pratitasva. Sahadeva will be his son and his son will be Sunaksatra. Kinnara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Divakara s son will be the renowned Sahadeva. Brhadasva will become the successor of Sahadeva. Bhanuratha will be his son. His son will be Pratitasva. Suprallta will become the son of Pratitasva. Sahadeva will be his son and his son will be Sunaksatra. Kinnara,…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीफलैर्बिल्वपत्रैश्च जुहुवुर्जातवेदसम् । गौतमो भृगुर्माण्डव्यो नारदो लोमशस्तथा
verses.transliteration: śrīphalairbilvapatraiśca juhuvurjātavedasam / gautamo bhṛgurmāṇḍavyo nārado lomaśastathā
verses.translation: Suparna will be born of Antariksa and Amitrajit In the family of Sakya, Rahula will be born to Suddhodana (?) Then Prascnajit will be born. Ksudraka will be born then.
verses.hindi: तावूचतुस्तदा सर्वास्तानृषीन्सुतमागधों । आदां देवानूषी श्चेव प्रोणयावः स्वकर्सभिः १४५ न चास्य कर वे विद्वो न तथा लक्षणं यश: स्तोत्न येनास्य कुर्याबो राज्षस्तेजस्विनों द्विजा: ऋषिभिस्तो नियुक्तों तु भविष्यें: स्तुयतामिति । दानधर्मरतो नित्य सत्यवावसं जितेन्द्रिय: ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: Suparna will be born of Antariksa and Amitrajit In the family of Sakya, Rahula will be born to Suddhodana (?) Then Prascnajit will be born. Ksudraka will be born then.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suparna will be born of Antariksa and Amitrajit In the family of Sakya, Rahula will be born to Suddhodana (?) Then Prascnajit will be born. Ksudraka will be born then.

verses.sanskrit: पराशरस्तथा शङ्खः कौशिकश्च्यवनो मुनिः । पिप्पलादो वसिष्ठश्च नाचिकेतो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: parāśarastathā śaṅkhaḥ kauśikaścyavano muniḥ / pippalādo vasiṣṭhaśca nāciketo mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: Ksulika will be the son of Ksudraka. From Ksulika will be born Suratha. Sumitra, the son of Suratha, will be the last king. All these mentioned are the future Iksvaku kings- in the Kali age. They will be'born in the race of Brhadbala in the Kali age. All of them will be heroic, learned and truth¬ ful. They will be the conquerors of the sense-organs. In this connection the following verse describing the subsequent race is cited by those who know the future. "This race of the Iksvakus will end with Sumitra. After coming to the king Sumitra, it will become extinct in the Kali age." Thus the Ksetra (domain?) originating from Manu and descending from Aila has been described.
verses.hindi: यानि कर्माणि कृतवान्प्रथुश्वापि सहाबलः । तानि शीलेन बद्धानि स्तुवद्धिः सुतमागधः १४८
verses.wordMeaning: Ksulika will be the son of Ksudraka. From Ksulika will be born Suratha. Sumitra, the son of Suratha, will be the last king. All these mentioned are the future Iksvaku kings- in the Kali age. They will be'born in the race of Brhadbala in the Kali age. All of them will be heroic,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksulika will be the son of Ksudraka. From Ksulika will be born Suratha. Sumitra, the son of Suratha, will be the last king. All these mentioned are the future Iksvaku kings- in the Kali age. They will be'born in the race of Brhadbala in the Kali age. All of them will be heroic,…

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो ऽप्यगस्त्यश्च उद्दालकयमौ तथा । शाण्डिल्यो जैमिनिः कण्वो याज्ञवल्क्योशनोऽङ्गिराः
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitro 'pyagastyaśca uddālakayamau tathā / śāṇḍilyo jaiminiḥ kaṇvo yājñavalkyośano'ṅgirāḥ
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall mention the kings of Magadha, the descendants of Bfhadratha, i.e. the kings of the race of Jarasandha and the family of Sahadeva. I shall mention the past, present and future kings in accordance with their importance. Even as I recount, listen and understand,
verses.hindi: सो5भिद्गतः प्रजाभिस्तु प्रजाहितचिकीेया द ६१५२ कि राजा की स्तुति करो भौर इसके अनुरूप जो भी कार्य करने पड़ें करो, यह तुम्हारी स्तुति करने के सर्वथा योग्य हैं। ऐसा कहने पर सूत और मागध ने वहाँ समुपस्थित सभी ऋषियों से कहा, हम दोनों अपने-अपने कार्यों से सभी देवताओं और ऋषियों को प्रसन्‍न रखेंगे; ।१४१-१४५। द्विजगण ! किस्तु हम लोग महाराज के कार्यों को कुछ भी नहीं जानते, न इनके लक्षणों का ही हमें ज्ञान है, न उनके यश्ञ के बारे में ही हमको कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth I shall mention the kings of Magadha, the descendants of Bfhadratha, i.e. the kings of the race of Jarasandha and the family of Sahadeva. I shall mention the past, present and future kings in accordance with their importance. Even as I recount, listen and understand,
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth I shall mention the kings of Magadha, the descendants of Bfhadratha, i.e. the kings of the race of Jarasandha and the family of Sahadeva. I shall mention the past, present and future kings in accordance with their importance. Even as I recount, listen and understand,

verses.sanskrit: शातातपो दधीचिश्च कपिलो गालवस्तथा । जैगीषव्यस्तथा दक्षो भरतो मुद्गलस्तथा
verses.transliteration: śātātapo dadhīciśca kapilo gālavastathā / jaigīṣavyastathā dakṣo bharato mudgalastathā
verses.translation: In the Mahabharata war Sahadeva fell. His son Somadhi, the saintly king, ruled over Girivraja. He ruled over the kingdom for fiftyeight years. His son Srutasravas ruled for sixtyfour years. Ayutayu ruled for twentysix years. Niramitra enjoyed the earth for a hundred years and passed over to heaven. Sukrtta ruled over the earth for fiftysix years. Brhat- karman ruled the kingdom for twentythree years.
verses.hindi: मालूम है, जिससे ऐसे तेजस्वी राजा को स्तुति कर सके । ऋषियों ने उनसे कहा कि इसके द्वारा भविष्यत्काल में होनेवाले जो कार्यकलाप हैं, उनका गान करते हुए स्तुति करो । यह राजा नित्य दान तथां धर्म में रत रहनेवाला, सत्यवादी, जितेन्द्रय, शानशील, परम दाता तथा संग्राम भूमि में विजयी होनेवाला हैं । परस- बलवान् इस पृथु ने भूतकाल में जिन कामों को किया है वे सभी शील सदाचार से सम्बद्ध हैं, उभ्हीं का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: In the Mahabharata war Sahadeva fell. His son Somadhi, the saintly king, ruled over Girivraja. He ruled over the kingdom for fiftyeight years. His son Srutasravas ruled for sixtyfour years. Ayutayu ruled for twentysix years.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Mahabharata war Sahadeva fell. His son Somadhi, the saintly king, ruled over Girivraja. He ruled over the kingdom for fiftyeight years. His son Srutasravas ruled for sixtyfour years. Ayutayu ruled for twentysix years.…

verses.sanskrit: वात्स्यायनो महातेजाः संवर्तः शक्तिरेव च । जातूकर्ण्यो भरद्वाजो वालखिल्यारुणिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: vātsyāyano mahātejāḥ saṃvartaḥ śaktireva ca / jātūkarṇyo bharadvājo vālakhilyāruṇistathā
verses.translation: Senajit enjoys the kingdom (now). (His son) Srutan- jaya will be king for forty years. Mahabala, the mighty-armed and endowed with great intellect and exploit, will become king and rule over the earth for thirtyfivc years.
verses.hindi: करते हुए इसकी स्तुति करो । सूत और मागधों ने इस प्रकार राजा ६६ की स्तुति की  स्तुति करने के बाद प्रजेश्वर महाराज प्रथु ने परम प्रसन्‍्त होकर सूत के लिए अनूप (जलतटवर्ती प्रान्त) तथा मागधों को मगध प्रदेश दान किया । तभी से पृथ्वीपति राजाओं की ये सूत तथा मागधगण स्तुति किया करते हैं, और तभी से वे लोग सूतों, मागघों एवं वन्दियों के आशीवादों द्वारा प्रातः काल नींद से जगाये जाते हैं ।(४६-१५०  राजा पृथ् को देखकर परम प्रसस्न महृर्षियों ने प्रजाओं से कहा यह प्रुथु तुम लोगों को वृत्ति देनेवाला है और यही नराधिप होगा ! महर्षियों की ऐसी बाते धुन सारी प्रजाएँ उस महाभाग्यशाली वेनपुत्र पथ की ओर दोड़ पड़ीं और कहने लगीं कि मह॒र्षियों के कथनानुसार तुम हम लोगों की जीविका का प्रबन्ध करो। प्रजाओं के
verses.wordMeaning: Senajit enjoys the kingdom (now). (His son) Srutan- jaya will be king for forty years. Mahabala, the mighty-armed and endowed with great intellect and exploit, will become king and rule over the earth for thirtyfivc years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Senajit enjoys the kingdom (now). (His son) Srutan- jaya will be king for forty years. Mahabala, the mighty-armed and endowed with great intellect and exploit, will become king and rule over the earth for thirtyfivc years.

verses.sanskrit: एवमादिसहस्राणि जुह्वते जातवेदसम् । अक्षमालाकरोत्कीर्णा ध्यानयोगपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: evamādisahasrāṇi juhvate jātavedasam / akṣamālākarotkīrṇā dhyānayogaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Suci will remain in the kingdom for fiftyeight years Ksema will be the king for full twentyeight years. Bhuvata the powerful will maintain the kingdom f 0r sixtyfour years. Then Dharmanetra will be the king for f u n five years. Njpati (?) will then enjoy the kingdom for fifty, eight years. Suvrata's rule will be for thirtyeight years.
verses.hindi: ता प्रथु्धनुरादाय द्रवन्तीमन्‍्वधावत । स लोकान्ब्रह्मलोकादीन्गत्वा वेन्यभयात्तदा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Suci will remain in the kingdom for fiftyeight years Ksema will be the king for full twentyeight years. Bhuvata the powerful will maintain the kingdom f 0r sixtyfour years. Then Dharmanetra will be the king for f u n five years. Njpati (?) will then enjoy the kingdom for fifty,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Suci will remain in the kingdom for fiftyeight years Ksema will be the king for full twentyeight years. Bhuvata the powerful will maintain the kingdom f 0r sixtyfour years. Then Dharmanetra will be the king for f u n five years. Njpati (?) will then enjoy the kingdom for fifty,…

verses.sanskrit: एकचित्ता द्विजाः सर्वे चक्रुर्होमक्रियां तदा । ततः समुत्थितं लिङ्गं मोक्षदं व्याधिनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: ekacittā dvijāḥ sarve cakrurhomakriyāṃ tadā / tataḥ samutthitaṃ liṅgaṃ mokṣadaṃ vyādhināśanam
verses.translation: Drdhasena will be the king for forty, ten and eight (i.e. fiftyeight) years. Then Sumati will be in possession of the kingdom for thirtythree years. Sucala will enjoy the kingdom for twentytwo years Thereafter, Sunetra will enjoy the kingdom for forty years.
verses.hindi: ददर्श चाग्रतो वेन्यं कार्मुकोद्यतधारिणम् १५४ ज्वलस्ट्विशिखर्बाणेदीप्ततेजसमच्युतम् । महायोगं॑ महात्मान दुर्धब समररपि । अलभन्ती तदा त्राणं बेन्यमेबान्वपद्यत । कृताऊजलिपुटा देवी पुज्या लौक॑स्त्रिभि: सदा
verses.wordMeaning: Drdhasena will be the king for forty, ten and eight (i.e. fiftyeight) years. Then Sumati will be in possession of the kingdom for thirtythree years. Sucala will enjoy the kingdom for twentytwo years Thereafter, Sunetra will enjoy the kingdom for forty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drdhasena will be the king for forty, ten and eight (i.e. fiftyeight) years. Then Sumati will be in possession of the kingdom for thirtythree years. Sucala will enjoy the kingdom for twentytwo years Thereafter, Sunetra will enjoy the kingdom for forty years.

verses.transliteration: acchedyaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyāsastutoṣa ca / puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ dadurdevā āśīrvādāndvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Satyajit will enjoy the earth for eightythree years. After attaining the kingdom Virajit will enjoy it for thirtyfive years. Arinjaya will be in possesssion of the earth for fifty years. These thirtytwo kings will be the future rulers in the line of Brhadratha. The rule of Ajaka will be for thirtyone years. His son Vartivardhana will rule for twenty years.
verses.hindi: मयि लोकाः स्थिता राजन्मयेदं धार्यते जगत् । भद॒ते व विनश्येयु: प्रजा: पाथिवसत्तम

verses.translation: His son will attain Girivraja in Varanasi. The suzerainty of Sisunaka (Sisunaga) will be for forty years. His son Sakavarrn* will iulc foi tlnrtysix years. Then for twenty years Ksemavarma will be the king. Ajatasatru will be the king for twentyfive years. Thereafter Ksatraujas will rule the Kingdom for forty years.

verses.translation: King Bimbisara will rule for twentyeight years. King Darsaka will rule for twentyfive years. The next king will be Udayl who will rule for thirty- three years. In the fourth year of his rule, he will build his capital city named Kusumapura (Mod. Patna)'on the southern bank of Ganga. Thus the kings of the Sisunaka (Sisunaga) dynasty will be ten in number. Theyaltogcther willrulefor three hundred andsixtytwo years.

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं व्यासाख्यं प्रोच्यते बुधैः
verses.transliteration: tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vyāsākhyaṃ procyate budhaiḥ
verses.translation: All the members of the Saisunaka (Saisunaga) family will be the contemporaries of the following kings who will be kinsmen to Ksatriyas. Those are twentyfour Iksvaku kings, twentyfive Paricalas, twentyfour Kalakas, twentyfour Haihayas, thirtytwo Kalihgas, twentyfive Sakas, twentysix Kurus, twentyeight Maithilas, twentythree Surasenas and twenty Vltihotras. All these kings will rule simultaneously.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार शौघ्रतापूरवंक दौड़कर अपने समीप आने पर उस बलवान ने उनकी हितकामना से धनुष और बाणों को लेकर वसुधा को अतिशय पीड़ित किया  उसके पीड़न से संत्रस्त होकर पृथ्वी गो का रूप धारण कर बड़े जोरों से भगने लगी। भागती हुई उस गो रूप धारिणी पृथ्वी के पीछे राजा पथु भी धनुष बाण लेकर दौड़े । पृथु के भय से संत्रस्त होकर पृथ्वी ब्रह्मलोक प्रभृति लोकों में घूम भाई तब आगे उद्यत धनुष को धारण किये हुए प्रथु को देखा । उस समय पृथु जलते हुए अति तीक्ष्ण बाणों की चमक से अतिशय तैजोमय हो रहा था । तब अपने त्राण का कोई अन्य उपाय न देख देवताओं से भी पराजित न होने वाले परम योगी, अपने कत्तेब्यपथ से च्युत न होने वाले प्थु की ही शरण में वह गई ।१५२-१५५६४। तीनों लोकों द्वारा सवंथा पूजित पृथ्वी ने अंजलि बाँधकर वेनपुत्र पृथ से कहा, है राजन् ! क्‍या तुम एक स्त्री के वध

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: व्यासतीर्थस्य यत्पुण्यं तत्सर्वं कथयस्व मे । स्नानदानविधानं च यस्मिन्काले महाफलम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: vyāsatīrthasya yatpuṇyaṃ tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me / snānadānavidhānaṃ ca yasminkāle mahāphalam
verses.translation: Mahapadma will be born ofaSudra wife of Maha¬ nandin. He will be a king over all Ksatriyas. Thereafter all the future kings will be born of Sudra wombs. Mahapadma will be the sole ruler with a single royal umbrella. He will rule over the earth for twentyeight years.
verses.hindi: करने में पाप नहों समझ रहे हो ? मेरे बिना तुम प्रजाओं का पालन किस प्रकार कर सकोगे । है राजन ! मुझमें ही समस्त लोक स्थित हैं, मैंने ही समस्त जगत् को धारण क्रिया है। है नृपसत्तम ! मेरे बिना सभी प्रजाएँ विनष्ट हो जायेगी, यदि तुम अपनी प्रजाओं का कल्याण करना चाहते हो तो मुझे मत मारो, मैरी बातें सुनो । उपाय द्वारा आरम्भ किये जाने पर सभी अध्यवसाथ सिद्ध होते हैं, है राजन ! मुझे मारकर भी

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: कथयामि समस्तं ते भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डव । कार्त्तिकस्य सिते पक्षे चतुर्दश्यां जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kathayāmi samastaṃ te bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pāṇḍava / kārttikasya site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: His sons will be thousands. For eight years twelve of them will rule as kings. In succession to Ivlahapadma they will become kings in order. Kautilya will exterminate all of them by means of the twice eight of them (sixteen). After enjoying the kingdom of the earth 1 for a hundred years, the moon in the form of Nanda will set and fall down.
verses.hindi: तुम प्रजाओं के पालन में किसी प्रकार समर्थ नहीं हो सकते ।१५६०१६०। है अतिशय शोभासम्पन्न राजन् ! मैं अन्न रूप में परिणत हो जाऊंगी । तुम अपना क्रोध दूर करो। है पृथ्वीपाल ! ऋषिबण पश्ु. कोट, पतज्भ आदि सैकड़ों तियक योनियों में भी स्त्री के वध का निषेध करते हैं, ऐसा मानकर तुम धर्म से अ्युत न हो । एवं बहुविध वाक्य शुत्वा राजा महाभनाः । क्रोध निगृह्म धर्मात्मा बसुधामिदभब्रवीत् १६२ एकस्यार्थाय यो हन्यादात्मनों वा परस्य वा । एक प्राणं बहुन्वाइपि काम तस्यास्ति पातक्॒॥१६२े यस्मिस्तु निहते भद्दे लभन्‍्ते बहवः सुखम् । तस्मिन्हते शुभि नास्ति पातकं चोषपातकम्
verses.wordMeaning: His sons will be thousands. For eight years twelve of them will rule as kings. In succession to Ivlahapadma they will become kings in order. Kautilya will exterminate all of them by means of the twice eight of them (sixteen).…

verses.sanskrit: उपोष्य यो नरो भक्त्या रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम् । स्नापयेद् ईश्वरं भक्त्या क्षौद्रक्षीरेण सर्पिषा
verses.transliteration: upoṣya yo naro bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram / snāpayed īśvaraṃ bhaktyā kṣaudrakṣīreṇa sarpiṣā
verses.translation: Kautilya will instal Candragupta as king. Kin» Candragupta will be ruling for twentyfour years. Bhadrasara {?), the next king, will be king for twentyfive years. King Asoka will rule over the men for twenty- six years. His son Kunala will rule for eight years. Kunala's son Bandhupalita will enjoy the kingdom for eight years.
verses.hindi: सो5हं प्रजानिमित्त त्वां वधिष्यामि बसुंधरे । यदि मे बचन॑ नाद्य करिष्यसि जगद्धिमू.

verses.sanskrit: दध्ना च खण्डयुक्तेन कुशतोयेन वै पुनः । श्रीखण्डेन सुगन्धेन गुण्ठयेत् परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dadhnā ca khaṇḍayuktena kuśatoyena vai punaḥ / śrīkhaṇḍena sugandhena guṇṭhayet parameśvaram
verses.translation: Bandhupalita's successor Indrapalita will rule for ten years (?) King Devavarma will be king for seven years. King Satadbara, his son, will rule for eight years. King Brhaaasva will be the ruler for seven years.
verses.hindi: सा त्वं वचनमासादय मम धर्मभुतां बरे। संजीवय प्रजा नित्यं शक्ता ह्ासि न संशय: १६७ दृहितृत्वं च मे गच्छ एवमेत॑ मह॒ह् रम् । नियच्छे त्वां तु धर्मार्थ प्रयुक्तं घोरदशने १६८ प्रत्युवाच ततो वेन्यमेवमुक्ता सतो मही। एवमेतदहं राजन्विधास्थासि न संशयः वत्सं तु मम त॑ं यच्छ क्षरेयं गेन वत्सला। समां च कुरु सवंत्र मां त्वं धर्मंभृतां वर॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Bandhupalita's successor Indrapalita will rule for ten years (?) King Devavarma will be king for seven years. King Satadbara, his son, will rule for eight years. King Brhaaasva will be the ruler for seven years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bandhupalita's successor Indrapalita will rule for ten years (?) King Devavarma will be king for seven years. King Satadbara, his son, will rule for eight years. King Brhaaasva will be the ruler for seven years.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुगन्धकुसुमैर्बिल्वपत्रैश्च पूजयेत् । मुचुकुन्देन कुन्देन कुशजातीप्रसूनकैः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sugandhakusumairbilvapatraiśca pūjayet / mucukundena kundena kuśajātīprasūnakaiḥ
verses.translation: These are the nine kings who will enjoy the earth. The earth will be in their possession for full one hundred and thirty seven years. 2 The general Puspamitra will drive out Byhadratha and will rule over the kingdom continuously for sixty years. The sons of Puspamitra will be kings for eight years. The eldest of all of them will be the king for seven years.
verses.hindi: तत उत्सारयामास शिलाजालानि सर्वशः । धनुष्कोटनया ततो वेन्यस्तेन शला विवधिताः
verses.wordMeaning: These are the nine kings who will enjoy the earth. The earth will be in their possession for full one hundred and thirty seven years. 2 The general Puspamitra will drive out Byhadratha and will rule over the kingdom continuously for sixty years.…

verses.sanskrit: इक्षुगडुकदानेन तुष्यते परमेश्वरः । गडुकाष्टकदानेन पातकं यात्यहोर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: ikṣugaḍukadānena tuṣyate parameśvaraḥ / gaḍukāṣṭakadānena pātakaṃ yātyahorjitam
verses.translation: After him the Pulindakas will rule for three years. King Ghosasuta too will rule for three years. Thereafter* Vikramamitra will be king for many years. King Bhagavata will rule for thirtytwo years. His son K$emabhumi will rule for ten years. Ten Tuhga (? Sunga) kings will enjoy the earth.
verses.hindi: पालन कर, तू उनके पालन करने में संशक्त है--इसमें सन्देह नहीं । तू मेरी कत्या बनने को स्वीकार कर ले--- यही महान् वरदान तेरे लिए है। है कठोर दिखाई पड़ने वाली  मैं तुम्हें धर्म कार्यों में नियुक्त करने के लिए ऐसा- कर रहा हूँ । वेनपुत्र पथ के ऐसा कहने पर साध्वी पृथ्वी ने कहा-हैं राजन् : जाप जसा कह रहे हैं में वैसा ही करूंगी--इसमें सन्देह नहीं, मुझे एक बछड़ा दीजिये जिसके वात्सल्य स्नेह से मैं क्षीर-प्रत्रवण
verses.wordMeaning: After him the Pulindakas will rule for three years. King Ghosasuta too will rule for three years. Thereafter* Vikramamitra will be king for many years. King Bhagavata will rule for thirtytwo years. His son K$emabhumi will rule for ten years.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After him the Pulindakas will rule for three years. King Ghosasuta too will rule for three years. Thereafter* Vikramamitra will be king for many years. King Bhagavata will rule for thirtytwo years. His son K$emabhumi will rule for ten years.…

verses.sanskrit: मासर्जितं च नश्येत गडुकाष्टशतेन च । षाण्मासिकं सहस्रेण द्विगुणैर् अब्दिकं तथा
verses.transliteration: māsarjitaṃ ca naśyeta gaḍukāṣṭaśatena ca / ṣāṇmāsikaṃ sahasreṇa dviguṇair abdikaṃ tathā
verses.translation: (Defective verse) They will enjoy the earth for full hundred and twelve years and it perhaps will go to Sudcva who will not be a (born) king but an indulgent fellow ever since his childhood. He will then become a king. There will be another king Dcvabhumi among the Srngas (? Sungas). He will be aKanthayana (Kanvayana— 'Belonging to Kanva gotra') and will rule for nine years.
verses.hindi: कहूँ । है घर्मज्ञों में श्रेष्ठ ! मुझे चारों ओर से बराबर करो, जिससे बहता हुआ मेरा क्षीर चारों ओर समरूप में प्रवाहित हो ।१६७-१७०। तदनन्तर वेनपुत्र राजा पृथु ने अपने धनुष को छोर से पृथ्वी पर फैले हुए पव॑तों को चारों ओर से हटा कद भिन्‍न-भिन्‍न स्थानों में रख दिया, जिससे उन उन स्थानों पर पवतों को न हि पुवबिसर्ग वे विषमे पुथिवीतले । प्रविभाग: पुराणां वा प्राप्ताणां वाषपि विद्यते १७३
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) They will enjoy the earth for full hundred and twelve years and it perhaps will go to Sudcva who will not be a (born) king but an indulgent fellow ever since his childhood. He will then become a king.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) They will enjoy the earth for full hundred and twelve years and it perhaps will go to Sudcva who will not be a (born) king but an indulgent fellow ever since his childhood. He will then become a king.…

verses.sanskrit: आजन्मजनितं पापमयुतेन प्रणश्यति । द्विगुणैर्नश्यते व्याधिस्त्रिगुणैः स्याद्धनागमः
verses.transliteration: ājanmajanitaṃ pāpamayutena praṇaśyati / dviguṇairnaśyate vyādhistriguṇaiḥ syāddhanāgamaḥ
verses.translation: Bhutimitra, his son, will be king for twentyfour years. After him king Narayana will rule for twelve years. His son Susanna will rule for ten years. These four kings of lofty activities will be Kanthayana (Kanvayana) Brahmanas. They will make the vassals bow down to them. They will rule for fortyfive years. After the change of their rule, Andhras will come in.
verses.hindi: समत्व॑ यत्र यत्राइसी द् भूपस्तास्मस्तदेव हि। तत्र तत्र प्रजास्ता ये निवसन्ति स्स स्वदा
verses.wordMeaning: Bhutimitra, his son, will be king for twentyfour years. After him king Narayana will rule for twelve years. His son Susanna will rule for ten years. These four kings of lofty activities will be Kanthayana (Kanvayana) Brahmanas. They will make the vassals bow down to them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhutimitra, his son, will be king for twentyfour years. After him king Narayana will rule for twelve years. His son Susanna will rule for ten years. These four kings of lofty activities will be Kanthayana (Kanvayana) Brahmanas. They will make the vassals bow down to them.…

verses.sanskrit: षड्गुणैर् जायते वाग्मी सिद्धस्तद्द्विगुणैस्तथा । रुद्रत्वं दशलक्षैश्च जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍguṇair jāyate vāgmī siddhastaddviguṇaistathā / rudratvaṃ daśalakṣaiśca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Driving out Kanthayanas (Kanvayanas), over¬ powering Susarman and making the remaining forces of the Srrigas (? Surigas) dwindle down, Sindhuka of the Andhra race will gain possession of the earth. King Sindhuka will rule for twentythree years. After him Bhata (Krsna) will rule for ten and eight years (?)
verses.hindi: वन्यात्प्रभ त लोके5स्मिन्सवंस्येतस्य संभव: १७६ ऋषिभि: स्तूथते बा5पि पुनर्दुग्धा वसुंधरा  वत्सः सोमस्त्वभूत्तेषां दोग्धा चापि बृहस्पति:
verses.wordMeaning: Driving out Kanthayanas (Kanvayanas), over¬ powering Susarman and making the remaining forces of the Srrigas (? Surigas) dwindle down, Sindhuka of the Andhra race will gain possession of the earth. King Sindhuka will rule for twentythree years.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Driving out Kanthayanas (Kanvayanas), over¬ powering Susarman and making the remaining forces of the Srrigas (? Surigas) dwindle down, Sindhuka of the Andhra race will gain possession of the earth. King Sindhuka will rule for twentythree years.…

verses.sanskrit: पौर्णमास्यां नृपश्रेष्ठ स्नानं कुर्वीत भक्तितः । मन्त्रोक्तेन विधानेन सर्वपापक्षयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: paurṇamāsyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha snānaṃ kurvīta bhaktitaḥ / mantroktena vidhānena sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: His son, Srlsatakarni will be very great. Satakarni will rule for fifty and six years, Apadabaddha, his son, will rule (first) for ten years, (then) for twentyfour years and (then) for six years. Nemikrsna will rule for twentyfive years. Then for full one year Hala will be the king.
verses.hindi: पात्रमासीत्तु ब्छगंसि गायश्यादीनि सर्वशः। क्षीरसासीत्तदा तेषां तपो ब्रह्म च शाश्वतभ् .
verses.wordMeaning: His son, Srlsatakarni will be very great. Satakarni will rule for fifty and six years, Apadabaddha, his son, will rule (first) for ten years, (then) for twentyfour years and (then) for six years. Nemikrsna will rule for twentyfive years.…
verses.commentary: Sense: His son, Srlsatakarni will be very great. Satakarni will rule for fifty and six years, Apadabaddha, his son, will rule (first) for ten years, (then) for twentyfour years and (then) for six years. Nemikrsna will rule for twentyfive years.…

verses.sanskrit: वारुणं च तथाग्नेयं ब्राह्मयं चैवाक्षयंकरम् । देवान्पित्ःन् मनुष्यांश्च विधिवत्तर्पयेद्बुधः
verses.transliteration: vāruṇaṃ ca tathāgneyaṃ brāhmayaṃ caivākṣayaṃkaram / devānpitḥn manuṣyāṃśca vidhivattarpayedbudhaḥ
verses.translation: Five (or) seven kings (of this race) will b c very powerful. Putrikascna will rule for twentyfivc years. Satakarni will be king for one year. SivasvamI will rule for twenty eight years.
verses.hindi: ऊंचाई अधिक हो गई । बीते हुए मन्वन्तरों में पृथ्वी अत्यन्त दुर्गेंग तथा स्वाभाविक ढऊू पर कहीं समान, कहीं विषम थी । इस प्रकार के विषम पृथ्बीतल पर पूर्व सृष्टि काल में पुरों और ग्रामों का कोई विभाग नहीं था. न अन्न पंदा होते थे, न पशुपालन, न कृषि अथवा वाणिज्य आदि व्यवसाय ही था। चाक्षुष मन्बन्तर में पृथ्वी की यही दशा थी। वेवस्वत मन्वन्तर में इन सभी कार्यों का प्रचलन हुआ । जहाँ-जहाँ पर पृथ्वी समान रही वहाँ-वहाँ पर प्रजावर्ग आजा आकर अपना निवास बनाकर रहते थे । आहार, फल, मूल आदि थे, बड़ी कठिनाई से उनका जीवन चलता था--ऐसा हमने सुना है । किन्तु पृथु के कार्यकाल से इस पृथ्वी लोक में सभी वस्तुएँ उत्पन्न होने लगीं ।7७१-१७६। पृथ्वी तल से नष्ट होकर लुप्त होने वाली ओबषधियों की बड़ी कठिनाई से उसने पुनः रक्षा की। फिर उस परम ऐश्वयंशाली पृथु ने चाक्षुप मनु को बछंड़ा बनाकर अपने
verses.wordMeaning: Five (or) seven kings (of this race) will b c very powerful. Putrikascna will rule for twentyfivc years. Satakarni will be king for one year. SivasvamI will rule for twenty eight years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Five (or) seven kings (of this race) will b c very powerful. Putrikascna will rule for twentyfivc years. Satakarni will be king for one year. SivasvamI will rule for twenty eight years.

verses.sanskrit: ऋचा ऋग्वेदजं पुण्यं साम्ना सामफलं लभेत् । यजुर्वेदस्य यजुषा गायत्र्या सर्वमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ṛcā ṛgvedajaṃ puṇyaṃ sāmnā sāmaphalaṃ labhet / yajurvedasya yajuṣā gāyatryā sarvamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: King Gautamiputra will rule for twcntyouc years among men. Thereafter Yajhasri of the Satakarni family will be the king for nineteen years. After him, king Vijaya will rule for only six years. DandasrI Satakarni, his son, will for three years. Pulova (Pulumayi) will rule for seven years. There will be other kings as well. Altogether there will be thirty Andhra kings who will enjoy the earth.
verses.hindi: करतल में अन्न राशि को पृथ्वी से दोहन किया  इस प्रकार वेन पून्र राजा पृथु ने गौ रूप घारिणी प्रृथ्वी से चाक्षपष मनु को बछड़ा बना कर पृथ्वी के पान्न में अन्नों का दोहन किया और उसी अन्न से उस समय की सभी प्रजाओं की जीविका चलायी। सुना जाता है कि इसके बाद ऋषियों ने वसुन्धरा का पुनः दोहन किया, उनके समूह के बछड़े चन्द्रमा तथा दुहने वाले बृहस्पति बने थे, दुहने का पात्र गायत्री आदि सभी प्रकार के
verses.wordMeaning: King Gautamiputra will rule for twcntyouc years among men. Thereafter Yajhasri of the Satakarni family will be the king for nineteen years. After him, king Vijaya will rule for only six years. DandasrI Satakarni, his son, will for three years.…
verses.commentary: Sense: King Gautamiputra will rule for twcntyouc years among men. Thereafter Yajhasri of the Satakarni family will be the king for nineteen years. After him, king Vijaya will rule for only six years. DandasrI Satakarni, his son, will for three years.…

verses.sanskrit: अक्षरं च जपेन्मन्त्रं सौरं वा शिवदैवतम् । अथवा वैष्णवं मन्त्रं द्वादशाक्षरसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: akṣaraṃ ca japenmantraṃ sauraṃ vā śivadaivatam / athavā vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ dvādaśākṣarasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: The rule of 'the Andhras will cover a period of four hundred, five and six (four hundred and eleven) years. There will be five families of the Andhras and all of them will be (are) equal (inpower). There will be ten and seven Abhlra kings, seven Gardabhins (Gardabhillas), ten Sakas, eight Yavanas, fourteen Maunas, as kings. Andhras will enjoy the earth for two hundred and one hundred years. Sakas will enjoy the earth for three hundred and eighty years.
verses.hindi: छन्‍्द समूह थे, उन ऋषियों का क्षीर शाइवत ब्रह्म एवं तप था ।(१७७-१५०। तदनन्तर इन्द्र आदि प्रमुख  इदमर्ध तास्ति ख. ग. घ. ड. पुस्तकेष । + इदमर्ध तास्ति क. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: The rule of 'the Andhras will cover a period of four hundred, five and six (four hundred and eleven) years. There will be five families of the Andhras and all of them will be (are) equal (inpower). There will be ten and seven Abhlra kings, seven Gardabhins (Gardabhillas),…
verses.commentary: Sense: The rule of 'the Andhras will cover a period of four hundred, five and six (four hundred and eleven) years. There will be five families of the Andhras and all of them will be (are) equal (inpower). There will be ten and seven Abhlra kings, seven Gardabhins (Gardabhillas),…

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या सर्वलक्षणलक्षितान् । स्वदारनिरतान्विप्रान्दम्भलोभविवर्जितान्
verses.transliteration: pūjayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitān / svadāraniratānviprāndambhalobhavivarjitān
verses.translation: Yavanas will enjoy the earth for eighty years. It is remembered (prophesied) that Tusaras will be in possession of the earth for five hundred years. Thirteen Marunda families will rule for four hundred and fifty years along with (other) Sudras. There will be other Mleccha tribes as well. * Eleven of those Mlecchas will enjoy (the earth) for three hundred years. Then the Sudra tribes (Kilakila) Koli- kilas (?) will rule for an equal period (?)
verses.hindi: पुन: स्तुत्वा देवगणेः पुरंदरपुरोगमैः  सोवर्ण पात्रमादाय अमृतं दुढ़हे तदा ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: Yavanas will enjoy the earth for eighty years. It is remembered (prophesied) that Tusaras will be in possession of the earth for five hundred years. Thirteen Marunda families will rule for four hundred and fifty years along with (other) Sudras.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Yavanas will enjoy the earth for eighty years. It is remembered (prophesied) that Tusaras will be in possession of the earth for five hundred years. Thirteen Marunda families will rule for four hundred and fifty years along with (other) Sudras.…

verses.sanskrit: भिन्नवृत्तिकरान् पापान् पतिताञ्छूद्रसेवनान् । शूद्रीग्रहणसंयुक्तान्वृषली यस्य मन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: bhinnavṛttikarān pāpān patitāñchūdrasevanān / śūdrīgrahaṇasaṃyuktānvṛṣalī yasya mandire
verses.translation: Vindhyasakti will take over the administration from Kolikilas. Having supervised over the administration for ninetysix years, he will pass away. Listen to and understand the future Sudra clans called Disakas (?) Svarapuranjaya will be the son of Sesa, the king of serpents (Vaidisaka—residents of Vidisa?).
verses.hindi: त्तेनेव वर्तयन्ते च देवा इन्द्रपुरोंगमाः नागेश्व स्तुयते दुग्धा विषं क्षीरं तदा मही । तेषां च वासुकिदोंग्धा काद्रवेया महोजसः
verses.wordMeaning: Vindhyasakti will take over the administration from Kolikilas. Having supervised over the administration for ninetysix years, he will pass away. Listen to and understand the future Sudra clans called Disakas (?) Svarapuranjaya will be the son of Sesa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vindhyasakti will take over the administration from Kolikilas. Having supervised over the administration for ninetysix years, he will pass away. Listen to and understand the future Sudra clans called Disakas (?) Svarapuranjaya will be the son of Sesa,…

verses.sanskrit: परोक्षवादिनो दुष्टान्गुरुनिन्दापरायणान् । वेदद्वेषणशीलांश्च हैतुकान् बकवृत्तिकान्
verses.transliteration: parokṣavādino duṣṭāngurunindāparāyaṇān / vedadveṣaṇaśīlāṃśca haitukān bakavṛttikān
verses.translation: That king, born of the race of serpents, will be a king who will enjoy. The following kings: Sadacandra who will be a part of the moon, Nakhavan the second, Dhana- At the close of the rule of Nandana of the Ahgas, Madhunandi will become the king. His younger brother will be Nandiyasas by name. There will be three kings in his family: Dohitra, Sisuka and Pravlra. SiSuka will rule over Purika. The powerful Pravira will be the son of VindhyaSakti, He will rule over the city Kahcanaka (along with the others) for sixty years.
verses.hindi: नागानां वे द्विजश्रेष्ठ सर्पाणां चेव सर्वेश:। तेनेव बतेंयन्त्युग्रा महाकाया महोल्बणा: ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: That king, born of the race of serpents, will be a king who will enjoy. The following kings: Sadacandra who will be a part of the moon, Nakhavan the second, Dhana- At the close of the rule of Nandana of the Ahgas, Madhunandi will become the king.…
verses.commentary: Sense: That king, born of the race of serpents, will be a king who will enjoy. The following kings: Sadacandra who will be a part of the moon, Nakhavan the second, Dhana- At the close of the rule of Nandana of the Ahgas, Madhunandi will become the king.…

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशान्वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धे दाने सर्वव्रतेषु च । गायत्रीसारमात्रो ऽपि वरं विप्रः सुयन्त्रितः
verses.transliteration: īdṛśānvarjayecchrāddhe dāne sarvavrateṣu ca / gāyatrīsāramātro 'pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ
verses.translation: When the family of Vindhyakas becomes extinct, three kings of Bahlikas. will enjoy the kingdom for thirty years. Supratlka and Nabhira (will be the prominent kings). The king named Sakyama will be the ruler of Mahisls. Puspamitras and Pattamitras will rule for thirteen years.
verses.hindi: आमपात्रे पुनर्दुग्धा त्वन्तर्धानमियं मही। वत्स वेश्ववर्ण कृत्वा यज्ञ: पुण्यजनस्तथा राक्षसेश्च पिशाचेश्च पुरुदंग्धा वसुंधरा । ब्रह्मोपेतस्तु दोग्धा वे तेषामासीत्कुबेरकः १८६
verses.wordMeaning: When the family of Vindhyakas becomes extinct, three kings of Bahlikas. will enjoy the kingdom for thirty years. Supratlka and Nabhira (will be the prominent kings). The king named Sakyama will be the ruler of Mahisls. Puspamitras and Pattamitras will rule for thirteen years.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the family of Vindhyakas becomes extinct, three kings of Bahlikas. will enjoy the kingdom for thirty years. Supratlka and Nabhira (will be the prominent kings). The king named Sakyama will be the ruler of Mahisls. Puspamitras and Pattamitras will rule for thirteen years.

verses.sanskrit: नायन्त्रितश्चतुर्वेदी सर्वाशी सर्वविक्रयी । ईदृशान्पूजयेद्विप्रानन्नदानहिरण्यतः
verses.transliteration: nāyantritaścaturvedī sarvāśī sarvavikrayī / īdṛśānpūjayedviprānannadānahiraṇyataḥ
verses.translation: Seven excellent kings will rule over Mckala (Amar- kantaka). The kings in Komala (Comilla, Bengal) will be very strong and powerful. Nine kings of great intellect and well known as Meghas will become the kings of the Nisadha (Marwar, Dc 140) land. They will rule till the end of the Manvantara. Those strong and powerful kings wili be born in the race of Nala. Visvasphani, the powerful, will become the ruler of Magadhas.
verses.hindi: देवगणों ने वसुन्चरा की प्रार्थना कर सुबरणमय पात्र लेकर पृथ्वी से अभ्रृत का दोहन किया, उसी अमृत के भरोसे इन्द्रादि देबगण विद्यमान रहते हैं। नागषों ने स्तुति कर बिष रूप क्षीर पृथ्वी से दृह्द, उनमें दुहने वाले बासुकि थे तथा उनके साथ कद्रू के सभी तेजस्वी पुत्रणण थे। है हिजश्रेष्ठ ! सभी नागों एब सर्पों में परम तेजस्वी, जो विशालकाय भति तीक्ष्ण विष बाले सपंगण हैं, बे उसी विष से बलंमान रहते हैं। उसौ का आहार
verses.wordMeaning: Seven excellent kings will rule over Mckala (Amar- kantaka). The kings in Komala (Comilla, Bengal) will be very strong and powerful. Nine kings of great intellect and well known as Meghas will become the kings of the Nisadha (Marwar, Dc 140) land.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Seven excellent kings will rule over Mckala (Amar- kantaka). The kings in Komala (Comilla, Bengal) will be very strong and powerful. Nine kings of great intellect and well known as Meghas will become the kings of the Nisadha (Marwar, Dc 140) land.…

verses.sanskrit: उपानहौ च वस्त्राणि शय्यां छत्रमथासनम् । यो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणे भक्त्या सो ऽपि स्वर्गे महीयते
verses.transliteration: upānahau ca vastrāṇi śayyāṃ chatramathāsanam / yo dadyādbrāhmaṇe bhaktyā so 'pi svarge mahīyate
verses.translation: After exterminating all the other kings he will make Kaivartas, Pahcakas, Pulindas and Brahmanas as well as the other castes (rule over the kingdom). After propitiating Devas, times that strong king will reach the and cast off his body.
verses.hindi: करते हैं. उसी के अनुरूप आचार क्रते हैं, उसी के भरोसे पराक्रमशाली तथा उसी के भाश्रय में आश्वित्त हैं। तदतन्तर' पुन: पृण्यकर्त्ता यक्षों द्वारा अन्तंधान होकर पृथ्वी का दोहन कच्चे पात्र में किया गया, जिसमें बछड़ा बेश्रवण नामक यक्ष था, दृहनेवाला जतुनाभ था, जो मणिबर नामक यक्ष का पिद्वा था १८१-१८४?। बह यक्षपत्र महान् तेजस्वी जितेन्द्रिय तथा महाबलवान् था। उसी क्षीर द्वारा बे लोग जीविका चलाते हैं। तदनन्तर राक्षसों और पिशान्तों ने बसुन्धरा का पुनः दोहन किया । उनमें दुहने बाला ब्रह्मज्ञानी कुबेरक, बछड़ा सुमाली नामक बलवान् राक्षस तथा क्षीर के स्थान पर रक्त हुआ। राक्षसों ने कपाल में अन्तर्धान होकर प्रथ्वी का दोहन किया था । उसी क्षीर पर आज भी राक्षसगण सब ओर अपनी जीविका निर्वाहित करते हैं ॥!८५-१८७। पितरों ने चाँदी के पात्र में पृथ्वी की स्तुतिकर दोहन किया, उनका अमृत स्वधा हुआ, दृहने वाले अब्रेमा नामक
verses.wordMeaning: After exterminating all the other kings he will make Kaivartas, Pahcakas, Pulindas and Brahmanas as well as the other castes (rule over the kingdom). After propitiating Devas, times that strong king will reach the and cast off his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: After exterminating all the other kings he will make Kaivartas, Pahcakas, Pulindas and Brahmanas as well as the other castes (rule over the kingdom). After propitiating Devas, times that strong king will reach the and cast off his body.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षा सुरभी तत्र जलधेनुस् तथाघृता । तिलधेनुः प्रदातव्या महिष्यश्च तथैव च
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣā surabhī tatra jaladhenus tathāghṛtā / tiladhenuḥ pradātavyā mahiṣyaśca tathaiva ca
verses.translation: After forsaking his body, he will go to Sakra's region. Thereafter, the nine Naka (Naga) kings will enjoy the city of Campavatl. The seven Nagas will enjoy the beautiful city 0 f Mathura. The descendants of Manidhanya will enjoy the terri¬ tories of Nisadha, Yaduka, Saislta and Kalatopaka.
verses.hindi: धनुदिचत्वान्तगंतग्रग्थ: क. ग. घ. इ. पुस्तकेषु नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: After forsaking his body, he will go to Sakra's region. Thereafter, the nine Naka (Naga) kings will enjoy the city of Campavatl. The seven Nagas will enjoy the beautiful city 0 f Mathura. The descendants of Manidhanya will enjoy the terri¬ tories of Nisadha, Yaduka,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After forsaking his body, he will go to Sakra's region. Thereafter, the nine Naka (Naga) kings will enjoy the city of Campavatl. The seven Nagas will enjoy the beautiful city 0 f Mathura. The descendants of Manidhanya will enjoy the terri¬ tories of Nisadha, Yaduka,…

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाजिनप्रदाता यो दाता यस्तिलसर्पिषोः । कन्यापुस्तकयोर्दाता सो ऽक्षयं लोकमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇājinapradātā yo dātā yastilasarpiṣoḥ / kanyāpustakayordātā so 'kṣayaṃ lokamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Devaraksitas (?) will enjoy the territories of Kosalas, Andhras, Paundras and Tamraliptas along with the oceans as well as the beautiful city of Campa. Guha will protect Kalihgas, Mahisas, Mahendra- nilaya and other territories.
verses.hindi: श्रेफ वायुपुराणम् शलेश्च ख्यते दुग्धा पुनर्देवी बसुंधरा। तत्रोषधीम तिमती रत्नानि विविधानि च १९१
verses.wordMeaning: Devaraksitas (?) will enjoy the territories of Kosalas, Andhras, Paundras and Tamraliptas along with the oceans as well as the beautiful city of Campa. Guha will protect Kalihgas, Mahisas, Mahendra- nilaya and other territories.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devaraksitas (?) will enjoy the territories of Kosalas, Andhras, Paundras and Tamraliptas along with the oceans as well as the beautiful city of Campa. Guha will protect Kalihgas, Mahisas, Mahendra- nilaya and other territories.

verses.sanskrit: धूर्वाहौ खुरसंयुक्तौ धान्योपस्करसंयुतौ । दापयेत्स्वर्गकामस्तु इति मे सत्यभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: dhūrvāhau khurasaṃyuktau dhānyopaskarasaṃyutau / dāpayetsvargakāmastu iti me satyabhāṣitam
verses.translation: (The king) named Kanaka will enjoy Strirastra (the women's territory, Kamarupa) and Bhaksyakas. All these kings will be contemporaries. Thereafter, 2 the untruthful and unrighteous Yavanas of great fury and of little grace will rule here spreading their religion, spending vast riches and giving vent to their lust. Those kings will not be duly crowned. They will have all the defects of the (Kali) Age. They will commit evil actions.
verses.hindi: कामधुक्पुष्पित:ः शेलः पक्षों ब॒त्सो यशस्विनी । सर्वकामदुधा दोग्ी पृथिवी भूतभाविनी
verses.wordMeaning: (The king) named Kanaka will enjoy Strirastra (the women's territory, Kamarupa) and Bhaksyakas. All these kings will be contemporaries. Thereafter, 2 the untruthful and unrighteous Yavanas of great fury and of little grace will rule here spreading their religion,…
verses.commentary: Sense: (The king) named Kanaka will enjoy Strirastra (the women's territory, Kamarupa) and Bhaksyakas. All these kings will be contemporaries. Thereafter, 2 the untruthful and unrighteous Yavanas of great fury and of little grace will rule here spreading their religion,…

verses.sanskrit: सूत्रेण वेष्टयेद्द्वीपमथवा जगतीं शुभम् । मन्दिरं परया भक्त्या परमेशमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: sūtreṇa veṣṭayeddvīpamathavā jagatīṃ śubham / mandiraṃ parayā bhaktyā parameśamathāpi vā
verses.translation: During the remaining period of the Kali Age, the kings will enjoy the Earth, not even hesitating to kill women and children and to destroy one another. The races of those kings will gain continuous ascen¬ dancy (at some time or in some places) or flourish and perish in succession in due course.
verses.hindi: सेषा धात्री विधात्रा च बारणी च बसुंधरा। दुग्धा हितार्थ लोकानां पृथुना इति वः श्रुतम् ॥ चराचरस्य लोकस्य प्रतिष्ठा योनिरेव च ११६५ इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते प्रथिवीदोहनं नाम ट्विषश्टितमोअध्याय;
verses.wordMeaning: During the remaining period of the Kali Age, the kings will enjoy the Earth, not even hesitating to kill women and children and to destroy one another.…
verses.commentary: Sense: During the remaining period of the Kali Age, the kings will enjoy the Earth, not even hesitating to kill women and children and to destroy one another.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणां विधानेन यः करोत्यत्र मानवः । जम्बूप्लाक्षाह्वयौ द्वीपौ शाल्मलिश्चापरो नृप
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇāṃ vidhānena yaḥ karotyatra mānavaḥ / jambūplākṣāhvayau dvīpau śālmaliścāparo nṛpa
verses.translation: They will be devoid of piety, true love and real wealth. All the common people coming into close contact with them, They will be acting contrary to accepted traditions. Bd. P. v. 195 reads Sapta for Gupta hereof.
verses.hindi: पितर हुए, बछड़ा यमराज बने । उस स्वधा रूप क्षीर से उन देवताओं की महीने भर की तृप्ति होती है । गन्धवोँ एवं अप्सराओों के समूहों ने कमल के पात्र में चित्ररथ को तथा शुत्रि गधों को बछड़ा बनाकर पृथ्वी का दोहन किया, उनमें मुनि का पुत्र परम पविन्रात्मा, गन्धवंराज, महात्मा सूर्य के समान तेजस्वी विश्वावस् दुहने वाला था । तदनन्तर बसुन्धरा देवी का बोहन पव॑तों ने किया, उस दोहन कायें में मूर्ति-
verses.wordMeaning: They will be devoid of piety, true love and real wealth. All the common people coming into close contact with them, They will be acting contrary to accepted traditions. Bd. P. v. 195 reads Sapta for Gupta hereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will be devoid of piety, true love and real wealth. All the common people coming into close contact with them, They will be acting contrary to accepted traditions. Bd. P. v. 195 reads Sapta for Gupta hereof.

verses.sanskrit: कुशः क्रौञ्चस्तथा काशः पुष्करश्चैव सप्तमः । सप्तसागरपर्यन्ता वेष्टिता तेन भारत
verses.transliteration: kuśaḥ krauñcastathā kāśaḥ puṣkaraścaiva saptamaḥ / saptasāgaraparyantā veṣṭitā tena bhārata
verses.translation: When their turn is over, women will outnumber men in that Age. People will become more and more deficient in learning and stiength. Their span of life will grow less and less. When their decline reaches the limit the ruling kings overwhelmed by Kalawill be ruined. Struck down by Kalki, all the MIecchas will be destroyed. All the heretics and the unrighteous will be doomed.
verses.hindi: मती औषधियां तथा विविध रत्न क्षीर रूप में थे। उन पर्षतों में बछड़ा हिमालय तथा दुहने वाला महागिरि सुमेरु था, दोहन का पात्र तो पर्वत ही था, उन औषधियों से पर्वत की प्रतिष्ठा हुई ।(८८-१६९। तदनन्तर' वक्षों और लताओं ने पलाश के पत्तों को लेकर प्ररोहों के तोड़ देने पर गिरने वाले दुग्ध का दोहन किया, जिसमें दुृहने वाला पुष्पित पवेत तथा वत्स पव॑त का पक्ष हुआ । सभी मनोरथों को पूर्ण रखनेवाली, भूतभाविनी ( जीव समूहों को उत्पन्न करनेवाली ) यशस्विनी वसुन्धरा सब को धारण करनेवाली, पालन करनेवाली तथा सभी प्रकार का विधान करनेवाली है, उस प्रथ्वी का दोहन लोकहित के लिए राजा पृथु ने किया--ऐसा हमने सूना है। वह प्रृथ्वी सभी चराचर जीवों की आश्रयभूत तथा उत्पन्न करने वाली
verses.wordMeaning: When their turn is over, women will outnumber men in that Age. People will become more and more deficient in learning and stiength. Their span of life will grow less and less. When their decline reaches the limit the ruling kings overwhelmed by Kalawill be ruined.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When their turn is over, women will outnumber men in that Age. People will become more and more deficient in learning and stiength. Their span of life will grow less and less. When their decline reaches the limit the ruling kings overwhelmed by Kalawill be ruined.…

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपेश्वरे महाराज वृषोत्सर्गं च कारयेत् । वृषेणारुणवर्णेन माहेशं लोकमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: dvīpeśvare mahārāja vṛṣotsargaṃ ca kārayet / vṛṣeṇāruṇavarṇena māheśaṃ lokamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: The very name king will disappear when the Kali Age comes to the period of junction. Only very few people will survive and they will be helpless and destitute without any belonging, as Dharma would have been destroyed by that time. There will be none to console them. They will have no where¬ withals. They will be afflicted by diseases and sorrows. They will be overwhelmed and ruined by drought and mutual slaughter. They will have none to support them. Being distressed (and due to fear) they will forsake their avocations and professions. Deserting their own villages and towns they will resort to forest. When the kings are destroyed, the subjects will leave off their homesteads. All the feelings of friendliness and affection will be lost. In acute distress, even the closest of friends will become bereft of affection. The discipline of castes and stages of life will become distrubed. Terrible mixture and mingling of the castes will result. People will take shelter on mountains and riverbanks. They will resort to rivers, marshy foreshores of the seas and mountains. They will gather together in the terri¬ tories of Angas, Vangas, Kalingas, Kasmiras, KasI, Kosalas, the mountain ravines of Rsika and other places. Men will seek shelter on the ridges of Himavan and the coasts of the briny sea.
verses.hindi: श्री वायुमह्ापुराण का पृथ्वीदोहय नामक बासठवाँ अध्याय समाप्त
verses.wordMeaning: The very name king will disappear when the Kali Age comes to the period of junction. Only very few people will survive and they will be helpless and destitute without any belonging, as Dharma would have been destroyed by that time. There will be none to console them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The very name king will disappear when the Kali Age comes to the period of junction. Only very few people will survive and they will be helpless and destitute without any belonging, as Dharma would have been destroyed by that time. There will be none to console them.…

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु वै पाण्डुरो वक्त्रे ललाटे पादयोस्तथा । लाङ्गूले यस्तु वै शुभ्रः स वै नाकस्य दर्शकः
verses.transliteration: yastu vai pāṇḍuro vaktre lalāṭe pādayostathā / lāṅgūle yastu vai śubhraḥ sa vai nākasya darśakaḥ
verses.translation: The Aryas will flock to the forests with the Mleccha tribes. Men will sustain themselves with the meat of deer, fishes, birds and beasts of prey as well as with sugar-cane plants, Like the sages (of yore) they will wear different kinds
verses.hindi: प्ठशु बचा च्तुव्की स्व न्‍्वम्त् आसोदियं समुद्रान्ता सेदिनीति परिश्रुता । वसु धारयते यस्माइसुधा तेन चोच्यते सधुकेटभयोः पूर्व मेदसा संपरिप्लुता । ततोड्स्युपगसाद्राज्ञः पृथोवेनस्य धीमतः
verses.wordMeaning: The Aryas will flock to the forests with the Mleccha tribes. Men will sustain themselves with the meat of deer, fishes, birds and beasts of prey as well as with sugar-cane plants, Like the sages (of yore) they will wear different kinds
verses.commentary: Sense: The Aryas will flock to the forests with the Mleccha tribes. Men will sustain themselves with the meat of deer, fishes, birds and beasts of prey as well as with sugar-cane plants, Like the sages (of yore) they will wear different kinds

verses.sanskrit: नीलो ऽयमीदृशः प्रोक्तो यस्तु द्वीपेश्वरे त्यजेत् । स समाः रोमसंख्याता नाके वसति भारत
verses.transliteration: nīlo 'yamīdṛśaḥ prokto yastu dvīpeśvare tyajet / sa samāḥ romasaṃkhyātā nāke vasati bhārata
verses.translation: Desirous of growing foodstuffs (grains) through seeds, they will dig the earth deep with wooden pikes. They will strenuously rear goats and sheep, donkeys and camels. The men then will resort to the banks of rivers for the sake of water. By means of their activities they will harass one another as well as the rulers of the land. They will consider it honourable to be issueless. They
verses.hindi: प्रथिता प्रविभक्ता च शोभिता वर वसंघरा। सस्याक्रवती राज्ञा पत्तनाकरमालिनी ॥ चातुर्वेण्यंसमाकीर्णा रक्षिता तेन धीमता
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of growing foodstuffs (grains) through seeds, they will dig the earth deep with wooden pikes. They will strenuously rear goats and sheep, donkeys and camels. The men then will resort to the banks of rivers for the sake of water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of growing foodstuffs (grains) through seeds, they will dig the earth deep with wooden pikes. They will strenuously rear goats and sheep, donkeys and camels. The men then will resort to the banks of rivers for the sake of water.…

verses.sanskrit: सौरं च शांकरं लोकं वैरञ्चं वैष्णवं क्रमात् । भुनक्ति स्वेच्छया राजन्व्यासतीर्थप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: sauraṃ ca śāṃkaraṃ lokaṃ vairañcaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ kramāt / bhunakti svecchayā rājanvyāsatīrthaprabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: The subjects will follow the worst of religious obser¬ vances. No one will live beyond their twentythird year. They will be weak. They will be debilitated and fatigued due to sensuality. They will be overcome by (prema lure) old age. Their diet will consist of leaves, roots and fruits. Bark garments and deer skins will constitute their clothings. In search of livelihood they will be roaming over the earth. Towards the end of Kaliyuga, the people will come to such a plight.
verses.hindi: एवं प्रभावों राजा55सीद्वैन्यः स नृपसत्तमः । नमस्यश्चेव प्ज्यश्र भृतग्रामेण सर्वेशः ब्राह्मणेश्व महाभागेवेंदवेदाइंगपा रगेः । पृथुरेव नमस्कार्यो ब्रह्मययोनि: सनातनः
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects will follow the worst of religious obser¬ vances. No one will live beyond their twentythird year. They will be weak. They will be debilitated and fatigued due to sensuality. They will be overcome by (prema lure) old age. Their diet will consist of leaves,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects will follow the worst of religious obser¬ vances. No one will live beyond their twentythird year. They will be weak. They will be debilitated and fatigued due to sensuality. They will be overcome by (prema lure) old age. Their diet will consist of leaves,…

verses.sanskrit: सपत्नीकं ततो विप्रं पूजयेत् तत्र भक्तितः । सितरक्तानि वस्त्राणि यो दद्याद् अग्रजन्मने
verses.transliteration: sapatnīkaṃ tato vipraṃ pūjayet tatra bhaktitaḥ / sitaraktāni vastrāṇi yo dadyād agrajanmane
verses.translation: When the Kali Age, the duration of which is a thousand divine years, comes to a close, the subjects will be annihilated along with the Kaliyuga. When it expires along with the period of junction, the Krta Age will come in. When the moon, the sun, Tisya and Jupiter come together in a single sign of zodiac, the Krta Age will set in. Thus the past, present and the future races have been enumerated in due order.
verses.hindi: पाथिवैश्व महाभागेः प्रार्थयदड्ूम ह्यशः । आदिराजा नससस्‍्काये: पृथुर्वेन्यः प्रतापवान्
verses.wordMeaning: When the Kali Age, the duration of which is a thousand divine years, comes to a close, the subjects will be annihilated along with the Kaliyuga. When it expires along with the period of junction, the Krta Age will come in. When the moon, the sun,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Kali Age, the duration of which is a thousand divine years, comes to a close, the subjects will be annihilated along with the Kaliyuga. When it expires along with the period of junction, the Krta Age will come in. When the moon, the sun,…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं युग्मं प्रीयतां मे जगद्गुरुः । नास्ति विप्रसमो बन्धुरिह लोके परत्र च
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ yugmaṃ prīyatāṃ me jagadguruḥ / nāsti viprasamo bandhuriha loke paratra ca
verses.translation: From the time of the coronation of Mahadeva* (Mahapadma?) to the birth of Parlksit the duration was a thousand and fifty years. The period between Mahapadma and the future kings ending with Andhras whom I have narrated, has been calculated as eight hundred and thirtysix years by the learned sages, the knowers of Puranas. The stellar mansions are altogerher twentyseven. The Seven Sages stay in each of these, for hundred years in succession. This is remembered as the Yugaof the Seven Sages. The years are calculated according to those of the Devas.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--यह समुद्र पर्यन्‍्त फैली हुई बसुन्धरा मेदिनी ( मेद--चंर्बी से उत्पन्न होने वाली ) इस नाम से विख्यात है । एवं बसु धन अथवा अन्न धारण करने के कारण यह वसुधा नाम से भी पुकारी जाती है ।१। पूवंकाल में यह मधु तथा वीटभ नामक दालवों की चर्बी से जाकीर्ण थी। यही कारण है कि समुद्र पयेल्त फंली हुई यह पृथ्वी मेदिनी नाम से विख्यात हुई। राजा प्रभु की पुत्री होने के कारण उसे पृथ्वी नाम से भी लोग पुकारते हैं। उस परम बुद्धिमानू राजा द्वारा वह वसुन्धरा प्रसिद्ध की गई, अनेक भागों में विभक्त की गई, शोभित की गई, विविध प्रकार के अन्नों और आकरों (खनि) से समन्वित की गई, बड़े-बड़े नगर-समूहों से संयुक्त की गई, ब्राह्मणादि चारों बर्णों के लोगों से भाकीणं की गई तथा रक्षित हुई ।२-४। राजाओं में श्रेष्ठ, वेन पुत्न॒ राजा प्रृथु इस प्रकार का अमित प्रभाव शाली सम्राट था। सभी जीव
verses.wordMeaning: From the time of the coronation of Mahadeva* (Mahapadma?) to the birth of Parlksit the duration was a thousand and fifty years. The period between Mahapadma and the future kings ending with Andhras whom I have narrated,…
verses.commentary: Sense: From the time of the coronation of Mahadeva* (Mahapadma?) to the birth of Parlksit the duration was a thousand and fifty years. The period between Mahapadma and the future kings ending with Andhras whom I have narrated,…

verses.sanskrit: यमलोके महाघोरे पतन्तं यो ऽभिरक्षति । इतिहासपुराणज्ञं विष्णुभक्तं जितेन्द्रियम्
verses.transliteration: yamaloke mahāghore patantaṃ yo 'bhirakṣati / itihāsapurāṇajñaṃ viṣṇubhaktaṃ jitendriyam
verses.translation: (Defective verse) The hundred years of the Seven Sages are equal to sixty divine years and seven (divine) days. (?) The Seven Sages are seen in the east at first and then in the north of the zone of the constellations. Thereafter they arc seen parallel to those constellations seen in the middle of the firmament. It should be known that the Seven Sages are united with it (the zone of the constellations) in the sky for a hundred years. This is the evidence of the union of the Sages and the constellations.
verses.hindi: समूह उसे नमस्कार करते थे, पूजा करते थे। वेद्दों एवं बेदाज्ों के पारगामी विद्वानू एवं महाभाग्यशाली ब्राह्मणों द्वारा नमस्कार करने योग्य एकमात्र राजा पृथु ही था क्योंकि बह ब्रह्म से समुदभृत था, तथा उसका प्रभाव कभी नष्ट होने वाला नहीं था । उस प्रतापश्ाली आदि राजा वेन पुत्र पृथु की परमभाग्यशालरी
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) The hundred years of the Seven Sages are equal to sixty divine years and seven (divine) days. (?) The Seven Sages are seen in the east at first and then in the north of the zone of the constellations.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) The hundred years of the Seven Sages are equal to sixty divine years and seven (divine) days. (?) The Seven Sages are seen in the east at first and then in the north of the zone of the constellations.…

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या सामगं वा विशेषतः । द्वीपेश्वरं च ये भक्त्या संस्मरन्ति गृहे स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: pūjayetparayā bhaktyā sāmagaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ / dvīpeśvaraṃ ca ye bhaktyā saṃsmaranti gṛhe sthitāḥ
verses.translation: In my opinion the Seven Sages were stationed in the Magha (tenth) constellation at the time of Parlksit. At the time of Andhras they will be in the twentyfourth constellation (i.e. Satabhisak).* At that time the subjects will be afflicted very much. They will be doomed through their mendacious nature in the affairs of virtue, wealth and love.
verses.hindi: योधरपि च सहस्रासे प्रार्थथाने्जयं युधि । आदिकर्ता नराणां वे नमस्यः प्रथरेव हि ८ यो हि योद्धा रणं याति कीत॑7 त्वा पृथुं नृपम् । स घोररूपे सह्ग्रामे क्षेमी तरति कीतिमान ॥ वेश्यरपि च राजधिवेश्यवृत्तिसमास्थिते: । पृथुरेव नमस्कार्यों वृत्तिदाता महायशा: १० ब्रह्मणा प्रथम दुग्धा पुरा पृथ्वी महात्मना। बायुं कृत्वा तदा वत्सं बीजानि वसुधातले १२
verses.wordMeaning: In my opinion the Seven Sages were stationed in the Magha (tenth) constellation at the time of Parlksit. At the time of Andhras they will be in the twentyfourth constellation (i.e. Satabhisak).* At that time the subjects will be afflicted very much.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In my opinion the Seven Sages were stationed in the Magha (tenth) constellation at the time of Parlksit. At the time of Andhras they will be in the twentyfourth constellation (i.e. Satabhisak).* At that time the subjects will be afflicted very much.…

verses.sanskrit: न तेषां जायते शोको न हानिर्न च दुष्कृतम् । प्रथमं पूजयेत् तत्र लिङ्गं सिद्धेश्वरं ततः
verses.transliteration: na teṣāṃ jāyate śoko na hānirna ca duṣkṛtam / prathamaṃ pūjayet tatra liṅgaṃ siddheśvaraṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: When the Vedic and Smarta (pertaining to the Smrtis) rituals (Dharma) become lax and the rigorous discip¬ line of the castes and the stages of life becomes very loose, the deluded subjects will be weak in their soul-power and undergo a mixing and mingling of the castes. Desirous of securing means of livelihood, Brah¬ manas will approach them reverentially. Declining gradually and bit by bit, all the subjects will be destroyed and when the Yuga expires, they will be completely destroyed. According to divine calculation it is one thousand years. The Sandhyamsa (the period of junction) is also men¬ tioned. (That period is extra.) When it has expired completely Krta Age comes in.
verses.hindi: उत्तमेध्नुत्तमेनापि दुग्धा देवभुजेन तु। मनु क्रृत्वोत्तमं वत्सं सवंसस्थानि धीमता
verses.wordMeaning: When the Vedic and Smarta (pertaining to the Smrtis) rituals (Dharma) become lax and the rigorous discip¬ line of the castes and the stages of life becomes very loose, the deluded subjects will be weak in their soul-power and undergo a mixing and mingling of the castes.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Vedic and Smarta (pertaining to the Smrtis) rituals (Dharma) become lax and the rigorous discip¬ line of the castes and the stages of life becomes very loose, the deluded subjects will be weak in their soul-power and undergo a mixing and mingling of the castes.…

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सिद्धो महाभागो व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः । अस्यैव पूजनात्सिद्धो धारासर्पो महामतिः
verses.transliteration: yatra siddho mahābhāgo vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / asyaiva pūjanātsiddho dhārāsarpo mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: The races of Aila and Iksvaku are said to become extinct with Sumitra. Those who know about the Lunar race know that the Ksatriya race of Aila will become extinct with Ksemaka. The sons and descendants of the Sun of the past, present and future have been glorified. They were and will be the heighte- ners of their fame. In that race there were Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras.
verses.hindi: पुनश्च पन्चसे पृथ्वी तामसस्यान्तरे मनोः। दुग्धेयं तामसं वत्सं कृत्वा तु बलबन्धुना १६ चारिष्णवस्थ देवस्य संप्राप्ते चास्तरे मनो: । दुग्धा मही पुराणेन दत्सं चारिष्णवं प्रति १७ चाक्षुषेषपि च संप्राप्ते तदा सन्वन्तरे पुनः । दुग्धा मही पुराणेन वत्सं कृत्वा तु चाक्षषम् १८ नृपसमृहों द्वारा प्राथंना की जाती थी। वास्तव में बह सर्वथा नमस्कार के योग्य था। संग्राम भूमि में उस महाराज प्रथू को विजय की प्राथंना बड़े-बड़े योद्धा लोग करते थे और वह वास्तव में विजय प्राप्त करता था, मनुष्यों का सर्वप्रथम पालक वह प्रथ् ही नमस्कार का पात्र था। जो बीर पुरुष राजा पृथ् के यञों का कीत॑न कर रणभूमि को जाता है वह कल्याण भाजन यशस्वी योद्धा विकट संग्राम में भी विजय लाभ करता
verses.wordMeaning: The races of Aila and Iksvaku are said to become extinct with Sumitra. Those who know about the Lunar race know that the Ksatriya race of Aila will become extinct with Ksemaka. The sons and descendants of the Sun of the past, present and future have been glorified.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The races of Aila and Iksvaku are said to become extinct with Sumitra. Those who know about the Lunar race know that the Ksatriya race of Aila will become extinct with Ksemaka. The sons and descendants of the Sun of the past, present and future have been glorified.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो राजन्प्राणत्यागं करोति च । सूर्यलोकमसौ भित्त्वा प्रयाति शिवसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanprāṇatyāgaṃ karoti ca / sūryalokamasau bhittvā prayāti śivasannidhau
verses.translation: Many noblc-souled kings are born and have pass¬ ed away in every Yuga. Their names are legion. When the members of every family are calculated, many names are re¬ peated. Hence they have not been mentioned by me. The race of Nimi comes to an end in the Vaivasvata Manvantara itself. I will recount how the Ksatriya race originates in this Yuga. Even as I recount listen and understand. Devapi will be born in the Kalapa village. He will be a king of Puru's family and considered (greater) than Iksvaku. He will be endowed with great Yogic power.*
verses.hindi: है ।५-६। वेश्य वृत्ति (व्यापार) करने वालों का भी वह महायदास्वी राजधि प्ृथ् नमस्कार का पात्र था, क्योंकि उन्हें भो वह वृत्ति देता था। पए्रथ्वी दोहन. के समय ऊपर कहे गये बड़े, दुहने वाले, दुग्ध, पात्रादि सभी का वर्णन मैं क्रमशः सुना चुका ।१०-११। प्राचीन काल में सर्वप्रथम भगवान् ब्रह्मा ने पृथ्वी का दोहन किया था, उस समय वायु को बछड़ा बनाकर पृथ्वी तल पर बीजों को दुह्ा गया था। उसके बाद पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: Many noblc-souled kings are born and have pass¬ ed away in every Yuga. Their names are legion. When the members of every family are calculated, many names are re¬ peated. Hence they have not been mentioned by me.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Many noblc-souled kings are born and have pass¬ ed away in every Yuga. Their names are legion. When the members of every family are calculated, many names are re¬ peated. Hence they have not been mentioned by me.…

verses.sanskrit: समाः सहस्राणि च सप्त वै जले दशैकमग्नौ पतने च षोडश । महाहवे षष्टिरशीति गोग्रहे ह्यनाशके भारत चाक्षया गतिः
verses.transliteration: samāḥ sahasrāṇi ca sapta vai jale daśaikamagnau patane ca ṣoḍaśa / mahāhave ṣaṣṭiraśīti gograhe hyanāśake bhārata cākṣayā gatiḥ
verses.translation: In the twentieth Yuga (? cycle of four Yugas?) there will not be any founder of the Lunar race. Devapi being un¬ rivalled, will be the first king in the family of Aila. In the four Yugas these two will be the founders of Ksatriya race. Everywhere this should be known as the characteristic feature, for the sake of progeny (the perpetuation of the line).
verses.hindi: स्वायम्भुव मनु को बछड़ा बनाकर आग्नीध्र ने पृथ्वी का दोहन किया था । तदनम्तर स्वारोचिष मन्वन्तर में परम बुद्धिमान चंत्र ने स्वारोचिष मनु को बछुड़ा बनाकर अन्‍्नों का दोहन किया था। उत्तम मन्वन्तर में परम बुद्धिमान् सर्वश्रेष्ठ देवभुज ने उत्तम मनु को बछड़ा बनाकर सभी प्रकार के अन्‍्नों का दोहन किया था ।१२-१४। पुनः पाँचबं तामस नामक मन्‍्वन्तर में बलबन्धु से तामस मनु को बछड़ा बनाकर यह पृथ्वी दुही गई थी। तदनन्तर पृन्रः चरिष्णव नामक मन्वन्तर में भी पुराण ने चारिष्णब को बछड़ा बन।कर धेथ्वी का दोहन किया। पुनः चाक्षुप नामक मन्‍्वस्तर में भी पुराण ने चाक्षुप मनु को बछड़ा कर पृथ्वी का
verses.wordMeaning: In the twentieth Yuga (? cycle of four Yugas?) there will not be any founder of the Lunar race. Devapi being un¬ rivalled, will be the first king in the family of Aila. In the four Yugas these two will be the founders of Ksatriya race.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twentieth Yuga (? cycle of four Yugas?) there will not be any founder of the Lunar race. Devapi being un¬ rivalled, will be the first king in the family of Aila. In the four Yugas these two will be the founders of Ksatriya race.…

verses.sanskrit: पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः । वायुभूतं निरीक्षन्ते ह्यागच्छन्तं स्वगोत्रजम्
verses.transliteration: pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ / vāyubhūtaṃ nirīkṣante hyāgacchantaṃ svagotrajam
verses.translation: When Kali Yuga declines and Krta Yuga sets in and again in the first Tretayuga they will be the acti- visors of the Ksatriya lines along with the Seven Sages. In the Dvapara period, Ksatriyas do not stay along with the sages. When Krtayuga and Tretayuga decline, the Seven Sages and the kings will take birth for the sake of seed of the Brahmana and Ksatriya races. For the sake of progeny, they (the Seven Sages) abide by the kings in all the Manvantaras in every Yuga. The annihilation of Ksatriyas leads to their contact with Brahmanas again (?) In all the seven Manvantaras all the progeny have been heard of (?)
verses.hindi: अधनुश्चिज्ञास्तर्गतग्रन्थो ड, पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: When Kali Yuga declines and Krta Yuga sets in and again in the first Tretayuga they will be the acti- visors of the Ksatriya lines along with the Seven Sages. In the Dvapara period, Ksatriyas do not stay along with the sages. When Krtayuga and Tretayuga decline,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When Kali Yuga declines and Krta Yuga sets in and again in the first Tretayuga they will be the acti- visors of the Ksatriya lines along with the Seven Sages. In the Dvapara period, Ksatriyas do not stay along with the sages. When Krtayuga and Tretayuga decline,…

verses.sanskrit: अस्मद्गोत्रे ऽस्ति कः पुत्रो यो नो दद्यात् तिलोदकम् । कार्त्तिक्यां च विशेषेण वेशाख्यां वा तथैव च
verses.transliteration: asmadgotre 'sti kaḥ putro yo no dadyāt tilodakam / kārttikyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa veśākhyāṃ vā tathaiva ca
verses.translation: In view of their long life the Seven Sages know the series of Yugas, the origin, activities and the decline of those active persons belonging to Brahmana and Ksatriya races. The birth of the Brahmanas in the families of Aila and Ik$vaku is in this manner (?) Born in the Treta Age and extinct in the Kali Age, they will follow the Age till the end of the Manvan- tara. When all the Ksatriyas were eliminated by Rama, the son of Jamadagni, the Ksatriyas of the two families were born again. I shall recount them. Listen and understand.
