verses.hindi: चाक्षुषस्पान्तरे5तीते प्राप्ते वेबस्वते पुनः । वन्येनेयं मही दुग्धा यथा ते कीतितं मया ३१६ एतदुंग्धा पुरा पृथ्वी व्यतोतेष्बन्तरेषु वे । देवादिभिमंनुष्य श्व तथा भुतादिभिश्च यः (२० ( + एवं सर्वेषु विज्ञेया ह्मतीतानागतेष्विह । देवा मन्वन्तरेष्वस्य प्रथोस्तु शुणुत प्रजा: १२१ पृथोस्तु पुत्रों बिक्रान्तो जज्ञातेडन्तधिपालिनों । शिखण्डिनी ह॒विर्धानमन्तधानादुष्यजायत प्राचीनबहिभंगवान्महानासोीत्प्रजापति: । बलश्रुततपोबी में : पृथिव्यामेक राडसौ ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: In view of their long life the Seven Sages know the series of Yugas, the origin, activities and the decline of those active persons belonging to Brahmana and Ksatriya races.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In view of their long life the Seven Sages know the series of Yugas, the origin, activities and the decline of those active persons belonging to Brahmana and Ksatriya races.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गतिं च प्रयास्यामस्तत्र तीर्थोपसेवनात् । एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं द्वीपेश्वरम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: svargatiṃ ca prayāsyāmastatra tīrthopasevanāt / etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dvīpeśvaram anuttamam
verses.translation: The families of Aila and Iksvaku spread once again. A series of other kings of the Ksatriya race became rulers. A hundred families undergoing coronation became famous among each of the races of Aila and Iksvaku. The extent of Bhojas is up to twice of that (i.e. two hundred). Thus there were three hundred Ksatriya
verses.hindi: दोहन किया। चाक्षुष नामक मन्वन्तर के बीत जाने पर जब पुनः वैवस्वत नामक मन्वन्तर प्रारम्भ हुआ तब वेन पुत्र राजा प्रथु ने जिस प्रकार इस पृथ्वी का दोहन किथा था, उसका वर्णन मैं कर चुका
verses.wordMeaning: The families of Aila and Iksvaku spread once again. A series of other kings of the Ksatriya race became rulers. A hundred families undergoing coronation became famous among each of the races of Aila and Iksvaku. The extent of Bhojas is up to twice of that (i.e. two hundred).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The families of Aila and Iksvaku spread once again. A series of other kings of the Ksatriya race became rulers. A hundred families undergoing coronation became famous among each of the races of Aila and Iksvaku. The extent of Bhojas is up to twice of that (i.e. two hundred).…

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेत्परया भक्त्या शृणुयात्तद्गतो नृप । सो ऽपि पापविनिर्मुक्तो मोदते शिवमन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhetparayā bhaktyā śṛṇuyāttadgato nṛpa / so 'pi pāpavinirmukto modate śivamandire
verses.translation: Listen and understand even as I recount the past and the present kings among them. Prativindhyas were a hundred; Nagas were a hundred; Hayas were a hundred; Dhrtarastras were a hundred and one; Janamejayas were eighty; Brahmadattas were a hundred; Sirins and Virins were a hundred (each); then Pulomans were a hundred; Svetas, Kagas, Kusas etc. were a hundred; the other Sasabindus who passed away were a thousand. All of them performed horse-sacrifices with lakhs and lakhs in Daksina. Thus hundreds and thousands of saintly kings have passed away.
verses.hindi: बीते हुए मन्वन्तरों में इन्हीं उपर्युक्त देवताओं, मनुष्यों तथा भूतादि ने प्रथ्वी का दोहन किया था । व्यतीत एवं भविष्यत्कालीन मन्वन्तरों में इसी प्रकार उन्हीं देवताओं को जान लेना चाहिए. जिनका वर्णन मैं कर चुका । अब इस राजा पृथ् की प्रजाओं के विषय में मुझसे सुनिये । उस राजा पृथु के अध्तधि और पाली नामक्र दो महान बलशाली पुत्र हुए। जिनमें अन्तर्धान से शिखण्डिनी ने ह॒विर्धान नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न किया आग्नेयी घिषणा ने हविर्धान के संयोग से प्राचीनबहिस, शुक्र, गय, कृष्ण, त्रज और अजिन नामक छ पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया । परम ऐश्वयंशाली प्राचीनबहिस एक महान् प्रजापति था वह अपने बल, शास्त्र ज्ञान, तपस्या और पराक्रम से समस्त पृथ्वीमण्डल का एकच्छ॒त्र सम्राट था। यज्ञादि कार्यों में उसके कुशों के अग्न भाग पूराने पड़ जाते थे अतः प्राचीनबहिस् नाम से वह प्रसिद्ध हुआ। महान अज्ञानान्थकार से पार हो
verses.wordMeaning: Listen and understand even as I recount the past and the present kings among them. Prativindhyas were a hundred; Nagas were a hundred; Hayas were a hundred; Dhrtarastras were a hundred and one; Janamejayas were eighty; Brahmadattas were a hundred;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen and understand even as I recount the past and the present kings among them. Prativindhyas were a hundred; Nagas were a hundred; Hayas were a hundred; Dhrtarastras were a hundred and one; Janamejayas were eighty; Brahmadattas were a hundred;…

verses.sanskrit: ऊषरं सर्वतीर्थानां निर्मितं मुनिपुंगवैः । कामप्रदं नृपश्रेष्ठ व्यासतीर्थं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ūṣaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ nirmitaṃ munipuṃgavaiḥ / kāmapradaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha vyāsatīrthaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Know that the descendants in this world of the present Vaivasvata Manu cannot be mentioned in detail and in full even in hundreds of years. In the Vaivasvata Manvantara already twentyeight cycles of four Yugas have passed along with their saintly kings. Listen and understand those who yet remain. Forty excellent kings will be born in the future. Then the Vaivasvata Manvantara will come to a close. Inciden¬ tally I have mentioned everything in detail and in brief. Many are repeated. As they are too many they could not be mention¬ ed in full. The twentyfive families of Yayati's sons were highly beneficent to the people. They have been glorified. They even now sustain the worlds.
verses.hindi: जाने पर उस प्रजापति एवं सम्राट् ने समुद्र-पृत्री सवर्णा से विवाह संस्कार किया। समुद्र-कन्या सवर्णा ने उसके संयोग से दस पत्रों को जन्म दिया जो सबके सब प्रचेता के नाम से विख्यात होकर धनुवेंद में पारंगत थे । एक ही प्रकार के धर्माचरण करने वाले उन प्रचेताओं ने दस सहस्न वर्षों तक समुद्र के जल में शयन कर परम कठोर तप किया । २३-२६। जिस समय प्रचेता गण तप कर रहे थे उस समय बिना रखवाली
verses.wordMeaning: Know that the descendants in this world of the present Vaivasvata Manu cannot be mentioned in detail and in full even in hundreds of years. In the Vaivasvata Manvantara already twentyeight cycles of four Yugas have passed along with their saintly kings.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Know that the descendants in this world of the present Vaivasvata Manu cannot be mentioned in detail and in full even in hundreds of years. In the Vaivasvata Manvantara already twentyeight cycles of four Yugas have passed along with their saintly kings.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे व्यासतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तनवतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ९८ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र प्रभासेश्वरमुत्तमम् । विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु स्वर्गसोपानमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vyāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 98 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra prabhāseśvaramuttamam / vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu svargasopānamuttamam
verses.translation: On seeing his birth, the Fire-god spoke to Brahma: "It was I who held your Semen Virile. Hence may this second son be mine."
verses.hindi: + धनुश्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो ह. पुस्तके नास्ति । तदुपश्चुत्य तपसा सर्वे युक्ता: प्रचेतस: । मुखेश्यों वायुमग्नि घ ससुश्नुर्जातमन्यवः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing his birth, the Fire-god spoke to Brahma: "It was I who held your Semen Virile. Hence may this second son be mine."
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing his birth, the Fire-god spoke to Brahma: "It was I who held your Semen Virile. Hence may this second son be mine."

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: प्रभासं तात मे ब्रूहि कथं जातं महाफलम् । स्वर्गसोपानदं दृश्यं संक्षेपात् कथयस्व मे
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: prabhāsaṃ tāta me brūhi kathaṃ jātaṃ mahāphalam / svargasopānadaṃ dṛśyaṃ saṃkṣepāt kathayasva me
verses.translation: The Fire-god was addressed by Brahma: "Let it be so". Hence, we have heard that all the descendants of Angiras are known as Agneyas.
verses.hindi: उन्मुलानथ तान्वृक्षान्कृत्वा वायुरशोषयत् । तानग्निरदहृदूघो र एबमासीद्द्ग॒मक्षयः ३० द्रमक्षयमथो बुद्धवा किचिच्छेषेषु शाखिषु । उपगम्यात्रवोदेतान्राजा सोमः प्रचेतसः ३१ दृष्ट्वा प्रयोजन सर्व लोकसंतानकारणात् । कोप॑ त्यजत राजानः सर्व प्राचीनबहिषः (३२
verses.wordMeaning: The Fire-god was addressed by Brahma: "Let it be so". Hence, we have heard that all the descendants of Angiras are known as Agneyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Fire-god was addressed by Brahma: "Let it be so". Hence, we have heard that all the descendants of Angiras are known as Agneyas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: दुर्भगा रविपत्नी च प्रभानामेति विश्रुता । तया चाराधितः शम्भुरुग्रेण तपसा पुरा
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: durbhagā ravipatnī ca prabhānāmeti viśrutā / tayā cārādhitaḥ śambhurugreṇa tapasā purā
verses.translation: When the Semen Virile was consigned to the holy fire for six more times by Brahma, the creator, the six Brahmas (sons of Brahma) were born. So it is heard.
verses.hindi: तथा काट छाँट के वक्षों ने समस्त प्रृथ्वीमण्डल पर बढ़ बढ़कर माकाश तक छेंक लिया, जिससे प्रजाओं का विनाश होने लगा। उस चाक्षष मन्वब्तर में इस प्रकार प्रजाओं के ऊपर घोदथ विपत्ति आ गई, सारा आकाशमण्डल वृक्षों से घिर उठा, और दस सहन वर्ष तक प्रजाएँ निरचेष्ट पड़ी रहीं अर्थात् उन बेतरतीब बढ़े हुए वक्षों के काटने छाँटने का साहस उन्हें नहीं हुआ । तपोबल द्वारा प्रजाओं की इस घोर विपत्ति को चर्चा सुनकर सभी प्रचेताओं ने अति क्रुद्ध होकर अपने-अपने मुख से एक ही साथ वायु और अग्नि को छोड़ा ।२७-२६। वायु ने उन सभी बुक्षों को उखाड़ कर सुक्षा दिया और तब अग्नि ने उन सब को भस्म कर दिया-“इस प्रकार उन वृक्षों का विनाश हो मया । उन बढ़े हुये वृक्षों के विनाश हो जाने पर जब कहीं कहीं थोड़ी संख्या में कुछ वृक्ष शेष रह गये तब उन प्रचेताओं के समीप जाकर राजा सोंम ने कहा--'प्रचेता
verses.wordMeaning: When the Semen Virile was consigned to the holy fire for six more times by Brahma, the creator, the six Brahmas (sons of Brahma) were born. So it is heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Semen Virile was consigned to the holy fire for six more times by Brahma, the creator, the six Brahmas (sons of Brahma) were born. So it is heard.

verses.sanskrit: वायुभक्षा स्थिता वर्षं वर्षं ध्यानपरायणा । ततस्तुष्टो महादेवः प्रभायाः पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: vāyubhakṣā sthitā varṣaṃ varṣaṃ dhyānaparāyaṇā / tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ prabhāyāḥ pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: Marici was the first among them, born from the rays (of sacrificial fire). Since the (second) son was born in the Kratu (sacrifice), he is called Kratu.
verses.hindi: गण ! लोगों को उत्पन्न होने वाली संततियों के नित्य आने वाले सभी प्रयोजनों को देखकर आप लोग क्रोध छोड़ दें, क्योंकि आप सब राजा हैं ओर बहिस् के पुत्र हैं।३०-३२। पृथ्वी पर शेष बचे हुये ये वक्ष अब नये वृक्षों को उत्पन्न करेंगे। अतः अग्नि और वायु को अब भाप लोग छान्‍्त कर दें। यह परम सुन्दर दिखाई पड़ने वाली रत्नभूत कश्या वृक्षों की है, भविष्य में घटित होनेवाली घटनाओं को जानकर
verses.wordMeaning: Marici was the first among them, born from the rays (of sacrificial fire). Since the (second) son was born in the Kratu (sacrifice), he is called Kratu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Marici was the first among them, born from the rays (of sacrificial fire). Since the (second) son was born in the Kratu (sacrifice), he is called Kratu.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: कस्मात् संक्लिश्यसे बाले कथ्यतां यद्विवक्षितम् । अहं हि भास्करो ऽप्येको नानात्वं नैव विद्यते
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: kasmāt saṃkliśyase bāle kathyatāṃ yadvivakṣitam / ahaṃ hi bhāskaro 'pyeko nānātvaṃ naiva vidyate
verses.translation: "I am the third" (Aham-Trtlya), saying thus the third son was born. So he is called Atri. The fourth son was born with sharp pointed hairs. Hence he is remembered as Pulastya.
verses.hindi: मैंने अपनी किरणों द्वारा इसको बढ़ाया है, इसका नाम मारिषा है, व॒क्षों ने हो इसको उत्पन्न किया है। सोम के (मेरे) गर्भ में बढ़ते वाली यह खुन्दरी कन्या तुम सबों की स्त्री होगी। तुम लोगों के भाधे तेज से तथा मेरे आधे तेज से इसमें परम विद्वान दक्ष नामक प्रजापति उत्पन्न होगा। तुम सबों के ततः सोमस्य वचनाज्जगहुस्ते प्रचेतसः । संहत्य कोप॑ वृक्षेस्यः पत्नीं धर्मेण मारिषाम् ३७
verses.wordMeaning: "I am the third" (Aham-Trtlya), saying thus the third son was born. So he is called Atri. The fourth son was born with sharp pointed hairs. Hence he is remembered as Pulastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am the third" (Aham-Trtlya), saying thus the third son was born. So he is called Atri. The fourth son was born with sharp pointed hairs. Hence he is remembered as Pulastya.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभोवाच: नान्यो देवः स्त्रियः शम्भो विना भर्त्रा क्वचित्प्रभो । सगुणो निर्गुणो वापि धनाढ्यो वाप्यकिंचनः
verses.transliteration: prabhovāca: nānyo devaḥ striyaḥ śambho vinā bhartrā kvacitprabho / saguṇo nirguṇo vāpi dhanāḍhyo vāpyakiṃcanaḥ
verses.translation: The son born with long hairs is remembered as Pulaha. He who was born out of the Vasu (fire?) was called Vasuman. He is called Vasistha by those who know the truth, by the expounders of Vedas. Thus these six great sages are the mental sons of Brahma.
verses.hindi: ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश । कालस्य मयने युक्ता: सप्तविशतिमिन्दवे ॥४ १ एभ्यो दत्त्वा ततोष्न्या वे चतस्नोरिष्टनेमिने । है चेव बाहुपुत्राय है चवाडिगरसे तथा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The son born with long hairs is remembered as Pulaha. He who was born out of the Vasu (fire?) was called Vasuman. He is called Vasistha by those who know the truth, by the expounders of Vedas. Thus these six great sages are the mental sons of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son born with long hairs is remembered as Pulaha. He who was born out of the Vasu (fire?) was called Vasuman. He is called Vasistha by those who know the truth, by the expounders of Vedas. Thus these six great sages are the mental sons of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियो वा यदि वा द्वेष्यः स्त्रीणां भर्तैव दैवतम् । दुर्भगत्वेन दग्धाहं सखीमध्ये सुरेश्वर । भर्त्तर् यल्लब्धसौख्यास्मि तेन क्लिश्याम्यहं भृशम्
verses.transliteration: priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhartaiva daivatam / durbhagatvena dagdhāhaṃ sakhīmadhye sureśvara / bharttar yallabdhasaukhyāsmi tena kliśyāmyahaṃ bhṛśam
verses.translation: Gf. Brhad-devala V. 97-101 for the story of the births of Bhrgu, Angiras and Atri. Etymologies of these names also are borrowed therefrom though grammarians offer different derivations.
verses.hindi: कन्यामेकां कृशाश्वाय तेम्यो5पत्यं निबोधत ४२ अन्तर चाक्षुषस्यात्र मनोः षष्ठ तु हीयते । सनोरवेबस्व॒तस्थापि सप्तभस्य प्रजापते: ॥ तासु देवा: खगा गावो नागा दितिजदानवाः। गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चव जज्ञिरेबन्याश्च जातयः ४४
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Brhad-devala V. 97-101 for the story of the births of Bhrgu, Angiras and Atri. Etymologies of these names also are borrowed therefrom though grammarians offer different derivations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Brhad-devala V. 97-101 for the story of the births of Bhrgu, Angiras and Atri. Etymologies of these names also are borrowed therefrom though grammarians offer different derivations.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: वल्लभा भास्करस्यैव मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: vallabhā bhāskarasyaiva matprasādādbhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: They maintain the continunity of the worlds. These subjects are developed and nurtured by them. Hence Brahma s sons are mentioned as Prajapatis.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रभृति लोके5स्मिस्त्रजा मैथुनसंभवाः । संकल्पाइशंनात्स्पर्शात्पूवेंषां सृष्टिरुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: They maintain the continunity of the worlds. These subjects are developed and nurtured by them. Hence Brahma s sons are mentioned as Prajapatis.
verses.commentary: Sense: They maintain the continunity of the worlds. These subjects are developed and nurtured by them. Hence Brahma s sons are mentioned as Prajapatis.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वत्युवाच: अप्रमाणं भवद्वाक्यं भास्करो ऽपि करिष्यति । वृथा क्लेशो भवेदस्याः प्रभायाः परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: pārvatyuvāca: apramāṇaṃ bhavadvākyaṃ bhāskaro 'pi kariṣyati / vṛthā kleśo bhavedasyāḥ prabhāyāḥ parameśvara
verses.translation: Others called Pitrs were created by these great sages alone. The seven groups of sages are well known in the world, viz. Maricas,Bhargavas, Ahgirasas, Paulastyas, Paulahas, Vasisthas and Atreyas; these groups of Pitrs are well-known in the world.
verses.hindi: तेजोबल के कारण एवं अग्नि द्वारा अग्नि के समान परम तेजस्वी हो वह इस जलकर नष्ट हुई बसुधा का तथा सारी प्रजाओं का पालन पोषण करेगा ३३-३६। चन्द्रमा के ऐसा करने पर प्रचेताओं ने वज्षों पर से अपना क्रोध हटा लिया और धर्मंपूर्वक मारिया को पत्नी रूप में वरण किया  तदनस्तर उन सबों ने मावसतिक संकल्प से मारिषा में गर्भाधान किया । उन दस प्रचेताओं के अंश से मारिषा में दक्ष नामक प्रजापति उत्पन्न हुए, जो चन्द्रमा के अंथ के कारण परम पराक्रमी तथा महान तेजस्वी थे । प्राचीन काल में सर्वप्रथम उन दक्ष ने केवल मानसिक संकल्प से प्रजा सृष्टि की, स्त्री-पुरुष सम्भोग द्वारा नहीं ।३७-३९। उन दक्ष ने पहले अचरों को, घरों को, द्विपदों (मनुष्यों) को तथा चतुष्पदों को मानसिक संकल्प द्वारा उत्पन्न कर तदनन्तर स्त्रियों की सृष्टि की । उनमें से दस धर्म को, तेरह कश्यप को, तथा समय के विभाजन में नियुक्त सत्ताईस
verses.wordMeaning: Others called Pitrs were created by these great sages alone. The seven groups of sages are well known in the world, viz. Maricas,Bhargavas, Ahgirasas, Paulastyas, Paulahas, Vasisthas and Atreyas; these groups of Pitrs are well-known in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Others called Pitrs were created by these great sages alone. The seven groups of sages are well known in the world, viz. Maricas,Bhargavas, Ahgirasas, Paulastyas, Paulahas, Vasisthas and Atreyas; these groups of Pitrs are well-known in the world.

verses.sanskrit: उमावाक्यान् महेशानध्यातस्तिमिरनाशनः । आगतो गगनाद्भानुर्नर्मदोत्तररोधसि
verses.transliteration: umāvākyān maheśānadhyātastimiranāśanaḥ / āgato gaganādbhānurnarmadottararodhasi
verses.translation: These three Ganas have been briefly mentioned before: They are Apurvas (Rare), Prakdsas (Brilliant) and Jyolifmaiitas (Illuminated ones).
verses.hindi: कन्याओं को चन्द्रमा को दिया। इन सब को देने के बाद चाह कन्याओं को भरिष्टनेमि को, दो बाहुपन्न को, दो अज्जिरा को तथा एक कृशाश्व को दिया। अब उनके पुत्र-पौत्रादिकों का विवरण सुनिये
verses.wordMeaning: These three Ganas have been briefly mentioned before: They are Apurvas (Rare), Prakdsas (Brilliant) and Jyolifmaiitas (Illuminated ones).
verses.commentary: Sense: These three Ganas have been briefly mentioned before: They are Apurvas (Rare), Prakdsas (Brilliant) and Jyolifmaiitas (Illuminated ones).

verses.sanskrit: भानुरुवाच: आहूतो ऽस्मि कथं देव ह्यघासुरनिषूदन
verses.transliteration: bhānuruvāca: āhūto 'smi kathaṃ deva hyaghāsuraniṣūdana
verses.translation: Their king is lord Yama and they have wiped off their sins by their (religious) observances. There are other Prajapatis also. Listen to them attentively.
verses.hindi: इस अवधि में छठवाँ चाक्षुष नामक मन्वन्तर व्यतीत हो गया और सातव प्रजापति वेबस्वत मनु का भी' कार्यकाल समाप्त हुआ। उन दक्ष की कन्याओं में देवता, पक्षी, नाग, देत्य दानव, गस्धवं, अप्सरायें, एवं अन्यान्य जातियाँ उत्पन्न हुईं  इसके उपरान्त इस पृथ्वी लोक में प्रजाएँ सम्भोग के ढ्वारा उत्पन्न होने लगीं । उनके पूर्व उत्पसन होने वालों की सृष्टि संकल्प, दर्शन एवं स्पर्श से होतो कही जाती है देवानां दानवानां च देवर्षोणां च ते शुभ:  संभवः कथित: पूर्व दक्षस्य च महात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: Their king is lord Yama and they have wiped off their sins by their (religious) observances. There are other Prajapatis also. Listen to them attentively.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their king is lord Yama and they have wiped off their sins by their (religious) observances. There are other Prajapatis also. Listen to them attentively.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: प्रभां पालय भो भानो संतोषेण परेण हि
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: prabhāṃ pālaya bho bhāno saṃtoṣeṇa pareṇa hi
verses.translation: There are other Prajapatis many in number, viz. Kardama, Kasyapa, Sesa (?), Vikranta, Susruvas, Bahuputra, Kumara, Vivasvan, Sucilravas, Pracetas, Aristanemi, Bahula and many others. 1
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठथ' कानिष्ठ्यमप्येषां पूर्व नासीद्विजोत्तमाः । तप एवं गरीयोभूत्प्रभावश्चेव कारणमू.
verses.wordMeaning: There are other Prajapatis many in number, viz. Kardama, Kasyapa, Sesa (?), Vikranta, Susruvas, Bahuputra, Kumara, Vivasvan, Sucilravas, Pracetas, Aristanemi, Bahula and many others. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other Prajapatis many in number, viz. Kardama, Kasyapa, Sesa (?), Vikranta, Susruvas, Bahuputra, Kumara, Vivasvan, Sucilravas, Pracetas, Aristanemi, Bahula and many others. 1

verses.sanskrit: उमोवाच: प्रभाया मन्दिरे नित्यं स्थीयतां हिमनाशन । अग्रपत्नी समस्तानां भार्याणां क्रियतां रवे
verses.transliteration: umovāca: prabhāyā mandire nityaṃ sthīyatāṃ himanāśana / agrapatnī samastānāṃ bhāryāṇāṃ kriyatāṃ rave
verses.translation: Kusoccayas and Valakhilyas had become great sages. They had the speed of the mind. They could go anywhere. They became Emperors.
verses.hindi: इमां विसृष्टि यो बेद चाक्षुपस्प चराचरम् । प्रजानामायुरुत्तीर्ण : स्वरगंलोके महीयते ५२ एष सर्ग: समाख्यातश्राक्षुपस्थ समासत: । इत्येते घड्विसर्गा हि क्रान्ता मन्वन्तरात्मकाः ॥ ऋषियां ने कहा--सूतजी ! देवताओं, दानवों तथा देवियों की उत्पत्ति तुमने महात्मा दक्ष की उत्पत्ति के पूर्व बतलाई है और प्रजापति दक्ष का जन्म प्राण से बतलाया है, उस महातपस्वी ने फिर किस प्रकार प्रचेताओं के पुत्र होने का गौरब्पूर्ण पद प्राप्त किया--हम लोगों के इस सन्देह को तुम दूर करो, तथा यह भी बतलाओ कि वह चन्द्रमा का दोहित्र (नाती) होकर फिर उसका इबशुर कंसे हुमा
verses.wordMeaning: Kusoccayas and Valakhilyas had become great sages. They had the speed of the mind. They could go anywhere. They became Emperors.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kusoccayas and Valakhilyas had become great sages. They had the speed of the mind. They could go anywhere. They became Emperors.

verses.sanskrit: भानुरुवाच: एवं देवि करिष्यामि तव वाक्यं वरानने । एतच्छ्रुत्वा प्रभाहूता प्रत्युवाच महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: bhānuruvāca: evaṃ devi kariṣyāmi tava vākyaṃ varānane / etacchrutvā prabhāhūtā pratyuvāca maheśvaram
verses.translation: The groups of sages called Vaikhanasas are honoured by Brahmanas. They were born of the sacred ashes. They are engaged in penance and learning.
verses.hindi: सूत ने कहा--ऋषिवरयंव॒न्द ! यह जन्म और निरोध (विनाश वा निवृत्ति) सर्वंदा स्वंक्षामान्य जीवों में हुभा करते हैं, ऋषिगण तथा विद्वान लोग इस विषय में कभी मोह को नहीं प्राप्त होते । है द्विजगण ! ये दक्षादि प्रजापति गण प्रत्येक युग में उत्पन्न होते रहते हैं ओर फिर से वे विनाश को प्राप्त हो जाते हैं-इस
verses.wordMeaning: The groups of sages called Vaikhanasas are honoured by Brahmanas. They were born of the sacred ashes. They are engaged in penance and learning.
verses.commentary: Sense: The groups of sages called Vaikhanasas are honoured by Brahmanas. They were born of the sacred ashes. They are engaged in penance and learning.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभोवाच: स्वांशेन स्थीयतां देव मन्मथारे उमापते । एकांशः स्थाप्यतामत्र तीर्थस्योन्मीलनाय च
verses.transliteration: prabhovāca: svāṃśena sthīyatāṃ deva manmathāre umāpate / ekāṃśaḥ sthāpyatāmatra tīrthasyonmīlanāya ca
verses.translation: The handsome Asvinas were born of his ears. The pure ones born of the eyes are known as Ak$arajas.
verses.hindi: भाव नहीं रहा है, केवल तफ्स्या ही इनकी महत्त्वपूर्ण मानी जाती थी तथा इनके व्यक्तिगत प्रभाव ही इनकी महत्ता के कारण होते रहे। चाक्षुष भनु की इस चराचर सृष्टि-वृत्तान्त को जो व्यक्ति भली भाँति जानता है बह अपनी सारी आयु सुखपूर्वंक समाप्त कर अन्त में स्वर्ग लोक में पुजित होता है ।४६-५२। चाक्षुष मन्वन्तर की सृष्टि सक्षेप में वर्णत कर चुका। इस उपर्युक्त छ मल्वन्तरों का, जो स्वायम्भुव मनु से आरम्भ कर चाक्षष मनु के अन्त तक चलते हैं, सक्षेप में क्रमिक वर्णन किया जा चुका । है द्विजवर्यबुल्द ! इन सृष्टि वृत्तान्तों को अपनी जानकारी के अनुसार मैं आप लोगों को बतला चुका, इनका विस्तारपूवंक वर्णन बेबस्वत मन्वन्तर के समान
verses.wordMeaning: The handsome Asvinas were born of his ears. The pure ones born of the eyes are known as Ak$arajas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The handsome Asvinas were born of his ears. The pure ones born of the eyes are known as Ak$arajas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: सर्वदेवमयं लिङ्गं स्थापितं तत्र पाण्डव । प्रभासेश इति ख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sarvadevamayaṃ liṅgaṃ sthāpitaṃ tatra pāṇḍava / prabhāseśa iti khyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu durlabham
verses.translation: The elder Prajapatis were born of his vessels. The sages were born of the hair pores in the skin and the sweat dirt.
verses.hindi: अनन्ता नातिरिक्ताश्व सब सर्गा विवस्वतः । आरोग्यायुः प्रमाणेन धर्मंत: कामतोथेतः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The elder Prajapatis were born of his vessels. The sages were born of the hair pores in the skin and the sweat dirt.
verses.commentary: Sense: The elder Prajapatis were born of his vessels. The sages were born of the hair pores in the skin and the sweat dirt.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यानि यानि तीर्थानि काले तानि फलन्ति वै । प्रभासेशस्तु राजेन्द्र सद्यः कामफलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: anyāni yāni tīrthāni kāle tāni phalanti vai / prabhāseśastu rājendra sadyaḥ kāmaphalapradaḥ
verses.translation: From his tears and cry were born the terrible mouths Niryasas (?), the junctions of fortnights, years, days and nights and the terrible light of Pitrs.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पृथुवंशानुकीत॑नं नाम त्रिषष्टितमोध्थ्याय: सप्तमे त्वथ पर्याये मनोबेंवस्व॒तस्थ ह । सारीचास्कश्यपादेवा जज्ञिरे परसर्षयः
verses.wordMeaning: From his tears and cry were born the terrible mouths Niryasas (?), the junctions of fortnights, years, days and nights and the terrible light of Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his tears and cry were born the terrible mouths Niryasas (?), the junctions of fortnights, years, days and nights and the terrible light of Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: माघमासे सिते पक्षे सप्तम्यां च विशेषतः । अश्वं यः स्पर्शयेत् तत्र यथोक्तब्राह्मणे नृप
verses.transliteration: māghamāse site pakṣe saptamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / aśvaṃ yaḥ sparśayet tatra yathoktabrāhmaṇe nṛpa
verses.translation: Raudra they say is the blood. Lohita is remembered as gold. That should be known as Maitra also. The smoke is remembered as animals.
verses.hindi: जान लेना चाहिए । वैवस्वत मनु के सभी सृष्टि कार्य आरोग्य, आयु, धर, अर्थ एवं काम सभी दृष्टियों से अनन्त तथा दूसरे सर्गों के समान ही हैं, जो असूया (ग्रुणों में दोषारोपण करने की प्रवृत्ति) भाव को छोड़कर इसको पढ़ता है वह आरोग्य, आयु, धम्म, अर्थ एवं काम इन सभी मनोरथों को प्राप्त करता है। अब सम्श्रति वर्तमान महात्मा वैवस्वत के सृष्टि क्रम का यथावसर और संक्षेप बिस्तार में वर्णन कर रहा हूं,
verses.wordMeaning: Raudra they say is the blood. Lohita is remembered as gold. That should be known as Maitra also. The smoke is remembered as animals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Raudra they say is the blood. Lohita is remembered as gold. That should be known as Maitra also. The smoke is remembered as animals.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रत्वं प्राप्यते तेन भास्करस्याथवा पदम् । स्नात्वा परमया भक्त्या दानं दद्याद् द्विजातये
verses.transliteration: indratvaṃ prāpyate tena bhāskarasyāthavā padam / snātvā paramayā bhaktyā dānaṃ dadyād dvijātaye
verses.translation: Different Puranas give different lists of Prajapatis. For example, the lists in Mbh., Mt. P. or Garuda differ from our text (and Bd. P) and inter se.
verses.hindi: श्री बायुमहापुराण में पृथु-बंशानुकीतंन नामक तिरसठवाँ अध्याय समाप्त ॥६३॥। बैवस्वत मन्वन्तर की सृष्टि का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Different Puranas give different lists of Prajapatis. For example, the lists in Mbh., Mt. P. or Garuda differ from our text (and Bd. P) and inter se.
verses.commentary: Sense: Different Puranas give different lists of Prajapatis. For example, the lists in Mbh., Mt. P. or Garuda differ from our text (and Bd. P) and inter se.

verses.sanskrit: गोप्रदाता लभेत्स्वर्गं सत्यलोकं वरेश्वर । सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरीं शुभ्रां क्षीरिणीं तरुणीं शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: gopradātā labhetsvargaṃ satyalokaṃ vareśvara / sarvāṅgasundarīṃ śubhrāṃ kṣīriṇīṃ taruṇīṃ śubhām
verses.translation: The flames are Rudras and Adityas. Divine human beings were born of the burning coal and the flame.
verses.hindi: खूतजी ने कहा- ऋषिवृन्द ! सातवें वेवस्वत नामक मन्वत्तर में मरीचि-पुत्र कश्यप से देवताओं एवं महर्षियों की उत्पत्ति हुईं ।१। उसमें आदित्यगण, वंसुगण, रुद्रगण, साध्यगण, विश्वेदेवगण, मरुद्गण, भ्ृगरुपुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: The flames are Rudras and Adityas. Divine human beings were born of the burning coal and the flame.
verses.commentary: Sense: The flames are Rudras and Adityas. Divine human beings were born of the burning coal and the flame.

verses.sanskrit: सवत्सां घण्टासंयुक्तां कांस्यपात्रावदोहिनीम् । ददते ये नृपश्रेष्ठ न ते यान्ति यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: savatsāṃ ghaṇṭāsaṃyuktāṃ kāṃsyapātrāvadohinīm / dadate ye nṛpaśreṣṭha na te yānti yamālayam
verses.translation: Brahma born of Brahman is the primordial being in the world. Requesting (for the hand of) a virgin, the sages told him who bestowed everything:
verses.hindi: आदित्या बसवो रुद्रा: साध्या विश्वे मरुद्गणा:। भृगवोड्धिरसश्चेव ह्ष्टो देवगणाः स्मृता: भृगोस्तु भागंबो देवो ह्यज्िरोडछझूगिरसः सुतः । वेवस्वतेउन्तरे ह्यस्मिश्नित्यं ते छन्दजाः सुरा: ॥ “एते४पि च गसिष्यन्ति महतः कालपर्ययात्
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma born of Brahman is the primordial being in the world. Requesting (for the hand of) a virgin, the sages told him who bestowed everything:
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma born of Brahman is the primordial being in the world. Requesting (for the hand of) a virgin, the sages told him who bestowed everything:

verses.sanskrit: अथ यः परया भक्त्या स्नानं देवस्य कारयेत् । स प्राप्नोति परं लोकं यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: atha yaḥ parayā bhaktyā snānaṃ devasya kārayet / sa prāpnoti paraṃ lokaṃ yāvadābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: "Brahma, the eldest among Suras, is delighted with Devas. These lords will be giving birth to all the subjects.
verses.hindi: त्रलोक्ये यानि सत्त्वानि गतिमन्त्यबलानि च। अभिभूयावतिष्ठन्ते धर्म: कारणरपि ८
verses.wordMeaning: "Brahma, the eldest among Suras, is delighted with Devas. These lords will be giving birth to all the subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Brahma, the eldest among Suras, is delighted with Devas. These lords will be giving birth to all the subjects.

verses.sanskrit: दौर्भाग्यं नाशमायाति स्नानमात्रेण पाण्डव । तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या कन्यादानं प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: daurbhāgyaṃ nāśamāyāti snānamātreṇa pāṇḍava / tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā kanyādānaṃ prayacchati
verses.translation: All of them are Prajapatis. All of them are sages. These rites will uphold these worlds with his grace.
verses.hindi: भूत भव्य भविष्य तत्स्मृत॑ कत्रय॑ द्विजे:। भूलोको5य॑ स्मृतो भूमिरन्तरिक्ष भूवं स्पृतम् ॥ एवं अगिरापूत्र --ये आठ देवगण स्मरण किये जाते हैं।२। इनमें आदित्यगण, मरुदगण और रुद्रगण-ये कश्यप के पृत्र हैं। साध्यगण, वसुगण एवं विष्वेदेबगण--ये तीन गण धर्म के पुत्र कहे गये हैं । भूगु के भागव एवं अंगिरा के अंगिरस गण पुत्र हैं, इस वेवस्वत मन्वन्तर में ये सुर गण 8न्‍्दों से उत्पन्न होने वाले कहे गये हैं। महाप्रलय पयन्त ये लोग भी सृष्टि के कार्यों के साथ चलेंगे अर्थात् महाप्रलय पयंन्त इनकी भी सत्ता विद्यमान
verses.wordMeaning: All of them are Prajapatis. All of them are sages. These rites will uphold these worlds with his grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them are Prajapatis. All of them are sages. These rites will uphold these worlds with his grace.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाय विवाहेन दापयेत् पाण्डुनन्दन । समानवयसे देया कुलशीलधनैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāya vivāhena dāpayet pāṇḍunandana / samānavayase deyā kulaśīladhanaistathā
verses.translation: They have developed couples increasing your splend¬ our. Among Devas there are learned ones in Vedas. All the saintly kings are also such.
verses.hindi: रहेगी ३-४। यह शुभ वर्तमान देव-'द्धति मरीचिनन्दत कश्यप के वंशधरों का जानना चाहिए, इन सबों का स्वामी इन्द्र साम्प्रत नामक महाबलशाली है। अतीत, भविष्यत् तथा वर्तमान कालीन जो मन्वन्तरों के इन्द्रगण हैं, वे सभी लक्षणों में एक समान हैं। वे सब के सब भूत, भविष्यत् तथा वर्तमान काल के स्वामी हैं, सहस्र भाँखोंवाले तथा पुरन्दर हैं, मघवान् हैं, श्वड़ी हैं, तथा वज्ञ धारण करनेवाले हैं। सभी सो यज्ञों को पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: They have developed couples increasing your splend¬ our. Among Devas there are learned ones in Vedas. All the saintly kings are also such.
verses.commentary: Sense: They have developed couples increasing your splend¬ our. Among Devas there are learned ones in Vedas. All the saintly kings are also such.

verses.sanskrit: ये ददन्ते महाराज ह्यपि पातकसंयुताः । तेषां पापानि लीयन्ते ह्युदके लवणं यथा
verses.transliteration: ye dadante mahārāja hyapi pātakasaṃyutāḥ / teṣāṃ pāpāni līyante hyudake lavaṇaṃ yathā
verses.translation: All of them are devoted to the Vedic Mantras. They have been born out of the attributes of Prajapatis. The infinite Brahman is the Truth and the greatest penance.
verses.hindi: करनेवाने तथा व्यक्तिगत सेकड़ों गुण-समूहों से उत्पन्न हैं !५-७॥ तीनों लोकों में जितने भी शक्तिशाली, गतिमान् अथवा निबल प्राणी हैं, इन्द्र उन सबों से--धर्मादि कार्यों में भी--बढ़े-चढ़े रहते हैं। तेज से, तप से, बुद्धि से, बल, शास्त्रीय ज्ञान तथा पराक्रम से वे सभी प्राणियाँ में श्रेष्ठ होते हैं । वे जिस प्रकार अत्यन्त प्रभावशाली तथा भूत, भविष्य एवं वर्तमान के स्वामी होते हैं, उन सब का वर्णन मैं कर रहा हें, सुनिये ।८-९॥ ब्राह्मणों ने भूत, भव्य एवं भविष्य--थे तीन लोक बताये हैं। भूलोक यह प्रथ्वी तथा अन्तरिक्ष (आकादमण्डल) भुवल्ञोक स्मरण
verses.wordMeaning: All of them are devoted to the Vedic Mantras. They have been born out of the attributes of Prajapatis. The infinite Brahman is the Truth and the greatest penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them are devoted to the Vedic Mantras. They have been born out of the attributes of Prajapatis. The infinite Brahman is the Truth and the greatest penance.

verses.sanskrit: स्वामिद्रोहकृतं पापं निक्षेपस्यापहारिणि । मित्रघ्ने च कृतघ्ने च कूटसाक्ष्यसमुद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: svāmidrohakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nikṣepasyāpahāriṇi / mitraghne ca kṛtaghne ca kūṭasākṣyasamudbhavam
verses.translation: O lord, all of us are your own children, the Brahman (Vedas), the Brahmanas and all the worlds including the mobile and the immobile beings.
verses.hindi: इदमधे नास्ति क. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, all of us are your own children, the Brahman (Vedas), the Brahmanas and all the worlds including the mobile and the immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, all of us are your own children, the Brahman (Vedas), the Brahmanas and all the worlds including the mobile and the immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: तद्ग्रामोद्यानभेदोत्थं परदारनिषेवणम् । वार्द्धुषिकस्य यत्पापं यत्पापं स्तेयसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: tadgrāmodyānabhedotthaṃ paradāraniṣevaṇam / vārddhuṣikasya yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ steyasambhavam
verses.translation: Beginning with Marlci and including all the sages, we Devas are thinking about and longing for children by your (blessings)".
verses.hindi: ध्यायता पुत्रकामेण ब्रह्मणाउग्रे विभाषितम् । भ्रिति व्याह॒तं पूर्व भूलोंकोयमभत्तदा ११ भूसत्तायां स्मृतों धातुस्तथाइसों लोकदशने । भतत्वाहृर्श नत्वाच्च भूलोको5यमभृत्ततः  अतोथ्य॑ प्रथमो लोको भूतत्वाद्भद्विज: स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Beginning with Marlci and including all the sages, we Devas are thinking about and longing for children by your (blessings)".
verses.commentary: Sense: Beginning with Marlci and including all the sages, we Devas are thinking about and longing for children by your (blessings)".

verses.sanskrit: कूपभेदोद्भवं यच्च बैडालव्रतधारिणः । दाम्भिकं वृक्षच्छेदोत्थं विवाहस्य निषेधजम्
verses.transliteration: kūpabhedodbhavaṃ yacca baiḍālavratadhāriṇaḥ / dāmbhikaṃ vṛkṣacchedotthaṃ vivāhasya niṣedhajam
verses.translation: (Siita said) O highly blessed ones, Devas along with sages identifying (themselves) with the abodes and the time are born in this family during the Yajna.
verses.hindi: भूतेइस्मिन्भवदित्युक्तं द्वितीय॑ ब्रह्मणा पुनः । भवत्युत्पद्ममनेन कालशब्दो5यमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: (Siita said) O highly blessed ones, Devas along with sages identifying (themselves) with the abodes and the time are born in this family during the Yajna.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Siita said) O highly blessed ones, Devas along with sages identifying (themselves) with the abodes and the time are born in this family during the Yajna.

verses.sanskrit: आरामस्थतरुच्छेदमगम्यागमनोद्भवम् । स्वभार्यात्यजने यच्च परभार्यासमीहनात्
verses.transliteration: ārāmasthatarucchedamagamyāgamanodbhavam / svabhāryātyajane yacca parabhāryāsamīhanāt
verses.translation: In that very form, they may not establish these sub¬ jects. They may be stabilised from the beginning till the end of the Yugas.
verses.hindi: भवनात्तु भुवलोको निरुक्तज्ञनिरुच्यते । अन्तरिक्ष भुवस्तस्माद्वितोयो लोक उच्यते उत्पन्ने तु भूवलकि तृतीय ब्रह्मणा पुनः । भव्येति व्याहृतं यस्मा:ड्ू व्यो लोकस्तदा5भवत् १५ अनागते भव्य इति शब्द एब विभाव्यते । तस्माउूव्यो हासों लोको नामतस्तु दिवं स्‍्पृतम्॒
verses.wordMeaning: In that very form, they may not establish these sub¬ jects. They may be stabilised from the beginning till the end of the Yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that very form, they may not establish these sub¬ jects. They may be stabilised from the beginning till the end of the Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मस्वहरणे यच्च गरदे गोविघातिनि । विद्याविक्रयणोत्थं च संसर्गाद्यच्च पातकम्
verses.transliteration: brahmasvaharaṇe yacca garade govighātini / vidyāvikrayaṇotthaṃ ca saṃsargādyacca pātakam
verses.translation: Then the preceptor of the world (Brahma), without any further thought, spoke—"O Devas, it was after deciding like this that the subjects had been created by me. There is no doubt about this. These sages have been born in your race".
verses.hindi: स्व॒रित्युक्तं तृतीयोडन्यो भाव्यो लोकस्तदाउभवत् । भाव्य इत्येष धातुर्वे भाव्ये काले विभाव्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Then the preceptor of the world (Brahma), without any further thought, spoke—"O Devas, it was after deciding like this that the subjects had been created by me. There is no doubt about this. These sages have been born in your race".
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the preceptor of the world (Brahma), without any further thought, spoke—"O Devas, it was after deciding like this that the subjects had been created by me. There is no doubt about this. These sages have been born in your race".

verses.sanskrit: श्वबिडालवधाद्घोरं सर्पशूद्रोद्भवं तथा । भूमिहर्तुश्च यत्पापं भूमिहारिणि चैव हि
verses.transliteration: śvabiḍālavadhādghoraṃ sarpaśūdrodbhavaṃ tathā / bhūmihartuśca yatpāpaṃ bhūmihāriṇi caiva hi
verses.translation: Among them I shall recount in detail and in proper sequence the race of Bhygu, the ancient noble soul and the first Prajapati.
verses.hindi: भ्रितोय॑ं स्पृता भूमिरन्तरिक्ष भव स्मृतम् । दिव्य स्मृतं तथा भाव्यं तअलोक्यस्यष संग्रहः १८ त्रेलोक्ययुक्त्व्याहारेस्तिख्रो व्याहृतयो5भवन् । नाथ इत्येष धातु्वे धातुज्ञ: पालने स्मृतः १६ किया गया है। स्वगंलोक भव्य नाम से स्मरण किया गया है, उनके लक्षणों को बतला रहा हूं । पुन्र उत्पन्न करने की इच्छा से ब्रह्मा ने ध्यानावस्थित होकर सर्वप्रथम 'भूः” इस अक्षर का उच्चारण किया, उसी समय यह भूलोक हुआ । भू धातु का सत्ता अर्थात् विद्यमान रहने अर्थ में प्रयोग होता है तथा लोक-दर्शंन, (लोगों के देखने योग्य) भर्थ में भी उसकी प्रसिद्धि है, विद्यमान रहने एवं लोगों के दृष्टिगोचर होने के कारण यह भूमि
verses.wordMeaning: Among them I shall recount in detail and in proper sequence the race of Bhygu, the ancient noble soul and the first Prajapati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among them I shall recount in detail and in proper sequence the race of Bhygu, the ancient noble soul and the first Prajapati.

verses.sanskrit: मा ददस्वेति यत्पापं गोवह्निब्राह्मणेषु च । तत्पापं याति विलयं कन्यादानेन पाण्डव
verses.transliteration: mā dadasveti yatpāpaṃ govahnibrāhmaṇeṣu ca / tatpāpaṃ yāti vilayaṃ kanyādānena pāṇḍava
verses.translation: Bhrgu had two unequalled, excellent and auspicious wives of noble families. One was the daughter ofHiranyakasipu, famous by the name 'Divya' and the other was the fair-com- plexioned daughter of Puloman, named Pauloml. Divyabore to Bhrgu the planet Sukra (Venus) who was the preceptor of Dcvas and Asuras, who was the son of Kavi, and was known as Kavya, Sukra and Usanas. He was the most excellent among the knowers of Vedas. Sukra's wife named Ahgl was the mental daughter of the Soma-drinking Pitfs and very famous. She gave birth to four sons.
verses.hindi: भूलोक नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुईं। यही कारण है कि ब्राह्मणो ने इसे विद्यमान होने के कारण प्रथम लोक माना है ।१०-१२। इस भूलोक के आविर्भाव हो जाने पर ब्रह्मा-ने फिर 'भवत्' ऐसा दूसरा उच्चारण किया। उत्पन्न (उच्चारित) होने वाले इस भवत् शब्द के द्वारा वर्तमान काल में होने वाले का अवगम (बोध) होता है, निरुक्‍त) के जानने वाले लोग भवन (होने वाले) इस शब्द से भुवलोंक की निरुक्ति करते हैं। अतः अन्तरिक्ष
verses.wordMeaning: Bhrgu had two unequalled, excellent and auspicious wives of noble families. One was the daughter ofHiranyakasipu, famous by the name 'Divya' and the other was the fair-com- plexioned daughter of Puloman, named Pauloml.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhrgu had two unequalled, excellent and auspicious wives of noble families. One was the daughter ofHiranyakasipu, famous by the name 'Divya' and the other was the fair-com- plexioned daughter of Puloman, named Pauloml.…

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा भास्करं लोकं रुद्रलोके शुभे व्रजेत् । क्रीडते रुद्रलोकस्थो यावद् इन्द्राश्चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā bhāskaraṃ lokaṃ rudraloke śubhe vrajet / krīḍate rudralokastho yāvad indrāścaturdaśa
verses.translation: He was endowed with Brahman's splendour and the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman. Sukia begot four sons of her, viz. Tvastr, Varutrin, Sanda and Amaika. They resembled the sun and in their prowess they were equal to Brahma.
verses.hindi: . द्वितीय भुवलोंक के नाम से कहा जाता.है। १३-१४। भृवलोंक के आविर्भूत हो जाने पर ब्रह्मा ने भव्य' इस तृतीय शब्द का उच्चारण किया, जिससे भव्यलोक का अविर्भाव हुआ  यह भव्य हब्द भविष्यत्काल के अर्थ में जाता है, इसी से यह लोक भव्य लोक हुआ, नाम से यह दिव (स्वर्ग) लोक से. स्मरण किया जाता है; तदन- स्‍्तर ब्रह्मा ने अन्य तीसरे 'स्वः' इस शब्द का उच्चारण किया, जिससे भाव्य लोक का प्रादुर्भाव हुआ । भाव्य इस धातु का भविष्यत्काल के अथे में प्रयोग होता है। यह भूमि भूलोक के अर्थ में, अन्तरिक्ष भुवलोक के अर्थ में तथा स्वगलोक भाव्य लोक के अर्थ में कहे गये हैं--यही तीनों लोकों के सपृह हैं ।१५-१५। इन्हीं तीनों लोकों के सयुक्त उच्चारणों से तीनों (भू: भुवः स्व:) महाव्याहृतियाँ हुईं । धातु के जानने वाले लोग नाथ धातु
verses.wordMeaning: He was endowed with Brahman's splendour and the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman. Sukia begot four sons of her, viz. Tvastr, Varutrin, Sanda and Amaika. They resembled the sun and in their prowess they were equal to Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was endowed with Brahman's splendour and the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman. Sukia begot four sons of her, viz. Tvastr, Varutrin, Sanda and Amaika. They resembled the sun and in their prowess they were equal to Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापक्षये जाते शिवे भवति भावना । एतद्व्रजति यस्तीर्थं प्रभासं पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpakṣaye jāte śive bhavati bhāvanā / etadvrajati yastīrthaṃ prabhāsaṃ pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: Ranjana, Prthurasmi and the scholarly Brhadgiras were the sons of Varutrin. They were devoted to Brahman and became the priests of Suras. They approached Manu with the motive of spoiling sacrificial rites. On seeing Dharma being violated, Indra spoke to Manu:
verses.hindi: १. प्रकृति-प्रत्यय गादि अवयबों के अर्थ को निचोड़ कर एक अर्थ को प्रतिपादन करने वाला वेद का एक अडद्भ अथवा व्याकरण ।
verses.wordMeaning: Ranjana, Prthurasmi and the scholarly Brhadgiras were the sons of Varutrin. They were devoted to Brahman and became the priests of Suras. They approached Manu with the motive of spoiling sacrificial rites. On seeing Dharma being violated, Indra spoke to Manu:
verses.commentary: Sense: Ranjana, Prthurasmi and the scholarly Brhadgiras were the sons of Varutrin. They were devoted to Brahman and became the priests of Suras. They approached Manu with the motive of spoiling sacrificial rites. On seeing Dharma being violated, Indra spoke to Manu:

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थफलं प्राप्य सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् । गोप्रदानं महापुण्यं सर्वपापक्षयं परम् । प्रशस्तं सर्वकालं हि चतुर्दश्यां विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpya so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / gopradānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃ param / praśastaṃ sarvakālaṃ hi caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "I would rather have the sacrifice performed through you than through these". On hearing these words of Indra, they fled from that place.
verses.hindi: ५४५ द वायुपुराणम् यस्माद्यूतस्य लोकस्य भव्यस्य भवतस्तदा । लोकत्रयस्य नाथास्ते तस्मादिय्धा दिजे: स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: "I would rather have the sacrifice performed through you than through these". On hearing these words of Indra, they fled from that place.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I would rather have the sacrifice performed through you than through these". On hearing these words of Indra, they fled from that place.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे प्रभासतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टनवतितमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ९९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे । स्थापितं वासुकीशं तु समस्ताघौघनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe prabhāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 99 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe / sthāpitaṃ vāsukīśaṃ tu samastāghaughanāśanam
verses.translation: After hearing the third section completed (narrated in full) by the intelligent Suta, the excellent sages asked him about the fourth Section. The third section called Anusahga Pada has been com¬ pletely narrated out of affection by you. Now narrate to us in details the fourth Pada called Samhdra (annihilation or con¬ clusion). Please recount all the Manvantaras, the ones that had elapsed along with the others (the future ones), theSeven Sages who exist now in the current Manvantara and the details of the creation and expansion of the noble-souled Manu.. Narrate everything in detail and in the proper order. O excellent sages I shall narrate everything to you precisely; the fourth and the concluding section, along with the (description of) annihilation. O Brahmanas, listen to the creative activity of the current noble-souled Vaivasvata Manu in detail as well as in proper order. Even as I recount, listen and understand the gist of the (past) Manvantaras along with the seven future ones as well as the dissolution of the worlds. There will be three groups of Devas, viz. Sutapas, Amitabhas and Sukhas (? Mukhyas). Each of these groups consists of twenty Devas. I shall enumerate them. Listen and understand attentively. Rita, Tapas, Sukra, Dyuti, Jyotis, Prabhakara, Prabhasa, Bhasakrt, Dharma, Tejas, Rasmi, Rtu, Virat, Arcisman, Dyotana, Bhanu, Yas'as, Kirti, Budha and Dhjrti— these twenty Devas constituting the group Sutapas, are glorified by their names.
verses.hindi: प्रधानभूता देवेन्द्रा गुणभुतास्तथेव च । मन्वन्तरेषु ये देवा यज्ञभाजों भवन्ति हि
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing the third section completed (narrated in full) by the intelligent Suta, the excellent sages asked him about the fourth Section. The third section called Anusahga Pada has been com¬ pletely narrated out of affection by you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing the third section completed (narrated in full) by the intelligent Suta, the excellent sages asked him about the fourth Section. The third section called Anusahga Pada has been com¬ pletely narrated out of affection by you.…

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कस्माच्च कारणात्तात रेवाया दक्षिणे तटे । वासुकीशस्थापितो वै विस्तराद्वद मे गुरो
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kasmācca kāraṇāttāta revāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe / vāsukīśasthāpito vai vistarādvada me guro
verses.translation: Prabhu, Vibhu, Vibhasa, Jeta, Hanta, Ariha, Ritu, Sumati, Pramati, DIpti, Samakhyata, Mahas, Mahan, Deha, Muni, Naya, Jyestha, Sama, Satya and Visruta these are the twenty Devas mentioned as Amitabhas. Dama, Data, Vida, Soma, Vitta, Vaidya, Yama, Nidhi, Homa, Havya, Huta, Dana, Deya, Data, Tapas, Sama, Dhruva, Sthana, Vidhana and Niyama—these twenty are mentioned as constituting the Mukhya (Sukha) group of Devas in the first Savarna Manvantara. All these are the sons of the noble-souled Kasyapa, the son of Marici who exists now. They will be born in the Savarna Manvantara. He who was formerly Bali, the son of Virocana, will become their Indra. Nine sons will be born to Savarna Manu, viz. Viravan, Avarlyan, Nirmoha, Satyavak, Krti, Carisnurajya, Visnu, Vaca and Sumati. I shall mention nine more in the other Savarna Manvantaras. Other Savarna Manus will be born as Brahma's (future) sons. They are seen as Merusavarnis by those end¬ owed with divine vision. They are the grandsons of Daksa, the sons of his beloved daughter. They are endowed with great penance and great splendour. They live on the ridges of Meru. They are pro¬ created by Brahma and other (Devas) as well as by the intelli¬ gent Daksa. They were bom in the previous Caksusa Manvantara. These noble persons had been in the Maharloka. After return¬ ing from there they will resort to Meru. How were the sons procreated by Daksa in his own daughter? How were they created by Bhava, Dharma and Brahma the noble souls?
verses.hindi: यक्षगन्धवेरक्षांसि पिशाचो रगदानवाः । महिमानः स्मृता हा ते देवेन्द्राणां तु स्बंशः २२ देवेन्द्रा गुरवो नाथा राजानः पितरो हि ते । रक्षन्तीमा: प्रजा: सर्बा धर्मणेह सुरोक्तमा: २३ इत्येतल्लक्षणं प्रोक्‍्त॑ देवेन्द्राणां समासतः । सप्तर्षीन्संप्रवक्ष्यामि सांप्रतं ये दिवि स्थिता: २४ गाधिजः कौशिको धीमान्विश्वामित्रों महातपः । भार्गवो जमदग्निश्व ऊरुपुत्र: प्रतापवान् स्वायंभुवो5त्रिभंगवान्ब्रह्मको शस्त पत्च॒मः । बष्ठो वशिष्ठपुत्रस्तु बसुमांल्लोकविश्वुतः २७ वत्सारः काश्यपश्चेव सप्तंते साधुसंमताः । एते सप्तर्षयः सिद्धा बतंन्‍्ते सांप्रतेडन्तरे २८
verses.wordMeaning: Prabhu, Vibhu, Vibhasa, Jeta, Hanta, Ariha, Ritu, Sumati, Pramati, DIpti, Samakhyata, Mahas, Mahan, Deha, Muni, Naya, Jyestha, Sama, Satya and Visruta these are the twenty Devas mentioned as Amitabhas. Dama, Data, Vida, Soma, Vitta, Vaidya, Yama, Nidhi, Homa, Havya, Huta, Dana,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Prabhu, Vibhu, Vibhasa, Jeta, Hanta, Ariha, Ritu, Sumati, Pramati, DIpti, Samakhyata, Mahas, Mahan, Deha, Muni, Naya, Jyestha, Sama, Satya and Visruta these are the twenty Devas mentioned as Amitabhas. Dama, Data, Vida, Soma, Vitta, Vaidya, Yama, Nidhi, Homa, Havya, Huta, Dana,…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: एतत्सर्वं समास्थाय नृत्यं शम्भुश्चकार वै
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etatsarvaṃ samāsthāya nṛtyaṃ śambhuścakāra vai
verses.translation: After bowing to Pracetas, henceforth, I shall mention the future Manus who are the Savarna Manus, their origin as well as their prowess. When a short period of Caksusa Manvantara remained and the Vaivasvata Manvantara had begun, those who will be the Manus in the future Manvantara were born. Of those Manus who are the daughter's sons of Pracetasa Daksa, the five named Savarnas and four are born from great sages. One Savarna is the son of Samjna born of Vivasvan (the Sun-god). The eldest son of Samjna is Lord Manu, son of the Sun-god (Vivasvan) Their auspicious manifestation was (took place) at the advent of the Vaivasvata Manvantara. The fourteen Manus are glorified as the enhancer of fame. These Manus are described in the Vedas, Srutis* and Puranas as very powerful Prajapatis. All of them were the lords of all living beings. The entire Earth consisting of the seven continents and mountains is to be protected by these kings for a full thousand Yugas. Their details will be mentioned along with their progeny
verses.hindi: को पालन करने अथं में स्मरण करते हैं। यतः वे इन्द्रणण भूतलोक, भव्य लोक एवं भकक्‍त् लोक--इन तीनों लोकों के पालक हैं अतः ब्राह्मण गण उन्हें भूत भव्य और भव्रत् तीनों का नाथ कहते हैं । प्रत्येक मन्वन्तर में जो देवगण यज्ञ भाग के भोक्ता होते हैं, उन सबों में ये इन्द्र प्रधान तथा गुणों में भी सर्वश्रेष्ठ होते हैं। सभी यक्ष, गन्धर्व, राक्षस, पिशाच, सपं॑ तथा दानव गण इन्हीं देवेन्द्रों की महिमा स्वरूप कहे जाते हैं  वे इन्द्र देवताओं
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing to Pracetas, henceforth, I shall mention the future Manus who are the Savarna Manus, their origin as well as their prowess. When a short period of Caksusa Manvantara remained and the Vaivasvata Manvantara had begun,…

verses.sanskrit: श्रमादजायत स्वेदो गङ्गातोयविमिश्रितम् । पतन्तमुरगो ऽश्नाति हरमौलिविनिर्गतम्
verses.transliteration: śramādajāyata svedo gaṅgātoyavimiśritam / patantamurago 'śnāti haramaulivinirgatam
verses.translation: They hold office as the presiding Authorities in the Manvantaras only once each. After the tenure of their office they resort to Maharloka. (Defective verse) Among them eight have already ceased to operate; (excepting) six more Manus are the others who will come in the future. At present it is Lord Vaivasvata Manu who rules. I shall mention those who remain, those who are the future Brahmanas (Manus), along with Devas, Danavas and sages as well as their (other) creation of the subjects. The details of the creation of these Manus are to be known through the creative activity of Vaivasvata Manu, since they are neither inferior nor superior to those of Vaivasvata Manu. I am not recounting their details for fear of repetition I shall mention them, the creative activities in the different families only partially. The remaining things should be known through their details and in order. Daksa had a pious daughter who was well known as Suvrata. Although she was the youngest of the daughters, she was the most excellent and the most pious. Once the father took her with him and approached Brahma. He was in the Vairaja region seated along with Dharma and Bhava. Brahma spoke to Daksa in the presence of Dharma and Bhava.
verses.hindi: के स्वामी, गुरु, नाथ, राजा एवं पितर-सब कुछ हैं, वे युरोत्तम धमंपूर्वक सभी प्रजाओं का पालन करते जो सम्प्रति स्वगलोक में अवस्थित हैं। इन सातों में परम बुद्धिमानू, कुशिक गोत्रीय, गाधि के पुत्र विश्वामित्र महान् तपस्वी हैं। भूगु गोत्रीय प्रतापशाली उछू पुत्र जमदग्नि हैं। बृहस्पति के पुत्र परम तपस्वी भारद्वाज हैं, परम धामिक एवं उतथ्य के पुत्र गौतम शरद्वान हैं, स्वयम्भू ब्रह्मा के पुत्र ब्रह्मपरायण भगवान् अतन्रि इन ऋषियों में पाँचवें ऋषि हैं, छठे वसिष्ठ के पुत्र लोक विख्यात वसुमान नामक ऋषि हैं, ।२४-२७। सातवें कव्यप गोत्रीय
verses.wordMeaning: They hold office as the presiding Authorities in the Manvantaras only once each. After the tenure of their office they resort to Maharloka. (Defective verse) Among them eight have already ceased to operate; (excepting) six more Manus are the others who will come in the future.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They hold office as the presiding Authorities in the Manvantaras only once each. After the tenure of their office they resort to Maharloka. (Defective verse) Among them eight have already ceased to operate; (excepting) six more Manus are the others who will come in the future.…

verses.sanskrit: मन्दाकिनी ततः क्रुद्धा व्यालस्योपरि भारत । प्राप्नुह्यजगरत् त्वं हि भुजङ्ग क्षुद्रजन्तुक
verses.transliteration: mandākinī tataḥ kruddhā vyālasyopari bhārata / prāpnuhyajagarat tvaṃ hi bhujaṅga kṣudrajantuka
verses.translation: "O Daksa, this, your daughter Suvrata will give birth to four sons who will become the auspicious Manus and stabilise the discipline of four castes." On hearing the words of Brahma, the three—Daksa, Dharma and Bhava approached that girl mentally along with Brahma. The girl immediately gave birth to four sons who were similar to and befitting those four divine personages as they were of truthful meditation. Those sons were born fully endowed with physical bodies, born in a trice but capable of all enjoyment, and com¬ petent to perform all activities. They were endowed with glory. On seeing them, those deities who had realised Brahman began to claim "This is my son, This is my son 5 '. They began to tug at them furiously. Since they mentally created sons through meditation, they said to one another: "Let us select that boy as our respec¬ tive son who is similar to us physically. If a boy is similar to one in features, prowess and name as well as complexion, one shall take him as one's gentle son. A son emulates the features of his father invariably. Hence the son is born taking after the father and the mother."
verses.hindi: वत्सार हैं-ये सत्पुरुषों द्वारा सम्माननीय इस वर्तमान वैवस्वत मन्वतर के सिद्ध सप्तधि हैं। इक्ष्वाकु, नाभाग, धृष्ट, शर्याति, नरिष्यन्त, नाभ, उद्विष्ट, करुष, पृषश्ध और वसुमान ये तववैवस्व॒त मनु के पुत्र कहे गये हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: "O Daksa, this, your daughter Suvrata will give birth to four sons who will become the auspicious Manus and stabilise the discipline of four castes." On hearing the words of Brahma, the three—Daksa, Dharma and Bhava approached that girl mentally along with Brahma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Daksa, this, your daughter Suvrata will give birth to four sons who will become the auspicious Manus and stabilise the discipline of four castes." On hearing the words of Brahma, the three—Daksa, Dharma and Bhava approached that girl mentally along with Brahma.…

verses.sanskrit: वासुकिरुवाच: अनुग्राह्यो ऽस्मि ते पापो दुर्नयो ऽहं हरादृते । त्रैलोक्यपावनी पुण्या सरित्त्वं शुभलक्षणा
verses.transliteration: vāsukiruvāca: anugrāhyo 'smi te pāpo durnayo 'haṃ harādṛte / trailokyapāvanī puṇyā sarittvaṃ śubhalakṣaṇā
verses.translation: After coming to terms like this, they took those boys who were similar in complexion ( Savarna ) to them. Since the boys were similar in complexion to god Brahma and others, they are called Savarna. Since they were meditated upon and were accepted respectfully, they are remembered as Manus. When the Caksu?a Manvantara expired and the Vaivasvata Manvantara set in, a son named Raucya was born to Ruci, the Prajapati. He who was born of Bhuti became known by the name Bhautya. In the Vaivasvata Manvantara two sons were born to Vivasvan. One is well known as Vaivasvata Manu and the other as Savarna. The learned Lord Vaivasvata Manu was the eldest son of Sarhjna. The other Vaivasvata Manu was the son of Savarna (i.e. Chaya, the shadow of Sarhjna). The four Savarna Manus born of the great sages will be equipping themselves with (the power of) penance. They will achieve all their tasks in their respective future Manvantaras. (Defective verse) The sons of the first Merusavarni Manu who was the son of Daksa were the three groups, Marlci- garbhas, Susarmans and Paras. All these noble-souled ones were born in the Vaivasvata Manvantara. They are the sons of Rohita, the Prajapati, the son of Daksa. In future each of these groups will consist of twelve Devas. (Defective) Aisvarya-Sangraha, Raha, Bahuvasa (and the remaining) should be known as twelve Para gods. Under¬ stand the later ones.
verses.hindi: गणना से यहाँ पुत्रों की संख्या दस हो रही है  वास्तव में वेवस्वत के दस पुत्र थे, जेंसा कि अन्य पुराणों में वणित है । अतः यहाँ नव की जगह दस होना चाहिए। नवमः के स्थान पर 'दशमः” स्मृतः होना करुषश्र पृषश्रश्च वसुमान्नवमः स्पृतः । मनोवेंवस्वतस्येते नव पुत्राः प्रकीतिताः ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to terms like this, they took those boys who were similar in complexion ( Savarna ) to them. Since the boys were similar in complexion to god Brahma and others, they are called Savarna. Since they were meditated upon and were accepted respectfully,…

verses.sanskrit: संसारच्छेदनकरी ह्यार्तानामार्तिनाशनी । स्वर्गद्वारे स्थिता त्वं हि दयां कुरु मयीश्वरि
verses.transliteration: saṃsāracchedanakarī hyārtānāmārtināśanī / svargadvāre sthitā tvaṃ hi dayāṃ kuru mayīśvari
verses.translation: Vajiya, Vajijit, Prabhuti, KakudI (?), Dadhikrava, Ayapakva, Pranita, Vijaya, Madhu, Tejasman and two Nathavas—these twelve constitute the Maricis. I shall re¬ count the Susarmans mentioning the names. Listen to (them) and understand. Varna, Anga, Visva, Muranya, Vrajana, Amita, Dravaketu, Jambhostha, Ajasra, Sakraka, Sunemi and Dyuta- pas—these twelve constitute SuSarmans. Their future Indra will be known by the name Adbhuta. The seven sages in the Rohita Manvantara were— Skanda of fiery nature and resembling Soma and otherwise known as Kartikeya, Medhatithi of Pulastya lineage, Vasu of Kasyapa Gotra, Jyotisman of Bhrgu family, Dyutiman of Angiras lineage, Vasita of Vasistha Gotra, Havyavahana of Atri's Gotra and Sutapas of Paulava family. In the tenth revolution (i.e. cycle of four Yugas?) the second Savarni, the son of Dharma, will be the Manu. In his Manvantara, there will be two groups of Devas, viz. Sukhamanas and Viruddhas. All of them will be Tvisivants ('highly effulgent') a hundred in number and mutually equal (?)—alike. They are said to be controlling the breath in (other?) persons by the sages. They will be the Devas at the time of the Manu, son of Dharma. Their Indra will be the great scholar Santi. The Seven Great Sages will be the glorious Havisman of the Pulaha family, Suklrti of Bhrgu race, Apomurti of Atri lineage, Apava (?) of Vasi$jha family, Pratipa of Pulastya family, Nabhaga of Kasyapa family and Abhimanyu of Angiras family. The ten sons ofManuwill be—Suksetra, Uttama- ujas, Bhurisena, Vlryavan, Satanlka, Niramitra, Vrsasena, Jayadratha, Bhuridyumna and Suvarcas. In the eleventh revo¬ lution (cycle of four Yugas) when the third Savarni will be the Manu, the following three groups of noble-souled Devas will be famous: Nirmanaratis, Kamajas (Kamagas in Bd.P.) and Manojavas. Each of these groups consists of thirty units. The thirty days in a month mentioned by the poets constitute the Devas Nirmanaratis. The nights (known as?) Vihangamas (constitute the Kamaja Devas). The Muhurtas constitute the Devas Manojavas. These are the three groups of Devas men¬ tioned, These future Manus are remembered as the sons of Brahma. Their Indra, the king of Suras, will be called Vfsa. Listen and understand their Seven Sages who are being glori¬ fied.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गोवाच: कुरुष्व विपुलं विन्ध्यं तपस्त्वं शङ्करं प्रति । ततः प्राप्स्यसि स्वं स्थानं पन्नगत्वं ममाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: gaṅgovāca: kuruṣva vipulaṃ vindhyaṃ tapastvaṃ śaṅkaraṃ prati / tataḥ prāpsyasi svaṃ sthānaṃ pannagatvaṃ mamājñayā
verses.translation: They are—Havisman of Kasyapa family, Vapusman of Bhrgu's race, Varuni of Atri lineage, Bhaga of Vasistha's family, Pusti who should be known as hailing from Angiras family, Niscara of Pulastya race and Agnitejas of Pulaha family. They are also the Devas in the eleventh Manvantara. The following are the sons of Prajapatya (son of Prajapati) Savarna Manu—Sarvavega, Sudharma, Devanlka, Purovaha, Ksema- dharma, Grhesu, Adarsa and Paunqhaka. The Devas will be—Haritas, Rohitas, Sumanas, Sukar- mans and Suparas. These are remembered as the five groups of Devas. They are the mental sons of Brahma. Each of these groups consists of ten Devas. The following ten constitute the Harita group of Devas: Aruntija, Hari (? Havi), Vidvan (whose followers are) in thousands, Parvatanucara, Apas, Amsu (prob. Apamsu as in Bd.P.), Manojava, Urja, Svaha, Svadha lixcL Tara The following ten constitute the Rohita group: Understand the Sukarmans. They are—Suparva, Vrsabha, Prsta, Krpi, Dyurana, Vipascita, Vikrama, Karma, Nibhrta and Kanta. These Devas are Sukarmans. Now under¬ stand their sons (i.e. Suparas?) They are: Varyodita, Jista, Varcasvl, Dyutiman, Havi, Subha, Havikrta, Prapti, Vyaprtha and Dasama (?) These are the mentally created ones the Suparas, the Devas mentioned (before). Rtadhama of great fame should be known as their Indra. The Seven Sages are—Krti the son of Vasistha, Sutapas of Atri's family, Tapomurti of the Angiras race, Tapas- vin of Kasyapa Gotra, Taposyana of Pulastya family, Taporati of Pulaha Gotra and the seventh of them should be known as Tapomati of Bhrgu family. These are the Siddhas, the Seven Sages in the Savarnika Manvantara. The following are the sons of the twelfth (?) Manu: Devavan, Upadeva, Devzisrestha, Viduratha, Mitravan, Mitrabindu, Mitrasena, Amitraha, Mitrabahu, and Suvargas. In the thirteenth revolution (Manvantara), the Raucya Manvantara, three groups of Devas are mentioned by the self- born deity (Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो ऽसौ त्वरितो विन्ध्यं नागो गत्वा नगं शुभम् । तपस् तप्तुं समारेभे शङ्कराराधनोद्यतः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato 'sau tvarito vindhyaṃ nāgo gatvā nagaṃ śubham / tapas taptuṃ samārebhe śaṅkarārādhanodyataḥ
verses.translation: They are said to be the future Somapayins (Imbi¬ bers of Soma juice), the groups of Devas. Along with the per¬ formers of Yajnas, the deities are thirtythree in number. They include the Ajya, Pfsadajya and Grahajyestha groups of Devas. Listen to and understand that the thirtythree Devas are separate ones. The Sutramans are the present Prayajyas and Ajyapas. The Anuyajyas and those who partake Pfsadajya are Sukarmans. The Upayajyas are Sudharmans. Thus the Devas have been recounted. Divaspati of great prowess will be their Indra. The sons of Ruci should be known as the grand¬ sons of Pulaha. The Seven Sages in the thirteenth Manvantara will be—Dhrtiman of Angiras family, Pathyavan of Pulastya race, Tattvadarsin of Pulaha family, Nirutsaka of Bhrgu Gotra, Nisprakampa of Atri's family, Nirmoha ofKasyapa Gotra and Svarupa of Vasistha lineage. The following are the sons of Raucya Manu in the thirteenth Manvantara: Citrasena, Vicitra, Tapas, Dharmadhrta, Bhava, Anekabaddha, Ksatrabaddha, Surasa, Nirbhaya and Prtha. In the fourteenth Bhautya Manvantara, the future groups of Devas are five. The five groups of Devas arc—Caksusas, Kanisthas, Pavitras, Bhajaras and Yacavrddhas. Know that the seven different parts are those named Caksusas. They understand Brhada and other Samans as the Kanisthas. The seven worlds are Paritras (Pavitras?) The Bhajiras (Bhajaras) are the seven Sindhus (oceans, rivers). Know the sages to be Vacavrddhas belonging to Svayambhuva Manu (?) AU the Indras of the Manvantaras should be known as having equal characteristics (and powers)..... Those Indras excel all the mobile and the immobile living beings in the three worlds by means of their splendour, penance, intellect, strength, learning and exploits. The Indras (or Devas) are Bhutapavadins, Hfstas, Medhyasthas, Bhutavadins, Bhutanuvadins. The three Vedas are competent in respect to Pravadins (arguers.) Agnidhra, Kasyapa, Paulastya, Magadha, Bharga, Agnibahu, lud. Aigirasa, Ojaavm, and Snbala are the som of
verses.hindi: सातवें मन्वन्तर का वृत्तान्त वर्णन मैं कर चुका । है द्विजगण ! द्वितीय चरण का मैं विस्तार पूर्वक क्रमिक वर्णन कर चुका, अब आगे किस विषय का वर्णन करूँ ?

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं दध्यौ महादेवं त्र्यक्षं डमरुकोद्यतम् । ततो वर्षशते पूर्ण उपरुद्धो जगद्गुरुः । आगतस्तत्समीपं तु श्लक्ष्णां वाणीमुदाहरत्
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ dadhyau mahādevaṃ tryakṣaṃ ḍamarukodyatam / tato varṣaśate pūrṇa uparuddho jagadguruḥ / āgatastatsamīpaṃ tu ślakṣṇāṃ vāṇīmudāharat
verses.translation: Then, at the end of the Manvantara, the seven Devas of the Bhrgu family, the powerful sovereign rulers, who had enjoyed the three worlds for seventyone cycles of four Yugas by remaining within them, and who used to perform Yajfias along with the Pitrs, Manus and the Seven Sages will then aban¬ don the three worlds and go to Maharloka along with their devotees and those who perform Yajfias. When they proceed upwards, and when the Manvantara expires, all the three worlds will be rendered without any support. O Brahmanas! Thereafter, the abodes presided over by deities become vacant and fall down along with constella¬ tions, stars and planets getting hurled and destroyed. Thereafter, when the lords of the three worlds including the eight Indras pass away, the fourteen groups of Devas beginning with (A)jita and others and ending with Caksusas—the Devas who were very mighty and full of splen¬ dour in all the Manvantaras—will go to Maharloka where they will become identical with those Devas who stay there till the end of the Kalpa. It is reported that when the time of Samhara (lit. heaping and collision— Sankalana) comes those fourteen groups of Devas will forsake Maharloka and go to Janaloka with (i.e. preserving) their physical bodies and accompanied by their followers. Thus when the Devas have gone from Maharloka to Janaloka, when BhQtadi (Cosmic Ego— Ahamkara ) and other (prime causes of the universe) remain and (even) immobiles have come to an end, when the abodes of the worlds beginning with Bhuh and ending with Mahah have become void, when the Devas have gone upward and become united with the Kalp- avasins (those who stay till the end of the Kalpa), after withdrawing (annihilating) those Devas, Sages, Pitps and Danavas, god Brahma with his powerful vision sees that it is the end of the Yuga and puts an end to his creation. The knowers of day and night of god Brahma under¬ stand that the day of Brahma consists of a thousand cycles of four Yugas and similarly the night too consists of a thousand cycles of four Yugas. This Pratisaficara (Dissolution & Reabsorption) of all

verses.sanskrit: वरं वरय मे वत्स पन्नग त्वं कृतादर
verses.transliteration: varaṃ varaya me vatsa pannaga tvaṃ kṛtādara
verses.translation: The Naimittika dissolution is the burning (of the Uni¬ verse) at the end of the Kalpa and complete withdrawal (of all beings) by god Brahma. The destruction of Karanas (instru¬ ments or means and causes) of living beings during Pratisarga (absorption) into Prakrti is called Prakrta type of dissolution. The dissolution due to dawning of spiritual knowledge is said to be the ultimate one ( Alyantika,) as it renders the seeds (causes) of Samsara, impossible. After dissolving all the Devas residing in the three worlds at the end of his day and when he feels the urge to sleep (?), Lord Brahma destroys all the subjects and dissolves all the creation. Then at the end of a thousand cycles of Caturjiugas, when the period of annihilation of Yuga arrives, Prajapati (Lord of subjects, viz. Brahma) begins to make the subjects abide in him (i.e. absorb in himself). Then a drought sets in lasting for a hundred years. Those living beings on the surface of the Earth, (still left) being deficient in strength become dissolved and are merg¬ ed into the Earth. The Sun then rises up with seven rays consti¬ tuting his chariot. Lord Sun of unbearable rays begins to suck up water through his rays. Those seven rays will be green in colour and Spreading over the forest ('the sky'-Bd.P.) gradually they get transformed again. The wood over the earth, wealth and refulgence begin to blaze with water (?) Hence it is water that is said to be the cause of the blazing of the Sun. With drought the Sun does not blaze. With drought the Sun has no halo(?) Then those seven rays assuming the forms of seven Suns, burn the four quarters and the four worlds like fires.
verses.hindi: पादः क्वान्तो5द्वितोयोध्यमनुषद्धः ण यस्त्वया । तृतीय॑ विस्तरात्पादं सोपोद्धातं +कीतंय ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Naimittika dissolution is the burning (of the Uni¬ verse) at the end of the Kalpa and complete withdrawal (of all beings) by god Brahma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Naimittika dissolution is the burning (of the Uni¬ verse) at the end of the Kalpa and complete withdrawal (of all beings) by god Brahma.…

verses.sanskrit: वासुकिर् उवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि मे देव वरं दास्यसि शङ्कर । प्रसादात्तव देवेश भूयान्निष्पापता मम । तीर्थं किंचित्समाख्याहि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: vāsukir uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva varaṃ dāsyasi śaṅkara / prasādāttava deveśa bhūyānniṣpāpatā mama / tīrthaṃ kiṃcitsamākhyāhi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: The fiery rays reach the top and bottom (of the worlds). Seven Suns and the blazing fires of dissolution shine fiercely. Ignited and illuminated by means of the water, thous¬ ands of rays envelop the sky and scorch the Earth. Being burnt by their blazing heat, the Earth inclusive of the oceans and the mountains becomes bereft of moisture and viscidity. The nether regions, the upper regions and the sides are restrained by the illuminated rays of the Sun of various colours and spreading everywhere. The scorching rays of the Sun and the leaping flames of the fires mingling with one another appear to be a single unit with a single flame. That fire becomes a mass of fiery zone creating the destruction of all the worlds. With its brilliance it scorches all the four worlds. All the mobile and the immobile beings get dissolved. The Earth, devoid of trees and even grass, appears like the back of a tortoise shell. The entire universe destroyed and affected by misfor¬ tune appears like a frying pan. The whole of the sky, filled with the burning rays, blazes fiercely.
verses.hindi: कीतंयिष्ये तृतोयं च सोपोद्धातं सविस्तरम् । पाद॑ सम्ुदयाद्विप्रा गदतों मे निबोधत चतुर्युगेकसप्तत्या संख्यातः पूर्वमेब तु । सह देवगणेश्चेव ऋषिभिर्दानवे: सह ५
