verses.sanskrit: प्रीयतां मे जगन्नाथो व्याधिर् नश्यतु मे ध्रुवम् । द्विजाय काञ्चने दत्ते यत्फलं तच्छृणुष्व मे
verses.transliteration: prīyatāṃ me jagannātho vyādhir naśyatu me dhruvam / dvijāya kāñcane datte yatphalaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me
verses.translation: Really the staff-bearing ascetic (Sannyasin) does not incur sins or acquire merits. Hence he renounces all activities and meditates on Visnu with noble thoughts. One may renounce all Karmans but should not for¬ swear the Vedas. He should shave liis head outside the limits of the holy centre to the east, west, south or north. The area of the sacred place of Gaya, as declared by Brahma, is two and a half krosas (1 krosa = 5 km.), that of the holy centre Gaya is five krosas and that of Gayasiras (Headland of Gaya) is one krosa. 2 Cf. NP. II. 45.31. Cf. N 44.16; A 42 Whatever holy places there are in the three worlds are present within 1 (the area of Gayas'iras). A person who performs Sraddha to the Pitps in the holy centre of Gaya be¬ comes free from indebtedness to them.
verses.hindi: सूत ने कह्टा--ऋषिवृस्द !” प्राचीन काल में पुष्कर क्षेत्र में कश्यप का एक अश्वमेष यज्ञ हुआ था, जिसमें ऋषि देवताओं एवं गन्धर्वथों के समुद्र आकर उस यज्ञ को झोभावद्धि कर रुहे थे । उस महान् यज्ञ में शास्त्रीय विधि सम्मत आख्यान आदि के लिये पाँच सुबर्णं मिमित आसन स्थापित किये गये थे ।५३-५४। कुश से पबित्रित तीम आसन ये, एक पर कूच (कुश को मुट्ठी) ओर पाँचवे पर फलक स्थापित

verses.sanskrit: बहुस्वर्णस्य यत्प्रोक्तं यागस्य फलमुत्तमम् । तथासौ लभते सर्वं काञ्चनं यः प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: bahusvarṇasya yatproktaṃ yāgasya phalamuttamam / tathāsau labhate sarvaṃ kāñcanaṃ yaḥ prayacchati
verses.translation: He who performs Sraddha at Gayasiras uplifts a hundred generations in his family. The moment one starts on his pilgri¬ mage to Gaya, every step that he takes (on his journey of Gaya) constitutes a flight of steps leading to Svarga to his Pitrs (ancestors). At every step taken (by the son) in his journey towards Gaya, the fruit of Asvamedha is certainly acquired by him. There is no doubt in this. Pindas in Gaya are offered by means of milk pudding, Cams (cooked rice soaked in ghee), Saktu (flour of fried grains), Pisiaka, rice grains, roots etc. Powdered gingelly seeds, lumps of jaggery with ghee or mere curds, any foodstuff mixed with honey, oilcake with jaggery, raw sugar and ghee, if offered to the Pitrs yield everlasting benefits. Or worship is performed' and any seasonal fruit is offered as food or Havisya food is also offered as mentioned by the sages. On one side are all the articles of offering such as clo¬ thes and things sweetened with tasty honey. On the other side is the sacred water from the Phalgutlrtha brought after meditating on the lotus-like feet of Gadadhara (i.e. Both these are at par with each other). The procedure of the Sraddhas in the holy centres is this: Seat is offered to Pindas; Pindas are offered, then Avanejana rite is performed (water is ritualistically sprinkled on the Darbha grass); Daksina is then offered and then the Annasamkalpa (ritualistic verbal utterance of one's intention of offering food). In the Sraddhas performed in the holy centres, there is no ritualistic invocation to Pitrs. As there is no defilement through seeing (i.e. on being seen by others) there is no screen- ing of the sides. Intelligent persons should perform Sraddha with due sympathy.
verses.hindi: था । चार मुख्य पुरोहितों के लिए उन चार की स्थापना की गईं थी । उनमें एक पाँचवाँ जो सर्वेश्रेष्ठ आसन था वह होता के लिये निदिष्ट किया बया था। बहू दिव्य आसम नीचे से ऊपर तक सब सुवर्णमय था, एवं बिछावस से सुझ्ोभित हो रहा था। गर्भवती दिति, कश्यप की पत्मी के रूप में बगल में बैठी थी उसके उदर में दस सइस्र वर्ष का गर्भ था ।१५४०५७। ठीक उसी समय वह गर्भ माता के उदर से निकलकर उस पाँचवें निषसाद स गर्भोषत्र तत्राइसीनः शश्शंस च (५८ आख्यानपश्चमान्वेदान्महर्षि: काश्यपो यथा। त॑ दृष्ट्वा मुनयस्तस्य नामाकुर्वेस्तु तद्विधिम् ३५६ हिरण्यकशिपुस्तस्मात्कमंणा तेन विश्वुतः । हिरण्पाक्षोध्नुजस्तस्थ सिंहिका तस्य चानुजा ॥॥

verses.transliteration: tena dānena pūtātmā mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnuyāt / rudrasyānucaras tāvad yāvad indrāścaturdaśa
verses.translation: In other places, the Pitrs if and when invoked at the By a person desirous of fruits and performing Sraddhas in the holy centres all the rites must always be performed after eschewing lust, anger and covetousness. One who observes celibacy, sleeps on the bare ground, takes food only once a day, speaks only the truth, remains always pure and is always engaged in the welfare of all living beings, attains the fruits of visiting the holy centres. A self-possessed man visiting holy centres must at the outset eschew heresy. A person who does everything urged by lust, should be known as a heretic. Just as the knowers of Brahman engaged in the meditation of Brahman with single-minded attention attain the knowable object, so also the self-possessed persons performing the holy rites in the holy centres enter Brahman named Paresa (the supreme lord). The river Vaitaran! which is famous in all the three worlds, has descended into the holy centre of Gaya for saving Pitrs. One who takes the sacred bath in the Vaitarani and gifts away cows uplifts three times seven (i.e. twentyone)
verses.hindi: राहोः सा जननी देवी विप्रत्तित्ते: परिग्रहः ६०

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सुवर्णशिलातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुरधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १०५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: करञ्जाख्यं ततो गच्छेत् सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः । तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe suvarṇaśilātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 105 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: karañjākhyaṃ tato gacchet sopavāso jitendriyaḥ / tatra snātvā tu rājendra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: How was Gayasura (Demon Gaya) born? What was his power? What was his nature? How did he perform the penance? How did he acquire purity of the body? Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, was born of the umbilical lotus of Visnu. Formerly, at the instance of lord Visnu, he created the subjects. Formerly he created the Asuras (Demons) through a demoniac inclination. Through a benevolent disposition of mind he created theDevas of gentle minds. Demon Gaya possessed the greatest strength and exploit among Asuras. His height is remembered to be one hundred and twentyfive Yojanas. His girth was sixty Yojanas. He is remembered as the most excellent of all the devotees of Visnu. He performed a very terrible penance on the excellent mountain Kolahala (Brahma- yoni hill including Muntfapr${ha at Gaya). He remained steady for many thousand years without breathing. Scorched by his fiery penance, Devas were greatly agitated. Devas went to Brahmaloka and spoke to Pitamaha (god Brahma), "O Lord, save us from demon Gaya". Then Brahma spoke to the Devas: "O Devas, we shall go to god Sankara." Brahma and others went to Siva. At Kailasa, they bowed to him and said, "O Lord, save us from the great demon". Sarhbhu spoke to Brahma and others: "We shall seek refuge in Hari, in the ocean of milk. He is the lord of all Devas. He will do something conducive to our welfare". Brahma, Siva and the Devas bowed to Visnu and eulogised him. Om! Obeisance to Visnu, the lord of all, the all- powerful, the radiant, the victorious and the devourer (destro¬ yer) of Raksasas and others. Hail to the sustainer of all these (worlds). Bow to him who leads the Yogins beyond (the ocean of worldly existence). Obeisance to the ever-increasing, the Infinite. Hail to the resplendent one. On being eulogised thus, Vasudeva granted vision unto the Suras (i.e. manifested himself in front of them). O Devas, wherefore have you all come?" On being asked thus by Visnu the Devas said to him: "O Lord, save us from the danger of demon Gaya". Hari said, "May Brahma and others go near that Daitya. I shall also come there". Seated on Garuda, Kesava started in order to grant a boon to Gayasura. All the Devas seated themselves on their respective excellent vehicles and proceeded. Vasudeva and others spoke to him: "O demon Gaya, what for is this penance being performed by you? We have all arrived here fully satisfied (with your penance). Mention the boon (you wish to have) O Devas, Brahma, Visnu and Mahcsvara, if you are pleased, may I be ever holier than these: than all the Devas, and Brahmanas, than all the Yajfias, holy rivers and mountains; than all the Devas; than all the sages; than even the unchanging Siva; than all the Mantras; than all the lords of Devas; than all the Yogins; than all the renouncers; than all the Karmins (the performers of holy rites); than all the Dharmins (pious ones); than all the holy Jhdnins (wise ones and knowers). "May you be pure and holy". After saying this to the Daitya, the Devas went to heaven. After seeing and touching the Daitya, all people went to Hari's city (i.e. Vaikuntha). All the three worlds became vacant. The whole of the city of Yama became void. Thereafter, Yama went to Brahma- loka along with Indra and others. All the Devas displaced by Gayasura spoke to Brahma: "O Pitamaha, please take back the authority which has been given by you (to us)." Then Brahma spoke to the Devas: "We shall go to the immutable Visnu". Brahma and others said to Visnu: "Since the Asura has been granted the boon by you, all the people have been going to heaven by merely looking at him. All the three worlds have become void." On being informed thus by the Devas, Vasudeva spoke thus to god Brahma: Go and request the demon thus, 'Give your body for the purpose of YajnaV* Urged by Visnu, Brahma went there accompanied by the Suras and saw the great Asura. On seeing Brahma along with the Devas, the demon Gaya stood up and duly and devoutly worshipped them. My birth has become fruitful today. My penance has
verses.hindi: सुशोभित आसन पर, जो होता के लिये निर्दिष्ट था, बेठ गया और अपने पिता मह॒षि कश्यप की भाँति वहीं से वेद एवं आख्यानात्मक पाँचवें वेद का व्याख्यान देने लघा  उस बालक को इस प्रकार देखकर सभी ऋषियों ने तदनुकूल नामकरण किया। अपने उक्त अद्भुत कर्म के कारण वह हिरण्यकशिपु नाम से विख्यात हुआ। उसका छोटा भाई हिरण्याक्ष था और सिहिका छोटी बहन थी । वह सिंहिका देबी

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयित्वा महादेवं दत्त्वा दानं तु भक्तितः । सुवर्णं रजतं वापि मणिमौक्तिकविद्रुमान्
verses.transliteration: arcayitvā mahādevaṃ dattvā dānaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ / suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi maṇimauktikavidrumān
verses.translation: O Yogin, O knovver of all the ancillaries of Yoga, O master of all the worlds, O father, O preceptor, O Brahma, I shall carry out the work for which you have come. All the holy centres of the earth seen by me while wandering over it, are not as pure as your body, for the purpose of Yajna. Holiness of the body has been attained by you, thanks to the grace of Visnu. Hence, O Asura, give unto me your pure body for the purpose of Yajna. O lordofDevas, I am blessed since my body is being asked for by you. If you perform Yaga (sacrifice) over my body the Pitrs in my family shall be contented. After saying thus, during the Sveta Kalpa, the demon Gaya fell on the ground in a south-western direction on the mountain Kolahala. 1 Keeping his head in the north and the feet in the south, the Daitya (lay there). After collecting together all the requisi¬ tes, Brahma mentally created the Rtviks. They were: Agnis'arman, Ampta, Saunaka, Yan- jali, Mrdu, Kumuthi, VedakaundBya, Harita, Kasyapa, Krpa, Garga, Kausika, Vasistha, the unchanging sage Bhargava, Vrddha Parasara, Kanva, Mandavya, Srutikevala, Sveta, Sutala, Damana, Suhotra, Kanka, Laukaksi of huge mighty arms, Jaiglsavya, the Brahmana Dadhipaficamukha, Rsabha, Karka, Katyayana, Go- bhila the sage of great fierce rites, Supalaka, Gautama, Vedasi- rovrata, Jatamalin, Avyagra, Catuhasa the terrible, Atreya, The Brahmayoni hill in Gaya, including the hill called Mup<?apr?tha which contains the impressions of Gadadhara's feet De 20 i. After creating these and other leading Brahmanas, god Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, performed the Yaga on the body of Gayasura. AgniSarma, without wasting his penance, created these five fires from his mouth: Daksinagni, Garhapatya, Ahavanlya, Satya and Avasathya. O celestial sage, the Yajnas are founded on these. To stabilise the Yajna, he gave Daksina to the Brahmanas. After performing the Purnahuti and taking the ablution of Avabhrtha, Brahma caused the sacrificial post to be brought along with the Suras and fixed it. The auspicious post was fixed in the Brahmasaras which is the most excellent of all lakes. Shaken and surprised, Brahma spoke to Dharmaraja: "There is a slab of stone in your house. Without hesita¬ tion bring it here at my behest and fix it on the head of the Daitya." On hearing it, Yama placed the slab on the head of the demon to keep him steady. Even when the slab was placed, the demon shook along with the slab. He spoke to Rudra and other Devas, "O Devas, you all stand steady on the slab". They said "Yes" and stood there (on it). The Devas pressed the slab with their feet (?) and noted that still the demon quaked. Then the distressed Brahma went to Visnu who was lying down in the ocean of milk. Bowing down and honouring the lord, he eulogised him. O Lord, O sovereign of the cosmic egg, I bow down to the lord of the worlds, the goal of persons possessing glory, the granter of worldly pleasures and salvation. Visvaksena spoke to Visnu,"O Lord, the lotus-born deity eulogises you". Hari said, "You bring him". Urged by Visnu, he brought him. Hari spoke to Aja (Brahma), "Tell me why you have come?" O Lord of Devas, when the Yaga was performed the demon Gaya moved even when the slab of stone of the form of the Devas was placed on his head. Even when Rudra and other Devas were stationed (over it) there, the demon quaked, O Madhava, be pleased to make it steady now. On hearing the words of Brahma, lord Hari pulled out a Murti (physical body/idol) from his person and gave it to Brahma to stop the restless quaking (of the demon). Bringing the idol with him, Brahma placed it on the slab of stone. Still the demon quaked, on seeing which, he (Brahma) invoked the lord again. Visnu came from the ocean of milk and stationed him¬ self on the slab, with the name of Janardana and Pundartka. The primordial Gadadhara (wielder of mace) himself stood there to steady the slab, for stabilising (Gaya or his body). For stabilising (Gaya or his body), Brahma divided himself into five, viz. Prapitamaha (Great-grandfather), Pitamaha (Grandfather), the master of Phalgu, Kedara and Kanakd- vara. Brahma as Vinayaka stood therein the form of an elephant. The Sun divided himself into three: Gayaditya, Uttararka and Daksinarka. Laksmi stood there in the name of Sita, Gauti in the name of Mangala and Sarasvatl stationed herself in the forms of the three, viz. Gayatii, Savitrl, and Trisandhya.
verses.hindi: विप्रचित्त की पत्नी तथा राहु की माता हुई। देत्यवर हिरण्यकशिपु ने परमकठोर तपस्या की । एक लाख वर्षों तक निराहार रहकर वह शिर को नीचे करके तपस्या में लीन रहा ।५८-६१। है विप्रवयव॒न्द ! देत्य हिरण्यकशिपु की इस घोर तपस्या से सन्तुष्ट होकर ब्रह्मा ने अपने वरदान से उस्ले प्रसन्न किमा, जिससे उसने सभी जीवों द्वारा मृत्यु को न प्राप्त करने अपने योगवल से देवताओं को भी पराजित कर देने तथा अमरो (देवताओं) के सभी धर्मों को प्राप्त करने का वरदान प्राप्त किया । इसके अतिरिक्त उसने यह वरदान याचता की कि सभी दानव एवं असुर भी देवताओं के समान ऐश्वयंशाली हो जाये. और मारुत (वायु) मैं जो महान ऐश्वयं है वह भी हमें प्राप्त हो ।” हिरण्यकशिपु की ऐसी वरदान याचना को सुनकर ब्रह्मा ने उसको मनः कामनापूर्ण की और उस दिव्य बरदानों को देने के उपरान्त वे वहीं अन्तहित हो गये । उस परमप्रभाव-
verses.wordMeaning: O Yogin, O knovver of all the ancillaries of Yoga, O master of all the worlds, O father, O preceptor, O Brahma, I shall carry out the work for which you have come. All the holy centres of the earth seen by me while wandering over it, are not as pure as your body,…

verses.sanskrit: पादुकोपानहौ छत्रं शय्यां प्रावरणानि च । कोटिकोटिगुणं सर्वं जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: pādukopānahau chatraṃ śayyāṃ prāvaraṇāni ca / koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Indra, Brhaspati, Pusan, the eight Vasus of great strength, Visvcdevas. thetwoAsvini Devas, Marnts, the leader of the universe and Devas along with the Yaksas, serpents, and Gandharvas remained there accompanied by their respective Saktis (powers). Since the Daitya was made steady by the primordial club and Hari stood there, he is famous as Adi-Gadadhara. 1 Gayasura spoke to the Devas, "Why have I been dece¬ ived? The pure body was given unto Brahma by me for the pur¬ pose of Yajiia. Would not have I been steady at the sheer ins¬ tance of Visnu? Etymology quoted in TSS ( Trislhalisetu ), Why have I been harassed by Suras and Hari by means of the club? May Devas be delighted for ever now that I have been tortured." Gadadhara and others were pleased. They all simul¬ taneously spoke to Gayasura, "Speak out (choose) a boon. We are all very delighted". Gayasura then spoke to Devas: "As long as the earth lasts, as long as the mountains, the Moon, the Sun and the stars remain, may Visnu, Brahma and Mahesvara stand on the slab along with all other Devas. Let the holy centre be named after me. The holy centre of Gaya shall extend to five krosas and Gayasiras to one krosa. Amidst them may all the holy centres grant welfare unto all men. By taking ablution etc. and performing Tarpana one should offer balls of rice. Then it is more fruitful. That man becomes a great soul and. uplifts a thousand members of his family. All of you, slay (here) for ever in manifest and un- manifest forms. May Gadadhara himself be the destroyer of all sins. May those on whose behalf the Sraddha has been perlormed and Pindas offered, go to lirahmaloka. May the sins due to p.rahmana slaughter etc. of those who report to this holy centre perish, May all the holy centres in heaven, firm?vinent and the earth such as Naimisa, Puskara, Ganga, Pravaga, Avimuktaka and others come here regularly, O Suras, and yield welfare unto all men. O hosts of Devas, of what avail is much talk. Unless one of you Devas stand (on this slab), I too will not be steady. This is the condition. Let it be strictly observed." On hearing the words of Gayasura, Visnu and other Suras spoke, "All that you have requested for shall undoubt¬ edly be granted. After worshipping our feet (all the devotees) will attain the great goal." When the boons were granted to him by Devas, the Daitya became delighted and remained steady. When Devas stood steady, the urborn deity (Brahma) gave unto Brahmanas fifty-five villages and the After giving away all these things and bowing to Adigadadhara Brahma went to Brahmaloka. The Brahmanas of Gaya officiated as priests of Dharma in his sacrifice at Dharmaranya and later begged him (for D'aksina). Out of covetousness they took monetary and other gifts at the sacrifice of Dharma. Brahma came there and cursed the Brahmanas. 1 "O Brahmanas even when everything had been given by me, you coveted for more. Hence you will always be burdened with debts. The river shall flow with water only (and not milk). The mountains of foodstuffs will turn into those of rocks. All the rivers shall flow with water and your houses will be of mud. Kamadhenu and the Kalpa-tree will come back to my own region." Cursed thus by Brahma all those Brahmanas imploringly said to the Unborn deity: "O lord, everything that had been given by you has gone off due to your curse. May you be kind enough to assign something for our livelihood". On hearing those words, the sympathetic Brahma spoke tjius to the Brahmanas: "As long as the Moon and the Sun shine, you will be maintaining your livelihood by means of (the earning at the) holy centres. Those meritorious persons who perform Sraddhas in Gaya will attain Brahmaloka. I will also always be considered worshipped by those who worship you." verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे करञ्जतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १०६ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । सौभाग्यकरणं दिव्यं नरनारीमनोरमम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karañjatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 106 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / saubhāgyakaraṇaṃ divyaṃ naranārīmanoramam
verses.translation: What is the origin of that slab whereby Gayasura was kept steady and submissive? What is its form? What is its greatness? Please mention its name. There was once a highly refulgent person named Dharma. He had mastered all sacred lore. His wife Visvarupa was devoted to the service of her husband. A daughter of great qualities and endowed with all the auspicious characteristics like LaksmI was born of her to Dharma. She was the chaste girl named Dharmavrata.
verses.hindi: वह राजा हिरण्यकशिपु जिस-जिस दिशा को जाता था उसनन्‍उस दिलश्या के लिये महर्षियों समेत देवगण एवंप्रभावो देत्येग्रों हिरण्यकशिपुद्धिजा:। तस्था55सीज्नरसिह: स विष्णुम्त त्यु: पुरा किल ॥।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र या दुर्भगा नारी नरो वा नृपसत्तम । स्नात्वार्चयेद् उमारुद्रौ सौभाग्यं तस्य जायते
verses.transliteration: tatra yā durbhagā nārī naro vā nṛpasattama / snātvārcayed umārudrau saubhāgyaṃ tasya jāyate
verses.translation: Whatever good qualities there are in the three worlds, were present in her. Dharma searched for a befitting bride¬ groom to Dharmavrata in all the three worlds, but in vain. Then he told her, "Perform a penance for the sake of attaining a bridegroom". She said, "So be it", and went to the forest. That girl performed a very severe penance which could not be performed by anyone. She subsisted only on the air and spent ten thousand Yugas in that Sveta Kalpa. During the course of his wandering over the earth, the mental son of Brahma, well known by the name of Marici, saw that jewel of a girl.

verses.transliteration: tṛtīyāyāmahorātraṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ / nimantrayed dvijaṃ bhaktyā sapatnīkaṃ surūpiṇam
verses.translation: To that girl who was endowed with beauty and youth and who was engaged in the greatest penance, Marici asked, "Tell me who you are and to whom you belong. O timid lady, of excellent vows, you are a fascinating one by this beauty of yours. I am the son of Brahma, well- known as Marici. I have mastered the Vedas." On hearing the words of Marici, the girl replied to the sage, "I am the daughter of Dharma. My name is Dharma¬ vrata. I am endowed with penance.
verses.hindi: हिरण्पाक्षसुताः पच्च विक्रान्ता: सुमहाबलाः । उत्कुरः शकुनिश्चेव कालनाभस्तथंव च ६६७ महानाभश्न विक्रान्तो भुतसंतापनस्तथा । हिरण्याक्षसुता होते देवरपि दुरासदा: ६८ तेषां पुत्राश्व पौत्राश्व वाडेय: स गणः स्मृतः  शत तानि सहल्लाणि निह॒तास्तारकामये ३६६ ब्रह्मघ्नस्तु सहावोयों मूकस्तु हृददायिनः । मारीचः सुन्दपुत्रस्तु ताडकामुपपच्यते ७२ ताडका निहता साउथ राधवेण बलीयसा। म्को विनिहतश्रापि किराते सव्यसाचिना ७३ उत्पन्ना महता चेव तपसा भाविताः स्वयम् । तिस्र: कोटचस्तु तेषां वे सणिवर्तनिवासिनाम् ॥ अवध्या देवतानां वे निहताः सव्यसाचिना ७४

verses.translation: O leading Brahmana, I am performing this great penance for the wooing of a good husband". Marici thereupon spoke to Dharmavrata lovingly: "O woman of auspicious rites, by merely looking at me, you will become a great chaste lady. I am roaming day and night on the earth, only with a desire to meet with a chaste lady. If you have become a Pativrata, I shall resort to you Come unto me.as your bridegroom. There is no other girl in the world like you, and you will never have another bride- groom equal to me.

verses.transliteration: bhojayitvā yathānyāyaṃ pradakṣiṇamudāharet / prīyatāṃ me mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: Hence O Dharmavrata, be my lawfully wedded wife now". Dharmavrata thereupon told the sage, "O sage of good rites, request Dharma (for my hand)." On hearing those words, he went to Dharma. Dhanna saw the (prospective) bridegroom like a mass of refulgence. He bowed to him and honoured him with the offer of seat and materials of worship. On being asked "Why have you come?" Marici replied to Dharma, "While roaming over the whole earth for the sake of a (marriageable) girl, your excellent daughter has been seen by me. Give that daughter unto me. You will have welfare resulting therefrom."
verses.hindi: शकुनि, कालनाभ महानाभ तथा भूतसन्तापन थे । हिरण्याक्ष के ये पुत्र देवताओं द्वारा भी पराजित नहीं किये जा सकते थे ।६५-६८। उन पुत्रों के जो पुत्र पौत्रादि हुये वे वाडेयगणों के नाम से विख्यात हुये, उनकी संख्या एक लाख की थी, जो सब के सब तारकामय नामक संग्राम में नष्ट हुये । हिरण्यकशिपु के चार महाबलवानु पुत्र हुए, जिनमें सबसे बड़े का नाम प्रह्लाद हुआ, प्रह्लाद से छोटे भाई का नाम अनुह्लाद था, दो उससे भी छोटे हुए, जिनके नाम सल्लाद और हद थे । अब हृद के पुत्रों को सुनिये ।६६-७०। हद के हाद और निसुन्द नामक दो पुत्र हुए । तिनमें निसुन्द के सुन्द और उपसुन्द दो पुत्र हुए  हृद के उत्तराधिकारी सुन्द के पुत्र महाबलशाली ब्रह्म क्र, मूक और मारीच हुए जो ताड़का से उत्पन्न हुये थे । वह ताड़का बलवान् रामचन्द्र के हाथों मारी बरई, मूक को किरातयुद्ध में सब्यसाची अर्जुन ने मारा था। इन मणिवर्त निवासी देत्यों के वंच्ाधए तोन कोटि तक

verses.translation: After honouring him with Arghya etc., Dharma said to him, "So be it". He brought Dharmavrata there and gave her to Marici. He granted him boons as well. He fulfilled the promise made. The Brahmana (Marici) took her to his hermitage along with Agnihotra (sacred fire).

verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛte tatastasya yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam / tatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā devena bhāṣitam
verses.translation: The sage sported in her company like Vi§nu with Sri or Sambhu with Parvatl or Brahma with Sarasvatl. Marici begot of her a hundred sons comparable even As he was tired, he told thus to his chaste wife, "After taking food massage my feet, even as I lie down on the couch".
verses.hindi: १. हिरण्यकणिपु ने ब्रह्मा से यह भी वरदान याचना की थी कि उसकी मृत्यु न गोली वस्तु के द्वारा हो न सूखी । इसी से भगवान् के नख न गीले हुये न सूखे । अनुह्नादसुतो वायुः सिनीवाली तथव च । तेषां तु शतसाहस्नो गणो हालाहलः स्मृतः ७४५ विरोचनस्तु प्राह लादिः पत्च तस्या5इत्मजाः स्पृताः । गवेष्ठी कालनेमिश्व जम्भो बाधष्कल एवं च॥

verses.sanskrit: दौर्भाग्यं दुर्गतिश्चैव दारिद्र्यं शोकबन्धनम् । वन्ध्यत्वं सप्तजन्मानि जायते न युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: daurbhāgyaṃ durgatiścaiva dāridryaṃ śokabandhanam / vandhyatvaṃ saptajanmāni jāyate na yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Dharmavrata said, "So be it". As the sage lay down on his bed, she rubbed his feet with ghee and began to massage them with eagerness. Even as the sage was becoming sleepy Brahma came to that place. She was placed in a dilemma, "Shall I continue to massage the feet or honour the Jagadguru (the pre¬ ceptor of the world)." Then deciding to honour him, as he was Guru of Gurus, she stood up.
verses.hindi: ययाप्रधान वक्ष्यामि तेथां पुत्रान्दुरासदानु । शुम्भश्चेव निशुम्भभ्र विष्वक्सेनो महोजसः
verses.wordMeaning: Dharmavrata said, "So be it". As the sage lay down on his bed, she rubbed his feet with ghee and began to massage them with eagerness. Even as the sage was becoming sleepy Brahma came to that place. She was placed in a dilemma,…

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठमासे सिते पक्षे तृतीयायां विशेषतः । तत्र गत्वा तु यो भक्त्या पञ्चाग्निं साधयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhamāse site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / tatra gatvā tu yo bhaktyā pañcāgniṃ sādhayettataḥ
verses.translation: She offered Arghya, Padya etc. and worshipped Brahma. Brahma took rest on a couch after due worship. In the meantime, the husband got up from his bed. Unable to see Dharmavrata, the Brahmana became infuriated and cursed her. "Abandoning the massage of my feet and thereby dis¬ obeying my behest, you have gone elsewhere. Hence you will be consumed by this fire of curse. Be a slab of stone."
verses.hindi: विरोधश्र मनुश्चेव वृक्षायुः कुशलीमुखः । बाष्कलस्य सुता होते कालनेमिसुताञ्शूणु ७६ ब्रह्मजित्क्षत्रजिच्चेव देवान्तकनरान्तकौ । कालनेमिसुता हम ते शंभोस्तु शूणुत प्रजाः ८० धनुको ह्यसिलोमा च नाबलभ्रव सगोमुखः । गवाक्षश्चेव गोमांश्व शंभोः पुत्राः प्रकीतिता: ८१ विरोचनस्य पुत्रस्तु बलिरेकः प्रतापवान् )। बलेः पृत्रशतं जज्ञे राजानः सर्व एव ते ८२ भी सव्यसाची ने किया था ।७१-७४। अनुह्ाद के पुत्र वायु और सिनीवाली हुए, इनके पुत्र पौन्नादिकों की संख्या लाखों तक पहुंच गई, जो सब के सब हालाहल गण के नाम से स्मरण किये जाते हैं ।७५। प्रह्नाद का पुत्र विरोचन हुआ, उसके पाँच छोटे भाई कहे जाते हैं, जिनके नाम गवेष्ठी, कालनेमि, जम्भ, बाष्कल ओर शम्भु हैं-ये पाँच प्रह्लाद के पुत्र कहे गये हैं ।॥७६। उन दुधंष॑ देत्य पुत्रों की चर्चा केवल मुख्य-मुख्य की गणना
verses.wordMeaning: She offered Arghya, Padya etc. and worshipped Brahma. Brahma took rest on a couch after due worship. In the meantime, the husband got up from his bed. Unable to see Dharmavrata, the Brahmana became infuriated and cursed her.…
verses.commentary: Sense: She offered Arghya, Padya etc. and worshipped Brahma. Brahma took rest on a couch after due worship. In the meantime, the husband got up from his bed. Unable to see Dharmavrata, the Brahmana became infuriated and cursed her.…

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि पापैरशेषैस्तु मुच्यते नात्र संशयः । गुग्गुलं दहते यस्तु द्विधा चित्तविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi pāpairaśeṣaistu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / guggulaṃ dahate yastu dvidhā cittavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: On being cursed by her husband, she spoke to Marici in a great fury, "While you were sleeping, Brahma, your father and preceptor, arrived here. It was your duty to have got up and worshipped your father. O sage, strictly adhering to pious activities (as a wife), I carried out your duty. Hence I am guiltless. Still I have been cursed by you. So I too curse you. O husband, you will have that curse undoubtedly from Mahadeva."
verses.hindi: करते हुये कर रहा हूं, उनमें से परमतेजस्वी शुम्भ निशुम्भ और विष्वक्सेन--ये तीन गवेष्ठी के पुत्र हुए, जम्भ का पुत्र झतदुन्दुनि हुआ। जम्भास्य, दातदुन्दुभि, दक्ष भोर खण्ड--ये चार जम्भ के पुत्र हुये । विरोध, मनु, वक्षायु और कुशलीमुख--ये चार बाष्कल के पुत्र कहे गये हैं, अब कालनेमि के पूत्रों का वर्णन सुनिये । कालनेमि के ब्रह्मजित्, क्षत्रजित् देवान्तकक भौर नरान्तक नामक पुत्र थे, शम्भु के पुत्रों

verses.sanskrit: शरीरं भेदयेद् यस्तु गौर्याश्चैव समीपतः । तस्मिन्कर्मप्रविष्टस्य उत्क्रान्तिर् जायते यदि
verses.transliteration: śarīraṃ bhedayed yastu gauryāścaiva samīpataḥ / tasminkarmapraviṣṭasya utkrāntir jāyate yadi
verses.translation: On seeing her husband agitated, she too became distressed. She went to Prajapati and bowed to him, as he was lying down. She kindled the fire Gdrhapatya with fuel and stood in its middle. There she performed a very terrible penance. Similarly Marici who too had been cursed, performed a terrible penance. Indra and others who were distressed due to the penance of Marici sought refuge in Hari. They spoke to Hari who was sleeping in the ocean of milk:' c O Hari, we are extremely distressed due to the penance
verses.hindi: को सुतिये ।७७-८०। धनुक, असिलोम: नाबल, सगोमुख, गवाक्ष, और ग्रोमानू, ये शम्भु के पुत्र कहे गये हैं । विरोचन का केवल एक पुत्र हुआ बलि, जो परम प्रतापी था। उस बलि के सौ पुत्र हुये, जो सब के सब राजा हुए  उन सौ पुत्रों में चार अत्यन्त प्रबल तथा विक्रमी हुये, जिममें सबसे ज्येष्ठ सहस्नवाहु बाण था, बाण  घनुश्रिल्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो ग. पुस्तके नास्ति ।

verses.sanskrit: देहपाते व्रजेत् स्वर्गम् इत्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत् । सितरक्तैस्तथा पीतैर्वस्त्रैश्च विविधैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: dehapāte vrajet svargam ityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt / sitaraktaistathā pītairvastraiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Indra and others, Visnu went up to Dharmavrata. In the meantime, Aja (Brahma) woke up. The Devas including Kesava, spoke to Dharmavrata who was in the middle cf the fire: "O chaste lady, who has the capacity to perform penance in the middle of the fire? But that has been achieved by you. It is really a thing that terrifies all worlds.
verses.hindi: १. किसी-किसी प्रति में आत्मजाः” पाठ भी है, जिसके अनुसार पाँच पुत्र” अं होगा। किस्तु नामों के अस्त में 'प्रह्लादसुनव:' पाठ से इसकी असंगति होती है, क्योंकि ये पाँचों तो विरोचन के पृत्र हुये, और प्रह्नाद के पोत्र हुए । अतः 'अनुजा:' पाठ कुछ समीचीन मालूम पड़ता है। आगे चलकर विशोचन के केवल एक पुत्र होने की चर्चा आती हैं, इससे और भी पुष्टि मिलती है ।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणीं ब्राह्मणं चैव पूजयित्वा यथाविधि । पुष्पैर्नानाविधैश्चैव गन्धधूपैः सुशोभनैः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva pūjayitvā yathāvidhi / puṣpairnānāvidhaiścaiva gandhadhūpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ
verses.translation: O knower of Dharmas, choose any boon that you desire from us". On hearing the words of Visnu and others, Dharma¬ vrata spoke to the Devas: "I am unable to turn back the curse of my husband even with all my power. Let that curse given by Marlci to me recede." On hearing the words of Dharmavrata, the Devas spoke to her again, "O daughter of Dharma, of pious rites, this curse has been given to you by a great sage. It cannot be nullified by Devas and Brahmanas. Hence choose any other boon, so that the Dharma proclaimed by the Vedas will be established in the three worlds, O lady of auspicious vows". On hearing the words of Devas, Dhamavrata spoke to the Devas:
verses.hindi: प्र रु 'धायुपुराणघ्ः ठप वरेण च्छन्दयामाप्त सा च॒ वबन्ने ब॒र॑ं. ततः। स तु तस्थे वर प्रादात्प्राथितं भगकान्प्रभुः॥ +

verses.sanskrit: कण्ठसूत्रकसिन्दूरैः कुङ्कुमेन विलेपयेत् । कल्पयेत स्त्रियं गौरीं ब्राह्मणं शिवरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: kaṇṭhasūtrakasindūraiḥ kuṅkumena vilepayet / kalpayeta striyaṃ gaurīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śivarūpiṇam
verses.translation: <c O immortal gods, if you are not able to redeem me from the curse of my husband, please grant me an excellent boon like this. I shall then become a slab of stone which will be the most auspicious and the holiest in the whole of the Cosmic Egg. I shall be more sanctifying than rivers, lakes, Devas etc.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण बंशतं तावच्छुचियंदि भविष्यसि । पुत्र॑-त्रिलोकप्रवरमथ त्वूं जनयिष्यसि  -.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तद्रूपकं कृत्वा दानमुत्सृज्यते ततः । कङ्कणं कर्णवेष्टं च कण्ठिकां मुद्रिकां तथा
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tadrūpakaṃ kṛtvā dānamutsṛjyate tataḥ / kaṅkaṇaṃ karṇaveṣṭaṃ ca kaṇṭhikāṃ mudrikāṃ tathā
verses.translation: I shall be holier than the sages, ascetics, the chief of Devas and others. Let all those Lingas in the three worlds, whether manifest or unmanifest, abide for ever on my body in the form of a holy place. Let all the holy centres, the chiefs of the constellations, all the Devas and the Devls (goddesses) and the sages stand by (on me). Brahma, Visnu and Rudra shall mark theirfootprints on me. The five fires andKumara and others be stationed in their multiforms. The Devas are stationed in their embodied and
verses.hindi: परम समृद्ध दत्य था, अन्य तीन कुम्भनाभ, मर्दभाक्ष और कुशि थे, इनके अतिरिक्त अन्य भी थे बलि की शकुनी ओर पूतना नामक दो पुत्रियाँ थीं। बलि के पुत्र-पौत्रों की संख्या सैकड़ों कया सहस्रों तर्क पहुँच गई थी । जिनके नाम बलिगण थे, वे सब परम विक्रमशील थे  इन्द्र के: समान मनसस्‍्वी बाण की राजधानी लौहित्यपुर थी । पुत्रों के नष्ट हो जाने पर दिति ने सेवा द्वारा कश्यप को संन्तुष्ट किया ॥ दिति की भली-भाँति सेवा करने पर प्रसन्न होकर कक्ष्यप ने वरदान से उसे प्रसन्‍तर किया । दिति ने उनसे वरदान माँगा

verses.sanskrit: सप्तधान्यं तथा चैव भोजनं नृपसत्तम । अन्यान्यपि च दानानि तस्मिंस्तीर्थे ददाति यः
verses.transliteration: saptadhānyaṃ tathā caiva bhojanaṃ nṛpasattama / anyānyapi ca dānāni tasmiṃstīrthe dadāti yaḥ
verses.translation: All the people will become purified on seeing that slab which is the destroyer of all great sins. The performer of Sradd- has becoming pure, will be authorised in the holy rites and will attain Brahmaloka. Let all those who after taking their baths in all the sac¬ red waters stationed on the rocky slab, perform Tarpana and then the Sraddha along with the offerings of Pinda attain Brahma¬ loka.
verses.hindi: और भगवान् कश्यप ने उसके अभिलषित वरदान को दिया  मरीचि पुत्र उग्रेतेजा महेषि कश्यप ने दिति से पूछा कि 'तू क्या चाहती है! ।८५४-८७। अपने पतिदेव मरीचि पुत्र महर्षि कश्यप को सुप्रसन्‍न देखे दिति ने हाथ जोड़कर कहा, भगवन् ! आपके पुत्र आदित्यों (अदिति के पुत्रों) द्वारा मेरे सभी पुत्रों का विनाश हो मयां, अब मैं परम तपस्वी, एवं इन्द्र को मारने में समर्थ एक पुत्र को प्राप्त करने कौ इच्छा करती हूँ । ऐसे प्रभावश्ञाली पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: All the people will become purified on seeing that slab which is the destroyer of all great sins. The performer of Sradd- has becoming pure, will be authorised in the holy rites and will attain Brahmaloka.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All the people will become purified on seeing that slab which is the destroyer of all great sins. The performer of Sradd- has becoming pure, will be authorised in the holy rites and will attain Brahmaloka.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदानैश्च यत्पुण्यं प्राप्नुयान्नात्र संशयः । सहस्रगुणितं सर्वं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: sarvadānaiśca yatpuṇyaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ / sahasraguṇitaṃ sarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Let the visible holy centre of Gadadharabe the most excellent of all excellent holy centres. May those who stay there or die there go to the region of Brahma. Let the holy centres of Varanasi and Prayaga stay therewith the name ofPurusottama. Let the holy centres named Gangasagara stay in the holy spot of Phalgu. The holiest of spots is presided over by Gadadhara. By performing Sraddha of dead persons, Pitrs will attain salvation. May Jarayujas (viviparous beings), Antfajas (oviparous), Svedajas (sweat-born beings) or Udbhids (vegetable kingdom) attain the form of Visnu after abandoning their bodies on the slab. Just as all Yajfias become completely accomplished when Hari is worshipped, so also let the Sraddha, Tarpana and ablution be everlasting here.
verses.hindi: को प्राप्त करने के लिए मैं तपदचर्या कर रही हूँ, आप गर्भाधान करें । ऐसी बातें सुन महान तेजस्वी मारीच पुत्र महषि कश्यप ने परम दुखिनी दिति से कहा, है तपोधने ! ऐसा ही होगा । तेरा कल्याण होगा, तू पवित्र आचरण कर । अवश्य ही युद्धस्थल में इन्द्र के संहार करने वाले सुपुत्र को तू उत्पन्न करेगी ।५५-६१। यदि तू पूरे सौ वर्ष तक पवित्र रहेगी तो त्रेलोक्यविजयी पूृत्र को उत्पन्न करेगो ।” ऐसी बातें दिति से कर महातेजस्वी + तस्मिन्गणे हते देव॑विकरान्ते दुजंयेउ्मरैरित्यधिक ख. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Let the visible holy centre of Gadadharabe the most excellent of all excellent holy centres. May those who stay there or die there go to the region of Brahma. Let the holy centres of Varanasi and Prayaga stay therewith the name ofPurusottama.…

verses.sanskrit: शङ्करेण समं तस्माद्भोगं भुङ्क्ते ह्यनुत्तमम् । सौभाग्यं तस्य विपुलं जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkareṇa samaṃ tasmādbhogaṃ bhuṅkte hyanuttamam / saubhāgyaṃ tasya vipulaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Let those who perform the Japas of the mantras of the leading Suras on my body become Siddhas and the masters of Siddhis ere long. It is certain that a man who performs Sraddha etc. uplifts thousand Pitrs of his family including himself and leads them to Visnuloka, the region of Visnu.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजार्तया संसवसत्प्रभु:  तामालिज्धब त्रिभुवन जगा भगवानूषिः. ६३ गति भत॑रि सा देवी दितिः परमहर्षिता । कुशलं बनमासाद्य तपस्तेपें सुदादणम् 0९४ तपस्तस्यां तु कुर्व॑त्यां परिचर्या चकार हू । सहस्राक्षः सुरक्षेष्ठः परया ग्रुणसंपदा... ६५ अग्नि समित्कुश काष्ठ फल मूल तथेव च्। न्यवेदयत्सहल्लाक्षों यच्चान्यदंपि किचन +

verses.sanskrit: अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो धनमाप्नुयात् । राजेन्द्र कामदं तीर्थं नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamāpnuyāt / rājendra kāmadaṃ tīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam
verses.translation: O leading Suras, whatever excellent (sacred) rivers there are such as Ganga etc., whatever auspicious eddies there are whether oceans, or important lakes such as Manasa etc., let them be conducive to salvation of the persons who perform Sraddhas. Let the Devatas go in their embodied forms in some places and in other places let them not go; Visnu is one and On hearing the words of the chaste lady, the Devas spoke to her, "Undoubtedly whatever has been requested by you shall take place. When you remain steady on the head of Gayasura we shall stay there in the form of footprints and remain there steadily. 55 After giving the evidence, of having granted the boon, the Devas vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: नात्रसंवाहनेश्चेव श्रमापनयनेस्तर्था । शक्र: सर्वेषु लोकेषु दिति पर्रिचचार ह्ु॥. प्रीता तेहहं सुरक्षेष्ठ दश वर्षाणि पुत्रक । अवशिष्टानि भद्रं ते अआतरं व्रक्ष्यसे ततः ६८ जयलिप्सं समाधास्ये लब्ध्बा5हूँ तादशशं सुतम् 4 त्रलोक्य्रविजयं पुत्र प्राप्स्यासि सह तेन वे.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कामदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षडुत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १०७ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र भण्डारीतीर्थम् उत्तमम् । दरिद्रच्छेदकरणं युगान्येकोनविंशतिः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kāmadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| rkv adhyāya 107 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gaccheta rājendra bhaṇḍārītīrtham uttamam / daridracchedakaraṇaṃ yugānyekonaviṃśatiḥ
verses.translation: O Narada, listen. I shall recount the greatness of the slab of rock, that confers salvation. Devas and the prominent sages sing of the greatness of the slab. That rocky slab situated on the earth, has the forms of Devas. It is highly sanctifying. The wonderful Silatirtha 1 is well known in the three worlds. Sila TTrtha, the same as Muntf aphtha, as the Sila was placed on the back of the (shaven) head of Gaya (v.12 below, also TSS, ). It has the combined sanctity of itself and that of the sacred head of Gaya (v.8 below). 'The area of Sila or the head of Gayasura is 3 Sq. Kms. On touching it, all the people in the worlds went to Hari's city (Vaikuntha). When the three worlds became void, Accompanied by Indra and others \ ama went to Brahma Brahma then said to Yama, "Keep it in your house. Advised by Brahma, Dharmaraja retained the slab m his house. Since it was held (laid) on the head of Gayasura due to its heaviness, the happy combination of two holy things is the bestower of salvation on Pitps. The unborn deity (Brahma) performed Hayamedha (horse sacrifice) on the combination of the two holy things. On seeing Visnu etc. who came to receive their due shares (in the sacrifice), the slab requested: "All of you take the vow of standing on the slab (for ever) to enable Pitrs to attain liberation". Saying "So be it" Vi§nu and other Devas stood on the Slid (the slab of rock). In accordance with their previous promise, Devas stayed on the Si la in embodied and unembodied forms either through their idols of stone or footprints. Since the Sila was stationed on the top of the tonsured head of the Daitya, it was called Mundaprsthadri. It is the bestower of Brahmaloka upon Pitrs. The foot of the Sila is concealed by the mountain Pra¬ bhasa. It is called Prabhasa because it is illuminated by Bhas- kara (the Sun-god). Silanguttha (the thumb of the Slid) has come out of Prabhasa by piercing through it. The lord presiding over Angu- spha section is glorified as Prabhasesa. A portion of the Sildngusfha is remembered as PreiaSild (the Rock of the Dead). If Pindas are offered to the dead on this rock, the dead man becomes free from the state of a goblin. A devotee should perform his ablution at the place where the Prabhasa mountain meets the great river. Rama i his bath here in the company of the gentle lady (i.e. ita). Hence this is remembered as 'Ramatirtha'. Here Rama was requested by the great river, "O Rama, take your bath (in my waters)." Since then it became well known in the three worlds as 'Ramatirtha. A man who takes his bath repeating this iv an ra a If a devotee repeats this Mantra— "O ama. If the devotee takes his bath repeating this Mantra and performs the Sraddha along with the offering of Pinzas, his Pitrs become released from the state of a ghost and attain Pitrtva (the state of Pitrhood). After bowing to the lord of Prabhasa, one should go unto the refulgent Siva. After making obeisance to Sambhu, one should perform the oblation to Yama. When Rama had gone to the forest, Bharata came to this mountain and performed the offerings of Pinda etc. to the Pitrs. The lord (Bharata) installed the idols of Rama, Slta, Laksmana and the sages. In the holy hermitage of Bharata, the foot-print of Matanga is seen by all men. It is always surround¬ ed by highly meritorious men. It is established as a model for people. It contains the essentials of piety. One who performs Srdddha in Matanga - pada enables all the Pitrs to cross the ocean of existence (sam- sara ). A man who takes bath in Ramatlrtha and wor¬ ships Sita and bows down to RameSvara is not reborn as an embodied being. The middle region of the Sila is again covered by a mountain. It was urged by Dharmaraja by saying "Na Gaccha — Do not go". Hence it is called Naga (mountain). "Yamaraja and Dharmaraja attempted to make (Gaya- sura) steady. I give Bali (oblation) unto them for the sake of liberation of (my) ancestors. There are two dogs of dark and variegated colour. They are born of the family of Vaivasvata (i.e. of Yama). I am giving Bali unto them. May they refrain from violence. May the crows stationed in east, west, north-west- south and south-west accept the balls of rice offered by me (on the ground). O strong one, you are Yama; you are Yama's messen¬ ger. You are a crow. Eating the oblations, destroy the sins committed during the seven births." When Rama went to the forest, Bharata came to this mountain. After offering the Pindas etc. to the Pitrs, Ramesa was installed by him here. After the bath and the worship of RameSa accompanied by Rama and Slta, one should perform Srdddha with the offer¬ ings of Pin<f<u. Such a pious soul shall go to Visnu's abode along with the Pitrs and hundreds of the members of his family. On the right-hand side of the Sild, the Kunda- parvata (mountain) is established. Various deities are installed there. Timiraditya, ISana, Bharga—these are the forms of Mahesvara. The Vahni, two Varunas and the four Rudras yield liberation unto the Pitrs. After going to the hermitage of Bharata, the devotee should bow to them and worship them. He is liberated from all major sins as well as minor ones along with his Pitrs. O celestial sage, a man can take bath anywhere in the hermitage of Bharata. If he performs a Srdddha etc. the fruit thereof is not lost even after a Kalpa. Really the Sraddha performed anywhere in Gaya is never perishing. Still they say that the Japas, Homas and penances and anything offered (as religious gift) at Bharata's hermitage are of infinite nature. There are four idols of Ravi (the Sun-god) in the forms of the four Yugas. On being seen, touched and worshipped, There are two deities, viz. Muktivamana and Taraka Brahman. These deities are the boats for those who are over¬ whelmed by the ocean of worldly existence. Brahman is Taraka (that which enables one to cross the ocean of Samsara) He who sees Trivikrama, Purusottama and Brahma becomes a pious soul and attains the greatest goal along with the Pits Brahma performed his sacrifice along with Suras near the Naimisa forest. That Tlrtha is called Mukhyatirtha (the chief of holy waters). Devas are stationed at its feet.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा दितिः शक्क मध्य॑ प्राप्ते दिवाकरे  निद्रायाइपह्वता देवी जान्वो: कृत्वा शिरस्तदा ॥

verses.sanskrit: धनदेन तपस्तप्त्वा प्रसन्ने पद्मसम्भवे । तत्रैव स्वल्पदानेन प्राप्तं वित्तस्य रक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: dhanadena tapastaptvā prasanne padmasambhave / tatraiva svalpadānena prāptaṃ vittasya rakṣaṇam
verses.translation: O Narada, the excellent among the sages, whatever inauspicious deeds there may be, perish in the three Padas (spots) in those holy centres. The Naimisa forest is holy and resorted to by meri¬ torious persons such as Vyasa, Suka, Paila, Kanva, Vedhas, Siva, Hari. By their mere sight, a man is liberated from all sins. On the right-hand side of the Sila, there is the Udyantaka mountain. This mountain is established. One who offers Piriqlas there leads Pitfs to the city of god Brahma. Kunda and Udyan¬ taka were created by him by means of his penance. Brahma stayed there along with Savitri and Kumara (i.e. Sanatkumara). Haha and Huhu and the others made the sound of music. The mountains Kunda and Udyantaka were full of songs and the sound of musical instruments. It is here that the holy sage Agastya performed an austere penance. From Brahma, he received the boon of great¬ ness rarely achieved on the earth. He secured Lopamudra as his wife and the great goal (Mok?a) to his Pitrs. At midday the devotees should take their bath and worship Savitn. The Brahmana will become a master of the Vedas and very rich for a crore of births (?) By taking ablution in the Agastya Pada and by offering Pindas there, one becomes a pious soul and attains Brahmaloka along with the Pitrs. He is worshipped even by the heaven- dwellers. A man who enters Brahmayoni and comes out attains the greatest Brahman. He is liberated from the miseries of wombs (i.e. rebirth). A man who bows to Gayakumara attains Brahmana- One who offers Pindas at Vyomaganga becomes free from impurities and leads the Pitrs to heaven. There is a heap of Bhasma at the right-hand side of the Sila. O Narada, the devotee should take bath with this Bhasma from the mountain called Bhasmakutadri. Prapitamaha (Brahma) is stationed on the Vafa as Vatesvara (Lord of the holy banyan tree). One who offers Pindas at the holy Mat'angapada leads the Pitrs to heaven. Ahead of it is Rukmini Kunda and to the west is the river Kapila. Kapilesa is on the banks of the river. On the new moon day, one should take bath in Kapila and worship Kapilesa. If he performs Sraddha in MaheSikunda, he shall attain heaven. Gauri, under the name of Mahgala there, grants all types of prosperity and glory. Janardana is near the Bhasmakufa. One who offers Pindas in his hand, with mantras, if for oneself and without gingelly seeds, in the left hand, if for others and mixed with curds for those who are alive—all these attain Visnu- loka. O Janardana, obeisance unto you. Hail to you of the form of the Pitrs. O Lord of Pitrs* obeisance to } ou. bow to you, O cause of salvation, O Janardana, O lord a f™ 1 * you assume the form of the Pitrs at Gaya yourself. Obeisance be to you, O bestower of salvation on the Pitrs. After meditating on Pundarikaksa (Vi»u) one becomes released from the three forms of indebtedness, ertam y peop Wain heaven after worshipping Pund ar tkaksa. Bhima knelt on his left knee and bowed to Janardana. After performing Sraddha along with the offerings of Pintfa, he attained Visnuloka along with his brothers. On the right foot of the Sila, the mountain Preta- kuta 1 is held by Dharmaraja with both of his feet. He kicked it off with his feet on account of the weight of sins. In the forest of Kara-grahana, many have stayed behind (unliberated) in the form of departed souls (ghosts). They are the cause of obstacles. The Tirtha confers salvation on the Pitrs through the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha etc. Pretakufa attained sacredness due to the contact of the Sila. Devas are stationed in the form of footprints on Pretakufa. After performing Sraddha etc. there, one should get the Pitrs released from ghost-hood. O Brahmana, those who have the terrible forms of a ghost near the Sila wander over the earth and in Yama's world. On the holy head of Gayasura which is devoid of ghosts etc., Brahma and other Devas are stationed and he attains sacredness. Among Kikatas (southern Magadha) Gaya is the holiest. Rajavana and Rajagrha are holy. The hermitage of Gyavanais holy. The river is many times holy (than the rest). Hemadanqia and the mountain Hemakuta are in Vaikuntha. One who performs Sraddha and offers Pinzas etc. there leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura. On the right foot of the Sila, the mountain Grdhrakufa is held by Dharmaraja in order to stabilise (Gaya). It is very holy. Sages performed their penance there in the form of Grdhras (vultures) and attained liberation. Hence this is called Grdhrakufa. GrdhreSvara is stationed there. A man who sees Grdhresvara attains Sambhu's region. After bowing down to Grdhravata one shall achieve one's desire and attain heaven. Pretak&ta, G r dhrakuta, Bhasmakuta etc. are the tops of hillocks near Gaya. He who offers Pintfas in the G r dhraguha (vulture-cave) attains Sivaloka. There is the Mahesvari Dhara (the current of Mahesvara). He who offers Pinzas there, leads the Pitj-s to heaven. There is a lake called Mulaksetra. He who offers Pinzas there, attains Brahmaloka. After visiting Siva he attains freedom from indebtedness and salvation from sins. He attains Siva himself after visualizing Siva. The middle of the Sila (the belly portion) is over¬ lapped (covered) by the mountain Adipala. It is here that Vighnesa, the destroyer of obstacles, stands in the form of an elephant. He who offers Pinzas at t h e umbilical region (of the god) leads his Pitjrs to Brahmapura. On the hips (i.e. ridges) of the mountain Mundapr$tha, there was a big forest of Devadaru trees. One shall destroy one's sins by seeing the mountain Aravinda on Muntfaprstha. A certain sage performed penance here in the form of a Kraunca (heron). The mountain was marked by his feet. Hence it is called Krauncapada. One who takes bath there in the water reservoir, leads three generations to heaven. Lak$mlsa (Visnu) is stationed on the Sila in the manifest and unmanifest forms along with Devas. Hence the Sila is full of Devas. That mountain was brought by the noble-souled Agastya. Brahma and Hara performed a fierce penance there. There is the excellent Kunqla (Pool) of Agastya which is of a very rare excellence in the three worlds. It was here that the eight sages achieved Siddhi after performing penance.. They attained final beatitude. After bowing to the eight sages in the Kunda, the pilgrim will be able to lead the Pitrs to Brahma's city. O celestial sage, an auspicious prominent mountain was established on the left hand of the Sila. It is always re¬ sounding with the sounds of musical instruments and divine symphony. It is called mountain Vaditraka. Even today Vidyadharas, accompanied by hosts of Gandharvas and Apsaras-s sing divine songs in chorus. Mohana, Sunitha, Sailuja, Mohanottama, Parvata>
verses.hindi: महषि कश्यप ने उसके साथ सहवास-किया और उसका आलिगनकर त्रिभुवन भ्रमण के निमित्त गर्मत किया   पतिदेव कब्यप के चले जाने पर परम हित हो देवी दिति ने. कुशल बन में परम कठोर तप किया ।६२-६४। उस: घोर तपस्या में लीन दिति की उस सहख्ननेत्र देवराज इन्द्र ने अनेक प्रकार की सेवाएँ कीं। अग्मि, समिघा, कुश, काष्ठ, फल, मूल आदि तश्रा अन्यान्य पृजोपयोगी वस्तुओं को सहस्नेन्न इन्द्र ला-लाकर देता था और परिश्रम के खेद को दूर करने के लिए गात्र संवाहन (मर्देत, पैर शिर आदि का दब्नाना) करता था। सभी लोगों को देखते हुये इन्द्र ने दिति कीं,विधिवत् परिचर्या की  इस प्रकार इन्द्र द्वारा भली-भाँति सत्कार एवं शूक्रषा पाकर दिति ने कहा ।९५-९७। .

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा तु यो भक्त्या स्नात्वा वित्तं प्रयच्छति । तस्य वित्तपरिच्छेदो न कदाचिद् भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā tu yo bhaktyā snātvā vittaṃ prayacchati / tasya vittaparicchedo na kadācid bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Similarly the Gandharva named Citraratha surrounded by all the Gandharvas, sings sweet songs of great festivities on the mountain. Hence that mountain is resorted to by Devas for ever even today. Hara, the lord of Devas, is desirous of applying Bhasma all over the body like an unguent. Rudra accompanied by Parvatl rejoices on that moun¬ tain resonant with music. He is worshipped as he is the greatest goal of the Pitrs. He should be meditated upon. The greatest Atman (Deity) in Gaya is either the lord of the cows or Gadadhara (the wielder of the mace). O sage, t hanks t0 the worship of Rudra, the Maya pertaining to Vi?nu becomes quelled. On the right-hand side of the Sila, the mountain Bhasmakua is held by Dharmaraja. Agastya stays there with his wife. One who takes bath at the spot of Agastya and offers Pindas, goes to Brahmaloka. It was from Brahma that he secured the excellent boon of greatness in the world, Lopamudra as wife and the highest goal (liberation) to his forefathers. There, on seeing Agastyesvara, one is absolved of the sin of Brahmana-slaughter. On seeing Agastya along with his wife, one leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura. Dandin performed a penance on the mountain south of Sitadri. There is a Vafa (banyan tree) called Vatesvara. Prapitamaha (god Brahma) is stationed there. Beyond that is Rukminikunda. To the west of it is the river Kapila. Kapilesa is on the banks of the river. When the New Moon and Monday coincide with each other, a devout man must take bath in Kapila and worship the lord of Kapila. If after that, Sraddha is performed and Pindas are offered the Pitrs shall attain salvation. There is a current of fire coming from the excellent mountain. There is the pool called Sarasvata Kunda. It has been created by Sarasvati. Lord Sukra stayed there with his sons Sanda, Amarka and others. O excellent sage, a man who performs Sraddha and offers Pinda etc. in the various spots at the feet of the eminent sages, enables the Pitrs to cross (the ocean of worldly existence) On the left-hand side of the Sila there stands the moun¬ tain Grdhrakuta. The great sages assuming the form of cranes performed penance there and became Siddhas. Hence the mountain is called Grdhrakuta. The deity Grdhresvara is stationed there. A man who visits and bows to Grdhresvara shall achieve the region of Sambhu. Pie who offers Pindas on Grdhrakuta and in the cave, attains Sivaloka. One who bows to the Vata (the banyan tree) on Grdhrakuta attains all his desires and goes to heaven. On seeing Siva, one attains freedom from indebtedness release from sins, and goes unto Siva. There is a Sulaksetra (shrine of the trident) there. One who offers Pindas there, leads the Pitrs to heaven. The centre of the Si la is overlapped by the ' mountain Adipala. Vighnesa, the destroyer of obstacles, stays there is the form of an elephant. On visiting him a devotee is freed from obstacles. He leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura. There was a forest of Devadaru trees on the ridge of the mountain Mundaprstha. After visiting the mountains Mun- daprstha and Aravindadri, one quells all sins. He who offers Pindas in the umbilical region of Gaya called Susumna (like the nerve Susumna in human body) leads his Pitrs to heaven. On the left leg of the Sila, the mountain Pretaparvata was established by Dharmaraja. The mountain is called Preta- sila because of its impurity due to sins. The mountain was kicked off to a great distance. Pretakuta was freed from sins and attained sanctity due to the contact with the Sila. There is a pool called Pretakunda there. Devas are stationed at its foot. Performing Sraddha etc. in the Kunda, one shall relieve the Pitrs of goblinhood. There are many of the ghosts staying separately and causing obstacles to those men who perform Sraddha etc. for the sake of the liberation of Pitrs. The ghosts assume the form of archers and catch hold of the hands (of the pilgrims). There is a rock on Muntfaprstha where Mahadeva stays. On seeing it all people become relieved of heinous and Gayasiras is holy and devoid of all sms. It is devoid In the Kikata land (i. e. the territories comprising southern Bihar) Gaya is the holiest centre. TheRajagrha forest is also holy. The hermitage of Gyavana is another holy spot. The river Punahpuna (?) is also holy. There are other holy spots, viz. Vaikuntha, Lohadanda, Grdhrakuta and Sonaka. By performing Sraddha etc. here, a pilgrim leads all the Pitrs to Brahmapura. Assuming the form of a heron, a sage performed pena¬ nce on the ridge of Mundaprstha. Since the mountain is marked by the foot-prints of the heron, it is remembered as Krauncapada. One who takes bath in the water reservoir there, shall lead the entire family to heaven. An oblation offered to crows on the rock Kakasila, is conducive to relief from indebted¬ ness. The two sages Lomasa and Lomaharsana performed a great penance on the ridge of Mundaprstha. Both of them attained Siddhi of the highest magnitude. Like other Sthala-purana?, this text claims all important rivers in India to be present at Gaya. Small streams and streamlets are supposed to represent big rivets like Ganga, Yamuna, Kaveri etc. A man who enters the holy spot Brahmayoni and comes out of it, attains the greatest Brahman freed from the distress of wombs (i.e. re-birth). Janardana stays in Bhasmakufa. He who offers Pindas m his hands whether for himself or for others-if it is for one's own self it must be without gingelly seeds (and be offered) with the sacred thread in the Savya (hanging from the left shoulder) position; and if for those who are alive, it must be mixed with curds all these go to Visnuloka (Vaikuntha). Mantra: "O Janardana, the Pinda that I offer in your hand, may please be given by you to that person for whom I have given it to thee now. It be given to him after he is dead, O lord." Mantra. "O Janardana, this Pinda is given into your hand by me. When I reach the end of my time (when I am dead) this must be given to me at Gayasiras. 1 O Janardana, obeisance to you. Bow to you, granter of liberation to the Pitrs. O lord of Pitrs, obeisance to you. Hail toyou in the form of Pitrs." In Gaya, Janardana assumed the form of Pitrs himself. On visiting that Pundarikaksa (lotus-eyed god Visnu) one is released from three-fold indebtedness. O Pundarikaksa, obeisance to you, O releaser from the three-fold indebtedness. O Laksmlkanta (Lord of LaksmI), obeisance to you, be the granter of liberation to the Pitrs." Kneeling on his left knee, Bhlma bowed to Janardana. After performing the Sraddha along with the offerings of Pindas, he attained Brahmaloka in the company of his brothers. He became a pious soul and uplifted a hundred forefathers in his family. Cf. NP. II.47.63b-65.
verses.hindi: द्विति ने कहा--हे सुरश्रेष्ठ  मैं तुम्हारे ऊपर प्रसन्न हँ। है बेटे ! तुम्हारे कल्याण कें दस वर्ष और रह गये हैं, जब तुम अपने भाई को देखोंगे। जय की अभिलाषा से युक्त परम पराक्रमओोील पुत्र को प्राप्त कर.- मेरी सारी आपत्तियाँ दूर हो जाम्ंगी । है पुत्र ! उसी के साथ समस्त त्रलोक्य विजय का मैं सुख अनुभव करूँगी ।' इन्द्र से ऐसी-बांतें कर दिति मध्याक्लु केः अवसर पर, जिस समय सूंयं ऑकाश के मध्य में विराजमान
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly the Gandharva named Citraratha surrounded by all the Gandharvas, sings sweet songs of great festivities on the mountain. Hence that mountain is resorted to by Devas for ever even today. Hara, the lord of Devas,…

verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhaṇḍārītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 108 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla rohiṇītīrthamuttamam / vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu sarvapāpaharaṃ param
verses.translation: How did the primordial Gadadhara (wielder of the mace) stay in the manifest form? How did he stay both as manifest and unmanifest? How did the mace (Gada) originate and how did he come to be known as Adigadadhara? How did the Gadalola spot become so (sanctifying) as to wipe off all sins.
verses.hindi: था, निद्रा से अभिभूत हो इंस्द्र के दोनों /जंघों पर शिर रखकर सोंगई। दोनों पेरों पर-बाल विखरने के कारण अपवित्र अवस्था में दिति को देखकर, और अपने स्वार्थ साधन का उत्तम अवसर देखकर इन्द्र परम मुदित होकर हँसने लगे ।१९८-१० ६। तदनन्तर महायशस्वी पुरन्दर ने दिति के फैले हुए शेरीर में प्रवेश किया और प्रविष्ड तें गर्भ सप्तधा कृत्वा होकेक सप्तधा पुनः । कुलिशेन विभेदेन्द्रस्ततो दितिरबुध्यत १०४

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: रोहिणीतीर्थमाहात्म्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: rohiṇītīrthamāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / śrotumicchāmi tattvena tanme tvaṃ vaktumarhasi
verses.translation: There was an Asura named Gada whose body was very hard and adamantine. By performing a very terrible penance he secured boons from Brahma. When he was requested, he gave up to Brahma the bones of his body which is very difficult to part with. Urged by Brahma, Visvakarma made the wonderful club (out of it). He turned the bone of the demon in the lathe that could crush even Vajra (thunderbolt) and kept it in the heaven itself.
verses.hindi: अशुचिदेधि सुप्ताइसि पादयोगंतसूर्धजा । तदन्तरमहं लब्ध्वा शक्रहन्तारमाहवे ॥

verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / udadhau ca śayānasya devadevasya cakriṇaḥ
verses.translation: After a great deal of time, in the Svayambhuva Mau- vantara, the demon Heti, the son of Brahma, performed a very terrible penance.* For a hundred thousand divine years he subsisted only on the air. Then looking up, he stood on his toes with hands raised up. Then he stood on a single foot for a long time taking in only air or dry leaves. Brahma and others were pleased by
verses.hindi: समापराधाद्गर्भोष्यं यदि ते विफलीकृतः । नापराधो5स्ति देवेश ऋषिपुत्र महाबल १०८ भवन्तु मभ पुत्राणां सप्त स्थानानि वे दिवि। वातस्कन्धानिभान्सप्त भरन्‍्तु सम पुत्रकाः॥। मरुतश्चेति विख्याता गणास्ते सप्त सप्तकाः ११०

verses.sanskrit: नाभौ समुत्थितं पद्मं रविमण्डलसन्निभम् । कर्णिकाकेसरोपेतं पत्रैश्च समलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: nābhau samutthitaṃ padmaṃ ravimaṇḍalasannibham / karṇikākesaropetaṃ patraiśca samalaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Saying "So be it", they vanished. Heti conquered Devas and began to rule as Indra. Brahma, Hara and others became afraid (of him). They sought refuge in Hari. They told him, "Kill Heti. Hari said to them, "O Suras, this Heti cannot be killed by Devas or Asuras.
verses.hindi: होकर वहाँ महान् तेजस्वी एवं अपरिमित उस गर्भ शिशु को देखा अपने वज्ञ से सात भागों में काट डाला । इन्द्र द्वारा वजत्न से काटते समय वह गर्भ डर के मादे कॉपने लगा और बारम्बार भयानक स्वर रोदन॑ करने लगा । इन्द्र ने उस गर्भ से कहा कि मत रोओ। और ऐसा कहकर उसे सात टुकड़ों में काटकर फिर से एक-एक टुकड़े को सात-सात भागों में वञ्न से काट दिया तब तक दि ति जग गई । और ऐसा कहने लगी मत मारो, मत

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ब्रह्मा समुत्पन्नश्चतुर्वदनपङ्कजः । किं करोमीति देवेश आज्ञा मे दीयतां प्रभो
verses.transliteration: tatra brahmā samutpannaścaturvadanapaṅkajaḥ / kiṃ karomīti deveśa ājñā me dīyatāṃ prabho
verses.translation: At the outset he held that (bone) club, so he was call¬ ed, 'Gadadhara" by Devas. After striking Heti with his (bone) club, he went to heaven along with Devas. In order to steady the rocky slab of Gayasuraiiras, he went there armed with this Gada to stabilise the Sila. Hence he is called Adigadadhara. 1
verses.hindi: मारो ।! माता की आज्ञा का गौरव रखने के लिए इन्द्र वञ्न समेत उदर से बाहर निकले और हाथ जोड़कर दिति से बोले, है देवि ! तुम अपवित्र अवस्था में सो गई थीं, तुम्हारे केश दोनों पैरो पर बिखरे हुए थे, ऐसे अवसर को पाकर मैंने युद्ध में इन्द्र का (मेरा) संहार करनेवाले इह गर्भस्थ शिशु को अनेक टुकड़ों में काट डाला, मुझे क्षमा करो ।१ ०२-१०६। उस गर्भ के निष्फल हो जाने पर दिति को बड़ा दुःख हुआ और उसने अनुनय पूव॑क सहल्र नेत्र इन्द्र से कहा, देवेश ! यदि मेरे ही अपराध से यह मेरा मर्भ निष्फल हुआ है तो है ऋषिपुत्र ! महाबलवान्  इसमें तुम्हारा कोई अपराध नहीं है, क्योंकि शत्रु का वध करने में कोई दोष नहीं है, इसीलिए मैं तुम्हें शाप नहीं दे रही हूँ प्रत्युत तुम्हारा मंगल करने की मेरी इच्छा है, मेरे इस गर्भ का कल्याण करो १०७-१०९६। स्वर्ग में भेरे इन पुत्रों का सात स्थान प्राप्त हों, मेरे थे पुत्र वायु के सात स्कश्धों में मस्त नाम

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु देवेशः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । उवाच मधुरां वाणीं तदा देवं पितामहम्

verses.translation: Adigadadhara is manifest in the form of Silas 2 (rocky slabs and mountains). Through Mundaprstha mountain, Prabhasa mountain, the mountains Udyanta, Gitanada, Bhas- makuta, Gfdhrakuta, Pretakuta, Adipala and Aravindaka, Pancaloka, Saptaloka, Vaikuntha, Lohadandaka, Krauncapada, Aksayavata, Phalgutlrtha, Madhus'rava, Dadhikulya, Madhu- kulya, the great river Devika and VaitaranI etc. Adigadadhara becomes manifest. This etymology does not explain the term 'Adi' in Adigadadhara.

verses.transliteration: sarasvatyāṃ mahābāho lokaṃ kuru mamājñayā / bhūtagrāmamaśeṣasya utpādanavidhikṣayam
verses.translation: Near Gaya there is a chain of sacred but rocky hillocks and their tops are called Bhasmakuta, Gfdhrakuia etc. Gayasiras consists of this chain of hillocks extending to about two miles. The following are manifest-cum-unmanifest 1. Visnu s Pada (footprint), Rudrapada, the excellent Pada of Brahman, Kasyapa's Pada, which is divine as well as wherein two hands have come out, the Pada? of the five fires, the prominent Padas of Indra and Agastya and the Pada? of Ravi, Kartikeya, Kraunca and Matanga. In all the Lingas the primordial Gada- dhara, the glorious and manifest Gadadhara, abides in manifest- cum-unmanifest form.
