verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुतं तु वचनं पद्मनाभस्य भारत । चिन्तयामास भगवान्सप्तर्षीन्हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: etacchrutaṃ tu vacanaṃ padmanābhasya bhārata / cintayāmāsa bhagavānsaptarṣīnhitakāmyayā
verses.translation: The primordial Gadadhara is stationed 2 as Gayatrl, Savitrl, Sandhya, Sarasvatl, Gayaditya, Uttararka, Daksinarka, Naimisa, Svetarka, Gananatha, the eight Vasus, the leading sages, the eleven Rudras, the Seven Sages, Soma- natha, Siddhesa, Kapardisa, Vinayaka, Narayana, MahalaksmI,, Brahma, Sripurusottama, Markandeycsa, Kautlsa, Angircsa; Pitamaha, Janardana, Mangala, the excellent Pundarlkaksa etc. (these are the various shrines and deities in Gaya). When the Raksasa Heti was killed Visnu went back to his city. When the Asura was rendered motionless by Brahma in the company of Rudra and others, Vedhas (god Brahma) who was overjoyed eulogised Adyagadapani (the primordial wielder of the club) (as follows):
verses.hindi: पृथिव्यां प्रथमस्कन्ध आमेधेभ्यों य आवह:ः । चरन्तु मम पुत्रास्ते सप्तमे प्रथमे गणे ११४ द्वितीयश्चापि मेध्येम्प आसूर्यात्प्रवहस्तु यः । बातस्कन्धं द्वितीयं तु द्वितीयश्ररतां गण: ११५
verses.wordMeaning: The primordial Gadadhara is stationed 2 as Gayatrl, Savitrl, Sandhya, Sarasvatl, Gayaditya, Uttararka, Daksinarka, Naimisa, Svetarka, Gananatha, the eight Vasus, the leading sages, the eleven Rudras, the Seven Sages, Soma- natha, Siddhesa, Kapardisa, Vinayaka, Narayana,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The primordial Gadadhara is stationed 2 as Gayatrl, Savitrl, Sandhya, Sarasvatl, Gayaditya, Uttararka, Daksinarka, Naimisa, Svetarka, Gananatha, the eight Vasus, the leading sages, the eleven Rudras, the Seven Sages, Soma- natha, Siddhesa, Kapardisa, Vinayaka, Narayana,…

verses.sanskrit: क्रमात्ते चिन्तिताः प्राज्ञाः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । प्राचेतसो वसिष्ठश्च भृगुर्नारद एव च
verses.transliteration: kramātte cintitāḥ prājñāḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ / prācetaso vasiṣṭhaśca bhṛgurnārada eva ca
verses.translation: I bow unto Gadadhara who is the bestower of boons, from whom Times (Death's) blemishes have receded, who is stationed in Gaya, whose attributes are well known, who poss¬ esses many attributes, who is present in the cavity (of the heart), who is in the white-coloured house of the excellent mountain and who is worshipped by all the Ganas (groups). I bow unto Gadadhara, who bestows prosperity on the day, who grants prosperity on the hosts of Devas, who grants royal glory even to Bhava (Siva), whose glory tears down Daityas, who bestows glory in the Kali age and whose glory
verses.hindi: (सोमादुृध्व तथक्षेम्यश्चतुर्थ: सुवहस्तु यः । च॒तुर्थों मस पुत्राणां गणस्तु चरतां विभो यक्षेम्यश्व तथंवोध्व॑माग्रहाद्विवहस्तु यः । पदच्चमं पश्चमः सोम्यः स्कन्धस्तु चरतां गणः) ११८
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto Gadadhara who is the bestower of boons, from whom Times (Death's) blemishes have receded, who is stationed in Gaya, whose attributes are well known, who poss¬ esses many attributes, who is present in the cavity (of the heart),…
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto Gadadhara who is the bestower of boons, from whom Times (Death's) blemishes have receded, who is stationed in Gaya, whose attributes are well known, who poss¬ esses many attributes, who is present in the cavity (of the heart),…

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञे प्राचेतसो दक्षो महातेजाः प्रजापतिः । दक्षस्यापि तथा जाताः पञ्चाशद्दुहितरो ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: yajñe prācetaso dakṣo mahātejāḥ prajāpatiḥ / dakṣasyāpi tathā jātāḥ pañcāśadduhitaro 'nagha
verses.translation: The various Padas (footprints) of gods and sages at which Pivd 33 are to be offered are the manifest-cum-unmanifest forms of Adigadadhara. The idols are the manifest forms, unmanifest in Phalgu (TSS 365). These are various deities and shrines at Gaya. The presence of Gadadhara is thus claimed everywhere in Gaya.
verses.hindi: सप्तर्षयस्तथेवोध्व॑माध्रुवात्सप्तमस्तु यः । वातस्कन्धः परिवहस्तन्न तिष्ठस्तु मे सुताः १२० एतत्सवं चरन्त्येते काले काले मसा5त्मजा: । त्वत्कृतेन च नाम्ना वे भवन्तु मरुतस्त्वमि
verses.wordMeaning: The various Padas (footprints) of gods and sages at which Pivd 33 are to be offered are the manifest-cum-unmanifest forms of Adigadadhara. The idols are the manifest forms, unmanifest in Phalgu (TSS 365). These are various deities and shrines at Gaya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The various Padas (footprints) of gods and sages at which Pivd 33 are to be offered are the manifest-cum-unmanifest forms of Adigadadhara. The idols are the manifest forms, unmanifest in Phalgu (TSS 365). These are various deities and shrines at Gaya.…

verses.sanskrit: ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश । तथैव स महाभागः सप्तविंशतिमिन्दवे
verses.transliteration: dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa / tathaiva sa mahābhāgaḥ saptaviṃśatimindave
verses.translation: I bow unto him who is both steady and unsteady who I perpetually bow to the supreme eternal Lord Hari, w-ho is incorporeal, who has no sense organs, who has no birth, who is decorated on Suryavedi 1 (altar of the Sun), to Gadadhara who is devoid of sound and face.
verses.hindi: मण्डल में हो तीसरा चन्द्रमा में और चौथा ज्योतिगणों में हो पाँचवाँ स्कन्ध ग्रहों में और छठवाँ सप्तर्षि मण्डल में हो, सव से आखिरी स्कन्‍्ध जो सतवा होगा वह धूव मण्डल में होगा । इस प्रकार उन मण्डलों में ये मेरे पुत्रणण समय-समय पर विचरण करते रहें १ १०-११३। पृथ्वी तल से लेकर मेघमण्डल पयथेन्‍्त प्रथम स्कन्ध जो भावह नामक है उसमें मेरे सातों गणों में से प्रथम गण के सात पुत्र विचरण करें  द्वितीय प्रवह नामक स्कन्ध जो कि मेघ मण्डल से लेकर सूर्य मण्डल पयेन्‍त है, उसमें हमारे पुत्रों का द्वितीय गण विचरण करे। सूर्ये मण्डल से ऊपर धन्द्रमण्डल तक जो उद्बह नामक वात स्कन्ध कहा गया है उसमें हमारे पुत्रों का तीसरा गण विचरण करे । चन्द्रमा से ऊपर नक्षत्र मण्डल पयेन्‍्त चौथा सुबह नामक जो वातस्कन्ध है, है विभो ! उनमें उन सबों का चौथा गण विचरण करे ।११४-११७। नक्षत्र मण्डल के ऊपर से लेकर ग्रहों के मण्डल तक जो
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto him who is both steady and unsteady who I perpetually bow to the supreme eternal Lord Hari, w-ho is incorporeal, who has no sense organs, who has no birth, who is decorated on Suryavedi 1 (altar of the Sun), to Gadadhara who is devoid of sound and face.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto him who is both steady and unsteady who I perpetually bow to the supreme eternal Lord Hari, w-ho is incorporeal, who has no sense organs, who has no birth, who is decorated on Suryavedi 1 (altar of the Sun), to Gadadhara who is devoid of sound and face.

verses.sanskrit: रोहिणीनाम या तासां मध्ये तस्य नराधिप । अनिष्टा सर्वनारीणां भर्तुश्चैव विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: rohiṇīnāma yā tāsāṃ madhye tasya narādhipa / aniṣṭā sarvanārīṇāṃ bhartuścaiva viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: I bow unto Gadadhara who is present in the heart, who is faster than the mind, who is beyond the reach of the mind, who is always without a second, who is eulogised by learned men in the Vedantas, who is Cidatmaka (pure consciousness) and who is beyond the causes present in Kali. The primordial wielder of the club, on being eulogised thus by Brahma along with Devas said, "You choose the boon 5 ' and Brahma spoke to him:
verses.hindi: पाँचवाँ विवाह नामक स्कन्ध है उसमें उतका पाँचवाँ सुन्दर गण विचरण करे। उक्त ग्रहमण्डल से ऊपर सप्तर्ष मण्डल पर्यन्त छठवाँ पराहृत नामक जो स्कन्धर है, उसमें, हमारे पुत्रों के छठवें गणों में रहनेवाले विचरण करें ।११८-११६। और इसी प्रकार सप्तर्षि मण्डल से ऊपर ध्रूव मण्डल पर्यन्‍्त जो सातवाँ परिवह नामक वायु स्कन्घ है, उसमें हमारे पुत्रों का सातवाँ गण निवास करे । ये मेरे आत्मज गण समय-समय पर उक्त स्कस्धों में
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto Gadadhara who is present in the heart, who is faster than the mind, who is beyond the reach of the mind, who is always without a second, who is eulogised by learned men in the Vedantas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto Gadadhara who is present in the heart, who is faster than the mind, who is beyond the reach of the mind, who is always without a second, who is eulogised by learned men in the Vedantas,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा परमं कृत्वा वैराग्यं नृपसत्तम । आगत्य नर्मदातीरे चचार विपुलं तपः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā paramaṃ kṛtvā vairāgyaṃ nṛpasattama / āgatya narmadātīre cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: €< We will not stay on the rock of divine nature and features without you. We will stay here for ever along with you who have the manifest form. 55 "So be it", said Gadadhara and stayed there along with Sri for the protection of the worlds and for the salvation of the people. The manifest form Pundarxkaksa (Visnu) is well known as Janardana.
verses.hindi: विचरण करते रहें  और तुम्हारे रखे गये 'मझ्त्' नाम से विश्यात हों । इस प्रकार बातें करने के उपरान्त माता धनुश्चित्नास्तगंतग्रम्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: €< We will not stay on the rock of divine nature and features without you. We will stay here for ever along with you who have the manifest form. 55 "So be it", said Gadadhara and stayed there along with Sri for the protection of the worlds and for the salvation of the people.…
verses.commentary: Sense: €< We will not stay on the rock of divine nature and features without you. We will stay here for ever along with you who have the manifest form. 55 "So be it", said Gadadhara and stayed there along with Sri for the protection of the worlds and for the salvation of the people.…

verses.sanskrit: एकरात्रैस् त्रिरात्रैश्च षड्द्वादशभिरेव च । पक्षमासोपवासैश्च कर्शयन्ति कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: ekarātrais trirātraiśca ṣaḍdvādaśabhireva ca / pakṣamāsopavāsaiśca karśayanti kalevaram
verses.translation: The primordial and eternal form that is incomprehen¬ sible even to the Vedas, is very clear and manifest in the Sveta- kalpa, will become unmanifest in the Varahakalpa although it had become manifest before. There is no doubt in this that he will be clearly manifest in Gayasiras for the emancipation of the worlds and the pro¬ tection of the Devas.
verses.hindi: डफफ “वायुपुराणस्?+ ८८
verses.wordMeaning: The primordial and eternal form that is incomprehen¬ sible even to the Vedas, is very clear and manifest in the Sveta- kalpa, will become unmanifest in the Varahakalpa although it had become manifest before.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The primordial and eternal form that is incomprehen¬ sible even to the Vedas, is very clear and manifest in the Sveta- kalpa, will become unmanifest in the Varahakalpa although it had become manifest before.…

verses.sanskrit: आराधयन्ती सततं महिषासुरनाशिनीं । देवीं भगवतीं तात सर्वार्तिविनिवारणीम्
verses.transliteration: ārādhayantī satataṃ mahiṣāsuranāśinīṃ / devīṃ bhagavatīṃ tāta sarvārtivinivāraṇīm
verses.translation: Refers to the sacred cluster of the Surya temple—Vidyarthi Those who regularly and devoutly visit lord Adigada¬ dhara will attain wealth, foodgrain, longevity and good health.
verses.hindi: ततस्तेषां तु सामान मातापुत्रो प्रचक्ततुः। तत्कृते कर्मभिश्चेव मरुतो वे पृथक्पृथंक्. (१९४: प्रथमस्तु गण: प्रोक्तो द्वितीय में न्िबोधत 4ःऋतजित्सत्यजिच्त्रवः सुषेण: सेनजित्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Refers to the sacred cluster of the Surya temple—Vidyarthi Those who regularly and devoutly visit lord Adigada¬ dhara will attain wealth, foodgrain, longevity and good health.
verses.commentary: Sense: Refers to the sacred cluster of the Surya temple—Vidyarthi Those who regularly and devoutly visit lord Adigada¬ dhara will attain wealth, foodgrain, longevity and good health.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा स्नात्वा जले नित्यं नर्मदायाः शुचिस्मिता । ततस्तुष्टा महाभागा देवी नारायणी नृप
verses.transliteration: snātvā snātvā jale nityaṃ narmadāyāḥ śucismitā / tatastuṣṭā mahābhāgā devī nārāyaṇī nṛpa
verses.translation: Men who bow unto Adigadadhara with great devotion and faith achieve good qualities, fame and happiness, wives, sons and grandsons. They attain Brahmapura. They will enjoy the fruits of a heap of meritorious action. By offering scents, one will be rich in fragrance; by offer¬ ing flowers, he attains good fortune; by offering sweet incense, he attains a kingdom and illumination through lamps.
verses.hindi: सत्यमित्रोउभिमित्रश्व हरिमित्रस्तकाइपरः +- गण एप: द्वितीयस्तु.तृतीय से निबोधत :..
verses.wordMeaning: Men who bow unto Adigadadhara with great devotion and faith achieve good qualities, fame and happiness, wives, sons and grandsons. They attain Brahmapura. They will enjoy the fruits of a heap of meritorious action. By offering scents, one will be rich in fragrance;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who bow unto Adigadadhara with great devotion and faith achieve good qualities, fame and happiness, wives, sons and grandsons. They attain Brahmapura. They will enjoy the fruits of a heap of meritorious action. By offering scents, one will be rich in fragrance;…

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्ना ते महाभागे व्रतेन नियमेन च । एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं रोहिणी शशिनः प्रिया
verses.transliteration: prasannā te mahābhāge vratena niyamena ca / etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā
verses.translation: By gifting flags, he becomes free from sins; by under¬ taking pilgrimage, he attains Brahmaloka. He who performs a Sraddha and offers Pindas, leads his Pitj-s to Visnu. Those who bow to Adigadadhara with great faith and eulogise him and worship him, lead their Pitrs to Madhava, Even Siva eulogised Adigadadhara with great pleasure.
verses.hindi: (मस्तिद्सरतश्चेच तथा देवो दिशो3पर:+ यजुश्चबानुद्क्सामस्तथाउन्यो मानुषीबिश:॥   देत्या देवाः समाण्याता: सप्तते सप्तका गणा: . :.. . 0१२६८ एते होफकोनपत्नाशन्सरुतो नाम्तः ह्पृत्ताः॥ प्रसंख्यातास्तथा ताम्यां दिल्या चेन्द्रेण चेचहि.
verses.wordMeaning: By gifting flags, he becomes free from sins; by under¬ taking pilgrimage, he attains Brahmaloka. He who performs a Sraddha and offers Pindas, leads his Pitj-s to Visnu. Those who bow to Adigadadhara with great faith and eulogise him and worship him, lead their Pitrs to Madhava,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By gifting flags, he becomes free from sins; by under¬ taking pilgrimage, he attains Brahmaloka. He who performs a Sraddha and offers Pindas, leads his Pitj-s to Visnu. Those who bow to Adigadadhara with great faith and eulogise him and worship him, lead their Pitrs to Madhava,…

verses.sanskrit: यथा भवामि न चिरात्तथा भवतु मानदे । एवमस्त्विति सा चोक्त्वा भवानी भक्तवत्सला
verses.transliteration: yathā bhavāmi na cirāttathā bhavatu mānade / evamastviti sā coktvā bhavānī bhaktavatsalā
verses.translation: I bow to Adigadadhara who though unmanifest, be¬ comes manifest in the form of Munqlaprstha etc. and the holy centre Phalgutlrtha etc. I bow down to Adigadadhara whc is both manifest and unmanifest in the forms of Padas and Mukhalingas etc.
verses.hindi: विचरन्तु व भद्रं ते देवः सहूं ममाउंइत्मजाः... ्््ि १३१
verses.wordMeaning: I bow to Adigadadhara who though unmanifest, be¬ comes manifest in the form of Munqlaprstha etc. and the holy centre Phalgutlrtha etc. I bow down to Adigadadhara whc is both manifest and unmanifest in the forms of Padas and Mukhalingas etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow to Adigadadhara who though unmanifest, be¬ comes manifest in the form of Munqlaprstha etc. and the holy centre Phalgutlrtha etc. I bow down to Adigadadhara whc is both manifest and unmanifest in the forms of Padas and Mukhalingas etc.

verses.sanskrit: स्तूयमाना मुनिगणैस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं रोहिणी शशिनः प्रिया
verses.transliteration: stūyamānā munigaṇaistatraivāntaradhīyata / tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā
verses.translation: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is born naturally on Mundaprstha and who is of unmanifest nature in the form of Janardana. I bow down to Gadadhara who is stationed in the Sila of divine features, who is worshipped by Brahma and other Suras and who is honoured by Devas.
verses.hindi: ओर पुंत्र ने उन सबों का मामकरण संस्कोर किया । इन्द्र के (मा रोदी) (मंत रोओ) इस कथन को लेकर उन सर्बों' का नाम मरुत् गण पड़ा; उनके पृथकं-पृथक् 'नाम इस प्रकार हैं ।१२०-१२२। सत्त्वज्योति,' आदित्य, सत्य-ज्योवि, तिर्यंक् ज्योति, सज्योति और ज्योतिष्मान् -- प्रथम गंण के मरुत् कहे मये हैं। अब दूसरे गणों की नामावली सुनिये, फत््जितू, संत्यजित् सुषेण, सेनेजित्। ' सैत्यमित्र, अभिमित्र और हरिमित्र-- ये द्वितीय गण के मरुत हैं, तृतीय गण को सुनिये ।१२३-१२५। ऋत, सत्य, प्र व, धघर्ता, विधर्ता, विधारय, ध्वान्त धुनि, उग्र भीम, अर्भियुं, सीक्षिप आह्वक, ये दो गणों के मरुत् हैं। ईदुके, ओन्यादंक्,' प्रतिकृत् यादुकं, ऋक्, समिति
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is born naturally on Mundaprstha and who is of unmanifest nature in the form of Janardana. I bow down to Gadadhara who is stationed in the Sila of divine features, who is worshipped by Brahma and other Suras and who is honoured by Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is born naturally on Mundaprstha and who is of unmanifest nature in the form of Janardana. I bow down to Gadadhara who is stationed in the Sila of divine features, who is worshipped by Brahma and other Suras and who is honoured by Devas.

verses.sanskrit: संजाता सर्वकालं तु वल्लभा नृपसत्तम । तत्र तीर्थे तु या नारी नरो वा स्नानि भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: saṃjātā sarvakālaṃ tu vallabhā nṛpasattama / tatra tīrthe tu yā nārī naro vā snāni bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: I bow down to Adigadadhara on seeing, touching, wor¬ shipping and bowing down to whom people attain Brahmaloka. I bow down to Adigadadhara who is the sole cause of Mahat etc. that is manifest and who is of the unmanifest form. I bow down to Adigadadhara who is devoid of physical body, sense organs, mind, intellect, vital airs and ego and who is free from wakeful and dreaming states.
verses.hindi: संरम्भ ये पांचवें गण के मंरुत हैं। ईदेके, पुरुष; अन्यादक्ष, चेतस; समिता, समिवक्ष, और प्रतिदुक्ष ये एक गण के मरुत हैं। मर्तिद्, सरते, दिश, यजु, अनुक्क्, साम, मानुषी विद्या, देत्य, देव ये सात-सातें के ' एक-एक गण हैं ।१२६-१२६। ये उंपर्थक्त उनंचास मरुत् गण के नाम से विख्यात हैं  इरंद्र और दिति ने इंनेकी गणना और नामंकरण किया । इस प्रकार इन सबों के नामकरण हो जांने पर दिति ने इन्द्र से कहां, पुत्र ! ये
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Adigadadhara on seeing, touching, wor¬ shipping and bowing down to whom people attain Brahmaloka. I bow down to Adigadadhara who is the sole cause of Mahat etc. that is manifest and who is of the unmanifest form.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Adigadadhara on seeing, touching, wor¬ shipping and bowing down to whom people attain Brahmaloka. I bow down to Adigadadhara who is the sole cause of Mahat etc. that is manifest and who is of the unmanifest form.…

verses.sanskrit: वल्लभा जायते सा तु भर्तुर् वै रोहिणी यथा । तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित्प्राणत्यागं करोति वै
verses.transliteration: vallabhā jāyate sā tu bhartur vai rohiṇī yathā / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitprāṇatyāgaṃ karoti vai
verses.translation: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is free from the eter¬ nal and the non-eternal (state), who is truth, bliss and the un¬ changing state, the fourth one, the luminous Atman. Eulogised thus by Mahesa, Adigadadhara became delighted. That lord stationed himself on the slab along with Brahma and other Devas.
verses.hindi: पुश्रगण उपर्थक्त वायु स्कन्धों में विचरण करें, तुम ऐसा ही करो कि देवताओं के साथ ये मेरे पुत्रंगण सुखपूव के स्वंमेत््यथोक्‍तं ते भविष्यन्ति न संशय: । देवभूता महात्मानः कुमारा देवसंमताः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is free from the eter¬ nal and the non-eternal (state), who is truth, bliss and the un¬ changing state, the fourth one, the luminous Atman. Eulogised thus by Mahesa, Adigadadhara became delighted.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is free from the eter¬ nal and the non-eternal (state), who is truth, bliss and the un¬ changing state, the fourth one, the luminous Atman. Eulogised thus by Mahesa, Adigadadhara became delighted.…

verses.sanskrit: सप्तजन्मानि दाम्पत्यवियोगो न भवेत् क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: saptajanmāni dāmpatyaviyogo na bhavet kvacit
verses.translation: Those who eulogise and worship Lord Adigadadhara who is stationed on the mountain Mun<Japrstha shall attain Brahmaloka. He who seeks piety shall attain piety; he who seeks love shall secure love and he who seeks salvation shall get salvation. Even a barren lady gets a son who will be a master of Vedas and their Angas (ancillaries). A king attains victory; a Sudra too shall attain happiness.
verses.hindi: हैव: सह भविष्यन्ति यज्ञभाजस्तवा55त्मजा ६१३३ तस्मात्ते मरुतो देवाः सर्वे चेन्रानुजामराः। विज्ञेयाश्वामरा: सर्वे दितिपुत्रास्तपस्विन
verses.wordMeaning: Those who eulogise and worship Lord Adigadadhara who is stationed on the mountain Mun<Japrstha shall attain Brahmaloka. He who seeks piety shall attain piety; he who seeks love shall secure love and he who seeks salvation shall get salvation.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who eulogise and worship Lord Adigadadhara who is stationed on the mountain Mun<Japrstha shall attain Brahmaloka. He who seeks piety shall attain piety; he who seeks love shall secure love and he who seeks salvation shall get salvation.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रोहिणीसोमनाथतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १०९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल चक्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । सेनापुरमितिख्यातं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe rohiṇīsomanāthatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 109 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla cakratīrthamanuttamam / senāpuramitikhyātaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: o Narada, listen. I shall recount the (procedure of) pilgrimage to Gaya which yields salvation. Redemption for those who perform Sraddha has been sung by Brahma earlier. If one makes preparations for going to Gaya, 1 one should duly perform Sraddha and circumambulate the vil¬ lage, dressed only in loin cloth like a pilgrim. He shou t en go to the next village and partake of the remainder of the Srad- Verses 2-5 deal with preliminaries before starting onpilgrimage to Gaya.
verses.hindi: इति श्री महापुराणे वायुप्रीक्तें उपोदधातपादे कश्यपीयप्रजासगों नाम सप्तषष्टितमोज्ध्याय: क्चिरण करें  दिति की बातें सुतकर सहसनेत्र पुरन्दर ने हाथ जोड़कर निवेदन किया, है मातः ! आपकी जंसी
verses.wordMeaning: o Narada, listen. I shall recount the (procedure of) pilgrimage to Gaya which yields salvation. Redemption for those who perform Sraddha has been sung by Brahma earlier. If one makes preparations for going to Gaya,…
verses.commentary: Sense: o Narada, listen. I shall recount the (procedure of) pilgrimage to Gaya which yields salvation. Redemption for those who perform Sraddha has been sung by Brahma earlier. If one makes preparations for going to Gaya,…

verses.sanskrit: सैनापत्याभिषेकाय देवदेवेन चक्रिणा । आनीतश्च महासेनो देवैः सेन्द्रपुरोगमैः
verses.transliteration: saināpatyābhiṣekāya devadevena cakriṇā / ānītaśca mahāseno devaiḥ sendrapurogamaiḥ
verses.translation: He whose hands and feet are controlled, the mind is restraiiied and who possesses learning, penance and fame, attains the fruit of the pilgrimage to the holy centre. After performing the Tarpana of Devas and others and after performing the Sraddha in accordance with the injunc¬ tions, one should recite the Vedic passage belonging to one's own branch but need not perform Arghyapradana (offering of Arghya) and Avahana (invocation). With all purity, he should perform the Sraddha for those who are Sapindas (haying the similar Pindas i.e. near kinsmen) on the Pretaparvata. The intelligent pilgrim should face the southern direction and wear the sacred thread as Pra- cinaviti (from the right shoulder across the chest and passed un¬ der the left arm.)
verses.hindi: आज्ञा है वैसा ही होगा। इसमें तनिक भी सन्देह मत करो, जेसी आपकी इच्छा है वसा ही मैं कडूंगा। ये तुम्हारे महात्मा पुत्रगण देव तुल्य हैं, यही नहीं देवताओं से भी सम्माननीय हैं, देबताओं के साथ ये भी यज्ञ में भाग पाने के अधिकारी होंगे ।१३०-१३३। (सुत ने कहा) ऋषिवन्द ! यही कारण है कि वे मरुत् गण
verses.wordMeaning: He whose hands and feet are controlled, the mind is restraiiied and who possesses learning, penance and fame, attains the fruit of the pilgrimage to the holy centre.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He whose hands and feet are controlled, the mind is restraiiied and who possesses learning, penance and fame, attains the fruit of the pilgrimage to the holy centre.…

verses.sanskrit: दानवानां वधार्थाय जयाय च दिवौकसाम् । भूमिदानेन विप्रेन्द्रांस् तर्पयित्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: dānavānāṃ vadhārthāya jayāya ca divaukasām / bhūmidānena viprendrāṃs tarpayitvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: "The fire with Kavyabala (?), Soma, Yama, Aryama, the Pitf-god, like Agnisvattas, the Barhisads and the Somapas may (please) come; you are the deities of the Pitrs. O blessed deities, my Pitrs are protected by you. Those kindred relations born in the family are to be offered the ball of rice. I Verses6-7 deal with the 1st dayof the Yatra. Va.P.prescribcs only bath in Phalgu, Sraddha and recitation of one's Veda. TSS. ( ) prescribes visit to Pretasila and Sraddha on that very day after Sraddha at Phalgu. The rites on the 2nd day: Visit to Pretaparvata, bath in Brahma- kuytfa Sraddha, offering of Piitfas first to one's paternal anscetors ( w. 23-
verses.hindi: दिति के पुत्र होकर भी अमर माने गुये । इस प्रकार का निश्चय कर वे तंपस्वी माता पृत्र परम हर्षित हुए, दिति अपने निवासस्थान को और इन्द्र स्व्गंलोक को प्रस्थित हुए । जो कोई मरुत्गणों के मंगलकारी जन्म बत्तान्त को सुनता है अथवा पढ़ता है उसे दीर्घायु की प्राप्ति होती है और वह कभी अनावृष्टि के काश्ण कष्ट नहीं अनुभव करता ।१३४०१३६। . सत्यसंघाः पराक्वान्ताः फ़रा सायाविनश्व ते । महाबला अयज्वानो ह्मब्रह्मण्याश्व दानवाः ।। कीत्यंमानानमया सर्वान्प्राधान्येन निबोधत ३३ द्विमूर्धा शहकुकर्णश्न तथा शडकुनिरामयः  शइकुकर्णो महाविश्वों गवेध्ठिदुन्दुभिस्तथा ४
verses.wordMeaning: "The fire with Kavyabala (?), Soma, Yama, Aryama, the Pitf-god, like Agnisvattas, the Barhisads and the Somapas may (please) come; you are the deities of the Pitrs. O blessed deities, my Pitrs are protected by you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "The fire with Kavyabala (?), Soma, Yama, Aryama, the Pitf-god, like Agnisvattas, the Barhisads and the Somapas may (please) come; you are the deities of the Pitrs. O blessed deities, my Pitrs are protected by you.…

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च पटहानां च निस्वनैः । वीणावेणुमृदङ्गैश्च झल्लरीस्वरमङ्गलैः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhabherīninādaiśca paṭahānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ / vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgaiśca jhallarīsvaramaṅgalaiḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and performing Acamana, the pil¬ grim should perform Pranayama with effort, in order to obtain Brahmaloka which is devoid of Pmaravrtti (a return to Sam- sara'again). After performing the Sraddha duly in this manner, he, should invoke the Pitrs and worship them with the mantras. Then he should offer the balls of rice. In the holy centre, on the Pretas'ila etc. the place must first be washed with Pancagavya separately while their mantras are being recited. Then the deities must be worshipped with offerings of Caru soaked in ghee. So long as the gingelly seeds are taken by the pilgrim in the holy rites of the Pitrs, Asuras run off from the place of holy rites like deer afraid of lion. The Sraddha of the mother 1 should be performed sep¬ arately during the Astakas (i.e. the 8th day of the three months on which the Pitrs are to be propitiated), during the Vrddhi (increase) days and on the day of the death at Gaya. On other occasions the Sraddha should be performed along with that of her husband (i.e. one's father).
verses.hindi: विक्षोब्यश्र सुकेतुश्व सुवीर्यः सुहृदस्तथा । इन्द्रजिद्विश्वजिच्चेव तथा सुरविमर्दनः
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and performing Acamana, the pil¬ grim should perform Pranayama with effort, in order to obtain Brahmaloka which is devoid of Pmaravrtti (a return to Sam- sara'again). After performing the Sraddha duly in this manner, he,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and performing Acamana, the pil¬ grim should perform Pranayama with effort, in order to obtain Brahmaloka which is devoid of Pmaravrtti (a return to Sam- sara'again). After performing the Sraddha duly in this manner, he,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः कृत्वा स्वनं घोरं दानवो बलदर्पितः । रुरुर्नाम विघातार्थमभिषेकस्य चागतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṛtvā svanaṃ ghoraṃ dānavo baladarpitaḥ / rururnāma vighātārthamabhiṣekasya cāgataḥ
verses.translation: During Vrddhi Sraddha, that of the mother should be performed first. But at Gaya that of the father should be performed first. The Sraddha is begun with the offerings of Padya at the outset and the proper laying of the Kusa grass with the tips pointing to the south to the father etc. The remaining part of the Sraddha is to be performed as mentioned in the res¬ pective Grhya Sutras. In the case of Sapindas, the Darbha grass is duly spread and the water with gingelly seeds is offered once and the Sraddha is performed on their southern side. The water libation is offered with the sacred water of the Pitrs holding it in the hollow of one's palms. He should then offer the Aksayya (inexhaustible) Pinda with a fistful of powdered fried grain. The other kinsmen are then to be invoked in the Ku£a grass by means of the waters with gingelly seeds.
verses.hindi: कश्यप की सन्ततियों की सृष्टि सूत ने कहा-ऋषिव॒ुन्द ! अब इसके उपराब्त मैं दनु के पुत्रों का वत्तात्त कह रहा हूँ सुनिये । वे दनु के पुत्र अपने वंश में परम विख्यात एवं महान् असुर थे १। उनमें सब का प्रधान विप्रचित्ति था, उनकी संख्या सैकड़ों की थी । जो सब फे सब परमपराक्रमी थे। उन सभी को वरदान मिले हुए थे, वे सब के सब परम तपस्वी थे । इतना होने पर भी वे दृढप्रतिश्ञ थे, परमविक्रमशील थे, क्र थे, मायावी
verses.wordMeaning: During Vrddhi Sraddha, that of the mother should be performed first. But at Gaya that of the father should be performed first.…
verses.commentary: Sense: During Vrddhi Sraddha, that of the mother should be performed first. But at Gaya that of the father should be performed first.…

verses.sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वरथपत्त्योघैः पूरयन्वै दिशो दश । तत्र तेन महद्युद्धं प्रवृत्तं किल भारत
verses.transliteration: hastyaśvarathapattyoghaiḥ pūrayanvai diśo daśa / tatra tena mahadyuddhaṃ pravṛttaṃ kila bhārata
verses.translation: The special Sraddha for one's mother is prescribed during the A?takas and in Vrddhi Sraddha. May all those Devas, sages. Pi tj-s and human beings, mothers and maternal grandfathers and others beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass, be propitiated by this water libation. May this be the water libation along withgingelly seeds to all those crores of past (members of) families, residing in the seven continents beginning with Brahma and ending with the earth.
verses.hindi: थे  महाबलवान् थे, यज्ञादि में उनकी निष्ठा नहीं थी, ब्राह्मण धर्म के विरोधी थे। उन्हें दानव नाम से लोग जानते हैं। उन सर्बों में जो प्रधात-प्रधान दानव हो गये हैं, उनका मैं वर्णन कर रहा हूँ, सुनिये ।२-३। द्विमूर्घा, शंकुकर्ण, शडकुनिरामय, शंकुकर्ण, महाविश्व, गवेष्ठि, दुन्दुभि, अजामुख, ऐश्वर्यशाली दिल, वामनस, मरीचि, रक्षक, महागाग्यं, अज्िराव॒त, विक्षोम्य, सुकेतु, सुवीयं, सुहृद, इख्द्रजितूु, विध्वजित् सुरविम्दंत एक
verses.wordMeaning: The special Sraddha for one's mother is prescribed during the A?takas and in Vrddhi Sraddha. May all those Devas, sages. Pi tj-s and human beings, mothers and maternal grandfathers and others beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The special Sraddha for one's mother is prescribed during the A?takas and in Vrddhi Sraddha. May all those Devas, sages. Pi tj-s and human beings, mothers and maternal grandfathers and others beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass,…

verses.sanskrit: शक्त्यृष्टिपाशमुशलैः खड्गैस्तोमरटङ्कनैः । भल्लैः कर्णिकनाराचैः कबन्धपटसंकुलैः
verses.transliteration: śaktyṛṣṭipāśamuśalaiḥ khaḍgaistomaraṭaṅkanaiḥ / bhallaiḥ karṇikanārācaiḥ kabandhapaṭasaṃkulaiḥ
verses.translation: A ball of rice has been offered by me to all these: father, grandfather, great-grandfather, mother, grandmother, great-grandmother, maternal grandfather, his father and his grandfather. May that Pinda be of everlasting benefit, At Gayasiras the Pinda offered is of the size of a first or that of the green emblic myrobalan fruit or that of the leaf of the Sami tree. The devotee shall uplift seven Gotras and a hundred families. The Gotras—seven in number—are those of the father, mother, one's wife (before marriage), one's sister (after marriage), one's daughter (after marriage), and those of the father's sisters and mother's sisters. The hundred and one families are as follows: father and his twentyfour ancestors, mother and her twenty ancestors, wife and her sixteen ancestors, twelve ancestors of the sister's husband, eleven an¬ cestors of the son-in-law, seven ancestors of the husband of the sister of one's father and eight ancestors of the husband of mother's sister. There is no invocation in a TirthaSraddha nor is screen erected shutting off the quarters. There is no defect due to the viewing of others. Clever people should not perform the Tirtha- iraddha out of pity.
verses.hindi: सुक्ष्मश्चव निचन्द्रश्न ऊर्गनाभों महागिरिः । असिलोमा सुकेशभ्र सदश्च बलको दश ६ इति पुत्रा दनोवँशे प्रधाना: परिकीतिता:  तेघामपरिसंख्येय॑ पुत्रपोत्रा्यनन्तकम्् ३१३
verses.wordMeaning: A ball of rice has been offered by me to all these: father, grandfather, great-grandfather, mother, grandmother, great-grandmother, maternal grandfather, his father and his grandfather. May that Pinda be of everlasting benefit,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A ball of rice has been offered by me to all these: father, grandfather, great-grandfather, mother, grandmother, great-grandmother, maternal grandfather, his father and his grandfather. May that Pinda be of everlasting benefit,…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु तां शत्रुबलस्य सेनां क्षणेन चापन्च्युतबाणघातैः । विध्वस्तहस्त्यश्वरथान्महात्मा जग्राह चक्रं रिपुसङ्घनाशनः
verses.transliteration: tatastu tāṃ śatrubalasya senāṃ kṣaṇena cāpancyutabāṇaghātaiḥ / vidhvastahastyaśvarathānmahātmā jagrāha cakraṃ ripusaṅghanāśanaḥ
verses.translation: This following is the procedure in the Tirtha Sraddhas'. providing seat of the Pintfas, offering of the Pintfas, Avane- jaria (ritualistic sprinkling with the Darbha grass), monetary gifts and the Annasarhkalpa (ritualistic expression of one's inten¬ tion in preparing food). Mantra: "I invoke all those members of our family who are dead and who have no other way of salvation. I shall I invoke all those persons in the family of our kinsmen who are dead and who have no other way of salvation. I shall invoke them on the Darbha grass with water libations along with gingelly seeds".
verses.hindi: एकाक्ष ऋषभो३रिष्ट: प्रलम्बनरकावपि । इन्द्रबाधनकेशी च समेरुः शंबोध्थ धेनुकः
verses.wordMeaning: This following is the procedure in the Tirtha Sraddhas'. providing seat of the Pintfas, offering of the Pintfas, Avane- jaria (ritualistic sprinkling with the Darbha grass), monetary gifts and the Annasarhkalpa (ritualistic expression of one's inten¬ tion in preparing food).…
verses.commentary: Sense: This following is the procedure in the Tirtha Sraddhas'. providing seat of the Pintfas, offering of the Pintfas, Avane- jaria (ritualistic sprinkling with the Darbha grass), monetary gifts and the Annasarhkalpa (ritualistic expression of one's inten¬ tion in preparing food).…

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलच्च चक्रं निशितं भयंकरं सुरासुराणां च सुदर्शनं रणे । चकर्त दैत्यस्य शिरस्तदानीं करात्प्रमुक्तं मधुघातिनश्च तत्
verses.transliteration: jvalacca cakraṃ niśitaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ surāsurāṇāṃ ca sudarśanaṃ raṇe / cakarta daityasya śirastadānīṃ karātpramuktaṃ madhughātinaśca tat
verses.translation: Thus the pilgrim should meditate on the Darbhas, repeat these mantras with the offering of water libations along with gingelly seeds, invoke and worship the Pitrs and offer the Pindas in due order. f< I am offering this Pinda in order to uplift those per¬ sons of our family who are dead and who have no other means of salvation. I am offering this Pinda in order to emancipate those persons of our maternal grandfather's family who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.
verses.hindi: गवेष्ठिभ्र गवाक्षश्र तालकेतुश्न वीयबान् । एते मनुष्यधर्मास्तु दनोः पुत्रा मया स्मृताः देत्यदानवसंधर्षे जाता भीसपराक्षमा: । सिहिकायासथोत्पन्ना विप्रचित्तिसुतास्त्विमे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the pilgrim should meditate on the Darbhas, repeat these mantras with the offering of water libations along with gingelly seeds, invoke and worship the Pitrs and offer the Pindas in due order.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the pilgrim should meditate on the Darbhas, repeat these mantras with the offering of water libations along with gingelly seeds, invoke and worship the Pitrs and offer the Pindas in due order.…

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा विघ्नमभिषेके षडाननः । त्यक्त्वा तु तत्र संस्थानं चचार विपुलं तपः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā vighnamabhiṣeke ṣaḍānanaḥ / tyaktvā tu tatra saṃsthānaṃ cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: I am offering this Pinda for the uplift of those persons belonging to the family of our kinsmen who are dead and who have no other means of salvation. I am offering this Pinda for the uplift of those persons who (died) before cutting teeth and those who were afflicted even while in the womb. I am offering this Pinda to those persons who were duly cremated and who were not those who were struck dead by lightning or by robbers.
verses.hindi: सेंहिकेया इति ख्याताशभ्रतुर्दश महासुरा: । शतगालश्र बलवान्त्यासः शाम्बस्तथेव च १८ + अनुलोमः शुचिश्चेव वातापिश्न सितांशुकः । हरकल्पः कालनाभो मोमश्व नरकस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering this Pinda for the uplift of those persons belonging to the family of our kinsmen who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering this Pinda for the uplift of those persons belonging to the family of our kinsmen who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.…

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तं चक्रं विनाशाय हरिणा लोकधारिणा । द्विदलं दानवं कृत्वा पपात विमले जले
verses.transliteration: muktaṃ cakraṃ vināśāya hariṇā lokadhāriṇā / dvidalaṃ dānavaṃ kṛtvā papāta vimale jale
verses.translation: I am offering this Pinda to those who died in the forest fire, to those who were killed by lions and tigers and those who were slain by horned and fanged (beasts of prey). I am offering to those who died by getting hanged, who were killed by poison or by weapons and those who have committed suicide. Iam offering this Pinda for the upliftment of those persons who have fallen into the hells called Raurava, Andha- tamisra and Kalasutra.
verses.hindi: घतराष्ट, सूथ॑, चन्द्र, इन्द्र, ताविनू, सूक्ष्म, निचन्द्र, ऊर्णनाभ, महागिरि असिलोमा, सुकेश, सद, बलक, शतमायु, शम्बर, शरभ और शलभ ये प्रमुख दाननगण कहे गये हैं। सूर्य और चन्द्रमा ये दोगों पहले असुरों के
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering this Pinda to those who died in the forest fire, to those who were killed by lions and tigers and those who were slain by horned and fanged (beasts of prey). I am offering to those who died by getting hanged,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering this Pinda to those who died in the forest fire, to those who were killed by lions and tigers and those who were slain by horned and fanged (beasts of prey). I am offering to those who died by getting hanged,…

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं चक्रतीर्थमिति श्रुतम् । सर्वपापविनाशाय निर्मितं विश्वमूर्तिना
verses.transliteration: tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ cakratīrthamiti śrutam / sarvapāpavināśāya nirmitaṃ viśvamūrtinā
verses.translation: Iam offering this Pinda for the emancipation of those I am offering this Pinda to those who are born in the animal wombs or as birds, worms, insects or reptiles or even as I am offering the Pinda to those Pitrs who are stationed in heaven, firmament or on the earth and to those kinsmen etc. who have not been cremated duly after death.
verses.hindi: सबों के पुत्र पौत्रादि की संख्या असंख्य है, अनन्त हैं । दिति और दलु के पृत्र गणों का, जो सब भसूर नाम से विख्यात हैं, परिचय कह चुका । स्वेभानु (राहु) दिति का पुत्र कहा गया है, अनुभानु दनु का पुत्र होने के कारण दानव कहा गया है !१३-१४। ये उपर्यक्त बंश परम्परागत दनु के पुत्र स्मरण किये जाते हैं । एकाक्ष, ऋषभ, अरिष्ट, पलम्ब, नरक, इन्द्रवाधन केश्ी, मेरु, दांव, धेनुक, गवेष्ठि, गवाक्ष, पराक्रमी तालकेतु-
verses.wordMeaning: Iam offering this Pinda for the emancipation of those I am offering this Pinda to those who are born in the animal wombs or as birds, worms, insects or reptiles or even as I am offering the Pinda to those Pitrs who are stationed in heaven,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Iam offering this Pinda for the emancipation of those I am offering this Pinda to those who are born in the animal wombs or as birds, worms, insects or reptiles or even as I am offering the Pinda to those Pitrs who are stationed in heaven,…

verses.sanskrit: चक्रतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेद् देवमच्युतम् । पुण्डरीकस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: cakratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayed devamacyutam / puṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated through this Pinda for ever, those Pitrs who exist in the form of ghosts. This Pinda has been offered by me to those who may or may not have been my kinsmen in this birth but who were my kinsmen in the other births. May it be of everlasting benefit This Pinda has been offered by me to all those who are dead in my father's family, to those who are dead in my mother's family, to those kinsmen, elders, fathers-in-law or other relatives who are dead, to such of those in my family as had neither sons nor wives and hence had been deprived of Pinda offerings, to those who had been defaulters in the holy rites, to those who were born blind, to those who had been lame, to those who had hideous forms, to those who had been prema¬ turely born, to all persons of my family known and unknown. To all those the Pinda has been offered by me. May it be of everlasting benefit in reaching unto them.
verses.hindi: ये दनु के पुत्र मनुष्यों के धर्मकम का आचरण करने वाले हैं--ऐसा मैं जानता हू । विप्रचित्ति के भयानक पराक्रमशाली चौदह पुत्र देत्यों और दानवों के संघ में सिहिका के संयोग से उत्पन्न हुये थे, इस कारणवश वे चौदहों महान अधुर सेहिकेय के नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुए । जिनके नाम शतगाल, बलवान न्यास, शाम्ब, अनुलोम, शुचि, वातापि, सितांशुक, हर, कल्प, कालनाभ, भौम और नरक; इनमें सब से ज्येष्ठ पुत्र का नाम
verses.wordMeaning: May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated through this Pinda for ever, those Pitrs who exist in the form of ghosts. This Pinda has been offered by me to those who may or may not have been my kinsmen in this birth but who were my kinsmen in the other births.…
verses.commentary: Sense: May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated through this Pinda for ever, those Pitrs who exist in the form of ghosts. This Pinda has been offered by me to those who may or may not have been my kinsmen in this birth but who were my kinsmen in the other births.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेद् ब्राह्मणाञ्छुभान् । शान्तदान्तजितक्रोधान्स लभेत्कोटिजं फलम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayed brāhmaṇāñchubhān / śāntadāntajitakrodhānsa labhetkoṭijaṃ phalam
verses.translation: I am offering this Pinda with Svadha to all these: Those who are born in my father's family ever since the days of god Brahma; those who are born in my mother's family; those who had been my servants in both these families; to those attendants and dependents, to the friends, disciples, animals, trees, birds seen or not seen, those who had rendered help unto me; those who had been in contact with me in my previous births". With these Mantras the pilgrim should offer the Pindas to the women too, beginning with mother. In that case he should make necessary changes in the substantives and adjec¬ tives making them conform to the feminine gender. Whether in one's own Gotra or in the other man's Gotra, the offering of the Pindas, the performance of Sraddhas and the water libation is futile if done separately.
verses.hindi: + एतदरधंस्थाने इदमर्ध ख. ग. घ. डः. पुस्तकेषु 'इल्बला नमुचिस्चंव वातापी दसुधाजकः” इति ।
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering this Pinda with Svadha to all these: Those who are born in my father's family ever since the days of god Brahma; those who are born in my mother's family; those who had been my servants in both these families; to those attendants and dependents, to the friends,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering this Pinda with Svadha to all these: Those who are born in my father's family ever since the days of god Brahma; those who are born in my mother's family; those who had been my servants in both these families; to those attendants and dependents, to the friends,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या त्यजते देहमात्मनः । विष्णुलोकं मृतो याति जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā tyajate dehamātmanaḥ / viṣṇulokaṃ mṛto yāti jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ
verses.translation: He should put the gingelly seeds in the vessel of Pindas and fill it with holy water. He should perform the Parisecana rite thrice for all the Pindas and conclude the rite by prostra¬ ting himself (before them). After ritualistically dismissing the Pitrs, he should per¬ form Acamana and express these words to Suras as witnesses. O Lord Gadadhara, I have come to Gaya for the performance of the rites of the Pitrs. 1 O Lord, you alone are the witness thereof. I have become free from the threefold indebtedness".
verses.hindi: राहुज्येष्ठस्तु तेषां वे चन्द्रसुयप्रतर्द न: । इत्येते सिहिकापुत्रा देवेरषि दुरासदाः २० दारुणाभिजना:ः क्रूराः सर्वे ब्रह्मद्विषश्व ते । दशान्यानि सहस्नाणि सहिकेयो गणः स्पृतः १२१९ निहतो जामदस्त्येन भाग॑वेण बलीयसा । स्वभनिस्तु प्रभा कन्बा पुलोम्नोइथ शचो सुता उपनादवीयमस्यथावि शर्मिष्ठा वाषपंणी । पुलोमा कालिका चेव वश्वानरसुते उमभे ।!२३
verses.wordMeaning: He should put the gingelly seeds in the vessel of Pindas and fill it with holy water. He should perform the Parisecana rite thrice for all the Pindas and conclude the rite by prostra¬ ting himself (before them). After ritualistically dismissing the Pitrs,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He should put the gingelly seeds in the vessel of Pindas and fill it with holy water. He should perform the Parisecana rite thrice for all the Pindas and conclude the rite by prostra¬ ting himself (before them). After ritualistically dismissing the Pitrs,…

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडयित्वा यथाकामं देवगन्धर्वपूजितः । इहागत्य च भूयो ऽपि जायते विपुले कुले
verses.transliteration: krīḍayitvā yathākāmaṃ devagandharvapūjitaḥ / ihāgatya ca bhūyo 'pi jāyate vipule kule
verses.translation: O Narada, the offering of Pindas in all the places should be like this alone. Beginning with the Preta mountain, he should do it in all the holy spots in due order. Thereafter, O celestial sage, he should throw powdered fried grains mixed with gingelly seeds on the Pretaparvata, anticlockwise and facing the south.
verses.hindi: वेश्वानरसुते होते पुलोमाकालिके उभे । उभे हापि तु ते कन्ये मारीचस्य परिप्रहे
verses.wordMeaning: O Narada, the offering of Pindas in all the places should be like this alone. Beginning with the Preta mountain, he should do it in all the holy spots in due order. Thereafter, O celestial sage,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Narada, the offering of Pindas in all the places should be like this alone. Beginning with the Preta mountain, he should do it in all the holy spots in due order. Thereafter, O celestial sage,…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं धन्यं दुःखप्रणाशनम् । कथितं ते महाभाग भूयश्चान्यच्छृणुष्व मे
verses.transliteration: etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥkhapraṇāśanam / kathitaṃ te mahābhāga bhūyaścānyacchṛṇuṣva me
verses.translation: To request the supreme deity of Gaya to stand witness to one's visit may appear funny to some, but that denotes the living faith of the pilgrim in Gadadhara. Mantra: "May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated by means of these powdered fried grains mixed with gingelly seeds, those Pitrs who exist in the form of ghosts. May all the mobile and immobile beings begin¬ ning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass be propitia¬ ted by means of the libation offered by me. O Narada, his Pitrs shall be released from ghosthood. Thanks to his great¬ ness, this ghosthood will never recur in his family.
verses.hindi: पौलोमा: कालकेयाश्र दानवाः सुमहाबला: । अवध्या देवतानां ते निह॒ताः सव्यप्ताचिना (२७ मयस्य जाता ये पुत्रा: सर्वे वीर॒पराक्रमा: । सायावी दुन्दुभिश्चेव वृषश्च महिषस्तथा २८ बालिको वज्ञ्कर्ण श्र कन्या मनन्‍्दोदरी तथा। देत्यानां दानवानां च सर्गं एष प्रकीतित: राहु था, जो चन्द्रमा और सूयं को कष्ट देने वाला था। ये सिंहिका के पुत्रणगण देवताओं से भी अजेय थे और वे सब के सब परम दारुण चित्तवतिवाले, क्र, तथा ब्राह्मण देषी थे । इनके अतिरिक्त अन्य दस सहस्र राक्षसों का समूह था, जो सेहिकेय नाम से स्मरण किया जाता था । १५-२१॥ उसका संहार बलवान भूगु वंशो-ड्ूब जामदग््य परशुराम ने किया था। स्वर्भानु की कन्या का नाम प्रभा था, पुलोमा की पुत्री सूची थी। मय की
verses.wordMeaning: To request the supreme deity of Gaya to stand witness to one's visit may appear funny to some, but that denotes the living faith of the pilgrim in Gadadhara. Mantra: "May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated by means of these powdered fried grains mixed with gingelly seeds,…
verses.commentary: Sense: To request the supreme deity of Gaya to stand witness to one's visit may appear funny to some, but that denotes the living faith of the pilgrim in Gadadhara. Mantra: "May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated by means of these powdered fried grains mixed with gingelly seeds,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सेनापुरे चक्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम नवोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ११० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: धौतपापं ततो गच्छेन् महापातकनाशनम् । समीपे चक्रतीर्थस्य विष्णुना निर्मितं पुरा
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe senāpure cakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 110 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dhautapāpaṃ tato gacchen mahāpātakanāśanam / samīpe cakratīrthasya viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ purā
verses.translation: At the outset, I shall mention the procedure for holy rites in the five holy centres 1 in the Uttara (Northern) Manasa. 2 The pilgrim should perform Acamana and sprinkle water over his head. Then he should go to the Uttaramanasa and perform On the third day Pancatirthi rites are to be observed. The five Tirthas are Uttaramanasa, Udicitirtha, Kanakhala, Daksinamanasa and Phalgu. TSS ( ) clarifies that five baths in a day or bath in each of them is not necessary. Phalgutlrth is Gayasiras. The real Kanakhala is near Hardwar. Here the tank is supposed to represent that Himalayan Tirtha. As I stated elsewhere, these Sthala Puranas claim ail the sacr ed spots in the three worlds as being present in their locality. The real Uttara Manasa is a twin-lake of Payoda and Pundarika. It is modern Karakul in northern Pamirs (AG ), while Southern Manasa is the twin take Manasa-sarovara and Raksasa Tala of the Kailasa range. But this Purana claims two ponds at Gaya as representing those two magnificent lakes. Indeed the lake Manasa is here. Hence it is called Uttaramanasa. The devotee shall bow to the Sun and worship him. He will lead the Pitrs to the solar sphere. "Obeisance to the lord and sustainer (Sun) who assumes The holy centre Kanakhala which is well known in the three worlds is there. One taking bath there, shines like gold. The man attains sanctity. These are three holy spots in the Southern Manasa. The devotee should take his bath therein duly and perform the Sraddhas severally. "I am performing my holy ablution in the Daksina.Manasa for the purification of the Atman, for the achievement of the solar world etc. and for the salvation of the Pitrs. O Divakara (Sun), I am taking my holy bath here in Daksinamanasa for the sake of freedom from the torture of the sins of Brahmana-slaughter etc. I bow down to the Sun-god for the propitiation and redemption of the Pitrs and for the increase of sons, grandsons, wealth, prosperity, longevity and health". Daksina Manasa is divided into three separate Tirthas: the northern part is the UdicI Tirtha, the middle is Kanakhala and the southern part is Southern Manasa—TSS 359. All the holy centres in all the three worlds come over to Phalgutirtha to take their bath along with Suras. Ganga is the water oozing out from the foot of Visnu. But Phalgu is the primordial Gadadhara himself. He assumes the liquid form himself. Hence they call it more sacred than Even he who performs a thousand times thousand horse sacrifices does not attain that fruit which one attains in Phalgutirtha. "I perform the ablution in the waters of Visnu, in Phalgutirtha with due respect, in order to secure Visnuloka for the Pitj-s and for the realisation of worldly pleasures and salvation". The man (the pilgrim) should take bath and perform Tarpana and Sraddha in Phalgutirtha in the manner it has been mentioned in his own Sutra (i.e. Grhyasuti'a he follows) with due offerings of Pindas. He shall then bow down to Pitamaha. "Obeisance to lord Siva, Isa, the (great) Purusa, to Aghoravamadeva, Sadyojata and Saiiibhu".
verses.hindi: पुत्री उपदानवी और वृधपर्वा की पुत्री आर्मिष्ठा थी । पुलोमा और कालिका-ये दोनों वैश्वानर की पुत्रियाँ थी । तिनमें से प्रभा का पूत्र नहुष और शी का पुत्र जयस्त हुआ, शर्भिष्ठा ने पुरु को और उपदानत्री ने दुष्यन्त को उत्पन्न किया । वै्ञानर की दोनों पुत्रियाँ, प्रलोमा और कालिका जो थीं, बे दोनों ही मरीचिपुत्र कश्यप की स्त्रियाँ हुई ।२२-२५। उन दोनों से एक सहस्न प्रमुख दानव पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए, इनके अतिरिक्त चौदह सहस्र अन्य
verses.wordMeaning: At the outset, I shall mention the procedure for holy rites in the five holy centres 1 in the Uttara (Northern) Manasa. 2 The pilgrim should perform Acamana and sprinkle water over his head.…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the outset, I shall mention the procedure for holy rites in the five holy centres 1 in the Uttara (Northern) Manasa. 2 The pilgrim should perform Acamana and sprinkle water over his head.…

verses.sanskrit: निहतैर् दानवैर् घोरैर् देवदेवो जनार्दनः । तत्पापस्य विनाशार्थं दानवान्तोद्भवस्य च
verses.transliteration: nihatair dānavair ghorair devadevo janārdanaḥ / tatpāpasya vināśārthaṃ dānavāntodbhavasya ca
verses.translation: Phalgutirtha is Gayasiras and its boundaries as given in w. 28-2 > from Nagakuta to Grdhrakuta, from there to Yupa and upto Uttara-manasa. It is beneath the mountain Mundaprsfha-A -25-26 and G.P. • differ. After taking bath in Phalgutlrtha and visiting lord Gadadhara, the man (the pilgrim) shall redeem his own soul, ten generations of the past and ten generations of the future. After bowing to Lord Gadadhara, one should wor¬ ship by means of this Mantra: "Om, obeisance to Vasudeva. Obeisance to Sarikarsana, to Pradyumna, to Aniruddha, to Srldhara, to Visnu". After performing the ablution in the "five holy centres", the pilgrim shall lead the Pitrs to Brahmaloka. Futile indeed is the Sraddha of that person who does not bathe the mace-bearing deity by means of Pancamrta nor embellishes it with flowers, garments etc. From the Nagakuta mountain to Gfdhrakuta, from there to Tupa and from there upto Uttaramanasa—This is men¬ tioned as Gayasiras. It is otherwise called Phalgutlrtha. The excellent Phalgutlrtha is beneath the mountain Mundaprstha. All the Pitrs shall attain salvation by means of the performance of Sraddha etc. Thus the procedure of the first day has been explained. The Second Day: O Narada, he who performs ablutions, Tarpana and Sraddha in the MatangavapI (the tank of Matanga) obtains Brahmaloka by going to Dharmaranya. After going to MatangavapI the pilgrim should bow down to Matangesa and repeat this Mantras: "May the deities be the authority and may the guardians of the quarters be the witnesses (to the fact that) I had come to this MatangavapI and the redemption of the Pitrs has been effected by me". The second day of Fanca TIrthI Yatra is the 4th day from entrance at Gaya. NP.II.45.103-104, A 34-37 mention these very Tirthas on the 'second day*. "Obeisance to you the king of ASvatthas (holy fig trees), of the form of Brahma, Visnu and Siva, the tree of enlightenment (. Bodhidruma] ) J for the performers (of Sraddha etc.) and the redeemer of the Pitrs. Repeated obeisance to the Asvattha (the holy fig tree), the tree with tremulous leaves, the cause of permanent stabilisa¬ tion. Obeisance toYajna, the Bodhisattva. O Pippala, you are the eleventh among Rudras. You are the fire among Vasus; you are Narayana among Devas. You are the king of trees. O Asvattha, king of trees since Narayana stays in you perpetually, you are the most auspicious of all trees; you are blessed for ever; you are the destroyer of evil dreams. I bow down to Hari who has assumed the form of a tree, who is in the form of the Asvattha tree, who is the lord Pundarlkaksa (Visnu) wielding Sankha, Cakra and Gada. As a result of seeing and touching you, may our kins¬ men, of our family or our mother's family who have been in distress, attain perpetual stay in heaven.
verses.hindi: दानव थे जो हिरण्यपुर निवासी थे । पुरतोमा, और कालका से उत्पन्न होनेवाले वे पौलोम और कालकेय नामक दानवगण महाबलवान थे, देवता भी उनका बध नहीं कर सकते थे, उन सब का संहार सव्यसाची अर्जुन ने किया  मय के जो पुत्र हुये वे सब के सब बड़े वीर और पराक्रमी थे, उनके नाम मायावी, दुन्दूभि, वृष, महिष, वालिक और व्ज्यकर्ण थे, मय की कन्या मन्दोदरी थी । हैत्यों और दानवों की सृष्टि की यह कथा आप लोगों को बतला चुका ।२६-२९। दनायुषा के पाँच महाबलवान्, पुत्र कहे जाते थे, जिनके नाम अरुण, बलि, जन्म, विरक्ष और विष थे । अरुण का पुत्र धुन्धु नामक महान् असुर था, जो क्रूर प्रकृति का था, उसका सहार उतदू के कहने पर कुबलाइव ने किया था। बलि के दो अनृपम टेजस्वी एबं पराक्रमी पुत्र हुये

verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe jitakrodhaścacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ / duścaraṃ maunamāsthāya hyaśakyaṃ devadānavaiḥ
verses.translation: O king of trees! After coming to Gaya, the three debts have been repaid by me. Thanks to your grace, I have been relieved from the great sin. I have been released from the ocean of worldly existence." On the third day 1 2 the pilgrim—the son should duly take bath in Brahmasaras and perform Sraddha with the offering of Pindas repeating the Mantra thereof. The Bodhidruma where the Buddha evolved Pralityasamutpada, be¬ The 3rd day of Pancatirthi is the 5th day from entering Gaya. Some of the rites mentioned here are found in A 35-40 and NP* II* 4 "I am performing.the ablution in this holy Tirtha for the relief from the three debts". (Sraddha performed) in the middle of Kupa (well) and Yupa (the sacrificial post) shall lead the Pitrs to Brahmaloka" This Yupa (sacrificial post) was raised by Brahma after performing the sacrifice. After performing this Sraddha in Brahmasaras, he redeems all the Phi's. After circumambulating the Yupa, one attains the fruit ofVajapeya sacrifice. After bowing down to Brahma, he will lead the Pitrs to Brahmaloka. "Obeisance be to Brahma, the unborn, the causal form of the birth etc. of this universe. Repeated bows to the re¬ deemer of the devotees and the Pitrs." The Mango trees growing near the place called Gopra - cara were planted by Brahma. Merely by watering them, one shall enable the Pitrs to attain salvation. Mantra: "For the cause of the salvation of the Pitrs, I am watering the mango tree that has come up from the Brahma¬ saras and which is of the forms of Brahma and Visnu". " (Like a Sage) I with the tips of my hands am touching the water pot and the Kusa grass. I am offering water at the root of the Mango tree. The Mango tree is watered and the Pitrs are propitiated. One action alone has become famous as serving two purposes." Then, with a controlled mind, the pilgrim should offer the oblation 1 to Yama with the Mantra: "Yamaraja and Dharmaraja have been engaged in the work of stabilising (demon Gaya). I am offering oblation to both of them for the cause of the liberation of the Pitrs" "There are two dogs born of the family of Vaivasvata (Yama). They are dark and variegated in colour. I am offering oblation to them. May they protect me for ever, on the path". V. 45 is the Mantra for Yamabaii, v. 46 for £va-bali (Bali to Dogs) and v. 47 is for Kakabali (Bali to Grows). The pilgrim is to take a bath (in Brahmasaras thereof)— TSS 362-363. Then the pilgrim should perform Sraddha at the foot (of Visnu) in Gayasiras along with the offering of Pindas. The real Gayasiras is within the limit of Phalgutlrtha. Naga, Janardana, Brahmayupa and Uttaramanasa— these delimit the holy spot called Gayasiras. It is also called Phalgutlrtha. That area of Phalgutlrtha extending from the seat of Pitamaha upto Uttaramanasa should be known as difficult of access, rare even to Devas.

verses.commentary: Sense: O king of trees! After coming to Gaya, the three debts have been repaid by me. Thanks to your grace, I have been relieved from the great sin.…

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा दत्त्वा द्विजातिभ्यो दानानि विविधानि च । तत्क्षणात् सुपापस् तु गतस्तद्वैष्णवं पदम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā dattvā dvijātibhyo dānāni vividhāni ca / tatkṣaṇāt supāpas tu gatastadvaiṣṇavaṃ padam
verses.translation: The real Gayasiras extends from Krauncapada up to Phalgutlrtha. Since this is the face of Gayasura, the Sraddha performed here is of everlasting benefit. The region below the mountain Mundaprstha too con¬ stitutes Phalgutlrtha. It is here that the primordial Gadadhara is stationed in both manifest and unmanifest forms. The foot-prints of Visnu and others are there conducive to the liberation of the Pitrs. This Visnupada (the foot-print of Visnu) is divine and destructive of sins at its very sight. By touching and worshipping it sins are dispelled. Whatever is given unto the Pitfs becomes Ak$aya (of inexhaus¬ tible benefit). By performing the Sraddha along with the Pina offerings one leads a thousand members of one's family to the divine foot of Visnu which is auspicious and infinite. By perfor¬ ming Srdddha at the foot of Rudra, a man takes a hundred The 4th day of Pancatirthi is the 6th day from entry into Gaya. TSS. 366 tells us that there is no separate Sraddha on Gayasiras apart from the Sraddhas at Vi§nupada and other Padas. Gayasiras is the holiest spot at Gaya. It* extends from Krauncapada to Phalgu Tirtha (v. 53). One who performs Sraddha at the foot (print) of Garhapatya attains the fruit of Vajapeya. After performing Sraddha at Ahavanlya, one attains the benefit of a horse- sacrifice. By performing Sraddha at the foot of (fire called) Sabhya one attains the benefit of Jyotistonia. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Avasathya leads Pitrs to Brahmapura. Performing Sraddha at Sakra's foot leads Pitrs to Indraloka. One who performs Sraddha at Agastya's foot leads Pitrs to Brahmapura, He who performs Sraddha at Krauncapada and Matangapada leads Pitrs to Brahmaloka. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of the Sun-god leads even the perpetrators of five great sins to the city of Arka. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Kartikeya leads the Pitrs to Sivaloka. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Ganesa leads the Pitrs to Rudraloka. One who performs Tarpana rites in the holy spot Gajakarna leads his Pitrs to the resplendent heaven. One who performs Sraddha at the feet of other deities leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura. At the beginning and at the conclusion one of them is remembered. O Narada, it is conducive to the welfare of the performer of the Sraddha. In order to emphasize that Piij<Jas are to be offered at the foot¬ prints and not in the hands of the dead ancestor even if he come in person. Two hands, one white and the other black, came out jutting out of the foot (of Kasyapa). On seeing the two (projec¬ ted) hands, the sage was overwhelmed with doubts. Then the great sage asked his mother Santa: "O mother, is the Pinda to be offered to the white hand or to the black hand, at the divine foot-print of Kasyapa? you know father (hence) say." Then Bharadvaja attempted to give the Pinda to the black one. Then the white one, remaining invisible said, "You are my legitimate bosom son."
verses.hindi: विरक्षस्यापि पुत्रो द्वो कालकश्न वरश्व तो । विषस्य त्वभवन्पुत्राभ्नत्वारः क्रकणिकः ३ भ्राद्धह्ा यश्चहा चब ब्रह्महा पशुहा तथा

verses.sanskrit: एवं युक्तस्तु यस्तत्र पापं कृत्वा सुदारुणम् । स्नात्वा जप्त्वा विधानेन मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः

verses.translation: The black one said, "The field is mine (i.e. the wife). Hence give the Pinda to me." Then the Svairini (wanton woman) said that the Pindas are to be given both to Ksetrin (the husband) and the Bijin (the procreator). Bharadvaja thereupon placed the Pinda at the foot of Kasyapa. Both of them went to Brahmaloka by means of an aerial chariot to which a swan was yoked. Rama attempted to offer the Pindas at the sacrifice at the foot of Rudra. His father Dasaratha came there from heaven stretching his hand. Rama did not offer the Pinda unto the hand. Then he placed the Pinda at the foot of Rudra. Dasaratha spoke to Rama who was afraid of transgressing the injunctions of the sacred texts: "O Son, I have been redeemed by you. I shall attain Rudraloka. If the Pinda had been given (deposited) unto the hand, I would not have attained heaven. You will rule over the kingdom for a long time and protect Brahmanas and other subjects. After performing Yajfias with due Daksina, you will go to Visnuloka along with all the citizens of Ayodhya and (including) even germs and insects." Bhisma invoked his Pitr (father) at the excellent Visnupada and performed the Sraddha. When he attempted to offer the Pinzas to the Pitrs, both the hands of his father Santanu came out of GayaSiras. Bh!§ma did not offer the Pindas into the hands. He placed them at the foot-print of Visnu. The delighted Santanu said: "You are definite about the meaning of the sacred text. May you have the vision extend¬ ing to the three times (past, present and future). In the end, may Visnu be your goal. Since the Gada of Hari was washed in that great Tirtha, it was called Gadalola. "I am taking my bath for the realisation of Siddhis. I shall attain the imperishable Pada (station)." On the fifth day 2 the pilgrim shall take his bath in the The 5th day of Pancatirthi is the 7th day from entering Gaya. On this day one should perform Bath and Sraddha at Ak$ayavata, honour The devotee shall propitiate the Brahmanas who had been originally assigned the duties at Gaya by god Brahma. He should propitiate them by means of Havyas, Kavyas etc. If they are satisfied, all the deities along with the Pitrs are propitiated If the Sraddha at Aksayavata is performed with great care and effort, with cooked rice alone, the pilgrim will lead the Pitrs to the indestructible and eternal Brahmaloka. If a single Brahmana is fed near that Vatavrksa (banyan tree) with vegetables or even with water, it is as fruitful as feeding a crore (of Brahmanas). Sixteen types of gifts should be made to the priest at Gayatlrtha after honouring him and offering him clothes, scents etc. in the company of one's sons. Whatever is given at the Vata tree at Gayatlrtha to the Pity's will be Aksaya (indestructible). By seeing, bowing to and worshipping Vatesa with calm and composed mind, the pilgrim will lead his Pitrs to the indestructible and eternal Brahmaloka. Obeisance to the Aksayavata which is a weapon severing the tree of worldly existence, which removes all the sins and which gives the imperishable Brahman.
