verses.hindi: इनके अतिरिक्त सात अन्य कस्याएँ भी थीं, उन्हें ऋ्रमानुसार सुनिये । साथ ही उन कन्याओं द्वारा जिन प्रजाओं की सृष्िट हुईं, और उनसे जिन गणों की उत्पत्ति हुई, उसे भी सुनिये । उन कन्याओं के नाम आलम्बा, उत्कचा, कृष्णा, निऋ ता, कपिला. शिवा और मह।भाग्यशालिनी केशिती थे, ये सात उक्त राक्षसों की बहिनें कही जाती हैं ।! ६१-१७०। उन्हीं कन्याओं द्वारा लोक में मांस खानेवाले जीवहिसक, बुद्ध में उत्कट पराक्रम दिखलानेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: All of them directed their minds towards lord Bhava (Siva) as the greatest god. They had no wives or sons. All of them were celibate with sublimated sexuality. These Bhutas, the great Almayogins, numbered a hund¬ red thousand.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them directed their minds towards lord Bhava (Siva) as the greatest god. They had no wives or sons. All of them were celibate with sublimated sexuality. These Bhutas, the great Almayogins, numbered a hund¬ red thousand.…

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः । महापातकयुक्तो ऽपि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: indratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / mahāpātakayukto 'pi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Kapisa, Kusmandl bore to Kusmanda twins of Pis¬ acas who were tawny-coloured. Because they were brownish, they were called Pisacas. 2 All of them were flesh-eaters.
verses.hindi: महान राक्षसगणों की उत्पत्ति हुई, इनमें से कुछ शुभ कार्य करनेवाले भी थे। आलम्बा से उत्पन्न होनेवाले आलम्बेय नामक राक्षसगण क्र प्रकृति के थे, उत्कचेय गण भी उसी प्रकार कै ऋरकर्मा थे। काष्णेय और शनेय नामक राक्षसगण उत्तम गुण वाले थे। इसी प्रकार महादेव जी के अनुचर गणेइवरों के चर ने नेऋ त नामक प्रजाओं की सृष्टि की । उस बलवान् ने महान् यक्षों एवं राक्षसों को उत्पन्न किया, जो परम पराक्रमी शौर्य॑सम्पन्न नैऋत नाम से विख्यात हुये, उन्हें देवराक्षस कहते हैं। उन सबों का अधिप्ति विरूपक नामक हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Kapisa, Kusmandl bore to Kusmanda twins of Pis¬ acas who were tawny-coloured. Because they were brownish, they were called Pisacas. 2 All of them were flesh-eaters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kapisa, Kusmandl bore to Kusmanda twins of Pis¬ acas who were tawny-coloured. Because they were brownish, they were called Pisacas. 2 All of them were flesh-eaters.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम् । सो ऽश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य पुष्कलं फलम् अश्नुते
verses.transliteration: indratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / so 'śvamedhasya yajñasya puṣkalaṃ phalam aśnute
verses.translation: There are sixteen other twins. Their descendants are living now. I shall mention by names the man-eaters belonging to their family. They are Chagala and Chagall, Vakra and Vakra- mukhi, Sue! and Suclmukha, Kumbhapatra and Kumbhl,
verses.hindi: नैऋत नामक उद्धत स्वभाववाले उन महात्मा देवराक्षसों के सैकड़ों गण प्रायः जगत स्वामी शंकर भगवान् के अनुचर हुये । महात्मा हैत्यराज कुम्भ ने महाबलवानू, महा पराक्रमी, परम साहसी एवं विशालकाय कापिलेय
verses.wordMeaning: There are sixteen other twins. Their descendants are living now. I shall mention by names the man-eaters belonging to their family. They are Chagala and Chagall, Vakra and Vakra- mukhi, Sue! and Suclmukha, Kumbhapatra and Kumbhl,
verses.commentary: Sense: There are sixteen other twins. Their descendants are living now. I shall mention by names the man-eaters belonging to their family. They are Chagala and Chagall, Vakra and Vakra- mukhi, Sue! and Suclmukha, Kumbhapatra and Kumbhl,

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । श्रुतमात्रेण येनैव मुच्यन्ते पातकैर् नराः
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam / śrutamātreṇa yenaiva mucyante pātakair narāḥ
verses.translation: Bd. 3.7.367 reads sumanaska 'of very good minds*.
verses.hindi: इृदमधे नास्ति ख. ग. घ. ड. पुस्तकेष । कापिलेया महावीर्या उदीर्णा देत्यराक्षसा:  कम्पनेन च यक्षेण केशिन्यास्ते परे जना:
verses.wordMeaning: Bd. 3.7.367 reads sumanaska 'of very good minds*.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bd. 3.7.367 reads sumanaska 'of very good minds*.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे इन्द्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टादशोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय ११९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र कह्लोडीतीर्थम् उत्तमम् । रेवायाश्चोत्तरे कूले सर्वपापविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe indratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 119 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra kahloḍītīrtham uttamam / revāyāścottare kūle sarvapāpavināśanam
verses.translation: The Purana distinguishes between Bhutas and Pisacas. Bhutas are noble-souled sons of Bhuti, celibate yogins and devotees of God Siva. Pisacas arc the progeny of Kusmandl. The superstitions about Pisacas current at the time of this text are recorded in vv. 251-282.
verses.hindi: उत्पादिता बलवता उदोर्णा यक्षराक्षसा: । केशिनीदुृहितुश्चेब नीलाया: क्षुद्रमानसाः
verses.wordMeaning: The Purana distinguishes between Bhutas and Pisacas. Bhutas are noble-souled sons of Bhuti, celibate yogins and devotees of God Siva. Pisacas arc the progeny of Kusmandl. The superstitions about Pisacas current at the time of this text are recorded in vv. 251-282.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Purana distinguishes between Bhutas and Pisacas. Bhutas are noble-souled sons of Bhuti, celibate yogins and devotees of God Siva. Pisacas arc the progeny of Kusmandl. The superstitions about Pisacas current at the time of this text are recorded in vv. 251-282.

verses.sanskrit: हितार्थं सर्वभूतानाम् ऋषिभिः स्थापितं पुरा । तपसा तु समुद्धृत्य नर्मदायां महाम्भसि
verses.transliteration: hitārthaṃ sarvabhūtānām ṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitaṃ purā / tapasā tu samuddhṛtya narmadāyāṃ mahāmbhasi
verses.translation: These are the sixteen families born of Kusman- das: Ajamukhas, Vakramukhas, Purins, Skandins, Vipa- das, Angarikas, Kumbhapatras, Prakundakas, Upacarolukha- likas, Anarkas, Kukhandikas, Panipatras, Naitundas, Ornasas, Nipunas, and Sucimukhocchesanadas.
verses.hindi: आलम्बेयेन जनिता नेका: सुरसिकेन हि। नेला इति समाख्याता दुर्जया घोरविक़माः चरन्ति पृथिवों कछ्त्स्नां तत्न ते देवलोकिकाः । बहुत्वाच्चेब सर्गस्य तेषां वक्‍तुं न शकक्‍्यते १८० तस्यास्त्वपि च नीलाया विकचा नाम राक्षसी । दुहिता स्वभावबिकचा मन्दसत्त्वपराक़मा
verses.wordMeaning: These are the sixteen families born of Kusman- das: Ajamukhas, Vakramukhas, Purins, Skandins, Vipa- das, Angarikas, Kumbhapatras, Prakundakas, Upacarolukha- likas, Anarkas, Kukhandikas, Panipatras, Naitundas, Ornasas, Nipunas, and Sucimukhocchesanadas.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the sixteen families born of Kusman- das: Ajamukhas, Vakramukhas, Purins, Skandins, Vipa- das, Angarikas, Kumbhapatras, Prakundakas, Upacarolukha- likas, Anarkas, Kukhandikas, Panipatras, Naitundas, Ornasas, Nipunas, and Sucimukhocchesanadas.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तु कपिलातीर्थे कपिलां यः प्रयच्छति । श्रुत्वा चाख्यानकं दिव्यं ब्राह्मणाञ्छृणु यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā tu kapilātīrthe kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / śrutvā cākhyānakaṃ divyaṃ brāhmaṇāñchṛṇu yatphalam
verses.translation: Those who are born as Sukalpas 1 (?) should be known as Pisacas. There are infinite number of sons and grandsons of hideous nature and ignoble activities. Hence, understand the characteristics of Pisacas.
verses.hindi: दंष्ट्राक्षरा लविकृता महाकर्णा महोदरा: । हारका भीषकाश्चव तथेव क्वामकाः परे १८३ वेनकाश्न पिशाचाश्व वाहुकाः प्राशकाः परे । भुमिराक्षसका होते मन्दाः पुरुषविक्रमा: १८४ चरन्त्यदृष्टपरर्वाश्व नानाकारा ह्मनेकशः । उत्कृष्टबलसत्त्वा ये ते च वे खेचराः स्मृताः १८५ लक्षमात्रेण चा55काशं स्वल्पाः स्वल्पं चरन्ति बे । एतेव्यप्तिमिमं लोक शतशो5थ सहस्नरशः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are born as Sukalpas 1 (?) should be known as Pisacas. There are infinite number of sons and grandsons of hideous nature and ignoble activities. Hence, understand the characteristics of Pisacas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are born as Sukalpas 1 (?) should be known as Pisacas. There are infinite number of sons and grandsons of hideous nature and ignoble activities. Hence, understand the characteristics of Pisacas.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव दानानां कपिलादानमुत्तमम् । ब्राह्मणान्वेषितं पूर्वमृषिदेवसमागमे
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ kapilādānamuttamam / brāhmaṇānveṣitaṃ pūrvamṛṣidevasamāgame
verses.translation: Pisacas have hair on all their limbs. Their eyes are round. They have claws and fangs. Their limbs are crooked. They are man-eaters and their faces are turned down.
verses.hindi: भूमिराक्षसकः सर्वेरनेकः क्षुद्रराक्षसः। नानाप्रकारेराक्तानता नानादेशा: समन्‍्ततः १८७ नामक हैत्यों एवं राक्षसों को उत्पन्न किया, जो अपने पराक्रम से सचमुच महान् थे। बलवान कम्पन मामक यक्ष के द्वारा केशिनी के गर्भ से दूसरे महाबलवान यक्षों और राक्षसों की उत्पत्ति हुईं, जो महान् थे । केशिनी की कन्या नीला के संयोग से आलम्बेय गण के सुरसिक नामक राक्षस के द्वारा अनेक क्षुद्र चित्तवाले राक्षसों का जन्म हुआ, जो नेल नाम से विख्यात हुये  ये नेल नामक राक्षसगण दुर्जेय और घोर पराक्रमी थे ।१७५०१७६। देविक
verses.wordMeaning: Pisacas have hair on all their limbs. Their eyes are round. They have claws and fangs. Their limbs are crooked. They are man-eaters and their faces are turned down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pisacas have hair on all their limbs. Their eyes are round. They have claws and fangs. Their limbs are crooked. They are man-eaters and their faces are turned down.

verses.sanskrit: सद्यः प्रसूतां कपिलां शोभनां यः प्रयच्छति । सोपवासो जितक्रोधस्तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: sadyaḥ prasūtāṃ kapilāṃ śobhanāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / sopavāso jitakrodhastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Kusmandikas are devoid of hair on their heads or bodies. Skins and hides constitute their garments. They always eat gingelly seeds and flesh.
verses.hindi: एवं लौकिक--दोनों प्रकार को शक्तियों से सम्पन्न वे राक्षसगण सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वौ-मण्डल का भ्रमण करते थे । उनके वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाली प्रज्ञाओं का बत्रिस्तार बहुत अधिक है, अतः कहा नहीं जा सकता ।ह८५०। उस नीला की भी एक पुत्री थी, जिसका नाम विकचा राक्षसी था, स्वभाव से वह परम ऋर और मध्यम पराक्रमवाली थी । उस विकचा के भी कुरूप निऋ त द्वारा अतिघोर स्वभाववाले सुरों (असुरों) की उत्पत्ति हुई, उनका क्रमानुसार
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Kusmandikas are devoid of hair on their heads or bodies. Skins and hides constitute their garments. They always eat gingelly seeds and flesh.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Kusmandikas are devoid of hair on their heads or bodies. Skins and hides constitute their garments. They always eat gingelly seeds and flesh.

verses.sanskrit: ससमुद्रगुहा तेन सशैलवनकानना । दत्ता चैव महाबाहो पृथिवी नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā / dattā caiva mahābāho pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Some Pis'acas have curved limbs, and feet. They walk in a zigzag manner. They should be known as Vakrapisacas. They are of crooked gait. They can assume any form as they please.
verses.hindi: वर्णन सुनिये । वे घोर असुरगण विकराल दाढ़ोंवाले, कुरूप, लम्बे कानोंवाले, तथा विशाल पेटवाले थे, उनके इन राक्षसों का पराक्रम पुरुषों के समान था। ये विविध प्रकार के स्वरूप घारण कर इतने विकराल दिखलाई पड़ते हैं जितने भीषण स्वरूप को कोई नहीं देख सका था । इन भूमि राक्षसों में जो अधिक बलवामू. एवं पराक्रमी होते हैं वे भाकाशगामी कहे जाते हैं ।१५१-१८५। ये क्षुद्र राक्षषगण देखने में अति लघुकाय होने पर भी थोड़ी दूर तक आकाश प्रदेश में विचरण करते हैं। ये सेकड़ों, सहस्नों की संख्या में इस लोक को डेंके हुये है ।
verses.wordMeaning: Some Pis'acas have curved limbs, and feet. They walk in a zigzag manner. They should be known as Vakrapisacas. They are of crooked gait. They can assume any form as they please.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some Pis'acas have curved limbs, and feet. They walk in a zigzag manner. They should be known as Vakrapisacas. They are of crooked gait. They can assume any form as they please.

verses.sanskrit: वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मणा यत्पुरा कृतम् । नश्यते कपिलां दत्त्वा सप्तजन्मार्जितं नृप
verses.transliteration: vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yatpurā kṛtam / naśyate kapilāṃ dattvā saptajanmārjitaṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: Some Pisacas have protruding bellies. Their noses are like snouts. Their bodies are short. Their heads and arms are small. These are called Nitunflakas. Gingelly seeds form
verses.hindi: इन सब विविध प्रकार के भूमिराक्षसों ओर अन्याय क्षुद्र राक्षसों से मिलकर चारों ओर से प्रायः सभी देशों
verses.wordMeaning: Some Pisacas have protruding bellies. Their noses are like snouts. Their bodies are short. Their heads and arms are small. These are called Nitunflakas. Gingelly seeds form
verses.commentary: Sense: Some Pisacas have protruding bellies. Their noses are like snouts. Their bodies are short. Their heads and arms are small. These are called Nitunflakas. Gingelly seeds form

verses.sanskrit: भूमिदानं धनं धान्यं हस्त्यश्वकनकादिकम् । कपिलादानस्यैकस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmidānaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hastyaśvakanakādikam / kapilādānasyaikasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: Some Pisacas have dwarfish forms 3. They are garrulous. They go about galloping. They are Anarkamarka
verses.hindi: भद्रका निकराः केचिद्यज्ननिष्पत्तिहेतुका: (? ) । सहखशतसंख्याता मत्यंलोकविचाचरिणः पुृतना मातृसामान्यास्तथा भुतभयंकरा: । बालानां सानुषे लोके ग्रहा वमानहेतुकाः १६० स्कन्दग्रहादयश्चेव आपकास्त्रासकादय: । कौमारास्ते तु विज्ञेया बालानां ग्रहवत्तय: १६१ स्‍्कन्दग्रहविशेषाणां मायिकानां तथव च्। पृतनानामभुतानां ये च लोकविनायका:
verses.wordMeaning: Some Pisacas have dwarfish forms 3. They are garrulous. They go about galloping. They are Anarkamarka
verses.commentary: Sense: Some Pisacas have dwarfish forms 3. They are garrulous. They go about galloping. They are Anarkamarka

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा कपिलां यः प्रयच्छति । मृतो विष्णुपुरं याति गीयमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ yāti gīyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Some Pisacas keep their hands lifted up (always).
verses.hindi: सहत्रशतसंख्यानां मत्यलोकविचारिणाम् । एवं गणशतान्येव चरन्ति प्रथिवीमिमाम् ॥१€९३ यक्षाः पुण्यजना नाम तथा गे के5पि गुह्मकाः । यक्षा देवजनाश्चेब तथा पुण्यजनाश्र ये १३१६४ गुह्मकानां च् सर्वेषासगस्त्या ये चर राक्षसा: । पौलस्त्या राक्षसा ये च विश्चामित्राश्व ये स्मृता:
verses.wordMeaning: Some Pisacas keep their hands lifted up (always).
verses.commentary: Sense: Some Pisacas keep their hands lifted up (always).

verses.sanskrit: यावन्ति तस्या रोमाणि सवत्सायास्तु भारत । तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स स्वर्गे क्रीडते चिरम्
verses.transliteration: yāvanti tasyā romāṇi savatsāyāstu bhārata / tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sa svarge krīḍate ciram
verses.translation: Bd.P. V. 390 reads Vanardhtayah -having the form of monkeys'.
verses.hindi: यक्षाणां राक्षसानां च पौलस्त्यागस्तयश्नव ये । तेषां राजा महाराजः कुबेरो ह्मलकाधिप:.. स्बलक्षणसंपन्नाः समक्षेत्राश्व॒ देवते: । भात्वरा बलवस्तश्व ईश्वराः कामरूपिण:
verses.wordMeaning: Bd.P. V. 390 reads Vanardhtayah -having the form of monkeys'.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bd.P. V. 390 reads Vanardhtayah -having the form of monkeys'.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽवकीर्णकालेन त्विह मानुष्यतां गतः । धनधान्यसमोपेतो जायते विपुले कुले
verses.transliteration: tato 'vakīrṇakālena tviha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ / dhanadhānyasamopeto jāyate vipule kule
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Upaviras are very considerate about their veins*. Their bodies are dry. They have plenty of moustache. They wear bark garments. Cremation ground is their abode.
verses.hindi: को आक़ान्त कर लिया है। संक्षेप में इन सब क्षुद्रराक्षसों की आठ माताएँ हैं, और उसी के अनुरूप इनके आठ विभाग कहे जाते हैं, जिन्हें ऋरमानुतार कहा गया है।१८६-१८५। इनमें से एक का नाम भद्रका और गण का नाम निकर है, जिनमें कुछ ज्ञानोत्पत्ति के कारण हैं (?) मत्यंतोक में विचरण करनेवाले इस गण में सकड़ों, सहसख्रों की संख्या में राक्षमगण विद्यमान हैं । दूसरी माता पूतना है, और गण का नाम मातृ सामान्य है,
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Upaviras are very considerate about their veins*. Their bodies are dry. They have plenty of moustache. They wear bark garments. Cremation ground is their abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Upaviras are very considerate about their veins*. Their bodies are dry. They have plenty of moustache. They wear bark garments. Cremation ground is their abode.

verses.sanskrit: वेदविद्या व्रतस्नातः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः । व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम्
verses.transliteration: vedavidyā vratasnātaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ / vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam
verses.translation: The Udukhala (Ulukhala) types of Pisacas have stable motionless eyes and long tongues with which they lick their lips. Their heads are as large as those of elephants and camels. They move about severally or jointly. Those Pisacas are called Kumbhapatras, who take cooked food without seeing it (invisibly?). They are small and yellow-complcxioned with hairy bodies. They move about visibly and invisibly.
verses.hindi: जो भयंकर भूत हैं। यह पूतना मानवलोक में बच्चों को पकड़नेवाली एवं कष्ट देकर बहुत परेशान करनेवाली है । स्कन्धग्रह आदि आपक, त्रासक आदि और कौमारंगण इन सब को. बालकों को ग्रहों के समान कष्ट देने वाले जानने चाहिए । माया करने वाले मायिक नामक ग्रहों स्कनद नामक ग्रहों, तथा पूतना नामक अभूत (१) ग्रह विशेष में से जो लोक में विविध विघ्नों के करने वाले हैं, वे लाखों की संख्या में मत्यंलोक में विचरण करते हैं। इसी प्रकार अन्याय भूतों एवं ग्रहों के संकड़ों गण इस प्रृथ्वी पर विचरण किया करते हैं ।१८५९-१६३। पुण्यजन नामक यक्ष, गुह्मक नाम से प्रसिद्ध यक्ष एवं देवजत नामक यक्ष--ये सभी गुह्मकों के अन्तगंत हैं। अगस्त्य नामक जो राक्षसगण हैं, पौलस्त्य नामक जो राक्षस गण हैं विश्वामित्र के गोत्र में जो राक्षसगण उत्पन्न हुए हैं, यक्षों एवं राक्षव्रों के वश में
verses.wordMeaning: The Udukhala (Ulukhala) types of Pisacas have stable motionless eyes and long tongues with which they lick their lips. Their heads are as large as those of elephants and camels. They move about severally or jointly. Those Pisacas are called Kumbhapatras,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Udukhala (Ulukhala) types of Pisacas have stable motionless eyes and long tongues with which they lick their lips. Their heads are as large as those of elephants and camels. They move about severally or jointly. Those Pisacas are called Kumbhapatras,…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं कल्होडीतीर्थम् उत्तमम् । यत्कृत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kalhoḍītīrtham uttamam / yatkṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Nipunas enter and infest those persons who go alone. Their mouths extend upto their ears. The eye-brows are long and the noses are thick.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न होनेवाले पौलस्त्य एवं अगस्त्य नामक जो यक्ष राक्षस हैं, उन सबों के राजा महाराज कृबेर हैं, जो अल्का नामक नगरी के अघीदवर हैं ये यक्ष गण केवल आँखों से देखकर मनुष्य के रक्त मांस एवं चर्बी को पी जते हैं, राक्षत गण शरीर के भीतर प्रवेश कर के पी जाते हैं और पिशाच गण बुरी तरह पीड़ित कर के पी जाते हैं। जो सभी प्रकार के लक्षणों से सम्पन्न एवं देवताओं के समान अधिकारी, तेजस्वी, बलवान, ऐश्वयं मय
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Nipunas enter and infest those persons who go alone. Their mouths extend upto their ears. The eye-brows are long and the noses are thick.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Nipunas enter and infest those persons who go alone. Their mouths extend upto their ears. The eye-brows are long and the noses are thick.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कह्लोडीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनविंशत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि कम्बुकेश्वरमुत्तमम् । हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यो दानवो बलदर्पितः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kahloḍītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 120 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kambukeśvaramuttamam / hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo dānavo baladarpitaḥ
verses.translation: (A line is missing from the text.) The Pisacas called Baladas (devourers of children) are short-statured and they attack people with their hands and feet. Their eyes are turned towards the earth. They resort to lying-in-chambers.
verses.hindi: अनाभिभाष्या विक्वान्ताः स्वलोकनमस्कृता: । सुक्ष्मास्त्थौजस्विनों सेध्या बरदा यज्ञियाश्व ये देवानां तुल्यधर्माणां झसुराः स्वंशः स्मृता: । त्रिभिः पादस्तु गन्धर्वा देवेहोना: प्रभावतः
verses.wordMeaning: (A line is missing from the text.) The Pisacas called Baladas (devourers of children) are short-statured and they attack people with their hands and feet. Their eyes are turned towards the earth. They resort to lying-in-chambers.
verses.commentary: Sense: (A line is missing from the text.) The Pisacas called Baladas (devourers of children) are short-statured and they attack people with their hands and feet. Their eyes are turned towards the earth. They resort to lying-in-chambers.

verses.sanskrit: अवध्यः सर्वलोकानां त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः । तस्य पुत्रो महातेजाः प्रह्लादो नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: avadhyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ / tasya putro mahātejāḥ prahlādo nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: Those Pisacas called Pisitadas (flesh eaters) drink blood from the battlefield. Their hands and feet are turned back¬ wards. They are short and are as swift as wind.
verses.hindi: गन्धर्वेम्यस्त्रिभि: पादेहीना बे सर्वशुह्यकाः । प्रभावतुल्या यक्षाणां विज्ञेयाः सर्वराक्षसा: ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Those Pisacas called Pisitadas (flesh eaters) drink blood from the battlefield. Their hands and feet are turned back¬ wards. They are short and are as swift as wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Pisacas called Pisitadas (flesh eaters) drink blood from the battlefield. Their hands and feet are turned back¬ wards. They are short and are as swift as wind.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुप्रसादाद्भक्त्या च तस्य राज्ये प्रतिष्ठितः । विरोचनस्तस्य सुतस् तस्यापि बलिरेव च
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuprasādādbhaktyā ca tasya rājye pratiṣṭhitaḥ / virocanastasya sutas tasyāpi balireva ca
verses.translation: The Pisacas called Skandins are naked and have no fixed abodes. They are globular in shape with long hair. There are other types of Pisacas eating leavings of food. Thus the sixteen types of Pisacas have been narrated.
verses.hindi: ऐश्वर्यहीना यक्षेम्यः पिशाचास्त्रिगुणं पुनः एवं धनेन रूपेण ओयुषा च बलेन व । धर्मेश्वयेंण बुद्धया च तपःश्रुतपराक्मै:
verses.wordMeaning: The Pisacas called Skandins are naked and have no fixed abodes. They are globular in shape with long hair. There are other types of Pisacas eating leavings of food. Thus the sixteen types of Pisacas have been narrated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pisacas called Skandins are naked and have no fixed abodes. They are globular in shape with long hair. There are other types of Pisacas eating leavings of food. Thus the sixteen types of Pisacas have been narrated.

verses.sanskrit: बलिपुत्रो ऽभवद् बाणस्तस्मादपि च शम्बरः । शम्बरस्यान्वये जातः कम्बुर्नाम महासुरः
verses.transliteration: baliputro 'bhavad bāṇastasmādapi ca śambaraḥ / śambarasyānvaye jātaḥ kamburnāma mahāsuraḥ
verses.translation: On seeing these types of Pisacas deficient in intellect and in a dejected condition among his progeny, Brahma sym¬ pathetically granted them the boons of vanishing and assuming forms as they pleased.
verses.hindi: देवासुरेभ्यो हीयन्ते त्रीन्पादान्वे परस्परभ् । गन्धर्वाद्या: पिशाचान्ताभ्वतस्रों देवयोनय:
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing these types of Pisacas deficient in intellect and in a dejected condition among his progeny, Brahma sym¬ pathetically granted them the boons of vanishing and assuming forms as they pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing these types of Pisacas deficient in intellect and in a dejected condition among his progeny, Brahma sym¬ pathetically granted them the boons of vanishing and assuming forms as they pleased.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा विष्णुमयं घोरं महद्भयमुपस्थितम् । दानवानां विनाशाय नान्यो हेतुः कदाचन
verses.transliteration: jñātvā viṣṇumayaṃ ghoraṃ mahadbhayamupasthitam / dānavānāṃ vināśāya nānyo hetuḥ kadācana
verses.translation: He permitted them to move about at the time of the two junctions (viz. dawn and dusk). (I shall mention) their abodes and way of maintaining themselves. Houses in
verses.hindi: अतः शूणुत भद्दे वः प्रजा: क्रोधवशात्मका: । ऋधायां कन्यका जज्ञे द्वादश ह्यात्मसंभवाः ॥। एवं इच्छानुस्तार स्वरूप घारण करनेवाले अनृपम शक्तिशाली, विक्रमी, सभी लोकों द्वारा पूजनीय, सूक्ष्म स्वरूप धारण करनेवाले, तेजस्वी, यक्षादि के योग्य, बरदान देनेवाले, यक्ष परायण एवं देवताओं के समान धर्मात्मा होते हैं, वे सब असुर नाम से स्मरण किये जाते हैं ।(६४-१६९९१। गन्धर्ब लोग प्रभाव में देवताओं की अपेक्षा तीन पादों से (तीब चौथाई ३) हीन होते हैं। सभी गुह्य (यक्ष) गन्धवों की अपेक्षा प्रभाव आदि में
verses.wordMeaning: He permitted them to move about at the time of the two junctions (viz. dawn and dusk). (I shall mention) their abodes and way of maintaining themselves. Houses in
verses.commentary: Sense: He permitted them to move about at the time of the two junctions (viz. dawn and dusk). (I shall mention) their abodes and way of maintaining themselves. Houses in

verses.sanskrit: स त्यक्त्वा पुत्रदारांश्च सुहृद्बन्धुपरिग्रहान् । चचार मौनमास्थाय तपः कम्बुर्महामतिः
verses.transliteration: sa tyaktvā putradārāṃśca suhṛdbandhuparigrahān / cacāra maunamāsthāya tapaḥ kamburmahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: Unrighteous persons, those who violate the dis¬ cipline of castes and stages of life and artisans and masons constitute the livelihood of these Pisacas as ordained by Suras. These Pisacas will be the presiding deities where holy rites are performed by means of money earned by unjustifiable means such as breach of trust and theft of nectar-like articles.
verses.hindi: तीन पदों से हीन होते हैं, इन्हीं यक्षों, के समान प्रभावशाली सब राक्षस होते हैं। इन यक्षों से गुण में तीन गुसे हीत पिशाच होते है । इस प्रकार धन से, रूप से, भायु से, बल से, धर्म, ऐश्वयं से बुद्धि से, तपस्या से शस्त्र बल से एवं पराक्रम से गन्धवे, यक्ष, राक्षक और पिशाच--ये चार देवयोनियों में उत्पन्न वाले देवताओं और असुरों की भपेक्षा परस्पर हीन होते हैं ९० ०-२०३॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Unrighteous persons, those who violate the dis¬ cipline of castes and stages of life and artisans and masons constitute the livelihood of these Pisacas as ordained by Suras.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Unrighteous persons, those who violate the dis¬ cipline of castes and stages of life and artisans and masons constitute the livelihood of these Pisacas as ordained by Suras.…

verses.sanskrit: अक्षसूत्रकरो भूत्वा दण्डी मुण्डी च मेखली । शाकयावकभक्षश्च वल्कलाजिनसंवृतः
verses.transliteration: akṣasūtrakaro bhūtvā daṇḍī muṇḍī ca mekhalī / śākayāvakabhakṣaśca valkalājinasaṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The oblations to Pisacas consist of honey (wine), flesh, cooked rice mixed with curds, powdered gingelly seeds, toddies and similar (intoxicating) beverages, incense, turmeric, Krsaras (i.e. balls of gingelly seeds in treacle), oil, rice mixed with jaggery, black cloths and flowers. At the junctions of Parvans, these things must be offered to Pisacas. Brahma, the lord, ordained thus.
verses.hindi: सूत ने कद्ाः---ऋषिवुन्द ! अब इसके उपरास्व आप लोग क्रोध के वश में रहनेवाली प्रजाओं का विधरण सुनिये, इससे आप लोगों का कल्याण होगा । क्रोधा में बारह स्वयम् उत्पन्न होनेवाल्ी कन्याएँ उत्पन्न हुई और वे सब पुलह ऋषि की पत्नियाँ हुईं, उनके नाम सुनिये ।२०४-३०४॥ मृदी, मृग मन्दा, हरिभद्रा, इरावती, भूता, कपिश्ञा, दंष्ट्रतन, निशा, तिर्या, इवेता, स्वरा, और सुरसा--नाम से विख्यात हैं । तिनमें से मृगी के पुत्र हरिण हुए, अन्यान्य मृग, शझ (स्वरगोश) ल्यंकु (बारहसिंगा) शरभ, रुद और पृषत् बामक
verses.wordMeaning: The oblations to Pisacas consist of honey (wine), flesh, cooked rice mixed with curds, powdered gingelly seeds, toddies and similar (intoxicating) beverages, incense, turmeric, Krsaras (i.e. balls of gingelly seeds in treacle), oil, rice mixed with jaggery,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The oblations to Pisacas consist of honey (wine), flesh, cooked rice mixed with curds, powdered gingelly seeds, toddies and similar (intoxicating) beverages, incense, turmeric, Krsaras (i.e. balls of gingelly seeds in treacle), oil, rice mixed with jaggery,…

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा नित्यं धृतिपरो नर्मदाजलमाश्रितः । पूजयंस्तु महादेवमर्बुदं वर्षसंख्यया
verses.transliteration: snātvā nityaṃ dhṛtiparo narmadājalamāśritaḥ / pūjayaṃstu mahādevamarbudaṃ varṣasaṃkhyayā
verses.translation: He made the trident-bearing Girisa the lord of all Bhutas and Pisacas.
verses.hindi: धृगराजा सृगमन्दाया गवयाभ्रायरे तथा। महिषोष्ट्रवराहाश्व खड्गगोरमुख्तस्तथा ११२०७
verses.wordMeaning: He made the trident-bearing Girisa the lord of all Bhutas and Pisacas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made the trident-bearing Girisa the lord of all Bhutas and Pisacas.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तुतोष भगवान्देवदेवो महेश्वरः । उवाच दानवं काले मेघगम्भीरया गिरा
verses.transliteration: tatastutoṣa bhagavāndevadevo maheśvaraḥ / uvāca dānavaṃ kāle meghagambhīrayā girā
verses.translation: Panthers, pythons and beasts of prey are also her sons.
verses.hindi: इरावत्याः सुतो यस्मात्तस्मादेरावतः स्मृतः  देवराजोपवाह्मत्वात्प्रथमः स सतड्भराद ॥ तस्य पुत्रो5जनश्चेव सुप्रतोको5थ वामन: । पद्मश्चेव चतुर्थोभुद्धस्तिनी चाश्रमुस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Panthers, pythons and beasts of prey are also her sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Panthers, pythons and beasts of prey are also her sons.

verses.sanskrit: भोभोः कम्बो महाभाग तुष्टो ऽहं तव सुव्रत । इष्टं व्रतानां परमं मौनं सर्वार्थसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: bhobhoḥ kambo mahābhāga tuṣṭo 'haṃ tava suvrata / iṣṭaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ maunaṃ sarvārthasādhanam
verses.translation: Mina, Mata, Vrtta, Pari vrtta and Anuvrtta are to be known (as her daughters). Listen to (the enumeration of) her children:
verses.hindi: दिग्गजास्तांश्व चत्वा(तु)र: श्वेताएउजनयता55शुगान् । भद्व मृगं च सन्‍्दं च संकी्ण चतुरः सुतान् २१४
verses.wordMeaning: Mina, Mata, Vrtta, Pari vrtta and Anuvrtta are to be known (as her daughters). Listen to (the enumeration of) her children:
verses.commentary: Sense: Mina, Mata, Vrtta, Pari vrtta and Anuvrtta are to be known (as her daughters). Listen to (the enumeration of) her children:

verses.sanskrit: चरितं च त्वया लोके देवदानवदुश्चरम् । वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यत्ते मनसि रोचते
verses.transliteration: caritaṃ ca tvayā loke devadānavaduścaram / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi rocate
verses.translation: Sharks and crocodiles with a thousand teeth, the types of fish known as Pathina, Timi and Rohita and other groups are called Maina (born of Mina) groups. They are extensive.
verses.hindi: णपययथ?िखिान्न करोंंततकंोररर-... ्॒7़़््ऱ पशु उसी से उत्पन्न हुए । मृगमन्दा के गे से मृगराजों (सिंहों) की उत्पत्ति हुई, अस्यास्य गवय (नौलग्राय) महिष, ऊंट, वराह, खड़्ग (मेंडा) तथा गौरमुख नामक वन्य पशु भी उसी से उत्पन्न हुए ।१९०६-२०७। हरि के गर्भ से बन्दरों की उत्पत्ति हुई तथा लज्भ ली बन्दर तरक्ष (भेड़िया) अन्यान्य छोटी जातियों के बन्दर, किन्नर, बाघ, किपुरुष आदि वन्यजीवों की भी उत्पत्ति उसी से हुई, इसके बाद इरावती के पुत्रों को सुनिये । २०८ एक
verses.wordMeaning: Sharks and crocodiles with a thousand teeth, the types of fish known as Pathina, Timi and Rohita and other groups are called Maina (born of Mina) groups. They are extensive.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sharks and crocodiles with a thousand teeth, the types of fish known as Pathina, Timi and Rohita and other groups are called Maina (born of Mina) groups. They are extensive.

verses.sanskrit: कम्बुरुवाच: यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम । अक्षय्यश्चाव्ययश्चैव स्वेच्छया विचराम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: kamburuvāca: yadi prasanno deveśa yadi deyo varo mama / akṣayyaścāvyayaścaiva svecchayā vicarāmyaham
verses.translation: The four types of Grdhas (crocodiles) —Anujyestha- kas, Niskas, Sisumaras etc. were born of Mata.
verses.hindi: बार भोवन ने सूर्य के दो अण्ड कपालों को लाकर अपने दोनों हाथों से उसे पकड़ कर रथन्तर का गान क्रिया था, उस समय सामवेद के श्थन्तर की स्तुति करते समय श्षीत्र ही एक हस्ती प्रार्दुभूत हुआ । भोवन ने वंसे पुत्र को कामना से इरावती के साथ समागम किया था, यत: वह इराबती के गर्भ से उत्पन्न हुआ था अत्त: ऐरावत नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुआ। देबराज इन्द्र के वाहन होने के कारण बह मतज्ों का प्रथम
verses.wordMeaning: The four types of Grdhas (crocodiles) —Anujyestha- kas, Niskas, Sisumaras etc. were born of Mata.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four types of Grdhas (crocodiles) —Anujyestha- kas, Niskas, Sisumaras etc. were born of Mata.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यदानवसङ्घानां संयुगेष्वपलायिता । भयं चान्यन्न विद्येत मुक्त्वा देवं गदाधरम्
verses.transliteration: daityadānavasaṅghānāṃ saṃyugeṣvapalāyitā / bhayaṃ cānyanna vidyeta muktvā devaṃ gadādharam
verses.translation: Vrtta gave birth to different types of tortoises and other aquatic animals as well as varieties of conches.
verses.hindi: राजा हुआ, वह ऐरावत श्वेत बादल के समान शुञ्र वर्ण का, चार दाँतों बाला, अतिशय शोभा सम्पन्न गजराज है ।२०६-२११। एक ही मूल से उत्पन्न हुये, बल सम्भूत, छः दाँतों वाले सुवर्ण के समान कान्तिमान्, भद्र नामक हस्ती पर सवार होने बाला बल था, जो हस्तिण (? ) था । उस ऐरावत के अज्जन, सुप्रतीक, वामन ओर पद्म ये चार पुत्र थे, हस्तिमी का नाम अ्श्नमुथा। श्वेता ने उन चार दिग्गजों को उत्पन्न किया, जो अति श्षीक्र गमन करने वाब्रे थे, उन चारों पुत्रों के नाम भद्र, सृग, मन्‍्द और संकीर्ण थे। इनमें से
verses.wordMeaning: Vrtta gave birth to different types of tortoises and other aquatic animals as well as varieties of conches.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vrtta gave birth to different types of tortoises and other aquatic animals as well as varieties of conches.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याहं संयुगे साध्यो येनोपायेन शङ्कर । भवामि न सदा कालं तं वदस्व वरं मम
verses.transliteration: tasyāhaṃ saṃyuge sādhyo yenopāyena śaṅkara / bhavāmi na sadā kālaṃ taṃ vadasva varaṃ mama
verses.translation: Anuvrtta gave birth to different types of toads and
verses.hindi: इंदमर्घ नास्ति घ. पुस्तके । एतदधेस्थाव इृदमर्ध॑ पव॑माना तयोश्चापि प्रथिता: इति ख. घ. डे. पुस्तकेषु ।
verses.wordMeaning: Anuvrtta gave birth to different types of toads and
verses.commentary: Sense: Anuvrtta gave birth to different types of toads and

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: मम संनिहितो यत्र त्वं भविष्यसि दानव । तत्र विष्णुभयं नास्ति वसात्र विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: mama saṃnihito yatra tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi dānava / tatra viṣṇubhayaṃ nāsti vasātra vigatajvaraḥ
verses.translation: Parivrtta gave birth to different varieties of oyster- shells, cowrie-shells and conchs.
verses.hindi: संकोर्णोधप्यञ्जनो यस्तु उपवाह्यो यमस्य तु । भद्दो यः सुप्रतोकस्तु हरितः स ह्मपांपते: शूलाः स्थूला: शिरोदास्ताः शुद्धघधालनखास्तथा । बलिन: शक्तिनश्चैव मृतास्त्वाकुलिका गजाः
verses.wordMeaning: Parivrtta gave birth to different varieties of oyster- shells, cowrie-shells and conchs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Parivrtta gave birth to different varieties of oyster- shells, cowrie-shells and conchs.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवाधिदेवस्य वेदगर्भस्य संयुगे । शङ्खचक्रधरस्येशा नाहं सर्वे सुरासुराः
verses.transliteration: tasya devādhidevasya vedagarbhasya saṃyuge / śaṅkhacakradharasyeśā nāhaṃ sarve surāsurāḥ
verses.translation: She produced the varieties of Kalakuta poison and leeches as well. Thus the race of Rsa consisting of five branches has been enumerated.
verses.hindi: वामदेवोजनश्यासः साम्नो जज्ञेप्य वामन:। भार्या चेवाद्भदा तस्य नीलदल्लक्षणों सुता
verses.wordMeaning: She produced the varieties of Kalakuta poison and leeches as well. Thus the race of Rsa consisting of five branches has been enumerated.
verses.commentary: Sense: She produced the varieties of Kalakuta poison and leeches as well. Thus the race of Rsa consisting of five branches has been enumerated.

verses.sanskrit: किं पुनर्यो द्विषत्येनं लोकालोकप्रभुं हरिम् । स सुखी वर्तते कालं न निमेषं मतं मम
verses.transliteration: kiṃ punaryo dviṣatyenaṃ lokālokaprabhuṃ harim / sa sukhī vartate kālaṃ na nimeṣaṃ mataṃ mama
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, these insects are born of the bodies of Svastipika 2 (?). The producers are human beings. The insects known as Usanas are born of dirt and sweat of men. So also the other insects and groups of ants moving about in rows.
verses.hindi: चण्डाश्चारुशिरोग्रोवा व्यूढो रस्कास्तरस्विन: । नरेबंद्धा: कुले तेषा जायन्ते विकृता गजा: संकीर्ण और अज्जन--ये यमराज के वाहन हैं, भद्र और सुप्रतीक, जो कि हरित वर्ण का है, जल के स्वामी वरुण के वाहन हैं ।२१२-११५। पद्म और मनन्‍्द जो कि गौर (इवेत) वर्ण का है, ऐलविल (कुबेर! के हस्ती हैं । प्ृग नामक इयाम वर्ण का जो हस्ती है वह अग्नियों का वाहन है। पद्मोत्तर पद्म नामक जो गज है वह वरुण के वाहन गणों में से है, और वह उपलेपन (7) भी कहा जाता है! उसके आठ पूत्र उत्पन्न हुए ।
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, these insects are born of the bodies of Svastipika 2 (?). The producers are human beings. The insects known as Usanas are born of dirt and sweat of men. So also the other insects and groups of ants moving about in rows.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, these insects are born of the bodies of Svastipika 2 (?). The producers are human beings. The insects known as Usanas are born of dirt and sweat of men. So also the other insects and groups of ants moving about in rows.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्वं परया भक्त्या सर्वभूतहिते रतः । वसिष्यसि चिरं कालम् इत्युक्त्वादर्शनं गतः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tvaṃ parayā bhaktyā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ / vasiṣyasi ciraṃ kālam ityuktvādarśanaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: There are varieties of insects born of conchs, pebbles which work like nails. 3 These and many others are the earthly groups of sweat-born creatures.
verses.hindi: जो सब उम्र स्वभाव वाले थे । उनके बंध में श्वेत बाल और नखवाले, पीले बर्ण के शरीरवाले मतंगज उत्पन्न हुए । उन सबों को तथा अन्यान्य नागों को भी क्रमशः सुना रहा हुं ११६-२१८। पुण्डरीक, नामक गज कपिल (भूरे) वर्ण का तथा रथान्तर पुष्प के रंग के समान शझ्योभावाला गज है. उन दोनों से सुश्रतिष्ठ और प्रमदंन नामक पुत्र उत्पन्त हुये । इनके अतिरिक्त शूल, स्थल प्रभूति उच्च श्षलिर वाले, शुद्ध बाल और नखवाने,
verses.wordMeaning: There are varieties of insects born of conchs, pebbles which work like nails. 3 These and many others are the earthly groups of sweat-born creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are varieties of insects born of conchs, pebbles which work like nails. 3 These and many others are the earthly groups of sweat-born creatures.

verses.sanskrit: गते चादर्शनं देवे तत्र तीर्थे महामतिः । स्थापयामास देवेशं शिवं शान्तमनामयम्
verses.transliteration: gate cādarśanaṃ deve tatra tīrthe mahāmatiḥ / sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ śivaṃ śāntamanāmayam
verses.translation: Similarly, these creatures are born out of water heated by the sun as well as of the rain water. Many of these insects are born of the bodies of other animals.
verses.hindi: बलवान, शक्तिशाली गज हुए, जो अकुलिक नाम से स्मरण किये गये  इनके वंश में पुष्पदन्त, बृहत्सामा, डुदन्त, दन्तपुष्पवान्, ताम्रपर्णी प्रभूति गज उत्पन्न हये। इनके हस्तिनियों के सहममन से पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए इनके वंश में लंबे ओठोंवाले सुर्दर दिखाई पड़नेवाले श्यामवर्ण के उम्रस्वभाव वाले / लेंबे मुँहवाले और अनेक ग्रकार की पीड़ा सहन करने में सश्चक्त गज उत्पन्न होते हैं। वामदेव नामक हस्ती अंजन के समान ए्यामल वर्ण का है, साम से बामन नामक गज उत्पन्न हुआ जिसकी स्त्री अंगदा थी, उसके नीलवत् और लक्षण नामक दो पुत्र थे ।२१९५२:३। ये सब गज अत्यन्त उग्र स्वभाव वाले थे इनके शिरोभाग और कन्धे देखने में सुन्दर थे, वक्षस्थल अत्यन्त विशाल और चलने में वे वेगशाली थे इन गजों के बंद में जो विकृत गज उत्पन्न होते हैं, वे मनुष्यों द्वारा बन्धन में डाले जाते हैं। सुप्रतीक के समान सुन्दर आकार बाला
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, these creatures are born out of water heated by the sun as well as of the rain water. Many of these insects are born of the bodies of other animals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, these creatures are born out of water heated by the sun as well as of the rain water. Many of these insects are born of the bodies of other animals.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महादेवं स्थापयित्वा दिवं गतः । तदाप्रभृति तत्पार्थ कम्बुतीर्थमिति श्रुतम् । विख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe mahādevaṃ sthāpayitvā divaṃ gataḥ / tadāprabhṛti tatpārtha kambutīrthamiti śrutam / vikhyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu mahāpātakanāśanam
verses.translation: The following tiny creatures are born both of water and of sweat: Small shrimps (minaka), ants, (mosquito¬ like) biting or stinging creatures (darhia), Tittira-pulrikas (tiny partridge-like creatures?). The Alakas (hair) are bluish or variegated in colour (nila-citrah) and very massive.
verses.hindi: एतान्देवासुरे युद्धे जयाथें जगहु: सुरा: । कृतार्थेश्व विसृष्टास्ते;पूर्वोक्ताः प्रययुदिश/....
verses.wordMeaning: The following tiny creatures are born both of water and of sweat: Small shrimps (minaka), ants, (mosquito¬ like) biting or stinging creatures (darhia), Tittira-pulrikas (tiny partridge-like creatures?).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following tiny creatures are born both of water and of sweat: Small shrimps (minaka), ants, (mosquito¬ like) biting or stinging creatures (darhia), Tittira-pulrikas (tiny partridge-like creatures?).…

verses.sanskrit: कम्बुतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा विधिनाभ्यर्च्य भास्करम् । ऋग्यजुःसाममन्त्रैश्च स्तूयमानो नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: kambutīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhinābhyarcya bhāskaram / ṛgyajuḥsāmamantraiśca stūyamāno nṛpottama
verses.translation: The line is corrupt. The corresponding line in Bd. P. V. 421 reads 2 lirydhetukam apydhur bahulam uamia-vistaraml 'They say that there is an extensive line of living beings procreated by Tirya'.
verses.hindi: एतेषामन्वये जायान्विनीतांस्त्रिदशा ददु: । अद्गाय लोसपादाय सुत्रकाराय वे द्विपान् गज दूसरा नहीं है, उसके प्रहारी संपाती और पृथुध्चित्ति नामक तीन पुत्र थे ।२२४-२२५। इनके वंश में
verses.wordMeaning: The line is corrupt. The corresponding line in Bd. P. V. 421 reads 2 lirydhetukam apydhur bahulam uamia-vistaraml 'They say that there is an extensive line of living beings procreated by Tirya'.
verses.commentary: Sense: The line is corrupt. The corresponding line in Bd. P. V. 421 reads 2 lirydhetukam apydhur bahulam uamia-vistaraml 'They say that there is an extensive line of living beings procreated by Tirya'.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुण्यं समुद्दिष्टं ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः । तत्सर्वं तु शृणुष्वाद्य ममैव गदतो नृप
verses.transliteration: tasya puṇyaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ / tatsarvaṃ tu śṛṇuṣvādya mamaiva gadato nṛpa
verses.translation: This obscure word is a misprint for ' Svtda-Klinna 'born of bodies mois- stened by sweat' (vid Bd. P. V. 422). Kilakdcarakdni 'which work lik nails' in the text is rather obscure. Bd. P. V. 423 b reads kilakavaranani 'Pebbles smaller than pins'.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न होते हैं। अच्जन से अठ्जना और साम से अड्जवती का जन्म हुआ । इन दोनों की साता भी आयुरज (?) की" पुत्री कही गई है। इनके वंश में उत्पन्न होने वाले मज अत्यन्त विभक्त शिर वाले, जल से पूर्ण बादल के समान काले वर्ण के, देखने में अति सुन्दर शरीर वाले, कमल के समान परिमण्डल वाले, मोटे ताजे, और पीले चौड़े मुख वाले, होते थे ।॥२६-२२५। चन्द्रमा ओर साम से पिगला कुमुदद्यति की
verses.wordMeaning: This obscure word is a misprint for ' Svtda-Klinna 'born of bodies mois- stened by sweat' (vid Bd. P. V. 422). Kilakdcarakdni 'which work lik nails' in the text is rather obscure. Bd. P. V. 423 b reads kilakavaranani 'Pebbles smaller than pins'.
verses.commentary: Sense: This obscure word is a misprint for ' Svtda-Klinna 'born of bodies mois- stened by sweat' (vid Bd. P. V. 422). Kilakdcarakdni 'which work lik nails' in the text is rather obscure. Bd. P. V. 423 b reads kilakavaranani 'Pebbles smaller than pins'.

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्यजुःसामगीतेषु साङ्गोपाङ्गेषु यत्फलम् । तत्फलं समवाप्नोति गायत्रीमात्रमन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: ṛgyajuḥsāmagīteṣu sāṅgopāṅgeṣu yatphalam / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti gāyatrīmātramantravit
verses.translation: Some creatures are born of ghee, black gram and green gram. Some are born of the fruits of Jamb u (Rose apple) Bilva, mango and arecanut.
verses.hindi: उत्पत्ति हुई । उस पिगला के महाए्य्य और उ्भिमाली नामक दो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुये । उसके कुल में उत्पन्न तागों को अत्यन्त उग्र स्वभाव वाले, बलशाली, लम्बे, पेट वाले विशाल दाँतों वाले तथा हस्ति युद्ध में रुचि रखने वाले समझिये  देवासुर संग्राम में देवताओं ने इन्हीं हस्तियों को विजय लाभार्थ अपने पास रखा और कार्य में सफलता प्राप्त फर लेने के उपराब्त उन्हे छोड़ दिया, जिससे उपर्युक्त सभी हस्ती विभिन्न दिशाओं को चले गये । इम्हीं के वंश में उत्पन्न, विनम्र स्वभाव वाले हस्तियों को देवताओं ने अंग, लोमपाद, सूत्रकार को दिया । दो रद (दाँत) होते के कारण इतका द्विरद नाम पड़ा, हस्त (शुण्ड) के कारण ह॒स्‍्ती और कय (दण्ड) के कारण करी कहते हैं। वरण (पूजन) होने के कारण इन्हें वारण, दो दाँतों के कारण दब्ती गर्जन (चिस्घाड़ने) के कारण गज कुझ्जों में विचरण करने के कारण कुज्जर, नगों) (पव॑तों और वृक्षों)
verses.wordMeaning: Some creatures are born of ghee, black gram and green gram. Some are born of the fruits of Jamb u (Rose apple) Bilva, mango and arecanut.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some creatures are born of ghee, black gram and green gram. Some are born of the fruits of Jamb u (Rose apple) Bilva, mango and arecanut.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः । पूजयेद् देवमीशानं सो ऽग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / pūjayed devamīśānaṃ so 'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Creatures are born of the dry hollows of trees and also of green gram, jack fruits and rice grains when kept (for a long time). Creatures are born of other things also when kept for a long time. Germs and worms are born of horses and other (animals) and even from poison etc.
verses.hindi: १. यहाँ पूंलिग 'सुतौ' पाठ है, जिसकी कोई संगति नहीं बंठती । २- हाथी पर्वतों की चट्टानों एवं वृक्षों की शास भों आदि के तोड़ने फोड़ने में प्रसिद्ध ही हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Creatures are born of the dry hollows of trees and also of green gram, jack fruits and rice grains when kept (for a long time). Creatures are born of other things also when kept for a long time. Germs and worms are born of horses and other (animals) and even from poison etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Creatures are born of the dry hollows of trees and also of green gram, jack fruits and rice grains when kept (for a long time). Creatures are born of other things also when kept for a long time. Germs and worms are born of horses and other (animals) and even from poison etc.

verses.sanskrit: अकामो वा सकामो वा तत्र तीर्थे कलेवरम् । यस्त्यजेन्नात्र सन्देहो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: akāmo vā sakāmo vā tatra tīrthe kalevaram / yastyajennātra sandeho rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: When cowdung is kept for a number of days, O Brahmanas, creatures are produced from them. White ants and other creatures are born of (putrefying) wood.
verses.hindi: श्र्द वायुपुराणम् द्विरदो द्विरदाभ्यां व हस्ताउस्सी करात्करी । वरणाद्वारणो दनन्‍्ती दन्ताभ्यां गर्जनाद्गजः .
verses.wordMeaning: When cowdung is kept for a number of days, O Brahmanas, creatures are produced from them. White ants and other creatures are born of (putrefying) wood.
verses.commentary: Sense: When cowdung is kept for a number of days, O Brahmanas, creatures are produced from them. White ants and other creatures are born of (putrefying) wood.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कम्बुकेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम विंशत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२१ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल चन्द्रहासमतः परम् । यत्र सिद्धिं परां प्राप्तः सोमराजः सुरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kambukeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 121 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla candrahāsamataḥ param / yatra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somarājaḥ surottamaḥ
verses.translation: Various kinds of blue flies are born of trees in due course. The creatures Putrikas (white ants?) are born of drying and withering things.
verses.hindi: देवदानवगन्धर्वा: पिशाचोरगराक्षसा: । कन्यासु जाता दिड्नागर्नानासत्त्वास्ततों गजाः
verses.wordMeaning: Various kinds of blue flies are born of trees in due course. The creatures Putrikas (white ants?) are born of drying and withering things.
verses.commentary: Sense: Various kinds of blue flies are born of trees in due course. The creatures Putrikas (white ants?) are born of drying and withering things.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं सिद्धिं परां प्राप्तः सोमनाथो जगत्पतिः । तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि कथयस्व ममानघ
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somanātho jagatpatiḥ / tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mamānagha
verses.translation: Everywhere serpents are born seasonally from Satikas (?). Scorpions and sweat-born creatures are produced from dry cow-dung.
verses.hindi: संभृतिश्च प्रभुतिश्व नामनिवंचनं तथा । एतदुगजातनां विज्ञेयं येषां राजा विभावसुः फोशिकाद्या: समुद्रत्त गड्गायास्तदवन्तरम् । अज्जनस्थेकमुलस्प प्राच्यान्नागवन तु तत्ु
verses.wordMeaning: Everywhere serpents are born seasonally from Satikas (?). Scorpions and sweat-born creatures are produced from dry cow-dung.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everywhere serpents are born seasonally from Satikas (?). Scorpions and sweat-born creatures are produced from dry cow-dung.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुरा शप्तो मुनीन्द्रेण दक्षेण किल भारत । असेवनाद्धि दाराणां क्षयरोगी भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā śapto munīndreṇa dakṣeṇa kila bhārata / asevanāddhi dārāṇāṃ kṣayarogī bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: Different types of leeches are born of eggs such as Caivtrikas and Gajas and many other subtle creatures too.
verses.hindi: उत्तरा तस्य विन्ध्यस्थ गदगाया दक्षिणं च यत् । गदगो:द्वदात्करूष भय: सुप्रतीकस्य तद्वनम् २३९ अपरेणोत्कलाच्चेव ह्ावेदिभ्यश्च पश्चमम् । एकभूतात्मजस्थैतद्वामनस्थ न स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Different types of leeches are born of eggs such as Caivtrikas and Gajas and many other subtle creatures too.
verses.commentary: Sense: Different types of leeches are born of eggs such as Caivtrikas and Gajas and many other subtle creatures too.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वाहितानां पत्नीनां ये न कुर्वन्ति सेवनम् । या निष्ठा जायते नृणां तां शृणुष्व नराधिप
verses.transliteration: udvāhitānāṃ patnīnāṃ ye na kurvanti sevanam / yā niṣṭhā jāyate nṛṇāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa
verses.translation: Different types of flies etc. are born of eggs. These are laid generally on the leavings of food, water and sloughs.
verses.hindi: से विरोध करने के कारण नाग, मतज़ से उत्पन्न होने के कारण मातंग, दोनों (मुख और शुण्ड) से पान करने के कारण द्विप तथा सामवेद के गान् से उत्पन्न होने के कारण थे सामज नाम से स्मरण क्रिये जाते हैं पह इनको निरुक्ति का क्रम है ।२२६-२३४। इन हस्तियों की जिद्ठा जो पीछे की ओर लौटी रहती है, और बोलने की शक्ति इनमें नहीं पायी जातो, वह अग्नि के शाथ के कारण है। और हस्तियों के जो बल की अनूतनता (स्फूति का अभाव) तथा इनके लिंग एवं अंडकोष का छिपा रहना--ये दोनों भी स्वयम्भू ब्रह्मा एवं सुरगणों के शाप के कारण हैं। देवता, दावन, गन्धव / पिशाच, सर्प एवं राक्षस--ये सब जिन कन्याओं में उत्पन्न हुये उन्हीं में दिग्गजों के संयोग से हृस्तियों की उत्पत्ति हुई जिससे वे विपुल पराक्रमी हुये । इन भजों की उत्पत्ति, प्रभाव, अनेक नाम पड़ने के कारण आदि की कथा यही जाननी चाहिए (जिसे ऊपर कह चुका) ।
verses.wordMeaning: Different types of flies etc. are born of eggs. These are laid generally on the leavings of food, water and sloughs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Different types of flies etc. are born of eggs. These are laid generally on the leavings of food, water and sloughs.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतावृतौ हि नारीणां सेवनाज्जायते सुतः । सुतात्स्वर्गश्च मोक्षश्च इत्येवं श्रुतिभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: ṛtāvṛtau hi nārīṇāṃ sevanājjāyate sutaḥ / sutātsvargaśca mokṣaśca ityevaṃ śrutibhāṣitam
verses.translation: Different types of mosquitoes and black bees are also born of eggs. The creatures known as nits {Putrikas and Putra- bhasakas) are produced from grass.
verses.hindi: इन सब का राजा विभावसु है । पूर्व दिशा में कौशकी से लेकर समुद्र पयन्त एवं उसके उपरान्त समुद्र तट से गंगा तक जो जंगल है; वह एक मात्र अठ्जन नामक हस्ती एवं उसके वह में उत्पन्न होनेवाले का है
verses.wordMeaning: Different types of mosquitoes and black bees are also born of eggs. The creatures known as nits {Putrikas and Putra- bhasakas) are produced from grass.
verses.commentary: Sense: Different types of mosquitoes and black bees are also born of eggs. The creatures known as nits {Putrikas and Putra- bhasakas) are produced from grass.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कालोचितधर्मेण वेष्टितो रौरवे पतेत् । तस्यास्तद्रुधिरं पापः पिबते कालमीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: tatkālocitadharmeṇa veṣṭito raurave patet / tasyāstadrudhiraṃ pāpaḥ pibate kālamīpsitam
verses.translation: The insects Manicchedas and Vyalas are said to be produced from foetus with no enveloping membrane ( potajas ). Varieties of Salaveri (?) are born of dry cow-dung.
verses.hindi: विन्ध्य गरिरि के उत्तर से लेकर गज्जा के दक्षिण ओर तक; तथा गज्भा के उद्गम स्थल से लेकर करुष देश तक सुप्रतीक नामक गज का जंगल है । उत्कल (उड़ीसा) प्रान्त के पश्चिमी छोर से लेकर वेदि ३- आनन्दाश्रम की प्रति में 'मत्वा यातीति मातज्भः जिसके अनुसार यह अर्थ होगा कि मान कर चलता है, इसलिये मातंग नाम हैं, पर अन्य प्रतियों के “मतंगादिति मातंगः” पाठ से ऊपर का अथे निकलता , जो अन्य कथाओं से मिलती जुलती है। और इस संम्बन्ध से मातंग नाम की निरुक्ति भी समीचीन एवं सर्वंसम्मत होती है। अतः 'मतंगादिति मातंगः” पाठ युक्तियुक्त प्रतीत हो रहा है । ह
verses.wordMeaning: The insects Manicchedas and Vyalas are said to be produced from foetus with no enveloping membrane ( potajas ). Varieties of Salaveri (?) are born of dry cow-dung.
verses.commentary: Sense: The insects Manicchedas and Vyalas are said to be produced from foetus with no enveloping membrane ( potajas ). Varieties of Salaveri (?) are born of dry cow-dung.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽवतीर्णः कालेन यां यां योनिं प्रयास्यति । तस्यां तस्यां स दुष्टात्मा दुर्भगो जायते सदा
verses.transliteration: tato 'vatīrṇaḥ kālena yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ prayāsyati / tasyāṃ tasyāṃ sa duṣṭātmā durbhago jāyate sadā
verses.translation: Thus innumerable groups of sweat-born creatures have been enumerated by me in brief. It is to be remembered that these are born as a result of their actions in a previous birth.
verses.hindi: भूतिविजले भुतांश्च रुद्रस्यानुच रान्प्रभो । स्थूलान्कृशांश्च दीर्घाश्च वामनानन्‍ह्ृुस्वकान्ससान्ू
verses.wordMeaning: Thus innumerable groups of sweat-born creatures have been enumerated by me in brief. It is to be remembered that these are born as a result of their actions in a previous birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus innumerable groups of sweat-born creatures have been enumerated by me in brief. It is to be remembered that these are born as a result of their actions in a previous birth.

verses.sanskrit: नारीणां तु सदा कामो ऽभ्यधिकाः परिवर्तते । विशेषेण ऋतौ काले पीड्यते कामसायकैः
verses.transliteration: nārīṇāṃ tu sadā kāmo 'bhyadhikāḥ parivartate / viśeṣeṇa ṛtau kāle pīḍyate kāmasāyakaiḥ
verses.translation: There are other beings of Nairfta nature (i.e. born of Nirpti). They are remembered as Upasargajas (born of paroxysm due to possession by devils). Some beings are born of womb {Tonijas) and some are Autpaltikas (born spontaneously). Generally all Devas are to be known as Autpaltikas. Some
verses.hindi: लम्बक्णास्प्रलम्बोष्ठात्लम्बजिह्वांस्तनो द रान् । एकरूपान्विरूपां श्र लम्बस्फिक्स्थुलपिण्डिकान् ॥ बच्चन न्‍वे शबलान्ध् स्रान्कदनराक्षसदारुणा न । मुझजकेशानहुषीकेशान्सपंयज्ञो पवीतिनः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: There are other beings of Nairfta nature (i.e. born of Nirpti). They are remembered as Upasargajas (born of paroxysm due to possession by devils). Some beings are born of womb {Tonijas) and some are Autpaltikas (born spontaneously).…
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other beings of Nairfta nature (i.e. born of Nirpti). They are remembered as Upasargajas (born of paroxysm due to possession by devils). Some beings are born of womb {Tonijas) and some are Autpaltikas (born spontaneously).…

verses.sanskrit: परिभूता हिता भर्त्रा ध्यायन्ते ऽन्यं पतिं स्त्रियः । ततः पुत्रः समुत्पन्नो ह्यटते कुलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: paribhūtā hitā bhartrā dhyāyante 'nyaṃ patiṃ striyaḥ / tataḥ putraḥ samutpanno hyaṭate kulamuttamam
verses.translation: The children of Sarama are the sons Tulalagha and
verses.hindi: सरोवरसमुद्रादिनदीपुलिनसेविनः । एककर्णान्महाकर्णाञ्शहक्कर्णानकर्णिकान् ।
verses.wordMeaning: The children of Sarama are the sons Tulalagha and
verses.commentary: Sense: The children of Sarama are the sons Tulalagha and

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गस्थास्तेन पितरः पूर्वजास्ते पितामहाः । पतन्ति जातमात्रेण कुलटस्तेन चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: svargasthāstena pitaraḥ pūrvajāste pitāmahāḥ / patanti jātamātreṇa kulaṭastena cocyate
verses.translation: TheKadrukas (?) are Sydma (dark-coloured), Sabala (ofvariegated colour), Arjuna (white), Harita (green-coloured), Krsna (black), Dhumraruna (smoke-coloured and pink-coloured— Aruna), Tulalagha (?).
verses.hindi: दंष्ट्रिणो नखिनश्चेव निर्दन्तांश्व दिजिल्लकान् । एकहस्तान्द्िहस्तांश्च त्रिहस्तांश्चाष्यहस्तकान् । (?) देश पय॑न्‍्त, जो पाँचवा जंगल है, वह एक मात्र (?) वामन नामक हस्ती के बंशजो का जंगल कहा जाता है। लोहित्य, (त्रह्मपुत्र) के दूसरे तट से पश्चिम, समुद्र तट के पंत के समीप तक यम का वन कहा गया है ।२३९-२४१। है प्रभो ! भूति ने रुद्र के अनुचर भूतों को उत्पन्न किया जिनमें से कुछ बहुत मोटे, कुछ बहुत पतले, कुछ विशालकाय, कुछ बौने, कुछ बहुत ही छोटे, कुछ समान आकार वाले थे, इसी प्रकार लम्बे कान
verses.wordMeaning: TheKadrukas (?) are Sydma (dark-coloured), Sabala (ofvariegated colour), Arjuna (white), Harita (green-coloured), Krsna (black), Dhumraruna (smoke-coloured and pink-coloured— Aruna), Tulalagha (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: TheKadrukas (?) are Sydma (dark-coloured), Sabala (ofvariegated colour), Arjuna (white), Harita (green-coloured), Krsna (black), Dhumraruna (smoke-coloured and pink-coloured— Aruna), Tulalagha (?).

verses.sanskrit: तेन कर्मविपाकेन क्षयरोग्यभवच्छशी । त्यक्त्वा लोकं सुरेन्द्राणां मर्त्यलोकमुपागतः
verses.transliteration: tena karmavipākena kṣayarogyabhavacchaśī / tyaktvā lokaṃ surendrāṇāṃ martyalokamupāgataḥ
verses.translation: Surasa gave birth to a hundred (serpents) with nectar in their heads (Siro'm T tam). The king ofSarpas (serpents) is Taksaka and that of the snakes is Vasuki. Thus this group
verses.hindi: वाले, लम्बे होठों वाले, लम्बी जीभवाले, लम्बे स्तन और लम्बे पेटवाले थे  कुछ एक ही तरह के रूपवाले थे तो कुछ एकदम कुरूप थे, कुछ के स्फिक् (नितंब चुतड़) बहुत लम्बे थे, कुछ के मोटे पिण्डाकार पेट निकले हुये थे। ये भूत गया सरोवर, समुद्र, नदी आदि जलाशयों के तट पर निवास करने बाले थे। इनमें से कुछ काले वर्ण के कुछ गोरे वर्ण के कुछ नीले वर्ण के, कुछ रवेत वर्ण के, कुछ लोहित और अरुण वर्ण के
verses.wordMeaning: Surasa gave birth to a hundred (serpents) with nectar in their heads (Siro'm T tam). The king ofSarpas (serpents) is Taksaka and that of the snakes is Vasuki. Thus this group
verses.commentary: Sense: Surasa gave birth to a hundred (serpents) with nectar in their heads (Siro'm T tam). The king ofSarpas (serpents) is Taksaka and that of the snakes is Vasuki. Thus this group

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तीर्थान्यनेकानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च । भ्रमन्वै नर्मदां प्राप्तः सर्वपापप्रणाशनीम्
verses.transliteration: tatastīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca / bhramanvai narmadāṃ prāptaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm
verses.translation: Now understand the bosom creation of Pulaha from Tamra. Many well-known daughters were born of Tamra.
verses.hindi: थे ।२४२-२४४। इसी प्रकार कुछ गहरे पीले वर्ण के; कुछ चितकबरे रंग के, कुछ धुएँ के वर्ण के, तथा कुछ हल्के पीले रंग के थे, ये सभी भूत गण दारुण दाक्षसों के समान उम्र स्वभाव वाले थे। इनमें से कोई मंजकेश;१ कोई हृषीकेश तथा कोई सप॑ का यज्ञोपवीत धारण करनेवाले थे । किसी की आँखें फूटी हुई थीं, क्रिसी की आँखें अतिशय कुरूप थीं, किसी की आँखें बहुत बेठी हुई थीं तथा किसी की एक आँख ही फूटी हुई थी । कोई अनेक शिरवाले थे, कोई शिरोविहीन थे, कोई एक शिरवाले थे, किसी के शिर था ही नहीं । कोई अतिशय उम्र स्वभाव वाले थे, कोई अत्यन्त विक्रट स्वभाववाले थे, कोई रोमावली विहोन थे, कोई बहुत रोमवाले थे, कोई अन्ध थे कोई लंबी-लंबी जटाओंवाले थे, कोई कुबड़े थे, कोई चिग्घाड़नेवाले तथा बौने थे। ये सब के सब सरोवर, समुद्र, नदी तट पर निवास करते थे ।२४५-२४७१। इनमें किसी-२ के एक कान था, कोई-२ बहुत बड़े कानवाले'
verses.wordMeaning: Now understand the bosom creation of Pulaha from Tamra. Many well-known daughters were born of Tamra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now understand the bosom creation of Pulaha from Tamra. Many well-known daughters were born of Tamra.

verses.sanskrit: उपवासं च दानानि व्रतानि नियमांस् तथा । चचार द्वादशाब्दानि ततो मुक्तः स किल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: upavāsaṃ ca dānāni vratāni niyamāṃs tathā / cacāra dvādaśābdāni tato muktaḥ sa kilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Sampati procreated one son and one daughter. Crows, vultures and ASvakarnins (a variety of vultures?) were the sons of Jatayu.
verses.hindi: थे, किसी-किसी के कान शांकु (खूँटे) के समान थे, कोई-कोई कान विहीन थे । किसी-किसी के दाँत बहुत बड़े थे, किसी-किसी के नख बढ़े हुये थे, किसी किसी के एक भी दाँत नहों थे, कोई-कोई दो जिह्दावाले थे ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sampati procreated one son and one daughter. Crows, vultures and ASvakarnins (a variety of vultures?) were the sons of Jatayu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sampati procreated one son and one daughter. Crows, vultures and ASvakarnins (a variety of vultures?) were the sons of Jatayu.

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयित्वा महादेवं सर्वपातकनाशनम् । जगाम प्रभया पूर्णः स च लोकमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: snāpayitvā mahādevaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam / jagāma prabhayā pūrṇaḥ sa ca lokamanuttamam
verses.translation: The wives of Garutman (Garuda) were Bhasi, Kraunci, Sukl, Dhrtarastri and Bhadra. Their sons are being enumerated.
verses.hindi: १. मूंज के समान केद्ववाले । एकपादान्द्रिपादांश्व त्रिपादाल्बहुपादकान । महायोगान्महासत्त्वान्सुतपक्वान्महाबलान् २५०
verses.wordMeaning: The wives of Garutman (Garuda) were Bhasi, Kraunci, Sukl, Dhrtarastri and Bhadra. Their sons are being enumerated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wives of Garutman (Garuda) were Bhasi, Kraunci, Sukl, Dhrtarastri and Bhadra. Their sons are being enumerated.

verses.sanskrit: येनैव स्थापितो देवः पूज्यते वर्षसंख्यया । तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रलोके स पूज्यते
verses.transliteration: yenaiva sthāpito devaḥ pūjyate varṣasaṃkhyayā / tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke sa pūjyate
verses.translation: Suki bore six well known sons to Garutman, viz. the sweet-faced Tris'ira, Bala, Pr?tha of great strength,* Trisahkhanetra, Susukha of good form and Surasa the power¬ ful. The sons and grandsons of these ruthless descendants of Garuda, the noble-souled serpent-eaters, numbering fourteen thousand. By procreation of sons and grandsons their family became extensive.
verses.hindi: सर्वत्रगानप्रतिधान्ब्रह्मजान्कामरूपिण: । धोरान्क्ूरांश्च मेध्यांश्च शिवान्पुण्यान्सबादिनः २५१ कुशहस्तान्महाजिद्वान्महाक्णन्महाननानु् । हस्तादांश्व सुखादांश्च शिरोदांश्च कपालिन:
verses.wordMeaning: Suki bore six well known sons to Garutman, viz. the sweet-faced Tris'ira, Bala, Pr?tha of great strength,* Trisahkhanetra, Susukha of good form and Surasa the power¬ ful. The sons and grandsons of these ruthless descendants of Garuda, the noble-souled serpent-eaters,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Suki bore six well known sons to Garutman, viz. the sweet-faced Tris'ira, Bala, Pr?tha of great strength,* Trisahkhanetra, Susukha of good form and Surasa the power¬ ful. The sons and grandsons of these ruthless descendants of Garuda, the noble-souled serpent-eaters,…

verses.sanskrit: तेन देवान्विधानोक्तान्स्थापयन्ति नरा भुवि । अक्षयं चाव्ययं यस्मात्कालं भुञ्जन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: tena devānvidhānoktānsthāpayanti narā bhuvi / akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ yasmātkālaṃ bhuñjanti mānavāḥ
verses.translation: I shall mention in due order the lands where they spread themselves—the whole of Salmall Dvipa, the mountain Devakuta, the leading mountains Maniman, Sahasra-sikhara, Parnamala, Sukesa, Satasniga, Kauraja, Pancasikhara and Hemakuta—all these mountains were occupied by the noble- souled descendants of Garuda. They were brightened with ruby stones and (while flying) they produced gusts of violent winds.
verses.hindi: अन्नादान्पिशितादांश्च बहुरूपान्सुरूपकान् । राधत्रिसंध्याचरान्धो रान्कांश्चित्सौम्यान्दिवाच रानु परत्वे व् भवं देव॑ सर्वे ते गतमानसाः। नेषां भार्यास्ति पुत्रो वा सर्वे ते ह्मध्वेरेतसः ७२५५
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention in due order the lands where they spread themselves—the whole of Salmall Dvipa, the mountain Devakuta, the leading mountains Maniman, Sahasra-sikhara, Parnamala, Sukesa, Satasniga, Kauraja,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention in due order the lands where they spread themselves—the whole of Salmall Dvipa, the mountain Devakuta, the leading mountains Maniman, Sahasra-sikhara, Parnamala, Sukesa, Satasniga, Kauraja,…

verses.sanskrit: सोमतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयेद्देवमीश्वरम् । स भ्राजते नरो लोके सोमवत् प्रियदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: somatīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamīśvaram / sa bhrājate naro loke somavat priyadarśanaḥ
verses.translation: Garutfa's children have been enumerated. Listen to the progeny of Ira. Ira gave birth to three daughters with eyes
verses.hindi: शत तानि सहरस्नाणि भृतानागात्मयोगिनाम् । एते सर्वे महात्मानों भृत्याः पुत्राः प्रकोतिता:ः
verses.wordMeaning: Garutfa's children have been enumerated. Listen to the progeny of Ira. Ira gave birth to three daughters with eyes
verses.commentary: Sense: Garutfa's children have been enumerated. Listen to the progeny of Ira. Ira gave birth to three daughters with eyes

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रहासे तु यो गत्वा ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः । स्नानं समाचरेद् भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: candrahāse tu yo gatvā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / snānaṃ samācared bhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: They were Lata, Valll and Vlrudha. They are the mothers of all types of plants, trees and creepers.
verses.hindi: किसी-किसी के एक हाथ थे तो कोई कोई दो हाथोंवाले थे, किसी-किसी के तीन ह्वाथ थे, और ऐसे भी थे, जिन्हें एक हाथ भी नहीं था । इसी प्रकार कोई-कोई एक पादवाले, कोई-कोई दो पादवाले, कोई-कोई तीन पादवाले तथा कोई-कोई इससे भी अधिक अनेक पादोंवाले थे। उनमें से कितने महान् पराक्रमी थे, कितने महान् घोगाम्यासी थे, कितने सुतपक्व (?) थे, कितने महाबलवान् थे। कितने ऐसे थे, जो सबंत्र जा सकते थे, कितने निष्कोधी थे, कितने इच्छानुसार विविध स्वरूप धारण करनेवाले थे ।२४८-२५० ?१ै। और ऐसे भी कितने थ जो परम घोर, तथा क्र स्वभाववाले थे, कितने परम पवित्र, कल्याणकारी, पुण्यकर्त्ता एवं प्रिय बोलनेवाले थे । कुछ हाथों में कुश लिये रहते थे, किसी की जिह्वाएँ बहुत बड़ी भीं, किसी के कान बहुत लम्बे थे, किसी के मुख बहुत भीषण थे । कोई हाथों से खानेवाले थे, कोई मुख से खानेवाले थे, कोई शिर से खानेवाले थे,
verses.wordMeaning: They were Lata, Valll and Vlrudha. They are the mothers of all types of plants, trees and creepers.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Lata, Valll and Vlrudha. They are the mothers of all types of plants, trees and creepers.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नानं च दानं च चन्द्रहासे शुभाशुभम् । कृतं नृपवरश्रेष्ठ सर्वं भवति चाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca candrahāse śubhāśubham / kṛtaṃ nṛpavaraśreṣṭha sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
verses.translation: Lata gave birth to Vanaspalis i.e. the non-flowering plants growing on the banks of rivers etc. She herself gave birth to Vfksas or trees with flowers and fruits.
verses.hindi: कोई- कोई मृण्डमाला पहिने हुये थे । कोई-कोई हाथों में धनुष घारण किये हुये थे, कोई-कोई मुद्गर धारण किये थे, कोई-कोई तलवार तथ्य शुल धारण किये थे, कितनों के नेत्र उद्दीप्त हो रहे थे, कितनों के मुख उद्दीप्त हो रहे थे, कितने विचित्र ढंग की मालाएँ घारण किये थे तो कितने विचित्र चन्दतादि का लेप किये थे । उनमें से कुछ अन्नाहार करनेवाले थे, कुछ मांसाहारी थे, कितने अनेक स्वरूप धारण करनेवाले थे;
verses.wordMeaning: Lata gave birth to Vanaspalis i.e. the non-flowering plants growing on the banks of rivers etc. She herself gave birth to Vfksas or trees with flowers and fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lata gave birth to Vanaspalis i.e. the non-flowering plants growing on the banks of rivers etc. She herself gave birth to Vfksas or trees with flowers and fruits.

verses.sanskrit: ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस् तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् । चन्द्रहासे तु ये स्नात्वा पश्यन्ति ग्रहणं नराः
verses.transliteration: te dhanyāste mahātmānas teṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / candrahāse tu ye snātvā paśyanti grahaṇaṃ narāḥ
verses.translation: Valli gave birth to hedges, grasses and bamboo etc. of the-same species. Vlrudha gave birth to Virudhas i.e. creepers spreading all round. The description of the race is concluded
verses.hindi: कितने अति सुन्दर स्वरूपवाले थे । उनमें से कितने रात्रि तथा संध्या में गसम करनेवाले थे कितने अति घोर दिखाई पडलेवाले थे, कितने अति सौम्य दिखाई पड़नेवाले थे । कितने केवल दिन को चलनेवाले थे, कितने रात्रि को चलनेवाले थे, कितने अति कठिनाई से देखे जानेवाले थे (अर्थात् इतने घोर स्वरूपवाले थे कि लोगों का उनकी ओर देखने का साहस ही नहीं होता था)। इस प्रकार उन निशिचरों को भूति ने उत्पन्न किया  वे सब भूति के पुत्रगण एकमात्र महादेव में चित्त लगानेवाले थे । इन सबों के न तो स्त्री थी न पुत्र थे, सब के
verses.wordMeaning: Valli gave birth to hedges, grasses and bamboo etc. of the-same species. Vlrudha gave birth to Virudhas i.e. creepers spreading all round. The description of the race is concluded
verses.commentary: Sense: Valli gave birth to hedges, grasses and bamboo etc. of the-same species. Vlrudha gave birth to Virudhas i.e. creepers spreading all round. The description of the race is concluded

verses.sanskrit: वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मजं यत्पुराकृतम् । स्नानमात्रेण राजेन्द्र तत्र तीर्थे प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurākṛtam / snānamātreṇa rājendra tatra tīrthe praṇaśyati
verses.translation: Thus the mobile and the immobile progeny of Kas- yapa have been enumerated. The whole Universe is filled with their sons and grandsons.
verses.hindi: सब ब्रह्मचारी थे । इन आत्मयोगी भूतों की संख्या एक लाख थी, भूति के इन सब महात्मा पुत्रों की चर्चा कर
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the mobile and the immobile progeny of Kas- yapa have been enumerated. The whole Universe is filled with their sons and grandsons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the mobile and the immobile progeny of Kas- yapa have been enumerated. The whole Universe is filled with their sons and grandsons.

verses.sanskrit: बहवस्तं न जानन्ति महामोहसमन्विताः । देहस्थमिव सर्वेषां परमानन्दरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: bahavastaṃ na jānanti mahāmohasamanvitāḥ / dehasthamiva sarveṣāṃ paramānandarūpiṇam
verses.translation: Thus a portion of the entire creation has been enumerat¬ ed. The Prajasarga of Marica (KaSyapa) has been succinctly narrated. O Brahmanas, it cannot be explained (in details) even in hundreds of years.
verses.hindi: १. संख्या पनद्रह ही होती है । अनफंश्व अनर्का च कखण्डश्र कुखण्डिका  पाणिपात्रा पाणिपात्री पांशुः पांशुमती तथा २६९१ नितुण्डश्य नितुण्डी च निपुणा निपुणस्तथा  छलादोच्छेषणा चव प्रस्करद: स्कन्दिका तथा ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus a portion of the entire creation has been enumerat¬ ed. The Prajasarga of Marica (KaSyapa) has been succinctly narrated. O Brahmanas, it cannot be explained (in details) even in hundreds of years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus a portion of the entire creation has been enumerat¬ ed. The Prajasarga of Marica (KaSyapa) has been succinctly narrated. O Brahmanas, it cannot be explained (in details) even in hundreds of years.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे सागरे गत्वा सोमतीर्थे तु यत्फलम् । तत्समग्रम् अवाप्नोति चन्द्रहासे न संशयः
verses.transliteration: paścime sāgare gatvā somatīrthe tu yatphalam / tatsamagram avāpnoti candrahāse na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Aditi was of righteous, pious temperament. Diti is -re¬ membered as strong-minded. Surabhi was inclined towards the performance of penance. Danu was of a deceitful nature. Kadru was of ruthless mind. KrauncI was disposed towards learning. Ira had the receptive capacity. Danayu was interested in taking food.
verses.hindi: अजामुखा बकमुखाः पुरिण: स्कन्दिनस्तथा । धिषादाड्भरअरिकाश्व॑व कुम्भपान्नाः प्रकुन्दका:
verses.wordMeaning: Aditi was of righteous, pious temperament. Diti is -re¬ membered as strong-minded. Surabhi was inclined towards the performance of penance. Danu was of a deceitful nature. Kadru was of ruthless mind. KrauncI was disposed towards learning. Ira had the receptive capacity.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Aditi was of righteous, pious temperament. Diti is -re¬ membered as strong-minded. Surabhi was inclined towards the performance of penance. Danu was of a deceitful nature. Kadru was of ruthless mind. KrauncI was disposed towards learning. Ira had the receptive capacity.…

verses.sanskrit: संक्रान्तौ च व्यतीपाते अयने विषुवे तथा । चन्द्रहासे नरः स्नात्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte ayane viṣuve tathā / candrahāse naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Vinata was capable of bearing burdens. Tamra was habituated to use nooses and strings. These are the natures and temperaments of the mothers of the worlds.
verses.hindi: उपचारोलखलिका ह्मनकश्नवि कुखण्डिका:  पाणिपात्राश्व नेतुण्डा ऊर्णाशा निपुणास्तथा. ॥ सूची मुखोच्छेषणादा: क्लान्येतानि षोडश । इत्येता ह्यभिजातास्तु कृष्माण्डानां प्रकीतिता:
verses.wordMeaning: Vinata was capable of bearing burdens. Tamra was habituated to use nooses and strings. These are the natures and temperaments of the mothers of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vinata was capable of bearing burdens. Tamra was habituated to use nooses and strings. These are the natures and temperaments of the mothers of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ते मूढास्ते दुराचारास्तेषां जन्म निरर्थकम् । चन्द्रहासं न जानन्ति ये रेवायां व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: te mūḍhāste durācārāsteṣāṃ janma nirarthakam / candrahāsaṃ na jānanti ye revāyāṃ vyavasthitam
verses.translation: The bosom-born progeny of Kasyapa were born with Since these were born of the daughters of Daksa who were human beings, hence human beings are the most excellent in all the Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: -«-४-------२.९०७० ( नल... अमममान»मऊ»मन+ नननम»मम-म-म-म «न 3 + “पनननाप मनन“ “7-7 “पर जट कल्पना केक
verses.wordMeaning: The bosom-born progeny of Kasyapa were born with Since these were born of the daughters of Daksa who were human beings, hence human beings are the most excellent in all the Manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bosom-born progeny of Kasyapa were born with Since these were born of the daughters of Daksa who were human beings, hence human beings are the most excellent in all the Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रहासे तु यः कश्चित्संन्यासं कुरुते द्विजः । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य सोमलोकान्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: candrahāse tu yaḥ kaścitsaṃnyāsaṃ kurute dvijaḥ / anivartikā gatistasya somalokānna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Human beings are the aspirants of Dharma (Virtue) Artha(Wealth), Kama (Love) and Moksa (Salvation). There- fore, Suras and Asuras are born as Adhah-srotas (downward flow).
verses.hindi: चुका । २५१-२५६। कपिशा कुष्माण्डी ने कुष्माण्ड के संयोग से पिशाच दम्पतियों को जन्म दिया जो सब कपिश (भूरे या मटमैले) रंग के थे । कपिश वर्ण होने के कारण वे पिशाच्र कहलाये । ये सब मांसाह.री थे । अन्य सोलह पिशाच दम्पति हैं, जिनके वंशज वतंमान हैं। उनके वंशधरों का नाम बतला रहा हूँ, वे सब मनुष्य का भक्षण करभैवाले थे । छगल और छगली, वक्त और वक्रमुखी, सूचीमुख और सूची, कुम्मपात्र और कुम्भी, वजद॑ष्ट्र और दृन्दभि, उपचार और अपचार उलखल और उलूखली, अनके ओर अनर्का, कुखण्ड और कुखण्डिका, पाणिपात्र और पाणिपाज्री, पांझु और पांशुमती, नितुण्ड और नितुण्डी, निपुण और निपुणा छलाद और उच्छेषणा तथा पुस्कन्द और स्कन्दिका-ये सोलह (?) पिशाच दम्पतियों के गण कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Human beings are the aspirants of Dharma (Virtue) Artha(Wealth), Kama (Love) and Moksa (Salvation). There- fore, Suras and Asuras are born as Adhah-srotas (downward flow).
verses.commentary: Sense: Human beings are the aspirants of Dharma (Virtue) Artha(Wealth), Kama (Love) and Moksa (Salvation). There- fore, Suras and Asuras are born as Adhah-srotas (downward flow).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सोमतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकविंशत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२२ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल कोहनस्वेति विश्रुतम् । सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं तीर्थं मृत्युविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 122 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla kohanasveti viśrutam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ mṛtyuvināśanam
verses.translation: They are born again and again among human beings for the purpose of achieving their object. Thus the origin of the race of ascetics has been recounted.
verses.hindi: हैं। कुष्माण्ड के कुल में उत्पन्न होने वाले इन कुलीनों का वर्णन किया गया। इन्हीं के कुन में उत्पन्न होनेवाले अन्याश्य पिल्चाचों को जानना चाहिए  इनके पूत्र पौन्नादि की संख्या अनन्त है. सब अति वीभत्स आकृतिवाले तथा निन्दय कर्म करनेवाले ये, अतः उन पिश्याचों के लक्षण बतला रहा हूँ, सुनिये !२६३-२६६।
verses.wordMeaning: They are born again and again among human beings for the purpose of achieving their object. Thus the origin of the race of ascetics has been recounted.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are born again and again among human beings for the purpose of achieving their object. Thus the origin of the race of ascetics has been recounted.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा तत्र द्विजः कश्चिद्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः । पत्नीपुत्रसुहृद्वर्गैः स्वकर्मनिरतो ऽवसत्
verses.transliteration: purā tatra dvijaḥ kaścidvedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / patnīputrasuhṛdvargaiḥ svakarmanirato 'vasat
verses.translation: The meritorious story of Suras, Asuras, Gan¬ dharvas, Apsaras-s, Yaksas, Raksasas, Pisacas, Suparnas, ser¬ pents, birds, pythons, peacocks, all medicinal herbs, worms, germs, insects, insignificant creatures born in water, animals and glorious Brahmanas, is conducive to longevity and wealth. It is pleasing and beneficial. It is meritorious. It must be heard always and retained by one who is devoid of malice and jealousy.
verses.hindi: २. संख्या अठारह हो जाती है, अतः इन नामों में से कोई विशेषण है। पर प्रम,.णाभाव से हमने अनुषाद यथातथ्य कर दिया है । ६२५ वायुपुराणम््
verses.wordMeaning: The meritorious story of Suras, Asuras, Gan¬ dharvas, Apsaras-s, Yaksas, Raksasas, Pisacas, Suparnas, ser¬ pents, birds, pythons, peacocks, all medicinal herbs, worms, germs, insects, insignificant creatures born in water, animals and glorious Brahmanas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The meritorious story of Suras, Asuras, Gan¬ dharvas, Apsaras-s, Yaksas, Raksasas, Pisacas, Suparnas, ser¬ pents, birds, pythons, peacocks, all medicinal herbs, worms, germs, insects, insignificant creatures born in water, animals and glorious Brahmanas,…

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: ब्राह्मणस्य तु यत्कर्म उत्पत्तिः क्षत्रियस्य तु । वैश्यस्यापि च शूद्रस्य तत्सर्वं कथयस्व मे
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: brāhmaṇasya tu yatkarma utpattiḥ kṣatriyasya tu / vaiśyasyāpi ca śūdrasya tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me
verses.translation: He who regularly reads this story of the race (of ascetics) of noble souls in the assembly of Brahmanas and physi¬ cians will attain children, abundant wealth and prosperity and the glorious goal after death.
verses.hindi: सर्वाद्धकेशा वृत्ताख्या दंष्ट्रिणो नखिनस्तथा । तियंडगाः पुरुषादाश्च पिशाचास्ते ह्धोमुखाः
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads this story of the race (of ascetics) of noble souls in the assembly of Brahmanas and physi¬ cians will attain children, abundant wealth and prosperity and the glorious goal after death.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads this story of the race (of ascetics) of noble souls in the assembly of Brahmanas and physi¬ cians will attain children, abundant wealth and prosperity and the glorious goal after death.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्यार्हस्य कामस्य मोक्षस्य च परं विधिम् । निखिलं ज्ञातुम् इच्छामि नान्यो वेत्ता मतिर्मम
verses.transliteration: dharmasyārhasya kāmasya mokṣasya ca paraṃ vidhim / nikhilaṃ jñātum icchāmi nānyo vettā matirmama
verses.translation: Thus when the entire mobile and immobile crea¬ tions had been created and established by the noblc-souled Kasyapa, he the chief Prajapati, crowned (the chiefs of them)
