verses.hindi: अकेशका ह्यरोमाणस्त्वग्वसाश्रमंबाससः । कृष्माण्डिका: पिशाचास्ते तिलभक्षा: सदामिषा: वक़ाड़ुहस्तपादाश्च वक़्शीलागतास्तथा । ज्ञेया वक़्पिशाचास्ते वक़गा:ः कामरूपिण: २६६ लस्बोदरास्तुण्डनाशा हृस्वक्ायशिरोमुजा:। नितुन्दका: पिशाचास्ते तिलभक्षा: प्रियअवा:
verses.wordMeaning: Thus when the entire mobile and immobile crea¬ tions had been created and established by the noblc-souled Kasyapa, he the chief Prajapati, crowned (the chiefs of them)
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus when the entire mobile and immobile crea¬ tions had been created and established by the noblc-souled Kasyapa, he the chief Prajapati, crowned (the chiefs of them)

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: उत्पत्तिकारणं ब्रह्मा देवदेवः प्रकीर्तितः । प्रथमं सर्वभूतानां चराचरजगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: utpattikāraṇaṃ brahmā devadevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ / prathamaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ carācarajagadguruḥ
verses.translation: He made Prahlada, the delighter of Diti, the king of Daityas: Narayana the king of Sadhyas; and the Bull- bannered lord (Siva) the king of Rudras.
verses.hindi: वामनाकतयश्चेब वाचाला: प्लुतगामिनः । पिशाचानकंम्कास्ते वक्षवासावनप्रियाः १२७१
verses.wordMeaning: He made Prahlada, the delighter of Diti, the king of Daityas: Narayana the king of Sadhyas; and the Bull- bannered lord (Siva) the king of Rudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Prahlada, the delighter of Diti, the king of Daityas: Narayana the king of Sadhyas; and the Bull- bannered lord (Siva) the king of Rudras.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजातयो मुखाज्जाताः क्षत्रिया बाहुयन्त्रतः । ऊरुप्रदेशाद् वैश्यास्तु शूद्राः पादेष्वथाभवन्
verses.transliteration: dvijātayo mukhājjātāḥ kṣatriyā bāhuyantrataḥ / ūrupradeśād vaiśyāstu śūdrāḥ pādeṣvathābhavan
verses.translation: He directed Vipracitti to be the king of Danavas. He ordered Varuna to be the king of waters. He made Vaisravana (Kubera) the lord of Yaksas, Raksasas and the wealth of (worldly) kings.
verses.hindi: धमनीमन्तकाः शुष्का: श्मश्ुलाश्ची रवाससः । उपदीराः पिशाचाश्च श्मशानायतनास्तथा विष्टब्धाक्षा महाजिद्ना लेलिहाना ह्यलूखला:। हस्त्युष्ट्स्यूलशिरसो विरता बद्धपिण्डका:
verses.wordMeaning: He directed Vipracitti to be the king of Danavas. He ordered Varuna to be the king of waters. He made Vaisravana (Kubera) the lord of Yaksas, Raksasas and the wealth of (worldly) kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He directed Vipracitti to be the king of Danavas. He ordered Varuna to be the king of waters. He made Vaisravana (Kubera) the lord of Yaksas, Raksasas and the wealth of (worldly) kings.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वन्ये पृथग्वर्णाः पृथग्धर्मान् समाचरन् । पर्यायेण समुत्पन्ना ह्यनुलोमविलोमतः
verses.transliteration: tatastvanye pṛthagvarṇāḥ pṛthagdharmān samācaran / paryāyeṇa samutpannā hyanulomavilomataḥ
verses.translation: He coronated Yama, the son of Vivasvan (the Sun), in
verses.hindi: पिश्नाचों के सभी अंगों में केश होते हैं, भाँखें गोली होती हैं, बड़े-बड़े दाँत तथा नख होते हैं, अंग्र ठेढ़े-मेढ़े रहले हैं, मनुष्य का भक्षण करते हैं, उनके मुख नीचे की ओर झुके रहते हैं। कुष्मांडिक कहलानेवाले पिशाचगण बिना केशों के होते हैं, शरीर पर रोम भी नहीं रहते, चमड़े, चर्वी, आदि को वस्त्र के स्थान पर लपेटे रहते हैं, वे सवंदा मास तथा तिल का भाहर करनेवाले हैं।२६७-२६८। बक्र नामक पिशाचों के सभी अंग हाथ पर
verses.wordMeaning: He coronated Yama, the son of Vivasvan (the Sun), in
verses.commentary: Sense: He coronated Yama, the son of Vivasvan (the Sun), in

verses.sanskrit: तेषां धर्मं प्रवक्ष्यामि श्रुतिस्मृत्यर्थचोदितम् । येन सम्यक्कृतेनैव सर्वे यान्ति परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ dharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrutismṛtyarthacoditam / yena samyakkṛtenaiva sarve yānti parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: He made Himavan the ruler of mountains; ocean, of the rivers; and Citraratha the ruler of Gandharvas.
verses.hindi: सब टेढ़े होते हैं, वे चलते समय भी टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी चाल चलते हैं, सबंदा टेढ़े बने रहते हैं, इच्छानुसार स्वरूप घारण करते हैं तथा वक्रगामी हैं।२६६। नितुन्दक नामक पिलज्ञाच लंबे पेटवाले, ऊँची उठी हुई नासिकावाले, छोटे शरीर वाले शिर और छोटे हाथवाले, तिल भक्षण करनेवाले तथा सुन्दर कानवाले हैं। अनक॑ मर्क (7) नामक पिशाच गण बौने के समान आक्ृतिवाले, बहुत बोलनेवाले, उछल-उछल कर चलनेवाले, वर्षों पर निवास करने, तथा बुक्षों पर आहार पसन्द करनेवाले हैं। पांशु कहे जानेवालें विशाचगण ऊषध्वें बाहुधारी होते हैं, उनके रोम ऊपर की ओर उठे हुए रहते हैं, उनके आवास स्थान भी ऊपर की ओर उढे हुये होते हैं, वे अपने अंगों से धूल गरिराये चलते हैं। उपवीर नामक पिशाचगण अपनी धमनियों को जाननेवाले, सूखे हुए, मूछ दाढ़ी रखे हुये, चीर घारणकरनेवाले तथा इमशानों में निवास करनेवाले होते
verses.wordMeaning: He made Himavan the ruler of mountains; ocean, of the rivers; and Citraratha the ruler of Gandharvas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Himavan the ruler of mountains; ocean, of the rivers; and Citraratha the ruler of Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit: गतिर्ध्यानं विना भक्तैर् ब्राह्मणैः प्राप्यते नृप । अध्यापयन्यतो वेदान्वेदं वापि यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: gatirdhyānaṃ vinā bhaktair brāhmaṇaiḥ prāpyate nṛpa / adhyāpayanyato vedānvedaṃ vāpi yathāvidhi
verses.translation: He crowned Uccaissravas as the king of horses, tiger as the king of deer and cows, and bulls the lords of quadrupeds.
verses.hindi: हैं। उलूखल नामक पिशाचगरण निश्चल आँखों वाले, लंबी जीभवाले, सवंदा जीभ से होंठ चाटनेवाले, हाथी भौर ऊंट की तरह मोटे शिरवाले, विरत तथा समूह बाँधकर चलनेवाले होते हैं ॥३७०-२७४। वे कुम्मपात्र नाम से विख्यात पिशाच हैं, जो बिना देखे हुये अन्न का भोजन करते हैं ये बहुत सूक्ष्म आकृतिवाले, सारे शरीर पर रोमावली युक्त, पीलेवर्ण तथा कहीं पर दिखाई पड़नेवाले और क हीं पर न दिखाई पड़नेवाले होते हैं । वे
verses.wordMeaning: He crowned Uccaissravas as the king of horses, tiger as the king of deer and cows, and bulls the lords of quadrupeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned Uccaissravas as the king of horses, tiger as the king of deer and cows, and bulls the lords of quadrupeds.

verses.sanskrit: कुलजां रूपसम्पन्नां सर्वलक्षणलक्षिताम् । उद्वाहयेत्ततः पत्नीं गुरुणानुमते तदा
verses.transliteration: kulajāṃ rūpasampannāṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām / udvāhayettataḥ patnīṃ guruṇānumate tadā
verses.translation: He made Garufla the most excellent among flying be¬ ings, the lord of all birds. He made Maruta the lord of scents and unembodied beings.
verses.hindi: निपुण नामक पिशाचगण हैं, जो इस भूलोंक में अकेले पाने पर मनुष्यों में आविष्ट होते हैं, उनके मुख कानों आयुक्तांश्च विशन्‍्तीह निपुणास्ते पिशाचकाः । आकर्णदारितास्थाश्च लम्बश्रूस्थुलनासिकाः
verses.wordMeaning: He made Garufla the most excellent among flying be¬ ings, the lord of all birds. He made Maruta the lord of scents and unembodied beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Garufla the most excellent among flying be¬ ings, the lord of all birds. He made Maruta the lord of scents and unembodied beings.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्मार्तं विवाहाग्निं श्रौतं वा पूजयेत् क्रमात् । प्रतिग्रहधनो भूत्वा दम्भलोभविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ smārtaṃ vivāhāgniṃ śrautaṃ vā pūjayet kramāt / pratigrahadhano bhūtvā dambhalobhavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: He made Vayu, the most excellent among strong be¬ ings, the lord of sound, sky and strength. He made Sesa, the lord of allfanged (reptiles), and Vasuki the lord of serpents.
verses.hindi: शन्यागा राश्षयाः स्थलाः पिशाचा: पुरणास्तु ते । हस्तपादाक्वान्तगणा ह्ृस्वका: क्षितिदृष्टयः ॥ बालादास्ते पिशाचा वे सुतिकागृहसेविनः
verses.wordMeaning: He made Vayu, the most excellent among strong be¬ ings, the lord of sound, sky and strength. He made Sesa, the lord of allfanged (reptiles), and Vasuki the lord of serpents.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Vayu, the most excellent among strong be¬ ings, the lord of sound, sky and strength. He made Sesa, the lord of allfanged (reptiles), and Vasuki the lord of serpents.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चयज्ञविधानानि कारयेद्वै यथाविधि । वनं गच्छेत् ततः पश्चाद्द्वितीयाश्रमसेवनात्
verses.transliteration: pañcayajñavidhānāni kārayedvai yathāvidhi / vanaṃ gacchet tataḥ paścāddvitīyāśramasevanāt
verses.translation: He made Taksaka, the lord of vipers, serpents and reptiles. He crowned Parjanya, one of the Adityas, as the lord of oceans, rivers, clouds and rains.
verses.hindi: पृष्ठतःपाणिपादाश्च हस्वका वातरंहसः । पिशितादाः पिशाचास्ते सइप्रामे रुघिराशिन: ७२७८ नग्नका ह्यनिकेताश्च लम्बकेशाश्च पिण्डकाः । पिशाचा: स्कन्दिनस्ते वे अन्या उच्छेषणाशिनः ७ घोडश जातयस्तेषां पिशाचानां प्रकीतिताः (२७६ एवंविधान्विशाचांस्तु दीनान्दुष्ट्वाइनुकम्पया । तेभ्यो ब्रह्मा बरं प्राद्मत्कारुण्यादल्पचेतस: ॥ अन्तर्धानं प्रजास्तेषां कामरूपत्वमेव च ११२८०
verses.wordMeaning: He made Taksaka, the lord of vipers, serpents and reptiles. He crowned Parjanya, one of the Adityas, as the lord of oceans, rivers, clouds and rains.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Taksaka, the lord of vipers, serpents and reptiles. He crowned Parjanya, one of the Adityas, as the lord of oceans, rivers, clouds and rains.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रेषु भार्यां निक्षिप्य सर्वसङ्गविवर्जितः । इष्टांल्लोकानवाप्नोति न चेह जायते पुनः
verses.transliteration: putreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya sarvasaṅgavivarjitaḥ / iṣṭāṃllokānavāpnoti na ceha jāyate punaḥ
verses.translation: He crowned Kamadeva the king of all groups of Apsaras-s.
verses.hindi: विध्वस्तानि च यानि स्युरनाचारोषितानि च। असंस्पृष्टोपलिप्तानि संस्कारबंजितानि च॒
verses.wordMeaning: He crowned Kamadeva the king of all groups of Apsaras-s.
verses.commentary: Sense: He crowned Kamadeva the king of all groups of Apsaras-s.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियस्तु स्थितो राज्ये पालयित्वा वसुंधराम् । शश्वद्धर्ममनाश्चैव प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyastu sthito rājye pālayitvā vasuṃdharām / śaśvaddharmamanāścaiva prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Verses 1-20 enumerate the heads of different categories of creation. Here one is reminded of the Vibhutiyoga (BG.X).
verses.hindi: राजमार्गोपरथ्याश्च निष्कुटाश्चत्वराणि च। द्वाराण्यट्रालकाश्चेव निमंमान्संक्रमांततथा. तक फले हुये रहते हैं, भौंहे लंबी होती हैं, और नाक मोदी होती हैं। वे पुरण नामक-पिश्ाचगण हैं, जो शु्य भवनों में निवास करते हैं, उनके शरीर होते हैं, उनके हाथ और पर बहुत छोटे-छोटे होते हैं और भांख पृथ्वी १र लगी रहती हैं, ये पिशाचगण बालकों का भक्षण करनेवाले हैं और सबंदा सूतिका गृहो का संवन करते हैं ।१७५-२७७. मांस भक्षण करनेवाले पिशाचों के द्वाथ और पर पीछे की ओर होते हैं, कद के छोटे होते
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 1-20 enumerate the heads of different categories of creation. Here one is reminded of the Vibhutiyoga (BG.X).
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 1-20 enumerate the heads of different categories of creation. Here one is reminded of the Vibhutiyoga (BG.X).

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यधर्मो न सन्देहः कृषिगोरक्षणे रतः । सत्यशौचसमोपेतो गच्छते स्वर्गमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vaiśyadharmo na sandehaḥ kṛṣigorakṣaṇe rataḥ / satyaśaucasamopeto gacchate svargamuttamam
verses.translation: The Prajapati crowned Sudhaman, the famous son of Rajas, as the king in the eastern quarter.
verses.hindi: है, वायु के समान वेगवान् होते है, ये संग्राम भूमि में जाकर रक्त का आहार करते हैं। स्कन्दी कहे जानेवाले पिशाचगण नग्न रहते हैं, उनके रहने का कोई नियत स्थान नहीं रहता, केश लंबे होते हैं, पिण्डाकार दिखाई पड़ते हैं, इनके अतिरिक्त अन्य पिशाचगण उच्छेषणाशी (जूठा खानेवाले) होते हैं। इन पिश्ञाचों की सोलह (?) जातियों का वर्णन किया जा चुका ।२७८-२७६। इस प्रकार अपनी प्रजाओं में विभिन्न आकृति एवं गुण
verses.wordMeaning: The Prajapati crowned Sudhaman, the famous son of Rajas, as the king in the eastern quarter.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Prajapati crowned Sudhaman, the famous son of Rajas, as the king in the eastern quarter.

verses.sanskrit: न शूद्रस्य पृथग्धर्मो विहितः परमेष्ठिना । न मन्त्रो न च संस्कारो न विद्यापरिसेवनम्
verses.transliteration: na śūdrasya pṛthagdharmo vihitaḥ parameṣṭhinā / na mantro na ca saṃskāro na vidyāparisevanam
verses.translation: In the western quarter, he crowned the noble-souled Ketuman, the unerring son of Rajas, the king.
verses.hindi: दोषवाले इन पिश्माचों को अल्पबुद्धियुक्त एवं दीन अवस्था में देख ब्रह्मा ने अनुग्रपृवंक भर्न्तघान होने, तथा इच्छानुसार विविध स्वरूप घारण करने का वरदान दिया। ये पिशाचगण दोनों सन्ध्याओों (प्रातः: एवं सायमृ) के अवसर पर विचरण करते हैं, उनकी जीविका एवं रहने के स्थानों को बतला रहा हूँ। जो भवन टूटे फूटे रहते हैं, थोड़े आदमी निवास करते हैं, विध्वस्त हो जाते हैं, अत्याचारों समेत निवास किया जाता है, असंस्क्ृत अथवा विना लिपे पुते रहते हैं, स्पर्श नहीं किये जाते उनमें ये निवास करते हैं ।२८००२८२॥ इसके अतिरिक्त
verses.wordMeaning: In the western quarter, he crowned the noble-souled Ketuman, the unerring son of Rajas, the king.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the western quarter, he crowned the noble-souled Ketuman, the unerring son of Rajas, the king.

verses.sanskrit: न शब्दविद्यासमयो देवताभ्यर्चनानि च । यथा जातेन सततं वर्तितव्यमहर्निशम्
verses.transliteration: na śabdavidyāsamayo devatābhyarcanāni ca / yathā jātena satataṃ vartitavyamaharniśam
verses.translation: He made Vaivasvata Manu the lord of human beings. The entire earth consisting of seven continents along with the towns therein, is being ruled righteously by them in their res¬ pective areas.
verses.hindi: राजमार्ग, (सड़क) ग़लियाँ घर के समीप के उपवन, चबूतरे या भोराहे, द्वारदेश निर्मम अट्टालक, एकास्त
verses.wordMeaning: He made Vaivasvata Manu the lord of human beings. The entire earth consisting of seven continents along with the towns therein, is being ruled righteously by them in their res¬ pective areas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Vaivasvata Manu the lord of human beings. The entire earth consisting of seven continents along with the towns therein, is being ruled righteously by them in their res¬ pective areas.

verses.sanskrit: स धर्मः सर्ववर्णानां पुरा सृष्टः स्वयम्भुवा । मन्त्रसंस्कारसम्पन्नास्त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: sa dharmaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ purā sṛṣṭaḥ svayambhuvā / mantrasaṃskārasampannāstrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: They had been crowned formerly by Brahma in the Svayambhuva Manvantara. Only those who become Manu are consecrated as kings.
verses.hindi: इदमर्ध नास्ति क, पुस्तके । अधामिका जनास्ते वे आजीबा विहिताः सुरे: । यर्णाश्रमा: संकरिका: कारुशिल्पिजनास्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: They had been crowned formerly by Brahma in the Svayambhuva Manvantara. Only those who become Manu are consecrated as kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had been crowned formerly by Brahma in the Svayambhuva Manvantara. Only those who become Manu are consecrated as kings.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मतमनादृत्य यदि वर्तेत कामतः । स मृतो जायते श्वा वै गतिरूर्ध्वा न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ matamanādṛtya yadi varteta kāmataḥ / sa mṛto jāyate śvā vai gatirūrdhvā na vidyate
verses.translation: In the Manvantaras that have passed, these kings (had ruled and) passed away. When the Manvantaras occur again, others will be crowned again. All the kings, past and future, are proclaimed as Lords of Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: आरभत्ते क्रिया यास्तु पिशाचास्तन्न देवता: रद
verses.wordMeaning: In the Manvantaras that have passed, these kings (had ruled and) passed away. When the Manvantaras occur again, others will be crowned again. All the kings, past and future, are proclaimed as Lords of Manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Manvantaras that have passed, these kings (had ruled and) passed away. When the Manvantaras occur again, others will be crowned again. All the kings, past and future, are proclaimed as Lords of Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: न तेषां प्रेषणं नित्यं तेषां मतमनुस्मरन् । यशोभागी स्वधर्मस्थः स्वर्गभागी स जायते
verses.transliteration: na teṣāṃ preṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ teṣāṃ matamanusmaran / yaśobhāgī svadharmasthaḥ svargabhāgī sa jāyate
verses.translation: Prthu was crowned by these excellent men at the time of Rajasuya. The valorous king was made so in accordance with the injunctions of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: पिशाचानामनुज्ञाय ब्रह्म सोषधिपतिदंदौ २८८ द्विपिनश्च सुतास्तस्य व्यालेयाश्वाउइइमसिषाशिनः । ऋषायाश्चापि कात्स्न्येन प्रजासगं निबोधत ।।
verses.wordMeaning: Prthu was crowned by these excellent men at the time of Rajasuya. The valorous king was made so in accordance with the injunctions of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prthu was crowned by these excellent men at the time of Rajasuya. The valorous king was made so in accordance with the injunctions of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: एवं गुणगणाकीर्णो ऽवसद्विप्रः स भारत । हनस्वेति हनस्वेति शृणोति वाक्यमीदृशम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇo 'vasadvipraḥ sa bhārata / hanasveti hanasveti śṛṇoti vākyamīdṛśam
verses.translation: The lord of Prajas, Kasyapa, procreated these sons, for the purpose of the continuity of the progeny. Thereafter, desirous of his own lineage, he performed a severe penance. He contemplated—"May sons, the founders of the lineage, be born to me".
verses.hindi: तस्य दुहितरः पतन्च तासां नामानि से शणु
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of Prajas, Kasyapa, procreated these sons, for the purpose of the continuity of the progeny. Thereafter, desirous of his own lineage, he performed a severe penance. He contemplated—"May sons, the founders of the lineage, be born to me".
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of Prajas, Kasyapa, procreated these sons, for the purpose of the continuity of the progeny. Thereafter, desirous of his own lineage, he performed a severe penance. He contemplated—"May sons, the founders of the lineage, be born to me".

verses.sanskrit: ततो निरीक्षते चोर्ध्वम् अधश्चैव दिशो दश । वेपमानः स भीतश्च प्रस्खलंश्च पदे पदे
verses.transliteration: tato nirīkṣate cordhvam adhaścaiva diśo daśa / vepamānaḥ sa bhītaśca praskhalaṃśca pade pade
verses.translation: As Kasyapa, the noble soul, contemplated, two power¬ ful sons born of Brahma's part were born to him.
verses.hindi: सहस्रदन्‍्ता मकराः पाठीनास्तिमिरोहिताः । इत्येवमार्दिहि गण मैनो विस्तीणं उच्यते १२९२ आवास, पथ, नदियाँ, तीर्थ, देवी देवताओं के कल्पित निवास वक्ष और महापथ (श्मशान मार्ग) इन स्थानों में सवंत्र पिशाचगण निवास करते हैं । जो अधामिक जन हैं वर्णाश्रम की मर्यादा से वहिभत हैं वर्णसंकर हैं, कारोगरी या शिल्पकर्म करनेवाले हैं देवताओं ने उनको ही इन पिशाचों की आजीविका बनाई है। चोरी, विश्वासघात, अमृत ?) तुल्य जीवों एवं इनके अतिरिक्त अन्यान्य कुत्सित उपायों द्वारा उपाजित घन से नो
verses.wordMeaning: As Kasyapa, the noble soul, contemplated, two power¬ ful sons born of Brahma's part were born to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Kasyapa, the noble soul, contemplated, two power¬ ful sons born of Brahma's part were born to him.

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्खलायुधहस्तैश्च पाशैश्चैव सुदारुणैः । वेष्टितं महिषारूढं नरं पश्यति मन्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṅkhalāyudhahastaiśca pāśaiścaiva sudāruṇaiḥ / veṣṭitaṃ mahiṣārūḍhaṃ naraṃ paśyati manmukham
verses.translation: They were Vatsara and Asita. Both of them were pro¬ pounders of Brahman. Nidhruva and Raibhya of great fame were born of Vatsara.
verses.hindi: क्रियाएं सम्पन्न की जाती हैं, उनमें देवुता पिज्ञाच होते हैं ।२८३-२८६। मधु, मांस, भात, दही. तिलचण, मदिरा, आसव, धूप, हरिद्रा, खिचड़ी तेल, मोधा. गुण और भात (एक में) काले वस्त्र, क्षप और पृष्प--इन सब सामग्रियों समेत पर्वों की सधियों के अवसर पर पिशाचों की बलि देनी चाहिए । ऐसौ आज्ञा ब्रद्मा ने उन पिशाचों को दी ओर शझूलपाणि महेश्बर को उन सभी भूतों एवम् पिशाचों का स्वामी नियत
verses.wordMeaning: They were Vatsara and Asita. Both of them were pro¬ pounders of Brahman. Nidhruva and Raibhya of great fame were born of Vatsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Vatsara and Asita. Both of them were pro¬ pounders of Brahman. Nidhruva and Raibhya of great fame were born of Vatsara.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णांजनचयप्रख्यं कृष्णाम्बरविभूषितम् । रक्ताक्षमायतभुजं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṃjanacayaprakhyaṃ kṛṣṇāmbaravibhūṣitam / raktākṣamāyatabhujaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam
verses.translation: The Raibhyas should be known as the (descendants) of Raibhya. Understand (those) of Nidhruva. Gyavana begot Sumcdhas of Sukanya.
verses.hindi: किया ।२८७-२८७। सुन्दरी दंष्ट्रा ने व्याप्नों और सिहों को पुत्रहूप में उत्पन्न किया । इनके अतिरिक्त चीते, अन्य प्रकार के बाध और शेर तथा अन्य न्य मांसभक्षी वन्य पशुओं को उसने उत्पन्न किया । अब इसके उपरान्त ऋषा की सम्पूर्ण प्रजाओं का विस्तार क्रम सुनिये । उसकौ पाँच कन्याएँ थीं, जिनके नाम मैं बतला रहा हैं, सुनिये । मीना, माता, वृत्ता, परिवत्ता तथा अनुवृत्ता--ये पाँच उनकी कन्याएँ थीं, इसके पृत्रादिकों का वर्णन सुनिये  सहस्न दाँतवाले मकर, पाठीन (जलजन्तु) तिमि, (मछली विशेष) रोहित, (रोह)--ये सब मीवनों के भेद मीना की सस्तानों में कहे गये हैं ।२०६-२६२। इसके अतिरिक्त छोटे और बड़े, चार प्रकार के ग्राह, निष्क
verses.wordMeaning: The Raibhyas should be known as the (descendants) of Raibhya. Understand (those) of Nidhruva. Gyavana begot Sumcdhas of Sukanya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Raibhyas should be known as the (descendants) of Raibhya. Understand (those) of Nidhruva. Gyavana begot Sumcdhas of Sukanya.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तं तु समायान्तं निरीक्ष्यात्मानमात्मना । जपञ्जाप्यं च परमं शतरुद्रीयसंस्तवम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā taṃ tu samāyāntaṃ nirīkṣyātmānamātmanā / japañjāpyaṃ ca paramaṃ śatarudrīyasaṃstavam
verses.translation: Nidhruva's wife 1 was the mother of Kundapayins. Brahniistha (Devala in Bd.P.) was born of Ekaparna and Asita.
verses.hindi: प्राह्श्वतुविधा ज्ञेया तथाइनुज्येष्ठका अपि । निष्कांश्च शिशुमारांश्व मीना व्यजनयत्प्रजा:
verses.wordMeaning: Nidhruva's wife 1 was the mother of Kundapayins. Brahniistha (Devala in Bd.P.) was born of Ekaparna and Asita.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nidhruva's wife 1 was the mother of Kundapayins. Brahniistha (Devala in Bd.P.) was born of Ekaparna and Asita.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोवाच भगवान्यमः संयमनो महान् । शृणु वाक्यमतो ब्रह्मन्यमो ऽहं सर्वजन्तुषु
verses.transliteration: tataḥ provāca bhagavānyamaḥ saṃyamano mahān / śṛṇu vākyamato brahmanyamo 'haṃ sarvajantuṣu
verses.translation: On hearing (i.e. paying heed to) the words of Sandilya, Devala became excessively famous. Nidhruvas, Sandilyas and Raibhyas all these three formed the Kas- yapa Gotra later 2.
verses.hindi: वृत्ता कूमंविकाराणि नेकानि जलचारिणाम् । तथा शद्भुविकाराणि जनयामास नेकशः (२६४ गण्डूकानां विकाराणि अनुवृत्ता व्यजायत । ऐणेयानां बिकाराणि शस्बूकानां तथंव च २६५ तथा शुक्तिविकाराणि वराटककृतानि च ॥ तथा शद्भूविकाराणि परिवत्ता व्यजायत कालक्टविकाराणि जलौकविहितानि च। इत्येष हि ऋषेबंशः पत्च शाखाः प्रकीतिता: २६७ तियंग्घेतुकमाद्याहुबहुलं (? ) वंशविस्तरम् । संस्वेदजविकाराणि यथा येभ्यो भवन्ति ह २९८
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing (i.e. paying heed to) the words of Sandilya, Devala became excessively famous. Nidhruvas, Sandilyas and Raibhyas all these three formed the Kas- yapa Gotra later 2.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing (i.e. paying heed to) the words of Sandilya, Devala became excessively famous. Nidhruvas, Sandilyas and Raibhyas all these three formed the Kas- yapa Gotra later 2.

verses.sanskrit: संहरस्व महाभाग रुद्रजाप्यं सुदुर्भिदम् । येनाहं कालपाशैस्त्वां संयमामि गतव्यथः
verses.transliteration: saṃharasva mahābhāga rudrajāpyaṃ sudurbhidam / yenāhaṃ kālapāśaistvāṃ saṃyamāmi gatavyathaḥ
verses.translation: Vara (Vajri i.e. Indra in Bd. P.) and other Devas are the progeny of Devala. These subjects function in Dvapara Yuga that remains (i.e. occurs) after eleven cycles of the sets of four Yugas have passed.
verses.hindi: स्वस्तिपिकशरीरेम्यो जायन्त्युत्पादका द्विजा:। मनुष्या: स्वेदमलजा उशना नाम जन्तवः
verses.wordMeaning: Vara (Vajri i.e. Indra in Bd. P.) and other Devas are the progeny of Devala. These subjects function in Dvapara Yuga that remains (i.e. occurs) after eleven cycles of the sets of four Yugas have passed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vara (Vajri i.e. Indra in Bd. P.) and other Devas are the progeny of Devala. These subjects function in Dvapara Yuga that remains (i.e. occurs) after eleven cycles of the sets of four Yugas have passed.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा निष्ठुरं वाक्यं यमस्य मुखनिर्गतम् । महाभयसमोपेतो ब्राह्मणः प्रपलायितः
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā niṣṭhuraṃ vākyaṃ yamasya mukhanirgatam / mahābhayasamopeto brāhmaṇaḥ prapalāyitaḥ
verses.translation: Carisyanta (Nairisyanta in Bd. P.) was the son of Manasa and his son was Dama. Manasa who was well-known as Tfnabindu, was his heir and successor.
verses.hindi: + तथा शिरसि चेले व यूकाः संस्वेदजा: स्मृता: । चन्द्रादित्याग्नितप्तायां पृश्चिव्यां संभवन्ति ये॥ तृणमेधप्रसिक्ताया: स्मता: संस्वेदजन्तव: । नानापिपीलिकगणाः कीटका बद्धपादका: ॥३० १ शबद्भगेपलविकाराणि कीलकाचारकाणि च । इत्येबमादिबहुलाः स्वेदजा: पाथिवा गणा:. और शिशुमार--इन सबको मीना (माता) ने उत्पन्न किया । बत्ता ने जल में विचरण करनेवाले सभी प्रकार के कच्छपों (कछओं) को तथा सभी प्रकार के शंखों को अगणित संख्या में उत्पन्न किया । अनुवृत्ता ने मेढ़कों के सभी भेदों एवं उपभेदों को तथा ऐणेय (१) और सम्बूक़ (घोधां) के सभी भेदोपभेदों को उत्पन्न किया । परिवृत्ता ने शुक्ति (सुतुही), वराठिका (कौड़ी) तथा शह्भु के सभी भेदोपभेद को उत्पन्न किया  इनके अतिरिक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Carisyanta (Nairisyanta in Bd. P.) was the son of Manasa and his son was Dama. Manasa who was well-known as Tfnabindu, was his heir and successor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Carisyanta (Nairisyanta in Bd. P.) was the son of Manasa and his son was Dama. Manasa who was well-known as Tfnabindu, was his heir and successor.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य मार्गे गताः सर्वे यमेन सह किंकराः । तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति तं विप्रमूचुस्ते सो ऽप्यधावत
verses.transliteration: tasya mārge gatāḥ sarve yamena saha kiṃkarāḥ / tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti taṃ vipramūcuste so 'pyadhāvata
verses.translation: In the beginning of the third Treta Yuga, he became the king. His daughter Idavida was unrivalled in her beauty. The saintly king gave her to Pulastya.
verses.hindi: कालकूट ओर जलौका (जोक) के सभी भेदों को भी उसने उत्पन्न किया / यह क्ूषि के बंश का वर्णन किया जा चुका, जिसकी उपर्युक्त पाँच शाखायें कही गई हैं । इन निरथेक योनि में उत्पन्न होनेवाले जन्तुओं का वंश विस्तार बहुत कहा जाता है स्वेद से उत्पन्न होनेवाले जीवों के भेदोपभेदों को चर्चा कर रहा हूँ, जो जिनके स्वेद से जिस प्रकार उत्पन्न होते हैं  है द्विजगण ! इन स्वेदज जस्तुओं के उत्पादक मनुष्य हैं ये स्वेदज जन्तु
verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning of the third Treta Yuga, he became the king. His daughter Idavida was unrivalled in her beauty. The saintly king gave her to Pulastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning of the third Treta Yuga, he became the king. His daughter Idavida was unrivalled in her beauty. The saintly king gave her to Pulastya.

verses.sanskrit: त्वरमाणः परिश्रान्तो हा हतो ऽहं दुरात्मभिः । रक्ष रक्ष महादेव शरणागतवत्सल
verses.transliteration: tvaramāṇaḥ pariśrānto hā hato 'haṃ durātmabhiḥ / rakṣa rakṣa mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala
verses.translation: The sage Visravas was born of Idavida. He had four wives who made the family of Pulastya flourish.
verses.hindi: स्वस्तिपिक (?) शरीरों से उत्पन्न होते हैं। स्वेद और मल से उत्पन्न होनेवाले जन्तुगण उशना नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं ।२६८-२६६। शिर के बालों में तथा वस्त्र में स्वेद से उत्पन्न होनेवाले जन्तु यूका नाम से स्मरण किये जाते हैं । चन्द्रमा, सूर्य और अग्नि से तपी हुई पृथ्वी में जो जन्तु उत्पन्न होते हैं, बादलों की वृष्टि से भीगे हुए तृथों में जो जन्तु उत्पन्न होते हैं, वे स्वेदज जन्तु कहे जाते हैं। विविध प्रकार के चींटीं जाति के जन्तु एवं कीट, जो श्रेणी बद्ध होकर चलते हैं, शंख और रत्नों के विविध प्रकार के जीव एवं कील का चारक (?) तथा इनके अतिरिक्त अन्यान्य बहुतेरे जन्तु पाथिव (पृथ्वी के) स्वेदज कहे जाते हैं ।३००-३०२। धाम (धूप) आदि से तपे हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The sage Visravas was born of Idavida. He had four wives who made the family of Pulastya flourish.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage Visravas was born of Idavida. He had four wives who made the family of Pulastya flourish.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वापतद्भूमौ लिङ्गमालिङ्ग्य भारत । गतसत्त्वः स विप्रेन्द्रः समाश्रित्य सुरेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvāpatadbhūmau liṅgamāliṅgya bhārata / gatasattvaḥ sa viprendraḥ samāśritya sureśvaram
verses.translation: Brhaspati, the preceptor of the Devas, had a famous daughter named Devavarnini. He (Visravas) married that girl.
verses.hindi: १. आनन्दाश्रम की श्रति में मीना पाठ यहाँ पर भी है, जो अशुद्ध प्रतीत होता है, क्योंकि पाँचों कन्याओं में मोना के बाद माता का नाम आता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Brhaspati, the preceptor of the Devas, had a famous daughter named Devavarnini. He (Visravas) married that girl.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhaspati, the preceptor of the Devas, had a famous daughter named Devavarnini. He (Visravas) married that girl.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ देवदेवो महेश्वरः । को हनिष्यति माभैस्त्वं हुङ्कारमकरोत्तदा
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ bhūmau devadevo maheśvaraḥ / ko haniṣyati mābhaistvaṃ huṅkāramakarottadā
verses.translation: He (Visravas) married Puspotkata and Vaka, the daughters of Malyavan as well as Kaikasi, the daughter of Malin. Listen to their progeny.
verses.hindi: ध्रेप् वायुपुराणम तथा घर्मादितप्ताभ्यस्त्वद्भ्यों वृष्टिभ्य एवं च। नका मृगशरीरेभ्यो जायन्ते जन्तवस्त्विसि
verses.wordMeaning: He (Visravas) married Puspotkata and Vaka, the daughters of Malyavan as well as Kaikasi, the daughter of Malin. Listen to their progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: He (Visravas) married Puspotkata and Vaka, the daughters of Malyavan as well as Kaikasi, the daughter of Malin. Listen to their progeny.

verses.sanskrit: तेन ते किंकराः सर्वे यमेन सह भारत । हुङ्कारेण गताः सर्वे मेघा वातहता यथा
verses.transliteration: tena te kiṃkarāḥ sarve yamena saha bhārata / huṅkāreṇa gatāḥ sarve meghā vātahatā yathā
verses.translation: Devavarnini gave birth to his eldest son Vaisravana who had divine fate and saintly learning, (but) had the form of a Raksasa and the strength of an Asura.
verses.hindi: मीनकाः पिप्पला दंशास्तथा तित्तिरपुत्रिका:  नीलचित्राश्च जायन्ते ह्ालका बहुविस्तराः
verses.wordMeaning: Devavarnini gave birth to his eldest son Vaisravana who had divine fate and saintly learning, (but) had the form of a Raksasa and the strength of an Asura.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devavarnini gave birth to his eldest son Vaisravana who had divine fate and saintly learning, (but) had the form of a Raksasa and the strength of an Asura.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं कोहनस्वेति विश्रुतम् । सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वतीर्थेष्वनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ kohanasveti viśrutam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam
verses.translation: He had three feet, a huge body, stout head, a large chin 3, eight fangs, green moustache, pike-like ears and red com¬ plexion. His arms were short and long (i.e. one short, one long). He was yellowish in colour (?) and very terrible to look at. He had the knowledge of the illusory world. He was enlight¬ ened with knowledge.
verses.hindi: जलजा: स्वेदजाश्चेच जायन्ते जन्तवस्त्विमि । काशतोयथ्ज (ज )काः कीटानलदा बषुपादका: ॥ सिहला रोमलाश्चव पिच्छला: परिकीतिता: । इत्येबमादिहि गणो जलज:ः स्वेदजः स्पृत:..
verses.wordMeaning: He had three feet, a huge body, stout head, a large chin 3, eight fangs, green moustache, pike-like ears and red com¬ plexion. His arms were short and long (i.e. one short, one long). He was yellowish in colour (?) and very terrible to look at.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He had three feet, a huge body, stout head, a large chin 3, eight fangs, green moustache, pike-like ears and red com¬ plexion. His arms were short and long (i.e. one short, one long). He was yellowish in colour (?) and very terrible to look at.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम् । अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamāpnotyanuttamam
verses.translation: Sumcdhas as per Bd. P. iMn in the text is a tautology. It should be maM-hanum as in
verses.hindi: मुद्गेम्य पनसेम्यश्च तण्डुलेस्यस्तथेव च । तथा कोटरशुष्केभ्यो निहितेभ्यो भवन्ति हि ३०८ अन्येभ्योषपि च जायन्ते न हि तेभ्यश्चिरं सदा । जन्तवस्तुरगादिभ्यो विषादिभ्यस्तथव च
verses.wordMeaning: Sumcdhas as per Bd. P. iMn in the text is a tautology. It should be maM-hanum as in
verses.commentary: Sense: Sumcdhas as per Bd. P. iMn in the text is a tautology. It should be maM-hanum as in

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र प्राणत्यागं करोति यः । न पश्यति यमं देवमित्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu rājendra prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ / na paśyati yamaṃ devamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: On seeing such a son assuming a cosmic form, the father himself said—"This is Kubera (ugly-bodied one) ". 1
verses.hindi: बहुन्यहानि निश्षिप्ते संभवन्ति च गोमये । जायन्ते कृमये विप्रा: काष्ठेभ्यश्च घुणादय: ३१० क़मा द्रुमाणां जायन्ते विविधा नीलसक्षिकाः। तथा शुष्कविकारेम्यः पुत्रिकाः प्रभवन्ति च
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing such a son assuming a cosmic form, the father himself said—"This is Kubera (ugly-bodied one) ". 1
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing such a son assuming a cosmic form, the father himself said—"This is Kubera (ugly-bodied one) ". 1

verses.sanskrit: अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्याज्जले वा नृपसत्तम । अग्निलोके वसेत् तावद् यावत् कल्पशतत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryājjale vā nṛpasattama / agniloke vaset tāvad yāvat kalpaśatatrayam
verses.translation: The word 'Ku' is used to indicate contempt. The body is mentioned by the word Bera. Hence he is called Kubera be¬ cause his body was deformed. Since he was the child of Visravas and he appeared like Visravas, he will be known in the world by the name Vaisravana.
verses.hindi: कालिका शतिकेभ्यश्च सर्पा जाथन्ति सर्वशः। संस्वेदजाश्च जायन्ते वृश्चिकाः शुष्कगोमयात्
verses.wordMeaning: The word 'Ku' is used to indicate contempt. The body is mentioned by the word Bera. Hence he is called Kubera be¬ cause his body was deformed. Since he was the child of Visravas and he appeared like Visravas, he will be known in the world by the name Vaisravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The word 'Ku' is used to indicate contempt. The body is mentioned by the word Bera. Hence he is called Kubera be¬ cause his body was deformed. Since he was the child of Visravas and he appeared like Visravas, he will be known in the world by the name Vaisravana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वरुणलोके ऽपि वसित्वा कालमीप्सितम् । इह लोकमनुप्राप्तो महाधनपतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ varuṇaloke 'pi vasitvā kālamīpsitam / iha lokamanuprāpto mahādhanapatirbhavet
verses.translation: Kubera begot of Rddhi the famous (son) Nalakubara. Kaikasi gave birth to four children Ravana, Kumbhakarna and Vibhlsana (the three sons and) a daughter Surpanakha.
verses.hindi: जल से वृष्टि से तथा प्रुगों (पशुओं) के शरीरों से ये अनेक जन्तु उत्पन्न होते हैं।मीनक, पिप्पल, दश (डंसे) तित्तिरपुत्रक, नीलचित्र, अलर्क--प्रभृति जन्तुओं की संख्या बहुत अधिक है ।य जन्‍्तु जलज एवं स्वेदज कहे जाते हैं। ये जलज ओर स्वेदज जच्तु काशतोयअझजक (?) तलद, बहुपादक, सिहल, रोमल, पिच्छल आदि नामों से पुकारे जाते हैं। इनके अतिरिक्त अन्य बहुतेरे भी हैं। घृत से, उड़द से, मूंग से भी ये जन्तु उत्पन्न होते हैं । इसी प्रकार बेल, जामुन, आम, सुपारी आदि फलों से भी ये जन्तु उत्पन्न होते हैं। मूंग, कटहल चाबल, सूखे वक्षों के कोटर एवं बहुत दिनों की रखी हुई वस्तुओं से भी ये कीट उत्पन्न होते हैं ।॥०३-३०८। इनक भतिरिक्त अन्य बहुत पदार्थों से इन कीटों की उत्पत्ति होती है; किन्तु उनसे सबंदा चिरकाल तक नहों उत्पन्न होते हैं । घोड़े आदि पशुओं तथा विष आदि पदार्थों से भी ये क्षुद्र जन्तु उत्पन्न होते हैं। बहुत दिनों से रखे
verses.wordMeaning: Kubera begot of Rddhi the famous (son) Nalakubara. Kaikasi gave birth to four children Ravana, Kumbhakarna and Vibhlsana (the three sons and) a daughter Surpanakha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kubera begot of Rddhi the famous (son) Nalakubara. Kaikasi gave birth to four children Ravana, Kumbhakarna and Vibhlsana (the three sons and) a daughter Surpanakha.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कोहनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्वाविंशत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२३ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र कर्मदीतीर्थम् उत्तमम् । यत्र तिष्ठति विघ्नेशो गणनाथो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kohanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 123 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra karmadītīrtham uttamam / yatra tiṣṭhati vighneśo gaṇanātho mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: His span of life as reckoned by Brahmanas, experts in calculation, extended to five crores and sixtyone lakhs of years. For sixty lakhs of years 3, this Ravana made Devas and Sages terribly sleepless (by means of his atrocities). In the twenty-fourth Tretayuga, when his merit of penance declin¬ ed, he met Rama, the son of Dasaratha, (in battle) and was slain along with his followers.
verses.hindi: गये गोबर में ये जन्तु उत्पन्न होते हैं। है द्विजगण  इसी प्रकार काष्ठादि वस्तुओं से घुन आदि क्षद्र जन्तु उत्पन्न होते हैं । वृक्षों से विविध प्रकार की नीली मक्खियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं, सब प्रकार की सूखी हुई वस्तुओं से पुत्रिका उत्पन्न होती हैं, शतिको (?) से सभी प्रकार के वर्षकालीन सर्प उत्पन्न होते है। सूखे गोबरों से बिच्छुओं की उत्पत्ति होती है ।३०६९-३१२। है प्रभो ! इसी प्रकार मौओं और भंसों के शरीर से भी स्वेदज जन्तुओं
verses.wordMeaning: His span of life as reckoned by Brahmanas, experts in calculation, extended to five crores and sixtyone lakhs of years. For sixty lakhs of years 3, this Ravana made Devas and Sages terribly sleepless (by means of his atrocities). In the twenty-fourth Tretayuga,…
verses.commentary: Sense: His span of life as reckoned by Brahmanas, experts in calculation, extended to five crores and sixtyone lakhs of years. For sixty lakhs of years 3, this Ravana made Devas and Sages terribly sleepless (by means of his atrocities). In the twenty-fourth Tretayuga,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा चतुर्थ्यां वा ह्युपोषितः । विघ्नं न विद्यते तस्य सप्तजन्मनि भारत
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā caturthyāṃ vā hyupoṣitaḥ / vighnaṃ na vidyate tasya saptajanmani bhārata
verses.translation: Etymology of'Kubera*, the god of wealth.
verses.hindi: की उत्पत्ति होती है। मत्स्य आदि विविध जन्‍्तु अण्डे से उत्पन्न होते हैं। च॑ंवीरिक, गोजा एथं अन्यान्य प्रकार  घनुरिचिल्नान्तगंतग्रग्यो घ पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Etymology of'Kubera*, the god of wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Etymology of'Kubera*, the god of wealth.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे हि यत्किंचिद् दीयते नृपसत्तम । तदक्षयफलं सर्वं जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe hi yatkiṃcid dīyate nṛpasattama / tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The Purana-writer entertained fantastic ideas about Ravana. Jaina Raraayanas give a sober and a more realistic picture of Ravana, e.g. Ravana was one-headed but due to the reflection of his face in the nine precious stones of his necklace, he was (poetically) called 'ten-headed*.
verses.hindi: चैवीरिकाश्च जायन्ते तथा गोजाकुलानि च  तथाउन्‍्यानि च सुक्ष्माणि जलोकादीनि जातयः ॥३ १४ +कपोतकुररादिभ्यः सुक्ष्मा यूकास्तथेव च ॥2 तथवान्ये४पि संख्याता अष्टापदकुलीरकाः
verses.wordMeaning: The Purana-writer entertained fantastic ideas about Ravana. Jaina Raraayanas give a sober and a more realistic picture of Ravana, e.g. Ravana was one-headed but due to the reflection of his face in the nine precious stones of his necklace, he was (poetically) called 'ten-headed*.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Purana-writer entertained fantastic ideas about Ravana. Jaina Raraayanas give a sober and a more realistic picture of Ravana, e.g. Ravana was one-headed but due to the reflection of his face in the nine precious stones of his necklace, he was (poetically) called 'ten-headed*.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कर्मदेश्वरतीर्थमाहत्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रयोविंशत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल नर्मदेश्वरमुत्तमम् । तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karmadeśvaratīrthamāhatmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| rkv adhyāya 124 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla narmadeśvaramuttamam / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Ravana's harrasment is not thus delimited elsewhere. It should be a part of his span of life. Bd. 3.8.53 correctly reads Satfim caiva sahasrayi 'sixty thousand years' as a part of Ravana's total life. For, a set of the four Yugas=4320000 years, thirteen such sets=56160000 years. Ravaria is credited with this span.
verses.hindi: मक्षिकाणां विकाराणि जायस्ते जातयो5परे ।) प्रायेण तु वसन्त्यस्मिन्नुच्छिष्टोदककर्दसे ३१३१६ मशकानां विकाराणि अ्रमराणां तथंव च। तृणेस्यः समजायन्त पुत्रिकाः पुत्रसप्तकाः मणिच्छेदास्तथा व्याला: पोतजाः परिकीतिता: । शतवेरिविकाराणि करीषेभ्यो भवन्ति हि. ॥३े१८ एवमादिरसंख्यातो गणः संस्वेदों मया  समासाभिहितों होष प्रावकर्मंवशजः स्मृतः ३१६ तथाइउन्ये नेऋंता सत्तवास्ते स्मृता उपसर्गजाः । पृतास्तु योनिजाः केचित्केचिदोत्पत्तिका: स्मृता: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Ravana's harrasment is not thus delimited elsewhere. It should be a part of his span of life. Bd. 3.8.53 correctly reads Satfim caiva sahasrayi 'sixty thousand years' as a part of Ravana's total life. For, a set of the four Yugas=4320000 years,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ravana's harrasment is not thus delimited elsewhere. It should be a part of his span of life. Bd. 3.8.53 correctly reads Satfim caiva sahasrayi 'sixty thousand years' as a part of Ravana's total life. For, a set of the four Yugas=4320000 years,…

verses.sanskrit: अग्निप्रवेशश्च जले ऽथवा मृत्युरनाशके । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य यथा मे शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: agnipraveśaśca jale 'thavā mṛtyuranāśake / anivartikā gatistasya yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: Mahodara, Prahasta, Mahapariisu and Khara were the sons of Puspotkata and Kumbhlnasl was her daughter.
verses.hindi: प्रायेण देवा: सर्वे वे विज्ेया ह्यपपत्तिजाः । केचित्तु योनिजा देवा: केचिदेवानिमित्तत:
verses.wordMeaning: Mahodara, Prahasta, Mahapariisu and Khara were the sons of Puspotkata and Kumbhlnasl was her daughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahodara, Prahasta, Mahapariisu and Khara were the sons of Puspotkata and Kumbhlnasl was her daughter.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुर्विंशत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल रवितीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यत्र देवः सहस्रांशुस्तपस्तप्त्वा दिवं गतः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 125 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla ravitīrthamanuttamam / yatra devaḥ sahasrāṃśustapastaptvā divaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Trisiras, Dusana, the Raksasa Vidyujjihva and the daughter Asalika are remembered as the children of Vaka.
verses.hindi: तूलालाघश्च कोलश्च शिवा कन्या तथेव च्। अपत्यं सरमायास्तु गणा वे सरसादय:ः श्यामश्च शबलश्चैब अर्जुनो हरितस्तथा । कृष्णो धूम्रारणश्चव तुलालाबृश्च कद्गुकाः
verses.wordMeaning: Trisiras, Dusana, the Raksasa Vidyujjihva and the daughter Asalika are remembered as the children of Vaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Trisiras, Dusana, the Raksasa Vidyujjihva and the daughter Asalika are remembered as the children of Vaka.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं देवो जगद्धाता सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः । तपस्तपति देवेशस्तापसो भास्करो रविः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ devo jagaddhātā sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ / tapastapati deveśastāpaso bhāskaro raviḥ
verses.translation: These are the ten Raksasa descendants of Pulastya. They were cruel in their activities. All of their followers were terrible and unassailable even by Devas.
verses.hindi: के जोंक आदि क्षुद्र जल जन्तुओं की उत्पत्ति भी अण्डों से हीती है । इसी प्रकार कबूतर, कुरर आदि पक्षी अण्डों से उत्पन्न होते हैं । अति सूक्ष्म यूक (जूँ) आदि जन्‍्तु भी अण्डों से उत्पन्य होते हैं। उसी प्रकार आठ पैरों वाले कुली रक (केकड़ा) भी अंडे से उत्पन्न होनेवाले जन्तुओ में गिने गये हैं ।३१३-३१५। सभी प्रकार की मव्खियों की जातियों में जितने अन्यान्य भेदोपभेद पाये जाते हैं, वे भी अंडों से उत्पन्न होते हैं। कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: These are the ten Raksasa descendants of Pulastya. They were cruel in their activities. All of their followers were terrible and unassailable even by Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the ten Raksasa descendants of Pulastya. They were cruel in their activities. All of their followers were terrible and unassailable even by Devas.

verses.sanskrit: आराध्यः सर्वभूतानां सर्वदेवैश्च पूजितः । प्रत्यक्षो दृश्यते लोके सृष्टिसंहारकारकः
verses.transliteration: ārādhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvadevaiśca pūjitaḥ / pratyakṣo dṛśyate loke sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ
verses.translation: All of them had secured boons. All of them were endowed with sons and grandsons.
verses.hindi: मक्खियाँ उच्छिष्ट वस्तुओं पर, जल में तथा कीचड़ में निवास करती हैं । सभी प्रकार के मशको के भदोपभद, अमरों के भदोपभेद, पुत्चिका तथा पुत्र सप्तक आदि क्षुद्र जन्तु तृणों से उत्पन्न होते हैं। मणिच्छेद तथा व्याल ये पोतज नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं (!) शतवेरि के जितने भेदोपभेद हैं व करोषों (करषे) से उत्पन्न होते हु । इस प्रकार के अन्यान्य स्वेदज क्षुद्र जन्तुओं की संख्या अगणित है। केवल संक्षप में मैंने इनका वणन किया हैं, ये सब जन्म प्राक्तन कम के अधीन कहे जाते हैं ।३१६-३३१९। इन सबों के अतिरिक्त जो नऋत प्राण' हैं, व उपसर्गज कहे जाते हैं। कोई जन्म ग्रहण करनेवाले प्राणी पृत और कोई औत्पत्तिक कहे जाते हैं । प्रायः सभी देवगणों को औत्पत्तिक जानना चाहिए । कुछ देवता योनिजात हैं ओर कुछ विना किसी कारण के ही उसन्न होनेवाले हैं  सरमा के तुलालाघ, और कोल ये दो पुत्र ओर शिवा नाम की तीसरी कन्या हुईं  ये सरमादिगण
verses.wordMeaning: All of them had secured boons. All of them were endowed with sons and grandsons.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them had secured boons. All of them were endowed with sons and grandsons.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यत्वं कथं प्राप्तः कथं भास्कर उच्यते । सर्वमेतत्समासेन कथयस्व ममानघ
verses.transliteration: ādityatvaṃ kathaṃ prāptaḥ kathaṃ bhāskara ucyate / sarvametatsamāsena kathayasva mamānagha
verses.translation: Thus, there are seven classes of Raksasas (including the above three and the following four groups): Panlastyas, Nairrtas, Agastyas and Kausikas.
verses.hindi: के नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं। श्याम, शबल, अर्जुन, हरित, कृष्ण, धूमत्र, अरुण और तूलालाबू ये क्र की सन्ततियाँ हैं । सुरसा ने एक सौ शिरोमृत सर्पों को उत्पन्न क्रिया । सपो का राजा तक्षक ओर नागों का राजा बासुकि है। ये
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, there are seven classes of Raksasas (including the above three and the following four groups): Panlastyas, Nairrtas, Agastyas and Kausikas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, there are seven classes of Raksasas (including the above three and the following four groups): Panlastyas, Nairrtas, Agastyas and Kausikas.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: महाप्रश्नो महाराज यस्त्वया परिपृच्छितः । तत्सर्वं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि नमस्कृत्य स्वयम्भुवम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mahāpraśno mahārāja yastvayā paripṛcchitaḥ / tatsarvaṃ sampravakṣyāmi namaskṛtya svayambhuvam
verses.translation: I shall describe the natural features of all these* (Raksasas) 1: They had round eyes. They were yellowish in colour. They had huge bodies and bellies. They had eight fangs; pikelike ears and hairs standing upright. They had their mouths extending (as if) upto the ears. Some had hair like the Munja grass. Some had smoke-coloured upright hair. Some had stout heads shedding white lustre. Some were short-statured. Some had long arms. Some had copper-coloured faces. Some had long (dangling down) tongues and lips. Some had long eyebrows and stout noses. Some were blue-bodied with red necks and majestic eyes. They were terrific. They were excessively terrible-voiced and hideous. They went in groups. They were stout with promi-
verses.hindi: +धनुश्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थः क. पुस्तके नास्ति। 2६ इदम्ध नास्ति डः.. पुस्तके । प्रे८ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: I shall describe the natural features of all these* (Raksasas) 1: They had round eyes. They were yellowish in colour. They had huge bodies and bellies. They had eight fangs; pikelike ears and hairs standing upright. They had their mouths extending (as if) upto the ears.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall describe the natural features of all these* (Raksasas) 1: They had round eyes. They were yellowish in colour. They had huge bodies and bellies. They had eight fangs; pikelike ears and hairs standing upright. They had their mouths extending (as if) upto the ears.…

verses.sanskrit: आसीदिदं तमोभूतमप्रज्ञातमलक्षणम् । अप्रतर्क्यम् अविज्ञेयं प्रसुप्तम् इव सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: āsīdidaṃ tamobhūtamaprajñātamalakṣaṇam / apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ prasuptam iva sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Superstitions about Raksasas
verses.hindi: सुरसाथ बिजन्ने तु शतमेक शिरोबृतम् । सर्वाणा तक्षकों राजा नागानां चापि बासुकिः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Superstitions about Raksasas
verses.commentary: Sense: Superstitions about Raksasas

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तेजश्च दिव्यं च तप्तपिण्डमनुत्तमम् । आकाशात्तु यथैवोल्का सृष्टिहेतोर् अधोमुखी
verses.transliteration: tatas tejaśca divyaṃ ca taptapiṇḍamanuttamam / ākāśāttu yathaivolkā sṛṣṭihetor adhomukhī
verses.translation: The deer, all the fanged beasts of prey, Bhutas, Pisacas, serpents, bees, elephants, monkeys, Kinnaras, Yamakimpurusas 1 (?) and all those mentioned by me as born of Krodhavasa—all these were Pulaha's sons.
verses.hindi: श्येनी भासी तथा क्ोची धृतराष्ट्री शुकी तथा । अरुणस्थ भार्या श्येनी तु वीयंवन्‍्ती महाबलौ॥ संपातिरजनयत्पुत्रं कन्यामेकां तथंव च। जटायुषश्च ये पुत्रा: काकगृश्राश्वक णिनः
verses.wordMeaning: The deer, all the fanged beasts of prey, Bhutas, Pisacas, serpents, bees, elephants, monkeys, Kinnaras, Yamakimpurusas 1 (?) and all those mentioned by me as born of Krodhavasa—all these were Pulaha's sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deer, all the fanged beasts of prey, Bhutas, Pisacas, serpents, bees, elephants, monkeys, Kinnaras, Yamakimpurusas 1 (?) and all those mentioned by me as born of Krodhavasa—all these were Pulaha's sons.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तेजसो ऽन्तः पुरुषः संजातः सर्वभूषितः । स शिवो ऽपाणिपादश्च येन सर्वमिदं ततम्
verses.transliteration: tattejaso 'ntaḥ puruṣaḥ saṃjātaḥ sarvabhūṣitaḥ / sa śivo 'pāṇipādaśca yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
verses.translation: In that Vaivasvata Manvantara, Kratu is remembered as childless. He had neither a son nor a grandson. He remained with fully controlled splendour (semen) (i.e. He was celibate).
verses.hindi: भार्या गरत्मतश्चापि भासी क़ौची तथा शुकी । धृतराष्ट्री च भद्रा च तास्वपत्यानि वक्ष्यते (च्म्पहम् ) शुकी गरुत्मतः पुत्रा्युषुबे घट परिश्रुतान् । त्रिशिरं सुसु्खं चेव बल॑ पृष्ठ महाबलम्
verses.wordMeaning: In that Vaivasvata Manvantara, Kratu is remembered as childless. He had neither a son nor a grandson. He remained with fully controlled splendour (semen) (i.e. He was celibate).
verses.commentary: Sense: In that Vaivasvata Manvantara, Kratu is remembered as childless. He had neither a son nor a grandson. He remained with fully controlled splendour (semen) (i.e. He was celibate).

verses.sanskrit: तस्योत्पन्नस्य भूतस्य तेजो रूपस्य भारत । पश्चात्प्रजापतिर्भूयः कालः कालान्तरेण वै
verses.transliteration: tasyotpannasya bhūtasya tejo rūpasya bhārata / paścātprajāpatirbhūyaḥ kālaḥ kālāntareṇa vai
verses.translation: I shall now recount the lineage of Atri 2, the third Praja- pati. He had ten chaste and beautiful wives.
verses.hindi: व्याप्तानि यानि देशानि(स्थानानि) तानि वक्ष्ये यथाक्रमम् । शाल्मलिद्वीपमखिलं देवक्टं च पर्वतम् ॥ मणिमन्तं च शलेन्द्रं सहल़शिखरं तथा। पर्णमालं सुकेशं च शतशूड्गं तथाइचलम् ३३३ कौरजं पतचशिखर हेमक्टं च पर्वंतम् । प्रचण्डवायुप्रभवर्दी पिते: पद्मरागिभिः प्रधानतया तमोगरुणवाले प्रजागण क्रोधवशात्मक कहे गये हैं ।३२०-३२४। प्रलह के पुत्र के संयोग से ताम्रा में जो प्रजा सृष्टि हुई, उसे सुनिये, ताम्रा से अन्यान्य बहुत सी संततियाँ उत्पन्न हुईं जो सुप्रसिद्ध हैं। जसे, व्येनी, भासी, क्रोआओ, धृतराष्ट्री और शुक्री । इनमें श्येनी अरुण की स्त्री हुई, और उसने सम्पाति और जटायु नामक महाबलवान् एवं पराक्रमी श्रेष्ठ पक्षियों को उत्पन्न किया, सम्पाति
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now recount the lineage of Atri 2, the third Praja- pati. He had ten chaste and beautiful wives.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now recount the lineage of Atri 2, the third Praja- pati. He had ten chaste and beautiful wives.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्जातः स भूतानां मनुष्यासुररक्षसाम् । सर्वदेवाधिदेवश्च आदित्यस्तेन चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: agnirjātaḥ sa bhūtānāṃ manuṣyāsurarakṣasām / sarvadevādhidevaśca ādityastena cocyate
verses.translation: Bhadrasva begot of Ghftacl the Apsaras, ten daugh¬ ters. They were:Bhadra, Sudra, Madra, Salada, Malada, Vela, Khala, these seven and Gocapala, Manarasa and Ratnakuta.
verses.hindi: ने एक पुत्र ओर एक एक कन्या को जन्म दिया । जटायु के जो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुये, वे काक गुृप्न और अछ्वकर्णी हैं ।३२५-२२७। गरुत्मानू (गरुड़) की , स्त्री भासी करा, शुकी, घृतराष्ट्री और भद्रा थीं, उनमें जो सनन्‍्ततियाँ उत्पन्न हुईं, उन्हें बतला रहा हूँ । इन पत्नियों में से शुकी ने ग़रुत्मान् के संयोग से छ सुविख्यात पुत्रों को जन्म दिया, जिनके नाम त्रिशिर, सुसुख, बल, महाबलवान् पृष्ठ, सुन्दर मुखवाला त्रिशंखनेत्र और महाबलशाली
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadrasva begot of Ghftacl the Apsaras, ten daugh¬ ters. They were:Bhadra, Sudra, Madra, Salada, Malada, Vela, Khala, these seven and Gocapala, Manarasa and Ratnakuta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadrasva begot of Ghftacl the Apsaras, ten daugh¬ ters. They were:Bhadra, Sudra, Madra, Salada, Malada, Vela, Khala, these seven and Gocapala, Manarasa and Ratnakuta.

verses.sanskrit: आदौ तस्य नमस्कारो ऽन्येषां च तदनन्तरम् । क्रियते दैवतैः सर्वैस्तेन सर्वैर्महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: ādau tasya namaskāro 'nyeṣāṃ ca tadanantaram / kriyate daivataiḥ sarvaistena sarvairmaharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: The founder of the lineage of Atri was famous by the name of Prabhakara (the originator of lustre). He was their husband. He begot of Bhadra, the famous son Soma (the Moon). When the Sun, struck by Rahu, was falling down to¬ wards the earth from the sky, the whole world was enveloped in darkness and it was he (the sage Atri) who spread light every¬ where whereby be got the name Prabhakara.
verses.hindi: रस्वरूपवान सुरस थे । इन महाबलशाली, क्र्रकर्मा, सपंभक्षी ग्ररुड़ों के पुत्रों एवं पौत्रों कौ संख्या चौदह सहस्न थी। उनके पुत्रो पोच्रों से ही पक्षियों की सृष्टि का विस्तार हुआ ।३२८-३३१॥ उन पक्षियों ने जिन देशों को व्याप्त किया है, अर्थात् वे जिन-जिन देशों में अपना स्थान बनाकर निवास करते हैं, उन्हें ऋमशः बतला रहा हूँ । सम्पूर्ण शाल्मलि द्वीप, सारा देवकूट परत, पर्वतराज मणिमान् और सहस्न शिखर, पर्णमाल, सुकेश, शतश्यृंग, कौरज, पश्चशिखर, हेमकूट प्रभृति पर्व्तों पर निवास करते हैं। प्रचण्डवायु१ उत्पन्न होनेवाले अति कान्तिमान;
verses.wordMeaning: The founder of the lineage of Atri was famous by the name of Prabhakara (the originator of lustre). He was their husband. He begot of Bhadra, the famous son Soma (the Moon). When the Sun, struck by Rahu, was falling down to¬ wards the earth from the sky,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The founder of the lineage of Atri was famous by the name of Prabhakara (the originator of lustre). He was their husband. He begot of Bhadra, the famous son Soma (the Moon). When the Sun, struck by Rahu, was falling down to¬ wards the earth from the sky,…

verses.sanskrit: तिस्रः सन्ध्यास्त्रयो देवाः सांनिध्याः सूर्यमण्डले । नमस्कृतेन सूर्येण सर्वे देवा नमस्कृताः
verses.transliteration: tisraḥ sandhyāstrayo devāḥ sāṃnidhyāḥ sūryamaṇḍale / namaskṛtena sūryeṇa sarve devā namaskṛtāḥ
verses.translation: While the Sun was falling the words 'welfare unto you' were addressed to him. At these words of the Brahmana sage Atri (the Sun) did not fall on the earth from heaven.
verses.hindi: १. अथवा, प्रचण्डवायु के समान प्रभावशाली ।
verses.wordMeaning: While the Sun was falling the words 'welfare unto you' were addressed to him. At these words of the Brahmana sage Atri (the Sun) did not fall on the earth from heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: While the Sun was falling the words 'welfare unto you' were addressed to him. At these words of the Brahmana sage Atri (the Sun) did not fall on the earth from heaven.

verses.sanskrit: न दिवा न भवेद् रात्रिः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् । अयनं चोत्तरं चापि भास्करेण विना नृप
verses.transliteration: na divā na bhaved rātriḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam / ayanaṃ cottaraṃ cāpi bhāskareṇa vinā nṛpa
verses.translation: Atri who was the performer of great penance founded excellent Gotras. Among Yajnas (the one called) Atrighana (?) is initiated by Suras.
verses.hindi: शलजालानि व्याप्तानि गारडंस्तेमहात्मभिः । भासीपुत्राः स्घुता भासा उलका: काककुक्कुटा: मयूराः कलविड्धाश्च कपोता लावतित्तिरा:।  क़ौची वार्धोणसाअश्येनी कुररान्स;रसासबकान ।॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Atri who was the performer of great penance founded excellent Gotras. Among Yajnas (the one called) Atrighana (?) is initiated by Suras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Atri who was the performer of great penance founded excellent Gotras. Among Yajnas (the one called) Atrighana (?) is initiated by Suras.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम् । न वर्तते विना सूर्यं तेन पूज्यतमो रविः
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam / na vartate vinā sūryaṃ tena pūjyatamo raviḥ
verses.translation: The race of Atri is described in vv. 67-78.
verses.hindi: चक्वाकांश्च विन्द्रग्रान्सवाश्चेव्रादकाजिहान् । एतानेव विजज्ञेष्थ पुत्रपौत्रमनन्‍्तकम्
verses.wordMeaning: The race of Atri is described in vv. 67-78.
verses.commentary: Sense: The race of Atri is described in vv. 67-78.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दगाः श्रुतिमुख्याश्च ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । प्रत्यक्षो भगवान्देवो दृश्यते लोकपावनः
verses.transliteration: śabdagāḥ śrutimukhyāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / pratyakṣo bhagavāndevo dṛśyate lokapāvanaḥ
verses.translation: He begot of them ten sons, all equal to him. They had no names. All the ten were purified by great penance. They were the sages famous by the name 'Svastyatrcyas. They were mas¬ ters of Vedas. Among them, two were very famous, powerful and expounders of Brahman the eldest was Dattalreya and Durvasas was his younger brother. The youngest daughter was Abala who expounded Brahman. In this connection, the for¬ mer (ancient) Pauranikas cite this verse.
verses.hindi: पद्म के समान रंगवाले, उन महाबलशाली' गरुड नामक पक्षियों से इस पव॑तों के शिखर जाल भरे पड़े हैं। भासी के पुत्र भास नाम से विख्यात हुये । उलूक, काक. कुक्कुर (मुर्गे) मयूर, कलविक (गवरा, गौरैया) कपोत. लवा, तीतर प्रभृति पक्षी भासी की सन्‍्तति स्मरण किये गये हैं ३३२-३३४)। क्रौच्ची ने वार्धीणस) नामक पक्षियों को उत्पन्न किया  कुरर, सारस, बगले, आदि अन्यान्य जो मांसभक्षी पक्षी हैं, उन्हें इ्येनी ने उत्पन्न किया । सुन्दरी घृतराष्ट्री ने हंस कलहंस, चक्रवाक तथा अन्य सभी प्रकार के हिंसक पक्षियों को जन्म दिया  इत सबों के इन पृत्रों के पुत्र पौतों की संख्या असंड्य हुई ।३३६-२३८। गरुड़ की सन्‍्ततियों का विवरण कह चुका अब इरा की सन्‍्ततियों को सुनिये । इरा ने कमल के समान मनोहर नेत्रोंवाली तीन कन्याओं को जन्म दिया, जो सभी प्रकार की वनस्पतियों, वृक्षों और लताओं की माता थीं। उनके नाम थे लता, वल्‍ली ओह वीरुधा । जिनमें
verses.wordMeaning: He begot of them ten sons, all equal to him. They had no names. All the ten were purified by great penance. They were the sages famous by the name 'Svastyatrcyas. They were mas¬ ters of Vedas. Among them, two were very famous,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He begot of them ten sons, all equal to him. They had no names. All the ten were purified by great penance. They were the sages famous by the name 'Svastyatrcyas. They were mas¬ ters of Vedas. Among them, two were very famous,…

verses.sanskrit: उत्पत्तिः प्रलयस्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् । हेतुरेको जगन्नाथो नान्यो विद्येत भास्करात्
verses.transliteration: utpattiḥ pralayasthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam / hetureko jagannātho nānyo vidyeta bhāskarāt
verses.translation: Those who arc conversant with Puranas say that Atri's son Dattatreya is embodied Visnu. The noble-souled one is free from sins and tranquil in mind.
verses.hindi: ने लता ने नदी भादि के तट प्रदेश में स्थित रहने वाले, पृष्परहित वनस्पतियों को उत्पन्न किया, इसके अतिरिक्त पुष्पों और फलों से संयुक्त वक्षों को लता ने जन्म दिया। वल्ली ने गुल्मों को जन्म दिया, समस्त तृण जाति एवं त्वक सार (जिनके चमड़े में ही सार हो, बाँस) आदि को भी वल्ली ने उत्पन्न किया। वीरुधा की सन्‍्ततियाँ वीरुध' के ताम से विख्यात हुईं । यह वंश परिचय की कथा यहाँ समाप्त की जाती है। कश्यप
verses.wordMeaning: Those who arc conversant with Puranas say that Atri's son Dattatreya is embodied Visnu. The noble-souled one is free from sins and tranquil in mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who arc conversant with Puranas say that Atri's son Dattatreya is embodied Visnu. The noble-souled one is free from sins and tranquil in mind.

verses.sanskrit: एवमात्मभवं कृत्वा जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् । लोकानां तु हितार्थाय स्थापयेद् धर्मपद्धतिम्
verses.transliteration: evamātmabhavaṃ kṛtvā jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam / lokānāṃ tu hitārthāya sthāpayed dharmapaddhatim
verses.translation: Four persons born in his spiritual lineage were famous on the earth. They were- Syamas, Mudgalas, Balarakas and Gavisthiras. These are remembered as the groups of very power- fill men.
verses.hindi: एतदधेस्थाने 'कौज्चा बान्नीणसाः श्येना: कुरराः सारसा बका:! इति ख. ग. घ. डः पुस्तकेषु । १. एक विशेष पक्षी । जिसका पैर, शिर और आँखें लाल तथा शेष अंग काले रंग के हो  मार्केण्डेय पुराण में उसका लक्षण इस प्रकार लिखा गया है। 'रक्तपादों रक्तशिरशा रक्तचक्षविहंगम:ः, क्ृष्णवर्णेन च तथा पक्षी वार्धीगसो मतः ॥ इसके अतिरिक्त “नीलग्रीवो रक्तशीषं: क्रष्णपादः सितच्छद: । वार्धीणसः स्थात् पक्षी्ो मम विष्णोरतिप्रिय:” यह एक दूसरा लक्षण भी मिलता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: Four persons born in his spiritual lineage were famous on the earth. They were- Syamas, Mudgalas, Balarakas and Gavisthiras. These are remembered as the groups of very power- fill men.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four persons born in his spiritual lineage were famous on the earth. They were- Syamas, Mudgalas, Balarakas and Gavisthiras. These are remembered as the groups of very power- fill men.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य स्थापयित्वात्मनस् तनुम् । सहस्रांशुं निधिं धाम्नां जगामाकाशमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: narmadātaṭamāśritya sthāpayitvātmanas tanum / sahasrāṃśuṃ nidhiṃ dhāmnāṃ jagāmākāśamavyayam
verses.translation: From Kasyapa Narada, Parvata and Arundhati were born. O excellent ones, (listen to and) understand (thesons)of Arundhati.
verses.hindi: २. विस्तार के साथ फंलनेवाली लताएं ।
verses.wordMeaning: From Kasyapa Narada, Parvata and Arundhati were born. O excellent ones, (listen to and) understand (thesons)of Arundhati.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Kasyapa Narada, Parvata and Arundhati were born. O excellent ones, (listen to and) understand (thesons)of Arundhati.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम् । सहस्रकिरणं देवं नाममन्त्रविधानतः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / sahasrakiraṇaṃ devaṃ nāmamantravidhānataḥ
verses.translation: Narada gave Arundhati (in marriage) to Vasistha. 1 Due to the curse of Daksa, the brilliant Narada (was compel¬ led to be) celibate.
verses.hindi: इति सर्गेकदेशस्य कीतितोइबयबों मया। मारीक्तो5यं प्रजासगं: समासेन प्रकीतितः ॥  + मुनिश्च गन्धशीला वे प्राबाध्ययनशालिनी । गीतशीला त्वरिष्टाइ्य क्रोधशीला खशा स्मृता
verses.wordMeaning: Narada gave Arundhati (in marriage) to Vasistha. 1 Due to the curse of Daksa, the brilliant Narada (was compel¬ led to be) celibate.
verses.commentary: Sense: Narada gave Arundhati (in marriage) to Vasistha. 1 Due to the curse of Daksa, the brilliant Narada (was compel¬ led to be) celibate.

verses.sanskrit: तेन तप्तं हुतं तेन तेन सर्वमनुष्ठितम् । तेन सम्यग्विधानेन सम्प्राप्तं परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tena taptaṃ hutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam / tena samyagvidhānena samprāptaṃ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Formerly when there was a great battle between Devas and Asuras, called Tarakamava, the whole world was op¬ pressed by drought and Sakra was aggrieved along with Suras. The intelligent Vasistha sustained all the subjects by means of his penance.
verses.hindi: बाहशीला तु विनता ताम्रा वे पाशशालिती । स्वभावा लोकमात॒णां शीलान्येतानि सर्वेशः
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly when there was a great battle between Devas and Asuras, called Tarakamava, the whole world was op¬ pressed by drought and Sakra was aggrieved along with Suras. The intelligent Vasistha sustained all the subjects by means of his penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly when there was a great battle between Devas and Asuras, called Tarakamava, the whole world was op¬ pressed by drought and Sakra was aggrieved along with Suras. The intelligent Vasistha sustained all the subjects by means of his penance.

verses.sanskrit: ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस्तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् । स्नात्वा ये नर्मदातोये देवं पश्यन्ति भास्करम्
verses.transliteration: te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / snātvā ye narmadātoye devaṃ paśyanti bhāskaram
verses.translation: Making use of the medicinal herbs, fruits and roots (the sage) sympathetically enlivened them.
verses.hindi: धमंतः शीलतो बुद्धचा क्षमया बलरूपतः । रज:सत्त्वतमोबृत्ता धामिकाधा्िकास्तु वें मातृतुल्याश्वाभिजाताः कश्यपस्या55त्मजाः प्रजा:  देवत/सुरगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Making use of the medicinal herbs, fruits and roots (the sage) sympathetically enlivened them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Making use of the medicinal herbs, fruits and roots (the sage) sympathetically enlivened them.

verses.sanskrit: तथा देवस्य राजेन्द्र ये कुर्वन्ति प्रदक्षिणम् । अनन्यभक्त्या सततं त्रिरक्षरसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: tathā devasya rājendra ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇam / ananyabhaktyā satataṃ trirakṣarasamanvitāḥ
verses.translation: (Defective Verse) O Brahmanas, Vasistha begot Sakti of Arundhati. Ad r syanti (wife of Sakti) bore Parara to Sakti on the seashore (?)
verses.hindi: के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले स्थावर जंगस जीव निकाय की सृष्टि को मैं सुना चुका, इनके पुत्रों एवं पोत्रों का परिचय सुना चुका, जो इस समस्त जगन्मण्डल को छेंके हुये हैं। इस विस्तृत प्रजा सृष्टि के एक अंश का लघ परिचय मैं आप लोगों को करा चुका । मरीचि पुत्र कश्यप की प्रजाओं का सुष्टि-विस्तार इस प्रकार सक्षप में कहा जा चुका। द्विजण  इस सृष्टि-क्रम को विस्तार के साथ संकेड़ों वर्षों में नहीं कहा जा
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective Verse) O Brahmanas, Vasistha begot Sakti of Arundhati. Ad r syanti (wife of Sakti) bore Parara to Sakti on the seashore (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective Verse) O Brahmanas, Vasistha begot Sakti of Arundhati. Ad r syanti (wife of Sakti) bore Parara to Sakti on the seashore (?)

verses.sanskrit: तेन पूतशरीरास्ते मन्त्रेण गतपातकाः । यत्पुण्यं च भवेत् तेषां तदिहैकमनाः शृणु
verses.transliteration: tena pūtaśarīrāste mantreṇa gatapātakāḥ / yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhavet teṣāṃ tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Kali bore K r?nadvaipayana, the holy lord, to Parasara. FromDvaipayana, Suka, endowed with good qualities, was born,
verses.hindi: सकता ।३३९-३४३॥। कश्यप की स्त्रियों में अदिति धर्मंशील एवं दिति बलशील कही जाती हूँ । इसी प्रक/र धुरभि तपस्या में निरत रहनेवाली तथा दनु मायाविनंं कही गई है । मुनि अध्ययन करनेवाली तथा गन्धशीला है । अरिष्टा गान करने वाली तथा खद्या क्रोध करनेवाली कही जाती है ।३४४-३४५॥। कब्रु परम क्र प्रकृति की तथा क्रौस्ची वेदों का अध्ययन करमरेवाली अथवा बहुत अधिक सुननेवाली कही जाती है। इसी प्रकार इरा को लोग अनुग्रह करनेवाली तथा दनायु को भक्षण करनेवाली बतलाते हैं । विनता भार वहन करनेवाली और ताम्रा पाथ धारण करनेवाली कही जाती है। लोकमाताओं के यही स्वभाव हैं, उनके शील सदाचारादि का समष्ठि में यहो परिचय है। इन सबों के धर्म, शील सदाचारादि, बुद्धि, क्षमा, बल एवं स्वरूप से राजसी, तामसी एवं मात्त्विकी प्रवत्तियाँ उनमें पाई जाती है, और इस प्रकार वे धामिक और अधाभिक दोनों प्रकार के विचारोंवाली कही जाती
verses.wordMeaning: Kali bore K r?nadvaipayana, the holy lord, to Parasara. FromDvaipayana, Suka, endowed with good qualities, was born,
verses.commentary: Sense: Kali bore K r?nadvaipayana, the holy lord, to Parasara. FromDvaipayana, Suka, endowed with good qualities, was born,

verses.sanskrit: ससमुद्रगुहा तेन सशैलवनकानना । प्रदक्षिणीकृता सर्वा पृथिवी नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā / pradakṣiṇīkṛtā sarvā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The following six children were born of Plvar! to Suka: five sons, viz. Bhurisravas, Prabhu, Sambhu, Krsna and Gaura and a daughter Kirtimati by name. She was firm'in her holy rites and a Yogic mother. She was the wife of Sattvaguha and the mother of Brahmadatta.
verses.hindi: हैं ।३४६-३४८। कश्यप की ये समस्त प्रजायें अपनी-अपनी माताओं के समान स्वभाववाली तथा कुलीन थी। देवता अपर, गन्धवं, यक्ष, राक्षस, सपे, पिशाच, पशु, मृग, पक्षी और लता वल्ली आदि सभी प्रजाये इस प्रकार की कही जाती हैं  यतः ये प्रजायें दक्ष की मानुषी कन्याओं में उत्पन्न हुई अत सभो मन्वन्तरों में मनुष्य सवश्रेष्ठ माने
verses.wordMeaning: The following six children were born of Plvar! to Suka: five sons, viz. Bhurisravas, Prabhu, Sambhu, Krsna and Gaura and a daughter Kirtimati by name. She was firm'in her holy rites and a Yogic mother. She was the wife of Sattvaguha and the mother of Brahmadatta.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following six children were born of Plvar! to Suka: five sons, viz. Bhurisravas, Prabhu, Sambhu, Krsna and Gaura and a daughter Kirtimati by name. She was firm'in her holy rites and a Yogic mother. She was the wife of Sattvaguha and the mother of Brahmadatta.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रमूलम् इदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । तेन मन्त्रविहीनं तु कार्यं लोके न सिध्यति
verses.transliteration: mantramūlam idaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / tena mantravihīnaṃ tu kāryaṃ loke na sidhyati
verses.translation: here were eight groups (spiritual lineage) of Parasaras of noble souls. They were Svetas, Kfsnas, Gauras, Syamas, Dhumras, Samfilikas, Darakas, the imbibers of hot ' (drinks?/ (Osmapas) and Nilas.
verses.hindi: + धनुश्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो ग. पुस्तके नास्ति । धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां मानुषा: साधकास्तु बै । ततो5धःशओोतसस्‍्ते बै उत्पद्न्ते सुरासुराः (३५१ जायन्ते कार्यसिद्धचर्थे मानुषेषु पुनः पुनः । इत्येव वंशप्रभवः प्रसंख्यातस्तपस्विनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: here were eight groups (spiritual lineage) of Parasaras of noble souls. They were Svetas, Kfsnas, Gauras, Syamas, Dhumras, Samfilikas, Darakas, the imbibers of hot ' (drinks?/ (Osmapas) and Nilas.
verses.commentary: Sense: here were eight groups (spiritual lineage) of Parasaras of noble souls. They were Svetas, Kfsnas, Gauras, Syamas, Dhumras, Samfilikas, Darakas, the imbibers of hot ' (drinks?/ (Osmapas) and Nilas.

verses.sanskrit: यथा काष्ठमयो हस्ती यथा चर्ममयो मृगः । कार्यार्थं नैव सिध्येत तथा कर्म ह्यमन्त्रकम्
verses.transliteration: yathā kāṣṭhamayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ / kāryārthaṃ naiva sidhyeta tathā karma hyamantrakam
verses.translation: Henceforth, understand the progeny of Indrapratima. Kusiti, who was bom of Kapinjall-GhrtacI to Vasistha is called Indrapratima.
verses.hindi: व्यालानां शिखिनां चेब ओषधीनां च सवंश:  कृमिकीटपतदूगानां क्षुद्रणां जलजाश्च ये ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, understand the progeny of Indrapratima. Kusiti, who was bom of Kapinjall-GhrtacI to Vasistha is called Indrapratima.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, understand the progeny of Indrapratima. Kusiti, who was bom of Kapinjall-GhrtacI to Vasistha is called Indrapratima.

verses.sanskrit: भस्महुतं पार्थ यथा तोयविवर्जितम् । निष्फलं जायते दानं तथा मन्त्रविवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmahutaṃ pārtha yathā toyavivarjitam / niṣphalaṃ jāyate dānaṃ tathā mantravivarjitam
verses.translation: Vasu was his son born of Pflhu's daughter. Upamanyu was his son whose (descendants) were these Upamanyus.
verses.hindi: आयुष्यश्चेव धन्यश्च श्रीमान्हितसुखावहः । श्रोतव्यश्चैव सतत प्राह्मश्चेवानसुयता . (३५५ इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते उपोद्घातपादे कश्यपीयप्रजासगों नाम नवषष्टितमो5्ष्याय: ॥।६८।।
verses.wordMeaning: Vasu was his son born of Pflhu's daughter. Upamanyu was his son whose (descendants) were these Upamanyus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasu was his son born of Pflhu's daughter. Upamanyu was his son whose (descendants) were these Upamanyus.

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठपाषाणलोष्टेषु मृन्मयेषु विशेषतः । मन्त्रेण लोके पूजां तु कुर्वन्ति न ह्यमन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhapāṣāṇaloṣṭeṣu mṛnmayeṣu viśeṣataḥ / mantreṇa loke pūjāṃ tu kurvanti na hyamantrataḥ
verses.translation: Kundins who were famous as descendants of Mitra- Varuna have one spiritual lineage. Others are well-known as Vasisthas. These are the eleven Gotras of Vasisthas.
verses.hindi: गये ।३४९-३५०। धर्म, अर्थ, काम, मोक्ष इन चारों पदार्थों के साधक मनुष्य ही हैं। उनके इस लोक में (मत्येलोक) सुर असुरगण कार्य सिद्धि के लिये बारम्बार निम्नश्रोत के रूप में उत्पन्न होते हैं। तपस्वियों के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले देवताओं, असुरों, गन्धर्वों, अप्सराओं, यक्षों, राक्षसों, पिशाचों, पक्षियों, सर्पों, विहंगमो, ब्यालों, शिखियों, सभी प्रकार की ओषध्षियों, कृमि, कीट-पतंगों, क्षुद्र जलजन्तुओं, पशुओं, ब्राह्मणों एवं श्रीमानों
verses.wordMeaning: Kundins who were famous as descendants of Mitra- Varuna have one spiritual lineage. Others are well-known as Vasisthas. These are the eleven Gotras of Vasisthas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kundins who were famous as descendants of Mitra- Varuna have one spiritual lineage. Others are well-known as Vasisthas. These are the eleven Gotras of Vasisthas.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशाब्दान्नमस्काराद्भक्त्या यल्लभते फलम् । मन्त्रयुक्तनमस्कारात्सकृत्तल्लभते फलम्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśābdānnamaskārādbhaktyā yallabhate phalam / mantrayuktanamaskārātsakṛttallabhate phalam
verses.translation: Thus these eight renowned mental sons of Brahma have been recounted. They were blessed brothers and their spiritual lineages have been established.
verses.hindi: के पुण्यदायी लक्षण एवं बंश विस्तार को मैं बतला चुका । यही उनका वर्णन है। यह वर्णन आयु प्रदान करनेवाला, धन्य, श्री सम्पन्न, कल्याणदायी एवं सुख का साधन देनेवाला है, इसको सवंदा निश्दा तन करते हुये सुनना तथा धारण करना चाहिए । इस सुष्टि विस्तार के वर्णन का जो मनुष्य नियमपूर्वक, महात्माओं, पण्डितों एवं ब्राह्मणों की सभा में पाठ करता है, वह सन्‍्तति लाभ करता है, प्रचुर धन सम्पत्ति को प्राप्त करता है तथा इस लोक के बाद परलोक में सुन्दर गति प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these eight renowned mental sons of Brahma have been recounted. They were blessed brothers and their spiritual lineages have been established.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these eight renowned mental sons of Brahma have been recounted. They were blessed brothers and their spiritual lineages have been established.

verses.sanskrit: संक्रान्तौ च व्यतीपाते अयने विषुवे तथा । नर्मदाया जले स्नात्वा यस्तु पूजयते रविम्
verses.transliteration: saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte ayane viṣuve tathā / narmadāyā jale snātvā yastu pūjayate ravim
verses.translation: They sustain these three worlds consisting of groups of Dcvas and sages. Their sons and grandsons are hundreds and thousands. By them the entire Earth is pervaded as with the rays of the Sun.
verses.hindi: श्रीवायुमहापु राण में कश्यपीयप्रजासर्ग नामक उनहृत्तरवाँ अध्याय समाप्त
verses.wordMeaning: They sustain these three worlds consisting of groups of Dcvas and sages. Their sons and grandsons are hundreds and thousands. By them the entire Earth is pervaded as with the rays of the Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: They sustain these three worlds consisting of groups of Dcvas and sages. Their sons and grandsons are hundreds and thousands. By them the entire Earth is pervaded as with the rays of the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशाब्देन यत् पापम् अज्ञानज्ञानसंचितम् । तत्क्षणान्नश्यते सर्वं वह्निना तु तुषं यथा
verses.transliteration: dvādaśābdena yat pāpam ajñānajñānasaṃcitam / tatkṣaṇānnaśyate sarvaṃ vahninā tu tuṣaṃ yathā
verses.translation: After hearing this narrative of Su ta, the knower of Atman, the Brahmanas, subsequently asked him as follows:
verses.hindi: ध्घर वायुपुराणम् द्विजातोनां वोरुधां च नक्षत्राणां ग्रहैः सह । यज्ञानां तपसां चेव सोम राज्येडस्यषेचयत्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing this narrative of Su ta, the knower of Atman, the Brahmanas, subsequently asked him as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing this narrative of Su ta, the knower of Atman, the Brahmanas, subsequently asked him as follows:

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे स्नात्वा सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः । तत्रादित्यमुखं दृष्ट्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: candrasūryagrahe snātvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ / tatrādityamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Sraddha is a form of ancestor worship. It is based on the belief in after-death survival of the deceased ancestors and their residence in a parti¬ cular region called Pitr-loka. It is an important topic and forms an integral part of Hindu Dharmasastra. This belief is pre-Vcdic as it dates back to the Indo-Iranian period {vide S.B.E. IV, ). Ancestor-worship was regarded essential for the continuation of one's race and prosperity to
verses.hindi: बृहस्पति तु विश्वेषां ददावड्धिरसां पतिम् ।भुगुणामधिपं चेब काव्य राज्येडम्यषेचयत् ४ आदित्यानां पुनविष्णुं बसुनामथ पावकम् । प्रजापतीनां दक्ष च मस्तामथ वासवम् ४ देत्यानामथ राजानं प्रह्मादं दितिनन्दनम् । नारायण तु साध्यानां रुद्राणां वृषभध्यजम् ६ विप्रचित्ति च राजानं दानवानामथा55दिशत् । अपां तु वरुण राज्ये राज्ञो वेश्रव्णं पतिभ् 0
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha is a form of ancestor worship. It is based on the belief in after-death survival of the deceased ancestors and their residence in a parti¬ cular region called Pitr-loka. It is an important topic and forms an integral part of Hindu Dharmasastra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha is a form of ancestor worship. It is based on the belief in after-death survival of the deceased ancestors and their residence in a parti¬ cular region called Pitr-loka. It is an important topic and forms an integral part of Hindu Dharmasastra.…

verses.sanskrit: माघमासे तु सम्प्राप्ते सप्तम्यां नृपसत्तम । सोपवासो जितक्रोध उषित्वा सूर्यमन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: māghamāse tu samprāpte saptamyāṃ nṛpasattama / sopavāso jitakrodha uṣitvā sūryamandire
verses.translation: How was BhavanI who was formerly Satl, born for the second time? She was DaksayanI at first. How did she become
verses.hindi: ऋषियों के वंशों का अनुकीतंन सूत ने कहा--ऋषिवुन्द ! इस प्रकार महात्मा कश्यप द्वारा सभी स्थावर जंग्रमात्मक प्रजाओं की सृष्टि सम्पन्न हो जाने पर एवं उनके भली भाँति प्रतिष्ठित हो जाने पर सब के प्रमुख प्रजापति ब्रह्मा ने उत् सब के आधिपत्य पर क्रमहय: भिन्न-भिन्न को नियुक्त करने का उपक्रम किया ।१-२। समस्त द्विजातियों (ब्राह्मणों) वीरुधों, नक्षत्रों, ग्रहों, यक्षों एवं तपस्याओं के राजा के पद पर सोम (चन्द्रमा) को अभिषिक्त किया। सभी
verses.wordMeaning: How was BhavanI who was formerly Satl, born for the second time? She was DaksayanI at first. How did she become
verses.commentary: Sense: How was BhavanI who was formerly Satl, born for the second time? She was DaksayanI at first. How did she become

verses.sanskrit: प्रातः स्नात्वा विधानेन ददात्यर्घं दिवाकरे । विधिना मन्त्रयुक्तेन स लभेत् पुण्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena dadātyarghaṃ divākare / vidhinā mantrayuktena sa labhet puṇyamuttamam
verses.translation: (Who are the Pitrs) whose grandson was Mainaka and whose grand-daughters wei'e Uma, Ekaparna, Ekapatala and Gaiiga, the most excellent one among rivers as well as the eldest of them all? Even before this, all this has been already desired to be pointed out (by you). Please listen to all my requests.
verses.hindi: अंपिरा के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाली प्रजाओं का राज्यपद बृहस्पति को दिया। भृगु गोत्र में उत्पन्न होतेवाली प्रजाओं का राज्यपद काव्य (शुक्र) को दिया। इसी प्रकार आदित्यों का राज्य पद विष्णु को, महतों का वासव को दिया  हैत्यों का राजा दितिनन्दन प्रह्लाद को बनाया, इसी प्रकःर साध्यों का राजा नारायण को, रुद्ों का राजा वृषभध्वज (इंंकर) को तथा दानवों का राजा विप्रचित्ति को नियुक्त किया । जल का राज्यपद
verses.wordMeaning: (Who are the Pitrs) whose grandson was Mainaka and whose grand-daughters wei'e Uma, Ekaparna, Ekapatala and Gaiiga, the most excellent one among rivers as well as the eldest of them all? Even before this, all this has been already desired to be pointed out (by you).…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Who are the Pitrs) whose grandson was Mainaka and whose grand-daughters wei'e Uma, Ekaparna, Ekapatala and Gaiiga, the most excellent one among rivers as well as the eldest of them all? Even before this, all this has been already desired to be pointed out (by you).…

verses.sanskrit: पितृदेवमनुष्याणां कृत्वा ह्युदकतर्पणम् । मन्दिरे देवदेवस्य ततः पूजां समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ kṛtvā hyudakatarpaṇam / mandire devadevasya tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret
verses.translation: Are there many Pitrs P * 1 And then where do they stay? Welfare unto you. I wish to hear the great procedure of Sraddha.
