verses.hindi: बरुण को. राजाओं . यक्षों, राक्षसों, भूपतियों तथा घत-सम्पत्ति का स्वाभित्व विश्ववा के पुत्र कुबेर को समर्पित उच्चे:अवसमश्वानां राजानं चाभ्यषेचयत्  मृगाणासथ शादल गोवषं च चतुष्पदाम् ११०
verses.wordMeaning: Are there many Pitrs P * 1 And then where do they stay? Welfare unto you. I wish to hear the great procedure of Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Are there many Pitrs P * 1 And then where do they stay? Welfare unto you. I wish to hear the great procedure of Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा धूपैर्दीपनैवेद्यशोभनैः । पूजयित्वा जगन्नाथं ततो मन्त्रमुदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpanaivedyaśobhanaiḥ / pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ tato mantramudīrayet
verses.translation: Whose sons are they (Pitrs) remembered to be? How are they the Pitrs? How were the Pitrs born and whose sons were they? Of what nature are they?
verses.hindi: शब्दाकाशबलानां च वायुं बलवतां वरम् । सर्वेषां दंष्ट्रिणां शेष नागानामथ वासुकिस्
verses.wordMeaning: Whose sons are they (Pitrs) remembered to be? How are they the Pitrs? How were the Pitrs born and whose sons were they? Of what nature are they?
verses.commentary: Sense: Whose sons are they (Pitrs) remembered to be? How are they the Pitrs? How were the Pitrs born and whose sons were they? Of what nature are they?

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुः शक्रो यमो धाता मित्रो ऽथ वरुणस्तथा । विवस्वान्सविता पूषा चण्डांशुर्भर्ग एव च
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuḥ śakro yamo dhātā mitro 'tha varuṇastathā / vivasvānsavitā pūṣā caṇḍāṃśurbharga eva ca
verses.translation: Are there other Pitrs who are deities (i.e. worthy of wor¬ ship) unto the Devas in heaven? Thus I wish to hear the excellent creation of Pitrs and how the Sraddha performed by us (as per prescribed injunctions) propitiates Pitrs.
verses.hindi: सर्वाप्सरोगणानां च कामदेवं तथेव च। ऋतुनामथ मासानामातंवानां तथव च ११४ पक्षाणां च॒ विपक्षाणां मुहूर्तानां व पर्वणाम् । कलाकाष्ठाप्रमाणानां गतेरयनयोस्तथा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Are there other Pitrs who are deities (i.e. worthy of wor¬ ship) unto the Devas in heaven? Thus I wish to hear the excellent creation of Pitrs and how the Sraddha performed by us (as per prescribed injunctions) propitiates Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Are there other Pitrs who are deities (i.e. worthy of wor¬ ship) unto the Devas in heaven? Thus I wish to hear the excellent creation of Pitrs and how the Sraddha performed by us (as per prescribed injunctions) propitiates Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: इति द्वादशनामानि जपन्कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणाम् । यत्फलं लभते पार्थ तदिहैकमनाः शृणु
verses.transliteration: iti dvādaśanāmāni japankṛtvā pradakṣiṇām / yatphalaṃ labhate pārtha tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: What is regarded (in the Smrtis) as the reason of their being not visible? What types of Pitrs stay in heaven and what types in hell?
verses.hindi: प्रजापतियें रजसः पूर्वस्यां दिशि विश्वुतम् । पुत्रं नाम्ता सुधामानं राजानं सोभ्यषेचयत् १६ पश्चिमस्थां (मायां) दिशि तथा रजसः पुत्रमच्युतम्  केतुमन्तं महात्मानं राजानं सोधभ्यधेचयत्
verses.wordMeaning: What is regarded (in the Smrtis) as the reason of their being not visible? What types of Pitrs stay in heaven and what types in hell?
verses.commentary: Sense: What is regarded (in the Smrtis) as the reason of their being not visible? What types of Pitrs stay in heaven and what types in hell?

verses.sanskrit: दरिद्रो व्याधितो मूको बधिरो जड एव च । न भवेत्सप्त जन्मानि इत्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: daridro vyādhito mūko badhiro jaḍa eva ca / na bhavetsapta janmāni ityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: What Sraddhas are to be offered (to Pitrs)? How do these Sraddhas reach Pitrs—the Sraddhas that are offered uttering the names of father, father's father and great¬ grandfather against the three ricc-balls (Pintfas)? How are they (Pitrs), if stationed in hell, competent to grant benefits? Who are these called by the name' Pitrs? Whom shall we worship again? We have heard that even Devas in heaven worship Pitrs.
verses.hindi: यथाप्रदेशमदण्यापि धर्मण परिपाल्यते १८ किया । पितरों के राज्यपद पर सूयंपुत्र यमराज को अभिषिक्त किया। सभी भूतों एवं पिशाचों का स्वामित्व शूलपाणि शंकर को समर्पित किया ॥३-७। पव॑तों का राज्यपद हिमवान् को, नदियों का सागर को तथा गर्धवों का चित्ररथ को दिया। अइवों के राज्यपद पर उच्चें:क्रवा को अ««्षिक्त किया, मृगों एवं गौ, बेल तथा अन्य चतुष्पदों का राजा सिंह को बतामा। सभी प्रकार के पक्षियों का स्वामी पक्षधारियों में श्रेष्ठ गररड़ को नियत
verses.wordMeaning: What Sraddhas are to be offered (to Pitrs)? How do these Sraddhas reach Pitrs—the Sraddhas that are offered uttering the names of father, father's father and great¬ grandfather against the three ricc-balls (Pintfas)? How are they (Pitrs), if stationed in hell,…
verses.commentary: Sense: What Sraddhas are to be offered (to Pitrs)? How do these Sraddhas reach Pitrs—the Sraddhas that are offered uttering the names of father, father's father and great¬ grandfather against the three ricc-balls (Pintfas)? How are they (Pitrs), if stationed in hell,…

verses.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा विधानेन जपन्मन्त्रं विचक्षणः । आराधयेद् रविं भक्त्या य इच्छेत्पुण्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā vidhānena japanmantraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ / ārādhayed raviṃ bhaktyā ya icchetpuṇyamuttamam
verses.translation: O extremely learned one, we wish to hear this in de¬ tail. It behoves you to explain the significance of this clearly.
verses.hindi: किया । अशरीरी भूतों एवं गन्‍्धों का स्वामी मारुत को बनाया । शब्द, भाकाश, एवं बल का स्वामी बलवानों में श्रेष्ठ वायु को नियत किया । समस्त दंष्ट्राधारी सर्पों का स्वामित्व शेष को तथा नागों का स्वामी बासुकि को बनाया । सरीसृप, सर्प एवं नागों का स्वामी तक्षक को बनाया । समस्त सागरों, नदियों मेघों, वर्षा तथा आदित्य के स्वामित्व पर अन्यतम पजंन्य को अभिषिक्त किया ।६-१३। सभी अप्सरावुन्दों का स्वामी कामदेव को
verses.wordMeaning: O extremely learned one, we wish to hear this in de¬ tail. It behoves you to explain the significance of this clearly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O extremely learned one, we wish to hear this in de¬ tail. It behoves you to explain the significance of this clearly.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रहीनां तु यः कुर्याद् भक्तिं देवस्य भारत । स विडम्बति चात्मानं पशुकीटपतङ्गवत्
verses.transliteration: mantrahīnāṃ tu yaḥ kuryād bhaktiṃ devasya bhārata / sa viḍambati cātmānaṃ paśukīṭapataṅgavat
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the sages, Suta, the seer of reality, said in accordance with the questions and the desire in the minds of the sages. I shall describe to you (in detail) what I have heard (regaxding Sraddha), in accordance with my intellectual ability. In every Manvantara, Pitrs are born as the sons of Devas.'
verses.hindi: बनाया । ऋतुओं, मास, ऋतुओं में होनेवाले कार्य विशेष पक्ष, विपक्ष, (?) मुहर्त, पर्वों, कला, काष्ठा आदि के प्रमाण, दोनों अयनों की गणित एवं योग का स्वामी संवस्सर को बनाया । तदनन्तर प्रजापति ने पृबंदिशा में सुविर्यात रज के पुत्र सुधामा को राजा बनाया। परदिचम दिशा में रज के पुत्र महात्मा केतुमान अच्युत को राजा के पद पर अभिषिक्त किया । तदनन्तर मनुष्यों का अधिपति सुय्यंपुत्र मनु को बनाया। आज भी ये अधिपति गण इन सातों द्वीपों एवं नगरादि से समस्वित समस्त प्रथ्वी मण्डल में अपने-अपने प्रदेशों में धर्म पूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of the sages, Suta, the seer of reality, said in accordance with the questions and the desire in the minds of the sages. I shall describe to you (in detail) what I have heard (regaxding Sraddha), in accordance with my intellectual ability.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the sages, Suta, the seer of reality, said in accordance with the questions and the desire in the minds of the sages. I shall describe to you (in detail) what I have heard (regaxding Sraddha), in accordance with my intellectual ability.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित् त्यजते देहमुत्तमम् । स गतस्तत्र देवैस्तु पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścit tyajate dehamuttamam / sa gatastatra devaistu pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: In the past and the future Manvantaras, they are respectively the eldest and the youngest. I shall precisely recount the Pitrs who have gone in the past Manvantaras along with Devas and who exist at present,
verses.hindi: स्वायंधुवेडन्तरे पु ब्रह्मगा तेडभिषेचिता:। न॒पा होतेडइभिषिच्यन्ते मनवो ये भवन्ति वे (१९ मन्वन्तरेष्वतीतेषु मता होतेषु पाथिवा:। एवमन्येडभिषिच्यन्ते प्राप्ते सन्‍्वन्तरे पुनः ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: In the past and the future Manvantaras, they are respectively the eldest and the youngest. I shall precisely recount the Pitrs who have gone in the past Manvantaras along with Devas and who exist at present,
verses.commentary: Sense: In the past and the future Manvantaras, they are respectively the eldest and the youngest. I shall precisely recount the Pitrs who have gone in the past Manvantaras along with Devas and who exist at present,

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छया सुचिरं कालमिह लोके नृपो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: svecchayā suciraṃ kālamiha loke nṛpo bhavet
verses.translation: They were cursed by Brahma—"O deluded ones! You will all become devoid of sense." They did not know anything. Then the whole world became deluded. All of them bowed to god Brahma and implored him. In order to bless the worlds, the lord spoke to them again.
verses.hindi: राजसुयेडभिविक्तश्न प्रथुरेभिनरोत्तमे: । वेददृष्टेन विधिना कृतो राजा प्रतापवान् एतानुत्पाद पुत्रांस्तु प्रजासंतानकारणात् । पुनरेव महाभागः प्रजानां पतिरीश्वर: २२ कश्यपो गोत्रकासस्तु चचार परम तपः। पुत्रों गोत्रकरो मह्यं भवेतामित्यचिन्तयत्
verses.wordMeaning: They were cursed by Brahma—"O deluded ones! You will all become devoid of sense." They did not know anything. Then the whole world became deluded. All of them bowed to god Brahma and implored him. In order to bless the worlds, the lord spoke to them again.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were cursed by Brahma—"O deluded ones! You will all become devoid of sense." They did not know anything. Then the whole world became deluded. All of them bowed to god Brahma and implored him. In order to bless the worlds, the lord spoke to them again.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्तो हस्त्यश्वरथसङ्कुलः । दासीदासशतोपेतो जायते विपुले कुले
verses.transliteration: putrapautrasamāyukto hastyaśvarathasaṅkulaḥ / dāsīdāsaśatopeto jāyate vipule kule
verses.translation: "Perform expiatory rites for the transgression which has been committed. Ask your sons and therefrom you will attain knowledge."
verses.hindi: तस्य प्रध्यायमानस्य कश्यपस्य महात्मनः । ब्रह्मणोंइशौ सुतौ पश्चात्प्रादुभेतो महोजसो २४ वत्सारभश्रासितश्चव तावुभो ब्रह्मवादिनौ । वत्साराक्षिश्लुवों जज्ञे रेभ्यश्न स महायशाः
verses.wordMeaning: "Perform expiatory rites for the transgression which has been committed. Ask your sons and therefrom you will attain knowledge."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Perform expiatory rites for the transgression which has been committed. Ask your sons and therefrom you will attain knowledge."

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रवितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चविंशत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र परं तीर्थमयोनिजम् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र न पश्येद् योनिसङ्कटम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ravitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 126 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra paraṃ tīrthamayonijam / snātamātro narastatra na paśyed yonisaṅkaṭam
verses.translation: Desirous of knowing (the procedure of) expiatory rites, Devas controlled themselves duly and asked their own sons mutually.
verses.hindi: शाण्डिल्यानां बचः श्रुत्वा देवलः सुमहायशाः । निश्चुवाः शण्डिला रेभ्ययास्र: पश्चात्तु कश्यपा: प्रजापालन करते हैं ।१४-१८। पूर्वकाल में स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तर में ब्रह्मा ने इन सबों को राज्यपद पर अभिषिक्त किया था, प्रत्येक मन्वन्तरों में जो मनु होते हैं, वे ही राज्यपद पर अभिषिक्‍त होते हैं। इन व्यतीत मन्वम्तरों में कितने राजागण बीत च॒के हैं। इसी प्रकार भावी मन्वन्तरों के आने पर अन्यान्य अभिषिक्त किये जायेंगे । जितने भूतकालीम एवं भविष्यत्कालीन मन्वन्तरों में होनेवाले राजा लोग हैं, वे सब मन्वन्तरों के अधीश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of knowing (the procedure of) expiatory rites, Devas controlled themselves duly and asked their own sons mutually.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of knowing (the procedure of) expiatory rites, Devas controlled themselves duly and asked their own sons mutually.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयेद् देवमीश्वरम् । अयोनिजो महादेव यथा त्वं परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayed devamīśvaram / ayonijo mahādeva yathā tvaṃ parameśvara
verses.translation: Those sons who were conversant with real Dharma and possessed self-control, explained to them the various modes of expiatory rites—verbal, mental and physical.
verses.hindi: कहे जाते हैं । इन्हीं नरपतियो ने प्रतापशाली राजा पृथु को वेदविहित विधि से राजसूय यज्ञ के अवसर पर राजा के पद पर अभिषिक्‍त किया । समस्त प्रजाओं के स्वामी परम ऐश्वयंवान् कश्यप ने प्रजावृद्धि के लिये इन पृत्रों को उत्पन्न कर पुनः पुत्र कामना से परम कठोर तप करना प्रारम्भ किया और यह चिन्तन किया कि मेरे दो गोत्रवृद्धि करनेवाले पुत्र उत्पन्न हों !8-२३। इस प्रकार कश्यप के विशेष मनोयोग पूर्वक ध्यानावस्थित
verses.wordMeaning: Those sons who were conversant with real Dharma and possessed self-control, explained to them the various modes of expiatory rites—verbal, mental and physical.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those sons who were conversant with real Dharma and possessed self-control, explained to them the various modes of expiatory rites—verbal, mental and physical.

verses.sanskrit: तथा मोचय मां देव सम्भवाद् योनिसङ्कटात् । गन्धपुष्पादिधूपैश्च स मुच्येत् सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: tathā mocaya māṃ deva sambhavād yonisaṅkaṭāt / gandhapuṣpādidhūpaiśca sa mucyet sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: The heaven-dwellers who regained their senses became delighted and spoke to their sons—"You are our fathers (Pitrs), since we are enlightened by you. What boon should be granted— virtue, knowledge or love?".
verses.hindi: होने पर महात्मा कदयप के ब्रह्मा के अंशभूत दो महातेजस्वी पुत्र उत्पन्न हुये । उनके नाम वत्सार जो असित थे, दो के दोनों ही ब्रह्मचिन्तन में लीन रहनेवाले थे  वत्सार से निश्चव एवं महान् यशस्वी रैभ्य का जन्म हुआ, रेम्य की सन्ततियों को रैभ्यगण नाम से जानना चाहिए, निध्रव की सन्‍्ततियों का विवरण सुनिये । च्यवन से सुकन्या में सुमेधा की उत्पत्ति हुई ।२४-२६। निश्चव की जो पत्नी थी वह कुण्डपायिगणों की माता थी । असित से एकपर्णा नामक पललनी में ब्रह्िष्ठ का जन्म हुआ। शॉंडिल्यों की बातें सुनकर देवल परमयशस्वी हुये । निध्रूवगण, शाण्डिल्यगण और रेम्यगण--ये तीनों कश्यपगोत्रीय थे। ये बर प्रभूति देवगण देवल की
verses.wordMeaning: The heaven-dwellers who regained their senses became delighted and spoke to their sons—"You are our fathers (Pitrs), since we are enlightened by you. What boon should be granted— virtue, knowledge or love?".
verses.commentary: Sense: The heaven-dwellers who regained their senses became delighted and spoke to their sons—"You are our fathers (Pitrs), since we are enlightened by you. What boon should be granted— virtue, knowledge or love?".

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवस्य यो भक्त्या कुरुते लिङ्गपूरणम् । स वसेद्देवदेवस्य यावत्सिक्थस्य संख्यया
verses.transliteration: tasya devasya yo bhaktyā kurute liṅgapūraṇam / sa vaseddevadevasya yāvatsikthasya saṃkhyayā
verses.translation: Then Brahma spoke to them—"You are the speakers of truth. Hence what is spoken by you shall be so and not otherwise.
verses.hindi: धरप्रभुतयो देवा देवलस्य प्रजास्त्विमाः । चतुर्युगे त्वतिक्रान्ते मनोह्येंकादशे प्रजा: ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma spoke to them—"You are the speakers of truth. Hence what is spoken by you shall be so and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma spoke to them—"You are the speakers of truth. Hence what is spoken by you shall be so and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: अयोनिजे महादेवं स्नापयेद् गन्धवारिणा । मधुक्षीरेण दध्ना वा स लभेद् विपुलां श्रियम्
verses.transliteration: ayonije mahādevaṃ snāpayed gandhavāriṇā / madhukṣīreṇa dadhnā vā sa labhed vipulāṃ śriyam
verses.translation: This is what is uttered by you—your own sons have been mentioned by you as your Pitrs (fathers;. They will be your Pitrs. Let this boon be given to them."
verses.hindi: त्रेतायुगमुखे राजा तृतीये संब॒भूव ह्। तस्य कन्या त्विडिविला रूपेणाप्रतिमाइभवत् ॥। ऋषिरिडिबिलायां तु विश्ववा: समपद्यत । तस्य पत्न्यश्रतस्नस्तु पौलस्त्यकुलवंधेनाः
verses.wordMeaning: This is what is uttered by you—your own sons have been mentioned by you as your Pitrs (fathers;. They will be your Pitrs. Let this boon be given to them."
verses.commentary: Sense: This is what is uttered by you—your own sons have been mentioned by you as your Pitrs (fathers;. They will be your Pitrs. Let this boon be given to them."

verses.sanskrit: अष्टभ्यां च सिते पक्षे असितां वा चतुर्दशीम् । पूजयित्वा महादेवं प्रीणयेद् गीतवाद्यकैः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭabhyāṃ ca site pakṣe asitāṃ vā caturdaśīm / pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ prīṇayed gītavādyakaiḥ
verses.translation: On account of the words of Brahma, Paramesthin, the sons (Pitrs) attained the status of fathers (of Devas) and Devas, the real fathers, the status of sons.
verses.hindi: ब्रहस्पतेब्हत्कीतिदंबाचायंस्प कीतिता । कन्यां तस्थोपयेमे स नाम्ना वे देववरणिनोम् ॥३ ३
verses.wordMeaning: On account of the words of Brahma, Paramesthin, the sons (Pitrs) attained the status of fathers (of Devas) and Devas, the real fathers, the status of sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of the words of Brahma, Paramesthin, the sons (Pitrs) attained the status of fathers (of Devas) and Devas, the real fathers, the status of sons.

verses.sanskrit: वसेत्स च शिवे लोके ये कुर्वन्ति मनोहरम् । ते वसन्ति शिवे लोके यावद् आभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: vasetsa ca śive loke ye kurvanti manoharam / te vasanti śive loke yāvad ābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: Hence it is declared (in Dharma-Sastra) that the sons (of Devas) are Pitrs and the status of Pitr-hood is proclai¬ med about them.
verses.hindi: पुष्पोत्कटां च वाकां च सुते माल्यव॒तः स्थिते । कंकसी मालिनः कन्यां तासां तु शूणुत प्रजा: 0३४ ज्येष्ठ वैश्ववर्ण तस्य सुषुवे देववर्णिनी । दिव्येन विधिना युक्तमार्षणैव श्रुतेन च ॥। राक्षसेन च रूपेण आसुरेण बलिन च ३५ त्रिपादं सुमहाकाय॑ स्थलशीर्ष महातनुम् । अष्टदंष्ट्रें हरिच्छमश्रुं शइःकुकर्णावलेहितम् ३३६
verses.wordMeaning: Hence it is declared (in Dharma-Sastra) that the sons (of Devas) are Pitrs and the status of Pitr-hood is proclai¬ med about them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence it is declared (in Dharma-Sastra) that the sons (of Devas) are Pitrs and the status of Pitr-hood is proclai¬ med about them.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवस्य भक्त्या तु यः करोति प्रदक्षिणाम् । विज्ञापयंश्च सततं मन्त्रेणानेन भारत
verses.transliteration: tasya devasya bhaktyā tu yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām / vijñāpayaṃśca satataṃ mantreṇānena bhārata
verses.translation: "If anyone will perform any holy rite without worship¬ ping Pitrs in a Sraddha, Raksasas and Danavas will obtain the fruit (good results) thereof.
verses.hindi: सन्ततियाँ हैं। “मनु' के ग्यारहवें चतुर्यग के व्यतीत हो जाते पर अर्थात् ग्यारहबार चारों युगों के व्यतीत हो जाने पर, जब द्वापर युग शेष रह जाता है, तब उसमें इन प्रजाओं (१) की सृष्टि हुई”
verses.wordMeaning: "If anyone will perform any holy rite without worship¬ ping Pitrs in a Sraddha, Raksasas and Danavas will obtain the fruit (good results) thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: "If anyone will perform any holy rite without worship¬ ping Pitrs in a Sraddha, Raksasas and Danavas will obtain the fruit (good results) thereof.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य यत्फलमुद्दिष्टं पारम्पर्येण मानवैः । सकाशाद्देवदेवस्य तच्छृणुष्व समाधिना
verses.transliteration: tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ pāramparyeṇa mānavaiḥ / sakāśāddevadevasya tacchṛṇuṣva samādhinā
verses.translation: The Pitrs propitiated and developed by means of Sraddhas (develop) the imperishable Soma. Propitiated and developed by you all, they will always increase.
verses.hindi: मानस के पुत्र रिष्यन्त हुये और उनके पुत्र दम नाम से विख्यात हुये । उनके भी पुत्र मानस कहे गये, जो तृणविन्दु नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुये । तीसरे त्रेतायुग के प्रारम्भिक काल में वह राज्यपद पर प्रतिष्ठित था । उसकी कन्या इडिविला अपने सौन्दर्भ में अनृपम थी! राजषि ने अपनी उस कन्या को पुलस्त्य, को समर्पित किया ।३०-३१। इडिविला में ऋषि विश्रववा की उत्पत्ति हुईं। उनकी चार पत्नियाँ थीं. जो पुलस्त्य वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले ऋषिओं की वंश वृद्धि कुरनेवाली हुईं। देवाचार्य बृहस्पति की एक परम यशस्विनी कन्या थी, उसका नाम था देवव्णिनी । बृहस्पति की उस कन्या के साथ उसने (विश्ववा ने) विवाह किया माल्थवान् की पुष्पोत्कटा और वाका नामक कन्याओं के साथ भी उसमे विवाह किया तथा माली की ककसी नामक कन्या को भी विवाहा। उन सबों में उत्पन्न होनेवाली प्रजाओं को घुनिये । सब से ज्येष्ठ वेश्रवण (कुबेर) को देव णिनी
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitrs propitiated and developed by means of Sraddhas (develop) the imperishable Soma. Propitiated and developed by you all, they will always increase.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitrs propitiated and developed by means of Sraddhas (develop) the imperishable Soma. Propitiated and developed by you all, they will always increase.

verses.sanskrit: अयोनिजो महादेव यथा त्वं परमेश्वर । तथा मोचय मां शर्व सम्भवाद्योनिसङ्कटात्
verses.transliteration: ayonijo mahādeva yathā tvaṃ parameśvara / tathā mocaya māṃ śarva sambhavādyonisaṅkaṭāt
verses.translation: Soma (the Moon-god) strengthened and developed by means of Sraddhas, will develop the people and the entire world, along with mountains and forests surrounded ( = inhabi¬ ted) by mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: ने उत्पन्न किया ।३४-३४१। उसका विधान देवताओं का था, श्रुतिज्ञान ऋषियों का था, रूप राक्षसों का था, बल अधुरो का था, तीन चरण थे, विशाल शरीर था, झिर बहुत बड़ा था, आठ दंत थे, दाढ़ी हरे वर्ण की थी, कान खूँटे की तरह थे, लाल वर्ण था, एक बाहु छोटा और एक-बहुत बड़ा था। देखने में
verses.wordMeaning: Soma (the Moon-god) strengthened and developed by means of Sraddhas, will develop the people and the entire world, along with mountains and forests surrounded ( = inhabi¬ ted) by mobile and immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Soma (the Moon-god) strengthened and developed by means of Sraddhas, will develop the people and the entire world, along with mountains and forests surrounded ( = inhabi¬ ted) by mobile and immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: किं तस्य बहुभिर्मन्त्रैः कंठशोषणतत्परैः । येनौंनमः शिवायेति प्रोक्तं देवस्य संनिधौ
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantraiḥ kaṃṭhaśoṣaṇatatparaiḥ / yenauṃnamaḥ śivāyeti proktaṃ devasya saṃnidhau
verses.translation: Those men, who, desirous of nourishment, perform Sraddhas are always granted development and progeny by Pitrs.
verses.hindi: १. यह अप्रासंगिक अंज्ष प्रक्षिप्त जान पड़ता है, बंगला प्रति में इसका पाठ नहीं है। पर आनन्दश्रम की प्रति ही यतः हमारे सामने आदर्श रूप में थी, अतः शाब्दिक अनुवाद मात्र कर दिया यथा; पर संगति नहीं बैठती । यस्माद्विश्रवसो5पत्यं सादृश्याद्विश्रवा इव । तस्मावेश्ववणों नाम नाम्ता लोके भविष्यति १४० ऋद्धचां कुबेरोइजनयद्विभुतं जलकूबरम् । रावण कुस्भकर्ण च कन्यां शुपंणद्षां तथा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Those men, who, desirous of nourishment, perform Sraddhas are always granted development and progeny by Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those men, who, desirous of nourishment, perform Sraddhas are always granted development and progeny by Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाधीतं श्रुतं तेन तेन सर्वमनुष्ठितम् । येनौंनमः शिवायेति मन्त्राभ्यासः स्थिरीकृतः
verses.transliteration: tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam / yenauṃnamaḥ śivāyeti mantrābhyāsaḥ sthirīkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Those (Pitrs) to whom they (the performers of Sraddha) offer three balls of rice ( Pinzas ) mentioning their names and Gotraupto great-grandfather, they (Pitrs) who are present (everywhere), strengthen and develop their progeny by that offering of Sraddha."
verses.hindi: बिभीषणचतुर्थास्तान्केकस्यजनयत्सुताम् ॥४ १ शड्कुकर्णो दशग्रीवः पिड्भलो रक्तमृर्धंज:  चतुष्पाद्रिशतिभुजो महाकायो महाबलः ४२ जात्याइञ्जननिभो दंष्ट्री लोहितग्रीव एवं च। राजसेनो यथा युक्तो रूपेण च बलेन च ४३
verses.wordMeaning: Those (Pitrs) to whom they (the performers of Sraddha) offer three balls of rice ( Pinzas ) mentioning their names and Gotraupto great-grandfather, they (Pitrs) who are present (everywhere), strengthen and develop their progeny by that offering of Sraddha."
verses.commentary: Sense: Those (Pitrs) to whom they (the performers of Sraddha) offer three balls of rice ( Pinzas ) mentioning their names and Gotraupto great-grandfather, they (Pitrs) who are present (everywhere), strengthen and develop their progeny by that offering of Sraddha."

verses.sanskrit: न तत्फलमवाप्नोति सर्वदेवेषु वै द्विजः । यत्फलं समवाप्नोति षडक्षर उदीरणात्
verses.transliteration: na tatphalamavāpnoti sarvadeveṣu vai dvijaḥ / yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ṣaḍakṣara udīraṇāt
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that Pitrs grant you perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यकशिपुस्त्वासीत्स राजा पुर्वजन्मनि । चतुर्युगानि (णि) राजा5त्र त्रयोदश स राक्षसः. ताः पत्च कोटबो वर्षाणामाख्याता: संख्यया द्विजे: । नियुतान्येकषष्टिश्न संस्याविख्दिरद्राहत
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that Pitrs grant you perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that Pitrs grant you perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेच्छिवयोगिनम् । द्विजानामयुतं साग्रं स लभेत् फलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayecchivayoginam / dvijānāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ sa labhet phalamuttamam
verses.translation: After hearing these words of Suta possessing self- knowledge, the sages asked him again subsequently:
verses.hindi: षष्ठि शतसहस्राणि वर्षाणां तु स रावण: । देवतानामृषीणां च घोरं कृत्बा प्रजागरभ् ४७
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing these words of Suta possessing self- knowledge, the sages asked him again subsequently:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing these words of Suta possessing self- knowledge, the sages asked him again subsequently:

verses.sanskrit: अथवा भक्तियुक्तस्तु तेषां दान्ते जितेन्द्रिये । संस्कृत्य ददते भिक्षां फलं तस्य ततो ऽधिकम्
verses.transliteration: athavā bhaktiyuktastu teṣāṃ dānte jitendriye / saṃskṛtya dadate bhikṣāṃ phalaṃ tasya tato 'dhikam
verses.translation: How many are the groups of these Pitrs? At what time did those groups (come into existence)—Pitrs who were the excellent ancestors of Devas and who developed and strengthened Soma? I shall recount to you the most excellent creation of Pitrs. This is the same question which had been formerly put to his father Brhaspati by Sarhyu.
verses.hindi: पीले वर्ण का तथा परमभयानक लगता था। उसे जगत् की माया आदि का पूर्ण ज्ञान था, ज्ञान सम्पत्ति से पूर्ण समृद्ध था, इस प्रकार के विश्वरूप धारी पुत्र को देखकर पिता ने कहा, यह स्वयं कुबेर है, कुशब्द कुत्सित अर्थ का वाची है, अर्थात् कु के अं होते हैं भद्दा, और बेर शरीर को कहते हैं, यतः इसका बेर (शरीर) कुत्सित (देखने में भद्दा) है अतः कुबेर नाम से यह अभिहित किया गया। यत: यह विश्ववा का पुत्र है ओर उसकी आति भी विश्ववा ही के समान है, अतः लोक में वेश्रवण के नाम से इसकी ख्याति होगी
verses.wordMeaning: How many are the groups of these Pitrs? At what time did those groups (come into existence)—Pitrs who were the excellent ancestors of Devas and who developed and strengthened Soma? I shall recount to you the most excellent creation of Pitrs.…
verses.commentary: Sense: How many are the groups of these Pitrs? At what time did those groups (come into existence)—Pitrs who were the excellent ancestors of Devas and who developed and strengthened Soma? I shall recount to you the most excellent creation of Pitrs.…

verses.sanskrit: यतिहस्ते जलं दद्याद् भिक्षां दत्त्वा पुनर्जलम् । सा भिक्षा मेरुणा तुल्या तज्जलं सागरोपमम्
verses.transliteration: yatihaste jalaṃ dadyād bhikṣāṃ dattvā punarjalam / sā bhikṣā meruṇā tulyā tajjalaṃ sāgaropamam
verses.translation: As Brhaspati, the great expertin all fields of knowledge, was seated, his son Sarhyu endowed with humility, put this question.
verses.hindi: कुबेर ने ऋद्धि नाम पत्नी में नलकूबर को उत्पन्न किया, जो परम विख्यात हुआ। इसके अतिरिक्त कैसी ने रावण, कुम्भकर्ण, शूपर्णला तथा विभीषण--इन चार सन्‍्ततियों को जन्म दिया। उस रावण का कान खूँटे की भाँति था, दस उसके कण्ठ थे, पिगल वर्ण का था, बाल लाल रंग के थे, जन्म से ही कज्जल के समान काला था, बड़े-बड़े दाँत थे, कण्ठ प्रदेश लाल रंग का था, रूप और बल से समन्वित था, उसकी सेना
verses.wordMeaning: As Brhaspati, the great expertin all fields of knowledge, was seated, his son Sarhyu endowed with humility, put this question.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Brhaspati, the great expertin all fields of knowledge, was seated, his son Sarhyu endowed with humility, put this question.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अयोनिप्रभवतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षड्विंशत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२७ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् तु राजेन्द्र अग्नितीर्थमनुत्तमम् । तत्र स्नात्वा तु पक्षादौ मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ayoniprabhavatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 127 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra agnitīrthamanuttamam / tatra snātvā tu pakṣādau mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: "Who are these Pitrs? What are their names? How were they born? How did they attain Pitr-hood?
verses.hindi: यथार्थंतः बलवान थी, सत्य बुद्धि था, शरीर दुढ़ था, सबंदा राक्षसों से ही युक्त रहता था, स्वभाव से ही वह परम दारुण, एवं क्र था, बहुत जोर से रव (शब्द) करने के कारण वह रावण नाम से विख्यात था पूर्व जन्म में वह हिरण्यकशिपु नाम से देत्यों का राजा था वह राक्षसराज चारों युगों तक राज्य करता रहा भोर राक्षसों के राजाओं में बह तेरहवाँ था (?) उसके राज्य काल की अवधि संख्या जाननेवाले पण्डितों ने पाँच करोड़ इकसठ नियत (?) बतलाया है। साठ लाख वर्षों तक वह रावण देवताओं और ऋषियों
verses.wordMeaning: "Who are these Pitrs? What are their names? How were they born? How did they attain Pitr-hood?
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who are these Pitrs? What are their names? How were they born? How did they attain Pitr-hood?

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कन्यां दद्यात् स्वयमलंकृताम् । तस्य यत्फलमुद्दिष्टं तच्छृणुष्व नरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dadyāt svayamalaṃkṛtām / tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narottama
verses.translation: What is the reason for which Pitrs are worshipped at the outset in every Yajna? All the holy rites of noble souls begin with the performance of Sraddhas.
verses.hindi: त्रिशिरा दूषणश्चेव विद्युज्जिह्श्व राक्षसः  कन्या ह्यसलिका चेव वाकाया:ः प्रसवाः सस्‍्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: What is the reason for which Pitrs are worshipped at the outset in every Yajna? All the holy rites of noble souls begin with the performance of Sraddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is the reason for which Pitrs are worshipped at the outset in every Yajna? All the holy rites of noble souls begin with the performance of Sraddhas.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां शतं शतगुणीकृतम् । प्राप्नोति पुरुषो दत्त्वा यथाशक्त्या ह्यलंकृताम्
verses.transliteration: agniṣṭomātirātrābhyāṃ śataṃ śataguṇīkṛtam / prāpnoti puruṣo dattvā yathāśaktyā hyalaṃkṛtām
verses.translation: To whom all these Sraddhas are to be offered? What is the great benefit when they are offered? In which of the holy centres and sacred rivers does the Sraddha performance yield ever-lasting benefit?
verses.hindi: इत्येते ऋरकर्माणः पौलस्त्या राक्षणा दश । दारुणाभिजना: सर्वे देवरपि दुरासदाः ५१ आमस्त्यवेश्वामित्रा्णां क््राणां ब्रह्मरक्षसाम् । वेदाध्ययनशीलानां तपोन्नत निषेदिणाम्  ५३ तेषामैडविलो राजा पौलस्त्यः सव्यपिड्भलः । इतरे वे यज्ञमुखास्तेम रक्षोगणास्त्रथः ३४४ यातुधाना ब्रह्मधाना वार्ताश्वव दिवाचराः । निशाच रगणास्तेषां चत्वार: कविभिः स्वृताः
verses.wordMeaning: To whom all these Sraddhas are to be offered? What is the great benefit when they are offered? In which of the holy centres and sacred rivers does the Sraddha performance yield ever-lasting benefit?
verses.commentary: Sense: To whom all these Sraddhas are to be offered? What is the great benefit when they are offered? In which of the holy centres and sacred rivers does the Sraddha performance yield ever-lasting benefit?

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः पुत्रप्रपौत्राणां या भवेद् रोमसंगतिः । स याति तेन मानेन शिवलोके परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ putraprapautrāṇāṃ yā bhaved romasaṃgatiḥ / sa yāti tena mānena śivaloke parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: What are those holy centres in Which excellent Brahmanas (ought to) perform Sraddha to obtain all (desired) benefits? What is the (proper) time for Sraddha? What is the procedure to be followed?
verses.hindi: पौलस्त्या ने ऋताश्चेब आगस्त्या: कौशिकास्तथा । इत्येताः सप्त तेषां वे जातयो राक्षसाः स्प्ृता:
verses.wordMeaning: What are those holy centres in Which excellent Brahmanas (ought to) perform Sraddha to obtain all (desired) benefits? What is the (proper) time for Sraddha? What is the procedure to be followed?
verses.commentary: Sense: What are those holy centres in Which excellent Brahmanas (ought to) perform Sraddha to obtain all (desired) benefits? What is the (proper) time for Sraddha? What is the procedure to be followed?

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अग्नितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तविंशत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२८ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र भृकुटेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धो महाभागो भृगुः परमकोपनः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe agnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 128 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra bhṛkuṭeśvaram uttamam / yatra siddho mahābhāgo bhṛguḥ paramakopanaḥ
verses.translation: O holy sire, I wish that what has been enquired by me be explained in detail in the proper sequence."
verses.hindi: नेषां रूप प्रवक््यामि स्वभावेन व्यवस्थितम् । वृत्ताक्षाः पिड्धलाश्चेब महाकाया महोदरा: ५७ अष्टदंष्टा: शडकुकर्णा ऊध्वंरोमाण एवं च। आकर्णदारितास्याश्व घुछ्जधुमोध्व॑युर्धजाः ५८ ॒/7.7.ह... ट॒ाघिपापतपापतखपपप प/८/भएई/ह/फ/झ।ै।
verses.wordMeaning: O holy sire, I wish that what has been enquired by me be explained in detail in the proper sequence."
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy sire, I wish that what has been enquired by me be explained in detail in the proper sequence."

verses.sanskrit: तेन वर्षशतं साग्रं तपश्चीर्णं पुरानघ । पुत्रार्थं वरयामास पुत्रं पुत्रवतां वरः
verses.transliteration: tena varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha / putrārthaṃ varayāmāsa putraṃ putravatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Verses 20-34 explain the paradox why Pitrs who were the sons of Devas became the fathers of their own fathers? Manu III. 201, however, differs and states that Pitrs sprang from Sages and from Pitrs were born Devas (gods) and human beings.
verses.hindi: को खूब जगाकर अर्थात् अति कष्ट देकर चौबीस त्रेता युग में अपनी तपस्या के नष्ट हो जाने पर दशरथपुत्र रामचन्द्र के हाथों सैन्य समेत विनष्ट हुआ ४५०४८। पृष्पोत्कट के महोदर, प्रहस्त, महारपाँगु, और खर नामक पुत्र तथा कुम्भीनसी नामक कन्या उत्पन्न हुई । वाका को सन्ततियों में त्रिशिरा, दूषण, विद्युज्जिल्न राक्षत नामक पुत्र तथा असलिका नामक कन्या सुप्रसिद्ध हैं। ये उपर्यक्त दस पुलस्त्य के वंश के ऋरकम करनेवाले राक्षस
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 20-34 explain the paradox why Pitrs who were the sons of Devas became the fathers of their own fathers? Manu III. 201, however, differs and states that Pitrs sprang from Sages and from Pitrs were born Devas (gods) and human beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 20-34 explain the paradox why Pitrs who were the sons of Devas became the fathers of their own fathers? Manu III. 201, however, differs and states that Pitrs sprang from Sages and from Pitrs were born Devas (gods) and human beings.

verses.sanskrit: वरो दत्तो महाभाग देवेनान्धकघातिना । तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: varo datto mahābhāga devenāndhakaghātinā / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram
verses.translation: On being asked thus clearly and specifically, the highly intelligent Brhaspati, the most excellent of those who understand (the implications of) questions, answered all the questions in the proper order.
verses.hindi: जो घोर आवास' स्थानों में निवास करनेवाले तथा देवताओं से भी दुर्दम्य थे । इडविला के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाला महपिपुलस्त्य का गोत्रीय, बाये अंग में पिगलवर्ण वाला वह कुबेर सभी यक्षों का, पुलस्त्य गोत्र में उत्पन्न होनेवाले समस्त राक्षसों का, तथा अगस्त्या और विश्वामित्र के गोत्र में उत्पन्न हौनेवाले वेदाध्यायी, तपस्या ब्रत आदि में निष्ठा रखनेवाले किन्तु क्ररकर्मा ब्रह्मराक्षमों का राजा था । अन्य राक्षस गण यज्ञमुख हैं, इस प्रकार ये तीन प्रह्नार के कहे जाते हैं। यातृधान, ब्रह्मधान, और वरता--ये दिन में गमन करने वाले हैं। कवियों ने इन तीनों के अतिरिक्त निशाचर गणों को चौथे राक्षस गणों में स्मरण किया है ।४६-५५४। पुलस्त्य के गोत्र में उत्पन्न होनेवाले ने ऋ त, अगस्त्य गोत्रीय, तथा कौशिऊ विश्वामित्र गोत्रीय--ये सब सात प्रकार वी राक्षसों की भिन्न-भिन्न जातियाँ कही गई हैं। इन सबों के स्वभाव गत स्वरूप का वर्णन कर
verses.wordMeaning: On being asked thus clearly and specifically, the highly intelligent Brhaspati, the most excellent of those who understand (the implications of) questions, answered all the questions in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked thus clearly and specifically, the highly intelligent Brhaspati, the most excellent of those who understand (the implications of) questions, answered all the questions in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलमष्टगुणं लभेत् । भृकुटेशं तु यः कश्चिद् घृतेन मधुना सह
verses.transliteration: agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet / bhṛkuṭeśaṃ tu yaḥ kaścid ghṛtena madhunā saha
verses.translation: O dear one! I shall explain the solemn excellent question which you ask me with due propriety and proper humility.
verses.hindi: रहा हूं । ये राक्षस गण गोली आँखों वाले पिगलवर्ण, महाकाय, विशाल उदर, आठदाँत, हंकु के समान कान वाले एवं ऊध्वरोमा थे । उनके मुख कान तक फटे हुये थे. किसी-किसी के बाल मूँज के समान तथा किसी-किसी के धुएँ के समान थे । शिर बहुत बड़े थे, देखने में किसी किसी की शोभा स्वेतवर्ण की मालूम पड़ती थी।॥
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one! I shall explain the solemn excellent question which you ask me with due propriety and proper humility.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one! I shall explain the solemn excellent question which you ask me with due propriety and proper humility.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थी स्नापयेद् भक्त्या स लभेत् पुत्रमीप्सितम् । तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा दद्याद् विप्राय काञ्चनम्
verses.transliteration: putrārthī snāpayed bhaktyā sa labhet putramīpsitam / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā dadyād viprāya kāñcanam
verses.translation: At that time, there was neither the heaven nor the firmament, neither the earth nor the stars nor the quarters, neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the day, nor the night. O dear, the whole Universe was in complete darkness. Brahma alone performed an austere penance difficult for others to perform.
verses.hindi: श्ष्द वायुपुराणम् स्थूलशीर्षा: सिताभाश्न ह्ृस्वकाश्र प्रबाहुका:। ताम्रास्या लम्बजिद्धीष्ठा लम्बअ्स्थुलनासिका:
verses.wordMeaning: At that time, there was neither the heaven nor the firmament, neither the earth nor the stars nor the quarters, neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the day, nor the night. O dear, the whole Universe was in complete darkness.…
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time, there was neither the heaven nor the firmament, neither the earth nor the stars nor the quarters, neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the day, nor the night. O dear, the whole Universe was in complete darkness.…

verses.sanskrit: गोदानं वा महीं वापि तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: godānaṃ vā mahīṃ vāpi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Samyu again spoke to his father who was the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman, who always performed holy ablutions in the form of rites and who was the most ex¬ cellent of all knowers of perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: नीलाख़ा लोहितप्रीवा गम्भीराक्षा बिभीषणा:। महाघोरस्वराश्चेब विकटा बद्धपिण्डिका:
verses.wordMeaning: Samyu again spoke to his father who was the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman, who always performed holy ablutions in the form of rites and who was the most ex¬ cellent of all knowers of perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Samyu again spoke to his father who was the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman, who always performed holy ablutions in the form of rites and who was the most ex¬ cellent of all knowers of perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ससमुद्रगुहा तेन सशैलवनकानना । दत्ता पृथ्वी न सन्देहस् तेन सर्वा नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā / dattā pṛthvī na sandehas tena sarvā nṛpottama
verses.translation: "What sort of a penance did Prajapati, the lord of all living beings perform?" Of all types of penance, Yukti i.e. Yoga penance is the most excellent. Meditating on it, the lord then created all the worlds by means of that Yoga.
verses.hindi: कोई-कोई बहुत छोटे थे और कोई बहुत बड़ी बड़ी बाहुओं वाले थे। किसी के मुख ताँबे के समान लाल ओर जिह्ला तथा भोंठ लम्बे-लम्बे थे। भौंहें लम्बी और नाकें मोटी थीं ।५६-५९। किसी के अंग नील वर्ण के थे, किसी की ग्रीवा लाल वर्ण की थी किसी की आँखें निश्चल तथा गंभीर थीं। देखने में परम भयानक थे । स्वर परम कठोर एवं दारुण थे। परम बिकट तथा समूह बाधकर चलने वाले थे। कोई-कोई परम स्थूलकाय, उठी हुई नासिका वाले, शिला के समान कठोर शरीर वाले एवं दृढ़ थे । ये सब राक्षस गण प्रायः अति दारुण निवास स्थल में रहनवाले तथा कठोर कर्मी थे। कुण्डल, अंगद तथा माला पहनते ये । मुकुट और पगड़ी बाँधते थे। विचित्र रंग के उनके वस्त्र थे, इसी प्रकार आभूषण, माला, चन्दनादि सब कुछ विचित्र थे। वे राक्षलगण अन्न भक्षण करते थे। माँस भी खाते थे यहाँ तक कि मनुष्यों तक को खा जाते थे--ऐसा लोग
verses.wordMeaning: "What sort of a penance did Prajapati, the lord of all living beings perform?" Of all types of penance, Yukti i.e. Yoga penance is the most excellent. Meditating on it, the lord then created all the worlds by means of that Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: "What sort of a penance did Prajapati, the lord of all living beings perform?" Of all types of penance, Yukti i.e. Yoga penance is the most excellent. Meditating on it, the lord then created all the worlds by means of that Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: तेन दानेन स स्वर्गे क्रीडयित्वा यथासुखम् । मर्त्ये भवति राजेन्द्रो ब्राह्मणो वा सुपूजितः
verses.transliteration: tena dānena sa svarge krīḍayitvā yathāsukham / martye bhavati rājendro brāhmaṇo vā supūjitaḥ
verses.translation: The past and future (items of) knowledge, the entire worlds and Vedas were created after practising Yoga by Brahma, by means of his Yogic vision.
verses.hindi: कहते हैं । पण्डित लोग उनके स्वरूप, शील, स्वभाव आदि के बारे में ऐसा ही स्मरण कहते हैं। उनके समस्त बल एवं पराक्रम का मान किसी को नहीं मालूम है, क्‍योंकि वे सब के सब मायादी हैं ।६०-६३। पुलह के पुत्र सभी प्रकार के मृग, व्याल एवं द॑ष्ट्रा धारी जीव हुये । इनके अतिरिक्त भूत पिशाचक्ष, सर्प, भ्रमर, हस्ती, वानर, किन्नर, मयूर, किपुरुष तथा अन्यान्य मायावी एवं सर्वदा क्रोध के वश में रहने वाले
verses.wordMeaning: The past and future (items of) knowledge, the entire worlds and Vedas were created after practising Yoga by Brahma, by means of his Yogic vision.
verses.commentary: Sense: The past and future (items of) knowledge, the entire worlds and Vedas were created after practising Yoga by Brahma, by means of his Yogic vision.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भृकुटेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टाविंशत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १२९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन् महीपाल ब्रह्मतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । अन्येषां चैव तीर्थानां परात्परतरं महत्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhṛkuṭeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 129 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchen mahīpāla brahmatīrthamanuttamam / anyeṣāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ parātparataraṃ mahat
verses.translation: The worlds, the heaven are named * Santanikas * where the shining deities of the Devas well-known as 'Vairajas* stay.
verses.hindi: जीव निकाय उत्पन्न हुये--वे सब पुलह की सन्‍्तति हैं। उस वेवस्वत मन्वन्तर में महर्षि क्रतु को ही कोई संतति नहीं थी ।न तो कोई पुत्र था, न पोन्न अपने तेज (बल ब्रह्मचयं) को समेट कर वे अपने आप में अवस्थित थे, भर्थात् नेष्ठिक ब्रह्मचारी थे ।६४-६६। अब तृतीय प्रजापति अन्रि के बंश का वर्णन कर रहा हूँ। उनकी + एतदधंस्थाने3पाठ:--प्रायोवल्योयः परिक्रास्तों मयाक्रोश वज्यान्वय इति ख. ग. घ. हू पुस्तकेषु ।
verses.wordMeaning: The worlds, the heaven are named * Santanikas * where the shining deities of the Devas well-known as 'Vairajas* stay.
verses.commentary: Sense: The worlds, the heaven are named * Santanikas * where the shining deities of the Devas well-known as 'Vairajas* stay.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे सुरश्रेष्ठो ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां नर्मदातटमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe suraśreṣṭho brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Even at the outset then, the lord Brahma, endowed with Yoga and penance, had created Devas after practising the eternal Yoga.
verses.hindi: आत्रेयवं शक्रत्तासां भर्ता नाम्ता प्रभाकर: । भद्रायां जनपामास सोम पुत्र यशस्विनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Even at the outset then, the lord Brahma, endowed with Yoga and penance, had created Devas after practising the eternal Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even at the outset then, the lord Brahma, endowed with Yoga and penance, had created Devas after practising the eternal Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मजं यत्पुराकृतम् । तत्क्षालयति देवेशो दर्शनाद् एव पातकम्
verses.transliteration: vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurākṛtam / tatkṣālayati deveśo darśanād eva pātakam
verses.translation: They are well known as Adidevas (the primordial Devas). They have great splendour and energy. They are the bestowers of all desires. They are worthy of being worshipped by Devas, Danavas and human beings.
verses.hindi: स्वभत्रिना हते सुर्ये पतमाने दिवो महीम् । तमोभिभृुते लोके5स्मिन्प्रभा येन प्रवरतिता १७१ स्वस्ति ते5स्त्विति चोक्तः स पतन्निह दिवाकरः  ब्रह्मषेंबंचनात्तस्य न पपात दिवो महीम् १७२ अन्निश्रेष्ठानि गोत्राणि यश्चथकार महातपाः । यज्ञेव्वत्रिघनश्चेव सुरयंश्व प्रवतितः (? ) ७३ सता स्वजनयत्पुत्रानात्मतुल्याननामकान् । दश तास्वेब महता तपसा भावितप्रभाः स्वस्त्यात्रया इति रख्याता ऋषयो वेदपारगाः । तेषां विख्यातयशसो ब्रह्मिष्ठों सुमहोजसौ १७५ दत्तात्रेयस्तस्य ज्येष्ठो दुर्वासास्तस्य चानुज:  यवीयसी सुता तस्यामबला ब्रह्मवादिनी ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: They are well known as Adidevas (the primordial Devas). They have great splendour and energy. They are the bestowers of all desires. They are worthy of being worshipped by Devas, Danavas and human beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are well known as Adidevas (the primordial Devas). They have great splendour and energy. They are the bestowers of all desires. They are worthy of being worshipped by Devas, Danavas and human beings.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितान्येव तत्र स्नात्वा द्विजर्षभाः । प्रायश्चित्तानि कुर्वन्ति तेषां वासस्त्रिविष्टपे
verses.transliteration: śrutismṛtyuditānyeva tatra snātvā dvijarṣabhāḥ / prāyaścittāni kurvanti teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape
verses.translation: There are seven groups of those Devas. They are worshipped by aJl the three worlds. Three of them are Arnurtis (devoid of forms) and four of them have splendid forms.
verses.hindi: अन्राप्युदाहरन्तीम श्लोक पौराणिका: पुरा
verses.wordMeaning: There are seven groups of those Devas. They are worshipped by aJl the three worlds. Three of them are Arnurtis (devoid of forms) and four of them have splendid forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are seven groups of those Devas. They are worshipped by aJl the three worlds. Three of them are Arnurtis (devoid of forms) and four of them have splendid forms.

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनः शास्त्रमुत्सृज्य कामलोभप्रपीडिताः । प्रायश्चित्तं वदिष्यन्ति ते वै निरयगामिनः
verses.transliteration: ye punaḥ śāstramutsṛjya kāmalobhaprapīḍitāḥ / prāyaścittaṃ vadiṣyanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ
verses.translation: The three sets which have conceptual forms (Bkava murlis) are stationed above. The four Suksmamurlis (having subtle forms) are stationed beneath them.
verses.hindi: अन्नेः पुत्र महात्मानं शान्तात्मानमकल्मषम् । दत्तात्रेयं तनुं विष्णो: पुराणज्ञाः प्रचक्षते ७७ दस स्त्रियाँ थी, जो सब परम सुन्दरी एवं पतिन्नता थीं। घृताची नामक अप्सरा में भद्राश्व को दस सन्ततियाँ उत्पन्न हुई । जिनके नाम थे, भद्वा, सूद्रा, अलदा, सलदा बेला, खला-ये सात तथा आठवीं गोचपला के नाम से विख्यात हुई। मानरसा नवीं और रत्नकूटा द।वीं सन्‍्तति थी। इन सब्रों का स्वामी एवं अत्रि के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवालों का गोत्रकर्ता प्रभाकर नाम से विख्यात था, उसने भद्गा में परम यशस्वी पुत्र सोम को उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: The three sets which have conceptual forms (Bkava murlis) are stationed above. The four Suksmamurlis (having subtle forms) are stationed beneath them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three sets which have conceptual forms (Bkava murlis) are stationed above. The four Suksmamurlis (having subtle forms) are stationed beneath them.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वादौ पातकी ब्रह्मन्नत्वा तु कीर्तयेद् अघम् । तस्य तन्नश्यते क्षिप्रं तमः सूर्योदये यथा
verses.transliteration: snātvādau pātakī brahmannatvā tu kīrtayed agham / tasya tannaśyate kṣipraṃ tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā
verses.translation: Thereafter, the (common) Devas are stationed and then the earth. This is the situation of the series of worlds. They (the groups of Devas) are stationed in this world The clouds take their origin from them, rain-showers are due to them and, thanks to rain-showers, the worlds (and people) are created again.
verses.hindi: किया ।६७ ७०। एकबार राहु द्वारा आहत होकर जब सूर्य आकाश से पृथ्वी की ओर गिरने लगे और यह समस्त भूलोक अन्वकार में आच्छन्न हो गया उस समय जिसने प्रकाश दान किया वह यही सोम थे आकाश मण्डल से इस पृथ्वी तल पर गिरते हुये दिवाकर को मह॒षि ने कहा कि तुम्हारा कल्याण हो । उनके इस आशीवंचन से वे आकाश से पृथ्वी पर नहीं गिरे। महातपस्वी अन्नि ने जिन श्रेष्ठ गोत्रों का प्रवत्तंन
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the (common) Devas are stationed and then the earth. This is the situation of the series of worlds. They (the groups of Devas) are stationed in this world The clouds take their origin from them, rain-showers are due to them and, thanks to rain-showers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the (common) Devas are stationed and then the earth. This is the situation of the series of worlds. They (the groups of Devas) are stationed in this world The clouds take their origin from them, rain-showers are due to them and, thanks to rain-showers,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् पितृदेवताः । अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य स लभेत् फलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet pitṛdevatāḥ / agniṣṭomasya yajñasya sa labhet phalamuttamam
verses.translation: Since they develop and strengthen the moon and the food-grains and make them flourish by means of Yogic power
verses.hindi: किया, ( उन्हें बता रहा हूँ ) देवताओं द्वारा जो प्रवरतित होना है--ऐसे यक्षों में ? (वे भाग प्राप्त करते हैं ) (?) उन दसों स्त्रियों में उसने अपने ही समान दस पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया, जिनके नाम नहीं ये । इन दसों स्त्रियों में उत्पन्न होनेवाले वे दस पुत्र गण अपनी महान् तपस्या के कारण परम कान्तिमान् थे, वेदों के पारगामी विद्वान थे, कल्याण दायी, भत्रि वंशोत्त्पन्न ऋषियों के रूप में विख्यात थे । उनके परम विख्यात यशस्वी, ब्रह्मवादी, महातैजस्वी दो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुये, जिनमें ज्येष्ठ दत्तात्रेय थे और दुर्वासा उनके अनुज थे । उसमें एक कनिष्ठ अबला नामक ब्रह्मवादिनी पुत्री थी। प्राचीन काल से पुराणों के जाननेवाले इस गौरव गाथा का गान करते आये हैं कि अत्रि के निष्पाप, शास्तक्षित्त, महात्मा पुत्र दत्तात्रेय भगवान् विष्णु के स्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: Since they develop and strengthen the moon and the food-grains and make them flourish by means of Yogic power
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they develop and strengthen the moon and the food-grains and make them flourish by means of Yogic power

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यद् दानं ब्रह्मोद्दिश्य प्रयच्छति । तदक्षयफलं सर्वमित्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yad dānaṃ brahmoddiśya prayacchati / tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: They are as speedy as mind. Svadhd constitutes their diet. They have every requisite they desire. They are devoid of greed, delusion and fear. They are certainly devoid of sorrow.
verses.hindi: तस्य गोन्रान्वये जाताभ्रत्वार:ः प्रथिता भुवि  श्यामाश्व मुदुगलाश्चव बलारकगविष्ठिराः ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: They are as speedy as mind. Svadhd constitutes their diet. They have every requisite they desire. They are devoid of greed, delusion and fear. They are certainly devoid of sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are as speedy as mind. Svadhd constitutes their diet. They have every requisite they desire. They are devoid of greed, delusion and fear. They are certainly devoid of sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीसारमात्रो ऽपि तत्र यः क्रियते जपः । ऋग्यजुःसामसहितः स भवेन्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: gāyatrīsāramātro 'pi tatra yaḥ kriyate japaḥ / ṛgyajuḥsāmasahitaḥ sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: After giving up Yoga, they have attained the worlds beautiful and pleasant to look at. They become divine, merit¬ orious and sinless noble souls.
verses.hindi: पुरा देवासुरे तस्मिन्सडग्रामे तारकामये । अनावृष्टया हते लोके व्यग्रे शक्ते सुर: सह ॥। अन्नौषध मुलफलमोषधीश्र प्रवर्तघन्  तास्तेन जीवयामास कारुण्यादोषधेन तु
verses.wordMeaning: After giving up Yoga, they have attained the worlds beautiful and pleasant to look at. They become divine, merit¬ orious and sinless noble souls.
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving up Yoga, they have attained the worlds beautiful and pleasant to look at. They become divine, merit¬ orious and sinless noble souls.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या त्यजेद्देहं सुदुस्त्यजम् । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य ब्रह्मलोकान् न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā tyajeddehaṃ sudustyajam / anivartikā gatistasya brahmalokān na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: At the end of a thousand Yugas, they become expoun¬ ders of Brahman. Regaining the Yogic power once again., they attain salvation in a bodiless state.
verses.hindi: काला पराशराज्जज्ञे कृष्णद्वपायनं प्रभम् । दपायनादरण्यां वे शुको जज्ञे गुणान्वितः ॥८ड॑
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of a thousand Yugas, they become expoun¬ ders of Brahman. Regaining the Yogic power once again., they attain salvation in a bodiless state.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of a thousand Yugas, they become expoun¬ ders of Brahman. Regaining the Yogic power once again., they attain salvation in a bodiless state.

verses.sanskrit: यावदस्थीनि तिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्मतीर्थे च देहिनाम् । तावद् वर्षसहस्राणि देवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yāvadasthīni tiṣṭhanti brahmatīrthe ca dehinām / tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi devaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: They forsake both the manifestand unmanifest (bodies) by means of their great Yogic power and perish (vanish) like a meteor or like the fading flash of lightning in the sky.
verses.hindi: कन्या कीतिमतो चव योगमाता दृढब्ता । जननी ब्रह्मदत्तस्य पत्नी सात्वगुहस्य च  0७४८६ श्वेता: कृष्णाभ्च गौराश्य श्यामा धम्राः समुलिका:  ऊष्मपा द्वारकाश्चेव नीलाश्चंव पराशराः ॥ पाराशराणामष्टो ते पक्षा: प्रोक्ता महात्मनाम् क्‍ हैं--ऐसा पुराणज्ञ लोग कहते हैं ।७१-७७। उनके गोत्र में उत्पन्न होनेवाले चार वश पृथ्वी पर विख्याति प्राप्त कर चुके हैं। उनके नाम हैं, श्याम, मुदूगल, बलारक और गविष्ठिर । महान तेजस्वी मनुष्यों के ये चार वंश गोत्र कर्ता हैं। कश्यप से नारद, पर्वत तथा अरुन्धती की उत्पत्ति हुई। है पण्डित गण ! अरुन्धती में उत्पन्न होने वाली सन्‍्ततियों का विवरण सुनिये । नारद ने अरुन्धती को वसिष्ठ को समर्पित किया । नारद महान् तेजस्वी
verses.wordMeaning: They forsake both the manifestand unmanifest (bodies) by means of their great Yogic power and perish (vanish) like a meteor or like the fading flash of lightning in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: They forsake both the manifestand unmanifest (bodies) by means of their great Yogic power and perish (vanish) like a meteor or like the fading flash of lightning in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: अवतीर्णस्ततो लोके ब्रह्मज्ञो जायते कुले । उत्तमः सर्ववर्णानां देवानामिव देवता
verses.transliteration: avatīrṇastato loke brahmajño jāyate kule / uttamaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ devānāmiva devatā
verses.translation: By abandoning all the bodies (and other adjuncts) by means of their great Yogic power, they attain the state of namelessness like rivers merging into the ocean.
verses.hindi: एवं नैष्ठिक ब्रह्मचयं ब्रत परायण थें। प्राचीन काल में दक्ष के शाप के कारण जब देवताओं और अबसुरों में विख्यात तारकामय नामक संग्राम छिड़ा था, और अतावुष्टि के कारण समस्त लोक ध्वस्त हो गया था ओर
verses.wordMeaning: By abandoning all the bodies (and other adjuncts) by means of their great Yogic power, they attain the state of namelessness like rivers merging into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: By abandoning all the bodies (and other adjuncts) by means of their great Yogic power, they attain the state of namelessness like rivers merging into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यास्थानानि सर्वाणि वेत्ति वेदाङ्गपारगः । जायते पूजितो लोके राजभिः स न संशयः
verses.transliteration: vidyāsthānāni sarvāṇi vetti vedāṅgapāragaḥ / jāyate pūjito loke rājabhiḥ sa na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Engaged everyday in holy rites and the worship of preceptors, Pitrs develop their Yogic power and satisfyall (make them flourish).
verses.hindi: रक्षा की थी ।७५-८१। उस समय उन्होंने अन्न, औषधि मूल फल, आदि की रचना की, और अति करुणा वश उन्हीं औषधियों द्वारा प्रजाव्ग को जीवित रखा था । द्विजवुन्द ! वसिष्ठ ने अरुन्धती में शक्ति को उत्पन्न किया । अदृश्यन्ती (?) ने शक्ति के संयोग से पराशर को जन्म दिया। काली ने पराशर के संयोग से परम ऐश्वर्ये शाली कृष्ण द्वेपाथन कौ उत्पन्न किया  द्वैवायन के संयोग से अरणी में परम गुणवान शुक की उत्पत्ति हुई । पीवरी में शुक के ये छः पुत्र उत्पन्न हुये, भूरिश्रवा, प्रभु, शंभु, कृष्ण और पाँचवें गौर ।५२-८५। कौतिमती नामक कन्या भी उत्पन्न हुई जो योग/भ्यास में सवंदा निरत रहनेवाली तथा दुढ़ब़्त परायण थी। वह ब्रह्मदत्त की माता और सात्त्वगुद् की स्त्री हुई। इवेत, कृष्ण, गौर, द्याम धूम्र समूलिक, ऊष्मपान करनेवाले दारक तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Engaged everyday in holy rites and the worship of preceptors, Pitrs develop their Yogic power and satisfyall (make them flourish).
verses.commentary: Sense: Engaged everyday in holy rites and the worship of preceptors, Pitrs develop their Yogic power and satisfyall (make them flourish).

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रपौत्रसमोपेतः सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः । जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं ब्रह्मतीर्थप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: putrapautrasamopetaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ / jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ brahmatīrthaprabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: Propitiated in Sraddha, Pitrs nourish Soma (the Moon) making use of their Yogic power whereby the three worlds sustain their lives. Hcncc Sraddhas must always be offered to Yogins 1 with (special efforts). Indeed, the mainstay of Pilfs is Yoga and from (thanks to) Yoga the Moon functions.
verses.hindi: मित्रावरुणयोश्चेव कुण्डिनो ये परिश्रुता: । एकार्षेयास्यथंवान्ये वसिष्ठा नाम विश्वुताः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Propitiated in Sraddha, Pitrs nourish Soma (the Moon) making use of their Yogic power whereby the three worlds sustain their lives. Hcncc Sraddhas must always be offered to Yogins 1 with (special efforts). Indeed,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Propitiated in Sraddha, Pitrs nourish Soma (the Moon) making use of their Yogic power whereby the three worlds sustain their lives. Hcncc Sraddhas must always be offered to Yogins 1 with (special efforts). Indeed,…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं तीर्थं ज्ञानवतां वरम् । ये पश्यन्ति महात्मानो ह्यमृतत्वं प्रयान्ति ते
verses.transliteration: etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ jñānavatāṃ varam / ye paśyanti mahātmāno hyamṛtatvaṃ prayānti te
verses.translation: One may feed thousands of Brahmanas or as many as do come, but listen that one knower of Yogas, if delighted, deserves all (propitiating a Yogin is as fruitful as feeding thousands of Brahmanas).
verses.hindi: एते पक्षा वसिष्ठानां स्मृता एकादशव तु ६० इत्येते ब्रह्मण: पुत्रा मानसा ह्मुष्ठ विश्वुता:। अातरः सुमहाभागा येषां बंशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ६१ त्रोल्लोकान्धारयन्ती मान्देवषिगणसंकुलान् । तेषां पुत्राश्न पोन्नाश्च शतशो5थ सहस्नशः ॥॥ इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते उपोद्धातपाद ऋषिवंशानुकीतंन ताम सप्ततितमोउ्ष्याय: ।॥७०॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: One may feed thousands of Brahmanas or as many as do come, but listen that one knower of Yogas, if delighted, deserves all (propitiating a Yogin is as fruitful as feeding thousands of Brahmanas).
verses.commentary: Sense: One may feed thousands of Brahmanas or as many as do come, but listen that one knower of Yogas, if delighted, deserves all (propitiating a Yogin is as fruitful as feeding thousands of Brahmanas).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे ब्रह्मतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनत्रिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १३० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले देवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । तत्र देवैः समागत्य तोषितः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe brahmatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| rkv adhyāya 130 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle devatīrthamanuttamam / tatra devaiḥ samāgatya toṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: What is taken in by a thousand invited (ordinary Brahmanas), or by a hundred Sndtakas (Brahmanas initiated into householder's life) or by one master of Yoga saves one from great fear.
verses.hindi: नील-+ये आठ पराशर गोत्र में उत्पन्न होनेवाले महापुरुषों के गोत्र कर्ता हैं। अब इसके उपरात्त इन्द्रप्रतिम के पुत्रों का विवरण सुनिये । कपिज्जली घुताची में बशिष्ठ के कुशीति (क्रणति) नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ; जो इन्द्रप्रतिम नाम से प्रसिद्ध है ।८६-८८। पृथु की पुत्री में उनके वसु नामक एक अन्य पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ। उसका पृत्र उपमन्यु हुआ, जिनके वंश में उत्पन्न होंनेवाले ये उपमन्यु गोत्रीय हैं। मित्रावरुण के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: What is taken in by a thousand invited (ordinary Brahmanas), or by a hundred Sndtakas (Brahmanas initiated into householder's life) or by one master of Yoga saves one from great fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is taken in by a thousand invited (ordinary Brahmanas), or by a hundred Sndtakas (Brahmanas initiated into householder's life) or by one master of Yoga saves one from great fear.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा कामक्रोधविवर्जितः । स लभेन्नात्र सन्देहो गोसहस्रफलं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ / sa labhennātra sandeho gosahasraphalaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: One Yogin excels a thousand householders, a hundred Vdnaprasthas (Forest-hermits) and a thousand Brahmacarins (celibate students).
verses.hindi: जों कुण्डी नाम से विर्यात वशधर हैं, वे एक ही मूल ऋषि के वंशधर हैं और अन्य वशिष्ठ नाम से विख्यात हैं । वशिष्ठ गोत्र में उत्पन्न होनेवालों के ग्यारह गोत्र कर्ता हैं। ये उपर्यूक्त आठ ब्रह्मा के मानस पुत्र रूप में विख्यात हैं और ये सब लोग महाभाग्यशाली हैं, इनके बंद्द आज तक भूमण्डल पर प्रतिष्ठित है ॥ देवताओं तथा ऋषि- बुन्दों से संकुलित इन तीनों लोकों को ये धारण करते हैं । उनके उन पुत्र पौन्नादिकों की संख्या सेकड़ों द्वी नहीं सहस्नों तक है, जिन्होंने सुयं की किरणों की भाँति समस्त पृथ्वी को व्याप्त कर रखा है
verses.wordMeaning: One Yogin excels a thousand householders, a hundred Vdnaprasthas (Forest-hermits) and a thousand Brahmacarins (celibate students).
verses.commentary: Sense: One Yogin excels a thousand householders, a hundred Vdnaprasthas (Forest-hermits) and a thousand Brahmacarins (celibate students).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे देवतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १३१ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले नागतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धा महानागा भये जाते ततो नृप
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 131 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle nāgatīrthamanuttamam / yatra siddhā mahānāgā bhaye jāte tato nṛpa
verses.translation: Prajapati has ordained: "(One may be) an atheist, an evil-doer, a person of mixed caste or a thief, (but) he cannot have redemption 2 ( Tdranam ) from anything else, except (by offering) a charitable gift unto those who have Yogic power.
verses.hindi: कर्थ द्वितोयमुत्पन्ना भवानी प्राक्सती तु या। आसीहाक्षायणी पूर्वमुमा कथमजायत २ मेनायां पितृकन्यायां जनयामास शेलराट् । के चेते पितरश्चेव येषां मेना तु मानसी 0३ सेनाकश्चेव दौहित्रो दोहिन्री च तथा हामा। एकपर्णा तथा चेब तथा या चेकपाटला है
verses.wordMeaning: Prajapati has ordained: "(One may be) an atheist, an evil-doer, a person of mixed caste or a thief, (but) he cannot have redemption 2 ( Tdranam ) from anything else, except (by offering) a charitable gift unto those who have Yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prajapati has ordained: "(One may be) an atheist, an evil-doer, a person of mixed caste or a thief, (but) he cannot have redemption 2 ( Tdranam ) from anything else, except (by offering) a charitable gift unto those who have Yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: महाभयानां लोकस्य नागानां द्विजसत्तम । कथं जातं भयं तीव्रं येन ते तपसि स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: mahābhayānāṃ lokasya nāgānāṃ dvijasattama / kathaṃ jātaṃ bhayaṃ tīvraṃ yena te tapasi sthitāḥ
verses.translation: His ancestors are delighted like the husbandmen by a good timely rain, even if his son or grandson feeds a (Yogic) meditator.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध की प्रक्रिया तेदनन्तर आत्मज्ञानी सूत की ये बातें सुन ब्राह्मणों ने (यूत) से पूछा” ?
verses.wordMeaning: His ancestors are delighted like the husbandmen by a good timely rain, even if his son or grandson feeds a (Yogic) meditator.
verses.commentary: Sense: His ancestors are delighted like the husbandmen by a good timely rain, even if his son or grandson feeds a (Yogic) meditator.

verses.sanskrit: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च यत्सुरासुरमानवे । तात ते विदितं सर्वं तेन मे कौतुकं महत्
verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca yatsurāsuramānave / tāta te viditaṃ sarvaṃ tena me kautukaṃ mahat
verses.translation: If meditating mendicants are not available, one should feed two Brahmacarins. When they too are not available, one should feed a householder not much engrossed in worldly affairs."
verses.hindi: शाशपायन ने कहा-- सूतजी ! भव (महादेव) की प्रिया, जो पहले सती रूप में थीं, द्वितीय बार किस प्रकार उत्पन्न हुईं। पूरब जन्म में वे दक्ष प्रजापति की पुत्री थीं बाद में वे उमा रूप में कैसे उत्पन्न हुईं। शेलराज हिमवान् ने उन्हें पितरों की कन्या सेना में उत्पन्न किया--ऐसी प्रसिद्धि है। वे पितर गण कोन हैं, जिनकी मानसी कन्या मेना हैं? भेनाक उनका दौहित्र है, तपस्या के समय एक पर्ण पर
verses.wordMeaning: If meditating mendicants are not available, one should feed two Brahmacarins. When they too are not available, one should feed a householder not much engrossed in worldly affairs."
verses.commentary: Sense: If meditating mendicants are not available, one should feed two Brahmacarins. When they too are not available, one should feed a householder not much engrossed in worldly affairs."

verses.sanskrit: मम संतापजं दुःखं दुर्योधनसमुद्भवम् । तव वक्त्राम्बुजौघेन प्लावितं निर्वृतिं गतम्
verses.transliteration: mama saṃtāpajaṃ duḥkhaṃ duryodhanasamudbhavam / tava vaktrāmbujaughena plāvitaṃ nirvṛtiṃ gatam
verses.translation: It is the injunction of Brahma that a meditating Yogin is greater than one. who (performs penance) for a hundred years standing on one leg and taking in nothing but air.
verses.hindi: जीवन रखनेवाली उमा उनकी दोहित्री है, सबों की पूर्वज समस्त सरिताओं में श्रेष्ठ सुरसरि उनकी सब से बड़ी सन्‍्तति है,-- इन सब बातों को तो हम लोग बहुत पहले ही से सुन चुके हैं । पर हमारी यह जिज्ञासा आप सुनिये कि ये पितरगण कौन हैं ? कहाँ निवास करते हैं? इनके श्रद्धादि की विधियाँ कया हैं--इन सब बातों को हम जानना चाहते हैं, आप का कल्याण हो ।३-६। ये किसके पुत्र है, और किस कारण वंश पितर नाम  एतस्मात्यूवं सूत उवाचेति ख. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: It is the injunction of Brahma that a meditating Yogin is greater than one. who (performs penance) for a hundred years standing on one leg and taking in nothing but air.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the injunction of Brahma that a meditating Yogin is greater than one. who (performs penance) for a hundred years standing on one leg and taking in nothing but air.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तव मुखोद्गीतां कथां पापप्रणाशनीम् । भूयो भूयः स्मृतिर्जाता श्रवणे मम सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tava mukhodgītāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm / bhūyo bhūyaḥ smṛtirjātā śravaṇe mama suvrata
verses.translation: The Siddhas roam over the Earth in the guise of Brahmanas. Hence one should approach the in-coming guest with palms joined in reverence. He should honour him with the vessel containing materials of worship. He shall offer him place of residence and food. The masters of Yoga assume diverse forms
verses.hindi: पुत्राश्व ते स्मृताः केषां कर्थं च पितरस्तु ते । पितरः कथमुत्पन्नाः कस्य पुत्रा: किमात्मकाः ७ स्वगें तु पितरोडन्ये ये देवानामपि देवता: । एवं वे श्रोतुमिच्छामि पित्षां सर्वंमुत्तमम् ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhas roam over the Earth in the guise of Brahmanas. Hence one should approach the in-coming guest with palms joined in reverence. He should honour him with the vessel containing materials of worship. He shall offer him place of residence and food.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhas roam over the Earth in the guise of Brahmanas. Hence one should approach the in-coming guest with palms joined in reverence. He should honour him with the vessel containing materials of worship. He shall offer him place of residence and food.…

verses.sanskrit: न क्लेशत्वं द्विजे युक्तं न चान्यो जानते फलम् । विद्यादानस्य महतः श्रावितस्य सुतस्य च
verses.transliteration: na kleśatvaṃ dvije yuktaṃ na cānyo jānate phalam / vidyādānasya mahataḥ śrāvitasya sutasya ca
verses.translation: Karanam in the text is irrelevant and obscure. Hence Tarariam, the reading in Bd. P. ibid V. 71 is accepted.
verses.hindi: यदर्थ ते न दृश्यन्ते तत्र कि कारण स्मृतम् । स्वर्ग हि के तु वर्तन्ते पितरो नरके तु के ३६ कानि श्राद्धानि देयानि कथं गच्छन्ति वे पित॒न्। कथं च शक्तास्ते दातुं नरकस्था: फल पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: Karanam in the text is irrelevant and obscure. Hence Tarariam, the reading in Bd. P. ibid V. 71 is accepted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Karanam in the text is irrelevant and obscure. Hence Tarariam, the reading in Bd. P. ibid V. 71 is accepted.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा यथान्यायं यः प्रश्नः पृच्छितो मया । कथा तु कथ्यतां विप्र दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā yathānyāyaṃ yaḥ praśnaḥ pṛcchito mayā / kathā tu kathyatāṃ vipra dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari
verses.translation: In heaven, there are seven excellent groups of highly intelligent Pitrs. Four of them have forms and three are formless (Amurta) A Understand as I shall recount their creative activity in the world.
verses.hindi: के चेह पितरों नाम कान्यजामों वयं पुनः । देवा अपि पित्नन्‍्स्वर्ग यजन्तीति हि नः श्रुतम् (१२
verses.wordMeaning: In heaven, there are seven excellent groups of highly intelligent Pitrs. Four of them have forms and three are formless (Amurta) A Understand as I shall recount their creative activity in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: In heaven, there are seven excellent groups of highly intelligent Pitrs. Four of them have forms and three are formless (Amurta) A Understand as I shall recount their creative activity in the world.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: यथा यथा त्वं नृप भाषसे च तथा तथा मे सुखमेति भारती । शैथिल्यभावाज्जरयान्वितस्य त्वत्सौहृदं नश्यति नैव तात
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: yathā yathā tvaṃ nṛpa bhāṣase ca tathā tathā me sukhameti bhāratī / śaithilyabhāvājjarayānvitasya tvatsauhṛdaṃ naśyati naiva tāta
verses.translation: (I shall describe) those who are proclaimed (in Smrtis) as their daughters and daughters' sons. There are three excellent groups of those who assume Dharmic bodies and forms. I shall briefly recount their names and creative activity. The disembodied groups of Pitrs, the sons of Prajapati, abide in the shining worlds named Virajas. O Brahmanas, they belong to Virajas. Hence they are famous as excellent Vairajas. I have thus mentioned the first group of Vairajas.
verses.hindi: ऋषोणां तु बच: श्रुत्वा सुतस्तत्त्वार्थंडशिवान् । आचचक्षे यथाप्रश्नं ऋषोणां मानस ततः १४ अन्न वो वर्ण प्रिष्यामि यथाप्रज्न यथाश्रुतम् । मन्वस्तरेषु जायन्ते पितरों देवसूनवः १५
verses.wordMeaning: (I shall describe) those who are proclaimed (in Smrtis) as their daughters and daughters' sons. There are three excellent groups of those who assume Dharmic bodies and forms. I shall briefly recount their names and creative activity. The disembodied groups of Pitrs,…
verses.commentary: Sense: (I shall describe) those who are proclaimed (in Smrtis) as their daughters and daughters' sons. There are three excellent groups of those who assume Dharmic bodies and forms. I shall briefly recount their names and creative activity. The disembodied groups of Pitrs,…

verses.sanskrit: कथयामि यथावृत्तम् इतिहासं पुरातनम् । कथितं पूर्वतो वृद्धैः पारम्पर्येण भारत
verses.transliteration: kathayāmi yathāvṛttam itihāsaṃ purātanam / kathitaṃ pūrvato vṛddhaiḥ pāramparyeṇa bhārata
verses.translation: 'Sanctifying the worlds'—Bd. P. V. 76.
verses.hindi: से विख्यात हैं ? ये लोग कैसे उत्पन्न हुए ? किसके पुत्र हैं? कसा इनका स्वरूप है १ स्वर्ग में जोपितर निवास करते हैं, वे देवताओं के भी देवता ( पूज्य ) कहे जाते हैं, वे कौन हैं? इन सब पितरों की सृष्टि (उत्पत्ति) सम्बन्धी कल्याण दाथिनी उत्तम बातें हम लोग सुनना चाहते हैं। हम लोग श्रद्धा एवं विधि पूर्वक उन पितरों को जो कुछ अपित करते हैं, वह वस्तुएं उन्हें (पितरों) प्रसन्न एवं सन्तुष्ट रखती हैं। वे लोग दृष्टिगोचर नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: 'Sanctifying the worlds'—Bd. P. V. 76.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Sanctifying the worlds'—Bd. P. V. 76.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे भार्ये कश्यपस्यास्तां सर्वलोकेष्वनुत्तमे । गरुत्मतो वै विनता सर्पाणां कद्रुरेव च
verses.transliteration: dve bhārye kaśyapasyāstāṃ sarvalokeṣvanuttame / garutmato vai vinatā sarpāṇāṃ kadrureva ca
verses.translation: This chapter is textually similar to Bd. 3,10. Reference are given to verses in that chapter.
verses.hindi: होते --इसका क्या कारण प्रसिद्ध है ।७-८५४औ। कौन से पितर गण स्वर्ग में निवास करने वाले हैं और कौन से नरक में ॥ पिता को, पिता के पिता को, पिता के पितामह को तीनों पिण्डदानों में नामोच्चारण पूवंक विधिसमेत कौन-कौन से श्राद्ध देने चाहिए, अर्थात् किन-किन श्राद्धों में णितामह तथा प्रपितामह का नाम लेकर तीन पिण्ड दान किये जाते हैं। ये श्रद्धादि में दी गई वस्तुएँ पितरों को किस प्रकार प्राप्त होती हैं। और जो स्वयमेव नरक में निवास करते हैं, वे किस प्रकार फलप्रदान में समर्थ हो सकते हैं ? ये पितर नामधारी कोन हैं? किन की हम पूजा करें। हम ऐसा सुना है कि स्वर्ग लोग में देवगण भी पितरों की पूजा तथा श्राद्वादि किया करते हैं। है बहुश्गुत ! इस विषय को हम विस्तारपूर्वक सुनना चाहते हैं ? इन सबों का स्पष्ट अभिप्राय आप बतलाइये । ऋषियों की ऐसी बातें सुन तत्त्वाथंदर्शी सून ऋषियों के प्रश्नगत एवं मनोगत जिज्ञासाओं को
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter is textually similar to Bd. 3,10. Reference are given to verses in that chapter.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter is textually similar to Bd. 3,10. Reference are given to verses in that chapter.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वसंदर्शनात् ताभ्यां कलिरूपं व्यवस्थितम् । प्रभातकाले राजेन्द्र भास्कराकारवर्चसम्
verses.transliteration: aśvasaṃdarśanāt tābhyāṃ kalirūpaṃ vyavasthitam / prabhātakāle rājendra bhāskarākāravarcasam
verses.translation: For similar seven divisions of Pitrs vide Pd. P. V.9.2-3, Bd. P. V-l,
verses.hindi: शान्ति करते हुए बोले
verses.wordMeaning: For similar seven divisions of Pitrs vide Pd. P. V.9.2-3, Bd. P. V-l,
verses.commentary: Sense: For similar seven divisions of Pitrs vide Pd. P. V.9.2-3, Bd. P. V-l,

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा विनता रूपम् अश्वं सर्वत्र पाण्डुरम् । अथ तां कद्रूमवोचत्सा पश्य पश्य वरानने
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā vinatā rūpam aśvaṃ sarvatra pāṇḍuram / atha tāṃ kadrūmavocatsā paśya paśya varānane
verses.translation: Their fair-complexioned mental daughter Mena is the wife of the great mountain Himavan. From her the son Mainaka was born.
verses.hindi: सूत ने कहाः--ऋषिव॒न्द ! आप लोगों की पूछी हुई बातों का उत्तर अपनी बुद्धि एवं श्रृति के आधार पर दे रहा हूँ । प्रत्येक मन्वस्तरों में ये क्रशः ज्येष्ठ और कनिष्ठ रूप में प्रादुभू त होते हैं । व्यतीत भाद्धं चषां मनुष्याणां श्राद्धमेव प्रवतंते । देवानसजत ब्रह्मा नायक्षन्निति वे पुनः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Their fair-complexioned mental daughter Mena is the wife of the great mountain Himavan. From her the son Mainaka was born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their fair-complexioned mental daughter Mena is the wife of the great mountain Himavan. From her the son Mainaka was born.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चैःश्रवसः सादृश्यं पश्य सर्वत्र पाण्डुरम् । धावमानम् अविश्रान्तं जवेन पवनोपमम्
verses.transliteration: uccaiḥśravasaḥ sādṛśyaṃ paśya sarvatra pāṇḍuram / dhāvamānam aviśrāntaṃ javena pavanopamam
verses.translation: The mountain Mainaka, the holder of all medicinal herbs, the mine of all gems, the holy leader of mountains, was born of her. Kraunca was his son.
verses.hindi: ते शप्ता ब्रह्मणा मुृढा नष्टसंज्ञा भविष्यथ । न सम किचिद्विजानन्ति ततो लोको हामुहात.
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain Mainaka, the holder of all medicinal herbs, the mine of all gems, the holy leader of mountains, was born of her. Kraunca was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain Mainaka, the holder of all medicinal herbs, the mine of all gems, the holy leader of mountains, was born of her. Kraunca was his son.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा यान्तम् ईर्ष्याभावेन मोहिता । कृष्णं मत्वा तथाजल्पत्तया सह नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā yāntam īrṣyābhāvena mohitā / kṛṣṇaṃ matvā tathājalpattayā saha nṛpottama
verses.translation: The king of mountains procreated three daughters of Mena, viz. Aparna, Ekaparna and the third Ekapatala.
verses.hindi: ते मूयः प्रणताः सर्वे याचन्ति स्स पितामहम् । अनुग्रहाय लोकानां पुनस्तानब्रवीत्प्रभुः तेम्यस्ते नियतात्मानः प्रशशंसुरनेकधा । प्रायश्वित्तानि धर्मज्ञा वाइमनः:कमंजानि तु
verses.wordMeaning: The king of mountains procreated three daughters of Mena, viz. Aparna, Ekaparna and the third Ekapatala.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king of mountains procreated three daughters of Mena, viz. Aparna, Ekaparna and the third Ekapatala.

verses.sanskrit: विनते त्वं मृषा लोके नृशंसे कुलपांसनि । कृष्णं चैनं वद श्वेतं नरकं यास्यसे परम्
verses.transliteration: vinate tvaṃ mṛṣā loke nṛśaṃse kulapāṃsani / kṛṣṇaṃ cainaṃ vada śvetaṃ narakaṃ yāsyase param
verses.translation: Two of them had support (They had their permanent abodes). But Aparna performed penance without an abode. Ekaparna had a Nyagrodha tree as her abode and Ekapatala had Pa tala (trumpet flower) tree as her abode. For a hundred thousand years, they performed such a penance as was difficult to be performed even by Devas and Danavas.
verses.hindi: धर्मज्ञानं च कामश्व को वरो वः प्रदीयताम् २३ पुनस्तानब्रवीद्ब्रह्मायुयं वे सत्यवादिनः । तस्माचथुक्‍तं युष्माभिस्तत्तथा न तदन्यथा
verses.wordMeaning: Two of them had support (They had their permanent abodes). But Aparna performed penance without an abode. Ekaparna had a Nyagrodha tree as her abode and Ekapatala had Pa tala (trumpet flower) tree as her abode. For a hundred thousand years,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Two of them had support (They had their permanent abodes). But Aparna performed penance without an abode. Ekaparna had a Nyagrodha tree as her abode and Ekapatala had Pa tala (trumpet flower) tree as her abode. For a hundred thousand years,…

verses.sanskrit: विनतोवाच: सत्यानृते तु वचने पणो ऽयं ते ममैव तु । सहस्रं वत्सरान्दासी भवेयं तव वेश्मनि
verses.transliteration: vinatovāca: satyānṛte tu vacane paṇo 'yaṃ te mamaiva tu / sahasraṃ vatsarāndāsī bhaveyaṃ tava veśmani
verses.translation: A single leaf was the diet of Ekaparna and a single Patala flower (trumpet flower) was the diet of Ekapatala.
