verses.hindi: दानवगण स्कन्दित (व्यथित) हो गयें अत: उस प्रताप दाली की स्कन्द नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुई ।३८-४२। अधुरों का विनाशक वह पुरातन पुरष यतः छृत्तिकाओं द्वारा पुष्ठ हुआ था अतः कारतिकेय नाम से उसकी प्रसिद्धि हुई । उस हैत्य विनाशक के जम्भआई लेते समय मुख अग्नि की ज्वालाओं को माला से पूर्ण हो गया ओर उससे उसकी अपराजिता नामक शक्ति बाहर हुई ।४३-४४। महान् प्रभावशाली भगवान् विष्णु ने स्कन्द को क्रीड़ा के लिए गरुड़ से भी अतिशय बलशाली तथा प्रभावशाली दो प्रभद्रक नामक मदर और कुक्कुट पक्षियों
verses.wordMeaning: Ajyapaswere the Pitrs of Kardama, the Prajapati, who was born of Pulaha. They were born of him again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajyapaswere the Pitrs of Kardama, the Prajapati, who was born of Pulaha. They were born of him again.

verses.sanskrit: यमतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा सम्पश्यति यमेश्वरम् । सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्येत सप्तजन्मान्तरार्जितैः
verses.transliteration: yamatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā sampaśyati yameśvaram / sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta saptajanmāntarārjitaiḥ
verses.translation: Moving about in the sky, they are stationed in these worlds that go about as they please. Groups of Vaisyas who are desirous of benefits, revere these in Sraddha.
verses.hindi: लात्राध्यायपरिसमाप्ति: क. ख. घ. छ. पुस्तकेषु । परंतु कथासंमत्याध्यमेव पाठः समीचीन
verses.wordMeaning: Moving about in the sky, they are stationed in these worlds that go about as they please. Groups of Vaisyas who are desirous of benefits, revere these in Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moving about in the sky, they are stationed in these worlds that go about as they please. Groups of Vaisyas who are desirous of benefits, revere these in Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णमास्याम् अमावास्यां स्नात्वा तु पितृतर्पणम् । यः करोति तिलैः स्नानं तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: pūrṇamāsyām amāvāsyāṃ snātvā tu pitṛtarpaṇam / yaḥ karoti tilaiḥ snānaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Their mental daughter is famous by the name of Viraja. The chaste lady was the wife of Nahusa and the mother of Yayati.
verses.hindi: ६९६ वायुपु्राणस् मयूरः कुक्कुटश्चेच पताका चेव वायुना। यस्य दत्ता सरस्वत्या महावीणा महास्वना ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Their mental daughter is famous by the name of Viraja. The chaste lady was the wife of Nahusa and the mother of Yayati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their mental daughter is famous by the name of Viraja. The chaste lady was the wife of Nahusa and the mother of Yayati.

verses.sanskrit: सुतृप्तास्तेन तोयेन पितरश्च पितामहाः । स्वर्गस्था द्वादशाब्दानि क्रीडन्ति प्रपितामहाः
verses.transliteration: sutṛptāstena toyena pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ / svargasthā dvādaśābdāni krīḍanti prapitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: This is the translation of *Datlasend Kumareria.* The absurdity of the text is obvious. 3d. P. ibid V. 87 reads Dattd Sanatkumareria 'She was given by Sanatkumara*. The reading in Bd. P. deserves adoption here as the next line reads "She became the beloved...of Sukra".
verses.hindi: मायाविहरणे विप्रा गिरो कौड्चे नियातिते । तारके चासुरवरे समुदीर्णं निपातिते
verses.wordMeaning: This is the translation of *Datlasend Kumareria.* The absurdity of the text is obvious. 3d. P. ibid V. 87 reads Dattd Sanatkumareria 'She was given by Sanatkumara*. The reading in Bd. P. deserves adoption here as the next line reads "She became the beloved...of Sukra".
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the translation of *Datlasend Kumareria.* The absurdity of the text is obvious. 3d. P. ibid V. 87 reads Dattd Sanatkumareria 'She was given by Sanatkumara*. The reading in Bd. P. deserves adoption here as the next line reads "She became the beloved...of Sukra".

verses.sanskrit: वरुणेशे नरः स्नात्वा ह्यर्चयित्वा महेश्वरम् । वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति पुष्कलम्
verses.transliteration: varuṇeśe naraḥ snātvā hyarcayitvā maheśvaram / vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam
verses.translation: The combined verses can be constructed as follows: Sukalas are the Pitrs of Vasistha, the Prajapati. They are the sons of Hiranyagarbha.
verses.hindi: सेर्द्रोपेन्द्रेम हाभागेदवरग्निसुतः प्रभुः। सेनापत्येन देत्यारिरभिषिक्तः प्रतापवान् ४८ देवसेनापतिस्त्वेब॑ पठचते नरनायक । देवारिस्कन्दनः स्कल्दः सर्वलोकेश्वर: प्रभु. ४६ इति श्रीमहाप्राणे वायुप्रोक्ते सेनान्युत्पत्तिकथनं नाम द्विसप्ततितमोअध्यायः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The combined verses can be constructed as follows: Sukalas are the Pitrs of Vasistha, the Prajapati. They are the sons of Hiranyagarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The combined verses can be constructed as follows: Sukalas are the Pitrs of Vasistha, the Prajapati. They are the sons of Hiranyagarbha.

verses.sanskrit: मृतां कालेन महता लोके यत्र जलेश्वरः । स गच्छेत् तत्र यानेन गीयमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: mṛtāṃ kālena mahatā loke yatra jaleśvaraḥ / sa gacchet tatra yānena gīyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: There are the worlds named Manasas where these are stationed. Their mental daughter is Narmada, the most excellent of rivers.
verses.hindi: की सृष्टि की  बायु ने पताका दी, सरस्वती ने उसे महान् शब्द करनेवाली एक बहुत बड़ी वीणा अपित की, स्वयः्भ् ब्रह्मा ने एक अज बिकरा) दिया, शंकर ने एक मेढ़ा दिया । द्विजवल्द ! क्रौज्वगमिरि पर असुरश्रेष्ठ तारकासुर की समस्त माया का उन्मूलनकर अग्नि कुमार ने जब उसका समस्त सेना के साथ संहार कर दिया, उस समय महाभाग्यशाली, इन्द्र, उपेन्द्र (विष्णु) प्रभूति देवताओं ने द॑त्यों के इस प्रबल प्रतापी शत्रु
verses.wordMeaning: There are the worlds named Manasas where these are stationed. Their mental daughter is Narmada, the most excellent of rivers.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are the worlds named Manasas where these are stationed. Their mental daughter is Narmada, the most excellent of rivers.

verses.sanskrit: वातेश्वरे नरः स्नात्वा सम्पूज्य च महेश्वरम् । जायते कृतकृत्यो ऽसौ लोकपालानवेक्षयन्
verses.transliteration: vāteśvare naraḥ snātvā sampūjya ca maheśvaram / jāyate kṛtakṛtyo 'sau lokapālānavekṣayan
verses.translation: Flowing in the southern region, she sanctifies living beings. She was tiie wife of Purukutsa and the mother of Trasadasyu. Manu became the lord of Manvantara by adopting these (Pitrs). In the beginning of Manvantara, he initiates all types of Sraddhas.
verses.hindi: को सेनापति के पद तर अभिषिक्त किया । ओर उसे समय विविध देवताओं, भूतों शिव के गणों, मातृकाओं तथा विनायकों के समूहों ने इसका नरनायक, देव सेनापति, देवारिस्कन्दन (देवताओं के शत्रु को व्यथित करने वाला) स्कल्द, स्वलोकेदवर एबं प्रभ आदि नामों से स्तवन किया लोकाः सोमपदा नाम मारीचेयंत्र वे सुता:। पितरो दिवि वर्तन्ते देवास्तान्भावयन्ति वे ३१ अग्निष्वात्ता इति ख्याता: सर्व एवामितौजसः । एतेषां मानसो कन्या अच्छीदा नाम निम्नगा
verses.wordMeaning: Flowing in the southern region, she sanctifies living beings. She was tiie wife of Purukutsa and the mother of Trasadasyu. Manu became the lord of Manvantara by adopting these (Pitrs). In the beginning of Manvantara, he initiates all types of Sraddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Flowing in the southern region, she sanctifies living beings. She was tiie wife of Purukutsa and the mother of Trasadasyu. Manu became the lord of Manvantara by adopting these (Pitrs). In the beginning of Manvantara, he initiates all types of Sraddhas.

verses.sanskrit: किं तस्य बहुभिर्यज्ञैर्दानैर्वा बहुदक्षिणैः । स्नात्वा चतुष्टये लोके अवाप्तं जन्मनः फलम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tasya bahubhiryajñairdānairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ / snātvā catuṣṭaye loke avāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, (I have recounted), all the Pitrs in their proper order. Hence Sraddha is to be* offered with faith in accordance with one's Dharma.
verses.hindi: अच्छोद॑ नाम तहिव्यं सरो यस्या: समुच्छितम् । अद्विकाप्सरसा युक्‍तं विमानधिषिठितं दिवि रे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, (I have recounted), all the Pitrs in their proper order. Hence Sraddha is to be* offered with faith in accordance with one's Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, (I have recounted), all the Pitrs in their proper order. Hence Sraddha is to be* offered with faith in accordance with one's Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस् तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् । नित्यं वसन्ति कौरिल्यां लोकपालान्निमन्त्र्य ये
verses.transliteration: te dhanyāste mahātmānas teṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / nityaṃ vasanti kaurilyāṃ lokapālānnimantrya ye
verses.translation: A Sraddha offered in silver vessels or those of silver alloy, after proferring Svadha, propitiates Pitrs. By the propitiation of Soma, Agni and Vaivasvata (Manu) and by the performance of Homo, in the sacrificial fire during the northern transit (of the sun), one shall attain the fruit of an Asvamcdha (a Horse Sacrifice).
verses.hindi: सा तेन व्यभिचारेण मनसः कामचारिणी  पतिकामा तदा सा च योगश्रष्टा पपात ह कि यणथी-- ्--- न तप +++ व भ"तथि:ं ी ंक्‍ॉक्‍क्‍हा+-न आह... ---.3ल्‍कर७»+ ७७-३० ...ललल६लुलॉैंकऋऋएए(' ५... कन-क+.. 4/977एश"/शश"शखशशणशणशणशशणणणणाणज  तन
verses.wordMeaning: A Sraddha offered in silver vessels or those of silver alloy, after proferring Svadha, propitiates Pitrs. By the propitiation of Soma, Agni and Vaivasvata (Manu) and by the performance of Homo, in the sacrificial fire during the northern transit (of the sun),…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं धन्यमायुर्विवर्धनम् । पठतां शृण्वतां चैव सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyamāyurvivardhanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet
verses.translation: Pitrs delight him who propitiates Pitrs with devo¬ tion. There is no doubt in this that Pitrs bestow nourish¬ ment or progeny.
verses.hindi: चृहस्पति बोल्ते-- स्वर्ग में सोमपद नामक लोक है, जहाँ मरीचि के पुत्र पितर गण वर्तमान
verses.wordMeaning: Pitrs delight him who propitiates Pitrs with devo¬ tion. There is no doubt in this that Pitrs bestow nourish¬ ment or progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitrs delight him who propitiates Pitrs with devo¬ tion. There is no doubt in this that Pitrs bestow nourish¬ ment or progeny.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कुबेरादितीर्थचतुष्टयमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १३४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले रामेश्वरमनुत्तमम् । तीर्थं पापहरं पुण्यं सर्वदुःखघ्नमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kuberāditīrthacatuṣṭayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 134 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle rāmeśvaramanuttamam / tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam
verses.translation: The rites of pitrs are always far superior to the rites of deities. It is ordained that the propitiation of Pitrs must be given priority over that of deities.
verses.hindi: हैं, देवगण वहाँ उनकी पूजा करते हैं। वे पितरगण अग्निष्वात्त नाम से विख्यात हैं, और सब के सब अमित तेजस्वी हैं इन पितरों की मानसी कन्या अच्छोदा नामक नदी है। जिससे निकला हुआ अच्छोद नामक दिव्य सरोवर भी वहाँ विराजमान हैं । स्वर्ग लोक में एक बार उसी सरोवर के पास अद्विका नामक भप्सरा के साथ आकाश में देवताओं के विमान सुशोभित हो रहे थे ।१-३। वहाँ मूृतिरहित पितरों को देखकर वह परम विस्मित हुई, ओर इसी दुःख से वह सुन्दरी बहुत काम पीड़ित हुई। झाकाश में विचरण करते हुए बसुओं के पिता आयु के परम यशस्वी पुत्र अमावसु नामक पितर को देखकर उसने मानसिक वरण किया। उस मानसिक व्यभिचार के कारण, पति के रूप में अमावसु को वरण करने की इच्छुक वह कामच।रिणी योग क्रष्ट ही गई ओर स्वर्ग से पतित हो गई ।४-६। स्वगं लोक से पतित होकर गिरते समय उसने उन देव विमानों को देखा और
verses.wordMeaning: The rites of pitrs are always far superior to the rites of deities. It is ordained that the propitiation of Pitrs must be given priority over that of deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rites of pitrs are always far superior to the rites of deities. It is ordained that the propitiation of Pitrs must be given priority over that of deities.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु ये स्नात्वा पूजयन्ति महेश्वरम् । महादेवं महात्मानं मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu ye snātvā pūjayanti maheśvaram / mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: The subtle movement (or goal) of Yoga or the satiation of Pitrs is not visible through the physical eye.
verses.hindi: वहाँ त्सरेणु के समान परम सृक्ष्म उन पितरों को देखा  वे परम सूक्ष्म थे और ज्वलन्त अग्नि के समान
verses.wordMeaning: The subtle movement (or goal) of Yoga or the satiation of Pitrs is not visible through the physical eye.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subtle movement (or goal) of Yoga or the satiation of Pitrs is not visible through the physical eye.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रामेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुस्त्रिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १३५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्यैवानन्तरं चान्यत्सिद्धेश्वरमनुत्तमम् । तीर्थं सर्वगुणोपेतं सर्वलोकेषु पूजितम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe rāmeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 135 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ cānyatsiddheśvaramanuttamam / tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam
verses.translation: Thus Pitrs, their worlds, their grandsons, their Yajamanas and those who been recounted.
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिह्वान्तग तग्रन्थ: क. ग. घ. हे, पुस्तकेषु नास्ति । ध्््ं चोयुपुराणंमू क्‍
verses.wordMeaning: Thus Pitrs, their worlds, their grandsons, their Yajamanas and those who been recounted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Pitrs, their worlds, their grandsons, their Yajamanas and those who been recounted.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा ह्युमारुद्रं प्रपूजयेत् । वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य स लभेत् फलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā hyumārudraṃ prapūjayet / vājapeyasya yajñasya sa labhet phalamuttamam
verses.translation: (Out of the seven classes of Pitrs) four hav< and three are formless. Devas honour them ar oraddhas to them devoutly and assiduously. 1
verses.hindi: ऊचुस्ते पितरः कर्न्यां भ्रष्टेश्वर्या व्यतिक्रमात् । अ्रष्टेश्वर्या स्वदोषेण पतसि त्वं शुचिस्मिति.
verses.wordMeaning: (Out of the seven classes of Pitrs) four hav< and three are formless. Devas honour them ar oraddhas to them devoutly and assiduously. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: (Out of the seven classes of Pitrs) four hav< and three are formless. Devas honour them ar oraddhas to them devoutly and assiduously. 1

verses.sanskrit: तेन पुण्येन महता मृतः स्वर्गमवाप्नुयात् । अप्सरोगणसंवीतो जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः
verses.transliteration: tena puṇyena mahatā mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnuyāt / apsarogaṇasaṃvīto jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ
verses.translation: All the Devas including Indra concentrate their minds on them. They join their palms in reverence and de¬ votedly worship them. Visvedevas, Sikatas, Prsnijas, Srrigins Krsnas, Svetas and Ajas worship them duly. Desirous of benefits, the subjects Vatarasanas, DivakJrtyas, Lekhas Maruts, Brahma and other heaven-dwellers, Atri, Bhr«n/ Angiras and all other sages, Yaksas, Nagas, Suparnas, Kinnaras and Raksasas always worshipped Pitrs.
verses.hindi: ये: क्रियन्ते च कर्माणि शरीरेरिह देवते: । तरेव तत्कंफलं प्राप्नुवन्तीह देवता: ११ सच्चा: फलस्ति कर्माणि देवत्वे प्रेत्य मानुबे । तस्मादमावसौ(सुं)पत्यं (ति) त्वं प्रेत्य साप्स्यसे फलम् ॥ इत्युक्तथा वे पितरः पुनस्ते तु प्रसादिता:  ध्यात्वा प्रसाद संचक्रुस्तस्यास्ते स्वनुकस्पणा , उत्पन्नस्थ पुथिव्यां तु मानुषत्वे महात्मनः । कन्या भृत्वा त्विमॉल्लोकास्पुनः प्राप्स्यसि स्वानिति
verses.wordMeaning: All the Devas including Indra concentrate their minds on them. They join their palms in reverence and de¬ votedly worship them. Visvedevas, Sikatas, Prsnijas, Srrigins Krsnas, Svetas and Ajas worship them duly. Desirous of benefits, the subjects Vatarasanas, DivakJrtyas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Devas including Indra concentrate their minds on them. They join their palms in reverence and de¬ votedly worship them. Visvedevas, Sikatas, Prsnijas, Srrigins Krsnas, Svetas and Ajas worship them duly. Desirous of benefits, the subjects Vatarasanas, DivakJrtyas,…

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रवत्सरांस्तत्र क्रीडयित्वा यथासुखम् । धनधान्यसमोपेते कुले महति जायते
verses.transliteration: sahasravatsarāṃstatra krīḍayitvā yathāsukham / dhanadhānyasamopete kule mahati jāyate
verses.translation: These noble-souled (Pitrs), if duly honoured and worshipped in Sraddha, grant all desires hundred-fold and thousand-fold.
verses.hindi: अष्टाविश भवित्री त्वं दरापरे मत्स्ययोत्रिजा । अस्थेव राजो दुहिता अहिकायां छामावसो: .
verses.wordMeaning: These noble-souled (Pitrs), if duly honoured and worshipped in Sraddha, grant all desires hundred-fold and thousand-fold.
verses.commentary: Sense: These noble-souled (Pitrs), if duly honoured and worshipped in Sraddha, grant all desires hundred-fold and thousand-fold.

verses.sanskrit: पूज्यमानो नरश्रेष्ठ वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः । व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम्
verses.transliteration: pūjyamāno naraśreṣṭha vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam
verses.translation: These grandfathers (Pitrs) bestow Yogic Power (and prosperity) and liberation (from Samsara) after one has aban¬ doned the three worlds of normal existence involving old age and death.
verses.hindi: पराशरस्य दायादपृषेस्त्व॑ जगविष्यसि । स वेदसेक विप्रषिश्नतुर्धा बे करिष्यति ...... ४१४ देदीप्पमान और तेजस्वी थे आकाश से गिरते हुए उसने रक्षा, कीजिये; इस प्रकार की आरत वाणी बिना शिर और स्पष्ट स्वर के ही कही । पितरों ते उससे कहा, 'मत डरो” और उनके ऐसा कहने पर वह सस्थिर हो गई। वहाँ स्थिर हो उसने अति दीन वाणी से पितरों को प्रसन्न किया  मानसिक भावों के ब्यतिक्रम से दुष्ट होने के कारण भ्रष्ट ऐश्वयंवाली उस कल़्या को देखकर पितरों ने कहा, है सध्दर हँसनेवाली !
verses.wordMeaning: These grandfathers (Pitrs) bestow Yogic Power (and prosperity) and liberation (from Samsara) after one has aban¬ doned the three worlds of normal existence involving old age and death.
verses.commentary: Sense: These grandfathers (Pitrs) bestow Yogic Power (and prosperity) and liberation (from Samsara) after one has aban¬ doned the three worlds of normal existence involving old age and death.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चत्रिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १३६ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल चाहल्येश्वरमुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धा महाभागा त्वहल्या तापसी पुरा
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 136 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla cāhalyeśvaramuttamam / yatra siddhā mahābhāgā tvahalyā tāpasī purā
verses.translation: Pitamahas, the deities of subtle bodies, grant the means of salvation, AiSvarya (prosperity), complete detachment and infiniteness.
verses.hindi: अपने ही दोषों से तू अपने ऐश्वर्य से भ्रष्ट होकर गिर रही हो ।७०१०। इस लोक में देवगण अपने जिस दारीर से कर्मों को करते हैं, उसी से उसका फल प्राप्त करते हैं। देवयौनि में कर्मों का फल तुरन्त प्राप्त होता है और सनुष्य योचि में पर लोक ( आय. ज्न्म-) में प्राप्त होता है, इस कॉरण -तुम दूसरे: जन्म में? अमावसू को पितर) (पति ?) रूप. में प्राप्त -क़्रोमी ६ प्लेसा कहने . के उपरान्त उसने पिलरों को पूल: प्राथना आदि सें
verses.wordMeaning: Pitamahas, the deities of subtle bodies, grant the means of salvation, AiSvarya (prosperity), complete detachment and infiniteness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitamahas, the deities of subtle bodies, grant the means of salvation, AiSvarya (prosperity), complete detachment and infiniteness.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमो ब्राह्मणस्त्वासीत् साक्षाद् ब्रह्मेव चापरः । सत्यधर्मसमायुक्तो वानप्रस्थाश्रमे रतः
verses.transliteration: gautamo brāhmaṇastvāsīt sākṣād brahmeva cāparaḥ / satyadharmasamāyukto vānaprasthāśrame rataḥ
verses.translation: Practised Yoga is AiSvarya', and Ativarya is the excellent wealth. Without Yoga and Aisvarya liberation (from Sarhsara) is impossible (to be achieved).
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न किया । प्रार्थना करने पर पित्तरों नेःउसके उऊपर- बड़ी अनुक्रम्पा- कर प्रसन्नता प्रकट की । ध्यान मग्न होक्कर उन पितरों ने राजा: रूप में अमावसू और उसकी, कव्या के बारे में ये बातें! की ।ह१-१४॥ पृथ्वीललः पर मनुष्स्त योनि में उत्पन्न महात्मा अमाव्रसु की. क्या होकर तुम - पुतः इन अपने लोंकों, को-प्राप्स करोगी  अदट्टाइसंवें द्वापर युग में तुम्हारी ; उत्पत्ति मत्स्य की योनि से-होगी और इसी राजा अपतावस् से -अद्विका-में तुम कन्या रूप में उत्पन्न होगी और पराश्र कषि के सुपुत्र, वेदव्यास को उत्पन्न क़रोगी । - वह तुम्हारा पृत्र ऋद्मणों में श्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: Practised Yoga is AiSvarya', and Ativarya is the excellent wealth. Without Yoga and Aisvarya liberation (from Sarhsara) is impossible (to be achieved).
verses.commentary: Sense: Practised Yoga is AiSvarya', and Ativarya is the excellent wealth. Without Yoga and Aisvarya liberation (from Sarhsara) is impossible (to be achieved).

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पत्नी महाभागा ह्यहल्या नाम विश्रुता । रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता
verses.transliteration: tasya patnī mahābhāgā hyahalyā nāma viśrutā / rūpayauvanasampannā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā
verses.translation: Vairajas
verses.hindi: होगा और एक बेद को चारसश्नागों में विभक्त करेगा ।/१४-१७। महाभिष शब्तनु- के कीति बद्धंक धर्म :विचित्रवीय॑

verses.sanskrit: अस्या अप्यतिरूपेण देवराजः शतक्रतुः । मोहितो लोभयामास ह्यहल्यां बलसूदनः
verses.transliteration: asyā apyatirūpeṇa devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ / mohito lobhayāmāsa hyahalyāṃ balasūdanaḥ
verses.translation: Barhisads
verses.hindi: टू. 5  /छा ; में «ता ् उन्हे "के भरे के व,  मी में 5. का 5 ७, आनन्दा्रेम की प्रति में यहाँ पर मूल पाठ को सन्देह में डाल दिया है। जिससे पति रूप में” प्राप्त करोगी-- ऐसा अर्थ निकलता है, परन्तु आगे चलकर पिता रूप में प्रप्त करने का उल्लेख है । खहामिषस्य पुत्रौग्दी शंत्ीः कीतिवर्धनो । विचित्रवीर्य घर्मज्ञ त्वमेबोत्पदियिष्यसि” ४« 5

verses.sanskrit: मां भजस्व वरारोहे देवराजम् अनिन्दिते । क्रीडयस्व मया सार्द्धं त्रिषु लोकेषु पूजिता
verses.transliteration: māṃ bhajasva varārohe devarājam anindite / krīḍayasva mayā sārddhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā
verses.translation: Agnisvattas
verses.hindi: चित्रा ड्रादं च राजानं तेजोबलगुणान्वितम् ।एलानुत्पाथ प्रृत्रांस्त्व॑ पुनलोकानवाप्स्यथसि :

verses.sanskrit: किं करिष्यसि विप्रेण शौचाचारकृशेन तु । तपःस्वाध्यायशीलेन क्लिश्यन्तीव सुलोचने
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kariṣyasi vipreṇa śaucācārakṛśena tu / tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīlena kliśyantīva sulocane
verses.translation: Kavyas (sons of Agni and Svadha)
verses.hindi: व्यतिक्वमात्पितर्णां त्वं फ्राष््यससे जन्म कुत्सितम् । तस्येव राज्ञरूव कन्या अद्विकायां भविष्यसि आरक़ कन्या मृत्वा ततश्रत्वभिमॉल्लोकानवाप्स्यसि । एवशुक्ता तु दासेयी जाता सत्यवत्ती तु सा. ॥२३१: अद्विकायां सुता मंत्स्प्रां जुता जाव्रा ह्वामावसों: । अडिकामत्स्प्रसंभूता गड़ायब्रुनप्नंपल्ने... २२ तस्य राज्ञो' हि'सा कल्या' राज्ो वीयें सेव हि'। बिरेजा नप्म ते लोका दिव्ि रोचून्ति ते गणाः ॥२४: अग्मिव्वात्ता: स्मृताइलत्र वितरों भास्व॒रप्रभा: ।- तान्दानवयणा यक्षा रकोगन्धर्बाकनरा: .... ॥३४:
verses.wordMeaning: Kavyas (sons of Agni and Svadha)
verses.commentary: Sense: Kavyas (sons of Agni and Svadha)

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता वरारोहा स्त्रीस्वभावात् सुचञ्चला । मनसाध्याय शक्रं सा कामेन कलुषीकृता
verses.transliteration: evamuktā varārohā strīsvabhāvāt sucañcalā / manasādhyāya śakraṃ sā kāmena kaluṣīkṛtā
verses.translation: Upahutas (sons of Angiras)
verses.hindi: फोगिनो योगपत्नी व योगसाता-तथैव बच भवित्ता' द्वापरं प्राप्य अष्टाविशं तदेव तु. 3, :..
verses.wordMeaning: Upahutas (sons of Angiras)
verses.commentary: Sense: Upahutas (sons of Angiras)

verses.sanskrit: तस्या विदित्वा तं भावं स देवः पाकशासनः । गौतमं वञ्चयामास दुष्टभावेन भावितः
verses.transliteration: tasyā viditvā taṃ bhāvaṃ sa devaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ / gautamaṃ vañcayāmāsa duṣṭabhāvena bhāvitaḥ
verses.translation: Ajyapas (sons of Pulaha)
verses.hindi: पराशरकुलोद्मूतः शुकी नाम महातपा: । श्रीमान्‍्योगी महायोगी योगस्तस्माहिजोत्तमाः २८ ब्यासादरण्यां संभुतो विधूम इव पावकः । स तस्यां पितृकन्यायाँ योगांचा्न्पिरिश्रुतान् ओर परम तेजस्वी; बलवान, गुणशील राज़ा चित्रांगद इन. दो पुत्रों को तुम्हीं उत्पन्न करोगी.। इन पुत्रों को. उत्पन्न करने के बाद तुम पुनः इन लोकों को प्राप्त करोगी। पितरों के साथ पति, भावना. करके तुमने बहुत बड़ा व्यतिक्रम कर दिया है ओर डूसी,से ऐसी कुत्सित योनि में जन्म आप्त करना पड़ेगा । किन्तु उस योनि में भी तुम अद्विका क्रे. ग़्रभे में उसी राजा के (ीय॑ से जभत्पन्न होगी ।१८-२०॥ उसी कन्या होने के बाद तू इन लोछों
verses.wordMeaning: Ajyapas (sons of Pulaha)
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajyapas (sons of Pulaha)

verses.sanskrit: विदित्वा चान्तरं तस्य गृहीत्वा वेषमुत्तमम् । अहल्यां रमयामास विश्वस्तां मन्दिरान्तिके
verses.transliteration: viditvā cāntaraṃ tasya gṛhītvā veṣamuttamam / ahalyāṃ ramayāmāsa viśvastāṃ mandirāntike
verses.translation: Sukala (sons of Vasisfha
verses.hindi: को निश्चय हो प्राप्त करोगी ।, पितूरों, के ऐसा कहने पूर वह दासों की पुत्री सत्यवत्ी के रूप में उत्पन्न हुई । अमावयु के संयोग से अद्विका नामक मछली की पुत्री के रूप में उसका जन्म हुआ, ग्रद्धा यंमुनता के संगम पर अद्विका मछली के , पेट,से ;,उसकी उत्पत्ति; हुई, वह उसी राजा अमावसु के वीये से उत्पन्न हुई थी अत उसकी कुन्या थो। स्व॒गं में श्िरज नाम पितरों से वे,लोक शोभायमान हैं ॥२१-२३। वहाँ विद्यमान. रहने वाले
verses.wordMeaning: Sukala (sons of Vasisfha
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukala (sons of Vasisfha

verses.sanskrit: क्षणमात्रान्तरे तत्र देवराजस्य भारत । आजगाम मुनिश्रेष्ठो मन्दिरं त्वरयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇamātrāntare tatra devarājasya bhārata / ājagāma muniśreṣṭho mandiraṃ tvarayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: It (Moksa) is as impossible as the movement of a wingless bird in the sky. il4bA/a-Dharma is the greatest of all Dharmas and eternal.
verses.hindi: पितरगण सूर्य के समान कान्तिमात्त, हैं, वे आ नृष्वात्त! नाम॒ से विख्यात हैं। उन पित्र .गणों की समस्त दानव यक्ष, राक्षस, गन्धर्व, किन्नर, भूत, सर्प एवं पिशाचों के गणुउत्तम फल की प्राप्ति की इच्छा से पूजा करते हैं । पुलह प्रजापति कै.दन पुत्रों का वर्णन क्रिया जा चुका। धर्ममूति इन पितरों के तीन गण कहे गये हैं । इनकी मानसी कन्या पीवरी नाम,से विख्यात, है, वह, बीवरी योगिनी, -योगपत्नी एवं योगमाता के रूप में भी विख्यात थी । है द्विंजवर्य बन्द ! अद्वाईसवें द्ात्तर युग के आने पर पराशर के कुल में शुक नामक महान् तपस्वी श्रीमान, योगी, एवं महान योगाभ्यासी की उन्‍पत्ति होगी, उन्हीं से पृथ्वी पर योंग का विस्तार होगा
verses.wordMeaning: It (Moksa) is as impossible as the movement of a wingless bird in the sky. il4bA/a-Dharma is the greatest of all Dharmas and eternal.
verses.commentary: Sense: It (Moksa) is as impossible as the movement of a wingless bird in the sky. il4bA/a-Dharma is the greatest of all Dharmas and eternal.

verses.sanskrit: आगतं गौतमं दृष्ट्वा भीतभीतः पुरंदरः । निर्गतः स ततो दृष्ट्वा शक्रो ऽयमिति चिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration: āgataṃ gautamaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītabhītaḥ puraṃdaraḥ / nirgataḥ sa tato dṛṣṭvā śakro 'yamiti cintayan
verses.translation: Pitamahas (manes) grant thousands of aerial chariots attended by groups of Apsaras-s and richly equipped with all desirable things.
verses.hindi: वे शुक व्यास के संयोग से अरणी में घूम रहित अग्नि.के समान तेजोमय रूप में उत्पन्न होंगे और पित्तरों
verses.wordMeaning: Pitamahas (manes) grant thousands of aerial chariots attended by groups of Apsaras-s and richly equipped with all desirable things.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitamahas (manes) grant thousands of aerial chariots attended by groups of Apsaras-s and richly equipped with all desirable things.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शशाप देवेन्द्रं गौतमः क्रोधमूर्छितः । अजितेन्द्रियो ऽसि यस्मात्त्वं तस्माद् बहुभगो भव
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaśāpa devendraṃ gautamaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ / ajitendriyo 'si yasmāttvaṃ tasmād bahubhago bhava
verses.translation: Intellect, nourishment, power of memory, brain, kingdom and health can be attained only through the grace of the noble-souled Pitrs.
verses.hindi: क्ृष्णं गोरं प्रभुं शंभूं तथा भूरिश्रुतं च बे । कन्या कोतिमतीं चेव. योगिनीं योगमातरम् ब्रह्मदत्तत्य जननो महिषी त्वणुहस्य तु । एतानुत्पाद्य धर्मात्मा पुत्रान्योगमवापष्य च
verses.wordMeaning: Intellect, nourishment, power of memory, brain, kingdom and health can be attained only through the grace of the noble-souled Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Intellect, nourishment, power of memory, brain, kingdom and health can be attained only through the grace of the noble-souled Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन्द्रस्तत्क्षणादेव भारत । भगानां तु सहस्रेण तत्क्षणाद् एव वेष्टितः
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu devendrastatkṣaṇādeva bhārata / bhagānāṃ tu sahasreṇa tatkṣaṇād eva veṣṭitaḥ
verses.translation: Pitamahas grant crores of gems, pearls, lapis lazuli, garments and thousands of horses and elephants.
verses.hindi: सर्वव्यापी विनिर्मुक्तो भविष्यति महामुनिः। अमू्तिमन्‍्तः पितरो धर्ंमृतिधरास्तु ये
verses.wordMeaning: Pitamahas grant crores of gems, pearls, lapis lazuli, garments and thousands of horses and elephants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitamahas grant crores of gems, pearls, lapis lazuli, garments and thousands of horses and elephants.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा राज्यं सुरैः सार्द्धं गतश्रीको जगाम ह । तपश्चचार विपुलं गौतमेन महीतले
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā rājyaṃ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ gataśrīko jagāma ha / tapaścacāra vipulaṃ gautamena mahītale
verses.translation: Pitamahas always bestow on men chariots fitted with swans and peacocks, studded with pearls and lapis lazuli and decorated with tinkling bells and provided with perpetual flowers and fruits.
verses.hindi: उतपन्नास्ते स्वधायास्तु कन्या ह्ग्ने: कबेः सुता: । पितरो देवलोकेषु ज्योतिर्भासिषु भास्वराः सर्वकामसमृद्धेषु द्विजास्तात्भावयन्त्युत । एतेषां मानसी कन्या गौर्नास दिवि विश्वुता
verses.wordMeaning: Pitamahas always bestow on men chariots fitted with swans and peacocks, studded with pearls and lapis lazuli and decorated with tinkling bells and provided with perpetual flowers and fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitamahas always bestow on men chariots fitted with swans and peacocks, studded with pearls and lapis lazuli and decorated with tinkling bells and provided with perpetual flowers and fruits.

verses.sanskrit: अहल्यापि ततः शप्ता यस्मात् त्वं दुष्टचारिणी । प्रेक्ष्य मां रमसे शक्रं तस्माद् अश्ममयी भव
verses.transliteration: ahalyāpi tataḥ śaptā yasmāt tvaṃ duṣṭacāriṇī / prekṣya māṃ ramase śakraṃ tasmād aśmamayī bhava
verses.translation: It is said (in Dharma-Sastra) that the vessels of (meant for) Pitrs should be made of gold, silver or copper. A silver or
verses.hindi: मरोचिगर्भास्ते लोकाः समावृत्य दिवि श्रुताः। एते ह्यद्धिरसः पुत्राः साध्य:ः सह विवधिताः
verses.wordMeaning: It is said (in Dharma-Sastra) that the vessels of (meant for) Pitrs should be made of gold, silver or copper. A silver or
verses.commentary: Sense: It is said (in Dharma-Sastra) that the vessels of (meant for) Pitrs should be made of gold, silver or copper. A silver or

verses.sanskrit: गते वर्षसहस्रान्ते रामं दृष्ट्वा यशस्विनम् । तीर्थयात्राप्रसङ्गेन धौतपापा भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: gate varṣasahasrānte rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā yaśasvinam / tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena dhautapāpā bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: Showing or gifting away of silver is proclaimed to be
verses.hindi: की मानसी कन्या उस पीवरी में सुविख्यात योगाचार्य ऋष्ण, गौर, प्रभु, शंभु तथा भूरिश्रुत नामक पुत्रों को तथा परम योगिनी योगमाता कौतिमती नामक कन्या को वे उत्पन्न करेंगे । वह कीतिमती अणुह की पत्नी ओर ब्रह्मदत्त की माता होगी। धर्मात्मा शुक्र अपने महान् तप एवं योग से इन पुत्रों की उत्पत्ति करने के बाद उस परम गति को प्राप्त होंगे, जिसको प्राप्त कर पुनरावतंन नहीं होता । सूयं की किरणों के समान . परम तेज को भ्राप्त होकर वे पुनजेन्त्र को न॒प्र'प्त होंगे। इस प्रकार वे महामुनि समस्त चराचर जगतु में व्याप्त होकर सांसारिक बन्धनों से विनिमुक्त हो जायेंगे । धर्म मूति धारण करनेवाले जो पितरगण हैं वे भमूर्त हैं इसके तीन गण हैं । है द्विजश्रेष्ठ, अब मैं उन अन्य चार पितरों के बारे में बतला रहा हूँ, जो परम कान्ति- मान स्वरूपधारी हैं, उन्हें पुनिये ।२६-३४।॥ वे पितर गण कवि अग्नि को पुत्री स्वधा से उत्पन्न हुये हैं, और
verses.wordMeaning: Showing or gifting away of silver is proclaimed to be
verses.commentary: Sense: Showing or gifting away of silver is proclaimed to be

verses.sanskrit: एवं गते ततः काले दृष्टा रामेण धीमता । विश्वामित्रसहायेन त्यक्त्वा साश्ममयीं तनुम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ gate tataḥ kāle dṛṣṭā rāmeṇa dhīmatā / viśvāmitrasahāyena tyaktvā sāśmamayīṃ tanum
verses.translation: O dear one, it was in silver vessel that Svadha was
verses.hindi: ज्थोतिर्मास चामक देबलोको में उनका निवास स्थान है, स्वयमेव ये पितरमण बहुत तेजोमय हैं। सभी अभिला- षाओं को पूर्ण करनेवाले उन ज्योतिमेय लोकों में विराजमान पितरों की द्विजगण इसी प्रकार से भावना करते हैं। इनकी मानसो कन्या गो हैं, जो स्वर्ग लोक में विख्यात है। सनत्कुमार) ने गौ को शुक्र को सौंपा था जहाँ पर वह शुक्र की प्रिया स्त्री हुई। भृगुबंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले परम यशस्वी इंकतीस पितरगण बहुत विख्यात हुये ।
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one, it was in silver vessel that Svadha was
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, it was in silver vessel that Svadha was

verses.sanskrit: पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं गतपापा विमत्सरा । आगता नर्मदातीरे तीर्थे स्नात्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ gatapāpā vimatsarā / āgatā narmadātīre tīrthe snātvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Cf. V, 5 ouDh.S 79.14-15. Yajnavalkya I. 236 specially recommends silver vessels. Cf also Mt. 19-22, Bd. 3.11-1.
verses.hindi: उनके लोक मरीचिग्रभं के नाम से विख्यात हुये, जो समस्त स्वर्ग लोक को आवृत करके स्थित हैं, ऐसा उतके स्वर्ग लोक में परम तेजोमय उपहृत नामक पितरगण विर।जमान हैं उन क्षत्रियों के पितरगणों की शुभ फल की
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. V, 5 ouDh.S 79.14-15. Yajnavalkya I. 236 specially recommends silver vessels. Cf also Mt. 19-22, Bd. 3.11-1.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. V, 5 ouDh.S 79.14-15. Yajnavalkya I. 236 specially recommends silver vessels. Cf also Mt. 19-22, Bd. 3.11-1.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं चान्द्रायणं मासं कृच्छ्रं चान्यं ततः परम् । ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो दत्त्वा वरमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ māsaṃ kṛcchraṃ cānyaṃ tataḥ param / tatastuṣṭo mahādevo dattvā varamanuttamam
verses.translation: Vessels made of gold, silver or copper, gingelly seeds Kutapa (i.e. the eighth muhurta of the day) or Kusa grass' sesamum seeds, garments and Tridanfi Toga (i. e. the Yoga of mind, speech and body)—all these are holy, objects.
verses.hindi: १. आनन्दाश्रम की प्रति में जो पाठ है, उससे यह अर्थ भिन्‍न है।
verses.wordMeaning: Vessels made of gold, silver or copper, gingelly seeds Kutapa (i.e. the eighth muhurta of the day) or Kusa grass' sesamum seeds, garments and Tridanfi Toga (i. e. the Yoga of mind, speech and body)—all these are holy, objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vessels made of gold, silver or copper, gingelly seeds Kutapa (i.e. the eighth muhurta of the day) or Kusa grass' sesamum seeds, garments and Tridanfi Toga (i. e. the Yoga of mind, speech and body)—all these are holy, objects.

verses.sanskrit: जगामादर्शनं भूयो रेमे चोमापतिश्चिरम् । अहल्या तु गते देवे स्थापयित्वा जगद्गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: jagāmādarśanaṃ bhūyo reme comāpatiściram / ahalyā tu gate deve sthāpayitvā jagadgurum
verses.translation: In the holy rite of Sraddha, the following ritual prescribed by god Brahma is the most excellent and eternal. It is conducive to increase in fame, longevity, progeny,' intellect and lineage.
verses.hindi: राजर्षेजननी देवी खट्वाड्रस्य महात्मनः । यस्य यज्ञे पुरा गीता गाथा दिव्येमह्िभिः ॥४ १ अग्नेजेन्स तथा दुृष्ट्वा शाण्डिल्यस्य महात्मनः । यजमानं दिलोप॑ ये पश्यन्ति सुसमाहिताः. सत्यत्नतं महात्मानं ते स्वर्ग जयिनो5सरा: । आज्यपा नाम पितरः कर्दमस्य प्रजापते: ४३ समुत्पन्नस्य पुलहादुत्पन्नास्तस्य वे पुनः । लोकेष्वेतेषु वर्तन्ते कामग्रेषु विहंगमा:ः ४४
verses.wordMeaning: In the holy rite of Sraddha, the following ritual prescribed by god Brahma is the most excellent and eternal. It is conducive to increase in fame, longevity, progeny,' intellect and lineage.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the holy rite of Sraddha, the following ritual prescribed by god Brahma is the most excellent and eternal. It is conducive to increase in fame, longevity, progeny,' intellect and lineage.

verses.sanskrit: अहल्येश्वरनामानं स्वगृहे चागमत्पुनः । तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ahalyeśvaranāmānaṃ svagṛhe cāgamatpunaḥ / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram
verses.translation: In the south-east direction, especially at the intermedi¬ ate point (corner) between them, (should be the place—altar inBd. P.—for Sraddha). It should be well-situated and square shaped with sides equal to an Aratni (the distance between the tip of the fist and the elbow). I shall mention the proper spot for the holy rites of Pitrs in accordance with the injunctions of the scriptures. It is conducive to the attainment of wealth, health and longevity. It enhances strength and brightness of complexion.
verses.hindi: ययातेजननी साध्वी पत्नी सा नहुषस्य तु । सुकाला नाम पितरो बसिष्ठस्य प्रजापते:
verses.wordMeaning: In the south-east direction, especially at the intermedi¬ ate point (corner) between them, (should be the place—altar inBd. P.—for Sraddha). It should be well-situated and square shaped with sides equal to an Aratni (the distance between the tip of the fist and the elbow).…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the south-east direction, especially at the intermedi¬ ate point (corner) between them, (should be the place—altar inBd. P.—for Sraddha). It should be well-situated and square shaped with sides equal to an Aratni (the distance between the tip of the fist and the elbow).…

verses.sanskrit: स मृतः स्वर्गमाप्नोति यत्र देवो महेश्वरः । क्रीडयित्वा यथाकामं तत्र लोके महातपाः
verses.transliteration: sa mṛtaḥ svargamāpnoti yatra devo maheśvaraḥ / krīḍayitvā yathākāmaṃ tatra loke mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: At the place (intended for Sraddha), three pits (should be dug) and three sticks of Khadira wood should be placed. They (the sticks) should be an Aratni (distance between the tip of the fist and the elbow) in length and should be embellished with silver (bands). (The pits) should be a Vitasti (the span or the distance between thumb and little finger when they are extend¬ ed on either side) in depth* and the four sides should be four Angulas (fingers) each.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भस्य सुताः शुद्रास्तान्भावयन्त्युत । मानसा नाम ते लोका बहन्ते यत्र ते दिवि (३४७ एतेषां मानसी कन्या नमंदा सरितां बरा। सा भावयति भुतानि दक्षिणापथगामिनी तस्मादिह स्वधर्मेण भ्राद्धं देयं तु शद्धया । सर्वेषां राजतेः पात्रेरपि वा रजतान्वित॑: ५१
verses.wordMeaning: At the place (intended for Sraddha), three pits (should be dug) and three sticks of Khadira wood should be placed. They (the sticks) should be an Aratni (distance between the tip of the fist and the elbow) in length and should be embellished with silver (bands).…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the place (intended for Sraddha), three pits (should be dug) and three sticks of Khadira wood should be placed. They (the sticks) should be an Aratni (distance between the tip of the fist and the elbow) in length and should be embellished with silver (bands).…

verses.sanskrit: गते वर्षसहस्रान्ते मानुष्यं लभते पुनः । धनधान्यचयोपेतः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: gate varṣasahasrānte mānuṣyaṃ labhate punaḥ / dhanadhānyacayopetaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: The sticks should not be hollow and they must be plac¬ ed on the ground with their faces pointing to the south-east. (The performer of Sraddha) should be pure and should wash them with holy waters or water rendered holy by the use of the ring of Darbha grass (called Pauitra ) worn by the per¬ former of Sraddha. The purification (Sodhana) may be carried out with goat's milk or cow's milk and water. By means of this Tarpana ( holy water-offering) the satisfaction (of Pitrs) will be permanent.
verses.hindi: प्राप्ति के द॒शछक प्राणी भावना ध्यान या पूजा करते हैं। इनकी मानसी कन्या यशोदा नाम से विख्यात है, जो विश्व महत की पत्नी, बिह्वशर्मा को पुत्र वध और उस महात्मा राजषि खट्वाज़ू की माता थी। प्राचीन काल में जिसके यज्ञ में दिव्य गुण सम्पन्न महर्षियों ने गाथाओं का गान किया था ।३८-४१। स्वर्ग के जीतने वाले समाहित चित्त वृत्ति सम्पन्न वे पितरमण यज्ञ में अग्नि का जन्म देखने के उपरान्त महात्मा शाण्डिल्य के सत्यब्रत
verses.wordMeaning: The sticks should not be hollow and they must be plac¬ ed on the ground with their faces pointing to the south-east.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sticks should not be hollow and they must be plac¬ ed on the ground with their faces pointing to the south-east.…

verses.sanskrit: वेदविद्याश्रयो धीमाञ्जायते विमले कुले । रूपसौभाग्यसम्पन्नः सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः । जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रम् अहल्यातीर्थसेवनात्
verses.transliteration: vedavidyāśrayo dhīmāñjāyate vimale kule / rūpasaubhāgyasampannaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ / jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgram ahalyātīrthasevanāt
verses.translation: He will be prosperous here and hereafter. He will be (blessed with the fruits of) all holy rites. If a person always takes bath three times a day and worships Pitrs with Mantras as per prescribed procedure, he gets the fruit of (performance) of a horse-sacrifice {Asvamedha ').
verses.hindi: परायण एवं महात्मा यजमान दिलीप का दर्शन करते हैं जिनके नाम आज्यपा हैं, ये प्रजापति कदंम के पि-रगण हैं जिनकी उत्पत्ति पुलह से हुई थी, उनन्‍्हों के यहाँ इनकी पुनः उत्पत्ति हुई, इन लोकों में ये आकाशचारी पितरगण अपने इच्छानुरूप भ्रमण करते हैं। शुभ फल प्राप्ति के इच्छुक वहयगण श्राद्धों में इन की भावना करते हैं । इन की मानसी कन्या विरजा नाम से विख्यात है, जो ययाति की माता और नहुष की प्रतिव्रता पत्नी थी ।४२-४५३। प्रजापति वशिष्ठ के सुकाल नामक पितरगण हैं, जो हिरण्य गर्भ के पुत्र हैं। इन पितरों की भावना शुद्र लोग करते हैं। स्वगं में मानस नामक लोक हैं, जिनमें ये निवास करते हैं। इनकी मानसी कन्या नदियों में श्रेष्ठ नमंदा है, (भारतभूमि) के दक्षिणापथ में बहती हुई वह सभी जौवों को पवित्र करती है। वह नमंदा त्रसदस्यु की भाता और पुरुकुत्स को पत्नी थी। इन्हीं उपयुक्त पितरों
verses.wordMeaning: He will be prosperous here and hereafter. He will be (blessed with the fruits of) all holy rites. If a person always takes bath three times a day and worships Pitrs with Mantras as per prescribed procedure, he gets the fruit of (performance) of a horse-sacrifice {Asvamedha ').
verses.commentary: Sense: He will be prosperous here and hereafter. He will be (blessed with the fruits of) all holy rites. If a person always takes bath three times a day and worships Pitrs with Mantras as per prescribed procedure, he gets the fruit of (performance) of a horse-sacrifice {Asvamedha ').

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अहल्यातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षट्त्रिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १३७ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: धर्मपुत्र ततो गच्छेत् कर्कटेश्वरमुत्तमम् । उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले सर्वपापक्षयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ahalyātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 137 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dharmaputra tato gacchet karkaṭeśvaramuttamam / uttare narmadākūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: On the New Moon day, the Sraddha materials should be placed in the pit in the ground four Angulas square. These rituals are called Trih-sapla-yajna (Three-times seven Yajiia). All the three worlds are sustained by them.
verses.hindi: के कारण मनु मन्वन्तर के अधीशवर हैं ।४६-४९। और मन्वन्तर के आदिम काल में वे सब प्रक्कार के श्राद्धों का प्रवर्तन करते हैं । द्विजबयंवृल्द, समस्त पितरों का वर्णन क्रमशः आप लोगों को सुना चुका । इन सब कारणों से मनुष्य को इस लोक में आकर अपने धमं के अनुसार श्रद्धापूवंक श्राद्धादि कम करने चाहिए, इन सत्र में
verses.wordMeaning: On the New Moon day, the Sraddha materials should be placed in the pit in the ground four Angulas square. These rituals are called Trih-sapla-yajna (Three-times seven Yajiia). All the three worlds are sustained by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the New Moon day, the Sraddha materials should be placed in the pit in the ground four Angulas square. These rituals are called Trih-sapla-yajna (Three-times seven Yajiia). All the three worlds are sustained by them.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन यस्तु पूजयते शिवम् । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य रुद्रलोकाद् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā vidhānena yastu pūjayate śivam / anivartikā gatistasya rudralokād asaṃśayam
verses.translation: He will attain nourishment, prosperity, longevity and progeny. Various types of fortune will resort to him and he will gradually attain liberation (from Samsara).
verses.hindi: चक्र हक चायुपुराणम् जे छदगायन चाग्नो च॑ अश्वमेंघं तदाप्नुयात् । पितुन्प्रीणाति वे भकत्या पितरः प्रीणयन्सि तमू
verses.wordMeaning: He will attain nourishment, prosperity, longevity and progeny. Various types of fortune will resort to him and he will gradually attain liberation (from Samsara).
verses.commentary: Sense: He will attain nourishment, prosperity, longevity and progeny. Various types of fortune will resort to him and he will gradually attain liberation (from Samsara).

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं पुराणे यच्छ्रुतं मया । न तद्वर्णयितुं शक्यं संक्षेपेण वदाम्यतः
verses.transliteration: tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ purāṇe yacchrutaṃ mayā / na tadvarṇayituṃ śakyaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa vadāmyataḥ
verses.translation: It removes sins. It sanctifies. It has the same fruit as a horse-sacrifice. I shall mention that Mantra composed by Brahma. It is the Amrla (immortal or nectarine) and it is honoured and worshipped by Brahmanas and grants (the fruit of) Asvamedha.
verses.hindi: पितरः पुष्टिकामस्य प्रजाकामस्य वां पुनः  पुष्टि प्रजां व स्थर्ग व प्रयच्छन्ति स संशय: ५४ देवकार्यादपि सदा पितृकायें विशिष्यते + देवताभ्य: पितृणां हि पु्वंसाप्यायमं स्मतुतमू॒...
verses.wordMeaning: It removes sins. It sanctifies. It has the same fruit as a horse-sacrifice. I shall mention that Mantra composed by Brahma. It is the Amrla (immortal or nectarine) and it is honoured and worshipped by Brahmanas and grants (the fruit of) Asvamedha.
verses.commentary: Sense: It removes sins. It sanctifies. It has the same fruit as a horse-sacrifice. I shall mention that Mantra composed by Brahma. It is the Amrla (immortal or nectarine) and it is honoured and worshipped by Brahmanas and grants (the fruit of) Asvamedha.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कुर्यात्किंचित्कर्म शुभाशुभम् । हर्षान् मदान् महाराज तत्सर्वं जायते ऽक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kuryātkiṃcitkarma śubhāśubham / harṣān madān mahārāja tatsarvaṃ jāyate 'kṣayam
verses.translation: The Mantra: "Obeisance to all the deities, to Pitrs, to the great Yogins, to Svadha. Obeisance for ever to Svaha.". 1
verses.hindi: इत्येते पितरश्चेव्र लोका दुहितरश्व ब। दोहिन्रा यजमानाश्र प्रोक्ता ये भावयन्ति तानू. .... . चत्वारों मुतिमन्तश्र त्रथस्तेषामसूर्तेयः + तेभ्यः भाद्धानि सत्कृत्य देवा; कुवेल्ति यत्ततः -
verses.wordMeaning: The Mantra: "Obeisance to all the deities, to Pitrs, to the great Yogins, to Svadha. Obeisance for ever to Svaha.". 1
verses.commentary: Sense: The Mantra: "Obeisance to all the deities, to Pitrs, to the great Yogins, to Svadha. Obeisance for ever to Svaha.". 1

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तपस्तप्त्वा वालखिल्या मरीचयः । रमन्ते ऽद्यापि लोकेषु स्वेच्छया कुरुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā vālakhilyā marīcayaḥ / ramante 'dyāpi lokeṣu svecchayā kurunandana
verses.translation: At the beginning and the conclusion of the Sraddha, this Mantra shall always be repeated three times. The devotee shall repeat tins with purity of mind, when he offers the balls of rice also. Pitrs arrive quickly and Raksasas flee.
verses.hindi: अक्ता: प्राज्जजय: सर्वे सेन््रास्तदृगतमान्सा: । विश्वे च सिकताश्चेव पृश्निजा: शूद्धिन (ण)स्तथा ॥ : कृष्णा: श्वेतास्त्वजाश्येब्र विधिवत्युजयन्त्युत । प्रजएता वातरशना दिवाकीरत्यास्तथव व.
verses.wordMeaning: At the beginning and the conclusion of the Sraddha, this Mantra shall always be repeated three times. The devotee shall repeat tins with purity of mind, when he offers the balls of rice also. Pitrs arrive quickly and Raksasas flee.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the beginning and the conclusion of the Sraddha, this Mantra shall always be repeated three times. The devotee shall repeat tins with purity of mind, when he offers the balls of rice also. Pitrs arrive quickly and Raksasas flee.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रस्थास्तन्न जानन्ति नराज्ञानबहिष्कृताः । शरीरस्थम् इवात्मानम् अक्षयं ज्योतिख्ययम्
verses.transliteration: tatrasthāstanna jānanti narājñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ / śarīrastham ivātmānam akṣayaṃ jyotikhyayam
verses.translation: ' Regularly repeated at the time of Sraddha by expoun¬ ders of Brahman, this Mantra enables Pitrs to cross (hell) in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: लेखाश्र मस्तश्चव ब्रह्माद्याश्न विदोकसः  अभिष्ृग्वद्धिराद्याश्व ऋषयः सर्वे एव च  ॥१६ ३ यक्षा नागा: सुपर्गाश्च किनरा राक्षस: सह 4 पितृ स्त्व॒पुजयन्सर्वे तित्यमेव फलाथिमः: .... कि डे तर - ह ध्ा है 7 टू ले    “ : ््ीऑ ृऔघृ 2€ल्‍छ ी यू ७0 री उरी रऊरउ2/॒॑ ३ ३ऑ२28क्‍ ८ ----+- हा येक॑ या प.+५०५ ० -  है जा  4 ३. ; नि हि डर
verses.wordMeaning: ' Regularly repeated at the time of Sraddha by expoun¬ ders of Brahman, this Mantra enables Pitrs to cross (hell) in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: ' Regularly repeated at the time of Sraddha by expoun¬ ders of Brahman, this Mantra enables Pitrs to cross (hell) in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नृपश्रेष्ठ देवी नारायणी पुरा । अद्यापि तपते घोरं तपो यावत्किलार्बुदम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha devī nārāyaṇī purā / adyāpi tapate ghoraṃ tapo yāvatkilārbudam
verses.translation: I shall mention the Mantra Saptarcis that is auspicious and that bestows all desires. By repeating it regularly, Pitrs are propitiated. 6 1 1 The Saptarcis 1 Mantra: "I always make obeisance to those who are engaged in meditation by means of the yogic
verses.hindi: चाँदी के बने हुये अथवा मिश्रित चाँदी के बने हुये पात्रों में रखकर पितरों के उद्देश्य से पुरोहित को दी गई स्वधा पितरों को. प्रसन्न करती है। सोम, अग्नि एवं सूम्रपुत्र मनु को स्वधादि से खूब सच्तुष्ट करके तथा सुथ के उत्तटस्तयण़ के अवसर पर अग्नि .में हव॒नादि करके अश्वमेध के फल की प्राप्ति होती है। जो भक्ति पूवेक पितरों को- भ्राद्धादि से प्रश्नन्न करता है, .उसे पितरगण भी, सन्तुष्ठ एवं प्रसन्न करते हैं ।५०-५३। पुष्टि (वृद्धि)
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention the Mantra Saptarcis that is auspicious and that bestows all desires. By repeating it regularly, Pitrs are propitiated. 6 1 1 The Saptarcis 1 Mantra: "I always make obeisance to those who are engaged in meditation by means of the yogic
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the Mantra Saptarcis that is auspicious and that bestows all desires. By repeating it regularly, Pitrs are propitiated. 6 1 1 The Saptarcis 1 Mantra: "I always make obeisance to those who are engaged in meditation by means of the yogic

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः । तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि तृप्तिं यान्ति पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptiṃ yānti pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: I bow to the Seven Sages and Pitrs who fulHl all desires and who are the progenitors of Indra and other (Dcvas) and of Bhrgu and Marlca (Kasyapa).
verses.hindi: क्षयवा प्रजा (पुत्र पौत्रादि) की कामना करनेवालों के पितरगण पुष्टि, प्रजा एवं स्वर्ग को प्रदान करते हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं । पितरों के उद्देश से किसे ,ज़ाने वाले श्राद्भधादि क्रार्य, देवताओं के उद्देर्य से किये जानेवःले यज्ञाद़ि कार्यों से भी अधिक फलदायी हैं 4 देवज्नाओं से.पहिले पितरों को सन्‍्तुष्ट करना चाहिए--ऐसा प्रसिद्ध है । पितरों की यह सूक्ष्म योग गति और तृप्ति मांस के नेत्र, से नहीं देश्ली जा सकती, तपस्या द्वास विशेष सिद्धि प्राप्त करने प्र ही: उनकी इस गति एवं तृप्ति का दर्शन हो सकता है।. इन.उपचुेक्त पितरगणों, - उनके लोक, उनकी कथाएँ, उनके दोहित्र, उनके बजमात्त एवं उनकी; भावना करने वाले सब. का ;वर्णन कर चुका । इन
verses.wordMeaning: I bow to the Seven Sages and Pitrs who fulHl all desires and who are the progenitors of Indra and other (Dcvas) and of Bhrgu and Marlca (Kasyapa).
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow to the Seven Sages and Pitrs who fulHl all desires and who are the progenitors of Indra and other (Dcvas) and of Bhrgu and Marlca (Kasyapa).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कर्कटेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तत्रिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १३८ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत् पाण्डुपुत्र शक्रतीर्थम् अनुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धो महाभागो देवराजः शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karkaṭeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 138 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet pāṇḍuputra śakratīrtham anuttamam / yatra siddho mahābhāgo devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ
verses.translation: After bowing to all the Pitrs who bestow welfare on Manu and other lords of Suras and on the sun and the moon, I bow down with palms joined in reverence to Pitamahas, the progenitors of the constellations, the mobile (and the immobile beings) and of the heaven and the earth.
verses.hindi: (जैसा कि-ऊपर भी कई बार कहू; चुके हैं). चार-मूतिधारी-है, और तीन ,अमुर्त हैं। देवगृण् प्रत्येक यत्न से सत्कारपुवंक उन सब का श्राद्ध करते हैं ।(४-६०। इच्द्रः समेत वे समस्त देवंगण,इन -पितरों में मन्-लगाकर।॥ हाथ जोड़कर् - उनके श्राद्धांदि कार्य सम्पन्न करते हैं। इनके साथ समस्त विश्वेदेवगण, सिकता, पृश्निज़, श्द्धिन, कृष्ण, ब्वेत, अज आदि .भी इन. पितरों को- विधिवतु,पूज़ा . करते हैं.। :वातरशक, -दिवाकीत्य नामक
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing to all the Pitrs who bestow welfare on Manu and other lords of Suras and on the sun and the moon, I bow down with palms joined in reverence to Pitamahas, the progenitors of the constellations, the mobile (and the immobile beings) and of the heaven and the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to all the Pitrs who bestow welfare on Manu and other lords of Suras and on the sun and the moon, I bow down with palms joined in reverence to Pitamahas, the progenitors of the constellations, the mobile (and the immobile beings) and of the heaven and the earth.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमेन पुरा शप्तं ज्ञात्वा देवाः सुरेश्वरम् । ब्रह्माद्या देवताः सर्व ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: gautamena purā śaptaṃ jñātvā devāḥ sureśvaram / brahmādyā devatāḥ sarva ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence I bow down to those who bestow fearlessness, to those who are revered by all the worlds and to the progenitors of the divine sages.
verses.hindi: प्रजायें; लेख, मरुत,, ब्रह्मा आदि देवगण, अन्रि भृगु अंगिरा आदि सम्रस्त ऋषिगण, यक्ष, नाम सुपर, किन्नर.एवं दाक्षस, ये सभी शुभ फल प्राप्ति: के इच्छुक होकर नित्य ही इन पितरों क़ी पूजा.करते हैं।६१:६७। श्राद्धाद्वि में एवमेते महात्मानः श्राद्धे सत्कृत्य पुजिताः । सर्वान्कासान्प्रयच्छन्ति शतशो5थ सहत्नशः ७४६५ हित्वा त्रेलोक्यसंसारं जरामृत्युभयं तथा। मोक्ष योगमर्थेश्च्य प्रयचछन्ति पितामहाः १६६ मोक्षोपायमर्थश्वर्य सुक्ष्मदेहाश्व॒ देवता: । कृत्स्नं वेराग्यमानन्त्यं प्रथच्छच्ति पितामहा: १६७ ऐश्वर्य विहित॑ं योगमैश्वर्य वित्तमुत्तमम् । यौगेश्वर्यादृते मोक्षः कर्थ विच्नोपपद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: With palms joined in reverence I bow down to those who bestow fearlessness, to those who are revered by all the worlds and to the progenitors of the divine sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence I bow down to those who bestow fearlessness, to those who are revered by all the worlds and to the progenitors of the divine sages.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमं प्रार्थयामासुर् वाक्यैः सानुनयैः शुभैः । गतराज्यं गतश्रीकं शक्रं प्रति मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: gautamaṃ prārthayāmāsur vākyaiḥ sānunayaiḥ śubhaiḥ / gatarājyaṃ gataśrīkaṃ śakraṃ prati munīśvara
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence, I bow down to Praja- pati, Kasyapa, Soma, Varuna and to the lords of all Yoga.
verses.hindi: अपक्षस्थेव गमन गमने पक्षिणो यथा । वरिष्ठः सर्वधर्माणां मोक्षधर्मं: सनातनः ६६ विमानायां सहल्लाणि युक्तान्यप्सरसां गणेः। सर्वकामप्रसिद्धानि प्रथच्छन्ति पितामहाः १७० प्रज्ञा पुष्टि: स्कृतिमेंधा राज्यमारोग्यमेव च । पितृणां हि प्रसादेन आ्रप्यते धुमहात्मनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: With palms joined in reverence, I bow down to Praja- pati, Kasyapa, Soma, Varuna and to the lords of all Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence, I bow down to Praja- pati, Kasyapa, Soma, Varuna and to the lords of all Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रेन रहितं राज्यं न कश्चित् कामयेद् द्विज । देवो वा मानवो वापि एतत्ते विदितं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: indrena rahitaṃ rājyaṃ na kaścit kāmayed dvija / devo vā mānavo vāpi etatte viditaṃ prabho
verses.translation: Obeisance to the seven groups of Pitrs in the seven worlds. Obeisance to the self-born Brahma of Yogic vision."
verses.hindi: मुक्तावेदूयबासांसि वाजिनागायुतानि च । कोटिशश्रवापि रत्नानि प्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः इति श्री महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पो नाम त्रिसप्ततितमोथ्ध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the seven groups of Pitrs in the seven worlds. Obeisance to the self-born Brahma of Yogic vision."
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the seven groups of Pitrs in the seven worlds. Obeisance to the self-born Brahma of Yogic vision."

verses.sanskrit: तस्य त्वं भगयुक्तस्य दयां कुरु द्विजोत्तम । गतश्चादर्शनं शक्रो दूषितः स्वेन पाप्मना
verses.transliteration: tasya tvaṃ bhagayuktasya dayāṃ kuru dvijottama / gataścādarśanaṃ śakro dūṣitaḥ svena pāpmanā
verses.translation: Thus the Mantra honoured by the groups of Brahmar-?is along with the Seven Sages has been mentioned. It is highly holy and sanctified. It is conducive to prosperity and destruc¬ tive of Raksasas.
verses.hindi: 3.33... नरननिनननिना---निनानडिया-+- “० नितत। भा का (पक लीतण।णखणज /४४/+४४४+///४////"अअ्एऑआऑलक्‍ए
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the Mantra honoured by the groups of Brahmar-?is along with the Seven Sages has been mentioned. It is highly holy and sanctified. It is conducive to prosperity and destruc¬ tive of Raksasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the Mantra honoured by the groups of Brahmar-?is along with the Seven Sages has been mentioned. It is highly holy and sanctified. It is conducive to prosperity and destruc¬ tive of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit: देवानां वचनं श्रुत्वा गौतमो वेदवित्तमः । तथेति कृत्वा शक्रस्य वरं दातुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā gautamo vedavittamaḥ / tatheti kṛtvā śakrasya varaṃ dātuṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: The man who (performs Sraddha) according to these injunctions attains three boons. Pitrs grant food, longevity and childern (to the people) on the earth.
verses.hindi: सत्कारपूर्वक पूजित ये महात्मा पितर गण सेकड़ों सहस्नों की संख्या में मनुष्य के समस्त मनोरथों को पूर्ण करते हैं । तीनों लोक, संसार, वृद्धावस्था एवं पृत्यु के भय को छोड़कर पतामह-गण मोक्ष, योग-प्राप्ति एवं प्रचुर ऐदवर्य--इन सब को प्रदान करते हैं। सूक्ष्म शरीरधारी ये पितामहनामक देवगण (पितरगण) मोक्ष को प्राप्त करने योग्य ऐद्वर्य, समस्त जागतिक बस्तुओं से उत्पन्न होनेवाल अनन्त वराग्य को प्रदान करते हैं । अनुष्ठित (किया हुआ) योग ही ऐश्वर्य है, सर्वश्रेष्ठ सम्पत्ति भी एश्वय है । योग एवं ऐश्वयं के विना मोक्ष की प्राप्ति किसी प्रकार भी सम्भव नहीं ।६५-६८। जिस प्रकार विनाप॑ खे के आकाश में पक्षियों का उड़ना सम्भव नहीं है, उसी प्रकार योग एव ऐश्वर्य के बिना मोक्ष की प्राप्ति भी सम्भव नहीं है । सभी धर्मों में मोक्ष का साधनभूत धर्म ही सर्वश्रेष्ठ और सबंदा विद्यमान रहने बाला है। ये पितामहगण अप्सराओं के समूहों से
verses.wordMeaning: The man who (performs Sraddha) according to these injunctions attains three boons. Pitrs grant food, longevity and childern (to the people) on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who (performs Sraddha) according to these injunctions attains three boons. Pitrs grant food, longevity and childern (to the people) on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्भगसहस्रं तु पुरा जातं शतक्रतो । तल्लोचनसहस्रं तु मत्प्रसादाद् भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: etadbhagasahasraṃ tu purā jātaṃ śatakrato / tallocanasahasraṃ tu matprasādād bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: He who is endowed with great devotion, who has faith, who has controlled his senses and who always repeals this Sap¬ tarcis Mantra with purity, becomes the sole Emperor on the earth consisting of seven continents and oceans.
verses.hindi: घिरे हुये ऐसे सहस्रों विमानों को प्रदान करते हैं, जो समस्त मनोरथों को पूर्ण करते हैं। महात्मामण, बुद्धि, पुष्टि, स्मरण शक्ति, मेधा (घारणाशक्ति) राज्य, आरोग्य इन सब को पितरों के आशोर्वाद से प्राप्त करते हैं। पितामहगण मुक्ता, वबैदूये, विविध वस्त्र सहस्रों अश्व. नाग, करोड़ों रत्न, आदि भी प्रदान करते हैं। ये पितामह (पितर) गण हंस और वहियों से युक्त, मुक्ता और बेदूयं से समन्वित, किकिणी क्रे जालों से गुथे हुये
verses.wordMeaning: He who is endowed with great devotion, who has faith, who has controlled his senses and who always repeals this Sap¬ tarcis Mantra with purity, becomes the sole Emperor on the earth consisting of seven continents and oceans.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is endowed with great devotion, who has faith, who has controlled his senses and who always repeals this Sap¬ tarcis Mantra with purity, becomes the sole Emperor on the earth consisting of seven continents and oceans.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः सहस्राक्षः प्रणम्य मुनिसत्तमम् । ब्राह्मणांस् तान् महाभागान् नर्मदां प्रत्यगात् ततः
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ praṇamya munisattamam / brāhmaṇāṃs tān mahābhāgān narmadāṃ pratyagāt tataḥ
verses.translation: If any thing is cooked in the house, whether a dainty or ordinary eatable, it should never be eaten in that house with¬ out first offering it (to deities).
verses.hindi: सबंदा पृष्प और फलों से संयुक्त, (रथ को) प्रसन्न होकर नित्य प्रदान करते हैं श्रीबायुमहापुराथ में उपोद्धात में श्राद्धकल्पनामक तिहृत्तरवाँ अध्याय समाप्त
verses.wordMeaning: If any thing is cooked in the house, whether a dainty or ordinary eatable, it should never be eaten in that house with¬ out first offering it (to deities).
verses.commentary: Sense: If any thing is cooked in the house, whether a dainty or ordinary eatable, it should never be eaten in that house with¬ out first offering it (to deities).

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा स विमले तोये संस्थाप्य त्रिपुरान्तकम् । जगाम त्रिदशावासं पूज्यमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: snātvā sa vimale toye saṃsthāpya tripurāntakam / jagāma tridaśāvāsaṃ pūjyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shall describe in the proper order, the vessels intended for oblations to Pitrs. Even as I mention listen These seven verses 21-27 are called 'Saptarcis Mantra Gf. Bd. 3.11
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, I shall describe in the proper order, the vessels intended for oblations to Pitrs. Even as I mention listen These seven verses 21-27 are called 'Saptarcis Mantra Gf. Bd. 3.11
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, I shall describe in the proper order, the vessels intended for oblations to Pitrs. Even as I mention listen These seven verses 21-27 are called 'Saptarcis Mantra Gf. Bd. 3.11

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम् । परदाराभिगमनान् मुच्यते पातकान् नरः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / paradārābhigamanān mucyate pātakān naraḥ
verses.translation: As against Hemadri our text calls this 'saptarcis' Mantra.
verses.hindi: काच्चनं राजतं ताम्नं दौहित्रं कुतपस्तिला: । घस्रं च पावनीयानि त्रिदण्डी योग एव च ग्रहस्पति ने कहाः-- सुवर्ण, चाँदी, ओर तांबे के निर्मित पात्न पितरों के लिये कहे गये हैं, चाँदी अथवा चाँदी से मढ़ा हुआ पात्र भौ पितरों के लिये कहा गया है। चाँदी का दान, अभाव में उसका देन अथवा उसका नाम ले लेना भी पितरों को अनन्त अक्षय एवं स्वर्ग देनेवाला दान कहा जाता है। योग्य पुत्रगण इस चांदी के दान से अपने पितरों को तारते हैं ।१-२। है तात ! प्राचीनकाल में स्वधा देनेवाले फ्तिरो ने
verses.wordMeaning: As against Hemadri our text calls this 'saptarcis' Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: As against Hemadri our text calls this 'saptarcis' Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शक्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् नामाष्टत्रिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १३९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन् महाराज सोमतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यत्र सोमस्तपस्तप्त्वा नक्षत्रपथमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam nāmāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 139 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchen mahārāja somatīrthamanuttamam / yatra somastapastaptvā nakṣatrapathamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: It is cited (in scriptures that) a leaf of the Palasa tree (Buteafrondosa ) is conducive to Brahmanic splendour. 1 That kingdom is conceived (as the fruit, if leaves of) the ASvattha tree (are used): The lordship of all living beings is mentioned (in using the leaves of) Plaksa (citron-leaved Indian fig tree) [i.e. the materials of oblations must be placed in cups made of these leaves or the wood as in the case of some of the following].
verses.hindi: चांदी के पात्र में स्वधा का दोहन किया था, यही कारण है कि उसका दान अथवा उसके बने हुये पान्र में दान करने पर अक्षय फल प्राप्ति होती है। काले मृगचर्म का सान्निध्य, दर्शन अथवा दान भी राक्षसों का विनाश करनेवाला (अथवा राक्षसों का विनाशक एवं ब्राह्मतेजका वड्धक मंत्र) एवं ब्राह्मतेज को प्रदान करनेवाला है, पितरों के कार्य में इसका वितरण करना चाहिए ।३-४। सुवर्णनिभित, चाँदीनिमित, ताम्रनिमित, वस्तु दौहित्र,
verses.wordMeaning: It is cited (in scriptures that) a leaf of the Palasa tree (Buteafrondosa ) is conducive to Brahmanic splendour. 1 That kingdom is conceived (as the fruit,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is cited (in scriptures that) a leaf of the Palasa tree (Buteafrondosa ) is conducive to Brahmanic splendour. 1 That kingdom is conceived (as the fruit,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नायादाचम्य विधिपूर्वकम् । कृतजाप्यो रविं ध्यायेत् तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snāyādācamya vidhipūrvakam / kṛtajāpyo raviṃ dhyāyet tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Those who are desirous of prosperity, wisdom, intellect and power of memory (shall use the leaves of) the banyan tree.* The vessel of the leaves of Kasmari (a large tree called Gambhari also) is conducive to fame and destructive of Raksasas.
verses.hindi: कुतप) तिल, वस्त्र, अन्यात्य पवित्र वस्तुएं, त्रिदण्डी योग (वचन, मन एवं कर्म का योग) ये सब वस्तुएं श्रेष्ठ १. दिन ही के दूसरे प्रहर की पिछली घड़ी से लेकर तीसरे प्रहर की प हिली घड़ी तक का समय, नेपाल देश का कम्बल, कुश का तृण, आदि श्राद्ध कर्म की उपथोगी कई वस्तुओं का नाम कुतप है । परन्तु यहाँ पर समय से,
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are desirous of prosperity, wisdom, intellect and power of memory (shall use the leaves of) the banyan tree.* The vessel of the leaves of Kasmari (a large tree called Gambhari also) is conducive to fame and destructive of Raksasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are desirous of prosperity, wisdom, intellect and power of memory (shall use the leaves of) the banyan tree.* The vessel of the leaves of Kasmari (a large tree called Gambhari also) is conducive to fame and destructive of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्वेदयजुर्वेदाभ्यां सामवेदेन भारत । जपतो यत्फलं प्रोक्तं गायत्र्या चात्र तत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: ṛgvedayajurvedābhyāṃ sāmavedena bhārata / japato yatphalaṃ proktaṃ gāyatryā cātra tatphalam
verses.translation: That which is offered in Madhuka (the tree Bassia lalifolia ) is considered excellent and conducive to good fortune. One who performs Sraddha in the vessel of Phalgu (a kind of fig tree) attains all desires.
verses.hindi: नेपाली कम्बल से तथा कुश से तात्पय है
verses.wordMeaning: That which is offered in Madhuka (the tree Bassia lalifolia ) is considered excellent and conducive to good fortune. One who performs Sraddha in the vessel of Phalgu (a kind of fig tree) attains all desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: That which is offered in Madhuka (the tree Bassia lalifolia ) is considered excellent and conducive to good fortune. One who performs Sraddha in the vessel of Phalgu (a kind of fig tree) attains all desires.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेच्छुचिः । तेन सम्यग्विधानेन कोटिर्भवति भोजिता
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇān bhojayecchuciḥ / tena samyagvidhānena koṭirbhavati bhojitā
verses.translation: The performer attains supreme lustre, particularly all¬ round brilliance (if the sun-plant is used—Bd. P.). By using a Bilva vessel, riches, intellect and longevity are always attained.
verses.hindi: श्राउकर्मण्ययं श्रेष्ठो विधिबाह्या:ः सनातन: । आयुः कीर्ति: प्रजाश्चेव प्रज्ासंततिवर्धनन.... तत्र गर्तास्त्रयः कार्यत्रियों दण्डाश्न खादिराः । रत्निमात्रास्तु ते कार्या रजतेन विभूषिताः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The performer attains supreme lustre, particularly all¬ round brilliance (if the sun-plant is used—Bd. P.). By using a Bilva vessel, riches, intellect and longevity are always attained.
verses.commentary: Sense: The performer attains supreme lustre, particularly all¬ round brilliance (if the sun-plant is used—Bd. P.). By using a Bilva vessel, riches, intellect and longevity are always attained.

verses.sanskrit: पादुकोपानहौ छत्रं वस्त्रकम्बलवाजिनः । यो दत्ते विप्रमुख्याय तस्य तत्कोटिसंमितम्
verses.transliteration: pādukopānahau chatraṃ vastrakambalavājinaḥ / yo datte vipramukhyāya tasya tatkoṭisaṃmitam
verses.translation: If Sraddiha is performed in Bamboo vessels, Paijanya (cloud or the lord of rain) always showers in his fields, parks, lakes and all crops.
verses.hindi: ते वितस्त्यायताः कार्या: स्वंतभ्रतुरहगुला
verses.wordMeaning: If Sraddiha is performed in Bamboo vessels, Paijanya (cloud or the lord of rain) always showers in his fields, parks, lakes and all crops.
verses.commentary: Sense: If Sraddiha is performed in Bamboo vessels, Paijanya (cloud or the lord of rain) always showers in his fields, parks, lakes and all crops.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रं तु सहस्राणामनृचां यस्तु भोजयेत् । एकस्य मन्त्रयुक्तस्य कलां नार्हति षोडशीम्
verses.transliteration: sahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇāmanṛcāṃ yastu bhojayet / ekasya mantrayuktasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: It is said (in Sastras that) those who make Sraddha
verses.hindi: तत्स्थापयेदमावास्यां (? )गते मृचतुरइगुले । त्रिःसप्तसंज्ञास्ते यज्ञास्त्रलोक्यं धार्यते तु व् ३१२ कही गई हैं । श्राद्ध कर्म में यह सर्वश्रेष्ठ विधि सनातन से प्रचलित है--यह बाह्य नियम है। इन उपपुत्त वस्तुओं के द्वारा विधिपुर्वेक किया गया श्राद्धविधान श्राद्धकर्ता को आयु, कीर्ति प्रजा, बुद्धि, संतति आदि सब कुछ बढ़ानेवाला है; दक्षिण और पूव॑ की दिशा में, विशेषतया विदिक् (कोण) में श्राद्धकर्म का विधान है। सत्रेत्र अरत्नि” मान्न परिमाण का, चौकोर सुन्दर स्थान होना चाहिए । पितरी के कार्य में जो भादेश्न शास्त्रों के हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: It is said (in Sastras that) those who make Sraddha
verses.commentary: Sense: It is said (in Sastras that) those who make Sraddha

verses.sanskrit: एवं तु भोजयेत् तत्र बह्वृचं वेदपारगम् । शाखान्तर्गम् अथाध्वर्युं छन्दोगं वा समाप्तिगम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu bhojayet tatra bahvṛcaṃ vedapāragam / śākhāntargam athādhvaryuṃ chandogaṃ vā samāptigam
verses.translation: Verses 1-6 enumerate the different trees, the leaves (i.e. cups of the leaves) of which (if used for giving oblations to Pitrs) confer different benefits. The Sraddha Sutra of Katyayana recommends the use of (cups of leaves of) sacrificial trees for Arghya.
verses.hindi: उनके अनुसार स्थान के विषय में विधिवत् कह रहा हूं, जो धन देनेवाला आरोग्य साधक, दीर्घायु प्रदाता तथा बल ओर वर्ण की वृद्धि करनेवाला है ।५-८। पितरों के पर्युक्त श्राउचस्थल में तीन गढ़े बनाने चाहिए, जो परिमाण में रत्निमात्र' लम्बे और चाँदी से विभूषित हों, इसके अतिरिक्त खदिर के डइंड भी होने चाहिबे, जो वित्ते भर लम्बे हों उनके चारों ओर ज़्ार अंगुल मान के वेष्ठन बने हों । पूव और दक्षिण के मुल्क भाग की ओर
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 1-6 enumerate the different trees, the leaves (i.e. cups of the leaves) of which (if used for giving oblations to Pitrs) confer different benefits. The Sraddha Sutra of Katyayana recommends the use of (cups of leaves of) sacrificial trees for Arghya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 1-6 enumerate the different trees, the leaves (i.e. cups of the leaves) of which (if used for giving oblations to Pitrs) confer different benefits. The Sraddha Sutra of Katyayana recommends the use of (cups of leaves of) sacrificial trees for Arghya.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्रसहस्रस्य यत्फलं प्राप्यते बुधैः । समं तद्वेदविदुषा तीर्थे सोमस्य तत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: agnihotrasahasrasya yatphalaṃ prāpyate budhaiḥ / samaṃ tadvedaviduṣā tīrthe somasya tatphalam
verses.translation: He who always offers fragrant garlands to Pitrs
verses.hindi: से पृथ्वी पर रखे गये, छिद्र रहित, उन डण्डों को परमपवित्र जल से नहलाये ।६-१०। बकरी के अथवा गाय के दूध अथवा जल से उसको पुनः शुद्ध करे, इस प्रकार विधिपूर्वक तपंण करने से साबंकालिक तृप्ति होती है इस प्रकार विधिपूर्वक श्राद्धकमं का अनुष्ठान करनेवाला श्राणी ऐहिक-पारलौकिक विभूतिवों से सुसमृद्ध तथा सर्वे-कमं-समन्वित होता है । इसी प्रकार तीन बार सवन स्नान करके जो विधिपूर्वक मंत्रादि का उच्चारण कर भलीभाँति सर्वदा पितरों की पूजा करता है, वह अश्बमेध यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त करता है ।१२। अमावास्या तिथि को पृथ्वीतल पर चार अंगुल के गढ़े में श्राद्धोपयोगी वस्तुओं की स्थापना करनी चाहिए। ये त्रिःसप्तयज्ञ के
verses.wordMeaning: He who always offers fragrant garlands to Pitrs
verses.commentary: Sense: He who always offers fragrant garlands to Pitrs

verses.sanskrit: भोजयेद्यः शतं तेषां सहस्रं लभते नरः । एकस्य योगयुक्तस्य तत्फलं कवयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: bhojayedyaḥ śataṃ teṣāṃ sahasraṃ labhate naraḥ / ekasya yogayuktasya tatphalaṃ kavayo viduḥ
verses.translation: One who offers shining fragrant Dhupa (incense) to Pitrs begets children of his wife (beneficial to him) here and heieafter. Hence he shall always offer it to Pitrs
verses.hindi: १. कनिष्ठिका अंगुली फैलाकर केहुनी तक की लम्बाई । २. मृदी बंधे हये हाथ का परिमाण ।
verses.wordMeaning: One who offers shining fragrant Dhupa (incense) to Pitrs begets children of his wife (beneficial to him) here and heieafter. Hence he shall always offer it to Pitrs
verses.commentary: Sense: One who offers shining fragrant Dhupa (incense) to Pitrs begets children of his wife (beneficial to him) here and heieafter. Hence he shall always offer it to Pitrs

verses.sanskrit: संनिरुध्येन्द्रियग्रामं यत्रयत्र वसेन् मुनिः । तत्रतत्र कुरुक्षेत्रं नैमिषं पुष्कराणि च
verses.transliteration: saṃnirudhyendriyagrāmaṃ yatrayatra vasen muniḥ / tatratatra kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca
verses.translation: He should offer scents, flowers, incense and ghee. After propitiating at the outset, Pitrs with fruits, roots and obeisance with purity of mind and body, the devotee should later worship Brahmanas with food and wealth.
verses.hindi: तस्य पुष्टिरथश्वयंमायु: संततिरेव च । विचित्रा भजते लक्ष्मीमोक्षं च लभते क्रमात् (१४ पापापहं पावनीयमश्वमेधफल तथा। अश्वमेधफल होतद्द्विजेः सत्कृत्य पुजितम् ॥ द पितृस्तत्त्रिषु लोकेशु मनत्रो5्यं तारयत्युत । पठ्यमानः सदा श्राड्धे नियतं ब्रह्मवादिभिः १८ राज्यकामो जपेदेव सदा सन्त्रमतन्द्रितः  वीयंशौचार्थसत्त्वं च श्रीरायुबंलवर्धनम् १६ प्रीयन्ते पितरों येन जप्येन नियमेन च। सप्ताधिषं अ्रवक्ष्यासि सर्वकामप्रद॑ शुभम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should offer scents, flowers, incense and ghee. After propitiating at the outset, Pitrs with fruits, roots and obeisance with purity of mind and body, the devotee should later worship Brahmanas with food and wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should offer scents, flowers, incense and ghee. After propitiating at the outset, Pitrs with fruits, roots and obeisance with purity of mind and body, the devotee should later worship Brahmanas with food and wealth.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः । संक्रान्तौ च व्यतीपाते योगी भोज्यो विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprayatnena grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte yogī bhojyo viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Always at the time of Sraddha, Pitamahas (manes) assume aerial forms and on seeing Brahmanas, they enter them. Hence I am saying this. 1
verses.hindi: इन्द्रादीनां जनथितारो भृगुमारीचयोस्तथा । सप्तर्षोणां पित॒णां च तान्ननस्यामि कामदानू
verses.wordMeaning: Always at the time of Sraddha, Pitamahas (manes) assume aerial forms and on seeing Brahmanas, they enter them. Hence I am saying this. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Always at the time of Sraddha, Pitamahas (manes) assume aerial forms and on seeing Brahmanas, they enter them. Hence I am saying this. 1

verses.sanskrit: संन्यासं कुरुते यस्तु तत्र तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर । विमानेन महाभागाः स याति त्रिदिवं नरः
verses.transliteration: saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yastu tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira / vimānena mahābhāgāḥ sa yāti tridivaṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: Excellent Brahmanas should be honoured with garments, foodstuffs, charitable gifts, food and beverages, (gifts of) cows, horses and villages. If Brahmanas are honoured, Pitrs become delighted. Hence, one should honour excellent Brahmanas duly. In the holy rite of Sraddha, Brahmanas should perform diligently the ritualistic scraping, digging and sprink¬ ling of water (with Darbha) (Ullekhana and Proksana) by means of the left and the right hands.
verses.hindi: नाम से विल्यात हैं, इन्हीं पर त्रंलोक्य की स्थिति है। जो व्यक्ति इसका अनुष्ठान करता है, उसको पृष्टि, ऐह्वर्ये, दीर्घायु, संतति, प्रचुर लक्ष्मी तथा मोक्ष की क्रमशः प्राप्ति होती है । ब्राह्मणों से सत्कार पूबक पूर्जित यह एक मंत्र समस्त पापों को दूर करनेवाला, परमपवित्र तथा अश्वमेध यज्ञ की फलप्राप्ति करानेवाला है, इसको बतला रहा हूँ, इस मंत्र की रचना ब्रह्मा ने की थी, यह अमृत मंत्र है ।१३ १५॥ देवाताम्यः पितृम्यश्च महायोगिभ्य एवं च  मम: स्वधाये स्यद्ाय नित्यमेव भवन्तुत”' अर्थात् समस्त देवताओं, पितरों, म्रहायोगियों, स्वधा एवं स्वराहा--सबको हम नमस्कार करते हैं, ये सब +त्य (शाब्वत्त) फल प्रदान करनेवाले हैं। सबंदा श्राद्ध के प्रारम्भ, अवसान तथा पिण्डदान के समय इस मत्र का समाहित (सावधान) चित्त होकर तीन बार पाठ करना चाहिए । इससे पितरगण शीक्ष ही वहाँ आ जाते हैं और राक्षसगण तुरत वहाँ सै पलायन कर जाते
verses.wordMeaning: Excellent Brahmanas should be honoured with garments, foodstuffs, charitable gifts, food and beverages, (gifts of) cows, horses and villages. If Brahmanas are honoured, Pitrs become delighted. Hence, one should honour excellent Brahmanas duly. In the holy rite of Sraddha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Excellent Brahmanas should be honoured with garments, foodstuffs, charitable gifts, food and beverages, (gifts of) cows, horses and villages. If Brahmanas are honoured, Pitrs become delighted. Hence, one should honour excellent Brahmanas duly. In the holy rite of Sraddha,…

verses.sanskrit: सोमस्यानुचरो भूत्वा तेनैव सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: somasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate
verses.translation: A learned man should keep ready for libation, Darbhas, balls of rice, foodstuffs, different kinds of flowers, scents, charitable gifts and ornaments.
verses.hindi: हैं ।(६-१७। ब्राह्मणों द्वारा श्राद्ध के अवसर पर पढ़े जाने पर यह मन्त्र तीनों लोकों में पितरों का उद्धार करता है। राज्यप्राप्ति का अभिलाषी इस मन्त्र का आलस्य रहित होकर सवंदा पाठ करे। यह वीये, पवित्रता, धन, सात्विकबल, लक्ष्मी, दोर्घायु, बल आदि को बढ़ानेवाला मन्त्र है। जिसके नियमपूर्वक जप करने से पितरगण प्रसन्न हो जाते हैं--ऐसे' सभी मनोरथों को पूर्ण करनेवाले, शुभ फलदायी नामक मन्त्र को बतला राहा
verses.wordMeaning: A learned man should keep ready for libation, Darbhas, balls of rice, foodstuffs, different kinds of flowers, scents, charitable gifts and ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: A learned man should keep ready for libation, Darbhas, balls of rice, foodstuffs, different kinds of flowers, scents, charitable gifts and ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सोमतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १४० मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज नन्दाह्रदमनुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धा महाभागा नन्दा देवी वरप्रदा
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 140 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja nandāhradamanuttamam / yatra siddhā mahābhāgā nandā devī varapradā
verses.translation: Hence Brahmanas are to be worshipped, fed and gifted at the time of Sraddha. The belief that Pitrs assume gascousform and enter the bodies of the invited Brahmins is found in AuSanasa Smfti V. 4-5. Gf. Manu III. 189.
