verses.hindi: देवदेवा महात्मानों होतेडपि पितरो ह्ात । इच्छन्ति केचिदाचार्याः पश्चात्पिण्डनिवेदनम् २४ पूजन चेव विप्राणां पूर्वमेव हि नित्यशः । तद्दिधर्मार्थकुशलानित्युवाच बृहस्पतिः २५ को चले गये ।१५-१६। वेद में मनुष्यों के लिये पाँच महायज्ञों की चर्चा की गयी है--इन पाँचों यहायज्ञों का मनुष्य सर्वदा अनुष्ठान करे । इन (पाँचों महायज्ञों! के देनेवाले (अनुष्ठान करनेवाले) जिस स्थान को जाते हैं, उसे सुनिये । भय रहित, अहंकार से सबंदा विहीन शोक रहित, परिश्रम को दूर करनेवाले, सभी मनोरथों को पुररूत करने वाले ब्रह्म के स्थान को वे प्राप्त करते हैं। ये पाँचों महायज्ञ- केवल मंत्रोच्चारण को छोड़कर --
verses.wordMeaning: Hence he (the performer ofSraddha), remaining pure and devotedly attached to Yogins, should offer the Pindas to Yogins. This shall be the Havi offering directly to Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence he (the performer ofSraddha), remaining pure and devotedly attached to Yogins, should offer the Pindas to Yogins. This shall be the Havi offering directly to Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: केशवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रुक्मो दानवपुंगवः । तं प्रणम्य जगन्नाथं जगाम भवनं पितुः
verses.transliteration: keśavasya vacaḥ śrutvā rukmo dānavapuṃgavaḥ / taṃ praṇamya jagannāthaṃ jagāma bhavanaṃ pituḥ
verses.translation: If a single Yogin be in the scat of priority among thousands of Brahmanas, he will enable the Yajamana and the Brahmanas partaking of the food, cross (the ocean of worldly existence) like a boat in water.
verses.hindi: शूद्रों को भी करने चाहिए  इन के बिना जो भोजन करता है वह नित्य ऋण का भक्षण करता है ।१७-१६। जो केवल अपने लिये भोजन बनाता हैं वह पापात्मा है और ऋण का भोजन करता है। इसलिये बुद्धिमान् पुरुष को इन पाँचों महायज्ञों का सर्वदा अनुष्ठान करना चाहिए । २०। कुछ लोग पितरों के जीवित रहते समय भी नैवेध करने की इच्छा करते है। तदनन्तर उसके लिये जल दान पूृवंक बलि देनी चाहिए, जल का कलश
verses.wordMeaning: If a single Yogin be in the scat of priority among thousands of Brahmanas, he will enable the Yajamana and the Brahmanas partaking of the food, cross (the ocean of worldly existence) like a boat in water.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a single Yogin be in the scat of priority among thousands of Brahmanas, he will enable the Yajamana and the Brahmanas partaking of the food, cross (the ocean of worldly existence) like a boat in water.

verses.sanskrit: गते रुक्मे तदा कृष्णः समामन्त्र्य द्विजोत्तमान् । मरीचिमत्र्यङ्गिरसं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: gate rukme tadā kṛṣṇaḥ samāmantrya dvijottamān / marīcimatryaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum
verses.translation: Where the wicked are accepted and honoured and where the good are disrespected, a terrible punishment meted out by the Devas befalls them immediately.
verses.hindi: भी देनी चाहिए ।२'। ऊँचे से भी ऊँचे स्थाम पर से भली प्रकार विहिंत बलि देनी चाहिए  सूक्ष्म (स्वल्प) मात्रा में बलि को लेकर सींगोंवाले गोंओं के ऊपर छोड़नी चाहिए ।६२। जीवित पितरों के लिये पिण्डदान नहीं है। उन्हे केवल विधिपूर्वक सुन्दर पसन्द आनेवाले अन्नों एवं अन्यान्य भक्ष्य भोज्य पदार्थों को खिलाना चाहिए । यह वेदों से सम्मत विधान है, अत इसे यत्नपूर्वक बतला रहा है । २३ ये पितरगण देवताओं के देवता एवं परम महात्मा हैं  कुछ आचार्य लोग श्राउ्धकर्म में सर्व प्रथम ब्राह्मणों का पूजन तदतन्तर पिण्डदान के विधान की इच्छा करते हैं ।२४॥ इस प्रक्रिया के मानने वाले धर्मा्थ में कुशल आचार्यों से बृहस्पति कहते हैं। महात्मा पितरगण परम योग/म्यास परायण, योग सम्भव एवं योगिराट् हैं, ये लोग चन्द्रमा को भी सस्तुष्ट करने
verses.wordMeaning: Where the wicked are accepted and honoured and where the good are disrespected, a terrible punishment meted out by the Devas befalls them immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: Where the wicked are accepted and honoured and where the good are disrespected, a terrible punishment meted out by the Devas befalls them immediately.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठं च महाभागमित्येते सप्त मानसाः । इत्येते ब्राह्मणाः सप्त पुराणे निश्चयं गताः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaṃ ca mahābhāgamityete sapta mānasāḥ / ityete brāhmaṇāḥ sapta purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: If a pious (Brahmana) who has come as a guest is left out and a foolish one is fed, the householder forgoes his prior holy rites and perishes (i.e. despite his merit in a previous birth he is faced with ruin).
verses.hindi: दद्ै० वायुपुराणभ्
verses.wordMeaning: If a pious (Brahmana) who has come as a guest is left out and a foolish one is fed, the householder forgoes his prior holy rites and perishes (i.e. despite his merit in a previous birth he is faced with ruin).
verses.commentary: Sense: If a pious (Brahmana) who has come as a guest is left out and a foolish one is fed, the householder forgoes his prior holy rites and perishes (i.e. despite his merit in a previous birth he is faced with ruin).

verses.sanskrit: क्षमावन्तः प्रजावन्तो महर्षिभिर् अलंकृताः । इत्येवं ब्रह्मपुत्राश्च सत्यवन्तो महामते
verses.transliteration: kṣamāvantaḥ prajāvanto maharṣibhir alaṃkṛtāḥ / ityevaṃ brahmaputrāśca satyavanto mahāmate
verses.translation: He who seeks enjoyment (of worldly pleasures) should assiduously consign the Pinda to the sacred fire. 1 Pie who seeks progeny shall give the middle Pinda to his wife but after per¬ forming all the intervening rites and mantras.
verses.hindi: असर्ता प्रग्रहो यत्र सतां चेव विमानना । दण्डो देवकृतस्तन्न सद्यः पतति दारुणः २६ हित्वा5डगर्म॑ सधर्माणं बालिशं यत्र भोजयेत् । आदिकर्म समुत्सृज्य दाता तत्न विनश्यति ३० उत्तमां द्युतिमान्विच्छन्गोषु नित्य॑ प्रयच्छति । प्रज्ञा पूजां यशः कोति गोषु नित्य॑ प्रयच्छति ४३२ प्रार्थयन्दी्घमायुश्व॒ वायसे भयः प्रयच्छति । सौकुमायंमथान्विच्छन्कुक्कुटेम्यः प्रयच्छति ॥३२३े एव्मेतत्समुदिष्ट पिण्डनिवंपणात्फलम् । आकाश शमयेद्वाईपि स्थितोधप्सु दक्षिणामुखः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who seeks enjoyment (of worldly pleasures) should assiduously consign the Pinda to the sacred fire. 1 Pie who seeks progeny shall give the middle Pinda to his wife but after per¬ forming all the intervening rites and mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who seeks enjoyment (of worldly pleasures) should assiduously consign the Pinda to the sacred fire. 1 Pie who seeks progeny shall give the middle Pinda to his wife but after per¬ forming all the intervening rites and mantras.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य निवसन्ति जितेन्द्रियाः । तपःस्वाध्यायनिरता जपहोमपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: narmadātaṭamāśritya nivasanti jitendriyāḥ / tapaḥsvādhyāyaniratā japahomaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Pie who wishes for excellent refulgence always offers it (the Pinda) to cows. So also he who wishes for intellect, honour, fame and renown, offers it always to cows.
verses.hindi: पितुंणां स्थानमाकाशं दक्षिणा चंब दिग्भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Pie who wishes for excellent refulgence always offers it (the Pinda) to cows. So also he who wishes for intellect, honour, fame and renown, offers it always to cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pie who wishes for excellent refulgence always offers it (the Pinda) to cows. So also he who wishes for intellect, honour, fame and renown, offers it always to cows.

verses.sanskrit: निमन्त्रितास्तु राजेन्द्र केशवेन महात्मना । श्राद्धं कृत्वा यथान्यायं ब्रह्मोक्तविधिना ततः
verses.transliteration: nimantritāstu rājendra keśavena mahātmanā / śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ brahmoktavidhinā tataḥ
verses.translation: He who seeks long life gives it to crows. One desirous of comeliness offers (oblations) to the fowl.
verses.hindi: वाले हैं, अत, सर्वप्रथम इन्हें पिण्डदान करना चाहिए, पश्चात् ग्राह्मणों को भोजन कराना चाहिए । इसी लिये पितरों में श्रद्धा एवं भक्ति रखनेवाले व्यक्ति पकित्र होकर उन परम योगी पितरों को सर्वप्रथम पिण्डदान दें यह पिण्डदान ही पितरों के लिये साक्षात् अग्नि में हुनी गई हवि के समान है ।२५-२ । श्राद्ध के अवसर पर सहस्नों ब्राह्मणों में से यदि एक भी योगाम्यासी अग्रासन पर बिठाया गया हैं तो वह अकेला ही जल में नाव की तरह यजमान और अन्य भोकक्‍्ता -सब का उद्धार करता है ।२८। जिस स्थान पर असत्पुरुषों का विशेष सम्मान एवं सत्पुरुषों का अपमान होता है, वहाँ अति दारुण देवदण्ड शीघ्र ही गिरता है ।२६९। जिस स्थान पर घर्माचरण में रत रहनेवाले एवं अतिथि रूप में समागत ब्राह्मण को छोड़कर किसी धृते अथवा मूल ब्राह्मण को भोजन कराया जाता है, वहाँ वह दाता अपने पूर्व जन्म के भोग्य कर्मों के रहते हुये भी विनाश को प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: He who seeks long life gives it to crows. One desirous of comeliness offers (oblations) to the fowl.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who seeks long life gives it to crows. One desirous of comeliness offers (oblations) to the fowl.

verses.sanskrit: हरिस्तान्पूजयामास सप्तब्रह्मर्षिपुंगवान् । प्रददौ द्वादश ग्रामांस्तेभ्यस्तत्र जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: haristānpūjayāmāsa saptabrahmarṣipuṃgavān / pradadau dvādaśa grāmāṃstebhyastatra janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the benefit of offering Pindas has been recounted. Or the devotee shall stand facing the south and pacify the sky (scatter the oblations in the sky) 2. The abode of Pitrs is the sky and their quarter is the south.
verses.hindi: भोग की इच्छा करनेवाला प्रयत्न पूर्वक सर्वदा अग्ति में पिण्डदान करे  सन्‍्तति का अभिलाषी स्त्रियों को सबंदा पिण्ड दें, किन्तु ऐसे समय भी पिण्डदात की अन्य क्रियाएँ उससे पूर्व ही कर लेनी चाहिए ।३१॥ उत्तम काह्ति की अभिलाषा करनेवाला नित्य गौओं को पिण्डदान करता है, इसी प्रकार उत्तम बुद्धि, पुजा, (सम्मान) यश, कीति की अभिलाषों भी नित्य गौंओं को पिण्ड देता है ।३२। दीर्घायु की प्राथंना करनेबाला नित्य भ्रति कोओं के
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the benefit of offering Pindas has been recounted. Or the devotee shall stand facing the south and pacify the sky (scatter the oblations in the sky) 2. The abode of Pitrs is the sky and their quarter is the south.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the benefit of offering Pindas has been recounted. Or the devotee shall stand facing the south and pacify the sky (scatter the oblations in the sky) 2. The abode of Pitrs is the sky and their quarter is the south.

verses.sanskrit: यावच्चन्द्रश्च सूर्यश्च यावत्तिष्ठति मेदिनी । तावद्दानं मया दत्तं परिपन्थी न कश्चन
verses.transliteration: yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca yāvattiṣṭhati medinī / tāvaddānaṃ mayā dattaṃ paripanthī na kaścana
verses.translation: (Defective) Further, Brahmanas mention one procedure of lifting up the Pinda. After being permitted by Brahmanas who say %et it be taken up dry"
verses.hindi: लिये बलिदान करता है । सुकुमारता का इच्छुक व्यक्ति मुर्गों को नित्य बलिदान देता है ।१३॥ पिण्डदान के फल का वर्णन कर चुका। अथवा जल में दक्षिणाभिमुख स्थित होकर आकाश को बलि दे क्योंकि पितरों का स्थान आकाश और दिल्ला दक्षिण मानी गयी है ।३४। बाह्यण लोग श्राद्धकर्म में एक पिण्डोद्धार की प्रक्रिया ( बेवस्वताय सोमाय हुत्वा पिण्ड निवेद्य सः। उदकानयन कृत्वा पश्चाद्विप्रांश्व॒ भोजयेत् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) Further, Brahmanas mention one procedure of lifting up the Pinda. After being permitted by Brahmanas who say %et it be taken up dry"
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) Further, Brahmanas mention one procedure of lifting up the Pinda. After being permitted by Brahmanas who say %et it be taken up dry"

verses.sanskrit: मद्दत्तं पालयिष्यन्ते ये नृपा गतकल्मषाः । तेभ्यः स्वस्ति करिष्यामि दास्यामि परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: maddattaṃ pālayiṣyante ye nṛpā gatakalmaṣāḥ / tebhyaḥ svasti kariṣyāmi dāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Verses 31-34 prescribe the disposal of Pindas and the benefits accru¬ ing from it. Cf. Mbh. Anuiasana 1 25.38-40, BM. 150-52 for similar views.
verses.hindi: स्निग्धभंक्षये: सुगन्धेश्व तपंयेत रसस्तथा । एकाग्र: पर्युपासीत प्रयतः प्रारुजलिःस्थितः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 31-34 prescribe the disposal of Pindas and the benefits accru¬ ing from it. Cf. Mbh. Anuiasana 1 25.38-40, BM. 150-52 for similar views.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 31-34 prescribe the disposal of Pindas and the benefits accru¬ ing from it. Cf. Mbh. Anuiasana 1 25.38-40, BM. 150-52 for similar views.

verses.sanskrit: यावद्धि यान्ति लोकेषु महाभूतानि पञ्च च । तावत्ते दिवि मोदन्ते मद्दत्तपरिपालकाः
verses.transliteration: yāvaddhi yānti lokeṣu mahābhūtāni pañca ca / tāvatte divi modante maddattaparipālakāḥ
verses.translation: 'or scatter them in the water' (in Bd. P.) for 'Slhitau' hereof be
verses.hindi: तत्पर: भ्रदधानश्र कामानाप्नोति मानव: ॥३ ७ अक्षुद्रत्वं कृतज्ञत्वं दाक्षिण्यं सत्कृतं च यत् । ततो यज्ञ च दान॑ च प्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः १३४० आगे बतलाते हैं, उन विप्रों की पिण्डों का उद्धार कीजिये,--ऐसी आज्ञा (?) प्राप्त हो जाने पर यह विधि करनी चाहिए  पुष्प, फल भक्ष्य, अन्न इन सब के अग्रभाग को नॉश्वकर सर्वप्रथम अग्नि में हवन कर देना चाहिए। पिण्डदान करनेवाले व्यक्ति दक्षिण ओर मुख करके विविध खांद्य सामग्रियाँ, अन्न, पीने की सामग्रियाँ अत्युत्तम फल--इन सब वस्तुओं को अग्नि में हवन करने के उपरान्त पिण्डदान करे ।३५-३७। वैवस्वत (यम)
verses.wordMeaning: 'or scatter them in the water' (in Bd. P.) for 'Slhitau' hereof be
verses.commentary: Sense: 'or scatter them in the water' (in Bd. P.) for 'Slhitau' hereof be

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु लोपयते मूढो दत्तं वः पृथिवीतले । नरके तस्य वासः स्याद् यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: yastu lopayate mūḍho dattaṃ vaḥ pṛthivītale / narake tasya vāsaḥ syād yāvadābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: The upper layer or the tip of flowers, fruits, edibles and cooked food shall be taken up and offered as oblation in the sacred fire.
verses.hindi: और सोभ को पिण्ड निवेदन करने के उपरान्त जलानयन कर लेने पर पीछे ब्राह्मणों को भोजन कराना चाहिए। उन्हें विविध खाद्य पदार्थों- एवं अन्नादि द्वारा अपनी दाक्ति भर वस्तुओं का क्रश: भोजन कराना चाहिए । चिकने खाद्य पदार्थ, सुगंधित खाद्य पदार्थ से सन्तुष्ट करके विविध रसों द्वारा तृप्त करे । तदनन्तर अकेले एकान्तबित होकर हाथ जोड़े हुये उनकी विधिवत् पूजा करे। इस श्राद्धकर्म में तत्पर एवं श्रद्धा रखने
verses.wordMeaning: The upper layer or the tip of flowers, fruits, edibles and cooked food shall be taken up and offered as oblation in the sacred fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The upper layer or the tip of flowers, fruits, edibles and cooked food shall be taken up and offered as oblation in the sacred fire.

verses.sanskrit: स्वदत्ता परदत्ता वा पालनीया वसुंधरा । यस्य यस्य यदा भूमिस् तस्य तस्य तदा फलम्
verses.transliteration: svadattā paradattā vā pālanīyā vasuṃdharā / yasya yasya yadā bhūmis tasya tasya tadā phalam
verses.translation: After consigning the edibles, cooked food, beverage and the excellent fruits to the fire, he should face the south and offer the Pindas.
verses.hindi: वाला मनुष्य अपने सम्पूर्ण मनोरथों को प्राप्त करता है ।३८-३६। पितामहगण उसे अक्षुद्रता (महत्त्व) कृतज्ञता चतुरता, सत्कार, यज्ञ, दान आदि की शक्ति देते हैं। ऋषि वुन्द ! अब इसके उपरान्त ब्राह्मणों के भोजन कर लेने पर जो जो क्रियाएँ श्राद्धकर्म में होती हैं, उन्हें में बतला रहा हूँ, सुनिये ४०-४१। सबसे पहले पितरों में भक्ति रखनेवाला भूमि का सिंचन एवं उसका परिष्कार करके विधान के अनुसार  धनुदिच्वान्तगंतग्रश्यः क. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: After consigning the edibles, cooked food, beverage and the excellent fruits to the fire, he should face the south and offer the Pindas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After consigning the edibles, cooked food, beverage and the excellent fruits to the fire, he should face the south and offer the Pindas.

verses.sanskrit: स्वदत्तां परदत्तां वा यो हरेत वसुंधराम् । स विष्ठायां कृमिर्भूत्वा पितृभिः सह मज्जति
verses.transliteration: svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā yo hareta vasuṃdharām / sa viṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmirbhūtvā pitṛbhiḥ saha majjati
verses.translation: He shall propitiate (them) with oily edibles, sweet scents and juices. With concentration and purity of mind, he should serve them standing (there) with palms joined in reverence. A man devoted to them and full of faith, obtains the desires.
verses.hindi: फेरे वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: He shall propitiate (them) with oily edibles, sweet scents and juices. With concentration and purity of mind, he should serve them standing (there) with palms joined in reverence. A man devoted to them and full of faith, obtains the desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall propitiate (them) with oily edibles, sweet scents and juices. With concentration and purity of mind, he should serve them standing (there) with palms joined in reverence. A man devoted to them and full of faith, obtains the desires.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यायेन हृता भूमिरन्यायेन च हारिता । हर्ता हारयिता चैव विष्ठायां जायते कृमिः
verses.transliteration: anyāyena hṛtā bhūmiranyāyena ca hāritā / hartā hārayitā caiva viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ
verses.translation: The grandfathers (manes) bestow the (following) qualities on him: the state of not being mean and low (non¬ pettiness), gratefulness, chivalry, hospitality and the (ability for performance of) sacrifices and religious gifts.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते श्राद्ध कल्पो नाम षट्सप्ततितमोअध्याय: सक्ृदर्भ्याचताः प्रीता भवन्ति पितरोब्ययाः । योगात्मानों महात्मानों विपाप्मानो महौजसः
verses.wordMeaning: The grandfathers (manes) bestow the (following) qualities on him: the state of not being mean and low (non¬ pettiness), gratefulness, chivalry, hospitality and the (ability for performance of) sacrifices and religious gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The grandfathers (manes) bestow the (following) qualities on him: the state of not being mean and low (non¬ pettiness), gratefulness, chivalry, hospitality and the (ability for performance of) sacrifices and religious gifts.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गे तिष्ठति भूमिदः । आच्छेत्ता चानुमन्ता च तान्येव नरके वसेत्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svarge tiṣṭhati bhūmidaḥ / ācchettā cānumantā ca tānyeva narake vaset
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall recount the Saumya* (belonging to Soma) procedure after the Brahmanas have taken food, in order. Listen to it, even as I recount it.
verses.hindi: प्रेत्य च स्वगलाभाय कार्वेश्वर्य सुविस्तरम् । येषां चाप्यनुगृह्न्ति मोक्षप्राप्तिक्रमेण तु २
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth I shall recount the Saumya* (belonging to Soma) procedure after the Brahmanas have taken food, in order. Listen to it, even as I recount it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth I shall recount the Saumya* (belonging to Soma) procedure after the Brahmanas have taken food, in order. Listen to it, even as I recount it.

verses.sanskrit: यानीह दत्तानि पुरा नरेन्द्रैर् दानानि धर्मार्थयशस्कराणि । निर्माल्यरूपप्रतिमानि तानि को नाम साधुः पुनराददाति
verses.transliteration: yānīha dattāni purā narendrair dānāni dharmārthayaśaskarāṇi / nirmālyarūpapratimāni tāni ko nāma sādhuḥ punarādadāti
verses.translation: The devotee attached to Pitrs should sprinkle the ground and scrub it at the outset. Then he should scatter (auspicious materials) in accordance with the injunctions. He shall request the excellent Brahmanas to chant the Svadha mantra and offer them plenty of Daksinas. He shall get the permission from them (as to what should be done with) the remnants of the food. With palms joined in reverence, he shall follow them after honouring them duly. He should then bid farewell.
verses.hindi: तानि वक्ष्याम्यहूं सोस्‍्या: सरांसि सरितस्तथा। तीर्थानि चेव पुण्यानि देशाअशेलांस्तथा55श्रमान् विफिरण करे। तदनन्तर ब्राह्मणों से स्वधा वाचन करा के प्रचुर दक्षिण प्राप्त उत्तम ब्राह्मणों का विधिवत सत्कार कर शेष अन्न को आाज्ञा प्राप्त कर, हाथ जोड़, मन एवं इन्द्रियों को स्ववश रब कुछ दूर तक उनको पहुँचा कर विसर्जन करे
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee attached to Pitrs should sprinkle the ground and scrub it at the outset. Then he should scatter (auspicious materials) in accordance with the injunctions. He shall request the excellent Brahmanas to chant the Svadha mantra and offer them plenty of Daksinas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee attached to Pitrs should sprinkle the ground and scrub it at the outset. Then he should scatter (auspicious materials) in accordance with the injunctions. He shall request the excellent Brahmanas to chant the Svadha mantra and offer them plenty of Daksinas.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं तान्पूजयित्वा तु सम्यङ् न्यायेन पाण्डव । रुक्मिण्या विधिवत्पाणिं जग्राह मधुसूदनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tānpūjayitvā tu samyaṅ nyāyena pāṇḍava / rukmiṇyā vidhivatpāṇiṃ jagrāha madhusūdanaḥ
verses.translation: Pitfs worshipped even once become delighted. They are imperishable Yogic souls. They are noble souls of great power and free from sins and evils.
verses.hindi: छहस्पति जी बोले:--सौम्यगण ! ये पितरगण केवल एक बार पूजा प्राप्त कर लेने पर परम प्रसन्न हो जाते हैं, ये कभी नष्ट होनेवाले नहीं हैं, योगी हैं, महात्मा हैं, पाप रहित हैं, महान् तेजस्वी हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Pitfs worshipped even once become delighted. They are imperishable Yogic souls. They are noble souls of great power and free from sins and evils.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitfs worshipped even once become delighted. They are imperishable Yogic souls. They are noble souls of great power and free from sins and evils.

verses.sanskrit: मुशली च ततः सर्वाञ्जित्वा दानवपुंगवान् । स्वस्थानम् अगमत् तत्र कृत्वा कार्यं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: muśalī ca tataḥ sarvāñjitvā dānavapuṃgavān / svasthānam agamat tatra kṛtvā kāryaṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: O gentle ones, I shall recount the holy lakes, rivers, sacred spots, places of pilgrimage, mountains and hermitages for performing Sraddha, at which Pitrs bless him (the performer) with fulfilment of desire for profuse riches (in this world), attainment of heaven after death and liberation from Samsara in due course.
verses.hindi: अब मैं इस जन्म के उपरान्त स्वर्ग लाभ करानेवाले, विस्तृत मनोरथ एवं एश्बय को देनेवाले, मोक्ष प्राप्ति के सहायक उन सरोवरों, सरिताओं, पुण्यप्रद तीथों, देशों एवं पव॑तों का वर्णन कर रहा हें, जिन पर (पितरगण ) १. विघ्तों को दूर करने के लिये फेंकी गयी गई एवेत सरसों आदि बस्तुएँ।
verses.wordMeaning: O gentle ones, I shall recount the holy lakes, rivers, sacred spots, places of pilgrimage, mountains and hermitages for performing Sraddha, at which Pitrs bless him (the performer) with fulfilment of desire for profuse riches (in this world),…
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle ones, I shall recount the holy lakes, rivers, sacred spots, places of pilgrimage, mountains and hermitages for performing Sraddha, at which Pitrs bless him (the performer) with fulfilment of desire for profuse riches (in this world),…

verses.sanskrit: प्रयातौ द्वारवत्यां तौ कृष्णसंकर्षणावुभौ । गच्छमानं तु तं दृष्ट्वा केशवं क्लेशनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: prayātau dvāravatyāṃ tau kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāvubhau / gacchamānaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā keśavaṃ kleśanāśanam
verses.translation: The mountain Amarakantaka 2 is the holiest and the most excellent in the three worlds. It is a sacred mountain resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas. Formerly, holy lord Angiras performed very severe penance (difficult for others to do) on it, for thousands of years, say, millions and crores of years.
verses.hindi: पुण्यो यस्त्रिषु लोकेध्वमरकण्टकपबवंतः । पर्वृतप्रवरः पुण्यः सिद्धचारणसेवितः ४ यत्र वर्षसहल्लाणि प्रयुतान्यबंदानि च्। लपः सुदृश्चर तेपे भगवानड्रिराः पुरा ३५
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain Amarakantaka 2 is the holiest and the most excellent in the three worlds. It is a sacred mountain resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas. Formerly, holy lord Angiras performed very severe penance (difficult for others to do) on it, for thousands of years, say,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain Amarakantaka 2 is the holiest and the most excellent in the three worlds. It is a sacred mountain resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas. Formerly, holy lord Angiras performed very severe penance (difficult for others to do) on it, for thousands of years, say,…

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः सत्यवन्तश्च निर्गताः शंसितव्रताः । आगच्छमानांस् तौ वीक्ष्य रथमार्गेण ब्राह्मणान्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ satyavantaśca nirgatāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ / āgacchamānāṃs tau vīkṣya rathamārgeṇa brāhmaṇān
verses.translation: As long as the earth holds (lasts), the god of death,
verses.hindi: तेजसा यशसा चेव भ्राजते स नगोत्तमः । शुद्धमाल्यबतो नित्य॑ बह्िः संबर्तकों यथा ७ दुष्टवान्स्वर्गसोपान भगवानड्िराः पुरा । अग्निहोत्रे महातेजाः प्रस्तराथथंकुशोत्तमान्
verses.wordMeaning: As long as the earth holds (lasts), the god of death,
verses.commentary: Sense: As long as the earth holds (lasts), the god of death,

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तं तत्र विश्रम्य केशवो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । किमागमनकार्यं वो ब्रूत सर्वं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: muhūrtaṃ tatra viśramya keśavo vākyam abravīt / kimāgamanakāryaṃ vo brūta sarvaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Due to their association with the founders of faith or with some great persons or events certain places have been regarded holy by all peoples of the world, e.g. Mecca by Muslims, Jerusalem by Christians, Bodha Gaya by Buddhists. These holy places have a deep psychological effect on religious-minded persons. Sraddha is to be performed in one's own house. But as K.P. II. 22.17 states, holy places arc the common property of all and not of a particular person. A list of such holy places is recommended in different Puranas like KP. II. 20-32-36, Mt, P. Ch. 22, Bd. 3.13. There is some divergence in the lists but there is a great deal of overlapping as a number of holy places like Prayaga, Varanasi, Gaya, Puskara are deeply respected by all Hindus.
verses.hindi: तेषु दर्भषु पिण्डास्योइसरकण्टकपवंते । दणद्यात्सकृदपि प्राज्ञस्तस्य वक्ष्यामि यत्फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Due to their association with the founders of faith or with some great persons or events certain places have been regarded holy by all peoples of the world, e.g. Mecca by Muslims, Jerusalem by Christians, Bodha Gaya by Buddhists.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to their association with the founders of faith or with some great persons or events certain places have been regarded holy by all peoples of the world, e.g. Mecca by Muslims, Jerusalem by Christians, Bodha Gaya by Buddhists.…

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वाणाः स्वीयकर्माणि मम कृत्यं तु तिष्ठते । देवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनयो वाक्यम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: kurvāṇāḥ svīyakarmāṇi mama kṛtyaṃ tu tiṣṭhate / devasya vacanaṃ śrutvā munayo vākyam abruvan
verses.translation: That excellent mountain shines with brilliance and renown, just as Samvartaka fire (Fire at the time of the annihila¬ tion of the world) blazes on the peak of mount Malyavan.
verses.hindi: तन्न ज्वालारसः पुण्यो दृश्यतेष्यापि सर्वंशः  सशल्यानां च सत्त्वानां विशल्यकरणी नदी ३१२ प्रादगक्षिणा तु सावर्ता वापी सा पर्व॑तोत्तमे । कलिडगदेशपार्श्ा्थे पितुर्णां प्रीतिवर्धनम् सिद्धक्षेत्रमूषिश्रेष्ठा यदुक्‍त परम भुवि । संमतो देवदेत्यानां श्लोकमप्युशना जगो ३१४
verses.wordMeaning: That excellent mountain shines with brilliance and renown, just as Samvartaka fire (Fire at the time of the annihila¬ tion of the world) blazes on the peak of mount Malyavan.
verses.commentary: Sense: That excellent mountain shines with brilliance and renown, just as Samvartaka fire (Fire at the time of the annihila¬ tion of the world) blazes on the peak of mount Malyavan.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पकोटिसहस्रेण सत्यभावात्तु वन्दितः । दुष्प्राप्यो ऽसि मनुष्याणां प्राप्तः किं त्यजसे हि नः
verses.transliteration: kalpakoṭisahasreṇa satyabhāvāttu vanditaḥ / duṣprāpyo 'si manuṣyāṇāṃ prāptaḥ kiṃ tyajase hi naḥ
verses.translation: The Kusa (growing there) is famous as soft, sweet¬ smelling, pleasing to the eyes and golden-coloured. They are well known as 'calm and quiet' Darbhas. Drinking the waters* of Narmada to the south of it, the holy lord Angiras of great brilliance formerly performed Agnihotra after spreading those excellent Kusas round the altar and he saw the steps leading to the heaven.
verses.hindi: अनुग्रह करते हैं। जो तीनों लोकों में पुण्यप्रद है वह अमरकण्टक सभी पर्वतों में श्रेष्ठ, पुण्यदायी तथा सिद्ध और चारणों द्वारा सेवित है ।२-४॥ जिन पर सहस्रों क्या करोड़ों अरबों बरस तक प्राचीनकाल में भगवान् अंगिरा ने परम कठोर तपस्या की थी ।५॥ जहाँ पर मृत्यु की भी गति नहीं है, असुर एवं राक्षसों से भी भय नहीं है तथा जब तक भूमि स्थित रहेगी तब तक लक्ष्मी का अभाव नहीं रहेगा, वह उत्तम नगराज अपने परभ तेज
verses.wordMeaning: The Kusa (growing there) is famous as soft, sweet¬ smelling, pleasing to the eyes and golden-coloured. They are well known as 'calm and quiet' Darbhas. Drinking the waters* of Narmada to the south of it,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kusa (growing there) is famous as soft, sweet¬ smelling, pleasing to the eyes and golden-coloured. They are well known as 'calm and quiet' Darbhas. Drinking the waters* of Narmada to the south of it,…

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणानां वचः श्रुत्वा भगवान् इदम् अब्रवीत् । मथुरायां द्वारवत्यां योधनीपुर एव च
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇānāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavān idam abravīt / mathurāyāṃ dvāravatyāṃ yodhanīpura eva ca
verses.translation: I shall recount the benefit attained by that intelligent man who offers Pindas even once, on the Darbhas on the mountain Amarakantaka.
verses.hindi: एवं यश से सुशोभित है । उसके परम उच्च शिखर के वक्षों पर खिले हुये पुष्यों से उसकी शोभा संवर्तक अग्नि की तरह है ।६-७। इस पर्वेतराज पर उगनेवाले कुश अति मृदु, सुगन्धित सुर्वेण के समान कान्तिवाले, देखने में मनोहर तथा शान्ति उत्पन्न करनेवाले प्रसिद्ध हैं। प्राचीतकाल में महान् तेजस्वी भगवान् अंगिरा ने अग्नि होतर में पृथ्वी पर बिछाने के लिये इन उत्तम कुझों का उपयोग किया था, दक्षिण भाग में नमंदा के जल का पान किया था, जिसके फल स्वरूप उन्हें स्वर्ग के सोपान दिखाई पड़े थे। जो बुद्धिमान् व्यक्ति पवित्र अमरकण्टक पर्वत पर. उन्हीं कुशों पर एक बार भी पिण्डदान करता है, उसके फल को बतला रहा हूँ । उसका किया हुआ वह श्राद्ध पितरों को परम प्रसन्न करनेवाला एवं अक्षय फलप्रदायी है। सबंदा इस पवित्र क्षेत्र को प्राप्त हो कर वे अन्तहित हो जाते हैं ।5-१ १। आज भी उस पवित्र पव॑त पर ज्वाला सरोवर (?) सम्पूर्ण रूप में दिखाई पड़ता
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount the benefit attained by that intelligent man who offers Pindas even once, on the Darbhas on the mountain Amarakantaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount the benefit attained by that intelligent man who offers Pindas even once, on the Darbhas on the mountain Amarakantaka.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकालमागमिष्यामि सत्यं सत्यं पुनः पुनः । एवं ते ब्राह्मणाः श्रुत्वा योधनीपुरमागताः
verses.transliteration: trikālamāgamiṣyāmi satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ / evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ śrutvā yodhanīpuramāgatāḥ
verses.translation: That Sraddha becomes everlasting, increasing the pleasure of Pitps. On reaching that holy centre, they vanish for ever.
verses.hindi: हैं, हंड्डीवाले जीवों को रोग मुक्त करनेवाली विशल्य करणी नामक नदी है ।१२। उस पर्वतराज अमरकण्टक के पृष्ठभाग पर पूर्व दक्षिण दिशा में फैली हुई वह् पवित्र बावली है। कलिज्ञंदेव के पाश्वेभाग में पितरों को अति प्रसन्न करनेवाला सिद्धक्षेत्र है, हें ऋषिश्रेष्ठाण ! वह स्थान पृथ्वी तल पर पवित्र कहा जाता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: That Sraddha becomes everlasting, increasing the pleasure of Pitps. On reaching that holy centre, they vanish for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Sraddha becomes everlasting, increasing the pleasure of Pitps. On reaching that holy centre, they vanish for ever.

verses.sanskrit: अवतीर्णस्त्रिभागेन प्रादुर्भावे तु माथुरे । एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं तीर्थस्योत्पत्तिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: avatīrṇastribhāgena prādurbhāve tu māthure / etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthasyotpattikāraṇam
verses.translation: Even today the holy " Jvalarasa " is seen there every¬ where. The river thereof (called Visalya—a branch of Narmada) makes all living beings free from darts and thorns (sins and miseries).
verses.hindi: धन्यास्ते पुरुषा लोके ये प्राप्पामरकण्टकम् । पित॒न्संतपंयिष्यन्ति भ्राद्धे पितृपरायणा: १५ अल्पेन तपसा सिद्धि गभिष्यन्ति न संशय: । सक्रुदेवाचितास्तत्न स्वर्गंसमरकण्टके . बिल्वाध: शिक्षरे युक्ता दिव्य चक्षुः प्रवतंते । अदृश्यं चेव भुतानां देवबच्चरते महीम् (१८ सप्तगोदावरे चेव गोकर्णे च तपोवने । अश्वमेधफलं तत्न स्नात्वा च लभते नरः
verses.wordMeaning: Even today the holy " Jvalarasa " is seen there every¬ where. The river thereof (called Visalya—a branch of Narmada) makes all living beings free from darts and thorns (sins and miseries).
verses.commentary: Sense: Even today the holy " Jvalarasa " is seen there every¬ where. The river thereof (called Visalya—a branch of Narmada) makes all living beings free from darts and thorns (sins and miseries).

verses.sanskrit: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च वर्तमानं तथापरम् । यं श्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca vartamānaṃ tathāparam / yaṃ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: To the south-east of that excellent mountain, there is a tank with a whirlpool in that part contiguous to the land of Kalinga. O excellent sages, there. is that great holy centre Siddhaksetra which increases the delight of Pitrs. It is the greatest on the earth, approved of by both Devas and Daityas. Usanashas sung a verse on it.
verses.hindi: धूतपापस्थल प्राप्य पृतः स्नात्वा भवेज्नरः । रुत्रस्तन्न तपस्तेपे देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: To the south-east of that excellent mountain, there is a tank with a whirlpool in that part contiguous to the land of Kalinga. O excellent sages, there. is that great holy centre Siddhaksetra which increases the delight of Pitrs. It is the greatest on the earth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: To the south-east of that excellent mountain, there is a tank with a whirlpool in that part contiguous to the land of Kalinga. O excellent sages, there. is that great holy centre Siddhaksetra which increases the delight of Pitrs. It is the greatest on the earth,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेद् बलकेशवौ । तेन देवो जगद्धाता पूजितस्त्रिगुणात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayed balakeśavau / tena devo jagaddhātā pūjitastriguṇātmavān
verses.translation: "Blessed are those men in the world who being devoted to Pitrs propitiate them in Sraddha after reaching Amara¬ kantaka.
verses.hindi: गोकर्णे बरणितं विप्रेर्नास्तिकानां निदर्शनम् । अन्नाह्मणस्य सावित्री पठतः संप्रणश्यति ॥२ १ देबधिभवने शुद्धभो सिद्धचारणसेविते । आरुह्म तं तु नियसात्ततो यान्ति त्रिविष्टपम॒ दिव्येभ्नरदनवुक्षेश्व॒ पादपेरुपशों भितम् । आपश्रन्दनसंपृक्ता वहन्ति सततं यतः
verses.wordMeaning: "Blessed are those men in the world who being devoted to Pitrs propitiate them in Sraddha after reaching Amara¬ kantaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Blessed are those men in the world who being devoted to Pitrs propitiate them in Sraddha after reaching Amara¬ kantaka.

verses.sanskrit: उपवासी नरो भूत्वा यस्तु कुर्यात् प्रदक्षिणम् । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: upavāsī naro bhūtvā yastu kuryāt pradakṣiṇam / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that they will attain Siddhi with very little penance. If they are worshipped even once on Amarakantaka, Pitrs attain Heaven".
verses.hindi: नद्यास्तस्यास्तु या आपो मृच्छेमाना महोदधो । शद्भृग भवन्ति मुक्ताश्न जायन्ते शद्धमुक्तिका:
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that they will attain Siddhi with very little penance. If they are worshipped even once on Amarakantaka, Pitrs attain Heaven".
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that they will attain Siddhi with very little penance. If they are worshipped even once on Amarakantaka, Pitrs attain Heaven".

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु ये वृक्षास्तान्पश्यन्त्यपि ये नराः । ते ऽपि पापैः प्रमुच्यन्ते भ्रूणहत्यासमैर् अपि
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu ye vṛkṣāstānpaśyantyapi ye narāḥ / te 'pi pāpaiḥ pramucyante bhrūṇahatyāsamair api
verses.translation: On the beautiful Mahendra 1 mountain, there is a holy centre resorted to by Sakra. If one mounts it, Pitrs are delighted. The Sraddha (if performed) there, yields great fruit.
verses.hindi: कि इस लोक में वे पुरुष घन्य हैं, जो अमरकण्टक पश्बत पर जाकर अपने पितरों में श्रद्धा भाव रखकर भाद्ध में उन को सल्तुष्ट करेंगे। उस पवंतराज अमरकण्टक पर अल्प तपस्या द्वारा ही लोग सिद्धि प्राप्त करते हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है कि एक ही बार पूजित होकर पितरगण वहाँ पर स्वर्ग प्राप्त करते हैं ।१३-१६। परम रमणीय महेन्द्र पव॑त पर इन्द्र द्वारा सेवित एक पुण्यप्रद स्थान है, वहाँ पर आरोहरण करने से पितरगणों को परम प्रसन्नता होती है और श्राद्ध का महान फल होता है ।१७। विल्वाध (?) शिखर पर जाने से दिव्य नेत्र की प्राप्ति होती है, जिससे मनुष्यों से अदृश्य होकर देवताओों की भाँति पृथ्वी पर विचरण करता है।१८। सप्त गोदाबर तथा गोकर्ण नामक तपोवन में स्नान कर मनुष्य अश्वमेघ यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त करता है ।१६। धृतपाप नामक स्थान 'पर जाकर स्नान करनेवाला मनुष्य परम पवित्र हो जाता है, वहाँ पर देव-देव महेश्वर शंकरजी ने
verses.wordMeaning: On the beautiful Mahendra 1 mountain, there is a holy centre resorted to by Sakra. If one mounts it, Pitrs are delighted. The Sraddha (if performed) there, yields great fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the beautiful Mahendra 1 mountain, there is a holy centre resorted to by Sakra. If one mounts it, Pitrs are delighted. The Sraddha (if performed) there, yields great fruit.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरुत्थाय ये केचित्पश्यन्ति बलकेशवौ । तेन ते सदृशाः स्युर् वै देवदेवेन चक्रिणा
verses.transliteration: prātarutthāya ye kecitpaśyanti balakeśavau / tena te sadṛśāḥ syur vai devadevena cakriṇā
verses.translation: If one practises Yoga on its lower peak named Bilva (Vailata in Bd.P.), one gets divine vision. I-Ie becomes invisible to all living beings and roams over the earth like a Deva.
verses.hindi: परम कठोर तपदचर्या की थी ।२०। उस ग्रोकर्ण नामक स्थान के विषय में ब्राह्मण लोग नास्तिकों के लिये एक अधान लक्षण यह बतलाते हैं कि जो लोग ब्राह्मण न होकर वहाँ गायत्री का पाठ करते हैं, उसकी साविश्नी नाश को प्राप्त होता है ।२१। सिद्धों भौर चारणों से सेवित देवाष के भवन वाले शिखर पर नियमपूर्वक आरोहण क रने- वाले मनुष्य स्वर्ग को प्राप्त करते हैं। क्योंकि उस परम रमणीय शिखर प्रदेश में दिव्य चन्दनादि के वृक्ष परम
verses.wordMeaning: If one practises Yoga on its lower peak named Bilva (Vailata in Bd.P.), one gets divine vision. I-Ie becomes invisible to all living beings and roams over the earth like a Deva.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one practises Yoga on its lower peak named Bilva (Vailata in Bd.P.), one gets divine vision. I-Ie becomes invisible to all living beings and roams over the earth like a Deva.

verses.sanskrit: ते पूज्यास्ते नमस्कार्यास् तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् । ये नमन्ति जगन्नाथं देवं नारायणं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: te pūjyāste namaskāryās teṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / ye namanti jagannāthaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim
verses.translation: If a man takes his holy ablution in the Saptagodavara 2 and in the penance grove Gokarna 3, he attains the benefit of a horse-sacrifice.
verses.hindi: शोभा बढ़ाते हैं, और चन्दन मिश्रित जल की शीतल घारा निरंतर प्रवाहित होती है ।२२-२३। उन जल धाराओं से ताम्रपर्णी नामक नदी प्रवाहित होती है, जो उप्त पव॑तराज की मदोध्मत्त एबं खेद से थकी हुई बाला की तरह दाने: शने: दक्षिण के समुद्र में जाकर मिलती है ।२४। उस ताम्रपर्णी कौ जलराशि महासभुद्र में मिलकर शब्भू- पुक्ता और शब्लमुक्तिका के रूप में उत्पन्न होती है ।२५। जो मनुष्य शद्भ॒ औौर मुक्ताओं के समेत उसके जल को उदकानयन कृत्वा शद्धूमोौक्तिकसंयुतम् । आधिभिर्व्याधिभिश्चेव मुक्ता यानत्यमरावतीम्
verses.wordMeaning: If a man takes his holy ablution in the Saptagodavara 2 and in the penance grove Gokarna 3, he attains the benefit of a horse-sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man takes his holy ablution in the Saptagodavara 2 and in the penance grove Gokarna 3, he attains the benefit of a horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यद्दानं स्नानं देवार्चनं नृप । तत्सर्वमक्षयं तस्य इत्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaddānaṃ snānaṃ devārcanaṃ nṛpa / tatsarvamakṣayaṃ tasya ityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: A man becomes sanctified after taking his holy dip in Dhutapapa. 4 Rudra, Mahesvara, the lord of Devas, performed a penance there.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रतीर्थ बरे पुण्ये पृण्यक्ज्धि निष बिते । चन्द्रतीर्थे कुमार्या तु कावेयाँ प्रभवे5क्षये ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: A man becomes sanctified after taking his holy dip in Dhutapapa. 4 Rudra, Mahesvara, the lord of Devas, performed a penance there.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man becomes sanctified after taking his holy dip in Dhutapapa. 4 Rudra, Mahesvara, the lord of Devas, performed a penance there.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्याग्नौ मृतानां च यत्फलं समुदाहृतम् । तच्छृणुष्व नृपश्रेष्ठ प्रोच्यमानमशेषतः
verses.transliteration: praviśyāgnau mṛtānāṃ ca yatphalaṃ samudāhṛtam / tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpaśreṣṭha procyamānamaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: In the holy place Gokarna, a proof has been cited by Brahmanas for (convincing?) the atheists. If a non-Brahmana recites the Gayatrl mantra, he perishes.
verses.hindi: एतद्डि मण्डल सिद्ध यज्ञियं द्विजसत्तमा:। अस्मिस्मुक्त्वा जनो5ड्गानि क्षिप्रं यात्यमरावतीम् कर्माणि स्वप्रयुक्तानि सिध्यन्ति प्रभवात्यये । दुष्प्रसक्तानि पितृष्षु प्रयुक्तानि भवन्त्युत ३ १ पिता दुहिता पुण्या नमंदा सरितां वरा। ततन्न भ्राद्धानि दत्तानि अक्षयाणि भवन्त्युत
verses.wordMeaning: In the holy place Gokarna, a proof has been cited by Brahmanas for (convincing?) the atheists. If a non-Brahmana recites the Gayatrl mantra, he perishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the holy place Gokarna, a proof has been cited by Brahmanas for (convincing?) the atheists. If a non-Brahmana recites the Gayatrl mantra, he perishes.

verses.sanskrit: विमानेनार्कवर्णेन किंकिणीजालमालिना । आग्नेये भवते तत्र मोदते कालमीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: vimānenārkavarṇena kiṃkiṇījālamālinā / āgneye bhavate tatra modate kālamīpsitam
verses.translation: Those who regularly ascend the peak, the abode of Devas and sages, resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas, attain heaven.
verses.hindi: माठरस्य वने पुण्ये सिद्धचारणसेवितम् । अन्तर्धानं न गच्छन्ति सक्तास्तस्तस्मिन्महागिरोौं
verses.wordMeaning: Those who regularly ascend the peak, the abode of Devas and sages, resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas, attain heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who regularly ascend the peak, the abode of Devas and sages, resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas, attain heaven.

verses.sanskrit: जले चैवा मृतानां तु योधनीपुरमध्यतः । वसन्ति वारुणे लोके यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: jale caivā mṛtānāṃ tu yodhanīpuramadhyataḥ / vasanti vāruṇe loke yāvadābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: Since the place is embellished with divine sandal¬ wood and other trees and since the water mixed with the flavour of sandal flows continuously, a river named Tamraparni 5 originates from them. It slowly winds its way to the southern
verses.hindi: बिन्‍्थ्ये चेव गिरो पुण्ये धर्माधमंनिदर्शनम् । पापधारां न पश्यन्ति धारा पश्यन्ति साधव: तस्यां तु दृश्यते पाप॑ केषांचित्पापकर्मणाम् । स्पष्टठा भवति सा धारा प्रायश: शुभक्ंणामू
verses.wordMeaning: Since the place is embellished with divine sandal¬ wood and other trees and since the water mixed with the flavour of sandal flows continuously, a river named Tamraparni 5 originates from them. It slowly winds its way to the southern
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the place is embellished with divine sandal¬ wood and other trees and since the water mixed with the flavour of sandal flows continuously, a river named Tamraparni 5 originates from them. It slowly winds its way to the southern

verses.sanskrit: अनाशके मृतानां तु तत्र तीर्थे नराधिप । अनिवर्तिका गतिर् नृणां नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: anāśake mṛtānāṃ tu tatra tīrthe narādhipa / anivartikā gatir nṛṇāṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Although this name is applied to the mountain range from Orissa to Madura, here it is specially applied to the range of hills separating Mahanadi from Ganjam District. It is regarded as the resort of Parasurama.
verses.hindi: लाते हैं, वे समस्त आधि व्याधिओं से मुक्त होकर अमरावती को प्राप्त करते हैं ।२६। चन्दनों से संयुक्त छांखों और मुक्ताओं के दान करने से वहाँ पर लोग अपने पाप करने वाले पितरों का भी उद्धार कर देते हैं-ऐसी श्रति है ।२७। पुण्यात्मा जनों द्वारा सुसेवित चन्द्र नामक पृण्यप्रद तीथ में, कुमारी में, कावेरी में, अक्षय प्रभ्व में, श्रीपबंत के तीथ में, वैक्ृत नामक पर्वत पर, औशिर नामक पर्वत पर्रंत पर भी, जहाँ पर कि पेलाश, खदिर,
verses.wordMeaning: Although this name is applied to the mountain range from Orissa to Madura, here it is specially applied to the range of hills separating Mahanadi from Ganjam District. It is regarded as the resort of Parasurama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although this name is applied to the mountain range from Orissa to Madura, here it is specially applied to the range of hills separating Mahanadi from Ganjam District. It is regarded as the resort of Parasurama.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो दद्यात् कपिलादानमुत्तमम् । विधानेन तु संयुक्तं शृणु तस्यापि यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo dadyāt kapilādānamuttamam / vidhānena tu saṃyuktaṃ śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam
verses.translation: A tributary of Gaiiga near Varanasi.
verses.hindi: बेल, पाकड़, पीपल, विकद्धूत आदि के पेड़ एक ही स्थान पर दिखाई पड़ते हैं, पितरों का लोग उद्धार करते हैं । है द्विजवयंगण ! यह तीर्थों का समूह यज्ञ करने के लिये समुचित तथा सिद्धि देनेवाला है, इनमें अपने अंगों (शरीर) को छोड़ देनेवाला मनुष्य अमरावती को प्राप्त करता है।३८-३०। इन पवित्र तीर्थों में किये गये स्वकर्मों के फल अन्य जन्म में मिलते हैं, एवं पितरों के उद्देश्य से अल्प रूप में भी कठिनाई से किये गये कर्म॑ अच्छी तरह से किये गये कर्मों का फल प्रदान करते हैं। पितरों की कन्या नमंदा समस्त सरिताओं में श्रेष्ठ एवं पुष्य प्रदायिनी है, उसके तट पर किये गये श्राद्धादि कर्म अक्षय फलदायी होते हैं ।११-३२। सिद्धों और चारणों से सुसेवित माठर के पवित्र बन में वे अन्तहित नहीं होते, क्योंकि उस महान् गिरि में उनकी आसक्ति है ।३३। पवित्र विस्ध्य ग्रिरि में धर्मी एवं अधर्मी की पहचान के लिये यह देखा जाता है कि जो पापात्मा हैं वे धारा को
verses.wordMeaning: A tributary of Gaiiga near Varanasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: A tributary of Gaiiga near Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: यावन्ति तस्या रोमाणि तत्प्रसूतेश्च भारत । तावन्ति दिवि मोदन्ते सर्वकामैः सुपूजिताः
verses.transliteration: yāvanti tasyā romāṇi tatprasūteśca bhārata / tāvanti divi modante sarvakāmaiḥ supūjitāḥ
verses.translation: The waters of that river in confluence with the great ocean become conchs, pearls and pearl-like conchs. People bringing its waters containing conchs and pearls, become free from mental agonies and physical ailments and go to the heavenly city of Amaravatl.
verses.hindi: नहीं देख पाते, केवल साधुगण उसका दर्शन करते हैं ।३४॥ उस घारा में किन्हीं पाप करमिियों के पाप दिखाई पड़ते हूँ। प्रायः शुभ कर्म करने वालों को ही वह धारा स्पष्ट दिखाई पड़ती है ।३४॥ कोशला में मतंग
verses.wordMeaning: The waters of that river in confluence with the great ocean become conchs, pearls and pearl-like conchs. People bringing its waters containing conchs and pearls, become free from mental agonies and physical ailments and go to the heavenly city of Amaravatl.
verses.commentary: Sense: The waters of that river in confluence with the great ocean become conchs, pearls and pearl-like conchs. People bringing its waters containing conchs and pearls, become free from mental agonies and physical ailments and go to the heavenly city of Amaravatl.

verses.sanskrit: यावन्ति रोमाणि भवन्ति धेन्वास्तावन्ति वर्षाणि महीयते सः । स्वर्गाच् च्युतश्चापि ततस्त्रिलोक्यां कुले समुत्पत्स्यति गोमतां सः
verses.transliteration: yāvanti romāṇi bhavanti dhenvāstāvanti varṣāṇi mahīyate saḥ / svargāc cyutaścāpi tatastrilokyāṃ kule samutpatsyati gomatāṃ saḥ
verses.translation: According to Sruti (Veda), the charitable gift of sandal, conchs and pearls enables Pitrs to cross (hell) even
verses.hindi: इृदमर्ध नास्ति ख. ग. घ. ड्. पुस्तकेष । कोशलायां मतहगस्य वापी पापनिषदनी । स्नातास्तस्यां दिवं यान्ति कामचारविहंगमाः
verses.wordMeaning: According to Sruti (Veda), the charitable gift of sandal, conchs and pearls enables Pitrs to cross (hell) even
verses.commentary: Sense: According to Sruti (Veda), the charitable gift of sandal, conchs and pearls enables Pitrs to cross (hell) even

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो दद्याद् रूप्यं काञ्चनमेव वा । काञ्चनेन विमानेन विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo dadyād rūpyaṃ kāñcanameva vā / kāñcanena vimānena viṣṇuloke mahīyate
verses.translation: So also is the case of Candratlrtha, (Kanya) Kumari, the peiennial source of Kaverl, the holy centres of Silparvata 1, the mountain Vaikrta, and the mountain Osiraparvata where the trees Palasa, Kliadira, Bilva, Plaksa, Asvattha and Vikankata are seen growing in one place. (The people taking ablutions and performing holy rites there attain heaven.) O excellent Brahmanas, this zone of holy centres is sacrifice-worthy and is conducive to great achievements. A person who casts his mortal coil here, quickly reaches the heavenly city of Amaravatl.
verses.hindi: कुमारकोशलाताथथ पते पालपञ्जरे । पाण्डुकूले समुद्रान्ते पण्डारकवने तथा
verses.wordMeaning: So also is the case of Candratlrtha, (Kanya) Kumari, the peiennial source of Kaverl, the holy centres of Silparvata 1, the mountain Vaikrta, and the mountain Osiraparvata where the trees Palasa, Kliadira, Bilva, Plaksa, Asvattha and Vikankata are seen growing in one place.…
verses.commentary: Sense: So also is the case of Candratlrtha, (Kanya) Kumari, the peiennial source of Kaverl, the holy centres of Silparvata 1, the mountain Vaikrta, and the mountain Osiraparvata where the trees Palasa, Kliadira, Bilva, Plaksa, Asvattha and Vikankata are seen growing in one place.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यो दद्यात् पादुके वस्त्रम् एव च । दानस्यास्य प्रभावेन लभते स्वर्गमीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe tu yo dadyāt pāduke vastram eva ca / dānasyāsya prabhāvena labhate svargamīpsitam
verses.translation: Holy rites performed by oneself fructify in the subse¬ quent birth. Rites of Pitrs (though) performed with defects become as beneficial as duly performed rites.
verses.hindi: बिसले च विपापे च सत्कृत्य प्रभवेडभयम् । श्रोवृक्षे गृक्नक्टे च जस्बूमा्गें च नित्यशः ३८ पुष्करेष्वक्षयं भाद्धं तपश्चेव महाफलम् । महोदधो प्रभासे च तस्मादेवं विनिद्दिशेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Holy rites performed by oneself fructify in the subse¬ quent birth. Rites of Pitrs (though) performed with defects become as beneficial as duly performed rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Holy rites performed by oneself fructify in the subse¬ quent birth. Rites of Pitrs (though) performed with defects become as beneficial as duly performed rites.

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्यजुःसामवेदानां पठनाद् यत्फलं भवेत् । तत्र तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र गायत्र्या तत्फलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: ṛgyajuḥsāmavedānāṃ paṭhanād yatphalaṃ bhavet / tatra tīrthe tu rājendra gāyatryā tatphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: The holy river Narmada, the most excellent of all rivers, is the daughter of Pitrs. Sraddhas offered there, become everlasting (in yielding benefits). In the holy forest of Mathara, resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas, they do not vanish because they are attached to that great mountain.
verses.hindi: देविकायां वृषो नाम कपः सिद्धनिषेवितः । समुत्पतन्ति तस्या55पो गर्वा शब्देन नित्यशः ४ १ योगेश्वरे: सदा जुष्टः सर्वपापबहिष्कृत: । दद्याच्छाद्धं तु यस्तस्मिस्तस्य वक्ष्यामि यत्फलभ् ३४२ अक्षयं स्बंकामीय श्राद्ध प्रीणाति थे पितुन्। जातवेद: शिला तत्र साक्षादरने: सनातनो ॥४ ३
verses.wordMeaning: The holy river Narmada, the most excellent of all rivers, is the daughter of Pitrs. Sraddhas offered there, become everlasting (in yielding benefits). In the holy forest of Mathara, resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy river Narmada, the most excellent of all rivers, is the daughter of Pitrs. Sraddhas offered there, become everlasting (in yielding benefits). In the holy forest of Mathara, resorted to by Siddhas and Caranas,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागे यद्भवेत्पुण्यं गयायां च त्रिपुष्करे । कुरुक्षेत्रे तु राजेन्द्र राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे
verses.transliteration: prayāge yadbhavetpuṇyaṃ gayāyāṃ ca tripuṣkare / kurukṣetre tu rājendra rāhugraste divākare
verses.translation: There is a proof (test) for discrimination between the pious and the impious on the holy mountain of Vindhya. Sinners do not see the current (waterfall?) Good men see the current.
verses.hindi: वशाश्वमेधिके तीर्थे तीथें पश्चाश्वमेधिके । यथोहिष्ट फल तेषां क़तुनां नान्र संशयः ॥४ ४५ के पापों को दूर करते वाली पापनिषदिती नामक बावली है, उसमें स्तावकर स्वेच्छा से गमन करनेवाले पक्षी गण भी स्वयं प्राप्त करते हैं ।३६। कुमारकोशला तीर्थ में, पालपञ्जर नामक पर्वत पर, समुद्रान्त पाण्डकूल नामक तीर्थ में, पण्डारक नामक वन में, अतिनिमल पाप रहित प्रभव अभय नामक तीथ में सत्कार कर श्रीवृक्ष, ग॒ध्रक्ट, जम्बूमार्गं, परम बुद्धिमान् योगाचार्य गुरुवर असित के असिता नामक पविन्न तीर्थ में नित्य
verses.wordMeaning: There is a proof (test) for discrimination between the pious and the impious on the holy mountain of Vindhya. Sinners do not see the current (waterfall?) Good men see the current.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a proof (test) for discrimination between the pious and the impious on the holy mountain of Vindhya. Sinners do not see the current (waterfall?) Good men see the current.

verses.sanskrit: सोमेश्वरे च यत्पुण्यं सोमस्य ग्रहणे तथा । तत्फलं लभते तत्र स्नानमात्रान् न संशयः
verses.transliteration: someśvare ca yatpuṇyaṃ somasya grahaṇe tathā / tatphalaṃ labhate tatra snānamātrān na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The sins of some sinners are seen in its current. Us- Srisailam in Kurnool District in Andhra Pradesh. It is one of the twelve J yotirlingas.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध करने से अनन्त फल की प्राप्ति होती है ।३७-३९। पुष्कर तीर्थ में श्राद्ध का अक्षय फल होता हैं, तपस्या महान् फलदायिनी होती है। महासमुद्र . में प्रभास नामक तीथे में भी ऐसी फल- प्राप्ति होती है, इसी लिये ऐसा कहा गयी है ।४०। देविका में सिद्धों द्वारा सुसेवित वृष नामक एक कप है, जिसका जल नित्यप्रति गौओं के शब्द से ऊपर उछलता है। सभी पापों से बहिष्कृत रहनेवाले योगेश्वरों से
verses.wordMeaning: The sins of some sinners are seen in its current. Us- Srisailam in Kurnool District in Andhra Pradesh. It is one of the twelve J yotirlingas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sins of some sinners are seen in its current. Us- Srisailam in Kurnool District in Andhra Pradesh. It is one of the twelve J yotirlingas.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादश्यां तु नरः स्नात्वा नमस्कृत्य जनार्दनम् । उद्धृताः पितरस्तेन अवाप्तं जन्मनः फलम्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśyāṃ tu naraḥ snātvā namaskṛtya janārdanam / uddhṛtāḥ pitarastena avāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam
verses.translation: In KauSala there is the tank of Matanga named PapanisudinI (Remover of Sins). Even stray birds, flying as they please, go to heaven after bathing (casually) in that tank.
verses.hindi: सुसेवित उस कप पर जो श्राद्ध करता है, उसके उस श्राद्ध का फल बतला रहा हूँ, वह श्राद्ध सभी मनोरथों को पूर्ण करनेवाला एवं अक्षय फलदायी है, तथा पितरों को प्रसन्न करता है। ठहाँ पर साक्षात् अग्नि की सनातन काल से प्रतिष्ठित जातवेद नाम शिला है ।४१-४३। वहाँ जो कोई व्यक्ति उस अग्नि में प्रवेश करता है वह स्वगंलोक में आनन्द का अनुभव करता हैं। एवं शान्त अभ्नि होने पर पुनर्जेन्म धारण करता है. उस परम पवित्र तीर्थ में दिया हुआ श्राद्धादि का दान अक्षय फलदायी होता है ।४२। दशाइवमेध तीथ्थ में एवं प्चाइवमेघ तीथ॑ में श्राद्ध करने पर दस एवं पाँच अश्वमेध यज्ञों का फल सचमुच प्राप्त होता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए ।४५। हयशिर नामक पवित्र एवं प्रख्यात तीर्थ शीघ्र वरदान देनेवाला है, वहाँ पर श्राद्धकर्म अक्षय फलदायी होता है, एवं श्राद्धकर्ता स्वगे में आनरद का अनुभव करता है ४६!) कुम्भतीर्थ में जाकर लोग
verses.wordMeaning: In KauSala there is the tank of Matanga named PapanisudinI (Remover of Sins). Even stray birds, flying as they please, go to heaven after bathing (casually) in that tank.
verses.commentary: Sense: In KauSala there is the tank of Matanga named PapanisudinI (Remover of Sins). Even stray birds, flying as they please, go to heaven after bathing (casually) in that tank.

verses.sanskrit: संक्रान्तौ च व्यतीपाते द्वादश्यां च विशेषतः । ब्राह्मणं भोजयेद् एकं कोटिर्भवति भोजिता
verses.transliteration: saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte dvādaśyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayed ekaṃ koṭirbhavati bhojitā
verses.translation: (Ablution) in the Kumarakosala Tirtha on the mountain Palapanjara 1 and on the hanks of Pantfu near the sea, in the Pantfaraka forest, performance of good actions in the Abhaya Prabhava which is pure and sinless, daily visit to Srrvrksa, Grdhrakuta, and Jambumarga and in the holy centre of Asita, the intelligent preceptor of Yoga—performance of Sraddha (at these holy places)—gives everlasting benefits. Sraddha in Puskara 2 is ever-lasting. Penance there yields great fruits and the same is true of the holy centre Prabhasa 8 on the great ocean.
verses.hindi: भ्रांड कुम्मे विमुचचन्ति ज्ञेवं पापनिषदनम् । श्राद्ध तत्राक्षयं प्रोक्तं जप्पहोमतपांसि च
verses.wordMeaning: (Ablution) in the Kumarakosala Tirtha on the mountain Palapanjara 1 and on the hanks of Pantfu near the sea, in the Pantfaraka forest, performance of good actions in the Abhaya Prabhava which is pure and sinless, daily visit to Srrvrksa, Grdhrakuta,…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Ablution) in the Kumarakosala Tirtha on the mountain Palapanjara 1 and on the hanks of Pantfu near the sea, in the Pantfaraka forest, performance of good actions in the Abhaya Prabhava which is pure and sinless, daily visit to Srrvrksa, Grdhrakuta,…

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि ह्यासमुद्राणि पाण्डव । तानि सर्वाणि तत्रैव द्वादश्यां पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni hyāsamudrāṇi pāṇḍava / tāni sarvāṇi tatraiva dvādaśyāṃ pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: In Devika 4, there is a well named Vfsa resorted to by Siddhas. Its water always gushes up on hearing the sound of cows and bulls.
verses.hindi: अधितास्तेन बे साक्षा:ड्ूबन्ती पितरः सदा । अस्मिल्लोके वशी यः स्यात्प्रेत्य स्थगें स मोदते. प्रायश: प्रवरः पुण्यः शिवों नाम ह्ृदस्तथा । तत्र व्याससरः पुण्य दिव्यं श्रह्मसरस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: In Devika 4, there is a well named Vfsa resorted to by Siddhas. Its water always gushes up on hearing the sound of cows and bulls.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Devika 4, there is a well named Vfsa resorted to by Siddhas. Its water always gushes up on hearing the sound of cows and bulls.

verses.sanskrit: क्षयं यान्ति च दानानि यज्ञहोमबलिक्रियाः । न क्षीयते महाराज तत्र तीर्थे तु यत्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: kṣayaṃ yānti ca dānāni yajñahomabalikriyāḥ / na kṣīyate mahārāja tatra tīrthe tu yatkṛtam
verses.translation: It is always resorted to by masters of Yogas who are beyond all sorts of sins. I shall mention the benefit resulting from the performance of Sraddha therein. The Sraddha (there) yields all desires and is ever¬ lasting. It delights Pitjrs. There is a rock of Agni there called Jatavedahsila. He who enters the fire there rejoices in
verses.hindi: ऋग्यजुःसामशिरसः कापोतः पुष्पसाह्वयः । आख्यातः पत्चमो बेदो सुष्ट्वा होतु षु बरह्मणा
verses.wordMeaning: It is always resorted to by masters of Yogas who are beyond all sorts of sins. I shall mention the benefit resulting from the performance of Sraddha therein. The Sraddha (there) yields all desires and is ever¬ lasting. It delights Pitjrs.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is always resorted to by masters of Yogas who are beyond all sorts of sins. I shall mention the benefit resulting from the performance of Sraddha therein. The Sraddha (there) yields all desires and is ever¬ lasting. It delights Pitjrs.…

verses.sanskrit: यद्भूतं यद्भविष्यच्च तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । कथितं ते मया सर्वं पृथग्भावेन भारत
verses.transliteration: yadbhūtaṃ yadbhaviṣyacca tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam / kathitaṃ te mayā sarvaṃ pṛthagbhāvena bhārata
verses.translation: Palamaiijara in Bd.P. near Surparaka or Sopara near Bassein in Thana district of Maharashtra.
verses.hindi: गत्वतान्मुच्यते पापादद्विजों वह्तनिः सनातन: । भ्राद्धं चा55नन्त्यमेतेषु जप्यहोमतपांसि च पुण्डरीके महातोथें पुण्डरकिसमं फलम्॥ ब्रह्मतीर्थे महातीर्थें अश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ५५
verses.wordMeaning: Palamaiijara in Bd.P. near Surparaka or Sopara near Bassein in Thana district of Maharashtra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Palamaiijara in Bd.P. near Surparaka or Sopara near Bassein in Thana district of Maharashtra.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रुक्मिणीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १४३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज योजनेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धौ पुरा कल्पे नरनारायणावृषी
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe rukmiṇītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 143 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja yojaneśvaram uttamam / yatra siddhau purā kalpe naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that the sacrifices performed at the holy centres called Dasasvamedhika and Pancasvame- dhika yield the benefits as indicated (in their names, viz. fruits of ten horse-sacrifices and of five horse-sacrifices).
verses.hindi: श्राद्धादि कर्मों का अनुष्ठान करते हैं, उस पवित्र तीर्थ को पाप विनाशक समझना चाहिए, वहाँ पर किये गये श्राद्ध को अक्षय फलदायी कहा गया है, इसी प्रकार जप, हवन एवं तपस्या के बारे में भी कहा गया है । अजतुंग नामक कल्याणदायी पविन्रतीथ में स्बंदा पितरों का तपंण करना चाहिए, जहाँ पर पर्वों के अवसर पर देवताओं की छाया दिखलाई पड़ती है । समस्त पृथ्वी मण्डल में इस पवित्र तीथें का दान अक्षय
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that the sacrifices performed at the holy centres called Dasasvamedhika and Pancasvame- dhika yield the benefits as indicated (in their names, viz. fruits of ten horse-sacrifices and of five horse-sacrifices).
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that the sacrifices performed at the holy centres called Dasasvamedhika and Pancasvame- dhika yield the benefits as indicated (in their names, viz. fruits of ten horse-sacrifices and of five horse-sacrifices).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तपस्तप्त्वा सङ्ग्रामे देवदानवैः । जयं प्राप्तौ महात्मानौ नरनारायणावुभौ
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā saṅgrāme devadānavaiḥ / jayaṃ prāptau mahātmānau naranārāyaṇāvubhau
verses.translation: The holy centre named Hayasiras is famous as granter of boon immediately. Sraddha performed there yields everlasting benefits. The devotee rejoices in heaven.
verses.hindi: बतलाया जाता है पाण्डव गण यहीं पर रोगमुक्त हुये थे ।४७-४८। सभी प्रकार के पाप पूर्ण कर्मों से विरक्त रहने- वाले योगेश्वरों द्वारा सुसेवित उस परमपवित्र तीर्थ में जो लोग श्राद्ध करते हैं, उसका फल बतला रहा हूँ । उस परम पवित्र तीथे॑ में साक्षात् पूजित होकर पितरगण सर्वदा प्रसन्न रहते हैं, इस लोक में जो इन्द्रियों को स्ववश रखनेवाला है वह मृत्यु के बाद स्वर्ग में आनर्द का अनुभव करता है /४६-५०। परम पवित्र शिव नाम का एक हद है, वहीं पर दिव्यगुण थुक्त व्याससर एवं ब्रह्मसर नामक दो सरोवरों को भी स्थिति है उज्जन्त नामक पुण्यप्रद पर्वत भी वहीं हैं, जिसमें बड़े-बड़े योगीश्वर लोग निवास करते हैं। महात्मा वसिष्ट का पुण्य आश्रम भी वहीं है ।११-५२। इन्हीं तीर्थों के मध्यभाग में ऋक यजु, सामवेद का शिर स्वरूप (?) कापोत अथवा पुष्प (?) नामक तीर्थ की रचता भगवान् ब्रह्मा ने की है, जो पाँचवे वेद के नाम से विख्यात है। इन पावत्र
verses.wordMeaning: The holy centre named Hayasiras is famous as granter of boon immediately. Sraddha performed there yields everlasting benefits. The devotee rejoices in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy centre named Hayasiras is famous as granter of boon immediately. Sraddha performed there yields everlasting benefits. The devotee rejoices in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पुनस्त्रेतायुगे प्राप्ते तौ देवौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । तत्र तीर्थे पुनः स्नात्वा रावणो दुर्जयो हतः
verses.transliteration: punastretāyuge prāpte tau devau rāmalakṣmaṇau / tatra tīrthe punaḥ snātvā rāvaṇo durjayo hataḥ
verses.translation: Sraddha is said to be everlasting. So also are Japas, Homas and penances.
verses.hindi: तीर्थों की यात्रा कर ब्राह्मण सनातन अग्ति की भी भाँति तेजस्वी होकर पाप मुक्त हो जाता है, इसमें श्राद्ध का अनन्त माहात्म्य वर्णित किया गया है जप, हवन एवं तपस्या के लिए भी अनन्त फल कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha is said to be everlasting. So also are Japas, Homas and penances.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha is said to be everlasting. So also are Japas, Homas and penances.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पार्थ कलौ प्राप्ते तौ देवौ बलकेशवौ । वसुदेवकुले जातौ दुष्करं कर्म चक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: punaḥ pārtha kalau prāpte tau devau balakeśavau / vasudevakule jātau duṣkaraṃ karma cakratuḥ
verses.translation: One should always propitiate the Pitrsin the auspicious holy centre of Ajatunga. There the shadow of the heaven-dwel¬ lers is always seen on Parvan days. Whatever is given here becomes everlasting in the world. The Pantfavas became free from ailment here.
verses.hindi: पुण्डरीक नामक महातीथ्थ॑ में श्राद्ध का पुण्डरीक (कमल) के समान मनोहर फल होता है ब्रह्मतीर्थ नामक महातीथे में अश्वमेध यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त होता हैं ।५५। सिन्धुतागर सम्भेद तथा पंचनद तीथ में अक्षय फल की प्राप्ति होती सिन्धुसागरसंभेदे तथा पश्चनदेक्षयम् । कीरकात्मा ततः पुण्यों मण्डवायां च पर्वते
verses.wordMeaning: One should always propitiate the Pitrsin the auspicious holy centre of Ajatunga. There the shadow of the heaven-dwel¬ lers is always seen on Parvan days. Whatever is given here becomes everlasting in the world. The Pantfavas became free from ailment here.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should always propitiate the Pitrsin the auspicious holy centre of Ajatunga. There the shadow of the heaven-dwel¬ lers is always seen on Parvan days. Whatever is given here becomes everlasting in the world. The Pantfavas became free from ailment here.

verses.sanskrit: नरकं कालनेमिं च कंसं चाणूरमुष्टिकौ । शिशुपालं जरासंधं जघ्नतुर् बलकेशवौ
verses.transliteration: narakaṃ kālanemiṃ ca kaṃsaṃ cāṇūramuṣṭikau / śiśupālaṃ jarāsaṃdhaṃ jaghnatur balakeśavau
verses.translation: It is always resorted to by masters of Yogas free from all sins. I shall mention the benefit of performance of Sraddha there.
verses.hindi: देयं सप्तरदे श्राद्ध मानसे च विशेषतः  महाकटे च बन्दे च गिरो त्रिककुदे तथा ५७
verses.wordMeaning: It is always resorted to by masters of Yogas free from all sins. I shall mention the benefit of performance of Sraddha there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is always resorted to by masters of Yogas free from all sins. I shall mention the benefit of performance of Sraddha there.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तत्र रिपून्संख्ये भीष्मद्रोणपुरःसरान् । कर्णदुर्योधनादींश्च निहनिष्यति स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tatastatra ripūnsaṃkhye bhīṣmadroṇapuraḥsarān / karṇaduryodhanādīṃśca nihaniṣyati sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Pitrs worshipped there always become delighted. He who keeps his sense-organs under control in this world shall rejoice after death in heaven.
verses.hindi: जातवेद:शिला तत्र साक्षादसने: सनातनी । श्राद्धानि चार्निका्यं चर तत्र कुर्यात्सदाइक्षयम् संश्रयित्वेकमेकेन सायाक्न प्रति नित्यशः  तस्मिन्देयं सदा श्राद्ध पितृणासक्षयाथिना ६०
verses.wordMeaning: Pitrs worshipped there always become delighted. He who keeps his sense-organs under control in this world shall rejoice after death in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitrs worshipped there always become delighted. He who keeps his sense-organs under control in this world shall rejoice after death in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे तत्र युध्यन्ति ते क्षणम् । भीमार्जुननिमित्तेन शिष्यौ कृत्वा परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: dharmakṣetre kurukṣetre tatra yudhyanti te kṣaṇam / bhīmārjunanimittena śiṣyau kṛtvā parasparam
verses.translation: The lake named Siva is the most excellent. Vyasa- saras and the divine lake Brahma-saras there are also holy.
verses.hindi: दृश्यन्ते काना यूपाः संचिष्ये(दृष्टे ) भास्करोदये । कृत्वा प्रदक्षिण तांस्तु गच्छन्त्यन्तहिता दिवम् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: The lake named Siva is the most excellent. Vyasa- saras and the divine lake Brahma-saras there are also holy.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lake named Siva is the most excellent. Vyasa- saras and the divine lake Brahma-saras there are also holy.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे पुनर्गत्वा तपः कृत्वा सुदुष्करम् । पूजयित्वा द्विजान्भक्त्या यास्येते द्वारकां पुनः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe punargatvā tapaḥ kṛtvā suduṣkaram / pūjayitvā dvijānbhaktyā yāsyete dvārakāṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: The mountain Ujjanta 1 of the noble soul Vasistha is also holy. Centres called Kapota, Puspasahvaya, (and those named after the Vedas) Rg, Yajus, Samanand (Atharva-) Siras have been created by god Brahma. After the creation of these the fifth Veda, viz. Puranas have been narrated by him.
verses.hindi: कीत्यंते च तिलानदत्त्वा पित्॒णां वे सदाक्षयम् ११६४ है, कीरकात्मा नामक पुण्य तीथे भी है, प्बंत पर अवस्थित पण्डवा तीर्थ में भी अक्षय फल होती है । सप्तरद तीथ में विशेषतया मानसतं!थ में श्राद्धऊम अवश्य करना चाहिए। महाकूट, बन्द एवं त्रिककुद पव॑त पर भी श्राद्धक्मं करना चाहिए ।५६-४७। महावेदी में सन्ध्या के अवसर पर महान आश्चरययं दिखाई पड़ता है, किन्तु वह अश्रद्धा रखनेवाले नास्तिकों को नहीं प्राप्त होती, केवल ब्रतपरायण श्रद्धालु ही को प्राप्ति होती है वहाँ पर जःतवेद
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain Ujjanta 1 of the noble soul Vasistha is also holy. Centres called Kapota, Puspasahvaya, (and those named after the Vedas) Rg, Yajus, Samanand (Atharva-) Siras have been created by god Brahma. After the creation of these the fifth Veda, viz.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain Ujjanta 1 of the noble soul Vasistha is also holy. Centres called Kapota, Puspasahvaya, (and those named after the Vedas) Rg, Yajus, Samanand (Atharva-) Siras have been created by god Brahma. After the creation of these the fifth Veda, viz.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेद् बलकेशवौ । तेन देवो जगद्धाता पूजितस्त्रिगुणात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayed balakeśavau / tena devo jagaddhātā pūjitastriguṇātmavān
verses.translation: After going there a Brahmana becomes free from sin like the eternal Fire-god Agni. Sraddha, Japas, Homas and penances are of endless benefits.
verses.hindi: नामक अग्नि की सनातन काल से चली आनेवाली एक शिला है, उस पर श्राद्धादि एवं अग्निहोत्रादि कार्य सबंदा करने चाहिए, क्योंकि उनका अक्षय फल होता है ।५८-५९। पितरों को अक्षयरूप में श्राद्ध देते के इच्छुक व्यक्ति को इन तीर्थों में सबंदा सायंकाल के समय श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। यहाँ पर कतात्मा (पुण्यात्मा) और अक्वतात्मा (पापात्मा) जन मालम पड़ जाते हैं। वहाँ स्वरग्यमार्ग प्रद नामक शीघ्र वर प्रदान करनेवाला
verses.wordMeaning: After going there a Brahmana becomes free from sin like the eternal Fire-god Agni. Sraddha, Japas, Homas and penances are of endless benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: After going there a Brahmana becomes free from sin like the eternal Fire-god Agni. Sraddha, Japas, Homas and penances are of endless benefits.

verses.sanskrit: उपवासी नरो भूत्वा यस्तु कुर्यात् प्रजागरम् । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो गायंस्तस्य शुभां कथाम्
verses.transliteration: upavāsī naro bhūtvā yastu kuryāt prajāgaram / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo gāyaṃstasya śubhāṃ kathām
verses.translation: In Aparanta as per HD. IV. 815. If identified with Ujjayanta, it is Mt. Girnar—De 211; but it is not associated with Vasistha but with Datta and Neminatha. Hence identification in HD probable.
verses.hindi: सरो१२ है ।६०-६१। जिसमें अपने पारस्परिक बेर भावों में छोड़कर सप्तषिगण स्वगंगामी हुए थे आज भी उनके बिगत वरभाव के चिह्न वहाँ दिखाई पड़ते हैं। उस उत्तम तीथ में स्नान कर मनुष्य स्बगलोक को प्राप्त करता है ।६२। वहीं पर नन्दिकेश्वर एवं सिद्धगणों द्वारा सुसेवित प्रसिद्ध आयतन (स्थान) है। वहाँ नन्दिकेश्वर की जो मूर्ति है, वह दुराचारियों को नहीं दिखाई पड़ती ।६३। भास्कर के उदय होने के अवसर पर वहाँ सुबर्ण के यूप (यज्ञ के खंभे) दिखलाई पड़ते हैं । उनकी प्रदक्षिणा करके लोग अन्तहित होकर स्वर्गलोक को चले जाते हैं । योगपरायण महात्मा सनत्कुमार का पुष्यप्रद कुरुक्षेत्र सभी क्षेत्रों में श्रेष्ठ माना गया है । ऐसा कहा जाता
verses.wordMeaning: In Aparanta as per HD. IV. 815. If identified with Ujjayanta, it is Mt. Girnar—De 211; but it is not associated with Vasistha but with Datta and Neminatha. Hence identification in HD probable.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Aparanta as per HD. IV. 815. If identified with Ujjayanta, it is Mt. Girnar—De 211; but it is not associated with Vasistha but with Datta and Neminatha. Hence identification in HD probable.

verses.sanskrit: यावतस्तत्र तीर्थे तु वृक्षान् पश्यन्ति मानवाः । ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं तावद् एषां प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: yāvatastatra tīrthe tu vṛkṣān paśyanti mānavāḥ / brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ tāvad eṣāṃ praṇaśyati
verses.translation: In the great holy centre Pundarika, one attains the benefit (as sweet and fragrant) as lotus. One gets the fruit of a horse-sacrifice in the great holy centre of Brahma Tirtha (by performing Sraddha there).
verses.hindi: एतदघंस्थाने5्यं पाठ: ख. पुस्तके-- तस्मिन्देशे तथा श्राद्धे पितृ णामज्ञक्षयाथिना म्' इति ।
verses.wordMeaning: In the great holy centre Pundarika, one attains the benefit (as sweet and fragrant) as lotus. One gets the fruit of a horse-sacrifice in the great holy centre of Brahma Tirtha (by performing Sraddha there).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the great holy centre Pundarika, one attains the benefit (as sweet and fragrant) as lotus. One gets the fruit of a horse-sacrifice in the great holy centre of Brahma Tirtha (by performing Sraddha there).

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरुत्थाय ये केचित् पश्यन्ति बलकेशवौ । तेनैव सदृशाः सर्वे देवदेवेन चक्रिणा
verses.transliteration: prātarutthāya ye kecit paśyanti balakeśavau / tenaiva sadṛśāḥ sarve devadevena cakriṇā
verses.translation: In the confluence of the Sindhu river and the ocean and in Pafcanada, the benefit is everlasting. Klrakatma 1 (in Bd. P. Viraja) and Mandava on the mountain are sacred spots (?)
verses.hindi: ओजसे चाक्षय श्रार्ड धर्मराजनिवेशने । श्राद्ध दत्तमसावस्यां विधिना व् यथाक़मम ३६५ पुनः संनिहितानां वे कुरुक्षेत्रे विशिववः । अचंयेद्रा वित॒स्तत्र सत्पुत्रस्त्वनूणों भवेत् ६६ विनशने सरस्वत्यां प्लक्षप्रश्रवण तथा। व्यासतोर्थे सरस्वत्यां त्रिप्लक्षे च विशेषतः ६७ देयमोक्ड7रपवने भ्राद्धमक्षयमिच्छता । सर्वतश्चेव गड्ायां मैनाके च नगोत्तमे ६८ यथुनाप्र भवे चेत्र सब्रेपापे: प्रमुच्यते । अत्युष्णाश्रातिशीताश्व आपस्तत्र निदर्शनम् ३६६ यमस्य भगिती पुण्या मातंण्डदुहिता तथा। तत्नाक्षयं तदा श्राद्ध पितृभिः पूर्वकीतितस् (4७०
verses.wordMeaning: In the confluence of the Sindhu river and the ocean and in Pafcanada, the benefit is everlasting. Klrakatma 1 (in Bd. P. Viraja) and Mandava on the mountain are sacred spots (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: In the confluence of the Sindhu river and the ocean and in Pafcanada, the benefit is everlasting. Klrakatma 1 (in Bd. P. Viraja) and Mandava on the mountain are sacred spots (?)

verses.sanskrit: ते पूज्यास्ते नमस्कार्यास्तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् । ये नमन्ति जगत्पूज्यं देवं नारायणं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: te pūjyāste namaskāryāsteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / ye namanti jagatpūjyaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim
verses.translation: Sraddha has to be performed in the holy centre Saptahrada and particularly in Manasa. 2 On the mountains of Mahakuta, Vanda and Trikakuda also (Sraddha should be performed).
verses.hindi: तुला तु दृश्यते यत्र धर्माधमंप्रदर्शिनी । यथा बे तुलितं विग्रेस्तीर्थानां फलमुत्तमम् ॥७२रे वित्॒णां दुहिता योगा गन्धकालीति विश्रुता । चतुर्थो ब्रह्मणश्रांशः पराशरकुलोइहः ७४ व्यत्य त्वेक चतुर्था सु वेद धीमान्महाघुनि:। महायोग॑ महात्मातं यो व्यास जनयिष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha has to be performed in the holy centre Saptahrada and particularly in Manasa. 2 On the mountains of Mahakuta, Vanda and Trikakuda also (Sraddha should be performed).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha has to be performed in the holy centre Saptahrada and particularly in Manasa. 2 On the mountains of Mahakuta, Vanda and Trikakuda also (Sraddha should be performed).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यद्दानं स्नानं देवार्चनं नृप । क्रियते तत्फलं सर्वमक्षयायोपकल्पते
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaddānaṃ snānaṃ devārcanaṃ nṛpa / kriyate tatphalaṃ sarvamakṣayāyopakalpate
verses.translation: In MahavedI (Mahanadi in Bd. P.) a great miracle is seen. It does not appear to one who has no faith (but).it does appear to a person who is firm in his religious vows.
verses.hindi: '+++ मत भा पा पा गान का++++++++०५०५+ धान ना माना». पक न मा परम इन रा नी कि 2४०५४५3५५५५४५५५००५५०५५+५५५०.आ७ पक ...५०++ ५३५५ नासा न न पक 8४४६३ आन न ०१५५-००» पा न-++-+-44७-9४७७५५+५ 2 गा -3 3.3. +भ.3.3न+-+-+++-++3+ आग +4 मम +-+न-+म ननननया+क++-+++4: ८-4.8048५५५-२०३७७७-----०-४४६७--३२-८--६७७....--०२७-०-२०२०-७----२५६३२३२०३५-कन+व-ननवतनीयन-ीी-ऊ३3+०मक हैं कि वहाँ पर तिलों का दान करके पितरों को सबंदा के लिये अक्षय तृप्ति दी जाती है ।६४। घमराज युधिष्ठिर के निवास स्थान पर किया गया श्राद्ध अक्षय फलदायी एवं कीति देनेवाला है। अभावास्या के अवसर पर विधिपू्वेक ऋ्रमानुसार किया गया श्राद्ध तथोक्त फलदायी होता । बिशेषतथा कुरुक्षेत्र के समीप निवास करनेवालों के लिये तो वह परम पवित्र है। सत्पुत्र अपने पितरों की वहाँ पूजा करके ऋण रहित हो जाता
verses.wordMeaning: In MahavedI (Mahanadi in Bd. P.) a great miracle is seen. It does not appear to one who has no faith (but).it does appear to a person who is firm in his religious vows.
verses.commentary: Sense: In MahavedI (Mahanadi in Bd. P.) a great miracle is seen. It does not appear to one who has no faith (but).it does appear to a person who is firm in his religious vows.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेरपत्यं प्रथमं सुवर्णं भूर्वैष्णवी सूर्यसुताश्च गावः । लोकास्त्रयस्तेन भवन्ति दत्ता यः काञ्चनं गां च भुवं च दद्यात्
verses.transliteration: agnerapatyaṃ prathamaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhūrvaiṣṇavī sūryasutāśca gāvaḥ / lokāstrayastena bhavanti dattā yaḥ kāñcanaṃ gāṃ ca bhuvaṃ ca dadyāt
verses.translation: The eternal rock of Agni himself is there. It is called Jatavedahsila. Sraddhas and holy rites in the fire performed there, have never-ending benefits.
verses.hindi: है ।६२५-६६। विनशन, सरस्वती के प्लक्षअ्रश्नवण, सरस्वती के व्यासतीर्थं, एवं ओंकारपवन में अंक्षय श्राद्ध की इच्छा करनेवाले श्राद्ध करें। गंगा में सवंत्र श्राद्ध करता चाहिए, पर्वतश्रेष्ठ मैताक पर श्राद्ध करने का विधान हैं ।९७-८५५। यमुना प्रभवतीर् में श्राद्ध करके मनुष्य समस्त पापों से निवृत्त हो जाता है। उसके अत्यन्त उष्ण और अत्यन्त शीतल जल ही इस तीथ के प्रमाण स्वरूप हैं। यह परमपवित्र यमुना यम की भगिनी और मार्तण्ड
verses.wordMeaning: The eternal rock of Agni himself is there. It is called Jatavedahsila. Sraddhas and holy rites in the fire performed there, have never-ending benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eternal rock of Agni himself is there. It is called Jatavedahsila. Sraddhas and holy rites in the fire performed there, have never-ending benefits.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । अतीतं च भविष्यच्च वर्तमानं महाबलम्
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam / atītaṃ ca bhaviṣyacca vartamānaṃ mahābalam
verses.translation: Going there everyday in the evening, one who seeks never-ending benefits should always offer Sraddha to Pitrs there. A man of purified mind or otherwise is known in the holy centre called Svargyamargaprada (that which shows the path leading to heaven). It grants boons immediately. Casting off their mutual enmity in it, the Seven Sages went to
verses.hindi: की पुत्री हैं. उसमें किया गया श्राद्ध अक्षय फलदायी होता है--ऐसे पूबंकाल से फितरों के वचन हैं ब्रह्मतुद्भ नामक सरोवर में स्नान कर इतर जातिवाले शीघ्र ही ब्राह्मणों की भाँति नष्पाप एबं पुण्यात्मा हो जाते हैं, उसमें श्राद्ध, जप एवं हवनादि करने का अनन्त फल है ।७१। महातपस्वी महू॒थि वसिष्ठ स्थाणुरूप में वहाँ. विचरण करते हैं, और आज भी वहाँ मणियों से चित्रित वक्षों को पक्तियाँ दिखाई पड़ती है। वहां पर धर्म एवं अधर् को दिखानेवाली एक तुला (तराजू) दिखाई पड़ती है. जिस पर तुलकर ब्राह्मणों के कथनावुसार उत्तम
verses.wordMeaning: Going there everyday in the evening, one who seeks never-ending benefits should always offer Sraddha to Pitrs there. A man of purified mind or otherwise is known in the holy centre called Svargyamargaprada (that which shows the path leading to heaven).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Going there everyday in the evening, one who seeks never-ending benefits should always offer Sraddha to Pitrs there. A man of purified mind or otherwise is known in the holy centre called Svargyamargaprada (that which shows the path leading to heaven).…

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वापि पठित्वेदं श्रावयिपत्वाथ धार्मिकान् । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vāpi paṭhitvedaṃ śrāvayipatvātha dhārmikān / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Even today signs of their extinct enmitv
verses.hindi: फल की प्राप्ति होती है। २-७३। पितरों की योगपरायण कन्या जो गन्धकाली नाम स विख्यात है, वहाँ तिबास करती है। भगवान ब्रह्मा के चतुर्थ अंशस्वरूप, मह॒षि पराशर के कुल में समुत्यन्न परम बुद्धिमान् महामुनि व्यास- देव हैं, जिन्होंने एक वेद का विस्तार कर चार भागों में विभाजन किया है, ऐसे परम योगीश्वर महात्मा व्यासदेव
verses.wordMeaning: Even today signs of their extinct enmitv
verses.commentary: Sense: Even today signs of their extinct enmitv

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे योजनेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १४४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज द्वादशीतीर्थमुत्तमम् । क्षरन्ति सर्वदानानि जपहोमबलिक्रियाः
