verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe yojaneśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 144 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja dvādaśītīrthamuttamam / kṣaranti sarvadānāni japahomabalikriyāḥ
verses.translation: Vairapi, but cirdpi 'garments* in'Bd. P. V. 2 3 61 i<
verses.hindi: अच्छोदक नाम सरो यत्राच्छोदा समुच्छिता । मत्स्ययोनो पुनर्जाता नियोगाह्वारणेन तु सिद्धस्तु सेविता नित्य॑ दृश्यते नाकृतात्मभिः  अनिवर्तनं तु नन्‍्दायां वेचां प्रागुत्ते (? )दिशि
verses.wordMeaning: Vairapi, but cirdpi 'garments* in'Bd. P. V. 2 3 61 i<
verses.commentary: Sense: Vairapi, but cirdpi 'garments* in'Bd. P. V. 2 3 61 i<

verses.sanskrit: न क्षीयते तु राजेन्द्र चक्रतीर्थे तु यत्कृतम् । यद्भूतं यद्भविष्यच्च तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: na kṣīyate tu rājendra cakratīrthe tu yatkṛtam / yadbhūtaṃ yadbhaviṣyacca tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam
verses.translation: Lake Manas-sarovar situated in Kailasa
verses.hindi: सिद्धक्षेत्र तु वे जुष्टं यत्प्राप्य न निवर्तते । महालये पद न्‍्यस्तं महादेवेन धीमता (८० देवालये तपस्तप्त्वा एकपादेन ईश्वरः । नीहारश्न युगं दिव्यमुमातुड्रे स्थितं जलम् ८१ उमातुज्धे भृगोस्तुड्ढे ब्रह्मतुड्नो महालये। काद्रवत्यां च शाण्डिल्यां गुहायां वामनस्य च ८रे
verses.wordMeaning: Lake Manas-sarovar situated in Kailasa
verses.commentary: Sense: Lake Manas-sarovar situated in Kailasa

verses.sanskrit: कथितं तन्मया सर्वं पृथग्भावेन भारत
verses.transliteration: kathitaṃ tanmayā sarvaṃ pṛthagbhāvena bhārata
verses.translation: The (land) all over Kuruksetra* is especially an ex¬ cellent holy place of Sanatkumara, the noble-souled lord of the Yogic cult. It is glorified as yielding ever-lasting benefit if Pitrs are offered gingelly seeds (there).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचर्य यजन्ते वे गुरुभक्ताः शतं समा: । एक्मादीनि सदयस्तां स्नात्वा प्राप्नोति सत्फलम् पद ढ को वह उत्पन्न करेगी ।७४-७५। वहाँ पर अच्छोदक नामक सरोवर है, जिसमें अच्छोदा नदी के रूप में वह प्रादर्भूत हुईै। पुनः वारण के नियोगवश वह मत्स्य योनि में उत्पन्न हुई। उसका जहाँ पर पविन्र आसन है, वहाँ पुण्यकर्त्ता जन स्वेदा निवास करते हैं। उस पवित्र स्थान पर एक बार का दिया हुआ श्राद्ध भक्षग्न माना गया है। उम्र अच्छोदा में श्राद्धदान करने से योग एवं समाधि की एक साथ उद्भावना होती है ।७६-७७। कुबेरतुज्ध
verses.wordMeaning: The (land) all over Kuruksetra* is especially an ex¬ cellent holy place of Sanatkumara, the noble-souled lord of the Yogic cult. It is glorified as yielding ever-lasting benefit if Pitrs are offered gingelly seeds (there).
verses.commentary: Sense: The (land) all over Kuruksetra* is especially an ex¬ cellent holy place of Sanatkumara, the noble-souled lord of the Yogic cult. It is glorified as yielding ever-lasting benefit if Pitrs are offered gingelly seeds (there).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे द्वादशीतीर्थमहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १४५ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेद्धरापाल शीवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । दर्शनाद्यस्य देवस्य मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dvādaśītīrthamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 145 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gaccheddharāpāla śīvatīrthamanuttamam / darśanādyasya devasya mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Sraddha performed in the residence of Dharmaraja is conducive to brilliance and it is never-ending (in yielding bene¬ fit). Sr add ha offered on the New Moon day in accordance with injunctions and in the proper order also yields never-ending benefits.
verses.hindi: व्यामोच्य एवं व्यासतीर्थ में जो श्राद्धदान करता है, वह पृण्यकर्तता ब्राह्मण है, उसका श्राद्ध अनन्त एवं अक्षय फलदायी है ।७८। उस स्थान से पूर्युएवं उत्तर दिशा की ओर नन्‍दा ताम की वेदी है, जो पुर्जेंजन्म को रोकनेवाली है, अर्थात् वहाँ पर पिण्डदानादि करने से पुर्जंजन्म नहीं होता । सिद्धजन उसका नित्य सेवन करते हैं, किन्तु अकृतात्माजनत (पापीजन) उसे नहीं देख पाते । परम बुद्धिमान महादेव ने नहाँ पर अपना चरणन्यास
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha performed in the residence of Dharmaraja is conducive to brilliance and it is never-ending (in yielding bene¬ fit). Sr add ha offered on the New Moon day in accordance with injunctions and in the proper order also yields never-ending benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha performed in the residence of Dharmaraja is conducive to brilliance and it is never-ending (in yielding bene¬ fit). Sr add ha offered on the New Moon day in accordance with injunctions and in the proper order also yields never-ending benefits.

verses.sanskrit: शिवतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः । पूजयेत महादेवं सो ऽग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: śivatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ / pūjayeta mahādevaṃ so 'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Moreover, to those who are near about Kuruksetra it is particularly efficacious. A dutiful son who worships Pitrs there, becomes free from his indebtedness to them.
verses.hindi: किया है, वह सिद्धों का क्षेत्र है, वहाँ पहुंचकर पुनजंन्म नहीं होता । देवी के उस पवित्र आयतन में ईश्वर (महादेव) ने एक चरण पर स्थिर होकर कठोर तपस्या कीथी। वहाँ पर उमातुद्भध में नीहार (बरफ) और जल एक देवयुग से स्थित हैं ।७६-८१। उस उमातुज्ध, भृगुतुद्ध, ब्रह्मतुज़्, महालय, काद्रक्ती, शांडिलीगुफा, वामनगुफा आदि पवित्र तीर्थों की यात्रा कर मनुष्य पविन्रात्मा हो जाता है, इन सब तीर्थों में किया गया श्राद्ध अक्षय फलदायी कहा गया है, जप, हवन, ध्यान, अथवा जो कुछ भी सत्कम यहाँ किये जाते हैं, सब अक्षय फलदायी होते हैं ।5२-८३। वहाँ पर ब्रह्मचयं में निरत रहनेवाले गुरुभक्त विद्यार्थी गण सैकड़ों वर्षो तक यज्ञादि का अनुष्ठान करते रहते हैं। उस पवित्र तोर्थ में स्नान करके ये उपर्यक्त फल श्षीघ्न ही प्राप्त किये
verses.wordMeaning: Moreover, to those who are near about Kuruksetra it is particularly efficacious. A dutiful son who worships Pitrs there, becomes free from his indebtedness to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover, to those who are near about Kuruksetra it is particularly efficacious. A dutiful son who worships Pitrs there, becomes free from his indebtedness to them.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या सोपवासो ऽर्चयेच्छिवम् । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य रुद्रलोकाद् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā sopavāso 'rcayecchivam / anivartikā gatistasya rudralokād asaṃśayam
verses.translation: Sraddha should be performed with the repetition of Oriikara by persons who wish for ever-lasting benefit, at the following places: Vinasana, 1 2 on the Sarasvatl river, Plaksa- prasravana 3, Vyasatlrtha on the Sarasvatl and especially at Brahma Ksetra, everywhere on the (banks of) Ganga and on the excellent mountain Mainaka and at the source of Yamuna. One gets absolved of sins (thereby). The proof for the same is the excessively hot and extremely cold water there.
verses.hindi: कुमारधारा तत्रव दृष्ठा पापप्रणाशनी । यानासन च तत्रेव सद्यः स्थाचत्प्रदृश्यते ८५ शेलकीतिपुराभ्यासे काम्ानाप्नोति पुष्कलान् । अदृश्यः सर्वेभृतानां देववच्चरते महीम् ८६ काश्यपस्य महातीर्थ कालसपिरिति श्रुतम् । तत्र श्राद्धानि देयानि नित्यमक्षयमिच्छता ८७
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha should be performed with the repetition of Oriikara by persons who wish for ever-lasting benefit, at the following places: Vinasana, 1 2 on the Sarasvatl river, Plaksa- prasravana 3, Vyasatlrtha on the Sarasvatl and especially at Brahma Ksetra,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha should be performed with the repetition of Oriikara by persons who wish for ever-lasting benefit, at the following places: Vinasana, 1 2 on the Sarasvatl river, Plaksa- prasravana 3, Vyasatlrtha on the Sarasvatl and especially at Brahma Ksetra,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शिवतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १४६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अस्माहकं ततो गच्छेत् पितृतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । प्रेतत्वाद्यत्र मुच्यन्ते पिण्डेनैकेन पूर्वजाः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śivatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 146 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: asmāhakaṃ tato gacchet pitṛtīrthamanuttamam / pretatvādyatra mucyante piṇḍenaikena pūrvajāḥ
verses.translation: (Yamuna) is Yama's sister and the daughter of Mar- tanda (the Sun-god). It is holy. Sraddha performed there is everlasting. It'was so glorified by Pitrs formerly.
verses.hindi: प्रत्यक्ष दृश्यते धर्मस्तीथंयारमेनयोड्ध योर यो: । देवदारुवने चापि चारयेस्तं निदर्शनम् ६ १ विधतानि तु पापानि दृश्यन्ते सुकृतात्मनाम् । भागी रथ्यां प्रयागे च नित्यभक्षयमुच्यते ६२ काजड्जरे दशार्णायां नेमिषे कुरुजाड्रले । वाराणस्यां नगर्या तु देय क्राद्धं तु यत्नतः जा सकते हैं । बहीं पर पापों को नष्ट करनेवाली कुमार धारा का दर्शन होता है वहाँ यान (वाहन) एवं आसन का लाभ करते हुये शीघज्ष ही देखा जाता है ।६४-८५। शलकीति नामक पवित्र तोथं में स्तात करके मनुष्य अपने सम्पूर्ण मनोरथों को प्राप्त करता है। सभी प्राणियों से अदृश्य होकर वह॒ देवताओं की तरह पृथ्वी पर विचरण करता है ।८६। काश्यप का परम प्रसिद्ध कालसवि नामक महान् तीर्थ सुना गया है, अक्षय श्राद्ध के इच्छुक
verses.wordMeaning: (Yamuna) is Yama's sister and the daughter of Mar- tanda (the Sun-god). It is holy. Sraddha performed there is everlasting. It'was so glorified by Pitrs formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Yamuna) is Yama's sister and the daughter of Mar- tanda (the Sun-god). It is holy. Sraddha performed there is everlasting. It'was so glorified by Pitrs formerly.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: अस्माहकस्य माहात्म्यं कथयस्व ममानघ । स्नानदानेन यत्पुण्यं तथा पिण्डोदकेन च
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: asmāhakasya māhātmyaṃ kathayasva mamānagha / snānadānena yatpuṇyaṃ tathā piṇḍodakena ca
verses.translation: One taking ablutions in the lake Brahmanuga be¬ comes a Brahmana immediately. Sraddha, Japas, Homas and penances performed there are everlasting.
verses.hindi: मनुष्यों को वहां नित्य श्राद्धवात करना चाहिए  शाज्षप्राम के चारों ओर किया गया श्राद्व कर्म अक्षय रूप पै प्राष्त होता है, किन्तु पापात्माओं को वह परम पवित्र तीथ॑ प्रत्यक्ष होने पर भी आँखों से नहीं दिखाई पड़ता
verses.wordMeaning: One taking ablutions in the lake Brahmanuga be¬ comes a Brahmana immediately. Sraddha, Japas, Homas and penances performed there are everlasting.
verses.commentary: Sense: One taking ablutions in the lake Brahmanuga be¬ comes a Brahmana immediately. Sraddha, Japas, Homas and penances performed there are everlasting.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुरा कल्पे नृपश्रेष्ठ ऋषिदेवसमागमे । प्रश्नः पृष्टो मया तात यथा त्वमनुपृच्छसि
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā kalpe nṛpaśreṣṭha ṛṣidevasamāgame / praśnaḥ pṛṣṭo mayā tāta yathā tvamanupṛcchasi
verses.translation: Vasistha of great penance performed penance standing still like a stump. Even to-day trees are seen there studded with gems.
verses.hindi: उस पवित्र तीथ्थ में अशिष्ट लोगों का,जाना वर्जित है, केवल शिष्टजन ही उम्में प्रवेश पा सकते हैं। बहाँ के पुण्य सरोवर में निवास करनेवाला नागराज केवल सत्पुरुषों द्वारा दिये गये पिण्डों का भक्षण करता है, और असध्पुरुषों द्वारा दिये गये पिण्डों का भक्षण नहीं करता । वह अपने साथ रहनेवाले असंख्य प्रचण्ड सर्पों समेत भी उस पापात्मा के अन्न का भक्षण करने में अशक्त रह जाता है! इन उपय॑क्त दोनों पवित्र तीर्थों में चर्म को प्रत्यक्ष देखा जाता है, देवदारु वन में भी यह निदर्शंक पाया जाता है, सुक्ृती जनों के पाप तो यहाँ दूर होते दिखाई पड़ते हैं। भागीरथी और प्रयाग में भी श्राद्ध का अक्षय फल कहा गया है ।58-६ २। कालंजर, दवाणं, नेमिष कुरजाडूल, तथा वाराणसी नगरी--इन पवित्र तीर्थों में मनुष्य को प्रयत्न करके श्राद्धकर्मे सम्पन्न करता चाहिए । वाराणसी नगरी में योगेश्वर झंकर का नित्य निवास रहता है, अतः उसमें पिण्डदान करने से अक्षय फल की
verses.wordMeaning: Vasistha of great penance performed penance standing still like a stump. Even to-day trees are seen there studded with gems.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasistha of great penance performed penance standing still like a stump. Even to-day trees are seen there studded with gems.

verses.sanskrit: एकत्र सागराः सप्त सप्रयागाः सपुष्कराः । नास्य साम्यं लभन्ते ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: ekatra sāgarāḥ sapta saprayāgāḥ sapuṣkarāḥ / nāsya sāmyaṃ labhante te nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: The famous sacred place in Haryana—the country round Thaneswar. Some of the holy places, e.g. Vyasa-tlrtha or Dvaipayana Hrada are in this area. Sarasvati flowed through it.
verses.hindi: प्राप्ति होती है इन पवित्र तीर्थों में पिण्डदान करके मनुष्य पवित्रात्मा हो जाता है, उसका श्राद्ध अनन्त फल दायी होता है। इसी प्रकार जप, हवन एवं अन्यान्य सत्कर्मों का भी अयक्षफल वहाँ होता है । लोहित्य बंतरणी, एबं
verses.wordMeaning: The famous sacred place in Haryana—the country round Thaneswar. Some of the holy places, e.g. Vyasa-tlrtha or Dvaipayana Hrada are in this area. Sarasvati flowed through it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The famous sacred place in Haryana—the country round Thaneswar. Some of the holy places, e.g. Vyasa-tlrtha or Dvaipayana Hrada are in this area. Sarasvati flowed through it.

verses.sanskrit: सोमनाथं तु विख्यातं यत्सोमेन प्रतिष्ठितम् । तत्र सोमग्रहे पुण्यं तत्पुण्यं लभते नरः
verses.transliteration: somanāthaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ yatsomena pratiṣṭhitam / tatra somagrahe puṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ
verses.translation: The spot in the sandy desert in Sirhind district where Sarasvati
verses.hindi: सकृदेव समुद्रान्ते दृश्यते पृण्यकर्तभिः । गडगायां धर्मप्रष्ठे च सरसि ब्रह्मणस्तथा ख्यापितं धर्मसवेस्त्रं लोकस्यपास्य निदर्शनम् । एवं पच्च॒वन पुष्य पुण्यकृज्ठि निषेवितम् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: The spot in the sandy desert in Sirhind district where Sarasvati
verses.commentary: Sense: The spot in the sandy desert in Sirhind district where Sarasvati

verses.sanskrit: मासान्ते पितरो नृणां वीक्षन्ते सन्ततिं स्वकाम् । कश्चिद् अस्मत्कुले ऽस्माकं पिण्डमत्र प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: māsānte pitaro nṛṇāṃ vīkṣante santatiṃ svakām / kaścid asmatkule 'smākaṃ piṇḍamatra pradāsyati
verses.translation: The source of the river Sarasvatl in the hills of Sirmur in the Siwalik range of the Himalayas.
verses.hindi: तुलामानस्तथा चाप: शास्त्रेश्न विविधेस्तथा । उन्‍्मज्जन्ति तथा लग्ने ये बे पापकृतो जना: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The source of the river Sarasvatl in the hills of Sirmur in the Siwalik range of the Himalayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The source of the river Sarasvatl in the hills of Sirmur in the Siwalik range of the Himalayas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रपितामहास्तथादित्याः श्रुतिरेषा सनातनी । एवं ब्रुवन्ति देवाश्च ऋषयः सतपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: prapitāmahāstathādityāḥ śrutireṣā sanātanī / evaṃ bruvanti devāśca ṛṣayaḥ satapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: There a weighing balance that indicates piety and impiety, is seen. People who get themselves weighed by Brah- manas in it derive excellent fruits.
verses.hindi: मुण्डपृष्ठ पद न्यस्तं महादेवेन धीमता । बहुन्देवयुगांस्तप्त्वा तपस्तीत्रं सुदुश्चरम् १०२ अल्पेनाप्यत्र कालेन नरो धर्मपरायणः । पाप्पानसुत्सजत्याश जीर्णत्वचमिवोरग: ॥ सिद्धानां प्रीतिजननेः पापानां च भयंकरे:। लेलिहानमंहाभोगे रक्षितं तु दिवानिशम्
verses.wordMeaning: There a weighing balance that indicates piety and impiety, is seen. People who get themselves weighed by Brah- manas in it derive excellent fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: There a weighing balance that indicates piety and impiety, is seen. People who get themselves weighed by Brah- manas in it derive excellent fruits.

verses.sanskrit: सकृत्पिण्डोदकेनैव शृणु पार्थिव यत्फलम् । द्वादशाब्दानि राजेन्द्र योगं भुक्त्वा सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: sakṛtpiṇḍodakenaiva śṛṇu pārthiva yatphalam / dvādaśābdāni rājendra yogaṃ bhuktvā suśobhanam
verses.translation: The daughter of Pitrs, the great Yogini, is famous by the name of Gandhakali. It is she who will give birth to the great Yogin, the noble souled Vyasa, who will divide the single Veda into four, who will be an intelligent great sage, the great scion of the family of Parasara and who is a fourth part of Brahma.
verses.hindi: स्वर्ण वेदी में भी श्राद्धकमे के यही फल कहे गये हैं ।8३-६४५। पुण्यकर्म परायणों ने समुद्रान्त में केवल एक श्राद्ध करने का विधान देखा है ! गज्भा, धर्मपृष्ठ, ब्रह्मसरोवर, गया, गृध्रकट, प्रभृति तीर्थों में श्राद्धधान का महान फल है। भरत के पवित्र, पुण्यप्रद आश्रम में जो अरण्य है, वह परम पुण्यदायी कहा है, उसके चारों ओर पाँच योजन तक बरफ गिरता है। उस पवित्र अरण्य मे माँस नेत्रधारी मनुष्य को भी मतंग ऋषि का आश्रम - दिखाई पड़ता
verses.wordMeaning: The daughter of Pitrs, the great Yogini, is famous by the name of Gandhakali. It is she who will give birth to the great Yogin, the noble souled Vyasa, who will divide the single Veda into four, who will be an intelligent great sage,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The daughter of Pitrs, the great Yogini, is famous by the name of Gandhakali. It is she who will give birth to the great Yogin, the noble souled Vyasa, who will divide the single Veda into four, who will be an intelligent great sage,…

verses.sanskrit: युगे युगे महाराज अस्माहके पितामहाः । सर्वदा ह्यवलोकन्त आगच्छन्तं स्वगोत्रजम्
verses.transliteration: yuge yuge mahārāja asmāhake pitāmahāḥ / sarvadā hyavalokanta āgacchantaṃ svagotrajam
verses.translation: There is the lake Acchodaka 1 from which she origina¬ ted as the river Acchoda. Again she (Gandhakali) was born of the womb of a fish at the instance of Varana 2.
verses.hindi: है ।६६-६८। यह परम पवित्र तीथं घममं स्वेस्व के रूप में प्रसिद्ध किया गया है, एवं इस लोक का धर्म निदर्शंक है। इसी प्रकार पतच्चवन नामक पुण्यप्रद तीर्थ भी पुण्यात्माओं द्वारा सुसेवित है। उस पत्चवन तीथे ने पाण्डु- विश्ञाला नामक तीर्थ धर्म का प्रत्यक्ष निदशंन है।६। जो पाप करनेवाले मनुष्य होते हैं, वे वहाँ तुलामान चाप ओर विविध शस्त्रों समेत लग्न आने पर डुबकी लगाते हैं। तृतीय में पद, निस्वर पावमण्डल (?) महाह्ृद तथा कौछिकी में दिया गया श्राद्ध महाफल देनेवाला होता है ।!००-१०१। परम बुद्धिमान महादेव ने मुण्डपृष्ठ में अपता पदन्‍्यास किया था, अनेक देव युगों तक परम कठोर एवं दुर्गम तपस्या उन्होंने वहाँ की थी । धर्म में आस्था रखनेवाला मनुष्य बहुत थोड़े समय में ही वहाँ अपने समस्त पापकर्मों को सर्प की कुचल की भाँति छोड़ देता है।१०२-१०३। वह परम पुनीत तीर्थ सिद्ध जनों के प्रीतिकारी, पापात्माओं के लिये परम भयंहर एवं
verses.wordMeaning: There is the lake Acchodaka 1 from which she origina¬ ted as the river Acchoda. Again she (Gandhakali) was born of the womb of a fish at the instance of Varana 2.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is the lake Acchodaka 1 from which she origina¬ ted as the river Acchoda. Again she (Gandhakali) was born of the womb of a fish at the instance of Varana 2.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यति किम् अस्माकम् अमावास्याप्यमाहके । स्नानं दानं च ये कुर्युः पित्ःणां तिलतर्पणम्
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyati kim asmākam amāvāsyāpyamāhake / snānaṃ dānaṃ ca ye kuryuḥ pitḥṇāṃ tilatarpaṇam
verses.translation: The place where she has a holy hermitage, is resorted to by meritorious persons. Sraddha offered there once, is said to be everlasting. If Sraddha is offered there even once, it causes the attainment of Yoga and Samadhi (Trance).
verses.hindi: अपनी विशाल दाढ़ों को लपलपाने वाले महान् सर्पों से रात दिन सुरक्षित है। उस मुण्डपृष्ठ तीर्थ के उत्तर
verses.wordMeaning: The place where she has a holy hermitage, is resorted to by meritorious persons. Sraddha offered there once, is said to be everlasting. If Sraddha is offered there even once, it causes the attainment of Yoga and Samadhi (Trance).
verses.commentary: Sense: The place where she has a holy hermitage, is resorted to by meritorious persons. Sraddha offered there once, is said to be everlasting. If Sraddha is offered there even once, it causes the attainment of Yoga and Samadhi (Trance).

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वपापनिर्मुक्ताः सर्वान्कामांल्लभति वै । जलमध्ये ऽत्र भूपाल अग्नितीर्थं च तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: te sarvapāpanirmuktāḥ sarvānkāmāṃllabhati vai / jalamadhye 'tra bhūpāla agnitīrthaṃ ca tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: He who offers Sraddha in Kuberatunga, Vyamocca and Vyasatlrtha is a holy Brahmana. The Sraddha yields ever¬ lasting benefits.
verses.hindi: नाम्ता कनकनन्दीति तीर्थ त्ेलोक्यविश्वुतम् । उदीच्यां मुण्डपृष्ठस्य देवषिगणसेवितम् ॥। तन्न स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति कामचारा विहंगमाः १०५ दत्त चापि तथा श्राद्धमक्षयं समुदाहृतम् । ऋणेस्त्रिभिस्तदा स्नात्वा निक्षिणोति नरोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: He who offers Sraddha in Kuberatunga, Vyamocca and Vyasatlrtha is a holy Brahmana. The Sraddha yields ever¬ lasting benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who offers Sraddha in Kuberatunga, Vyamocca and Vyasatlrtha is a holy Brahmana. The Sraddha yields ever¬ lasting benefits.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनात् तस्य तीर्थस्य पापराशिर्विलीयते । स्नानमात्रेण राजेन्द्र ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: darśanāt tasya tīrthasya pāparāśirvilīyate / snānamātreṇa rājendra brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: In the north-eastern quarter there is Nandavedl. It is resorted to by Siddhas for ever. It is not visible to non-self- possessed souls. (Those who perform Sraddha there) do not return (i.e. they attain liberation from Samsara).
verses.hindi: तीरे तु सरसस्तत्र देवस्थाइड्यतनं महत् । आरुह्म तज्जपंस्तन्न सिड्धो याति दिवं ततः
verses.wordMeaning: In the north-eastern quarter there is Nandavedl. It is resorted to by Siddhas for ever. It is not visible to non-self- possessed souls. (Those who perform Sraddha there) do not return (i.e. they attain liberation from Samsara).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the north-eastern quarter there is Nandavedl. It is resorted to by Siddhas for ever. It is not visible to non-self- possessed souls. (Those who perform Sraddha there) do not return (i.e. they attain liberation from Samsara).

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लाम्बरधरो नित्यं नियतः स जितेन्द्रियः । एककालं तु भुञ्जानो मासं तीर्थस्य सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: śuklāmbaradharo nityaṃ niyataḥ sa jitendriyaḥ / ekakālaṃ tu bhuñjāno māsaṃ tīrthasya sannidhau
verses.translation: In the holy centre Mahalaya, 3 the intelligent Maha- deva had imprinted his foot. It is a Siddhaksetra resorted to (by Siddhas). People who go there do not return (i.e. attain Moksa).
verses.hindi: तस्मिन्निवंतंयेज्छाडं यथाशक्ति यथाबलम् । कामान्स लभते दिव्यान्मोक्षोपायं च नित्यशः सानसे सरसि श्रेष्ठे दृश्यते महदद्भुतम् । दिवश्च्च्युता महाभागा ह्यन्तरिक्षे विराजते ११० गड़ा त्रिपथगा देवी सोमपाद्वाच्युता भुवि । आकाशे दृश्यते तत्र तोरणं सुर्यंसंतिभम् ११११
verses.wordMeaning: In the holy centre Mahalaya, 3 the intelligent Maha- deva had imprinted his foot. It is a Siddhaksetra resorted to (by Siddhas). People who go there do not return (i.e. attain Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the holy centre Mahalaya, 3 the intelligent Maha- deva had imprinted his foot. It is a Siddhaksetra resorted to (by Siddhas). People who go there do not return (i.e. attain Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णालंकृतानां तु कन्यानां शतदानजम् । फलमाप्नोति सम्पूर्णं पितृलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: suvarṇālaṃkṛtānāṃ tu kanyānāṃ śatadānajam / phalamāpnoti sampūrṇaṃ pitṛloke mahīyate
verses.translation: (Partially defective) On (the peak called) Umatunga, in the shrine of the goddess (Uma) has performed penance standing on one foot for the period of a divine yuga, without taking any food 4. And the water (also) stood (for that period?).
verses.hindi: पावनो सर्वेभ्नुतानां धर्मज्ञानां विशेषतः  चन्द्रभागा च सिन्धुश्न उसे मानससंनिभे ॥
verses.wordMeaning: (Partially defective) On (the peak called) Umatunga, in the shrine of the goddess (Uma) has performed penance standing on one foot for the period of a divine yuga, without taking any food 4. And the water (also) stood (for that period?).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Partially defective) On (the peak called) Umatunga, in the shrine of the goddess (Uma) has performed penance standing on one foot for the period of a divine yuga, without taking any food 4. And the water (also) stood (for that period?).

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्याम् आसमुद्रायां महाभोगपतिर्भवेत् । धनधान्यसमायुक्तो दाता भवति धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyām āsamudrāyāṃ mahābhogapatirbhavet / dhanadhānyasamāyukto dātā bhavati dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: The same as Omkaranatha or Amaresvara in M.P. _Dc 117
verses.hindi: पर स्नान करके इच्छानुरूप विचरण करनेवाले विहंगम स्वर्ग को प्राप्ति करते हैं ।१०४-१०५। वहाँ पर दिया गया श्राद्ध अक्षय फलदायी कहा गया है। उत्तम मनुष्य उस पुतीत तीथे में स्नान करके तीनों ऋणों से मुक्त होते हैं। सरोवर के तीर पर देव का विशाल मन्दिर है, उस पर आरूढ़ होकर मन्त्र जप करने से »द्ध होता हैं तदनन्तर स्वर्ग की प्राप्ति होती है ।१०६-१०७। उत्तर ओर मानस तीथ की यात्रा करने से परम सिद्धि को प्राप्ति होती है  वहाँ जाने से सुरश्रेष्ठ का प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन होता है, जो अत्यन्त आश्चयें का विषय है  वहाँ जाकर अपनी शक्ति एवं पराक्रम के अनुसार श्राद्धकर्म सम्पन्न करना चाहिए, जो ऐसा करता है वह दिव्य मनोरथों की प्राप्ति करता है एवं मोक्ष का उपाय सुलभ करता है ।!०८-१०९। परम श्रेष्ठ उस मानस सरोवर में एक महान आएचय दिखाई पड़ता है, वहाँ पर महाभाग्य शालिनी तजिपथयामिनी गड्जा देवी आकाशमाग से च्यूत होकर
verses.wordMeaning: The same as Omkaranatha or Amaresvara in M.P. _Dc 117
verses.commentary: Sense: The same as Omkaranatha or Amaresvara in M.P. _Dc 117

verses.sanskrit: उपवासी शुचिर्भूत्वा ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नुयात् । अस्माहकं समासाद्य यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: upavāsī śucirbhūtvā brahmalokamavāpnuyāt / asmāhakaṃ samāsādya yastu prāṇān parityajet
verses.translation: One becomes sanctified by visiting Umatunga, Bhrgutunga, Brahmatunga, Mahalaya, Kadravati, Sandili and Vamana's cave. Sraddha performed there yields ever-lasting benefit. Japa, Homa and meditation—everything performed there becomes meritorious.
verses.hindi: अन्तरिक्ष में विराजमान हैं  वह देवी वहीं पर चन्द्र मण्डल से पृथ्वी तल पर गिरी हैं। वहाँ आक्राशमण्डल में सूय के समान परम तेजोमय तोरण दिखाई पड़ता है। जो सुवर्णमय तथा स्वर्ण के द्वार की भाँति विस्तृत है । वहीं से जीवों की  विशेषतय। धर्म के मर्म को जाननेवालों की--उद्धार करनेवाली चन्द्रभागा नामक नदी निकल कर पूर्व के समुद्र में गिरती है ।११०-१११। चन्द्रभागा और सिन्‍्धु ये दोनों नदियाँ मानस सरोवर की भाँति
verses.wordMeaning: One becomes sanctified by visiting Umatunga, Bhrgutunga, Brahmatunga, Mahalaya, Kadravati, Sandili and Vamana's cave. Sraddha performed there yields ever-lasting benefit. Japa, Homa and meditation—everything performed there becomes meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: One becomes sanctified by visiting Umatunga, Bhrgutunga, Brahmatunga, Mahalaya, Kadravati, Sandili and Vamana's cave. Sraddha performed there yields ever-lasting benefit. Japa, Homa and meditation—everything performed there becomes meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिवर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते । ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टः क्षीणकर्मा दिवश्च्युतः
verses.transliteration: koṭivarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate / tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭaḥ kṣīṇakarmā divaścyutaḥ
verses.translation: By regularly visiting Sailaklrtipura, one attains all cherished desires. Like Devas he remains invisible to all living beings and roams in the earth.
verses.hindi: पुण्यदायी एवं पवित्र हैं, नदियों में श्रेष्ठ दिव्य गुणयुक्त सिन्धु पश्चिम के समुद्र में गिरती है विविध्न प्रकार के धातुओं से विभूषित हिंमवान् नामक पर्वत है, जो अस्सी सहसों योजन विस्तृत कहा जाता है, सिद्धों एवं सिद्ध चारणसंको्ण: सिद्धच्चाचारणसेवित:ः । तत्र पुष्करिणी रम्या सुषुम्ना नाम विश्वुता
verses.wordMeaning: By regularly visiting Sailaklrtipura, one attains all cherished desires. Like Devas he remains invisible to all living beings and roams in the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: By regularly visiting Sailaklrtipura, one attains all cherished desires. Like Devas he remains invisible to all living beings and roams in the earth.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णमणिमुक्ताढ्ये कुले जायेत रूपवान् । कृत्वाभिषेकविधिना हयमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇamaṇimuktāḍhye kule jāyeta rūpavān / kṛtvābhiṣekavidhinā hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Sraddhas should be offered everyday by one who seeks everlasting benefits at the great holy centre of Kasyapa well known as Kalasarpi.
verses.hindi: कुर्याच्छाद्धमथ्थतेषु नित्यमेव यथाविधि। प्रदक्षिणं दिशं गत्वा सर्वकासचिकीर्षक:ः
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhas should be offered everyday by one who seeks everlasting benefits at the great holy centre of Kasyapa well known as Kalasarpi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhas should be offered everyday by one who seeks everlasting benefits at the great holy centre of Kasyapa well known as Kalasarpi.

verses.sanskrit: धनाढ्यो रूपवान्दक्षो दाता भवति धार्मिकः । चतुर्वेदेषु यत्पुण्यं सत्यवादिषु यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: dhanāḍhyo rūpavāndakṣo dātā bhavati dhārmikaḥ / caturvedeṣu yatpuṇyaṃ satyavādiṣu yatphalam
verses.translation: Sraddha performed all round Salagrama 2 becomes ever-lasting. It is not directly visible to sinful persons,
verses.hindi: त्रेवण्यें बिहिते स्थाने धर्मवर्णाश्रमे तथा । कोयस्थानस्य संत्यागात्प्राप्पते पितृपुजनम् चारणों के समूहों से वह पंत राज भरा पड़ा है। उसमें सुषुम्ता नामक एक परम मनोहर पुष्करिणी है, उसमें जन्म लेनेवाला प्राणी दस सहल्नो व जीवित रहता है, उसमें दिया हुआ श्राद्ध महान् उन्नति करनेवाला तथा अनन्तफल दायी होता है, उसमें श्राद्ध करके मनुष्य अपनी दस अगली और दस पिछली पीढ़ियों को तारता है ।११३-११६। हिमवान् पब॑ंत का प्रत्येक स्थल पुण्यदायी है, गंगा में सर्वत्र पुण्य है । इसी प्रकार समुद्र में गिरने
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha performed all round Salagrama 2 becomes ever-lasting. It is not directly visible to sinful persons,
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha performed all round Salagrama 2 becomes ever-lasting. It is not directly visible to sinful persons,

verses.sanskrit: तत्फलं लभते नूनं तत्र तीर्थे ऽभिषेचनात् । तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं निर्मितं शम्भुना पुरा
verses.transliteration: tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ tatra tīrthe 'bhiṣecanāt / tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ śambhunā purā
verses.translation: The place is forbidden to the evil-minded and the good ones are allowed entry, since the pure divine king of serpents dwelling in the holy lake accepts the Pintfa of thegood and not that of the bad. Even by the highly illuminated ser¬ pents, the food cannot be eaten (if offered by the bad).
verses.hindi: वाली अम्यान्य नदियाँ तथा स्वयं समुद्र भी सर्वत्र श्राद्धकर्मों में पुषण्यदायी कहा गया है। बुद्धिमान पुरुष इन उपर्युक्त एवं अन्यान्य पविच्न ती्थों में आद्धक्रिया सम्पन्न करे । पवित्रतीर्थों में स्नान एवं दान करके मनुष्य पविन्न हो जाता है ! १७-११५। उच्च गिरिशिखर पर, कन्दरा एवं गुफाओं में पर्वतों की उपत्यकाओं एवं झरनों के समीप, नदियों के तटों, पर युगारम्भ की तिथियों, महासमुद्र के तट पर, गौंओं की शाला में, नदियों के
verses.wordMeaning: The place is forbidden to the evil-minded and the good ones are allowed entry, since the pure divine king of serpents dwelling in the holy lake accepts the Pintfa of thegood and not that of the bad. Even by the highly illuminated ser¬ pents,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The place is forbidden to the evil-minded and the good ones are allowed entry, since the pure divine king of serpents dwelling in the holy lake accepts the Pintfa of thegood and not that of the bad. Even by the highly illuminated ser¬ pents,…

verses.sanskrit: हृदयेशः स्वयं विष्णुर् जपेद्देवं महेश्वरम् । गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव मरुतो मारुतास्तथा
verses.transliteration: hṛdayeśaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇur japeddevaṃ maheśvaram / gandharvāpsarasaścaiva maruto mārutāstathā
verses.translation: In these two holy centres, Dharma is directly seen. In Devadaruvana 3 too the same proof can be seen.
verses.hindi: संगम पर बनों में, स्वच्छ लिपी पुती मनोहर पृथ्वी पर, गोबर से लिपे हुए एकास्त घर में नित्य ही विधिपृर्वक श्राद्धकरना चाहिए। सभी मनोरथों की प्राप्ति का इच्छुक मनुष्य इन स्थानों पर श्राद्ध एवं प्रदक्षिण कर सफल होता है ।११९-३२४। सवंदा इन्हीं स्थानों में आलस्थादि छोड़कर सावधान मन से श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। इस प्रकार बुद्धिमान पुरुष ब्रह्मत्व की सिद्धि प्राप्त कर सकता है ।!२३। क्रोधादि को सबंथा छोड़ने पर तीनों उच्च- वर्णा (ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय तथा वेश्य) से किये धर्म एवं वर्णाश्रम की मर्यादा से अनुमोदित विधि के अनुसार दान करने पर पितरों की पूजा का फल प्राप्त होता है ।१२४। पापात्मा भी इन उपर्युक्त पवित्र तीर्थों की यात्रा धैय॑ एवं, श्रद्धा
verses.wordMeaning: In these two holy centres, Dharma is directly seen. In Devadaruvana 3 too the same proof can be seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: In these two holy centres, Dharma is directly seen. In Devadaruvana 3 too the same proof can be seen.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवाश्च पितरः सचन्द्राः सदिवाकराः । मरीचिरत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः
verses.transliteration: viśvedevāśca pitaraḥ sacandrāḥ sadivākarāḥ / marīciratryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ
verses.translation: The sins shaken off are visible to the meritorious soul. InBhagirathi and Prayaga 4 (the Sraddha performed) is said to be of ever-lasting benefit.
verses.hindi: तीर्थान्यनुसरन्धीरः श्रदधधानो जितेन्द्रिय: । कृतपापश्च शुध्येत कि पुनः शुभकर्मफृत् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The sins shaken off are visible to the meritorious soul. InBhagirathi and Prayaga 4 (the Sraddha performed) is said to be of ever-lasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sins shaken off are visible to the meritorious soul. InBhagirathi and Prayaga 4 (the Sraddha performed) is said to be of ever-lasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: प्रचेताश्च वसिष्ठश्च भृगुर्नारद एव च । च्यवनो गालवश्चैव वामदेवो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: pracetāśca vasiṣṭhaśca bhṛgurnārada eva ca / cyavano gālavaścaiva vāmadevo mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: Near Vyasa's seat for dhyana and Kantipuri or ancient Kathmandu
verses.hindi: तियंग्योनि न गच्छेच्च कुदेशे न च जायते । स्वर्गो भवति बै विप्रो मोक्षोपायं च विनचदति अश्वद्धधानाः पाप्मानों नास्तिकाः स्थितसंशया: । हेतुद्रष्टा च पञ्चेते न तोर्थंफलमश्रुते (१२७ गुरुतीर्थे परा सिद्धिस्तीर्थानां परम पदस्। ध्यान तीर्थपरं तस्माहब्रह्मतीय्य॑ सनातनम् १२८
verses.wordMeaning: Near Vyasa's seat for dhyana and Kantipuri or ancient Kathmandu
verses.commentary: Sense: Near Vyasa's seat for dhyana and Kantipuri or ancient Kathmandu

verses.sanskrit: वालखिल्याश्च गन्धारास्तृणबिन्दुश्च जाजलिः । उद्दालकश्चर्ष्यशृङ्गो वसिष्ठश्च सनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: vālakhilyāśca gandhārāstṛṇabinduśca jājaliḥ / uddālakaścarṣyaśṛṅgo vasiṣṭhaśca sanandanaḥ
verses.translation: A place near the source of Gandak, the place where Sage Pulaha and Bharata performed penance.
verses.hindi: प्रत्याहार पुनविद्धि मोक्षोपायमसंशयम् । इच्द्रियाणां मनो घोर बुद्धचयादीनां प्रवर्तेनम् (१३१
verses.wordMeaning: A place near the source of Gandak, the place where Sage Pulaha and Bharata performed penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: A place near the source of Gandak, the place where Sage Pulaha and Bharata performed penance.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रश्चैव भरद्वाजो वात्स्यो वात्स्यायनस्तथा । अगस्तिर्मित्रावरुणौ विश्वामित्रो मुनीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: śukraścaiva bharadvājo vātsyo vātsyāyanastathā / agastirmitrāvaruṇau viśvāmitro munīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Its site is on Ganga near Kcdar in Garhwal; Badarikasrama is situated in this 'Vana'.
verses.hindi: क्षीणेषु सबंपापेषु क्षोणेष्वेबेन्द्रियिषु च । परिनिर्वाति शुद्धात्मा यथा वह्विनिरिन्धनः ११३३ कारणेम्यो गुणेभ्यो5थ व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्य कृत्स्नशः । वियोजयति क्षेत्रज्ञं तेम्यो योगेन योगवित्
verses.wordMeaning: Its site is on Ganga near Kcdar in Garhwal; Badarikasrama is situated in this 'Vana'.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its site is on Ganga near Kcdar in Garhwal; Badarikasrama is situated in this 'Vana'.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमश्च पुलस्त्यश्च पौलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । सनातनस्तु कपिलो वाह्निः पञ्चशिखस्तथा
verses.transliteration: gautamaśca pulastyaśca paulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ / sanātanastu kapilo vāhniḥ pañcaśikhastathā
verses.translation: Modern Allahabad, U.P.
verses.hindi: पूवंक दन्द्रियों को स्ववद्ष रख यदि करे तो शुद्ध हो जाता है, शुभ कर्म करने वालों के लिये तो कुछ कहना ही ही नहीं है । इन तीर्थों की यात्रा करने वाला पाप करने वाला भी विश्र तियंक् योनि में कभी जन्म नहीं लेता और न बुरे स्थानों में ही उसका जन्म होता है, प्रत्युत वह स्वर प्राप्त करता है, मोक्ष के उपाय उसे सुलभ हो जाते हैं ।(२५-१ :६। श्रद्धा न करने वाले, पापात्मा, परलोक न माननेवाले अथवा वेदों के निन्‍्दक, स्थिति में सन्देह
verses.wordMeaning: Modern Allahabad, U.P.
verses.commentary: Sense: Modern Allahabad, U.P.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये ऽपि बहवस्तत्र मुनयः शंसितव्रताः । क्रीडन्ति देवताः सर्व ऋषयः सतपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: anye 'pi bahavastatra munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ / krīḍanti devatāḥ sarva ṛṣayaḥ satapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: Sraddfaa should be offered with efforts at Kalanjara, 1 DaSarna, Naimisa, Kurujangala and the city of Varanasi.
verses.hindi: रखने वाले संशयात्मा, एवं सभी पुण्य कार्यों में किसी कारण का अन्वेषण करनेवाले कुतर्की-- इन पाँचों को इन पवित्र तीर्थों का फल नहीं प्राप्त होता । गुरु रूपी तीर्थ में परम सिद्धि प्राप्त होती है, वह सभी तीथों से श्रेष्ठ है। उससे भी श्रेष्ठ तीथं ध्यान है, यह ध्यान साक्षात् ब्रह्म तीर्थ है, इसका कभी विनाश नहीं होता ।7२७-१२८। उपवास से भी यह ध्यान श्रेष्ठ है, यह सभी इन्द्रियों को उनके विषयों से निवत्त करनेवाला है, उपवास से बंधे रहनेवाले व्यक्तिगण प्राणों से विमुक्त होकर इस लोक में पुनः पुतः जन्म धारण करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddfaa should be offered with efforts at Kalanjara, 1 DaSarna, Naimisa, Kurujangala and the city of Varanasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddfaa should be offered with efforts at Kalanjara, 1 DaSarna, Naimisa, Kurujangala and the city of Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्याश्चैव योगीन्द्राः पितरः सपितामहाः । अस्माहके ऽत्र तिष्ठन्ति सर्व एव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: manuṣyāścaiva yogīndrāḥ pitaraḥ sapitāmahāḥ / asmāhake 'tra tiṣṭhanti sarva eva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: In that city, Yogesvara is present for ever. Hence what is offered there is ever-lasting. Offering Sraddhas in these holy places, one becomes sanctified. The Sraddha yields ever¬ lasting benefits.
verses.hindi: प्राण एवं अपान वायु-इन दोनों को समान करके इन्द्रियों, उनके विषयों और बुद्धि को मन में बआंधने पर सब की निवत्ति हो जाती है। मोक्ष के साधन भूत प्रत्याह्र (इन्द्रियों को उनके विषयों से अलग रखना) को पुनः सुनिये । समस्त इन्द्रियों में मन परम चम्चल और घोर है, बुद्धि आदि सबको यही परिचालित करता है ।! ३०- ६ ३१। निराहार रहने से मत की चज्चलता और कठोरता नष्ट हो जाती है, अतः अनशन को परम तप जानता चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: In that city, Yogesvara is present for ever. Hence what is offered there is ever-lasting. Offering Sraddhas in these holy places, one becomes sanctified. The Sraddha yields ever¬ lasting benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that city, Yogesvara is present for ever. Hence what is offered there is ever-lasting. Offering Sraddhas in these holy places, one becomes sanctified. The Sraddha yields ever¬ lasting benefits.

verses.sanskrit: पितरः पितामहाश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहाः । येषां दत्तमुपस्थायि सुकृतं वापि दुष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: pitaraḥ pitāmahāścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahāḥ / yeṣāṃ dattamupasthāyi sukṛtaṃ vāpi duṣkṛtam
verses.translation: Penance, Homa, meditation, nay anything performed in Lauhitya, 2 Vaitaranx and SvarnavedI, becomes meritorious.
verses.hindi: चंचल बुद्धि और मन इन दोनों को वश में रखने से सुश्दर बुद्धि उत्पन्न होती है। समस्त पापकर्मों के क्षीण हो जाने पर एवं इन्द्रियों के क्षीण हो जाने पर (वा में आ जाने पर) आत्मा शुद्ध होकर इन्धन रहित अग्नि की तरह निर्वाण प्राप्त करती है। समस्त व्यक्त अव्यक्त वस्तुओं के कारण एवं गुणों से योगीजत
verses.wordMeaning: Penance, Homa, meditation, nay anything performed in Lauhitya, 2 Vaitaranx and SvarnavedI, becomes meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Penance, Homa, meditation, nay anything performed in Lauhitya, 2 Vaitaranx and SvarnavedI, becomes meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयं तत्र तत्सर्वं यत्कृतं योधनीपुरे । मातरं पितरं त्यक्त्वा सर्वबन्धुसुहृज्जनान्
verses.transliteration: akṣayaṃ tatra tatsarvaṃ yatkṛtaṃ yodhanīpure / mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tyaktvā sarvabandhusuhṛjjanān
verses.translation: Only once, is (Sraddha) seen (performed) near the sea-shore by men of meritorious actions. So also in Gaya, Dharmaprstha and in Brahma's lake.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्‍्ते श्राउ्धकल्पे तीथंयात्रा नाम सप्तसप्ततितमो5ष्याय: ।७७। ।
verses.wordMeaning: Only once, is (Sraddha) seen (performed) near the sea-shore by men of meritorious actions. So also in Gaya, Dharmaprstha and in Brahma's lake.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only once, is (Sraddha) seen (performed) near the sea-shore by men of meritorious actions. So also in Gaya, Dharmaprstha and in Brahma's lake.

verses.sanskrit: धनं धान्यं प्रियान्पुत्रांस् तथा देहं नृपोत्तम । गच्छते वायुभूतस्तु शुभाशुभसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ priyānputrāṃs tathā dehaṃ nṛpottama / gacchate vāyubhūtastu śubhāśubhasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: The Sraddha offered in Gaya and Grdhrakuta yields great benefit. Snow falls all round it upto a distance of five Yojanas (1 Yojana = 12 Kms.). The forest surrounding the her¬ mitage of Bharata is remembered as the most meritorious. The foot-print of Matanga is seen there with the physical eye.
verses.hindi: यहस्पतिरुवाच अतः पर प्रवक्ष्यासि दानानि च फलानि च। श्राद्धकमंणि मेध्यानि वर्जनीयानि यानि च नक्तं तु वर्जयेच्छाडं राहोरन्यत्र दर्शनात् । सर्वस्वेनापि कर्तव्य क्षिप्र॑ वे राहुदशंने
verses.wordMeaning: The Sraddha offered in Gaya and Grdhrakuta yields great benefit. Snow falls all round it upto a distance of five Yojanas (1 Yojana = 12 Kms.). The forest surrounding the her¬ mitage of Bharata is remembered as the most meritorious.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sraddha offered in Gaya and Grdhrakuta yields great benefit. Snow falls all round it upto a distance of five Yojanas (1 Yojana = 12 Kms.). The forest surrounding the her¬ mitage of Bharata is remembered as the most meritorious.…

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां परमात्मा महत्तरः । शुभाशुभगतिं प्राप्तः कर्मणा स्वेन पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ paramātmā mahattaraḥ / śubhāśubhagatiṃ prāptaḥ karmaṇā svena pārthiva
verses.translation: This spot is glorified as (conducive to) entire righte¬ ousness. It is an example for this world. Similarly the Panca- vana is very holy. It is resorted to by men of meritorious actions. The holy centre Panduvisala is also a ready example.
verses.hindi: अपनी आत्मा को वियुक्त करते हैं, जिसके फलस्बरूप इस जन्म के उपरान्त उनकी न कोई गति होती है, न
verses.wordMeaning: This spot is glorified as (conducive to) entire righte¬ ousness. It is an example for this world. Similarly the Panca- vana is very holy. It is resorted to by men of meritorious actions. The holy centre Panduvisala is also a ready example.
verses.commentary: Sense: This spot is glorified as (conducive to) entire righte¬ ousness. It is an example for this world. Similarly the Panca- vana is very holy. It is resorted to by men of meritorious actions. The holy centre Panduvisala is also a ready example.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: शुभाशुभं न बन्धूनां जायते केन हेतुना । एकः प्रसूयते जन्तुरेक एव प्रलीयते
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: śubhāśubhaṃ na bandhūnāṃ jāyate kena hetunā / ekaḥ prasūyate jantureka eva pralīyate
verses.translation: (Defective) The persons who perpetrate sins come to the surface (become exposed) by means of weighing balances, by its arcs 3 and by various scriptures when they get attached (visit) to that Tlrtha (?).
verses.hindi: कोई स्थान रहता है. निश्चय ही वे व्यक्त एवं अव्यक्त किसी में नहीं रहते । न वे सत् हैं न असत् उनकी स्थिति के बारे में कुछ भी नहीं कहा जा सकता ।!३२-१२०।  बृहस्पति ने कहा--अब इसके उपरान्त मैं श्राडकर्म में दिये जाने वाले दान एवं उनसे मिलने वाले फलों के बारे में बतला रहा हैं, यह भी बतला रहा हूँ कि श्राद्ध में कौन सी वस्तुएँ पवित्र और कौन सी वर्जित रखी हैं ।!। हिम गिरते समय हिम का भ्रक्षण (१?) करना चाहिए, तदवम्तर अर्थात् वसन्त ग्रीष्म आदि में अग्निहोत्र करना चाहिए यह विधि परम पुण्य प्रद कही जाती है। रात्रि के समय
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) The persons who perpetrate sins come to the surface (become exposed) by means of weighing balances, by its arcs 3 and by various scriptures when they get attached (visit) to that Tlrtha (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) The persons who perpetrate sins come to the surface (become exposed) by means of weighing balances, by its arcs 3 and by various scriptures when they get attached (visit) to that Tlrtha (?).

verses.sanskrit: एको हि भुङ्क्ते सुकृतमेक एव हि दुष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: eko hi bhuṅkte sukṛtameka eva hi duṣkṛtam
verses.translation: Highly efficacious is the Sraddha offered at the silent (deep) great lake Pavamandala in the (river) Kausiki in the third quarter on the third Tithi (day).
verses.hindi: श्ाद्धकर्म वजित रखना चाहिए। रात्रि के बिना अन्य अवसर पर २ हु के दशन के समय सर्वस्व व्यय करके शीघ्र ही श्राद्धकम करना चाहिए। जो व्यक्ति प्रहण के अवसर पर श्राद्धकर्म नहीं करता है बह कीचड़ में
verses.wordMeaning: Highly efficacious is the Sraddha offered at the silent (deep) great lake Pavamandala in the (river) Kausiki in the third quarter on the third Tithi (day).
verses.commentary: Sense: Highly efficacious is the Sraddha offered at the silent (deep) great lake Pavamandala in the (river) Kausiki in the third quarter on the third Tithi (day).

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: एष त्वयोक्तो नृपते महाप्रश्नः स्मृतो मया
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: eṣa tvayokto nṛpate mahāpraśnaḥ smṛto mayā
verses.translation: The places mentioned are identified as follows:
verses.hindi: ” एतदर्ध॑स्थाने 'आसच्न: सदसन्तैव किचित्स्थित:” इति क. पुस्तके । उपरागे न कुर्याद्च: पड़े गौरिव सीदति। कुर्वाणस्तुद्धरेत्पापास्मज्जनरिव सागरे
verses.wordMeaning: The places mentioned are identified as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: The places mentioned are identified as follows:

verses.sanskrit: पितामहमुखोद्गीतं श्रुतं ते कथयाम्यहम् । यन्मे पितामहात्पूर्वं विज्ञातम् ऋषिसंसदि
verses.transliteration: pitāmahamukhodgītaṃ śrutaṃ te kathayāmyaham / yanme pitāmahātpūrvaṃ vijñātam ṛṣisaṃsadi
verses.translation: It appears that sinners are supposed to be weighed in the balance.
verses.hindi: विश्वदेव॑ च सौम्पं च बहुमांसपरं हृवि: । विषाणं वर्जयेत्खाइूगमसुयानाशनाय वे कर त्वष्टा वे बायंमाणस्तु देवेशेन सहात्मना । पिबञ्शच्रीपतेः सोम पृथिव्यामपतत्पुरा
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that sinners are supposed to be weighed in the balance.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that sinners are supposed to be weighed in the balance.

verses.sanskrit: न माता न पिता बन्धुः कस्यचिन्न सुहृत्क्वचित् । कस्य न ज्ञायते रूपं वायुभूतस्य देहिनः
verses.transliteration: na mātā na pitā bandhuḥ kasyacinna suhṛtkvacit / kasya na jñāyate rūpaṃ vāyubhūtasya dehinaḥ
verses.translation: After performing a very severe penance for many celes¬ tial Yugas, the intelligent deity Mahadeva set foot on Mun<Ja- prstha.
verses.hindi: शामाकास्तु तथोत्पन्नाः पिन्रर्थभपि पूजिताः । विध्रुषस्तस्य नासाभ्यामसक्ताभ्यां तथेक्षव ३७ श्लेष्माण: शीतला हदया मधुराश्व तथेक्षवः  श्यामाकरिक्षुभिश्वव पित॒णां सावेकासिकम् ॥ श्यामाका हस्तिनामा चर पटोलं ब्रहृतीफलम् । अगस्त्यस्य शिखा तीज़ा कषाया: सब एबं च
verses.wordMeaning: After performing a very severe penance for many celes¬ tial Yugas, the intelligent deity Mahadeva set foot on Mun<Ja- prstha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing a very severe penance for many celes¬ tial Yugas, the intelligent deity Mahadeva set foot on Mun<Ja- prstha.

verses.sanskrit: यद्येवं न भवेत्तात लोकस्य तु नरेश्वर । अमर्यादं भवेन्नूनं विनश्यति चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: yadyevaṃ na bhavettāta lokasya tu nareśvara / amaryādaṃ bhavennūnaṃ vinaśyati carācaram
verses.translation: Within a very short time, a righteous man discards his sin quickly like a serpent casting off its slough.
verses.hindi: वंशीकरीराः सुरसाः सर्जक भुस्तृणानि च्। वर्जनीयानि वक्ष्यमि श्राद्धकर्मंणि नित्यशः
verses.wordMeaning: Within a very short time, a righteous man discards his sin quickly like a serpent casting off its slough.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within a very short time, a righteous man discards his sin quickly like a serpent casting off its slough.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा पूरा राजन्समस्तैर्लोककर्तृभिः । मर्यादा स्थापिता लोके यथा धर्मो न नश्यति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā pūrā rājansamastairlokakartṛbhiḥ / maryādā sthāpitā loke yathā dharmo na naśyati
verses.translation: Sraddha offered there is said to yield everlasting benefit. An excellent man becomes Tree from his three-fold indebtedness by taking his bath there.
verses.hindi: + लशुनं गुऊजनं चेव पलाण्डः पिण्डमुलकम् । करम्भाद्यानि चान्यानि हीनानि रसगन्धतः फंसी गौ की तरह यातना सहता है । और जो करता है वह अपने पापों से सागर में नाव" की तरह उद्घार पा जाता है २-४। विश्व देव, सोम्य और प्रचुर मांस युक्त हि, गड़े का सींग पितरों की असूया (द्वेष) नष्ट करने के लिये वजित रखना चाहिए ।५। प्राचीन काल में महात्मा देवेश के निषेध करने पर भी त्वष्टा (विश्वकर्मा) ने शचीपति (इन्द्र) का सोमरस पान किया था उनके पीते समय पृथ्वी पर वह गिर पड़ा,
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha offered there is said to yield everlasting benefit. An excellent man becomes Tree from his three-fold indebtedness by taking his bath there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha offered there is said to yield everlasting benefit. An excellent man becomes Tree from his three-fold indebtedness by taking his bath there.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मे नष्टे मनुष्याणाम् अधर्मो ऽभिभवेत् पुनः । ततः स्वधर्मचलनान्नरके गमनं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: dharme naṣṭe manuṣyāṇām adharmo 'bhibhavet punaḥ / tataḥ svadharmacalanānnarake gamanaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: On the banks of that lake, there is a great shrine of the lord. After mounting up to it and performing Japas, one be¬ comes a Siddha and thereafter goes to heaven.
verses.hindi: जो साँवा के रूप में उत्पन्न हुआ  पितरों के लिए वह पूजित माना गया है। उत्ती समय पीते हुए त्वष्टा के अधक्त नासिका के छिद्रों से उस सोमरस के बूंद भो टरथ्वी पर गिरे, जो ईख के रूप में उत्पन्न हुए । इसी कारण ईखें शीतलता प्रदान करनेवाली, रुचिकर, मधुर और कफ कारक होती है। इन सावाँ और ईखों से पितरों की सारी कामनाएँ पूर्ण होती हैं। जो इन दोनों वस्तुओं को श्राद्धकर्म में निवेदित करता है
verses.wordMeaning: On the banks of that lake, there is a great shrine of the lord. After mounting up to it and performing Japas, one be¬ comes a Siddha and thereafter goes to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the banks of that lake, there is a great shrine of the lord. After mounting up to it and performing Japas, one be¬ comes a Siddha and thereafter goes to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: लोको निरङ्कुशः सर्वो मर्यादालङ्घने रतः । मर्यादा स्थापिता तेन शास्त्रं वीक्ष्य महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: loko niraṅkuśaḥ sarvo maryādālaṅghane rataḥ / maryādā sthāpitā tena śāstraṃ vīkṣya maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: After going to the northern Manasa, 1 one attains excellent Siddhi. On going to the excellent city 2, a very wonder¬ ful thing is seen.
verses.hindi: वह शीघ्र ही सिद्धि प्राप्त करता है ।६-८। साँवा, हस्तिनाम, पटोल, बुहतीफल, अभस्त्य की तीखी शिखाएं, ये सभी कषाय स्वादुवाले हैं । इसी प्रकार अन्यान्य सुस्वादु एवं मधुर द्रव्य पितरों को प्रिय हैं। श्राद्धकर्म में नागर और दीघेमूलक भी देना चाहिए ।६-१०। इसी प्रकार वंशी करीर, सुरसा, सर्जक और भूस्तृण भी देने चाहिए । श्रा्धकर्म में सर्बदा जो वर्जित वस्तुएँ हैं, उन्हें बतला रहा हूँ !१। लहसुन, गाजर, प्याज, पिण्डमूलक, करम्भ आदि वस्तुएँ, जो रस और गन्ध से निन्ध हैं, श्रा़कर्म में वजित रखनी चाहिए, इनका कारण बतला रहा
verses.wordMeaning: After going to the northern Manasa, 1 one attains excellent Siddhi. On going to the excellent city 2, a very wonder¬ ful thing is seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: After going to the northern Manasa, 1 one attains excellent Siddhi. On going to the excellent city 2, a very wonder¬ ful thing is seen.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम् । पिण्डोदकप्रदानं च तथैवातिथिपूजनम्
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam / piṇḍodakapradānaṃ ca tathaivātithipūjanam
verses.translation: One should perform Sraddha there according to one's capacity and physical strength. He should attain divine pleasures and the means to liberation (from Sariisara) for ever.
verses.hindi: न पधनुश्चित्वान्तगंतग्रन्थों ड. पुस्तके वास्ति । १. आनम्दाश्रम की प्रति का मूल गत पाठ भ्रामक समझ कर यहाँ छोड़ दिया गया है। --अनुवादक
verses.wordMeaning: One should perform Sraddha there according to one's capacity and physical strength. He should attain divine pleasures and the means to liberation (from Sariisara) for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should perform Sraddha there according to one's capacity and physical strength. He should attain divine pleasures and the means to liberation (from Sariisara) for ever.

verses.sanskrit: पितरः पितामहाश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहाः । त्रयो देवाः स्मृतास्तात ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: pitaraḥ pitāmahāścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahāḥ / trayo devāḥ smṛtāstāta brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
verses.translation: In the excellent Manasa lake, a very wonderful thing is seen. The highly blessed goddess Ganga of three-fold path, slipping dawn from heaven, shines in the sky. Falling off the lunar rays on to the earth, it appears like festoons in the sky with the brightness of the sun.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धकर्मणि वर्ज्यानि कारण चात्र वक्ष्यते । पुरा दे (दे) वासरे युद्धे निजितस्थ बलेः सुरेः अथ वेदोक्तनिर्यासाल्लेंवणान्यूषणानि च। श्राद्धकर्माणि वर्ज्यानि याश्र नार्यो रजस्वला: ३१५
verses.wordMeaning: In the excellent Manasa lake, a very wonderful thing is seen. The highly blessed goddess Ganga of three-fold path, slipping dawn from heaven, shines in the sky. Falling off the lunar rays on to the earth, it appears like festoons in the sky with the brightness of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the excellent Manasa lake, a very wonderful thing is seen. The highly blessed goddess Ganga of three-fold path, slipping dawn from heaven, shines in the sky. Falling off the lunar rays on to the earth, it appears like festoons in the sky with the brightness of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: पूजितैः पूजिताः सर्वे तथा मातामहास्त्रयः । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन श्रुतिस्मृत्यर्थनोदितान्
verses.transliteration: pūjitaiḥ pūjitāḥ sarve tathā mātāmahāstrayaḥ / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śrutismṛtyarthanoditān
verses.translation: It is diving with golden splendour. It is like the gate to heaven thrown wide open. It is from this place that it flows again towards the eastern ocean in its final stage.
verses.hindi: वन्‍्यमुलफलाहार: भ्राद्ध॑ कुर्यातु श्रद्धया । राष्ट्रमिष्टमवाप्नोति स्वर्ग मोक्ष यशस्करम् ११६ अनिष्टशब्दसंकीर्ण जस्तुव्याप्तमथापि वा। पुतिगन्धां तथा भूमि श्राद्धक्ंणि व्जयेत् २०
verses.wordMeaning: It is diving with golden splendour. It is like the gate to heaven thrown wide open. It is from this place that it flows again towards the eastern ocean in its final stage.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is diving with golden splendour. It is like the gate to heaven thrown wide open. It is from this place that it flows again towards the eastern ocean in its final stage.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं समाचरन्नित्यं पापांशेन न लिप्यते । श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं धर्मं मनसापि न लङ्घयेत्
verses.transliteration: dharmaṃ samācarannityaṃ pāpāṃśena na lipyate / śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ manasāpi na laṅghayet
verses.translation: It sanctifies all living beings and particularly those who know righteousness. Candrabhaga (Chenab) and
verses.hindi: उत्तरेण महानद्या दक्षिणेन च कंकटठात् । देशस्त्रशद्भूवो नाम वर्जित: श्राउ्धकर्मणि २२ कारस्करा: कलिडगाश्य सिन्धोरुत्तरमेव च । प्रनष्टअ्मधर्माश्व वर्ज्या देशाः प्रयत्नतः ३२२३ हूँ । प्राचीनकाल में देवताओं और ओर राक्षसों के युद्ध में देवताओं द्वारा पराजित बलि के शरीर में जो घाव थे, उनसे रक्त के विन्दु निकलकर पृथ्वी पर गिरे, वे ही इन वस्तुओं के रूप में हुये, अतः श्राद्धकम में इनको सबंदा वर्जित रखना चाहिए ।१२-१४। वेद में गिनाये गये समस्त निर्यास (मोंद) द्रव्य, लवण, एवं ऊषण (पिप्पलोमूल, चीता) ये वस्तुएं भी श्राद्धकम में वजित रखी जायें। इसी प्रकार जो रजस्वला स्त्रियाँ हों; वे भी भ्राद्धक्म
verses.wordMeaning: It sanctifies all living beings and particularly those who know righteousness. Candrabhaga (Chenab) and
verses.commentary: Sense: It sanctifies all living beings and particularly those who know righteousness. Candrabhaga (Chenab) and

verses.sanskrit: इह लोके परे चैव यदीच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः । पितापुत्रौ सदाप्येकौ बिम्बाद्बिम्बमिवोद्धृतौ
verses.transliteration: iha loke pare caiva yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ / pitāputrau sadāpyekau bimbādbimbamivoddhṛtau
verses.translation: Can it be the Kara Kul of northern Pamirs as suggested by M. Ali (AGP )? The so-called Uttara Manasa at Gaya is an ordinary pond.
verses.hindi: में प्रवत्त न हों। दुर्गन्धि युक्त, फेनों से व्याप्त, छोटे गड़ढों का जिसमें मौओं की तृप्ति नहीं होती, जो रात में ग्रहण किया गया हो, भेंड, मृग, बकरी, ऊँट एवं अन्य एक खुरवाले पशुओं से पीकर दृषित किया गया, महिष, चमर आदि अन्य पशुओं द्वारा गेंदला किया गया जल, श्राद्धकर्म में विद्वान् पुरुष वर्जित रखें! ६-१७। अब इसके उपरान्त उन स्थानों को बतलाने कौ चेष्टा कहूँग्रा, जिन्हें भरसक श्राद्धकर्म में
verses.wordMeaning: Can it be the Kara Kul of northern Pamirs as suggested by M. Ali (AGP )? The so-called Uttara Manasa at Gaya is an ordinary pond.
verses.commentary: Sense: Can it be the Kara Kul of northern Pamirs as suggested by M. Ali (AGP )? The so-called Uttara Manasa at Gaya is an ordinary pond.

verses.sanskrit: विभक्तौ वाविभक्तौ वा श्रुतिस्मृत्यर्थतस्तथा । उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानम् आत्मानम् अवसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: vibhaktau vāvibhaktau vā śrutismṛtyarthatastathā / uddharedātmanātmānam ātmānam avasādayet
verses.translation: No mention of any city is here in the context. Bd. P. ibid V. 117 reads Sarafreffhe 'inthat excellent lake*.
verses.hindi: वर्जित रखना चाहिए । इसके अतिरिक्त उन लोगों को भी बतला रहा हूँ, जिन्हें श्राद्ध कम देखना भी नहीं चाहिए । इस प्रकार सभी प्रकार की पवित्रता एवं अपवित्रता के बारे में बतला रहा हूं । श्रद्धा पूर्वक वन में उत्पन्न होनेवाले मूल एवं फलों के आहारों से श्राद्धकर्म सम्पन्न करने चाहिए । ऐसे करनेवाले को राष्ट्र मित्र की भाँति सम्मान देता है और यश की बृद्धि होती है, स्वर्ग की प्राप्ति होती है।१८-१६। अनिष्टकारी शब्दों से एवं जीव जम्तुओं से व्याप्त, दुगंन्धि युक्त भूमि को श्राद्धकम में वजित रखना चाहिए। सागर तक जानेवाली समस्त नदियाँ, दक्षिण पूर्व के द्वार एवं त्रिश्डकु देश इनको वारह योजन से छोड़ देना चाहिए । यह त्रिशंकु देश महानदी के उत्तर, कंकट देश से दक्षिण फैला हुआ है, यह श्राकर्म में वर्जित है ।२०-२२। कारस्कर, कलिड्, सिन्धु के उत्तरवर्ती देश एवं वे देश जहाँ पद वर्णाश्रम धर्म नष्ट हो चुका है, प्रयत्न पूर्वक श्राद्ध में वजित
verses.wordMeaning: No mention of any city is here in the context. Bd. P. ibid V. 117 reads Sarafreffhe 'inthat excellent lake*.
verses.commentary: Sense: No mention of any city is here in the context. Bd. P. ibid V. 117 reads Sarafreffhe 'inthat excellent lake*.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डोदकप्रदानाभ्यामृते पार्थ न संशयः । एवं ज्ञात्वा प्रयत्नेन पिण्डोदकप्रदो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: piṇḍodakapradānābhyāmṛte pārtha na saṃśayaḥ / evaṃ jñātvā prayatnena piṇḍodakaprado bhavet
verses.translation: There is the mountain named Himavan. It is embellished with various kinds of minerals. It is said that it ex¬ tends to eighty thousand Yojanas. It is crowded with Siddhas and Caranas. It is served and resorted to by Siddhas and Cara¬ cas. There is a PuskarinI (lake) on it, well known by the name Susumna.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तो महातेजा बृहस्पतिरुवाच तम् । सर्वेषासेव सृतानां त्रयी संवरणं स्मृतप्म्
verses.wordMeaning: There is the mountain named Himavan. It is embellished with various kinds of minerals. It is said that it ex¬ tends to eighty thousand Yojanas. It is crowded with Siddhas and Caranas. It is served and resorted to by Siddhas and Cara¬ cas. There is a PuskarinI (lake) on it,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is the mountain named Himavan. It is embellished with various kinds of minerals. It is said that it ex¬ tends to eighty thousand Yojanas. It is crowded with Siddhas and Caranas. It is served and resorted to by Siddhas and Cara¬ cas. There is a PuskarinI (lake) on it,…

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्धर्मो यशस्तेजः सन्ततिश्चैव वर्धते । पृथिव्यां सागरान्तायां पितृक्षेत्राणि यानि च
verses.transliteration: āyurdharmo yaśastejaḥ santatiścaiva vardhate / pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ pitṛkṣetrāṇi yāni ca
verses.translation: One who is born there lives upto ten thousand years. Sraddha offered thereyields ever-lasting benefits, and great pros¬ perity. The performer of Sraddhas enables ten previous genera¬ tions and ten succeeding ones to cross (hell).
verses.hindi: वृष यश्न परित्यज्य मोक्षमन्यत्र मार्गति । वथा वेदाश्रमास्तस्मिन्यों वे सम्यदून पश्यति पाषण्डवे कृतास्तात नैषा सृष्टि: स्वयंभुवः। यद्दिश्राद्धक निर्गन्‍्था: शक्‍्त्या जीवन्ति कर्पटा:..
verses.wordMeaning: One who is born there lives upto ten thousand years. Sraddha offered thereyields ever-lasting benefits, and great pros¬ perity. The performer of Sraddhas enables ten previous genera¬ tions and ten succeeding ones to cross (hell).
verses.commentary: Sense: One who is born there lives upto ten thousand years. Sraddha offered thereyields ever-lasting benefits, and great pros¬ perity. The performer of Sraddhas enables ten previous genera¬ tions and ten succeeding ones to cross (hell).

verses.sanskrit: तानि ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि येषु दत्तं महाफलम् । गयायां पुष्करे ज्येष्ठे प्रयागे नैमिषे तथा
verses.transliteration: tāni te sampravakṣyāmi yeṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam / gayāyāṃ puṣkare jyeṣṭhe prayāge naimiṣe tathā
verses.translation: Everything belonging to Himavan is holy. The Gahga is sacred everywhere (throughout). The ocean-going rivers and all the oceans all round are holy.
verses.hindi: ये धर्म नानुवतंन्ते ते बे नग्नादयों जना:। वृथाजटी वुधासुण्डी वथानग्नश्व यो द्विज: ३१ वृथात्रती बुथाजापी ते ब॑ नग्नादयों जनाः। कुलंधमा निकाशाश्व तथा पुष्टिकलंशका: ३२
verses.wordMeaning: Everything belonging to Himavan is holy. The Gahga is sacred everywhere (throughout). The ocean-going rivers and all the oceans all round are holy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything belonging to Himavan is holy. The Gahga is sacred everywhere (throughout). The ocean-going rivers and all the oceans all round are holy.

verses.sanskrit: संनिहत्यां कुरुक्षेत्रे प्रभासे कुरुनन्दन । पिण्डोदकप्रदानेन यत्फलं कथितं बुधैः
verses.transliteration: saṃnihatyāṃ kurukṣetre prabhāse kurunandana / piṇḍodakapradānena yatphalaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ
verses.translation: A sensible man should perform Sraddha in all these places and at similar ones. Even by taking bath, he becomes sanctified. By offering (Sraddha*?) he becomes so (all the more).
verses.hindi: रखने चाहिए । नंगे आदि असंस्कृत लोग शाद्धकम न देखें--ऐसी व्यवस्था है। उन लोगों द्वारा देखे जाने पर श्राद्ध को बस्तुयें पितामहादि पितरों को नहीं प्राप्त होती शंयु ने कहा--'हे भगवन्  वे नंगे आदि कौन हैं? है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणों में पूज्य  मैं उनके बारे में जानना चाहता हूं, विस्तार पूवंक उनका यथातथ्य वर्णन कौजिये' ।२५। हांयु के इस प्रकार पूछने पर महा तेजस्वी बृहस्पति ने उनसे कहा  संसार के समस्त जीवों (मनुष्यों) के लिये तीनों वेद आच्छादान करनेवाले (शान्ति देनेवाले) कहे गये हैं जो लोग अज्ञानवश उन्हें छोड़ देते हैं, वे नंगे हैं। मनुष्य जब वेद
verses.wordMeaning: A sensible man should perform Sraddha in all these places and at similar ones. Even by taking bath, he becomes sanctified. By offering (Sraddha*?) he becomes so (all the more).
verses.commentary: Sense: A sensible man should perform Sraddha in all these places and at similar ones. Even by taking bath, he becomes sanctified. By offering (Sraddha*?) he becomes so (all the more).

verses.sanskrit: अस्माहके तदाप्नोति नर्मदायां न संशयः । तत्र ब्रह्मा मुरारिश्च रुद्रश्च उमया सह
verses.transliteration: asmāhake tadāpnoti narmadāyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ / tatra brahmā murāriśca rudraśca umayā saha
verses.translation: Sraddha can be performed in the following places: On the high summits and ridges of mountains, crevasses, in the solitary sides, springs and fountains, on the sandy banks of rivers, on the auspicious anniversaries of the beginning of Yugas, on great oceans, in cowpens, in the confluence of two rivers, in the forests, well-cleaned and scrubbed ground, pleasing fragrant spots, in solitary houses, on the ground polished with cow-dung, etc. One should perform Sraddha in these places in accordance with injunctions. Those who seek fulfilment, of all desires shall perform Sraddha in these places carefully. They should perform circumambulation in all the quarters. An intelligent man per- ormmg thus, shall attain the Siddhi of Brahmatva (Brahmahood).
verses.hindi: से पराइमुख हो जाता है तब वह वेद रूप वृष निरवलम्ब हो जाता है ।२६। जो इस धर्म रूप वृष को छोड़ फेर अस्यत्र मोक्ष का मार ढूँढ़ता है, उसका वेदादि के अध्ययन का श्रम व्यर्थ है, क्योंकि वह इन वेदों में दिये हुये मोक्ष के स्वरूप को भली भाँति नहीं देखता है ।२७। प्राचीनकाल में देवताओं और असुरों के युद्ध में पराजित हुये अधुरों द्वारा सभी ब्राह्मण क्षत्रिय वैद्य शूद्र पाषण्डी होकर विक्ृत ( पतित ) हो गये, तात !
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha can be performed in the following places: On the high summits and ridges of mountains, crevasses, in the solitary sides, springs and fountains, on the sandy banks of rivers, on the auspicious anniversaries of the beginning of Yugas, on great oceans, in cowpens,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha can be performed in the following places: On the high summits and ridges of mountains, crevasses, in the solitary sides, springs and fountains, on the sandy banks of rivers, on the auspicious anniversaries of the beginning of Yugas, on great oceans, in cowpens,…

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राद्या देवताः सर्वे पितरो मुनयस्तथा । सागराः सरितश्चैव पर्वताश्च बलाहकाः
verses.transliteration: indrādyā devatāḥ sarve pitaro munayastathā / sāgarāḥ saritaścaiva parvatāśca balāhakāḥ
verses.translation: The worship of Pit r s becomes fruitful if anger etc.
verses.hindi: तह स्वयम्भू की वह सृष्टि नहीं रह गयी । जो लोग श्राद्धादि कार्यों के विरोध करनेवाले सद्ग्रन्थों के विरोधी, अपनी इच्छा एवं शक्ति के भरोसे जीवन यापन करते हैं, जो घर्मं का आचरण नहीं करते, वे नेंगे लोग हैं। व्यथ में जटा बढ़ानेवाले, व्यथ में मुण्डित शिर रहनेवाले, व्यथ्ं में तग्न रहनेवाले जो द्विजाति हैं, वे सब भी नंगे लोग हैं ।२५-३ १। व्यय ब्रत रखनवाले, व्यथं में जप करनेवाले कुल को पीड़ा पहुँचानेवाले निषाद, पुष्टि विनाशक एवं किये गये सत्कमों पर आक्षेप करनेवाले कुमार्गी कहे गये हैं। ऐसे लोगों द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: The worship of Pit r s becomes fruitful if anger etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The worship of Pit r s becomes fruitful if anger etc.

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठन्ति पितरः सर्वे सर्वतीर्थाधिकं ततः । स्थिता ब्रह्मशिला तत्र गजकुम्भनिभा नृप
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhanti pitaraḥ sarve sarvatīrthādhikaṃ tataḥ / sthitā brahmaśilā tatra gajakumbhanibhā nṛpa
verses.translation: Even a person who has committed sins becomes sancti¬ fied if he boldly and faithfully makes the pilgrimage to the holy centres and courageously controls his senses. What need be said in regard to a person of meritorious deeds?
verses.hindi: एतदपंस्थानेव्यं पाठ:--द्विश्राद्धकश्व निम्न॑न्था: शाक्था पुष्टिकलशंका:” इति क. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Even a person who has committed sins becomes sancti¬ fied if he boldly and faithfully makes the pilgrimage to the holy centres and courageously controls his senses. What need be said in regard to a person of meritorious deeds?
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a person who has committed sins becomes sancti¬ fied if he boldly and faithfully makes the pilgrimage to the holy centres and courageously controls his senses. What need be said in regard to a person of meritorious deeds?

verses.sanskrit: कलौ न दृश्या भवति प्रधानं यद्गयाशिरः । वैशाखे मासि सम्प्राप्ते ऽमावास्यां नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: kalau na dṛśyā bhavati pradhānaṃ yadgayāśiraḥ / vaiśākhe māsi samprāpte 'māvāsyāṃ nṛpottama
verses.translation: He is not reborn in an animal womb. He is not born again in an impious land. A Brahmana attains heaven and at¬ tains the means to salvation (Moksa).
verses.hindi: कृतकर्म क्षितास्त्वेते कुपथाः परिकीतिता: । एभिनिव त्त वा भ्राउं वृथा गच्छति मानवानू. ब्रह्मघ्नश्व झतध्नभ्व नास्तिका गुरुतल्पगा:  दस्यवश्च नृशंसाभ्न दर्शनेनेव वर्जिता: ३४ ये चान्ये पापकर्माणः सर्वास्तान्परिवर्जयेत् । देवदेवर्धिनिदायां रताश्चेव विशेषतः (३४५
verses.wordMeaning: He is not reborn in an animal womb. He is not born again in an impious land. A Brahmana attains heaven and at¬ tains the means to salvation (Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: He is not reborn in an animal womb. He is not born again in an impious land. A Brahmana attains heaven and at¬ tains the means to salvation (Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्य सा तिष्ठते तीर्थं गजकुम्भनिभा शिला । तच्च गव्यूतिमात्रं हि तीर्थं ततः प्रवक्षते
verses.transliteration: vyāpya sā tiṣṭhate tīrthaṃ gajakumbhanibhā śilā / tacca gavyūtimātraṃ hi tīrthaṃ tataḥ pravakṣate
verses.translation: These five do not attain the benefit of pilgrimage: those who have no faith, sinners, atheists, permanent doubters and those who always seek a cause (for everything).
verses.hindi: अपमानापविन्रश्न कुक्कुटो ग्रामसुक रः । वा चेव दर्शनादेव हन्ति ्राउ न संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: These five do not attain the benefit of pilgrimage: those who have no faith, sinners, atheists, permanent doubters and those who always seek a cause (for everything).
verses.commentary: Sense: These five do not attain the benefit of pilgrimage: those who have no faith, sinners, atheists, permanent doubters and those who always seek a cause (for everything).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्दिने तत्र गत्वा यस्तु श्राद्धप्रदो भवेत् । पित्ःणाम् अक्षया तृप्तिर्जायते शतवार्षिकी
verses.transliteration: tasmindine tatra gatvā yastu śrāddhaprado bhavet / pitḥṇām akṣayā tṛptirjāyate śatavārṣikī
verses.translation: Great Siddhi is achieved in the holy centre of Guru (the preceptor). He is the most excellent of all sacred objects and spots. Meditation is a still greater Tirtha. It is the eternal Bra- hmatfrtha, 1
verses.hindi: शावसूतकसंसृष्टो दीर्घरोगिभिरेव च। सलिने: पतितेश्चैव न द्रष्टव्यं कथंचन ३६ अच्च पश्येयुरेते ब॑ न॑तत्स्याद्धवव्यकव्ययो: । तत्संस्पृष्ठ प्रधानार्थ संस्कारश्वापदों भवेत् ४० सम्पन्न श्राद्धकर्म पितरों के लिये व्यर्थ हो जाते हैं। ब्रह्महत्या करनेबाले, क्ृतन्न, नास्तिक, गुरु पत्नी गामी दस्यु, नृशंस, आत्मतत्त्वज्ञान से वंचित, गवं अन्यान्य जो पापकर्म परायण लोग हैं, उन्हें सबको श्राद्धकर्म में वर्जित रखना चाहिए ।६२-३४। विद्येषतया देवताओं एवं देवियों की निन्‍दा में निरत रहने वाले जो लोग हों, उन्हें भी वर्जित रखना चाहिए। इसी प्रकार असुरों एवं यातुधानों को भी श्राद्ध कम में वजित रखना था हिये ।
verses.wordMeaning: Great Siddhi is achieved in the holy centre of Guru (the preceptor). He is the most excellent of all sacred objects and spots. Meditation is a still greater Tirtha. It is the eternal Bra- hmatfrtha, 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Great Siddhi is achieved in the holy centre of Guru (the preceptor). He is the most excellent of all sacred objects and spots. Meditation is a still greater Tirtha. It is the eternal Bra- hmatfrtha, 1

verses.sanskrit: अन्यस्यामप्यमावास्यां यः स्नात्वा विजितेन्द्रियः । करोति मनुजः श्राद्धं विधिवन्मन्त्रसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: anyasyāmapyamāvāsyāṃ yaḥ snātvā vijitendriyaḥ / karoti manujaḥ śrāddhaṃ vidhivanmantrasaṃyutam
verses.translation: Meditation is greater than observance of fasts. It makes all the sense organs shun (their objects). Those who are wedded to observance of fasts are reborn again and again along with their vital breaths.
verses.hindi: इन उपर्युक्त लोगों द्वारा देखा गया श्राद्कर्म॑ निष्फल हो जाता है। सतयुग को ब्राह्मणों का युग कहा गया है, त्रेता क्षत्रियों का युग कहा जाता है, द्वापर बेदयों का युग है, इसी प्रकार कलियुग शूद्रों का युग कहा गया है ।३५०३६। ह क्‍
verses.wordMeaning: Meditation is greater than observance of fasts. It makes all the sense organs shun (their objects). Those who are wedded to observance of fasts are reborn again and again along with their vital breaths.
verses.commentary: Sense: Meditation is greater than observance of fasts. It makes all the sense organs shun (their objects). Those who are wedded to observance of fasts are reborn again and again along with their vital breaths.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुण्यफलं यत्स्यात् तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप । अग्निष्टोमाश्वमेधाभ्यां वाजपेयस्य यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yatsyāt tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa / agniṣṭomāśvamedhābhyāṃ vājapeyasya yatphalam
verses.translation: One shall equalise Prana and Apana. One should res¬ train in mind objects and the sense organs and restrain the intellect in the mind. Then every sense-organ recedes.
verses.hindi: पितरगण बोले:--सतयुग में वेदों को रजा होती थो, भेतायुग में देवगण पृज्य माने जाते थे। द्वापर में लोगों को युद्ध प्रिय था, कलियुग में लोगों की पाषण्ड में सवंदा रुचि रहती है अपमानित एवं अपविन्न लोब, कुक्कुट (मुर्गे) प्राम्य सुअर, और कुत्ता-- इनके तो केवल दर्शन से श्राद्ध नष्ट हो जाता है--इसहैं सन्देह नहीं ।३८। बच्चों का सृतक जिनके घर में हो, दीर्घकाल से जो रोग ग्रस्त हो, मलिन एवं पतित विचारों वाला हो, इनको किसी प्रकार भी श्राद्धकर्म नहीं देखता चाहिए ।३६। यदि ये लोग श्राद्ध के अन्न को देख लेते हैं तो वह अन्न भी हव्य के लिये उपर्युक्त नहीं है, इनके द्वारा स्पर्श किये गये श्राद्धादि
verses.wordMeaning: One shall equalise Prana and Apana. One should res¬ train in mind objects and the sense organs and restrain the intellect in the mind. Then every sense-organ recedes.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall equalise Prana and Apana. One should res¬ train in mind objects and the sense organs and restrain the intellect in the mind. Then every sense-organ recedes.

verses.sanskrit: तत्फलं समवाप्नोति यथा मे शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत् । रौरवादिषु सर्वेषु नरकेषु व्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt / rauravādiṣu sarveṣu narakeṣu vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: Understand that undoubtedly Pratyahara (the withdra¬ wal of all sense organs) is the sure means to salvation. Among the sense-organs, the mind is the most terrible. It makes the intellect and other organs function.
verses.hindi: संस्कार अपवित्र हो जाते हैं। जमे हुये घृत को प्रथमतः वर्जित रखना चाहिए। श्राद्धकमं में मिट्टी से मिले हुये जल से सिंचन करना चाहिए ।४०-४१। पीजे सरसों से अथवा काले तिल से अवकीौरण (विकी रण, पृथ्वी पर
verses.wordMeaning: Understand that undoubtedly Pratyahara (the withdra¬ wal of all sense organs) is the sure means to salvation. Among the sense-organs, the mind is the most terrible. It makes the intellect and other organs function.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand that undoubtedly Pratyahara (the withdra¬ wal of all sense organs) is the sure means to salvation. Among the sense-organs, the mind is the most terrible. It makes the intellect and other organs function.

verses.sanskrit: पिता पितामहाद्याश्च पितृके मातृके तथा । पिण्डोदकेन चैकेन तर्पणेन विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: pitā pitāmahādyāśca pitṛke mātṛke tathā / piṇḍodakena caikena tarpaṇena viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: (The restlessness of the mind) is subdued by not taking food. Know that fasting is a penance. By restraining the intel¬ lect and the mind, the intellect is sublimated (the intellect be¬ comes beautiful).
verses.hindi: सिद्धार्थकः कृष्णतिल:ः कार्य वाध्प्पवको रणम् । गुशसूर्याग्निवस्तुनां दर्शनं वाईपि यत्नतः अशितं परिदुष्टं च तथवाग्रावलेहितम् । शकराकेशपाषाण: कीटंयेच्चाप्युपद्ुतम् ४४
verses.wordMeaning: (The restlessness of the mind) is subdued by not taking food. Know that fasting is a penance. By restraining the intel¬ lect and the mind, the intellect is sublimated (the intellect be¬ comes beautiful).
verses.commentary: Sense: (The restlessness of the mind) is subdued by not taking food. Know that fasting is a penance. By restraining the intel¬ lect and the mind, the intellect is sublimated (the intellect be¬ comes beautiful).

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडन्ति पितृलोकस्था यावद् आभूतसम्प्लवम् । ये कर्मस्था विकर्मस्था ये जाताः प्रेतकल्मषाः
verses.transliteration: krīḍanti pitṛlokasthā yāvad ābhūtasamplavam / ye karmasthā vikarmasthā ye jātāḥ pretakalmaṣāḥ
verses.translation: When all the sins are mitigated, when the sense organs are weakened (subdued) the pure soul attains bliss of libera¬ tion like fire without fuel.
verses.hindi: वाससा चावधृतानि वर्ज्यानि श्राद्धकमंणि । सन्ति वेदविरोधेन केचिद्विज्ञानमानिन: (४६ अयज्ञपतयों नाम ते श्राद्धस्थ यथा रजः । दधि शाक तथा5भक्ष्या: शुक्ल चौषं विवर्जितम्
verses.wordMeaning: When all the sins are mitigated, when the sense organs are weakened (subdued) the pure soul attains bliss of libera¬ tion like fire without fuel.
verses.commentary: Sense: When all the sins are mitigated, when the sense organs are weakened (subdued) the pure soul attains bliss of libera¬ tion like fire without fuel.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डेनैकेन मुच्यन्ते ते ऽपि तत्र न संशयः । अस्माहके शिला दिव्या तिष्ठते गजसन्निभा
verses.transliteration: piṇḍenaikena mucyante te 'pi tatra na saṃśayaḥ / asmāhake śilā divyā tiṣṭhate gajasannibhā
verses.translation: The influence of Yoga is so profound on the Purana writer that Yogic meditation is regarded superior to Tirthayatra (w. 128-131). The importance of feeding a Yogin at the time of Sraddhas has been already extolled in previous chapters.
verses.hindi: वार्ताक वर्जयेहबद्यात्सर्वानिषवानपि । सेन्धवं लवण यच्च तथा मानससंभवम् ॥ै४८ गमयेन्मस्तक चेब ब्रह्मतीर्थ हि तत्स्मृतम् । द्रव्याणां प्रोक्षणं कार्य तथेवा5:बपन पुनः (५०
verses.wordMeaning: The influence of Yoga is so profound on the Purana writer that Yogic meditation is regarded superior to Tirthayatra (w. 128-131). The importance of feeding a Yogin at the time of Sraddhas has been already extolled in previous chapters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The influence of Yoga is so profound on the Purana writer that Yogic meditation is regarded superior to Tirthayatra (w. 128-131). The importance of feeding a Yogin at the time of Sraddhas has been already extolled in previous chapters.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा निर्मिता पूर्वं सर्वपापक्षयंकरी । उपर्यस्या यथान्यायं पित्ःन् उद्दिश्य भारत
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā nirmitā pūrvaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī / uparyasyā yathānyāyaṃ pitḥn uddiśya bhārata
verses.translation: A knower of Yogas separates the individual soul from all manifest and unmanifest causes and Glows by means of his Yogic power.
verses.hindi: छींटना) करता चाहिए । यत्नपूर्वक गुरु. सूयं और अग्ति की वस्तुओं का दर्शन करना चाहिए ।४२। आसनासीन
verses.wordMeaning: A knower of Yogas separates the individual soul from all manifest and unmanifest causes and Glows by means of his Yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: A knower of Yogas separates the individual soul from all manifest and unmanifest causes and Glows by means of his Yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणाग्रेषु दर्भेषु दद्यात्पिण्डान्विचक्षणः । भूमौ चान्नेन सिद्धेन श्राद्धं कृत्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu dadyātpiṇḍānvicakṣaṇaḥ / bhūmau cānnena siddhena śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: There is no place for him to go, whether manifest or unmanifest. He is neither Asat (non-existent) nor Sat-A sat. No¬ thing can be said of his existence.
verses.hindi: से चाटी हुई, शक्कर, (बालुका) केश और पत्थर से दूषित, कीड़ों से गन्दी की गयी वस्तुयें श्राद्धकम॑ में वर्जित हैं ४३-४४ तिल और जव में, तिलों के चूरे न मिले हों, बनाये गये जो अक्षत खाने के लिये रखे गये हों तथा जिसमें नमक का अंश मिला हुआ हो, इसी प्रकार वस्त्र से जो स्पर्श किया गया हो; वे सब अन्नादि पदार्थ श्राद्धकर्म में दूषित माने गये हैं। कुछ विज्ञान के मानने वाले वेदों का विरोध करते हैं, वे यज्ञ के अनधिकारी हैं, और श्राद्ध के धल की तरह (विनाशक) हैं, उन्हें भी श्रा्कर्म॑ में वरजित रखना चाहिए। इसी प्रकार दही, न खाप्रै जानेवाले शाक, तथा श्वेत वर्ण का चोष्य (चूसा जानेवाला) पदार्थ--- ये सब भी श्राउकर्म में वजित हैं।४५-४७ भाँटे को भी श्राद्ध में वर्जित रखे। सभी प्रकार के अभिषवों को ( मद्य अथवा आसव ) देना चाहिए (?) जो समुद्र से निकला हुआ लवण है,
verses.wordMeaning: There is no place for him to go, whether manifest or unmanifest. He is neither Asat (non-existent) nor Sat-A sat. No¬ thing can be said of his existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no place for him to go, whether manifest or unmanifest. He is neither Asat (non-existent) nor Sat-A sat. No¬ thing can be said of his existence.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धिभ्यो वस्त्रयुग्मानि छत्रोपानत्कमण्डलु । दक्षिणा विविधा देया पित्ःन् उद्दिश्य भारत
verses.transliteration: śrāddhibhyo vastrayugmāni chatropānatkamaṇḍalu / dakṣiṇā vividhā deyā pitḥn uddiśya bhārata
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shail recount the various types of Danas (religious gifts) and the benefits thereof. I shall also mention the pure things to be used in the Sraddha rite and those that should be avoided.
verses.hindi: तथा मानस से उत्पन्न हुआ लवण है, वह परम पवित्र माना गया है, ये दोनों लवण होने पर भी निषिद्ध नहीं हैं। उन्हें आग में छोड़कर पुनः दोनों हाथों से यत्नपूवंक निकाल ले और अपने मह्तक पर लगा ले, मस्तक ब्रह्मतीर्थ कहा जाता है। समस्त श्राद्धीय दृव्यों को सबंप्रथम जल से सिचित करना चाहिए पुनः उनके ऊपर लगी हुईं मैल आदि को छुड़ा देता चाहिए ।४८-५०। फिर रखकर जल से पुनः सिंचन करना
