After washing the hands with water and taking bath, a sensible man shall apply clay to the private parts twice.
verses.hindi: में बजित हैं ।७१-७२। वेदवाक्यों में अपनी आज्ञा देनेवाले, अर्थात् वेद वाक्‍यों में मनमानी करनेवाले, लोभ और अज्ञानवश फल की आशा करनेवाले, ब्रह्म (विद्या) का विक्रय करनेवाले जो ब्राह्मण हैं, वे भी भ्राद्धकर्म में वजित हैं ।७३। वेदवाक्यों में किसी को दखल देने का अधिकार नहीं है, जो उनमें अपनी आज्ञा लगाता है, वह पातकी है। ऐसे लोगों को श्राद्धकमें में जो दान करता है वह दान के फल से भ्रष्ट (बंचित) रहता है । और जो भोजन
verses.wordMeaning: The same purificatory rite should be followed in the case of sexual intercourse. Clay is to be applied nine times. After washing hands with clay (and water), a person shall perform the purificatory rite. After washing the hands with water and taking bath,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The same purificatory rite should be followed in the case of sexual intercourse. Clay is to be applied nine times. After washing hands with clay (and water), a person shall perform the purificatory rite. After washing the hands with water and taking bath,…

verses.sanskrit: कासारेण तथाग्नेय्यां स्थापयेत् करकं परम् । रक्ततन्दुलसंमिश्रं नैरृत्यां वायुगोचरे
verses.transliteration: kāsāreṇa tathāgneyyāṃ sthāpayet karakaṃ param / raktatandulasaṃmiśraṃ nairṛtyāṃ vāyugocare
verses.translation: This is themode of purification to be observed by all the castes for ever. One should smear hands and feet three times and sprinkle them with water.
verses.hindi: करता है वह वेदाध्ययन के फल से भ्रष्ट (वंचित) रहता है । जो जीविका(रुपया आदि) लेकर किसी को पढ़ाता है और जो जीविका आदि लेकर पढ़ानेवाले अध्यापक से पढ़ता है--ये दोनों भी श्राद्धादि कर्म भें प्रवेश पाने के अधिकारी नहीं हैं, क्योंकि ये दोतों ही विद्या के क्रय और विक्रय करने रूप अपराध के अपराधी हैं । जीविका के लिए विद्या का क्रप विक्रय करना गदित है, यह वेश्यों की बृत्ति है, ब्राह्मण के लिए तो यह पातक है । जो सामान्य कथाओं की भाँति वेदवाक्यों को कहता है और जो वेदों का जाननेवाला, जीविका के लिए वेदों का पाठ आदि करता है--वे दोनों ही श्राद्धकर्म के योग्य नहीं हैं, इसी प्रकार पुत्री का पति अर्थात् जामाता भी श्रायकर्म में नियुक्त करने योग्य नहीं हैं ॥७७। जो व्यर्थ में स्‍त्री के साथ समागम करता है, और जो व्यर्थ में ही यज्ञ में हवन करता है, वे दोनों भी श्राद्ध के योग्य नहों हैं, इसी प्रकार नास्तिक द्विज भी श्राद्ध का अधिकारी
verses.wordMeaning: This is themode of purification to be observed by all the castes for ever. One should smear hands and feet three times and sprinkle them with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is themode of purification to be observed by all the castes for ever. One should smear hands and feet three times and sprinkle them with water.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयेन्मोदकैः सार्धं चतुर्थं करकं बुधः । सूत्रेण वेष्टितग्रीवं गन्धमाल्यैर् अलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: sthāpayenmodakaiḥ sārdhaṃ caturthaṃ karakaṃ budhaḥ / sūtreṇa veṣṭitagrīvaṃ gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Verses 226-30 deal with personal purification
verses.hindi: नहीं हैं ।४»८। जो केवल अपने लिये अन्न पकाता है, और जो देवताओं और अतिथियों के लिये कुछ भी नहीं रखता, वे दोनों ही श्राद्ध के लिये अनृपयुक्त हैं, ऐसे ब्राह्मण पतित और ब्रह्माराक्षस हैं। जिनकी स्त्रियाँ रात्रि में पर पुरुषों के साथ व्यभिचार (करती हैं, अथवा जो दूसरे की स्त्रियों के साथ व्यभिचार करते हैं, जो अर्थ एवं काम में सर्वेधा लोलुप रहते हैं, ऐसे ब्राह्मणों को श्राद्धकर्म में भोजन नहीं कराना चाहिए ।७६९। वर्णाश्रम्त की
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 226-30 deal with personal purification
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 226-30 deal with personal purification

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खतूर्यनिनादेन जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः । रक्ताम्बरधरं विप्रं रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhatūryaninādena jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ / raktāmbaradharaṃ vipraṃ raktamālyānulepanam
verses.translation: Clay shall be applied fifteen times to the hands and other unclean parts. Clay shall be applied to the uncleaned parts and it shall be washed with water.
verses.hindi: मर्यादा, धर्म एवं श्राद्धकर्म के विरोधी, चोरी करनेवाले, सब किसी से यज्ञ करानेवाले, या विना विचार के सब कुछ यज्ञ में करनेवाले ब्राह्मण पंक्तिदूषक हैं ।७०-८१। जो ब्राह्मण सुअर की तरह भोजन करता है, हथेली पर यश्न शुकरवद्भुद्क्ते यश्च॒ पाणितले द्विज: । न तदश्तन्ति पितरो यश्व वाम॑ समश्नुते ८२
verses.wordMeaning: Clay shall be applied fifteen times to the hands and other unclean parts. Clay shall be applied to the uncleaned parts and it shall be washed with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Clay shall be applied fifteen times to the hands and other unclean parts. Clay shall be applied to the uncleaned parts and it shall be washed with water.

verses.sanskrit: वेदिमध्यगतं वापि महदासनसंस्थितम् । सुरूपं सुभगं शान्तं सर्वभूतहिते रतम्
verses.transliteration: vedimadhyagataṃ vāpi mahadāsanasaṃsthitam / surūpaṃ subhagaṃ śāntaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratam
verses.translation: After tying a cloth round the neck or the head, if any- one walks on foot along the street, he shall wash the feet. With¬ out washing the feet, even if he performs Acamana, he shall be unclean.
verses.hindi: तस्मान्न देयमुच्छिष्टमन्तायं श्राद्धकर्मणि । अन्यन्न दधिसपिर्भ्या शिष्ये पुत्नाय नान्यथा
verses.wordMeaning: After tying a cloth round the neck or the head, if any- one walks on foot along the street, he shall wash the feet. With¬ out washing the feet, even if he performs Acamana, he shall be unclean.
verses.commentary: Sense: After tying a cloth round the neck or the head, if any- one walks on foot along the street, he shall wash the feet. With¬ out washing the feet, even if he performs Acamana, he shall be unclean.

verses.sanskrit: वेदविद्याव्रतस्नातं सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम् । पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं वाचयेत्पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: vedavidyāvratasnātaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradam / pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ vācayetpāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: After washing the feet and setting the waterpot down, he should perform Acamana and then sprinkle it with water. The materials of Sraddha etc. shall be sprinkled again.
verses.hindi: दान प्रतिप्रहो होमो भोजन बलिरेब च ॥ साडूगुष्ठेन तथा कार्य नासुरेम्यो यथा भवेत् मुण्डाउजटिलकाषायाब्श्राद्धकालेडपि बर्जयेत् । शिखिभ्यो वा जिदण्डिभ्यः भ्राद्ध यत्नात्प्रदापयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: After washing the feet and setting the waterpot down, he should perform Acamana and then sprinkle it with water. The materials of Sraddha etc. shall be sprinkled again.
verses.commentary: Sense: After washing the feet and setting the waterpot down, he should perform Acamana and then sprinkle it with water. The materials of Sraddha etc. shall be sprinkled again.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तां गां च ततो दद्याद् रक्तेनानडुहा सह । प्रीयतां भूमिजो देवः सर्वदैवतपूजितः
verses.transliteration: raktāṃ gāṃ ca tato dadyād raktenānaḍuhā saha / prīyatāṃ bhūmijo devaḥ sarvadaivatapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Sprinkling is recommended on flowers etc., grass and Havis. Objects brought by others should be placed down and sprinkled with water.
verses.hindi: ये तु ब्रते स्थिता नित्य ज्ञानिनों ध्यानिनस्तथा। देवभक्ता महात्मानः पुनीयुदंर्शनादपि (९० सर्वे योगेश्वरव्र्याप्तं त्रेलोक्‍्यं वे निरन्तरम् । तस्मात्पश्यन्ति ते सर्व यत्किचिज्जगतीगतमु ॥६ १
verses.wordMeaning: Sprinkling is recommended on flowers etc., grass and Havis. Objects brought by others should be placed down and sprinkled with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sprinkling is recommended on flowers etc., grass and Havis. Objects brought by others should be placed down and sprinkled with water.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य पत्नीपुत्रसमन्वितः । पितृमातृसुहृत्सार्द्धं क्षमाप्य च विसर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: vipraṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya patnīputrasamanvitaḥ / pitṛmātṛsuhṛtsārddhaṃ kṣamāpya ca visarjayet
verses.translation: In a Sraddha and rites for Devas only, those articles that are sprinkled with water should be used. Whatever is brought to the altar should be brought at the northern end and taken away from the southern end.
verses.hindi: खाता है, अथवा बाएं हाथ से खाता है; उसका दिया हुआ पितरगण नहीं खाते । श्राद्ध से बची हुई भोजनादि वस्तुएं स्त्री को तथा ऐसे शूद्र को, जो अनुचर न हो, नहीं देनी चाहिए । जो अज्ञान वश इन्हें दे देता है, उसका दिया हुआ श्षाद्ध पित्तरों को नहीं प्राप्त होता । इसलिये श्राद्धकर्म में जूठझे बचे हुए अन्नादि पदार्थों को किप्ती को नहीं देना चाहिए  दूसरे कार्यों में दही और घत को मिश्वित कर शिष्य और पुत्र को देना चाहिए अन्यथा नहीं ।5२-८४। विशेषतया बिता जूठे हुए अन्‍न्नादि को देता चाहिए  पुष्प, मुल और फलों से जिसप्रकार पितर गण तृप्त होते हैं उसी प्रकार अन्न से भी तृप्त होते हैं। जब तक अन्न उष्ण रहता है, तभी तक बह पवित्र रहता है अर्थात् ठंढा हो जाने पर अपवितन्र हो जाता है । ब्राह्मण लोग जब तक तृुपच्राप इन्द्रियों को वद्य में रखकर भोजन करते हैं तभी तक पितर गण भोजन करते हैं, अर्थात् ब्राह्मणों को चुपचाप सावधानी पृथषेक
verses.wordMeaning: In a Sraddha and rites for Devas only, those articles that are sprinkled with water should be used. Whatever is brought to the altar should be brought at the northern end and taken away from the southern end.
verses.commentary: Sense: In a Sraddha and rites for Devas only, those articles that are sprinkled with water should be used. Whatever is brought to the altar should be brought at the northern end and taken away from the southern end.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृतस्य तस्याथ तस्मिंस्तीर्थे विशेषतः । यत्पुण्यं फलमुद्दिष्टं तत्ते सर्वं वदाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛtasya tasyātha tasmiṃstīrthe viśeṣataḥ / yatpuṇyaṃ phalamuddiṣṭaṃ tatte sarvaṃ vadāmyaham
verses.translation: If the procedure is altered in the rites pertaining to Devas or Pitrs, it (the rite) becomes fruitless. With the right hand, one should touch the southern altar*.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियों को वश में रखकर भोजन करना चाहिए ।५५-८६॥ दात, दान का अंग्रीकार, हवन, भोजन, बलि-- इन सबको अंगूठे के साथ सम्पन्न करना चाहिए, जिससे असुरों के लिये वहु न हो जाय । श्राद्ध क्रम में विशेष- तया ये उर्पेयुक्त दानादि करने चाहिए। साधारणतया घुटनों के भीतर हाथ करके आचमन करना चाहिप ।53-55। श्राद्ध काल में भी मुण्डित शिरवाले, जटा रखनेवाले काषायवस्त्रधारी को वर्जित रखता चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: If the procedure is altered in the rites pertaining to Devas or Pitrs, it (the rite) becomes fruitless. With the right hand, one should touch the southern altar*.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the procedure is altered in the rites pertaining to Devas or Pitrs, it (the rite) becomes fruitless. With the right hand, one should touch the southern altar*.

verses.sanskrit: सप्त जन्मानि राजेन्द्र सुरूपः सुभगो भवेत् । तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावेन नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: sapta janmāni rājendra surūpaḥ subhago bhavet / tīrthasyāsya prabhāvena nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: when one spits; after taking food; when feet are not washed; after conversing with a person excommunicated (by others); after working in unclean places (?); in all doubtful acts such as when the tuft of hair is untied and/or one is with¬ out the sacred thread; when the lips touch the teeth; when one He should perform Marjana (cleansing with water) twice and then Abhyuksana (sprinkling with water) once over the sense organs, head, hands and feet as well.
verses.hindi: यलपूवंक शिखारी और त्रिदण्डी (मत, वचन और शरीर के दंड को घारण करने वाला, एक प्रकार का संन्‍्यासी) को श्राद्ध प्रदान करना चाहिए । जो ब्राह्मण नित्य ब्रतपरायण रहते हैं, ज्ञानाजन में प्रवत्त रहकर योगामभ्यास में निरत रहते हैं, देवता में भक्त रखते हैं, आत्मा से महान् होते हैं--वे दर्शन मात्र से पवित्र करते हैं हूं समस्त चराचर जगत योगपरायण महात्माओं से निरन्तर व्याप्त रहता है, इसीलिये वे इस जग्रतीतल में जो
verses.wordMeaning: when one spits; after taking food; when feet are not washed; after conversing with a person excommunicated (by others); after working in unclean places (?); in all doubtful acts such as when the tuft of hair is untied and/or one is with¬ out the sacred thread;…
verses.commentary: Sense: when one spits; after taking food; when feet are not washed; after conversing with a person excommunicated (by others); after working in unclean places (?); in all doubtful acts such as when the tuft of hair is untied and/or one is with¬ out the sacred thread;…

verses.sanskrit: अकामो वा सकामो वा तत्र तीर्थे मृतो नरः । अङ्गारकपुरं याति देवगन्धर्वपूजितः
verses.transliteration: akāmo vā sakāmo vā tatra tīrthe mṛto naraḥ / aṅgārakapuraṃ yāti devagandharvapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Anything not considered properly, shall besprinkled with water. In tin's manner his Acamana, Vedas (Vedic Study) Yajnas, penance, charitable gifts and vow of celibacy become fruitful. If an atheist performs holy rites without performing Acamana out of delusion, all those rites shall undoubtedly be futile. All these following should be known pure—that which is pure in words, that which is cleaned, that which is undefiled and that which is not censured. The opposite of these is impure. A hungry Brahmana should never be told—"There is nothing". If anything is given to him after duly honouring him, it is called a sacrifice without erecting a sacrificial post. During Sraddhas, an indigent but non-begging, solitary and shy Brahmana should always be fed with food neither over-cooked nor watery. He who offers food to the low castes only, is a wicked soul, a Brahmana-slayer.
verses.hindi: सर्वज्ञानानि दृष्टानि मोक्षादीनि सहात्मनाम् । तस्मात्तेषु सदा सक्तः प्राप्तोत्यनृपमं शुभभ्॒.
verses.wordMeaning: Anything not considered properly, shall besprinkled with water. In tin's manner his Acamana, Vedas (Vedic Study) Yajnas, penance, charitable gifts and vow of celibacy become fruitful. If an atheist performs holy rites without performing Acamana out of delusion,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Anything not considered properly, shall besprinkled with water. In tin's manner his Acamana, Vedas (Vedic Study) Yajnas, penance, charitable gifts and vow of celibacy become fruitful. If an atheist performs holy rites without performing Acamana out of delusion,…

verses.sanskrit: उपभुज्य यथान्यायं दिव्यान्भोगाननुत्तमान् । इह मानुष्यलोके वै राजा भवति धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: upabhujya yathānyāyaṃ divyānbhogānanuttamān / iha mānuṣyaloke vai rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: Even if he takes a hundred births, he does not be¬ come free from that sin. A Brahmana who feeds the nobler and less dignified Brahman as in the same row, whether urged by others or not, incurs sin immediately. Even his merit resulting from digging wells and tanks becomes destroyed. In a festival, an ascedc is the leader of all Brah- manas. 1 An excellent Brahmana who reads all the Vedas with Itihasa constituting their fifth (Veda), should be kept next
verses.hindi: ऋतचो हि यो वेद स बेद वेदान्यजंधि यो बेद स वेद यज्ञम् । सामानि यो बेद स वेद ब्रह्म यो मानस वेद स बेद सर्वम॒ ६६४
verses.wordMeaning: Even if he takes a hundred births, he does not be¬ come free from that sin. A Brahmana who feeds the nobler and less dignified Brahman as in the same row, whether urged by others or not, incurs sin immediately.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if he takes a hundred births, he does not be¬ come free from that sin. A Brahmana who feeds the nobler and less dignified Brahman as in the same row, whether urged by others or not, incurs sin immediately.…

verses.sanskrit: सुरूपः सुभगश्चैव सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः । जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः
verses.transliteration: surūpaḥ subhagaścaiva sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ / jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Then a man of a single Veda and after him comes a per¬ son who studies the Nyaya System. For the purity of the row, I am mentioning them. Understand. I shall mention those who sanctify the row (?).
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे बायुप्रोक्ते श्राद्धकल्पे ब्रह्मणपरीक्षणं नाम नवसप्ततितमो5्ध्याय; ॥७दे।।
verses.wordMeaning: Then a man of a single Veda and after him comes a per¬ son who studies the Nyaya System. For the purity of the row, I am mentioning them. Understand. I shall mention those who sanctify the row (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a man of a single Veda and after him comes a per¬ son who studies the Nyaya System. For the purity of the row, I am mentioning them. Understand. I shall mention those who sanctify the row (?).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराणे एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मङ्गलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टाचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १४९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्यैवानन्तरं तीर्थं लिङ्गेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् । दर्शनाद् देवदेवस्य यत्र पापं प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe maṅgaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 149 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ tīrthaṃ liṅgeśvaramiti śrutam / darśanād devadevasya yatra pāpaṃ praṇaśyati
verses.translation: Those who are mentioned before, are mentioned in their order. The Panktipavanas 1 (those who sanctify the row of diners) arc the following:—Sadangl (a person who has learnt all the six ancillary subjects of the Veda), Vinayl (the discipli¬ ned one), Yogin, Sarvatantrasvatantra (he who has mastered all systems of philosophy) and Yaydvara (a wandering mendicant saint). All these five should be known as Panktipavanas. He who has mastered completely one of the eighteen lores, he who ful¬ fills his duty duly—all of them are also so. The Trinaciketas 2 (a Brahmana who learns the three Vidyas of Naciketas), the Traividya (he who has mastered three Vidyas), the Brahmana who learns Dharmasastras, the Brahmana who has mastered the Barhaspatya scripture—all these Brahmanas are said to be those who sanctify the row.
verses.hindi: अतः पर प्रवक्ष्यासि दानानि च फलानि च। तारणं सर्वभुतानां स्वर्गंसाग सुखावहमू... कुछ होता है, उसे देखते हैं । व्यक्ति, अव्यक्त, सबसे परे जो कुछ पदार्थ हैं उन सब को बे वश में रखते हूँ । सत् असत् जो कुछ भी भाव या पदार्थ हैं उनके देखे हुए हैं, महात्मा पुरुषों के लिये सत् असत् सभी पदाथथ वशीइत हैं ।६१-६२। महात्माओं के लिए निश्चित मोक्षादि, एवं समस्त ज्ञान उनके भधिकृत रहते हैं । इसलिये उन योगपरायण महापुरुषों में भासक्त (प्रेम) रखनेवाला परम कल्याण का भाजन होता । जो ऋग्वेद
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are mentioned before, are mentioned in their order. The Panktipavanas 1 (those who sanctify the row of diners) arc the following:—Sadangl (a person who has learnt all the six ancillary subjects of the Veda), Vinayl (the discipli¬ ned one), Yogin,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are mentioned before, are mentioned in their order. The Panktipavanas 1 (those who sanctify the row of diners) arc the following:—Sadangl (a person who has learnt all the six ancillary subjects of the Veda), Vinayl (the discipli¬ ned one), Yogin,…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा तु कदनं घोरं दानवानां युधिष्ठिर । वाराहं रूपमास्थाय नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tu kadanaṃ ghoraṃ dānavānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: If a Brahmana invited in a Sraddha indulges in sexual intercourse with a woman, the Pitrs lie down in his semen virile for the period of that month (?)
verses.hindi: को जानता है, बह सभी वेदों को जानता है, जो यजुर्वेद को जानता है वह समस्त यज्ञों का जाननेवाला है, जो सामवेद जानता है, वह पूर्णब्रह्मआनी है, जो मानस (?) जानता है वह सब कुछ जानता है
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana invited in a Sraddha indulges in sexual intercourse with a woman, the Pitrs lie down in his semen virile for the period of that month (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana invited in a Sraddha indulges in sexual intercourse with a woman, the Pitrs lie down in his semen virile for the period of that month (?)

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नानं कृत्वा देवं नमस्यति । स मुच्यते नृपश्रेष्ठ महापापैः पुराकृतैः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ namasyati / sa mucyate nṛpaśreṣṭha mahāpāpaiḥ purākṛtaiḥ
verses.translation: It was believed that persons of specially high character, merit, learning etc. purify excommunicated or degenerate members of the society by associating with them, by sitting in their row for dining or even by their beneficent look (v 91 below). The belief was probably current before the time of Dharma Sutras: vide Apartamba Dh. S.II. 7.17-22. Curiously enough, Gautama (15.28), Baudhayana Dh.S. II. 8.2, Manu III. 185-186, Yajnavalkya Smfti (I. 219) use the same words about these sanctifiers of diners ( Panktipavanas ). We get a long list of such sanctifiers in Mbh. Anuiasana 90.25-31, Mt. 7-23, KP. II.21-1-14. Bd. 3.15.28-
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध में दान के फल बृहरुपति ने कद्ा--अब इसके उपरास्त पुनः दान और उसके फलों को बतला रहा हूं। सभी जीवों के उद्धार करनेवाले, स्वर्गमार्ग में सुख देनेवाले, लोक में सर्वश्रेष्ठ, स्वगप्रदान करनेवाले, अपने को विशेष
verses.wordMeaning: It was believed that persons of specially high character, merit, learning etc. purify excommunicated or degenerate members of the society by associating with them, by sitting in their row for dining or even by their beneficent look (v 91 below).…
verses.commentary: Sense: It was believed that persons of specially high character, merit, learning etc. purify excommunicated or degenerate members of the society by associating with them, by sitting in their row for dining or even by their beneficent look (v 91 below).…

verses.sanskrit: द्वादश्यां कृष्णपक्षस्य शुक्ले च समुपोषितः । गन्धमाल्यैर्जगन्नाथं पूजयेत् पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya śukle ca samupoṣitaḥ / gandhamālyairjagannāthaṃ pūjayet pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: Our text practically repeats the same lines.
verses.hindi: लोके श्रेष्ठतमं स्वग्यंमात्मनश्वापि यत्प्रियम् । सर्व पित्॒णां दातव्यं तेषामेबाक्षयाथिता २ जाम्बूनदमयं दिव्यं विमान सुर्यंसंनिभम्  दिव्याप्सरोधिः संकीर्णमन्नदो लभते फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Our text practically repeats the same lines.
verses.commentary: Sense: Our text practically repeats the same lines.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणांश्च महाभाग दानसंमानभोजनैः । पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāṃśca mahābhāga dānasaṃmānabhojanaiḥ / pūjayetparayā bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Trindciketa is alternately explained as:
verses.hindi: आच्छादन तु यो दद्यादहतं श्ाद्धकर्मणि । आयुः प्रकाममेश्वर्य रूपं च लभते सुतम् ४ उपवोतं तु यो दद्याच्छाड्कालेषु धर्मंवित् । पानं च् सब विप्राणां ब्रह्मदानस्थ यत्फलम् ५ कृतं विप्रेष यो दह्याच्छाद्धकाले कमण्डलुम्। मधुक्षो रखवा धेनुर्दातारमुपतिष्ठति ६ चक्राविद्धं तु यो दद्याच्छाद्धकाले कमण्डलुम्। धेनुं स लभते दिव्यां पयोदां काम्यदोहिनीमू. सुमहज्ज्वलनप्रख्यं रत्वकामसमन्वितम् । सुर्यचन्द्रनिभ दिव्यं विमान लभतेक्षयम् ११ अप्सरोभिः परिवुतं कामर्ग तु मनोजवस् । बसते स विसानागरूचे स्तुयमानः समन्ततः ३१२
verses.wordMeaning: Trindciketa is alternately explained as:
verses.commentary: Sense: Trindciketa is alternately explained as:

verses.sanskrit: सत्रयाजिफलं जन्तुर् लभते द्वादशाब्दकैः । ब्राह्मणान्भोजयंस्तत्र तदेव लभते फलम्
verses.transliteration: satrayājiphalaṃ jantur labhate dvādaśābdakaiḥ / brāhmaṇānbhojayaṃstatra tadeva labhate phalam
verses.translation: If the performer of a Sraddha or he who takes food in a 3raddha, indulges in sexual intercourse, undoubtedly the Pitrs are stationed in his semen virile that month.
verses.hindi: प्रिय लगनेवाले पदार्थों को अक्षय तृप्ति के लिये उन पितरों को देना चाहिए ।३-२। श्राद्धादि में अन्न का दान करनेवाला मनुष्य सुवर्ण के बने हुए, सूर्य के समान चमऊते हुए, दिव्य सीौन्दयंशालिनी अप्सराओं से भरे हुए दिव्य विमान को प्राष्त करता है ।३। जो मनुष्य श्राद्धकर्म में विता फटा हुआ ओढ़ने का वस्त्र प्रदान करता है, वह दीर्वायु, ऐश्वयं सुन्दरता तथा पुत्र की प्राप्ति करता है ४। जो घर्मात्मा मनुष्य श्राद्धकर्म में यश्ञोपवीत का
verses.wordMeaning: If the performer of a Sraddha or he who takes food in a 3raddha, indulges in sexual intercourse, undoubtedly the Pitrs are stationed in his semen virile that month.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the performer of a Sraddha or he who takes food in a 3raddha, indulges in sexual intercourse, undoubtedly the Pitrs are stationed in his semen virile that month.

verses.sanskrit: तर्पयित्वा पित्ःन् देवान् स्नात्वा तद्गतमानसः । जपेद् द्वादशनामानि देवस्य पुरतः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: tarpayitvā pitḥn devān snātvā tadgatamānasaḥ / japed dvādaśanāmāni devasya purataḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Hence a Dana (religious gift) is to be made to the guest and a Brahmacarin (celibate person) is to be fed. The Dana is to be made to one engrossed in meditation and having sympathetic feelings. In the Sraddha rite, a righteous ascetic or a Valakhilya (a mendicant who docs not hoard anything) should be fed. A Vanaprastha (forest-dweller) and an Upakur- vdiia (Brahmacarin who completes his studies and pays his teacher and is about to be a householder) is propitiated by mere worship.
verses.hindi: दान करता है तथा सभी समागत ब्राह्ीणों को सुन्दर जलपान कराता है उसे ब्रह्म (विद्या) दाव का फल प्राप्त होता हैं।।५। जो मनुष्य श्राद्ध के अवसर पर ब्राह्मणों के लिये सुन्दर कमण्डलु का दान करता है, उस दाता के लिये मधु के समान मीठा दूध देनेवाली गो नियुक्त रहती है ।६॥ जो श्राद्धकाल में चक्राकार चिह्न से चिह्नित कृमण्डलु प्रदान करता है, वह सभी मनोरथों की श्रदात क्रनेवाली, दिव्य गुग सम्पन्न दूध देनेवाली गौ प्राप्त करता है ।७। जो पुष्प की मालाओं से विभूषित, सभी सामग्रियों से समन्वित सुन्दर शब्या का दान करता है, उसकी वह शय्या उत्तम प्रासाद (राजमहल) के रूप में उसके पीछे-पीछे (परलोक में) चलती है ।८5। श्राद्ध के अवसर पर रत्नादि से युक्त शय्या, एवं आसनादि से अलंकृत भवन को यतियों के लिए दान करनेवाला मनुष्य स्त्रगं में आनन्द की प्राप्ति करता है। मोती, बंदूय, विविधवस्त्र, रत्न, करोड़ों अरबों की संख्या में दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: Hence a Dana (religious gift) is to be made to the guest and a Brahmacarin (celibate person) is to be fed. The Dana is to be made to one engrossed in meditation and having sympathetic feelings. In the Sraddha rite,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence a Dana (religious gift) is to be made to the guest and a Brahmacarin (celibate person) is to be fed. The Dana is to be made to one engrossed in meditation and having sympathetic feelings. In the Sraddha rite,…

verses.sanskrit: मासि मासि निराहारो द्वादश्यां कुरुनन्दन । केशवं पूजयेन् नित्यं मासि मार्गशिरे बुधः
verses.transliteration: māsi māsi nirāhāro dvādaśyāṃ kurunandana / keśavaṃ pūjayen nityaṃ māsi mārgaśire budhaḥ
verses.translation: If a householder is fed, Visvedevas are worshipped. By worshipping a Vanaprastha, sages are worshipped. By worshipping Valakhilyas, Purandara (i.e. Indra) is wor¬ shipped.
verses.hindi: बाहन, तथा अतिप्रकाशमान, रत्नादि से विभूषित, चन्द्रमा और सूर्य के समान एक दिव्यवाहन प्राप्त करता है उस दिव्य विमान का कभी विनाश नहीं होता ।६-११। इच्छानुस्तार गमन करनेवाला, सन के समान वेगश्ञाली बह रथ चारों ओर से अप्सराभों द्वारा घिरा रहता है। उस श्रेष्ठ विमान में चारों ओर से उसकी स्तुति की.
verses.wordMeaning: If a householder is fed, Visvedevas are worshipped. By worshipping a Vanaprastha, sages are worshipped. By worshipping Valakhilyas, Purandara (i.e. Indra) is wor¬ shipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a householder is fed, Visvedevas are worshipped. By worshipping a Vanaprastha, sages are worshipped. By worshipping Valakhilyas, Purandara (i.e. Indra) is wor¬ shipped.

verses.sanskrit: पौषे नारायणं देवं माघमासे तु माधवम् । गोविन्दं फाल्गुने मासि विष्णुं चैत्रे समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: pauṣe nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ māghamāse tu mādhavam / govindaṃ phālgune māsi viṣṇuṃ caitre samarcayet
verses.translation: In worshipping ascetics, Brahma himself is wor¬ shipped. These Asramas are holy. There are five Anasramas through deceitfulness (?)
verses.hindi: जोबितस्य प्रदानाद्धि नान्यहानं विशिष्यते । तस्मात्सवंप्रयत्नेन देय प्राणाभिरक्षणम् .. १७ अहिसा सर्वंदेवेभ्यः पवित्रा सर्वदायिनी । दान हि जीवितस्था558ु: प्राणिनां परम बुधाः १८ पात्र वे तेजस दह्यान्मनोज्ञ श्राद्धभोजने । पात्र भवति कामानां रूपस्य च धनस्थ च॑ ६२० (+ राजतं का्चनं बाइपि दद्याच्छाद्वे तु कर्माणि। दत्त्वा तु लभते दाता प्रकाम धर्ममेव च)
verses.wordMeaning: In worshipping ascetics, Brahma himself is wor¬ shipped. These Asramas are holy. There are five Anasramas through deceitfulness (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: In worshipping ascetics, Brahma himself is wor¬ shipped. These Asramas are holy. There are five Anasramas through deceitfulness (?)

verses.sanskrit: वैशाखे मधुहन्तारं ज्येष्ठे देवं त्रिविक्रमम् । वामनं तु तथाषाढे श्रावणे श्रीधरं स्मरेत्
verses.transliteration: vaiśākhe madhuhantāraṃ jyeṣṭhe devaṃ trivikramam / vāmanaṃ tu tathāṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe śrīdharaṃ smaret
verses.translation: Four Asramas (i. e. people in the four stages of life) are to be worshipped in the rites ot Devas and Pitrs. A Sraddha
verses.hindi: जाती है  गन्धवे ओर अप्सराओं के बुन्द दिव्य सुगन्धित द्रब्यों एवं पुष्प की बृष्टियों से उसे आाष्छादित करते हैं। मनोहुः गायन और वबादन द्वारा उसका मनोरंजन करते हैं। परम धसुन्दरी अप्सराओं के साथ मुख्य-मुख्य युवती कन्यायें मनोरम संगीतमय स्वरों से उन्हें सवंदा जगाती हैं ।१२-१४। एक सहुस्न अइवों के दान करने से, एक सौ रथों के दान करने से तथा एक सहस्न हाथियों के दात करने से मनुष्य योगिनी के साथ निवास
verses.wordMeaning: Four Asramas (i. e. people in the four stages of life) are to be worshipped in the rites ot Devas and Pitrs. A Sraddha
verses.commentary: Sense: Four Asramas (i. e. people in the four stages of life) are to be worshipped in the rites ot Devas and Pitrs. A Sraddha

verses.sanskrit: हृषीकेशं भाद्रपदे पद्मनाभं तथाश्विने । दामोदरं कार्त्तिके तु कीर्तयन् नावसीदति
verses.transliteration: hṛṣīkeśaṃ bhādrapade padmanābhaṃ tathāśvine / dāmodaraṃ kārttike tu kīrtayan nāvasīdati
verses.translation: Even if he stays hungry, let him stay so outside the four stages of life. The non-ascetic and the Salvationist—both of them are the defilers of the row. 1
verses.hindi: करता है ।१५। जो व्यक्ति योग परायण पितरों के उद्देश्य से जल में दोपदान करता है, उसे एक श्रहखल निष्कों के दान का फल प्राप्त होता है।१६॥ जीवनदान के समान विशेषता किसी अन्य दान की नहीं है; इसलिये सब प्रयत्त करके प्राणों की रक्षा का दान करना चाहिए ।१७। अहिंसा देवताओं की भपेक्षा पवित्र एवं सबकुछ देनेवाली है, प्राणियों को जीवन का दान करना सभी दातों से श्रेष्ठ है--ऐसा बुद्धिमान लोग कहते हैं ।१८। प्ाद्ध में सभी लक्षणों से युक्त सुबर्ण के पात्रों का दान करना चाहिए  जो लोग श्राद्ध में इस प्रकार के सुवर्ण निर्भित पात्रों का दान करते हैं, उन्हें विविध प्रकार के खाद्य पदार्थ, रस एवं सौभाग्य की प्राप्ति होती है ।१६। श्राद्धकाल में भोजन के अवसर पर सुन्दर बने हुए तंजस (चाँदी के)पात्रों का दान करना चाहिए, वह पात्र दाता के स्वरूप, धन-सम्पत्ति और सभी मनोरधों
verses.wordMeaning: Even if he stays hungry, let him stay so outside the four stages of life. The non-ascetic and the Salvationist—both of them are the defilers of the row. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if he stays hungry, let him stay so outside the four stages of life. The non-ascetic and the Salvationist—both of them are the defilers of the row. 1

verses.sanskrit: वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मजं यत्पुरा कृतम् । तन्नश्यति न सन्देहो मासनामानुकीर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurā kṛtam / tannaśyati na sandeho māsanāmānukīrtanāt
verses.translation: Those who shave off their hair in vain, those who wear matted hair, those who wear all sorts of robes, those who are devoid of mercy, those who break all codes of good con¬ duct and those who are indiscriminate in eating—are to be avoided.
verses.hindi: को पूर्ण करनेबाला होता है, (श्राद्धकर्म में सुवर्ण अथवा चाँदी के बने हुए पात्रों को जो दाता देते हैं, वे परम धर्म की प्राप्ति करते हैं।) जो व्यक्ति श्राद्ध में दोहन पात्र के साथ एक बार की ब्याई हुई गौ का दान करता है, उसे अनेक गोौयें प्राप्त होती हैं और सबंदा पुष्टि रहती हैं ।१०-२२। शिश्षिर ऋतु में श्राद्ध के अवसर पर जो
verses.wordMeaning: Those who shave off their hair in vain, those who wear matted hair, those who wear all sorts of robes, those who are devoid of mercy, those who break all codes of good con¬ duct and those who are indiscriminate in eating—are to be avoided.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who shave off their hair in vain, those who wear matted hair, those who wear all sorts of robes, those who are devoid of mercy, those who break all codes of good con¬ duct and those who are indiscriminate in eating—are to be avoided.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं विनुद्धः सततमुन्मिषन्निमिषंस्तथा । शीघ्रं प्रपश्य भुञ्जानो मन्त्रहीनं समुद्गिरेत्
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ vinuddhaḥ satatamunmiṣannimiṣaṃstathā / śīghraṃ prapaśya bhuñjāno mantrahīnaṃ samudgiret
verses.translation: In the matter of Havya and Kavya, one shall avoid Karukas (a Saiva sect) and men of no disciplined conduct of life, men ostracised from the Vedic Society, musicians and actors (who imitate deities).
verses.hindi: एतदधेस्थान इदमर्ध दिव्य; पुष्पे: प्रसिश्वन्ति पूर्णवृष्टि भिरेव च! इति ख. ग. घ. ह. पुस्तकेषु । +घनुश्चित्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति । शिशिरेषु तथा त्वग्नि बहुकाष्ठ तथेव च। -- इन्धनानि तु यो दद्यादृद्विजिम्यः शिशिरागसे ॥३२ ३
verses.wordMeaning: In the matter of Havya and Kavya, one shall avoid Karukas (a Saiva sect) and men of no disciplined conduct of life, men ostracised from the Vedic Society, musicians and actors (who imitate deities).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the matter of Havya and Kavya, one shall avoid Karukas (a Saiva sect) and men of no disciplined conduct of life, men ostracised from the Vedic Society, musicians and actors (who imitate deities).

verses.sanskrit: परमापद्गतस्यापि जन्तोरेषा प्रतिक्रिया । यन्मासाधिपतेर् विष्णोर् मासनामानुकीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: paramāpadgatasyāpi jantoreṣā pratikriyā / yanmāsādhipater viṣṇor māsanāmānukīrtanam
verses.translation: A person who has social and other contacts with these, attains black complexion (taint). He who dines with Sudras—all these are defilers of the row (of diners).
verses.hindi: श्राउेष्वेतानि यो दह्यादश्वमेधफलं लभेत् । श्राद्धकाले निवेद्यं च॒ दर्शभ्राद्ध उपस्थिते
verses.wordMeaning: A person who has social and other contacts with these, attains black complexion (taint). He who dines with Sudras—all these are defilers of the row (of diners).
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who has social and other contacts with these, attains black complexion (taint). He who dines with Sudras—all these are defilers of the row (of diners).

verses.sanskrit: ता निशास्ते च दिवसास्ते मासास्ते च वत्सराः । नराणां सफला येषु चिन्तितो भगवान्हरिः
verses.transliteration: tā niśāste ca divasāste māsāste ca vatsarāḥ / narāṇāṃ saphalā yeṣu cintito bhagavānhariḥ
verses.translation: Killing (of animals etc.), destruction with force, agriculture, trading activities, animal husbandry, secret service to a person other than the preceptor—these should not be followed by a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: ५८ कुस्भदो हनधेनूनां बह्लीनां च फलं लभेत् । अस्मिस्तु सोदते लोके स्यन्दनेश्न सुवाहने: अग्नि एवं प्रचुर परिमांण में इन्धन का दान करता हैं, अथवा शिशिर ऋतु के आ जाने पर जो ब्राह्मणों के लिए इन्धन दान करता है, वह संग्राम में सवंदा विजयी होता है, ओर. शोभा सम्पन्न होकर परम तेजस्वी होता है। श्रा्ध के अवसर पर सुगन्धित पुष्पों की मालाएँ तथा सुन्दर पात्रों को सत्कार पुृवंक दान करना चाहिए। जो ऐसा करता है, उसे महानदियाँ सुगन्धित से युक्त होकर परम सुख पहुँचाती हैं, विविध सुखों की प्राप्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Killing (of animals etc.), destruction with force, agriculture, trading activities, animal husbandry, secret service to a person other than the preceptor—these should not be followed by a Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Killing (of animals etc.), destruction with force, agriculture, trading activities, animal husbandry, secret service to a person other than the preceptor—these should not be followed by a Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: परमापद्गतस्यापि यस्य देवो जनार्दनः । नावसर्पति हृत्पद्मात्स योगी नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: paramāpadgatasyāpi yasya devo janārdanaḥ / nāvasarpati hṛtpadmātsa yogī nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are real Brahmanas, pursue knowledge and meditation. Even if they are born as Brahmanas, those who have false conceptions are of evil conduct.
verses.hindi: होती है ।२३-२४५। मनोरम युवती स्त्रियाँ उस दाता के पास उपस्थित होती हैं । विविध प्रकार की शय्पा, मनोहर आपन, प्रचुर भूमि एवं विविध वाहइन-“इन सब को जो श्राद्ध के अवसर पर देता है, वह अध्वमेध यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त करता है। सामान्य श्राद्धों के अवसर पर अथवा दर्श श्राद्धों के अवसर पर जो इन वस्तुओं का दान सर्वगुषसम्पन्त ब्राह्मणों को करता है वह सुन्दर स्मरण शक्ति और बुद्धि को प्राप्त करता है। श्राद्ध के अवसर
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are real Brahmanas, pursue knowledge and meditation. Even if they are born as Brahmanas, those who have false conceptions are of evil conduct.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are real Brahmanas, pursue knowledge and meditation. Even if they are born as Brahmanas, those who have false conceptions are of evil conduct.

verses.sanskrit: ते भाग्यहीना मनुजाः सुशोच्यास्ते भूमिभाराय कृतावताराः । अचेतनास्ते पशुभिः समाना ये भक्तिहीना भगवत्यनन्ते
verses.transliteration: te bhāgyahīnā manujāḥ suśocyāste bhūmibhārāya kṛtāvatārāḥ / acetanāste paśubhiḥ samānā ye bhaktihīnā bhagavatyanante
verses.translation: The preachers of wrong/heretic doctrines should be avoided. So also the arrogant, the scandal-monger, and people defiled by minor sins and great sins should be avoided.
verses.hindi: पर घृत से भरे हुए अनेक पात्रों का साकार पूर्वक दान करना चाहिए, जो ऐसा करता है, वह दोहन कलश समेत अनेक गौओं के दान का फल प्राप्त करता है । इस लोक में सुन्दर वाहनों एवं रथों का आनन्द प्राप्त करता है ।२६-२९। श्राद्ध के अवसर पर याचक की मनचाही वस्तु का दान करने से पुण्डरीक यज्ञ का एवं सुन्दर निवास स्थल का दान करने से राजसूय यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त करता है। एवं फलों से समिस्वत बत का दाच करने से सुगन्धित पदार्थों की प्राप्ति होती है। कूपों, बगीचों, तड़ायों, क्षेत्रों, गोशालाओं और गहों के दाव करने से दाता स्वर्ग लोक में तब तक निवास करता है, जब तक चन्द्रमा और ताराएं विद्यमान रहती हैं। श्राद्ध काल में र॒त्नजटित बिछावन और दय्या का दान करता है, उसके पितरगण सन्तुष्ट होते हैं, ओर दाता
verses.wordMeaning: The preachers of wrong/heretic doctrines should be avoided. So also the arrogant, the scandal-monger, and people defiled by minor sins and great sins should be avoided.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preachers of wrong/heretic doctrines should be avoided. So also the arrogant, the scandal-monger, and people defiled by minor sins and great sins should be avoided.

verses.sanskrit: ते पूर्णकार्याः पुरुषाः पृथिव्यां ते स्वाङ्गपाताद्भुवनं पुनन्ति । विचक्षणा विश्वविभूषणास्ते ये भक्तियुक्ता भगवत्यनन्ते
verses.transliteration: te pūrṇakāryāḥ puruṣāḥ pṛthivyāṃ te svāṅgapātādbhuvanaṃ punanti / vicakṣaṇā viśvavibhūṣaṇāste ye bhaktiyuktā bhagavatyanante
verses.translation: Those who make use of Vedas as a means of em¬ ployment out of greed and delusion or for profit are the sellers of Vedas. They are to be avoided in the Sraddha rite.
verses.hindi: ,-इत उत्तरमेतदधेमधिकरम् 'का्याग्निदीप्ति: प्राकाइ्ये रूपं सौभाग्यमेव च' इति ख. घ. ड. पुस्तकेषु ।
verses.wordMeaning: Those who make use of Vedas as a means of em¬ ployment out of greed and delusion or for profit are the sellers of Vedas. They are to be avoided in the Sraddha rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who make use of Vedas as a means of em¬ ployment out of greed and delusion or for profit are the sellers of Vedas. They are to be avoided in the Sraddha rite.

verses.sanskrit: स एव सुकृती तेन लब्धं जन्मतरोः फलम् । चित्ते वचसि काये च यस्य देवो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: sa eva sukṛtī tena labdhaṃ janmataroḥ phalam / citte vacasi kāye ca yasya devo janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: A person hired to teach the Vedas and one who is taught by such a person—both of them do not deserve invit¬ ation to a Sraddha as the sellers and buyers of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: एतदर्घस्थाने5्यं पाठ: 'कुम्भदोदोह॒धे नूनां वह्दीनां फलमस्नुते' इति ख. ग. घ ड. पुस्तकेषु । अर्णाकौशेयवस्त्राणि तथा प्रवरकम्बलौ । अजिन॑ कान पहट्ट' प्रवेणीमृगलोमकम् ३३४ दानान्येतानि विप्रेभ्यों भोजग्रित्वा यथाविधि। प्राप्नोति श्रहधानस्तु वाजपेयशर्तं फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: A person hired to teach the Vedas and one who is taught by such a person—both of them do not deserve invit¬ ation to a Sraddha as the sellers and buyers of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person hired to teach the Vedas and one who is taught by such a person—both of them do not deserve invit¬ ation to a Sraddha as the sellers and buyers of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्तीर्थवरं पुण्यं लिङ्गो यत्र जनार्दनः । वञ्चयित्वा रिपून्संख्ये क्रोधो भूत्वा सनातनः
verses.transliteration: etattīrthavaraṃ puṇyaṃ liṅgo yatra janārdanaḥ / vañcayitvā ripūnsaṃkhye krodho bhūtvā sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Those (Brahmanas) who buy and sell for the purpose of livelihood are despicable ones. This is the profession of a Vaisya but a sin unto Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: बह्ुचो नाये: सुरुपास्तु पुत्रा भृत्याश्व किकरा: । वशे तिष्ठन्ति भूतानि अस्मिललोके त्वनामयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Those (Brahmanas) who buy and sell for the purpose of livelihood are despicable ones. This is the profession of a Vaisya but a sin unto Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those (Brahmanas) who buy and sell for the purpose of livelihood are despicable ones. This is the profession of a Vaisya but a sin unto Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: उपप्लवे चन्द्रमसो रवेश्च यो ह्यष्टकानामयनद्वये च । पानीयमप्यत्र तिलैर्विमिश्रं दद्यात् पितृभ्यः प्रयतो मनुष्यः
verses.transliteration: upaplave candramaso raveśca yo hyaṣṭakānāmayanadvaye ca / pānīyamapyatra tilairvimiśraṃ dadyāt pitṛbhyaḥ prayato manuṣyaḥ
verses.translation: They say that he who depends for his livelihood upon the Vedas and he who depends upon those who know Vedas for livelihood do not deserve invitation to a Sraddha. The husband of one's daughter also shall not be invited. He who goes unto his wife in vain (i.c. an issueless person) and he who performs Yajna in vain—both of these do not deserve an (invitation to) a Sraddha. A Brahmana (who is) an atheist also shall not be invited.
verses.hindi: कोशेय क्षौ मकार्पासं दुकूलमह॒तं तथा। श्ाद्धेष्वेतानि यो दह्यात्कामानाप्नोति पुष्कलान् ३७ सर्वदेवमय वासो सर्वदेबेस्व्वभिष्टुतम् । वस्त्राभावे क्विया नास्ति यज्ञा वेदास्तरपासि लू ॥३ ६९ तस्मादस्त्राणि देयानि श्राद्धकाले विशेषतः । तामि सर्वाण्यवाप्नोति यज्ञवेदतपांसि च ॥४ ० नित्य श्राउेषु यो दह्यात्प्रयतस्तत्परायण: । सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति स्वर्ग राज्य तंत्र च
verses.wordMeaning: They say that he who depends for his livelihood upon the Vedas and he who depends upon those who know Vedas for livelihood do not deserve invitation to a Sraddha. The husband of one's daughter also shall not be invited. He who goes unto his wife in vain (i.c.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that he who depends for his livelihood upon the Vedas and he who depends upon those who know Vedas for livelihood do not deserve invitation to a Sraddha. The husband of one's daughter also shall not be invited. He who goes unto his wife in vain (i.c.…

verses.sanskrit: घोणोन्मीलितमेरुरन्ध्रनिवहो दुःखाब्धिमज्जत्प्लवः प्रादुर्भूतरसातलोदरबृहत्पङ्कार्धमग्नक्षुरः । फूत्कारोत्करनुन्नवातविदलद्दिग्दन्तिनादश्रुतिन्यस्तस्तब्धवपुः श्रुतिर्भवतु वः क्रोडो हरिः शान्तये
verses.transliteration: ghoṇonmīlitamerurandhranivaho duḥkhābdhimajjatplavaḥ prādurbhūtarasātalodarabṛhatpaṅkārdhamagnakṣuraḥ / phūtkārotkaranunnavātavidaladdigdantinādaśrutinyastastabdhavapuḥ śrutirbhavatu vaḥ kroḍo hariḥ śāntaye
verses.translation: He who cooks food for himself only and he who does not offer anything to Dcvas and guests—both of them are fallen and they are Brahmaraksasas. They do not deserve (invitation to) a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: सकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञषस्य फलसश्नुते । भव्ष्यान्धा ना: करम्भांश्व पिष्ठकार्धृतश्क रा: ६४२
verses.wordMeaning: He who cooks food for himself only and he who does not offer anything to Dcvas and guests—both of them are fallen and they are Brahmaraksasas. They do not deserve (invitation to) a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who cooks food for himself only and he who does not offer anything to Dcvas and guests—both of them are fallen and they are Brahmaraksasas. They do not deserve (invitation to) a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे लिङ्गवाराहतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज कुसुमेश्वरमुत्तमम् । दक्षिणे नर्मदाकूले उपपातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe liṅgavārāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 150 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja kusumeśvaramuttamam / dakṣiṇe narmadākūle upapātakanāśanam
verses.translation: Those whose wives eagerly await the nights and those who run after other men's wives, as well as those who are mad after wealth and love should not be invited to a Sraddha.
verses.hindi: अनध्त काल तक स्व में निवास करता है। राजाओं द्वारा वह पूजित होता है, उसके धन धाश्यादि की वृद्धि होती है ।३०-३३॥ ऊती, रेह्ममी वस्त्र, श्रेष्ठ, कम्बल, चरम, सुबर्ण सिमित पट्ठट और मृगलोम इन सब वस्तुओं को विधिपूवंक ब्राह्मणों को देना चाहिए  इन दानों पर श्रद्धा रखनेवाले सो वाजपेय यज्ञों का फल प्राप्त करते हैं ।३४-३४५। इस लोक में बहुतेरी सुन्दरी स्थ्रियाँ, पुत्र, पुत्र, एवं सेवक गण उसके वश में रहते- हैं, बहुत से लोग उसके अधीन रहते हैं, और वह सबंदा नीरोग रहता है। जो व्यक्ति नवीन रेशमी वस्त्र, सूक्ष्म सुती वस्त्र, सुन्दर साड़ियों को श्राद्धों के अवसर पर दान करता है, वह अपने समस्त मनोरथों को प्राप्त करता हैे। उसकी सारी विपत्तियाँ इस प्रकार दूर हो जाती हैं, जंसे सूयोंदय होने पर अन्धकार । नक्षत्रों में चन्द्रमा के समान देवविमानों में वह अग्रसर होकर सुक्षोभित होता है ।३६-३८। वस्त्र सभी देवताओं द्वारा प्रशंसित तथा सर्वे देवमय है, उस
verses.wordMeaning: Those whose wives eagerly await the nights and those who run after other men's wives, as well as those who are mad after wealth and love should not be invited to a Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those whose wives eagerly await the nights and those who run after other men's wives, as well as those who are mad after wealth and love should not be invited to a Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: कामेन स्थापितो देवः कुसुमेश्वरसंज्ञितः । ख्यातः सर्वेषु लोकेषु देवदेवः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: kāmena sthāpito devaḥ kusumeśvarasaṃjñitaḥ / khyātaḥ sarveṣu lokeṣu devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are opposed to the discipline andtbe duties of the four castes and stages of life, a thief and he who indiscri¬ minately performs Yajna for everyone—all these are defilers of the row in the rite ofSraddha.
verses.hindi: सर्वश्रेष्ठ वस्त्र के अभाव में कोई क्रिया सम्पन्न नहीं होती, न तो यह सम्पन्न होता है और न तपस्या ही सफल होती है। इसलिये श्राद्ध के अवसर पर विश्लेष रूप से बस्त्रों का दान करना चाहिए । ऐसा करने वाला समस्त यज्ञों, वेदों और तपध्याओं का फल प्राप्त करता है। जो व्यवित भ्राद्ध के अवसर पर इन्द्रियों को बश में रखकर बस्त्रों का दान करता है वह समस्त कामनाओं को प्राप्त करता है, स्वर्ग और राज्य प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are opposed to the discipline andtbe duties of the four castes and stages of life, a thief and he who indiscri¬ minately performs Yajna for everyone—all these are defilers of the row in the rite ofSraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are opposed to the discipline andtbe duties of the four castes and stages of life, a thief and he who indiscri¬ minately performs Yajna for everyone—all these are defilers of the row in the rite ofSraddha.

verses.sanskrit: कामो मनोभवो विश्वः कुसुमायुधचापभृत् । स कामान् ददाति सर्वान् पूजितो मीनकेतनः
verses.transliteration: kāmo manobhavo viśvaḥ kusumāyudhacāpabhṛt / sa kāmān dadāti sarvān pūjito mīnaketanaḥ
verses.translation: The leavings of the Sraddha food should not be given to women or a Sudra unless he is an attendant. If anyone gives out of passion or delusion, it never reaches Pitrs.
verses.hindi: सभी कामनाओं से सम्पन्न यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त करता है। विविध प्रकार के भद्ष्य पदार्थ, घान्य करम्भ (दही- मिश्रित सत्त), पेठ, घृत और शक्‍कर, खिचड़ी, मधुपक, दुग्ध, दुग्ध में बने हुए पदार्थ, सुन्दर पृुआ--इन सब शकराक्षो संयुक्त पृथुक॑ नित्यमक्षयम् । स्युश्न संवत्सरं प्रीता: कृशरेमंसुरेण च 0४७ सक्तुलाजास्तथा पृषाः कुल्माषव्यअजनेस्तथा । सपिःस्निग्धानि हुआ्यानि दध्ना सक्तंस्तु भोजयेत् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: The leavings of the Sraddha food should not be given to women or a Sudra unless he is an attendant. If anyone gives out of passion or delusion, it never reaches Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leavings of the Sraddha food should not be given to women or a Sudra unless he is an attendant. If anyone gives out of passion or delusion, it never reaches Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: तेन निर्दग्धकायेन चाराध्य परमेश्वरम् । अनङ्गेन तथा प्राप्तमङ्गित्वं नर्मदातटे
verses.transliteration: tena nirdagdhakāyena cārādhya parameśvaram / anaṅgena tathā prāptamaṅgitvaṃ narmadātaṭe
verses.translation: Hence in a Sraddha rite, the leavings of food should never be given except curds and ghee and that too to a disciple and a son; not otherwise.
verses.hindi: वेश्वदेव॑ च सौस्‍्यं च खाड्गमांसं परं हृवि। विषाणं वर्जयेत्लाड्गं असुयां नाशयामहे ॥४५ १
verses.wordMeaning: Hence in a Sraddha rite, the leavings of food should never be given except curds and ghee and that too to a disciple and a son; not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence in a Sraddha rite, the leavings of food should never be given except curds and ghee and that too to a disciple and a son; not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: अङ्गिभृतस्य नाशत्वमनङ्गस्य तु मे वद । न श्रुतं न च मे दृष्टं भूतपूर्वं कदाचन
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: aṅgibhṛtasya nāśatvamanaṅgasya tu me vada / na śrutaṃ na ca me dṛṣṭaṃ bhūtapūrvaṃ kadācana
verses.translation: Only that which is not left over should be given, such as food particularly. Pitrs are propitiated with flowers, ' roots and fruits too as with food.
verses.hindi: वस्तुओं को श्राद्ध के अवसर पर जो व्यक्ति दान करता है वह अग्निष्टोम यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त करता है वर्षा ऋतु में श्राद्ध के अवसर पर विशेषतया मधा नक्षत्र में--पितरगण दही शुद्ध मोरस, विविध प्रकार के भक्ष्य पदार्थ की चिन्ता करते हैं अर्थात् मधानक्षत्र में श्राद्ध करते समय इन पदार्थों को देना चा हिये । श्राद्ध करते समय घृत के साथ ब्राह्मणों को भोजन कराना चाहिए, भूमि पर घृत छोड़ना चाहिए, गया तीथ में हाथी दान करके पित्तरों के विषय में चिन्ता छूट जाती है ।४४-४५। भात, दुग्ध में बने हुए पदार्थ, घृत, मधु, मूल, फल,
verses.wordMeaning: Only that which is not left over should be given, such as food particularly. Pitrs are propitiated with flowers, ' roots and fruits too as with food.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only that which is not left over should be given, such as food particularly. Pitrs are propitiated with flowers, ' roots and fruits too as with food.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं यथा वृत्तमाचक्ष्व द्विजसत्तम । श्रोतुमिच्छामि विप्रेन्द्र भीमार्जुनयमैः सह
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaṃ yathā vṛttamācakṣva dvijasattama / śrotumicchāmi viprendra bhīmārjunayamaiḥ saha
verses.translation: The foodstuffs served are sanctified as long as they are warm. Pitrs partake of the food as long as the invited Brahmanas take their food, with control over their speech.
verses.hindi: विविध प्रकार की भोजन सामग्री-- इन सब वरतुओं को श्राद्ध के अवसर पर दान करने से इह लोक तथा परलोक में आनन्द की प्राप्ति होती है । दूध मिश्रित शक्कर और चिउड़ा का दान कभी नष्ट होनेवाला नहीं है । मसूर और बिचड़ी के दान से पितर गण एक वर्ष तक सन्तुष्ट रहते हैं। इसी प्रकार सत्तू, धान के लारे, पूआ और कुल्माष (कुल्थी के बने हुए व्यंजनों) से भी एक वर्ष तक पितरगण तृप्त रहते हैं । घुत, मनोहर और हृदय
verses.wordMeaning: The foodstuffs served are sanctified as long as they are warm. Pitrs partake of the food as long as the invited Brahmanas take their food, with control over their speech.
verses.commentary: Sense: The foodstuffs served are sanctified as long as they are warm. Pitrs partake of the food as long as the invited Brahmanas take their food, with control over their speech.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: आदौ कृतयुगे तात देवदेवो महेश्वरः । तपश्चचार विपुलं गङ्गासागरसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ādau kṛtayuge tāta devadevo maheśvaraḥ / tapaścacāra vipulaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: All these rites and particularly the rite of gifting away,
verses.hindi: को लुभाने वाली अन्यान्य खाद्य सामाग्री तथा दही के साथ सत्तू का भोजन श्राद्ध के अवसर पर देना चाहिए। जो व्यक्ति इन सब वस्तुओं को श्राद्ध के अवसर पर दान करता है, वह कई पद्म का खजाना प्राप्त करता है।४६-४८। जो सत्कार एवं यत्नपूर्वक श्राद्ध के अवसर पर नवीन अन्न का दान करता है बह सभी प्रकार के भोगों को प्राप्त करता है, पूजित होता है तथा स्व प्राप्त करता है ।४:। जो मनुष्य विविध प्रकार के खाद्य पदार्थ, भक्ष्य सामग्रियाँ, तथा पीने और चाटने की क्षेष्ठ सामग्रियाँ श्रद्धकाल में देता है, बह सर्वश्रेष्ठ होता है। इस थाद्ध में वंश्वदेव और सोम को उनका भाग देना चाहिए, गैंडे के माँस की अहुति देती चाहिए--बही सर्व श्रेष्ठ हवि है । केवल गैंडे की सोंग छोड़ देनी चाहिए-इसे वर्जित कर हम पितरों की घृणा को नष्ट करते हैं । अर्थात्
verses.wordMeaning: All these rites and particularly the rite of gifting away,
verses.commentary: Sense: All these rites and particularly the rite of gifting away,

verses.sanskrit: तेन सम्पादिता लोकास्तपसा ससुरासुराः । जग्मुस्ते शरणं सर्वे देवदेवं शचीपतिम्
verses.transliteration: tena sampāditā lokāstapasā sasurāsurāḥ / jagmuste śaraṇaṃ sarve devadevaṃ śacīpatim
verses.translation: Those who are steadfast in their holy rites, those who
verses.hindi: तरुणादित्यसंकाश विमान हंसवाहनम् । अन्नदों लभते तिख्रः कन्याकोटीस्तथंव च ..
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are steadfast in their holy rites, those who
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are steadfast in their holy rites, those who

verses.sanskrit: व्यापकः सर्वभूतानां देवदेवो महेश्वरः । संतापयति लोकांस्त्रींस्तन्निवारय गोपते
verses.transliteration: vyāpakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ / saṃtāpayati lokāṃstrīṃstannivāraya gopate
verses.translation: The whole of the three worlds is pervaded or ever by the masters of Yoga. Hence they (can) observe whatever there is in the universe.
verses.hindi: जीवदानात्परं दानं न किचिदिह विद्यते  अन्लेर्जीवन्ति त्रलोक्यमन्नस्थेव हि तत्फलम् अन्ने लोका: प्रतिष्ठन्ति लोकदानस्य तत्फलम्  अन्न प्रजापति: साक्षात्तेन सर्बंसिदं ततम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The whole of the three worlds is pervaded or ever by the masters of Yoga. Hence they (can) observe whatever there is in the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole of the three worlds is pervaded or ever by the masters of Yoga. Hence they (can) observe whatever there is in the universe.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तद्वचनं तेषां देवानां बलवृत्रहा । चिन्तयामास मनसा तपोविघ्नायचादिशत्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tadvacanaṃ teṣāṃ devānāṃ balavṛtrahā / cintayāmāsa manasā tapovighnāyacādiśat
verses.translation: The noble souls keep both the manifest and the un¬ manifest under their control. They control even that which is greater than all. Truth and falsehood have been perceived by them. Sat, Asat have been seen by them. All knowable things, absolution etc. are' seen by the noble souls. Hence one who is devoted to them attains everything auspicious.
verses.hindi: प्रतिभ्रयं सदा द्चादतिथिभ्यः कृताजलिः । देवास्ते संप्रतीक्षस्ते दिव्यातिथ्य: सहस्नशः (५६ सर्वाप्येतानि यो दद्यात्यृथिव्यामेकराइ्भवेत् । त्रिभिद्वस्यामथैकेन दानेन तु सुखी भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: The noble souls keep both the manifest and the un¬ manifest under their control. They control even that which is greater than all. Truth and falsehood have been perceived by them. Sat, Asat have been seen by them. All knowable things, absolution etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The noble souls keep both the manifest and the un¬ manifest under their control. They control even that which is greater than all. Truth and falsehood have been perceived by them. Sat, Asat have been seen by them. All knowable things, absolution etc.…

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरां मेनकां रम्भां घृताचीं च तिलोत्तमाम् । वसन्तं कोकिलं कामं दक्षिणानिलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: apsarāṃ menakāṃ rambhāṃ ghṛtācīṃ ca tilottamām / vasantaṃ kokilaṃ kāmaṃ dakṣiṇānilamuttamam
verses.translation: He who knows the Rks knows the Vedas. He who knows the Yajur Mantras knows Yajna. He who knows Saman Mantras knows Brahman. He who knows Manasa (? mind) knows everything.
verses.hindi: वलनदया/मणबुाननासलााआ+--मनमा ४५० गआ-83० 8००८ ०--०-००००व-००++०+»कमुैनन०००++++नानामभारमममभानातान नव पानता नानी नम मातम मा हा मत नमन ्मप॒भनकनक पना नानक न 0 न॒म- नागा गान नम भानानापुभ४४--ल्‍ "नमन के -- कम म पनान्नानन्ममह पन्ना 5 नढनकम्त++नननन+ मनु पब्न पर सन न आना नम अमान «मम ७००००4५०४+ ना कु» मम ० न्‍म मनाया रे कं न पर गैंडे की सींग को पितरगण घ॒णा दृष्टि से देखते हैं। हाथ जोड़कर अतिथियों को भोजन कराते समय आगे आसन देना चाहिए, जो ऐसा करता है वह सभी यज्ञों एवं सत्कियाओं का फल प्राप्त करता है ।१५०-५३। जो भूला अतिथि हों, उसे अति ज्वीध्रता पूवंक खूब पकी हुई गरमागरम भोजन सामग्री देती चाहिए । यत्नपूर्वंक भक्ति एवं सत्कार के साथ उसे चिकना स्निग्ध भोजव देना चाहिए । जो ऐसा करता है, उसे मध्याक्ष के सूर्य के समान
verses.wordMeaning: He who knows the Rks knows the Vedas. He who knows the Yajur Mantras knows Yajna. He who knows Saman Mantras knows Brahman. He who knows Manasa (? mind) knows everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who knows the Rks knows the Vedas. He who knows the Yajur Mantras knows Yajna. He who knows Saman Mantras knows Brahman. He who knows Manasa (? mind) knows everything.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र महादेवं तपश्चरणतत्परम् । क्षोभयध्वं यथान्यायं गङ्गासागरवासिनम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā tatra mahādevaṃ tapaścaraṇatatparam / kṣobhayadhvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ gaṅgāsāgaravāsinam
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall recount the various types of religious gifts and the benefits thereof. 1 A religious gift enables all living beings to cross (the ocean of worldly existence). It is the pleas¬ ing pathway unto heaven.
verses.hindi: तैजस्वी हंसी के वाहनों से समन्वित विमान की प्राप्ति छ्लोती है। भ्राद्ध के अवसर पर अन्न दान करनेवाला तीन करोड़ सुन्दरी कन्याओं को प्राप्त करता है ।१३-५४। इस मरत्यलोक में अन्नदान से बढ़कर कोई अन्यदान' नहीं है। इसमें किसी की सन्देह न होगा कि अन्न से ही समस्त जीव प्रथ्वी पर उत्पन्न होते हैं और जीवन: चलाते हैं । उसी प्रकार इस मत्यंत्रोक -में जीव दान के समान कोई अन्य दान नहीं हैं। अन्नों द्वारा यह
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth I shall recount the various types of religious gifts and the benefits thereof. 1 A religious gift enables all living beings to cross (the ocean of worldly existence). It is the pleas¬ ing pathway unto heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth I shall recount the various types of religious gifts and the benefits thereof. 1 A religious gift enables all living beings to cross (the ocean of worldly existence). It is the pleas¬ ing pathway unto heaven.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे देवराजेन भारत । देवाप्सरःसमोपेता जग्मुस्ते हरसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: evamuktāstu te sarve devarājena bhārata / devāpsaraḥsamopetā jagmuste harasannidhau
verses.translation: Though ancient works on Dharma Sastra insist upon avoidance of lavishness in Sraddha, later Puraijas encourage profuse expenditure on Sraddha, e.g. Pd. P. Srsti-Khada 9.179-181, Varaha 50-51, VP. III. 14.22-23. Pitrs are reported to have two Gathas expressing their desire to have a descendant who would bestow on Brahmanas (for the benefit of Pitrs) jewels, clothes, land, costly vehicles. This text encourages
verses.hindi: त्रेलोक्य जीवित है, यह सारा विध्वप्रपंच अन्न का ही परिणाम है। अन्न में ही समस्त लोकों की स्थिति और प्रतिष्ठा है, अन्न दात से ही वे वर्तमान हैं, अन्न ही साक्षात् प्रजापति है उसी से यह सारा त्ैलोक्य व्याप्त है । इस कारण अन्न दान के समान कोई अन्य दाव ने तो जगत् में था और न भविष्यत्काल में कभी होगा ।५५-१७ इस पृथ्वी में जितने भी वाहन हैं, जितनी भी सुन्दर स्त्रियाँ हैं, उव सब को पितरों में भक्त रखनेवाला मनुष्य शीघ्र ही प्राप्त करता है इसलिये उसे सब्वेदा हाथ जोड़कर अतिथियों को आश्रय देना चाहिए  सहस्रों देवगण दिव्य (मनोरम) आतिथ्य प्राप्त के लिये प्रतीक्षा करते रहते हैं। जो व्यक्ति ऊपर कही गई समस्त वस्तुओं को श्राद्ध में दान करता है वह पृथ्वी का एकच्छत्र सम्राद होता है, अथवा इनमें से तीत, दो या एक ही का दान करता है वह भी सुखी होता है ।५८-६०। ये दान परमेधमं हैं, सत्परुषों
verses.wordMeaning: Though ancient works on Dharma Sastra insist upon avoidance of lavishness in Sraddha, later Puraijas encourage profuse expenditure on Sraddha, e.g. Pd. P. Srsti-Khada 9.179-181, Varaha 50-51, VP. III. 14.22-23.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Though ancient works on Dharma Sastra insist upon avoidance of lavishness in Sraddha, later Puraijas encourage profuse expenditure on Sraddha, e.g. Pd. P. Srsti-Khada 9.179-181, Varaha 50-51, VP. III. 14.22-23.…

verses.sanskrit: वसन्तमासे कुसुमाकराकुले मयूरदात्यूहसुकोकिलाकुले । प्रनृत्य देवाप्सरगीतसंकुले प्रवाति वाते यमनैरृताकुले
verses.transliteration: vasantamāse kusumākarākule mayūradātyūhasukokilākule / pranṛtya devāpsaragītasaṃkule pravāti vāte yamanairṛtākule
verses.translation: That which is the most excellent in the world, that which is conducive to the attainment of heaven, nay, everything that is pleasing to oneself, must be offered to Pitrs by one who seeks one's own eternal salvation.
verses.hindi: ७३२ बायूपुराणन्.
verses.wordMeaning: That which is the most excellent in the world, that which is conducive to the attainment of heaven, nay, everything that is pleasing to oneself, must be offered to Pitrs by one who seeks one's own eternal salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: That which is the most excellent in the world, that which is conducive to the attainment of heaven, nay, everything that is pleasing to oneself, must be offered to Pitrs by one who seeks one's own eternal salvation.

verses.sanskrit: तेन संमूर्छिताः सर्वे संसर्गाच्च खगोत्तमाः । मधुमाधवगन्धेन सकिन्नरमहोरगाः
verses.transliteration: tena saṃmūrchitāḥ sarve saṃsargācca khagottamāḥ / madhumādhavagandhena sakinnaramahoragāḥ
verses.translation: A person who offers cooked rice, derives the benefit of attaining a divine golden chariot dazzling like the sun and filled with divine Apsaras-s.
verses.hindi: दानानि परमो धर्म: सद्धिः सत्कृत्य पुजितः । त्रलोक्यस्या5डथिपत्यं हि दानादेव व्यवस्थितम राजा तु लभते राज्यमधनश्नोत्तमं धनम्  क्षीणायुलेभते चा55युः पितुभक्तः सदा बरः ॥ यान्कामान्मनसाष्थेंत तांस्तस्य पितरो ददुः द ६२
verses.wordMeaning: A person who offers cooked rice, derives the benefit of attaining a divine golden chariot dazzling like the sun and filled with divine Apsaras-s.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who offers cooked rice, derives the benefit of attaining a divine golden chariot dazzling like the sun and filled with divine Apsaras-s.

verses.sanskrit: यावद् आलोकते तावत्तद्वनं व्याकुलीकृतम् । वीक्षते मदनाविष्टं दशावस्थागतं जनम्
verses.transliteration: yāvad ālokate tāvattadvanaṃ vyākulīkṛtam / vīkṣate madanāviṣṭaṃ daśāvasthāgataṃ janam
verses.translation: Pie who gifts a cloth fresh from the loom at the time of the Sraddha rite attains longevity, ample wealth, beauty and a son.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्‍्ते श्राद्धकल्पे दानफल नामाशीतितमोध्ध्याय: ॥६०॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Pie who gifts a cloth fresh from the loom at the time of the Sraddha rite attains longevity, ample wealth, beauty and a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pie who gifts a cloth fresh from the loom at the time of the Sraddha rite attains longevity, ample wealth, beauty and a son.

verses.sanskrit: देवदेवो ऽपि देवानाम् अवस्थात्रितयं गतः । सात्त्विकीं राजसीं राजंस्तामसीं तां शृणुष्व मे
verses.transliteration: devadevo 'pi devānām avasthātritayaṃ gataḥ / sāttvikīṃ rājasīṃ rājaṃstāmasīṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva me
verses.translation: The knower of Dhannas who gives a sacred thread at the time of Sraddha and offers water to all Brahmanas attains the fruit of Brahmadana (the gift of Vedic learning).
verses.hindi: अथेकाशीतितमोअध्याय: अत ऊर्ध्व प्रवक््यासि श्राउउकर्मणि पुणितस् । काम्यने सिसिकाजस भ्राउइकर्मणि नित्यशः ३१ पुत्रदा धनमुलाः स्पुरष्टकास्तिस्त्र एबं च्। पूर्पपक्षों बरिष्ठो हि पूर्वा चित्री उदाहता
verses.wordMeaning: The knower of Dhannas who gives a sacred thread at the time of Sraddha and offers water to all Brahmanas attains the fruit of Brahmadana (the gift of Vedic learning).
verses.commentary: Sense: The knower of Dhannas who gives a sacred thread at the time of Sraddha and offers water to all Brahmanas attains the fruit of Brahmadana (the gift of Vedic learning).

verses.sanskrit: एकं योगसमाधिना मुकुलितं चक्षुर्द्वितीयं पुनः पार्वत्या जघनस्थलस्तनतटे शृङ्गारभारालसम् । अन्यद्दूरनिरस्तचापमदनक्रोधानलोद्दीपितं शम्भोर्भिन्नरसं समाधिसमये नेत्रत्रयं पातु वः
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ yogasamādhinā mukulitaṃ cakṣurdvitīyaṃ punaḥ pārvatyā jaghanasthalastanataṭe śṛṅgārabhārālasam / anyaddūranirastacāpamadanakrodhānaloddīpitaṃ śambhorbhinnarasaṃ samādhisamaye netratrayaṃ pātu vaḥ
verses.translation: If anyone offers a good waterpot at the time of Sraddhas to the Brahmanas, a cow exuding honey and milk approaches the donor.

verses.sanskrit: एवं दृष्टः स देवेन सशरः सशरासनः । भस्मीभूतो गतः कामो विनाशः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sa devena saśaraḥ saśarāsanaḥ / bhasmībhūto gataḥ kāmo vināśaḥ sarvadehinām
verses.translation: He who gives a circular waterpot at the time of Sraddha obtains a milk-yielding divine cow that can be milked for whatever he wishes.
verses.hindi: ने इसका सवंदा सत्कार और पूजन किया है। समस्त बेलोक्य का आधिपत्य दान से ही व्यवस्थित है । राजा लोग राज्य प्राप्त करते हैं, निर्धेन लोग उत्तम धन प्राप्त करते हैं, क्षीणायु दीर्घायु प्राप्त करते हैं, पितरों में भक्ति रखनेवाला मनुष्य मन से भी जिन अभिलाषाओं का चित्तन करता है, उनको पितरगण पूर्ण बिशेष तिथियों में श्राद्ध के किये जाने का फल इहस्पति ने कहा--अब इसके बाद मैं नित्य, नमित्तिक और काम्य श्राद्धों का विवरण बतला रहा हूँ, और यह भी बतला रहा हूं कि श्ाइ्धकर्म पुजनतादि किस प्रकार सम्पन्न होते हैं ।१। तीनों अष्टकाएँ पुत्र को देनेवली और घन सम्पत्ति भादि की कारणीभूत हैं। इस श्राद्षकर्म में पूव्वपक्ष अर्थात्:
verses.wordMeaning: He who gives a circular waterpot at the time of Sraddha obtains a milk-yielding divine cow that can be milked for whatever he wishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives a circular waterpot at the time of Sraddha obtains a milk-yielding divine cow that can be milked for whatever he wishes.

verses.sanskrit: कामं दृष्ट्वा क्षयं यातं तत्र देवाप्सरोगणाः । भीता यथागतं सर्वे जग्मुश्चैव दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: kāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣayaṃ yātaṃ tatra devāpsarogaṇāḥ / bhītā yathāgataṃ sarve jagmuścaiva diśo daśa
verses.translation: If anyone gives a complete bed-equipment decorated with garlands of flowers, it becomes a palace and follows him as he goes (to heaven).
verses.hindi: एकाशीतितमोः्ष्यायः छरेरे
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone gives a complete bed-equipment decorated with garlands of flowers, it becomes a palace and follows him as he goes (to heaven).
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone gives a complete bed-equipment decorated with garlands of flowers, it becomes a palace and follows him as he goes (to heaven).

verses.sanskrit: कामेन रहिता लोकाः ससुरासुरमानवाः । ब्रह्माणं शरणं जग्मुर्देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: kāmena rahitā lokāḥ sasurāsuramānavāḥ / brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurdevā indrapurogamāḥ
verses.translation: By giving a house full of gems, furnished with bed, seats and food, at the time of Sraddha to ascetics, one rejoices in heaven.
verses.hindi: प्राजापत्या द्वितीया स्थात्तुतोया वैश्वदेविकी । आद्या पू्पे: सदा कार्या मांसेरनन्‍्या भवेत्सदा 0३ (शाकरन्या तृतोया स्याहैव द्रव्यगवों विधिः । अन्वष्टका पित॒णां वे नित्यमेव विधीयते 8 परत्रेह च सर्वेषु नित्यमेव सुखीभवेत् । पुजकानां सदोत्कर्षो नास्तिकानामधोगतिः १६ पितरः पर्वकालेषु तिथिकालेषु देवता: । सर्वे पुरुषमायान्ति निपानसिव धेनवः ७ मा सम ते प्रतिगच्छेयु रष्टकाः सुरपूजिताः । मोघस्तस्य भबेललोको लब्धं चास्य विनश्यति ८ देवांस्तु दायिनों यान्ति तियंग्गच्छस्त्यदायिनः। प्रा पुष्टि स्वाति मेधां पुत्रानेश्वयंमेव च १६
verses.wordMeaning: By giving a house full of gems, furnished with bed, seats and food, at the time of Sraddha to ascetics, one rejoices in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: By giving a house full of gems, furnished with bed, seats and food, at the time of Sraddha to ascetics, one rejoices in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सीदमानं जगद् दृष्ट्वा तमूचुः परमेष्ठिनम् । जानासि त्वं जगच्छेषं प्रभो मैथुनसम्भवात्
verses.transliteration: sīdamānaṃ jagad dṛṣṭvā tamūcuḥ parameṣṭhinam / jānāsi tvaṃ jagaccheṣaṃ prabho maithunasambhavāt
verses.translation: He obtains pearls, lapis lazuli, garments, varieties of precious stones, divine vehicles, hundred thousands and trillions in number and a divine aerial chariot that dazzles like a great blazing fire, that;has the lustre of the moon and the sun and that is furnished with jewels according to one's desire. The aerial chariot has the speed of the mind and can go anywhere as per his pleasure. It is surrounded by Apsaras-s. He remains at the head of the aerial chariot eulogised by eveyone allround. The Gandharva-s and Apsaras-s sprinkle him with divine scents and showers of flowers. They sing and play on the instruments.
verses.hindi: द्वितीयायां तु यः कुर्याद्द्विपदाधिपतिभंवेत् ।) वराधिनां तृतीया तु शत्रुध्नी पापनाशिनो ११
verses.wordMeaning: He obtains pearls, lapis lazuli, garments, varieties of precious stones, divine vehicles, hundred thousands and trillions in number and a divine aerial chariot that dazzles like a great blazing fire,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He obtains pearls, lapis lazuli, garments, varieties of precious stones, divine vehicles, hundred thousands and trillions in number and a divine aerial chariot that dazzles like a great blazing fire,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रजाः सर्वा विशुष्यन्ति कामेन रहिता विभो
verses.transliteration: prajāḥ sarvā viśuṣyanti kāmena rahitā vibho
verses.translation: by the gilts ol a thousand horses, a hundred chariots and a thousand elephants, a man lives with a Yogint,
verses.hindi: कृष्णपक्ष श्रेष्ठ माना गया हैं। तीनों अष्टक।ओं में प्रथम चित्नरी कही गई है। दूसरी प्राजापत्य भौर तीसरी धैदवदेवी है । इन तीनों में पहिली को पुओं द्वारा, हूंसरी को मांसों द्वारा तथा तीसरी को शाकों द्वारा करना चाहिए । यह इन तीनों अष्टकाओं के लिये पदार्थों का नियम है। पितरों के लिये अन्वष्टका श्राद्ध सर्वत्र करना चाहिए ।२-४॥ यदि कोई अन्य चौथी अष्टका मिले तो उसे भी विधिपूर्वक सम्पन्न करे । बुद्धिमान पुरुष को इन सब अष्टकाओं में सर्व॑स्व व्यय करके भी श्राद्ध करना चाहिए । ऐसा करनेवाला प्राणी इह लोक तथा परलोक--दोनों में सबंदा आनन्द का अनुभव करता है। पूजा आदि करनेवालों की सदा उन्नति होती है और जो नास्तिक विचारवाले होते हैं, उनकी स्बदा अधोगति होती है ।५-६। पितरगण पर्व के अवसरों पर तथा देवगण विशेष-विशेष तिथियों पर श्राद्धादि एवं पूजा आदि करनेवाले पुरुष के पास इस प्रकार उपस्थित
verses.wordMeaning: by the gilts ol a thousand horses, a hundred chariots and a thousand elephants, a man lives with a Yogint,
verses.commentary: Sense: by the gilts ol a thousand horses, a hundred chariots and a thousand elephants, a man lives with a Yogint,

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां देवानां प्रपितामहः । जगाम सहितस् तत्र यत्र देवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā vacasteṣāṃ devānāṃ prapitāmahaḥ / jagāma sahitas tatra yatra devo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He who offers water (and) lamp to Pitrs and Yogins, attains the fruit of the gift of thousands of gold coins.
verses.hindi: होते हैं जँंसे गौएं जलाशय के समीप पाती पीने के लिये आती हैं ।७। वे पितरगण देवताभों द्वारा पूजित इन अष्टकाओं के समीप नहीं जाते । जो व्यक्ति इन अध्टकाओं में पितरों की पूजा आदि नहों करते, उनका यह लोक (जन्म) ध्यर्थ हो जाता है और जो कुछ प्राप्त हुआ रहता है वह नष्ट हो जाता है ।८। जो इन अवसरों पर श्राद्धादि का दान करते हैं वे देवताओं के समीप अर्थात् स्वर्ग लोक को जाते हैं और जो नहीं देते वे तियंक्
verses.wordMeaning: He who offers water (and) lamp to Pitrs and Yogins, attains the fruit of the gift of thousands of gold coins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who offers water (and) lamp to Pitrs and Yogins, attains the fruit of the gift of thousands of gold coins.

verses.sanskrit: अतोषयज्जगन्नाथं सर्वभूतमहेश्वरम् । स्तुतिभिस्तण्डकैः स्तोत्रैर्वेदवेदाङ्गसम्भवैः
verses.transliteration: atoṣayajjagannāthaṃ sarvabhūtamaheśvaram / stutibhistaṇḍakaiḥ stotrairvedavedāṅgasambhavaiḥ
verses.translation: No other gift is more excellent than the gift of life. Hence, by all means protection to life should be given.
verses.hindi: (अधम, पक्षी आदि) योनियों में जाते हैं। उसकी बृद्धि, पुष्टि, स्मरणशक्ति, धारणाशकित, पुत्र पोौनादि, एवं ऐश्वर्य की वृद्धि होती है, जो पूर्णमासी के अवसर पर श्राद्धादि करता है, इस प्रकार वह पूर्ण पर्व का फल भोगता है। इसी प्रकार प्रतिपदा धन सम्पत्ति के लाभ के लिये होती है, एवं करनेवाले की प्राप्त वस्तु नष्ट नहीं होती ।६-१०। द्वितीयातिथि को जो पितरों के उद्देश से भ्राद्धांदि करता है, वह दो पादवालों (मनुष्यों का राजा होता है। उत्तम आर्थ की प्राप्ति के अभिलाषी व्यक्ति के लिये भ्षाद्भादि में तृतीया विहित है, बह तृतीया
verses.wordMeaning: No other gift is more excellent than the gift of life. Hence, by all means protection to life should be given.
verses.commentary: Sense: No other gift is more excellent than the gift of life. Hence, by all means protection to life should be given.

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तुष्टो महादेवो देवानां परमेश्वरः । उवाच मधुरां वाणीं देवान्ब्रह्मपुरोगमान्
verses.transliteration: tatas tuṣṭo mahādevo devānāṃ parameśvaraḥ / uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ devānbrahmapurogamān
verses.translation: At the time of Sraddha, one should give golden vessels having good characteristics. Sweet (divine) juices and bevera¬ ges, good foodstuffs and good fortune approach him.
verses.hindi: घनुश्चिह्नास्तगंतग्रन्थ: ग. पुस्तके नास्ति ...
verses.wordMeaning: At the time of Sraddha, one should give golden vessels having good characteristics. Sweet (divine) juices and bevera¬ ges, good foodstuffs and good fortune approach him.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time of Sraddha, one should give golden vessels having good characteristics. Sweet (divine) juices and bevera¬ ges, good foodstuffs and good fortune approach him.

verses.sanskrit: किं कार्यं कश्च सन्तापः किं वागमनकारणम् । देवतानाम् ऋषीणां च कथ्यतां मम माचिरम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kāryaṃ kaśca santāpaḥ kiṃ vāgamanakāraṇam / devatānām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca kathyatāṃ mama māciram
verses.translation: In the Sraddha rite, one should give a silver or gold vessel. By giving it, the donor gets ample virtue (as reward).
verses.hindi: क्राउ्ड तवस्यां कुर्वाणं ऐश्वर्य काइटक्षितां स्त्रियम् । कुव॑न्दशम्यां तु नरो ब्राह्मीं क्रियमवाप्तुयात् वेद शभ्रिवाउपप्नुयात्सवन्धिणाशभेनसस्तथा । एकादश्यां पर दानसैश्वयं सततं तथा ॥.
verses.wordMeaning: In the Sraddha rite, one should give a silver or gold vessel. By giving it, the donor gets ample virtue (as reward).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Sraddha rite, one should give a silver or gold vessel. By giving it, the donor gets ample virtue (as reward).

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । कामनाशाज्जगन्नाशो भवितायं चराचरे । त्रैलोक्यं त्वं पुनः शम्भो उत्पादयितुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ / kāmanāśājjagannāśo bhavitāyaṃ carācare / trailokyaṃ tvaṃ punaḥ śambho utpādayitum arhasi
verses.translation: He who makes a gift of a cow that has calved but once, along with a milking pot, at the time of a Sraddha, obtains several cows and the nourishment of the cows.
verses.hindi: तथा विषमजातानां यमलानां तु सर्वेशः। अमावास्यां प्रयस्नेन श्रां कुर्याच्छूचि: सदा ११६ सर्वास्का मानवाप्नोति स्वगंमानन्त्यमश्नुते । ऋत॑ दह्यादसावास्यां सोमसाप्यायनं महत् २०
verses.wordMeaning: He who makes a gift of a cow that has calved but once, along with a milking pot, at the time of a Sraddha, obtains several cows and the nourishment of the cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who makes a gift of a cow that has calved but once, along with a milking pot, at the time of a Sraddha, obtains several cows and the nourishment of the cows.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस् तेषां विमृश्य परमेश्वरः । चिन्तयामास कामस्य विग्रहं भुवि दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā vacas teṣāṃ vimṛśya parameśvaraḥ / cintayāmāsa kāmasya vigrahaṃ bhuvi durlabham
verses.translation: He who gives the above-mentioned articles at a Sraddha, attains the benefit of a horse-sacrifice. In ordinary Sraddhas or at the time of Darsa Sraddha, one should give to the Brahmanas of good qualities, vessels full of ghee with.very great respect. He shall attain good memory and fine intellect.
verses.hindi: शत्रुओं का नाथ करनेवाली तथा पापनाशिनी है। जो चतुर्थी तिथि को श्राद्ध करता है वह शत्रुओों का छिल्र देखता है, भर्थात् उसे छात्र की समस्त कट चालों का ज्ञान हो जाता है। पत्यममी तिथि को श्राद्ध करनेवाला उत्तम लक्ष्मी की प्राप्ति करता है ।११-१२। जो षष्ठीतिथि को श्राद्वादि कर्मों को सम्पन्न करते हैं उनकी पूजा प्राप्त करते हैं भऔर गणों के स्वामी होते हैं । जो मनुष्य अष्टमी को श्राद्ध करता है वह सम्पूर्ण समृद्धियाँ प्राप्त करता है। नवमीतिथि को श्राद्ध कर्म करनेवाले को प्रचुर ऐश्वर्य एवं मन के अनुसार चलनेवाली स्त्री की प्राप्ति होती है । दशमी तिथि को श्लवाद्ध करनेवाल। मनुष्य ब्रह्मत्व की लक्ष्मी प्राप्त करता है ।११३-१५। एकादशी तिथि को श्राद्धादि का दान सर्वश्रेष्ठ दात है जो उबत तिथि को न्राद्धादि का दान करता है, वह समस्त वेदों को
verses.wordMeaning: He who gives the above-mentioned articles at a Sraddha, attains the benefit of a horse-sacrifice. In ordinary Sraddhas or at the time of Darsa Sraddha, one should give to the Brahmanas of good qualities, vessels full of ghee with.very great respect.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives the above-mentioned articles at a Sraddha, attains the benefit of a horse-sacrifice. In ordinary Sraddhas or at the time of Darsa Sraddha, one should give to the Brahmanas of good qualities, vessels full of ghee with.very great respect.…

verses.sanskrit: आजगाम ततः शीघ्रम् अनङ्गो ह्यङ्गतां गतः । प्राणदः सर्वभूतानां पश्यतां नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: ājagāma tataḥ śīghram anaṅgo hyaṅgatāṃ gataḥ / prāṇadaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpasattama
verses.translation: He obtains the benefit of many cows yielding potfuls
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करता है, उसके सम्पूर्ण पापकर्मों का विनाश हो जाता है तथा निरन्तर ऐह्वर्य की प्राप्ति होती है। द्वादशीतिथि को श्राद्ध करने से राष्ट्र का कल्याण तथा बअन्नों की प्राप्ति होती कही गई है। त्रयोदशी तिथि को श्राद्धादि कर्म करने से सन्‍्तति, बुद्धि, पशु धारणाशवित, स्वतन्त्रता, उत्तम पुष्टि, दीर्घायु तथा ऐश्वय, की प्राप्ति होती है । जिसके घर के जवान लोग मर गये हों उसे चाहिए कि उन सबों के उद्देश्य से चतुदं शी -
verses.wordMeaning: He obtains the benefit of many cows yielding potfuls
verses.commentary: Sense: He obtains the benefit of many cows yielding potfuls

verses.sanskrit: ततः शङ्खनिनादेन भेरीणां निःस्वनेन च । अभ्यनन्दंस् ततो देवं सुरासुरमहोरगाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaṅkhaninādena bherīṇāṃ niḥsvanena ca / abhyanandaṃs tato devaṃ surāsuramahoragāḥ
verses.translation: By giving the thing wished for, at the time of Sraddha, one gets the benefit of the sacrifice called Pundarlka. By giving a beautiful residential place, one attains the fruit of Rajasuya sacrifice.
verses.hindi: तिथि को श्राद्ध करे । इसी प्रकार हथियारों के द्वारा जिसकी मृत्यु हुई हो, उतके लिये भी चतुर्दशी को श्राद्धकर्म करे ।१६-१८। इसी प्रकार समस्त विषम उत्पन्न होनेवालों (अर्थात् तीन कन्याओं के बाद जो पृत्र उत्पन्न होते हैं, भथवा तीन पुत्रों के बाद जो कम्यायें उत्पन्न होती हैं) तथा जुड़वाँ उत्पन्न होनेवालों के लिये सबंदा पवित्र होकर अमावस्थातिथि को प्रयत्न पूर्वक श्राद्ध करता चाहिए । जो इस प्रकार शक्षाद्वादि कर्म सम्पन्न करते हैं, बे समस्त मनोरथों को प्राप्त करते हैं और अनन्तकाल पर्यन्त स्वर्ग का उपभोग करते हैं। अमावात्या तिथि को ब्राह्मण को भोजन देना चाहिए, चस्द्रमा के लिये भी तपंण करना चांहिये, इसका महान फल होता है
verses.wordMeaning: By giving the thing wished for, at the time of Sraddha, one gets the benefit of the sacrifice called Pundarlka. By giving a beautiful residential place, one attains the fruit of Rajasuya sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: By giving the thing wished for, at the time of Sraddha, one gets the benefit of the sacrifice called Pundarlka. By giving a beautiful residential place, one attains the fruit of Rajasuya sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते देवदेवेश कृतार्थाः सुरसत्तमाः । विसर्जिताः पुनर्जग्मुर् यथागतम् अरिन्दम
verses.transliteration: namaste devadeveśa kṛtārthāḥ surasattamāḥ / visarjitāḥ punarjagmur yathāgatam arindama
verses.translation: By giving a forest full of flowers and fruits, one obtains sweet smelling substances. By giving wells, parks, tanks, fields, cowsheds and houses, one rejoices in heaven as long as the moon and the stars stay. By giving beds and bedsheets embellished with jewels, one attains endless heavenly pleasure. Pitps are pleased with him. He is worshipped (honoured) by kings. He flourishes with wealth and grain.
verses.hindi: एकाशीतितमोड्ष्याये: ७१५
