verses.wordMeaning: By giving a forest full of flowers and fruits, one obtains sweet smelling substances. By giving wells, parks, tanks, fields, cowsheds and houses, one rejoices in heaven as long as the moon and the stars stay. By giving beds and bedsheets embellished with jewels,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By giving a forest full of flowers and fruits, one obtains sweet smelling substances. By giving wells, parks, tanks, fields, cowsheds and houses, one rejoices in heaven as long as the moon and the stars stay. By giving beds and bedsheets embellished with jewels,…

verses.sanskrit: गतेषु सर्वदेवेषु कामदेवो ऽपि भारत । तपश्चचार विपुलं नर्मदातटमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: gateṣu sarvadeveṣu kāmadevo 'pi bhārata / tapaścacāra vipulaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Woollen and silk garments, excellent blankets, deer-skin, gold brocade, coloured cloth and wool—these should be given to Brahmanas after duly feeding them. A person who has faith then gets the benefit of a hundred Vajapeya Yajiias. 1
verses.hindi: एंबमाप्यायितः सोमस्त्रील्लोकान्धारयिष्यति । सिद्धचा रणगन्धर्वे: स्तुयमानस्तु नित्यशः ३२१ स्तवं: पुष्पेम॑नोज्ञेश्न सर्वकामपरिच्छदे: । नुत्यवादि्रगीतेश्व अप्सरोभिः सहखशः उपक्रीडविमानेस्तु पितृभक्त दृढब्नतम् । स्तुबन्ति देवगन्धर्वा: सिद्धसंघाश्व त॑ सदा
verses.wordMeaning: Woollen and silk garments, excellent blankets, deer-skin, gold brocade, coloured cloth and wool—these should be given to Brahmanas after duly feeding them. A person who has faith then gets the benefit of a hundred Vajapeya Yajiias. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Woollen and silk garments, excellent blankets, deer-skin, gold brocade, coloured cloth and wool—these should be given to Brahmanas after duly feeding them. A person who has faith then gets the benefit of a hundred Vajapeya Yajiias. 1

verses.sanskrit: तपोजपकृशीभूतो दिव्यं वर्षशतं किल । महाभूतैर्विघ्नकरैः पीड्यमानः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: tapojapakṛśībhūto divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ kila / mahābhūtairvighnakaraiḥ pīḍyamānaḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Many beautiful women, sons, servants and attendants, nay all living beings, become submissive to him in this world. He becomes free from all ailments.
verses.hindi: पितृभक्तस्त्वमावस्यां सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् । प्रत्यक्षमचितास्तेन भवन्ति पितरः सदा २४ पितृदेवा मधा यस्मात्तस्मात्तास्वक्षय स्मृतम् । पित्यं कुर्व॒न्ति तस्थां तु विशेषेण विचक्षणाः
verses.wordMeaning: Many beautiful women, sons, servants and attendants, nay all living beings, become submissive to him in this world. He becomes free from all ailments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Many beautiful women, sons, servants and attendants, nay all living beings, become submissive to him in this world. He becomes free from all ailments.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मविघ्नविनाशार्थं संस्मृतः कुण्डलेश्वरः । चकार रक्षां सर्वत्र शरपाते नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: ātmavighnavināśārthaṃ saṃsmṛtaḥ kuṇḍaleśvaraḥ / cakāra rakṣāṃ sarvatra śarapāte nṛpottama
verses.translation: He who gives silk, woven silk, cotton and velvet cloth, in Sraddhas obtains the fulfilment of all his cherished desires.
verses.hindi: तस्मान्मघां वे वाउछन्ति पितरो नित्यमेव हि। पितृदेवतभक्ता ये तेईपि यान्ति परां गतिमू इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते श्राउ्धकल्पे तिथिविशेषे श्र (द्धफलवर्णनं नार्मकाशीतितमोअध्यायः ।।७०॥॥।
verses.wordMeaning: He who gives silk, woven silk, cotton and velvet cloth, in Sraddhas obtains the fulfilment of all his cherished desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives silk, woven silk, cotton and velvet cloth, in Sraddhas obtains the fulfilment of all his cherished desires.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो दृढभक्त्या वरप्रदः । वरेण छन्दयामास कामं कामविनाशनः
verses.transliteration: tatastuṣṭo mahādevo dṛḍhabhaktyā varapradaḥ / vareṇa chandayāmāsa kāmaṃ kāmavināśanaḥ
verses.translation: He dispels all inglorious things and misfortunes im¬ mediately like the darkness at the time of sunrise. He shines on an aerial chariot like the moon among stars.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार तपित होकर सोमदेव तीनों लोकों को धारण करेंगे। दुढ़ब्नत परायण, पितरों में भक्ति रखनेवाले व्यकित की सिद्ध, चारण और गस्धर्वगण नित्य स्तुति करते हैं ।२१। उनके साथ सहस्नों अप्सराएं अपने नाच, गान, वाद्य, स्तुति, मनोहर पुष्प निचय एवं सभी श्रकार के अभिलषित वस्त्रादिकों से उसे प्रसन्न करती हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: He dispels all inglorious things and misfortunes im¬ mediately like the darkness at the time of sunrise. He shines on an aerial chariot like the moon among stars.
verses.commentary: Sense: He dispels all inglorious things and misfortunes im¬ mediately like the darkness at the time of sunrise. He shines on an aerial chariot like the moon among stars.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा तुष्टं महादेवमुवाच झषकेतनः । प्रणतः प्राञ्जलिर् भूत्वा देवदेवं त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: jñātvā tuṣṭaṃ mahādevamuvāca jhaṣaketanaḥ / praṇataḥ prāñjalir bhūtvā devadevaṃ trilocanam
verses.translation: A garment is praised by all Devas; garment belongs to all the deities. In the absence af cloth, no holy rite—neither Yajiias nor (study of) Vedas nor penances, can be performed.
verses.hindi: उसकी सेवा में उपस्थित रहते हैं। पितरों में भक्ति रखनेवाला मनुष्य अमावास्था को सभी मनोरथ प्राप्त करता है बयोंकि सबंदा उस तिथि को पितरगण उससे प्रत्यक्षतः पूजा प्राप्त करते हैं ।२२-२४। मघा नक्षत्र पितरों को अभीष्ट सिद्धि देनेवाला है, अतः उक्त नक्षत्र के दिन किया गया श्राद्ध अक्षय कहा जाता है। इसी लिये विवेकशील लोग विशेषतया उसी नक्षत्र में पितरों के श्राद्धादि कर्म सम्पन्न करते हैं। यही कारण है कि पितरगण भी उसे सर्वदा अधिक पसन्द करते हैं। पितरों और देवताओों में जो केवल भव्िति रखते हैं, वेभी परमगति
verses.wordMeaning: A garment is praised by all Devas; garment belongs to all the deities. In the absence af cloth, no holy rite—neither Yajiias nor (study of) Vedas nor penances, can be performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: A garment is praised by all Devas; garment belongs to all the deities. In the absence af cloth, no holy rite—neither Yajiias nor (study of) Vedas nor penances, can be performed.

verses.sanskrit: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम । अत्र तीर्थे जगन्नाथ सदा संनिहितो भव
verses.transliteration: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama / atra tīrthe jagannātha sadā saṃnihito bhava
verses.translation: Hence clothes should be given at the time of Sraddha particularly. He obtains all those things—Yajiias, the Vedas and the penances.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Hence clothes should be given at the time of Sraddha particularly. He obtains all those things—Yajiias, the Vedas and the penances.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence clothes should be given at the time of Sraddha particularly. He obtains all those things—Yajiias, the Vedas and the penances.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति चोक्त्वा वचनं देवदेवो महेश्वरः । जगामाकाशमाविश्य स्तूयमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: tatheti coktvā vacanaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ / jagāmākāśamāviśya stūyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: The promise of the fruit of sacrifices (which require a lot of trouble and expenditure) for dim must have resulted as a disincentive for perfor¬ mance of sacrifice and these Brahmanical advocates of such cheap and easy
verses.hindi: श्री बायुमहापुराण के श्राद्धकल्प में तिथिविशेष सम्बन्धी श्राद्धफल वर्णन नामक ७३६ . बायुपुराणम
verses.wordMeaning: The promise of the fruit of sacrifices (which require a lot of trouble and expenditure) for dim must have resulted as a disincentive for perfor¬ mance of sacrifice and these Brahmanical advocates of such cheap and easy
verses.commentary: Sense: The promise of the fruit of sacrifices (which require a lot of trouble and expenditure) for dim must have resulted as a disincentive for perfor¬ mance of sacrifice and these Brahmanical advocates of such cheap and easy

verses.sanskrit: गते चादर्शनं देवे कामदेवो जगद्गुरुम् । स्थापयामास राजेन्द्र कुसुमेश्वरसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: gate cādarśanaṃ deve kāmadevo jagadgurum / sthāpayāmāsa rājendra kusumeśvarasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: He who always gives them during Sraddhas with faith and purity, obtains all his desires and all realms H f *
verses.hindi: पमस्तु यानि श्राद्धानि प्रोवात शिवबिस्दवे । तानि में शूणु कात्स्स्यंन नक्षत्रेषु पुृथकपूथकू..
verses.wordMeaning: He who always gives them during Sraddhas with faith and purity, obtains all his desires and all realms H f *
verses.commentary: Sense: He who always gives them during Sraddhas with faith and purity, obtains all his desires and all realms H f *

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा ह्युपवासपरायणः । चैत्रमासे चतुर्दश्यां मदनस्य दिने ऽथवा
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā hyupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / caitramāse caturdaśyāṃ madanasya dine 'thavā
verses.translation: By giving cooked rice, milk pudding, ghee, honey, fruits
verses.hindi: श्राउ्ड यः कत्तिकायोगे करोति सततं नरः । अग्नीनाधाय सापत्यो जायते स गतज्बरः २ अपत्यकासो रोहिण्यां सौम्पेनोजस्विता भवेत् । प्रायशः क्ररकर्मा तु चाउ5द्रायां श्राद्धभाचरेतू क्षेत्रभागी भवेत्पुत्री भ्राद्धं कुव॑स्पुनरवंसों। धनधान्यसमाकीर्ण: पुत्रपौत्नसमाकुलः ४ तुष्टिकामः पुनस्तिष्ये श्राउ्ध कुबोत मानवः । आश्लेषासु पित॒नच्य वीरान्पुत्नानवाप्नुयात् ३४ श्रेष्ठों भवति ज्ञातीनां भधासु श्राद्धमाचरन् । फाट्गुनोषु पितनर्च्य सोभाग्य लभते लभते नरः
verses.wordMeaning: By giving cooked rice, milk pudding, ghee, honey, fruits
verses.commentary: Sense: By giving cooked rice, milk pudding, ghee, honey, fruits

verses.sanskrit: प्रभाते विमले प्राप्ते स्नात्वा पूज्य दिवाकरम् । तिलमिश्रेण तोयेन तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: prabhāte vimale prāpte snātvā pūjya divākaram / tilamiśreṇa toyena tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: Beaten rice mixed with sugar and milk is always of everlasting benefit. If Masuradal and Ki-sara (rice cooked with
verses.hindi: प्रधानशोलः सापत्य उत्तरासु करोति यः। स सत्सु मुख्यो भवति हस्ते यस्तपंयेत्पित॒न्
verses.wordMeaning: Beaten rice mixed with sugar and milk is always of everlasting benefit. If Masuradal and Ki-sara (rice cooked with
verses.commentary: Sense: Beaten rice mixed with sugar and milk is always of everlasting benefit. If Masuradal and Ki-sara (rice cooked with

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा स्नानं विधानेन पूजयित्वा च तं नृप । पिण्डनिर्वपणं कुर्यात् तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā snānaṃ vidhānena pūjayitvā ca taṃ nṛpa / piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryāt tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Fried grain-powder, fried rice, pies, cooked horse-gram dishes all mixed with curds-He who gives all these in Sraddha obtains the treasure of Kubera.
verses.hindi: विशेष नक्षत्रों में किये गये श्राद्धों के फरले ग्रेहस्पतिं बोले+विशेष नक्षत्रों में पृथक्-पृथक् श्राद्ध के करने से क्‍या फंल होते हैं--इस
verses.wordMeaning: Fried grain-powder, fried rice, pies, cooked horse-gram dishes all mixed with curds-He who gives all these in Sraddha obtains the treasure of Kubera.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fried grain-powder, fried rice, pies, cooked horse-gram dishes all mixed with curds-He who gives all these in Sraddha obtains the treasure of Kubera.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्रयाजिफलं यच्च लभते द्वादशाब्दिकम् । पिण्डदानात्फलं तच्च लभते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: sattrayājiphalaṃ yacca labhate dvādaśābdikam / piṇḍadānātphalaṃ tacca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The man who offers the most excellent foods and edibles, beverages, lambatives and juicy things, becomes the most excel¬ lent of all.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य सबंदा कृत्तिका नक्षत्र के योग में श्राद्ध करता है, और अग्नि की स्थापना करता है, वह अपनी सन्तततियों समेत चिन्ताओं एवं व्याधियों से मुक्त होंता है।१-२। सन्‍्तान की कामना से रोहिणी में श्राद्ध करना चाहिए । मृगशिरा नक्षत्र में श्राद्ध करने से तेजस्बिता का लाभ होता है। आरर्द्रो में श्राद्धकार्य प्रायः करकर्म करने वाले ही करते हैं। पुनव॑ंसु नक्षत्र में श्राद्ध करनेवाला क्षेत्र का अधिकारी और पुत्रवान् होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: The man who offers the most excellent foods and edibles, beverages, lambatives and juicy things, becomes the most excel¬ lent of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who offers the most excellent foods and edibles, beverages, lambatives and juicy things, becomes the most excel¬ lent of all.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्कुल्लमूले यः पिण्डं पित्ःनुद्दिश्य दापयेत् । तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि तृप्तिं यान्ति पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: aṅkullamūle yaḥ piṇḍaṃ pitḥnuddiśya dāpayet / tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptiṃ yānti pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: The devotee, with palms joined in reverence, should offer the best seat to the guests while feeding. He shall then attain the excellent fruit of all the rites and Yajnas.
verses.hindi: घनवान्यादि से समन्वित तथा पुत्र पोत्रादि से संयुक्त होता हैं ।३-४॥ सन्‍्तोष लाभ की अभिलाषा से मनुष्य को पृष्य नक्षत्र में श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। अश्लेषा में पितरों की पूजा करके मनुष्य वीर पुत्रों का लाभ करता है। मघा में श्राद्ध करनेबाला अपनी जाति में सर्वेश्रेष्ठ होता है। फाल्युनी नक्षत्रों में पितरोंकी पूजा कर मनुष्य सौभाग्य की प्राप्ति करता है ।५-६। उत्तरा नक्षत्रों में श्राद्ध करनेवाले अपने सन्‍्तान समेत समाज का प्रमुख व्यक्ति होता है  जो हस्त नक्षत्र में पितरों की पूजा करता है वह सत्पुरुषों में अग्रगण्य होता है। जो चित्रा
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee, with palms joined in reverence, should offer the best seat to the guests while feeding. He shall then attain the excellent fruit of all the rites and Yajnas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee, with palms joined in reverence, should offer the best seat to the guests while feeding. He shall then attain the excellent fruit of all the rites and Yajnas.

verses.sanskrit: कृमिकीटपतङ्गा ये तत्र तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर । प्राप्नुवन्ति मृताः स्वर्गं किं पुनर्ये नरा मृताः
verses.transliteration: kṛmikīṭapataṅgā ye tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira / prāpnuvanti mṛtāḥ svargaṃ kiṃ punarye narā mṛtāḥ
verses.translation: A dish consisting of sesamum and grain (mixture of rice peas with a few spices)— MW, The person who ofTers food attains an aerial chariot resembling the mid-day sun and fitted with swans for three crores ofKalpas (crores of maidens in Bd. P.).
verses.hindi: आषाढाभिश्रोत्तराभिरवीतशोको भवेज्नर: । श्रवर्णन तु लोकेषु प्राप्नृपात्परमां गतिम् (१११
verses.wordMeaning: A dish consisting of sesamum and grain (mixture of rice peas with a few spices)— MW, The person who ofTers food attains an aerial chariot resembling the mid-day sun and fitted with swans for three crores ofKalpas (crores of maidens in Bd. P.).
verses.commentary: Sense: A dish consisting of sesamum and grain (mixture of rice peas with a few spices)— MW, The person who ofTers food attains an aerial chariot resembling the mid-day sun and fitted with swans for three crores ofKalpas (crores of maidens in Bd. P.).

verses.sanskrit: संन्यासं कुरुते यो ऽत्र जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः । कुसुमेशे नरो भक्त्या स गच्छेच्छिवमन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yo 'tra jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ / kusumeśe naro bhaktyā sa gacchecchivamandiram
verses.translation: There is nothing here greater than the gift of food and they are sustained by it without any doubt.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते नक्षत्रविशेषे श्राद्धफलवर्णनं नाम हचशीतितमोध्ध्याय: ॥5र।। नक्षत्र में श्राद्ध करता है वह रूपवान पुत्रों को देखता (प्राप्त करता) है। जो विद्वान पुरुष स्वाती नक्षत्र में भ्राद्ध करता है, वह लाभ प्राप्त करता है ।७-८। मनुष्य को पुत्र प्राप्ति के लिये विशाखा नक्षत्र में श्राद्ध करने की अभिलाषा करनी चाहिए । अनुराधा में श्राद्ध करनेवाला मनुष्य राज्य का विस्तार करता है। जो सदा ज्येष्ठा नक्षत्र में श्राद्ध करता है वह उत्तम आधिपत्य प्राप्त करता है। मूलनक्षत्र से लोग अरोग्य की इच्छा करते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: There is nothing here greater than the gift of food and they are sustained by it without any doubt.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is nothing here greater than the gift of food and they are sustained by it without any doubt.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दिव्याप्सरोभिश्च देवगन्धर्वगायनैः । क्रीडते सेव्यमानस्तु कल्पकोटिशतं नृप
verses.transliteration: tatra divyāpsarobhiśca devagandharvagāyanaiḥ / krīḍate sevyamānastu kalpakoṭiśataṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: There is no gift nobler than the gift of life. The set of the three worlds lives by means of food. That is the fruit of offering cooked rice. All the worlds are founded (dependent) on food. It is the fruit of the gift of the worlds. Food is Prajapati himself. All these worlds are pervaded by it. Hence a gift on par with that of food has never been before nor will there be any ever in future.
verses.hindi: आषाढ़ा में महान् यश प्राप्त करते हैं, उत्तराषाढ़ नक्षत्र में श्राद्ध करने वाला मनुष्य शोक रहित होता है। श्रवण नक्षत्र में आाद्ध करने से सभी लोकों में परम गति प्राप्त होती है ।९-१ १ धनिष्ठा नक्षत्र में श्राद्ध करनेवाला राज्य और विपुल घन प्राप्त करता है। अभिजित् नक्षत्र में श्राद्ध करनेवाला अंगों समेत समस्त बेदों का अधिकारी होता है । शतभिष् नक्षत्र में श्राद्ध क्रने से सिद्धियाँ प्राप्त होती हैं। पूर्व भाद्रपद में श्वाद्ध करनेबाला
verses.wordMeaning: There is no gift nobler than the gift of life. The set of the three worlds lives by means of food. That is the fruit of offering cooked rice. All the worlds are founded (dependent) on food. It is the fruit of the gift of the worlds. Food is Prajapati himself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no gift nobler than the gift of life. The set of the three worlds lives by means of food. That is the fruit of offering cooked rice. All the worlds are founded (dependent) on food. It is the fruit of the gift of the worlds. Food is Prajapati himself.…

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णे चैव ततः काल इह मानुष्यतां गतः । जायते राजराजेन्द्रैः पूज्यमानो नृपो महान्
verses.transliteration: pūrṇe caiva tataḥ kāla iha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ / jāyate rājarājendraiḥ pūjyamāno nṛpo mahān
verses.translation: A man devoted to Pitrs immediately attains all the jewels, vehicles and women on the earth.
verses.hindi: अजावबिक (?) फल प्राप्त करता है।१२-१३। उत्तरा भाद्रपद में श्राद्ध कर्ता श्राद्ध करने के फलस्वहप सहस्रों गोंएँ प्राप्त करता है। रेवती में श्राद्ध करनेवाला बहुत सा द्रव्य प्राप्त करता है। इसी प्रकार अश्विनी में अश्व कौर भरणी में उत्तम आयु प्राप्त करता है। इस श्राद्ध विधि का विधिवत् पालन कर शशविन्दु ने इस समस्त पृथ्वी को प्राप्त किया था और उसकी प्रत्तशा की थी १४-१५। '  एतदर्धस्थान इदमर्थम् -- कुत्स्तां सलभतोस्‍्कृष्टां लब्ध्वा च प्रशशास तासू ई ति! ह: पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: A man devoted to Pitrs immediately attains all the jewels, vehicles and women on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man devoted to Pitrs immediately attains all the jewels, vehicles and women on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: सुरूपः सुभगो वाग्मी विक्रान्तो मतिमाञ्छुचिः । जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: surūpaḥ subhago vāgmī vikrānto matimāñchuciḥ / jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: One should with palms joined in reverence, always offer- shelter to the guests. They are the Devas awaiting in thousands, for the divine hospitality. He who makes all gifts (mentioned before) shall be the sole emperor on the earth. He shall become happy even if he makes three, two or even one of those gifts.
verses.hindi: छरेद द वायुपुराण॑म्
verses.wordMeaning: One should with palms joined in reverence, always offer- shelter to the guests. They are the Devas awaiting in thousands, for the divine hospitality. He who makes all gifts (mentioned before) shall be the sole emperor on the earth. He shall become happy even if he makes three,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should with palms joined in reverence, always offer- shelter to the guests. They are the Devas awaiting in thousands, for the divine hospitality. He who makes all gifts (mentioned before) shall be the sole emperor on the earth. He shall become happy even if he makes three,…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं तीर्थकोटिशताधिकम् । कुसुमेशेति विख्यातं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ tīrthakoṭiśatādhikam / kusumeśeti vikhyātaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam
verses.translation: Making gifts is the greatest virtue (Dharma). It is honourd and revered by good men. The Lordship of the three worlds is to be attained only through Dana.
verses.hindi: ध्नाद्ध पे ज्निज्ञव्कात्तिव्कसुप्ल्तिस्ताध्यलड्रलय व्विछोष्पगाया धश्ना छ्हा- हवींषि भ्रा्धकाले तु यानि श्राद्धविदो विदुः । तानि मे शुण सर्वाणि फल॑ चेषां यथावलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Making gifts is the greatest virtue (Dharma). It is honourd and revered by good men. The Lordship of the three worlds is to be attained only through Dana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Making gifts is the greatest virtue (Dharma). It is honourd and revered by good men. The Lordship of the three worlds is to be attained only through Dana.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कुसुमेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५१ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । जयवाराहमाहात्म्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kusumeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 151 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: uttare narmadākūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / jayavārāhamāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: A king regains his kingdom; a poor man gets excell¬ ent wealth; a man about to die, attains longevity. Whatever a man devoted to Pitrs desires in his mind, will be granted by his Pitrs.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध में भिन्न भिन्न समय में तृप्ति के साधनभूत विशेष द्रव्य, गया में श्राद्ध के फल तथा ब्राह्मण की परीक्षा आदि
verses.wordMeaning: A king regains his kingdom; a poor man gets excell¬ ent wealth; a man about to die, attains longevity. Whatever a man devoted to Pitrs desires in his mind, will be granted by his Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: A king regains his kingdom; a poor man gets excell¬ ent wealth; a man about to die, attains longevity. Whatever a man devoted to Pitrs desires in his mind, will be granted by his Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृता जगती येन सर्वदेवनमस्कृता । लोकानुग्रहबुद्ध्या च संस्थितो नर्मदातटे
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtā jagatī yena sarvadevanamaskṛtā / lokānugrahabuddhyā ca saṃsthito narmadātaṭe
verses.translation: There are three sets of Asfakas* (the 7th, 8th and 9th days of the dark half of a month) that bring about marriage, birth of a son and acquisition of wealth. The dark half of a month is the most excellent. The first Asfaka is called Citri.
verses.hindi: शंयु ने कहा--हे बोलने वालों में श्रेष्ठ ! कौन-सी वस्तु बितरों को (थोड़े दिनों तक) तृप्ति देने वाली है ? कौनन्‍सी वस्तु चिरकाल तक तृप्ति देती है ? भौर कौन-सी वस्तु अनंत काल तक तृप्ति देती है ?
verses.wordMeaning: There are three sets of Asfakas* (the 7th, 8th and 9th days of the dark half of a month) that bring about marriage, birth of a son and acquisition of wealth. The dark half of a month is the most excellent. The first Asfaka is called Citri.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are three sets of Asfakas* (the 7th, 8th and 9th days of the dark half of a month) that bring about marriage, birth of a son and acquisition of wealth. The dark half of a month is the most excellent. The first Asfaka is called Citri.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा वीक्षते मधुसूदनम् । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो दशजन्मानुकीर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vīkṣate madhusūdanam / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo daśajanmānukīrtanāt
verses.translation: The second Asfaka, shall be Prajapatya (with Prajapati as its deity) and the third one (is) Vaisvadevikl. The first Asfaka shall always be performed with flour cakes. The second should always be performed with meat. The third Asfaka shall be per¬ formed with greens and vegetables. This is the injunction regar¬ ding the articles (for Sraddha ). The Anoasfaka (the ninth day in the dark half of Pausa, Magha and Phalguna) of the Pitrs is also laid down permanently.
verses.hindi: बहस्पति ने कहा--भ्राद्ध के माहात्म्य को जाननेबाले श्राद्धादि में जिन हविष द्वव्यों को उक्त फल-
verses.wordMeaning: The second Asfaka, shall be Prajapatya (with Prajapati as its deity) and the third one (is) Vaisvadevikl. The first Asfaka shall always be performed with flour cakes. The second should always be performed with meat.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The second Asfaka, shall be Prajapatya (with Prajapati as its deity) and the third one (is) Vaisvadevikl. The first Asfaka shall always be performed with flour cakes. The second should always be performed with meat.…

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यः कूर्मो वराहश्च नरसिंहो ऽथ वामनः । रामो रामश्च कृष्णश्च बुद्धः कल्किश्च ते दश
verses.transliteration: matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃho 'tha vāmanaḥ / rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca buddhaḥ kalkiśca te daśa
verses.translation: If there happens to be a fourth As / (ihd 9 a learned person should perform a special Sraddha therein, even by spending his entire possession.
verses.hindi: दायी जानते हैं, उन सब की क्या और कितनी समथ्यं है, इसे मैं विस्तार पूर्थक बलला रहा हूं, सुनिये श्राद्ध में तिल, जो, उड़द, जल, मूल और फलों के दान करने से पितामह (पित्तर) लोग एक मास तक
verses.wordMeaning: If there happens to be a fourth As / (ihd 9 a learned person should perform a special Sraddha therein, even by spending his entire possession.
verses.commentary: Sense: If there happens to be a fourth As / (ihd 9 a learned person should perform a special Sraddha therein, even by spending his entire possession.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: मत्स्येन किं कृतं तात कूर्मेण मुनिसत्तम । वराहेण च किं कर्म नरसिंहेन किं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: matsyena kiṃ kṛtaṃ tāta kūrmeṇa munisattama / varāheṇa ca kiṃ karma narasiṃhena kiṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: The word c Asfaka* is formed from 'asfan*. But according to Vartika 9 on Panini VII. 3.45, it means f a rite with Pitre as deities'. Afualayana Gr. S. II. 4-1 informs that the 8th day in the dark halves of seasons Hemanta and Sisira are Asfakas. As a season consists of two months there are (and should be) four Atfakas. But most other Grhya Sutras differ and regard the 8th day in the dark halves of Margasirsa, Pausa and Magha as Asfaka days. This Purana does not follow As'valayana. Though the above- mentioned Vartika regards Pitrs as the deities on these days, our Puraria regards the first Asfaka as Citri (Aindrl? as in Bd.P.), the second has Prajapati and the third has Visvedevas as the deities and Pitrs are cons¬ picuous by their non mention.
verses.hindi: सन्तुष्ट रहते हैं । मछली से दो मास तक सन्तुष्ट रहते हैं, हरिण के मांस से तीन मास तक तृथ्त रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The word c Asfaka* is formed from 'asfan*. But according to Vartika 9 on Panini VII. 3.45, it means f a rite with Pitre as deities'. Afualayana Gr. S. II. 4-1 informs that the 8th day in the dark halves of seasons Hemanta and Sisira are Asfakas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The word c Asfaka* is formed from 'asfan*. But according to Vartika 9 on Panini VII. 3.45, it means f a rite with Pitre as deities'. Afualayana Gr. S. II. 4-1 informs that the 8th day in the dark halves of seasons Hemanta and Sisira are Asfakas.…

verses.sanskrit: वामनेन च रामेण राघवेण च किं कृतम् । बुद्धरूपेण किं वापि कल्किना किं कृतं वद
verses.transliteration: vāmanena ca rāmeṇa rāghaveṇa ca kiṃ kṛtam / buddharūpeṇa kiṃ vāpi kalkinā kiṃ kṛtaṃ vada
verses.translation: He (the performer of a Sraddha ) shall always be happy both here and hereafter. The worshippers shall attain progress and the non-believers, downfall.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार खरगोश के मास से चार सास और पक्षी के मांस से पाँच मास तक स तुष्ट रहते हैं ।३५४। शूकर के मांस से छः मास, बकरे के मांस से सात मास, ओर पृषत् (सफेद चित्ती बाला एक विशेष मृग) के मांस से
verses.wordMeaning: He (the performer of a Sraddha ) shall always be happy both here and hereafter. The worshippers shall attain progress and the non-believers, downfall.
verses.commentary: Sense: He (the performer of a Sraddha ) shall always be happy both here and hereafter. The worshippers shall attain progress and the non-believers, downfall.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु विप्रेन्द्रो धर्मपुत्रेण धीमता । उवाच मधुरां वाणीं तदा धर्मसुतं प्रति
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu viprendro dharmaputreṇa dhīmatā / uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ tadā dharmasutaṃ prati
verses.translation: Like cows approaching a water-trough, all these Pitps and gods approach the man (who performs a Sraddha)—Pitrs during the Parvan days and deities on different Tithis.
verses.hindi: न धनुदिचिह्ान्तर्गतग्रन्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Like cows approaching a water-trough, all these Pitps and gods approach the man (who performs a Sraddha)—Pitrs during the Parvan days and deities on different Tithis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like cows approaching a water-trough, all these Pitps and gods approach the man (who performs a Sraddha)—Pitrs during the Parvan days and deities on different Tithis.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: मीनो भूत्वा पुरा कल्पे प्रीत्यर्थं ब्रह्मणो विभुः । समर्पयत्समुद्धृत्य वन्दान्मग्नान्महार्णवे
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mīno bhūtvā purā kalpe prītyarthaṃ brahmaṇo vibhuḥ / samarpayatsamuddhṛtya vandānmagnānmahārṇave
verses.translation: Let them not return without being worshipped during Asfakas. The world (worldly life) will be in vain in regard to him (who does not worship). Even what is obtained by him, perishes.
verses.hindi: रोरवेण तु प्रीयन्ते नव सासान्पितामहा: । गवयस्य तु मांसेन तृप्ति: स्थाहशमासिको ६ कूर्मस्य चेव मांसेन सासानेकादशंब तु । आ्राद्धमेवं विजानीयाद्गब्यं संवत्सरं भवत् तथा गव्यससायुक्त पायसं मधुसपिषा । वश्नीणसस्य मांसेन तृप्तिददिशवार्िकी ८ आनन्त्याय भवद्युक्ते खाइमयांसे: पितृक्षये । कृष्णच्छागस्तथा गोधा अनन्त्यायेव कल्प्यते ६ अन्न गाथा: पितृगीताः कीतंयन्ति पुराबविद: । तास्ते5हं संप्रवक््यामि यथावत्संनिबोधत १०
verses.wordMeaning: Let them not return without being worshipped during Asfakas. The world (worldly life) will be in vain in regard to him (who does not worship). Even what is obtained by him, perishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let them not return without being worshipped during Asfakas. The world (worldly life) will be in vain in regard to him (who does not worship). Even what is obtained by him, perishes.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतोत्पादने राजन्कूर्मो भूत्वा जगद्गुरुः । मन्दरं धारयामास तथा देवीं वसुंधराम्
verses.transliteration: amṛtotpādane rājankūrmo bhūtvā jagadguruḥ / mandaraṃ dhārayāmāsa tathā devīṃ vasuṃdharām
verses.translation: Those who offer worship attain Devas. Those who do not offer are reborn as lower animals. A person who performs a Sraddha on the Full Moon day obtains progeny, nourishment, memory, intellect, sons and prosperity. 1 2 3 4 5 6 He enjoys to the full. (The Sraddha performed on) Pralipad (the first day of a fort¬ night) is conducive to the acquisition of wealth. What he has acquired does not perish.
verses.hindi: आजेन सबंलोहेन वर्षासु च मघासु च्। एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा यद्येकोषपि गयां त्रजेत् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Those who offer worship attain Devas. Those who do not offer are reborn as lower animals. A person who performs a Sraddha on the Full Moon day obtains progeny, nourishment, memory, intellect, sons and prosperity. 1 2 3 4 5 6 He enjoys to the full.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who offer worship attain Devas. Those who do not offer are reborn as lower animals. A person who performs a Sraddha on the Full Moon day obtains progeny, nourishment, memory, intellect, sons and prosperity. 1 2 3 4 5 6 He enjoys to the full.…

verses.sanskrit: उज्जहार धरां मग्नां पातालतलवासिनीम् । वाराहं रूपमास्थाय देवदेवो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: ujjahāra dharāṃ magnāṃ pātālatalavāsinīm / vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya devadevo janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: He who performs a Sraddha on the second day of the lunar fortnight, becomes the lord of bipeds. The third day (is to be selected for Sraddha) by one who seeks excellent things, (for) Trtiya (third day) is destructive of sins.
verses.hindi: भाठ मास तक सन्‍्तुष्ठ रहते हैं--ऐसा बतलाया जाता है। रूरू (एक विशेष मृग जाति) के भांस से पितामह गण नव मास तक तृुप्त रहते हैं। गवय के मांस से दस मास की तृप्ति होती है।५-६। कछए के मास से ग्यारह मास की तृप्ति होती है। गोरस से एक बष की तृप्ति होती है। मधु; घृत, दूध में बने हुए व्यंजन तथा अभ्य गोरस से भी एक वर्ष की तृप्ति होती है । वश्नीणस के मांस से जो श्राद्ध किया जाता है, उससे बारह वर्ष तक तक तृप्ति रहती है ।५-5। पितरों के लिये गेडें का माँस श्राद्ध में अनस्त काल तृप्ति करता है। इसी प्रकार काले बकरे तथा गोह का मांस भी अनन्त काल तक तृप्ति करता है।६। अब इसके बाद प्राचीन काल के वृत्तान्तों के जानने वाले पितरों द्वारा गाई हुई साथाओं का जो वर्णन लोग करते हैं, उन्हें आपलोगों से बतला रहा हैं, यथावत् सुनिये । पितरगण ऐसा कहते हैं कि, हमारे वंश में कोई ऐसा सुपुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Sraddha on the second day of the lunar fortnight, becomes the lord of bipeds. The third day (is to be selected for Sraddha) by one who seeks excellent things, (for) Trtiya (third day) is destructive of sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Sraddha on the second day of the lunar fortnight, becomes the lord of bipeds. The third day (is to be selected for Sraddha) by one who seeks excellent things, (for) Trtiya (third day) is destructive of sins.

verses.sanskrit: नरस्यार्द्धतनुं कृत्वा सिंहस्यार्द्धतनुं तथा । हिरण्यकशिपोर्वक्षो विददार नखाङ्कुशैः
verses.transliteration: narasyārddhatanuṃ kṛtvā siṃhasyārddhatanuṃ tathā / hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣo vidadāra nakhāṅkuśaiḥ
verses.translation: Verses JO-19 state the benefit accruing from performance of Sraddha on different Tithis from the 1st to the 15th. Apastamba Dh. S. II. 7.16-22, Mbh. Anuttsana 87, Bd. 3.9-20, BM. 15-21, KP.II. 20.17.22 state the reward a man gets for performance of Sraddha on these Tithis. But there is difference of opinion among these about the benefits. For example, see the comparative table of rewards of Sraddha performance on various Tithis.
verses.hindi: पैदा हो, जो हाथी की छाया में चयोदक्षी तिथि को मधु, घृत, एवं दूध में बताये हुए व्यंजनों तथा अश्नों का दान करे एवं वर्षा ऋतु में विश्ेषतया मघा नक्षत्र में स्वंलोह अज (बकरा) का मांस दे। बहुत पुत्रों की कामना करनी चाहिए, उप्तमें से एक भी गया चला जायेगा, एक भी सुकुमारी गौर वर्ण की कन्या का विवाह कर देगा, अर्थात् कम्यादान कर देगा अथवा एक भी नीले बल का (हम लोगों के उद्देश्य से) त्याब करेगा तो हम
verses.wordMeaning: Verses JO-19 state the benefit accruing from performance of Sraddha on different Tithis from the 1st to the 15th. Apastamba Dh. S. II. 7.16-22, Mbh. Anuttsana 87, Bd. 3.9-20, BM. 15-21, KP.II. 20.17.22 state the reward a man gets for performance of Sraddha on these Tithis.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses JO-19 state the benefit accruing from performance of Sraddha on different Tithis from the 1st to the 15th. Apastamba Dh. S. II. 7.16-22, Mbh. Anuttsana 87, Bd. 3.9-20, BM. 15-21, KP.II. 20.17.22 state the reward a man gets for performance of Sraddha on these Tithis.…

verses.sanskrit: जटी वामनरूपेण स्तूयमानो द्विजोत्तमैः । तद्दिव्यं रूपमास्थाय क्रमित्वा मेदिनीं क्रमैः
verses.transliteration: jaṭī vāmanarūpeṇa stūyamāno dvijottamaiḥ / taddivyaṃ rūpamāsthāya kramitvā medinīṃ kramaiḥ
verses.translation: Acquisition of wealth
verses.hindi: लोगों की मनः कामनाएँ पूर्ण हो जायेगी ।ह०-१२। शंयु ने कह्दा-हें तात  बया आदि तीर्थों का माहत्म्य हम आप से पूछ रहे हैं, बतलाइये, वहाँ पर पितरों के उद्देश्य से जो कुछ कार्य किया जाता है उससे कया पुष्य प्राप्त होता है, उसे हमें भाद्योपाग्त
verses.wordMeaning: Acquisition of wealth
verses.commentary: Sense: Acquisition of wealth

verses.sanskrit: कृतवांश्च बलिं पश्चात् पातालतलवासिनम् । स्थापयित्वा सुरान् सर्वान् गतो विष्णुः स्वकं पुरम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtavāṃśca baliṃ paścāt pātālatalavāsinam / sthāpayitvā surān sarvān gato viṣṇuḥ svakaṃ puram
verses.translation: Lordship over bipeds
verses.hindi: इृदमर्थ तास्ति घ. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Lordship over bipeds
verses.commentary: Sense: Lordship over bipeds

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निसुतो रामो भूत्वा शस्त्रभृतां वरः । क्षत्रियान् पृथिवीपालान् अवधीद्धैहयादिकान्
verses.transliteration: jamadagnisuto rāmo bhūtvā śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / kṣatriyān pṛthivīpālān avadhīddhaihayādikān
verses.translation: Destroys sins
verses.hindi: ७४० द वायुपुराणम् (+अब्दमध्ये गयाआ्रा््ध यः करोति च मानव: । सर्वास्कामान्स लभते स्वर्गलोके सहीयते.
verses.wordMeaning: Destroys sins
verses.commentary: Sense: Destroys sins

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपाय महीं दत्त्वा सपर्वतवनाकराम् । तपस्तपति देवेशो महेन्द्रे ऽद्यापि भारत
verses.transliteration: kaśyapāya mahīṃ dattvā saparvatavanākarām / tapastapati deveśo mahendre 'dyāpi bhārata
verses.translation: Discovers weak points of his enemies
verses.hindi: यदि पुत्रो गयां गच्छ च्छाडं कुर्यादतन्द्रित: । कामान्स लभते दिव्यास्पोक्षोपायं च विन्दति
verses.wordMeaning: Discovers weak points of his enemies
verses.commentary: Sense: Discovers weak points of his enemies

verses.sanskrit: ततो दाशरथी रामो रावणं देवकण्टकम् । सगणं समरे हत्वा राज्यं दत्त्वा विभीषणे
verses.transliteration: tato dāśarathī rāmo rāvaṇaṃ devakaṇṭakam / sagaṇaṃ samare hatvā rājyaṃ dattvā vibhīṣaṇe
verses.translation: Attains prosperity and glory
verses.hindi: केशश्मश्रुनखादीनां वपन न प्रशस्यते । अतो न कार्य बन श्राद्धार्थी ना गयासदा (१) ८ ब्रह्मकुण्डे प्रभासे च ब्रह्मवेच्यां तथैव च। प्रेतपर्व॑तमासाथ श्राद्ध कुर्याद्रिधानतः
verses.wordMeaning: Attains prosperity and glory
verses.commentary: Sense: Attains prosperity and glory

verses.sanskrit: पालयित्वा नयाद्भूमिं मखैः संतर्प्य देवताः । स्वर्गं गतो महातेजा रामो राजीवलोचनः
verses.transliteration: pālayitvā nayādbhūmiṃ makhaiḥ saṃtarpya devatāḥ / svargaṃ gato mahātejā rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ
verses.translation: Reverence from Brahmanas
verses.hindi: उत्तरे मानसे चेव यत्र मैनाकसंज्ञकाः । उदीच्यां कनखले चेब दक्षिणे मानसे तथा ३२१ स्नात्वा छृत्वा तथा भ्राद्धं पितुलोके समुद्ध रेत् । स्वर्गपातालमरत्येषु नास्ति तीर्थंसम भुवि १२२ तेषु भ्राउ्ध प्रकुर्वोत यदीच्छेत्परमां गतिम् । धर्मारिष्यं ततो गच्छेदादं दृष्ट्वा गदाधरम् २३
verses.wordMeaning: Reverence from Brahmanas
verses.commentary: Sense: Reverence from Brahmanas

verses.sanskrit: वसुदेवगृहे भूयः संकर्षणसहायवान् । अवतीर्णो जगन्नाथो वासुदेवो युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: vasudevagṛhe bhūyaḥ saṃkarṣaṇasahāyavān / avatīrṇo jagannātho vāsudevo yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: He who performs a Sraddha on Caturthi (fourth day) finds the weak points of his enemies. A performer of a Sraddha on the fifth day attains great prosperity and glory.
verses.hindi: बहस्पति ने कहा--जो मनुष्य साल भर में गया जाकर श्राद्ध करता है, वह अपनी समस्त कामनाओं को प्राप्त करता है और स्वर्गलोक में पूजित होता हैं।१४। यदि पुत्र गया की यात्रा करता है, और वहाँ पर सावधानी से श्राद्ध करता है, वह समस्त मनोरथों को सुन्दर रूप में प्राप्त करता है भौर मोक्ष के उपायों को प्राप्त करता है। गया जाने के लिये उद्यत होकर सर्वे प्रथम विधिपुवक श्राद्ध कर काषायवस्त्र धारण कर अपने ग्राम की भी प्रदक्षिणा करनी चाहिए ।१५-१६। तदनन्तर दूसरे ग्राम में जाकर श्राद्ध से शेष बचे हुए का भोजन करे. प्रदक्षिणा कर बिना किसी का दान आदि लिए गमन करे  गया की यात्रा में केश, दाढ़ी मंछ आदि का मुण्डन प्रशंसनीय नहीं कहा-गया है, अतएक श्राद्ध करनेवाले को चाहिए कि वहा गया यात्रा के समय मुण्डन न कराये ।१७-१८। मनुष्य को चाहिए कि गया श्राद्ध के लिये कभी कंजसी न करे, कजसी करने पर
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Sraddha on Caturthi (fourth day) finds the weak points of his enemies. A performer of a Sraddha on the fifth day attains great prosperity and glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Sraddha on Caturthi (fourth day) finds the weak points of his enemies. A performer of a Sraddha on the fifth day attains great prosperity and glory.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽवधीत्तव सामर्थ्याद्वधार्थं दुष्टभूभृताम् । चाणूरकंसकेशीनां जरासंधस्य भारत
verses.transliteration: so 'vadhīttava sāmarthyādvadhārthaṃ duṣṭabhūbhṛtām / cāṇūrakaṃsakeśīnāṃ jarāsaṃdhasya bhārata
verses.translation: Brahmanas revere him who performs a Sraddha on the sixth day. The man who performs a Sraddha on the seventh day regularly attains the fruit of Mahdsalra (great Soma sacri¬ fice). He becomes the lord of Ganas (followers of Siva). The man who performs a Sraddha on the eighth day attains complete prosperity.
verses.hindi: तीथे यात्रा का वास्तविक फल नहीं मिलता । ब्रह्मकुण्ड, प्रभात, ब्रद्यवेदी, और प्रेतपबत पर विधिपू्वंक श्राद्ध करना चाहिए ।१९-२०। उत्तर मानस तीर्थ में भी श्राद्ध करना चाहिए, जहाँ मैनाक पर॑तों को श्रेणियाँ हैं। उत्तर दिशा में कमखल तथा दक्षिण दिल्या में मानस स्थान पर स्तान कर श्राद्ध करने से पितरों का उद्धार हो जाता है । स्व लोक, पाताल लोक तथा मत्यंत्रोक में इन तीयों के समान कोई दूसरा नहीं है।२१-३२। यदि श्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmanas revere him who performs a Sraddha on the sixth day. The man who performs a Sraddha on the seventh day regularly attains the fruit of Mahdsalra (great Soma sacri¬ fice). He becomes the lord of Ganas (followers of Siva).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmanas revere him who performs a Sraddha on the sixth day. The man who performs a Sraddha on the seventh day regularly attains the fruit of Mahdsalra (great Soma sacri¬ fice). He becomes the lord of Ganas (followers of Siva).…

verses.sanskrit: तेन त्वं सुसहायेन हत्वा शत्रून्नरेश्वर । भोक्ष्यसे पृथिवीं सर्वां भ्रातृभिः सह संभृताम्
verses.transliteration: tena tvaṃ susahāyena hatvā śatrūnnareśvara / bhokṣyase pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha saṃbhṛtām
verses.translation: He who performs a Sraddha on the ninth day, attains prosperity and a beloved wife. He who performs a Sraddha on the tenth day, attains the glory of Brahman-hood.
verses.hindi: गति प्राप्त करते की इच्छा है, तो इन तीथथों में श्राद्ध करना चाहिए । सर्वप्रथम गदाधर का दर्शन कर धर्मारिण्य + अव्दमध्य.. इत्यारभ्यः दद्याद्विचक्षण इत्यस्तग्रत्थ ख, पृश््तके बर्ततेउत्रेव स्थले गयामाहात्म्यमीप
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Sraddha on the ninth day, attains prosperity and a beloved wife. He who performs a Sraddha on the tenth day, attains the glory of Brahman-hood.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Sraddha on the ninth day, attains prosperity and a beloved wife. He who performs a Sraddha on the tenth day, attains the glory of Brahman-hood.

verses.sanskrit: तथा बुद्धत्वमपरं नवमं प्राप्स्यते ऽच्युतः । शान्तिमान्देवदेवेशो मधुहन्ता मधुप्रियः
verses.transliteration: tathā buddhatvamaparaṃ navamaṃ prāpsyate 'cyutaḥ / śāntimāndevadeveśo madhuhantā madhupriyaḥ
verses.translation: He shall attain (mastery over) all the Vedas and the destruction of sins. The Dana (religious gift) offered on the ele¬ venth day yields prosperity for ever.
verses.hindi: मतडु स पुनदूं ष्ट्वा बुद्धा नारायण तथा। श्राद्ध कृत्वा विधानेन कुलकोटीः समुद्धशेतू.
verses.wordMeaning: He shall attain (mastery over) all the Vedas and the destruction of sins. The Dana (religious gift) offered on the ele¬ venth day yields prosperity for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall attain (mastery over) all the Vedas and the destruction of sins. The Dana (religious gift) offered on the ele¬ venth day yields prosperity for ever.

verses.sanskrit: तेन बुद्धस्वरूपेण देवेन परमेष्ठिना । भविष्यति जगत्सर्वं मोहितं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: tena buddhasvarūpeṇa devena parameṣṭhinā / bhaviṣyati jagatsarvaṃ mohitaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: They say that he who performs a Sraddha on the twelfth day acquires wealth, a kingdom and becomes victorious. He who performs a Sraddha on the thirteenth day attains progeny, intellect, cattle, wisdom, freedom, excellent nourishment, long life and prosperity.
verses.hindi: यदि पुत्रों गयां गच्छेत्कदाचित्कालपयंयात् । तानेव भोजयेद्विप्रास्ब्राह्मणा ये प्रकल्पिता: अमानुषतया विप्रा ब्राह्मणा ये प्रकल्पिताः । तेषु तुष्देषु संतुष्टा: पितृभिः सह देवता: १२६
verses.wordMeaning: They say that he who performs a Sraddha on the twelfth day acquires wealth, a kingdom and becomes victorious. He who performs a Sraddha on the thirteenth day attains progeny, intellect, cattle, wisdom, freedom, excellent nourishment, long life and prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that he who performs a Sraddha on the twelfth day acquires wealth, a kingdom and becomes victorious. He who performs a Sraddha on the thirteenth day attains progeny, intellect, cattle, wisdom, freedom, excellent nourishment, long life and prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: न श्रोष्यन्ति पितुः पुत्रास्तदाप्रभृति भारत । न गुरोर्बान्धवाः शिष्या भविष्यत्यधरोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: na śroṣyanti pituḥ putrāstadāprabhṛti bhārata / na gurorbāndhavāḥ śiṣyā bhaviṣyatyadharottaram
verses.translation: One shall offer a Sraddha on the fourteenth day to those young men of the house who have met premature death and to those who have been killed by weapons.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रवतंयेच्छाडं यथाशक्तिबलाबलम् । का सान्स लभते दिब्यान्मोक्षोपायं च विदन्ति
verses.wordMeaning: One shall offer a Sraddha on the fourteenth day to those young men of the house who have met premature death and to those who have been killed by weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall offer a Sraddha on the fourteenth day to those young men of the house who have met premature death and to those who have been killed by weapons.

verses.sanskrit: जितो धर्मो ह्यधर्मेण चासत्येन ऋतं जितम् । जिताश्चौरैश्च राजानः स्त्रीभिश्च पुरुषा जिताः
verses.transliteration: jito dharmo hyadharmeṇa cāsatyena ṛtaṃ jitam / jitāścauraiśca rājānaḥ strībhiśca puruṣā jitāḥ
verses.translation: With purity one should always offer a Sraddha on the New Moon day to those children unfavourably born (e.g. a son after three daughters or a daughter after three sons) as well as to twin children.
verses.hindi: सवर्णा जातयो मिन्रा बान्धवाः सुहृदश्य ये । तेम्यो भूप गयाकूपे पिण्डा देवा विधानतः २६ ते४पि यान्ति दिव॑ सबें पिण्डदा इति नः श्रुतम् । अज्ञातनामगोत्राणां मन्त्र एव प्रकीतितः . ये में कुले लुप्तपिण्डा: पुत्रदारविवर्जिता: । विरूपा आमगर्भाश्च ज्ञाताज्ञाता: कुले मम १३२
verses.wordMeaning: With purity one should always offer a Sraddha on the New Moon day to those children unfavourably born (e.g. a son after three daughters or a daughter after three sons) as well as to twin children.
verses.commentary: Sense: With purity one should always offer a Sraddha on the New Moon day to those children unfavourably born (e.g. a son after three daughters or a daughter after three sons) as well as to twin children.

verses.sanskrit: सीदन्ति चाग्निहोत्राणि गुरौ पूजा प्रणश्यति । सीदन्ति मानवा धर्माः कलौ प्राप्ते युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: sīdanti cāgnihotrāṇi gurau pūjā praṇaśyati / sīdanti mānavā dharmāḥ kalau prāpte yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: One who regularly performs a Sraddha attains all cheris¬ hed desires and infinite heavenly pleasures. One shall always perform on the New Moon day the rituals and those great rites that involve extraction of Soma Juice (or that are conducive to the development of the Moon (?) ) Thus developed, the Moon sustains the three worlds, being regularly eulogised by Siddhas, Caranas and Gand- harvas.
verses.hindi: की यात्रा करनी चाहिए । मतंग में पुन: गदाघर का दंत कर नारायण का स्मरण करना चाहिए  वहाँ पर विधि पूर्वक श्राद्ध करके कोटि कुलों का उद्धार किया जाता है ।२३-२४। यदि कालक्रमानुसार पृश्र गया की यात्रा करता है तो उसे उन्हीं ब्राह्मणों को भोजन कराना चाहिए जिनके विषय में पहिले ही से विचार किया गया हो । श्राद्ध के अवसर पर नियुक्त किये जाने के लिये जिन ब्राह्मणों के विषय में विचार किया जाता है, उन्हें मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: One who regularly performs a Sraddha attains all cheris¬ hed desires and infinite heavenly pleasures.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One who regularly performs a Sraddha attains all cheris¬ hed desires and infinite heavenly pleasures.…

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशे दशमे वर्षे नारी गर्भवती भवेत् । कन्यास्तत्र प्रसूयन्ते ब्राह्मणो हरिपिङ्गलः
verses.transliteration: dvādaśe daśame varṣe nārī garbhavatī bhavet / kanyāstatra prasūyante brāhmaṇo haripiṅgalaḥ
verses.translation: (The Moon) is eulogised by thousands of Apsaras-s danc¬ ing, singing and playing on instruments, by means of eulogies, flowers of great beauty and all the requisites for the fulfilment of desires.
verses.hindi: रूप में नहीं जानना चाहिए। उनके सन्तुष्ट होने पर पितरों के साथ देवगण भी सन्तुष्ट हो जाते है ।२५-२६। हे राजेद् ! श्राद्ध में नियुवत होनेवाले उन्त ब्राह्मणों के कुल शील, विद्या अथवा तपस्था का विचार नहीं करना चाहिए, उनके सुपूजित होने पर मनुष्य मुक्ति प्राप्त करता है ।२७। अपनी सामथ्य॑ एवं बलाबल का विचार कर श्राद्ध का अनुष्ठान करना चाहिए  जो; ऐसा करता है, वह अपने समस्त मनोरधों को प्राप्त करता है! और मोक्ष के साधनों को हस्तगत करता है। है राजन । गयाक॒प में अपने वर्ण के, जाति के, मित्र, परिवार वर्ग एवं सुहृदू, जो भी हों सब के लिए विधिपूर्वकं पिण्डदान करता चाहिए । इनको पिण्डदान करनेवाले सभी लोग स्वर्ग जाते हैं--ऐसा हमने सुना हैं। जिन लोगों के नाम अथवा गोत्र ज्ञात नहीं हैं, उनका मन्त्र इस प्रकार है ।२८-३०। “हमारे पिता के वंश में समुत्पन्न, हमारी माता के वंश में, हमारे गुर, श्वसुर सब उनके
verses.wordMeaning: (The Moon) is eulogised by thousands of Apsaras-s danc¬ ing, singing and playing on instruments, by means of eulogies, flowers of great beauty and all the requisites for the fulfilment of desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Moon) is eulogised by thousands of Apsaras-s danc¬ ing, singing and playing on instruments, by means of eulogies, flowers of great beauty and all the requisites for the fulfilment of desires.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यति ततः कल्किर्दशमे जन्मनि प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyati tataḥ kalkirdaśame janmani prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Devas and Gandharvas and the groups of Siddhas eulogise that devotee of thePi/w, steady in his holy rites. They serve him by means of aerial, chariots for sport. The devotee of Pitrs shall attain all cherished desires on the' Amavasya (New Moon) day, for Pitrs are worshipped by him directly always.
verses.hindi: भाई विरादरी तथा अन्यान्य जो वान्धववर्ग हों, मेरे कुल में जिनकी पिंड प्राप्त करने की आशा नष्ट हो गई हो, जो पुत्र स्त्री आदि से विवर्जित थे, हमारे कूल में जों ज्ञात अथवा भज्ञात रुप में उत्पन्न हुए थे, विरूप थे, रुप्ण थे, जिनकी सत्क्रियाएँ लुप्त हो गई थीं, अर्थात् दुराचारी थे, अथवा गर्भावस्‍था में ही जिनका विनाश हो गया हो, उन सबों के उद्देश से दिया गया यह पिण्ड अक्षय तृप्ति प्रदान करे”
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Gandharvas and the groups of Siddhas eulogise that devotee of thePi/w, steady in his holy rites. They serve him by means of aerial, chariots for sport. The devotee of Pitrs shall attain all cherished desires on the' Amavasya (New Moon) day,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Gandharvas and the groups of Siddhas eulogise that devotee of thePi/w, steady in his holy rites. They serve him by means of aerial, chariots for sport. The devotee of Pitrs shall attain all cherished desires on the' Amavasya (New Moon) day,…

verses.sanskrit: एतत् ते कथितं राजन्देवस्य परमेष्ठिनः । कारणं दश जन्मनां सर्वपापक्षयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: etat te kathitaṃ rājandevasya parameṣṭhinaḥ / kāraṇaṃ daśa janmanāṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: The constellation Magha has Pitrs for its deities Hence a Sraddha on that day yields everlasting benefit. The wise per¬ form the rites for Pitfs particularly on that day.
verses.hindi: हे परम बुद्धिमान् ! बया क्षेत्र में (!) तिल के बिना अपना (?) पिण्डदान करता चाहिए । अन्यास्थ अपने ७४२ द वायुपुराणन्
verses.wordMeaning: The constellation Magha has Pitrs for its deities Hence a Sraddha on that day yields everlasting benefit. The wise per¬ form the rites for Pitfs particularly on that day.
verses.commentary: Sense: The constellation Magha has Pitrs for its deities Hence a Sraddha on that day yields everlasting benefit. The wise per¬ form the rites for Pitfs particularly on that day.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्वेतवाराहतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५२ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेद् धरापाल भार्गलेश्वरम् उत्तमम् । शङ्करं जगतः प्राणं स्मृतमात्राघनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śvetavārāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 152 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacched dharāpāla bhārgaleśvaram uttamam / śaṅkaraṃ jagataḥ prāṇaṃ smṛtamātrāghanāśanam
verses.translation: Hence the Pitrs always desire Magha. Those who are devoted to Pitrs and deities attain the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: त्रिदिबं यान्ति ते सर्दे पिण्डदा इति च श्रुति: । ब्रह्महां च कृतध्नश्च महापातकिनश्र ये
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the Pitrs always desire Magha. Those who are devoted to Pitrs and deities attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the Pitrs always desire Magha. Those who are devoted to Pitrs and deities attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम् । अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: Listen to a detailed account of all those Sraddhas which Yama mentioned to Sasabindu. They are to be performed under different constellations severally. 2
verses.hindi: ते सर्वे निष्कृति यानिति गयायां पिण्डपातनातु। ब्रह्मध्नस्य सुरापस्य बालब॒द्धगुरुद्र हः नाशमायाति वे पापं गयायामनुयाति यः । यनज्ञास्ता पातयेत्पिण्ड त॑ नयेद्रत्रहय शाश्वतम् ३८
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to a detailed account of all those Sraddhas which Yama mentioned to Sasabindu. They are to be performed under different constellations severally. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to a detailed account of all those Sraddhas which Yama mentioned to Sasabindu. They are to be performed under different constellations severally. 2

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित् प्राणत्यागं करिष्यति । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य रुद्रलोकादसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścit prāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyati / anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam
verses.translation: He who maintains the sacrificial fires for ever and per¬ forms a Sraddha (when the Moon is) in conjuction with the Krttika constellation, becomes free from worries and ailments along with his children.
verses.hindi: दुलंभं त्रिषु लोकेषु नास्ति तीर्थ गयासममन् । नरकस्था दिव॑ यान्ति स्वर्गंस्था मोक्षसाप्नुयु:ः
verses.wordMeaning: He who maintains the sacrificial fires for ever and per¬ forms a Sraddha (when the Moon is) in conjuction with the Krttika constellation, becomes free from worries and ailments along with his children.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who maintains the sacrificial fires for ever and per¬ forms a Sraddha (when the Moon is) in conjuction with the Krttika constellation, becomes free from worries and ailments along with his children.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भार्गलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५३ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्यैवानन्तरं चान्यद्रवितीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यस्य संदर्शनादेव मुच्यन्ते पातकैर्नराः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhārgaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 153 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ cānyadravitīrthamanuttamam / yasya saṃdarśanādeva mucyante pātakairnarāḥ
verses.translation: A person desirous of children should perform a Sraddha under Rohini.By performing a Sraddhaundcr theSaumya (Mrga-
verses.hindi: मकरे वतंमाने तु ग्रहणे चन्द्रसुर्ययो: । प्रेतपक्षे च चेत्रे च दुर्लभ पिण्डपातनम् ३४ १ अधिमासे जन्मदिने चास्ते च॒ गुरुशुक्रयो: । न त्यक्तव्यं गयाश्राद्ध सिहस्थे च ब्ृहस्पतों ॥ द गयायां सर्वकालेषु पिण्ड दद्याद्विचक्षणः) ४२
verses.wordMeaning: A person desirous of children should perform a Sraddha under Rohini.By performing a Sraddhaundcr theSaumya (Mrga-
verses.commentary: Sense: A person desirous of children should perform a Sraddha under Rohini.By performing a Sraddhaundcr theSaumya (Mrga-

verses.sanskrit: रवितीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा नरः पश्यति भास्करम् । तस्य यत्फलमुद्दिष्टं स्वयं देवेन तच्छृणु
verses.transliteration: ravitīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā naraḥ paśyati bhāskaram / tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ svayaṃ devena tacchṛṇu
verses.translation: This chapter is incorporated from Mbh. AnuSasana 89.
verses.hindi: गोत्र में उत्पन्न होने वाले जो हों, उनके लिए भी यही विधान है। पुत्रों, कन्‍्याओं एबं इष्टमित्रों सब के लिए सावधान होकर बुडद्धिमान् पुरुष को प्रयत्नपूवंक पिण्डददान करना चाहिए ।३४-३५। वे सभी पिण्डदाल करने वाले स्व लोक प्राप्त करते हैं ऐसा युता जाता है। ब्रह्म हत्या करने वाले, कृतघ्त एवं महाव पाप कर्म करने वाले, जो लोग हैं वे सब भी गया में पिण्डदान करने से निस्तार पा जाते हैं। ब्रह्म हत्या करने
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter is incorporated from Mbh. AnuSasana 89.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter is incorporated from Mbh. AnuSasana 89.

verses.sanskrit: नान्धो न मूको बधिरः कुले भवति कश्चन । कुरूपः कुनखी वापि तस्य जन्मानि षोडश
verses.transliteration: nāndho na mūko badhiraḥ kule bhavati kaścana / kurūpaḥ kunakhī vāpi tasya janmāni ṣoḍaśa
verses.translation: Vi§nu Dh.S. (78.8-15) mentions the rewards obtained by performing iriddha under different constellations from Krttika to Bhararu. Yajnavalkya I. 265-268, MK. 8-16, BM. 33-42, KP.II. 20.9-15, Bd.P..2.3.18 deal with the same topic though there is some disagreement about the benefits promised.
verses.hindi: वाले, मदिरा पान करने वाले, बालक, वृद्ध एवं गुरु से द्वोह करने वाले, इन सबों के भी पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं, यदि वे गया की यात्रा करे । जिसका नाम लेकर पिण्डदान किया जाता है, वह शाइवत ब्रह्म पद की प्राप्ति करता है ।३६०३२०। तीनों लोफों में गया के समान दुलंभ तीथ कोई नहीं है। उप्तके प्रभाव से नरक में रहने वाले स्वर्ग जाते हैं और स्वर्ग” में रहने वाल्ले मोक्ष को प्राप्त करते हैं ।३६। मनुष्य अपने मन में यह शुभ कल्पना करते रहते हैं कि हमारे कुल में भी ऐसे सम्मार्गगामी पुत्र उत्पन्न होंगे, जो गया की मात्रा कर आदरपुवंक हमें पिण्डदान करेंगे!। मकर राशि में सूर्य के होने पर, चर्द्ग्रहूण और सूरयंप्रहण के अवसर पर, पितृपक्ष में, और चंत्र मास में पिण्डदान दुले भ है, अर्थात् इन अवसरों पर गया में पिण्डदान का महान् फल है। अधिक मास में, जन्मदिन में, गुद ओर शुक्र के अस्त होने पर; पिंह राह्षि में बृहस्पति के आने पर
verses.wordMeaning: Vi§nu Dh.S. (78.8-15) mentions the rewards obtained by performing iriddha under different constellations from Krttika to Bhararu. Yajnavalkya I. 265-268, MK. 8-16, BM. 33-42, KP.II. 20.9-15,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vi§nu Dh.S. (78.8-15) mentions the rewards obtained by performing iriddha under different constellations from Krttika to Bhararu. Yajnavalkya I. 265-268, MK. 8-16, BM. 33-42, KP.II. 20.9-15,…

verses.sanskrit: दद्रुचित्रककुष्ठानि मण्डलानि विचर्चिका । नश्यन्ति देवभक्तस्य षण्मासान्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: dadrucitrakakuṣṭhāni maṇḍalāni vicarcikā / naśyanti devabhaktasya ṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: One performing a Sraddha under the Punarvasu conste¬ llation becomes the possessor of fields and begets sons. He will be blessed with wealth and food-grains as well as sons and grand¬ sons. A man who desires satisfaction and contentment should perform Sraddha under Pusya constellation. One shall attain heroic sons by worshipping Pitfs under Aglesa.
verses.hindi: गया का श्राद्ध न छोड़ना चाहिए। बुद्धिमान लोग तो सर्वदा गया में पिण्डदान करते हैं ।४०-४२॥ है पुत्र  गया तो में पितरों की निधनतिथि के अवसर पर श्राद्ध का अक्षय फल होता है, जप, हवन एवं तप का भी अक्षयफल कहा जाता है। गोरी पत्नी में समुत्पन्ष पुत्र इक्‍्कीस पीढ़ी को पवित्र करता है। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: One performing a Sraddha under the Punarvasu conste¬ llation becomes the possessor of fields and begets sons. He will be blessed with wealth and food-grains as well as sons and grand¬ sons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One performing a Sraddha under the Punarvasu conste¬ llation becomes the possessor of fields and begets sons. He will be blessed with wealth and food-grains as well as sons and grand¬ sons.…

verses.sanskrit: चरितं तस्य देवस्य पुराणे यच्छ्रुतं मया । न तत्कथयितुं शक्यं संक्षेपेण नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: caritaṃ tasya devasya purāṇe yacchrutaṃ mayā / na tatkathayituṃ śakyaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa nṛpottama
verses.translation: He who performs a Sraddha under Magha becomes the most excellent among his kinsmen. A man worshipping Pitrs in the (Purva) Phalgunl constellation attains good fortune.
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिन्नास्तगंतग्रन्थः ख. पुस्तके नास्ति ।. पुनीयादेकाविशं तु गौर्यामुत्पादितः सुत: । माताहांस्तु षड्भुय इति तस्य फल स्मृतम् ४४
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Sraddha under Magha becomes the most excellent among his kinsmen. A man worshipping Pitrs in the (Purva) Phalgunl constellation attains good fortune.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Sraddha under Magha becomes the most excellent among his kinsmen. A man worshipping Pitrs in the (Purva) Phalgunl constellation attains good fortune.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यद्दानं रविमुद्दिश्य दीयते । विधिना पात्रविप्राय तस्यान्तो नास्ति कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaddānaṃ ravimuddiśya dīyate / vidhinā pātraviprāya tasyānto nāsti karhicit
verses.translation: He who performs a Srdddha under Uttaraphalguni
verses.hindi: ( » सहन्ननल्वमात्रेण तडाकेन यथा श्रुति: । तृप्तिस्तृप्ति: पितृणां वे सद्वृषस्थाधिकोच्यते ४६ यो ददाति गुडेमिश्रांस्तिलास्वे श्राद्धकर्म णि । मधुना मधुभिश्षान्वा अक्षय सबबंसेब तत् ५०
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Srdddha under Uttaraphalguni
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Srdddha under Uttaraphalguni

verses.sanskrit: अयने विषुवे चैव चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे तथा । रवितीर्थे प्रदत्तानां दानानां फलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ayane viṣuve caiva candrasūryagrahe tathā / ravitīrthe pradattānāṃ dānānāṃ phalamuttamam
verses.translation: He who performs a Sraddha in the Citra constel¬ lation sees (has) handsome sons. He who performs a Sraddha
verses.hindi: न ब्राह्मणासपरीक्षेत सदा देये तु मानवः । देवे कर्णि पिश्ये च भ्रूयते व परीक्षणस् ॥५ १ सर्ववेदब्रतस्नाता: पदक्तीनां पावता द्विजा:। ये च भाष्यविदो मुख्या ये च॒ व्याकरण रताः अधोयते पुराण च धमंशास्त्रं तथेब च । त्रिणाचिकेतपआग्निस्त्रिसुपर्ण: षडज़बित्
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Sraddha in the Citra constel¬ lation sees (has) handsome sons. He who performs a Sraddha
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Sraddha in the Citra constel¬ lation sees (has) handsome sons. He who performs a Sraddha

verses.sanskrit: संक्रान्तौ यानि दानानि हव्यकव्यानि भारत । अपामिव समुद्रस्य तेषामन्तो न लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃkrāntau yāni dānāni havyakavyāni bhārata / apāmiva samudrasya teṣāmanto na labhyate
verses.translation: A man wishing for sons shall perform a Sraddha in the Visakha constellation. He who performs a Srdddha in the Anu- radha constellation extends his realm.
verses.hindi: अतिरिक्त मामा के परिवार में छः को पत्िित्र करता है-- ऐसा फल कहा गया दवै ।४३-४४ अब वध का फल बतला रहा हूँ, सुनिये । वषौत्सगं करने वाला दस पूर्वजों और दस बाद में उत्पन्न होने वाले पुरुषों को पवित्र करता है। जल से तेर कर पृथ्वी पर आने वाले बुष की पूछ से गिरने वाले जल बिन्दुओं द्वारा वृषोत्सग कर्म में जो वस्तुएं स्पर्श की जाती हैं, वे पितरों के लिए अक्षयफलदायिनी कही जाती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: A man wishing for sons shall perform a Sraddha in the Visakha constellation. He who performs a Srdddha in the Anu- radha constellation extends his realm.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man wishing for sons shall perform a Sraddha in the Visakha constellation. He who performs a Srdddha in the Anu- radha constellation extends his realm.

verses.sanskrit: येन येन यदा दत्तं येन येन यदा हुतम् । तस्य तस्य तदा काले सविता प्रतिदायकः
verses.transliteration: yena yena yadā dattaṃ yena yena yadā hutam / tasya tasya tadā kāle savitā pratidāyakaḥ
verses.translation: He who performs a Srdddha under the Jyestha constella¬ tion attains lordship and excellence for ever. Those who desire health shall perform a Srdddha under the Mula constellation. Those who desire great fame should perform a Srdddha under Purvasadha.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार अन्त तक वृष के लॉगूल आदि से गिरने वाले जल द्वारा जो-जो वस्तुएं स्पश्ठ की जाती हैं, वे सब पितरों को अक्षय तृप्ति प्रदान करने वाली हैं--इसमें सम्देह नहीं। वह वृष अपने सींगों तथा खूरों से जो भूमि खोदता है, वह भूमि क्रक्षय मधु की नहर के रूप में उसके :दाता के) पितरों को प्राप्त होती है । एक सहस्न॒नल्व (एक नलव बराबर चार सो हाथ के) में विस्तृत तड़ाग के खनाने से पितरों की जो तृप्ति सुनी जाती है, उसस्ले अधिक तृप्ति वषोत्सगं से होती है। गुड़मित्रित तिलों, मधु मिश्रित तिलों से अथवा मधु से जो श्राउ्धकर्म किया जाता हैं, वह सब अक्षय फलदायी होता है
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Srdddha under the Jyestha constella¬ tion attains lordship and excellence for ever. Those who desire health shall perform a Srdddha under the Mula constellation. Those who desire great fame should perform a Srdddha under Purvasadha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Srdddha under the Jyestha constella¬ tion attains lordship and excellence for ever. Those who desire health shall perform a Srdddha under the Mula constellation. Those who desire great fame should perform a Srdddha under Purvasadha.

verses.sanskrit: सप्त जन्मानि तान्येव ददात्यर्कः पुनः पुनः । शतमिन्दुक्षये दानं सहस्रं तु दिनक्षये
verses.transliteration: sapta janmāni tānyeva dadātyarkaḥ punaḥ punaḥ / śatamindukṣaye dānaṃ sahasraṃ tu dinakṣaye
verses.translation: A man performing a Srdddha under the Uttarasadha con¬ stellation shall be free from grief. By performing a Srdddha under the Sravana constellation, one shall attain the greatest goal in excellent worlds.
verses.hindi: बहस्पति ने कहा--मनुष्य को चाहिए कि वह सबंदा दान कम में ब्राह्मणों की परीक्षा न करे देव कम में तथा पितरों के कम में ब्राह्मणों की परीक्षा सुनी जाती है ।५१॥ सभी समस्त वेदों के ब्रती अर्थात् वेदास्यास परायण, वेदों के पारगामी, पंक्तिपावन, भाष्य के जानते वाले, मुख्यत्र: व्याकरण वेत्ता, पुराणों ओर धर्मशास्त्रों के अध्ययन में निरत रहने वाले, नचिकेता की तीनों विद्याओं के बध्येता, पंचार्नि के
verses.wordMeaning: A man performing a Srdddha under the Uttarasadha con¬ stellation shall be free from grief. By performing a Srdddha under the Sravana constellation, one shall attain the greatest goal in excellent worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man performing a Srdddha under the Uttarasadha con¬ stellation shall be free from grief. By performing a Srdddha under the Sravana constellation, one shall attain the greatest goal in excellent worlds.

verses.sanskrit: संक्रान्तौ शतसाहस्रं व्यतीपाते त्वनन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: saṃkrāntau śatasāhasraṃ vyatīpāte tvanantakam
verses.translation: A man who performs a Srdddha under the Dhanistha constellation gains a kingdom and attains enormous wealth. By performing a Srdddha under the Abhijit constellation, (he) ob¬ tains goats and sheep as fruit.
verses.hindi: » धनुध्चित्वास्तगंतग्रन्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति । ७४४ बायुपुराणवें
verses.wordMeaning: A man who performs a Srdddha under the Dhanistha constellation gains a kingdom and attains enormous wealth. By performing a Srdddha under the Abhijit constellation, (he) ob¬ tains goats and sheep as fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who performs a Srdddha under the Dhanistha constellation gains a kingdom and attains enormous wealth. By performing a Srdddha under the Abhijit constellation, (he) ob¬ tains goats and sheep as fruit.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: रवितीर्थं कथं तात पुण्यात्पुण्यतरं स्मृतम् । विस्तरेण ममाख्याहि श्रवणौ मम लम्पटौ
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: ravitīrthaṃ kathaṃ tāta puṇyātpuṇyataraṃ smṛtam / vistareṇa mamākhyāhi śravaṇau mama lampaṭau
verses.translation: He who performs a Srdddha in the Satabhisak constel¬ lation attains success as a great physician. He who performs a. Srdddha in the Purva-Bhadrapada (Prosthapada) constellation attains goats and sheep as the fruit.
verses.hindi: मुख्येषु येषु सन्नेषु भवन्त्यवभूथप्लुता: । ये व सद्योव्षता नित्यं स्वकर्मनिरताश्च ये ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Srdddha in the Satabhisak constel¬ lation attains success as a great physician. He who performs a. Srdddha in the Purva-Bhadrapada (Prosthapada) constellation attains goats and sheep as the fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Srdddha in the Satabhisak constel¬ lation attains success as a great physician. He who performs a. Srdddha in the Purva-Bhadrapada (Prosthapada) constellation attains goats and sheep as the fruit.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणुष्वावहितो भूत्वा ह्यादित्येश्वरमुत्तमम् । उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā hyādityeśvaramuttamam / uttare narmadākūle sarvavyādhivināśanam
verses.translation: He who performs a Sraddha unfailingly under Uttara Bhadrapada shall obtain thousands of cows. He who per¬ forms a Sraddha under the Revatl constellation gets much wealth. By performing a Sraddha under the Asvini constellation one at¬ tains horses. He who performs a Sraddha in the BharanI constel¬ lation attains long life.
verses.hindi: +ये चापि नित्यं दशसु सुकृतेषु व्यवस्थिता: । स्वकर्मनिरता नित्य ताउश्राद्धेषु निमन्त्रयेत् एतेषु दत्तमक्षय्यमेते वे पश्क्तिपावना:। श्रद्धया ब्राह्मणा ये तु योगधर्म मनुब्नताः ५७ धर्मा श्रमवरिष्ठास्ते हृव्यकब्येषु ते बराः । त्रयो5पि पूजितास्तेन ब्रह्मविष्ण महेश्व रा: ३५८ पितृनिः सह लोकाश्र यो होतान्पूजयेश्वर: । पवित्नाणां पवित्र च मद्भालानां व मद्भलम् ह
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs a Sraddha unfailingly under Uttara Bhadrapada shall obtain thousands of cows. He who per¬ forms a Sraddha under the Revatl constellation gets much wealth. By performing a Sraddha under the Asvini constellation one at¬ tains horses.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs a Sraddha unfailingly under Uttara Bhadrapada shall obtain thousands of cows. He who per¬ forms a Sraddha under the Revatl constellation gets much wealth. By performing a Sraddha under the Asvini constellation one at¬ tains horses.…

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ जाबालिर्ब्राह्मणो ऽभवत् । वसिष्ठान्वयसम्भूतो वेदशास्त्रार्थपारगः
verses.transliteration: purā kṛtayugasyādau jābālirbrāhmaṇo 'bhavat / vasiṣṭhānvayasambhūto vedaśāstrārthapāragaḥ
verses.translation: By performing a Sraddha according to these injunctions SaSabindu attained the entire earth. After attaining the entire earth he praised him (Yaraa).
verses.hindi: प्रथम: सर्वधधर्माणां योगधर्मो निगद्यते। अपाइक्तेयांस्तु बक्ष्यासि गदतों मे निबोधत १६० कितबो मद्यपो यक्ष्मी पशुपालो निराक्ृति:। पग्रामप्रेष्यों वार्धषिको गायनो वणिजस्तथा ॥६ १ अगारदाही गरदः कुण्डाशी सोमबिक्रयी । समुद्रयायी दुश्चर्मा तैलिक: कृटकारकः
verses.wordMeaning: By performing a Sraddha according to these injunctions SaSabindu attained the entire earth. After attaining the entire earth he praised him (Yaraa).
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing a Sraddha according to these injunctions SaSabindu attained the entire earth. After attaining the entire earth he praised him (Yaraa).

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रता साधुशीला तस्य भार्या मनस्विनी । ऋतुकाले तु सा गत्वा भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: pativratā sādhuśīlā tasya bhāryā manasvinī / ṛtukāle tu sā gatvā bhartāram idam abravīt
verses.translation: O foremost one among the eloquents, what is it that offered to the Pitj-s, delights them to a little extent? What deli¬ ghts (them) for a long time? What is it that is conducive to delight them infinitely 7 1
verses.hindi: उपासक वेदों के छहों अंगों के जानने वाले, त्रियुपर्ण, ब्रह्मज्ञानियों का पुत्र, छत्दोग, ज्येष्ठसाम को जानने वाले, जितने भी पुण्य तीथे हैं, उनमें ब्रतोपरास्त अभिषेक करने वाले, मुख्य-मुख्य यज्ञों में अवभृथ स्नान करने वाले, शीक्ष ही किसी ब्रत से निवत्त होने वाले, अपने-अपने कर्मों में निरत रहने वाले, क्रोधरहित, तथा शान्तिपरायण जो ब्राह्मण हों उन्हें श्राद्ध में निमन्त्रित करना चाहिए ।१३-५४। जो सवंदा दसों शुभ कर्मों में व्यवस्थित रहकर जीवन यापन करने वाले हैं तथा अपने कर्मों में निरत रहते हैं, उन्हें श्राद्ध में निमन्त्रित करना चाहिए ।५६। इन सत्पात्नों में दिया गया दान अक्षय फलदायी होता है--ये उपर्युक्त ब्राह्मण पंक्तिपावन हैं । जो योगधमं में अनुरक्ति एवं श्रद्धां रखने वाले ब्राह्मण हैं, वे वर्णाश्रम धर्म की मर्यादा मानने वाली सभी जातियों में श्रेष्ठ हैं, ओर हृब्य कव्य--सभी कार्यों में श्रेष्ठ हैं। जिसने ऐसे ब्राह्मणों की पूजा की, उसने
verses.wordMeaning: O foremost one among the eloquents, what is it that offered to the Pitj-s, delights them to a little extent? What deli¬ ghts (them) for a long time? What is it that is conducive to delight them infinitely 7 1
verses.commentary: Sense: O foremost one among the eloquents, what is it that offered to the Pitj-s, delights them to a little extent? What deli¬ ghts (them) for a long time? What is it that is conducive to delight them infinitely 7 1

verses.sanskrit: वर्तते ऋतुकालो मे भर्तारं त्वामुपस्थिता । भज मां प्रीतिसंयुक्तः पुत्रकामां तु कामिनीम्
verses.transliteration: vartate ṛtukālo me bhartāraṃ tvāmupasthitā / bhaja māṃ prītisaṃyuktaḥ putrakāmāṃ tu kāminīm
verses.translation: The first topic discussed is about the vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes liked by Pitxs and therefore should be served to Brahmanas while dining at a Sraddha (vide w. 3-9).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश--तीनों देवताओं की पूजा की  जो मनुष्य ऐसे सवंगुण सम्पन्न ब्राह्मणों की पूजा करता है, वह पितरों के साथ समस्त लोकों की पूजा करता है। योगधर्म सभी पवित्र पदार्थों से अधिक पवित्र एवं सभी मंगलदायी वस्तुओं से अधिक मंगलदायी हैं। सभी धर्मों में वह प्रथम कहा गया है। अब इसके उपरान्त जो अप॑क्तिपावन ब्राह्मण हैं, उन्हें मैं बतला रहा हैं, सुनिये ।६७-६०। धत्तं, शराबी, यक्ष्मारोग ग्रस्त, पशुओं
verses.wordMeaning: The first topic discussed is about the vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes liked by Pitxs and therefore should be served to Brahmanas while dining at a Sraddha (vide w. 3-9).
verses.commentary: Sense: The first topic discussed is about the vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes liked by Pitxs and therefore should be served to Brahmanas while dining at a Sraddha (vide w. 3-9).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो द्विजः प्राह प्रिये ऽद्याहं व्रतान्वितः । गच्छेदानीं वरारोहे दास्य ऋत्वन्तरे पुनः
verses.transliteration: evamukto dvijaḥ prāha priye 'dyāhaṃ vratānvitaḥ / gacchedānīṃ varārohe dāsya ṛtvantare punaḥ
verses.translation: Listen to those sacrificial offerings which are to be made at the time of Sraddha as the knowers of Sraddha have under¬ stood. Listen also to the benefit of these in accordance with their strength.
verses.hindi: को पालना करने वाला, कुरूप, ग्राम में दृत या सेवक का काम करने वाला, व्याज से जीविका चलाने वाला, गायक, व्यवसा ), किसी का स्थान जलाने वाला, विष देने वाला, छिनाले से उत्पन्न होने बालों का अन्न लाने वाला, सोमरस का विक्रय करने वाला, समुद्र यात्रा करने बाला, दुष्ट चमड़े बाला, तेल का व्यवसायी,  इृदमर्ध नास्ति क. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to those sacrificial offerings which are to be made at the time of Sraddha as the knowers of Sraddha have under¬ stood. Listen also to the benefit of these in accordance with their strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to those sacrificial offerings which are to be made at the time of Sraddha as the knowers of Sraddha have under¬ stood. Listen also to the benefit of these in accordance with their strength.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्द्वितीये सम्प्राप्ते ऋतुकाले ऽप्युपस्थिता । पुनः सा छन्दिता तेन व्रतस्थो ऽद्येति भारत
verses.transliteration: punardvitīye samprāpte ṛtukāle 'pyupasthitā / punaḥ sā chanditā tena vratastho 'dyeti bhārata
verses.translation: Grandfathers are pleased for a month by a Sraddha in which gingelly seeds, grains of rice, barley, black gram, water, fruits and roots are offered.
verses.hindi: पिन्ना विवदमानशभ्र यस्य चोपपतिग है । अभिशस्तस्तथा स्तेनः शिल्पयंश्रोपजीबति
verses.wordMeaning: Grandfathers are pleased for a month by a Sraddha in which gingelly seeds, grains of rice, barley, black gram, water, fruits and roots are offered.
verses.commentary: Sense: Grandfathers are pleased for a month by a Sraddha in which gingelly seeds, grains of rice, barley, black gram, water, fruits and roots are offered.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं वा बहुशस्तेन छन्दिता च पुनः पुनः । निराशा चाभवत्तत्र भर्तारं प्रति भामिनी
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ vā bahuśastena chanditā ca punaḥ punaḥ / nirāśā cābhavattatra bhartāraṃ prati bhāminī
verses.translation: They are pleased for two months if fishes are offered; for three months if venison is offered; for four months if the meat of hare is offered; and forfive months if the meat of birds is offered.
verses.hindi: सूचकः पर्वकारी च यस्तु मित्रेषु दुह्मति । गणयाचलकश्ेव नाह्तिको बेदवर्जितः . द्द४ बिक्रीणाति च यो ब्रह्म ब्रतानि च तपांसि च। नष्ट स्यान्नास्तिके दत्त कृतध्ने चेब शंसके ६६ यच्च वाणिजके चेब नेह नामुत्र तजूबेत्  निक्षेपहारिणे चव कितवे बेदनिन्दके ३६७ तथा वाणिजके चेब कारुके धर्मर्वाजते । निनदर्क्रीणाति पण्यानि विक्रीणंश्र प्रशंसति ६८
verses.wordMeaning: They are pleased for two months if fishes are offered; for three months if venison is offered; for four months if the meat of hare is offered; and forfive months if the meat of birds is offered.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are pleased for two months if fishes are offered; for three months if venison is offered; for four months if the meat of hare is offered; and forfive months if the meat of birds is offered.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखेन महताविष्टा विधायानशनं मृता । तेन भ्रूणहतेनैव पापेन सहसा द्विजः
verses.transliteration: duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭā vidhāyānaśanaṃ mṛtā / tena bhrūṇahatenaiva pāpena sahasā dvijaḥ
verses.translation: They are delighted for six months with the flesh of boars, for seven months with goats' flesh and for eight months with the flesh of a spotted doe.
verses.hindi: घष्टि काण: शर्त पण्ड: श्वित्री यावत्प्रपश्यति । पापरोगी सहस्नस्य दातुर्नाशयते फलम् ११७०
verses.wordMeaning: They are delighted for six months with the flesh of boars, for seven months with goats' flesh and for eight months with the flesh of a spotted doe.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are delighted for six months with the flesh of boars, for seven months with goats' flesh and for eight months with the flesh of a spotted doe.

verses.sanskrit: शीर्णघ्राणाङ्घ्रिरभवत्तपः सर्वं ननाश च । दृष्ट्वात्मानं स कुष्ठेन व्याप्तं ब्राह्मणसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: śīrṇaghrāṇāṅghrirabhavattapaḥ sarvaṃ nanāśa ca / dṛṣṭvātmānaṃ sa kuṣṭhena vyāptaṃ brāhmaṇasattamaḥ
verses.translation: The manes are delighted for nine months with the meat of the Ruru deer. They will have contentment lasting for ten months with the meat of Gauaya (a kind of ox).
verses.hindi: करना पल काना  "न "कमान लगना ५ ना डा ननाक कल दा का ध विननानण परम भानप क7//ककनकनन काफी एई हर ता या कूटनीतिज्ञ, पिता के साथ विवाद करने बाला, जिसके घर में कोई दूसरा गृहस्वामी हो, लम्पठ, चोर, शिल्पजीवी, चुगुलखोर, धन के लोभ से विना पर्व के ही अमावास्या आदि पर्बो के दित सम्पन्त होने वाली सत्क्रियाओं का अनुष्ठान करने वाला, मित्रों के साथ द्रोह करने बाला, समूह बनाकर यावना करने वाला, नास्तिक, वेदविहीन, उन्मत्त, हिजड़ा, दुष्ट प्रकृति वाला, गर्भ हत्या करने वाला, गुरु की शब्या पर शयन
verses.wordMeaning: The manes are delighted for nine months with the meat of the Ruru deer. They will have contentment lasting for ten months with the meat of Gauaya (a kind of ox).
verses.commentary: Sense: The manes are delighted for nine months with the meat of the Ruru deer. They will have contentment lasting for ten months with the meat of Gauaya (a kind of ox).

verses.sanskrit: विषादं परमं गत्वा नर्मदातटमाश्रितः । अपृच्छद्भास्करं तीर्थं द्विजेभ्यो द्विजसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gatvā narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ / apṛcchadbhāskaraṃ tīrthaṃ dvijebhyo dvijasattamaḥ
verses.translation: They are propitiated for eleven months with the meat of a tortoise. Know that Sraddha with (products of) cow's milk lasts for a year.
verses.hindi: करने वाला, बैचक से जीविका चलाने वाला, दूत का कर्म करने बाला, परस्त्रीगामी, जो ब्रह्म, (विद्या) ब्रत एवं तपस्या को बेंचता है, इन सबको दान करने से दान का समस्त फेल नष्ट हो जाता है। इसी प्रकार नास्तिक, कृतप्न, एवं निन्‍दक को दान करने से फल का नाश हो जाता है ।६१-६६। वाणिज्य व्यवसाय में लगे हुए ब्राह्मण को जो कुछ दिया जाता है बह न तो इस लोक में फल देता है न पर लोक में ।
verses.wordMeaning: They are propitiated for eleven months with the meat of a tortoise. Know that Sraddha with (products of) cow's milk lasts for a year.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are propitiated for eleven months with the meat of a tortoise. Know that Sraddha with (products of) cow's milk lasts for a year.

verses.sanskrit: आरोग्यं भास्करादिच्छेदिति संचिन्त्य चेतसि । कुतस्तद्भास्करं तीर्थं भो द्विजाः कथ्यतां मम
verses.transliteration: ārogyaṃ bhāskarādicchediti saṃcintya cetasi / kutastadbhāskaraṃ tīrthaṃ bho dvijāḥ kathyatāṃ mama
verses.translation: So also in the case of milk-pudding along with milk pro¬ ducts, honey and ghee. The satisfaction with the meat of a Vadhririasa (a rhino-like animal?) lasts for twelve years.
