verses.hindi: दूसरे के रखे हुए निःक्षेप (गिरबी) को ले लेनेवाले धूर्त एवं वेदनिन्दक को दिये गये दान का भी यही फल होता है। वाणिज्य कम में प्रवृत, कारोगर, धर्महीन, एबं ऐसे लोग जो दूसरे की अच्छी वस्तु की खरीदते समय निन्‍दा करते हों और अपनी खराब वस्तु को बेचते समय प्रशंसा करते हों--इस सबों को भी दान देने से यही फल होता है। इसी प्रकार मिथ्या भाषण करनतेवाला वणिक् व्यवसाय में भ्रवृत्त द्विज भी श्राद्ध के योग्य नहीं है। पोनभंव ब्राह्मण को दिया गया दान भस्म (राख) पर दी गई आहुति के समान व्यर्थ है ।६७-६६। काना व्यक्ति साठ, नपुश्तक सो, दवेसकुष्ठ ग्रसित जितने भी कर्मो को देखता है, तथा पाप के कारण रोगी, एक सहसख्र दाता के सत्कर्मों के फलों को नष्ट कर देता है। मूर्ख व्यक्ति को दान करनेवाला
verses.wordMeaning: So also in the case of milk-pudding along with milk pro¬ ducts, honey and ghee. The satisfaction with the meat of a Vadhririasa (a rhino-like animal?) lasts for twelve years.
verses.commentary: Sense: So also in the case of milk-pudding along with milk pro¬ ducts, honey and ghee. The satisfaction with the meat of a Vadhririasa (a rhino-like animal?) lasts for twelve years.

verses.sanskrit: तपस् तप्याम्यहं गत्वा तस्मिंस्तीर्थे सुभावितः
verses.transliteration: tapas tapyāmyahaṃ gatvā tasmiṃstīrthe subhāvitaḥ
verses.translation: With the meat of Khadga (rhinoceros) during the rites of Pitrs, the pleasure is everlasting. So also with the meat of a black goat and an alligator provides endless pleasure.
verses.hindi: १९. पति से परित्यक्त अथवा विधवा यदि अपनी इच्छा से पर पुरुष द्वारा पुत्र उत्पन्न करतीं है तो बहू पौनभव कहा जाता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: With the meat of Khadga (rhinoceros) during the rites of Pitrs, the pleasure is everlasting. So also with the meat of a black goat and an alligator provides endless pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the meat of Khadga (rhinoceros) during the rites of Pitrs, the pleasure is everlasting. So also with the meat of a black goat and an alligator provides endless pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजा ऊचुः । रेवाया उत्तरे कूले आदित्येश्वरनामतः । विद्यते भास्करं तीर्थं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: dvijā ūcuḥ / revāyā uttare kūle ādityeśvaranāmataḥ / vidyate bhāskaraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam
verses.translation: In this connection, those who know the ancient lores mention about the gathas (traditional verses) sung by Pitrs.
verses.hindi: ७४६. वायुपुराणध् सोपानत्कश्न यो भुदक्ते यच्च दद्यात्तिरस्कृतम् । सर्व तदसुरेन्द्राणां ब्रह्मा भागमकल्पयत् ७२ श्वानश्व यातुधानाश्र नावेक्षेरन्‍्कथंचन । तस्मात्परिवार्ति दर्यात्तिलेश्वान्ववकी रयन् ५७३ राक्षसानां तिला: प्रोक्ता : शुनां परिवृतिस्तथा । दर्शनात्सुकरों हन्ति पक्षपातेन कुबकुटः ७४ न प्रोणाति पितन्देवास्स्वर्ग न च स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: In this connection, those who know the ancient lores mention about the gathas (traditional verses) sung by Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this connection, those who know the ancient lores mention about the gathas (traditional verses) sung by Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र याह्यविचारेण गन्तुं चेच्छक्यते त्वया । एवमुक्तो द्विजैर्विप्रो गन्तुं तत्र प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: tatra yāhyavicāreṇa gantuṃ cecchakyate tvayā / evamukto dvijairvipro gantuṃ tatra pracakrame
verses.translation: (Pitrs sing) "Will a son be bom in our own family who will give us on the Trayodafi (thirteenth) day, cooked food, milk pudding, honey and ghee on the occasion of Gaja- cchaya Parvan P * 1 Or give the same with the meat of a goat that is
verses.hindi: अपसब्ये कृते तेन विधिवद॒र्भपाणिना । पिश्यसानिधन कार्यभेवं प्रीणाति वे पित॒न् ७८
verses.wordMeaning: (Pitrs sing) "Will a son be bom in our own family who will give us on the Trayodafi (thirteenth) day, cooked food, milk pudding, honey and ghee on the occasion of Gaja- cchaya Parvan P * 1 Or give the same with the meat of a goat that is
verses.commentary: Sense: (Pitrs sing) "Will a son be bom in our own family who will give us on the Trayodafi (thirteenth) day, cooked food, milk pudding, honey and ghee on the occasion of Gaja- cchaya Parvan P * 1 Or give the same with the meat of a goat that is

verses.sanskrit: व्याधिना परिभूतस्तु घोरेण प्राणहारिणा । यदा गन्तुं न शक्नोति तदा तेन विचिन्तितम्
verses.transliteration: vyādhinā paribhūtastu ghoreṇa prāṇahāriṇā / yadā gantuṃ na śaknoti tadā tena vicintitam
verses.translation: The conjunction that occurs when the Moon is in the Magha constel¬ lation, the Sun is in Hasta and the Tithi is the 13th in the rainy season, it is called Gajacchdya or Kunjaracchaya.
verses.hindi: कननन्‍गनगनाी + "का फिपश गा "शाम एक ता बयान टिकी जज जा करीीत, 5» तन बआ अगला 6 अल“ त शुभकर्म फलों से बंचित हो जाता है। जो शिर को बाँधकर भोजन करता है, जो दक्षिण दिशा की ओर मुख करके भोजन करता है, जो जूता पहिनकर भोजन करता है, जो तिरस्कार पूर्वक दान करता हैं, उनके समस्त कर्मों के फल को भगवान् ब्रह्मा असुरेन्द्रों के लिए कल्पित करते हैं ।७०-७२। श्राद्ध के सम्पन्न होते समय उसे श्वान और यातुधान किसी प्रकार भीन देखने पावें, इसके लिए चारों तरफ से ऑट करने के लिए.
verses.wordMeaning: The conjunction that occurs when the Moon is in the Magha constel¬ lation, the Sun is in Hasta and the Tithi is the 13th in the rainy season, it is called Gajacchdya or Kunjaracchaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The conjunction that occurs when the Moon is in the Magha constel¬ lation, the Sun is in Hasta and the Tithi is the 13th in the rainy season, it is called Gajacchdya or Kunjaracchaya.

verses.sanskrit: सामर्थ्यं ब्राह्मणानां हि विद्यते भुवनत्रये । लिङ्गपातः कृतो विप्रैर्देवदेवस्य शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: sāmarthyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hi vidyate bhuvanatraye / liṅgapātaḥ kṛto viprairdevadevasya śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: O dear one, recount the benefit of the holy centres Gaya etc. to me who ask. Please mention the merit entirely that is derived by performing the rites of Pitrs.
verses.hindi: परदा लगा देना चाहिए और चारों ओर तिलों का विकिरण करना चाहिए। राक्षसों को निवारित करने के लिए तिल और कुत्तों को निवारित करने के लिए परदा या दूसरे किसी प्रकार का घेरा बना देने की बात कही जाती है  शूकर केवल देख लेने से हो श्राद्ध के फल को नष्ट कर देता है, मुर्गा अपने पंखों के फड़फड़ाने से उसके फल को नष्ट कर देता है, रजस्वला स्त्री के स्पर्श से तथा क्रोध पूवंक दान कर: से क्षाद्ध के फलों
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one, recount the benefit of the holy centres Gaya etc. to me who ask. Please mention the merit entirely that is derived by performing the rites of Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, recount the benefit of the holy centres Gaya etc. to me who ask. Please mention the merit entirely that is derived by performing the rites of Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रः शोषितो विप्रैर्विन्ध्यश्चापि निवारितः । अहमप्यत्र संस्थस्तु ह्यानयिष्यामि भास्करम्
verses.transliteration: samudraḥ śoṣito viprairvindhyaścāpi nivāritaḥ / ahamapyatra saṃsthastu hyānayiṣyāmi bhāskaram
verses.translation: O son, a Sraddha performed in Gaya yields endless benefit. Japas, Homas and penances (performed there) 'are also beneficial endlessly. Hence on the anniversary day of the death of father, Sraddha performed there is remembered as everlasting,
verses.hindi: का विनाश हो जाता है। इसी प्रकार जो व्यक्ति अपने द्वारा किये जाने वाले श्राद्ध के कार्यों को अथवा हवनादि को मित्रों द्वारा सम्पन्त कराता है, उसके कार्य पितरों और देवताओं को सन्तुष्ट नहीं करते और वह स्व्गलोक को नहीं जाता ।७३-७१। सुरम्य नदियों के किनारों पर छोटी-छोटी सरिताओं एवं सरोबरों के मनोहर एकान्स तट पर, किये गये श्राद्धादि कार्य से पितामहगण तृप्त होते हैं ।७६। श्राद्ध करते समय न तो कभी आँसू गिराना चाहिए न किसी साधारण बात-चीत में सम्मिलित होना चाहिए, न भोजन करते हुए ही श्राद्ध करना चाहिए, एक दूसरे के प्रति मत्सर अथवा ईष्यॉभाव भी नहीं प्रकट करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: O son, a Sraddha performed in Gaya yields endless benefit. Japas, Homas and penances (performed there) 'are also beneficial endlessly. Hence on the anniversary day of the death of father, Sraddha performed there is remembered as everlasting,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son, a Sraddha performed in Gaya yields endless benefit. Japas, Homas and penances (performed there) 'are also beneficial endlessly. Hence on the anniversary day of the death of father, Sraddha performed there is remembered as everlasting,

verses.sanskrit: तपोबलेन महता ह्यादित्येश्वरसंज्ञितम् । इति निश्चित्य मनसा ह्युग्रे तपसि संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: tapobalena mahatā hyādityeśvarasaṃjñitam / iti niścitya manasā hyugre tapasi saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: A son begot after marrying a girl of eight years sanctifies twentyone generations. Moreover, he sanctifies six generations in the family of his maternal uncle. This is remem¬ bered as the benefit (of such a marriage).
verses.hindi: भपसव्य होकर विधिपृंक हाथ में कुशा लेकर अपने जीवन पय॑न्त मनुष्य को पितरों का श्राद्ध/दि कार्य सम्पन्त करना चाहिए। इस प्रकार श्राद्ध के करने से पितरगणों की तृप्ति होती है। सर्वप्रथम (गृरुजनों या ब्राह्मणों की) अनुमति प्राप्तकर अग्नि में विधिपूर्वंक आहुति करे। पितरों के उद्देश से दिया जाने वाला पदार्थ पथ्वी पर, सूप पर अथवा कुश के विछावन पर रखना चाहिए ।७८-७९। बुद्धिमान पुरुष शुक्लपक्ष में
verses.wordMeaning: A son begot after marrying a girl of eight years sanctifies twentyone generations. Moreover, he sanctifies six generations in the family of his maternal uncle. This is remem¬ bered as the benefit (of such a marriage).
verses.commentary: Sense: A son begot after marrying a girl of eight years sanctifies twentyone generations. Moreover, he sanctifies six generations in the family of his maternal uncle. This is remem¬ bered as the benefit (of such a marriage).

verses.sanskrit: वायुभक्षो निराहारो ग्रीष्मे पञ्चाग्निमध्यगः । शिशिरे तोयमध्यस्थो वर्षास्वप्रावृताकृतिः
verses.transliteration: vāyubhakṣo nirāhāro grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyagaḥ / śiśire toyamadhyastho varṣāsvaprāvṛtākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: I shall recount the benefit derived from (discharging) a bull. Even as I recount listen and understand. The discharger of the bull sanctifies ten previous generations and ten succeeding generations.
verses.hindi: एबमेते महात्मानो महायोगा महौजस: । सदा वे पितरः पूज्या द्रष्टारों देशकालयो: ८१ पितृभक्तिरतो नित्य योगं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् । ध्यानेन मोक्ष गच्छन्ति हित्वा कर्म शुभाशुभभ्ू अमृत गुह्यमुद्भधुत्य योगं योगविदांवर। प्रोक्त सनत्कुमारेण महान्त धर्मशाश्वतम् ८४ देवानां परम गुह्ामृषीणां च परायणम् । पितृभक्त्या प्रयत्नेन पितृभक्तेश्व नित्यशः ८५ त॑ व योगं समासेन पितृभक्तस्तु कृत्स्नशः। प्रयत्नात्पराप्नुयात्तन्न सर्वभेव न संशय: ८६ यस्से भ्राद्धानि देयानि यच्च दत्त महाफलम् । येषु वाधष्प्यक्षयं श्राद्ध तीथेंषु च नदीषु च्॥
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount the benefit derived from (discharging) a bull. Even as I recount listen and understand. The discharger of the bull sanctifies ten previous generations and ten succeeding generations.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount the benefit derived from (discharging) a bull. Even as I recount listen and understand. The discharger of the bull sanctifies ten previous generations and ten succeeding generations.

verses.sanskrit: साग्रे वर्षशते पूर्णे रविस्तुष्टो ऽब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: sāgre varṣaśate pūrṇe ravistuṣṭo 'bravīd idam
verses.translation: At the time of letting free the bull whatever is sprinkled with water as it emerges from water on to the ground, is said to yield endless benefit.
verses.hindi: श्रत्वेवं शाकल्पं तु योधसुर्या कुर्ते नरः। स सज्जेन्न रके घोरे नास्तिकस्तमसाइ्बुतः ८८
verses.wordMeaning: At the time of letting free the bull whatever is sprinkled with water as it emerges from water on to the ground, is said to yield endless benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time of letting free the bull whatever is sprinkled with water as it emerges from water on to the ground, is said to yield endless benefit.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्य उवाच: वरं वरय भद्रं ते किं ते मनसि वाञ्छितम् । अदेयमपि दास्यामि ब्रूहि मां त्वं चिरं कृथाः
verses.transliteration: sūrya uvāca: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te kiṃ te manasi vāñchitam / adeyamapi dāsyāmi brūhi māṃ tvaṃ ciraṃ kṛthāḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that all those things touched by water tossed about by its tail etc., give endless satisfaction to Pitrs.
verses.hindi: दिन के प्रथमार्थ में श्राद्ध सम्पन्न करे, और कृष्णपक्ष में उनके उत्तराद्धे में करे, रोहिणी! का उल्लंघन नहीं करना चाहिए, देश और काल के देखने वाले, महान् तेजस्वी, महान योगी एवं परम महात्मा उन पितरों की सर्वदा पूजा करनी चाहिए ।5०-८१॥ पितरों में भक्ति रखते बाला मनुष्य सबेदा श्रेष्ठ योग की सिद्धि प्राप्त करता है। पितरों का ध्यान करने से वे अपने शुभाशुभ कर्म बन्धतनों से छुटकारा पाकर मोक्ष की भ्राष्ति करते हैं। महात्मा कश्यप ने जगत् को मोहित करके यज्ञ के लिए जिस योग का उद्घधारकर गुफा में सुरक्षित रखा था, है योग जानने वालों में प्रवीग  उस अमरत्व पूर्ण, परमगोपनीय चिरन्तत एवं परम महात् योगधर्म को उद्धत करके सनत्कुमार ने प्रकाशित किया । 5२-८४ उस देवताओं की परमभोपनीय, ऋषियों की सर्वध्व योग सम्पत्ति को पितरों में भक्ति रखने वाले मानव पितरों में भक्ति रखकर नित्य ही प्राप्त करते हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that all those things touched by water tossed about by its tail etc., give endless satisfaction to Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that all those things touched by water tossed about by its tail etc., give endless satisfaction to Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: किमसाध्यं हि ते विप्र इदानीं तपसि स्थितः
verses.transliteration: kimasādhyaṃ hi te vipra idānīṃ tapasi sthitaḥ
verses.translation: This is called'the rite of letting free a bull* ( Vrsotsarga-vidhi). For the details vide Vifliu Dh. S. 86.1-20. Vimdharmottara 1.147. 1-19 repeat the same procedure. Though the words ' nilam vam' are translated as 'blue bull* the bull is not blue in colour. Though the adjective 'blue* (Mla) is variously defined, Mt. 38 defines it as 'a bull having white legs, face & tail and the rest of the body as red* I could not trace the verse lohilo yastu varpena etc. in Bd. P. though Kane quotes it as ascribed to it (HD, IV , fn 1215). •
verses.hindi: संक्षेप में उस योम की प्राप्ति पितृभक्त लोग अपने प्रयत्न से सर्वाशतः प्राप्त कर लेते हैं-- इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। जिसे श्राद्ध देना चाहिए, जिम वस्तु के देते से महान् फल की प्राप्ति होती है, जिन तीर्थों अथवा नदियों में किये गये श्राद्ध का अक्षय फल होता है, जिन तीर्थों में करने से स्वर्ग की प्राप्ति होती है--उन सब को मैं
verses.wordMeaning: This is called'the rite of letting free a bull* ( Vrsotsarga-vidhi). For the details vide Vifliu Dh. S. 86.1-20. Vimdharmottara 1.147. 1-19 repeat the same procedure. Though the words ' nilam vam' are translated as 'blue bull* the bull is not blue in colour.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This is called'the rite of letting free a bull* ( Vrsotsarga-vidhi). For the details vide Vifliu Dh. S. 86.1-20. Vimdharmottara 1.147. 1-19 repeat the same procedure. Though the words ' nilam vam' are translated as 'blue bull* the bull is not blue in colour.…

verses.sanskrit: जाबालिरुवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम । मम प्रतिज्ञा देवेश ह्यादित्येश्वरदर्शने
verses.transliteration: jābāliruvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama / mama pratijñā deveśa hyādityeśvaradarśane
verses.translation: The ground dug up by the bull by means of its hoofs or horns, serves as canals of honey perpetually feeding Pitrs.
verses.hindi: तुम से संग्रहपूृवंक बतला चुका बहस्पति ने कहा--इस प्रकार श्राद्ध विषयक चर्चा एवं उसकी विधियों को चुनकर जो मनुष्य दोष
verses.wordMeaning: The ground dug up by the bull by means of its hoofs or horns, serves as canals of honey perpetually feeding Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ground dug up by the bull by means of its hoofs or horns, serves as canals of honey perpetually feeding Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: कृता तां पारितुं देव न शक्तो व्याधिना वृतः । शुक्लतीर्थे ऽत्र तिष्ठ त्वम् आदित्येश्वरमूर्तिधृक्
verses.transliteration: kṛtā tāṃ pārituṃ deva na śakto vyādhinā vṛtaḥ / śuklatīrthe 'tra tiṣṭha tvam ādityeśvaramūrtidhṛk
verses.translation: The satisfaction derived by Pitrs at the rite of letting free the bull is more than that when they hear that a tank, a thousand Nalvas square, has been dug (a Nalva =400 hands).
verses.hindi: १. पन्द्रह भागों में विभक्त दिन का नवाँ. भाग. ।.
verses.wordMeaning: The satisfaction derived by Pitrs at the rite of letting free the bull is more than that when they hear that a tank, a thousand Nalvas square, has been dug (a Nalva =400 hands).
verses.commentary: Sense: The satisfaction derived by Pitrs at the rite of letting free the bull is more than that when they hear that a tank, a thousand Nalvas square, has been dug (a Nalva =400 hands).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ते तु देवेशो बहुरूपो दिवाकरः । उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले क्षणादेव व्यदृश्यत
verses.transliteration: evamukte tu deveśo bahurūpo divākaraḥ / uttare narmadākūle kṣaṇādeva vyadṛśyata
verses.translation: If anyone gives gingelly seeds mixed with honey and jaggery, it yields everlasting benefit.
verses.hindi: सहारोगावसायस्तु स यः संपततमानस: । वेदाश्नमान्पुक्तचिल:ः कुम्भीकानधिगच्छति ॥॥ तस्माच्छादुध धर्म उद्दिष्टि एप नित्य कार्य: अश्रहधानेन पुंसा
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone gives gingelly seeds mixed with honey and jaggery, it yields everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone gives gingelly seeds mixed with honey and jaggery, it yields everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति भूपाल तद्धि तीर्थं प्रचक्षते । सर्वपापहरं प्रोक्तं सर्वदुःखविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti bhūpāla taddhi tīrthaṃ pracakṣate / sarvapāpaharaṃ proktaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanam
verses.translation: One should not test Brahmanas always in order to give them anything. But testing is heard about (i.e. prescribed in £rutis) in regard to the rites of Devas (gods) and Pitrs. 1 One should invite these for the Sraddha rite: Those who have studied all the Vedas and who have performed all rites; the Brahmanas who are the sanctifiers of the row; important Brahmanas who know the Bhasyas (Glosses on Aphorisms); those who regularly study Grammar; those who study Puranas and Dharmasastras; those who are conversant with the three-Naci- ketas-Vidyas; the worshippers of five fires; the Trisuparnas, the knowers of the six ancillary subjects of the Vedas; a son of the Brahma form of marriage; a master of Vedic Prosody (or chanter of the Vedas); a singer of the Jycstha Saman; one who has taken baths in sacred waters (at holy places); those who have taken part in important Yajnas and taken the concluding (Avabhrtha) ablutions; those who observe rites immediately; those who stri¬ ctly adhere to their own duties; those who are not wrathful and those who are always calm and quiescent. And those who perpetually observe the ten meritorious deeds shall also be invited.
verses.hindi: योग परिवदेश्वस्तु ध्वानिनां मोक्षकारणम् । स गच्छेन्नरक घोर॑ श्रोता यश्व न संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: One should not test Brahmanas always in order to give them anything. But testing is heard about (i.e. prescribed in £rutis) in regard to the rites of Devas (gods) and Pitrs.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not test Brahmanas always in order to give them anything. But testing is heard about (i.e. prescribed in £rutis) in regard to the rites of Devas (gods) and Pitrs.…

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु संवत्सरं पूर्णं नित्यम् आदित्यवासरे । स्नात्वा प्रदक्षिणाः सप्त दत्त्वा पश्यति भास्करम्
verses.transliteration: yastu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ nityam ādityavāsare / snātvā pradakṣiṇāḥ sapta dattvā paśyati bhāskaram
verses.translation: Whatever is offered to these, yields everlasting benefit. These are the sanctifiers of the row. Those Brahmanas who observe Yogic rites and duties should be revered faithfully.
verses.hindi: योगेश्वराणामाक्ोश शुणुयाद्यों यतात्मनाम् । स हि काल चिरं मज्जेत्कुस्भीपाके न संशय: मनसा कर्मंणा वाचा द्वेषं योगिषु बर्जयेत् । प्रेत्यान्यं तत्फल भुड्क्त इह बेब न संशय: ६४ न पारगो विन्दति पारसात्मनस्त्रिलोकमध्ये चरति स्वक्लिः । क्‍ ऋचो यजुः साम तदड्भपारगो विकारमेन हानवाप्प सीदति ६६
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever is offered to these, yields everlasting benefit. These are the sanctifiers of the row. Those Brahmanas who observe Yogic rites and duties should be revered faithfully.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever is offered to these, yields everlasting benefit. These are the sanctifiers of the row. Those Brahmanas who observe Yogic rites and duties should be revered faithfully.

verses.sanskrit: यत्फलं लभते तेन तच्छृणुष्व मयोदितम् । प्रसुप्तं मण्डलानीह दद्रुकुष्ठविचर्चिकाः
verses.transliteration: yatphalaṃ labhate tena tacchṛṇuṣva mayoditam / prasuptaṃ maṇḍalānīha dadrukuṣṭhavicarcikāḥ
verses.translation: They are the foremost due to their adherence to the duties of their (specific) stages of life. In regard to the offering Verses 22-31 state the qualifications of the Brahmins eligible for in¬ vitation to Sraddha, though it has been already discussed in Gh. 17. Yogins are given the first preference as Yoga-dharma was regarded as the foremost among Dharmas.
verses.hindi: दृष्टि से देखकर उनमें अश्रद्धा करता है। वह नास्तिक अन्धकार से चारों ओर घिर कर घोर नरक में गिरता है। जो मन को संयत रखकर श्राद्धकर्म सम्पन्न करते हैं, उनके भीषण रोगों का बिनाश होता है। वेदों में वर्णित आश्रमों से मुक्त होकर मन माने ढंग से जीवन यापत्त करने वाले कुम्भीक तरक में जाते हैं । जिद्ठा के छेदन एवं चौय॑ कर्म को वे प्राप्त होते हैं ।४८-८६। जो योग के द्वेष करने वाले हैं, वे समुद्र में ढेला होकर
verses.wordMeaning: They are the foremost due to their adherence to the duties of their (specific) stages of life. In regard to the offering Verses 22-31 state the qualifications of the Brahmins eligible for in¬ vitation to Sraddha, though it has been already discussed in Gh. 17.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the foremost due to their adherence to the duties of their (specific) stages of life. In regard to the offering Verses 22-31 state the qualifications of the Brahmins eligible for in¬ vitation to Sraddha, though it has been already discussed in Gh. 17.…

verses.sanskrit: नश्यन्ति सत्वरं राजंस्तूलराशिरिवानले । धनपुत्रकलत्राणां पूरयेद्वत्सरत्रयात्
verses.transliteration: naśyanti satvaraṃ rājaṃstūlarāśirivānale / dhanaputrakalatrāṇāṃ pūrayedvatsaratrayāt
verses.translation: One who worships these, worships all the worlds along with the Pitrs. ( Togadharma ) is the holiest of all holy things, the most auspicious of all auspicious things.
verses.hindi: तब तक निवास करते हैं जब तक इस पृथ्वी की अवस्थिति रहती है। इसलिए श्राद्ध में ऊपर बतलाये गये इन श्राद्ध नियमों का श्रद्धापूवेंक मनुष्यों को सबंदा पालन करना चाहिए ।६०। विशेषतया योगियों की निन्दा तो नहीं ही करनी चाहिए, योगियों की निन्‍दा करने से बहीं पर कृमि होकर जन्म धारण करना पड़ता है । ध्यान परायण योगियों के अन्यतम लक्ष्य मोक्ष के मुख्य साधन योग की जो निन्‍दा करता है, वह घोर नरक में जाता है, उस निन्‍दा को सुनने वाला भी घोर नरक में जाता है--इसमें सन्देह नहीं ।६१-६२। योग परायण योगेदवरों की निन्‍दा करने से मनुष्य चारों ओर से अन्धकार से आच्छन्न, परम घोर दिखाई पड़ने वाले नरक में निश्चय ही जाता है। आत्मा को वश में रखने वाले योगेश्वरों की निन्‍्दा जो मनुष्य सुनता है, बह चिरकाल पयं॑न्‍्त कुम्भीपाक नरक में निवास करता है--इसमें सनन्‍्देह नहीं । योगियों के अ्रति देष की भावना
verses.wordMeaning: One who worships these, worships all the worlds along with the Pitrs. ( Togadharma ) is the holiest of all holy things, the most auspicious of all auspicious things.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who worships these, worships all the worlds along with the Pitrs. ( Togadharma ) is the holiest of all holy things, the most auspicious of all auspicious things.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु श्राद्धप्रदस्तत्र पित्ःनुद्दिश्य संक्रमे । तृप्यन्ति पितरस्तस्य पितृदेवो हि भास्करः
verses.transliteration: yastu śrāddhapradastatra pitḥnuddiśya saṃkrame / tṛpyanti pitarastasya pitṛdevo hi bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: Togadharma is mentioned as the first among all Dharmas. A rogue, a drunkard, a patient of pulmonary con¬ sumption, a cattle breeder, an ugly person, a common servant of all in the village, a usurer, a professional musician, a merchant, an incendiary, an administerer of poison, a pimp, a seller of Soma juice, a person who undertakes sea voyage, one whose skin is defiled, a dealer in oil, a deceitful person, one who quarrels with his father, one who has a co-husband at home, a calumnia¬ ted person, a thief, a person whose livelihood is arts and crafts, a tale-bearer, a person giving wrong information about holy days, one who is malicious to his friends, a group-beggar, an atheist, a discarder of the Vedas, a mad fellow, a eunuch, a knavish fellow, a destroyer of foetus, a defiler of the preceptor's bed, a follower of the physician's profession for livelihood, a messenger and an adulterer.
verses.hindi: मनसा, वाचा, करमंणा--सर्वथा वर्जित रस्तनो चाहिसे। इस सत्कर्म का फल वह दूसरे जन्म में भोगता है, ओर इस जन्म ने भी भोगता है- इसमें सन्देह नहीं ।६३-६५॥ योग मार्ग के पारंगत आत्मा के पार को नहीं प्राप्त होते (१) अपने कर्म के अनुसार वे तीनों लोकों में विचरण करते हैं। ऋक, य्जु और सामवेद तथा इनके स्रमस्त अंगों के पारंगत इस प्रकार. विकारों को नः प्राप्त होकर आनन्द का अनुभव करते,
verses.wordMeaning: Togadharma is mentioned as the first among all Dharmas. A rogue, a drunkard, a patient of pulmonary con¬ sumption, a cattle breeder, an ugly person, a common servant of all in the village, a usurer, a professional musician, a merchant, an incendiary, an administerer of poison,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Togadharma is mentioned as the first among all Dharmas. A rogue, a drunkard, a patient of pulmonary con¬ sumption, a cattle breeder, an ugly person, a common servant of all in the village, a usurer, a professional musician, a merchant, an incendiary, an administerer of poison,…

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं सर्वमादित्येश्वरमुत्तमम् । सर्वपापहरं दिव्यं सर्वरोगविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ sarvamādityeśvaramuttamam / sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ sarvarogavināśanam
verses.translation: He who sells the Vedas, religious observances, holy rites and penances—all these are defilers of the row.
verses.hindi: विकारपारः प्रकृतेश्व॒ पारगस्त्रयोगुणानां त्रिगुणान्तपारगः । बेशं च बेदितव्यं च विदित्वा वे यथाविधि । एवं बेदबिदं प्राहुस्ततोडस्ये बेदचिन्तकाः १००
verses.wordMeaning: He who sells the Vedas, religious observances, holy rites and penances—all these are defilers of the row.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sells the Vedas, religious observances, holy rites and penances—all these are defilers of the row.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे आदित्येश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले तीर्थं कलकलेश्वरम् । विख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु स्वयं देवेन निर्मितम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ādityeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 154 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ kalakaleśvaram / vikhyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu svayaṃ devena nirmitam
verses.translation: What is given to a trader is not beneficial here or here¬ after. The same is the case in regard to a person who misappro¬ priates (deposits), who is knavish and who hates the Vedas.
verses.hindi: यज्ञास्वेदांस्तथा कामाञज्ञानानि विविधानि च। प्राप्नोत्यायुः प्रजाश्वेव पितृमक्तो धनानि च
verses.wordMeaning: What is given to a trader is not beneficial here or here¬ after. The same is the case in regard to a person who misappro¬ priates (deposits), who is knavish and who hates the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is given to a trader is not beneficial here or here¬ after. The same is the case in regard to a person who misappro¬ priates (deposits), who is knavish and who hates the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकं समरे हत्वा देवदेवो महेश्वरः । सहितो देवगन्धर्वैः किन्नरैश्च महोरगैः
verses.transliteration: andhakaṃ samare hatvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ / sahito devagandharvaiḥ kinnaraiśca mahoragaiḥ
verses.translation: Verses 31-42 give a list of persons unfit for invitation to a Sraddha. Long lists of such unfit persons are given by Gautama Dh.S. XV. 16-19, Manu III. 150-166, Yajiiavalkya I. 222-224, Mbh. Anuiasana 90.6-11, Mt. 14-17, KP.II. 21.23-43.
verses.hindi: स॒ पद्क्तिपावनश्व द्विजानामग्रभुग्भवेत् । अध्याप्य वा द्विजास्सर्वान्सवन्कामानवाप्नुयात् हैं।९६। समस्त विकारों के पार जाने वाले, प्रकृति के पारगामी, सत्य, रज, तम, तीनों गुणों के पारगामी बास्तव में तीनों गुणों के पारगामी हैं। जो योग मार्ग एवं चोबीस तत्वों के पारगरामी हैं, वे ही वास्तव में इस जन्म मरण रूप संसृति सम्बन्ध के पारगामी हैं। जिस प्रकार योगी निखिल योग तत्त्वों को अपने मोग बल द्वारा विसजित करता है, उसी प्रकार सवंदा अपना विनाश भी संघटित करता है, इस प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 31-42 give a list of persons unfit for invitation to a Sraddha. Long lists of such unfit persons are given by Gautama Dh.S. XV. 16-19, Manu III. 150-166, Yajiiavalkya I. 222-224, Mbh. Anuiasana 90.6-11, Mt. 14-17, KP.II. 21.23-43.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 31-42 give a list of persons unfit for invitation to a Sraddha. Long lists of such unfit persons are given by Gautama Dh.S. XV. 16-19, Manu III. 150-166, Yajiiavalkya I. 222-224, Mbh. Anuiasana 90.6-11, Mt. 14-17, KP.II. 21.23-43.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खतूर्यनिनादैश्च मृदङ्गपणवादिभिः । वीणावेणुरवैश्चान्यैः स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलादिभिः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhatūryaninādaiśca mṛdaṅgapaṇavādibhiḥ / vīṇāveṇuravaiścānyaiḥ stutibhiḥ puṣkalādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Dogs and demons should not see the performance of a Sraddha. 1 Hence it should be screened out all round, and gingelly seeds should be strewn around.
verses.hindi: योग के तत्त्वों को भली-भाँति जानने वाला योगी, सब से परे जिसकी गति है, ऐसे परम पुरुष के गोचर होता है, अर्थात् योगी योग का आश्रय लेकर शरीर त्याग करते हैं और आत्मसारूप्य प्राप्त करते हैं। योग के तत्वों को जानने वाला जो पुरुष वेदों का सम्यक् अध्ययन कर वेदों के वेद्य (जानने योग्य) उस परम पुरुष को प्राप्त करता है, उसे ही वास्तव में वेदों का तत्त्ववेत्ता और वेदों का पारगामी कहा जाता है ।९७-९९:
verses.wordMeaning: Dogs and demons should not see the performance of a Sraddha. 1 Hence it should be screened out all round, and gingelly seeds should be strewn around.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dogs and demons should not see the performance of a Sraddha. 1 Hence it should be screened out all round, and gingelly seeds should be strewn around.

verses.sanskrit: गायन्ति सामानि यजूंषि चान्ये छन्दांसि चान्ये ऋचमुद्गिरन्ति । स्तोत्रैर् अनेकैर् अपरे गृणन्ति महेश्वरं तत्र महानुभावाः
verses.transliteration: gāyanti sāmāni yajūṃṣi cānye chandāṃsi cānye ṛcamudgiranti / stotrair anekair apare gṛṇanti maheśvaraṃ tatra mahānubhāvāḥ
verses.translation: It is to ward off Raksasas that gingelly seeds are strewn and the screen is to prevent the dogs. Boars destroy the effect of a Sraddha by having a look at it and a cock by fluttering its wings (or by the fall of its feathers within).
verses.hindi: जो वेदों के चरम प्रतिपाद्य उस परम पुरुष को भली-भाँति जानता है, वही वास्तव में वेदों के तत्त्वों को जानने वाला है, दूसरे सब वेद चिन्तक हैं ।१००। पितरों में भक्ति रखने वाला समस्त यज्ञों, समस्त वेदों, समस्त मनोरथों, विविध ज्ञान-विज्ञान, दीर्घायु, प्रचुर सम्पत्ति एवं पुत्र पौत्रादिकों सब को प्राप्त करता है । श्राद्ध के अवसर पर जो मनुष्य इस श्राद्धकल्प का सावधान चित्त होकर पाठ करता है, वह पृ कथित समस्त फलों को तथा तीथ में दिये गये दानों के फलों को प्राप्त करता है 8०१-१०२। वह पवित्रात्मा पुरुष पंक्तिपावन तथा ब्राह्मण समाज में स्ंप्रथम भोजन करने वाला होता है । अथवा समस्त ब्राह्मण समाज को विद्याहीन करके अपने समस्त मनोरथ को प्राप्त करता है ।१०३, जो मदुष्य इस श्राद्ध के माहँत्म्य को नित्य श्रद्धाभाव से, क्रोध को वश में रख, लोभ आदि से रहित होकर श्रवण करता है वह अनन्त काल पर्यन्त स्वर्ग भोगता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: It is to ward off Raksasas that gingelly seeds are strewn and the screen is to prevent the dogs. Boars destroy the effect of a Sraddha by having a look at it and a cock by fluttering its wings (or by the fall of its feathers within).
verses.commentary: Sense: It is to ward off Raksasas that gingelly seeds are strewn and the screen is to prevent the dogs. Boars destroy the effect of a Sraddha by having a look at it and a cock by fluttering its wings (or by the fall of its feathers within).

verses.sanskrit: प्रमथानां निनादेन कल्कलेन च बन्दिनाम् । यस्मात्प्रतिष्ठितं लिङ्गं तस्माज्जातं तदाख्यया
verses.transliteration: pramathānāṃ ninādena kalkalena ca bandinām / yasmātpratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃ tasmājjātaṃ tadākhyayā
verses.translation: A woman in her monthly course destroys the Sraddha by touching. If the performer of a Sraddha becomes angry, he destroys the benefit derived. If anyone gets his friends to offer Sraddha and Havis, they do not please Pitrs or Devas. Nor does he attain heaven.
verses.hindi: समस्त तीथों एवं दानों के फलों को वह, प्राप्त कत्ता है, यह, मोक्ष का सब से श्रेष्ठ उपाय है. सवमें प्र/प्ति
verses.wordMeaning: A woman in her monthly course destroys the Sraddha by touching. If the performer of a Sraddha becomes angry, he destroys the benefit derived. If anyone gets his friends to offer Sraddha and Havis, they do not please Pitrs or Devas. Nor does he attain heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: A woman in her monthly course destroys the Sraddha by touching. If the performer of a Sraddha becomes angry, he destroys the benefit derived. If anyone gets his friends to offer Sraddha and Havis, they do not please Pitrs or Devas. Nor does he attain heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा वीक्षेत्कलकलेश्वरम् । वाजपेयात्परं पुण्यं स लभेन्मानवो भुवि
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vīkṣetkalakaleśvaram / vājapeyātparaṃ puṇyaṃ sa labhenmānavo bhuvi
verses.translation: Grandfathers (manes) are delighted with what is given on the beautiful banks of the rivers and streams as well as of the lakes and in secluded places.
verses.hindi: अपत्यभाग्मवति परेण तेजसा दिवोकसां स ब्रजते सलोकताम् इत्येते पितरस्तात देवानामपि देवताः । सप्तस्वतेषु ते नित्यं स्थानेषु पितरो5्ब्यथाः ॥ै१०८
verses.wordMeaning: Grandfathers (manes) are delighted with what is given on the beautiful banks of the rivers and streams as well as of the lakes and in secluded places.
verses.commentary: Sense: Grandfathers (manes) are delighted with what is given on the beautiful banks of the rivers and streams as well as of the lakes and in secluded places.

verses.sanskrit: तेन पुण्येन पूतात्मा प्राणत्यागाद्दिवं व्रजेत् । आरूढः परमं यानं गीयमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: tena puṇyena pūtātmā prāṇatyāgāddivaṃ vrajet / ārūḍhaḥ paramaṃ yānaṃ gīyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: One shall not shed tears while performing a Sraddha, nor should he take active part in irrelevant conversation. One should not munch or crunch anything while performing a Srad¬ dha. One should avoid mutual rivalry too.
verses.hindi: प्रजापतिसुता होते सर्वे चच महात्मनः । आश्यो गणस्तु योगानां स नित्यो योगवर्ध नः १०६
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not shed tears while performing a Sraddha, nor should he take active part in irrelevant conversation. One should not munch or crunch anything while performing a Srad¬ dha. One should avoid mutual rivalry too.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not shed tears while performing a Sraddha, nor should he take active part in irrelevant conversation. One should not munch or crunch anything while performing a Srad¬ dha. One should avoid mutual rivalry too.

verses.sanskrit: उपभुज्य महाभोगान्कालेन महता ततः । मर्त्यलोके महात्मासौ जायते विमले कुले
verses.transliteration: upabhujya mahābhogānkālena mahatā tataḥ / martyaloke mahātmāsau jāyate vimale kule
verses.translation: Since the period of Dharma Sutras, people believed that food for Sraddha got polluted even by being looked by certain animals and.certain categories of people. The list of such unvvorthies is given in vv. 44-46—an echo of Gautama Dh.S. 15.25-28, Manu III. 239-242, and Purarias like KP. II. 22.34-35, VP. III.16.12-14, Bd. 3.19, 43-44. While performing a Sraddha the sacred thread should be worn from right to left and the Darbhas should be held duly in the hands. One should perform a Sraddha till one's death. Thus one delights Pitrs.
verses.hindi: द्वितीयों देवतानां नु तृतीयों देवता5:रिणाम् । शेषास्तु वर्णिनां ज्ञेया इति सर्वे प्रकीतिताः देवास्त्वेतान्यजस्ते वे सर्वेष्वेतेष्ववस्थिता: आश्रमास्तु यजस्त्येतांभ्वत्वारस्तु यथाक्रमम् १११
verses.wordMeaning: Since the period of Dharma Sutras, people believed that food for Sraddha got polluted even by being looked by certain animals and.certain categories of people. The list of such unvvorthies is given in vv. 44-46—an echo of Gautama Dh.S. 15.25-28, Manu III. 239-242,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the period of Dharma Sutras, people believed that food for Sraddha got polluted even by being looked by certain animals and.certain categories of people. The list of such unvvorthies is given in vv. 44-46—an echo of Gautama Dh.S. 15.25-28, Manu III. 239-242,…

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणः सुभगो लोके वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः । व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ subhago loke vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam
verses.translation: At the outset, he should formally take permission of the preceptor or the invited Brahmanas. He should then kindle a fire duly. The articles to be offered to Pitrs should be placed on the ground over a winnowing basket or on a Kusa mat.
verses.hindi: बणशभ्वापि यजस्त्येतांश्रत्वारस्तु यथाविधि  तथा संकरजाताश्र स्लेच्छाश्वेव यजन्ति बं
verses.wordMeaning: At the outset, he should formally take permission of the preceptor or the invited Brahmanas. He should then kindle a fire duly. The articles to be offered to Pitrs should be placed on the ground over a winnowing basket or on a Kusa mat.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the outset, he should formally take permission of the preceptor or the invited Brahmanas. He should then kindle a fire duly. The articles to be offered to Pitrs should be placed on the ground over a winnowing basket or on a Kusa mat.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कलकलेश्वरतीर्थफलमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुःपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वतीर्थादनुत्तमम् । उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले शुक्लतीर्थं युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kalakaleśvaratīrthaphalamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 155 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvatīrthādanuttamam / uttare narmadākūle śuklatīrthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: During the bright half (of the month), the Sraddha is to be performed in the forenoon by the skilful performer of a Sraddha. During the dark half, it should be performed in the afternoon. In any case the Rauhina period (the 4th Muhurta of the day), should not be transgressed.
verses.hindi: पितृ भ्र यो यजेज्धूकत्या पितरः पुजयन्ति तम्॥ पितरः पुष्टिकामस्थ प्रजाकामस्थ॒ वा पुनः ॥ पुष्टि प्रजाश्न स्वर्ग व प्रबच्छरित पितामहाः ऑफ परम. या नायाब -अका पाना जन». की" 2-०-करन+-२कअ«-ननवलानन- नागिन ममता 4नरमक ५ + के ताप-वालप + न-जमक पक -+ाका५ ५१3०५.
verses.wordMeaning: During the bright half (of the month), the Sraddha is to be performed in the forenoon by the skilful performer of a Sraddha. During the dark half, it should be performed in the afternoon. In any case the Rauhina period (the 4th Muhurta of the day), should not be transgressed.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the bright half (of the month), the Sraddha is to be performed in the forenoon by the skilful performer of a Sraddha. During the dark half, it should be performed in the afternoon. In any case the Rauhina period (the 4th Muhurta of the day), should not be transgressed.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तीर्थस्य चान्यानि पुण्यत्वाच्छुभदर्शनात् । पृथिव्यां सर्वतीर्थानि कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tīrthasya cānyāni puṇyatvācchubhadarśanāt / pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrthāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: Thus the great and noble souls, the seers of time and place, the Pitrs of great Yoga (yogic power) and great virility should be worshipped.
verses.hindi: के लिये इससे बढ़कर सरल उपाय कोई दूसरा नहीं है। इस लोक में इसके द्वारा परम संतोष की प्राप्ति होती है-+अतः यत्नपुबंक इसका अनुष्ठात करता चाहिए ।१०४-१०५॥ आलस्य-रहित होकर पर्ष-सल्धियों में जो व्यक्ति इस श्राद्ध विधि का पाठ सावध।नी एवंक सभा आदि में करता है, वह परम तेजस्वी मनुष्य संततिवाव होता है, ओर देवताओं के धमान उसे पवित्र लोक की प्राप्ति होती है ।१०६। जिस् अजन्‍्मा
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the great and noble souls, the seers of time and place, the Pitrs of great Yoga (yogic power) and great virility should be worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the great and noble souls, the seers of time and place, the Pitrs of great Yoga (yogic power) and great virility should be worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: तस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः । भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैस् तथान्यैर् द्विजसत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ / bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvais tathānyair dvijasattamaiḥ
verses.translation: A person always devoted to Pitrs attains the excellent Yoga. After eschewing both auspicious and inauspicious actions they attain salvation through meditation.
verses.hindi: भगवान् स्वयम्भू ने श्राद्ध की पुनीत विधि बतलाई है, उसे हम तमस्कार करते हैं ।!०७। महान् योगेश्वरों के चरणों में हम सर्बदा प्रणाम करते हैं । है तात  ये पित्तरमण देवताओं के भी देवता हैं, वे नाशहीन पितरगण इन सात स्थातों में नित्य निवास करते हैं। वे सब परम महात्मा तथा प्रजापति के पुत्र हैं, इनका सर्वप्रथम गण योगियों का है, अतः वे नित्य योगवर्धन के नाम से विख्यात हैं ।१००-१०९। द्वितीय गण देवताओं का, तृतीय देवताओं के शत्रुओं का, शेष अन्य वर्णियों के हैं--इन सबो का वर्णन कर चुका । इन सब लोकों में अवस्थित रहकर देवगण इन सबों की पूजा करते हैं। चारों आश्रम में निवास करते वाले क्रमपूबंक इनकी पूजा करते हैं, चारों वर्ण के लोग भी इन सबों की विधिपूर्वक पूजा करते हैं, इसी प्रकार समस्त म्लेच्छ जाति बाले और संकरवर्ण भी उन सबों की पूजा करते हैं। जो भक्ति पू्वक इन पितरों की पूछा
verses.wordMeaning: A person always devoted to Pitrs attains the excellent Yoga. After eschewing both auspicious and inauspicious actions they attain salvation through meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person always devoted to Pitrs attains the excellent Yoga. After eschewing both auspicious and inauspicious actions they attain salvation through meditation.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: शुक्लतीर्थस्य चोत्पत्तिमाकर्णय नरेश्वर । यस्य संदर्शनादेव ब्रह्महत्या प्रलीयते
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śuklatīrthasya cotpattimākarṇaya nareśvara / yasya saṃdarśanādeva brahmahatyā pralīyate
verses.translation: It is for the sake of (promotion of) sacrifices that after deluding the universe, it (Yoga) was eschewed and kept in the cavity (of the heart, i.e. kept secret) by the noble-souled Kasyapa.
verses.hindi: करता है, उसकी पूजा पितरगण स्वयं करते हैं, पुष्टि एवं पूजा की कामना करने वाले को ये पितामहादि प्ितिरगण सब प्रकार से पुष्टि, प्रजाएँ और स्वर प्रदान करते हैं ।११०-११३। पुत्र के लिए पितरों का कार्य
verses.wordMeaning: It is for the sake of (promotion of) sacrifices that after deluding the universe, it (Yoga) was eschewed and kept in the cavity (of the heart, i.e. kept secret) by the noble-souled Kasyapa.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is for the sake of (promotion of) sacrifices that after deluding the universe, it (Yoga) was eschewed and kept in the cavity (of the heart, i.e. kept secret) by the noble-souled Kasyapa.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी । यच्च बाल्यं कृतं पापं दर्शनादेव नश्यति
verses.transliteration: narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī / yacca bālyaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ darśanādeva naśyati
verses.translation: O excellent one among the knowers of Yoga, that nectarine (or immortal) Yoga, the eternal great Dharma was promulgated by Sanatkumara.
verses.hindi: देवकार्यादपि सुनो पित॒का्य विशिष्यते  देवतानां हि पितरः पू्बंसाप्यायन स्वयम् ११४ न हि योगगतिः सुक्ष्मा पितुर्णां च परा गतिः। तपसा विप्रकृष्टे न दृश्यते मांसचक्षुषा सर्वेषां राजतं पात्रमथवा रजतान्वितम् । पावन ह्यत्तमं प्रोक्तं देवानां पितृभिः सह ११६ येथां दास्पन्ति पिण्डांस्त्रीन्बास्धवा नासगोन्रतः । सुम्रों कुशोत्तरायां च अपसब्यविधानत:
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among the knowers of Yoga, that nectarine (or immortal) Yoga, the eternal great Dharma was promulgated by Sanatkumara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among the knowers of Yoga, that nectarine (or immortal) Yoga, the eternal great Dharma was promulgated by Sanatkumara.

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षदानि न सर्वत्र शुक्लतीर्थमृते नृप । शुक्लतीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं पुराणे यच्छ्रुतं मया
verses.transliteration: mokṣadāni na sarvatra śuklatīrthamṛte nṛpa / śuklatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ purāṇe yacchrutaṃ mayā
verses.translation: It is a great esoteric secret of the Devas. It is the grea¬ test resort of the sages. It can always (be attained) by the devo¬ tees of Pitrs through filial devotion, piety and endeavour.
verses.hindi: एवमेधा स्थिता संस्था बरह्मणा परमेष्ठिना । पित॒णामादिसगगंस्तु लोकानासक्षयाथिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is a great esoteric secret of the Devas. It is the grea¬ test resort of the sages. It can always (be attained) by the devo¬ tees of Pitrs through filial devotion, piety and endeavour.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a great esoteric secret of the Devas. It is the grea¬ test resort of the sages. It can always (be attained) by the devo¬ tees of Pitrs through filial devotion, piety and endeavour.

verses.sanskrit: समागमे मुनीनां तु देवानां हि तथैव च । कथितं देवदेवेन शितिकण्ठेन भारत । कैलासे पर्वतश्रेष्ठे तत्ते संकथयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: samāgame munīnāṃ tu devānāṃ hi tathaiva ca / kathitaṃ devadevena śitikaṇṭhena bhārata / kailāse parvataśreṣṭhe tatte saṃkathayāmyaham
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that one who is devoted to Pitrs shall, with endeavour, attain everything of that Yoga in essence.
verses.hindi: इत्येते पितरो देवा देवाभश्व पितरः पुतः । दोहित्रां यजमानाश्र प्रोक्ताश्नव सयाइनघा: ११२२ लोका दुह्तिरश्येव दौहित्राश्व सुतास्तथा  दानानि सह झोचेत तीर्थानि च फलाति सच १२३ अक्षयत्वं ट्विजाश्वेब यायावरविधिस्तथा । प्रोक्त सर्व यथान्यायं यथा ब्रह्माअब्नवीत्पुरा । रकमाज-ञकृतक-ग न - "आन वपप्यवान "कम्मयन्ान नकल मन भ+-००- ००-५५ करत ५० नानान न पट जोक ५ ७ न पिननापीयन- ५ +मौकियन “० पकूनननियानभपनाा क- पनरीननाण2ममकीण " प०५त निरपिियनीण पर नणकनतता+ फातक “लता वि लकिनश पल एएाण गण हा
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that one who is devoted to Pitrs shall, with endeavour, attain everything of that Yoga in essence.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that one who is devoted to Pitrs shall, with endeavour, attain everything of that Yoga in essence.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ तोषितुं गिरिजापतिम् । तपश्चचार विपुलं विष्णुर्वर्षसहस्रकम् । वायुभक्षो निराहारः शुक्लतीर्थे व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: purā kṛtayugasyādau toṣituṃ girijāpatim / tapaścacāra vipulaṃ viṣṇurvarṣasahasrakam / vāyubhakṣo nirāhāraḥ śuklatīrthe vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: To whom are the Sraddhas to be offered; which are the things that yield great benefits when given; what are the holy centres and sacred rivers wherein the Sraddha offered bears everlasting benefits; by what means does one attain heaven—all these have been mentioned to you in brief.
verses.hindi: देवकाय की अपेक्षा अधिक महत्त्वपूर्ण हे, देवताओं से पूर्व पितरों को सन्तुष्ठ करने की बात कही जाती है। पितरों की परम सूक्ष्म योगगति उत्कृष्ट तपस्या के प्रभाव से वंचित मांस के नेत्रों से नहीं दिखाई पड़ती अर्थात् उसे देखने के लिये परम कठोर तप की आवश्यकता है। समस्त देवताओं और पितरों के लिए चाँदी का पात्र विहित है, अभाव में चाँदी से समन्वित (मढ़ा हुआ) होना चाहिए । ऐसे पात्र इनके कार्यों में परम पुनीत कहे
verses.wordMeaning: To whom are the Sraddhas to be offered; which are the things that yield great benefits when given; what are the holy centres and sacred rivers wherein the Sraddha offered bears everlasting benefits;…
verses.commentary: Sense: To whom are the Sraddhas to be offered; which are the things that yield great benefits when given; what are the holy centres and sacred rivers wherein the Sraddha offered bears everlasting benefits;…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रत्यक्षतामागाद्देवदेवो महेश्वरः । प्रादुर्भूतस्तु सहसा तत्र तीर्थे नराधिप
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pratyakṣatāmāgāddevadevo maheśvaraḥ / prādurbhūtastu sahasā tatra tīrthe narādhipa
verses.translation: The man who after hearing this explanation of the procedure of Sraddhas, becomes malicious, is an atheist envelo¬ ped in darkness. He will drown himself in the terrible hell.
verses.hindi: जते हैं। जिनके परिवारवर्ग के लोग नाम और गोत्र का उच्चारण कर विधिपूर्वक अपसव्य होकर कुश बिछी भूमि पर तीन पिण्डदान करते हैं, उनके वे तीनों पिण्ड सर्वत्र वर्तमान रहनेबाले पितरों को प्रसन्न करते हैं। जन्यु (मनुष्य) जो आहार करता है, वही आहार उसके पितर का होना चाहिए ।११४-११४। जिस प्रकार चारागाह में सैकड़ों गौओं में छिपी हुई अपनी माता को बछड़ा पा जाता है, उसी प्रकार श्राद्धकमे में दिये गये पदार्थों को मंत्र वहाँ पर पहुंचा देता है, जहाँ वह जीव अवस्थित रहता है। पितरों के नाम, गोत्र और मंत्र श्राद्ध में दिये गये अन्न को उसके पास ले जाते हैं, चाहे वे सैकड़ों योनियों में क्‍यों न गये हों पर श्राद्ध के अन्नादि से उसकी तृत्ति होती है। परमेष्ठी पितामह ब्रह्मा ने इसी प्रकार की श्राद्ध की मर्यादा स्थिर की है, अक्षय लाभ की प्राप्ति के अभिलाषी लोगों के लिये पितरों की यह आदि सृष्टि हुई ।११८-१२१। ये पितरगण ही देवस्वरूप हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The man who after hearing this explanation of the procedure of Sraddhas, becomes malicious, is an atheist envelo¬ ped in darkness. He will drown himself in the terrible hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who after hearing this explanation of the procedure of Sraddhas, becomes malicious, is an atheist envelo¬ ped in darkness. He will drown himself in the terrible hell.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोशद्वयमिदं चक्रे भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् । तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: krośadvayamidaṃ cakre bhuktimuktipradāyakam / tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: He who has perfectly controlled his mind, finds all his great ailments terminated. He who is not mindful of the Airamas (stages in life) stated in the Vedas attains the Kumbhlka hell. He attains the status of a thief and gets his tongue cut.
verses.hindi: और देवगण ही पितर स्वरूप हैं। निष्पाप ऋषिगण, दौहित्र (नाती) गण उन पितरों के यजमान हैं। समस्त लोक उनकी पुत्री, नाती और पूत्र के रूप में है। श्राद्धकर्म में पवित्रता, दान, तीर्थ, फल, अक्षय फल प्राप्ति, द्विंज गण, पर्यटन विधि आदि सभी आवश्यक विषयों की चर्चा पूथ्वकाल में ब्रह्माजी ने जिस प्रकार को थी, उन सब विधि को मैं आप लोंगों से बतला चुका
verses.wordMeaning: He who has perfectly controlled his mind, finds all his great ailments terminated. He who is not mindful of the Airamas (stages in life) stated in the Vedas attains the Kumbhlka hell. He attains the status of a thief and gets his tongue cut.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has perfectly controlled his mind, finds all his great ailments terminated. He who is not mindful of the Airamas (stages in life) stated in the Vedas attains the Kumbhlka hell. He attains the status of a thief and gets his tongue cut.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गा कनखले पुण्या कुरुक्षेत्रे सरस्वती । ग्रामे वा यदि वारण्ये पुण्या सर्वत्र नर्मदा
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā kanakhale puṇyā kurukṣetre sarasvatī / grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā
verses.translation: Those who censure Yoga become lumps of clay in the ocean 1 and decay as long as the earth exists. Hence, this is the Dharma (virtue) intended in the Sraddha that it should be per¬ formed by a man with faith (in it).
verses.hindi: ७४५२ बायुपुराणम् सत्रे वे बितते पुर्व॑ तदा वर्बसहस्रिके । यस्मिन्गहपतिह्यसीद्ब्ह्मा वे देवता प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who censure Yoga become lumps of clay in the ocean 1 and decay as long as the earth exists. Hence, this is the Dharma (virtue) intended in the Sraddha that it should be per¬ formed by a man with faith (in it).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who censure Yoga become lumps of clay in the ocean 1 and decay as long as the earth exists. Hence, this is the Dharma (virtue) intended in the Sraddha that it should be per¬ formed by a man with faith (in it).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वौषधीनामशनं प्रधानं सर्वेषु पेयेषु जलं प्रधानम् । निद्रा सुखानां प्रमदा रतीनां सर्वेषु गात्रेषु शिरः प्रधानम्
verses.transliteration: sarvauṣadhīnāmaśanaṃ pradhānaṃ sarveṣu peyeṣu jalaṃ pradhānam / nidrā sukhānāṃ pramadā ratīnāṃ sarveṣu gātreṣu śiraḥ pradhānam
verses.translation: Scandalisation of Yogins should be scrupulously avoided. By scandalising (them), a person becomes a worm and rolls there itself.
verses.hindi: संवत्सरशतान्पच्च तत्रोपेता इति श्रुतिः। श्लोकाश्वात्र पुरा गीता ऋषिभिन्रह्मवादिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: Scandalisation of Yogins should be scrupulously avoided. By scandalising (them), a person becomes a worm and rolls there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Scandalisation of Yogins should be scrupulously avoided. By scandalising (them), a person becomes a worm and rolls there itself.

verses.sanskrit: स्नातस्यापि यथा पुण्यं ललाटं नृपसत्तम । शुक्लतीर्थं तथा पुण्यं नर्मदायां युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: snātasyāpi yathā puṇyaṃ lalāṭaṃ nṛpasattama / śuklatīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that he who censures Yoga, the cause of salvation unto those who meditate, goes to terrible hell. He who listens to it (the censure), also falls into the hell.
verses.hindi: दीक्षितस्य तदा सत्रे ब्रह्मण: परमात्मनः । तत्नेव जातमत्युग्न पितुणाम्क्षयाथिनास् ॥ लोकानां व् हितार्थाय ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना इति श्रीमहापुराणे बायुप्रोक्ते श्राद्धकत्पे नाम व्यशीतितमोअध्याय: ।5३)।।
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that he who censures Yoga, the cause of salvation unto those who meditate, goes to terrible hell. He who listens to it (the censure), also falls into the hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that he who censures Yoga, the cause of salvation unto those who meditate, goes to terrible hell. He who listens to it (the censure), also falls into the hell.

verses.sanskrit: सरितां च यथा गङ्गा देवतानां जनार्दनः । शुक्लतीर्थं तथा पुण्यं नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: saritāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā devatānāṃ janārdanaḥ / śuklatīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam
verses.translation: By denigrating masters of Yoga, a man certainly falls into the hell surrounded by darkness and terrible to behold.
verses.hindi: बहस्पति ने कह्ा--प्राचीन काल में ऋषियों द्वारा पूछे जाने पर महर्षि अंग्रिरा.ने पितरों के
verses.wordMeaning: By denigrating masters of Yoga, a man certainly falls into the hell surrounded by darkness and terrible to behold.
verses.commentary: Sense: By denigrating masters of Yoga, a man certainly falls into the hell surrounded by darkness and terrible to behold.

verses.sanskrit: चतुष्पदानां सुरभिर्वर्णानां ब्राह्मणो यथा । प्रधानं सर्वतीर्थानां शुक्लतीर्थं तथा नृप
verses.transliteration: catuṣpadānāṃ surabhirvarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā / pradhānaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ śuklatīrthaṃ tathā nṛpa
verses.translation: There is no doubt about it that he who pays heed to the vilification of masters of Yoga of fully controlled selves, be¬ comes submerged in the Kumbhlpaka hell for a long time.
verses.hindi: एक सहुस्न वर्ष तक चलनेवाला महायज्ञ सम्पन्न हुआ था, जिसमें गृहपति होकर भगवान् ब्रह्मा पाँच सो वर्षों तक देवताओं पर प्रभुत्व स्थापित किये रहे । ब्रह्मबेत्ता गण इस विषय में कुछ इलोक गाते हैं (जिसका आशय निम्न प्रकार है) उस महान यज्ञ में परमात्मा परमेष्ठी भगवान् ब्रह्मा के दीक्षित होने पर उन्हीं से समस्त लोकों के कल्याणार्थ, अक्षय लाभ के प्रार्थी पितरों का उत्तम जन्म वहीं पर सम्पन्न हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt about it that he who pays heed to the vilification of masters of Yoga of fully controlled selves, be¬ comes submerged in the Kumbhlpaka hell for a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt about it that he who pays heed to the vilification of masters of Yoga of fully controlled selves, be¬ comes submerged in the Kumbhlpaka hell for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहाणां तु यथादित्यो नक्षत्राणां यथा शशी । शिरो वा सर्वगात्राणां धर्माणां सत्यमिष्यते
verses.transliteration: grahāṇāṃ tu yathādityo nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā śaśī / śiro vā sarvagātrāṇāṃ dharmāṇāṃ satyamiṣyate
verses.translation: One should eschew hatred for Yogins mentally, verbally and physically. He will reap the benefit of the same here itself
verses.hindi: खूत बोले---अपने बुद्धिमान् पुत्र से पूछने पर इस प्रकार पूर्व काल में बृहस्पति ने पितरों के वक्ष का जो बर्णन किया था, वही मैंने आप लोगों को बतलाया । अब इसके उपरास्त मैं वरुण के :वंश का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: One should eschew hatred for Yogins mentally, verbally and physically. He will reap the benefit of the same here itself
verses.commentary: Sense: One should eschew hatred for Yogins mentally, verbally and physically. He will reap the benefit of the same here itself

verses.sanskrit: तथैव पार्थ तीर्थानां शुक्लतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । दुर्विज्ञेयो यथा लोके परमात्मा सनातनः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva pārtha tīrthānāṃ śuklatīrthamanuttamam / durvijñeyo yathā loke paramātmā sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: A person who has mastered (all lores) does not get (realize) the Atman. He wanders within the three worlds due to his own actions. A person who has mastered Rgveda, Yajurveda, Samaveda and all their ancillary subjects does not attain Brahman which is devoid of changes and aberrations ( avikaram ) and therefore, becomes distressed.
verses.hindi: कर रहा हूँ । सुनिये श्री बायुमहापुराण में श्रा्धकल्पतामक तिरासोयाँ अध्याय समाष्स ॥८३।॥।
verses.wordMeaning: A person who has mastered (all lores) does not get (realize) the Atman. He wanders within the three worlds due to his own actions. A person who has mastered Rgveda, Yajurveda,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who has mastered (all lores) does not get (realize) the Atman. He wanders within the three worlds due to his own actions. A person who has mastered Rgveda, Yajurveda,…

verses.sanskrit: सुसूक्ष्मत्वादनिर्देश्यः शुक्लतीर्थं तथा नृप । मन्दप्रज्ञत्वमापन्ने महामोहसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: susūkṣmatvādanirdeśyaḥ śuklatīrthaṃ tathā nṛpa / mandaprajñatvamāpanne mahāmohasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Verses 54-57, and vv. 61-71 show the blind faith of Puranic writers in Yogins. Since the times of Vasisjha Dh.S. XI. 17, Yatis (recluses) and Yogins had a special place of honour among the invitees to a Sraddha. But Purana writers have prohibited denigration of Yogis even orally.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तस्ततः सृतस्तथा।सोौ लोमहषंणः । शुश्रूषासुत्तराख्याने ऋषीणां वाक्यकोवबिदः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 54-57, and vv. 61-71 show the blind faith of Puranic writers in Yogins. Since the times of Vasisjha Dh.S. XI. 17, Yatis (recluses) and Yogins had a special place of honour among the invitees to a Sraddha. But Purana writers have prohibited denigration of Yogis even orally.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 54-57, and vv. 61-71 show the blind faith of Puranic writers in Yogins. Since the times of Vasisjha Dh.S. XI. 17, Yatis (recluses) and Yogins had a special place of honour among the invitees to a Sraddha. But Purana writers have prohibited denigration of Yogis even orally.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लतीर्थं ना जानाति नर्मदातटसंस्थितम् । बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन धर्मपुत्र पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: śuklatīrthaṃ nā jānāti narmadātaṭasaṃsthitam / bahunātra kimuktena dharmaputra punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective verse) 1 * * * He who has crossed the bounds of effects (of Prakrti) goes beyond Prakrti. Mastery, of the three Vedas leads to the crossing (of the limits?) of three gunas The (highest) principle is beyond the twentyfour Yogas (?). He is the master of all, who has passed beyond worldly existe¬ nce. (?)
verses.hindi: ब्रुवतो मे निबोधस्व ऋषिराह यथा मम ४ वरुणस्य पत्नी सामुद्री शुनादेवोत्युदाहृता । तस्याः पुत्रों कलिवेंचा: सुता च॒ सुरसुन्दरी
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) 1 * * * He who has crossed the bounds of effects (of Prakrti) goes beyond Prakrti. Mastery, of the three Vedas leads to the crossing (of the limits?) of three gunas The (highest) principle is beyond the twentyfour Yogas (?). He is the master of all,…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) 1 * * * He who has crossed the bounds of effects (of Prakrti) goes beyond Prakrti. Mastery, of the three Vedas leads to the crossing (of the limits?) of three gunas The (highest) principle is beyond the twentyfour Yogas (?). He is the master of all,…

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लतीर्थं महापुण्यं सम्प्राप्तं कल्मषक्षयात् । यो ऽत्र दत्ते शुचिर्भूत्वा एकं रेवाजलाञ्जलिम्
verses.transliteration: śuklatīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ samprāptaṃ kalmaṣakṣayāt / yo 'tra datte śucirbhūtvā ekaṃ revājalāñjalim
verses.translation: (Defective verse) By means of his Yogic power, a knower of Yogas withdraws unto himself the dissolution of the Atman, in the same manner as the entire creation of the princi¬ ples by the Atman. He alone becomes the master of all.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध विधि के प्रसंग में वरुण के बंश का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) By means of his Yogic power, a knower of Yogas withdraws unto himself the dissolution of the Atman, in the same manner as the entire creation of the princi¬ ples by the Atman. He alone becomes the master of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) By means of his Yogic power, a knower of Yogas withdraws unto himself the dissolution of the Atman, in the same manner as the entire creation of the princi¬ ples by the Atman. He alone becomes the master of all.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि पितरस्तेन तर्पिताः
verses.transliteration: kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi pitarastena tarpitāḥ
verses.translation: It is the knower of Yogas who knows the Vedas and at¬ tains the knowable. They call him the knower of the Vedas, and the master of Vedas.
verses.hindi: सूत के ऐसा कहने परम ऋषिगण परम हषित हुए और पुनः जिज्ञासा भाव से उनसे पूछा ऋषियों ने कहा---अमित तेजस्वी राजाओं के वंों का क्रमपू्वेंक वर्णन, उनकी स्थिति एवं उनके प्रभाव को हम लोग सुनना चाहते हैं, बतलाइये । लोमहषंण सृतजी, जो समस्त श्रोता ऋषियों के उत्तर देने में परम प्रवीण सुन्दर वाक्यों के बोलने में सुनिपुण, एवं प्राचीन आख्यानों के कुशल वक्ता थे, ऋषि के इस प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: It is the knower of Yogas who knows the Vedas and at¬ tains the knowable. They call him the knower of the Vedas, and the master of Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the knower of Yogas who knows the Vedas and at¬ tains the knowable. They call him the knower of the Vedas, and the master of Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: एकः पुत्रो धरापृष्ठे पित्ःणामार्तिनाशनः । चाणक्यो नाम राजाभूच्छुक्लतीर्थं च वेद सः
verses.transliteration: ekaḥ putro dharāpṛṣṭhe pitḥṇāmārtināśanaḥ / cāṇakyo nāma rājābhūcchuklatīrthaṃ ca veda saḥ
verses.translation: After duly knowing the knowable and what should be known (one becomes the knower of Vedas). They call him the knower of the Vedas. All others are thinkers of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: सूत ने कहा--ऋषि ने इस विषय में जो कुछ मुझसे बतलाया है उसे मैं बतला रहा हें, सुनिये । अमित तेजस्वी राजाओं के वंश उनकी स्थिति, एवं उनके प्रभाव का वर्णन मैं कर रहा हूं, सुनिये  वरुण की पत्नी सामुद्री थीं जो शुना देवी के नाम से पुकारी जाती हैं, उनके कलि और वंच्य नामक दो पुत्र हुए और एक पुत्री सुर सुन्दरी नामक हुई ।४-६। कलि के दो महाबलवान् पुत्र जय भोर विजय नामक हुए । वद्य के
verses.wordMeaning: After duly knowing the knowable and what should be known (one becomes the knower of Vedas). They call him the knower of the Vedas. All others are thinkers of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After duly knowing the knowable and what should be known (one becomes the knower of Vedas). They call him the knower of the Vedas. All others are thinkers of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: को ऽसौ द्विजवरश्रेष्ठ चाणक्यो नाम नामतः । शुक्लतीर्थस्य यो वेत्ता नान्यो वेत्ता हि कश्चन
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: ko 'sau dvijavaraśreṣṭha cāṇakyo nāma nāmataḥ / śuklatīrthasya yo vettā nānyo vettā hi kaścana
verses.translation: A person devoted to Pitrs attains the (fruit of) Yajfias, Vedas, all cherished desires, different kinds of knowledge, longevity, progeny and riches.
verses.hindi: कलिपुत्रो महावीयों जयश्न विजयश्व ह्। वेच्यपुत्रौ घृणिश्चेव मुनिश्चेव महाबलौ (७ प्रजानामत्तुकामानामन्योन्यस्य प्रभक्षिणो । भक्षयित्वा तावस्योन्यं विनाश समवापतुः ८ असुतान्यान्कले:ः पुन्नांश्चतुरः पुरुषादकान् । नाक विध्नं च विख्यातं सद्रम॑ं विधमं तथा १० अशिरस्कस्तयोविध्नो नाकश्चंवाशरीरवान् । सद्रमश्चेकहस्तो5भृद्विधमश्चेकपात्स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: A person devoted to Pitrs attains the (fruit of) Yajfias, Vedas, all cherished desires, different kinds of knowledge, longevity, progeny and riches.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person devoted to Pitrs attains the (fruit of) Yajfias, Vedas, all cherished desires, different kinds of knowledge, longevity, progeny and riches.

verses.sanskrit: केनोपायेन तत्तीर्थं तेन ज्ञातं धरातले । तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि परं कौतूहलं हि मे
verses.transliteration: kenopāyena tattīrthaṃ tena jñātaṃ dharātale / tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
verses.translation: He who invariably reads this Sraddhakalpa during Sraddha, in the end, gets all these (benefits) and the benefits of charitable gifts at the holy centres.
verses.hindi: बृहस्पतेरया भगिनी वरस्त्री ब्रह्मतारिणी । योगसिद्धा! जगत्कृत्स्नससक्ता चरते सदा (११४ प्रभासस्य तु सा भार्या वसुनामष्टसस्थ तु । विश्वकर्मा सुतस्तस्या जातः शिल्पिप्रजापतिः १६
verses.wordMeaning: He who invariably reads this Sraddhakalpa during Sraddha, in the end, gets all these (benefits) and the benefits of charitable gifts at the holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who invariably reads this Sraddhakalpa during Sraddha, in the end, gets all these (benefits) and the benefits of charitable gifts at the holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: इक्ष्वाकुप्रभवो राजा नप्ता शुद्धोदनस्य च । चाणक्यो नाम राजर्षिर् बुभुजे पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ikṣvākuprabhavo rājā naptā śuddhodanasya ca / cāṇakyo nāma rājarṣir bubhuje pṛthivīmimām
verses.translation: He shall be the sanctifier of the row (of diners). He shall be given priority in being fed among the Brahmanas. Or he shall (be eligible to) teach all the Brahmanas and attain all cherished desires.
verses.hindi: त्वष्टा विराजा रूपाणां ध्ंपौनत्र उदारधी: । कतई शिल्पसहल्लाणां त्रिदशानां व वास्तुकृतूु धणि और मुनि नामक दो महा बलवान पुत्र हुए । प्रजाओं के भक्षण करने को उत्सुक वे दोनों एक दूसरे को भक्षण करने को उद्यत हुए । और एक दूसरे को भक्षण कर विनाश को भी प्राप्त हुए । सुरा (शुना ?) के गर्भ से कलि की उत्पत्ति हुई, उसके पुत्र का नाम मद कहा जाता है। त्वष्टा की पुत्री हिसा कलि की स्त्री थी, जो ज्येष्ठ स्त्री थी, उसका नाम निक्ृति कहा जाता है ।७-६। उसने कलि के संयोग से जिन चार मनुष्य-
verses.wordMeaning: He shall be the sanctifier of the row (of diners). He shall be given priority in being fed among the Brahmanas. Or he shall (be eligible to) teach all the Brahmanas and attain all cherished desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be the sanctifier of the row (of diners). He shall be given priority in being fed among the Brahmanas. Or he shall (be eligible to) teach all the Brahmanas and attain all cherished desires.

verses.sanskrit: विक्रान्तो मतिमाञ्छूरः सर्वलोकैरवञ्चितः । वञ्चितः सहसा धूर्तवायसाभ्यां नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: vikrānto matimāñchūraḥ sarvalokairavañcitaḥ / vañcitaḥ sahasā dhūrtavāyasābhyāṃ nṛpottamaḥ
verses.translation: The text is defective and requires slight modifications as per the same verse printed in the Bd. 3.19.64 which means: "One who has mastered all created things, the products of Prakrti (the nature known as AvidyS), one
verses.hindi: भक्षी पन्नों को उत्पन्न किया, उनके नाम नाक, विध्न, सद्रम और विधम थे । अगले दोनों पुत्रों में विध्न नामक जो पृत्र था, वह शिर विहीन था, नाक अद्वरीरी था। सद्रम को केवल एक हाथ था, और (विधम एक पैर वाला कहा जाता था ।१०-११। सद्गम की पत्नी परम तमोगुण मयी पूतना नाम से विख्यात थो, विधम की पत्नी रेबती थी, इन दोनों के सहस्रों पुत्र थे । नाक की पत्नी का नाम शकुनि और विघ्न की पत्नी का नाम अयोगुखी था,
verses.wordMeaning: The text is defective and requires slight modifications as per the same verse printed in the Bd. 3.19.64 which means: "One who has mastered all created things, the products of Prakrti (the nature known as AvidyS), one
verses.commentary: Sense: The text is defective and requires slight modifications as per the same verse printed in the Bd. 3.19.64 which means: "One who has mastered all created things, the products of Prakrti (the nature known as AvidyS), one

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं स वञ्चितो राजा वायसाभ्यां कुतो ऽथवा । पुरा येन प्रतिज्ञातं धीगर्भेण महात्मना
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ sa vañcito rājā vāyasābhyāṃ kuto 'thavā / purā yena pratijñātaṃ dhīgarbheṇa mahātmanā
verses.translation: He who always listens to this after subduing anger, being without malice and becoming free fromgreed and delusion' attains endless heavenly pleasure.
verses.hindi: जिनके बड़े-बड़े भीषण शिर वाले राक्षस उत्पन्न हुए, जो दोनों सन्ध्याओं में विचरण करते रहते थे । रेवती ओर पृतना के पुत्र नेऋत नाम से विख्यात थे  ये समस्त राक्षस ग्रह रूप में लोगों को विशेषतया बालकों को कष्ट पहुँचाते थे। ब्रह्मा की आज्ञा से इन सबों के स्वामी सस्‍्कन्द (स्वामी कौर्तिकेय) हुए ।१२-१४। असक्त भाव से समस्त जगत में सवंदा विचरण करनेवाली ब्रह्मचारिणी एवं परम सुन्दरी योगसिद्धा नामक बृ-स्पति की जो भमिती थी, वह आठवें वसु प्रभास की भार्या थी । उप्के पुत्र शिल्पियों के प्रजापति (स्रष्ठा) विश्वकर्मा हुए । धर्म के पोत्र उदार बुद्धि विश्वकर्मा परम सुन्दर आकृति से सुशोभित थे, देवताओं के सहस्रों शिल्प- कर्मों के वे करनेवाले तथा वास्तु विज्ञान के वेत्ता थे । उन्होंने समस्त देवताओं के विमानों (उडने वाले रथों)
verses.wordMeaning: He who always listens to this after subduing anger, being without malice and becoming free fromgreed and delusion' attains endless heavenly pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who always listens to this after subduing anger, being without malice and becoming free fromgreed and delusion' attains endless heavenly pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: न जीवे वञ्चितो ऽन्येन प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्ये न संशयः । एतन्मे वद विप्रेन्द्र परं कौतूहलं मम
verses.transliteration: na jīve vañcito 'nyena prāṇāṃstyakṣye na saṃśayaḥ / etanme vada viprendra paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama
verses.translation: He attains the entire benefit of visiting holy centres, and making charitable gifts etc. This is the most excellent means to liberation. This is the greatest means of attaining heaven. He shall have the greatest contentment in this world too. Hence he should assiduously perform this.
verses.hindi: यः सर्वेषां विभानानि देवतानां चकार ह। मानुषाश्वोपजोवन्ति यस्य शिल्प भहात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: He attains the entire benefit of visiting holy centres, and making charitable gifts etc. This is the most excellent means to liberation. This is the greatest means of attaining heaven. He shall have the greatest contentment in this world too.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He attains the entire benefit of visiting holy centres, and making charitable gifts etc. This is the most excellent means to liberation. This is the greatest means of attaining heaven. He shall have the greatest contentment in this world too.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: आत्मानं वञ्चितं ज्ञात्वा तदा संगृह्य वायसौ । प्रेषयामास तीव्रेण दण्डेन यमसादनम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ātmānaṃ vañcitaṃ jñātvā tadā saṃgṛhya vāyasau / preṣayāmāsa tīvreṇa daṇḍena yamasādanam
verses.translation: He who reads these injunctions about (performance of) Sraddha attentively and with purity of mind, in the assembly (of the learned) during Parvan days, becomes endowed with children. With great brilliance, he attains the same region as that of the heaven-dwellers.
verses.hindi: देवचार्यस्य महतो विश्वकर्माधस्य धीमतः । विश्वकर्मात्मजश्चेव विश्वकर्मा भयः स्मृतः १२० असूत तपसा सा तु मनु ज्येष्ठ विवस्व॒तः । यमौ पुनरसुतासौ यम च यघु्नां च ह् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads these injunctions about (performance of) Sraddha attentively and with purity of mind, in the assembly (of the learned) during Parvan days, becomes endowed with children. With great brilliance, he attains the same region as that of the heaven-dwellers.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads these injunctions about (performance of) Sraddha attentively and with purity of mind, in the assembly (of the learned) during Parvan days, becomes endowed with children. With great brilliance, he attains the same region as that of the heaven-dwellers.

verses.sanskrit: वायसावूचतुः । सुन्दोपसुन्दयोः पुत्रावावां काकत्वमागतौ । मा वधीस्त्वं महाभाग कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे
verses.transliteration: vāyasāvūcatuḥ / sundopasundayoḥ putrāvāvāṃ kākatvamāgatau / mā vadhīstvaṃ mahābhāga kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare
verses.translation: Obeisance to that self-born deity by whom this Kalpa has been prescribed. I always bow down to the great masters of Yoga.
verses.hindi: स॒ तु गत्वा कुरून्देवी वडवारूपधारिणी । सवितुश्राश्वरूपस्य नासिकाम्यां तु तो स्मृतो २३ असृत सा महाभागा व्वस्तरीक्षेश्चिनौं किल । नासत्यं चंव दर्ल च मारतंण्डस्याउपत्सजावुभोी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to that self-born deity by whom this Kalpa has been prescribed. I always bow down to the great masters of Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to that self-born deity by whom this Kalpa has been prescribed. I always bow down to the great masters of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: तावावां कृतसंकल्पौ त्वया कोपेन मानद । निरस्तावनिरस्तौ वा यास्यावः परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tāvāvāṃ kṛtasaṃkalpau tvayā kopena mānada / nirastāvanirastau vā yāsyāvaḥ paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: O dear one, these Pitrs are the deities of Devas. Pitrs are stationed in these seven abodes for ever. They are free from pain.
verses.hindi: कस्सास्मार्तण्ड इत्येष विवस्वानुच्यते बुधेः  किमर्थ साश्वरूपा वे नासिकाभ्यामसुयत ॥। की रचना की थी । उन्हीं परम महात्मा द्वारा प्रचालित शिल्प कम के आश्रय से मनृष्य लोग आज भी अपनी जीविका चलाते हैं ।१५-१८। उन विश्वकर्मा की पत्ती विरोचना थी, जो प्रह्लादी नाम से भी विख्यात थी, वह विरोचन की भगिनी और तिशिरा की माता थी । परम बुद़िमान् विश्वकर्मा देवताओं में शिल्पकर्म के आचाय॑ थे, उनका पुत्र मय भी उसी प्रकार शिल्प कर्म में निपुण होने के कारण विश्वकर्मा नाम से विख्यात हुआ ।
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one, these Pitrs are the deities of Devas. Pitrs are stationed in these seven abodes for ever. They are free from pain.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, these Pitrs are the deities of Devas. Pitrs are stationed in these seven abodes for ever. They are free from pain.

verses.sanskrit: तदादेशय राजेन्द्र कृत्वा तव महत्प्रियम् । मुक्तशापौ भविष्यावो ब्रह्मणो वचनं तथा
verses.transliteration: tadādeśaya rājendra kṛtvā tava mahatpriyam / muktaśāpau bhaviṣyāvo brahmaṇo vacanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: All these noble souls are the sons of Prajapati. The first group is that of Yogins. That is eternal and is ever conducive to the increase in the Yogic Power (of Yogins).
verses.hindi: उस मयकी छोटी बहन, विश्वकर्मा की पुत्री सुरेण नाम से विख्यात थी, जो संज्ञा नाम से सूये की पत्नी हुई । उसने अपने परम तपोबल द्वारा सूर्य के ज्येष्ठ पुत्र सन को उत्पन्न किया । सतदननन्‍्तर उसके यम नाभक पुत्र और यमुना नाम की एक पुत्री- दोनों को जुड़वा उत्पन्न किया ।१६-२२। फिर उस देवी ने कुरु देश में जाकर वडवा (घोड़ी) का रूप धारण किया और अश्वरूप घारण करनेवाले सूर्थ के संयोग से आकाश में
verses.wordMeaning: All these noble souls are the sons of Prajapati. The first group is that of Yogins. That is eternal and is ever conducive to the increase in the Yogic Power (of Yogins).
verses.commentary: Sense: All these noble souls are the sons of Prajapati. The first group is that of Yogins. That is eternal and is ever conducive to the increase in the Yogic Power (of Yogins).

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा काकवचनं चाणक्यो नृपसत्तमः । नाहं जीवे विदित्वैवं वञ्चितः केन कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā kākavacanaṃ cāṇakyo nṛpasattamaḥ / nāhaṃ jīve viditvaivaṃ vañcitaḥ kena karhicit
verses.translation: All Devas worship them. They are stationed in them (Pitrs). The four Airamas too successively worship them. The four castes also worship them in accordance with the injunc¬ tions. Similarly the mixed castes and the Mlecchas (alien out- castes) also worship them.
verses.hindi: अपनी नांसिका के दोनों छिद्रों द्वारा नासत्य और दख नामक दो पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया, जो दोनों मातंण्डि (सूर्य के पुत्र) कहे जाते हैं, ऐसी प्रसिद्धि है ... ऋ्षियाँ ने पूछा--पण्डित लोग सूर्य को मार्तण्ड किस लिये कहा करते हैं, किस कारणवश संज्ञा ने बड़वा का रूप धारण किया ओर किस प्रकार अपनी नासिका के छिद्रों से पुत्र उत्पन्न किया--इस बात को हम लोग सुनना चाहते हैं-- विस्तारपुरवंक बतलाये
verses.wordMeaning: All Devas worship them. They are stationed in them (Pitrs). The four Airamas too successively worship them. The four castes also worship them in accordance with the injunc¬ tions. Similarly the mixed castes and the Mlecchas (alien out- castes) also worship them.
verses.commentary: Sense: All Devas worship them. They are stationed in them (Pitrs). The four Airamas too successively worship them. The four castes also worship them in accordance with the injunc¬ tions. Similarly the mixed castes and the Mlecchas (alien out- castes) also worship them.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तीर्थं विजानीतं यमस्य सदने द्विजौ । प्रेषयामि यथान्यायं श्रुत्वा तत्कथयिष्यथः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttīrthaṃ vijānītaṃ yamasya sadane dvijau / preṣayāmi yathānyāyaṃ śrutvā tatkathayiṣyathaḥ
verses.translation: Pitrs revere him who devotedly worships Pitrs. Pitrs in the form of grandfather grant nourishment, progeny and heavenly pleasure to him who desires nourishment or who desires progeny.
verses.hindi: सूतजी ने कह्ा--प्राचीनकाल में सुय॑ं देव एक अण्डे के रूप में उत्पन्न हुए थे, बहुत दिवों
verses.wordMeaning: Pitrs revere him who devotedly worships Pitrs. Pitrs in the form of grandfather grant nourishment, progeny and heavenly pleasure to him who desires nourishment or who desires progeny.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitrs revere him who devotedly worships Pitrs. Pitrs in the form of grandfather grant nourishment, progeny and heavenly pleasure to him who desires nourishment or who desires progeny.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव मुक्तौ तौ काकौ स्रक्चन्दनविभूषितौ । शीघ्रगौ प्रेषयामास यमस्य सदनं प्रति
verses.transliteration: tenaiva muktau tau kākau srakcandanavibhūṣitau / śīghragau preṣayāmāsa yamasya sadanaṃ prati
verses.translation: To a son, the rite for Pitrs is preferable to the rite for Devas. Pitrs are to be propitiated even before Devas.
verses.hindi: यम्मातंण्डो भवेत्युक्तः पिन्राउण्डे वे द्विधा कृते । तस्मादिवस्वान्मातेण्डः पुराणज्ञविभाष्ते.. ७२६ विवस्वान्कश्यपाज्जन्ञे दाक्षायण्यां महायशाः ॥ तस्य भार्याभवत्त्वाष्ट्री महादेवी विवस्वतः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: To a son, the rite for Pitrs is preferable to the rite for Devas. Pitrs are to be propitiated even before Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: To a son, the rite for Pitrs is preferable to the rite for Devas. Pitrs are to be propitiated even before Devas.

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच: तत्र धर्मपुरं गत्वा विचरन्तावितस्ततः । यदि पृच्छति धर्मात्मा यमः संयमनो महान्
verses.transliteration: rājovāca: tatra dharmapuraṃ gatvā vicarantāvitastataḥ / yadi pṛcchati dharmātmā yamaḥ saṃyamano mahān
verses.translation: The subtle movement of the Yogic power of Pitrs is in-
verses.hindi: आदित्यस्य हि तद्॒पं मार्तण्डस्थ हि तेजसा। गात्रेषु प्रतिरुद्ध वे नातिकान्तमिवाभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: The subtle movement of the Yogic power of Pitrs is in-
verses.commentary: Sense: The subtle movement of the Yogic power of Pitrs is in-

verses.sanskrit: कुतो वामागतं ब्रूतं केन वा भूषितावुभौ । मदीया भारती तस्य कथनीया ह्यशङ्कितम्
verses.transliteration: kuto vāmāgataṃ brūtaṃ kena vā bhūṣitāvubhau / madīyā bhāratī tasya kathanīyā hyaśaṅkitam
verses.translation: To all of them a silver vessel or one accompanied with silver is ordained. It is said to be sanctifying and excellent (for the rites) of Devas along with (those of) Pit r s.
