verses.sanskrit: अदत्त्वा दंशमशकैर्भक्ष्यन्ते जन्यसप्ततिम् । पितुर्द्रव्यापहर्तारस्ताडनक्रोशने रताः
verses.transliteration: adattvā daṃśamaśakairbhakṣyante janyasaptatim / piturdravyāpahartārastāḍanakrośane ratāḥ
verses.translation: "Since you are threatening the renowned wife of your father, this leg of yours will undoubtedly fall off."
verses.hindi: सुचन्द्र इति बिश्यातो हेमचन्द्रादनन्तरम् । सुचन्ब्रतनयो राजा धूम्राश्व इति विश्वुतः १८ धम्राश्वतनयो विद्वान्युआजयः समपच्चयत  सृअ्जयस्य सुतः श्रीमान्सहदेवः प्रतापवान्
verses.wordMeaning: "Since you are threatening the renowned wife of your father, this leg of yours will undoubtedly fall off."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Since you are threatening the renowned wife of your father, this leg of yours will undoubtedly fall off."

verses.sanskrit: पीडनं क्रियते तेषां यत्र तौ युग्मपर्वतौ । या सा वैतरणी घोरा नदी रक्तप्रवाहिनी
verses.transliteration: pīḍanaṃ kriyate teṣāṃ yatra tau yugmaparvatau / yā sā vaitaraṇī ghorā nadī raktapravāhinī
verses.translation: With his mind deeply afflicted due to that curse, Yama of virtuous soul reported everythin g to his father, along with Manu (i.e. accompanied by him.)
verses.hindi: हुए  आविशक्षित् ने अपने गुणों द्वारा अपने. पिता का अतिक्रमण किया, उनके पुत्र परमधर्मात्मा, चक्रतरतियों के समान प्रभावशाली राजा मनुत्त (महत्त) नामक हुए, जिन्होंने संव्तं नामक ऋषि की प्रेरणा से अपने मित्रों, तथा परिवार वर्ग वालों के साथ स्वगगं प्राप्त किया । इस कार्य में संवर्त और बृहस्पति के बीच में महान् विवाद छ्ड़ा हो गया। उस यज्ञ की समृद्धि को देखकर बृहस्पति क्रूढ हुए ८-१० संवर्ते के निविष्त यज्ञ समाप्त कर देने पर तो वे बहुत क्रद्ध हुए , समस्त लोकों के क्नाश की सम्भावना देखकर देवताओं ने ब्रृहस्पति को प्रसन्न किया । चक्रवर्ती राजा मनुत्त ने पुत्र छूप में नरिष्यन्त को प्राप्त क्रिया, नरिष्यन्त का उत्तराधिकारी पुत्र दम हुआ, जो दण्ड देने में बड़ा कठोर था। उसका पुत्र राष्ट्रवर्धन पराक्रमी था। उसका पुत्र सुधृती और सुधृती का पुत्र नर हुआ ।११-१३॥ उसका पुत्र केवल हुआ, केवल का पुत्र बच्चुमान हुआ। बन्चुमान का उतर
verses.wordMeaning: With his mind deeply afflicted due to that curse, Yama of virtuous soul reported everythin g to his father, along with Manu (i.e. accompanied by him.)
verses.commentary: Sense: With his mind deeply afflicted due to that curse, Yama of virtuous soul reported everythin g to his father, along with Manu (i.e. accompanied by him.)

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्ति रुधिरं तत्र ये ऽभियान्ति रजस्वलाम् । असिपत्रवने घोरे पीड्यन्ते पापकारिणः
verses.transliteration: pibanti rudhiraṃ tatra ye 'bhiyānti rajasvalām / asipatravane ghore pīḍyante pāpakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: "I am much distressed due to the fear of the curse (tak¬ ing effect). I have been defeated (?) by the (statement) words of Saiiijfia. (This mistake is) due to my childishness or delusion. Sir, please protect me.
verses.hindi: परम धर्मात्मा राजा वेगवान हुआ । वेगवान का पुत्र बुध और बुध का पुत्र तृणविन्दु हुआ, यह राजा तृणविन्दु तीसरे त्रेतायुग के प्रारम्भ काल में विद्यमान था ।१४-१३॥ उस (तृणविन्दु) की कन्या द्रविडा थो जो विश्ववा की माता थी। इसका पुत्र परम धार्मिक राजा विशाल हुआ, इसी राजा विज्ञाल ने विशाला नामक पुरी का निर्माण किया था, राजा विज्ञाल के पुत्र महाबलवान् राजा हेमचर्व हुए। हेमचर्ः के उपदान्त उनके पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: "I am much distressed due to the fear of the curse (tak¬ ing effect). I have been defeated (?) by the (statement) words of Saiiijfia. (This mistake is) due to my childishness or delusion. Sir, please protect me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am much distressed due to the fear of the curse (tak¬ ing effect). I have been defeated (?) by the (statement) words of Saiiijfia. (This mistake is) due to my childishness or delusion. Sir, please protect me.

verses.sanskrit: परपीडाकरा नित्यं ये नरो ऽन्त्यजगामिनः । गुरुदाररतानां तु महापातकिनामपि
verses.transliteration: parapīḍākarā nityaṃ ye naro 'ntyajagāminaḥ / gurudāraratānāṃ tu mahāpātakināmapi
verses.translation: O lord of the worlds, foremost one among those who
verses.hindi: राजा सुचन्द्र की ख्याति हुई। राजा सुचन्द्र का पुत्र धूमाक्व नाम से विख्यात हुमा ।१६-१८। राजा धूमाध्व के पुत्र परम विद्वान् राजा सुञ्जय उत्पन्न हुए। सृञुजय के पुत्र श्रीमान् परम प्रताषी सहदेव हुए । सह॒देव के ७६ ष्द वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of the worlds, foremost one among those who
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the worlds, foremost one among those who

verses.sanskrit: शिलावगूहनं तेषां जायते जन्मसप्ततिम् । ज्वलन्तीमायसीं घोरां बहुकण्टकसंवृताम्
verses.transliteration: śilāvagūhanaṃ teṣāṃ jāyate janmasaptatim / jvalantīmāyasīṃ ghorāṃ bahukaṇṭakasaṃvṛtām
verses.translation: Thus implored, lord Vivasvan spoke to Yama: "O son, undoubtedly there will be a great reason behind this (incident).
verses.hindi: कुशाश्वः सहदेवस्य पुत्र: परमाधमिक: । कृशाश्वस्य महातेजा: सोमदत्तः प्रतापवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus implored, lord Vivasvan spoke to Yama: "O son, undoubtedly there will be a great reason behind this (incident).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus implored, lord Vivasvan spoke to Yama: "O son, undoubtedly there will be a great reason behind this (incident).

verses.sanskrit: शाल्मलीं ते ऽवगूहन्ति परदाररता हि ये । परस्य योषितं हृत्वा ब्रह्मस्वमपहृत्य च
verses.transliteration: śālmalīṃ te 'vagūhanti paradāraratā hi ye / parasya yoṣitaṃ hṛtvā brahmasvamapahṛtya ca
verses.translation: That was why anger took possession of you who are the knower of virtue and the speaker of the truth. The words of your mother too cannot be falsified.
verses.hindi: तृणबिन्दुप्रसादेन सर्वे वशालका नृपा: । दीर्घायुषों महात्मानों वीय॑बन्तः सुधामिकः रेवस्य रवतः पुत्र: ककुझी नाम धार्मिक: । ज्येष्ठो भ्रातृशतस्था55सीद्राजा प्राप्य कुशस्थलीम्
verses.wordMeaning: That was why anger took possession of you who are the knower of virtue and the speaker of the truth. The words of your mother too cannot be falsified.
verses.commentary: Sense: That was why anger took possession of you who are the knower of virtue and the speaker of the truth. The words of your mother too cannot be falsified.

verses.sanskrit: अरण्ये निर्जले देशे स भवेत्क्रूरराक्षसः । देवस्वं ब्राह्मणस्वं च लोभेनैवाहरेच्च यः
verses.transliteration: araṇye nirjale deśe sa bhavetkrūrarākṣasaḥ / devasvaṃ brāhmaṇasvaṃ ca lobhenaivāharecca yaḥ
verses.translation: In this way, your mother's words will be true and effec¬ tive. By removal of the curse, you will also be saved." Aditya then spoke to Samjna, "When the sons are all equal, why is more affection shown by you towards one?"
verses.hindi: कन्यया सह श्रुत्वा च गान्धर्व ब्रह्मणोन्तिके । मुह्॒तं देवदेवस्य साय बहुयुगं विभोः २६
verses.wordMeaning: In this way, your mother's words will be true and effec¬ tive. By removal of the curse, you will also be saved." Aditya then spoke to Samjna, "When the sons are all equal, why is more affection shown by you towards one?"
verses.commentary: Sense: In this way, your mother's words will be true and effec¬ tive. By removal of the curse, you will also be saved." Aditya then spoke to Samjna, "When the sons are all equal, why is more affection shown by you towards one?"

verses.sanskrit: स पापात्मा परे लोके गृध्रोच्छिष्टेन जीवति । एवमादीनि पापानि भुञ्जन्ते यमशासनात्
verses.transliteration: sa pāpātmā pare loke gṛdhrocchiṣṭena jīvati / evamādīni pāpāni bhuñjante yamaśāsanāt
verses.translation: Avoiding (the necessity of disclosing the secret) she did not say anything to Vivasvan. But by means of his Yogic power and concentration, the Sun found out the truth.
verses.hindi: भोजवुृष्ण्यन्धकंगुंप्ता वसुदेवपुरोगमः । तां कथां रंबत: श्रुत्वा यथातत्त्वमरिदम: २८ +कन्यां तु बलदेवाय सुब्रतां नाम रेवतीम् । दत्त्वा जगाम शिखरं मेरोस्तपसि संस्थितः २६ पुत्र कुशाइव हुए, जो परम धार्मिक राजा थे । इक्षाइव के पुत्र परम प्रतापी महान् तेजस्वी राजा सोमदत्त हुए । राजषि सोमदत्त के पुत्र जनमेजय हुए। राजा जनमेजय के पुत्र प्रमति नाम से विख्यात हुए ।१६-२१। राजा तृणविन्दु की कृपा से ये सभी विद्वाला पुरी के नृपतिगण, दीर्घायुवाले, परम पराक्रमी, परम धामिक एवं महात्मा हुए । राजा शर्याति की दो सन्ततियाँ हुईं। पुत्र का नाम आनते और कन्या का नाम सुकन्या था,
verses.wordMeaning: Avoiding (the necessity of disclosing the secret) she did not say anything to Vivasvan. But by means of his Yogic power and concentration, the Sun found out the truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Avoiding (the necessity of disclosing the secret) she did not say anything to Vivasvan. But by means of his Yogic power and concentration, the Sun found out the truth.

verses.sanskrit: येषां तु दर्शनादेव श्रवणाज्जायते भयम् । तथा दानफलं चान्ये भुञ्जाना यममन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ tu darśanādeva śravaṇājjāyate bhayam / tathā dānaphalaṃ cānye bhuñjānā yamamandire
verses.translation: The infuriated Sun-god was about to curse her bringing about her destruction. She then confessed factually everything to Vivasvan. On hearing it, Vivasvan was enraged and hastened to Tvastr. Tvastr honoured with due formalities the Sun-god who wanted to burn down everything. He pacified him slowly saying: "Your present form which is excessively dazzling, is not attractive.
verses.hindi: सुकन्या च्यवन की स्त्री हुई। राजा आनते का उत्तराधिकारी परम पराक्रमी रेव नामक राजा हुआ, आनते का समस्त राज्य और कृञ्नस्थली पुरी पर उसका आधिपत्य था।२२-२४। रेव का पुत्र परम धामिक रेवत हुआ, जो ककुझी नाम से भी विख्यात् हुआ । ककुझी अपने अन्य सौ भाइयों में सब से ज्येष्ठ थे, इन्होंने भी कुश€्यली पुरी में रज्य किया । एक बार अपनी कन्या के साथ यह ब्रह्मा के समीप संगीत सुनने के लिए गये
verses.wordMeaning: The infuriated Sun-god was about to curse her bringing about her destruction. She then confessed factually everything to Vivasvan. On hearing it, Vivasvan was enraged and hastened to Tvastr. Tvastr honoured with due formalities the Sun-god who wanted to burn down everything.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The infuriated Sun-god was about to curse her bringing about her destruction. She then confessed factually everything to Vivasvan. On hearing it, Vivasvan was enraged and hastened to Tvastr. Tvastr honoured with due formalities the Sun-god who wanted to burn down everything.…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टाः श्रुतं कथयतां दूतानां च यमाज्ञया । रथैरन्ये गजैरन्ये केचिद्वाजिभिर् आवृताः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭāḥ śrutaṃ kathayatāṃ dūtānāṃ ca yamājñayā / rathairanye gajairanye kecidvājibhir āvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: It is because she could not endure it that Saihjna is wandering in the forests and meadows. You will see your wife of auspicious conduct today itself.
verses.hindi: थे, वहाँ देवाधिदेव ब्रह्मा के केवल एक मृहूतं॑ (दो घड़ी) भर इत्होंते अवस्थान किया था, किन्तु ब्रह्मा की वह दो घड़ी मानव वर्षमान से अनेक युगों की थी। वहाँ से राजा युवावस्था में ही अपनी पुरी को जब वापस लौटे तो उनकी वह पुरी यदुवंशियों से अधिकृत थी, उसके चारों ओर अनेक सुन्दर द्वार बने थे और अब वह कुशस्थली नाम से नहीं प्रत्युत रवती नाम से प्रसिद्ध थी ।२५-२७। बसुदेव प्रभृति प्रमुख भोज, वृष्णि एवं अख्धक वंशों के लोग उसकी रक्षा कर रहे थे। शत्रुओं को वश में करने वाले रैवत ने इस घटना को जानकर अपनो साध्वी ब्रतपरायण कन्या रेवती को बलदेव को समर्पित कर दिया, और स्वयं मेर के शिखर पर जाकर
verses.wordMeaning: It is because she could not endure it that Saihjna is wandering in the forests and meadows. You will see your wife of auspicious conduct today itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is because she could not endure it that Saihjna is wandering in the forests and meadows. You will see your wife of auspicious conduct today itself.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टास्तत्र महाभाग तपःसंचयसंस्थिताः । गोदाता स्वर्णदाता च भूमिरत्नप्रदा नराः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭāstatra mahābhāga tapaḥsaṃcayasaṃsthitāḥ / godātā svarṇadātā ca bhūmiratnapradā narāḥ
verses.translation: O lord of rays, by using your Yogic power, you will see your praiseworty wife superbly endowed with youthful charm. Everything will be favourable if my condition is accepted. O suppressor of enemies! At the outset, I shall change your personal form into an excellent one". The form of Vivasvan, then, was sideways, upwards and below (i.c. the rays were diffused everywhere). Hence Divaspati (the Sun-god) was ashamed of that form. So the deity of great penance praised the wheel of Tvastr. Tvastr was then permitted to change the form. With the concurrence of the Sun-god (Martanda Vivasvan), Tvastr mounted him on the wheel and whetted his brilliance. Then the brilliance had pleasant refulgence due to reduction in dazzle.
verses.hindi: अत्रेवाध्यायसमाप्ति: ख. घ. पुस्तकयोः। +कर्पों तु बलदेवाय इत्यारभ्य सप्ताशीतितमाध्यायस्य-
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of rays, by using your Yogic power, you will see your praiseworty wife superbly endowed with youthful charm. Everything will be favourable if my condition is accepted. O suppressor of enemies! At the outset, I shall change your personal form into an excellent one".…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of rays, by using your Yogic power, you will see your praiseworty wife superbly endowed with youthful charm. Everything will be favourable if my condition is accepted. O suppressor of enemies! At the outset, I shall change your personal form into an excellent one".…

verses.sanskrit: शय्याशनगृहादीनां स लोकः कामदो नृणाम् । अन्नं पानीयसहितं ददते ये ऽत्र मानवाः
verses.transliteration: śayyāśanagṛhādīnāṃ sa lokaḥ kāmado nṛṇām / annaṃ pānīyasahitaṃ dadate ye 'tra mānavāḥ
verses.translation: The refulgence became very pleasing to behold. What was inauspicious before shone splendidly. Then (the Sun) made use of Yogic power and saw his wife in the form of a mare.
verses.hindi: रेमे रामश्र धर्मात्मा रेवत्या सहितः किल । तां कथामृषयः श्रुत्वा पप्रच्छुस्तदनन्तरम् १३० कर्थ बहुयुगे काले व्यतीते सुतनन्दन । न जरां रेवतो प्राप्ता पलितं च कुतः प्रभो
verses.wordMeaning: The refulgence became very pleasing to behold. What was inauspicious before shone splendidly. Then (the Sun) made use of Yogic power and saw his wife in the form of a mare.
verses.commentary: Sense: The refulgence became very pleasing to behold. What was inauspicious before shone splendidly. Then (the Sun) made use of Yogic power and saw his wife in the form of a mare.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तृप्ताः सुसंतुष्टाः क्रीडन्ते यमसादने । अत्र यद्दीयते दानमपि वालाग्रमात्रकम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tṛptāḥ susaṃtuṣṭāḥ krīḍante yamasādane / atra yaddīyate dānamapi vālāgramātrakam
verses.translation: She had been invisible to all living beings due to her brilliance and observance of rites. In the form of a horse, Mar¬ tanda approached her and declared his love. In the physical activity of sexual intercourse, she suspec¬ ted him to be someone other than her lord. She therefore dis¬ charged the semen virile of Vivasvan through her nostrils.
verses.hindi: कियन्तो वा सुरगणा गन्धर्वास्तत्र कीद्शा:। यच्छ त्वा रबतः कालान्मुह॒तंमिव मन्यते ३३
verses.wordMeaning: She had been invisible to all living beings due to her brilliance and observance of rites. In the form of a horse, Mar¬ tanda approached her and declared his love. In the physical activity of sexual intercourse, she suspec¬ ted him to be someone other than her lord.…
verses.commentary: Sense: She had been invisible to all living beings due to her brilliance and observance of rites. In the form of a horse, Mar¬ tanda approached her and declared his love. In the physical activity of sexual intercourse, she suspec¬ ted him to be someone other than her lord.…

verses.sanskrit: तदक्षयफलं सर्वं शुक्लतीर्थे नृपोत्तम । एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं यद्दृष्टं यच्च वै श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ śuklatīrthe nṛpottama / etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ yacca vai śrutam
verses.translation: From that semen were born the twin gods Asvins, the excellent physicians, Nasatya and Dasra. They are remembered as Asvins.
verses.hindi: न जरा क्षुत्पिपासा वा न च सृत्युभयं ततः। न च् रोगः प्रभवति ब्रह्मतोकगतस्य हि गान्धर्व प्रति यच्चापि पृष्ठस्तु मुनिसत्तमाः । ततोहह संप्रवक्ष्यासि याथातथ्येन सुन्नताः
verses.wordMeaning: From that semen were born the twin gods Asvins, the excellent physicians, Nasatya and Dasra. They are remembered as Asvins.
verses.commentary: Sense: From that semen were born the twin gods Asvins, the excellent physicians, Nasatya and Dasra. They are remembered as Asvins.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुष्व यदभिप्रेतं यदि शक्नोषि मुच्यताम् । तयोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चाणक्यो हृष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: kuruṣva yadabhipretaṃ yadi śaknoṣi mucyatām / tayostadvacanaṃ śrutvā cāṇakyo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: They are the sons of Martanda, the eighth Prajapati. Bhaskara (the Sun-god) showed his beautiful form to her. On seeing him the wife was satisfied and fascinated. Yama was much afflicted in the mind due to that curse.
verses.hindi: सप्त स्व॒रास्त्रयों ग्रामा मुछ॑नास्त्वेकाविशति: । तालाभ्रेकोनपण्चाशदित्येतत्स्वरमण्डलम्
verses.wordMeaning: They are the sons of Martanda, the eighth Prajapati. Bhaskara (the Sun-god) showed his beautiful form to her. On seeing him the wife was satisfied and fascinated. Yama was much afflicted in the mind due to that curse.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the sons of Martanda, the eighth Prajapati. Bhaskara (the Sun-god) showed his beautiful form to her. On seeing him the wife was satisfied and fascinated. Yama was much afflicted in the mind due to that curse.

verses.sanskrit: विसर्जयामास खगावभिनन्द्य पुनःपुनः । ताभ्यां गताभ्यां सर्वस्वं दत्त्वा विप्रेषु भारत
verses.transliteration: visarjayāmāsa khagāvabhinandya punaḥpunaḥ / tābhyāṃ gatābhyāṃ sarvasvaṃ dattvā vipreṣu bhārata
verses.translation: He pleased (all) by means of his Dharma. Then ne became known as Dharmaraja. By means of his auspicious acti¬ vity, he became extremely refulgent and attained the lordship of Pitrs and guardianship of the quarters. Savarni Manu of great fame shall become the Manu in the Savarnika Manvan- tara. Even today the holy lord performs penance on the beautiful ridge of the Meru mountain.
verses.hindi: तपस्या में प्रवत्त हुए। यह सर्वप्रसिद्ध बात है कि बलराम जी ने रेवती के साथ दाम्पत्य सुख का अनुभव किया । (सूत से) ऐसी कथा सुनने के उपरान्त ऋषियों ने पुछा ऋ:पषयों ने पूछा- सृतनन्दन ! यह कंसे सम्भव हुआ कि अनेक युगों के बीत जाने पर भी रेवती में वृद्धत्व का समागम नहीं हुआ और उसके अंगों में पलित का भी आभास नहीं हुआ और मेरु पबंत पर तपस्या चले जाने पर राजा शर्याति को सन्‍्तति प्राप्ति किस प्रकार हुई, जो आज भी प्रथ्वी में उनके नाम से विख्यात है। इसको हम यथाथेतः सुनना चाहते हैं। ब्रह्मा की उस सभा में कितने देवता निवास
verses.wordMeaning: He pleased (all) by means of his Dharma. Then ne became known as Dharmaraja. By means of his auspicious acti¬ vity, he became extremely refulgent and attained the lordship of Pitrs and guardianship of the quarters.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He pleased (all) by means of his Dharma. Then ne became known as Dharmaraja. By means of his auspicious acti¬ vity, he became extremely refulgent and attained the lordship of Pitrs and guardianship of the quarters.…

verses.sanskrit: कामक्रोधौ परित्यज्य जगामामरपर्वतम् । तत्र बद्ध्वोडुपं गाढं कृष्णरज्ज्वावलम्बितम्
verses.transliteration: kāmakrodhau parityajya jagāmāmaraparvatam / tatra baddhvoḍupaṃ gāḍhaṃ kṛṣṇarajjvāvalambitam
verses.translation: Their brother SanaiScara attained the status of a planet. With'the (chopped off) brilliance (of the Sun) Tvastr made Visnu's discus. 1 It was unobstructed (irresistible) in battles to check Danavas. Their younger sister Yamuna of great fame, became the excellent river Yamuna, the purifier of all the worlds. 2
verses.hindi: करते हैं ? वहां के ग्न्धवं किस प्रकार के हैं, जिनके संगीत को सुनकर राजा रेवत ने इतने समय को दो घड़ी
verses.wordMeaning: Their brother SanaiScara attained the status of a planet. With'the (chopped off) brilliance (of the Sun) Tvastr made Visnu's discus. 1 It was unobstructed (irresistible) in battles to check Danavas. Their younger sister Yamuna of great fame, became the excellent river Yamuna,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Their brother SanaiScara attained the status of a planet. With'the (chopped off) brilliance (of the Sun) Tvastr made Visnu's discus. 1 It was unobstructed (irresistible) in battles to check Danavas. Their younger sister Yamuna of great fame, became the excellent river Yamuna,…

verses.sanskrit: प्लवमानो ऽशु ध्यायन्देवं जनार्दनम् । आरोग्यं भास्करादिच्छेद्धनं वै जातवेदसः
verses.transliteration: plavamāno 'śu dhyāyandevaṃ janārdanam / ārogyaṃ bhāskarādiccheddhanaṃ vai jātavedasaḥ
verses.translation: I shall now narrate the details of Vaivasvata Manu who was the eldest among them. He had great splendour and his creation is current (and he presides over the present Manvan- tara).
verses.hindi: सूत ने कहा---ऋषिदृन्द ! ब्रह्मलोक में जानेवाले प्राणी में न चुद्धता का समावेश होता है, न उसे भूख लगती है, न प्यास लगती है, न मृत्यु ही का भय सताता है, यही नहीं किसी प्रकार का रोग भी उस प्राणी को नहीं सताता । है सद्व्नतपरायण ! मुनिवर्यव॑न्द ! उस गान्धव विद्या (संगीत शास्त्र) के विषय में आप लोगों ने जो कुछ मुझसे पूछा है, उसे जो कुछ जानता हूँ बतला रहा हूँ सूत बोले--उस संगीतशास्त्र में सात स्वर, तीन ग्राम, इक्क्रीस मूर्छनाएँ, तथा उनचास ताल होते हैं-“-यही स्वरमण्डल कहा जाता है। षडज, ऋषभ, गान्धार, मध्यम, पच्चम, धैवत, और निषाद-ये
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now narrate the details of Vaivasvata Manu who was the eldest among them. He had great splendour and his creation is current (and he presides over the present Manvan- tara).
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now narrate the details of Vaivasvata Manu who was the eldest among them. He had great splendour and his creation is current (and he presides over the present Manvan- tara).

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नोति ज्ञानमीशानान्मोक्षं प्राप्नोति केशवात् । नीलं रक्तं तदभवन्मेचकं यद्धि सूत्रकम्
verses.transliteration: prāpnoti jñānamīśānānmokṣaṃ prāpnoti keśavāt / nīlaṃ raktaṃ tadabhavanmecakaṃ yaddhi sūtrakam
verses.translation: He who listens to or reads the origin of Devas, the seven powerful sons of Vivasvan, shall be released, if-he attains misfortune. He shall attain great glory. When the Caksusa Manvantara had elapsed, when the Devas (pertaining to that epoch) too had gone, the kingdom of the earth was assigned to the great Vaivasvata (Manu). 3
verses.hindi: शाड्री व पावनी चेव दृष्टाका च यथाक्रमम् । मध्यमग्रासिकाः ख्याताः षड्जग्राम॑ं निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to or reads the origin of Devas, the seven powerful sons of Vivasvan, shall be released, if-he attains misfortune. He shall attain great glory. When the Caksusa Manvantara had elapsed, when the Devas (pertaining to that epoch) too had gone,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to or reads the origin of Devas, the seven powerful sons of Vivasvan, shall be released, if-he attains misfortune. He shall attain great glory. When the Caksusa Manvantara had elapsed, when the Devas (pertaining to that epoch) too had gone,…

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं दृष्ट्वा रज्जुं महामतिः । आप्लुत्य विमले तोये गतो ऽसौ वैष्णवं पदम्
verses.transliteration: śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā rajjuṃ mahāmatiḥ / āplutya vimale toye gato 'sau vaiṣṇavaṃ padam
verses.translation: The creation of Visnu's discus Sudarsana from -the pruned part of the Sun-god is mentioned in VP. III. 2.11.
verses.hindi: गांधा रग्रासीकां श्रान्पान्की त्यं मानान्िबोधत । आर्निष्टोमिकमा्ं तु द्वितीयं वाजपेयिकम् सप्तमं गोसवबं नाम महावृष्टिकमष्टसम् । ब्रह्मदानं च नवमं प्राजापत्यमनन्तरम् नागपक्षाश्रयं विद्यादगोतरं च तथेव च । हयक्रान्तं मृगक़रान्तं विष्णुक्रान्तं मनोहरम् सुर्यक्रास्त वरेण्यं च मत्तकोकिलवादिनम् । सावितन्रमर्धेंसावित्रं सर्वंतोभद्रमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Visnu's discus Sudarsana from -the pruned part of the Sun-god is mentioned in VP. III. 2.11.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Visnu's discus Sudarsana from -the pruned part of the Sun-god is mentioned in VP. III. 2.11.

verses.sanskrit: गायन्ति यद्वेदविदः पुराणं नारायणं शाश्वतमच्युताह्वयम् । प्राप्तः स तं राजसुतो महात्मा निक्षिप्य देहं शुभशुक्लतीर्थे
verses.transliteration: gāyanti yadvedavidaḥ purāṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śāśvatamacyutāhvayam / prāptaḥ sa taṃ rājasuto mahātmā nikṣipya dehaṃ śubhaśuklatīrthe
verses.translation: This story of the Sun-god, his wife Samjna and Chaya, his children from them, pruning of the Sun-god*s excessive lustre, his approach to his wife Samjna (who was in a marc's form) and birth of Asvin gods—these are traditional accounts found in Mbh. Adi 76, AnuSasana 150, VP. III. 2 and other Puraas. Description of dynasties of kings is an integral part of a Purana of five characteristics. Vaivasvata Manu, being the progenitor of these dynasties, is described in all Puranas.
verses.hindi: अलम्बुषेष्टश्व तथा नारदप्रिय एवं च । कथितो भीमसेनेन नागराणां यथा प्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: This story of the Sun-god, his wife Samjna and Chaya, his children from them, pruning of the Sun-god*s excessive lustre, his approach to his wife Samjna (who was in a marc's form) and birth of Asvin gods—these are traditional accounts found in Mbh. Adi 76, AnuSasana 150, VP.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This story of the Sun-god, his wife Samjna and Chaya, his children from them, pruning of the Sun-god*s excessive lustre, his approach to his wife Samjna (who was in a marc's form) and birth of Asvin gods—these are traditional accounts found in Mbh. Adi 76, AnuSasana 150, VP.…

verses.sanskrit: एषा ते कथिता राजन्सिद्धिश्चाणक्यभूभृतः । तथान्यत्तव वक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकाग्रमानसः
verses.transliteration: eṣā te kathitā rājansiddhiścāṇakyabhūbhṛtaḥ / tathānyattava vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahrnanas, I shall recount in the proper order the race of that noble-souled current Manu, the son of Vivasvan. (Listen to) and understand what is being narrated.
verses.hindi: सांत स्वर हैं। सौवी री, हरिणास्था, कलोपबला, शुद्धमध्यमा, हाजी, पावनी ओर दृष्टाका ये मध्यमग्राम के नाम से विख्यात हैं- षड्जग्राम को सुनिये  उत्तरमन्द्रा जननी, उत्तरायता (?) शुद्धघडजा आदि षड्जग्राम में कही जाती हैं, इसे सातवीं जानना चाहिए ।३६-४०। अन्य गान्धारग्राम के विषय में बतला रहा हूँ, चुनिये प्रथम गोसव, अष्टम महावुष्टिक, नवम ब्रह्मदान, तदनन्तर प्राजापत्य, नागपक्षाश्रय, गोतर, हयक्रान्त, मृगरक्रास्त, मनोहर विष्णुक्रास्त, सर्वेश्रष्ठ सुयंकान्त, मत्तकोकिलवादिन्, सावित्र अर्धसावित्र, सर्वतोभद्र, सुवर्ण, सुतन्द्र, विष्णु, वेष्णुवर, सागर, सभी जीवों के मन को हरनवाला विजय, हंस को सर्वेश्नेष्ठ हम लोग जानते हैं, तुम्बुरुप्रिय, मनोहर अधात्य--जो सभी गन्धवों द्वारा प्रशंसित, विशेषतया अलम्बुष को अभिमत एवं नारद को परम प्रिय
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahrnanas, I shall recount in the proper order the race of that noble-souled current Manu, the son of Vivasvan. (Listen to) and understand what is being narrated.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahrnanas, I shall recount in the proper order the race of that noble-souled current Manu, the son of Vivasvan. (Listen to) and understand what is being narrated.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे चाणक्यसिद्धिप्राप्तिवर्णनं नाम पञ्चपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५६ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: नास्ति लोकेषु तत्तीर्थं पृथिव्यां यन्नरेश्वर । शुक्लतीर्थेन सदृशमुपमानेन गीयते
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe cāṇakyasiddhiprāptivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 156 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: nāsti lokeṣu tattīrthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ yannareśvara / śuklatīrthena sadṛśamupamānena gīyate
verses.translation: (I shall narrate the story) now taking up the present creation of Vaivasvata Manu. The first bom Manu had nine sons equal to him.
verses.hindi: है, जिसकी प्रशंसा भीमसेत ने नागरों के पास की थी, जिसके कारण वह उनका प्रिय हुआ -विकल, उपनीत, विनस, भागेवप्रिय, अभिरम्य, शुक्र, पुण्यप्रद पुण्यारक- ये सब मान्धार ग्राम के अन्तर्गत हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: (I shall narrate the story) now taking up the present creation of Vaivasvata Manu. The first bom Manu had nine sons equal to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: (I shall narrate the story) now taking up the present creation of Vaivasvata Manu. The first bom Manu had nine sons equal to him.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लतीर्थं महातीर्थं नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम् । प्रागुदक्प्रवणे देशे मुनिसङ्घनिषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: śuklatīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam / prāgudakpravaṇe deśe munisaṅghaniṣevitam
verses.translation: These nine are remembered as the sons of Manu: Iksvaku, Nahusa, Dhrsta, Saryati, Narisyanta, tha tall ( Pramsu ) Nabhaga, Arista, Karusa and Prsadhra.
verses.hindi: क॑ इृदमध नास्ति क. पुस्तके । तथा पड्चदशेच्छन्ति गान्धारप्रामसंस्थितानु । ससौवीरा तु गान्धारों ब्रह्मणा ह्ापगीयते.
verses.wordMeaning: These nine are remembered as the sons of Manu: Iksvaku, Nahusa, Dhrsta, Saryati, Narisyanta, tha tall ( Pramsu ) Nabhaga, Arista, Karusa and Prsadhra.
verses.commentary: Sense: These nine are remembered as the sons of Manu: Iksvaku, Nahusa, Dhrsta, Saryati, Narisyanta, tha tall ( Pramsu ) Nabhaga, Arista, Karusa and Prsadhra.

verses.sanskrit: वैशाखे च तथा मासि कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी । कैलासादुमया सार्द्धं स्वयमायाति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: vaiśākhe ca tathā māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī / kailāsādumayā sārddhaṃ svayamāyāti śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Know that formerly Manu, on being urged by Brahma, began to create willingly, but he was unsuccessful.
verses.hindi: उत्तरादिस्वरस्पेव ब्रह्म वे देवता5त्र च। हरिवेशससुत्पन्ना हरिणास्था व्यजायत ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Know that formerly Manu, on being urged by Brahma, began to create willingly, but he was unsuccessful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know that formerly Manu, on being urged by Brahma, began to create willingly, but he was unsuccessful.

verses.sanskrit: मध्याह्नसमये स्नात्वा पश्यत्यात्मानमात्मना । ब्रह्मविष्ण्विन्द्रसहितः शुक्लतीर्थे समाहितः
verses.transliteration: madhyāhnasamaye snātvā paśyatyātmānamātmanā / brahmaviṣṇvindrasahitaḥ śuklatīrthe samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Then Prajapati, desirous of sons, performed a great Isfi (Yajna). Manu offered the oblation (Ahuti) in the share of Mitra and Varuna.
verses.hindi: मूर्छना हरिणास्पेव अस्या इस्द्रोडईघिदेवतम् ५१ करोपनीतवितता मरुद्धि: स्व॒रमण्डले । सा कलोपनता तस्मान्मास्तश्रात्र देवतम् मरुदेशसमुत्पन्ना मूछना शुद्धमध्यमा । सध्यमोत्र स्वरः शुद्धो गन्धवंश्रात्र देवता
verses.wordMeaning: Then Prajapati, desirous of sons, performed a great Isfi (Yajna). Manu offered the oblation (Ahuti) in the share of Mitra and Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Prajapati, desirous of sons, performed a great Isfi (Yajna). Manu offered the oblation (Ahuti) in the share of Mitra and Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तिक्यां तु विशेषेण वैशाख्यां च नरोत्तम । ब्रह्मविष्णुमहादेवान् स्नात्वा पश्यति तद्दिने
verses.transliteration: kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa vaiśākhyāṃ ca narottama / brahmaviṣṇumahādevān snātvā paśyati taddine
verses.translation: It is heard, that Ida 1 was born thereof. She wore heavenly garments and was bedecked in celestial ornaments. Her body too was divine.
verses.hindi: मृगे: सह संचरते सिद्धानां मार्गदशने । यस्मात्तस्मात्स्तृता मार्गी मृगेस्द्रोसस्याश्व देवता ५४ सा चा55श्रमसमायुक्ता अनेकान्यौरवान्नवान् । सूछेना योजना होषा रजसा रजनी ततः॥ ..
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard, that Ida 1 was born thereof. She wore heavenly garments and was bedecked in celestial ornaments. Her body too was divine.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard, that Ida 1 was born thereof. She wore heavenly garments and was bedecked in celestial ornaments. Her body too was divine.

verses.sanskrit: देवराजः सुरैः सार्द्धं वायुमार्गव्यवस्थितः । कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां स्नात्वा पश्यति शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: devarājaḥ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ vāyumārgavyavasthitaḥ / kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ snātvā paśyati śaṅkaram
verses.translation: It is remembered that Manu, the bearer of the staff of justice, addressed her as 'Ila' and said, "Welfare unto you, I shall follow you". Ila replied to the Prajapati who was desirous of sons, in the following words sanctioned by Dharma. "O fore¬ most of the eloquent ones, I am born in the share of Mitra and Varuna. I will (first) approach them. May not Dharma violated by us kill us". After speaking thus, the noble lady went near them (Mitra and Varuna).
verses.hindi: ताल उत्तरमद्द्रांशः षड्जदेवतकां विदुः  तस्मादृत्तरतालं च प्रथम स्वायतं बिदुः ॥ तस्मादृत्तरमर्द्रो5्यं देवताइस्य श्रुवों भुवम् ५६ आयामादुत्तरत्वाच्च घेवतस्योत्तरायण: । स्यादियं सूछंना छोव॑ पितरः श्राइददेवताः यः सतां मूछनां कृत्वा पझचमस्वरको भवेत् । यक्षीणां मूछना सा तु याक्षिका सूछता स्मृता ५६ नागदृष्टिविषा गीता नोपसपन्ति मुछंनाम् । भवन्तीव हता होते बरह्मणा नागदेवताः
verses.wordMeaning: It is remembered that Manu, the bearer of the staff of justice, addressed her as 'Ila' and said, "Welfare unto you, I shall follow you". Ila replied to the Prajapati who was desirous of sons, in the following words sanctioned by Dharma. "O fore¬ most of the eloquent ones,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is remembered that Manu, the bearer of the staff of justice, addressed her as 'Ila' and said, "Welfare unto you, I shall follow you". Ila replied to the Prajapati who was desirous of sons, in the following words sanctioned by Dharma. "O fore¬ most of the eloquent ones,…

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यक्षाः सिद्धविद्याधरोरगाः । तद्दिने ते ऽपि देवेशं दृष्ट्वा मुञ्चन्ति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvāpsaraso yakṣāḥ siddhavidyādharoragāḥ / taddine te 'pi deveśaṃ dṛṣṭvā muñcanti kilbiṣam
verses.translation: After going near them, the beautiful lady spoke these words with palms joined in reverence: "O Devas, I am born in your share. What should I do?
verses.hindi: मध्यमग्राम बीस हैं, पडजग्रामों की संख्या चौदह है, गान्धारग्राम को लोग पन्‍्द्रह मानते हैं। भगवान् ब्रह्मा सोवीर के साथ गान्धारी का गान करते हैं ।४१-५०। उत्तरादि स्वरों के अधिदेवता ब्रह्मा ही माने गये हैं, हरिदेश में उत्पन्न मूछेना हरिणास्गा के नाम से प्रत्तिद्ध है, इसके अधिदेवता इन्द्र हैं। समस्त स्वर मण्डल में मरुतों हारा प्रसारण पूर्वक ग्रहण किये जाने से कलोपनता के मारुत अधिदेवता माने गये हैं। मरुदेश में समुत्यन्न
verses.wordMeaning: After going near them, the beautiful lady spoke these words with palms joined in reverence: "O Devas, I am born in your share. What should I do?
verses.commentary: Sense: After going near them, the beautiful lady spoke these words with palms joined in reverence: "O Devas, I am born in your share. What should I do?

verses.sanskrit: अर्धयोजनविस्तारं तदर्द्धेनैव चायतम् । शुक्लतीर्थं महापुण्यं महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: ardhayojanavistāraṃ tadarddhenaiva cāyatam / śuklatīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam
verses.translation: I have been requested by Manu, thus, 'Follow me' ". When the chaste lady Ida spoke thus, both of them, Mitra and Varuna spoke these words: "O fair-complexioned lady of beautiful hips, O knower of Dharma, we are delighted by your humility, self-control and truthfulness. O blessed lady, you will become renowned as our daughter".
verses.hindi: मूछेना भुद्ध मध्यमा कही जाती है । इसमें शुद्ध स्वर मध्यम है, इसके अधिदेवता गन्धवं हैं। सिद्धों का मार्य दिल्ललाते समय मृगों के साथ विचरण करने के कारण मूछना मार्गी नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुई, इसके अधिदेवता मृगेन्द्र हैं (५१-५४। यह मूछेना अनेक स्व॒रों की आश्रयभूत होने के कारण अनेक पुरों में गाये जानेवाले स्वरों में प्रयुक्त होती है । (?) यह रजती नामक मूछेना रजोगुण से संयुक्त करनी चाहिए । (?) उत्तर मन्द्रांश ताल का अधिदेवता षडज है। उसका उत्तरवर्ती ताल भी प्रथम का अनुयायी माना जाता है । इसीलिए उसका नाम भी उत्तरमन्द्र कहा जाता है, उसके अधिदेवता ध्रूव हैं ।(५-५६। विस्तृत और उत्तरवर्ती होने के कारण धैबत की मुछना उत्तरायण है. इसके अधिदेवगण श्राद्ध में पूजित होनेवाले पितरगण हैं। महषियों ने शुद्ध पडज् स्वर 8 रा अग्ति की उपासना की थी, इसलिये उस स्वर को लोग शुद्ध पडजिक नाम से जानते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: I have been requested by Manu, thus, 'Follow me' ". When the chaste lady Ida spoke thus, both of them, Mitra and Varuna spoke these words: "O fair-complexioned lady of beautiful hips, O knower of Dharma, we are delighted by your humility, self-control and truthfulness.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been requested by Manu, thus, 'Follow me' ". When the chaste lady Ida spoke thus, both of them, Mitra and Varuna spoke these words: "O fair-complexioned lady of beautiful hips, O knower of Dharma, we are delighted by your humility, self-control and truthfulness.…

verses.sanskrit: यत्र स्थितैः प्रदृश्यन्ते वृक्षाग्राणि नरोत्तमैः । तत्र स्थिता महापापैर् मुच्यन्ते पूर्वसंचितैः
verses.transliteration: yatra sthitaiḥ pradṛśyante vṛkṣāgrāṇi narottamaiḥ / tatra sthitā mahāpāpair mucyante pūrvasaṃcitaiḥ
verses.translation: In RV. it was used in the sense of 'refreshing draught* Later on it came to mean 'a cow*, and 'a goddess of speech*. In Sat. Br. I<Ja is Manu's daughter. But in our text she is the daughter of ('bora of the share of*) Mitra and Varuna.
verses.hindi: पद्चम स्वर की मूरछना सत्पुरुषों के मन को भी मूच्छित कर देती है, यह यक्षों की पत्नियों की मूछेना है, इसीलिये उसका नाम भी याक्षिकी मूछेना प्रसिद्ध है ।५६। दृष्टि से ही विष विक्रीरित करनेवाले नागगण जिस
verses.wordMeaning: In RV. it was used in the sense of 'refreshing draught* Later on it came to mean 'a cow*, and 'a goddess of speech*. In Sat. Br. I<Ja is Manu's daughter. But in our text she is the daughter of ('bora of the share of*) Mitra and Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: In RV. it was used in the sense of 'refreshing draught* Later on it came to mean 'a cow*, and 'a goddess of speech*. In Sat. Br. I<Ja is Manu's daughter. But in our text she is the daughter of ('bora of the share of*) Mitra and Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: पापोपपातकैर्युक्तो नरः स्नात्वा प्रमुच्यते । उपार्जिता विनश्येत भ्रूणहत्यापि दुस्त्यजा
verses.transliteration: pāpopapātakairyukto naraḥ snātvā pramucyate / upārjitā vinaśyeta bhrūṇahatyāpi dustyajā
verses.translation: The son of Manu, the rightcous-souled promoter of Manti's race is the beloved of the universe. He who is revered in the three worlds is famous as Sudyumna. He has attained the form of a lady. 1 That noble lady returned to her father after securing the boon.
verses.hindi: (अहीनां मुछेना होषा वरुणभ्रात्र देवता । + जलाधिपेन दृष्टा स्थादप्सु लोला तथव च शउुन्तकानां कृत्वा च उपगायन्ति किनराः । उत्तमा मुछुना तस्मात्पक्षिराजोउन्र देवता (१६२   मनो सन्दयती तेषां मुछेता मन्दनीत्यपि । ऋषीणां स्नातकानां च विश्वे देवात्र (स्तु) देवतम् ॥ अश्वा इवाक़मन्ते वा रमन्ते वा5त्र वाजिनः। अश्वक्कान्तेति नित्या वे अश्यिनी वाइन्र देवतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Manu, the rightcous-souled promoter of Manti's race is the beloved of the universe. He who is revered in the three worlds is famous as Sudyumna. He has attained the form of a lady. 1 That noble lady returned to her father after securing the boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Manu, the rightcous-souled promoter of Manti's race is the beloved of the universe. He who is revered in the three worlds is famous as Sudyumna. He has attained the form of a lady. 1 That noble lady returned to her father after securing the boon.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्तत्रैव देवेश उमया सह तिष्ठति । वैशाख्यां च विशेषेण कैलासादेति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: yasmāttatraiva deveśa umayā saha tiṣṭhati / vaiśākhyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa kailāsādeti śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: After getting an opportune moment, she was invited for love making'(sexual intercourse) by Budha (the planet Mer¬ cury). From Budha, the son of Soma, Pururavas, the son of Ila was born.
verses.hindi: + गान्धाररागशब्देन गां धारयतेर्थतः । तस्मादिशुद्ध गान्धारी गन्धवंश्राधिदेवतम् ६५ गान्धारानन्तरं गत्वा सृष्टेयं मुछंना यतः । तस्मादुत्तरगान्धारी बसवश्रात्र देवता:
verses.wordMeaning: After getting an opportune moment, she was invited for love making'(sexual intercourse) by Budha (the planet Mer¬ cury). From Budha, the son of Soma, Pururavas, the son of Ila was born.
verses.commentary: Sense: After getting an opportune moment, she was invited for love making'(sexual intercourse) by Budha (the planet Mer¬ cury). From Budha, the son of Soma, Pururavas, the son of Ila was born.

verses.sanskrit: तेन तीर्थं महापुण्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् । कथितं ब्रह्मणा पूर्वं मया तव तथा नृप
verses.transliteration: tena tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam / kathitaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ mayā tava tathā nṛpa
verses.translation: After giving birth to the son born of Budha, she became Sudyumna again. Sudyumna had three sons, all extremely virtuous.
verses.hindi: सेयं खलु महाभूता पितामहमुपस्थिता । षड्जेय॑ मुछंना तस्मात्स्मृता ह्ानलदेवता ) दिव्येयं चायता तेन मन्दषष्ठा च मूछेने । निवृत्तमुणनासानं पञचर्म चान्न देवतम्
verses.wordMeaning: After giving birth to the son born of Budha, she became Sudyumna again. Sudyumna had three sons, all extremely virtuous.
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving birth to the son born of Budha, she became Sudyumna again. Sudyumna had three sons, all extremely virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: रजकेन यथा धौतं वस्त्रं भवति निर्मलम् । तथा तत्र वपुःस्नानं पुरुषस्य भवेच्छुचि
verses.transliteration: rajakena yathā dhautaṃ vastraṃ bhavati nirmalam / tathā tatra vapuḥsnānaṃ puruṣasya bhavecchuci
verses.translation: They were Utkala, Gaya and Vinatasva. The land of Utkala went over to Utkala. The western region went over to Vinatasva. In the quarter of the Wind-god (north-west) was Gaya, the city of Gaya, the saintly king.
verses.hindi: मूछेता को सनकर चल फिर नहीं सकते, और ब्रह्मा द्वारा मृतक के समान हो जाते हैं, वह भहिमृछेना कही जाती है, उसके अधिदेवता वरुण हैं। जलराशि में अवस्थित इस मूर्छना को सर्वप्रथम जलाधिप वरुण ने देखा था ।६०-६१। किन्नर गण पक्षियों के स्वर का अनुकरण कर जिसका गान करते हैं, उस परमश्रेष्ठ मुछेना के भधिदेवता पक्षिराज गरुड़ हैं। ऋषियों और विद्या में पारंगत स्नातकों के भी मन को
verses.wordMeaning: They were Utkala, Gaya and Vinatasva. The land of Utkala went over to Utkala. The western region went over to Vinatasva. In the quarter of the Wind-god (north-west) was Gaya, the city of Gaya, the saintly king.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Utkala, Gaya and Vinatasva. The land of Utkala went over to Utkala. The western region went over to Vinatasva. In the quarter of the Wind-god (north-west) was Gaya, the city of Gaya, the saintly king.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे वयसि पापानि कृत्वा पुष्टानि मानवः । अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा शुक्लतीर्थे व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: pūrve vayasi pāpāni kṛtvā puṣṭāni mānavaḥ / ahorātroṣito bhūtvā śuklatīrthe vyapohati
verses.translation: (Defective verse) When Manu was abandoned (created) the Sun (Divakara) created the subjects and divided the whole region of the earth into ten.
verses.hindi: जो मन्द कर देती है वह मन्दनी नामक मूछना है, उसके अधिदेवता विश्वेदेवगण हैं। अव्व के समान तीदत्र गति से चलने अथवा जिसको सुनकर अश्वमण विहार (प्रसन्न होते हैं) करते हैं उस स्थिर मूछेना का भश्वक्रान्ता नाम हैं, उसके अधिदेवता दोनों अश्विनीकुमार हैं ।६२-६४। गान्धार राग के शब्द से गौ (पृथ्वी) को धारण करते हैं, (अर्थात् इसकी स्वरमहिमा से पृथ्वी फ्री स्थिति शक्ति की धृद्धि होती है) इस निरुक्ति से इस मूछ॑ना का नाम विशुद्ध गास्धारी कहा जाता है, इसके अधिदेवता ग्रन्धवं हैं । गास्धार के अन्तर इस मूछना की सृष्टि हुई है, अतः इसे उत्तर गान्धारी कहते हैं, इसके अधिदेवता वसुगण हैं। षडज् नामक यह मुछेना सबसे प्रथम पितामह के समीप उपस्थित हुई अतः यह सबसे अधिक महत्त्वशालिनी है, इसके अधिदेवता अनल कहे जाते हैं ।६५-६७। यह मन्दषष्ठा नामक मूछेना बहुत विस्तृत है, इसके प्रभाव दिव्य हैं, इसके गुणों की
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) When Manu was abandoned (created) the Sun (Divakara) created the subjects and divided the whole region of the earth into ten.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) When Manu was abandoned (created) the Sun (Divakara) created the subjects and divided the whole region of the earth into ten.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लतीर्थे महाराज राकां रेवाजलाञ्जलिम् । कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि दत्त्वा स्युः पितरः शिवाः
verses.transliteration: śuklatīrthe mahārāja rākāṃ revājalāñjalim / kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi dattvā syuḥ pitaraḥ śivāḥ
verses.translation: Iksvaku had ten other sons. In view of his being a lady (as well), Sudyumna had no share.
verses.hindi: धनुदिचित्वान्तगंतग्रन्थों ग. पुस्तके तास्ति। -+तास्तीदमध॑ क. पुस्तके। ३८ धनुरिच्वान्तगंतग्रन्थः क. पुस्तके नारित । +एत्ंस्थान इदमर्ध गांधारयते शब्देन गांधारेध्यथ वा पुनरिति ह. पुश्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Iksvaku had ten other sons. In view of his being a lady (as well), Sudyumna had no share.
verses.commentary: Sense: Iksvaku had ten other sons. In view of his being a lady (as well), Sudyumna had no share.

verses.sanskrit: न माता न पिता बन्धुः पतनं नरकार्णवे । उद्धरन्ति यथा पुण्यं शुक्लतीर्थे नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: na mātā na pitā bandhuḥ patanaṃ narakārṇave / uddharanti yathā puṇyaṃ śuklatīrthe nareśvara
verses.translation: At the instance of Vasistha, the establishment of the noble-souled Sudyumna, the virtuous king of great lustre, was (took place) in Pratisthana. After getting the kingdom, he, of great renown, gave it to Pururavas. The characteristics of wo¬ men and men among human beings, O blessed ones, (will be duly manifest). Sudyumna, the son of Manu, attained the status of a woman again.
verses.hindi: पूर्णा सप्त स्व॒रा होव॑ मुछनाः संप्रकीतिता: । नानासाधारणाश्चेव षडेबानुविदस्तथा ६६९ इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्‍्ते वैवस्वतमनुवंशगान्धव॑मूछुनालक्षणकथनं नाम षडशीतितमोड्ध्याय: पुर्वाचार्यमतं बुद्ध्वा प्रवक्ष्याम्यनृपुर्बंशः । त्रिशतं वे अलंकारास्तान्से निगदतः शूणु ३१ अलंकारास्तु वक्तव्याः स्वेः स्वेबंणें: प्रहेतवः । संस्थानयोगेश्व तथा पदानां चान्ववेक्षया
verses.wordMeaning: At the instance of Vasistha, the establishment of the noble-souled Sudyumna, the virtuous king of great lustre, was (took place) in Pratisthana. After getting the kingdom, he, of great renown, gave it to Pururavas. The characteristics of wo¬ men and men among human beings,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the instance of Vasistha, the establishment of the noble-souled Sudyumna, the virtuous king of great lustre, was (took place) in Pratisthana. After getting the kingdom, he, of great renown, gave it to Pururavas. The characteristics of wo¬ men and men among human beings,…

verses.sanskrit: तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण न तां गच्छन्ति सद्गतिम् । शुक्लतीर्थे मृतो जन्तुर्देहत्यागेन यां लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa na tāṃ gacchanti sadgatim / śuklatīrthe mṛto janturdehatyāgena yāṃ labhet
verses.translation: On hearing this the sages asked thereafter: "How did Sudyumna, the son of Manu, attain womanhood?"
verses.hindi: बाक्याथंपदयोगार्थेरलंकारस्य प्रणम् । पदानि गीतकस्या55हुः पुरस्तात्पृष्ठतो5थवा
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this the sages asked thereafter: "How did Sudyumna, the son of Manu, attain womanhood?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this the sages asked thereafter: "How did Sudyumna, the son of Manu, attain womanhood?"

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तिकस्य तु मासस्य कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् । घृतेन स्नापयेद् देवमुपोष्य प्रयतो नरः
verses.transliteration: kārttikasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm / ghṛtena snāpayed devamupoṣya prayato naraḥ
verses.translation: The beloved goddess (Uma) spoke these words to her lover (Siva) for the sake of his love: "O Lord, the man who enters my personal hermitage will certainly become a woman. She will be auspicious and on a par with the celestial damsels.'*
verses.hindi: महिमा का वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता, इसके अधिदेवता पतञ्चम हैं। इस प्रकार सातों स्वरों, समस्त मूर्छेनाओं, (?) एवं उनके छः साधारण भेदों का वर्णत मैं कर चुका गीतों के अलंकारों का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: The beloved goddess (Uma) spoke these words to her lover (Siva) for the sake of his love: "O Lord, the man who enters my personal hermitage will certainly become a woman. She will be auspicious and on a par with the celestial damsels.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: The beloved goddess (Uma) spoke these words to her lover (Siva) for the sake of his love: "O Lord, the man who enters my personal hermitage will certainly become a woman. She will be auspicious and on a par with the celestial damsels.'*

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा प्रभाते रेवायां दद्यात्सघृतकम्बलम् । सहिरण्यं यथाशक्ति देवमुद्दिश्य शङ्करं
verses.transliteration: snātvā prabhāte revāyāṃ dadyātsaghṛtakambalam / sahiraṇyaṃ yathāśakti devamuddiśya śaṅkaraṃ
verses.translation: All the living beings there, Pisacas, and the animals became women and played with Rudra like heavenly ladies.
verses.hindi: अब इसके उपरान्त पृवंवर्ती आचार्यों के मतानुसार तीन सौ संगीत के अलंकारों का क्रम पूर्वक वर्णन मैं कर रहा हूँ, सुनिये । अपने-अपने वर्णों एवं पद समूहों के विशेष संयोग से संगठित होने को ही अलंकार कहना चाहिए ।१-२। पद एवं वाक्य के योगा के द्वारा अलंकार की पूति होती है । गीत के पद समूह पूर्व अथवा पीछे दोनों स्थानों में विन्यस्त होते है--ऐसा लोग कहते हैं ।३। गीतों के स्थान तीन होते हैं, उर:थल, कण्ठ तथा शिर ।
verses.wordMeaning: All the living beings there, Pisacas, and the animals became women and played with Rudra like heavenly ladies.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the living beings there, Pisacas, and the animals became women and played with Rudra like heavenly ladies.

verses.sanskrit: देवस्य पूरणं कुर्याद्घृतेन घृतकम्बलम् । स गच्छति महातेजाः शिवलोकं मृतो नरः
verses.transliteration: devasya pūraṇaṃ kuryādghṛtena ghṛtakambalam / sa gacchati mahātejāḥ śivalokaṃ mṛto naraḥ
verses.translation: That king who had gone a-hunting entered Uma's forest. He attained womanhood along with the Pisacas, Bhutas and Rudras. Hence that king attained womanhood. By the grace of Mahadeva, he shall attain the lordship of the Ganas.
verses.hindi: इन्हीं तीन स्थानों में प्रारम्भ किया गया स्वर उत्तम होता है ।४। प्रकृति गत बंणों की संख्या चार है, इनका चत्वारः प्रकृतों वर्णाः प्रविचारश्चतुविध: । विकल्पयष्टधा चेव देवा: षघोडशधा बिदु: ५
verses.wordMeaning: That king who had gone a-hunting entered Uma's forest. He attained womanhood along with the Pisacas, Bhutas and Rudras. Hence that king attained womanhood. By the grace of Mahadeva, he shall attain the lordship of the Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king who had gone a-hunting entered Uma's forest. He attained womanhood along with the Pisacas, Bhutas and Rudras. Hence that king attained womanhood. By the grace of Mahadeva, he shall attain the lordship of the Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: एकविंशकुलोपेतो यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् । शुक्लतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा ह्युमां रुद्रं च यो ऽर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: ekaviṃśakulopeto yāvadābhūtasamplavam / śuklatīrthe naraḥ snātvā hyumāṃ rudraṃ ca yo 'rcayet
verses.translation: (Listen to and) understand the details of Manu's sons. Pjrsadhra tortured the cow of his preceptor and ate it. Due to the curse of the noble-souled Cyavana, he attained the status of a Sudra.
verses.hindi: आरोहणेन चा55रोहवर्ण वर्णविदा बिदुः। एतेषासेव वर्णानामलंकारान्निबो धत ८ अलंकारास्तु चत्वार: स्थापनी क़मरेजिन: । प्रमावश्चाप्रमादश्व तेषां वक्ष्यामि लक्षणम् ६ विस्व॒रोष्ट्रकलाश्रेव स्थानादेकानतरं गताः । आवतंस्याक्रमोत्पत्ती है कार्ये परिणामतः १०
verses.wordMeaning: (Listen to and) understand the details of Manu's sons. Pjrsadhra tortured the cow of his preceptor and ate it. Due to the curse of the noble-souled Cyavana, he attained the status of a Sudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Listen to and) understand the details of Manu's sons. Pjrsadhra tortured the cow of his preceptor and ate it. Due to the curse of the noble-souled Cyavana, he attained the status of a Sudra.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धपुष्पादिधूपैश्च सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् । मासोपवासं यः कुर्यात् तत्र तीर्थे नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: gandhapuṣpādidhūpaiśca so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / māsopavāsaṃ yaḥ kuryāt tatra tīrthe nareśvara
verses.translation: Bhalandana had a very powerful son named Pramsu. Pramsu had a son who became well known as Prajani.
verses.hindi: श्येनस्त्वेकान्तरे जात: कलामात्रन्तरे स्थितः । तस्मिश्वव स्वरे वृद्धिस्तिष्ठते तहिलक्षणा श्येनस्तु अपरोहस्तु उत्तरः परिकीतित: । कलाकलप्रमाणाच्च सबिन्दुर्नाम जायते .
verses.wordMeaning: Bhalandana had a very powerful son named Pramsu. Pramsu had a son who became well known as Prajani.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhalandana had a very powerful son named Pramsu. Pramsu had a son who became well known as Prajani.

verses.sanskrit: मुच्यते स महत्पापैः सप्तजन्मसुसंचितैः । उष्ट्रीक्षीरमविक्षीरं नवश्राद्धे च भोजनम्
verses.transliteration: mucyate sa mahatpāpaiḥ saptajanmasusaṃcitaiḥ / uṣṭrīkṣīramavikṣīraṃ navaśrāddhe ca bhojanam
verses.translation: Prajani had a valorous son named Khanitra. His son was the glorious Ksupa of great fame.
verses.hindi: बिख्दुरेककला कार्या वर्णान्तस्थायिनी भवेत्  विपयंयस्व॒रो5पि स्थाद्यस्य दुर्घटितोईपि न
verses.wordMeaning: Prajani had a valorous son named Khanitra. His son was the glorious Ksupa of great fame.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prajani had a valorous son named Khanitra. His son was the glorious Ksupa of great fame.

verses.sanskrit: वृषलीगमनं चैव तथाभक्ष्यस्य भक्षणम् । अविक्रये ऽनृते पापं माहिषे ऽयाज्ययाजके
verses.transliteration: vṛṣalīgamanaṃ caiva tathābhakṣyasya bhakṣaṇam / avikraye 'nṛte pāpaṃ māhiṣe 'yājyayājake
verses.translation: Ksupa's son was Virhsa who had no one equal to him. Vimsa's son was Vivimsa, the righteous performer of religi¬ ous rites.
verses.hindi: एकास्तरा तु वाद्य तु षएडुजतः परम: स्वरः। आक्षेपास्कर्दनं कार्य काकस्थेबोच्चप्रुष्कलप्त १४ विचार भी चार प्रकार का होता है। विकल्प से आठ प्रकार कहे जाते हैं, देवगण इनकी संख्या सोलह बतलाते हैं ।५। वर्णों के तत्त्वज्ञ लोग स्थायी, संचारी, अवरोहण तथा आरोहण--ये चार वर्ण जानते हैं। एक ही प्रकार के भाव वर्ण में जिसका संचरण होता है वह स्थायी, विभिन्न प्रकार के भावों में जिसका संचरण होता है वह संचारी, निम्न गति जिसकी होती है वह अवरोहण तथा उन्नति शील जो होता है वह आरोहण कहा
verses.wordMeaning: Ksupa's son was Virhsa who had no one equal to him. Vimsa's son was Vivimsa, the righteous performer of religi¬ ous rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksupa's son was Virhsa who had no one equal to him. Vimsa's son was Vivimsa, the righteous performer of religi¬ ous rites.

verses.sanskrit: वार्द्धुष्ये पङ्क्तिगरदे देवब्राह्मणदूषके । एवमादीनि पापानि तथान्यान्यपि भारत
verses.transliteration: vārddhuṣye paṅktigarade devabrāhmaṇadūṣake / evamādīni pāpāni tathānyānyapi bhārata
verses.translation: Vivimsa's son was the virtuous-souled and valorous Kha- ninetra. In the beginning of Tretavuga, his son Karandhama was born.
verses.hindi: जाता है--ऐसा वर्णवेत्ता लोग जानते हैं ! इन्हीं चार प्रकार के वर्णों का अलंकार सुनिये ।६-८। मुख्यतः अलंकार चार प्रकार के होते हैं, स्थापनी, क्रमरेजित, प्रसाद और प्रस्तार, उनके लक्षणों को बतला रहा हूं । उष्टूकल नामक विकृत स्वर एक स्थान से उत्पन्न होकर दूसरे स्थान में समाप्त होते हैं, उस भावत्त (चक्राकार घ॒माव) को उत्पत्ति और उसका क्रय ये दोनों परिणाम के अनुरूप करना चाहिए ।६-१०। अन्य कुमार नामक
verses.wordMeaning: Vivimsa's son was the virtuous-souled and valorous Kha- ninetra. In the beginning of Tretavuga, his son Karandhama was born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vivimsa's son was the virtuous-souled and valorous Kha- ninetra. In the beginning of Tretavuga, his son Karandhama was born.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणेन नश्यन्ति शुक्लतीर्थे न संशयः । शुक्लतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇena naśyanti śuklatīrthe na saṃśayaḥ / śuklatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: Karandhama's son was the vigorous Aviksit. By means of his good qualities, Aviksit surpassed his father.
verses.hindi: स्वर को अत्यभल्प विस्तार करनेवाला जानना चाहिए। दूसरा अपाज्ु नामक और मभात्राधिक कुलारेक नामक अभलड्ार होता है । १ १। श्येन नामक स्वर एक ही स्थान में उत्पन्न होता है, और कलामात्र के अन्तर में प्रतिष्ठित होता है । इसी स्वर में विलक्षण वद्धि होती है ।२। यही ध्येन स्व॒र उत्तर अवरोह कहा जाता है। सविन्दु नामक स्त्रर कला-कला के परिणाम में उत्पन्न होता है । विन्दु को एक कला की करनी चाहिए, यह एक ही वर्ण के अन्त में स्थिर रहनेवाली है ! स्व॒रों का विपर्यय (उलट फेर) भी हो जाता है, जहाँ अनवधानता भी नही होती है। षडज से एक स्वर का अन्तर देकर एकास्तरा वाद्य करने से उत्कृष्ट स्वर होता है । इसमें काक के समान स्वर का आशक्षेप करने से उच्च पुष्कल स्वर होता है ।१३-१५॥ कार्य और कारण रूप से दोनों संतारो
verses.wordMeaning: Karandhama's son was the vigorous Aviksit. By means of his good qualities, Aviksit surpassed his father.
verses.commentary: Sense: Karandhama's son was the vigorous Aviksit. By means of his good qualities, Aviksit surpassed his father.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि तृप्तिं यान्ति सुतर्पिताः । पादुकोपानहौ छत्रं शय्यामासनम् एव च
verses.transliteration: tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptiṃ yānti sutarpitāḥ / pādukopānahau chatraṃ śayyāmāsanam eva ca
verses.translation: The term ' Murcchana ' means the changing of key or modulation of voice (and sounds) in the Science of Music. For more explanation see Footnote No 3,
verses.hindi: संतारो तौ तु संचायों कार्य वा कारण तथा । आक्षिप्रमवरोह्माषि प्रोक्षमद्यस्तथेव च १६ द्वाद्श च कलास्थानमेकान्तरगत ततः ।(प्रेड्डोलितमलंकारमेव स्व॒रसमस्वितम् ३१७ स्वरसंक्रामकाच्चेव ततः प्रोक्तं तु पुष्कलम् । प्रक्षिप्समेव फलया पादनीतरयों भवेत् १८
verses.wordMeaning: The term ' Murcchana ' means the changing of key or modulation of voice (and sounds) in the Science of Music. For more explanation see Footnote No 3,
verses.commentary: Sense: The term ' Murcchana ' means the changing of key or modulation of voice (and sounds) in the Science of Music. For more explanation see Footnote No 3,

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णं धनधान्यं च श्राद्धं युक्तहलं तथा । अन्नं पानीयसंहितं तस्मिंस्तीर्थे ददन्ति ये
verses.transliteration: suvarṇaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ yuktahalaṃ tathā / annaṃ pānīyasaṃhitaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe dadanti ye
verses.translation: A. reads: Nabhaga was the son of Arista. Bhalandana was a scholar.
verses.hindi: यस्तु स्थादवरोहो वा तारतो मन्द्रतोषपि वा । एकान्तरहिता होते तमेव स्व॒रमन्ततः १२० मणिप्रच्छेदनो नाम चतुष्कलगणः स्मृतः । अलंकारा भवस्त्येते त्रिशदे वे प्रकोतिताः ॥ संस्थान च प्रमाणं च विकारी लक्षण तथा। चतुविधासद ज्ञेयसलंकारप्रयोजनम् द
verses.wordMeaning: A. reads: Nabhaga was the son of Arista. Bhalandana was a scholar.
verses.commentary: Sense: A. reads: Nabhaga was the son of Arista. Bhalandana was a scholar.

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टाः पुष्टा मृता यान्ति शिवलोकं न संशयः । तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या शिवमुद्दिश्य भारत
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭā mṛtā yānti śivalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā śivamuddiśya bhārata
verses.translation: (His son) named Marutta was a virtuous-souled king equal to an emperor. He was taken to heaven by (sage) Sam- varta along with his friends and kinsmen.
verses.hindi: यथा5घत्मनो ह्ालंकारों विपयंस्तो5४तिगहितः  वर्णमेबाप्यल कतु विषम ह्यात्मसंभवात् २३ नानाभरणसंयोगाद्यथा नार्या विभृषणम् । वर्णस्य चेवालंकारो विपयंस्तोइतिगहितः २४
verses.wordMeaning: (His son) named Marutta was a virtuous-souled king equal to an emperor. He was taken to heaven by (sage) Sam- varta along with his friends and kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: (His son) named Marutta was a virtuous-souled king equal to an emperor. He was taken to heaven by (sage) Sam- varta along with his friends and kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षामात्रं तथान्नं ये ते ऽपि स्वर्यान्ति वै नराः । यज्विनां व्रतिनां चैव तत्र तीर्थनिवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: bhikṣāmātraṃ tathānnaṃ ye te 'pi svaryānti vai narāḥ / yajvināṃ vratināṃ caiva tatra tīrthanivāsinām
verses.translation: In this connection a great dispute arose between Sam- vavta and Byhaspati. On seeing the magnificence of the Yajfia, Byahspati became angry with him.
verses.hindi: का संचारण करना चाहिए । इस प्रकार क्षिप्र गति तक अवरोह स्वर संचार करने से उसी प्रकार का प्रोक्षमच अलंकार होता है ।१६। तदनन्तर एकास्तर गत द्वादश कला स्थान है । इस प्रकार के स्वर संयुक्त एक प्रेंखो लित अनद्भर होता है । पुनः कुछ अधिक स्वरों के संक्रमण होने के कारण ही वह पृष्कल कहा जाता है। मात्रा के प्रक्षेप और पाद संक्रमण होने से जो द्विकलात्मक अलझ्भार होता है वह प्नासित कहा जाता है। स्वरोच्चार और विस्वर के संयोग से अष्टस्वर का अन्तर हो जाता है ।७-१६। तार और मन्द्र के क्रम से जो स्वरावरोह होते हैं, वे अन्त में उसी स्वर के एक अन्तरा के बाद उपयुक्त माने जाते हैं। मणिप्रच्छेदन तामक गण चार कलाओं वाला कहा जाता है। वर्ण, स्थान औद् प्रयोग विशेष के अतुसार कलामात्र प्रमाण के अनुसार अलंकार निश्चित किये गये हैं । इस प्रकार कहे गये तीसों अलंकारों का वर्णन कर चुका । संस्थान, प्रमाण, विकार और लक्षण--
verses.wordMeaning: In this connection a great dispute arose between Sam- vavta and Byhaspati. On seeing the magnificence of the Yajfia, Byahspati became angry with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this connection a great dispute arose between Sam- vavta and Byhaspati. On seeing the magnificence of the Yajfia, Byahspati became angry with him.

verses.sanskrit: अपि वालाग्रमात्रं हि दत्तं भवति चाक्षयम् । अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्याच्छुक्लतीर्थे समाहितः
verses.transliteration: api vālāgramātraṃ hi dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam / agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryācchuklatīrthe samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: When the Yajfla was brought to a successful conclusion by Samvarta, he (Brhaspati) became more furious. He was in¬ tent on the destruction of the worlds but he was propitiated by the deities (gods).
verses.hindi: ये चार अलंकारों के प्रयोजन जान , चाहिए ।३०-२२। जिस प्रकार मनुष्य के अपने अलंकार योग्य स्थान पर न पड़कर अथवा अति निम्न कोटि के होकर शरीर शोभा की हानि करते हैं, वृद्धि नहीं करते उसी प्रकार ये संगीत के अलंकार भी अपने योग्य स्थान पर पड़कर तथा निक्ृष्ट कोटि के होकर वर्णों की द्योभा बढ़ाने में सशक्त नहों होते, इसलिए स्त्रियों के आभूषण की भांति इन संगीतालंकारों का यथा स्थान सब्निवेश करना
verses.wordMeaning: When the Yajfla was brought to a successful conclusion by Samvarta, he (Brhaspati) became more furious. He was in¬ tent on the destruction of the worlds but he was propitiated by the deities (gods).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Yajfla was brought to a successful conclusion by Samvarta, he (Brhaspati) became more furious. He was in¬ tent on the destruction of the worlds but he was propitiated by the deities (gods).

verses.sanskrit: रागद्वेषविनिर्मुक्तो हृदि ध्यात्वा जनार्दनम् । सर्वकामसुसम्पूर्णः स गच्छेद् वारुणं पुरम्
verses.transliteration: rāgadveṣavinirmukto hṛdi dhyātvā janārdanam / sarvakāmasusampūrṇaḥ sa gacched vāruṇaṃ puram
verses.translation: Emperor Marutta obtained Narisyanta (as son). Nari-?yanta's successor was the king Dama, wielding the staff of jus¬ tice and punishment.
verses.hindi: आवश्यक होता है  जिस प्रकार विविध अलंकारों से अलंकृत होने पर स्त्रियों का सौन्दर्य बढ़ जाता है, उसी प्रकार इन वर्णों के अलंकारों से अलंकृत होकर संगीत की शोभा बढ़ जाती है। इनके यथा स्थान विभूषित न होने की बड़ी निन्‍दा की गई है । जिस प्रकार पेर में बंधे हुए कुण्डल नहीं देखे जाते और कण्ठ में करधनी नहीं  धनृश्चि्नान्तगंतग्रन्थों ग। पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Emperor Marutta obtained Narisyanta (as son). Nari-?yanta's successor was the king Dama, wielding the staff of jus¬ tice and punishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Emperor Marutta obtained Narisyanta (as son). Nari-?yanta's successor was the king Dama, wielding the staff of jus¬ tice and punishment.

verses.sanskrit: न रोगो न जरा तत्र यत्र देवो ऽंभसां पतिः । अनाशकं तु यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस्तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: na rogo na jarā tatra yatra devo 'ṃbhasāṃ patiḥ / anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: The valorous king Ra$travardhana was his son. His son was Sudhytin and Sudhrtin's son was Nara.
verses.hindi: न पादे कुण्डले दृष्टे न कण्ठे रसना तथा। एवमेव ह्ालंकारो विपयंस्तो विगहितः २५ क्रियमाणो5प्यलंकारो राग॑ यश्चंव दशयेत् । यथोहिष्टस्य सार्गस्य कतंव्यस्प विधीयते
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous king Ra$travardhana was his son. His son was Sudhytin and Sudhrtin's son was Nara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous king Ra$travardhana was his son. His son was Sudhytin and Sudhrtin's son was Nara.

verses.sanskrit: अनिवर्तिका गतिस् तस्य रुद्रलोकाद् असंशयम् । अवशः स्ववशो वापि जन्तुस्तत्क्षेत्रमण्डले
verses.transliteration: anivartikā gatis tasya rudralokād asaṃśayam / avaśaḥ svavaśo vāpi jantustatkṣetramaṇḍale
verses.translation: Kevala was his son and Bandhuman was the son of Ke- vala. The virtuous-souled king Vegavan was Bandhuman's son.
verses.hindi: लक्षण पर्यवस्थापि वरणिकाभिः प्रवर्तनम् । यातातथ्येन वक्ष्यासि मासो:दू वमुखोउद्ू वे स्वरालंप्रत्ययश्चेव सर्वेषां प्रत्ययः स्पृतः । अनुगम्य वहिर्गोतं विज्ञातं पद॑श्चदेवतम
verses.wordMeaning: Kevala was his son and Bandhuman was the son of Ke- vala. The virtuous-souled king Vegavan was Bandhuman's son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kevala was his son and Bandhuman was the son of Ke- vala. The virtuous-souled king Vegavan was Bandhuman's son.

verses.sanskrit: मृतः स तु न सन्देहो रुद्रस्यानुचरो भवेत् । शुक्लतीर्थे तु यः कन्यां शक्त्या दद्याद् अलंकृताम्
verses.transliteration: mṛtaḥ sa tu na sandeho rudrasyānucaro bhavet / śuklatīrthe tu yaḥ kanyāṃ śaktyā dadyād alaṃkṛtām
verses.translation: Budha was Vegavan's son and Tynabindu was the son of Budha. He became king at the beginning of the third Treta- yuga.
verses.hindi: गन्धारांशेन गीयन्ते चत्वारि मद्रकानि च। पश्चमों सध्यमश्चेव धेवते तु निषादज: ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Budha was Vegavan's son and Tynabindu was the son of Budha. He became king at the beginning of the third Treta- yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Budha was Vegavan's son and Tynabindu was the son of Budha. He became king at the beginning of the third Treta- yuga.

verses.sanskrit: विधिना यो नृपश्रेष्ठ कुरुते वृषमोक्षणम् । तस्य यत् फलम् उद्दिष्टं पुराणे रुद्रभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: vidhinā yo nṛpaśreṣṭha kurute vṛṣamokṣaṇam / tasya yat phalam uddiṣṭaṃ purāṇe rudrabhāṣitam
verses.translation: His daughter was Dravi(ja (Idaviqla in Bd. P.) who be¬ came the mother of Visravas. He had a son also named Visala. He was an extremely virtuous king.
verses.hindi: घपड्जबंभश्न जानीमो भव्रकेष्वेब नानन्‍तरे हें चापरान्तिके विद्याद्धयशुल्लाष्टकस्य तु । प्राकृते बेणवेश्वेव गान्धारांशे प्रयुज्यते
verses.wordMeaning: His daughter was Dravi(ja (Idaviqla in Bd. P.) who be¬ came the mother of Visravas. He had a son also named Visala. He was an extremely virtuous king.
verses.commentary: Sense: His daughter was Dravi(ja (Idaviqla in Bd. P.) who be¬ came the mother of Visravas. He had a son also named Visala. He was an extremely virtuous king.

verses.sanskrit: तदहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना नृप । यावन्तो रोमकूपाः स्युः सर्वाङ्गेषु पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa / yāvanto romakūpāḥ syuḥ sarvāṅgeṣu pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: The city of Visala (Vaisali) 1 was built by king Visala. Visala's son was the king Hemacandra of great strength.
verses.hindi: पदस्य तु त्रयं रूप सप्तरूषं तु कशिकम् । गान्धारांशेन कात्स्स्पेंन पर्ययस्थ विधिः स्मृतः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The city of Visala (Vaisali) 1 was built by king Visala. Visala's son was the king Hemacandra of great strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of Visala (Vaisali) 1 was built by king Visala. Visala's son was the king Hemacandra of great strength.

verses.sanskrit: तावद् वर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते । शुक्लतीर्थे तु यद् दत्तं ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः
verses.transliteration: tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate / śuklatīrthe tu yad dattaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ
verses.translation: After Hemacandra (his son) Sucandra became very famous. Sucandra's son was the well known king Dhumrasva.
verses.hindi: देखी जाती। अर्थात् ये निन्दित हैं उसी प्रकार अनृपयुक्त स्थान में पड़े अलंकार भी अत्यन्त गहित माने गये हैं ।२३-२५। जो गायक अलंकारों को यथा स्थान सन्निविष्ट कर के राग का प्रदर्शन करते हैं, वे संगीत के समु- चित कत्तंब्य का पालन करते हैं ।२१६। अब इसके उपरान्त मैं प्यंव का लक्षण, वर्णिका के द्वारा उनका प्रवर्तत मासोद्भुव ओर भुखोद्भूव को यथार्थ रूप से बतला रहा हूँ ।२७। षडज् स्वर के तेईस प्रकार के अलंकार विपर्यय के द्वारा अस्सी/ प्रकार के हो जाते हैं । षड्ज पक्ष भी तत्त्व के आदि में और हीन स्वर हो जाता है २८। षड्ज और मध्यम, एवं दोनों ग्राम का पये य, उत्तर मन्द तथा अविक का मान छः प्रकार का होता है । स्वर, अलदडूतर और प्रत्यय सब के प्रत्यय होते हैं । बहिर्गीतों के विश्लेषण से ये भी पञ्च दंवत ही जाने गये हैं ।२६-३०। गोरूपों के आगे मध्यमांश का स्थापन ही पर्यय है । इन दोनों का विभाग गीतों की सौन्‍्दयें-
verses.wordMeaning: After Hemacandra (his son) Sucandra became very famous. Sucandra's son was the well known king Dhumrasva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Hemacandra (his son) Sucandra became very famous. Sucandra's son was the well known king Dhumrasva.

verses.sanskrit: वर्धते तद्गुणं तावद्दिनानि दश पञ्च च । शुक्लतीर्थे शुचिर्भूत्वा यः करोति प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: vardhate tadguṇaṃ tāvaddināni daśa pañca ca / śuklatīrthe śucirbhūtvā yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: Dhumrasva's son Synjaya became a great scholar. Syn- jaya's son was the glorious and valorous Sahadeva. Krsasva was Sahadeva's son. He was extremely righte¬ ous. The valorous Somadatta of great brilliance was Krsasva's son.
verses.hindi: वृद्धि में सहायक होता है । मैंने स्वसार और स्वरान्तर का गौणरूप में वर्णन कर दिया। सप्त स्वर, और पदक्रम के अनुसार पर्यय का प्रयोग होता है। चारों मद्रक गान्धारां से गाये जाते हैं, पचम धैवत में निषादज का प्रयोग होता है। मद्रकों में पहज और ऋषभ का ही प्रयोग होता है इतर का नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Dhumrasva's son Synjaya became a great scholar. Syn- jaya's son was the glorious and valorous Sahadeva. Krsasva was Sahadeva's son. He was extremely righte¬ ous. The valorous Somadatta of great brilliance was Krsasva's son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhumrasva's son Synjaya became a great scholar. Syn- jaya's son was the glorious and valorous Sahadeva. Krsasva was Sahadeva's son. He was extremely righte¬ ous. The valorous Somadatta of great brilliance was Krsasva's son.

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्वी प्रदक्षिणा तेन कृता यत्तस्य तत्फलम् । शोभनं मिथुनं यस्तु रुद्रम् उद्दिश्य पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: pṛthvī pradakṣiṇā tena kṛtā yattasya tatphalam / śobhanaṃ mithunaṃ yastu rudram uddiśya pūjayet
verses.translation: Janamejaya was the son of the saintly king Somadatta. Janamejaya's son named Pramati was very famous.
verses.hindi: हयशुल्लाष्टक के अपर और अन्तिम दो भेद होते हैं। गान्धारांश में और प्राकृत में वेण सम्बन्धी रागों का प्रयोग होता है। पद के तीन रूप होते हैं, केशिक के सात। सम्पूर्ण गान्धारांश से पर्यंय विधि सम्पन्न की जाती है। इसी प्रकार मध्यमांश के मध्यम पद के भी क्रमिक विधान का निर्देश किया गया धानि गीतानि प्रोक्तानि रूपेण तु विशेषतः । तत्तु सप्तस्वरं कार्य सप्तरूपं च केशिकम् ३६ अडगदशंनमित्याहुर्माने है समके तथा । ट्वितीयभावाचरणा मात्रा नाभिप्रतिष्ठिता १३७ उत्तरे च प्रकृत्येब॑ मात्रा तल्‍लीयते तथा । हन्तारः पिण्डको यत्र मात्रायां नातिवतंते ३८ पादेनेकेन मात्रायां पादोनामतिवीरणा। संख्यायाश्रोपहननं तत्र यानमिति स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Janamejaya was the son of the saintly king Somadatta. Janamejaya's son named Pramati was very famous.
verses.commentary: Sense: Janamejaya was the son of the saintly king Somadatta. Janamejaya's son named Pramati was very famous.

verses.sanskrit: सप्त जन्मानि तस्यैव वियोगो न च वै क्वचित् । एतत्ते कथितं राजन् संक्षेपेण फलं महत्
verses.transliteration: sapta janmāni tasyaiva viyogo na ca vai kvacit / etatte kathitaṃ rājan saṃkṣepeṇa phalaṃ mahat
verses.translation: By the grace of Tynabindu, all the kings ruling over Visala were long-lived, noble-souled, valorous and very righteous. Saryati begot twins, a son and a daughter Th* tnn u
verses.hindi: द्वितोयं पादभड्गं च ग्रहेणाभिप्रतिष्ठितम् । पूर्व॑मष्टतृतीये तु द्वितोयं चापरीतके ॥॥४ ० अर्थेंन पादसाम्यस्य पादभागाच्च पश्चके  पादभागं सपादं तु प्रकृत्यासपि संस्थितस् ३४१ चतुर्थमुत्तरे चेव मद्रवत्या च मद्रके । मद्रके दक्षिणास्थापि यथोक्ता बतेते कला
verses.wordMeaning: By the grace of Tynabindu, all the kings ruling over Visala were long-lived, noble-souled, valorous and very righteous. Saryati begot twins, a son and a daughter Th* tnn u
verses.commentary: Sense: By the grace of Tynabindu, all the kings ruling over Visala were long-lived, noble-souled, valorous and very righteous. Saryati begot twins, a son and a daughter Th* tnn u

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लतीर्थस्य यत्पुण्यं यथा देवाच्छ्रुतं मया । य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या पुराणे विहितं फलम्
verses.transliteration: śuklatīrthasya yatpuṇyaṃ yathā devācchrutaṃ mayā / ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā purāṇe vihitaṃ phalam
verses.translation: Anarta's successor was the heroic (kin j n
verses.hindi: एकत्वमुपयोगस्प द्योयद्धि द्विजोत्तम । अनेकसमवायस्तु पताकाहरिणं स्मृतभ् ४४ हैं ।३४-३५। जिन गीतों का वर्णन विशेष रूप से रूप के साथ किया गया है उनको संप्त स्वरों से युक्त करना चाहिए और केशिक को सप्तरूप में । इस प्रकार अंगदर्शन, दो मान और समक को कहा गया है। ह्वितीय भावाचरण मात्रा उपयुक्त नहीं होती । और स्वभावतः उत्तर (मन्द्र) में मात्रा लोन हो जाती है। जहाँ हन्तार पिण्डक मात्रा से अधिक नहीं होता, ओर जिस मात्रा में एक चरण ओर पौन चरण रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Anarta's successor was the heroic (kin j n
verses.commentary: Sense: Anarta's successor was the heroic (kin j n

verses.sanskrit: स लभेन्नात्र सन्देहः सत्यं सत्यं पुनः पुनः । पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रं धनार्थी लभते धनम्
verses.transliteration: sa labhennātra sandehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ / putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam
verses.translation: O son of Suta, O holy lord, how is it that even after the lapse of a long period of many Yugas, Revati did not become old? How did her hair not turn grey? After going to the mountain Meru how did Saryati's son have progeny of his own? How did they survive till now on the earth? We wish to hear precisely.-
verses.hindi: अर्थात् जो मात्रा पोने दो चरण की होती है उसको अतिवीरण कहते हैं और उसमें संख्या के संधर्ष होने पर यान नामक अलंकार की उत्पत्ति होती है।३६-३६। द्वितीय पाद भंग को ग्रह नाम से प्रतिष्ठित किया गया है  पहला, आठवाँ, तीसरा और दूसरा अपर और अन्तिम, पाद साम्य के आधे भाग के साथ, पाँचों में वाद भाग, और संपाद पाद भाग प्रकृति में स्थिर रहते हैं। उत्तर, मद्रवती, मद्रक में चोथी कला तथा मद्रक में
verses.wordMeaning: O son of Suta, O holy lord, how is it that even after the lapse of a long period of many Yugas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of Suta, O holy lord, how is it that even after the lapse of a long period of many Yugas,…

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षार्थी लभते मोक्षं स्नानदानफलं महत्
verses.transliteration: mokṣārthī labhate mokṣaṃ snānadānaphalaṃ mahat
verses.translation: How many are the groups of gods? How are the Gan- dharvas? How was that music on hearing which Raivata consi¬ dered a long period as only a Muhurta?
verses.hindi: दक्षिण की उक्त कला रहती है।४०-४२। पहले ही अनुयोग को द्वितीय बुद्धि इष्ट रहती है। इसके बाद दो पादों के और कलाओं के आकलन का विधान आचार्यों ने नहों बताया है। द्विजोत्तम ! दोनों के उपयोग की एकता और अनेक कलाओं के एकन्न संगठन को पताकाहरिण कहते हैं। बत्ति में तीन बृत्तियों की आवृत्ति दक्षिणा कहीं गई है। सोवीरी मृच्छेना ओर वे भाठ समवाय ये भी आवृत्त (दुहराना) होते इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते गीतालंकारनिर्देशो नाम सप्ताशीतितमोअध्याय: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: How many are the groups of gods? How are the Gan- dharvas? How was that music on hearing which Raivata consi¬ dered a long period as only a Muhurta?
verses.commentary: Sense: How many are the groups of gods? How are the Gan- dharvas? How was that music on hearing which Raivata consi¬ dered a long period as only a Muhurta?

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शुक्लतीर्थमहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षट्पञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५७ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्यैवानन्तरं राजञ्छुक्लतीर्थसमीपतः । वासुदेवस्य तीर्थं तु सर्वलोकेषु पूजितम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śuklatīrthamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 157 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ rājañchuklatīrthasamīpataḥ / vāsudevasya tīrthaṃ tu sarvalokeṣu pūjitam
verses.translation: Accidentally Einstein is anticipated by the imaginative Purana-
verses.hindi: ककुद्चिनस्तु तं लोक रबतस्यथ गतस्य हू । हता पुण्यजनेः सर्वा राक्षस: सा कुशस्थली
verses.wordMeaning: Accidentally Einstein is anticipated by the imaginative Purana-
verses.commentary: Sense: Accidentally Einstein is anticipated by the imaginative Purana-

verses.sanskrit: तद्धि पुण्यं सुविख्यातं नर्मदायां पुरातनम् । यत्र हुङ्कारमात्रेण रेवा क्रोशं जगाम सा
verses.transliteration: taddhi puṇyaṃ suvikhyātaṃ narmadāyāṃ purātanam / yatra huṅkāramātreṇa revā krośaṃ jagāma sā
verses.translation: To a person who goes to the world of god Brahma, there is neither hunger nor thirst. He has neither old age nor fear of death. No ailment affects him.
verses.hindi: हैं। जो सर्वश्रेष्ठ व्यक्ति इम सात मूल स्वरों का भली भाँति अध्ययन करता है, उस धामिक महात्मा की विश्रशाखा सुत के समान कीति फंलती है वेवस्वत मनु के बंश का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: To a person who goes to the world of god Brahma, there is neither hunger nor thirst. He has neither old age nor fear of death. No ailment affects him.
verses.commentary: Sense: To a person who goes to the world of god Brahma, there is neither hunger nor thirst. He has neither old age nor fear of death. No ailment affects him.

verses.sanskrit: यदा प्रभृति राजेन्द्र हुङ्कारेण गता सरित् । तदाप्रभृति स स्वामी हुङ्कारः शब्दितो बुधैः
verses.transliteration: yadā prabhṛti rājendra huṅkāreṇa gatā sarit / tadāprabhṛti sa svāmī huṅkāraḥ śabdito budhaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, as to the question put to me on Gandharva (science of music), I shall explain it precisely, O good sages of holy rites.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले--ऋषिवृन्द ! उपर्यक्त महाराज रेबत के, जिनका दूसरा नाम क्षकुक्मो भी था, मेरु शिखर पर चले जाने के उपरान्त यक्षों और राक्षसों ने मिलकर सारी कुशस्यथली को विध्वस्त कर दिया। परम धामिक एवं महात्मा उस राजा ककुझी के अन्य सौ भाई लोग उन राक्षसों से अतिशय पीडित एवं भयभीत॑ होकर इधर उधर भाग गये !१-२। और इस प्रकार उन राक्षसों से भयभीत क्षत्रियों के समुह इधर उधर तितर-
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, as to the question put to me on Gandharva (science of music), I shall explain it precisely, O good sages of holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, as to the question put to me on Gandharva (science of music), I shall explain it precisely, O good sages of holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: संसारार्णवमग्नानां नराणां पापकर्मिणाम् । नैवोद्धर्ता जगन्नाथं विना नारायणं परः
verses.transliteration: saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ narāṇāṃ pāpakarmiṇām / naivoddhartā jagannāthaṃ vinā nārāyaṇaṃ paraḥ
verses.translation: It suggests the ascent and descent of seven notes, known as Svara- sap taka. Sec v. 37.

verses.wordMeaning: It suggests the ascent and descent of seven notes, known as Svara- sap taka. Sec v. 37.
verses.commentary: Sense: It suggests the ascent and descent of seven notes, known as Svara- sap taka. Sec v. 37.

verses.sanskrit: सा जिह्वा या हरिं स्तौति तच्चित्तं यत्तदर्पितम् । तावेव केवलौ श्लाघ्यौ यौ तत्पूजाकरौ करौ
verses.transliteration: sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti taccittaṃ yattadarpitam / tāveva kevalau ślāghyau yau tatpūjākarau karau
verses.translation: Grama: Grama means the group of seven notes. The three Gramas mentioned in Puranas are (1) §adja-grama, (ii) Madhyama-grama and (iii) Gandhara-grama. These three were the basic scales—the Sdsca\c, the Ma-s cale and the Ga-scale. These had the notes Sd, Ma and Ga as the starting points. TIius the order of notes in these scales will be as follows:
verses.hindi: क्षुवतस्तु मनोः पुर्व॑सिक्वाकुरभिनि:सुतः । तस्य पुत्रशतं त्वासीदिक्षवाको भूरिदक्षिणम् ८ विशतिप्रमुखास्ते तु दक्षिणापथरक्षिण:। इक्ष्वाकुस्तु विकुक्षि वे अष्टाकायामथा55दिशत् ११
verses.wordMeaning: Grama: Grama means the group of seven notes. The three Gramas mentioned in Puranas are (1) §adja-grama, (ii) Madhyama-grama and (iii) Gandhara-grama. These three were the basic scales—the Sdsca\c, the Ma-s cale and the Ga-scale. These had the notes Sd,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदा सर्वकार्येषु नास्ति तेषाममङ्गलम् । येषां हृदिस्थो भगवान्मङ्गलायतनो हरिः
verses.transliteration: sarvadā sarvakāryeṣu nāsti teṣāmamaṅgalam / yeṣāṃ hṛdistho bhagavānmaṅgalāyatano hariḥ
verses.translation: Murcchand:
verses.hindi: मांसमानय भआ्धेयं मृगान्हत्वा महाबल । क्षाद्धमद्य नु कतंव्यमष्टकायां न संशयः

verses.sanskrit: यद् अन्यद् देवतार्चायाः फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः । साष्टाङ्गप्रणिपातेन तत्फलं लभते हरेः
verses.transliteration: yad anyad devatārcāyāḥ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ / sāṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena tatphalaṃ labhate hareḥ
verses.translation: Tala or Tana:
verses.hindi: के वे वंशज क्षत्रिय गण सभी दिद्ञाओं में धामिक विचारोंवाले तथा इन्द्रियों को वश में रखनेवाले विश्यात थे । इसी वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले धृष्ट के धाष्टक, क्षत्र, रणधृष्ट नामक पुत्र हुए ।३-४॥ जो परम बलवान् तीन सहल्न क्षत्रियों के समृह में प्रमुख थे । दूसरे उसी वंश्व में उत्पन्न होनेवाले नभग के उत्तराधिकारी परम बलवान नाभाग नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुए। नाभाग के पुत्र अम्बरीष हुए, उन अम्बरीष के पुत्र विरूप हुए। विरूप के प्रषदव्व हु', जिनके पुत्र का नाम रथीतर हुआ । ये उपर्युक्त राजा गण क्षत्रिय वंश में उत्पन्न हुए और अंगिरा॥ के गोत्रज रूप में विख्यात हुए । रथीतर के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवालों के प्रवर क्षत्रिय एवं ब्राह्मण दोनों के हैं। प्राचीनकाल में मनु के छींकते समय इक्ष्वाकु नामक पुत्र निकल पड़े थे। वे परम दातशील थे, उनके एक सौ पुत्र हुए ।५-८। उन सभी पुत्रों में सबसे ज्येष्ठ विकुक्षि नाम से विरुयात थे, उनके अतिरिक्त नेमि और
