verses.wordMeaning: Tala or Tana:
verses.commentary: Sense: Tala or Tana:

verses.sanskrit: रेणुगुण्ठितगात्रस्य यावन्तो ऽस्य रजःकणाः । तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: reṇuguṇṭhitagātrasya yāvanto 'sya rajaḥkaṇāḥ / tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate
verses.translation: The Murcchanas of the Mas calc ( Maclhyama-gramika ) are known as Saublr! (Sauvlra in Bd. P.) of the Madhyama- grama, Harinasya, Kalopabalopeta (also known as Kalopanata) the fourth Suddha-madhyama, Sarngi, Pavanl and Dpstaka in the serial order. Murcchanas of Madhyama-grama are ex¬ plained. Now understand (the Murcchanas of) the Sascale (Safia-grama ).
verses.hindi: दण्ड--को मिलाकर तीन पुत्र विख्यात थे, विकुक्षि के शकुनि प्रभृति पाँच सौ पुत्र हुए । वे सभी उत्तराखण्ड के देशों के स्वामी हुए  अड़तालीस दक्षिण में हुए  जिनमें बीघध्र प्रमुख थे, वे दक्षिण दिशा पथ के समस्त प्रदेशों की रक्षा में तत्पर रहनेवाले थे । एक बार अष्टकातिथि के अवसर पर इक्ष्वाकु ने विकुक्षि को आदेश
verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchanas of the Mas calc ( Maclhyama-gramika ) are known as Saublr! (Sauvlra in Bd. P.) of the Madhyama- grama, Harinasya, Kalopabalopeta (also known as Kalopanata) the fourth Suddha-madhyama, Sarngi, Pavanl and Dpstaka in the serial order.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchanas of the Mas calc ( Maclhyama-gramika ) are known as Saublr! (Sauvlra in Bd. P.) of the Madhyama- grama, Harinasya, Kalopabalopeta (also known as Kalopanata) the fourth Suddha-madhyama, Sarngi, Pavanl and Dpstaka in the serial order.…

verses.sanskrit: सम्मार्जनाभ्युक्षणलेपनेन तदालये नश्यति सर्वपापम् । नारी नराणां परया तु भक्त्या दृष्ट्वा तु रेवां नरसत्तमस्य
verses.transliteration: sammārjanābhyukṣaṇalepanena tadālaye naśyati sarvapāpam / nārī narāṇāṃ parayā tu bhaktyā dṛṣṭvā tu revāṃ narasattamasya
verses.translation: The text omitted the names Abhirudgata, Matsarikrta and Asvakranta.
verses.hindi: राजा ने कहा--हे महाबलवान् ! भूगों को मारकर श्राद्ध करने योग्य मांस लाओ। आज अष्टका तिथि है, आज श्राद्ध करने का मेरा निरचय है। परम बुद्धिमान राजा इक्ष्वाकु की आज्ञा से विकुक्षि मृग्रों का वध करने के लिये वन को गये । वहाँ सहस्नों मृगों का वध करने के कारण विकुक्षि परम बल- ७८० वायुपुराणम्र्
verses.wordMeaning: The text omitted the names Abhirudgata, Matsarikrta and Asvakranta.
verses.commentary: Sense: The text omitted the names Abhirudgata, Matsarikrta and Asvakranta.

verses.sanskrit: येनार्चितो भगवान्वासुदेवो जन्मार्जितं नश्यति तस्य पापम् । स याति लोकं गरुडध्वजस्य विधूतपापः सुरसङ्घपूज्यताम्
verses.transliteration: yenārcito bhagavānvāsudevo janmārjitaṃ naśyati tasya pāpam / sa yāti lokaṃ garuḍadhvajasya vidhūtapāpaḥ surasaṅghapūjyatām
verses.translation: Strangely enough neither our text nor Bd. P. gives the Murcchanas of the Ga-scale.
verses.hindi: आगते स विकुक्षो तु समांसे सहसेनिके। बसिष्ठ चोदयासास मांस प्रोक्षय सन्त्रतः
verses.wordMeaning: Strangely enough neither our text nor Bd. P. gives the Murcchanas of the Ga-scale.
verses.commentary: Sense: Strangely enough neither our text nor Bd. P. gives the Murcchanas of the Ga-scale.

verses.sanskrit: शाठ्येनापि नमस्कारं प्रयुञ्जंश् चक्रपाणिनः । सप्तजन्मार्जितं पापं गच्छत्याशु न संशयः
verses.transliteration: śāṭhyenāpi namaskāraṃ prayuñjaṃś cakrapāṇinaḥ / saptajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ gacchatyāśu na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The Murcchana Karopanita-vitala was sung by Maruts in Svara-Mandala. That is Kalofianitd. Hence its presiding deity is Maruta. 7
verses.hindi: तथेति चोदितो राज्ञा विधिवत्सम्रुपस्थितः  स॒ दृष्ट्वोपह॒तं मांस क़ुद्धो राजानमन्रवीत् शशं भक्षयसे5रण्ये निघ णः पृर्व॑ंचद्य नु १८
verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchana Karopanita-vitala was sung by Maruts in Svara-Mandala. That is Kalofianitd. Hence its presiding deity is Maruta. 7
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchana Karopanita-vitala was sung by Maruts in Svara-Mandala. That is Kalofianitd. Hence its presiding deity is Maruta. 7

verses.sanskrit: पूजायां प्रीयते रुद्रो जपहोमैर् दिवाकरः । शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिः प्रणिपातेन तुष्यति
verses.transliteration: pūjāyāṃ prīyate rudro japahomair divākaraḥ / śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ praṇipātena tuṣyati
verses.translation: The Murcchana Suddha-madhyama originated in the Manu (ru?) desa.
verses.hindi: इक्ष्वाको संस्थिते तल्मिझ्शशास पृथिवीसिमाम्। प्राप्त: परमधर्मात्मा स चायोध्याधिपो5भवत्
verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchana Suddha-madhyama originated in the Manu (ru?) desa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchana Suddha-madhyama originated in the Manu (ru?) desa.

verses.sanskrit: भवजलधिगतानां द्वन्द्ववाताहतानां सुतदुहितृकलत्रत्राणभारार्दितानाम् । विषमविषयतोये मज्जतामप्लवानां भवति शरणमेको विष्णुपोतो नराणाम्
verses.transliteration: bhavajaladhigatānāṃ dvandvavātāhatānāṃ sutaduhitṛkalatratrāṇabhārārditānām / viṣamaviṣayatoye majjatāmaplavānāṃ bhavati śaraṇameko viṣṇupoto narāṇām
verses.translation: Since it moves along with the deer for the guidance of As the Murcchana is associated with hermitages and also with the various (human) voices of citizens, it is called Rajani due to its association with rajas (dust/atmosphere).
verses.hindi: वान् होने पर भी बहुत थक से गये । और मृगया करते समय उत्होंने थकावट दूर करने के लिये वहीं पर एक खरगोश खा लिया ।१२-१३। सेनिकों के साथ मांस लेकर जब विकुक्षि राजधानी को वापिस लौटे तब राजा ने महषि वसिष्ठ से “मांस का मंत्रोच्चारण पूर्वक सिंचन संस्कार कर दीजिये'--ऐसा कहा । राजा के ऐसा कहने पर वसिष्ठ थ्ले “बहुत अच्छा” कहकर विधि पूर्वक सिचन संस्कार करने के लिये जब वहाँ उपस्थित हुए । तब उस समस्त मांस राशि को अपवित्र देखकर परम कुद्ध होकर राजा से बोले
verses.wordMeaning: Since it moves along with the deer for the guidance of As the Murcchana is associated with hermitages and also with the various (human) voices of citizens, it is called Rajani due to its association with rajas (dust/atmosphere).
verses.commentary: Sense: Since it moves along with the deer for the guidance of As the Murcchana is associated with hermitages and also with the various (human) voices of citizens, it is called Rajani due to its association with rajas (dust/atmosphere).

verses.sanskrit: हुङ्कारतीर्थे राजेन्द्र शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् । यत्कृतं पुरुषव्याघ्र तन्नश्यति न कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: huṅkāratīrthe rājendra śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham / yatkṛtaṃ puruṣavyāghra tannaśyati na karhicit
verses.translation: The Tala (beating time) is known as having Satjlja as its deity. Hence Uttara-t&la is known first as well extended.
verses.hindi: राजन् ! तुम्हारे इस नीच स्वभाव वाले पुत्र विकुक्षि ने यह्व सब मांस अपवित्र कर दिया है । इसने पूर्व में ही खरगोश्न का मांस खा लिया है, अतः उसी के कारण यह सारा मांस अखाद्य हो गया है । है निष्पाप  इस तुम्हारे दुरात्मा पुत्र ने वन में श्राद्ध के पूर्व ही एक खरगोश खा लिया है, है तृपतिवर ! इसी कारण से यह सारा मांस दूषित हो गया, अब यह पितरों के योग्य नहीं रह गया है ।१६-९७॥।
verses.wordMeaning: The Tala (beating time) is known as having Satjlja as its deity. Hence Uttara-t&la is known first as well extended.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tala (beating time) is known as having Satjlja as its deity. Hence Uttara-t&la is known first as well extended.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे हुङ्कारस्वामितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५८ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्परं तीर्थं सङ्गमेश्वरमुत्तमम् । नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले सर्वपापभयापहम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe huṅkārasvāmitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 158 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchetparaṃ tīrthaṃ saṅgameśvaramuttamam / narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sarvapāpabhayāpaham
verses.translation: Since it is after Apana (?), Uttarayana having Dha (Dhaivata) as the starting point, is the Murcchana the deities of which are Pitrs (manes), the deities (worshipped in) Sraddhas.
verses.hindi: वसिष्ठ की ऐसी बातें सुनकर राजा इक्ष्वाकु परम कुद्ध हुए और बिकुक्षि से बोले--मैंने तुम्हें पित॒कमं के योग्य मांस लाने के लिए आज्ञा की थी, और उसी के लिये तुम शिकार करने गये भी थे, किन्तु वहाँ पर तुमने कुछ भी उचित अनुचित का विचार न कर श्राद्ध के पहिले ही निर्ममतायुबंक एक खरगोश खा लिया इस गुर अपराध के कारण तुम्हें मैं त्याग कर रहा हैं, अब तुम यहाँ से बाहर जहाँ मन कहे चले जाओ और अपने इस नीच कर्म का फल भोगो ।” वत्तिष्ठ के कहने पर इस प्रकार राजा इक्ष्वाकु ने अपने पृत्र विकुक्षि को त्याग दिया  उस राजा इशक्ष्वाकु के परलोक गमन के अनन्तर परम धर्मात्मा विकृक्षि ने महर्षि वसिष्ठ के बहुत कहने सुनने पर अयोध्या का राज्य भार अपने ऊपर ले लिया और समस्त पृथ्वी मण्डल का हासन किया ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since it is after Apana (?), Uttarayana having Dha (Dhaivata) as the starting point, is the Murcchana the deities of which are Pitrs (manes), the deities (worshipped in) Sraddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since it is after Apana (?), Uttarayana having Dha (Dhaivata) as the starting point, is the Murcchana the deities of which are Pitrs (manes), the deities (worshipped in) Sraddhas.

verses.sanskrit: धनदस्तत्र विश्रान्तो मुहूर्तं नृपसत्तम । पितृलोकात्समायातः कैलासं धरणीधरम्
verses.transliteration: dhanadastatra viśrānto muhūrtaṃ nṛpasattama / pitṛlokātsamāyātaḥ kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam
verses.translation: The great sages worship the Fire-god with the Suddha- Sadja (pure Sa-) note; it should be known as $uddha-Sa<jljika.
verses.hindi: कालेन गतवांस्तत्र स च न्यूनतरां गतिम् । ज्ञात्वेबमेतदाख्यानं नाविधिभंक्षयेत्तु व २२
verses.wordMeaning: The great sages worship the Fire-god with the Suddha- Sadja (pure Sa-) note; it should be known as $uddha-Sa<jljika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great sages worship the Fire-god with the Suddha- Sadja (pure Sa-) note; it should be known as $uddha-Sa<jljika.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्ययार्थं नृपश्रेष्ठ ह्यद्यापि धरणीतले । कृष्णवर्णा हि पाषाणा दृश्यन्ते स्फटिकोज्ज्वलाः
verses.transliteration: pratyayārthaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha hyadyāpi dharaṇītale / kṛṣṇavarṇā hi pāṣāṇā dṛśyante sphaṭikojjvalāḥ
verses.translation: It starts from the Pahcama note causing delight to the good people.
verses.hindi: पुबंमाडीवके युद्धे ककुत्स्थस्तेन स स्घृतः । अनेनास्तु कवुत्स्थस्य पृथरानेनसः स्पृतः जज्षे श्रावस्तको राजा श्रावस्ती येन निशिता । श्रायस्तस्थ तु दायादों बृहदश्वो महायशाः १२७
verses.wordMeaning: It starts from the Pahcama note causing delight to the good people.
verses.commentary: Sense: It starts from the Pahcama note causing delight to the good people.

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्यनिर्झरनिष्क्रान्ता पुण्यतोया सरिद्वरा । प्रविष्टा नर्मदातोये सर्वपापप्रणाशने
verses.transliteration: vindhyanirjharaniṣkrāntā puṇyatoyā saridvarā / praviṣṭā narmadātoye sarvapāpapraṇāśane
verses.translation: (Defective) That Murcchana which serpents of poiso¬ nous eyes do not approach and the serpent-deities become as it
verses.hindi: किन्तु राज्य भार ले लेने पर वह राजा विकुक्षि अपने उस पर्व पाप के कारण उत्तरोत्तर गिरता गया उसकी महिमा उत्तरोत्तर क्षीण होती गई  इस आख्यान को जानकर लोगों को चाहिए कि विना विधान के मांस को न खाये ।१९-२२। बुद्धिमान् लोग मांस के विषय में यह कहा करते हैं कि “मैं इस लोक में जिसके मांस का भक्षण कर रहा हूँ, वह परलोक में मेरे मांस का भक्षण करेगा--यही माँस भक्षण का नियम्न है ।?” शहर
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) That Murcchana which serpents of poiso¬ nous eyes do not approach and the serpent-deities become as it
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) That Murcchana which serpents of poiso¬ nous eyes do not approach and the serpent-deities become as it

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गमे तत्र यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् सङ्गमेश्वरम् । अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्य् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: saṅgame tatra yaḥ snātvā pūjayet saṅgameśvaram / aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam
verses.translation: The Murcchana with which Kinnaras (sing) in imitation of birds, is the excellent ( Ultama) MQrcchand. Its deity is the Lord of Birds (Garutfa).
verses.hindi: भक्षण करनेवाले राजा विकुक्षि का उत्तराधिकारी परम बलवान् राजा ककुत्स्थ हुआ  प्रात्रीनकाल में इन्द्र के बैल का स्वरूप धारण करने पर यह राजा उनके ककुद (डील) पर सवार हुआ था। यह प्रसंग पुर्बकाल में होनेवाले भाडीवक नामक युद्ध में घटित” हुआ था, इसीलिये इसका नाम ककुत्स्थ पड़ा । ककुत्स्थ के पुत्र अनेना हुए, अनेना के पुत्र राजा पृथु हुए, पृथु के पुत्र वृषदश्व हुए, उनके परम बलशाली अन्ध्न नामक पुत्र हुआ  अन्ध्र के यवनाइव नामक पुत्र हुआ, जिसके पुत्र का नाम श्रावस्त हुआ ।र३-२६। उसी राजा श्रावस्त ने श्रावस्ती नामक पुरी का निर्माण किया था। राजा श्रावस्त के पुत्र महान् यशस्वी राजा बृहदश्व हुए । बृहदश्व के पत्र का नाम कुवलाइव सुना जाता है। यही राजा कुवलाइव घुस्धु के मारने के कारण धुन्धुमार नाम से विख्यात हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchana with which Kinnaras (sing) in imitation of birds, is the excellent ( Ultama) MQrcchand. Its deity is the Lord of Birds (Garutfa).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchana with which Kinnaras (sing) in imitation of birds, is the excellent ( Ultama) MQrcchand. Its deity is the Lord of Birds (Garutfa).

verses.sanskrit: घण्टापताकावितनं यो ददेत्सङ्गमेश्वरे । हंसयुक्तविमानस्थो दिव्यस्त्रीशतसंवृतः
verses.transliteration: ghaṇṭāpatākāvitanaṃ yo dadetsaṅgameśvare / haṃsayuktavimānastho divyastrīśatasaṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: By the sound of Gandhara Raga, the earth (or cow?) is held in support. Hence it is called Visuddha-Gandharl (of pure Go). And Gandharva is its presiding deity.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने कहा--हे परम बुद्धिमान् सूत जी ! धुन्धु के वध का वृत्तान्त विस्तारपृवंक सुनना चाहते हैं, जिस कारणवश राजा कुवलाइव को धुन्धुमार की उपाधि मिली
verses.wordMeaning: By the sound of Gandhara Raga, the earth (or cow?) is held in support. Hence it is called Visuddha-Gandharl (of pure Go). And Gandharva is its presiding deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the sound of Gandhara Raga, the earth (or cow?) is held in support. Hence it is called Visuddha-Gandharl (of pure Go). And Gandharva is its presiding deity.

verses.sanskrit: स रुद्रपदमाप्नोति रुद्रस्यानुचरो भवेत् । दधि भक्ते न देवस्य यः कुर्याल्लिङ्गपूरणम्
verses.transliteration: sa rudrapadamāpnoti rudrasyānucaro bhavet / dadhi bhakte na devasya yaḥ kuryālliṅgapūraṇam
verses.translation: The Murcchana Uttara-Gandharl is so called as it was created after Gandhara. Its (presiding) deities are Vasus.
verses.hindi: खूत बोले--ऋषिवुन्द ! राजा बृहदइव के पुत्रों की संख्या इक्कीस सहखर थी, वे सब के सब्र बमुवुर्धासिकाः सर्वे यज्वानो भूरिदक्षिणा:। कुबलाश्व॑ं महावीय॑ शुरमुत्तमधासिकम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchana Uttara-Gandharl is so called as it was created after Gandhara. Its (presiding) deities are Vasus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchana Uttara-Gandharl is so called as it was created after Gandhara. Its (presiding) deities are Vasus.

verses.sanskrit: सिक्थसंख्यं शिवे लोके स वसेत् कालम् ईप्सितम् । श्रीफलैः पूरयेल्लिङ्गं निःस्वो भूत्वा भवस्य तु
verses.transliteration: sikthasaṃkhyaṃ śive loke sa vaset kālam īpsitam / śrīphalaiḥ pūrayelliṅgaṃ niḥsvo bhūtvā bhavasya tu
verses.translation: The Satfja Murcchana first approached god Brahma (Pitamaha). Hence its greatness. Its deity is the Fire-god.
verses.hindi: बृहदश्वोइभ्यषिज्चत्तं तस्मित्राष्ट्रे नराधिपः । पुत्रसंक्रामितश्रीस्तु बन राजा विवेश ह ७३ २ बृहदश्यं महाराज शुरमुत्तमधासिकम् । प्रयात॑ तमुत्तड्धूस्तु ब्रह्मषिः प्रत्यवारयत्
verses.wordMeaning: The Satfja Murcchana first approached god Brahma (Pitamaha). Hence its greatness. Its deity is the Fire-god.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Satfja Murcchana first approached god Brahma (Pitamaha). Hence its greatness. Its deity is the Fire-god.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि तत्फलमाप्नोति गतः स्वर्गे नरेश्वर । अक्षया सन्ततिस्तस्य जायते सप्तजन्मसु
verses.transliteration: so 'pi tatphalamāpnoti gataḥ svarge nareśvara / akṣayā santatistasya jāyate saptajanmasu
verses.translation: The Murcchana called Mandasastha is divine and extensive. The names of its equalities cannot be described. Its deity is Paflcama (the note Pa).
verses.hindi: भवता रक्षणं कार्य तत्तावत्कतुंमहेति । निरुद्धिग्सस्तपः करतुं' न हि शक्नोमि पार्थिव ३४ समा5अ्रससमोपेषु समेषु सरुधन्वसु । ससुद्रो वालुकापुण्णस्तत्र तत्र तिष्ठति भूपते स मनोस्तनय: क्रो धुन्धुर्नाम सुदारण:। शतं लोकविनाशाय तप आस्थाय दारुणम् ३७ संवत्सरस्य पयन्ते स निश्चासं प्रमु्यति । यदा यदा मही तत्र घलति सम सकानना
verses.wordMeaning: The Murcchana called Mandasastha is divine and extensive. The names of its equalities cannot be described. Its deity is Paflcama (the note Pa).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Murcchana called Mandasastha is divine and extensive. The names of its equalities cannot be described. Its deity is Paflcama (the note Pa).

verses.sanskrit: स्नपनं देवदेवस्य दध्ना मधुघृतेन वा । यः करोति विधानेन तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: snapanaṃ devadevasya dadhnā madhughṛtena vā / yaḥ karoti vidhānena tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.hindi: सभी विद्याओं में पारज़ुत, परम बलवान्, दुर्दमनीय, प्रचुरदक्षिणा देते वाले, यज्ञकर्त्ता एवं घामिक विचारों वाले थे। नराधिप बृहदद्व ने सबों में परम धामिक, शूरवीर एवं साहसी कु+लाइ्व को अपने राज्य के उत्तराधिकारी पद पद अभिषिक्त किया और इस प्रकार योग्य पुत्र को राज्य भी समयित कर र्त्यं वन को चले गये । ब्रह्म उत्तदू: ते परम धघामिक महाराज बृहदश्व को वन में जाते हुए निवारित किया ।३०-३ ३।
verses.wordMeaning: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the seven Notes ( Svaras) and the Murcchanas are recounted completely. Murcchanas with Sadharana Svaras 1 Ce.g. Antara Gandhara, Kakall Nisada) are many. Only six of them are known.

verses.sanskrit: धृतक्षीरवहा नद्यो यत्र वृक्षा मधुस्रवाः । तत्र ते मानवा यान्ति सुप्रसन्ने महेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: dhṛtakṣīravahā nadyo yatra vṛkṣā madhusravāḥ / tatra te mānavā yānti suprasanne maheśvare
verses.translation: After knowing the views of earlier teachers, I shall explain in due order, the thirty embellishments of music. Listen to them while I am expounding.
verses.hindi: उत्तक॒क ने कहा--हे राजनू ! आपको हम लोगों की रक्षा करनी चाहिए, अतः हमारी रक्षा कीजिये, उद्विग्न चित्र होने के कारण तपस्या करने में हम असमर्थ हो रहे हैं। भूपते ! हमारे आश्रम के समीप ही इस समान मरुभूमि में बालू का समुद्र है। उसी में भूमि के अध्दर निवास बनाकर परम विकराल शरीरवाला, महाबलवान धुन्धु रहता है, देवबगण भी उस धुन्धु का वध नहीं कर सकते, वह बाल में रहता है । वह धुन्धु मनु का पुत्र है, फिर भी परम क्र और दारुण चित्तवृत्तिहाला है। लोकों का विनाश्ष करने के लिए वह सौ वर्षों से दारुण तप कर रहा है ।३४-३७। एक वर्ष बीतने पर वह एक श्वास छोड़ता है, जिस समय वह श्वास छोड़ता है, उस समय जंगलों समेत सारी पृथ्वी हिलने लगती है। उसकी निःश्वास वायु से ध्ल का विकराल बवंडर उठ पड़ता है, जिससे सूर्य का मार्ग ही घिर जाता है, सात दिनों तक भूमि कॉँपती
verses.wordMeaning: After knowing the views of earlier teachers, I shall explain in due order, the thirty embellishments of music. Listen to them while I am expounding.
verses.commentary: Sense: After knowing the views of earlier teachers, I shall explain in due order, the thirty embellishments of music. Listen to them while I am expounding.

verses.sanskrit: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यस्तु दद्यान्महेश्वरे । तत्सर्वं सप्तजन्मानि ह्यक्षयं फलम् अश्नुते
verses.transliteration: patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yastu dadyānmaheśvare / tatsarvaṃ saptajanmāni hyakṣayaṃ phalam aśnute
verses.translation: The Alankaras (embellishments of music) are to be explained along with their Varnas (movements of notes such as 'steady', 'ascending' and others) as their specific basis and also along with their associated configuration ( Samsthana ), always in regard to dramatic performance 2 etc.
verses.hindi: रहती है। चारों ओर अग्नि की चिनगारियाँ उठ पड़ती हैं, विकराल ज्वालाएँ निकलने लगती है, अतिदारुण धूएँ में सारी दिशाएं आकी्ण हो जाती हैं, है राजन् ! इन सब उत्पातों से हम अपने इस आश्रम में भी निवास नही कर पाते ।३८-४०। है महाबाहु राजन ! लोकरक्षा के ध्यान से उसे उत्पात से निवारित कीजिये ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Alankaras (embellishments of music) are to be explained along with their Varnas (movements of notes such as 'steady', 'ascending' and others) as their specific basis and also along with their associated configuration ( Samsthana ),…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Alankaras (embellishments of music) are to be explained along with their Varnas (movements of notes such as 'steady', 'ascending' and others) as their specific basis and also along with their associated configuration ( Samsthana ),…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव पात्राणां महापात्रं महेश्वरः । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूजनीयो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva pātrāṇāṃ mahāpātraṃ maheśvaraḥ / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pūjanīyo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The SSdharana Svaras are:
verses.hindi: त॑ वारय भहाबाहो लोकानां हितकाम्यया । तेजस्ते सुमहाविष्णुस्तेजसा55प्याययिष्यति ॥॥४ १ लोकाः स्वस्था भवन्‍न्त्वय्य तस्मिन्विनिहते5सुरे । त्वं हि तस्य वधायाद्य समर्थ: पृथवोपते ४२ विष्णुना च बरो दत्तो मम पूर्व ततो४नघ । न हि धुन्धुमहावीयंस्तेजसाइल्‍पेन शक्‍्यते निर्दग्पुं पथिवीपाल अपि वर्षशतेरिह । वीर्य हि सुमहत्तस्थ देवरपि दुरासहम् ४४
verses.wordMeaning: The SSdharana Svaras are:
verses.commentary: Sense: The SSdharana Svaras are:

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यस्थितो नित्यं यस्तु पूजयते शिवम् । इह जीवन्स देवेशो मृतो गच्छेद् अनामयम्
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryasthito nityaṃ yastu pūjayate śivam / iha jīvansa deveśo mṛto gacched anāmayam
verses.translation: Vide Bharata's NafyaSastra Volume. IV, p -92 (Baroda Edition)
verses.hindi: राजा संन्यस्तशस्त्रो5हमयं तु तनयो मस । भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ धुन्धुमारों न संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: Vide Bharata's NafyaSastra Volume. IV, p -92 (Baroda Edition)
verses.commentary: Sense: Vide Bharata's NafyaSastra Volume. IV, p -92 (Baroda Edition)

verses.sanskrit: शिवे तु पूजिते पार्थ यत्फलं प्राप्यते बुधैः । योगीन्द्रे चैव तत्पार्थ पूजिते लभते फलम्
verses.transliteration: śive tu pūjite pārtha yatphalaṃ prāpyate budhaiḥ / yogīndre caiva tatpārtha pūjite labhate phalam
verses.translation: The fulfilment of embellishment is achieved by the implications of sentences and connotations of the word-com- binations.
verses.hindi: स॒ त॑ व्यादिश्य तनयं धुन्धुमारणमुद्यतम् । जगाम पबंतायव तपसे शंसितत्रतः ३४७ कुबलाश्वस्तु धर्मात्मा पितुर्बचननमास्थित: । सहस्नरेकाविशत्या पुवाणां सह पाथिव: ॥ तमाविशत्ततो विष्णुभंगवान्स्वेन तेजसा । उत्तड्भस्य नियोगात्तु लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.wordMeaning: The fulfilment of embellishment is achieved by the implications of sentences and connotations of the word-com- binations.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fulfilment of embellishment is achieved by the implications of sentences and connotations of the word-com- binations.

verses.sanskrit: ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस् तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् । येषां गृहेषु भुञ्जन्ति शिवभक्तिरता नराः
verses.transliteration: te dhanyāste mahātmānas teṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / yeṣāṃ gṛheṣu bhuñjanti śivabhaktiratā narāḥ
verses.translation: One should understand that there are three place of utterance. They are the chest, the throat and the head. The best procedure (of production of notes) begins in these three places.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारे इस उपकार काये में भगवान् विष्णु अपने तेजोबल से तुम्हारी सन्तुष्टि करेगें अर्थात् सहायता करेंगे। उस महान् असुर के मारे जाने पर सभी लोक स्वस्थ हो जायेंगे। है प्रथ्वीपति ! तुम उस महान् असुर के मारने में आज समर्थ हो  है निष्पाप ! पृवेकाल में भगवान् विष्णु ने यह वरदान दिया है कि महाबलवान् घुन्धु अल्प बल से अधीन नहीं किया जा सकता । अर्थात् इसे वश्य करने के लिये किसी महान् बलशाली
verses.wordMeaning: One should understand that there are three place of utterance. They are the chest, the throat and the head. The best procedure (of production of notes) begins in these three places.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should understand that there are three place of utterance. They are the chest, the throat and the head. The best procedure (of production of notes) begins in these three places.

verses.sanskrit: संनिरुध्येन्द्रियग्रामं यत्रयत्र वसेन्मुनिः । तत्र तत्र कुरुक्षेत्रं नैमिषं पुष्कराणि च
verses.transliteration: saṃnirudhyendriyagrāmaṃ yatrayatra vasenmuniḥ / tatra tatra kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca
verses.translation: In the original stage (Prakftau), there are four varnas (tone-patterns) with fourfold movement. The alternative movement is eightfold; 1 and gods know it as sixteenfold.
verses.hindi: को आवश्यकता है, है प्रथ्वीपाल ! सकड़ों वर्षो में भी इसे कोई पराजित नहीं कर सकता, उसका बल महान् है, देवगण भी उसे पराजित नहीं कर सर्कतिे' ४१-४४। महात्मा उत्तड्धू के ऐसा कहते पर रजर्षि बृहृदश्व ने धुन्धु के उपद्रयों को निर्म्ल करने के लिये उन्हें अपने पुत्र कुबलाश्व को समर्पित करते हुए बोले। महष ! मैं राजा हैँ, सभी का पालन करता हमारा धर्म है; परन्तु हम अस्त्र शस्त्र छोड़ चुके हैं, है द्विंजभ्रेष्ठ ! यह हमारा पुत्र निस्सन्देह उस धुन्धु को मारने में समथ होगा । इस प्रकार धुन्धु के मारने के लिए सत्यप्रतिज्ञ राजा बृहदश्व ने अपने पुत्र कुवलाश्व को नियुक्त कर स्वयं तपस्या के लिये पर्वत की और प्रस्थान किया । इधर पिता की आज्ञा शिरोघार्य कर धर्मात्मा महाराज कुबलाश्व ने अपने इक्कीस सहख्र पुत्रों को तथा महृषि उत्तद्भु को साथ लेकर उस धुन्धु के निवारणार्थं प्रस्थान किया ।४५-४८। महषि उत्तद्भू के प्रयत्न पूर्वक प्रार्थना
verses.wordMeaning: In the original stage (Prakftau), there are four varnas (tone-patterns) with fourfold movement. The alternative movement is eightfold; 1 and gods know it as sixteenfold.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the original stage (Prakftau), there are four varnas (tone-patterns) with fourfold movement. The alternative movement is eightfold; 1 and gods know it as sixteenfold.

verses.sanskrit: यत्फलं वेदविदुषि भोजिते शतसंख्यया । तत्फलं जायते पार्थ ह्येकेन शिवयोगिना
verses.transliteration: yatphalaṃ vedaviduṣi bhojite śatasaṃkhyayā / tatphalaṃ jāyate pārtha hyekena śivayoginā
verses.translation: [ The designations of Varnas: ]
verses.hindi: आदि करने के कारण तथा लोक हित की भावना से भगवान् विष्णु स्वयं उस रार्जाष कुवलाश्व में अपने तेज सहित आविष्ट हुए । इस प्रकार ,राजि कुवलाइ्व ने जिस समय धुन्धु के निवा रणार्थ प्रस्थान किया उस समय भाकाद्ष में चारों ओर से घोर शब्द होने लगे । और चारों ओर से यह आवाज आने लगी कि आज यह राजा
verses.wordMeaning: [ The designations of Varnas: ]
verses.commentary: Sense: [ The designations of Varnas: ]

verses.sanskrit: यत्र भुञ्जति भस्माङ्गी मूर्खो वा यदि पण्डितः । तत्र भुञ्जति देवेशः सपत्नीको वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: yatra bhuñjati bhasmāṅgī mūrkho vā yadi paṇḍitaḥ / tatra bhuñjati deveśaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: There is one (Varna viz. Sthayin) which has steady employment. Sancara is a mixed movement. One should indicate the descent of Varnas (i.e. Svaras) as Avarohana.
verses.hindi: दिव्य: पुष्पेश्न त॑ देवा: समसंमत अद्भुतम् । स गत्वा पुरुषव्याश्नस्तनये: सह वीय॑वान् समुद्रं खनयामास वालुकाणंवमव्ययम् । नारायणेत राजर्षिस्तेजस455प्याथितो हि सः ५२
verses.wordMeaning: There is one (Varna viz. Sthayin) which has steady employment. Sancara is a mixed movement. One should indicate the descent of Varnas (i.e. Svaras) as Avarohana.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is one (Varna viz. Sthayin) which has steady employment. Sancara is a mixed movement. One should indicate the descent of Varnas (i.e. Svaras) as Avarohana.

verses.sanskrit: विप्राणां वेदविदुषां कोटिं संभोज्य यत्फलम् । भिक्षामात्रप्रदानेन तत्फलं शिवयोगिनाम्
verses.transliteration: viprāṇāṃ vedaviduṣāṃ koṭiṃ saṃbhojya yatphalam / bhikṣāmātrapradānena tatphalaṃ śivayoginām
verses.translation: There are four embellishments, viz. Sthapani, These are mentioned in the Puranas, only later writers do not refer to them.
verses.hindi: तस्य पुत्र: खनद्दिश्व वालुकान्तहितस्तदा । धुन्चुरासादितस्तत्न दिशामाश्षित्य पश्चिमाम् ५४ सुखजेनारिनना कुद्धों लोकानुद्वतंयन्चिव । वारि सु्लाव योगेन सहोदधिरिवोदये ह ५५ सोमस्य सोसपश्रेष्ठ धारोमभिकलिलो महान् । तस्य पुत्रास्तु निदंग्धास्त्रिभिरूनास्तु राक्षकाः
verses.wordMeaning: There are four embellishments, viz. Sthapani, These are mentioned in the Puranas, only later writers do not refer to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are four embellishments, viz. Sthapani, These are mentioned in the Puranas, only later writers do not refer to them.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गमेश्वरमासाद्य प्राणत्यागं करोति यः । न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिः शिवलोकात् कदाचन
verses.transliteration: saṅgameśvaramāsādya prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ / na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ śivalokāt kadācana
verses.translation: The exigencies of the metre have led to the change in the order of Vardas. The order should have been:
verses.hindi: ततः स राजाउतिबलो धुन्धुबन्धुनिबहेँण: । तस्य वारिमयं वेगमपिबत्स नराधिप:ः ४७ योगी योगेन वलछ्लि वा शमयामास वारिणा। निरस्य तं॑ महाकाय॑ घबलेनोदक राक्षसम् श्द उत्तड़ं दर्शयामास कृतकर्मा नराधिप:। उत्तडु:श्व बरं प्रादात्तस्भे राजे महात्मने ५६ अवात्तस्पाक्षयं वित्त शत्रुभिश्वाप्यधुष्यताम् । धर्म रत च सतत स्वर्ग वास तथा5क्षयम् ॥॥ पुत्राणां चाक्षयॉल्लोकान्स्वर्गे ये रक्षसा हताः
verses.wordMeaning: The exigencies of the metre have led to the change in the order of Vardas. The order should have been:
verses.commentary: Sense: The exigencies of the metre have led to the change in the order of Vardas. The order should have been:

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सङ्गमेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १५९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज तीर्थं परमपावनम् । नर्मदायां सुदुष्प्रापं सिद्धं ह्यनरकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe saṅgameśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 159 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam / narmadāyāṃ suduṣprāpaṃ siddhaṃ hyanarakeśvaram
verses.translation: Although I have referred to the section on Alankdras in Sangita Ratnakara (I.VI) only a few Alankaras like Sycna ( of S. R.) shed some light. Though S.R. is much later than Va.P or Bd.P., I consulted it m S.R. preserved some of the PurAuic traditions.
verses.hindi: कुव॒लाइव अवश्यमेव धुन्धु का संहार करेगा। देवतागण चारों ओर से स्वर्गीय पुष्षों की वृष्टि उसके ऊपर करने लगे। इस प्रकार अपने पुत्रों समेत प्रस्थान कर परम बल शाली नरव्यात्र कुबलाशव ने उस बालुकामय समुद्र को जिसका विनाश असम्भव था, खतना प्रारम्भ किया  उस समय वह राजधि भगवान् के तेज से समन्वित होकर महान् बलवान हो गये थे, फिर भी महर्षि उत्तद्भु के वश में वतंमान थे ।४९-५३॥ उस समय
verses.wordMeaning: Although I have referred to the section on Alankdras in Sangita Ratnakara (I.VI) only a few Alankaras like Sycna ( of S. R.) shed some light. Though S.R. is much later than Va.P or Bd.P., I consulted it m S.R. preserved some of the PurAuic traditions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although I have referred to the section on Alankdras in Sangita Ratnakara (I.VI) only a few Alankaras like Sycna ( of S. R.) shed some light. Though S.R. is much later than Va.P or Bd.P., I consulted it m S.R. preserved some of the PurAuic traditions.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पापकर्मापि भारत । न पश्यति महाघोरं नरकद्वारसंज्ञिकम्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā pāpakarmāpi bhārata / na paśyati mahāghoraṃ narakadvārasaṃjñikam
verses.translation: (Names of Alankaras still continue as follows:) Visoara, Asfakala 2 3 which has an interval of one place (from its original place?). Avarta and Kramolpalti —these two should be effected according to their proportion.
verses.hindi: जब कि उनके पुत्र गण उस वालुकामय समुद्र को खन रहे थे धुन्धु इर पश्चिम दिशा की ओर दिखाई पड़ा। उस समय वह बहुत क्रोधित हो रद्दा था, मुख से अग्नि की विकराल ज्वालाएं इस प्रकार उगल रहा था मानों समस्त लोकों को विनष्ट कर देना चाहता है। फिर उसने योगबल का आश्रय लेकर इतना जल बरसाया कि चारों ओर जल का भीषण समुद्र उमड़ पड़ा । है सोमपान करनेवाले ऋषियों में सर्वोपरि ! उस समय वह जल राशि एवं तरंगे इस प्रकार ऊपर की ओर उमड़ने लगीं मानों चन्द्रमा का उवय हो गया हो। इस प्रकार राक्षसों ने राजा के समस्त पुत्रों को, केवल तीन पुत्रों को छोड़कर, भस्म कर दिया ।५४-५६। तब धुन्धु के परिवार वर्ग को नष्ट करने की चिन्ता से उस महाबलवान राजा ने धुन्धु की उस समस्त जल राशि को पान कर लिया, और योगबल द्वारा जल से इस अग्नि को भी शान्‍्त कर दिया । और उस प्रकार अपने अदम्य साहस से उस
verses.wordMeaning: (Names of Alankaras still continue as follows:) Visoara, Asfakala 2 3 which has an interval of one place (from its original place?). Avarta and Kramolpalti —these two should be effected according to their proportion.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Names of Alankaras still continue as follows:) Visoara, Asfakala 2 3 which has an interval of one place (from its original place?). Avarta and Kramolpalti —these two should be effected according to their proportion.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: शुभाशुभफलैस्तात भुक्तभोगा नरास्त्विह । जायन्ते लक्षणैर्यैस्तु तानि मे वद सत्तम
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: śubhāśubhaphalaistāta bhuktabhogā narāstviha / jāyante lakṣaṇairyaistu tāni me vada sattama
verses.translation: Syena is originated as having one interval and situated in the midst of Matras of a Kala. In it there abides the increase in the order of the note different from it (e.g. Sa~ Pa, Ri—Dha, Ga—Ni).
verses.hindi: महाबलवान् जलवासी राक्षस धुन्धु को निरस्त कर दिया ।५३-४5। अपने कार्य में सफलता प्राप्त कर राजा महषि उत्तद्भु के समीप उपस्थित हुए  मह॒षि ने उस महात्मा राजा को उत्तम वरदान दिये। उसे कभी नष्ट न होने वाली अक्षय सम्पत्ति प्रदान की, शत्रुओं से उसे कभी पराजय न भिले, धर्म में प्रेम भावना की वृद्धि हो; स्वर्ग लोक में निरन्तर बास हो,--वहाँ से कभी पतन न हो-ऐसा वरदान दिया। इसके अतिरिक्त राक्षसों
verses.wordMeaning: Syena is originated as having one interval and situated in the midst of Matras of a Kala. In it there abides the increase in the order of the note different from it (e.g. Sa~ Pa, Ri—Dha, Ga—Ni).
verses.commentary: Sense: Syena is originated as having one interval and situated in the midst of Matras of a Kala. In it there abides the increase in the order of the note different from it (e.g. Sa~ Pa, Ri—Dha, Ga—Ni).

verses.sanskrit: यथा निर्गच्छते जीवस्त्यक्त्वा देहं न पश्यति । तथा गच्छन्पुनर्देहं पञ्चभूतसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: yathā nirgacchate jīvastyaktvā dehaṃ na paśyati / tathā gacchanpunardehaṃ pañcabhūtasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: The descent of the Syena AlankSra is called Uttara. The
verses.hindi: तस्य पत्नी हैमवती सतां मतिदृषद्गवती । विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु पृत्रस्तस्याः प्रसेनजित् ६४ युवनाश्वः सुतस्तस्य त्रिषु लोकेष्वतिद्युतिः । अत्यन्तधामिकों गौरी तस्य पत्नी पतिब्रता ३६५ मांधाता यौवनाश्वो वे अलोक्यविजयी नृपः । अन्राप्युदाहरन्तोमो श्लोफो पोराणिका द्विजा:
verses.wordMeaning: The descent of the Syena AlankSra is called Uttara. The
verses.commentary: Sense: The descent of the Syena AlankSra is called Uttara. The

verses.sanskrit: त्वगस्थिमांसमेदोऽसृक्केशस्नायुशतैः सह । विण्मूत्ररेतःसङ्घाते का संज्ञा जायते नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: tvagasthimāṃsamedo'sṛkkeśasnāyuśataiḥ saha / viṇmūtraretaḥsaṅghāte kā saṃjñā jāyate nṛṇām
verses.translation: The Alankara called Prenkholita has the twelfth place of Kala having one interval. Thus it is endowed with Svaras (Notes).
verses.hindi: मांधाता तु तनुविष्णो: पुराणज्ञा: प्रचक्षेी। .. ६६
verses.wordMeaning: The Alankara called Prenkholita has the twelfth place of Kala having one interval. Thus it is endowed with Svaras (Notes).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Alankara called Prenkholita has the twelfth place of Kala having one interval. Thus it is endowed with Svaras (Notes).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः स मार्कण्डः कथयामास योगवित् । ध्यात्वा सनातनं सर्वं देवदेवं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ sa mārkaṇḍaḥ kathayāmāsa yogavit / dhyātvā sanātanaṃ sarvaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: Some verses after this must have been lost as neither our text nor Bd.P. explains these anywhere.
verses.hindi: द्वारा उनके जिन पुत्रों का निधन हुआ था, उन्हें अक्षय स्वर्ग प्रदात किया ।५६-६०। उस राजा कुवलाश्व के जो तीन पुत्र शेष रह गये थे, उनमें सबसे बड़े का नाम दुढाश्व कहा जाता है, भद्गाइव ओर कपिलाइव--ये दो छोटे कहे जाते हैं । धुन्धुभार के ज्येष्ठ पृत्र दुढाइ्व का जो पुत्र हुआ उसका नाम हयंश्व था । हयेदव कौ पुत्र निकुम्भ हुआ, जो सवदा क्षत्रिय धर्म में निरत रहनेवाला था ।६१-६२। निकुम्भ का पुत्र सहताइ्व रणभूमि में परम निपुण सुना जाता है। उसके कृशाश्व और अक्षयाइव नामक दो पुत्र हुए। संहताइव की एक पत्नी का नाम हेमवती थी, जो सत्पुरुषों से सम्मानीय थी, उसका दूसरा नाम मतिदुषद्वती था, तीनों लोकों में वह परम विख्यात थी, उसका पुत्र प्रसेनजित हुआ ।६३-६४। प्रसेनजित का पुत्र युवनाश्व तीनों लोकों में परम कान्तिमान था, उसके विचार परम धाभिक थे, उसकी पतित्रता भार्या मौरी थी। पतिने एक बार उसे शाप दे दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Some verses after this must have been lost as neither our text nor Bd.P. explains these anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some verses after this must have been lost as neither our text nor Bd.P. explains these anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणु पार्थ महाप्रश्नं कथयामि यथाश्रुतम् । सकाशाद्ब्रह्मणः पूर्वमृषिदेवसमागमे
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu pārtha mahāpraśnaṃ kathayāmi yathāśrutam / sakāśādbrahmaṇaḥ pūrvamṛṣidevasamāgame
verses.translation: Uffrakala in the text being obscure, is emended as per Bd. P.
verses.hindi: जिसके फंल स्वरूप वह बाहुदा नामक नदी के रूप में परिणत हुई । उसका. पुत्र गौरिक अपने समय का चक्रवर्ती सम्राट् हुआ । युवनाइव का पुत्र मान्धाता त्रेलोक्य विजयी राजा था, उसके विषय में पुरानी कथाओं के जानने वाले विप्रगग ये दो श्लोक बतलाते हैं, जिनका तात्पयं यह है। “जहाँ से सूर्य उदित होते हैं ओर जहाँ पर जाकर अस्त होते हैं, वह सब मान्धाता का क्षेत्र (राज्य) कहा जाता है। इस प्रसंग में राजवंशों के जानने
verses.wordMeaning: Uffrakala in the text being obscure, is emended as per Bd. P.
verses.commentary: Sense: Uffrakala in the text being obscure, is emended as per Bd. P.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुरात्मवतां शास्ता राजा शास्ता दुरात्मनाम् । इह प्रच्छन्नपापानां शास्ता वैवस्वतो यमः
verses.transliteration: gururātmavatāṃ śāstā rājā śāstā durātmanām / iha pracchannapāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ
verses.translation: The text is obscure both here and in the Bd. P.
verses.hindi: वाले लोग परम तेजस्वी, यज्ञ परायण महात्मा मान्धाता के विषय में यहाँ तक कहते हैं कि 'पुराणज्ञ लोग मान्धाता को भगवान विष्ण का स्वरूप बतलाते हैं ।६५-६६॥ उस राजा मान्धाता कौ स्त्री शशबविन्दू की पुत्री संभुतस्याउपत्मजः पुत्रों ह्वनरण्यः प्रतापवान् । रावणो निहतो येन त्रिलोकीविजये पुरा
verses.wordMeaning: The text is obscure both here and in the Bd. P.
verses.commentary: Sense: The text is obscure both here and in the Bd. P.

verses.sanskrit: अचीर्णप्रायश्चित्तानां यमलोके ह्यनेकधा । यातनाभिर्वियुक्तानामनेकां जीवसन्ततिम्
verses.transliteration: acīrṇaprāyaścittānāṃ yamaloke hyanekadhā / yātanābhirviyuktānāmanekāṃ jīvasantatim
verses.translation: Just as in the case of beautification (of one's person; it is extremely censured if it is used at the wrong place, similarly unfavourable (discordant) embellishment of the Varners also (is censurable) as it is produced by oneself.
verses.hindi: तस्य पुत्रोभवद्राजा त्रिधन्‍्वा नाम धारमिकः । आसोत्त्रेधन्वनश्रापि विद्वांस्त्रय्यारुण: प्रभु:
verses.wordMeaning: Just as in the case of beautification (of one's person; it is extremely censured if it is used at the wrong place, similarly unfavourable (discordant) embellishment of the Varners also (is censurable) as it is produced by oneself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as in the case of beautification (of one's person; it is extremely censured if it is used at the wrong place, similarly unfavourable (discordant) embellishment of the Varners also (is censurable) as it is produced by oneself.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा मनुष्यभावे तु पापचिह्ना भवन्ति ते । तत्ते ऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना नृप
verses.transliteration: gatvā manuṣyabhāve tu pāpacihnā bhavanti te / tatte 'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa
verses.translation: Just as with the use of various ornaments, a woman gets herself beautified, so are the (musical) embellishments to a Varna, (but) if discordantly used, it is bitterly denounced.
verses.hindi: तस्य सत्यत्रतो नाम कुमासे5भुन्महाबलः। तेन भार्या विदर्भस्य हृता हत्वा दिवौकसानू. पाणिग्रहणमन्त्रेषु निष्ठां संप्रापितेष्विह । विष्णुवद्धः सुतस्तस्य विष्णवरद्धा यतः स्मृताः ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: Just as with the use of various ornaments, a woman gets herself beautified, so are the (musical) embellishments to a Varna, (but) if discordantly used, it is bitterly denounced.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as with the use of various ornaments, a woman gets herself beautified, so are the (musical) embellishments to a Varna, (but) if discordantly used, it is bitterly denounced.

verses.sanskrit: सहित्वा यातनां सर्वां गत्वा वैवस्वतक्षयम् । विस्तीर्णयातना ये तु लोकमायान्ति चिह्निताः
verses.transliteration: sahitvā yātanāṃ sarvāṃ gatvā vaivasvatakṣayam / vistīrṇayātanā ye tu lokamāyānti cihnitāḥ
verses.translation: The ear-ring is not seen (worn) on the feet; nor a girdle round the neck. So also the embellishment (in music) if used in the wrong place, is reproached.
verses.hindi: कामाहइलाच्च मोहाच्च संकषंणबलेन च। भाविनोथंस्य च बलात्तत्कृतं तेन धोमता ८०
verses.wordMeaning: The ear-ring is not seen (worn) on the feet; nor a girdle round the neck. So also the embellishment (in music) if used in the wrong place, is reproached.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ear-ring is not seen (worn) on the feet; nor a girdle round the neck. So also the embellishment (in music) if used in the wrong place, is reproached.

verses.sanskrit: गद्गदो ऽनृतवादी स्यान्मूकश्चैव गवानृते । ब्रह्महा जायते कुष्ठी श्यावदन्तस्तु मद्यपः
verses.transliteration: gadgado 'nṛtavādī syānmūkaścaiva gavānṛte / brahmahā jāyate kuṣṭhī śyāvadantastu madyapaḥ
verses.translation: When the embellishment is effected, it should indicate the Raga (melody); just as the path intended to be undertaken is characterised.
verses.hindi: “--+++्+"५/)3२7स्‍8) -+-"-+-+-+-.न्‍॥ह/॥्््ननन्‍नन्‍बनछझ॥0202/हऑ.7रै है है हएऋ£ओआऑआऑ 9 उउः चेतरथी थी । वह समस्त पृथ्वी में अपने रूप में अनृपम थी  उस परम पतित्नता का अन्य नाम विन्दुमतो भी था। अपने दस सहस्र भाइयों में वह सबसे ज्येष्ठ थी, उसका पतिब्रता धर्म प्रशंसनोय था । ऐश्वयंशाली मान्धाता ने उससे तीन पुत्र उत्पन्न किये, जिनके नाम पुरुकुत्स, अम्बरीष और मुचुकुन्द सुने जाते हैं। राजा अम्बरीष का उत्तराधिकारी दूसरा युवनादव हुआ, युवनाश्व के पुत्र हरित हुए, हरित के पुत्र शूरि नाम से विख्यात हुए ।
verses.wordMeaning: When the embellishment is effected, it should indicate the Raga (melody); just as the path intended to be undertaken is characterised.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the embellishment is effected, it should indicate the Raga (melody); just as the path intended to be undertaken is characterised.

verses.sanskrit: कुनखी स्वर्णहरणाद् दुःश्चर्मा गुरुतल्पगः । संयोगी हीनयोनिः स्याद् दरिद्रो ऽदत्तदानतः
verses.transliteration: kunakhī svarṇaharaṇād duḥścarmā gurutalpagaḥ / saṃyogī hīnayoniḥ syād daridro 'dattadānataḥ
verses.translation: If the reading from Bd.P. is referred to the name of this Alankara is Vdpa. But I am not sure of the correctness of the reading in the Bd.P.
verses.hindi: ये महृषि अंगिरा के पुत्र क्षत्रिय धर्म परायण द्विजाति कहे जातें थे, राजा पुरुकृत्स के उत्तराधिकारी महान् यशस्वी त्रसदस्यु हुए, जिनका जन्म नमंदा में हुआ था, त्रसदन्यु के पुत्र सम्भूत हुए ।७००-७४। सम्भूत के पुत्र परम प्रताप शाली अनरण्य हुए । जिन्होने प्राचीव काल में त्रिलोकी विजय के प्रसद्भ में रावण का निधन किया था । उन राजा अनरण्य के पुत्र त्रसददव हुए, जिनके पुत्र का चाम हयेश्व था, उन राजा ह॒यंश्व से दुषद्ती में
verses.wordMeaning: If the reading from Bd.P. is referred to the name of this Alankara is Vdpa. But I am not sure of the correctness of the reading in the Bd.P.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the reading from Bd.P. is referred to the name of this Alankara is Vdpa. But I am not sure of the correctness of the reading in the Bd.P.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामशूकरतां याति ह्ययाज्ययाजको नृप । खरो वै बहुयाजी स्याच्छ्वानिमन्त्रितभोजनात्
verses.transliteration: grāmaśūkaratāṃ yāti hyayājyayājako nṛpa / kharo vai bahuyājī syācchvānimantritabhojanāt
verses.translation: Vide Sangita-ratndkara I, 6.64 which enumerates Rakfilabha etc.
verses.hindi: राजा वसुमत का जन्म हुआ । राजा वसुमत के पुत्र परम धमिक राजा त्रिधन्वा उत्पन्न हुए, राजा त्रिधन्वा के पुत्र परम विद्वान् एवं प्रभावशाली राजा त्रय्यारुण ६ए ।७५-३७। उसके महा बलवान पुत्र सत्यक्नत हुए उन्होंने विदर्भ राजा की स्त्नी को, विवाह के मंत्रों के उच्चारण करते समय, जब सारी क्रियाएँ समाप्त हो ग्रयी थीं, समस्त देवताओं को पराजित कर, हरण किया था। उस परम बलवान राजा के पुत्र विष्ण॒षृद्ध हुए, जिनसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले बंश के लोग विष्णुवृद्ध नाम से विर्यात हुए । अंगिरा के ये पुत्रगण भी क्षत्रिय मिश्रित द्विजाति बर्ण के हैं ।७८-७६। परम बुद्धिमान सत्यत्नत ने अपनी इच्छा से, बल से, अथवा बलवान भावी (नियति) के बश होकर बलपू्वंक उक्त दुराचरण किया था, उसके इस अधर्माचरण से असन्तुष्ट होकर पिता त्रय्पारुण ने
verses.wordMeaning: Vide Sangita-ratndkara I, 6.64 which enumerates Rakfilabha etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vide Sangita-ratndkara I, 6.64 which enumerates Rakfilabha etc.

verses.sanskrit: अपरीक्षितभोजी स्याद्वानरो विजने वने । वितर्जको ऽथ मार्जारः खद्योतः कक्षदाहतः
verses.transliteration: aparīkṣitabhojī syādvānaro vijane vane / vitarjako 'tha mārjāraḥ khadyotaḥ kakṣadāhataḥ
verses.translation: Obscure*..,..
verses.hindi: तमधमेंण सयुक्त पिता त्रय्यारुणोउत्यजत् । अपध्वंसेति बहुशो5वदत्कोधसमस्वितः
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure*..,..
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure*..,..

verses.sanskrit: अविद्यां यः प्रयच्छेत बलीवर्दो भवेद्धि सः । अन्नं पर्युषितं विप्रे ददानः क्लीबतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: avidyāṃ yaḥ prayaccheta balīvardo bhaveddhi saḥ / annaṃ paryuṣitaṃ vipre dadānaḥ klībatāṃ vrajet
verses.translation: The songs which have been mentioned with particular emphasis on the form should be effected with seven notes and the Kaifiki [-Aa] of the sevenfold form.
verses.hindi: न चेन धारयामास वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः  स तु सत्यक्नतों धीमाञ्श्वपाकावसथान्तिकम् ॥ तस्मिस्तु विषये तस्य नावषंत्पाकशासन:। समा द्वादश संपूर्णास्तेनाधमेंण वे तदा .. ८५ दारांसतु तस्थ विषये विश्वामित्रों महातपा:। संन्यस्य सागरानपे चचार विपुलं तपः
verses.wordMeaning: The songs which have been mentioned with particular emphasis on the form should be effected with seven notes and the Kaifiki [-Aa] of the sevenfold form.
verses.commentary: Sense: The songs which have been mentioned with particular emphasis on the form should be effected with seven notes and the Kaifiki [-Aa] of the sevenfold form.

verses.sanskrit: मात्सर्यादथ जात्यन्धो जन्मान्धः पुस्तकं हरन् । फलान्याहरतो ऽपत्यं म्रियते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: mātsaryādatha jātyandho janmāndhaḥ pustakaṃ haran / phalānyāharato 'patyaṃ mriyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: With one foot (Pada) in the Matra and with one foot
verses.hindi: ते तु बढ्धं गले दृष्ट्वा विक्रीतं तं नरोत्तमः। महर्षिपुत्र धर्मात्मा मोक्षयामास सुब्रत: ८८ सत्यब्रतो महाबुद्धिभरणं तस्य चाकरोत् । विश्वामित्रस्य तुष्टयर्थमनुकम्पार्थमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: With one foot (Pada) in the Matra and with one foot
verses.commentary: Sense: With one foot (Pada) in the Matra and with one foot

verses.sanskrit: मृतो वानरतां याति तन्मुक्तो ऽथ गलाडवान् । अदत्त्वा भक्षयंस्तानि ह्यनपत्यो भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: mṛto vānaratāṃ yāti tanmukto 'tha galāḍavān / adattvā bhakṣayaṃstāni hyanapatyo bhavennaraḥ
verses.translation: The second break in the foot is well, established with Graha (the starting point of the song) and in the Aparantika (songs). The first, the eighth, the third and second are esta- blished with Graha (!)
verses.hindi: सोडभवद्गालवो नाम गले बद्धो महातपाः  महषि:ः कौशिकस्तातस्तेन वीयेंण मोक्षितः ६० उसका परित्याग कर दिया । और परम क्रद्ध होकर अनेक बार उससे कहा कि तुम हमारे घर से बाहर निकल जा ।! अपने पिता के एकमात्र पुत्र सत्यत्रत ने जब पिता से बारम्बार पूछा कि 'मैं कहाँ जाऊं ।! तब पिता ने कहा कि चाण्डालों के साथ जाकर निवास कर, है कुल में कलंक लगानेवाले ! तुम्हारे जैसे नालायक पुत्र से में पुत्रवान नहीं होना चाहता ।” है परम प्रतापशाली ! पिता के इस प्रकार निरादर पूर्ण वचन कहे
verses.wordMeaning: The second break in the foot is well, established with Graha (the starting point of the song) and in the Aparantika (songs). The first, the eighth, the third and second are esta- blished with Graha (!)
verses.commentary: Sense: The second break in the foot is well, established with Graha (the starting point of the song) and in the Aparantika (songs). The first, the eighth, the third and second are esta- blished with Graha (!)

verses.sanskrit: हरन्वस्त्रं भवेद्गोधा गरदः पवनाशनः । प्रव्राजी गमनाद् राजन् भवेन् मरुपिशाचकः
verses.transliteration: haranvastraṃ bhavedgodhā garadaḥ pavanāśanaḥ / pravrājī gamanād rājan bhaven marupiśācakaḥ
verses.translation: (Obscure) With half of the equivalent of a Pada and in the one-fifth portion of the Pada, the Pada-bhdga (one fourth of the Pada) also along with the one and a quarter (of a pada) (?) is established in the original form)
verses.hindi: जाने पर सत्यत्रत नगर से बाहर निकल गये  उस समय परम प्रभावशाली महृषि वसिष्ठ ने भी उन्हें घर रहने के लिये नहीं रोका । इधर, परम बुद्धिमान-एवं वीर सत्यव्रत पिता के परित्याग कर देने पर चाण्डालों की बस्ती के समीप जाकर बस गये और उधर उनके पिता बन को चले गये ॥5०-८४। इस अधमं से उस प्रास्त में इन्द्र ने बारह वर्षों तक वृष्टि नहीं की उसी प्रान्त में महातपस्वी विश्वामित्र अपने स्त्री पुत्रों को तिराधार छोड़कर
verses.wordMeaning: (Obscure) With half of the equivalent of a Pada and in the one-fifth portion of the Pada, the Pada-bhdga (one fourth of the Pada) also along with the one and a quarter (of a pada) (?) is established in the original form)
verses.commentary: Sense: (Obscure) With half of the equivalent of a Pada and in the one-fifth portion of the Pada, the Pada-bhdga (one fourth of the Pada) also along with the one and a quarter (of a pada) (?) is established in the original form)

verses.sanskrit: वातको जलहर्ता च धान्यहर्ता च मूषकः । अप्राप्तयौवनां गच्छन् भवेत् सर्प इति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: vātako jalahartā ca dhānyahartā ca mūṣakaḥ / aprāptayauvanāṃ gacchan bhavet sarpa iti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: In the Uttara and Mandraka songs in their original form, the Kala exists as explained of the Daksina Marga (way of the Tala—procedure).*
verses.hindi: सागर के तटवर्ती प्रान्त में घोर तप कर रहे थे, उनकी पत्नी ने अपने मँझले पुत्र को गले में बाँधकर शेष पुत्रों के भरण-पोषण के लिये सौ गौंओं के बदले बेंच दिया था  व्रतपरायण, धर्मात्मा नरपति सत्यव्रत ने महषि- पुत्र विश्वा मित्र के मझले पुत्र को इस प्रकार गले में बंधा और विक्रीत देखकर उस संकट से छुड़ाया तदुपरान्त उस महाबुद्धिमान राजा ने महषि विश्वामित्र को सन्‍्तुष्ट और प्रसन्न करने के लिये उनके पुत्र का  पालन-पोषण किया। गले में बंधने के कारण विद्वामित्र के उस महातपस्वी पुत्र का नाम गालव पड़ा। इस प्रकार महृषि विश्वामित का पुत्र उस बलवान् राजा के द्वारा बचाया गया । उसने अपनी ब्रत परायणता, भक्ति, कृपा सत्यप्रतिशा एवं विनय से महषि विश्वामित्र की रुन्नी का भी भरण-पोषण किया। विश्वामित्र के आश्रम
verses.wordMeaning: In the Uttara and Mandraka songs in their original form, the Kala exists as explained of the Daksina Marga (way of the Tala—procedure).*
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Uttara and Mandraka songs in their original form, the Kala exists as explained of the Daksina Marga (way of the Tala—procedure).*

verses.sanskrit: गुरुदाराभिलाषी च कृकलासो भवेच्चिरम् । जलप्रस्रवणं यस्तु भिन्द्यान्मत्स्यो भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: gurudārābhilāṣī ca kṛkalāso bhavecciram / jalaprasravaṇaṃ yastu bhindyānmatsyo bhavennaraḥ
verses.translation: When there is the use of one and the use of two, O best of Brahmanas, and when there is the combination of many Pataka 3 etc. are declared.
verses.hindi: हत्वा सगान्वराहांश्व महिषांश्व वनेचरान् । विश्वासित्राक्षमाभ्यासे तम्मांसमपचत्ततः
verses.wordMeaning: When there is the use of one and the use of two, O best of Brahmanas, and when there is the combination of many Pataka 3 etc. are declared.
verses.commentary: Sense: When there is the use of one and the use of two, O best of Brahmanas, and when there is the combination of many Pataka 3 etc. are declared.

verses.sanskrit: अविक्रेयान् विक्रयन् वै विकटाक्षो भवेन्नरः । अयोनिगो वृको हि स्याद् उलूकः क्रयवञ्चनात्
verses.transliteration: avikreyān vikrayan vai vikaṭākṣo bhavennaraḥ / ayonigo vṛko hi syād ulūkaḥ krayavañcanāt
verses.translation: Some lines are perhaps missing ( vide Bd. 3-62.40-41).
verses.hindi: उपांशुब्रतमास्थाय दीक्षां द्वादशवाधिकोम् । पितुनियोगादर्जन्नूपे तु बनमास्थिते . अयोध्याँ चेव राज्यं च तथवास्तःपुरं मुनि: । याज्योपाध्यायसंयोगाहशिष्ठः पर्यरक्षत १३६४ सत्यत्रतस्तु वाल्यात्तु भाविनोथंस्य वे बलातु । वशिष्ठेडम्यधिक मन्युं धारयामास सन्युना. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Some lines are perhaps missing ( vide Bd. 3-62.40-41).
verses.commentary: Sense: Some lines are perhaps missing ( vide Bd. 3-62.40-41).

verses.sanskrit: मृतस्यैकादशाहे तु भुञ्जानः श्वोपजायते । प्रतिश्रुत्य द्विजायार्थम् अददन् मधुको भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mṛtasyaikādaśāhe tu bhuñjānaḥ śvopajāyate / pratiśrutya dvijāyārtham adadan madhuko bhavet
verses.translation: (Tentative translation): The two feet and their Ahara(ia(?) beyond this are not laid down.
verses.hindi: पित्रा रुदंस्‍्तदा राष्ट्रात्परित्यक्तं स्वमात्मजम् । न वारयामास सुनिर्बसिष्ठः कारणेन वे ॥€ ६ पाणिग्रहणमन्त्राणां निष्ठा स्थात्सप्तमे पदे । एवं सत्यश्नतस्तान्वे हतवास्सप्तसे पदे
verses.wordMeaning: (Tentative translation): The two feet and their Ahara(ia(?) beyond this are not laid down.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Tentative translation): The two feet and their Ahara(ia(?) beyond this are not laid down.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञीगमाद्भवेद्दुष्टतस्करो विड्वराहकः । परिवादी द्विजातीनां लभते काच्छपीं तनुम्
verses.transliteration: rājñīgamādbhavedduṣṭataskaro viḍvarāhakaḥ / parivādī dvijātīnāṃ labhate kācchapīṃ tanum
verses.translation: Patdkd was one of eight mdtrds, which was indicated by moving the hand upwards. These mdtrds were to be employed in the mdrgas as specifically directed.
verses.hindi: जानन्धर्मान्वसिष्ठस्तु न च मन्त्रानिहेच्छुति । इति सत्यक्षते रोषं वसिष्ठो मनसाक रोत् गुरुबुद्धया तु भगवान्वसिष्ठः कृतवांस्तदा । न तु सत्यक्नतो्बुध्यदुपांशुन्रतमस्य 5 ६ €
verses.wordMeaning: Patdkd was one of eight mdtrds, which was indicated by moving the hand upwards. These mdtrds were to be employed in the mdrgas as specifically directed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Patdkd was one of eight mdtrds, which was indicated by moving the hand upwards. These mdtrds were to be employed in the mdrgas as specifically directed.

verses.sanskrit: व्रजेद्देवलको राजन्योनिं चाण्डालसंज्ञिताम् । दुर्भगः फलविक्रेता वृश्चिको वृषलीपतिः
verses.transliteration: vrajeddevalako rājanyoniṃ cāṇḍālasaṃjñitām / durbhagaḥ phalavikretā vṛściko vṛṣalīpatiḥ
verses.translation: The Vjrttis are the styles of rendering songs. They were three in number viz. Citrd, Vftti and Dakfipa. They were associated with the three
verses.hindi: ततो बसिष्ठो भगवान्पित्रा त्यक्त न्‍्यवारयत् । अभिषेक्ष्याम्यहूं राज्ये पश्चादेनसिति प्रभु:
verses.wordMeaning: The Vjrttis are the styles of rendering songs. They were three in number viz. Citrd, Vftti and Dakfipa. They were associated with the three
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vjrttis are the styles of rendering songs. They were three in number viz. Citrd, Vftti and Dakfipa. They were associated with the three

verses.sanskrit: मार्जारो ऽग्निं पदा स्पृष्ट्वा रोगवान्परमांसभुक् । सोदर्यागमनात्षण्ढो दुर्गन्धश्च सुगन्धहृत्
verses.transliteration: mārjāro 'gniṃ padā spṛṣṭvā rogavānparamāṃsabhuk / sodaryāgamanātṣaṇḍho durgandhaśca sugandhahṛt
verses.translation: When Raivata, otherwise known as Kakudmin, went to that world (of Brahma) the entire Kusasthall was over-run and destroyed by Punyajanas and Raksasas.
verses.hindi: के समीप म्गों, शूकरों, महिषों एवं अन्यान्य वन्य जन्तुओं को मारकर उनके मांस को वह पकाता था और मौनव्त धारण कर पिता कौ आज्ञा से बारह वर्ष तक वन में चाण्डालों के समीप तिवास करने की दीक्षा ग्रहण कर निवास करता रहा । इधर पिता पुत्र दोनों की अनृपस्थिति में महषि वसिष्ठ बुरोहितों एवं उपाध्यायों के सहयोग से राजधानी अयोध्या, राज्य, एवं अन्तःपुर की रक्षा करते रहे। कुमार सत्यत्रत अपने बाल्य स्वभाव के कारण तथा भावीवश मह॑षि वसिष्ठ के ऊपर बहुत अधिक क्रृद्ध थे। क्योंकि पिता द्वारा घर से
verses.wordMeaning: When Raivata, otherwise known as Kakudmin, went to that world (of Brahma) the entire Kusasthall was over-run and destroyed by Punyajanas and Raksasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Raivata, otherwise known as Kakudmin, went to that world (of Brahma) the entire Kusasthall was over-run and destroyed by Punyajanas and Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामभट्टो दिवाकीर्तिर् दैवज्ञो गर्दभो भवेत् । कुपण्डितः स्यान्मार्जारो भषणो व्यास एव च
verses.transliteration: grāmabhaṭṭo divākīrtir daivajño gardabho bhavet / kupaṇḍitaḥ syānmārjāro bhaṣaṇo vyāsa eva ca
verses.translation: The hundred brothers of that noble-soulcd virtuous king, on being harassed by the Raksasas, fled away in great terror.
verses.hindi: निकाले जाते समय जब वे रोते हुए राष्ट्र से बाहर निकल रहे थे तब मह॒धि वसिष्ठ ने किसी कारण से उन्हें निवारित नहीं किया ।8३-६६। पाणिग्रहण अर्थात् विवाह संस्कार के मंत्रों की समाप्ति सातवें चरण में होती है (सब्त पदी के होने के बाद विवाह संस्कार सम्पन्न होता है) किन्तु उसी सप्तपदी के समाप्त होने के अवसर पर उस विदर्भ राज की स्त्री को बलपूर्वक छीन लिया था। महर्षि वसिष्ठ धर्म की मर्यादा को जानने वाले थे
verses.wordMeaning: The hundred brothers of that noble-soulcd virtuous king, on being harassed by the Raksasas, fled away in great terror.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hundred brothers of that noble-soulcd virtuous king, on being harassed by the Raksasas, fled away in great terror.

verses.sanskrit: स एव दृश्यते राजन्प्रकाशात् परमर्मणाम् । यद्वा तद्वापि पारक्यं स्वल्पं वा यदि वा बहु
verses.transliteration: sa eva dṛśyate rājanprakāśāt paramarmaṇām / yadvā tadvāpi pārakyaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu
verses.translation: Fleeing in terror, those Ksatriyas established their families in different places. 2 3 O excellent Brahmanas, these families were very great.
verses.hindi: अतः उन्होंने सत्यक्नत के उक्त कार्य का अनुमोदन नहीं किया, और मंत्रों की मर्यादा भ्रष्ट होने के भय से कुमार सत्यवक्षत के ऊपर उन्होंने मन से क्रोध किया ।६७-६८। महथि वसिष्ठ ने गुरु की मर्यादा रक्षा के ध्यान से सत्यत्रत के ऊपर वह कोप किया था, उधर कुमार सत्यव्रत उनके इस मौनावलम्बन का जो नगर से निकालते समय उन्होंने अपनाया था, तात्पर्य नहीं जान सके  महा मनस्बी वसिष्ठ जी ने सोचा कि पिता की मृत्यु हो जाने के बाद इन्द्र ने बारह वर्षों तक अराजकता से अधरम बढ़ जाने के कारण वृष्टि नहीं की. इधर सत्यक्षत भी पिता की आज्ञा से बारह वर्ष तक बन में दीक्षा ग्रहण कर निवास कर रहा है पृथ्वी पर लोगों की जीविका कष्ट साध्य हो गई है, सत्यत्नत के आ जाने से उसके वंद्य का तिस्तार तो हो ही जायगा ।६६-१०१। ऐसा विचार कर
verses.wordMeaning: Fleeing in terror, those Ksatriyas established their families in different places. 2 3 O excellent Brahmanas, these families were very great.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fleeing in terror, those Ksatriyas established their families in different places. 2 3 O excellent Brahmanas, these families were very great.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा वै योनिमाप्नोति तैरश्चीं नात्र संशयः । एवमादीनि चान्यानि चिह्नानि नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā vai yonimāpnoti tairaścīṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / evamādīni cānyāni cihnāni nṛpasattama
verses.translation: As they were virtuous, they were famous in all the quarters as '■'Prayalas" 2 (the pure ones). The family of Dhpsta, the Ksatriyas named Dharstakas, became quite invinci¬ ble in war. Thus there were three thousand groups of noble-
verses.hindi: हथि वसिष्ठ ने उस समय पिता द्वारा निष्कासित किये गये सत्यत्रत्त को निवारित किप्रा, और कहा कि तुम्हें
verses.wordMeaning: As they were virtuous, they were famous in all the quarters as '■'Prayalas" 2 (the pure ones). The family of Dhpsta, the Ksatriyas named Dharstakas, became quite invinci¬ ble in war. Thus there were three thousand groups of noble-
verses.commentary: Sense: As they were virtuous, they were famous in all the quarters as '■'Prayalas" 2 (the pure ones). The family of Dhpsta, the Ksatriyas named Dharstakas, became quite invinci¬ ble in war. Thus there were three thousand groups of noble-

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्मविहितान्येव दृश्यन्ते यैस्तु मानवाः । ततो जन्म ततो मृत्युः सर्वजन्तुषु भारत
verses.transliteration: svakarmavihitānyeva dṛśyante yaistu mānavāḥ / tato janma tato mṛtyuḥ sarvajantuṣu bhārata
verses.translation: This chapter corresponds to Bd. -3-63. The references are to the verses in this chapter.
verses.hindi: स तु द्वादश वर्षाणि दीक्षां तामुद्रहन्बली । अविद्यमाने मांसे तु वसिष्ठस्थ महात्मनः ३१०३ सर्वक्ामदुधां धेनूं स ददर्श नृपात्मज: । तां वे क्रोधाच्च मोहाच्च श्रमाच्चव क्षुधान्चित:. दस्युधर्म गतो दृष्दृ्वा जघान बलिनां वरः। स तु मांस स्वयं चेब विश्वामित्रस्य चा5घत्समजान्
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter corresponds to Bd. -3-63. The references are to the verses in this chapter.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter corresponds to Bd. -3-63. The references are to the verses in this chapter.

verses.sanskrit: जायते नात्र सन्देहः समीभूते शुभाशुभे । स्त्रीपुंसोः सम्प्रयोगेण विषुद्धे शुक्रशोणिते
verses.transliteration: jāyate nātra sandehaḥ samībhūte śubhāśubhe / strīpuṃsoḥ samprayogeṇa viṣuddhe śukraśoṇite
verses.translation: Though the chapter is mainly concerned with the Iksvaku dynasty, w. 3-7 mention a dynasty of the pre-Yayati period, before circa 3000 B.C. (The Vedic Age, , BVB's The History and Culture of the Indian People Vol. 1.)
verses.hindi: भोजयामास तच्छ त्वा वसिष्ठरतं तदाउत्यजत् । प्रोवाच चेव भगवान्वसिष्ठस्तं नृपात्मजभ्
verses.wordMeaning: Though the chapter is mainly concerned with the Iksvaku dynasty, w. 3-7 mention a dynasty of the pre-Yayati period, before circa 3000 B.C. (The Vedic Age, , BVB's The History and Culture of the Indian People Vol. 1.)
verses.commentary: Sense: Though the chapter is mainly concerned with the Iksvaku dynasty, w. 3-7 mention a dynasty of the pre-Yayati period, before circa 3000 B.C. (The Vedic Age, , BVB's The History and Culture of the Indian People Vol. 1.)

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चभूतसमोपेतः सषष्ठः परमेश्वरः । इन्द्रियाणि मनः प्राणा ज्ञानमायुः सुखं धृतिः
verses.transliteration: pañcabhūtasamopetaḥ saṣaṣṭhaḥ parameśvaraḥ / indriyāṇi manaḥ prāṇā jñānamāyuḥ sukhaṃ dhṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Saryata in Bd. P. ibid v. 5
verses.hindi: पातये क्र है कर तब शडकुमयोमयम् । यदि ते त्रीणि शड्कूनि न स्युहि पुरुषाधम १०७ पितुश्चापरितोबेण गुरोदोग्श्रीवधेन च्  अप्रोक्षितोपयोगाच्च त्रिधिधस्ते व्यतिक्रमः उन्हामानों वरेणाथ गुर बच्चे नृपात्मजः । अनावृष्टिभये तस्मिन्गते हादशवाधिके ॥ै१११
verses.wordMeaning: Saryata in Bd. P. ibid v. 5
verses.commentary: Sense: Saryata in Bd. P. ibid v. 5

verses.sanskrit: धारणं प्रेरणं दुःखमिच्छाहङ्कार एव च । प्रयत्न आकृतिर्वर्णः स्वरद्वेषौ भवाभवौ
verses.transliteration: dhāraṇaṃ preraṇaṃ duḥkhamicchāhaṅkāra eva ca / prayatna ākṛtirvarṇaḥ svaradveṣau bhavābhavau
verses.translation: Arhbarisa was the son of Nabhaga. His son was Virupa. Virupa s son was Prsadasva and his son was Rathltara.
verses.hindi: अभिषिच्य तदा राज्ये याजयामास त॑ मुनिः। मिषता देवतानां व वशिष्ठस्थ घथ कोशिकः
verses.wordMeaning: Arhbarisa was the son of Nabhaga. His son was Virupa. Virupa s son was Prsadasva and his son was Rathltara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arhbarisa was the son of Nabhaga. His son was Virupa. Virupa s son was Prsadasva and his son was Rathltara.

verses.sanskrit: तस्येदमात्मनः सर्वमनादेरादिमिच्छतः । प्रथमे मासि स क्लेदभूतो धातुविमूर्छितः
verses.transliteration: tasyedamātmanaḥ sarvamanāderādimicchataḥ / prathame māsi sa kledabhūto dhātuvimūrchitaḥ
verses.translation: These (Rathitaras), though born as Ksatriyas, were known as Angiras-s. The prominent members (descendants) of Rathltara were Brahmanas with Ksatriya-like (heroic) prowess. 1
verses.hindi: राज्य पद पर अभिषिक्त कर रहा हूँ ।! उधर बलवान राजकुमार सत्यव्रत पिता की आज्ञा से बारह ब्षका श्षत लेकर जिस समय वन में निवास कर रहा था, उस समय एक दिन मांस का अभाव हों गया, तब उसने भहांत्मा वसिष्ठ की सभी मनोरथों को पूर्ण करनेवाली कामधेनु को देखा ।!०२-१०३२। क्रोध, मोह, श्रुधा एवं. अत्यन्त थके माँदे होने के कारण, उसने विचार किया कि मै इस चांण्डालों के समीप लिवास करता हूँ, उन्हीं के. समान आचरण भी मुझे करता चाहिए, क्यों त इसी को मारकर क्षुधा शान्‍्त करूँ।” यह सोचकर उसने द वसिष्ठ की उसे कामधेनु को मार डाला । महाबलवान् राजकुमार सत्यत्नत ने इस प्रकार उस" कामधेनु के मांस को स्वयं खाया और महर्षि के पुत्रादिकों को भी खिलाया। इस दारुण वृत्तान्त को सुनकर परमतेजस्वी महधि वसिष्ठ भे कुमार सत्यत्रत को छोड़ दिया और उसने कहा, है क्र कर्मा  अब हम तुम्हें गिरा रहे हैं
verses.wordMeaning: These (Rathitaras), though born as Ksatriyas, were known as Angiras-s. The prominent members (descendants) of Rathltara were Brahmanas with Ksatriya-like (heroic) prowess. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: These (Rathitaras), though born as Ksatriyas, were known as Angiras-s. The prominent members (descendants) of Rathltara were Brahmanas with Ksatriya-like (heroic) prowess. 1

verses.sanskrit: मास्यर्बुदं द्वितीये तु तृतीये चेन्द्रियैर्युतः । आकाशाल्लाघवं सौक्ष्म्यं शब्दं श्रोत्रबलादिकम् । वायोस्तु स्पर्शनं चेष्टां दहनं रौक्ष्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: māsyarbudaṃ dvitīye tu tṛtīye cendriyairyutaḥ / ākāśāllāghavaṃ saukṣmyaṃ śabdaṃ śrotrabalādikam / vāyostu sparśanaṃ ceṣṭāṃ dahanaṃ raukṣyameva ca
verses.translation: Formerly when Manu sneezed, Iksavaku was bom. 2 Iksvaku had hundred sons. All of them were liberal-minded (distributing enormous wealth as Daksina).
verses.hindi: हे पुरुषाधम ! यदि तुम्हारे ये तीर्न शंकु (महापाप रूप कील) न होते तो तुम्हारे ऊपर लोंह का शेंकु गिरता
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly when Manu sneezed, Iksavaku was bom. 2 Iksvaku had hundred sons. All of them were liberal-minded (distributing enormous wealth as Daksina).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly when Manu sneezed, Iksavaku was bom. 2 Iksvaku had hundred sons. All of them were liberal-minded (distributing enormous wealth as Daksina).

verses.sanskrit: पित्तात्तु दर्शनं पक्तिमौष्ण्यं रूपं प्रकाशनम् । सलिलाद्रसनां शैत्यं स्नेहं क्लेदं समार्दवम्
verses.transliteration: pittāttu darśanaṃ paktimauṣṇyaṃ rūpaṃ prakāśanam / salilādrasanāṃ śaityaṃ snehaṃ kledaṃ samārdavam
verses.translation: The eldest son was Vikuksi. His younger brothers, Nemi and Danda (two were famous). He had five hundred sons, the chief of them being Sakuni.
verses.hindi: विता के असन्तुष्ट करने के कारण, गुरु की कामधेनु की हत्या करने के कारण, विना संस्कार आदि किये माँस भक्षण करने के कारण तुमने तीन धारमिक अपराध किये हैं ९ ०४-१०५। महातपस्वी महर्षि वसिष्ठ ने सत्यव्त के हन तीन हांकु संदश महान् अपराधों का विचार कर उसका त्रिशंकु नाम रख दिया, इसी कारण उसका त्रिशंकु नाम भी पड़ गया इधर राजधि विश्वामिन्र जब तपस्या से निवत्त होकर आश्रम को लौटे और स्त्री पुत्रादिकों के सत्यत्रत द्वारा भरण पोषण किये जाने वा वृत्तान्त सुना तो परम प्रसन्न होकर' त्रिशंकु को वरदान दिया । विश्वामित्र के वर दान देते समय राजकुमार सत्यव्रत ने सारा शाप वृत्तान्त निवेदन किया । कौशिक ने उस बारह वर्ष के अनावष्टि जनित दुष्काल के बीत जाने पर सत्यव्रत को राज्यपद पर अभिषिक्त किया, और उसके द्वारा यशादि शुभ का सम्पन्न कराया, सभी देवगण तथा महर्षि वसिष्ठ देखते ही रह
verses.wordMeaning: The eldest son was Vikuksi. His younger brothers, Nemi and Danda (two were famous). He had five hundred sons, the chief of them being Sakuni.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eldest son was Vikuksi. His younger brothers, Nemi and Danda (two were famous). He had five hundred sons, the chief of them being Sakuni.

verses.sanskrit: भूमेर्गन्धं तथा घ्राणं गौरवं मूर्तिमेव च । आत्मा गृह्णात्यजः पूर्वं तृतीये स्पन्दते च सः
verses.transliteration: bhūmergandhaṃ tathā ghrāṇaṃ gauravaṃ mūrtimeva ca / ātmā gṛhṇātyajaḥ pūrvaṃ tṛtīye spandate ca saḥ
verses.translation: They were the kings and protectors of the land of Uttarapatha (northern region). Forty-eight of them ruled in the southern region.
verses.hindi: उहै० वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: They were the kings and protectors of the land of Uttarapatha (northern region). Forty-eight of them ruled in the southern region.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the kings and protectors of the land of Uttarapatha (northern region). Forty-eight of them ruled in the southern region.

verses.sanskrit: दौर्हृदस्याप्रदानेन गर्भो दोषमवाप्नुयात् । वैरूप्यं मरणं वापि तस्मात्कार्यं प्रियं स्त्रियाः
verses.transliteration: daurhṛdasyāpradānena garbho doṣamavāpnuyāt / vairūpyaṃ maraṇaṃ vāpi tasmātkāryaṃ priyaṃ striyāḥ
verses.translation: Twenty of them were very important. They protected the whole of the southern region.
verses.hindi: + विन्ध्यपाश्वें महापुण्या निम्नगा गिरिकानने  तस्य स्नासमेन संभुता कर्मनाशा शुभा नदी ॥ मिषतस्तु वसिष्ठस्य तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् । अन्राप्युदाहरन्तीमो श्लोको पौराणिका जनाः
verses.wordMeaning: Twenty of them were very important. They protected the whole of the southern region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Twenty of them were very important. They protected the whole of the southern region.

verses.sanskrit: स्थैर्यं चतुर्थे त्वङ्गानां पञ्चमे शोणितोद्भवः । षष्ठे बलं च वर्णश्च नखरोम्णां च सम्भवः
verses.transliteration: sthairyaṃ caturthe tvaṅgānāṃ pañcame śoṇitodbhavaḥ / ṣaṣṭhe balaṃ ca varṇaśca nakharomṇāṃ ca sambhavaḥ
verses.translation: The king said: O powerful one, kill deer and bring the meat worthy of the Sraddha. Undoubtedly the A?fakd Sraddha has to be performed today.
verses.hindi: विश्वामित्रप्रसादेन त्रिशडकुदिवि राजते। देवेः साथ महातेजा«्नुग्रहात्तस्य धमितः
verses.wordMeaning: The king said: O powerful one, kill deer and bring the meat worthy of the Sraddha. Undoubtedly the A?fakd Sraddha has to be performed today.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king said: O powerful one, kill deer and bring the meat worthy of the Sraddha. Undoubtedly the A?fakd Sraddha has to be performed today.

verses.sanskrit: मनसा चेतनायुक्तो नखरोमशतावृतः । सप्तमे चाष्टमे चैव त्वचावान् स्मृतिवान् अपि
verses.transliteration: manasā cetanāyukto nakharomaśatāvṛtaḥ / saptame cāṣṭame caiva tvacāvān smṛtivān api
verses.translation: Vikuksi who went a-hunting at the instance of the intelligent (king) killed thousands of deer. Though very powerful, he became very tired. He then (killed and) ate a hare.
verses.hindi: तस्य सत्यरता नाम भार्या केकयबवंशजा । कुमारं जनयामास हरिश्रन्क्रमकल्मषम् स॒तु राजा हरिश्रद्धस्त्रशड्ूव इति श्रुतः । आहर्ता राजसुयस्य सम्राडिति परिश्रुतः
verses.wordMeaning: Vikuksi who went a-hunting at the instance of the intelligent (king) killed thousands of deer. Though very powerful, he became very tired. He then (killed and) ate a hare.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vikuksi who went a-hunting at the instance of the intelligent (king) killed thousands of deer. Though very powerful, he became very tired. He then (killed and) ate a hare.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्गर्भं पुनर् धात्रीम् एनस्तस्य प्रधावति । अष्टमे मास्यतो गर्भो जातः प्राणैर्वियुज्यते
verses.transliteration: punargarbhaṃ punar dhātrīm enastasya pradhāvati / aṣṭame māsyato garbho jātaḥ prāṇairviyujyate
verses.translation: When Vikuksi returned with the meat along with the army, the king urged Vasi$tha, "May the meat be sprinkled with the holy water".
verses.hindi: विजयश्र सुदेवश्य चच्च॒पुत्रो बभूवतु:। जैता सर्वस्य क्षत्रस्थ विजयस्तेन प्र स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: When Vikuksi returned with the meat along with the army, the king urged Vasi$tha, "May the meat be sprinkled with the holy water".
verses.commentary: Sense: When Vikuksi returned with the meat along with the army, the king urged Vasi$tha, "May the meat be sprinkled with the holy water".

verses.sanskrit: नवमे दशमे वापि प्रबलैः सूतिमारुतैः । निर्गच्छते बाण इव यन्त्रच्छिद्रेण सज्वरः
verses.transliteration: navame daśame vāpi prabalaiḥ sūtimārutaiḥ / nirgacchate bāṇa iva yantracchidreṇa sajvaraḥ
verses.translation: This indicates the fluidity of the caste-system in ancient India.
verses.hindi: रुचकस्तनयस्तत्र राजा धर्मर्थिकोविदः । रुरुकाद्भधतकः पुत्रस्तस्मादृबाहुश्र जजिवान् गये ।१०९-११२। यज्ञावसान में उस त्रिशंकु के स्नान करने से. कमंताशा नामक नदी अवतीर्ण हुई जो विल््याचल पंत के सभीष जंगलों और पहाड़ियों में से बहती है। वह कर्मनाशा नदी महापुण्य- दायिनों तथा मंगलकारी है। इस प्रकार महान ऐश्वयेशाली विश्वामित्र ने सत्यव्रत को स्वयं में प्रतिष्ठित किया । महषि वसिष्ठ उनके इस अद्भुत कार्य को देखकर रह गये । पौराशिक लोग इस विषय में इन दो इलोकों
verses.wordMeaning: This indicates the fluidity of the caste-system in ancient India.
verses.commentary: Sense: This indicates the fluidity of the caste-system in ancient India.

verses.sanskrit: शरीरावयवैर्युक्तो ह्यङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसंयुतः । अष्टोत्तरं मर्मशतं तत्रास्था तु शतत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: śarīrāvayavairyukto hyaṅgapratyaṅgasaṃyutaḥ / aṣṭottaraṃ marmaśataṃ tatrāsthā tu śatatrayam
verses.translation: From v. 8, the Purana describes the Iksvaku dynasty. His three sons—Vikuksi, Nemi and Dan<Ja—founded separate dynasties at Ayodhya (U.P.), Videha (Bihar) and Dantfaka (North Deccan) respectively. Nemi is mentioned as 'Nimi* in Buddhist Jatakas.
verses.hindi: को उपस्थित करते हैं। जिनका आशय इस प्रकार है।?१३-११४। 'महामुनि विश्वामित्र की पा से, जिशंकु स्वयं में विराजमान है, उस परम बुद्धिमान की कृपा से वह तेजस्वी होक्र देवताओं के साथ शोभा पता है, त्रिद्वंकु रूप ग्रह के आकर्षण से विभूषित होकर, तीन प्रकार के भावों से अलंकृत हेमन्त में चन्द्रमा के समान सुस्दरो एक मनोहर रमणी उसके पास धीरेधीरे जाती है।” उस राजा त्रिश्वुकु की पत्नी केकयवंश में उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: From v. 8, the Purana describes the Iksvaku dynasty. His three sons—Vikuksi, Nemi and Dan<Ja—founded separate dynasties at Ayodhya (U.P.), Videha (Bihar) and Dantfaka (North Deccan) respectively. Nemi is mentioned as 'Nimi* in Buddhist Jatakas.
verses.commentary: Sense: From v. 8, the Purana describes the Iksvaku dynasty. His three sons—Vikuksi, Nemi and Dan<Ja—founded separate dynasties at Ayodhya (U.P.), Videha (Bihar) and Dantfaka (North Deccan) respectively. Nemi is mentioned as 'Nimi* in Buddhist Jatakas.

verses.sanskrit: सप्त शिरःकपालानि विहितानि स्वयम्भुवा । तिस्रः कोट्यो ऽर्धकोटी च रोम्णामङ्गेषु भारत
verses.transliteration: sapta śiraḥkapālāni vihitāni svayambhuvā / tisraḥ koṭyo 'rdhakoṭī ca romṇāmaṅgeṣu bhārata
verses.translation: The Sraddha performed on the 7th, 8th and 9th days after the Full Moon in the three months of Pausa, Magha and Ph&lguna.
verses.hindi: सत्यत्रता वाम की थी ।११५-११६२। उसने हरिश्चन्द्र नामक परम धामिक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया, वह राजा हरिश्चन्द्र त्रिशंकु के पुत्र रूप में परम विख्यात था  उसने अपने समय में राजसूय यज्ञ सम्पन्न किया था, समस्त पृथ्वी मण्डल का वह एकच्छुत्र सम्राट था, ऐसा सुना जाता है। हरिश्चन्द्र का पुत्र परम बलवान रोहित का पुत्र हरित हुआ, हरित का पुत्र चंचू नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुआ ।११७-११६। उस चंचु के विजय और सुदेव नामक दो पुत्र हुए । विजय सभी क्षत्रियों का विजेता था, इसी कारण से उसका नाम भी विजय था । बिजय का पुत्र रुक हुआ, जो अपने समय का परम धर्मथिवेत्ता राजा था रुछुक का पुत्र हृतक हुआ, और उसका बाहु उत्पन्न हुआ। हैहय ओर तालजंध के वंशों में उत्पन्न होने वालों ने परम व्यसनी राजा वाहु को परास्त कर दिया ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Sraddha performed on the 7th, 8th and 9th days after the Full Moon in the three months of Pausa, Magha and Ph&lguna.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sraddha performed on the 7th, 8th and 9th days after the Full Moon in the three months of Pausa, Magha and Ph&lguna.

verses.sanskrit: द्वासप्ततिसहस्राणि हृदयाद् अभिनिसृताः । हितानाम हि ता नाड्यस् तासां मध्ये शशिप्रभा
verses.transliteration: dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi hṛdayād abhinisṛtāḥ / hitānāma hi tā nāḍyas tāsāṃ madhye śaśiprabhā
verses.translation: The infuriated Iksvaku then spoke thus to Vikuksi: "Commanded by me for the purpose of the rites of Pitrs, you went for hunting the deer. In the forest you mercdessly ate the flesh of a hare before the Sraddha. Hence I banish you. Go away along with your fate (as a result of your own action)." Thus at the instance of Vasistha the son was abandoned by Iksvaku.
verses.hindi: + नास्त्ययं श्लोक: क. ग॒. घ. ड. पुस्तकेषु ।
verses.wordMeaning: The infuriated Iksvaku then spoke thus to Vikuksi: "Commanded by me for the purpose of the rites of Pitrs, you went for hunting the deer. In the forest you mercdessly ate the flesh of a hare before the Sraddha. Hence I banish you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The infuriated Iksvaku then spoke thus to Vikuksi: "Commanded by me for the purpose of the rites of Pitrs, you went for hunting the deer. In the forest you mercdessly ate the flesh of a hare before the Sraddha. Hence I banish you.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवर्तते चक्रं भूतग्रामे चतुर्विधे । उत्पत्तिश्च विनाशश्च भवतः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravartate cakraṃ bhūtagrāme caturvidhe / utpattiśca vināśaśca bhavataḥ sarvadehinām
verses.translation: When Iksvaku passed away, the hare-eater attained this earth. He was a very virtuous-souled king of Ayodhya. Urged and guided by Vasistha, he ruled over the kingdom. Thereafter, being full of that sin, the king, ruling over the king¬ dom declined in power as time elapsed. 1 After understanding (the import of) this story, no one shall eat (meat) outside the injunction. Learned men explain the etymology of Mdriisa (Meat) thus—'In the other world that will eat me, Marti Sa (Bhaksayita) the flesh of which I eat here now'. 2
verses.hindi: हैहयेस्तालजड्घश्च निरस्तो व्यसनी नृप:  शकयेवनकाम्बोज: पारदेः पल्हवेस्तथा नात्यर्थ धामिको5भुत्स ध्य सत्ययुगे तथा। सगरस्तु सुतो बाहोज॑ज्ञे सह गरेण बे ॥
verses.wordMeaning: When Iksvaku passed away, the hare-eater attained this earth. He was a very virtuous-souled king of Ayodhya. Urged and guided by Vasistha, he ruled over the kingdom. Thereafter, being full of that sin, the king, ruling over the king¬ dom declined in power as time elapsed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When Iksvaku passed away, the hare-eater attained this earth. He was a very virtuous-souled king of Ayodhya. Urged and guided by Vasistha, he ruled over the kingdom. Thereafter, being full of that sin, the king, ruling over the king¬ dom declined in power as time elapsed.…

verses.sanskrit: गतिरूर्ध्वा च धर्मेण ह्यधर्मेण त्वधोगतिः । जायते सर्ववर्णानां स्वधर्मचलनान् नृप
verses.transliteration: gatirūrdhvā ca dharmeṇa hyadharmeṇa tvadhogatiḥ / jāyate sarvavarṇānāṃ svadharmacalanān nṛpa
verses.translation: Sasada's successor was Kakutstha, the powerful. Formerly he had sat on the hump of Indra who had assumed the form of a bull, in the course of the war named Adibaka. 3
verses.hindi: आस्नेग्रमस्इ लब्ध्वा तु भागवात्सगरो नृप:। जघान प्रृथिवीं गत्वा तालजडइघान्सहैहयानू..
verses.wordMeaning: Sasada's successor was Kakutstha, the powerful. Formerly he had sat on the hump of Indra who had assumed the form of a bull, in the course of the war named Adibaka. 3
verses.commentary: Sense: Sasada's successor was Kakutstha, the powerful. Formerly he had sat on the hump of Indra who had assumed the form of a bull, in the course of the war named Adibaka. 3

verses.sanskrit: देवत्वे मानवत्वे च दानभोगादिकाः क्रियाः । दृश्यन्ते या महाराज तत्सर्वं कर्मजं फलम्
verses.transliteration: devatve mānavatve ca dānabhogādikāḥ kriyāḥ / dṛśyante yā mahārāja tatsarvaṃ karmajaṃ phalam
verses.translation: or went to an inferior world (hell) after death.
verses.hindi: शकतां पहुचानां च धर्मान्नचिरसदच्युतः । क्षत्रियाणां तथा तेषां पारदानां च धर्मंचित् कर्थ प्त सगरी राजा गरेण सह जज्ञिवान् । किमर्थं च शकादोनां क्षत्रियाणां महौजसाम् ।।
verses.wordMeaning: or went to an inferior world (hell) after death.
verses.commentary: Sense: or went to an inferior world (hell) after death.

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्म विहिते घोरे कामक्सोधार्जिते शुभे । निमज्जेन्नरके घोरे यस्योत्तारो न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: svakarma vihite ghore kāmaksodhārjite śubhe / nimajjennarake ghore yasyottāro na vidyate
verses.translation: Quoted from Manu V. 55.
verses.hindi: धंमम्कुम्नोचितान्कुदो राजा निरसदच्युतः
verses.wordMeaning: Quoted from Manu V. 55.
verses.commentary: Sense: Quoted from Manu V. 55.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तारणाय जन्तूनां नर्मदातटसंस्थितम् । एवमेतन्महातीर्थं नरकेश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: uttāraṇāya jantūnāṃ narmadātaṭasaṃsthitam / evametanmahātīrthaṃ narakeśvaramuttamam
verses.translation: Kalidasa, however, explains the epithet Kakutstha as 'one who
verses.hindi: बाहोव्येंसनिनस्तस्य हृतं राज्य पुरा किल  हैहयेस्तालजड्घेश्व शकः साथ समागतेः १२७ यथना:ः पारदाश्वव कास्बोजाः १ल्‍हवास्तथा । हैहयार्थ पराक्रानता एते पञच गणास्तदा १२८
verses.wordMeaning: Kalidasa, however, explains the epithet Kakutstha as 'one who
verses.commentary: Sense: Kalidasa, however, explains the epithet Kakutstha as 'one who

verses.sanskrit: नरकापहं महापुण्यं महापातकनाशनम् । तत्तीर्थं सर्वतीर्थानामुत्तमं भुवि दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: narakāpahaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam / tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrthānāmuttamaṃ bhuvi durlabham
verses.translation: Vfsadasva was Prthu's son. From him was born the powerful Andhra. YavanaSva was Andhra's son. Sravasta was his son.
