verses.hindi: उनके साथ शक, यवन काम्बोज पारद और पल्हवों के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले भी थे। सत्ययुग का समय होने पर भी वह राजा वाहु परम धार्मिक नहीं था, उस राजा वाहु का पुत्र विष के साथ गर्भ.से उत्पन्न हुआ, उसका नाम सगर पड़ा  पिता के छात्रओं द्वारा की गई दुरवस्था में भूगु के आश्रम में उसकी रक्षा तुबं ने की थी ।१२०-१२३। भागंव से आरनेय अस्त्र प्राप्त कर राजा सगर ने समस्त पृथ्वी पर घृम घूम कर हैहय
verses.wordMeaning: Vfsadasva was Prthu's son. From him was born the powerful Andhra. YavanaSva was Andhra's son. Sravasta was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vfsadasva was Prthu's son. From him was born the powerful Andhra. YavanaSva was Andhra's son. Sravasta was his son.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत महेश्वरम् । महापातकयुक्तो ऽपि नरकं नैव पश्यति
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayeta maheśvaram / mahāpātakayukto 'pi narakaṃ naiva paśyati
verses.translation: Sravasta was the king by whom SravastI * 1 was built. Sravasta's successor was BfhadaSva of great fame.
verses.hindi: और तालजंष के वंद्व में उत्पन्न होने वालों में सब का संहार कर डाला। उस महाबलवान् राजा सगर ने शककों, पल्हवों, पारदों एवं अन्य क्षत्रियों को भी अपने पृव॑ंजों के अधिकार एवं धर्म से बंचित कर ऋषियों ने कहा--सुत जी ! वे राजा सगर किस प्रकार विष के साथ उत्पन्न हुए, और किस लिये उस अच्युत ने महान तेजस्वी छाकों, एवं क्षत्रियों के कुलोचित धर्मों को क्रद्ध होकर निरत कर
verses.wordMeaning: Sravasta was the king by whom SravastI * 1 was built. Sravasta's successor was BfhadaSva of great fame.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sravasta was the king by whom SravastI * 1 was built. Sravasta's successor was BfhadaSva of great fame.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो दद्याद् धेनुं वैतरणीं शुभाम् । स मुच्यते सुखेनैव वैतरण्यां न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo dadyād dhenuṃ vaitaraṇīṃ śubhām / sa mucyate sukhenaiva vaitaraṇyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: It is heard that Kuvalasva was the son of BrhadaSva. By killing Dhundhu that king became known as Dhundhu- mara.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले-- ऋषिगण ! ऐसी प्रसिद्धि है कि पू्काल में राजा बाहु के व्यसनी होने के कारण उनका राज्य हैहय, तालजंघ एवं हकों के साथ यवन, पारद, कम्बोज और पल्हवों ने आक्रमण करके सारा राज्य छीन लिया । उस समय इन पाँचों गणों ने हैहुय के लिये यह आक्रमण किया। इन क्षत्रिय पुड़ब बलवान् शत्रुओं द्वारा राज्य छीन लिए जाने पर धर्मात्मा राजा बाहु घर द्वार छोड़ कर पत्नी के साथ
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard that Kuvalasva was the son of BrhadaSva. By killing Dhundhu that king became known as Dhundhu- mara.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard that Kuvalasva was the son of BrhadaSva. By killing Dhundhu that king became known as Dhundhu- mara.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: यमद्वारे महाघोरे या सा वैतरणी नदी । किंरूपा किंप्रमाणा सा कथं सा वहति द्विज
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: yamadvāre mahāghore yā sā vaitaraṇī nadī / kiṃrūpā kiṃpramāṇā sā kathaṃ sā vahati dvija
verses.translation: O highly intelligent one, we wish to hear how Dhundhu was slain, whereby Kuvalasva attained the title of Dhundhumara.
verses.hindi: : ७४२ वायुपुराणभ बने प्रविश्य धर्मात्मा सह पत्न्या तपो5चरत् क्र कस्यचित्त्वव कालस्य तोयार्थ प्रस्थितो नृपः । बृद्धात्वादृदुबंलत्वाच्च अन्तरा स समार च
verses.wordMeaning: O highly intelligent one, we wish to hear how Dhundhu was slain, whereby Kuvalasva attained the title of Dhundhumara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly intelligent one, we wish to hear how Dhundhu was slain, whereby Kuvalasva attained the title of Dhundhumara.

verses.sanskrit: कथं तस्याः प्रमुच्यन्ते केषां वासस्तु संततम् । केषां तु सानुकूला सा ह्येतद्विस्तरतो वद
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ tasyāḥ pramucyante keṣāṃ vāsastu saṃtatam / keṣāṃ tu sānukūlā sā hyetadvistarato vada
verses.translation: Bfhadasva had twentyone thousand sons. All of them were experts in Vidyas. They were powerful and invin¬ cible. All of them were righteous. All of them were performers of Yajnas with profuse Dak§ina. Bfhadasva, the king, crowned. Kuvalasva who was very powerful, heroic, excellent and virtuous, in that kingdom. After transferring the royal position and glory to his son, the king went to the forest.
verses.hindi: सा तु भरतुभ्रितां कृत्वा बल्चि तं समरोहयत् । औव॑स्तां भागंवो दृष्ट्वा कारण्याहिन्यवरतंयत्.
verses.wordMeaning: Bfhadasva had twentyone thousand sons. All of them were experts in Vidyas. They were powerful and invin¬ cible. All of them were righteous. All of them were performers of Yajnas with profuse Dak§ina. Bfhadasva, the king, crowned. Kuvalasva who was very powerful, heroic,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bfhadasva had twentyone thousand sons. All of them were experts in Vidyas. They were powerful and invin¬ cible. All of them were righteous. All of them were performers of Yajnas with profuse Dak§ina. Bfhadasva, the king, crowned. Kuvalasva who was very powerful, heroic,…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: धर्मपुत्र महाबाहो शृणु सर्वं मयोदितम् । या सा वैतरणी नाम यमद्वारे महासरित्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dharmaputra mahābāho śṛṇu sarvaṃ mayoditam / yā sā vaitaraṇī nāma yamadvāre mahāsarit
verses.translation: Uttahka, the Brahmana sage, prevented the great heroic king Bfhadasva who was excellent and virtuous and who was proceeding to the forest (for penance).
verses.hindi: ओवंस्तु जातकर्मादीन्कृत्वा तस्थ महात्मनः । अध्याप्य बेदशालाणि ततोषइस्त्रं प्रत्यपादयत् जघान हैहयान्कुद्धों रद्रः पशुगणानिव
verses.wordMeaning: Uttahka, the Brahmana sage, prevented the great heroic king Bfhadasva who was excellent and virtuous and who was proceeding to the forest (for penance).
verses.commentary: Sense: Uttahka, the Brahmana sage, prevented the great heroic king Bfhadasva who was excellent and virtuous and who was proceeding to the forest (for penance).

verses.sanskrit: अगाधा पाररहिता दृष्टमात्रा भयावहा । पूयशोणिततोया सा मांसकर्दमनिर्मिता
verses.transliteration: agādhā pārarahitā dṛṣṭamātrā bhayāvahā / pūyaśoṇitatoyā sā māṃsakardamanirmitā
verses.translation: "O King, protection must be offered by you. It be¬ hoves you to do it. I am unable to perform penance un¬ disturbed.
verses.hindi: ततः शकान्सयवनान्कास्बोजान्पारदांस्तथा । पहुवांश्येव निःशेषान्दर्तु व्यवसितों नृप:ः .
verses.wordMeaning: "O King, protection must be offered by you. It be¬ hoves you to do it. I am unable to perform penance un¬ disturbed.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O King, protection must be offered by you. It be¬ hoves you to do it. I am unable to perform penance un¬ disturbed.

verses.sanskrit: तत्तोयं भ्रमते तूर्णं तापीमध्ये घृतं यथा । कृमिभिः सङ्कुलं पूयं वज्रतुण्डैरयोमुखैः
verses.transliteration: tattoyaṃ bhramate tūrṇaṃ tāpīmadhye ghṛtaṃ yathā / kṛmibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ pūyaṃ vajratuṇḍairayomukhaiḥ
verses.translation: Modern Sahet-Mahet on the Rapti (ancient Airavatl or Aciravau)
verses.hindi: . बन को चले गये ओर वहाँ तपस्या करना प्रारंभ किया १7२७-१२९। कुछ समय बाद एक दिन राजा जल लेने के लिये गये, ओर अत्यन्त वुद्ध तथा दुबंस होने के कारण बीच मार्ग में ही उनकी मृत्यु हो गयी । उनकी यादवी नामक पत्नी, जो उस समय गरभवती थी, अनुगमन के लिये प्रस्तुत हुई, उसके .यरभं को मारने की नीयत से सपत्नी ने उसे विष दे दिया था  यादवी को पति की चिता. बनाकर उसने -बैठा दिया . और आग भी लगा दी, उसी बीच भागंव भओव॑ मुनि वहाँ आये और करुणावदश उसे जलने से निवारित किया 7३०-१३२। उन्हों ओऔब ऋषि के आश्रम में यादवी ने सपत्नी के दिये गए. विष के साथ महाबाहू समर नामक परम धार्मिक पुत्र उत्पन्न किया  मुनिवर ओब ने उस महा तेजस्वी सगर का जातकर्मादि संस्कार सम्पन्न किया और वेद शास्त्रों का सम्पूर्ण अध्ययन कराकर अस्त्र विद्या भी दी। उसी समय जमदस्ति के पृत्र औव॑
verses.wordMeaning: Modern Sahet-Mahet on the Rapti (ancient Airavatl or Aciravau)
verses.commentary: Sense: Modern Sahet-Mahet on the Rapti (ancient Airavatl or Aciravau)

verses.sanskrit: शिशुमारैश्च मकरैर् वज्रकर्तरिसंयुतैः । अन्यैश्च जलजीवैः सा सुहिंस्रैर्मर्मभेदिभिः
verses.transliteration: śiśumāraiśca makarair vajrakartarisaṃyutaiḥ / anyaiśca jalajīvaiḥ sā suhiṃsrairmarmabhedibhiḥ
verses.translation: In the wild desert region near my hermitage, there is
verses.hindi: मुनि से सगर ने उस आगश्नेयास्त्र को प्राप्त किया, जिसे बड़े बड़े राक्षस भी सहन करने में असमर्थ थे । उसी अस्त्र बल से तथा अपने शारीरिक बल से उस परम प्रतापी राजा सगर ने अत्यन्त ऋद्ध होकर हैहयों का वध इस प्रकार कर डाला, जंसे रूद्र सृष्टि के अवसान में जीव समूहों का संहार करते हैं ।?३३-१३५। हैहयों को मारने के उपरान्त राजा सगर ने शक, यवन, कम्बोज पारद, एवं पह्कुवों को भी निर्जीव कर देने का इरादा किया ।
verses.wordMeaning: In the wild desert region near my hermitage, there is
verses.commentary: Sense: In the wild desert region near my hermitage, there is

verses.sanskrit: तपन्ति द्वादशादित्याः प्रलयान्त इवोल्बणाः । पतन्ति तत्र वै मर्त्याः क्रन्दन्तो भृशदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: tapanti dvādaśādityāḥ pralayānta ivolbaṇāḥ / patanti tatra vai martyāḥ krandanto bhṛśadāruṇam
verses.translation: He breathes out (once) at the end of a year. But when he exhales the whole earth along with forests quakes and
verses.hindi: महाबलवान् एवं पराक्रमी सगर ने अत्यन्त पीड़ित एवं भयभीत होकर वे सब शरण खोजते हुए जब मह॒षि वसिष्ठ के पास पहुँचे तब महामुनि ने वचन देकर उनको अभय दान दिया और राजा सगर को इस सहार कार्य से निवारित किया। राजा सगर ने इधर अपनी प्रतिज्ञा पूर्ण करते का, उधर गुर के आदेश का विचार सगर: स्वां प्रतिज्ञां च गुरोर्वाक्यं निशस्य च। धर्म जघान तेषां वे वेषान्यत्वं चकार हू.
verses.wordMeaning: He breathes out (once) at the end of a year. But when he exhales the whole earth along with forests quakes and
verses.commentary: Sense: He breathes out (once) at the end of a year. But when he exhales the whole earth along with forests quakes and

verses.sanskrit: हा भ्रातः पुत्र हा मातः प्रलपन्ति मुहुर्मुहुः । असिपत्त्रवने घोरे पतन्तं यो ऽभिरक्षति
verses.transliteration: hā bhrātaḥ putra hā mātaḥ pralapanti muhurmuhuḥ / asipattravane ghore patantaṃ yo 'bhirakṣati
verses.translation: A great column of dust is raised by the air exhaled by him. It covers up the path of the sun and the earth — quake continues for a week.
verses.hindi: अर्ध शकानां शिरसो मुण्डयित्वा व्यसर्जयत् । यवनानां शिरः सर्व काम्वोजानां तथेव च
verses.wordMeaning: A great column of dust is raised by the air exhaled by him. It covers up the path of the sun and the earth — quake continues for a week.
verses.commentary: Sense: A great column of dust is raised by the air exhaled by him. It covers up the path of the sun and the earth — quake continues for a week.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतरन्ति निमज्जन्ति ग्लानिं गच्छन्ति जन्तवः । चतुर्विधैः प्राणिगणैर्द्रष्टव्या सा महानदी
verses.transliteration: prataranti nimajjanti glāniṃ gacchanti jantavaḥ / caturvidhaiḥ prāṇigaṇairdraṣṭavyā sā mahānadī
verses.translation: It is accompanied by very terrible flames of fire, sparks and smoke. O King, I am not therefore able to stay in my own hermitage.
verses.hindi: पारदा मक्तकेशाश्र पल्हवाः श्मश्ुधारिण: । निःस्वाध्यायवषट्काराः कृतास्तेन महात्मना शका यवनकाम्बोजाः पल्हवाः पारदेः सह । कलिस्पर्शा माहिषिका दार्वाश्वोला: खसास्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: It is accompanied by very terrible flames of fire, sparks and smoke. O King, I am not therefore able to stay in my own hermitage.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is accompanied by very terrible flames of fire, sparks and smoke. O King, I am not therefore able to stay in my own hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: तरन्ति तस्यां सद्दानैरन्यथा तु पतन्ति ते । मातरं ये न मन्यन्ते ह्याचार्यं गुरुमेव च
verses.transliteration: taranti tasyāṃ saddānairanyathā tu patanti te / mātaraṃ ye na manyante hyācāryaṃ gurumeva ca
verses.translation: O brawny-armed king, restrain him with a desire for the welfare of the worlds. The great deity Vi$nu will further develop your prowess by means of his own splendour.
verses.hindi: सर्वे ते क्षत्रियगणा धर्मस्तेषां निराकृतः । वसिष्ठवचनात्पूर्वें सगरेण महात्मना ३१४ ३ स धमंविजयो राजा विजित्वेमां वसुंधराम् । अश्वं विचारयासास वाजिमेधाय दीक्षितः ॥ १४४.
verses.wordMeaning: O brawny-armed king, restrain him with a desire for the welfare of the worlds. The great deity Vi$nu will further develop your prowess by means of his own splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brawny-armed king, restrain him with a desire for the welfare of the worlds. The great deity Vi$nu will further develop your prowess by means of his own splendour.

verses.sanskrit: अवजानन्ति मूढा ये तेषां वासस्तु संततम् । पतिव्रतां साधुशीलामूढां धर्मेषु निश्चलाम्
verses.transliteration: avajānanti mūḍhā ye teṣāṃ vāsastu saṃtatam / pativratāṃ sādhuśīlāmūḍhāṃ dharmeṣu niścalām
verses.translation: The worlds will be happy and relieved today when the Asura is killed. O King, you are hence competent to kill him.
verses.hindi: स॒तंदेशं सुतेः सर्वे: खानयामास पार्थिवः । आसेदुश्य ततस्तस्मिस्तदन्तस्ते महार्णवे ३१४६ तमादिपुरुष देवं हरि क्रृष्णं प्रजापतिम् । विष्णुं कपिलरूपेण हंस॑ नारायण प्रभुम् १४७ बहिकेतु: सकेतुश्व॒ तथा बर्मरतश्व वः । श्रः पत्चवनश्चव तस्य वंशकरा: प्रभो:
verses.wordMeaning: The worlds will be happy and relieved today when the Asura is killed. O King, you are hence competent to kill him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The worlds will be happy and relieved today when the Asura is killed. O King, you are hence competent to kill him.

verses.sanskrit: परित्यजन्ति ये पापाः संततं तु वसन्ति ते । विश्वासप्रतिपन्नानां स्वामिमित्रतपस्विनाम्
verses.transliteration: parityajanti ye pāpāḥ saṃtataṃ tu vasanti te / viśvāsapratipannānāṃ svāmimitratapasvinām
verses.translation: O Sinless one, a boon has been granted to me (that you would help me by killing him) formerly by Visnu. Hence Dhundhu of great virility cannot be slain by anyone of less splendour even in hundreds of years. His virility is so great that it cannot be brooked even by the Devas."
verses.hindi: कं ननर--»+५ ०५४ कानपग-म
verses.wordMeaning: O Sinless one, a boon has been granted to me (that you would help me by killing him) formerly by Visnu. Hence Dhundhu of great virility cannot be slain by anyone of less splendour even in hundreds of years. His virility is so great that it cannot be brooked even by the Devas."
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sinless one, a boon has been granted to me (that you would help me by killing him) formerly by Visnu. Hence Dhundhu of great virility cannot be slain by anyone of less splendour even in hundreds of years. His virility is so great that it cannot be brooked even by the Devas."

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीबालवृद्धदीनानां छिद्रम् अन्वेषयन्ति ये । पच्यन्ते तत्र मध्ये वै क्रन्दमानाः सुपापिनः
verses.transliteration: strībālavṛddhadīnānāṃ chidram anveṣayanti ye / pacyante tatra madhye vai krandamānāḥ supāpinaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the noble-souled Uttanka, that saintly king entrusted his son Kuvalasva with the job of restrain¬ ing Dhundhu.
verses.hindi: करके उन सबों के धर्मों को नष्ट कर दिया तथा वेष भूषा आदि भी बदल दी ।१३६-१३:६। शूकों का उसने आधा शिर मुण्डित करा कर छोड़ दिया, यवनों के पूरे शिर को मूंडित करा के छोड़ दिया, कम्बोजी को भी पूरा शिर मंडित करा के छोड़ दिया, पारदों के केवल केश छोड़ दिये मूंछ दाढ़ी सब मुण्डित करा दिये, पल्हवों की केवल दाढ़ी रखवा कर छोड़ दिया । उस महान बलशाली ने इन सप्र को वेदाध्ययन, यज्ञ हृवनादि से संर्वेथा वंचित कर दिया । ये शक, यवन, काम्बोज, पह्मव, पारद, कलिस्पर्श, माहिषिक, दार्य, चोल एवं खस जाति वाले सभो पहले क्षत्रिय वर्ण के थे, इनके धर्म को उस महाबलवान् राजा ने वसिष्ठ का वचत मानकर निराक्षत कर दिया ।(४०-१४३। इस प्रकार उस घमंविजयी राजा ने सारी पृथ्वी जीतकर अश्बमेध यज्ञ की दीक्षा ग्रहण कर अश्व को भूमण्डल भर घुमाया  घमाते समय उसका अश्वमेध्ष यज्ञ का वह अइ्व पू+-दद्षिण समुद्र के तटवर्ती
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the noble-souled Uttanka, that saintly king entrusted his son Kuvalasva with the job of restrain¬ ing Dhundhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the noble-souled Uttanka, that saintly king entrusted his son Kuvalasva with the job of restrain¬ ing Dhundhu.

verses.sanskrit: श्रान्तं बुभुक्षितं विप्रं यो विघ्नयति दुर्मतिः । कृमिभिर् भक्ष्यते तत्र यावत्कल्पशतत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: śrāntaṃ bubhukṣitaṃ vipraṃ yo vighnayati durmatiḥ / kṛmibhir bhakṣyate tatra yāvatkalpaśatatrayam
verses.translation: The King said, "I have already laid aside iny weapons. Here is my son. O Excellent Brahmana, he will undoubtedly become the slayer of Dhundhu."
verses.hindi: प्रान्त में अपहत कर लिया गया और प्रथ्वी के भीतर छिपा दिया गया ।१४४-१४५॥ तदनन्तर राजा समर ने अपने सभी पुत्रों से समृद्र के तटबर्ती समस्त प्रान्‍्तों को खनवा डाला, खनते समय उसके पृत्रगण उस महासमुद्र के अन्तिम छोर पर पहुँच गये और वहाँ पर आदि पुरुष, हरि, कृष्ण, प्रजापति, नारायण, प्रभु, हंस आदि अनेक नामों एवं रूपों स प्रकाशित होनेवाले भगणान् विषण को महाँ। कपिल के वेश
verses.wordMeaning: The King said, "I have already laid aside iny weapons. Here is my son. O Excellent Brahmana, he will undoubtedly become the slayer of Dhundhu."
verses.commentary: Sense: The King said, "I have already laid aside iny weapons. Here is my son. O Excellent Brahmana, he will undoubtedly become the slayer of Dhundhu."

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाय प्रतिश्रुत्य यो दानं न प्रयच्छति । आहूय नास्ति यो ब्रूते तस्य वासस्तु संततम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāya pratiśrutya yo dānaṃ na prayacchati / āhūya nāsti yo brūte tasya vāsastu saṃtatam
verses.translation: After ordering his son who was ready to slay Dhundhu, the king of praise-worthy holy observances retired to the mountains for performing penance.
verses.hindi: (में उपस्थित देखा ।) चोर जानकर उनके पास, ज्योंदी उनकी आँख के सामने पहुंचे त्योंह्दी परथ तेज को न सहव कर भस्म हो गये, केवल चार पुत्र शेष रह गये ।१४६-१४५। उनके नाम वहिकेतु, सुकेतु, धर्मरत और पंचवन थे, उस महान् ऐश्वयंशाली राजा सार के वंश को बढ़ाने वाले ये चार पुत्र कहे जाते हैं। भगवान् नारायण ने प्रादाच्च तस्ब भगवान्हुरिनाॉरायणो वरान् । अक्षतत्वं स्ववंशस्य वाजिमेधशतं तथा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After ordering his son who was ready to slay Dhundhu, the king of praise-worthy holy observances retired to the mountains for performing penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After ordering his son who was ready to slay Dhundhu, the king of praise-worthy holy observances retired to the mountains for performing penance.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निदो गरदश्चैव राजगामी च पैशुनी । कथाभङ्गकरश्चैव कूटसाक्षी च मद्यपः
verses.transliteration: agnido garadaścaiva rājagāmī ca paiśunī / kathābhaṅgakaraścaiva kūṭasākṣī ca madyapaḥ
verses.translation: The righteous-souled king Kuvalasva, obeying the behest of his father, went ahead to Dhundhu's haunt, accom¬ panied by his twentyone thousand sons and Uttanka, in order to restrain Dhundhu.
verses.hindi: स समुद्रो5श्वमादाय ववन्दे सरिता पति:। सागरत्वं च लेभे स करमंणा तेन तस्य वे (१५१
verses.wordMeaning: The righteous-souled king Kuvalasva, obeying the behest of his father, went ahead to Dhundhu's haunt, accom¬ panied by his twentyone thousand sons and Uttanka, in order to restrain Dhundhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The righteous-souled king Kuvalasva, obeying the behest of his father, went ahead to Dhundhu's haunt, accom¬ panied by his twentyone thousand sons and Uttanka, in order to restrain Dhundhu.

verses.sanskrit: वज्रविध्वंसकश्चैव स्वयंदत्तापहारकः । सुक्षेत्रसेतुभेदी च परदारप्रधर्षकः
verses.transliteration: vajravidhvaṃsakaścaiva svayaṃdattāpahārakaḥ / sukṣetrasetubhedī ca paradārapradharṣakaḥ
verses.translation: Due to the imploring entreaty of Uttanka, and with a desire for the welfare of the worlds, lord Visnu entered him with his own brilliance.
verses.hindi: सगरस्या55त्मजा राज्ञः कथ्थ जाता महाबला: । विक्रान्ता: पष्टिसाहल्ना विधिना केन वा बद हे पत्न्यो सगरस्या55स्तां तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषे। ज्येष्ठा विदर्भदुहिता केशिनी नाम नामतः
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the imploring entreaty of Uttanka, and with a desire for the welfare of the worlds, lord Visnu entered him with his own brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the imploring entreaty of Uttanka, and with a desire for the welfare of the worlds, lord Visnu entered him with his own brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो रसविक्रेता वृषलीपतिरेव च । गोकुलस्य तृषार्तस्य पालीभेदं करोति यः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇo rasavikretā vṛṣalīpatireva ca / gokulasya tṛṣārtasya pālībhedaṃ karoti yaḥ
verses.translation: When that invincible (king) started, a loud voice arose in heaven—"This king shall be the slayer of Dhundhu (Dhundhumara) with effect from today."
verses.hindi: कनीयसी तु या तस्य पत्नो परमधर्मिणी । अरिष्टनेमिदुहिता रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि
verses.wordMeaning: When that invincible (king) started, a loud voice arose in heaven—"This king shall be the slayer of Dhundhu (Dhundhumara) with effect from today."
verses.commentary: Sense: When that invincible (king) started, a loud voice arose in heaven—"This king shall be the slayer of Dhundhu (Dhundhumara) with effect from today."

verses.sanskrit: कन्याभिदूषकश्चैव दानं दत्त्वा तु तापकः । शूद्रस्तु कपिलापानी ब्राह्मणो मांसभोजनी
verses.transliteration: kanyābhidūṣakaścaiva dānaṃ dattvā tu tāpakaḥ / śūdrastu kapilāpānī brāhmaṇo māṃsabhojanī
verses.translation: The Devas honoured him with divine flowers. It was a wonderful thing. That tiger-like man (the king) of great prowess went to that vast sea of sand accompanied by his sons and dug it up without any waste (of time). That saintly king had already been developed (empowered) extra-ordinarily by the splendour of Narayana.
verses.hindi: ओवस्ताभ्यां बर॑ प्रादात्तपसा55राधित:प्रभुः । एका जनिष्यते पुत्र वंशकर्तारमीप्सितम् ॥ राजा को सुन्दर वरदान दिये । जिनसे उनको अपने वंश का अक्षयत्व, सौ अश्वमेध यज्ञों के सम्पन्न करने का सुअवसर, परम ऐश्वर्य सम्पन्न समुद्र का पूत्रत्व, एवं स्वर्ग लोक में अनन्त काल पर्यन्त निवास प्राप्त हुए ।(४६-११५०।॥ समस्त सरिताओं का स्वामी समुद्र उस समय उनके समीप अश्व लेकर उपस्थित हुआ ओर नमस्कार किया । राजा के उसी महान् कर्म से उसे सागरत्व (सागर के पुत्रत्व) को उपाधि प्राप्त हुई। इस
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas honoured him with divine flowers. It was a wonderful thing. That tiger-like man (the king) of great prowess went to that vast sea of sand accompanied by his sons and dug it up without any waste (of time).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas honoured him with divine flowers. It was a wonderful thing. That tiger-like man (the king) of great prowess went to that vast sea of sand accompanied by his sons and dug it up without any waste (of time).…

verses.sanskrit: एते वसन्ति सततं मा विचारं कृथा नृप । सानुकूला भवेद्येन तच् छृणुष्व नराधिप
verses.transliteration: ete vasanti satataṃ mā vicāraṃ kṛthā nṛpa / sānukūlā bhavedyena tac chṛṇuṣva narādhipa
verses.translation: He became still more powerful by staying under the control of Uttanka. Dhundhu was found out by his sons who were digging. He had been lying hidden beneath the sand on the western side. He seemed to be furiously covering the worlds by means of the fire coming out of his mouth.
verses.hindi: प्रकार समुद्र से उस अश्वमेधयज्ञ के अश्व को प्राप्त कर राजा सगर ने अन्य सौ अश्वमेध यज्ञों को निविध्न सम्वन्न किया । उसके उस प्रथम यज्ञ के पीछे पीछे चलने वाले जो साठ सहन पुत्र भस्म हुए थे वे सब के सब महा बलवान् पृत्रगण नारायण के तेज में तद्बप होकर प्रविष्ट हो गये--ऐसा हमने सुना है।?५१-१५३॥।
verses.wordMeaning: He became still more powerful by staying under the control of Uttanka. Dhundhu was found out by his sons who were digging. He had been lying hidden beneath the sand on the western side. He seemed to be furiously covering the worlds by means of the fire coming out of his mouth.
verses.commentary: Sense: He became still more powerful by staying under the control of Uttanka. Dhundhu was found out by his sons who were digging. He had been lying hidden beneath the sand on the western side. He seemed to be furiously covering the worlds by means of the fire coming out of his mouth.

verses.sanskrit: अयने विषुवे चैव व्यतीपाते दिनक्षये । अन्येषु पुण्यकालेषु दीयते दानमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ayane viṣuve caiva vyatīpāte dinakṣaye / anyeṣu puṇyakāleṣu dīyate dānamuttamam
verses.translation: O excellent one among the imbibers of Soma, by means of his Yogic power, he exuded water like the great ocean at the time of Moon-rise. It was a vast sheet of water with currents and waves.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने पूछा--सूत्त जी । राजा सगर के वे साठ सहस्न पुत्र गण, जो सब के सब परम बलवान् एवं विजयी थे, किस प्रकार से अथवा किस विधि से उत्पन्न हुए-+यह बतलाइये सूत जी बोले--उस राजा सगर की दो स्त्रियाँ थीं, जिन्होंने अपनी घोर तपस्या द्वारा समस्त पापों को भस्म कर दिया था, बड़ी स्त्री विदर्भराज की कन्या केशिनी नाम से विख्यात थीं, उनकी छोटी परम धर्मिष्ठ पत्नी जो थीं, वे राजा अरिष्टनेमि की कन्या थीं, अपने रूप में सारे भूमण्डल में वे अकेली थीं।१५१-१५६। (उनका नाम सुमति था) तपस्या द्वारा सन्तुष्ट किये गये महामुनि और ने उन्हें वरदान दिया,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one among the imbibers of Soma, by means of his Yogic power, he exuded water like the great ocean at the time of Moon-rise. It was a vast sheet of water with currents and waves.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one among the imbibers of Soma, by means of his Yogic power, he exuded water like the great ocean at the time of Moon-rise. It was a vast sheet of water with currents and waves.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णां वा पाटलां वापि कुर्याद्वैतरणीं शुभाम् । स्वर्णशृङ्गीं रूप्यखुरां कांस्यपात्रस्य दोहिनीम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṃ vā pāṭalāṃ vāpi kuryādvaitaraṇīṃ śubhām / svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ rūpyakhurāṃ kāṃsyapātrasya dohinīm
verses.translation: His sons excepting three were burnt by the Raksasa. Then the king of great strength destroyed all the attendants and kinsmen of Dhundhu.
verses.hindi: मुनेस्तु बचन श्रुत्वा केशिनी पुत्रमेककम् । वंशस्य कारण श्रेष्ठा जग्राह नृपसंसदि १५८ षष्टिपुन्नसहल्नाणि सुपर्ण भगिनी तथा । महात्मनस्तु जग्राह सुमतिः स्वमतियंथा
verses.wordMeaning: His sons excepting three were burnt by the Raksasa. Then the king of great strength destroyed all the attendants and kinsmen of Dhundhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: His sons excepting three were burnt by the Raksasa. Then the king of great strength destroyed all the attendants and kinsmen of Dhundhu.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णवस्त्रयुगाच्छन्नां सप्तधान्यसमन्विताम् । कुर्यात्सद्रोणशिखर आसीनां ताम्रभाजने
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇavastrayugācchannāṃ saptadhānyasamanvitām / kuryātsadroṇaśikhara āsīnāṃ tāmrabhājane
verses.translation: The king who was a Yogin, drank up his behemence in the form of water-flood (let loose by him) by means of his Yogic power and extinguished the fire by means of water.
verses.hindi: अथ काले गते ज्येष्ठा ज्येष्ठ पुत्र व्यजायत । असमड्ज इति ख्यातं काकुत्स्थं सगरात्मजम् घ॒तपुर्णेषु कुम्मेषु तान्गर्भाव्यदधत्ततः । धात्रीश्चेकेकशः प्रादात्तावतीः पोषणे नृपः
verses.wordMeaning: The king who was a Yogin, drank up his behemence in the form of water-flood (let loose by him) by means of his Yogic power and extinguished the fire by means of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king who was a Yogin, drank up his behemence in the form of water-flood (let loose by him) by means of his Yogic power and extinguished the fire by means of water.

verses.sanskrit: यमं हैमं प्रकुर्वीत लोहदण्डसमन्वितम् । इक्षुदण्डमयं बद्ध्वा ह्युडुपं पट्टबन्धनैः
verses.transliteration: yamaṃ haimaṃ prakurvīta lohadaṇḍasamanvitam / ikṣudaṇḍamayaṃ baddhvā hyuḍupaṃ paṭṭabandhanaiḥ
verses.translation: Then he overpowered the huge-bodied aquatic
verses.hindi: ततो नवसु मासेषु समुत्तस्थुयंथासुखम् । कुमारास्ते महाभागाः सगरप्रीतिवर्धना:
verses.wordMeaning: Then he overpowered the huge-bodied aquatic
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he overpowered the huge-bodied aquatic

verses.sanskrit: उडुपोपरि तां धेनुं सूर्यदेहसमुद्भवाम् । कृत्वा प्रकल्पयेद् विद्वाञ् छत्त्रोपानद्युगान्विताम्
verses.transliteration: uḍupopari tāṃ dhenuṃ sūryadehasamudbhavām / kṛtvā prakalpayed vidvāñ chattropānadyugānvitām
verses.translation: DrdhaSva was the eldest ofhis three sons who survived. BhadraSva and Kapilaiva were the younger ones..
verses.hindi: कालेन महता चेच यौवन प्रतिपेदिरे । षष्टिपुत्रसहल्लाणि तेषासंश्वानुसारिणाम् १६४ स॒ तु ज्येष्ठो नरव्याध्रः सगरस्या5घत्मसंभवः । असमञ्ज इति ख्यातो बहिकेतुर्महाबल: तस्य पुत्रस्तु धर्मात्मा दिलोप इति विश्वुतः  दिलीपात्तु महातेजा बीरो जातो भगीरथः १६७
verses.wordMeaning: DrdhaSva was the eldest ofhis three sons who survived. BhadraSva and Kapilaiva were the younger ones..
verses.commentary: Sense: DrdhaSva was the eldest ofhis three sons who survived. BhadraSva and Kapilaiva were the younger ones..

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुलीयकवासांसि ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् । इममुच्चारयेन्मन्त्रं संगृह्यास्याश्च पुच्छकम्
verses.transliteration: aṅgulīyakavāsāṃsi brāhmaṇāya nivedayet / imamuccārayenmantraṃ saṃgṛhyāsyāśca pucchakam
verses.translation: DrdhaSva was known as Dhaundhumari (son of Dhundhumara). Haryasva was his son. His son was Nikumbha who was always engaged in Ksatra Dharma (military Pro- fession).
verses.hindi: कि इनमें से एक वंश कर्ता पुत्र को उत्पन्न करेगी और दूसरी साठ सहख्र पुन्न उत्पन्न करेगी। राज सभा में मुनि के इन दोनों वरदानों में से केशिनी ने वंशकर्त्ता एक पुत्र की प्राप्ति का वरदान माँगा, सुपर्णभगिनी दूसरी रानी सुमति ने अपने मन के अनुकूल महाघुनि से साठ सहस्र पुत्रों को प्राप्त करने का वरदान माँगा  तदनुसार समय आने पर बड़ी रानी केशिनी ने ज्येष्ठ पुत्र असमञ्ज को उत्पन्न किया बाद में चलकर वह सगर पुत्र राजा असमंज
verses.wordMeaning: DrdhaSva was known as Dhaundhumari (son of Dhundhumara). Haryasva was his son. His son was Nikumbha who was always engaged in Ksatra Dharma (military Pro- fession).
verses.commentary: Sense: DrdhaSva was known as Dhaundhumari (son of Dhundhumara). Haryasva was his son. His son was Nikumbha who was always engaged in Ksatra Dharma (military Pro- fession).

verses.sanskrit: ॐ यमद्वारे महाघोरे या सा वैतरणी नदी । तर्तुकामो ददाम्येनां तुभ्यं वैतरणि नमः । इत्यधिवासनमन्त्रः
verses.transliteration: oṃ yamadvāre mahāghore yā sā vaitaraṇī nadī / tartukāmo dadāmyenāṃ tubhyaṃ vaitaraṇi namaḥ / ityadhivāsanamantraḥ
verses.translation: Samhatasva was the son of Nikumbha. He is reputed as an expert in warfare. Krsasva and Aksayasva were the sons of Samhatasva.
verses.hindi: काकुत्स्थ नाम से विख्यात हुआ १ ५७-१६०। यशस्विनी' रानी सुमति ने अपने गर्भ से एक तुम्ब' उत्पन्न किया जिसके बीच से साठ सहस्न पुत्र निकले  उतान्न होने के बाद वे गर्भ घृत से भरे हुए पात्रों में रखे गये, राजा ने उन पात्रों को साठ सहस्न धायो को पालने के लिये सौंपा । नव महीने बीत जाने पर उन पात्रों से सुखपूर्वक वे स'ठ सहस्न महाभाग्यशाली राजकुमार बाहर निकले, जिन्हें देखकर राजा सगर को परम सुख प्राप्त हुआ । बहुत दिन व्यतीत हो जाने पर वे सब राजकुमार युवावस्था को प्राप्त हुए  प्रथम अश्वमेध यज्ञ के अहृव के पीछे वे साठ सहस्र पुत्र गये थे ।!(६१-१६४। राजा सगर के सब से बड़े औरस पुत्र नर ब्याप्न असमंज महा- बलवान् थे, उनका दूसरा नाम वहिकेतु भी प्रसिद्ध था। पहले वे तगर निवासियों के अहितकर कार्यों में लगे रहते थे, इससे पिता ने उन्हें निर्वासित कर दिया था  असमज्ज के परम बलवान् अंशुमान नामक पुत्र हुए।
verses.wordMeaning: Samhatasva was the son of Nikumbha. He is reputed as an expert in warfare. Krsasva and Aksayasva were the sons of Samhatasva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Samhatasva was the son of Nikumbha. He is reputed as an expert in warfare. Krsasva and Aksayasva were the sons of Samhatasva.

verses.sanskrit: गावो मे चाग्रतः सन्तु गावो मे सन्तु पृष्ठतः । गावो मे हृदये सन्तु गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: gāvo me cāgrataḥ santu gāvo me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ / gāvo me hṛdaye santu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham
verses.translation: His wife was Haimavati who was like the river DfSadvati to the minds of the good. She was famous in the three worlds. Her son was Prasenajit.
verses.hindi: अंञुमान् के परम धर्मात्मा दिलीप नाम से विख्यात पुत्र हुए। दिलीप से महान् तेजस्वी भगीरथ नामक वीर पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ ।१६९५-१६७। इसी भगीरथ ने अपनी पूजा एवं क्रिया के बल से विमानों से सुशोभित, समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: His wife was Haimavati who was like the river DfSadvati to the minds of the good. She was famous in the three worlds. Her son was Prasenajit.
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife was Haimavati who was like the river DfSadvati to the minds of the good. She was famous in the three worlds. Her son was Prasenajit.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ विष्णुरूप द्विजश्रेष्ठ भूदेव पङ्क्तिपावन । सदक्षिणा मया दत्ता तुभ्यं वैतरणि नमः । इति दानमन्त्रः
verses.transliteration: oṃ viṣṇurūpa dvijaśreṣṭha bhūdeva paṅktipāvana / sadakṣiṇā mayā dattā tubhyaṃ vaitaraṇi namaḥ / iti dānamantraḥ
verses.translation: Yuvanasva was his son. He was very brilliant and famous in the three worlds as highly virtuous. The chaste lady Gauri was his wife.
verses.hindi: एतदर्धेस्थाने इदमर्ध 'महात्मा त् समहतो जग्राह समतीं तथा' इति ख. ग. घ. पुस्तकेषु । अन्नाप्युदाहरन्तीमं श्लोक॑ पोराणिका जनाः
verses.wordMeaning: Yuvanasva was his son. He was very brilliant and famous in the three worlds as highly virtuous. The chaste lady Gauri was his wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yuvanasva was his son. He was very brilliant and famous in the three worlds as highly virtuous. The chaste lady Gauri was his wife.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणं धर्मराजं च धेनुं वैतरणीं शिवाम् । सर्वं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaṃ dharmarājaṃ ca dhenuṃ vaitaraṇīṃ śivām / sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet
verses.translation: She was cursed by her husband and turned into the river Bahuda. 1 Her son Gaurika became an emperor.
verses.hindi: भगीरथसुतश्रापि श्रुतो नाम बभूव ह। नाभागस्तस्य दायादो नित्यं धर्मपरायणः ३१७० अम्बरीषः सुतस्तस्य सिन्धुद्दीपस्ततो5भवत् । एवं वंशपुराणज्ञा गायन्तीति परिश्रुतम् १७१ नाभागेरम्ब्रीषस्य भुजाभ्यां परिपालिता । बभव वसुधाउत्यर्थ तापन्नयविरबवजिता
verses.wordMeaning: She was cursed by her husband and turned into the river Bahuda. 1 Her son Gaurika became an emperor.
verses.commentary: Sense: She was cursed by her husband and turned into the river Bahuda. 1 Her son Gaurika became an emperor.

verses.sanskrit: पुच्छं संगृह्य सुरभेरग्रे कृत्वा द्विजं ततः
verses.transliteration: pucchaṃ saṃgṛhya surabheragre kṛtvā dvijaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: Mandhata, the son of Yuvanasva, became a king con¬ quering the three worlds. In this connection, Brahmanas well versed in Puranas, cite these two verses.
verses.hindi: दिष्याक्षहृदयज्ञोईसो राजा नलसखो बली। नलो द्वाविति विख्यातों पुराणंषु दृढब़तो वीरसेनात्मजश्रेव यश्चेक्ष्वाकुकुलोहह:  ऋतुपणंस्य पुत्रो5भुत्सवेकामो जनेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Mandhata, the son of Yuvanasva, became a king con¬ quering the three worlds. In this connection, Brahmanas well versed in Puranas, cite these two verses.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mandhata, the son of Yuvanasva, became a king con¬ quering the three worlds. In this connection, Brahmanas well versed in Puranas, cite these two verses.

verses.sanskrit: धेनुके त्वं प्रतीक्षस्व यमद्वारे महाभये । उत्तितीर्षुरहं धेनो वैतरण्यै नमो ऽस्तु ते । इत्यनुव्रजमन्त्रः
verses.transliteration: dhenuke tvaṃ pratīkṣasva yamadvāre mahābhaye / uttitīrṣurahaṃ dheno vaitaraṇyai namo 'stu te / ityanuvrajamantraḥ
verses.translation: "The entire region from the place where the Sun rises up to (the place) where he sets, the whole of it, is called the territory of Mandhata, son of Yuvanasva".
verses.hindi: सुबासस्तस्य तनयो राजा हंसमुखो5भवत् । सुदासस्य सुतः प्रोक्त: सोदासो नाम पाथिवः
verses.wordMeaning: "The entire region from the place where the Sun rises up to (the place) where he sets, the whole of it, is called the territory of Mandhata, son of Yuvanasva".
verses.commentary: Sense: "The entire region from the place where the Sun rises up to (the place) where he sets, the whole of it, is called the territory of Mandhata, son of Yuvanasva".

verses.sanskrit: अनुव्रजेत गच्छन्तं सर्वं तस्य गृहं नयेत् । एवं कृते महीपाल सरित्स्यात्सुखवाहिनी
verses.transliteration: anuvrajeta gacchantaṃ sarvaṃ tasya gṛhaṃ nayet / evaṃ kṛte mahīpāla saritsyātsukhavāhinī
verses.translation: People who know the (details of) different races also quote this verse. "Those who know Puranas call the son of Yuvanasva, noble-souled, a performer of sacrifices and (a king) of unmeasured splendour. Mandhata is the embodied form of Visnu."
verses.hindi: र्यात: कल्माषपादो वे नाम्ता मिन्रसहश्य सः । वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजाः क्षेत्र कल्माषपादके ।। सरिताओं में श्रेष्ठ गंगा को पुत्री रूप में प्राप्त किया और समुद्र पर्यन्त उसकी पावती धारा से पृथ्वी को सुशोभित किया । पुराणों के जाननेवाले आज भी इस इलोक (यशोगाथा) का गान करते हैं कि “राजा भगीरथ ने अपने कर्मों द्वारा गंगा जी को प्रृथ्वी पर उतारा था, राजवंशों के वत्तान्त को जाननेवाले अर्थात् ऐतिहाप्रिक लोग इसीलिये गंगा को भागी रथी कहते हैं । उस राजा भगीरथ का पुत्र श्रत नाम से विर्यात हुआ उसका उत्तरा-
verses.wordMeaning: People who know the (details of) different races also quote this verse. "Those who know Puranas call the son of Yuvanasva, noble-souled, a performer of sacrifices and (a king) of unmeasured splendour. Mandhata is the embodied form of Visnu."
verses.commentary: Sense: People who know the (details of) different races also quote this verse. "Those who know Puranas call the son of Yuvanasva, noble-souled, a performer of sacrifices and (a king) of unmeasured splendour. Mandhata is the embodied form of Visnu."

verses.sanskrit: तारयते तया धेन्वा सा सरिज्जलवाहिनी । सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः
verses.transliteration: tārayate tayā dhenvā sā sarijjalavāhinī / sarvānkāmānavāpnoti ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ
verses.translation: His wife CaitrarathI was Sasabindu's daughter. She was known by the name ofBindumati also. She was a chaste lady and had no equal in beauty all over the earth.
verses.hindi: घिकारी नाभाग हुआ, जो सर्वदा अपने धर्म में तत्वर रहने वाला था ।१६५-१३०। नाभाग का पुत्र अम्बरीष था, और उसका पुत्र राजा सिन्धुद्रीप हुआ  पुरानी कथाओं के जातनेवाले लोग इस वंश का इतिहास इसी प्रकार सुनाते हैं-ऐसा हमने भी सुता है। ऐसी प्रसिद्धि है कि राजा नाभाग के पुत्र अम्बरीष की भूजाओं से पाली गई प्रथ्वी तीनों तापों से सवंदा के लिये विहीन हो गई थी, अर्थात् उसके समय में प्रजाओं को किसी प्रकार का
verses.wordMeaning: His wife CaitrarathI was Sasabindu's daughter. She was known by the name ofBindumati also. She was a chaste lady and had no equal in beauty all over the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife CaitrarathI was Sasabindu's daughter. She was known by the name ofBindumati also. She was a chaste lady and had no equal in beauty all over the earth.

verses.sanskrit: रोगी रोगाद्विमुक्तः स्याच्छाम्यन्ति परमापदः । स्वस्थे सहस्रगुणितमातुरे शतसंमितम्
verses.transliteration: rogī rogādvimuktaḥ syācchāmyanti paramāpadaḥ / svasthe sahasraguṇitamāture śatasaṃmitam
verses.translation: She was the eldest sister often thousand brothers. She was devotedly attached to her husband. Mandhata begot three sons of her.
verses.hindi: कष्ट नहीं था । अम््ररीष के पृत्र सिन्धुद्वीप का पुत्र आयुतायु हुआ, वह भी परम बलशाली राजा था। उस आयुतायु का उत्तराधिकारी महान् यशस्वी राजा ऋतुपर्ण हुआ ।१७१-१७३। यह ऋतुपर्ण राजा नल का परम सहद एवं बलवान राजा था, दिव्य अक्ष विद्या में वह परम निपुण था। पुराणों में दो नल विख्यात हैं, वे दोनो ही परम साहसी एवं बीर हैं, उनमें एक नल राजा वीरसेन के पुत्र थे, दूसरे इक्ष्वाकु वंश में उत्पन्न हुए थे । राजा ऋतुपणं के पुत्र राजा संकाम थे, उनके पुत्र का नाम सुदास था, इस सुदास का दूसरा नाम हंसमुख भी था। (अथवा उसका मुख हंस की तरह था) उस युदास के पुत्र राजा सौदास के नाम से कहदे जाते हैं। इनके दूसरे नाम कल्माषपाद तथा मित्रस॒ह भी विख्यात है ।!७४-१७६३१। महान् तेजस्वी मह॒षि वस्तिष्ठ ने राजा
verses.wordMeaning: She was the eldest sister often thousand brothers. She was devotedly attached to her husband. Mandhata begot three sons of her.
verses.commentary: Sense: She was the eldest sister often thousand brothers. She was devotedly attached to her husband. Mandhata begot three sons of her.

verses.sanskrit: मृतस्यैव तु यद्दानं परोक्षे तत्समं स्मृतम् । स्वहस्तेन ततो देयं मृते कः कस्य दास्यति । इति मत्वा महाराज स्वदत्तं स्यान्महाफलम्
verses.transliteration: mṛtasyaiva tu yaddānaṃ parokṣe tatsamaṃ smṛtam / svahastena tato deyaṃ mṛte kaḥ kasya dāsyati / iti matvā mahārāja svadattaṃ syānmahāphalam
verses.translation: They were Purukutsa, Ambarisa and Mucukunda. Ambarlsa's successor was another Yuvanasva.
verses.hindi: अश्सफस्योरकामस्तु मुलकस्तत्सुतोभवत् । अन्नाप्युदाहरन्तीम॑ मुलक बे नृपं प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: They were Purukutsa, Ambarisa and Mucukunda. Ambarlsa's successor was another Yuvanasva.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Purukutsa, Ambarisa and Mucukunda. Ambarlsa's successor was another Yuvanasva.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्तं तव धर्मसूनो दानं मया वैतरणीसमुत्थम् । शृणोति भक्त्या पठतीह सम्यक्स याति विष्णोः पदमप्रमेयम्
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktaṃ tava dharmasūno dānaṃ mayā vaitaraṇīsamuttham / śṛṇoti bhaktyā paṭhatīha samyaksa yāti viṣṇoḥ padamaprameyam
verses.translation: Harita was Yuvanasva's son. Descendants of Harita are remembered by the name Suris. They were the (adopted) sons of Ahgiras (spiritual lineage). They were Brahmanas endowed with martial qualities.
verses.hindi: स॒ हि रामभयाद्राजा स्नीमिः परिवृतो्वसत् । विघस्त्रस्त्राणमिच्छन्वे नारीकवचमीश्वरः मूलकस्यापि धर्मात्मा राजा शतरथः स्मृतः । तस्माच्छ १रथाज्जज्ञे राजा चेडिविडो बली
verses.wordMeaning: Harita was Yuvanasva's son. Descendants of Harita are remembered by the name Suris. They were the (adopted) sons of Ahgiras (spiritual lineage). They were Brahmanas endowed with martial qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harita was Yuvanasva's son. Descendants of Harita are remembered by the name Suris. They were the (adopted) sons of Ahgiras (spiritual lineage). They were Brahmanas endowed with martial qualities.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: प्राप्ते चाश्वयुजे मासि तस्मिन्कृष्णा चतुर्दशी । स्नात्वा कृत्वा ततः श्राद्धं सम्पूज्य च महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: prāpte cāśvayuje māsi tasminkṛṣṇā caturdaśī / snātvā kṛtvā tataḥ śrāddhaṃ sampūjya ca maheśvaram
verses.translation: Purukutsa's successor was Trasaddasyu of great fame. He was born of Narmada. His son was Sambhuta. Sambhuta's son was the valorous Anaranya. He was killed by Ravana formerly while he was conquering the three
verses.hindi: श्रयो5भिसंहिता लोका बुध्चया सत्येन चेव हि १८२
verses.wordMeaning: Purukutsa's successor was Trasaddasyu of great fame. He was born of Narmada. His son was Sambhuta. Sambhuta's son was the valorous Anaranya. He was killed by Ravana formerly while he was conquering the three
verses.commentary: Sense: Purukutsa's successor was Trasaddasyu of great fame. He was born of Narmada. His son was Sambhuta. Sambhuta's son was the valorous Anaranya. He was killed by Ravana formerly while he was conquering the three

verses.sanskrit: पितृभ्यो दीयते दानं भक्तिश्रद्धासमन्वितैः । पश्चाज्जागरणं कुर्यात् सत्कथाश्रवणादिभिः
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhyo dīyate dānaṃ bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaiḥ / paścājjāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt satkathāśravaṇādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Trasadasva was the son of Anaranya. His son was Haryasva. From Haryasva Drsadvatl gave birth to king Vasumata.
verses.hindi: राजा दशरथो नाम इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दन: १८३ रामो दाशरथिवोरो धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः  भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चेव शत्रुध्नश्व महाबल:ः १८४ सुबाहु: श्रसेनश्व शत्रुघ्नसहितावुभी । पालयामासतुः सुतो बदेह्ों मथुरां पुरीम्
verses.wordMeaning: Trasadasva was the son of Anaranya. His son was Haryasva. From Haryasva Drsadvatl gave birth to king Vasumata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Trasadasva was the son of Anaranya. His son was Haryasva. From Haryasva Drsadvatl gave birth to king Vasumata.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभातसमये स्नात्वा वै नर्मदाजले । तर्पणं विधिवत्कृत्वा पित्ःणां देवपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhātasamaye snātvā vai narmadājale / tarpaṇaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā pitḥṇāṃ devapūrvakam
verses.translation: His son was the virtuous king Tridhanva by name. The scholarly king Trayyaruna was the son of Tridhanvan. He had a powerful son named Satyavrata. Vidarbha's wife was abducted by him after killing (i.e. defeat¬ ing) the heaven-dwellers, when all the sacred mantras of marriage ceremony had been chanted and the ceremonies con¬ cluded. Visnuvfddha was his son whence his descendants are remembered as Visnuvrddhas. They were also the (adopted) sons of Ahgiras endowed with martial qualities.
verses.hindi: कल्माषपाद के क्षेत्र में (स्त्री में) इक्ष्वाकु के वंश की वृद्धि के लिए अश्मक नामक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया । अश्मक का पुत्र उरकाम हुआ, उसका पुत्र मूलक था। उस राजा मूलक के विषय में आज भी लोग यह कहते हैं कि वह राजा मूलक राम (परशुराम) के भय से स्त्रियों के बीच में निवास करता था; समर्थ होते हुये भी वह वस्त्र विहीन होकर अपनी रक्षा के लिये स्त्रियों को कवच बनाये हुए था । अथवा पुरुषों का वेश छोड़कर स्त्रियों
verses.wordMeaning: His son was the virtuous king Tridhanva by name. The scholarly king Trayyaruna was the son of Tridhanvan. He had a powerful son named Satyavrata. Vidarbha's wife was abducted by him after killing (i.e. defeat¬ ing) the heaven-dwellers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was the virtuous king Tridhanva by name. The scholarly king Trayyaruna was the son of Tridhanvan. He had a powerful son named Satyavrata. Vidarbha's wife was abducted by him after killing (i.e. defeat¬ ing) the heaven-dwellers,…

verses.sanskrit: सौवर्णे घृतसंयुक्तं दीपं दद्याद् द्विजातये । पश्चात् संभोजयेद् विप्रान् स्वयं चैव विमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: sauvarṇe ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dīpaṃ dadyād dvijātaye / paścāt saṃbhojayed viprān svayaṃ caiva vimatsaraḥ
verses.translation: That (sin) was committed by him out of lust, or (pride) due to his strength, or to the powerful force exerted by the inevitable destiny, though he was intelligent.
verses.hindi: का वेश धारण किये हुए था ।१७७-१७६। उस राजा मूलक के पुत्र परम घर्मात्मा राजा शतरथ कहे जाते हैं । उस राजा शतरथ से परम बलवान राजा ऐडिविड उत्पन्न हुए । वे राजा ऐडिविड परम कान्तिशाली थे । उनके पुत्र प्रतापशाली कृतशर्मा हुए, कृतद्ार्मा के विध्वमहत् नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए ।ह5०-१५१। उनके पूत्र दिलीप हुए, जो खटट्वागिद नाम से भी प्रसिद्ध थे। वे राजा दिलीप स्वर्गलोक से प्रथ्वी लोक पर आकर दो घड़ी तक जीवित रहे । अपने सत्य, बुद्धि एवं बल से उन्होंने तीनों लोकों को पराजित कर दिया था। उन राजा खट्वाँगद कै पुत्र दीघंवाहु हुए, उनसे राजा रघ् हुए । रघ् के परम बलवान् अज उत्पन्न हुए । उन्हीं अज से इंक्ष्वाकु के कुल को आनन्दित करनेवाले परम बलद्याली राजा दशरथ हुए ।१८२-१८३। दशरथ के पुत्र रामचन््र व॒रत धर्ंज्न थे, समस्त लोक में उनड्ी घमंज्ञता विख्यात थी । राम के अतिरिक्त भरत, लक्ष्मण और महाबलवानु शत्रुघ्न नामक
verses.wordMeaning: That (sin) was committed by him out of lust, or (pride) due to his strength, or to the powerful force exerted by the inevitable destiny, though he was intelligent.
verses.commentary: Sense: That (sin) was committed by him out of lust, or (pride) due to his strength, or to the powerful force exerted by the inevitable destiny, though he was intelligent.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृते नरश्रेष्ठ न जन्तुर्नरकं व्रजेत् । अवश्यमेव मनुजैर्द्रष्टव्या नारकी स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛte naraśreṣṭha na janturnarakaṃ vrajet / avaśyameva manujairdraṣṭavyā nārakī sthitiḥ
verses.translation: His father Trayyaruna banished him as he was sinful. Being infuriated with him, he repeated many times, "Be He spoke to his father again and again,
verses.hindi: उनके तीन पुत्र और थे । मधु के पुत्र लवणासुर का संहार कर, और मधुवन में प्रवेशकर शन्नुष्न ने वहीं पर मथुरा नामक पुरी की प्रतिष्ठापना को थी । विदेह की राजकुमारी से उत्पन्न होनेवाले सुबाहु और शूरसेन नामक दोनों पुत्रों ने अपने पिता शत्रुघ्न के साथ मथुरा पुरी का शासन एवं वहाँ की प्रजाओं का पालन पोषण किया
verses.wordMeaning: His father Trayyaruna banished him as he was sinful. Being infuriated with him, he repeated many times, "Be He spoke to his father again and again,
verses.commentary: Sense: His father Trayyaruna banished him as he was sinful. Being infuriated with him, he repeated many times, "Be He spoke to his father again and again,

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना कृत्वा न पश्येन्नरकान्नरः । तत्र तीर्थे मृतानां तु नराणां विधिना नृप
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinā kṛtvā na paśyennarakānnaraḥ / tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ vidhinā nṛpa
verses.translation: Visvamitra of great penance left his wife in that land and performed a severe penance in the marshy land near the
verses.hindi: ७द्है८ बायुपुराणमस् अज्जभदश्चन्द्रकेतुश्न॒ लक्ष्यणस्पाउपत्मजावुभो । हिमवत्पवृ॑ताभ्यासे स्फीतो जनपदौ तयो:
verses.wordMeaning: Visvamitra of great penance left his wife in that land and performed a severe penance in the marshy land near the
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvamitra of great penance left his wife in that land and performed a severe penance in the marshy land near the

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरं शिवे लोके वासो भवति दुर्लभे । विमानेनार्कवर्णेन किंकिणीशतशोभिना
verses.transliteration: manvantaraṃ śive loke vāso bhavati durlabhe / vimānenārkavarṇena kiṃkiṇīśataśobhinā
verses.translation: His wife tied her own bosom-born middle son (with; a rope) round his neck and offered him for sale in exchange for a hundred cows for maintaining (the remaining ones). On seeing the son of the sage tied round the neck, the excellent man of good rites, the virtuous-souled Satyavrata of great intellect, got him released by being sold. He nurtured him in order to propitiate Visvamitra and gain his sympathy.
verses.hindi: अज्भदस्यद्भदीया तु देशे कारपथे पुरी । चन्द्रकेतोस्तु मल्‍लस्य चन्द्रवक्‍त्रा पुरी शुभा १८८ भरतस्पाउःत्मजो वीरो तक्षः पुष्कर एवं च। गान्धारबिषये सिद्धे तथोः पुर्यों महात्मनोः
verses.wordMeaning: His wife tied her own bosom-born middle son (with; a rope) round his neck and offered him for sale in exchange for a hundred cows for maintaining (the remaining ones). On seeing the son of the sage tied round the neck, the excellent man of good rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife tied her own bosom-born middle son (with; a rope) round his neck and offered him for sale in exchange for a hundred cows for maintaining (the remaining ones). On seeing the son of the sage tied round the neck, the excellent man of good rites,…

verses.sanskrit: स गच्छति महाभाग सेव्यमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः । भुनक्ति विविधान्भोगानुक्तकालं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: sa gacchati mahābhāga sevyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ / bhunakti vividhānbhogānuktakālaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The boy came to be known as Galava because he had been tied round the neck {Gala ). That descendant of Kusika, a great sage of severe penance had been redeemed by that powerful (King).
verses.hindi: तक्षस्य दिक्षु बिख्याता रम्या तक्षशिला पुरी । पुष्करस्थापि वीरस्य विख्याता पुष्कराबती गाथां चंवात्र गायन्ति ये पुराणविदों जना: । रामे निबद्ध/स्तत्त्वार्था माहात्म्यात्तस्य धीमतः
verses.wordMeaning: The boy came to be known as Galava because he had been tied round the neck {Gala ). That descendant of Kusika, a great sage of severe penance had been redeemed by that powerful (King).
verses.commentary: Sense: The boy came to be known as Galava because he had been tied round the neck {Gala ). That descendant of Kusika, a great sage of severe penance had been redeemed by that powerful (King).

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णे चैव ततः काल इह मानुष्यतां गतः । सर्वव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम्
verses.transliteration: pūrṇe caiva tataḥ kāla iha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ / sarvavyādhivinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam
verses.translation: On account of his (?) sacred vow, devotion, mercy and solemn declaration, the king who adhered to the rules of discipline, sustained Visvamitra's wife also. After killing deer, boars, buffaloes and other forest animals, he cooked that flesh near the hermitage of ViSvamitra.
verses.hindi: दश वर्षसहुल्लाणि रामो राज्यमकारयत्  ऋक्सामयजुर्षा घोषो ज्याघोषश्य महास्वनः १६३ अविच्छिन्नोइभवद्राष्ट्रे दीयतां भुज्यतामिति । जनस्थाने बसन्कार्य त्रिदशानां चक्वार सः
verses.wordMeaning: On account of his (?) sacred vow, devotion, mercy and solemn declaration, the king who adhered to the rules of discipline, sustained Visvamitra's wife also. After killing deer, boars, buffaloes and other forest animals, he cooked that flesh near the hermitage of ViSvamitra.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his (?) sacred vow, devotion, mercy and solemn declaration, the king who adhered to the rules of discipline, sustained Visvamitra's wife also. After killing deer, boars, buffaloes and other forest animals, he cooked that flesh near the hermitage of ViSvamitra.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्य चाश्वयुजे मासि कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् । अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् । महापातकयुक्तो ऽपि मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: prāpya cāśvayuje māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm / ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram / mahāpātakayukto 'pi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of the father, he adopted a secret vow (UpdrhSu Vrata) and for that purpose took initiation ex¬ tending to twelve years. As the king (Satyavrata's father) had gone to the forest, the sage Vasistha, in the capacity of the king s priest, protected Ayodhya, the kingdom and the harem.
verses.hindi: तमागस्कारिणं पुत्र पोलस्त्यं मनुजर्षभः ! सीताया: पदन्विच्छन्निजधान महायशाः था। लक्ष्मण के अज्भव और चन्द्रकेतु नामक दो पूत्र थे, उन दोनों के राज्य हिमवान् पर्वत के सीमावर्ती प्रान्तों में विस्तृत थे ।१८४-१८७। बड़े पुत्र अद्भुद की राजधानी कारपथ देश में अंगदीया नाम से विख्यात पुरी थी  मलल (बलवान) चन्द्रकेतु की चन्द्रवक्‍त्रा नामक परम शोभायमातर पुरी थी । भरत के पुत्र तक्ष और पुष्कर दोबों बड़े वीर थे। उन दोनों महान बलशालियों की राजधानी गान्वार नामक सिद्ध देश में थी। तक्ष की परम
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of the father, he adopted a secret vow (UpdrhSu Vrata) and for that purpose took initiation ex¬ tending to twelve years. As the king (Satyavrata's father) had gone to the forest, the sage Vasistha, in the capacity of the king s priest, protected Ayodhya,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the father, he adopted a secret vow (UpdrhSu Vrata) and for that purpose took initiation ex¬ tending to twelve years. As the king (Satyavrata's father) had gone to the forest, the sage Vasistha, in the capacity of the king s priest, protected Ayodhya,…

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाविंशतिकोट्यो वै नरकाणां युधिष्ठिर । विमुक्ता नरकैर्दुःखैः शिवलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭyo vai narakāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / vimuktā narakairduḥkhaiḥ śivalokaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: Out of childishness, or due to the force of the inevit¬ able destiny, Satyavrata nursed a great grudge against Vasistha. While he was crying on being exiled by his father and banished from the kingdom, the sage Vasistha had not restrain-
verses.hindi: विख्यात परम रमणीय तक्षशिला नामक पुरी थी। दीरवर पुष्कर की भी पुष्करावती नाम से विख्यात पुरी राजधानी थी । जो पुराणों के जाननेवाले लोग हैं, वे परम बुद्धिमान राम के विषय में उनके माहात्म्य को प्रकट करनेवाली तत्त्वपूर्ण यज्ञोगाथाएँ गाते हैं ।१८८० १६१। वे ऐसा कहते हैं कि राम दयामलवर्ण के, लाल नेत्रोंव.ले तेज से देदीप्यमान मुखमण्डलवाले एवं मितभाषी युवा थे । उनका मुख परम सुन्दर था, उनकी दोनों बाहुएं
verses.wordMeaning: Out of childishness, or due to the force of the inevit¬ able destiny, Satyavrata nursed a great grudge against Vasistha. While he was crying on being exiled by his father and banished from the kingdom, the sage Vasistha had not restrain-
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of childishness, or due to the force of the inevit¬ able destiny, Satyavrata nursed a great grudge against Vasistha. While he was crying on being exiled by his father and banished from the kingdom, the sage Vasistha had not restrain-

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगान्दिव्यैश्वर्यसमन्वितान् । लभन्ते मानुषं जन्म दुर्लभं भुवि मानवाः
verses.transliteration: tatra bhuktvā mahābhogāndivyaiśvaryasamanvitān / labhante mānuṣaṃ janma durlabhaṃ bhuvi mānavāḥ
verses.translation: The Mantras chanted during the celebration of a marriage are concluded at the seventhstep (of the Saptafiadi rite) but Satyavrata abducted her (the bride ofVidarbha) at the seventh step.
verses.hindi: घुटमों को छुनेवाली थीं सिह के समान उनका विशाल कन्धा था, उनके भुजदण्ड विशाल थे । राम मे दस सहस्न वर्षों तक राज्य किया था । उनके राज्य में चारों ओर ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद एवं सामवेद की सुन्दर मनोहारिणी ध्वनि सुनाई पड़ती थी। उनके धनुष की प्रत्यंचा की ध्वनि परम कठोर थी ।१६२-१६३/ उनके राष्ट्र में किसी को भी किसी प्रकार का कष्ट नहीं था, लोगों में खूब दाव करो, खूब खाओ, पीओ, की धूममची थी। उस राम ने जन स्थान में निवास कर देवताओं का एक परम आवद्यक कार्य सम्पन्न किया था। उन मनुज शिरोमणि महान् यशस्वी राम ने पुलस्त्य मुनि के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले, पापात्मा रावण का संहार सीता को खोौजते समय किया था। वे दशरथ पुत्र राम परम बलशाली, सर्व गुण सम्पन्न, एवं अपने अनृपम तेज से देदीप्यमान थे। सूर्थ एवं अनि को भी उन्होने अपने तेज से अतिक्रान्त कर दिया था। परम प्रभावशाली महाबाहु इक्ष्वाकु
verses.wordMeaning: The Mantras chanted during the celebration of a marriage are concluded at the seventhstep (of the Saptafiadi rite) but Satyavrata abducted her (the bride ofVidarbha) at the seventh step.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Mantras chanted during the celebration of a marriage are concluded at the seventhstep (of the Saptafiadi rite) but Satyavrata abducted her (the bride ofVidarbha) at the seventh step.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कन्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे ऽनरकेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनषष्ट्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्पाण्डुपुत्र मोक्षतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । सेवितं देवगन्धर्वैर्मुनिभिश्च तपोधनैः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskande mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe 'narakeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 160 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchetpāṇḍuputra mokṣatīrthamanuttamam / sevitaṃ devagandharvairmunibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ
verses.translation: Vasistha the knower of Dharmas does not wish to repeat the hantras. So Vasistha was inwardly angry with Satyavrata* (?)
verses.hindi: कुशस्य कोशला राज्य पुरो बाइपि कुशस्थली। रम्या निवेशिता तेन विन्ध्यपर्वंतसानुषु
verses.wordMeaning: Vasistha the knower of Dharmas does not wish to repeat the hantras. So Vasistha was inwardly angry with Satyavrata* (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasistha the knower of Dharmas does not wish to repeat the hantras. So Vasistha was inwardly angry with Satyavrata* (?)

verses.sanskrit: बहवस्तन्न जानन्ति विष्णुमायाविमोहिताः । यत्र सिद्धा महाभागा ऋषयः सतपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: bahavastanna jānanti viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ / yatra siddhā mahābhāgā ṛṣayaḥ satapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: It was because of being fully mindful of his position as preceptor that Vasistha did so then. Nor did Satyavrata understand the secret vow of (the sage).
verses.hindi: उत्तराकोशले राज्यं लवस्य च महात्मन: । श्रावस्ती लोकविख्याता कुशवंश निबोधत ६२०० कुशस्य पुत्रों धर्मात्मा ह्मतिथि: सुश्रिययतिथिं: । अतिथेरपि विख्यातो निषधो नाम पाथिच: क्षेमधन्वसुतो राजा देवानीकः प्रतापवान् । आसीदहीनपुर्नाम देवानीकात्मज: प्रभुः २०३
verses.wordMeaning: It was because of being fully mindful of his position as preceptor that Vasistha did so then. Nor did Satyavrata understand the secret vow of (the sage).
verses.commentary: Sense: It was because of being fully mindful of his position as preceptor that Vasistha did so then. Nor did Satyavrata understand the secret vow of (the sage).

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यः पुलहो विद्वान्क्रतुश्चैव महामतिः । प्राचेतसो वसिष्ठश्च दक्षो नारद एव च
verses.transliteration: pulastyaḥ pulaho vidvānkratuścaiva mahāmatiḥ / prācetaso vasiṣṭhaśca dakṣo nārada eva ca
verses.translation: (Defective verses) When the father of lofty mind passed away, Indra did not shower for twelve years. Thereby all the people on the earth became weak. All these years the son was having Dikfa (i.e. performing holy rites in accordance with his fathers' injunction). Vasistha thought that the people would be saved if he was crowned again. So he restrained Satyavrata from keeping out of the kingdom further.
verses.hindi: औड़ूुते नाम स् धर्मात्मा बलपुत्रो बभूव ह। व्जनाभसुतस्तस्य शब्भूनस्तस्थ चाउचत्मज:.
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verses) When the father of lofty mind passed away, Indra did not shower for twelve years. Thereby all the people on the earth became weak. All these years the son was having Dikfa (i.e. performing holy rites in accordance with his fathers' injunction).…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verses) When the father of lofty mind passed away, Indra did not shower for twelve years. Thereby all the people on the earth became weak. All these years the son was having Dikfa (i.e. performing holy rites in accordance with his fathers' injunction).…

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये महाभागाः सप्तसाहस्रसंज्ञिताः । मोक्षं गताः सह सुतैस्तत्तीर्थं तेन मोक्षदम्
verses.transliteration: ete cānye mahābhāgāḥ saptasāhasrasaṃjñitāḥ / mokṣaṃ gatāḥ saha sutaistattīrthaṃ tena mokṣadam
verses.translation: The powerful (younger king) performed the holy rites for twelve years. When there was no meat avail¬ able, the son of the king saw the cow of the noble-souled Vasi¬ stha, Kamadugha (i.e. the yielder of desired objects). Out of spite, due to delusion and exhaustion and because he was hungry, the foremost among powerful persons who had adopted the practice ofDasyus (robbers and Candalas), killed the cow. He himself ate the meat and fed the sons of Visvamitra also. On hearing it Vasistha abandoned him then. The holy lord Vasistha spoke also thus to the son of the king (i.e. Satyavrata):
verses.hindi: शडद्भुनस्य सुतो विद्वान्ध्युषिताश्व इति श्रुतः। ध्युषिताश्वसुत ख्रपि राजा विश्वलहः किल के कुल को आनन्दित करनेवाले राम परिवार समेत रावण का विनाश कर इसी प्रकार स्वर्ग को चले गये ।१६४-१६७। श्रीराम के पुत्र जो उत्पन्न हुए वे कुश नाम से विख्यात हुए, लब॒ नामक महा बलवान एक पुत्र और था, उन दोनों के देशों को सुनिये । कुश का राज्य कोशला नाम से विख्यात था, उसकी राजघानी कुशस्थली नामक पुरी थी, करुश ने विन्ध्याचल के मनोहर पंत शिखर पर उसकी स्थापना की थीं। महाउलवान्
verses.wordMeaning: The powerful (younger king) performed the holy rites for twelve years. When there was no meat avail¬ able, the son of the king saw the cow of the noble-souled Vasi¬ stha, Kamadugha (i.e. the yielder of desired objects). Out of spite,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful (younger king) performed the holy rites for twelve years. When there was no meat avail¬ able, the son of the king saw the cow of the noble-souled Vasi¬ stha, Kamadugha (i.e. the yielder of desired objects). Out of spite,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र प्रवाहमध्ये तु पतिता तमहा नदी । तत्र तत्सङ्गमं तीर्थं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra pravāhamadhye tu patitā tamahā nadī / tatra tatsaṅgamaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
verses.translation: "O base one among men, had it not been for the fact that you have already three Sahkus (sins), O cruel one, I would have let this iron Sahku (rod) fall on you.
verses.hindi: लव का राज्य उत्तर कोशला के नाम से विख्यात था । उसकी परम विख्यात श्रावस्ती पुरी राजधानी थी । कुझ के बंश को सुनिये ।8६८5-२००।,कुश के पुत्र परम घर्मात्मा अतिथि थे, वे अतिथियों का विशेष सम्मान करते थे । अतिथि के पुत्र परम विख्यात राजा निषध हुए  निषध के पुत्र नल और नल के पुत्र नभ हुए । नभ के पुत्र पृण्डरीक हुए, पुण्डरीक के बाद उनके पुत्र क्षेमधव्वा का स्मरण किया जाता है। क्षेमधन्वा के पुत्र परम बलवान
verses.wordMeaning: "O base one among men, had it not been for the fact that you have already three Sahkus (sins), O cruel one, I would have let this iron Sahku (rod) fall on you.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O base one among men, had it not been for the fact that you have already three Sahkus (sins), O cruel one, I would have let this iron Sahku (rod) fall on you.

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्यजुःसामसंज्ञानाम् अभ्यस्तानां तु यत्फलम् । सम्यग्जप्त्वा तु विधिना गायत्रीं तत्र तल्लभेत्
verses.transliteration: ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñānām abhyastānāṃ tu yatphalam / samyagjaptvā tu vidhinā gāyatrīṃ tatra tallabhet
verses.translation: Your transgression (commission of sins) is of three forms: One because of the dissatisfaction of your father, the other due to the slaughter of the preceptor's cow and (finally) due to the partaking of unsanctified (flesh)
verses.hindi: राजा देवानीक हुए, देवानोक के पुत्र परम प्रभावशाली राजा अहीनगु हुए । अहीनगु के उत्तराधिकारी उनके पुत्र महान् यशस्वी राजा पारिपात्र हुए, उनके पुत्र दल ओर दल के पुत्र राजा बल उत्पन्न हुए। बल के पुत्र परम धर्मात्मा राजा औौद्धू हुए, उन ओड्ू के पुत्र बत्अनाम हुए जिनके पुत्र शद्धेन हुए । शर््धन के परम विद्वान घ्युषिताइव नामक पुत्र सुने जाते हैं । ऐसी प्रसिद्धि है कि राजा ध्युषिताश्व के पुत्र राजा विश्वसह हुए! राजा राजा विश्वसह के पुत्र हिरण्य नाभ कौदाल्य के नाम से विख्यात हुए । उनके पुत्र वह्षिष्ठ हुए। वे ज॑मिनि के पौत्र के शिष्य रूप में प्रसिद्धि हैं, सभी माँगलिक कार्यों में उनकी सिद्धहस्तता प्रसिद्ध थी २०१-२०७। इन्होंने पाँच
verses.wordMeaning: Your transgression (commission of sins) is of three forms: One because of the dissatisfaction of your father, the other due to the slaughter of the preceptor's cow and (finally) due to the partaking of unsanctified (flesh)
verses.commentary: Sense: Your transgression (commission of sins) is of three forms: One because of the dissatisfaction of your father, the other due to the slaughter of the preceptor's cow and (finally) due to the partaking of unsanctified (flesh)

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दत्तं हुतं जप्तं तीर्थसेवार्जितं फलम् । सर्वमक्षयतां याति मोक्षसाधनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ tīrthasevārjitaṃ phalam / sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti mokṣasādhanamuttamam
verses.translation: To Vasistha who was watching, it was very surprising.
verses.hindi: कुशस्य कोशलाराज्यं लवस्य च महात्मन इत्यर्थ घ. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: To Vasistha who was watching, it was very surprising.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Vasistha who was watching, it was very surprising.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे मृतानां तु संन्यासेन द्विजन्मनाम् । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तेषां मोक्षतीर्थप्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu saṃnyāsena dvijanmanām / anivartikā gatisteṣāṃ mokṣatīrthaprabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: By the favour of Visvamitra, Tnsanku shines in heaven with great brilliance in the company of Devas. It is the result of the blessing of that intelligent one. A beautiful woman bedecked by the moon in the season Hemanta proceeds slowly. She is embellished by the three Bhavas and adorned by the heavenly body—a planet (called) TriSanku. Satyarata hailing from the Kekaya family was his wife. She gave birth to a son, HariScandra, the sinless.
verses.hindi: एकोनविशभप्रयुगे क्षत्रप्रावतंकः प्रभु: २१० आसोत्सहस्वतः पुत्रो राजा विश्वुतवानिति । तस्याष्सोद्विभ्ुतवतः पुत्रो राजा बृहद्वलः २१२ एते इक्ष्वाकुदायादा राजानः प्रायशः स्मृता: । वंशे प्रधाना ये तेइस्मिन्प्राधान्येन तु कीतिताः
verses.wordMeaning: By the favour of Visvamitra, Tnsanku shines in heaven with great brilliance in the company of Devas. It is the result of the blessing of that intelligent one. A beautiful woman bedecked by the moon in the season Hemanta proceeds slowly.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By the favour of Visvamitra, Tnsanku shines in heaven with great brilliance in the company of Devas. It is the result of the blessing of that intelligent one. A beautiful woman bedecked by the moon in the season Hemanta proceeds slowly.…

verses.sanskrit: एष ते विधिरुद्दिष्टः संक्षेपेण मयानघ । व्युष्टिस्तीर्थस्य महती पुराणे याभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ saṃkṣepeṇa mayānagha / vyuṣṭistīrthasya mahatī purāṇe yābhidhīyate
verses.translation: That king Hariscmdra was well known as Traisankava (son of Trisanku). He was renowned as an emperor and a performer of Rajasuya sacrifice.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धदेवस्थ देवस्य प्रजानां पुष्टिदस्य च्। विपाप्मा विरजश्नेव आयुष्मान्भवते5च्युत: ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: That king Hariscmdra was well known as Traisankava (son of Trisanku). He was renowned as an emperor and a performer of Rajasuya sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king Hariscmdra was well known as Traisankava (son of Trisanku). He was renowned as an emperor and a performer of Rajasuya sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मोक्षतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षष्ट्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६१ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज सर्पतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धा महासर्पास्तपस्तप्त्वा युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mokṣatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 161 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja sarpatīrthamanuttamam / yatra siddhā mahāsarpāstapastaptvā yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Hari&jandra's son was Rohita, the powerful. Harita, wasRohita's son. Cancu is called Harita (son of Harita).
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्त इक्ष्वाकुवंशानुकीतंन नामाष्टाशीतितमोउध्याय: ॥छ८।॥। सौ संहिताओं का विधिवत् अध्ययन किया था, परम बुद्धिमान् यज्ञावल्क्य ने इन्हीं से योग की साज्ोपाड् दिक्षा प्राप्ति की थी उनके पुत्र परम विद्वान् पुष्य हुए । पुष्य के पुत्र श्र्वसन्धि नाम से विख्यात हुए, उनके पुत्र सुदर्शन हुये, सुदर्शन से अग्निवर्ण की उत्पत्ति हुई। भरिन वर्ण के पुत्र ज्ीध्र नाम से विख्यात हुए, शौध्रक के बुत्र मनु कहे जाते हैं । मनु योग मार्ग का अवलम्ब करके कलाप नामक ग्राम में निवास करते थे, परम ऐश्वर्य-
verses.wordMeaning: Hari&jandra's son was Rohita, the powerful. Harita, wasRohita's son. Cancu is called Harita (son of Harita).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hari&jandra's son was Rohita, the powerful. Harita, wasRohita's son. Cancu is called Harita (son of Harita).

verses.sanskrit: वासुकिस्तक्षको घोरः सार्प ऐरावतस्तथा । कालियश्च महाभागः कर्कोटकधनंजयौ
verses.transliteration: vāsukistakṣako ghoraḥ sārpa airāvatastathā / kāliyaśca mahābhāgaḥ karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau
verses.translation: Vijaya and Sudeva were the sons of Cancu. Since he was the conqueror of all Ksatriyas, he is remembered as Vijaya.
verses.hindi: शाली ये मनु उन्नीसवें युग में क्षत्रिय धर्म के पुनः प्रवरतंक रूप में प्रसिद्ध हुए ।३२०८-२१०। मनु के पुत्र प्रधुश्रत थे उनके पुत्र सुसधि हुए । सुसंधि के मषे नामक पुत्र हुए, जिनका दुसरा नाम सहस्वान भी था। सहस्वान के पुत्र राजा विश्वुतवान् के नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुए । उन राजा विश्वुतवान् के पृत्र राजा वृहद्दल हुए । इक्ष्वाकु के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले प्रायः यही राजागण स्मरण किये जाते हैं, जो इस वंश के प्रमुख राजा थे, उनका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Vijaya and Sudeva were the sons of Cancu. Since he was the conqueror of all Ksatriyas, he is remembered as Vijaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vijaya and Sudeva were the sons of Cancu. Since he was the conqueror of all Ksatriyas, he is remembered as Vijaya.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचूडो महातेजा धृतराष्ट्रो वृकोदरः । कुलिको वामनश्चैव तेषां ये पुत्रपौत्रिणः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacūḍo mahātejā dhṛtarāṣṭro vṛkodaraḥ / kuliko vāmanaścaiva teṣāṃ ye putrapautriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Ruruka was his son. He was a king, a great expert in matters pertaining to religion and wealth. Hrtaka (or Dhrtaka) was the son of Ruruka and Bahu was born of him.
verses.hindi: प्रधान रूप से कर दिया गया है। भदिति के पुत्र विवस्वान् की इस सृष्ठि विवरण का जो भली भाँति पाठ करता है, वह सन्‍्तति वाला होता है तथा विवस्वान् के पुत्र मनु का सान्निध्य प्राप्त करता है। प्रजाओं की पुष्टि देनेवाले श्राद्धों में पुजनीय पितरगण एवं देवगण का वह वृत्तान्त जो पढ़ता है, वह पाप विहीन, रजोगुण' रहित, अविनाशशील एबं दीर्घायु वाला होता है । यदि: अपुत्री है तो उसे पूत्र की प्राप्ति होती है, दीर्घायु मिलती है, और अन्त में परम गति प्राप्ति होती है ।२११-२१५। क्‍
verses.wordMeaning: Ruruka was his son. He was a king, a great expert in matters pertaining to religion and wealth. Hrtaka (or Dhrtaka) was the son of Ruruka and Bahu was born of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ruruka was his son. He was a king, a great expert in matters pertaining to religion and wealth. Hrtaka (or Dhrtaka) was the son of Ruruka and Bahu was born of him.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे महापुण्ये तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुष्करम् । भुञ्जन्ति विविधान्भोगान्क्रीडन्ति च यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe mahāpuṇye tapastaptvā suduṣkaram / bhuñjanti vividhānbhogānkrīḍanti ca yathāsukham
verses.translation: The king (viz. Bahu) who was addicted to vice was
verses.hindi: -नास्त्यधंमिद क. ग. घ. छह. पुस्तकेषु ।
verses.wordMeaning: The king (viz. Bahu) who was addicted to vice was
verses.commentary: Sense: The king (viz. Bahu) who was addicted to vice was

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः । वाजपेयफलं तस्य पुरा प्रोवाच शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / vājapeyaphalaṃ tasya purā provāca śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Even in that righteous Satyayuga that king was not very virtuous. Sagara was born as the son of Bahu. He was bom with a body containing poison in the hermitage of Bhrgu. He was saved by Turva (Aurva).
verses.hindi: लेअस्पव्वस्तम्नन्यव्य॑ ध्वव्की से ्वस्न् अनुजस्य विकुक्षेस्तु निमेबंशं निबोधत । योडइसो निवेशयामास परं देवपुरोपसम् १ जप्रन्तमिति विख्यातं गौतमस्याइश्रमाभितः । यस्यान्ववाये जज्ञे व जनकादषिसत्तमात् २ नेमिर्नाम सुधर्मात्मा सर्वसत्वनमस्कृतः । आसीत्पुत्रों महाराज्ञ इक्ष्वाकोभूरितेजसः:
verses.wordMeaning: Even in that righteous Satyayuga that king was not very virtuous. Sagara was born as the son of Bahu. He was bom with a body containing poison in the hermitage of Bhrgu. He was saved by Turva (Aurva).
verses.commentary: Sense: Even in that righteous Satyayuga that king was not very virtuous. Sagara was born as the son of Bahu. He was bom with a body containing poison in the hermitage of Bhrgu. He was saved by Turva (Aurva).

verses.sanskrit: स्नातानां सर्पतीर्थे तु नराणां भुवि भारत । सर्पवृश्चिकजातिभ्यो न भयं विद्यते क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: snātānāṃ sarpatīrthe tu narāṇāṃ bhuvi bhārata / sarpavṛścikajātibhyo na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit
verses.translation: After obtaining the missile pertaining to Fire-god from Bhargava, the king Sagara went over the whole of the earth and killed Talajanghas along with Haihayas.
verses.hindi: अरण्पां मथ्यमानायां प्रादुभतो महायशा:  नामना सिथिरितिख्यातों जननाज्जनको5भवत् ५
verses.wordMeaning: After obtaining the missile pertaining to Fire-god from Bhargava, the king Sagara went over the whole of the earth and killed Talajanghas along with Haihayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After obtaining the missile pertaining to Fire-god from Bhargava, the king Sagara went over the whole of the earth and killed Talajanghas along with Haihayas.

verses.sanskrit: मृतो भोगवतीं गत्वा पूज्यमानो महोरगैः । नागकन्यापरिवृतो महाभोगपतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mṛto bhogavatīṃ gatvā pūjyamāno mahoragaiḥ / nāgakanyāparivṛto mahābhogapatirbhavet
verses.translation: The unerring king repudiated the Dharma (code of
verses.hindi: + मिथिर्नाम महाबोरयों येनासों सिथिला3भवत् । राजासो जनको नाम जनकाच्चाप्युदावसु: बेवस्वत मनु के बंश का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: The unerring king repudiated the Dharma (code of
verses.commentary: Sense: The unerring king repudiated the Dharma (code of

verses.sanskrit: मार्गशीर्षस्य मासस्य कृष्णपक्षे च याष्टमी । सोपवासः शुचिर्भूत्वा लिङ्गं सम्पूरयेत् तिलैः । यथाविभवसारेण गन्धपुष्पैः समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: mārgaśīrṣasya māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe ca yāṣṭamī / sopavāsaḥ śucirbhūtvā liṅgaṃ sampūrayet tilaiḥ / yathāvibhavasāreṇa gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet
verses.translation: Plow was the king Sagara (Sa-gara) born with poison (inside)? Why did the infuriated unerring.king repudi¬ ate the traditional holy rites of those powerful Ksatriyas such as the Sakas and others?
verses.hindi: सूत बोले--ऋषिव॒न्द  तदनन्तर विकुक्षि के अनुज राजा निमि के वंश का वर्णन सुनिये । इन॑ राजा निमि ने गौतम के आश्रम के चारों ओर जयन्त नामक परम सुन्दर एक पुर की स्थापना की थी, जो देवपुर के समान मनोहर एवं रम्य था । उन्हीं निमि के वंश में ऋषि सत्तम जनक से नेमि नामक परम धर्मात्मा राजा उत्पन्न हुआ, जो सभी द्वारा नमस्करणीय था । ।१-२२। परम तेजस्वी महाराज इक्ष्वाकु से जो पुत्र उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: Plow was the king Sagara (Sa-gara) born with poison (inside)? Why did the infuriated unerring.king repudi¬ ate the traditional holy rites of those powerful Ksatriyas such as the Sakas and others?
verses.commentary: Sense: Plow was the king Sagara (Sa-gara) born with poison (inside)? Why did the infuriated unerring.king repudi¬ ate the traditional holy rites of those powerful Ksatriyas such as the Sakas and others?

verses.sanskrit: एवं विधाय विधिवत्प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् । तस्य यत्फलमुद्दिष्टं तच्छृणुष्व नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vidhāya vidhivatpraṇipatya kṣamāpayet / tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva nareśvara
verses.translation: These five clans, viz. Yavanas, Paradas, Kambojas, Pahlavas, (and Sakas) attacked him.
verses.hindi: हुआ, वह मह॒षि वसिष्ठ के शाप से विदेह (शरीर रहित) हो गया । विदेह के अरणी के तीन पर्बों के मंधन करने द से महान् तेजस्वी मिथि नामक पुत्र हुये, मिथि नाम से ही उनकी खुयाति हुई, इस प्रकार के जनन (उत्पत्ति) होने के कारण उनका जनक नाम भी प्रसिद्ध हुआ  वे मिथि परम बलवान् राजा थे, उन्हीं के नाम पर मिथिला- पुरी की ख्याति हुई  इसी राजा जनक से राजा उदावसु की उत्पत्ति हुई ।३-६। उदावसु से धर्मात्मा राजा नन्दि ८०२ वायुपुराणमभ्
verses.wordMeaning: These five clans, viz. Yavanas, Paradas, Kambojas, Pahlavas, (and Sakas) attacked him.
verses.commentary: Sense: These five clans, viz. Yavanas, Paradas, Kambojas, Pahlavas, (and Sakas) attacked him.

verses.sanskrit: तिलास्तत्र च यत्संख्याः पत्रपुष्पफलानि च । तावत् स्वर्गपुरे राजन्मोदते कालमीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: tilāstatra ca yatsaṃkhyāḥ patrapuṣpaphalāni ca / tāvat svargapure rājanmodate kālamīpsitam
verses.translation: His kingdom was plundered and taken by these powerful leading Ksatriyas. King Bahu whose realm was seized, renounced the world. Accompanied by his wife the righteous- souled king entered the forest and performed penance. After some time the king once went to fetch water. Due to advancing years and weakness he died midway.
verses.hindi: सुकेतो रपि धर्मात्मा देवरातों महाबलः। देवरातस्य धर्मात्मा बृहदुत्थ इति श्रुति: ८
verses.wordMeaning: His kingdom was plundered and taken by these powerful leading Ksatriyas. King Bahu whose realm was seized, renounced the world. Accompanied by his wife the righteous- souled king entered the forest and performed penance. After some time the king once went to fetch water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: His kingdom was plundered and taken by these powerful leading Ksatriyas. King Bahu whose realm was seized, renounced the world. Accompanied by his wife the righteous- souled king entered the forest and performed penance. After some time the king once went to fetch water.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वर्गात्परिभ्रष्टो जायते विमले कुले । सुरूपः सुभगश्चैव धनकोटिपतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svargātparibhraṣṭo jāyate vimale kule / surūpaḥ subhagaścaiva dhanakoṭipatirbhavet
verses.translation: His wife Yadavl who was pregnant then, followed him. Poison had been administered to her by her co-wife with a desire to kill the foetus.
verses.hindi: सुधृतेरपि धर्मात्मा धुष्टकेतु: परंतपः। धुष्टकेतुसुतश्राषि हय॑श्वों नाम विश्वुतः १० हयश्वस्य सरुः पुत्नो मरोः पुत्र: प्रतित्वकः । प्रतित्वकस्य धर्मात्मा राजा कीतिरथः सुतः पुत्र: कीतिरथस्यापि देवमोढ इति श्रुतः। देवभीढस्य विबुधो विद्युधस्थ सुतो धृतिः
verses.wordMeaning: His wife Yadavl who was pregnant then, followed him. Poison had been administered to her by her co-wife with a desire to kill the foetus.
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife Yadavl who was pregnant then, followed him. Poison had been administered to her by her co-wife with a desire to kill the foetus.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सर्पतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकषष्ट्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६२ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: गोपेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् सर्पक्षेत्रादनन्तरम् । यत्र स्नानेन चैकेन मुच्यन्ते पातकैर्नराः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe sarpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 162 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: gopeśvaraṃ tato gacchet sarpakṣetrādanantaram / yatra snānena caikena mucyante pātakairnarāḥ
verses.translation: She prepared the funeral pyre of her husband, got him placed and lit it and was (about) to enter into the fire,
verses.hindi: महाधृतिसुतो राजा कीतिराजः प्रतापवान् । कीतिराज/त्मजो विद्वान्म हारोमेति विश्रुतः १३
verses.wordMeaning: She prepared the funeral pyre of her husband, got him placed and lit it and was (about) to enter into the fire,
verses.commentary: Sense: She prepared the funeral pyre of her husband, got him placed and lit it and was (about) to enter into the fire,

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा कुरुते प्राणसंक्षयम् । स गच्छेद्यदि युक्तो ऽपि पापेन शिवमन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā kurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam / sa gacchedyadi yukto 'pi pāpena śivamandiram
verses.translation: In his urVa.fiministercd) poison. Thus she gave (child) alongh the: | t P
