verses.hindi: कर्य सीता समुत्पन्ना कृष्पणमाणा यशस्विनी । किमर्थ चाकृषद्राजा क्षेत्र यस्मिन्बभूव सा बचश्नंत की उत्पत्ति हुई। नन्दिवधत से वीर एवं धामिक सुकेतु की उत्पत्ति हुई ।७। सुकेतु के भी धर्मात्मा एवं महाबलवान् देवरात उत्पन्न हुए । उन देवरात से धर्मात्मा राजा बुह॒दुत्थ की उत्पत्ति सुनी जाती है । राजा बृहदुत्थ के पुश्न परम प्रतापी महावीय॑ नाम से विख्यात थे, महावीयं के पुत्र धृतिमान् थे, उनके पुत्र सुधृति थे । सुधृति के पुत्र परम तपस्वी एवं धर्मात्मा धृष्ठकेतु थे । धुष्टकेतु के पुत्र हुयंइव भी परम विख्यात राजा थे ।5-६ ०
verses.wordMeaning: In his urVa.fiministercd) poison. Thus she gave (child) alongh the: | t P
verses.commentary: Sense: In his urVa.fiministercd) poison. Thus she gave (child) alongh the: | t P

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेद्देवमीश्वरम् । मुच्यते सर्वपापैश्च रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamīśvaram / mucyate sarvapāpaiśca rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Being harassed and victimised by the heroic and noble-souled Sagara, all of them desirous of protection sought
verses.hindi: हयेदव के पुत्र मह और मर के पृत्र प्रसित्वक हुए । प्रतित्वक के परम धर्मात्मा राजा कीतिरथ थे । राजा कौतिरथ के पुत्र देवमीढ़ नाम से प्रसिद्ध थे। देवमीढ़ के पुत्र विबुध और विबुध के पुत्र धृति हुए 7१-१२! उस राजा महाधति के पुत्र परम प्रतापशाली राजा कीतिराज हुए। कीतिराज के पुत्र परम विद्वान् राजा महारोमा नाम से विष्यात थे । राजा महारोमा के पुत्र स्वर्ण रोमा हुए। स्वर्णरोमा के पुत्र राजा हस्वरोमा हुए। हस्वरोमा के -
verses.wordMeaning: Being harassed and victimised by the heroic and noble-souled Sagara, all of them desirous of protection sought
verses.commentary: Sense: Being harassed and victimised by the heroic and noble-souled Sagara, all of them desirous of protection sought

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडित्वा च यथाकामं रुद्रलोके महातपाः । इह मानुष्यतां प्राप्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: krīḍitvā ca yathākāmaṃ rudraloke mahātapāḥ / iha mānuṣyatāṃ prāpya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: Remembering his own vow and on hearing the words of his preceptor, Sagara put an end to their traditional rites of worship and made them change their dress and apparel. 1
verses.hindi: पुत्र राजा सीरध्वज सुने जाते हैं। उन्‍्हों राजा सीरध्वज के प्रृथ्वी जोतते समय परम यशस्विनी सीता देवी का प्रादुर्भाव हुआ--ऐसी प्रसिद्ध है। वे सीता रामचन्द्र की परम साध्वी पतितन्नरता सदब्नतपरायणा पत्नी शाशपायन बोले--सूत जी ! प्रथ्वी जोतते समय परम यशस्विनी सीता देवी का प्रादुर्भाव किस प्रकार हुआ ? और राजा सीरध्वज किस प्रयोजन वश उस क्षेत्र को जोत रहे थे। जिसमें सीता को उत्पत्ति हुई 7
verses.wordMeaning: Remembering his own vow and on hearing the words of his preceptor, Sagara put an end to their traditional rites of worship and made them change their dress and apparel. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Remembering his own vow and on hearing the words of his preceptor, Sagara put an end to their traditional rites of worship and made them change their dress and apparel. 1

verses.sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पन्नो दासीदाससमन्वितः । पूज्यमानो नरेन्द्रैश्च जीवेद्वर्षशतं सुखी
verses.transliteration: hastyaśvarathasampanno dāsīdāsasamanvitaḥ / pūjyamāno narendraiśca jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sukhī
verses.translation: He got half of the heads of Sakas shaved and released them. He got the heads of Yavanas and Kambojas comp¬
verses.hindi: सीरध्वजात्तु जातस्तु भानुमान्नाम मैथिलः । भ्राता कुशध्वजस्तस्य स काश्याघिपतिन् पः १८ तस्य भानुमतः पुत्र: प्रद्युम्नश्व॒ प्रतापवान् । मुनिस्तस्य सुतश्चाषि तस्मादूर्जवहः स्मृतः ११९
verses.wordMeaning: He got half of the heads of Sakas shaved and released them. He got the heads of Yavanas and Kambojas comp¬
verses.commentary: Sense: He got half of the heads of Sakas shaved and released them. He got the heads of Yavanas and Kambojas comp¬

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे गोपेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विषष्ट्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज नागतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । आश्विनस्य सिते पक्षे पञ्चम्यां नियतः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gopeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 163 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja nāgatīrthamanuttamam / āśvinasya site pakṣe pañcamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: Paradas were compelled to keep their hair dis¬ hevelled and Pahlavas were made to grow their beards. They were debarred from Vedic study and the use of Va$afkara by that noble-souled king.
verses.hindi: ध॒तेस्तु बहुलाश्वो5भुद्बहुलाश्वसुतः कृति: । तस्मिन्संतिष्ठते बंशो जनकानां महात्मनाम् ॥। इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्‍्ते मैथिलवंशानुकीतंन॑ नाम नवाशीतितमोः5्ध्याय: ॥छछे॥
verses.wordMeaning: Paradas were compelled to keep their hair dis¬ hevelled and Pahlavas were made to grow their beards. They were debarred from Vedic study and the use of Va$afkara by that noble-souled king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Paradas were compelled to keep their hair dis¬ hevelled and Pahlavas were made to grow their beards. They were debarred from Vedic study and the use of Va$afkara by that noble-souled king.

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा गन्धधूपनिवेदनैः । प्रभाते विमले स्नात्वा श्राद्धं कृत्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā gandhadhūpanivedanaiḥ / prabhāte vimale snātvā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Sakas, Yavanas, Kambojas, Pahlavas, Paradas, Kelisparsas, Mahisikas, Darvas, Colas and Khasas—all these were clans of Ksatriyas. Their traditional religious rites were prohibited by the noble-souled Sagara at the instance of Vasi$tha.
verses.hindi: सूत ने कद्दा-- 'अव्वमेध यज्ञ के अवसर पर महाराज सीरध्वज ने विधिपूवंक जिस अग्निक्षेत्र का कथंण किया, उसी से सीता का जन्म हुआ । उस राजा सीरध्वज से भानुमान् का जन्म हुआ, जो मैथिल नाम से विख्यात था। उसका भाई कुशध्वज था, जो काशी का राजा हुआ। उस राजा भानुमान् का पुत्र प्रतापशाली प्रद्यम्त हुआ, उसका पुक्र मुनि था, घुनि से ऊजंवह की उत्पत्ति कही जाती है ।!७-१६। ऊर्जेवह
verses.wordMeaning: Sakas, Yavanas, Kambojas, Pahlavas, Paradas, Kelisparsas, Mahisikas, Darvas, Colas and Khasas—all these were clans of Ksatriyas. Their traditional religious rites were prohibited by the noble-souled Sagara at the instance of Vasi$tha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sakas, Yavanas, Kambojas, Pahlavas, Paradas, Kelisparsas, Mahisikas, Darvas, Colas and Khasas—all these were clans of Ksatriyas. Their traditional religious rites were prohibited by the noble-souled Sagara at the instance of Vasi$tha.

verses.sanskrit: मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा । तत्र तीर्थे तु यो राजन्प्राणत्यागं करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā / tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanprāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyati
verses.translation: Conducting his conquests righteously, the king con¬ quered the earth and took initiation for the performance of a horse-sacrifice. He let loose the horse.
verses.hindi: से सृतद्वाज की उत्पत्ति हुई, उसका पुत्र शकुनि हुआ, उस शकुति का पुत्र स्वागत हुआ, जिसका पुत्र सुवर्चा कहा जाता है। सुवर्चा का पुत्र श्रुत और श्रुत का पुत्र सुशुल हुआ ॥ सुश्रुत का पुत्र जय और जय का पुत्र विजय हुआ ।२०-३१। विजय का पुत्र ऋत और ऋत का पुत्र युनय कहा जाता है, सुनय से वीतह॒ब्य की उत्पत्ति हुई, वीतह॒व्य का पुत्र धति हुआ  धृति का पुत्र बहुलाइव हुआ, बहुलाश्व का पुत्र कृति हुआ । इसी राजा कृति तक महान प्रतापी जनक नाम धारी राजाओं का वंश प्रतिष्ठित माना जाता है। मैथिल नामधारी राजाओं का वर्णन किया जा चुका अब चल्द्रमा के वंश का भी वर्णन सुनिये ।
verses.wordMeaning: Conducting his conquests righteously, the king con¬ quered the earth and took initiation for the performance of a horse-sacrifice. He let loose the horse.
verses.commentary: Sense: Conducting his conquests righteously, the king con¬ quered the earth and took initiation for the performance of a horse-sacrifice. He let loose the horse.

verses.sanskrit: अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य प्रोवाचेति शिवः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: anivartikā gatistasya provāceti śivaḥ svayam
verses.translation: As it was being taken round, it was stolen near the shore of the south-eastern sea and made to enter beneath the earth.
verses.hindi: पिता सोमस्य बे विपध्रा जज्ञेइत्रिर्भगवानूषिः । तत्रात्रि: सर्वेलोकानां तस्थो स्वेनमये धृतः
verses.wordMeaning: As it was being taken round, it was stolen near the shore of the south-eastern sea and made to enter beneath the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: As it was being taken round, it was stolen near the shore of the south-eastern sea and made to enter beneath the earth.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नागतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिषष्ट्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महाराज सांवौरं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । यत्र संनिहितो भानुः पूज्यमानः सुरासुरैः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nāgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 164 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahārāja sāṃvauraṃ tīrthamuttamam / yatra saṃnihito bhānuḥ pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: The king made all his sons to dig the whole area. Then ultimately, in the great ocean, they met with the primordial Being, Lord Visnu, Lord Hari, K r sna, the Lord of subjects, Lord Hamsa, Lord Narayana, in the form of Kapila.
verses.hindi: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा शुभान्येव समाचरन् । काष्ठकुड्यूशिलाभूत ऊध्वेसाहुमहाद्युतिः २ त॑ गर्भ विधिना55दिष्टा' दश देव्यों द्धुस्तदा । समेत्य धारयामासुनेंच तास्तमशकतुवन् ६ स् ताम्यः सहसंवाथ दिग्म्यो गर्भ: प्रभान्वित:। यथाइवभासयल्लेॉकान्शोतांशुः सर्वभावनः ७
verses.wordMeaning: The king made all his sons to dig the whole area. Then ultimately, in the great ocean, they met with the primordial Being, Lord Visnu, Lord Hari, K r sna, the Lord of subjects, Lord Hamsa, Lord Narayana, in the form of Kapila.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king made all his sons to dig the whole area. Then ultimately, in the great ocean, they met with the primordial Being, Lord Visnu, Lord Hari, K r sna, the Lord of subjects, Lord Hamsa, Lord Narayana, in the form of Kapila.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ये पङ्गुतां प्राप्ताः शीर्णघ्राणनखा नराः । दद्रुमण्डलभिन्नाङ्गा मक्षिकाकृमिसंकुलाः
verses.transliteration: tatra ye paṅgutāṃ prāptāḥ śīrṇaghrāṇanakhā narāḥ / dadrumaṇḍalabhinnāṅgā makṣikākṛmisaṃkulāḥ
verses.translation: They came within the range of the vision of that brilliant being. Then all those sons (ofSagara) were burnt and four of them survived.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमा का जन्म वृतान्त
verses.wordMeaning: They came within the range of the vision of that brilliant being. Then all those sons (ofSagara) were burnt and four of them survived.
verses.commentary: Sense: They came within the range of the vision of that brilliant being. Then all those sons (ofSagara) were burnt and four of them survived.

verses.sanskrit: मातापितृभ्यां रहिता भ्रातृभार्याविवर्जिताः । अनाथा विकला व्यङ्गा मग्ना ये दुःखसागरे
verses.transliteration: mātāpitṛbhyāṃ rahitā bhrātṛbhāryāvivarjitāḥ / anāthā vikalā vyaṅgā magnā ye duḥkhasāgare
verses.translation: They were Barhiketu, Suketu, Dharmarata and the heroic Pancavana. All these continued the lineage of the lord (Sagara).
verses.hindi: सूत बोले--' ऋषि व॒न्द ! चन्द्रमा के पिता परम तेजस्वी एवं ऐश्वर्यव्ाली अत्रि ऋषि थे । वे समस्त लोकों के कल्याणार्थ तपस्या में निरित रहते थे ।0' मनसा, वाचा, कमंणा स्वंदा शुभ कार्यों में ही वे तत्पर रहा करते ये। काष्ठ, भीत अथवा पत्थर की चट्टान की भाँति परम तेजस्वी वे महर्षि सबंदा ऊपर बाहु किये हुए ऐसी तपस्या में--जिसका नाम हौ दुश्चर था--निरत थे। ऐसा हम लोगों ने सुना है कि उस वठोर तपस्या में महर्षि अत्रि देवताओं के तीन सहस्न वर्ष तक लगे रहे ।२-३॥ परम ब्रह्मचारी ऊध्वरेता महर्षि अति ने इतनी लम्बी अवधि तक पलक मारने की इच्छा नहीं की, अर्थात् निर्निमेष तपस्या में लगे ही रहे । इस परम कठोर तप के प्रभाव से डिजबये महाबुद्धिमान् अत्रि का शरीर चन्द्रमा की भाँति निर्मेल हो गया । आत्मा को वश में करनेवाले उन भगवान अतन्रि के सोमत्व ने ऊध्वं देश पर आक्रमण किया, अर्थात् उनके
verses.wordMeaning: They were Barhiketu, Suketu, Dharmarata and the heroic Pancavana. All these continued the lineage of the lord (Sagara).
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Barhiketu, Suketu, Dharmarata and the heroic Pancavana. All these continued the lineage of the lord (Sagara).

verses.sanskrit: तेषां नाथो जगद्योनिर्नर्मदातटमाश्रितः । सांवौरनाथो लोकानामार्तिहा दुःखनाशनः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ nātho jagadyonirnarmadātaṭamāśritaḥ / sāṃvauranātho lokānāmārtihā duḥkhanāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Hari, Narayana granted him boons such as the everlasting nature of his race, the benefit of a hundred horse-sacrifices, the all-pervading Samudra (ocean) as the son and perpetual residence in heaven.
verses.hindi: शिरोभाग की अतीव कान्ति बढ़ गई, ठीक उसी समय दसों दिशाओं को प्रकाशित करते हुए, उनके दोनों नेत्रों से सोम नीचे चू पड़ा ।४-५! ब्रह्मा के आदेशानुसार उस गर्भ को दसों देवियों (दिशाओं) ने धारण कर लिया, किन्तु एक साथ मिलकर धारण करने पर भी वे उस गर्भ को धारण करने में असमर्थ हो गई । परम तेजोमय
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Hari, Narayana granted him boons such as the everlasting nature of his race, the benefit of a hundred horse-sacrifices, the all-pervading Samudra (ocean) as the son and perpetual residence in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Hari, Narayana granted him boons such as the everlasting nature of his race, the benefit of a hundred horse-sacrifices, the all-pervading Samudra (ocean) as the son and perpetual residence in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा मासमेकं निरन्तरम् । पूजयेद् भास्करं देवं तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā māsamekaṃ nirantaram / pūjayed bhāskaraṃ devaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Taking the horse with him, the ocean, the lord of rivers, came there and bowed to him. On account of that action he earned the title of "Sagara" (born ofSagara).
verses.hindi: पतन्‍्तं सो ममालोक्य ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । रथमारोपयामास लोकानां हितकाम्यया ३६ स॒ हि देवमयो विप्रा धर्मारथों सत्यसंगरः । युक्तो वाजिसहस्नेण सितेनेति हि नः श्रुतम् १० तस्मिन्निपतिते देवा: पुत्रेउत्रे: परमात्मनि। तुष्दुवुब्नंह्मणः पुत्रा मानसाः सप्त विश्वुताः ११ ततः संस्तृयमानस्य तेज: सोमस्य भास्वतः । आप्यायसान लोकांस्त्रीन्‍्भावयासास सर्वशः
verses.wordMeaning: Taking the horse with him, the ocean, the lord of rivers, came there and bowed to him. On account of that action he earned the title of "Sagara" (born ofSagara).
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking the horse with him, the ocean, the lord of rivers, came there and bowed to him. On account of that action he earned the title of "Sagara" (born ofSagara).

verses.sanskrit: यत्फलं चोत्तरे पार्थ तथा वै पूर्वसागरे । दक्षिणे पश्चिमे स्नात्वा तत्र तीर्थे तु तत् फलम्
verses.transliteration: yatphalaṃ cottare pārtha tathā vai pūrvasāgare / dakṣiṇe paścime snātvā tatra tīrthe tu tat phalam
verses.translation: After regaining the horse from the ocean the king performed horse-sacrifices again and again making up the total of one hundred.
verses.hindi: स तेन रथमुख्येन सागरान्‍्तां वसुंधराम्। त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो विपुलशभ्रकाराभिप्रदक्षिणम् १४
verses.wordMeaning: After regaining the horse from the ocean the king performed horse-sacrifices again and again making up the total of one hundred.
verses.commentary: Sense: After regaining the horse from the ocean the king performed horse-sacrifices again and again making up the total of one hundred.

verses.sanskrit: कौमारे यौवने पापं वार्द्धके यच्च संचितम् । तत् प्रणश्यति सांवौरे स्नानमात्रान्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: kaumāre yauvane pāpaṃ vārddhake yacca saṃcitam / tat praṇaśyati sāṃvaure snānamātrānna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: We have heard (it reported) that there were sixty thousand sons. Those sixty thousand sons were burnt. Those noble-souled sixty thousand sons entered (merged in) the divine brilliance of Narayana.
verses.hindi: ताभिर्धायत्ययं लोकान्प्रजाश्रापि चतुविधाः  पोष्टा हि भगवान्सोमो जगतो हि द्विजोत्तमाः स लब्धतेजास्तपसा संस्तवेस्तेश्व कर्मभिः । तपस्तेपे महाभागः पद्चानां दशतोदंश ६१७
verses.wordMeaning: We have heard (it reported) that there were sixty thousand sons. Those sixty thousand sons were burnt. Those noble-souled sixty thousand sons entered (merged in) the divine brilliance of Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: We have heard (it reported) that there were sixty thousand sons. Those sixty thousand sons were burnt. Those noble-souled sixty thousand sons entered (merged in) the divine brilliance of Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: न व्याधिर्नैव दारिद्र्यं न चैवेष्टवियोजनम् । सप्तजन्मानि राजेन्द्र सांवौरपरिसेवनात्
verses.transliteration: na vyādhirnaiva dāridryaṃ na caiveṣṭaviyojanam / saptajanmāni rājendra sāṃvauraparisevanāt
verses.translation: By what means did the sixty thousand sons of Sagara become powerful and valorous? Please narrate.
verses.hindi: वह गर्भ चब थोड़ी देर के लिए भी दिशाओं द्वारा घारण नहीं किया जा सका, और वे सब स्त्रियाँ अशक्त हो गईं, तब समस्त लोकों का मनोभावन, शीतल किरणोंवाला वह गर्भ उनके उदर से निकलकर सभस्‍्त लोकों को प्रकाशमय करता हुआ प्रृथ्वी पर गिर पड़ा । लोक पितामह बहा जी ने इस प्रकार गिरते हुए सोम को लोक फल्याणाथ अपने रथ पर बिठा लिया ।६-६। विप्रगण ! धह चन्द्रमा दिव्यगुण सम्पन्न हैं, धर्माथ में निरत रहने
verses.wordMeaning: By what means did the sixty thousand sons of Sagara become powerful and valorous? Please narrate.
verses.commentary: Sense: By what means did the sixty thousand sons of Sagara become powerful and valorous? Please narrate.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तम्यामुपवासेन तद्दिने चाप्युपोषिते । स तत्फलमवाप्नोति तत्र स्नात्वा न संशयः
verses.transliteration: saptamyāmupavāsena taddine cāpyupoṣite / sa tatphalamavāpnoti tatra snātvā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Sagara had two wives. By means of penance they had burnt all their sins. The elder of them named Ke$Ini was the daughter of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: वाले एवं सत्यप्रतिज्ञ हैं, हमने ऐसा सुना है कि वे एक सहल इवेत घोड़ों के रथ पर विराजमान रहते हैं। अत्रि के पुत्र, परम तेजोमय चन्द्रमा के इस प्रकार पृथ्वी पर गिरने पर देवताओं एवं ब्रह्मा के परम विख्यात सातों मानस पत्रों ने उनकी स्तुति की । अंगिरा एवं भृगु के पुत्रों ने ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद, अथवेवेद एवं आंगिरस के मंत्रों से उनकी विधिवत स्त॒ति की ।१०-१२। इन सबों से स्तुति किये जाते हुए परम तेजस्वी चन्द्रमा के तैज ने तीनों लोकों को सन्तृष्ट कर दिया, सब को अपने शान्त स्निग्ध प्रकाश से सुप्रसन्न कर दिया। महान् चरद्रमा ने उस समय ब्रह्मा जी के उस रथ पर विराजमान होकर सागर पयेन्‍्त विस्तृत पृथ्वी की इक्कीस बार प्रदक्षिणा की ।१३-१४। चर्द्रमा का जो तेज प्रथ्वी पर गिर पडा था, वह ओषधियों के रूप में परिगत हो गया, आज भी वे ओषधियाँ चद्ध मा के तेज से जाज्वल्यमान रहती हैं। चन्द्रमा उन्हों ओषधियों द्वारा समस्त लोकों एवं चार
verses.wordMeaning: Sagara had two wives. By means of penance they had burnt all their sins. The elder of them named Ke$Ini was the daughter of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sagara had two wives. By means of penance they had burnt all their sins. The elder of them named Ke$Ini was the daughter of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तचन्दनमिश्रेण यदर्घ्येण फलं स्मृतम् । तत्र तीर्थे नृपश्रेष्ठ स्नात्वा तत्फलमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: raktacandanamiśreṇa yadarghyeṇa phalaṃ smṛtam / tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha snātvā tatphalamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Sumati, the sister of Suparna, accepted the boon of sixty thousand sons from the noble-souled sage, in accordance
verses.hindi: प्रकार की प्रजाओं का पालन करता है, द्विजवर्यंगण ! इस समस्त चराचर जगत् के पुष्टि देनेवाले परम ऐश्वर्य - शाली भगवान् चन्द्रमा ही एकमात्र हैं। अत्रि के उस परम तपोबल से, देवताओं और ऋषियों की स्तुतियों से तथा अपने शुभ कर्मों द्वारा परम तेजोबल प्राप्त कर महाभाग्यशाली चन्द्रमा दद पद्म वर्षों तक घोर तपस्या में लगे रहे ।१४-१७। सुवर्ण के समान शुभ्र वर्णोवाली जो देवियाँ अपने में इस समस्त चराचर जगतु को धारण करती
verses.wordMeaning: Sumati, the sister of Suparna, accepted the boon of sixty thousand sons from the noble-souled sage, in accordance
verses.commentary: Sense: Sumati, the sister of Suparna, accepted the boon of sixty thousand sons from the noble-souled sage, in accordance

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदासलिलं रम्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् । निरीक्षितं विशेषेण सांवौरेण महात्मना
verses.transliteration: narmadāsalilaṃ ramyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam / nirīkṣitaṃ viśeṣeṇa sāṃvaureṇa mahātmanā
verses.translation: After some time the elder wife gave birth to the
verses.hindi: हिरण्यवर्मा या देव्यों धारयन्त्यात्मना। जगत् । विभुस्तासां भवेत्सोमः प्रख्यात: स्वेन कर्मणा ततस्तस्म ददो राज्य ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वर: । बीजौषधिषु विप्राणामपां च द्विजसत्तसा: १६ सो5भिषिक्तो महातेजा महाराज्येब राजराद्  लोकानां भावयामास स्वभावाश्रपतां बरः.
verses.wordMeaning: After some time the elder wife gave birth to the
verses.commentary: Sense: After some time the elder wife gave birth to the

verses.sanskrit: ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस् तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् । स्नात्वा पश्यन्ति देवेशं सांवौरेश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: te dhanyāste mahātmānas teṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / snātvā paśyanti deveśaṃ sāṃvaureśvaramuttamam
verses.translation: Sumati, the famous lady, gave birth to a gourd-like foetus. From the gourd-like foetus all the sixty thousand sons came out. The king caused (pieces of) the foetus to be depo¬ sited in (sixty thousand) jars of ghee and engaged as many nurses to look after them individually.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भश्वोद्गाता बहा ब्रह्मत्वमेयिवान् । सदस्यस्तत्र भगवान्हरिनाॉरायणः प्रभुः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Sumati, the famous lady, gave birth to a gourd-like foetus. From the gourd-like foetus all the sixty thousand sons came out. The king caused (pieces of) the foetus to be depo¬ sited in (sixty thousand) jars of ghee and engaged as many nurses to look after them individually.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sumati, the famous lady, gave birth to a gourd-like foetus. From the gourd-like foetus all the sixty thousand sons came out. The king caused (pieces of) the foetus to be depo¬ sited in (sixty thousand) jars of ghee and engaged as many nurses to look after them individually.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यलोके वसेत् तावद् यावद् आभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: sūryaloke vaset tāvad yāvad ābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: Then, In the course of nine months, they grew well and came out of them (jars) hale and hearty; those blessed sons heightened the pleasure of Sagara.
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमारप्रमुख राह्ब्रह्म पिभिव तः दक्षिणामददात्सोमस्त्रील्लॉकानिति नः श्रुतम् । तेम्यो ब्रह्मधिमुख्येम्यः सदस्येस्पस्तु वे द्विजा:
verses.wordMeaning: Then, In the course of nine months, they grew well and came out of them (jars) hale and hearty; those blessed sons heightened the pleasure of Sagara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, In the course of nine months, they grew well and came out of them (jars) hale and hearty; those blessed sons heightened the pleasure of Sagara.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सांवौरेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुःषष्ट्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले सिद्धेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् । तीर्थं परं महाराज सिद्धैः कृतमिति प्रभो
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe sāṃvaureśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 165 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle siddheśvaramiti śrutam / tīrthaṃ paraṃ mahārāja siddhaiḥ kṛtamiti prabho
verses.translation: After a long time those sixty thousand sons (of Sagara) attained youth. Of those who (later) (closely) followed the horse (of Asvamedha) the eldest son of Sagara was a tiger among men. The powerful one was famous as Asamanja, otherwise known as Barhiketu.
verses.hindi: त॑ सिनी च कुहश्चव वपुः पुष्टि: प्रभा दसु:। कीतिध तिश्व लक्ष्मीथ्र नव देव्यः सिषेविरे
verses.wordMeaning: After a long time those sixty thousand sons (of Sagara) attained youth. Of those who (later) (closely) followed the horse (of Asvamedha) the eldest son of Sagara was a tiger among men. The powerful one was famous as Asamanja, otherwise known as Barhiketu.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a long time those sixty thousand sons (of Sagara) attained youth. Of those who (later) (closely) followed the horse (of Asvamedha) the eldest son of Sagara was a tiger among men. The powerful one was famous as Asamanja, otherwise known as Barhiketu.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थं महापुण्यं सर्वतीर्थेषु पावनम् । नर्मदाया महाराज दक्षिणं कूलमाश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu pāvanam / narmadāyā mahārāja dakṣiṇaṃ kūlamāśritam
verses.translation: Since he was engaged in activities against the interest of the citizens, he was banished by his father at the very outset. The son of Asamanja was the powerful Amsuman.
verses.hindi: प्राप्यावभूथमव्यग्र: सर्वदेवर्धिपुजित: । अतिराजातिराजेरखोो दशधाइतापयहिशः २६ तंदा तत्प्राप्य दुष्पापमंश्वयंम्षिसंस्तुतम् । स विश्वसमतिविश्रा विनयोउविनयाहतः हैं, उन्हीं के गर्भ से परम तेजस्वी एवं सर्वेसमर्थ चन्द्रमा की उत्पत्ति हुई और वे अपने कर्मों द्वारा प्रख्यात हुए । ऋषिवन्द ! तदनन्तर ब्रह्मतानियों में श्रेष्ठ भगवान् ब्रद्मा ने चन्द्रमा को समस्त बीजों, ओषधियों, ब्राह्मणों एवं जल जगत् का राज्यभार समर्पित किया । इस महान् दायित्वपूर्ण राज्य पद पर प्रतिष्ठित होने पर चन्द्रमा का प्रताप बहुत अधिक बढ़ गया, तपस्वियों में अग्रगण्य चन्द्रमा ने इस पद पर प्रतिष्ठित होकर अपने सुन्दर
verses.wordMeaning: Since he was engaged in activities against the interest of the citizens, he was banished by his father at the very outset. The son of Asamanja was the powerful Amsuman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since he was engaged in activities against the interest of the citizens, he was banished by his father at the very outset. The son of Asamanja was the powerful Amsuman.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः । श्राद्धं तत्रैव यो दद्यात् पित्ःन् उद्दिश्य भारत
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yo dadyāt pitḥn uddiśya bhārata
verses.translation: His son was a virtuous soul. He was well-known by the name of Dilipa. From Dillpa was born Bhagiratha, a hero of great splendour.
verses.hindi: स्वभाव से समस्त लोक को परम सन्तुष्ट रखा। प्रचेता के पुत्र दक्ष ने दाक्षायणी के गर्भ से उत्पन्न, परम तपो ब्रत पालनेवाली सत्ताईस कन्याएँ चन्द्रमा को समपित कीं, जिन्हें लोग नक्षत्र नाम से जानते हैं ।१८-२१। ब्राह्मणों के स्वामी चन्द्रमा ने इत बड़े राज्याधिकार की प्राप्ति के बाद एक विराद् राजसूय यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान किया, जिसमें लाखों की दक्षिणा प्रदात की। उस विशाल राजसूय यज्ञ में भगवान् हिरण्यगर्भ उदगाता के पद
verses.wordMeaning: His son was a virtuous soul. He was well-known by the name of Dilipa. From Dillpa was born Bhagiratha, a hero of great splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was a virtuous soul. He was well-known by the name of Dilipa. From Dillpa was born Bhagiratha, a hero of great splendour.

verses.sanskrit: तृप्यन्ति पितरस्तस्य द्वादशाब्दान्न संशयः । तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या स्नात्वा पूजयते शिवम्
verses.transliteration: tṛpyanti pitarastasya dvādaśābdānna saṃśayaḥ / tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā snātvā pūjayate śivam
verses.translation: Ganga, the most excellent of rivers, rendered beauti¬ ful with aerial chariots, was (brought here in this world) by him. She was given the status of a daughter by the (king), the
verses.hindi: पर ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मा के पद पर नारायण विष्णु सदस्य के स्थान पर, सनत्कुमार प्रभृति आद्य मह्षियों समेत विराजमान थे। द्विजवयंवन्द ! उस यज्ञ में चन्द्रमा ने उन प्रमुख ब्रह्मधियों को तथा जो सदस्य बने हुए थे उन्हें दक्षिण रूप में तीनों लोकों को समपित कर दिया--ऐसा हमने सुना है ।२३-३४ उस चन्द्रमा की सिनी कुह, वपु, पृष्टि, प्रभा, वसु, कौति, धृति तथा लक्ष्मी ये नवों देवियाँ सेवा कर रही थीं। उस राजसूय यज्ञ का अवभृथ स्तान कर चुकने के उपरास्त सभी देवताओं और ऋषियों से सत्कार प्राप्त कर चन्द्रमा जब निश्चित हो गये, तब अपने विशाल साम्राज्य के सिहासन पर समासीन होकर, राजाधिराज बनकर दसों दिशाओं को दस प्रकार से तपाने लगे ।२५-३६। विश्रव॒न्द ! ऋषि लोग जिसकी स्तुति करते थे --ऐसे दुष्प्राप्प ऐश्वरयं की प्राप्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Ganga, the most excellent of rivers, rendered beauti¬ ful with aerial chariots, was (brought here in this world) by him. She was given the status of a daughter by the (king), the
verses.commentary: Sense: Ganga, the most excellent of rivers, rendered beauti¬ ful with aerial chariots, was (brought here in this world) by him. She was given the status of a daughter by the (king), the

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा पठेत्पौराणिकीं कथाम् । ततः प्रभाते विमले स्नानं कुर्याद्यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā paṭhetpaurāṇikīṃ kathām / tataḥ prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi
verses.translation: "Bhaglratha brought down Ganga by means of his active endeavour. Hence Ganga is called Bhaglrathl by those who are the foremost ones among those conversant with genealogies (of kings)."
verses.hindi: स याचमानो देवेश्व तथा देवषिभिश्व हू । नेव व्यसर्जयत्तारां तसस्‍्मायाजिरसे तदा (१२६
verses.wordMeaning: "Bhaglratha brought down Ganga by means of his active endeavour. Hence Ganga is called Bhaglrathl by those who are the foremost ones among those conversant with genealogies (of kings)."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Bhaglratha brought down Ganga by means of his active endeavour. Hence Ganga is called Bhaglrathl by those who are the foremost ones among those conversant with genealogies (of kings)."

verses.sanskrit: वीक्षते गिरिजाकान्तं स गच्छेत् परमां गतिम् । पुरा सिद्धा महाभागाः कपिलाद्या महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: vīkṣate girijākāntaṃ sa gacchet paramāṃ gatim / purā siddhā mahābhāgāḥ kapilādyā maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Bhaglratha s son was Sruta by name. His successor was Nabhaga. He was always engaged in religious activities.
verses.hindi: तेन स्नेहेन भगवानरद्वस्तस्य बृहस्पते: । पारष्णिग्राहो5भवदेबः प्रगुह्मा55जगवं धनुः ३१ तेन ब्रह्मपिमुस्येम्यः परमास्त्र महात्मना । उद्दिश्य देवानुत्सुष्टं येनेषां नाशितं यशः ३२ तत्र तदयुद्धमभवत्प्रत्यक्षं तारकामयम् । देवानां दानवानां च लोकक्षयकरं महत् ३ ३ तत्न शिष्टास्त्रयों देवास्तुषिताश्वेव ये स्मृताः.। ब्रह्मा शरण जग्सुरादिदेव॑ पितामहम् ३३४ ततो निवार्योशनसं रुद्रं ज्येष्ठ च शंक्रम् । ददावाड्िरसे तारां स्वयमेव पितामहः ३४५ अस्तवंत्नी च तां दृष्टूवा तारां ताराधिपाननाम् । गर्भमुत्सूजसे न त्वं विप्रः प्राह बृहस्पति:
verses.wordMeaning: Bhaglratha s son was Sruta by name. His successor was Nabhaga. He was always engaged in religious activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhaglratha s son was Sruta by name. His successor was Nabhaga. He was always engaged in religious activities.

verses.sanskrit: जपन्तश्च परं ब्रह्म योगसिद्धा महाव्रताः । सिद्धिं ते परमां प्राप्ता नर्मदायाः प्रभावतः
verses.transliteration: japantaśca paraṃ brahma yogasiddhā mahāvratāḥ / siddhiṃ te paramāṃ prāptā narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: Ambarisa was his son. Sindhudvlpa succeeded him. It is well-known that the knowers of the Purana of genealogies sing thus:

verses.wordMeaning: Ambarisa was his son. Sindhudvlpa succeeded him. It is well-known that the knowers of the Purana of genealogies sing thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: Ambarisa was his son. Sindhudvlpa succeeded him. It is well-known that the knowers of the Purana of genealogies sing thus:

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सिद्धेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चषष्ट्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६६ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततः सिद्धेश्वरी देवी वैष्णवी पापनाशिनी । आनन्दं परमं प्राप्ता दृष्ट्वा स्थानं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe siddheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 166 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ siddheśvarī devī vaiṣṇavī pāpanāśinī / ānandaṃ paramaṃ prāptā dṛṣṭvā sthānaṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: "Protected by the arms of Ambarisa, son of Nabhaga, the earth became completely free from three types of Tapa (distress)".
verses.hindi: ईषिकास्तम्ब मासाद्य ज्वलन्तभिव पावकम् । जातमात्रो5थ भगवान्देवानासाक्षिपद्॒पुः ...  ्॒पापहपफहझईछ।/क/इफइफ्पौूूः
verses.wordMeaning: "Protected by the arms of Ambarisa, son of Nabhaga, the earth became completely free from three types of Tapa (distress)".
verses.commentary: Sense: "Protected by the arms of Ambarisa, son of Nabhaga, the earth became completely free from three types of Tapa (distress)".

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् पितृदेवताः । देवीं पश्यति यो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayet pitṛdevatāḥ / devīṃ paśyati yo bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Ayutayu, the powerful, was the son of Sindhudvlpa. Rtuparna of great fame was the successor of Ayutayu.
verses.hindi: कर लेने के बाद चन्द्रमा की मति भ्रान्त हो गई, उसके विनय पर अविनय ने अधिकार कर लिया (अर्थात् वह बड़ा कठोर एवं दम्भी हो गया) । बृहस्पति की तारा नामक पत्नी को जिनकी बड़ी (ख्ययाति) थी, वह अंगिरा के समस्त पुत्रों की कोई परवाह कर, हर ले गया ।३७-२५॥। देवताओं और देवियों के याचना करने पर भी वह तारा को लौटाने को राजी नहीं हुआ । इस प्रकार किसी प्रकार भी उसने बृहस्पति को तारा के लौटाने का
verses.wordMeaning: Ayutayu, the powerful, was the son of Sindhudvlpa. Rtuparna of great fame was the successor of Ayutayu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ayutayu, the powerful, was the son of Sindhudvlpa. Rtuparna of great fame was the successor of Ayutayu.

verses.sanskrit: मृतवत्सा तु या नारी वन्ध्या स्त्रीजननी तथा । पुत्रं सा लभते नारी शीलवन्तं गुणान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: mṛtavatsā tu yā nārī vandhyā strījananī tathā / putraṃ sā labhate nārī śīlavantaṃ guṇānvitam
verses.translation: He was the knower of the divine Aksahrdaya Mantra (the Mantra with which people become sure winners at the game of dice). He was a powerful king and a friend to Nala.
verses.hindi: इरादा नहीं किया । द्विज वन्द ! उस समय अंगिरा के पुत्र शुक्र उसके पिछलग्गू (सहायक) बने थे । महात् तेजस्वी उशना पहले बृहस्पति के पिता-का शिष्य था। उसी स्नेह के कारण भगवान् रुद्रदेव उस बृहस्पति के सहायक हुए, भोर अपना अजगव नामक प्रच"्ड धनुष लेकर उपस्थित हुए ।२६-३१। महान् बलशाली रुद्रदेव ने उन प्रमुख ब्रह्मषियों के तथा देवताओं के उद्देश से उस महान् अस्त्र का संधान किया, जिससे उसका यश्ञ नष्ट हो गया । प्रत्यक्ष तारकामय नामक युद्ध वहाँ मच गया, देवताओं तथा दानवों का वह घोर युद्ध महान लोकक्षयकारी हुआ ।३२-३३। उस युद्ध में तुषित नाम से प्रसिद्ध तीन देवता शेष बच रहे, वे आदिदेव पितामह ब्रहा की शरण में गये । लोक पितामह भगवान् ब्रह्मा ने स्वयं शुक्र को एवं इस विनाश कर्म में प्रवत्त शंकर को निवारित किया और तारा को बृहस्पति को वापस किया  चन्द्रमा के समान धुन्दर मुखवाली तारा को गर्भ-
verses.wordMeaning: He was the knower of the divine Aksahrdaya Mantra (the Mantra with which people become sure winners at the game of dice). He was a powerful king and a friend to Nala.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was the knower of the divine Aksahrdaya Mantra (the Mantra with which people become sure winners at the game of dice). He was a powerful king and a friend to Nala.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पश्येद्देवीं सुभक्तितः । अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां सर्वकाले ऽथवा नृप
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā paśyeddevīṃ subhaktitaḥ / aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ sarvakāle 'thavā nṛpa
verses.translation: One of them was the son of Virasena and the other a leading member of the Iksvaku race. Rtuparna's son was Sarvakama who was lord of the people.
verses.hindi: वती देखकर विश्रवर्य बृहस्पति ने कहा, क्या, तुम अब भी गर्भ त्याग नहीं कर रही हो ? मेरी भूमि में तुम दूसरे वीर्य का किस प्रकार धारण कर सकती हो ? तारा उस दस्युहन्तम कुमार को इस पर भी नहीं छोड़ सकी थी कि इसी बीच तृण राशि में जलते हुए अग्ति की तरह वह कुमार उत्पन्न हो गया और उत्पन्न होते
verses.wordMeaning: One of them was the son of Virasena and the other a leading member of the Iksvaku race. Rtuparna's son was Sarvakama who was lord of the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: One of them was the son of Virasena and the other a leading member of the Iksvaku race. Rtuparna's son was Sarvakama who was lord of the people.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गमे तु ततः स्नाता नारी वा पुरुषो ऽपि वा । पुत्रं धनं तथा देवी ददाति परितोषिता
verses.transliteration: saṅgame tu tataḥ snātā nārī vā puruṣo 'pi vā / putraṃ dhanaṃ tathā devī dadāti paritoṣitā
verses.translation: King Sudasa was his son. He was Hamsamukha (one with the face of a swan) 2. Sudasa's son was the king Saudasa.
verses.hindi: घ्ग्पे वॉर्युपुराणभ हियमाणा यदा देवाना55ह सा साध्वसाधु वा। तदा तां शप्तुमारब्धः कुमारो दस्युहन्तमः .
verses.wordMeaning: King Sudasa was his son. He was Hamsamukha (one with the face of a swan) 2. Sudasa's son was the king Saudasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Sudasa was his son. He was Hamsamukha (one with the face of a swan) 2. Sudasa's son was the king Saudasa.

verses.sanskrit: गोत्ररक्षां प्रकुरुते दृष्टा देवी सुपूजिता । प्रजां च पाति सततं पूज्यमाना न संशयः
verses.transliteration: gotrarakṣāṃ prakurute dṛṣṭā devī supūjitā / prajāṃ ca pāti satataṃ pūjyamānā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: He was well-known by the names of Kalmasapada and Mitrasaha. Vasistha, of great brilliance, begot of Kalma- sapada's wife the son Asmaka, for the purpose of making the line of Iksvaku flourish (and perpetuate).
verses.hindi: त॑ निवाये तदा ब्रह्मा तारां चरद्रस्य शंस यः । यदत्र तथ्य॑ तद्ब्रृहि तारे कस्य सुतस्त्वयम् ॥४ १ सा प्राइजलिर्वाचेदं ब्रह्मार्ण बरदं प्रभुम् । सोमस्येति महात्मानं कुमार दस्युहन्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: He was well-known by the names of Kalmasapada and Mitrasaha. Vasistha, of great brilliance, begot of Kalma- sapada's wife the son Asmaka, for the purpose of making the line of Iksvaku flourish (and perpetuate).
verses.commentary: Sense: He was well-known by the names of Kalmasapada and Mitrasaha. Vasistha, of great brilliance, begot of Kalma- sapada's wife the son Asmaka, for the purpose of making the line of Iksvaku flourish (and perpetuate).

verses.sanskrit: नवम्यां च महाराज स्नात्वा देवीमुपोषितः । पूजयेत् परया भक्त्या श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: navamyāṃ ca mahārāja snātvā devīmupoṣitaḥ / pūjayet parayā bhaktyā śraddhāpūtena cetasā
verses.translation: Urakama was the son of Asmaka and his son was Mulaka. As regards King Mulaka, they cite the following (verse). The text: Ijanena samudrddvai is obscure and gives an awkward meaning, especially of samudrat. Bd. P. v.167: ihanM sureSSd vai etc. 'was brought
verses.hindi: ततः सुतमुपाध्राय सोमो दाता प्रजापति:  बुध इत्यकरोन्नाम तस्य पुत्रस्य धीमतः प्रतिपुर्वं च गमने समस्युत्तिष्ठते बुध:  उत्पादयामास तदा पुत्र वे राजपुत्रिका ४४
verses.wordMeaning: Urakama was the son of Asmaka and his son was Mulaka. As regards King Mulaka, they cite the following (verse). The text: Ijanena samudrddvai is obscure and gives an awkward meaning, especially of samudrat. Bd. P. v.167: ihanM sureSSd vai etc. 'was brought
verses.commentary: Sense: Urakama was the son of Asmaka and his son was Mulaka. As regards King Mulaka, they cite the following (verse). The text: Ijanena samudrddvai is obscure and gives an awkward meaning, especially of samudrat. Bd. P. v.167: ihanM sureSSd vai etc. 'was brought

verses.sanskrit: स गच्छेत् परमं लोकं यः सुरैरपि दुर्लभः
verses.transliteration: sa gacchet paramaṃ lokaṃ yaḥ surairapi durlabhaḥ
verses.translation: The heroic Rama, the knower of Dharmas, well-known
verses.hindi: तस्य तत्पापशमन चकारात्रिमंहाथशा: । स राजयक्ष्मणा मुक्तः श्रिया जज्वाल सर्वशः
verses.wordMeaning: The heroic Rama, the knower of Dharmas, well-known
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic Rama, the knower of Dharmas, well-known

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सिद्धेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षट्षष्ट्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६७ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले त्वच्चिह्नेनोपलक्षितम् । तीर्थम् एतन् ममाख्याहि सम्भवं च महामुने
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe siddheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 167 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tvaccihnenopalakṣitam / tīrtham etan mamākhyāhi sambhavaṃ ca mahāmune
verses.translation: After killing Lavana, the son of Madhu, Satrughna entered his Madhuvana and founded die city of Mathura there.
verses.hindi: एतत्सोमस्य वे जन्म कीतितं द्विजसत्तमाः । वंश तस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठा: कीत्यंमान॑ निबोधत ४८ ही उस परम ऐद्वयेशाली ने देवताओं को हतश्री कर दिया  देवता लोग इससे सन्देह में पड़ गये और तारा से कहने लगे, सच सच बतलाओ, यह पुत्र किसका है, चद्धमा अथवा बृहस्पति का ।३२-३६। देवताओं के इस प्रकार बारम्बार कहने पर भी जब तारा साधु असाधु कुछ नहीं बोल सकी, तब दस्युहस्तम कुमार उसे शाप देने को उतारू हो गया। ब्रह्मा ने कुमार को निवारित करण पुनः तारा से पूछा--तारे ! बतलाओ, इस
verses.wordMeaning: After killing Lavana, the son of Madhu, Satrughna entered his Madhuvana and founded die city of Mathura there.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing Lavana, the son of Madhu, Satrughna entered his Madhuvana and founded die city of Mathura there.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ दक्षिणे गिरिमुत्तमम् । विन्ध्यं सर्वगुणोपेतं नियतो नियताशनः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā kṛtayugasyādau dakṣiṇe girimuttamam / vindhyaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ niyato niyatāśanaḥ
verses.translation: Angada and Candraketu were the sons of Laksmana. Their territories at the border of mountain Himalaya were very prosperous and flourishing.
verses.hindi: बोली - यह महान् बलशाली दस्युहन्तम कुमार चन्द्रमा का है ।४०-४२। दाता प्रजापति ने सुत का शिर सूंघकर उस परम बुद्धिमान् का नाम बुध रखा  उस समय बुध पूर्व दिशा में गमन करने के लिये उठ खड़े हुए । राजपुत्री इला के संयोग से बुध ने एक पुत्र उत्पन्न किया  बुध के उस परम तेजस्वी पुत्र का नाम पुरूरवा था, वह क् इला के गर्भ से उत्पन्न होने के कारण ऐल नाम से भी विख्यात था । उयंशी में उस बुध पुत्र के छह परमतेजस्वी
verses.wordMeaning: Angada and Candraketu were the sons of Laksmana. Their territories at the border of mountain Himalaya were very prosperous and flourishing.
verses.commentary: Sense: Angada and Candraketu were the sons of Laksmana. Their territories at the border of mountain Himalaya were very prosperous and flourishing.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिसङ्घैः कृतातिथ्यो दण्डके न्यवसं चिरम् । उषित्वा सुचिरं कालं वर्षाणामयुतं सुखी
verses.transliteration: ṛṣisaṅghaiḥ kṛtātithyo daṇḍake nyavasaṃ ciram / uṣitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sukhī
verses.translation: Angadiya, the capital city of Angada, was in the land Karapatha. 1 Candravakfra, the city of the mighty Candraketu, was very auspicious.
verses.hindi: पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए, राजयक्ष्मा रोग ने जबरदस्ती आकर चद्रमा को विवश एवं परेशान कर दिया, यंक्ष्मा से अतिशय पीड़ित होने पर जब चन्द्रमा का मण्डल क्षीण हो गया, तब वह पितामह ब्रह्मा एबं अत्रि की शरण में गये ।४३-४६। महान् यशस्वी अत्नि ने चन्द्रमा का पाप शमन किया, राज्यक्ष्मा से मुक्ति प्राप्त कर चन्द्रमा पुनः अपनी कान्ति से चारों भोर प्रकाशित हो उठे । द्विजवुन्द ! यह् चन्द्रमा के जन्म का वृत्तान्त आप लोगों को बतला चुका, अब उनके वंश का वर्णन कर रहा हूँ, सुनते जाइये । चन्द्रमा के इस जन्म वृत्तान्त को सुनने पर
verses.wordMeaning: Angadiya, the capital city of Angada, was in the land Karapatha. 1 Candravakfra, the city of the mighty Candraketu, was very auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Angadiya, the capital city of Angada, was in the land Karapatha. 1 Candravakfra, the city of the mighty Candraketu, was very auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: तान् ऋषीन् समनुज्ञाप्य शिष्यैरनुगतस्ततः । निवृत्तः सुमहाभाग नर्मदाकूलम् आगतः
verses.transliteration: tān ṛṣīn samanujñāpya śiṣyairanugatastataḥ / nivṛttaḥ sumahābhāga narmadākūlam āgataḥ
verses.translation: Tak?a and Puskara were the heroic sons of Bharata.
verses.hindi: धनसा रोग्यमायुष्यं पुण्य कल्मषशो धनम् । सोमस्य जन्म श्रुत्वेव सर्वपाप: प्रमुच्यते ४ ६
verses.wordMeaning: Tak?a and Puskara were the heroic sons of Bharata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tak?a and Puskara were the heroic sons of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यं च रमणीयं च सर्वपापविनाशनम् । कृत्वाहमास्पदं तत्र द्विजसंघसमायुतः
verses.transliteration: puṇyaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ ca sarvapāpavināśanam / kṛtvāhamāspadaṃ tatra dvijasaṃghasamāyutaḥ
verses.translation: Modem Karabagh or Baghan on the west bank of the Indus, at the foot of salt range called Niti hill in the Bannu district (cf. RaghuvamJa. XV-90).
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते सोमोत्पत्तिकथनं नाम नवतितमोड्ध्यायः चन्‍्ड््वच्याव्कीर्त वस्तु
verses.wordMeaning: Modem Karabagh or Baghan on the west bank of the Indus, at the foot of salt range called Niti hill in the Bannu district (cf. RaghuvamJa. XV-90).
verses.commentary: Sense: Modem Karabagh or Baghan on the west bank of the Indus, at the foot of salt range called Niti hill in the Bannu district (cf. RaghuvamJa. XV-90).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारिभिराकीर्णं गार्हस्थ्ये सुप्रतिष्ठितैः । वानप्रस्थैश्च यतिभिर्यताहारैर् यतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: brahmacāribhirākīrṇaṃ gārhasthye supratiṣṭhitaiḥ / vānaprasthaiśca yatibhiryatāhārair yatātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: The beautiful city of Tak§a, viz. Takasila 1 is renowned in all the quarters. Puskaravati, 2 the city of the heroic Puskara, is also well-known.
verses.hindi: . ब्रह्मवादी पराक़ान्तः शत्रुभियुंधि दुर्जयः । आहर्ता चारिनहोत्रस्प यज्वनां च् ददो महीम्
verses.wordMeaning: The beautiful city of Tak§a, viz. Takasila 1 is renowned in all the quarters. Puskaravati, 2 the city of the heroic Puskara, is also well-known.
verses.commentary: Sense: The beautiful city of Tak§a, viz. Takasila 1 is renowned in all the quarters. Puskaravati, 2 the city of the heroic Puskara, is also well-known.

verses.sanskrit: तपस्विभिर्महाभागैः कामक्रोधविवर्जितैः । तत्राहं वर्षमयुतं तपः कृत्वा सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: tapasvibhirmahābhāgaiḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitaiḥ / tatrāhaṃ varṣamayutaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam
verses.translation: The people who know the Puranas sing this Gatha (laudatory verse): "All the principles are fettered to (con¬ centrated in) intelligent Rama due to his greatness."
verses.hindi: सत्यवाक्कमंबुद्धि श्र कान्‍त: संवृतमैथुनः । अतोव पुत्रों लोकेयु रूपेणाप्र तिमोभवत् ३३ धन आरोग्य, आयु, पुण्य, एवं पापशान्ति होती है । इसे सुनते ही मनुष्य समस्त पापकर्मों से छटकारा पा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The people who know the Puranas sing this Gatha (laudatory verse): "All the principles are fettered to (con¬ centrated in) intelligent Rama due to his greatness."
verses.commentary: Sense: The people who know the Puranas sing this Gatha (laudatory verse): "All the principles are fettered to (con¬ centrated in) intelligent Rama due to his greatness."

verses.sanskrit: आराधयं वासुदेवं प्रभुं कर्तारम् ईश्वरम् । जपंस्तपोभिर्नियमैर्नर्मदाकूलमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: ārādhayaṃ vāsudevaṃ prabhuṃ kartāram īśvaram / japaṃstapobhirniyamairnarmadākūlamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Rama was a dark-complexioned, youthful, red-eyed, bright-faced hero with arms extending upto the knees. With a smiling face and leonine shoulders, that mighty-armed (one) uttered only measured words.
verses.hindi: चरद्रवंश का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Rama was a dark-complexioned, youthful, red-eyed, bright-faced hero with arms extending upto the knees. With a smiling face and leonine shoulders, that mighty-armed (one) uttered only measured words.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama was a dark-complexioned, youthful, red-eyed, bright-faced hero with arms extending upto the knees. With a smiling face and leonine shoulders, that mighty-armed (one) uttered only measured words.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तौ वरदौ देवौ समायातौ युधिष्ठिर । प्रत्यक्षौ भास्करौ राजन्नुमाश्रीभ्यां विभूषितौ
verses.transliteration: tatastau varadau devau samāyātau yudhiṣṭhira / pratyakṣau bhāskarau rājannumāśrībhyāṃ vibhūṣitau
verses.translation: Rama reigned for ten thousand years. The sound of the chanting of Rk, Saman and Yajur Mantras and the twanging of his bow string were always heard.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले--“ऋषिव॒ुन्द ! चन्द्रमा के पुत्र बुध और बुध के पुत्र पुरूरवा हुए। राजा पुरूरवा परमतेजस्वी, दानी, यज्ञकर्ता एवं विपुल दक्षिणा देने वाला था वह ब्रह्मवेत्ता था, शत्रुलोग युद्ध में उसे किसी प्रकार भी नहीं जीत सकते थे, शत्रओं का तो उसने विध्वंश कर डाला था।ववह अग्निद्दोत्र का उपासक था, यज्ञ करनेवालों को उसने सारी पृथ्वी दान में दे दी थी ।१-२। वह सर्वेदा सत्य वचन बोलता था, कर्मशील एवं परम बुद्धिमान् था, देखने में परम धुन्दर था, वह गुप्त या उच्छु खलता रहित भैथुन वाला था, लोक में वह एक
verses.wordMeaning: Rama reigned for ten thousand years. The sound of the chanting of Rk, Saman and Yajur Mantras and the twanging of his bow string were always heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama reigned for ten thousand years. The sound of the chanting of Rk, Saman and Yajur Mantras and the twanging of his bow string were always heard.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्याहं ततो देवौ भक्तियुक्तो वचो ऽब्रुवम् । भवन्तौ प्रार्थयामि स्म वरार्हौ वरदौ शिवौ
verses.transliteration: praṇamyāhaṃ tato devau bhaktiyukto vaco 'bruvam / bhavantau prārthayāmi sma varārhau varadau śivau
verses.translation: Proceeding in search of Slta, that renowned leader of men killed the (demon) of the family of Pulastya, who had committed sins before.
verses.hindi: तं ब्रह्मवादिन दान्‍्तं धर्मज्ं सत्यवादिनम् । उबंशी वरयासास हित्वा मान यशस्विनी
verses.wordMeaning: Proceeding in search of Slta, that renowned leader of men killed the (demon) of the family of Pulastya, who had committed sins before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Proceeding in search of Slta, that renowned leader of men killed the (demon) of the family of Pulastya, who had committed sins before.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्थितिं महाभागौ भक्तिं वानुत्तमां युवाम् । अजरो व्याधिरहितः पञ्चविंशतिवर्षवत् । अस्मिन्स्थाने सदा स्थेयं सह देवैरसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: dharmasthitiṃ mahābhāgau bhaktiṃ vānuttamāṃ yuvām / ajaro vyādhirahitaḥ pañcaviṃśativarṣavat / asminsthāne sadā stheyaṃ saha devairasaṃśayam
verses.translation: Rama, son of Dasaratha, was brilliant with his own splendour. He possessed Sattvic qualities. He was richly endowed with good attributes. He surpassed even the Sun and the blazing fire in brilliance.
verses.hindi: तया सहावसद्राजा दश वर्षाणि चाष्ट च  सप्त षट् सप्त चाष्टो च दश चाष्टो च वीयंबान बने चेत्ररथे रम्ये तथा मनन्‍्दाकिनोतटे । अलकायां विशालायां ननन्‍दने च वनोत्तमे
verses.wordMeaning: Rama, son of Dasaratha, was brilliant with his own splendour. He possessed Sattvic qualities. He was richly endowed with good attributes. He surpassed even the Sun and the blazing fire in brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama, son of Dasaratha, was brilliant with his own splendour. He possessed Sattvic qualities. He was richly endowed with good attributes. He surpassed even the Sun and the blazing fire in brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तौ मया पार्थ तौ देवौ कृष्णशङ्करौ । मामूचतुः प्रहृष्टौ तौ निवासार्थं युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: evamuktau mayā pārtha tau devau kṛṣṇaśaṅkarau / māmūcatuḥ prahṛṣṭau tau nivāsārthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Thus the mighty-armed scion of the family of Iksvaku killed Ravana along with all of his followers and then went back to Heaven.
verses.hindi: गन्धमादनपादेषु मेरुशज्रे नगोत्तमे । उत्तरांश्व कुरून्प्राप्प कलापग्रामसेव च .
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the mighty-armed scion of the family of Iksvaku killed Ravana along with all of his followers and then went back to Heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the mighty-armed scion of the family of Iksvaku killed Ravana along with all of his followers and then went back to Heaven.

verses.sanskrit: देवावूचतुः । अस्मिन्स्थाने स्थितौ विद्धि सह देवैः सवासवैः । एवमुक्त्वा ततो देवौ तत्रैवान्तरधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: devāvūcatuḥ / asminsthāne sthitau viddhi saha devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ / evamuktvā tato devau tatraivāntaradhīyatām
verses.translation: Srirama's son was called Kusa, He had another son Lava of great prowess. Understand (the names of) their realms.
verses.hindi: एतेषु वनमुख्येषु सुरेराचरितेषु च  उर्वश्या सहितो राजा रेसे परमया सुदा ८ गन्धर्वी चोवंशी देवी राजानं मानुषं कथम् । देवानुत्सुज्य संप्राप्ता तन्नो ब्ृहि बहुआुत ९
verses.wordMeaning: Srirama's son was called Kusa, He had another son Lava of great prowess. Understand (the names of) their realms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Srirama's son was called Kusa, He had another son Lava of great prowess. Understand (the names of) their realms.

verses.sanskrit: अहं च स्थापयित्वा तौ शङ्करं कृष्णमव्ययम् । कृतकृत्यस्ततो जातः सम्पूज्य सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ ca sthāpayitvā tau śaṅkaraṃ kṛṣṇamavyayam / kṛtakṛtyastato jātaḥ sampūjya susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: According to VR. VII. 101.10-15 it was founded by Bharata. Probably the same as 'Poukelaotes* mentioned by Greeks as being sacked by Alexander the great. De ( ) identifies it with Charsaddah eighteen miles north of Peshawar, on the Landi near its junction with the Kabul river.
verses.hindi: आत्मनः शापमोक्षार्थ नियमं सा चकार तु । अनग्नदर्शनं चेब अकामात्सह मेथुनम् ११
verses.wordMeaning: According to VR. VII. 101.10-15 it was founded by Bharata. Probably the same as 'Poukelaotes* mentioned by Greeks as being sacked by Alexander the great. De ( ) identifies it with Charsaddah eighteen miles north of Peshawar, on the Landi near its junction with the Kabul river.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to VR. VII. 101.10-15 it was founded by Bharata. Probably the same as 'Poukelaotes* mentioned by Greeks as being sacked by Alexander the great. De ( ) identifies it with Charsaddah eighteen miles north of Peshawar, on the Landi near its junction with the Kabul river.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम् । मार्कण्डेश्वरनाम्ना वै विष्णुं त्रिभुवनेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / mārkaṇḍeśvaranāmnā vai viṣṇuṃ tribhuvaneśvaram
verses.translation: Modem Nasik or Paficavafi in Maharashtra.
verses.hindi: दौ मेषो शयनाभ्यासे स तावद्य्यवतिष्ठते । घृतमात्र॑ तथा5डहारः कालमेक॑ तु पाथिव १२ अनृपम पुत्र था, सुन्दरता में वह बेजोड़ था ! उस ब्रह्मवादी, क्षमाशील, दानपरायण, धमेश, एवं सत्यभाषी पुरूरवा को अपने रूप के लिये परम यद्य प्राप्त करनेवाली उर्वशी ने अपना मान छोड़कर पतिरूप में वरण किया ।३-४। उस उबंशी के साथ परम बलवान राजा पुरूरवा ने दस आठ, सात, छ, सात, आठ, दस आठ, कुल मिलाकर चोंसठ वर्षों तक सुखपूर्वंक निवास किया। कभी मनोरम च॑त्ररथ नामक वन में, कभी मन्दाकिनी
verses.wordMeaning: Modem Nasik or Paficavafi in Maharashtra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Modem Nasik or Paficavafi in Maharashtra.

verses.sanskrit: स गच्छेत्परमं स्थानं वैष्णवं शैवमेव च । घृतेन पयसा वाथ दध्ना च मधुना तथा
verses.transliteration: sa gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śaivameva ca / ghṛtena payasā vātha dadhnā ca madhunā tathā
verses.translation: Ahlnagu's successor was Pariyatra of great fame. His son was Dala and from him was born the king Bala.
verses.hindi: के रमणीय तटवर्ती प्रान्त में, कभी अलकापुरी में, कभी विशालापुरी में, सर्वश्रेष्ठ वन में, कभी गन्धमादन पव॑त के शिखरों पर, कभी नगराजसुमेरु की चोटियों पर, कभी उत्तर कुरु प्रदेश में, कभी कलाप ग्राम में इन प्रमुख वनों एवं देवताओं की क्रीड़ा भूमियों में वह राजा पुरूरवा परम आनन्द समेत उवंशी के साथ विहार करता रहा
verses.wordMeaning: Ahlnagu's successor was Pariyatra of great fame. His son was Dala and from him was born the king Bala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ahlnagu's successor was Pariyatra of great fame. His son was Dala and from him was born the king Bala.

verses.sanskrit: नार्मदेनोदकेनाथ गन्धधूपैः सुशोभनैः । पुष्पोपहारैश्च तथा नैवेद्यैर् नियतात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: nārmadenodakenātha gandhadhūpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ / puṣpopahāraiśca tathā naivedyair niyatātmavān
verses.translation: Bala's son was a pious-souled (king) Auhka 2 by name. His son was Vajranabha whose son was Sarikhana.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने पूछा--बहुश्रत सूतजी ! गन्धर्व को कन्या दिव्यग्रुणयुक्त उबंशी ने मनुष्य पुत्र॒ राजा पुरूरवा को, समस्त देवताओं को छोड़कर, क्‍यों पतिरूप में वरण किया-हइसे हमें बतलाइये सूत बोले--ऋषिवृन्द ! गन्धवंपुत्री सुन्दरी उर्वशी ने ब्रह्मशाप के कारण मनुष्य को पति- रूप में वरण किया था, उसने प्रतिज्ञा करके इला पुत्र राजा पुरुरवा के साथ रहने की व्यवस्था की थो। शाप से मुक्ति पाने के लिए उसने नियम निश्चित किया था । उसने कहा था, “है राजन् ! मैथुन के अवसर को छोड़कर बिना कामासक्ति के, किसी भी समय मैं आपको नंगा नहीं देखूंगी, हमारी शब्या के समीप
verses.wordMeaning: Bala's son was a pious-souled (king) Auhka 2 by name. His son was Vajranabha whose son was Sarikhana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bala's son was a pious-souled (king) Auhka 2 by name. His son was Vajranabha whose son was Sarikhana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विष्णोः प्रकुर्वीत जागरं भक्तितत्परः । स्नानादीनि तथा राजन्प्रयतः शुचिमानसः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ viṣṇoḥ prakurvīta jāgaraṃ bhaktitatparaḥ / snānādīni tathā rājanprayataḥ śucimānasaḥ
verses.translation: Sankhana's son Dhyusitasva was a renowned scholar. King Visvasaha was the son of Dhyusitasva.
verses.hindi: यद्येष समयो राजन्यावत्कालश्र ते दृढम् । तावत्कालं तु वत्स्पामि एप नः समयः कृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Sankhana's son Dhyusitasva was a renowned scholar. King Visvasaha was the son of Dhyusitasva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sankhana's son Dhyusitasva was a renowned scholar. King Visvasaha was the son of Dhyusitasva.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठे मासि सिते पक्षे चतुर्दश्यामुपोषितः । द्वादश्यां कारयेद् देवपूजनं वैष्णवो नरः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe caturdaśyāmupoṣitaḥ / dvādaśyāṃ kārayed devapūjanaṃ vaiṣṇavo naraḥ
verses.translation: Hiranyanabha belonged to Kosala. His son was Vasistha. He was remembered as the disciple of the grandson of Jaimini in all auspicious rites.
verses.hindi: तस्थास्तं समय सर्व स॒ राजा पर्यपालयत् । एवं सा चावसत्तर्मिन्पुरूरवसि भामिनी समयद्युत्क्रमात्सा बे राजानं त्यक्ष्यते यथा । तदहूं वच्मि वः सर्व यथा त्यक्ष्यति सा नृपणू
verses.wordMeaning: Hiranyanabha belonged to Kosala. His son was Vasistha. He was remembered as the disciple of the grandson of Jaimini in all auspicious rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hiranyanabha belonged to Kosala. His son was Vasistha. He was remembered as the disciple of the grandson of Jaimini in all auspicious rites.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा चतुर्दश्यामेकादश्यां नरोत्तम । वैष्णवं लोकम् आप्नोति विष्णुतुल्यो भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛtvā caturdaśyāmekādaśyāṃ narottama / vaiṣṇavaṃ lokam āpnoti viṣṇutulyo bhavennaraḥ
verses.translation: He had studied five hundred Vedic Samhitas. 3 The Yoga philosophy was learned from him by the intelligent Yajfiavalkya.
verses.hindi: ससहायो गमिष्यामि युष्माक॑ कार्यसिद्धये । एचमुक्त्वा गतस्ततन्न प्रतिष्ठान महायशा:ः १६ स निशायामथा55गम्य मेषमेक जहार वे। मातृबद्वतंते सा तु मेषयोश्रारुहासिनो
verses.wordMeaning: He had studied five hundred Vedic Samhitas. 3 The Yoga philosophy was learned from him by the intelligent Yajfiavalkya.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had studied five hundred Vedic Samhitas. 3 The Yoga philosophy was learned from him by the intelligent Yajfiavalkya.

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरे च राजेन्द्र गणवन्मोदते पुरे । श्राद्धं च कुरुते तत्र पित्ःन् उद्दिश्य सुस्थिरः
verses.transliteration: māheśvare ca rājendra gaṇavanmodate pure / śrāddhaṃ ca kurute tatra pitḥn uddiśya susthiraḥ
verses.translation: Pusya, his son, was a great scholar. His son was Dhruvasandhi. Sudarana was his son and Agnivarna was born of Sudarsana.
verses.hindi: गश्धर्वागम्न ज्ञात्वा शयनस्था यशस्विनो । राजानमन्रवीत्सा तु पुत्रों मेडहियतेति वे २१ 'मन-+-न-८ कर  मननानाय नमन न तन-++्०्न्गा
verses.wordMeaning: Pusya, his son, was a great scholar. His son was Dhruvasandhi. Sudarana was his son and Agnivarna was born of Sudarsana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pusya, his son, was a great scholar. His son was Dhruvasandhi. Sudarana was his son and Agnivarna was born of Sudarsana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते ह्यक्षयां तृप्तिं प्राप्नुवन्ति न संशयः । नर्मदायां द्विजः स्नात्वा मौनी नियतमानसः
verses.transliteration: tasya te hyakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ / narmadāyāṃ dvijaḥ snātvā maunī niyatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: Agnivarna's son was Slghra and Manu (Maru in Bd. P.) is remembered as the son of Slghraka. Manu adopted
verses.hindi: दो मेढ़े सवंदा बंधे रहेंगे, और केवल एक सम्रय घृत मात्र का आहार मैं करूँगी । है राजन् ! जब तक हमारे इन नियमों को दढ़तापूर्वक आप अक्षुण्ण पालन करते रहेंगे, तब तक मैं. निश्चय आपके साथ रहूंगी, यही हमारी प्रतिज्ञा है।” राजा पुरूरवा ने उवंशी की इस प्रतिज्ञा का जब तक अक्षरश पालन किया, तब तक सुन्दरी उवंशी उसके साथ निवास करती रही । इस प्रकार ब्रह्मशाप से मोहित होकर
verses.wordMeaning: Agnivarna's son was Slghra and Manu (Maru in Bd. P.) is remembered as the son of Slghraka. Manu adopted
verses.commentary: Sense: Agnivarna's son was Slghra and Manu (Maru in Bd. P.) is remembered as the son of Slghraka. Manu adopted

verses.sanskrit: उपास्य सन्ध्यां तत्रस्थो जपं कृत्वा सुशोभनम् । तर्पयित्वा पित्ःन्देवान्मनुष्यांश्च यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: upāsya sandhyāṃ tatrastho japaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam / tarpayitvā pitḥndevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Dc(p. Ill) identifies it with Ujjain but our text locates it on the ridges of the Vindhya mountain.
verses.hindi: उवंशी चौंसठ वर्षों तक भक्ति पूर्वक मनुष्य योनि में उत्पन्न होनेवाले राजा पुरूरवा के साथ रहीं, उधर गन्षवें लोग उसके वियोग से परम चिन्तित थे १०-१५॥ गन्चर्व गण बोले--'हे, महाभाग्यशालियों ! स्वर्ग को विभूषित करनेवाली परम सुन्दरी उवंशी जिस प्रकार देवताओं को पुनः प्राप्त हो-इस बात की चिन्ता करते जाइये ।” उस समय बोलने में सब से प्रवीण विश्वासु नामक गरधवे बोला, निष्पाप ! गन्धवंगण ! मेरी ऐसी धारणा है कि उवंशी ने अवद्य कोई प्रतिज्ञा उस राजा के साथ की होगी, जिसके संग निवास कर रही है  उस प्रतिज्ञा के टूट जाने
verses.wordMeaning: Dc(p. Ill) identifies it with Ujjain but our text locates it on the ridges of the Vindhya mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dc(p. Ill) identifies it with Ujjain but our text locates it on the ridges of the Vindhya mountain.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णस्य पुरतः स्थित्वा मार्कण्डेशस्य वा पुनः । ऋग्यजुःसाममन्त्रांश्च जपेदत्र प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇasya purataḥ sthitvā mārkaṇḍeśasya vā punaḥ / ṛgyajuḥsāmamantrāṃśca japedatra prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: 'Uluka* as per Bd. P.v. 205. Pargiter, in the list of kings of Ayodhya, calls him'Uktha* ( A1HT\ ).
verses.hindi: से वह जिस प्रकार उस राजा को छोड़ देगी, वह उपाय तुम लोगों को मैं बतला रहा हूँ । तुम लोगों की कार्य सिद्धि के लिये मैं सहायक के साथ उसके पास जा रहा हूँ  महान यशस्वी विद्ववासु ने भस्धवों से ऐसी बातें करने के उपरान्त प्रतिष्ठानपुर की ओर प्रस्थान किया ।१६-१६९। रात के समय उसने शयनागार में प्रवेश- कर एक मेढ़े को चुरा लिया, उन दोनों भेढ़ों पर सुन्दर हेसनेवाली उर्वशी माता के समान स्नेह रखती थी ।
verses.wordMeaning: 'Uluka* as per Bd. P.v. 205. Pargiter, in the list of kings of Ayodhya, calls him'Uktha* ( A1HT\ ).
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Uluka* as per Bd. P.v. 205. Pargiter, in the list of kings of Ayodhya, calls him'Uktha* ( A1HT\ ).

verses.sanskrit: ऋचमेकां जपेद्यस्तु ऋग्वेदस्य फलं लभेत् । यजुर्वेदस्य यजुषा साम्ना सामफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: ṛcamekāṃ japedyastu ṛgvedasya phalaṃ labhet / yajurvedasya yajuṣā sāmnā sāmaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Bd.P. v. 207 states that Pausyaiiji was his teacher in Sama Veda. Pau?yanji, a disciple of Sukarman, taught 500 branches of the Sama Veda.
verses.hindi: शय्या पर लेटे लेटे ही यशस्विनी उवंशी को गन्धर्वों के आने का बृत्ताश्त विदित हो गया और वह वहीं से राजा से केवल इतना बोली--मेरा एक पुत्र चुराया जा रहा है। उर्वशी इस बात को जिस समय राजा से कह एबमुक्तो विनिश्चित्य नर्नस्तिष्ठति वे नृपः । नग्न द्रक्ष्यति मां देवी समयो वितथों भवेत् २२ ततो भूयस्तु गन्धर्वा द्वितीय मेषमाददुः । द्वितीयेउपहलते मेषे ऐल॑ देवी तमब्रवीत्
verses.wordMeaning: Bd.P. v. 207 states that Pausyaiiji was his teacher in Sama Veda. Pau?yanji, a disciple of Sukarman, taught 500 branches of the Sama Veda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bd.P. v. 207 states that Pausyaiiji was his teacher in Sama Veda. Pau?yanji, a disciple of Sukarman, taught 500 branches of the Sama Veda.

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्भोजिते विप्रे कोटिर्भवति भोजिता । मृतप्रजा तु या नारी वन्ध्या स्त्रीजननी तथा
verses.transliteration: ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā / mṛtaprajā tu yā nārī vandhyā strījananī tathā
verses.translation: Manu'ssonwas Prasusruta. His son was Susandhi. Susandhi's son was A-marsa, otherwise known by the name Sahasvan.
verses.hindi: पुत्री मम हतो राजन्ननाथाया इब प्रभो । एवमुक्तस्तवोत्थाय नग्नो राजा प्रधावितः
verses.wordMeaning: Manu'ssonwas Prasusruta. His son was Susandhi. Susandhi's son was A-marsa, otherwise known by the name Sahasvan.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manu'ssonwas Prasusruta. His son was Susandhi. Susandhi's son was A-marsa, otherwise known by the name Sahasvan.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रांस्तु विधिवज्जप्त्वा ब्राह्मणो वेदतत्त्ववित् । लिङ्गस्य दक्षिणे पार्श्वे स्थापयेत् कलशं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: rudrāṃstu vidhivajjaptvā brāhmaṇo vedatattvavit / liṅgasya dakṣiṇe pārśve sthāpayet kalaśaṃ śivam
verses.translation: Sahasvan's son was the king known by the name ViSrutavan. Visrutavan's son was the king Brhadbala.
verses.hindi: प्रकाशिता तु सहसा ततो नग्नमवेक्ष्य सा। नग्नं दृष्ट्वा तिरोभूत्सा अप्सरा कामरूपिणी २६ . उत्पष्टाबुरणो दृष्ट्वा राजाध्युद्याधप्गतः प्रभुः । अपश्य॑स्तां तु वे राजा विललाप सुदुःखितः
verses.wordMeaning: Sahasvan's son was the king known by the name ViSrutavan. Visrutavan's son was the king Brhadbala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahasvan's son was the king known by the name ViSrutavan. Visrutavan's son was the king Brhadbala.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रैकादशभिर्मन्त्रैः स्नापयेत् कलशाम्भसा । पुत्रमाप्नोति राजेन्द्र दीर्घायुषमकल्मषम्
verses.transliteration: rudraikādaśabhirmantraiḥ snāpayet kalaśāmbhasā / putramāpnoti rājendra dīrghāyuṣamakalmaṣam
verses.translation: These are the mostly remembered kings, the successors of Iksvaku. The most important members of the race have been enumerated here. One who reads well this creation of Vivasvan, the son of Aditi, becomes endowed with progeny. He attains identity with Vaivasvata Manu, lord Sraddha-Deva who bestows prosperity on the subjects. He becomes free from sins and Rajasic qualities. He becomes long-lived and does not swerve from the righteous path.
verses.hindi: बनेषु सरिता क्लेष्वालयेषु सहेषु च। विचचार गिरिष्वेको निर्भरोपवनेषु च
verses.wordMeaning: These are the mostly remembered kings, the successors of Iksvaku. The most important members of the race have been enumerated here. One who reads well this creation of Vivasvan, the son of Aditi, becomes endowed with progeny. He attains identity with Vaivasvata Manu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the mostly remembered kings, the successors of Iksvaku. The most important members of the race have been enumerated here. One who reads well this creation of Vivasvan, the son of Aditi, becomes endowed with progeny. He attains identity with Vaivasvata Manu,…

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेश्वरवृक्षान्यो दूरस्थान् अपि पश्यति । ब्रह्महत्यादिपापेभ्यो मुच्यते शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeśvaravṛkṣānyo dūrasthān api paśyati / brahmahatyādipāpebhyo mucyate śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: Now (listen to and) understand the race of Nimi 3, the younger brother of Vikuksi. It was he who founded a city well known as Jayanta near the hermitage of Gautama.
verses.hindi: रहौ थी, उस समय' राजा नग्न पड़ा हुआ था, अतः उसने निश्चय किया कि यदि इस समय मैं उठ पड़गा तो मुझे नंगे रूप में देवी देख लेगी और तब उसकी प्रतिज्ञा टट जायमी ।२०-२२। इसी बीच में गन्धर्वों ने दूसरे मेढ़े को भी चुरा लिया । दूसरे को चुरा लेने पर उवंशी ने राजा पुरूरवा से कहा, राजन् ! प्रभो ! मेरे दोनों पुत्र अनाथ के पुत्रों की तरह चुरा लिए गये । उर्वशी के ऐसा कहने पक राजा नग्न अवस्था ही में शब्या से उठकर दौंड पड़ा और गरन्धवों तथा दोनों भेढ़ों के पद चिक्नों का अनुसरण करते हुए आगे बढ़ा । गरधवाँ ने इस अवसर पर एक बड़ी चाल चली, उन्होंने सारे राज्य भवन को शीक्रता से प्रकाशयुक्त कर दिया, और उवंशी ने राजा को नंगा देख लिया। इच्छानुकूल स्वरूप घारण करने वाली अप्सरा उवेशी राजा को नंगा
verses.wordMeaning: Now (listen to and) understand the race of Nimi 3, the younger brother of Vikuksi. It was he who founded a city well known as Jayanta near the hermitage of Gautama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now (listen to and) understand the race of Nimi 3, the younger brother of Vikuksi. It was he who founded a city well known as Jayanta near the hermitage of Gautama.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या पठेद्वा नृपसत्तम । सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā paṭhedvā nṛpasattama / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Probably a fictitious It I I * r! sar t e a s° a pleasure 1 haunt of This chapter corresponds to Bd. r. 2.3.0*.,
verses.hindi: देखते ही अन्तेंघान हो गयी ।२३-२६७ उवंशी को अरन्तहित जान गन्धवों ने उन दोनों मेढ़ों को छोड़ दिया और स्वयं वहीं पर अन्तहित हो गये । छटे हुए दोनों मेढ़ों को पकड़ कर राजा शबनागार में आये और वहाँ पर उबंशी को न देखकर बहुत दुःखित होकर विलाप करने लगे। इधर उधर उवंशी को ढूंढ़ते हुए वह प्रथ्बी भर घूम आये । जगत् के स्वामी होकर भी उवंशी के वियोग में राजा परम दुःखित होकर जयत् भर घूमते
verses.wordMeaning: Probably a fictitious It I I * r! sar t e a s° a pleasure 1 haunt of This chapter corresponds to Bd. r. 2.3.0*.,
verses.commentary: Sense: Probably a fictitious It I I * r! sar t e a s° a pleasure 1 haunt of This chapter corresponds to Bd. r. 2.3.0*.,

verses.sanskrit: इदं यशस्यमायुष्यं धन्यं दुःखप्रणाशनम् । पठतां शृण्वतां वापि सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥkhapraṇāśanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ vāpi sarvapāpapramocanam
verses.translation: Mithi was a king of great prowess whereby the capital city became (known as) Mithila 1 and the king was Janaka. Janaka's son was Udavasu.
verses.hindi: रहे। वनों में, नदियों के तटों पर, भवनों में, पर्वतों में, नि्लरों और उपवनों में, शिकार खेलने के स्थानों पर पर्बंतों के समौपवर्ती ग्रामों में, बगीचों एवं वाटिकाओं में. नगर-नगर में घूम-घूम कर वह सभी जीवधारियों से पूछते हुए परम विषण्ण होकर यह कहता फिरता था ।३७-३ १। अरे  मुझ दुःखिये को तू क्‍यों नहीं देख रही अन्र संधिराष:।. +घनुश्चिह्नास्तर्गतग्रश्थः ख पुस्तके विद्यते ।
verses.wordMeaning: Mithi was a king of great prowess whereby the capital city became (known as) Mithila 1 and the king was Janaka. Janaka's son was Udavasu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mithi was a king of great prowess whereby the capital city became (known as) Mithila 1 and the king was Janaka. Janaka's son was Udavasu.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मार्कण्डेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तषष्ट्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६८ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: नर्मदादक्षिणे रोधस्यङ्कूरेश्वरमुत्तमम् । तीर्थं सर्वगुणोपेतं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 168 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadādakṣiṇe rodhasyaṅkūreśvaramuttamam / tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: From Udavasu was born the extremely pious-souled Nandivardhana. From Nandivardhana was born the heroic and pious Suketu.
verses.hindi: कि न पश्यसि रे मूर्ठ मदसुढं विरुध्य साम् । वंब गता5सि वरारोहे धिक्ते (इसमे) जीवितमीदृशम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: From Udavasu was born the extremely pious-souled Nandivardhana. From Nandivardhana was born the heroic and pious Suketu.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Udavasu was born the extremely pious-souled Nandivardhana. From Nandivardhana was born the heroic and pious Suketu.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सिद्धं महारक्ष आराध्य तु महेश्वरम् । शङ्करं जगतः प्राणं स्मृतिमात्रावहारिणम्
verses.transliteration: yatra siddhaṃ mahārakṣa ārādhya tu maheśvaram / śaṅkaraṃ jagataḥ prāṇaṃ smṛtimātrāvahāriṇam
verses.translation: From Suketu was born the pious-souled Devarata of great strength. It is heard that the pious-souled Brhaduccha was Devarata's son.
verses.hindi: अथापश्यच्च तां राजा कुरुक्षेत्र महाबलः प्लक्षतीरथें पुष्करिण्यां विगाढेनास्वुना55प्लुताम् । क़ीडन्तीमप्सरोसिश्व पचभिः सह शोभनाम् ७३३ अपश्यत्सा ततः सुश्र् राजानमविदूरतः । उबंशी ता: सखीः प्राह अय॑ स पुरुषोत्तम:
verses.wordMeaning: From Suketu was born the pious-souled Devarata of great strength. It is heard that the pious-souled Brhaduccha was Devarata's son.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Suketu was born the pious-souled Devarata of great strength. It is heard that the pious-souled Brhaduccha was Devarata's son.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: किं तद्रक्षो द्विजश्रेष्ठ किंनाम कस्य वान्वये । एतद्विस्तरतः सर्वं कथयस्व ममानघ
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kiṃ tadrakṣo dvijaśreṣṭha kiṃnāma kasya vānvaye / etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha
verses.translation: Brhaduccha's son was the valorous Mahavlrya. Dhrti- man was the son of Mahavlrya and his son was Sudhrti.
verses.hindi: दष्द्वा तु राजा तां प्रीतः प्रलापानकुरुते बहुन् । आयाहि तिष्ठ मनसा धोरे वचसि तिष्ठ है.
verses.wordMeaning: Brhaduccha's son was the valorous Mahavlrya. Dhrti- man was the son of Mahavlrya and his son was Sudhrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhaduccha's son was the valorous Mahavlrya. Dhrti- man was the son of Mahavlrya and his son was Sudhrti.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानतिमिरान्धा ये पुमांसः पापकारिणः । युष्मद्विधैर् दीपभूतैः पश्यन्ति सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: ajñānatimirāndhā ye pumāṃsaḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ / yuṣmadvidhair dīpabhūtaiḥ paśyanti sacarācaram
verses.translation: The pious-souled Dhrstaketu, the oppressor of enemies, was the son of Sudhrti. Dhrstaketu's son was well known by the name of Haryasva.
verses.hindi: संव॒त्सरात्कुमारस्ते भविता नेव संशय: । निशामेकां तु वे राजा अवसत्तु तया सह समहुष्ठो जगामाथ स्वपुरं तु महायशाः । गते संव॒त्सरे राजा उर्वशी पुनरागमत् ३ € उषधित्वा तु तया साधमेकरात्र महामनाः । कामातंश्राब्रवीदीनो भव नित्यं ममेति व ३४०
verses.wordMeaning: The pious-souled Dhrstaketu, the oppressor of enemies, was the son of Sudhrti. Dhrstaketu's son was well known by the name of Haryasva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pious-souled Dhrstaketu, the oppressor of enemies, was the son of Sudhrti. Dhrstaketu's son was well known by the name of Haryasva.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मपुत्रवचः श्रुत्वा मार्कण्डेयो मुनीश्वरः । स्मितं कृत्वा बभाषे तां कथां पापप्रणाशनीम्
verses.transliteration: dharmaputravacaḥ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyo munīśvaraḥ / smitaṃ kṛtvā babhāṣe tāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm
verses.translation: Maru was Haryasva's son. Pratitvaka 2 was Maru's son. The pious-souled king Kirtiratha was the son of Pratit¬ vaka.
verses.hindi: हो, है सुन्दरी ! मेरे साथ विरोध भाव ठानकर तू कहाँ चली गई, हमारे ऐसे जीवन को घधिक्‍कार है। इस प्रकार विलाप करते हुए उप्त महाबलवान् राजा ने घूमते-घूमते कुरुक्षेत्र में उसे देखा  उस समय वह सुन्दरी प्लक्ष तीथे में एक पुष्करिणी के गहरे जल में पाँच अन्य सुन्दरी अप्सराओं के साथ क्रौड़ा कर रहो थी
verses.wordMeaning: Maru was Haryasva's son. Pratitvaka 2 was Maru's son. The pious-souled king Kirtiratha was the son of Pratit¬ vaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Maru was Haryasva's son. Pratitvaka 2 was Maru's son. The pious-souled king Kirtiratha was the son of Pratit¬ vaka.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: मानसो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रः पुलस्त्यो नाम पार्थिव । वेदशास्त्रप्रवक्ता च साक्षाद्वेधा इवापरः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mānaso brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ pulastyo nāma pārthiva / vedaśāstrapravaktā ca sākṣādvedhā ivāparaḥ
verses.translation: The son of Kirtiratha was well known as Devamldha. and Vibudhawas the son of Devamldha and Vibudha's son was Dhrti.
verses.hindi: सुन्दर भौहोंवाली उबंशी ते सप्लिकट आने पर राजा पुरूरवा को देख लिया और अपनी सखियों से कहा, अरे ! यह पुरुष श्रेष्ठ वही राजा है, जिसके साथ मैं निवास करती थी, ऐसा कहकर उसने राजा को दिखाया । उवंशी के ऐसा कहने पर वे पाँचों सुन्दर अप्सराएँ जल से बाहर भा गईं। राजा ने उवंशी को देखकर बहुत विलाप किया । उसे परम प्रसन्नता प्राप्त हुई। वह कहने लगा, हें सुन्दरी ! आओ । मन से मेरे इस कठोर हृदय में निवास करो ।३४-३६। अपनी पूर्व की बातों पर स्थित रहो । इस प्रकार सूक्ष्म बातें उन दोनों ने परस्पर कीं । अस्त में उवंशी ते पुरूरवा से कहा. प्रभो ! मैं आपके संयोग से गर्भवती है, एक व में तुम्हारा पुत्र मुन्से उत्पन्न होगा--इसमें सम्देह नहीं ।!” राजा ने वहाँ एक रात फिर उबंशी के साथ निवास क्रिया । महान् यदस्वी पुरूरबा दूसरे दिन अत्यन्त हरषित होकर अपने पुर को वापस आया । एक वर्ष
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Kirtiratha was well known as Devamldha. and Vibudhawas the son of Devamldha and Vibudha's son was Dhrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Kirtiratha was well known as Devamldha. and Vibudhawas the son of Devamldha and Vibudha's son was Dhrti.

verses.sanskrit: तृणबिन्दुसुता तस्य भार्यासीत्परमेष्ठिनः । तस्य धर्मप्रसङ्गेन पुत्रो जातो महामनाः
verses.transliteration: tṛṇabindusutā tasya bhāryāsītparameṣṭhinaḥ / tasya dharmaprasaṅgena putro jāto mahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: MahadhftPs son was Klrtiraja, a king of great valour. Klrtiraja s son was a scholar well known as Maharoma.
verses.hindi: बीत जाने पर वह पुनः उर्वशी के पास गया । महा मनस्वी पुरूरवा उस्र अवसर पर पुनः एक रात उबंशी के साथ निवास करने के उपरान्त कामार्त होकर दीन भाव से बोला तुम मेरे साथ सबवेदा निवास करो
verses.wordMeaning: MahadhftPs son was Klrtiraja, a king of great valour. Klrtiraja s son was a scholar well known as Maharoma.
verses.commentary: Sense: MahadhftPs son was Klrtiraja, a king of great valour. Klrtiraja s son was a scholar well known as Maharoma.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद्वेदेतिहासैश्च सषडङ्गपदक्रमाः । विश्रान्ता ब्रह्मणा दत्ता नाम विश्रवसेति च
verses.transliteration: yasmādvedetihāsaiśca saṣaḍaṅgapadakramāḥ / viśrāntā brahmaṇā dattā nāma viśravaseti ca
verses.translation: Also called Janakapur, capital of Videha in the district of Darbhanga (Bihar). It was famous for its Brahmanical University (upto 14th cent. A.D ). Now a new Sanskrit University has been founded there some years
verses.hindi: उर्बशी ने राजा को प्रत्युत्तर दिया कि है महाराज ! गन्धंगण तुम्हें ऐसा वरदान देंगे, उन्हीं से इस बात की ब॒ण नित्यं हि सालोक्य गन्धर्वाणां महात्मनाम्। तथेत्युक्त्वा वरं वन्ने गन्धर्वाश्व॒ तथास्त्विति
verses.wordMeaning: Also called Janakapur, capital of Videha in the district of Darbhanga (Bihar). It was famous for its Brahmanical University (upto 14th cent. A.D ). Now a new Sanskrit University has been founded there some years
verses.commentary: Sense: Also called Janakapur, capital of Videha in the district of Darbhanga (Bihar). It was famous for its Brahmanical University (upto 14th cent. A.D ). Now a new Sanskrit University has been founded there some years

verses.sanskrit: कस्मिंश्चिद् अथ काले च भरद्वाजो महामुनिः । स्वसुतां प्रददौ राजन्मुदा विश्रवसे नृप
verses.transliteration: kasmiṃścid atha kāle ca bharadvājo mahāmuniḥ / svasutāṃ pradadau rājanmudā viśravase nṛpa
verses.translation: Pratimbaka in Bd.P.v, 11. Pargiter records 'Pratindhaka* as his name
verses.hindi: स्थालीमगनेः पुरयित्वा गन्धर्वाश्व तमब्र॒वन् । अनेन इष्ट्वा लोक त॑ प्राप्स्यसि त्वं नराधिष
verses.wordMeaning: Pratimbaka in Bd.P.v, 11. Pargiter records 'Pratindhaka* as his name
verses.commentary: Sense: Pratimbaka in Bd.P.v, 11. Pargiter records 'Pratindhaka* as his name

verses.sanskrit: स तया रमते सार्धं पौलोम्या मघवा इव । मुदा परमया राजन्ब्राह्मणो वेदवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: sa tayā ramate sārdhaṃ paulomyā maghavā iva / mudā paramayā rājanbrāhmaṇo vedavittamaḥ
verses.translation: From Maharoma was born, the famous Svarnaroma. Svarnaroma's son was the king Hrasvaroma.
verses.hindi: अश्वत्थादर्राण कृत्वा मथित्वाईग्नि यथाविधि । तेनेष्ट्वा तु सलोक नः प्राप्स्यसि त्वं नराधिप मथित्वा5घ्न त्रिधा कृत्वा ह्ययजत्स नराधिपः । इष्ट्वा यज्ञबंहुविधर्गंतस्तेषां सलोकताम् ४८ वासाय च स गन्धवंस्त्रेतायां स महारथः । एकोग्निः पुबंसासीह ऐलस्त्रीस्तानकल्पयत्
verses.wordMeaning: From Maharoma was born, the famous Svarnaroma. Svarnaroma's son was the king Hrasvaroma.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Maharoma was born, the famous Svarnaroma. Svarnaroma's son was the king Hrasvaroma.

verses.sanskrit: केनचित् त्वथ कालेन पुत्रः पुत्रगुणैर्युतः । जज्ञे विश्रवसो राजन्नाम्ना वैश्रवणः श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: kenacit tvatha kālena putraḥ putraguṇairyutaḥ / jajñe viśravaso rājannāmnā vaiśravaṇaḥ śrutaḥ
verses.translation: It is heard that the son of Hrasvaroma was the scholar Slradhvaja. While this king was ploughing, Sita, of great fame, was born. She became the chaste queen of Rama. She was devoted to her husband and a virtuous wife.
verses.hindi: एवंप्रभावों राजा5सोदलस्तु द्विजसत्तमाः । देशे पुण्यतमे चैव मह॒पषिभिरलंकृते १४०
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard that the son of Hrasvaroma was the scholar Slradhvaja. While this king was ploughing, Sita, of great fame, was born. She became the chaste queen of Rama. She was devoted to her husband and a virtuous wife.
