verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard that the son of Hrasvaroma was the scholar Slradhvaja. While this king was ploughing, Sita, of great fame, was born. She became the chaste queen of Rama. She was devoted to her husband and a virtuous wife.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि मौनव्रतं कृत्वा बालभावाद्युधिष्ठिर । सर्वभूताभयं दत्त्वा चचार परमं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: so 'pi maunavrataṃ kṛtvā bālabhāvādyudhiṣṭhira / sarvabhūtābhayaṃ dattvā cacāra paramaṃ vratam
verses.translation: How was Sita of great fame born while (the field) was being ploughed. Why did the king plough the field wherein she was born?
verses.hindi: याचना फौजिये, आप उनसे मिलकर यह कहिये कि महात्मा गान्धर्वों के लोक में मैं स्वदा निवास करते का वरदान चाहता हूँ । उवंशी की इस बात को राजा ने अंगीकार किया और गन्धरवोों से वरदान की याउना की । गन्धवों ने राजा की प्रांना पर यह कहा कि आप जंसा कह रहे हैं, वैसा ही होगा ।” उन लोगों ने स्थाली को आग से भरकर राजा से कहा, नराधिप ! इसी अग्नि से हवन करने पर तुम्हें उक्त गन्धबलोक की प्राप्ति होगी ।४१-४२। तदनन्तर राजा पुरूरवा ने उबंशी के गर्भ से समुत्पन्न कुमार को लेकर अपने नगर को चलने का उपक्रम किया । और उस अग्नि को अरणि में रखकर पुत्र के समेत अपने घर को प्रस्थान किया । वहाँ आने पर उन्होंने उस अग्नि को देखा, और उसे लेने पर अश्वत्थ के वृक्ष का भी उन्हें दर्शन हुआ। समीप में स्थित अद्वत्थ के वृक्ष को देखकर राजा को परम विस्मय हुआ । तब उन्होंने गन्धरवों से इस वृत्तासत को
verses.wordMeaning: How was Sita of great fame born while (the field) was being ploughed. Why did the king plough the field wherein she was born?
verses.commentary: Sense: How was Sita of great fame born while (the field) was being ploughed. Why did the king plough the field wherein she was born?

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तुष्टो महादेवो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मर्षिभिः सह । सखित्वं चेश्वरो दत्त्वा धनदत्वं जगाम ह
verses.transliteration: tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo brahmā brahmarṣibhiḥ saha / sakhitvaṃ ceśvaro dattvā dhanadatvaṃ jagāma ha
verses.translation: While the Agniksetra (the field where sacrifice was to be performed) was being ploughed in accordance with the injunction in the course of the horse-sacrifice of the noble soul she was born out of it.
verses.hindi: कहने का इरादा किया  पृथ्वी पर आये हुए राजा पुरूरवा ने इस अग्नि से यज्ञ करने के बारे में जब गन्धर्वों से जिज्ञासा प्रकट की तब उन लोगों ने सब बातें सुन लेते पर अरणि से मम्थन करने का आदेश दिया। उन्होंने कहा--है नराधिप ! इस अश्वत्य वक्ष से अरणि लेकर विधिवत् मनन्‍्थन करने पर जो अग्नि उत्न्न हो, उसी से हवन करने पर तुम हम लोगों के लोक को प्राप्त करोगे ४४-४७। गर्धवों के कथनानुसार नराधिप
verses.wordMeaning: While the Agniksetra (the field where sacrifice was to be performed) was being ploughed in accordance with the injunction in the course of the horse-sacrifice of the noble soul she was born out of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: While the Agniksetra (the field where sacrifice was to be performed) was being ploughed in accordance with the injunction in the course of the horse-sacrifice of the noble soul she was born out of it.

verses.sanskrit: यमेन्द्रवरुणानां च चतुर्थस्त्वं भविष्यसि । ब्रह्माप्युक्त्वा जगामाशु लोकपालत्वम् ईप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: yamendravaruṇānāṃ ca caturthastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi / brahmāpyuktvā jagāmāśu lokapālatvam īpsitam
verses.translation: From Slradhvaja was born the Maithila (king of Mithila) named Bhanuman. His brother was Kusadhvaja, the lord and king of Kasl.
verses.hindi: पुरूरवा ने अरणि का मन्धन कर अग्नि को तीन भागों में विभक्त कर यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान किया, और अनेक प्रकार के यज्ञों का विधान समाप्त कर गन्धवों का लोक प्राप्त किया  वहाँ निवास के लिये उनसे गनन्‍्धर्वों के समान सुविधा प्राप्त की, त्रेता युग में वह राजा पुरूरवा महारथी था, अग्नि पूब॑ काल में केवल एक थे, उसने उनका तीव विभाग किया। ऋषिवृस्द ! इला का पुत्र वह राजा पुरुरवा इसी प्रकार का महान् प्रभावशाली एवं योद्धा था । महषियों से सुशोभित परम पुण्यप्रद प्रयाग तीर्थ में वह प्रथ्वी पति राज्य करता था, उस मह
verses.wordMeaning: From Slradhvaja was born the Maithila (king of Mithila) named Bhanuman. His brother was Kusadhvaja, the lord and king of Kasl.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Slradhvaja was born the Maithila (king of Mithila) named Bhanuman. His brother was Kusadhvaja, the lord and king of Kasl.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वनन्तरे काले कैकसी नाम राक्षसी । पातालं भूतलं त्यक्त्वा विश्रवं चकमे पतिम्
verses.transliteration: tatastvanantare kāle kaikasī nāma rākṣasī / pātālaṃ bhūtalaṃ tyaktvā viśravaṃ cakame patim
verses.translation: Bhanuman's son was the valorous Pradyumna. His son was Muni and from him Urjavaha is remembered (as born).
verses.hindi: राज्यं स कारयामास प्रयागे परथिवीपतिः । उत्तरे यामुने तीरे प्रतिष्ठाने महायशाः ५१ तस्थ पुत्रा बभव॒ह षडिस्द्रोपमतेजसः । गन्धवंलोके विदिता आयुर्धोसानसावसुः ५२ विश्वायुश्च शतायुश्व॒ गतायुश्चोबंशीसुताः । अमावसोस्तु वे जातो भीमो राजाइ्थ विश्वजित्
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanuman's son was the valorous Pradyumna. His son was Muni and from him Urjavaha is remembered (as born).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanuman's son was the valorous Pradyumna. His son was Muni and from him Urjavaha is remembered (as born).

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रो ऽथ रावणो जातस्तस्या भरतसत्तम । कुम्भकर्णो महारक्षो धर्मात्मा च विभीषणः
verses.transliteration: putro 'tha rāvaṇo jātastasyā bharatasattama / kumbhakarṇo mahārakṣo dharmātmā ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: From Orjavaha was born Sutadvaja. Sakuni was his son. Sakuni's son was Svagata. 1 Suvarcas is remembered as his son.
verses.hindi: श्रीमान्भी मस्य दायादो राजाउब्सीत्का्नप्रभः। विद्वांस्तु काच्चनस्यापि सुहोत्रोइभुन्महाबलः ४५४ सुहोत्रस्याभवज्जह नुः कौशिकागर्भसंभव: । प्रतिगत्य ततो गड्भा बितते यज्ञकमंणि ३५४५ प्लावयामास त॑ देशं भाविनोथंस्य दर्शनात् । गद्भाया प्लाबितं दृष्ट्वा यज्ञवार्ट समन्‍्ततः ५६
verses.wordMeaning: From Orjavaha was born Sutadvaja. Sakuni was his son. Sakuni's son was Svagata. 1 Suvarcas is remembered as his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Orjavaha was born Sutadvaja. Sakuni was his son. Sakuni's son was Svagata. 1 Suvarcas is remembered as his son.

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भश्चैव विकुम्भश्च कुम्भकर्णसुतावुभौ । महाबलौ महावीर्यौ महान्तौ पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: kumbhaścaiva vikumbhaśca kumbhakarṇasutāvubhau / mahābalau mahāvīryau mahāntau puruṣottama
verses.translation: Sruta was his successor. Susruta was his son. Jaya was Susruta's son. Vijaya was the son of Jaya.
verses.hindi: एतत्ते बिफूलूं सर्व पीतमम्भः करोम्यहम् । राजषिणा ततः पीतां गड्ां दृष्द्वा सुरषेय (५८ उपनिन्युमहाभागा दुहितृत्वेन जाह्नवीम् । योवनाश्वस्य पोन्नों तु कावेरों जह नुरावहत् १५६ युवनाभ्वस्य शापेन गड्भां येन विनिम॑मे । कावेरी सरितां श्रेष्ठां जह नुभयामिनिन्दिताम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sruta was his successor. Susruta was his son. Jaya was Susruta's son. Vijaya was the son of Jaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sruta was his successor. Susruta was his son. Jaya was Susruta's son. Vijaya was the son of Jaya.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्कूरो राक्षसश्रेष्ठः कुम्भस्य तनयो महान् । विभीषणं च गुणवद्दृष्ट्वैवं राक्षसोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: aṅkūro rākṣasaśreṣṭhaḥ kumbhasya tanayo mahān / vibhīṣaṇaṃ ca guṇavaddṛṣṭvaivaṃ rākṣasottamaḥ
verses.translation: Vijaya's son was Rta and Sunaya was the son of Rta. From Sunaya was born Vitahavya, and Vitahavya's son was
verses.hindi: जह् नुश्च दयित पुत्र सुहोत्रं नाम घामिकस् । कावेया जनयामास अजकस्तस्य चाउ5त्मजः यक्षस्वी की राजधानी यमुना के पविन्न उत्तर तट पर अवस्थित प्रतिष्ठान पुर में थी ।४५०५१॥ उस राजा पुरुरवा के इन्द्र के समान महान् तेजस्वी छः पुत्र थे, गन्धवों के लोक में इनकी बड़ी प्रतिष्ठा और ख्याति थी। उनके नाम थे आयु, श्रीमान्, अमावसु, विश्वायु, छतायु ओर गतायु--ये सब उवंशी के पुत्र थे । अमावसु के पुत्र राजा मीम हुए, जो विध्व-विजयी थे । उस राजा भीम का उत्तराधिकारी परम कल्तिमान् राजा काइचनप्रभ हुआ।
verses.wordMeaning: Vijaya's son was Rta and Sunaya was the son of Rta. From Sunaya was born Vitahavya, and Vitahavya's son was
verses.commentary: Sense: Vijaya's son was Rta and Sunaya was the son of Rta. From Sunaya was born Vitahavya, and Vitahavya's son was

verses.sanskrit: ततः स यौवनं प्राप्य ज्ञात्वा रक्षः पितामहम् । परं निर्वेदमापन्नश्चचार सुमहत्तपः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa yauvanaṃ prāpya jñātvā rakṣaḥ pitāmaham / paraṃ nirvedamāpannaścacāra sumahattapaḥ
verses.translation: Dhrti's son was Bahulasva and Bahulasva's son was Krti. 2 It is with him that the race of Janaka is terminated. Thus the Maithilas (kings of Mithila) are enumerated. Understand the race of Soma also.
verses.hindi: काव्चनप्रभ का पुत्र महाबलवान् एवं परम विद्वान् राजा सुहोत्र हुआ ।१५२-४४। राजा सुहोत्र के पुश्र जह नु हुए, ये राजा जह्नु कौछिका के भर्भ से उत्पन्न हुए थे। इन राजा जहनु ने एक बार पृथ्वी पर यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान प्रारम्भ किया था, समस्त यज्ञ सामग्रियाँ पृथ्वी पर विस्तृत थीं, भावी वश गंगा की धारा ने उस प्रान्त को अपने जल से प्लाबित कर दिया। चारों ओर से यज्ञ भूमि को गंगा से प्लावित देखकर सुहोन्न के पुत्र राजा जह नु को,
verses.wordMeaning: Dhrti's son was Bahulasva and Bahulasva's son was Krti. 2 It is with him that the race of Janaka is terminated. Thus the Maithilas (kings of Mithila) are enumerated. Understand the race of Soma also.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhrti's son was Bahulasva and Bahulasva's son was Krti. 2 It is with him that the race of Janaka is terminated. Thus the Maithilas (kings of Mithila) are enumerated. Understand the race of Soma also.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणं पश्चिमं गत्वा सागरं पूर्वमुत्तरम् । नर्मदायां प्रसङ्गेन ह्यङ्कूरो राक्षसेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇaṃ paścimaṃ gatvā sāgaraṃ pūrvamuttaram / narmadāyāṃ prasaṅgena hyaṅkūro rākṣaseśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The list in AIHT, shows that our text and Bd.P. jumped twelve generations downwards and declared Svagata as the son of Sakuni.
verses.hindi: जो परम दयालु और याचकों को मन चाहा देनेवाले थे, परम क्रोध आ गया, आँखें क्रोध से लाल हो गईं, और उसी भावावेश में उन्होंने कहा-गरु ! इह धमंड का फल तुम्हें शीत्र ही मिलेगा, तुम्हारे इस सब जल राशि को पीकर मैं व्यर्थ किये देता हूँ ।' ।१५५-५७३। ऐसा कह कर राजषि जहनु ने गंगा कौ समस्त जलराशि पी डाली । महाभाग्यशाली देवता ओर ऋषिगण गज्जा के पीने को देखकर गड्भा को उनकी कन्या के रूप में उपहार स्वरूप समपित कर दिया, तभी से गज्भा का नाम जाह्नवी पड़ा । राजा योवनाइव की पौन्री कावेरी को जह नु ने पत्नी रूप में अंगीकार किया था। युवनाश्व के शाप से उसने गज़ा का निर्माण किया था जह नु को भार्या कावेरी सरिताओं में श्रेष्ठ एवं प्रशंसनीय गुणों वालों है। जहनु ने कावेरी में परम धामिक सुहोत्र नामक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया, जो उसका परम प्रिय था। उसका पुत्र अजक हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: The list in AIHT, shows that our text and Bd.P. jumped twelve generations downwards and declared Svagata as the son of Sakuni.
verses.commentary: Sense: The list in AIHT, shows that our text and Bd.P. jumped twelve generations downwards and declared Svagata as the son of Sakuni.

verses.sanskrit: तपश्चचार सुमहद्दिव्यं वर्षशतं किल । ततस्तुष्टो महादेवः साक्षात् परपुरंजयः
verses.transliteration: tapaścacāra sumahaddivyaṃ varṣaśataṃ kila / tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ sākṣāt parapuraṃjayaḥ
verses.translation: Krtaksana in AIHT,
verses.hindi: अजकस्य तु दायादो बलाकाश्वो महायशाः। बभृवुश्च॒ मयः शीलः कुशस्तस्या5घत्मज: स्मपृत:
verses.wordMeaning: Krtaksana in AIHT,
verses.commentary: Sense: Krtaksana in AIHT,

verses.sanskrit: वरेण छन्दयामास राक्षसं वृषकेतनः । वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते तव दास्यामि सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: vareṇa chandayāmāsa rākṣasaṃ vṛṣaketanaḥ / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te tava dāsyāmi suvrata
verses.translation: The highly intelligent Brahmana had sublimated his sexual urge. He stood without even winking his eyes. His body attained the status of Soma.
verses.hindi: सुदुर्ग तापसं दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षः पुरंदरः  समर्थ: पुत्रजनने स्वयसेवास्य शाश्वत: १६५ तां गाधिः पुत्रा काव्याय रुचीकय दो प्रभुः द
verses.wordMeaning: The highly intelligent Brahmana had sublimated his sexual urge. He stood without even winking his eyes. His body attained the status of Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The highly intelligent Brahmana had sublimated his sexual urge. He stood without even winking his eyes. His body attained the status of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच राक्षसो वाक्यं देवदेवं महेश्वरम् । वरदं सो ऽग्रतो दृष्ट्वा प्रणम्य च पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: provāca rākṣaso vākyaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram / varadaṃ so 'grato dṛṣṭvā praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: The sage of sanctified soul in the state of Soma rose up (to the sky). The Soma juice exuded from his eyes illuminating all the quarters.
verses.hindi: तथा चा55हय णिधतिम्रचीकों भागंवस्तदा । उपयोज्यश्ररुरयं त्वया मात्रा च ते शुभे . ६६
verses.wordMeaning: The sage of sanctified soul in the state of Soma rose up (to the sky). The Soma juice exuded from his eyes illuminating all the quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage of sanctified soul in the state of Soma rose up (to the sky). The Soma juice exuded from his eyes illuminating all the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: यदि तुष्टो महादेव वरदो ऽसि सुरेश्वर । दुर्लभं सर्वभूतानाममरत्वं प्रयच्छ मे
verses.transliteration: yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva varado 'si sureśvara / durlabhaṃ sarvabhūtānāmamaratvaṃ prayaccha me
verses.translation: On being ordered by Vidhi (Brahma), the ten Devis (i.e. the quarters) gathered together there and received it in their womb collectively, but could not do so (for long).
verses.hindi: िताननसन लक करनान सका -++ “मनन कैम". --7:-4--4-44--ननरनकन५- ५-3५ +-- तनमन ना अजक का उत्तराधिकारी राजा बलाकाश्व परम यशस्वी राजा था । उसके गय, शील और कुश नामक पुत्र कहे जाते हैं। कुश के चार पुत्र हुए, जो वेद ज्ञान में यहा प्राप्त करनेवाले थे, उनके बाम थे कुशाइव, कुशनाभ, अमूतंरयश् और वसु। राजाओं में श्रेष्ठ कुशस्तम्ब ने पुत्र प्राप्ति के लिये तपस्या की, एक सहख्र वर्ष बीतने पर उसने इस्द्र का दर्शन किया ! ।६२-६४। स हस्ननेत्रवाले पुरनदर ने परम कठोर तप ३
verses.wordMeaning: On being ordered by Vidhi (Brahma), the ten Devis (i.e. the quarters) gathered together there and received it in their womb collectively, but could not do so (for long).
verses.commentary: Sense: On being ordered by Vidhi (Brahma), the ten Devis (i.e. the quarters) gathered together there and received it in their womb collectively, but could not do so (for long).

verses.sanskrit: मम नाम्ना स्थितो ऽनेन वरेण त्रिपुरान्तक । सदा संनिहितो ऽप्यत्र तीर्थे भवितुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: mama nāmnā sthito 'nena vareṇa tripurāntaka / sadā saṃnihito 'pyatra tīrthe bhavitum arhasi
verses.translation: When those goddesses (ladies) were unable to hold the foetus in their wombs, the foetus endowed with lustre, illu¬ minated the worlds like the Moon (now) blessing everyone; it emerged from the quarters (womb of the ladies) and fell on the ground (assuming the form of) the Moon along with them (the goddesses).
verses.hindi: में निरत राजा कुशस्तम्ब को देखकर, स्वयमेव उनके पुत्र रूप में होने का निश्चय किया। इस प्रकार पुरन्वर ने स्वयमेव पुत्रत्व॒ का निश्चय किया। पाकज्ासब इस्द्र राजा कुशस्तम्ब के पुत्र के रूप सें ग्राधि नाम से ख्यात हुए, उनका एक दूसरा कौशिक नाम भी हुआ। राजा कुशस्तम्ब की पत्नी पौरकुत्सा थो, जिसमें गाधि की उत्पत्ति हुई। महाभाग्यशालिती, कल्याणदायिनी बड़ी कन्या सत्यवत्ती को ऐदवर्यशाली ग्राधि ने भगु गोत्र में
verses.wordMeaning: When those goddesses (ladies) were unable to hold the foetus in their wombs, the foetus endowed with lustre, illu¬ minated the worlds like the Moon (now) blessing everyone;…
verses.commentary: Sense: When those goddesses (ladies) were unable to hold the foetus in their wombs, the foetus endowed with lustre, illu¬ minated the worlds like the Moon (now) blessing everyone;…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: यावद् विभीषणमतं यावद् धर्मनिषेवणम् । करिष्यसि दृढात्मा त्वं तावदेतद्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: yāvad vibhīṣaṇamataṃ yāvad dharmaniṣevaṇam / kariṣyasi dṛḍhātmā tvaṃ tāvadetadbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On seeing Soma falling, Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, placed him in a chariot, with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न होने वाले रुचीक को समपित किया। ।६५-६७। उस सत्यवती में भुगुनन्दन, भुगुबंश शिरोमणि जमदग्नि उत्पन्न हुए । भूगुवंशोत्पन्न ऋषिवर्य रुचीक ने अपने और गाधि के पुत्र के लिए एक चंद बनाया। अपनी पत्नी णिधृति (सत्यवती) को बुलाकर उन्होंने कहा, 'कल्याणी ! यह चरु तुम और तुम्हारी माता इस क्रम से खाना । इसके प्रभाव से तुम्हारी माता में क्षत्रिय जाति में श्रेष्ठ, परमका न्तिमान् एक पुत्र उत्पन्न होगा, वह युद्धभमि में अन्यास्य क्षत्रियों द्वारा पराजित नहीं होगा, बड़े बड़े योद्धा क्षत्रियों का वह विनाश करनेवाला होगा। हे कल्याणि ! तुम्हारा पुत्र भी परम ज्ञान्त, तपोमय, धैयंशाली एवं बुद्धिमा नू होगा  यह चरु उसे ब्राह्मण जाति में सर्वश्रेष्ठ बनायेगा, अर्थात् इसके प्रभाव से वह समस्त ब्राह्मण जाति में श्रेष्ठ गुणोंवाला होगा
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Soma falling, Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, placed him in a chariot, with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Soma falling, Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, placed him in a chariot, with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ययौ देवः सर्वदैवतपूजितः । विमानेनार्कवर्णेन कैलासं धरणीधरम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā yayau devaḥ sarvadaivatapūjitaḥ / vimānenārkavarṇena kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, indeed he (the Moon) was a Deva(god) himself, a seeker of righteousness and truthful to the. promise. We have heard that (the chariot) was (fitted with) yoked to a thousand white horses.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्‍त्वा तु तां भायस्रचीको भूगुनन्दनः । तपस्थाभिरतो नित्यमरण्यं प्रविवेश ह (७१ गाधिः सदारस्तु तदा ऋचीकाश्रसमभ्यगात् । तीर्थयात्राप्रसद्भोन सुतां द्रष्दुं नरेश्वरः ७२ चरुद्रयं गृहीत्वा तु ऋषे: सत्यवती तदा । भर्तुरबंचनमव्यग्रा हृष्ठा मात्रे न्‍्यवेदयत्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, indeed he (the Moon) was a Deva(god) himself, a seeker of righteousness and truthful to the. promise. We have heard that (the chariot) was (fitted with) yoked to a thousand white horses.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, indeed he (the Moon) was a Deva(god) himself, a seeker of righteousness and truthful to the. promise. We have heard that (the chariot) was (fitted with) yoked to a thousand white horses.

verses.sanskrit: गते चादर्शनं देवे स्नात्वाचम्य विधानतः । स्थापयामास राजेन्द्र ह्यङ्कूरेश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: gate cādarśanaṃ deve snātvācamya vidhānataḥ / sthāpayāmāsa rājendra hyaṅkūreśvaramuttamam
verses.translation: When that great soul, the son of Atri, had fallen,
verses.hindi: माता तु तस्‍्ये देवेन दुहित्रे स्व॑ चर ददौ । तस्याश्वरुमधाज्ञानादात्मगः सा चकार ह ७४ अथ सत्यवती गर्भ क्षत्रियान्तकरं शुभम् । धारयामास दीप्तेन वपुबा घोरदर्शना ७५ तमृचीकस्ततो दृष्ट्वा योगेनाप्यनुमृश्य व । तदाइब्रवीदृद्विजश्रेष्ठः स्वां भार्या वरवणिनीमू मात्राईसि वन्च्चिता भद्े चश्व॒त्या सहेतुना । जनिष्यति हि पुत्रस्ते क्रूरकर्माइतिदारुण: ७७ माता जनिष्यते वाइपि तथाभूतं तपोधनम् । विश्व हि ब्रह्म तपसा मया तत्न समपितम् ७८
verses.wordMeaning: When that great soul, the son of Atri, had fallen,
verses.commentary: Sense: When that great soul, the son of Atri, had fallen,

verses.sanskrit: गन्धपुष्पैस्तथा धूपैर्वस्त्रालङ्कारभूषणैः । पताकैश् चामरैश् छत्रैर् जयशब्दादिमंगलैः
verses.transliteration: gandhapuṣpaistathā dhūpairvastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ / patākaiś cāmaraiś chatrair jayaśabdādimaṃgalaiḥ
verses.translation: There itself, the sons of Angiras and Bhj*gu eulogised by means, of Rks, Yajur mantras and many Atharva Ahgirasa mantras.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणापसदस्त्वन्य इत्युक्तो मुनिरब्रवीत् ७६ नेष संकल्पितः कामो मया भद्रे तथा त्वया। उप्रकर्मा भवेत्पुत्रः पितुर्मातुश्च कारणात् ८०
verses.wordMeaning: There itself, the sons of Angiras and Bhj*gu eulogised by means, of Rks, Yajur mantras and many Atharva Ahgirasa mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: There itself, the sons of Angiras and Bhj*gu eulogised by means, of Rks, Yajur mantras and many Atharva Ahgirasa mantras.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयित्वा सुरेशानं स्तोत्रैर्हृद्यैः सुपुष्कलैः । जगाम भवनं रक्षो यत्र राजा विभीषणः
verses.transliteration: pūjayitvā sureśānaṃ stotrairhṛdyaiḥ supuṣkalaiḥ / jagāma bhavanaṃ rakṣo yatra rājā vibhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The brilliance of the shining Moon who was being eulo¬ gised, developed further and it purified all the three worlds.
verses.hindi: भुगुवंशोत्पन्न ऋचीक अपनी ज्री सत्यवती से ये बातें कर तपस्या के लिए जंगल की ओर चले गये, वे सवंदा तपस्या ही में लगे रहते थे  संयोगतः उसी अवसर पर अपनी स्त्री समेत राजा गाधि ऋचीक के आश्रम पर तीर्थयात्रा के प्रसंग से घूमते घुमते अपनो पुत्री को देखने को आ गये ॥9१-७२। परम शाभ्तचित्त सत्यवती ने ऋषिवरय ऋचीक के दिये हुए दोनों चझओं को लेकर परमप्रसन्‍न मन से माता से उस वृत्तास्त को साचन्‍्त बतलाया । भाग्यवश उनकी माता ने अपना चर पुत्री सत्यवती को दिया और बिना उसका प्रभाव जाने ही सत्य- बती के चरु को स्वयं ग्रहण किया । फलतः सत्यवती ने क्षत्रियों का विनाश करनेवाला परम तेजस्वी गर्भ को धारण किया । उस समय उसकी कान्ति बहुत बढ़ गई, शरीर से वह भयानक दिखाई पड़ने लगी । द्विजश्र ष्ठ ऋचीक ने अपनी सुन्दरी पत्नी की यह दशा देखकर योगबल से सारी स्थिति जान ली । वे बोले, भद्दे ! माता ने तुम्हें ठग
verses.wordMeaning: The brilliance of the shining Moon who was being eulo¬ gised, developed further and it purified all the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brilliance of the shining Moon who was being eulo¬ gised, developed further and it purified all the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पूजितः स यथान्यायं दानसन्मानगौरवैः । सौदर्ये स्थापितो भावे सो ऽवात्सीत्परयामुदा
verses.transliteration: pūjitaḥ sa yathānyāyaṃ dānasanmānagauravaiḥ / saudarye sthāpito bhāve so 'vātsītparayāmudā
verses.translation: In that prominent chariot, he circumambulated the earth extending upto the ocean twenty-one times.
verses.hindi: लिया है, उसने विशेष कारण से तुम्हारे चरु को स्वयं ले लिया है इसके फलस्वरूप तुम्हारा पुत्र परम कठोर वित्तवाला एवं क्ररकर्मा उत्पन्न होगा ।७३-७७ और तुम्हारी माता, परम तपस्वी पुत्र उत्पन्न करेगी, जैसा मैंने तुम्हें बतलाया था । मैंने तुम्हारे उस चरु में अपने तपोबल से समस्त ब्रह्मज्ञान को समर्पित किया था । पति के ऐसा कहने पर महाभाग्यशालिनी सत्यवती ने पति की बड़ी आराधना की और इस बात के लिए राजी किया कि मेरा
verses.wordMeaning: In that prominent chariot, he circumambulated the earth extending upto the ocean twenty-one times.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that prominent chariot, he circumambulated the earth extending upto the ocean twenty-one times.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम् । अङ्कूरेश्वरनामानं सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / aṅkūreśvaranāmānaṃ so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: His splendour that reached the earth became medicinal herbs. They sparkle by means of his brilliance.
verses.hindi: पुत्र वैसा न हो जो नीच ब्राह्मण कहा जाय ।” सत्यवती की इस प्रार्थना पर मुनिवर ऋचीक ने कहा; भद्ठी ! भेंने या तुमने विचार करके ऐसी इच्छा नहीं की थी कि हमारा पुत्र ऐसा क्रूर कर्मा हो अर्थात् यह देव विधान है। प्रायः पिता और माता के कारण से पुत्र उग्रकर्मे करनेवाले होते हैं॥७८-८०। ऋचीक के ऐसा कहने पर सत्यवती पपैय वायुपुराणम् पुनः सत्यवती वाक्यमेवमुक्त्वाउन्रवीदिदस् । इच्छल्लेंकानपि मुने सुजेथा: किः पुनः सुतप्
verses.wordMeaning: His splendour that reached the earth became medicinal herbs. They sparkle by means of his brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: His splendour that reached the earth became medicinal herbs. They sparkle by means of his brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्यखातमारभ्य सङ्गमं वापि यच्छुभम् । रेवाया आमलक्याश्च देवक्षेत्रं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavyakhātamārabhya saṅgamaṃ vāpi yacchubham / revāyā āmalakyāśca devakṣetraṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: O excellent Brahamans! He sustains subjects of four types and the universe with them (herbs). Lord Soma is indeed the nourisher of the universe.
verses.hindi: शमात्सकमजु भर्त: पुत्र मे दातुमहेसि । काससेवंविधः पुत्रो सम स्यात्तु बद प्रभो ८२ मय्यन्यथा न शक्यं बे कर्तुमेव द्विजोत्तम । ततः प्रसादमकरोत्स तस्यास्तपसो बलात्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahamans! He sustains subjects of four types and the universe with them (herbs). Lord Soma is indeed the nourisher of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahamans! He sustains subjects of four types and the universe with them (herbs). Lord Soma is indeed the nourisher of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्यखातात् पश्चिमतस्तीर्थं तदङ्कूरेश्वरम् । तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा शुचिः प्रयतमानसः
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavyakhātāt paścimatastīrthaṃ tadaṅkūreśvaram / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: Having acquired splendour through the penance (of Atri), the eulogy (of Devas and sages) and his own religious activities, the blessed one (Soma) performed penance for ten times ten Padma years, (one Padma<= a thousand billion).
verses.hindi: पुत्रे नास्ति विशेषों से पोत्रे वा वरवरणिनि। त्वया यथोक्त बचन तथा भद्दे भविष्यति ८४ तस्मात्सत्यवती पुत्र जनयामास भागंवम् । तपंस्यभिरतं दान्‍्तं जमर्दाग्न शमात्मकम् विश्वामित्रं तु दायादं गाधिः कुशिकनदनः । प्राप्य ब्रह्मषिसमतां जगास ब्रह्मणा बृतः ८७ सा हि सत्यवती पुण्या सत्यक्षतपरायणा । कौशिकीति समाख्याता प्रवत्तेयं महानदो ८८ परिश्रुता महाभागा कोशिकी सरितां बरा । इक्ष्वाकुबंशे त्वभवत्सुवेणुर्नाण पार्थिव: ८६ तस्य कन्या सहाभागा कामली नाम रेणुका। रेणुकायां तु कासल्यां तपोधुतिसमन्वितः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Having acquired splendour through the penance (of Atri), the eulogy (of Devas and sages) and his own religious activities, the blessed one (Soma) performed penance for ten times ten Padma years, (one Padma<= a thousand billion).
verses.commentary: Sense: Having acquired splendour through the penance (of Atri), the eulogy (of Devas and sages) and his own religious activities, the blessed one (Soma) performed penance for ten times ten Padma years, (one Padma<= a thousand billion).

verses.sanskrit: सन्ध्यामाचम्य यत्नेन जपं कृत्वाथ भारत । तर्पयित्वा पित्ःन्देवान् मनुष्यान् भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration: sandhyāmācamya yatnena japaṃ kṛtvātha bhārata / tarpayitvā pitḥndevān manuṣyān bharatarṣabha
verses.translation: Soma who is famous by his own Karmans will be the pervader of those (ten) gold-complexioned goddesses (viz. quarters) who sustain the whole world.
verses.hindi: आर्चोको जनयामास जमदग्नि: सुदारुणम् १९०
verses.wordMeaning: Soma who is famous by his own Karmans will be the pervader of those (ten) gold-complexioned goddesses (viz. quarters) who sustain the whole world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Soma who is famous by his own Karmans will be the pervader of those (ten) gold-complexioned goddesses (viz. quarters) who sustain the whole world.

verses.sanskrit: सचैलः क्लिन्नवसनो मौनमास्थाय संयतः । अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्दश्याम् उपोष्य विधिवन्नरः
verses.transliteration: sacailaḥ klinnavasano maunamāsthāya saṃyataḥ / aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyām upoṣya vidhivannaraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, Brahma the foremost among the knowers of Brahman, entrusted him with the kingdom of seeds, herbs, Brahmanas and waters.
verses.hindi: पुनः बोली, मुंनिवर्य ! आप इच्छा करें तो समस्त लोकों की सृष्टि कर सकते हैं, ऐसे पुत्र को उत्पन्न करने की तो बात ही क्या है ? है पतिदेव ! मुझे परम शान्‍्त, सरल, एवं सत्पुरुष पुत्र दोजिये। यह तो हो सकता है कि हमारा पौत्र उग्र एवं कठोर स्वभाववाला हो । है प्रभो ! द्विजोत्तम  अब मेरे लिये यह-तो करना ही होगा । आप अन्यथा नहीं करेंगे--ऐसी विशेष प्रार्थना कर रहो हूं ! मुनिवर ऋचीक ने अपने तपोबल से उसकी मनः कामना पूर्ण कर प्रसन्न किया । वे बोले, सुन्दरि ! मुझे पुत्र या पौत्र किसी में कोई विशेषता नहीं दिखाई पड़ती, किन्तु तुम्हारा थदि आग्रह ऐसा है तो मैं बंसा ही करूँगा, भद्दे  तुम्हारी बात सत्य होयी ।८१-८४। ऋचोक के वचनानुसार सत्यवती ने भागंव जमदग्नि को उत्पन्न किया । वे परमशान्त, क्षमाक्षील एवं तपः परायण थे। इस भ्रकार प्राचीनकाल में रुद्व एवं विष्णु के चर में परिवतंन हो जाने से विष्णु एवं अग्नि
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, Brahma the foremost among the knowers of Brahman, entrusted him with the kingdom of seeds, herbs, Brahmanas and waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, Brahma the foremost among the knowers of Brahman, entrusted him with the kingdom of seeds, herbs, Brahmanas and waters.

verses.sanskrit: पूजां यः कुरुते राजंस्तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु । साग्रं तु योजनशतं तीर्थान्यायतनानि च
verses.transliteration: pūjāṃ yaḥ kurute rājaṃstasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / sāgraṃ tu yojanaśataṃ tīrthānyāyatanāni ca
verses.translation: Being naturally the foremost among those who shine brilliantly and, thereafter, being crowned over a big kingdom, (Soma) of great splendour became the king of kings and puri¬ fied the worlds and developed them.
verses.hindi: के तेज के जमन (भक्षण) किये जाने से भृगुवंश में जमदस्नि नामक ऋषि उत्पन्न हुए  इधर कुशिकनन्दन ग्राप्रि ने विदवामित्र को पुत्र रूप में उत्पन्न किया, उन विश्वामित्र ने ब्रह्मधियों की समानता प्राप्त कर ब्राह्मणों समेत स्वयं को प्रस्थान किया  सत्यव्रत परायण वह सत्यवती परम पुष्यदायिनी महानदी कौछिकी के नाम से प्रवाहित हुई ।८५-५८८। महाभाग्यश्ालिनी, नदियों में श्रेष्ठ कोशिकी को परम ख्याति प्राप्त हुई। इक्ष्वाकु के थंश में सुधेण्
verses.wordMeaning: Being naturally the foremost among those who shine brilliantly and, thereafter, being crowned over a big kingdom, (Soma) of great splendour became the king of kings and puri¬ fied the worlds and developed them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being naturally the foremost among those who shine brilliantly and, thereafter, being crowned over a big kingdom, (Soma) of great splendour became the king of kings and puri¬ fied the worlds and developed them.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्ति तानि दृष्टानि ततः पापैः प्रमुच्यते । तत्र तीर्थे तु यद्दानं देवमुद्दिश्य दीयते
verses.transliteration: bhavanti tāni dṛṣṭāni tataḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate / tatra tīrthe tu yaddānaṃ devamuddiśya dīyate
verses.translation: Daksa, the son of Pracetas, gave twenty-seven Daksa- yanls (daughters of Daksa) of great holy rites to Indu (the Moon). They (people) know them as Naksatras (constellations). Having attained that great kingdom, Soma the lord of possessors of Sonia (i.e. Brahmanas) performed the Rajasuya sacrifice, wherein the Daksina amounted to hundred thousands.
verses.hindi: नामक एक राजा थे। उनकी कन्या महाभाग्यशालिनी कामली थी, जिसका दूसरा नाम रेणका भी था, उस कामली रेणुका में परम तपस्वी, धेयंशील, ऋचीक के पुत्र जमदरिन ने परम कठोर स्वभाववाले परशुराम को उत्पन्न किया, वे परशुराम सभी विद्याओं में पारंगत, विशेषतया धनुर्वेद के परम जानकार, क्षत्रियों के विनादाक सर्वविद्यास्तगं श्रेष्ठ धनु्वेदस्य पारगम् । राम॑ क्षत्रियहन्तार॑ प्रदीप्तमिव पावकम् 0६ १ ओर्व॑स्थेबम्तत्तोकस्य सत्यवत्यां महासनाः । जमदग्निस्तपोवीर्याज्जज्ञे ब्रह्मविदां वरः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Daksa, the son of Pracetas, gave twenty-seven Daksa- yanls (daughters of Daksa) of great holy rites to Indu (the Moon). They (people) know them as Naksatras (constellations). Having attained that great kingdom, Soma the lord of possessors of Sonia (i.e.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Daksa, the son of Pracetas, gave twenty-seven Daksa- yanls (daughters of Daksa) of great holy rites to Indu (the Moon). They (people) know them as Naksatras (constellations). Having attained that great kingdom, Soma the lord of possessors of Sonia (i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तु विधिवत्पात्रे तदक्षयमुदाहृतम् । होमाद्दशगुणं प्रोक्तं फलं जाप्ये ततो ऽधिकम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā tu vidhivatpātre tadakṣayamudāhṛtam / homāddaśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ phalaṃ jāpye tato 'dhikam
verses.translation: In that sacrifice, Hiranyagarbha was the Udgatr (the presiding priest who recites mantras); Brahma occupied the seat of Brahma and lord Narayana Hari was the Sadasya (member of the witnessing assembly). He was surrounded by Sanatkumara and other leading original Brahmarsis. O Brah¬ manas, we have heard that Soma gave the three worlds as
verses.hindi: विश्वामित्रस्तु धर्मात्मा नाम्ना विश्वरथः स्पृतः । जज्ञे मुगुप्रसादेन कौशिकाहंशवर्धनः ९३ विश्वामित्रस्य पुत्रस्तु शुनःशेपो5भवन्पुनिः । हरिश्रन्द्वस्य यज्ञे तु पशुत्वे नियतः स थे १९४ देवर्दत्त: शुनः शेपो विश्वामित्राय वे पुनः । देवदंत्तः स वे यस्माहेवरातस्ततोभवत् ६५ विश्वामित्रस्य पुत्राणां शुनःशेपो5्ग्रजः स्मृतः । मधुच्छन्दों नयश्चेव कृतदेवों प्रुवाष्टको
verses.wordMeaning: In that sacrifice, Hiranyagarbha was the Udgatr (the presiding priest who recites mantras); Brahma occupied the seat of Brahma and lord Narayana Hari was the Sadasya (member of the witnessing assembly). He was surrounded by Sanatkumara and other leading original Brahmarsis.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In that sacrifice, Hiranyagarbha was the Udgatr (the presiding priest who recites mantras); Brahma occupied the seat of Brahma and lord Narayana Hari was the Sadasya (member of the witnessing assembly). He was surrounded by Sanatkumara and other leading original Brahmarsis.…

verses.sanskrit: त्रिगुणं चोपवासेन स्नानेन च चतुर्गुणम् । संन्यासं कुरुते यस्तु प्राणत्यागं करोति वा
verses.transliteration: triguṇaṃ copavāsena snānena ca caturguṇam / saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yastu prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti vā
verses.translation: Nine Devls, viz. Smi,_Kuhu,v P Though implored by Devas and celestial sages, he
verses.hindi: कच्छपः प्रणश्चेव विश्वामित्रसुतास्तु वे । तेषां गोत्राणि बहुधा फोशिकानां महात्मनाम् वाधथिवा वेवराताश्व याज्ञवल्क्या: समर्षंणा: । उद्म्बरः उदुम्लानास्तारका यमसुचचताः ६८ लोहिण्या रेणवश्चेव तथा कारीषवः स्मृता:  बश्रवः पाणिनश्चेव ध्यानजप्यास्तथेव च १६६९
verses.wordMeaning: Nine Devls, viz. Smi,_Kuhu,v P Though implored by Devas and celestial sages, he
verses.commentary: Sense: Nine Devls, viz. Smi,_Kuhu,v P Though implored by Devas and celestial sages, he

verses.sanskrit: अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य रुद्रलोकादसंशयम् । कृमिकीटपतङ्गानां तत्र तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर । अङ्कूरेश्वरनामाख्ये मृतानां सुगतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam / kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira / aṅkūreśvaranāmākhye mṛtānāṃ sugatirbhavet
verses.translation: O Brahraanas, Usanas, one of the Ahgiras (?) took h is side. Indeed, he had been the highly brilliant disciple of Bphas-
verses.hindi: शालावत्या हिरण्याक्षा स्यड॒कृता गालवाः स्पृता: । देवला यामदूताभ्व सालड्भायनबाष्कलाः
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahraanas, Usanas, one of the Ahgiras (?) took h is side. Indeed, he had been the highly brilliant disciple of Bphas-
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahraanas, Usanas, one of the Ahgiras (?) took h is side. Indeed, he had been the highly brilliant disciple of Bphas-

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं राजन्नङ्कूरेश्वरसम्भवम् । तीर्थं सर्वगुणोपेतं परमं पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ rājannaṅkūreśvarasambhavam / tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ paramaṃ pāpanāśanam
verses.translation: Thanks to that affection, lord Rudra took The great miraculous weapon was discharged by that noble soul aiming at the chief Brahmana sage and Devas whereby their fame was destroyed.
verses.hindi: ददातिबादराश्चान्ये विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः  ऋष्यन्तरविवाह्यस्ते बहुवः कोशिका: स्मृता: एवं अग्नि के समान परम तेजस्वी थे । उ् के पुत्र ऋचीक के सत्यवती में ज्येष्ठ पुत्र महामनस्वी जमदग्नि हुए, उनके तपोबल से मध्यम पुत्र शुन'शेप हुए, जो परम ब्रह्मज्ञानी थे। शुनःपुष्छ ऋचीक के सब से कनिष्ठ पुत्र थे ।5६-६९२॥। धर्मात्मा विश्वामित्र विश्वरथ के नाम से प्रख्यात थे । महर्षि भृगु कौ कृपा से ये कौशिक के संयोग से उश्पन्न हुए थे, वे कौशिक वंश में सबसे अधिक प्रभावशाली थे। उन विक््वामित्र के पुत्र शुनःशेप नामक
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to that affection, lord Rudra took The great miraculous weapon was discharged by that noble soul aiming at the chief Brahmana sage and Devas whereby their fame was destroyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to that affection, lord Rudra took The great miraculous weapon was discharged by that noble soul aiming at the chief Brahmana sage and Devas whereby their fame was destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽपि शृण्वन्ति भक्त्येदं कीर्त्यमानं महाफलम् । लभन्ते नात्र सन्देहः शिवस्य भुवनं हि ते
verses.transliteration: ye 'pi śṛṇvanti bhaktyedaṃ kīrtyamānaṃ mahāphalam / labhante nātra sandehaḥ śivasya bhuvanaṃ hi te
verses.translation: There ensued a great battle directly (between Devas andAsuras). It was called Tarakamaya 1 2 (concerningTara?)• It caused great destruction of Devas, Danavas and all the worlds.
verses.hindi: मुनि हुए । वे शुनःशेप राजा हरिशचन्द्र, के यज्ञ कर्म में बलिदान देने के लिये नियुक्त हुए थे। देवताओं ने शुनःशेप को पुनः विश्वामित्र को वापस कर दिया। देवताओं के देने के कारण इनका बाद में देवरात नाम पड़ा । विद्वामित्र के पुत्रों में शुनःशेप सब से बड़े कहे जाते हैं। इनके अतिरिक्त मधुच्छन्द, नय, कत, देव, थ्र व, अष्टक, कच्छप, और पूरण--ये सब भी विद्वाभित्र के पुत्र हैं। इन सबों के गोत्र प्रायः महान् पराक्रमी
verses.wordMeaning: There ensued a great battle directly (between Devas andAsuras). It was called Tarakamaya 1 2 (concerningTara?)• It caused great destruction of Devas, Danavas and all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: There ensued a great battle directly (between Devas andAsuras). It was called Tarakamaya 1 2 (concerningTara?)• It caused great destruction of Devas, Danavas and all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अङ्कूरेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टषष्ट्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १६९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्परं तीर्थं पुण्यं पापप्रणाशनम् । माण्डव्यो यत्र संसिद्ध ऋषिर्नारायणस्तथा
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe aṅkūreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 169 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchetparaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / māṇḍavyo yatra saṃsiddha ṛṣirnārāyaṇastathā
verses.translation: Only three Devas survived. They are remembered by the name Tusitas. They sought shelter in Brahma, the primor¬ dial lord, the grandfather of the worlds.
verses.hindi: कोशिकों के ही हैं ।६३-९७। पाथिव, देवरात, याज्ञवल्व्य, समर्षण, उदृम्बर, उदुम्लान, तारक, यममुच्चत, लोहिष्य, रेणव, कारीषु, बच्चु, पाणिन, ध्यानजप्य, शालावत्य, हिरण्याक्ष, स्पडकृत, गालव, देवल, यामदूत, सालद्भायन, बाष्कल, ददाति एवम् बादर नाम से प्रसिद्ध वंशों में उत्पन्न होनेवालों का परम बुद्धिमान् विश्वामित्र का गोत्र हैं। बहुतेरे कौशिक गोत्र में उत्पन्न होनेवालों का विवाह अन्य ऋषि के गोत्र में उत्पन्न होनेवालों के हदमधं नास्ति के. पुस्तक ।
verses.wordMeaning: Only three Devas survived. They are remembered by the name Tusitas. They sought shelter in Brahma, the primor¬ dial lord, the grandfather of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only three Devas survived. They are remembered by the name Tusitas. They sought shelter in Brahma, the primor¬ dial lord, the grandfather of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणेन शुश्रूषा शूलस्थेन कृता पुरा । तत्र स्नात्वा महाराज मुच्यते पापकञ्चुकात्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇena śuśrūṣā śūlasthena kṛtā purā / tatra snātvā mahārāja mucyate pāpakañcukāt
verses.translation: Then Pitamaha (Brahma) himself prevented Usanas and Rudra, the eldest (deity) Sankara, (from fighting) and handed over Tara to Ahgiras (Brhaspati).
verses.hindi: ह ८२० वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then Pitamaha (Brahma) himself prevented Usanas and Rudra, the eldest (deity) Sankara, (from fighting) and handed over Tara to Ahgiras (Brhaspati).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Pitamaha (Brahma) himself prevented Usanas and Rudra, the eldest (deity) Sankara, (from fighting) and handed over Tara to Ahgiras (Brhaspati).

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: आश्चर्यमेतल्लोकेषु यत्त्वया कथितं मुने । न दृष्टं न श्रुतं तात शूलस्थेन तपः कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: āścaryametallokeṣu yattvayā kathitaṃ mune / na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ tāta śūlasthena tapaḥ kṛtam
verses.translation: Sini and Kuhu are deities presiding over (i) the day preceding the new moon day on which the moon rises with scarcely visible crescent and (ii) the new moon day when the moon is invisible, respectively.
verses.hindi: कौशिक: सौश्रताश्चेव तथाउन्ये सेंघवायना: । पौरोरवस्य पुण्यस्य ब्रह्मषें: कोशिकस्य तु कि लक्षणेत धर्मेण तपसेह श्रुतेन वा । ब्राह्मण्यं समनृप्राप्तं विश्वामित्रादिभिन पेः ॥१ ०४
verses.wordMeaning: Sini and Kuhu are deities presiding over (i) the day preceding the new moon day on which the moon rises with scarcely visible crescent and (ii) the new moon day when the moon is invisible, respectively.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sini and Kuhu are deities presiding over (i) the day preceding the new moon day on which the moon rises with scarcely visible crescent and (ii) the new moon day when the moon is invisible, respectively.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं कथय मे ऋषिभिः सहितस्य वै । अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं माण्डव्यस्य कुतूहलात्
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaṃ kathaya me ṛṣibhiḥ sahitasya vai / asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ māṇḍavyasya kutūhalāt
verses.translation: Out of the twelve wars between Devas and Asuras this was the fifth one.
verses.hindi: धर्माभिकाइक्षी यजते न धर्मफलमश्नुते
verses.wordMeaning: Out of the twelve wars between Devas and Asuras this was the fifth one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of the twelve wars between Devas and Asuras this was the fifth one.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणु राजन्यथावृत्तपुरा त्रेतायुगे क्षितौ । लोकपालोपमो राजा देवपन्नो महामतिः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājanyathāvṛttapurā tretāyuge kṣitau / lokapālopamo rājā devapanno mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that Tara, the lady with a moon-like face, was pregnant, the Brahmana Brhaspati said: "Don't you cast off the foetus?
verses.hindi: धरम चेत॑ समाख्याय पापात्मा पुरुषाधमः । ददाति दान विप्रेभ्यो लोकानां दम्भभारणात् लेन दत्तानि दानानि अफलानि भवन्त्युत । तस्य धर्मेप्रवृत्तत्य हिसकस्य दुरात्मनः १०६ एवं लब्ध्बा धनं मोहाइदतो यजतश्र हु। संक्लिष्टकर्मंणों दाने न तिष्ठति दुरात्मनः ११०
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that Tara, the lady with a moon-like face, was pregnant, the Brahmana Brhaspati said: "Don't you cast off the foetus?
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that Tara, the lady with a moon-like face, was pregnant, the Brahmana Brhaspati said: "Don't you cast off the foetus?

verses.sanskrit: धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च यज्वा दानरतः सदा । प्रजा ररक्ष यत्नेन पिता पुत्रान् इवौरसान्
verses.transliteration: dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca yajvā dānarataḥ sadā / prajā rarakṣa yatnena pitā putrān ivaurasān
verses.translation: In (your) body belonging to me another foetus shall by no means be held in the womb." Still she did not cast off the child • Dasyu-hantama * (the slayer of robbers).
verses.hindi: साथ कहा जाता है  कौशिक, सौश्रुत एवं सैंधवायन नाम से प्रसिद्ध वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले, पुरूरवा के बंश में उत्पन्न पुण्यद्वाली ब्रह्म कौशिक के गोत्र में कहे जाते हैं। विश्वामित्र से दुषद्वती में उत्पन्न होनेवाले एक पुत्र का नाम अष्टक था, अष्टक के पुत्र जह नुगण हुए, जिसका वर्णन ऊपर किया जा चुका ।६८-१० हे।
verses.wordMeaning: In (your) body belonging to me another foetus shall by no means be held in the womb." Still she did not cast off the child • Dasyu-hantama * (the slayer of robbers).
verses.commentary: Sense: In (your) body belonging to me another foetus shall by no means be held in the womb." Still she did not cast off the child • Dasyu-hantama * (the slayer of robbers).

verses.sanskrit: दात्यायनी प्रिया भार्या तस्य राज्ञो वशानुगा । हारनूपुरघोषेण झङ्काररवनादिता
verses.transliteration: dātyāyanī priyā bhāryā tasya rājño vaśānugā / hāranūpuraghoṣeṇa jhaṅkāraravanāditā
verses.translation: Like the fire that blazes after catching the I§ika grass, the son surpassed the beautiful bodies of Devas at the very instant he was born.
verses.hindi: ऋषिधृन्द् बोले--सृत जी ! इस लोक में उत्पन्न होकर विश्वामित्र प्रभृति क्षत्रिय राजाओं ने किस प्रकार के कम, तपस्या अथवा ज्ञान द्वारा ब्राह्मणत्व की प्राप्ति की, जिन-जिन सत्कर्मों अथवा दान या तपस्या द्वारा क्षत्रिय लोग ब्राह्मण हुए, उन उनको विशेष रूप से हम लोग जानना चाहते हैं।' ऋषियों के इस प्रकार पूछने पर सूत जी तात्पर्य से भरी हुई यह वाणी बोले--ऋषिवृन्द ! अन्याय से उपाजित किये गये द्रव्य द्वारा धर्म की आकांक्षा से अच्छे-अच्छे विद्वान ब्राह्मणों को बुलाकर जो यज्ञादिक सत्कर्म करते हैं, वे धर्म का फल नहीं प्राप्त करते १०४-१०६। जो पापात्मा नीच पुरुष दम्भवश 'मैं यह धर्मकायं कर रहा हूँ! इस प्रकार का प्रचार कर के, लोक में अपनी ख्याति प्राप्त करने के उद्देश्य से, ब्राह्मणों को दान देता है, अथवा जो निरंकुश व्यक्ति धन के लोभ से कठोर जप करता है, या राग मोहबश पहले पाप करके अस्त में पवित्र होने
verses.wordMeaning: Like the fire that blazes after catching the I§ika grass, the son surpassed the beautiful bodies of Devas at the very instant he was born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the fire that blazes after catching the I§ika grass, the son surpassed the beautiful bodies of Devas at the very instant he was born.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परं तयोः प्रीतिर् वर्धते ऽनुदिनं नृप । वंशस्तम्बे स्थितो राजा संशास्ति पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: parasparaṃ tayoḥ prītir vardhate 'nudinaṃ nṛpa / vaṃśastambe sthito rājā saṃśāsti pṛthivīmimām
verses.translation: Their suspicion having been aroused, Suras spoke to Tara: "Tell us the truth, whose son is he, Soma's or Brhas- pati's r
verses.hindi: के उद्देश से दान करता है, उन सब के दानादि सज््कर्म निष्फल होते हैं। दुरात्मा वास्तव में हिस्र भावना से धर्म में प्रवत्त होते हैं।१०७-१०९। इस प्रकार के अन्याय द्वारा धन प्राप्श कर मोहबश जो दुरात्मा, ऋ्ररकर्मा दान करता है अथवा यज्ञ करता है, वह नष्ट हो जाता है, टिकता नहीं । इसलिये न्यायतः प्राप्त धन को उपयुक्त तीथे (पात्र) में जो दान करते हैं, अपने मनोरथों के लिए किसी प्रकार को अभिसंधि (षडयंत्र) नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Their suspicion having been aroused, Suras spoke to Tara: "Tell us the truth, whose son is he, Soma's or Brhas- pati's r
verses.commentary: Sense: Their suspicion having been aroused, Suras spoke to Tara: "Tell us the truth, whose son is he, Soma's or Brhas- pati's r

verses.sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पूर्णां धनवाहनसंयुताम् । अलंकृतो गुणैः सर्वैर् अनपत्यो महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: hastyaśvarathasampūrṇāṃ dhanavāhanasaṃyutām / alaṃkṛto guṇaiḥ sarvair anapatyo mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: When she, out of bashfulness, did not tell Devas, 'yes' or 'no*, the boy Dasyuhantaraa was about to curse her.
verses.hindi: स्यायागतानां द्रव्याणां तोथें संप्रतिपादनम्। कामाननभिसंधाय यजते च ददानि च तपसा तु सुगुप्तेन लोकान्विष्टम्य तिष्ठति। विष्टम्य स तु तेजस्वी लोकेष्वानन्त्यमश्नुते
verses.wordMeaning: When she, out of bashfulness, did not tell Devas, 'yes' or 'no*, the boy Dasyuhantaraa was about to curse her.
verses.commentary: Sense: When she, out of bashfulness, did not tell Devas, 'yes' or 'no*, the boy Dasyuhantaraa was about to curse her.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखेन महताविष्टः संतप्तः सन्ततिं विना । स्नानहोमरतो नित्यं द्वादशाब्दानि भारत
verses.transliteration: duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ saṃtaptaḥ santatiṃ vinā / snānahomarato nityaṃ dvādaśābdāni bhārata
verses.translation: Preventing him, Brahma said to Tara, "(We have) suspicion that it is Candra's (Moon's), O Tara; therefore, speak the truth. Whose son is this?"
verses.hindi: दानाच्छ यस्तथा यज्ञो यज्ञाच्छे यस्तथा तपः। संन्यास्तपसः श्रेयांस्तस्साजज्ञानं गुरु स्‍्पुतम्ु
verses.wordMeaning: Preventing him, Brahma said to Tara, "(We have) suspicion that it is Candra's (Moon's), O Tara; therefore, speak the truth. Whose son is this?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Preventing him, Brahma said to Tara, "(We have) suspicion that it is Candra's (Moon's), O Tara; therefore, speak the truth. Whose son is this?"

verses.sanskrit: व्रतोपवासनियमैः पत्नीभिः सह तस्थिवान् । आराधयद्भगवतीं चामुण्डां मुण्डमर्दिनीम्
verses.transliteration: vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ patnībhiḥ saha tasthivān / ārādhayadbhagavatīṃ cāmuṇḍāṃ muṇḍamardinīm
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence, she said this to lord Brahma, the granter of boons, that the noble-souled boy Das- yuhantama was Soma's.
verses.hindi: क्षात्रोपेता: स्पृता होते तपसा ऋषितां गताः। एते राजषंयः सर्वे सिद्धि सुमहतीं गताः ।। क्‍ इति महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते अमावसुवंशानुकीत॑नम् नामकतवतितमोध्ध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: With palms joined in reverence, she said this to lord Brahma, the granter of boons, that the noble-souled boy Das- yuhantama was Soma's.
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence, she said this to lord Brahma, the granter of boons, that the noble-souled boy Das- yuhantama was Soma's.

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रैर् अनेकैर् भक्त्या च पूजाविधिसमाधिना । जय वाराहि चामुण्डे जय देवि त्रिलोचने
verses.transliteration: stotrair anekair bhaktyā ca pūjāvidhisamādhinā / jaya vārāhi cāmuṇḍe jaya devi trilocane
verses.translation: Thereafter, sniffing at the head of his son, Lord Soma, the Prajapati, named his intelligent son as Budha.
verses.hindi: करते, अथवा बिता किसी कामना के यज्ञ दान करते हैं, वही दान के वास्तविक फल को प्राप्त करते हैं, और वही दान सुख शान्ति एवं समृद्धि देने वाला है।११०-१११३। दान द्वारा मनुष्य विविध प्रकार के भोगों की प्राप्ति करता है, सत्य द्वारा स्वर्ग लोक की प्राप्ति करता है, तथा परम गोपनीय ढंग से की गई तपस्या द्वारा समस्त लोक का अतिक्रमण कर स्थित होता है, बर्थात् गुप्त तपस्या द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, sniffing at the head of his son, Lord Soma, the Prajapati, named his intelligent son as Budha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, sniffing at the head of his son, Lord Soma, the Prajapati, named his intelligent son as Budha.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मि रौद्रि च कौमारि कात्यायनि नमो ऽस्तु ते । प्रचण्डे भैरवे रौद्रि योगिन्याकाशगामिनि
verses.transliteration: brāhmi raudri ca kaumāri kātyāyani namo 'stu te / pracaṇḍe bhairave raudri yoginyākāśagāmini
verses.translation: (Defective verse) While rising up to go towards the east*, Budha begot a son of the princess (Ila).
verses.hindi: समस्त लोक से ऊपर होता है  इस प्रकार समस्त लोक का अतिक्रमण क्रनेवाला परम तेजस्वी तपस्वी सभी लोकों में अनन्त अक्षय सुख की प्राप्ति करता है । दान की अपेक्षा यज्ञ कल्याणकारी है, यज्ञ से बढ़कर कल्याणकारी तपस्या है, तपस्या से भी बढ़कर संन्यास की महत्ता है, और संस्यास से भी बढ़कर कल्याण दायी एवं महात् ज्ञान कहा गया है ।११२-११४। ऐसा सुना जाता है कि क्षत्रिय-गुण-कर्मे-स्वभाव वाले बनेक द्विजातियों ने तपस्या द्वारा सिद्धि प्राप्त की। नरपति विद्वामित्र, मान्धाता, संकृति, कपि, पुरुकुत्स,
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) While rising up to go towards the east*, Budha begot a son of the princess (Ila).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) While rising up to go towards the east*, Budha begot a son of the princess (Ila).

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति किंचित्त्वया हीनं त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे । राज्ञा स्तुता च संतुष्टा देवी वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: nāsti kiṃcittvayā hīnaṃ trailokye sacarācare / rājñā stutā ca saṃtuṣṭā devī vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: Pururavas, his son of great brilliance, was born of Ila. In UrvasI, six sons of great prowess were born (to Pururavas).
verses.hindi: रथीतर, रुनद, विष्णुवृद्धादि राजाओं ने क्षत्रिय जाति में उत्पन्न हौकर अपनी तपस्या द्वारा ऋषि-पदवी प्राप्त की । इन सभी राजपियों ते अपनी महान् तपस्या द्वारा परम सिद्धि की प्राप्ति की । अब इसके उपरान्त महाव् पराक्रमी राजा (अयु) (आ4)के वंश का वर्णन कर रहा हूँ !१५-११८।
verses.wordMeaning: Pururavas, his son of great brilliance, was born of Ila. In UrvasI, six sons of great prowess were born (to Pururavas).
verses.commentary: Sense: Pururavas, his son of great brilliance, was born of Ila. In UrvasI, six sons of great prowess were born (to Pururavas).

verses.sanskrit: वरयस्व यथाकामं यस्ते मनसि वर्तते । आराधिता त्वया भक्त्या तुष्टा दास्यामि ते वरम्
verses.transliteration: varayasva yathākāmaṃ yaste manasi vartate / ārādhitā tvayā bhaktyā tuṣṭā dāsyāmi te varam
verses.translation: Then, being violently attacked by pulmonary con¬ sumption Soma became exhausted and helpless. Overwhelmed by consumption, the Moon's disc became pale and weak. He, therefore, sought refuge in his own father Atri.
verses.hindi: ८२२ वायुपुराणम् क्‍ चन्‍्ट्रर्व्यंच्याकठी से ्वम्त
verses.wordMeaning: Then, being violently attacked by pulmonary con¬ sumption Soma became exhausted and helpless. Overwhelmed by consumption, the Moon's disc became pale and weak. He, therefore, sought refuge in his own father Atri.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, being violently attacked by pulmonary con¬ sumption Soma became exhausted and helpless. Overwhelmed by consumption, the Moon's disc became pale and weak. He, therefore, sought refuge in his own father Atri.

verses.sanskrit: देवपन्न उवाच: यदि तुष्टासि देवेशि वरार्हो यदि वाप्यहम् । पुत्रसन्तानरहितं संतप्तं मां समुद्धर
verses.transliteration: devapanna uvāca: yadi tuṣṭāsi deveśi varārho yadi vāpyaham / putrasantānarahitaṃ saṃtaptaṃ māṃ samuddhara
verses.translation: Atri, of great fame, quelled his sin (disease). He was cured of the pulmonary consumption and so he shone with bri¬ lliance all round.
verses.hindi: एते पुत्रा महात्मानः पशथ्चेवाइसल्महाबलाः । स्वर्भानुतनया विप्राः प्रभायां जज्ञिरे नपाः नहुषः प्रथमस्तेषां पत्रथर्मा ततः स्मृतः । धर्मंवद्धात्मजश्चेव सुतहोत्रों महायशाः सुतहोत्रस्य दायादास्त्रयः परमधासिकाः । काशः कालश्र द्वावेतो तथा गृत्समदः प्रभुः पुत्रों गृत्समदस्थापि शुनकों यस्य शौनकः । ब्राह्मणा: क्षत्रियाश्चेव वेश्या: शुद्रास्तथेव च
verses.wordMeaning: Atri, of great fame, quelled his sin (disease). He was cured of the pulmonary consumption and so he shone with bri¬ lliance all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: Atri, of great fame, quelled his sin (disease). He was cured of the pulmonary consumption and so he shone with bri¬ lliance all round.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तानं नय मे वृद्धिं गोत्ररक्षां कुरुष्व मे । अपुत्रिणां गृहाणीह श्मशानसदृशानि हि
verses.transliteration: santānaṃ naya me vṛddhiṃ gotrarakṣāṃ kuruṣva me / aputriṇāṃ gṛhāṇīha śmaśānasadṛśāni hi
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, thus the origin of Soma has been recounted by me. Listen to and understand his race that is being recounted to you, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: शोनकाश्चा55थ्टिषेणाश्च क्षाओोपेता द्ििजातयः  काशस्य काशयो राष्टः पुत्रो दीर्घतपास्तथा खूत बोले--विप्रव॒न्द ! पाँच महात््॒ पराक्रमी तथा परम बलवान स्वर्भानु के पुत्र प्रभा नामक परनी में उत्पन्त हुए, जो सब राजा थे उन सबों में प्रथम गणनीय राजा नहुष थे । उनके बाद पुृत्रधर्मा कहे जाते हैं । तदनन्तर घमवद्ध हुए, धर्मंवृद्ध के पुत्र परम यशस्वी राजा सुतहोत्र हुए ।(-२। राजा सुतहोन्न के उत्तराधिकारी तीन परम धामिक पुत्र हुए, जिनके नाम काश, शल एवं गृत्समद थे । परम प्रभाव शाली राजा गृत्समद के पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, thus the origin of Soma has been recounted by me. Listen to and understand his race that is being recounted to you, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, thus the origin of Soma has been recounted by me. Listen to and understand his race that is being recounted to you, O excellent Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: पितरस्तस्य नाश्नन्ति देवता ऋषिभिः सह । क्रियमाणे ऽप्यहरहः श्राद्धे मत्पितरः सदा
verses.transliteration: pitarastasya nāśnanti devatā ṛṣibhiḥ saha / kriyamāṇe 'pyaharahaḥ śrāddhe matpitaraḥ sadā
verses.translation: He was an expounder of Brahman (Vedas), destro¬ yer of foes and invincible in battle. He regularly performed Agnihotra and granted gifts of lands to sacrificial priests.
verses.hindi: . शुनक थे, जिनके पृत्र शौनक हुए  द्िजब॒न्द ! इस वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाली संततियाँ ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, यंश्य शुद्र--चा रो बर्णों में भपने विचित्र कर्मों द्वारा विभक्त हुईं। शल के पुत्र राजा आष्टिषेण हुए, जिनके पुत्र चरन्त हुये ।३-४॥ शौनक ओर आए्टिषेण के वंश में उत्पश्त होनेवाली सन्ततियाँ क्षत्रिय एवं ब्राह्मण दोनों वर्णों में हैं । काश के काशय, राष्ट और दीघेतपा नामक पुत्र हुए। दीघंतपा के पुत्र राजा धर्म हुए, धर्म से परम विद्वान्
verses.wordMeaning: He was an expounder of Brahman (Vedas), destro¬ yer of foes and invincible in battle. He regularly performed Agnihotra and granted gifts of lands to sacrificial priests.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was an expounder of Brahman (Vedas), destro¬ yer of foes and invincible in battle. He regularly performed Agnihotra and granted gifts of lands to sacrificial priests.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शयन्ति सदात्मानं स्वप्ने क्षुत्पीडितं मम । इति राज्ञो वचः श्रुत्वा देवी ध्यानमुपागता
verses.transliteration: darśayanti sadātmānaṃ svapne kṣutpīḍitaṃ mama / iti rājño vacaḥ śrutvā devī dhyānamupāgatā
verses.translation: He was truthful in speech and intelligently engaged in holy rites. Handsome in features, he indulged in sexual inter¬ course in great privacy. He was an extraordinarily dutiful son, and in beauty of form was unequalled in all the worlds.
verses.hindi: राजा घत्वन्तरि का जन्म हुआ ।। परम बुद्धिमान् राजा धर्म की वृद्धावस्था में उनकी तपस्या के कारण महान् तैजस्वी धब्वन्तरि का जन्म हुआ था। इस बात को सुनकर ऋषियों ने सूस से यह बात पूछी ।
verses.wordMeaning: He was truthful in speech and intelligently engaged in holy rites. Handsome in features, he indulged in sexual inter¬ course in great privacy. He was an extraordinarily dutiful son, and in beauty of form was unequalled in all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was truthful in speech and intelligently engaged in holy rites. Handsome in features, he indulged in sexual inter¬ course in great privacy. He was an extraordinarily dutiful son, and in beauty of form was unequalled in all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्येन चक्षुषा दृष्टं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । प्रसन्नवदना देवी राजानमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: divyena cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / prasannavadanā devī rājānamidamabravīt
verses.translation: Eschewing her pride in personal prestige, the renowned UrvaSi wedded that righteous, truthful (king), conversant with Dharmas and expounder of Brahman (Veda)
verses.hindi: कर्थ धन्वन्तरिदेवों मानुषेष्विह जज्ञिवान् । एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामस्ततो बूहि प्रियं तथा ८
verses.wordMeaning: Eschewing her pride in personal prestige, the renowned UrvaSi wedded that righteous, truthful (king), conversant with Dharmas and expounder of Brahman (Veda)
verses.commentary: Sense: Eschewing her pride in personal prestige, the renowned UrvaSi wedded that righteous, truthful (king), conversant with Dharmas and expounder of Brahman (Veda)

verses.sanskrit: सन्तानं नास्ति ते राजंस्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे । यजस्व यज्ञपुरुषमपत्यं नास्ति ते ऽन्यथा
verses.transliteration: santānaṃ nāsti te rājaṃstrailokye sacarācare / yajasva yajñapuruṣamapatyaṃ nāsti te 'nyathā
verses.translation: The vigorous king stayed with her (in all for sixty- four years) spending ten, eight, seven, six, seven, eight, ten and eight years in the beautiful Caitraratha park, on the banks of Gariga, in the excellent forest Nandana, in the extensive Alaka, at the foot of the Gandhamadana mountain* on the peak of the excellent mountain Meru, in the northern Kurus, and in the village Kalapagrama respectively. With great
verses.hindi: उत्पन्नः सकलात्पूर्व स्वंतश्य थ्रिया वृतः । सर्वसंसिद्धकाय॑ त॑ दृष्ट्वा विष्टम्भितः स्थित: ॥॥ अजः प्रोबाच विष्णुं तं तनयोउस्मि तव प्रभो। विधत्स्व भाग स्थान च सम लोके सुरोत्तत
verses.wordMeaning: The vigorous king stayed with her (in all for sixty- four years) spending ten, eight, seven, six, seven, eight, ten and eight years in the beautiful Caitraratha park, on the banks of Gariga, in the excellent forest Nandana, in the extensive Alaka,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The vigorous king stayed with her (in all for sixty- four years) spending ten, eight, seven, six, seven, eight, ten and eight years in the beautiful Caitraratha park, on the banks of Gariga, in the excellent forest Nandana, in the extensive Alaka,…

verses.sanskrit: मया दृष्टं महीपाल त्रैलोक्यं दिव्यचक्षुषा । एवमुक्त्वा गता देवी राजा स्वगृहमागमत्
verses.transliteration: mayā dṛṣṭaṃ mahīpāla trailokyaṃ divyacakṣuṣā / evamuktvā gatā devī rājā svagṛhamāgamat
verses.translation: The present chapter which corresponds to Bd. 3.66, opens with the episode of Pururavas, the founder of the Lunar race and Urvasi, the celestial nymph. This episode gives the background of the famous "Dialogue" sukta in the RV. This romantic story inspired Kalidasa to write his immortal play Vikramorvattya.
verses.hindi: एयसुक्तः स दृष्द्वा तु तथ्य प्रोवाच स प्रश्चुः। कृतो यज्ञविभागस्तु यज्ञियहि सुरेस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The present chapter which corresponds to Bd. 3.66, opens with the episode of Pururavas, the founder of the Lunar race and Urvasi, the celestial nymph. This episode gives the background of the famous "Dialogue" sukta in the RV.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The present chapter which corresponds to Bd. 3.66, opens with the episode of Pururavas, the founder of the Lunar race and Urvasi, the celestial nymph. This episode gives the background of the famous "Dialogue" sukta in the RV.…

verses.sanskrit: इयाज यज्ञपुरुषं संजाता कन्यका ततः । तेजस्विनी रूपवती सर्वलोकमनोहरा
verses.transliteration: iyāja yajñapuruṣaṃ saṃjātā kanyakā tataḥ / tejasvinī rūpavatī sarvalokamanoharā
verses.translation: UrvasI was a Gandharva lady. Forsaking Devas, how did she attain the king, a mere human being? O (sage)' of extensive learning, please explain it to us.
verses.hindi: अर्वाक्सुतो5सि है देव नाममन्‍्त्रोईसि वे प्रभो । द्वितीयायां तु संभुत्यां लोके रुपाति गभसिष्यसि ॥ ऋषियों ने पूछा--सूत जी ! देव धन्वन्तरि किस प्रकार मनुष्य लोक में उत्पन्न हुए, इस बात को हम लोग जानना चाहते हैं, हमारे इस प्रिय विषय को बतलाइये
verses.wordMeaning: UrvasI was a Gandharva lady. Forsaking Devas, how did she attain the king, a mere human being? O (sage)' of extensive learning, please explain it to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: UrvasI was a Gandharva lady. Forsaking Devas, how did she attain the king, a mere human being? O (sage)' of extensive learning, please explain it to us.

verses.sanskrit: देवगन्धर्वलोके ऽपि तादृशी नास्ति कामिनी । तस्या नाम कृतं पित्रा हर्षात् कामप्रमोदिनी
verses.transliteration: devagandharvaloke 'pi tādṛśī nāsti kāminī / tasyā nāma kṛtaṃ pitrā harṣāt kāmapramodinī
verses.translation: She was overwhelmed by the curse of Brahma and therefore had to approach a human being. The beautiful lady (became the wife of) Aila Pururavas under certain stipulated conditions.
verses.hindi: सूत थोले--ह्विजव॒न्द ! धन्वन्तरि का जन्म-वत्तान्त मैं बतला रहा हूँ, सुनिये । श्राचीनकाल में समुद्र मन्थन के अवसर पर देव धन्वश्तरि का आविर्भाव हुआ था। वे सब से पहले और सभी प्रकार की कान्तियों से समन्वित उत्पन्न हुए थे, इस प्रकार सब प्रकार के ग्रुणों एवं कान्तियों से विभूषित उनके शरीर को देखकर देवगण भौचकक्‍्के रह गयेट“ओर बोल उठे कि “तुम अज हो ।” इसी कारण वश वे अज नाम से
verses.wordMeaning: She was overwhelmed by the curse of Brahma and therefore had to approach a human being. The beautiful lady (became the wife of) Aila Pururavas under certain stipulated conditions.
verses.commentary: Sense: She was overwhelmed by the curse of Brahma and therefore had to approach a human being. The beautiful lady (became the wife of) Aila Pururavas under certain stipulated conditions.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालेन ववृधे रूपेणास्तम्भयज्जगत् । हंसलीलागतिः सुभ्रूः स्तनभारावनामिता
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālena vavṛdhe rūpeṇāstambhayajjagat / haṃsalīlāgatiḥ subhrūḥ stanabhārāvanāmitā
verses.translation: In order to redeem herself from the evil effects of the curse, she stipulated that she should not see him naked except at the time of sexual intercourse or when swayed with passionate love.
verses.hindi: विख्यात हुए । तदनन्तर अज ने विष्णु से कहा, प्रभो ! मैं आप का पुत्र हूं, सुरोत्तम ! लोक में हमारे लिये स्थान एवं यज्ञादि में हमारे लिये अंश की व्यवस्था कोजिये! ।९-११। अज के ऐसा कहने पर प्रभु विष्णु ने अज की ओर देखकर ये तथ्यपूर्ण बातें कहीं, है देव ! यज्ञ के विधान बनानेवाले देवताओं ने यज्ञादि में अंधों के विभाग आदि की व्यवस्था पहले ही से बना दी है, महर्षियों द्वारा वेदों में उतके लिये विधान युक्त हवन करने की प्रक्रिया जादि भी निर्धारित हो चुकी है, तुम बाद में उत्पन्न होनेवाले पुत्र हो, अतः हवनादि में उन देवताओं के साथ, जिनके लिये अंश प्राप्त करने की व्यवस्था बंध च॒की है, तुम्हें समानता नहीं प्राप्त करा सकता । हे समर्थ ! तुम केवल नाम से ही मंत्र रूप हो । दूसरे जन्म में तुम लोक में ख्याति प्राप्त करोगे। गर्भ में हो तुम्हें अणिमा आदि सिद्धियों की प्राप्ति होगी । परम प्रभावशालिन् ! उसी शरीर से तुम्हें देवषण की भी प्राप्ति होगी।
verses.wordMeaning: In order to redeem herself from the evil effects of the curse, she stipulated that she should not see him naked except at the time of sexual intercourse or when swayed with passionate love.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to redeem herself from the evil effects of the curse, she stipulated that she should not see him naked except at the time of sexual intercourse or when swayed with passionate love.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरा कुण्डलाभरणोज्ज्वला । दिव्यानुलेपनवती सखीभिः सा सुरक्षिता
verses.transliteration: raktamālyāmbaradharā kuṇḍalābharaṇojjvalā / divyānulepanavatī sakhībhiḥ sā surakṣitā
verses.translation: (She said further) "O King, two rams will always be kept near our bed. 1 My sole diet will be ghee which I shall take only once a day.
verses.hindi: उस समय द्विजाति गण चरु, घृत, गन्ध भादि द्रब्यों से मंत्रोच्चारण पूर्वक तुम्हारी पूजा करेंगे ।! २-१५। उसके
verses.wordMeaning: (She said further) "O King, two rams will always be kept near our bed. 1 My sole diet will be ghee which I shall take only once a day.
verses.commentary: Sense: (She said further) "O King, two rams will always be kept near our bed. 1 My sole diet will be ghee which I shall take only once a day.

verses.sanskrit: कुचमध्यगतो हारो विद्युन्मालेव राजते । भ्रमराञ्चितकेशी सा बिम्बोष्ठी चारुहासिनी
verses.transliteration: kucamadhyagato hāro vidyunmāleva rājate / bhramarāñcitakeśī sā bimboṣṭhī cāruhāsinī
verses.translation: If these conditions are fulfilled, O king, as long as you strictly adhere to these stipulations, I shall stay with you. This is our mutual agreement".
verses.hindi: द्वितीये द्वापरे प्राप्ते शौनहोत्रः प्रकाशिराद् । पुत्रकामस्तपस्तेपे न॒पो दीघंतपास्तथा - ॥श्द अजं देव॑ तु पुत्रार्थ ह्यारिराधयिषुनु पः । वरेण चछन्दयामास प्रीतो धन्वन्तरिन पम् तस्प गेहे समुत्पन्नो देवो धन्वन्तरिस्तदा  काशिराजों महाराज: सर्बरोगप्रणाशनः
verses.wordMeaning: If these conditions are fulfilled, O king, as long as you strictly adhere to these stipulations, I shall stay with you. This is our mutual agreement".
verses.commentary: Sense: If these conditions are fulfilled, O king, as long as you strictly adhere to these stipulations, I shall stay with you. This is our mutual agreement".

verses.sanskrit: कर्णान्तप्राप्तनेत्राभ्यां पिबन्तीवाथ कामिनः । चन्द्रताम्बूलसौरभ्यैराकर्षन्तीव मन्मथम्
verses.transliteration: karṇāntaprāptanetrābhyāṃ pibantīvātha kāminaḥ / candratāmbūlasaurabhyairākarṣantīva manmatham
verses.translation: The king scrupulously adhere to her conditions. Thus that beautiful lady stayed with Pururavas.
verses.hindi: आयुर्वेद भरद्वाजश्रकार सभिषविक्षयम् । तमष्टधा पुनव्यंस्थ शिष्येस्यः प्रत्यपादयत्
verses.wordMeaning: The king scrupulously adhere to her conditions. Thus that beautiful lady stayed with Pururavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king scrupulously adhere to her conditions. Thus that beautiful lady stayed with Pururavas.

verses.sanskrit: कम्बुग्रीवा चारुमध्या ताम्रपादाङ्गुलीनखा । निम्ननाभिः सुजघना रम्भोरू सुदती शुभा
verses.transliteration: kambugrīvā cārumadhyā tāmrapādāṅgulīnakhā / nimnanābhiḥ sujaghanā rambhorū sudatī śubhā
verses.translation: Deluded by her curse, UrvasI became a human lady and stayed with him devotedly for sixty-four years. The Gand- harvas became worried due to this.
verses.hindi: धन्वन्तरिसुतश्रापि केतुमानिति विश्वुतः  अथ केतुमतः पुत्रो विप्रो भीमरथो नृपः ॥ का एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु पुरी वाराणसी पुरा। शुन्यां विवेशवामास क्षेमको नाम राक्षस: . २४
verses.wordMeaning: Deluded by her curse, UrvasI became a human lady and stayed with him devotedly for sixty-four years. The Gand- harvas became worried due to this.
verses.commentary: Sense: Deluded by her curse, UrvasI became a human lady and stayed with him devotedly for sixty-four years. The Gand- harvas became worried due to this.

verses.sanskrit: मातापितृसुहृद्वर्गे क्रीडानन्दविवर्धिनी । एकस्मिन्दिवसे बाला सखीवृन्दसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: mātāpitṛsuhṛdvarge krīḍānandavivardhinī / ekasmindivase bālā sakhīvṛndasamanvitā
verses.translation: Urvasi, as her name indicates, seems to have hailed from the ancient central Asian town Ur. It appears that fashionable ladies from Ur had a fascination for rams in the fourth millennium B.G. In his excavation at Ur, Sir Leonard Wooley discovered in a queen's tomb of 3300 B.G. a pair of rams, "beautifully and intricately made. Their bodies were covered with fleece of shell....their heads and legs were of gold" (quoted on in A. J. Karandikar's introduction to his Marathi book Background of the Mahabharata —Mahabhdratdci PdrSvabhdmi 9 Poona, 1980. This fascination for rams may be the cause of the inclusion and importance attached to this term in the marriage-contract between Pururavas and UrvaSi.
verses.hindi: बाद तुम आयुर्वेद का उद्धार करोगे, यह सब बातें अवदय घटित होंगी । इन्हीं के लिये पद्ययोनि ब्रह्माजी ने तुम्हारी सृष्टि पृवंकाल में को है। द्वितीय द्वापर युग में तुम आविर्भूत होगे--इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं है।' उस समय ऐसा वरदान देकर भगवान् विष्णु अन्तहित हो गये ।8६-१७। द्वितीय द्वापर युग में काशिराज सुनहोन्न (सुतहोत्र) के वंश में उत्पन्त होनेवाले राजा दीघंतपा ने पुत्र प्राप्ति की कामना से तपस्या को थी। उस तपस्या में राजा ने
verses.wordMeaning: Urvasi, as her name indicates, seems to have hailed from the ancient central Asian town Ur. It appears that fashionable ladies from Ur had a fascination for rams in the fourth millennium B.G. In his excavation at Ur, Sir Leonard Wooley discovered in a queen's tomb of 3300 B.G.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Urvasi, as her name indicates, seems to have hailed from the ancient central Asian town Ur. It appears that fashionable ladies from Ur had a fascination for rams in the fourth millennium B.G. In his excavation at Ur, Sir Leonard Wooley discovered in a queen's tomb of 3300 B.G.…

verses.sanskrit: चन्दनागरुतांबूलधूपसौमनसाञ्चिता । गृहीत्वा पुष्पधूपादि गता देवीप्रपूजने
verses.transliteration: candanāgarutāṃbūladhūpasaumanasāñcitā / gṛhītvā puṣpadhūpādi gatā devīprapūjane
verses.translation: Then the foremost of the eloquent ones (Gnndhar.
verses.hindi: पुत्र के लिये उन्हीं अज देव की आराधना की थी  प्रयत्न होकर घन्वन्तरि ने राजा दीर्घतपा को वरदान देने की राजा बोले--भगवन् ! यादि आप मेरे ऊपर प्रसन्न हैं, तो आप ही मेरे धर्मंशाली पुत्र के रूप में उत्पन्त हों ।' देव धन्वन्तरि राजा की प्राथंना स्वीकार कर बहीं अन्तंधान हो गये । तत्पश्चात् वरदान के अनुसार द्वितीय द्वापर युग में देव धन्वन्तरि राजा दीघंतपा के पुत्र रूप में उत्पन्न हुए  बाद में चलकर वे महाराजाधिराज, काशिराज सभी रोगों के विनाश करनेवाले हुए।२०-२१। भरद्वाज ऋषि ने ओषधियों की.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the foremost of the eloquent ones (Gnndhar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the foremost of the eloquent ones (Gnndhar.

verses.sanskrit: तडागतट उत्सृज्य भूषणान्यङ्गवेष्टकान् । चक्रुः सरसिताः क्रीडां जलमध्यगतास्तदा
verses.transliteration: taḍāgataṭa utsṛjya bhūṣaṇānyaṅgaveṣṭakān / cakruḥ sarasitāḥ krīḍāṃ jalamadhyagatāstadā
verses.translation: Then the Gandharvas took away the second ram as well. When the second ram was taken away, the queen spoke
verses.hindi: समस्त प्रक्रियाओं के साथ आयुर्वेद का प्रणयन किया था राजा ने उसी को पुनः आठ भागों में विभक्तकर अपने शिष्यों को उसकी शिक्षा दी थी। धन्वन्तरि के पुत्र केतुमान् नाम से विख्यात हुए, केतुमान् के पुत्र परम प्रताप शाली राजा भोमरथ हुए । वही राजा भीमरथ वाराणसी के परम प्रसिद्ध राजा दिवोदास के नाम से विख्यात हुए । प्राचीन काल में इसी राजा के राज्य काल में वाराणसी पुरी सूनी हो गई थी और उसमें क्षेमक नामक
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Gandharvas took away the second ram as well. When the second ram was taken away, the queen spoke
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Gandharvas took away the second ram as well. When the second ram was taken away, the queen spoke

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडन्तीं तामवेक्ष्याथ ससखीं विमले जले । राक्षसः शम्बरो नाम श्येनरूपेण चागमत्
verses.transliteration: krīḍantīṃ tāmavekṣyātha sasakhīṃ vimale jale / rākṣasaḥ śambaro nāma śyenarūpeṇa cāgamat
verses.translation: "O Lord, O king, my sons are taken away as though they are the sons of a helpless woman". Thus taunted the king got up and rushed out (though he was) naked.
verses.hindi: राक्षस घुस आया था ।३२२-२४। प्राचीत काल में महाव पराक्रमशाली निकुम्भ ने वाराणसी पूरी को यह शाप वाराणसी किमथ॑ तां निकुम्भः शप्तवान्पुरा । निकुम्भश्वापि धर्मात्मा सिद्धक्षेत्र शशाप यः
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord, O king, my sons are taken away as though they are the sons of a helpless woman". Thus taunted the king got up and rushed out (though he was) naked.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, O king, my sons are taken away as though they are the sons of a helpless woman". Thus taunted the king got up and rushed out (though he was) naked.

verses.sanskrit: गृहीता जलमध्यस्था तेन सा काममोदिनी । खमुत्पपात दुष्टात्मा गृहीत्वाभरणान्यपि
verses.transliteration: gṛhītā jalamadhyasthā tena sā kāmamodinī / khamutpapāta duṣṭātmā gṛhītvābharaṇānyapi
verses.translation: The king rushed out seeking the sheep taken away by the Gandharvas, whereupon a great Maya (i lusion) was produced by them. The great palace became illuminated sud denly and she saw the naked king. On seeing the king naked, the Apsara lady (Urvasi) who could assume any form she wished, vanished (from there). On realising that she had vanished, the Gandharvas abandoned the rams there and disappeared themselves.
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कृतदारों महेश्वरः । देव्याः स प्रियकामस्तु बसानः श्वशुरान्तिके २९ देवाज्ञया पारिषदा विश्वरूपास्तपोधना: । पूर्वोक्ते रूपविशेषस्तोषयन्ति महेश्वरीमू ३० हृष्यति तैमंहादेवों मेना नेव तु हृष्यति । जुगुप्सते सा नित्य॑ च देव॑ देवों तथव च ३१
verses.wordMeaning: The king rushed out seeking the sheep taken away by the Gandharvas, whereupon a great Maya (i lusion) was produced by them. The great palace became illuminated sud denly and she saw the naked king. On seeing the king naked,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The king rushed out seeking the sheep taken away by the Gandharvas, whereupon a great Maya (i lusion) was produced by them. The great palace became illuminated sud denly and she saw the naked king. On seeing the king naked,…

verses.sanskrit: वायुमार्गं गतः सो ऽथ कामिन्या सह भारत । अपतन्कुण्डलादीनि यत्र तोये महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: vāyumārgaṃ gataḥ so 'tha kāminyā saha bhārata / apatankuṇḍalādīni yatra toye mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the abandoned rams, the king, the lord, took them with him and returned. Unable to see her there, the king became extremely dejected and lamented.
verses.hindi: के कर .ॉन्‍मण-न«भ-- दिया था कि यह वाराणसी एक सहस्र वर्ष तक सूनी रहेगी ऐसी बात उसने बार-बार कही थी  उसके इस प्रकार के शाष देने पर नरफपति दिवोदास ने इस वाराणसी पुरी को छोड़कर अपनी मनोहर राजधानी गोमती नदी के तट पर बसाई थी ।२५-२६। ु
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the abandoned rams, the king, the lord, took them with him and returned. Unable to see her there, the king became extremely dejected and lamented.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the abandoned rams, the king, the lord, took them with him and returned. Unable to see her there, the king became extremely dejected and lamented.

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्यो नर्मदातीरे काष्ठवत्संजितेन्द्रियः । लीनो माहेश्वरे स्थाने नारायणपदे परे
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavyo narmadātīre kāṣṭhavatsaṃjitendriyaḥ / līno māheśvare sthāne nārāyaṇapade pare
verses.translation: Seeking her here and there, the king roamed over The lady of splendid evebrows saw the king not very far. Urvasi then spoke to her friends: "Here is that excellent man with whom I lived." She pointed out che king to them. Then those ladies, the Apsaras (with five braids of hair) appeared in front (of him).
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने पूछाः-- सूत जो ! प्रचीनकाल में निकुंभ ने वाराणसी को क्‍यों शाप दिया था। परम धर्मात्मा होकर भी उसने सिद्ध क्षेत्र वाराणसी को भला क्‍यों शाप दिया ?
verses.wordMeaning: Seeking her here and there, the king roamed over The lady of splendid evebrows saw the king not very far. Urvasi then spoke to her friends: "Here is that excellent man with whom I lived." She pointed out che king to them. Then those ladies,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeking her here and there, the king roamed over The lady of splendid evebrows saw the king not very far. Urvasi then spoke to her friends: "Here is that excellent man with whom I lived." She pointed out che king to them. Then those ladies,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चानुचरो भ्राता भ्रातुः शुश्रूषणे रतः । तपोजपकृशीभूतो दध्यौ देवं जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: tasya cānucaro bhrātā bhrātuḥ śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ / tapojapakṛśībhūto dadhyau devaṃ janārdanam
verses.translation: On seeing her (Urvasi) the king was delighted. He began to lament in diverse ways, "o cruel lady, come (unto me). Stay willingly, stand by your words."
verses.hindi: सतत बोलेः--राजधि दिवोदास वाराणसी नगरी में निवास करता था, उस मनोहर नगरी में वह अपने समय का एक मद्दान् शासक एवं परमतेजस्वी राजा था ।२८५। इसी अवधि में महेश्वर शिव ने पावती के साथ पत्नी सम्बन्ध स्थापित किया था और देवी को प्रसन्‍न करने की नीयत से वे दवशुर हिंमवान् के ही घर में निवास करते थे ।२९। महादेव की आज्ञा से उनके पाषंदगण, जो अनेक स्त्ररूप धारण करनेवाले, किन्तु महान् तेजस्वी थे, पूर्व में कहे गये विचित्र विचित्र रूपों को धारण कर महेश्वरी को प्रसन्‍न किया करते थे। उनके इस व्यापार से महादेव जी प्रसन्‍न होते थे किन्तु मेना को इससे प्रसन्नता नहीं होती थी । महादेव ओर पावंती दोनों कौ वह मन में सदा भर्त्सना किया करती थीं ।३०-३१।॥ एक बार उन्होंने पावती से कहा भी, निष्पापे ! तुम्हारे पति महेश्वर हमारे यहाँ नित्य प्रति अनाचार किया करते हैं ।' मेरी समझ में तो वे एक परम अकिचन
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing her (Urvasi) the king was delighted. He began to lament in diverse ways, "o cruel lady, come (unto me). Stay willingly, stand by your words."
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her (Urvasi) the king was delighted. He began to lament in diverse ways, "o cruel lady, come (unto me). Stay willingly, stand by your words."

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे काममोदिनीहरणवर्णनं नामैकोनसप्तत्यधिशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १७० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: कामप्रमोदिनीसख्यो नीयमानां च तेन तु । दृष्ट्वा ताश् चुक्रुशुः सर्वा निःसृत्य जलमध्यतः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kāmamodinīharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatyadhiśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 170 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kāmapramodinīsakhyo nīyamānāṃ ca tena tu / dṛṣṭvā tāś cukruśuḥ sarvā niḥsṛtya jalamadhyataḥ
verses.translation: These and similar subtle words they exchanged. Urvasi then spoke to Aila: "O lord, I have been rendered pregnant by you. Undoubtedly your son will be born within a year." The king stayed for a night with her.
verses.hindi: एवं व्यर्थ में नाच गान में लगे हुए लम्पट प्रतीत होते है।' माता मेना की ऐसी बातों को स्त्री स्वभाव
verses.wordMeaning: These and similar subtle words they exchanged. Urvasi then spoke to Aila: "O lord, I have been rendered pregnant by you. Undoubtedly your son will be born within a year." The king stayed for a night with her.
verses.commentary: Sense: These and similar subtle words they exchanged. Urvasi then spoke to Aila: "O lord, I have been rendered pregnant by you. Undoubtedly your son will be born within a year." The king stayed for a night with her.

verses.sanskrit: गता राजगृहे सर्वाः कथयन्ति सुदुःखिताः । कामप्रमोदिनी राजन्हृता श्येनेन पक्षिणा
verses.transliteration: gatā rājagṛhe sarvāḥ kathayanti suduḥkhitāḥ / kāmapramodinī rājanhṛtā śyenena pakṣiṇā
verses.translation: The king went back to his city with great delight. When a year elapsed, the king of great fame came to Urvasi again.
verses.hindi: विषण्णवदना देवी महावदेवमभाषत । नेह वत्स्याम्यहूं देव नय मां स्व॑ं निवेशनम् ३३४ तथोक्तस्तु महादेवः सवल्लिकानवेक्ष्य ह। वासार्थं रोचयामास पृथिव्यां तु द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ दिवोदासेन तां ज्ञात्वा निंविष्टां नगरीं भवः । पाश्वेस्थं स समाहुय गणशं क्षेमक ब्रवीत् ३३६
verses.wordMeaning: The king went back to his city with great delight. When a year elapsed, the king of great fame came to Urvasi again.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king went back to his city with great delight. When a year elapsed, the king of great fame came to Urvasi again.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडन्ती च जलस्थाने तडागे देवसन्निधौ । अन्वेष्या च त्वया राजंस्तस्य मार्गं विजानता
verses.transliteration: krīḍantī ca jalasthāne taḍāge devasannidhau / anveṣyā ca tvayā rājaṃstasya mārgaṃ vijānatā
verses.translation: After staying with her for a night, the lofty-minded king became overwhelmed by passionate love. In a pitiable tone he spoke: "Be mine for ever".
verses.hindi: श्रेयस्तेहं करिष्यामि स्थान मे रोवयानघ । मद्ग॒पां प्रतिसां कृत्वा नगयेंन्‍्ते निवेशय ३३६ तथा स्वप्ने यथा दृष्टं सर्वे कारितवान्द्विजा: । नगरीद्ाय॑नुज्ञाप्प राजानं तु बथाविधि (४४०
verses.wordMeaning: After staying with her for a night, the lofty-minded king became overwhelmed by passionate love. In a pitiable tone he spoke: "Be mine for ever".
verses.commentary: Sense: After staying with her for a night, the lofty-minded king became overwhelmed by passionate love. In a pitiable tone he spoke: "Be mine for ever".

verses.sanskrit: तासां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवपन्नः सुदुःखितः । हाहेत्युक्त्वा समुत्थाय रुदमानो वरासनात्
