verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devapannaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ / hāhetyuktvā samutthāya rudamāno varāsanāt
verses.translation: Urvasi then said to Aila: "The Gandharvas will grant you (that) boon. O great king, choose that boon and tell them this yourself:
verses.hindi: अन्नप्रदानयुक्तेश्व अत्यद्धतसिबाभवत् । एवं संपूज्यते तन्न नित्यसेव गणेश्वरः १४२ बहा पार्वती सहन ने कर सकीं। वरदान देने वाली पावंती मन्द हास्य करती हुई महादेव के समीप आई ओर वहाँ खिन्‍न मुख होकर महादेव से बोलीं--देव ! अब मैं यहाँ पर निवास नहीं करूँग्री, मुझे अपने यहाँ ले चलिये । देवी के ऐसा कहने पर महादेव ने तीनों लोकों में अपने योग्य स्थान देखा ॥ द्विजवयंवन्द ! समस्त भूमंडल भर में महान् तेजस्वी महेश्वर ने अपने निवास योग्य स्थान सिद्ध क्षेत्र वाराणसी को ही पसन्द
verses.wordMeaning: Urvasi then said to Aila: "The Gandharvas will grant you (that) boon. O great king, choose that boon and tell them this yourself:
verses.commentary: Sense: Urvasi then said to Aila: "The Gandharvas will grant you (that) boon. O great king, choose that boon and tell them this yourself:

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रिभिः सहितस्तस्मिंस्तडागे जलसन्निधौ । न चिह्नं न च पन्थानं दृष्ट्वा दुःखान्मुमोह च
verses.transliteration: mantribhiḥ sahitastasmiṃstaḍāge jalasannidhau / na cihnaṃ na ca panthānaṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhānmumoha ca
verses.translation: T choose the boon of Salokya (having the same world) with the noble-souled Gandharvas' ". The king accepted the suggestion saying "So be it", and requested the Gandharvas for the boon. The Gandharvas replied, "So be it".
verses.hindi: किया ।३२-३५। भव ने उक्त वाराणसी नगरी को उस समय राजा दिवोदास के अधीन जानकर अपने समीप रहनेवाले गणेह्वर क्षेमक को बुलाकर कहा । गणेश्वर ! तुम वाराणसी पुरी को जाओ, और उसे खाली कराओ । देखना, मृदुल उपायों द्वारा उसे खाली कराना, क्‍योंकि वहाँ का राजा दिवोदास महान् पराक्रमी है
verses.wordMeaning: T choose the boon of Salokya (having the same world) with the noble-souled Gandharvas' ". The king accepted the suggestion saying "So be it", and requested the Gandharvas for the boon. The Gandharvas replied, "So be it".
verses.commentary: Sense: T choose the boon of Salokya (having the same world) with the noble-souled Gandharvas' ". The king accepted the suggestion saying "So be it", and requested the Gandharvas for the boon. The Gandharvas replied, "So be it".

verses.sanskrit: तस्य राज्ञस्तु दुःखेन दुःखितो नागरो जनः । क्षणेनाश्वासितो राजा मन्त्रिभिः सपुरोहितैः
verses.transliteration: tasya rājñastu duḥkhena duḥkhito nāgaro janaḥ / kṣaṇenāśvāsito rājā mantribhiḥ sapurohitaiḥ
verses.translation: After filling the Sthali (mud-pot) with fire, the Gandharvas spoke to him: "O king, performing the sacrifice with this, you will attain that world." 1
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार शिव की आज्ञा से प्राचीन काल में निकुम्भ वाराणसी पुरी को प्रस्थित हुआ, और वहाँ जाकर उसने स्वयं को मद्भून नामक नापित को स्वप्न में दिखाया, और उससे कहा, निष्पाप ! मैं तुम्हारा कल्याण करूँगा, मेरे लिए एक स्थान तू बना  इस नगरी के अन्तिम छोर पर मेरी प्रतिमा बनाकर स्थापित कर दे  ट्विजवन्द ! मद्धुन ने स्वप्न में देखी हुई सभी बातों को पूर्ण किया, राजा से आज्ञा प्राप्त कर उसने नगरी के प्रवेश द्वार पर विधिपूर्वक निकुम्भ की प्रतिमा स्थापित की ।३८-४०। उस स्थान पर निकुम्म की मूति को नित्यप्रति बड़ी पूजा होने लग्ी। गन्ध, धृपष, पुष्प, माला, अन्नादि वस्तुओं के देने से एक अद्भुत दृश्य उपस्थित हो गया । इस प्रकार गणेश्वर की नित्यप्रति पुजा होती थी। गणेश्वर ने भी पूजा
verses.wordMeaning: After filling the Sthali (mud-pot) with fire, the Gandharvas spoke to him: "O king, performing the sacrifice with this, you will attain that world." 1
verses.commentary: Sense: After filling the Sthali (mud-pot) with fire, the Gandharvas spoke to him: "O king, performing the sacrifice with this, you will attain that world." 1

verses.sanskrit: किं कुर्म इत्युवाचेदमस्मिन्काले विधीयताम् । सर्वैस्तत्संविदं कृत्वा वाहिनीं चतुरङ्गिणीम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kurma ityuvācedamasminkāle vidhīyatām / sarvaistatsaṃvidaṃ kṛtvā vāhinīṃ caturaṅgiṇīm
verses.translation: He took the fire and went back to his city along with the prince. He placed the fire in the Arani and went to his abode along with his son.
verses.hindi: ततो बरसहस्राणि नगराणां प्रयच्छति। पुत्रान्हिरिण्यमायूंषि सर्वकार्मांस्तथव च ..
verses.wordMeaning: He took the fire and went back to his city along with the prince. He placed the fire in the Arani and went to his abode along with his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: He took the fire and went back to his city along with the prince. He placed the fire in the Arani and went to his abode along with his son.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषयामि दिशः सर्वा हस्त्यश्वरथसंकुला । वादित्राणि च वाद्यन्ते व्याकुलीभूतसंकुले
verses.transliteration: preṣayāmi diśaḥ sarvā hastyaśvarathasaṃkulā / vāditrāṇi ca vādyante vyākulībhūtasaṃkule
verses.translation: As w. 40-45 show, this Puraria attributes to Pururavas, the institution (or encouragement) of the performance of Yajha out of the fire created from Arafii ( of Asvattha wood) by attrition. Bd. 3.66.19 gives the credit of introducing three fires (Daksinagni etc.) to Pururavas.
verses.hindi: राज्ञस्तु महिषी श्रेष्ठा सुयशा नाम विश्रुता । पुत्रार्थभागता साध्वी राज्ञा देवी प्रचोदिता पैडड पुजां तु बिपुलां कृत्वा देवी पुत्रानयाचत  पुनः पुनरथा55गम्य बहुशः पुत्रकारणात् ४४५ न प्रयच्छति पुत्रांस्तु निकुम्भः कारणेन तु । राजा यदि तु क्ष्येत ततः किचिटवतंते अथ दीघेंण कालेन क्रोधो राजानमाविशत् । भृतं त्थिदं महाद्यारि नागराणां प्रयच्छति ४७
verses.wordMeaning: As w. 40-45 show, this Puraria attributes to Pururavas, the institution (or encouragement) of the performance of Yajha out of the fire created from Arafii ( of Asvattha wood) by attrition. Bd. 3.66.19 gives the credit of introducing three fires (Daksinagni etc.) to Pururavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: As w. 40-45 show, this Puraria attributes to Pururavas, the institution (or encouragement) of the performance of Yajha out of the fire created from Arafii ( of Asvattha wood) by attrition. Bd. 3.66.19 gives the credit of introducing three fires (Daksinagni etc.) to Pururavas.

verses.sanskrit: नाराचैस्तोमरैर्भल्लैः खड्गैः परश्वधादिभिः । राजा संनाहबद्धो ऽभूद्गनं ग्रसते किल
verses.transliteration: nārācaistomarairbhallaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhādibhiḥ / rājā saṃnāhabaddho 'bhūdganaṃ grasate kila
verses.translation: S rim an, the successor of Bhima, was a king with go en lustre (otherwise known as Kancanaprabha). The scholarly and powerful Suhotra was the son of Kancana (i.e. Kancana- prabha).
verses.hindi: तत्राचितभ्र बहुशो देव्या मे तत्र कारणात् । न ददाति च पुत्न॑ से कृतघ्नो बहुभोजनः ३४६ अतो नाहंति पूजां तु मत्सकाशात्कथंचन । तस्मात्तु नाशयिष्यामि तस्य स्थान दुरात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: S rim an, the successor of Bhima, was a king with go en lustre (otherwise known as Kancanaprabha). The scholarly and powerful Suhotra was the son of Kancana (i.e. Kancana- prabha).
verses.commentary: Sense: S rim an, the successor of Bhima, was a king with go en lustre (otherwise known as Kancanaprabha). The scholarly and powerful Suhotra was the son of Kancana (i.e. Kancana- prabha).

verses.sanskrit: न देवो न च गन्धर्वो न दैत्यो न च राक्षसः । किं करिष्यति राजाद्य न जाने रोषनिष्कृतिम्
verses.transliteration: na devo na ca gandharvo na daityo na ca rākṣasaḥ / kiṃ kariṣyati rājādya na jāne roṣaniṣkṛtim
verses.translation: Jahnu was the son of Suhotra, born of Kesika s
verses.hindi: भग्नमायतन दृष्ट्वा राजानमगमत्प्रभुः । यस्मादनपराध॑ मे त्वया स्थान विनाशितम् से सस्तुष्ट होकर नगरनिवासियों के लिए सहस्रों वरदान प्रदान किये, पुत्र, सुवंग, दीर्घायु, एवं अन्य सभी प्रकार के मनोरथों की पूर्ति की ।४१-४३। राजा दिवोदास कौ पटरानी का नाम सुयशा था जो परम साध्वी थीं । राजा की प्रेरणा से वह भी पुत्र प्राप्ति की कामना से उपस्थित हुई और विपुल पूजा करने के उपरास्त पुत्रों का वरदान माँगा । इसी प्रकार बारम्बार आकर उन्होंने पुत्र प्राप्ति के लिए पूजा और वरदान-याचना की ।४४-४४॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Jahnu was the son of Suhotra, born of Kesika s
verses.commentary: Sense: Jahnu was the son of Suhotra, born of Kesika s

verses.sanskrit: नागरो ऽपि जनस्तत्र दृष्ट्वा चकितमानसः । चतुर्दशसहस्राणि दन्तिनां सृणिधारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: nāgaro 'pi janastatra dṛṣṭvā cakitamānasaḥ / caturdaśasahasrāṇi dantināṃ sṛṇidhāriṇām
verses.translation: Amavasu was the founder of Kanyakubja kingdom—Pargiter, AITH,
verses.hindi: किल्तु निकुम्म ते उक्त कारणवश् पुत्रों का वरदान नहीं दिया, उसने सोचा कि यदि रानी को मैं वरदान न दूंगा तो राजा क्रुठ हो जायग्रा और तब हमारा सब काम सध जायग्रा। इस प्रकार बहुत समय व्यतीत हो जाने पर राजा को क्रोव आ गया, वह सोचने लगा, कि यह भूत हमारी इस नगरी के महान् द्वारदेश पर स्थित है, नगरवासियों के ऊपर प्रसन्‍त होकर संकड़ों वरदान इसने प्रदान किये, किन्तु हमें कुछ भी नहीं देता,
verses.wordMeaning: Amavasu was the founder of Kanyakubja kingdom—Pargiter, AITH,
verses.commentary: Sense: Amavasu was the founder of Kanyakubja kingdom—Pargiter, AITH,

verses.sanskrit: अश्वारोहसहस्राणि ह्यशीतिः शस्त्रपाणिनाम् । रथानां त्रिसहस्राणि विंशतिर्भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration: aśvārohasahasrāṇi hyaśītiḥ śastrapāṇinām / rathānāṃ trisahasrāṇi viṃśatirbharatarṣabha
verses.translation: It was a result of the curse of Yuvanasva that Ganga was produced by him. Kaverl, the most excellent of all rivers, became the praise-worthy wife of Jahnu. Jahnu begot a beloved righteous son named Suhotra, of Kaverl. Suhotra's son was Ajaka.
verses.hindi: हमाशी ही प्रजाओं द्वारा इसकी पूजा नित्य होती है, मेरी ही नगरी में इसका आवासस्थल है, देवी ने मेरे कहने से इसकी अनेक प्रकार से पूजाएँ भी कों, किस्तु इस इृतध्न को मेरे लिए एक भी पुत्र देने का अवसर नहीं मिला, यह बड़ा खत्बू है, अतः आज से इसकी पूजा नहीं करनी चाहिए, मेरी ओर से इसको पूजा किसी प्रकार भी नहीं होगी। इस दुरात्मा का स्थान नष्ट करा दूंगा ।! ।४६-५०। इस प्रकार का निश्चय कर दुरात्मा एवं कुटिल राजा ने कुमतिवश होकर गणेश्वर निकुम्भ का स्थान नष्ट करा दिया । अपने आवासस्थल को नष्ट भ्रष्ट देखकर परम प्रभावशाली गणपति निकुम्भ राजा के पास आये और बोले, तुमने यतः बिना किसी अपराध के ही हमारे स्थान को नष्ट करवा दिया हैं, इसलिये है नराधिप ! तुम्हारी यह नगरी बिना किसी
verses.wordMeaning: It was a result of the curse of Yuvanasva that Ganga was produced by him. Kaverl, the most excellent of all rivers, became the praise-worthy wife of Jahnu. Jahnu begot a beloved righteous son named Suhotra, of Kaverl. Suhotra's son was Ajaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was a result of the curse of Yuvanasva that Ganga was produced by him. Kaverl, the most excellent of all rivers, became the praise-worthy wife of Jahnu. Jahnu begot a beloved righteous son named Suhotra, of Kaverl. Suhotra's son was Ajaka.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्ग्रामभेरीनिनदैः खुररेणुर्नभोगता । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तात रक्षको नगरस्य हि
verses.transliteration: saṅgrāmabherīninadaiḥ khurareṇurnabhogatā / etasminnantare tāta rakṣako nagarasya hi
verses.translation: Ajaka's successor was Balakasva of great fame. Gaya, Slla and Kusa are remembered as sons born to him.
verses.hindi: परेद भायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Ajaka's successor was Balakasva of great fame. Gaya, Slla and Kusa are remembered as sons born to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajaka's successor was Balakasva of great fame. Gaya, Slla and Kusa are remembered as sons born to him.

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वाभरणं तस्यास्त्वङ्गप्रत्यङ्गिकं तथा । कुण्डलाङ्गदकेयूरहारनूपुरझल्लरीः
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvābharaṇaṃ tasyāstvaṅgapratyaṅgikaṃ tathā / kuṇḍalāṅgadakeyūrahāranūpurajhallarīḥ
verses.translation: Kusa had four sons brilliant due to their Vedic know¬ ledge. They were Kusasva, Kusanabha, Amurtarayasas and Vasu.
verses.hindi: शप्त्वा पुरी निकुम्भस्तु महादेवमथानयत् । शुन्यां पुरीं महादेवो निर्ममे परमात्मना ५४ तुल्याँ देवविभृत्यास्तु देव्याश्चेब महात्मनः । रमते तत्न वे देवी रममाणों महेश्वरः ५५ न राति तत्र वे देवी लभते गृहविस्मयात् । देव्याः क़ीडार्थमीशानों देवो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ५६ नाहूं वेश्म विभोक्ष्यामि अविमुक्त हि में गृहम् । प्रहस्येनासथोवाच अविमुक्त हि से गृहम् ५७ नाह देवि गमिष्यासि गच्छस्वेह वसाम्यहम् । तस्मात्तदविमुक्त हि प्रोक्तं देवेन वे स्वयम् ४८ एवं वाराणसी शप्ता अविमुक्त च कीतितम् । यस्मिन्वसति वे देवाः सर्वदेवनसस्कृतः ॥। द
verses.wordMeaning: Kusa had four sons brilliant due to their Vedic know¬ ledge. They were Kusasva, Kusanabha, Amurtarayasas and Vasu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kusa had four sons brilliant due to their Vedic know¬ ledge. They were Kusasva, Kusanabha, Amurtarayasas and Vasu.

verses.sanskrit: निवेद्याकथयद्राज्ञे मया दृष्टं त्ववेक्षणात् । तापसानामाश्रमे तु माण्डव्यो यत्र तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: nivedyākathayadrājñe mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tvavekṣaṇāt / tāpasānāmāśrame tu māṇḍavyo yatra tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: The excellent king Kusastamba desirous of a son, performed a penance. When a thousand years were completed he saw Satakratu (Indra).
verses.hindi: युगेषु त्रिष धर्मात्मा सह देव्या महेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent king Kusastamba desirous of a son, performed a penance. When a thousand years were completed he saw Satakratu (Indra).
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent king Kusastamba desirous of a son, performed a penance. When a thousand years were completed he saw Satakratu (Indra).

verses.sanskrit: तापसैर्वेष्टितो यत्र ददृशे तत्र सन्निधौ । दण्डवासिवचः श्रुत्वा प्रत्यक्षाङ्गविभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: tāpasairveṣṭito yatra dadṛśe tatra sannidhau / daṇḍavāsivacaḥ śrutvā pratyakṣāṅgavibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: On seeing him who performed severe penance, the thousand-eyed Purandara decided to become his son, as he was competent to do so. The enemy of Paka (i.e. Indra) became his son and took the name Gadhi. He was called Kausika also, being a member of the family of Kusa.
verses.hindi: 7रण के ही सनी हो जायगी ।” निकुम्भ के इसी शाप के कारण प्राचीनकाल में वाराणसोपुरी सूनी हुई थी । इस प्रकार वाराणसी को शाप देकर निकृम्भ ने वहाँ पर महादेव जी को बुलाया ।११-५४। देवाधिदेव महादेवजी ने उस सूनी प्री का हैविकविभ्त्तियों द्वारा पुनर्तिर्माण किया, उसमें महान् ऐश्वयंशाली महादेव का तथा दिव्यगुणमयी पाबंती का निध्य विहार होने लगा। अपने भवन को देखकर पावंती जी को परम विस्मय होता था, उन्हें कुछ दिन के बाद इसमें सन्‍्तोष नहीं मिला, तब ईशानदेव ने देवी की फक्रीडा के लिए उनसे यह बात कही, 'देवि ! मैं अपने इस सन्दर भवन का परित्याग नहाँ करूँगा, मेरा यह गृह अविमुक्त है, इस प्रकार हँसते हुए महादेव जी ने पाव॑ती से फिर" कहा कि मेरा यह भवन अविमुक्त है। मैं तो यहाँ से कही अन्यन्र नहीं जाऊँगा. तुम चाहो तो यहाँ से जा सकती हो, मैं तो यहीं पर रहेंगा। यतः महादेव जी ने स्वयं अपने मुख
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him who performed severe penance, the thousand-eyed Purandara decided to become his son, as he was competent to do so. The enemy of Paka (i.e. Indra) became his son and took the name Gadhi. He was called Kausika also, being a member of the family of Kusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him who performed severe penance, the thousand-eyed Purandara decided to become his son, as he was competent to do so. The enemy of Paka (i.e. Indra) became his son and took the name Gadhi. He was called Kausika also, being a member of the family of Kusa.

verses.sanskrit: स क्रोधरक्तनयनो मन्त्रिणो वीक्ष्य नैगमान् । ईदृग्भूतसमाचारो ब्राह्मणो नगरे मम
verses.transliteration: sa krodharaktanayano mantriṇo vīkṣya naigamān / īdṛgbhūtasamācāro brāhmaṇo nagare mama
verses.translation: Kusastamba's wife was Paurukutsa and Gadhi was born of her. Lord Gadhi gave his eldest daughter, the splendid and blessed Satyavati, to Rcika who was a descendant of Bhrgu (Kavya?).
verses.hindi: से इसे अविमक्त कहा था, अतः उसका अविमृक्त नाम पड़ा ।५५-४८। इस प्रकार वाराणसीपुरी को जिस कारणवश शाप दिया गया था और उसका अविमुक्त नाम जिस कारण से पड़ा था, वह सब मैं कह चुका  उस वाराणसी नगरी में सभी देवताओं के ममस्करणौय धर्मात्मा महादेव जी पा्बयंती के साथ तीनों युगों में निवास करते हैं ।५९। केवल कलियुग में महात्मा शंकर का वह पुर अन्तहित हो जाता है। उसके अन्तहित हो जाने
verses.wordMeaning: Kusastamba's wife was Paurukutsa and Gadhi was born of her. Lord Gadhi gave his eldest daughter, the splendid and blessed Satyavati, to Rcika who was a descendant of Bhrgu (Kavya?).
verses.commentary: Sense: Kusastamba's wife was Paurukutsa and Gadhi was born of her. Lord Gadhi gave his eldest daughter, the splendid and blessed Satyavati, to Rcika who was a descendant of Bhrgu (Kavya?).

verses.sanskrit: चौरचर्यां व्रतच्छन्नः परद्रव्यापहरकः । तेन कन्या हृता मे ऽद्य तपस्विपापकर्मिणा
verses.transliteration: cauracaryāṃ vratacchannaḥ paradravyāpaharakaḥ / tena kanyā hṛtā me 'dya tapasvipāpakarmiṇā
verses.translation: Her husband, himself a descendant of Bhrgu and the delighter of the Bhrgu family, prepared Cam (consecrated cooked rice) for the sake (of the birth) of a son to himself as well as to Gadhi. The courageous sageRcIka, the descendant of Bhrgu, called (his wife Satyavati and said): "O splendid lady, this Caru should be taken by you and this by your mother. A brilliant leader of Ksatriyas will be born to her. He cannot be conquered by Ksatriyas in battle. He will be the destroyer of prominent Ksatriyas. This Caru will give you, O splendid lady, an excellent Brahmana as a son. He will be courageous and quiescent, possessing penance as his wealth (i.e. he will become a great sage)."
verses.hindi: पर वह वाराणसी पुरी पुनः वहाँ प्रतिष्ठित होती है। इस प्रकार निकुम्भ के शाप से शापित वाराणसी पुत प्रतिष्ठित हुई । प्राचीनकाल में नरपति दिवोदास ने राजा भद्रश्नेण्य के परम धनुर्धारी सो पुत्रों का निधन करके उसके पुर में प्रवेश किया और परम बलशाली उसने भरद्रश्रेण्य के राज्य को भी छीत लिया था। भद्रश्नण्य का एक पुत्र दुर्दभम नामक था, राजा दिवोदास ने उसे निपट बालक समझ कर, उसके जीतने का कोई
verses.wordMeaning: Her husband, himself a descendant of Bhrgu and the delighter of the Bhrgu family, prepared Cam (consecrated cooked rice) for the sake (of the birth) of a son to himself as well as to Gadhi. The courageous sageRcIka, the descendant of Bhrgu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Her husband, himself a descendant of Bhrgu and the delighter of the Bhrgu family, prepared Cam (consecrated cooked rice) for the sake (of the birth) of a son to himself as well as to Gadhi. The courageous sageRcIka, the descendant of Bhrgu,…

verses.sanskrit: शाकुन्तं रूपमास्थाय जलस्थो गगनं ययौ । पाखण्डिनो विकर्मस्थान् बिडालव्रतिकाञ्छठान्
verses.transliteration: śākuntaṃ rūpamāsthāya jalastho gaganaṃ yayau / pākhaṇḍino vikarmasthān biḍālavratikāñchaṭhān
verses.translation: After saying entered the forest,
verses.hindi: बत्सपुत्रों ह्यालकंस्तु संनतिस्तस्य चा5घत्मजः । अलक॑ प्रति राजषिगीतश्लोको पुरातनों ६६ षष्टिवर्षसहत्लाणि षष्टिवर्षशतानि च । युवा रूपेण संपन्नो ह्मलकेः काशिसत्तमः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After saying entered the forest,
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying entered the forest,

verses.sanskrit: चाटुतस्करदुर्वृत्तान् हन्यान्नस्त्यस्य पातकम् । न द्रष्टव्यो मया पापः स्तेयी कन्यापहारकः
verses.transliteration: cāṭutaskaradurvṛttān hanyānnastyasya pātakam / na draṣṭavyo mayā pāpaḥ steyī kanyāpahārakaḥ
verses.translation: Then Satyavatl Conceived in her womb a foetus that
verses.hindi: शापस्यान्ते महाबाहुहेत्वा क्षेमकराक्षसम् । रम्यभावासयामरास पुरीं वाराणसी नृपः ६८ संनतेरपि दायादः सुनीथो नाम धामिकः । सुनीथस्य तु दायादः सुकेतुर्नाम धामिकः ६९ सुकेतुतनयश्रापि धर्मकेतुरिति श्रुतिः। धर्मकेतोस्तु दायादः सत्यकेतुर्महारथः . (७० सत्यकेतुसतश्रधापि विभुर्नाम प्रजेश्वरः। सुविभुस्तु विभोः पुत्र: सुकुमारस्ततः स्मृतः ७१ सुकुमारस्य पुत्रस्तु धुष्टकेतुः स धामिकः। धृ ध्टकेतोस्तु दायादो वेणुहोत्रः प्रजेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Then Satyavatl Conceived in her womb a foetus that
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Satyavatl Conceived in her womb a foetus that

verses.sanskrit: शूलम् आरोप्यतां क्षिप्रं न विचारस्तु तस्य वै । स च वध्यो मया दुष्टो रक्षोरूपी तपोधनः
verses.transliteration: śūlam āropyatāṃ kṣipraṃ na vicārastu tasya vai / sa ca vadhyo mayā duṣṭo rakṣorūpī tapodhanaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing it and pondering over it by means of Yogic power, Rcika, the excellent Brahmana, spoke to his fair- complexioned wife:
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणा क्षत्रियाश्चेव तयोः पुत्राः सुधासिकाः । विक्वान्ता बलवन्तश्न सिहतुल्यपराक्षमाः ७४
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing it and pondering over it by means of Yogic power, Rcika, the excellent Brahmana, spoke to his fair- complexioned wife:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing it and pondering over it by means of Yogic power, Rcika, the excellent Brahmana, spoke to his fair- complexioned wife:

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवंश्चलन्क्रोधादादिश्य दण्डवासिनम् । कार्याकार्यं न विज्ञाय शूलमारोपयद्द्विजम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvaṃścalankrodhādādiśya daṇḍavāsinam / kāryākāryaṃ na vijñāya śūlamāropayaddvijam
verses.translation: Your mother will give birth to such a saintly son. The entire Brahman (Vedic knowledge) has been instilled into it by me.
verses.hindi: महत्त्व न समझ कर घृणा से छोड़ दिया था ।६०-६३। राजा दिवोदास से दुषढ्गवती नामक पत्नी में प्रतदत नामक वौर पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ, भव्रश्नेण्य के उस बालक उतर ने प्रतच॑ईन से छीना हुआ राज्य पुनः छीन लिया । उस राजाधिराज ने इस प्रकार अपने वर का बदला चुका लिया। प्रतदंत के वत्स और गगे नामक दों पुत्र कहे जाते हैं। वत्स के पुत्र अलक हुए, जिनके पुत्र का नाम सन्नति हुआ । राजषि अलको के लिए ये पुराने दो श्लोक गाये जते हैं, जिनका आद्यय इस प्रकार है। साठ सहस्त साठ सौ वर्षो तक काशिराज अलक युवा था, लोपामुद्रा की कपा से उसे इतनी बड़ी आयु प्राप्त हुई थी ।६४-६७॥ एक सहख . वर्ष के शाप के व्यंतीत हो जाने पर महाबाहु राजा अलक ने उस क्षेमक नामक राक्षस को मार कर पुनः मनोहर वाराणसी पुरी को बसाया  सन्‍तति का उत्तराधिकारी सुनीथ नामक धाभिक राजा हुआ । सुनीथ का उत्तराधि-
verses.wordMeaning: Your mother will give birth to such a saintly son. The entire Brahman (Vedic knowledge) has been instilled into it by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your mother will give birth to such a saintly son. The entire Brahman (Vedic knowledge) has been instilled into it by me.

verses.sanskrit: पौरा जानपदाः सर्वे अश्रुपूर्णमुखास्तदा । हाहेत्युक्त्वा रुदन्त्यन्ये वदन्ति च पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: paurā jānapadāḥ sarve aśrupūrṇamukhāstadā / hāhetyuktvā rudantyanye vadanti ca pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: Thus warned by her husband, the blessed lady Satya¬ vatl propitiated her husband: "May my son never be like this. Let another be a base Brahmana". Thus requested, the sage said: "O gentle lady, this has never been thought of nor desired by me or by you. The son may be one of terrible activities due to the fault of his father or mother".
verses.hindi: कारी सुकेत नामक धामिक विचारों वाला राजा हुआ  सुकेतु का पुत्र धर्मकेतु नाम से सुना जाता है । घर्ंकेतु का उत्तराधिकारी भहारथी सत्यवेतु हुआ  सत्यकेतु का पुत्र प्रजश्वर विश्र हुआ, विश्र का पुत्र सुविश्ञ और उससे सुकुमार नामक पुत्र की उत्पत्ति कही जाती है ।६८-७१। सुकुमार का उत्र परम धामिक यष्टकेतु हुआ, धृष्ठकेतु का उत्तराधिकारी प्रजापालक वेणहोत्र हुआ। वेणहोत्र का पुत्र गाग्ये नाम से विख्यात हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus warned by her husband, the blessed lady Satya¬ vatl propitiated her husband: "May my son never be like this. Let another be a base Brahmana". Thus requested, the sage said: "O gentle lady, this has never been thought of nor desired by me or by you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus warned by her husband, the blessed lady Satya¬ vatl propitiated her husband: "May my son never be like this. Let another be a base Brahmana". Thus requested, the sage said: "O gentle lady, this has never been thought of nor desired by me or by you.…

verses.sanskrit: कुत्सितं च कृतं कर्म राज्ञा चण्डालचारिणा । ब्राह्मणो नैव वध्यो हि विशेषेण तपोवृतः
verses.transliteration: kutsitaṃ ca kṛtaṃ karma rājñā caṇḍālacāriṇā / brāhmaṇo naiva vadhyo hi viśeṣeṇa tapovṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thus addressed, Satyavatl spoke again these words: "O sage, if you wish, you can create many worlds. What then a mere son?
verses.hindi: गाग्ये का पुत्र गर्भभूमि और बुद्धिमान् वत्स का पुत्र वात्स्य हुआ। ईने दोनों राजाओं के पुत्र ब्राह्मण और क्षत्रिय दोनों वर्णोवाले हुए, जो परम उत्साही बलशाली, एवं सिंह के समान प्राक्ष्मी थे। काशी के राजाओं का वर्णन कर चुका अब रजि के पुत्रों का वर्णन सुनिये। महाराज रजि के सौ पूत्र थे, जिसमें पांच पृथ्वी में इत्येते काश(श्य) पाः प्रोक्ता रजेरपि निबोधत । रजेः पुत्रशतान्यासन्पच्च वीयेवतो भुवि ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed, Satyavatl spoke again these words: "O sage, if you wish, you can create many worlds. What then a mere son?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed, Satyavatl spoke again these words: "O sage, if you wish, you can create many worlds. What then a mere son?

verses.sanskrit: यदि रोषसमाचारो निर्वास्यो नगराद्बहिः । न जातु ब्राह्मणं हन्यात् सर्वपापे ऽप्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: yadi roṣasamācāro nirvāsyo nagarādbahiḥ / na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt sarvapāpe 'pyavasthitam
verses.translation: This explains why Parasuraraa, though ]a Brahmana, was of a militant nature and Visvamitra, though K?atriya by birth, attained Brahm ana-hood. O holy lord, O master, it behoves you to grant me a son who will be quiescent and straightforward. O Lord, say 'Let such a son be born'.
verses.hindi: राजेपमिति विख्यात क्षत्रमिद्वभयावहम् "७४५ तदा दवासुरे युद्ध समुत्पन्ने सुदारुण । देवाश्चेवासुराश्वेव पितामहमथाबुवन् ,
verses.wordMeaning: This explains why Parasuraraa, though ]a Brahmana, was of a militant nature and Visvamitra, though K?atriya by birth, attained Brahm ana-hood. O holy lord, O master, it behoves you to grant me a son who will be quiescent and straightforward. O Lord, say 'Let such a son be born'.
verses.commentary: Sense: This explains why Parasuraraa, though ]a Brahmana, was of a militant nature and Visvamitra, though K?atriya by birth, attained Brahm ana-hood. O holy lord, O master, it behoves you to grant me a son who will be quiescent and straightforward. O Lord, say 'Let such a son be born'.

verses.sanskrit: राष्ट्रादेनं बहिष्कुर्यात् समग्रधनमक्षतम् । नाश्नाति च गृहे राजन्नाग्निर्नगरवासिनाम् । सर्वे ऽप्युद्विग्नमनसो गृहव्याप्तिविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: rāṣṭrādenaṃ bahiṣkuryāt samagradhanamakṣatam / nāśnāti ca gṛhe rājannāgnirnagaravāsinām / sarve 'pyudvignamanaso gṛhavyāptivivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmana, nothing other than this can be done to me". Thereafter, by means of the power of his penance, he made her delighted.
verses.hindi: आवयोभंगबन्युद्धे विजेता को भविष्यति । ब्रृहि नः सर्वलोकेश श्रोतुसिच्छामहे वयम् ७७ येबासर्थाय सहःग्रामे रजिरात्तायुधः प्रभु:  योत्स्यते ते विजेष्यस्ति त्रील्लाँकान्नात्र संशय: ७८ रजियंतस्ततो लक्ष्मीयंतो लक्ष्मीस्ततों धुतिः  यतो धृतिस्ततों धर्मो यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः ७६
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmana, nothing other than this can be done to me". Thereafter, by means of the power of his penance, he made her delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmana, nothing other than this can be done to me". Thereafter, by means of the power of his penance, he made her delighted.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे माण्डव्यशूलारोपणवर्णनं नाम सप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १७१ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: कथितं ब्राह्मणं द्रष्टुं शूले क्षिप्तं तपोधनैः । नारायणसमीपे तु गताः सर्वे महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe māṇḍavyaśūlāropaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 171 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kathitaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ śūle kṣiptaṃ tapodhanaiḥ / nārāyaṇasamīpe tu gatāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: "O fair-complexioned lady, it makes no difference as far as I am concerned whether it is the son or the grand¬ son. O gentle lady, everything shall be in accordance with the words spoken by you."
verses.hindi: ते हृष्टमनसः सर्वे राजानं देवदानवाः। ऊचुरस्मज्ज्जयाय त्वं गृहाण वरकार्मुकम् ८१
verses.wordMeaning: "O fair-complexioned lady, it makes no difference as far as I am concerned whether it is the son or the grand¬ son. O gentle lady, everything shall be in accordance with the words spoken by you."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O fair-complexioned lady, it makes no difference as far as I am concerned whether it is the son or the grand¬ son. O gentle lady, everything shall be in accordance with the words spoken by you."

verses.sanskrit: नारदो देवलो रैभ्यो यमः शातातपो ऽङ्गिराः । वसिष्ठो जमदग्निश्च याज्ञवल्क्यो बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: nārado devalo raibhyo yamaḥ śātātapo 'ṅgirāḥ / vasiṣṭho jamadagniśca yājñavalkyo bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: Therefore Satyavatl gave birth to a son, the scion of the family of Bhrgu. He was Jamadagni, the quiescent and self-controlled. He was interested in penance.
verses.hindi: अहं जेष्यामि वा युद्धे वेवाअशक़पुरोगमान् । इस्द्रो भवासि धर्मात्मा ततो योत्स्यामि संयुगे. परम बलवान् विख्यात थे । वे राजेय नाम से विख्यात थे, इन्द्र भी उनके क्षात्रबल से भय खाते थे ।७२-७५। उस समय देवताओं ओर राक्षसों में परम दारुण युद्ध मचा हुआ था, देवता औद असुर दोनों दलवालों ने वितामह ब्रह्मा से पुछा, भगवन् ! हम दोनों के वर्गों के इस घमासान युद्ध में कौन वर्ग विज्रयी होगा समस्त लोकों के स्वामित् ! इस बात को हम लोग जानना चाहते हैं, बतलाइये
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore Satyavatl gave birth to a son, the scion of the family of Bhrgu. He was Jamadagni, the quiescent and self-controlled. He was interested in penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore Satyavatl gave birth to a son, the scion of the family of Bhrgu. He was Jamadagni, the quiescent and self-controlled. He was interested in penance.

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपो ऽत्रिर्भरद्वाजो विश्वामित्रो ऽरुणिर्मुनिः । वालखिल्यादयो ऽन्ये च सर्वे ऽप्यृषिगणान्वयाः
verses.transliteration: kaśyapo 'trirbharadvājo viśvāmitro 'ruṇirmuniḥ / vālakhilyādayo 'nye ca sarve 'pyṛṣigaṇānvayāḥ
verses.translation: Formerly when there was an interchange of Raudra and Vaisnava Cams in the Yajna of Bhrgu, he ate ( Jamanat) the Vaisnava nre and so he came to be known as 'Jamadagni'.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा ने कहा--जिन लोगों के लिए महान् पराक्रमशाली महाराज रजि संग्राम भूमि में हथियार धारण करेगे, वे लोग तीनों लोकों को जीत सकेंगे, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। जहाँ पर महाराज रजि हैं वहीं लक्ष्मी है, जहाँ पर लक्ष्मी का निवास है, वहीं पर वास्तविक धैये॑ और शान्ति है, जहाँ धैय॑ का निवास है, वहीं पर धर्म रहता है, और जहाँ पर धर्म रहता है, वहीं वास्तविक विजय है ।” देवताओं और दानवों ने रजि
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly when there was an interchange of Raudra and Vaisnava Cams in the Yajna of Bhrgu, he ate ( Jamanat) the Vaisnava nre and so he came to be known as 'Jamadagni'.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly when there was an interchange of Raudra and Vaisnava Cams in the Yajna of Bhrgu, he ate ( Jamanat) the Vaisnava nre and so he came to be known as 'Jamadagni'.

verses.sanskrit: ददृशुः शूलमारूढं माण्डव्यमृषिपुंगवाः । प्रोचुर्नारायणं विप्रं किं कुर्मस्तव चेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: dadṛśuḥ śūlamārūḍhaṃ māṇḍavyamṛṣipuṃgavāḥ / procurnārāyaṇaṃ vipraṃ kiṃ kurmastava cepsitam
verses.translation: Having obtained Visvamitra as his successor, Gadhi the delighter of KuSikas (members of the family of Kusika) attained the status equal to that of Brahmana sages. He was selected to be such by Brahma.
verses.hindi: ढ्वारा जय की बातें सुनकर अपने-अपने पक्ष की विजय आकांक्षा से राजाधिराज रजि की प्रार्थना की । अत्यन्त प्रसन्न मत से देवताओं और दानवों ने राजा रजि के पास जाकर यह निवेदन किया कि 'तुम हमारी विजय के लिए सुदृढ़ धनुष घारण करो! राज़ बोले--हम तुम सब को युद्ध में पराजित कर देंगे, इन्द्र प्रभृति प्रमुख देवगणों को भी हम पराजित कर देंगे, किन्तु हमीं धर्मात्मा इन्द्र होंगे, इसी शर्ते पर हम युद्ध में धनृष धारण करेंगे ।५२॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Having obtained Visvamitra as his successor, Gadhi the delighter of KuSikas (members of the family of Kusika) attained the status equal to that of Brahmana sages. He was selected to be such by Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having obtained Visvamitra as his successor, Gadhi the delighter of KuSikas (members of the family of Kusika) attained the status equal to that of Brahmana sages. He was selected to be such by Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ते तत्र सांनिध्यान् माण्डव्यस्य महात्मनः । संभ्रान्ता आगता ऊचुः किं मृतः किं नु जीवति
verses.transliteration: sarve te tatra sāṃnidhyān māṇḍavyasya mahātmanaḥ / saṃbhrāntā āgatā ūcuḥ kiṃ mṛtaḥ kiṃ nu jīvati
verses.translation: In this manner, the lofty-minded Jamadagni, the fore¬ most among those who know Brahman, was born of Satya vatl, thanks to the semen virile of Aurva Rcika. The middle son was Sunahsepha and the youngest was Sunahpuccha.
verses.hindi: अस्माकमिन्द्र: प्रह्दादस्तस्यार्थें विजयामहे । अस्मिस्तु समये राज॑स्तिष्ठेया देवनोदिते ॥८रे स तयेति ब्रुवस्नेव देवेरप्यभिचोदितः । भविष्यसीन्‍्द्रो जित्बेति देवेरपि निमन्त्रितः ८४ जघान दानवास्सर्वान्समक्षं वज्ञपाणिन:ः । स विप्रनष्टां देवानां परमश्रीः श्रियं वशी ८५ निह॒त्य दानवान्सर्वानाजहार रजिः प्रभुः । त॑ तथा तु राज तत्र देवः सह शतक्तुः ८६
verses.wordMeaning: In this manner, the lofty-minded Jamadagni, the fore¬ most among those who know Brahman, was born of Satya vatl, thanks to the semen virile of Aurva Rcika. The middle son was Sunahsepha and the youngest was Sunahpuccha.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this manner, the lofty-minded Jamadagni, the fore¬ most among those who know Brahman, was born of Satya vatl, thanks to the semen virile of Aurva Rcika. The middle son was Sunahsepha and the youngest was Sunahpuccha.

verses.sanskrit: अवस्थां तस्य ते दृष्ट्वा विषादमगमन्परम् । असहित्वा तु तद्दुःखं सर्वे ते मनसा द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: avasthāṃ tasya te dṛṣṭvā viṣādamagamanparam / asahitvā tu tadduḥkhaṃ sarve te manasā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The pious-souled Visvamitra is remembered by the name Visvaratha also. By the favour of Bhrgu, he was born of Kau£ika, as the perpetuator of the race of Kausika.
verses.hindi: रजिपुत्रो5हमित्युक्त्वा पुनरेजाब्वीदहचः । इन्द्रोडसि राजन्देवानां सर्वेषां नातन्र संशयः । स तु शक्रबचः भ्रुत्वा वच्चितस्तेन मायया । तथेत्येवाब्रवीद्राजा प्रीयमाण: शतक़्तुम्
verses.wordMeaning: The pious-souled Visvamitra is remembered by the name Visvaratha also. By the favour of Bhrgu, he was born of Kau£ika, as the perpetuator of the race of Kausika.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pious-souled Visvamitra is remembered by the name Visvaratha also. By the favour of Bhrgu, he was born of Kau£ika, as the perpetuator of the race of Kausika.

verses.sanskrit: पृच्छयतां यदि मन्येत राजानं भस्मसात्कुरु । तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वाक्यं नारायणो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: pṛcchayatāṃ yadi manyeta rājānaṃ bhasmasātkuru / teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vākyaṃ nārāyaṇo 'bravīt
verses.translation: Some other families of the Brahmarsi Kausika, the holy descendant of Pururavas are: Sosrumas and Saindhava-
verses.hindi: ताध्मस्तु देवसदुशे दिवं प्राप्त महीपतो । दायाद्यमिन्द्रादाजहू रुराचारं तनया रजेः ८६ तानि पुत्रशतान्यस्थ तच्च स्थान शचीपतेः । समक्रामन्त बहुधा स्वर्गलोक त्रिविष्टपम् (१६० ततः काले बहुतिये समतीते महाबलः । हतराज्यो5ब्रवोच्छ क्रो हृतभागो बृहस्पतिम् .. ७६१
verses.wordMeaning: Some other families of the Brahmarsi Kausika, the holy descendant of Pururavas are: Sosrumas and Saindhava-
verses.commentary: Sense: Some other families of the Brahmarsi Kausika, the holy descendant of Pururavas are: Sosrumas and Saindhava-

verses.sanskrit: मयि जीवति मद्भ्राता ह्यवस्थामीदृशीं गतः । धिग् जीवितं च मे किंतु तपसो विद्यते फलम्
verses.transliteration: mayi jīvati madbhrātā hyavasthāmīdṛśīṃ gataḥ / dhig jīvitaṃ ca me kiṃtu tapaso vidyate phalam
verses.translation: Astaka, born of Drsadvat!, was also Visvamitra's son. Astaka's sons (and descendants) constituting the Jahnu family have already been recounted by me.
verses.hindi: दानथों ने कद्दा--हम लोगों के इन्द्र प्रह्ाद हैं, उन्हीं के लिये विजय की आकांक्षा हम सबों को है, पर है साजन् ! देवता द्वारा प्रेरित इस प्रतिज्ञा में हम सभी सहमत हैं। दानवों की यह बात सुनकर महाराज रजि स्वीकारोक्ति दे ही रहे थे कि देवतागण भी बोल उठे  उन लोगों ने भौ यह निमंत्रण दिया कि आप दानवों को पराजित कर हम सब के इन्द्र हो सकते हैं ।८३-८४। देवताओं के इस निमंत्रण को स्वीकार कर रजि ने वज्जपाणि देधराज इन्द्र के देखते-देखते सभी दानवों का संहार कर डाला, इस प्रकार उस जितेन्द्रिय परम प्रभावशाली महाराज रजि ने देवताओं की विनष्ट राजलक्ष्मी क। समस्त दानवों का संहार कर उद्धार किया । उस युद्ध में विजय प्राप्त करनेवाले महाराज रजि से देवता ओं समेत शतक्रतु इन्द्र बोले, हे महाराज ! मैं आपका पुत्र हूं । पुनः इन्द्र ने कहा, राजन्  आप समस्त देवताओं के इन्द्र हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहों ।
verses.wordMeaning: Astaka, born of Drsadvat!, was also Visvamitra's son. Astaka's sons (and descendants) constituting the Jahnu family have already been recounted by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Astaka, born of Drsadvat!, was also Visvamitra's son. Astaka's sons (and descendants) constituting the Jahnu family have already been recounted by me.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा शूलस्थितं ज्येष्ठं मन्मनो नु विदीर्यते । परं किं तु करिष्यामि येन राष्ट्रं सराजकम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā śūlasthitaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ manmano nu vidīryate / paraṃ kiṃ tu kariṣyāmi yena rāṣṭraṃ sarājakam
verses.translation: What are the characteristics of Dharma, penance and learning whereby Brahmana-hood was attained by Visvamitra and other kings?
verses.hindi: हे शत्रविनाशक  मैं इन्द्र आप के पुत्र के रूप में विख्यात हँगा ।५५-८७। शक्र की ऐसी बातें सुनकर ओर उसको माया से ठगे जाकर महराज रजि ने प्रसन्न होकर कहा कि अच्छी बात है। उस देवतुल्य महाराज रजि के स्वर्गंगामी हो जाने पर उनके पुत्रों ने इन्द्र से उनका सम्पूर्ण उत्तराधिकार छीन लिया। इस प्रकार इन्द्र के स्थान पर महाराज रजि के सौ पुत्रों ने अपना अधिकार जमा लिया, और अनेक प्रकार से एक ही साथ सारे
verses.wordMeaning: What are the characteristics of Dharma, penance and learning whereby Brahmana-hood was attained by Visvamitra and other kings?
verses.commentary: Sense: What are the characteristics of Dharma, penance and learning whereby Brahmana-hood was attained by Visvamitra and other kings?

verses.sanskrit: भस्मसाच्च करोम्यद्य भवद्भिः क्षम्यतामिह । एवमुक्त्वा गृहीत्वासौ करस्थमभिमन्त्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: bhasmasācca karomyadya bhavadbhiḥ kṣamyatāmiha / evamuktvā gṛhītvāsau karasthamabhimantrayet
verses.translation: The list of Gotras of Kaufika clan given in w. 91-97 is incomplete (dot ML P. A Study, p -409).
verses.hindi: स्वर्ग शोक को आक्रान्त कर लिया ।८८-६०। बहुत दिवस बीत जाने पर महाबलशाली हतभाग्य इन्द्र, राज्य छीन लिये जाने पर बृहस्पति के समीप गये और बोले, ब्रह्मषि  आप बैर के फल जितना बड़ा पुरोडाश (चरु) का बदरीफलमात्र बे पुरोडाशं विधत्स्व मे । ब्रह्म्ष येन तिष्ठेयं तेजसाइध्प्यायितस्ततः ६२ ब्रह्मन्कृशो5यं विमना हृतराज्यो हताशनः । हतौजा दुर्बलो मुढो रजिपुत्रेः प्रसोद से
verses.wordMeaning: The list of Gotras of Kaufika clan given in w. 91-97 is incomplete (dot ML P. A Study, p -409).
verses.commentary: Sense: The list of Gotras of Kaufika clan given in w. 91-97 is incomplete (dot ML P. A Study, p -409).

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधेन पश्यते यावत्तावद्धुंकारको ऽभवत् । तेन हुङ्कारशब्देन ऋषयो विस्मितास्तदा
verses.transliteration: krodhena paśyate yāvattāvaddhuṃkārako 'bhavat / tena huṅkāraśabdena ṛṣayo vismitāstadā
verses.translation: Thus requested, he ( Sula ) spoke these meaningful words:
verses.hindi: यदेव चोदितः शुक्र त्वया स्यां पु्बंभेव हि। नाभविष्यत्त्वत्प्रियार्थ नाकतंव्यं ममानघ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested, he ( Sula ) spoke these meaningful words:
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested, he ( Sula ) spoke these meaningful words:

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्यस्य समीपे तु ह्यपृच्छंस्ते द्विजोत्तमाः । निवारयसि किं विप्र शापं नृपजिघांसनम्
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavyasya samīpe tu hyapṛcchaṃste dvijottamāḥ / nivārayasi kiṃ vipra śāpaṃ nṛpajighāṃsanam
verses.translation: A sinful soul, a base man, may give charitable gifts to Brahmanas after proclaiming his intention to perform righteous deeds to the people out of hypocrisy. An uncontrol¬ led man overwhelmed by passion and delusion may perform severe Japas and in the end may give charitable gifts for the purpose of sanctifying himslf. But these charitable gifts offered by him do not yield fruits. The charitable gifts of a wicked- souled man indulging in violence, do not stay (i.e. do not yield fruits) even if he engaged himself in holy rites. Similarly the Danas offered by one who has amassed wealth by painful
verses.hindi: प्रयतिष्यामि देवेन्द्र त्वद्धितार्थ महाद्यते । तथा भागं च राज्यं च अचिरात्प्रतिपत्स्यसे १६५ तथा शक्क गमिष्यामि मा भूत्ते विकक्‍लवं मनः । ततः कर्म चकारास्य तेज: संवर्धनं महत् ६६ तेषा च बुद्धिसंमोहमकरोद्बुद्धिसत्तमः । ते यदा ससुता मुढा रागोन्मत्ता विर्धापणः ३६७ ब्रह्मद्विषश्च संवत्ता हतवीयंपराक्रमा: । ततो लेमे सुरश्वय॑मैच्धस्थानं तथोत्तमम् ॥€८ अंश मेरे लिये बनाइये, जिससे टिक सकू, उसी के तेज से मेरी सन्तुष्टि हो सकेगी। ब्रह्मत् ! क्‍योंकि इस समय मेरी स्थिति बहुत शोचनीय हो गई है, मैं बहुत दुबंल हो बया हूं, मेरा मत नहीं लगता, मेरा राज्य-पाठ छीन लिया गया है, भोजन भी छीन लिया गया है मेरी सारी शक्ति नष्ट हो गई है, शरीर भी दुबंल हो गया है, मेरी बुद्धि भी मारी गयी है, रजि के पुत्रों से हमारी रक्षा कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: A sinful soul, a base man, may give charitable gifts to Brahmanas after proclaiming his intention to perform righteous deeds to the people out of hypocrisy.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A sinful soul, a base man, may give charitable gifts to Brahmanas after proclaiming his intention to perform righteous deeds to the people out of hypocrisy.…

verses.sanskrit: अपापस्य तु येनेह कृतमस्य जिघांसनम् । ऋषीणां वचनं श्रुत्वा कृच्छ्रान् माण्डव्यको ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: apāpasya tu yeneha kṛtamasya jighāṃsanam / ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛcchrān māṇḍavyako 'bravīt
verses.translation: Riches acquired by just (proper) means must be gifted to pious, deserving persons. If one performs; Tajnas and makes charitable gifts without harbouring any specific desire in his mind, he attains the fruits of that Dana. His; Dana results in happiness. One attains enjoyment through Dana and goes
verses.hindi: बहस्पति ने कहा--शक्र ! यदि तुम पहले ही मुझसे अपनी स्थिति बतलाये होते तो तुम्हारी यह स्थिति न होती, तुम्हारा कुछ ,भी अनिष्ठ न होता, निष्पाप  तुम्हारे कल्याण के लिए मैं कुछ भी अकर्त्तव्य नहीं समझता अर्थात् तुम्हारे लिए सब कर सकता हूं। है महाकान्तिशालिन ! देवराज  तुम्हारे लिए मैं वही प्रयत्न करूँग्रा, जिससे तुम्हारा अंश और राज्य तुम्हें पुनः शीघ्र ही वापस मिल जाय ।: ४-६५।
verses.wordMeaning: Riches acquired by just (proper) means must be gifted to pious, deserving persons. If one performs; Tajnas and makes charitable gifts without harbouring any specific desire in his mind, he attains the fruits of that Dana. His; Dana results in happiness.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Riches acquired by just (proper) means must be gifted to pious, deserving persons. If one performs; Tajnas and makes charitable gifts without harbouring any specific desire in his mind, he attains the fruits of that Dana. His; Dana results in happiness.…

verses.sanskrit: अभिवन्दामि वो मूर्ध्ना स्वागतं ऋषयः सदा । अर्घ्यसन्मानपूजार्हाः सर्वे ऽत्रोपविशन्तु ते
verses.transliteration: abhivandāmi vo mūrdhnā svāgataṃ ṛṣayaḥ sadā / arghyasanmānapūjārhāḥ sarve 'tropaviśantu te
verses.translation: Th in; an evidence of social mobility in ancient India.
verses.hindi: हे शक्र ! मैं बसा करने जा रहा हूँ, तुम मन की विकलता छोड़ दो ।? इस प्रकार इन्द्र को सानन्‍्त्वना देकर बृहस्पति ने इन्द्र की प्रताप-बद्धि के लिए महान् अनुष्ठान किया  परम बुद्धिमान् बृहस्पति ने रजि के पुत्रों की बुद्धि को मोहित कर दिया। जिससे उन सब की मति मारी गईं, पुत्रों के समेत वे विधरमम में निरत हो गये, परिणामत: रोग्रग्रस्त एवं उन्मत्त से हो गये । ब्राह्मणों से द्वेघ करने लगे, सब के पराक्रम एवं बल का विनाह्ष हो गया । ऐसी दक्शा में, जब कि वे सब के सब काम क्रोध मोह में लिप्त हो गये, इन्द्र ने उन राजि पुत्रों का संहार कर डाला, और अपना उत्तम देवताओं का स्वामित्व पद पुत्र: प्राप्त किया  जो व्यक्ति शतकतु इस्द्र
verses.wordMeaning: Th in; an evidence of social mobility in ancient India.
verses.commentary: Sense: Th in; an evidence of social mobility in ancient India.

verses.sanskrit: निविष्टैकाग्रमनसा सर्वान्माण्डव्यको ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: niviṣṭaikāgramanasā sarvānmāṇḍavyako 'bravīt
verses.translation: Bhargavyoma in Bd. P.
verses.hindi: हंत्वा रजिसुतान्सबन्कासक्रोधपरायणान् । य इ॒दं पावन स्थान प्रतिष्ठान शतक्तोः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bhargavyoma in Bd. P.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhargavyoma in Bd. P.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तं दुःखं मया घोरं पूर्वजन्मार्जितं फलम् । मा विषादं कुरुध्वं भोः कृतं पापं तु भुज्यते
verses.transliteration: prāptaṃ duḥkhaṃ mayā ghoraṃ pūrvajanmārjitaṃ phalam / mā viṣādaṃ kurudhvaṃ bhoḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tu bhujyate
verses.translation: Sutahotra's successors were three extremely righteous ones, viz. KaSa, Sala and lord Gjrtsamada.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोवत्ते रजियुद्धं नाम द्विनवतितमोथ्ध्याय: ॥ मरुत्तन कथ्थ कन्या राज्ञे सा महात्मना । किवीर्यश्व महात्मानो जाता सरुत्तकन्यकाः
verses.wordMeaning: Sutahotra's successors were three extremely righteous ones, viz. KaSa, Sala and lord Gjrtsamada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sutahotra's successors were three extremely righteous ones, viz. KaSa, Sala and lord Gjrtsamada.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । केन कर्मविपाकेन इह जात्यन्तरं व्रजेत् । दानधर्मफलेनैव केन स्वर्गं च गच्छति
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ / kena karmavipākena iha jātyantaraṃ vrajet / dānadharmaphalenaiva kena svargaṃ ca gacchati
verses.translation: Sunaka was the son of Grtsamada and his son was Saunaka. In his race Brahmanas, Vaisyas and Sudras were born as a result of their diverse Karmans. O Brahmana, Salas son was Arsti$ena and Caranta was liis son.
verses.hindi: आहवन्तं मरत्सोममन्नकासः प्रजेश्वरम् । मासि मासि महातेजाः षष्टिसंवत्सरास्नृपः
verses.wordMeaning: Sunaka was the son of Grtsamada and his son was Saunaka. In his race Brahmanas, Vaisyas and Sudras were born as a result of their diverse Karmans. O Brahmana, Salas son was Arsti$ena and Caranta was liis son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sunaka was the son of Grtsamada and his son was Saunaka. In his race Brahmanas, Vaisyas and Sudras were born as a result of their diverse Karmans. O Brahmana, Salas son was Arsti$ena and Caranta was liis son.

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्य उवाच: अदत्तदाना जायन्ते परभाग्योपजीविनः । न स्नानं न जपो होमो नातिथ्यं न सुरार्चनम्
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavya uvāca: adattadānā jāyante parabhāgyopajīvinaḥ / na snānaṃ na japo homo nātithyaṃ na surārcanam
verses.translation: The Saunakas and the Arstisenas were Brahmanas endowed with qualities characteristic of Ksatriyas. Kasa's sons were Kasaya, Rasta and Dirghatapas.
verses.hindi: की पुनः इन्द्र पद प्राप्त का एवं महाराज रजि का यह परम पवित्र वृत्तान्त पढ़ता या सुनता है, वह कभी दुर्गति में नहीं पड़ता ।६ ६-६६। ऋषियों ने पूछा;--सूत जी ! महान् पराक्रमी मरुत्त नें राजा को किस प्रकार अपनी कन्या प्रदान की थी? और मरुत्त की कन्या से उत्पस्न होने वाले वे महान् बलशाली पुत्र कितने पराक्रमी
verses.wordMeaning: The Saunakas and the Arstisenas were Brahmanas endowed with qualities characteristic of Ksatriyas. Kasa's sons were Kasaya, Rasta and Dirghatapas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saunakas and the Arstisenas were Brahmanas endowed with qualities characteristic of Ksatriyas. Kasa's sons were Kasaya, Rasta and Dirghatapas.

verses.sanskrit: न पर्वणि पितृश्राद्धं न दानं द्विजसत्तमाः । व्रजन्ति नरके घोरे यान्ति ते त्वन्त्यजां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: na parvaṇi pitṛśrāddhaṃ na dānaṃ dvijasattamāḥ / vrajanti narake ghore yānti te tvantyajāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Dharma was the son of Dirghatapas. The scholarly Dhanvantari was his son. He was of great brilliance due to his
verses.hindi: सूत बोलेः--महान् तेजस्वी राजा ने अन्न की कामना से साठ वर्षों तक प्रत्येक मास में प्रजापति
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma was the son of Dirghatapas. The scholarly Dhanvantari was his son. He was of great brilliance due to his
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma was the son of Dirghatapas. The scholarly Dhanvantari was his son. He was of great brilliance due to his

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्दरिद्राः पुनरेव पापाः पापप्रभावान्नरके वसन्ति । तेनैव संसरिणि मर्त्यलोके जीवादिभूते कृमयः पतङ्गाः
verses.transliteration: punardaridrāḥ punareva pāpāḥ pāpaprabhāvānnarake vasanti / tenaiva saṃsariṇi martyaloke jīvādibhūte kṛmayaḥ pataṅgāḥ
verses.translation: This Chapter corresponds to Ch. 2.3.67 in Bd. P. The references are to verses of the chapter in Bd. P.
verses.hindi: तेन ते मरुतस्तस्य मरुत्सोमेन तोषिताः। अक्षय्यान्नं ददुः प्रीताः स्वकामपरिच्छदम् ३ अन्न तस्थ सकृत्पक्वमहोरात्रे न क्षीयते । केटिशों दीयभानं च सुययस्योदयनादपि ३४ मिन्रज्योतिस्तु कन्यायां मरुत्तस्य च धीमतः । तस्माज्जाता महासत्तवा धर्मज्ञा मोक्षद्शिनः १३४. संन्‍्यस्य गह॒धर्माणि वेराग्यं समुपस्थिताः । यतिधरमंमवाप्येह ब्रह्मभुयाय ते गताः ६ अनपायस्ततो जातस्तदा धर्मप्रदत्तवान् (? )। क्षत्रधमंस्ततो जातः प्रतिपक्षों महातपा: १७
verses.wordMeaning: This Chapter corresponds to Ch. 2.3.67 in Bd. P. The references are to verses of the chapter in Bd. P.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Chapter corresponds to Ch. 2.3.67 in Bd. P. The references are to verses of the chapter in Bd. P.

verses.sanskrit: ये स्नानशीला द्विजदेवभक्ता जितेन्द्रिया जीवदयानुशीलाः । ते देवलोकेषु वसन्ति हृष्टा ये धर्मशीला जितमानरोषाः
verses.transliteration: ye snānaśīlā dvijadevabhaktā jitendriyā jīvadayānuśīlāḥ / te devalokeṣu vasanti hṛṣṭā ye dharmaśīlā jitamānaroṣāḥ
verses.translation: As stated at the end of the last chapter, this chapter describes the race of Ayu who ruled at Kasi. Dhanvantari, the famous physician-king, the founder of the systematic science of Ayurveda was bom in Ayu's lineage. Hence the title specifically refers to him in preference to his forebears.
verses.hindi: विजयस्य जय: पुत्रस्तस्य हय॑द्वतः स्मृतः । हयेह्तस्ततो राजा सहदेवः प्रताषवान् ६ सह॒देवस्य धर्मात्मा अदीन इति विश्वुतः। अदीनस्य जयत्सेनस्तस्य पुत्नोध्य संकृतिः १० संस्कृतेरपि धर्मात्मा कृतधर्मा महायशा:  इत्येते क्षत्रधर्माणो नहुषस्य निबोधत ११
verses.wordMeaning: As stated at the end of the last chapter, this chapter describes the race of Ayu who ruled at Kasi. Dhanvantari, the famous physician-king, the founder of the systematic science of Ayurveda was bom in Ayu's lineage.…
verses.commentary: Sense: As stated at the end of the last chapter, this chapter describes the race of Ayu who ruled at Kasi. Dhanvantari, the famous physician-king, the founder of the systematic science of Ayurveda was bom in Ayu's lineage.…

verses.sanskrit: विद्याविनीता न परोपतापिनः स्वदारतुष्टाः परदारवर्जिताः । तेषां न लोके भयमस्ति किंचित्स्वभावशुद्धा गतकल्मषा हि ते
verses.transliteration: vidyāvinītā na paropatāpinaḥ svadāratuṣṭāḥ paradāravarjitāḥ / teṣāṃ na loke bhayamasti kiṃcitsvabhāvaśuddhā gatakalmaṣā hi te
verses.translation: Ksatravrddha in Bd. P. A line is missing here. Bd. P. supplies the names of the remaining three sons, viz. Rambha, Raji and Anenas (Bd.P. Op. Cit. v. 2).
verses.hindi: मरुत एवं सोम का यज्ञ किया था। उसके उस मरुत्सोम पन्न से परम प्रसन्‍्त होकर मरुतों ने अक्षय अन्न प्रदात किये, जो सभी मनोरथों को पूर्ण करने वाले थे ।२-३॥। एक बार का पकाया गया उसका अन्न दित रात भर में भी नष्ट नहीं होता था। और सुयोदिय से करोड़ों बार दिये जाने पर भी वह नहीं चुकता था । परम बुद्धिमान मरुत्त की कन्या में मित्रज्योति का जन्म हुआ  उससे महान् पराक्रमी मोक्षदर्शी, धर्मज्ञ पुत्रों की उत्पत्ति हुई, जो गृहस्थाश्रम क्ष्मं का परित्याग कर वराग्य पथ के अनुगामी हुए, और अस्त में संन्‍्यासियों का घर्मं अपनाकर ब्रह्मत्व -को प्राप्त हुए ।४-६। तत्पश्चात् अनपाय की उत्पति हुई, जिससे घ्मंप्रदत्तवानू (९) की उत्पत्ति हुई, उससे क्षत्रधर्म की उत्पत्ति हुई  क्षत्र धर्म से महान् तपस्वी प्रतिपक्ष की उत्पत्ति हुई । प्रतिपक्ष के पुत्र संजय नाम से विख्यात हुए। संजय के पुत्र जय हुए और जय से विजय नामक पुत्र की
verses.wordMeaning: Ksatravrddha in Bd. P. A line is missing here. Bd. P. supplies the names of the remaining three sons, viz. Rambha, Raji and Anenas (Bd.P. Op. Cit. v. 2).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksatravrddha in Bd. P. A line is missing here. Bd. P. supplies the names of the remaining three sons, viz. Rambha, Raji and Anenas (Bd.P. Op. Cit. v. 2).

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः । पूर्वजन्मनि विप्रेन्द्र किं त्वया दुष्कृतं कृतम् । येन कष्टमिदं प्राप्तं सन्धानं शूलगर्हितम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ / pūrvajanmani viprendra kiṃ tvayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam / yena kaṣṭamidaṃ prāptaṃ sandhānaṃ śūlagarhitam
verses.translation: How was Dhanvantari, a god, born among human
verses.hindi: उत्पत्ति हुई । विजय का पुत्र भी जय नाम से विर्यात हुआ, जय का पुत्र हयंद्गवत नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुभा । हयंद्त के उपरान्त परम प्रतापशालो राजा सहदेव हुये  सहदेव के पुत्र धर्मात्मा अदीन नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुए । अदीन के पुत्र जयत्सेन के पुत्र हुए, जयत्सेन के पुत्र संकृति हुए । संकृत के पुत्र महान् यहास्व्री एवं धर्मात्मा सजा कृतधर्मा ह ये । ये सब राजा गण क्षत्रिय ग्रुण कम॑ स्वभाववाले थे। अब इसके उपरन्त राजा नहुष के वंश
verses.wordMeaning: How was Dhanvantari, a god, born among human
verses.commentary: Sense: How was Dhanvantari, a god, born among human

verses.sanskrit: शूलस्थं त्वां समालक्ष्य ह्यागताः सर्व एव हि । जीवन्तं त्वां प्रपश्याम त्वन्तरन्नवतारयन् । रुजासंतापजं दुःखं सोढ्वापि त्वमवेदनः
verses.transliteration: śūlasthaṃ tvāṃ samālakṣya hyāgatāḥ sarva eva hi / jīvantaṃ tvāṃ prapaśyāma tvantarannavatārayan / rujāsaṃtāpajaṃ duḥkhaṃ soḍhvāpi tvamavedanaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, may the origin of Dhanvantari be heard.
verses.hindi: का वर्णन सुनिये ।७-११। राजा नहुष के इन्द्र के समान तेजस्वी छः पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए, वे महान् तेजस्वी नहुष पुत्र पितरों की कन्या विरजा में उत्पन्न हुये थे । उनके नाम थे यति, ययाति, संयाति, आयति, पत्च (?) दय (१) । इन सब पुत्रों में पति सबसे बड़े थे, ययाति उनसे छोटे थे  यति ने राजा काकुत्स्थ की कन्या मो को पत्नी काकुत्स्थकन्यां गां नाम लेभे पत्नीं यतिस्तदा । संयातिमक्षिमास्थाय ब्रह्मभुतोइ्भवन्धुनि:ः
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, may the origin of Dhanvantari be heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, may the origin of Dhanvantari be heard.

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्य उवाच: स्वयमेव कृतं कर्म स्वयमेवोपभुज्यते । सुकृतं दुष्कृतं पूर्वे नान्ये भुञ्जन्ति कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavya uvāca: svayameva kṛtaṃ karma svayamevopabhujyate / sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ pūrve nānye bhuñjanti karhicit
verses.translation: He was born prior to everyone. 1 He was enveloped in a halo of glory all round. On seeing him with perfectly shaped limbs, (gods) stood surprised and said, "You are Aja (the unborn) ". Heivie he is remembered as Aja.
verses.hindi: तेषां मध्ये तु पश्चानां ययातिः पृथिवीपतिः । देवयानीसुशनसः सुतां भार्यासवाप ह् १५ शर्भिष्ठामासुरीं चेव तनयां वृषपर्बंण:। अजीजनन्महावीर्यान्सुतान्देवसुतोपमान् १६ दुह्मंं चानुं च पुरं च शर्मिष्ठा वार्षप्वणी । अजीजनन्महावोर्यान्सुतान्देवसुतोपमान्
verses.wordMeaning: He was born prior to everyone. 1 He was enveloped in a halo of glory all round. On seeing him with perfectly shaped limbs, (gods) stood surprised and said, "You are Aja (the unborn) ". Heivie he is remembered as Aja.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was born prior to everyone. 1 He was enveloped in a halo of glory all round. On seeing him with perfectly shaped limbs, (gods) stood surprised and said, "You are Aja (the unborn) ". Heivie he is remembered as Aja.

verses.sanskrit: यथा धेनुसहस्रेषु वत्सो विन्दति मातरम् । तथा पूर्वकृतं कर्म कर्तारम् उपगच्छति
verses.transliteration: yathā dhenusahasreṣu vatso vindati mātaram / tathā pūrvakṛtaṃ karma kartāram upagacchati
verses.translation: Aja spoke to Visnu: "O lord, most excellent of gods, I am your son. Please assign me my share (in
verses.hindi: रथं तस्मे ददो रुद्रः प्रीतः परमभास्वरम् । असड्भं काचचन दिव्यमक्षयों च महेघुधी १८ ययातिर्युधि दुर्ध्षों देवदानवमानवेः । पौरवाणां नृषाणां श्र सर्वेधां सोइभवद्रथः २०
verses.wordMeaning: Aja spoke to Visnu: "O lord, most excellent of gods, I am your son. Please assign me my share (in
verses.commentary: Sense: Aja spoke to Visnu: "O lord, most excellent of gods, I am your son. Please assign me my share (in

verses.sanskrit: न माता न पिता भ्राता न भार्या न सुताः सुहृत् । न कस्य कर्मणां लेपः स्वयमेवोपभुज्यते
verses.transliteration: na mātā na pitā bhrātā na bhāryā na sutāḥ suhṛt / na kasya karmaṇāṃ lepaḥ svayamevopabhujyate
verses.translation: "O lord, if you are satisfied, be pleased to be born as my righteous son." After agreeing to it saying "So be it he vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: गाग्यंस्थ हि सुतं बालः स॒ राजा जनमेजय: । दुर्बद्धिहिंसपामास लोहगन्ध नराधिपम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, if you are satisfied, be pleased to be born as my righteous son." After agreeing to it saying "So be it he vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, if you are satisfied, be pleased to be born as my righteous son." After agreeing to it saying "So be it he vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयतां मम वाक्यं च भवद्भिः पृच्छितो ह्यहम् । पूर्वे वयसि भो विप्रा मलस्नानकृतक्षणः
verses.transliteration: śrūyatāṃ mama vākyaṃ ca bhavadbhiḥ pṛcchito hyaham / pūrve vayasi bho viprā malasnānakṛtakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: God Dhanvantari was born in his house. The great king, king of Ka$I became the destroyer of all ailments.
verses.hindi: रूप में बरण किया था संयाति ने मोक्ष मार्ग का आश्रय लेकर मुन्यों के समान ब्रह्म पद की प्राप्ति की इन पाँचों भाइयों में यथाति प्रथ्वी पति (राजा) हुआ  उसने शुक्राचाये की देवयानी नामक कन्या से विवाह किया । असुरराज वषपर्वा की शभिष्ठा नामक कन्या को भी उसने पत्नी रूप में वरण किया था। देवयानी' ने घदू और त्वंस नामक दो प्रश्न उत्पन्न किये। बषपर्वा की पूत्री शामिष्ठा ने, द्ृह्मू, अनु और पुरु नामक तौम पुत्र उत्पन्न किये। इस प्रकार राजा ययाति ने इन देवताओं के समान सुन्दर एवं पराक्रमशाली,
verses.wordMeaning: God Dhanvantari was born in his house. The great king, king of Ka$I became the destroyer of all ailments.
verses.commentary: Sense: God Dhanvantari was born in his house. The great king, king of Ka$I became the destroyer of all ailments.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानाद्बालभावेन यूका कण्टे ऽधिरोपिता । तैलाभ्यक्तशिरोगात्रे मया यूका घृता न हि
verses.transliteration: ajñānādbālabhāvena yūkā kaṇṭe 'dhiropitā / tailābhyaktaśirogātre mayā yūkā ghṛtā na hi
verses.translation: Sage Bharadvaja created the science of Ayurveda along with its therapeutics. 1 The king divided it into eight parts and taught them to his disciples.
verses.hindi: महाबलवान् पत्रों को उत्पन्न किया ।१५-१६। महादेव जी ने प्रसन्न होकर उस राजा ययाति को परम सुन्दर, चमकनेवाला, सवर्ण निर्मित एक दिव्य रथ प्रदान किया था, इसके अतिरिक्त दो कभी नष्ट न होनेवाले तरकश भी दिये थे। उस सुन्दर “रथ में मन के समान वेगशाली घोड़े जुते हुए थे। उसी रथ षर चढ़कर शुक्र की पुत्री देवगनी को साथ लेकर राजा ययाति ने समस्त प्रृथ्वी को जीता था। वह राजा ययाति युद्षभूमि में
verses.wordMeaning: Sage Bharadvaja created the science of Ayurveda along with its therapeutics. 1 The king divided it into eight parts and taught them to his disciples.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sage Bharadvaja created the science of Ayurveda along with its therapeutics. 1 The king divided it into eight parts and taught them to his disciples.

verses.sanskrit: कङ्कतीं रोप्य केशेषु सासा कण्टे ऽधिरोपिता । तेषु पापं कृतं सद्यः फलमेतन्ममाभवत्
verses.transliteration: kaṅkatīṃ ropya keśeṣu sāsā kaṇṭe 'dhiropitā / teṣu pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ sadyaḥ phalametanmamābhavat
verses.translation: Dhanvantari's son was famous by the name Ketuman. Ketuman's son was the powerful king Bhimaratha. He was famous by the name Divodasa 2 and he was the king of Varanasi.
verses.hindi: वह महान् रथ व्यवहार में लाया जाता था जब क्रुवंश के राजा परीक्षित के पुत्र जनमेजय शासनारूढ़ हुए, उस समय भी वह सन्दर रथ उनके अधीन धा । बुद्धिमान् गाग्यं के शाप से वह रथ नष्ट हुआ ।१७-२१। राजा जनमेजय ने कुबुद्धि में आकर गाग्यं के पुत्र का संहार कर दिया था, जिससे फ्रुंद्ध होकर उन्होंने नरपति जममेजय को लोहगंध, (लोहे के समान दुर्गन्‍्धवाला ) होने का अभिशाप दे दिया था !२२। राजपिं जनमेजय लोहगंध होने पर इधर उधर बहुत दौड़े पर कहीं भी उन्हें शान्ति नहीं मिली, ग्राम-निवासियों ने भी उनका परित्याग कर
verses.wordMeaning: Dhanvantari's son was famous by the name Ketuman. Ketuman's son was the powerful king Bhimaratha. He was famous by the name Divodasa 2 and he was the king of Varanasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhanvantari's son was famous by the name Ketuman. Ketuman's son was the powerful king Bhimaratha. He was famous by the name Divodasa 2 and he was the king of Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: किंचित्कालं क्षपित्वाहं प्राप्स्ये मोक्षं निरामयम् । भवन्तस्त्विह सन्तापं मां कुरुध्वं महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: kiṃcitkālaṃ kṣapitvāhaṃ prāpsye mokṣaṃ nirāmayam / bhavantastviha santāpaṃ māṃ kurudhvaṃ maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: In the meanwhile, the city of Varanasi had become desolate and a Raksasa named Ksemaka occupied it.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रोतो नाम विद्यातो योइसौ सुनिरुदारधीः । याजयामास चेन्द्रोतः शौनको जनमेजयम् ॥। द अश्वमेधेन राजानं पावनार्थ द्विजोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: In the meanwhile, the city of Varanasi had become desolate and a Raksasa named Ksemaka occupied it.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meanwhile, the city of Varanasi had become desolate and a Raksasa named Ksemaka occupied it.

verses.sanskrit: इमाम् अवस्थां भुक्त्वाहं कंचिच्छपे न चोच्चरे । अहनि कतिचिच्छूले क्षपयिष्यामि किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: imām avasthāṃ bhuktvāhaṃ kaṃcicchape na coccare / ahani katicicchūle kṣapayiṣyāmi kilbiṣam
verses.translation: Though our text does not mention it, Bd. 3.67. 23-24 informs us that Dhanvantari learnt Ayurveda (ihz science of medicine) along with its therapeutics from Bharadvaja. Dhanvantari divided it into eight sections and taught them to different disciples.
verses.hindi: प्रददो वासुदेवाय प्रीत्या कौरवनन्दनः ३२७ जरावली च मां तात पलितानि च पर्यगुः। काव्यस्थयोशनसः शापात्न च तृप्तो5स्मि यौवने
verses.wordMeaning: Though our text does not mention it, Bd. 3.67. 23-24 informs us that Dhanvantari learnt Ayurveda (ihz science of medicine) along with its therapeutics from Bharadvaja. Dhanvantari divided it into eight sections and taught them to different disciples.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though our text does not mention it, Bd. 3.67. 23-24 informs us that Dhanvantari learnt Ayurveda (ihz science of medicine) along with its therapeutics from Bharadvaja. Dhanvantari divided it into eight sections and taught them to different disciples.

verses.sanskrit: प्राक्तनं कर्म भुञ्जामि यन्मया संचितं द्विजाः । क्षन्तव्यमस्य राज्ञो ऽथ कोपश्चैव विसर्ज्यताम्
verses.transliteration: prāktanaṃ karma bhuñjāmi yanmayā saṃcitaṃ dvijāḥ / kṣantavyamasya rājño 'tha kopaścaiva visarjyatām
verses.translation: He is regarded as the contemporary of Dasaratha of the Iksvaku dynasty of Ayodhya. It was during his reign that god Siva occupied it by first making it desolate through crafty machination of one of his chief Ganas (aptly called demon) Ksemaka. To get a flourishing capital city vacated for one's honey-moon in the manner described later (w. 36-53) is not creditable to a great god ie. Siva.
verses.hindi: त्वं यदो प्रतिपद्यस्व पाप्मानं जरया सह। जरां मे प्रतियृह्लीष्व त॑ यदृः प्रत्युवाच ह
verses.wordMeaning: He is regarded as the contemporary of Dasaratha of the Iksvaku dynasty of Ayodhya. It was during his reign that god Siva occupied it by first making it desolate through crafty machination of one of his chief Ganas (aptly called demon) Ksemaka.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He is regarded as the contemporary of Dasaratha of the Iksvaku dynasty of Ayodhya. It was during his reign that god Siva occupied it by first making it desolate through crafty machination of one of his chief Ganas (aptly called demon) Ksemaka.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु तस्य तद्वाक्यं माण्डव्यस्य महर्षयः । प्रहर्षमतुलं लब्ध्वा साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu tasya tadvākyaṃ māṇḍavyasya maharṣayaḥ / praharṣamatulaṃ labdhvā sādhu sādhvityapūjayan
verses.translation: Formerly that city had been cursed by the noble-souled Nikumbha, 'The city (of Varanasi) will be desolate for a thousand years'. He had repeated the curse many times.
verses.hindi: दिया था  इस प्रकार अत्यन्त दःखत हो जाने पर भी उनको जब कहीं शान्ति का स्थान नहीं मिल सका तो अनमन्यौपाय एवं परम दुःखी होकर शाप देनेवाले ऋषि की शरण में गये ।२३-२४। पर उदार बुद्धिवाले शुनक गोत्रोत्पन्न इन्द्रोत नामक परम विख्यात मुनि ने राजा जनमेजय को इस घोर पाप से छुड़ाने के लिये यज्ञ कराया। इस प्रकार ट्विजश्रेष्ठ इच्दोत ने अश्वमेघ यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान कराया, तब उन्हीं के निवास में राजा का लोहगग्धत्व दूर हुआ । वहू दिव्य रथ उसके अधिकार से (?) चेदि देशाधिपति राजा वस् के अधीन हुआ  वसुसे इन्द्र ने प्राध्त किया, इन्द्र मे स्तुष्ट होकर राजा बुृह॒ंद्रथ को दिया । ब्रहद्रथ' को मार कर उसे जरासंघ ने छीना, इसके उपरान्त जरासंब से उस दिव्य रथ को भीम ने प्राप्त किया। कौरवनन्दन भीम ने प्रसन्नता पूर्वक उस रथ को वासुदेव को समर्पित किया
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly that city had been cursed by the noble-souled Nikumbha, 'The city (of Varanasi) will be desolate for a thousand years'. He had repeated the curse many times.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly that city had been cursed by the noble-souled Nikumbha, 'The city (of Varanasi) will be desolate for a thousand years'. He had repeated the curse many times.

verses.sanskrit: नारायण उवाच: इदं जलं मन्त्रपूतं कस्मिन्स्थाने क्षिपाम्यहम् । येन राजा भवेद्भस्म सराष्ट्रः सपुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇa uvāca: idaṃ jalaṃ mantrapūtaṃ kasminsthāne kṣipāmyaham / yena rājā bhavedbhasma sarāṣṭraḥ sapurohitaḥ
verses.translation: As soon as the city was cursed, Divodasa the king, founded a beautiful city on the banks of Gomatl, near the extremities of his realm.
verses.hindi: नहुषपुत्र राजषि ययाति जब बहुत वृद्ध हो गये तब अपने सब से बड़े और योग्य पुत्र यदु से यह बात बोले, पुत्र ! यदु  शुक्राचार्य के शाप के कारण वृ॒द्धता, चमड़े कौ सिकुड़न और पलितादि ने मुझे चारों ओर से घेर लिया, किन्तु मैं अभी तक यौवनावस्था से सस्तुष्ट नहीं हों सका। हुम मेरी इस वद्धता और पाप कौ ग्रहण कर लो।” ययाति की ऐसी बातें सुनकर यदु ने उत्तर दिया तात ! मैंने अनन्तकाल तक
verses.wordMeaning: As soon as the city was cursed, Divodasa the king, founded a beautiful city on the banks of Gomatl, near the extremities of his realm.
verses.commentary: Sense: As soon as the city was cursed, Divodasa the king, founded a beautiful city on the banks of Gomatl, near the extremities of his realm.

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्य उवाच: इदं जलं च रक्षस्व कालकूटविषोपमम् । समुद्रे क्षिपयिष्यामि देवकार्यं समुत्थितम्
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavya uvāca: idaṃ jalaṃ ca rakṣasva kālakūṭaviṣopamam / samudre kṣipayiṣyāmi devakāryaṃ samutthitam
verses.translation: Why did Nikumbha curse Varanasi in the days of yore? Nikumbha was a righteous soul. Why did he curse the holy centre of Siddhas?
verses.hindi: १. यहाँ पर ग्रन्थ का मूल पाठ अ्रष्ट मालूम पड़ता है। पूर्व कथा से पर कथा की कोई संग्रति नहीं मिलती । जनभेजय भीम के बाद हुये थे । फिर जनमेजय के बाद भीम को रथ की प्राप्ति किस प्रकार सम्भव जराया बहवो दोषा यानभोजनकारिणः। तस्माज्जरां न ते राजन्प्रहीतुमहमुत्सहे ३२
verses.wordMeaning: Why did Nikumbha curse Varanasi in the days of yore? Nikumbha was a righteous soul. Why did he curse the holy centre of Siddhas?
verses.commentary: Sense: Why did Nikumbha curse Varanasi in the days of yore? Nikumbha was a righteous soul. Why did he curse the holy centre of Siddhas?

verses.sanskrit: अथ ते मुनयः सर्वे माण्डव्यं प्रणिपत्य च । आमन्त्रयित्वा हर्षाच्च कश्यपाद्या गृहान्ययुः
verses.transliteration: atha te munayaḥ sarve māṇḍavyaṃ praṇipatya ca / āmantrayitvā harṣācca kaśyapādyā gṛhānyayuḥ
verses.translation: After gaining the city, King Divodasa, the saintly king of great splendour lived in that flourishing city.
verses.hindi: अशक्तः कार्यकरणे परिभृतस्तु यौवने । महोषभीतिभिश्चव तां जरां नाभिकासये ३४ सन्ति ते बहुबः पुत्रा मत्तः प्रियतरा नृप । प्रतिगृहन्तु धर्मज्ञ पुत्रमन्‍्यं वृणीष्व वे (३५ स एवमुक्तो यदुना तीवरकोपसमन्वितः । उबाच बदतां श्रेष्ठो ज्येष्ठ त॑ गहू यन्सुतम् ३६ आश्रम: कश्न्व वाउन्यो5स्ति को वा धर्मविधिस्तव  मामनादृत्य दुर्बुद्धे यदात्थ नवदेशिक
verses.wordMeaning: After gaining the city, King Divodasa, the saintly king of great splendour lived in that flourishing city.
verses.commentary: Sense: After gaining the city, King Divodasa, the saintly king of great splendour lived in that flourishing city.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छमानास्तु ते चोक्ताः पञ्चमे ऽहनि तापसाः । आगन्तव्यं भवद्भिश्च मत्सकाशं प्रतिज्ञया
verses.transliteration: gacchamānāstu te coktāḥ pañcame 'hani tāpasāḥ / āgantavyaṃ bhavadbhiśca matsakāśaṃ pratijñayā
verses.translation: In the meantime, Mahesvara who had married (Uma) stayed near the Devas* and desired to do what was pleasing to the goddess.
verses.hindi: एवमुकत्वा यदुं राजा शशापेनं स मन्युमान् । यस्त्वं मे हृदयाज्जातो बयः स्वं न प्रयच्छसि तस्मान्न राजभाग्मृढ प्रजा ते वे भविष्यति । तुंसो प्रतिपद्यस्व पाप्मानं जरया सह ॥३ ६
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, Mahesvara who had married (Uma) stayed near the Devas* and desired to do what was pleasing to the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, Mahesvara who had married (Uma) stayed near the Devas* and desired to do what was pleasing to the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति ते प्रतिज्ञाय नारदाद्या अदर्शनम् । गतेषु विप्रमुख्येषु शाण्डिली च तपोधना
verses.transliteration: tatheti te pratijñāya nāradādyā adarśanam / gateṣu vipramukhyeṣu śāṇḍilī ca tapodhanā
verses.translation: His attendants and the saints assuming various forms continued to delight the great godddess by means of their diverse forms mentioned before.
verses.hindi: वद्धता ग्रहण करने में मै अधक्त हें ।२८-३१। राजन् ! इस वृद्धता में भोजन पान आदि के बहुत बड़े दोष हो जाते हैं, अर्थात् बुढ़ापे में ठीक से अन्न नहीं पचता, पानी आदि भी बहुत सवाच कर (जाँच कर) पीना पड़ता है, खान-पान फे थोड़े-से ही असंयम से बड़ा कष्ठ मिलता है। इसलिए भी आपको इस बृंद्धता को अंग्रीकार करने का उत्साह मुझमें नहीं हो रहा है । दवेत बाल धारण करनैवालों फो यह वद्धता एकदम शिथिल कर
verses.wordMeaning: His attendants and the saints assuming various forms continued to delight the great godddess by means of their diverse forms mentioned before.
verses.commentary: Sense: His attendants and the saints assuming various forms continued to delight the great godddess by means of their diverse forms mentioned before.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीये ऽह्नि समायाता न तु बुद्ध्वाथ तं ऋषिम् । भर्तारं शिरसा धार्य रात्रौ पर्यटते स्म सा
verses.transliteration: dvitīye 'hni samāyātā na tu buddhvātha taṃ ṛṣim / bhartāraṃ śirasā dhārya rātrau paryaṭate sma sā
verses.translation: (She said to Uma) "Your husband Mahesvara is carrying on ill-mannered activities in (my) presence. O sinless girl, he is by all means very indigent. Without wearying him¬ self out, he sports and dallies".
verses.hindi: देती है । शरीर में सिकुड़न आ जाती है, देखने में चेहरा भद्दा हो जाता है, प्रकृति दुबंल हो जाती है, कोई कायं करमे की भी शक्ति महीं रह जाती, यौवन के सुखों से वंचित एवं पराभूत होना पड़ता हैं। इस प्रकार की अनैक महान् विपत्तियों से घिरी हुई उस वृद्धता को मै अंगीकार नहीं करूँगा ।३२-३४ नृपति ! आपके अन्य पुत्र भी हैं, जों मुझसे भी अधिकु प्रिय हैं, है धर्म ! आप उन्हीं से इसका प्रस्ताव कीजिये, अन्य पुत्रों से ही इसको याचना करना उचित है ।” यदू के ऐसा कहने पर बोलने वालों में प्रवीण राजा ययाति परम ऋ्रंद्ध होकर अपने बड़े पुत्र यदु की भत्संना करते हुए बोले । दुर्बुद्ध ! तुम्हारा कौन-सा आश्रम है ? गृहस्थाश्रम के अतिरिक्त क्‍या तुम्हारा कोई अन्य आश्रम धर्म है ? तुम्हारे धर्म की विधि कौन-सी है ? नये ढंग से उपदेश
verses.wordMeaning: (She said to Uma) "Your husband Mahesvara is carrying on ill-mannered activities in (my) presence. O sinless girl, he is by all means very indigent. Without wearying him¬ self out, he sports and dallies".
verses.commentary: Sense: (She said to Uma) "Your husband Mahesvara is carrying on ill-mannered activities in (my) presence. O sinless girl, he is by all means very indigent. Without wearying him¬ self out, he sports and dallies".

verses.sanskrit: न दृष्टः शूलके विप्रो भराक्रान्त्या युधिष्ठिर । स्खलिता तस्य जानुभ्यां शूलस्थस्य पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: na dṛṣṭaḥ śūlake vipro bharākrāntyā yudhiṣṭhira / skhalitā tasya jānubhyāṃ śūlasthasya pativratā
verses.translation: On being thus taunted by her mother, she did not brook it as was but natural to women. After smiling (at the words of her mother) the goddess, the granter of boons, went
verses.hindi: करनेवाले ! कुमति ! भेरा निरादर करके जिस घ॒र्म का तुम पालन कर रहे हो, वह कौन-सा धर्म आश्रम या विधि है ।१४-१७ इस प्रकार की क्रोध पूर्ण बातें कर परम क्रोध में भरे हुए राजा ययाति ने यदु को छाप दे दिया + 'जो तुम मेरे हृदय से उत्पन्न होकर भी मुझे अपनी यौवन अवस्था नहीं दे रहे हो, सो है मृढ़, तुम्हारी प्रजा और तुम कोई भी हमारे राज्य के उत्तराधिकारी न होगे ।” इस प्रकार शाप देकर राजा ययाति ने तुर्वेसु
verses.wordMeaning: On being thus taunted by her mother, she did not brook it as was but natural to women. After smiling (at the words of her mother) the goddess, the granter of boons, went
verses.commentary: Sense: On being thus taunted by her mother, she did not brook it as was but natural to women. After smiling (at the words of her mother) the goddess, the granter of boons, went

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाङ्गेषु व्यथा जाता तस्याः प्रस्खलनान् मुनेः । ईदृशीं वर्तमानां च ह्यवस्थां पूर्वदैविकीम्
verses.transliteration: sarvāṅgeṣu vyathā jātā tasyāḥ praskhalanān muneḥ / īdṛśīṃ vartamānāṃ ca hyavasthāṃ pūrvadaivikīm
verses.translation: With a dejected face the goddess spoke to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: नामक अपने पुत्र से कहा, तुर्वसु ! मेरी वृद्धावस्था और मेरे पाप को तुम अंगीकार कर लो, पुत्र ! तुम्हारी यौवनावस्था से मैं विविध प्रकार के भोगों का उपभोग करना चाहता हूँ । एक सहख्र वर्ष बीतने पर तुम्हारी परेण गायुपुराणन्
verses.wordMeaning: With a dejected face the goddess spoke to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: With a dejected face the goddess spoke to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पापफलं किंचिद्धा कष्टं मम वर्तते । व्यथितो ऽहं त्वया पापे किमर्थं सूनकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: punaḥ pāpaphalaṃ kiṃciddhā kaṣṭaṃ mama vartate / vyathito 'haṃ tvayā pāpe kimarthaṃ sūnakarmaṇi
verses.translation: Thus requested, the great god, Mahesvara of great splendour, surveyed all the worlds. O excellent Bra a$as,
verses.hindi: स्व चेव प्रतिपत्स्यासि पाप्मानं जरया सह ४०
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested, the great god, Mahesvara of great splendour, surveyed all the worlds. O excellent Bra a$as,
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested, the great god, Mahesvara of great splendour, surveyed all the worlds. O excellent Bra a$as,

verses.sanskrit: स्वैरिणीं त्वां प्रपश्यामि राक्षसी तस्करी नु किम् । एवमुक्त्वा क्षणं मोहात्क्रन्दमानो मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: svairiṇīṃ tvāṃ prapaśyāmi rākṣasī taskarī nu kim / evamuktvā kṣaṇaṃ mohātkrandamāno muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: Nikumbha then went to the city of Varanasi and revealed himself to a barber named Mankana in his dream and said, "O sinless one, I shall bring welfare unto you. Assign a place for me. Make an image of my form and place it at the outskirt of the city."
verses.hindi: न कामये जरां तात कामभोगप्रणाशिनीम् । जराया बहुवो दोषाः पानभोजनकारिणः। यसत्व॑ में हृदयाज्जातो वयः स्वं न प्रयच्छसि । तस्मात्प्रजा समुच्छेदं तुबंसो तब यास्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Nikumbha then went to the city of Varanasi and revealed himself to a barber named Mankana in his dream and said, "O sinless one, I shall bring welfare unto you. Assign a place for me. Make an image of my form and place it at the outskirt of the city."
verses.commentary: Sense: Nikumbha then went to the city of Varanasi and revealed himself to a barber named Mankana in his dream and said, "O sinless one, I shall bring welfare unto you. Assign a place for me. Make an image of my form and place it at the outskirt of the city."

verses.sanskrit: तपस्विनो ऽथ ऋषयः सर्वे संत्रस्तमानसाः । पश्यमाना मुनेः कष्टं पृच्छन्ते ते युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: tapasvino 'tha ṛṣayaḥ sarve saṃtrastamānasāḥ / paśyamānā muneḥ kaṣṭaṃ pṛcchante te yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the barber did everything m accordance with what he was told in dream. After getting the permission of the king, he did everything duly at the gate of the city.
verses.hindi: असंकोर्णा च धर्मेण प्रतिलोमवरेषु च। पिशिताशिषु चान्येषु मुठ राजा भविष्यसि ॥॥४ ३ गुरुद्रप्रसकतेषु तियंग्योनिगतेषु वा। पशुधर्मेषु स्लेच्छेषु भविष्यसि न संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the barber did everything m accordance with what he was told in dream. After getting the permission of the king, he did everything duly at the gate of the city.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the barber did everything m accordance with what he was told in dream. After getting the permission of the king, he did everything duly at the gate of the city.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यटसे किमर्थं त्वं निशीये वहनं नु किम् । क्षिप्तं तु झोलिकाभारं किंवागमनकारणम् । व्यथामुत्पाद्य ऋषये दुःखाद्दुःखविलासिनि
verses.transliteration: paryaṭase kimarthaṃ tvaṃ niśīye vahanaṃ nu kim / kṣiptaṃ tu jholikābhāraṃ kiṃvāgamanakāraṇam / vyathāmutpādya ṛṣaye duḥkhādduḥkhavilāsini
verses.translation: He used to grant thousands of boons to the people of the city, such as sons, gold, longevity and similar desires.
verses.hindi: यौवनावस्था तुम्हें वापस कर दूँगा, और निश्चय ही उस समय मैं अपने पाप और वृद्धावस्था को ले लूँगा तुतखु ने कहाः--तात ! ऐच्छिकभोगों को नष्ट कुरनेवाली, विषयादि सुखों से वंचित करनेवाली तुम्हारी बृढ्धता को मैं पसन्द नहीं करु सकता । राजेन्द्र  इस वृद्धता से तो भोजन पानादि में भी बड़ी भड़चर्ने पड॒ती हैं। इसलिए उस वद्धता के ग्रहण करने का उत्साह मुझमें नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: He used to grant thousands of boons to the people of the city, such as sons, gold, longevity and similar desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: He used to grant thousands of boons to the people of the city, such as sons, gold, longevity and similar desires.

verses.sanskrit: शाण्डिल्युवाच: नासुरीं न च गन्धर्वीं न पिशाचीं न राक्षसीम् । पतिव्रतां तु मां सर्वे जानन्तु तपसि स्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: śāṇḍilyuvāca: nāsurīṃ na ca gandharvīṃ na piśācīṃ na rākṣasīm / pativratāṃ tu māṃ sarve jānantu tapasi sthitām
verses.translation: The senior queen-consort of the king was well-known by the name Suyasa. That chaste lady was urged by the king and she came (to that deity) with a desire to have a son.
verses.hindi: ययाति बोलेः--तुवंसो ! मेरे हृदय से उत्पन्न होकर भी तुम मेरे लिए अपनी अवस्था नहीं दे रहे हो, अतः तुम्हारी सन्‍्ततियाँ नाश को प्राप्त होंगी  प्रतिलोम रीति से वे संकरवर्ण की हो जाय॑ंगी। धर्म से च्युत मांसाहारी एवं अन्य दुराचारों में निरत रहनेवाली प्रजाओं के तुम राजा होगे। गुर की स्त्री के साथ गमन करनेवाले, नीच योनियों में जन्म धारण करनेवाले पशु के समान अविवेकशील, म्लेच्छों के देश के तुम राजा
verses.wordMeaning: The senior queen-consort of the king was well-known by the name Suyasa. That chaste lady was urged by the king and she came (to that deity) with a desire to have a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The senior queen-consort of the king was well-known by the name Suyasa. That chaste lady was urged by the king and she came (to that deity) with a desire to have a son.

verses.sanskrit: न मे कामो न मे क्रोधो न वैरं न च मत्सरः । अज्ञानाद् दृष्टिमान्द्याच्च स्खलनं क्षन्तुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration: na me kāmo na me krodho na vairaṃ na ca matsaraḥ / ajñānād dṛṣṭimāndyācca skhalanaṃ kṣantumarhatha
verses.translation: She performed (his) worship on a grand scale and requested him for sons. She frequented (the shrine) again and again for (the boon of getting) a son.
verses.hindi: होगे--इसमें सन्देह नहीं है सूत बोलेः--ऋषिबुन्द  राजा ययाति ने इस प्रकार अपने पुत्र तुबंसु को शाप देने के उपरान्त शमिष्ठा
verses.wordMeaning: She performed (his) worship on a grand scale and requested him for sons. She frequented (the shrine) again and again for (the boon of getting) a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: She performed (his) worship on a grand scale and requested him for sons. She frequented (the shrine) again and again for (the boon of getting) a son.

verses.sanskrit: वहनं भर्तृसौख्याय दिवा सम्पीड्यते रुजा । अयं भर्ता विजानीथ झोलिकासंस्थितः सदा
verses.transliteration: vahanaṃ bhartṛsaukhyāya divā sampīḍyate rujā / ayaṃ bhartā vijānītha jholikāsaṃsthitaḥ sadā
verses.translation: There was a reason behind Nikumbha's not granting sons. If the king were to be infuriated something could be done.
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिह्नान्तगंतग्रग्थ: क. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: There was a reason behind Nikumbha's not granting sons. If the king were to be infuriated something could be done.
verses.commentary: Sense: There was a reason behind Nikumbha's not granting sons. If the king were to be infuriated something could be done.

verses.sanskrit: भरणं पानं वस्त्रं च ददाम्येतस्य रोगिणः । ऋषिः शौनकमुख्यो ऽसौ शाण्डिलीं मां विजानत
verses.transliteration: bharaṇaṃ pānaṃ vastraṃ ca dadāmyetasya rogiṇaḥ / ṛṣiḥ śaunakamukhyo 'sau śāṇḍilīṃ māṃ vijānata
verses.translation: After the lapse of a long period, the king became furious. (He thought) 'This spirit at the main gate delightedly bestows hundreds of boons on the town-people but does not do anything (for me). In my city he is worshipped by my people. He has been worshipped by my queen there for that specific reason. Though he eats much, he does not grant me a son. He is ungrateful. Hence he does not deserve further
verses.hindi: त्रिनवतितमोअध्यायः ८रेहै द्ुह्म त्वं प्रतिपद्चस्व वर्णरूपविनाशिनीम् । जरां वर्षसहस्त्र वे यौवन स्वं ददस्व से
