verses.hindi: इन सबों ने अवस्ति देशा में राज्य किया था । जयध्वज का पुत्र प्रतापशालों तालजंघ था, उसके सौ पुत्र हुए, जो तालजंघ गण के नाम से :विख्यात हुए । महान् पराक्रमशाली उन हैहयवंश में उत्पन्न होनेवालों के पाँच ग़ण विख्यात हैं, उनके नाम हैं, वीर होत्रगण, जिनकी गणना नहीं की जा सकती, भोजगण, आवर्तिगण, तुण्डिकिरगण, जो परम बलशाली थे, तथा तालजंघ  बीरहोतन्र का पुत्र राजा अनन्त हुआ, उसका पुत्र दुर्जय हुआ, दुर्जय से अमिन्रदरशंत का जन्म हुआ ।४७-४३। जेसा कि पहले भी कह चुके हैं उस महाराज कार्तवीये अजु न के राज्य में लोगों का द्रव्य नष्ट नहीं होता था, वह अपने व्यक्तित्व के प्रभाव से समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: O Puru, I am pleased with you. Welfare unto you. Delightedly I grant this unto you. All the subjects in your kingdom shall flourish and enjoy all pleasures (or your progeny will realise their desires, be affluent and rule over a kingdom).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Puru, I am pleased with you. Welfare unto you. Delightedly I grant this unto you. All the subjects in your kingdom shall flourish and enjoy all pleasures (or your progeny will realise their desires, be affluent and rule over a kingdom).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे ऽश्विने मासि चतुर्दश्यां विशेषतः । वायुमार्गे स्थितः शक्रस्तिष्ठते दैवतैः सह
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe 'śvine māsi caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / vāyumārge sthitaḥ śakrastiṣṭhate daivataiḥ saha
verses.translation: By means of the youthful age, Yayati, the son of Nahusa, became highly delighted and enjoyed all worldly plea-
verses.hindi: न तस्य वित्तनाशश्व नष्ट प्रतिलभेत सः । कार्तवीयेस्थ यो जन्म कथयेदिह धोमतः ३५५ वित्तवान्मवतेउत्रेव धर्मभ्वास्य विवर्धते । यथा त्वष्ठा यथा दाता तथा स्वगें महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: By means of the youthful age, Yayati, the son of Nahusa, became highly delighted and enjoyed all worldly plea-
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of the youthful age, Yayati, the son of Nahusa, became highly delighted and enjoyed all worldly plea-

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि सरितः सागरास्तथा । विंशति तानि सर्वाणि देवखाते दिनद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaḥ sāgarāstathā / viṃśati tāni sarvāṇi devakhāte dinadvayam
verses.translation: In the parks with (the celestial dam
verses.hindi: इति महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते कातंवीर्यार्जुनोत्पत्तिविवरणं नाम चतुर्न॑वतितमोः्ध्याय: ॥र्ै४॥ किमथें भुवनं दग्धमापवस्य सहात्मनः । कार्तंवीयेण विक्रम्य तन्नः प्रत्नहि पृच्छताम् ३१
verses.wordMeaning: In the parks with (the celestial dam
verses.commentary: Sense: In the parks with (the celestial dam

verses.sanskrit: गयाशिरे च यत्पुण्यं प्रयागे मकरकण्टके । प्रयागे सोमतीर्थे च तत्पुण्यं माण्डवेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: gayāśire ca yatpuṇyaṃ prayāge makarakaṇṭake / prayāge somatīrthe ca tatpuṇyaṃ māṇḍaveśvare
verses.translation: Counting (even the small units of time such as) Kolas and Kdffhds, he considered that the time limit was complete and so he spoke to his son Puru:
verses.hindi: प्रजाओं का पालस करता था  उस परम बुद्धिमान् महाराज कातंवीर्याजु न का जन्म वृत्तास्त इस लोक में जो कहता है, उसकी सम्पत्ति नष्ट नहीं होती, यदि नष्ट हो गई हो तो पुनः प्राप्त होती है, इस लोक में वह परम धनद्ाली होता है, धर्म की वद्धि होती है, जिस प्रकार शुभ कम परायण एवं दानशील लोग स्व में पूजित होते हैं, उसी प्रकार वह भी स्वर्ग में पृजित होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Counting (even the small units of time such as) Kolas and Kdffhds, he considered that the time limit was complete and so he spoke to his son Puru:
verses.commentary: Sense: Counting (even the small units of time such as) Kolas and Kdffhds, he considered that the time limit was complete and so he spoke to his son Puru:

verses.sanskrit: पट्टबन्धेन यत्पुण्यं मात्रायां लकुलेश्वरे । आश्विन्यामश्विनीयोगे तत्पुण्यं माण्डवेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: paṭṭabandhena yatpuṇyaṃ mātrāyāṃ lakuleśvare / āśvinyāmaśvinīyoge tatpuṇyaṃ māṇḍaveśvare
verses.translation: "O son, O suppressor of enemies, with your youthful age, all worldly pleasures have been enjoyed by me in accor¬ dance with my zeal befitting the time and in a way conducive to happiness.
verses.hindi: ज्यामघ का चृत्तान्त विवरण ऋषि च॒न्द् बोले--सूत णी ! कातंवीयें ने अपना पराक्रम दिखाते हुए भहात्मा आपव के आश्रम को क्यों जला दिया ? ऐसा सुना जाता है कि वह राजधि कातंवीर्धा्जन अपनी प्रजाओं का पालक था, सो रक्षक होकर उसने तपोबन को भला क्यों जलाग्रा, इसे हम लोग आपसे पृ रहे हैं, कृपया
verses.wordMeaning: "O son, O suppressor of enemies, with your youthful age, all worldly pleasures have been enjoyed by me in accor¬ dance with my zeal befitting the time and in a way conducive to happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O son, O suppressor of enemies, with your youthful age, all worldly pleasures have been enjoyed by me in accor¬ dance with my zeal befitting the time and in a way conducive to happiness.

verses.sanskrit: उज्जयिन्यां महाकाले वाराणस्यां त्रिपुष्करे । संनिहत्यां रविग्रस्ते माण्डव्याख्ये सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: ujjayinyāṃ mahākāle vārāṇasyāṃ tripuṣkare / saṃnihatyāṃ ravigraste māṇḍavyākhye sanātanam
verses.translation: O Puru, I am delighted. Welfare uptu you, you take back your own youthful age. Accept the realm too. You alone have been my beloved son who carried out what is pleasing to
verses.hindi: आदित्यो विप्ररूपेण कार्तंवीयमुपस्थित: । तृप्तिकामः प्रयच्छान्नमादित्यो5हूं न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: O Puru, I am delighted. Welfare uptu you, you take back your own youthful age. Accept the realm too. You alone have been my beloved son who carried out what is pleasing to
verses.commentary: Sense: O Puru, I am delighted. Welfare uptu you, you take back your own youthful age. Accept the realm too. You alone have been my beloved son who carried out what is pleasing to

verses.sanskrit: इति ज्ञात्वा महाराज सर्वतीर्थेषु चोत्तमम् । पित्ःन्देवान् समभ्यर्च्य स्नानदानादिपूजनैः
verses.transliteration: iti jñātvā mahārāja sarvatīrtheṣu cottamam / pitḥndevān samabhyarcya snānadānādipūjanaiḥ
verses.translation: King Yayati, the son of Nahusa, took back his old age and Puru regained his own youthful age.
verses.hindi: भगवन्केन ते तुष्टिभवेदश्ूहि दिवाकर । कोदु् भोजन दक्षि श्रुत्वा च विदधाम्यहम् ४ न शकयं स्थावरं सर्व तेजसा मानुषेण तु। निर्दंग्धु तपतां श्रेष्ठ त्वासेव प्रणसास्यहम् ६
verses.wordMeaning: King Yayati, the son of Nahusa, took back his old age and Puru regained his own youthful age.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Yayati, the son of Nahusa, took back his old age and Puru regained his own youthful age.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दश्यां निराहारः स्थितो भूत्वा शुचिव्रतः । पूजयेत् परया भक्त्या रात्रौ जागरणे शिवम्
verses.transliteration: caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthito bhūtvā śucivrataḥ / pūjayet parayā bhaktyā rātrau jāgaraṇe śivam
verses.translation: When the king evinced his desire to crown his youngest son Puru, people of all castes with Brahmanas as the chief of them, spoke these words. 1 2
verses.hindi: आदिष्टं तेजसा मेघसागरं शोषयिष्यति । शुष्क॑ भस्स करिष्यामि तेस प्रीतो नराधिप 'द
verses.wordMeaning: When the king evinced his desire to crown his youngest son Puru, people of all castes with Brahmanas as the chief of them, spoke these words. 1 2
verses.commentary: Sense: When the king evinced his desire to crown his youngest son Puru, people of all castes with Brahmanas as the chief of them, spoke these words. 1 2

verses.sanskrit: स्नानैश्च विविधैर्देवं पुष्पागरुविलेपनैः । प्रभाते पौर्णमास्यां तु स्नानादिविधितर्पणैः
verses.transliteration: snānaiśca vividhairdevaṃ puṣpāgaruvilepanaiḥ / prabhāte paurṇamāsyāṃ tu snānādividhitarpaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: "O lord, why do you set aside (the claim of) your eldest son, the excellent Yadu, the grandson of Sukra, the son of De.vayani, and bestow the kingdom on Puru?
verses.hindi: खूत बोले--ऋषिबन्द ! आदित्य ब्राह्मणवेश धारण कर महाराज कार्तवीयं के पास आये और बोले राजन् ! मैं भूखा हूं, समतोष प्राप्ति के लिए आपके पास आया हैं, मुझे अन्नादि दीजिये, मैं आदित्य हूँ इसमें सल्देह न करिये ।३ राजा बोले--भगवन् दिवाकर ) आपको किस से सस्तोष-प्राप्ति होगी, मैं किस प्रकार का भोजन आपको दूँ ? आपका उत्तर सुनकर ही मैं कुछ प्रबन्ध कर सकूंगा
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, why do you set aside (the claim of) your eldest son, the excellent Yadu, the grandson of Sukra, the son of De.vayani, and bestow the kingdom on Puru?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, why do you set aside (the claim of) your eldest son, the excellent Yadu, the grandson of Sukra, the son of De.vayani, and bestow the kingdom on Puru?

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धेन हव्यकव्येन शिवपूजार्चनेन च । अग्निष्टोमादियज्ञैश्च विधिवच्चाप्तदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhena havyakavyena śivapūjārcanena ca / agniṣṭomādiyajñaiśca vidhivaccāptadakṣiṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Yadu is your eldest son. Turvasu was born next to him. Sarmistha's eldest son is Druhyu, then comes Anu and then only Puru.
verses.hindi: सूर्य धोले--दानिशिरोमणि राजन् ! मुझे समस्त स्थावर जगत प्रदान कीजिये, मैं उसी का भोजन कर सन्‍्तोष प्राप्त करूँगा, अध्य भोजन द्वारा मेरी तृप्ति नहीं होगी ।५॥ क्‍
verses.wordMeaning: Yadu is your eldest son. Turvasu was born next to him. Sarmistha's eldest son is Druhyu, then comes Anu and then only Puru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yadu is your eldest son. Turvasu was born next to him. Sarmistha's eldest son is Druhyu, then comes Anu and then only Puru.

verses.sanskrit: धौतपापो विशुद्धात्मा फलते फलमुत्तमम् । गोसहस्रप्रदानेन दत्तं भवति भारत
verses.transliteration: dhautapāpo viśuddhātmā phalate phalamuttamam / gosahasrapradānena dattaṃ bhavati bhārata
verses.translation: How can the younger son deserve the kingdom super¬ seding (the claims of) the elder ones? Hence we urge you to abide by the (traditional) Dharma. 5>
verses.hindi: राजा बोले--हे तेजस्वियों में श्रेष्ठ ! मैं मानवतेज द्वारा समस्त स्थावर जगत को जलाने में स्वेधा . अममथ् हूं, अतः आपही को प्रमाण करता हूँ आदित्य बोले-- राजन् ! मैं तुम्हारे ऊपर सन्तुष्ट हूं, मैं तुम्हें ऐसे बाण दे रहा हूँ, जिनका कभी नाश नही होगा जो तुम्हें सब प्रकार के सुख देनेवाले होंगे। मेरे तेज से समब्वित होकर ये बाण, फंके जाने पर प्रज्वलित हो उठेंगे। है नराधिप ! मेरे तेज से सम्व लित होने पर वे आदेश दे देने पर मेघ और समुद्र को भी
verses.wordMeaning: How can the younger son deserve the kingdom super¬ seding (the claims of) the elder ones? Hence we urge you to abide by the (traditional) Dharma. 5>
verses.commentary: Sense: How can the younger son deserve the kingdom super¬ seding (the claims of) the elder ones? Hence we urge you to abide by the (traditional) Dharma. 5>

verses.sanskrit: स्नानाद्यैर् विधिवत् तत्र तद्दिने शिवसन्निधौ । हिरण्यं वृषभं धेनुं भूमिं गोमिथुनं हयम्
verses.transliteration: snānādyair vidhivat tatra taddine śivasannidhau / hiraṇyaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dhenuṃ bhūmiṃ gomithunaṃ hayam
verses.translation: Bd. P.v. 69 reads: alad-dofa-nidarfanal 'because he failed to notice the defects (of passionate indulgence)'. This is a better reading as it states why he went with Visvaci.
verses.hindi: एतस्मिश्नेव काले तु आपवो नियमस्थितः । दशवर्षसह्लाणि जलवासा महानषिः
verses.wordMeaning: Bd. P.v. 69 reads: alad-dofa-nidarfanal 'because he failed to notice the defects (of passionate indulgence)'. This is a better reading as it states why he went with Visvaci.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bd. P.v. 69 reads: alad-dofa-nidarfanal 'because he failed to notice the defects (of passionate indulgence)'. This is a better reading as it states why he went with Visvaci.

verses.sanskrit: शिवमुद्दिश्य वै वस्त्रयुग्मे दद्यात् सुरूपिणे । पादुकोपानहौ छत्रं भाजनं रक्तवाससी
verses.transliteration: śivamuddiśya vai vastrayugme dadyāt surūpiṇe / pādukopānahau chatraṃ bhājanaṃ raktavāsasī
verses.translation: Verses 75-86 show that subjects did notallow injustice even if commit¬ ted by the king. Some sort of public sanction seems to be necessary for appointing a new king.
verses.hindi: क्रोधाच्छुशाप राजषिं कीतितं वो यथा मया ३१३ क्ोष्टोरेकोीइभवत्पुत्रो वुजिनोवान्महायशा: । वाजिनीवतमिच्छन्ति स्वाहि स्वाहबतां वरमू
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 75-86 show that subjects did notallow injustice even if commit¬ ted by the king. Some sort of public sanction seems to be necessary for appointing a new king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 75-86 show that subjects did notallow injustice even if commit¬ ted by the king. Some sort of public sanction seems to be necessary for appointing a new king.

verses.sanskrit: होमं जाप्यं तथा दानमक्षयं सर्वमेव तत् । ऋचमेकां तु ऋग्वेदे यजुर्वेदे यजुस्तथा
verses.transliteration: homaṃ jāpyaṃ tathā dānamakṣayaṃ sarvameva tat / ṛcamekāṃ tu ṛgvede yajurvede yajustathā
verses.translation: O people of all castes with Brahmanas as leaders! Let all of you listen to my speech why I do not intend to give the kingdom to the elder ones.
verses.hindi: स्वाहेः पुत्रोउभवद्राजा रशादुर्ददतां बरः । सुतं प्रसुतमिच्छन्ति रशादोरप्रयमात्मजम्
verses.wordMeaning: O people of all castes with Brahmanas as leaders! Let all of you listen to my speech why I do not intend to give the kingdom to the elder ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: O people of all castes with Brahmanas as leaders! Let all of you listen to my speech why I do not intend to give the kingdom to the elder ones.

verses.sanskrit: सामैकं सामवेदे तु जपेद् देवाग्रसंस्थितः । सम्यग्वेदफलं तस्य भवेद्वै नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: sāmaikaṃ sāmavede tu japed devāgrasaṃsthitaḥ / samyagvedaphalaṃ tasya bhavedvai nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Only that son who carries out the words (orders) of his father and mother is considered praiseworthy. My behest was not obeyed by the eldest son Yadu.
verses.hindi: सुखा डालेंगे । और इस प्रकार पदार्थों के सूल जाने पर तो मैं उस्हें भस्म कर ही डालगा, तभी हमारी वास्तविक तृष्ति होगी ।” ऐसी बातें करने के उपरास्त आदित्य ने राजा कातंवीये को वे बाण प्रदान किये। उन बाणों को प्राप्त कर अजु न ने समस्त स्थावर पदार्थों को, जो विश्वाल भूमण्डल भर में व्याप्त थे, तथा आश्रम, ग्राम, गौओं के ठहरने के स्थान, नगर, तपोवन, सुरम्य वन, उपवन संब को भस्म कर दिया और तदनस्तर सूर्य की प्रदक्षिणा की । सूर्य के तेज से भस्म पृथ्वी, ब॒क्षों और तृणों से विहीन हो गई। इसी अवसर भहषि आंपव ने एक नियम किया था, जिसके अनुक्वार दस सहस्र वर्षों तक जल में निवास कर रहे ये । महान् तेजस्वी तपोधन आपव जब अपने नियम समाप्त कर जल से उठे और बाहर आये तो उन्होंने अपने आश्रम को अजु न द्वारा जलाया हुआ देखा । उस समय उन्होंने राजधि कातंवीयं को शाप दिया, उसे हम आप लोगों से
verses.wordMeaning: Only that son who carries out the words (orders) of his father and mother is considered praiseworthy. My behest was not obeyed by the eldest son Yadu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only that son who carries out the words (orders) of his father and mother is considered praiseworthy. My behest was not obeyed by the eldest son Yadu.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीजाप्यमात्रस् तु वेदत्रयफलं लभेत् । कुलकोटिशतं साग्रं लभते तु शिवार्चनात्
verses.transliteration: gāyatrījāpyamātras tu vedatrayaphalaṃ labhet / kulakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ labhate tu śivārcanāt
verses.translation: That son who is antagonistic to his father is not honoured or approved by good men. He is the real son who does his duties to his parents. I have been slighted by Yadu and also by Turvasu. Much discourtesy was shown by Druhyu and Anu too.
verses.hindi: खूत बोले--ऋषिवृद ! अब इसके बाद पुरुषरत्न राजधि कोष्टु के वंश का विवरण सुनिये, जिनके वंश में वृष्णिबंश के प्रवंतक बृष्णि का प्रार्देभाव हुआ था। कोष्टु के एक मात्र पुत्र महा- पशस्बी वृजिनीवान् हुए  बजितीवान् के पुत्र स्वाहि को, जो स्वाहा करनेवालों (यज्ञकर्ताओं) में श्रेष्ठ थे, लोग बहुत चाहते हैं। स्वाहि के पुत्र राजा रशादु द्वानियों में अग्रगण्य थे। रहादु के ज्येष्ठ पुत्र प्रसृत को
verses.wordMeaning: That son who is antagonistic to his father is not honoured or approved by good men. He is the real son who does his duties to his parents. I have been slighted by Yadu and also by Turvasu. Much discourtesy was shown by Druhyu and Anu too.
verses.commentary: Sense: That son who is antagonistic to his father is not honoured or approved by good men. He is the real son who does his duties to his parents. I have been slighted by Yadu and also by Turvasu. Much discourtesy was shown by Druhyu and Anu too.

verses.sanskrit: स्नाने दाने तथा श्राद्धे जागरे गीतवादिते । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य शिवलोकात्कदाचन
verses.transliteration: snāne dāne tathā śrāddhe jāgare gītavādite / anivartikā gatistasya śivalokātkadācana
verses.translation: I have been specially honoured by Puru who had carried out my behest. Though he is the youngest, he shall be my successor. It was he who accepted my old age. It was he who fulfilled all my desires. Everything has been done by Puru who carried out his duties as a son.
verses.hindi: प्रजाएं बहुत चाहती थीं, उसने ऐसे महान् यज्ञों का अनुष्ठान किया था, जिनमें प्रचुर दक्षिणाएँ दी गई थीं । विचित्र ढंग के पुत्र-प्राप्ति के कर्मों द्वारा उसे जो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ, चित्ररथ नाम से विश्यात हुआ। वीर एवं चित्ररथों वीरो यज्ञान्विपुलदक्षिणान् । शशबिन्दुः पर॑ वृत्तो राजर्षोणामनुष्ठितः १८ चक़वर्तोी महासत्त्वों महावीर्यों बहुप्रज: । तत्रानुवंशश्ोको5यं यस्मिन्गीतः पुराविद: १६ शशबिन्दोउस्तु पुत्राणां शतानामभवच्छतम् । धीमतामनुरूपाणां भूरिद्रविणतेजसाम्
verses.wordMeaning: I have been specially honoured by Puru who had carried out my behest. Though he is the youngest, he shall be my successor. It was he who accepted my old age. It was he who fulfilled all my desires. Everything has been done by Puru who carried out his duties as a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been specially honoured by Puru who had carried out my behest. Though he is the youngest, he shall be my successor. It was he who accepted my old age. It was he who fulfilled all my desires. Everything has been done by Puru who carried out his duties as a son.

verses.sanskrit: कालेन महताविष्टो मर्त्यलोके समाविशेत् । राजा भवति मेधावी सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: kālena mahatāviṣṭo martyaloke samāviśet / rājā bhavati medhāvī sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: This boon has been granted by Sukra, Kavya, Usanas, himself—'O highly intelligent one, that son who is favourable to you shall be the king to succeed you.' Permitted by you all, may Puru be crowned as the ruler of the kingdom. The son who is endowed with all qualities and who is always loyal to his parents deserves all welfare. He is to be the lord (the king), though he may be the youngest.
verses.hindi: तेषां घट च प्रधानास्तु प्रथुसाह्मा महाबला:  प्रथुश्षवाः पृथुयशाः पृथुधर्मा पृथुंजयः
verses.wordMeaning: This boon has been granted by Sukra, Kavya, Usanas, himself—'O highly intelligent one, that son who is favourable to you shall be the king to succeed you.' Permitted by you all, may Puru be crowned as the ruler of the kingdom.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This boon has been granted by Sukra, Kavya, Usanas, himself—'O highly intelligent one, that son who is favourable to you shall be the king to succeed you.' Permitted by you all, may Puru be crowned as the ruler of the kingdom.…

verses.sanskrit: जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं पुत्रपौत्रधनान्वितः । तच्च तीर्थं पुनः स्मृत्वा लीयमानो महेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ putrapautradhanānvitaḥ / tacca tīrthaṃ punaḥ smṛtvā līyamāno maheśvare
verses.translation: Thus addressed by the delighted citizens and the
verses.hindi: पृथुकीति: पथुदाता राजानः शाशबिन्दवः । शंसन्ति चर पुराणानि पार्थश्रवसमन्तरम् ॥ अन्तर: स पुरा यस्तु यज्ञस्थ तनयोइभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed by the delighted citizens and the
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by the delighted citizens and the

verses.sanskrit: उपास्ते यस्तु वै सन्ध्यां तस्मिंस्तीर्थे च पर्वणि । साङ्गोपाङ्गैश् चतुर्वेदैर् लभते फलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: upāste yastu vai sandhyāṃ tasmiṃstīrthe ca parvaṇi / sāṅgopāṅgaiś caturvedair labhate phalamuttamam
verses.translation: The whole of this earth consisting of the seven "Never can lust subside by enjoyment of pleasures. Just as the fire gets ablaze all the more by ghee-oblations, so also desires get increased by indulgence.
verses.hindi: उशना सेतु धर्मात्मा अवाप्य पृथिवीमिमाम् । आजहाराश्वमेधानां शतसमुत्तमधासिकः २३
verses.wordMeaning: The whole of this earth consisting of the seven "Never can lust subside by enjoyment of pleasures. Just as the fire gets ablaze all the more by ghee-oblations, so also desires get increased by indulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole of this earth consisting of the seven "Never can lust subside by enjoyment of pleasures. Just as the fire gets ablaze all the more by ghee-oblations, so also desires get increased by indulgence.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सर्वं शिवक्षेत्राच्छरपातं समन्ततः । न संचरेद् भयोद्विग्ना ब्रह्महत्या नराधिप
verses.transliteration: tatra sarvaṃ śivakṣetrāccharapātaṃ samantataḥ / na saṃcared bhayodvignā brahmahatyā narādhipa
verses.translation: All the grains and barley seeds, all the gold, all the cattle and all the women in the world are not sufficient for even one (person). He who realises this, does not become deluded.
verses.hindi: ........ ३ ७... धअ४ पड टी आतभघपखणक्‍ न की चित्ररथ ने भी इसी प्रकार विपुलदक्षिणावाले बज्ञों का अनुष्ठान किया था। तदनन्तर राजर्षियों द्वारा सम्मानित शशविन्दु राज्याधिकारी हुआ ।१४-१८। वह महाबलवान्ू, महान् पराक्रमी, अनेक पुत्रोंवाला, तथा चन्रवर्ती शासक था । पुरानी कथाओं के जाननेवाले उसके विषय में श्लोक गाते हैं, जिसका आशय निम्न प्रकार है । राजा शशविन्दु के एक सौ विपुल अथेबल सम्पन्न बुद्धिमान एवं तेजस्वों पुत्र थे, जिनमें छः सबसे बड़े प्रमुख थे,
verses.wordMeaning: All the grains and barley seeds, all the gold, all the cattle and all the women in the world are not sufficient for even one (person). He who realises this, does not become deluded.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the grains and barley seeds, all the gold, all the cattle and all the women in the world are not sufficient for even one (person). He who realises this, does not become deluded.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र तत्र स्थितो वृक्षान् पश्यते तीर्थतत्परः । विविधैः पातकैर् मुक्तो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: yatra tatra sthito vṛkṣān paśyate tīrthatatparaḥ / vividhaiḥ pātakair mukto mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: When one maintains the purifying (auspicious) atti¬ tude to all living beings in thought, speech and action, one attains (realizes) Brahman. When one is not afraid of others, when others are not afraid of him, when one neither desires nor hates (anything),
verses.hindi: जो सब प्ृरथुगण के नाम से विख्यात थे, वे छः पुत्र महान् बलशाली थे । उनके नाम थे, पृथश्रवा, पृथुयश्ञा, पृथुधमा, पृथुञ्जय, पृथकीति और पृथुदाता । ये सब के सब राजा थे ओर शबविन्दु के पूत्रों के नाम से विख्यात थे । सभी पुराण पृश्नत्रवा के पृत्र अस्तर को बड़ी प्रसंसा करते हैं, यही अन्तर प्राचीन काल में यज्ञ का पुत्र था ।१६-२२। उसी धर्मात्मा ने उश्वना नाम से इस पृथ्वी को प्राप्त किया ।
verses.wordMeaning: When one maintains the purifying (auspicious) atti¬ tude to all living beings in thought, speech and action, one attains (realizes) Brahman. When one is not afraid of others, when others are not afraid of him, when one neither desires nor hates (anything),
verses.commentary: Sense: When one maintains the purifying (auspicious) atti¬ tude to all living beings in thought, speech and action, one attains (realizes) Brahman. When one is not afraid of others, when others are not afraid of him, when one neither desires nor hates (anything),

verses.sanskrit: श्वभ्री तत्र महाराज जलमध्ये प्रदृश्यते । कथानिका पुराणोक्ता वानरी तीर्थसेवनात्
verses.transliteration: śvabhrī tatra mahārāja jalamadhye pradṛśyate / kathānikā purāṇoktā vānarī tīrthasevanāt
verses.translation: Happiness comes to one who eschews Trsna (cove¬ tousness), which cannot be got rid of by evil-minded ones, which does not subside even when one grows old and which is a foul disease full of fatal faults.
verses.hindi: परम धार्िक विचारों वाले उशना ने एक सो अश्वमेघ यज्ञों का अनुष्ठान किया। उसका पुत्र मरुत्त हुआ जिसे राजधिगण परम सम्मान देते हैं, मरुत्त का पुत्र वीरकम्बलवहि कहा जाता है, कम्बलर्वाह का पुत्र परम विद्वान राजा रवमकवच हुआ । प्राचीनकाल में इस राजा रुक्‍्मकवच ने बहुतेरे धनुष, बाण, कवच घारण करनेवाले योद्धाओं को युद्ध क्षेत्र में अपने तीक्ष्याणों से मारकर उत्तम लक्ष्मी को प्राप्ति की थी। और अदवमेघ यज्ञ में ब्राह्मणों को भूरि दक्षिणा दान कर महान् यघ्ञ प्राप्त किया था। उप्त राजा रुक्‍्मकबच से शत्रओं के वीरों को नष्ट करनेवाले महान् बलवान, महान् पराक्रमी पाँच वोर पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए, जिनके
verses.wordMeaning: Happiness comes to one who eschews Trsna (cove¬ tousness), which cannot be got rid of by evil-minded ones, which does not subside even when one grows old and which is a foul disease full of fatal faults.
verses.commentary: Sense: Happiness comes to one who eschews Trsna (cove¬ tousness), which cannot be got rid of by evil-minded ones, which does not subside even when one grows old and which is a foul disease full of fatal faults.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र कूपो महाराज तिष्ठते देवनिर्मितः । शिवस्य पश्चिमे भागे शिवक्षेत्रमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra kūpo mahārāja tiṣṭhate devanirmitaḥ / śivasya paścime bhāge śivakṣetramanuttamam
verses.translation: When one grows old, the hairs grow old; the teeth decay along with old age; but the hope for longevity and acquisition of wealth never grow old. The happiness arising from enjoyment of lust or by attaining the great pleasure in heaven does not deserve even a sixteenth part of the happiness resulting from-the destruction of covetousness".
verses.hindi: नाम थे, उक्मेषु, पृथुरुकम, ज्यामघ, परिधि और हरि । पिता में प्रिघि और हरि नामक पुत्रों को विदेह देश
verses.wordMeaning: When one grows old, the hairs grow old; the teeth decay along with old age; but the hope for longevity and acquisition of wealth never grow old.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When one grows old, the hairs grow old; the teeth decay along with old age; but the hope for longevity and acquisition of wealth never grow old.…

verses.sanskrit: वृषोत्सर्गं तु यः कुर्यात्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप । क्रीडन्ति पितरस्तस्य स्वर्गलोके यदृच्छया
verses.transliteration: vṛṣotsargaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / krīḍanti pitarastasya svargaloke yadṛcchayā
verses.translation: Verses 94-100 are the immortal verses quoted in various works and they constitute the moral of this episode.
verses.hindi: ८४६ वॉयूपुराणंमू रुकमेषुरभवद्राजा पृथुरुक्मस्तदाश्रयः । तेभ्यः प्रब्रजितो राज्याज्ज्यामेघो5भवदाश्रमे
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 94-100 are the immortal verses quoted in various works and they constitute the moral of this episode.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 94-100 are the immortal verses quoted in various works and they constitute the moral of this episode.

verses.sanskrit: अगम्यागमने पापम् अयाज्ययाजने कृते । स्तेयाच्च ब्रह्मगोहत्यागुरुघाताच्च पातकम् । तत्सर्वं नश्यते पापं वृषोत्सर्गे कृते तु वै
verses.transliteration: agamyāgamane pāpam ayājyayājane kṛte / steyācca brahmagohatyāgurughātācca pātakam / tatsarvaṃ naśyate pāpaṃ vṛṣotsarge kṛte tu vai
verses.translation: After saying this, the saintly king went to the forest along with his wife. He performed a great penance on Bhrgu- tunga 1 and performed hundreds of holy rites. Earning great fame, he attained,Svarga. His races are five thus. They are holy and rever¬ ed by Devas and sages. The whole earth is pervaded by them as if with the rays of the sun.
verses.hindi: नर्मदानूप एकाकी मेकलावृत्तिका अपि । ऋश्षवन्त॑ गिरि गत्वा शुक्तिमत्यामथाविशत्
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, the saintly king went to the forest along with his wife. He performed a great penance on Bhrgu- tunga 1 and performed hundreds of holy rites. Earning great fame, he attained,Svarga. His races are five thus. They are holy and rever¬ ed by Devas and sages.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the saintly king went to the forest along with his wife. He performed a great penance on Bhrgu- tunga 1 and performed hundreds of holy rites. Earning great fame, he attained,Svarga. His races are five thus. They are holy and rever¬ ed by Devas and sages.…

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यं यः शृणोति समाधिना । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavyatīrthamāhātmyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samādhinā / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: An excellent Brahmana who reads this entire narra¬ tive of Yayati or listens to it, shall become wealthy, long-lived and renowned. He will be blessed with children.
verses.hindi: ज्यामघस्या भवद्भार्या शेव्या बलवती भृशम् । अयुन्नोइषि स वे राजा भायमिन्यां न विन्दति तस्था55सी द्विजयो युद्धे ततः कन्याम॒वाप सः । भार्यासुवाच राजा स स्नुषेति तु नरेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: An excellent Brahmana who reads this entire narra¬ tive of Yayati or listens to it, shall become wealthy, long-lived and renowned. He will be blessed with children.
verses.commentary: Sense: An excellent Brahmana who reads this entire narra¬ tive of Yayati or listens to it, shall become wealthy, long-lived and renowned. He will be blessed with children.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये माण्डव्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १७३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye māṇḍavyatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 173 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: I shall recount the race of the eldest (son of Yayati) Yadu, of excellent splendour. Listen and understand, even as I recount it in detail and in the proper order.
verses.hindi: कुन्तेध ष्टसुतो जज्ञे पुरो धुष्ट: प्रतापवान् । धृष्टस्य पुत्रों धर्मात्मा निव् तिः परवीरहा ३६
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount the race of the eldest (son of Yayati) Yadu, of excellent splendour. Listen and understand, even as I recount it in detail and in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount the race of the eldest (son of Yayati) Yadu, of excellent splendour. Listen and understand, even as I recount it in detail and in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धेश्वरमिति ख्यातं महापातकनाशनम् । यत्र शुद्धिं परां प्राप्तो देवदेवो महेश्वरः । पुरा हत्यायुतः पार्थ देवदेवस् त्रिशूलधृक्
verses.transliteration: siddheśvaramiti khyātaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam / yatra śuddhiṃ parāṃ prāpto devadevo maheśvaraḥ / purā hatyāyutaḥ pārtha devadevas triśūladhṛk
verses.translation: Yadu had five sons, all comparable to the sons of Devas. Sahasrajit was the eldest. (The others were) Krostu, Nila, Jita and Laghu.
verses.hindi: में स्थापित किया ।२३-२८। रुक्मेषु अपने पिता के राज्य का अधिकारी हुआ, प्रथुरुकम उसके अधीन था । उन सभी भाइयों ने मिलाकर ज्यामघ को निर्वासित कर दिया, जिससे उसने वन में अपना आश्रम बनाया । घोर वन्य प्रान्त में मुनिवृत्ति धारण करनेवाले ज्यामघ को एक ब्राह्मण ने प्रेरणा दी, जिससे प्रभावित होकर वह रथ पर चढ़ धनुष घारण कर मध्य देश को प्रस्थित हुआ  वहाँ नमंदा के तटवर्ती प्रान्त में अकेले घूमते हुए, वह मेकल पवंत के छिखरों से ऋक्षवान् नासक पवेत पर पहुँचा ओर वहाँ से शुक्तिमतीो में प्रविष्ट हुआ  ज्यामघ की पत्नी शंव्या परम शक्तिमती ओर साहसी थी। उससे कोई पुत्र यद्यपि नहीं था फिर भी राजा होकर उसने दूसरी स्त्री से ब्याह नहीं किया था ।३९-३२। एक युद्ध में राजा ज्यामघ की विजय हुई, जिसमें उसने एक कन्या प्राप्त की । नरपति ने उस कन्या को लाकर अपनी स्त्रीं से यह कहा कि यह
verses.wordMeaning: Yadu had five sons, all comparable to the sons of Devas. Sahasrajit was the eldest. (The others were) Krostu, Nila, Jita and Laghu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yadu had five sons, all comparable to the sons of Devas. Sahasrajit was the eldest. (The others were) Krostu, Nila, Jita and Laghu.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा पञ्चशिरा आसीद्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । तेनानृतं वचश्चोक्तं कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे
verses.transliteration: purā pañcaśirā āsīdbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / tenānṛtaṃ vacaścoktaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare
verses.translation: Sahasrajit's son was the glorious king named Satajit. Satajit had three sons who were well known as very virtuous.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारी पुत्र वध है ।” राजा के ऐसा कहने पर दोव्या ने कहा “यह किसकी पुत्रवध् होगी। राजा ने कहा "तुम्हें जो पुत्र उत्पन्न होगा यह कन्या उसीकी स्त्री होगी ।/ राजा के इस वचन से शंव्या ने कठोर तपस्या की, जिससे उसे एक पुत्र हुआ  सुम्दरी, साध्वोन्शंव्या ने वृद्धावस्था में इस प्रकार विदर्भ नामक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया था । उसकी पुत्रवध् में विदर्भ से क्र८ और कौशिक नामक दो राजपुत्र उत्पन्न हुए, जो परम
verses.wordMeaning: Sahasrajit's son was the glorious king named Satajit. Satajit had three sons who were well known as very virtuous.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahasrajit's son was the glorious king named Satajit. Satajit had three sons who were well known as very virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा सहसा तस्मै चुकोप परमेश्वरः । छेदयामास भगवान्मूर्धानं करजैस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā sahasā tasmai cukopa parameśvaraḥ / chedayāmāsa bhagavānmūrdhānaṃ karajaistadā
verses.translation: They were Haihaya, Haya and the king Venuhaya. It is heard that Haihaya's successor was Dharmatattva.
verses.hindi: विद्वान शुर-वीर और रणनिप्रण थे ।३३-२६। उन दोनों पुत्रों के पीछे राजा विदर्भ ने एक तीसरे परम धामिक लोमपाद मामक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया । लोमपाद के पुत्र राजा वस्तु हुए, उनके पुत्र आहृति हुए। कौशिक के पुत्र चिदि हुए, जिस लिंदि से उत्पन्न होने वाले राजा लोग चंद्य नाम से विख्यात हुए। विदर्भराज के पुत्र जो क्रग थे, उनके आत्मज कुन्ति हुए । कुन्ति के पुत्र धुष्ठसुत हुए, जो परम प्रतापशाली राजा थे  धृष्ट के दाता धर्मरतो नित्यं सत्यशीलपरायण: । तस्य पुत्री नवरथस्ततो दशरथः स्मृतः ॥४ २ तस्य चकादशरथः शकुनिस्तस्य चा55त्मजः । तस्मात्करम्भको धन्वी देवरातोउभवत्तत:ः ॥३४ ३ देवक्षत्रो5भवद्राजा देवरातिम हायशा: । देवक्षत्रसुतो जज्ञे देवन: क्षत्रनन्दनः (४४ देवनात्स मधुजेले यस्य मेघार्थंसम्भव:। मधोश्चापि महातेजा मनुरमंनुवशस्तथा ३४४५
verses.wordMeaning: They were Haihaya, Haya and the king Venuhaya. It is heard that Haihaya's successor was Dharmatattva.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Haihaya, Haya and the king Venuhaya. It is heard that Haihaya's successor was Dharmatattva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तत्करसंलग्नं च्यवते न कदाचन । ततो हि देवदेवेशः पर्यटन् पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tatkarasaṃlagnaṃ cyavate na kadācana / tato hi devadeveśaḥ paryaṭan pṛthivīmimām
verses.translation: Dharmatattva's son was Kirti and his son was Samjneya. Samjfieya's successor was the king named Mahisman.
verses.hindi: जश्ने पुरुद्गतः पुत्रों भद्रवत्यां पुरुद्हः । ऐक्वाकों त्वभवद्धार्या सत्त्वस्तस्यामजायत ॥ सत्त्वात्सत्त्वगुणोपेतः सात्त्वतः कीतिवर्धनः
verses.wordMeaning: Dharmatattva's son was Kirti and his son was Samjneya. Samjfieya's successor was the king named Mahisman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharmatattva's son was Kirti and his son was Samjneya. Samjfieya's successor was the king named Mahisman.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वाराणसीं प्राप्तस्तस्यां तदपतच्छिरः । पतिते तु कपाले च ब्रह्महत्या न मुञ्चति
verses.transliteration: tato vārāṇasīṃ prāptastasyāṃ tadapatacchiraḥ / patite tu kapāle ca brahmahatyā na muñcati
verses.translation: Mahisman's son was the valorous Bhadrasrenya who was the king of Varanasi and has already been mentioned.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते ज्यामघवृत्तान्तकथन नाम पत्चनवतितमोअध्याय: पुत्र धर्मा,मा निवृ ति हुए, जो छ्षत्रुओं के वीरों को नष्ठ करने वाले थे । निबति के पुत्र महान् बलशाली एवं परम पराक्रमी राजा इश्चाहें हुए, दशाहे के पुत्र व्योमा हुए, व्योमा के बाद राजा जीमूत कहे जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Mahisman's son was the valorous Bhadrasrenya who was the king of Varanasi and has already been mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahisman's son was the valorous Bhadrasrenya who was the king of Varanasi and has already been mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु सागरे गत्वा पूर्वे च दक्षिणे तथा । पश्चिमे चोत्तरे पार्थ देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tatastu sāgare gatvā pūrve ca dakṣiṇe tathā / paścime cottare pārtha devadevo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: A mountain in Nepal on the eastern bank of Gandak. Here was the hermitage of Bhygu. (De 34).
verses.hindi: जीमृत के पुत्र विक्ृति हुए, बिक्ृति के पुत्र राजा भीमरथ कहे जाते हैं, तदन्तर भीमरथ के पुत्र राजा रथवर प्रस्चिद्ध हुए जो सर्वदा सत्य वचन बोलनेवाले, शीलवान एवं दान कम में तत्पर रहते थे । उन राजा रथवर के पुत्र नवरथ हुए, जिनके बाद दशरथ कहे जाते हैं। उन राजा दशरथ के एकादशरथ नामक पुत्र हुए। उनके पुत्र राजा शकुति हुए। छाकुनि के बाद धनुषघारी राजा करम्भ हुए, जिनके पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: A mountain in Nepal on the eastern bank of Gandak. Here was the hermitage of Bhygu. (De 34).
verses.commentary: Sense: A mountain in Nepal on the eastern bank of Gandak. Here was the hermitage of Bhygu. (De 34).

verses.sanskrit: पर्यटन्सर्वतीर्थेषु ब्रह्महत्या न मुञ्चति । नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले सुतीर्थं प्राप्तवान् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: paryaṭansarvatīrtheṣu brahmahatyā na muñcati / narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sutīrthaṃ prāptavān prabhuḥ
verses.translation: This chapter describes the Haihaya line of Yadu in which the greatest ruler of the Narmada valley, Kartavirya Arjuna, was born. This chapter is captioned after that illustrious king. This chapter corresponds to Bd. 3.69 & verse-numbers in the notes refer to that chapter.
verses.hindi: देवरात हुए  देवरात का पुत्र महान् यशस्वी राजा देवक्षत्र हुआ । देवक्षत्र का पुत्र क्षत्रनन्‍्दन देवन उत्पन्न हुए देवन से मधु नामक पुत्र को उत्पत्ति हुई, जिसके पुत्र का नाम मेधार्थसम्भव था ।४२-४४१। उस सधु के महान् तेजस्वी मनु, मनुवंश, नन्दन और महानपुरुवश नामक पुत्र और हुए  पुरुवशा का पृत्र पुरुष श्रेष्ठ पुरुद्वान हुआ पुरुद्वान का पुत्र पुरुद्दह भद्रवती नामक स्त्री से उत्पन्न हुआ। उसकी स्त्री इक्ष्वाकुवंश्ोत्पन्न थी, उसमें उसे सत्त्व नामक पुत्र की प्राप्ति हुई। उस सत्त्व से सत्वगुणसम्पन्न कीतिशाली सात््वत नामक पुत्र की उत्पत्ति हुईं। महात्मा ज्यामघ के बंश विस्तार की इस कथा को जानकर मनुष्य संतत्ियोंवाला होता है और परम बुद्धिमान् राजा चन्द्रमा का सायुज्य (सान्निष्य) प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter describes the Haihaya line of Yadu in which the greatest ruler of the Narmada valley, Kartavirya Arjuna, was born. This chapter is captioned after that illustrious king. This chapter corresponds to Bd. 3.69 & verse-numbers in the notes refer to that chapter.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter describes the Haihaya line of Yadu in which the greatest ruler of the Narmada valley, Kartavirya Arjuna, was born. This chapter is captioned after that illustrious king. This chapter corresponds to Bd. 3.69 & verse-numbers in the notes refer to that chapter.

verses.sanskrit: कुलकोटिं समासाद्य प्रार्थयामास चात्मवान् । प्रायश्चित्तं ततः कृत्वा बभूव गतकल्मषः
verses.transliteration: kulakoṭiṃ samāsādya prārthayāmāsa cātmavān / prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā babhūva gatakalmaṣaḥ
verses.translation: The entire earth consisting of seven continents and many towns and surrounded by seven oceans, was conquered by him in a manner befitting a Ksatriya. 1 2
verses.hindi: सात्वतोी रूपसंपन्ना कौशल्या सुषुबे सुतान्ू  भजिनं भजमानं च दिव्यं देवाव्॒ध नृपम् हि अन्धकं च महाभोजं व॒ष्णि च यदुनन्‍्दनम् । तेषां हि सर्गाश्चित्वारः शुणुध्ब विस्तरेण व
verses.wordMeaning: The entire earth consisting of seven continents and many towns and surrounded by seven oceans, was conquered by him in a manner befitting a Ksatriya. 1 2
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire earth consisting of seven continents and many towns and surrounded by seven oceans, was conquered by him in a manner befitting a Ksatriya. 1 2

verses.sanskrit: ततो निष्कल्मषो जातो देवदेवो महेश्वरः । हत्वा सुरेभ्यस्तत्स्थानं ततश्चान्तर्दधे प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tato niṣkalmaṣo jāto devadevo maheśvaraḥ / hatvā surebhyastatsthānaṃ tataścāntardadhe prabhuḥ
verses.translation: When he started fighting in a battle, banners and chariots befitting it and a thousand arms used to appear by means of the Maya of that intelligent one.
verses.hindi: भजमानस्य शज्जय्यां बाह्मश्वोपरि बाह्यकः  शूअजयस्य सुते दे तु वाह्यकस्ते उदावहत् ये बाह्यकायेशुअुजय्यां भजमानाद्विजज्ञिरे । भयुतायुतसाहल्रशतजिदथ वासकः
verses.wordMeaning: When he started fighting in a battle, banners and chariots befitting it and a thousand arms used to appear by means of the Maya of that intelligent one.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he started fighting in a battle, banners and chariots befitting it and a thousand arms used to appear by means of the Maya of that intelligent one.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं शुद्धरुद्रेति कीर्तितम् । विख्यातं त्रिषु लोके ब्रह्महत्याहरं परम्
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ śuddharudreti kīrtitam / vikhyātaṃ triṣu loke brahmahatyāharaṃ param
verses.translation: It is heard that without any difficulties ten thousand Yajiias had been performed by that intelligent king in all the seven continents.
verses.hindi: बाह्यकार्याभगिन्यां ये भजमानाद्विजज्षिरे । तेषां देवावधो राजा चचार परम तपः ६ पुत्र: सर्वगुणोपेतों मम भुयादिति सम ह्। संयोज्या5त्सानसेवं सा,सवर्णा जलमस्पृशत् ३७ सा चोपस्पशनात्तस्य चकार ऋषिमापगा । कल्याणं च नरपतेस्तस्य सा निम्नगोत्तमा ८
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard that without any difficulties ten thousand Yajiias had been performed by that intelligent king in all the seven continents.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard that without any difficulties ten thousand Yajiias had been performed by that intelligent king in all the seven continents.

verses.sanskrit: मासे मासे सिते पक्षे ऽमावास्यायां युधिष्ठिर । स्नात्वा तत्र विधानेन तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: māse māse site pakṣe 'māvāsyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / snātvā tatra vidhānena tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: All the Yajnas performed by that mighty-armed king were profoundly splendid. All of them were provided with golden altars with golden sacrificial posts. All of thorp were graced by the presence of blessed Devas seated in aerial
verses.hindi: विष्णु-बंश-वर्णन सूत बोले--ऋषिवृन्द ! रूपव॒ती सात्वत की स्त्री कशिल्या ने भजिन भजमान् राजा देवावध अन्धक, महाभोज तथा यदुनन्दु बुष्णि प्रभृति पुत्रों को उत्पन्त किया। इन सबों में चार वंशों का विवरण विस्तारपूृर्वकं: सुनिये। भजमान के श्ञ्जयी नामक पत्नी में धाह्य और उपरिवाह्य नामक दो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए । शइज्जय की दो पुत्रियाँ थीं, जिन्हें वाह्मयक ने पत्नी रूप में स्वीकार किया  उन दोनों बहिनों ने,
verses.wordMeaning: All the Yajnas performed by that mighty-armed king were profoundly splendid. All of them were provided with golden altars with golden sacrificial posts. All of thorp were graced by the presence of blessed Devas seated in aerial
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Yajnas performed by that mighty-armed king were profoundly splendid. All of them were provided with golden altars with golden sacrificial posts. All of thorp were graced by the presence of blessed Devas seated in aerial

verses.sanskrit: दद्यात् पिण्डं पित्ःणां तु भावितेनान्तरात्मना । तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि सुतृप्ताः पितरो नृप
verses.transliteration: dadyāt piṇḍaṃ pitḥṇāṃ tu bhāvitenāntarātmanā / tasya te dvādaśābdāni sutṛptāḥ pitaro nṛpa
verses.translation: Bd. 3.69. reads: ability to prevent one from evil the moment he plans it.
verses.hindi: वाह्यक की पत्नी होकर अनेक पुत्र उत्पन्न किए। जिनमें निमि, पणव, एवं शत्रुओं के नगरों को जीतने वाले वृष्णि प्रमुख हुए--भजमान के पुत्र वाह्मक ने अपनी ज़्येष्ठ रानी में इन पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया। इसी प्रकार कनिष्ठ रानी में अयुतायुत-जित् सहख्नजित् शतजित् और वामक नामक पुत्र उत्परत हुए। इन सबों में राजा देवावृध ने परम तपस्या की ।१-६। उन्होंने यह संकल्प करके तपस्था की थी कि "मुझे एक सर्बंगुणसम्पन्त
verses.wordMeaning: Bd. 3.69. reads: ability to prevent one from evil the moment he plans it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bd. 3.69. reads: ability to prevent one from evil the moment he plans it.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धधूपप्रदीपाद्यैरभ्यर्च्य परमेश्वरम् । शुद्धेश्वराभिधानं तु शिवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: gandhadhūpapradīpādyairabhyarcya parameśvaram / śuddheśvarābhidhānaṃ tu śivaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Verses 14-37 describe the exploits, munificence, righteousness and glory of Kartavirya. The Gathas sung by Narada about him (vv. 20-22) record in a nutshell Arjuna's achievements. Generally these Gathas are quotations from ancient traditional verses. After observing the conduct and the grandeur of that saintly king, Narada and Gandharvas sang the following verse(s) of glory of that king.
verses.hindi: पुत्र प्राप्त हो ।' इस प्रकार संकल्प कर राजा ने तपस्या करते समय योगबल से पर्णाश्षा नामक नदी के जल का स्पर्श किया । स्पष्टों करते ही नदी ने राजा की, कल्याण चिसम्ता को नदियों में उत्तम पर्णाशा ने चिस्ता भवेत्सवंगुणोपेतो राज्ञो देववृधस्य हि। तस्मादस्य स्वयं चाह भवाम्यद्य सहव्ता ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 14-37 describe the exploits, munificence, righteousness and glory of Kartavirya. The Gathas sung by Narada about him (vv. 20-22) record in a nutshell Arjuna's achievements. Generally these Gathas are quotations from ancient traditional verses.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 14-37 describe the exploits, munificence, righteousness and glory of Kartavirya. The Gathas sung by Narada about him (vv. 20-22) record in a nutshell Arjuna's achievements. Generally these Gathas are quotations from ancient traditional verses.…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं राजञ्छुद्धरुद्रम् अनुत्तमम् । मया श्रुतं यथा देवसकाशाच्छूलपाणिनः । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ rājañchuddharudram anuttamam / mayā śrutaṃ yathā devasakāśācchūlapāṇinaḥ / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: "Certainly no man can emulate (none can attain) the goal or status of Kartavlrya by means of Yajnas, Danas, penances, exploits and learning.
verses.hindi: अथ भुत्वा कुमारी तु सावित्री परम वचः । चिन्तयामास राजानं तामियेष स पाथिवः ३११ तस्यामाधत्त गर्भ स तेजस्विनमुदारधीः । अथ सा नवसे मासि सुधुर्व सरितां बरा ११२ पुत्र सबंगुणोपेत॑ यथा वेबावृ्धेष्सितः  तत्र बंशे पुराणज्ञा गाथां गायच्ति वे द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: "Certainly no man can emulate (none can attain) the goal or status of Kartavlrya by means of Yajnas, Danas, penances, exploits and learning.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Certainly no man can emulate (none can attain) the goal or status of Kartavlrya by means of Yajnas, Danas, penances, exploits and learning.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शुद्धेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिसप्तत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १७४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: गोपेश्वरं ततो गच्छेदुत्तरे नर्मदातटे । यत्र स्नानेन चैकेन मुच्यन्ते पातकैर् नराः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śuddheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 174 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: gopeśvaraṃ tato gaccheduttare narmadātaṭe / yatra snānena caikena mucyante pātakair narāḥ
verses.translation: In all the seven continents he is seen moving about with his sword drawn and the excellent bows and arrows kept ready as well as seated in his chariot. Though he is the king, he behaves as though he is the follower.*
verses.hindi: गुणान्देवावधस्थापि कौतंयन्तो महात्मनः । यथेव शूणुते दूरात्संपश्यति तथान्तिकात् बनच्नुः श्रेष्ठो मनुष्याणां देवेदेवावधः समः। पुरुषाः पचषष्टिश्न सहर्नाणि च सप्ततिः ॥॥ क्‍ येड्मृतत्वमनृप्राप्ता बच्ुदंबावधादपि:
verses.wordMeaning: In all the seven continents he is seen moving about with his sword drawn and the excellent bows and arrows kept ready as well as seated in his chariot. Though he is the king, he behaves as though he is the follower.*
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the seven continents he is seen moving about with his sword drawn and the excellent bows and arrows kept ready as well as seated in his chariot. Though he is the king, he behaves as though he is the follower.*

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा कुरुते प्राणसंक्षयम् । बर्हियुक्तेन यानेन स गच्छेच्छिवमन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā kurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam / barhiyuktena yānena sa gacchecchivamandire
verses.translation: While he was protecting the subjects righteously, none of his subjects lost his wealth, no one was grief-stricken and no one had any confusion, thanks to the prowess of that great king".
verses.hindi: यज्वा दानपतिर्वीरो ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यवाग्बुध:  कीतिमांश्व महाभागः सात्वतानाों महारथ १६ तस्यास्ववाये सुमहाभो जयेमातिकाबला: । गान्धारी चंव माद्री च वुष्णेभायें ब॒भृवतुः
verses.wordMeaning: While he was protecting the subjects righteously, none of his subjects lost his wealth, no one was grief-stricken and no one had any confusion, thanks to the prowess of that great king".
verses.commentary: Sense: While he was protecting the subjects righteously, none of his subjects lost his wealth, no one was grief-stricken and no one had any confusion, thanks to the prowess of that great king".

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडित्वा सुचिरं कालं शिवलोके नराधिप । इह मानुष्यतां प्राप्य राजा भवति वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ śivaloke narādhipa / iha mānuṣyatāṃ prāpya rājā bhavati vīryavān
verses.translation: That king became the sole monarch and emperor of the seven continents for eightyfive thousand years.
verses.hindi: गान्धारी जनयामास सुमित्र सिन्ननन्दनम् । साद्री युधाजित॑ पुत्र सा तु व देवमीदृषम् १८ आंतुर होकर यह विचार किया कि 'मेरी जानकारी में ऐसो कोई स्त्री नहीं है, जिसमें राजा देवावृध के संकल्प के अनुसार सर्वगुणसम्पन्न पुत्र उत्पर्त हों, अतः अब मैं स्वयं ही इसकी सहधर्भिणी बन रही हूँ । राजा ने जिस प्रकार की भावना की थी उसी के अनुसार नदी से स्वमेव उसके हाथों का प्रार्दभाव हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: That king became the sole monarch and emperor of the seven continents for eightyfive thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king became the sole monarch and emperor of the seven continents for eightyfive thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पन्नो दासीदाससमन्वितः । पूज्यमानो नरेन्द्रैश्च जीवेद्वर्षशतं नरः
verses.transliteration: hastyaśvarathasampanno dāsīdāsasamanvitaḥ / pūjyamāno narendraiśca jīvedvarṣaśataṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: (In his realm) he himself was the protector of cattle and the fields. As a Yogin, Arjuna became Parjanya (Lord of clouds and rains) and showered in plenty.
verses.hindi: तदनस्तर सावित्री कुमार होकर उसने सुन्दर शब्दों में राजा के प्रति अपनी चिन्ता (अनुरक्ति) प्रकट की, राजा ने उसकी इच्छा पूति की। उदारचेता राजा देवावध ने उस कुमारी में एक तेजस्वी पुत्र का गर्भाधान किया  सरिताओं में श्रेष्ठ पर्णाशा ते नव सहिने में जिस प्रकार के पुत्र को इच्छा राजा देवावृध को थी उसी प्रकार का स्वंगुण सम्पन्न पुत्र उत्पन्न किया। पुराणों की कथाओं के जाननेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: (In his realm) he himself was the protector of cattle and the fields. As a Yogin, Arjuna became Parjanya (Lord of clouds and rains) and showered in plenty.
verses.commentary: Sense: (In his realm) he himself was the protector of cattle and the fields. As a Yogin, Arjuna became Parjanya (Lord of clouds and rains) and showered in plenty.

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्राप्ते कार्त्तिके मासि नवम्यां शुक्लपक्षतः । सोपवासः शुचिर्भूत्वा दीपकांस्तत्र दापयेत्
verses.transliteration: samprāpte kārttike māsi navamyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ / sopavāsaḥ śucirbhūtvā dīpakāṃstatra dāpayet
verses.translation: With his thousand arms rendered tough by frequent contact with the bowstring, he shone like the Sun with his thousands of autumnal rays.
verses.hindi: विद्वान् ब्राह्मण लोग उस वंश के प्रसंग में महात्मा राजा देवाब॒ध के गुणों और वंशों का वर्णन करते हुए कहते हैं कि वह राजा देवावध दूर से जैसा सुना जाता था कि वैसा ही समीप में जाने पर प्रत्यक्ष दिखाई पढ़ता था। राजा देवावध देवताओं के समान गुणशाली था। बश्न् मानव समाज में सर्वेश्रेष्ठ था। इस वंश के पेंसठ सहस्न सत्तर मनुष्यों ने अमृतत्व की प्राप्ति को । बच्नु गुणों में देवावध से भी बढ़ा चढ़ा था ।॥११-१५॥। वह यज्ञ करनेवाला, दानियों का स्वामी, वीर, ब्राह्मणप्रतिपालक, बुद्धिमान् सत्यवादी, कीतिमान् महाभाग्यशाली एवं सात्वत के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवालों में एकमात्र महारथी था  उसके वंश में महान् भोंज (?) वंशीय एवं आतिकाबलों (?) की उत्पत्ति हुई थी। गान्धारोी और माद्री-ये दो वष्णि की स्त्रियाँ थीं। इनमें से
verses.wordMeaning: With his thousand arms rendered tough by frequent contact with the bowstring, he shone like the Sun with his thousands of autumnal rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his thousand arms rendered tough by frequent contact with the bowstring, he shone like the Sun with his thousands of autumnal rays.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धपुष्पैः समभ्यर्च्य रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम् । तस्य यत्फलमुद्दिष्टं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप
verses.transliteration: gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya rātrau kurvīta jāgaram / tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa
verses.translation: Having conquered the royal assembly of (the serpent king) Karkotaka in Mahismall with a thousand elephants, he established his capital there.
verses.hindi: प्रसेनभ्र प्रहाभागः शुक्षजिच्च सुताबुभौ । तस्य शुक्रजितः सूर्य: सखा प्राणसमो5भवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Having conquered the royal assembly of (the serpent king) Karkotaka in Mahismall with a thousand elephants, he established his capital there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having conquered the royal assembly of (the serpent king) Karkotaka in Mahismall with a thousand elephants, he established his capital there.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्पुण्यं फलं संख्या दीपकानां तथैव च । तावद्युगसहस्राणि शिवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yāvatpuṇyaṃ phalaṃ saṃkhyā dīpakānāṃ tathaiva ca / tāvadyugasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: (Defective) The lotus-eyed king used to check the for¬ ceful (speedy) waves of the sea during the rainy season (when the sea is stormy). In a happy mood, he sportingly spewed out water and made an (artificial) rainy season.
verses.hindi: अथ राजा बविवस्वन्तमुबाच स्थितमग्रतः । यथव व्योस्नि पश्यामि त्वामहूं ज्योतिषां पते... तेजोमण्डलिनं चेव तथवाध्यग्रतः स्थितम् । को विशेषों विवस्व॑स्ते सख्येनोपगतेन वे .. रेड एतच्छ त्वा स भगवान्मणिरत्नं स्थमन्तकम् । स्वकण्ठादवमुच्याथ बबन्ध नपतेस्तदा २५
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) The lotus-eyed king used to check the for¬ ceful (speedy) waves of the sea during the rainy season (when the sea is stormy). In a happy mood, he sportingly spewed out water and made an (artificial) rainy season.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) The lotus-eyed king used to check the for¬ ceful (speedy) waves of the sea during the rainy season (when the sea is stormy). In a happy mood, he sportingly spewed out water and made an (artificial) rainy season.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र लिङ्गपूरणकं विधिम् । तथैव पद्मकैश्चैव दधिभक्तैस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra liṅgapūraṇakaṃ vidhim / tathaiva padmakaiścaiva dadhibhaktaistathaiva ca
verses.translation: Shaken and tossed about by him during his (water- sports), Narmada, wearing garlands with golden fillets approached the king in an apprehensive mannar, with eyebrows like waves producing the gentle (murmuring) soun
verses.hindi: तमतिप्रस्थितं भूयों विवस्वन्‍्तं स शक़जित् । प्रोवाचाग्निसवर्णा त्वं येन लोकान्प्रयास्थति(सि)॥ तदेब मणिरत्नं तन्‍्मां भवानदातुमहंति द द
verses.wordMeaning: Shaken and tossed about by him during his (water- sports), Narmada, wearing garlands with golden fillets approached the king in an apprehensive mannar, with eyebrows like waves producing the gentle (murmuring) soun
verses.commentary: Sense: Shaken and tossed about by him during his (water- sports), Narmada, wearing garlands with golden fillets approached the king in an apprehensive mannar, with eyebrows like waves producing the gentle (murmuring) soun

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु कुर्यान् नरश्रेष्ठ तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु । यावन्ति तिलसंख्यानि दधिभक्तं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: yastu kuryān naraśreṣṭha tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / yāvanti tilasaṃkhyāni dadhibhaktaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Giant fishes and great serpents concealed under great billows were crushed and scattered in the flood of foam, the eddies and whirlpools which were unbearably furious.
verses.hindi: स्पमन्तक नाम मणि दत्तवांस्तस्य भास्कर: । स तसाबध्य नगरं प्रविवेश महीपतिः २८ गान्धारी ने सुमित्र मित्रनन्दन और माद्री ने युधाजित देवमीढुष और अनमित्र नामक पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया-- वे दोनों पुरुष श्रेष्ठ थे । अनमित्र का पुत्र निध्त हुआ, निध्न के दो पुत्र हुए, महाभाग्यशाली प्रसेन और शक्रजित् । उस शक्रजित् के सूयय प्राणों के समान परम मिन्र थे।!६-२०। एक बार कभी प्रातःकाल के समय रथारोहियों में श्रेष्ठ वह शक्रजित सूय की उपासना करने के लिए अपने लिये अपने रथपर सवार होकर जलाशय
verses.wordMeaning: Giant fishes and great serpents concealed under great billows were crushed and scattered in the flood of foam, the eddies and whirlpools which were unbearably furious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Giant fishes and great serpents concealed under great billows were crushed and scattered in the flood of foam, the eddies and whirlpools which were unbearably furious.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मसंख्या शिवे लोके मोदते कालमीप्सितम् । तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र यत्किंचिद् दीयते नृप
verses.transliteration: padmasaṃkhyā śive loke modate kālamīpsitam / tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra yatkiṃcid dīyate nṛpa
verses.translation: Agitating it by means of his thousand arms, the king made the ocean resemble the milky sea churned by Devas and Asuras. (Defective verse) On seeing the terrible, prominent king, the (aquatic beings) were afraid that the ocean was once again being churned by the Mandara mountain for the sake of Amrla (nectar) and at once felt uprooted (utpafita in A ).
verses.hindi: के जल का स्पश करने निकला । जिस समय वह उपासना कर रहा था, उस समय अस्पष्ट रूप धारण कर अपने तेजोमण्डल से समन्त्रित होकर भगवान् संयेनाराण उसके आगे उपस्थित हुए। सूये के आगे तपस्थित देखकर राजा ने कहा ज्योतिर्गणों के स्वामिन् ! मैं आकादह्य मण्डल में आपको जिस प्रकार तेजोमय देखता हूँ, उसी प्रकार इस समय भी देख रहा हूँ, तो फिर भगवन् ! आपके
verses.wordMeaning: Agitating it by means of his thousand arms, the king made the ocean resemble the milky sea churned by Devas and Asuras. (Defective verse) On seeing the terrible, prominent king,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Agitating it by means of his thousand arms, the king made the ocean resemble the milky sea churned by Devas and Asuras. (Defective verse) On seeing the terrible, prominent king,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं कोटिगुणं तस्य संख्यातुं वा न शक्यते । एवं ते कथितं सर्वं सर्वतीर्थमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tasya saṃkhyātuṃ vā na śakyate / evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatīrthamanuttamam
verses.translation: Great serpents bent down their heads and stood mo¬ tionless like the stumps of the plantain trees standing still in the evening hours, when the wind does not blow.
verses.hindi: मित्र रूप में उपस्थित होने की विशेषता क्या है? शक्रजित की यह बात सुनकर भगवान् सुर्यनारायण ने अपने कण्ठ से स्थमन्तक नामक उत्तम मणि को छोड़कर राजा के कण्ठ में बाँध दिया, उस समय राजा ने सूर्य नारायण को शरीर घारण किये हुए देखा । उस अनृपम तेजस्विनी प्रतिमा को उन्होंने एक मुह॒तं तक उसी प्रकार देखा ।२१-२६। तदनन्तर सूर्य को गमनोद्यत देखकर छाक्रजित ने कहा, 'भगवन् ! आप अशिन के समान परमतैजोमय हैं, आपने जिस प्रकाशमान मणि से इतने प्रकाश युक्त होकर आप समस्त लोकों में भ्रमण करते हैं, उसी सुन्दर मणि को मुझे प्रदान करने की क्रपा करें ।! शक्रजित की इस याचना पर भगवान् सूर्य नारायण ने अपना स्यथमन्तक नामक मणि राजा को प्रदान कर दिया। महीपति ने उस सुन्दर मणि को बाँध क्र
verses.wordMeaning: Great serpents bent down their heads and stood mo¬ tionless like the stumps of the plantain trees standing still in the evening hours, when the wind does not blow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Great serpents bent down their heads and stood mo¬ tionless like the stumps of the plantain trees standing still in the evening hours, when the wind does not blow.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे गोपेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुःसप्तत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १७५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले भृगुक्षेत्रस्य मध्यतः । कपिलेश्वरं तु विख्यातं विशेषात्पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gopeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 175 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: uttare narmadākūle bhṛgukṣetrasya madhyataḥ / kapileśvaraṃ tu vikhyātaṃ viśeṣātpāpanāśanam
verses.translation: (Defective verse) Proudly he went to Lanka. With his bow and five hundred arrows he overpowered Ravana along with his army. He defeated and brought him to Mahismatl and imprisoned him there.
verses.hindi: त॑ प्रसेनजिते दिव्यं मणिरत्नं स्थमन्तकस् । ददो श्रात्रे नरपतिः प्रेम्णा शक़जिदुत्तमम् (३० + स्थमन्तको नाम मणियंस्य राष्ट्रे स्थितों भवेत् । कालवर्षो च पर्जन्यो न च व्याधिभयं तदा ॥३ १ लिप्सां चक प्रसेनात्त मणिरत्न स्थमन्तकम् । गोबिन्दो न च त॑ लेभे शक्तोषपि न जहार च
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) Proudly he went to Lanka. With his bow and five hundred arrows he overpowered Ravana along with his army. He defeated and brought him to Mahismatl and imprisoned him there.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) Proudly he went to Lanka. With his bow and five hundred arrows he overpowered Ravana along with his army. He defeated and brought him to Mahismatl and imprisoned him there.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽसौ सनातनो देवः पुराणे परिपठ्यते । वासुदेवो जगन्नाथः कपिलत्वमुपागतः
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau sanātano devaḥ purāṇe paripaṭhyate / vāsudevo jagannāthaḥ kapilatvamupāgataḥ
verses.translation: (Sage) Pulastya himself went to Arjuna and propitiat¬ ed him. The king released Paulastya (Ravana) at the request of Pulastya.
verses.hindi: कदाचिन्मृगयां यातः प्रसेनस्तेन भूषितः । स्थभन्तककृते सिहाद्वधं प्राप्त: सुदारुणम् 0३ ३ तत्कर्म कृष्णस्प ततो वुष्ण्यन्धकमहत्तरा: । सणो गुध्नुं तु मन्‍्वानास्तसेव विशशद्धिरे
verses.wordMeaning: (Sage) Pulastya himself went to Arjuna and propitiat¬ ed him. The king released Paulastya (Ravana) at the request of Pulastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Sage) Pulastya himself went to Arjuna and propitiat¬ ed him. The king released Paulastya (Ravana) at the request of Pulastya.

verses.sanskrit: पातालं सुतलं नाम तस्यैव नितलं ह्यधः । गभस्तिगं च तस्याधो ह्यन्धतामिस्रमेव च
verses.transliteration: pātālaṃ sutalaṃ nāma tasyaiva nitalaṃ hyadhaḥ / gabhastigaṃ ca tasyādho hyandhatāmisrameva ca
verses.translation: The sound produced by the twang of the bowstrings by his thousand arms was like the thunder at the time of the close of the Yugas, when the trees* of the clouds of dissolution seem to burst.
verses.hindi: मिथ्याभिशस्त तेभ्यस्तां बलवानरिसुदनः । अम्ृष्यम्ाणो भगवान्वनं स विचचार ह
verses.wordMeaning: The sound produced by the twang of the bowstrings by his thousand arms was like the thunder at the time of the close of the Yugas, when the trees* of the clouds of dissolution seem to burst.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sound produced by the twang of the bowstrings by his thousand arms was like the thunder at the time of the close of the Yugas, when the trees* of the clouds of dissolution seem to burst.

verses.sanskrit: पातालं सप्तमं यच्च ह्यधस्तात्संस्थितं महत् । वसते तत्र वै देवः पुराणः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: pātālaṃ saptamaṃ yacca hyadhastātsaṃsthitaṃ mahat / vasate tatra vai devaḥ purāṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Sad indeed that his thousand powerful arms were cut off by Bhargava (Parasurama) in battle, as though they were gol¬ den palm trees.
verses.hindi: स तु प्रसेनो मृगयासचरतत्र चाप्यथ । प्रसेनस्य पर गृह्य पुरुषेराप्तकारिभिः ३३७ अपने पुर में प्रवेश किया । लोग यह समझकर उसके पीछे-पीछे दौड़ने लगे कि यह सूर्य जा रहे हैं।” इस प्रकार नगर निवासियों को तथा अन्तः पुर को उस मणिद्वारा विस्मय विमुग्ध कर राजा शक्रजित ने दिव्य मणि को अपने भाई प्रसेनजित को प्रेमपुर्वक प्रदान कर दिया ।२७-३०। उस स्यथमन्तक भणि के विषय में यह प्रसिद्धि है कि वह जिस राष्ट्र में रहता है, वहाँ सेघ समय समय पर वष्टि करते हैं, और वहाँ व्याधियों का भय नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Sad indeed that his thousand powerful arms were cut off by Bhargava (Parasurama) in battle, as though they were gol¬ den palm trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sad indeed that his thousand powerful arms were cut off by Bhargava (Parasurama) in battle, as though they were gol¬ den palm trees.

verses.sanskrit: स ब्रह्मा स महादेवः स देवो गरुडध्वजः । पूज्यमानः सुरैः सिद्धैस् तिष्ठते ब्रह्मवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: sa brahmā sa mahādevaḥ sa devo garuḍadhvajaḥ / pūjyamānaḥ suraiḥ siddhais tiṣṭhate brahmavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Once upon a time, the thirsty Sun-god begged alms of him.. The Lord of the people bestowed on the Sun-god the seven continents as alms.
verses.hindi: रहता । गोविन्द के मत में उस स्थमस्तक मणि को प्रसेतजित से ले लेने की इच्छा हुई, किश्तु सामथ्य रखते हुए भी उन्होंने उसे प्रसेतजित से छीना नहीं । एक बार कभी उस सुरदर मणि से विभूषित होकर प्रसेनजित शिकार के लिये वन को गये, वहाँ उसी स्यमन्तक के कारण एक सिंह ने उनको मार डाला । रीछराज जाम्बवान ने उस सिह को मार डाला, भौर स्यमन्तक को लेकर अपने बिल में प्रवेश किया। महान् वृष्णि,
verses.wordMeaning: Once upon a time, the thirsty Sun-god begged alms of him.. The Lord of the people bestowed on the Sun-god the seven continents as alms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once upon a time, the thirsty Sun-god begged alms of him.. The Lord of the people bestowed on the Sun-god the seven continents as alms.

verses.sanskrit: वसतस् तस्य राजेन्द्र कपिलस्य जगद्गुरोः । विनाशं चाग्रतः प्राप्ताः क्षणेन सगरात्मजाः
verses.transliteration: vasatas tasya rājendra kapilasya jagadguroḥ / vināśaṃ cāgrataḥ prāptāḥ kṣaṇena sagarātmajāḥ
verses.translation: With a desire to consume (everything), the Sun-god blazed at the tips of his arrows and burnt cities, cowherd colonies, villages and all the towns.
verses.hindi: अन्धकों के वंशजों ने इस हत्या कर्म की शंका कृष्ण के ऊपर की, उसी मणि की लालच से कृष्ण ने ऐसा किया! इस प्रकार की आशंकाएं सबों के मत में हुईं । शत्रुम॒दंत बलवान भगवान् कृष्ण इस सिंथ्या अपवाद को उन लोगों द्वारा सुनकर सहन न कर सक्रे और तुरन्त वन को प्रस्थित हुए ।११-३६। प्रसेनजित जिस स्थान पर शिकार खेलने के लिये गये थे, उसी स्थान को प्रसेन के पदचिन्हों को जानकर लोगों से पता लगाकर अनुसरण करते हुए कृष्ण चले। और इस प्रकार ऋक्षवान् गिरिवर और पव॑तश्रेष्ठ विन्ध्याचल में घूमतै-घूमते वे बहुत परेशान हो गये । वहाँ पर महामनस्वी कृष्ण ने घोड़े समेत प्रसेन को मरा हुआ पाया पर मणि को
verses.wordMeaning: With a desire to consume (everything), the Sun-god blazed at the tips of his arrows and burnt cities, cowherd colonies, villages and all the towns.
verses.commentary: Sense: With a desire to consume (everything), the Sun-god blazed at the tips of his arrows and burnt cities, cowherd colonies, villages and all the towns.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मीभूतांस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा कपिलो मुनिसत्तमः । जगाम परमं शोकं चिन्त्यमानो ऽथ किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmībhūtāṃstu tāndṛṣṭvā kapilo munisattamaḥ / jagāma paramaṃ śokaṃ cintyamāno 'tha kilbiṣam
verses.translation: Thanks to the prowess of that chief of men (Arjuna) the (Sun-god) of great fame burnt the mountains and forests of Kartavirya.
verses.hindi: + एतदर्धस्थान इमे अर्धे --'स्यमन्तकर्माण रत्न धृष्यकं॑ स्व॑ निवेशने! इति ख. पृस्तके  'स्यमम्तकेमर्णि रत्न दुश्यकस्त न्रिवेशने' इति घ. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to the prowess of that chief of men (Arjuna) the (Sun-god) of great fame burnt the mountains and forests of Kartavirya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to the prowess of that chief of men (Arjuna) the (Sun-god) of great fame burnt the mountains and forests of Kartavirya.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसङ्गपरित्यागे चित्ते निर्विषयीकृते । अयुक्तं षष्टिसहस्राणां कर्तं मम विनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvasaṅgaparityāge citte nirviṣayīkṛte / ayuktaṃ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇāṃ kartaṃ mama vināśanam
verses.translation: The Sun-god in the company of Haihaya (Kartavirya) burnt everything including continents along with forests. He burnt the empty hermitage of Varuna's son completely.
verses.hindi: प्ध्र वायुपु राणम् साश्व॑ हतं प्रसेन॑ तं नाविन्दत्तत्र वे मणिम् । अथ सिंहः प्रसेनस्थ शरोरस्थाविदृरतः
verses.wordMeaning: The Sun-god in the company of Haihaya (Kartavirya) burnt everything including continents along with forests. He burnt the empty hermitage of Varuna's son completely.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sun-god in the company of Haihaya (Kartavirya) burnt everything including continents along with forests. He burnt the empty hermitage of Varuna's son completely.

verses.sanskrit: कृतस्य करणं नास्ति तस्मात्पापविनाशनम् । गत्वा तु कापिलं तीर्थं मोचयाम्यघमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: kṛtasya karaṇaṃ nāsti tasmātpāpavināśanam / gatvā tu kāpilaṃ tīrthaṃ mocayāmyaghamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Varuna had obtained this glorious and excellent son formerly. He was famous by the name of sage Vasistha other- wise known as Apava.
verses.hindi: प्रसेनमवर्धीत्सिह: सिहो जाम्बता हतः  सुकुमारक मा रोदीस्तव होष स्यमन्‍्तकः
verses.wordMeaning: Varuna had obtained this glorious and excellent son formerly. He was famous by the name of sage Vasistha other- wise known as Apava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varuna had obtained this glorious and excellent son formerly. He was famous by the name of sage Vasistha other- wise known as Apava.

verses.sanskrit: पातालं तु ततो मुक्त्वा कपिलो मुनिसत्तमः । तपश्चचार सुमहन्नर्मदातटमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: pātālaṃ tu tato muktvā kapilo munisattamaḥ / tapaścacāra sumahannarmadātaṭamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Out of anger the powerful Apava cursed Arjuna then, 1 O Haihaya, since you have not spared this forest of mine another man will set aside even this difficult task achieved by you. He will be Kuntl's son named Arjuna. 2 He will not be a king.
verses.hindi: व्यक्तोकृतं च शब्द त॑ तुर्णं सोडषपि ययौ बिलम्। अपश्यच्च बिलाम्यासे प्रसेनमवदारितम् ॥४ ३ प्रविश्य चापि भगवांस्तदक्षबिलमञ्जसा । ददर्श ऋक्षराजानं जाम्बवन्तमुदारधीः ४४ पुयु्े वासुदेवस्तु बिले जाम्बब॒ता सह । बाहुश्यामेव गोविन्दों दिवसानेर्कावशतिम् प्रविष्टे च बिल कृष्णे वासुदेवपुरः सराः । पुनर्हारवतामेत्य हतं कृष्णं स्यवेदयन्
verses.wordMeaning: Out of anger the powerful Apava cursed Arjuna then, 1 O Haihaya, since you have not spared this forest of mine another man will set aside even this difficult task achieved by you. He will be Kuntl's son named Arjuna. 2 He will not be a king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of anger the powerful Apava cursed Arjuna then, 1 O Haihaya, since you have not spared this forest of mine another man will set aside even this difficult task achieved by you. He will be Kuntl's son named Arjuna. 2 He will not be a king.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतोपवासैर्विविधैः स्नानदानजपादिकैः । परं निर्वाणमापन्नः पूजयन्रुद्रमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: vratopavāsairvividhaiḥ snānadānajapādikaiḥ / paraṃ nirvāṇamāpannaḥ pūjayanrudramavyayam
verses.translation: O Arjuna, the extremely powerful Rama, the fore¬ most among those who strike with weapons, will cut off and shatter your thousand arms. The powerful. Brahmana and Sage of great strength will kill you." Then, as a result of the curse of that intelligent (sage), Rama became the cause of his death.
verses.hindi: वासुदेवस्तु निजित्य जाम्बवन्तं महाबलम् । लेभे जाम्बबतीं कन्यामक्षराजस्थ संमताम् (३४७ भगवत्तेजसा ग्रस्तो जाम्बवान्प्रसभं मणिम् । सुतां जाम्बवती माशु विष्वक्सेनाय दत्तवान् ४८
verses.wordMeaning: O Arjuna, the extremely powerful Rama, the fore¬ most among those who strike with weapons, will cut off and shatter your thousand arms. The powerful. Brahmana and Sage of great strength will kill you." Then, as a result of the curse of that intelligent (sage),…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Arjuna, the extremely powerful Rama, the fore¬ most among those who strike with weapons, will cut off and shatter your thousand arms. The powerful. Brahmana and Sage of great strength will kill you." Then, as a result of the curse of that intelligent (sage),…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम् । गोसहस्रफलं तस्य लभते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet parameśvaram / gosahasraphalaṃ tasya labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Such a boon had been chosen by the king himself for¬ merly (from Datta). He had a hundred sons, five of whom were great warriors..
verses.hindi: नहीं पाया । उसी प्रसेन के शव से थोड़ी दूर सिह को भी मरा हुआ पाया, वहाँ पर रीछ के पद चिद्नों से यह स्पष्ट पता चल रहा था कि रीछ ने सिंह को मारा। तदनस्तर यादव श्रौक्ृष्ण जी ने रीछ के उन्हीं पद चिन्हों से रीछ की गुफा का पता लगाया । उन्होंने उसकी विशाल बिल में स्त्री की आवाज सुनौ  द्विजगण ! जाम्बवान की बिल में उसके लड़के को धाय प्रेमपूर्वक स्ममस्तक मणि को दिखलाकर यह कह रही थी कि 'बेटा मत रोओ' इसके अतिरिक्त वह इस प्रकार की बातें भो कह रही थी
verses.wordMeaning: Such a boon had been chosen by the king himself for¬ merly (from Datta). He had a hundred sons, five of whom were great warriors..
verses.commentary: Sense: Such a boon had been chosen by the king himself for¬ merly (from Datta). He had a hundred sons, five of whom were great warriors..

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठमासे तु सम्प्राप्ते शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दशी । तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन भक्त्या दानं प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhamāse tu samprāpte śuklapakṣe caturdaśī / tatra snātvā vidhānena bhaktyā dānaṃ prayacchati
verses.translation: They were Surasena, Vrstyadya, Vr?a and Jaya- dhvaja. All of them were well-trained in the use of miraculous weapons. They were heroic, strong, pious-souled and re-
verses.hindi: घाय बोली--प्रसेनेजित को सिंह ने मारा, सिंह को जाम्बवान् ने मारा, मेरे सुकुमार बेटे ! तुम मत रोओ । यह स्यमन्‍्तक मणि तुम्हारा है।! धाय की यह वाणी सुनते ही कृष्ण शीक्षतापूर्वक उस बिल में प्रविष्ट हो गये, बिल के समीप ही वे प्रसेनजित् को मारा हुआ देख चुके थे। बिल में शौघ्रतापूर्वक प्रविष्ट होकर परम तेजस्वी उदारबुद्धि भगवान् क्रष्ण ने रीछराज जाम्बवान् कों देखा । और उसी बिल में ही
verses.wordMeaning: They were Surasena, Vrstyadya, Vr?a and Jaya- dhvaja. All of them were well-trained in the use of miraculous weapons. They were heroic, strong, pious-souled and re-
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Surasena, Vrstyadya, Vr?a and Jaya- dhvaja. All of them were well-trained in the use of miraculous weapons. They were heroic, strong, pious-souled and re-

verses.sanskrit: पात्रभूताय विप्राय स्वल्पं वा यदि वा बहु । अक्षयं तत्फलं प्रोक्तं शिवेन परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: pātrabhūtāya viprāya svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu / akṣayaṃ tatphalaṃ proktaṃ śivena parameṣṭhinā
verses.translation: The curse motif and that of boon were very popular with Puraria- writers to explain an unlikely or miraculous, event. Here both are used to explain Kartavirya's death at the hands of Parasurama. Kartavirya is stated to have sought such a boon from Datta (supra v. 13) and received a curse from Apava Vasistha (w. 46-47) for destroying (i.c. helping the Sun-god to destroy) his hermitage.
verses.hindi: जाम्बवान् के साथ वासुदेव का युद्ध प्रारम्भ हो गया, बाहुद्वारा ही गोविन्द ने इक्कीस दिनों तक युद्ध क्रिया । उधर कृष्ण के बिल में प्रविष्ट हो जाने पर जब देरी होने लगी तो उनके साथियों ने द्वारकापुरी में लौटकर यह बात बतलाई कि कृष्ण तो मारे गये। इधर वासुदेव ने महाबलक्षाली रीछराज जाम्बवान को पराजित कर उसकी सम्मति से जाम्बवती नामक सुल्दरी कन्या को प्राप्त किया तेजोबल से अभिभूत होकर जाम्बवान् ने जबरदस्ती अपनी कन्या जाम्बंवती को और स्थमन्‍्तकमणि को
verses.wordMeaning: The curse motif and that of boon were very popular with Puraria- writers to explain an unlikely or miraculous, event. Here both are used to explain Kartavirya's death at the hands of Parasurama. Kartavirya is stated to have sought such a boon from Datta (supra v.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The curse motif and that of boon were very popular with Puraria- writers to explain an unlikely or miraculous, event. Here both are used to explain Kartavirya's death at the hands of Parasurama. Kartavirya is stated to have sought such a boon from Datta (supra v.…

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गारकदिने प्राप्ते चतुर्थ्यां नवमीषु च । स्नानं करोति पुरुषो भक्त्योपोष्य वराङ्गना
verses.transliteration: aṅgārakadine prāpte caturthyāṃ navamīṣu ca / snānaṃ karoti puruṣo bhaktyopoṣya varāṅganā
verses.translation: Apava's curse was of a twofold nature. Kartavirya Arjuna will meet physical death at the hands of Parasurama and he will be superseded in reputation by another Arjuna (Kunti's son) for a similar act (viz. burn¬ ing of Kharujava forest).
verses.hindi: बशंस्व्सुभ्यों भार्यास्यः शत्रुजित्त: शर्त सुताः। स्यातिमन्तस्त्रयस्तेषां भज्ञकारस्तु पुव॑ज: ३४३
verses.wordMeaning: Apava's curse was of a twofold nature. Kartavirya Arjuna will meet physical death at the hands of Parasurama and he will be superseded in reputation by another Arjuna (Kunti's son) for a similar act (viz. burn¬ ing of Kharujava forest).
verses.commentary: Sense: Apava's curse was of a twofold nature. Kartavirya Arjuna will meet physical death at the hands of Parasurama and he will be superseded in reputation by another Arjuna (Kunti's son) for a similar act (viz. burn¬ ing of Kharujava forest).

verses.sanskrit: रूपमैश्वर्यमतुलं सौभाग्यं संततिं पराम् । लभते सप्तजन्मानि नित्यं नित्यं पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: rūpamaiśvaryamatulaṃ saubhāgyaṃ saṃtatiṃ parām / labhate saptajanmāni nityaṃ nityaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: That king had the boon of never losing his wealth.
verses.hindi: अथ द्वारवती नाम भड्कारस्य सुप्रजा:। सुषवे सा कुमारीस्तु तिल्नो रूपगुणान्विताः ३५४ भव्रकारं ततो हत्वा शतधन्वा महाबलः। रात्रौ तं मणिमादाय ततोक्कलूराय दत्तवान् ४८
verses.wordMeaning: That king had the boon of never losing his wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king had the boon of never losing his wealth.

verses.sanskrit: पौर्णमास्याममावास्यां स्नात्वा पिण्डं प्रयच्छति । तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि तृप्ता यान्ति सुरालयम्
verses.transliteration: paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ snātvā piṇḍaṃ prayacchati / tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptā yānti surālayam
verses.translation: Why was the world (hermitage) of the noble-souied Apava burnt by Kartavirya forcibly? 1 Please explain it to us who ask.
verses.hindi: विष्वकसेन भगवान् कृष्ण को समपित कर दिया। भगवान् कृष्ण ने अपने ऊपर फैले हुए अपवादों की शुद्धि के लिये स्यमन्तकमणि को ऋक्षराज जमबवान् से ले लिया और उससे फिर अनुनय विनय कर बिल से बाहर आये इस प्रकार स्यमन्तक मणि को प्राप्त कर उन्होंने अपने पुरुषाथं से अपना अपयश्ञ दूर किया और ले जाकर समस्त सात्वत वंक्षियों के समक्ष श््कोजित को समपित किया । तदनन्तर भगवान् मधुसूदन कृष्ण ने जाम्बवती
verses.wordMeaning: Why was the world (hermitage) of the noble-souied Apava burnt by Kartavirya forcibly? 1 Please explain it to us who ask.
verses.commentary: Sense: Why was the world (hermitage) of the noble-souied Apava burnt by Kartavirya forcibly? 1 Please explain it to us who ask.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या दद्याद्दीपं सुशोभनम् । जायते तस्य राजेन्द्र महादीप्तिः शारीरजा
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā dadyāddīpaṃ suśobhanam / jāyate tasya rājendra mahādīptiḥ śārīrajā
verses.translation: We have heard that the saintly king was a protector of his subjects. Being a guardian, therefore, why did he destroy that hermitage? Aditya (the Sun-god) desirous of satisfaction (of hunger) approached Kartavirya in the guise of a Brahmana (and said), "Please give me food. Undoubtedly I am Adilya."
verses.hindi: से अपना विवाह किया। इस प्रकार उस मिथ्या अपवाद से जनादंन भगवान् क्रृष्ण की मुक्ति हुई भगवान् कृष्ण के ऊपर फेलायी गयी इस् मिथ्या अपक्षीति को दूर करने का वृत्तान्त जो ध्यक्ति जानता है उसे कभी किसी प्रकार से इस प्रकार की मिथ्या अपकीर्ति का भाजन नहीं होना पड़ता। शत्रुजित से उसको दस पत्नियों में जो सब की सब संगी बहिन थीं, एक सौ पुत्र उत्तन्न हुए, उनमें तीन ख्यात हुए, उनमें सब से बड़ा पुत्र भूज़कार था । अन्य दो पुत्रों के नाम बलवान् ब्रतपति तथा सुप्रिय अपस्वान्त थे  भृज्धकार को
verses.wordMeaning: We have heard that the saintly king was a protector of his subjects. Being a guardian, therefore, why did he destroy that hermitage? Aditya (the Sun-god) desirous of satisfaction (of hunger) approached Kartavirya in the guise of a Brahmana (and said), "Please give me food.…
verses.commentary: Sense: We have heard that the saintly king was a protector of his subjects. Being a guardian, therefore, why did he destroy that hermitage? Aditya (the Sun-god) desirous of satisfaction (of hunger) approached Kartavirya in the guise of a Brahmana (and said), "Please give me food.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे मृतानां तु जन्तूनां सर्वदा किल । अनिवर्तिका भवेत्तेषां गतिस्तु शिवमन्दिरात्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu jantūnāṃ sarvadā kila / anivartikā bhavetteṣāṃ gatistu śivamandirāt
verses.translation: Verses 1-13 explain in details again why the hermitage of Apava Vasi?tha was burnt by Kartavirya. As these verses deal with the curse of Apava, they should have formed a part of the last chapter after v. 39. Vv. 1-13 hereof are unrelated to the present chapter (Race of Kro?tii)
