verses.hindi: तमस्कार करते हैं। तप, सत्य, त्याग, शुभ १६९७। अहिसक, अलोभ, सुवेश, अतिशय, सर्वेभृतात्मभूत, योगात्मन् ! तुम्हें हमारा नमस्कार है। पृथ्वी, अन्तरिक्ष, दिव, मह, जन, तप, सध्य प्रभृति लोक स्वरूप भगवन् ! तुम्हें हम नमस्कार करते हैं । अव्यक्त, महानू, भूत, इन्द्रिय, तन्मात्र, महास्त, प्रभृति तत्त्व स्वरूप भगवन् ! तुम्हें नमस्कार है ।!६८-२००। नित्य, लिज्ञ, सूक्ष्म, शुद्ध, विभु, नित्यात्मन् ! तुम्हें हम नमस्कार करते हैं। स्वरन्त तीनों (भू: भुवः और स्वः) एवं सत्यास्त चारों (मह जन, तप और सत्य) महान् लोकों में व्याप्त रहनेवाले भगवन् ! तुम्हें नमस्कार है । विभो ! इस स्तुति में मैंने जो कुछ सदसत् कहा है, उसे यह समझकर कि यह मेरा भक्त है, आप क्षमा कर दे । क्योंकि आप ब्राह्मणों के ऊपर कृपा करने वाले हैं ।२०१-२० ३।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Devas also standing there he reflected over the fate. 2 Remembering the previous incidents, he spoke to them (Asuras):
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Devas also standing there he reflected over the fate. 2 Remembering the previous incidents, he spoke to them (Asuras):

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति सर्वेषाम् अहङ्कारो द्विजन्मनाम् । न पिता पुत्रवाक्येन न पुत्रः पितृकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhṛti sarveṣām ahaṅkāro dvijanmanām / na pitā putravākyena na putraḥ pitṛkarmaṇi
verses.translation: "All the three worlds were conquered by Vamana by means of three paces. Bali was bound. Jambha was killed. Virocana was slain.
verses.hindi: धनुध्ििह्वान्तगंतग्रत्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: "All the three worlds were conquered by Vamana by means of three paces. Bali was bound. Jambha was killed. Virocana was slain.
verses.commentary: Sense: "All the three worlds were conquered by Vamana by means of three paces. Bali was bound. Jambha was killed. Virocana was slain.

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारकृताः सर्वे भविष्यन्ति न संशयः । इति शप्त्वा रमादेवी तदैव च दिवं ययौ
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkārakṛtāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ / iti śaptvā ramādevī tadaiva ca divaṃ yayau
verses.translation: In twelve great and terrible battles they were killed by Suras. By various means most of the important persons have been killed.
verses.hindi: लिषए-ुस्ताह्डाल्म्यव्की स्ते च्वस्त् एवमाराध्य देवेशमोशानं नोलोहितम्। ब्रह्मेति प्रणतस्तस्म प्राआजलिवॉक्यमब्वीत् १ काव्यस्य गात्र संस्पृश्य हस्तेन प्रीतिमान्भवः । निकाम दर्शन दत्त्वा तत्रेवान्तरधीयत
verses.wordMeaning: In twelve great and terrible battles they were killed by Suras. By various means most of the important persons have been killed.
verses.commentary: Sense: In twelve great and terrible battles they were killed by Suras. By various means most of the important persons have been killed.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गतायां वै लक्ष्म्यां देवा ब्रह्मर्षयो ऽमलाः । क्रोधलोभमिदं स्थानं ते ऽपि चोक्त्वा दिवं ययुः
verses.transliteration: tato gatāyāṃ vai lakṣmyāṃ devā brahmarṣayo 'malāḥ / krodhalobhamidaṃ sthānaṃ te 'pi coktvā divaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: Only a few of you have been spared in these latest battles. I shall now employ a great strategy. Please wait for a short while.
verses.hindi: ततः सो5न्तहिते तस्मिन्देवेशानुचरे तदा। तिष्ठन्तीं प्राहुजलिभृत्वा जयन्तोमिदमन्रवीत् ३ कस्य त्वं सुभगे का वा दुःखिते सयि दुःखिता । महता तपसा थुक्त किसर्थ मां” जुगोपसि ढ॑
verses.wordMeaning: Only a few of you have been spared in these latest battles. I shall now employ a great strategy. Please wait for a short while.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only a few of you have been spared in these latest battles. I shall now employ a great strategy. Please wait for a short while.

verses.sanskrit: गतां दृष्ट्वा ततो देवीम् ऋषींश्चैव तपोधनान् । भृगुश्च परमेष्ठी स विषादम् अगमत् परम् । प्रसादयामास पुनः शङ्करं त्रिपुरान्तकम्
verses.transliteration: gatāṃ dṛṣṭvā tato devīm ṛṣīṃścaiva tapodhanān / bhṛguśca parameṣṭhī sa viṣādam agamat param / prasādayāmāsa punaḥ śaṅkaraṃ tripurāntakam
verses.translation: Bd. P. v. 103 reads: samrak$ata samstrastdn 'protected the frightened /(sons of Did)*
verses.hindi: किमिच्छसि वरारोहे कस्ते कामः सम्ृृध्यताम् । त॑ ते संप्रयाम्यद्य यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् ४६ विष्णु-माहात्म्य-कीत॑न
verses.wordMeaning: Bd. P. v. 103 reads: samrak$ata samstrastdn 'protected the frightened /(sons of Did)*
verses.commentary: Sense: Bd. P. v. 103 reads: samrak$ata samstrastdn 'protected the frightened /(sons of Did)*

verses.sanskrit: तपसा महता पार्थ ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः । उवाच वचनं काले हर्षयन् भृगुसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tapasā mahatā pārtha tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ / uvāca vacanaṃ kāle harṣayan bhṛgusattamam
verses.translation: Daivam in Bd. P.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले :--ऋषिव॒न्द ! शुक्राचायं में इस प्रकार नौललोहित देवेश भगवान् शझद्भूर की आराधना कर पुनः प्रमाण किया और हाथ जोड़े हुए ब्रह्म का उच्चारण किया, प्रा्थता से परम प्रसन्न महादेव जी अपने हाथ से शुक्राचार्य के छारीर का स्पर्श कर एवं पर्याप्त दर्शन देकर वहीं अस्तहिंत हो गये । १-२। देवेश के अन्तर्घान हो जाने पर हाथ जोड़कर सामने उपस्थित जयन्ती से शुक्राचायं बोले-- सुन्दरि !
verses.wordMeaning: Daivam in Bd. P.
verses.commentary: Sense: Daivam in Bd. P.

verses.sanskrit: किं विषण्णो ऽसि विप्रेन्द्र किं वा सन्तापकारणम् । मयि प्रसन्ने ऽपि तव ह्येतत्कथय मे ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: kiṃ viṣaṇṇo 'si viprendra kiṃ vā santāpakāraṇam / mayi prasanne 'pi tava hyetatkathaya me 'nagha
verses.translation: I shall go to Mahadeva for acquiring Mantras for the sake of your victory. Brhaspati is performing Homa and wor¬ shipping Agni by means of Mantras.
verses.hindi: तुम किसकी पुत्री हो, मेरे दुःख के समय दुःख उठाने वाली तुम कोन हो ? ऐसी महान् तपस्या में निरत रहकर तुम किस लिए भेरी रक्षा में दत्तचित रही हो  है सुन्दर अंगों बाली, सुश्रोणि ! तुम्हारी इस सबंदा एक रूप रहने वाली भक्ति, कष्टसहिष्णुता, प्रणय और स्मेह से मैं बहुत प्रसन्न हूं । है सुस्दरि ! तुम क्‍या चाहती हो, मैं तुम्हारी किस कामना की पूति करूँ, तुम्हारी जो भी अभिलाषा होगी--चाहे वह अत्यस्त कठिन ही क्‍यों न होगी मैं भाज पूर्ण करना चाहुेगा ।३-६। शुक्राचाये के इस प्रकार कहने पर जयन्ती ने कहा,
verses.wordMeaning: I shall go to Mahadeva for acquiring Mantras for the sake of your victory. Brhaspati is performing Homa and wor¬ shipping Agni by means of Mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall go to Mahadeva for acquiring Mantras for the sake of your victory. Brhaspati is performing Homa and wor¬ shipping Agni by means of Mantras.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुरुवाच: शापयित्वा द्विजान्सर्वान्पुरा लक्ष्मीर्विनिर्गता । अपवित्रमिदं चोक्त्वा ततो देवा विनिर्गताः
verses.transliteration: bhṛguruvāca: śāpayitvā dvijānsarvānpurā lakṣmīrvinirgatā / apavitramidaṃ coktvā tato devā vinirgatāḥ
verses.translation: Hence I shall go unto the lord Nllalohita (Siva) for the sake of Mantras. I shall bless you all after my return.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्ताउन्नवीदेनं तपसा ज्ञातुमहेंसि । चिकीषितं मे ब्रह्मिष्ठ त्वं हि बेत्थ यथातथम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence I shall go unto the lord Nllalohita (Siva) for the sake of Mantras. I shall bless you all after my return.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence I shall go unto the lord Nllalohita (Siva) for the sake of Mantras. I shall bless you all after my return.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: पुरा मया यथा प्रोक्तं तत्तथा न तदन्यथा । क्रोधस्थानम् असंदेहं तथान्यदपि तच्छृणु
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: purā mayā yathā proktaṃ tattathā na tadanyathā / krodhasthānam asaṃdehaṃ tathānyadapi tacchṛṇu
verses.translation: All of you perform penance in the forest clad in bark garments. Dcvas will not kill you until I return.
verses.hindi: देवेन्द्रानलवणभि वरारोहे सुलोचने । इमं वृुणीष्व काम ते मत्तो वे वल्गुभाषिणि १० एवं भवतु गच्छामों गृहान्व मत्तकाशिनि । ततः स्वगूहमागम्प जयन्त्या सहितः प्रभुः स तया संवसेद्देव्या दश वर्षाणि भागशः । अदृश्यः सर्वेभुतानां मायया संवृतस्तदा ..
verses.wordMeaning: All of you perform penance in the forest clad in bark garments. Dcvas will not kill you until I return.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of you perform penance in the forest clad in bark garments. Dcvas will not kill you until I return.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थानसमुद्भूता महद्भयविवर्जिताः । ब्राह्मणा मत्प्रसादेन भविष्यन्ति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tatra sthānasamudbhūtā mahadbhayavivarjitāḥ / brāhmaṇā matprasādena bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: After obtaining the Mantras that will never go against us, from Lord Mahesvara, we shall fight Dcvas again. You will surely gain victory."
verses.hindi: कृताथंमागत॑ दृष्ट्वा काव्यं सर्वे दितेः सुताः॥ अभिजम्सुगृ हूं तस्थ मुदितास्ते दिदुक्षबः १३
verses.wordMeaning: After obtaining the Mantras that will never go against us, from Lord Mahesvara, we shall fight Dcvas again. You will surely gain victory."
verses.commentary: Sense: After obtaining the Mantras that will never go against us, from Lord Mahesvara, we shall fight Dcvas again. You will surely gain victory."

verses.sanskrit: वेदविद्याव्रतस्नाताः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदाः । ये ऽपि ते शतसाहस्रास्त्वरिता ह्यागतास्त्विह
verses.transliteration: vedavidyāvratasnātāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ / ye 'pi te śatasāhasrāstvaritā hyāgatāstviha
verses.translation: After deliberating thus Asuras spoke to Devas:
verses.hindi: बृहस्पतिस्तु संरुद्ध ज्ञात्वा काव्य चकार हू । पिन्नर्थ दश वर्षाणि जयन्त्या हिंतकाम्यया १५ बुद्ध्वा तदन्तरं सो5थ देत्यानामिव चोदितः । काव्यस्य रूपमास्थाय सोसुरान्समभाषत १६ ततः समागतान्दृष्ट्वा बृहस्पतिरुवाच तान्। स्वागत मस याज्यानां संप्राप्तोईइस्सि हिताय च
verses.wordMeaning: After deliberating thus Asuras spoke to Devas:
verses.commentary: Sense: After deliberating thus Asuras spoke to Devas:

verses.sanskrit: अपठस्यापि मूर्खस्य सर्वावस्थां गतस्य च । उत्तरादुत्तरं शक्रो दातुं न तु भृगूत्तम
verses.transliteration: apaṭhasyāpi mūrkhasya sarvāvasthāṃ gatasya ca / uttarāduttaraṃ śakro dātuṃ na tu bhṛgūttama
verses.translation: Then Kavya said to them: "Wait for some time per¬ forming penance without enthusiasm, waiting for an opportunity to achieve the object in view. All Devas including Vasava are in my father's hermitage."*
verses.hindi: वनगानगान का. १०५०० पिनियाययाण + नल + विन“ ००7“
verses.wordMeaning: Then Kavya said to them: "Wait for some time per¬ forming penance without enthusiasm, waiting for an opportunity to achieve the object in view. All Devas including Vasava are in my father's hermitage."*
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Kavya said to them: "Wait for some time per¬ forming penance without enthusiasm, waiting for an opportunity to achieve the object in view. All Devas including Vasava are in my father's hermitage."*

verses.sanskrit: कोटितीर्थम् इदं स्थानं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । अद्यप्रभृति विप्रेन्द्र भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: koṭitīrtham idaṃ sthānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / adyaprabhṛti viprendra bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: After instructing Asuras thus, Kavya approached Mahadeva. After bowing to the lord, the cause of origin of the universe, he said:
verses.hindi: ब्रद्मज्ञानी ब्रह्म ! मेरे मनोरथ को आप अपने तपोबल से जान सकते हैं, मेरी सारी अभिलाषाओं को आप जानते हैं।' जयन्ती के ऐसा कहने पर शुक्राचायं ने अपने दिव्य दृष्टि द्वारा उसके मनोश्थों को जानकर बोले, 'इन्द्रपुत्रि  सुन्दरि, तुम यहां मेरी रक्षा के लिए भाई हुई थी, है भामिनि : सुश्रोणि  मेरे साथ दस वर्षों तक सभी प्राणियों से अदृश्य रहकर तुम निवास करना चाहती हो, देवेन्द्रपुत्रि ! अग्ति के समान गौरवर्ण वाली ! सुन्दरि, सुलोचने ! भृदुभाषिणि ! अपने इस मनोरथ की मुझसे पूण॑ता प्राप्त करोगी। तुम्हारा मनोरथ सफल होगा। मत्त चाल चलने वाली ! चलो, अब हम अपने निवास को चल रहे हैं ।! इस प्रकार जयन्ती से बातें कर भगवान् शुक्राचायं अपने निवास स्थल पर आये और समल्त्र प्राणधारियों से अदृद्य होकर मायापूर्वक दश वर्षों तक उसके साथ निवास करने का निदंचय किया ।७-१२। इधर
verses.wordMeaning: After instructing Asuras thus, Kavya approached Mahadeva. After bowing to the lord, the cause of origin of the universe, he said:
verses.commentary: Sense: After instructing Asuras thus, Kavya approached Mahadeva. After bowing to the lord, the cause of origin of the universe, he said:

verses.sanskrit: मत्प्रसादाद्देवगणैः सेवितं च भविष्यति । भृगुक्षेत्रे मृता ये तु कृमिकीटपतंगकाः
verses.transliteration: matprasādāddevagaṇaiḥ sevitaṃ ca bhaviṣyati / bhṛgukṣetre mṛtā ye tu kṛmikīṭapataṃgakāḥ
verses.translation: "O lord, I wish to secure such Mantras as are not in the possession of Brhaspati. I want them to be the bestowers of fearlessness on Asuras. I wish to defeat Devas.
verses.hindi: शुक्राचायं को सफल मनोरथ होकर लौट आने का वृत्तान्त जब देत्यों को विदित हुआ तो वे परम प्रसन्न हुए और देखने की इच्छा से उनके आश्रम पर गये । वहाँ जाने पर जयन्ती के साथ अज्ञात वास करते हुए अपने आचाये को नहीं देख सके, और उनकी इस नीतिनिपुणता को जानकर परम मुदित हुए। उधर देवगुरु बृहस्पति ने जब यह सुना कि देवताओं की हितकारिणी जयल्ती ने अपने पिता की हितकामना से
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, I wish to secure such Mantras as are not in the possession of Brhaspati. I want them to be the bestowers of fearlessness on Asuras. I wish to defeat Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, I wish to secure such Mantras as are not in the possession of Brhaspati. I want them to be the bestowers of fearlessness on Asuras. I wish to defeat Devas.

verses.sanskrit: वासस् तेषां शिवे लोके मत्प्रसादाद् भविष्यति । वृषखाते नरः स्नात्वा पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vāsas teṣāṃ śive loke matprasādād bhaviṣyati / vṛṣakhāte naraḥ snātvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram
verses.translation: Thus requested, the lord said: "O Brahmana! do you wish for the Mantras? Perform then the holy rites indicated by me, with purity of mind and observing celibacy.
verses.hindi: दस वर्षों के लिए शुक्राचायं के पास गई थी, शुक्राचायं को एकान्तवास करते सुना तो एक अच्छा अवसर देखा ।१३-१५)। उन्होंने शुक्राचायं का स्वरूप बनाकर, इस मुद्रा में मानों देत्यों ने उन्हें ही तपस्या के लिए प्रेरित किया था, शुक्राचायं के दर्शन करने के लिए आये हुए असुरों से कहा- मेरे यजमानों का स्वागत है, तुम लोगों के हित के लिए मैं तपस्या से निवत्त होकर आ गया। मैंने वह विद्या, जिसकी प्राप्ति के लिए अष्ट्नवतितमीअध्याय। है ०७
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested, the lord said: "O Brahmana! do you wish for the Mantras? Perform then the holy rites indicated by me, with purity of mind and observing celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested, the lord said: "O Brahmana! do you wish for the Mantras? Perform then the holy rites indicated by me, with purity of mind and observing celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् । भृगुतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: sarvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam / bhṛgutīrthe naraḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: For full thousand years you must stay in a topsy turvy position inhaling the smoke from the holy sacrificial fire-pit. Welfare unto you. If you perform (a sacred tite) like this, you will obtain the Mantra from me."
verses.hindi: पूर्व काम्य (व्य) स्तदा तस्मिन्समये दशवा्िके । ययौ च समकालं स सद्योत्पन्नमतिस्तदा
verses.wordMeaning: For full thousand years you must stay in a topsy turvy position inhaling the smoke from the holy sacrificial fire-pit. Welfare unto you. If you perform (a sacred tite) like this, you will obtain the Mantra from me."
verses.commentary: Sense: For full thousand years you must stay in a topsy turvy position inhaling the smoke from the holy sacrificial fire-pit. Welfare unto you. If you perform (a sacred tite) like this, you will obtain the Mantra from me."

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि शान्तिं गच्छन्ति तर्पिताः । दधिक्षीरेण तोयेन घृतेन मधुना सह
verses.transliteration: tasya te dvādaśābdāni śāntiṃ gacchanti tarpitāḥ / dadhikṣīreṇa toyena ghṛtena madhunā saha
verses.translation: Thus advised by the lord of Devas, Sukra of great penance, touched the feet of the lord and said: "Yes, my lord I shall perform the holy rites and observe all the other things as instructed." Then he was engaged by the lord in¬ haling the smoke from the holy fire-pit.
verses.hindi: समयान्‍्ते देवयानी सद्योजाता सुता तदा। बुद्धि चक्र ततश्रवापि याज्यानां प्रत्यवेक्षणे १२० देवि गच्छामहे द्रष्टु तव याज्याञ्शुचिस्मिते । वि आन्तप्रेक्षिते साध्वि त्रिवर्णायतलोचने
verses.wordMeaning: Thus advised by the lord of Devas, Sukra of great penance, touched the feet of the lord and said: "Yes, my lord I shall perform the holy rites and observe all the other things as instructed." Then he was engaged by the lord in¬ haling the smoke from the holy fire-pit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus advised by the lord of Devas, Sukra of great penance, touched the feet of the lord and said: "Yes, my lord I shall perform the holy rites and observe all the other things as instructed." Then he was engaged by the lord in¬ haling the smoke from the holy fire-pit.

verses.sanskrit: ये स्नपन्ति विरूपाक्षं तेषां वासस्त्रिविष्टपे । मत्प्रसादाद् द्विजश्रेष्ठ सर्वदेवानुसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: ye snapanti virūpākṣaṃ teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape / matprasādād dvijaśreṣṭha sarvadevānusevitam
verses.translation: When Sukra had gone to Mahesvara and was staying there observing celibacy for the acquisition of the Man¬ tras with the welfare of Asuras in view, Devas understood that the kingdom was set aside by Asuras as a measure of strategy. Finding that loophole, the infuriated Devas attacked them. They had sharp weapons in their hands and Brhaspati led them all.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्ता5ब्रवीदेवी भज भक्तान्महात्रत  एप ब्र ह्वास्सतां धर्मो न धर्म लोपयामि ते १२२
verses.wordMeaning: When Sukra had gone to Mahesvara and was staying there observing celibacy for the acquisition of the Man¬ tras with the welfare of Asuras in view, Devas understood that the kingdom was set aside by Asuras as a measure of strategy. Finding that loophole,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When Sukra had gone to Mahesvara and was staying there observing celibacy for the acquisition of the Man¬ tras with the welfare of Asuras in view, Devas understood that the kingdom was set aside by Asuras as a measure of strategy. Finding that loophole,…

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यति भृगुक्षेत्रं कुरुक्षेत्रादिभिः समम् । मार्तण्डग्रहणे प्राप्ते यवं कृत्वा हिरण्मयम्
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyati bhṛgukṣetraṃ kurukṣetrādibhiḥ samam / mārtaṇḍagrahaṇe prāpte yavaṃ kṛtvā hiraṇmayam
verses.translation: On seeing Devas armed with weapons again Asuras became frightened and fled suddenly.
verses.hindi: ततो गत्वाउसुरान्दृष्द्वा देवाचायेंण धीमता । वन्धितान्काव्यरूपेण वेधसा5सुरमब्नवीत् २३ काव्य मां तात जानीध्वमेष ह्याड्िरसो भुवि  वड्िचिता बत यूयं वे सयि शक्ते तु दातनवाः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Devas armed with weapons again Asuras became frightened and fled suddenly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Devas armed with weapons again Asuras became frightened and fled suddenly.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा शिरसि यः स्नाति भृगुक्षेत्रे द्विजोत्तम । अविचारेण तं विद्धि संस्नातं कुरुजाङ्गले
verses.transliteration: dattvā śirasi yaḥ snāti bhṛgukṣetre dvijottama / avicāreṇa taṃ viddhi saṃsnātaṃ kurujāṅgale
verses.translation: "We have laid down our weapons and conceded victory unto them. Our preceptor is observing holy rites. Devas have abrogated the terms of agreement. They are desirous of slaying us, (their) enemies. Welfare unto you all, we arc now without a preceptor (to guide us). We had been credulous. We remained quiet performing penances. We are clad in bark and coarse garments. We have no holy rite. We have nothing to grasp and hold on to. By no means are we able to conquer Devas in war. In this nasty situation* it is better that wc seek refuge in the mother of Kavya.
verses.hindi: इतना कठोर तप करना पड़ा, पा ली है, उसे तुम सब को पढ़ाऊँगां ।” बृहस्पति की ऐसी बातें सुनकर देत्यगण बहुत प्रसन्न हुए और विद्याध्ययन के लिए वहाँ एकत्र हुए। जयल्ती के अनुरोधानुसार इस दस वर्ष की अवधि के पूर्ण होने पर शुक्राचायं का मोह नष्ट हुआा और उन्हें सदबुद्धि प्राप्त हुई, अवधि के अन्त में जयन्ती के संयोग से उनकी पुत्री देवयानी उत्पन्न हुई। तदनन्तर उन्होंने अपने यजमानों की देखभाल करने का
verses.wordMeaning: "We have laid down our weapons and conceded victory unto them. Our preceptor is observing holy rites. Devas have abrogated the terms of agreement. They are desirous of slaying us, (their) enemies. Welfare unto you all, we arc now without a preceptor (to guide us).…
verses.commentary: Sense: "We have laid down our weapons and conceded victory unto them. Our preceptor is observing holy rites. Devas have abrogated the terms of agreement. They are desirous of slaying us, (their) enemies. Welfare unto you all, we arc now without a preceptor (to guide us).…

verses.sanskrit: अहं चैव वसिष्यामि अम्बिका च मम प्रिया । सर्वदुःखापहा देवी नाम्ना सौभाग्यसुन्दरी
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ caiva vasiṣyāmi ambikā ca mama priyā / sarvaduḥkhāpahā devī nāmnā saubhāgyasundarī
verses.translation: We shall wait here till the return of the preceptor. We shall tell him everything. When Kavya returns we shall fight with Suras."
verses.hindi: शुक्र बोले :--शुचिस्मिते  देवि ! साध्वि ! दीघनेत्रे ! सुन्दर प्रेक्षणे ! मैं अब तुम्हारे यजमानों को देखने के लिए जाना चाहता हूँ।' शुक्राचार्य के ऐसा कहने पर जयन्ती ने कहा, महात्रत ! अपने भक्तों का कल्याण कीजिये, सत्पुरुषों का यही धमम है, आपके धर्म को मैं नष्ट नहीं करूँगी ।३१-२२॥। सूत बोले :--इस प्रकार जयम्ती से बातें कर श॒ुक्राचायं ने जाकर असुरों को देखा कि उन्हें परम बुद्धिमान् देवताओं के गुरु बृहस्पति ने मेरा स्वरूप धारण कर ठग लिया है। ऐसा देखकर वे परम विस्मित होकर अपुरों से बोले, दानवो ! शुक्राचार्य तो मैं हैँ, यह तो अंगिरा का पुत्र बृहस्पति है, मुझे खेद है कि मेरे रहते हुए भी तुम लोग ठगे गये । शुक्राचायं को ऐसा कहते हुए देखकर देत्यगण किकर्तव्य-
verses.wordMeaning: We shall wait here till the return of the preceptor. We shall tell him everything. When Kavya returns we shall fight with Suras."
verses.commentary: Sense: We shall wait here till the return of the preceptor. We shall tell him everything. When Kavya returns we shall fight with Suras."

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्यामि तया देव्या सहितो भृगुकच्छके । एवमुक्त्वा स्थितो देवो भृगुकच्छे ऽम्बिका तथा
verses.transliteration: vasiṣyāmi tayā devyā sahito bhṛgukacchake / evamuktvā sthito devo bhṛgukacche 'mbikā tathā
verses.translation: Saying this to one another, they sought shelter with the mother of Kavya. They had been frightened but the boon of fearlessness was offered unto them as they sought shelter. (The mother of Kavya said:) "O Danavas, do not be afraid, do not be afraid. Cast off all fear. You need not be afraid as long as you are with me." On seeing 'Asuras frightened, Devas pursued them earnestly without caring for strength or weakness. On seeing the frightened Asuras being harassed by Devas, the gentle lady (the mother of Kavya) became infu¬ riated and said to them: "I shall cause Anindratva (the state of
verses.hindi: विमूढ़ हो गये, और वहीं पर परम लिन्न एवं विस्मत होकर दोनों गुरुओं की ओर देखने लगे। बड़ी देर
verses.wordMeaning: Saying this to one another, they sought shelter with the mother of Kavya. They had been frightened but the boon of fearlessness was offered unto them as they sought shelter. (The mother of Kavya said:) "O Danavas, do not be afraid, do not be afraid. Cast off all fear.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying this to one another, they sought shelter with the mother of Kavya. They had been frightened but the boon of fearlessness was offered unto them as they sought shelter. (The mother of Kavya said:) "O Danavas, do not be afraid, do not be afraid. Cast off all fear.…

verses.sanskrit: भृगुस्तु स्वपुरं प्रायाद्ब्रह्मघोषनिनादितम् । ऋग्यजुःसामघोषेण ह्यथर्वणनिनादितम्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgustu svapuraṃ prāyādbrahmaghoṣanināditam / ṛgyajuḥsāmaghoṣeṇa hyatharvaṇanināditam
verses.translation: On seeing Indra in that helpless condition after being rendered motionless like the sacrificial post, Devas became afraid and fied from there.
verses.hindi: संप्रमुढा: स्थिताः सर्वे प्रापद्चन्त न किचन । ततस्तेषु प्रमूढेषु काव्यस्तान्पुनरत्रवीतू.. आचार्यों वो ह्हें काव्यो देवाचार्योडयमड्िराः । अनुगच्छत गां सर्वे त्यजतनं बृहस्पतिम
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Indra in that helpless condition after being rendered motionless like the sacrificial post, Devas became afraid and fied from there.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Indra in that helpless condition after being rendered motionless like the sacrificial post, Devas became afraid and fied from there.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा वृषमुत्सृजते नरः । स याति शिवसायुज्यमित्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vṛṣamutsṛjate naraḥ / sa yāti śivasāyujyamityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: When the groups of Suras had gone, Visnu said to Indra: "O lord of Suras, welfare unto you. Enter me. I shall take you away."
verses.hindi: बृहस्पतिरवाचेतानसंभ्रान्तो 5यमज़िरा: । काव्यो5हं वो गुरुदेत्या मद्र॒पोड्यं ब्रहस्पतिः २६ स मोहयति रूपेण मामकेनेष बो5सुराः । श्रुत्वा तस्य ततस्ते वे संमन्‍्त्यार्थवचो5ब्रवीत् ३० अय॑ नो दश वर्षाणि सततं शास्ति वे प्रभु :। एप वे गुरुरस्माकमन्तरेप्सुरयं ह्विज:
verses.wordMeaning: When the groups of Suras had gone, Visnu said to Indra: "O lord of Suras, welfare unto you. Enter me. I shall take you away."
verses.commentary: Sense: When the groups of Suras had gone, Visnu said to Indra: "O lord of Suras, welfare unto you. Enter me. I shall take you away."

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा चैत्रे मासि समाचरेत् । दद्याच्च लवणं विप्रे पूज्य सौभाग्यसुन्दरीम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā caitre māsi samācaret / dadyācca lavaṇaṃ vipre pūjya saubhāgyasundarīm
verses.translation: Thus advised Purandara (Indra) entered Visnu. On seeing him saved by Visnu, the infuriated lady spoke these words:
verses.hindi: ततस्ते दानवाः सर्वे प्रणिपत्याभिवाद्य च। बचन जगृहुस्तस्थ चिराभ्यासेन मोहिताः तक इसी प्रकार से अश्षान में पड़े रहे, किसी भी निश्चय पर नहों पहुँच सके  हैह्यों के किकत्तव्यविमृढ़ हो जाने पर शुक्राचायं ने पुत: उनसे कहा, अरे दानवों ! तुम लोगों का आचार्य शुक्र मैं ही हूं, यह अंगिरा का पुत्र देवताओं का गुरु बृहस्पति है, मेरी आज्ञा मानो, इसके कहने में न आवो, इसको छोड़ो । शुक्राचार्य के इस प्रकार कहने पर भी सब दानवगण दोनों आचारयों की ओर देखते ही रह गये, उन्हें उन दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: Thus advised Purandara (Indra) entered Visnu. On seeing him saved by Visnu, the infuriated lady spoke these words:
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus advised Purandara (Indra) entered Visnu. On seeing him saved by Visnu, the infuriated lady spoke these words:

verses.sanskrit: गोभूहिरण्यं विप्रेभ्यः प्रीयेतां ललिताशिवौ । न दुःखं दुर्भगत्वं च वियोगं पतिना सह
verses.transliteration: gobhūhiraṇyaṃ viprebhyaḥ prīyetāṃ lalitāśivau / na duḥkhaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca viyogaṃ patinā saha
verses.translation: "O Maghavan, here itself I will burn you down along with Visnu even as all the living beings observe. May the power of my penance be witnessed."
verses.hindi: में कोई विशेषता नहीं जान पड़ी ।२३-२८। तदुपरान्‍्त बिना किसी घबराहट के स्वाभाविक स्वर में बृहस्पति बोले, हैत्यो! धतुम लोगों के गुरु शुक्राचायं हमीं हैं, यह मेरा स्वरूप धारण कर अंगिरा पुत्र बृहस्पति है। अरे असुरो ! मेरा, स्वरूप घारण कर यह तुम लोगों को मोहित कर रहा है।' बृहस्पति की ऐसी बातें सुनकर वेत्यों ने आपस में सम्मति करके निरचय पूवंक यह वचन कहा--परम ऐश्वयंशाली यही
verses.wordMeaning: "O Maghavan, here itself I will burn you down along with Visnu even as all the living beings observe. May the power of my penance be witnessed."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Maghavan, here itself I will burn you down along with Visnu even as all the living beings observe. May the power of my penance be witnessed."

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नोति नारी राजेन्द्र भृगुतीर्थाप्लवेन च । यस्तु नित्यं भृगुं देवं पश्येद्वै पाण्डुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: prāpnoti nārī rājendra bhṛgutīrthāplavena ca / yastu nityaṃ bhṛguṃ devaṃ paśyedvai pāṇḍunandana
verses.translation: The lords Indra and Visnu, on being oppressed by her, conversed (under their breath). Visnu asked Indra—"How can both of us get free jointly?".
verses.hindi: हमें आज दस वर्षों से पढ़ाते आ रहे हैं अतः यह्दी हमारे वास्तविक ग्रुरु हैं, यह ब्राह्मण हम लोगों के. भेद को जानने की इच्छा से यहाँ कंत्रिम वेश धारणकर आया हुआ है।” इस प्रकार कह कर चिरकाल के अभ्यास से मोह को प्राप्त होने वाले उवब समस्त असुरगणों ने पुनः बृहस्पति को ही शुक्राचायं समझकर प्रणाम ओर अभिवादन किया और उन्हीं की बातें अंगीकार कीं। इतना ही नहीं, शुक्राचयं के ऊपर वे परमर्तृद्ध हो गये उनके नेन्न लाल हो आये, और वे आवेश में भरकर बोले, हमारे कल्याण के चाहनेवाले आचार्य यही हैं, तुम हमारे आचार्य नहीं हो, यहाँ से चले जाओ ।२९-३३। यह चाहे भृगु के पुत्र शुक्राचाय हों या अंगिरा के पुत्र बृहस्पति हों, यही अब हमारे गुर हैं, हम सब अब इन्हीं के भादेश में स्थित हैं, तुम यहाँ से चले जाओ, देर मत करो, इसी में तुम्हारी भलाई है। ऐसा कहकर हैत्यगण बृहस्पति के समीप
verses.wordMeaning: The lords Indra and Visnu, on being oppressed by her, conversed (under their breath). Visnu asked Indra—"How can both of us get free jointly?".
verses.commentary: Sense: The lords Indra and Visnu, on being oppressed by her, conversed (under their breath). Visnu asked Indra—"How can both of us get free jointly?".

verses.sanskrit: आ ब्रह्मसदनं यावत्तत्रस्थैर्दैवतैः सह । यत्फलं समवाप्नोति तच्छृणुष्व नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: ā brahmasadanaṃ yāvattatrasthairdaivataiḥ saha / yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpottama
verses.translation: Indra replied: cc O lord, kill her before she burns us both. Especially I have been attacked. Hence, kill her. Do not delay."
verses.hindi: चले आये। इस प्रकार शुक्र चार्य की महान् कल्याणकारिणी बातों की अवज्ञाकर जब हैत्यगण उनके
verses.wordMeaning: Indra replied: cc O lord, kill her before she burns us both. Especially I have been attacked. Hence, kill her. Do not delay."
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra replied: cc O lord, kill her before she burns us both. Especially I have been attacked. Hence, kill her. Do not delay."

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णशृङ्गीं कपिलां पयस्विनीं साध्वीं सुशीलां तरुणीं सवत्साम् । दत्त्वा द्विजे सर्वव्रतोपपन्ने फलं च यत्स्यात्तदिहैव नूनम्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ kapilāṃ payasvinīṃ sādhvīṃ suśīlāṃ taruṇīṃ savatsām / dattvā dvije sarvavratopapanne phalaṃ ca yatsyāttadihaiva nūnam
verses.translation: Then on seeing her (thus intending to kill them) Visiu got ready (even) to kill that woman. Caught in adverse cii- cumstances, the lord hurriedly remembered his discus.
verses.hindi: चुकोप भाग॑वस्तेषामवलेपेन वे तदा । बोधिता5पि मया यस्मान्न मां भजत दानवाः 0३६ तस्मात्प्रनष्टसंज्ञा वे पराभव गसिष्यथ । इति व्याहृत्य तान्काव्यों जगामाथ सथागतम् ३३७ ज्ञात्वाइभिशस्तानसुरान्काव्येन तु बृहस्पतिः । कृतार्थ: स तदा हृष्टः स्वरूप प्रत्यपद्यत ॥ ततो5सुराः परित्रस्ता वेवेभ्यस्त्वरिता ययुः । प्रह्लादमग्नतः कृत्वा काव्यस्थानुगर्म पुनः ॥३४ १ ततः काव्यं समासाञ्य अभितस्थुरवाइःमुखा:  तानागतास्पुनदु ष्ट्वा काव्यों याज्यानुबाच हु
verses.wordMeaning: Then on seeing her (thus intending to kill them) Visiu got ready (even) to kill that woman. Caught in adverse cii- cumstances, the lord hurriedly remembered his discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then on seeing her (thus intending to kill them) Visiu got ready (even) to kill that woman. Caught in adverse cii- cumstances, the lord hurriedly remembered his discus.

verses.sanskrit: समाः सहस्राणि तु सप्त वै जले म्रियेल् लभेद् द्वादशवह्निमध्ये । त्यजंस्तनुं शूरवृत्त्या नरेन्द्र शक्रातिथ्यं याति वै मर्त्यधर्मा
verses.transliteration: samāḥ sahasrāṇi tu sapta vai jale mriyel labhed dvādaśavahnimadhye / tyajaṃstanuṃ śūravṛttyā narendra śakrātithyaṃ yāti vai martyadharmā
verses.translation: While she was hastening to kill them, the discus (Sudarsana), the destroyer of the enemies of Suras, hastened still more. On realising the ruthless attempt of the woman (tne mother of Kavya) Visnu became furious. Taking up that we apon the husband of Ma (i.e. LaksmI) cutoffhcr head.
verses.hindi: मया5पि बोधिताः काले यतो मां नाभिनन्‍्दथ । ततस्तेनावलेपेन गता यूयें पराभवम् ..
verses.wordMeaning: While she was hastening to kill them, the discus (Sudarsana), the destroyer of the enemies of Suras, hastened still more. On realising the ruthless attempt of the woman (tne mother of Kavya) Visnu became furious. Taking up that we apon the husband of Ma (i.e.…
verses.commentary: Sense: While she was hastening to kill them, the discus (Sudarsana), the destroyer of the enemies of Suras, hastened still more. On realising the ruthless attempt of the woman (tne mother of Kavya) Visnu became furious. Taking up that we apon the husband of Ma (i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: आख्यानमेतच्च सदा यशस्यं स्वर्ग्यं धन्यं पुत्र्यमायुष्यकारि । शृण्वंल्लभेत्सर्वमेतद्धि भक्त्या पर्वणि पर्वण्याजमीढस् सदैव
verses.transliteration: ākhyānametacca sadā yaśasyaṃ svargyaṃ dhanyaṃ putryamāyuṣyakāri / śṛṇvaṃllabhetsarvametaddhi bhaktyā parvaṇi parvaṇyājamīḍhas sadaiva
verses.translation: On seeing that terrible slaughter of a woman (his wife) the holy lord Bhrgu became furious. Then Vi?nu was cen¬ sured and cursed by Bhrgu for the murder of his wife.
verses.hindi: पास नहीं गये तब शुक्राचायं उनके गब से परम कुपित हो उठे और बोले, “अरे दानवो! मेरे बहुत समझाने पर भी तुम लोग मेरे कहने में नहीं आ रहे हो, अतः तुम सब की चेतना मारी जायग्री भोर निशूचय ही तुम्हारी पराजय होगी । देत्यों को ऐसा शाप देकर शुक्राचायं जहाँ से जेसे आये थे चले गये । इधर शुक्राचाय द्वारा उन असुरों को दूषित एवं शापग्रस्त जानकर बृहस्पति अपने उद्देश में सफल हो गये, उन्हें परम प्रसन्नता प्राप्त हुई, और वे अपने वास्तविक स्परूप में आ गये  जब उन्होंने समझ लिया कि असुरभण अपनी उद्देश्यसिद्धि में विफल हो चुके हैं, तब अपने को कृतार्थ समझकर अन्‍्तहित दो भये। ।१४-३८। इस प्रकार बृहस्पति के अस्तर्धाव हो जाने पर दानवगण परम व्याकुल हो गये ओर आपस में कहने लगे कि 'हाय उसने हम लोगों को ठग लिया, हमें घिककार है ।३६। हम लोग अपने कत्तंव्य से विमुख हो
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that terrible slaughter of a woman (his wife) the holy lord Bhrgu became furious. Then Vi?nu was cen¬ sured and cursed by Bhrgu for the murder of his wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that terrible slaughter of a woman (his wife) the holy lord Bhrgu became furious. Then Vi?nu was cen¬ sured and cursed by Bhrgu for the murder of his wife.

verses.sanskrit: संन्यासं कुरुते यस्तु भृगुतीर्थे विधानतः । स मृतः परमं स्थानं गच्छेद्वै यच्च दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yastu bhṛgutīrthe vidhānataḥ / sa mṛtaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ gacchedvai yacca durlabham
verses.translation: "Since (according to Dharma) a woman should not be killed and that you have killed one even though you are con¬ versant with what is Dharma, you will have to take birth
verses.hindi: गये, विधाता ने हमें पीछे से दण्ड दिया, अपने प्रयोजन की सिद्धि के लिए देवगुरु ने माया करके हमें छल लिया, इस तरह हम लोग नष्ट हो गये ।४०। ऐसी बातें परस्पर करते हुए असुरगण देवताओं से परम संत्रस्त होकर भाग खड़े हुए और प्रह्लाद को अग्रुआ बनाकर पुनः शुक्राचायं के पीछे-पीछे दौड़े, मोर शुक्राचार्य के समीप जाकर नीचे मुखकर के खड़े हो गये। शुक्राचायं ने अपने यजमानों को पुनः अपनी शरण में
verses.wordMeaning: "Since (according to Dharma) a woman should not be killed and that you have killed one even though you are con¬ versant with what is Dharma, you will have to take birth
verses.commentary: Sense: "Since (according to Dharma) a woman should not be killed and that you have killed one even though you are con¬ versant with what is Dharma, you will have to take birth

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा भृगुश्रेष्ठो देवदेवेन भाषितम् । प्रहृष्टवदनो भूत्वा तत्रैव संस्थितो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā bhṛguśreṣṭho devadevena bhāṣitam / prahṛṣṭavadano bhūtvā tatraiva saṃsthito dvijaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, as a result of that curse he incarnates again and again in the world (of mortals) for the we are o a, whenever virtue (Dharma) declines. Thus addressed with the emphasis on truth, the gentle lady regained her life. Then he sprinkled her with cool water and uttered, "Get up".
verses.hindi: आया हुआ देखकर उनसे कहा, देत्यों! ठोक समय पर मैंने तुम लोगों को समझाया बुझावा था; परन्तु तुम लोगों ने मेरी एक बात गी नहीं भानी, अतः उसी अभिमान के कारण तुम लोग पराजय को प्राप्त हो रहे हो ।४१-४३। शुक्राचायं की ऐसी बात सुनकर प्रह्लाद ने कहा, भृगुनन्दन ! आप भमर्ष छोड़ दें, अपने यजमान विशेषतया परमभक्त एवं अनुगामी असुरों को बचाइये । आपने हुम लोगों को समय समय त्वया पृष्ठा बय॑ं तेन देवाचायेंण मोहिताः । भक्तानहँसि नस्त्नातुं ज्ञात्वा दीघेंण चक्षुषा ४५
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, as a result of that curse he incarnates again and again in the world (of mortals) for the we are o a, whenever virtue (Dharma) declines. Thus addressed with the emphasis on truth, the gentle lady regained her life. Then he sprinkled her with cool water and uttered,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, as a result of that curse he incarnates again and again in the world (of mortals) for the we are o a, whenever virtue (Dharma) declines. Thus addressed with the emphasis on truth, the gentle lady regained her life. Then he sprinkled her with cool water and uttered,…

verses.sanskrit: तिरोभावं गते देवे भृगुः श्रेष्ठो द्विजोत्तमः । स्वमूर्ति तत्र मुक्त्वा तु ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम ह
verses.transliteration: tirobhāvaṃ gate deve bhṛguḥ śreṣṭho dvijottamaḥ / svamūrti tatra muktvā tu brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha
verses.translation: On seeing her getting up as if from sleep, all living beings loudly applauded "Well done! Well done!" Such an applause of invisible (incorporeal) voices arose from all the quarters.
verses.hindi: ज्ञात्वा काव्यों यथातत्त्वं कारुण्येनानुकम्पया । एवं शुक्रोडनुनीतः स ततः कोप॑ न्ययच्छत ।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing her getting up as if from sleep, all living beings loudly applauded "Well done! Well done!" Such an applause of invisible (incorporeal) voices arose from all the quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her getting up as if from sleep, all living beings loudly applauded "Well done! Well done!" Such an applause of invisible (incorporeal) voices arose from all the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुकच्छस्य चोत्पत्तिः कथिता तव पाण्डव । संक्षेपेण महाराज सर्वपामप्रणाशनी
verses.transliteration: bhṛgukacchasya cotpattiḥ kathitā tava pāṇḍava / saṃkṣepeṇa mahārāja sarvapāmapraṇāśanī
verses.translation: Even as all living beings were observing, the lady was resuscitated to life by Bhrgu. That was really miraculous. On seeing his wife resuscitated lo life by Bhrgu with¬ out the least agitation Sakra was not at all happy, because he was afraid of Kavya (all the more).
verses.hindi: न शक्यमन्यथाकर्तुमदृष्ट हि बलवत्तरम्। संज्ञा प्रनष्टा या बोध्य काम ता प्रतिलप्स्यथ ४६ प्राप्त: वर्यायकालो व इति ब्रह्माउन्यभाषत । मत्प्रसादाच्च युष्माभिर्भुक्त त्रेलोक्यमुजितसू. युगारुया दश संपूर्णा देवानाक़रम्य सूर्धनि । तावस्तमेव॑ काल॑ वे ब्रह्मा राज्यमभाषत
verses.wordMeaning: Even as all living beings were observing, the lady was resuscitated to life by Bhrgu. That was really miraculous. On seeing his wife resuscitated lo life by Bhrgu with¬ out the least agitation Sakra was not at all happy, because he was afraid of Kavya (all the more).
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as all living beings were observing, the lady was resuscitated to life by Bhrgu. That was really miraculous. On seeing his wife resuscitated lo life by Bhrgu with¬ out the least agitation Sakra was not at all happy, because he was afraid of Kavya (all the more).

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं क्षेत्रं देवेन कीर्तितम् । चतुर्युगसहस्रेण पितामहदिनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ kṣetraṃ devena kīrtitam / caturyugasahasreṇa pitāmahadinaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Indra had no sleep at all (after the incident). The intelligent chastiser of Paka (i.e. Indra) called his daughter Javantl and spoke to her.
verses.hindi: साव्णिके पुनस्तस्य राज्यं किल भविष्यति । लोकानामीश्वरो भावो पौत्रस्तव पुनबलिः १३२ एवं किलमहू प्रोक्तः पौत्रस्ते ब्रह्मणा स्वयम् । तथा ह॒तेषु लोकेषु तपो5स्थ न किलाभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Indra had no sleep at all (after the incident). The intelligent chastiser of Paka (i.e. Indra) called his daughter Javantl and spoke to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra had no sleep at all (after the incident). The intelligent chastiser of Paka (i.e. Indra) called his daughter Javantl and spoke to her.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्ते ब्रह्मदिने विप्रा जायते युगसम्भवः । न पश्यामि त्विदं क्षेत्रम् इति रुद्रः स्वयं जगौ
verses.transliteration: prāpte brahmadine viprā jāyate yugasambhavaḥ / na paśyāmi tvidaṃ kṣetram iti rudraḥ svayaṃ jagau
verses.translation: "O daughter, this Kavya is performing a terrible penance for the sake of my destruction (lit. Indra-lcss-ncss). I have been rendered much dispirited by that (Bralimana) of great fortitude. Go and honour him with auspicious (services) remov¬ ing his fatigue and by rendering alertly and deligcntly service pleasing to his mind".
verses.hindi: पर रक्षा की है, आप अपनी दिव्य दृष्टि से यह जान सकते हूँ कि हमें देवाचार्य ने ठयथ लिया था, हस आप के भक्त हैं, हमारी रक्षा कीजिये। है भृगुनन्दन  यदि आज आप हम लोगों की रक्षा नहीं करते, तो फिर आप से अपमानित होंकर हम लोग रसातल को जा रहे हैं ।४४-४६॥।
verses.wordMeaning: "O daughter, this Kavya is performing a terrible penance for the sake of my destruction (lit. Indra-lcss-ncss). I have been rendered much dispirited by that (Bralimana) of great fortitude.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O daughter, this Kavya is performing a terrible penance for the sake of my destruction (lit. Indra-lcss-ncss). I have been rendered much dispirited by that (Bralimana) of great fortitude.…

verses.sanskrit: यः शृणोति त्विदं भक्त्या नारी वा पुरुषो ऽपि वा । स याति परमं लोकम् इति रुद्रः स्वयं जगौ
verses.transliteration: yaḥ śṛṇoti tvidaṃ bhaktyā nārī vā puruṣo 'pi vā / sa yāti paramaṃ lokam iti rudraḥ svayaṃ jagau
verses.translation: The gentle lady Jayanti, the daughter of Indra, of auspicious conduct, saw Kavya engaged in meditation. Although he was weak, he was quiet and self-possessed, endowed with fortitude, as her father had already mentioned to her. She rendered every service to Kavya in accordance with the behest of her father. In sweet and pleasing words she eulogised him. Frequently she massaged his body and served him in various other pleasant ways. Thus she stayed there for many years.
verses.hindi: खूत बोले--ऋषिवन्द ! हैत्यों एबं दानवों के इस प्रकार निवेदन करने पर शुक्राचायें को सब बातें यथार्थत: ज्ञात हुईं, उनका क्रोध दूर हो गवा, देत्यों के ऊपर उन्हें बड़ी करुणा हुई, अनुकम्पा के स्वर में यह बोले, देत्यो! डरो मत, रसातल भरत जाओ । किश्तु अबश्य घटित होनेवाली यह घटना तो मेरे प्रयत्नशील रहने पर भी घटित होगी ।४७-४८।॥ अदुष्ट महाबलवान् होता है, उसे हम टाल नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: The gentle lady Jayanti, the daughter of Indra, of auspicious conduct, saw Kavya engaged in meditation. Although he was weak, he was quiet and self-possessed, endowed with fortitude, as her father had already mentioned to her.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The gentle lady Jayanti, the daughter of Indra, of auspicious conduct, saw Kavya engaged in meditation. Although he was weak, he was quiet and self-possessed, endowed with fortitude, as her father had already mentioned to her.…

verses.sanskrit: देवखाते नरः स्नात्वा पिण्डदानादिसत्क्रियाम् । यां करोति नृपश्रेष्ठ ताम् अक्षयफलां विदुः
verses.transliteration: devakhāte naraḥ snātvā piṇḍadānādisatkriyām / yāṃ karoti nṛpaśreṣṭha tām akṣayaphalāṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: When the terrible rite of inhaling the smoke lasting Due to his excessive joy, the following hymn to the lord Mahesvara manifested itself. Prostrating (before the Lord), he eulogised Nilalohita (Lord Siva):
verses.hindi: सकते । तुम लोगों की चेतना नष्ट होने का आज जो अभिश्ञाप मैंने दिया है, उसे तो अवश्यमेव भोगना पड़ेगा । ब्रह्मा ने यह कहा है, अर्थात् उनको यह अभीष्ट है कि तुम लोगों का यह अवनतिकाल प्रारम्भ हो, अतः वह अवनति का क्रम प्राप्त हो गया है। मेरे अनुग्रह से तुम लोगों ने तैलोक्य की समस्त समृद्धियों का उपभोग किया है ।४६-५०। देवताओं के शिर पर आक्रमण कर राज्य प्राप्त किये हुए तुम लोगों के बस युग व्यतीत हो चके, उतने ही समय तक का राज्य ब्रह्मा ने तुम लोगों के लिए कहां है  सार्वाणक मन्वन्तर के भाने पर तुम्हें पुन निश्चय ही राज्य की प्राप्ति होगी । उस समय लि समस्त लोकों का अधौदवर होगा ।५१-५२। इन सब बातों को मुझसे स्वयं ब्रह्मा ने कह्दा है, जो वे अवश्यमेंव घटित होंगी, तुम्हारे पौत्र बलि से समस्त लोक छिन जायेंगे । उसके तपोबल से कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: When the terrible rite of inhaling the smoke lasting Due to his excessive joy, the following hymn to the lord Mahesvara manifested itself. Prostrating (before the Lord), he eulogised Nilalohita (Lord Siva):
verses.commentary: Sense: When the terrible rite of inhaling the smoke lasting Due to his excessive joy, the following hymn to the lord Mahesvara manifested itself. Prostrating (before the Lord), he eulogised Nilalohita (Lord Siva):

verses.sanskrit: य इमं शृणुयाद् भक्त्या भृगुकच्छस्य विस्तरम् । कोटितीर्थफलं तस्य भवेद् वै नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: ya imaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā bhṛgukacchasya vistaram / koṭitīrthaphalaṃ tasya bhaved vai nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: ''Obeisance to Sitikantha (Blue-throated god) to Surupa (of good form), to Suvarcas (of good brilliance), to Ririhdna (one who exhibits the mystic mudra of frequently lick¬ ing with the tongue), to Lop a (the destroyer), to Vatsara (the presiding deity of the year), to the Jagatpati (the lord of the universe).
verses.hindi: गा, उसकी प्रवृत्तियाँ निस्वार्थ होगी, उस समय अजन्मा
verses.wordMeaning: ''Obeisance to Sitikantha (Blue-throated god) to Surupa (of good form), to Suvarcas (of good brilliance), to Ririhdna (one who exhibits the mystic mudra of frequently lick¬ ing with the tongue), to Lop a (the destroyer), to Vatsara (the presiding deity of the year),…
verses.commentary: Sense: ''Obeisance to Sitikantha (Blue-throated god) to Surupa (of good form), to Suvarcas (of good brilliance), to Ririhdna (one who exhibits the mystic mudra of frequently lick¬ ing with the tongue), to Lop a (the destroyer), to Vatsara (the presiding deity of the year),…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भृगुकच्छतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्व्यशीत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १८३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: अतः परं महाराज गच्छेत् केदारसंज्ञकम् । यत्र गत्वा महाराज श्राद्धं कृत्वा पिबेज्जलम् । सम्पूज्य देवदेवेशं केदारोत्थं फलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhṛgukacchatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyaśītyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 183 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ataḥ paraṃ mahārāja gacchet kedārasaṃjñakam / yatra gatvā mahārāja śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā pibejjalam / sampūjya devadeveśaṃ kedārotthaṃ phalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: To Kapardin (having matted hair), to Ordhvaroman (having hair standing up erect), to Haya (the horse), to Kararia (the instrument), to Snmskrta (the consecrated), to Sulirlha (the holy centre), to Deva-deva (Lord of Devas), to Ravihas (velocity personified).
verses.hindi: न होगा तब वह निष्काम भाव से तपस्या में निरत हो यस्मात्प्रव॒यत्तश्वास्य न कामानभिसंधिताः । तस्मादजेन प्रीतेन दत्त सावर्णिकेइन्तरे ४४
verses.wordMeaning: To Kapardin (having matted hair), to Ordhvaroman (having hair standing up erect), to Haya (the horse), to Kararia (the instrument), to Snmskrta (the consecrated), to Sulirlha (the holy centre), to Deva-deva (Lord of Devas), to Ravihas (velocity personified).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Kapardin (having matted hair), to Ordhvaroman (having hair standing up erect), to Haya (the horse), to Kararia (the instrument), to Snmskrta (the consecrated), to Sulirlha (the holy centre), to Deva-deva (Lord of Devas), to Ravihas (velocity personified).

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथम् अत्र सुरश्रेष्ठ केदाराख्यः स्थितः स्वयम् । उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले एतद्विस्तरतो वद
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: katham atra suraśreṣṭha kedārākhyaḥ sthitaḥ svayam / uttare narmadākūle etadvistarato vada
verses.translation: To Usnisin (one with a turban or turban-wearer), to Suvnktra (one with a charming face), to Siihasrak$a (god with a thousand eyes), to Mijhvan (bountiful), to Vasureta (distributer
verses.hindi: बेवराज्यं बलेभाव्यमिति मामीश्वरोउब्रवीत् । तस्माददृश्यों भुतानां कालकाइक्षी स तिष्ठति
verses.wordMeaning: To Usnisin (one with a turban or turban-wearer), to Suvnktra (one with a charming face), to Siihasrak$a (god with a thousand eyes), to Mijhvan (bountiful), to Vasureta (distributer
verses.commentary: Sense: To Usnisin (one with a turban or turban-wearer), to Suvnktra (one with a charming face), to Siihasrak$a (god with a thousand eyes), to Mijhvan (bountiful), to Vasureta (distributer

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ शङ्करस् तु महेश्वरः । भृगुणाराधितः शप्तः श्रिया च भृगुकच्छके
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā kṛtayugasyādau śaṅkaras tu maheśvaraḥ / bhṛguṇārādhitaḥ śaptaḥ śriyā ca bhṛgukacchake
verses.translation: Praising deity by giving him/her various attributes is found common
verses.hindi: न च शकयं ममा तुभ्य॑ पुरस्तादे विसर्षितुम् । ब्रह्मणा प्रतिषिद्धोस्मि भविष्यं जानता प्रभो इमौ च शिष्यौ द्ौ महां तुल्याबेतो बृहस्पतेः । देवतेः सह संरब्धास्सर्वान्चों धारयिष्यतः ५८
verses.wordMeaning: Praising deity by giving him/her various attributes is found common
verses.commentary: Sense: Praising deity by giving him/her various attributes is found common

verses.sanskrit: अपवित्रमिदं क्षेत्रं सर्ववेदविवर्जितम् । भविष्यति नृपश्रेष्ठ गतेत्युक्त्वा हरिप्रिया
verses.transliteration: apavitramidaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvavedavivarjitam / bhaviṣyati nṛpaśreṣṭha gatetyuktvā haripriyā
verses.translation: To Saliasrabdhu (one with a thousand i.e. infinite arms), to Sahasr&malacaksus (one with a thousand clean eyes), to Sahasra- kuksi (one with a thousand bellies), to Sahasracarana (one with a thousand feet).
verses.hindi: एवपुक्तास्तु देतेया: कव्येनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । ततस्ताभ्यां ययुः साथ प्रह्लादप्रमुखास्तदा ३५६
verses.wordMeaning: To Saliasrabdhu (one with a thousand i.e. infinite arms), to Sahasr&malacaksus (one with a thousand clean eyes), to Sahasra- kuksi (one with a thousand bellies), to Sahasracarana (one with a thousand feet).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Saliasrabdhu (one with a thousand i.e. infinite arms), to Sahasr&malacaksus (one with a thousand clean eyes), to Sahasra- kuksi (one with a thousand bellies), to Sahasracarana (one with a thousand feet).

verses.sanskrit: तपश्चचार विपुलं भृगुर्वर्षसहस्रकम् । वायुभक्षो निराहारश्चिरं धमनिसंततः
verses.transliteration: tapaścacāra vipulaṃ bhṛgurvarṣasahasrakam / vāyubhakṣo nirāhāraściraṃ dhamanisaṃtataḥ
verses.translation: To SahasraSiras (one with a thousand heads), to Bahurupa (multi-formed), to Vitoarupa (immanent in the universe), to $ vc ta (the white one), to Purusa (primordial man).
verses.hindi: अवश्यंभावमर्थत्वं (? ) श्रुत्वा शुक्राच्च दानवाः । सकृदाशंसमानास्ते जय॑ काव्येन भाषितम्ू ॥ दंशिताः सायुधाः सर्वे ततो देवान्समाह्ययन् । अथ देवाशसुरान्दृष्ट्वा सहःग्रामे समुपस्थितानू
verses.wordMeaning: To SahasraSiras (one with a thousand heads), to Bahurupa (multi-formed), to Vitoarupa (immanent in the universe), to $ vc ta (the white one), to Purusa (primordial man).
verses.commentary: Sense: To SahasraSiras (one with a thousand heads), to Bahurupa (multi-formed), to Vitoarupa (immanent in the universe), to $ vc ta (the white one), to Purusa (primordial man).

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रत्यक्षतामागाल् लिङ्गीभूतो महेश्वरः । प्रादुर्भूतस्तु सहसा भित्त्वा पातालसप्तकम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pratyakṣatāmāgāl liṅgībhūto maheśvaraḥ / prādurbhūtastu sahasā bhittvā pātālasaptakam
verses.translation: To Nisangin (one with a quiver), to ICavacin (one wearing a coat of mail), to Sukfma (the subtle one), to Ksapana (the destroyer), to Tamra (the copper-coloured), to Siva (the
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा प्रसन्न होकर सावणिक मध्वन्तर में उसे अमरत्व प्रदान करेंगे ।६३-५४। देवताओं का समस्त वेभव एवं साम्राज्य बलि को प्राप्त होगा--ऐसा ब्रह्मा ने मुझसे कहा है। इसलिए सभी प्राणधारियों से अदृष्य होकण उपयुक्त समय की प्रतीक्षा करते हुए वह कालपायन करता है । इस समय किसी प्रकार की उत्सुकता एवं व्याकुलता के बिना काल के इस चक्र का सहन करो मैं तुम्हारी इस समय के आने के पूर्व किसी प्रकार रक्षा
verses.wordMeaning: To Nisangin (one with a quiver), to ICavacin (one wearing a coat of mail), to Sukfma (the subtle one), to Ksapana (the destroyer), to Tamra (the copper-coloured), to Siva (the
verses.commentary: Sense: To Nisangin (one with a quiver), to ICavacin (one wearing a coat of mail), to Sukfma (the subtle one), to Ksapana (the destroyer), to Tamra (the copper-coloured), to Siva (the

verses.sanskrit: ददर्शाथ भृगुर्देवम् औत्पलीं केलिकामिव । स्तुतिं चक्रे स देवाय स्थाणवे त्र्यम्बकेति च
verses.transliteration: dadarśātha bhṛgurdevam autpalīṃ kelikāmiva / stutiṃ cakre sa devāya sthāṇave tryambaketi ca
verses.translation: To Bubhru (the tawny-coloured), to Pisanga (reddish brown), to Pingola (yellowsih brown), to Atuiio, ( the pink coloured), to Mahddeva (the great god), to Sana (the des¬ troyer), to Visoanlpasiva* (the auspicious omnipresent god).
verses.hindi: नही कर सकता  है सबंसमर्थ ! भविष्य की सब बातों को जाननेवाले स्वयं ब्रह्मा जी ने इस विषय में मुझे कुछ कहने से रोका है । बृहस्पति के शिष्य देवमण, और हमारे शिष्य तुम लोग--दोनों ही हमारे लिए यद्यपि समान हो, तथापि देवताओं के साथ युद्धभूमि में विरद्ध लड़नेवाले तुम सब की हम ओर देवताओं की बृहस्पति रक्षा करेंगे खूत बोले--ऋषिवृन्द ! अपने यजमानों के उपकार में सबंदा निरत रहने वाले शुक्राचार्य के इस प्रकार कहने पर प्रह्लाद प्रमुब देत्यमण उस दोनों के साथ गये  अवश्य घटित होनेवाली घटना तो घटकर ही रहेगी --ऐसी शुक्रचार्य की बातें सुनकर दानवों ने यह वितंक किया कि शुक्राचायं ने तो हम लोगों कौ एक बार विजय प्राप्ति की बात बतलायी ही है अतः युद्ध ही
verses.wordMeaning: To Bubhru (the tawny-coloured), to Pisanga (reddish brown), to Pingola (yellowsih brown), to Atuiio, ( the pink coloured), to Mahddeva (the great god), to Sana (the des¬ troyer), to Visoanlpasiva* (the auspicious omnipresent god).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Bubhru (the tawny-coloured), to Pisanga (reddish brown), to Pingola (yellowsih brown), to Atuiio, ( the pink coloured), to Mahddeva (the great god), to Sana (the des¬ troyer), to Visoanlpasiva* (the auspicious omnipresent god).

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुतः स भगवान् प्रोवाच प्रहसन्निव । पुनः पुनर्भृगुं मत्तः किंतु प्रार्थयसे मुने
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavān provāca prahasanniva / punaḥ punarbhṛguṃ mattaḥ kiṃtu prārthayase mune
verses.translation: To Hiranya (the golden one), to Sista (the self-con¬ trolled one), to Srestha (the excellent one), to Madhyama (the middling), to Pinakin (wielding the bow Pinaka), to I$uman (possessing arrows), to Citra (the miraculous one or one of variegated colours), to Rohila (reddish-tinged).
verses.hindi: क्‍यों त किया जाय ? ऐसा निशचय कर उन सबों ने अस्त्र-शस्त्रादि धारण कर युद्ध के लिये देवताओं का आह्वान किया । देवताओं ने संग्राम के लिए असुरों को जब तैयार देखा तो कवच आदि धारण कर युद्ध करते के लिये आ गये ओर घोर युद्ध करने लगे। वह घोर देवासुर संग्राम सौ वर्षों तक चलता
verses.wordMeaning: To Hiranya (the golden one), to Sista (the self-con¬ trolled one), to Srestha (the excellent one), to Madhyama (the middling), to Pinakin (wielding the bow Pinaka), to I$uman (possessing arrows), to Citra (the miraculous one or one of variegated colours),…
verses.commentary: Sense: To Hiranya (the golden one), to Sista (the self-con¬ trolled one), to Srestha (the excellent one), to Madhyama (the middling), to Pinakin (wielding the bow Pinaka), to I$uman (possessing arrows), to Citra (the miraculous one or one of variegated colours),…

verses.sanskrit: भृगुरुवाच: पञ्चक्रोशमिदं क्षेत्रं पद्मया शापितं विभो । उपवित्रम् इदं क्षेत्रं सर्ववेदविवर्जितम् । भविष्यतीति च प्रोच्य गता देवी विदं प्रति
verses.transliteration: bhṛguruvāca: pañcakrośamidaṃ kṣetraṃ padmayā śāpitaṃ vibho / upavitram idaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvavedavivarjitam / bhaviṣyatīti ca procya gatā devī vidaṃ prati
verses.translation: To Dundnbhya (worthy of being honoured with the sound of war-drums), to Ekapada (single-footed), to Arha (the deserving), to Buddhi (the intellect), to Mrgavyadha (one who has assumed the form of a hunter of deer in Daksa's sacrifice), to Sarpa (the serpent), to Sthdnu (motionless like a tree-trunk in meditation), to Bhisana (the terrible).
verses.hindi: पे२ द वायुपुराणम् ततः संवत्तसंनाहा देवास्तान्समयोधयन् । देत्यासुरे ततस्तस्मिन्वतेंमाने शत समाः ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: To Dundnbhya (worthy of being honoured with the sound of war-drums), to Ekapada (single-footed), to Arha (the deserving), to Buddhi (the intellect), to Mrgavyadha (one who has assumed the form of a hunter of deer in Daksa's sacrifice), to Sarpa (the serpent),…
verses.commentary: Sense: To Dundnbhya (worthy of being honoured with the sound of war-drums), to Ekapada (single-footed), to Arha (the deserving), to Buddhi (the intellect), to Mrgavyadha (one who has assumed the form of a hunter of deer in Daksa's sacrifice), to Sarpa (the serpent),…

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पवित्रतां याति यथेदं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् । तथा कुरु महेशान प्रसन्नो यदि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: punaḥ pavitratāṃ yāti yathedaṃ kṣetramuttamam / tathā kuru maheśāna prasanno yadi śaṅkara
verses.translation: To Bahurupa (the multiformed), to Ugra (the fierce), to Trinetra (the three-eyed), to livara (the supreme ruler), to Kapila (tawny-coloured or identical with Kapila), to Ekavira (the single hero), to Mrlyu (the death), to Tryambaka (tlie three- eyed).
verses.hindi: अजयच्नसुरा देवान्भग्ना देवा अमन्त्रयन्
verses.wordMeaning: To Bahurupa (the multiformed), to Ugra (the fierce), to Trinetra (the three-eyed), to livara (the supreme ruler), to Kapila (tawny-coloured or identical with Kapila), to Ekavira (the single hero), to Mrlyu (the death), to Tryambaka (tlie three- eyed).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Bahurupa (the multiformed), to Ugra (the fierce), to Trinetra (the three-eyed), to livara (the supreme ruler), to Kapila (tawny-coloured or identical with Kapila), to Ekavira (the single hero), to Mrlyu (the death), to Tryambaka (tlie three- eyed).

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: केदाराख्यमिदं ब्रह्मंल् लिङ्गमाद्यं भविष्यति । कृत्वेदमादिलिङ्गानि भविष्यन्ति दशैव हि
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: kedārākhyamidaṃ brahmaṃl liṅgamādyaṃ bhaviṣyati / kṛtvedamādiliṅgāni bhaviṣyanti daśaiva hi
verses.translation: To Vdstospali (the protective deity presiding over the foundation of a house), to Vinaka (one beyond heaven), to Sankara (the benefactor), to Siva (the auspicious one), to Aranya (the forest-dweller), to Grhastha (the householder), to the Brahmacarin (the religious student observing celibacy).
verses.hindi: षण्डामर्कप्रभाव॑ न जानीमस्त्वसुरेवंयम् । तस्मादज्ञं समुद्दिश्य कार्य चाउ5त्महितं च यत् ६३ तज्ज्ञानापहुतावेतौ कृत्वा जेष्यामहेइसुरान् । अथोपामन्त्रयन्देवा: षण्डामकों तु ताबुभौ ६४
verses.wordMeaning: To Vdstospali (the protective deity presiding over the foundation of a house), to Vinaka (one beyond heaven), to Sankara (the benefactor), to Siva (the auspicious one), to Aranya (the forest-dweller), to Grhastha (the householder),…
verses.commentary: Sense: To Vdstospali (the protective deity presiding over the foundation of a house), to Vinaka (one beyond heaven), to Sankara (the benefactor), to Siva (the auspicious one), to Aranya (the forest-dweller), to Grhastha (the householder),…

verses.sanskrit: एकादशम् अदृश्यं हि क्षेत्रमध्ये भविष्यति । पावयिष्यति तत्क्षेत्रमेकादशः स्वयं विभुः
verses.transliteration: ekādaśam adṛśyaṃ hi kṣetramadhye bhaviṣyati / pāvayiṣyati tatkṣetramekādaśaḥ svayaṃ vibhuḥ
verses.translation: To the Sdnkhya (one accessible through the Sdnkhya system of philosophy), to Toga (one realizable through the Yoga system), to Dhydnin (the meditating one), to Diksila (the initia¬ ted), to Antarhita (unmanifest, hidden), to Sarva (destroyer of the world), to Mdnya (the honourable), to Malin (one wearing garland).
verses.hindi: यज्ञ समाह्मयिष्यामस्त्यजतमसुरान्द्रिजो । ग्रह तं वा ग्रहीष्यामों ह्यनुजित्य तु दानवान् ३६५
verses.wordMeaning: To the Sdnkhya (one accessible through the Sdnkhya system of philosophy), to Toga (one realizable through the Yoga system), to Dhydnin (the meditating one), to Diksila (the initia¬ ted), to Antarhita (unmanifest, hidden), to Sarva (destroyer of the world),…
verses.commentary: Sense: To the Sdnkhya (one accessible through the Sdnkhya system of philosophy), to Toga (one realizable through the Yoga system), to Dhydnin (the meditating one), to Diksila (the initia¬ ted), to Antarhita (unmanifest, hidden), to Sarva (destroyer of the world),…

verses.sanskrit: तथा वै द्वादशादित्या मत्प्रसादात्तु मूर्तितः । वसिष्यन्ति भृगुक्षेत्रे रोगदुःखनिबर्हणाः
verses.transliteration: tathā vai dvādaśādityā matprasādāttu mūrtitaḥ / vasiṣyanti bhṛgukṣetre rogaduḥkhanibarhaṇāḥ
verses.translation: To Buddha (the enlightened one), to Suddha (the pure), to Mukta (the liberated one), to Kcvala (the sole one without a second), to Rodhas (staying on the mountain slope), to Cekitdna (the sentient), to Brahmisfha (merged in Brahman), to Maharfi (the great sage).
verses.hindi: एवं तत्यजतुस्तो तु षण्डामकों तदाउसुरान्  ततो देवा जय॑ प्राप्ता दानवाश्य पराभवन् + देवाइसु रान्पराभाव्य षण्डामकाविपागसन् । काव्यशापाभिभृताभ्य अनाधाराश्र ते पुनः ६७
verses.wordMeaning: To Buddha (the enlightened one), to Suddha (the pure), to Mukta (the liberated one), to Kcvala (the sole one without a second), to Rodhas (staying on the mountain slope), to Cekitdna (the sentient), to Brahmisfha (merged in Brahman), to Maharfi (the great sage).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Buddha (the enlightened one), to Suddha (the pure), to Mukta (the liberated one), to Kcvala (the sole one without a second), to Rodhas (staying on the mountain slope), to Cekitdna (the sentient), to Brahmisfha (merged in Brahman), to Maharfi (the great sage).

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गाः ह्यष्टादश तथा क्षेत्रपालास्तु षोडश । भृगुक्षेत्रे भविष्यन्ति वीरभद्राश्च मातरः
verses.transliteration: durgāḥ hyaṣṭādaśa tathā kṣetrapālāstu ṣoḍaśa / bhṛgukṣetre bhaviṣyanti vīrabhadrāśca mātaraḥ
verses.translation: To Caluspada (one having four feet), to Medhya (one worthy of sacrifice), to Dharmin (the virtuous), to wearer of an armour ( Varmin as in Bd.P. v. 178), to Sighraga{ one goingfast), to S ikhantjUn (one with tuft of hair), to Kapala (one holding the human skull), to Damsfrin (one with curved fangs), to VUvamedhas (of universal intellect).
verses.hindi: बध्यमानास्तदा देवेविवशुस्ते रसातले । एवं निरुच्ममास्ते वे कृता: शक्रेण दानवाः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: To Caluspada (one having four feet), to Medhya (one worthy of sacrifice), to Dharmin (the virtuous), to wearer of an armour ( Varmin as in Bd.P. v. 178), to Sighraga{ one goingfast), to S ikhantjUn (one with tuft of hair), to Kapala (one holding the human skull),…
verses.commentary: Sense: To Caluspada (one having four feet), to Medhya (one worthy of sacrifice), to Dharmin (the virtuous), to wearer of an armour ( Varmin as in Bd.P. v. 178), to Sighraga{ one goingfast), to S ikhantjUn (one with tuft of hair), to Kapala (one holding the human skull),…

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रीकृतमेतद्धि नित्यं क्षेत्रं भविष्यति । नाघमासे ह्युषःकाले स्नात्वा मासं जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: pavitrīkṛtametaddhi nityaṃ kṣetraṃ bhaviṣyati / nāghamāse hyuṣaḥkāle snātvā māsaṃ jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: To Apratighata (the unimpeded), to Dipta (the illumi¬ nated), to Bhdskara (the creator of lustre), to Sumedhas (of excellent intellect), to Krura (the cruel one), to Vikrta (the deformed), to Bibhatsa (the hideous), to Siva (auspicious).
verses.hindi: ततः प्रश्नुति शापेन मृगुनेमित्तकेन च रहा  अस्त में अपुरों में देवताओं पर विजय प्राप्त की। पराजित देवताओं ने आपस में सम्मति
verses.wordMeaning: To Apratighata (the unimpeded), to Dipta (the illumi¬ nated), to Bhdskara (the creator of lustre), to Sumedhas (of excellent intellect), to Krura (the cruel one), to Vikrta (the deformed), to Bibhatsa (the hideous), to Siva (auspicious).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Apratighata (the unimpeded), to Dipta (the illumi¬ nated), to Bhdskara (the creator of lustre), to Sumedhas (of excellent intellect), to Krura (the cruel one), to Vikrta (the deformed), to Bibhatsa (the hideous), to Siva (auspicious).

verses.sanskrit: यः पूजयति केदारं स गच्छेच्छिवमन्दिरम् । तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पित्ःनुद्दिश्य भारत । श्राद्धं ददाति विधिवत् तस्य प्रीताः पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ pūjayati kedāraṃ sa gacchecchivamandiram / tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā pitḥnuddiśya bhārata / śrāddhaṃ dadāti vidhivat tasya prītāḥ pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: To Saumya (the gentle one), to Pwiya (the meritorious) to Dhdimika (the righteous), to Subha (the auspicious), to Avadhya (one who cannot be killed), to Mrtahga (one whose body is dead?), to jVitya (the eternal one), to Satvata (the perpe¬ tual one). To Sddya (one with a beginning), to Sarabha (the eight¬ footed fabulous animal), to &ulin (the trident-bearing god), to Tricaksus (the three-eyed god), to Somapa (the imbiber of Soma
verses.hindi: देवगण बोले--हम लोग असुरों के सहायक षण्ड और अमक के प्रभाव को नहीं जानते  अतः अपने कल्याण के लिये हमें इस समय एक यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान करना चाहिए । उसमें इन्हें बुलाना चाहिए । उस यज्ञ में इनको बहका कर हम असुरों को जीत लेंगें। देवताओं ने एकान्त में इस प्रकार की मंत्रणा कर एक यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान प्रारम्भ किया और उसमें षण्ड और अमक का आवाहन किया।
verses.wordMeaning: To Saumya (the gentle one), to Pwiya (the meritorious) to Dhdimika (the righteous), to Subha (the auspicious), to Avadhya (one who cannot be killed), to Mrtahga (one whose body is dead?), to jVitya (the eternal one), to Satvata (the perpe¬ tual one).…
verses.commentary: Sense: To Saumya (the gentle one), to Pwiya (the meritorious) to Dhdimika (the righteous), to Subha (the auspicious), to Avadhya (one who cannot be killed), to Mrtahga (one whose body is dead?), to jVitya (the eternal one), to Satvata (the perpe¬ tual one).…

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं सम्यक्केदाराख्यं सविस्तरम् । सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वदुःखप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ samyakkedārākhyaṃ savistaram / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: To Vyafrita (having no dependent), to Sravisfha (the most famous), to Dharata (one engaged in brilliant light), to Antariksa (the firmament), to Ksama (the competent), to Sahamana (the enduring), to Satya (the truthful), to Tnpana (the blazing one).
verses.hindi: यज्ञ में आने पर उनसे निवेदन किया--द्विजवर्य  हम इसी प्रकार बराबर यज्ञादि शुभकार्यो में आप को बुलाते रहेंगे, आप असुरों की संगति छोड़ दीजिये, दानवों को पराजित कर लेने के उपराग्त हम उन्हें फिर ग्रहण कर सकते हैं ।६३-६६। देवताओं ने जब इस प्रकार अनुरोध किया तो षण्ड और अमके ने दानवों का संग छोड़ दिया, परिणाम स्वरूप देवता लोग जीत गये, दानवों की पराजय हो गई । देबतागण असुरों को पराजित कर लेने के उपरान्त पुनः षण्ड और अमक के पास आये। शुक्राचार्ये के शाप से पराजित एवं निराश्चित दानव जब देवताओं द्वारा पीड़ित होकर रसातल को चले गये। इन्द्र ने इस प्रकार उन दानवों को अपनी बुद्धिमत्ता से अकमंण्य बना दिया । तभी से महषि भृगु के उसी नेमित्तिक शाप के कारण जब जब यज्ञादि का हास होने लगता है धर्म की शियिलता होने लगती है, तब तब
verses.wordMeaning: To Vyafrita (having no dependent), to Sravisfha (the most famous), to Dharata (one engaged in brilliant light), to Antariksa (the firmament), to Ksama (the competent), to Sahamana (the enduring), to Satya (the truthful), to Tnpana (the blazing one).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Vyafrita (having no dependent), to Sravisfha (the most famous), to Dharata (one engaged in brilliant light), to Antariksa (the firmament), to Ksama (the competent), to Sahamana (the enduring), to Satya (the truthful), to Tnpana (the blazing one).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे केदारेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्र्यशीत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १८४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: धौतपापं ततो गच्छेद्भृगुतीर्थसमीपतः । वृषेण तु भृगुस्तत्र भूयोभूयो धुतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kedāreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryaśītyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 184 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dhautapāpaṃ tato gacchedbhṛgutīrthasamīpataḥ / vṛṣeṇa tu bhṛgustatra bhūyobhūyo dhutastataḥ
verses.translation: To Tripuraghna (the destroyer of the three cities), to Difita (the illuminated), to the Cakra (the discus), to Romasa (the hairy one), to Tigmayudho. (having shaip weapons), to Medhya (the cleanest), to Siddha, to Pulasti.
verses.hindi: जले पुनः पुनर्विष्णुयं् च शिथिले प्रभुः। कतु धर्मव्यवस्थानमधमंस्थ च नाशनमू... ॥६€६ प्र्दादस्य निदेशे तु येइसुरा न व्यवस्थिताः । सनुष्यवध्यांस्तान्सवॉन्ग्रिह्ाध्नुव्याहरत्प्रभुः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: To Tripuraghna (the destroyer of the three cities), to Difita (the illuminated), to the Cakra (the discus), to Romasa (the hairy one), to Tigmayudho. (having shaip weapons), to Medhya (the cleanest), to Siddha, to Pulasti.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Tripuraghna (the destroyer of the three cities), to Difita (the illuminated), to the Cakra (the discus), to Romasa (the hairy one), to Tigmayudho. (having shaip weapons), to Medhya (the cleanest), to Siddha, to Pulasti.

verses.sanskrit: धौतपापं तु तत्तेन नाम्ना लोकेषु विश्रुतम् । तत्र स्थितो महादेवस्तुष्ट्यर्थं भृगुसत्तमे
verses.transliteration: dhautapāpaṃ tu tattena nāmnā lokeṣu viśrutam / tatra sthito mahādevastuṣṭyarthaṃ bhṛgusattame
verses.translation: loRocamana (one who is appealing), to Khantfa, to Sphita (the flourishing), to Rsabha (the bull, the chief one), to Bhogin (the enjoyer), to Yunjamana (the united one), to Santa (the quiescent one), to Ordhoarctas (of sublimated sexuality).
verses.hindi: धर्मान्नारायणस्तस्मात्संभृतश्राक्षुषेबन्तरे । यज्ञ प्रवतंयामास चत्ये वेबस्वतेःन्तरे प्रादुर्भावे तदाउन्यस्य ब्रह्म वाधसी त्पु रोहित: । चतुर्थ्यां तु युगार्यायामापश्नेष्वसुरेष्वथ
verses.wordMeaning: loRocamana (one who is appealing), to Khantfa, to Sphita (the flourishing), to Rsabha (the bull, the chief one), to Bhogin (the enjoyer), to Yunjamana (the united one), to Santa (the quiescent one), to Ordhoarctas (of sublimated sexuality).
verses.commentary: Sense: loRocamana (one who is appealing), to Khantfa, to Sphita (the flourishing), to Rsabha (the bull, the chief one), to Bhogin (the enjoyer), to Yunjamana (the united one), to Santa (the quiescent one), to Ordhoarctas (of sublimated sexuality).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा शाठ्येनापि नरेश्वर । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā śāṭhyenāpi nareśvara / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: To Aghaghna (the destroyer of sins), to Makhaghna (destroyer of Daksa's sacrifice), to Mnyu (god of death), to Yajhiya (one belonging to sacrifice), to KrSdnu (fire), to Praceia, to Vahni (thefire, bearer of offerings), to Kifala(l)
verses.hindi: बलिसंस्थेषु लोकेषु त्रेतायां सप्तमे युगे। देत्यस्त्रलोक्य आक्वान्ते तुतीयों वामनो5भवत् ७४
verses.wordMeaning: To Aghaghna (the destroyer of sins), to Makhaghna (destroyer of Daksa's sacrifice), to Mnyu (god of death), to Yajhiya (one belonging to sacrifice), to KrSdnu (fire), to Praceia, to Vahni (thefire, bearer of offerings), to Kifala(l)
verses.commentary: Sense: To Aghaghna (the destroyer of sins), to Makhaghna (destroyer of Daksa's sacrifice), to Mnyu (god of death), to Yajhiya (one belonging to sacrifice), to KrSdnu (fire), to Praceia, to Vahni (thefire, bearer of offerings), to Kifala(l)

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु सम्यग्विधानेन तत्र स्नात्वार्चयेच्छिवम् । देवान्पित्ःन्समभ्यर्च्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: yastu samyagvidhānena tatra snātvārcayecchivam / devānpitḥnsamabhyarcya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: To Sikatya (belonging to sand?), to Prasanna (the delighted), to Varcnya (the most excellent), to Caksus (the eye), to Ksipragu (having a fast bull), to Pramedhya (the excessively pure), to Piva (the corpulent one?)
verses.hindi: ह्विजो भृत्वा शुभे काले बलि वेरोचनं पुरा ७५ त्रेलोक्यस्य भवानराजा त्वयि सर्व प्रतिष्ठितम् । दातुमहँसि मे राजन्विक्रमांस्त्रीनिति प्रभु: ददामीत्येव त॑ राजा बलिबेरोचनो5ब्रवीत् । वामनं तं च विज्ञाय ततोष्नुमुदितः स्वयम्  ७७
verses.wordMeaning: To Sikatya (belonging to sand?), to Prasanna (the delighted), to Varcnya (the most excellent), to Caksus (the eye), to Ksipragu (having a fast bull), to Pramedhya (the excessively pure), to Piva (the corpulent one?)
verses.commentary: Sense: To Sikatya (belonging to sand?), to Prasanna (the delighted), to Varcnya (the most excellent), to Caksus (the eye), to Ksipragu (having a fast bull), to Pramedhya (the excessively pure), to Piva (the corpulent one?)

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या गवां वध्या तत्र तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर । प्रविशेन्न सदा भीता प्रविष्टापि क्षयं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā gavāṃ vadhyā tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira / praviśenna sadā bhītā praviṣṭāpi kṣayaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: To Rafaoghna (the destroyer of Raksasas), to PaSughna (destroyer of animals), to Vighna (the obstacle), to Sayana (the lying one), to Vibhranta (the revolving one), to Mahanta. (having great end), to Anti (the nearest one), to Durgaina (difficult to attain).
verses.hindi: भगवान् विष्णु धर्म की व्यवस्था एवं अधघममं के नाश के लिये जन्म धारण करते हैं ।६७-६६९। चालश्षुष
verses.wordMeaning: To Rafaoghna (the destroyer of Raksasas), to PaSughna (destroyer of animals), to Vighna (the obstacle), to Sayana (the lying one), to Vibhranta (the revolving one), to Mahanta. (having great end), to Anti (the nearest one), to Durgaina (difficult to attain).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Rafaoghna (the destroyer of Raksasas), to PaSughna (destroyer of animals), to Vighna (the obstacle), to Sayana (the lying one), to Vibhranta (the revolving one), to Mahanta. (having great end), to Anti (the nearest one), to Durgaina (difficult to attain).

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: आश्चर्यभूतं लोके ऽस्मिन्कथयस्व द्विजोत्तम । प्रविशेन्न ब्रह्महत्या यथा वै धौतपाप्मनि
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: āścaryabhūtaṃ loke 'sminkathayasva dvijottama / praviśenna brahmahatyā yathā vai dhautapāpmani
verses.translation: To Dak$a (the dexterous), to jaghanya (the last one), to the lord of the worlds, to Andmaya (the non-ailing), to Ordhva (the topmost one), to Samhatya Adhisthita (to one established in masses).
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तर में असुर गण प्रक्लाद की आज्ञा में स्थित नहीं थे। मनुष्यों द्वारा मारे जा सकते थे, उन सब का विनाश करने के लिये भगवान् ब्रह्मा ने इस प्रकार बतलाया है कि उनके विनाश एवं धम की रक्षा के लिये नारायण का जन्म हो जाता है। वेवस्वत मन्वस्तर में इसी प्रकार यज्ञों का प्रवर्तत हुआ। उनके उस प्रा्दुभाव में स्वयं ब्रह्मा पुरोहित थे । चौथे युग में जब कि असुर मण बहुत अत्याचारी हो गये थे, वे समुद्र के मध्य भाग में प्रादुभूत हुए थे । तदनन्तर हिरण्यकर्शिपु के वध के लिये देवगणों के साथ भीषण नरसिंह रूप धारण कर उन्होंने द्वितीय अवतार घारण किया ७०-७३। तदनन्तर सातवें त्रेता युग में, जिस समय देद्यराज बलि समस्त लोकों का एक मात्र अधीक्वर था, तोनों लोक अछुरों के भय से आतंकित थे, ऐश्वयंशाली भगवान् विष्णु ने वामन अवतार धारण किया । यह उनका तृतीय अवतार था।
verses.wordMeaning: To Dak$a (the dexterous), to jaghanya (the last one), to the lord of the worlds, to Andmaya (the non-ailing), to Ordhva (the topmost one), to Samhatya Adhisthita (to one established in masses).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Dak$a (the dexterous), to jaghanya (the last one), to the lord of the worlds, to Andmaya (the non-ailing), to Ordhva (the topmost one), to Samhatya Adhisthita (to one established in masses).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यासमं पापं भविता नेह किंचन । कथं वा धौतपापे तु प्रविष्टं नश्यते द्विज । एतद्विस्तरतः सर्वं पृच्छामि वद कौतुकात्
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavitā neha kiṃcana / kathaṃ vā dhautapāpe tu praviṣṭaṃ naśyate dvija / etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ pṛcchāmi vada kautukāt
verses.translation: To Hiranyabdhu (of golden arms), to Satya (the truth¬ ful), to §amana (the tranquiliser)to Asikalpa (one like a
verses.hindi: उस समय भगवान् ने अपने को अंगों में समेट कर छोटा बना लिया था । बृहस्पति को आगे कर अदिति के कुल को आनन्दित करनेवाले भगवान् यज्ञ के अनुष्ठान में निरत दंत्येन्द्र विरोचन के पुत्र बलि की यज्ञशाला में ब्राह्मण वेश धारण कर पहुंचे थे ।७४-७५। उपयुक्त शुभ समय देखकर उन्होंने निवेदन किया कि हे राजन ! आप इस समस्त त्ैलोक्य के राजा हैं, आपमें संसार की समस्त सिद्धियाँ विद्यमानः हैं, आप सब्वे-
verses.wordMeaning: To Hiranyabdhu (of golden arms), to Satya (the truth¬ ful), to §amana (the tranquiliser)to Asikalpa (one like a
verses.commentary: Sense: To Hiranyabdhu (of golden arms), to Satya (the truth¬ ful), to §amana (the tranquiliser)to Asikalpa (one like a

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: आदिसर्गे पुरा शम्भुर्ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः । विकारं पञ्चमं दृष्ट्वा शिरो ऽश्वमुखसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ādisarge purā śambhurbrahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / vikāraṃ pañcamaṃ dṛṣṭvā śiro 'śvamukhasannibham
verses.translation: To Sresfha (the excellent one), to Vdmadeoa, to liana (supreme ruler), to Dhimati (the intelligent one), to Mahdkalpa toDipla (the illuminated), to Rodana (the crying), to Hasa (the laughing).
verses.hindi: समर्थ एवं प्रजाओं के मन को आनन्दित करनेवाले हैं, अत मुझे तीन पं भूमि का दान करें। भगवान् की ऐसी बातें सुनकर विरोचनपुत्र बलि ने उत्तर दिया कि आपको तीन पग भूमि मैं अवश्य दूंगा। उसने ब्राह्मणवेशधारी भगवान् को आकृति में अत्यन्त छोटा समझकर ऐसा कहा था, उसे इस दान में बड़ी दे ४ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: To Sresfha (the excellent one), to Vdmadeoa, to liana (supreme ruler), to Dhimati (the intelligent one), to Mahdkalpa toDipla (the illuminated), to Rodana (the crying), to Hasa (the laughing).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Sresfha (the excellent one), to Vdmadeoa, to liana (supreme ruler), to Dhimati (the intelligent one), to Mahdkalpa toDipla (the illuminated), to Rodana (the crying), to Hasa (the laughing).

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठाङ्गुलियोगेन तच्छिरस्तेन कृन्तितम् । कृत्तमात्रे तु शिरसि ब्रह्महत्याभक्तदा
verses.transliteration: aṅguṣṭhāṅguliyogena tacchirastena kṛntitam / kṛttamātre tu śirasi brahmahatyābhaktadā
verses.translation: To Vrtadhanoan (Drtfhadhanvan — having firm bow), to Kavacin (one wearing a coat of mail), to Rathin (having a chariot), to Varuthin (having a host of army), to Bhrgundlha (the lord of Bhrgu), to Sukra, to Vahniriffa (?), to Dhimdn (the intelligent).
verses.hindi: अत्यरिच्यत भृतात्मा भास्करं स्वेन तेजसा। प्रकाशयन्दिशः सर्वा: प्रदिशश्व महायशा: ७६ शुशुभे स महाबाहुः सर्वलोकान्प्रकाशयन् । आसुरीं श्रीयमाहत्य त्रील्लो कांश्व जनादनः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: To Vrtadhanoan (Drtfhadhanvan — having firm bow), to Kavacin (one wearing a coat of mail), to Rathin (having a chariot), to Varuthin (having a host of army), to Bhrgundlha (the lord of Bhrgu), to Sukra, to Vahniriffa (?), to Dhimdn (the intelligent).
verses.commentary: Sense: To Vrtadhanoan (Drtfhadhanvan — having firm bow), to Kavacin (one wearing a coat of mail), to Rathin (having a chariot), to Varuthin (having a host of army), to Bhrgundlha (the lord of Bhrgu), to Sukra, to Vahniriffa (?), to Dhimdn (the intelligent).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यायुतश्चासीद् उत्तरे नर्मदातटे । धुनितं तु यतो राजन्वृषेण धर्ममूर्तिना
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāyutaścāsīd uttare narmadātaṭe / dhunitaṃ tu yato rājanvṛṣeṇa dharmamūrtinā
verses.translation: To Ag/ia (the sin), to Agha§a7hsa (the despiser of sin), to Vipriya (having no beloved), to Priya (the beloved). O Digvdsas( having the quarters as garments), obeisance be to you, the wearer of elephant hide and destroyer of Bhaga.
verses.hindi: नमुचिः शम्बरश्चेव प्रह्नादश्चेव विष्णुना। क़्रा हता विनिधूंता दिशा संप्रतिप्रेदिरे महाभूतानि भूतात्मा सविशेषाणि साधवः । काल च सकल विप्रांस्तत्नादृभुतमदर्शयत्
verses.wordMeaning: To Ag/ia (the sin), to Agha§a7hsa (the despiser of sin), to Vipriya (having no beloved), to Priya (the beloved). O Digvdsas( having the quarters as garments), obeisance be to you, the wearer of elephant hide and destroyer of Bhaga.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Ag/ia (the sin), to Agha§a7hsa (the despiser of sin), to Vipriya (having no beloved), to Priya (the beloved). O Digvdsas( having the quarters as garments), obeisance be to you, the wearer of elephant hide and destroyer of Bhaga.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र धौतेश्वरीं देवीं स्थापितां वृषभेण तु । ददर्श भगवाञ्छम्भुः सर्वदैवतपूजिताम्
verses.transliteration: tatra dhauteśvarīṃ devīṃ sthāpitāṃ vṛṣabheṇa tu / dadarśa bhagavāñchambhuḥ sarvadaivatapūjitām
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of Pahis (individual souls), to the lord of living beings. Obeisance to Pranava, the Rk, the Yajus and the Saman, to Svadha and Sudha (nectar).
verses.hindi: तस्य गात्रे जगत्सवंमात्मानमनृपश्यति । न किचिदस्ति लोकेशु यदव्याप्तं महात्मना ८ ३ तह रूपमुपेन्द्रस्य देवदानवमानवा: । दृष्ट्वा संमुमुहुः सर्वे विष्णुतेजोविभोहिताः विद
