verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of Pahis (individual souls), to the lord of living beings. Obeisance to Pranava, the Rk, the Yajus and the Saman, to Svadha and Sudha (nectar).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of Pahis (individual souls), to the lord of living beings. Obeisance to Pranava, the Rk, the Yajus and the Saman, to Svadha and Sudha (nectar).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा धौतेश्वरीं दुर्गां ब्रह्महत्याविनाशिनीम् । तत्र विश्रममाणश्च शङ्करस्त्रिपुरान्तकः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā dhauteśvarīṃ durgāṃ brahmahatyāvināśinīm / tatra viśramamāṇaśca śaṅkarastripurāntakaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you of the form of Vasafkara. Obeisance to you, O Antatmsn (soul of all ends). Obeisance to you, the creator, the sustainer, and the annihilator, to the Hotr and the destroyer.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्नता हो रही थी  ऋषिवन्द ! किन्तु उस वामन रूपघारी भगवान् ने अपने तीन पगों से स्व, आकाह एवं प्रथ्वी-तीनों लोकों को नाप लिया, स्वंसमथ प्रभु ने केवल तीन पगों में इस समस्त जगत् को आतक्रान्त कर लिया ।७६-०८। समस्त जीवों के पालक भृतात्मा भगवान् बे उस समय अपने तेजोबल से भास्कर का भी अतिरेक कर दिया था। अपने भहान् प्रखरतेज से महान यशस्वी भगवात् ने समस्त दिशाओों एवं विदिज्ञाओं को प्रभासित कर दिया था  समस्त लोकों को प्रकाशित करनेवाले भगवान् की उस समय अपूब श्योभा हुई थी । जनार्दन भगवान् ने इस प्रकार समस्त आसुरी सम्पत्ति एवं समृद्धि को छौनकर नमुचि, शम्बर, प्रह्लाद प्रभृति असुरों को पुत्र पोत्रादिकों समेत पाताल लोक को पहुंचा दिया था ७६-८०८। क्रूर प्रकृति देत्यों को भगवान् विष्णु ने भार डाला था और कितनों को भय से कम्पित कर अन्यान्य दिशाओं में भगरा विया था। भूतात्मा,
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you of the form of Vasafkara. Obeisance to you, O Antatmsn (soul of all ends). Obeisance to you, the creator, the sustainer, and the annihilator, to the Hotr and the destroyer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you of the form of Vasafkara. Obeisance to you, O Antatmsn (soul of all ends). Obeisance to you, the creator, the sustainer, and the annihilator, to the Hotr and the destroyer.

verses.sanskrit: स शङ्करो ब्रह्महत्याविहीनं मेने आत्मानं तस्य तीर्थस्य भावात् । सुविस्मितो देवदेवो वरेण्यो दृष्ट्वा दूरे ब्रह्महत्यां च तीर्थात्
verses.transliteration: sa śaṅkaro brahmahatyāvihīnaṃ mene ātmānaṃ tasya tīrthasya bhāvāt / suvismito devadevo vareṇyo dṛṣṭvā dūre brahmahatyāṃ ca tīrthāt
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, of the form of Kala, past,
verses.hindi: लक्ष्मीपति भगवान् ने इस प्रकार समस्त जीवों एवं पृथ्वी आकाशादि महाभूतों को भी सुक्ती कर दिया था, उस समय उन्होंने समस्त कालों में वतंमान रहनेवाले अपने अद्भुत स्वरूप को ब्राह्मणों को दिश्लाया था। उन ब्राह्मणों ने जगदात्मा के उस शरीर में समस्त चराचर जगत् का दर्शन किया था, एवं अपने को भी उनमें स्थित देखा था। उस्होंने देखा कि जगत् में कोई ऐसी वस्तु की सत्ता नहीं है, जिसमें वह महान् आत्मा
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, of the form of Kala, past,
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, of the form of Kala, past,

verses.sanskrit: विधौतपापं महितं धर्मशक्त्या विशेन्न हत्या देवीभयात् प्रभीता । रक्ताम्बरा रक्तमाल्योपयुक्ता कृष्णा नारी रक्तदामप्रसक्ता
verses.transliteration: vidhautapāpaṃ mahitaṃ dharmaśaktyā viśenna hatyā devībhayāt prabhītā / raktāmbarā raktamālyopayuktā kṛṣṇā nārī raktadāmaprasaktā
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the Visva (Visvedevas), to
verses.hindi: व्याप्त न हो । उस समय भगवान् विष्णु के उस महान् तेज से विमोहित देवताओं, दानवो एवं मनुष्यों ने उपेस्द्र के उस अद्भुत रूप का दर्शन किया था और वे सब मोह को प्राप्त हो गये थे । सुदृद् एवं परिवार वर्ग के साथ बलि को पाश में बाँधकरय विरोचन के समस्त कुल को पाताल लोक में प्रविष्ट करा दिया ।८१-८६। तदनस्तर संसार के समस्त ऐश्वर्य को महात्मा इन्द्र को प्रदान किया। महाबाहु जनार्दन मनुष्य त्रेयायुगे तु दशमे दत्तात्रेयो बन्ूव ह। नष्टे धर्मे चतुश्व मार्कण्डेयपुरः सरः ८८
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the Visva (Visvedevas), to
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the Visva (Visvedevas), to

verses.sanskrit: मां वाञ्छन्ती स्कन्धदेशं रहस्ये दूरे स्थिता तीर्थवर्यप्रभावात् । संचिन्त्य देवो मनसा स्मरारिर्वासाय बुद्धिं तत्र तीर्थे चकार
verses.transliteration: māṃ vāñchantī skandhadeśaṃ rahasye dūre sthitā tīrthavaryaprabhāvāt / saṃcintya devo manasā smarārirvāsāya buddhiṃ tatra tīrthe cakāra
verses.translation: You are Daksina> Avabhrtha (sacred ablution of con¬ cluding rites), and the Tajna itself. You are Tapas (penance), Satya (truth), Tyaga (renunciation) and &ama (self-control).
verses.hindi: एकोनरविशे विशे त्रतायां सर्वेक्षत्र सर्वेक्षत्रान्तको5भवत् । जामदग्न्यस्तथा षष्ठो विश्वामित्रपुरःसरः)
verses.wordMeaning: You are Daksina> Avabhrtha (sacred ablution of con¬ cluding rites), and the Tajna itself. You are Tapas (penance), Satya (truth), Tyaga (renunciation) and &ama (self-control).
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Daksina> Avabhrtha (sacred ablution of con¬ cluding rites), and the Tajna itself. You are Tapas (penance), Satya (truth), Tyaga (renunciation) and &ama (self-control).

verses.sanskrit: विमृश्य देवो बहुशः स्थितः स्वयं विधौतपापः प्रथितः पृथिव्याम् । बभूव तत्रैव निवासकारी विधूतपापनिकटप्रदेशे
verses.transliteration: vimṛśya devo bahuśaḥ sthitaḥ svayaṃ vidhautapāpaḥ prathitaḥ pṛthivyām / babhūva tatraiva nivāsakārī vidhūtapāpanikaṭapradeśe
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the embodiment of nonviolence and non-covetousness. You are of good demeanour, the surpass¬ ing one. Obeisance to you, the Yogatman (ofYogic Soul), the soul of all living beings.
verses.hindi: अष्टमो द्वापरे विष्णुरष्टाविशे पराशरात् । द्वापरे विष्णुरष्टाविशे पराशरात् । बेदव्यासस्ततो जज्ञे जातुकर्णपुरःसरः ९२ + तथब नवसो विष्णुरदित्या: कश्यपात्मज: । देवक्या वसुदेवात्तु ब्रह्मगाग्यंपु रःसरः 8३ अप्रसेयो नियोज्यश्र यत्र कामचरों वशी । क्लीडते भगवाँललोके बाल: क़ौडनकरिव ३६४ न प्रमातुं महाबाहुः शक्योइसों मधुसूदनः । परं॑ परममेतस्माद्िश्वरूपान्न विद्यते ६५ अष्टविशतिमे तद्द्वापरस्वांशसंक्षये । नष्टे धर्में तदा जज्ञे विष्णवंष्णिकुले प्रभु:
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the embodiment of nonviolence and non-covetousness. You are of good demeanour, the surpass¬ ing one. Obeisance to you, the Yogatman (ofYogic Soul), the soul of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the embodiment of nonviolence and non-covetousness. You are of good demeanour, the surpass¬ ing one. Obeisance to you, the Yogatman (ofYogic Soul), the soul of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति राजेन्द्र ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम् । विधौतपापं तत्तीर्थं नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti rājendra brahmahatyāvināśanam / vidhautapāpaṃ tattīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, of the form of all worlds, the earth, the firmament, the heaven, Mahar, Jana, Tapas and Satya (Lokas).
verses.hindi: कर्तु धमंव्यवस्थानमसुराणां प्रणाशनम । मोहयन्सबंभुतानि योगात्मा'योगभायया ॥€७
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, of the form of all worlds, the earth, the firmament, the heaven, Mahar, Jana, Tapas and Satya (Lokas).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, of the form of all worlds, the earth, the firmament, the heaven, Mahar, Jana, Tapas and Satya (Lokas).

verses.sanskrit: आश्वयुक्शुक्लनवमी तत्र तीर्थे विशिष्यते । दिनत्रयं तु राजेन्द्र सप्तम्यादिविशेषतः
verses.transliteration: āśvayukśuklanavamī tatra tīrthe viśiṣyate / dinatrayaṃ tu rājendra saptamyādiviśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the unmanifest, the great, the ele¬ ment, the sense organs, the Tanmatras, the end of the Mahat. Obeisance to you, of the form of the Reality.
verses.hindi: योनि में भी उत्पन्न हुए थे । उनकी ये तीन सम्भूतिमां कल्माणदायिती देवयोनि को थीं । मनुष्य योनि में उनकी जो सात सम्भूतियाँ हैं. वे भी मृगु के शापवश हुई थीं, उन्हें सुनिये । दसवें त्रेतायून में, जब कि धर्म का 'ह्वास हो रहा था, मार्केण्डेय के साथ दत्ताश्रेय के रूप में उत्पन्न हुए थे, यह उनका चतुर्थ अवतार था। पहरदरहवें शेतायुग में चक्रवर्ती सम्राट मान्धाता के शासनकाल में तथ्य समेत उनका अवतार हुआ था, यह पाचर्वा अवतार था ।5७-९ ०। फिर उच्नीसवें त्रेंतायुग में विद्वामित्र के साथ जमदग्नि के पुत्र परशुराम के रूप में समस्त क्षत्रियकुलसंहारक होकश उस्होंने छठवाँ अवतार धारण किया था। फिर चौबीसवें त्रेतायुग में प्रोहित वसिष्ठ के साथ रावण के विनाशार्थ“दशरथ पुत्र रामचमन्द्र के रूप में उन्होंने सातवीं बार जन्म ग्रहण किया। इसी प्रकार गटठाइसतें द्वापरयुग में भगवान् विष्ण ने जातृकर्ण के साथ भहषि पराशर के संयोग से वेदव्यास
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the unmanifest, the great, the ele¬ ment, the sense organs, the Tanmatras, the end of the Mahat. Obeisance to you, of the form of the Reality.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the unmanifest, the great, the ele¬ ment, the sense organs, the Tanmatras, the end of the Mahat. Obeisance to you, of the form of the Reality.

verses.sanskrit: समुपोष्याष्टमीं भक्त्या साङ्गं वेदं पठेत्तु यः । अहोरात्रेण चैकेन ऋग्यजुःसामसंज्ञकम्
verses.transliteration: samupoṣyāṣṭamīṃ bhaktyā sāṅgaṃ vedaṃ paṭhettu yaḥ / ahorātreṇa caikena ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñakam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the eternal one, the Arthalinga (of meaningful index?), the subtle one, the sentient, the pure, the omnipresent, the permanent soul.
verses.hindi: के रूप में आठवाँ अवतार धारण किया था। उसी प्रकार नवीं घार अदिति स्वरूप देवकी के गर्भ के कश्यप स्वरूप वसुदेव के पुत्र होकर ब्रह्म और गार््य के साथ विष्ण ने अवतार धारण किया था  उन भगवान् का धर्णत शब्दों द्वारा नहीं किया जा सकता । वे भक्तों के उपकार करनेवाले हैं, इच्छानुरूव विचरण करनेवाले हैं, जितेन्द्रिय हैं, लोक में भगवान् उसी तरह की क्रीडा करते हैं जैसे बालक खिलौनों से ।६१-९१४५। वे महाबाह मधुसूदन
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the eternal one, the Arthalinga (of meaningful index?), the subtle one, the sentient, the pure, the omnipresent, the permanent soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the eternal one, the Arthalinga (of meaningful index?), the subtle one, the sentient, the pure, the omnipresent, the permanent soul.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यसन्ब्रह्महत्याया मुच्यते नात्र संशयः । वृषलीगमनं चैव यश्च गुर्वङ्गनागमः
verses.transliteration: abhyasanbrahmahatyāyā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / vṛṣalīgamanaṃ caiva yaśca gurvaṅganāgamaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you in the three worlds beginning with Bhuh and ending with Svah (i.e. Bhuh, Bhuvah and Svah) and in the four worlds beginning with Satya and ending with Mahahi (i.e. Satya, Tapas, Jana and Mahah).
verses.hindi: शब्दों द्वारा प्रमाणित बहीं किये जा सकते  यह समस्त बघिदुव उन्हीं से व्याप्त है, वे इससे भी परे हैं, स्वरूप में इनके समान कोई नहीं है। अट्ठाइसवें द्वापरयुग के कुछ अंश व्यतीत हो जाने पर, जब  एतच्चिद्वाम्तर्गतग्नन्थो घ. पुस्तके नारित । +अय॑ शलोको म विद्यते घ. छः. पुस्तकयो: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you in the three worlds beginning with Bhuh and ending with Svah (i.e. Bhuh, Bhuvah and Svah) and in the four worlds beginning with Satya and ending with Mahahi (i.e. Satya, Tapas, Jana and Mahah).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you in the three worlds beginning with Bhuh and ending with Svah (i.e. Bhuh, Bhuvah and Svah) and in the four worlds beginning with Satya and ending with Mahahi (i.e. Satya, Tapas, Jana and Mahah).

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा ब्रह्मरसोत्कृष्टे कुम्भेनैव प्रमुच्यते । वन्ध्या स्त्रीजननी या तु काकवन्ध्या मृतप्रजा
verses.transliteration: snātvā brahmarasotkṛṣṭe kumbhenaiva pramucyate / vandhyā strījananī yā tu kākavandhyā mṛtaprajā
verses.translation: O lord, you are friend and sympathiser of Brahmanas. In this prayer of obeisance both correct and incorrect things 1 have been uttered by me. It behoves you to forgive everything thinking like "He is my devotee".
verses.hindi: यत्र कंसं च साल्‍व च हिविदं व महासरम् । अरिष्टं वुषभं चेव पुतनां केशिनं हयम् ३६९
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, you are friend and sympathiser of Brahmanas. In this prayer of obeisance both correct and incorrect things 1 have been uttered by me. It behoves you to forgive everything thinking like "He is my devotee".
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you are friend and sympathiser of Brahmanas. In this prayer of obeisance both correct and incorrect things 1 have been uttered by me. It behoves you to forgive everything thinking like "He is my devotee".

verses.sanskrit: सापि कुम्भोदकैः स्नाता जीवत्पुत्रा प्रजावती । अपठस्तु नर उपोष्य ऋग्यजुःसामसम्भवाम्
verses.transliteration: sāpi kumbhodakaiḥ snātā jīvatputrā prajāvatī / apaṭhastu nara upoṣya ṛgyajuḥsāmasambhavām
verses.translation: After propitiating Isana, Nilalohita, the lord of Devas, Sukra spoke words of prayer bowing to him with palms joined in reverence uttering Brahman (Vedic Mantras). Siva who was delighted, touched the body of Kavya with his hand, accorded him a full vision of His own form and vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: छिन्नं बाहसहल्ल॑ च बाणस्यथाद्भुतकर्मण: । नरकश्न हतः संख्ये यवनश्र महाबलः . १०१ एते लोकहितार्थाय प्रादुर्भावा महात्मनः । अस्पमिश्ेव युगे क्षोणे संध्या ज्चिष्टे भविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: After propitiating Isana, Nilalohita, the lord of Devas, Sukra spoke words of prayer bowing to him with palms joined in reverence uttering Brahman (Vedic Mantras). Siva who was delighted, touched the body of Kavya with his hand,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After propitiating Isana, Nilalohita, the lord of Devas, Sukra spoke words of prayer bowing to him with palms joined in reverence uttering Brahman (Vedic Mantras). Siva who was delighted, touched the body of Kavya with his hand,…

verses.sanskrit: ऋचमेकां जपन्विप्रस्तथा पर्वणि यो नृप । अनृचोपोष्य गायत्रीं जपेद्वै वेदमातरम्
verses.transliteration: ṛcamekāṃ japanviprastathā parvaṇi yo nṛpa / anṛcopoṣya gāyatrīṃ japedvai vedamātaram
verses.translation: When the lord of the Devas 2 had vanished, he spoke the following words to Jayanti who was standing near him, with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: कल्किविष्णुयशा नाम पाराशयें: प्रतापवान्। दशमो भाव्यसंभुतो याज्ञवल्क्यपुरःसरः ३१०४ अनुकर्ष न्सबंसेनां हस्त्यश्वरथसंकुलाम् । प्रगृहीतायुधविप्रेव,तः शतसह्शः १०५
verses.wordMeaning: When the lord of the Devas 2 had vanished, he spoke the following words to Jayanti who was standing near him, with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the lord of the Devas 2 had vanished, he spoke the following words to Jayanti who was standing near him, with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: जपन्नवम्यां विप्रेन्द्रो मुच्यते पापसञ्चयात् । एवं तु कथितं तात पुराणोक्तं महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: japannavamyāṃ viprendro mucyate pāpasañcayāt / evaṃ tu kathitaṃ tāta purāṇoktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: The reading 'sadasat' needs emendation as ' yadasat' as in Bd. 3.72,. 195 as there is no point in begging pardon for saying correct things.
verses.hindi: नात्यर्थ धा्िका ये च ये च धर्मद्विषः क्वचित् । उदीच्यान्मध्यदेशांश्र तथा विन्ध्यापरान्तिकान् ३१०६ तथैव दाक्षिणात्पांश्व द्रविडान्सिहलेः सह  गान्धारान्पारदांश्वव पछ्लवान्यवनाक्शकानू. धर्म नष्ट हो जाता है तो थे प्रभ॒विष्णु वुष्णिवंश में धर्म की संस्थापना एवं अधर्म के विनाश के लिए जन्म धारण करते हैं। योगात्मा अपनो योगमाया से समस्त जीवनिकायों को मोहित कर मनुष्य योनि में जन्म घारण करने पर भी प्रच्छन्न स्वरूप से समस्त पृथ्वी भर में विचरण करते हैं। उस अवतार में सान्दीपनि के साथ मानव समाज में अपनी लीला दिखाने के लिये वे भगवान् प्रादुर्भत होते हैं ।९६-६६॥। उस अवतार में कंस,
verses.wordMeaning: The reading 'sadasat' needs emendation as ' yadasat' as in Bd. 3.72,. 195 as there is no point in begging pardon for saying correct things.
verses.commentary: Sense: The reading 'sadasat' needs emendation as ' yadasat' as in Bd. 3.72,. 195 as there is no point in begging pardon for saying correct things.

verses.sanskrit: धौतपापं महापुण्यं शिवेन कथितं मम । प्राणत्यागं तु यः कुर्याज्जले वाग्नौ स्थले ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: dhautapāpaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śivena kathitaṃ mama / prāṇatyāgaṃ tu yaḥ kuryājjale vāgnau sthale 'pi vā
verses.translation: The obscure reading dtveSinucare is probably a scribal error and should be emended as deoe sinucare 'God (Siva) along with his retinue'. Bd. 3.73.3 supports the emendation suggested.
verses.hindi: सालव, द्विविद, अरिष्ट, वृषभ, पूतना, केशी, नाग, कुवलयापीड, मल्लराज गृहाधिप प्रभृूति अथुरों का, जो मानवदेहधानी देत्य थे, महाबलशाली भगवान् ने संहार किया  उसी अवतार में उन्होंने अद्भुत पराक्रम- शाली बाणासुर की सहख्र बाहुओं को काट डाला था। युद्ध में महान पराक्रमो नरकासुर एवं कालयवन का वध किया था। बड़े-बढ़े राजाओं के समस्त बहुमूल्य रत्नों के आभूषणादि को उन्होंने अपने अनृपम
verses.wordMeaning: The obscure reading dtveSinucare is probably a scribal error and should be emended as deoe sinucare 'God (Siva) along with his retinue'. Bd. 3.73.3 supports the emendation suggested.
verses.commentary: Sense: The obscure reading dtveSinucare is probably a scribal error and should be emended as deoe sinucare 'God (Siva) along with his retinue'. Bd. 3.73.3 supports the emendation suggested.

verses.sanskrit: स गच्छति विमानेन ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभः । हंसबर्हिप्रयुक्तेन सेव्यमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: sa gacchati vimānena jvalanārkasamaprabhaḥ / haṃsabarhiprayuktena sevyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: "O beautiful lady, whose (daughter) are you? When I was distressed, you too were distressed. Who are you? What for did you take care of me when I was performing the great penance?
verses.hindi: तेज से छीन लिया था । उसी समय उन भगवान् ने रसातल निवासी अनेक पापाचारपरायण भूषतियों का भी संहार किया था ।१००-१०३। महान् ऐश्वयंशालो भगवान् के ये अवतार लोक रक्षा के लिए हुए थे। इसी कलियुग के सन्ध्यांश में जबकि इसकी समाप्ति हो जायगी, पराशर तनय प्रतापशाली विष्णुयज्ञा, याज्ञवल्कूय के साथ कल्कि नामक अवतार धारण करेंगे। यह उनका दसवाँ अवतार होगा । ये अनेक प्रकार की सेना साथ लेकर, जिसमें हाथी, घोड़े और रथों की भरमार रहेगी, लाखों को संख्या में शस्त्रासत्र से सुसज्जित विप्रगणों से संयुक्त होकर एक महान् विनाश उपस्थित करेंगे। उस समय जितने घोर अधापिक होंगे, धर्म से द्वेष करनेवाले होंगे, उत्तर दिग्वर्ती, मध्यदेशीय विन्ध्यगिरि के उस पार के रहनेवाले, सुदूर दक्षिण दिशा के द्रविणादि, सिंहल देशीय, गान्धार, पारद, पह्छलुत, यवन, शक्त,
verses.wordMeaning: "O beautiful lady, whose (daughter) are you? When I was distressed, you too were distressed. Who are you? What for did you take care of me when I was performing the great penance?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O beautiful lady, whose (daughter) are you? When I was distressed, you too were distressed. Who are you? What for did you take care of me when I was performing the great penance?

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य परमं स्थानं यत्सुरैरपि दुर्लभम् । क्रीडते स्वेच्छया तत्र यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकम्
verses.transliteration: śivasya paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatsurairapi durlabham / krīḍate svecchayā tatra yāvaccandrārkatārakam
verses.translation: O lady of beautiful hips, O fair-complexioned one, I am delighted with your steady devotion, humility, self-control and affection.
verses.hindi: अष्टनवरतितमोअध्याय! हैप७
verses.wordMeaning: O lady of beautiful hips, O fair-complexioned one, I am delighted with your steady devotion, humility, self-control and affection.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of beautiful hips, O fair-complexioned one, I am delighted with your steady devotion, humility, self-control and affection.

verses.sanskrit: धौतपापे तु या नारी कुरुते प्राणसंक्षयम् । तत्क्षणादेव सा पार्थ पुरुषत्वमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: dhautapāpe tu yā nārī kurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam / tatkṣaṇādeva sā pārtha puruṣatvamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: O beautiful damsel, what do you wish? What is your cherished desire which should be fully gratified? Even if it be very difficult to be fulfilled, I shall get it realised (for you) On being asked thus, JayantI said: "O sage merged in Brahman, it behoves you to know it by means of the power of your penance. In fact, you already know precisely what I have desired to achieve".
verses.hindi: तुषारान्यबंरांश्वेव पुलिन्दान्दरदान्लसान् । लम्पकानम्प्रकान्रद्रान्किरातांश्वेव स॒प्रभुः १०८ मानव: स तु संजज्ञे देवस्यांशेन धोमतः । पूर्व॑जन्सनि विष्णुयें: प्रसितिर्नाम बीयंवान् ॥११०- गात्रेण वे चन्द्रसमः पूर्ण कलियुगे5भवत् । इत्येतास्तस्थ देवस्य दश संभूतयः स्मृताः ॥ै१११
verses.wordMeaning: O beautiful damsel, what do you wish? What is your cherished desire which should be fully gratified? Even if it be very difficult to be fulfilled, I shall get it realised (for you) On being asked thus, JayantI said: "O sage merged in Brahman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O beautiful damsel, what do you wish? What is your cherished desire which should be fully gratified? Even if it be very difficult to be fulfilled, I shall get it realised (for you) On being asked thus, JayantI said: "O sage merged in Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: अथ किं बहुनोक्तेन शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् । तदक्षयफलं सर्वं धौतपापे कृतं नृप
verses.transliteration: atha kiṃ bahunoktena śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham / tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ dhautapāpe kṛtaṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: On being told thus, the sage saw everything by means of his divine vision and said: <c O beautiful maiden, you are the daughter of Mahendra. You have come here to render service to me.
verses.hindi: तं त॑ काल च कायं च तत्तदुहिश्य कारणम् । अंशेन त्रिषु लोकेषु तास्ता योनी: प्रपत्स्यते
verses.wordMeaning: On being told thus, the sage saw everything by means of his divine vision and said: <c O beautiful maiden, you are the daughter of Mahendra. You have come here to render service to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being told thus, the sage saw everything by means of his divine vision and said: <c O beautiful maiden, you are the daughter of Mahendra. You have come here to render service to me.

verses.sanskrit: संन्यसेन्नियमेनान्नं संन्यसेद् विषयादिकम् । फलमूलादिकं चैव जलमेकं न संत्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃnyasenniyamenānnaṃ saṃnyased viṣayādikam / phalamūlādikaṃ caiva jalamekaṃ na saṃtyajet
verses.translation: O woman of beautiful lips, O lustrous woman, you desire to live in contact with me for ten years without being seen by any other living being. O beautiful lady with (brilliant) complexion of the Lord of Devas and of fire*! O lady of beautiful eyes, you choose (the fulfilment of your) desire from me, O lady of sweet voice.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा बीजावशेषां तु महीं क्रेण कर्मणा  संशातयित्वा वृषलान्पायशस्तानधामिकान् ततः स वे तदा कल्किश्ररितार्थ: ससेनिकः । कर्मणा निहता ये तु सिद्धास्ते तु पुनः स्वयम
verses.wordMeaning: O woman of beautiful lips, O lustrous woman, you desire to live in contact with me for ten years without being seen by any other living being. O beautiful lady with (brilliant) complexion of the Lord of Devas and of fire*! O lady of beautiful eyes,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O woman of beautiful lips, O lustrous woman, you desire to live in contact with me for ten years without being seen by any other living being. O beautiful lady with (brilliant) complexion of the Lord of Devas and of fire*! O lady of beautiful eyes,…

verses.sanskrit: एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति । तत्र भुक्ताखिलान्भोगाञ्जायते भुवि भूपतिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha rudralokaṃ sa gacchati / tatra bhuktākhilānbhogāñjāyate bhuvi bhūpatiḥ
verses.translation: Let it be, O fascinating woman, we shall go home". Thereafter the holy lord returned to his abode, accompanied by Jayanti.
verses.hindi: गड्भायमुनयोमंध्ये निष्ठां प्राप्स्यति सानुगः । ततो व्यतीते कल्कौ तु सामास्येः (त्ये:)सह सेनिकः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Let it be, O fascinating woman, we shall go home". Thereafter the holy lord returned to his abode, accompanied by Jayanti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let it be, O fascinating woman, we shall go home". Thereafter the holy lord returned to his abode, accompanied by Jayanti.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे धौतपापतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुरशीत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १८५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल एरण्डीतीर्थमुत्तमम् । स्नानमात्रेण तत्रैव ब्रह्महत्या प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dhautapāpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturaśītyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 185 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla eraṇḍītīrthamuttamam / snānamātreṇa tatraiva brahmahatyā praṇaśyati
verses.translation: He stayed along with her for ten years. Being envelop¬ ed with Maya (illusive power), he was invisible to all living beings.
verses.hindi: तुषार, बबंर, पुलिन्द, दरद, खस, लम्पक, अन्ज्क, रुद्र, किरात प्रभूति सबको परम ऐश्वयंशाली, बलवान, स्लेच्छों को नष्ट करने वाले भगवान् नष्ट कर देंगे और समस्त जीवों से अद्रय रहकर पृथ्वी भर में विचरण करेंगे। १०४-१०६। जो भगवान् विष्ण पूर्वजन्म में परमबलशाली प्रमिति के रूप में वर्तमान रहते हैं, वे ही देवांश भूत होरर मनुष्य योति में जन्म धारण करते हैं। कलियुग के पूर्ण हो जाने पर चन्द्रमा के समान शरीर धारण कर वे ही उत्पन्न हुए थे । उन परम महिमामय भगवान् की ये दस सम्भूतियाँ (अवतार) कही गईं हैं। जो-जो समय, शरीर, और कारण भगवान् के अबतारों के लिये ऊपर कहे गये हैं, उनकी परिस्थिति के अनुसार अंधावतार भगवान विष्णु ते उन योनियों में जन्म धारण किया ।११०-११२। पच्चीसवों कल्प आते वर पच्चीस वर्ष जब व्यतीत हो जाता है, उस समय भगवान् समस्त जीवों का विनाश करते हुए मनुष्यों को
verses.wordMeaning: He stayed along with her for ten years. Being envelop¬ ed with Maya (illusive power), he was invisible to all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He stayed along with her for ten years. Being envelop¬ ed with Maya (illusive power), he was invisible to all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: मासि चाश्वयुजे तत्र शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् । उपोष्य प्रयतः स्नातस्तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: māsi cāśvayuje tatra śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm / upoṣya prayataḥ snātastarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing (learning) that Kavya had returned after realising his desires, all Daityas delightedly came to his house desirous of seeing him.
verses.hindi: सर्वाधतः नष्ट करते हुए, अपने ऋर कर्म द्वारा प्रृथ्वी को बीजावशेष कर देते हैं, अपर कहे गये उन परम अधामिक बुषलों का संहार कर सेनाओं के समेत अपने अवतार धारण को वे चरितार्थ (सफल) कर देते हैं। उस समय की प्रजाएँ अपने कर्मों द्वारा यद्यपि नाश को प्राप्त हो जाती हैं, फिर भी उन्हें पुनः स्वयमेव सिद्धि प्राप्त होती है । तदनन्तर अकस्मात् वे आपस में ही एक दूसरे के ऊपर मोहबरश कृषित हो जाँयगी, भावीवश
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing (learning) that Kavya had returned after realising his desires, all Daityas delightedly came to his house desirous of seeing him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing (learning) that Kavya had returned after realising his desires, all Daityas delightedly came to his house desirous of seeing him.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रर्द्धिरूपसम्पन्नो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् । शिवलोकं मृतो याति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: putrarddhirūpasampanno jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam / śivalokaṃ mṛto yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Sukra said: "O gentle lady, let us go to see your disciples, O lady of sweet smiles and of tremulous eyes, O chaste lady, O lady of large eyes of three colours".
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार के गृह कलह में निरत उन सारी प्रजा ओ का विनाश कर अपने अनुचरों समेत वे भगवान् गज़ा यमुना के संगम पर अस्ने इस घोर कमे की समाप्ति करेंगे (१ १३-११६१। तदन्तर कल्कि रूपधारी भगवान् के अवसान हो जाने पर, साधारण सैनिकों के साथ राजाओं के नष्ट हो जाने पर प्रजाएँ आशभ्रय-विहीन हो
verses.wordMeaning: Sukra said: "O gentle lady, let us go to see your disciples, O lady of sweet smiles and of tremulous eyes, O chaste lady, O lady of large eyes of three colours".
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukra said: "O gentle lady, let us go to see your disciples, O lady of sweet smiles and of tremulous eyes, O chaste lady, O lady of large eyes of three colours".

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे एरण्डीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाशीत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १८६ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल तीर्थं कनखलोत्तमम् । गरुडेन तपस्तप्तं पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe eraṇḍītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśītyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 186 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ kanakhalottamam / garuḍena tapastaptaṃ pūjayitvā maheśvaram
verses.translation: The lady replied: "O sage of great holy rites, please resort to your disciples. It is the sacred Dharma, O Brahmana. I shall not make you swerve from it."
verses.hindi: जायेंगी । अपनी रक्षा करने का भी उत्हें साहस नहीं रहेगा, आपस में युद्ध कर एक दूसरे को मार
verses.wordMeaning: The lady replied: "O sage of great holy rites, please resort to your disciples. It is the sacred Dharma, O Brahmana. I shall not make you swerve from it."
verses.commentary: Sense: The lady replied: "O sage of great holy rites, please resort to your disciples. It is the sacred Dharma, O Brahmana. I shall not make you swerve from it."

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं वर्षशतं यावज्जातमात्रेण भारत । तपोजपैः कृशीभूतो दृष्टो देवेन शम्भुना
verses.transliteration: divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ yāvajjātamātreṇa bhārata / tapojapaiḥ kṛśībhūto dṛṣṭo devena śambhunā
verses.translation: Then he went to Asuras and saw that they had been deceived by the intelligent preceptor of Devas by assuming the form ofKavya. He spoke to Asuras:
verses.hindi: परास्परहृताश्वासा निराक़न्दाः सुदुःद्धिता: । पुराणि हित्वा ग्रामांश्र तुल्यास्ता निष्परिग्रहाः प्रनष्टभु तिधर्माश्व॒ नष्टर्माश्रमास्तथा । हस्वा अल्पायुषश्चेव भविष्यन्ति बनौकसः १२० सरित्पवेतसेविन्य: पत्रमुलफलाशना: । चीरपत्राजिनधराः संकरं.वे रमास्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Then he went to Asuras and saw that they had been deceived by the intelligent preceptor of Devas by assuming the form ofKavya. He spoke to Asuras:
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he went to Asuras and saw that they had been deceived by the intelligent preceptor of Devas by assuming the form ofKavya. He spoke to Asuras:

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो वैनतेयं मनोजवम् । उवाच परमं वाक्यं विनतानन्दवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: tatastuṣṭo mahādevo vainateyaṃ manojavam / uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ vinatānandavardhanam
verses.translation: "O dear ones, know me to be the (real) Kavya. This is the son of Angiras. O Danavas, in spite of my power, you have been deceived".
verses.hindi: अल्पायुषो नष्टवार्ता बह्बाबाधाः सुदुःखिताः । एवं कष्टमनृप्राप्ता: कलिसंध्यांशके तता. ७१२२
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear ones, know me to be the (real) Kavya. This is the son of Angiras. O Danavas, in spite of my power, you have been deceived".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear ones, know me to be the (real) Kavya. This is the son of Angiras. O Danavas, in spite of my power, you have been deceived".

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नस्ते महाभाग वरं वरय सुव्रत । दुर्लभं त्रिषु लोकेषु ददामि तव खेचर
verses.transliteration: prasannaste mahābhāga varaṃ varaya suvrata / durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu dadāmi tava khecara
verses.translation: On hearing him speak thus, Daityas were confused. They looked at both of them smiling pleasantly.*
verses.hindi: प्रपत्स्यन्ते यथान्यायं स्वभावादेवन नास्यथा । इत्येतत्कोतितं सर्व॑ देवासुरविचेष्टितम् इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते विष्णमाहात्म्यकथनं नामाष्टनवतितमो5्ध्याय; ॥।ह५॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing him speak thus, Daityas were confused. They looked at both of them smiling pleasantly.*
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing him speak thus, Daityas were confused. They looked at both of them smiling pleasantly.*

verses.sanskrit: गरुड उवाच: इच्छामि वाहनं विष्णोर्द्विजेन्द्रत्वं सुरेश्वर । प्रसन्ने त्वयि मे सर्वं भवत्विति मतिर्मम
verses.transliteration: garuḍa uvāca: icchāmi vāhanaṃ viṣṇordvijendratvaṃ sureśvara / prasanne tvayi me sarvaṃ bhavatviti matirmama
verses.translation: They stood there utterly confused. They were unable to understand anything. When they were (seen) confused like this, Kavya spoke to them again:
verses.hindi: काट डालेंगे, परस्पर विश्वास कोई नहीं करेगा, उनके सारे उत्साह नष्ट हो जायेंगे । इस प्रकार परम दुःखित होकर वे अपने पुरों एवं ग्रामों को छोड़कर साधनविहीत अवस्था में नदियों एवं प्॑तों को भाग जायेंगे, वेदिक धर्म का उनमें सर्वथा बिलोप हो जायगा, वर्णाश्रम धर्म शष्ट हो जायगा। आकार में छोडे छोटे होने लगेंगे , अल्प आयु हो जायगी, बन में निवास करने लगेंगे ।११७-१२०। वहाँ पर पत्र, मूल, फल
verses.wordMeaning: They stood there utterly confused. They were unable to understand anything. When they were (seen) confused like this, Kavya spoke to them again:
verses.commentary: Sense: They stood there utterly confused. They were unable to understand anything. When they were (seen) confused like this, Kavya spoke to them again:

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमहेश उवाच: दुर्लभः प्राणिनां तात यो वरः प्रार्थितो ऽनघ । देवदेवस्य वाहनं द्विजेन्द्रत्वं सुदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmaheśa uvāca: durlabhaḥ prāṇināṃ tāta yo varaḥ prārthito 'nagha / devadevasya vāhanaṃ dvijendratvaṃ sudurlabham
verses.translation: "I am your preceptor Kavya. This is the praceptor of
verses.hindi: खाकर जीवन यापन करेंगे। चीर, पत्र एवं सृगचर्म धारण करनेवाली वे प्रजाएँ घोर संकरवण्ण की £ हो जायेंगी । अल्प आयु वाली उन प्रजाओं की जीविका आदि के स्राधन भी सब नष्ट हो जायेंगे। अनेक प्रकार की बाधाओं में पिस कर वे परम (घोर) कष्ट सहन करेंगी। कलियुग के उस सल्ध्यांश में प्रजाओं को इस प्रकार के विविध कष्ट सहन करने पड़ेंगे। कलियुग के साथ उसकी प्रजाएं नष्ट हो जायेगी, इस प्रकार उस कलियुग के व्यतीत हो जाने पर जब पुनः सतयुग का प्रारम्भ होगा, उस समय सारी बस्तुएं फिर स्वाभाविक ढंग से अपनी पूर्व स्थिति को प्राप्त होंगी, किसी अन्य उपाय से नहांँ।
verses.wordMeaning: "I am your preceptor Kavya. This is the praceptor of
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am your preceptor Kavya. This is the praceptor of

verses.sanskrit: नारायणोदरे सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । त्वया स कथम् ऊह्येत देवदेवो जगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇodare sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / tvayā sa katham ūhyeta devadevo jagadguruḥ
verses.translation: On being addressed thus, all the Asuras stood gazing at them. They could not see any difference between them.
verses.hindi: के महान् यश का भी वर्णन कर दिया गया, अब आगे तुवव॑सु' पूर और द्रह्म. के वंश का वर्णन कर रहा
verses.wordMeaning: On being addressed thus, all the Asuras stood gazing at them. They could not see any difference between them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being addressed thus, all the Asuras stood gazing at them. They could not see any difference between them.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव स्थापितश्चेन्द्रस्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे । कथमन्यस्य चेन्द्रत्वं भवतीति सुदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: tenaiva sthāpitaścendrastrailokye sacarācare / kathamanyasya cendratvaṃ bhavatīti sudurlabham
verses.translation: Unperturbed by anything, Brhaspati told them: "O Daityas, this is Anginas. I am Kavya, your preceptor. This is Brhaspati in my guise. O Asuras, he deludes you all by assum¬ ing my form". On hearing his words, they consulted one another and spoke these words:
verses.hindi: श्री वायुमद्ापुराण में विष्णुमाहात्म्य कथन नामक अट्ठानबैवाँ अध्याय समाप्त करन्धमस््रिसानोस्तु मर्तस्य तु चा55तसजः । अन्यस्त्वाविक्षितो राजा मरुत्तः कथितः पुरा 0२ अनपत्यो मरत्तस्तु स राजा55सो दिति श्रुतः । दुष्कृतं पोरव चापि सर्वे पुत्रसकल्पयन्
verses.wordMeaning: Unperturbed by anything, Brhaspati told them: "O Daityas, this is Anginas. I am Kavya, your preceptor. This is Brhaspati in my guise. O Asuras, he deludes you all by assum¬ ing my form". On hearing his words, they consulted one another and spoke these words:
verses.commentary: Sense: Unperturbed by anything, Brhaspati told them: "O Daityas, this is Anginas. I am Kavya, your preceptor. This is Brhaspati in my guise. O Asuras, he deludes you all by assum¬ ing my form". On hearing his words, they consulted one another and spoke these words:

verses.sanskrit: तथापि मम वाक्येन वाहनं त्वं भविष्यसि । शङ्खचक्रगदापाणेर् वहतो ऽपि जगत्त्रयम्
verses.transliteration: tathāpi mama vākyena vāhanaṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi / śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇer vahato 'pi jagattrayam
verses.translation: Then all those Danavas bowed to and paid respects to him (Brhaspati in the guise of Kavya). Deluded by a long practice they accepted only his words.
verses.hindi: पाण्ड्यभ्र फेरलश्वैव चोलः कुल्यस्तथेव च् । तेषां जनपदाः कुल्याः पाष्याभ्रोलाः सकेरलाः
verses.wordMeaning: Then all those Danavas bowed to and paid respects to him (Brhaspati in the guise of Kavya). Deluded by a long practice they accepted only his words.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all those Danavas bowed to and paid respects to him (Brhaspati in the guise of Kavya). Deluded by a long practice they accepted only his words.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्त्वं पक्षिणां मध्ये भविष्यसि न संशयः । इति दत्त्वा वरं तस्मा अन्तर्धानं गतो हरः
verses.transliteration: indrastvaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ madhye bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ / iti dattvā varaṃ tasmā antardhānaṃ gato haraḥ
verses.translation: All the infuriated Asuras spoke to him (the real Kavya) (staring at him) with reddened eyes: "This is our preceptor and benefactor. You may go. You are not our precep¬ tor.
verses.hindi: ब्ृह्मस्य तनयो वीरो बच्चन: सेतुश्व विश्रुतो । अरुद्ध:ः सेतुपुत्रस्तु बाधभ्रवो रिपुरुच्यते ७ तुबंसु आदि ययाति पुत्रों के वंश का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: All the infuriated Asuras spoke to him (the real Kavya) (staring at him) with reddened eyes: "This is our preceptor and benefactor. You may go. You are not our precep¬ tor.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the infuriated Asuras spoke to him (the real Kavya) (staring at him) with reddened eyes: "This is our preceptor and benefactor. You may go. You are not our precep¬ tor.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गते महादेवे ह्युरुणस्यानुजो नृप । आराधयामास तदा चामुण्डां मुण्डमण्डिताम्
verses.transliteration: tato gate mahādeve hyuruṇasyānujo nṛpa / ārādhayāmāsa tadā cāmuṇḍāṃ muṇḍamaṇḍitām
verses.translation: Whether heisBhargava (son ofBhrgu) or Angirasa (son of Ahgiras) let him be our preceptor. Wc shall abide by his guidance. Do not tarry (here any longer). That will be in your interest."
verses.hindi: सूत बोले--ययाति पुत्र तुवँसु का पुत्र वक्ति था, वह्लि का उत्र गोभानु हुआ ग्रोभानु का परम वीर त्रितानु था, जो कभी पराजित नहीं हुआ । उस त्रिसानु का पुत्र राजा करण्थम हुआ, और उसका पुत्र मार््त हुआ । आविक्षित का पुत्र मदत्त नामक एक अन्य दा जा भी प्रावीन काल में कहा जाता है। राजा मरुत्ति के कोई सस्ताने नहीं थी-ऐसा सुना जाता है, इसलिये सबलोगों ने पुणवंशीय
verses.wordMeaning: Whether heisBhargava (son ofBhrgu) or Angirasa (son of Ahgiras) let him be our preceptor. Wc shall abide by his guidance. Do not tarry (here any longer). That will be in your interest."
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether heisBhargava (son ofBhrgu) or Angirasa (son of Ahgiras) let him be our preceptor. Wc shall abide by his guidance. Do not tarry (here any longer). That will be in your interest."

verses.sanskrit: श्मशानवासिनीं देवीं बहुभूतसमन्विताम् । योगिनीं योगसंसिद्धां वसामांसासवप्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: śmaśānavāsinīṃ devīṃ bahubhūtasamanvitām / yoginīṃ yogasaṃsiddhāṃ vasāmāṃsāsavapriyām
verses.translation: After saying this, all the Asuras resorted to Brhaspati (as their teacher). When the Asuras did not accept his sugges¬ tion for their great benefit, Bhargava became angry at their arrogance. He told them again: "O Danavas, although I had apprised (and instructed) you, you are not resorting to me. Hence, you will become deficient in sense and will attain defeat after defeat". After saying this to them, Kavya went away the way he had come.
verses.hindi: दुष्कृत को उसका पुत्र बनाया ।१-३। राजा ययाति ने वृद्धत्व को अंग्रीकार न करने के कारण जो शाप तुबंसु को दिया था उसी के कारण तुर्बसु का वंश नष्ट हो गया भौर ओर ऐसी भ्रसिद्धि है कि वह अंत में पुर बंध में मिल गया । उस दुष्कृत का उत्तराधिकारी राजा शरूथ हुआ, शूंथ से जनापीड की उत्पत्ति हुई, उसके चार पुत्र हुए, उनके नाम पराण्डय, केरल, चोल और हुल्य थे। उन स्रबों के अपन अपने जनपद थे, जो पाण्डय, केरल, चोल ओर कुल्य के नाम से विख्यात हैं।४-६। द्रुह्म के दो वोर पुत्र थे, बच्रु और सेतु, इनमें सेतु का पुत्र अरुद्ध हुआ और बच्नु का पुत्र रिपु हुआ  युद्ध में इस बलशाली रिप को परम कठोर स्वभाववाले यौवनाश्व ने मार डाला, वह मद्दाइुद्ध लगातार चौदहु मास तक
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, all the Asuras resorted to Brhaspati (as their teacher). When the Asuras did not accept his sugges¬ tion for their great benefit, Bhargava became angry at their arrogance. He told them again: "O Danavas, although I had apprised (and instructed) you,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, all the Asuras resorted to Brhaspati (as their teacher). When the Asuras did not accept his sugges¬ tion for their great benefit, Bhargava became angry at their arrogance. He told them again: "O Danavas, although I had apprised (and instructed) you,…

verses.sanskrit: ध्यातमात्रा तु तेनैव प्रत्यक्षा ह्यभवत् तदा । जालंधरे च या सिद्धिः कौलीने उड्डिशे परे
verses.transliteration: dhyātamātrā tu tenaiva pratyakṣā hyabhavat tadā / jālaṃdhare ca yā siddhiḥ kaulīne uḍḍiśe pare
verses.translation: Then the Asuras became extremely frightened of the Devas and fled from that place. Keeping Prahlada at the head, they approached Kavya again. On approaching him, they stood there with heads bent down. On seeing his disciples (lit. ones for whose benefit he performed Yajiias) Kavya said to
verses.hindi: धृतस्य दुंमो जज्ञे प्रचेतास्तस्य चा55त्मज: । प्रचेतसः पुत्रशतं राजान: सर्वे एव ते
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Asuras became extremely frightened of the Devas and fled from that place. Keeping Prahlada at the head, they approached Kavya again. On approaching him, they stood there with heads bent down. On seeing his disciples (lit.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Asuras became extremely frightened of the Devas and fled from that place. Keeping Prahlada at the head, they approached Kavya again. On approaching him, they stood there with heads bent down. On seeing his disciples (lit.…

verses.sanskrit: समग्रा सा भृगुक्षेत्रे सिद्धक्षेत्रे तु संस्थिता । चामुण्डा तत्र सा देवी सिद्धक्षेत्रे व्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration: samagrā sā bhṛgukṣetre siddhakṣetre tu saṃsthitā / cāmuṇḍā tatra sā devī siddhakṣetre vyavasthitā
verses.translation: "In spite of being cautioned by me at the proper
verses.hindi: स्लेच्छराष्ट्राधिपा: सर्वे हवा दीचीं दिशमाश्रिता: । अनो: पुत्रा माहात्मानत्लयः परमधासिकाः: सभानरश्न पक्षश्न परपक्षस्तथव च। सभानरस्य पुत्रस्तु विद्वान्कालानलो नपः १३ कालानलस्य धर्मात्मा सुझ्जयो नाम धामिकः । सृठजयस्थाभवत्पुत्रो वीरो राजा पुरंजयः
verses.wordMeaning: "In spite of being cautioned by me at the proper
verses.commentary: Sense: "In spite of being cautioned by me at the proper

verses.sanskrit: संस्तुता ऋषिभिर् देवैर् योगक्षेमार्थसिद्धये । विनतानन्दजननस् तत्र तां योगिनीं नृप । भक्त्या प्रसादयामास स्तोत्रैर्वैदिकलौकिकैः
verses.transliteration: saṃstutā ṛṣibhir devair yogakṣemārthasiddhaye / vinatānandajananas tatra tāṃ yoginīṃ nṛpa / bhaktyā prasādayāmāsa stotrairvaidikalaukikaiḥ
verses.translation: Then Prahlada entreated him: "O Bhargava, (please) give up (forget) your wounded sense of honour. O Bhargava, do not forsake us, your own disciples, particularly attached to you with devotion and prayerfulness.
verses.hindi: आसोीदिन्द्रसमो राजा प्रतिष्ठितयशाः दिवि। महामनाः सुतस्तस्य महाशालस्य धासिक:ः
verses.wordMeaning: Then Prahlada entreated him: "O Bhargava, (please) give up (forget) your wounded sense of honour. O Bhargava, do not forsake us, your own disciples, particularly attached to you with devotion and prayerfulness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Prahlada entreated him: "O Bhargava, (please) give up (forget) your wounded sense of honour. O Bhargava, do not forsake us, your own disciples, particularly attached to you with devotion and prayerfulness.

verses.sanskrit: गरुड उवाच: ॐ या सा क्षुत्क्षामकण्ठा नवरुधिरमुखा प्रेतपद्मासनस्था भूतानां वृन्दवृन्दैः पितृवननिलया क्रीडते शूलहस्ता । शस्त्रध्वस्तप्रवीरव्रजरुधिरगलन्मुण्डमालोत्तरीया देवी श्रीवीरमाता विमलशशिनिभा पातु वश्चर्ममुण्डा
verses.transliteration: garuḍa uvāca: oṃ yā sā kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhā navarudhiramukhā pretapadmāsanasthā bhūtānāṃ vṛndavṛndaiḥ pitṛvananilayā krīḍate śūlahastā / śastradhvastapravīravrajarudhiragalanmuṇḍamālottarīyā devī śrīvīramātā vimalaśaśinibhā pātu vaścarmamuṇḍā
verses.translation: When asked by you, we had been deluded by the preceptor of Devas. Knowing this by means of your long- ranged vision, it behoves you to save us. O son of Bhrgu, ifyou are not going to favour us, we are (no belter than) cursed by you. So we shall enter Rasalala (the nether worlds) to-day."
verses.hindi: +सप्तद्वीपेश्वरो राजा चक्रवर्तो महायशा: । महामनास्तु पुत्रौ दौ जनयामास विश्वुतौ उशोीनरं च॒ धर्मज्ञ तितिक्षुं चेच धासिकम् । उशीनरस्य पत्न्यस्तु पश्च राजधिवंशजाः १८ भृगा कृमी नवा दर्वा पञचमी च दषद्वती । उशीनरस्य पुत्रास्तु पञ्च तासु कुलोद्वहा: ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: When asked by you, we had been deluded by the preceptor of Devas. Knowing this by means of your long- ranged vision, it behoves you to save us. O son of Bhrgu, ifyou are not going to favour us, we are (no belter than) cursed by you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When asked by you, we had been deluded by the preceptor of Devas. Knowing this by means of your long- ranged vision, it behoves you to save us. O son of Bhrgu, ifyou are not going to favour us, we are (no belter than) cursed by you.…

verses.sanskrit: या सा क्षुत्क्षामकण्ठा विकृतभयकरी त्रासिनी दुष्कृतानां मुञ्चज्ज्वालाकलापैर् दशनकसमसैः खादति प्रेतमांसम् । या सा दोर्दण्डचण्डैर् डमरुरणरणाटोपटंकारघण्टैः कल्पान्तोत्पातवाताहतपटुपटहैर् वल्गते भूतमाता । क्षुत्क्षामा शुष्ककुक्षिः खवरतरनरवरैः क्षोदति प्रेतमांसं मुञ्चन्ती चाट्टहासं घुरघुरितरवा पातु वश्चर्ममुण्डा
verses.transliteration: yā sā kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhā vikṛtabhayakarī trāsinī duṣkṛtānāṃ muñcajjvālākalāpair daśanakasamasaiḥ khādati pretamāṃsam / yā sā dordaṇḍacaṇḍair ḍamaruraṇaraṇāṭopaṭaṃkāraghaṇṭaiḥ kalpāntotpātavātāhatapaṭupaṭahair valgate bhūtamātā / kṣutkṣāmā śuṣkakukṣiḥ khavarataranaravaraiḥ kṣodati pretamāṃsaṃ muñcantī cāṭṭahāsaṃ ghuraghuritaravā pātu vaścarmamuṇḍā
verses.translation: On being thus implored, eulogised and informed Kavya realised the truth. Out of mercy and sympathy, he controlled his anger.
verses.hindi: तपसा ते सुमहता जातवृद्धाश्व धासिकाः
verses.wordMeaning: On being thus implored, eulogised and informed Kavya realised the truth. Out of mercy and sympathy, he controlled his anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being thus implored, eulogised and informed Kavya realised the truth. Out of mercy and sympathy, he controlled his anger.

verses.sanskrit: या सा निम्नोदराभा विकृतभवभयत्रासिनी शूलहस्ता चामुण्डा मुण्डघाता रणरणितरणझल्लरीनादरम्या । त्रैलोक्यं त्रासयन्ति ककहकहकहैर् घोररावैर् अनेकैर् नृत्यन्ती मातृमध्ये पितृवननिलया पातु वश्चर्ममुण्डा
verses.transliteration: yā sā nimnodarābhā vikṛtabhavabhayatrāsinī śūlahastā cāmuṇḍā muṇḍaghātā raṇaraṇitaraṇajhallarīnādaramyā / trailokyaṃ trāsayanti kakahakahakahair ghorarāvair anekair nṛtyantī mātṛmadhye pitṛvananilayā pātu vaścarmamuṇḍā
verses.translation: He spoke these words: <c Do not be afraid. Do not go to Rasatala. Even though I was alert this incident befell you because it was inevitable.
verses.hindi: चलता रहा । अवरुद्ध का उत्तराधिकारी राजा गास्धार हुआ, जिसके नाम से विशाल गान्धार तामक देश विख्यात है । उसी गान्बार देश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले अब्य बहुत अच्छे अश्व होते हैं। राजा गान्धार का पुत्र धर्म हुआ, उसका पुत्र धत हुआ ।७-१०। धृत को दुर्दम नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ, उसका पत्र प्रचेता हुआ । उस श्रचेता के सौ पुत्र हुए, णो सब के सब राजा थे। वे सब उत्तर दिज्या में स्लेच्छों के देश के शासक थे । अनु के तीन पुत्र हुए, जो परमबलशाली एवं घारमिक थे । उनके नाम थे, सभानर, पक्ष और परपक्ष । इनमें सभानर का पुत्र परम विद्वान राजा कालानल था। कालानल का पुत्र धर्मात्मा राजा सृज्जय हुआ । सृञ्जय का पुत्र वीर राजा पुरञझ्जय हुआ । पुरब्जय का पुत्र महान बलशाली राजा जनमेजय हुआ, राजधि जनमेजय का पुत्र राजा महाश्याल हुआ ।११-१५॥ उस महराज महाशाल का यश्ञ स्वर में इन्द्र की
verses.wordMeaning: He spoke these words: <c Do not be afraid. Do not go to Rasatala. Even though I was alert this incident befell you because it was inevitable.
verses.commentary: Sense: He spoke these words: <c Do not be afraid. Do not go to Rasatala. Even though I was alert this incident befell you because it was inevitable.

verses.sanskrit: या धत्ते विश्वमखिलं निजांशेन महोज्ज्वला । कनकप्रसवे लीना पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: yā dhatte viśvamakhilaṃ nijāṃśena mahojjvalā / kanakaprasave līnā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: Destiny which is very powerful cannot be altered. The sense that you have lost, you will regain now.
verses.hindi: भाँति प्रतिष्ठित था  उसका पुत्र परम धार्मिक राजा महामता हुआ । सातों द्वीपों का अधीक्वर महान पशस्वी राजा महामना अपने समय का चत्रवर्ती सम्राट था। उसने परम यशस्वी दो पुत्रों को उप्पन्न किया । जिनमें एक धर्म के तत्त्वों के जाननेवाले राजा उशौनर थे, दूसरे परम धामिक राजा तितिक्षु थे। उस राजा उशीनर की राजबिवंश्ष में उत्पन्न होनेवाली पाँच पत्नियाँ थीं, उनके नम थे, मृगा, कृमी, नवा, दर्वा
verses.wordMeaning: Destiny which is very powerful cannot be altered. The sense that you have lost, you will regain now.
verses.commentary: Sense: Destiny which is very powerful cannot be altered. The sense that you have lost, you will regain now.

verses.sanskrit: हिमाद्रिसम्भवा देवी दयादर्शितविग्रहा । शिवप्रिया शिवे सक्ता पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: himādrisambhavā devī dayādarśitavigrahā / śivapriyā śive saktā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: Brahma too had mentioned that the period adverse lo you had arrived. It was due to my favour that you had enjoyed the great pleasures of the three worlds (so long).
verses.hindi: और दृषद्वती । उन पाँचों पतियों के संयोग से महाराज उशीनर को पाँच कुलोद्धारक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए थे, जो सब के सब परम तपस्वी, महात्मा एबं परम धाभिक थे ।१६-१ ६। मृगा का पुत्र मृथ. था, नवा का पुत्र नव था, क्ृमो एतदादिश्लोकद्व यं ग॒ पुस्तके नास्ति । + अय॑ श्लोको न विद्यते स्र पुल्तके
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma too had mentioned that the period adverse lo you had arrived. It was due to my favour that you had enjoyed the great pleasures of the three worlds (so long).
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma too had mentioned that the period adverse lo you had arrived. It was due to my favour that you had enjoyed the great pleasures of the three worlds (so long).

verses.sanskrit: अनादिजगदादिर्या रत्नगर्भा वसुप्रिया । रथाङ्गपाणिना पद्मा पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: anādijagadādiryā ratnagarbhā vasupriyā / rathāṅgapāṇinā padmā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: For full ten Yugas you have reigned over Dcvas. Brahma has ordained your rulcrship only for that length of period.
verses.hindi: दुषद्वतीसुतश्रापि शिविरोशीनरो द्विजाः । शिबेः शिवपुरं ल्यातं यौधेयं तु मृगस्‍्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: For full ten Yugas you have reigned over Dcvas. Brahma has ordained your rulcrship only for that length of period.
verses.commentary: Sense: For full ten Yugas you have reigned over Dcvas. Brahma has ordained your rulcrship only for that length of period.

verses.sanskrit: सावित्री या च गायत्री मृडानी वागथेन्दिरा । स्मर्त्ःणां या सुखं दत्ते पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: sāvitrī yā ca gāyatrī mṛḍānī vāgathendirā / smartḥṇāṃ yā sukhaṃ datte pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: In the Savarnika Alanvantara you will again have suzerainty. Your grandson Bali will become the lord of all the worlds.
verses.hindi: शिवेस्तु शिवयः पुत्राश्न॒त्वारों लोकसंसता: । वृषदर्भ: सुवीरस्तु केकयो मंद्रकस्तथा तेषां जनपदाः स्फीताः केकया माद्रकस्तथा । वृषदर्भाः सूचीदर्भास्तितिक्षो: शुणुत प्रजा:
verses.wordMeaning: In the Savarnika Alanvantara you will again have suzerainty. Your grandson Bali will become the lord of all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Savarnika Alanvantara you will again have suzerainty. Your grandson Bali will become the lord of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्यासौम्यैः सदा रूपैः सृजत्यवति या जगत् । परा शक्तिः परा बुद्धिः पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: saumyāsaumyaiḥ sadā rūpaiḥ sṛjatyavati yā jagat / parā śaktiḥ parā buddhiḥ pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: It has been mentioned by Brahma himself to me that when later on the worlds will be seized from him, his power of penance will not be of any avail.
verses.hindi: तैतिक्षुरभवद्राजा पूर्वस्यां दिशि विश्रुतः  उशद्रथों महाबाहुस्तस्य हेमः सुतो5भवत्
verses.wordMeaning: It has been mentioned by Brahma himself to me that when later on the worlds will be seized from him, his power of penance will not be of any avail.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has been mentioned by Brahma himself to me that when later on the worlds will be seized from him, his power of penance will not be of any avail.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणः सर्गसमये सृज्यशक्तिः परा तु या । जगन्माया जगद्धात्री पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇaḥ sargasamaye sṛjyaśaktiḥ parā tu yā / jaganmāyā jagaddhātrī pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: Since his activities will be devoid of undue attachment, Brahma will be pleased with him and (the kingdom) will be bestowed on him in the Savarnika Manvantara.
verses.hindi: महायोगी स तु बलिवंडों यः स महामनाः । पुन्नानुत्पादयामास चातुरवेण्यंकरान्भूवि बालेया ब्राह्मणाश्वेव तस्थ वंशकरा: प्रभो: । बलेस्तु ब्रह्मणा दत्ताः बराः प्रीतेन धर्मतः
verses.wordMeaning: Since his activities will be devoid of undue attachment, Brahma will be pleased with him and (the kingdom) will be bestowed on him in the Savarnika Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since his activities will be devoid of undue attachment, Brahma will be pleased with him and (the kingdom) will be bestowed on him in the Savarnika Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्य पालने विष्णोर्या शक्तिः परिपालिका । मदनोन्मादिनी मुख्या पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: viśvasya pālane viṣṇoryā śaktiḥ paripālikā / madanonmādinī mukhyā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: The lord has told me, 'The kingdom of Devas will come to Bali'. Hence he bides his time remaining invisible to all living beings.
verses.hindi: साहैयोगित्वमायुश्न कल्पायुः परिसाणकम् । सडमग्रामे चाप्यजेयत्वं धर्म चेव प्रभावना
verses.wordMeaning: The lord has told me, 'The kingdom of Devas will come to Bali'. Hence he bides his time remaining invisible to all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord has told me, 'The kingdom of Devas will come to Bali'. Hence he bides his time remaining invisible to all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वसंलयने मुख्या या रुद्रेण समाश्रिता । रौद्री शक्तिः शिवानन्ता पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: viśvasaṃlayane mukhyā yā rudreṇa samāśritā / raudrī śaktiḥ śivānantā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: You have been granted immortality by the delighted self-born deity. Hence, without exhibiting undue curiosity and agitation you have to bear with the change.
verses.hindi: का पुत्र कृमि था, दर्वा का परम धमिक सुव्रत था। ऋषिबुन्द ! पाँचवीं पत्नी दुषद्वती का पुत्र महाराज शिवि था, जो औशीनर शिवि के नाम से विख्यात है। उसी महाराज शिवि का पुर शिवपुर के नाम से विख्यात है, इसी प्रकार भृूग का योधेयपुर, नव का नवराष्ट्र, कम को कृमिपुरी, और सुब्रत की अम्बष्टा नामक पुरी थी । अब शिवि के पुत्रों का वर्णन सुनिये । शिवि के चार पूत्र हुए, जिनका लोक में परम सम्मान था, वे सब शिविगण के नाम से विख्यात थे। उनके नाम ये, वृषदर्म, सुवीर केकय और मद्रक ।२०-२३। उन चारो शिविपुत्रों के जनपद परम रमणीय कैकय, माह्रक, वृषदर्भा ओर सूचीदर्भा के नाम से विख्यात हैं। अब विविक्ष की प्रजाओं का वर्णन सुनिये। उस राजा तितिक्षु का पुत्र महाबाहु उदाद्रथ पूर्वेदिशा का परम यशस्वी राजा सुना जाता है । उसका पुत्र राजा हेम हुआ ।२४-२५॥। हेम का पुत्र परम तथस्वों बन्ि हुआ  यह
verses.wordMeaning: You have been granted immortality by the delighted self-born deity. Hence, without exhibiting undue curiosity and agitation you have to bear with the change.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have been granted immortality by the delighted self-born deity. Hence, without exhibiting undue curiosity and agitation you have to bear with the change.

verses.sanskrit: कैलाससानुसंरूढ कनकप्रसवेशया । भस्मकाभिहृता पूर्वं पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: kailāsasānusaṃrūḍha kanakaprasaveśayā / bhasmakābhihṛtā pūrvaṃ pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: Before the (proper) time, it is not possible for me to save you. O lord, I have been forbidden by Brahma who knows the future.
verses.hindi: बलि महान योगी दंत्यराज बलि द्वी थे, जिन्हें मगवान वामन ने बाँधा था, सनन्‍्तति के अभाव में राजा हैम के वंश के विनाक्ष उपस्थित होने पर इन्होंने मानवयोनि में हेम का पुत्र द्वोकर जन्म घारण किया था इस राजा बलि ने पृथ्वी में चारों वर्णों की सृष्टि करनेवाले पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया था, उन्होंने भज्भ, बद्र, मुहा, पुण्ड, कलिज्ध नामक पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया था। उस महाराज बलि के वंशज क्षत्रिय भी कहे जाते
verses.wordMeaning: Before the (proper) time, it is not possible for me to save you. O lord, I have been forbidden by Brahma who knows the future.
verses.commentary: Sense: Before the (proper) time, it is not possible for me to save you. O lord, I have been forbidden by Brahma who knows the future.

verses.sanskrit: पतिप्रभावमिच्छन्ती त्रस्यन्ती या विना पतिम् । अबला त्वेकभावा च पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: patiprabhāvamicchantī trasyantī yā vinā patim / abalā tvekabhāvā ca pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: These two are my disciples. They are equal to me.* and Brhaspati. They will sustain you all when attacked by Devas."
verses.hindi: हैं और ब्राह्मण भो कहें जाते हैं ।२६-२८। बलि के परम धामिक कार्यों से प्रसन्न होकर ब्रह्मा ने उसे महायोगी, एक कल्प की दीर्घायुवाला, संग्राम में अजेय एवं धर्म में परम निष्ठावान् होने का वरदान दिया था, इसके मतिरिक्त ब्रह्मा ने कहा था, बले तुम्हें समस्त त्रलोक्य का दर्दांग, सन्‍्तनोत्पत्ति में प्रधानता, धर्मंतत्व का देरेर वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: These two are my disciples. They are equal to me.* and Brhaspati. They will sustain you all when attacked by Devas."
verses.commentary: Sense: These two are my disciples. They are equal to me.* and Brhaspati. They will sustain you all when attacked by Devas."

verses.sanskrit: विश्वसंरक्षणे सक्ता रक्षिता कनकेन या । आ ब्रह्मस्तम्बजननी पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: viśvasaṃrakṣaṇe saktā rakṣitā kanakena yā / ā brahmastambajananī pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: When the Daityas, the chief of whom was Prahlada, were given this advice by Kavya of indefatigable energy and activity, they went away along with those two (disciples i.e. Sanda and Amarka).
verses.hindi: तओलोक्यदर्शनं घेव प्राधान्य प्रसवे तथा । बले चाप्रतिमत्वं वे धर्मतत्त्वाथथंदर्शेनम् ३३१
verses.wordMeaning: When the Daityas, the chief of whom was Prahlada, were given this advice by Kavya of indefatigable energy and activity, they went away along with those two (disciples i.e. Sanda and Amarka).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Daityas, the chief of whom was Prahlada, were given this advice by Kavya of indefatigable energy and activity, they went away along with those two (disciples i.e. Sanda and Amarka).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीश्वराः शक्त्या शरीरग्रहणं यया । प्रापिताः प्रथमा शक्तिः पातु मां कनकेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇvīśvarāḥ śaktyā śarīragrahaṇaṃ yayā / prāpitāḥ prathamā śaktiḥ pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī
verses.translation: On hearing about the inevitability of future events
verses.hindi: चतुरों नियतान्वर्णास्त्वं वे स्थापयितेति च। इत्पुक्तो विभुना राजा बलिः शान्ति परां ययोौ.. 0४३२ कालेन महता विद्वान्स्व॑ वे स्थानंमुपागतः । तेषां जनपदाः स्फीता वद्भाड्भसुद्राकास्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing about the inevitability of future events
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about the inevitability of future events

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु गरुडेनोक्तं देवीवृत्तचतुष्टयम् । प्रसन्ना संमुखी भूत्वा वाक्यमेतद् उवाच ह
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu garuḍenoktaṃ devīvṛttacatuṣṭayam / prasannā saṃmukhī bhūtvā vākyametad uvāca ha
verses.translation: They equipped themselves with various weapons and the coats of mail and challenged Devas for fighting. On seeing Asuras advanced for jattlc, Devas got ready with all equipments and fought them in return. The battle between Devas and Asuras continued for a hundred years. Asuras defeated Devas. The beaten and distressed Devas spoke thus among themselves.
verses.hindi: कर बले: सुताः पठच जनिताः क्षेत्रजा: प्रभो । ऋषिणा दीर्घतपसा एतन्नो बृहि पृच्छतामू
verses.wordMeaning: They equipped themselves with various weapons and the coats of mail and challenged Devas for fighting. On seeing Asuras advanced for jattlc, Devas got ready with all equipments and fought them in return. The battle between Devas and Asuras continued for a hundred years.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They equipped themselves with various weapons and the coats of mail and challenged Devas for fighting. On seeing Asuras advanced for jattlc, Devas got ready with all equipments and fought them in return. The battle between Devas and Asuras continued for a hundred years.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीचामुण्डोवाच: प्रसन्ना ते महासत्त्व वरं वरय वाञ्छितम् । ददामि ते द्विजश्रेष्ठ यत्ते मनसि रोचते
verses.transliteration: śrīcāmuṇḍovāca: prasannā te mahāsattva varaṃ varaya vāñchitam / dadāmi te dvijaśreṣṭha yatte manasi rocate
verses.translation: Devas said: "We do not know the (extent of the) power of San<ja and Amarka on Asuras. Hence, what is conducive to our welfare must be done by preparing for a Yajha. After knowing about and capturing those two, we will defeat Asuras".
verses.hindi: छउइौएऊउ उइउैे / ्॒ िपपफपहपफहफहैफअखआफउहफैफोैहएह/फझ/ झ/णख/ः चिन्तन, एवं प्रतिद्वन्दों का सवंथा अभाव रहेगा, तुम ब्राह्मण क्षत्रियादि चारों वर्णों की स्थापना करनेवाला होगा । भगवान् ब्रह्मा के इस वरदाबात्मक वचन को सुनकर राजा बलि को परम शान्ति प्राप्ति हुई
verses.wordMeaning: Devas said: "We do not know the (extent of the) power of San<ja and Amarka on Asuras. Hence, what is conducive to our welfare must be done by preparing for a Yajha. After knowing about and capturing those two, we will defeat Asuras".
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas said: "We do not know the (extent of the) power of San<ja and Amarka on Asuras. Hence, what is conducive to our welfare must be done by preparing for a Yajha. After knowing about and capturing those two, we will defeat Asuras".

verses.sanskrit: गरुड उवाच: अजरश्चामरश्चैव अधृष्यश्च सुरासुरैः । तव प्रसादाच्चैवान्यैरजेयश्च भवाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: garuḍa uvāca: ajaraścāmaraścaiva adhṛṣyaśca surāsuraiḥ / tava prasādāccaivānyairajeyaśca bhavāmyaham
verses.translation: In this manner, Sanda and Amarka thereafter forsook Asuras. Devas were victorious and Danavas suffered disastrous defeat.
verses.hindi: वरदान के अनुसार दी्घंकाल के अनन्तर वह परम विद्वान राजा बलिः पुनः अपने स्थान को प्राप्त हुआ। बलि के उन पुत्रों के परम रमणीय देश उन्हीं के नामों के अनुसार बंग अंग, सुहाक, पुण्ड और कलिंग के नाम से विल्यात हैं। अब उनके वंछाजों का विवरण सुनिये । राजा के बलि के ये पुत्र मुनि के अंक्ष से बलि के  क्षेत्रज पुत्र थे। महान तेजस्वी दीधंतमा ऋषि के संयोग से ये बलि की स्त्री सुदेष्णा में उत्पन्न हुए
verses.wordMeaning: In this manner, Sanda and Amarka thereafter forsook Asuras. Devas were victorious and Danavas suffered disastrous defeat.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this manner, Sanda and Amarka thereafter forsook Asuras. Devas were victorious and Danavas suffered disastrous defeat.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया चात्र सदा देवि स्थातव्यं तीर्थसन्निधौ । मार्कण्डेय उवाच: एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा देवी देवैरभिष्टुता
verses.transliteration: tvayā cātra sadā devi sthātavyaṃ tīrthasannidhau / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā devī devairabhiṣṭutā
verses.translation: After defeating Asuras, Devas approached Sanda and Amarka. Asuras who had already been over¬ whelmed by the curse of Kavya had no support now. Hai assed by Devas, they entered Rasatala. Thus Danavas were crippled and rendered inactive by Sakra.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने पूछा--सूत जी ! महाराज बलि के वे पाँचों पुत्र किस प्रकार दीर्घतमा ऋषि के संयोग से उनके क्षेत्र (पत्नी) में उत्पन्न हुए, इसे हम लोग जानना चाहते हैं, बतला इये ।३५॥। खूत बोले-- ऋषिवन्द प्राची नकाल में एक अधिज नामक परम विद्वान ऋषि बिल्यात हो गये हैं, उन परम माहात्मा ऋषि की पत्नी का नाम ममता था । अशिज के छोटे भाई देवताओं के-पुरोहित परम तेजस्वी बृहस्पति थे, एक बार वे कामवश होकर ममता के पास गये । देवी ममता ने बृहस्पति के प्रति अपनी इच्छा प्रकट नहीं की । वे बोलीं, मैं इस समय तुम्हारे ज्येष्ठ भाई के संयोग से गर्भवती हूँ, बृहस्पति !
verses.wordMeaning: After defeating Asuras, Devas approached Sanda and Amarka. Asuras who had already been over¬ whelmed by the curse of Kavya had no support now. Hai assed by Devas, they entered Rasatala. Thus Danavas were crippled and rendered inactive by Sakra.
verses.commentary: Sense: After defeating Asuras, Devas approached Sanda and Amarka. Asuras who had already been over¬ whelmed by the curse of Kavya had no support now. Hai assed by Devas, they entered Rasatala. Thus Danavas were crippled and rendered inactive by Sakra.

verses.sanskrit: जगामाकाशमाविश्य भूतसङ्घसमन्विता । यदा लक्ष्म्या नृपश्रेष्ठ स्थापितं पुरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: jagāmākāśamāviśya bhūtasaṅghasamanvitā / yadā lakṣmyā nṛpaśreṣṭha sthāpitaṃ puramuttamam
verses.translation: Lord Brahma pronounced that all those Asuras who did not follow the directions of Prahlada would be killed by human beings. Hence Narayana was born of Dharma in the Caksusa
verses.hindi: उय्ेष्ठस्पेत्यादिपादस्त्रुटितों ग. घन ड़. पुस्तकेषु ।
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Brahma pronounced that all those Asuras who did not follow the directions of Prahlada would be killed by human beings. Hence Narayana was born of Dharma in the Caksusa
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Brahma pronounced that all those Asuras who did not follow the directions of Prahlada would be killed by human beings. Hence Narayana was born of Dharma in the Caksusa

verses.sanskrit: अनुमान्य तदा देवीं कृतं तस्यां समर्पितम् । लक्ष्मीरुवाच: रक्षणाय मया देवि योगक्षेमार्थसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: anumānya tadā devīṃ kṛtaṃ tasyāṃ samarpitam / lakṣmīruvāca: rakṣaṇāya mayā devi yogakṣemārthasiddhaye
verses.translation: At the time of the manifestation of the other (i.e. Prthu) Brahma himself was the priest. In the fourth Yuga.when Asuras 2 were in distress, he was born within the ocean for the purpose of killing Hiranyakasipu 3.
verses.hindi: अय॑ हि मे महागर्भो रोचसे5ति बृहस्पते । अशिजं ब्रह्म चाभ्यस्य षडड् वेदसुद्गिरन् ७३६ असोघरेतास्त्यं चापि न मां भजितुमहेसि । अस्मिश्नेव गते काले यथा वा मन्यसे प्रभो
verses.wordMeaning: At the time of the manifestation of the other (i.e. Prthu) Brahma himself was the priest. In the fourth Yuga.when Asuras 2 were in distress, he was born within the ocean for the purpose of killing Hiranyakasipu 3.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time of the manifestation of the other (i.e. Prthu) Brahma himself was the priest. In the fourth Yuga.when Asuras 2 were in distress, he was born within the ocean for the purpose of killing Hiranyakasipu 3.

verses.sanskrit: मातृवत्प्रतिपाल्यं ते सदा देवि पुरं मम । गरुडो ऽपि ततः स्नात्वा सम्पूज्य कनकेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: mātṛvatpratipālyaṃ te sadā devi puraṃ mama / garuḍo 'pi tataḥ snātvā sampūjya kanakeśvarīm
verses.translation: The third incarnation, that of Vamana, took place in the seventh Tretayuga when all the three worlds had been overrun by Daityas and were ruled over by Bali. Withdrawing all the limbs within himself (Assum¬ ing the form of a Dwarf) the son of Aditi approached the son of Virocana, Bali, the king of Daityas, who was performing a Yajna. Brhaspati too accompanied him. Assuming the form of a Brahmana on an auspicious occasion, he requested Bali: "O king, you are the lord of the three worlds. Everything is in you. It behoves you to grant me (the space covered by) three paces".
verses.hindi: एयमुक्तस्तया सम्यग्वृहत्तेजा बृहस्पति: । कामात्मानं महात्मा5पि नाउधत्मानं सो5डस्यधारयत्
verses.wordMeaning: The third incarnation, that of Vamana, took place in the seventh Tretayuga when all the three worlds had been overrun by Daityas and were ruled over by Bali.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The third incarnation, that of Vamana, took place in the seventh Tretayuga when all the three worlds had been overrun by Daityas and were ruled over by Bali.…

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं तत्रैव संस्थाप्य जगामाकाशमुत्तमम् । तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत् पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ tatraiva saṃsthāpya jagāmākāśamuttamam / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayet pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: "I will give", promised the king Bali, the son of Viro¬ cana. On knowing that he was a Vamana (dwarf), he was delighted much.
verses.hindi: संबमुवेव धर्मात्मा तथा साध बृहस्पतिः । + (उत्सूजन्तं तदा रेतो गर्भस्थः सो5भ्यभाषत नोस्नातक स्थसे (? ) ह्ास्मिन्द्रयोनेहाध्ति संभव: । अमोधरेतास्त्व॑ चापि पुर्व चाहमिहा55गतः ॥४२े शशाप त॑ तदा क़द्ध एवमुक्तो बृहस्पतिः । अशिजं त॑ सुतं अआतुगगंर्भस्थं भगवानृषिः ४४
verses.wordMeaning: "I will give", promised the king Bali, the son of Viro¬ cana. On knowing that he was a Vamana (dwarf), he was delighted much.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I will give", promised the king Bali, the son of Viro¬ cana. On knowing that he was a Vamana (dwarf), he was delighted much.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते । गन्धपुष्पादिभिर् यस्तु पूजयेत् कनकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute / gandhapuṣpādibhir yastu pūjayet kanakeśvaram
verses.translation: But, O excellent Brahmanas, that lord Vamana measured the entire Universe, the Earth, the Heaven and the Sky by means of three paces. That Bhutatman (the immanent soul of all living beings) of great fame excelled even the sun by means of his brilliance. He illuminated all the quarters and the intermediate directions with his refulgence.
verses.hindi: ततो दीर्घतमा नाम शापाद्षिरजायत । अथाशिजो बृहत्कीतिबु हस्पतिरिवौजसा १४६ ऊरध्यरेतास्ततश्रापि न्यवसद्ञ्ञातुराश्मे । गोधर्म सोरभेयात्तु वुषभाच्छ तवान्प्रभो ४७ तस्थ आता पितृव्यस्तु चकार भवन तदा। तस्मिन्हि तत्र वसति यदृच्छाभ्यागतो वृषः ४८.
verses.wordMeaning: But, O excellent Brahmanas, that lord Vamana measured the entire Universe, the Earth, the Heaven and the Sky by means of three paces. That Bhutatman (the immanent soul of all living beings) of great fame excelled even the sun by means of his brilliance.…
verses.commentary: Sense: But, O excellent Brahmanas, that lord Vamana measured the entire Universe, the Earth, the Heaven and the Sky by means of three paces. That Bhutatman (the immanent soul of all living beings) of great fame excelled even the sun by means of his brilliance.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य योगैश्वर्यसिद्धिर्योगपीठेषु जायते । मृतो योगेश्वरं लोकं जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः । स गच्छेन्नात्र सन्देहो योगिनीगणसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: tasya yogaiśvaryasiddhiryogapīṭheṣu jāyate / mṛto yogeśvaraṃ lokaṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ / sa gacchennātra sandeho yoginīgaṇasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: 'Vainya* i.e. King Prthu in Bel. P. v. 72. It-is a better reading as this and other sources give the credit of Yajna to Prthu in this Manvantara.
verses.hindi: ॒॒॒॒॒ ७ख"//फसट ्पहंपपह।थए।पहपप-एथपहफह8हैयआययणए यह हमारा महाभ् गर्भ अपने तेज से परम प्रकाशित हो रहा है, यह गर्भावस्‍था में ही अशिज के अंशभूत होने के कारण षडंग वेदों का उच्चारण करता है एवं ब्रह्म का अभ्यास करता है ।३६-३६। तुम भी अमोघवी ये वाले हो, इसलिए ऐसी स्थिति में मेरे साथ समागम नहीं कर सकते  है सर्वसमर्थ ! इस काल के व्यतीत हो जाने के उपरान्त तुम्हारी ज॑सी इच्छा हो, करना । ममता के इस प्रकार कहने पर परम तेजस्वी बृहस्पति
verses.wordMeaning: 'Vainya* i.e. King Prthu in Bel. P. v. 72. It-is a better reading as this and other sources give the credit of Yajna to Prthu in this Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Vainya* i.e. King Prthu in Bel. P. v. 72. It-is a better reading as this and other sources give the credit of Yajna to Prthu in this Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कनखलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षडशीत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १८७ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: जालेश्वरं ततो गच्छेल्लिङ्गमाद्यं स्वयम्भुवः । कालाग्निरुद्रं विख्यातं भृगुकच्छे व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kanakhaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 187 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: jāleśvaraṃ tato gacchelliṅgamādyaṃ svayambhuvaḥ / kālāgnirudraṃ vikhyātaṃ bhṛgukacche vyavasthitam
verses.translation: Suras (in Bd. P. v. 74) is the correct reading.
verses.hindi: महात्मा होकर भी अपनी काम वशीभूत आत्मा को वश में न रख सके । परम धर्मात्मा होकर भी उन्होंने ममता से समागम किया, जिस समय वीयघान कर रहे ये, गर्भत्थ शिशु ने उनसे कहा--ताव ! आप आप अपना वीय॑े यहाँ न निहित करें, क्योंकि इसमें दो प्राणियों का निवास सम्भव नहीं है  तुम भी अमोधवीर्य वाले हो, मैं यहाँ पहिले हो से उपस्थित हूँ ।४०-४३। गर्भस्थ शिक्ु के इस वाक्य से बृहस्पति के वोर्याधान
verses.wordMeaning: Suras (in Bd. P. v. 74) is the correct reading.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suras (in Bd. P. v. 74) is the correct reading.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वोपद्रवनाशनम् । क्षेत्रपापविनाशाय कृपया च समुत्थितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam / kṣetrapāpavināśāya kṛpayā ca samutthitam
verses.translation: It implies Varaha incarnation, but Varaha killed Hiraijyaksa and Nrsiriiha incarnation was for killing Hiranyakasipu.
verses.hindi: में बाधा पहुँची । परम तेजस्वी ऋषिवर बृहस्पति ने अभ्रसन्न होकर अपने बड़े भाई अशिज के संयोग से समुत्पन्न गर्मंस्थ शिशु को शाप दिया कि सभी प्राणधारियों के परम अभीष्ट ऐसे सुखभय अवसर में तुमने बाँधा पहुंचाई है, अज्ञानवश तुमने मुझको ऐसा कहा है, अतः महान अंधकार को भ्रांप्त होगे । बृहस्पति के शाप के क़ारण वह शिशु दीधतमा ऋषि के नाम से विख्यात हुआ । ऋषिवर अशिज भी बृहस्पति के समान तेजस्वी एवं परम यशस्वी थे ।४४-४६॥ उनके पुत्र दीघंतमा परम ब्रह्मचारी थे, और उनके भाई के आश्रम में निवास करते ये, सुरमी के पुत्र एक बरृषभ से उन्होंने एक बार गोधर्म का श्रवण-प्रहण किया था  अशिज के श्राता एवं दी्घतमा के पिठृव्य बृहस्पति ने उनके निवासार्थ एक भवन का निर्माण
verses.wordMeaning: It implies Varaha incarnation, but Varaha killed Hiraijyaksa and Nrsiriiha incarnation was for killing Hiranyakasipu.
verses.commentary: Sense: It implies Varaha incarnation, but Varaha killed Hiraijyaksa and Nrsiriiha incarnation was for killing Hiranyakasipu.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कल्पे ऽसुरगणैराक्रान्ते भुवनत्रये । वेदोक्तकर्मनाशे च धर्मे च विलयं गते
verses.transliteration: purā kalpe 'suragaṇairākrānte bhuvanatraye / vedoktakarmanāśe ca dharme ca vilayaṃ gate
verses.translation: Madhava, the immanent soul of all living beings showed, the Brahmanas there a great miracle, viz. all the great elements' with their special features and the entire Time.
verses.hindi: + एतब्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो डः पुस्तके नास्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Madhava, the immanent soul of all living beings showed, the Brahmanas there a great miracle, viz. all the great elements' with their special features and the entire Time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Madhava, the immanent soul of all living beings showed, the Brahmanas there a great miracle, viz. all the great elements' with their special features and the entire Time.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षिमुनिसिद्धेषु विश्वासपरमेषु च । कालाग्निरुद्राद् उत्पन्नो धूमः कालोद्भवोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: devarṣimunisiddheṣu viśvāsaparameṣu ca / kālāgnirudrād utpanno dhūmaḥ kālodbhavodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: They saw the entire Universe and themselves in his cosmic body. There was nothing in the worlds which was not pervaded by thenoble-souled lord.
verses.hindi: न मया5घसादितस्तात बलवांस्त्वद्विधः क्वचित् । ध्यम्ब्क वहता देव यतो जातो55स्मि(स)सूतले तेन त्वाहं न मोक्ष्यासि परस्वारद चतुष्पदम् । ततस्तं दीर्घतमसं स वृषः प्रत्युवाच ह ॥४३े
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the entire Universe and themselves in his cosmic body. There was nothing in the worlds which was not pervaded by thenoble-souled lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the entire Universe and themselves in his cosmic body. There was nothing in the worlds which was not pervaded by thenoble-souled lord.

verses.sanskrit: धूमात्समुत्थितं लिङ्गं भित्त्वा पातालसप्तकम् । अवटं दक्षिणे कृत्वा लिङ्गं तत्रैव तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: dhūmātsamutthitaṃ liṅgaṃ bhittvā pātālasaptakam / avaṭaṃ dakṣiṇe kṛtvā liṅgaṃ tatraiva tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Seeing that form of Upendra (i.e. Vamana) Devas, Danavas and human beings were fascinated. All of them were enchanted by Visnu's refulgence.
verses.hindi: कार्याकारये न वै विद्यो गम्यागम्यं तयेव व । न पाप्सानों व्य विप्र धर्मो होष गवां स्पृत:.. ४५४ गवां नाम सब श्रुत्वा संभ्रास्तस्त्वनुमृुच्य तम्। भक्तघा रा55नुअ्विकया गोषु तं॑ वे प्रसादयत्
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing that form of Upendra (i.e. Vamana) Devas, Danavas and human beings were fascinated. All of them were enchanted by Visnu's refulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing that form of Upendra (i.e. Vamana) Devas, Danavas and human beings were fascinated. All of them were enchanted by Visnu's refulgence.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नृपश्रेष्ठ कुण्डं ज्वालासमुद्भवम् । यत्र सा पतिता ज्वाला शिवस्य दहतः पुरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha kuṇḍaṃ jvālāsamudbhavam / yatra sā patitā jvālā śivasya dahataḥ puram
verses.translation: Bali was bound with great nooses along with his kinsmen, friends and followers. The entire race of Virocana was consigned to Patala.
verses.hindi: प्रसादिते गते तस्मिश्गोधर्म भक्तितस्तु तम्। मनसेब तदादत्ते तद्निष्ठस्तत्परायणः ५७ ततो यवीयसः पत्नीमोतथ्यस्याम्यमन्यत । विशेष्टसानां रुदतों देवात्संमुटलैतनः किया था, उसी में निवास कर रहे थे, एक बार कहीं से धूमता हुआ एक वृषभ वहाँ पर आ गया, गौजों के साथ घूमते हुए उस वृषभ ने श्राद्ध के लिये लाये गये कुशों का भक्षण करना प्रारम्भ कर दिया । ऋषिवर दीघतमा ने फुड़कते हुए उस वृषभ की दोनों सींगों को बल पूर्वक पकड़ लिया ॥४७-डेंछे। उनके पकड़े जाते पर जब वह एक पग से दूसरा पग भी नहीं रख सका तब जअंसतता होकर दीघंतमा से बोला, बलवानों
verses.wordMeaning: Bali was bound with great nooses along with his kinsmen, friends and followers. The entire race of Virocana was consigned to Patala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bali was bound with great nooses along with his kinsmen, friends and followers. The entire race of Virocana was consigned to Patala.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रावटं समुद्भूतं धूमावर्तस् ततो ऽभवत् । तस्मिन्कुण्डे तु यः स्नानं कृत्वा वै नर्मदाजले
verses.transliteration: tatrāvaṭaṃ samudbhūtaṃ dhūmāvartas tato 'bhavat / tasminkuṇḍe tu yaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā vai narmadājale
verses.translation: After handing back the entire riches and glory of Devas to the noble-souled Indra, the mighty-armed Janardana manifested himself before the human world.
verses.hindi: में श्रेष्ठ ! मुझे माप छोड़ दें, तात ! मैंने आप के समान बलवान् कहीं पर किसी अन्य को नहीं पाया, यदायपि समस्त पृथ्वी भर का मैंने देवदेव महादेव जी को वहन करते हुए भ्रमण किया है। बसझालियों में श्रेष्ठ! मुझे छोड़ दीजिये मैं तुम्हारे ऊपर परम प्रसन्न हैं, मुझसे वर माँगिये  बषभ के ऐसा कहने पर दीघंतमा ने कहा, वृषभ ! मेरे हाथ से तू जीते हुए कहाँ. जाओगे । तुम चार परवाले होकर
verses.wordMeaning: After handing back the entire riches and glory of Devas to the noble-souled Indra, the mighty-armed Janardana manifested himself before the human world.
verses.commentary: Sense: After handing back the entire riches and glory of Devas to the noble-souled Indra, the mighty-armed Janardana manifested himself before the human world.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्याच्छ्राद्धं पितृभ्यो वै पूजयेच्च त्रिलोचनम् । कालाग्निरुद्रनामानि स गच्छेत् परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: kuryācchrāddhaṃ pitṛbhyo vai pūjayecca trilocanam / kālāgnirudranāmāni sa gacchet paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: These three incarnations of the lord were divine and auspicious. Listen and understand the seven incarnations as human beings as a result of the curse. In the tenth Tretayuga when Dharma had been ruined he had his fourth incarnation as Dattatreya with Markandeya as his preceptor.
verses.hindi: भी दूसरे की वस्तु का भक्षण करते हो, अतः मैं तुम्हें नहीं छोड़ गा । दीघंतमा के ऐसा कहने पर बृषभ ने पुनः उत्तर दिया, तात ! मेरे लिये कोई पाप नहीं है. चोरी भी कुछ नहीं है। मैं गया खाना चाहिए, क्‍या नहीं खाना चाहिए, कया पीना चाहिए, क्या नहीं पीना चाहिए--इसे नहीं जानता ॥४०-५४। उसी प्रकार मुझे इसका भी ज्ञान नहीं है कि मुझे क्या करना चाहिए और कया नहीं करना चाहिए, कहाँ जाना चाहिए और कहाँ न जाना चाहिए, ब्राह्मणदेव ! हम पशुओं को ,पाप नहीं लगता, गौओं का तो यही धर्म कहा गया है । बृषभ के इस कथन में दोर्घतमा गो का नाम झुतई अयकचा गये, उन्होंने परम भक्ति तथा विनयपूर्ण चाटुकारी के साथ बषभ को प्रसन्न किया । इस प्रकार प्रसन्न होकर वृषभ के चले जाने पर उन्होंने भक्ति पूर्वेंक इस गौधर्म पर विचार किया, और मन से उसे ग्रहण कर स्वेदा उसी में निष्ठा रख कर पालन में भी
verses.wordMeaning: These three incarnations of the lord were divine and auspicious. Listen and understand the seven incarnations as human beings as a result of the curse. In the tenth Tretayuga when Dharma had been ruined he had his fourth incarnation as Dattatreya with Markandeya as his preceptor.
