verses.commentary: Sense: These three incarnations of the lord were divine and auspicious. Listen and understand the seven incarnations as human beings as a result of the curse. In the tenth Tretayuga when Dharma had been ruined he had his fourth incarnation as Dattatreya with Markandeya as his preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: यत्किंचित्कामिकं कर्म ह्याभिचारिकमेव वा । रिपुसंक्षयकृद्वापि सांतानिकमथापि वा । अत्र तीर्थे कृतं सर्वम् अचिरात् सिध्यते नृप
verses.transliteration: yatkiṃcitkāmikaṃ karma hyābhicārikameva vā / ripusaṃkṣayakṛdvāpi sāṃtānikamathāpi vā / atra tīrthe kṛtaṃ sarvam acirāt sidhyate nṛpa
verses.translation: His fifth incarnation was in the fifteenth Tretayuga as Mandhatr, the Emperor. Tathya (Utathya?) was his preceptor.
verses.hindi: तत्पर हो गये ।५५-४५७। तदनन्तद देव की अकृपा से इतबुद्धि होकर उन्होंने अपने छोटे भाई ओऔतथ्य की पत्नी को
verses.wordMeaning: His fifth incarnation was in the fifteenth Tretayuga as Mandhatr, the Emperor. Tathya (Utathya?) was his preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: His fifth incarnation was in the fifteenth Tretayuga as Mandhatr, the Emperor. Tathya (Utathya?) was his preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कालाग्निरुद्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्ताशीत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १८८ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततः परं महाराज चत्वारिंशत्क्रमान्तरे । शालग्रामं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वदैवतपूजितम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kālāgnirudratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptāśītyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 188 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ paraṃ mahārāja catvāriṃśatkramāntare / śālagrāmaṃ tato gacchet sarvadaivatapūjitam
verses.translation: The sixth incarnation was that as the son of Jamadagni in the nineteenth Tretayuga. He annihilated all the Ksatriyas. He had Visvamitra as his preceptor (Purohita).
verses.hindi: अबलेप तु त॑ मत्या शरहांस्तस्थ नाक्षमत् । गोधर्म वे बल॑ कृत्वा स्नुषां स सममस्यत ॥श विपयंय तु त॑ दृष्ट्वा शरद्वास्प्रत्यचिन्तयत् । भविष्यमर्थ ज्ञात्वा च महात्मा च न मृत्युतामू प्रोवाच दीर्घतमसं क्रोधात्संरक्तलोचनः । गस्यागम्यं न जानोथे मोधर्मात्यार्थयन्लुबाम ६१ ढुवं त्तस्त्वं त्यजाम्पेष गच्छ त्वं तेन करंणा । यस्मात्त्वमन्धों वृद्धख् भर्तंव्यों दुरनुष्ठितः 0
verses.wordMeaning: The sixth incarnation was that as the son of Jamadagni in the nineteenth Tretayuga. He annihilated all the Ksatriyas. He had Visvamitra as his preceptor (Purohita).
verses.commentary: Sense: The sixth incarnation was that as the son of Jamadagni in the nineteenth Tretayuga. He annihilated all the Ksatriyas. He had Visvamitra as his preceptor (Purohita).

verses.sanskrit: यत्रादिदेवो भगवान्वासुदेवस्त्रिविक्रमः । स्वयं तिष्ठति लोकात्मा सर्वेषां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: yatrādidevo bhagavānvāsudevastrivikramaḥ / svayaṃ tiṣṭhati lokātmā sarveṣāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: In the twentyfourth Tretayuga, he took his seventh incarnation as Rama, the son of Dasaratha. In his sacrifice Vasistha was his priest. It was for the purpose of killing Ravana.
verses.hindi: तेनासि त्वं परित्यक्तो दुराचारोइसि से सतिः
verses.wordMeaning: In the twentyfourth Tretayuga, he took his seventh incarnation as Rama, the son of Dasaratha. In his sacrifice Vasistha was his priest. It was for the purpose of killing Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twentyfourth Tretayuga, he took his seventh incarnation as Rama, the son of Dasaratha. In his sacrifice Vasistha was his priest. It was for the purpose of killing Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: नारदेन तपस्तप्त्वा कृता शाला द्विजन्मनाम् । सिद्धिक्षेत्रं भृगुक्षेत्रं ज्ञात्वा रेवातटे स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: nāradena tapastaptvā kṛtā śālā dvijanmanām / siddhikṣetraṃ bhṛgukṣetraṃ jñātvā revātaṭe svayam
verses.translation: In the twentyeighth Dvapara Yuga, Visnu took his eighth incarnation as Vedavyasa born of ParaSara. He had Jatukarna as the preceptor.
verses.hindi: कमंण्यस्मिस्तत: करे तस्य बुद्धिरजायत । निर्भ॑त्स्यं चेब बहुशों बाहुम्यां परिगुह्य च॥ कोष्ठ समुद्रे प्रक्षिप्य गड़/म्भसि समुत्सृजत् ३६३ उह्मानः समुद्रस्तु सप्ताहें ख्लोतसा तदा। त॑ सस्त्रीकों बलिर्नाम राजा धर्मार्थतत्ववित् ॥। अपश्यश्मज्जमानं तु ख्रोयसाउभ्याशमागतम् ्््ि
verses.wordMeaning: In the twentyeighth Dvapara Yuga, Visnu took his eighth incarnation as Vedavyasa born of ParaSara. He had Jatukarna as the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twentyeighth Dvapara Yuga, Visnu took his eighth incarnation as Vedavyasa born of ParaSara. He had Jatukarna as the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: शालग्रामाभिधो देवो विप्राणां त्वधिवासितः । साधूनां चोपकाराय वासुदेवः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: śālagrāmābhidho devo viprāṇāṃ tvadhivāsitaḥ / sādhūnāṃ copakārāya vāsudevaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: Vi$nu who had been born earlier as the son of Aditi andKasyapa took his ninth incarnation as the son of DevakI an asudeva with the Brahmana Gargya as his preceptor.
verses.hindi: एक बार कामवश दोकर छेड़ते का उपक्रम किया, उनके अनाकानी करने और रोने कर भी वे अपने इस निनन्‍्दय-
verses.wordMeaning: Vi$nu who had been born earlier as the son of Aditi andKasyapa took his ninth incarnation as the son of DevakI an asudeva with the Brahmana Gargya as his preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vi$nu who had been born earlier as the son of Aditi andKasyapa took his ninth incarnation as the son of DevakI an asudeva with the Brahmana Gargya as his preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनामुपकाराय योगिध्येयो जनार्दनः । शालग्रामेति तेनैव नर्मदातटमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: yogināmupakārāya yogidhyeyo janārdanaḥ / śālagrāmeti tenaiva narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: The lord is Aprameya (one whocannot be measured). He is Niyojya* (freely ordered about and employed bydevotees). He moves about as he pleases. He has full self-control. He sports about in the world like a boy playing with toys. This mighty-armed ladhusudana cannot be measured. There is nothing greater than the cosmic form of the Lord.
verses.hindi: कम से विरत नहीं हुए  दौघंतमा के इस महान् गवंमूलक अपराध ऋषि वारद्वान को सहन नहीं हुआ । उन्होंने देखा कि दीभंतमा अपने बल के कारण झोटे भाई की स्त्री के साथ जो पुत्रवधू के,समान है, समागम कर रहे हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: The lord is Aprameya (one whocannot be measured). He is Niyojya* (freely ordered about and employed bydevotees). He moves about as he pleases. He has full self-control. He sports about in the world like a boy playing with toys. This mighty-armed ladhusudana cannot be measured.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord is Aprameya (one whocannot be measured). He is Niyojya* (freely ordered about and employed bydevotees). He moves about as he pleases. He has full self-control. He sports about in the world like a boy playing with toys. This mighty-armed ladhusudana cannot be measured.…

verses.sanskrit: मासि मार्गशिरे शुक्ला भवत्येकादशी यदा । स्नात्वा रेवाजले पुण्ये तद्दिनं समुपोषयेत्
verses.transliteration: māsi mārgaśire śuklā bhavatyekādaśī yadā / snātvā revājale puṇye taddinaṃ samupoṣayet
verses.translation: In the twentycighth Dvapara Yuga, when a slight portion of the end of Dvapara remained and when Dharma had been destroyed, Lord Visnu was born in the family of Vi'?nis in order to establish Dharma and destroy Asuras. By means of his Yogic Maya, the Yogic soul fascinated all living beings.
verses.hindi: इस महान् विपयंय को देखकर महात्मा शरद्वान् को बड़ी चिन्ता हुई, किश्तु भविथ्य में घटित होनेबाली घटना
verses.wordMeaning: In the twentycighth Dvapara Yuga, when a slight portion of the end of Dvapara remained and when Dharma had been destroyed, Lord Visnu was born in the family of Vi'?nis in order to establish Dharma and destroy Asuras. By means of his Yogic Maya,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twentycighth Dvapara Yuga, when a slight portion of the end of Dvapara remained and when Dharma had been destroyed, Lord Visnu was born in the family of Vi'?nis in order to establish Dharma and destroy Asuras. By means of his Yogic Maya,…

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यात् सम्पूज्य च जनार्दनम् । पुनः प्रभातसमये द्वादश्यां नर्मदाजले
verses.transliteration: rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt sampūjya ca janārdanam / punaḥ prabhātasamaye dvādaśyāṃ narmadājale
verses.translation: Entering human womb, he moved about on the Earth fully concealed (from the view of ordinary mortals) for the sake of the sport among the human beings. He was accom¬ panied by Sandipani as his preceptor.
verses.hindi: के प्रभाव को जानते हुए उन्होंने दीघंतमा को यृत्यु का शाप नहीं दिया ।५८-६०। अत्यश्त क्रोध से उनके नेत्र लाल हो गये आवेश में भर कर दोध॑तमा से बोले, रे दुष्कमंपरायण ! तू गम्य अग्रम्य कुछ नहीं जानता, पशुधम
verses.wordMeaning: Entering human womb, he moved about on the Earth fully concealed (from the view of ordinary mortals) for the sake of the sport among the human beings. He was accom¬ panied by Sandipani as his preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Entering human womb, he moved about on the Earth fully concealed (from the view of ordinary mortals) for the sake of the sport among the human beings. He was accom¬ panied by Sandipani as his preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा संतर्प्य देवांश्च पित्ःन्मात्ःस् तथैव च । श्राद्धं कृत्वा ततः पश्चात् पितृभ्यो विधिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā saṃtarpya devāṃśca pitḥnmātḥs tathaiva ca / śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paścāt pitṛbhyo vidhipūrvakam
verses.translation: In that incarnation, the powerful lord slew the following Daityas who had taken human bodies: Kamsa, Salva, Dvivida the great Asura, Arista, Vrsabha, Kesin the horse, Kuvalayaplda the elephant, the chief of wrestlers, the officer in-charge of the abode (ofKarhsa) (Canura) and the demoness Putana.
verses.hindi: को प्रश्रय देकर पुत्रवध् के साथ समागम करना चाहता है! अब मैं तुझे छोड़ रहा हूँ, अपने इस नीच
verses.wordMeaning: In that incarnation, the powerful lord slew the following Daityas who had taken human bodies: Kamsa, Salva, Dvivida the great Asura, Arista, Vrsabha, Kesin the horse, Kuvalayaplda the elephant, the chief of wrestlers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In that incarnation, the powerful lord slew the following Daityas who had taken human bodies: Kamsa, Salva, Dvivida the great Asura, Arista, Vrsabha, Kesin the horse, Kuvalayaplda the elephant, the chief of wrestlers,…

verses.sanskrit: शक्तितो ब्राह्मणान्पूज्य स्वर्णवस्त्रान्नदानतः । क्षमापयित्वा तान्विप्रांस्तथा देवं खगध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: śaktito brāhmaṇānpūjya svarṇavastrānnadānataḥ / kṣamāpayitvā tānviprāṃstathā devaṃ khagadhvajam
verses.translation: The thousand arms of Bana of wonderful exploits were cut ofTby him. The Asura Naraka and the powerful (Kala-) Yavana were killed by him in battle.
verses.hindi: कर्म का फल भोग । अन्धे, वद्ध, एवं जीविका चलाने में असमर्थ होकर भी तुम इतना नीच कर्म कर रहे हो, जिसे कोई नहीं करता, अतः मैं तुम्हें एक महान् दुराचारी समझ रहा हूँ, और इसीलिये तुम घर से बाहर
verses.wordMeaning: The thousand arms of Bana of wonderful exploits were cut ofTby him. The Asura Naraka and the powerful (Kala-) Yavana were killed by him in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: The thousand arms of Bana of wonderful exploits were cut ofTby him. The Asura Naraka and the powerful (Kala-) Yavana were killed by him in battle.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृते महाराज यत्पुण्यं च भवेन्न्ःणाम् । शृणुष्वावहितो भूत्वा तत्पुण्यं नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛte mahārāja yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhavennḥṇām / śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā tatpuṇyaṃ nṛpasattama
verses.translation: All the precious gems and jewels of kings were con¬ fiscated by him through his splendid refulgence. All the kings of evil conduct in Rasiitala were killed by him.
verses.wordMeaning: All the precious gems and jewels of kings were con¬ fiscated by him through his splendid refulgence. All the kings of evil conduct in Rasiitala were killed by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the precious gems and jewels of kings were con¬ fiscated by him through his splendid refulgence. All the kings of evil conduct in Rasiitala were killed by him.

verses.sanskrit: न शोकदुःखे प्रतिपत्स्यतीह जीवन्मृतो याति मुरारिसाम्यम् । महान्ति पापानि विसृज्य दुग्धं पुनर्न मातुः पिबते स्तनोद्यत्
verses.transliteration: na śokaduḥkhe pratipatsyatīha jīvanmṛto yāti murārisāmyam / mahānti pāpāni visṛjya dugdhaṃ punarna mātuḥ pibate stanodyat
verses.translation: These incarnations of the noble-souled lord were for the sake of the benefit of the worlds.
verses.hindi: खूत बोले--ऋषिवन्द ! इतना कहने के उपरान्त दीध॑तमा की प्रवृत्ति क्र कर्म में हो गयी। तब ऋषि शरद्वान् ने उनकी बहुत भत्संता करके अपने दोनों बाहुओं से पकड़ कर एक बाक्स में बन्द कर समुद्र में बह जाने के लिये गंगा जल में डाल दिया ।६३। एक सब्ताह तक गंगा के श्ोतों में तैरते रहने के बाद दीर्घतमा को स्त्री समेत परम धामिक राजा बलि ने देखा । उस समय वे डूब रहे थे, किस्तु जल के प्रवाह से राजा के समीप पहुंच चुके थे । विरोचन पुत्र राजा बलिने दीर्घतमा को जलराधि से पंकड़ कर ऊपर
verses.wordMeaning: These incarnations of the noble-souled lord were for the sake of the benefit of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: These incarnations of the noble-souled lord were for the sake of the benefit of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: शालग्रामं पश्यते यो हि नित्यं स्नात्वा जले नार्मदे ऽघौघहारे । स मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यादिपापैर्नारायणानुस्मरणेन तेन
verses.transliteration: śālagrāmaṃ paśyate yo hi nityaṃ snātvā jale nārmade 'ghaughahāre / sa mucyate brahmahatyādipāpairnārāyaṇānusmaraṇena tena
verses.translation: He will be leading all the armies consisting of elephants, horses and chariots. He will be surrounded by hundreds and thousands of Brahmanas armed with weapons. He will be killing those who are not very religious and those who hate religion, viz. the northerners, those of the middle lands, those who live to the west of the Vindhya mountain, the southerners (such as) Dravitfas along with Simhalcse, Gandharas, Paradas, Pahlavas, Yavanas, Sakas, Tusaras, Barbaras, Pulindas, Daradas,Khasas, Lampakas, Andhakas, Rudras and Kiratas. The powerful lord will destroy Mlecchas making his discus whirl. He will be invisible to all living beings and move about on the Earth. Visnu will be born as a human being with a part of the intelligent god. In the previous birth he would have been born as the powerful Pramiti.
verses.hindi: स्लींच कर बचा लिया और अपने अस्तःपुर में ले जाकर विविध प्रकार के खान पानादि से उन्हें सन्तुष्द
verses.wordMeaning: He will be leading all the armies consisting of elephants, horses and chariots. He will be surrounded by hundreds and thousands of Brahmanas armed with weapons. He will be killing those who are not very religious and those who hate religion, viz. the northerners,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He will be leading all the armies consisting of elephants, horses and chariots. He will be surrounded by hundreds and thousands of Brahmanas armed with weapons. He will be killing those who are not very religious and those who hate religion, viz. the northerners,…

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ति ये संन्यसित्वा च तत्र निगृह्य दुःखानि विमुक्तसङ्घाः । ध्यायन्तो वै सांख्यवृत्त्या तुरीयं पदं मुरारेस्ते ऽपि तत्रैव यान्ति
verses.transliteration: vasanti ye saṃnyasitvā ca tatra nigṛhya duḥkhāni vimuktasaṅghāḥ / dhyāyanto vai sāṃkhyavṛttyā turīyaṃ padaṃ murāreste 'pi tatraiva yānti
verses.translation: In bodily splendour he was (will be) like the moon and will be born when the Kaliyuga is complete. Thus the ten incarnations of the lord have been recounted.
verses.hindi: २६ क्‍ वायपुराणन् संतानार्थ महाभाग भारयाया मम सानद। पुत्रान्धर्मायंसंयुक्तानुत्पादयितु महँसि
verses.wordMeaning: In bodily splendour he was (will be) like the moon and will be born when the Kaliyuga is complete. Thus the ten incarnations of the lord have been recounted.
verses.commentary: Sense: In bodily splendour he was (will be) like the moon and will be born when the Kaliyuga is complete. Thus the ten incarnations of the lord have been recounted.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शालग्रामतीर्थमहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टाशीत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १८९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । उदीर्णो यत्र वाराहो ह्यभवद्धरणीधरः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śālagrāmatīrthamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāśītyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 189 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / udīrṇo yatra vārāho hyabhavaddharaṇīdharaḥ
verses.translation: The lord takes incarnations in the different periods with a part of his powerful splendour in the three worlds for different purposes and ends in view. He is born in different wombs in accordance with the function he has to perform.
verses.hindi: एयमुक्तस्तु तेनपिस्तथाउस्त्वित्युक्तवान्हितम् । सुदेष्णां नाम भार्या स्वां राजाउस्सै प्राहिणोत्तदा
verses.wordMeaning: The lord takes incarnations in the different periods with a part of his powerful splendour in the three worlds for different purposes and ends in view. He is born in different wombs in accordance with the function he has to perform.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord takes incarnations in the different periods with a part of his powerful splendour in the three worlds for different purposes and ends in view. He is born in different wombs in accordance with the function he has to perform.

verses.sanskrit: धन्वदंष्ट्रां करालाग्रां बिभ्रच्च पृथिवीम् इमाम् । स एव पञ्चमः प्रोक्तो वाराहो मुक्तिदायकः
verses.transliteration: dhanvadaṃṣṭrāṃ karālāgrāṃ bibhracca pṛthivīm imām / sa eva pañcamaḥ prokto vārāho muktidāyakaḥ
verses.translation: When the twentyfifth Kalpa has started and twenty- five years have elapsed, he will be killing all living being and men.
verses.hindi: अन्धं बुद्ध च॒ त॑ं दृष्टूवा न सा देवी जगाम ह। स्वां च धात्रेयकों तस्मे भृषयित्वा व्यसजंयतू कक्षीवचक्षुषों तस्यां शुद्रयोन्‍्यास्पृषिवेंशी । जनयामास धर्मात्मा पुत्राबेतो महोजसौ ७० कक्षीवचक्षषों तो तु दृष्ट्वा राजा बलिस्तदा। प्राधीतौ विधिवत्सम्यगीश्वरों ब्रह्मतादिनो.
verses.wordMeaning: When the twentyfifth Kalpa has started and twenty- five years have elapsed, he will be killing all living being and men.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the twentyfifth Kalpa has started and twenty- five years have elapsed, he will be killing all living being and men.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथमुदीर्णरूपो ऽभूद्वाराहो धरणीधरः । वाराहत्वं गतः केन पञ्चमः केन संज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathamudīrṇarūpo 'bhūdvārāho dharaṇīdharaḥ / vārāhatvaṃ gataḥ kena pañcamaḥ kena saṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: By means of his ruthless activities he will make the Earth left with only the seeds. He would have (then) mas¬ sacred all Vrsalas and almost all impious persons.
verses.hindi: सिद्धों प्रत्यक्षधर्माणो बुद्धों श्रेष्ठममावषि । ममंताबिति होवाच वलिबवेरोचनस्त्युषिम्
verses.wordMeaning: By means of his ruthless activities he will make the Earth left with only the seeds. He would have (then) mas¬ sacred all Vrsalas and almost all impious persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of his ruthless activities he will make the Earth left with only the seeds. He would have (then) mas¬ sacred all Vrsalas and almost all impious persons.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: आदिकल्पे पुरा राजन्क्षीरोदे भगवान् हरिः । शेते स भोगिशयने योगनिद्राविमोहितः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ādikalpe purā rājankṣīrode bhagavān hariḥ / śete sa bhogiśayane yoganidrāvimohitaḥ
verses.translation: Then Kalki will have achieved his object along with

verses.sanskrit: बभूव नृपतिश्रेष्ठ गत्वा वै देवसंनिधौ । अवोचद्भारखिन्नाहं गमिष्यामि रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: babhūva nṛpatiśreṣṭha gatvā vai devasaṃnidhau / avocadbhārakhinnāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi rasātalam
verses.translation: They will be resorting to rivers and mountains. Leaves, roots and fruits will constitute their diet. They will be wearing leaves and barks of trees or hides. There will be a highly indiscriminate fusion of castes. In the last junction of the Kali age they will be short-lived and highly distressed. Their means of sustenance will be destroyed. They will be overwhel¬ med with many adversities. They will undergo sufferings. The people will be completely extinct along with the Kali age. When the Kali age lapses and the Krta Yuga starts again, all objects will regain their original forms.naturally and not other¬ wise. Thus I have recounted the activities of Devas and Asuras. In the context of the narration of Yadu race the great fame of Visnu has been recounted. I shall now recount the race of Turvasu, Puru and Druhvu.
verses.hindi: किया । बलि के इस व्यवहार से दीर्घतमा परम सन्तुष्ट हुए और वरदान देकर उसे प्रसन्न करता चाहा । दानव-  पति बलि ने पुत्र की कामना से दीघंतमा से वरदान याचना की
verses.wordMeaning: They will be resorting to rivers and mountains. Leaves, roots and fruits will constitute their diet. They will be wearing leaves and barks of trees or hides. There will be a highly indiscriminate fusion of castes.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They will be resorting to rivers and mountains. Leaves, roots and fruits will constitute their diet. They will be wearing leaves and barks of trees or hides. There will be a highly indiscriminate fusion of castes.…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा देवाः समुद्विग्ना गता यत्र जनार्दनः । तुष्टुवुर्वाग्भिरिष्टाभिः केशवं जगत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā devāḥ samudvignā gatā yatra janārdanaḥ / tuṣṭuvurvāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ keśavaṃ jagatpatim
verses.translation: Vahni was the son of Turvasu. Gobhanu was the son of Vahni 3. The unconquered heroic Trisanu was Gobhanu's son.
verses.hindi: बलि ने कहा--मानियों के मान रक्षक! महाभाग्यशालिन् । मैं सन्‍्तान प्राप्ति कौ याचना आपसे कर रहा हूँ, आप धर्म, अथं, काम से समन्वित पुत्रों की उत्पत्ति मेरे लिये करें बलि के इस प्रकार कहने पर दीघंतमा ने कहा कि बहुत अच्छा, मुझे आपकी प्राथेता स्वीकार है। राजा बलि ने अपनी सुदेष्णा. नामक रानी को सन्‍्तान के लिये दीघंतमा के पास जाने के लिये कहा ।६५। दीघेतमा को अन्धा और वृद्ध देखकर देवी सुदेष्णा उनके पास स्वयं नहीं गयी और अपनी धाय को विविध वस्त्राभूषणादि से विभूषित कर भेज दिया  उस शुद्रयोनि में जितेन्द्रिय
verses.wordMeaning: Vahni was the son of Turvasu. Gobhanu was the son of Vahni 3. The unconquered heroic Trisanu was Gobhanu's son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vahni was the son of Turvasu. Gobhanu was the son of Vahni 3. The unconquered heroic Trisanu was Gobhanu's son.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । नमो नमस्ते देवेश सुरार्तिहर सर्वग । विश्वमूर्ते नमस्तुभ्यं त्राहि सर्वान्महद्भयात्
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ / namo namaste deveśa surārtihara sarvaga / viśvamūrte namastubhyaṃ trāhi sarvānmahadbhayāt
verses.translation: These verses (to the end of the chapter) describe a gloomy picture of the society at the end of Kali Yuga. All Puranas are unanimous in depicting the terrible state of the public as Kali advances.
verses.hindi: वश्यामा दीघतमा ने कक्षीबान्ू और चाक्षुष नामक दो घर्मात्मा पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया, जो महान् तेजस्वी थे ।६९-७०। उन कक्षीवान् और चाक्षुप नामक पुत्रों को, जो भली भाँति पढ़ लिखकर ब्रह्मवेत्ता योगपरायण, परमबुद्धिमान्, सिद्ध, धमंतत्त्वों के विचारक एवं श्रेष्ठ हो चुके थे, देखकर विरोचन पृत्र राजा बलि ने कहा कि ये दोनों हमारे पुत्र हैं क्‍या ? दीघेतमा ने कहा, नहीं, ये तुम्हारे नहीं, हमारे पुत्र हैं;
verses.wordMeaning: These verses (to the end of the chapter) describe a gloomy picture of the society at the end of Kali Yuga. All Puranas are unanimous in depicting the terrible state of the public as Kali advances.
verses.commentary: Sense: These verses (to the end of the chapter) describe a gloomy picture of the society at the end of Kali Yuga. All Puranas are unanimous in depicting the terrible state of the public as Kali advances.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तो दैवतैर्देवो ह्युवाच किमुपस्थितम् । कार्यं वदध्वं मे देवा यत्कृत्यं मा चिरं कृथाः
verses.transliteration: ityukto daivatairdevo hyuvāca kimupasthitam / kāryaṃ vadadhvaṃ me devā yatkṛtyaṃ mā ciraṃ kṛthāḥ
verses.translation: This chapter correspond to Bd. 3.74. Reference are to verse numbers.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि तुम्हारे छद्म से ये शुद्र योनि में उत्पन्न हुए हैं, ये असुरों में श्रेष्ठ होंगे (?) तुम्हारी रानी सुदेष्णा ने मुझे अन्धा और युद्ध मासकर अपमान करने के लिये मेरे पास अपनी एक शुद्रवर्ण घाय को भेज दिया था ।७१-७४। दीघंतमा की ऐसी बातें सुनकर राजा बलि ने उनकी पुन: पुतः प्राथंना की और किसी नवमवतितमोष्ष्याय: है२७
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter correspond to Bd. 3.74. Reference are to verse numbers.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter correspond to Bd. 3.74. Reference are to verse numbers.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः । धरा धरित्री भूतानां भारोद्विग्ना निमज्जति । तामुद्धर हृषीकेश लोकान्संस्थापय स्थितौ
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ / dharā dharitrī bhūtānāṃ bhārodvignā nimajjati / tāmuddhara hṛṣīkeśa lokānsaṃsthāpaya sthitau
verses.translation: Genealogy orTurvasu as recorded in AITH, shows Garbha as the predecessor of Gobhanu.
verses.hindi: क्‍ पुनश्चेनामलंकृत्य ऋषये प्रत्यपादयत् । तां सं दी्घंतमा देवीमब्नवीद्यदि मां शुसे . ७६ दध्ना लवणमिश्रेण स्व (सु) व्यक्त नग्नकं तथा लिहिष्यस्यजुपुप्सन्ती आपादतलसस्तफस्
verses.wordMeaning: Genealogy orTurvasu as recorded in AITH, shows Garbha as the predecessor of Gobhanu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Genealogy orTurvasu as recorded in AITH, shows Garbha as the predecessor of Gobhanu.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः सुरैः सर्वैः केशवः परमेश्वरः । वाराहं रूपमास्थाय सर्वयज्ञमयं विभुः
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ keśavaḥ parameśvaraḥ / vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya sarvayajñamayaṃ vibhuḥ
verses.translation: Thus, due to the curse of Yayati in connection with the
verses.hindi: ततस्त्व॑ प्राप्स्यसे देवि पृत्रांश्व मनसेप्सितान् । तस्य सा तद्गचो देवो सर्व कृतवती तथा ७८ ततस्त॑ दीघंतमस सा देवी प्रत्युवाच ह्। नाहुेसि त्वं महाभाग पुत्र दातुं ममेदृशम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, due to the curse of Yayati in connection with the
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, due to the curse of Yayati in connection with the

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालं पिङ्गाक्षं समाकुञ्चितमूर्धजम् । कृत्वा ऽनन्तं पादपीठं दंष्ट्राग्रेणोद्धरन्भुवम्
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ piṅgākṣaṃ samākuñcitamūrdhajam / kṛtvā 'nantaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ daṃṣṭrāgreṇoddharanbhuvam
verses.translation: The successor of Duskrta was the king named Sarutha. After Sarutha came Janapltfa and he had four sons.
verses.hindi: ( ऋषिरझुवाच ) तवापराधो देव्येष नास्यथा भविता नु वे । देवोदानों च ते पुत्रमहं दास्यामि सुब्रते
verses.wordMeaning: The successor of Duskrta was the king named Sarutha. After Sarutha came Janapltfa and he had four sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The successor of Duskrta was the king named Sarutha. After Sarutha came Janapltfa and he had four sons.

verses.sanskrit: सपर्वतवनाम् उर्वीं समुद्रपरिमेखलाम् । उद्धृत्य भगवान् विष्णुर् उदीर्णः समजायत
verses.transliteration: saparvatavanām urvīṃ samudraparimekhalām / uddhṛtya bhagavān viṣṇur udīrṇaḥ samajāyata
verses.translation: They were Pantfya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya with their kingdoms named after them, viz. Pandya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya.
verses.hindi: प्रकार उन्हें प्रसक्ष किया । ऐश्वयंशाली राजा बलि मे अपनी पत्नी सुदेष्णा को भी बड़ी भर्त्सना की। और पुनः अलंकारादि से विभूषित कर ऋषि के पास भेजा । दीघंतमा ने सुदेष्णा से कहा, मजूले  यदि नमक मिश्रित दही मेरे नग्न और खुले हुए समस्त शरीर में लगाकर पैर से लेकर मस्तक तक बिना किसी घ॒णा या जुगृप्सा के अपनी जीम से चाटोगी तब अपनी इच्छा के अनुसार पुत्रों को प्राप्त करोगी । देवी सुदेष्णा ने दीधंतमा के इस आदेक्ष का यद्यपि सर्वाशतः पालन किया ॥७५-७८। पर उनके शरीर के मलमाग को चाटते उसे बड़ी घुणा हुई जिससे छोड़ दिया । ऐसा देखकर ऋषि दीघंतमा ने सुदेष्णा से पुनः कहा, शुभे ! अपने ज्येष्;य कुमार को बिना अपान (मलमार्ग) के उत्पन्न करोगी  दोध॑ंतमा को ऐसी बातें सुनकर देवी ने पुन्रः प्राथंना की, महाभाग ! ऐसे पुत्र देने कि कपा आप ने
verses.wordMeaning: They were Pantfya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya with their kingdoms named after them, viz. Pandya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Pantfya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya with their kingdoms named after them, viz. Pandya, Kerala, Cola and Kulya.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शयन्पञ्चधात्मानमुत्तरे नर्मदातटे । तथाद्यं कोरलायां तु द्वितीयं योधनीपुरे
verses.transliteration: darśayanpañcadhātmānamuttare narmadātaṭe / tathādyaṃ koralāyāṃ tu dvitīyaṃ yodhanīpure
verses.translation: Druhyu had two heroic sons well known as Babhru and Setu. Aruddha was the son of Setu and Ripu was the son of Babhru.
verses.hindi: ऋषि ने कहाः--देवि ! यह तो तुम्हारा ही अपराध है, अब यह अस्यथा नहीं हो सकता  सद्वद्धपदायणे ! देबि ऐसा ही है तो तुम्हारा पौत्र इस प्रकार का होगा । उसका अपानभागं के विना भी सब कार्य होता रहेगा । ऐसा कहने के उपरान्त ऋषिवर दीर्घतमा ने देवी सुदेष्णा की कुक्षि का स्पष्शी करते हुए पुनः कहा, देवि ! सुन्दर हँसनेवालो ! तू ने मेरे समस्त अंगों से दधि का जो प्राशन
verses.wordMeaning: Druhyu had two heroic sons well known as Babhru and Setu. Aruddha was the son of Setu and Ripu was the son of Babhru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Druhyu had two heroic sons well known as Babhru and Setu. Aruddha was the son of Setu and Ripu was the son of Babhru.

verses.sanskrit: जयक्षेत्राभिधाने तु जयेति परिकीर्तितम् । असुरान् मोहयल्लिङ्गस्तृतीयः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: jayakṣetrābhidhāne tu jayeti parikīrtitam / asurān mohayalliṅgastṛtīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: This strong (king) Ripu was killed in war with very great difficulty by Yauvanasva. Their great war lasted conti¬ nuously for fourteen months.
verses.hindi: क्र लिया है, उसके फलस्वरूप तुम्हारा गर्भ पूणिमा तिथि के समुद्र की भाँति पूण्णता को प्राप्त हो जया एतच्चिद्वान्तमंतग्रल्थों  पुस्तके मास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: This strong (king) Ripu was killed in war with very great difficulty by Yauvanasva. Their great war lasted conti¬ nuously for fourteen months.
verses.commentary: Sense: This strong (king) Ripu was killed in war with very great difficulty by Yauvanasva. Their great war lasted conti¬ nuously for fourteen months.

verses.sanskrit: पावनाय जगद्धेतोः स्थितो यस्माच्छशिप्रभः । अतस्तु नृपशार्दूल श्वेत इत्याभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: pāvanāya jagaddhetoḥ sthito yasmācchaśiprabhaḥ / atastu nṛpaśārdūla śveta ityābhidhīyate
verses.translation: Aruddha's successor was the king named Gandhara after whom the great lan d of Gandhara took its name. 2
verses.hindi: भविष्यन्ति कुमारास्ते पञ्च देवसुतोपमाः । तेजस्विनः पराक्वान्ता यज्वानो धार्मिकासत्तथा ॥ढड़ ततो5डूस्तु सुवेष्णाया ज्येष्ठपुत्रों व्यजायत । वज्भस्तस्मात्कलिड्रस्तु पुण्डी ब्रह्मस्तथेव च
verses.wordMeaning: Aruddha's successor was the king named Gandhara after whom the great lan d of Gandhara took its name. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Aruddha's successor was the king named Gandhara after whom the great lan d of Gandhara took its name. 2

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृत्य जगतां देवीमुदीर्णो भृगुकच्छके । ततः पञ्चम उदीर्णो वराह इति संज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtya jagatāṃ devīmudīrṇo bhṛgukacchake / tataḥ pañcama udīrṇo varāha iti saṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: The horses bred in Gandhara land are the most excel¬ lent horses. Gandhara's son was Dharma and Ghrta (Dhrta) was his son.
verses.hindi: प्रजास्त्वपहतास्तस्य ब्रह्मणा कारण प्रति । अपत्यमस्य दारेषु स्वेषु मा भुन्महात्मनः ८७ ततो मनुष्ययोन्यां वे जनयामास स प्रजा: । सुरभिदीर्घतमसमथ प्रोतो बचो5ब्रवीत् विचार्य यस्माद्गोधर्म त्वमेवं कृतवानसि  तेन न्‍्यायेन सुसुचे अहं प्रीतो5स्ति तेन ते
verses.wordMeaning: The horses bred in Gandhara land are the most excel¬ lent horses. Gandhara's son was Dharma and Ghrta (Dhrta) was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses bred in Gandhara land are the most excel¬ lent horses. Gandhara's son was Dharma and Ghrta (Dhrta) was his son.

verses.sanskrit: इति पञ्चवराहास्ते कथितः पाण्डुनन्दन । युगपद्दर्शनं चैषां ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: iti pañcavarāhāste kathitaḥ pāṇḍunandana / yugapaddarśanaṃ caiṣāṃ brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: Durdama was born to Ghrta (Dhrta) and his son was Pracetas. A hundred sons were born to Pracetas. All of them were kings.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्तव तमो दोर्ष निस्तुदाम्यल्व पश्य वे । बाहुस्पत्यं च॒ यत्तेध्स्यत्पापं संतिष्ठते तनो
verses.wordMeaning: Durdama was born to Ghrta (Dhrta) and his son was Pracetas. A hundred sons were born to Pracetas. All of them were kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Durdama was born to Ghrta (Dhrta) and his son was Pracetas. A hundred sons were born to Pracetas. All of them were kings.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठे मासि सिते पक्ष एकादश्यां विशेषतः । गत्वा ह्यादिवराहं तु सम्प्राप्ते दशमीदिने
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣa ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / gatvā hyādivarāhaṃ tu samprāpte daśamīdine
verses.translation: All of them were the rulers of the Mleccha territory in the northern direction (region). Anu had three noble-souled sons. All of them were highly righteous.
verses.hindi: है ।८१-८३। तुम्दारे गर्भ से देवताओं के समान परम सुन्दर एवं प्रभावशाली पाँच पुत्र उत्पन्न होंगे, वे परम धामिक, यश्षपरायण, परमपराक्रमक्षाली एवं तेजस्वी होंगे । ऋषिवर दी्तमा के इस वरदान के अनुसा € देवी सुदेष्णा से राजा बलि का ज्येष्ठ पृत्र अज्ञ उत्पन्न हुबा  उसके बाद बज, फिर कलिड्भ, फिर पुष्ड् तथा सबसे बाद में ब्रह्म नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ! वंक्ष की वृद्धि करनेवाले ये पुत्रणण राजा बलि के क्षोत्रज पुत्र थे। प्राचीन काल में ऋषिवर दीर्घतमा ने इन्हों पाचों पुत्रों को राजा बलि को प्रदान किया था ।५४-८६। भगवान् ब्रहा ने किसी कारणवश इस महात्मा को (तुम्हें अपनी स्त्रियों में सन्‍्तर्ति न होगी-- ऐसा अभिशाप दिया था। इसी से उन्हें अपनी पत्नी में कोई सस्तति न हुई, इसी कारण वश उन्होंने मनुष्य योनि में सस्ततियाँ उत्पन्न कों। ऋषि के इस गोक्म से परम श्रसन्न होंकद वृष ने यह
verses.wordMeaning: All of them were the rulers of the Mleccha territory in the northern direction (region). Anu had three noble-souled sons. All of them were highly righteous.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them were the rulers of the Mleccha territory in the northern direction (region). Anu had three noble-souled sons. All of them were highly righteous.

verses.sanskrit: हविष्यमन्नं भुञ्जीयाल् लघुसायं गते रवौ । रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याद् वाराहे ह्यादिसंज्ञके
verses.transliteration: haviṣyamannaṃ bhuñjīyāl laghusāyaṃ gate ravau / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād vārāhe hyādisaṃjñake
verses.translation: They were Sabhanara, Paksa and Parapaksa. The son of Sabhanara was the scholarly king Kalanala.
verses.hindi: बचन कहा 'तुमने घोधरं की मर्यादा पर भलोभांति विचार कर पालन किया है, दे मुने ! तुम्हारे इस आचरण से मैं परम प्रसन्न हूं, देखो, आज महान् अंधकार से मैं तुम्हारी मुक्ति कर रहा हूँ, तुम्हारे शरीर में बृहस्पति के श्ञाप के कारण जो पाप चिरकाल से निबद्ध था, उसे भी तुमसे अलग कर रहा हैं ।7७-€०। अपने नथुनों से सूंघकर तुम्हारे शरीर से वृद्धता एवं मृत्यु के श्ञाप को भी मैं दूर कर रहा हें ।!
verses.wordMeaning: They were Sabhanara, Paksa and Parapaksa. The son of Sabhanara was the scholarly king Kalanala.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Sabhanara, Paksa and Parapaksa. The son of Sabhanara was the scholarly king Kalanala.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभाते ह्युषसि संस्नात्वा नर्मदाजले । संतर्प्य पितृदेवांश्च तिलैर्यवविमिश्रितैः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte hyuṣasi saṃsnātvā narmadājale / saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca tilairyavavimiśritaiḥ
verses.translation: Kalanala's son was the pious-souled Spijaya who was righteous. The heroic king Puranjaya was the son of Srnjaya.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहने के उपराम्त वृषभ के सुंघते ही दीर्षतमा का चिरकालीन अंधकार दूर हो गया, ओर वे देखने लगे  आशीर्वाद के फलस्वरूप वे दीर्घायुसम्पन्न युवा ओर नेत्रवानू हो गये  इस प्रकार गो के आशीर्वाद से ऋषि दीधंतमा गौतम--इस नये नाम से प्रख्यात हुये । तदनन्तर शुद्रा के गर्भ से समुत्पप्न कक्षीवाद् ने पिता के साथ परव्वतोय भ्रदेश को प्रस्थान किया ओयण पिता के कल्याणाय ऐसी तैतः कालेन महृता तपसा भावितः स॒ वे । विधूय सानुजों दोषास्व्राह्मण्यं प्राप्तवास्प्रभु:
verses.wordMeaning: Kalanala's son was the pious-souled Spijaya who was righteous. The heroic king Puranjaya was the son of Srnjaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kalanala's son was the pious-souled Spijaya who was righteous. The heroic king Puranjaya was the son of Srnjaya.

verses.sanskrit: धेनुं दद्याद्द्विजे योग्ये सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् । निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो दानं दद्याद् द्विजातये
verses.transliteration: dhenuṃ dadyāddvije yogye sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām / nirmamo nirahaṅkāro dānaṃ dadyād dvijātaye
verses.translation: Janamejaya of great strength and vitality was the son of the saintly king Puranjaya.
verses.hindi: ततो5ब्रबीत्पिता चेन॑ पुत्रवानस्म्यहूं प्रभो। सत्पुत्रेण त्वया तात क्तार्थोस्मि यशस्विना
verses.wordMeaning: Janamejaya of great strength and vitality was the son of the saintly king Puranjaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Janamejaya of great strength and vitality was the son of the saintly king Puranjaya.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा सम्पूजयेद् देवं वाराहं ह्यादिसंज्ञितम् । अनेन विधिना पूज्य पश्चाद्गच्छेज्जयं त्वरन्
verses.transliteration: gatvā sampūjayed devaṃ vārāhaṃ hyādisaṃjñitam / anena vidhinā pūjya paścādgacchejjayaṃ tvaran
verses.translation: This king was equal to Indra. His fame was established (even) in heaven. Mahamanas was the son of MahaSala. He was very pious.
verses.hindi: कृताय: सोषपि योगात्मा योगमाश्रित्य च प्रभुः  अदृश्यः सर्वभुतानां कालाकाइक्षी चरत्युत तत्राड़स्य तु राजवें राजा६इसोहधिवाहनः । सापराधसुदेष्णाया अनपानो5भवश्लूपः
verses.wordMeaning: This king was equal to Indra. His fame was established (even) in heaven. Mahamanas was the son of MahaSala. He was very pious.
verses.commentary: Sense: This king was equal to Indra. His fame was established (even) in heaven. Mahamanas was the son of MahaSala. He was very pious.

verses.sanskrit: त्वरितं तु जयं गत्वा पूर्वकं विधिमाचरेत् । अश्वं दद्याद् द्विजाग्र्याय जयपूर्वाभिनिर्गतम्
verses.transliteration: tvaritaṃ tu jayaṃ gatvā pūrvakaṃ vidhimācaret / aśvaṃ dadyād dvijāgryāya jayapūrvābhinirgatam
verses.translation: He was the lord of the seven continents. He was an emperor of great fame. Mahamanas procreated two famous sons.
verses.hindi: अनपानस्य पुत्रस्तु राजा विविरथः स्मृतः । पुश्रो विविरथस्या5असोदिद्वान्धर्म रथों नृपः
verses.wordMeaning: He was the lord of the seven continents. He was an emperor of great fame. Mahamanas procreated two famous sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was the lord of the seven continents. He was an emperor of great fame. Mahamanas procreated two famous sons.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गे चैव तिला देयाः श्वेते हिरण्यमेव च । उदीर्णे च भुवं दद्यात् पूर्वकं विधिम् आचरेत्
verses.transliteration: liṅge caiva tilā deyāḥ śvete hiraṇyameva ca / udīrṇe ca bhuvaṃ dadyāt pūrvakaṃ vidhim ācaret
verses.translation: They were Usinara the knower of Dharma and Titiksu the righteous. Uslnara had five wives. They were born of the races of saintly kings.
verses.hindi: »स वे धर्मरथः भ्रीमान्येन विष्णुवदे गिरो  सोमः शक्रेण सह वे यज्ञे पीतो महात्मना विपुल तपस्या की, जेसी तपस्या करने के लिये पिता ने उपदेश किया था। अपनी परम कठोर तपस्या के बल पर परम ऐद्वर्यशालो कक्षीवान् ने बहुत दिनों के उपरान्त सिद्धि प्राप्त की, ओर अपने तथा अपने अनुज चक्षुष के भी पापों को नष्टकर ब्राह्मणस्व को प्राप्त किया ।६१-६४। कक्षीबान् के इस कर्म से पिश्ा को परम प्रसन्नता हुई और वे बोले, सर्वंसमर्थ पुत्र ! तुम जैसे योग्य पूत्र से मैं पुत्रवान् हूँ, परम
verses.wordMeaning: They were Usinara the knower of Dharma and Titiksu the righteous. Uslnara had five wives. They were born of the races of saintly kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Usinara the knower of Dharma and Titiksu the righteous. Uslnara had five wives. They were born of the races of saintly kings.

verses.sanskrit: अनस्तमित आदित्ये वराहान्पञ्च पश्यतः । यत्फलं लभते पार्थ तदिहैकमनाः शृणु
verses.transliteration: anastamita āditye varāhānpañca paśyataḥ / yatphalaṃ labhate pārtha tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: They were Mrga (Nrga in Bd. P.), Krmi, Nava, Darva and Drsadvatl the fifth. Usinara had five sons from them. They made his race flourish. They were virtuous and grew old with the performance of great penance.
verses.hindi: यशस्वी सत्पुत्न को प्राप्त कर मैं कता्थ हो गया।' ऐसा कहने के उपरान्त महात्मा गोतम ने योग की साधना की और ब्रह्म के पद को प्राप्त किया । इधर कक्षीवान् ने ब्राह्मणत्व की प्राप्ति कर सहल्न पुत्रों की सृष्टि की । कक्षीवान् के वे पुत्र काले अंगोंवाले गौतम मोत्रीय कहे जाते हैं ।६५-६९ 2ै। बिरोचन के पुत्र बलि की एवं दीभंतमा की सन्‍्ततियों का परस्पर समागम जिस प्रकार हुआ, उसे मैं आप लोगों को बतला
verses.wordMeaning: They were Mrga (Nrga in Bd. P.), Krmi, Nava, Darva and Drsadvatl the fifth. Usinara had five sons from them. They made his race flourish. They were virtuous and grew old with the performance of great penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Mrga (Nrga in Bd. P.), Krmi, Nava, Darva and Drsadvatl the fifth. Usinara had five sons from them. They made his race flourish. They were virtuous and grew old with the performance of great penance.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वङ्गनागमः । एभिस्तु सह संयोगो विश्वस्तानां च वञ्चनम्
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ / ebhistu saha saṃyogo viśvastānāṃ ca vañcanam
verses.translation: Mrga (Nrga in Bd. P.) was the son of Mrga (Nrga), Nava was the son of Nava. Krmi was the son of KrmI and Suvrata, the virtuous, was the son of Darva.
verses.hindi: चुका । महाराज बलि अपने उन पांचों पुत्रों का राज्याभिषेक करने के उपराष्त इतार्थ हो गया। योगात्मा परमऐश्वयंशाल' वह राजा बलि योग का आश्रय लेकर सभी जीवों से अदृश्य होकर काल की प्रतीक्षा करता हुआ तपस्या में अपना काल यापन करने लगा। बलि के उन पाँचों पुत्रों में राजबि अद्भद का पुत्र दधिवाहन हुआ । देवी सुदेष्णा के अपराध के कारण दीर्भतमा के शापानुसार उसे मलमार्ग नहीं था। उस राजा दधिवाहन का दूसरा नाम असपान भी था, अनपान का पुत्र राजा दिविरथ कहा जाता है । दिविरथ का पुत्र परम विद्वानू राजा धर्मरव हुआ ।६७-१०१। इसी परम धामिक महाबलशाली श्रीसम्पन्न राजा धर्मरथ ने विष्णुपद नामक पर्वत पर इन्द्र के साथ एक यज्ञ में सोम रसका पान किया था। राजा
verses.wordMeaning: Mrga (Nrga in Bd. P.) was the son of Mrga (Nrga), Nava was the son of Nava. Krmi was the son of KrmI and Suvrata, the virtuous, was the son of Darva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mrga (Nrga in Bd. P.) was the son of Mrga (Nrga), Nava was the son of Nava. Krmi was the son of KrmI and Suvrata, the virtuous, was the son of Darva.

verses.sanskrit: स्वसृदुहितृभगिनीकुलदारोपबृंहणम् । आ जन्ममरणाद्यावत्पापं भरतसत्तम
verses.transliteration: svasṛduhitṛbhaginīkuladāropabṛṃhaṇam / ā janmamaraṇādyāvatpāpaṃ bharatasattama
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the son of Drsadvatl was (popular¬ ly called) Auslnara Sivi. The city ofSiviwas famous as Siva- pura * 1 (II) (III) (IV) and that of Mrga was the Yaudheya city. Navarastram belonged to Nava and the city Krmila to Krmi. That of Suvrata was Vrsta (Ambastha). Now listen and understand Sivi's sons.
verses.hindi: ५८ इत आरम्य अन्त्यश्च भविता नूप इत्यन्तग्रस्यों न विद्यते ग. पुस्तके । (इदमर्घ न विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the son of Drsadvatl was (popular¬ ly called) Auslnara Sivi. The city ofSiviwas famous as Siva- pura * 1 (II) (III) (IV) and that of Mrga was the Yaudheya city. Navarastram belonged to Nava and the city Krmila to Krmi. That of Suvrata was Vrsta (Ambastha).…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the son of Drsadvatl was (popular¬ ly called) Auslnara Sivi. The city ofSiviwas famous as Siva- pura * 1 (II) (III) (IV) and that of Mrga was the Yaudheya city. Navarastram belonged to Nava and the city Krmila to Krmi. That of Suvrata was Vrsta (Ambastha).…

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थपञ्चकपूतस्य वैष्णवस्य विशेषतः । युगपच्चविनश्येत तूलराशिरिवानलात्
verses.transliteration: tīrthapañcakapūtasya vaiṣṇavasya viśeṣataḥ / yugapaccavinaśyeta tūlarāśirivānalāt
verses.translation: The four sons of Sivi called Sivis were very popular among the people. They were Vrsadarbha, Suvlra, Kekaya and Madraka.
verses.hindi: रे ई ० वायुपुराण॑म् सुनुर्धभ रथस्यापि राजा चित्ररथो5भवत् । अथ चित्ररथस्थापि राजा दशरथो5भवत् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The four sons of Sivi called Sivis were very popular among the people. They were Vrsadarbha, Suvlra, Kekaya and Madraka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four sons of Sivi called Sivis were very popular among the people. They were Vrsadarbha, Suvlra, Kekaya and Madraka.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणानुस्मरणाज्जपध्यानाद् विशेषतः । विप्रणश्यन्ति पापानि गिरिकूटसमान्यपि
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇānusmaraṇājjapadhyānād viśeṣataḥ / vipraṇaśyanti pāpāni girikūṭasamānyapi
verses.translation: Their territories were very flourishing. They were Vrsadarbhas, Sucldarbhas, Kekayas and Madrakas. Now listen to the progeny of Titiksu.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मण: क्षत्रियेवेंश्येः सर्वे स्वेधमंनुष्ठिते । सर्वे धर्म वे तपसा सर्वे विष्णुपरायणा:(? ) ७
verses.wordMeaning: Their territories were very flourishing. They were Vrsadarbhas, Sucldarbhas, Kekayas and Madrakas. Now listen to the progeny of Titiksu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their territories were very flourishing. They were Vrsadarbhas, Sucldarbhas, Kekayas and Madrakas. Now listen to the progeny of Titiksu.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा पञ्च वराहान्वै पौरुषे महति स्थितः । आप्लवन्नर्मदातोये श्राद्धं कृत्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā pañca varāhānvai pauruṣe mahati sthitaḥ / āplavannarmadātoye śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: These places are located as follows:
verses.hindi: जज्ञे वे तण्डिकरतस्य वारणं शुक्रवारणम् ॥। आनयामास स महों मन्‍्त्रेर्वाहनमुत्तमम् हय॑ड्भूगस्प तु राजा दायादो भव्ररथः फिल । अथ भद्वरथस्या5सो दुबूह॒त्कर्मा प्रजेश्चरः
verses.wordMeaning: These places are located as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: These places are located as follows:

verses.sanskrit: उदयास्तमनाद् अर्वाग् यः पश्येल् लोटणेश्वरम् । कलेवरविमुक्तः स इत्येवं शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: udayāstamanād arvāg yaḥ paśyel loṭaṇeśvaram / kalevaravimuktaḥ sa ityevaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: The mighty-armed son of Titiksu named Us'adratha was the well-known king in the eastern quarter. His son was Hema.
verses.hindi: धमंरथ का पुत्र राजा चित्ररथ हुआ। उस चित्ररथ के पुत्र राजा ददढ्वरथ हुए । यही राजा दशरथ लोमपाद के नाम से विरुयात थे, जिनकी पुत्री शान्ता थीं) ।१०२०१०३। राजा दशरथ का पुत्र महान् यरास्वी कुलोद्धारक परम वोर राजा चतुरज्ध था, बह मद्दात्मा ऋष्यऋजु के अनुग्रह से उत्पन्न हुआ था। चतुरज्ञ का पुत्र राजा पृथुलाइव सुना जाता है। पृथुलाश्व का चम्प नामक पुत्र हुआ ।उस राजा चम्प की परम रमणीय
verses.wordMeaning: The mighty-armed son of Titiksu named Us'adratha was the well-known king in the eastern quarter. His son was Hema.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mighty-armed son of Titiksu named Us'adratha was the well-known king in the eastern quarter. His son was Hema.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तिं प्रयाति सहसा दुष्प्रापां परमेश्वरीम् । पौरुषे क्रियमाणे ऽपि न सिद्धिर्जायते यदि
verses.transliteration: muktiṃ prayāti sahasā duṣprāpāṃ parameśvarīm / pauruṣe kriyamāṇe 'pi na siddhirjāyate yadi
verses.translation: Sutapa was born to Hema and Bali was the son of Sutapas* (Bd. P.). The noble-minded Bali who was a great Yogin was bound (by Vamana). He took birth in the human womb, being desirous of children, as the family was ncarin extinction due to absence of issues. He begot sons who established the discriplines of four castes on this earth. He procreated the sons Ahga, Vanga, Sulha, Pundra and ICalinga. These are called Baleya Ksatras (the Ksatriyas born of Bali). That lord had Brahmana sons also called Baleya Brah- manas. They established the line (of Bali). Many boons were granted to the intelligent Bali by the delighted Brahma. The boons granted were Mahayogitva (the state of being a great Yogin), longevity of life lasting for a Kalpa, invincibility in war, great inclination towards righteousness and piety, the vision of the three worlds, importance among his descendants unrivalled state in strength as the ability to see the true prin¬ ciples of Dharma. "You will establish the (discipline of) four castes"—on being thus told by the lord, king Bali attained great peace (of mind).
verses.hindi: मालिनी नामक नगरी थी। उसका दूसरा नाम चम्पावती भी था, उस मनोहर चम्पावती नगरी में चारों वर्णों के लोग निवास करते थे । उस चम्पावती नगरी में राजा चम्प ने साठ सहस्न वर्षों तक निवास किया था। ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय वैद्य सभी जातियों के लोग अपने अपने धर्म पर रहते थे, सभी परम धामिक विचारोंवाले एवं भगवान् विष्णु के परम भक्त थे । पूर्णभद्व की अनुकम्पा से उस राजा चम्प का पुत्र हयंज्ध हुआ । १०४-१०७। उस राजा हय॑ड्भु के पास तणिक नामक एक महान् बलशाली हाथी था जो पूर्व जस्म में इन्द्र का ऐरवल था, राजा अपने मन्त्र बल से उस वाहन रत्न को पृथ्वी पर बुलाया था। राजा हयज्ू का उत्तरा- घिकारी राजा भद्व रथ हुआ, ऐसी प्रसिद्धि है कि राजा भद्गरथ का पुत्र राजा बृह॒त्कर्मा हुआ ।श०८-१०६।
verses.wordMeaning: Sutapa was born to Hema and Bali was the son of Sutapas* (Bd. P.). The noble-minded Bali who was a great Yogin was bound (by Vamana). He took birth in the human womb, being desirous of children, as the family was ncarin extinction due to absence of issues.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sutapa was born to Hema and Bali was the son of Sutapas* (Bd. P.). The noble-minded Bali who was a great Yogin was bound (by Vamana). He took birth in the human womb, being desirous of children, as the family was ncarin extinction due to absence of issues.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रुवन्ति स्वर्गगमनम् अपि पापान्वितस्य च । यत्र तत्र गतस्यैव भवेत् पञ्चवराहकी
verses.transliteration: bruvanti svargagamanam api pāpānvitasya ca / yatra tatra gatasyaiva bhavet pañcavarāhakī
verses.translation: After a long period the scholarly Bali went back to his own abode. The territories of the sons were Angas, Vangas, Sulhakas (Suhma), Pundras and Kalirigas. They were very flourishing territories.
verses.hindi: घनुदिचिह्लान्तर्गतग्रन्थः ख. घ. डः. पुस्तकेष्वेव । +- एतच्छुलोकद््यं घ. ड़. पुस्तकर्योने ...
verses.wordMeaning: After a long period the scholarly Bali went back to his own abode. The territories of the sons were Angas, Vangas, Sulhakas (Suhma), Pundras and Kalirigas. They were very flourishing territories.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a long period the scholarly Bali went back to his own abode. The territories of the sons were Angas, Vangas, Sulhakas (Suhma), Pundras and Kalirigas. They were very flourishing territories.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठस्यैकादशीतिथौ ध्रुवं तत्र वसेन्नरः । आदिं जयं तथा श्वेतं लिङ्गमुदीर्णमेव च
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhasyaikādaśītithau dhruvaṃ tatra vasennaraḥ / ādiṃ jayaṃ tathā śvetaṃ liṅgamudīrṇameva ca
verses.translation: O holy lord, how were these five Ksetraja sons of
verses.hindi: १. भवभुति ने उत्तररामचरित्र में रामचन्द्र के पिता महाराज दशरथ की पुत्री को शान्ता माना है, और ऋष्यश्व॒ ज्र को देने की बात भी लिखी है, अन्य स्थानों पर उक्त महाराज दशरथ के रामचद्धादि चार पुत्रों हो के होने की कथा आती है, शान्ता कौ नहीं । इससे मालूम होता हैं कि शान्‍्ता को उक्त महाराज दशरथ कौ पुत्रों भवभूवि ने भ्रास्तिवश माना है ? वह इसी दह्व रथ की पुत्री थी। दायादस्तस्य चाड्रेम्यो यस्मात्कर्णोइभवन्नृप: । कर्णस्य सुरसेनस्तु द्विजस्तस्था5त्मजः स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, how were these five Ksetraja sons of
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, how were these five Ksetraja sons of

verses.sanskrit: आश्रित्य तस्या द्रष्टव्या वराहास्तु यतस्ततः । ज्येष्ठस्यैकादशीतिथौ विष्णुना प्रभुविष्णुना
verses.transliteration: āśritya tasyā draṣṭavyā varāhāstu yatastataḥ / jyeṣṭhasyaikādaśītithau viṣṇunā prabhuviṣṇunā
verses.translation: Formerly there was an intelligent and renowned sage named Asija. The wife of this noble-souled sa-e was named Mamata.
verses.hindi: सुतात्मजः कर्थ कर्ण: कर्थ चाज़्स्य बंशजः । एतविच्छाम वे श्रोतुमत्यर्थ कुशलो ह्यसि ३११३
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly there was an intelligent and renowned sage named Asija. The wife of this noble-souled sa-e was named Mamata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly there was an intelligent and renowned sage named Asija. The wife of this noble-souled sa-e was named Mamata.

verses.sanskrit: वाराहं रूपमास्थाय उद्धृता धरणी विभो । पुण्यात्पुण्यतमा तेन ह्यशेषाघौघनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya uddhṛtā dharaṇī vibho / puṇyātpuṇyatamā tena hyaśeṣāghaughanāśinī
verses.translation: Not desirous of having sexual intercourse with him, Mamata spoke thus to Brhaspati: "I am pregnant due to my contact with your elder brother. This is the eighth (month). O Brhaspati, this great child in the womb cries much. The son of Asija that he is, he has learned the Vedas with their six ancillaries and he repeats the Vedic Mantras.
verses.hindi: बृह:द्भानो: सुतो जज्ने नाम्ना राजा बृहन्मनाः । तस्य पत्नीह॒यं चाउपसीच्चेद्वस्योभे च ते सुते यशोदेवी च सत्या च ताम्यां वंशस्तु भिद्यते । जयब्रथस्तु राजेस्रों यशोदेव्यां व्यजायत.
verses.wordMeaning: Not desirous of having sexual intercourse with him, Mamata spoke thus to Brhaspati: "I am pregnant due to my contact with your elder brother. This is the eighth (month). O Brhaspati, this great child in the womb cries much. The son of Asija that he is,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Not desirous of having sexual intercourse with him, Mamata spoke thus to Brhaspati: "I am pregnant due to my contact with your elder brother. This is the eighth (month). O Brhaspati, this great child in the womb cries much. The son of Asija that he is,…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा पञ्चवराहान्वै क्रोडमुदीर्णरूपिणम् । पूजयित्वा विधानेन पश्चाज्जागरणं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā pañcavarāhānvai kroḍamudīrṇarūpiṇam / pūjayitvā vidhānena paścājjāgaraṇaṃ caret
verses.translation: Though emphatically told thus by her, the noble- soulcd Brhaspati of excessive refulgence did not restrain him- self, as he was overwhelmed by passion. The virtuous-souled Brhaspati did have his sexual intercourse with her. Even as he was discharging the semen virile; the child in the womb spoke thus:
verses.hindi: धतत्रतस्य पुत्रस्तु सत्यकर्मा महायशाः । सत्यकर्म॑सुतश्रापि सुतस्त्वधिरथस्तु वे
verses.wordMeaning: Though emphatically told thus by her, the noble- soulcd Brhaspati of excessive refulgence did not restrain him- self, as he was overwhelmed by passion. The virtuous-souled Brhaspati did have his sexual intercourse with her. Even as he was discharging the semen virile;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Though emphatically told thus by her, the noble- soulcd Brhaspati of excessive refulgence did not restrain him- self, as he was overwhelmed by passion. The virtuous-souled Brhaspati did have his sexual intercourse with her. Even as he was discharging the semen virile;…

verses.sanskrit: सपञ्चवर्तिकान् दीपान् घृतेनोज्ज्वाल्य भक्तितः । पुराणश्रवणैर् नृत्यैर् गीतवाद्यैः सुमङ्गलैः
verses.transliteration: sapañcavartikān dīpān ghṛtenojjvālya bhaktitaḥ / purāṇaśravaṇair nṛtyair gītavādyaiḥ sumaṅgalaiḥ
verses.translation: "No Snatakn (a Brahmana who just had his sacred ablution after completing his Vedic study) shall deposit his (semen virile) here. There is no space here for two. You too are one with never-failing semen virile. I have come here first."
verses.hindi: स कर्ण परिजाग्राह तेन कर्णस्तु सुतजः । एतद्ः कथितं सर्व कर्णे यद्दे प्रचोदितम् ११८ बृहत्कर्मा का पुत्र राजा बृहद्रथ हुआ, उससे बृहन्मना नामक पुत्र की उत्पत्ति हुई । राजेन्द्र बृहन्मना ने जयद्रथ नामक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया, जिससे राजा दृढ़रथ को उत्पत्ति हुई। उस राजा वृढ़रथ का पुत्र विद्वविजयी राजा जनमेजय हुआ। उसके बज्ञों से राजा कर्ण हुआ है। जो उसका उत्तराधिकारी था । कर्ण का पुत्र सुरसेन हुआ, और उसका द्विज (घ्वज) नाम से कहा जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: "No Snatakn (a Brahmana who just had his sacred ablution after completing his Vedic study) shall deposit his (semen virile) here. There is no space here for two. You too are one with never-failing semen virile. I have come here first."
verses.commentary: Sense: "No Snatakn (a Brahmana who just had his sacred ablution after completing his Vedic study) shall deposit his (semen virile) here. There is no space here for two. You too are one with never-failing semen virile. I have come here first."

verses.sanskrit: वेदजाप्यैः पवित्रैश्च क्षपयित्वा च शर्वरीम् । यत्पुण्यं लभते मर्त्यो ह्याजमीढ शृणुष्व तत्
verses.transliteration: vedajāpyaiḥ pavitraiśca kṣapayitvā ca śarvarīm / yatpuṇyaṃ labhate martyo hyājamīḍha śṛṇuṣva tat
verses.translation: Brhaspati, the sage of divine attributes, became in¬ furiated on being told thus. He cursed the son of Asija, his brother, who was yet in the womb: "You have spoken thus to me on an occasion coveted by all living beings. Since you have spoken thus out of delusion, you will enter a long period of darkness".
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने कहा-सूत जी ! वे राजा कर्ण किस प्रकार सूत के पुत्र हुए ? और किस प्रकार वे ही राजा अंग के वंद्ज हुए ? आप इन प्राचीन कथाओं के परम कुशल ज्ञाता हैं : अतः इसे हम लोग सुनना चाहते हैं ।११२
verses.wordMeaning: Brhaspati, the sage of divine attributes, became in¬ furiated on being told thus. He cursed the son of Asija, his brother, who was yet in the womb: "You have spoken thus to me on an occasion coveted by all living beings. Since you have spoken thus out of delusion,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhaspati, the sage of divine attributes, became in¬ furiated on being told thus. He cursed the son of Asija, his brother, who was yet in the womb: "You have spoken thus to me on an occasion coveted by all living beings. Since you have spoken thus out of delusion,…

verses.sanskrit: रेवाजलं पुण्यतमं पृथिव्यां तथा च देवो जगतां पतिर्हरिः । एकादशी पापहरा नरेन्द्र बह्वायासैर् लभ्यते मानवानाम्
verses.transliteration: revājalaṃ puṇyatamaṃ pṛthivyāṃ tathā ca devo jagatāṃ patirhariḥ / ekādaśī pāpaharā narendra bahvāyāsair labhyate mānavānām
verses.translation: Due to that curse, the sage thereafter came to be called Dlrghatamas.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले--बृहद्भानु का पुत्र राजा बृहन्मना था। उस राजा वबृहन्मना की दो पत्नियाँ थों, जो दोनों चेदिनरेश की पुत्रियाँ थीं। उनके नाम थे, यशोदेवी और सत्या। इन्हीं दोनों पत्नियों से राजा का वंश अलग अलग हो गया, राजाधिराज जयद्रथ यशोदेवी में उत्पन्न हुआ । दूसरी देवी सत्या से ब्राह्मणों एवं क्षत्रियों का उद्धारक परम प्रख्यात राजा विजय हुआ । उस विजय का पुत्र धृति हुआ, जिसका पुत्र श्रतवृत नाम से प्रसिद्धि हुआ। घृततब्रत का पुत्र महान् यशस्वी राजा सत्यकर्मा हुआ, उसी सत्यकर्मा का पुत्र सृत अधिरथ हुआ, उसी ने कर्ण का पालन पोषण किया था, इसी से कर्ण को सूत-पुत्र मानते हैं, कर्ण के विषय में जो कुछ कहा जाता है वह सब मैं आप को बतला चुका। इस प्रकार अज्भ के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले राजाओं का वर्णन मैंने विस्तार पूर्वक क्रमश: कर दिया, अब इसके उपरान्त पुरु को
verses.wordMeaning: Due to that curse, the sage thereafter came to be called Dlrghatamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to that curse, the sage thereafter came to be called Dlrghatamas.

verses.sanskrit: एकैकशो ब्रह्महत्यादिकानि शक्तानि हन्तुं पापसङ्घानि राजन् । नैते सर्वे युगपद्वै समेता हन्तुं शक्ताः किं न तद्ब्रूहि राजन्
verses.transliteration: ekaikaśo brahmahatyādikāni śaktāni hantuṃ pāpasaṅghāni rājan / naite sarve yugapadvai sametā hantuṃ śaktāḥ kiṃ na tadbrūhi rājan
verses.translation: Asija's brother, his uncle, had built a house for him. While he was staying there, a bull came there casually. Surrounded by cows he grazed the Darbha grass that had been brought for the DarSa 1 rituals. DIrghatamas caught hold of the quivering bull by its horns.
verses.hindi: प्रजाओं का वर्णन सुनिये
verses.wordMeaning: Asija's brother, his uncle, had built a house for him. While he was staying there, a bull came there casually. Surrounded by cows he grazed the Darbha grass that had been brought for the DarSa 1 rituals. DIrghatamas caught hold of the quivering bull by its horns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Asija's brother, his uncle, had built a house for him. While he was staying there, a bull came there casually. Surrounded by cows he grazed the Darbha grass that had been brought for the DarSa 1 rituals. DIrghatamas caught hold of the quivering bull by its horns.

verses.sanskrit: यथेदमुक्तं तव धर्मसूनो श्रुतं च यच्छङ्कराच्चन्द्रमौलेः । श्रुत्वेदम् इच्छन्मुच्यते सर्वपापैः पठन्पदं याति हि वृत्रशत्रोः
verses.transliteration: yathedamuktaṃ tava dharmasūno śrutaṃ ca yacchaṅkarāccandramauleḥ / śrutvedam icchanmucyate sarvapāpaiḥ paṭhanpadaṃ yāti hi vṛtraśatroḥ
verses.translation: Caught by him, the bull could not move even a step. Then the bull spoke to him: "O foremost one among the strong persons, leave me off.
verses.hindi: है३२ वायुपुराणम् एते5ड्भवंशजाः सर्वे राजानः कीतिता मया। बिस्तरेणाइश्नृपुर्ब्या च पुरोस्तु शुणुत प्रजा:
verses.wordMeaning: Caught by him, the bull could not move even a step. Then the bull spoke to him: "O foremost one among the strong persons, leave me off.
verses.commentary: Sense: Caught by him, the bull could not move even a step. Then the bull spoke to him: "O foremost one among the strong persons, leave me off.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये उदीर्णवराहतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोननवत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १९० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल सोमतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । चन्द्रहासेति विख्यातं सर्वदैवतपूजितम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye udīrṇavarāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonanavatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 190 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla somatīrthamanuttamam / candrahāseti vikhyātaṃ sarvadaivatapūjitam
verses.translation: o dear one, a strong one like you has not been met with by me anywhere, even though I had been bearing the three-eyed lord (everywhere), as a result of which I have come down to the earth.
verses.hindi: पुरो: पुत्रो महाबाहुराजा5इसोज्जनमिेजयः । अविद्धस्तु सुतस्तस्य यः प्राचीसमजयदिशम् !!१२० अविद्धतः प्रवीरस्तु मनस्युरभवत्सुतः। राजाइथो जयदों नाम मनस्योरभवत्सुत:
verses.wordMeaning: o dear one, a strong one like you has not been met with by me anywhere, even though I had been bearing the three-eyed lord (everywhere), as a result of which I have come down to the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: o dear one, a strong one like you has not been met with by me anywhere, even though I had been bearing the three-eyed lord (everywhere), as a result of which I have come down to the earth.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सिद्धिं परां प्राप्तः सोमो राजा सुरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: yatra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somo rājā surottamaḥ
verses.translation: O most excellent one among strong persons, leave me off. I am pleased with you. Choose a boon". On being told thus, the sage told the bull: "Where will you go alive, away from me?
verses.hindi: आत्रेयों वंशतस्तासां भर्ता नाम्ना प्रभाकर: । अनादुृष्टस्तु राजवों रिवेयुस्तस्थ चापत्मजः रिवेयोज्वलना नाम भार्या ये तक्षफात्मजा  यसयां देव्यां स राजर्थी रस्ति नाम ह्ाजीजनत्
verses.wordMeaning: O most excellent one among strong persons, leave me off. I am pleased with you. Choose a boon". On being told thus, the sage told the bull: "Where will you go alive, away from me?
verses.commentary: Sense: O most excellent one among strong persons, leave me off. I am pleased with you. Choose a boon". On being told thus, the sage told the bull: "Where will you go alive, away from me?

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं सिद्धिमनुप्राप्तः सोमो राजा जगत्पतिः । तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि कथयस्व ममानघ
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ siddhimanuprāptaḥ somo rājā jagatpatiḥ / tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mamānagha
verses.translation: Hence I will not release you, the quadruped that eats others' wealth". Then that bull replied to DIrghatamas:
verses.hindi: सूत बोले--ऋषिवन्द ! राजा पुरु का पुत्र महाबाहु जममेजय हुआ, उसका पुत्र अविद्ध था, जिसने पूर्व दिशा को जीता था । अविद्ध से प्रवीर नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ, जिसका पुत्र मनस्थु थां। उस मनस्थु का पुत्र राजा जयद हुआ । जयद का उत्तराधिकारी राजा धुन्धु था, धुन्धु का पुत्र वहुगवी था, जिसका पुत्र संजाति था  सजाति का पुन्र॒रौद्राइव था, उसके पुत्रों का वणन सुनिये। उस रोद्राइव के घताची
verses.wordMeaning: Hence I will not release you, the quadruped that eats others' wealth". Then that bull replied to DIrghatamas:
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence I will not release you, the quadruped that eats others' wealth". Then that bull replied to DIrghatamas:

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुरा शप्तो मुनीन्द्रेण दक्षेण किल भारत । असेवनाद्धि दाराणां क्षयरोगी भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā śapto munīndreṇa dakṣeṇa kila bhārata / asevanāddhi dārāṇāṃ kṣayarogī bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: "O dear one, to us nothing is sinful. There is no theft. We do not distinguish between what should be eaten or what should not be eaten or what should be drunk or should not be drunk.
verses.hindi: नामक अप्सरा में दस पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए, जिनके नाम रजेयु, इतेयु, कक्षेयु, स्थण्डिलेयु, घृतेयु, जलेयु, स्थले यू धर्मेयु, संनतेयु और वनेयु थे । इन पुत्रों के अतिरिक्त रौद्राब्व की दश पुन्रियाँ भी थीं, जिनके नाम थे, दुद्रा, कत्याओं का एक मात्र स्वामी अन्िवंश्ोत्पन्न प्रभाकर था  राजषि अवादृष्ठ का पुत्र रिवेयु था । उस राजा रिवेयु कौ पत्नी ज्वलना तक्षक की पुत्री थी। राजधषि रिवेयु ने ज्वलना में रत्मि नामक पुत्र कों उत्पन्न किया । नरवति रन्ति ने सरस्वती नामक अपनी पत्नी में त्रसु, अप्रतिरथ, और क्रूव नामक परम धामिक कल्याण कामनावाले पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया । उसकी एक मद्भुलदायिनी कन्या गौरी थीं, जो राजा मास्धाता की माता हुईं। राजा
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear one, to us nothing is sinful. There is no theft. We do not distinguish between what should be eaten or what should not be eaten or what should be drunk or should not be drunk.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear one, to us nothing is sinful. There is no theft. We do not distinguish between what should be eaten or what should not be eaten or what should be drunk or should not be drunk.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वाहितानां पत्नीनां ये न कुर्वन्ति सेवनम् । या निष्ठा जायते तेषां तां शृणुष्व नरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: udvāhitānāṃ patnīnāṃ ye na kurvanti sevanam / yā niṣṭhā jāyate teṣāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva narottama
verses.translation: We do not know what should be done or what should not be done, what should be approached or what should not be approached. O Brahmana, we are not sinners. This is remembered as the Dharmaofcows and bulls". 1 2
verses.hindi: अप्रतिरथ का पुत्र धुये हुआ, जिसका पुत्र कण्ठ हुआ ।१२७-१३०। उस कण्ठ का पुत्र मेधातिथि था, जिससे
verses.wordMeaning: We do not know what should be done or what should not be done, what should be approached or what should not be approached. O Brahmana, we are not sinners. This is remembered as the Dharmaofcows and bulls". 1 2
verses.commentary: Sense: We do not know what should be done or what should not be done, what should be approached or what should not be approached. O Brahmana, we are not sinners. This is remembered as the Dharmaofcows and bulls". 1 2

verses.sanskrit: ऋतुकाले तु नारीणां सेवनाज्जायते सुतः । सुतात्स्वर्गश्च मोक्षश्च हीत्येवं श्रुतिनोदना
verses.transliteration: ṛtukāle tu nārīṇāṃ sevanājjāyate sutaḥ / sutātsvargaśca mokṣaśca hītyevaṃ śrutinodanā
verses.translation: On hearing the name of cows mentioned, he became confused and released him. Thanks to his devotion to the cows as ordained by the Vedas, he propitiated the bull.
verses.hindi: + एतर्श्चह्वान्तगंतग्रग्थः ख. पुस्तके नास्ति । भेधातिथि:ः सुतस्तस्प यस्मात्काण्ठायना द्विजा:। इतिनानुयम(? )स्था55सीत्कन्या साइजनयत्सुतान् ॥ त्रसो: सुदयित॑ पुत्र॑ मलिनं ब्रह्मवादिनम् । उपदातं ततो लेने चतुरस्त्विति सा3त्मजानु
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the name of cows mentioned, he became confused and released him. Thanks to his devotion to the cows as ordained by the Vedas, he propitiated the bull.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the name of cows mentioned, he became confused and released him. Thanks to his devotion to the cows as ordained by the Vedas, he propitiated the bull.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कालोचितधर्मेण ये न सेवन्ति तां नराः । तेषां ब्रह्मघ्नजं पापं जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: tatkālocitadharmeṇa ye na sevanti tāṃ narāḥ / teṣāṃ brahmaghnajaṃ pāpaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The sacrificial rite to be performed on the New Moon Day..
verses.hindi: शकुन्तलायां भरतो यस्य नाम्ना तु भारतम् । दुष्स (ष्य)न्तं राजाने प्रति वागुवाचाशरीरिणों
verses.wordMeaning: The sacrificial rite to be performed on the New Moon Day..
verses.commentary: Sense: The sacrificial rite to be performed on the New Moon Day..

verses.sanskrit: तेन पापेन घोरेण वेष्टतो रौरवे पतेत् । तस्य तद्रुधिरं पापाः पिबन्ते कालमीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: tena pāpena ghoreṇa veṣṭato raurave patet / tasya tadrudhiraṃ pāpāḥ pibante kālamīpsitam
verses.translation: This practice of open and unconcealed sexual intercourse is men¬ tioned in the M.Bh. (MW 365A) and seems to have been followed by Dirghatamas. The Buddha mentions this Dharma in derision.
verses.hindi: रेतोधा: पुत्र नयति नरदेव यमक्षयात् । त्वं चास्य धाता गर्भेस्य माउवमंस्थाः शकुन्तलामू भरतस्तिसषु स्त्रीषु नव पुश्रानजीजनत् । नाम्यनन्दच्च तानराजा नानुरूपान्मसेत्युत..
verses.wordMeaning: This practice of open and unconcealed sexual intercourse is men¬ tioned in the M.Bh. (MW 365A) and seems to have been followed by Dirghatamas. The Buddha mentions this Dharma in derision.
verses.commentary: Sense: This practice of open and unconcealed sexual intercourse is men¬ tioned in the M.Bh. (MW 365A) and seems to have been followed by Dirghatamas. The Buddha mentions this Dharma in derision.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽवतीर्णकालेन यां यां योनिं प्रयास्यति । तस्यां तस्यां स दुष्टात्मा दुर्भगो जायते सदा
verses.transliteration: tato 'vatīrṇakālena yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ prayāsyati / tasyāṃ tasyāṃ sa duṣṭātmā durbhago jāyate sadā
verses.translation: Considering it to be his arrogance, Saradvan did not brook it Using force and following Godharma (the practice of cattle), he had approached his daughter-in-law (the wife of younger brother).
verses.hindi: काण्ठायन त!मक द्विजाति वर्ग की उत्पत्ति हुई। इस''(?)की एक कत्या थी, जिसने अनेक पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया था। राजा रब्ति के प्रथम पुत्र त्रसु का परमत्रिय पुनत्रमलिन था, जो शच्छा ब्रह्मवेत्ता था। उससे उपदानबी ने चारपुत्रों की प्राप्ति की, जिनके नाम थे, सुष्मश्त, दृष्यन्त, प्रवीर और अमष  इनमें दुष्यन्त का पूत्र नूपतियर्य भरत चक्रवर्ती सस्नाद हुआ, वहू राजा भरत शकुस्तला नामक पत्नी में उत्पन्न हुआ था, उसी
verses.wordMeaning: Considering it to be his arrogance, Saradvan did not brook it Using force and following Godharma (the practice of cattle), he had approached his daughter-in-law (the wife of younger brother).
verses.commentary: Sense: Considering it to be his arrogance, Saradvan did not brook it Using force and following Godharma (the practice of cattle), he had approached his daughter-in-law (the wife of younger brother).

verses.sanskrit: नारीणां तु सदा कामो ह्यधिकः परिवर्तते । विशेषेण ऋतोः काले भिद्यते कामसायकैः
verses.transliteration: nārīṇāṃ tu sadā kāmo hyadhikaḥ parivartate / viśeṣeṇa ṛtoḥ kāle bhidyate kāmasāyakaiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing this trespass, Saradvan reflected. The noble- souled (Saradvan) knew what was destined to happen. So he did not confer death on him (Dlrghatamas).
verses.hindi: के नाम से भारतवर्ष की प्रसिद्धि है ।१३१-१३३१। ऐसी प्रसिद्धि है कि राजा दुष्यल्त को अशरोरिणी वाणी (आकाछझ् वाणी) हुई थी --दुष्यस्त ! पुत्र की माता उसकी केवल रक्षा करनेवाली है, पुत्र पिता का प्रतिनिधि है, पिता ही उसका सब कुछ है, जिससे उसकी उत्पत्ति होती है, बही सब कुछ है, तुम इस बालक के वही पिता द्वो । यह तुम्हारा ही पुत्र है, इसका पालन पोषण करो, शकुन्तला ने तुमसे सत्य बात कही है। नरदेव ! पिता अपने पुत्र की मृत्यु भय आदि आपत्तियों से रक्षा करता है, तुम्ही इस गर्भ का आधान करनेवाले हो, शकुन्तला का अपमान मत करो ।१३४-१३६। सम्राट् भरत ने अपनी तीनों पत्नियों में नव पुत्रों को उश्पन्न किया था; किन्तु उसने अपने उन समस्त पुत्रों का यह कहकर के अभिननन्‍्दन नहीं किया कि ये सब हमारी प्रतिष्ठा के अनुकूल नहीं है ।१३७। भरत की ऐसी बातों से पुत्रों की माताओं को बड़ा क्रोध हुआ और आवेश
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing this trespass, Saradvan reflected. The noble- souled (Saradvan) knew what was destined to happen. So he did not confer death on him (Dlrghatamas).
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing this trespass, Saradvan reflected. The noble- souled (Saradvan) knew what was destined to happen. So he did not confer death on him (Dlrghatamas).

verses.sanskrit: परिभूता हि सा भर्त्रा ध्यायते ऽन्यं पतिं ततः । तस्याः पुत्रः समुत्पन्नो ह्यटते कुलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: paribhūtā hi sā bhartrā dhyāyate 'nyaṃ patiṃ tataḥ / tasyāḥ putraḥ samutpanno hyaṭate kulamuttamam
verses.translation: With eyes turned red due to anger, he shouted to Dlrghatamas: You do not distinguish between whom to approach and whom not to. Following Godharma you have solicited your daughter-in-law.
verses.hindi: में आकर उन सबों को उन्होंने मार डाला, इस प्रकार राजाधिराज भरत की पूत्रोत्पत्ति निष्फल हो मई । तदनन्तर मरुतों ने बृहस्पति के पुत्र भरद्वाज को लाकर राजा भरत को वे दिया। परम सामथ्यंशाली भरद्वाज इस प्रकार यज्ञाधिपति मरुतों द्वारा सम्राट् भरत के वंश में संक्रामित हुए ।8३८-३३१६। इसी वार्ता के प्रसजु में लोग परम बुद्धिशाली भरद्वाज के जस्म वृत्तास्त की चर्चा करते हैं कि इस प्रकार उनकी (उत्तत्ति में
verses.wordMeaning: With eyes turned red due to anger, he shouted to Dlrghatamas: You do not distinguish between whom to approach and whom not to. Following Godharma you have solicited your daughter-in-law.
verses.commentary: Sense: With eyes turned red due to anger, he shouted to Dlrghatamas: You do not distinguish between whom to approach and whom not to. Following Godharma you have solicited your daughter-in-law.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गस्थास्तेन पितरः पूर्वं जाता महीपते । पतन्ति जातमात्रेण कुलटस् तेन चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: svargasthāstena pitaraḥ pūrvaṃ jātā mahīpate / patanti jātamātreṇa kulaṭas tena cocyate
verses.translation: You are a man of despicable conduct. I am casting you o(T. Go away along with your evil action. In spite of being blind, old and dependent on others for maintenance you have committed a deplorable, sinful action. Therefore, you are for¬ saken. I am convinced that you are a person of evil conduct".
verses.hindi: दरे० वायुपुराणम् एवमुक्ताश्रवादे  नमन्तवंत्नी ह्यहं विभो। गर्भ: परिणतश्ाय ब्रह्म व्याहरते गिरा
verses.wordMeaning: You are a man of despicable conduct. I am casting you o(T. Go away along with your evil action. In spite of being blind, old and dependent on others for maintenance you have committed a deplorable, sinful action. Therefore, you are for¬ saken.…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are a man of despicable conduct. I am casting you o(T. Go away along with your evil action. In spite of being blind, old and dependent on others for maintenance you have committed a deplorable, sinful action. Therefore, you are for¬ saken.…

verses.sanskrit: तेन कर्मविपाकेन क्षयरोगी शशी ह्यभूत् । त्यक्त्वा लोकं सुरेन्द्राणां मर्त्यलोकम् उपागतः
verses.transliteration: tena karmavipākena kṣayarogī śaśī hyabhūt / tyaktvā lokaṃ surendrāṇāṃ martyalokam upāgataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter he thought of a ruthless action. After rebuking Dlrghatamas many times, he caught hold of him by his arms, put him in a sealed casket and hurled it into the waters of Gariga.
verses.hindi: अमोधरेतास्त्वं चापि धर्मश्नेव विगहितः । एवसुक्तो5ब्रवीदेनां  स्मयसानों बृहस्पतिः ॥१४रे बिनयो नोपदेष्टव्यस्त्या मम कर्थ चन । हषसाण: प्रसहोनां मैथुनायोपच क़मे १४४
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter he thought of a ruthless action. After rebuking Dlrghatamas many times, he caught hold of him by his arms, put him in a sealed casket and hurled it into the waters of Gariga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he thought of a ruthless action. After rebuking Dlrghatamas many times, he caught hold of him by his arms, put him in a sealed casket and hurled it into the waters of Gariga.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थान्यनेकानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च । भ्रमित्वा नर्मदां प्राप्तः सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca / bhramitvā narmadāṃ prāptaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm
verses.translation: For seven days the sealed casket was wafted by the current. King Bali, the knower of the principles of Dharma, who was in the company of his wife, saw the sinking casket borne towards him by the current.
verses.hindi: अमोधरेताह्न भवान्नावकाशो5स्ति च हयो: । एबमुक्तः स गर्भेण कुपितः प्रत्युवाच ह १४६ यस्मान्मामीदशे काले सर्वभूतेप्सिते सति । प्रतिषेधसि तत्तस्मात्तमो दीर्घ प्रवेक्ष्सि.. पादाभ्यां तेन तच्छन्न॑ मातुर्हारं ब्रहस्पतेः । तद्रेतस्तुमध्येषनिवार्य: शिशुकोभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: For seven days the sealed casket was wafted by the current. King Bali, the knower of the principles of Dharma, who was in the company of his wife, saw the sinking casket borne towards him by the current.
verses.commentary: Sense: For seven days the sealed casket was wafted by the current. King Bali, the knower of the principles of Dharma, who was in the company of his wife, saw the sinking casket borne towards him by the current.

verses.sanskrit: उपवासस्तु दानानि व्रतानि नियमाश्च ये । चचार द्वादशाब्दानि ततो मुक्तः स किल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: upavāsastu dānāni vratāni niyamāśca ye / cacāra dvādaśābdāni tato muktaḥ sa kilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Bali, the righteous-souled son of Virocana, saved him and took him to his harem where he propitiated him with different kinds of food and drinks, and looked after him.
verses.hindi: संधि हुई) और इस प्रकार वे मरुतों द्वारा लाकर भरत को समपित किये गये  यह प्रसिद्ध बात है कि प्राचीन
verses.wordMeaning: Bali, the righteous-souled son of Virocana, saved him and took him to his harem where he propitiated him with different kinds of food and drinks, and looked after him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bali, the righteous-souled son of Virocana, saved him and took him to his harem where he propitiated him with different kinds of food and drinks, and looked after him.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयित्वा महादेवं सर्वपातकनाशनम् । जगाम प्रभया पूर्णः सोमलोकमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam / jagāma prabhayā pūrṇaḥ somalokamanuttamam
verses.translation: The delighted sage asked Bali to choose a boon accord¬ ing to his desire. The leading Danava chose the boon for (blessing him with) a son.
verses.hindi: काल में ऋषिवर अशिज की पत्नी ममता जब आसस्नगर्भा हुई तब वे तपस्या में मिरत हो गये। एकास्त में अपने भाई की भार्या को देखकर ब्रहस्पति ने कहा--'मंगले ! अपने शरीर कौ विधिवत अलंकॉरादि से अलंकृत करके मुझे मैथुन का दान कंरो १४०-१४१। बृहस्पति के इस प्रकार कहने पर देवी ममता ने कहा, समर्थ ! मैं सम्प्रति गर्भवती हूं, यह गर्भ भी अब पूर्ण हो चुका है, ब्रह्म (वेद) का उच्चारण करता है, तुम्हारा वीर्य भी निष्फल हो जाने वाला नहीं है, और प्रकार व्यभिचार करने पर धर्म की विगहंणा होगी। ममता के ऐसे कहने पर बृहस्पति हंसते हुए बोले, सुन्दरि ! मुझे तुम किसी प्रकार भी आचार की शिक्षा नही दे सकतीं, मैं सब कुछ जानता हैँ । ऐसा कहकर बड़े आनन्द के साथ बृहस्पति ने साहस पूर्वक ममता के साथ मैथन करने का उपक्रम किया ।१४२-१४४। रति कर्म में
verses.wordMeaning: The delighted sage asked Bali to choose a boon accord¬ ing to his desire. The leading Danava chose the boon for (blessing him with) a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted sage asked Bali to choose a boon accord¬ ing to his desire. The leading Danava chose the boon for (blessing him with) a son.

verses.sanskrit: येनैव स्थापितो देवः पूज्यते वर्षसंख्यया । तावद् युगसहस्राणि तस्य लोकं समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: yenaiva sthāpito devaḥ pūjyate varṣasaṃkhyayā / tāvad yugasahasrāṇi tasya lokaṃ samaśnute
verses.translation: The righteous-souled sage ot good sell-control begot of that Sudra woman two sons of great prowess, Kakslva and Caksus. They studied the Vedas duly and be¬ came masters and expounders of Vedas, great enlightened Siddhasand excellent ones with direct vision of Dharma. On seeing them, Kakslva and Cak§us, the king, Bali, the son of Virocana, asked the sage, "Are these my sons?" The sage said, "O excellent Asura, no, that is not the case. They ai e mine. Due to your deception, these god-like children are born of Sudra womb.
verses.hindi: आनन्दविभोर बृहस्पति से गरभस्थ शिशु ने कहा, तात ! बृहस्पते ! मैं यहाँ पहिले ही से सन्निविष्ट हूं, आपका बीय॑ कदापि निष्फल होने वाला नहीं है, इस संकीर्ण स्थली में दो व्यक्तियों के निवास की सम्भावना नहीं है। गर्भस्थ शिशु के ऐसा कहने पर बृहस्पति को बड़ा क्रोध हो गया। वे बोले, सभी प्राणियों के अभीष्टतम इस सुन्दर अवसर पर तुम मुझे निषेध कर रहे हो, इस कारण तुम महान् घोर
verses.wordMeaning: The righteous-souled sage ot good sell-control begot of that Sudra woman two sons of great prowess, Kakslva and Caksus. They studied the Vedas duly and be¬ came masters and expounders of Vedas, great enlightened Siddhasand excellent ones with direct vision of Dharma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The righteous-souled sage ot good sell-control begot of that Sudra woman two sons of great prowess, Kakslva and Caksus. They studied the Vedas duly and be¬ came masters and expounders of Vedas, great enlightened Siddhasand excellent ones with direct vision of Dharma.…

verses.sanskrit: तेन देवान् विधानोक्तान् स्थापयन्ति नरा भुवि । अक्षयं चाव्ययं यस्मात्फलं भवति नान्यथा
