verses.transliteration: tena devān vidhānoktān sthāpayanti narā bhuvi / akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ yasmātphalaṃ bhavati nānyathā
verses.translation: Considering me blind and old, Sudesna, your queen, sent the Sudra servant-maid unto me and disrespected me.
verses.hindi: अन्धकार में प्रवेश करोगे ।१४५-१४७। बृहस्पति के इस कथन के उपरान्त गर्भस्थ शिशु ने अपने दोंनों पैरों से माता के योनिद्वार को आबृत कर दिया, किन्तु तिस पर भी बृहस्पति का बीरय॑ उपके दोतों पैरों के मध्यभाग से अनिवाय होकर उदर के भीतर चला गया, और एक छोटे शिक्षु के रूप में उत्पन्न होकर बाहरं॑ निकल घनुचिह्नान्तगंतप्रन्थः ख. पुस्तके न ।
verses.wordMeaning: Considering me blind and old, Sudesna, your queen, sent the Sudra servant-maid unto me and disrespected me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Considering me blind and old, Sudesna, your queen, sent the Sudra servant-maid unto me and disrespected me.

verses.sanskrit: सोमतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेद् देवमीश्वरम् । जायते स नरो भूत्वा सोमवित्प्रियदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: somatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayed devamīśvaram / jāyate sa naro bhūtvā somavitpriyadarśanaḥ
verses.translation: Bali, thereupon propitiated the excellent sage again. The lord rebuked his wife Sudesna.
verses.hindi: तस्मिन॒काले तु भरतो मदद्धि: क्रतुभिः क्रमात् )) कास्पनेमित्तिकयेज्षेयंजते पुत्नलिप्तया
verses.wordMeaning: Bali, thereupon propitiated the excellent sage again. The lord rebuked his wife Sudesna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bali, thereupon propitiated the excellent sage again. The lord rebuked his wife Sudesna.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रप्रभासे यो गत्वा स्नानं विधिवद् आचरेत् । व्याधिना नाभिभूतः स्यात् क्षयरोगेण वा युतः
verses.transliteration: candraprabhāse yo gatvā snānaṃ vidhivad ācaret / vyādhinā nābhibhūtaḥ syāt kṣayarogeṇa vā yutaḥ
verses.translation: He bedecked her in ornaments and gave her unto the sage. The sage DIrghatamas spoke thus to the queen: "O splendid lady, if, without showing aversion, you lick from head to foot my naked body smeared well with curds mixed with salt, you will obtain those sons mentally desired by you". The queen, thereupon, carried out all his instructions.
verses.hindi: यदा स यजमानो वै पुत्रान्ना5औसादयत्प्रभुः । यज्ञ ततो मरुत्सोम॑ पुत्रार्थ पुनराहरत् १४३ पड़ा । इस सद्योजात कुमार को देखकर देवी ममता ने कहा, बृहस्पते ! मैं तो अपने मिवास को जा रहो हूँ इस द्वाज (जारज) पुत्र की पालना तुम्हें करनी होगी । ऐसा कहकर ममता के चले जाने पर बृहस्पति ने भी उसी क्षण उस पुत्र को छोड़ दिया । भर द्वाजम्! (इस जारज शिशु की रक्षा करो) इस कथन के अनुसार वह झिशु भरद्वाज नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुआ । १४८-१४०। माता ओर पिता द्वारा छोड़े गये इस छोंठे शिक्षु भरदाज को
verses.wordMeaning: He bedecked her in ornaments and gave her unto the sage. The sage DIrghatamas spoke thus to the queen: "O splendid lady, if, without showing aversion, you lick from head to foot my naked body smeared well with curds mixed with salt,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He bedecked her in ornaments and gave her unto the sage. The sage DIrghatamas spoke thus to the queen: "O splendid lady, if, without showing aversion, you lick from head to foot my naked body smeared well with curds mixed with salt,…

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रहास्ये नरः स्नात्वा द्वादश्यां तु नरेश्वर । चतुर्दश्याम् उपोष्यैव क्षीरस्य जुहुयाच्चरुम्
verses.transliteration: candrahāsye naraḥ snātvā dvādaśyāṃ tu nareśvara / caturdaśyām upoṣyaiva kṣīrasya juhuyāccarum
verses.translation: When she reached the anus, her aversion was so great that she avoided it. Thereupon that sage said to her: <c O auspicous lady, since you avoided the anus, the eldest son you will give birth to will be without anus".
verses.hindi: जब मरुद्गणों ने देखा, तो उन्हें बड़ो दया आई, वे उसे अपने साथ उठा ले गये। ठीक उसी समय पुत्रप्राप्ति की अभिलाषा से सम्नाद् भरत नैभित्तिक एवं काम्य विविध यज्ञों का अनुष्ठान कर रहे थे, सर्वेबवर्यंशाली सम्राट् भरत को जब उन यज्ञों से भी पुत्र प्राप्ति नहीं हुई तो उन्होंने पुत्रप्राब्ति की कामना से पुनः मरुद् गणों का एवं सोम का यज्ञ प्रारम्भ किया १५१-१५३। उस मरुत्सोमात्मक यज्ञ से मरद॒गण परम प्रसन्न हुए, और
verses.wordMeaning: When she reached the anus, her aversion was so great that she avoided it. Thereupon that sage said to her: <c O auspicous lady, since you avoided the anus, the eldest son you will give birth to will be without anus".
verses.commentary: Sense: When she reached the anus, her aversion was so great that she avoided it. Thereupon that sage said to her: <c O auspicous lady, since you avoided the anus, the eldest son you will give birth to will be without anus".

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रैः पञ्चभिर् ईशानं पुरुषस्त्र्यम्बकं यजेत् । हविःशेषं स्वयं प्राश्य चन्द्रहास्येशमीक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: mantraiḥ pañcabhir īśānaṃ puruṣastryambakaṃ yajet / haviḥśeṣaṃ svayaṃ prāśya candrahāsyeśamīkṣayet
verses.translation: This Purana has mixed up two different Balis—Bali or Mahabali, the rival of Indra, who donated three feet of land to Vamana, was not childless. Bana, Usa*s father, was his son. This Bali is another East Indian King who being childless requested thus to Dirghatamas.
verses.hindi: बृहस्पति के वीय॑ से समुत्पन्न परम मनोषी उस भरद्वाज नामक पुत्र को उन्होंने भरत को दे दिया। भरद्वाज को पुत्र रूप में प्राप्त कर सम्राद् भरत विनतस्वर में बोले, 'विभो, इस अवसर पर जब कि मेरी सारी सश्ततियाँ मृत्यु को प्राप्त हो गयी थीं, आपने पुत्रदान कर मुझे कृतार्थ कर दिया १५४-१५५॥ सन्नाद् भरत की पहली सन्ततियों का जन्म वितथ (असफल) हो चुका था अतः भरद्ाज वितथ नाम से भी प्रसिद्धि हुए। सम्राद भरत के पालन पोषण के कारण दिव्य विभूति सम्पन्न भरद्वाज ब्राह्मणत्व से क्षत्रियत्व को प्राप्त हुए। वे द्विमुस्यायन एवं द्विपितर नाम से भी प्रसिद्ध हुए। इस प्रकार उत्तराधिकारी रूप में वितथ को प्राप्त कर सम्राद् भरत स्वगंगामी हुए। वितथ के उत्तराधिकारी राजा भुवमन्यु हुए, उन भुवमन्यु के महाभूतों के समान महान् पराक्रम-
verses.wordMeaning: This Purana has mixed up two different Balis—Bali or Mahabali, the rival of Indra, who donated three feet of land to Vamana, was not childless. Bana, Usa*s father, was his son. This Bali is another East Indian King who being childless requested thus to Dirghatamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Purana has mixed up two different Balis—Bali or Mahabali, the rival of Indra, who donated three feet of land to Vamana, was not childless. Bana, Usa*s father, was his son. This Bali is another East Indian King who being childless requested thus to Dirghatamas.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना राजंस्तुष्टो देवो महेश्वरः । विधिना तीर्थयोगेन क्षयरोगाद् विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinā rājaṃstuṣṭo devo maheśvaraḥ / vidhinā tīrthayogena kṣayarogād vimucyate
verses.translation: Then the queen replied to the sage Dirghatamas, "O blessed one, it does not behove you to give me a son like that".
verses.hindi: + घधनुश्चिह्नान्तबंतग्रन्थो न घ. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the queen replied to the sage Dirghatamas, "O blessed one, it does not behove you to give me a son like that".
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the queen replied to the sage Dirghatamas, "O blessed one, it does not behove you to give me a son like that".

verses.sanskrit: सप्तभिः सोमवारैर् यः स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । स वै कर्णकृताद्रोगान्मुच्यते पूजयञ्छिवम्
verses.transliteration: saptabhiḥ somavārair yaḥ snānaṃ tatra samācaret / sa vai karṇakṛtādrogānmucyate pūjayañchivam
verses.translation: The sage said: "O gentle lady, this is your own fault. It will not be otherwise. O queen of good rites, I shall bestow a son unto you. Even without anus, he will perform all bodily functions". Touching her belly, the sage Dirghatamas continued—
verses.hindi: नरस्य सांक्ृतिः पुत्रस्तस्य पुत्री महोजसो । ग्रुरुवीयंस्त्रिदेवश्व सांकृत्वाबबरो स्मृतौ ६१६० त्र्यारुणि पुष्करिणं तृतोय॑ सुषुबे कपिम्। कपेः क्षत्रवरा होते तयोः प्रोक्ता महर्षयः ११६३
verses.wordMeaning: The sage said: "O gentle lady, this is your own fault. It will not be otherwise. O queen of good rites, I shall bestow a son unto you. Even without anus, he will perform all bodily functions". Touching her belly, the sage Dirghatamas continued—
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage said: "O gentle lady, this is your own fault. It will not be otherwise. O queen of good rites, I shall bestow a son unto you. Even without anus, he will perform all bodily functions". Touching her belly, the sage Dirghatamas continued—

verses.sanskrit: अक्षिरोगस् तथा राजंश्चन्द्रहास्ये विनश्यति । चन्द्रहास्ये तु यो गत्वा ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः । स्नानं समाचरेद् भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: akṣirogas tathā rājaṃścandrahāsye vinaśyati / candrahāsye tu yo gatvā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / snānaṃ samācared bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: "O lady of sweet smiles, since' you have licked up the curds from my body, your womb is filled like the ocean on the Full Moon Day. Five splendid sons comparable to the sons of Devas will be born to you. They will be refulgent, valiant and righteous and performer of sacrifices."
verses.hindi: हस्तिनश्रापि दायादास्त्रयः परमधासिकाः । अजमीढो द्विजामौढ़ः पुरुमीढस्तथेव च १६६ अजमोढस्य पत्यस्तु शुभाः कुरुकुलोह्हाः । नीलिनी केशिनी चेव धूमिनी च बराइगना १६७ अजमीढस्य पुत्रास्तु तासु जाता कुलोहहाः । तपसो5न्ते सुमहतों राज्ञो बद्धस्थ धामिका: १६८ भरद्वाजप्रसादेन शणध्वं तस्य विस्तरम । अजमीढस्य केशिन्यां कषण्ठः समभवत्किल ३१६६९
verses.wordMeaning: "O lady of sweet smiles, since' you have licked up the curds from my body, your womb is filled like the ocean on the Full Moon Day. Five splendid sons comparable to the sons of Devas will be born to you. They will be refulgent, valiant and righteous and performer of sacrifices."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lady of sweet smiles, since' you have licked up the curds from my body, your womb is filled like the ocean on the Full Moon Day. Five splendid sons comparable to the sons of Devas will be born to you. They will be refulgent, valiant and righteous and performer of sacrifices."

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नानं च दानं च चन्द्रहास्ये शुभशुभम् । कृतं नृपवरश्रेष्ठ सर्वं भवति चाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca candrahāsye śubhaśubham / kṛtaṃ nṛpavaraśreṣṭha sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
verses.translation: Then Anga, the eldest son of Sudesna, was born. The other sons born to her thereafter were Vanga, Kalinga, Punclra and Brahma (Suhma in Bd. P. v. 87).
verses.hindi: शाली चार पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए । जिनके नाम थे, बृहत्क्षत्र, महाबीयं, नर और गाग्र (गा) ।१५६-३५९। इनमें नर के सांकृति नामक पुत्र हुए, जिनके गुरुवीयं और त्रिदेव नामक महान् तेजस्वी पुत्र हुए--ये दोनों पुत्र सांकृत्य के नाम से विश्यात हैं। शिनिवद्ध'''''? गाग्र के उत्तराधिकारी गाग्रय के नाम से विश्यात हुए-- ये सब क्षत्रियोचित गुण धर्मं समन्वित ब्राह्मण कहे जाते हैं। महावीये के पुत्र भीम थे, उनसे उपक्षय तामक पुत्र की उत्पत्ति हुई, उपक्षय की पुत्री विद्याला थी, उसने त्रय्यारुणि, पुष्करी और कपि नामक तीन पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया, कपि के कंशज केवल उत्तम क्षत्रिय हुए और उन दोनों के महषि हुए । गाग्र्य और सांकृति के वंशज परम बलशालो क्षत्रिय थे; वे सब आद्लिरिस बृहस्पति के वंश में मिल ग्रये, अब ब्रृहत्क्षत्र के वंश का वर्णन कर रहा हुं !६०-१६४। बृहत्क्षत्र का उत्तराधिकारी पुत्र परम घाभिक सुहोत्र था, सुहोत्र का उत्तरा-
verses.wordMeaning: Then Anga, the eldest son of Sudesna, was born. The other sons born to her thereafter were Vanga, Kalinga, Punclra and Brahma (Suhma in Bd. P. v. 87).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Anga, the eldest son of Sudesna, was born. The other sons born to her thereafter were Vanga, Kalinga, Punclra and Brahma (Suhma in Bd. P. v. 87).

verses.sanskrit: ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस् तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् । चन्द्रहास्ये तु ये स्नात्वा पश्यन्ति ग्रहणं नराः
verses.transliteration: te dhanyāste mahātmānas teṣāṃ janma sujīvitam / candrahāsye tu ye snātvā paśyanti grahaṇaṃ narāḥ
verses.translation: For certain reasons, his (Bali's) progeny had been prevented by Brahma, saying, "Let there not be any off¬ spring of this nobie-soulcd (king) by his own wives"* That was why he begot children of human wombs. Then the delighted bull, the son of Kamadhenu, spoke these words to Dirghatamas:
verses.hindi: धिकारी हस्ती नाम से प्रसिद्ध था। उसी ने प्राचीनकाल में हस्तिनापुर का निर्माण किया था। राजा हस्ती के तीन परम धारमिक उत्तराधिकारी पुत्र हुए, उनके नाम थे अजमीढ़ द्विजामीढ़ और पुरुमीढ़ ।१६५-१६ ६! अजमीढ़ की कुरुवंश का उद्धार करने वाली परम सुन्दरी नीलिनी, केशिती और धूमिती तामक पत्नियाँ थीं, उन सबों से अजमीढ़ के वंशोद्धारक कई पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। महान तपस्या के उपरान्त राजा अजमीढ़ को
verses.wordMeaning: For certain reasons, his (Bali's) progeny had been prevented by Brahma, saying, "Let there not be any off¬ spring of this nobie-soulcd (king) by his own wives"* That was why he begot children of human wombs. Then the delighted bull, the son of Kamadhenu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: For certain reasons, his (Bali's) progeny had been prevented by Brahma, saying, "Let there not be any off¬ spring of this nobie-soulcd (king) by his own wives"* That was why he begot children of human wombs. Then the delighted bull, the son of Kamadhenu,…

verses.sanskrit: वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मजं यत्पुरा कृतम् । स्नानमात्रात् तु राजेन्द्र तत्र तीर्थे प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurā kṛtam / snānamātrāt tu rājendra tatra tīrthe praṇaśyati
verses.translation: "Since you have done this after pondering over Godharma, I am pleased with you. I shall release you (from the curse).
verses.hindi: व॒द्धावस्था में भरद्वाज की अनुकम्पा से इन पुत्रों की प्राप्ति हुई थौ। उनके बंश का विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन सुनिये । ऐसी प्रसिद्धि है कि केशिनी में राजा अजमीढ़ के कण्ठ मामक पुत्र की उत्पत्ति हुईैं। १६७-१६९। कण्ठ का पुत्र न विद्यतेथ्यं इलोक: क, पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: "Since you have done this after pondering over Godharma, I am pleased with you. I shall release you (from the curse).
verses.commentary: Sense: "Since you have done this after pondering over Godharma, I am pleased with you. I shall release you (from the curse).

verses.sanskrit: बहवस्तन्न जानन्ति महामोहसमन्विताः । देहस्थ इव सर्वेषां परमात्मेव संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: bahavastanna jānanti mahāmohasamanvitāḥ / dehastha iva sarveṣāṃ paramātmeva saṃsthitam
verses.translation: Hence, look, I shall remove your long period of dark¬ ness and gloom, as well as the curse of Brhaspati along with the other sins that may be lingering, sticking to your body.
verses.hindi: बृहद्सोबू हद्विष्णुः पुत्रस्तस्य महाबलः । बृह॒त्कर्मा सुतस्तस्य पुत्रस्तस्य बृहद्रथः ११७१ विश्वजित्तनयस्तस्य सेनजित्तस्य चाउ5त्मजः । अथ सेनजितः पुत्राश्व॒त्वारों लोकविश्वुताः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, look, I shall remove your long period of dark¬ ness and gloom, as well as the curse of Brhaspati along with the other sins that may be lingering, sticking to your body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, look, I shall remove your long period of dark¬ ness and gloom, as well as the curse of Brhaspati along with the other sins that may be lingering, sticking to your body.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे सागरे गत्वा सोमतीर्थे तु यत्फलम् । तत्समग्रमवाप्नोति चन्द्रहास्ये न संशयः
verses.transliteration: paścime sāgare gatvā somatīrthe tu yatphalam / tatsamagramavāpnoti candrahāsye na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: After sniffing at you, I shall remove your fear of death and old age." As soon as he was sniffed at, the darkness was destroyed and he began to see. He regained his eye-sight. He became a young man
verses.hindi: रुचिराश्वश्च काव्यश्न रामो दृढ्धनुस्तथा । वत्सभ्रावन्‍न्तको राजा यस्य ते परिवत्सराः यस्य चेकशत्ं चा55सोत्पुत्रनाणासिति नः श्रुतम् । नीपा इति सामासख्याता राजानः सर्व एवं ते
verses.wordMeaning: After sniffing at you, I shall remove your fear of death and old age." As soon as he was sniffed at, the darkness was destroyed and he began to see. He regained his eye-sight. He became a young man
verses.commentary: Sense: After sniffing at you, I shall remove your fear of death and old age." As soon as he was sniffed at, the darkness was destroyed and he began to see. He regained his eye-sight. He became a young man

verses.sanskrit: संक्रान्तौ च व्यतीपाते विषुवे चायने तथा । चन्द्रहास्ये नरः स्नात्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte viṣuve cāyane tathā / candrahāsye naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Thereafter Kakslvan went to Giripraja (Girivraja_Bd.
verses.hindi: तेषां बंशकर: श्रीमानराजा55सो त्की तिवर्धनः । काम्पिल्थे समरो नाम स चेष्टसमरोइभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter Kakslvan went to Giripraja (Girivraja_Bd.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Kakslvan went to Giripraja (Girivraja_Bd.

verses.sanskrit: ते मूढास्ते दुराचारास् तेषां जन्म निरर्थकम् । चन्द्रहास्यं न जानन्ति नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: te mūḍhāste durācārās teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam / candrahāsyaṃ na jānanti narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam
verses.translation: After a long period, he became purified through his penance. After shaking off his defects, the lord (sage) attained Brahmanahood along with his younger brother. Then spoke his father: "O Lord, now I am (really) one blessed with a son. By having a famous and good son (like you), 1 have achieved my objective (and am happy and con¬ tented) in life."
verses.hindi: वर्ोस्तु सुकृतिर्नाम सुकृतेनेह करमंणा । जज्ञे सर्वंगुणोपेतों विश्वजस्तस्य चाउप्त्मजः ११७८ अणुहस्य तु दायादो ब्रह्मदत्तो महातपाः । योगसुनुः सुतस्तस्य विष्वक्सेनो5भवन्नृपः ३१८०
verses.wordMeaning: After a long period, he became purified through his penance. After shaking off his defects, the lord (sage) attained Brahmanahood along with his younger brother. Then spoke his father: "O Lord, now I am (really) one blessed with a son.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After a long period, he became purified through his penance. After shaking off his defects, the lord (sage) attained Brahmanahood along with his younger brother. Then spoke his father: "O Lord, now I am (really) one blessed with a son.…

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रहास्ये तु यः कश्चित् संन्यासं कुरुते नृप । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य सोमलोकात्कदाचन
verses.transliteration: candrahāsye tu yaḥ kaścit saṃnyāsaṃ kurute nṛpa / anivartikā gatistasya somalokātkadācana
verses.translation: With his soul united in Yogic practice, he attained Brahman-hood and extinction of (worldly bondage). After obtaining Brahmana-hood Kakslvan procreated a thousand sons.
verses.hindi: मेधातिथि था, उसके वंशज कण्ठायन नामक द्विज कहे जाते हैं। अजमीढ़ की दूसरी पत्नी धूमिनी में राजा बृहदूबसु का जन्म हुआ, बृंहद्वसु का पृत्र बृहद्विष्णु हुआ, उप्तका पुत्र महाबल था, महाबल का पुत्र बृहत्कर्मा था, बृह॒त्कर्मा का पुत्र राजा बृंहद्रथ हुआ  उसका पुत्र विश्वजित् था, विश्वजितू का पुत्र सेनजित् हुआ । सेनजित् के चार लोकबिख्यात पुत्र हुए । उनके नाम थे, रुधिराइव काव्य, ढढ़ धनुर्धारी राम और अवन्‍्तिदेशाधिपति
verses.wordMeaning: With his soul united in Yogic practice, he attained Brahman-hood and extinction of (worldly bondage). After obtaining Brahmana-hood Kakslvan procreated a thousand sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his soul united in Yogic practice, he attained Brahman-hood and extinction of (worldly bondage). After obtaining Brahmana-hood Kakslvan procreated a thousand sons.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे चन्द्रहास्यतीर्थमहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम नवत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १९१ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: सिद्धेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् तस्यैव तु समीपतः । अमृतस्रावि तल्लिङ्गमाद्यं स्वायम्भुवं तथा
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe candrahāsyatīrthamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 191 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: siddheśvaraṃ tato gacchet tasyaiva tu samīpataḥ / amṛtasrāvi talliṅgamādyaṃ svāyambhuvaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Those dark-skinned Gautamas (descendants of Gautama) are remembered as the sons of Kakslvan. Thus the association of DIrghatamas and Bali, the son of Virocana, has been narrated. So also the progeny of both. After the corona¬ tion of his five sinless sons, the contented Bali resorted to Yogic practice. The lord of Yogic soul bides his time roaming (on the earth) while remaining invisible to all living beings.
verses.hindi: वत्स । इसी राजा वत्स के नामसे सुप्रसिद्ध परिवत्सरों का प्रचलन हुआ ॥१७०-१७३। रुचिराश्व का पुत्र महानू यशस्वी पृथुषेण था, प्रथृषेण का पुत्र पार था, पार से नीप का जन्म हुआ। हमने सुना है कि उस राजा नीप के एक सौ पुत्र थे । सब के सब राजा थे, उन सब की नीपगण नाम से ख्याति थी । उन समस्त नीपगणों में बंशोद्धारक परम यशस्वी समर नामक एक पुत्र था, उसने काम्पिलय के युद्ध में विजय प्राप्त की थी । उस समर के पर, वार ओर सत्वदश्ब--ये तीन पुत्र हुए, तीनों स्वगुणसम्पन्न थे । इनमें पार का पुत्र बृषु हुआ, वृषु का पुत्र सुकृति नामक हुआ, उसके शुभ कर्मों से स्वंगुण सम्पन्न विश्राज नामक एक पुत्र हुआ ।६७४-१७८। विम्राज का उत्तराधिकारी राजा अणुह हुआ । वह परम बश्चस्वी राजा अगुह शुक का जामाता एवं ऋची का पत्ति था। अणुह का उत्तराधिकारी महान् तपस्वी ब्रह्मदत्त हुआ । उस ब्रह्मदत्त
verses.wordMeaning: Those dark-skinned Gautamas (descendants of Gautama) are remembered as the sons of Kakslvan. Thus the association of DIrghatamas and Bali, the son of Virocana, has been narrated. So also the progeny of both. After the corona¬ tion of his five sinless sons,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those dark-skinned Gautamas (descendants of Gautama) are remembered as the sons of Kakslvan. Thus the association of DIrghatamas and Bali, the son of Virocana, has been narrated. So also the progeny of both. After the corona¬ tion of his five sinless sons,…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टमात्रेण येनेह ह्यनृणो जायते नरः । पुरा वर्षशतं साग्रमाराध्य परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭamātreṇa yeneha hyanṛṇo jāyate naraḥ / purā varṣaśataṃ sāgramārādhya parameśvaram
verses.translation: Some words missing herein the text are supplied here.
verses.hindi: का पुत्र योगसूनु और योगसूनु का पुत्र विष्वक्सेव हुआ । विश्राज के वंश में होनेवाले ये नृपतिगण अपने सत्कर्मों
verses.wordMeaning: Some words missing herein the text are supplied here.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some words missing herein the text are supplied here.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नुयुः परमां सिद्धिमादित्या द्वादशैव तु । अतः सिद्धेश्वरः प्रोक्तः सिद्धिदः सिद्धिकाङ्क्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: prāpnuyuḥ paramāṃ siddhimādityā dvādaśaiva tu / ataḥ siddheśvaraḥ proktaḥ siddhidaḥ siddhikāṅkṣiṇām
verses.translation: The elephant of Sakra was bom as his elephant
verses.hindi: विश्राजपुत्रा राजानः सुकृतेनेह कर्मणा । विष्वक्सेनस्थ पुत्रस्तु उदक्सेनों ब॒भुव ह १८९१ भल्लाटस्तस्य दायादो येन राजा पुरा हुतः । भललाटस्य तु दायादो राजा55सीज्जनसेजय: ॥ उग्रापुधः कस्य सुतः कस्मिन्वंशे च कीत्यंते । किमर्थ चेव नोपास्ते तेन सर्वे प्रणाशिताः ॥ै१८रे
verses.wordMeaning: The elephant of Sakra was bom as his elephant
verses.commentary: Sense: The elephant of Sakra was bom as his elephant

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं सिद्धेश्वरे प्राप्ताः सिद्धिं देवा द्विजोत्तम । आदित्या इति यच्चोक्तं तन्मे विस्मापनं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ siddheśvare prāptāḥ siddhiṃ devā dvijottama / ādityā iti yaccoktaṃ tanme vismāpanaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: Haryanga's successor was the king Bhadraratha. Bhadraratha's son was Brhatkarma, the lord of subjects.
verses.hindi: आसीत्सुवर्मणः पुत्र: सावंभोमः प्रतापवान् । सावभौस इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यासेकराड्बभौ
verses.wordMeaning: Haryanga's successor was the king Bhadraratha. Bhadraratha's son was Brhatkarma, the lord of subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Haryanga's successor was the king Bhadraratha. Bhadraratha's son was Brhatkarma, the lord of subjects.

verses.sanskrit: तपस्युग्रे व्यवसिता आदित्याः केन हेतुना । सम्प्राप्तास्तु द्विजश्रेष्ठ सिद्धिं चैवाभिलाषिकीम्
verses.transliteration: tapasyugre vyavasitā ādityāḥ kena hetunā / samprāptāstu dvijaśreṣṭha siddhiṃ caivābhilāṣikīm
verses.translation: Bjhadratha was his son and Brhanmana was born of him. Brhanmana procreated the son Rajendra.
verses.hindi: तस्थान्वये च महति महत्पौरवननन्‍्दनः । महत्पौरवपुत्रस्तु राजा रुक्मरथः स्मृतः सुमतेरपि धर्मात्मा राजा संनतिमान्प्रभुः। तस्या४5सीत्संनतिर्नाम कृतस्तस्थ सुतोष्भवत्.
verses.wordMeaning: Bjhadratha was his son and Brhanmana was born of him. Brhanmana procreated the son Rajendra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bjhadratha was his son and Brhanmana was born of him. Brhanmana procreated the son Rajendra.

verses.sanskrit: संक्षिप्य तु मया पृष्टं विस्तराद्द्विज शंस मे
verses.transliteration: saṃkṣipya tu mayā pṛṣṭaṃ vistarāddvija śaṃsa me
verses.translation: He was otherwise known as Jayadratha and from him was born king Drdharatha. The son of Drdharatha was Janamejaya, the conqueror of the universe.
verses.hindi: से इस लोक में परम यश के भाजन हो गये हैं । उस राजा विष्कसेन का पुत्र उदक्सेने हुआ । उसका उत्तरा- धिकारी भल्लाट हुआ, जिसने राजा का संहार कर दिया । भल्लाट का उत्तराधिकारी राजा जनमेजय हुआ, इसी के वर के कारण उग्रायुध ने समस्त नीपवंशियों का विध्वंश कर डाला था
verses.wordMeaning: He was otherwise known as Jayadratha and from him was born king Drdharatha. The son of Drdharatha was Janamejaya, the conqueror of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was otherwise known as Jayadratha and from him was born king Drdharatha. The son of Drdharatha was Janamejaya, the conqueror of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: अदितेर् द्वादशादित्या जाताः शक्रपुरोगमाः । इन्द्रो धाता भगस्त्वष्टा मित्रो ऽथ वरुणो ऽर्यमा
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: aditer dvādaśādityā jātāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ / indro dhātā bhagastvaṣṭā mitro 'tha varuṇo 'ryamā
verses.translation: His successor, the king of Ahgas, was Kama. Kama's son was Surasena and Dvija is remembered'as his son.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने पूछा--सूत जो-! यह उग्रायुध किसका पुत्र था ? किस वंश में इसकी उत्पत्ति कही जाती है ” इसने किसलिए समस्त नौपवंशी राजाओं का विध्वंस किया था ? सूत बोले--ऋषिवृन्द ! ट्विमीढ़ का उत्तराधिकारी विद्वान राजा थवीनर हुआ। उसका पुत्र धृतिमान् था। घृतिमान् का पुत्र सत्यधृति था। सत्यधृति का पुत्र परम प्रतापशाली राजा वृढ़नेमि था। दृढ़नेमि का पुत्र राजा सुवर्मा था। सुवंसा का पुत्र सावंभौम परमप्रतापशाली राजा था, अपने समय का समस्त भूमण्डल का एकच्छन्र सम्राद् था ।१८४-१८६। उसकी ख्याति ही सार्वभौम नाम से थी। उस राजा सा्वभौम
verses.wordMeaning: His successor, the king of Ahgas, was Kama. Kama's son was Surasena and Dvija is remembered'as his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: His successor, the king of Ahgas, was Kama. Kama's son was Surasena and Dvija is remembered'as his son.

verses.sanskrit: विवस्वान्सविता पूषा ह्यंशुमान्विष्णुर् एव च । त इमे द्वादशादित्या इच्छन्तो भास्करं पदम्
verses.transliteration: vivasvānsavitā pūṣā hyaṃśumānviṣṇur eva ca / ta ime dvādaśādityā icchanto bhāskaraṃ padam
verses.translation: How was Karna known as the son of a charioteer and how did he become a member of the family of kings of Ahgas? This we wish to hear. Indeed you are very efficient (in narra¬ tion).
verses.hindi: के महान् वंश में महत्पोरवनन्दन नामक एक राजा हुआ, जिसका पुत्र रुक्‍्मरथ कहा जाता है। रुक्‍मरथ का पुत्न राजा सुपाइव हुआ, उस सुपाश्य का परम घाभिक पूत्र राजा सुमति था। सुमति का पुत्र धर्मात्मा राजा सन्नतिमान् परम ऐश्वयंशाली था। उसका संतति नामक एक पुत्र था, उस संनति का पुत्र क्रत था,
verses.wordMeaning: How was Karna known as the son of a charioteer and how did he become a member of the family of kings of Ahgas? This we wish to hear. Indeed you are very efficient (in narra¬ tion).
verses.commentary: Sense: How was Karna known as the son of a charioteer and how did he become a member of the family of kings of Ahgas? This we wish to hear. Indeed you are very efficient (in narra¬ tion).

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य तपस्युग्रे व्यवस्थिताः । सिद्धेश्वरे महाराज काश्यपेयैर्महात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: narmadātaṭamāśritya tapasyugre vyavasthitāḥ / siddheśvare mahārāja kāśyapeyairmahātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: They were Yasodevi and Satya. The race is bifurca¬ ted on account of these two wives. Jayadratha otherwise known as Rajendra was born of Yasodevi.
verses.hindi: स्पृतास्ते प्राच्यनामानः कार्ता साम्नां तु सामगाः। कारतिरुग्रायुध: सोड्थ वीरः पोरवनत्दनः मुद्गलः शूठजयश्चेव राजा बृहदिषुस्तथा। यवीयांभ्रापि विक्वान्तः काम्पिल्यश्वेव पत्चमः
verses.wordMeaning: They were Yasodevi and Satya. The race is bifurca¬ ted on account of these two wives. Jayadratha otherwise known as Rajendra was born of Yasodevi.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Yasodevi and Satya. The race is bifurca¬ ted on account of these two wives. Jayadratha otherwise known as Rajendra was born of Yasodevi.

verses.sanskrit: परा सिद्धिरनुप्राप्ता द्वादशादित्यसंज्ञितैः । स्थापितश्च जगद्धाता तस्मिंस्तीर्थे दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: parā siddhiranuprāptā dvādaśādityasaṃjñitaiḥ / sthāpitaśca jagaddhātā tasmiṃstīrthe divākaraḥ
verses.translation: That noble-minded heroic son of Das'aratha, Caturanga, the pro¬ motor of his family, was born through the grace of Rsyasrriga.
verses.hindi: वह राजा कृत कौथुमीश्ाखाध्यायी महात्मा हिरण्यताभि का शिष्य था, यह चोबीस प्रकार को सामसंहिताओं का प्रवक्ता था ।7१८७-१६०। उनके द्वारा निर्मित संहिताओं की ख्याति सामग्रान करनेवाले प्राच्य नाम से करते हैं। उसी राजा कृत का पुत्र उग्रायुध था, यह पुरुवंशियों को आनन्दित करनेवाला राजा उप्रायुध परम वीर था। इसी राजा उम्रायुध ने अपने विक्रम की ख्याति करते हुए पण्चाल देशाधिपत्ति राजा पृषत् के
verses.wordMeaning: That noble-minded heroic son of Das'aratha, Caturanga, the pro¬ motor of his family, was born through the grace of Rsyasrriga.
verses.commentary: Sense: That noble-minded heroic son of Das'aratha, Caturanga, the pro¬ motor of his family, was born through the grace of Rsyasrriga.

verses.sanskrit: स्वकीयांशविभागेन द्वादशादित्यसंज्ञितैः । तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं राजन्ख्यातिं गतं भुवि
verses.transliteration: svakīyāṃśavibhāgena dvādaśādityasaṃjñitaiḥ / tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ rājankhyātiṃ gataṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: It is reported that Prthulasva was Caturanga's son. The son of Prthulas'va was (?) of Campa. The (capital) city of Campa was beautiful. It became the beautiful Malini (real name of Campa).
verses.hindi: पितामह महाबाहु नील का संद्वार किया था । उग्रायुध का उत्तराधिकारी महान् यशश्वी राजा क्षेम हुआ ॥ उस क्षेम से सुवीर नामक पुत्र का जन्म हुआ, सुवीर का पुत्र राजा नृपण्जय हुआ । नृपझजय से वीररुथ की उत्पत्ति हुई--यही सब पुरुवंशी राजा कहे गये हैं १!९१-१६३॥ अजमीढ़ की नीलिनी नामक पत्नी में राजा बील की उत्पत्ति हुईं, नील की विकट तपस्या के फलस्वरूप सुशान्ति नामक पुत्र का जन्म हुआ, सुशार्ति का पुत्र पुरुजानु हुआ, पुरुजानु का पुत्र रिक्ष था  उस रिक्ष के अनेक उत्तराधिकारी पुत्र हुए, उनके नाम थे, मुद्गल, श्वज्जय, बृहदिषु, यवीयान् ओर काम्पिलल्‍्य ।१६४-१६६। पाँचों पुत्रों की सुरक्षा के लिये पिता ने इनसे बतलाया था कि तुम पाँचों के लिये ये पाँच सुन्दर एवं उपजाऊ जनपद हैं, इन्हें जान लो, उन पाँचों पुत्रों के भरण पोषण के लिये वे पाँच जनपद पर्याप्त थे। उन पाँचों जनपदों की कालान्तर में पञ्चाल नाम से ख्याति हुईं मुदूगल के वशज
verses.wordMeaning: It is reported that Prthulasva was Caturanga's son. The son of Prthulas'va was (?) of Campa. The (capital) city of Campa was beautiful. It became the beautiful Malini (real name of Campa).
verses.commentary: Sense: It is reported that Prthulasva was Caturanga's son. The son of Prthulas'va was (?) of Campa. The (capital) city of Campa was beautiful. It became the beautiful Malini (real name of Campa).

verses.sanskrit: प्रलये समनुप्राप्ते ह्यादित्या द्वादशैव ते । द्वादशादित्यतो राजन् सम्भवन्ति युगक्षये
verses.transliteration: pralaye samanuprāpte hyādityā dvādaśaiva te / dvādaśādityato rājan sambhavanti yugakṣaye
verses.translation: The city of Campavati (alias) Campa was inhabited by people of four Varnas (castes). They lived in Campavati for sixty thousand years. By Brahmanas, Ksattriyas, Vais'yas, by all, their own duty (Dharma) was followed. All were devoted to Visnu by performing penance and following the duties of their (respective) caste.
verses.hindi: क्षत्रिय गुणधर्म समन्वित द्विज हुए । ये सब कण्ठ और मुद्गल के वंशज आंगिरस गोत्र में सम्मिलित हो गये । मुद्गल का ज्येष्ठ पुत्र महान् यशस्वी ब्रहष्ठ था ।१६७-१६६। उसके संयोग से इन्द्सेना ने वध्यशव नामक पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: The city of Campavati (alias) Campa was inhabited by people of four Varnas (castes). They lived in Campavati for sixty thousand years. By Brahmanas, Ksattriyas, Vais'yas, by all, their own duty (Dharma) was followed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of Campavati (alias) Campa was inhabited by people of four Varnas (castes). They lived in Campavati for sixty thousand years. By Brahmanas, Ksattriyas, Vais'yas, by all, their own duty (Dharma) was followed.…

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्तपति पूर्वेण धाता चैवाग्निगोचरे । गभस्तिपतिर्वै याम्ये त्वष्टा नैरृतदिङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: indrastapati pūrveṇa dhātā caivāgnigocare / gabhastipatirvai yāmye tvaṣṭā nairṛtadiṅmukhaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective verse) Satya gave birth to the famous Vijaya who was of mixed Brahmana-Ksatriya caste (?) Vijaya's son was Dlijli and his son was Dhrtavrata.
verses.hindi: नाय॑ श्लोको घ. पुस्तके । +घनुश्चिन्नान्तगंतग्रन्थो डः. पुस्तके नास्ति । टै२० वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) Satya gave birth to the famous Vijaya who was of mixed Brahmana-Ksatriya caste (?) Vijaya's son was Dlijli and his son was Dhrtavrata.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) Satya gave birth to the famous Vijaya who was of mixed Brahmana-Ksatriya caste (?) Vijaya's son was Dlijli and his son was Dhrtavrata.

verses.sanskrit: वरुणः पश्चिमे भागे मित्रस्तु वायवे तथा । विष्णुश्च सौम्यदिग्भागे विवस्वानीशगोचरे
verses.transliteration: varuṇaḥ paścime bhāge mitrastu vāyave tathā / viṣṇuśca saumyadigbhāge vivasvānīśagocare
verses.translation: Dhrtavrata's son was Satyakarma of great fame. Satyakarma's son was Adhiratha, the charioteer.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रसेना यतो गर्भ वध्यश्व प्रत्यपद्यत । वध्यश्वान्मिथुनं जज्ञे मेनका इति नः अ्तिः (२००
verses.wordMeaning: Dhrtavrata's son was Satyakarma of great fame. Satyakarma's son was Adhiratha, the charioteer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhrtavrata's son was Satyakarma of great fame. Satyakarma's son was Adhiratha, the charioteer.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वतश्चैव सविता ह्यधः पूषा विशोषयन् । अंशुमांस् तु तथा विष्णुर् मुखतो निर्गतं जगत्
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvataścaiva savitā hyadhaḥ pūṣā viśoṣayan / aṃśumāṃs tu tathā viṣṇur mukhato nirgataṃ jagat
verses.translation: He adopted and looked after Karna. Hence Karna was known as the son of a charioteer. Thus everything that had been asked about Karna has been mentioned to you.
verses.hindi: दिवोदासस्य दायादो ब्रह्मिष्ठो मित्रयुन पः। मेत्रेयस्तु ततो जज्ञे स्घुता एतेषपि संश्िताः १२०६ एते5पि संश्षिताः पक्ष क्षात्त्रोपेतास्तु भागंवाः । राजाइपि च्यवनों विद्वांस्ततो5प्रतिरथोडइभवत् अथ थे च्यवनाद्धीमान्सुदासः समपद्यत । सौदासः सहदेवश्व सोमकस्तस्य चाउधत्मजः २०४
verses.wordMeaning: He adopted and looked after Karna. Hence Karna was known as the son of a charioteer. Thus everything that had been asked about Karna has been mentioned to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: He adopted and looked after Karna. Hence Karna was known as the son of a charioteer. Thus everything that had been asked about Karna has been mentioned to you.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदहन्वै नरश्रेष्ठ बभ्रमुश्च इतस्ततः । यथैव ते महाराज दहन्ति सकलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: pradahanvai naraśreṣṭha babhramuśca itastataḥ / yathaiva te mahārāja dahanti sakalaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Thus all the kings in the family of Ariga have been recounted by me. Now listen to the progeny of Puru in detail and in the proper order.
verses.hindi: को जन्म दिया । हमने ऐसा सुना है कि मेनका ने इसी राजा वध्यश्व के समागम से एक जुड़वाँ सस्‍्तानें उत्पन्न की थीं । जिसमें एक राजधि दिवोदास थे, दूसरी परम वशस्विनतों अहल्या थीं। अहल्या ने शारद्गबत के संयोग से ऋषिवर बझताननन्‍द को पुत्ररूप में प्राप्त किया । दतानन्द के महान् यशस्वी सत्यधृति नामक पुत्र हुआ, जो धनुवेद में परम पारज़्त था ।२००-२०२। एक बार सम्मुख आती हुई किसी अप्सरा को देखकर सत्यधृति का
verses.wordMeaning: Thus all the kings in the family of Ariga have been recounted by me. Now listen to the progeny of Puru in detail and in the proper order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus all the kings in the family of Ariga have been recounted by me. Now listen to the progeny of Puru in detail and in the proper order.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव द्वादशादित्या भक्तानां भावसाधनाः । प्रातरुत्थाय यः स्नात्वा द्वादशादित्यसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva dvādaśādityā bhaktānāṃ bhāvasādhanāḥ / prātarutthāya yaḥ snātvā dvādaśādityasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: The mighty-armed son of Puru, Janamejaya became a king. His son was Aviddha who conquered the eastern region.
verses.hindi: शुक्र सरपतों के गुल्म में गिए पड़ा, जिससे एक जुड़वाँ सन्तानें उत्पन्न हुईं। संयोगवश राजा शन्तनु मृगया खेलते हुए वहाँ पहुँचे और उन्होंने कृपा करके उन बच्चों को उठा लिया और अपने घर लाकर उनका पालन पोषण किया! इसी कारण उन दोनों के नाम कृपा और कृपी रखे गये, उसी क्ृपी का दूसरा नाम गौतमी भी था ।२०३-२०४। दारद्त कहे जाने वाले गौतमबंशीय ऋतथ्यों का यह वंशवर्णन कर चुका । अब इसके उपरान्त दिवोदास की सनन्‍्ततियों का वणन कर रहा हूँ  दिवोदास का उत्तराधिकारी ब्रह्म- परायण राजा मित्रयु था। उससे मैत्रेय की उत्पत्ति हुई--मैत्रेय के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले भी क्षत्रियगुण धर्म समन्वित द्विजाति कहलाये--और उन सबों का गोत्र भागव रहा  तदल्तर उसी वंश में विद्वान् राजा च्यवन का जन्म हुआ, जिसके रथ की समानता कोई अन्य राजा नहीं कर सकता था ।२०५-२०७। च्यवन से
verses.wordMeaning: The mighty-armed son of Puru, Janamejaya became a king. His son was Aviddha who conquered the eastern region.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mighty-armed son of Puru, Janamejaya became a king. His son was Aviddha who conquered the eastern region.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यते देवदेवेशं शृणु तस्यैव यत्फलम् । वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मजं यत्पुराकृतम्
verses.transliteration: paśyate devadeveśaṃ śṛṇu tasyaiva yatphalam / vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurākṛtam
verses.translation: From Aviddha was born as son the great hero Manasyu. King Jayada was the son of Manasyu.
verses.hindi: परम बुद्धिमान् राजा सुदासु की उत्पत्ति हुई, सुदासु का पुत्र सहदेव हुआ, सहदेव का पुत्र सोमक था। वंश के विनाश समुपस्थित होने पर राजा अजमीढ़ ही सोमक के रूप में उत्पन्न हुये थे। सोमक का पुत्र जन्तु था, उसके मारे जाने पर उस महान् पराक्रमशाली एवं धर्मात्मा सोमक रूपधारी राजा अजमीढ़ के अन्य सो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए, जिनमें सबसे छोठा पृषत् था, यह पृषत् राजा द्वुपद का पिता था। अर्थात्
verses.wordMeaning: From Aviddha was born as son the great hero Manasyu. King Jayada was the son of Manasyu.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Aviddha was born as son the great hero Manasyu. King Jayada was the son of Manasyu.

verses.sanskrit: नश्यते तत्क्षणादेव द्वादशादित्यदर्शनात् । प्रदक्षिणं तु यः कुर्यात् तस्य देवस्य भारत
verses.transliteration: naśyate tatkṣaṇādeva dvādaśādityadarśanāt / pradakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasya devasya bhārata
verses.translation: His successor was the king named Dhundhu. Bahu- gavl was the son of Dhundhu. Sanjati was his son.
verses.hindi: नवनवतितमो ध्याय। है४१ धुष्टशुम्नः सुतस्तस्य धुष्टकेतुश्व॒ सत्सुतः:। महिषा चाजमीठस्य धूमिनी पुन्रगधिनी
verses.wordMeaning: His successor was the king named Dhundhu. Bahu- gavl was the son of Dhundhu. Sanjati was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: His successor was the king named Dhundhu. Bahu- gavl was the son of Dhundhu. Sanjati was his son.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन पृथिवी नात्र संशयः । तत्र तीर्थे तु सप्तम्यामुपवासेन यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ / tatra tīrthe tu saptamyāmupavāsena yatphalam
verses.translation: Sanjati's son was Raudrasva. Understand his sons. Raudrasva begot ten sons of the celestial damsel GhrtacT.
verses.hindi: यः प्रयागं पदा55क्रम्य कुरुक्षेत्र चकार ह। कृष्ट्वन सुमहातेजा वर्षाणि सुबहुन्यथ
verses.wordMeaning: Sanjati's son was Raudrasva. Understand his sons. Raudrasva begot ten sons of the celestial damsel GhrtacT.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sanjati's son was Raudrasva. Understand his sons. Raudrasva begot ten sons of the celestial damsel GhrtacT.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्र सप्तसप्तम्यां लभन्ति न लभन्ति च । षष्ठ्यां वारे दैनकरे द्वादशादित्यदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: anyatra saptasaptamyāṃ labhanti na labhanti ca / ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vāre dainakare dvādaśādityadarśanāt
verses.translation: They were Rajeyu, Krteyu, Vakseyu, Sthandileyu, Ghrtcyu, Jaleyu, Sthaleyu the seventh, Dharmeyu, Sannatcyu and the tenth son Vaneyu. He had ten daughters also, viz. Rudra, Sudra, Madra, Subha, Jamalaja, Tala, Khala (these seven and then), the daughter who is remembered as Gopajala, then, Tamrarasa and Ratnakutl. The husband of all of them was Prabhakara by name. He belonged to the Atreya line (Gotra).
verses.hindi: च्यवनस्तस्य पुत्रस्तु राजा धर्मार्थकोविदः  च्यवनस्य कृतः पुत्र इष्ट्वा यज्ञमंहातपाः २१६९६ विश्वुतं जनयामास पुत्रसिन्द्रसख॑ नृपः  विद्योपरिचरं बोर वसूं नामान्‍्तरिक्षगम् .. विद्योपरिच राज्जज्ञे गिरिका सप्त सूुनवः । महारथो मगधराइविश्वुतों यो बहद्रथः
verses.wordMeaning: They were Rajeyu, Krteyu, Vakseyu, Sthandileyu, Ghrtcyu, Jaleyu, Sthaleyu the seventh, Dharmeyu, Sannatcyu and the tenth son Vaneyu. He had ten daughters also, viz. Rudra, Sudra, Madra, Subha, Jamalaja, Tala, Khala (these seven and then),…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Rajeyu, Krteyu, Vakseyu, Sthandileyu, Ghrtcyu, Jaleyu, Sthaleyu the seventh, Dharmeyu, Sannatcyu and the tenth son Vaneyu. He had ten daughters also, viz. Rudra, Sudra, Madra, Subha, Jamalaja, Tala, Khala (these seven and then),…

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणं तु यः कुर्यात् तस्य पापं तु नश्यति । अरोगी सप्तजन्मानि भवेद्वै नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasya pāpaṃ tu naśyati / arogī saptajanmāni bhavedvai nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Riveyu's wife named Jvalana was the daughter of Taksaka. That saintly king begot of that gentle lady a son named Ranti.
verses.hindi: ााा..-3०.-"“--.. आना मा ० ५-१नमनना नाना वीमामानणथनना/प बन 3 बनआमन-आननााा वि पिगएएएएए टीका
verses.wordMeaning: Riveyu's wife named Jvalana was the daughter of Taksaka. That saintly king begot of that gentle lady a son named Ranti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Riveyu's wife named Jvalana was the daughter of Taksaka. That saintly king begot of that gentle lady a son named Ranti.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु प्रदक्षिणशतं दद्याद्भक्त्या दिने दिने । दद्रूपिटककुष्ठानि मण्डलानि विचर्चिकाः
verses.transliteration: yastu pradakṣiṇaśataṃ dadyādbhaktyā dine dine / dadrūpiṭakakuṣṭhāni maṇḍalāni vicarcikāḥ
verses.translation: Ranti, the king, begot splendid sons of his wife Sarasvati. They were Trasu, Praliratha and Dhruva, who was exceedingly righteous. His daughter Gaurl is famous as the splendid mother of Mandhata. Dhurya was Pratiratha's son and his son was Kantha. (Defective verse) His son was Mcdhatithi from whom the Brahinanas Kanthayanas originated. Itina (?) was the daughter of Anuyama (?). She gave birth to sons.
verses.hindi: प्षत् का पुत्र द्रपद था ।२०८ २१०। द्रुपद का पुत्र धृष्ट्युम्न हुआ, धृष्ट्युप्न का उतर घष्टकेतु था। राजा अजमीढ़ की तीसरी रानी धमिनी को पहले कोई सन्‍्तान नहीं थी, सन्तान की उहकट आकांक्षा से उसने इस पुनर्जन्म में सौ वर्षों तक परम कठोर तपस्या की, हवत किया, रात भर जागरण किया, पवित्र कर्मों में निरत रह कर स्वल्पाहार किया; रात दिन कुशासन पर बेठती रही--उसी पर सोती रही -- इस प्रकार उसने महान् तपस्या की । तपस्या करते करते वह काली पड़ गई, उसमें परम वोयंशाली राजा अजमीढ़ ने गर्भाधान किया, जिससे ऋक्ष नामक पुत्र का जन्म हुआ, यह ऋक्ष देखने में धूएँ के समान कृष्णवर्ण का था, इसका एक छोटा भाईसित भी था ऋक्ष से सम्वरण की उत्पत्ति हुई, सम्वरण से कुरु उत्पन्न हुआ ।२११-२१४। महान् तेजस्वी इस कुरु ने अपने चरणों से प्रयांग को आक्रान्त कर नवीन तोथ॑
verses.wordMeaning: Ranti, the king, begot splendid sons of his wife Sarasvati. They were Trasu, Praliratha and Dhruva, who was exceedingly righteous. His daughter Gaurl is famous as the splendid mother of Mandhata. Dhurya was Pratiratha's son and his son was Kantha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ranti, the king, begot splendid sons of his wife Sarasvati. They were Trasu, Praliratha and Dhruva, who was exceedingly righteous. His daughter Gaurl is famous as the splendid mother of Mandhata. Dhurya was Pratiratha's son and his son was Kantha.…

verses.sanskrit: नश्यन्ति व्याधयः सर्वे गरुडेनेव पन्नगाः । पुत्रप्राप्तिर् भवेत् तस्य षष्ट्या वासरसेवनात्
verses.transliteration: naśyanti vyādhayaḥ sarve garuḍeneva pannagāḥ / putraprāptir bhavet tasya ṣaṣṭyā vāsarasevanāt
verses.translation: Trasu obtained his favourite son Malina who was an expounder of Brahman. Thereafter he obtained Upadata and the (following) four sons of Itina (?): Susmanta, Du?yanta, Pravlra and Anagha. The son born to Dusyanta was an excellent king and he became an emperor.
verses.hindi: कुरुक्षेत्र का निर्माण किया था  बहुत बर्षों तक उसने कुरुक्षेत्र को जोता था। कुरुक्षेत्र के जोतते समय इन्द्र ने वरदान दिया था कि तुम्हारा यह क्षेत्र परम रमणीय, पुषण्यप्रद एवं धर्मात्माओं के निवास करने योग्य है। उस राजा कुर के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले कुरुणणों के नाम से ख्यात हुए, वे सब अपने समय के यशस्वी राजा थे । कुरु के परम प्रिय पुत्र सुधव्वा, जह्न,, परीक्षित, पुत्रक और अरिमदंन थे । इनमें सुधन्वा
verses.wordMeaning: Trasu obtained his favourite son Malina who was an expounder of Brahman. Thereafter he obtained Upadata and the (following) four sons of Itina (?): Susmanta, Du?yanta, Pravlra and Anagha. The son born to Dusyanta was an excellent king and he became an emperor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Trasu obtained his favourite son Malina who was an expounder of Brahman. Thereafter he obtained Upadata and the (following) four sons of Itina (?): Susmanta, Du?yanta, Pravlra and Anagha. The son born to Dusyanta was an excellent king and he became an emperor.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे द्वादशादित्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकनवत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १९२ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्यैवानन्तरं तात देवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । दृष्ट्वा तु श्रीपतिं पापैर् मुच्यते मानवो भुवि
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dvādaśādityatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikanavatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 192 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ tāta devatīrthamanuttamam / dṛṣṭvā tu śrīpatiṃ pāpair mucyate mānavo bhuvi
verses.translation: That son Bharata was born of Sakuntala. It is from him that (the land) took its name Bharata. A disembodied (celestial) voice spoke to king Dusyanta.
verses.hindi: के उत्तराधिकारी परम बुद्धिमान सुहोत्र थे १२१५-२१८५। सुहोत्र का पुत्र धर्मार्थवेत्ता राजा च्यवन् था, च्यवन का पुत्र कृत हुआ, यह कृत महान् तपसवी राजा था, इसने विविध यज्ञों का अनुष्ठान करके इन्द्र के मिन्र, प्रम विख्यात, आकाशचारी वसुनाम से विख्यात विद्योपरिचर नामक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया । उस विद्योपरिचर से गिरिका ने सात पुत्र उत्पन्न किये। जिनमें एक महारथी मगधसम्नाट् राजा बृहद्रथ था ॥२१ ९-२२१। : ब्रत्यग्रहः कुशश्चेब यमाहुमंणिवाहनम्। प्रार्यल्यश्र ललित्थश्र मत्स्यकालस्य सप्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: That son Bharata was born of Sakuntala. It is from him that (the land) took its name Bharata. A disembodied (celestial) voice spoke to king Dusyanta.
verses.commentary: Sense: That son Bharata was born of Sakuntala. It is from him that (the land) took its name Bharata. A disembodied (celestial) voice spoke to king Dusyanta.

verses.sanskrit: महर्षेस् तस्य जामाता भृगोर्देवो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: maharṣes tasya jāmātā bhṛgordevo janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: <c O Dusyanta, the mother is but a leathern pouch (or bellows). The son belongs to the father. He is identical with him by whom he is begotten. Sakuntala tells the truth. Maintain your son. O lord of men, he who discharges the semen virile redeems the son from the abode of Yama. You are the progenitor of this child in the womb. Do not dishonour Sakuntala'h
verses.hindi: ऋषभस्यापि दायाद पुष्पवान्नाम धारमिकः । विक्रान्तस्तस्य दायादो राजा सत्यहितः स्मृत:
verses.wordMeaning: <c O Dusyanta, the mother is but a leathern pouch (or bellows). The son belongs to the father. He is identical with him by whom he is begotten. Sakuntala tells the truth. Maintain your son. O lord of men,…
verses.commentary: Sense: <c O Dusyanta, the mother is but a leathern pouch (or bellows). The son belongs to the father. He is identical with him by whom he is begotten. Sakuntala tells the truth. Maintain your son. O lord of men,…

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: को ऽयं श्रियः पतिर्देवो देवानामधिपो विभुः । कथं जन्माभवत् तस्य देवेषु त्रिषु वा मुने
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: ko 'yaṃ śriyaḥ patirdevo devānāmadhipo vibhuḥ / kathaṃ janmābhavat tasya deveṣu triṣu vā mune
verses.translation: Bharata begot of his three wives nine sons. "These arc not befitting me". Saying this, the king did not approve of them. (Pie disowned them).
verses.hindi: शकले है स वे जातो जरया संधितस्तु सः  जरासंधो महाबाहुजेरया संधितस्तु सः सर्वक्षत्रस्य जेताइसों जरासंधो महाबलः । जरासंधस्य पुत्रस्तु सहदेवः प्रतापन्
verses.wordMeaning: Bharata begot of his three wives nine sons. "These arc not befitting me". Saying this, the king did not approve of them. (Pie disowned them).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bharata begot of his three wives nine sons. "These arc not befitting me". Saying this, the king did not approve of them. (Pie disowned them).

verses.sanskrit: सम्बन्धी च कथं जातो भृगुणा सह केशवः । एतद्विस्तरतो ब्रह्मन् वक्तुम् अर्हसि भार्गव
verses.transliteration: sambandhī ca kathaṃ jāto bhṛguṇā saha keśavaḥ / etadvistarato brahman vaktum arhasi bhārgava
verses.translation: Then those infuriated mothers slew their sons. Thus the births of those sons to the king were futile.
verses.hindi: सहदेवात्मज: श्रीमास्सोमाधिः सुमहातपाः । श्रुतश्रवास्तु सोमाधेर्मागधः परिकोतितः
verses.wordMeaning: Then those infuriated mothers slew their sons. Thus the births of those sons to the king were futile.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then those infuriated mothers slew their sons. Thus the births of those sons to the king were futile.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: संक्षेपात् कथयिष्यामि साध्यस्य चरितं महत् । न हि विस्तरतो वक्तुं शक्ताः सर्वे महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: saṃkṣepāt kathayiṣyāmi sādhyasya caritaṃ mahat / na hi vistarato vaktuṃ śaktāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Then the powerful son Bharadvaja, the son of Bfha- spati, was brought over there by the Maruts in the course of the sacrifices and handed over to him.
verses.hindi: स्रथस्य तु दायादो भोमसेनोइषपि नामतः द २२६ जह् नुस्त्वजनयत्पुत्न सुर्थ नाम भुसिपम् । सुरथस्थ तु दायादों बौरो राजा विद्रथः १२३०
verses.wordMeaning: Then the powerful son Bharadvaja, the son of Bfha- spati, was brought over there by the Maruts in the course of the sacrifices and handed over to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the powerful son Bharadvaja, the son of Bfha- spati, was brought over there by the Maruts in the course of the sacrifices and handed over to him.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणस्य नाभ्यब्जाज्जातो देवश्चतुर्मुखः । तस्य दक्षो ऽङ्गजो राजन् दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठसम्भवः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇasya nābhyabjājjāto devaścaturmukhaḥ / tasya dakṣo 'ṅgajo rājan dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhasambhavaḥ
verses.translation: In this connection, they cite this story of the intelli¬ gent Bharadvaja, his birth and the transfer unto Bharata by the Maruts.
verses.hindi: उसके अतिरिक्त, प्रत्याग्रह, कुश, मणिवाहन, प्राथैल्य, ललित्य और मत्स्यकाल नामक अन्य छः पुत्र भी थे । बृहद्रथ का उत्तराधिकारी परम विख्यात राजा कुशाग्र हुआ। उस कुशाग्न का पुत्र परम बलवानू ऋषभ था । ऋषभ का उत्तराधिकारी परम धामिक पुष्पवान् था, जिसका योग्य उत्तराधिकारी विक्रमशाली राजा सत्यहित कहा जाता है ।२२२-२२४। उस राजा सत्यहित का पुत्र सुधन्वा था, उससे प्रतापशाली ऊर्ज का जन्म
verses.wordMeaning: In this connection, they cite this story of the intelli¬ gent Bharadvaja, his birth and the transfer unto Bharata by the Maruts.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this connection, they cite this story of the intelli¬ gent Bharadvaja, his birth and the transfer unto Bharata by the Maruts.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मः स्तनान्तात्संजातस् तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवत्किल । नारायणसहायो ऽसावजो ऽपि भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration: dharmaḥ stanāntātsaṃjātas tasya putro 'bhavatkila / nārāyaṇasahāyo 'sāvajo 'pi bharatarṣabha
verses.translation: When his wife was in the advanced state ofpreg- nancy, it is said that Asija died. Looking at his brother's wife, Bt-haspati said: "O auspicious lady, embellish your body with ornaments and give me (the pleasure of) sexual intercourse
verses.hindi: हुआ, ऊर्जे का पुत्र राजा नभस् था, उस नभस् से परमबलशाली उस राजा का जस्म हुआ, जिसके जन्म के पहिले दो टुकड़े उत्पन्न हुये थे, जरा ज्ञामक राक्षसी ने उन दोनों टुकड़ों को आपस में जोड़ दिया, अर्थात् वह परम बलश्ाली पृत्र महाबाहु जरासंघ था, जरा से संधित होने के कारण उसका यह नाम विख्यात था । महाबलशाली यह राजा जरासन्ध अपने समय के समस्त क्षत्रियों को पराजित करनेवाला था। उस जरासंध का पुत्र प्रतापशाली सहदेव था । सहदेव का पुत्र महान् तपस्वी श्रीमान राजा सोमाधि था, उस सोमाधि था, उस सोमाधि का पुत्र श्रतश्नवा हुआ-मगधवंशीय राजाओं का वर्णन कर चुका
verses.wordMeaning: When his wife was in the advanced state ofpreg- nancy, it is said that Asija died. Looking at his brother's wife, Bt-haspati said: "O auspicious lady, embellish your body with ornaments and give me (the pleasure of) sexual intercourse
verses.commentary: Sense: When his wife was in the advanced state ofpreg- nancy, it is said that Asija died. Looking at his brother's wife, Bt-haspati said: "O auspicious lady, embellish your body with ornaments and give me (the pleasure of) sexual intercourse

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्वती वसुर्ज्ञाना लम्बा भानुमती सती । संकल्पा च मुहूर्ता च साध्या विश्वावती ककुप्
verses.transliteration: marutvatī vasurjñānā lambā bhānumatī satī / saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvāvatī kakup
verses.translation: You too are one whose semen virile never goes in
verses.hindi: सूत बोले--ऋषिव॒न्द ! परीक्षित का उत्तराधिकारी राजा जनमेजय था। उस राजा जनमभेजय का पुत्र पृथ्वीपति सुरथ हुआ। सुरथ का पुत्र भी भोमसेत नाम से विश्यात हुआ ।२२६। जह. ने भी एक सुरथ नामक पूत्र को उत्पन्न किया था, जो अपने समय में प्रृथ्वीपति था। उस सुरथ का उत्तराधिकारी राजा विदूरथ जन्मा । विदूरथ का पूत्र भी सावंभौम नाम से विख्यात हुआ ।
verses.wordMeaning: You too are one whose semen virile never goes in
verses.commentary: Sense: You too are one whose semen virile never goes in

verses.sanskrit: धर्मपत्न्यो दशैवैता दाक्षायण्यो महाप्रभाः । तासां साध्या महाभागा पुत्रानजनयन् नृप
verses.transliteration: dharmapatnyo daśaivaitā dākṣāyaṇyo mahāprabhāḥ / tāsāṃ sādhyā mahābhāgā putrānajanayan nṛpa
verses.translation: ''You need not at all instruct me in good behaviour". With great delight, he forcibly indulged in sexual intercourse with her.
verses.hindi: दुदमर्ध न विद्यते क. ख. घ. पुस्तके । . विद्रथसुतश्रापि सार्वभौस इति श्रुतिः। सावंभोमाज्जयत्सेन आराधिस्तस्थ चाघत्मज:ः.
verses.wordMeaning: ''You need not at all instruct me in good behaviour". With great delight, he forcibly indulged in sexual intercourse with her.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''You need not at all instruct me in good behaviour". With great delight, he forcibly indulged in sexual intercourse with her.

verses.sanskrit: नरो नारायणश्चैव हरिः कृष्णस्तथैव च । विष्णोरंशांशका ह्येते चत्वारो धर्मसूनवः
verses.transliteration: naro nārāyaṇaścaiva hariḥ kṛṣṇastathaiva ca / viṣṇoraṃśāṃśakā hyete catvāro dharmasūnavaḥ
verses.translation: "O father (uncle) Brhaspati", said the foetus to Brhaspati who was in a state of exhilaration, "I am already embedded here, having come here before.
verses.hindi: देवातियेस्तु दायाद ऋक्ष एवं बभूव ह् । भोमसेनस्तथा ऋक्षाद्विलीपस्तस्य चाउःत्मजः
verses.wordMeaning: "O father (uncle) Brhaspati", said the foetus to Brhaspati who was in a state of exhilaration, "I am already embedded here, having come here before.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O father (uncle) Brhaspati", said the foetus to Brhaspati who was in a state of exhilaration, "I am already embedded here, having come here before.

verses.sanskrit: तथा नारायणनरौ गन्धमादनपर्वते । आत्मन्यात्मानमाधाय तेपतुः परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: tathā nārāyaṇanarau gandhamādanaparvate / ātmanyātmānamādhāya tepatuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: You arc one whose semen virile never goes in vain. There is no space here for two (children)." On being told thus by the child in the womb, the infuriated Brhaspati said again:
verses.hindi: दिलीपसूनुः प्रतिपस्तस्य पुत्रास्त्रयः स्मृताः । देवापिः शंतनुश्चव बाह्लीकश्रेव ते त्रयः देवापिस्तु प्रवव्राजे वन धर्मपरीप्सया  उपाध्यायस्तु देवानां देवापिरभवन्मुनिः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: You arc one whose semen virile never goes in vain. There is no space here for two (children)." On being told thus by the child in the womb, the infuriated Brhaspati said again:
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc one whose semen virile never goes in vain. There is no space here for two (children)." On being told thus by the child in the womb, the infuriated Brhaspati said again:

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायमानावनौपम्यं स्वं कारणमकारणम् । वासुदेवमनिर्देश्यमप्रतर्क्यमनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: dhyāyamānāvanaupamyaṃ svaṃ kāraṇamakāraṇam / vāsudevamanirdeśyamapratarkyamanantaram
verses.translation: "Since you prevent me at such a time as this, desired by all living beings, you will enter a long period of darkness".
verses.hindi: च्यवनोःस्य हि पुत्रस्तु इष्टकश्व महात्मन: । शंतनुस्त्वभवद्राजा बिद्वान्च स महाभिषः
verses.wordMeaning: "Since you prevent me at such a time as this, desired by all living beings, you will enter a long period of darkness".
verses.commentary: Sense: "Since you prevent me at such a time as this, desired by all living beings, you will enter a long period of darkness".

verses.sanskrit: योगयुक्तौ महात्मानावास्थितावुरुतापसौ । तयोस्तपःप्रभावेण न तताप दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: yogayuktau mahātmānāvāsthitāvurutāpasau / tayostapaḥprabhāveṇa na tatāpa divākaraḥ
verses.translation: The (vaginal) passage of his mother was covered with his feet by the child. Tiie semen virile of Brhaspati, being obstructed in between them became an infant.
verses.hindi: इस चोदाहरन्त्यत्र श्लोक प्रति महाभिषम् । य॑ यं राजा स्पृशशति वे जीर्ण समयतो नरमभ् स तुपयेमे धर्मात्मा शंतनुर्जाह्नवों नृपः द
verses.wordMeaning: The (vaginal) passage of his mother was covered with his feet by the child. Tiie semen virile of Brhaspati, being obstructed in between them became an infant.
verses.commentary: Sense: The (vaginal) passage of his mother was covered with his feet by the child. Tiie semen virile of Brhaspati, being obstructed in between them became an infant.

verses.sanskrit: ववाह शङ्कितो वायुः सुखस्पर्शो ह्यशङ्कितः । शिशिरो ऽभवद् अत्यर्थं ज्वलन्नपि विभावसुः
verses.transliteration: vavāha śaṅkito vāyuḥ sukhasparśo hyaśaṅkitaḥ / śiśiro 'bhavad atyarthaṃ jvalannapi vibhāvasuḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the son instantaneously born Mamata said, "O Brhaspati, I am going to my house. Bhara (Nurture), Dvaja (that which is born of two)."
verses.hindi: तस्यां देवब्तं भीष्म पुत्र सोउजनयत्प्रभु:। स च भीष्म इति ख्यातः पाण्डवानां पितामहः ४२४०
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the son instantaneously born Mamata said, "O Brhaspati, I am going to my house. Bhara (Nurture), Dvaja (that which is born of two)."
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the son instantaneously born Mamata said, "O Brhaspati, I am going to my house. Bhara (Nurture), Dvaja (that which is born of two)."

verses.sanskrit: सिंहव्याघ्रादयः सौम्याश्चेरुः सह मृगैर्गिरौ । तयोर् गौर् इव भारार्ता पृथिवी पृथिवीपते
verses.transliteration: siṃhavyāghrādayaḥ saumyāśceruḥ saha mṛgairgirau / tayor gaur iva bhārārtā pṛthivī pṛthivīpate
verses.translation: When she went away after saying this, he (too) for¬ sook the son instantaneously." "Bharasva (Nurture). Dadham (very well)". Since this was said, he came to be known as 'Bharadvaja'.
verses.hindi: .॒ “ ््॒॒ ॒ ॒॒ २ खफा -तहैन..+ल्‍+++ॉल  मो मस्‍िा्ं्॒ै््॒7ह्घभ/7+ै5+7:5 सावभोम से जयत्सेन की उत्पति हुई, जयत्सेन का पुत्र आराधि हुआ  आराधि से महासत्तव को उत्पत्ति हुई, महासत्त्व से अयुतायु ने जन्म धारण किया । अयुतायु का पुत्र राजा अक्रोधन हुआ, उससे राजा देवा तिथि की उत्पत्ति सुनी जातो है ।२३०-२३२। देवातिथि का उत्तराधिकारी राजा ऋल्ष हुआ  ऋक्ष से भीमसेत का जन्म हुआ, उस भीमसेन का पुत्र राजा दिलीप था। दिलीप का पुत्र प्रतिप था, उसके तीन पुत्र कहे
verses.wordMeaning: When she went away after saying this, he (too) for¬ sook the son instantaneously." "Bharasva (Nurture). Dadham (very well)". Since this was said, he came to be known as 'Bharadvaja'.
verses.commentary: Sense: When she went away after saying this, he (too) for¬ sook the son instantaneously." "Bharasva (Nurture). Dadham (very well)". Since this was said, he came to be known as 'Bharadvaja'.

verses.sanskrit: चेरुश्च भूधराश्चैव चुक्षुभे च महोदधिः । देवाश्च स्वेषु धिष्ण्येषु निष्प्रभेषु हतप्रभाः । बभूवुरवनीपाल परमं क्षोभमागताः
verses.transliteration: ceruśca bhūdharāścaiva cukṣubhe ca mahodadhiḥ / devāśca sveṣu dhiṣṇyeṣu niṣprabheṣu hataprabhāḥ / babhūvuravanīpāla paramaṃ kṣobhamāgatāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the infant abandoned by both the mother and the father, the Maruts took away the child Bharadvaja out of mercy.
verses.hindi: जाते हैं। उनके नाम हैं, देवापि, शन्तनु और वाह्लीक  वाह्लीक का पुत्र राजा सप्तवाह्लीशर्वरः को जानना चाहिए; यह महान् यशस्वी सोमदत्त वाह्लीक का पुत्र था। सोमदत्त से भूरि, भूरिश्रवा और छाल नामक पुत्रों की उत्पत्ति हुई ।२३३-२३४। देवापि घ॒र्मतत्त्व के अनुसंधान के लिये वन को चला गया था वहाँ जाकर वह मुनिवेश धारण कर देवताओं का उपाध्याय हुआ  महात्मा देवापि के च्यवन और इष्टक नामक पुत्र हुए, शन्तनु
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the infant abandoned by both the mother and the father, the Maruts took away the child Bharadvaja out of mercy.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the infant abandoned by both the mother and the father, the Maruts took away the child Bharadvaja out of mercy.

verses.sanskrit: देवराजस्तथा शक्रः संतप्तस्तपसा तयोः । युयोजाप्सरसस्तत्र तयोर्विघ्नचिकीर्षया
verses.transliteration: devarājastathā śakraḥ saṃtaptastapasā tayoḥ / yuyojāpsarasastatra tayorvighnacikīrṣayā
verses.translation: At that time Bharata had performed various Yajiias and other Iulmja and JVoimillilca (sacrifices) with the desire for obtaining a son. In spite of those Yajiias, the lord did not obtain any son. Thereafter he performed the A 'land- Soma Yajna for the sake of a son.
verses.hindi: परम विद्वान एवं महाभिष (बहुत बड़े वैद्य) थे, वही राजा हुए। भिषक् शन्तनु के सम्बन्ध में लोग एक इलोक कहा करते हैं, उसका आशय इस प्रकार है, कि जिस-जिस वृद्ध मनुष्य का वह राजा स्पशे करता था, वह पुनः युवा हो जाता था, इसी कारण से उसका नाम झन्तनु कहा जाता हैं। सर्वे साधारण प्रजा में वह शम्तनु नाम से ही विख्यात था उस परम धर्मात्मा राजा शत्तनु ने जाह्न वी के साथ विवाह किया था ।२३६-२३९। परम ऐश्वयेशाली द्ान्‍्तनु ने जाह्नवी में देवव्रत नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न किया, वह देवबन्नत भीष्म नाम से विख्यात हुए, समस्त पाण्डवों के वे पितामह थे । उसी समय राजा झन्‍्तनु की दूसरी पत्नी दासेयी ने
verses.wordMeaning: At that time Bharata had performed various Yajiias and other Iulmja and JVoimillilca (sacrifices) with the desire for obtaining a son. In spite of those Yajiias, the lord did not obtain any son. Thereafter he performed the A 'land- Soma Yajna for the sake of a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time Bharata had performed various Yajiias and other Iulmja and JVoimillilca (sacrifices) with the desire for obtaining a son. In spite of those Yajiias, the lord did not obtain any son. Thereafter he performed the A 'land- Soma Yajna for the sake of a son.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उवाच: रम्भे तिलोत्तमे कुब्जे घृताचि ललिते शुभे । प्रम्लोचे सुभ्रु सुम्लोचे सौरभेयि महोद्धते
verses.transliteration: indra uvāca: rambhe tilottame kubje ghṛtāci lalite śubhe / pramloce subhru sumloce saurabheyi mahoddhate
verses.translation: Being propitiated by that Marut-Soma sacrifice, the Maruts (gave) him Bharadvaja, the intelligent son of Bjrhaspati.
verses.hindi: काले विचित्रवीर्य तु दासेय्यजनयत्सुतम् । शंतनोदंयित थुन्न॑ प्रजाहितकरं प्रभुम् ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Being propitiated by that Marut-Soma sacrifice, the Maruts (gave) him Bharadvaja, the intelligent son of Bjrhaspati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being propitiated by that Marut-Soma sacrifice, the Maruts (gave) him Bharadvaja, the intelligent son of Bjrhaspati.

verses.sanskrit: अलम्बुषे मिश्रकेशि पुण्डरीके वरूथिनि । विलोकनीयं बिभ्राणा वपुर्मन्मथबोधनम्
verses.transliteration: alambuṣe miśrakeśi puṇḍarīke varūthini / vilokanīyaṃ bibhrāṇā vapurmanmathabodhanam
verses.translation: On obtaining that son Bharadvaja, Bharata said: <f O lord, with you as my son, I am satisfied, since all my previous children had been killed".
verses.hindi: कृष्णद् पायनश्रव क्षेत्रे बेचित्रवीर्यके २४१ देददत्ता: सुतास्ताभ्यां पाण्डोरथें विजज्ञिरे । धर्माग्धिष्ठिरो जज्ञे वायोजंजञे वृफोदर:ः २४४ इन्द्राद्धनंजयो जन्ने शक्रतुल्यपराक्तमः । अश्विभ्यां सहदेवश्व नकुलश्रापि माद्रिजों ..
verses.wordMeaning: On obtaining that son Bharadvaja, Bharata said: <f O lord, with you as my son, I am satisfied, since all my previous children had been killed".
verses.commentary: Sense: On obtaining that son Bharadvaja, Bharata said: <f O lord, with you as my son, I am satisfied, since all my previous children had been killed".

verses.sanskrit: गन्धमादनमासाद्य कुरुध्वं वचनं मम । नरनारायणौ तत्र तपोदीक्षान्वितौ द्विजौ
verses.transliteration: gandhamādanamāsādya kurudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama / naranārāyaṇau tatra tapodīkṣānvitau dvijau
verses.translation: The births of his (i.e, Bharata's) previous sons had
verses.hindi: हिडम्बा भीमसेनात्तु जज्ञे पुत्रं घटोत्कचम् । काश्या पुनर्भोमसेनाज्जज्ञ स्बंवक सुतम् २४७ सुहोत्रं विजया माद्री सहदेवादजायत । कमेरत्यां तु वेद्यायां निरमित्रस्तु नाकुलिः २४८ सुभद्रायां रथी पार्थादर्भिमन्युरजायत । उत्तरायां तु वेरादबां परी क्षिदर्भिमन्युजः
verses.wordMeaning: The births of his (i.e, Bharata's) previous sons had
verses.commentary: Sense: The births of his (i.e, Bharata's) previous sons had

verses.sanskrit: तेपाते धर्मतनयौ तपः परमदुश्चरम् । तावस्माकं वरारोहाः कुर्वाणौ परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: tepāte dharmatanayau tapaḥ paramaduścaram / tāvasmākaṃ varārohāḥ kurvāṇau paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: Hence the Divine child Bharadvaja turned into a Ksatiiya from mahinana-hood. He is remembered by the names Dvimuhhydyana (having two important abodes) and Dvipitrka (having two fathers).
verses.hindi: परीक्षितस्तु दायादो राजासीज्जनमेजय:ः । ब्राह्म णानस्थापयामास स वे वाजसनेयिकानू विचित्र वीये नामक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया था, जो परम प्रभावशाली, प्रजा हितंषी एवं शस्तनु को परमप्रिय था। - राजा विचित्रवीय के क्षेत्र (पत्नी) में कृष्णद्व पायन ने धुतराष्ट्र, पाण्ड और विदुर नामक पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया । इनमें धृतराष्ट्र के संयोग से ग्रान्धारी ने सौ पुत्रों को उत्पन्न किया ।२४०-२४२। उन सौ पुत्रों में सबसे ज्येष्ठ पृत्र दुर्योधन था, अपने समय का वह समस्त क्षत्रिय जाति का स्वामी था। पाण्डु की माद्री और पृथा नामक दो
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the Divine child Bharadvaja turned into a Ksatiiya from mahinana-hood. He is remembered by the names Dvimuhhydyana (having two important abodes) and Dvipitrka (having two fathers).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the Divine child Bharadvaja turned into a Ksatiiya from mahinana-hood. He is remembered by the names Dvimuhhydyana (having two important abodes) and Dvipitrka (having two fathers).

verses.sanskrit: कर्मातिशयदुःखार्तिप्रदावायतिनाशनौ । तद्गच्छत न भीः कार्या भवतीभिर् इदं वचः
verses.transliteration: karmātiśayaduḥkhārtipradāvāyatināśanau / tadgacchata na bhīḥ kāryā bhavatībhir idaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Four sons comparable to the Mahabhutas (great elements) were born to Bhuvamanyu. They were Brhatksatra, Mahavlrya, Naraand the powerful Gagra.
verses.hindi: स्त्रियाँ थीं। पाण्ड के लिये विभिन्न देवताओं से दिये गये पुत्र उन दोनों रानियों में उत्पन्न हुए । धर्म से युधिष्ठिर का जन्म हुआ, वायु से वुकोदर भीम की उत्पत्ति हुई, इन्द्र से धनंजय का जन्म हुआ, जो इन्द्र के समान ही पराक्रमशाली था, दोनों अश्विनीकुमारों के संयोग से मांद्री के नकुल और सहदेव नामक दो पुत्र हुए ।२४३-२४५। पाँच पाण्डुओं के संयोग से द्रौपदी में भी पाँच ही पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए । द्रौपदी ने सबसे बड़े पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Four sons comparable to the Mahabhutas (great elements) were born to Bhuvamanyu. They were Brhatksatra, Mahavlrya, Naraand the powerful Gagra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four sons comparable to the Mahabhutas (great elements) were born to Bhuvamanyu. They were Brhatksatra, Mahavlrya, Naraand the powerful Gagra.

verses.sanskrit: स्मरः सहायो भविता वसन्तश्च वराङ्गनाः । रूपं वयः समालोक्य मदनोद्दीपनं परम् । कन्दर्पवशमभ्येति विवशः को न मानवः
verses.transliteration: smaraḥ sahāyo bhavitā vasantaśca varāṅganāḥ / rūpaṃ vayaḥ samālokya madanoddīpanaṃ param / kandarpavaśamabhyeti vivaśaḥ ko na mānavaḥ
verses.translation: ThesonofNara was Samkrti. His sons were very powerful. Guruvlrya and Trideva are remembered as the sons of Samkrti. There were none greater than they.
verses.hindi: प्रतिविन्‍्ध्य को युधिष्ठिर के संयोग से उत्पन्न किया था। हिडम्बा ने भीमसेन के संयोग से घटोत्कव नामक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया था। दूसरी पत्नी काश्या ने भीमसेत से सर्वेवक नामक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया था। मद्र देश की राजकस्या विजया ने सुहोश्र नामक पुत्र को उत्पन्न किया था । चेदिदेश की राजपुत्री कर्मरती ने नकुल से नरमित्र नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न किया था ।२४६-२४८५। पार्थे के संयोग से सुभद्रा में महारथी अभिमस्यु ते जन्म धारण किया था। विराट पुत्री उत्तरा में अभिमन्यु से परीक्षित नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ था । परीक्षित का उत्तराधिकारी राजा जनमेजय था । राजा जनमेजय ने वाजसनेय यज्ञ की प्रतिष्ठा करनेवाले ब्राह्मणों की मर्यावा स्थिर की थी ।२४६-२५०। वंशम्पायन ने उनके इस कार्य को सहन नहीं किया, और अमर्ष में भरकर बोले, दुर्बद्ध !
verses.wordMeaning: ThesonofNara was Samkrti. His sons were very powerful. Guruvlrya and Trideva are remembered as the sons of Samkrti. There were none greater than they.
verses.commentary: Sense: ThesonofNara was Samkrti. His sons were very powerful. Guruvlrya and Trideva are remembered as the sons of Samkrti. There were none greater than they.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: इत्युक्त्वा देवराजेन मदनेन समं तदा । जग्मुरप्सरसः सर्वा वसन्तश्च महीपते
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ityuktvā devarājena madanena samaṃ tadā / jagmurapsarasaḥ sarvā vasantaśca mahīpate
verses.translation: The successors of Gagra were born of Sinibaddha. Therefore the Gagryas (descendants of Gagra) are remembered as Brahmanas with the traits of Ksatriyas.
verses.hindi: नवेनवतितमोश्याय। है४५
verses.wordMeaning: The successors of Gagra were born of Sinibaddha. Therefore the Gagryas (descendants of Gagra) are remembered as Brahmanas with the traits of Ksatriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The successors of Gagra were born of Sinibaddha. Therefore the Gagryas (descendants of Gagra) are remembered as Brahmanas with the traits of Ksatriyas.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धमादनमासाद्य पुंस्कोकिलकुलाकुलम् । चचार माधवो रम्यं प्रोत्फुल्लवनपादपम्
verses.transliteration: gandhamādanamāsādya puṃskokilakulākulam / cacāra mādhavo ramyaṃ protphullavanapādapam
verses.translation: Blilma was the son of Mahavlrya. From him was born Ubhaksaya. His wife Visala gave birth to three sons.
verses.hindi: यावत्स्थास्याम्यहूं लोके तावन्नतत्प्रशस्यते । अभितः संस्थितश्राषि ततः स जनमेजय:ः पौणंमास्थेन हविषा देवमिष्द्वा प्रजापतिम्। घिन्नाय संस्थितो5पश्यत्तद्ठ धीष्टां (त्तदिष्ट) विभोम॑जे ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Blilma was the son of Mahavlrya. From him was born Ubhaksaya. His wife Visala gave birth to three sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Blilma was the son of Mahavlrya. From him was born Ubhaksaya. His wife Visala gave birth to three sons.

verses.sanskrit: प्रववौ दक्षिणाशायां मलयानुगतो ऽनिलः । भृङ्गमालारुतरवै रमणीयमभूद्वनम्
verses.transliteration: pravavau dakṣiṇāśāyāṃ malayānugato 'nilaḥ / bhṛṅgamālārutaravai ramaṇīyamabhūdvanam
verses.translation: She gave birth to Trayvaruni, Puskarin and the third son Kapi. Kapi's descendants were excellent Ksatriyas and those of the other two arc said to be great sages.
verses.hindi: तस्य पुत्र: शतानोको बलवान्प्त्यविक्रमः  ततः सुतं शतानीक॑ विप्रास्तमभ्यवंचयन्
verses.wordMeaning: She gave birth to Trayvaruni, Puskarin and the third son Kapi. Kapi's descendants were excellent Ksatriyas and those of the other two arc said to be great sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: She gave birth to Trayvaruni, Puskarin and the third son Kapi. Kapi's descendants were excellent Ksatriyas and those of the other two arc said to be great sages.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धश्च सुरभिः सद्यो वनराजिसमुद्भवः । किन्नरोरगयक्षाणां बभूव घ्राणतर्पणः
verses.transliteration: gandhaśca surabhiḥ sadyo vanarājisamudbhavaḥ / kinnaroragayakṣāṇāṃ babhūva ghrāṇatarpaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Brhatksatra's successor was a pious one named Suhotra. Suhotra's successor was one named Hastin. Formerly this city named Hastinapura was built by him.
verses.hindi: अधिसामकछृष्णो धर्मात्मा सांप्रतोष्य महायशाः । यस्मिन्प्रशासति महीं युष्भाभिरिदमाहुतम् तुम्हारी यह मर्यादा पृथ्वी पर स्थिर न रह सकेगी, जब तक मैं नीवित हूँ, तब तक तो उसकों प्रशंसा नहीं हो सकती । चारों ओर स्रे संकटापन्न होकर जनमेजय ने पोणमास नामक यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान किया, और उसमें प्रजापति देव को हृवि देकर सन्तुष्ट किया, मखर में सर्वव्वयंशाली प्रजापत्नि के निमित्त यज्ञ करने पर भी उनकी स्थिति वेसी ही रहौ । यह देखकर पुनः पुरुवंशी परोक्षितपुत्र राजा जनमेजय ने दो अद्यमेध यज्ञों का अनुष्ठान
verses.wordMeaning: Brhatksatra's successor was a pious one named Suhotra. Suhotra's successor was one named Hastin. Formerly this city named Hastinapura was built by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhatksatra's successor was a pious one named Suhotra. Suhotra's successor was one named Hastin. Formerly this city named Hastinapura was built by him.

verses.sanskrit: वराङ्गनाश्च ताः सर्वा नरनारायणावृषी । विलोभयितुम् आरब्धा वागङ्गललितस्मितैः
verses.transliteration: varāṅganāśca tāḥ sarvā naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī / vilobhayitum ārabdhā vāgaṅgalalitasmitaiḥ
verses.translation: II as tin's successor were three, viz. Ajamidha, Dvimldha and Purunildha. They were all extremely devout and pious. 1
verses.hindi: किया, ओर उसमें अपने द्वारा प्रतिष्ठित वाजसेतय का प्रवर्तन किया, इसमें उन्हें तीन स्थानों पर पराजित होना पड़ा ।२५१५२४४। सर्वप्रथम अद्वक म्रुरुषों के यहाँ, फिर अद्भ देशवासियों के यहाँ फिर मध्यदेश निवासियों के यहाँ--इस प्रकार जनमेजय को तीन बार पराजित होना पड़ा । इससे उसे बड़ा विषांद हुआ फलस्वरूप ब्राह्मणों के साथ मिनन्‍दा का पात्र होकर वह विनाश को प्राप्त हुआ ।३५४। राजा जनमेजय का पुत्र शतानीक था,
verses.wordMeaning: II as tin's successor were three, viz. Ajamidha, Dvimldha and Purunildha. They were all extremely devout and pious. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: II as tin's successor were three, viz. Ajamidha, Dvimldha and Purunildha. They were all extremely devout and pious. 1

verses.sanskrit: जगौ मनोहरं काचिन्ननर्त तत्र चाप्सराः । अवादयत् तथैवान्या मनोहरतरं नृप
verses.transliteration: jagau manoharaṃ kācinnanarta tatra cāpsarāḥ / avādayat tathaivānyā manoharataraṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: Ajamidha's sons were splendid. They perpetua¬ ted the auspicious line. They were very pious. They were
verses.hindi: जो परम बलशाली, सत्यवादी तथा विक्रमी था । ब्राह्मणों ने जनमेजय की यृत्यु के बाद उसके स्थान पर शतानीक का अभिषेक किया  शतानौक का पुत्र परम बलशाली अश्वमेघदत्त हुआ  अदइवमेदत्त से शत्रुओं के दुर्गो को जीतनेवाले अधिसामकष्ण नामक पुत्र की उत्पत्ति हुईै। ऋषिवुत्द ! यही परम धर्मात्मा राजा सम्प्रति राज्य कर रहा है । उसी के राज्यकाल में आप लोगों ने इस परम दुलंभ तीन वर्ष चलनेवाले दीघंसत्र का अनुष्ठान प्रारंभ किया है, इसके अतिरिक्त दुषढद्वती के तट प्रान्त पर कुरुश्नेत्र में भी दो वर्ष व्यपी एक दीघंसत्र चल रहा है
verses.wordMeaning: Ajamidha's sons were splendid. They perpetua¬ ted the auspicious line. They were very pious. They were
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajamidha's sons were splendid. They perpetua¬ ted the auspicious line. They were very pious. They were

verses.sanskrit: हावैर्भावैः सृतैर्हास्यैस् तथान्या वल्गुभाषितैः । तयोः क्षोभाय तन्वङ्ग्यश्चक्रुरुद्यममङ्गनाः
verses.transliteration: hāvairbhāvaiḥ sṛtairhāsyais tathānyā valgubhāṣitaiḥ / tayoḥ kṣobhāya tanvaṅgyaścakrurudyamamaṅganāḥ
verses.translation: The following additional verse numbered 167 in A, is translated as follows:
verses.hindi: एतच्चिन्वान्तगंतग्रन्थः लव पुस्तक नास्ति । ++ अन्नाध्यायसमाप्तिद इयतै क्ष पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: The following additional verse numbered 167 in A, is translated as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: The following additional verse numbered 167 in A, is translated as follows:

verses.sanskrit: तथापि न तयोः कश्चिन्मनसः पृथिवीपते । विकारो ऽभवदध्यात्मपारसम्प्राप्तचेतसोः
verses.transliteration: tathāpi na tayoḥ kaścinmanasaḥ pṛthivīpate / vikāro 'bhavadadhyātmapārasamprāptacetasoḥ
verses.translation: Medhatithi was his son and from him were born the Brahmanas called Kanthayanas. King Brhadvasu was born to Ajamidha and (his second wife) Dhumini.
verses.hindi: काल युगप्रमाणं च गुणदीषान्भविष्पतः । सुखदुःखे प्रजानां च धर्मंतः कामतोथंतः २६२ एतत्सवं प्रसंस्थाय पृच्छतां ब्र॒हि तत्वतः। स एवमुक्तो मुनिश्िः सुतो बुद्धिमतां बरः ॥ आचचक्षे यथावृत्तं यथादुष्टं यथाश्रुतम् यथा मे फोतितं सर्व व्यासेनादुभुतकर्ंणा । भाष्यं कलियुग चेच तथा मन्वन्तराणि तु २६४
verses.wordMeaning: Medhatithi was his son and from him were born the Brahmanas called Kanthayanas. King Brhadvasu was born to Ajamidha and (his second wife) Dhumini.
verses.commentary: Sense: Medhatithi was his son and from him were born the Brahmanas called Kanthayanas. King Brhadvasu was born to Ajamidha and (his second wife) Dhumini.

verses.sanskrit: निवातस्थौ यथा दीपावकम्पौ नृप तिष्ठतः । वासुदेवार्पणस्वस्थे तथैव मनसी तयोः
verses.transliteration: nivātasthau yathā dīpāvakampau nṛpa tiṣṭhataḥ / vāsudevārpaṇasvasthe tathaiva manasī tayoḥ
verses.translation: Brhadvasu's son was Brhadvisnu who was very strong. His son was Brhatkarma whose son was Brhadratha.
verses.hindi: तान्सर्वान्‍्कीतंयिष्पासि भविष्ये पठितान्नपान् । तेभ्यः परे च ये चाम्ये उत्पत्स्यन्ते महीक्षित:
verses.wordMeaning: Brhadvasu's son was Brhadvisnu who was very strong. His son was Brhatkarma whose son was Brhadratha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhadvasu's son was Brhadvisnu who was very strong. His son was Brhatkarma whose son was Brhadratha.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्यमाणो ऽपि चाम्भोभिर्भुवमन्यां महोदधिः । यथा न याति संक्षोभं तथा तन्मानसं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: pūryamāṇo 'pi cāmbhobhirbhuvamanyāṃ mahodadhiḥ / yathā na yāti saṃkṣobhaṃ tathā tanmānasaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: His son was Visvajit, whose son was Senajit. The four sons of Senajit were well known in the world.
verses.hindi: क्षत्त्रा: पारशवाः शुद्रास्तथा ये व द्विजातयः । अन्ध्रा: शकाः पुलिन्दाश्र तुलिका पवनेः सह ऋषिगण बोले--महामति सूत जी! आप भूतकालीन राजाओं का वर्णन तो कर चुके, अब हम लोग भविष्य में उत्पन्न होनेवाले राजाओं के साथ उनकी प्रजाओं का वर्णन सुनना चाहते हैं। भविष्य में उत्पन्न होकर वे लोग जिन नवीन विधाओं का प्रवरतंन करेंगे, उनके जो नाम होंगे, उन्हें उनके हासन काल की मणना के साथ बतलाइये। उस समय से उत्पन्न होनेवाली प्रजाओं के सुख दुःख, गुण
verses.wordMeaning: His son was Visvajit, whose son was Senajit. The four sons of Senajit were well known in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was Visvajit, whose son was Senajit. The four sons of Senajit were well known in the world.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतहितं ब्रह्म वासुदेवमयं परम् । मन्यमानौ न रागस्य द्वेषस्य च वशंगतौ
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtahitaṃ brahma vāsudevamayaṃ param / manyamānau na rāgasya dveṣasya ca vaśaṃgatau
verses.translation: They were Rucirasva, Kavya, Rama of steady bow and Vatsa, the king of Avant! from whom the Parivatscira (era started).
verses.hindi: दोष, युगप्रमाण उतके धर्माथ काम सम्बन्धी विचारों को हम लोग सुनना चाहते हैं, यथा्थंतः बतलाइये । मुनियों द्वास इस प्रकार पूछे जाने पर बुद्धिमानों में श्रेष्ठ सूत जी ने इन प्रश्नों के विषय में जेसा कुछ देखा था, जेसा सुना था, कहना प्रारम्भ किया
verses.wordMeaning: They were Rucirasva, Kavya, Rama of steady bow and Vatsa, the king of Avant! from whom the Parivatscira (era started).
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Rucirasva, Kavya, Rama of steady bow and Vatsa, the king of Avant! from whom the Parivatscira (era started).

verses.sanskrit: स्मरो ऽपि न शशाकाथ प्रवेष्टुं हृदयं तयोः । विद्यामयं दीपयुतमन्धकार इवालयम्
verses.transliteration: smaro 'pi na śaśākātha praveṣṭuṃ hṛdayaṃ tayoḥ / vidyāmayaṃ dīpayutamandhakāra ivālayam
verses.translation: Paicirasva's successor was Prtlmscna of great fame. Para was the son of Pythusena and Nipa was born of Para.
