verses.hindi: सूत बोले--ऋषिवृन्द ! अद्भुत कर्म शील व्यास जी ने इस विषय में मुझसे जो कुछ बतलावा है, उसे मैं बतला रहा हूँ  भविष्य में जिस प्रकार कलियुग आयेगा, जितने मन्वन्तर होंगे, जितने राजा लोग उत्पन्न होंगे, मैं उन सब का वर्णन अब कर रहा हूं ।३६४-२६४५। उन्त ऐल वंशीय, इक््वाकु बंशीय तथा सौधुम्नवंशीय राजाओं का वर्णन करूँगा, जिसके वंशजों पर इन सर्वकल्याणकारी इश्ष्बाकुवंक्षियों का एक मात्र प्रभाव होगा  भविष्य में कहे जानेवाले समस्त राजओं का वर्णन करूँगा, अन्य सामास्य राजा लोग भी उत्पन्न होंगे उन्हें भी बतलाऊंगा । उन सब के अतिरिक्त क्षत्र, पारशव, छुद्ठ, अस्यात्य द्विजातिवर्य, अन्न्र, शक, पुलिन्द, तूलिका यवन, कवर, जाभीर, शबर प्रभृति अभ्यान्य स्लेच्छ जातियों का वर्णव भी कडूंगा,
verses.wordMeaning: Paicirasva's successor was Prtlmscna of great fame. Para was the son of Pythusena and Nipa was born of Para.
verses.commentary: Sense: Paicirasva's successor was Prtlmscna of great fame. Para was the son of Pythusena and Nipa was born of Para.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पोज्ज्वलांस् तरुवरान् वसन्तं दक्षिणानिलम् । ताश्चैवाप्सरसः सर्वाः कन्दर्पं च महामुनी
verses.transliteration: puṣpojjvalāṃs taruvarān vasantaṃ dakṣiṇānilam / tāścaivāpsarasaḥ sarvāḥ kandarpaṃ ca mahāmunī
verses.translation: We have heard that a hundred sons were horn to Nipa. They are called 'Nlpas'. All of them were kings.
verses.hindi: सुखोबलसुतश्रापि भाव्यो राजा परिष्लुतः । परिष्लुसुतभ्रापि भविता सुनयो नृपः
verses.wordMeaning: We have heard that a hundred sons were horn to Nipa. They are called 'Nlpas'. All of them were kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: We have heard that a hundred sons were horn to Nipa. They are called 'Nlpas'. All of them were kings.

verses.sanskrit: यच्चारब्धं तपस्ताभ्यामात्मानं गन्धमादनम् । ददर्शाते ऽखिलं रूपं ब्रह्मणः पुरुषर्षभ
verses.transliteration: yaccārabdhaṃ tapastābhyāmātmānaṃ gandhamādanam / dadarśāte 'khilaṃ rūpaṃ brahmaṇaḥ puruṣarṣabha
verses.translation: The most glorious king among them who raised the fame of the race and stabilised the race was Samara with his capital in Kathpilya. He was fond of war.
verses.hindi: दण्डपाणेनिरामित्रो निरामित्राच्च क्षेमकः । पश्चविशनपा होते भविष्याः पूर्ववंशनाः .. अन्नानुवंशश्ोकफो5यं गौतो विध्रे: पुराविद: । ब्रह्मक्षस्त्रस्यथ यो योनिवंशो देवषिसत्कृतः
verses.wordMeaning: The most glorious king among them who raised the fame of the race and stabilised the race was Samara with his capital in Kathpilya. He was fond of war.
verses.commentary: Sense: The most glorious king among them who raised the fame of the race and stabilised the race was Samara with his capital in Kathpilya. He was fond of war.

verses.sanskrit: दाहाय नामलो वह्नेर्नापः क्लेदाय चाम्भसः । तद्द्रव्यमेव तद्द्रव्यविकाराय न वै यतः
verses.transliteration: dāhāya nāmalo vahnernāpaḥ kledāya cāmbhasaḥ / taddravyameva taddravyavikārāya na vai yataḥ
verses.translation: Samara had three sons endowed with all good qualities. They were Para, Para and Sattvadasva. Para's son Vrsu shone well.
verses.hindi: तथा उस समय में जो राजा लोग होंगे, उनके नाम एवं शासनकाल का भी वर्णन करूँगा ।२६६-२६६। सम्श्रति अधिसामकृष्ण तामक राजा राज्य कर रहा है, उसकी उत्पत्ति विख्यात पौरव वंश से है, उसके वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले भविष्यत्कालीन राजाओं का वर्णन सर्वप्रथम कर रहा हूँ । इस राजा अधिसामक्ृष्ण का पुत्र) निबंक्त्र होना, गंगा द्वारा हस्तिनापुर (?) के डुबा देने पर वह उसे छोड़ कर अपनी राजघानी कौशाम्बी में बनायेमा,
verses.wordMeaning: Samara had three sons endowed with all good qualities. They were Para, Para and Sattvadasva. Para's son Vrsu shone well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Samara had three sons endowed with all good qualities. They were Para, Para and Sattvadasva. Para's son Vrsu shone well.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विज्ञाय विज्ञाय परं ब्रह्म स्वरूपतः । मधुकन्दर्पयोषित्सु विकारो नाभवत्तयोः
verses.transliteration: tato vijñāya vijñāya paraṃ brahma svarūpataḥ / madhukandarpayoṣitsu vikāro nābhavattayoḥ
verses.translation: A son named Sukrii endowed with all good qualities was born to Vrsu, thanks to his meritorious activities. Vibhraja was his son.
verses.hindi: और वहीं पर निवास करेगा ।२७०-२७१। राजा निव॑क्त्र को उष्णनामक एक पुत्र होगा। उष्ण से चित्ररथ नामक पुत्र की उत्पत्ति होगी । चित्रर॒थ से शुचिद्रथ की उत्पत्ति होगी  शुचिद्रथ से परम धंयंशाली, महान् यश्नस्वी एवं बलशाली सुषेण की उत्पत्ति होगी । उस राजा सुषेण से सुतीयं नामक राजा का जन्म होगा । सुतीर्थ से रुच होगा, रुच से त्रिचक्ष होगा, त्रिचक्ष का उत्तराधिकारी राजा सुखोबल होगा ।२७२-२७४। सुखीबल का पुत्र राजा परिष्लुत होगा, परिष्लुत का पुत्र राजा सुनय होगा । सुनय का पुत्र नरपति मेधावी होगा, मेधावी का पूत्र दण्डपाणि होगा । दण्डपाणि से निरामित्र और निरामित्र से क्षेमक होगा । ये पच्चीस नृपतिगण भविष्यत्काल में इस वंश में उत्पन्न होंगे (२७४-२७७। प्राचीन कथाओं के जाननेवाले ब्राह्मण लोग इस वंश के विषय में एक इलोक का गान करते हैं । उसका तत्पयं बतला रहा हूँ, जो वेश ब्राह्मणों एवं क्षत्रियों का उत्पत्ति-स्थान
verses.wordMeaning: A son named Sukrii endowed with all good qualities was born to Vrsu, thanks to his meritorious activities. Vibhraja was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: A son named Sukrii endowed with all good qualities was born to Vrsu, thanks to his meritorious activities. Vibhraja was his son.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गुरुतरं यत्नं वसन्तमदनौ नृप । चक्राते ताश्च तन्वङ्ग्यस्तत्क्षोभाय पुनःपुनः
verses.transliteration: tato gurutaraṃ yatnaṃ vasantamadanau nṛpa / cakrāte tāśca tanvaṅgyastatkṣobhāya punaḥpunaḥ
verses.translation: Vibhraja's successor was the king named Anuha who was very famous. He was the husband ofRcI and so the son-in- law of $uka.
verses.hindi: था, जिस वंद् का देवता तथा ऋषिगण सत्कार करते थे, वह फपौरववंश कलियुग में क्षेमक नामक राजा के बाद
verses.wordMeaning: Vibhraja's successor was the king named Anuha who was very famous. He was the husband ofRcI and so the son-in- law of $uka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vibhraja's successor was the king named Anuha who was very famous. He was the husband ofRcI and so the son-in- law of $uka.

verses.sanskrit: अथ नारायणो धैर्यं संधायोदीर्णमानसः । ऊरोरुत्पादयामास वराङ्गीमबलां तदा
verses.transliteration: atha nārāyaṇo dhairyaṃ saṃdhāyodīrṇamānasaḥ / ūrorutpādayāmāsa varāṅgīmabalāṃ tadā
verses.translation: Anuha s successor was Brahmadatta of great penance. "Vogasunu was his son and his son Visvaksena became a king.
verses.hindi: १. मत्स्यपुराण में इनका नाम विवक्षु रखा गया है । हैश्ष बायुपुराणभ ह ॥॒
verses.wordMeaning: Anuha s successor was Brahmadatta of great penance. "Vogasunu was his son and his son Visvaksena became a king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Anuha s successor was Brahmadatta of great penance. "Vogasunu was his son and his son Visvaksena became a king.

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरीरत्नम् अशेषम् अवनीपते । गुणैर्लाघवमभ्येति यस्याः संदर्शनादनु
verses.transliteration: trailokyasundarīratnam aśeṣam avanīpate / guṇairlāghavamabhyeti yasyāḥ saṃdarśanādanu
verses.translation: Vibhraja's sons became kings, thanks to their merito¬ rious activities. Visvaksena's son was Udaksena.
verses.hindi: क्षेमक प्राप्य राजान संस्थां प्राप्स्यति वे कलो । इत्येष पौरवो वंशों यथावदनुकीतितः
verses.wordMeaning: Vibhraja's sons became kings, thanks to their merito¬ rious activities. Visvaksena's son was Udaksena.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vibhraja's sons became kings, thanks to their merito¬ rious activities. Visvaksena's son was Udaksena.

verses.sanskrit: तां विलोक्य महीपाल चकम्पे मनसानिलः । वसन्तो विस्मयं यातः स्मरः सस्मार किंचन
verses.transliteration: tāṃ vilokya mahīpāla cakampe manasānilaḥ / vasanto vismayaṃ yātaḥ smaraḥ sasmāra kiṃcana
verses.translation: Whose son was Ugrayudha? In which family was he born and glorified? What for were all the Nipas destroyed by him?
verses.hindi: बहुद्रथस्य दायादो बीरो राजा बुह॒त्क्षयः । ततः क्षयः सुतस्तस्य वत्सव्यूहस्ततः क्षयात्ु.. ॥रघ१ वत्सव्यूहात्प्रतिव्यूहस्तस्य पुत्रों दिवाकरः । यश्न सांप्रतमध्यास्ते अयोध्यां नगरीं नृपः २८२ दिवाकरस्य भविता सहदेवों सहायशाः । सहदेवस्य दायादो बह॒दश्चो भविष्यति ॥रबरे सहदेवः सुतस्तस्य सुनक्षत्रश्च तत्सुतः
verses.wordMeaning: Whose son was Ugrayudha? In which family was he born and glorified? What for were all the Nipas destroyed by him?
verses.commentary: Sense: Whose son was Ugrayudha? In which family was he born and glorified? What for were all the Nipas destroyed by him?

verses.sanskrit: रम्भातिलोत्तमाद्याश्च वैलक्ष्यं देवयोषितः । न रेजुरवनीपाल तल्लक्ष्यहृदयेक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: rambhātilottamādyāśca vailakṣyaṃ devayoṣitaḥ / na rejuravanīpāla tallakṣyahṛdayekṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: The scholarly Yavinara was the son and succes¬ sor of DvimJdha. Dhrtiman was his son. His son was Satya- dhrti. Satyadhrti's son was the valorous Drdhanemi. The king named Suvarma was Drclhanemi's son.
verses.hindi: अस्तरिक्षात्सुपर्णस्तु सुपर्णाच्चाप्यमित्रजित् । पुत्रस्तस्य भरद्वाणों धर्मी तस्य सुतः स्मृतः..
verses.wordMeaning: The scholarly Yavinara was the son and succes¬ sor of DvimJdha. Dhrtiman was his son. His son was Satya- dhrti. Satyadhrti's son was the valorous Drdhanemi. The king named Suvarma was Drclhanemi's son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The scholarly Yavinara was the son and succes¬ sor of DvimJdha. Dhrtiman was his son. His son was Satya- dhrti. Satyadhrti's son was the valorous Drdhanemi. The king named Suvarma was Drclhanemi's son.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कामो वसन्तश्च पार्थिवाप्सरसश्च ताः । प्रणम्य भगवन्तौ तौ तुष्टुवुर् मुनिसत्तमौ
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāmo vasantaśca pārthivāpsarasaśca tāḥ / praṇamya bhagavantau tau tuṣṭuvur munisattamau
verses.translation: The valorous Sarvabhauma (lord of the entire earth) was Suvarma's son. He shone as the sole lord of the earth and he became famous as Sarvabhauma.
verses.hindi: पुत्र: कृतंजयों नाम धर्मिण: स भविष्यति । कृतंजयसुतो ब्रातो तस्य पुष्रो रणंजयः भविता संजयश्चापि बोरो राजा रणंजयात्  संजयस्य सुतः शाक्यः शाक्याच्छुद्धोदनो3भवत्
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous Sarvabhauma (lord of the entire earth) was Suvarma's son. He shone as the sole lord of the earth and he became famous as Sarvabhauma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous Sarvabhauma (lord of the entire earth) was Suvarma's son. He shone as the sole lord of the earth and he became famous as Sarvabhauma.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्तकामाप्सरस ऊचुः । प्रसीदतु जगद्धाता यस्य देवस्य मायया । मोहिताः स्म विजानीमो नान्तरं विद्यते द्वयोः
verses.transliteration: vasantakāmāpsarasa ūcuḥ / prasīdatu jagaddhātā yasya devasya māyayā / mohitāḥ sma vijānīmo nāntaraṃ vidyate dvayoḥ
verses.translation: In his great family was born (a king named) Mahat- pauravanandana. King Rukmaratha is remembered as the son of Mahatpaurava.
verses.hindi: शुद्धोदनस्प भविया शाक्यार्ें राहुल: स्मृतः । प्रसैनजित्ततो भाव्यः क्षुद्रकों भविता ततः
verses.wordMeaning: In his great family was born (a king named) Mahat- pauravanandana. King Rukmaratha is remembered as the son of Mahatpaurava.
verses.commentary: Sense: In his great family was born (a king named) Mahat- pauravanandana. King Rukmaratha is remembered as the son of Mahatpaurava.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीदतु स वां देवो यस्य रूपमिदं द्विधा । धामभूतस्य लोकानाम् अनादेर् अप्रतिष्ठतः
verses.transliteration: prasīdatu sa vāṃ devo yasya rūpamidaṃ dvidhā / dhāmabhūtasya lokānām anāder apratiṣṭhataḥ
verses.translation: Rukmaratha's son was the king named Suparsva. Suparsva's son named Sumati was very virtuous.
verses.hindi: समाप्त हो जायेगा । पौरवबंश का वत्तास्त, ज॑ंसा कुछ कहा जाता है आप लोगों को बतला चुका पाण्ड्पुत्र महान् बलशाली अर्जन का विख्यात पौरववबंश समाप्त हो गया  अब इसके उपरान्त महानूबलशाली इध्ष्वाकुबंशी राजाओं का वर्णन कर रहा हूँ । बुहद्रथ का उत्तराधिकारी वीर राजा बुृह॒त्क्षय था। उसका पूत्र क्षय हुआ, क्षय से वत्सव्यूह नामक पुत्र की उत्पत्ति हुई, वत्सव्यूह से प्रतिव्यूह नामक पुश्र की उत्पत्ति. हुई, उसका पुन्र दिवाकर हुआ । यह राजा दिवाकर सम्प्रति अयोध्या नगरी का राजा है
verses.wordMeaning: Rukmaratha's son was the king named Suparsva. Suparsva's son named Sumati was very virtuous.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rukmaratha's son was the king named Suparsva. Suparsva's son named Sumati was very virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: नरनारायणौ देवौ शङ्खचक्रायुधावुभौ । आस्तां प्रसादसुमुखावस्माकमपराधिनाम्
verses.transliteration: naranārāyaṇau devau śaṅkhacakrāyudhāvubhau / āstāṃ prasādasumukhāvasmākamaparādhinām
verses.translation: The son of Sumati was lord Sannatiman, the right- eous-souled king. His son was named Sanati and Krta was his
verses.hindi: २८२। दिवाकर पुत्र महान यशस्वी सहदेव होगा, सहदेव का उत्तराधिकारी बुंहददव होगा। बहुददव का पुत्र भानुरथ होगा। उसका पुत्र प्रतीताश्व होगा। प्रतीताश्व का पुत्र सुप्रतीत होगा। सुप्रतीत का पुत्र सहदेव होगा, उसका पुत्र सुनक्षत्र होगा। सुनक्षत्र से परम तपस्वी किन्नर नामक पुत्र होगा। किन्नर का पुत्र अन्तरिक्ष अपने, समय का महान् राजा होगा ।२८३-२८५। अन्तरिक्ष से सुपर्ण और सुपर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Sumati was lord Sannatiman, the right- eous-souled king. His son was named Sanati and Krta was his
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Sumati was lord Sannatiman, the right- eous-souled king. His son was named Sanati and Krta was his

verses.sanskrit: निधानं सर्वविद्यानां सर्वपापवनानलः । नारायणो ऽतो भगवान् सर्वपापं व्यपोहतु
verses.transliteration: nidhānaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ sarvapāpavanānalaḥ / nārāyaṇo 'to bhagavān sarvapāpaṃ vyapohatu
verses.translation: He was a disciple of the noble-souled Hiranyanabhi of the Kauthuma branch (of Samavedic study). Twenty four Saman-Sariihitas were expounded by him.
verses.hindi: से अमित्रज्ञित नामक पुत्र होगा। अमित्रजित् का पुत्र भरहाज होगा, उसका पुत्र धर्मी नाम से स्मरण किया जायगा । धर्मी का पुत्र कृतञ्जय होगा, कृतञ्जय का पुत्र ब्रात और ब्रात का पुत्र रणज्जय होगा। रणञ्जय से परम वीर पुत्र सञ्जय की उत्पत्ति होगी । सञ्जय का पुत्र शाकय और शाकक्‍्य से शुद्धोदन नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न होगा ।२८६-२८०। श्वाक्यवंश - में !शुद्धोदतत का पुत्र राहुल होगा। राहुल से प्रसेनजित् और प्रसेनजित से क्षद्र नामक पत्र होगा । क्षद्रक के क्षलिक और क्षूलिक से सुरथ नामक पत्र उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: He was a disciple of the noble-souled Hiranyanabhi of the Kauthuma branch (of Samavedic study). Twenty four Saman-Sariihitas were expounded by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was a disciple of the noble-souled Hiranyanabhi of the Kauthuma branch (of Samavedic study). Twenty four Saman-Sariihitas were expounded by him.

verses.sanskrit: शार्ङ्गचिह्नायुधः श्रीमानात्मज्ञानमयो ऽनघः । नरः समस्तपापानि हतात्मा सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: śārṅgacihnāyudhaḥ śrīmānātmajñānamayo 'naghaḥ / naraḥ samastapāpāni hatātmā sarvadehinām
verses.translation: The sons of Krta, the singers of Saman hymns, are re¬ membered by the name 'Pracyas' (Easterners). The heroic Ugrayudha was one of the sons of Krta. He was the scion of the family of Puru..
verses.hindi: नवनवतितमोधष्ण्याय। द हैएट॑
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Krta, the singers of Saman hymns, are re¬ membered by the name 'Pracyas' (Easterners). The heroic Ugrayudha was one of the sons of Krta. He was the scion of the family of Puru..
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Krta, the singers of Saman hymns, are re¬ membered by the name 'Pracyas' (Easterners). The heroic Ugrayudha was one of the sons of Krta. He was the scion of the family of Puru..

verses.sanskrit: जटाकलापबद्धो ऽयमनयोर् नः क्षमावतोः । सौम्यास्यदृष्टिः पापानि हन्तुं जन्मार्जितानि वै
verses.transliteration: jaṭākalāpabaddho 'yamanayor naḥ kṣamāvatoḥ / saumyāsyadṛṣṭiḥ pāpāni hantuṃ janmārjitāni vai
verses.translation: The mighty-armed lord of Paiicalas named Nila, who was the grandfather of Prsata, was killed by him (Ugrayudha) (and thereby) he exhibited his valour.
verses.hindi: क्षुद्रकात्कुलिको भाग्य: क्षुलिकात्सुरथः स्पृतः । सुमिन्रः सुरथस्थापि अन्त्यश्न भवति नपः एत ऐक्ष्वाकवा: प्रोक्ता भवितारः कलो युगे । बृहद्बलान्वये जाता भवितारः कलो युगे ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The mighty-armed lord of Paiicalas named Nila, who was the grandfather of Prsata, was killed by him (Ugrayudha) (and thereby) he exhibited his valour.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mighty-armed lord of Paiicalas named Nila, who was the grandfather of Prsata, was killed by him (Ugrayudha) (and thereby) he exhibited his valour.

verses.sanskrit: तथात्मविद्यादोषेण यो ऽपराधः कृतो महान् । त्रैलोक्यवन्द्यौ यौ नाथौ विलोभयितुम् आगताः
verses.transliteration: tathātmavidyādoṣeṇa yo 'parādhaḥ kṛto mahān / trailokyavandyau yau nāthau vilobhayitum āgatāḥ
verses.translation: Ugrayudha's son (successor) was a very famous king named Ksema. Suvira was born of Ksema. Suvira's son was Nrpanjaya. Viraratha was born of Nrpanjaya. Thus these are remembered as Pauravas (descendants of Puru).
verses.hindi: अन्नानुवंशश्लोकोयं भविष्यज्ञेरदाहुतः । इक्ष्वाकृणामयं वंशः सुमित्रान्तो भविष्यति (२९२ सुमित्रं प्राप्य राजानं संस्थां प्राप्स्यति वे कलौ  इत्येतन्मानवं क्षत्रमैलं च समुवाहतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Ugrayudha's son (successor) was a very famous king named Ksema. Suvira was born of Ksema. Suvira's son was Nrpanjaya. Viraratha was born of Nrpanjaya. Thus these are remembered as Pauravas (descendants of Puru).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ugrayudha's son (successor) was a very famous king named Ksema. Suvira was born of Ksema. Suvira's son was Nrpanjaya. Viraratha was born of Nrpanjaya. Thus these are remembered as Pauravas (descendants of Puru).

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद देव विज्ञानधन मूढदृशामिव । भवन्ति सन्तः सततं स्वधर्मपरिपालकाः
verses.transliteration: prasīda deva vijñānadhana mūḍhadṛśāmiva / bhavanti santaḥ satataṃ svadharmaparipālakāḥ
verses.translation: Purujanu was the son of Susanti. Riksa was born of Purujanu. The following were the sons and successors of Riksa.
verses.hindi: अत ऊध्वें प्रवक््यासि सागधेयान्वृह॒द्रथान् । जरासंधस्य ये बंशे सहदेवान्वये नृपाः २६४ पश्चाशत तथा5ष्टो व समा राज्यमकारयत्। श्रुतश्रवाश्यतुःषष्टिसमास्तस्थ सुतो5भवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Purujanu was the son of Susanti. Riksa was born of Purujanu. The following were the sons and successors of Riksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purujanu was the son of Susanti. Riksa was born of Purujanu. The following were the sons and successors of Riksa.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैतन्नः समुत्पन्नं यथा स्त्रीरत्नमुत्तमम् । त्वयि नारायणोत्पन्ना श्रेष्ठा पारवती मतिः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvaitannaḥ samutpannaṃ yathā strīratnamuttamam / tvayi nārāyaṇotpannā śreṣṭhā pāravatī matiḥ
verses.translation: They were: Mudgala, Srrljaya, the king Brhadisu, Vikranta who was younger to him and Karnpilya, the fifth.
verses.hindi: अयुतायुस्तु षड्विशं राज्मं वर्षाण्यकारयत् । समाः शत निरामित्रों महीं भुक्तवा दिवं गतः ॥२€८ पञ्चाशतं समा: षद् थ॒ सुकृत्तः प्राप्तवान्महीम् । त्रयोविशं बुहत्कर्मा राज्य वर्षाण्यकारयत्
verses.wordMeaning: They were: Mudgala, Srrljaya, the king Brhadisu, Vikranta who was younger to him and Karnpilya, the fifth.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were: Mudgala, Srrljaya, the king Brhadisu, Vikranta who was younger to him and Karnpilya, the fifth.

verses.sanskrit: तेन सत्येन सत्यात्मन्परमात्मन्सनातन । नारायण प्रसीदेश सर्वलोकपरायण
verses.transliteration: tena satyena satyātmanparamātmansanātana / nārāyaṇa prasīdeśa sarvalokaparāyaṇa
verses.translation: For the sustenance and the upkeep of all the five the father spoke to them thus: "Know that there are five flouri¬ shing territories for all the five of you." Since the five were sufficient, all the territories were together well known as Paiica- las.* Maudgalyas, the descendants of Mudgala,were Brahmanas endowed with Ksatriya traits.
verses.hindi: होगा । सुरथ का पुत्र सुमिन्र इस वंश का अन्तिम राजा होगा। कलियुग में ये उपयक्त इत्वाकुवंशीय राजा लोग कहे गये हैं, बृहद्ल के बंश में कलियुग में इतने ही राजा उत्पन्न होंगे, ये सब शूरवीर, विद्वान सत्यप्रतिज्ञ और जितेख्रिय राजा होंगे ।२८९-२९१। भविष्य की कथाओं के जाननेबाले विद्वानूगण इस इक्ष्वाकुन वंश के विषय में एक इलोक गाते हैं, इसका तात्परय इस प्रकार है, इृक्ष्वाकुबंशीय राजाओं की परम्परा राजा सुमित्र तक चलेगी, कलियुग में सुमित्र राजा के अनन्तर इस बंध की समाप्ति हो जायगी  भनृपुत्र राजा इला के वंश्न में उत्पन्न होनेवाले क्षत्रिय राजाओं का वर्णन कर चुका ।२९२-२६१॥ अब इसके अन्तर मगधदेशीय बृहद्रथ के वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले राजाओं का वर्णव कर रहा हूँ । जरासंघ एवं सहदेव के वंश में भूतकालौन, वर्तमानकालीन एवं भविष्यकालीन जो राजा गण उत्पन्न हो गये हैं, वर्तमान हैं, एवं
verses.wordMeaning: For the sustenance and the upkeep of all the five the father spoke to them thus: "Know that there are five flouri¬ shing territories for all the five of you." Since the five were sufficient, all the territories were together well known as Paiica- las.* Maudgalyas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sustenance and the upkeep of all the five the father spoke to them thus: "Know that there are five flouri¬ shing territories for all the five of you." Since the five were sufficient, all the territories were together well known as Paiica- las.* Maudgalyas,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नबुद्धे शान्तात्मन्प्रसन्नवदनेक्षण । प्रसीद योगिनामीश नर सर्वगताच्युत
verses.transliteration: prasannabuddhe śāntātmanprasannavadanekṣaṇa / prasīda yogināmīśa nara sarvagatācyuta
verses.translation: These were known ns Kanthamudgalas and they mer¬ ged into the Atigirasa Gotra. Mudgala's eldest son was very famous. He was engrossed in the meditation of Brahman.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न हंगि, मुख्यतः उत सबों का वर्णन आप लोगों से कर रहा हूँ, सुनिये । उस विस्यात महाभारत में सहदेव का संहार हो गया था, उसका पुत्र राज सोमाधि था, बह भिरिव्रज का शासक था ।२६४-२६९६। उसने अठावन चर्षों तक राज्य किया  उसका पुत्र श्रुतशक्षवा था, जिसने चौंसठ वर्षो तक राज्य किया । तदनन्तर अयुतायु नामक राजा हुआ, जिसने छब्बीस वर्षों तक राज्य किया। उसके बाद राजा निरामित्र हुआ, जो सौ
verses.wordMeaning: These were known ns Kanthamudgalas and they mer¬ ged into the Atigirasa Gotra. Mudgala's eldest son was very famous. He was engrossed in the meditation of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: These were known ns Kanthamudgalas and they mer¬ ged into the Atigirasa Gotra. Mudgala's eldest son was very famous. He was engrossed in the meditation of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्यामो नरं देवं तथा नारायणं हरिम् । नमो नराय नम्याय नमो नारायणाय च
verses.transliteration: namasyāmo naraṃ devaṃ tathā nārāyaṇaṃ harim / namo narāya namyāya namo nārāyaṇāya ca
verses.translation: From him Indrasena conceived Badhyasva. We have heard that Mcnaka bore to Badhyasva twins.
verses.hindi: वर्षों तक पृथ्वी पर शासन करने के उपरान्त स्वर्गंगामी हुआ ।२६७-२९८। तदननन्‍्तर सुकृत्त ने छप्पन वर्षो तक पृथ्वी पर राज्य किया, फिर बृह॒त्कर्मा नामक राजा हुआ, उसने तेईस वर्षों तक प्रृथ्वी पर राज्य है ० वायुप्राणम्
verses.wordMeaning: From him Indrasena conceived Badhyasva. We have heard that Mcnaka bore to Badhyasva twins.
verses.commentary: Sense: From him Indrasena conceived Badhyasva. We have heard that Mcnaka bore to Badhyasva twins.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नानामनाथानां तथा नाथवतां प्रभो । शं करोतु नरो ऽस्माकं शं नारायण देहि नः
verses.transliteration: prasannānāmanāthānāṃ tathā nāthavatāṃ prabho / śaṃ karotu naro 'smākaṃ śaṃ nārāyaṇa dehi naḥ
verses.translation: They were Divodasa the saintly king and Ahalya of great fame. Ahalya bore Satananda the excellent sage to Saradvata. His son was Satyadhrti of great fame. He was a master of the science of archery.
verses.hindi: सेनाजित्सांप्रतं चापि एता वे भोक्ष्यते समाः । श्रुतंजयस्तु वर्षाणि चत्वा रिशज्भधू विध्यति १३००
verses.wordMeaning: They were Divodasa the saintly king and Ahalya of great fame. Ahalya bore Satananda the excellent sage to Saradvata. His son was Satyadhrti of great fame. He was a master of the science of archery.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Divodasa the saintly king and Ahalya of great fame. Ahalya bore Satananda the excellent sage to Saradvata. His son was Satyadhrti of great fame. He was a master of the science of archery.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: एवमभ्यर्चितः स्तुत्या रागद्वेषादिवर्जितः । प्राहेशः सर्वभूतानां मध्ये नारायणो नृप
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evamabhyarcitaḥ stutyā rāgadveṣādivarjitaḥ / prāheśaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ madhye nārāyaṇo nṛpa
verses.translation: On seeing an Apsaras (celestial damsel) in front, the semen virile of Satyadhrti was emitted in the bush of Sara-grass and twins were born.
verses.hindi: अष्टपर्चाशतं चाब्दान्राज्ये स्थास्यति वे शुचिः । अष्टाविशत्ससाः पूर्णा: क्षेभो राजा भ्विष्यति ३६ भुवतस्तु चतुःषष्टी राज्यं प्राप्स्यति वीयंवान्। पड्चवर्षाणि पूर्णानि धर्मनेत्रो भविष्यति ४३०३ भोक्ष्यते नृपतिश्चेव अष्टपठ्चाशतं समाः। अष्ठत्रित्समा राज्य सुब्रतस्य भविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing an Apsaras (celestial damsel) in front, the semen virile of Satyadhrti was emitted in the bush of Sara-grass and twins were born.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing an Apsaras (celestial damsel) in front, the semen virile of Satyadhrti was emitted in the bush of Sara-grass and twins were born.

verses.sanskrit: नारायण उवाच: स्वागतं माधवे कामे भवत्वप्सरसामपि । यत्कार्यम् आगतानां च इहास्माभिस्तदुच्यताम्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇa uvāca: svāgataṃ mādhave kāme bhavatvapsarasāmapi / yatkāryam āgatānāṃ ca ihāsmābhistaducyatām
verses.translation: Santanu who had come that way ahunting took them out of mercy (Krpa). The boy is remembered as Krpa and the girl Krpi. She was also known as Gautaml. Thus the race of Gautama, known as Saradvatas and Rtathyas, has been recounted.
verses.hindi: चत्वारिशदशाष्टो च दृढसेनो भविष्यति।। त्रयस्त्रिशत्तु वर्षाणि सुमतिः प्राप्य्यले ततः
verses.wordMeaning: Santanu who had come that way ahunting took them out of mercy (Krpa). The boy is remembered as Krpa and the girl Krpi. She was also known as Gautaml. Thus the race of Gautama, known as Saradvatas and Rtathyas, has been recounted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Santanu who had come that way ahunting took them out of mercy (Krpa). The boy is remembered as Krpa and the girl Krpi. She was also known as Gautaml. Thus the race of Gautama, known as Saradvatas and Rtathyas, has been recounted.

verses.sanskrit: यूयं संसिद्धये नूनमस्माकं बलशत्रुणा । संप्रेषितास्ततो ऽस्माकं नृत्ययोगादिदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: yūyaṃ saṃsiddhaye nūnamasmākaṃ balaśatruṇā / saṃpreṣitāstato 'smākaṃ nṛtyayogādidarśanam
verses.translation: The intelligent Sudasa was born of Cyavann was born as the son of Sudasa. Somalia was his son
verses.hindi: दाविशतिसमा राज्यं सुचलो भोक्ष्यते ततः  । चत्वारिशत्समा राजा सनेत्रों भोग्यते ततः आरिजयस्तु वर्षाणि पञ्चाशत्प्राप्स्यते महोम् । द्वात्रिशच्च नृपा होते भवितारों बहहंथात्
verses.wordMeaning: The intelligent Sudasa was born of Cyavann was born as the son of Sudasa. Somalia was his son
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent Sudasa was born of Cyavann was born as the son of Sudasa. Somalia was his son

verses.sanskrit: न वयं गीतनृत्येन नाङ्गचेष्टादिभाषितैः । लुब्धा वै विषयैर् मन्ये विषया दारुणात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: na vayaṃ gītanṛtyena nāṅgaceṣṭādibhāṣitaiḥ / lubdhā vai viṣayair manye viṣayā dāruṇātmakāḥ
verses.translation: When the race was about to be extinct, Ajamidha was born again. That was Somalia. Somalia's son was Tanm When he was killed hundred other sons were born to the noble- soulcd lord Ajamidha in his birth as Somaka. The youngest of them, Prsata was Drupada's father. } ° 1
verses.hindi: मुनिकः स्वासिनं ह॒त्वा पुत्रं सम्िषेक्ष्यति । सिषतां क्षत्रियाणां हि प्रद्योतो सुनिकों बलातू
verses.wordMeaning: When the race was about to be extinct, Ajamidha was born again. That was Somalia. Somalia's son was Tanm When he was killed hundred other sons were born to the noble- soulcd lord Ajamidha in his birth as Somaka. The youngest of them, Prsata was Drupada's father. } ° 1
verses.commentary: Sense: When the race was about to be extinct, Ajamidha was born again. That was Somalia. Somalia's son was Tanm When he was killed hundred other sons were born to the noble- soulcd lord Ajamidha in his birth as Somaka. The youngest of them, Prsata was Drupada's father. } ° 1

verses.sanskrit: शब्दादिसङ्गदुष्टानि यदा नाक्षाणि नः शुभाः । तदा नृत्यादयो भावाः कथं लोभप्रदायिनः
verses.transliteration: śabdādisaṅgaduṣṭāni yadā nākṣāṇi naḥ śubhāḥ / tadā nṛtyādayo bhāvāḥ kathaṃ lobhapradāyinaḥ
verses.translation: His son was Dhystadyumna and Dhrstaketu was his son. Dhuminl, the queen of Ajamidha, was desirous of a son In her rebirth she performed a very difficult penance for a hun¬ dred years. She performed Homas in the fire. She kept awake She ate but little and that too only the holy food. She perform¬ ed great holy rites. Day and night she stayed on the Kusa mattress alone. By these rigorous activities, she became smoke- coloured. The powerful Ajamidha begot of her Rksa, asmoke- coloured son, who was elder brother of Sita (one of white colour). Sam vara na was born of Rksa. Kuru was bom of Sam- varana.
verses.hindi: बन + जल ओ+ नल व तीन आए ४ 3 प्रन्‍माताज अजीत 6५ ॥ ५ डडगा- पति  की गत पहल 7 ०५ ३ जप न वा न जे सनीतजयलपार पा स्णाड पका ए- ५ ५ जन्‍म अप 3 अन्ना उन वा अआ- 4 8७७. +++पाआा अब +५ मम :3» “ने मेन जनाप गाकण०+ कम ३५-अा+-फ- किया । हस समय रुस वंश का सेनजित् वामक राजा राज्य कर रहा है, उसका पुत्र श्रुव्॑जय चालीस वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा। तदनम्तर महाव् बलशाली, परम बुद्धिमान् पराक्रमशील समहाबल नामक राजा होगा जो तैंतीस वर्षों तक पृथ्वी पर शासन करेगा ।२९६-३० १। उसके उपरान्त शुचि नामक एक राजा अद्ठावन वर्षों तक राज्य पद पर प्रतिष्ठित होबा। फिर क्षेम नामक राजा अट्ठाईस वर्षों तक राजा होगा ।
verses.wordMeaning: His son was Dhystadyumna and Dhrstaketu was his son. Dhuminl, the queen of Ajamidha, was desirous of a son In her rebirth she performed a very difficult penance for a hun¬ dred years. She performed Homas in the fire.…
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was Dhystadyumna and Dhrstaketu was his son. Dhuminl, the queen of Ajamidha, was desirous of a son In her rebirth she performed a very difficult penance for a hun¬ dred years. She performed Homas in the fire.…

verses.sanskrit: ते सिद्धाः स्म न वै साध्या भवतीनां स्मरस्य च । माधवस्य च शाक्रो ऽपि स्वास्थ्यं यात्वविशङ्किताः
verses.transliteration: te siddhāḥ sma na vai sādhyā bhavatīnāṃ smarasya ca / mādhavasya ca śākro 'pi svāsthyaṃ yātvaviśaṅkitāḥ
verses.translation: After treading on (conquering) Prayaga, he built Kuruksctra. The cxcessive-splendoured king ploughed it for many years.
verses.hindi: तदनस्तर बलशाली भुवत नामक राजा चोंसठ वर्षों के लिए राजा होगा। फिर राजा धर्मक्षेत्र पाँच वर्षों के लिए होगा। तदुपरास्त धपति अद्ठावन वर्ष के लिए पृथ्वी का उपभोग करेगा। फिर राजा सुत्रत का अड़तीस वर्ष के लिये राज्य होगा ।३०२-३०४। तदनन्तर राजा दृढ़सेन अदृठावन वर्षों तक राजा होगा । उसके बाद सुमति त़ैंतीस वर्ष के लिये राज्य पंद प्राप्त करेगा। फिर सुचल नामक
verses.wordMeaning: After treading on (conquering) Prayaga, he built Kuruksctra. The cxcessive-splendoured king ploughed it for many years.
verses.commentary: Sense: After treading on (conquering) Prayaga, he built Kuruksctra. The cxcessive-splendoured king ploughed it for many years.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽसौ परश्च परमः पुरुषः परमेश्वरः । परमात्मा समस्तस्य स्थावरस्य चरस्य च
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau paraśca paramaḥ puruṣaḥ parameśvaraḥ / paramātmā samastasya sthāvarasya carasya ca
verses.translation: While it was being ploughed, Sakra shone there and granted this boon: Your (Kuruksetra) shall be beautiful, holy and resorted to by meritorious persons.
verses.hindi: राजा बाईस वर्षों तक पृथ्वी का उपभोग करेगा । उसके उपरान्त राजा सुनेत्र चालीस वर्षों तक राज्य करैगा । तदनन्तर सत्यजित तिरासी वर्षों तक पृथ्वी पर राज्य करेगा। फिर राजा वोरजित् इस पृथ्वी पर आकर पैतीस वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा ।३०५-३०७। तदुपरास्त राजा अरिज्जय पचास वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा। बहद्रथ के उपरान्त ये बाईस राजा लोग पृथ्वी पर राज्य करेंगे। उनका शासनकाल प्रे एक सहस्न वर्ष का होंगा । बृहद्रथ वंशीय राजाओं के राज्यकाल के उपरान्त वीतिहोत्र बंशीय राजाओं का राज्य जिस समय रहेगा, उस समय समस्त क्षत्रिय जाति के देखते देखते मुनिक नामक एक राज्य-कमंचारी प्रधोत नामक अपने स्वामी का अपने पराक्रम से संहार कर पुत्र का राज्याभिषेक फरेगा। वहू.नवीन राजा
verses.wordMeaning: While it was being ploughed, Sakra shone there and granted this boon: Your (Kuruksetra) shall be beautiful, holy and resorted to by meritorious persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: While it was being ploughed, Sakra shone there and granted this boon: Your (Kuruksetra) shall be beautiful, holy and resorted to by meritorious persons.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पत्तिहेतुरेते च यस्मिन्सर्वं प्रलीयते । सर्वावासीति देवत्वाद् वासुदेवेत्य् उदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: utpattiheturete ca yasminsarvaṃ pralīyate / sarvāvāsīti devatvād vāsudevety udāhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Persons born in his family were excellent kings famous as Kurus. Kuru's beloved sons were Sudhanvan, Jahnu, Pariksita the great king, Putraka and Arimardana. It is remem¬ bered that the intelligent Suhotra was the successor of Sudhan¬ van.
verses.hindi: स॒ वे प्रणतसामन्तो भविष्येषबनयर्वाजितः । त्रयोविशत्समा राजा भविता स नरोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: Persons born in his family were excellent kings famous as Kurus. Kuru's beloved sons were Sudhanvan, Jahnu, Pariksita the great king, Putraka and Arimardana. It is remem¬ bered that the intelligent Suhotra was the successor of Sudhan¬ van.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons born in his family were excellent kings famous as Kurus. Kuru's beloved sons were Sudhanvan, Jahnu, Pariksita the great king, Putraka and Arimardana. It is remem¬ bered that the intelligent Suhotra was the successor of Sudhan¬ van.

verses.sanskrit: वयमंशांशकास्तस्य चतुर्व्यूहस्य मानिनः । तदादेशितवार्त्मानौ जगद्बोधाय देहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: vayamaṃśāṃśakāstasya caturvyūhasya māninaḥ / tadādeśitavārtmānau jagadbodhāya dehinām
verses.translation: Cyavana was his son. The king was an expert in religious affairs. Krta was the son of Cyavana. He performed great penance and many Yajnas. The king procreated his famous son Vidyoparicara who claimed friendship of Indra. He was a great hero who could traverse the sky and was known as Vasu too.
verses.hindi: चतुविशत्समा राजा पालकों भविता ततः  विशाखयूपो भविता नृपः पञचाशतों समाः अष्टत्रिशच्छत भाव्या: प्राद्योताः पञ्च ते सृताः । ह॒त्वा तेषां यशः कृत्स्ने शिशुनाको भविष्यति ॥ वाराणस्यां सुतस्तस्य संप्राप्स्यति गरिरिन्षजम् । शिशुनाकस्य वर्षाणि चत्वारिशख्धूविष्पति
verses.wordMeaning: Cyavana was his son. The king was an expert in religious affairs. Krta was the son of Cyavana. He performed great penance and many Yajnas. The king procreated his famous son Vidyoparicara who claimed friendship of Indra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Cyavana was his son. The king was an expert in religious affairs. Krta was the son of Cyavana. He performed great penance and many Yajnas. The king procreated his famous son Vidyoparicara who claimed friendship of Indra.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वभूतं सर्वेशं सर्वत्र समदर्शिनम् । कुतः पश्यन्तौ रागादीन्करिष्यामो विभेदिनः
verses.transliteration: tatsarvabhūtaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvatra samadarśinam / kutaḥ paśyantau rāgādīnkariṣyāmo vibhedinaḥ
verses.translation: Girika bore seven sons to Vidyoparicara—Brhad- ratha, a great warrior, who became famous as the king of Magadha, Pratyagjrha, Kusa, one whom they call Manivahana Mathailya, Lalittha and Matsyakala the seventh.
verses.hindi: शकवर्ण: सुतस्तस्य षद्त्रिशच्च भविष्यति । ततस्तु विर्शात राजा क्षेमवर्मा भविष्यति ३१६
verses.wordMeaning: Girika bore seven sons to Vidyoparicara—Brhad- ratha, a great warrior, who became famous as the king of Magadha, Pratyagjrha, Kusa, one whom they call Manivahana Mathailya, Lalittha and Matsyakala the seventh.
verses.commentary: Sense: Girika bore seven sons to Vidyoparicara—Brhad- ratha, a great warrior, who became famous as the king of Magadha, Pratyagjrha, Kusa, one whom they call Manivahana Mathailya, Lalittha and Matsyakala the seventh.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ते मयि चेन्द्रे च भवतीषु तथा स्मरे । यदा स एव भूतात्मा तदा द्वेषादयः कथम्
verses.transliteration: vasante mayi cendre ca bhavatīṣu tathā smare / yadā sa eva bhūtātmā tadā dveṣādayaḥ katham
verses.translation: Bfhadratha's successor was famous by the name of Kusagra. Kusagra's son was a powerful king named Rsabha.
verses.hindi: अध्टाविशत्समा राजा विधिसारों भविष्यति । पश््चावशत्समा राजा दर्शकस्तु भविष्वति उदायी भविता यस्मात्त्रयस्त्रिशत्समा नृपः। वे स पुरवरं राजा पृथिव्यां कुसुमाद्दयम् ।।
verses.wordMeaning: Bfhadratha's successor was famous by the name of Kusagra. Kusagra's son was a powerful king named Rsabha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bfhadratha's successor was famous by the name of Kusagra. Kusagra's son was a powerful king named Rsabha.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मयान्यविभक्तानि यदा सर्वेषु जन्तुषु । सर्वेश्वरेश्वरो विष्णुः कुतो रागादयस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tanmayānyavibhaktāni yadā sarveṣu jantuṣu / sarveśvareśvaro viṣṇuḥ kuto rāgādayastataḥ
verses.translation: Rsabha's successor was a virtuous king named Puspa- van. King Satyahita is remembered as his valoious successor.
verses.hindi: गड्भाया दक्षिणे कले चतुर्थेब्दे करिष्यति (३१६ हांचत्वारिशत्समा भाव्यों राजा वे नन्दिवर्धन: । चत्वारिशत्त्रयं चेब महानन्दी भविष्यति ४३२०
verses.wordMeaning: Rsabha's successor was a virtuous king named Puspa- van. King Satyahita is remembered as his valoious successor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rsabha's successor was a virtuous king named Puspa- van. King Satyahita is remembered as his valoious successor.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणम् इन्द्रम् ईशानम् आदित्यमरुतो ऽखिलान् । विश्वेदेवान् ऋषीन् साध्यान्वसून्पितृगणांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇam indram īśānam ādityamaruto 'khilān / viśvedevān ṛṣīn sādhyānvasūnpitṛgaṇāṃs tathā
verses.translation: His son was Sudhanvan. From him the valorous Drja was born. Orja's son was Nabhasa and from him was born that powerful king Jarasandha. He was born in two pieces and he was joined by Jara. Jarasandha was mighty-armed because he was joined by Jara.
verses.hindi: किसी प्रकार का अनेतिक कार्य नहीं करेगा। सभी सामन्त लोग उसके सम्मुख प्रणत होंगे । इस प्रकार वहु नरश्रेष्ठ तेईस वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा ।३१०८-३११॥ उसके बाद पालक नामक राजा चौबोस वर्षों तक राज्य करेंगा । फिरं विशासयूप नामक राजा होगा, वह पचास वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा। फिर अजक नामक राजा का इकतीस वर्षों तक राज्य होगा। तदनन्तर उसका पुत्र वर्तिबधंन बीस वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा । प्रयोत के उपर्युक्त पाँच वंश्ञज राजा लोग इस प्रकार एक सो अड़्तीस (१३८) वर्षों तक राज्य करेंगे । तदतस्तर उन सब के यद को समूलत: नष्ट करके शिशुनाक नामक राजा होगा ।३१२९०३ १४। सब प्रथम यह भिरिब्रज प्रदेश का राजा होगा, तत्पश्चात् इसका पुत्र वाराणसी का राजा होगा । शिशुनाक बासींस वर्षों तक राज्य करेंगा । उसका पुत्र शकवर्ण छत्तीस वर्ष तक राज्य करेगा। उसके उपरान्त
verses.wordMeaning: His son was Sudhanvan. From him the valorous Drja was born. Orja's son was Nabhasa and from him was born that powerful king Jarasandha. He was born in two pieces and he was joined by Jara. Jarasandha was mighty-armed because he was joined by Jara.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was Sudhanvan. From him the valorous Drja was born. Orja's son was Nabhasa and from him was born that powerful king Jarasandha. He was born in two pieces and he was joined by Jara. Jarasandha was mighty-armed because he was joined by Jara.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षराक्षसभूतादीन्नागान्सर्पान्सरीसृपान् । मनुष्यपक्षिगोरूपगजसिंहजलेचरान्
verses.transliteration: yakṣarākṣasabhūtādīnnāgānsarpānsarīsṛpān / manuṣyapakṣigorūpagajasiṃhajalecarān
verses.translation: This Jarasandha of great strength was the conqueror of all Ksatriya kings. Jarasandha's son was the valorous Saha- deva.
verses.hindi: राजा क्षेमवर्मा बीस वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा । उसके बाद राजा अजातशत्रु पण्चीस वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा  तदन्दर क्षतौजा नामक राजा चालीस वर्षों के लिये राज्य पद प्राप्त करैगा। उसके बाद रागा विविसार अठाईस वर्षों तक राब्य करेगा । फिर दद्ंन नामक राजा पच्चीस वर्ष तक राज्य करेगा ३१५-३१५। तदुप्राम्त उदायो तामक राजा लैंतीस वर्षा तक राज्य करेगा। वह राजा उदायी पृथ्वी माण्डल में कुसुम
verses.wordMeaning: This Jarasandha of great strength was the conqueror of all Ksatriya kings. Jarasandha's son was the valorous Saha- deva.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Jarasandha of great strength was the conqueror of all Ksatriya kings. Jarasandha's son was the valorous Saha- deva.

verses.sanskrit: मक्षिकामशकान्दंशाञ्छलभाञ्जलजान् कृमीन् । गुल्मवृक्षलतावल्लीत्वक्सारतृणजातिषु
verses.transliteration: makṣikāmaśakāndaṃśāñchalabhāñjalajān kṛmīn / gulmavṛkṣalatāvallītvaksāratṛṇajātiṣu
verses.translation: Sahadeva's son was the glorious Somadhi of very great penance. Srutasruva was the son of Somadhi and is glorified as Magadha.
verses.hindi: नॉम से विस्यात, परम रमणीय मगर में गंगा के दाहिने तट पर अपने शासन काल के चतुर्थ वर्ष में अपना निवास-स्थान निर्मित करेगा । उसके बाद राजा नन्दिवर्धन बयालीस वर्षों तक राज्य पद का उपभोग करेगा । फिर महानन्दी नामक राजा पेंतालीस वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा ।३१६-३२०। ये उपर्युक्त दस राजा दृत आरध्य पत्यविशत्समा नृप इत्यल्त: पाठो ह. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sahadeva's son was the glorious Somadhi of very great penance. Srutasruva was the son of Somadhi and is glorified as Magadha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahadeva's son was the glorious Somadhi of very great penance. Srutasruva was the son of Somadhi and is glorified as Magadha.

verses.sanskrit: यच्च किंचिददृश्यं वा दृश्यं वा त्रिदशाङ्गनाः । मन्यध्वं जातमेकस्य तत्सर्वं परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yacca kiṃcidadṛśyaṃ vā dṛśyaṃ vā tridaśāṅganāḥ / manyadhvaṃ jātamekasya tatsarvaṃ paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksita. Sruta- sena's successor was named Bhlmasena. (lines missing).
verses.hindi: इत्येते भवितारों वे शेशुनाका नूपा दश । शतानि त्रीणि वर्षाणि द्विषष्टयरभ्यधिकानि तु
verses.wordMeaning: Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksita. Sruta- sena's successor was named Bhlmasena. (lines missing).
verses.commentary: Sense: Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksita. Sruta- sena's successor was named Bhlmasena. (lines missing).

verses.sanskrit: जायमानः कथं विष्णुमात्मानं परमं च यत् । रागद्वेषौ तथा लोभं कः कुर्याद् अमराङ्गनाः
verses.transliteration: jāyamānaḥ kathaṃ viṣṇumātmānaṃ paramaṃ ca yat / rāgadveṣau tathā lobhaṃ kaḥ kuryād amarāṅganāḥ
verses.translation: Jahnu begot a son named Suratha who became a king. Suratha's successor was the heroic king Viduratha.
verses.hindi: शेशुनाका भविष्यन्ति राजानः क्षत्रबान्धवा: । एते: सार्थ भविष्यन्ति तावत्कालं नृपाः परे ऐक्षाकवाश्रतुविशत्पञठचालाः पञचरविशति: । कालकास्तु चतुविशच्चतुविशत्तु हैहया: ४३२३ द्वात्रिशद् कलिज्भास्तु पञर्चावशत्तथा शकाः। (+कुरवश्चापि षर्दटान्निशदष्टाविशतिमेथिला:
verses.wordMeaning: Jahnu begot a son named Suratha who became a king. Suratha's successor was the heroic king Viduratha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jahnu begot a son named Suratha who became a king. Suratha's successor was the heroic king Viduratha.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतमये विष्णौ सर्वगे सर्वधातरि । निपात्य तं पृथग्भूते कुतो रागादिको गुणः
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtamaye viṣṇau sarvage sarvadhātari / nipātya taṃ pṛthagbhūte kuto rāgādiko guṇaḥ
verses.translation: It is well known that Viduratha's son too was Sarva- bhauma. Jayatsena was bom of Sarvabhauma and Aradhi was his son.
verses.hindi: श्रसेनास्त्रयोविशद्वीतिहोन्राश्न विशति: । तुल्यकाल भविष्यन्ति सर्व एवं महीक्षितः) 3२२५ महानन्दिसुतश्रापि शुूद्रायां कालसंबृतः । उत्पत्स्यते महापद्मः सर्वक्षत्रान्तरे नृपः
verses.wordMeaning: It is well known that Viduratha's son too was Sarva- bhauma. Jayatsena was bom of Sarvabhauma and Aradhi was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is well known that Viduratha's son too was Sarva- bhauma. Jayatsena was bom of Sarvabhauma and Aradhi was his son.

verses.sanskrit: एवमस्मासु युष्मासु सर्वभूतेषु चाबलाः । तन्मथैकत्वभूतेषु रागाद्यवसरः कुतः
verses.transliteration: evamasmāsu yuṣmāsu sarvabhūteṣu cābalāḥ / tanmathaikatvabhūteṣu rāgādyavasaraḥ kutaḥ
verses.translation: Mahasattva was born of Aradhi and Ayutayu came thereafter. Akrodhana was the son of Ayutayu. It is remember¬ ed that Devatithi was born of him.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रभ्नुति राजानो भविष्याः शुद्रयोनयः । एकराट स महापशद्म एकच्छन्नो भविष्यति ३२७ उद्धरिष्यति ताम्सबॉन्कोटिल्यो बे द्विरष्टभिः । भुक्तृवा महीं वर्षश्त नन्‍देन्दुःस भविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Mahasattva was born of Aradhi and Ayutayu came thereafter. Akrodhana was the son of Ayutayu. It is remember¬ ed that Devatithi was born of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahasattva was born of Aradhi and Ayutayu came thereafter. Akrodhana was the son of Ayutayu. It is remember¬ ed that Devatithi was born of him.

verses.sanskrit: सम्यग् दृष्टिर् इयं प्रोक्ता समस्तैक्यावलोकिनी । पृथग्विज्ञानमात्रैव लोकसंव्यवहारवत्
verses.transliteration: samyag dṛṣṭir iyaṃ proktā samastaikyāvalokinī / pṛthagvijñānamātraiva lokasaṃvyavahāravat
verses.translation: It was Rksa who became the successor of Devatithi. Bhlmasena was born of Rksa and Dilipa was his son.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रगुप्तं नृप॑ राज्ये कोटिल्य: स्थापयिष्यति । चतुधिशत्समा राजा चन्द्रगुप्तो भविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: It was Rksa who became the successor of Devatithi. Bhlmasena was born of Rksa and Dilipa was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was Rksa who became the successor of Devatithi. Bhlmasena was born of Rksa and Dilipa was his son.

verses.sanskrit: भूतेन्द्रियान्तः करणप्रधानपुरुषात्मकम् । जगद्वै ह्येतद् अखिलं तदा भेदः किमात्मकः
verses.transliteration: bhūtendriyāntaḥ karaṇapradhānapuruṣātmakam / jagadvai hyetad akhilaṃ tadā bhedaḥ kimātmakaḥ
verses.translation: Pratlpa was the son of Dilipa. It is remembered that. three sons were born to him. Those three were Devapi, Santanu and Bah lika.
verses.hindi: न ननिकाएए टली 7 पान कब ह ० ताणणए कण ता शिटए ल्‍काए कटा अत 7 । ता तन पहनने ना पलिनित-का कन+ “ना (2 न नया फेक कफ, ननगा "4५ -+ ५० ५3 रत हा जान "काम शिशुनाक वंश में उत्पन्न होंगे--ये सब कुल मिलाकर तीन सौ बासठ वर्षों तक राज्य करेंगे। इन शिशुनाकवंशी राजाओं के राजत्वकाल में अस्यान्य क्षत्रिय जाति के राला लोग भी होंगे । जिनमें इक्ष्वाकुवंशीय चोबीस, पंचान्रबंशीय पच्चीस, कालक चौबीस, हैहय चौबीस, कलिर्ः देशीय बत्तीस, शक पच्चीस, कुरुदेशीय छत्तीस, मिथिलादेशीय अट्ठाईस, शूरसेम के तेईस, वीतिहोत्र के बीस उल्लेखनीय हैं। इन
verses.wordMeaning: Pratlpa was the son of Dilipa. It is remembered that. three sons were born to him. Those three were Devapi, Santanu and Bah lika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pratlpa was the son of Dilipa. It is remembered that. three sons were born to him. Those three were Devapi, Santanu and Bah lika.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्ति लयमायान्ति समुद्रसलिलोर्मयः । न वारिभेदतो भिन्नास्तथैवैक्यादिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: bhavanti layamāyānti samudrasalilormayaḥ / na vāribhedato bhinnāstathaivaikyādidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: King Saptabahlisvara should be known as (the son) of Bahllka. Somadatla too, of great fame, was the son of Bahllka.
verses.hindi: सबका शासनकाल एक ही समय में होगा ।३२१-३२५। समस्त क्षत्रियवंशीय राजाओं के बाद महापत्म से शुद्रयोनि में उत्पन्न कन्या से उत्पन्न महाप्म नामक एक पुत्र होगा । उसो के राजत्वकाल में प्रायः सभी राजा लोग शुद्ध योनि में उत्पन्न होनैवाले होंगे । वह महाप्म अपने समय का एकच्छत्र सम्राट् होगा । वह अट्ठाईस वर्षों तक पृथ्वी का पालन करेगा। भवितव्यता की बलवत्ता से वह महापग्म
verses.wordMeaning: King Saptabahlisvara should be known as (the son) of Bahllka. Somadatla too, of great fame, was the son of Bahllka.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Saptabahlisvara should be known as (the son) of Bahllka. Somadatla too, of great fame, was the son of Bahllka.

verses.sanskrit: यथाग्नेर् अर्चिषः पीताः पिङ्गलारुणधूसराः । तथापि नाग्नितो भिन्नास् तथैतद् ब्रह्मणो जगत्
verses.transliteration: yathāgner arciṣaḥ pītāḥ piṅgalāruṇadhūsarāḥ / tathāpi nāgnito bhinnās tathaitad brahmaṇo jagat
verses.translation: Bhuri, Bhurisravas and Sala were born of Somadatta. With a desire to accumulate virtue Devapi (renounced every¬ thing and) went to the forest.
verses.hindi: समस्त क्षत्रिय राजाओं का गवंहरण करने वाला होगा ।३२६-३२८! उसके एक सहृख्र पृत्र होंगे, जिनमें बारह राजा होंगे, उन सब का राजत्वकाल केवल आठ वर्षो का होगा । महापद्य के बाद वे सब क्रम क्रम से शासनाधिरृढ़ होंगे। उन सब को कौटिल्य निर्मूल कर देंगे । महापद्मवंश का अच्तिम राजा सौ वर्षों तक पृथ्वी का शासन करेगा ।२२६-३३०। कोटिल्य उच्चे अवदस्थ कर चर्वगुप्त को पिहासन पर प्रतिष्ठित करेंगे । वह चद्धगुप्त चौबीस वर्षों के लिये राजा होगा । उसके बाद भद्रसाद पच्चीस वर्ष तक राजा
verses.wordMeaning: Bhuri, Bhurisravas and Sala were born of Somadatta. With a desire to accumulate virtue Devapi (renounced every¬ thing and) went to the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhuri, Bhurisravas and Sala were born of Somadatta. With a desire to accumulate virtue Devapi (renounced every¬ thing and) went to the forest.

verses.sanskrit: भवतीभिश्च यत् क्षोभम् अस्माकं स पुरंदरः । कारयत्यसद् एतच् च विवेकाचारचेतसाम्
verses.transliteration: bhavatībhiśca yat kṣobham asmākaṃ sa puraṃdaraḥ / kārayatyasad etac ca vivekācāracetasām
verses.translation: Sage Devapi became the preceptor of Dcvas. To this noble-souled sage, two sons Cyavana and Istaka were born.
verses.hindi: + धनुश्चिह्वान्तर्गतग्रल्थो ग. पुस्तके नास्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Sage Devapi became the preceptor of Dcvas. To this noble-souled sage, two sons Cyavana and Istaka were born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sage Devapi became the preceptor of Dcvas. To this noble-souled sage, two sons Cyavana and Istaka were born.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्त्यः स च देवेन्द्रो लोकाश्च ससुरासुराः । समुद्राद्रिवनोपेता मद्देहान्तरगोचराः
verses.transliteration: bhavantyaḥ sa ca devendro lokāśca sasurāsurāḥ / samudrādrivanopetā maddehāntaragocarāḥ
verses.translation: Santanu became king. He was a scholar and a great physician ( MahabhUa ). About this Mahabhisa they cite this verse.
verses.hindi: भविता भद्गसारस्तु पञ्चॉविशत्समा नृप:। षड्विशत्तु समा राजा अशोको भविता नृघु ३३२ बन्धुपालितदायादो दशमानोद्धपालित: । भविता सप्त वर्षाणि देववर्मा नराधिपः
verses.wordMeaning: Santanu became king. He was a scholar and a great physician ( MahabhUa ). About this Mahabhisa they cite this verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: Santanu became king. He was a scholar and a great physician ( MahabhUa ). About this Mahabhisa they cite this verse.

verses.sanskrit: यथेयं चारुसर्वाङ्गी भवतीनां मयाग्रतः । दर्शिता दर्शयिष्यामि तथा चैवाखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: yatheyaṃ cārusarvāṅgī bhavatīnāṃ mayāgrataḥ / darśitā darśayiṣyāmi tathā caivākhilaṃ jagat
verses.translation: "Whomsoever docs the king touch, be he very old due to the efflux of time, becomes a youth again. Therefore they know him as Samtanu (Sam —happiness, Tanu —body)/' Therefore the quality of his being Sarhtanu was well known among the subjects. That righteous king Samtanu married Jahnavx (Ganga).
verses.hindi: राजा शतधरश्नाष्टो तस्य पुत्रो भविष्यति । बृहदश्श्न वर्षाणि सप्त वे भविता नृपः ३३४५ इत्येते नव भूपा ये भोक्ष्यन्ति च बस धरासम् । सप्तत्रिशच्छतं पूर्ण तेभ्यः शुद्धान्य भिष्पति
verses.wordMeaning: "Whomsoever docs the king touch, be he very old due to the efflux of time, becomes a youth again. Therefore they know him as Samtanu (Sam —happiness, Tanu —body)/' Therefore the quality of his being Sarhtanu was well known among the subjects.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Whomsoever docs the king touch, be he very old due to the efflux of time, becomes a youth again. Therefore they know him as Samtanu (Sam —happiness, Tanu —body)/' Therefore the quality of his being Sarhtanu was well known among the subjects.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रयातु शक्रो मा गर्वमिन्द्रत्वं कस्य सुस्थिरम् । यूयं च मा स्मयं यात सन्ति रूपान्विताः स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: prayātu śakro mā garvamindratvaṃ kasya susthiram / yūyaṃ ca mā smayaṃ yāta santi rūpānvitāḥ striyaḥ
verses.translation: The lord begot a son of her, named Devavrata (who later became) Bhlsma. That Bhlsma became famous as the grandfather of the Pantfavas.
verses.hindi: पुष्पमित्रस्तु सेनानो रुद्धत्य वे बहुद्रथम् । कारयिष्यति वे राज्यं समाः षष्टि सदव तु बसुमित्रः सुतो भाव्यो दश वर्षाणि पाथिवः । ततोइन्क्रकः समा है तु भविष्यति सुतश्र वे.
verses.wordMeaning: The lord begot a son of her, named Devavrata (who later became) Bhlsma. That Bhlsma became famous as the grandfather of the Pantfavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord begot a son of her, named Devavrata (who later became) Bhlsma. That Bhlsma became famous as the grandfather of the Pantfavas.

verses.sanskrit: किं सुरूपं कुरूपं वा यदा भेदो न दृश्यते । तारतम्यं सुरूपत्वे सततं भिन्नदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ surūpaṃ kurūpaṃ vā yadā bhedo na dṛśyate / tāratamyaṃ surūpatve satataṃ bhinnadarśanāt
verses.translation: After some time Samtanu begot his most favourite son Vicitravlrya who as king did much for the welfare of the subjects. Krsnadvaipayana begot of Vicitravlrya's wife (< ksetra ), Dhrtarastra, Pandu and Vidura. Gandharl bore to Dhrtarastra a hundred sons. Duryodhana was the eldest among them. He became the lord of all Ksatriyas. Madri and the queen Prtha became the wives of Pandu.
verses.hindi: भविष्यन्ति समास्तस्मात्तित्र एवं पुलिन्दका:। राजा घोषसुताश्रापि वर्षाणि भविता त्रयः(? ) ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After some time Samtanu begot his most favourite son Vicitravlrya who as king did much for the welfare of the subjects. Krsnadvaipayana begot of Vicitravlrya's wife (< ksetra ), Dhrtarastra, Pandu and Vidura. Gandharl bore to Dhrtarastra a hundred sons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After some time Samtanu begot his most favourite son Vicitravlrya who as king did much for the welfare of the subjects. Krsnadvaipayana begot of Vicitravlrya's wife (< ksetra ), Dhrtarastra, Pandu and Vidura. Gandharl bore to Dhrtarastra a hundred sons.…

verses.sanskrit: भवतीनां स्मयं मत्वा रूपौदार्यगुणोद्भवम् । मयेयं दर्शिता तन्वी ततस्तु शममेष्यथ
verses.transliteration: bhavatīnāṃ smayaṃ matvā rūpaudāryaguṇodbhavam / mayeyaṃ darśitā tanvī tatastu śamameṣyatha
verses.translation: Sons bestowed by gods were born of them on behalf of Pandu. Yudhisthira was born, thanks to the grace of Dharma; Vrkodara was born of Vayu; Dhananjaya whose valour was equal to that of Sakra was born of Indra. Sahadcva and Nakula were born to Madri, thanks to the grace of Asvins.
verses.hindi: ततो व विक्रमितश्रस्तु समा राजा ततः पुनः । द्वान्रिशद्धूविता चापि समा भागवतो नृपः ॥३४ १ भविष्यति सुतस्तस्य क्षेममुमिः समा दश । दशते शुदगराजानो भोक्ष्यन्तीमां वसंधरामू शर्त पूर्ण दश ह्वे च तेम्यः कि वा गसिष्यति । अपा्िवसुदेव तु बाल्यादुष्यसनिनं नृपमू
verses.wordMeaning: Sons bestowed by gods were born of them on behalf of Pandu. Yudhisthira was born, thanks to the grace of Dharma; Vrkodara was born of Vayu; Dhananjaya whose valour was equal to that of Sakra was born of Indra. Sahadcva and Nakula were born to Madri, thanks to the grace of Asvins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sons bestowed by gods were born of them on behalf of Pandu. Yudhisthira was born, thanks to the grace of Dharma; Vrkodara was born of Vayu; Dhananjaya whose valour was equal to that of Sakra was born of Indra. Sahadcva and Nakula were born to Madri, thanks to the grace of Asvins.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मान् मदूरोर्निष्पन्ना त्वियमिन्दीवरेक्षणा । उर्वशी नाम कल्याणी भविष्यति वराप्सराः
verses.transliteration: yasmān madūrorniṣpannā tviyamindīvarekṣaṇā / urvaśī nāma kalyāṇī bhaviṣyati varāpsarāḥ
verses.translation: Five sons were born to DraupadI from the (five) Pandavas. DraupadI bore Srutividdha, the eldest of them, to Yudhisthira. Hidarhba bore her son Ghatotkaca to Bhlmasena. Kasya too bore her son Sarvavrka to Bhlmasena.
verses.hindi: होगा । फिर अशोक नामक राजा मनुष्यों में छब्वीस वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा ।३३१-३३२। उसका पुत्र कुनाल आठ वर्ष राज्य करेगा। इन्द्रपालित कुनाल का पुत्र बन्धुपालित आठ वर्षों तक राज्यपद पर समासीन होगा । बन्धुपालित का उत्तराधिकारी दस वर्ष के लिये राजा होगा । फिर नराधिपति देववर्मा सात वर्ष के लिये राजा होगा । तददु- परान्त उसका पुत्र राजा शतधर आठ वर्ष राज्य करेगा । पश्चात् राजा वृहदश्व सात वर्ष राज्य करेगा ।३३३-
verses.wordMeaning: Five sons were born to DraupadI from the (five) Pandavas. DraupadI bore Srutividdha, the eldest of them, to Yudhisthira. Hidarhba bore her son Ghatotkaca to Bhlmasena. Kasya too bore her son Sarvavrka to Bhlmasena.
verses.commentary: Sense: Five sons were born to DraupadI from the (five) Pandavas. DraupadI bore Srutividdha, the eldest of them, to Yudhisthira. Hidarhba bore her son Ghatotkaca to Bhlmasena. Kasya too bore her son Sarvavrka to Bhlmasena.

verses.sanskrit: तदियं देवराजस्य नीयतां वरवर्णिनी । भवत्यस्तेन चास्माकं प्रेषिताः प्रीतिमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: tadiyaṃ devarājasya nīyatāṃ varavarṇinī / bhavatyastena cāsmākaṃ preṣitāḥ prītimicchatā
verses.translation: The heroic Abhimanyu was born of Subhadra as the son of Partha. Parlksit was born of Uttara, the princess of Virata, as the son of Abhimanyu.
verses.hindi: ३३४५॥ ये तन्दबंश के नव राजा पृथ्वी का भोग करेंगे, उन-सब का राजत्व-काल कुल मिलाकर एक सौ सैंतीस (?) वर्षों का होगा  इन नन्दवंशीय राजाओं के हाथ से शासन शुद्धों के हाथ में चला जायगा। अन्तिम राजा बृहदश्व का सेनापति पुष्पमित्न उसको मारकर स्वयं साठ वर्षों राज्य करेगा  पुथ्पमित्र आठ पुत्र होंगे, जो सब के सब राजा होंगे। सब से बड़ा पुत्र सात वर्षों तक राज्य पद पर प्रतिष्ठित होगा ।३३६“३२५। फिर वसुमित्र नामक पुत्र दस वर्ष के लिये राजा होगा। फिर अस्ध्रक नामक पुत्र दो वर्ष के लिये राजा होगा । फिर पुलिभ्दक तीन वर्ष के लिये ओर घोषसुत भी तीन वर्ष के लिये राजा बनेंगा । उसके बाद राजा बिक्रमित्र भी तीन वर्ष के लिये राजा होगा । तदनन्तर भागवत नामक राजा होगा, जो बत्तीस बर्षों
verses.wordMeaning: The heroic Abhimanyu was born of Subhadra as the son of Partha. Parlksit was born of Uttara, the princess of Virata, as the son of Abhimanyu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic Abhimanyu was born of Subhadra as the son of Partha. Parlksit was born of Uttara, the princess of Virata, as the son of Abhimanyu.

verses.sanskrit: वक्तव्यश्च सहस्राक्षो नास्माकं भोगकारणात् । तपश्चर्या न वाप्राप्यफलं प्राप्तुम् अभीप्सता
verses.transliteration: vaktavyaśca sahasrākṣo nāsmākaṃ bhogakāraṇāt / tapaścaryā na vāprāpyaphalaṃ prāptum abhīpsatā
verses.translation: King Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksit. H e established Vajcsaneyika Brahmanas. The infuriated Vaisariipayana (said to him), «q evil-minded one, your directions (rule) will not remain long here in this world without an enemy (without being protested against). As long as I am alive in this world, this (act of yours) cannot be praised." Thereupon, Janamejaya was faced with difficulties all round.
verses.hindi: तक राज्य करेगा। फिर उप्तका पुत्र क्षेमभूमि दस वर्ष तक राजा होगा । उपर्युक्त शुद्भधवंशीय दस राजा इस पृथ्वी का उपभोग करेंगे । उन सब का राजत्वकाल एक श्री बारह (?) वर्षों (?) का होगा ।३३६-३४२ह। फिंश बाल्यकाल से ही व्यसन में निरत रहनेवाले सुदेव राजा के हाथ में दासनशक्ति आयेगी। श्यूजुवंधियों में एक
verses.wordMeaning: King Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksit. H e established Vajcsaneyika Brahmanas. The infuriated Vaisariipayana (said to him), «q evil-minded one, your directions (rule) will not remain long here in this world without an enemy (without being protested against).…
verses.commentary: Sense: King Janamejaya was the successor of Parlksit. H e established Vajcsaneyika Brahmanas. The infuriated Vaisariipayana (said to him), «q evil-minded one, your directions (rule) will not remain long here in this world without an enemy (without being protested against).…

verses.sanskrit: सन्मार्गमस्य जगतो दर्शयिष्ये करोम्यहम् । तथा नरेण सहितो जगतः पालनोद्यतः
verses.transliteration: sanmārgamasya jagato darśayiṣye karomyaham / tathā nareṇa sahito jagataḥ pālanodyataḥ
verses.translation: He worshipped lord Prajapati by offering Havis in the Paurnamasa Yajfia. He saw that the different materials were offered in the sacrifice of the lord. Still he was in difficulties?
verses.hindi: देरए वायुपुराणस् देवमुमिस्ततोउन्यश्र शड्गेषु भविता नृपः । भविष्यति समा राजा द नवकण्ठायनस्तु सः-
verses.wordMeaning: He worshipped lord Prajapati by offering Havis in the Paurnamasa Yajfia. He saw that the different materials were offered in the sacrifice of the lord. Still he was in difficulties?
verses.commentary: Sense: He worshipped lord Prajapati by offering Havis in the Paurnamasa Yajfia. He saw that the different materials were offered in the sacrifice of the lord. Still he was in difficulties?

verses.sanskrit: यदि कश्चित्तवाबाधां करोति त्रिदशेश्वर । तमहं वारयिष्यामि निवृत्तो भव वासव
verses.transliteration: yadi kaścittavābādhāṃ karoti tridaśeśvara / tamahaṃ vārayiṣyāmi nivṛtto bhava vāsava
verses.translation: Janamejaya, the son of Parlksit, the descendant of Puru, then performed Asvamedha twice. Thereafter, he made those Vajasaneyaka Brahmanas function. Janamejaya was crippled (defeated) three times. Crippled at the hands of As'vakomukhyas, crippled at the hands of the residents of Angas, and crippled at the hands of the people of MadhyadeSa (Middle Lands)! Janame¬ jaya became Trikharvi (crippled three times). He was distres¬ sed. Being cursed along with those Brahmanas, he suffered ruin.
verses.hindi: भाग्या: प्रणतसामन्ता भ््वत्वा रिशच्च पत्च च । तेषां पर्यायकाले तु तरन्धा तु भविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Janamejaya, the son of Parlksit, the descendant of Puru, then performed Asvamedha twice. Thereafter, he made those Vajasaneyaka Brahmanas function. Janamejaya was crippled (defeated) three times. Crippled at the hands of As'vakomukhyas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Janamejaya, the son of Parlksit, the descendant of Puru, then performed Asvamedha twice. Thereafter, he made those Vajasaneyaka Brahmanas function. Janamejaya was crippled (defeated) three times. Crippled at the hands of As'vakomukhyas,…

verses.sanskrit: कर्तासि चेत् त्वम् आबाधां न दुष्टस्येह कस्यचित् । तं चापि शास्ता तदहं प्रवर्तिष्याम्य् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: kartāsi cet tvam ābādhāṃ na duṣṭasyeha kasyacit / taṃ cāpi śāstā tadahaṃ pravartiṣyāmy asaṃśayam
verses.translation: Satanlka of truthful exploit and strength was his son. After him (Janamejaya), the Brahmanas crowned his son Satanlka.
verses.hindi: सिन्धुको ह्यन्धजातीय: प्राप्स्पतीमां बसुंधराम् ... ३४८ . श्रयोविशत्सभा राजा सिन्धुको भविता त्वथ। अष्टों भातश्र वर्षाणि तस्माहश भविधष्यति(? ) श्रीशातकरणिभंविता तस्य पुत्रस्तु वे महान् । पश्चाशतं समाः घटू च शातकरणिभंविष्यतिर
verses.wordMeaning: Satanlka of truthful exploit and strength was his son. After him (Janamejaya), the Brahmanas crowned his son Satanlka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Satanlka of truthful exploit and strength was his son. After him (Janamejaya), the Brahmanas crowned his son Satanlka.

verses.sanskrit: एतज्ज्ञात्वा न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्यो हि मां प्रति । उपकाराय जगताम् अवतीर्णो ऽस्मि वासव
verses.transliteration: etajjñātvā na santāpastvayā kāryo hi māṃ prati / upakārāya jagatām avatīrṇo 'smi vāsava
verses.translation: The powerful As'vamedhadatta was the son of Satanlka. Adhisamakrsna was born as the son of Asvamedha- datta. He conquered the cities of his enemies. He is the present ruler, of righteous soul and great fame. It is under his rule that you have been able to perform this Dirghasatra (sacri¬ fice of long duration) for three years. It is very difficult to be • performed. O excellent Brahmanas, (besides) there is another a ra lasting for two years, which is being performed in Kuru- ksetra on the banks of the river Drsadvati. We wish to hear all these—the activities that will be undertaken by them, and their names, the kings who will be born, their time calculated in years, the extent of theYugas, their good points and their defects, their happiness and misery and those of the subjects, their religious activities and their passionate pursuits as well as their monetary dealings. Enu¬ merate all these to us who ask you.
verses.hindi: भविता नेसिकृष्णस्तु वर्षाणां'पञचॉविशतिम् । ततः संवत्सरं पूर्ण हालो राजा भविष्यति..
verses.wordMeaning: The powerful As'vamedhadatta was the son of Satanlka. Adhisamakrsna was born as the son of Asvamedha- datta. He conquered the cities of his enemies. He is the present ruler, of righteous soul and great fame.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful As'vamedhadatta was the son of Satanlka. Adhisamakrsna was born as the son of Asvamedha- datta. He conquered the cities of his enemies. He is the present ruler, of righteous soul and great fame.…

verses.sanskrit: या चेयमुर्वशी मत्तः समुद्भूता पुरंदर त्रेताग्निहेतुभूतेयं एवं प्राप्य भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: yā ceyamurvaśī mattaḥ samudbhūtā puraṃdara tretāgnihetubhūteyaṃ evaṃ prāpya bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Even as I recount listen and understand the future events, 1 the Kaliyuga and the Manvantaras in the manner they had been described to me by Vyasa of wonderful activities. Henceforth, I shall mention the kings who will be born in future.
verses.hindi: पञचसप्तकराजानो भविष्यन्ति महाबलाः । भाव्यः पुत्रिकषेणस्तु समा: सोउप्येकविशशिन्च देवभूमि नामक अन्य राजा भी होगा, कण्ठायन नाम से लव वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा। उसका पुत्र भूतिमित्र चौबीस वर्षों तक राज्य पद अधिकारी होगा। उसके बाद राजा तारायण बारह वर्षों के लिये राजा होगा ।६४३-३४०। फिर उसका पुत्र सुशर्मा दस वर्ष तक राजा होगा । द्विजबृन्द ! ये उपयु क्त कठोर कम करने- : वाले चार राजा कष्ठायन नाम से प्रसिद्ध होंगे, इन कण्ठायन नाम से विश्यात राजाओं के राज्यकाल में सामन्त-
verses.wordMeaning: Even as I recount listen and understand the future events, 1 the Kaliyuga and the Manvantaras in the manner they had been described to me by Vyasa of wonderful activities. Henceforth, I shall mention the kings who will be born in future.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as I recount listen and understand the future events, 1 the Kaliyuga and the Manvantaras in the manner they had been described to me by Vyasa of wonderful activities. Henceforth, I shall mention the kings who will be born in future.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये श्रीपत्युत्पत्तिवर्णनं नाम द्विनवत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १९३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: इत्युक्ते ऽप्सरसः सर्वाः प्रणिपत्य पुनः पुनः । ऊचुर् नारायणं देवं तद्दर्शनसमीहया
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye śrīpatyutpattivarṇanaṃ nāma dvinavatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 193 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ityukte 'psarasaḥ sarvāḥ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ / ūcur nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ taddarśanasamīhayā
verses.translation: I shall mention the descendants of Aila, Iksvaku, Sudyumna and other kings in whom this splendid territory of the Iksvakus will be vested. I shall mention all other kings also besides these who will be born in future, viz. Ksatriyas, Parasavas, Sudras and Brahmanas, Andhas (Andhras), Sakas, Pulindas, Tulikas, Yavanas, Kaivartas, Abhiras, Sabaras, and all other Mleccha (outcaste) tribes.
verses.hindi: जर्वदा विनम्र रहेंगे, इनका शासनकाल कुल मिलाकर पेतालीस वर्षों का होगा । इनके उपराण्त आाश्प्रवंशीय राजा होंगे । कण्ठावन उपाधिधारी राजाओों के अन्तिम नरपति सुशर्मा को, तथा शुद्धंगवंशोय राजाओं की सेनाओं को युद्धस्थल में पराजित कद अन्भ्रज्ञातीय सिन्धुक नामक एक राजा इस पृथ्वी को प्राप्त करेगा। वह सिन्धुक तेईस वर्षों तक राज्यपद पर प्रतिष्ठित होगा । उसके उपरान्त भात (?) नामक राजा अठारह वर्षो के
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention the descendants of Aila, Iksvaku, Sudyumna and other kings in whom this splendid territory of the Iksvakus will be vested. I shall mention all other kings also besides these who will be born in future, viz. Ksatriyas, Parasavas, Sudras and Brahmanas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the descendants of Aila, Iksvaku, Sudyumna and other kings in whom this splendid territory of the Iksvakus will be vested. I shall mention all other kings also besides these who will be born in future, viz. Ksatriyas, Parasavas, Sudras and Brahmanas,…

verses.sanskrit: वसन्तकामाप्सरस ऊचुः । भगवन्भवता यो ऽयमुपदेशो हितार्थिना । प्रोक्तः स सर्वो विज्ञातो माहात्म्यं विदितं च ते
verses.transliteration: vasantakāmāpsarasa ūcuḥ / bhagavanbhavatā yo 'yamupadeśo hitārthinā / proktaḥ sa sarvo vijñāto māhātmyaṃ viditaṃ ca te
verses.translation: This present king Adhisamakrsna is a king belonging to the Puru dynasty. I shall mention all the future kings in his family.
verses.hindi: लिए राजा होगा ।३४६-३४६। उसके बाद उसका पुत्र शातकणि अपने समय का महान् राजा होमा, वह छप्पन यों तक क्षासन की बागडोर अपने हाथ में रखेगा  तदनन्तर शातकर्णि का पुत्र राजा आपादबठ्ध होया, वह दस, पैबीस और छः वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा (?) उसके बाद वेमिष्ण १०चीस वर्ष के लिये राजा बनेगा । तदनन्तर हाल नामक राजा पूरे एक वर्ष के लिये शासनाधिरूढ़ होगा ; इस वंश में पाँच सात राजा महाबलवान होंगे । हाल के बाद पुत्रिकषेण इककौस वर्षों तक राज्य करेगा। उसके बाद स्ातकरणि मराधिपति होगा, जो पूरे एक वर्ष
verses.wordMeaning: This present king Adhisamakrsna is a king belonging to the Puru dynasty. I shall mention all the future kings in his family.
verses.commentary: Sense: This present king Adhisamakrsna is a king belonging to the Puru dynasty. I shall mention all the future kings in his family.

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं प्रसन्नेनान्तरात्मना । दर्शितेयं विशालाक्षी दर्शयिष्यामि वो जगत्
verses.transliteration: yattvetadbhavatā proktaṃ prasannenāntarātmanā / darśiteyaṃ viśālākṣī darśayiṣyāmi vo jagat
verses.translation: Nirvaktra will be the son of Adhisamakrsna. When his city Hastinapura is swept away by Ganga he will abandon it and live happily at Kausambl.
verses.hindi: सातकॉजिबंर्थमेकं भविष्यति नराधिप:। + चकार शातकणिस्तु षण्मासान्वे नराधिप: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Nirvaktra will be the son of Adhisamakrsna. When his city Hastinapura is swept away by Ganga he will abandon it and live happily at Kausambl.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nirvaktra will be the son of Adhisamakrsna. When his city Hastinapura is swept away by Ganga he will abandon it and live happily at Kausambl.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रार्थे सर्वभावेन प्रपन्नानां जगत्पते । दर्शयात्मानमखिलं दर्शितेयं यथोर्वशी
verses.transliteration: tatrārthe sarvabhāvena prapannānāṃ jagatpate / darśayātmānamakhilaṃ darśiteyaṃ yathorvaśī
verses.translation: His son will be Usna. Citraratha will be born of Usna. Sucidratha will be born of Citraratha, and Vj-timan will be born of Sucidratha.
verses.hindi: अधष्टायिशसु वर्षाण शिवस्वामी भविष्यति राजा चर गोतमीपुत्र एकविशस्तमा नृषु । एकोर्नावर्शात राजो यज्ञश्री: सातकष्यंथ....
verses.wordMeaning: His son will be Usna. Citraratha will be born of Usna. Sucidratha will be born of Citraratha, and Vj-timan will be born of Sucidratha.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son will be Usna. Citraratha will be born of Usna. Sucidratha will be born of Citraratha, and Vj-timan will be born of Sucidratha.

verses.sanskrit: यदि देवापराधे ऽपि नास्मासु कुपितं तव । नमस्ते जगतामीश दर्शयात्मानमात्मना
verses.transliteration: yadi devāparādhe 'pi nāsmāsu kupitaṃ tava / namaste jagatāmīśa darśayātmānamātmanā
verses.translation: Suscna of great fame and prowess will be born there¬ after. To Suscna will be born the king named Sutlriha.
verses.hindi: घडेंव भविता तस्माद्विजयस्तु समा नपः। दण्डश्री: सातकर्णो च तस्य पुत्र: समास्त्रयः? )
verses.wordMeaning: Suscna of great fame and prowess will be born there¬ after. To Suscna will be born the king named Sutlriha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suscna of great fame and prowess will be born there¬ after. To Suscna will be born the king named Sutlriha.

verses.sanskrit: नारायण उवाच: पश्यतेहाखिलांल् लोकान् मम देहे सुराङ्गनाः । मधुं मदनम् आत्मानं यच् चान्यद् द्रष्टुमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇa uvāca: paśyatehākhilāṃl lokān mama dehe surāṅganāḥ / madhuṃ madanam ātmānaṃ yac cānyad draṣṭumicchatha
verses.translation: Ruca will be born of Sutlrtha. Then Tricak?a will be born. Tricaksa's successor will be Sukhibala.
verses.hindi: सप्तेव तु भविष्यन्ति दशा5भीरास्ततो नृपाः । सप्त ग्दसिनश्रापि ततोघन्ये दश बे शकाः अन्ध्रा भोकयन्ति कसुधां शते हें च शर्त च वे । शतानि त्रीण्यशीति च॒ भोक्ष्यन्ति बसुधा शका: ३६१ अशीर्ति चैव वर्षाणि भोक्तारो यबना सहीम् ।  पञचवर्षशतानीह तुषाराणां मही स्मृता.
verses.wordMeaning: Ruca will be born of Sutlrtha. Then Tricak?a will be born. Tricaksa's successor will be Sukhibala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ruca will be born of Sutlrtha. Then Tricak?a will be born. Tricaksa's successor will be Sukhibala.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्देवस्तदा नारायणो नृप । उच्चैर्जहास स्वनवत्तत्राभूदखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ityuktvā bhagavāndevastadā nārāyaṇo nṛpa / uccairjahāsa svanavattatrābhūdakhilaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Sukhibala's son will be the king Paripluta. King Sunaya will be born as the son of Paripluta.
verses.hindi: और छः: मास तक राज्य करेगा । तदनन्तर अट्ठाईस वर्ष तक शिवस्वामी नामक एक राजा होगा
verses.wordMeaning: Sukhibala's son will be the king Paripluta. King Sunaya will be born as the son of Paripluta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukhibala's son will be the king Paripluta. King Sunaya will be born as the son of Paripluta.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः शक्रः सह रुद्रैः पिनाकधृक् । आदित्या वसवः साध्या विश्वेदेवा महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: brahmā prajāpatiḥ śakraḥ saha rudraiḥ pinākadhṛk / ādityā vasavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevā maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: King Mcdhavi will be the son of Sunaya and Medha- vin's son will be Dantfapani.
verses.hindi: फिर बोतमीपुन्र मनुष्यों में इककीस वर्ष तक राज्य करेगा। तदनन्तर सातकर्णी वंशोत्पन्न राजा यज्ञश्री उन्नीस वर्षो के लिये राजा होगा । उसके बाद विजय नामक राजा छः वरषंतक राज्य करेगा। उसके बाद उसका पुत्र सातकर्णी दण्डश्री तीन वर्ष तक राज्य करेगा । फिर पुलोवा नामक राजा होगा, जो सात बर्षों तक प्रथ्वी पर राज्य करेगा । इन राजाओं के अतिरिक्त अन्याग्य राजाओं का भी पृथ्वी पर राज्य होगा। उपर्युक्त अन्ध्र वंशीय तेईस राजा होंगे, जो पृथ्वी का उपभोग करेंगे। उन सब का राजत्वकाल कुल मिलाकर चार सौ ग्यारह वर्ष का होता है । ये अन्भ्रवंशीय राजा लोग पाँच वंशों में विभक्त हो जायेंगे ।३५५-३५८। उनके बाद सत्रह आभीर वंशीय राजाओं का शासनकाल आयेगा, फिर सात गर्दमिन वंशीय और दस हाक-वंशीय राजा होंगे । तदनशध्तर आठ यवन, चौदह तुषार वंशीय, तेरह मेनण्ट, और अट्ठोरह मौन वंश में उत्पन्न होनेवाले राजा राज्य
verses.wordMeaning: King Mcdhavi will be the son of Sunaya and Medha- vin's son will be Dantfapani.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Mcdhavi will be the son of Sunaya and Medha- vin's son will be Dantfapani.

verses.sanskrit: नासत्यदस्रावनिलः सर्वशश्च तथाग्नयः । यक्षगन्धर्वसिद्धाश्च पिशाचोरगकिन्नराः
verses.transliteration: nāsatyadasrāvanilaḥ sarvaśaśca tathāgnayaḥ / yakṣagandharvasiddhāśca piśācoragakinnarāḥ
verses.translation: Dandapani's son will be Niramitra and Ksemaka will be the son of Niramitra. These twentyfive kings (?) will be born in the race of Puru.
verses.hindi: करेंगे । आन्ध्र बंशीय राजा लोग तीन सौ वर्षों तक राज्य करेंगे । शक लोग तीन सौ अस्सी वर्षों तक प्ृृष्वो का उपभोग करेंगे ।३५९-३६१॥ यवन लोग अस्सी वर्षों तक राज्य करेंगे । तुधारवंशीय राजा लोग पाँच सौ वर्षों तक पृथ्वी का राज्य करेंगे । तेरह मरुण्ड बंशीय राजागण अन्य शुद्र जातीय राजाओं के साथ साढ़े चार सौ वर्षों तक प्रृथ्वी का उपभोग करेंगे। उस समय अनेछे स्लेच्छ जातियाँ होंगी। उनमें से ग्यारह स्लेच्छ
verses.wordMeaning: Dandapani's son will be Niramitra and Ksemaka will be the son of Niramitra. These twentyfive kings (?) will be born in the race of Puru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dandapani's son will be Niramitra and Ksemaka will be the son of Niramitra. These twentyfive kings (?) will be born in the race of Puru.

verses.sanskrit: समस्ताप्सरसो विद्याः साङ्गा वेदास्तदुक्तयः । मनुष्याः पशवः कीटाः पक्षिणः पादपास्तथा
verses.transliteration: samastāpsaraso vidyāḥ sāṅgā vedāstaduktayaḥ / manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ kīṭāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ pādapāstathā
verses.translation: In this connection the following verse describing the subsequent race has been cited by Brahmanas who know ancient lore. "This race which has produced Brahmanas and Ksatriyas, and which is honoured by Devas and sages, will be extinct in the Kali age after coming to Ksemaka". Thus the race of Puru has been enumerated precisely.
verses.hindi: +-एतदध॑ क, ग. घ. पुस्तकेषु नास्ति।.  एतदनन्तरं ख. ग. घ. पुस्तकेष्वघिक:ः एलोक उपलभ्यते है१६ द वायुपुराणस्
verses.wordMeaning: In this connection the following verse describing the subsequent race has been cited by Brahmanas who know ancient lore. "This race which has produced Brahmanas and Ksatriyas, and which is honoured by Devas and sages, will be extinct in the Kali age after coming to Ksemaka".…
verses.commentary: Sense: In this connection the following verse describing the subsequent race has been cited by Brahmanas who know ancient lore. "This race which has produced Brahmanas and Ksatriyas, and which is honoured by Devas and sages, will be extinct in the Kali age after coming to Ksemaka".…

verses.sanskrit: सरीसृपाश्चाथ सूक्ष्मा यच्चान्यज्जीवसंज्ञितम् । समुद्राः सकलाः शैलाः सरितः काननानि च
verses.transliteration: sarīsṛpāścātha sūkṣmā yaccānyajjīvasaṃjñitam / samudrāḥ sakalāḥ śailāḥ saritaḥ kānanāni ca
verses.translation: (The race) of the intelligent son of Pandu, the noble- souled Arjuna (has been narrated).
verses.hindi: शताजनि त्रीणि भोक्ष्यस्ति स्लेच्छा एकादशंव तु । तच्छन्नेन च फालेन ततः कोलिकिला नूपाः
verses.wordMeaning: (The race) of the intelligent son of Pandu, the noble- souled Arjuna (has been narrated).
verses.commentary: Sense: (The race) of the intelligent son of Pandu, the noble- souled Arjuna (has been narrated).

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपान्यशेषाणि तथा तथा सर्वसरांसि च । नगरग्रामपूर्णा च मेदिनी मेदिनीपते । देवाङ्गनाभिर्देवस्य देहे दृष्टं महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: dvīpānyaśeṣāṇi tathā tathā sarvasarāṃsi ca / nagaragrāmapūrṇā ca medinī medinīpate / devāṅganābhirdevasya dehe dṛṣṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Brhadratha's successor was the heroic king Brhatksaya. His son was Ksaya. Vatsavyuha was the son of Ksaya. After Vatsavyuha, Prativyuha became king. His son is Divakara and this king is ruling over the city of Ayodhya now.
verses.hindi: ततः कोलिकिलेस्यश्व विन्ध्यशक्तिभंविष्यति । समाः षण्णवर्ति ज्ञात्वा पृथिवों च समेष्यति व॒धाग्य दिशकाञउ्चापि भविध्यांश्व निबोधत । शेषस्य नागराजस्य पुत्र: स्वरपुरंजयः
verses.wordMeaning: Brhadratha's successor was the heroic king Brhatksaya. His son was Ksaya. Vatsavyuha was the son of Ksaya. After Vatsavyuha, Prativyuha became king. His son is Divakara and this king is ruling over the city of Ayodhya now.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhadratha's successor was the heroic king Brhatksaya. His son was Ksaya. Vatsavyuha was the son of Ksaya. After Vatsavyuha, Prativyuha became king. His son is Divakara and this king is ruling over the city of Ayodhya now.

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्रग्रहताराभिः सुसम्पूर्णं नभस्तलम् । ददृशुस् ताः सुचार्वङ्ग्यस् तस्यान्तर्विश्वं रूपिणः
verses.transliteration: nakṣatragrahatārābhiḥ susampūrṇaṃ nabhastalam / dadṛśus tāḥ sucārvaṅgyas tasyāntarviśvaṃ rūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Divakara s son will be the renowned Sahadeva. Brhadasva will become the successor of Sahadeva.
verses.hindi: भोगी भविष्यते राजा नपो नागकुलोइ्नहः  सदाचन्दस्तु चस्द्रांशो द्वितीयों नखवांस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Divakara s son will be the renowned Sahadeva. Brhadasva will become the successor of Sahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Divakara s son will be the renowned Sahadeva. Brhadasva will become the successor of Sahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं न तिर्यङ्नाधस्ताद्यदान्तस् तस्य दृश्यते । तमनन्तमनादिं च ततस्तास् तुष्टुवुः प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ na tiryaṅnādhastādyadāntas tasya dṛśyate / tamanantamanādiṃ ca tatastās tuṣṭuvuḥ prabhum
verses.translation: Bhanuratha will be his son. His son will be Pratitasva. Suprallta will become the son of Pratitasva.
verses.hindi: धनधर्मा ततश्रापि चतुर्थों विशजः स्मृतः । भूतिननन्‍दस्ततश्रापि बेदेशे तु भविष्यति तस्यान्वये भविष्यन्ति राजानस्ते त्रयस्तु वे । दोहित्र: शिशुकों नाम पुरिकायां नृपोभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Bhanuratha will be his son. His son will be Pratitasva. Suprallta will become the son of Pratitasva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhanuratha will be his son. His son will be Pratitasva. Suprallta will become the son of Pratitasva.

verses.sanskrit: मदनेन समं सर्वा मधुना च वराङ्गनाः । ससाध्वसा भक्तिपराः परं विस्मयमागताः
verses.transliteration: madanena samaṃ sarvā madhunā ca varāṅganāḥ / sasādhvasā bhaktiparāḥ paraṃ vismayamāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Sahadeva will be his son and his son will be Sunaksatra. Kinnara, the oppressor of his enemies, will become the son of Sunaksatra. Antariksa, the son of Kinnara, will be a great (king).
verses.hindi: विस्ध्यशक्तिसुतभ्रापि प्रवीरो नाम वीयंबान्। भोक्ष्यम्ति च समा: षष्टि पुरी काउचनकां च वे
verses.wordMeaning: Sahadeva will be his son and his son will be Sunaksatra. Kinnara, the oppressor of his enemies, will become the son of Sunaksatra. Antariksa, the son of Kinnara, will be a great (king).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahadeva will be his son and his son will be Sunaksatra. Kinnara, the oppressor of his enemies, will become the son of Sunaksatra. Antariksa, the son of Kinnara, will be a great (king).

verses.sanskrit: वसन्तकामाप्सरस ऊचुः । पश्याम नादिं तव देव नान्तं न मध्यमव्याकृतरूपपारम् । परायणं त्वां जगताम् अनन्तं नताः स्म नारायणमात्मभूतम्
verses.transliteration: vasantakāmāpsarasa ūcuḥ / paśyāma nādiṃ tava deva nāntaṃ na madhyamavyākṛtarūpapāram / parāyaṇaṃ tvāṃ jagatām anantaṃ natāḥ sma nārāyaṇamātmabhūtam
