verses.translation: Suparna will be born of Antariksa and Amitrajit
verses.hindi: विन्ध्यकानां कुलेइतीते नपा वे बालिकाखय: । सुप्रतोको नभीरस्तु समा भोक्ष्यति त्रिशति(त)म् ॥ वंशीय राजागण तीन सौ वर्षों तक राज्य करेंगे। इन राजाओं के बाद कोलिकिल नामक शुद्ध जातीय राजाओं का राज्य होगा ।३६२०३६४। उन कोलिकिलों से विष्ष्य शक्ति नामक राजा के हाथ में शासनशक्ति आयेगी । वह छात्रबें वर्षों तक पृथ्वी पर राज्य करेगा । अब इसके उपरास्त भविष्यत्कालीन शूद्र जातीय विदेशी राजाओं (१) का वर्णन सुनिये । नागराज शेष का पुत्र दत्रुओं के नगरों को जीतनिवाला राजा भोगी, नागकुल
verses.wordMeaning: Suparna will be born of Antariksa and Amitrajit
verses.commentary: Sense: Suparna will be born of Antariksa and Amitrajit

verses.sanskrit: महीनभोवायुजलाग्नयस्त्वं शब्दादिरूपस्तु परापरात्मन् । त्वत्तो भवत्यच्युते सर्वम् एतद्भेदादिरूपो ऽसि विभो त्वमात्मन्
verses.transliteration: mahīnabhovāyujalāgnayastvaṃ śabdādirūpastu parāparātman / tvatto bhavatyacyute sarvam etadbhedādirūpo 'si vibho tvamātman
verses.translation: In the family of Sakya, Rahula will be born to Suddhodana (?) Then Prascnajit will be born. Ksudraka will be born then.
verses.hindi: में सर्वश्रेष्ठ राजा होगा--यही सर्बप्रथम विदेशी राजा होगा  उसके उपरान्त सदाचन्द्र चद्र दाभूत नखवान्, बनधर्मा, विशज और भूतिनस्द नामक राजा गण भी विदेश में राज्य पद. प्राप्त करेंगे ३६५-३६८। अंगवंशीय राजा नन्‍द के उपरास्त राजा मधुनर्द के हाथ में शासनशक्ति जायगी, मधुमन्दि के छोटे भाई का नाम नन्दियशा होगा। इसी नन्‍्दयशा के वंश में तीन राजा उत्पन्न होंगे । उनके नाम दोहित्र,
verses.wordMeaning: In the family of Sakya, Rahula will be born to Suddhodana (?) Then Prascnajit will be born. Ksudraka will be born then.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the family of Sakya, Rahula will be born to Suddhodana (?) Then Prascnajit will be born. Ksudraka will be born then.

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टासि रूपस्य परस्य वेत्ता श्रोता च शब्दस्य हरे त्वमेकः । स्रष्टा भवान् सर्वगतो ऽखिलस्य घ्राता च गन्धस्य पृथक् शरीरी
verses.transliteration: draṣṭāsi rūpasya parasya vettā śrotā ca śabdasya hare tvamekaḥ / sraṣṭā bhavān sarvagato 'khilasya ghrātā ca gandhasya pṛthak śarīrī
verses.translation: Ksulika will be the son of Ksudraka. From Ksulika will be born Suratha. Sumitra, the son of Suratha, will be the last king.
verses.hindi: और शिशुक और परम बलशाली प्रवीर होंगे। ये तीनों कुल मिला कर साठ वर्ष तक राज्य करेगे। इन तौनों में राजा प्रवीर पूर्वकथित राजा विन्ध्यशक्ति का पूत्र होगा । राजा शिशुक पुरी में अन्य बोनों राजा फाञचनपुरी में राज्य करेंगे । ३६९-३७१। ये तो मों राजा लोग प्रचुर दक्षिणा देकर वाजपेय यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान करेंगे । तदनन्तर प्रवीर के चार पुत्र राज्य पद के अधिकारी होंगे। विग्ध्यक बंशीय राजाओं के परिवार के विनष्ट हो जाने पर सुप्रतीक नभीर आदि तीन वाह्वलीक राजा लोग तीस वष तक राज्य पद का उपभोग करेंगे । माहिषी वंशीयों में शक्यममा नामक एक राजा होगा । तदनन्तर पुृष्पमित्र और मित्र
verses.wordMeaning: Ksulika will be the son of Ksudraka. From Ksulika will be born Suratha. Sumitra, the son of Suratha, will be the last king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksulika will be the son of Ksudraka. From Ksulika will be born Suratha. Sumitra, the son of Suratha, will be the last king.

verses.sanskrit: सुरेषु सर्वेषु न सो ऽस्ति कश्चिन् मनुष्यलोकेषु न सो ऽस्ति कश्चित् । पश्वादिवर्गेषु न सो ऽस्ति कश्चिद् यो नांशभूतस्तव देवदेव
verses.transliteration: sureṣu sarveṣu na so 'sti kaścin manuṣyalokeṣu na so 'sti kaścit / paśvādivargeṣu na so 'sti kaścid yo nāṃśabhūtastava devadeva
verses.translation: All these mentioned are the future Iksvaku kings- in the Kali age. They will be'born in the race of Brhadbala in the Kali age. All of them will be heroic, learned and truth¬ ful. They will be the conquerors of the sense-organs.
verses.hindi: +एतदध न ग॒पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: All these mentioned are the future Iksvaku kings- in the Kali age. They will be'born in the race of Brhadbala in the Kali age. All of them will be heroic, learned and truth¬ ful. They will be the conquerors of the sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these mentioned are the future Iksvaku kings- in the Kali age. They will be'born in the race of Brhadbala in the Kali age. All of them will be heroic, learned and truth¬ ful. They will be the conquerors of the sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माम्बुधीन्दुप्रमुखानि सौम्य शक्रादिरूपाणि तवोत्तमानि । समुद्ररूपं तव धैर्यवत्सु तेजः स्वरूपेषु रविस्तथाग्निः
verses.transliteration: brahmāmbudhīndupramukhāni saumya śakrādirūpāṇi tavottamāni / samudrarūpaṃ tava dhairyavatsu tejaḥ svarūpeṣu ravistathāgniḥ
verses.translation: In this connection the following verse describing the subsequent race is cited by those who know the future. "This race of the Iksvakus will end with Sumitra. After coming to the king Sumitra, it will become extinct in the Kali age." Thus the Ksetra (domain?) originating from Manu and descending from Aila has been described.
verses.hindi: नवमवतितमोअध्याय: है५७ शकयमा नाम वे राजा माहिषोणां महीपतिः। 2 पुष्पसिश्ना भविष्यन्ति पट्टमिन्रास्त्रयोदश
verses.wordMeaning: In this connection the following verse describing the subsequent race is cited by those who know the future. "This race of the Iksvakus will end with Sumitra. After coming to the king Sumitra,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In this connection the following verse describing the subsequent race is cited by those who know the future. "This race of the Iksvakus will end with Sumitra. After coming to the king Sumitra,…

verses.sanskrit: क्षमाधनेषु क्षितिरूपमग्र्यं शीघ्रो बलवत्सु वायुः । मनुष्यरूपं तव राजवेषो मूढेषु सर्वेश्वर पादपो ऽसि
verses.transliteration: kṣamādhaneṣu kṣitirūpamagryaṃ śīghro balavatsu vāyuḥ / manuṣyarūpaṃ tava rājaveṣo mūḍheṣu sarveśvara pādapo 'si
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall mention the kings of Magadha, the descendants of Bfhadratha, i.e. the kings of the race of Jarasandha and the family of Sahadeva.
verses.hindi: मेकलायां नपा: सप्त भविष्यन्ति च सत्तमाः। फोमलायां तु राजानो भविष्यन्ति सहाबलाः
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth I shall mention the kings of Magadha, the descendants of Bfhadratha, i.e. the kings of the race of Jarasandha and the family of Sahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth I shall mention the kings of Magadha, the descendants of Bfhadratha, i.e. the kings of the race of Jarasandha and the family of Sahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वानयेष्वच्युत दानवस्त्वं सनत्सजातश्च विवेकवत्सु । रसस्वरूपेण जलस्थितो ऽसि गन्धस्वरूपं भवतो धरित्र्याम्
verses.transliteration: sarvānayeṣvacyuta dānavastvaṃ sanatsajātaśca vivekavatsu / rasasvarūpeṇa jalasthito 'si gandhasvarūpaṃ bhavato dharitryām
verses.translation: I shall mention the past, present and future kings in accordance with their importance. Even as I recount, listen and understand,
verses.hindi: नलवंशप्रसूतास्ते वीयंवन्‍्तो महाबला:। मागमावां महावीरयों विश्वस्फानिभेविष्यति उत्साद्य पार्थिवास्सर्वान्सो5न्यान्वर्णान्करिष्यति । क्तेवर्तान्पत्चकांश्वव पुलिस्दान्ब्राह्मणणस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention the past, present and future kings in accordance with their importance. Even as I recount, listen and understand,
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the past, present and future kings in accordance with their importance. Even as I recount, listen and understand,

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यस्वरूपश्च हुताशनस्त्वं स्पर्शस्वरूपं भवतः समीरे । शब्दादिकं ते नभसि स्वरूपं मन्तव्यरूपो मनसि प्रभो त्वम्
verses.transliteration: dṛśyasvarūpaśca hutāśanastvaṃ sparśasvarūpaṃ bhavataḥ samīre / śabdādikaṃ te nabhasi svarūpaṃ mantavyarūpo manasi prabho tvam
verses.translation: In the Mahabharata war Sahadeva fell. His son Somadhi, the saintly king, ruled over Girivraja.
verses.hindi: स्थापयिष्यन्ति राजानो नानादेशेषु तेजसा। विश्वस्फाणिमंहासत्वो युद्धे विष्ससमो बलो. २७६
verses.wordMeaning: In the Mahabharata war Sahadeva fell. His son Somadhi, the saintly king, ruled over Girivraja.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Mahabharata war Sahadeva fell. His son Somadhi, the saintly king, ruled over Girivraja.

verses.sanskrit: बोधस्वरूपश्च मतौ त्वमेकः सर्वत्र सर्वेश्वर सर्वभूत । पश्यामि ते नाभिसरोजमध्ये ब्रह्माणमीशं च हरं भृकुट्याम्
verses.transliteration: bodhasvarūpaśca matau tvamekaḥ sarvatra sarveśvara sarvabhūta / paśyāmi te nābhisarojamadhye brahmāṇamīśaṃ ca haraṃ bhṛkuṭyām
verses.translation: He ruled over the kingdom for fiftyeight years. His son Srutasravas ruled for sixtyfour years. Ayutayu ruled for twentysix years. Niramitra enjoyed the earth for a hundred years and passed over to heaven.
verses.hindi: विश्वस्फानिन रपति: क्लीबाकृतिरिवोच्यते । उत्सादयित्वा क्षत्र तु क्षत्रमस्यत्करिष्यति ३८० देवास्पित श्र विप्रांश्र॒ तर्पयित्वा सकृत्पुनः  जाह्नवीतीरमासाद्य शरौरं यस्यते बली संग्यस्य स्वशरीरं तु शुक्लोक॑ गमिष्यति । नवनाकारतु भोक्ष्यन्ति पुरों चम्पाव्तीं नूपा:..
verses.wordMeaning: He ruled over the kingdom for fiftyeight years. His son Srutasravas ruled for sixtyfour years. Ayutayu ruled for twentysix years. Niramitra enjoyed the earth for a hundred years and passed over to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: He ruled over the kingdom for fiftyeight years. His son Srutasravas ruled for sixtyfour years. Ayutayu ruled for twentysix years. Niramitra enjoyed the earth for a hundred years and passed over to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तवाश्विनौ कर्णगतौ समस्तास्तवास्थिता बाहुषु लोकपालाः । घ्राणो ऽनिलो नेत्रगतौ रवीन्दु जिह्वा च ते नाथ सरस्वतीयम्
verses.transliteration: tavāśvinau karṇagatau samastāstavāsthitā bāhuṣu lokapālāḥ / ghrāṇo 'nilo netragatau ravīndu jihvā ca te nātha sarasvatīyam
verses.translation: Sukrtta ruled over the earth for fiftysix years. Brhat- karman ruled the kingdom for twentythree years.
verses.hindi: तामक राजा तेरह वर्ष के लिए राजा होंगे ।३७२-३७४। मेकला में सात उत्तम नरपति गण राज्यासन प्राप्त करेंगे। कुछ महाबलशाली राजा कोमला में राज्य प्रतिष्ठापित करेंगे । तदतन्तर मेघ नाम से विख्यात नव परम बुद्धिशाली राजा होंगे। ये निषधदेशीय समस्त नृपतिगण मन्वस्तर की समाप्ति तक राज्य पद के अधिकारी रहेंगे । इनकी उत्पत्ति नल वंश से होगी, ये सब के सब महान बलझ्ाली
verses.wordMeaning: Sukrtta ruled over the earth for fiftysix years. Brhat- karman ruled the kingdom for twentythree years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukrtta ruled over the earth for fiftysix years. Brhat- karman ruled the kingdom for twentythree years.

verses.sanskrit: पादौ धरित्री जठरं समस्तांल् लोकान् हृषीकेश विलोकयामः । जङ्घे वयं पादतलाङ्गुलीषु पिशाचयक्षोरगसिद्धसङ्घाः
verses.transliteration: pādau dharitrī jaṭharaṃ samastāṃl lokān hṛṣīkeśa vilokayāmaḥ / jaṅghe vayaṃ pādatalāṅgulīṣu piśācayakṣoragasiddhasaṅghāḥ
verses.translation: Senajit enjoys the kingdom (now). (His son) Srutan- jaya will be king for forty years.
verses.hindi: एवं परम पराक्रमी होंगे । इसके उपरान्त महान बलशाली मंगधदेशीय विश्वस्फानि नामक राजा होगा ।३७५- ३७७। उस समय के अन्य नरेशों को समुल नष्ट करके वह अन्यान्य जातिवालों को राज्य पद प्रदान करेगा । जिनमें कंवर्त पझु्चक, पुलिन्द और ब्राह्मणों के नाम विशेष उल्लेखनीय हैं। महात् पराक्रमी राजा विष्वस्फानि विभिन्न देशों में इन जाति वालों का राज्य स्थापित करेगा । युद्ध में वह विष्णु के समान बलवान् होगा । ऐसा कहा जाता है कि वह राजा विश्वस्फानि आकृति में नपुसकों के समान होगा । अपने पराक्रम से क्षत्रिय जाति का विध्वंस करके वह शासन को इतर जातिवालों के अधीन कर देमा ।३७८-३८०। परमबलणशाली राजा विश्वस्फानि अपने जीवन में देवताओं, पितरों एवं ब्राह्मणों को एक बार पुन: सन्तुष्ट करके अन्तिम समय में पवित्र जाह्नवी तठ पर प्राण त्याग करेगा। अपने भौतिक शरीर
verses.wordMeaning: Senajit enjoys the kingdom (now). (His son) Srutan- jaya will be king for forty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Senajit enjoys the kingdom (now). (His son) Srutan- jaya will be king for forty years.

verses.sanskrit: पुंस्त्वे प्रजानां पतिरोष्ठयुग्मे प्रतिष्ठितास्ते क्रतवः समस्ताः । सर्वे वयं ते दशनेषु देव दंष्ट्रासु देवा ह्यभवंश्च दन्ताः
verses.transliteration: puṃstve prajānāṃ patiroṣṭhayugme pratiṣṭhitāste kratavaḥ samastāḥ / sarve vayaṃ te daśaneṣu deva daṃṣṭrāsu devā hyabhavaṃśca dantāḥ
verses.translation: Mahabala, the mighty-armed and endowed with great intellect and exploit, will become king and rule over the earth for thirtyfivc years.
verses.hindi: को त्याग कर वह इन्द्र लोक प्राप्त करेगा । उसके उपरान्त चम्पावती पुरी में नव नाग वंशीय राजाओं का अधिकार होगा। मथुरापुरी में सात नागवंशीय राजा लोग झ्ासन करेंगे । इसके अनन्तर शणंगा
verses.wordMeaning: Mahabala, the mighty-armed and endowed with great intellect and exploit, will become king and rule over the earth for thirtyfivc years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahabala, the mighty-armed and endowed with great intellect and exploit, will become king and rule over the earth for thirtyfivc years.

verses.sanskrit: रोमाण्यशेषास् तव देवसङ्घा विद्याधरा नाथ तवाङ्घ्रिरेखाः । साङ्गाः समस्तास्तव देव वेदाः समास्थिताः सन्धिषु बाहुभूताः
verses.transliteration: romāṇyaśeṣās tava devasaṅghā vidyādharā nātha tavāṅghrirekhāḥ / sāṅgāḥ samastāstava deva vedāḥ samāsthitāḥ sandhiṣu bāhubhūtāḥ
verses.translation: Suci will remain in the kingdom for fiftyeight years Ksema will be the king for full twentyeight years.
verses.hindi: एतदधंस्थान पुत्रमित्रा भविष्यन्ति पण्मित्रास्त्रयोदशेति पाठों इः पुस्तके । + इत: प्रभति साधंइलोकों नास्ति ग. पुस्तके । हैधद ः वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Suci will remain in the kingdom for fiftyeight years Ksema will be the king for full twentyeight years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suci will remain in the kingdom for fiftyeight years Ksema will be the king for full twentyeight years.

verses.sanskrit: वराहभूतं धरणीधरस्ते नृसिंहरूपं च सदा करालम् । पश्याम ते वाजिशिरस्तथोच्चैस्त्रिविक्रमे यच्च तदाप्रमेयम्
verses.transliteration: varāhabhūtaṃ dharaṇīdharaste nṛsiṃharūpaṃ ca sadā karālam / paśyāma te vājiśirastathoccaistrivikrame yacca tadāprameyam
verses.translation: Bhuvata the powerful will maintain the kingdom f 0r sixtyfour years. Then Dharmanetra will be the king for f u n five years.
verses.hindi: मथरां च पुरी रम्यां नागा भोक्ष्यन्ति सप्त वे । अनुगड्गं प्रयाग च साकेतु मगधांस्तथा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bhuvata the powerful will maintain the kingdom f 0r sixtyfour years. Then Dharmanetra will be the king for f u n five years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhuvata the powerful will maintain the kingdom f 0r sixtyfour years. Then Dharmanetra will be the king for f u n five years.

verses.sanskrit: अमी समुद्रास्तव देव देहे मौर्वालयः शैलधरास् तथामी । इमाश्च गङ्गाप्रमुखाः स्रवन्त्यो द्वीपाण्यशेषाणि वनादिदेशाः
verses.transliteration: amī samudrāstava deva dehe maurvālayaḥ śailadharās tathāmī / imāśca gaṅgāpramukhāḥ sravantyo dvīpāṇyaśeṣāṇi vanādideśāḥ
verses.translation: Njpati (?) will then enjoy the kingdom for fifty, eight years. Suvrata's rule will be for thirtyeight years.
verses.hindi: निवधान्यदुकांश्वेव शेशीतान्कालतोपकान् । एताञजनपदास्सर्वान्भोक्यन्ति मणिधान्यजा: ॥र३े८४ कोशलांश्रानभ्र पोड़ांश्व॒ ताम्नलिप्तान्ससागरानू। चम्पां चेव पुरों रम्यां भोक्ष्यन्ति देवरक्षिताम् सत्रो राष्ट्र भक्ष्यकांश्वेव भोक्ष्तते कनकाह्गुयः । तुल्यकालं भविष्यन्ति सर्वे जेते महोीक्षितः .
verses.wordMeaning: Njpati (?) will then enjoy the kingdom for fifty, eight years. Suvrata's rule will be for thirtyeight years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Njpati (?) will then enjoy the kingdom for fifty, eight years. Suvrata's rule will be for thirtyeight years.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवन्ति चेमे मुनयस्तवेश देहे स्थितास्त्वन्महिमानमग्र्यम् । त्वामीशितारं जगतामनन्तं यजन्ति यज्ञैः किल यज्ञिनो ऽमी
verses.transliteration: stuvanti ceme munayastaveśa dehe sthitāstvanmahimānamagryam / tvāmīśitāraṃ jagatāmanantaṃ yajanti yajñaiḥ kila yajñino 'mī
verses.translation: Drdhasena will be the king for forty, ten and eight (i.e. fiftyeight) years. Then Sumati will be in possession of the kingdom for thirtythree years.
verses.hindi: अल्पप्रसादा ह्ानुता महाक्रोधा ह्धामिकाः । भविष्यन्तीह यवना धर्मंत: कामतोथंतः ॥र३े८८ नव मूर्धाभिषिक्तास्ते भविष्यस्ति नराधिपा: । युगदोषादूबुराचारा भविष्यन्ति नृपास्तुते..
verses.wordMeaning: Drdhasena will be the king for forty, ten and eight (i.e. fiftyeight) years. Then Sumati will be in possession of the kingdom for thirtythree years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drdhasena will be the king for forty, ten and eight (i.e. fiftyeight) years. Then Sumati will be in possession of the kingdom for thirtythree years.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तोहि सौम्यं जगतीह किंचित् त्वत्तो न रौद्रं च समस्तमूर्ते । त्वत्तो न शीतं च न केशवोष्णं सर्वस्वरूपातिशयी त्वमेव
verses.transliteration: tvattohi saumyaṃ jagatīha kiṃcit tvatto na raudraṃ ca samastamūrte / tvatto na śītaṃ ca na keśavoṣṇaṃ sarvasvarūpātiśayī tvameva
verses.translation: Sucala will enjoy the kingdom for twentytwo years Thereafter, Sunetra will enjoy the kingdom for forty years.
verses.hindi: उदितोदितवंशास्ते डदित्तास्तसितास्तथा । भविष्यन्तीह पर्याये कालेन पृथिवीक्षितः विही नास्तु भविष्यन्ति धर्मतः कामतो5थंत: । तंविमिश्रा जनपदा स्लेच्छाचाराश्य सर्वशः .
verses.wordMeaning: Sucala will enjoy the kingdom for twentytwo years Thereafter, Sunetra will enjoy the kingdom for forty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sucala will enjoy the kingdom for twentytwo years Thereafter, Sunetra will enjoy the kingdom for forty years.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद सर्वेश्वर सर्वभूत सनातनात्मपरमेश्वरेश । त्वन्मायया मोहितमानसाभिर्यत्ते ऽपराद्धं तदिदं क्षमस्व
verses.transliteration: prasīda sarveśvara sarvabhūta sanātanātmaparameśvareśa / tvanmāyayā mohitamānasābhiryatte 'parāddhaṃ tadidaṃ kṣamasva
verses.translation: Satyajit will enjoy the earth for eightythree years. After attaining the kingdom Virajit will enjoy it for thirtyfive years.
verses.hindi: के तटवर्ती प्रान्त प्रयाग, साकेत और मगव आदि ज़नपदों में गुप्तवंशीय राजाओं का अधिकार होगा ।३८१-३८३। निधष, यदुक, शशीत, कालतोपद आदि जनपदों में मणिधान्य वंशज राजाओं का छासन होगा । कोशल, आन्ध्र, पौण्ड, समुद्रसमेत ताम्रलिप्त देवताओं द्वारा सुरक्षित मनोहारिणी चम्पानगरो-- कलिज़, महिष, महेन्द्रनिलय प्रभृति जनपदों में गुहवंशोत्पन्न राजा का राज्य होगा ।३८५४-३८६। कनक नामक
verses.wordMeaning: Satyajit will enjoy the earth for eightythree years. After attaining the kingdom Virajit will enjoy it for thirtyfive years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Satyajit will enjoy the earth for eightythree years. After attaining the kingdom Virajit will enjoy it for thirtyfive years.

verses.sanskrit: किं वापराद्धं तव देवदेव यन्मायया नो हृदयं तवापि । मायाभिशङ्किप्रणतार्तिहन्तर् मनो हि नो विह्वलतामुपैति
verses.transliteration: kiṃ vāparāddhaṃ tava devadeva yanmāyayā no hṛdayaṃ tavāpi / māyābhiśaṅkipraṇatārtihantar mano hi no vihvalatāmupaiti
verses.translation: Arinjaya will be in possesssion of the earth for fifty years. These thirtytwo kings will be the future rulers in the line of Brhadratha.
verses.hindi: राजा सौराष्ट्र (स्त्री राष्ट्र) भक्ष्यक आदि जनपदों का शासन होगा। ये सब राजा गण भी उसी एक समय में इन सब स्थानों के शासक होंगे । इनके उपरान्त थोड़े प्रसन्न होनेवाले, मिप्यावादी, महान् क्रोधी, अधा्िक प्रवृत्तियों वाले घर्माथंकाम-सभी ओर से विहीन यवनों का यहाँ पर राज्य होभा। वे यवन राजा गण कभी मूर्धामिषिक्त नहीं होंगे, युगदोष के कारण वे परम दूराचारी होंगे । कलि के अन्तिम भाग में स्त्री और बालकों का वध करनेवाले वे राजा लोग परस्पर मारकाट मचाकर पृथ्वी पर शासन करेंगे ।३५७-३९०। उन दुराचारी राजाओं के वंश कहीं पर तो अत्यन्त बढ़ जायेंगे और कहीं पर बहुत बढ़ क्र विनाश को प्राप्त हो जायगे। कालक्रम से पृथ्वी पर ऐसे दुराचारी नशंस राजाओं का शासन होगा । वे धर्माथंकाम बत्रिवर्ग से सवंदा विहीन रहेंगे। प्रत्येक जनपदों में वे म्लेच्छाचार-परायण राजा
verses.wordMeaning: Arinjaya will be in possesssion of the earth for fifty years. These thirtytwo kings will be the future rulers in the line of Brhadratha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arinjaya will be in possesssion of the earth for fifty years. These thirtytwo kings will be the future rulers in the line of Brhadratha.

verses.sanskrit: न ते ऽपराद्धं यदि ते ऽपराद्धम् अस्माभिर् उन्मार्गविवर्तिनीभिः । तत्क्षम्यतां सृष्टिकृतस्तवैव देवापराधः सृजतो विवेकम्
verses.transliteration: na te 'parāddhaṃ yadi te 'parāddham asmābhir unmārgavivartinībhiḥ / tatkṣamyatāṃ sṛṣṭikṛtastavaiva devāparādhaḥ sṛjato vivekam
verses.translation: The rule of Ajaka will be for thirtyone years. His son Vartivardhana will rule for twenty years.
verses.hindi: लोग जा जाकर मिल जायेंगे ।३६१-३६२। परिणाम स्वरूय सत्र ओर से जनपदों में भी उनके अत्याबारों की घम मच जायगी । वहाँ जाकर वे सब उलठफेर मचायेंगे, प्रजावर्ग का विनाश करेंगे । लालच में
verses.wordMeaning: The rule of Ajaka will be for thirtyone years. His son Vartivardhana will rule for twenty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rule of Ajaka will be for thirtyone years. His son Vartivardhana will rule for twenty years.

verses.sanskrit: नमो नमस्ते गोविन्द नारायण जनार्दन । त्वन्नामस्मरणात् पापमशेषं नः प्रणश्यतु
verses.transliteration: namo namaste govinda nārāyaṇa janārdana / tvannāmasmaraṇāt pāpamaśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu
verses.translation: His son will attain Girivraja in Varanasi. The suzerainty of Sisunaka (Sisunaga) will be for forty years. His son Sakavarrn* will iulc foi tlnrtysix years. Then for twenty years Ksemavarma will be the king.
verses.hindi: तेषां व्यतीते पर्याय बहुस्त्रीके युगे तदा । लवाल्‍लबं अश्यमाना आयूरूपबलथुतेः .. ॥ह्ध्ड तथा गतास्तु वे काष्ठां प्रजासु जगतीश्वराः । राजानः संप्रणश्यन्ति फालेनोपहतास्तदा. ॥रे५ कल्किनोपहताः सब स्लेच्छा यास्यन्ति सर्वशः  अधामिकाश्र तेह्त्यर्थ पाषण्डाश्चेय सवृंशः ः प्रसष्टे नृपशब्दे च-संध्याश्विष्टे कलो. युगे । किचिच्छिष्टाः प्रजास्ता वे धर्मे नष्टेडपरिग्रहाः
verses.wordMeaning: His son will attain Girivraja in Varanasi. The suzerainty of Sisunaka (Sisunaga) will be for forty years. His son Sakavarrn* will iulc foi tlnrtysix years. Then for twenty years Ksemavarma will be the king.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son will attain Girivraja in Varanasi. The suzerainty of Sisunaka (Sisunaga) will be for forty years. His son Sakavarrn* will iulc foi tlnrtysix years. Then for twenty years Ksemavarma will be the king.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽनन्त नमस् तुभ्यं विश्वात्मन्विश्वभावन । त्वन्नामस्मरणात् पापमशेषं नः प्रणश्यतु
verses.transliteration: namo 'nanta namas tubhyaṃ viśvātmanviśvabhāvana / tvannāmasmaraṇāt pāpamaśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu
verses.translation: Ajatasatru will be the king for twentyfive years. Thereafter Ksatraujas will rule the Kingdom for forty years.
verses.hindi: असाधना हताशाश्र व्याधिशोकेन पीडिताः । अनावृष्टिहताश्चेव परस्परवरधेन च ॥रेध८ अनाथा हि परित्रस्ता वार्तामुत्सृज्य बुःखिता:। त्यवत्या पुराणि ग्रामांश्न भविष्यग्ति बतोकसः ॥३६€६
verses.wordMeaning: Ajatasatru will be the king for twentyfive years. Thereafter Ksatraujas will rule the Kingdom for forty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ajatasatru will be the king for twentyfive years. Thereafter Ksatraujas will rule the Kingdom for forty years.

verses.sanskrit: वरेण्य यज्ञपुरुष प्रजापालन वामन । त्वन्नामस्मरणात् पापमशेषं नः प्रणश्यतु
verses.transliteration: vareṇya yajñapuruṣa prajāpālana vāmana / tvannāmasmaraṇāt pāpamaśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu
verses.translation: King Bimbisara will rule for twentyeight years. King Darsaka will rule for twentyfive years.
verses.hindi: वर्णाथमपरि अध्टाः संकरं घोरमास्थिता- । सरित्पर्वंतसेविन्यो भविष्यन्ति प्रजास्तता.. ४४०१ सरितः सागरानूपान्सेवन्ते पर्वतानि च। अज्भ स्कलिज्भन्वड्गांश्व काश्मी रान्‍्कोशिकोशलान् ऋषिकान्तगिरिद्रोणी: संभ्रयिष्यन्ति मानवा: । कृत्स्न हिमबतः पृष्ठ कूल च लवणास्भसः । (४०३
verses.wordMeaning: King Bimbisara will rule for twentyeight years. King Darsaka will rule for twentyfive years.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Bimbisara will rule for twentyeight years. King Darsaka will rule for twentyfive years.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते ऽब्जनाभाय प्रजापतिकृते हर । त्वन्नामस्मरणात् पापमशेषं नः प्रणश्यतु
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te 'bjanābhāya prajāpatikṛte hara / tvannāmasmaraṇāt pāpamaśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu
verses.translation: The next king will be Udayl who will rule for thirty- three years. In the fourth year of his rule, he will build his capital city named Kusumapura (Mod. Patna)'on the southern bank of Ganga.
verses.hindi: भरे हुए, मिथ्याचारण वे राजा लोग इसी प्रकार सवंदा पापकर्मों में लगे रहेंगे  कालक्रम से उनके विनाश हो जाने पर देश में स्त्रियों की अधिकता हो जायगी, लोग आयु; सौन्दयं, बल एवं क्षास्त्रज्ान में धीरे धीरे स्यून होते जायेंगे । इस प्रकार क्षीण होते होते प्रजा जब अन्तिम हास की सौमा पर पहुँच बायंगी, तब वे दुराचारी राजा लोग कालक्रम से विनाश को प्राप्त हो जायेंगे।३९३-३९५। उस समय
verses.wordMeaning: The next king will be Udayl who will rule for thirty- three years. In the fourth year of his rule, he will build his capital city named Kusumapura (Mod. Patna)'on the southern bank of Ganga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The next king will be Udayl who will rule for thirty- three years. In the fourth year of his rule, he will build his capital city named Kusumapura (Mod. Patna)'on the southern bank of Ganga.

verses.sanskrit: संसारार्णवपोताय नमस् तुभ्यमधोक्षज । त्वन्नामस्मरणात् पापमशेषं नः प्रणश्यतु
verses.transliteration: saṃsārārṇavapotāya namas tubhyamadhokṣaja / tvannāmasmaraṇāt pāpamaśeṣaṃ naḥ praṇaśyatu
verses.translation: Thus the kings of the Sisunaka (Sisunaga) dynasty will be ten in number. Theyaltogcther willrulefor three hundred andsixtytwo years.
verses.hindi: कल्कि द्वारा ताडित होकर वे अधामिक स्लेचछ सब ओर से. विनष्ठ हो जायेंगे पाषण्डों का उच्छेद हो जोयेगा। इस प्रकार सम्ध्यामात्र जब कलियुग शेष रह जायगा तो नूप शब्द ही नष्ट हो जानेगा, अर्थात् राजाओं का सबंदा अभाव हो जायेगा। कुछ प्जाएं शेष रह जायेंगी। धर्म के नष्ट हो जाने पर साधनविहोन आपत्तियों की मारी, व्याधि एवं श्लोक के कारण चिन्ताक्रुलित, अनावृष्टि ठथा परस्पर मारकाट से आतंकित और ,पीड़ित प्रजाएँ अनाथ हो जायंगी । सब ओर से. त्रस्त होकर वे जीविका विहोन हो जायंगी। अत्यन्त दुःखित होकर पुर, ग्रम एवं नगरों को छोड़कर वन में निवास बधाएँगी ।६६६-२६६॥) इस प्रकार राजाओं के विनाश होने पर प्रजाएँ. अपना घर छोड़ कर भाग जायेगी । स्नेह भावना नष्ट हो जायगी, आपत्तियों से दलित होकर स्‍्नेहियों तथा सुहदों को छोड़ देंगी ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the kings of the Sisunaka (Sisunaga) dynasty will be ten in number. Theyaltogcther willrulefor three hundred andsixtytwo years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the kings of the Sisunaka (Sisunaga) dynasty will be ten in number. Theyaltogcther willrulefor three hundred andsixtytwo years.

verses.sanskrit: नमः परस्मै श्रीशाय वासुदेवाय वेधसे । स्वेच्छया गुणयुक्ताय सर्गस्थित्यन्तकारिणे
verses.transliteration: namaḥ parasmai śrīśāya vāsudevāya vedhase / svecchayā guṇayuktāya sargasthityantakāriṇe
verses.translation: All the members of the Saisunaka (Saisunaga) family will be the contemporaries of the following kings who will be kinsmen to Ksatriyas.
verses.hindi: वर्णाक्रम धर्म का विनास हो जायगा, वे धोर संकर वर्ण हो जायँगी। पर्वतों की ग्रुफाओं ओर नदियों के एकास्त तटों पर वे निबास करेंगी ।४००-४०१। घर द्वार छोड़ कर सारी प्रजाएँ समुद्र॒तट, नदियों, पर्बतों एवं जलीय प्रान्तों में निवासार्थ भाग जायेंगी। सारी मानव जाति अपने अपने प्रियदेशों को छोड़कर बज़, कलिज्र, बज़, फाशमीर, काशी, कोशल, ऋषिक, गिरिद्रोणी प्रभृति प्रास्तों में आश्रम
verses.wordMeaning: All the members of the Saisunaka (Saisunaga) family will be the contemporaries of the following kings who will be kinsmen to Ksatriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the members of the Saisunaka (Saisunaga) family will be the contemporaries of the following kings who will be kinsmen to Ksatriyas.

verses.sanskrit: उपसंहर विश्वात्मन्रूपमेतत्सनातनम् । वर्धमानं न नो द्रष्टुं समर्थं चक्षुरीश्वर
verses.transliteration: upasaṃhara viśvātmanrūpametatsanātanam / vardhamānaṃ na no draṣṭuṃ samarthaṃ cakṣurīśvara
verses.translation: Those are twentyfour Iksvaku kings, twentyfive Paricalas, twentyfour Kalakas, twentyfour Haihayas, thirtytwo Kalihgas, twentyfive Sakas, twentysix Kurus, twentyeight Maithilas, twentythree Surasenas and twenty Vltihotras. All these kings will rule simultaneously.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करेंगी । आयंलोग स्लेच्छों के साथ सारी हिमवान् को पृष्ठ भूमि, क्षार समुद्र के तटबर्ती प्रान्तों बीजान्नानि तथा निम्नेष्वोहन्त: काष्ठशड्कुमिः  अजेडक खरोष्ट्रं च पालयिष्यस्ति यत्नंतः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Those are twentyfour Iksvaku kings, twentyfive Paricalas, twentyfour Kalakas, twentyfour Haihayas, thirtytwo Kalihgas, twentyfive Sakas, twentysix Kurus, twentyeight Maithilas, twentythree Surasenas and twenty Vltihotras. All these kings will rule simultaneously.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those are twentyfour Iksvaku kings, twentyfive Paricalas, twentyfour Kalakas, twentyfour Haihayas, thirtytwo Kalihgas, twentyfive Sakas, twentysix Kurus, twentyeight Maithilas, twentythree Surasenas and twenty Vltihotras. All these kings will rule simultaneously.

verses.sanskrit: प्रलयाग्निसहस्रस्य समा दीप्तिस्तवाच्युत । प्रमाणेन दिशो भूमिर्गगनं च समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: pralayāgnisahasrasya samā dīptistavācyuta / pramāṇena diśo bhūmirgaganaṃ ca samāvṛtam
verses.translation: Mahapadma will be born ofaSudra wife of Maha¬ nandin. He will be a king over all Ksatriyas.
verses.hindi: नदोवत्स्यन्ति तोयार्थे कूलमाशित्य मानयजाः । पार्थिवान्व्यवहारेण विब्वाधन्तः परस्परम् ४०७ बह्नृपत्या: प्रजाहीना: शोचाचार विवर्जिता: । एवं भविष्यन्ति नरास्तदा5धर्मे व्यवस्थिताः ४०८ हीनाद्वीनांस्तथा धर्मान्प्रजा समनुवतंते । आयुस्तदा त्रयोविश न कश्विदतिवतंते ४०६
verses.wordMeaning: Mahapadma will be born ofaSudra wife of Maha¬ nandin. He will be a king over all Ksatriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahapadma will be born ofaSudra wife of Maha¬ nandin. He will be a king over all Ksatriyas.

verses.sanskrit: न विद्मः कुत्र वर्तामो भवान्नाथोपलक्ष्यते । सर्वं जगदिऐकस्थं पिण्डितं लक्षयामहे
verses.transliteration: na vidmaḥ kutra vartāmo bhavānnāthopalakṣyate / sarvaṃ jagadiaikasthaṃ piṇḍitaṃ lakṣayāmahe
verses.translation: Thereafter all the future kings will be born of Sudra wombs. Mahapadma will be the sole ruler with a single royal umbrella.
verses.hindi: वत््ययंमभिलिप्सन्तश्ररिष्यन्ति वसुंधराम् । एतत्कालमनृप्राप्ताः प्रजा: कलियुगान्तके ४११ क्षीणे कलियुगे तस्मिन्दिव्ये वर्षतहस्नके । निःशेषास्तु भविष्यन्ति सार्ध कलियुगेन तु ॥ एवं भीषण अरण्यों में म्गों, मत्स्यों पक्षिया एवं अन्यान्य हिल जन्तुओं के साथ साथ मधु, शाक, मूल, फलादि खा-खाकर जीबन यापन करेंगे ।४०२-४०४। वे मुनियों की भाँति वक्ष के वल्कलों, मृगचर्मों एवं पत्तों के चोर अपने हाथों से बना बना कर धारण करेंगे। निम्न प्रान्तों में अन्न के बीजों का अन्वेषण करते हुए वे लोग काष्ठ और दांकुओं द्वारा जीविका अर्जित करेंगे । बकरो, भेड़, गधे और ऊंटों का
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter all the future kings will be born of Sudra wombs. Mahapadma will be the sole ruler with a single royal umbrella.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter all the future kings will be born of Sudra wombs. Mahapadma will be the sole ruler with a single royal umbrella.

verses.sanskrit: किं वर्णयामो रूपं ते किं प्रमाणमिदं हरे । माहात्म्यं किं नु ते देव यज्जिह्वाया न गोचरे
verses.transliteration: kiṃ varṇayāmo rūpaṃ te kiṃ pramāṇamidaṃ hare / māhātmyaṃ kiṃ nu te deva yajjihvāyā na gocare
verses.translation: He will rule over the earth for twentyeight years.
verses.hindi: यत्नपुर्वक पालन करेंगे ४०५-४०६। जल के लिये नदियों के किनारे निवास बनाएँगे। राजाओं में परस्पर वमनस्थ का बोज बोएंगे। किन्‍्हीं किन्‍्हीं को सन्‍तानों की अधिकता हो जायगी, किन्‍्हीं किन्‍्हीं को सश्तानें एकदम न रहेंगी. पवित्रता एवं आचार का स्थान एकदस से उनमें विलुप्त हो जायगा । उस समय अधमं में पड़ी हुई मानव जाति इस प्रकार की हो जायेगी। लोग निकृष्ट से भी निदकृष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: He will rule over the earth for twentyeight years.
verses.commentary: Sense: He will rule over the earth for twentyeight years.

verses.sanskrit: वक्तारो वायुतेनापि बुद्धीनामयुतायुतैः । गुणनिर्वर्णनं नाथ कर्तुं तव न शक्यते
verses.transliteration: vaktāro vāyutenāpi buddhīnāmayutāyutaiḥ / guṇanirvarṇanaṃ nātha kartuṃ tava na śakyate
verses.translation: His sons will be thousands. For eight years twelve of them will rule as kings. In succession to Ivlahapadma they will become kings in order.
verses.hindi: तर अधरमंमय कार्यों में अनु रक्त हो जायेंगे । उस समय तेईस वर्ष से बढ़कर किसी की आयु न होगी ।४०७-४० ६। दुबंलाज़ू, विषयलोलुप, वृद्धता से दबाए हुए पत्ते, मूल, फूल, फल का आहार करनेवाले, चौर एवं कृष्ण मृग चर्म के पहिनने वाले वे लोग जीविका के लिये सारी पृथ्वी का भ्रमण करेंगे। कलियुग फ्रे अन्त में प्रजाएं इस प्रकार की विविध आपत्तियों में प्रस्त हो जयँंगी- ।४१०-४११॥ एक सहस्न वर्षात्मक उस कलियुग के क्षीण हो जाने पर उस समय की सारी प्रजाएँ भी उसी के साथ सर्वाशतः
verses.wordMeaning: His sons will be thousands. For eight years twelve of them will rule as kings. In succession to Ivlahapadma they will become kings in order.
verses.commentary: Sense: His sons will be thousands. For eight years twelve of them will rule as kings. In succession to Ivlahapadma they will become kings in order.

verses.sanskrit: तदेतद्दर्शितं रूपं प्रसादः परमः कृतः । छन्दतो जगतामीश तदेतदुपसंहर
verses.transliteration: tadetaddarśitaṃ rūpaṃ prasādaḥ paramaḥ kṛtaḥ / chandato jagatāmīśa tadetadupasaṃhara
verses.translation: Kautilya will exterminate all of them by means of the twice eight of them (sixteen). After enjoying the kingdom of the earth 1 for a hundred years, the moon in the form of Nanda will set and fall down.
verses.hindi: इतः प्रभ्ृति साधेश्लोको नास्ति घ. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Kautilya will exterminate all of them by means of the twice eight of them (sixteen). After enjoying the kingdom of the earth 1 for a hundred years, the moon in the form of Nanda will set and fall down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kautilya will exterminate all of them by means of the twice eight of them (sixteen). After enjoying the kingdom of the earth 1 for a hundred years, the moon in the form of Nanda will set and fall down.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: इत्येवं संस्तुतस् ताभिर् अप्सरोभिर् जनार्दनः । दिव्यज्ञानोपपन्नानां तासां प्रत्यक्षमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ityevaṃ saṃstutas tābhir apsarobhir janārdanaḥ / divyajñānopapannānāṃ tāsāṃ pratyakṣamīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Kautilya will instal Candragupta as king. Kin» Candragupta will be ruling for twentyfour years.
verses.hindi: यदा चन्द्रश्च सुयंश्व तथा तिष्यब॒हस्पती । एकराज्रे भविष्यन्ति तदा क्ृतयुगं भवेत् ॥ैडश्३ एप वंशक्रम: कृत्स्न कीतितो वो यथाक्रमम् । अतीता वर्तमानाश्च तथेवानागताश्च ये धडश्ड महादेवाभिषेफात्तु जन्म यावत्परीक्षितः । एतद्रषंसह्त्न तु ज्ञेयं पश्चाशदुत्तरम् श्र एत्कालास्तरं भाग्या अन्ध्रान्ता ये प्रकीतिताः। भविष्येस्तत्र संस्याता: पुराण: श्रुतपिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: Kautilya will instal Candragupta as king. Kin» Candragupta will be ruling for twentyfour years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kautilya will instal Candragupta as king. Kin» Candragupta will be ruling for twentyfour years.

verses.sanskrit: विवेश सर्वभूतानि स्वैरंशैर्भूतभावनः । तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वभूतेषु लीयमानमधोक्षजम्
verses.transliteration: viveśa sarvabhūtāni svairaṃśairbhūtabhāvanaḥ / taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvabhūteṣu līyamānamadhokṣajam
verses.translation: Bhadrasara {?), the next king, will be king for twentyfive years. King Asoka will rule over the men for twenty- six years.
verses.hindi: सा सा दिव्या स्मृता षष्टिविव्याह्वाश्चेव संप्तभिः । तेभ्यः प्रवतंते कालो दिव्यः सप्तर्षिभिस्तु तेः ॥। सप्तर्षोणां तु ये पूर्वा दृश्यन्ते उत्तरादिशि  ततो मध्येन च क्षेत्र दृश्यते यत्समं दिवि
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadrasara {?), the next king, will be king for twentyfive years. King Asoka will rule over the men for twenty- six years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadrasara {?), the next king, will be king for twentyfive years. King Asoka will rule over the men for twenty- six years.

verses.sanskrit: विस्मयं परमं चक्रुः समस्ता देवयोषितः । स च सर्वेश्वरः शैलान्पादपान्सागरान्भुवम्
verses.transliteration: vismayaṃ paramaṃ cakruḥ samastā devayoṣitaḥ / sa ca sarveśvaraḥ śailānpādapānsāgarānbhuvam
verses.translation: His son Kunala will rule for eight years. Kunala's son Bandhupalita will enjoy the kingdom for eight years.
verses.hindi: नष्ट हो जायेंगी और इस प्रकार संध्या समेत कलियुग के व्यतीत हो जाने पर कतयुग की प्रवृत्ति होगी। जिस समय चन्द्रमा, सूय, पुष्य भौर वृहस्पति--ये सब एक राशि पर होंगे, उस समय कूतयुग को प्रवृत्ति  . होगी ।४१२-४१३॥ अतीत, वर्तमान एवं भविष्यत्कालीन राजाओं के वेशों को क्रमानुसार मैं आप लोगों को बतला चुका राजा परीक्षित् के जन्म से लेकर महापझ्म के अभिषेक तक का समय एक सहल्त पचास वर्ष जानना चाहिए । पुराणों के जाननेवाले वदिकुशानसम्पन्न ऋषियों ने महापक्च के शासनकाल से लेकर अभ्पभ्रों के अन्त तक का काल आठ सौ उन्‍्तीस वर्ष का बतलाया है । सप्तषिगण एक-एक नक्षत्र में एक-एक सौ वर्ष क्रमानुसार अवस्थित रहते हैं । इस प्रकार समस्त नक्षत्र मण्डल में वे सत्ताईस सौ वर्ष स्थित .
verses.wordMeaning: His son Kunala will rule for eight years. Kunala's son Bandhupalita will enjoy the kingdom for eight years.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son Kunala will rule for eight years. Kunala's son Bandhupalita will enjoy the kingdom for eight years.

verses.sanskrit: जलमग्निं तथा वायुम् आकाशं च विवेश ह । काले दिक्ष्वथ सर्वात्म ह्य् आत्मनश्चान्यथापि च
verses.transliteration: jalamagniṃ tathā vāyum ākāśaṃ ca viveśa ha / kāle dikṣvatha sarvātma hy ātmanaścānyathāpi ca
verses.translation: Bandhupalita's successor Indrapalita will rule for ten years (?) King Devavarma will be king for seven years.
verses.hindi: रहते हैं। पर्यायक्रम से एक-एक नक्षत्र में एक-एक सौ वर्ष की स्थिति का काल उनका उनका एक-एक युत कहलाता है । यह युग दिव्य संख्या से निर्णीत होता है ।४९४-४१६। दिव्य साठ वर्षों तथा सात दिनों का सप्त- थियों का एक सौ वर्ष द्वोता है। सप्तर्षिगणों के इस प्रकार के ग्रतिक्रम में दिव्यकाल का प्रवर्तन होता है। सप्तर्विगण प्रथमतः नक्षत्र मण्डल के पूर्व दिशा की ओर पर्चात उत्तर दिशा की ओर दिखाई पढ़ते हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Bandhupalita's successor Indrapalita will rule for ten years (?) King Devavarma will be king for seven years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bandhupalita's successor Indrapalita will rule for ten years (?) King Devavarma will be king for seven years.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मरूपस्थितं स्वेन महिम्ना भावयञ्जगत् । देवदानवरक्षांसि यक्षीविद्याधरोरगाः
verses.transliteration: ātmarūpasthitaṃ svena mahimnā bhāvayañjagat / devadānavarakṣāṃsi yakṣīvidyādharoragāḥ
verses.translation: King Satadbara, his son, will rule for eight years. King Brhaaasva will be the ruler for seven years.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर आकाश के मध्यभाग में जो नक्षत्र दिखाई पड़ता है, उसके समानान्‍्तर दिखाई पड़ता है । उसके साथ आकाश में सप्तधिगणों को सौ वर्षों तक स्थित जानना चाहिए? नक्षत्रों एवं ऋषियों के साथ योग .. इतः मभृति पर्यायेण शर्त शतमित्यश्तग्रन्थों ग. पुस्तके न विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: King Satadbara, his son, will rule for eight years. King Brhaaasva will be the ruler for seven years.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Satadbara, his son, will rule for eight years. King Brhaaasva will be the ruler for seven years.

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यपशुकीटादिमृगपश्वन्तरिक्षगाः । ये ऽन्तरिक्षे तथा भूमौ दिवि ये च जलाश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: manuṣyapaśukīṭādimṛgapaśvantarikṣagāḥ / ye 'ntarikṣe tathā bhūmau divi ye ca jalāśrayāḥ
verses.translation: These are the nine kings who will enjoy the earth. The earth will be in their possession for full one hundred and thirty seven years. 2
verses.hindi: दर ..... वायुपुरांणम्
verses.wordMeaning: These are the nine kings who will enjoy the earth. The earth will be in their possession for full one hundred and thirty seven years. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the nine kings who will enjoy the earth. The earth will be in their possession for full one hundred and thirty seven years. 2

verses.sanskrit: तान्विवेश स विश्वात्मा पुनस्तद्रूपम् आस्थितः । नरेण सार्धं यत् ताभिर् दृष्टपूर्वम् अरिन्दम
verses.transliteration: tānviveśa sa viśvātmā punastadrūpam āsthitaḥ / nareṇa sārdhaṃ yat tābhir dṛṣṭapūrvam arindama
verses.translation: The general Puspamitra will drive out Byhadratha and will rule over the kingdom continuously for sixty years.
verses.hindi: सप्तर्षयो मधायुक्ताः काले पारिक्षिते शतम् । अन्क्रांशे सचतुविंशे भविष्यन्ति मते मम इमास्तवा तु प्रकृतिव््यापत्स्पन्ति प्रजा भृशम् । अनृतोपहताः सर्वा धर्मतः कामतो5थंतः
verses.wordMeaning: The general Puspamitra will drive out Byhadratha and will rule over the kingdom continuously for sixty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: The general Puspamitra will drive out Byhadratha and will rule over the kingdom continuously for sixty years.

verses.sanskrit: ताः परं विस्मयं जग्मुः सर्वास्त्रिदशयोषितः । प्रणेमुः साध्वसात् पाण्डुवदना नृपसत्तम
verses.transliteration: tāḥ paraṃ vismayaṃ jagmuḥ sarvāstridaśayoṣitaḥ / praṇemuḥ sādhvasāt pāṇḍuvadanā nṛpasattama
verses.translation: The sons of Puspamitra will be kings for eight years. The eldest of all of them will be the king for seven years.
verses.hindi: श्रौतस्मातें प्रशिथिले धर्मे वर्णाअमे तदा । संकरं बुबंलात्मानः प्रतिपत्स्यन्ति मोहिताः ४४२५
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Puspamitra will be kings for eight years. The eldest of all of them will be the king for seven years.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Puspamitra will be kings for eight years. The eldest of all of them will be the king for seven years.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणो ऽपि भगवानाह तास्त्रिदशाङ्गनाः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇo 'pi bhagavānāha tāstridaśāṅganāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter Vasumitra, his son, will be king for ten years. Then Dhruka (?), his son, will rule for two years.
verses.hindi: दिव्यं वर्षसहस्नं तु तत्संध्यांशं प्रकीतितम् । निःशेषे च तदा तस्मिन्क्ृतं बे प्रतिपत्स्यते ऐल इक्वाकुवंशश्य सह भेदे: प्रकोतितो । इक्वाकोस्तु स्पृतः क्षत्रः सुमित्रान्त विवस्वतः
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter Vasumitra, his son, will be king for ten years. Then Dhruka (?), his son, will rule for two years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Vasumitra, his son, will be king for ten years. Then Dhruka (?), his son, will rule for two years.

verses.sanskrit: नारायण उवाच: नीयतामुर्वशी भद्रा यत्रासौ त्रिदशेश्वरः । भवतीनां हितार्थाय सर्वभूतेष्वसाविति
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇa uvāca: nīyatāmurvaśī bhadrā yatrāsau tridaśeśvaraḥ / bhavatīnāṃ hitārthāya sarvabhūteṣvasāviti
verses.translation: Instead of bhuktva mahim hereof, Pargiter's suggestion (Dynasties of the Koh Age, p 26) <bhuktamahV -the earth that was-enjoyed (for 100
verses.hindi: ऐलं क्षत्रं क्षेमकास्तं सोमबंशविदों विदुः  एते विवस्व॒तः पुत्राः कोतिताः कीतिवर्धनाः
verses.wordMeaning: Instead of bhuktva mahim hereof, Pargiter's suggestion (Dynasties of the Koh Age, p 26) <bhuktamahV -the earth that was-enjoyed (for 100
verses.commentary: Sense: Instead of bhuktva mahim hereof, Pargiter's suggestion (Dynasties of the Koh Age, p 26) <bhuktamahV -the earth that was-enjoyed (for 100

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानमुत्पादितं भूयो लयं भूतेषु कुर्वता । तद्गच्छध्वं समस्तो ऽयं भूतग्रामो मदंशकः
verses.transliteration: jñānamutpāditaṃ bhūyo layaṃ bhūteṣu kurvatā / tadgacchadhvaṃ samasto 'yaṃ bhūtagrāmo madaṃśakaḥ
verses.translation: After him the Pulindakas will rule for three years. King Ghosasuta too will rule for three years.
verses.hindi: . होने का यही निदर्शन है। हमारे मत से राजा परीक्षित के राजत्वकाल में सप्तषिगण एक सौ वर्ष के लिए मंघा नक्षत्र में स्थित होंगे, अंन्ध्रवंशीय राजा की समाप्ति के बाद वे चौबीसवें नक्षत्र (शतमिषा) में स्थित . रहेंगे ।४२०-४११३॥ उस समय पृथ्दी पर सारो प्रंजाएँ अनेक प्रकार की विपत्तियों में पिस जायंगी। मिथ्याचार - परायण होकर पधर्मा्ण काम विहीत हो जायेगी । शास्त्रीय भ्रौत समा कर्मों का हास हो जायगा, वर्णाश्रम धर्म . की बर्कादा लुप्त हो जायगी, दुबंलात्मा सानव अज्ञान में पड़कर संकरवर्ण हो जायेंगे । शूद्र लोग .दिजातियों के साथ: हिलमिल जायेंगे, ब्राह्मण शुद्रों के घर जाकर यज्ञ कराने लगेंगे, शुद्र लोग सस्त्र कर्ता बन जाय॑गे। जीविका के लोभ से ब्राह्मण उन शुद्रों की उपासना करने लगेंगे, सारी प्रजा धीरे-धीरे हास को प्राप्त होने लगेगी ओर इसी प्रकार युग को समाप्ति हो जाने पर वह भी क्षीण हो जायगी।
verses.wordMeaning: After him the Pulindakas will rule for three years. King Ghosasuta too will rule for three years.
verses.commentary: Sense: After him the Pulindakas will rule for three years. King Ghosasuta too will rule for three years.

verses.sanskrit: अहमद्यात्मभूतस्य वासुदेवस्य योगिनः । अस्मात्परतरं नास्ति यो ऽनन्तः परिपथ्यते
verses.transliteration: ahamadyātmabhūtasya vāsudevasya yoginaḥ / asmātparataraṃ nāsti yo 'nantaḥ paripathyate
verses.translation: Thereafter* Vikramamitra will be king for many years. King Bhagavata will rule for thirtytwo years.
verses.hindi: जिस दिन भगवान् स्वगंवासी होते हैं, उसी दिन कलियुग की प्रवृत्ति होती है, डसकी अवधि की संल्या सुत्तिये । मानव मान से तीन लाख साठ सहस्त वर्षों का कलियुग कहा जाता हैं ।४२४-४२६। उसका सर्ध्यांश देव मान से एक सहलस्त वर्ष कहा जाता है। कलियुग को समाप्ति हो जाने पर कृतयुग का प्रारम्भ होता है इला ओर इश्याकु के वक्षों को, उनके पारस्परिक भेदों के साथ, हम बतला चुके, इक्ष्वाकु के वंश में जिन क्षत्रियों
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter* Vikramamitra will be king for many years. King Bhagavata will rule for thirtytwo years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter* Vikramamitra will be king for many years. King Bhagavata will rule for thirtytwo years.

verses.sanskrit: तमजं सर्वभूतेशं जानीत परमं पदम् । अहं भवत्यो देवाश्च मनुष्याः पशवश्च ये । एतत्सर्वमनन्तस्य वासुदेवस्य वै कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tamajaṃ sarvabhūteśaṃ jānīta paramaṃ padam / ahaṃ bhavatyo devāśca manuṣyāḥ paśavaśca ye / etatsarvamanantasya vāsudevasya vai kṛtam
verses.translation: His son K$emabhumi will rule for ten years. Ten Tuhga (? Sunga) kings will enjoy the earth.
verses.hindi: का आविर्भाव हुआ, वे सब राजा सुमित्र के अन्त पर्यन्त रहे, सुमित्र के बाद सूर्य पुत्र इक्ष्वाकु के वंश का मवसान हो जाता है। चन्द्रवंश के इतिहास को जानने वाले लोग इला के वंश को राजा क्षेमक के अन्त तक जानते हैं । सूर्य के कीतिशाली इन पुत्रों का वर्णन किया जा चुका ।४३०-४३२। इसके अतिरिक्त उन सबों नवनवतितमोध्ष्यायः चर ३ आय मा ॥॒ .. है६रे
verses.wordMeaning: His son K$emabhumi will rule for ten years. Ten Tuhga (? Sunga) kings will enjoy the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son K$emabhumi will rule for ten years. Ten Tuhga (? Sunga) kings will enjoy the earth.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा समं सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् । सपश्वादिगुणं चैव द्रष्टव्यं त्रिदशाङ्गनाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā samaṃ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam / sapaśvādiguṇaṃ caiva draṣṭavyaṃ tridaśāṅganāḥ
verses.translation: (Defective verse) They will enjoy the earth for full hundred and twelve years and it perhaps will go to Sudcva who will not be a (born) king but an indulgent fellow ever since his childhood. He will then become a king.
verses.hindi: पुनरक्तबहुत्वाज्च न मया परिकोतता: । वेवस्वतेइस्तरे ह्मस्मिन्निमिवंशः समाप्यते... ४३४५
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) They will enjoy the earth for full hundred and twelve years and it perhaps will go to Sudcva who will not be a (born) king but an indulgent fellow ever since his childhood. He will then become a king.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) They will enjoy the earth for full hundred and twelve years and it perhaps will go to Sudcva who will not be a (born) king but an indulgent fellow ever since his childhood. He will then become a king.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: इत्युक्तास् तेन देवेन समस्तास्ताः सुरस्त्रियः । प्रणम्य तौ समदनाः सवसन्ताश्च पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ityuktās tena devena samastāstāḥ surastriyaḥ / praṇamya tau samadanāḥ savasantāśca pārthiva
verses.translation: There will be another king Dcvabhumi among the Srngas (? Sungas). He will be aKanthayana (Kanvayana— 'Belonging to Kanva gotra') and will rule for nine years.
verses.hindi: देवाषि: पौरवो राजा इक््वाकोश्चेब यो मतः। महायोगबलोपेत: कलापग्राममास्थित:.. हड३े७ देवापिः पौरवो राजा इक्ष्याकोस्तु भविष्यति । एतो क्षत्रप्रणेतारो चतुबिंशे चतुयुगे .. वपडेडेध न च॒ विशे युगे सोमवंशस्या5४विभंविष्यति । देवापिरसपत्नस्तु ऐलादिभेविता नूपः.... कड़े. क्षत्रप्रवर्तकों होतो भविष्येते चतुर्यंगे । एवं सर्वत्र बिज्ञेयं संतानाथं तु लकक्षणम् . डंडे गोत्रा्णा क्षत्रियाणां च भविष्येते प्रदर्तको । हापरांशे न तिष्ठन्ति क्षत्रिया ऋषिभिः सह
verses.wordMeaning: There will be another king Dcvabhumi among the Srngas (? Sungas). He will be aKanthayana (Kanvayana— 'Belonging to Kanva gotra') and will rule for nine years.
verses.commentary: Sense: There will be another king Dcvabhumi among the Srngas (? Sungas). He will be aKanthayana (Kanvayana— 'Belonging to Kanva gotra') and will rule for nine years.

verses.sanskrit: आदाय चोर्वशीं भूयो देवराजमुपागताः । आचख्युश्च यथावृत्तं देवराजाय तत्तथा
verses.transliteration: ādāya corvaśīṃ bhūyo devarājamupāgatāḥ / ācakhyuśca yathāvṛttaṃ devarājāya tattathā
verses.translation: Bhutimitra, his son, will be king for twentyfour years. After him king Narayana will rule for twelve years.
verses.hindi: काले कृतयुगे चेव क्षीणे त्रेतायुगे पुनः  बीजार्थ ते भविष्यन्ति ब्रह्मक्षश्रस्थ व पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: Bhutimitra, his son, will be king for twentyfour years. After him king Narayana will rule for twelve years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhutimitra, his son, will be king for twentyfour years. After him king Narayana will rule for twelve years.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: तथा त्वमपि राजेन्द्र सर्वभूतेषु केशवम् । चिन्तयन्समतां गच्छ समतैव हि मुक्तये
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tathā tvamapi rājendra sarvabhūteṣu keśavam / cintayansamatāṃ gaccha samataiva hi muktaye
verses.translation: His son Susanna will rule for ten years. These four kings of lofty activities will be Kanthayana (Kanvayana) Brahmanas. They will make the vassals bow down to them. They will rule for fortyfive years. After the change of their rule, Andhras will come in.
verses.hindi: एथसेव तु सर्वेषु तिष्ठस्तीहान्तरेषु वे। सप्तर्षयो न्पेः साथ संतानार्थ युगे युगे.. (४४४ के वंश में अतीत, वर्तमान एयं भविष्यत्कालीन ब्राह्मणों, क्षत्रियाँ, बश्यों और शुद्रों का भी बर्णव किया गया। प्रत्येक युगों में सहलों लाखों की संख्या में महान् पराक्रम शाली, बुद्धिमान् एवं जितेन्द्रिय राजा लोग उत्पन्न हो गये हैं, बहुत अधिक हो जाने तथा पुनरुक्ति के कारण उनकी संख्या प्रह्येक कुल के अनुसार मैंने महीं बतलाई । इस वैवस्वत मन्वन्तर में निम्िवंश की समाप्ति हो जाती है ।४३३-४३५। इस वतंमान युग में जिस
verses.wordMeaning: His son Susanna will rule for ten years. These four kings of lofty activities will be Kanthayana (Kanvayana) Brahmanas. They will make the vassals bow down to them. They will rule for fortyfive years. After the change of their rule, Andhras will come in.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son Susanna will rule for ten years. These four kings of lofty activities will be Kanthayana (Kanvayana) Brahmanas. They will make the vassals bow down to them. They will rule for fortyfive years. After the change of their rule, Andhras will come in.

verses.sanskrit: राजन्नेवं विशेषेण भूतेषु परमेश्वरम् । वासुदेव कथं दोषांल् लोभादीन्न प्रहास्यसि
verses.transliteration: rājannevaṃ viśeṣeṇa bhūteṣu parameśvaram / vāsudeva kathaṃ doṣāṃl lobhādīnna prahāsyasi
verses.translation: Driving out Kanthayanas (Kanvayanas), over¬ powering Susarman and making the remaining forces of the Srrigas (? Surigas) dwindle down, Sindhuka of the Andhra race will gain possession of the earth.
verses.hindi: प्रकार इन क्षत्रियों की उत्पत्ति होगी, उसे मैं बतला रहा हूँ, सुनिये । पौरववंशीय देवापि नामक राजा जो महान् योगाध्यासी होगा, कलाफ ग्राम में निवास करेगा, इसी प्रकार इक्ष्वाकुबंशीय सोमपुत्र सुवर्चा नामक एक राजा होगा । चौबौसवें युग में ये दो परम वीर « राजा क्षत्रिय धर्म का प्रवर्तेन करनेवाले होंगे ।४३७-४३८। बोसवें (?) द युग में चन्द्रवश का आदिम राजा कोई न होगा। देवापि बिना किसी की प्रतिदवन्द्रिता एवं वेरभावना के ऐल वंश
verses.wordMeaning: Driving out Kanthayanas (Kanvayanas), over¬ powering Susarman and making the remaining forces of the Srrigas (? Surigas) dwindle down, Sindhuka of the Andhra race will gain possession of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Driving out Kanthayanas (Kanvayanas), over¬ powering Susarman and making the remaining forces of the Srrigas (? Surigas) dwindle down, Sindhuka of the Andhra race will gain possession of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतानि गोविन्दाद् यदा नान्यानि भूपते । तदा वैरादयो भावाः क्रियताम् न तु पुत्रक
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtāni govindād yadā nānyāni bhūpate / tadā vairādayo bhāvāḥ kriyatām na tu putraka
verses.translation: King Sindhuka will rule for twentythree years. After him Bhata (Krsna) will rule for ten and eight years (?) His son, Srlsatakarni will be very great. Satakarni will rule for fifty and six years,
verses.hindi: का प्रथम राजा होगा । चारों यूगों के लिए ये दो राजा क्षत्रिय धर्म के प्रंवतक होंगे । क्षत्रियगुण, धर्म, स्वभाववाली सन्‍्तानों के लिए इन्हीं दोनों राजाओं को मूलरूप जानना: चाहिए। तथा कथित कलियुग के व्यतीत हो जाने पर जब पुनः सतयुग का प्रारम्भ होगा, तब विख्यात सप्त्ियों के साथ ये दोनों क्षत्रिय ; गोत्र के प्रवर्तकों के रूप में जन्म धारण करेंगे  इसी प्रकार त्रेतांयुग के प्रारम्भिक काल में पुनः जन्म धारण करेंगे  हापरांश में न॒ तो क्षत्रिय रहेंगे न ऋषिगण रहेंगे ।४३९-४४२। सतयुग और त्रेतायुग के क्षोण होने पर वे ऋषि तथा राजपिगण ब्राहाणों एवं क्षत्रियों के वंशों के बीज रूप होकर उत्पन्न होंगे ।४४३। सभी मन्वस्तरों में इसी प्रकार सप्तविगण क्षत्रिय राजाओं के साथ स्थित रहते हैं। और प्रत्येकयुग में इसी प्रकार सन्तति उत्पन्न «
verses.wordMeaning: King Sindhuka will rule for twentythree years. After him Bhata (Krsna) will rule for ten and eight years (?) His son, Srlsatakarni will be very great. Satakarni will rule for fifty and six years,
verses.commentary: Sense: King Sindhuka will rule for twentythree years. After him Bhata (Krsna) will rule for ten and eight years (?) His son, Srlsatakarni will be very great. Satakarni will rule for fifty and six years,

verses.sanskrit: इति पश्य जगत्सर्वं वासुदेवात्मकं नृप । एतदेव हि कृष्णेन रूपमाविष्कृतं नृप
verses.transliteration: iti paśya jagatsarvaṃ vāsudevātmakaṃ nṛpa / etadeva hi kṛṣṇena rūpamāviṣkṛtaṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: Apadabaddha, his son, will rule (first) for ten years, (then) for twentyfour years and (then) for six years.
verses.hindi: है६४ कर बायुपुराणम् क्षत्रस्येव समुच्छेद: संबन्धों वे द्विजे: स्पृतः । सन्वन्तराजां सप्तानां संतानाश्य सुताशभ्न ते... ४४४
verses.wordMeaning: Apadabaddha, his son, will rule (first) for ten years, (then) for twentyfour years and (then) for six years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Apadabaddha, his son, will rule (first) for ten years, (then) for twentyfour years and (then) for six years.

verses.sanskrit: परमेश्वरेति यद्रूपं तदेतत्कथितं तव । जन्मादिभावरहितं तद् विष्णोः परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: parameśvareti yadrūpaṃ tadetatkathitaṃ tava / janmādibhāvarahitaṃ tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Nemikrsna will rule for twentyfive years. Then for full one year Hala will be the king. Five (or) seven kings (of this race) will b c very powerful. Putrikascna will rule for twentyfivc years.
verses.hindi: परम्परा युगानां च ब्रह्मक्षत्रस्थ चोड्धूवः । यथा प्रवुत्तिस्तेषां वे प्रवतानां तथा क्षय दिवंशकरणाश्यव फीतंयिष्ये निबोधत ..
verses.wordMeaning: Nemikrsna will rule for twentyfive years. Then for full one year Hala will be the king. Five (or) seven kings (of this race) will b c very powerful. Putrikascna will rule for twentyfivc years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nemikrsna will rule for twentyfive years. Then for full one year Hala will be the king. Five (or) seven kings (of this race) will b c very powerful. Putrikascna will rule for twentyfivc years.

verses.sanskrit: संक्षेपेणाथ भूपाल श्रूयतां यद्वदामि ते । यन्मतं पुरुषः कृत्वा परं निर्वाणमृच्छति
verses.transliteration: saṃkṣepeṇātha bhūpāla śrūyatāṃ yadvadāmi te / yanmataṃ puruṣaḥ kṛtvā paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati
verses.translation: Satakarni will be king for one year. SivasvamI will rule for twenty eight years.
verses.hindi: ऐलस्येक्ष्वाकुनन्दस्य प्रकृति: परिवतंते । राजानः श्रेणिबद्धास्तु तथाइस्ये क्षत्रिया नृपाः..
verses.wordMeaning: Satakarni will be king for one year. SivasvamI will rule for twenty eight years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Satakarni will be king for one year. SivasvamI will rule for twenty eight years.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वो विष्णुसमासो हि भावाभावौ च तन्मयौ । सदसत्सर्वमीशो ऽसौ महादेवः परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: sarvo viṣṇusamāso hi bhāvābhāvau ca tanmayau / sadasatsarvamīśo 'sau mahādevaḥ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: King Gautamiputra will rule for twcntyouc years among men. Thereafter Yajhasri of the Satakarni family will be the king for nineteen years. After him, king Vijaya will rule for only six years. DandasrI Satakarni, his son, will for three years.
verses.hindi: तावदेव तु भोजानां विस्तरो द्विगुणः स्मृतः । भजते त्रिशफ क्षत्र॑ चतुर्धा त्ययादिशमू धृत(धातं )राष्ट्राश्वेकशतमशीतिजनमेजया: । शत च ब्रह्म दत्तानां शीरिणां वीरिणां शतमू
verses.wordMeaning: King Gautamiputra will rule for twcntyouc years among men. Thereafter Yajhasri of the Satakarni family will be the king for nineteen years. After him, king Vijaya will rule for only six years. DandasrI Satakarni, his son, will for three years.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Gautamiputra will rule for twcntyouc years among men. Thereafter Yajhasri of the Satakarni family will be the king for nineteen years. After him, king Vijaya will rule for only six years. DandasrI Satakarni, his son, will for three years.

verses.sanskrit: भवजलधिगतानां द्वन्द्ववाताहतानां सुतदुहितृकलत्रत्राणभारार्दितानाम् । विषमविषयतोये मज्जतामप्लवानां भवति शरणमेको विष्णुपोतो नराणाम्
verses.transliteration: bhavajaladhigatānāṃ dvandvavātāhatānāṃ sutaduhitṛkalatratrāṇabhārārditānām / viṣamaviṣayatoye majjatāmaplavānāṃ bhavati śaraṇameko viṣṇupoto narāṇām
verses.translation: Pulova (Pulumayi) will rule for seven years. There will be other kings as well. Altogether there will be thirty Andhra kings who will enjoy the earth.
verses.hindi: करने के लिए राजाओं के साथ अवतीण्ण होते हैं क्षत्रिय वंश का मूलतः विध्वंस, ब्राह्मणों के साथ सम्बन्ध स्थापन, सातों मन्वन्तर, मन्वस्तरों में उत्पन्न होने वाली प्रजाएँ, युगों की परम्परा, ब्राह्मणों एवं क्षत्रियों की उत्पत्ति, उनके कुलों का उद्भव, उत्पत्ति के उपरान्त उनके विनाश एवं दीर्घायुप्राप्ति, प्रजाओं की प्रवृत्ति आदि समस्त बातों को सप्तषिगण जानते हैं ।४४४-४४६६३। इस उपर्यक्त क्रम के अनुसार
verses.wordMeaning: Pulova (Pulumayi) will rule for seven years. There will be other kings as well. Altogether there will be thirty Andhra kings who will enjoy the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pulova (Pulumayi) will rule for seven years. There will be other kings as well. Altogether there will be thirty Andhra kings who will enjoy the earth.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्रीपतिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिनवत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १९४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तच्छ्रुत्वानान्तदेवेन विश्वरूपमुदाहृतम् । देवराजस्तथा देवाः परं विस्मयमागताः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīpatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trinavatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 194 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tacchrutvānāntadevena viśvarūpamudāhṛtam / devarājastathā devāḥ paraṃ vismayamāgatāḥ
verses.translation: The rule of 'the Andhras will cover a period of four hundred, five and six (four hundred and eleven) years. There will be five families of the Andhras and all of them will be (are) equal (inpower).
verses.hindi: ऐल तथा इद्वाकुवंशीय ह्विजातियाँ ज्रेता में उत्पन्न होकर कलियुग के विनाश पर्य॑न्त युग का अनुवतंन तब तक करतो रहती हैं, जब तक मन्वन्तर का क्षय नहीं उपस्थित होता । जमदश्नि पुत्र परशुराम के प्रथ्वीपति राजाओं के साथ क्षत्रियों का सपुल संहार कर डालने के बाद चन्द्र और सूर्य दोनों वंज्ष के क्षत्रियों की पुनः उत्पत्ति हुई, मैं उन सब का वर्णन कर रहा हूँ, सुनिये ।४४७-४४६॥ उस महान् क्षत्रिय संहार के बाद इला और इक्वाकु के वंशज क्षत्रियों की सनन्‍्तानों का पुन विस्तार हुआ, धारावाहिक रूप में क्षत्रिय लोग पुनः राज्याधिकारी हुए, उनके साथ साथ अमन्यान्य क्षत्रिय भी राजा हुए। ऐल और ऐक्वाकु--ऐसे वंश थे, जिनमें पर विख्यात अभिषिक्त राजाओं के एक सौ कुल हुए। भोजवंशीय राजाओं के कुलों की संख्या. उमकी द्विगुणित कहों जाती है, इस प्रकार ऐश्रे क्षत्रिय कुलों
verses.wordMeaning: The rule of 'the Andhras will cover a period of four hundred, five and six (four hundred and eleven) years. There will be five families of the Andhras and all of them will be (are) equal (inpower).
verses.commentary: Sense: The rule of 'the Andhras will cover a period of four hundred, five and six (four hundred and eleven) years. There will be five families of the Andhras and all of them will be (are) equal (inpower).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा चाप्सरसं पुण्याम् उर्वशीं कमलाननाम् । संत्रस्तो विस्मितश्चाभूदिन्द्रो राजश्रिया वृतः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā cāpsarasaṃ puṇyām urvaśīṃ kamalānanām / saṃtrasto vismitaścābhūdindro rājaśriyā vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: There will be ten and seven Abhlra kings, seven Gardabhins (Gardabhillas), ten Sakas, eight Yavanas, fourteen Maunas, as kings. Andhras will enjoy the earth for two hundred and one hundred years. Sakas will enjoy the earth for three hundred and eighty years.
verses.hindi: की संख्या तीन सो हो जाती है (?) उनमें समान नाम वाले राजा व्यतीत हो चके हैं, उन सब को बतला रहा हूँ, सुनिये ॥४५००४५२३। ऐसे राजाओं में प्रतिविन्ध्यों कीं संख्या एक सौ, नागों कौ एक सौ, हयों कौ एक सौ, घतराष्ट्रों की एक सौ, जनमेंजयों कौ अस्सी, ब्रह्मदत्तों की एक सौ, शीरी और- कीरियों की
verses.wordMeaning: There will be ten and seven Abhlra kings, seven Gardabhins (Gardabhillas), ten Sakas, eight Yavanas, fourteen Maunas, as kings. Andhras will enjoy the earth for two hundred and one hundred years. Sakas will enjoy the earth for three hundred and eighty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: There will be ten and seven Abhlra kings, seven Gardabhins (Gardabhillas), ten Sakas, eight Yavanas, fourteen Maunas, as kings. Andhras will enjoy the earth for two hundred and one hundred years. Sakas will enjoy the earth for three hundred and eighty years.

verses.sanskrit: न किंचिदुत्तरं वाक्यमुक्तवाञ्जोषमास्थितः । इति वृत्तान्तभूतं हि नारायणविचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: na kiṃciduttaraṃ vākyamuktavāñjoṣamāsthitaḥ / iti vṛttāntabhūtaṃ hi nārāyaṇaviceṣṭitam
verses.translation: Yavanas will enjoy the earth for eighty years. It is remembered (prophesied) that Tusaras will be in possession of the earth for five hundred years.
verses.hindi: ततः शत तु पौलानां श्वेतकाशकुशादयः । ततोइबरे सहस्न वे येइतीता: शतबिन्दवः मनोर्बेवस्‍्वतस्यास्मिन्वतंमानेषन्तरे तु ये । तेषां निबोधतोत्पन्ना लोके संततयः स्मृता ४५७
verses.wordMeaning: Yavanas will enjoy the earth for eighty years. It is remembered (prophesied) that Tusaras will be in possession of the earth for five hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yavanas will enjoy the earth for eighty years. It is remembered (prophesied) that Tusaras will be in possession of the earth for five hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: भृगोः खात्यां समुत्पन्ना लक्ष्मीः श्रुत्वा तु वै नृप । वैश्वरूपं परं रूपं विस्मिताचिन्तयत् तदा
verses.transliteration: bhṛgoḥ khātyāṃ samutpannā lakṣmīḥ śrutvā tu vai nṛpa / vaiśvarūpaṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ vismitācintayat tadā
verses.translation: Thirteen Marunda families will rule for four hundred and fifty years along with (other) Sudras. There will be other Mleccha tribes as well.
verses.hindi: एते ययातिपुत्राणां पर्श्चावशा विशां हिताः। कोतिता छामिता ये ये लेकान्वे धारयन्त्युत ॥४४६२ . लभते च वरान्पञुच दुलंभानिह लौोकिकान् । आपयुः कोति धन पुत्रानस्वर्ग चाउघनन्त्यमश्नुते
verses.wordMeaning: Thirteen Marunda families will rule for four hundred and fifty years along with (other) Sudras. There will be other Mleccha tribes as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirteen Marunda families will rule for four hundred and fifty years along with (other) Sudras. There will be other Mleccha tribes as well.

verses.sanskrit: केनोपायेन स स्यान् मे भर्ता नारायणः प्रभुः । व्रतेन तपसा वापि दानेन नियमेन च
verses.transliteration: kenopāyena sa syān me bhartā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / vratena tapasā vāpi dānena niyamena ca
verses.translation: * Eleven of those Mlecchas will enjoy (the earth) for three hundred years. Then the Sudra tribes (Kilakila) Koli- kilas (?) will rule for an equal period (?)
verses.hindi: एक सौ, पौलीं की एक सौ, तथा कवेत काश कुशादिकों की एक सो की है। दातविन्दु नामक एक सहस्र  राजा हो पके हैं ।/५३-४५५॥ ये सभी नृपतिगण करोड़ों की दक्षिणावाले अनेक अश्वमेघ यज्ञों से अनुष्ठान करनेवाले थे, सेकड़ों सह्नों की संख्या में ऐसे उदारचेता नपति व्यातीत हो गये हैं। इसी बतेमान बेवस्वत मन्वन्तर में, इन्हीं मनु के अधिकार काल में, जो राजा हो गये हैं, उन्हीं की बहुत बड़ी संख्या में संततियाँ उत्पन्न हुई हैं, उन सब को परम्परा का विस्तृत विवरण पहले और पीछे की सारी संख्याएं मिलाकर सौ बे में भी प्रस्तुत नहीं किया जा सकता ।॥४५६-४२८। वैवस्व॒त मन्क्‍वन्‍्तर का अट्ठाईसवाँ . युग समाध्तप्राय हो गया है, इस समय राजबियों के साथ जो सन्‍्ताने शेष हैं, उन्हें सुनिये । भविष्य में इसी युग में चालीस अन्य विशिष्ट राजा लोग राज्य करेंगे, वैवस्वत का सर्वाशतः अवसान .होगा
verses.wordMeaning: * Eleven of those Mlecchas will enjoy (the earth) for three hundred years. Then the Sudra tribes (Kilakila) Koli- kilas (?) will rule for an equal period (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: * Eleven of those Mlecchas will enjoy (the earth) for three hundred years. Then the Sudra tribes (Kilakila) Koli- kilas (?) will rule for an equal period (?)

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धानां सेवनेनाथ देवताराधनेन वा । इति चिन्तापरां कन्यां सती ज्ञात्वा युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: vṛddhānāṃ sevanenātha devatārādhanena vā / iti cintāparāṃ kanyāṃ satī jñātvā yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Vindhyasakti will take over the administration from Kolikilas. Having supervised over the administration for ninetysix years, he will pass away.
verses.hindi: प्रसंगत: संक्षेप और विस्तार में मैं ऑप लोगों को राजाओं का यह वृत्तान्त बतला चुका, प्रत्येक युगों में होनेबाले समस्त राजाओं का बत्तानत एवं वंशक्रम बहुत अधिक एवं पुनरुक्ति के कारण मैं नहीं बतला सकता । सम्नराद ययाति के पुत्रों से होने वाले, प्रजारक्षक पच्चीस राजबंशों का एवं उनके शासना- धोन देशों का वर्णन कर चुका, वे सब के सब अमित भ्रभावशाली एवं बलवान् थे, बड़े प्रेम से समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: Vindhyasakti will take over the administration from Kolikilas. Having supervised over the administration for ninetysix years, he will pass away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vindhyasakti will take over the administration from Kolikilas. Having supervised over the administration for ninetysix years, he will pass away.

verses.sanskrit: प्राह प्राप्तो मया भर्ता शङ्करस्तपसा किल । प्रजापतिश्च गायत्र्या ह्यन्याभिरभिवाञ्छिताः
verses.transliteration: prāha prāpto mayā bhartā śaṅkarastapasā kila / prajāpatiśca gāyatryā hyanyābhirabhivāñchitāḥ
verses.translation: Listen to and understand the future Sudra clans called Disakas (?) Svarapuranjaya will be the son of Sesa, the king of serpents (Vaidisaka—residents of Vidisa?).
verses.hindi: लोकीं का पालन करते थे। इस पवित्र वृत्तान्त को धारण करने से तथा सुनने से मनुष्य दीर्घायू, यश्षा, घन, पुत्र, और अनन्त काल व्यापी स्वर्ग निवास--इन पाँच वरदानों को प्राप्त करता है । इस लोक में गे वरदान परम दुलंभ हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to and understand the future Sudra clans called Disakas (?) Svarapuranjaya will be the son of Sesa, the king of serpents (Vaidisaka—residents of Vidisa?).
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to and understand the future Sudra clans called Disakas (?) Svarapuranjaya will be the son of Sesa, the king of serpents (Vaidisaka—residents of Vidisa?).

verses.sanskrit: तपसैव हि ते प्राप्यस्तस्मात्तच्चर सुव्रते । तपस्त्वं हि महच्चोग्रं सर्ववाञ्छितदायकम्
verses.transliteration: tapasaiva hi te prāpyastasmāttaccara suvrate / tapastvaṃ hi mahaccograṃ sarvavāñchitadāyakam
verses.translation: That king, born of the race of serpents, will be a king who will enjoy. The following kings: Sadacandra who will be a part of the moon, Nakhavan the second, Dhana-
verses.hindi: धारणाच्छवणाच्येव ते लोकान्धारयन्त्युत । इत्येष वो मया पादस्तुतोयः कथितो विजा॥.. विस्तरेणा5नृपूर्र्या च कि भूयों वर्तयास्यहम् ः ४६४
verses.wordMeaning: That king, born of the race of serpents, will be a king who will enjoy. The following kings: Sadacandra who will be a part of the moon, Nakhavan the second, Dhana-
verses.commentary: Sense: That king, born of the race of serpents, will be a king who will enjoy. The following kings: Sadacandra who will be a part of the moon, Nakhavan the second, Dhana-

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: सागरान्तं समासाद्य लक्ष्मीः परपुरंजय । चचार विपुलं कालं तपः परमदुश्चरम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: sāgarāntaṃ samāsādya lakṣmīḥ parapuraṃjaya / cacāra vipulaṃ kālaṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram
verses.translation: At the close of the rule of Nandana of the Ahgas, Madhunandi will become the king. His younger brother will be Nandiyasas by name.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुध्रोक्ते तुव॑स्वादिवंशवर्णनं नाम नवनवतितमोथ्ष्यायः ॥दंद॥ श्रुत्वा पादं तृतीय तु क्रान्तं सुतेन धीमता । ततश्रतुर्थ पप्रच्छुः पादं वे ऋषिसत्तमाः वह
verses.wordMeaning: At the close of the rule of Nandana of the Ahgas, Madhunandi will become the king. His younger brother will be Nandiyasas by name.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close of the rule of Nandana of the Ahgas, Madhunandi will become the king. His younger brother will be Nandiyasas by name.

verses.sanskrit: स्थाणुवत्संस्थिता साभूद्दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् । तत इन्द्रादयो देवाः शङ्खचक्रगदाधराः
verses.transliteration: sthāṇuvatsaṃsthitā sābhūddivyaṃ varṣasahasrakam / tata indrādayo devāḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharāḥ
verses.translation: There will be three kings in his family: Dohitra, Sisuka and Pravlra. SiSuka will rule over Purika. The powerful Pravira will be the son of VindhyaSakti, He will rule over the city Kahcanaka (along with the others) for sixty years.
verses.hindi: पादः क्लास्तस्तृतोीपोइयमनु बड्भेण यस्त्वया । चतुर्थ विस्तरात्पादं संहारं परिकोतय
verses.wordMeaning: There will be three kings in his family: Dohitra, Sisuka and Pravlra. SiSuka will rule over Purika. The powerful Pravira will be the son of VindhyaSakti, He will rule over the city Kahcanaka (along with the others) for sixty years.
verses.commentary: Sense: There will be three kings in his family: Dohitra, Sisuka and Pravlra. SiSuka will rule over Purika. The powerful Pravira will be the son of VindhyaSakti, He will rule over the city Kahcanaka (along with the others) for sixty years.

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा जग्मुस्तदर्थं ते सा तु पृष्टवती सुरान् । विश्वरूपं वैष्णवं यत्तद्दर्शयत माचिरम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtvā jagmustadarthaṃ te sā tu pṛṣṭavatī surān / viśvarūpaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yattaddarśayata māciram
verses.translation: When the family of Vindhyakas becomes extinct, three kings of Bahlikas. will enjoy the kingdom for thirty years. Supratlka and Nabhira (will be the prominent kings).
verses.hindi: द्विजव॒न्द ! मैं आप लोगों को विस्तारपू्रक क्रमानुस।र. इस तृतीय पाद को सुना चका, अब इसके बाद क्या बतलाऊ, बतलाइये श्री वायुमद्रापुराण में तुर्बस्वादि बंशवर्णव नामक निन्‍्यानबेवाँ अध्याय समाप्त
verses.wordMeaning: When the family of Vindhyakas becomes extinct, three kings of Bahlikas. will enjoy the kingdom for thirty years. Supratlka and Nabhira (will be the prominent kings).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the family of Vindhyakas becomes extinct, three kings of Bahlikas. will enjoy the kingdom for thirty years. Supratlka and Nabhira (will be the prominent kings).

verses.sanskrit: विलक्षा व्रीडिता देवा गत्वा नारायणं तदा । अब्रुवन् वैश्वरूपं नो शक्ता दर्शयितुं वयम्
verses.transliteration: vilakṣā vrīḍitā devā gatvā nārāyaṇaṃ tadā / abruvan vaiśvarūpaṃ no śaktā darśayituṃ vayam
verses.translation: The king named Sakyama will be the ruler of Mahisls. Puspamitras and Pattamitras will rule for thirteen years.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरों का वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: The king named Sakyama will be the ruler of Mahisls. Puspamitras and Pattamitras will rule for thirteen years.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king named Sakyama will be the ruler of Mahisls. Puspamitras and Pattamitras will rule for thirteen years.

verses.sanskrit: ततो यथेष्टं ते जग्मुः स च विष्णुर् अचिन्तयत् । उग्ररूपा स्थिता देवी देहं दहति भार्गवी
verses.transliteration: tato yatheṣṭaṃ te jagmuḥ sa ca viṣṇur acintayat / ugrarūpā sthitā devī dehaṃ dahati bhārgavī
verses.translation: Seven excellent kings will rule over Mckala (Amar- kantaka). The kings in Komala (Comilla, Bengal) will be very strong and powerful.
verses.hindi: परम बुद्धिमान सूत द्वारा तृतीय पाद का सुनते के उपरान्त श्रेष्ठ ऋषियों ते चतथे पाद के विषय में जिज्नासा प्रकट की ऋषिदुन्द बोल---यूत जी ! आप अनुषज् नामक तृतीय पाद को हम लोगों को सुना चके
verses.wordMeaning: Seven excellent kings will rule over Mckala (Amar- kantaka). The kings in Komala (Comilla, Bengal) will be very strong and powerful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seven excellent kings will rule over Mckala (Amar- kantaka). The kings in Komala (Comilla, Bengal) will be very strong and powerful.

verses.sanskrit: तां तस्मात् तत्र गत्वाहं वरं दत्त्वा तु वाञ्छितम् । पुनस् तपः करिष्यामि दर्शयिष्यामि वा पुनः । वैष्णवं विश्वरूपं यद् दुर्दश्यं देवदानवैः
verses.transliteration: tāṃ tasmāt tatra gatvāhaṃ varaṃ dattvā tu vāñchitam / punas tapaḥ kariṣyāmi darśayiṣyāmi vā punaḥ / vaiṣṇavaṃ viśvarūpaṃ yad durdaśyaṃ devadānavaiḥ
verses.translation: Nine kings of great intellect and well known as Meghas will become the kings of the Nisadha (Marwar, Dc 140) land. They will rule till the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: भवता कथयिष्यामि सर्वभेतद्यथातथम् । पा त्विस ससंहारं चतुर्थ मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: Nine kings of great intellect and well known as Meghas will become the kings of the Nisadha (Marwar, Dc 140) land. They will rule till the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nine kings of great intellect and well known as Meghas will become the kings of the Nisadha (Marwar, Dc 140) land. They will rule till the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गत्वा हृषीकेशः सागरान्तस्थितां श्रियम् । प्राह तुष्टो ऽस्मि ते देवि वरं वृणु यथेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gatvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ sāgarāntasthitāṃ śriyam / prāha tuṣṭo 'smi te devi varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam
verses.translation: Those strong and powerful kings wili be born in the race of Nala. Visvasphani, the powerful, will become the ruler of Magadhas.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तराणां संक्षेप भविष्येः सह सप्तभिः । प्रलयं चेब लोकानां ब्रुवतो' मे निबोधत ७ एतान्युक्तानि वे सम्यक्‍्सप्तसप्तसु वे मया। मन्वन्तराणि संक्षेपाच्छुणुतानागतानि मे अनागताश्च सप्तैव स्मृतास्त्विह महंर्षयः । कौशिको गालवश्चेव जामदस्त्यश्च भागवः
verses.wordMeaning: Those strong and powerful kings wili be born in the race of Nala. Visvasphani, the powerful, will become the ruler of Magadhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those strong and powerful kings wili be born in the race of Nala. Visvasphani, the powerful, will become the ruler of Magadhas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीरुवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि मे देव प्रपन्नाया जनार्दन । तदा दर्शय यद्दृष्टमप्सरोभिस् तवानघ
verses.transliteration: śrīruvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva prapannāyā janārdana / tadā darśaya yaddṛṣṭamapsarobhis tavānagha
verses.translation: After exterminating all the other kings he will make Kaivartas, Pahcakas, Pulindas and Brahmanas as well as the other castes (rule over the kingdom).
verses.hindi: हँपायनों वसिष्ठश्च कृप: शारहतस्तथा । आत्रेयो दीप्तिमांश्वेव ऋष्यशडगस्तु काश्यपः ३११
verses.wordMeaning: After exterminating all the other kings he will make Kaivartas, Pahcakas, Pulindas and Brahmanas as well as the other castes (rule over the kingdom).
verses.commentary: Sense: After exterminating all the other kings he will make Kaivartas, Pahcakas, Pulindas and Brahmanas as well as the other castes (rule over the kingdom).

verses.sanskrit: विश्वरूपमनन्तं च भूतभावन केशव । गन्धमादनम् आसाद्य कृतं यच्च तपस्त्वया
verses.transliteration: viśvarūpamanantaṃ ca bhūtabhāvana keśava / gandhamādanam āsādya kṛtaṃ yacca tapastvayā
verses.translation: After propitiating Devas, times that strong king will reach the and cast off his body.
verses.hindi: अब चतुर्थ उपसंहार नामक पाद का विस्तार पूर्वक वर्णन कीजिये । जो मन्वन्तर ग्यातीत हो चुके हैं, उनके अतिरिक्त अस्य मम्वन्तर हैं, तथा इस वर्तमान मस्वस्तर में जो सप्तर्षि हैं, उन सब का बृत्तान्त हमें बतलाइये । वर्तमान मह्दात्मा मनु की इस सृष्टि का. उद्धव एवं विस्तार किस प्रकार होता है, इन सब बातों को क्रमानुसार विस्तार पूर्वक हमें बतलाइये ।२-४॥ .ः ः क्‍ सूत बोले:--ऋषिवयंवन्द ' मैं आप लोगों को इन सब जिज्ञासाओं के बारे में यायातथ्य रूप से बतला रहा हूँ । चतुर्थ उपसंहार पाद का वर्णन सुनिये । द्विजवुन्द ! साथ ही वर्तमान महात्मा मनु के इस सृष्टि विस्तार का भी विस्त्वारपूर्वक क्रमानुसार वर्णन कर रहा हें ।५-६। व्यतीत सातों मन्यम्तरों
verses.wordMeaning: After propitiating Devas, times that strong king will reach the and cast off his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: After propitiating Devas, times that strong king will reach the and cast off his body.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वदस्व विभो विष्णो न मिथ्या यदि केशव । श्रद्दधामि न चैवाहं रूपस्यास्य कथंचन
verses.transliteration: tadvadasva vibho viṣṇo na mithyā yadi keśava / śraddadhāmi na caivāhaṃ rūpasyāsya kathaṃcana
verses.translation: After forsaking his body, he will go to Sakra's region. Thereafter, the nine Naka (Naga) kings will enjoy the city of Campavatl.
verses.hindi: होता है-यह भो बतला रहा हैँ, सुनिये । पूर्व प्रसंग में सातों अतीत एवं भविष्यकालीन मस्वन्तरों का विक्षद वर्णन मैं यद्यपि कर चुका हूँ, पर यहाँ प्रसंगवश भविष्यकालीन मन्वन्तरों का. संक्षेप में पुनः वर्णन कर रहा रहा हूँ ।७-८। सम्प्रति वर्तमान वैवस्वत मनु तथा भविष्यकालौन सावणर्ण मनु का वर्णन कर रहा हैं, संक्षेप में सुनिये। भावी भन्वस्तर में जो मुनिगण होंगे उनके नाम सुनिये । वे होंगे कुशिकनन्दन गावल,
verses.wordMeaning: After forsaking his body, he will go to Sakra's region. Thereafter, the nine Naka (Naga) kings will enjoy the city of Campavatl.
verses.commentary: Sense: After forsaking his body, he will go to Sakra's region. Thereafter, the nine Naka (Naga) kings will enjoy the city of Campavatl.

verses.sanskrit: बहुभिर्यक्षरक्षोभिर् मायाचारिप्रचारिभिः । छन्दिता मम जानद्भिर्भावम् अन्तर्गतं हरौ
verses.transliteration: bahubhiryakṣarakṣobhir māyācāripracāribhiḥ / chanditā mama jānadbhirbhāvam antargataṃ harau
verses.translation: The seven Nagas will enjoy the beautiful city 0 f Mathura.
verses.hindi: जमदग्नि पुत्र भागंव, वर्सिष्ठ भोत्रीय हैपायन, शारद्गवत वंशोत्पन्न कप, अत्रियंध्ोदूभव दीप्तिमान, काश्यपनोत्रीय ऋष्यभज्, एवं भरहाज गोत्रीय द्रोणपुश्र अध्वत्थामा  ये परम प्रभावशाली महात्मा गण भावी मश्यम्तर में
verses.wordMeaning: The seven Nagas will enjoy the beautiful city 0 f Mathura.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven Nagas will enjoy the beautiful city 0 f Mathura.

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा विष्णुस्वरूपास्ते चक्रिणश्च चतुर्भुजाः । सुव्रीडिता गताः सर्वे विश्वरूपो सहायतः
verses.transliteration: bhūtvā viṣṇusvarūpāste cakriṇaśca caturbhujāḥ / suvrīḍitā gatāḥ sarve viśvarūpo sahāyataḥ
verses.translation: The descendants of Manidhanya will enjoy the terri¬ tories of Nisadha, Yaduka, Saislta and Kalatopaka.
verses.hindi: परम ऋषि के नाम से विस्वात होंगे । सुतपा, अमिताभ ओर सुख ये दीव भावी मस्वस्तर के देवसणों के
verses.wordMeaning: The descendants of Manidhanya will enjoy the terri¬ tories of Nisadha, Yaduka, Saislta and Kalatopaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The descendants of Manidhanya will enjoy the terri¬ tories of Nisadha, Yaduka, Saislta and Kalatopaka.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: नारायणो ऽथ भगवाञ्छङ्खचक्रगदाभृतम् । तया तथोक्तस् तद् रूपं मुक्त्वा वै सुरपूजितम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: nārāyaṇo 'tha bhagavāñchaṅkhacakragadābhṛtam / tayā tathoktas tad rūpaṃ muktvā vai surapūjitam
verses.translation: Devaraksitas (?) will enjoy the territories of Kosalas, Andhras, Paundras and Tamraliptas along with the oceans as well as the beautiful city of Campa.
verses.hindi: दद८ ..... वायुपुराणम सुतापाश्चामिताभाश्च सुखाश्चव गणास्त्रय: । तेषां गणास्तु देवानामेकेको विशकः स्पृत:  कह३
verses.wordMeaning: Devaraksitas (?) will enjoy the territories of Kosalas, Andhras, Paundras and Tamraliptas along with the oceans as well as the beautiful city of Campa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devaraksitas (?) will enjoy the territories of Kosalas, Andhras, Paundras and Tamraliptas along with the oceans as well as the beautiful city of Campa.

verses.sanskrit: रूपं परं यथोक्तं वै विश्वरूपम् अदर्शयत् । दर्शयित्वा वचः प्राह पञ्चरात्रविधानतः
verses.transliteration: rūpaṃ paraṃ yathoktaṃ vai viśvarūpam adarśayat / darśayitvā vacaḥ prāha pañcarātravidhānataḥ
verses.translation: Guha will protect Kalihgas, Mahisas, Mahendra- nilaya and other territories.
verses.hindi: नामतस्तु प्रवक्ष्यामि निबो धध्वं समाहिता: । रितस्तपश्च शुक्रश्न यर॒तिज्योतिष्प्रभाकरो १४ प्रभासों भासकृद्धमंस्तेजो रश्मिऋतुविराद् । अचिष्मान्योतनों भानुयंशः कोतिुधों धृतिः ॥ विशतिः सुतपा होते नामभिः परिकीतिता . कहर
verses.wordMeaning: Guha will protect Kalihgas, Mahisas, Mahendra- nilaya and other territories.
verses.commentary: Sense: Guha will protect Kalihgas, Mahisas, Mahendra- nilaya and other territories.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽर्चयिष्यति मां नित्यं स पूज्यः स च पूजितः । धनधान्यसमायुक्तः सर्वभोगसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: yo 'rcayiṣyati māṃ nityaṃ sa pūjyaḥ sa ca pūjitaḥ / dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ sarvabhogasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: (The king) named Kanaka will enjoy Strirastra (the women's territory, Kamarupa) and Bhaksyakas. All these kings will be contemporaries.
