verses.hindi: जिताधांश्च गणा हात्र चाक्षुषान्ताश्रतुर्देश । मस्वस्तरेषु सर्वेषु देवास्ते वे महौजसः. ततस्तेषु गतेषूध्व॑ं सायो (यु) ज्यं कल्पवासिनाम् । समेत्य देवास्ते सर्वे प्राप्त संकलने तदरा ४१२६ महलोंक परित्यज्य गणास्ते वे चतु्दंश  सशरीराश्च श्रूयन्ते जनलोक सहानुगाः... 0१ २७
verses.wordMeaning: They hold office as the presiding Authorities in the Manvantaras only once each. After the tenure of their office they resort to Maharloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: They hold office as the presiding Authorities in the Manvantaras only once each. After the tenure of their office they resort to Maharloka.

verses.sanskrit: स सर्वाह्लादमाप्नोति स्वर्गलोके युधिष्ठिर । देवतीर्थे नरो नारी स्नात्वा नियतमानसौ
verses.transliteration: sa sarvāhlādamāpnoti svargaloke yudhiṣṭhira / devatīrthe naro nārī snātvā niyatamānasau
verses.translation: (Defective verse) Among them eight have already ceased to operate; (excepting) six more Manus are the others who will come in the future. At present it is Lord Vaivasvata Manu who rules.
verses.hindi: एवं देवेष्वतीतेषु महलोंकाज्जन प्रति । भूतादिष्ववशिष्टेषु स्थावरान्तेषु चाप्युत. ... , "१२८ ) शुन्येषु लोकस्थानेषु महान्तेषु भूरादिषु । देवेषु च गतेषध्वं सायो (यु) ज्यं कल्पवासिनामू
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) Among them eight have already ceased to operate; (excepting) six more Manus are the others who will come in the future. At present it is Lord Vaivasvata Manu who rules.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) Among them eight have already ceased to operate; (excepting) six more Manus are the others who will come in the future. At present it is Lord Vaivasvata Manu who rules.

verses.sanskrit: उपोष्यैकादशीं भक्त्या पूजयेद् यः श्रियः पतिम् । रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा घृतेनोद्बोध्य दीपकम्
verses.transliteration: upoṣyaikādaśīṃ bhaktyā pūjayed yaḥ śriyaḥ patim / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtenodbodhya dīpakam
verses.translation: I shall mention those who remain, those who are the future Brahmanas (Manus), along with Devas, Danavas and sages as well as their (other) creation of the subjects.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले :--ऋषिवृन्द ! सभी मल्वन्तर जब समाप्त हो जाते हैं ओर उनमें अनेक युग व्यतीत हो जाते हैं, तब सुष्ठि का संहार होता है--ऐसा कहां जाता है। भन्तिम मन्वन्तर में ये सात भूगुवंशोत्पन्न देवगण इकदृत्तर युगों तक समस्त त्ैलोक्य में विराजमान रह कर समस्त भोगों का उपभोग करेंगे और अन्त में पितरों, म्ुनियों, सप्तधियों, अस्यान्य यज्ञ पद यजमानों एवं भक्तों के साथ तीनों लोकों का परित्याग करके वे सवंशक्ति सम्पन्न देवगण महलोंक को चले जायंगे ।११९-१२१३। इस भकार जब वे सब छोड़ कर मस्वन्तर को समाप्ति हो जाने पर चले जायेंगे तब यह भंलोक्‍्य निराधार हो जायगा । द्विजवुन्द ! उस समय सभी स्थान शुन्य हो जायगा, स्थानी ( अभिमानी ) देवगण भी अपने अपने स्थान छोड़ देंगे । तारायें, नक्षत्र, ग्रहादि निरवलम्ब होकर विध्वंस हो जाते हैं (२२-११३॥। ेलोक्य के समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention those who remain, those who are the future Brahmanas (Manus), along with Devas, Danavas and sages as well as their (other) creation of the subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention those who remain, those who are the future Brahmanas (Manus), along with Devas, Danavas and sages as well as their (other) creation of the subjects.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादश्यां प्रातरुत्थाय तथा वै नर्मदाजले । विप्रदाम्पत्यम् अभ्यर्च्य विधिवत्कुरुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthāya tathā vai narmadājale / vipradāmpatyam abhyarcya vidhivatkurunandana
verses.translation: The details of the creation of these Manus are to be known through the creative activity of Vaivasvata Manu, since they are neither inferior nor superior to those of Vaivasvata Manu.
verses.hindi: पामथ्यंसम्पन्न॒ शक्तियों के समाप्त हो जाने पर इल्द्रादि प्रमुख देवगण, चाक्षुपादि समस्त भनृगण एवं अन्याय महान् तेजस्वी देवगण--सभी महलकि में जाकर वहाँ कल्पपयंन्त स्थिर निवास करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: The details of the creation of these Manus are to be known through the creative activity of Vaivasvata Manu, since they are neither inferior nor superior to those of Vaivasvata Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The details of the creation of these Manus are to be known through the creative activity of Vaivasvata Manu, since they are neither inferior nor superior to those of Vaivasvata Manu.

verses.sanskrit: वस्त्राभरणताम्बूलपुष्पधूपविलेपनैः । अक्षये विष्णुलोके ऽसौ मोदते चरितव्रतः
verses.transliteration: vastrābharaṇatāmbūlapuṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ / akṣaye viṣṇuloke 'sau modate caritavrataḥ
verses.translation: I am not recounting their details for fear of repetition
verses.hindi: . मिलने पर जब प्रलय का जोर बहुत अधिक बढ़ जायगा, तब वे चौददों मनुगण अपने सहमामी अनुचरादि के साथ सदारीर जनलोक चले जाते हैं--ऐसा सुना जाता है ।१२४-१२७ देवताओं के महलुकि से जनलोंकि में चले जाने पर जब केवल स्थावर जीवनिकाय शेष रह जाते हैं, मह, भू आदि सभी शोगीं के स्थान शूत्य हो जाते हैं, देवगण कल्पपर्यध्त निवास करनेवाले अन्यान्य देवताओं के समान स्थान प्राप्तकर ऊपर चले संहृत्य तांस्तता ब्रह्मा वेबधिपितृदानवान् । संस्थापयति वे सर्ग महन्दृष्टवा युगंक्षये
verses.wordMeaning: I am not recounting their details for fear of repetition
verses.commentary: Sense: I am not recounting their details for fear of repetition

verses.sanskrit: यः सदैकादशीतिथौ स्नात्वोपोष्यार्चयेद्धरिम् । रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याद् वेदशास्त्रविधानतः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sadaikādaśītithau snātvopoṣyārcayeddharim / rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād vedaśāstravidhānataḥ
verses.translation: I shall mention them, the creative activities in the different families only partially. The remaining things should be known through their details and in order.
verses.hindi: मेमिशिकः प्राकृतिको यश्चेबाउउत्यस्तिकोर्यतः  त्रिविधः सर्वभृतानामित्येष प्रतिसंचरः .
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention them, the creative activities in the different families only partially. The remaining things should be known through their details and in order.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention them, the creative activities in the different families only partially. The remaining things should be known through their details and in order.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मराजकृतां पापां न स पश्यति यातनाम् । पञ्चरात्रविधानेन श्रीपतिं यो ऽर्चयिष्यति
verses.transliteration: dharmarājakṛtāṃ pāpāṃ na sa paśyati yātanām / pañcarātravidhānena śrīpatiṃ yo 'rcayiṣyati
verses.translation: Daksa had a pious daughter who was well known as Suvrata. Although she was the youngest of the daughters, she was the most excellent and the most pious. Once the father took her with him and approached Brahma.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मो नेसित्तिकस्तस्य कल्पदाहः प्रसंयमः । प्रतिसगें तु भूतानां प्राकृतः करणक्षयः.. शानाचउचा55त्यन्तिकः प्रोक्त: कारणानामसंभवः । ततः संहृत्य तान्ब्रह्मा देवांस्त्रेलोक्यवासिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Daksa had a pious daughter who was well known as Suvrata. Although she was the youngest of the daughters, she was the most excellent and the most pious. Once the father took her with him and approached Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Daksa had a pious daughter who was well known as Suvrata. Although she was the youngest of the daughters, she was the most excellent and the most pious. Once the father took her with him and approached Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: दीक्षामवाप्य विधिवद्वैष्णवीं पापनाशिनीम् । स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदां पुण्यां भोगदां वित्तदामथ
verses.transliteration: dīkṣāmavāpya vidhivadvaiṣṇavīṃ pāpanāśinīm / svargamokṣapradāṃ puṇyāṃ bhogadāṃ vittadāmatha
verses.translation: He was in the Vairaja region seated along with Dharma and Bhava. Brahma spoke to Daksa in the presence of Dharma and Bhava.
verses.hindi: ततो युगसहस्रास्ते संप्राप्ते चर युगक्षये । तत्रा5पत्मस्थाः प्रजा: कर्तु प्रपेदे स प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: He was in the Vairaja region seated along with Dharma and Bhava. Brahma spoke to Daksa in the presence of Dharma and Bhava.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was in the Vairaja region seated along with Dharma and Bhava. Brahma spoke to Daksa in the presence of Dharma and Bhava.

verses.sanskrit: राज्यदां वा महाभाग पुत्रदां भाग्यदाम् अथ । सुकलत्रप्रदां वापि विष्णोर् भक्तिप्रदाम् इति
verses.transliteration: rājyadāṃ vā mahābhāga putradāṃ bhāgyadām atha / sukalatrapradāṃ vāpi viṣṇor bhaktipradām iti
verses.translation: "O Daksa, this, your daughter Suvrata will give birth to four sons who will become the auspicious Manus and stabilise the discipline of four castes."
verses.hindi: तदा भवत्यनावृष्टिस्तदा सा शतवाधिकी । तथा यएयल्पसाराणि सत्त्वानि पथिवीतलि. जाते हैं, उस समय ब्रह्मा देवताओं, ऋषियाँ, पितरों, दानवॉ--सब का संहार कर युगक्षय पर महती वृष्टि के द्वारा सृष्टि की पुनः स्थापना करते हैं ॥!२८-१३०। एक सहस्र चतुर्युग का ब्रह्मा का एक दिन बतलाया जाता है और इसी प्रकार एक सहख्र चतुर्यूण कौ उनकी रात्रि, दिन रात्रि के नाम को जानने वाले ज्योतिषी लोग जानते हैं। नैमित्तिक, प्राकृतिक एवं आत्यन्तिक-जीवों के ये तीन प्रकार के प्रलय जतलाये जाते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: "O Daksa, this, your daughter Suvrata will give birth to four sons who will become the auspicious Manus and stabilise the discipline of four castes."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Daksa, this, your daughter Suvrata will give birth to four sons who will become the auspicious Manus and stabilise the discipline of four castes."

verses.sanskrit: तरिष्यति भवाम्भोधिं स नरः कुरुनन्दन । यो ऽर्चयिष्यति तत्रैव देवतीर्थे श्रियः पतिम्
verses.transliteration: tariṣyati bhavāmbhodhiṃ sa naraḥ kurunandana / yo 'rcayiṣyati tatraiva devatīrthe śriyaḥ patim
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma, the three—Daksa, Dharma and Bhava approached that girl mentally along with Brahma.
verses.hindi: अर्थानुसार इनकी चरिताथंता होती है। इनमें ब्रह्मा द्वारा किया गया कल्पदाह प्रसंयम और नैमित्तिक है ।. जिन प्रलय में भूतों के कारणों ( असाधारण कारणों ) का क्षय हो जाता है उसको प्राकृतिक प्रलय कहते हैं ॥३१-१२३। अच्छी तरह जान बूझकर किये गये उस महान प्रलय को, जिसके बाद कारणीभूत उपादानों का अस्तित्व एक दम नष्ट हो जाता है, वे असम्भव हो जाते हैं, आत्यन्तिक प्रलय कहते हैं। त्रेलोक्य-
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Brahma, the three—Daksa, Dharma and Bhava approached that girl mentally along with Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Brahma, the three—Daksa, Dharma and Bhava approached that girl mentally along with Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वरूपमथो सम्यङ्मूलश्रीपतिमेव वा । नारायणगिरिं वापि गृहे वैकादशीतिथौ
verses.transliteration: viśvarūpamatho samyaṅmūlaśrīpatimeva vā / nārāyaṇagiriṃ vāpi gṛhe vaikādaśītithau
verses.translation: The girl immediately gave birth to four sons who were similar to and befitting those four divine personages as they were of truthful meditation.
verses.hindi: वासी उन देवताओं का संहार करने के उपरान्त अपने एक दिन के बाद पुनः सृष्टि का प्रतलय करते हैं । उस समय शयन करने को इच्छा से भगवान् ब्रह्मा प्रजाओं का संहार करते हैं। इस प्रकार एक सहस्त युग के व्यतीत हो जाने के उपरान्त युवक्षय के प्राप्त होने पर प्रजापति आत्मस्थ समस्त प्रजाओं का विस्तार करने में प्रवत्त होते हैं ।३४-१३६। उस समय सी वर्ष व्यापी घोर अनावष्टि होती है, जिससे प्रथ्वीतल में जो अल्पसार प्राणी शेष रह जाते हैं, वे भी विनष्ट होकर प्रृथ्वी रूप में परिणत हो जाते हैं । विभावसु सात विशिष्ट रदिमयों से समन्वित होकर उदित होते हैं, और अपनी तीवण रश्मियों से जलराशि का शोषण करते हैं । उस समय उनकी रश्मियों का तेज असह्य हो जाता है वे रहिमयाँ हरित वर्ण की एवं परम तेजोमयी होती हैं, उनका सात भाग होता है ।१३७-१३६९। वे शन
verses.wordMeaning: The girl immediately gave birth to four sons who were similar to and befitting those four divine personages as they were of truthful meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The girl immediately gave birth to four sons who were similar to and befitting those four divine personages as they were of truthful meditation.

verses.sanskrit: भक्तिमाञ्छ्रद्धया युक्तः क्षीरैस्तीर्थोदकैरपि । सुसूक्ष्मैर् अहतैर् वस्त्रैर् महाकौशेयकैर् नृप
verses.transliteration: bhaktimāñchraddhayā yuktaḥ kṣīraistīrthodakairapi / susūkṣmair ahatair vastrair mahākauśeyakair nṛpa
verses.translation: Those sons were born fully endowed with physical bodies, born in a trice but capable of all enjoyment, and com¬ petent to perform all activities. They were endowed with glory.
verses.hindi: + इत आरम्य प्रतिसंचर इत्यन्तग्रन्थो ड. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Those sons were born fully endowed with physical bodies, born in a trice but capable of all enjoyment, and com¬ petent to perform all activities. They were endowed with glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those sons were born fully endowed with physical bodies, born in a trice but capable of all enjoyment, and com¬ petent to perform all activities. They were endowed with glory.

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रैर् नेत्रजैर् वापि धूपैरगुरुचन्दनैः । गुग्गुलैर् घृतमिश्रैश्च नैवेद्यैर् विविधैर् अपि
verses.transliteration: vicitrair netrajair vāpi dhūpairagurucandanaiḥ / guggulair ghṛtamiśraiśca naivedyair vividhair api
verses.translation: On seeing them, those deities who had realised Brahman began to claim "This is my son, This is my son 5 '. They began to tug at them furiously.
verses.hindi: भूय एव विवतंस्ते ध्याप्नुवस्तों बने शने:। भौस काष्ठ धनं तेजो भृशमडिस्तु दीप्पते १४० तस्मादुदक सूर्स्थ तपतो5पि हि कथ्यते । नावुष्द्या तपते सूर्यो नावष्टया परिविष्यते.. ततस्ते रश्मयः सप्त सूर्य भूताश्नतुदिशम् । चतुर्लोकमिसं सर्व दहस्ति शिखिनस्तदा १४४ प्राप्तुतष्ति ल भाभिस्तु ऊध्वे चाधश्व रश्मिभिः। दीप्यन्ते भास्कराः सप्त युगान्ताग्निप्रतापिनः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing them, those deities who had realised Brahman began to claim "This is my son, This is my son 5 '. They began to tug at them furiously.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them, those deities who had realised Brahman began to claim "This is my son, This is my son 5 '. They began to tug at them furiously.

verses.sanskrit: पायसाद्यैर् मनुष्येन्द्र पयसा वा युधिष्ठिर । पिष्टदीपैः सुविमलैर् वर्धमानैर् मनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: pāyasādyair manuṣyendra payasā vā yudhiṣṭhira / piṣṭadīpaiḥ suvimalair vardhamānair manoharaiḥ
verses.translation: Since they mentally created sons through meditation, they said to one another: "Let us select that boy as our respec¬ tive son who is similar to us physically.
verses.hindi: शनेः पृथ्वीस्थ समस्त जल राशि में व्याप्त होकर अधिकाचिक विवतित हो जाती हैं। भौम, काष्ठ, वन, तेज प्रभ्नति में पुनः पुनः परिव्याप्त होकर वे रदिमयाँ जल से बहुत अधिक प्रदीष्त हो उठती हैं  ज्वलनात्मक सूर्य के अधिक ताप का कारण इसी लिए जल कहा जाता है, अनावष्टि से सूर्य तप्त नहीं होते और न अनावष्टि से उनके मण्डल सन्निवेश आदि में ही कोई विशेष दीप्ति होती है, यही नहीं बल्कि
verses.wordMeaning: Since they mentally created sons through meditation, they said to one another: "Let us select that boy as our respec¬ tive son who is similar to us physically.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they mentally created sons through meditation, they said to one another: "Let us select that boy as our respec¬ tive son who is similar to us physically.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयित्वा नरो याति यथा तच्छृणु भारत । शङ्खी चक्री गदी पद्मी भूत्वासौ गरुडध्वजः
verses.transliteration: pūjayitvā naro yāti yathā tacchṛṇu bhārata / śaṅkhī cakrī gadī padmī bhūtvāsau garuḍadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: If a boy is similar to one in features, prowess and name as well as complexion, one shall take him as one's gentle son.
verses.hindi: अनावुष्टि से उनकी रहदिमयाँ प्रृथ्वीस्थ पदार्थों के श्सादि का संचयन नहीं कर पाती हैं । केवल जल से रवि उह्ीप्त होते हैं.। अपनी किरणों द्वारा जलराधशि का पान करते हुए वे आकाश मण्डल में प्रकाशित होते हैं। उनकी वे सातों किरणें समुद्र से जल का पान करती हैं । उस जल रूप आहार से संदीप्त होकर सूर्य सात हो जाते हैं ॥!४०-१४३। इस प्रकार उनकी वे सातों रश्मियाँ सूर्य रूप हो चारों दिल्लाओं में व्याप्त होकर चारों लोकों को अग्नि की भाँति दस्घ कर देती हैं। नीचे ऊपर सर्वत्र अपनी उन प्रखर तेजस्विनी किरणों द्वारा युगास्तकालीन अग्नि के समान परम उद्दीप्त वे सातों भास्कर परम तप्त हो उठते हैं ।१४४-१४५॥। जलराशि के पान करने के कारण उत्तरोत्तर अधिक उद्दीप्त होनेवाली अनेक सहस्र रदिभयों से समन्वित वे सूरयवन्द समस्त वसुन्धरा को दग्ध करते हुए सारे आकाश मण्डल में प्रकाशित होते हैं। उन सभों के परम
verses.wordMeaning: If a boy is similar to one in features, prowess and name as well as complexion, one shall take him as one's gentle son.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a boy is similar to one in features, prowess and name as well as complexion, one shall take him as one's gentle son.

verses.sanskrit: देवलोकान् अतिक्रम्य विष्णुलोकं प्रपद्यते । यस्तु वै परया भक्त्या श्रीपतेः पादपङ्कजम्
verses.transliteration: devalokān atikramya viṣṇulokaṃ prapadyate / yastu vai parayā bhaktyā śrīpateḥ pādapaṅkajam
verses.translation: A son emulates the features of his father invariably. Hence the son is born taking after the father and the mother."
verses.hindi: प्रखर प्रताप से दग्घ होती हुईं वसुन्धरा पर्वतों, नदियों एवं समुद्रों समेत सूखी हो जायगी, कहीं पर आहर्ता के चिह्न भी शेष न रहेंगे । चारों ओर से विचित्र रंग बिरंगी परम तेजस्विनी उन सूर्य रश्मियों से समस्त पृथ्वी मण्डल, ऊपर नीचे सरव्ंत्र व्याप्त हो जाता है ।१४६-१४८! सूर्य के भ्रताप से उत्पन्न होने बाली अग्नियाँ इस
verses.wordMeaning: A son emulates the features of his father invariably. Hence the son is born taking after the father and the mother."
verses.commentary: Sense: A son emulates the features of his father invariably. Hence the son is born taking after the father and the mother."

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्धाधिष्ठितं पश्येच्छ्रियं त्रैलोक्यमातरम् । नृत्यगीतविनोदेन मुच्यते पातकर्ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: caturdhādhiṣṭhitaṃ paśyecchriyaṃ trailokyamātaram / nṛtyagītavinodena mucyate pātakardhruvam
verses.translation: After coming to terms like this, they took those boys who were similar in complexion ( Savarna ) to them. Since the boys were similar in complexion to god Brahma and others, they are called Savarna. Since they were meditated upon and were accepted respectfully, they are remembered as Manus.
verses.hindi: सर्वलोकप्रणाशं च सोउग्निर्भुत्वा तु सण्डलो । चतुर्लोकलिदं सर्व निर्दहत्याशु तेजसा तलः संवर्तक: शेलानतिक़म्प महांस्तया । लोकास्संहरते दौप्तो घोरः संवर्तकोश्नलः
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to terms like this, they took those boys who were similar in complexion ( Savarna ) to them. Since the boys were similar in complexion to god Brahma and others, they are called Savarna. Since they were meditated upon and were accepted respectfully,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to terms like this, they took those boys who were similar in complexion ( Savarna ) to them. Since the boys were similar in complexion to god Brahma and others, they are called Savarna. Since they were meditated upon and were accepted respectfully,…

verses.sanskrit: नीराजने तु देवस्य प्रातर्मध्ये दिने तथा । सायं च नियतो नित्यं यः पश्येत् पूजयेद्धरिम्
verses.transliteration: nīrājane tu devasya prātarmadhye dine tathā / sāyaṃ ca niyato nityaṃ yaḥ paśyet pūjayeddharim
verses.translation: When the Caksu?a Manvantara expired and the Vaivasvata Manvantara set in, a son named Raucya was born to Ruci, the Prajapati.
verses.hindi: लत: स पृथिवीं भिस्वा रसातलमशोषयत् । निर्देहा तांस्तु पातालान्नागलोकमथादहत् ११५७ अधस्तात्पूथियीं दग्ध्या ऊध्वं स वहते दिवम्। योजनानां सहक्राणि अयुतास्यबृंदानि च ॥१र८
verses.wordMeaning: When the Caksu?a Manvantara expired and the Vaivasvata Manvantara set in, a son named Raucya was born to Ruci, the Prajapati.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Caksu?a Manvantara expired and the Vaivasvata Manvantara set in, a son named Raucya was born to Ruci, the Prajapati.

verses.sanskrit: स तीर्त्वा ह्यापदं दुर्गां नैवार्तिं समवाप्नुयात् । आयुःश्रीवर्धनं पुंसां चक्षुषाम् अपि पूरकम्
verses.transliteration: sa tīrtvā hyāpadaṃ durgāṃ naivārtiṃ samavāpnuyāt / āyuḥśrīvardhanaṃ puṃsāṃ cakṣuṣām api pūrakam
verses.translation: He who was born of Bhuti became known by the name Bhautya. In the Vaivasvata Manvantara two sons were born to Vivasvan.
verses.hindi: ग्रकार जब बहुत अधिक वृद्धि को प्राप्त हो जाती हैं, तब परस्पर मिल कण एक ज्वाला के रूप में परिणत ही. जाती है। एक मण्डलाकार स्वरूप धारणकर वह भग्नि चारों लोकों को अपने परम तेज से शीघ्र ही भस्म कर हि देती है, उस समय सभी लोकों का विनाश हो जाता हैं, सभी स्थावर जंगम जीवनिकाय विलीन हो जाते हैं, 'वृथ्वी वृक्षों एवं ठृणों से विहीन होकर कच्छप की पीठ की भाँति हों जाती है ।१४९-१५४१ । चारों ओर से इस प्रकार वक्षादि रहित जगत् एक भाड़ की तरह दिखाई पड़ता है, सारा आकाश मण्डल ज्वालाओं से देदीप्यमान हो जाता है, पाताल में जो जीव समूह रहते हैं, महान समुद्रों में जिन जन्तुओं का निवास रहता है, वे भी विलीन होकर पृथ्वी रूप में परिणत हो जाते हैं ।१५२-१४५२। सभी जीवों में व्याप्त रहने वाले अग्निदेव सातों द्वीपों, प्रवंतों, समस्त वर्षों दिक्षों) एवं महासमुद्रों तक को भस्म कर देते हैं। सवत्र व्याप्त अग्नि उस समय
verses.wordMeaning: He who was born of Bhuti became known by the name Bhautya. In the Vaivasvata Manvantara two sons were born to Vivasvan.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who was born of Bhuti became known by the name Bhautya. In the Vaivasvata Manvantara two sons were born to Vivasvan.

verses.sanskrit: उपपापहरं चैव सदा नीराजनं हरेः । तदा नीराजनाकाले यो हरेः पठति स्तवम्
verses.transliteration: upapāpaharaṃ caiva sadā nīrājanaṃ hareḥ / tadā nīrājanākāle yo hareḥ paṭhati stavam
verses.translation: One is well known as Vaivasvata Manu and the other as Savarna. The learned Lord Vaivasvata Manu was the eldest son of Sarhjna.
verses.hindi: जब समुद्रों, नदियों, पातालस्थ प्रदेशों से जलरासि का पान करते हुए परम जाज्ज्वल्यमान होकर प्रथ्वी का आश्रय लेती है, तब महान् संवतंक नामक अश्नि पर्वतों का अतिक्रमण कर घोर रूप हो समस्त लोकों का विनाझ करने लगती है। पृथ्वी का भेदन कर वह रसातल को शुष्क कर देती है, पाताल के सभी प्रदेशों को भस्म कर वह नाभों का लोक जला देती है ।११४-१५७। निम्न भूमण्डल का दहन करने के उपरान्त ऊपर आकाशस्थ
verses.wordMeaning: One is well known as Vaivasvata Manu and the other as Savarna. The learned Lord Vaivasvata Manu was the eldest son of Sarhjna.
verses.commentary: Sense: One is well known as Vaivasvata Manu and the other as Savarna. The learned Lord Vaivasvata Manu was the eldest son of Sarhjna.

verses.sanskrit: स धन्यो देवदेवस्य प्रसन्नेनान्तरात्मना । हरेर् नीराजनाशेषं पाणिभ्यां यः प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: sa dhanyo devadevasya prasannenāntarātmanā / harer nīrājanāśeṣaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati
verses.translation: The other Vaivasvata Manu was the son of Savarna (i.e. Chaya, the shadow of Sarhjna). The four Savarna Manus born of the great sages will be equipping themselves with (the power of) penance. They will achieve all their tasks in their respective future Manvantaras.
verses.hindi: प्रदेशों एवं पिडों का दहत करती है, उस समय महान् संवर्तक की ज्वालाएँ सहस्रों, लाखों अरबों योजनों तक ऊपर को उठती हैं। गन्धवों, पिशाचों, सर्पों एवं राक्षसों के था श्रयों को सर्वाशतः भस्म करने के उपरान्त गोलोक को भी वह भस्म कर देती है ।१५८-१५९। इस प्रकार कालाग्नि घोर स्वरूप धारण कर भू, भुव स्व एवं मह-- केगर क्‍ .. बापूपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: The other Vaivasvata Manu was the son of Savarna (i.e. Chaya, the shadow of Sarhjna). The four Savarna Manus born of the great sages will be equipping themselves with (the power of) penance. They will achieve all their tasks in their respective future Manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The other Vaivasvata Manu was the son of Savarna (i.e. Chaya, the shadow of Sarhjna). The four Savarna Manus born of the great sages will be equipping themselves with (the power of) penance. They will achieve all their tasks in their respective future Manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: संगृह्य चक्षुषी तेन योजयेन् मार्जयन्मुखम् । तिमिरादीनक्षिरोगान् नाशयेद् दीप्तिमन्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: saṃgṛhya cakṣuṣī tena yojayen mārjayanmukham / timirādīnakṣirogān nāśayed dīptimanmukham
verses.translation: (Defective verse) The sons of the first Merusavarni Manu who was the son of Daksa were the three groups, Marlci- garbhas, Susarmans and Paras. All these noble-souled ones were born in the Vaivasvata Manvantara. They are the sons of Rohita, the Prajapati, the son of Daksa. In future each of these groups will consist of twelve Devas.
verses.hindi: चूलोक तु भुवर्लोक स्थलॉक व महस्तथा। घोरो दहति कालाग्निरेवं लॉकचतुष्टयम्
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) The sons of the first Merusavarni Manu who was the son of Daksa were the three groups, Marlci- garbhas, Susarmans and Paras. All these noble-souled ones were born in the Vaivasvata Manvantara. They are the sons of Rohita, the Prajapati, the son of Daksa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) The sons of the first Merusavarni Manu who was the son of Daksa were the three groups, Marlci- garbhas, Susarmans and Paras. All these noble-souled ones were born in the Vaivasvata Manvantara. They are the sons of Rohita, the Prajapati, the son of Daksa.…

verses.sanskrit: भवत्य् अशेषदुष्टानां नाशायालं नरोत्तम । दीपप्रज्वलनं यस्य नित्यमग्रे श्रियः पतेः
verses.transliteration: bhavaty aśeṣaduṣṭānāṃ nāśāyālaṃ narottama / dīpaprajvalanaṃ yasya nityamagre śriyaḥ pateḥ
verses.translation: (Defective) Aisvarya-Sangraha, Raha, Bahuvasa (and the remaining) should be known as twelve Para gods. Under¬ stand the later ones.
verses.hindi: व्याप्तेषु तेषु लोकेंबु तियंगरष्वंभधारिनना । तत्तेजः समनृप्राप्तं कृत्स्नं जगविवं शनेः । अयोगुडनिभ सब तदा होब॑ प्रकाशते... क्‍ ततो गजगुलाकारास्तडिख्िः समलंकृताः । उत्तिष्ठन्ति तदा धोरा व्योम्नि संवर्तका घनाः
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) Aisvarya-Sangraha, Raha, Bahuvasa (and the remaining) should be known as twelve Para gods. Under¬ stand the later ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) Aisvarya-Sangraha, Raha, Bahuvasa (and the remaining) should be known as twelve Para gods. Under¬ stand the later ones.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा रेवाजले पुण्ये प्रदद्यादधिकं व्रती । सप्तद्वीपवती तेन ससागरवनापगा
verses.transliteration: snātvā revājale puṇye pradadyādadhikaṃ vratī / saptadvīpavatī tena sasāgaravanāpagā
verses.translation: Vajiya, Vajijit, Prabhuti, KakudI (?), Dadhikrava, Ayapakva, Pranita, Vijaya, Madhu, Tejasman and two Nathavas—these twelve constitute the Maricis. I shall re¬ count the Susarmans mentioning the names. Listen to (them) and understand. Varna, Anga, Visva, Muranya, Vrajana, Amita, Dravaketu, Jambhostha, Ajasra, Sakraka, Sunemi and Dyuta- pas—these twelve constitute SuSarmans. Their future Indra will be known by the name Adbhuta.
verses.hindi: केचिप्तीलोत्पलश्यामा केचित्कुसुदसंनिभाः । केचिहवदूयंसंकाशा इखनोलतनिभाः परे . (१६३ शद्भुकुरदनिभाश्वान्ये जात्यअ्जननिभास्तथा । घूज्वर्णा घनाः केचित्केचित्पीताः पयोधराः
verses.wordMeaning: Vajiya, Vajijit, Prabhuti, KakudI (?), Dadhikrava, Ayapakva, Pranita, Vijaya, Madhu, Tejasman and two Nathavas—these twelve constitute the Maricis. I shall re¬ count the Susarmans mentioning the names. Listen to (them) and understand. Varna, Anga, Visva, Muranya, Vrajana,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vajiya, Vajijit, Prabhuti, KakudI (?), Dadhikrava, Ayapakva, Pranita, Vijaya, Madhu, Tejasman and two Nathavas—these twelve constitute the Maricis. I shall re¬ count the Susarmans mentioning the names. Listen to (them) and understand. Varna, Anga, Visva, Muranya, Vrajana,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणीकृता स्याद्वै धरणी शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत् । इदं यः पठ्यमानं तु शृणुयात् पठते ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇīkṛtā syādvai dharaṇī śaṅkaro 'bravīt / idaṃ yaḥ paṭhyamānaṃ tu śṛṇuyāt paṭhate 'pi vā
verses.translation: The seven sages in the Rohita Manvantara were— Skanda of fiery nature and resembling Soma and otherwise known as Kartikeya, Medhatithi of Pulastya lineage, Vasu of Kasyapa Gotra, Jyotisman of Bhrgu family, Dyutiman of Angiras lineage, Vasita of Vasistha Gotra, Havyavahana of Atri's Gotra and Sutapas of Paulava family.
verses.hindi: केथिद्रासभवर्णाभा लाक्षारकतनिभास्तथा । मनःशिलाभास्त्वपरे कपोताभास्तथाअस्ुदा: इच्त्रगोपनिभाः केचिदुत्तिष्ठस्ति घना दिवि। (केचित्पुरधराकाराः केचिवृगजकुलोपमाः १६६ केचित्पयं तसंकाशाः कैचित्स्थलनिभा धनताः) । कुण्डागारनिभाः केचित्केचित्मीनकुलोपमाः:
verses.wordMeaning: The seven sages in the Rohita Manvantara were— Skanda of fiery nature and resembling Soma and otherwise known as Kartikeya, Medhatithi of Pulastya lineage, Vasu of Kasyapa Gotra, Jyotisman of Bhrgu family, Dyutiman of Angiras lineage, Vasita of Vasistha Gotra,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven sages in the Rohita Manvantara were— Skanda of fiery nature and resembling Soma and otherwise known as Kartikeya, Medhatithi of Pulastya lineage, Vasu of Kasyapa Gotra, Jyotisman of Bhrgu family, Dyutiman of Angiras lineage, Vasita of Vasistha Gotra,…

verses.sanskrit: स्मरणं सो ऽतसमये विपाप्मा प्राप्नुयाद्धरेः । इदं यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वर्ग्यं पितृगुणप्रियम्
verses.transliteration: smaraṇaṃ so 'tasamaye vipāpmā prāpnuyāddhareḥ / idaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ pitṛguṇapriyam
verses.translation: In the tenth revolution (i.e. cycle of four Yugas?) the second Savarni, the son of Dharma, will be the Manu. In his Manvantara, there will be two groups of Devas, viz. Sukhamanas and Viruddhas. All of them will be Tvisivants ('highly effulgent') a hundred in number and mutually equal (?)—alike. They are said to be controlling the breath in (other?) persons by the sages. They will be the Devas at the time of the Manu, son of Dharma.
verses.hindi: ततस्ते जलदा घोरा शाविणों भास्करात्मिकाः। सप्तथा संवृतात्मानस्तमग्नि शमयस्त्युत
verses.wordMeaning: In the tenth revolution (i.e. cycle of four Yugas?) the second Savarni, the son of Dharma, will be the Manu. In his Manvantara, there will be two groups of Devas, viz. Sukhamanas and Viruddhas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the tenth revolution (i.e. cycle of four Yugas?) the second Savarni, the son of Dharma, will be the Manu. In his Manvantara, there will be two groups of Devas, viz. Sukhamanas and Viruddhas.…

verses.sanskrit: माहात्म्यं श्रावयेद् विप्राञ्छ्रीपतेः श्राद्धकर्मणि । घृतेन मधुना तेन तर्पिताः स्युः पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: māhātmyaṃ śrāvayed viprāñchrīpateḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi / ghṛtena madhunā tena tarpitāḥ syuḥ pitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: Their Indra will be the great scholar Santi. The Seven Great Sages will be the glorious Havisman of the Pulaha family, Suklrti of Bhrgu race, Apomurti of Atri lineage, Apava (?) of Vasi$jha family, Pratipa of Pulastya family, Nabhaga of Kasyapa family and Abhimanyu of Angiras family.
verses.hindi: इन चारों लोकों को सर्वांशतः भस्मावशेष कर देती है। नीचे ऊपश॒ सत्र अग्नि से परिव्याप्त होकर धीरे-धीरे यह समस्त जगर्मण्डल तेजोमय होकर एक तपाये हुए लोहे के पिण्ड की भाँति प्रकाशमान होता है। उसके बाद हाथियों के समूहों के समान आकार वाले, विद्युतों से सुप्रकाशित संवर्तक नामक मेघगण घोररूप धारण कर आकाश भण्डल में उठ पड़ते हैं ।१६०-१६२। उनमें कुछ नीचे कमल के समान द्यामल धर्ण के, कुछ कुमुदिमी के समान श्वेत वर्ण के, कुछ वैदर्भ मणि के समान, कुछ इन्द्रतील के समान, कुछ कुल्द ओर हांख के समान अतिदाय धवेत, कुछ काजल के समान काले, कुछ धुएँ के समान अतिशय काले, कुछ पीले, कुछ गधे के समान घूसरित-रंगवाले, कुछ लाल के समान रक्तवर्ण वाले, कुछ मैनशिल के समान और कुछ कबूतरों के समान वर्ण वाले रहते हैं। १६३०१६५॥ यही नहीं, कुछ. इन्द्रमोप (एक बरसाती कीड़ा जो लाल रंग का होता है ।) के
verses.wordMeaning: Their Indra will be the great scholar Santi. The Seven Great Sages will be the glorious Havisman of the Pulaha family, Suklrti of Bhrgu race, Apomurti of Atri lineage, Apava (?) of Vasi$jha family, Pratipa of Pulastya family,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Their Indra will be the great scholar Santi. The Seven Great Sages will be the glorious Havisman of the Pulaha family, Suklrti of Bhrgu race, Apomurti of Atri lineage, Apava (?) of Vasi$jha family, Pratipa of Pulastya family,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्रीपतिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चनवत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १९६ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेद् धराधीश हंसतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यत्र हंसस्तपस्तप्त्वा ब्रह्मवाहनतां गतः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīpatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcanavatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 196 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacched dharādhīśa haṃsatīrthamanuttamam / yatra haṃsastapastaptvā brahmavāhanatāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: The ten sons ofManuwill be—Suksetra, Uttama- ujas, Bhurisena, Vlryavan, Satanlka, Niramitra, Vrsasena, Jayadratha, Bhuridyumna and Suvarcas. In the eleventh revo¬ lution (cycle of four Yugas) when the third Savarni will be the Manu, the following three groups of noble-souled Devas will be famous: Nirmanaratis, Kamajas (Kamagas in Bd.P.) and Manojavas.
verses.hindi: समान अतिशय रक्त वर्ण के मेघ आकाश 'पष्डल में दिखाई “पड़ते हैं । कुछ ग्रामों एवं प्रथ्वी खण्ड के समान  भीषण, कुछ हाथियों की पंक्ति के समान विज्ञाल, कुछ पर्वतों के समान विशाल, कुछ पव॑तों के समान भीषण, कुछ चट्टानों कौ तरह विस्तृत भेत्र भी होते हैं। कुछ की आकृति कुण्डों की तरह गहरी दिखाई पड़ती है, कुछ मछलियों के समूहों से व्याप्त दिखाई पड़ते हैं ।१६६-१६७। इस प्रकार अनेक रूप धारण कर कठोर क्केश
verses.wordMeaning: The ten sons ofManuwill be—Suksetra, Uttama- ujas, Bhurisena, Vlryavan, Satanlka, Niramitra, Vrsasena, Jayadratha, Bhuridyumna and Suvarcas. In the eleventh revo¬ lution (cycle of four Yugas) when the third Savarni will be the Manu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ten sons ofManuwill be—Suksetra, Uttama- ujas, Bhurisena, Vlryavan, Satanlka, Niramitra, Vrsasena, Jayadratha, Bhuridyumna and Suvarcas. In the eleventh revo¬ lution (cycle of four Yugas) when the third Savarni will be the Manu,…

verses.sanskrit: हंसतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा दानं दत्त्वा च काञ्चनम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: haṃsatīrthe naraḥ snātvā dānaṃ dattvā ca kāñcanam / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Each of these groups consists of thirty units. The thirty days in a month mentioned by the poets constitute the Devas Nirmanaratis. The nights (known as?) Vihangamas (constitute the Kamaja Devas). The Muhurtas constitute the Devas Manojavas. These are the three groups of Devas men¬ tioned, These future Manus are remembered as the sons of Brahma.
verses.hindi: गजंन करने वाले वे मेघणण सारे आकाअ मण्डल को व्याप्त कर लेते हैं । सूर्यात्मक वे मेघगण घोर गजन करते हुए सात भागों में विर्भक्त होकर उस भग्नि को शान्‍्त करने लगते हैं। बड़े वेग से जल-राशि बरसाते हुए वे  घनुरिचिल्वास्तबंतग्रन्थों ग. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Each of these groups consists of thirty units. The thirty days in a month mentioned by the poets constitute the Devas Nirmanaratis. The nights (known as?) Vihangamas (constitute the Kamaja Devas). The Muhurtas constitute the Devas Manojavas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Each of these groups consists of thirty units. The thirty days in a month mentioned by the poets constitute the Devas Nirmanaratis. The nights (known as?) Vihangamas (constitute the Kamaja Devas). The Muhurtas constitute the Devas Manojavas.…

verses.sanskrit: हंसयुक्तेन यानेन तरुणादित्यवर्चसा । सर्वकामसमृद्धेन सेव्यमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: haṃsayuktena yānena taruṇādityavarcasā / sarvakāmasamṛddhena sevyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Their Indra, the king of Suras, will be called Vfsa. Listen and understand their Seven Sages who are being glori¬ fied.
verses.hindi: ततस्ते जलदा वर्ष मुझचन्ति च महोघवत्  सुघोरमशिवं सर्व नाशयस्ति च पावकम्. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Their Indra, the king of Suras, will be called Vfsa. Listen and understand their Seven Sages who are being glori¬ fied.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their Indra, the king of Suras, will be called Vfsa. Listen and understand their Seven Sages who are being glori¬ fied.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भुक्त्वा यथाकामं सर्वान् भोगान् यथेप्सितान् । जातिस्मरो हि जायेत पुनर्मानुष्यम् आगतः
verses.transliteration: tatra bhuktvā yathākāmaṃ sarvān bhogān yathepsitān / jātismaro hi jāyeta punarmānuṣyam āgataḥ
verses.translation: They are—Havisman of Kasyapa family, Vapusman of Bhrgu's race, Varuni of Atri lineage, Bhaga of Vasistha's family, Pusti who should be known as hailing from Angiras family, Niscara of Pulastya race and Agnitejas of Pulaha family. They are also the Devas in the eleventh Manvantara. The following are the sons of Prajapatya (son of Prajapati) Savarna Manu—Sarvavega, Sudharma, Devanlka, Purovaha, Ksema- dharma, Grhesu, Adarsa and Paunqhaka.
verses.hindi: साद़िद्वीपान्तरं पृथ्वी अख्दिः संछायते तदा कर ््ि .. ततस्तु सहसोद्धास्त: पयोदांस्‍्तान्नभस्तले । संवेष्टयति घोरात्मा विबि वायुः समस्‍्ततः ७४१७७ तस्मिप्लेकाणवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजड्धमे । पूर्ण युगसहल्ने वे निशेषः कल्प उच्चते... १७८
verses.wordMeaning: They are—Havisman of Kasyapa family, Vapusman of Bhrgu's race, Varuni of Atri lineage, Bhaga of Vasistha's family, Pusti who should be known as hailing from Angiras family, Niscara of Pulastya race and Agnitejas of Pulaha family.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are—Havisman of Kasyapa family, Vapusman of Bhrgu's race, Varuni of Atri lineage, Bhaga of Vasistha's family, Pusti who should be known as hailing from Angiras family, Niscara of Pulastya race and Agnitejas of Pulaha family.…

verses.sanskrit: संन्यासेन त्यजेद् देहं मोक्षम् आप्नोति भारत
verses.transliteration: saṃnyāsena tyajed dehaṃ mokṣam āpnoti bhārata
verses.translation: The Devas will be—Haritas, Rohitas, Sumanas, Sukar- mans and Suparas. These are remembered as the five groups of Devas.
verses.hindi: मेभमण उस परम घोर अमज़ुलकारी अग्नि को सर्वेत्र नष्ट कर देते हैं। १६८-१७०। उस अनम्त जल राशि से समस्त जमगन्मण्डल पूर्ण हो जाता है, अग्नि का सारा तेज जल से शान्त हो जांता है, बह जल में प्रविष्ट होकर विलीन हो जाती है। अग्नि के सध्ट हो जाने के उपरान्त समस्त ज्वलनात्मक कार्यो के परिणाम से उत्पन्न पंजंस्य बण सो वर्षों तक अपनो अकूत जलराशि की धृष्टि द्वारा समस्त जगल्मण्डल को
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas will be—Haritas, Rohitas, Sumanas, Sukar- mans and Suparas. These are remembered as the five groups of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas will be—Haritas, Rohitas, Sumanas, Sukar- mans and Suparas. These are remembered as the five groups of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं पार्थ हंसतीर्थस्य यत्फलम् । सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वदुःखविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ pārtha haṃsatīrthasya yatphalam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanam
verses.translation: They are the mental sons of Brahma. Each of these groups consists of ten Devas. The following ten constitute the Harita group of Devas: Aruntija, Hari (? Havi), Vidvan (whose followers are) in thousands, Parvatanucara, Apas, Amsu (prob. Apamsu as in Bd.P.), Manojava, Urja, Svaha, Svadha lixcL Tara
verses.hindi: प्लावित करते हैं । स्वयम्भू की प्रेरणा से प्रेरित होकर ने अपनी धाराओं से जगत् को पूर्ण कर देते हैं। कुछ पयोद अपनी जल राशि से मर्यादा को भी अतिक्रांत कर देते हैं  उस समय पृथ्वी के समस्त द्वीप, पर्वत एवं प्रदेश जले से आच्छादित ही जाते हैं ।१७१-१७३ सूत कहते हैं, विश्रवुल्द ! पर्जन्यों से बृष्टि द्वारा बरसाया गया जल-समूह, जितना भी होता है, जाकर समुद्र में प्रवेश करता है, वहां सूर्य की किरणों से पिया जाता है, सू की किरणों से पिये जाने के बाद बह जल बादलों में स्थित होता है । फिर वही पृथ्वी पर गिरता है, ओर फिर से सादे समुद्र भर जाहे हैं और भय कर अपनो स्र्यादा को भी बाँध जाते हैं, जिसके कारण पबंत समूह छिन्न भिन्न होकर गिर पड़ते हैं; पृष्वी पानी में छिप जाती है। १७४-१७६॥ अस्तु, इस प्रकाद जब मेभगण आकाशमण्डल में स्थित होकर बृष्टि से पस्त जगल्मण्डल को व्याप्त कर देते हैं, हब सहसा महात् बाबू घोर
verses.wordMeaning: They are the mental sons of Brahma. Each of these groups consists of ten Devas. The following ten constitute the Harita group of Devas: Aruntija, Hari (? Havi), Vidvan (whose followers are) in thousands, Parvatanucara, Apas, Amsu (prob. Apamsu as in Bd.P.), Manojava, Urja,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the mental sons of Brahma. Each of these groups consists of ten Devas. The following ten constitute the Harita group of Devas: Aruntija, Hari (? Havi), Vidvan (whose followers are) in thousands, Parvatanucara, Apas, Amsu (prob. Apamsu as in Bd.P.), Manojava, Urja,…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे हंसतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षण्णवत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १९७ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्यैवानन्तरं गच्छेत् सूर्यतीर्थम् अनुत्तमम् । मूलस्थानमिति ख्यातं पद्मजस्थापितं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe haṃsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṇṇavatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 197 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ gacchet sūryatīrtham anuttamam / mūlasthānamiti khyātaṃ padmajasthāpitaṃ śubham
verses.translation: The following ten constitute the Rohita group:
verses.hindi: स्वरूप धारण कर उन बादलों को चारों भोर से आकाश में घेर लेता है, उस महान् भीषण, एक सर्मुई के रूप झें परिणत जगत् के सारे स्थावर जंगमात्मक जीव निकाय नष्ट हो जाते हैं, ओर ऐसी अवस्था में एक सहल युग व्यतीत हो जाता है, इसी अवस्था को कल्प कहते हैं ।!७७-१७५। पण्डित लोग उस स्थिति को; जब कि
verses.wordMeaning: The following ten constitute the Rohita group:
verses.commentary: Sense: The following ten constitute the Rohita group:

verses.sanskrit: मूलश्रीपतिना देवी प्रोक्ता स्थापय भास्करम् । श्रुत्वा देवोदितं देवी स्थापयामास भास्करम्
verses.transliteration: mūlaśrīpatinā devī proktā sthāpaya bhāskaram / śrutvā devoditaṃ devī sthāpayāmāsa bhāskaram
verses.translation: Understand the Sukarmans. They are—Suparva, Vrsabha, Prsta, Krpi, Dyurana, Vipascita, Vikrama, Karma, Nibhrta and Kanta. These Devas are Sukarmans. Now under¬ stand their sons (i.e. Suparas?)
verses.hindi: है5९ बायुपुराणमस् अभाम्भसावते लोके प्राहुरेकाणंवं बुधा: । अथ भूमितलं खं व वायुश्चकार्णवे तदा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Understand the Sukarmans. They are—Suparva, Vrsabha, Prsta, Krpi, Dyurana, Vipascita, Vikrama, Karma, Nibhrta and Kanta. These Devas are Sukarmans. Now under¬ stand their sons (i.e. Suparas?)
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand the Sukarmans. They are—Suparva, Vrsabha, Prsta, Krpi, Dyurana, Vipascita, Vikrama, Karma, Nibhrta and Kanta. These Devas are Sukarmans. Now under¬ stand their sons (i.e. Suparas?)

verses.sanskrit: प्रोच्यते नर्मदातीरे मूलस्थानाख्यभास्करः
verses.transliteration: procyate narmadātīre mūlasthānākhyabhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: They are: Varyodita, Jista, Varcasvl, Dyutiman, Havi, Subha, Havikrta, Prapti, Vyaprtha and Dasama (?) These are the mentally created ones the Suparas, the Devas mentioned (before). Rtadhama of great fame should be known as their Indra.
verses.hindi: पा्थिवास्त्वथ सासुद्रा आपो. हैमाश्च सर्वेशः । प्रसरन्त्यों ब्रजन्त्येकं सलिलाख्यां भजत्युत
verses.wordMeaning: They are: Varyodita, Jista, Varcasvl, Dyutiman, Havi, Subha, Havikrta, Prapti, Vyaprtha and Dasama (?) These are the mentally created ones the Suparas, the Devas mentioned (before). Rtadhama of great fame should be known as their Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are: Varyodita, Jista, Varcasvl, Dyutiman, Havi, Subha, Havikrta, Prapti, Vyaprtha and Dasama (?) These are the mentally created ones the Suparas, the Devas mentioned (before). Rtadhama of great fame should be known as their Indra.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरो यस्तु स्नात्वा नियतमानसः । संतर्प्य पितृदेवांश्च पिण्डेन सलिलेन च
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naro yastu snātvā niyatamānasaḥ / saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca piṇḍena salilena ca
verses.translation: The Seven Sages are—Krti the son of Vasistha, Sutapas of Atri's family, Tapomurti of the Angiras race, Tapas- vin of Kasyapa Gotra, Taposyana of Pulastya family, Taporati of Pulaha Gotra and the seventh of them should be known as Tapomati of Bhrgu family. These are the Siddhas, the Seven Sages in the Savarnika Manvantara. The following are the sons of the twelfth (?) Manu: Devavan, Upadeva, Devzisrestha, Viduratha, Mitravan, Mitrabindu, Mitrasena, Amitraha, Mitrabahu, and Suvargas.
verses.hindi: नानात्वे चेब शोध च धातुर्वे अर उच्यते । एकार्णवे तदा55पो वे न शीघ्रास्तेन ता नराः. ४१८३ तस्मिस्युगस हख्रान्ते दियसे ब्रह्मणो मते । तावन्तं कालमेवं तु भवत्येकाणंवं जगत् ॥ द एवमेकार्णवे तस्मिश्नष्टे स्थावरजडभमे । तदा स भवति ब्रह्मा सहत्नाक्ष: सहख्नरपात् (१८५
verses.wordMeaning: The Seven Sages are—Krti the son of Vasistha, Sutapas of Atri's family, Tapomurti of the Angiras race, Tapas- vin of Kasyapa Gotra, Taposyana of Pulastya family, Taporati of Pulaha Gotra and the seventh of them should be known as Tapomati of Bhrgu family. These are the Siddhas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Seven Sages are—Krti the son of Vasistha, Sutapas of Atri's family, Tapomurti of the Angiras race, Tapas- vin of Kasyapa Gotra, Taposyana of Pulastya family, Taporati of Pulaha Gotra and the seventh of them should be known as Tapomati of Bhrgu family. These are the Siddhas,…

verses.sanskrit: मूलस्थानं ततः पश्येत् स गच्छेत् परमां गतिम् । गुह्याद्गुह्यतरस्तत्र विशेषस्तु श्रुतो मया
verses.transliteration: mūlasthānaṃ tataḥ paśyet sa gacchet paramāṃ gatim / guhyādguhyatarastatra viśeṣastu śruto mayā
verses.translation: In the thirteenth revolution (Manvantara), the Raucya Manvantara, three groups of Devas are mentioned by the self- born deity (Brahma).
verses.hindi: समस्त लोक जल राशि दे घिर जाते हैं, एकार्णव (एक समुद्र) कहते हैं। उस एकार्णेव में पृथ्वो, आकाश अथवा वायु का कोई विशेष स्थान वा सन्निवेज्ष नहीं मालुम पड़ता, सब परृथक् अस्तित्व मिट जाता है, सभी एक दूसरे में बिलीन हो जाते हैं, कोन क्या है-यह कुछ नहीं मालूम पड़ता पाथिव (पृथ्वी सम्बन्धो) सामुद्र (समुद्रीय) एवं हैम ( सुवर्भ सम्बन्धी, तंजस ) जलराशि चारों भोर प्रवाहित द्वोतोी हुई उस समय एक मात्र सलिल
verses.wordMeaning: In the thirteenth revolution (Manvantara), the Raucya Manvantara, three groups of Devas are mentioned by the self- born deity (Brahma).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the thirteenth revolution (Manvantara), the Raucya Manvantara, three groups of Devas are mentioned by the self- born deity (Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: समागमे मुनीनां तु शङ्कराच्छशिशेखरात् । सदा वै शुक्लसप्तम्यां मूलमादित्यवासरः
verses.transliteration: samāgame munīnāṃ tu śaṅkarācchaśiśekharāt / sadā vai śuklasaptamyāṃ mūlamādityavāsaraḥ
verses.translation: They are said to be the future Somapayins (Imbi¬ bers of Soma juice), the groups of Devas. Along with the per¬ formers of Yajnas, the deities are thirtythree in number. They include the Ajya, Pfsadajya and Grahajyestha groups of Devas. Listen to and understand that the thirtythree Devas are separate ones.
verses.hindi: (जल) की पदबी धारण करती है, अर्थात् उसको अलग सत्ता नहीं रह बातो ॥१७९-१८०। समस्त जलराधशि केवल अनवरत इधर उधर आती जाती रहती है--ऐसा कहा जाता है, समुद्र के रूप में परिणत बह जलराशि समस्त महीमण्डल- को अच्छादित कर लेती है ।१८१। भा शब्द प्रकाक्ष ओर व्याप्ति करने के धर्य में ब्यवहृत होता है, इस समस्त जगतू-मण्डल के भस्म द्वो जाने के बाद अपनी व्याप्ति एवं प्रभा से सब ओर प्रकाशित होता है, अतः उसका नाम अम्भ (जल) कहा जाता. है, यही इस नाम के पड़ने का कारण है। भर् घातु अनेकरव एवं शीक्रत्व को प्रकठ करता है, एकार्ज व होने पर यतः वहू जलराधि शीत्नता से नहीं चलती, अतः उत्तका ताम नाइ कहा जाता है ।१८२-१५२। एक सहस युग के समाप्त द्वोने पर ब्रह्मा का एक दिन व्यतीत होता है, उतने ही समय तक यह समस्त जबत
verses.wordMeaning: They are said to be the future Somapayins (Imbi¬ bers of Soma juice), the groups of Devas. Along with the per¬ formers of Yajnas, the deities are thirtythree in number. They include the Ajya, Pfsadajya and Grahajyestha groups of Devas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are said to be the future Somapayins (Imbi¬ bers of Soma juice), the groups of Devas. Along with the per¬ formers of Yajnas, the deities are thirtythree in number. They include the Ajya, Pfsadajya and Grahajyestha groups of Devas.…

verses.sanskrit: तदा रेवाजलं गत्वा स्नात्वा संतर्प्य देवताः । पित्ःंश्च भरतश्रेष्ठ दत्त्वा दानं स्वशक्तितः
verses.transliteration: tadā revājalaṃ gatvā snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ / pitḥṃśca bharataśreṣṭha dattvā dānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ
verses.translation: The Sutramans are the present Prayajyas and Ajyapas. The Anuyajyas and those who partake Pfsadajya are Sukarmans. The Upayajyas are Sudharmans. Thus the Devas have been recounted. Divaspati of great prowess will be their Indra.
verses.hindi: एकार्णव के रूप में परिणित रहता है, उस अवधि में प्रजापति ब्रह्मा के समस्त व्यापार निवत्त हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Sutramans are the present Prayajyas and Ajyapas. The Anuyajyas and those who partake Pfsadajya are Sukarmans. The Upayajyas are Sudharmans. Thus the Devas have been recounted. Divaspati of great prowess will be their Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sutramans are the present Prayajyas and Ajyapas. The Anuyajyas and those who partake Pfsadajya are Sukarmans. The Upayajyas are Sudharmans. Thus the Devas have been recounted. Divaspati of great prowess will be their Indra.

verses.sanskrit: करवीरैस् ततो गत्वा रक्तचन्दनवारिणा । संस्थाप्य भास्करं भक्त्या सम्पूज्य च यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: karavīrais tato gatvā raktacandanavāriṇā / saṃsthāpya bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā sampūjya ca yathāvidhi
verses.translation: The sons of Ruci should be known as the grand¬ sons of Pulaha. The Seven Sages in the thirteenth Manvantara will be—Dhrtiman of Angiras family, Pathyavan of Pulastya race, Tattvadarsin of Pulaha family, Nirutsaka of Bhrgu Gotra, Nisprakampa of Atri's family, Nirmoha ofKasyapa Gotra and Svarupa of Vasistha lineage. The following are the sons of Raucya Manu in the thirteenth Manvantara: Citrasena, Vicitra, Tapas, Dharmadhrta, Bhava, Anekabaddha, Ksatrabaddha, Surasa, Nirbhaya and Prtha.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार महान् एकार्णव में जब समस्त स्थावर जंग्रमात्मक जगत् नष्ट हो जाता है, तब सहसनेत्र, सहस्त (वेदतयी) पयानुमामी, आदित्य के समान प्रखर तेजस्वी स्वरूपवाले, धमस्त भुवनरक्षक, अपूर्व, अद्वितौय, बपने
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Ruci should be known as the grand¬ sons of Pulaha. The Seven Sages in the thirteenth Manvantara will be—Dhrtiman of Angiras family, Pathyavan of Pulastya race, Tattvadarsin of Pulaha family, Nirutsaka of Bhrgu Gotra, Nisprakampa of Atri's family,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Ruci should be known as the grand¬ sons of Pulaha. The Seven Sages in the thirteenth Manvantara will be—Dhrtiman of Angiras family, Pathyavan of Pulastya race, Tattvadarsin of Pulaha family, Nirutsaka of Bhrgu Gotra, Nisprakampa of Atri's family,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः सागुरुकैर् धूपैः कुन्दरैश्च विशेषतः । धूपयेद् देवदेवेशं दीपान् बोध्य दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sāgurukair dhūpaiḥ kundaraiśca viśeṣataḥ / dhūpayed devadeveśaṃ dīpān bodhya diśo daśa
verses.translation: In the fourteenth Bhautya Manvantara, the future groups of Devas are five.
verses.hindi: चतुर्युगसहख्ान्ते सर्वतः सलिलाप्लुते । सुषुप्सुरप्रकाशां स्वां रात्रि तु कुरुते प्रभु .. १६८ खतु्विधा यदा शेते प्रजा: सर्वाण्डमण्डिता: । पश्यन्ते त॑ महात्मानं काल सप्त सहर्षयः.. ध१च६: जनलोके विवतंन्तस्तपसा लब्धचक्षुधः । भृग्वादयों महात्मानः पूर्वे व्यास्यातलक्षणाः
verses.wordMeaning: In the fourteenth Bhautya Manvantara, the future groups of Devas are five.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the fourteenth Bhautya Manvantara, the future groups of Devas are five.

verses.sanskrit: उपोष्य जागरं कुर्याद्गीतवाद्यं विशेषतः । एवं कृते महीपाल न भवेद् उग्रदुःखभाक्
verses.transliteration: upoṣya jāgaraṃ kuryādgītavādyaṃ viśeṣataḥ / evaṃ kṛte mahīpāla na bhaved ugraduḥkhabhāk
verses.translation: The five groups of Devas arc—Caksusas, Kanisthas, Pavitras, Bhajaras and Yacavrddhas. Know that the seven different parts are those named Caksusas. They understand Brhada and other Samans as the Kanisthas. The seven worlds are Paritras (Pavitras?) The Bhajiras (Bhajaras) are the seven Sindhus (oceans, rivers). Know the sages to be Vacavrddhas belonging to Svayambhuva Manu (?) AU the Indras of the Manvantaras should be known as having equal characteristics (and powers).....
verses.hindi: सत्यादीन्सप्त लोकास्वे ते हि पश्यन्ति चक्षूषा । ब्रह्मा ते तु पश्यन्ति महाब्राह्मौषु राजियु ॥१६१. सप्तर्षयः प्रपश्यन्ति सुप्तकालं स्व॒रात्रिषु । कल्पानां परमेष्टित्वात्तस्मादाद्यः स पठ्चते.. अथाधत्मनि महातेजाः सर्बमादाय सर्वकृत् । ततः स वसते रात्रि तमस्येका्णवे जले १६४
verses.wordMeaning: The five groups of Devas arc—Caksusas, Kanisthas, Pavitras, Bhajaras and Yacavrddhas. Know that the seven different parts are those named Caksusas. They understand Brhada and other Samans as the Kanisthas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The five groups of Devas arc—Caksusas, Kanisthas, Pavitras, Bhajaras and Yacavrddhas. Know that the seven different parts are those named Caksusas. They understand Brhada and other Samans as the Kanisthas.…

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यलोके वसेत् तावद् यावत् कल्पशतत्रयम् । गन्धर्वैर् अप्सरोभिश्च सेव्यमानो नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: sūryaloke vaset tāvad yāvat kalpaśatatrayam / gandharvair apsarobhiśca sevyamāno nṛpottama
verses.translation: Those Indras excel all the mobile and the immobile living beings in the three worlds by means of their splendour, penance, intellect, strength, learning and exploits.
verses.hindi: एवं सलोके निव॑ त्ते उपशान्ते प्रजापतो । ब्रह्मनेमित्तिके तस्मिन्कलि्पिते बे प्रसंयमे १६६
verses.wordMeaning: Those Indras excel all the mobile and the immobile living beings in the three worlds by means of their splendour, penance, intellect, strength, learning and exploits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Indras excel all the mobile and the immobile living beings in the three worlds by means of their splendour, penance, intellect, strength, learning and exploits.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मूलस्थानतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तनवत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १९८ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल भद्रकालीतिसङ्गमम् । शूलतीर्थमिति ख्यातं स्वयं देवेन निर्मितम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mūlasthānatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptanavatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 198 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchenmahīpāla bhadrakālītisaṅgamam / śūlatīrthamiti khyātaṃ svayaṃ devena nirmitam
verses.translation: The Indras (or Devas) are Bhutapavadins, Hfstas, Medhyasthas, Bhutavadins, Bhutanuvadins. The three Vedas are competent in respect to Pravadins (arguers.)
verses.hindi: अनृपम॒तेज सबको अभिभूंत करनेवाले, महान् अंधकार रूप अज्ञान से परे, हिरण्पगर्भ भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्थित रहते हैं। महामहिमामय भगवान् उस समय जबकि एक सहल्ल बार चारों युग व्यतीत हो जाते हैं, समस्त जमस्मण्डल जलराष्षि में डूब जाता है, शासन करने की इच्छा से अपनी महारात्रि की कल्पना करते हैं, जो महान् अंधकार से पूर्ण रहती है ।१८६-१८८। जिस समय चारों प्रकार की प्रजाओं को उस विश्ञास अण्ह में परिणत करके ( सब का संह्ार करके ) महात्मा प्रजापति ब्रह्मा शयन करते हैं। उसः समय उनकों केवल सप्तषिगण देखते रहते हैं । वे भुगु आदि महात्मा ऋषिगण उस समय जनलोक में निवास करते हैं, परम
verses.wordMeaning: The Indras (or Devas) are Bhutapavadins, Hfstas, Medhyasthas, Bhutavadins, Bhutanuvadins. The three Vedas are competent in respect to Pravadins (arguers.)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Indras (or Devas) are Bhutapavadins, Hfstas, Medhyasthas, Bhutavadins, Bhutanuvadins. The three Vedas are competent in respect to Pravadins (arguers.)

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चायतनमध्ये तु तिष्ठते परमेश्वरः । शूलपाणिर्महादेवः सर्वदेवतपूजितः
verses.transliteration: pañcāyatanamadhye tu tiṣṭhate parameśvaraḥ / śūlapāṇirmahādevaḥ sarvadevatapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Agnidhra, Kasyapa, Paulastya, Magadha, Bharga, Agnibahu, lud. Aigirasa, Ojaavm, and Snbala are the som of
verses.hindi: तपसथा के फलस्वरूप उन्हें दिव्य चक्षु की श्राप्ति हुई रहती है । इनके विस्तृत लक्षणों की चर्चा पूर्व प्रसंग में कर चुका हूँ ।ये महात्मा गण अपने दिव्यनेत्रों से सत्यादि सातों लोकों को देखते रहते हैं । भगवान् बहा का दर्शन उन्हें महाबलशाली रात्रियों में होता है।१८६-६६३॥ अपनी रात्रि के आने पर ब्रह्म जिस समय सुदुप्तावस्था में स्थित रहते हैं, उस समय सातों ऋषि उन्हें देखते हैं। समस्त कल्पों के
verses.wordMeaning: Agnidhra, Kasyapa, Paulastya, Magadha, Bharga, Agnibahu, lud. Aigirasa, Ojaavm, and Snbala are the som of
verses.commentary: Sense: Agnidhra, Kasyapa, Paulastya, Magadha, Bharga, Agnibahu, lud. Aigirasa, Ojaavm, and Snbala are the som of

verses.sanskrit: स सङ्गमो नृपश्रेष्ठ नित्यं देवैर्निषेवितः । दर्शनात्तस्य तीर्थस्य स्नानदानाद्विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sa saṅgamo nṛpaśreṣṭha nityaṃ devairniṣevitaḥ / darśanāttasya tīrthasya snānadānādviśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Then, at the end of the Manvantara, the seven Devas of the Bhrgu family, the powerful sovereign rulers, who had enjoyed the three worlds for seventyone cycles of four Yugas by remaining within them, and who used to perform Yajfias along with the Pitrs, Manus and the Seven Sages will then aban¬ don the three worlds and go to Maharloka along with their devotees and those who perform Yajfias. When they proceed upwards, and when the Manvantara expires, all the three worlds will be rendered without any support.
verses.hindi: अस्त में एक मात्र भगवान् ब्रह्मा हो शेष ( परमेष्ठी ) रहते हैं, अतः उन्हें भाथ्य ( सर्वप्रथम ) कहा जाता है। सब कुछ करने धरनेवाले महान् तेजस्वी भगवान् ब्रह्मा अपनी रात्रि में आत्मा में सबको समेट कर महातर॒ एकार्णव जबत् में; जब कि चारों ओर घोर अन्धकार विद्यमान रहता है, निवास करते हैं । तदनन्तर- जब रात्रि व्यतीत हो जाती है तब वें जाग्रत होते हैं, और सृष्टि करने कौ इच्छा से पुनः मन का संयोग करते हैं ।१६२-१६४५। इसी प्रकार ब्रह्मा के नेमित्तिक प्रलय में प्रजापति के हपशान्त एवं समस्त लोकों
verses.wordMeaning: Then, at the end of the Manvantara, the seven Devas of the Bhrgu family, the powerful sovereign rulers, who had enjoyed the three worlds for seventyone cycles of four Yugas by remaining within them, and who used to perform Yajfias along with the Pitrs,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, at the end of the Manvantara, the seven Devas of the Bhrgu family, the powerful sovereign rulers, who had enjoyed the three worlds for seventyone cycles of four Yugas by remaining within them, and who used to perform Yajfias along with the Pitrs,…

verses.sanskrit: दौर्भाग्यं दुर्निमित्तं च ह्यभिशापो नृपग्रहः । यदन्यद्दुष्कृतं कर्म नश्यते शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: daurbhāgyaṃ durnimittaṃ ca hyabhiśāpo nṛpagrahaḥ / yadanyadduṣkṛtaṃ karma naśyate śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: O Brahmanas! Thereafter, the abodes presided over by deities become vacant and fall down along with constella¬ tions, stars and planets getting hurled and destroyed.
verses.hindi: है८प९ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas! Thereafter, the abodes presided over by deities become vacant and fall down along with constella¬ tions, stars and planets getting hurled and destroyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas! Thereafter, the abodes presided over by deities become vacant and fall down along with constella¬ tions, stars and planets getting hurled and destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: कथं शूलेश्वरी देवी कथं शूलेश्वरो हरः । प्रथितो नर्मदातीरे एतद्विस्तरतो वद
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ śūleśvarī devī kathaṃ śūleśvaro haraḥ / prathito narmadātīre etadvistarato vada
verses.translation: Thereafter, when the lords of the three worlds including the eight Indras pass away, the fourteen groups of Devas beginning with (A)jita and others and ending with Caksusas—the Devas who were very mighty and full of splen¬ dour in all the Manvantaras—will go to Maharloka where they will become identical with those Devas who stay there till the end of the Kalpa.
verses.hindi: देहैवियोगः सत्त्वानां तस्मिन्व कृत्स्नशः स्मृतः । ततो दस्धेषु भृतेषु सर्वेष्वादित्यरश्मिभिः ॥ देवषिमनुवर्येषु तस्मिन्संकलने तदा
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, when the lords of the three worlds including the eight Indras pass away,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, when the lords of the three worlds including the eight Indras pass away,…

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: बभूव ब्राह्मणः कश्चिन्माण्डव्य इति विश्रुतः । वृत्तिमान्सर्वधर्मज्ञः सत्ये तपसि च स्थितः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: babhūva brāhmaṇaḥ kaścinmāṇḍavya iti viśrutaḥ / vṛttimānsarvadharmajñaḥ satye tapasi ca sthitaḥ
verses.translation: It is reported that when the time of Samhara (lit. heaping and collision— Sankalana) comes those fourteen groups of Devas will forsake Maharloka and go to Janaloka with (i.e. preserving) their physical bodies and accompanied by their followers.
verses.hindi: तियंग्योनीनि सत्त्वानि नारकेयाणि यान्यपि । तदा तान्यपि दग्धानि धृतपापानि सर्वेशः ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is reported that when the time of Samhara (lit. heaping and collision— Sankalana) comes those fourteen groups of Devas will forsake Maharloka and go to Janaloka with (i.e. preserving) their physical bodies and accompanied by their followers.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is reported that when the time of Samhara (lit. heaping and collision— Sankalana) comes those fourteen groups of Devas will forsake Maharloka and go to Janaloka with (i.e. preserving) their physical bodies and accompanied by their followers.

verses.sanskrit: अशोकाश्रममध्यस्थो वृक्षमूले महातपाः । ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्महातेजास्तस्थौ मौनव्रतान्वितः
verses.transliteration: aśokāśramamadhyastho vṛkṣamūle mahātapāḥ / ūrdhvabāhurmahātejāstasthau maunavratānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus when the Devas have gone from Maharloka to Janaloka, when BhQtadi (Cosmic Ego— Ahamkara ) and other (prime causes of the universe) remain and (even) immobiles have come to an end, when the abodes of the worlds beginning with Bhuh and ending with Mahah have become void, when the Devas have gone upward and become united with the Kalp- avasins (those who stay till the end of the Kalpa),
verses.hindi: व्युष्टायां तु रजस्यां तु ब्रह्मणेड्व्यक्तयोनये । जायन्ते हि पुनस्तानि सर्वेभुतानि कृत्लशः २०० ऋषयो मनयो देवा: प्रजा: सर्वाश्वतुविधा:  तेषामपीह सिद्धानां निधनोत्पत्तिरुच्यते २० १ यथा सुययस्य लोके5स्मिन्नुदयास्तमनं स्मृतम्। वया जन्म निरोधश्च भूतानामिह दृश्यते.. के घिनव्ट हो जाते पर सभी जीवविकाय अपने शरीरों से वियुक्त हो जाते हैं, सूर्य की किरणों से सभ्री जीव वहाँ तक कि देवता ऋषि एवं बड़े बड़े मुन्रि गण भी भस्म द्वो जते हैं १९६-१६८। इतना ही नहीं गन्धवं एवं . पिष्ताचादि यघोनियों में उत्पन्न भूत गण भी कल्पास्त में भस्म होकर जनलोक का आश्रय लेते हैं। उस समय जो तियंक योनि में उत्पन्न होनेवाले प्राणी रहते हैं, अथवा जिनका घोर नरकादि लोकों में निवास रहता है वे भी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus when the Devas have gone from Maharloka to Janaloka, when BhQtadi (Cosmic Ego— Ahamkara ) and other (prime causes of the universe) remain and (even) immobiles have come to an end, when the abodes of the worlds beginning with Bhuh and ending with Mahah have become void,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus when the Devas have gone from Maharloka to Janaloka, when BhQtadi (Cosmic Ego— Ahamkara ) and other (prime causes of the universe) remain and (even) immobiles have come to an end, when the abodes of the worlds beginning with Bhuh and ending with Mahah have become void,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य कालेन महता तीव्रे तपसि वर्ततः । तमाश्रममनुप्राप्ता दस्यवो लोप्त्रहारिणः
verses.transliteration: tasya kālena mahatā tīvre tapasi vartataḥ / tamāśramamanuprāptā dasyavo loptrahāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: after withdrawing (annihilating) those Devas, Sages, Pitps and Danavas, god Brahma with his powerful vision sees that it is the end of the Yuga and puts an end to his creation.
verses.hindi: दरघ होकर निष्पाप हो जाते हैं, और जन लोक में विद्यमान होते हैं ((६८-१६६। अम्त में जब ब्रह्मा की इस पन्‍्रहारातरिका अवदसान द्वोता है, तब वे सब जीव पुतः उत्पन्न होते हैं । ऋषियण, मनुगभ देवगण एवं प्रजा, इन सब की यहो गति होती है उस समय उन सिद्धि प्राप्त करने वालों का भी विनाश एबं उत्पन्न होना बतलायां जाता है जिस प्रकार इस लोक में सूयें का उदय होना तथा अस्त होना निद्दियत कहा जाता
verses.wordMeaning: after withdrawing (annihilating) those Devas, Sages, Pitps and Danavas, god Brahma with his powerful vision sees that it is the end of the Yuga and puts an end to his creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: after withdrawing (annihilating) those Devas, Sages, Pitps and Danavas, god Brahma with his powerful vision sees that it is the end of the Yuga and puts an end to his creation.

verses.sanskrit: अनुसर्प्यमाणा बहुभिः पुरुषैर् भरतर्षभ । ते तस्यावसथे लोप्त्रं न्यदधुः कुरुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: anusarpyamāṇā bahubhiḥ puruṣair bharatarṣabha / te tasyāvasathe loptraṃ nyadadhuḥ kurunandana
verses.translation: The knowers of day and night of god Brahma under¬ stand that the day of Brahma consists of a thousand cycles of four Yugas and similarly the night too consists of a thousand cycles of four Yugas.
verses.hindi: : है, उसी प्रकार समस्त जीवों का भी जम्म लेना और मृत्यु प्राप्त करना देखा जाता है ।२००-२०१। समस्त जीवों के इस महान् बिताश के बाद पुनः भव अर्थात् उत्पत्ति होती है, इसीलिए इस लोक का नाम संसार कहा जादा है। जिस प्रकार वर्षा ऋतु में वे वस्तुएं अपने आप उत्पन्न हो जाती हैं, उसी प्रकार प्रलय के प्रत्येक कस्पों में जिन चराचर जीवों का जो-जो स्वरूप रहता है, जंसा जैसा आकार-प्रकार रहता है, ब्राह्म रात्रि के अवसान के उपरान्त पुलः नये कल्प का आरम्भ द्वोने पर वे उसी प्रकार के स्वरुप आकार एवं प्रकार में उत्पन्न देखे जाते हैं। भराचर जीव व॒ग्द, प्रजाकर्ता, प्रजापति; महायोगी; एवं महान् ऐद्वर्यशाली भगवान् ब्रह्मा के
verses.wordMeaning: The knowers of day and night of god Brahma under¬ stand that the day of Brahma consists of a thousand cycles of four Yugas and similarly the night too consists of a thousand cycles of four Yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowers of day and night of god Brahma under¬ stand that the day of Brahma consists of a thousand cycles of four Yugas and similarly the night too consists of a thousand cycles of four Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: निधाय च तदा लीनास्तत्रैवाश्रममण्डले । तेषु लीनेष्वथो शीघ्रं ततस् तद्रक्षिणां बलम्
verses.transliteration: nidhāya ca tadā līnāstatraivāśramamaṇḍale / teṣu līneṣvatho śīghraṃ tatas tadrakṣiṇāṃ balam
verses.translation: This Pratisaficara (Dissolution & Reabsorption) of all
verses.hindi: शततमोध्ण्याय: द है८७
verses.wordMeaning: This Pratisaficara (Dissolution & Reabsorption) of all
verses.commentary: Sense: This Pratisaficara (Dissolution & Reabsorption) of all

verses.sanskrit: आजगाम ततो ऽपश्यंस्तम् ऋषिं तस्करानुगाः । तमपृच्छंस्तदा वृत्तं रक्षिणस्तं तपोधनम्
verses.transliteration: ājagāma tato 'paśyaṃstam ṛṣiṃ taskarānugāḥ / tamapṛcchaṃstadā vṛttaṃ rakṣiṇastaṃ tapodhanam
verses.translation: The Naimittika dissolution is the burning (of the Uni¬ verse) at the end of the Kalpa and complete withdrawal (of all beings) by god Brahma. The destruction of Karanas (instru¬ ments or means and causes) of living beings during Pratisarga (absorption) into Prakrti is called Prakrta type of dissolution.
verses.hindi: निष्कमस्ते विशस्ते व प्रजाकारं प्रजापतिम् । ब्रह्माणं सर्वभुतानि महायोग॑ महेश्वरम् सखष्टा सर्वमृतानां कल्पादिषु पुनः पुनः । व्यक्ताव्यक्तो महादेवस्तस्य सर्व्िदं जगत् १२०७ येनेव सृष्ठा प्रथम प्रयाता आपो हि मार्गण महीतलेइस्सिन । द
verses.wordMeaning: The Naimittika dissolution is the burning (of the Uni¬ verse) at the end of the Kalpa and complete withdrawal (of all beings) by god Brahma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Naimittika dissolution is the burning (of the Uni¬ verse) at the end of the Kalpa and complete withdrawal (of all beings) by god Brahma.…

verses.sanskrit: वद केन पथा याता दस्यवो द्विजसत्तम । तेन गच्छामहे ब्रह्मन् यथा शीघ्रतरं वयम्
verses.transliteration: vada kena pathā yātā dasyavo dvijasattama / tena gacchāmahe brahman yathā śīghrataraṃ vayam
verses.translation: The dissolution due to dawning of spiritual knowledge is said to be the ultimate one ( Alyantika,) as it renders the seeds (causes) of Samsara, impossible.
verses.hindi: तद्भाविताख्यातिवशाच्च धर्म्या: पुननिसगेण भवन्ति सत्त्वा:+ २१० अत ऊचध्वे प्रवक््यामि कालमामूतसंप्लवम् । मन्वन्तराणि यानि स्पुर्व्याल्यातानि मया द्विजा: ॥ सह प्रजानिसगेंण सह देवंश्वतुदंश द
verses.wordMeaning: The dissolution due to dawning of spiritual knowledge is said to be the ultimate one ( Alyantika,) as it renders the seeds (causes) of Samsara, impossible.
verses.commentary: Sense: The dissolution due to dawning of spiritual knowledge is said to be the ultimate one ( Alyantika,) as it renders the seeds (causes) of Samsara, impossible.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तु वचनं तेषां ब्रुवतां स तपोधनः । न किंचिद् वचनं राजन्नवदत्साध्वसाधु वा
verses.transliteration: tathā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ bruvatāṃ sa tapodhanaḥ / na kiṃcid vacanaṃ rājannavadatsādhvasādhu vā
verses.translation: After dissolving all the Devas residing in the three worlds at the end of his day and when he feels the urge to sleep (?), Lord Brahma destroys all the subjects and dissolves all the creation.
verses.hindi: स पुगाल्यासहख्त तु सर्वाण्येवास्तराणि वे । अस्या: सहले है पूर्ण निःशेषः कल्प उच्चते... काक्राआओपअणणशण/:/ईणई४८ई”/थ/भ/भलऋझलदवजजय--न्‍-  “॒“
verses.wordMeaning: After dissolving all the Devas residing in the three worlds at the end of his day and when he feels the urge to sleep (?), Lord Brahma destroys all the subjects and dissolves all the creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: After dissolving all the Devas residing in the three worlds at the end of his day and when he feels the urge to sleep (?), Lord Brahma destroys all the subjects and dissolves all the creation.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते राजपुरुषा विचिन्वन्तस्तमाश्रमम् । संयम्यैनं ततो राज्ञे सर्वान् दस्यून् न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration: tataste rājapuruṣā vicinvantastamāśramam / saṃyamyainaṃ tato rājñe sarvān dasyūn nyavedayan
verses.translation: Then at the end of a thousand cycles of Caturjiugas, when the period of annihilation of Yuga arrives, Prajapati (Lord of subjects, viz. Brahma) begins to make the subjects abide in him (i.e. absorb in himself).
verses.hindi: झरोर में प्रवेश करते हैं और उसी से पुनः बाहर निकलते हैं ।२०२५२०६। प्रत्येक कल्प के आदिमकाल में व्यक्त एबं अव्यक्त उभय विद उपाधिधारी देवाधिदेव भगवान् ब्रह्मा ही समस्त जीव समूह की सृष्टि करते हैं इस चरा- चर जगत में जो कुछ भी है, वह उन्हीं का बनाया हुआ इस महोतल में प्रथम प्रवलित जल राशि जिस मार्ग का आश्रय लेकर प्रयाण करतो है, अन्यान्य जल राशियाँ भी उसी पूर्व प्रथित पथ पर प्रयाण करतो हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then at the end of a thousand cycles of Caturjiugas, when the period of annihilation of Yuga arrives, Prajapati (Lord of subjects, viz. Brahma) begins to make the subjects abide in him (i.e. absorb in himself).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at the end of a thousand cycles of Caturjiugas, when the period of annihilation of Yuga arrives, Prajapati (Lord of subjects, viz. Brahma) begins to make the subjects abide in him (i.e. absorb in himself).

verses.sanskrit: तं राजा सहितैश् चोरैर् अन्वशाद् वध्यताम् इति । सम्बध्य तं च तैर् राजञ्छूले प्रोतो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: taṃ rājā sahitaiś corair anvaśād vadhyatām iti / sambadhya taṃ ca tair rājañchūle proto mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: Then a drought sets in lasting for a hundred years. Those living beings on the surface of the Earth, (still left) being deficient in strength become dissolved and are merg¬ ed into the Earth. The Sun then rises up with seven rays consti¬ tuting his chariot.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य यणज, दूसरे दरीर की भवितव्यता ( आवद्यक प्राच्ति ) के कारण एवं रविरद्ियों के वशीभूत होकर, अपने-अपने शुभाशुभ कार्यकलापों के अधीन उसी कम के निदिध्ट पथ पर विच्रण करते हुए ऊध्य अथवा निम्न लोकों में गमन करते हैं। जो देवगण मनुगण, प्रजापति एवं अन्याय स्वस्थ सिद्धिप्राप्त पुरुष हैं, वे भी भवितव्यता वद्य अपने अपने धर्म को मर्यादा के अनुरूप स्वभावत: जरम धारण करते हैं ।१०७-२१०। ऋषिवृन्द ! अब इसके उपरान्त मैं प्रलय काल के विषय में बतला रहा हैं) जो चोदहू मस्वस्तर होते हैं, उनको बतला चुका । साथ में हो उनमें होनेवाली प्रजाओं की सृष्टि भी देवताओं के साथ बतला चुका हूँ । वे सभी मन्वन्तर एक सहस्न युगों के होते हैं । इसी प्रकार दो सहस्न युगों के व्यतीत होने पद एक कल्प की
verses.wordMeaning: Then a drought sets in lasting for a hundred years. Those living beings on the surface of the Earth, (still left) being deficient in strength become dissolved and are merg¬ ed into the Earth. The Sun then rises up with seven rays consti¬ tuting his chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then a drought sets in lasting for a hundred years. Those living beings on the surface of the Earth, (still left) being deficient in strength become dissolved and are merg¬ ed into the Earth. The Sun then rises up with seven rays consti¬ tuting his chariot.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते शूलमारोप्य तं मुनिं रक्षिणस्तदा । प्रतिजग्मुर् महीपाल धनान्यादाय तान्यथ
verses.transliteration: tataste śūlamāropya taṃ muniṃ rakṣiṇastadā / pratijagmur mahīpāla dhanānyādāya tānyatha
verses.translation: Lord Sun of unbearable rays begins to suck up water through his rays. Those seven rays will be green in colour and
verses.hindi: समाप्ति होती कही जाती है ।२११-२१२। इस अवधि को ब्रह्मा का एक दिन समझना चाहिए । उसकी संख्या
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Sun of unbearable rays begins to suck up water through his rays. Those seven rays will be green in colour and
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Sun of unbearable rays begins to suck up water through his rays. Those seven rays will be green in colour and

verses.sanskrit: शूलस्थः स तु धर्मात्मा कालेन महता तदा । ध्यायन्देवं त्रिलोकेशं शङ्करं तमुमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: śūlasthaḥ sa tu dharmātmā kālena mahatā tadā / dhyāyandevaṃ trilokeśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ tamumāpatim
verses.translation: Spreading over the forest ('the sky'-Bd.P.) gradually they get transformed again. The wood over the earth, wealth and refulgence begin to blaze with water (?)
verses.hindi: अन्राध्यायसग्राप्ति: ख. पुस्तके । अनन्तरं सूत उवाचेति भ् । सानुषाध्षिनिमेषास्तु काष्ठा पत्चवश स्पृता । लवः क्षणास्तु पडठ्चेव. विशत्काष्ठा तु ते त्रयः
verses.wordMeaning: Spreading over the forest ('the sky'-Bd.P.) gradually they get transformed again. The wood over the earth, wealth and refulgence begin to blaze with water (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: Spreading over the forest ('the sky'-Bd.P.) gradually they get transformed again. The wood over the earth, wealth and refulgence begin to blaze with water (?)

verses.sanskrit: बहुकालं महेशानं मनसाध्याय संस्थितः । निराहारो ऽपि विप्रर्षिर्मरणं नाभ्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: bahukālaṃ maheśānaṃ manasādhyāya saṃsthitaḥ / nirāhāro 'pi viprarṣirmaraṇaṃ nābhyapadyata
verses.translation: Hence it is water that is said to be the cause of the blazing of the Sun. With drought the Sun does not blaze. With drought the Sun has no halo(?)
verses.hindi: प्रस्थः सप्तोदकाश्चेवे साधिकास्तु लवः स्मृतः। लबास्त्रिशत्कला ज्ेया मुहृतंस्त्रिशतः कलाः ४२१५ मुहूर्तास्तु पुर्नास्त्रशवहो रात्रमिति स्थिति: । अहोराज कालानां तु हधधिकांनि शतानि घद ॥२१६ - ताश्चेब संख्यया शेय चरद्रादित्यगतियंथा । निमेषा दश पर्चेव काष्ठास्ताध्च्रिशतः कला
verses.wordMeaning: Hence it is water that is said to be the cause of the blazing of the Sun. With drought the Sun does not blaze. With drought the Sun has no halo(?)
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence it is water that is said to be the cause of the blazing of the Sun. With drought the Sun does not blaze. With drought the Sun has no halo(?)

verses.sanskrit: धारयामास विप्राणाम् ऋषभः स हृदा हरिम् । शूलाग्रे तप्यमानेन तपस्तेन कृतं तदा
verses.transliteration: dhārayāmāsa viprāṇām ṛṣabhaḥ sa hṛdā harim / śūlāgre tapyamānena tapastena kṛtaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Then those seven rays assuming the forms of seven Suns, burn the four quarters and the four worlds like fires.
verses.hindi: मागधेनेव मानेन जलप्रस्थो विधीयते । एते वाप्युदकप्रस्थाश्वत्वारों नालिको घटः १२२० . हेममाषेः कृतच्छिदेश्वतुभिश्वतुरहगुले: । समाहनि च रात्रौ ज सुहूर्ता वे हिनालिकाः:... ४२११ रवेगंतिविशेषेण सर्बेप्वुतुषु नित्यशः  अधिक षद्शतं पश्च कलानां प्रविधीयते तंवहूर्मानुषं शेय नाक्षत्रं तु दशाधिकम् ।-सावनेन तु मासेन अब्दोषयं मानुषः स्मृतः और२३१
verses.wordMeaning: Then those seven rays assuming the forms of seven Suns, burn the four quarters and the four worlds like fires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then those seven rays assuming the forms of seven Suns, burn the four quarters and the four worlds like fires.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तापं परमं जग्मुः श्रुत्वैतन् मुनयो ऽखिलाः । ते रात्रौ शकुना भूत्वा संन्यवर्तन्त भारत
verses.transliteration: santāpaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ śrutvaitan munayo 'khilāḥ / te rātrau śakunā bhūtvā saṃnyavartanta bhārata
verses.translation: The fiery rays reach the top and bottom (of the worlds). Seven Suns and the blazing fires of dissolution shine fiercely.
verses.hindi: . एतह्व्यमहो रात्रमिति शास्त्रविनिश्चयः  अह्लाइनेन तु या संख्या मासत्व॑ंयनवाधिकी
verses.wordMeaning: The fiery rays reach the top and bottom (of the worlds). Seven Suns and the blazing fires of dissolution shine fiercely.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fiery rays reach the top and bottom (of the worlds). Seven Suns and the blazing fires of dissolution shine fiercely.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शयन्तो मुनेः शक्तिं तमपृच्छन् द्विजोत्तमम् । श्रोतुम् इच्छाम ते ब्रह्मन् किं पापं कृतवानसि
verses.transliteration: darśayanto muneḥ śaktiṃ tamapṛcchan dvijottamam / śrotum icchāma te brahman kiṃ pāpaṃ kṛtavānasi
verses.translation: Ignited and illuminated by means of the water, thous¬ ands of rays envelop the sky and scorch the Earth.
verses.hindi: के बारे में विस्तार पूर्वक बतला रहा हूँ, सुनिये । एक लघु अक्षर के उच्चारण में जो समय लगता है उसे निमेष आँख की झपकी में जो समय लगता है, उसे भी निमेष कहते हैं। ऐसे पर्ह निमेषों की! एक काष्ठा कही जाती है। पाँच क्षण का एक लव होता है, बींस काष्ठा का तीन लव होता है।२१३-२१४। मतास्तर के साढ़े सात प्रस्थ का एक लव होता है, तीस लव की एक कला होती है, तीस कला का एक मुहूर्त होता है, तीस मुहूर्त का एक दिन रात होता है--एक दिन रात में छ सौ दो कलाएँ होती
verses.wordMeaning: Ignited and illuminated by means of the water, thous¬ ands of rays envelop the sky and scorch the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ignited and illuminated by means of the water, thous¬ ands of rays envelop the sky and scorch the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततः स मुनिशार्दूलस् तान् उवाच तपोधनान् । दोषतः किं गमिष्यामि न हि मे ऽन्यो पराध्यति
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ sa muniśārdūlas tān uvāca tapodhanān / doṣataḥ kiṃ gamiṣyāmi na hi me 'nyo parādhyati
verses.translation: Being burnt by their blazing heat, the Earth inclusive of the oceans and the mountains becomes bereft of moisture and viscidity.
verses.hindi: , हैं।२१५-२१६॥ इन्हीं संख्याओं से चन्द्रमा और सूर्य की गति जाननी चाहिए, पत्रह निमेष की एक काष्ठा और "तौस काष्ठा कौ एक कला, तीस कला का एक मुहतं होता है, किन्‍्हीं किरहीं के मत से चालीस कलाओं का ऐक मुह॒ते होता है । जाननेवालों ने इन सब के यही प्रमाण निश्चित किये हैं । जल द्वारा भी एक प्रकार से परिमाण का निदचय होता है, मागधमान के अनुसार तेरह पश्च-जल का एक प्रस्थ होता है, ऐसे चार प्रस्थों
verses.wordMeaning: Being burnt by their blazing heat, the Earth inclusive of the oceans and the mountains becomes bereft of moisture and viscidity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being burnt by their blazing heat, the Earth inclusive of the oceans and the mountains becomes bereft of moisture and viscidity.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ततः सर्वान् आचचक्षे ततो मुनिः । मुनयश्च ततो राज्ञे द्वितीये ऽह्नि न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tataḥ sarvān ācacakṣe tato muniḥ / munayaśca tato rājñe dvitīye 'hni nyavedayan
verses.translation: The nether regions, the upper regions and the sides are restrained by the illuminated rays of the Sun of various colours and spreading everywhere.
verses.hindi: का एक नालिक घट होता है ।२१७-२२०। एक कलश में चार अंगुलों पर चार सुवर्णमाष के समान छिद्रों द्वारा दिन और रात भर में प्रतिमुहृतं दो नालिक जल का क्षरण होता है। सूर्य की गति की न्यूनता के रहते हुए भी सभी ऋतुओं में एक दिन रात छ सौसे कुछ अधिक कलाओं वाला होता है। यह दिन मनुष्यों का है, नाक्षत्रिक दिन राति का परिणाम छ सौ दस कलाओं का होता है। यही एक. सावत का भी मान है। इस मान से "बारह मास का एक मानव वर्ष कहा जाता है ।२२१-२२३। उतना ही एक दिव्य वर्ष का मान
verses.wordMeaning: The nether regions, the upper regions and the sides are restrained by the illuminated rays of the Sun of various colours and spreading everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: The nether regions, the upper regions and the sides are restrained by the illuminated rays of the Sun of various colours and spreading everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: राजा तु तमृषिं श्रुत्वा निष्क्रान्तः सह बन्धुभिः । प्रसादयामास तदा शूलस्थम् ऋषिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: rājā tu tamṛṣiṃ śrutvā niṣkrāntaḥ saha bandhubhiḥ / prasādayāmāsa tadā śūlastham ṛṣisattamam
verses.translation: The scorching rays of the Sun and the leaping flames of the fires mingling with one another appear to be a single unit with a single flame.
verses.hindi: कहते हैं, मनुष्य कौ
verses.wordMeaning: The scorching rays of the Sun and the leaping flames of the fires mingling with one another appear to be a single unit with a single flame.
verses.commentary: Sense: The scorching rays of the Sun and the leaping flames of the fires mingling with one another appear to be a single unit with a single flame.

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच: यन्मया ऽपकृतं तात तवाज्ञानवशाद्बहु । प्रसादये त्वां तत्राहं न मे त्वं क्रोद्धुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: rājovāca: yanmayā 'pakṛtaṃ tāta tavājñānavaśādbahu / prasādaye tvāṃ tatrāhaṃ na me tvaṃ kroddhum arhasi
