verses.translation: That fire becomes a mass of fiery zone creating the destruction of all the worlds. With its brilliance it scorches all the four worlds.
verses.hindi: शततमोष्ध्याय) ला 'हैपदी तदा बद्धमिदं शान संशा या हापलक्यताम् । कलानां सुपरीमाणात्काल इत्यभिषोयतले
verses.wordMeaning: That fire becomes a mass of fiery zone creating the destruction of all the worlds. With its brilliance it scorches all the four worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: That fire becomes a mass of fiery zone creating the destruction of all the worlds. With its brilliance it scorches all the four worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस् ततो राज्ञा प्रसादम् अकरोन् मुनिः । कृतप्रसादं राजा तं ततः समवतारयत्
verses.transliteration: evamuktas tato rājñā prasādam akaron muniḥ / kṛtaprasādaṃ rājā taṃ tataḥ samavatārayat
verses.translation: All the mobile and the immobile beings get dissolved. The Earth, devoid of trees and even grass, appears like the back of a tortoise shell.
verses.hindi: यवहुब्रंह्मणः प्रोक्तं दिव्या कोटी तु सा स्मृता । शतानां च सह्राणि दश द्विगुणितानि च ॥
verses.wordMeaning: All the mobile and the immobile beings get dissolved. The Earth, devoid of trees and even grass, appears like the back of a tortoise shell.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the mobile and the immobile beings get dissolved. The Earth, devoid of trees and even grass, appears like the back of a tortoise shell.

verses.sanskrit: अवतीर्यमाणस्तु मुनिः शूले मांसत्वम् आगते । अतिसंपीडितो विप्रः शङ्करं मनसागमत्
verses.transliteration: avatīryamāṇastu muniḥ śūle māṃsatvam āgate / atisaṃpīḍito vipraḥ śaṅkaraṃ manasāgamat
verses.translation: The entire universe destroyed and affected by misfor¬ tune appears like a frying pan. The whole of the sky, filled with the burning rays, blazes fiercely.
verses.hindi: तेयां श्रुत्वा स देवस्तु वायुलोंकहिते रतः । संक्षेपाहिष्यचक्षुष्मान्प्ोवाच भगवास्तरभुः एले राश्यहनो पूर्व कीतिते त्विह लोकिके । तासा संख्याय वर्षाप्रं ब्राह स्‍्यं व्याम्यहः क्षये
verses.wordMeaning: The entire universe destroyed and affected by misfor¬ tune appears like a frying pan. The whole of the sky, filled with the burning rays, blazes fiercely.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire universe destroyed and affected by misfor¬ tune appears like a frying pan. The whole of the sky, filled with the burning rays, blazes fiercely.

verses.sanskrit: संध्यातः शङ्करस् तेन बहुकालोपवासतः । प्रादुर्भूतो महादेवः शूलं तस्य तथाछिनत्
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyātaḥ śaṅkaras tena bahukālopavāsataḥ / prādurbhūto mahādevaḥ śūlaṃ tasya tathāchinat
verses.translation: All the living beings in the nether worlds and in the great ocean become dissolved and one with the Earth.
verses.hindi: कोटोशतानि चत्वारि वर्षाणि मानुषाणि तु। द्वात्रिशच्च तथा फोटश्ः संख्याताः संख्यया द्विजेः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: All the living beings in the nether worlds and in the great ocean become dissolved and one with the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the living beings in the nether worlds and in the great ocean become dissolved and one with the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: शूलमूलस्थितः शम्भुस्तुष्टः प्राह पुनःपुनः । ब्रूहि किं क्रियतां विप्र सत्त्वस्थानपरायण
verses.transliteration: śūlamūlasthitaḥ śambhustuṣṭaḥ prāha punaḥpunaḥ / brūhi kiṃ kriyatāṃ vipra sattvasthānaparāyaṇa
verses.translation: The continents, mountains, sub-continents, the great oceans all these will be reduced to ashes by that cosmic fire, the soul of everything.
verses.hindi: तथा शतसहल्ञाणि एकोननवतिः पुनः । अशीतिश्न सहल्नाणि एव कालः प्लवस्य सु मानुषाल्येण संहयातः कालो झ्यामूतसंप्लवः । सप्त सुर्ास्तदा5ग्रेषु तदा लोकेषु तेषु ये ॥२३ रे भहासूतेषु लीयस्ते प्रजा: सर्वाश्वतुविधाः । सलिलेनापप्लुते लोके नष्टे स्थावरजड्डसे
verses.wordMeaning: The continents, mountains, sub-continents, the great oceans all these will be reduced to ashes by that cosmic fire, the soul of everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: The continents, mountains, sub-continents, the great oceans all these will be reduced to ashes by that cosmic fire, the soul of everything.

verses.sanskrit: अदेयमपि दास्यामि तुष्टो ऽस्म्यद्योमया सह । किं तु सत्यवतां लोके सिद्धिर्न स्याच्च भूयसी
verses.transliteration: adeyamapi dāsyāmi tuṣṭo 'smyadyomayā saha / kiṃ tu satyavatāṃ loke siddhirna syācca bhūyasī
verses.translation: Then the big Samvartaka fire (the fire of dissolution) transcends the mountains and destroys all the worlds. It becomes a terribly kindled fire.
verses.hindi: है--ऐसा शास्त्रों का निरचय है । इसी दिन मान से मास, अयन एवं वर्ष भादि की गणना होती है, ये संज्ञाएँ ब्रह्म के एक दिन की उपलक्षण मात्र हैं । कलाओं द्वारा परिगणित होने के कारण समय काल नाम से पुकारा जाता है। एक ब्राह्न दिवस एक करोड़ बीस लाख नव सहस्त से अधिक दिव्य बर्षों का होता है। इस कथन से ऋषिवुन्द परम विस्मित हो उठे यह परम अद्भुत बात मालूस पड़ी, काल
verses.wordMeaning: Then the big Samvartaka fire (the fire of dissolution) transcends the mountains and destroys all the worlds. It becomes a terribly kindled fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the big Samvartaka fire (the fire of dissolution) transcends the mountains and destroys all the worlds. It becomes a terribly kindled fire.

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्मणो ऽनुरूपं हि फलं भुञ्जन्ति जन्तवः । शुभेन कर्मणा भूतिर्दुःखं स्यात् पातकेन तु
verses.transliteration: svakarmaṇo 'nurūpaṃ hi phalaṃ bhuñjanti jantavaḥ / śubhena karmaṇā bhūtirduḥkhaṃ syāt pātakena tu
verses.translation: It then pierces through the Earth and dries up Rasa-
verses.hindi: संख्या विषयक जिज्ञासा की शान्ति के लिए पुनः उस स्बो ने पूछा।२ २४-२२७। ऋषिगंण बोले- हम लोग संक्षेप में मानव मान से --सम्मत संख्या द्वारा प्रलय का परिमाण
verses.wordMeaning: It then pierces through the Earth and dries up Rasa-
verses.commentary: Sense: It then pierces through the Earth and dries up Rasa-

verses.sanskrit: बहुभेदप्रभिन्नं तु मनुष्येषु विपच्यते । केषां दरिद्रभावेन केषां धनविपत्तिजम्
verses.transliteration: bahubhedaprabhinnaṃ tu manuṣyeṣu vipacyate / keṣāṃ daridrabhāvena keṣāṃ dhanavipattijam
verses.translation: After burning the Earth from below, it burns the firmament above spreading through thousands, lakhs and tril- lions of Yojanas.
verses.hindi: हितेषी परम ऐश्वयंशाली भगवान् वायु, जिन्हें दिव्य नैत्र प्राप्त थे, संक्षेप में कथा का प्रारम्भ करते हुए बोले ।२२८-२२९। लोकिक दिन रात का प्रमाण मैं आप लोगों को बतला चुका हूँ, उन्ही के माध्यम से ब्राह्म वर्ष कं उनके दिवस का परिमाण बतला रहा हूँ! मानव के चार सो बत्तीस करोड़ उनन्‍्यासी लाख अस्सी सह वहुँ में प्रलय होता है, मानव मान से इतने ही वर्षों बाद प्रलय की अवधि कही गई है । प्रलय
verses.wordMeaning: After burning the Earth from below, it burns the firmament above spreading through thousands, lakhs and tril- lions of Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After burning the Earth from below, it burns the firmament above spreading through thousands, lakhs and tril- lions of Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: सन्तत्यभावजं केषां केषांचित् तद्विपर्ययः । तथा दुर्वृत्तितस्तेषां फलमाविर्भवेन् नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: santatyabhāvajaṃ keṣāṃ keṣāṃcit tadviparyayaḥ / tathā durvṛttitasteṣāṃ phalamāvirbhaven nṛṇām
verses.translation: Many flames leap out from that Samvartaka fire. Glowing fiercely the Samvartaka fire consumes Gandharvas, Pisacas, the great serpents and Raksasas. Everything is reduced to a huge globular mass (of ashes).
verses.hindi: के अवर्सर पर सात सूर्य उदित होते हैं, सभी लोंकों में चार्रो.प्रकार की प्रजाएँ महाभूतों में विलीन हो जाती हैं, सारा लोक जल मग्न हो जाता है स्थावर, जंगम, जीव निकाय नष्ट हो जाते हैं ।२३०-२३४। संहार काये + इतः प्रभृति सार्धष्लोको नास्ति ख. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Many flames leap out from that Samvartaka fire. Glowing fiercely the Samvartaka fire consumes Gandharvas, Pisacas, the great serpents and Raksasas. Everything is reduced to a huge globular mass (of ashes).
verses.commentary: Sense: Many flames leap out from that Samvartaka fire. Glowing fiercely the Samvartaka fire consumes Gandharvas, Pisacas, the great serpents and Raksasas. Everything is reduced to a huge globular mass (of ashes).

verses.sanskrit: केषांचित्पुत्रमरणे वियोगात् प्रियमित्रयोः । राजचौराग्नितः केषां दुःखं स्याद्दैवनिर्मितम्
verses.transliteration: keṣāṃcitputramaraṇe viyogāt priyamitrayoḥ / rājacaurāgnitaḥ keṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ syāddaivanirmitam
verses.translation: The deadly fire thus burns all the four worlds, viz. Bhurloka, Bhuvarloka, Svarloka and Maharloka in a terrible manner.
verses.hindi: हैहै० बायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: The deadly fire thus burns all the four worlds, viz. Bhurloka, Bhuvarloka, Svarloka and Maharloka in a terrible manner.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deadly fire thus burns all the four worlds, viz. Bhurloka, Bhuvarloka, Svarloka and Maharloka in a terrible manner.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छरीरे तु केषांचित्कर्मणा सम्प्रदृश्यते । जराश्च विविधाः केषां दृश्यन्ते व्याधयस् तथा
verses.transliteration: taccharīre tu keṣāṃcitkarmaṇā sampradṛśyate / jarāśca vividhāḥ keṣāṃ dṛśyante vyādhayas tathā
verses.translation: When all the worlds arc enveloped with fire on all sides and above, the entire universe is slowly permeated with brilliance and shines like a (redhot) ball of iron.
verses.hindi: विनिवृत्ते थ सहारे उपशान्ते प्रजापतो । निरालोके प्रदग्धे तु नेशेन तमसा5ब॒ते ।। डे ईश्वराधिष्ठिते हास्मिस्तवा होकार्णवे किल क्‍ तावबेकाजवो शेयो यावदासीदहः प्रभो: । रात्रिस्तु सलिलावस्था निवृत्तो चाप्यहः स्मृतम्॒
verses.wordMeaning: When all the worlds arc enveloped with fire on all sides and above, the entire universe is slowly permeated with brilliance and shines like a (redhot) ball of iron.
verses.commentary: Sense: When all the worlds arc enveloped with fire on all sides and above, the entire universe is slowly permeated with brilliance and shines like a (redhot) ball of iron.

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यन्ते चाभिशापाश्च पूर्वकर्मानुसंचिताः । कष्टाः कष्टतरावस्था गताः केचिद् अनागसः
verses.transliteration: dṛśyante cābhiśāpāśca pūrvakarmānusaṃcitāḥ / kaṣṭāḥ kaṣṭatarāvasthā gatāḥ kecid anāgasaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter the terrible Sariivartaka clouds begin to rise in the sky. They assume the shapes of the herds of huge ele¬ phants and are embellished with lightning streaks,
verses.hindi: जेलोक्ये यानि सत्वानि गतिमन्ति भ्रवाणि च। आतमुर्तेस्यः प्रलोयन्ते तस्मादासृतसंप्लल:
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter the terrible Sariivartaka clouds begin to rise in the sky. They assume the shapes of the herds of huge ele¬ phants and are embellished with lightning streaks,
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the terrible Sariivartaka clouds begin to rise in the sky. They assume the shapes of the herds of huge ele¬ phants and are embellished with lightning streaks,

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वकर्मविपाकेन धर्मेण तपसि स्थिताः । दान्ताः स्वदारनिरता भूरिदाः परिपूजकाः
verses.transliteration: pūrvakarmavipākena dharmeṇa tapasi sthitāḥ / dāntāḥ svadāraniratā bhūridāḥ paripūjakāḥ
verses.translation: Some are dark-coloured like the blue lotus. Some are like the white lilies, some resemble lapis lazuli and others are like emerald and sapphire.
verses.hindi: पराधंदिगु्ण चापि परमायु: प्रकीतितम । एतावान्स्थितिकालस्तु अजस्थेह प्रजापतेः ॥ द स्थित्यन्ते प्रतिसगस्य ब्रह्मण: परसेंष्ठिन:
verses.wordMeaning: Some are dark-coloured like the blue lotus. Some are like the white lilies, some resemble lapis lazuli and others are like emerald and sapphire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some are dark-coloured like the blue lotus. Some are like the white lilies, some resemble lapis lazuli and others are like emerald and sapphire.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रीमन्तो नयसंयुक्ता अन्ये बहुगुणैर् युताः । दुर्गमामापदं प्राप्य निजकर्मसमुद्भवाम्
verses.transliteration: hrīmanto nayasaṃyuktā anye bahuguṇair yutāḥ / durgamāmāpadaṃ prāpya nijakarmasamudbhavām
verses.translation: Others are (white) like the conch shell and the kunda flowers. Some are (black) like the natural collyrium. Some clouds are smoke-coloured and some clouds are yellow.
verses.hindi: ' यथा वायुप्रवेगेन दीपाचिरपशास्यति । तथव प्रतिसगेंण ब्रह्मा समुपशाम्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Others are (white) like the conch shell and the kunda flowers. Some are (black) like the natural collyrium. Some clouds are smoke-coloured and some clouds are yellow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Others are (white) like the conch shell and the kunda flowers. Some are (black) like the natural collyrium. Some clouds are smoke-coloured and some clouds are yellow.

verses.sanskrit: न संज्वरन्ति ये मर्त्या धर्मनिन्दां न कुर्वते । इदमेव तपो मत्वा क्षिपन्ति सुविचेतसः
verses.transliteration: na saṃjvaranti ye martyā dharmanindāṃ na kurvate / idameva tapo matvā kṣipanti suvicetasaḥ
verses.translation: Some clouds have the (grey) colour of a donkey, some resemble the red lac, others have the lustre of the red arsenic and there are dove-coloured clouds.
verses.hindi: कर प्रजापति शांत हो जाते हैं, दाघ लोक समूहों में आलोक ( प्रकाश ) का सबंधा अभाव हो जाता है. घोर नेश अंधकार में संसार सभी ओर से आवत हो जाता है। ईइवर में अधिष्ठित गृह समस्त जगत एक महासमुद्र रूप में परिणत हो जाता है । तब तक भगवान् का एक दिन रहता है तब तक एकार्णव रुप जगत् की स्थिति जाननी चाहिए, उसके बाद उनकी रात्रि केवल जलावस्था तक रहती है  इसके उपरान्त दिन कहा जांता है । ये दिव और रात क्रम से परिवर्तित होते हैं । इस प्रकार उन परम ऐश्वर्यशाली का एक दिन रात निश्चिल प्राणि समूहों के प्रलय अवधि तक कहा' जाता है ।२३५-०२३८। इस समस्त त्रैलोक्य में जितने भी चराचर भूत ( जीव ) समूह हैं, वे सव के सब विनष्ट हो जाते हैं, इसीलिये प्रलय का नाम आभूत- संप्लव कहा जाता है। प्रजाओं में सब में प्रथम भूत ( उत्पन्न ) हुए थे, अतः प्रजापति भूत हैं, उन्हों से तब
verses.wordMeaning: Some clouds have the (grey) colour of a donkey, some resemble the red lac, others have the lustre of the red arsenic and there are dove-coloured clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some clouds have the (grey) colour of a donkey, some resemble the red lac, others have the lustre of the red arsenic and there are dove-coloured clouds.

verses.sanskrit: हा भ्रातर्मातः पुत्रेति कष्टेषु न वदन्ति ये । स्मरन्ति मां महेशानमथवा पुष्करेक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: hā bhrātarmātaḥ putreti kaṣṭeṣu na vadanti ye / smaranti māṃ maheśānamathavā puṣkarekṣaṇam
verses.translation: Some glow-worm-coloured clouds rise up in the sky; some arc as vast as the expansive cities and the Earth and some are as huge as herds of elephants.
verses.hindi: चराचर जगत् भूत ( विनाश ) होता है, इसलिये भी प्रलय को आशभूृतसंप्लव कहते हैं । शाश्वत एवं अमृतत्व शब्द भी इस आशभुतसंप्लव शब्द के अथ में प्रयुक्त होते हैं। अतीत, भविष्य एवं वर्तमान ब्रजाओं का त्रकालिक आयु परिमाण दिव्य संख्या से अपराद्धं कहा जाता है ।२३९-२४०। प्रजापति ब्रह्मा कौ परम आयु दो पराद्ध काल हैं। इतने ही समय तक उनकी स्थिति कही जाती है। इसके उपरान्त परमेष्ठी ब्रह्मा का
verses.wordMeaning: Some glow-worm-coloured clouds rise up in the sky; some arc as vast as the expansive cities and the Earth and some are as huge as herds of elephants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some glow-worm-coloured clouds rise up in the sky; some arc as vast as the expansive cities and the Earth and some are as huge as herds of elephants.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्कृतं पूर्वजं भोक्तुं ध्रुवं तदुपशाम्यति
verses.transliteration: duṣkṛtaṃ pūrvajaṃ bhoktuṃ dhruvaṃ tadupaśāmyati
verses.translation: Some clouds are like mountains and some are like rocky regions. Some resemble large basins and some huge shoals of fish.
verses.hindi: प्रति सम॑ होता है। जिस श्रकार वायु के झोंके में दीप की ज्योति ज्ञान्तं हो जाती है, उसी प्रकार प्रतिसर्ग तास्त्ययं श्लोंको घ. पुस्तके।
verses.wordMeaning: Some clouds are like mountains and some are like rocky regions. Some resemble large basins and some huge shoals of fish.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some clouds are like mountains and some are like rocky regions. Some resemble large basins and some huge shoals of fish.

verses.sanskrit: दिनानि यावन्ति वसेत्स कष्टे यथाकृतं चिन्तयद् देवमीशम् । तावन्ति सौम्यानि कृतानि तेन भवन्ति विप्र श्रुतिनोदनैषा
verses.transliteration: dināni yāvanti vasetsa kaṣṭe yathākṛtaṃ cintayad devamīśam / tāvanti saumyāni kṛtāni tena bhavanti vipra śrutinodanaiṣā
verses.translation: Terrific in appearance and multi-formed, all those clouds thundering terribly, fill the entire firmament at that time (of dissolution).
verses.hindi: इत्येष थ समाख्यातो मया झ्यामृतसंप्लवः । ब्रह्मनेमित्तिको होष संप्रक्षालनसंयमः
verses.wordMeaning: Terrific in appearance and multi-formed, all those clouds thundering terribly, fill the entire firmament at that time (of dissolution).
verses.commentary: Sense: Terrific in appearance and multi-formed, all those clouds thundering terribly, fill the entire firmament at that time (of dissolution).

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्त्वया कष्टगतेन नित्यं स्मृतश्चाहं मनसा पूजितश्च । गौरीसहायस्तेन इहागतो ऽस्मि ब्रूह्यद्य कृत्यं क्रियतां किं नु विप्र
verses.transliteration: yasmāttvayā kaṣṭagatena nityaṃ smṛtaścāhaṃ manasā pūjitaśca / gaurīsahāyastena ihāgato 'smi brūhyadya kṛtyaṃ kriyatāṃ kiṃ nu vipra
verses.translation: Then the terrific fresh clouds identifying themselves with the Suns, organise themselves in seven groups and extin¬ guish the fire.
verses.hindi: समासेन समाल्यातों भुयः कि वर्तयासि वः । +य इद धारयेन्नित्यं शणुयाद्वाषप्यभीक्षणश: ॥। कोतेंनाच्छवणाज्चापि मह॒तों सिद्धिमासुयात् इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मन्‍्वन्तरनिसर्गादिकथन नाम शततमो्ध्याय: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the terrific fresh clouds identifying themselves with the Suns, organise themselves in seven groups and extin¬ guish the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the terrific fresh clouds identifying themselves with the Suns, organise themselves in seven groups and extin¬ guish the fire.

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्य उवाच: तुष्टो यद्युमया सार्धं वरदो यदि शङ्कर । तदा मे शूलसंस्थस्य संशयं परमं वद
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavya uvāca: tuṣṭo yadyumayā sārdhaṃ varado yadi śaṅkara / tadā me śūlasaṃsthasya saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ vada
verses.translation: The clouds then shower energetically and quell the entire inauspicous and terrible fire.
verses.hindi: हारा ब्रह्मा शान्त हो जाते हैं! उस समय जब अव्यक्त में महत् विलीन हो जाता है और महृदादि सब महेश्वर में तद॒प हो जाते हैं, तब गुण साम्य हो जाता है। प्रलय का वृत्तान्त मैं आप लोगों को सुना चुका, यहो ब्रह्मा का नेभित्तिक प्रलय कहा जाता है, इसका वर्जन मैंने संक्षेप ही में किया है। अब बतलाइये आप लोगों को पुनः क्या बतलाऊँ ? जो व्यक्ति इस वृत्तान्‍्त को धारण करता है, अथवा नित्य
verses.wordMeaning: The clouds then shower energetically and quell the entire inauspicous and terrible fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The clouds then shower energetically and quell the entire inauspicous and terrible fire.

verses.sanskrit: न रुजा मम कापि स्याच्छूलसंप्रोतिते ऽगके । अमृतस्रावि तच्छूलं प्रभावात् कस्य शंस मे
verses.transliteration: na rujā mama kāpi syācchūlasaṃprotite 'gake / amṛtasrāvi tacchūlaṃ prabhāvāt kasya śaṃsa me
verses.translation: The universe is filled with waters of the heavy down¬ pour. The brilliance of the burning fire is overcome by the wateis and the fire enters (i.e. merges) into water.
verses.hindi: श्रवण फरता है, वह मद्दान सिद्धि प्राप्त करता है, क्योंकि इसके श्रवण एयं कीतेतन से भी महान् फल कौ प्राप्ति होती है। इसके माहात्म्य से ब्राह्मण को विद्या प्राप्ति होती है, क्षत्रिय विजयी होता है, बंध्य धन प्राप्त करता है, शुद्र सुख लाभ करता है +एतदर्धस्थाने य इदं ध्यायते नित्यं धारयेद्वः समाहित इति घ. पुस्तके । ( अब इलोको न विद्यते क. ग, घ. ड. पुस्तकेषु ।
verses.wordMeaning: The universe is filled with waters of the heavy down¬ pour. The brilliance of the burning fire is overcome by the wateis and the fire enters (i.e. merges) into water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The universe is filled with waters of the heavy down¬ pour. The brilliance of the burning fire is overcome by the wateis and the fire enters (i.e. merges) into water.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशूलपाणिर् उवाच: शूलस्थेन त्वया विप्र मनसा चिन्तितो ऽस्मि यत् । अनयानां निहन्ताहं दुःखानां विनिबर्हणः
verses.transliteration: śrīśūlapāṇir uvāca: śūlasthena tvayā vipra manasā cintito 'smi yat / anayānāṃ nihantāhaṃ duḥkhānāṃ vinibarhaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Urged by the self-bom deity (Brahma), they fill the universe with their showers. Others assail the sea-shore with large quantities of water. The entire Earth with its continents and mountains is covered with water.
verses.hindi: हैहैर क्‍ ...... ैमुपुरारणय
verses.wordMeaning: Urged by the self-bom deity (Brahma), they fill the universe with their showers. Others assail the sea-shore with large quantities of water. The entire Earth with its continents and mountains is covered with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by the self-bom deity (Brahma), they fill the universe with their showers. Others assail the sea-shore with large quantities of water. The entire Earth with its continents and mountains is covered with water.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यातमात्रो ह्यहं विप्र पाताले वापि संस्थितः । शूलमूले त्वहं शम्भुरग्रे देवी स्वयं स्थिता । जगन्माताम्बिका देवी त्वामृतेनान्वपूरयत्
verses.transliteration: dhyātamātro hyahaṃ vipra pātāle vāpi saṃsthitaḥ / śūlamūle tvahaṃ śambhuragre devī svayaṃ sthitā / jaganmātāmbikā devī tvāmṛtenānvapūrayat
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the entire quantity of water showered by the clouds enters the ocean. There it is sucked up by the rays of the Sun.
verses.hindi: असाधारणवबुत्तत्तु हुतशेषादिभिद्विजे: । धर्मा वेशेषिकाश्येव आचीर्णाः सुक्ष्मदशिलिः ते देवें: सह तिष्ठन्ति महलोकिनिवासिनः । चतुदंशते सनवः कीतिताः फीतिवर्धनाः अतीता वतंमानाश्रव तथेवानागताश्व ये । ऋषिभिरदेंवतेश्रव सह गन्धवंराक्षसे: मम्बस्तराधिका रेषु जयन्तीह पुनः पुनः । देवा: सप्तर्षयश्चेव सनवः पितरस्तथा तेस्तथ्यकारिभियुक्तः भ्रद्ावज्ू रर्दापत: । वर्णाश्षमाणां धर्मेषु श्ौतस्मातेंषु संस्थिते: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the entire quantity of water showered by the clouds enters the ocean. There it is sucked up by the rays of the Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the entire quantity of water showered by the clouds enters the ocean. There it is sucked up by the rays of the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्य उवाच: पूर्वमेव स्थितो यस्माच्छूलं व्याप्योमया सह । प्रसादप्रवणो मह्यमिदानीं चानया सह
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavya uvāca: pūrvameva sthito yasmācchūlaṃ vyāpyomayā saha / prasādapravaṇo mahyamidānīṃ cānayā saha
verses.translation: The water sucked up by the rays of the Sun clings to the clouds. It falls again on to the Earth whereby the oceans are filled up.
verses.hindi: विनिवृत्ताधिकारास्ते यावन्मन्वन्तरक्षय
verses.wordMeaning: The water sucked up by the rays of the Sun clings to the clouds. It falls again on to the Earth whereby the oceans are filled up.
verses.commentary: Sense: The water sucked up by the rays of the Sun clings to the clouds. It falls again on to the Earth whereby the oceans are filled up.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याः संस्मरणाद् एव दौर्भाग्यं प्रलयं व्रजेत् । न दौर्भाग्यात् परं लोके दुःखाद्दुःखतरं किल
verses.transliteration: yasyāḥ saṃsmaraṇād eva daurbhāgyaṃ pralayaṃ vrajet / na daurbhāgyāt paraṃ loke duḥkhādduḥkhataraṃ kila
verses.translation: Then the oceans overflow their shores all round. Mountains crumble down and the Earth sinks into the water.
verses.hindi: महलकिति यत्प्रोक्त मातरिभ्वस्त्वथा विभो । प्रतिलोके च कतंव्यमनेकं: समधिष्ठिता भूलोकादि की व्यवस्था
verses.wordMeaning: Then the oceans overflow their shores all round. Mountains crumble down and the Earth sinks into the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the oceans overflow their shores all round. Mountains crumble down and the Earth sinks into the water.

verses.sanskrit: किलैवं श्रूयते गाथा पुराणेषु सुरोत्तम । त्रैलोक्यं दहतस् तुभ्यं सौभाग्यमेकतां गतम्
verses.transliteration: kilaivaṃ śrūyate gāthā purāṇeṣu surottama / trailokyaṃ dahatas tubhyaṃ saubhāgyamekatāṃ gatam
verses.translation: Whirling up suddenly, a violent wind of terrible nature envelops all those clouds in the sky.
verses.hindi: वायु बंले---ऋषिगण जो सूक्ष्म दर्शी असामान्य चरित्रवल सम्पन्न द्विजाति बन्द, यज्ञादि का सुन्दर अनुष्ठान कर शास्त्र सम्मत विशेष-विशेष धर्मों का पालन करते हैं, वे सब देवताओं के साथ महलोंक में निवास करते हैं। मैंने पूर्व प्रसंग में जिन अतीत, भविष्य एवं वतंमान कालीन परम यश्वस्वों योदह मलुओं का वर्णन किया है, वे ऋषियों, देवताओं ग्न्धवों एवं राक्षसों के साथ प्रत्येक मन्वस्तरों
verses.wordMeaning: Whirling up suddenly, a violent wind of terrible nature envelops all those clouds in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whirling up suddenly, a violent wind of terrible nature envelops all those clouds in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोर्वक्षःस्थलं प्राप्य तत्स्थितं चेति नः श्रुतम् । पीतं तद्वक्षसस्त्रस्तदक्षेण परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalaṃ prāpya tatsthitaṃ ceti naḥ śrutam / pītaṃ tadvakṣasastrastadakṣeṇa parameṣṭhinā
verses.translation: In that Ekdrnava (a single vast sheet of water) all the mobile and the immobile beings get dissolved. When a thousand cycles of four Yugas pass away, it is called a complete Kalpa.
verses.hindi: में पुनः पुनः जन्म धारण करते हैं ।!-३२। देवगण सप्तधि, मनुगण एवं पितर गण ये सभो धामिक विचारों द वाले ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, बेश्यादि के साथ क्रमशः: अतीत होकर महलोंक में आश्रय ग्रहण करते हैं । अभिमान द
verses.wordMeaning: In that Ekdrnava (a single vast sheet of water) all the mobile and the immobile beings get dissolved. When a thousand cycles of four Yugas pass away, it is called a complete Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that Ekdrnava (a single vast sheet of water) all the mobile and the immobile beings get dissolved. When a thousand cycles of four Yugas pass away, it is called a complete Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सतीति संजज्ञ इयमिन्दीवरेक्षणा । यजतस्तस्य देवेश तव मानावखण्डनात्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt satīti saṃjajña iyamindīvarekṣaṇā / yajatastasya deveśa tava mānāvakhaṇḍanāt
verses.translation: Learned men call this vast sheet of water whereby the entire world is enveloped, Ekdrnava. All separate entities are lost sight of. Neither the surface of the Earth, nor the atmosphere, neither the wind nor the firmament is visible distinctly.
verses.hindi: रहित, सत्यवादी, योगपरायण, श्रोतस्माते कर्मो में श्रद्धा रखनेवाले, वर्णाश्रमाचार में निष्ठावान् ब्राह्मणादि प्रजाओं के साथ वे लोग मन्वन्तर के समप्त हो जाने पर विधि निर्दिष्ट काल के बाद अपने अपने अधिकारों
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men call this vast sheet of water whereby the entire world is enveloped, Ekdrnava. All separate entities are lost sight of. Neither the surface of the Earth, nor the atmosphere, neither the wind nor the firmament is visible distinctly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men call this vast sheet of water whereby the entire world is enveloped, Ekdrnava. All separate entities are lost sight of. Neither the surface of the Earth, nor the atmosphere, neither the wind nor the firmament is visible distinctly.

verses.sanskrit: जुहावाग्नौ तु सा देवी ह्यात्मानं प्राणसंज्ञिकम् । आत्मानं भस्मसात्कृत्वा प्रालेयाद्रेस्ततः सुता
verses.transliteration: juhāvāgnau tu sā devī hyātmānaṃ prāṇasaṃjñikam / ātmānaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā prāleyādrestataḥ sutā
verses.translation: Objects of Parthiva (Earthly) nature, waters of the ocean and all Haima (i.e. of the elements of fire, Gold standing for Tejas) objects form one unit termed Salila (water).
verses.hindi: से विनिबत्त होकर महलोंक में आश्रित होते हैं ।४-६। । ऋषियों ने पूछा--परम समर्थ मातरिश्वन् ! आप जिस मंहलोंक की चर्चा कर रहे हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: Objects of Parthiva (Earthly) nature, waters of the ocean and all Haima (i.e. of the elements of fire, Gold standing for Tejas) objects form one unit termed Salila (water).
verses.commentary: Sense: Objects of Parthiva (Earthly) nature, waters of the ocean and all Haima (i.e. of the elements of fire, Gold standing for Tejas) objects form one unit termed Salila (water).

verses.sanskrit: मेनकायां प्रभो जाता साम्प्रतं या ह्युमाभिधा । अनादिनिधना देवी ह्यप्रतर्क्या सुरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: menakāyāṃ prabho jātā sāmprataṃ yā hyumābhidhā / anādinidhanā devī hyapratarkyā sureśvara
verses.translation: When only water is seen flowing hither and thither it is called Salila. When it stands covering the whole Earth, that (mass of) water is called Arnava (an ocean).
verses.hindi: यावन्तश्चेव ते लोका दह्न्ते येन ते अ्रभो । एतन्नः कथय प्रीत्या त्वं हि बेत्थ पधातथम्. “पद एवमुक्तस्ततो वायुमुंनिभिविनयात्मभि: । प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं यथातत्तवेन तत्त्ववित् आ
verses.wordMeaning: When only water is seen flowing hither and thither it is called Salila. When it stands covering the whole Earth, that (mass of) water is called Arnava (an ocean).
verses.commentary: Sense: When only water is seen flowing hither and thither it is called Salila. When it stands covering the whole Earth, that (mass of) water is called Arnava (an ocean).

verses.sanskrit: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि देवेश ह्युमा मे वरदा यदि । उभावप्यत्र वै स्थाने स्थितौ शूलाग्रमूलयोः
verses.transliteration: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa hyumā me varadā yadi / ubhāvapyatra vai sthāne sthitau śūlāgramūlayoḥ
verses.translation: At the end of that period of a thousand sets of four Yugas, one day of Brahma passes off. During the whole of that period the entire universe becomes sub-merged in the Ekamava. All the activities of Prajapati (Brahma) cease (to exist).
verses.hindi: चतुर्दशव स्थानानि वणितानि महपिभिः । लोकाख्यानि तु यानि स्युयंषु तिष्ठन्ति सानवाः. सप्त तेषु कृतान्याहुरकृतानि तु सप्त वे । भ्रादयास्तु संख्याता: सप्त लोकाः कृतास्त्विह
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of that period of a thousand sets of four Yugas, one day of Brahma passes off. During the whole of that period the entire universe becomes sub-merged in the Ekamava. All the activities of Prajapati (Brahma) cease (to exist).
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of that period of a thousand sets of four Yugas, one day of Brahma passes off. During the whole of that period the entire universe becomes sub-merged in the Ekamava. All the activities of Prajapati (Brahma) cease (to exist).

verses.sanskrit: अवतारो यत्र तत्र संस्थितिं वै ततः कुरु
verses.transliteration: avatāro yatra tatra saṃsthitiṃ vai tataḥ kuru
verses.translation: When in that Ekamava the mobile and the im¬ mobile beings become annihilated, Brahma assumes this form— with thousand eyes, thousand feet, thousand heads, beautiful mind, thousand legs, thousand eyes and faces, thousand speeches (tongues), thousand arms and the lustre of the Sun. He is called the first Prajapati and the Purusa in the path of Trayl (three Vedas).
verses.hindi: पृथिवी चान्तरिक्षं च दिव्यं यच्च महः स्मृतम् । स्थानास्येतानि चत्वारि स्पृतान्याणंवकानि च
verses.wordMeaning: When in that Ekamava the mobile and the im¬ mobile beings become annihilated, Brahma assumes this form— with thousand eyes, thousand feet, thousand heads, beautiful mind, thousand legs, thousand eyes and faces, thousand speeches (tongues),…
verses.commentary: Sense: When in that Ekamava the mobile and the im¬ mobile beings become annihilated, Brahma assumes this form— with thousand eyes, thousand feet, thousand heads, beautiful mind, thousand legs, thousand eyes and faces, thousand speeches (tongues),…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तेनैवमुक्ते सहसा कृत्वा भूमण्डलं द्विधा । निःसृतौ शूलमूलाग्राल्लिङ्गार्चाप्रतिरूपिणौ
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tenaivamukte sahasā kṛtvā bhūmaṇḍalaṃ dvidhā / niḥsṛtau śūlamūlāgrālliṅgārcāpratirūpiṇau
verses.translation: He has brilliant complexion like the Sun. He is the protector of the worlds. He is single and the first Turdsdf (fore- staller of the enemies). He becomes Hiranyagarbha, the great Purusa. He goes beyond the darkness (of ignorance).
verses.hindi: क्षयातिशययुक्तानि तथा युक्तानि बक्ष्यते  च्म्यहम् । यानि नेमित्तिकानि स्थुस्तिष्ठन्त्याभृतसंप्लवम् है जनस्तपत्र सत्य च स्थानान्येतानि त्रीणि तु । ऐकान्तिकानि सत्त्वानि तिष्ठन्तीहाइडप्रसंगयभात् स्वस्तृतीयस्तु विज्ञेयश्रतुर्थों व॑ महः स्मृत: । जनस्तु पञचमो लोकस्तपः षष्ठो विभाव्यते
verses.wordMeaning: He has brilliant complexion like the Sun. He is the protector of the worlds. He is single and the first Turdsdf (fore- staller of the enemies). He becomes Hiranyagarbha, the great Purusa. He goes beyond the darkness (of ignorance).
verses.commentary: Sense: He has brilliant complexion like the Sun. He is the protector of the worlds. He is single and the first Turdsdf (fore- staller of the enemies). He becomes Hiranyagarbha, the great Purusa. He goes beyond the darkness (of ignorance).

verses.sanskrit: प्रद्योतयद्दिशः सर्वा लिङ्गं मूले प्रदृश्यते । वामतः प्रतिमा देवी तदा शूलेश्वरी स्थिता
verses.transliteration: pradyotayaddiśaḥ sarvā liṅgaṃ mūle pradṛśyate / vāmataḥ pratimā devī tadā śūleśvarī sthitā
verses.translation: At the end of the period of a thousand cycles of four Yugas when everything around is flooded with water, the lord becomes desirous of sleep and creates a dark night without light.
verses.hindi: वह किस प्रकार का है, हम समझते हैं, प्रत्येक लोकों में बहुसंख्यक पुण्यात्मा जब निवास करते होंगे, अतः उन महात्माओं के निवास के जितने लोक हैं और वे जिस प्रकार जलाये जाते हैं, उन्हें आप बतलावें, क्योंकि आप हम सबों पर प्रसन्न हैं, और इन सब बातों को यथार्थ रूप में जानते हैं। विनत मुनियों के इस प्रकार कहने पर तत्ववेत्ा वायु ने मधुर बाणी में कहा ।७-६। क्‍ ्ि
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the period of a thousand cycles of four Yugas when everything around is flooded with water, the lord becomes desirous of sleep and creates a dark night without light.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the period of a thousand cycles of four Yugas when everything around is flooded with water, the lord becomes desirous of sleep and creates a dark night without light.

verses.sanskrit: विलोभयन्ती च जगद्भाति पूरयती दिशः । दृष्ट्वा कृताञ्जलिपुटः स्तुतिं चक्रे द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: vilobhayantī ca jagadbhāti pūrayatī diśaḥ / dṛṣṭvā kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ stutiṃ cakre dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: When Brahma lies down with the four types of creation withdrawn in the Ania (Cosmic Egg), the Seven Great Sages see that noble-souled Kala (god of Time or Death).
verses.hindi: द वायु बले--ऋषिवन्द ! महृतियों ने ऐसे चौदह लोकों को बतलाया है, जिनमें पृष्यात्मा मानवगण निवास करते हैं, उनमें स्रात को कृत और सात को अक्ृत लोक कहते हैं । भू आदि सार लोक कृत हैं (१०-११। सात प्राकृब लोक अकृत कहे जाते हैं। स्थानाभिमानी देवताओं के साथ कृत लोकों की स्थिति है। पृथ्वी, भन्तरिक्ष, दिव्य और मह--ये चारों लोक आण्णंविक नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं। ये क्षय, और वृद्धिवाले लोक कहे जाते हैं।जो लोक क्षय वृद्धि रहित हैं उनके विषय में बतला रहा हूं । नेमित्तिक लोक जितने हैं, वे प्रलय पर्यन्त स्थिर रहने वाले हैं। जन, तप, और सत्य--ग्रे तीन लोक एकान्तिक और सत्वगरुण सम्पन्न हैं, इनकी स्थिति कल्प पयेन्‍्त रहती है। १९-१५ सात व्यक्त कहे जाने वाले... लोकों का व्णंव कर रहा हुं, उन सब में प्रथम भूलोक है, दूसरा भुव, तंसरा स्वर, चौथा मह, पाँचवाँ
verses.wordMeaning: When Brahma lies down with the four types of creation withdrawn in the Ania (Cosmic Egg), the Seven Great Sages see that noble-souled Kala (god of Time or Death).
verses.commentary: Sense: When Brahma lies down with the four types of creation withdrawn in the Ania (Cosmic Egg), the Seven Great Sages see that noble-souled Kala (god of Time or Death).

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्य उवाच: त्वमस्य जगतो माता जगत्सौभाग्यदेवता । न त्वया रहितं किंचिद् ब्रह्माण्डे ऽस्ति वरानने
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavya uvāca: tvamasya jagato mātā jagatsaubhāgyadevatā / na tvayā rahitaṃ kiṃcid brahmāṇḍe 'sti varānane
verses.translation: At that time they move about in Janaloka. By means of penance they have gained (divine) vision. They are the noble souls—Bhrgu and others. Their characteristics have already been recounted by me.
verses.hindi: जन, छठ तप और सातवाँ सत्य है । इनके बाद निरालोक ( घोर अन्धकार है )। ब्रह्मा ने भूः--ऐसा
verses.wordMeaning: At that time they move about in Janaloka. By means of penance they have gained (divine) vision. They are the noble souls—Bhrgu and others. Their characteristics have already been recounted by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time they move about in Janaloka. By means of penance they have gained (divine) vision. They are the noble souls—Bhrgu and others. Their characteristics have already been recounted by me.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादं कुरु धर्मज्ञे मम त्वाज्ञप्तुम् अर्हसि । ईदृशेनैव रूपेण केषु स्थानेषु तिष्ठसि । प्रसादप्रवणा भूत्वा वद तानि महेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: prasādaṃ kuru dharmajñe mama tvājñaptum arhasi / īdṛśenaiva rūpeṇa keṣu sthāneṣu tiṣṭhasi / prasādapravaṇā bhūtvā vada tāni maheśvari
verses.translation: With their divine vision only they see the seven worlds—Satya and others. They visualize Brahma during the great nights of Brahma.
verses.hindi: अय॑ साथइलोको नाष्ति ग. पुस्तके । सत्यस्तु सप्तमो लोकों निरालोकस्ततः परम् । भूरिति व्याहते पूर्व भूलेकिश्व॒ ततोइमवतू.
verses.wordMeaning: With their divine vision only they see the seven worlds—Satya and others. They visualize Brahma during the great nights of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their divine vision only they see the seven worlds—Satya and others. They visualize Brahma during the great nights of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेव्युवाच: सर्वगा सर्वभूतेषु द्रष्टव्या सर्वतो भुवि । सर्वलोकेषु यत्किंचिद्विहितं न मया विना
verses.transliteration: śrīdevyuvāca: sarvagā sarvabhūteṣu draṣṭavyā sarvato bhuvi / sarvalokeṣu yatkiṃcidvihitaṃ na mayā vinā
verses.translation: The Seven Sages see him at the time of his sleep. He is cited to be the first Paramesthin, because he stays beyond ail Kalpas.
verses.hindi: स्याहारेस्त्रिभिरेतंस्तु ब्रह्मा लोकमकल्पयत्  ततो भूः पाथिवो लोकोह्मन्तरिक्षं भुचः स्पृतम्॒
verses.wordMeaning: The Seven Sages see him at the time of his sleep. He is cited to be the first Paramesthin, because he stays beyond ail Kalpas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Seven Sages see him at the time of his sleep. He is cited to be the first Paramesthin, because he stays beyond ail Kalpas.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि येषु स्थानेषु द्रष्टव्या सिद्धिम् ईप्सुभिः । स्मर्तव्या भूतिकामेन तानि वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: tathāpi yeṣu sthāneṣu draṣṭavyā siddhim īpsubhiḥ / smartavyā bhūtikāmena tāni vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ
verses.translation: In the beginning of every Kalpa, he becomes the creator of all living beings again and again. After withdrawing all creations within himself Prajapati (creates them again).
verses.hindi: सस्‍्वर्लोको वे दिवं होतत्पुराणे निश्चय गतम् । भुतस्याधिपतिश्चाग्नितसस्‍्तो भुतपतिः स्घुत:.. वायुर्भुवस्थाधिपतिस्तेन वायुर्भुवस्पतिः  भव्यस्थ सुर्योड्घिपतिस्तेन सुर्यो दिवस्पतिः धर२२ महेतिव्याहतेनेव महलोंकस्ततोइभवत् । विनिवत्ताधिकाराणां देवानां तत्न वे क्षयः ॥२२रे
verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning of every Kalpa, he becomes the creator of all living beings again and again. After withdrawing all creations within himself Prajapati (creates them again).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning of every Kalpa, he becomes the creator of all living beings again and again. After withdrawing all creations within himself Prajapati (creates them again).

verses.sanskrit: वाराणस्यां विशालाक्षी नैमिषे लिङ्गधारिणी । प्रयागे ललिता देवी कामुका गन्धमादने
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī naimiṣe liṅgadhāriṇī / prayāge lalitā devī kāmukā gandhamādane
verses.translation: The excessively brilliant one, the creator of every¬ thing takes (withdraws) everything into himself and thereafter stays within the single vast sheet of water for the whole of that night.
verses.hindi: जनस्तु पथ्चमो लोकस्तस्माज्जायन्ति वे जनाः । तासां स्वायंभुवाद्यानां प्रजानां जननाज्जनः
verses.wordMeaning: The excessively brilliant one, the creator of every¬ thing takes (withdraws) everything into himself and thereafter stays within the single vast sheet of water for the whole of that night.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excessively brilliant one, the creator of every¬ thing takes (withdraws) everything into himself and thereafter stays within the single vast sheet of water for the whole of that night.

verses.sanskrit: मानसे कुमुदा नाम विश्वकाया तथा ऽपरे । गोमन्ते गोमती नाम मन्दरे कामचारिणी
verses.transliteration: mānase kumudā nāma viśvakāyā tathā 'pare / gomante gomatī nāma mandare kāmacāriṇī
verses.translation: Then, when the night passes off, Prajapati wakes U p. He is induced (in his mind) with the desire for creation once again.
verses.hindi: यास्‍्ता: स्वायंभुवाद्या हि पुरस्तत्परिकीतिताः । कल्पदस्धे तदा लोके प्रतिष्ठति + तदा तप: उच्चारण कर भूलोक की, भुवः-ऐसा उच्चारण कर भुव्लोक की, स्वः ऐसा उच्चारण कय स्वर लोक की सृष्टि की। भूर्भूवः स्वः- इन्हीं तीतों महाव्यादृतियों से उक्त तीनों की उत्पत्ति हुई है।भू की दाधिव लोक नाम से, भूव की अन्तरिक्ष लोक नाम से, और स्वर की स्वर्ग लोक नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं-: ढेसा पुराणों में निश्चित किया गया है । अग्नि भूतों का अर्थात् पृथ्वीस्थ समस्त पदार्थों का
verses.wordMeaning: Then, when the night passes off, Prajapati wakes U p. He is induced (in his mind) with the desire for creation once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, when the night passes off, Prajapati wakes U p. He is induced (in his mind) with the desire for creation once again.

verses.sanskrit: मदोत्कटा चैत्ररथे हयन्ती हास्तिने पुरे । कान्यकुब्जे स्थिता गौरी रम्भा ह्यमलपर्वते
verses.transliteration: madotkaṭā caitrarathe hayantī hāstine pure / kānyakubje sthitā gaurī rambhā hyamalaparvate
verses.translation: At the time of the Naimiltika (periodic) dissolution (by Brahma), when Prajapati grows calm, inthecoursc of with¬ drawal effected all the living beings get separated from their bodies. All the Bhutas become burnt by the rays of the Sun; even gods, sages and the excellent Manus (are affected by it in that water of flood.). In that collision all the living beings beginning with Gandharvas and ending with Pisacas who have not been scorched in the beginning of the Kalpa resort to Jana- loka.
verses.hindi: अधिपति है, इसी कारण उसे भूतपति के नाम से लोग जानते हैं ।१६-२१। अन्तरिक्ष का अधिपति वायु है, इसी कारण से वायु भुवस्वति के नाम से प्रसिद्ध हैं। भव्य अर्थात् स्वर लोक का अधिपति सूर्य है, इसी कारण वह दिवस्पति नाम से विख्यात है। ब्रह्मा के महा' ( महान् )-ऐसा उच्चारण करने पर महलोंक की सृष्टि हुई थो, देवषण अपने अधिकार काल से विनिव॒त्त होकर महलोंक में जाकर अवस्थान करते हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: At the time of the Naimiltika (periodic) dissolution (by Brahma), when Prajapati grows calm, inthecoursc of with¬ drawal effected all the living beings get separated from their bodies. All the Bhutas become burnt by the rays of the Sun; even gods,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time of the Naimiltika (periodic) dissolution (by Brahma), when Prajapati grows calm, inthecoursc of with¬ drawal effected all the living beings get separated from their bodies. All the Bhutas become burnt by the rays of the Sun; even gods,…

verses.sanskrit: एकाम्रके कीर्तिमती विश्वां विश्वेश्वरे विदुः । पुष्करे पुरुहूता च केदारे मार्गदायिनी
verses.transliteration: ekāmrake kīrtimatī viśvāṃ viśveśvare viduḥ / puṣkare puruhūtā ca kedāre mārgadāyinī
verses.translation: The living beings of the lower strata of animals and those that have fallen into hell—all those become burnt up and get absolved from sins. As long as the universe is submerged in water, they abide in Janaloka.
verses.hindi: अनग लोक उक्त लोंकों में पाँचवाँ है, इसी लोक से स्वायम्भुब मनु भा दि की प्रजाओं का जनन ( उत्पत्ति ) झोता है, अतः उसको जनलौक नाम से प्रसिद्धि है। पूर्व प्रसंग में स्वायम्भुव मनु आंदि की जिन प्रजाओं का बिस्तार पूर्वकएाक वर्णन किया जा चुका है वे सब कल्प के अवसान काल में, जबकि समस्त लोक दः्ध हो जाते हैं, तपोलोक में आश्रय भ्राप्त करते हैं, क्योंकि यह उस समय भी विद्यमान रहता है ।२३-२१५। ऋषभ पर्थ सनत्कुमारादि देवगण जो परम ब्रह्मचा सै एवं ऊध्वेरेता हो गये हैं, कठोर तपस्या ढवारा आत्मा को जिम्होंने वष् में कर लिया है, वे जिस लौक में अवस्थित रहते हैं उसको तपोलोक कहते हैं-यह भी तपोलोक का एक लक्षण है,  सत्य--यद्द ब्रह्मा का एक दाब्द हैं, इसका प्रयोग सत्ता ( अस्तित्व ) मात्र में होता
verses.wordMeaning: The living beings of the lower strata of animals and those that have fallen into hell—all those become burnt up and get absolved from sins. As long as the universe is submerged in water, they abide in Janaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The living beings of the lower strata of animals and those that have fallen into hell—all those become burnt up and get absolved from sins. As long as the universe is submerged in water, they abide in Janaloka.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दा हिमवतः प्रस्थे गोकर्णे भद्रकर्णिका । स्थानेश्वरे भवानी तु बिल्वके बिल्वपत्त्रिका
verses.transliteration: nandā himavataḥ prasthe gokarṇe bhadrakarṇikā / sthāneśvare bhavānī tu bilvake bilvapattrikā
verses.translation: When the night of Brahma whose source of origin is the Unmanifest, dawns again all those - living beings are born again.
verses.hindi: + धनुस्चिह्लास्तर्गतग्रन्थो ह पुस्तके। . +अत्र परस्मपदमार्षैम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: When the night of Brahma whose source of origin is the Unmanifest, dawns again all those - living beings are born again.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the night of Brahma whose source of origin is the Unmanifest, dawns again all those - living beings are born again.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीशैले माधवी नाम भद्रे भद्रेश्वरीति च । जया वराहशैले तु कमला कमलालये
verses.transliteration: śrīśaile mādhavī nāma bhadre bhadreśvarīti ca / jayā varāhaśaile tu kamalā kamalālaye
verses.translation: The sages, Manus, Devas and all the four kinds of living beings (are alike in this respect). Those Siddhas too die and are born.
verses.hindi: गन्धवर्पाप्सरसो यक्षा गुहाकास्तु सराक्षसा: । सर्वभूतपिशाचाश्न नागाश्न सह सानुषे: ॥ स्वलॉकिवासिनः सर्वे देवा भुवि निवासिनः
verses.wordMeaning: The sages, Manus, Devas and all the four kinds of living beings (are alike in this respect). Those Siddhas too die and are born.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages, Manus, Devas and all the four kinds of living beings (are alike in this respect). Those Siddhas too die and are born.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रकोट्यां तु कल्याणी काली कालञ्जरे तथा । महालिङ्गे तु कपिला माकोटे मुकुटेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: rudrakoṭyāṃ tu kalyāṇī kālī kālañjare tathā / mahāliṅge tu kapilā mākoṭe mukuṭeśvarī
verses.translation: Just as die Sun is rising and setting in this world (it happens regularly), so also the living beings are seen to have birth and destruction.
verses.hindi: मरातो मातरिश्वानों रुद्रा देवास्तथाश्विनों। अनिकेतान्तरिक्षास्ते भुवर्लोॉक्या दिवौफसः ३२६ आदित्या ऋभवो विश्वे साध्याश्र पितरस्तथा । ऋषयो5ड्रिरसश्वेव भुवलोंकं समाक्चिता:..
verses.wordMeaning: Just as die Sun is rising and setting in this world (it happens regularly), so also the living beings are seen to have birth and destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as die Sun is rising and setting in this world (it happens regularly), so also the living beings are seen to have birth and destruction.

verses.sanskrit: शालिग्रामे महादेवी शिवलिङ्गे जलप्रिया । मायापुर्यां कुमारी तु संताने ललिता तथा
verses.transliteration: śāligrāme mahādevī śivaliṅge jalapriyā / māyāpuryāṃ kumārī tu saṃtāne lalitā tathā
verses.translation: All the living beings come out and re-enter the creator of subjects, Brahma, the great lord, Prajapati of great Yogic power.
verses.hindi: एते वेमानिका वेवास्ताराग्रहनिवासिन: । इत्येते क्रमशः प्रोक्ता ब्रह्मग्याहारसंभवाः भूलॉकप्रथमा लोका महदन्ताश्र ते स्मृताः। आरभ्यन्ते तु तन्मान्रे: शुद्धास्तेषां परस्परम् ३२ शुक्राद्याश्राक्षुषान्ताश्र ये व्यतीता भुवं शिता: । महलोकिश्चतुर्थस्तु तस्मिस्ते कल्पवासिन: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: All the living beings come out and re-enter the creator of subjects, Brahma, the great lord, Prajapati of great Yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the living beings come out and re-enter the creator of subjects, Brahma, the great lord, Prajapati of great Yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पलाक्षी सहस्राक्षे हिरण्याक्षे महोत्पला । गयायां विमला नाम मङ्गला पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: utpalākṣī sahasrākṣe hiraṇyākṣe mahotpalā / gayāyāṃ vimalā nāma maṅgalā puruṣottame
verses.translation: The great Deva who is both manifest and unmanifest
verses.hindi: हत्येते क्रमशः प्रोक्ता ब्रह्मव्याहारसंभवा:.. द
verses.wordMeaning: The great Deva who is both manifest and unmanifest
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Deva who is both manifest and unmanifest

verses.sanskrit: विपाशायाममोघाक्षी पाटला पुण्ड्रवर्धने । नारायणी सुपार्श्वे तु त्रिकूटे भद्रसुन्दरी
verses.transliteration: vipāśāyāmamoghākṣī pāṭalā puṇḍravardhane / nārāyaṇī supārśve tu trikūṭe bhadrasundarī
verses.translation: It is he by whom the waters are created at first the waters that reach the surface of the earth along the path taken before.
verses.hindi: मुलोकप्रथमा लोका मह॒दसश्ताश्च ये स्मृता:। तास्सवस्सप्त सुर्यास्ते अचिभिनिर्दहन्ति वे रेड है, इसी कारण ब्रह्मलोक सत्यलोक के नाम से प्रसिद्ध है, यह परम प्रकाद्भय लोक उक्त सातों लोकों में अन्तिम अर्थात् सातवाँ है। समस्त देवगण गष्धवोँ, अप्सराओं, यक्षों, और गुह्मकों के साथ स्वलॉक में निवास करते हैं। सर्प, भूत, पिशाच, नाग एवं मनुष्यगण पृथ्वी लोक के निवासी हैं ।२६-२८। मरुद्गण, वायुगण, रुद्रगण कुछ देवगण, दोनों अध्विनीकुमार ये यथ्पि किसी निकेतन में निवास करने वाले नहीं हैं; पर इनका प्रमुख
verses.wordMeaning: It is he by whom the waters are created at first the waters that reach the surface of the earth along the path taken before.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is he by whom the waters are created at first the waters that reach the surface of the earth along the path taken before.

verses.sanskrit: विपुले विपुला नाम कल्याणी मलयाचले । कोटवी कोटितीर्थेषु सुगन्धा गन्धमादने
verses.transliteration: vipule vipulā nāma kalyāṇī malayācale / koṭavī koṭitīrtheṣu sugandhā gandhamādane
verses.translation: Just as mortal beings revolve through those ( Tonis or births) due to their auspicious and inauspicious activities, so they move upwards and downwards due to the (pull of) the Sun, as transfer from one body to another is inevitable.
verses.hindi: निवास स्थल भूवलोक है। स्वर्ग लोक में निवास करने वाले आदित्य गण, ऋभगण, विश्वेदेव गण, साध्यनगण पितर गण, एवं अंगिरा गोत्रोय ऋषिगण, भी, भुवर्लोक में आश्रय प्राप्त करते हैं। ये सभी देवादियण विमानों में चढ़ कर तराओं एवं ग्रहपिण्डों का.आश्रय ग्रहण कर भुवर्लोक में निवास करते हैं । ब्रह्मा के भभुवस्स्वरादि शब्दों के उच्चारणों द्वारा निर्मित लोकों की चर्चा आप लोगों से कर चुका । भुलोंकादि महलों-
verses.wordMeaning: Just as mortal beings revolve through those ( Tonis or births) due to their auspicious and inauspicious activities, so they move upwards and downwards due to the (pull of) the Sun, as transfer from one body to another is inevitable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as mortal beings revolve through those ( Tonis or births) due to their auspicious and inauspicious activities, so they move upwards and downwards due to the (pull of) the Sun, as transfer from one body to another is inevitable.

verses.sanskrit: गोदाश्रमे त्रिसन्ध्या तु गङ्गाद्वारे रतिप्रिया । शिवचण्डे सभानन्दा नन्दिनी देविकातटे
verses.transliteration: godāśrame trisandhyā tu gaṅgādvāre ratipriyā / śivacaṇḍe sabhānandā nandinī devikātaṭe
verses.translation: J So also Devas, Manus, Prajesas and other Siddhas who have attained heaven naturally assume the forms of righteous living beings on being subjected to the inevitable future.
verses.hindi: कास्त ( भूलोक से लेकर महलोंक तक ) जिन लोकों कौ चर्चा ऊपर की गई है, वे सब तस्मात्राओं से आरम्भ किये गये हैं ये परस्पर शुद्ध हैं, एक दूसरे से मिले हुये नहीं हैं। शुक्र से लेकर चाक्षुष मनु पर्य॑स्त, जो प्रृथ्वी लोक में आश्रम प्राप्त करनेवाले व्यतीत हो चके हैं, वे भी कल्पान्त के अवसर पर इस चतुर्थ महलोंक में जाकर अवस्थान करते हैं । ब्रह्मा की महा व्याहृतियों से उत्पन्न समध््त लोकों का विवरण क्रम पूर्वक कह चुका ।२६९-३३। प्रलय में भू से लेकर महलोंक तक जब सभी लोक सात सूर्य की रद्िमयों द्वारा दग्ध हो जाते हैं, तब मरीचि, कश्यप, दक्ष, स्वायम्भुव, अज़्िरा, भृगु, पुलस्त्य, पुलह ऋतु आदि प्रजापति गण एक साथ जन लोक में निवास करते हैं। कऋभ एवं सनत्कुमारादि नि;सत्त्म, निर्मम ऊध्वेरेता संसार
verses.wordMeaning: J So also Devas, Manus, Prajesas and other Siddhas who have attained heaven naturally assume the forms of righteous living beings on being subjected to the inevitable future.
verses.commentary: Sense: J So also Devas, Manus, Prajesas and other Siddhas who have attained heaven naturally assume the forms of righteous living beings on being subjected to the inevitable future.

verses.sanskrit: रुक्मिणी द्वारवत्यां तु राधा वृन्दावने वने । देवकी मथुरायां तु पाताले परमेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: rukmiṇī dvāravatyāṃ tu rādhā vṛndāvane vane / devakī mathurāyāṃ tu pātāle parameśvarī
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shall recount the period of dissolution of all living beings (Abhutasamplava). O Brahamanas, the Manvantaras have already been explained by me along with Prajnanisarga 1 2 (creation through intellect.) and the fourteen Marius.
verses.hindi: +एतदर्ध क. पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, I shall recount the period of dissolution of all living beings (Abhutasamplava). O Brahamanas, the Manvantaras have already been explained by me along with Prajnanisarga 1 2 (creation through intellect.) and the fourteen Marius.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, I shall recount the period of dissolution of all living beings (Abhutasamplava). O Brahamanas, the Manvantaras have already been explained by me along with Prajnanisarga 1 2 (creation through intellect.) and the fourteen Marius.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रकूटे तथा सीता विन्ध्ये विन्ध्यनिवासिनी । सह्याद्रावेकवीरा तु हरिश्चन्द्रे तु चण्डिका
verses.transliteration: citrakūṭe tathā sītā vindhye vindhyanivāsinī / sahyādrāvekavīrā tu hariścandre tu caṇḍikā
verses.translation: All the Manvantaras consist of a thousand cycles of four Yugas. When two thousand cycles of four Yugas are com¬ pleted it is said that a Kalpa is finished entirely.
verses.hindi: “हैहै९ .. जायुपुराणम् घोगं तपश्च सत्यं च समाधाय तदा55त्मनि । घष्ठे काले निवतंन्ते तत्तदाह (?) विपयेये
verses.wordMeaning: All the Manvantaras consist of a thousand cycles of four Yugas. When two thousand cycles of four Yugas are com¬ pleted it is said that a Kalpa is finished entirely.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Manvantaras consist of a thousand cycles of four Yugas. When two thousand cycles of four Yugas are com¬ pleted it is said that a Kalpa is finished entirely.

verses.sanskrit: रमणा रामतीर्थे तु यमुनायां मृगावती । करवीरे महालक्ष्मी रूपादेवी विनायके
verses.transliteration: ramaṇā rāmatīrthe tu yamunāyāṃ mṛgāvatī / karavīre mahālakṣmī rūpādevī vināyake
verses.translation: This should be known as one day of Brahma. Under¬ stand its calculation. The time taken to utter a short syllable or to wink once is called Nimesa. It is equal to a Matra.
verses.hindi: सत्यस्तु सप्तमो लोकों ह्ापुनर्मागंगासिणाम् । ब्रह्मलोकः समाख्यातों ह्मप्रतीघातलक्षण: ३३६
verses.wordMeaning: This should be known as one day of Brahma. Under¬ stand its calculation. The time taken to utter a short syllable or to wink once is called Nimesa. It is equal to a Matra.
verses.commentary: Sense: This should be known as one day of Brahma. Under¬ stand its calculation. The time taken to utter a short syllable or to wink once is called Nimesa. It is equal to a Matra.

verses.sanskrit: आरोग्या वैद्यनाथे तु महाकाले महेश्वरी । अभयेत्युष्णतीर्थे तु मृगी वा विन्ध्यकन्दरे
verses.transliteration: ārogyā vaidyanāthe tu mahākāle maheśvarī / abhayetyuṣṇatīrthe tu mṛgī vā vindhyakandare
verses.translation: According to another calculation seven and a half measures (Praslhas) of water constitute a Lava. 3 Thirty Lavas should be known as a Kala and thirty Kalas, one Muhurta.
verses.hindi: सुर्यक्षवान्तरं यच्च स्वर्गलोको दिवः स्मृतः । प्रुवाज्जनान्तरं यच्च महलीकः स उच्यते . ४१ विख्याताः सप्त लोकार्तु तेषां वक्ष्यासि सिद्धयः । भू्लोकवासिनः सर्वे अन्नादास्तु रसात्मकाः भुवे स्वगें च ये से सोमपा आज्यपाश्च ते । चतुर्थे येषपि वर्तन्ते महलोंक समाथ्षिताः ४३ विज्ञेया मानसी तेषां सिद्धिवें पश्चसक्षणा । सद्यश्चोत्पद्यते तेषां मनसा सर्वबसोप्सितम्
verses.wordMeaning: According to another calculation seven and a half measures (Praslhas) of water constitute a Lava. 3 Thirty Lavas should be known as a Kala and thirty Kalas, one Muhurta.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to another calculation seven and a half measures (Praslhas) of water constitute a Lava. 3 Thirty Lavas should be known as a Kala and thirty Kalas, one Muhurta.

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्ये माण्डुकी नाम स्वाहा माहेश्वरे पुरे । छागलिङ्गे प्रचण्डा तु चण्डिकामरकण्टके
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavye māṇḍukī nāma svāhā māheśvare pure / chāgaliṅge pracaṇḍā tu caṇḍikāmarakaṇṭake
verses.translation: Thirty such Muhurtas make one day and one night or nine hundred Kalas make one day and one night. 4
verses.hindi: एते देवा यजस्ते वे यज्ञः सबें: परस्परम् । अतोतास्वर्तमानांश्व वतेमानाननागतान् ४४५
verses.wordMeaning: Thirty such Muhurtas make one day and one night or nine hundred Kalas make one day and one night. 4
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirty such Muhurtas make one day and one night or nine hundred Kalas make one day and one night. 4

verses.sanskrit: सोमेश्वरे वरारोहा प्रभासे पुष्करावती । वेदमाता सरस्वत्यां पारा पारातटे मुने
verses.transliteration: someśvare varārohā prabhāse puṣkarāvatī / vedamātā sarasvatyāṃ pārā pārātaṭe mune
verses.translation: Obscure. So is the corresponding text in Bd. 41.207.
verses.hindi: विरागी ऋषिगण तपो लोक में निवास करते हैं। सावर्णादि चौदह मनु गणों के अधिकार काल की पुन- रावृत्ति इसी तपोलोक से कही जाती है। उस महान लोक विनाश काल के अवसर पर जन लोकादि निम्न प्ैणी के लोकों में निवास करनेवाले प्राणिवुन्द अपने अपने योग, तप, सत्य आदि का आत्मा में समाधान करके उस तपोलोक में आश्रय ग्रहण करते हैं ३४-३८। सत्य सातवाँ लोक है, वहाँ जाकर पुनरावत्ति नहीं होती इस सत्य लोक का कभी विनाश जलहीं होता-“इसी का दूसरा नाम तह लोक भी है, परिमाणों के अनुसार भूलोक मध्यवर्ती माना जाता है, भूमि तल से लेकर सूर्य पर्यन्त भुवलाँक को स्थिति कही जाती है, सुर्य॑ से लेकर भ्र्व पर्येन्‍्त स्वर्ग लोक की स्थिति है, इसे दिव लोक भी करते हैं। भव से लेकर जनलोक पयेन्‍त महलोंक है, इसी प्रकार अन्यान्य लोकों की भी स्थिति है। अब उन परम विख्यात सातों लोकों की
verses.wordMeaning: Obscure. So is the corresponding text in Bd. 41.207.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obscure. So is the corresponding text in Bd. 41.207.

verses.sanskrit: महालये महाभागा पयोष्ण्यां पिङ्गलेश्वरी । सिंहिका कृतशौचे तु कर्तिके चैव शांकरी
verses.transliteration: mahālaye mahābhāgā payoṣṇyāṃ piṅgaleśvarī / siṃhikā kṛtaśauce tu kartike caiva śāṃkarī
verses.translation: Prajdniiarga 'creation of subjects' in Bd.P.v.209.
verses.hindi: सिंद्धियों की चर्चा कर रहा हूँ। भूलोक में वास करनेवाले सब अन्नभक्षी रसास्वादी हैं, भुवर्लोक में निवास करनेवाले सोमपायी हैं. अर्थात् वे सोम का पान करते हैं, स्वर्ग लोक निवासियों का आहार आज्य पान है। जो चतुर्थ महलोंक से निवास करते हैं, उनकी पाँच मानसिक सिद्धियाँ कही जाती हैं, मन में सद्धुल्प मात्र करने से उन्हें समस्त मनौजञांछित सिद्धियाँ प्राप्त हो जाती है ।३६-४४। समस्त देवगण सभी प्रकार यज्ञों का
verses.wordMeaning: Prajdniiarga 'creation of subjects' in Bd.P.v.209.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prajdniiarga 'creation of subjects' in Bd.P.v.209.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पलावर्तके लोला सुभद्रा शोणसङ्गमे । मता सिद्धवटे लक्ष्मीस् तरंगा भारताश्रमे
verses.transliteration: utpalāvartake lolā subhadrā śoṇasaṅgame / matā siddhavaṭe lakṣmīs taraṃgā bhāratāśrame
verses.translation: Perhaps it indicates that the time taken by so much of water to drip through the hole in the mechanical device used to calculate time, is one Lava.
verses.hindi: अनुष्ठान करके परस्पर सन्तुष्टि लाभ करते हैं । वर्तमान देव अतोतकालीन देवताओं के लिए भविष्य एकशततमो5्याय! . हैथे७
verses.wordMeaning: Perhaps it indicates that the time taken by so much of water to drip through the hole in the mechanical device used to calculate time, is one Lava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Perhaps it indicates that the time taken by so much of water to drip through the hole in the mechanical device used to calculate time, is one Lava.

verses.sanskrit: जालन्धरे विश्वमुखी तारा किष्किन्धपर्वते । देवदारुवने पुष्टिर्मेधा काश्मीरमण्डले
verses.transliteration: jālandhare viśvamukhī tārā kiṣkindhaparvate / devadāruvane puṣṭirmedhā kāśmīramaṇḍale
verses.translation: The reading here of vyadhikdni Satdni sat should be emended as iryadhikdni etc. meaning 'six (hundred) increased by three hundred.
verses.hindi: प्रथमानस्तरैरिष्ट्वा अस्तराः सांप्रतेः पुनः । निवर्तंतीत्यासंबन्धोइतीते देवगणे ततः (? )
verses.wordMeaning: The reading here of vyadhikdni Satdni sat should be emended as iryadhikdni etc. meaning 'six (hundred) increased by three hundred.
verses.commentary: Sense: The reading here of vyadhikdni Satdni sat should be emended as iryadhikdni etc. meaning 'six (hundred) increased by three hundred.

verses.sanskrit: भीमादेवी हिमाद्रौ तु पुष्टिर्वस्त्रेश्वरे तथा । कपालमोचने शुद्धिर्माता कायावरोहणे
verses.transliteration: bhīmādevī himādrau tu puṣṭirvastreśvare tathā / kapālamocane śuddhirmātā kāyāvarohaṇe
verses.translation: The movement of the Moon and the Sun should be known by counting these: Fifteen Nimesas make one Kastha. Thirty Kasthas make one Kala.
verses.hindi: विनिवृत्ताधिकाराणां सिद्धिस्तेषां तु मानसी । तेषां तु मानसोक्ञेया शुद्धा सिद्धिपरम्परा (४७ उक्ता लोकाश्व चत्वारो जनस्थानुविधिस्तथा । समासेन मया विध्रा भूयर्तं वर्तयामि वः ४८ पर्व ते संप्रसुयन्ते ब्रह्मणो सनसा इह । ततः प्रजा: प्रतिष्ठाप्प जनमेदा55श्रयन्ति ते) ४० कहपदाहप्रदोप्तेषु तदा कालेषु तेषु वे । भ्रादिषु महान्तेषु भशं व्याप्तेष्वथारिनिना ५१ शिखा संवर्तेका ज्ञेया प्राप्नुवन्ति सदा जनाः  यामादयों गणाः सर्वे महलोॉकिनिवासिन:ः ३४५२ महलकिषु दीप्तेषु जनमेवा55श्र यस्ति ते । सर्वे सुक्ष्मशरीरास्ते तत्रस्थास्तु भविस्त ते ..
verses.wordMeaning: The movement of the Moon and the Sun should be known by counting these: Fifteen Nimesas make one Kastha. Thirty Kasthas make one Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: The movement of the Moon and the Sun should be known by counting these: Fifteen Nimesas make one Kastha. Thirty Kasthas make one Kala.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खोद्धारे ध्वनिर्नाम धृतिः पिण्डारके तथा । काला तु चन्द्रभागायामच्छोदे शक्तिधारिणी
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhoddhāre dhvanirnāma dhṛtiḥ piṇḍārake tathā / kālā tu candrabhāgāyāmacchode śaktidhāriṇī
verses.translation: Thirty Kalas make one Muhurta. Some say that Kala is a tenth part of a Muhurta. Forty Kalas arc termed (by others) one Muhurta.
verses.hindi: तेषां ते तुल्यसामर्थ्यास्तुल्यभूतिधरास्तथा । जनलोके विंवतेन्ते यावत्संप्लवते जगत् ५४ ब्युष्टायां तु रजस्यां वे ब्रहाणोउव्यक्तयोनिनः । अहरादौ प्रसूयन्ते पूर्वव॒तक्तमशस्टिवह 8
verses.wordMeaning: Thirty Kalas make one Muhurta. Some say that Kala is a tenth part of a Muhurta. Forty Kalas arc termed (by others) one Muhurta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirty Kalas make one Muhurta. Some say that Kala is a tenth part of a Muhurta. Forty Kalas arc termed (by others) one Muhurta.

verses.sanskrit: वेणायाममृता नाम बदर्यामुर्वशी तथा । ओषधी चोत्तरकुरौ कुशद्वीपे कुशोदका
verses.transliteration: veṇāyāmamṛtā nāma badaryāmurvaśī tathā / oṣadhī cottarakurau kuśadvīpe kuśodakā
verses.translation: Muhurtas and Lavas arc determined (thus) by those who know the measure. (Instead of the above) through water also time is measured. Thirteen Palas of water make a Prastha according to the calculation current in Magadha. Four Prasthas of water make one Nalika Ghata (a jar with a tube fitted in).
verses.hindi: स्कालीन देव वर्तमान देवताओं के लिए। इस प्रकार परवर्ती काल में उत्पन्न होनेवाले अपने पूव॑ वर्ती की सन्तुष्टि के लिये इन यज्ञादिकों का अनुष्ठान करते हैं। देवगणों के व्यातीत होने पर उनका सम्बन्ध निवृत्त दो जाता है। उन महरलोंक निवासियों का अधिकार काल जब समाप्त हो जाता है, उस समय भी उनकी परम विशुद्ध मानसी सिद्धियों की परम्परा उनमें विद्यमान जाननी चाहिए । विप्रवन्द ! आप लोगों को जनलोक तथा उससे निम्नवर्ती चारों लोकों की चर्चा संक्षेप में सुना चुका पुनः उसी का विस्तौर पवेक वर्णन कर रहा हैं ।४५-४८५। द
verses.wordMeaning: Muhurtas and Lavas arc determined (thus) by those who know the measure. (Instead of the above) through water also time is measured. Thirteen Palas of water make a Prastha according to the calculation current in Magadha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Muhurtas and Lavas arc determined (thus) by those who know the measure. (Instead of the above) through water also time is measured. Thirteen Palas of water make a Prastha according to the calculation current in Magadha.…

verses.sanskrit: मन्मथा हेमकूटे तु कुमुदे सत्यवादिनी । अश्वत्थे वन्दिनीका तु निधिर्वैश्रवणालये
verses.transliteration: manmathā hemakūṭe tu kumude satyavādinī / aśvatthe vandinīkā tu nidhirvaiśravaṇālaye
verses.translation: The bottom plate of the device is four Angulas square. There are four holes in it, each of the size of a golden masa (the pulse, black gram). Two Nalika Ghatas of water flow through those holes in the period of a Muhurta. It is the same both in the day and in the night.
verses.hindi: वायु ने कहा--ऋषिगण  मरीचि, कश्यप, दक्ष, वसिष्ठ, अज्िरा भूगु, पुलस्त्य पुलहह और ऋतु आदि ऋषिगण सर्व प्रथम ब्रह्मा के मानस पुत्रों के रूप में उत्पन्न होते हैं, और अपनी-अपनी प्रजाओं का विस्तार करके पुनः जनलोक का आश्रय लेते हैं ।४६-५०। कल्प के अवसान में संवतेक नामक अग्नि की प्रचण्ड ज्वाला से जब भू भुव स्वर मह-ये चारो लोक प्रज्वलित हो उठते हैं, इनमें सब ओर से अग्नि फैल जाती है,
verses.wordMeaning: The bottom plate of the device is four Angulas square. There are four holes in it, each of the size of a golden masa (the pulse, black gram). Two Nalika Ghatas of water flow through those holes in the period of a Muhurta. It is the same both in the day and in the night.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bottom plate of the device is four Angulas square. There are four holes in it, each of the size of a golden masa (the pulse, black gram). Two Nalika Ghatas of water flow through those holes in the period of a Muhurta. It is the same both in the day and in the night.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्री वेदवदने पार्वती शिवसन्निधौ । देवलोके तथेन्द्राणी ब्रह्मास्ये तु सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: gāyatrī vedavadane pārvatī śivasannidhau / devaloke tathendrāṇī brahmāsye tu sarasvatī
verses.translation: Thanks to the special movement of the Sun, the maximum number of Kalas is six hundred and five in all the Rtus always. This is to be known as one human day. The Stellar day contains ten more. A human year is calculated through Savana months.
verses.hindi: तब महलोक निवासी यमांदि देवगण सूक्ष्म शरीर धारण कर जनलोक का आश्रय ग्रहण करते हैं, ओर तदुपरास्त वहीं पर निवास करने लगते हैं ।५१-५३। वहाँ पहुँच कर वे जनलोक निवाध्तियों के समान सामथ्यंशौल स्वहूपवान् एवं ऐश्वयंशाली हो जाते हैं और उसी रूप में जगत के महान विनाशकाल तक स्थिति रहते हैं। अव्यक्त योनि भगवान् ब्रह्म की महारजनी के व्यतीत होने पर जब पुनः उनके दिन का प्रारम्भ होता है न धनुश्चित्वान्तर्गतग्रन्थों ड. पुस्तके नास्ति ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to the special movement of the Sun, the maximum number of Kalas is six hundred and five in all the Rtus always. This is to be known as one human day. The Stellar day contains ten more. A human year is calculated through Savana months.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to the special movement of the Sun, the maximum number of Kalas is six hundred and five in all the Rtus always. This is to be known as one human day. The Stellar day contains ten more. A human year is calculated through Savana months.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यबिम्बे प्रभा नाम मात्ःणां वैष्णवी मता । अरुन्धती सतीनां तु रामासु च तिलोत्तमा
verses.transliteration: sūryabimbe prabhā nāma mātḥṇāṃ vaiṣṇavī matā / arundhatī satīnāṃ tu rāmāsu ca tilottamā
verses.translation: It is decided in the scripture that a human year is one day and one night for the Devas. Through this day, the months, Ayanas and years should be calculated.
verses.hindi: पैदद वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is decided in the scripture that a human year is one day and one night for the Devas. Through this day, the months, Ayanas and years should be calculated.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is decided in the scripture that a human year is one day and one night for the Devas. Through this day, the months, Ayanas and years should be calculated.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रे ब्रह्मकला नाम शक्तिः सर्वशरीरिणाम् । शूलेश्वरी भृगुक्षेत्रे भृगौ सौभाग्यसुन्दरी
verses.transliteration: citre brahmakalā nāma śaktiḥ sarvaśarīriṇām / śūleśvarī bhṛgukṣetre bhṛgau saubhāgyasundarī
verses.translation: Knowledge of this is arrived at by this method. The terms given are only indicative. Since Kala constitutes the basic unit dme is mentioned as Kala.
verses.hindi: स्वायंभुवादयः सर्वे मरोच्यन्तास्तु साधका: । देवास्ते वे पुनस्तेषां जायन्ते निधनेष्चिह ४५६ देवान्वये देवता हि सप्त संभृतयः स्मृताः । व्यतीताः: कल्पजास्तेषां तिस्र: शिष्टास्तथा परे
verses.wordMeaning: Knowledge of this is arrived at by this method. The terms given are only indicative. Since Kala constitutes the basic unit dme is mentioned as Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowledge of this is arrived at by this method. The terms given are only indicative. Since Kala constitutes the basic unit dme is mentioned as Kala.

verses.sanskrit: एतदुद्देशतः प्रोक्तं नामाष्टशतमुत्तमम् । अष्टोत्तरं च तीर्थानां शतमेतद् उदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: etaduddeśataḥ proktaṃ nāmāṣṭaśatamuttamam / aṣṭottaraṃ ca tīrthānāṃ śatametad udāhṛtam
verses.translation: One day of Brahma is constituted by ten million two hundred and ninety thousand divine years.
verses.hindi: आवतंमाना देवास्ते क्रमेणेतेन स्वंशः । गत्वा जबं जबीभावं दशक्ृत्वः पुनः पुनः ५६ ततस्ते वे गणाः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा भावेष्वनित्यताम् । भाविनोर्थस्य च बलात्पुण्यास्यातिबलेन च
verses.wordMeaning: One day of Brahma is constituted by ten million two hundred and ninety thousand divine years.
verses.commentary: Sense: One day of Brahma is constituted by ten million two hundred and ninety thousand divine years.

verses.sanskrit: इदमेव परं विप्र सर्वेषां तु भविष्यति । पठत्यष्टोत्तरशतं नाम्नां यः शिवसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: idameva paraṃ vipra sarveṣāṃ tu bhaviṣyati / paṭhatyaṣṭottaraśataṃ nāmnāṃ yaḥ śivasannidhau
verses.translation: On hearing this, the sages were very much surprised. They asked Suta thereafter to make their knowledge clearer numerically.
verses.hindi: निवृत्तवृत्तयः सर्वे स्वस्था: सुमनसस्तथा । वेराजे तुपपद्चन्ते लोकमुत्सूज्य तज्जनम् . ततोहयेनव कालेन नित्ययुक्तास्तपस्विनः । कथनाच्चव धर्मंस्थ तेषां ते जज्ञिरेबन्चये
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this, the sages were very much surprised. They asked Suta thereafter to make their knowledge clearer numerically.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this, the sages were very much surprised. They asked Suta thereafter to make their knowledge clearer numerically.

verses.sanskrit: स मुच्यते नरः पापैः प्राप्नोति स्त्रियमीप्सिताम् । स्नात्वा नारी तृतीयायां मां समभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: sa mucyate naraḥ pāpaiḥ prāpnoti striyamīpsitām / snātvā nārī tṛtīyāyāṃ māṃ samabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: We wish to hear the magnitude of the period of dissolution on the basis of human calculation, briefly, consisting of small words and syllables.
verses.hindi: इहोत्पन्नास्ततस्ते वे स्थानान्यापुरयन्त्युत । देवत्वे च ऋषित्वे च मनुष्यत्वे च सर्वशः 0७४६३ एवं देवगणाः सर्वे दशकृत्यों निवत्य वे । वेराजेष॒पपन्नास्ते दश तिष्ठन्ट्युपप्लवान् ६४ पूर्णे पुर्णे ततः कल्पे स्थित्वा वेराजके पुनः । ब्रह्म लोके विवतंन्ते पुर्पुर्वक़मेण तु
verses.wordMeaning: We wish to hear the magnitude of the period of dissolution on the basis of human calculation, briefly, consisting of small words and syllables.
verses.commentary: Sense: We wish to hear the magnitude of the period of dissolution on the basis of human calculation, briefly, consisting of small words and syllables.

verses.sanskrit: न सा स्याद्दुःखिनी जातु मत्प्रभावान्नरोत्तम । नित्यं मद्दर्शने नारी नियताया भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: na sā syādduḥkhinī jātu matprabhāvānnarottama / nityaṃ maddarśane nārī niyatāyā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On hearing their words, lord Vayu endowed with d.vme attributes and celestial vision and engaged in the welfare ol the worlds spoke in brief.
verses.hindi: एस्मिस्म्रह्मलोके तु कल्पे वराजके गते । वेराज॑ पुरनप्येके कल्पस्थानमकल्पयन् . तब वे स्वायम्भुव आदि मनु, मरीचि आदि साधक ऋषिगण अपने-अपने पूृवंवर्ती पु्षों की मृत्यु के उपरान्त पूवक्रम से पुनर्जेन्म ग्रहण करते हैं ।५४-५६। तदनन्तर यमादि देवगण पूर्षकथित ज्येष्ठ कनिष्ठादि क्रम से जस्म ग्रहणं करते हैं । देववंद् में देवताओं की सात विभूतियों का स्मरण किया जाता है । उनमें से चारा कल्पज देवता व्यतीत हो चुके हैं, तीन शेष हैं। देवता भी उक्त क्रम से दस बार पुनः पुनः जन्म मरण को प्राप्त होकर
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their words, lord Vayu endowed with d.vme attributes and celestial vision and engaged in the welfare ol the worlds spoke in brief.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, lord Vayu endowed with d.vme attributes and celestial vision and engaged in the welfare ol the worlds spoke in brief.

verses.sanskrit: पतिपुत्रकृतं दुःखं न सा प्राप्स्यति कर्हिचित् । मदालये तु या नारी तुलापुरुषसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: patiputrakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ na sā prāpsyati karhicit / madālaye tu yā nārī tulāpuruṣasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: "The day and the night of Brahma have already been
verses.hindi: संसार के सभी पदार्थों एवं भावों में अनित्यता का दह्यंन करते हैं, तदनन्तर भावी की बलवत्ता से एवं अपने किये गए पुण्य कर्मों के प्रभाव से वे प्रशांत चित्त हो जाते हैं, और सभी कार्यों से विवत्त होकर स्वस्थ मन से इस जन लोक का परित्याग कर बैराज लोक को प्राप्त होते हैं ।१७-६१। तत्पश्चात् बहुत काल के उपरान्त नित्य योगाभ्यास परायण तपोनिष्ठ वे लोग धर्म कीतेन के प्रभाव से उन परम धा्िकों के वंश में जन्म ग्रहण
verses.wordMeaning: "The day and the night of Brahma have already been
verses.commentary: Sense: "The day and the night of Brahma have already been

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य मण्डयेद् देवांल्लोकपालांश्च साग्निकान् । सपत्नीकान्द्विजान्पूज्य वासोभिर् भूषणैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: sampūjya maṇḍayed devāṃllokapālāṃśca sāgnikān / sapatnīkāndvijānpūjya vāsobhir bhūṣaṇais tathā
verses.translation: The night and day of Brahma succeed each other. This successive period of night and day of the lord is what is called Abhulasainplava.
verses.hindi: करते हैं। और इस प्रकार उत्पन्न होकर देवत्व, ऋषित्व एवं मनुष्यत्व को प्राप्त कर उन उन स्थानों की पूर्ति करते हैं। सभी देवगण इस प्रकार दस बार जन्म ग्रहण करने के बाद वैराज नामक लोकों में आश्रय प्राप्त कर दस कल्प पयेन्त निवास करते हैं ।६२-६४॥। एक एक कल्प के पूर्ण होने पर वराज नामक लोकों में स्थित हो कर वे देवगण पूर्व पूर्व क्रम से ब्रह्म लोक स्थित होते हैं। वेराज के कल्पो के व्यतीत हो जाने पर वे . इस ब्रह्मलोक में निवास करते हैं । कुछ लोग वैराज लोक को कल्प पयंन्त स्थायी मानते हैं, इसी पूर्व कथित क्रमानुसार वे लोग अपने-अपने तप के प्रभाव से बराज लोक में जा जाकर वहाँ दस कल्प पयेश्त निवास कर ब्रह्मलोक को प्राप्त होते हैं । इस प्रकार वैराज लोक में जो लोग प्राप्त होते हैं. वे दस बार जन्म
verses.wordMeaning: The night and day of Brahma succeed each other. This successive period of night and day of the lord is what is called Abhulasainplava.
verses.commentary: Sense: The night and day of Brahma succeed each other. This successive period of night and day of the lord is what is called Abhulasainplava.

verses.sanskrit: भूतेभ्यस् तु बलिं दद्यादृत्विग्भिः सह देशिकः । ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य तुलामित्यभिमन्त्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: bhūtebhyas tu baliṃ dadyādṛtvigbhiḥ saha deśikaḥ / tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tulāmityabhimantrayet
verses.translation: It is called Abhutosamplava because whatever living beings there be whether mobile or immobile in the entire range of three worlds upto the elements ( bhiitas ) become merged.
verses.hindi: एवं पूर्वानृपुर्वेण ब्रह्मलोकगतेन व । एवं तेषु व्यतीतेषु तपसा परिकल्पिते ॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Abhutosamplava because whatever living beings there be whether mobile or immobile in the entire range of three worlds upto the elements ( bhiitas ) become merged.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Abhutosamplava because whatever living beings there be whether mobile or immobile in the entire range of three worlds upto the elements ( bhiitas ) become merged.

verses.sanskrit: शुचिरक्ताम्बरो वा स्याद् गृहीत्वा कुसुमाञ्जलिम् । नमस्ते सर्वदेवानां शक्तिस्त्वं परमा स्थिता
verses.transliteration: śuciraktāmbaro vā syād gṛhītvā kusumāñjalim / namaste sarvadevānāṃ śaktistvaṃ paramā sthitā
verses.translation: (Another explanation) Prajapati is called Bhuta because he exists at the very outset before all the subjects and creations. Everything floats and merges in Bliuta. Therefore the the final dissolution is called Abhutasamplava.
verses.hindi: एवं देवयुगानोह व्यतीतानि सह्रशः । निधन ब्रह्मलोके तु गतानामृषिभिः सह ६८ न शक्‍्यमानृपृव्येण तेषां वक्तुं प्रविस्तरम् । अनादित्वाच्च कालस्य असंख्यानाच्च सर्वशः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: (Another explanation) Prajapati is called Bhuta because he exists at the very outset before all the subjects and creations. Everything floats and merges in Bliuta. Therefore the the final dissolution is called Abhutasamplava.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Another explanation) Prajapati is called Bhuta because he exists at the very outset before all the subjects and creations. Everything floats and merges in Bliuta. Therefore the the final dissolution is called Abhutasamplava.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षिभूता जगद्धात्री निर्मिता विश्वयोनिना । त्वं तुले सर्वभूतानां प्रमाणमिह कीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: sākṣibhūtā jagaddhātrī nirmitā viśvayoninā / tvaṃ tule sarvabhūtānāṃ pramāṇamiha kīrtitā
verses.translation: The word Abhutasariiplava is also used in the sense of permanency and deathlessness (?) The past, present and future subjects are calculated up to Aparardha* (infinite number) by means of divine number.
verses.hindi: तवुपश्चुत्य वाक्यारथमरृषयः संशयान्विता: । सुतमाहुः पुराणज्ञ व्यासशिष्य॑ महामतिम् ७०
verses.wordMeaning: The word Abhutasariiplava is also used in the sense of permanency and deathlessness (?) The past, present and future subjects are calculated up to Aparardha* (infinite number) by means of divine number.
verses.commentary: Sense: The word Abhutasariiplava is also used in the sense of permanency and deathlessness (?) The past, present and future subjects are calculated up to Aparardha* (infinite number) by means of divine number.

verses.sanskrit: कराभ्यां बद्धमुष्टिभ्यामास्ते पश्यन्नुमामुखम् । ततो ऽपरे तुलाभागेन्यसेयुर् द्विजपुंगवाः
verses.transliteration: karābhyāṃ baddhamuṣṭibhyāmāste paśyannumāmukham / tato 'pare tulābhāgenyaseyur dvijapuṃgavāḥ
verses.translation: The maximum longevity (of Brahma) is mentioned as twice Parardha. This much is the period of stay of Aja (the
verses.hindi: बैराजास्ते यदाहारा यत्सत्त्वाश्व यदाश्रया: । तिष्ठन्ति चेब यत्कालं तन्नो बृहि यधातथम्॒. तदुक्तमृषिभिर्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा लोकार्थतत्त्ववित् । सुतः पौराणिको वाक्य विनयेनेदमनब्नवीत् (७२
verses.wordMeaning: The maximum longevity (of Brahma) is mentioned as twice Parardha. This much is the period of stay of Aja (the
verses.commentary: Sense: The maximum longevity (of Brahma) is mentioned as twice Parardha. This much is the period of stay of Aja (the

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्यमष्टविधं तत्र ह्यात्मवित्तानुसारतः । मन्दशभूते विप्रेन्द्र पृथिव्यां यदधिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: dravyamaṣṭavidhaṃ tatra hyātmavittānusārataḥ / mandaśabhūte viprendra pṛthivyāṃ yadadhiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: Just as the flame of a lump is blown out by the gust of wind, so also Brahma becomes quiescent as a result of the Pratisarga.
verses.hindi: ज० तबलनक-१- पक -स्‍मममनकथ का नीति य पल 4 -- पाशनकनननकाधीकिा : त»-ाऑआ «४०० "हा पान किक कप्तान जास्य मनबह मत ऑि्कलन-ॉतता ऑन हज
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the flame of a lump is blown out by the gust of wind, so also Brahma becomes quiescent as a result of the Pratisarga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the flame of a lump is blown out by the gust of wind, so also Brahma becomes quiescent as a result of the Pratisarga.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णं चैव निष्पावांस्तथा राजिकुसुम्भकम् । तृणराजेन्दुलवणं कुङ्कुमं तु तथाष्टमम्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇaṃ caiva niṣpāvāṃstathā rājikusumbhakam / tṛṇarājendulavaṇaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tu tathāṣṭamam
verses.translation: (Defective) The principles beginning with Mahat become withdrawn in the great Isvara; Mahat merges into the Unmanifest and all the three Gunas attain equilibrium.
verses.hindi: भारण का निवत्त होते हैं (!) इसी प्रकार देवताओं के सहम्नों युग समाप्त हो गये हैं। ऋषियों के साथ मृत्यु प्राप्त कर वे देवगण बराज लोकों में निवास करने के उपरान्त ब्रह्मलोक की प्राप्ति करते हैं ... खूत बोले--ऋषिव॒न्द ! देवताओं की एवं लय सृष्टि के विस्तार को क्रमानुसार नहीं बतलाया जा सकता, काल का कोई आदि नहीं है। संख्याओं की भी कोई इयत्ता नहीं है। ज॑ंसा मैं आप लोगों को अभी बतला चुका हूँ, उसमें सन्देह मत मानिये, वह सब वेसा ही हुआ है ।६६। सूत की इन बातों को सुनकर ऋषियों को बहुत सन्देह हो गया, तब के वेदव्यास के परम बुद्धिमान शिष्य यूत से, जो पुराणों के मा्िक स्थलों
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) The principles beginning with Mahat become withdrawn in the great Isvara; Mahat merges into the Unmanifest and all the three Gunas attain equilibrium.
