verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) The principles beginning with Mahat become withdrawn in the great Isvara; Mahat merges into the Unmanifest and all the three Gunas attain equilibrium.

verses.sanskrit: एषामेकतमं कुर्याद् यथा वित्तानुसारतः । साम्यादभ्यधिकं यावत् काञ्चनादि भवेद्द्विज
verses.transliteration: eṣāmekatamaṃ kuryād yathā vittānusārataḥ / sāmyādabhyadhikaṃ yāvat kāñcanādi bhaveddvija
verses.translation: Thus Abhulasariiplava lias been recounted by me briefly. This withdrawal by complete merging in water is a periodic ( jVaimittika ) reabsorption in relation to Brahma. What more shall I tell you? Those Brahmanas of acute discernment, who are of extra-ordinary good behaviour, who subsist on the residue of what is consigned to sacred fire in Homa, and who maintain special piety, become die residents of Maharloka along with Devas.
verses.hindi: को जानने वाले थे, बोले ।७०। क्‍ द
verses.wordMeaning: Thus Abhulasariiplava lias been recounted by me briefly. This withdrawal by complete merging in water is a periodic ( jVaimittika ) reabsorption in relation to Brahma. What more shall I tell you? Those Brahmanas of acute discernment, who are of extra-ordinary good behaviour,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Abhulasariiplava lias been recounted by me briefly. This withdrawal by complete merging in water is a periodic ( jVaimittika ) reabsorption in relation to Brahma. What more shall I tell you? Those Brahmanas of acute discernment, who are of extra-ordinary good behaviour,…

verses.sanskrit: तावत्तिष्ठेन्नरो नारी पश्चादिदमुदीरयेत् । नमो नमस्ते ललिते तुलापुरुषसंज्ञिते
verses.transliteration: tāvattiṣṭhennaro nārī paścādidamudīrayet / namo namaste lalite tulāpuruṣasaṃjñite
verses.translation: This chapter corresponds to Bd. 4.2. Only verse numbers from it are mentioned for reference. The chapter is an epitome of Dhuvana Kola.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने पूछा-सूत जी ! उस बेराज नामक लोकों में निवास करने वाले जो आहार करते हैं, उनका जो पराक्रम है, जिन पदार्थों या वस्तुओं का उन्हें आश्रय प्राप्त है, जितने समय तक वे बहाँ स्थित रहते हैं-इन सब बातों को हम यथार्थतः सुनना चाहते हैं, बतलाइए' ।७१। ऋषियों की इस जिज्ञासा को घुनकर लोकार्थ तत्ववेत्ता, पौराणिक सूत जी विनयपूर्ण स्वर में बोले। ऋषिवृन्द ! धर्माचरण के कारण जो परम शुद्ध एवं निविक्रार हो जाते हैं वे लोग उस वैराज नामक लोक में दस कल्प घक निबास करते हैं ।७३२-७३। ने सब परम ज्ञानो, सूक्ष्म एवं स्वच्छ शरीर समन्वित होते हैं। अनन्त काल तक
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter corresponds to Bd. 4.2. Only verse numbers from it are mentioned for reference. The chapter is an epitome of Dhuvana Kola.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter corresponds to Bd. 4.2. Only verse numbers from it are mentioned for reference. The chapter is an epitome of Dhuvana Kola.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमुमे तारयस्वास्मानस्मात्संसारकर्दमात् । ततो ऽवतीर्य मुरवे पूर्वमर्द्धं निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: tvamume tārayasvāsmānasmātsaṃsārakardamāt / tato 'vatīrya murave pūrvamarddhaṃ nivedayet
verses.translation: O Powerful Maiarisvan (Wind-god), of what nature is that world which has been called Maharloka by you? In every world many (meritorious souls) will be presiding. Hence, O Lord, recount to us with pleasure, how many are those worlds and how they are burnt (if at all). You alone know this precisely. On being requested thus by those disciplined-souled sages, Vayu, the knower of reality, spoke these sweet and truth¬ ful words.
verses.hindi: अन्न सूत उवाचेति ख. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: O Powerful Maiarisvan (Wind-god), of what nature is that world which has been called Maharloka by you? In every world many (meritorious souls) will be presiding. Hence, O Lord, recount to us with pleasure, how many are those worlds and how they are burnt (if at all).…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Powerful Maiarisvan (Wind-god), of what nature is that world which has been called Maharloka by you? In every world many (meritorious souls) will be presiding. Hence, O Lord, recount to us with pleasure, how many are those worlds and how they are burnt (if at all).…

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विग्भ्यो ऽपरमर्द्धं च दद्यादुदकपूर्वकम् । तेभ्यो लब्धा ततो ऽनुज्ञां दद्याद् अन्येषु चार्थिषु
verses.transliteration: ṛtvigbhyo 'paramarddhaṃ ca dadyādudakapūrvakam / tebhyo labdhā tato 'nujñāṃ dadyād anyeṣu cārthiṣu
verses.translation: There are only fourteen abodes called Lokas 1 (worlds) described by great sages and (meritorious men) stay therein.
verses.hindi: १००० द वायुपुराणम् सर्वे सुक्ष्मशरी रास्ते विद्वांसो घनमृतंयः । स्थितलोकस्थितत्वाच्च तेषां भूतं न विद्यते . छह ऊचुः सनत्कुमाराद्या: सिद्धास्ते योगर्धामिण: । ख्याति नेमित्तिकीं तेषां पर्याये समुपस्थिते ७४ स्थानत्यागे मनश्रापि युगपत्संप्रवतंते । ऊचुः सर्वे तदाइन्योन्यं वेराजा: शुद्धबुद्धयः ७६ एबमेव महाभागाः प्रणव संप्रविश्य ह। ब्रह्मलोके प्रवर्तामस्तन्नः श्रेयो भविष्यति ७७
verses.wordMeaning: There are only fourteen abodes called Lokas 1 (worlds) described by great sages and (meritorious men) stay therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are only fourteen abodes called Lokas 1 (worlds) described by great sages and (meritorious men) stay therein.

verses.sanskrit: सपत्नीकं गुरुं रक्तवाससी परिधापयेत् । अन्यांश्च ऋत्विजः शक्त्या गुरुं केयूरकङ्कणैः
verses.transliteration: sapatnīkaṃ guruṃ raktavāsasī paridhāpayet / anyāṃśca ṛtvijaḥ śaktyā guruṃ keyūrakaṅkaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: They call seven of them Krtas and the other seven Akrlas. The seven worlds, enumerated as Bhuh etc. are the Krtas. The seven Akrtas are the Prakfta ones (created by Verses 10-48 describe the seven Lokas (worlds), viz. (1) Bhur,
verses.hindi: एबमुक्त्वा तदा सर्वे ब्रह्मान्ते व्यवसायिनः  योजयित्वा तदा5तसानं बर्तन्ते योगधर्मिण: ७८ तन्नेव संप्रलीयन्ते शान्ता दीपाचिषो यथा। ब्रह्मकायमवर्तन्त पुनराव॒त्तिदुर्ल भम् ७६ लोक त॑ समनृप्राप्य सर्वे ते भावनामयस् । आननदं ब्रह्मणः प्राप्य अश्वतत्वाय ते गताः पद० बराजेम्यस्तयषोध्व॑मन्तरे षड्गुण सतः। ब्रह्मतोकः समाख्यातो यत्र ब्रह्मा पुरोहितः
verses.wordMeaning: They call seven of them Krtas and the other seven Akrlas. The seven worlds, enumerated as Bhuh etc. are the Krtas. The seven Akrtas are the Prakfta ones (created by Verses 10-48 describe the seven Lokas (worlds), viz. (1) Bhur,
verses.commentary: Sense: They call seven of them Krtas and the other seven Akrlas. The seven worlds, enumerated as Bhuh etc. are the Krtas. The seven Akrtas are the Prakfta ones (created by Verses 10-48 describe the seven Lokas (worlds), viz. (1) Bhur,

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लां गां क्षीरिणीं दद्याल्ललिता प्रीयतामिति । अनेन विधिना या तु कुर्यान्नारी ममालये
verses.transliteration: śuklāṃ gāṃ kṣīriṇīṃ dadyāllalitā prīyatāmiti / anena vidhinā yā tu kuryānnārī mamālaye
verses.translation: The Earth, the firmament, the heaven and what is remembered as Mahah —these four abodes are remembered as Arnavakas.
verses.hindi: ते सर्वे प्रणवात्मानों बुद्धशुद्धतपास्तथा । आनन्द ब्रह्मण: प्राप्यामृतत्व॑ं च भजन्त्युत पर हंदेस्ते नाभिभुयन्ते भावत्रयविर्वाजता: । आधिपत्यं बिना तुल्या ब्राह्मणस्ते महौजसः प्रभावविजयेश्वयंस्थितिवेराग्यदर्शने: । ते ब्रह्मलोकिका: सर्वे गति प्राप्प विवतेनीमू.. ऐद४
verses.wordMeaning: The Earth, the firmament, the heaven and what is remembered as Mahah —these four abodes are remembered as Arnavakas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Earth, the firmament, the heaven and what is remembered as Mahah —these four abodes are remembered as Arnavakas.

verses.sanskrit: मत्तुल्या सा भवेद्राज्ञां तेजसा श्रीरिवामला । सावित्रीव च सौन्दर्ये जन्मानि दश पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: mattulyā sā bhavedrājñāṃ tejasā śrīrivāmalā / sāvitrīva ca saundarye janmāni daśa pañca ca
verses.translation: These abodes are having decline and increase. Those not endowed so will be mentioned (later). Those that are Jfaimiltikas (periodical ones) last till the final dissolution. Jana, Tapa and Saiya— these three abodes are exclusive ones. They last till the (final) Prasarhyama (dissolution).
verses.hindi: स्थित रहने के कारण उनके शरीर में भूतों का सम्पर्क नहीं रहता ।७४। दस कल्प के उपरान्त धैराज लोक से विवर्तंन का अवसर जब उपस्थित होता है तब वेराज लोक में निवास करने वाले, शुद्धिबुद्धि योगाम्यास परायण सनत्कुमारादि, सिद्धशजण उस लोक को त्यागने के लिए एक साथ ही समुत्सुक होकर परस्पर इस प्रकार का वार्तालाप करते हैं, है महाभाग्यशालियों ! अब हम लोग प्रणव का आश्रय प्राप्त कर ब्रह्म लोक
verses.wordMeaning: These abodes are having decline and increase. Those not endowed so will be mentioned (later). Those that are Jfaimiltikas (periodical ones) last till the final dissolution. Jana, Tapa and Saiya— these three abodes are exclusive ones.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These abodes are having decline and increase. Those not endowed so will be mentioned (later). Those that are Jfaimiltikas (periodical ones) last till the final dissolution. Jana, Tapa and Saiya— these three abodes are exclusive ones.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: एवं निशम्य वचनं गौर्या द्विजवरोत्तमः । नमस्कृत्य जगामाशु धर्मराज निवेशनम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ gauryā dvijavarottamaḥ / namaskṛtya jagāmāśu dharmarāja niveśanam
verses.translation: I shall mention the Vyakta (manifest) ones. They are the seven abodes. Bhurloka is the first among them. The second one is remembered as Bhuvah.
verses.hindi: में निवास करेंगे, उससे हम सबों को विशेष कल्याण की प्राप्ति होगी ।७५-७७। इस प्रकार परस्पर सम्भाषण करने के उपराश्त वे योगधर्मा महात्मागण योगाभ्यास द्वारा आत्मा को परमात्मा ब्रह्म में सन्नियोजित कर शास्ते दीप शिखा की भाँति पुनरावृत्ति विरहित ब्रह्म पद की प्राप्ति करते हैं, और उसी स्थान पर विलीन हो जाते हैं। उञ्र परम सुखदायिनी कल्पनाओं से परिपूर्ण अनामय ब्रह्मलोक को प्राप्त कर ब्रह्मनन्द में निमग्त होर वे अमृतत्व की सम्प्राप्ति करते हैं। यह ब्रह्मतोक वराज नामक लोकों से छ गुना अधिक ऊपर विद्यमान है। उसकी ख्याति ब्रह्म लोक नाम से हैं, वहाँ ब्रह्म पुरोहित हैं ।७८-८१। वहाँ के सभी निवासी परम शुद्ध बुद्ध एवं तपोनिष्ठ होते हैं, प्रणव ही उनकी आत्मा होती है। ब्रह्मानन्द में मिमग्न होकर वे अमृतत्व का उपभोग करते हैं । उनमें सुख दुःखादि द्वल्दों का उदय नहीं होता, तीनों भावों का उनमें सवंथा अभाव
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention the Vyakta (manifest) ones. They are the seven abodes. Bhurloka is the first among them. The second one is remembered as Bhuvah.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the Vyakta (manifest) ones. They are the seven abodes. Bhurloka is the first among them. The second one is remembered as Bhuvah.

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं ख्यातं शूलेश्वरीति च । तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ khyātaṃ śūleśvarīti ca / tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: The third one should be known as Svah\ the fourth is remembeted as Mahah. Jana is the fifth world and Tapah is. considered as the sixth. Saiya is the seventh world. Beyond that there is dark¬ ness. When (Brahma) said " Bhuh" Bhurloka originated.
verses.hindi: रहता है, वे सब के सब परम तेजस्वी एवं आधिपत्य को छोड़कर सभी बातों में ब्रह्मा के समान प्रभावशाली होते हैं। प्रभाव, विजय ऐब्वर्ये, स्थिति, बेराग्य, ज्ञानादि में श्रह्मा ही के समान होते हैं । वे परमणुद्ध, बुद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: The third one should be known as Svah\ the fourth is remembeted as Mahah. Jana is the fifth world and Tapah is. considered as the sixth. Saiya is the seventh world. Beyond that there is dark¬ ness. When (Brahma) said " Bhuh" Bhurloka originated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The third one should be known as Svah\ the fourth is remembeted as Mahah. Jana is the fifth world and Tapah is. considered as the sixth. Saiya is the seventh world. Beyond that there is dark¬ ness. When (Brahma) said " Bhuh" Bhurloka originated.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् अन्नवासोभिः पिण्डैः पितृपितामहान् । भक्तोपहारैर्देवेशमुमया सह शङ्करं
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇān annavāsobhiḥ piṇḍaiḥ pitṛpitāmahān / bhaktopahārairdeveśamumayā saha śaṅkaraṃ
verses.translation: Second time when he said " Bhuvah ", firmament ori¬ ginated. For the third time when he said " Svah ", heaven appeared.
verses.hindi: हत आरभ्य 'भजर्त्यत' इत्यन्तग्रन्थो घ. पुस्तके नास्ति । ब्रह्मणा सह वेवेश्र संप्राप्ते प्रतिसंचरे । तपसो३्ते क्रियात्मानों बुद्धावस्था सनीधिण: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Second time when he said " Bhuvah ", firmament ori¬ ginated. For the third time when he said " Svah ", heaven appeared.
verses.commentary: Sense: Second time when he said " Bhuvah ", firmament ori¬ ginated. For the third time when he said " Svah ", heaven appeared.

verses.sanskrit: धूपगुग्गुलदानैश्च दीपदानैः सुबोधितैः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स गच्छेच्छिवसन्निधिम्
verses.transliteration: dhūpagugguladānaiśca dīpadānaiḥ subodhitaiḥ / sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa gacchecchivasannidhim
verses.translation: By means of these three Vyaharas (utterances) Brahma created the worlds. Hence Bhuh is remembered as Parthiva Loka (Earth) and firmament is remembered as Bhuvah. Svarloka is heaven. This is the conclusion in the Puranas. Agni (Fire-god) is the lord of Bhutas. Hence he is remembered as Bhutapati. Vayu is the lord of Bhuvah. Hence he is Bhuvaspati. The Sun is the lord of Bhavya i.e. Svah, hence is Divaspati.
verses.hindi: इत्येतदसृतं शुक नित्यमक्षयमव्ययम् । देवर्षयों ब्रह्मसत्नं सनातनसुपासते १८६ अपुनर्मागंगादीनां तेषां चेवोध्वेरेतसामू । कर्माम्थासकृता शुद्धिवंदान्तेषपलक्ष्यत ८७ तत्न तेडभ्यासिनो युक्ताः परां काष्ठाघुपासते । हित्वा शरौर॑ं पाप्मानममृतत्वाय ते गताः ८
verses.wordMeaning: By means of these three Vyaharas (utterances) Brahma created the worlds. Hence Bhuh is remembered as Parthiva Loka (Earth) and firmament is remembered as Bhuvah. Svarloka is heaven. This is the conclusion in the Puranas. Agni (Fire-god) is the lord of Bhutas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of these three Vyaharas (utterances) Brahma created the worlds. Hence Bhuh is remembered as Parthiva Loka (Earth) and firmament is remembered as Bhuvah. Svarloka is heaven. This is the conclusion in the Puranas. Agni (Fire-god) is the lord of Bhutas.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यः कश्चिद् अभियुक्तो नरेश्वर । अम्भिशापि तथा स्नातस्त्रिदिनं मुच्यते नरः
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ kaścid abhiyukto nareśvara / ambhiśāpi tathā snātastridinaṃ mucyate naraḥ
verses.translation: When he uttered "Mahah", Maharloka originated. The residence of the Devas who retire from their offices is there.
verses.hindi: निःसज्भा: शुच्यश्चव ब्रह्मसायों (यु) ज्यगाः स्मृताः । अकामयुक्तेयें वीरास्तपोभिदेग्धकिल्विषा: ॥॥ तेषाम अंशिनो लोका अप्रमेयसुखाः स्मृताः १९० एतद्ब्रह्मपदं दिव्यं परम व्योम्नि भास्वरम् । यत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति हमरा ब्रह्मणा सह ३६१
verses.wordMeaning: When he uttered "Mahah", Maharloka originated. The residence of the Devas who retire from their offices is there.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he uttered "Mahah", Maharloka originated. The residence of the Devas who retire from their offices is there.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां रात्रौ जागर्ति यो नरः । उपवासपरः शुद्धः शिवं सम्पूजयेन्नरः । प्रमुच्य पापसंमोहं रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ rātrau jāgarti yo naraḥ / upavāsaparaḥ śuddhaḥ śivaṃ sampūjayennaraḥ / pramucya pāpasaṃmohaṃ rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Jana is the fifth Loka. Janas (people) are born there. It is called Janaloka because the subjects of Svayambhuva Manu and others were born there. Those subjects of Svayambhuva Manu and others, who have already been glorified, set out for Tapoloka when all the worlds are consumed by the fire at the end of the Kalpa.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानी, क्रियाशील ब्रह्म लोक में निवास करने वाले महात्मागण पुतर्जन्म मरणादि विरहित शुभ गति को प्राप्त कर महा प्रलय में अपनी तपस्याओं के पूर्ण हो जाने पर अक्ला ही के साथ अब्यक्त प्रकृति में विलीन हो जाते हैं ।॥८२-८५। यही नित्य, अक्षय, अव्यय, परम छुद्धि अमृत पद हैं । इसी आवृत्ति विरहित सनातन परम पद की प्राप्ति के लिए ऊध्वरेता देवता एवं ऋषिगण वेदान्तादि में निर्णीत मज्जलमय कर्मों के अनुष्ठान
verses.wordMeaning: Jana is the fifth Loka. Janas (people) are born there. It is called Janaloka because the subjects of Svayambhuva Manu and others were born there. Those subjects of Svayambhuva Manu and others, who have already been glorified,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Jana is the fifth Loka. Janas (people) are born there. It is called Janaloka because the subjects of Svayambhuva Manu and others were born there. Those subjects of Svayambhuva Manu and others, who have already been glorified,…

verses.sanskrit: त्रिनेत्रश्च चतुर्बाहुः साक्षाद्रुद्रो ऽपरः । क्रीडते देवकन्याभिर्यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकम्
verses.transliteration: trinetraśca caturbāhuḥ sākṣādrudro 'paraḥ / krīḍate devakanyābhiryāvaccandrārkatārakam
verses.translation: That world is called Tapoloka because Rbhu, Sanat- kumara and other holy personages of souls purified by Tapas (penance) and of sublimated sexuality stay in that world.
verses.hindi: में निरत रहकर-शुद्धि प्राप्त करते हैं, ओर सतत योगाभ्यास में दत्त चित्त रहकर उसकी अन्तिम सीमा तक उपासना ( साधना ) करते हैं और अन्त में अपने पापमय शरीर को त्याग कर अमृतत्व की प्राप्ति करते हैं ।५६-८५८। वीघराग, जित क्रोध; निर्मोह, सत्यवादी, आत्मा को वंश में रखने वाले, जितेन्द्रिय, दयावान्, संगविरहित, पवित्रात्मा, जन ही उस ब्रह्म लोक की प्राप्ति करते सुने जाते हैं। जो वीरात्मा कामना विहीन, योग परायण एवं तपस्या द्वारा समस्त पापों को नष्ट करमे घाले हैं, उन्हीं के ऐसे अविनश्वर लोकों की कल्पना कौ गई है, जहाँ पर प्राप्त होने वाले कल्याण एवं सुख की कोई इयत्ता नहीं है यह ब्रह्म पद परम दिव्यगुण सम्पन्न एवं परम आकाश जाज्वल्यमान है, वहाँ जाकर वे अमर गण ब्रह्मा के साथ--निवास सुख का अनुभव करते हुए शोक रहित हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: That world is called Tapoloka because Rbhu, Sanat- kumara and other holy personages of souls purified by Tapas (penance) and of sublimated sexuality stay in that world.
verses.commentary: Sense: That world is called Tapoloka because Rbhu, Sanat- kumara and other holy personages of souls purified by Tapas (penance) and of sublimated sexuality stay in that world.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शूलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टनवत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय १९९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्यैवानन्तरं राजन्नाश्विनं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । कामिकं सर्वतीर्थानां प्राणिनां सिद्धिदायकम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 199 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ rājannāśvinaṃ tīrthamuttamam / kāmikaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ prāṇināṃ siddhidāyakam
verses.translation: The word Satya refers to Brahmi. It refers to pure existence as well. Hence Brahma's world is Satya. It is the shining seventh world.
verses.hindi: ऋषि ने पूछा- समादरणीय सूृत जी ! यह परादे क्‍या है ? पर किसे कहते हैं? यह हम लोग जानना चाहते हैं, कृपपा बतलाइगे ।६२। द
verses.wordMeaning: The word Satya refers to Brahmi. It refers to pure existence as well. Hence Brahma's world is Satya. It is the shining seventh world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The word Satya refers to Brahmi. It refers to pure existence as well. Hence Brahma's world is Satya. It is the shining seventh world.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे ऽश्विनौ देवौ सुरूपौ भिषजां वरौ । तपः कृत्वा सुविपुलं संजातौ यज्ञभागिनौ
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe 'śvinau devau surūpau bhiṣajāṃ varau / tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ saṃjātau yajñabhāginau
verses.translation: All the Devas are the residents of Svarloka along with Gandharvas, Apsaras-s, Yaksas, Guhyakas and Raksasas. AH Bhutas, Pisacas and Nagas are residents of the Earth along with men.
verses.hindi: १००२ वायुपुराणम् तथा शतसहस्नाणामर्बुदं कोटिरुच्यते । अरबुंदं दशकोट्यस्तु अब्जं कोटिशतं बिदुः । सहस्नलसपि कोटीनां खबमाहुर्मनीषिण: । दशकोटिसहर्नाणि निखरबंसिति त॑ विदुः
verses.wordMeaning: All the Devas are the residents of Svarloka along with Gandharvas, Apsaras-s, Yaksas, Guhyakas and Raksasas. AH Bhutas, Pisacas and Nagas are residents of the Earth along with men.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Devas are the residents of Svarloka along with Gandharvas, Apsaras-s, Yaksas, Guhyakas and Raksasas. AH Bhutas, Pisacas and Nagas are residents of the Earth along with men.

verses.sanskrit: संमतौ सर्वदेवानामादित्यतनयावुभौ । नासत्यौ सत्त्वं पन्नौ सर्वदुःखघ्नसत्तमौ
verses.transliteration: saṃmatau sarvadevānāmādityatanayāvubhau / nāsatyau sattvaṃ pannau sarvaduḥkhaghnasattamau
verses.translation: AlthoughMaruts, MatariSvans (Wind-gods), Rudras, (some) Devas and the Asvins have no fixed abode and they roam about in the atmosphere, they have their main residence in Bhuvarloka. The heaven-dwelling Adityas, Rbhus, Visve- devas, Sadhyas, Pitrs, and the sages of Angiras Gotra resort to Bhuvarloka also.
verses.hindi: शर्तं कोटिसहल्राणां शड्कुरित्यभिधीयते । सहस्न॑ तु सहस्नाणां कोटीनां दशधा पुनः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: AlthoughMaruts, MatariSvans (Wind-gods), Rudras, (some) Devas and the Asvins have no fixed abode and they roam about in the atmosphere, they have their main residence in Bhuvarloka. The heaven-dwelling Adityas, Rbhus, Visve- devas, Sadhyas, Pitrs,…
verses.commentary: Sense: AlthoughMaruts, MatariSvans (Wind-gods), Rudras, (some) Devas and the Asvins have no fixed abode and they roam about in the atmosphere, they have their main residence in Bhuvarloka. The heaven-dwelling Adityas, Rbhus, Visve- devas, Sadhyas, Pitrs,…

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: आदित्यस्य सुतौ तात नासत्यौ येन हेतुना । संजातौ श्रोतुम् इच्छामि निर्णयं परमं द्विज
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: ādityasya sutau tāta nāsatyau yena hetunā / saṃjātau śrotum icchāmi nirṇayaṃ paramaṃ dvija
verses.translation: All these Devas move about in aerial chariots and reside in the constellations and planets also. Thus all the (worlds) born of the utterances (Bhuh, Bhuvak, Svah) of Brahma have been recounted in order.
verses.hindi: कोटीनां सहल्नमयुतमित्ययं मध्य उच्चते । कोटिसहस्ननियुता स चानन्‍्त इति संज्ञितः द ६८ फोटिकोटिसहल्लाणि परार्ध इति कीत्यंते । परार्ध॑ द्विगुणं चापि परमाहुमंनीषिणः ६९ सूत बोले :--ऋषिवुन्द ! मैं पराई और पर की परिभाषा बतला रहा हूं, सुनिये । एक, दस, सो, सहस्न ये संख्यायें आप लोगों को विदित ही हूँ । भागे चलकर दस सहस्न का एक अयुत जानना चाहिए। सो सहल्ल का बुद्धिमान लोग एक नियुत बतलाते हैं  दस सौ सहस्न अर्थात् दस नियुत" को एक कोटि होतो है, दस कोटि का एक भर्वृद ( भरब ) होता है, सौ कोटि का एक अब्ज ( पद्म )
verses.wordMeaning: All these Devas move about in aerial chariots and reside in the constellations and planets also. Thus all the (worlds) born of the utterances (Bhuh, Bhuvak, Svah) of Brahma have been recounted in order.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these Devas move about in aerial chariots and reside in the constellations and planets also. Thus all the (worlds) born of the utterances (Bhuh, Bhuvak, Svah) of Brahma have been recounted in order.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: पुराणे भास्करे तात एतद्विस्तरतो मया । संश्रुतं देवदेवस्य मार्तण्डस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purāṇe bhāskare tāta etadvistarato mayā / saṃśrutaṃ devadevasya mārtaṇḍasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Bhurloka is the first of these worlds and the last one is Maharloka. They are created by the Tanmatras. They are mutually pure i.e. they are separated from one another.
verses.hindi: बतलाते है । मनीषीगण एक सहुन्न कोटि का ख़ब्व कहते हैं, दस सहस्न कोटि का एक निखर्ब होता हैं, सो सहस्त कोटि का एक शहू कु कहा जाता है, सह -सहुल्त कोटि को पुनः दस बार गुणित करते पर जो गुणनफल प्राप्त होता है उसे संख्या-तत्बवेत्ता लोग समुद्र नाम से पुकारते हैं (६३-६७। सहस्न अयुत कोटि का एक मध्य, सहन नियुत कोटि का एक अन्त, और बहस कोटि कोटि का एक परारद्ध होता है। भनीषीगण
verses.wordMeaning: Bhurloka is the first of these worlds and the last one is Maharloka. They are created by the Tanmatras. They are mutually pure i.e. they are separated from one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhurloka is the first of these worlds and the last one is Maharloka. They are created by the Tanmatras. They are mutually pure i.e. they are separated from one another.

verses.sanskrit: तत्ते संक्षेपतः सर्वं भक्तियुक्तस्य भारत । कथयामि न सन्देहो वृद्धभावेन कर्शितः
verses.transliteration: tatte saṃkṣepataḥ sarvaṃ bhaktiyuktasya bhārata / kathayāmi na sandeho vṛddhabhāvena karśitaḥ
verses.translation: Those who have gone away after resorting to the Earth, viz. Sukra and others ending with Caksusa (Manu?) reside in Maharloka till the end of the Kalpa.
verses.hindi: दो पराद्ध की एक संख्या मानते हैं। सौ संख्या को परिदृढ़ और सहस्त को परिषद्मक कहते हैं। उसके परा्ध ओर पर आदि कुल अठारह संख्यायें हैं, जो गणना के कार्यों में प्रयुक्त होती हैं । ये संजयायें परस्पर ग्रुणित होंने पर सौ सौ की संख्या में परिणत हो जाती है। महार्षियों ने बतलाया है, ब्रह्म के एक कल्प काल की परिमाण संख्या सृष्टि भारम्भ होने के काल से लेकर एक परार्द होती है। इसके उपरान्त
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have gone away after resorting to the Earth, viz. Sukra and others ending with Caksusa (Manu?) reside in Maharloka till the end of the Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have gone away after resorting to the Earth, viz. Sukra and others ending with Caksusa (Manu?) reside in Maharloka till the end of the Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: अतितेजोरवेर्दृष्ट्वा राज्ञी देवी नरोत्तम । चचार मेरुकान्तारे वडवा तप उल्बणम्
verses.transliteration: atitejoraverdṛṣṭvā rājñī devī narottama / cacāra merukāntāre vaḍavā tapa ulbaṇam
verses.translation: The seven Suns burn with their rays those worlds beginning with Bhurloka and ending with Maharloka. All the following: Marlci, Kasyapa, Daksa, Svayariibhuva, Angiras, Bhrgu, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu and others, are the Prajapatis and they live there with them. They are devoid of possessions and free from the feelings of my-ness. They are of sublimated sexuality. Rbhu, Sanatkumara and others are ascetics of great detachment. These worlds are the causes of the rebirth of all the fourteen Manvantaras including those of the Savarnas.
verses.hindi: १. यहाँ आनन्दाश्रम की प्रति में 'अर्वद पाठ बशुद्ध है, शुद्ध पाठ इस प्रकार होगा, 'तथा शंतेसहस्राणां दशर्क कोटि रुच्यते ।' अनुवादक
verses.wordMeaning: The seven Suns burn with their rays those worlds beginning with Bhurloka and ending with Maharloka. All the following: Marlci, Kasyapa, Daksa, Svayariibhuva, Angiras, Bhrgu, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu and others, are the Prajapatis and they live there with them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven Suns burn with their rays those worlds beginning with Bhurloka and ending with Maharloka. All the following: Marlci, Kasyapa, Daksa, Svayariibhuva, Angiras, Bhrgu, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu and others, are the Prajapatis and they live there with them.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः कतिपयाहस्य कालस्य भगवान्रविः । दृष्ट्वा तु रूपमुत्सृज्य परमं तेज उज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ katipayāhasya kālasya bhagavānraviḥ / dṛṣṭvā tu rūpamutsṛjya paramaṃ teja ujjvalam
verses.translation: Practising Yoga, penance and truthfulness and medita¬ ting on the soul, they return to the sixth Loka (i.e. Tapoloka) then at the end of the day (of Brahma i.e. during dissolution).
verses.hindi: शलानोति विजानोयात्स॑ज्ितानि महषिभिः । कल्पसंख्या प्रवृत्तस्य पराघधें ब्रह्मणः स्पृतम् वावच्छेषो5षपि कालो5स्य तस्यान्ते प्रतिसज्यते । पर एव पराधेंभ्र संख्यातः संख्या मया.. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Practising Yoga, penance and truthfulness and medita¬ ting on the soul, they return to the sixth Loka (i.e. Tapoloka) then at the end of the day (of Brahma i.e. during dissolution).
verses.commentary: Sense: Practising Yoga, penance and truthfulness and medita¬ ting on the soul, they return to the sixth Loka (i.e. Tapoloka) then at the end of the day (of Brahma i.e. during dissolution).

verses.sanskrit: मनोभववशीभूतो हयो भूत्वा लघुक्रमः । विस्फुरन्ती यथाप्राणं धावमाना इतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: manobhavavaśībhūto hayo bhūtvā laghukramaḥ / visphurantī yathāprāṇaṃ dhāvamānā itastataḥ
verses.translation: Salya is the seventh Loka. It is the region from which there is no return. It is unobstructed (i.e. eternal). It is god Brahma's Loka.
verses.hindi: यस्मादस्य पर बोय परसायुः परं तपः । परा शक्ति: परो धर्म: परा विद्या परा धृतिः
verses.wordMeaning: Salya is the seventh Loka. It is the region from which there is no return. It is unobstructed (i.e. eternal). It is god Brahma's Loka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salya is the seventh Loka. It is the region from which there is no return. It is unobstructed (i.e. eternal). It is god Brahma's Loka.

verses.sanskrit: हेषमाणः स्वरेणासौ मैथुनायोपचक्रमे । सम्मुखी तु ततो देवी निवृत्ता लघुविक्रमा
verses.transliteration: heṣamāṇaḥ svareṇāsau maithunāyopacakrame / sammukhī tu tato devī nivṛttā laghuvikramā
verses.translation: In (velocity?) of rotation and in magnitude Bhurloka is the meeting place (i.e. in the middle?). The firmament, the space between the Earth and the Sun is remembered as Bhuvah (-Loka).
verses.hindi: परं ब्रह्मा परं ज्ञानं परमश्वयेमेव च् । तस्मात्परतरं सूतं ब्रह्मणोब्न्यप्न विद्यते द १०६ परे स्थितो होष परः सर्वार्थेषु ततः पर: । संख्यातस्तु परा ब्रह्मा तस्यार्ध॑ तु पराधेता १०७ संख्येयं चाप्यसंख्येयं सतत चापि तत्त्रिकम् । संख्येयं संख्यया दृष्टमपरार्धाद्विभाष्यते राशों दुष्टे न संख्याइस्ति तदसंख्यस्य लक्षणम् । अनपत्य॑ सिक्तास्वेषु (? )दृष्टवनपञचलक्षणम् १०९ ईश्वरेस्तत्प्रसंख्यातं शुद्धत्वाहिव्यदृष्टिभिः । एवं ज्ञानप्रतिष्टत्वात्सवें ब्रह्माउनृपश्यति ११०
verses.wordMeaning: In (velocity?) of rotation and in magnitude Bhurloka is the meeting place (i.e. in the middle?). The firmament, the space between the Earth and the Sun is remembered as Bhuvah (-Loka).
verses.commentary: Sense: In (velocity?) of rotation and in magnitude Bhurloka is the meeting place (i.e. in the middle?). The firmament, the space between the Earth and the Sun is remembered as Bhuvah (-Loka).

verses.sanskrit: यथा तथा नासिकायां प्रविष्टं बीजमुत्तमम् । ततो नासागते बीजे संजातो गर्भ उत्तमः
verses.transliteration: yathā tathā nāsikāyāṃ praviṣṭaṃ bījamuttamam / tato nāsāgate bīje saṃjāto garbha uttamaḥ
verses.translation: This space between the Sun and Dhruva (the Pole Star) is Svarloka (Heaven). It is called Diva also. The space between Dhruva and Janaloka is called Maharloka.
verses.hindi: एक पराई काल सृह्ठिठ रहित अवस्था में व्यतीत होता है। उसके बाद पुनः सृष्ठि का प्रारम्भ होता है, इस प्रकार एक सृष्टि के आरम्भकाल से दूसरी सुष्ठि के आरम्भ का काल दो पराद्ध अर्थात् एक परकाल कझेता है। पर अर पराड इन दोनों कालों को संख्याओं द्वारा मैं बतला चुका ।६८-१०४। भगवान् ब्रह्मा का फ्रतः पराक्रम परम अतिक्षय महान् एवं ( सीमा रहित ) है, परम आयु है, तपस्या परम है, शक्ति परा है, धर्म
verses.wordMeaning: This space between the Sun and Dhruva (the Pole Star) is Svarloka (Heaven). It is called Diva also. The space between Dhruva and Janaloka is called Maharloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: This space between the Sun and Dhruva (the Pole Star) is Svarloka (Heaven). It is called Diva also. The space between Dhruva and Janaloka is called Maharloka.

verses.sanskrit: जातौ यतः सुतौ पार्थ नासत्यौ विश्रुतौ ततः । सुसमौ सुविभक्ताङ्गौ बिम्बाद्बिम्बमिवोद्यतौ
verses.transliteration: jātau yataḥ sutau pārtha nāsatyau viśrutau tataḥ / susamau suvibhaktāṅgau bimbādbimbamivodyatau
verses.translation: The seven worlds have been recounted well. Now I shall recount the Siddhis of those worlds. All the living beings in Bhurloka are the imbibers of juice and eaters of cooked food-grains.
verses.hindi: परम है, विद्या परा है, धैय॑ परम है, एबं ब्रह्मज्ञात, परम है, ऐश्वर्यं परम है, संक्षेप में निष्कर्ष यह कि उनसे बढ़कर किसी परम किसी वस्तु में कोई अन्य नहों है, वही. एक मात्र सभी वस्तुओं की परम सीमा में मर्यादा रूप से अवस्थित हैँ, इसी कारण से समस्त सासांरिक पदार्थों में उन्हें ही पर पद से विशिष्ट समझना चाहिए, उनके इस महान् अधिकार-काल के आधे के भाग को इसीलिये पराद्ध कहा जाता है। पुरुष प्रकृति एवं अह्या -ये तीनों संख्याओं द्वारा स्वंधा असंख्येय हैं, अर्थात् गणनाओं से इतकी इयता नहीं बाँधी जा सकती । किन्तु ऐसा होने पर भी संख्याओं द्वारा इनके पारस्परिक न्यूनाधिक्य का कुछ अनुमान किया जाता है, इसी कारण से इन्हें संख्येय कहते हैँ, वस्तुतः परार््ध की पूर्ववर्तिती संख्याओं की गणना की जा सकती है । उससे परवतिन्री संख्याएँ व्यावहारिक दृष्टि से किसी प्रकार व्यक्त कर दी जाती
verses.wordMeaning: The seven worlds have been recounted well. Now I shall recount the Siddhis of those worlds. All the living beings in Bhurloka are the imbibers of juice and eaters of cooked food-grains.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven worlds have been recounted well. Now I shall recount the Siddhis of those worlds. All the living beings in Bhurloka are the imbibers of juice and eaters of cooked food-grains.

verses.sanskrit: अधिकौ सर्वदेवानां रूपैश् चर्यसमन्वितौ । नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य भृगुकच्छे गतावुभौ । परां सिद्धिमनुप्राप्तौ तपः कृत्वा सुदुश्चरम्
verses.transliteration: adhikau sarvadevānāṃ rūpaiś caryasamanvitau / narmadātaṭamāśritya bhṛgukacche gatāvubhau / parāṃ siddhimanuprāptau tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram
verses.translation: All the residents of Bhuvarloka and Svarga are the imbibers of Soma and Ajya (ghee-oblations). Those who stay in the fourth Loka, Maharloka, should be known to possess the mental Siddhis of five characteristics. Everything that they desire mentally is immediately realised. These Devas are of the past, present and future. They mutually worship by means of Yajhas.
verses.hindi: हैं किन्तु उनकी गणना असंख्य में हो की- जाती है ।१०५-१०८। एक महान् राशि की इकाइयों की संख्या नहीं की जाती  उसे असंख्य का लक्षण मानते हैं, क्योंकि उनकी गणना में सारी संख्याएँ ही समाप्त हो जाती हैं, कोई संख्या शेष नहीं रहती । परार्, पर, ब्रह्मा, प्रकृति एवं पुरुष-इन पाँचों के ताक्तिवक निर्णय में कोई पूर्व निरदिष्ट विधान दृष्टि गत नहीं है। केवल शुद्धि बुद्धि, दिव्य दुष्टि स्रम्पल योगराम्यास
verses.wordMeaning: All the residents of Bhuvarloka and Svarga are the imbibers of Soma and Ajya (ghee-oblations). Those who stay in the fourth Loka, Maharloka, should be known to possess the mental Siddhis of five characteristics. Everything that they desire mentally is immediately realised.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All the residents of Bhuvarloka and Svarga are the imbibers of Soma and Ajya (ghee-oblations). Those who stay in the fourth Loka, Maharloka, should be known to possess the mental Siddhis of five characteristics. Everything that they desire mentally is immediately realised.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः । सुरूपः सुभगः पार्थ जायते यत्र तत्र च
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / surūpaḥ subhagaḥ pārtha jāyate yatra tatra ca
verses.translation: The middle ones worship the earlier ones (by sacrifice) and the present ones worship the middle ones. When the groups of Devas pass off, the contact and relations cease (to exist).
verses.hindi: परायण लोग ही अपनी महान् शुद्धता के कारण उनके तत्त्व निर्णय में समर्थ होते हैं। इन सभी तत्त्वों को, भगवान् ब्रह्मा, समस्त ज्ञान राशि के एक मात्र आगार स्वरूप होने के कारण यथार्थतः देखते हैं 4१०९-११०। १००९४ वायुपुराणम
verses.wordMeaning: The middle ones worship the earlier ones (by sacrifice) and the present ones worship the middle ones. When the groups of Devas pass off, the contact and relations cease (to exist).
verses.commentary: Sense: The middle ones worship the earlier ones (by sacrifice) and the present ones worship the middle ones. When the groups of Devas pass off, the contact and relations cease (to exist).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे आश्विनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २०० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्यैवानन्तरं पार्थ सावित्रीतीर्थमुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धा महाभागा सावित्री वेदमातृका
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe āśvinatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 200 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ pārtha sāvitrītīrthamuttamam / yatra siddhā mahābhāgā sāvitrī vedamātṛkā
verses.translation: It should be known that they still retain their series of mental Siddhis even though they cease to hold positions of authority. Their series of Siddhis is pure and should be known as mental.
verses.hindi: पप्रच्छूर्मातरिश्वानं सर्वे ते ब्रह्मवादिनः । ब्रह्मतोकस्तु भगवन्यावन्मात्रान्तर: प्रभो
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that they still retain their series of mental Siddhis even though they cease to hold positions of authority. Their series of Siddhis is pure and should be known as mental.
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that they still retain their series of mental Siddhis even though they cease to hold positions of authority. Their series of Siddhis is pure and should be known as mental.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: सावित्री का द्विजश्रेष्ठ कथं वाराध्यते बुधैः । प्रसन्ना वा वरं कं च ददाति कथयस्व मे
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: sāvitrī kā dvijaśreṣṭha kathaṃ vārādhyate budhaiḥ / prasannā vā varaṃ kaṃ ca dadāti kathayasva me
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the four worlds situated lower than Janaloka have been briefly recounted by me to you. I shall recount them again.
verses.hindi: वायुरुवाच क्‍ एतद्वो5ह प्रवक्ष्यासि शुणुध्वं मे विवक्षितम् । अव्यक्ताहचक्तभागो वे सहास्थूलों विभाव्यले परमाणु: सुसुक्ष्मस्तु भावाग्राह्मो न चक्षुषा । यदभेद्यतमं लोके विज्ञेयं परमाणु तत्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the four worlds situated lower than Janaloka have been briefly recounted by me to you. I shall recount them again.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the four worlds situated lower than Janaloka have been briefly recounted by me to you. I shall recount them again.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: पद्मा पद्मासनस्थेनाधिष्ठिता पद्मयोगिनी । सावित्रतेजःसदृशी सावित्री तेन चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: padmā padmāsanasthenādhiṣṭhitā padmayoginī / sāvitratejaḥsadṛśī sāvitrī tena cocyate
verses.translation: Marlci, Kasyapa, Daksa, Vasistha, Angiras, Bhrgu, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu and others are born at the outset as the
verses.hindi: दनरिकना+ निजता नादाला--४नअभक5 या -+०० 7 +--४० ४०५०० मम 9॥० ०-५ -३००आा एव हा ममाइम४-ाडा धनु "पा ना ना मना गा नहा ०- गा १4००-७५ मम पा न्‍णा भय पान यु ४+ ७५४४७ ना ना - अमल नआनन नहा -++ 5 डा मुन्ना» «रा नह “पाप +॥४+- पुल भा नह  माह न्‍य ० मुकाम म मन ग०५+५+॥०३४ ५४ गए -ग्॥ १०४५ पममम पड माता साइड 0७००३ १॥४४४४०४४४हु॥ कया पा बुपपाा ुक2आ मद दुनिममेभेकमे प्राए- कम दनमूहपपांधपपनपंदक
