verses.sanskrit: पद्मानना पद्मवर्णा पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणा । ध्यातव्या ब्राह्मणैर्नित्यं क्षत्रवैश्यैर् यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: padmānanā padmavarṇā padmapatranibhekṣaṇā / dhyātavyā brāhmaṇairnityaṃ kṣatravaiśyair yathāvidhi
verses.translation: When the worlds beginning with Bhiih and ending with Mahar are pervaded by the flames of Samvartaka fire at the end of the Kalpa, when the black fires blaze and burn, Yama and other groups of Devas residing in Maharloka resort to Janaloka. All those stationed there are of very subtle bodies.
verses.hindi: धायु की इन बातों को सुनकर ब्रक्तवेसा नैमिषारण्य निवासी महषिगण अतिशय हफषे से भानन्दाश्रु बहाने लगे, उनके कण्ठ मंद् गद हो गये। उन सभी ब्रह्मवेत्ाओं ने मातरिएवा से पूछा। भगवन वायु देव ! जक्त ब्रह्म लोक जितनी दूरी पर अवस्थित है, इसकी दूरी जितने योजनों एवं कोसों में है, एवं उन बोजमों भोर कोसों की परिभाषा क्‍या है--हन सब बातों की हम सब को जिज्ञासा, हो रही है, इनकी यथार्थतः जानकारी हमें कराइये । मह्ियों की इस वाणी को सुनकर वायु ने मीठे विनीतस्वर में उक्त ब्रह्मलोक के बारे में जो कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: When the worlds beginning with Bhiih and ending with Mahar are pervaded by the flames of Samvartaka fire at the end of the Kalpa, when the black fires blaze and burn, Yama and other groups of Devas residing in Maharloka resort to Janaloka.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the worlds beginning with Bhiih and ending with Mahar are pervaded by the flames of Samvartaka fire at the end of the Kalpa, when the black fires blaze and burn, Yama and other groups of Devas residing in Maharloka resort to Janaloka.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्याभयात्सा हि न तु शूद्रैः कदाचन । उच्चारणाद् धारणाद् वा नरके पतति ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyābhayātsā hi na tu śūdraiḥ kadācana / uccāraṇād dhāraṇād vā narake patati dhruvam
verses.translation: The (newcomers) assume the same features and excellence as they (the residents of Janaloka ) and move about in Janaloka as long as the universe is submerged in water.
verses.hindi: वायु बोले--ऋषिव॒त्द ! आप लोगों का अस्यात्य वक्तव्य विषयों को बतला रहा हूँ, सुनिये। अन्यक्त की भपेक्षा व्यक्त भाग महा स्थूल बतलाया जाता है। महत् के दस भाग जितना स्थल भूतादि बतलाये जाते हैं, भूतादि से दस भाग अधिक स्थूल परमाणु कहा जाता है यह परमाणु भी अतिशय सूक्ष्म होता है, इसे केवल अनुभव द्वारा ही जाना जा सकता है। आँखों द्वारा नहीं। लोक में जो सब से
verses.wordMeaning: The (newcomers) assume the same features and excellence as they (the residents of Janaloka ) and move about in Janaloka as long as the universe is submerged in water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The (newcomers) assume the same features and excellence as they (the residents of Janaloka ) and move about in Janaloka as long as the universe is submerged in water.

verses.sanskrit: वेदोच्चारणमात्रेण क्षत्रियैर् धर्मपालकैः । जिह्वाछेदो ऽस्य कर्तव्यः शूद्रस्येति विनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: vedoccāraṇamātreṇa kṣatriyair dharmapālakaiḥ / jihvāchedo 'sya kartavyaḥ śūdrasyeti viniścayaḥ
verses.translation: When the night of Brahma whose source of origin is the Unmanifest, dawns into day, they are reborn in the same order as before.
verses.hindi: सूक्ष परम अभेद्य वस्तु होती है, उसी कौ परमाणु जानना चाहिए। जालियों के भीतर घुसकर ( कमरे के अन्दर ) आने वाली सूर्य की किरणों में जो अति सूक्ष्म घल के कण दिखलाई पड़ते हैं, वहीं प्रमाणों में सभे प्रथम परमाणु कहे जाते हैं ।११५-११८। ऐसे आठ परमाणुओं का जब समवाय ( मिलन ) होता है, तब उसे श्रसरेणु कहा जाता है, इसे पश्चरज भी कहा जाता है। ऐसे आठ त्रसरेणुओं के मेल से रथरेण बनता है वे  नास्त्ययं श्लोक: ख. घ. पुस्तकयों:
verses.wordMeaning: When the night of Brahma whose source of origin is the Unmanifest, dawns into day, they are reborn in the same order as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the night of Brahma whose source of origin is the Unmanifest, dawns into day, they are reborn in the same order as before.

verses.sanskrit: बाला बालेन्दुसदृशी रक्तवस्त्रानुलेपना । उषःकाले तु ध्यातव्या सन्ध्या सन्धान उत्तमे
verses.transliteration: bālā bālendusadṛśī raktavastrānulepanā / uṣaḥkāle tu dhyātavyā sandhyā sandhāna uttame
verses.translation: On the death of their predecessors all those aspirants beginning with Svayambhuva (Manu) and ending with Marlci are reborn.
verses.hindi: बलाग्राण्यष्ट लिक्षा स्याद्यका तच्चाष्टकं भवेत् । यूकाष्टक यब॑ प्राहुरहगुलं तु यवाष्टकमू
verses.wordMeaning: On the death of their predecessors all those aspirants beginning with Svayambhuva (Manu) and ending with Marlci are reborn.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the death of their predecessors all those aspirants beginning with Svayambhuva (Manu) and ending with Marlci are reborn.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तुङ्गपीवरकुचा सुमुखी शुभदर्शना । सर्वाभरणसम्पन्ना श्वेतमाल्यानुलेपना
verses.transliteration: uttuṅgapīvarakucā sumukhī śubhadarśanā / sarvābharaṇasampannā śvetamālyānulepanā
verses.translation: Thereafter the Yama groups of Devas are reborn in the (chronological) order, the eldest first and the younger afterwards. In the family of Devas are remembered seven Sambhutis (Manifestations). These Sambhutis are born with the Kalpa— Kalpajah. Four of these manifestations have passed away, while the three others (still) survive.
verses.hindi: धनुःसहले है चापि गव्यूतिरुपदिश्यते । अष्टो धनुःसहल्लाणि योजनं तु विधीयते १२६ योजनानां तु संख्यातं संख्याज्ञानविशारदेः । एतेन योजनाग्रेण शुणुब्ब॑ ब्रह्मणोन्तरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter the Yama groups of Devas are reborn in the (chronological) order, the eldest first and the younger afterwards. In the family of Devas are remembered seven Sambhutis (Manifestations). These Sambhutis are born with the Kalpa— Kalpajah.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the Yama groups of Devas are reborn in the (chronological) order, the eldest first and the younger afterwards. In the family of Devas are remembered seven Sambhutis (Manifestations). These Sambhutis are born with the Kalpa— Kalpajah.…

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतवस्त्रपरिच्छन्ना श्वेतयज्ञोपवीतिनी । मध्याह्नसन्ध्या ध्यातव्या तरुणा भुक्तिमुक्तिदा
verses.transliteration: śvetavastraparicchannā śvetayajñopavītinī / madhyāhnasandhyā dhyātavyā taruṇā bhuktimuktidā
verses.translation: Undergoing transmigration again and again upto ten times in order those Devas observe the evanescence of all created beings. Thanks to the force of the inevitable future and as a result of that power of their own meritorious deeds, they attain mental equilibrium. They desist from all activities and leave off Janaloka with a calm mind. They then attain the Vairaja Loka.
verses.hindi: महीतलात्सहज्नाणां शतादृध्वं दिवाकरः  दिवाकरात्सह्रेण तावदूध्य निशाकरः
verses.wordMeaning: Undergoing transmigration again and again upto ten times in order those Devas observe the evanescence of all created beings. Thanks to the force of the inevitable future and as a result of that power of their own meritorious deeds, they attain mental equilibrium.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Undergoing transmigration again and again upto ten times in order those Devas observe the evanescence of all created beings. Thanks to the force of the inevitable future and as a result of that power of their own meritorious deeds, they attain mental equilibrium.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रदोषे तु पुनः पार्थ श्वेता पाण्डुरमूर्धजा । सुमृता तु दुर्गकान्तारे मातृवत्परिरक्षति
verses.transliteration: pradoṣe tu punaḥ pārtha śvetā pāṇḍuramūrdhajā / sumṛtā tu durgakāntāre mātṛvatparirakṣati
verses.translation: Practising Yoga perpetually, performing penance and preaching dharma for a long time, they are bom in the families of meritorious persons. Whether they attain Devahood, sage-hood or human form, they do fulfil the duties of those respective positions.
verses.hindi: पूर्ण शतसहल्न तु योजनानां निशाकरात्। नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नमुपरिष्दात्प्रकाशते शर्त सह संख्यातो मेरुद्विगुणित पुनः । ग्रहान्तरमभेकेकमुथ्वे नक्षत्रमण्डलात्
verses.wordMeaning: Practising Yoga perpetually, performing penance and preaching dharma for a long time, they are bom in the families of meritorious persons. Whether they attain Devahood, sage-hood or human form, they do fulfil the duties of those respective positions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Practising Yoga perpetually, performing penance and preaching dharma for a long time, they are bom in the families of meritorious persons. Whether they attain Devahood, sage-hood or human form, they do fulfil the duties of those respective positions.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषेण तु राजेन्द्र सावित्रीतीर्थमुत्तमम् । स्नात्वाचम्य विधानेन मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: viśeṣeṇa tu rājendra sāvitrītīrthamuttamam / snātvācamya vidhānena manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: Thus these groups of Devas resort to the Vairdja Loka after ten repetitions of births. There they stay for ten Kalpas.
verses.hindi: भी जब आठ इकट॒ठे हो जाते हैं, तब बुद्धिमात् लोग बलाग्र कहते हें। ऐसे आठ बलाग्रों की एक लिक्षा होती है, और आठ लिक्षा की एक यूका कही जाती है। आठ यूका का एक जब कहा जाता है और आठ जब का एक अंगुल होता है! बारह अंगुलियों के पोरों की एक वितस्ति होती है, और ऐसे ही इक्कीस पौरों की एक रुत्ति जाननी चाहिए ।११९-१२२। चोबीस अंगुलों का एक हाथ होता है। बयालीस अंगुल बर्थात्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these groups of Devas resort to the Vairdja Loka after ten repetitions of births. There they stay for ten Kalpas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these groups of Devas resort to the Vairdja Loka after ten repetitions of births. There they stay for ten Kalpas.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामैर् दहेद् दोषान् सप्तजन्मार्जितान्बहून् । आपोहिष्ठेति मन्त्रेण प्रोक्षयेदात्मनस्तनुम्
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmair dahed doṣān saptajanmārjitānbahūn / āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa prokṣayedātmanastanum
verses.translation: As each of the Kalpas is completed in the Vairdjaka (Kalpa) (Loka?), they move on to Brahmaloka in their due order of priority. In the world of Brahma, when a Kalpa of Vairdjalza (pertaining to Brahma) passes away, they. again get assigned a position lasting for a Kalpa in Vairdja (loka).
verses.hindi: दो रत्नि का एक किष्कु होता है। बुद्धिमानू लोग छानबे अंगुलों का एक धनुष बतलाते हैं । यह धनुष गश्यूति अर्थात् दो कोस परिमाण मापने में एक साधन कहा जाता है। संख्या के तत्तवों के जाननेवाले लोग घनुष, दण्ड, युग और नाली को अंगुलों द्वारा एक समान बतलाते हूं, अर्थात् ये उपयुक्त चारों परिमाण छानबे अंगुलों के कहे जाते हैं ॥ तीन सौ धनुष परिमाण का एक नल्‍व कहा जाता है, ओर दो सहख्र धनुष की एक गव्यूति अर्थात् दों कोस होता है । आठ सहख्र घनुष का एक योजन बतलाया जाता है १३३-१२६। इस प्रकार धनुष के परिमाण द्वारा योजत तक का माप किया जाता है। संख्यातत्त्व विदों ने इसी वद्धति में योजन तक का परिमाण निश्चित किया है। इस योजन के परिमाण द्वारा ब्रह्मलोक की दूरी सुनिये । पृथ्वीतल से सौ सहस्न कर्थात् एक लाख योजन पर सूर्य का निवास है। सूर्य से सी सह योजन
verses.wordMeaning: As each of the Kalpas is completed in the Vairdjaka (Kalpa) (Loka?), they move on to Brahmaloka in their due order of priority. In the world of Brahma, when a Kalpa of Vairdjalza (pertaining to Brahma) passes away, they.…
verses.commentary: Sense: As each of the Kalpas is completed in the Vairdjaka (Kalpa) (Loka?), they move on to Brahmaloka in their due order of priority. In the world of Brahma, when a Kalpa of Vairdjalza (pertaining to Brahma) passes away, they.…

verses.sanskrit: नवषट् च तथा तिस्रस्तत्र तीर्थे नृपोत्तम । आपोहिष्ठेति त्रिरावृत्य प्रतिग्राहैर् न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: navaṣaṭ ca tathā tisrastatra tīrthe nṛpottama / āpohiṣṭheti trirāvṛtya pratigrāhair na lipyate
verses.translation: Thus in the order mentioned before they frequently go to Vairaja as a result of their penance up to ten times and return to Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: दूर चम्द्रमा हैं। १२७-१२६। चन्द्रमा से सहस्न योंजन दूर नक्षत्रों का प्रकाश होता हैं। मेरुमण्डल इस नक्षत्र लोक से दो लाख योजन पर अवस्थित है इस नक्षत्र मण्डल से ऊपर एक एक ग्रह परस्पर इतनी द्वी दूरी पर हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus in the order mentioned before they frequently go to Vairaja as a result of their penance up to ten times and return to Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus in the order mentioned before they frequently go to Vairaja as a result of their penance up to ten times and return to Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: अघमर्षणं त्र्यृचं तोयं यथावेदम् अथापि वा । उपपापैर् न लिप्येत पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा
verses.transliteration: aghamarṣaṇaṃ tryṛcaṃ toyaṃ yathāvedam athāpi vā / upapāpair na lipyeta padmapatramivāmbhasā
verses.translation: Thus thousands of Devayugas have passed. They attained death along with the sages in Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: १००६ वायुपुराणन्र् सप्तर्विमण्डलं कृष्णमुपरिष्टात्प्रकाशते । ऋषिभिस्तु सहर्राणां शतादृध्ब॑ विभाव्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Thus thousands of Devayugas have passed. They attained death along with the sages in Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus thousands of Devayugas have passed. They attained death along with the sages in Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यापं हि कुरुते विप्र उल्लेखत्रयम् आचरेत् । चतुर्थं कारयेद् यस् तु ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: tryāpaṃ hi kurute vipra ullekhatrayam ācaret / caturthaṃ kārayed yas tu brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: It is impossible to recount them in detail and in the proper sequence because time is beginningiess and it is impos¬ sible to count everything completely. Still you need not have any doubt. Everything has been mentioned by me precisely.
verses.hindi: योध्सों तारामये दिव्ये बिमाने हृस्वरूपके। उत्तानपादपुत्रोइसो मेढीभूतो ध्रुबो दिवि १३५ त्रेलोक्यस्येष उत्सेधो व्याख्यातो योजनेमंया । मन्वन्तरेषु देवानामिज्या यत्रेव लौकिकी.
verses.wordMeaning: It is impossible to recount them in detail and in the proper sequence because time is beginningiess and it is impos¬ sible to count everything completely. Still you need not have any doubt. Everything has been mentioned by me precisely.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is impossible to recount them in detail and in the proper sequence because time is beginningiess and it is impos¬ sible to count everything completely. Still you need not have any doubt. Everything has been mentioned by me precisely.

verses.sanskrit: द्रुपदाख्यश्च यो मन्त्रो वेदे वाजसनेयके । अन्तर्जले सकृज्जप्तः सर्वपापक्षयंकरः
verses.transliteration: drupadākhyaśca yo mantro vede vājasaneyake / antarjale sakṛjjaptaḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing that statement the sages were over-whelm¬ ed with doubts. They then spoke to Suta who was conversant with the Puranas, whose intellect was great and who was Vyasa's disciple.
verses.hindi: वर्णाश्रमेभ्य इज्या तु लोके5स्मिन्या प्रबरतंते । सर्वासां देवयोनीनां स्थितिहेतुः स वे स्मृतः. त्रेलोक्यमेतद्रयास्यातमत ऊध्वे निबोधत। श्रुवादृर्ध्य महलोंको यस्मिस्ते कल्पवासिनः ।।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that statement the sages were over-whelm¬ ed with doubts. They then spoke to Suta who was conversant with the Puranas, whose intellect was great and who was Vyasa's disciple.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that statement the sages were over-whelm¬ ed with doubts. They then spoke to Suta who was conversant with the Puranas, whose intellect was great and who was Vyasa's disciple.

verses.sanskrit: उदुत्यम् इति मन्त्रेण पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् । गायत्रीं च जपेद् देवीं पवित्रां वेदमातरम्
verses.transliteration: udutyam iti mantreṇa pūjayitvā divākaram / gāyatrīṃ ca japed devīṃ pavitrāṃ vedamātaram
verses.translation: Please mention precisely what constitutes the diet of these people in Vairdja Loka y what the extent of their exploit is, what their support is and how long they stay there.
verses.hindi: + (एकयोजनकोटी सा इत्येव निश्चयं गतम १३८ हें कोट्यो तु महलोकाथस्मिस्ते कल्पवासिनः) ॥ यत्र ते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा दक्षादय साधकाः स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: Please mention precisely what constitutes the diet of these people in Vairdja Loka y what the extent of their exploit is, what their support is and how long they stay there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Please mention precisely what constitutes the diet of these people in Vairdja Loka y what the extent of their exploit is, what their support is and how long they stay there.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीं तु जपेद् देवीं यः सन्ध्यानन्तरं द्विजः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: gāyatrīṃ tu japed devīṃ yaḥ sandhyānantaraṃ dvijaḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: On hearing the statement uttered by the Sages, Suta who was well-versed in the Puranas and who knew the reality of the world, spoke thus with humility.
verses.hindi: चतुर्गुणोत्तरादृध्वे जनलोकात्तपः स्मृतम् । बेराजा यत्र ते देवा भूतदाह॒विवर्जिताः १४० षड़्गु्ण तु तपोलोकात्सत्यलोकास्तरं स्मृतम् । अपुनर्मा रकामानां (णां) ब्रह्मलोक: स उच्यते ३१४ १
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the statement uttered by the Sages, Suta who was well-versed in the Puranas and who knew the reality of the world, spoke thus with humility.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the statement uttered by the Sages, Suta who was well-versed in the Puranas and who knew the reality of the world, spoke thus with humility.

verses.sanskrit: दशभिर्जन्मभिर्लब्धं शतेन तु पुराकृतम् । त्रियुगं तु सहस्रेण गायत्री हन्ति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: daśabhirjanmabhirlabdhaṃ śatena tu purākṛtam / triyugaṃ tu sahasreṇa gāyatrī hanti kilbiṣam
verses.translation: Those people who become the purest of the pure (by means of meritorious actions) attain that world (Vairdja) and stay there for ten Abhutasamplavas (periods of final dissolution).
verses.hindi: सभी ताश ग्रहों में बुष्त निम्न प्रदेश चारी है; उसके ऊपर शुक्र का लोक है, उससे ऊपर मजूल है, उप्तसे ऊपर बृहस्पति तदतस्तर शनदचर का निवास है, शनेव्चर से ऊपर एक लाख योजन पर सप्तर्षि मण्डलों का प्रकाश होता है। इन सप्तर्षियों से भी एक लाख योजन ऊपर तारामय दिव्य लघ विमान में उत्तानपाद का सुत प्रुव स्वर्ग लोक के प्रमुख चिह्न स्वरूप होकर विराजमान रहते हैं। १३०-१३४। योजनों द्वारा भ्लोक्य कौ
verses.wordMeaning: Those people who become the purest of the pure (by means of meritorious actions) attain that world (Vairdja) and stay there for ten Abhutasamplavas (periods of final dissolution).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those people who become the purest of the pure (by means of meritorious actions) attain that world (Vairdja) and stay there for ten Abhutasamplavas (periods of final dissolution).

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीसारमात्रो ऽपि वरं विप्रः सुयन्त्रितः । नायन्त्रितश्चतुर्वेदी सर्वाशी सर्वविक्रयी
verses.transliteration: gāyatrīsāramātro 'pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ / nāyantritaścaturvedī sarvāśī sarvavikrayī
verses.translation: All of them have only subtle bodies. They are learned. Their forms and features are like those of clouds. Since they abide in a permanent world there is no Bhuta (the elements) in them.
verses.hindi: ऊँचाई की व्याख्या मैं कर चुका  सभी मन्वन्तरों में जो लौकिक यज्ञादि सत्कर्मों के अनुष्ठान इस लोक में वर्णा- अ्रमाचारानुमोदित ढंग से होते रहते हैं, वे ही समस्त देवयोनि में उत्पन्न होनेवाले प्राणियों की स्थिति के कारण भूत कहे जाते हैं  त्रलोक्य की यह व्याख्या कर' चुका अब इसके आगे का विवरण सुनिये उस भ्रव लोक से ऊपर महलोंक की स्थिति है, जिसमें उन कल्प पर्यस्त स्थिर रहनेवाले महात्माओं का निवास रहता है। उसकी दूरी भव से एक कोटि योजन की है--ऐसा निश्चय हो चुका है। उस महलाँक से दो कोटि योजब ऊपर जन लोक की स्थिति है, जिसमें सिद्धि के अभिलाषी ब्रह्मा के पुत्र दक्षादि कल्पपय प्त निवास करते हैं। जन लोक के चार कोटि योजन ऊपर तपो लोक की स्थिति स्मरण की जाती है, जिनमें
verses.wordMeaning: All of them have only subtle bodies. They are learned. Their forms and features are like those of clouds. Since they abide in a permanent world there is no Bhuta (the elements) in them.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them have only subtle bodies. They are learned. Their forms and features are like those of clouds. Since they abide in a permanent world there is no Bhuta (the elements) in them.

verses.sanskrit: सन्ध्याहीनो ऽशुचिर् नित्यमनर्हः सर्वकर्मसु । यदन्यत् कुरुते किंचिन्न तस्य फलभाग् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sandhyāhīno 'śucir nityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu / yadanyat kurute kiṃcinna tasya phalabhāg bhavet
verses.translation: When a change is imminent (i.e. when they are about to leave), Sanatkumara and other Siddhas ofYogic rites and practice mention (reveal) their time of (periodic) change. The inclination to abandon the abode occurs simultaneously. Then all of them, of pure intellect, say to the Vairajas and to one another: "O blessed ones, now we shall enter into Pranava and stay in Brahmaloka. It is conducive to our welfare to proceed to Brahmaloka".
verses.hindi: भू्तों के तापादि से सवंथा विरहित बैराज नामक देवताओं का निवास कहा जाता है। तपोलोक से छ गुणित भर्थात् छः कोटि योजन ऊपर सत्य लोक की स्थिति कही जाती है, वही पुनरावत्ति विरहित जरामर- आदि विहीन सिद्धों का ब्रदह्मलोक कहा जाता है ।! ३८५-१४१। उस बरह्ालोक से उनका कभी भी पतन नहीं होता,
verses.wordMeaning: When a change is imminent (i.e. when they are about to leave), Sanatkumara and other Siddhas ofYogic rites and practice mention (reveal) their time of (periodic) change. The inclination to abandon the abode occurs simultaneously. Then all of them, of pure intellect,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When a change is imminent (i.e. when they are about to leave), Sanatkumara and other Siddhas ofYogic rites and practice mention (reveal) their time of (periodic) change. The inclination to abandon the abode occurs simultaneously. Then all of them, of pure intellect,…

verses.sanskrit: सन्ध्यां नोपासते यस्तु ब्राह्मणो मन्दबुद्धिमान् । स जीवन्नेव शूद्रः स्यान् मृतः श्वा सम्प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: sandhyāṃ nopāsate yastu brāhmaṇo mandabuddhimān / sa jīvanneva śūdraḥ syān mṛtaḥ śvā samprajāyate
verses.translation: After saying thus, all of them striving to attain Brahman practise Yogic rites and stay there uniting the Atman with Paramdtman. Like the flames of a lamp that has ceased to burn (for want of oil), they become extinct and become merged in Brahman wherefrom a return is rarely achieved. (There is no return.)
verses.hindi: धनुश्निल्वान्तर्गतग्रन्थों घ. पुस्तके नास्ति । यस्माक्त च्यवते भुयो ब्रह्माणं स उपासते । एककोटियॉजनानां पत्चाशन्नियुतानि तु
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, all of them striving to attain Brahman practise Yogic rites and stay there uniting the Atman with Paramdtman. Like the flames of a lamp that has ceased to burn (for want of oil),…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, all of them striving to attain Brahman practise Yogic rites and stay there uniting the Atman with Paramdtman. Like the flames of a lamp that has ceased to burn (for want of oil),…

verses.sanskrit: सावित्रीतीर्थमासाद्य सावित्रीं यो जपेद्द्विजः । त्रैविद्यं तु फलं तस्य जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: sāvitrītīrthamāsādya sāvitrīṃ yo japeddvijaḥ / traividyaṃ tu phalaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: After attaining that world full of meditation, they attain the bliss of Brahman and the state of immortality.
verses.hindi: ऊध्वंभागस्ततो5ण्डस्य ब्रह्मलोकात्पर: स्मृतः  चतुर (तत्नर)श्चेव कोटचस्तु नियुता पत्चषष्टि च १४३ एषो४र्धाशप्रचारोस्य गत्यन्तश्रापर: स्मृतः । श्रुवाग्रमेतद्याख्यातं योजनाग्राद्याशरुतम् +.
verses.wordMeaning: After attaining that world full of meditation, they attain the bliss of Brahman and the state of immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: After attaining that world full of meditation, they attain the bliss of Brahman and the state of immortality.

verses.sanskrit: पित्ःनुद्दिश्य यः स्नात्वा पिण्डनिर्वपणं नृप । कुरुते द्वादशाब्दानि तृप्यन्ति तत्पितामहाः
verses.transliteration: pitḥnuddiśya yaḥ snātvā piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ nṛpa / kurute dvādaśābdāni tṛpyanti tatpitāmahāḥ
verses.translation: Brahmaloka is mentioned to be six times higher up be¬ yond the Vairaja worlds. And god Brahma is the Purohita (one who has been put in charge beforehand). All of them are Pnz?awz-souled (i.e. have concentrated their souls in the mystic syllable Om). They are endowed with enlightenment, purity and penance. After deriving the bliss of Brahman, they enjoy the state of deathless-ness.
verses.hindi: अधोगतीनां वक्ष्यामि भृतानां स्थानकल्पनाम् । गच्छन्ति घोरकर्माण: प्राणिनों यन्न कर्मंभिः नरको रोरवो रोधः सुकरस्ताल एवं चे । ( )९ तप्तकुम्भो महाज्वाल: शबलोडइथ बिमोचन: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmaloka is mentioned to be six times higher up be¬ yond the Vairaja worlds. And god Brahma is the Purohita (one who has been put in charge beforehand). All of them are Pnz?awz-souled (i.e. have concentrated their souls in the mystic syllable Om).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmaloka is mentioned to be six times higher up be¬ yond the Vairaja worlds. And god Brahma is the Purohita (one who has been put in charge beforehand). All of them are Pnz?awz-souled (i.e. have concentrated their souls in the mystic syllable Om).…

verses.sanskrit: सावित्रीतीर्थमासाद्य यः कुर्यात् प्राणसंक्षयम् । ब्रह्मलोकं वसेत् तावद् यावद् आभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: sāvitrītīrthamāsādya yaḥ kuryāt prāṇasaṃkṣayam / brahmalokaṃ vaset tāvad yāvad ābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: They are not affected by mutually clashing opposites (like happiness and sorrow etc.). They are devoid of the three Bhav.as (states of existence, i.e. birth, growth and decay). They possess majestic lustre. They are in every respect equal to Brahma except in the matter of over-lordship.
verses.hindi: कृमी च क्मिभक्षश्र लालाभक्षों विशंसनः। अधः शिराः पुयवहो रुधिरान्धस्तथंव च) १४७
verses.wordMeaning: They are not affected by mutually clashing opposites (like happiness and sorrow etc.). They are devoid of the three Bhav.as (states of existence, i.e. birth, growth and decay). They possess majestic lustre.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are not affected by mutually clashing opposites (like happiness and sorrow etc.). They are devoid of the three Bhav.as (states of existence, i.e. birth, growth and decay). They possess majestic lustre.…

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णे चैव ततः काल इह मानुष्यतां गतः । चतुर्वेदो द्विजो राजञ्जायते विमले कुले
verses.transliteration: pūrṇe caiva tataḥ kāla iha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ / caturvedo dvijo rājañjāyate vimale kule
verses.translation: They are endowed with majestic lustre, victory, AiSvarya (divine faculties of omnipotence etc.), Slhiti (continuous exis¬ tence), Vairdgya (non-attachment), Dartana (vision) on par with Brahma. Cf. Brahma Sutra 1V.4.17-21 which state that the Liberated Soul has all the powers of Brahma except that of creation of the world.
verses.hindi: तमश्न कृष्णसूत्रश्न लोहश्चाप्यसिजस्तथा । अप्रतिष्ठो5्थ वीच्यश्वनरका होवसादय: तामसा नरकाः सर्वे यमस्य विषये स्थिताः । येषु दुष्क्ृतकर्माण: पतन्तीह पृथक्पृथक्..
verses.wordMeaning: They are endowed with majestic lustre, victory, AiSvarya (divine faculties of omnipotence etc.), Slhiti (continuous exis¬ tence), Vairdgya (non-attachment), Dartana (vision) on par with Brahma. Cf.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are endowed with majestic lustre, victory, AiSvarya (divine faculties of omnipotence etc.), Slhiti (continuous exis¬ tence), Vairdgya (non-attachment), Dartana (vision) on par with Brahma. Cf.…

verses.sanskrit: धनधान्यचयोपेतः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः । व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम्
verses.transliteration: dhanadhānyacayopetaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ / vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam
verses.translation: Thus Devas and Sages partake of, i.e. worship the Sattra (the sacrificial session in the form of) Brahman. The Satlra (i.e. Brahman) is eternal ( sandtana ), immortal, resplen¬ dent, ever-existent, imperishable and immutable.
verses.hindi: मुमेरधस्तात्ते सर्वे रोरवाद्याः प्रकीतिताः । रौरबे क्टसाक्षी तु मिथ्या यश्चवाभिशंसति ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus Devas and Sages partake of, i.e. worship the Sattra (the sacrificial session in the form of) Brahman. The Satlra (i.e. Brahman) is eternal ( sandtana ), immortal, resplen¬ dent, ever-existent, imperishable and immutable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Devas and Sages partake of, i.e. worship the Sattra (the sacrificial session in the form of) Brahman. The Satlra (i.e. Brahman) is eternal ( sandtana ), immortal, resplen¬ dent, ever-existent, imperishable and immutable.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सावित्रीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २०१ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेन् महीपाल देवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धा महाभागा देवाः सेन्द्रा युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe sāvitrītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 201 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchen mahīpāla devatīrthamanuttamam / yatra siddhā mahābhāgā devāḥ sendrā yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: They are of sublimated sexuality. They traverse a path of no return. The purity they have attained by means of the practice of holy rites is supplemented by the knowledge of Vedantas.
verses.hindi: वहाँ वे सर्वेथा ब्रह्मा की उपासना में निरत रहते हैं । इस ब्रह्मलोक से अण्ड ( ब्रह्माण्ड ) के ऊपर भाग का परिमाण एक कोटि पचास नियुत योजन एवं निम्न भाग का परिमाण चार कोटि पैंसठ नियुत योजन कहा जाता है । हस अंश के अधो भाग में भव की स्थिति भौर उसी में नक्षत्र ग्रहादिकों का विचरण होता है ऊपरी भागों में किसी को भी गति नहीं सुनी जाती है। मैंने जिस प्रकार सुना था उसी प्रकार योजनों द्वारा उषयु क्त लोकों को दूरी आदि का वर्णन भ्रवलोक से ऊपर स्थित आप लोगों के सम्मुख कर चका । अब इसके उपरान्त अधोगति को प्राप्त होनेवाले जीवों के निवास स्थलों का वर्णन कर रहा हूं, जहाँ पर घोर पाप कर्म करनेवाले पापात्मा' अपने कर्मों के अनुसार गमन करते. हैं ।१४२-१४५। रौरबव, रोध सूकर, ताल, तप्तकुम्भ, महा ज्वाल, शबल, विमोचन, कमी, कृमिभक्ष, लानाभक्ष, विशंसन, अध!शिरा, पयबह,
verses.wordMeaning: They are of sublimated sexuality. They traverse a path of no return. The purity they have attained by means of the practice of holy rites is supplemented by the knowledge of Vedantas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are of sublimated sexuality. They traverse a path of no return. The purity they have attained by means of the practice of holy rites is supplemented by the knowledge of Vedantas.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम् । तत्र तीर्थप्रभावेन कृतमानन्त्यमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam / tatra tīrthaprabhāvena kṛtamānantyamaśnute
verses.translation: There they engage themselves in the practice of Yogic union (with the Supreme Brahman). They worship the highest goal. They abandon their physical body which is the cause of all sins and proceed ahead to (the state of)immortality.
verses.hindi: रुघिरान्थ, वंतरण, कृष्ण, असिपत्रवन, अग्विज्वाल, महाधोर, संदेश, दवभोजन, तम, क्ृष्णसूत्र, लोह, असिज अप्रतिष्ठ, वीचि, अश्व आदि घोर अंधकार मय नरलोक हैं, जो यमराज के अधीन हैं । इन्हीं नरकों में दुष्कमी लोग पृथक् पृथक् पतित होते हैं । ये रौरवादि सभी नरक भूमि के निम्न भाग में अवस्थित कहे जाते हैं । जो कूट साक्षी है अर्थात झूठी गवाही देता है, सवंधा मिथ्या बोलने में
verses.wordMeaning: There they engage themselves in the practice of Yogic union (with the Supreme Brahman). They worship the highest goal. They abandon their physical body which is the cause of all sins and proceed ahead to (the state of)immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: There they engage themselves in the practice of Yogic union (with the Supreme Brahman). They worship the highest goal. They abandon their physical body which is the cause of all sins and proceed ahead to (the state of)immortality.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषाद्भाद्रपदे तु कृष्णपक्षे त्रयोदशीम् । प्रधानं सर्वतीर्थानां देवैरध्यासितं पुरा
verses.transliteration: viśeṣādbhādrapade tu kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśīm / pradhānaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ devairadhyāsitaṃ purā
verses.translation: They are devoid of passion. They have conquered anger. They are rid of delusion. They speak the truth invariably. They are quiescent. They are of dedicated souls endowed with mercy and sympathy. They have conquered the sense organs. They are devoid of attachment. They are pure. They are remembered as ones who have attained Sayujya (identity) with Brahman. They are the heroic souls who have burnt all their sins by means of acts of penance uncontaminated by desires. Theirs are those worlds from which there is no falling off. It is remembered that the pleasure therein is immeasurable.
verses.hindi: निरत रहता है, एक पक्ष का किसी कारण वद्य समर्थन करता है वह असत्यभाषी मनुष्य घोर रोश्व मरक में गरिरता है ।१४६-१५१। गोहत्या करनेवाला, गर्भ की हत्या करनेघाला, किसी ग्रामादि में आग + अन्राध्यायसमप्ति: ख. पुस्तके । » घनुश्चिह्वास्तगंतग्रश्यों ग. पुस्तके बास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: They are devoid of passion. They have conquered anger. They are rid of delusion. They speak the truth invariably. They are quiescent. They are of dedicated souls endowed with mercy and sympathy. They have conquered the sense organs. They are devoid of attachment. They are pure.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are devoid of passion. They have conquered anger. They are rid of delusion. They speak the truth invariably. They are quiescent. They are of dedicated souls endowed with mercy and sympathy. They have conquered the sense organs. They are devoid of attachment. They are pure.…

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा त्रयोदशीदिने श्राद्धं कृत्वा विधानतः । देवैः संस्थापितं देवं सम्पूज्य वृषभध्वजम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: snātvā trayodaśīdine śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ / devaiḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ devaṃ sampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam / sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: This is the immortal region of Brahman. It is superbly resplendent in the most exalted firmament. After attaining it along with Brahma, Devas cease to be worried and sorrowful (i.e. attain Liberation—Moksa).
verses.wordMeaning: This is the immortal region of Brahman. It is superbly resplendent in the most exalted firmament. After attaining it along with Brahma, Devas cease to be worried and sorrowful (i.e. attain Liberation—Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the immortal region of Brahman. It is superbly resplendent in the most exalted firmament. After attaining it along with Brahma, Devas cease to be worried and sorrowful (i.e. attain Liberation—Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे देवतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोत्तरद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २०२ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्यैवानन्तरं चान्यच्छिखितीर्थमनुत्तमम् । प्रधानं सर्वतीर्थानां पञ्चायतनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 202 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ cānyacchikhitīrthamanuttamam / pradhānaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pañcāyatanamuttamam
verses.translation: O excellent one, whence is this Parardha (Infinite, Infinity)? What is this called Para (the greatest)? We wish to know this. Please speak.
verses.hindi: रोधे गोध्नो भ्रूणहा च अग्निदाता पुरस्य चर । सुकरे ब्रह्महा मज्जेत्सुरापः स्वर्णतस्करः:. ताले पतेक्क्षत्रियहा हत्वा बैश्यं च दुर्गतिम् । ब्रह्मह॒त्यां च यः कुयच्िश्व स्थादग्ुरतल्पपः.
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one, whence is this Parardha (Infinite, Infinity)? What is this called Para (the greatest)? We wish to know this. Please speak.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one, whence is this Parardha (Infinite, Infinity)? What is this called Para (the greatest)? We wish to know this. Please speak.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तपस्तप्त्वा शिखार्थं हव्यवाहनः । शिखां प्राप्य शिखी भूत्वा शिखाख्यं स्थापयञ्छिवम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā śikhārthaṃ havyavāhanaḥ / śikhāṃ prāpya śikhī bhūtvā śikhākhyaṃ sthāpayañchivam
verses.translation: Listen from me the definition of Parardha 1 and
verses.hindi: साध्वीविक्रयकर्ता च वस्तु भक्त परित्यजेत् । महाज्वाले दुहितरं स्नुषां गच्छति यस्तु व ४११५५
verses.wordMeaning: Listen from me the definition of Parardha 1 and
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen from me the definition of Parardha 1 and

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपच्छुक्लपक्षे या भवेदाश्वयुजे नृप । तदा तीर्थवरे गत्वा स्नात्वा वै नर्मदाजले
verses.transliteration: pratipacchuklapakṣe yā bhavedāśvayuje nṛpa / tadā tīrthavare gatvā snātvā vai narmadājale
verses.translation: Learned men call a thousand crores a Kharua and ten times a Kharua make a jVikharva.
verses.hindi: दुरिष्तं कुरुते यस्तु कौठलोहूं प्रपद्यते । ( देवब्नाह्मणविद्वेष्ठा गुरूर्णा चाप्यपुजकः ॥ पर्यश्नाति य एको5न्यो ब्राह्मणीं सुहृदः सताम् ) । लालाभक्षे स पतति दुर्गन्‍्धे नरके गतः.
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men call a thousand crores a Kharua and ten times a Kharua make a jVikharva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men call a thousand crores a Kharua and ten times a Kharua make a jVikharva.

verses.sanskrit: देवान् ऋषीन् पित्ःंश्चान्यांस् तर्पयेत् तिलवारिणा । हिरण्यं ब्राह्मणे दद्यात् संतर्प्य च हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: devān ṛṣīn pitḥṃścānyāṃs tarpayet tilavāriṇā / hiraṇyaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyāt saṃtarpya ca hutāśanam
verses.translation: A huudred thousand Kofis make (what is called) Sanku. People who know numbers (and calculation) say that a thous¬ and times thousand Kofis multiplied by ten make a Samudra (i.e. Jaladhi). Ten thousand times a thousand Kotis is called Madhya. A hundred thousand times a thousand Kofis is termed Anta (Antya).
verses.hindi: लगाने वाला पापी मनुष्य रोध नामक नरक में गिरता है । जो ब्राह्मण की ह॒त्या करता है, सुरापान करता है, सुवर्ण को चोरी करता है, वह पापात्मा सूकर नामक नरक में पतित होता है । जो किसी क्षत्रिय की हत्या करता है, अथवा किसी ब्राह्मण या वैश्य की हत्या करता है, गुरु की शय्या ( स्त्री के साथ ) पर गमन करता है, वह पापों मनुष्य घोर ताल नामक नरक में निपतित होंता है। जो पापात्मा बहिन के साथ
verses.wordMeaning: A huudred thousand Kofis make (what is called) Sanku. People who know numbers (and calculation) say that a thous¬ and times thousand Kofis multiplied by ten make a Samudra (i.e. Jaladhi). Ten thousand times a thousand Kotis is called Madhya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A huudred thousand Kofis make (what is called) Sanku. People who know numbers (and calculation) say that a thous¬ and times thousand Kofis multiplied by ten make a Samudra (i.e. Jaladhi). Ten thousand times a thousand Kotis is called Madhya.…

verses.sanskrit: गन्धमाल्यैस् तथा धूपैस् ततः सम्पूजयेच्छिवम् । अनेन विधिनाभ्यर्च्य शिखितीर्थे महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: gandhamālyais tathā dhūpais tataḥ sampūjayecchivam / anena vidhinābhyarcya śikhitīrthe maheśvaram
verses.translation: A thousand crores multiplied by a crore iscalled Parardha. Learned men call twice a Parardha, a Para (great).
verses.hindi: व्यभिचार करता है, राजा की हत्या करता है वह तप्तकुम्भ नामक नरक लोक में निवास करता है। दुबरे के अश्व को चुराकर विक्रय करनेबाला तथा अन्याय पूर्वक किसी को बाँघने ( फेंसाने ) वाला पापी पुरुष तप्तलोह यामक नरक में निवास करता है। जो अपनी पतिन्नता स्त्री को बेचता है, तथा अपने अनुगामी भक्त को छोड़ देता है, अपनी पुत्री अथवा पुत्रवध् के साथ समागम करता है, वह पापात्मा मनुष्य महाज्वाल नामक नरक में पतिज्ञ होता है ।१५२-६५४५। जो वेदों का विक्रय करता है, अथवा वेद को निन्‍दा करता है, अपने गुरुजनों का अपमान करता है, उन्हें गाली देता है या मारता पीटता है, अथवा अगम्य स्थलों में ( पुत्री; पुत्रवध, भगिनी, गु्पत्नी आदि के साथ ) ममन करता है, वह पापात्मा शबल नामक भोर नरक में गिरता है। जो परद्रव्यापहारी पापात्मा किसी की मर्यादा ( प्राचीर, चहारदिवारी आदि ) में भेदत
verses.wordMeaning: A thousand crores multiplied by a crore iscalled Parardha. Learned men call twice a Parardha, a Para (great).
verses.commentary: Sense: A thousand crores multiplied by a crore iscalled Parardha. Learned men call twice a Parardha, a Para (great).

verses.sanskrit: विमानेनार्कवर्णेन ह्यप्सरोगणसंवृतः । गीयमानस्तु गन्धर्वैर् रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: vimānenārkavarṇena hyapsarogaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ / gīyamānastu gandharvair rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: The number hundred they say is Paridrdha ( Pari -. vrdha in Bd.P.). A thousand is Paripadmaka. Thereafter the other numbers (each number is multiplied by ten to get the next number) are Ayuta, jViyuta, Prayula, Arbuda, Nirbuda, Kharbuda, Kharua, Nikharva, Saiiku, Padma, Samudra, (Antya), Madhyama, Parardha and Para. In calculation these are the eighteen digits.
verses.hindi: करता है, वह विमोह नामक नरक में पतित होता है। जो किसी का अनिष्ट साधन करता है वह कीट लोह नामक नरक में निवास करता है । देवता और ब्राह्मण के साथ जो पापात्मा विद्वेष करता है, गुरुजनों कौ पूजा नहीं करता, तथा रत्न को दृषित करता है, वह कृमिभक्ष्य नामक घोणश नरक में, पहुंचता है ।१५६-१५८। जो पापात्मा किसी ब्राह्मणी, मित्रादि एवं कत्या के सामने उपस्थित रहने पर भी
verses.wordMeaning: The number hundred they say is Paridrdha ( Pari -. vrdha in Bd.P.). A thousand is Paripadmaka. Thereafter the other numbers (each number is multiplied by ten to get the next number) are Ayuta, jViyuta, Prayula, Arbuda, Nirbuda, Kharbuda, Kharua, Nikharva, Saiiku, Padma,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The number hundred they say is Paridrdha ( Pari -. vrdha in Bd.P.). A thousand is Paripadmaka. Thereafter the other numbers (each number is multiplied by ten to get the next number) are Ayuta, jViyuta, Prayula, Arbuda, Nirbuda, Kharbuda, Kharua, Nikharva, Saiiku, Padma,…

verses.sanskrit: शत्रुक्षयमवाप्नोति तेजस्वी जायते भुवि
verses.transliteration: śatrukṣayamavāpnoti tejasvī jāyate bhuvi
verses.translation: These are the terms given by sages. A Parardha (? yeais) from the beginning of creation constitutes a Kalpa (?) of Brahma (only a day). A period extending as much also remains, at the end of which there is Pratisarga. Thus Para and Parardha have been (calculated) explained by me.
verses.hindi: घनुश्चिह्नान्तगंतग्रन्थ: ख. पुस्तके नास्ति । काण्डकर्ता कुलालश्र निष्कहर्ता चिकित्सक: । आरामेष्बग्निदाता यः पतते स विशंसने
verses.wordMeaning: These are the terms given by sages. A Parardha (? yeais) from the beginning of creation constitutes a Kalpa (?) of Brahma (only a day). A period extending as much also remains, at the end of which there is Pratisarga. Thus Para and Parardha have been (calculated) explained by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the terms given by sages. A Parardha (? yeais) from the beginning of creation constitutes a Kalpa (?) of Brahma (only a day). A period extending as much also remains, at the end of which there is Pratisarga. Thus Para and Parardha have been (calculated) explained by me.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शिखितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्व्यधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २०३ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततो गच्छेद्धराधीश कोटितीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यत्र सिद्धा महाभागाः कोटिसंख्या महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śikhitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 203 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gaccheddharādhīśa koṭitīrthamanuttamam / yatra siddhā mahābhāgāḥ koṭisaṃkhyā maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: As Brahma's prowess is the greatest, his longevity the highest, (his power of) penance,strength, piety (or Dliarma), learning, fortitude, knowledge, realization of Brahman and faculties such as omnipotence ( aiivarya ) etc. are of the highest magnitude, there is no living being who is greater than Brahma. He is established in the highest position, so he is the greatest of all objects.
verses.hindi: क्षोरं सुरां च मांस च लाक्षां गन्धं रसं तिलान्। एक्मादीनि विक्रोणस्घोरे पृयवहे पतेतु.
verses.wordMeaning: As Brahma's prowess is the greatest, his longevity the highest, (his power of) penance,strength, piety (or Dliarma), learning, fortitude, knowledge, realization of Brahman and faculties such as omnipotence ( aiivarya ) etc. are of the highest magnitude,…
verses.commentary: Sense: As Brahma's prowess is the greatest, his longevity the highest, (his power of) penance,strength, piety (or Dliarma), learning, fortitude, knowledge, realization of Brahman and faculties such as omnipotence ( aiivarya ) etc. are of the highest magnitude,…

verses.sanskrit: तपः कृत्वा सुविपुलमृषिभिः स्थापितः शिवः । तथा कोटीश्वरी देवी चामुण्डा महिषार्दिनी
verses.transliteration: tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulamṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitaḥ śivaḥ / tathā koṭīśvarī devī cāmuṇḍā mahiṣārdinī
verses.translation: The countable yet ever uncountable is the trinity-
verses.hindi: यः कुक्कुटानि बध्नाति सार्जारान्सुकरांश्र तानू  पक्षिणश्व मृगांश्छागान्सोध्प्येनं नरक ब्रजेत् अजाविको माहिषकस्तथा चक़ध्वजी च यः । रड्भरोपजीविको विप्र: शाकुनिप्रमियाचक:.
verses.wordMeaning: The countable yet ever uncountable is the trinity-
verses.commentary: Sense: The countable yet ever uncountable is the trinity-

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां मासि भाद्रपदे नृप । तीर्थकोटीः समाहूय मुनिभिः स्थापितः शिवः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade nṛpa / tīrthakoṭīḥ samāhūya munibhiḥ sthāpitaḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: When the mass is seen there is no specific number. It is the characteristic of countless ness. If we say as many as sand particles it means infinite. These are the five characteri¬ stics (?).
verses.hindi: विशस्ता महिषादीनां भृगहन्ता तथेव च्  पर्वकारश्थ सूची च॒ यश्वच स्पान्सित्रधातक: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: When the mass is seen there is no specific number. It is the characteristic of countless ness. If we say as many as sand particles it means infinite. These are the five characteri¬ stics (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the mass is seen there is no specific number. It is the characteristic of countless ness. If we say as many as sand particles it means infinite. These are the five characteri¬ stics (?).

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां तिथौ च हस्तर्क्षं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । तत्र तीर्थे तदा गत्वा स्नानं कृत्वा समाहितः
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ tithau ca hastarkṣaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / tatra tīrthe tadā gatvā snānaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: That can be calculated by Isvaras of divine vision be¬ cause of their purity. Since he is established in perfect know¬ ledge, Brahma sees every tiling.
verses.hindi: उपविष्टमेकपडकत्यां विषम भोजयन्ति ये । पतन्ति तरके घोरे विडभुजे नाञ्न संशयः उन्हें न देकर अकेला भोजन करता है वह अतिशय दुर्गग्धमय लालाभक्ष नामक घोर नरक में निपतित होता है। जो पापात्मा काण्डकर्त्ता होते हैं, शराब बनाते हैं, दूसरों का निष्क चुराते हें, अच्छी औषधि जानते हुए भी द्वेघषवद्ा या लालच से बुरी दवा करते है, किसी के बाग अथवा उपवनादि में आग लगाते हैं वे विशंसन नामक घोर नरक में गिरते है ।जों असत् कर्मों द्वारा धन उपाजित करता है अथवा नीच
verses.wordMeaning: That can be calculated by Isvaras of divine vision be¬ cause of their purity. Since he is established in perfect know¬ ledge, Brahma sees every tiling.
verses.commentary: Sense: That can be calculated by Isvaras of divine vision be¬ cause of their purity. Since he is established in perfect know¬ ledge, Brahma sees every tiling.

verses.sanskrit: नरकाद् उद्धरत्य् आशु पुरुषानेकविंशतिम् । तिलोदकप्रदानेन किमुत श्राद्धदो नरः
verses.transliteration: narakād uddharaty āśu puruṣānekaviṃśatim / tilodakapradānena kimuta śrāddhado naraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing this, all the sages residing in Naimisa forest had their eyes bedimmed with tears (of joy). Their (voice) was choked up due to delight.
verses.hindi: प्रवत्तिवालों का दान ग्रहण करता है, जिन्हें यज्ञादि का अधिकार नहीं है, उनसे यज्ञादि का अनुष्ठान करवाता है, नक्षत्रों से अपनी जीविका चलाता है, वह पापात्मा अघोसुद्ध नामक नरक में जाता है। दूध, मदिरा, मांस, लाक्षा, सुगन्धित पदार्थ तेल इतञ्रादि, रस एवं तिल आदि बस्तुओं का विक्रेता घोर पूयवह नामक नरक में गिरता है ।१५९-१६२। जो मुर्ग को मारता है; बिल्ली और'सुअर का बध करता है,
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this, all the sages residing in Naimisa forest had their eyes bedimmed with tears (of joy). Their (voice) was choked up due to delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this, all the sages residing in Naimisa forest had their eyes bedimmed with tears (of joy). Their (voice) was choked up due to delight.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम् । तस्य तीर्थस्य योगेन सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam / tasya tīrthasya yogena sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Those expounders of Brahman asked Matarisvan (the Wind-god): "O holy lord, we wish to hear precisely how far is Brahmaloka in so many Yojanas. What is the magnitude of Yojana and Krosa?"
verses.hindi: पक्षियों, मगों, एवं बकरों को मारता है, वह पापात्मा प्राणी भी उसी पूथवह नामक नरक में जाता है। जो ब्राह्मण होकर भी बकरी, बकरे, भेड़, महिष आदि का पालन करता है, चक्र एवं ध्वजा ग्रहण करता है, रंगों की विक्री से जीविका चलाता है, पक्षी मारता है, ग्रामों में इधर उधर झूठमूठ का यज्ञ करता फिरता है, किसी के घर में आग लगाता है, विष देता है, कुण्डों के ( संकरवर्णवालों के ) घर भोजन करता है, सौमरस विक्रय करता है, मदिरा पीता है, माँस भक्षण करता है, पशुओं की हिंसा करता है, महिषादि का बलिदान करता है, मृगादि वन्य जन्तुओं का शिकार करता है, गाँठ बनाता है, सूचीकर् ( सिलाई ) करता है, मित्रों की हत्या करता है, वह रुधिराग्ध नामक घोर नरक में गिरता है--ऐसा मनीषियों का कथन है ।१६३-१६६। जो एक ही पंक्ति में बैठाये गये व्यक्तियों को भोजन कराने में भेद करते हैं, वे पापात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: Those expounders of Brahman asked Matarisvan (the Wind-god): "O holy lord, we wish to hear precisely how far is Brahmaloka in so many Yojanas. What is the magnitude of Yojana and Krosa?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Those expounders of Brahman asked Matarisvan (the Wind-god): "O holy lord, we wish to hear precisely how far is Brahmaloka in so many Yojanas. What is the magnitude of Yojana and Krosa?"

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कोटितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्र्युत्तरद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २०४ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: भृगुतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् तीर्थराजमनुत्तमम् । पैतामहं महापुण्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryuttaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 204 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: bhṛgutīrthaṃ tato gacchet tīrtharājamanuttamam / paitāmahaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam
verses.translation: On hearing their words, Matarisvan (Vayu) of hum¬ ble speech spoke as follows in sweet words, in the proper order and in the same manner as was seen (by him).
verses.hindi: १०१० वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their words, Matarisvan (Vayu) of hum¬ ble speech spoke as follows in sweet words, in the proper order and in the same manner as was seen (by him).
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, Matarisvan (Vayu) of hum¬ ble speech spoke as follows in sweet words, in the proper order and in the same manner as was seen (by him).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा तत्र तीर्थे तु पुरा वर्षशतत्रयम् । आराधनं कृतं शम्भोः कस्मिंश्चित् कारणान्तरे
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā tatra tīrthe tu purā varṣaśatatrayam / ārādhanaṃ kṛtaṃ śambhoḥ kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare
verses.translation: I shall recount this to you. Listen to what I intend to say. The Vyakla Bhaga (that which is manifest) is grosser than Avyakta.
verses.hindi: मृषावादी नरो यश्व तथा चक्रोशकोइशुभः । पतति नरके घोरे मृत्राकीणं स पापक्ृत् १६८ मधुग्राहाभिहन्तारो यान्ति वेतरणीं नराः । उन्मत्ताश्वित्तभग्नाश्न शौचाचारघिवर्जिता: क्रोधना दुःखदाश्वेव कुहकाःकष्टगामितः । असिपनत्रवने छेंदी तथा झोरज्िकाश्व ये ॥
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount this to you. Listen to what I intend to say. The Vyakla Bhaga (that which is manifest) is grosser than Avyakta.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount this to you. Listen to what I intend to say. The Vyakla Bhaga (that which is manifest) is grosser than Avyakta.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: किमर्थं मुनिशार्दूल ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । आराधयद् देवदेवं महाभक्त्या महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kimarthaṃ muniśārdūla brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / ārādhayad devadevaṃ mahābhaktyā maheśvaram
verses.translation: There are ten parts of Mahat. The gross part is called Bhutaai (Ahamkarci or the Cosmic Ego). The magnitude of Paramdnu (an atom) is little more than the tenth part of Bhutadi (?)
verses.hindi: आश्रमप्रत्यवसिता अग्निज्वाले पतन्ति वे। भोज्यम्ते श्यामशवले रयस्तुण्डेश्व वायसेः
verses.wordMeaning: There are ten parts of Mahat. The gross part is called Bhutaai (Ahamkarci or the Cosmic Ego). The magnitude of Paramdnu (an atom) is little more than the tenth part of Bhutadi (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: There are ten parts of Mahat. The gross part is called Bhutaai (Ahamkarci or the Cosmic Ego). The magnitude of Paramdnu (an atom) is little more than the tenth part of Bhutadi (?)

verses.sanskrit: आराध्यः सर्वभूतानां जगद्भर्ता जगद्गुरुः । श्रोतव्यं श्रोतुम् इच्छामि महदाश्चर्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ārādhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jagadbhartā jagadguruḥ / śrotavyaṃ śrotum icchāmi mahadāścaryamuttamam
verses.translation: A Paramdnu is very subtle. It cannot he seen by the (naked) eye. It can be imagined; what cannot be (ultimately) split in the world should be known as Paramdnu.
verses.hindi: इज्याब्रतसमालोपात्संदंशे नरके पतेत् । स्कर्दते यदि वा स्वप्ने ब्रतिनो ब्रह्मचारिणः १७२ पुश्रेरध्यापिता ये च पुत्नेराज्ञापिताश्व ये । ते सर्वे नरके यान्ति नियतं तु श्वभोजने १७३ वर्णाश्रमविरुद्धाभिक्रोधहर्षसमन्विता: । कर्मामंणि ये तु कुबन्ति सर्वे निरयगामिनः (ण). ४१७४
verses.wordMeaning: A Paramdnu is very subtle. It cannot he seen by the (naked) eye. It can be imagined; what cannot be (ultimately) split in the world should be known as Paramdnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Paramdnu is very subtle. It cannot he seen by the (naked) eye. It can be imagined; what cannot be (ultimately) split in the world should be known as Paramdnu.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मपुत्रवचः श्रुत्वा मार्कण्डेयो मुनीश्वरः । कथयामास तद्वृत्तमितिहासं पुरातनम्
verses.transliteration: dharmaputravacaḥ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyo munīśvaraḥ / kathayāmāsa tadvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam
verses.translation: When the Sun's rays enter through the window, the subtlest dust particle that is seen is called Paramdnu It is the first among the units of magnitude. It is called Paramdnu.
verses.hindi: घोर विड्भुज नामक नरक में गिरते हें--इसमें सन्देह नहीं। जो मिथ्यावादी मनुष्य होता है तथा णो सबंथा दूसरे को अभिशाप अथवा गाली गलौज दिया करता है, अमांगलिक कार्यों में निरत रहता है, वह पापात्मा मूत्राकीणं नामक नरक में निवास करता है, जो पापात्मा मधुदान करने वाले को मारते हैं, अर्थात् अपने प्रति शुभ कम करनेवाले को भी मार डालते है, वे बंतरणी में जाते है। जो उन्मत्त है,
verses.wordMeaning: When the Sun's rays enter through the window, the subtlest dust particle that is seen is called Paramdnu It is the first among the units of magnitude. It is called Paramdnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Sun's rays enter through the window, the subtlest dust particle that is seen is called Paramdnu It is the first among the units of magnitude. It is called Paramdnu.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: स्वपुत्रिकामभिगन्तुमिच्छन्पूर्वं पितामहः । शप्तस्तु देवदेवेन कोपाविष्टेन सत्तम
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: svaputrikāmabhigantumicchanpūrvaṃ pitāmahaḥ / śaptastu devadevena kopāviṣṭena sattama
verses.translation: When there is an aggregate of eight Paramdnus it is called Trasarenu or Padmarajas (pollen-dust of a lotus).
verses.hindi: जिनका चित्त विकृत एवं मस्तिष्क ठिकाने नहों रहता, पवित्रता एवं आचार से स्रो विहौन रहते हैं, भकारण फ्रोध करते हैं, दूसरों को सदा दुःख दिया करते हैं, जादू या इन्द्रजालादि से दुसरे को अपने वश में रखकर उनके साथ अत्याचार करते हैं, वे पापात्मा असिपत्रवत नामक घोर नरक में परम दारुण स्वभाववाले हिंस जस्तुओं द्वारा काट काट कर इधर उधर खींचे जाते हैं, दूसरों के शिर काटने वाले वापात्माओं की भी यही दशा होती है ।१६७-१७०। ब्रह्मचर्यादि आश्रमों को मर्यादा को भ्रष्टकरने वाले पापात्मा अग्निज्वाल नामक घोर नरक में पतित होते हैं, वहाँ पर लौहमय चोंच वाले इयाम एवं चितकबरे रंग के काग उनका शरीर नोंच-सोंच कर भक्षण करते हैं, यज्ञादि सत्कमं, ब्रतादि सदाचारों से विहीन होने पर पापात्मा प्राणी संदंश नामक नरक में बिरता है। जो ब्रती अथवा ब्रह्मवारी स्वप्तावस्था में भी स्ललित
verses.wordMeaning: When there is an aggregate of eight Paramdnus it is called Trasarenu or Padmarajas (pollen-dust of a lotus).
verses.commentary: Sense: When there is an aggregate of eight Paramdnus it is called Trasarenu or Padmarajas (pollen-dust of a lotus).

verses.sanskrit: वेदास्तव विनश्यन्ति ज्ञानं च कमलासन । अपूज्यः सर्वलोकानां भविष्यसि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: vedāstava vinaśyanti jñānaṃ ca kamalāsana / apūjyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Twelve /%a/a-joints make a Vitasti and twentyone ii/a-joints make a Ratni (a cubit—the distance between the elbow and the closed fist).
verses.hindi: हो जाते हैं, अथवा जो मनुष्य अपने पुत्रों द्वारा अध्ययन करते हैं, अथवा पुत्रों द्वारा अनुशासित होकर जीवन यापन करते हैं, वे सब भी श्वभोजन नामक घोर नरक में निवास फरते हैं। वर्णाश्रम की मर्यादा से विरहिंत अनायास क्रोध हर्षादि में आविष्ट होकर जो लोग बिना विचारे अदुसद् कार्य किया करते हैं, वे भी निरय (नरक) गामी होते हैं ।(७१-६७४। उपयुक्त रौरव नरक महान् विस्तृत एवं घोर है, ऊपर से शीतल
verses.wordMeaning: Twelve /%a/a-joints make a Vitasti and twentyone ii/a-joints make a Ratni (a cubit—the distance between the elbow and the closed fist).
verses.commentary: Sense: Twelve /%a/a-joints make a Vitasti and twentyone ii/a-joints make a Ratni (a cubit—the distance between the elbow and the closed fist).

verses.sanskrit: एवं दत्ते ततः शापे ब्रह्मा खेदावृतस्तदा । रेवाया उत्तरे कूले स्नात्वा वर्षशतत्रयम् । तोषयामास देवेशं तुष्टः प्रोवाच शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ datte tataḥ śāpe brahmā khedāvṛtastadā / revāyā uttare kūle snātvā varṣaśatatrayam / toṣayāmāsa deveśaṃ tuṣṭaḥ provāca śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Twentyfour Angulas form one Hasla (the distance bet¬ ween the elbow and the tip of the middle finger). Two Ratnis or fortytwo Angulas should be known as a Kisku.
verses.hindi: और भीतर से अति उष्ण है, उसके निम्न प्रदेश में पश्म शीतल तप ? तम नामक नरक कहा जाता है, इस एवमादिक़मेणेव वण्यंमानान्निबोधत । भुमेरधस्तात्सप्तेव नरकाः परिकीरतिता:
verses.wordMeaning: Twentyfour Angulas form one Hasla (the distance bet¬ ween the elbow and the tip of the middle finger). Two Ratnis or fortytwo Angulas should be known as a Kisku.
verses.commentary: Sense: Twentyfour Angulas form one Hasla (the distance bet¬ ween the elbow and the tip of the middle finger). Two Ratnis or fortytwo Angulas should be known as a Kisku.

verses.sanskrit: पूज्यस्त्वं भविता लोके प्राप्ते पर्वणि पर्वणि । अहमत्र च वत्स्यामि देवैश्च पितृभिः सह
verses.transliteration: pūjyastvaṃ bhavitā loke prāpte parvaṇi parvaṇi / ahamatra ca vatsyāmi devaiśca pitṛbhiḥ saha
verses.translation: Learned men say that ninetysix Angulas form one Dhanus (a bow). This Dhanus is a unit used in measuring Gavyuti (Explanation in verse 126).
verses.hindi: अधमंसूनवस्ते स्युरन्धतामित्नकादयः । रौरबवः प्रथमस्तेषां महारौरव एव च॑ १७७
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men say that ninetysix Angulas form one Dhanus (a bow). This Dhanus is a unit used in measuring Gavyuti (Explanation in verse 126).
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men say that ninetysix Angulas form one Dhanus (a bow). This Dhanus is a unit used in measuring Gavyuti (Explanation in verse 126).

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं ख्यातिं प्राप्तं पितामहात् । सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वतीर्थेष्वनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ khyātiṃ prāptaṃ pitāmahāt / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam
verses.translation: Dhanus, Dan<ja> Yuga and Nali —all these contain equal number of Angulas. Persons who know calculation say that three hundred Dhanus units make a Nalva.
verses.hindi: घोरत्वाद्ो रव:ः प्रोक्त: साम्भकों दहनः स्मृतः । सुदारुणस्तु शीतात्मा तस्याधस्तात्तमोइ्धमः सर्पो निक्ृन्तनः प्रोक्तः कालसुत्रेडतिदारुणः । अप्रतिष्ठे स्थितिर्नास्ति भ्रमस्तस्मिन्सुदारणः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Dhanus, Dan<ja> Yuga and Nali —all these contain equal number of Angulas. Persons who know calculation say that three hundred Dhanus units make a Nalva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhanus, Dan<ja> Yuga and Nali —all these contain equal number of Angulas. Persons who know calculation say that three hundred Dhanus units make a Nalva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भाद्रपदे मासि कृष्णपक्षे विशेषतः । अमावास्यां तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: tatra bhādrapade māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ / amāvāsyāṃ tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: It is taught that two thousand Dhanus units make one Gavyuti. Eight thousand Dhanus units make one Yojana.
verses.hindi: अवीचिर्दादणः प्रोक्तो यन्त्रसंपीडनाच्च सः । तस्मात्सुदारुणो लोहः करमंणां क्षयषणाच्च सः .
verses.wordMeaning: It is taught that two thousand Dhanus units make one Gavyuti. Eight thousand Dhanus units make one Yojana.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is taught that two thousand Dhanus units make one Gavyuti. Eight thousand Dhanus units make one Yojana.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डदानेन चैकेन तिलतोयेन वा नृप । तृप्यन्ति द्वादशाब्दानि पितरो नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: piṇḍadānena caikena tilatoyena vā nṛpa / tṛpyanti dvādaśābdāni pitaro nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The measurement of the distance of a Yojana is based on this unit of Dhanus. It should be known that a thousand of these Dhanus make the distance of a Sakra-Krosa (or a Krosa ).
verses.hindi: तथाभूते (त) शरोरत्वादविये (घथि)भ्यस्तु स स्पृतः। पीडबन्धवधासड्भादप्रतीकारलक्षण: ऊध्वे लोक: समावेतौ निरालोकाश्च ते स्मृता: । दुःखोत्कषंस्तु सर्वेषु अधमंस्प निमित्ततःक
verses.wordMeaning: The measurement of the distance of a Yojana is based on this unit of Dhanus. It should be known that a thousand of these Dhanus make the distance of a Sakra-Krosa (or a Krosa ).
verses.commentary: Sense: The measurement of the distance of a Yojana is based on this unit of Dhanus. It should be known that a thousand of these Dhanus make the distance of a Sakra-Krosa (or a Krosa ).

verses.sanskrit: कन्यागते तु यस्तत्र नित्यं श्राद्धप्रदो भवेत् । अवाप्य तृप्तिं तत्पूर्वे वल्गन्ति च हसन्ति च
verses.transliteration: kanyāgate tu yastatra nityaṃ śrāddhaprado bhavet / avāpya tṛptiṃ tatpūrve valganti ca hasanti ca
verses.translation: Calculation in Yojanas is made by those who are experts in the knowledge of numbers. Listen to the distance of Brahma- loka, in so many Yojanas. 1
verses.hindi: भूमितल के निम्नप्रदेश में सात नरक लोक बतलाये जाते हैं, उन्हें क्रमानुरूप सुनिये । उन अधर्म से उत्पन्न होने वाले नरकों का नाम अन्धतामिस्न आदि हैं। उनमें रौरब सर्व प्रथम एवं महान् दारुण कष्ट पूर्ण है, दूसरा महा रोरव नामक है, तीसरा उसका निम्नप्रदेश में परम शीतल एवं अति उष्ण नरक स्मरण किया जाता है उसका नाम कालसूत्र है, वह तीसरा नरक है। उसका अपर नाम महाह॒वि विधि भी बतलाया जाता है। चौथा
verses.wordMeaning: Calculation in Yojanas is made by those who are experts in the knowledge of numbers. Listen to the distance of Brahma- loka, in so many Yojanas. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Calculation in Yojanas is made by those who are experts in the knowledge of numbers. Listen to the distance of Brahma- loka, in so many Yojanas. 1

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषु पितृतीर्थेषु श्राद्धं कृत्वास्ति यत्फलम् । तत्फलं समवाप्नोति दर्शे तत्र न संशयः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣu pitṛtīrtheṣu śrāddhaṃ kṛtvāsti yatphalam / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti darśe tatra na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Divakara (Sun) is a hundred thousand Yojanas above the surface of the Earth. jVifokara (Moon) is a thousand Yojanas above the disc of the Sun.
verses.hindi: नरक अप्रतिष्ठ कहा जाता है, पाँचवा अवीची नामक नरक है। छठाँ लौह पृष्ठ नामक नरक है, सातवाँ अविधेय नाम से प्रस्यात है ।१७५-१७६। अतिशय घोर कष्ट प्रद होने के कारण प्रथम नरक का नाम रौरव पड़ा हैं। यह यद्यपि जलयुक्त है, पर परम ज्वलनात्मक है। उसके निम्नप्रदेश में परम शीतल, अति दारुण एवं अधम तम नामक नरक है ।१८०। कालसूत्र में डंसनेवाला सप॑ बतलाया जाता है-इसलिए वह परम दारुण है। अप्रतिष्ठ नरक में किसी प्रकार भी प्राणी ठहर नहीं सकता, क्योंकि उसमें अतिशय दारुण भंवरे उठती रहती हैं। यन्त्र द्वारा पीडित किया जाता है--इसी कारण से अवीचि नरक भी परम दारुण कहा जाता है। उससे भी दारुण लोपृष्ठ नामक है। उसमें जलकर मनुष्यों के समस्त कर्म विलीन हो जाते हैं, इसी कारण परम दारुण वह भी कहा जाता। सातवें अविधेय नामक नरक में तथाकथित अशरीरी रहने
verses.wordMeaning: Divakara (Sun) is a hundred thousand Yojanas above the surface of the Earth. jVifokara (Moon) is a thousand Yojanas above the disc of the Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Divakara (Sun) is a hundred thousand Yojanas above the surface of the Earth. jVifokara (Moon) is a thousand Yojanas above the disc of the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: पैतामहे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयन्पार्वतीपतिम् । मुच्यते नात्र सन्देहः पातकैश्चोपपातकैः
verses.transliteration: paitāmahe naraḥ snātvā pūjayanpārvatīpatim / mucyate nātra sandehaḥ pātakaiścopapātakaiḥ

verses.hindi: पर भी प्राणी को जिस बन्धन जबित पीड़ा एवं कष्ट को सहन करना पड़ता है वह परम अस्ह्य हो जाता है, उसके प्रतिकार का कोई उपाय नहीं दिखाता। ये चरक लोक सब के सब पवंतों के समान भीषणाकार एवं आलोक से सर्वदा विहीन कहें जाते हैं। अक्ष्म के कारण इन सत्रों में प्राणियों को असह्य
verses.wordMeaning: The entire stellar zone shines a full hundred thousand Yojanas above the Moon. Verses I28fif. give the distances from the earth to other planets and
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire stellar zone shines a full hundred thousand Yojanas above the Moon. Verses I28fif. give the distances from the earth to other planets and

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे मृतानां तु नराणां भावितात्मनाम् । अनिवर्तिका गती राजन्रुद्रलोकादसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām / anivartikā gatī rājanrudralokādasaṃśayam
verses.translation: The Mcru mountain is a hundred thousand Yojanas high. The distance between planets above the stellar zone is twice this (height) and they are one above the other
verses.hindi: धातना का अनुभव करना पड़ता है। इन सबों में दुःखों का प्राबल्य रहता है ।१5१०१८४॥ विशेषतया  अन् ख घ पुस्तकयोरधिकमर्ध वर्तते तद्यथा सुखोत्कर्ष: स्पृतः सर्वे घर्मेस्य हिं: निमित्तत।। तथा ड़ पुस्तकेषपि 'दुःखोत्कर्ष: स्मृतः सर्वे धर्मेस्य हि निमित्ततः  इति ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Mcru mountain is a hundred thousand Yojanas high. The distance between planets above the stellar zone is twice this (height) and they are one above the other
verses.commentary: Sense: The Mcru mountain is a hundred thousand Yojanas high. The distance between planets above the stellar zone is twice this (height) and they are one above the other

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पैतामहतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुरधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २०५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: गच्छेत् ततः क्षोणिनाथ तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । कुर्कुरीनाम विख्यातं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe paitāmahatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 205 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: gacchet tataḥ kṣoṇinātha tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / kurkurīnāma vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: Budha (Mercury) moves about beneath all stars and planets. Sukra (Venus) moves about above it. Above it is the
verses.hindi: १०१२ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Budha (Mercury) moves about beneath all stars and planets. Sukra (Venus) moves about above it. Above it is the
verses.commentary: Sense: Budha (Mercury) moves about beneath all stars and planets. Sukra (Venus) moves about above it. Above it is the

verses.sanskrit: यं यं प्रार्थयते कामं पशुपुत्रधनादिकम् । तं तं ददाति देवेशी कुर्कुरी तीर्थदेवता
verses.transliteration: yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ paśuputradhanādikam / taṃ taṃ dadāti deveśī kurkurī tīrthadevatā
verses.translation: Above it is Brhaspati (Jupiter) and above that is Sanaikara (Saturn). A hundred thousand Yojanas above Saturn shines the entire zone of the Seven Sages (Great Bear). A hundred thousand Yojanas above the Seven Sages shines Dhruva (Pole star), son of Utianapada. He is the main pivot of all stars in the heaven. He has the compact divine stellar aerial chariot.
verses.hindi: ऊध्वें लोके:ः समावेती निरालोकौ व ताबुभौ । कूठाड्भारप्रमाणेश्र शरीरी सूत्रनायकाः उपभोगसमर्थेस्तु सद्यो जायन्ति कर्म भिः। दुःखमकर्ष श्चो ग्रस्तु तेषु सर्वषु वे स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Above it is Brhaspati (Jupiter) and above that is Sanaikara (Saturn). A hundred thousand Yojanas above Saturn shines the entire zone of the Seven Sages (Great Bear). A hundred thousand Yojanas above the Seven Sages shines Dhruva (Pole star), son of Utianapada.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Above it is Brhaspati (Jupiter) and above that is Sanaikara (Saturn). A hundred thousand Yojanas above Saturn shines the entire zone of the Seven Sages (Great Bear). A hundred thousand Yojanas above the Seven Sages shines Dhruva (Pole star), son of Utianapada.…

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रपालो वसेत्तत्र ढौण्ढेशो नाम नामतः । तस्य चाराधनं कृत्वा नारी वा पुरुषो ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: kṣetrapālo vasettatra ḍhauṇḍheśo nāma nāmataḥ / tasya cārādhanaṃ kṛtvā nārī vā puruṣo 'pi vā
verses.translation: The height of the three worlds has been recounted by mein Yojanas. In the course of the Manvantaras, worldly Yajnas are performed for Devas by the people of different castes and stages of life. These Yajfias alone are conducive to the sustenance and stability of Devas.
verses.hindi: पातनाश्राप्यसंब्येया नारकार्णा तथा स्मृताः । तन्नानुभूय ते दुःखं क्षीणे कर्म णि वे पुनः १८७ तियग्योनौ प्रसुयस्ते कम शेषे गते ततः । देवाश्व नारकाश्रवेव उध्वें चाधश्र संस्थिताः ॥ै१८८ धर्माधमंनिभित्तेन सद्यो जायन्ति मूर्तयः । उपभोगार्थमुत्पत्तिरोपपत्तिककमं तः
verses.wordMeaning: The height of the three worlds has been recounted by mein Yojanas. In the course of the Manvantaras, worldly Yajnas are performed for Devas by the people of different castes and stages of life. These Yajfias alone are conducive to the sustenance and stability of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The height of the three worlds has been recounted by mein Yojanas. In the course of the Manvantaras, worldly Yajnas are performed for Devas by the people of different castes and stages of life. These Yajfias alone are conducive to the sustenance and stability of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: वन्दनादपि राजेन्द्र दौर्भाग्यं नाशमाप्नुयात् । अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो धनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vandanādapi rājendra daurbhāgyaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt / aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamuttamam
verses.translation: The set of the three worlds has been explained. Understand what is beyond this. Above Dhruvaloka is Maharloka wherein those people staying till the end of the Kalpa reside. It is ten million Yojanas from Dhruva— that is the conclusion (of wise men).
verses.hindi: पश्यन्ति नारकानदेव्ग ह्ाधोवकत्रान्ह्घोगतान् । नारकाश्व तथा देवान्सर्वान्पश्यन्त्यधोमुस्धान् अनग्रमुलता यस्माडारणाश्व स्वभावतः। तस्मादृध्वंमधोभावो लोकालोके न विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: The set of the three worlds has been explained. Understand what is beyond this. Above Dhruvaloka is Maharloka wherein those people staying till the end of the Kalpa reside. It is ten million Yojanas from Dhruva— that is the conclusion (of wise men).
verses.commentary: Sense: The set of the three worlds has been explained. Understand what is beyond this. Above Dhruvaloka is Maharloka wherein those people staying till the end of the Kalpa reside. It is ten million Yojanas from Dhruva— that is the conclusion (of wise men).

verses.sanskrit: नारी नरस्तथाप्येवं लभते काममुत्तमम् । स्पर्शनाद् दर्शनात् तस्य तीर्थस्य विधिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: nārī narastathāpyevaṃ labhate kāmamuttamam / sparśanād darśanāt tasya tīrthasya vidhipūrvakam
verses.translation: Janaloka is twenty million Yojanas from Maharloka. In it stay those Sadhakas (aspirants)—Daksa and others, the sons of Brahma. They live till the end of the Kalpa.
verses.hindi: एषा स्वाभाविकी संज्ञा लोकालोके प्रवर्तते । अथाब्रवच्पुनर्वायुं ब्राह्मणा: सत्रिणस्तवा
verses.wordMeaning: Janaloka is twenty million Yojanas from Maharloka. In it stay those Sadhakas (aspirants)—Daksa and others, the sons of Brahma. They live till the end of the Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Janaloka is twenty million Yojanas from Maharloka. In it stay those Sadhakas (aspirants)—Daksa and others, the sons of Brahma. They live till the end of the Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कुर्कुरीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २०६ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: गच्छेत्ततः क्षोणिनाथ तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं दशकन्येति विश्रुतम् । महादेवकृतं पुण्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kurkurītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ|| rkv adhyāya 206 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: gacchettataḥ kṣoṇinātha tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ daśakanyeti viśrutam / mahādevakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: It is remembered that Tapoloka is forty million Yojanas above Janaloka. It is here that the Vairaja groups of Devas stay. They are exempt from the effects of burning of all living beings in the destruction of the universe.
verses.hindi: सर्वेषासेव मुतानां लोकालोकनिवासिनाम् । संसारे संसराग्तीहयावन्तः प्राणिनश्र तन् १६९३ ऊपर के दो लोक अस्य लोकों के समान होते हुए भी परम दारण अन्घकार मय होते हैं। इन नरकों में विविध कष्ठों के अनुभव करने में सक्षम शरीर को पूर्वक्ृत कर्मों के अनुस्तार धारण कर बे पापात्मा दुःख भोगते हैं। सभी नरकों में दुःख की अधिकता बतलाई जाती है । नरक निवासियों को दी जानेवाली उन यातनाओं की संख्या अगणित है। वहाँ विविध प्रकार के दुःखों का अनुभव कर लेने के उपरान्त
verses.wordMeaning: It is remembered that Tapoloka is forty million Yojanas above Janaloka. It is here that the Vairaja groups of Devas stay. They are exempt from the effects of burning of all living beings in the destruction of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is remembered that Tapoloka is forty million Yojanas above Janaloka. It is here that the Vairaja groups of Devas stay. They are exempt from the effects of burning of all living beings in the destruction of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे महादेवो दशकन्या गुणान्विताः । ब्रह्मणो वरयामास ह्युद्वाहेन युयोज ह
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe mahādevo daśakanyā guṇānvitāḥ / brahmaṇo varayāmāsa hyudvāhena yuyoja ha
verses.translation: Sixty million Yojanas from Tapoloka is Satyaloka. It is called Brahmaloka of those who are devoid of death and desire and so who never return to the Sarhsdra therefrom.
verses.hindi: जब कर्मों का सबंधा नाश हो जाता है तब वे तियंक् योनियों में उत्पन्न होते हैं ।!५५-१८५७ ३। ऊपर रहने वाले समस्त देवताओं एवं निम्नप्रदेशों में रहते वाले नारकीय प्राणी ये सब अपने घ॒र्माधर्म के अनुसार शरीर धारण करते हैं इस उत्पत्ति के मूल उनके स्वयंक्ृत कर्म हैं, उनऔत्पत्तिक कर्मों के अनुसार फल भोगने के लिए ही वे शरीर घारण करते हैं। देवगण इन अधोभाग में अवस्थित नारकौय प्राणियों को अधोमुख हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty million Yojanas from Tapoloka is Satyaloka. It is called Brahmaloka of those who are devoid of death and desire and so who never return to the Sarhsdra therefrom.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty million Yojanas from Tapoloka is Satyaloka. It is called Brahmaloka of those who are devoid of death and desire and so who never return to the Sarhsdra therefrom.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं दशकन्येति विश्रुतम् । सर्वपापहरं पुण्यमक्षयं कीर्तितं फलम्
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ daśakanyeti viśrutam / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamakṣayaṃ kīrtitaṃ phalam
verses.translation: It is remembered (proclaimed) that the space above Brahmaloka upto the (upper crust of the) Cosmic Egg is a crore and fifty niyuta (a fifteen million) Yojanas.
verses.hindi: देखते हैं इसी प्रकार वे नारकीय भी समस्त देवताओं को अधोमुख देखते हैं। उन लोकों में अग्रभाग एवं मूलभाग का कोई भेद नहीं है, उनकी स्थिति यों ही स्वाभाविक है, इसी कारण से लोकालोक में कोई ऊपर अथवा निम्न का भेद भाव नहीं है। लोका-लोक की यह स्वाभाविक संज्ञा प्रचलित है वायु की इन बातों के सुनने के उपरास्त यज्ञकर्ता ब्राह्मणों ने पुनः पुछा ।!5८४-१९२। ऋषियाँ ने कहा--भगवन् वायु देव ! उस लोका-लोक में निवास करने वाले समस्त प्राणियों की जितने इस संसार में विचरण करते हैं उनकी संख्या क्‍या है, वे कोन हैं ये सब बातें सम्पृर्णतया मुझे बंतलायें । ऋषियों की इस जिज्ञास्ता को सुनकर मारुत बोले
verses.wordMeaning: It is remembered (proclaimed) that the space above Brahmaloka upto the (upper crust of the) Cosmic Egg is a crore and fifty niyuta (a fifteen million) Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is remembered (proclaimed) that the space above Brahmaloka upto the (upper crust of the) Cosmic Egg is a crore and fifty niyuta (a fifteen million) Yojanas.

verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dadāti samalaṃkṛtām / prāpnoti puruṣo dattvā yathāśaktyā svalaṃkṛtām
