verses.sanskrit: तेन दानोत्थपुण्येन पूतात्मानो नराधिप । वसन्ति रोमसंख्यानि वर्षाणि शिवसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: tena dānotthapuṇyena pūtātmāno narādhipa / vasanti romasaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi śivasannidhau
verses.translation: Now I shall mention the allotment of abodes to those living beings who deserve falling into hells due to their cruel actions.
verses.hindi: गणना बिनिवृत्तेषामानन्त्येन प्रकीतिता: द अनाव्यानादवेद्त्वान्नव प्रश्नो विधोयते  ब्रह्मणा संज्ञितं यत्तु संख्यया तन्निबोधत १६९७ यः सहख्रतमों भाग: स्थावराणां भवेदिह। पाथिवाः क्िमयस्तावत्संसेकाचेषु संभव: १६८ संसेकज्ञानाभावेन सहर््नेणेव संभिताः । औदका जन्तवः सर्वे निश्चयात्तद्विचारितम् १६६ सहख्रेणेव भावेन सत्त्वानां सलिलौकसाम् । घिहुंंगमास्तु विज्ञेया लौकिकास्ते च सर्वशः (२००
verses.wordMeaning: Now I shall mention the allotment of abodes to those living beings who deserve falling into hells due to their cruel actions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now I shall mention the allotment of abodes to those living beings who deserve falling into hells due to their cruel actions.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालेन महता त्विह लोके नरेश्वर । मानुष्यं प्राप्य दुष्प्राप्यं धनकोटीपतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālena mahatā tviha loke nareśvara / mānuṣyaṃ prāpya duṣprāpyaṃ dhanakoṭīpatirbhavet
verses.translation: The following are the hells*: Raurava, Rodha Sukara, Tala, Taptakumbha, Mahajvdla, Sabala, Vimocana, ICrmi, Krmibhaksa, Lalabhaksa, Visamsana, AdhahSiras, Pdyavaha, Rudhirandha, Vailarana, ICrsna, Asipalravana, Agnijvdla, Mahaghora, SathdamSc, Svabliojana, Tamas, Krsnasutra, Loha, Asija, Apratistha, Vicyaiva and others.
verses.hindi: यः सहस्नतमों भास्तेषां बे पक्षिणां भवेत् । पशवस्तत्समा ज्ञेया लौकिकास्तु चतुष्पदाः २० १ चतुष्पदानां सर्वेषां सहस्नेणेव संमता:  भागेन द्विपदा ज्ञेया लोकिके5स्मस्तु सर्वशः २०२ यः सहद्नतमों भागों भागे तु द्विपदां पुनः। धामिकास्तेन भामेन॑ विज्ञोयः संसिताः पुनः २०३
verses.wordMeaning: The following are the hells*: Raurava, Rodha Sukara, Tala, Taptakumbha, Mahajvdla, Sabala, Vimocana, ICrmi, Krmibhaksa, Lalabhaksa, Visamsana, AdhahSiras, Pdyavaha, Rudhirandha, Vailarana, ICrsna, Asipalravana, Agnijvdla, Mahaghora, SathdamSc, Svabliojana, Tamas, Krsnasutra,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the hells*: Raurava, Rodha Sukara, Tala, Taptakumbha, Mahajvdla, Sabala, Vimocana, ICrmi, Krmibhaksa, Lalabhaksa, Visamsana, AdhahSiras, Pdyavaha, Rudhirandha, Vailarana, ICrsna, Asipalravana, Agnijvdla, Mahaghora, SathdamSc, Svabliojana, Tamas, Krsnasutra,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या स्नात्वा विप्राय काञ्चनम् । सम्प्रयच्छति शान्ताय सो ऽत्यन्तं सुखम् अश्नुते
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā snātvā viprāya kāñcanam / samprayacchati śāntāya so 'tyantaṃ sukham aśnute
verses.translation: All these dark and gloomy hells are under the juris¬ diction of Varna. -Vfcn of evil deeds fall into these severally
verses.hindi: वायु बोले--ऋषिवृल्द ! उन समस्त प्राणियों की संख्या बलताना किसी प्रकार भी हमसे सम्भव नहीं है । उनका प्रवाह अनादि है, अनन्त है, वे इतने परस्पर सद्भीर्ण हैं कि केवल अनुमान या तके से विचार किया जा सकता है । उनकी गणना किसी प्रकार भी सम्भव नहीं है, वे अनन्त हैं--ऐसा ही उनके विषय में कहा जाता है। दिव्य दृष्टि अथवा परम ज्ञान ढारा भी उनकी निश्चित संल््या नहीं जानी जा सकती । अतः है नर श्रेष्ठ व॒न्द ! मैं उनकी निश्चित संख्या इस चर्म चक्षु से किस प्रकार बतला सकते हैं- जो अचिन्तनीय एवं स्बंथा अज्ञात है--ऐसे प्रइन को नहीं करना चाहिए। ब्रह्मा ने इस विषय में जो सामान्यतया जातिगत संख्याएँ निश्चित कौ हैं, उसे सुनिये। इस संसार में स्थावर जीवों का जो सहस्रतम भाग है संख्या में उतने ही पाथिकृमि हैं, जो संपेक आदि से
verses.wordMeaning: All these dark and gloomy hells are under the juris¬ diction of Varna. -Vfcn of evil deeds fall into these severally
verses.commentary: Sense: All these dark and gloomy hells are under the juris¬ diction of Varna. -Vfcn of evil deeds fall into these severally

verses.sanskrit: वाचिकं मानसं वापि कर्मजं यत्पुरा कृतम् । तत्सर्वं विलयं याति स्वर्णदानेन भारत
verses.transliteration: vācikaṃ mānasaṃ vāpi karmajaṃ yatpurā kṛtam / tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti svarṇadānena bhārata
verses.translation: All these hells Raurava etc. are reported to be beneath the Earth. A perjuror, a person taking up a side by making false statements and untruths falls into the hell Raurava of ruthless grasp.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न होते हैं। इन संसेकज जन्तुओं का सहद्रतम भाग जितना होता है, उतने समस्त जलीय जन्तु होते हैं, पह भलीभाँति निश्चित एवं सुविचारित मत है ।१६९५-१६६। इन जलनिवासी जन्तुओं का सहस्नतम भाग लोकिक विहद्भमों की संख्या के बराबर है। उन लौकिक विहज्भमों का सहत्रतम भाग जितना होता है उतना ही संख्या में समस्त चतृष्पद जीव होते हैं । उन समस्त चतुष्पदों का सहख्रतम भाग जितना होता है, उतने ही
verses.wordMeaning: All these hells Raurava etc. are reported to be beneath the Earth. A perjuror, a person taking up a side by making false statements and untruths falls into the hell Raurava of ruthless grasp.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these hells Raurava etc. are reported to be beneath the Earth. A perjuror, a person taking up a side by making false statements and untruths falls into the hell Raurava of ruthless grasp.

verses.sanskrit: नरो दत्त्वा सुवर्णं चापि वालाग्रमात्रकम् । तत्र तीर्थे दिवं याति मृतो नास्त्यत्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: naro dattvā suvarṇaṃ cāpi vālāgramātrakam / tatra tīrthe divaṃ yāti mṛto nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: A slayer of a cow, a destroyer of a foetus and one who commits arson in the city fall into the hell Rodha. A slayer of a Brahmana, a drink-addict and a stealer of gold fall into the hell Sukara. A slayer of a Ksatriya, of a Vaisya in miserable circumstances or of a Brahmana as well as a defiler of the preceptor's bed falls into the hell Tala.
verses.hindi: संख्या में द्विपद (मनुष्य) होते हैं। पुनः इन द्विपदों का जो सहखतम भाग होता है. उतने ही संख्या में सम्मान- नौय धार्मिक विचार वाले सत्पुरुष होते हैं। इन धामिकों का सहख्रतम भाग जितना होता हैं उतने स्वर्गीय १०१४ वायुपुराणम् - सहलेणेवभागेन घामिकेस्यों दिवं गताः। यः सहज्नतमों भागों धामिकाणां भवेदिवि ॥
verses.wordMeaning: A slayer of a cow, a destroyer of a foetus and one who commits arson in the city fall into the hell Rodha. A slayer of a Brahmana, a drink-addict and a stealer of gold fall into the hell Sukara. A slayer of a Ksatriya,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A slayer of a cow, a destroyer of a foetus and one who commits arson in the city fall into the hell Rodha. A slayer of a Brahmana, a drink-addict and a stealer of gold fall into the hell Sukara. A slayer of a Ksatriya,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र विद्याधरैः सिद्धैर्विमानवरमास्थितः । पूज्यमानो वसेत् तावद् यावद् आभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tatra vidyādharaiḥ siddhairvimānavaramāsthitaḥ / pūjyamāno vaset tāvad yāvad ābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: He who indulges in sexual intercourse with his sister and the soldier of a king (i.e. murderer of a king) fall into the hell Taptakumbha. A trader in (stolen) horses and protector of one who is kept in legal bondage fall into the hell Taplaloha.
verses.hindi: संमितास्तेन भागेन मोक्षिणस्तावदेव हि द . परणद वर्गों पपादकस्तुल्या यातनास्थानवासिनः । पतिताः पापकर्माणों दुरात्मानों चियन्ति ये॥. ह रौरबे तामसे होते शीतोष्णं प्राप्नुवन्ति ते .
verses.wordMeaning: He who indulges in sexual intercourse with his sister and the soldier of a king (i.e. murderer of a king) fall into the hell Taptakumbha. A trader in (stolen) horses and protector of one who is kept in legal bondage fall into the hell Taplaloha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who indulges in sexual intercourse with his sister and the soldier of a king (i.e. murderer of a king) fall into the hell Taptakumbha. A trader in (stolen) horses and protector of one who is kept in legal bondage fall into the hell Taplaloha.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे दशकन्यातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षडुत्तरद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २०७ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्याग्रे पावनं तीर्थं स्वर्णबिन्द्विति विश्रुतम् । यत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति मृताश्च न पुनर्भवम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe daśakanyātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍuttaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 207 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyāgre pāvanaṃ tīrthaṃ svarṇabindviti viśrutam / yatra snātvā divaṃ yānti mṛtāśca na punarbhavam
verses.translation: He who sells his chaste wife, he who forsakes a devotee and he who indulges in sexual intercourse with his daughter or daughter-in-law falls into the hell Mahajvala.
verses.hindi: बेदनाकटकास्तब्धा यातनास्थानमागता: । उष्णस्तु रौरबो ज्ञेयस्तेजो घोररसात्मकः . ततो घनात्मकश्नापि शीतात्मा सततं तपः । एवं सुदुर्लभाः सनन्‍्तः स्वगें वा धामिका नराः.
verses.wordMeaning: He who sells his chaste wife, he who forsakes a devotee and he who indulges in sexual intercourse with his daughter or daughter-in-law falls into the hell Mahajvala.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sells his chaste wife, he who forsakes a devotee and he who indulges in sexual intercourse with his daughter or daughter-in-law falls into the hell Mahajvala.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा दत्ते विप्राय काञ्चनम् । तेन यत्तु फलं प्रोक्तं तच्छृणुष्व महीपते
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā datte viprāya kāñcanam / tena yattu phalaṃ proktaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahīpate
verses.translation: He who sells the Vedas, he who blasphemes the Vedas, those who abuse or disrespect elders or hit them with wounding words and one who carnally approaches forbidden
verses.hindi: महो जनस्तपः सत्य भुतो भाष्यो भवस्तथा। उक्ता होते त्वया लोका लोकानासन्तरेण च ॥ लोकास्तरं च याद्ग्वे तन्नो बृहि यथातथम् द .. २०९
verses.wordMeaning: He who sells the Vedas, he who blasphemes the Vedas, those who abuse or disrespect elders or hit them with wounding words and one who carnally approaches forbidden
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sells the Vedas, he who blasphemes the Vedas, those who abuse or disrespect elders or hit them with wounding words and one who carnally approaches forbidden

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषाम् एव रत्नानां काञ्चनं रत्नमुत्तमम् । अग्नितेजःसमुद्भूतं तेन तत्परमं भुवि
verses.transliteration: sarveṣām eva ratnānāṃ kāñcanaṃ ratnamuttamam / agnitejaḥsamudbhūtaṃ tena tatparamaṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: Veases 146-184 deal with the hells, the tortures therein and the sins that lead to these hells. The total number of hells is twentyeight.
verses.hindi: ..2०---मन+-+०नननन मनन“ मकान काम + मानकर ननननन++न नानी ननननणणण 7077 //7/ धामिक होते हैं। स्व में इन धर्मात्मा महापुरुषों की संख्या का जितना सहस्ततम भाग होता है उतनी ही मोक्ष प्राप्त करने वालों की संख्या होती है ।२००-२०४। वे स्वर्गोपपदाकों के समान ही होते हैं । जो पाप कम में निरत रहने वाले पतित दुरात्मा भृत्यु के वश में होकर उन यातना स्थानॉ--नश्कॉ--में निवास करते हैं, वे महान् अन्धकारपूर्ण उन परम भयानक रौरवादि नरकों में परमश्ीत एवं उत्ताप का अनुभव करते हैं। उन.
verses.wordMeaning: Veases 146-184 deal with the hells, the tortures therein and the sins that lead to these hells. The total number of hells is twentyeight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Veases 146-184 deal with the hells, the tortures therein and the sins that lead to these hells. The total number of hells is twentyeight.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव दत्ता पृथिवी सशैलवनकानना । सपत्तनपुरा सर्वा काञ्चनं यः प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: tenaiva dattā pṛthivī saśailavanakānanā / sapattanapurā sarvā kāñcanaṃ yaḥ prayacchati
verses.translation: He who dismantles or spoils public roads falls into the hell Kifoloha. Those who hate Devas and Brahmanas, those who do not worship preceptors and those who contaminate precious gems fall into the hell Kwiibhaksya.
verses.hindi: यातना स्थानों में पहुंचकर वेदना' की अस॒ह्य कटता को बे स्तठ्व्र होकर सहन करते हैं, उस रोरव नरक को परम: उष्ण तेजोमय (उत्तापक) एवं घोर रक्नात्मक जानना चाहिए। उससे भी परम भयानक सर्वदा परम क्षीतात्म तप (तम) नामक नरक है। सात्त्विक गुण सम्पन्न धामिक नर परम दुलभ होते हैं, जो स्वर्ग लोक में निवास करते हैं। स्वयम्भू परमैश्वयंशाली भगवान् ब्रह्मा ने, उपर्यूक्त आनृपातिक सख्या निद्चितत की है। उस विषय:
verses.wordMeaning: He who dismantles or spoils public roads falls into the hell Kifoloha. Those who hate Devas and Brahmanas, those who do not worship preceptors and those who contaminate precious gems fall into the hell Kwiibhaksya.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who dismantles or spoils public roads falls into the hell Kifoloha. Those who hate Devas and Brahmanas, those who do not worship preceptors and those who contaminate precious gems fall into the hell Kwiibhaksya.

verses.sanskrit: मानसं वाचिकं पापं कर्मणा यत्पुरा कृतम् । तत्सर्वं नश्यति क्षिप्रं स्वर्णदानेन भारत
verses.transliteration: mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yatpurā kṛtam / tatsarvaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ svarṇadānena bhārata
verses.translation: He who eats food keeping his wife, friends and daughter (starving) falls into the foul-smelling hell Lalabhakfa.
verses.hindi: में मनुष्यों की निदिचत की गई संख्या की निवृत्ति है, अर्थात् मानव कभी इस विषय की संख्या आदि. निश्चित नहीं कर सकता, केवल ब्राह्मी संख्या हो ऐसे स्थलों पर प्रमाणभ्ूत होती है ।२०५-२०५। द ऋषि बृन्द बोले--भगवन् वायुदेव ! आप ने मह, जन, तप, सत्य, भूत, (भू) भाव्य (भव) एवं भव (स्वर)--इन सातों लोकों की स्थिति एक के बाद एक बतलाई है। उन लोकों में एक की है अपेक्षा दूसरे में क्या अन्तर है--इसे हम यथार्थत- सुनना चाहते हैं। उन ऊध्वेरेता ऋषियों की इस बांत को : सुनकर तत्वविद् वायु ने तथ्यपूर्ण अपनी बातों को कहना प्रारम्भ किया ।२०६-२१५। पा
verses.wordMeaning: He who eats food keeping his wife, friends and daughter (starving) falls into the foul-smelling hell Lalabhakfa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who eats food keeping his wife, friends and daughter (starving) falls into the foul-smelling hell Lalabhakfa.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्णदानं तु यो दत्त्वा ह्यपि वालाग्रमात्रकम् । तत्र तीर्थे मृतो याति दिवं नास्त्यत्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: svarṇadānaṃ tu yo dattvā hyapi vālāgramātrakam / tatra tīrthe mṛto yāti divaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: A manufacturer of arrows, a potter, a person who takes
verses.hindi: ऋभु: सनत्कुमाराधा: संबुद्धा: शुद्धयुद्धयः । व्यपेतशोका विरजा: सस्तो ब्रह्मंव सत्तमाः. ४२१२
verses.wordMeaning: A manufacturer of arrows, a potter, a person who takes
verses.commentary: Sense: A manufacturer of arrows, a potter, a person who takes

verses.sanskrit: तत्र विद्याधरैः सिद्धैर् विमानवरमास्थितः । पूज्यमानो वसेत्तावद्यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tatra vidyādharaiḥ siddhair vimānavaramāsthitaḥ / pūjyamāno vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam
verses.translation: He who accepts monetary gifts from evil men, he who officiates as a priest in theYajna on behalf of an ineligible man and the man who maintains himself by stellar calculation fall into the hell Adhomukho.
verses.hindi: अक्षयाः प्रीतिसंयुक्ता ब्रह्म निष्टन्ति योगिन:। ऋषीणां वाललिल्यानां तैयंथाहृतमीश्वरेः. दृष्टत्थमात्यसंबन्धसजिष्डामत्यसेव व् । अध्ययानि दर्शतानि तस्मितष्ठत्ति शंकरे .

verses.sanskrit: क्षमानाथं ततो गच्छेत् तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् । दानवगन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च सेवितम्
verses.transliteration: kṣamānāthaṃ tato gacchet tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / dānavagandharvairapsarobhiśca sevitam
verses.translation: Biting serpents arc said to be in the terrible Kalasutra. Nothing can stay in the hell Apratisfiia. There is a terrible
verses.hindi: बहू इसी परमेदबर से आविर्भूत हुआ है ।२२१-२२७। उसी ईइवर से सृष्ठि के समस्त बीजों की परम्परा प्रचलित हुई है, यह क्षेत्रश् स्थमेव सृष्टि का बीज स्वरूप है। प्रकृति ही. सब की योनि (उत्पत्ति स्थली) है । और बह स्वयं नारायणात्मिका है। समस्त लोकों का निर्माता वह परमैश्वयंशान्नी परमात्मा लोक सृष्टि एवं लोक की विधिबत स्थिति के लिए ही प्रकृति के सहयोग से अपने शरीर दढ्वादा ब्रह्लोक एवं ब्रह्माण्डादि का
verses.wordMeaning: Biting serpents arc said to be in the terrible Kalasutra. Nothing can stay in the hell Apratisfiia. There is a terrible
verses.commentary: Sense: Biting serpents arc said to be in the terrible Kalasutra. Nothing can stay in the hell Apratisfiia. There is a terrible

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तिष्ठति देवेशः साक्षाद्रुद्रो महेश्वरः । भारेण महता जातो भारभूतिरिति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tatra tiṣṭhati deveśaḥ sākṣādrudro maheśvaraḥ / bhāreṇa mahatā jāto bhārabhūtiriti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Avici is said to be very terrible because the sinners are
verses.hindi: निर्माण करता है। उन दोनों के मध्यभाग में एक परम रमणीय दिव्य स्थान हैं, जो मनोमय स्थान के साम अन्न संबिस्त्याथं:। + घनुश्चिह्लान्तगंतप्रन्थो ग. पुस्तकेषु न विद्यते । इतः प्रभूति प्रकृतपरः स्थृहा इश्यस्त. पाठो घ« पुस्तके नास्ति + ३९ एतदर्ध च्रुटितं मे. घ« झ पुस्तकेषु । द द
verses.wordMeaning: Avici is said to be very terrible because the sinners are
verses.commentary: Sense: Avici is said to be very terrible because the sinners are

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: भारभूतीति विख्यातं तीर्थं सर्वगुणान्वितम् । श्रोतुम् इच्छामि विप्रेन्द्र परं कौतूहलं हि मे
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: bhārabhūtīti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam / śrotum icchāmi viprendra paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
verses.translation: (Defective verse) Though the beings in the hell are without bodies, the harassment, afflictions and sufferings that they undergo in the Avidlujo hell are irremediable.
verses.hindi: तदहिग्रहवतः स्थानमीश्वरस्पासितौजसः । शिव नाम पुर तत्र शरणं जन्सभोीरुणाम् १२३१ सहस्नाणां शत पूर्ण योजनानां द्विजोत्तमाः। अभ्यस्तरे तु विस्तीण महीभण्डलसंस्थितनू
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) Though the beings in the hell are without bodies, the harassment, afflictions and sufferings that they undergo in the Avidlujo hell are irremediable.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) Though the beings in the hell are without bodies, the harassment, afflictions and sufferings that they undergo in the Avidlujo hell are irremediable.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: भारभूतिसमुत्पत्तिं शृणु पाण्डवसत्तम । विस्तरेण यथा प्रोक्ता पुरा देवेन शम्भुना
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: bhārabhūtisamutpattiṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍavasattama / vistareṇa yathā proktā purā devena śambhunā
verses.translation: All these hells are as terrible as mountains and devoid of light above. In all these the misery due to sin is very intense.
verses.hindi: मध्याह्वाकंप्रकाशेन परतेजोभिमदिना । शान्तकोम्मेन महता प्रकारेणाकंवर्चेंसा तच्चा55काशे पुर रम्यं दिव्यं घण्टानिनादितम्। “न तत्र कमते मृत्यु्न तापो न जरा श्रमः
verses.wordMeaning: All these hells are as terrible as mountains and devoid of light above. In all these the misery due to sin is very intense.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these hells are as terrible as mountains and devoid of light above. In all these the misery due to sin is very intense.

verses.sanskrit: आसीत्कृतयुगे विप्रो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः । विष्णुशर्मेति विख्यातः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः
verses.transliteration: āsītkṛtayuge vipro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / viṣṇuśarmeti vikhyātaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ
verses.translation: These two worlds on the top are devoid of any light whatsoever. Although they are like the other worlds, the sufferings in these two worlds by means of fiery piles (?) are the worst. They take up bodies capable of experiencing these suffer¬ ings as a result of their previous actions. Intensity of suffering is common to all these worlds.
verses.hindi: तत्पुरं गोवषाडूस्य तेजसा व्याप्य तिष्ठति । भावेन मानसो भुमिविस्यस्ता कतकामंयी.
verses.wordMeaning: These two worlds on the top are devoid of any light whatsoever. Although they are like the other worlds, the sufferings in these two worlds by means of fiery piles (?) are the worst.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These two worlds on the top are devoid of any light whatsoever. Although they are like the other worlds, the sufferings in these two worlds by means of fiery piles (?) are the worst.…

verses.sanskrit: क्षमा दमो दया दानं सत्यं शौचं धृतिस्तथा । विद्या विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं सर्वं तस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: kṣamā damo dayā dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucaṃ dhṛtistathā / vidyā vijñānamāstikyaṃ sarvaṃ tasminpratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: The sufferings of the beings doomed to hell are innumerable. They undergo misery. When the sins have been exhausted, they are born again in the womb of lower animals or as Devas. Devas are stationed above and Narakas (beings doomed to hell) arc stationed below.
verses.hindi: रत्नवालुकया ततन्र विन्यस्ता शुशुभेषघिकम् । शा रदेन्दुप्रकाशानि बालसुयंनिभानि च अरधश्वेतार्धरकानि सौचर्णानि तथेव च्। रथचक्रप्रमाणानि नालेमरकतप्रभः
verses.wordMeaning: The sufferings of the beings doomed to hell are innumerable. They undergo misery. When the sins have been exhausted, they are born again in the womb of lower animals or as Devas. Devas are stationed above and Narakas (beings doomed to hell) arc stationed below.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sufferings of the beings doomed to hell are innumerable. They undergo misery. When the sins have been exhausted, they are born again in the womb of lower animals or as Devas. Devas are stationed above and Narakas (beings doomed to hell) arc stationed below.

verses.sanskrit: ईदृग्गुणा हि ये विप्रा भवन्ति नृपसत्तम । पतितान्नरके घोरे तारयन्ति पित्ःंस् तु ते
verses.transliteration: īdṛgguṇā hi ye viprā bhavanti nṛpasattama / patitānnarake ghore tārayanti pitḥṃs tu te
verses.translation: Caused by Dharmas or Adharmas they develop befitting bodies for the purpose of experiencing the fruits thereof.
verses.hindi: से स्यात है। वह उस परम तेजस्बी ईश्वर का शिव नामक पुर है, जिसमें पुनर्जन्मादि से भीत होने वाले महापुरुषों का निवास है । द्विजवर्य्य बुन्द ! वह शिव नामकपुरी सौ सहस्न बोजनों में विस्तृत हैं। इसका अन्तवर्ती भाग एथ्वी मण्डल जितना विस्तीर्ण है ।२२८-२३२। इस महापुरी के चारों ओर मध्याह्न कालीन भास्कर की भांति परम तेजस्वी, अन्यान्य तेजस्वी पदार्थों के तेज को मलिन कर देने वाली सुवर्ण निर्मित महान्
verses.wordMeaning: Caused by Dharmas or Adharmas they develop befitting bodies for the purpose of experiencing the fruits thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: Caused by Dharmas or Adharmas they develop befitting bodies for the purpose of experiencing the fruits thereof.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियं लोलुपा विप्रा ये भवन्ति नृपोत्तम । पतन्ति नरके घोरे रौरवे पापमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: indriyaṃ lolupā viprā ye bhavanti nṛpottama / patanti narake ghore raurave pāpamohitāḥ
verses.translation: Devas see the hellish beings standing topsy turvy below them. The hellish beings too sec all the Devas standing topsy turvy.
verses.hindi: चहा रदीवारी सुक्योभित है । उसकी चमक चारों ओर सूर्य के समान चकाचौंष करती रहती है। उस महान् पुरी में चार द्वार हैं, जो सुबर्ण से निर्मित हैं। मोतियों की लड़ियाँ उनकी शोभावद्धि करती हैं, वे परम शुघ्र एवं शोभा सम्पन्न हैं। उस मनोहर पुरी के चारों ओर एक अन्य रक्षा दीवाल भी खड़ी है, जो परम पुष्ट है । आकाझ्ष में वह परम सुशोभित पुरी दिव्य घंटाओं के सुरंम्य नादों से कजित रहती है । उस पुरी में न तो वृद्धावस्था का कोई भय रहता है न मृत्यु का कोई आतद्ू । परिश्रम भी नहीं खलता। समस्त त्रैलोक्य में ऐसी कोई पुरी नहों है; जिसकी शोभा को उत्त रम्य पुरी की सुन्दरता अनुकरण करे अर्थात् वैसी सुरम्य पुरी त्रेलोक्य में अन्यत्र कहों नहों है । दर्सों दिशाओं में उसका परिमाण एक लाख योजन है  भगवान् वुषभध्वज महेश्वर को बह पुरी अपने तेजोबल से अवस्थित है । उस सुवर्णमयी पुरी की सृष्टि मानसिक भाव भूमि पर हुई
verses.wordMeaning: Devas see the hellish beings standing topsy turvy below them. The hellish beings too sec all the Devas standing topsy turvy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas see the hellish beings standing topsy turvy below them. The hellish beings too sec all the Devas standing topsy turvy.

verses.sanskrit: ये क्षान्तदान्ताः श्रुतिपूर्णकर्णा जितेन्द्रियाः प्राणिवधान् निवृत्ताः । प्रतिग्रहे संकुचिताग्रहस्तास्ते ब्राह्मणास्तारयितुं समर्थाः
verses.transliteration: ye kṣāntadāntāḥ śrutipūrṇakarṇā jitendriyāḥ prāṇivadhān nivṛttāḥ / pratigrahe saṃkucitāgrahastāste brāhmaṇāstārayituṃ samarthāḥ
verses.translation: There is no distinction in Lokaloka as to the top or bottom because these worlds have no tip or root. They are held in position naturally.
verses.hindi: है ।१३३-२३७। रत्नों की बालुका से विन्यस्त उस परम रम्य नगरी की शोभा अधिक बढ़ जाती है। शरदपूर्णिमा के चन्द्रमा के समान सुप्रकाशमय, प्रातः कालीन सुये की भाँति मनोहर एवं तेजोमय, आधे श्वेत आधे लाल सुवर्णनिसित रथ के चककों के समान गोलाकार दिव्य पद्म उस पुरी में झोभायमान हैं । वे पद्म अपनो
verses.wordMeaning: There is no distinction in Lokaloka as to the top or bottom because these worlds have no tip or root. They are held in position naturally.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no distinction in Lokaloka as to the top or bottom because these worlds have no tip or root. They are held in position naturally.

verses.sanskrit: एवं गुणगणाकीर्णो ब्राह्मणो नर्मदातटे । वसते ब्राह्मणैः सार्धं शिलोञ्छवृत्तिजीवनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇo brāhmaṇo narmadātaṭe / vasate brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ śiloñchavṛttijīvanaḥ
verses.translation: This situation, this Samjna (? name) is natural to Lokaloka (?).
verses.hindi: + धनुध्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थो ग. पुस्तके नास्ति । १०१८ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: This situation, this Samjna (? name) is natural to Lokaloka (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: This situation, this Samjna (? name) is natural to Lokaloka (?).

verses.sanskrit: तादृशं ब्राह्मणं ज्ञात्वा देवदेवो महेश्वरः । द्विजरूपधरो भूत्वा तस्याश्रममगात्स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jñātvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ / dvijarūpadharo bhūtvā tasyāśramamagātsvayam
verses.translation: Mention completely the number of living beings
verses.hindi: भूड़पन्ननिकाशानि तपनीयानि यानि च। अधेकृष्णाधंरक्तानि सुकुमारान्तराणि च २४१
verses.wordMeaning: Mention completely the number of living beings
verses.commentary: Sense: Mention completely the number of living beings

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तं ब्राह्मणैः सार्धमुच्चरन्तं पदक्रमम् । अभिवादयते विप्रं स्वागतेन च पूजितः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā taṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhamuccarantaṃ padakramam / abhivādayate vipraṃ svāgatena ca pūjitaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent ones among men, all the creatures can by no means be entirely enumerated. 1 They are beginning¬ less and endless. They are jumbled and mixed with one another. Only a general inference can be made to fix their number. The
verses.hindi: बरा वरेण्या वरदा वराहा वरवणिनी । वरमा वरभद्रा च रम्पास्तस्मिस्पुरोत्तसे पद्मात्यलदलोस्मिश्र॑ फेनाक्याबतंविग्रहम् । जल॑ मणिदलप्रस्यमावहन्ति सरिद्वराः १२४४ न तु ब्रह्मंयो देवा नासुराः पितरस्तथा। न खल्वन्येडप्रमेयस्य जिंदुरीशस्य तत्पुरम् २४५
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent ones among men, all the creatures can by no means be entirely enumerated. 1 They are beginning¬ less and endless. They are jumbled and mixed with one another. Only a general inference can be made to fix their number. The
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent ones among men, all the creatures can by no means be entirely enumerated. 1 They are beginning¬ less and endless. They are jumbled and mixed with one another. Only a general inference can be made to fix their number. The

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच तं मुहूर्तेन ब्राह्मणो विस्मयान्वितः । किमथ तद्बटो ब्रूहि किं करोमि तवेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: provāca taṃ muhūrtena brāhmaṇo vismayānvitaḥ / kimatha tadbaṭo brūhi kiṃ karomi tavepsitam
verses.translation: Actually no question is asked on what cannot be con¬ ceived or known. Understand what has been named and numbered by Brahma.
verses.hindi: मध्ये पुरवरेन्द्रस्य तस्यामसिततेजसा । सुमहान्से रुसंकाशो दिव्यों भव्रश्चिय्य बृतः २४७
verses.wordMeaning: Actually no question is asked on what cannot be con¬ ceived or known. Understand what has been named and numbered by Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Actually no question is asked on what cannot be con¬ ceived or known. Understand what has been named and numbered by Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: बटुरुवाच: विद्यार्थिनमनुप्राप्तं विद्धि मां द्विजसत्तम । ददासि यदि मे विद्यां ततः स्थास्यामि ते गृहे
verses.transliteration: baṭuruvāca: vidyārthinamanuprāptaṃ viddhi māṃ dvijasattama / dadāsi yadi me vidyāṃ tataḥ sthāsyāmi te gṛhe
verses.translation: The earthly worms born of Samscka (sprinkling or watering) etc. form about a thousandth part of the number of immobile beings.
verses.hindi: स्फटिके भ्रर्द्रसंकाशबेंदुर्यं: सोमसंप्रभः । बालसुयंप्रभेश्वव सोवण्णेश्राग्निसंप्रभः १२४६ सुकुमारता, सौन्दयं, एवं सुबन्ध में अनृपम है। ऐसे परम मनोहर दिव्य पद्म वहाँ के वनों एवं उपवनों में सवंत्र हैं। वहाँ के कुछ सुन्दर परम सुकुमार पद्म भृज्भू के पंख के समान इ्यामल वर्ण के, कुछ एकदम सुनहले, कुछ आधे काले आधे लाल, आकार में छत्र के समान द्वोते हैं। ऐसे सुन्दर पदूमों से वहां के जलाशय व्याप्त हैं। वहाँ सात महानदियाँ हैं, उनके नाम वरा, वरेण्या, वरदा, वराहाँ, वरवरणिनों,
verses.wordMeaning: The earthly worms born of Samscka (sprinkling or watering) etc. form about a thousandth part of the number of immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earthly worms born of Samscka (sprinkling or watering) etc. form about a thousandth part of the number of immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच: सर्वेषामेव विप्राणां बटो त्वं गोत्र उत्तमे । दानानां परमं दानं कथं विद्या च दीयते
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa uvāca: sarveṣāmeva viprāṇāṃ baṭo tvaṃ gotra uttame / dānānāṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ kathaṃ vidyā ca dīyate
verses.translation: This has been decisively arrived at that all the aquatic creatures together come to about a thousandth part of the creatures born of Samseka.
verses.hindi: वरमा, वरभद्रा, है। वे परम रमणीय नदियाँ उस सुन्दरपुरी की शोभा वृद्धि करनेवाली हैं ।३३८-२४३॥। इन सुन्दर सरिताओं में श्वेत, रक्त पद्मों के दलों से विमिश्रित, फेनों एवं भंवरियों से विभूषित मणियों के टुकड़ों के समान परम स्वच्छ शुक्र जल प्रवाहित होता है । अप्रमेय महेश्वर के इस परम रम्यपुर को न तो ब्रह्मधिगण ही जानते हैं, न देवता ही जानते हैं। अथुरों एवं पितरों को भी इस पुर
verses.wordMeaning: This has been decisively arrived at that all the aquatic creatures together come to about a thousandth part of the creatures born of Samseka.
verses.commentary: Sense: This has been decisively arrived at that all the aquatic creatures together come to about a thousandth part of the creatures born of Samseka.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुशुश्रूषया विद्या पुष्कलेन धनेन वा । अथवा विद्यया विद्या भवतीह फलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: guruśuśrūṣayā vidyā puṣkalena dhanena vā / athavā vidyayā vidyā bhavatīha phalapradā
verses.translation: All the worldly birds should be known as forming a thousandth part of the number of aquatic living beings.
verses.hindi: का कोई पता नहीं है । जो परम जितेन्द्रिय योगाभ्यास परायण महात्मा हैं, जिनका चित्त कभी चंचल वा व्यग्र नहीं होता, वे ही ध्यान घर कर वुषभध्वज के इस पुर का दर्शन करते हैं ।२४४-२४६। उस पुरबर के मध्य भाग में अनृपम तेजस्वी, महान्, सुमे् पवंत के समान विशाल, समग्र सोौन्दयंश्री से विभूषित एक प्रासाद सुशोभित है, जिसके सहस्न चरण हैं, उस मज्भलमय प्रासाद की रचना सुवर्ण से है। सभी ओर से अमूल्य अनृपम रत्नों द्वारा उसकी झोभा वृद्धि होती है। कहीं शुश्र स्फटिक मणियों से, कहीं चन्द्रकान्त मणियों से, कहीं बेदुय॑ मणियों से, कहीं चन्द्रमा के समान सुशोभित मणियों से, कहीं प्रातः कालीन सूर्य की भाँति परम मनोहर किन्तु तेजोमय मणियों से, कहीं सुवर्णणय मणियों से, कहीं अग्नि के समान तैजोमय
verses.wordMeaning: All the worldly birds should be known as forming a thousandth part of the number of aquatic living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the worldly birds should be known as forming a thousandth part of the number of aquatic living beings.

verses.sanskrit: बटुरुवाच: यथान्ये बालकाः स्नाताः शुश्रूषन्ति ह्यहर्निशम् । तथाहं बटुभिः सार्धं शुश्रूषामि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: baṭuruvāca: yathānye bālakāḥ snātāḥ śuśrūṣanti hyaharniśam / tathāhaṃ baṭubhiḥ sārdhaṃ śuśrūṣāmi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: All.the animals, the quadrupeds, should be known as constituting a thousandth part of the number of birds.
verses.hindi: जलेश्र विविधाका रदीप्य-डू रधिवासितम् । चन्द्ररश्मिप्रकाशानिः पताकाभिरलंकृतम् ॥२४ १९ रुक्मघण्ट निनादेश्व नित्यप्रमुदितोत्सवः ।- किनराणासधीवासे: संध्याश्राकारराजितः
verses.wordMeaning: All.the animals, the quadrupeds, should be known as constituting a thousandth part of the number of birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: All.the animals, the quadrupeds, should be known as constituting a thousandth part of the number of birds.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति चोक्त्वा विप्रेन्द्रः पाठयंस्तं दिने दिने । वर्तते सह शिष्यैः स शिलोञ्छानुपहारयन्
verses.transliteration: tatheti coktvā viprendraḥ pāṭhayaṃstaṃ dine dine / vartate saha śiṣyaiḥ sa śiloñchānupahārayan
verses.translation: The bipeds (men) in this world should be known as constituting a thousandth part of all the quadrupeds.
verses.hindi: (  चामीकरमयीभिस्तु पताकाभिस्तथा पुरम् । एवं प्रसादराजोइसो भूसिकाभिविराजते वसन्‍्तप्रीतमा यत्र उ्यम्बकस्य निवेशने । लक्ष्मी: श्रीभ्र वपुर्माया कीतिः शोभा सरस्वती ७२५५ देव्या वे सहिता होता रूपगन्धसमविन्ता:। नित्या झ्परिसंख्याताः परस्प रगुणाश्रया: ) ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The bipeds (men) in this world should be known as constituting a thousandth part of all the quadrupeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bipeds (men) in this world should be known as constituting a thousandth part of all the quadrupeds.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कतिपयाहोभिः प्रोक्तो बटुभिरीश्वरः । पचनाद्यं बटो कर्म कुरु क्रमत आगतम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ katipayāhobhiḥ prokto baṭubhirīśvaraḥ / pacanādyaṃ baṭo karma kuru kramata āgatam
verses.translation: Righteous men should be known to constitute a thou¬ sandth part of the entire number of bipeds.
verses.hindi: भृषणं सर्वरत्नानां योउस्यः काम्तिविलासयो:
verses.wordMeaning: Righteous men should be known to constitute a thou¬ sandth part of the entire number of bipeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Righteous men should be known to constitute a thou¬ sandth part of the entire number of bipeds.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति चोक्तो देवेशो भारग्रामम् उपागतः । ध्यात्वा वनस्पतीः सर्वा इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tatheti cokto deveśo bhāragrāmam upāgataḥ / dhyātvā vanaspatīḥ sarvā idaṃ vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Of the righteous men only a thousandth part goes to heaven. Of those righteous men who go to heaven only a thou¬ sandth part qualify themselves for absolution ( Moksa ).
verses.hindi: कोटी शत महाभाग विभज्या55त्मानमात्मना । भगवन्तं महात्मान॑ प्रतिमोदन्त्यतन्द्रिताः २५७ मणियों से, कहीं रजत मय (चाँदी के) मणियों से, कहीं सुरम्य इसख्रनील मणियों से, कहीं परम दढ़ हीरों से उस विद्याल प्रासाद की शोभा बृद्धि होती है। वे सभी मणियाँ भली तरह जड़ी बई है। चमकते हुए गवाक्ष जंगले जो विविध प्रकार के बने हुए हैं, उस प्रासाद की शोभा वृद्धि के सहायक हैं। चन्द्रमा की किरणों के समान सुप्रकाशमान पताकाएँ उस पर सुशोभित हैं ।२४७-२५१। सुवर्ण निर्मित घण्टों के सुरम्य स्वरों से वह
verses.wordMeaning: Of the righteous men only a thousandth part goes to heaven. Of those righteous men who go to heaven only a thou¬ sandth part qualify themselves for absolution ( Moksa ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Of the righteous men only a thousandth part goes to heaven. Of those righteous men who go to heaven only a thou¬ sandth part qualify themselves for absolution ( Moksa ).

verses.sanskrit: यावदागच्छते विप्रो बटुभिः सह मन्दिरम् । अदर्शनाभिः कर्तव्यं तावदन्नं सुसंस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yāvadāgacchate vipro baṭubhiḥ saha mandiram / adarśanābhiḥ kartavyaṃ tāvadannaṃ susaṃskṛtam
verses.translation: Persons staying in the abodes of torture are equal to those who go to heaven. Those wicked souls who fall into the dark Raurava after death are harassed by both chill and heat.
verses.hindi: आसाद मुखरित रहता है, प्रमोद एवं उत्सव के समारोह वहाँ नित्य मनाये जाते हैं । सन्ध्या कालीन मेघों की पंक्तियों के समान सुझ्लोभित किन्नरों के आवास स्थान उस पुर में परम क्षोभा पाते हैं। वे चारों ओर से सुवर्ण निर्मित पुष्पों एवं सुवर्णंणय जलराशि की तरह सुशोभित होते हैं। किन्नरों के सुरम्य भवनों से वह पुर सुवर्णभय शिखरों से सुशोभित पर्वंतराज सुमेर को तरह शोभा पाता है। कहों पर सुवर्णनिर्मित पताका-
verses.wordMeaning: Persons staying in the abodes of torture are equal to those who go to heaven. Those wicked souls who fall into the dark Raurava after death are harassed by both chill and heat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons staying in the abodes of torture are equal to those who go to heaven. Those wicked souls who fall into the dark Raurava after death are harassed by both chill and heat.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु ताः सर्वा विश्वरूपो महेश्वरः । क्रीडनार्थं गतस्तत्र बटुवेषधरः पृथक्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu tāḥ sarvā viśvarūpo maheśvaraḥ / krīḍanārthaṃ gatastatra baṭuveṣadharaḥ pṛthak
verses.translation: Verses 195-208 give the Puranic notions about the number ofjivas m each species.
verses.hindi: द्वारा और भी शोभा पाता है। ज्यम्बक शिव के उस भवन में वसन्‍्त की मूति विराजमान रहती है। उसके अतिरिक्त लक्ष्मी, श्री, माया, कीति, शोभा, सरस्वती आदि देवियाँ अपने अनृपम सौरदय एवं सुगन्ध के साथ वहाँ निवास करती हैं वे देवियाँ सबंदा एक रूप हैं, उनकी संख्या नहीं परिगणित की जा सकती  उनके गुण समुदाय परस्पर आश्रित रहते हैं। अर्थात् उनकी दया की शोभा उनकी क्षमा और शान्ति से होती है, और उनकी शास्ति दया से विशेष शोभाशालिनी हो घाती है। कान्ति एवं विलास की वे उत्पत्ति- स्थली हैं, समग्र रत्नों के आभूषणों से उनकी छ्लोभा की अधिक वृद्धि होती है, वे महाभाग्यशालिनी देवियाँ सैकड़ों कोटि अंशों में अपने को आत्मा से विभक्त कर के निरालस भाव से परमैश्वयंशाली एवं महान् भगवान् परमेश्वर को प्रमुदित करती हैं ।२५२-२५७। उनकी सहस्रों की संख्या में अन्य परिचारिकाएँ रहती हैं !
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 195-208 give the Puranic notions about the number ofjivas m each species.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 195-208 give the Puranic notions about the number ofjivas m each species.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा समागतं तत्र बटुवेषधरं पृथक् । धिक् त्वां च परुषं वाक्यम् ऊचुस् ते गिरिसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ tatra baṭuveṣadharaṃ pṛthak / dhik tvāṃ ca paruṣaṃ vākyam ūcus te girisannidhau
verses.translation: They suffer bitter pain. The bodies of those who reach the abodes of torture become benumbed. Raurava should be known as hot. Blazing splendour and hot liquids flow there.
verses.hindi: एतज्चित्वास्तगंतग्रन्थे पाठव्यत्यासों दुश्यते ख. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: They suffer bitter pain. The bodies of those who reach the abodes of torture become benumbed. Raurava should be known as hot. Blazing splendour and hot liquids flow there.
verses.commentary: Sense: They suffer bitter pain. The bodies of those who reach the abodes of torture become benumbed. Raurava should be known as hot. Blazing splendour and hot liquids flow there.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुत्क्षामकंठाः सर्वे च गत्वा तु किल मन्दिरम् । त्वया सिद्धेन चान्नेन तृप्तिं यास्यामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration: kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭhāḥ sarve ca gatvā tu kila mandiram / tvayā siddhena cānnena tṛptiṃ yāsyāmahe vayam
verses.translation: The Tapa hell is in solid form and always chill. Good and righteous people going to heaven are very rare.
verses.hindi: १०२० बायुपुराणम् लीलाविलाससंयुक्तेभविरतिमनोहरे: । गणेस्ता: सह मोदन्ते शलाभः पावकोपमै: २५६९ कुब्जा वामनिकाश्वेव वरगात्रा हयानना: । पुण्डाश्य विकटाश्वव करालाश्रिपिटानना: १२६० लम्बोदरा हृस्वभुजा विनेत्रा हस्वपादिका:। मृगेन्द्रवदनाभ्रान्या गजवक्त्रोदरास्तथा २६१
verses.wordMeaning: The Tapa hell is in solid form and always chill. Good and righteous people going to heaven are very rare.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tapa hell is in solid form and always chill. Good and righteous people going to heaven are very rare.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वृथा चिन्तितं सव त्वयागत्य कृतं द्विज । मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञेन सता दुरनुष्ठितमद्य ते
verses.transliteration: tadvṛthā cintitaṃ sava tvayāgatya kṛtaṃ dvija / mithyāpratijñena satā duranuṣṭhitamadya te
verses.translation: This fixation of number is made by the self-born lord Isvara himself. Human calculation recedes. Only the calculation of Brahma decides (properly).
verses.hindi: हस्वकुश्चितशकैश/श्र सुन्दर्य श्रारलोचना: । अन्याश्य कासरूपिण्यो नानावेषधरा:ः स्त्रियःः
verses.wordMeaning: This fixation of number is made by the self-born lord Isvara himself. Human calculation recedes. Only the calculation of Brahma decides (properly).
verses.commentary: Sense: This fixation of number is made by the self-born lord Isvara himself. Human calculation recedes. Only the calculation of Brahma decides (properly).

verses.sanskrit: बटुरुवाच: सन्तापमनुतापं वा भोजनार्थं द्विजर्षभाः । मा कुरुध्वं यथान्यायं सिद्धे ऽग्रे गृहमेष्यथा
verses.transliteration: baṭuruvāca: santāpamanutāpaṃ vā bhojanārthaṃ dvijarṣabhāḥ / mā kurudhvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ siddhe 'gre gṛhameṣyathā
verses.translation: Mahah, Jana, Tapah, Satya, Bhuta, Bhavya andBhava—all these worlds have been recounted by you. Please mention precisely what their difference is and what the distance between them is.
verses.hindi: अभ्यन्तरपरिस्कन्धा देवावासगहोचिता: ।  रराम भगवांस्तत्र दशबाहुमहेश्वरः पावकात्मजसंकाशयपदंष्ट्रोत्कटानने: । वन्द्यमानों विमानश्न ( स्थः ) पुज्यमानश्र तत्परः
verses.wordMeaning: Mahah, Jana, Tapah, Satya, Bhuta, Bhavya andBhava—all these worlds have been recounted by you. Please mention precisely what their difference is and what the distance between them is.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahah, Jana, Tapah, Satya, Bhuta, Bhavya andBhava—all these worlds have been recounted by you. Please mention precisely what their difference is and what the distance between them is.

verses.sanskrit: बटुर् उवाच: दिनशेषेण चास्माकं पञ्चतां च दिने दिने । निष्पत्तिं याति वा नेति तद् असिद्धम् अशेषतः
verses.transliteration: baṭur uvāca: dinaśeṣeṇa cāsmākaṃ pañcatāṃ ca dine dine / niṣpattiṃ yāti vā neti tad asiddham aśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Learned men see that manifest through inference; the Yogins see it directly by means of Yogic power and those who habitually perform holy rites observe it through Pratyahara (withdrawal of physical senses), meditation and penance.
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men see that manifest through inference; the Yogins see it directly by means of Yogic power and those who habitually perform holy rites observe it through Pratyahara (withdrawal of physical senses), meditation and penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men see that manifest through inference; the Yogins see it directly by means of Yogic power and those who habitually perform holy rites observe it through Pratyahara (withdrawal of physical senses), meditation and penance.

verses.sanskrit: असिद्धं सिद्धमस्माकं यत् त्वया समुदाहृतम् । दृष्ट्वानृतं गतास् तत्र त्वां बद्धाम्भसि निक्षिपे
verses.transliteration: asiddhaṃ siddhamasmākaṃ yat tvayā samudāhṛtam / dṛṣṭvānṛtaṃ gatās tatra tvāṃ baddhāmbhasi nikṣipe
verses.translation: The enlightened Rbhu, Sanatkumara and others who possess pure intellect, the Virajas (those who are free from Rajoguna) free from sorrow, those excellent saintly men like Brahma himself who are never fading (always) full of delight, logins adhering to Brahman, and the sages Valakhilya and others—all these have observed the residence of the eternal lord from close quarters. That residence cannot be conceived or argued about. It makes good men contented. I too have observ¬ ed it by remaining close at hand.
verses.hindi: जो सदा उनका अनुगमन करती हैं। वे सब भी कमल के समान मनोहर नेत्रोंवाली स्वरूपवती एवं शोभाशा- लिनी रहती हैं। परम मनोहर लीला एवं विलास की भावनाओं से ओत-प्रोत, पर्वत के समात भीषणाकार अग्ति के समान जाज्वल्यमान 'एवं तेजस्वी गणों के साथ वें परिचारिकाएँ आनन्द का अनुभव करती हैं, उन परिचारिकाओं में कुछ कुबड़ी हैं, कु वामनाकृत हैं, किसी का शरीर बहुत सुन्दर है, पर मुख घोड़े के समान है। कुछ गसने के समान पतली और लम्बी पर स्वभाव से बड़ी विकट, कुंछ देखने में महा कराल, कुछ चिपटे मुख वाली, कुछ लम्बे पेटों वाली, कुछ छोटे हाथों वाली, कोई नेत्र विहौन, कोई छोटे- चरणों वाली, कुछ सिंह के समान कटि वाली, कोई हाथी के समान भीषण मुख और उदर वाली, कुछ वैसे ही हाथी के समान मुख वाली, कुछ सिंह और बाघ के समान मुखवाली हैं। उनमें किसी के नेत्र
verses.wordMeaning: The enlightened Rbhu, Sanatkumara and others who possess pure intellect, the Virajas (those who are free from Rajoguna) free from sorrow, those excellent saintly men like Brahma himself who are never fading (always) full of delight, logins adhering to Brahman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The enlightened Rbhu, Sanatkumara and others who possess pure intellect, the Virajas (those who are free from Rajoguna) free from sorrow, those excellent saintly men like Brahma himself who are never fading (always) full of delight, logins adhering to Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: बटुरुवाच: भोभोः शृणुध्व सर्वे ऽत्र सोपाध्याया द्विजोत्तमाः । प्रतिज्ञां मम दुर्धर्षां यां श्रुत्वा विस्मयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: baṭuruvāca: bhobhoḥ śṛṇudhva sarve 'tra sopādhyāyā dvijottamāḥ / pratijñāṃ mama durdharṣāṃ yāṃ śrutvā vismayo bhavet
verses.translation: Since Isvara is so subtle as the atom, he can only be conceived by learned men. The following ten everlast¬ ing attributes are always present in Sankara —Jfidna (perfect knowledge), Vairagya (detachment), AiSvarya (overlordship or
verses.hindi: बहुत लाल हैं तो कोई लम्बे-लब्बे विशाल स्तनों के भारों से दुःखी हैं। इनके अतिरिक्त कुछ बहुत ही सुन्दर एवं चित्ताकर्षक नेत्रों वाली भी हैं ।२५८-२६२॥ उत्त परम पुन्दरियों के केश बहुत छोटे और घृघराले होते हैं। उनके नेत्र चित्त को आक्ृष्ट कर लेते हैं। अन्यान्य सुन्दरी स्त्रियाँ नाना प्रकार की वेश-भूषा से सुसज्जित होकर वहाँ पर विराजमान रहती हैं। वे अपनी इच्छा के अनुरूप स्वरूप धारण करने वाली हैं । उस
verses.wordMeaning: Since Isvara is so subtle as the atom, he can only be conceived by learned men. The following ten everlast¬ ing attributes are always present in Sankara —Jfidna (perfect knowledge), Vairagya (detachment), AiSvarya (overlordship or
verses.commentary: Sense: Since Isvara is so subtle as the atom, he can only be conceived by learned men. The following ten everlast¬ ing attributes are always present in Sankara —Jfidna (perfect knowledge), Vairagya (detachment), AiSvarya (overlordship or

verses.sanskrit: यदि सिद्धमिदं सर्वमन्नं स्याद् आश्रमे गुरोः । यूयं बद्ध्वा मया सर्वे क्षेप्तव्या नर्मदाम्भसि
verses.transliteration: yadi siddhamidaṃ sarvamannaṃ syād āśrame guroḥ / yūyaṃ baddhvā mayā sarve kṣeptavyā narmadāmbhasi
verses.translation: He is ViMu (all-powerful and omnipresent). The flee of Yog,c power ol the Yog,ns is kindled by his blessing,. A,sum- mg physical bodies, lie helps the world of human beinos.
verses.hindi: विशाल महाप्रसाद के भीतरी भाग में वे सुन्दरियाँ सबेथा विचरण किया करती हैं, वे सचमुच देवस्थानों में तिवास करने योग्य हैं। उस सुन्दर विशाल प्रासाद में दशबाहु भगवान् महेश्वर क्रीडा करते हैं। उनके साथ नन्दीहवर एवं महान पराक्रमशाली विश्व रूप धारण करने में सक्षम उनके गण निवास करते हैं । रुद्रगण भगवान् के समान ही उदार एवं पराक्रमशाली हैं।वे आकूति में अग्ति पुत्र की भाँति परम ईषत्कराललम्बोष्ठं तीकणदंष्ट्रागणाडिचितम् । षड्ध्व॑नेन्न दुष्प्रेकषय रुचिरं खीरवाससम् २६८ आहवेष्वपरिक्लिष्टं देवानामरिनाशनम् । बाहुना बाहुमाबवेश्य पाश्वें सब्येडन्तरे स्थितमू
verses.wordMeaning: He is ViMu (all-powerful and omnipresent). The flee of Yog,c power ol the Yog,ns is kindled by his blessing,. A,sum- mg physical bodies, lie helps the world of human beinos.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is ViMu (all-powerful and omnipresent). The flee of Yog,c power ol the Yog,ns is kindled by his blessing,. A,sum- mg physical bodies, lie helps the world of human beinos.

verses.sanskrit: अथवान्नं न सिद्धं स्याद् भवद्भिर्दृढबन्धनैः । गुरोस्तु पश्यतो बद्ध्वा क्षेप्तव्यो ऽहं नर्मदाह्रदे
verses.transliteration: athavānnaṃ na siddhaṃ syād bhavadbhirdṛḍhabandhanaiḥ / gurostu paśyato baddhvā kṣeptavyo 'haṃ narmadāhrade
verses.translation: The abode of that eternal lord is imperishable, fixed and untarnished by worldly chaos. I, is the eighth (one beyond the seven Lokas). It is conceived by Maya and the greatest of all.
verses.hindi: रराज पद्टिशं तत्य वामाग्रकरगोचरम् । महाभेरवनिर्घोष॑ बलेनाप्रतिमौजसम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of that eternal lord is imperishable, fixed and untarnished by worldly chaos. I, is the eighth (one beyond the seven Lokas). It is conceived by Maya and the greatest of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of that eternal lord is imperishable, fixed and untarnished by worldly chaos. I, is the eighth (one beyond the seven Lokas). It is conceived by Maya and the greatest of all.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति कृत्वा ते सर्वे समयं गुरुसन्निधौ । स्नात्वा जाप्यविधानेन भूतग्रामं ततो ययुः
verses.transliteration: tatheti kṛtvā te sarve samayaṃ gurusannidhau / snātvā jāpyavidhānena bhūtagrāmaṃ tato yayuḥ
verses.translation: The eightfold Prakrti and its creations are created by him through Maya. Lord Mahesvara is Mdyin (Master or possessor of Maya). The withdrawal (annihilation) of Devas is done there (in his abode).
verses.hindi: असिश्चेबौजसां श्रेष्ठ: शोतरश्मिः शशी तथा । तेजसा वपुषा कान्‍्त्या देवेशस्थ महात्मनः ॥ स्थित: पुरस्तादेवस्थ शातकौम्भमयों महान् । शुशुभ दचिरः क्रीमाग्सोदकः सः कसण्डलु:
verses.wordMeaning: The eightfold Prakrti and its creations are created by him through Maya. Lord Mahesvara is Mdyin (Master or possessor of Maya). The withdrawal (annihilation) of Devas is done there (in his abode).
verses.commentary: Sense: The eightfold Prakrti and its creations are created by him through Maya. Lord Mahesvara is Mdyin (Master or possessor of Maya). The withdrawal (annihilation) of Devas is done there (in his abode).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मयं जग्मुर्विस्तृते भक्ष्यभोजने । षड्रसेन नृपश्रेष्ठ भुक्त्वा हुत्वा पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā te vismayaṃ jagmurvistṛte bhakṣyabhojane / ṣaḍrasena nṛpaśreṣṭha bhuktvā hutvā pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: Listen to and understand even as I recount in detail and m the proper order. The distance between Bhurloka and Brahmaloka is one hundred and thirtyone million five hundred thousand Yojanas.
verses.hindi: भयानक होते हैं, खम्भे के समान विशाल एवं भीषण दाँतों से उनके मुख की एक विकट शोभा होती है। ये गण विमानों में चढ़कर तन्मय होकर भगवान् की बन्दता एवं पूजा करते हैं । उस समय महादेव जी सभी ऋतुओं में सुलभ पुष्पों से निर्मित माला को, जो उनके विशाल वक्षःस्थल पर शोभा वृद्धि करती है, सूंघते हैं। वे नीले कमल दल के समान श्यामल वर्ण हैं, लम्बे-लम्बे लाल वर्ण के उनके मनोहर नेत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to and understand even as I recount in detail and m the proper order. The distance between Bhurloka and Brahmaloka is one hundred and thirtyone million five hundred thousand Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to and understand even as I recount in detail and m the proper order. The distance between Bhurloka and Brahmaloka is one hundred and thirtyone million five hundred thousand Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोवाच वचनं हृष्टपुष्टो द्विजोत्तमः । वरदो ऽस्मि वरं वत्स वृणु यत्तव रोचते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ provāca vacanaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭo dvijottamaḥ / varado 'smi varaṃ vatsa vṛṇu yattava rocate
verses.translation: The space of Brahmanda above Brahmaloka is fifteen million Yojanas.
verses.hindi: हैं। कुछ भयानक और लम्बे होंठ, तीक्ष्ण दंत पैक्तियों से सुशोभित हैं, ऊपर को ताकने वाले भयानक नेत्र से उनका मुखमण्डल दुष्प्रेक्ष्य होता है  सुन्दर चीर वस्त्र धारण किये रहते हैं ।२६३-२६५। युद्धों में जिसे कोई कठिनाई नहीं होती, ऐसे राक्षसों के परम विध्वेंसक एक हाथ को वे दूसरे हाथ में लपेट कर वामपारव में रख लेते हैं। उससे थोड़ी ही दूर पर स्थित उनके वाम हाथ में सुशोभित पट्टिश नामक अस्त्र शोभा पाता है, उसके अतिरिक्त जिसकी प्रत्यअचा का मिनाद महान् भीषण होता है, जिसके समान दूंढ़ एवं तेजस्वी कोई अन्य धनुष नहीं हैं, उनका दसवर्णों वाला विचित्र धनुष भी वहाँ अधिक्राषिक शोभा लाभ करता है ।२६६-२७०। विद्युतु के समान चमकीला शत्र्संहारकारी उनका त्रिशुल भी वहाँ अपनी जाज्वल्यमान कान्ति से १रम शोभा प्राप्त करता है। उस त्रिशुल का लक्ष्य कभी विफल होने वाला नहीं है। देवाधिदेव महान्
verses.wordMeaning: The space of Brahmanda above Brahmaloka is fifteen million Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The space of Brahmanda above Brahmaloka is fifteen million Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: साङ्गोपाङ्गास् तु ते वेदाः शास्त्राणि विविधानि च । प्रतिभास्यन्ति ते विप्र मदीयो ऽस्तु वरस्त्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sāṅgopāṅgās tu te vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca / pratibhāsyanti te vipra madīyo 'stu varastvayam
verses.translation: This is the highest point that can be reached. Beyond that no one can go. The eternal, uncountable, subtle raki tis supported by mutual Gunas exist there. Their attribute is to create the Ksetrajnci termed Brahma who makes them function and is present there.
verses.hindi: पराक्रमशाली भगवान् के समीप परम तेजोमय तलवार एवं शीतलरश्मि चन्द्रमा सुशोभित हैं । अपने तेज शरीर एवं कान्ति से वे वेदी में अग्नि की ज्वाला की तरह अधिक सुशोभित होते हैं । देव के सम्मुख सुवर्णमय, महान् कमण्डलु जल समेत विराजमान है, उसकी शोभा की एक निराली छटा रहती है । अपने अंग में तलवार लटकाये हुये, पीले रंग का वस्त्र धारण किये, वक्षःस्थल पर एक विशाल मुक्ता की माला घारण
verses.wordMeaning: This is the highest point that can be reached. Beyond that no one can go. The eternal, uncountable, subtle raki tis supported by mutual Gunas exist there. Their attribute is to create the Ksetrajnci termed Brahma who makes them function and is present there.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the highest point that can be reached. Beyond that no one can go. The eternal, uncountable, subtle raki tis supported by mutual Gunas exist there. Their attribute is to create the Ksetrajnci termed Brahma who makes them function and is present there.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य बटुभिः सार्धं स चिक्रीड यथासुखम् । द्वितीये तु ततः प्राप्ते दिवसे नर्मदाजले
verses.transliteration: praṇamya baṭubhiḥ sārdhaṃ sa cikrīḍa yathāsukham / dvitīye tu tataḥ prāpte divase narmadājale
verses.translation: It is in them that all these exist: the possessor of lakrti, the subtle, supporting, the eternal one, the unproduc¬ ed, great abode, the great atom, the great one lying down, the undying, the unimaginable, unembodied, the mental form, the manifestation, the disappearance, the maintenance and the blessing. Vidhi (Brahma) cannot be compared to anyone else. The great IiSvara is like Paramanu. With his brilliance he makes this illuminated. He is beyond the darkness.
verses.hindi: १०२२ वायुपुराणम् असिमावेश्य चाद्भंषु पाण्डुराम्बरधारिणी । उरश्छेदेन महता मोक्तिकेन विराजिता ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is in them that all these exist: the possessor of lakrti, the subtle, supporting, the eternal one, the unproduc¬ ed, great abode, the great atom, the great one lying down, the undying, the unimaginable, unembodied, the mental form, the manifestation, the disappearance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is in them that all these exist: the possessor of lakrti, the subtle, supporting, the eternal one, the unproduc¬ ed, great abode, the great atom, the great one lying down, the undying, the unimaginable, unembodied, the mental form, the manifestation, the disappearance,…

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडनार्थं गताः सर्वे सोपाध्याया युधिष्ठिर । ततः स्मृत्वा पणं सर्वे भाषयित्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: krīḍanārthaṃ gatāḥ sarve sopādhyāyā yudhiṣṭhira / tataḥ smṛtvā paṇaṃ sarve bhāṣayitvā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: The golden egg that was evolved at the outset as Aupasargika (a relevant adjunct) was very huge and wholly circular. It was evolved out of Isvara.
verses.hindi: चतुर्भूजा महाभागा विजया लोकसंमता २७४ देव्या आद्यप्रतीहारी श्रीरिवाप्रतिमा परा । विश्ञाजन्ती स्थिता,चेव कृत्वा देवस्य चाझुजलिम्
verses.wordMeaning: The golden egg that was evolved at the outset as Aupasargika (a relevant adjunct) was very huge and wholly circular. It was evolved out of Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The golden egg that was evolved at the outset as Aupasargika (a relevant adjunct) was very huge and wholly circular. It was evolved out of Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: उपाध्यायमथोवाच नत्वा देवः कृताञ्जलिः । जले प्रक्षेपयाम्यद्य निष्प्रतिज्ञान् बटून् प्रभो
verses.transliteration: upādhyāyamathovāca natvā devaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ / jale prakṣepayāmyadya niṣpratijñān baṭūn prabho
verses.translation: The germination of seed is from Isvara. Ksetrajria (individual soul) is considered as the seed. They speak of Prakrti as the Toni (the source of the origin) and that is of the nature of Narayana.
verses.hindi: तस्था: पृष्ठानुगाश्रान्या: स्त्रियोडप्सरोगणान्विता: । ता: खल्वभिनवे:ः कान्‍्तेरुपतिष्ठन्ति शंकरम् सर्वलक्षणसंपन्ना वादित्रेर्षव् हिताः । उपगायन्ति देवेशं गणा गन्धर्वयोनयः २७७
verses.wordMeaning: The germination of seed is from Isvara. Ksetrajria (individual soul) is considered as the seed. They speak of Prakrti as the Toni (the source of the origin) and that is of the nature of Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The germination of seed is from Isvara. Ksetrajria (individual soul) is considered as the seed. They speak of Prakrti as the Toni (the source of the origin) and that is of the nature of Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: तद्देवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नष्टास्ते बटवो नृप । गुरोस्तु पश्यतो राजन्धावमाना दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: taddevasya vacaḥ śrutvā naṣṭāste baṭavo nṛpa / gurostu paśyato rājandhāvamānā diśo daśa
verses.translation: The creator of all the worlds, the noble-souled omni¬ present lord in contact with Prakrti creates Brahmaloka and Brahmanda through his body, for the purpose of the creation and maintenance of the worlds.
verses.hindi: ते; साथ स महावीय: शोभते शिखिवाहनः । व्यालक्कीडनकंस्तत्र क्रोडते विश्वतोमुखः ॥ २ १ ये नूपा विदुधेन्राणां काश्चनस्थ प्रदायिन:  ये च स्वायतना विप्रा गुहस्था ब्रह्मवादिनः २८२ गृहस्वाध्यायतपसस्तथा चेबोजूछव॒त्तयः । एते समासदस्तस्य देवेशस्थ च संभताः रदरे
verses.wordMeaning: The creator of all the worlds, the noble-souled omni¬ present lord in contact with Prakrti creates Brahmaloka and Brahmanda through his body, for the purpose of the creation and maintenance of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creator of all the worlds, the noble-souled omni¬ present lord in contact with Prakrti creates Brahmaloka and Brahmanda through his body, for the purpose of the creation and maintenance of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: वायुवेगेन देवेन लुञ्जितास्ते समन्ततः । भारं बद्ध्वा तु सर्वेषां बटूनां च नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: vāyuvegena devena luñjitāste samantataḥ / bhāraṃ baddhvā tu sarveṣāṃ baṭūnāṃ ca nareśvara
verses.translation: Beyond Brahmaloka and beneath the upper crust of the Cosmic Egg—in between these two is the Pur a (city), his divine abode Manomaya (consisting of the mind). l
verses.hindi: किये चार भुजाओं से सुशोभित लोक सम्माननीय महाभाग्यशालिनी देवी विजया भी वहाँ स्थित हैं ।२७:१- २७४। वह देवी की सबंप्रथम प्रतिहारिणी है, रूप में धुसरी लक्ष्मी के समान अनृपम है । भगवान् शंकर की ओर अंजलि बाँधे हुए वहाँ पर उसकी परम शोभा होती है । उसके पीछे अन्य अनुगामी स्त्रियाँ रहती हैं, उनके साथ भप्सराओं के झुण्ड रहते हैं। वे सब भी अपने अभिनव कान्‍्तों के साथ हांंकर की उपासना में तललीन रहती हैं। सर्वृलक्षण-सम्पन्न, विविध प्रकार के वाद्यों से समन्वित भन्धवों कौ टोलियाँ देवेश के समक्ष गायन, वादन करती हैं। उनके उस सुन्दर प्रासाद में अति विशाल वक्ष:स्थल शरत्कालीन मेघ के समान गोपति “नन्‍दीश्वर) आनन्द का अनुभव करता हुआ सुशोभित है। रक्त वर्ण के वस्त्र को धारण किये हुए, परम शोभा सम्पन्न, कमल दल के समान सुन्दर नेत्रवाले उनके अमित पराक्रमशाली पत्र स्कन्द भी वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: Beyond Brahmaloka and beneath the upper crust of the Cosmic Egg—in between these two is the Pur a (city), his divine abode Manomaya (consisting of the mind). l
verses.commentary: Sense: Beyond Brahmaloka and beneath the upper crust of the Cosmic Egg—in between these two is the Pur a (city), his divine abode Manomaya (consisting of the mind). l

verses.sanskrit: शापानुग्रहको देवो ऽक्षिपत्तोये यथा गृहे । ततो विषादमगमद्दृष्ट्वा तान् नर्मदाजले
verses.transliteration: śāpānugrahako devo 'kṣipattoye yathā gṛhe / tato viṣādamagamaddṛṣṭvā tān narmadājale
verses.translation: That is the abode of the embodied Isvara of un¬ measured splendour. The city named Siva is there and it is the refuge of those who are afraid of rebirth.
verses.hindi: सपरिवार सुशोभित हैं। शाख, विशाख और नेगमेय प्रभूति अनुचर गण भी उनके साथ विराजमान हैं, जो प्रकृति से परम क्रूर किन्तु प्रजा पालन में दत्तचित्त एवं व्यसनों से विहीन हैं, उन अनुचरों के साथ महान् पराक्रमी, शिखि वाहन, विश्वतो मुख स्कन्द व्यालक्रीड़ा का अनुभव करते हैं ।२७५-२९०१। जो राजा लोग विद्वान् पण्डितेन्द्रों को सुवर्ण की दक्षिणा देते हैं, जो विष्र अपने गृह पर निवास करते हुये भी ब्रह्म-चिन्तन
verses.wordMeaning: That is the abode of the embodied Isvara of un¬ measured splendour. The city named Siva is there and it is the refuge of those who are afraid of rebirth.
verses.commentary: Sense: That is the abode of the embodied Isvara of un¬ measured splendour. The city named Siva is there and it is the refuge of those who are afraid of rebirth.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुणा बटुरुक्तो ऽथ किमेतत्साहसं कृतम् । एतेषां मातृपितरो बालकानां गृहे ऽङ्गनाः
verses.transliteration: guruṇā baṭurukto 'tha kimetatsāhasaṃ kṛtam / eteṣāṃ mātṛpitaro bālakānāṃ gṛhe 'ṅganāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, it is full one hundred thou¬ sand Yojanas in extent. Within, it is as extensive as the sphere of the Earth.
verses.hindi: में निरत रहते हैं, जो उंछ व॒त्ति से जीविका निर्वाह करनेवाले ब्रद्मचारी गण सर्वदा स्वाध्याय एवं तपस्या में लीन रहते हैं, वे देवाषिदेव शंकर की इस पुरी में उनकी सभा के सभ्य होते हैं। अनेक मन्वन्तर व्यतीत होकर पुनः पुनः प्रारम्भ होते हैं, किन्तु महादेव की बह सभा पृव॑वत प्रतिष्ठित है। देवदेव की अन्य सन्वन्तराण्यनेकानि व्यवतंस्त पुनः पुनः । भ्रूयतां देवदेवस्य भविष्याश्चयंसुत्तमम् २८४ ब्याप्राश्चेवानुगास्तत्र काश्वनाभास्तरस्विन: । स्वच्छन्दचारिणः सर्वे स्वयं देवेन नि्मिताः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, it is full one hundred thou¬ sand Yojanas in extent. Within, it is as extensive as the sphere of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, it is full one hundred thou¬ sand Yojanas in extent. Within, it is as extensive as the sphere of the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: यदि पृच्छन्ति ते बालान् क्व गतान् कथयाम्यहम् । एवं स्थिते महाभाग यदि कश्चिन्मरिष्यति
verses.transliteration: yadi pṛcchanti te bālān kva gatān kathayāmyaham / evaṃ sthite mahābhāga yadi kaścinmariṣyati
verses.translation: It is surrounded by a massive gold rampart of solar splendour. It has brilliance of the mid-day Sun outshining the lustre of all others. It has four golden portals embellished with strings of pearls. The enclosures are well-constructed with bright golden adjuncts.
verses.hindi: मृत्योमृ त्युसमास्ते तु यमदर्पापहारिण:ः । विभुतिमप्यसंख्येयां को न खल्वभिधास्यते १२८६
verses.wordMeaning: It is surrounded by a massive gold rampart of solar splendour. It has brilliance of the mid-day Sun outshining the lustre of all others. It has four golden portals embellished with strings of pearls. The enclosures are well-constructed with bright golden adjuncts.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surrounded by a massive gold rampart of solar splendour. It has brilliance of the mid-day Sun outshining the lustre of all others. It has four golden portals embellished with strings of pearls. The enclosures are well-constructed with bright golden adjuncts.

verses.sanskrit: तदा स्वकीयजीवेन त्वं योजयितुम् अर्हसि । मृतेषु तेषु विप्रेषु न जीवे निश्चयो मृतः
verses.transliteration: tadā svakīyajīvena tvaṃ yojayitum arhasi / mṛteṣu teṣu vipreṣu na jīve niścayo mṛtaḥ
verses.translation: That divine city (shines well) with the sounds of bells reverberating in the sky. Neither the fear of death, nor distress nor the exhaustion of old age finds a place there.
verses.hindi: मन्दाराद्रिप्रकाशानां बलेनाप्रतिमौजसाम् । हारकुन्देन्दृवर्णानां विद्युरुधननिनादिनाम् ॥ै२८८ चडामणिधराणां वे मेघसंनिभवाससाम् । श्रीवत्साड्िःतवज्ञाणामहःगुलीशुलपाणिनामू एवं विशानां देवानां रुपेणोत्तमशालिनाम् । तस्थ प्रासादसुख्यस्य स्तम्भेष्त्तमशोभिषु १२६०
verses.wordMeaning: That divine city (shines well) with the sounds of bells reverberating in the sky. Neither the fear of death, nor distress nor the exhaustion of old age finds a place there.
verses.commentary: Sense: That divine city (shines well) with the sounds of bells reverberating in the sky. Neither the fear of death, nor distress nor the exhaustion of old age finds a place there.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्याश्च ते बह्व्यो भविष्यन्ति मृते मयि । द्विजबन्धनमात्रेण नरको भवति ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāśca te bahvyo bhaviṣyanti mṛte mayi / dvijabandhanamātreṇa narako bhavati dhruvam
verses.translation: No other city deserves to be compared to this city. It extends to a hundred thousaud Yojanas to the ten quarters.
verses.hindi: फफफझफझफ हझफह छ ७ ट उ॒ी्ुदरकर्र्ुः/'आ-३:0/0/स्‍उ)9ल्‍क्‍स्‍लेभई।ई।णप७प/”यप,य.+५प7””पप/एण/य/य/-77
verses.wordMeaning: No other city deserves to be compared to this city. It extends to a hundred thousaud Yojanas to the ten quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: No other city deserves to be compared to this city. It extends to a hundred thousaud Yojanas to the ten quarters.

verses.sanskrit: मरणाद्यां गतिं यासि न तां वेद्मि द्विजाधम । एवमुक्तः स्मितं कृत्वा देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: maraṇādyāṃ gatiṃ yāsi na tāṃ vedmi dvijādhama / evamuktaḥ smitaṃ kṛtvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: That city is pervaded by the brilliance of the bull- bannered lord and so it stands (firm). The creation of that golden city is by means of mental conception.
verses.hindi: उत्तम आश्चयं जनक घटनाएँ सुनिये  सुबर्ण के समान पीले वर्ण वाले परम वेगशाली व्याप्त उनके अनुगामी रहते हैं । वे सब अपनी इच्छा के अनुसार गमन करते हैं देवदेव ने स्वयमेव उनका निर्माण किया है ।३८१३- २५५। वे मृत्यु के लिये भी मृत्यु के समान हैं, यमराज के भी दर्पे को चूर्ण करनेवाले हैं । अर्थात् उन्हें मृत्यु का कोई भय नहीं रहता । इस प्रकार देवदेव की विभूतियों की कोई संख्या निश्चित नहीं है वे असंख्य हैं कोन उन्हें सम्पूर्णंतया बतला सकता है। अब इसके उपराच्त मैं ऐसी अद्भुत एवं उत्तम विभूतियाँ बतलाऊंगा, भव ने जिन्‍्हें जीवों के ऊपर असीम अनुग्रह करके निर्मित किया है, सुनिये । भव के उक्त उत्तम प्रासाद में जो परम शोभामय स्तम्भ लगे हुए हैं, उनमें उनकी माया द्वारा निभित एक सहन सिहगरण प्रदीप्त अग्नि के समान जाज्वल्यमान पाश द्वारा पृथक-पृथक् बंधे हुए हैं। वहाँ पर वे सुखपू्बंक निवास करते हैं। वे सिहगण
verses.wordMeaning: That city is pervaded by the brilliance of the bull- bannered lord and so it stands (firm). The creation of that golden city is by means of mental conception.
verses.commentary: Sense: That city is pervaded by the brilliance of the bull- bannered lord and so it stands (firm). The creation of that golden city is by means of mental conception.

verses.sanskrit: भारभूतेश्वरे तीर्थ उज्जहार जलाद्द्विजान् । मुक्त्वा भारं तु देवेन छादयित्वा तु तान्द्विजान्
verses.transliteration: bhārabhūteśvare tīrtha ujjahāra jalāddvijān / muktvā bhāraṃ tu devena chādayitvā tu tāndvijān
verses.translation: The city shines much with scattered diamond ust. In the gardens and parks therein, there are divine lotuses which have the lustre of the autumnal Moon, which resemble the rising Sun, which are half white and half red and which are ma e of gold. With their stalks having the lustre of Marakata (emerald) gem they are of the size of the wheels of chariots, n fragrance, beauty and tenderness they are unequalled.
verses.hindi: देखने में मस्दराचल के समान विशालाकार हैं, बल एवं तेज में उनका कोई प्रतिदवन्द्दी नहीं है, मुक्ताहार, कुन्दपुष्प एवं चन्द्रमा के समान ध्वेत उनके रंग हैं । बिजली संयुक्त मेघों की कड़क के समान वे भीषण निनाद करते हैं ।१८६-२८८। उनकी शिखाओं पर मणि शोभायमान हैं। मेघ के समान काले रंग के वस्त्रों से उनके दारीर वेष्टित हैं। श्रीवत्स चिह्न से वे सुश्योभित हैं, अपने भीषण नखों से संयुक्त अंगुलियों को धारण कर
verses.wordMeaning: The city shines much with scattered diamond ust. In the gardens and parks therein, there are divine lotuses which have the lustre of the autumnal Moon, which resemble the rising Sun, which are half white and half red and which are ma e of gold.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The city shines much with scattered diamond ust. In the gardens and parks therein, there are divine lotuses which have the lustre of the autumnal Moon, which resemble the rising Sun, which are half white and half red and which are ma e of gold.…

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गं प्रतिष्ठितं तत्र भारभूतेति विश्रुतम् । मृतांस् तान् वै द्विजान् दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्महत्या निराकृता
verses.transliteration: liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ tatra bhārabhūteti viśrutam / mṛtāṃs tān vai dvijān dṛṣṭvā brahmahatyā nirākṛtā
verses.translation: Verses 230-300 give a poetic description of the residents- therein.
verses.hindi: वे शूल पाणि के समान हैं । दशों दिशाओं में देवताओं के समान सुन्दर स्वरूपधारी वे सिंह गण त्रयम्बक के उक्त प्रासाद में श्वृद्धलावद्ध होकर विराजमान हैं। वायु के इस कथन का अभिनन्‍दन करते हुए नेमि  इत उत्तरमेक: श्लोकोधिको डः पुस्तके स यथा--सुदीर्धा रितकायानामत विक्रूरचक्षुषा म् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 230-300 give a poetic description of the residents- therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 230-300 give a poetic description of the residents- therein.

verses.sanskrit: गतानि पञ्च वै दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्महत्याशतानि वै । ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो दृष्ट्वा तान्बालकान् गुरुः
verses.transliteration: gatāni pañca vai dṛṣṭvā brahmahatyāśatāni vai / tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo dṛṣṭvā tānbālakān guruḥ
verses.translation: The following are the beautiful rivers in that excellent city: Vara, Varenya, Varada, Vararha, VaravarninI, Varama and Varabhadra.
verses.hindi: १०२४ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: The following are the beautiful rivers in that excellent city: Vara, Varenya, Varada, Vararha, VaravarninI, Varama and Varabhadra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the beautiful rivers in that excellent city: Vara, Varenya, Varada, Vararha, VaravarninI, Varama and Varabhadra.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यस्य कस्यचिच्छक्तिरेवं स्याद् ईश्वरं विना । ज्ञात्वा तं देवदेवेशं प्रणामम् अकरोद् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: nānyasya kasyacicchaktirevaṃ syād īśvaraṃ vinā / jñātvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ praṇāmam akarod dvijaḥ
verses.translation: The excellent rivers contain water shining like split jewels. It is mixed with the petals of red and blue lotuses. Foams and whirlpools add to their beauty.
verses.hindi: भगवस्सवे भृतानां प्राण स्वेत्रग प्रभो  के ते सिहमहाभुताः कब ते जाताः किसात्मका: २९३ सिहाः केनापराधेन भुतानां प्रभविष्णुना। वेश्वानरसयः पाशः संरुद्धास्तु पृथक्पृथक् २६४ तेबां तद्वचन श्रुत्वा वायुर्वाक्यं जगाद ह्। यहे सहर्न॑ सिहानामीश्वरेण महात्मा ॥ व्यपनोय स्वकाहेहात्क़ो धास्ते सिहविप्रहाः
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent rivers contain water shining like split jewels. It is mixed with the petals of red and blue lotuses. Foams and whirlpools add to their beauty.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent rivers contain water shining like split jewels. It is mixed with the petals of red and blue lotuses. Foams and whirlpools add to their beauty.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानेन मया सव यदुक्तं परमेश्वर । अप्रियं यत्कृतं सर्वं क्षन्तव्यं तन्मम प्रभो
verses.transliteration: ajñānena mayā sava yaduktaṃ parameśvara / apriyaṃ yatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṣantavyaṃ tanmama prabho
verses.translation: Neither Brahmarsis nor Devas, nor Asuras nor Pitrs nor others knew that city of the inconceivable lord.
verses.hindi: भूतानामभयं दत्त्वा पुरा बद्धाग्गिबन्धने । यज्ञभागनिमित्तं च ईश्वरस्था55ज्ञया तदा २६६ तेषां विधानमुक्तेन सिहेने केन लीलया । देव्या भन्युं कृतं ज्ञात्वा हतो दक्षस्यथ स क्रतुः ६२६९७ निःसुता च महादेव्या महाकाली महेश्वरी । आत्मनः कर्मेसाक्षिण्या भूतः सार्घ तदाइ्नुगं:ः ॥२€८ स एप भगवान्क्रोधो रुद्रावासकृतालयः । वीरभद्रो5प्रमेयात्मा देव्या मन्युप्रमार्जनः
verses.wordMeaning: Neither Brahmarsis nor Devas, nor Asuras nor Pitrs nor others knew that city of the inconceivable lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither Brahmarsis nor Devas, nor Asuras nor Pitrs nor others knew that city of the inconceivable lord.

verses.sanskrit: देव उवाच: भगवन्गुरुर्भवान्देवो भवान्मम पितामहः । वेदगर्भ नमस्तेऽस्तु नास्ति कश्चिद्व्यतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: deva uvāca: bhagavangururbhavāndevo bhavānmama pitāmahaḥ / vedagarbha namaste'stu nāsti kaścidvyatikramaḥ
verses.translation: Only those noble-souled ones who perform meditation without agitation and who have conquered their sense-organs by means of good yogic power, see that city of the bull-banner¬ ed one.
verses.hindi: तस्य वेश्म सुरेन्द्रस्य सर्वंगुह्मतमस्य वे । संनिवेशस्त्वनौपस्थो सया वः परिकीरतितः ३०० अतः पर प्रवक्ष्यामि ये तत्र प्रतिवासिन:।  रम्ये पुरवरभ्रेष्ठे तस्मिन्वेहायभुमिषु नानारत्नविचित्रेष्ु पताकाबहुलेषु च। सर्वकाससमृद्धेषु वनोपवनशोभिषु .
verses.wordMeaning: Only those noble-souled ones who perform meditation without agitation and who have conquered their sense-organs by means of good yogic power, see that city of the bull-banner¬ ed one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only those noble-souled ones who perform meditation without agitation and who have conquered their sense-organs by means of good yogic power, see that city of the bull-banner¬ ed one.

verses.sanskrit: जनिता चोपनेता च यस्तु विद्यां प्रयच्छति । अन्नदाता भयत्राता पञ्चैते पितरः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: janitā copanetā ca yastu vidyāṃ prayacchati / annadātā bhayatrātā pañcaite pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: There is a splendid golden palace in the middle of that excellent city of unequalled splendour. It is divine and it resembles the great Meru mountain. It is enveloped in graci¬ ous glory. It has a thousand 'feet' (columns). It is embellished all round with incomparable gems and jewels.
verses.hindi: घारण्य निवासी ऋषिगण परम विस्मय विमुग्ध हो गये और बोले--समस्त जीवधघारियों के प्राण ! सबंत्र ममन करनेवाले ! महामहिमामय भगवन् वायुदेव ! वे महान् पराक्रम शाली सिंह कौन हैं ? थे कहाँ उत्पन्न हुए ? उनका स्वरूप कसा है ? परम प्रभाव शाली भगवान् शंकर ने उन सिंहों को किस अपराध के कारण अग्निमय पाशों में बाँध कर पृथक्-पृथक् कर रखा है ।२८६-२६४। ऋषियों की इस बात को सुनकर वायु बोले,
verses.wordMeaning: There is a splendid golden palace in the middle of that excellent city of unequalled splendour. It is divine and it resembles the great Meru mountain. It is enveloped in graci¬ ous glory. It has a thousand 'feet' (columns).…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a splendid golden palace in the middle of that excellent city of unequalled splendour. It is divine and it resembles the great Meru mountain. It is enveloped in graci¬ ous glory. It has a thousand 'feet' (columns).…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा जगन्नाथो विष्णुशर्माणमानतः । तत्र तीर्थे जगामाशु कैलासं धरणीधरम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā jagannātho viṣṇuśarmāṇamānataḥ / tatra tīrthe jagāmāśu kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam
verses.translation: Its splendour all round is increased by means of invaluable and incomparable gems. It is embellished in some sections with crystals, in some sections with lunar stones, in other sections with lapis lazuli, in some sections with shining gems resembling the Moon, in some with brilliant gems as beautiful as the rising Sun, in others with golden jewels refulgent like fire, in some sections with jewels shining with silver lustre, in other sections with blue sapphire gems and in some sections with firmly fixed diamonds. It was heightened in splendour by means of brilliant windows and ventilators of various sizes. It is decorated with festoons and flags shining like the rays of the Moon. Sounds of golden bells reverberate in it. Joy and revelry are ever present there. Its refulgence is heightened by the residences of Kinnaras, which have the shape and lustre of the evening clouds. Just as the mountain-lord Meru shines with its golden peaks, so also the palace shines with shining water currents all round abounding in golden flowers.
verses.hindi: ऋषि गण ! वे एक सहस्न सिह, जिनकी महात्मा भगवान् शंकर ने अपने शरीर से अलग करके सृष्टि की है, उनके क्रोध के भूत रूप हैं, जीवों को अभयदान देकर उन्होंने उन सब को भग्नि के पाशों में बाँध रखा है । प्राचीन काल में दक्ष प्रजापति के साथ यज्ञभाग के सम्बन्ध में बिरोध होने पर भगवान् की आज्ञा से उन सहस्न सिंहों में से केवल एक सिह छूटा था, जिसने महादेवी उम्रा के अमर्ष को देखकर लीला पूर्वक दक्ष के यज्ञ का सर्वाशत; विताश कर दिया था। उस समय महादेवी के शरीर से महेश्वरी महाकाली अपने कर्मों को साक्षिणी होकर अपने अनुचर भृूतगणों के साथ प्रादुर्भूत हुई थीं । रुद्र के उक्त आवास स्थल में निवास करने वाले भगवान् क्रोध हो तथोक्त वीर भद्र हैं, जो देवी के अमर्ष को दूर करने के लिये अति भीषण शरीर धारण कर प्रादुर्भूत हुए । परम गोपनोय सुरेश्वर दांकर के उक्त प्रासाद का सविस्तार वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Its splendour all round is increased by means of invaluable and incomparable gems. It is embellished in some sections with crystals, in some sections with lunar stones, in other sections with lapis lazuli, in some sections with shining gems resembling the Moon,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Its splendour all round is increased by means of invaluable and incomparable gems. It is embellished in some sections with crystals, in some sections with lunar stones, in other sections with lapis lazuli, in some sections with shining gems resembling the Moon,…

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं भारभूतीति विश्रुतम् । विख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ bhārabhūtīti viśrutam / vikhyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu mahāpātakanāśanam
verses.translation: In this abode of the three-eyed lord there is a statue of Vasanta (Spring). The goddesses LaksmI, Sri, Kirti Sobha and Sarasvatl are present there in physical bodies (crea¬ ted through Maya). These eternal goddesses endowed with beauty and fragrance are innumerable and of mutually depen¬ dent (complementary) qualities. They are the ornaments of all precious stones and source of the origin of loveliness and dalliance. The highly blessed goddesses divided them-elves into a hundred crores and diligently wait upon the Lord with Uma.
verses.hindi: आप लोगों से कर चुका, उसके समान कोई अन्य प्रासाद नहीं है, समस्त त्रलोक्य में वह अनृपम है
verses.wordMeaning: In this abode of the three-eyed lord there is a statue of Vasanta (Spring). The goddesses LaksmI, Sri, Kirti Sobha and Sarasvatl are present there in physical bodies (crea¬ ted through Maya).…
verses.commentary: Sense: In this abode of the three-eyed lord there is a statue of Vasanta (Spring). The goddesses LaksmI, Sri, Kirti Sobha and Sarasvatl are present there in physical bodies (crea¬ ted through Maya).…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे पुनर्वृत्तमितिहासं ब्रवीमि ते । सर्वपापहरं दिव्यमेकाग्रस्त्वं शृणुष्व तत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe punarvṛttamitihāsaṃ bravīmi te / sarvapāpaharaṃ divyamekāgrastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat
verses.translation: They have thousands of other maid-servants behind them, beautiful and endowed with splendour and glory. They all have eyes like the petals of lotuses.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद उक्त पुरी में अवस्थित अन्य वस्तुओं एवं व्यक्तियों का वर्णन कर रहा हूँ। अध्तरिक्ष में अवस्थित उस परमरम्य शिवपुरी में अनेक सुन्दर प्रासाद बने हुए हैं, जो विविध प्रकार के रत्नों से चित्रित एवं जठित राजतेषु महान्तेषु शातकोम्भमयेषु च। संध्याभ्रसंनिकाशेषु कलासप्रतिमेषु च
verses.wordMeaning: They have thousands of other maid-servants behind them, beautiful and endowed with splendour and glory. They all have eyes like the petals of lotuses.
verses.commentary: Sense: They have thousands of other maid-servants behind them, beautiful and endowed with splendour and glory. They all have eyes like the petals of lotuses.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ वैश्यः कश्चिन्महामनाः । सुकेश इति विख्यातस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽतिधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: purā kṛtayugasyādau vaiśyaḥ kaścinmahāmanāḥ / sukeśa iti vikhyātastasya putro 'tidhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: They rejoice along with the Ganas as huge as moun¬ tains and as brilliant as fire; they exhibit their extremely attrac¬ tive amorous gestures and sportive activities.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मघोष रविरता: कथाश्व विविधा: शुभा:  गीतवादित्रघोषाश्च संस्तवाधभ्न समन्ततः ३३०५ संहताभ्रेवमतुला नानाश्रयक्ृतास्तथा । एवमादोनि वतंन्‍्ते तेषां प्रासादमुर्धनि
verses.wordMeaning: They rejoice along with the Ganas as huge as moun¬ tains and as brilliant as fire; they exhibit their extremely attrac¬ tive amorous gestures and sportive activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: They rejoice along with the Ganas as huge as moun¬ tains and as brilliant as fire; they exhibit their extremely attrac¬ tive amorous gestures and sportive activities.

verses.sanskrit: सोमशर्मेति विख्यातो मृतः पृथुललोचनः । स सखायं वणिक्पुत्रं कंचिच् चक्रे दरिद्रिणम्
verses.transliteration: somaśarmeti vikhyāto mṛtaḥ pṛthulalocanaḥ / sa sakhāyaṃ vaṇikputraṃ kaṃcic cakre daridriṇam
verses.translation: Some are hunch-backed; some are dwarfish; some
verses.hindi: स्फटिकेश्वन्द्रसंकाशवबेंदुर्य मणिसंप्रभे: । बालसुययंमयश्रापि सोवर्णेश्वार्निसप्रभः ३०८ के तु तत्न महात्मानो ये भवस्यानुसारिण: । अनुग्राह्मतमाः सम्यकप्रमोदन्‍्ते पुरोत्तमे ऋषोीणां वचन श्रुत्वा वायुर्वक्यमथाब्रवोत् १३१०
verses.wordMeaning: Some are hunch-backed; some are dwarfish; some
verses.commentary: Sense: Some are hunch-backed; some are dwarfish; some

verses.sanskrit: सुदेवमिति ख्यातं सर्वकर्मसु कोविदम् । एकदा तु समं तेन व्यवहारमचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: sudevamiti khyātaṃ sarvakarmasu kovidam / ekadā tu samaṃ tena vyavahāramacintayat
