verses.translation: He stands with his right arm (hand) clasping the left arm (hand) and keeping both of them clinging to his side— the hand that has destroyed the enemies of Devas and has never exhausted by fatigue in battles. In his left hand shines the weapon Pattis'a (a spear with a sharp edge). There also shines much his wonderful bow of ten colours, the twanging sound of which is very terrible. There is no other bow to equal its strength.
verses.hindi: हैं, असंख्य पताकाएँ उनकी शोभा वृद्धि कर रही हैं। सभी मनोरथों को वे पूर्ण करने वाले हैं। सुन्दर वनों एवं उपवर्नों से उनकी एक निराली छटा है। उनमें से कितने विशाल प्रासाद चाँदी के और कितने स्वच्छ सुबर्ण के हैं। कितनों की शोभा सायच्ुालीन मेघों के समान लाल वर्ण की ओर कितनों की कलास- शिखर के समान श्वेत वर्ण की है। उन सुरम्य प्रसादों में भव के सद॒त्नत परायण अनुचर गण अभिमत
verses.wordMeaning: He stands with his right arm (hand) clasping the left arm (hand) and keeping both of them clinging to his side— the hand that has destroyed the enemies of Devas and has never exhausted by fatigue in battles.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He stands with his right arm (hand) clasping the left arm (hand) and keeping both of them clinging to his side— the hand that has destroyed the enemies of Devas and has never exhausted by fatigue in battles.…

verses.sanskrit: सखे समुद्रयानेन गच्छावोत्तरणैः शुभैः । भाण्डं बहु समादाय मदीये द्रव्यसाधने
verses.transliteration: sakhe samudrayānena gacchāvottaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ / bhāṇḍaṃ bahu samādāya madīye dravyasādhane
verses.translation: Again there is his Trident which has the refulgence of lightening. It never fails in destroying enemies. It has the most excessive splendour and it blazes brilliantly.
verses.hindi: संगीतादि विविध भोपोपयोगी साधनों से आनन्द का अनुभव करते हैं। वहाँ चारों ओर ब्रह्नचर्चा का सुरम्य स्वर गुंजरित होता रहता है। विविध कल्याण दायिनी पोराणिक कथाएं बराबर चलती रहती हैं, मायन, वादन, स्तोत्नादि सभी भोर चलते रहते हैं  उक्त विविध प्रकार के स्व॒रों स्रे एक विचित्र मनोहारिणी दशा वहाँ की हो जाती है, उसकी तुलना कहीं अन्यत्र से नहों दी जा सकती। वहाँ के सभी गुहों में उक्त मांगलिक कथाओं , स्तोन्नों, गायन-वादमादि मनोरंजक साधनों का कार्यक्रम चलता है। ऐसे अनेक सुरम्य प्रासादों में एक स्ंश्रेष्ठ प्रासाद है, जो सहस्न चरणों (स्तम्भों) से सुश्नोभित एवं सुवर्णमय है। सभी ओर से अनृपम रत्न उसमें विभूषित हो रहे हैं । उन रत्नों में से कितने चन्द्रमा के समान शुभ्र स्फटिक के समान निमंल, वेदूयंमण के समान देदीप्यमान, उदयकालीन सूर्य के समान मनोहर एवं तेजस्वी, अग्नि एवं सुवर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: Again there is his Trident which has the refulgence of lightening. It never fails in destroying enemies. It has the most excessive splendour and it blazes brilliantly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again there is his Trident which has the refulgence of lightening. It never fails in destroying enemies. It has the most excessive splendour and it blazes brilliantly.

verses.sanskrit: परं तीरं गमिष्याव उत्कर्षस्त्वावयोः समः । इति तौ मन्त्रयित्वा तु मन्त्रवत् समभीप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: paraṃ tīraṃ gamiṣyāva utkarṣastvāvayoḥ samaḥ / iti tau mantrayitvā tu mantravat samabhīpsitam
verses.translation: The sword of the noble-souled lord of Devas is the most excellent of all shining objects. Similarly does the cool-rayed Moon shine with its brilliant splendour and gorgeous body like the flame of fire in the sacrificial altar.
verses.hindi: के समान सुन्दर हैं ॥ वायु के इस वर्णन को सुनकर नेमिषारण्य निवासों तपस्वी ऋषिवन्द परम विस्मित एबं संशयित होकर समीरण से बोले
verses.wordMeaning: The sword of the noble-souled lord of Devas is the most excellent of all shining objects. Similarly does the cool-rayed Moon shine with its brilliant splendour and gorgeous body like the flame of fire in the sacrificial altar.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sword of the noble-souled lord of Devas is the most excellent of all shining objects. Similarly does the cool-rayed Moon shine with its brilliant splendour and gorgeous body like the flame of fire in the sacrificial altar.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं प्रयाणकं गृह्य ह्यारूढौ लवणोदधिम् । तौ गत्वा तु परं भाण्डं विक्रीय पुरतस्तदा
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ prayāṇakaṃ gṛhya hyārūḍhau lavaṇodadhim / tau gatvā tu paraṃ bhāṇḍaṃ vikrīya puratastadā
verses.translation: In front of the lord is the great golden Kamandalu (water pot). It is full of water and it shines splendidly.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने पूछा-- भगवन् वायु देव ! उस पुरश्रेष्ठ में निवास करनेवाले शिव के अनुगामी महात्मागण कौन हैं जो वहाँ सभी सुखों का अनुभव करते हैं। ऋषियों के इस वचन को सुनक्तर वायु बोले १०७२६ ...... वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: In front of the lord is the great golden Kamandalu (water pot). It is full of water and it shines splendidly.
verses.commentary: Sense: In front of the lord is the great golden Kamandalu (water pot). It is full of water and it shines splendidly.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तौ बहु सुवर्णं च रत्नानि विविधानि च । नावं तां संगतां कृत्वा पश्चात् तावारुरोहतुः
verses.transliteration: prāptau bahu suvarṇaṃ ca ratnāni vividhāni ca / nāvaṃ tāṃ saṃgatāṃ kṛtvā paścāt tāvārurohatuḥ
verses.translation: The first (or the head) female doorkeeper (port¬ ress) of the goddess, named Vijaya stands there shining splen¬ didly after making obeisance to the lord. She is a blessed lady with four arms. She is very popular. She wears whitish garments. A sword hangs from her (waist). There is a great pearl necklace covering her chest. She shines like another goddess Sri. She is unequalled and great.
verses.hindi: .. वायुरुवाच श्र॒यतां देवदेवस्थ भक्तियेरनुकल्पिता । ह्लीमन्‍्तः सुजिता दान्ताः शोयंयुक्ता ह्मलोलुपाः ३११
verses.wordMeaning: The first (or the head) female doorkeeper (port¬ ress) of the goddess, named Vijaya stands there shining splen¬ didly after making obeisance to the lord. She is a blessed lady with four arms. She is very popular. She wears whitish garments. A sword hangs from her (waist).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The first (or the head) female doorkeeper (port¬ ress) of the goddess, named Vijaya stands there shining splen¬ didly after making obeisance to the lord. She is a blessed lady with four arms. She is very popular. She wears whitish garments. A sword hangs from her (waist).…

verses.sanskrit: नावमन्तर्जले दृष्ट्वा निशीथे स्वर्णसंभृताम् । दृष्ट्वा तु सोमशर्माणमुत्सङ्गे कृतमस्तकम्
verses.transliteration: nāvamantarjale dṛṣṭvā niśīthe svarṇasaṃbhṛtām / dṛṣṭvā tu somaśarmāṇamutsaṅge kṛtamastakam
verses.translation: There are other ladies behind her. They are accom¬ panied by groups of celestial ladies. With their newly wed and beloved husbands they worship Sankara.
verses.hindi: तेलब्धं रुद्रमालोक्यं शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् । भवस्थ रूपसादुश्यं नीताश्चव ह्ानुत्तमम् ३३१४ तरुणादित्यसंकाशाः सर्वे ते पीतवाससः । पिनाकपाणयः सर्वे श्वेतगोवृषवाहनाः
verses.wordMeaning: There are other ladies behind her. They are accom¬ panied by groups of celestial ladies. With their newly wed and beloved husbands they worship Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other ladies behind her. They are accom¬ panied by groups of celestial ladies. With their newly wed and beloved husbands they worship Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: शयानमतिविश्वस्तं सहदेवो व्यचिन्तयत् । एष निद्रावशं यातो मयि प्राणान्निधाय वै
verses.transliteration: śayānamativiśvastaṃ sahadevo vyacintayat / eṣa nidrāvaśaṃ yāto mayi prāṇānnidhāya vai
verses.translation: Groups of Gandharvas endowed with all characteristic features and accompanied by all musical instruments, sing songs of prayer before the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: श्रियाउन्विताः कुण्डलिनो मुक्ताहारविभूषिताः । तेजसो5स्यधिका देवेः सर्वज्ञा: सर्वदशिनः.
verses.wordMeaning: Groups of Gandharvas endowed with all characteristic features and accompanied by all musical instruments, sing songs of prayer before the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Groups of Gandharvas endowed with all characteristic features and accompanied by all musical instruments, sing songs of prayer before the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: अस्याधीनमिदं सर्वं द्रव्यरत्नम् अशेषतः । उत्कर्षार्द्धं तु मे दद्यात्तत्र गत्वेति वा न वा
verses.transliteration: asyādhīnamidaṃ sarvaṃ dravyaratnam aśeṣataḥ / utkarṣārddhaṃ tu me dadyāttatra gatveti vā na vā
verses.translation: The Lord of bulls, of broad chest and great height, shines there. He has the lustre of the autumnal cloud. He re¬ joices much in his (lord's) house.
verses.hindi: वायु ने कहा--ऋषिवुन्द ! सुनिये। जो देव-देव भगवान् छांकर की भक्ति करते हैं, भौर सवंदा लज्जान्वित, तपस्या के क्लेशों को सहन करने में सशक्त, पराक्रमशील, अलोलुप, मिताहांर विहार परायण, आत्मा में रमण श्लील (आत्म चिन्तन में निरत) जितेन्द्रिय, सुख दुःखादि द्वल्हों से परे, महोत्सव सम्पन्न, सब क॑ साथ बन्धुत्व का व्यवहार माचते हुए, मत्सरादि से विहीन, भाव प्रवण, सभी जीवों में समदर्शिता का व्यवहार रखते हुए, आकुलता रहित, मनस्ता, वाचा, कमंणा एवं विशुद्ध अन्तरात्मा से भक्ति
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord of bulls, of broad chest and great height, shines there. He has the lustre of the autumnal cloud. He re¬ joices much in his (lord's) house.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord of bulls, of broad chest and great height, shines there. He has the lustre of the autumnal cloud. He re¬ joices much in his (lord's) house.

verses.sanskrit: इति निश्चित्य मनसा पापस्तं लवणोदधौ । चिक्षेप सोमशर्माणं पापध्यातेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: iti niścitya manasā pāpastaṃ lavaṇodadhau / cikṣepa somaśarmāṇaṃ pāpadhyātena cetasā
verses.translation: Then there is Skanda, his son, of unmeasured prowess.
verses.hindi: रख एवं अनन्य चित्त होकर शिव. की शरण में जाते हैं, वे द्वी रुद्र का सायुज्य पद प्राप्त करते हैं, जो दाश्वत एवं अविनश्वर है। यही नहीं प्रत्युत वे भव के सर्वेश्रेष्ठ स्वरूप में भी समानता प्राप्त करते हैं । वे सभी छिवपुर निवासी अग्नि के समान मुझ्षधाले सब तरह के स्व्रह्प धारण करने में सशक्त, जठाजूट धारो, नीलकण्ठ, खवेतग्रीव, तीक्षण दाँत, त्रिलोचन, अद्धंचरद्र को शिर में घारण करने वाले, जढाओं के मुकुट से
verses.wordMeaning: Then there is Skanda, his son, of unmeasured prowess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then there is Skanda, his son, of unmeasured prowess.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तीर्य तरणात् तस्माद् गत्वा संगृह्य तद्धनम् । ततः कतिपयाहोभिः संयुक्तः कालधर्मणा
verses.transliteration: uttīrya taraṇāt tasmād gatvā saṃgṛhya taddhanam / tataḥ katipayāhobhiḥ saṃyuktaḥ kāladharmaṇā
verses.translation: He has four followers (attendants), viz. Sakha Visakha, Naigameya and Astavan (?) They are devoid of vicious indulgence. They are not cruel. They are engaged in protecting the subjects. The deity having peacock for his vehicle (i.e. Skanda) shines in their company. He has great prowess. There, the lord having faces all round (i.e. six-faced) sports with big serpents as his toys.
verses.hindi: विभूषित, वीर तथा दस भुजाओं से सुशोभित होते हैं, उनके बारीणर से पद्म के अन्तर्भाग की भांति भीनौ« भीनी सुगन्ध आती है । वे मध्यान्न के सूयं को तरह परम तेजस्वी होते हैं। सभी पीले रंग का वस्त्र धारण करते हैं। सब के हाथों में पिवाक रहता है, सभी श्वेतवर्ण के वृषभ पर सवार होते हैं।३११-३१७। सुन्दर कुण्डल एवं हार से विभूषित होने पर उनकी निराली छठा होती है, वे सब के सब सर्वज्ञ, सबंद्शी एवं तेज में एक दूसरे से चढ़े बढ़े रहते हैं । वृद्धावस्था एवं मृत्यु के भय से रहित होकर वे शिवपुर निवासी अपने को अनेक
verses.wordMeaning: He has four followers (attendants), viz. Sakha Visakha, Naigameya and Astavan (?) They are devoid of vicious indulgence. They are not cruel. They are engaged in protecting the subjects. The deity having peacock for his vehicle (i.e. Skanda) shines in their company.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He has four followers (attendants), viz. Sakha Visakha, Naigameya and Astavan (?) They are devoid of vicious indulgence. They are not cruel. They are engaged in protecting the subjects. The deity having peacock for his vehicle (i.e. Skanda) shines in their company.…

verses.sanskrit: गतो यमपुरं घोरं गृहीतो यमकिंकरैः । स नीतस्तेन मार्गेण यत्र संतपते रविः
verses.transliteration: gato yamapuraṃ ghoraṃ gṛhīto yamakiṃkaraiḥ / sa nītastena mārgeṇa yatra saṃtapate raviḥ
verses.translation: Those kings who make gifts of gold to leading scholars, those householder Brahmanas who live at home ex¬ pounding Brahman, those who perform their Vedic study and penance in secret and those who maintain themselves by glean¬ ing (grains)—all these become the honoured councillors of the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: +एतच्चिह्वान्त्गक्षग्रन्थो ग. पुस्तके न विद्यते ।
verses.wordMeaning: Those kings who make gifts of gold to leading scholars, those householder Brahmanas who live at home ex¬ pounding Brahman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those kings who make gifts of gold to leading scholars, those householder Brahmanas who live at home ex¬ pounding Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा द्वादशधात्मानं सम्प्राप्ते प्रलये यथा । सुतीक्ष्णाः कण्टका यत्र यत्र श्वानः सुदारुणाः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā dvādaśadhātmānaṃ samprāpte pralaye yathā / sutīkṣṇāḥ kaṇṭakā yatra yatra śvānaḥ sudāruṇāḥ
verses.translation: Many Manvantaras expire and new Manvantaras come (yet the assembly of the lord stays as it was before). May the excellent and wonderful feats of Bhava. the lord of Devas, be heard.
verses.hindi: स्वच्छन्दगतयः सिद्धाः सिद्धेश्चास्येविबोधिताः । एकादशानां रुद्राणां कोटबो5नेका महात्मनाम् एभिः सह महात्मानों देवदेवो महेश्वरः । भक्तानुकस्पी भगवान्मोदते पावंतीपध्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: Many Manvantaras expire and new Manvantaras come (yet the assembly of the lord stays as it was before). May the excellent and wonderful feats of Bhava. the lord of Devas, be heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: Many Manvantaras expire and new Manvantaras come (yet the assembly of the lord stays as it was before). May the excellent and wonderful feats of Bhava. the lord of Devas, be heard.

verses.sanskrit: तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रा महाव्याला व्याघ्रा यत्र महावृकाः । सुतप्ता वालुका यत्र क्षुधा तृष्णा तमो महत्
verses.transliteration: tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrā mahāvyālā vyāghrā yatra mahāvṛkāḥ / sutaptā vālukā yatra kṣudhā tṛṣṇā tamo mahat
verses.translation: Tigers are his followers. They have great speed and the lustre of gold. They are created by the lord himself and they move about as they please.
verses.hindi: मातरिश्वा5ब्रवोत्पुण्यमित्येतामोश्व राच्छू ,ताम् । जब ते ऋषपः सर्वे दिवाकरसमप्रभाः
verses.wordMeaning: Tigers are his followers. They have great speed and the lustre of gold. They are created by the lord himself and they move about as they please.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tigers are his followers. They have great speed and the lustre of gold. They are created by the lord himself and they move about as they please.

verses.sanskrit: पानीयस्य कथा नास्ति न छाया नाश्रमः क्वचित् । अन्नं पानीयसहितं यावत्तद्दीयते विषम्
verses.transliteration: pānīyasya kathā nāsti na chāyā nāśramaḥ kvacit / annaṃ pānīyasahitaṃ yāvattaddīyate viṣam
verses.translation: They are like Death unto god of Death. They subdue
verses.hindi: श्र॒त्वेमां परमां पुण्यां कथां त्रयम्बकीं ततः ३२३ भूशं चानुग्रह प्राध्य है चैवाप्यनुसमस् । संभावयित्वा चाप्येनां वायुमुचुमेहाबलस् ७३२४ महादेवस्य माहात्म्यं दुविज्ञेयं सुरेरपि। स्वेन साहात्म्ययोगेन सहस्नस्याभितोजसः 0३२७
verses.wordMeaning: They are like Death unto god of Death. They subdue
verses.commentary: Sense: They are like Death unto god of Death. They subdue

verses.sanskrit: छायां संप्रार्थमानानां भृशं ज्वलति पावकः । तैर् दह्यमाना बहुशो विलपन्ति मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: chāyāṃ saṃprārthamānānāṃ bhṛśaṃ jvalati pāvakaḥ / tair dahyamānā bahuśo vilapanti muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: In strength and prowess they are unequalled.
verses.hindi: पदापपपतपयय३पिह्ानहज्ग््ल्का क भागों में विभक्तकर विविध प्रकार के अति दुलंभ उपभोग्य सामग्रियों को प्राप्तकर विविध भावों से भोगते हैं। वे सब स्वच्छन्द गमन करते हैं, सभी सिद्धियाँ उनकी वशवर्तिनी हैं, दुसरे सिद्ध गण उन्हें प्रबुद्ध करते हैं । ऐसे परम ऐश्वर्यशाली एकादश रुद्ध के गणों की संख्या शिवपुरु में अनेक को टि है। इन सबों के साथ देवदेव
verses.wordMeaning: In strength and prowess they are unequalled.
verses.commentary: Sense: In strength and prowess they are unequalled.

verses.sanskrit: हा भ्रातर्मातः पुत्रेति पतन्ति पथि मूर्छिताः । इत्थंभूतेन मार्गेण स गीतो यमकिंकरैः
verses.transliteration: hā bhrātarmātaḥ putreti patanti pathi mūrchitāḥ / itthaṃbhūtena mārgeṇa sa gīto yamakiṃkaraiḥ
verses.translation: They roar like the rumbling cloud (illuminated by) lightning.
verses.hindi: पार्यतीवल्लभ, भक्तहितकारी भगवान् महेशवर आनन्द का अनुभव करते हैं ।३१८-३२१। ऋषि वृन्द  मैं सच कह रहा हूँ कि उन शिवपुर निव सी रुद्रगणोँ की एवं परम ऐश्वयंमय भगवान् महेश्वर की विविध सम्भूतियों को अर्थात् सब की विविध रूपता को नहीं देख पाता  वे सब परस्पर अभिन्न हैं। स्वयं भगवान् के मुख से सुनी गई व्यम्बक की इस पुण्यकथा को मातरिश्वा वाबु ने जब उन सूर्य के समान परम तेजोमय ऋषियों को सुनाया तो वे परम प्रसन्न हुए और अपने को परम अनुगृहीत माना  इस पुण्य कथा का अभिनन्दन करते हुए वे सब महाबलशाली वायु से बोले
verses.wordMeaning: They roar like the rumbling cloud (illuminated by) lightning.
verses.commentary: Sense: They roar like the rumbling cloud (illuminated by) lightning.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र तिष्ठति देवेशः प्रजासंयमनो यमः । ते द्वारदेशे तं मुक्त्वाचक्षुर्यमकिंकराः
verses.transliteration: yatra tiṣṭhati deveśaḥ prajāsaṃyamano yamaḥ / te dvāradeśe taṃ muktvācakṣuryamakiṃkarāḥ
verses.translation: They wear crystalline jewels on their heads.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने कद्दा-महाभाग  आप सवे समर्थ हैं, आपने ईईवर के उस परम पुण्यमय सर्वेश्षेष्ठ अष्टम औपसण्िक निवास स्थान का श्रम एवं अन्य परिचयात्मक विवरण हम लोगों को सुनाया है; जो परमात्मा की सुगन्ध से सर्वथा समृद्ध है । महादेव का माहात्य देवताओं को भी कठिनता से विदित होता है। वे अपने ही पराक्रम हारा अमित तेजस्वी सहस्नों अनुत्ररों की सृष्टि करनेवाले हैं, द
verses.wordMeaning: They wear crystalline jewels on their heads.
verses.commentary: Sense: They wear crystalline jewels on their heads.

verses.sanskrit: बद्ध्वा तं गलपाशेन ह्यासीनं मित्रघातिनम् । अवधारय देवेश बुध्यस्व यदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: baddhvā taṃ galapāśena hyāsīnaṃ mitraghātinam / avadhāraya deveśa budhyasva yadanantaram
verses.translation: They have cloud-like dark garments (covering their bodies).
verses.hindi: जो प्रभाव आदि में उन्हीं के समाम हैं ।॥ जो भक्तों के ऊपर जनृप्रहं करने के लिए ही भक्तों के हृदय में सम्मोह (अज्ञान) का संचार नहीं करते। अनृपम शक्तिशालिनी ब्राह्मी एवं लक्ष्मी स्वयमेव जिसके व्याप्य ज्योत्स्तेव ख॑ चन्द्र विन्यस्ता विश्वरूपिणा । विभृतिश्नाजतेः्त्य्थ देवदेवस्थ वेश्मनि
verses.wordMeaning: They have cloud-like dark garments (covering their bodies).
verses.commentary: Sense: They have cloud-like dark garments (covering their bodies).

verses.sanskrit: यम उवाच: न तु पूर्वं मुखं दृष्टं मया विश्वासघातिनाम् । ये मित्रद्रोहिणः पापास् तेषां किं शासनं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yama uvāca: na tu pūrvaṃ mukhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayā viśvāsaghātinām / ye mitradrohiṇaḥ pāpās teṣāṃ kiṃ śāsanaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: They are marked with Srivatsa mark in Vajra (adamant).
verses.hindi: महादेवस्य तुल्यानां रुद्राणां तु महात्मनाम्  तत्सव॑ निखिलेनेदं वक्‍त्रादमृतनिस्रवम्
verses.wordMeaning: They are marked with Srivatsa mark in Vajra (adamant).
verses.commentary: Sense: They are marked with Srivatsa mark in Vajra (adamant).

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयो ऽत्र विचारार्थं नियुक्ता निपुणाः स्थिताः । ते यत्र ब्रुवते तत्र क्षिपध्वं मा विचार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayo 'tra vicārārthaṃ niyuktā nipuṇāḥ sthitāḥ / te yatra bruvate tatra kṣipadhvaṃ mā vicāryatām
verses.translation: Their fingers(toes) with their claws resemble the Trident and hence they are termed Sulapanin (armed with trident).
verses.hindi: प्रश्न देववर प्राण यथावद्वक्तुमहंसि स खलूबाच भगवाल्कि भूयों वर्तयाम्यहम् । कि मया चेव वक्तव्य तद्गदिष्ियामि सुब्रताः ३३९२
verses.wordMeaning: Their fingers(toes) with their claws resemble the Trident and hence they are termed Sulapanin (armed with trident).
verses.commentary: Sense: Their fingers(toes) with their claws resemble the Trident and hence they are termed Sulapanin (armed with trident).

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तास् ते तमादाय किंकराः शीघ्रगामिनः । मुनीशांस् तत्र तानूचुस् तं निवेद्य यमाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: ityuktās te tamādāya kiṃkarāḥ śīghragāminaḥ / munīśāṃs tatra tānūcus taṃ nivedya yamājñayā
verses.translation: "O omnipresent lord, O holy lord, the vital air of all living beings, who are those great beings in the forms of lions? Where are they born? Of what forms are they?
verses.hindi: द्वारा उपभुक्त होती हैं ।३२५०३२८। जिस प्रकार चर्द्रिका समस्त आकाश एवं चन्द्रमा में व्याप्त रहती है, उसौ प्रकार विश्वरूपी भगवान् द्वारा विन्यस्त बिभूति उनके उस सुंदर प्रासाद में सर्वत्र व्याप्त रहती है। ऐसे सर्वेशक्ति सम्पन्न महादेव के समान ही पराक्रमश्ाली एवं महात्मा रुद्रों की भी शक्ति है। वह सारो कथा आपके मुख से अप्ृत कौ धारा को भांति हम सबों ने भक्ति पूवंक पान की है, और उससे हम
verses.wordMeaning: "O omnipresent lord, O holy lord, the vital air of all living beings, who are those great beings in the forms of lions? Where are they born? Of what forms are they?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O omnipresent lord, O holy lord, the vital air of all living beings, who are those great beings in the forms of lions? Where are they born? Of what forms are they?

verses.sanskrit: द्विजा अनेन मित्रं स्वं प्रसुप्तं निशि घातितम् । विश्वस्तं धनलोभेन को दण्डो ऽस्य भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: dvijā anena mitraṃ svaṃ prasuptaṃ niśi ghātitam / viśvastaṃ dhanalobhena ko daṇḍo 'sya bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: What is their guilt for which those lions have been severally bound by means of Vaisvanara (fiery) fetters by the lord of all living beings?"
verses.hindi: सब को परम तृप्ति का लाभ हुआ है। उसे सुनने के उपरान्त अब कुछ भो सुनना शेष नहीं रह गया है । है देववरों के प्राण ! इसके उपरान्त आप हमारे एक अन्य प्रदन का उत्तर देने की कृपा करें ! सूत बोले--ऋषिवन्द ! नैमिषारण्यवासी ऋषियों की इस विनीत वाणी को सुनकर भगवान् वायु ने कहा, सद्व्रतपरायण ऋषिगण ! अब आप को क्या बतलाऊँ, मुझे क्या कहना है?
verses.wordMeaning: What is their guilt for which those lions have been severally bound by means of Vaisvanara (fiery) fetters by the lord of all living beings?"
verses.commentary: Sense: What is their guilt for which those lions have been severally bound by means of Vaisvanara (fiery) fetters by the lord of all living beings?"

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः । अदृष्टपूर्वमस्माभिर्वदनं मित्रघातिनाम् । कृत्वा पटान्तरे ह्येनं शृण्वन्तु गतिमस्य ताम्
verses.transliteration: munaya ūcuḥ / adṛṣṭapūrvamasmābhirvadanaṃ mitraghātinām / kṛtvā paṭāntare hyenaṃ śṛṇvantu gatimasya tām
verses.translation: On hearing their words Vayu spoke thus: f< Those thousand lions are the embodied forms of the Furies of the lord and created by the noble-souled Isvara after removing them from his own body. They are given the physical forms of lions.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों ने कहा--भगवन् वायुदेव ! भगवान् शंकर के पाश्यभाग में अवस्थित आदित्य उनके क्रोध के मूर्तरूप वे सिहगण, वश्वानरगण, भूतगण, अनुगामी व्याश्रवन्द तथा उनके साथ अन्य जिन सिद्धि प्राप्त करनेवालों की चर्चा आपने ऊपर की है - वे सब उस सर्वप्राणिविनाशक घोर महाप्रलय में किस अवस्था को प्राप्त होते हैं, आप यथार्थवेत्ता हैं, इस बातकों यथार्थतः बतल।ने की कृपा करें। मातरिश्वा
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their words Vayu spoke thus: f< Those thousand lions are the embodied forms of the Furies of the lord and created by the noble-souled Isvara after removing them from his own body. They are given the physical forms of lions.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words Vayu spoke thus: f< Those thousand lions are the embodied forms of the Furies of the lord and created by the noble-souled Isvara after removing them from his own body. They are given the physical forms of lions.

verses.sanskrit: ते शास्त्राणि विचार्याथ ऋषयश्च परस्परम् । आहूय यमदूतांस् तानूचुर्ब्राह्मणपुंगवाः
verses.transliteration: te śāstrāṇi vicāryātha ṛṣayaśca parasparam / āhūya yamadūtāṃs tānūcurbrāhmaṇapuṃgavāḥ
verses.translation: After granting the boon of freedom from fear to all living beings, they had been fettered formerly by means of the fiery bonds. When (dispute arose with Daksa) regarding his share in the Yajna, that Yajna of Daksa was completely destro¬ yed sportfully by a single lion that had been released from bondage at the behest of Isvara after knowing that the wrath of the goddess has been incurred (by him).
verses.hindi: हुत आरभ्य छण्वतामित्यन्तग्रन्थो ग. पुस्तके न विद्यते । तन्न पूर्वंगतास्तेषु कुमारा ब्रह्मण: सुता:। सनकश्न सनन्‍्दश्च तृतोयश्र सनातन: ॥३ ३७ वोलुश्च फपिलस्तेषामासुरिश्च महायशाः । मुनिः पच्चशिखश्चव ये चान्येप्प्पेवमादय: ॥रे३८ ततः काले व्यतिक्वान्ते कल्पानां पर्यये गते । महाभूतविनाशास्ते प्रलये प्रत्युपस्थिते ३३६ अनेकरुद्रकोट चस्तु या प्रसन्ना महेश्वरी । शब्दादीस्विषयान्भोगान्सत्यस्याष्टविधश्रयात्
verses.wordMeaning: After granting the boon of freedom from fear to all living beings, they had been fettered formerly by means of the fiery bonds. When (dispute arose with Daksa) regarding his share in the Yajna,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting the boon of freedom from fear to all living beings, they had been fettered formerly by means of the fiery bonds. When (dispute arose with Daksa) regarding his share in the Yajna,…

verses.sanskrit: आलोकितानि शास्त्राणि वेदाः साङ्गाः स्मृतीरपि । पुराणानि च मीमांसा दृष्टमस्माभिरत्र च
verses.transliteration: ālokitāni śāstrāṇi vedāḥ sāṅgāḥ smṛtīrapi / purāṇāni ca mīmāṃsā dṛṣṭamasmābhiratra ca
verses.translation: At that time the great goddess Mahakall came out of MahaJevI (goddess Urna), the eternal witness of all rites, along with the Bhutas (goblins) as her followers.
verses.hindi: तन्न यान्ति महात्मानः परमाणु महेश्वरम् । तरन्ति सुमहावर्ता जन्ममृत्युदर्का नदीम्
verses.wordMeaning: At that time the great goddess Mahakall came out of MahaJevI (goddess Urna), the eternal witness of all rites, along with the Bhutas (goblins) as her followers.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time the great goddess Mahakall came out of MahaJevI (goddess Urna), the eternal witness of all rites, along with the Bhutas (goblins) as her followers.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघ्ने च सुरापे च स्तेये गुर्वङ्गनागमे । निष्कृतिर्विहिता शास्त्रे कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: brahmaghne ca surāpe ca steye gurvaṅganāgame / niṣkṛtirvihitā śāstre kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: That fury is the holy lord Virabhadra who perma¬ nently resides in Rudra's abode. He is of incomprehensible form. He is the wiper (remover) of the anger of the goddess.
verses.hindi: ततः पश्यन्ति सर्वाणं (? ) परं ब्रह्माणमेव च । देव्या वे सहिताः सप्त या देव्यः परिकोरतिताः आवेश्याइ5त्मनि तास्सर्वान्संस्थायोप:दरवांस्तथा । लोकान्सप्त इमास्सर्वान्महाभूतानि पठ्च च्
verses.wordMeaning: That fury is the holy lord Virabhadra who perma¬ nently resides in Rudra's abode. He is of incomprehensible form. He is the wiper (remover) of the anger of the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: That fury is the holy lord Virabhadra who perma¬ nently resides in Rudra's abode. He is of incomprehensible form. He is the wiper (remover) of the anger of the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: ये स्त्रीघ्नाश्च गुरुघ्नाश्च ये बालब्रह्मघातिनः । विहिता निष्कृतिः शास्त्रे कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: ye strīghnāśca gurughnāśca ye bālabrahmaghātinaḥ / vihitā niṣkṛtiḥ śāstre kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the palace, the incomparable residence of the
verses.hindi: विष्णुना सह संयुक्त: करोति विकरोति च। स॒ रुद्रो यः साममयस्तथब च यजुरमयः .
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the palace, the incomparable residence of the
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the palace, the incomparable residence of the

verses.sanskrit: वापीकूपतडागानां भेत्तारो ये च पापिनः । उद्यानवाटिकानां च छेत्तारो ये च दुर्जनाः
verses.transliteration: vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ bhettāro ye ca pāpinaḥ / udyānavāṭikānāṃ ca chettāro ye ca durjanāḥ
verses.translation: Henceforth I shall describe the other residents and objects of that city which is the most excellent of all beautiful cities. It is situated in the atmospheric regions. There are man other palaces decorated wonderfully with various kinds of gems There are many flags there heightening their beauty. The palaces are richly endowed with things fulfilling all desires They are beautified splendidly by parks and gardens. Some are made of silver and some of gold. Some are like the evening clouds (red) and some resemble the Kailasa mountain fwhino All are lofty. 1 eJ -
verses.hindi: बोले, ऋषिवृष्द ! यह परम गुह्य तत्त्व है, बतला रहा हूँ सावधानता पूवंक सुनिये । उन समस्त सिद्धि प्राप्त करनेवाले शिवपुर निवासियों में जो ब्रह्मा के कुमार पुत्र सनक, सनन्‍दन, सनातन, सनतृकुमार, बोढू, कपिल आसुरि एवं महायशस्वी मुनिवर पश्चशिख ऋषि हैं, तथा इनके अतिरिक्त अन्यान्य जो ऋषि- गण हैं, वे सब के सब आदि कारण भूत अव्यक्त सत्ता की महत्ता कों जानकर पूर्व ही परम गति को प्राप्त हो जाते हैं ।३३३-३३८। तदनन्तर बहुत काल व्यतीत होने के उपरान्त कल्प समाप्ति के अवप्तर पर, जब कि समस्त महाभूतों का विनाश हो जाता है, और महाप्रलय आ जाता है, अनेक कोटि रुद्रगण सत्य का आश्रय ग्रहण कर, शब्दादि विषयों से विरक्त होकर अपने ज्ञानमय तेजोबल से समस्‍्त जीवधारियों में आत्मभाव से प्रविष्ट होकर सभी भूतों के ऊपर अनुग्रह करने के लिए अविनश्वर अच्युत बहायस पद को
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth I shall describe the other residents and objects of that city which is the most excellent of all beautiful cities. It is situated in the atmospheric regions.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth I shall describe the other residents and objects of that city which is the most excellent of all beautiful cities. It is situated in the atmospheric regions.…

verses.sanskrit: दावाग्निदाहका ये च सततं ये ऽसुहिंसकाः । न्यासापहारिणो ये च गरदाः स्वामिवञ्चकाः
verses.transliteration: dāvāgnidāhakā ye ca satataṃ ye 'suhiṃsakāḥ / nyāsāpahāriṇo ye ca garadāḥ svāmivañcakāḥ
verses.translation: In those excellent palaces, the followers of Bhava who perform good rites, rejoice enjoying various means of pleasures liked by them such as sweet melody etc.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करते हैं। वे सब महात्मा गण परमाणु स्वरूप धारी महेष्वर को प्राप्त होते हैं और वहाँ पहुँच कर जन्म मृत्यु रूप जल से प्रपूणं, भीषण भेंवरों से समन्वित भवनदी को पार कर जाते हैं। वहाँ पर ब्राप्त होकर वे सववेब्यापी परब्रह्म का दर्शन करते हैं। ऊपर जिन सात महूदेवियों की चर्चा की गई. है उनके साथ ही वे वहाँ अवस्थित होते हैं ।३३९-३४३। सिंहों एवं आदित्यों को, जिनकी संख्या एक सहन कही
verses.wordMeaning: In those excellent palaces, the followers of Bhava who perform good rites, rejoice enjoying various means of pleasures liked by them such as sweet melody etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those excellent palaces, the followers of Bhava who perform good rites, rejoice enjoying various means of pleasures liked by them such as sweet melody etc.

verses.sanskrit: मातापितृगुरूणां च त्यागिनो दोषदायिनः । स्वभर्तृवञ्चनपरा या स्त्री गर्भप्रघातिनी
verses.transliteration: mātāpitṛgurūṇāṃ ca tyāgino doṣadāyinaḥ / svabhartṛvañcanaparā yā strī garbhapraghātinī
verses.translation: Different kinds of auspicious mythological stories are
verses.hindi: जाती है, तथा वबैदवानर, भूत, व्यात्न, एवं अनुगामी रुद्रजण--इन सब को अपनी आत्मा में आविष्ट करके इन सातों लोकों को तथा पाँचों महाभूतों (पृथ्वी, जल, आकाश, अग्नि और वायु) को भी शंकर अपने में समाबिष्ट कर लेते हैं। इस प्रकार भगवान् विष्णु के साथ वे इस सृष्टि का प्रादुर्भाव एवं १०३० वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Different kinds of auspicious mythological stories are
verses.commentary: Sense: Different kinds of auspicious mythological stories are

verses.sanskrit: विवेकरहिता या स्त्री यास्नाता भोजने रता । द्विकालभोजनरतास्तथा वैष्णववासरे
verses.transliteration: vivekarahitā yā strī yāsnātā bhojane ratā / dvikālabhojanaratāstathā vaiṣṇavavāsare
verses.translation: O sages! May this be heard. 1 Only the follow¬ ing have attained Sdlokyo (residence in the same region—that of Siva) with Rudra, the eternal and never changing region. They alone attain identity of forms and excellent features with Bhava. They are the people who are devoted to the lord of
verses.hindi: स एब ओत: प्रोतश्न बहिरन्तश्र निश्चयात् । एको हि भगवाज्नाथों हानादिश्वान्तकृदृद्विजा:
verses.wordMeaning: O sages! May this be heard. 1 Only the follow¬ ing have attained Sdlokyo (residence in the same region—that of Siva) with Rudra, the eternal and never changing region. They alone attain identity of forms and excellent features with Bhava.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages! May this be heard. 1 Only the follow¬ ing have attained Sdlokyo (residence in the same region—that of Siva) with Rudra, the eternal and never changing region. They alone attain identity of forms and excellent features with Bhava.…

verses.sanskrit: तासां स्त्रीणां गतिर्दृष्टा न तु विश्वासघातिनाम् । विश्वासघातिनां पुंसां मित्रद्रोहकृतां तथा
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ strīṇāṃ gatirdṛṣṭā na tu viśvāsaghātinām / viśvāsaghātināṃ puṃsāṃ mitradrohakṛtāṃ tathā
verses.translation: Those who live in Siva's palace are all universal- formed with firc-like faces. They have kaparda (matted hair). Their throats are blue in colour, the neck white and the fangs very sharp. They are three-eyed with the crescent Moon form¬ ing their coronet. Matted hair is worn by them. All of them are heroic. They have ten arms and have the fragrance of lotus. All of them resemble the midday Sun in brilliance and wear yellow garments; all of them arc armed with Pinaka bows. They ride white bulls. They are endowed with glory; they wear ear-rings; they are embellished with pearl necklaces; in brilliance they are superior to Devas; they are omniscient and observers of everything.
verses.hindi: ततस्त ऋषयः: सर्वे दिवाकरसमप्रभाः: । स्व स्वमाधभमसंवासमारोप्याग्नि तथा5घत्मनि प्रपण्य परया भकत्या ज्ञानयुक्तेन तेजसा। तलंब्धं रुद्रसालोक्‍्यं शाश्वत पदमव्ययम् ३५१ यः पठेत्तपसा युक्तो वायुप्रोक्तमिमां स्तुतिम् । +ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वापि वेश्यों वा स्वक्षियापर: ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Those who live in Siva's palace are all universal- formed with firc-like faces. They have kaparda (matted hair). Their throats are blue in colour, the neck white and the fangs very sharp. They are three-eyed with the crescent Moon form¬ ing their coronet.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who live in Siva's palace are all universal- formed with firc-like faces. They have kaparda (matted hair). Their throats are blue in colour, the neck white and the fangs very sharp. They are three-eyed with the crescent Moon form¬ ing their coronet.…

verses.sanskrit: तेषां गतिर्न वेदेषु पुराणेषु च का कथा । इति स्थितेषु पापेषु गतिरेषां न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ gatirna vedeṣu purāṇeṣu ca kā kathā / iti sthiteṣu pāpeṣu gatireṣāṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: They divide themselves into various forms and enjoy various sports and pleasures, rare for others. They are devoid of death and old age.
verses.hindi: लभते राद्रसालोक्यं भक्तिमान्विगतज्वरः । अमद्यपश्च यः शुद्रो भवभक्तो जितेन्द्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: They divide themselves into various forms and enjoy various sports and pleasures, rare for others. They are devoid of death and old age.
verses.commentary: Sense: They divide themselves into various forms and enjoy various sports and pleasures, rare for others. They are devoid of death and old age.

verses.sanskrit: नान्या गतिर्मित्रहनने विश्वस्तघ्ने च नः श्रुतम् । इतो नीत्वा यमदूता एनं विश्वस्तघातिनम्
verses.transliteration: nānyā gatirmitrahanane viśvastaghne ca naḥ śrutam / ito nītvā yamadūtā enaṃ viśvastaghātinam
verses.translation: They can go anywhere they please. They are great Siddhas themselves and they are further enlightened by other Siddhas. Thus the attendants of the eleven Rudras of great souls are crores and crores.
verses.hindi: आशभुतसंप्लवस्थायी अप्रतीघातलक्षण:। गाणपत्यं स लभते स्थान वा सा्वकासिकम् ३५४ विनाञ दोनों करते हैं, वे रुद्र हैं, साममय हैं, यजुर्मय हैं। द्विजवृन्द ! वे बाहर भीतर सबंत्र एक निरचय से ओत-प्रोत रहते हैं! वे ही एक मात्र समस्त चराचर जगत् के नाथ हैं, उनका आदि नहीं है, वे स्वयं हो सबके अध्तकर्ता हैं। बायु की इन बातों को सुनकर दिवाकर के समान परम तेजस्वी नैमिषारण्य- निवासी वे ऋषिगण अपने-अपने आश्रम में अग्ति का आधान करके मनसा, वादा, करमंणा शुद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: They can go anywhere they please. They are great Siddhas themselves and they are further enlightened by other Siddhas. Thus the attendants of the eleven Rudras of great souls are crores and crores.
verses.commentary: Sense: They can go anywhere they please. They are great Siddhas themselves and they are further enlightened by other Siddhas. Thus the attendants of the eleven Rudras of great souls are crores and crores.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पकोटिशतं साग्रं पर्यायेण पृथक्पृथक् । नरकेषु च सर्वेषु त्रिंशत्कोटिषु संख्यया
verses.transliteration: kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ paryāyeṇa pṛthakpṛthak / narakeṣu ca sarveṣu triṃśatkoṭiṣu saṃkhyayā
verses.translation: A Puranic way of describing the Sdlokald, SoTtiipota find Sovaptitd types of liberation.
verses.hindi: अन्तरात्मा से अनन्य चित्त होकर महेश्वर की आराधना में लग गये ।३४४-३४६। ब्रत एवं उपवास की साधना में पुन: लग गये । सभी जीवों पर दया का व्यवहार करने लगे। उनके समस्त संशय छिल्न हो गये थे । अतः उन्हें अनृपम दिव्य थोग की प्राष्ति हुईं। अपनी परम भक्ति एवं ज्ञानमय तेजोबल से उन सबों को हधाववत रुद्र-सालोक्य पद को प्राप्ति हुईं। जो तपस्वी व्यक्ति वायु द्वारा बतलाई गई इस शिवपुरी की
verses.wordMeaning: A Puranic way of describing the Sdlokald, SoTtiipota find Sovaptitd types of liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Puranic way of describing the Sdlokald, SoTtiipota find Sovaptitd types of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्यताम् एष मित्रघ्नो विचारो मा विधीयताम् । इति ते वचनं श्रुत्वा किंकरास् तं निगृह्य च
verses.transliteration: kṣipyatām eṣa mitraghno vicāro mā vidhīyatām / iti te vacanaṃ śrutvā kiṃkarās taṃ nigṛhya ca
verses.translation: With them, Mahesvara, the noblc-souled lord of Dcvas, the beloved lover of Parvall, rejoices there fully sympa¬ thetic with his devotees.
verses.hindi: स्तुति का पाठ करता है वह चाहे ब्राह्मण हो, चाहे क्षत्रिय हो, चाहे अपने कार्य व्यापार में लगा हुआ वेदय हों, रुद्र का सालोक्य प्राप्त करता है, रुद्र में उसकी भक्ति बढ़ती है, उसके सारे संताप दूर हो जाते हैं। जो जितेन्द्रिय शुद्र भव में भक्ति रखनेवाला है, और कभी मदिरा नहीं पान करता वह भी इसके पाठ से महाप्रलय तक की परमायु प्राप्त करता है, इस महान् अवधि में उसे कोई कष्ट भी नहीं होता, अथवा सभी मनोरथों को पूर्ण करनेवाले गणपत्ति का पद उसे प्राप्त होता हैं। यदि शुद्र मचप हैं तो वह भी मद्यप भूतगणों के साथ आनन्द का अनुभव करता है। प्रृथ्वी तल में पृज्य होकर वह
verses.wordMeaning: With them, Mahesvara, the noblc-souled lord of Dcvas, the beloved lover of Parvall, rejoices there fully sympa¬ thetic with his devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: With them, Mahesvara, the noblc-souled lord of Dcvas, the beloved lover of Parvall, rejoices there fully sympa¬ thetic with his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र ते नरका घोरास्तत्र क्षेप्तुं गतास्ततः । ते तमादाय हि नरके घोरे रौरवसंज्ञिते
verses.transliteration: yatra te narakā ghorāstatra kṣeptuṃ gatāstataḥ / te tamādāya hi narake ghore rauravasaṃjñite
verses.translation: I do not find any difference between those Rudras and the noble-souled Bhava. I am speaking the truth unto you.
verses.hindi: + इत उत्तरमधिकमर्ध ख. पुस्तके तद्यथ--शिवलोके स वसति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् । इति ।
verses.wordMeaning: I do not find any difference between those Rudras and the noble-souled Bhava. I am speaking the truth unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: I do not find any difference between those Rudras and the noble-souled Bhava. I am speaking the truth unto you.

verses.sanskrit: चिक्षिपुस्तत्र पापिष्ठं क्षिप्ते रावो ऽभवन्महान् । नरकस्थितभूतेषु मोक्तव्यो नैष पापकृत्
verses.transliteration: cikṣipustatra pāpiṣṭhaṃ kṣipte rāvo 'bhavanmahān / narakasthitabhūteṣu moktavyo naiṣa pāpakṛt
verses.translation: The lordly MatariSva (Wind-god) thus concluded the holy story. All the sages resplendent like the Sun, considered that they attained great blessing on hearing the extremely meritorious story of the three-eyed Lord. They were delighted much. Honouring him suitably they spoke thus to Vayu of great strength.
verses.hindi: इति होवाच भगवान्वायुर्वाक्यसिदं वरः २५४५ इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते शिवपुरवर्णनं नामैकशततमोश्ष्यायः ॥वब्ने। प्रत्याहारं प्रवक्ष्यासि परस्यान्ते स्वयंभुवः  बह्मण: स्थितिकाले तु क्षोण तस्मिस्तदा प्रभोः ३१
verses.wordMeaning: The lordly MatariSva (Wind-god) thus concluded the holy story. All the sages resplendent like the Sun, considered that they attained great blessing on hearing the extremely meritorious story of the three-eyed Lord. They were delighted much.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lordly MatariSva (Wind-god) thus concluded the holy story. All the sages resplendent like the Sun, considered that they attained great blessing on hearing the extremely meritorious story of the three-eyed Lord. They were delighted much.…

verses.sanskrit: अस्य संस्पर्शनाद् एव पीडा शतगुणा भवेत् । यथा व्यथासिकाष्ठैश्च समिद्धैर्दहनात्मकैः
verses.transliteration: asya saṃsparśanād eva pīḍā śataguṇā bhavet / yathā vyathāsikāṣṭhaiśca samiddhairdahanātmakaiḥ
verses.translation: O highly exalted and fortunate Wind-God! The excellent holy Aupasargika eighth abode of Isvara and its magni¬ tude has been recounted precisely to us by you. It is redolent with the excellent fragrance of the great Atman.
verses.hindi: सामान्य मनुष्यों को वरदान देता है। भगवान् वात ने इस सुस्दर कला को नेमिषारण्यवासी ऋषियों को
verses.wordMeaning: O highly exalted and fortunate Wind-God! The excellent holy Aupasargika eighth abode of Isvara and its magni¬ tude has been recounted precisely to us by you. It is redolent with the excellent fragrance of the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly exalted and fortunate Wind-God! The excellent holy Aupasargika eighth abode of Isvara and its magni¬ tude has been recounted precisely to us by you. It is redolent with the excellent fragrance of the great Atman.

verses.sanskrit: भवति स्पर्शनात्तस्य किमेतेन कृतामलम् । यथा दुर्जनसंसर्गात् सुजनो याति लाघवम्
verses.transliteration: bhavati sparśanāttasya kimetena kṛtāmalam / yathā durjanasaṃsargāt sujano yāti lāghavam
verses.translation: The grandeur ofMahadeva is difficult to be under¬ stood even by Suras. Due to the greatness belonging to him¬ self, the lord of unmeasured splendour has thousand Ganas.
verses.hindi: अब इसके बाद मैं परम पुरुषोत्तम स्वयम्भू भगवान् के हा के स्थिति.काल के समाप्त होने पर ईश्वर जिस जगत को स्थिर कर लेते हैं उसे बतला रहा है । सुत बोले--ऋषिवृन्द ! प्रत्याहार) का वर्णन कर रहा हूँ । परम ऐश्वयंशाली ब्र प्रकार अपनी आत्मा में परम सूक्ष्म रूप में इस समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: The grandeur ofMahadeva is difficult to be under¬ stood even by Suras. Due to the greatness belonging to him¬ self, the lord of unmeasured splendour has thousand Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The grandeur ofMahadeva is difficult to be under¬ stood even by Suras. Due to the greatness belonging to him¬ self, the lord of unmeasured splendour has thousand Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: सन्निधानात् तथास्याशु क्षते क्षारावसेचनम् । प्रसादः क्रियतामाशु नीयतां नरके ऽन्यतः
verses.transliteration: sannidhānāt tathāsyāśu kṣate kṣārāvasecanam / prasādaḥ kriyatāmāśu nīyatāṃ narake 'nyataḥ
verses.translation: Non-delusion is effected by him in his devotees in order to bless them. In the abode of the lord of Dcvas, the Vibhiili (excellence, grandeur) that assumes a cosmic form shines very well. It is unequalled and is served (attended) by Brahmalaksmi (the glory ofBrahma or Brahman) itself. It appears like the Moon that pervades the sky with the moonlight.
verses.hindi: १. सृष्टि को संकुचित करने की प्रक्रिया ।
verses.wordMeaning: Non-delusion is effected by him in his devotees in order to bless them. In the abode of the lord of Dcvas, the Vibhiili (excellence, grandeur) that assumes a cosmic form shines very well.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Non-delusion is effected by him in his devotees in order to bless them. In the abode of the lord of Dcvas, the Vibhiili (excellence, grandeur) that assumes a cosmic form shines very well.…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तास् ततस् तैस् तु गतास्ते त्वशुचिं प्रति । तत्र ते नारकाः सन्ति पूर्ववत्ते ऽपि चुक्रुशुः
verses.transliteration: evamuktās tatas tais tu gatāste tvaśuciṃ prati / tatra te nārakāḥ santi pūrvavatte 'pi cukruśuḥ
verses.translation: You have also mentioned everything regarding the noble-souled Rudras who are equal to Mahadeva. All these stories came out of your mouth like nectar.
verses.hindi: १०३२ वायुपुराणभ् मह॒दादेविकारस्य विशेषान्तस्य संक्षये । स्वभावकारिते तस्मि )चब॒त्ते प्रतिसंचरे
verses.wordMeaning: You have also mentioned everything regarding the noble-souled Rudras who are equal to Mahadeva. All these stories came out of your mouth like nectar.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have also mentioned everything regarding the noble-souled Rudras who are equal to Mahadeva. All these stories came out of your mouth like nectar.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ते किंकराः सर्वे पर्यटन्नरकमण्डले । नरके ऽपि स्थितिस् तस्य नास्ति पापस्य दुर्मतेः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ te kiṃkarāḥ sarve paryaṭannarakamaṇḍale / narake 'pi sthitis tasya nāsti pāpasya durmateḥ
verses.translation: Without drinking it devoutly, of what use are our excellent holy rites? There is nothing (?) which is not known by us. O Prana (life-breath), O excellent one among Dcvas, it uchoves you to answer our question precisely.
verses.hindi: उस प्रत्याह्ार में समस्त अव्यक्त (?) भूतों को व्यक्त ग्रस लेता है ? । कलपों के क्षय काल के थोड़े शेष रहने पर ही सृष्टि के इस प्रत्याहार का काय॑ प्रारम्भ हो जाता है । सब से अन्तिम द्रम नामक मनु को अधिकारावधि के अन्तिम अवसर पर कलियुग के अवसान में यह घोर संकट काल उपस्थित होता है। उस समय यह सारी सृष्टि अप्रत्यक्ष (अव्यक्त) में परिणत हो जाती है, बही सृष्ठि का संहार कहा जाता
verses.wordMeaning: Without drinking it devoutly, of what use are our excellent holy rites? There is nothing (?) which is not known by us. O Prana (life-breath), O excellent one among Dcvas, it uchoves you to answer our question precisely.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without drinking it devoutly, of what use are our excellent holy rites? There is nothing (?) which is not known by us. O Prana (life-breath), O excellent one among Dcvas, it uchoves you to answer our question precisely.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तदा तु ते सर्वे तं गृह्य यमसन्निधौ । गत्वा निवेद्य तत्सर्वं यदुक्तं नारकैर्नरैः । नरके न स्थितिर्यस्य तस्य किं क्रियतां वद
verses.transliteration: yadā tadā tu te sarve taṃ gṛhya yamasannidhau / gatvā nivedya tatsarvaṃ yaduktaṃ nārakairnaraiḥ / narake na sthitiryasya tasya kiṃ kriyatāṃ vada
verses.translation: That lord (Wind-god) spoke: What else shall I explain again? O sages of excellent rites, what should be re¬ counted by me? I shall tell it.
verses.hindi: है ।१-४। उस प्रति संचर काल के प्रवत्त होने पर जब सृष्टि का प्रत्याहार उपस्थित होता है, उस समय भूतों की तस्मात्राओं का भी विनाद्य होता है। मह॒दादि विशेषान्त समस्त विकार क्षय को प्राप्त होते हैं। यहू सब स्वाभाविक ढंग पर घटित होता है । सर्बप्रथम जलराशि भूमि के गन्धगुण को ग्रस लेतो है, जिससे भूमि गन्ध- विहोत होकर जल में विलीन हो जाती है। और इस प्रकार जल में गन्ध-तन्मात्रा के प्रविष्ट हो जाने से पृथ्वी जल रूप में परिणत हो जाती है। उसके बाद वह जलराधि समस्त जगत् में व्याप्त होकर वेगवानू एबं अति मुक्षरित होकर सर्वत्र संचरित और स्थिर होने लगती है। तदनन्तर जल का जो रस गुण है वह ज्योति (तेज) में लीन हो जाता है, भौर इस प्रकार रस तस्मात्रा के नष्ट हो जाने से जलराशि समाप्त हो जाती है। तेज के द्वारा विनष्ट रस के ज्योति में परिणत हो जाने पर जलराशि का जब सर्वेथा अभाव
verses.wordMeaning: That lord (Wind-god) spoke: What else shall I explain again? O sages of excellent rites, what should be re¬ counted by me? I shall tell it.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lord (Wind-god) spoke: What else shall I explain again? O sages of excellent rites, what should be re¬ counted by me? I shall tell it.

verses.sanskrit: यम उवाच: पापिष्ठ एष वै यातु योनिं तिर्यङ्निषेविताम् । कालं मुनिभिरुद्दिष्टः तिर्यग्योनिं प्रवेश्यताम्
verses.transliteration: yama uvāca: pāpiṣṭha eṣa vai yātu yoniṃ tiryaṅniṣevitām / kālaṃ munibhiruddiṣṭaḥ tiryagyoniṃ praveśyatām
verses.translation: Please precisely recount to us what, at the time of Abhutasamplava, will be the state of the Adityas who stand by as attendants (near the lord), the lions who had been the outcome of the lord s furious outburst, the Vaisvanara groups of Bbutas (goblins), the tigers and other followers about whom you have mentioned along with the groups of lions and tigers. What will be their state as well as the state of those who have attained Siddhi at the time of the terrible dissolution, when all living beings are destroyed?
verses.hindi: हो जाता है तब सभो ओर तेज ही तेज दिखाई पड़ने लगता है। समस्त जगत् में व्याप्त अग्नि उस समय जल को अपने में ग्रहण कर लेती है, उसकी लपटों से यह जगन्‍्मण्डल झानें: शर्ने पृर्ष हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Please precisely recount to us what, at the time of Abhutasamplava, will be the state of the Adityas who stand by as attendants (near the lord), the lions who had been the outcome of the lord s furious outburst, the Vaisvanara groups of Bbutas (goblins),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Please precisely recount to us what, at the time of Abhutasamplava, will be the state of the Adityas who stand by as attendants (near the lord), the lions who had been the outcome of the lord s furious outburst, the Vaisvanara groups of Bbutas (goblins),…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ते तु वचने प्रजासंयमनेन च । स गतः कृमितां पापो विष्ठासु च पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: evamukte tu vacane prajāsaṃyamanena ca / sa gataḥ kṛmitāṃ pāpo viṣṭhāsu ca pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: This is the greatest and (secret) reality. 1 I shall recount it. Please listen. Those who have gone.there before, the sons of Brahma, viz. Sanaka, Sananda and Sanatana, Vodhu, Kapila, Asuri of great fame, Sage Pancasikha and others have known the existence of Is vara, the unmanifcst source of origin (and attained salvation).
verses.hindi: धनुश्चिह्नान्तग्मंतप्रन्धो डा. पुस्तके नास्ति । अचधिभिः संतते तस्मिस्तियंगूध्वंमथस्ततः । ज्योतिषो5पि ग्रुणं रूपं वायुरत्ति प्रकाशकम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: This is the greatest and (secret) reality. 1 I shall recount it. Please listen. Those who have gone.there before, the sons of Brahma, viz. Sanaka, Sananda and Sanatana, Vodhu, Kapila, Asuri of great fame, Sage Pancasikha and others have known the existence of Is vara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the greatest and (secret) reality. 1 I shall recount it. Please listen. Those who have gone.there before, the sons of Brahma, viz. Sanaka, Sananda and Sanatana, Vodhu, Kapila, Asuri of great fame, Sage Pancasikha and others have known the existence of Is vara,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽसौ दंशमशकान् पिपीलिकसमुद्भवान् । यूकामत्कुणकाढ्यांश्च गत्वा पक्षित्वम् आगतः
verses.transliteration: tato 'sau daṃśamaśakān pipīlikasamudbhavān / yūkāmatkuṇakāḍhyāṃśca gatvā pakṣitvam āgataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, when much time elapses, at the close of theKalpas, when even the great Bfnltas (Elements) are destro¬ yed and utter annihilation takes place, many crores of Rudraganas delightedly (meditate on) Mahesvara, closely adhere to eight types of truth (?), desist from enjoying melody and other objects of pleasure, enter all the living beings through their brilliance accompanied by perfect knowledge and attain the unagitated Vaihayasapada (the abode of firmament) in order to bless the living beings sympathetically.
verses.hindi: निरालोके तदा लोके वायुभूते च तेजसि । ततस्तु समुलमासादो वायुः संभवमात्मनः (१४ ऊध्यें चाधश्र तियंक्च दोधवीति दिशों दश । वायोरपि गुण स्पर्शभाकाशं प्रसते च तत्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, when much time elapses, at the close of theKalpas, when even the great Bfnltas (Elements) are destro¬ yed and utter annihilation takes place, many crores of Rudraganas delightedly (meditate on) Mahesvara, closely adhere to eight types of truth (?),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, when much time elapses, at the close of theKalpas, when even the great Bfnltas (Elements) are destro¬ yed and utter annihilation takes place, many crores of Rudraganas delightedly (meditate on) Mahesvara, closely adhere to eight types of truth (?),…

verses.sanskrit: स्थावरत्वं गतः पश्चात् पाषाणत्वं ततः परम् । सरीसृपानजगरवराहमृगहस्तिनः
verses.transliteration: sthāvaratvaṃ gataḥ paścāt pāṣāṇatvaṃ tataḥ param / sarīsṛpānajagaravarāhamṛgahastinaḥ
verses.translation: The noble-souled ones attain to Mahesvara of the subtle nature of Paramanu (Atom) there. They cross the river of births and deaths of great eddies and whirlpools of terrific nature.
verses.hindi: प्रशाम्यति तदा वायु: खे तु तिष्टत्यनावृतम् । अरूपमरसस्पर्शमगन्धं न च मुतिमत् सर्वमाप्रयन्नाद: सुमहत्तत्थ्रकाशते । परिमण्डलं तच्छुषिरमाकाशं शब्दलक्षणम् १७ शब्दमात्र तथाकाशं सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति  त॑ तु शब्दगु्णं तस्य भृतादिग्रेंसते पुनः १८
verses.wordMeaning: The noble-souled ones attain to Mahesvara of the subtle nature of Paramanu (Atom) there. They cross the river of births and deaths of great eddies and whirlpools of terrific nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: The noble-souled ones attain to Mahesvara of the subtle nature of Paramanu (Atom) there. They cross the river of births and deaths of great eddies and whirlpools of terrific nature.

verses.sanskrit: वृकश्वानखरोष्ट्रांश्च सूकरीं ग्रामजातिकाम् । योनिम् आश्वतरीं प्राप्य तथा महिषसम्भवाम्
verses.transliteration: vṛkaśvānakharoṣṭrāṃśca sūkarīṃ grāmajātikām / yonim āśvatarīṃ prāpya tathā mahiṣasambhavām
verses.translation: Then they see Sarva and the great Brahman. They are accompanied by those seven goddesses who have been glorified (before).
verses.hindi: नोचे ऊपर, इधर-उधर सर्वत्र अग्ति की लपटों के फेल जाने पर ज्योति के प्रकाशमय गुण रूप को वायु अपने में समेट लेती है, उस समय वायु में वह तेजोराशि दीपक शिक्षा की भांति विलीन हो जाती है तस्मात्रा के विनष्ट हो जाने पर अग्नि का रूप नष्ट हो जाता है, जिससे तेज छानन्‍्त पड़ जाता है, वायु से यह समस्त जगत् अतिशय कम्पायमान हो उठता है। तेज के वायु के रूप में परिणत हो जाने पर जब समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: Then they see Sarva and the great Brahman. They are accompanied by those seven goddesses who have been glorified (before).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they see Sarva and the great Brahman. They are accompanied by those seven goddesses who have been glorified (before).

verses.sanskrit: एताश्चान्याश्च बह्वीर्वै प्राप योनीः क्रमेण वै । स ता योनीरनुप्राप्य धुर्यो ऽभूद्भारवाहकः
verses.transliteration: etāścānyāśca bahvīrvai prāpa yonīḥ krameṇa vai / sa tā yonīranuprāpya dhuryo 'bhūdbhāravāhakaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Sankara draws within him the thousand lions, the Adityas, the Vaisvanara groups of Bhutas, the tigers and his own followers (the Rudraganas). Thereafter he draws these seven Lokas that rush (towards him) and the five Maha- bhutas (the great elements).
verses.hindi: लोंक भालोक विहीत हो जाता है, तब वायु अपने मूल उत्पत्ति स्थान का आश्रय ग्रहण करता है और ऊपर नीचे इधर उथर सर्वत्र दसों दिशाओं को बारम्बार-कम्पित करता है । तदुपरान्त वायु के स्पर्शात्मक गुण को आकाश अपने में समेट लेता है परिणाम स्वरूप वायु का वेग शान्‍्त हो जाता है उस समय केवल अनावृत आकाश स्थित रहता है, कोई रूप रस, गनन्‍ध, स्पर्श एवं मृत्ति उसको नहीं रहती, अपने भीषण निनाद से जमत् को पूरित करता हुआ वह मण्डलाकार आकाश प्रक्राशित होंता है, वह केवल शब्दात्मक रहता है, उसमें केवल पोल रहती है। इस प्रकार केवल शब्द गुण युक्त आकाश समस्त भूतों को आवुत कर स्थिर रहता है। उसके बाद उस शब्दगुणमय आकाश को भी भूतादि ग्रस लेता है ।१२-१८। समस्त भूतों को एवं उन आश्रित समस्त इन्द्रियों को एक साथ ही यह अहंकार तत्त्व
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Sankara draws within him the thousand lions, the Adityas, the Vaisvanara groups of Bhutas, the tigers and his own followers (the Rudraganas). Thereafter he draws these seven Lokas that rush (towards him) and the five Maha- bhutas (the great elements).
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Sankara draws within him the thousand lions, the Adityas, the Vaisvanara groups of Bhutas, the tigers and his own followers (the Rudraganas). Thereafter he draws these seven Lokas that rush (towards him) and the five Maha- bhutas (the great elements).

verses.sanskrit: स गृहे पार्थिवेशस्य धार्मिकस्य यशस्विनः । स दृष्ट्वा कार्त्तिकीं प्राप्तामेकदा नृपसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sa gṛhe pārthiveśasya dhārmikasya yaśasvinaḥ / sa dṛṣṭvā kārttikīṃ prāptāmekadā nṛpasattamaḥ
verses.translation: Accompanied by Visnu, he makes (the worlds) united (sustained) and annihilates. He is Rudra who is of the nature of Saman andYajur (Vedas). He is warped and woofed both within and without, decisively. O Brahmanas, he is the only lord and leader. He is beginninglcss. He is the annihilator.
verses.hindi: ग्रस लेता है, यह भूतादि तामस अर्थात् अहुंकारतत्व के नाम से विख्यात है । उस भूतादि तामस को भी बुद्धि रूपी महत्तत््व ग्रतता है। यही महत्तत्व्ही संकल्प एवं अध्यवसायात्मक है ॥ तत्त्व- चिन्तापरायण लोग इसी को बुद्धि, मन, लिज्छ, महान् एवं अक्षर प्रभृति पर्यायवाच्री शब्दों से पुकारते
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by Visnu, he makes (the worlds) united (sustained) and annihilates. He is Rudra who is of the nature of Saman andYajur (Vedas). He is warped and woofed both within and without, decisively. O Brahmanas, he is the only lord and leader. He is beginninglcss.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by Visnu, he makes (the worlds) united (sustained) and annihilates. He is Rudra who is of the nature of Saman andYajur (Vedas). He is warped and woofed both within and without, decisively. O Brahmanas, he is the only lord and leader. He is beginninglcss.…

verses.sanskrit: पुरोहितं समाहूय ब्राह्मणांश्च तथा बहून् । न गृहे कार्त्तिकीं कुर्याद् एतन् मे बहुशः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: purohitaṃ samāhūya brāhmaṇāṃśca tathā bahūn / na gṛhe kārttikīṃ kuryād etan me bahuśaḥ śrutam
verses.translation: Then all those sages (of Naimisa forest) refulgent like the Sun consecrated the sacred fire in their own hermitage. They thereafter devoted themselves to the worship of Mahesvara by means of the purity of their inner soul mentally, verbally and physically.
verses.hindi: १०२३४ वायुपुराणम् बुद्धिमंतश्व लिड्भश्व महानक्षर एवं च। पर्यायवाचके: शब्देस्तमाहुस्तत््वचिन्तकाः.. ॥२ १ संप्रलीनेषु भूतेषु गुणसाम्ये तमोमये । स्वात्मन्येव स्थिते चेव कारण लोककारणे....
verses.wordMeaning: Then all those sages (of Naimisa forest) refulgent like the Sun consecrated the sacred fire in their own hermitage. They thereafter devoted themselves to the worship of Mahesvara by means of the purity of their inner soul mentally, verbally and physically.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all those sages (of Naimisa forest) refulgent like the Sun consecrated the sacred fire in their own hermitage. They thereafter devoted themselves to the worship of Mahesvara by means of the purity of their inner soul mentally, verbally and physically.

verses.sanskrit: समेताः कुत्र यास्याम इति ब्रूत द्विजोत्तमाः । यो गृहे कार्त्तिकीं कुर्यात् स्नानदानादिवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: sametāḥ kutra yāsyāma iti brūta dvijottamāḥ / yo gṛhe kārttikīṃ kuryāt snānadānādivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: They were merciful towards all living beings and engaged themselves in observing fasts and holy rites. All their doubts were cleared and the unequalled divine Yoga was attain¬ ed by them.
verses.hindi: भावग्राह्मानुमानाच्च चिन्तगित्वेदमुच्यते स्थिते तु कारणे तस्मिन्नित्ये सदसदात्मिके
verses.wordMeaning: They were merciful towards all living beings and engaged themselves in observing fasts and holy rites. All their doubts were cleared and the unequalled divine Yoga was attain¬ ed by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were merciful towards all living beings and engaged themselves in observing fasts and holy rites. All their doubts were cleared and the unequalled divine Yoga was attain¬ ed by them.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरकृतात्पुण्यात् स बहिर्भवति श्रुतिः । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन तीर्थं सर्वगुणान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarakṛtātpuṇyāt sa bahirbhavati śrutiḥ / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam
verses.translation: After attaining these by means of the mind endowed with perfect knowledge and their greatest devotion, the Sdlokja form of salvation was attained by them. It is the eternal and unchanging region.
verses.hindi: अनिर्देश्या प्रवृत्तिवें स्वात्मिका कारणेन तु । एवं सप्तादयोउम्यस्तात्क्रमात्प्रकर॒यस्तु व. ४२६ प्रत्याहरे तदा सगे प्रविशन्ति परस्परम् । येनेदमावतं सर्वेमण्डमप्सु प्रलीयते सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रान्तं सप्तलोको सपर्वंतम् । उदकावरणं यच्च ज्योतिषां लीयते तु तत्
verses.wordMeaning: After attaining these by means of the mind endowed with perfect knowledge and their greatest devotion, the Sdlokja form of salvation was attained by them. It is the eternal and unchanging region.
verses.commentary: Sense: After attaining these by means of the mind endowed with perfect knowledge and their greatest devotion, the Sdlokja form of salvation was attained by them. It is the eternal and unchanging region.

verses.sanskrit: सहितास्तत्र गच्छामः स्नातुं दातुं च शक्तितः । एवमुक्ते तु वचने पार्थिवेन द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sahitāstatra gacchāmaḥ snātuṃ dātuṃ ca śaktitaḥ / evamukte tu vacane pārthivena dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: He who regularly reads this hymn of prayer narrated by Vayu, whether a Brahmana, a Ksatriya or a Vaisya but observing his duties, attains Salokya with Rudra. He will be endowed with devotion and be free from ailments. A Sudra who is not addicted to wine, who is a devotee of Bhava and who has conquered his sense organs, remains till the time of dissolution without obstacles and attains the leadership of Ganas or the abode coveted by all. If he is a wine addict, he rejoices with those groups of Bhutas who are drunkards. Being worshipped on the earth he will be the granter of boons to men. Thus the Wind-god the excellent lord spoke these words.
verses.hindi: यत्तेजसं चा55वरणमाकाश ग्रसते तु तत् । यद्वायव्यं चा55वरणमाकाशं ग्रसते तु तत्
verses.wordMeaning: He who regularly reads this hymn of prayer narrated by Vayu, whether a Brahmana, a Ksatriya or a Vaisya but observing his duties, attains Salokya with Rudra. He will be endowed with devotion and be free from ailments. A Sudra who is not addicted to wine,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who regularly reads this hymn of prayer narrated by Vayu, whether a Brahmana, a Ksatriya or a Vaisya but observing his duties, attains Salokya with Rudra. He will be endowed with devotion and be free from ailments. A Sudra who is not addicted to wine,…

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुः श्रेष्ठं नृपथेष्ठ रेवाया उत्तरे तटे । भारेश्वरेति विख्यातं मुक्तितीर्थं नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: ūcuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ nṛpatheṣṭha revāyā uttare taṭe / bhāreśvareti vikhyātaṃ muktitīrthaṃ nṛpottama
verses.translation: During the process of Pratyahara, Isvara swallows the un- manifest ones** entirely and clearly ( vyaktam ) in exactly the same manner as he does the subtle ones.
verses.hindi: आकाशावरणं यच्च भृतादिग्रंसते तु तत् । भृतादि ग्रसते चापि महान्वे बुद्धिलक्षण: ३० महान्तं ग्रसतेःव्यक्त गुणसाम्यं ततः परम । एतो संहारविस्तारो ब्रह्मउव्क्तात्ततः पुनः ३३ १ हैं। इस प्रकार जब सभी भूत बविलीन हो जाते हैं, गृणों में साम्य; हो जाता है, समस्त जगत् तमोमय हो जाता है, लोक के कारणभूत कारणसमूह आत्मस्थित हो जाते हैं, सृष्टि निवृत्त होकर प्रकृति में अवस्थित हो जाती हैं, तब आदि अन्त किसी का कुछ पता नहीं लगता, कुछ दिखाई नहीं पड़ता, किसी का कुछ नाम रूप शेष नहीं रह जाता, जिससे शान सम्पन्न को भी कुछ मालूम नहीं पड़ता ओर उस समय
verses.wordMeaning: During the process of Pratyahara, Isvara swallows the un- manifest ones** entirely and clearly ( vyaktam ) in exactly the same manner as he does the subtle ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the process of Pratyahara, Isvara swallows the un- manifest ones** entirely and clearly ( vyaktam ) in exactly the same manner as he does the subtle ones.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यामो वयं सर्वे सर्वपापक्षयावहम् । एवमुक्तः स नृपतिर्गृहीत्वा प्रचुरं वसु
verses.transliteration: tatra yāmo vayaṃ sarve sarvapāpakṣayāvaham / evamuktaḥ sa nṛpatirgṛhītvā pracuraṃ vasu
verses.translation: This activity of re-absorption of creations begins even as the Kalpas have not fully expired. This terriblycritical period sets in at the closing period of the tenure of the office of the Manu named Druma (?) towards the end of Kaliyuga then. The entire creation merges in the apratyaksa (the invisible i.e. the unmanifest). It is called annihilation.
verses.hindi: गतागत का भी कुछ बोध नहीं होता ७९-२४ ऐसी स्थिति का भावनाओं एवं अनुमान द्वारा कुछ चिन्तन करके यह कहा गया है कि उस समय वे सब पदार्थ उस सदसदात्मक, शाश्वत परम शार्ग में प्रतिष्ठित होते हैं । यह स्वात्मिका प्रवृत्ति कारण द्वारा अनिर्देश्य है। सृष्टि के इन सातों उपादानों के इस प्रकार क्रमशश विलय कहे जाते हैं । प्रत्याहारकाल में इसी प्रकार इन सातों प्राइत पदार्थों का परस्पर अनृप्रवेश होता है। सातों
verses.wordMeaning: This activity of re-absorption of creations begins even as the Kalpas have not fully expired. This terriblycritical period sets in at the closing period of the tenure of the office of the Manu named Druma (?) towards the end of Kaliyuga then.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This activity of re-absorption of creations begins even as the Kalpas have not fully expired. This terriblycritical period sets in at the closing period of the tenure of the office of the Manu named Druma (?) towards the end of Kaliyuga then.…

verses.sanskrit: शकटं संभृतं कृत्वा तत्र युक्तः स धूर्वहः । यः कृत्वा मित्रहननं गोयोनिं समुपागतः
verses.transliteration: śakaṭaṃ saṃbhṛtaṃ kṛtvā tatra yuktaḥ sa dhūrvahaḥ / yaḥ kṛtvā mitrahananaṃ goyoniṃ samupāgataḥ
verses.translation: When that period of 'great washing off 9 begins to function, 4 * * * * when the withdrawal of the creation is imminent, elements gross and subtle ( Bhutas and Tanmatras) are destroyed. All evolutes beginning with Mahal and ending with Vi$e$a be-
verses.hindi: द्वीप, समस्त पव॑त, सातों लोक एवं सब समुद्र इन सथ को जिसने आवृत किया है, वह विशाल ब्ह्माण्ड स्व प्रथम जलराशि में विलीन होता है। और तदनन्तर वह जलावरण ज्योति पदार्थ में विलय होता है । उसके बाद उस तजस आवरण को वायु ग्रसता है ओर उस वायवीय आवरण को आकाध्य समेट लेता है। उस आकाशीय आक्रण को भूतादि तामस बहड्भार तत्त्व ग्रसता है। भूतादि को बुद्धि रूप मह्तत्तत्त्व ग्रसता है। उस महत्तत््व्को अव्यक्त ग्रसता है, उसके बाद गुणों में समानता हो जाती है  सृष्टि का यह संहार एवं विस्तार ब्रह्मनिष्ठ अव्यक्त प्रकृति से होता है। सृष्टि के लिये ही वह इन विकारों को ग्रसती एवं
verses.wordMeaning: When that period of 'great washing off 9 begins to function, 4 * * * * when the withdrawal of the creation is imminent, elements gross and subtle ( Bhutas and Tanmatras) are destroyed. All evolutes beginning with Mahal and ending with Vi$e$a be-
verses.commentary: Sense: When that period of 'great washing off 9 begins to function, 4 * * * * when the withdrawal of the creation is imminent, elements gross and subtle ( Bhutas and Tanmatras) are destroyed. All evolutes beginning with Mahal and ending with Vi$e$a be-

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं स नर्मदातीरे सम्प्राप्तस्तीर्थमुत्तमम् । गत्वा चतुर्दशीदिने ह्युपवासकृतक्षणः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ sa narmadātīre samprāptastīrthamuttamam / gatvā caturdaśīdine hyupavāsakṛtakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: This chapter corresponds to Bd.P.III.4.3 Only verse numbers are referred.
verses.hindi: सृजते ग्रसते चेव विकारान्सगंसंयमे । सांसिद्धकायंकरणाः संसिद्धा ज्ञानिनस्तु ये ३२ गत्वा जवं जवीभावे स्थानेष्वेषु प्रसंयमात् । प्रत्याहारे बियुज्यस्ते क्षेत्रजा: करणः पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter corresponds to Bd.P.III.4.3 Only verse numbers are referred.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter corresponds to Bd.P.III.4.3 Only verse numbers are referred.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा स नर्मदातीरे नाम रुद्रेत्यनुस्मरन् । शुचिप्रदेशाच्च मृदं मन्त्रेणानेन गृह्यताम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā sa narmadātīre nāma rudretyanusmaran / śucipradeśācca mṛdaṃ mantreṇānena gṛhyatām
verses.translation: The word avyaktan in the line: avyaktan grasate vyaktam creates confusion. If emended as ' avyaktam * as in Bd.P.v.2 the verse means 'during the process of Pratyahara, the Avyakta (the Unmanifest one) swallows the Vyakta (the Manifest one, the whole universe) entirely in the same way as Is'vara created the manifest universe which is very subtle/
verses.hindi: एवं सर्गेषु विज्ञेयं क्षेत्रज्षेष्विह ब्राह्मणा:। ब्रह्मविच्चेव विज्ेयः क्षेत्रज्ञानात्यृथक्प्ृथक् ३५ अव्यूहासंकाराच्चेब ज्योतिबंच्च व्यवस्थित । यस्मात्म्नतिशरीरं हि सुखदुःखो पलब्धिता ।।
verses.wordMeaning: The word avyaktan in the line: avyaktan grasate vyaktam creates confusion. If emended as ' avyaktam * as in Bd.P.v.2 the verse means 'during the process of Pratyahara, the Avyakta (the Unmanifest one) swallows the Vyakta (the Manifest one,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The word avyaktan in the line: avyaktan grasate vyaktam creates confusion. If emended as ' avyaktam * as in Bd.P.v.2 the verse means 'during the process of Pratyahara, the Avyakta (the Unmanifest one) swallows the Vyakta (the Manifest one,…

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृतासि वराहेण रुद्रेण शतबाहुना । अहमप्युद्धरिष्यामि प्रजया बन्धनेन च
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtāsi varāheṇa rudreṇa śatabāhunā / ahamapyuddhariṣyāmi prajayā bandhanena ca
verses.translation: For Par am tad anukalpanam apuTQt Bd. reads Paranta-dyyapu - kddyandm sampurne: It means '(when the extremely dreadful destruction) of everything beginning with molecules of two atoms and ending with para (greatest thing) is imminent it is called Samhara.
verses.hindi: यदा प्रवर्तते चेषां भेदानां चेव संयमाः । स्वभावकारिताः सर्वे कालेन महता तदा ३६ निवर्तते तदा तस्य स्थितिरागः स्वयंभुवः । सहसा योज्यक: सर्वेत्रेद्दालोकनिवासिभि: ३४० विनिवत्ते तदा रागे स्थितावात्मनिवासिनाम् । तत्कालवासिनां तेषां तदा तद्दोषद्शिनामू
verses.wordMeaning: For Par am tad anukalpanam apuTQt Bd. reads Paranta-dyyapu - kddyandm sampurne: It means '(when the extremely dreadful destruction) of everything beginning with molecules of two atoms and ending with para (greatest thing) is imminent it is called Samhara.
verses.commentary: Sense: For Par am tad anukalpanam apuTQt Bd. reads Paranta-dyyapu - kddyandm sampurne: It means '(when the extremely dreadful destruction) of everything beginning with molecules of two atoms and ending with para (greatest thing) is imminent it is called Samhara.

verses.sanskrit: स एवं तां मृदं नीत्वा मुक्त्वा तीरे तथोत्तरे । ददर्श भास्करं पश्चान्मन्त्रेणानेन चालभेत्
verses.transliteration: sa evaṃ tāṃ mṛdaṃ nītvā muktvā tīre tathottare / dadarśa bhāskaraṃ paścānmantreṇānena cālabhet
verses.translation: Verses 5-33 state the process of involution of Tattvas. Thus at the end
verses.hindi: निर्माण करती है । समस्त काये और कारणों को अधिगत करनेवाले जो पराम ज्ञानी एवं सिद्ध लोग हैं वे इन स्थानों पर अपने प्रकृष्टसंयम से इस संहारकालीन आकर्षण में स्वयं हृतगति से आक्ृष्ट हो प्रत्याहारकाल में वे क्षेत्रत करणों से पुनः वियुक्त हो जाते हैं। अव्यक्त ही को क्षेत्र कहा जाता है, और ब्रह्म क्षेत्रत कहा जाता है। इन दोनों का साधर्म्य एवं वधम्यं मूलक वंयोंग अनादिकाल से चला आ रहा है २५-३४ । विप्र व॒न्द ! समस्त सर्मों में (सृष्टि में) क्षेत्रों के विषय में यही विशेषता (क्रम) जाननी चाहिए। जो 'एउन्‍्रथक्-ट्रथक् रूप में इस क्षेत्र का (ज्ञान) तत्त्व जानता है उसी को ब्रह्मज्ञानी (क्षेत्र) जातना चाहिए । क्षेत्र एवं क्षेत्रत्ष का
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 5-33 state the process of involution of Tattvas. Thus at the end
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 5-33 state the process of involution of Tattvas. Thus at the end

verses.sanskrit: अश्वक्रान्ते रथक्रान्ते विष्णुक्रान्ते वसुंधरे । मृत्तिके हर मे पापं जन्मकोटिशतार्जितम्
verses.transliteration: aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasuṃdhare / mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ janmakoṭiśatārjitam
verses.translation: The waters of great velocity and loud report spread throughout the entire universe and stay by awaiting destruction (?) • The special attribute of the waters ( Rasa —taste) becomes merged in Jyolis (fiery element). At the destruction of the subtle element Rasa, the waters too get dissolved.
verses.hindi: क्षेत्र द्वारा अधिष्ठित है, उसक्री उपयोगिता ही क्षैत्रज्ञ के लिये कही जाती है  शरीर के आधिक्य के काःण छारीरी भी अनेक कहे जाते हैं।३५-३७ किन्तु ये ज्योतिमंय पदार्थ की भाँति असम्बद्ध और भअसंकर रहते हैं। प्रत्येक शरीर में सुख दुःख दोनों की उपलब्धि होती है, अतः ज्ञानी लोग पुरुष को अनेक मानने हैं। बहुत काल व्यतीत हो जाने पर प्रकृतिवश जब सब के भेद की प्रवृत्ति का
verses.wordMeaning: The waters of great velocity and loud report spread throughout the entire universe and stay by awaiting destruction (?) • The special attribute of the waters ( Rasa —taste) becomes merged in Jyolis (fiery element). At the destruction of the subtle element Rasa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The waters of great velocity and loud report spread throughout the entire universe and stay by awaiting destruction (?) • The special attribute of the waters ( Rasa —taste) becomes merged in Jyolis (fiery element). At the destruction of the subtle element Rasa,…

verses.sanskrit: तत एवं विगाह्यापो मन्त्रमेतमुदीरयेत् । त्वं नर्मदे पुण्यजले तवाम्भः शङ्करोद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: tata evaṃ vigāhyāpo mantrametamudīrayet / tvaṃ narmade puṇyajale tavāmbhaḥ śaṅkarodbhavam
verses.translation: When Rasa is absorbed by Tcjas (fiery element), the waters become merged in it. When the waters are thus absorbed, only Tejas is seen all round.
verses.hindi: संयम घटित होता है तब स्वयम्भू की स्थितिबुद्धि निवृत्त हो जाती है। और उस समय समस्त ब्रह्मलोक निवासी सहसा अपनी-अपनी स्थितिवृत्ति में दोष देखकर वेराभ्य युक्त हो जाते हैं। जिससे उनके आत्म वादात्मक अहुंकार का सर्वथा विनाश हो जाता है । भौग्य एवं भोक्तापन के ज्ञान से रहित होकर वे नानात्व के दर्शानाभाव से प्रशान्‍्त होकर आत्मा में अवस्थित होते हैं ।३८-४२। वे समस्त ब्रह्यलोंक निवासी पृथक्- १०२६ वायुपुराणस्
verses.wordMeaning: When Rasa is absorbed by Tcjas (fiery element), the waters become merged in it. When the waters are thus absorbed, only Tejas is seen all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Rasa is absorbed by Tcjas (fiery element), the waters become merged in it. When the waters are thus absorbed, only Tejas is seen all round.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं प्रकुर्वतो मे ऽद्य पापं हरतु चार्जितम् । स स्नात्वानेन विधिना संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ prakurvato me 'dya pāpaṃ haratu cārjitam / sa snātvānena vidhinā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: The fire element, pervading everywhere, absorbs the waters. The entire universe is gradually filled up with flames of
verses.hindi: पृथगज्ञानेन क्षेत्रज्ञास्ततस्ते ब्रह्मलोकिका: । प्रकृतो करणातीताः सर्वे नानाप्रदर्शिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The fire element, pervading everywhere, absorbs the waters. The entire universe is gradually filled up with flames of
verses.commentary: Sense: The fire element, pervading everywhere, absorbs the waters. The entire universe is gradually filled up with flames of

verses.sanskrit: ययौ देवालयं पश्चाद् उपहारैः समन्वितः । भक्त्या संचिन्त्य सान्निध्ये शङ्करं लोकशङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: yayau devālayaṃ paścād upahāraiḥ samanvitaḥ / bhaktyā saṃcintya sānnidhye śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram
verses.translation: When this (entire universe) is filled with flames, the flames spread on all sides, above and below. Vayu (the wind element) swallows up Rilpa (colour or form), the luminous quality of Jyotis (the fire element). The entire fire element merges in the cosmic air, like the flame of lamp in the great wind.
verses.hindi: स्वात्मन्येवावतिष्ठस्ते प्रशान्ता दर्शनात्मका: । शुद्धा निरञ्जनाः सर्वे चेतनाचेतनास्तथा ४४ इत्येबं प्राकृतः प्रोक्तः प्रतिसर्ग: स्वयंभुवः । भिद्यन्ते सर्वभूतानां करणानि प्रसंयमे .
verses.wordMeaning: When this (entire universe) is filled with flames, the flames spread on all sides, above and below. Vayu (the wind element) swallows up Rilpa (colour or form), the luminous quality of Jyotis (the fire element). The entire fire element merges in the cosmic air,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When this (entire universe) is filled with flames, the flames spread on all sides, above and below. Vayu (the wind element) swallows up Rilpa (colour or form), the luminous quality of Jyotis (the fire element). The entire fire element merges in the cosmic air,…

verses.sanskrit: पुराणोक्तविधानेन पूजां समुपचक्रमे । पूजाचतुष्टयं देवि शिवरात्र्यां निगद्यते
verses.transliteration: purāṇoktavidhānena pūjāṃ samupacakrame / pūjācatuṣṭayaṃ devi śivarātryāṃ nigadyate
verses.translation: When the Rupa Tanmatra (the essential quality) is dissolved, Vibhdvasu (the element of Fire) becomes bereft of Rupa (colour). Tejas then subsides. The great Tejas is then blown off by Vayu.
verses.hindi: इत्येष संयमश्वेव तत्त्वानां करणः सह । तत्त्वप्रसंयमो होष स्मृतो हावतंफो द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: When the Rupa Tanmatra (the essential quality) is dissolved, Vibhdvasu (the element of Fire) becomes bereft of Rupa (colour). Tejas then subsides. The great Tejas is then blown off by Vayu.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Rupa Tanmatra (the essential quality) is dissolved, Vibhdvasu (the element of Fire) becomes bereft of Rupa (colour). Tejas then subsides. The great Tejas is then blown off by Vayu.

verses.sanskrit: संस्नाप्य प्रथमे यामे पञ्चगव्येन शङ्करम् । घृतेन पूरणं पश्चात्कृतं नृपवरेण तु
verses.transliteration: saṃsnāpya prathame yāme pañcagavyena śaṅkaram / ghṛtena pūraṇaṃ paścātkṛtaṃ nṛpavareṇa tu
verses.translation: When the entire universe thus becomes bereft of light, the element of Tejas having merged in Vayu, the element of Vayu resorts to the source of its origin.
verses.hindi: धर्माधर्मों तपो ज्ञानं शुभे सत्यानृते तथा । उध्वंभावों ह्ाथोभावों सुखदुःखे प्रियाप्रिये प्रकृत्यां चेब तत्सव॑ पुण्य पाप॑ प्रतिष्ठति । योन्यवस्था स्वभावे च देहिनां तु निषिच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: When the entire universe thus becomes bereft of light, the element of Tejas having merged in Vayu, the element of Vayu resorts to the source of its origin.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the entire universe thus becomes bereft of light, the element of Tejas having merged in Vayu, the element of Vayu resorts to the source of its origin.

verses.sanskrit: धूपदीपनैवेद्याद्यं संकल्प्य च यथाविधि । अर्घेणानेन देवेशं मन्त्रेणानेन शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: dhūpadīpanaivedyādyaṃ saṃkalpya ca yathāvidhi / argheṇānena deveśaṃ mantreṇānena śaṅkaram
verses.translation: It shakes everything above, below and the sides in all the ten quarters. Then Aka§a (Ether) absorbs the quality of Vayu, viz. SparSa (Touch).
verses.hindi: जन्‍्तूनां पापपुष्यं तु प्रकृतो यत्प्रतिष्ठतभ् । अव्यक्तस्थानि तास्येव पुण्यपापानि जम्तवः ॥। द
verses.wordMeaning: It shakes everything above, below and the sides in all the ten quarters. Then Aka§a (Ether) absorbs the quality of Vayu, viz. SparSa (Touch).
verses.commentary: Sense: It shakes everything above, below and the sides in all the ten quarters. Then Aka§a (Ether) absorbs the quality of Vayu, viz. SparSa (Touch).

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते देवदेवेश शम्भो परमकारण । गृहाणार्घमिमं देव संसाराघमपाकुरु
verses.transliteration: namaste devadeveśa śambho paramakāraṇa / gṛhāṇārghamimaṃ deva saṃsārāghamapākuru
verses.translation: The element of Vayu subsides and the open firmament alone remains, sans colour, sans taste, sans touch and sans smell. It has no physical body as well.
verses.hindi: धर्माधर्मों तु जन्तुनां गुणमात्रात्मकावुभी । करणः स्व: प्रचोयैते कायत्वेनेह जन्तुभिः..... ४५२ पृथक क्षेत्र ज्ञान युक्त होने के कारण हो क्षेत्रज्ञ कहे जाते हैं। वे सब प्रकरृतिगत सभो कारणों से परे है और उन सब के नातनात्व के देखने वाले हैं। चेतनाचेतनात्मक, शुद्ध, बुद्ध, चैतन्य, निरणज्जन, प्रकृति में निर्वाण प्राप्त करनेवाले एवं पुनः कभी लौटकर आनेवाले नहीं हैं अर्थात् उनका पुनर्जन्म नहीं होता। प्रकृति निर्गुण और निरात्म होने के कारण वे क्षेत्रजरगण मुक्त हो जाते हैं उनका पुनः आगमन (जन्म) नहीं होता ।
verses.wordMeaning: The element of Vayu subsides and the open firmament alone remains, sans colour, sans taste, sans touch and sans smell. It has no physical body as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: The element of Vayu subsides and the open firmament alone remains, sans colour, sans taste, sans touch and sans smell. It has no physical body as well.

verses.sanskrit: वित्तानुरूपतो दत्तं सुवर्णं मन्त्रकल्पितम् । अग्निर्हि देवाः सर्वे सुवर्णं च हुताशनात्
verses.transliteration: vittānurūpato dattaṃ suvarṇaṃ mantrakalpitam / agnirhi devāḥ sarve suvarṇaṃ ca hutāśanāt
verses.translation: The AWfl-characteriscd Akasa envelops everything and
verses.hindi: स्वयम्भू का प्राऊृत् प्रतिसगं इसी प्रकार का कहा जाता है । सभी भूतों के कारणसमूह प्रकृति के इस गुण-संयम में भिन्न-भिन्न हो जाते हैं। तत्वों का करणों के साथ इसी प्रकार का संयम है। ह्विजवन्द ! यह तत्त्वप्रसंयम आबतंनद्यील कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The AWfl-characteriscd Akasa envelops everything and
verses.commentary: Sense: The AWfl-characteriscd Akasa envelops everything and

verses.sanskrit: अतः सुवर्णदानेन प्रीताः स्युः सर्वदेवताः । तदर्घं सर्वदा दातुः प्रीतो भवतु शङ्करः
