verses.transliteration: ataḥ suvarṇadānena prītāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ / tadarghaṃ sarvadā dātuḥ prīto bhavatu śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Then the Bhutas and the sense-organs get merged simul¬ taneously in Bhuladi. Bhuladi is of the form of Cosmic Ego. It is said to be of the quality of Tamas.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले--ऋषियन्द ! धर्म अधमे, तप, ज्ञान, सत्य, झूठ, ऊर्ष्य, अधः, सुख, दुःख, प्रिय अप्रिय --- ये सब गुणमात्रात्मक कहे जाते हैं। इन्द्रियों से परे अर्थात् जितेन्द्रिय ज्ञान सम्पन्न प्राणियों के जो कुछ भी शुभाशुभ पुण्य पापात्मक कर्म हैं, वे सब प्रकृति वश प्रतिष्ठित हैं। प्राणघारी जन्तुओं के जो कुछ भी पृण्य पापादि कम प्रकृति में प्रतिष्ठित रहते हैं। प्रकृति ही उन देहधारियों के स्वभाव की उत्तत्ति- स्‍्थली है। अव्यक्त प्रकृति में प्रतिष्ठित जन्तुओं के पुण्यपापादि कर्म समूह अन्य शरीर धारण करने पर पुनः संयुक्त हो जाते हैं । वेह॒धारियों के धर्म और भधमं -- ये दो ग्रुणमात्रात्मक हैं  काय दशा में अपने-अपने कारणों द्वारा देहधारी के स्वभाव में वद्धि प्राप्त करते हैं। इस जगत में क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठित
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Bhutas and the sense-organs get merged simul¬ taneously in Bhuladi. Bhuladi is of the form of Cosmic Ego. It is said to be of the quality of Tamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Bhutas and the sense-organs get merged simul¬ taneously in Bhuladi. Bhuladi is of the form of Cosmic Ego. It is said to be of the quality of Tamas.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना तेन पूजितः प्रथमे शिवः । यामे द्वितीये तु पुनः पूर्वोक्तविधिना चरेत्
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinā tena pūjitaḥ prathame śivaḥ / yāme dvitīye tu punaḥ pūrvoktavidhinā caret
verses.translation: The principle Mahat characterised by Budd'ni (the cos¬ mic intellect) absorbs Bhuladi. The Mahat principle is to be known to be of the form of Samkalpa (conception) and Adhyava - saya (determination, will).
verses.hindi: संयुज्यन्ते वियुज्यन्ते करण: संचरन्ति च
verses.wordMeaning: The principle Mahat characterised by Budd'ni (the cos¬ mic intellect) absorbs Bhuladi. The Mahat principle is to be known to be of the form of Samkalpa (conception) and Adhyava - saya (determination, will).
verses.commentary: Sense: The principle Mahat characterised by Budd'ni (the cos¬ mic intellect) absorbs Bhuladi. The Mahat principle is to be known to be of the form of Samkalpa (conception) and Adhyava - saya (determination, will).

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयामास दुग्धेन गव्येन त्रिपुरान्तकम् । तंदुलैः पूरणं पश्चात्कृतं लिङ्गस्य शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: snāpayāmāsa dugdhena gavyena tripurāntakam / taṃdulaiḥ pūraṇaṃ paścātkṛtaṃ liṅgasya śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: Philosophers who ponder over reality call it by the synonyms Buddhi (Intellect), Manas (Mind), Linga (the Sym¬ bol), Mahat (Great) and Aksara (the Imperishable).
verses.hindi: राजसी तामसी चेव सात्विकी चेब वृत्तय: । गुणमात्राः प्रवर्तेन्ते पुरुषाधिष्ठितास्त्रिधा ५४ ऊध्वें देवात्मकं सत्वमधोभागात्मकं तमः । तयोः प्रवर्तकं सध्य इहैवा5घ्वतंक॑ रजः इत्येब॑ परिवर्तन्ते त्रयः श्रोतोगुणात्मकाः । लोकेषु सर्वभुतानां तन्न कार्य विजानता ५६ अविद्याप्रत्ययारभ्भा आरभ्यन्ते हिं मानवेः। एतास्तु गतयस्तिस्रः शुभाः पापात्मिका: स्मृता:
verses.wordMeaning: Philosophers who ponder over reality call it by the synonyms Buddhi (Intellect), Manas (Mind), Linga (the Sym¬ bol), Mahat (Great) and Aksara (the Imperishable).
verses.commentary: Sense: Philosophers who ponder over reality call it by the synonyms Buddhi (Intellect), Manas (Mind), Linga (the Sym¬ bol), Mahat (Great) and Aksara (the Imperishable).

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा विधानं पूर्वोक्तं दत्तं वस्त्रयुगं सितम् । श्वेतवस्त्रयुगं यस्माच्छङ्करस्यातिवल्लभम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā vidhānaṃ pūrvoktaṃ dattaṃ vastrayugaṃ sitam / śvetavastrayugaṃ yasmācchaṅkarasyātivallabham
verses.translation: When all the Bhutas become dissolved, the Gunas remain in equilibrium, the entire universe becomes dark and gloomy; the groups of causes of the worlds remain merged in Atman.
verses.hindi: प्राकृतेन च बन्धेन तथा बेकारिकेण च। दक्षिणाभिस्तृतीयेन बद्धोध्त्यन्तं बिवतंते (५६ इत्येते वे त्रयः प्रोक्ता बन्धा ह्ाज्ञानहेतुका: । अनित्ये नित्यसंज्ञा च दुःखे च सुखदशनम् )६०
verses.wordMeaning: When all the Bhutas become dissolved, the Gunas remain in equilibrium, the entire universe becomes dark and gloomy; the groups of causes of the worlds remain merged in Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: When all the Bhutas become dissolved, the Gunas remain in equilibrium, the entire universe becomes dark and gloomy; the groups of causes of the worlds remain merged in Atman.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतो भवति वै शम्भुर्दत्तेन श्वेतवाससा । यामं तृतीयं सम्प्राप्तं दृष्ट्वा नृपतिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: prīto bhavati vai śambhurdattena śvetavāsasā / yāmaṃ tṛtīyaṃ samprāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpatisattamaḥ
verses.translation: The creation becomes re-absorbed in Prakrti; neither the beginning nor the end of anything is perceived; nothing is seen; no name or form remains; even those endowed with perfect knowledge do not become aware of anything; no going in or coming out is observed.
verses.hindi: सुचेतन गुण समुदाय सृष्टि की और संहारदक्षा में अपने-अपने कारणों द्वारा संयुक्त, वियुक्त और संचरणशील होते हैं ।४८-५३। समस्त पुरुषों में अधिष्ठित राजसी, तामसी एवं सात्तिकी-ये तीन गुणमात्र वृत्तियाँ प्रवरतित होती हैं। ऊध्ब भाग देवात्मक एवं सत्त्वगुण सम्पन्न है, अधोभाग तमोगुणमय है, दोनों का मध्यवर्ती एवं प्रवंतकक भाग रजोगरुणमय इस लोक प्रापक है । समस्त त्रेलोक्य में सर्वे जीवों के भीतर यही तीन भाव परिवर्तित होते रहते हैं । ज्ञानी पुरुष को लोक में समस्त जीवों के इन विविध स्वभावों की पर्यालोचना नहीं करनी चाहिए। मानव अविद्या वश विविध प्रकार के कर्मों का अनुष्ठान कर शुभ, पाप एवं मध्यात्मक़ तीन गतियों को प्राप्त करता है। जन्तृगण तमों गुण में आबद्ध होकर यथार्थ तत्तवज्ञान की प्राप्ति करने से वंचित रह जाते हैं। और इस प्रकार तत्त्वों के अदर्शव के कारण
verses.wordMeaning: The creation becomes re-absorbed in Prakrti; neither the beginning nor the end of anything is perceived; nothing is seen; no name or form remains; even those endowed with perfect knowledge do not become aware of anything; no going in or coming out is observed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation becomes re-absorbed in Prakrti; neither the beginning nor the end of anything is perceived; nothing is seen; no name or form remains; even those endowed with perfect knowledge do not become aware of anything; no going in or coming out is observed.

verses.sanskrit: देवं संस्नाप्य मधुना पूरणं चक्रिवांस् तिलैः । तिलद्रोणप्रदानं च कुर्यान्मन्त्रमुदीरयन्
verses.transliteration: devaṃ saṃsnāpya madhunā pūraṇaṃ cakrivāṃs tilaiḥ / tiladroṇapradānaṃ ca kuryānmantramudīrayan
verses.translation: Such a situation is inferred and conceived mentally and the following account is given. All objects become established in that existent-cum-non-existent ( sad-asad-atmika ) eternal great cause. This automotive activity cannot be pointed out through any specific cause. The dissolution of the Seven Prakrtis occurs in this manner. At the time of the reabsorption of creation, they enter into one another. That by which the globular Egg is enveloped becomes dissolved.
verses.hindi: तीन प्रकार के बन्धनों से आबद्ध होते हैं। प्रथम प्राकत बन्धन, द्वितीय वेकारिक बन्धन और तृतीय दक्षिणात्मक बन्धत--इन तीनों से अतिशयष आबद्ध होकर जस्तुगण दुःख का अनुभव करते हैं। ये तीनों अज्ञानपूलक बन्धन कहे जाते हैं ।(४-५९४३। अनित्य पदार्थों में नित्यता का दर्शन, दुःख में सुख का दर्शन, परकीय वस्तु में निजत्व का दर्शन, अपवित्र में पवित्रता का दर्शन, जिनके मव में ऐसे दोष रहते हैं, उनके
verses.wordMeaning: Such a situation is inferred and conceived mentally and the following account is given. All objects become established in that existent-cum-non-existent ( sad-asad-atmika ) eternal great cause. This automotive activity cannot be pointed out through any specific cause.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Such a situation is inferred and conceived mentally and the following account is given. All objects become established in that existent-cum-non-existent ( sad-asad-atmika ) eternal great cause. This automotive activity cannot be pointed out through any specific cause.…

verses.sanskrit: तिलाः श्वेतास्तिलाः कृष्णाः सर्वपापहरास्तिलाः । तिलद्रोणप्रदानेनु संसारश्छिद्यतां मम
verses.transliteration: tilāḥ śvetāstilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ sarvapāpaharāstilāḥ / tiladroṇapradānenu saṃsāraśchidyatāṃ mama
verses.translation: The seven continents, the seven oceans, the seven worlds and the seven mountains are enveloped by the covering of water. This Udakavarana (water-covering) becomes merged in Jyotis (Fire).
verses.hindi: विपयंय वश ज्ञान में भी दोष हो जाते हैं । राग और द्वेष से पूर्ण निवृत्ति का होना ही ज्ञान कहा जाता है। ऐसे ज्ञान का अभाव तमोगुण का मूल है, शुभ एवं अशुभ कर्मों का प्रेरक रजोगुण है। कर्मों से पुतः शरीर + नास्त्ययं इलो 5: ख. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: The seven continents, the seven oceans, the seven worlds and the seven mountains are enveloped by the covering of water. This Udakavarana (water-covering) becomes merged in Jyotis (Fire).
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven continents, the seven oceans, the seven worlds and the seven mountains are enveloped by the covering of water. This Udakavarana (water-covering) becomes merged in Jyotis (Fire).

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना राजा यामिनीयामपूजनम् । अतिवाह्य विनोदेन ब्रह्मघोषेण जागरम्
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinā rājā yāminīyāmapūjanam / ativāhya vinodena brahmaghoṣeṇa jāgaram
verses.translation: (Defective verse) The Taijasa (fiery) Avarana (covering) is absorbed by the Wind element. The cover of the wind element is absorbed by the element Ether.
verses.hindi: १०३८ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) The Taijasa (fiery) Avarana (covering) is absorbed by the Wind element. The cover of the wind element is absorbed by the element Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) The Taijasa (fiery) Avarana (covering) is absorbed by the Wind element. The cover of the wind element is absorbed by the element Ether.

verses.sanskrit: चकार पूजनं शम्भोर्बहुपुण्यप्रसाधकम् । ये जागरे त्रिनेत्रस्य शिवरात्र्यां शिवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: cakāra pūjanaṃ śambhorbahupuṇyaprasādhakam / ye jāgare trinetrasya śivarātryāṃ śivasthitāḥ
verses.translation: Bhuladi (the Cosmic Ego) absorbs the Ethereal Tarawa. Mahat characterised by cosmic intelligence ( Buddhi ) absorbs Bhuladi.
verses.hindi: रागद्वेषनिवत्तिश्र तज्ज्ञानं समुदाहतम् । अज्ञानं तमसो सुल॑ कर्मद्रयफल रजः ॥। कर्मजस्तु पुनर्देहो महादुःखं प्रवतंते
verses.wordMeaning: Bhuladi (the Cosmic Ego) absorbs the Ethereal Tarawa. Mahat characterised by cosmic intelligence ( Buddhi ) absorbs Bhuladi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhuladi (the Cosmic Ego) absorbs the Ethereal Tarawa. Mahat characterised by cosmic intelligence ( Buddhi ) absorbs Bhuladi.

verses.sanskrit: ते यां गतिं गताः पार्थ न तां गच्छन्ति यज्विनः । पापानि यानि कानि स्युः कोटिजन्मार्जितान्यपि
verses.transliteration: te yāṃ gatiṃ gatāḥ pārtha na tāṃ gacchanti yajvinaḥ / pāpāni yāni kāni syuḥ koṭijanmārjitānyapi
verses.translation: The Unmanifest absorbs the principle of Mahal. Thereafter the Gunas attain equilibrium. This annihilation and extension of creation is pursued through the unmanifest Prakrti stationed in Brahman.
verses.hindi: श्रोत्रजा नेत्रजा चेच त्वग्जिद्वप्नाणतस्तथा । पुनर्भवकरी दुःखा करमंणां जायते तु सा
verses.wordMeaning: The Unmanifest absorbs the principle of Mahal. Thereafter the Gunas attain equilibrium. This annihilation and extension of creation is pursued through the unmanifest Prakrti stationed in Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Unmanifest absorbs the principle of Mahal. Thereafter the Gunas attain equilibrium. This annihilation and extension of creation is pursued through the unmanifest Prakrti stationed in Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: हरकेशवयोः स्नान्ति जागरे यान्ति संक्षयम् । यावन्तो निमिषा नृणां भवन्ति निशि जाग्रताम्
verses.transliteration: harakeśavayoḥ snānti jāgare yānti saṃkṣayam / yāvanto nimiṣā nṛṇāṃ bhavanti niśi jāgratām
verses.translation: It creates and absorbs the VikSras (created objects) for the sake of creation and annihilation. The Siddhas who are en¬ dowed with perfect knowlcdgehave all instruments in the activity of annihilation (?)
verses.hindi: इत्येष वषयों राग: संभूत्या कारणं स्मृतम् । ब्रह्मादों स्थावरान्ते थे संसारे ह्माधिभौतिके ॥ धारण करना पड़ता है, जिससे महादुःख की प्राप्ति होती है ।६०-६२। कान से, नेत्र से, चमड़े से, जीभ से, और नाक से पुनर्जस्म के कारणभूत कर्मों का जन्म होता है। अपने-अपने किये गये कर्मों के फल से ही अज्ञ जीव की इन्द्रियों द्वारा उपभोग्य विषयों की तृष्णा में फसकर दुःखों का अनुभव करना पड़ता है। वह तेली के बल के समान उन्हीं विषयों में बार-बार चकक्‍कर काटता रहता है। इसी कारण से समस्त अनर्थों के मूल
verses.wordMeaning: It creates and absorbs the VikSras (created objects) for the sake of creation and annihilation. The Siddhas who are en¬ dowed with perfect knowlcdgehave all instruments in the activity of annihilation (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: It creates and absorbs the VikSras (created objects) for the sake of creation and annihilation. The Siddhas who are en¬ dowed with perfect knowlcdgehave all instruments in the activity of annihilation (?)

verses.sanskrit: निमिषे निमिषे राजन्नश्वमेधफलं ध्रुवम् । उपवासपराणां च देवायतनवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: nimiṣe nimiṣe rājannaśvamedhaphalaṃ dhruvam / upavāsaparāṇāṃ ca devāyatanavāsinām
verses.translation: Attaining a quick motion in these abodes due to their self-control, these Ksetrajnas become bereft of Karanas (sense organs and organs of activity).
verses.hindi: भूत अज्ञान से बचने का उपदेश किया जाता है । उसे अपना क्षत्रु समझकर मनुष्य को सच्चे ज्ञान की प्राप्ति के लिये यत्न करना चाहिए। ज्ञान ह्वारा ही समस्त भन्नानों से मुक्ति मिलती है। अज्ञान त्याग से सांसा- रिक विषय वासनाओं से विराग होता है। वैराग्य से मन की शुद्धि होती है और मनः शुद्धि से सात्विक भावनाओं का उदय होता है, जिसके द्वारा भुक्ति की श्राप्ति होती है । अब इसके उपरान्त समस्त प्राणियों
verses.wordMeaning: Attaining a quick motion in these abodes due to their self-control, these Ksetrajnas become bereft of Karanas (sense organs and organs of activity).
verses.commentary: Sense: Attaining a quick motion in these abodes due to their self-control, these Ksetrajnas become bereft of Karanas (sense organs and organs of activity).

verses.sanskrit: शृण्वतां धर्ममाख्यानं ध्यायतां हरकेशवौ । न तां बहुसुवर्णेन क्रतुना गतिमाप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇvatāṃ dharmamākhyānaṃ dhyāyatāṃ harakeśavau / na tāṃ bahusuvarṇena kratunā gatimāpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: They call the Avyakta (the Unmanifest) by the term kfdra and Brahma (or Brahman) is called Ksetrajha. Their union is bcginningless but is caused by Sadharmya (similarity of characteristics) and Vaidharmya (dissimilarity of charac¬ teristics).
verses.hindi: को अज्ञान में डालने वाले राग के विषय में बतला रहा हूँ। इसी राग के कारण प्राणिसमूह अवश होकर है । मनोभिलषित वस्तु की प्राप्ति में बाधा पड़ने से दुःख होता है, उसके रात दिन के अनुस्मरण से सुख का अनुभव होता है। यह सब विषयगत राग है, जो सब की उत्पत्तिका कारण कहा जाता है। ब्रह्मा से लेकर स्थावर जीव निकाथ जितने हैं, वे सब इस आधिभौतिक जगत् में इसी अज्ञान मूलक विषयों के प्रति अनुराग रखने से जन्म ग्रहण करते हैं। इस लिये इस अज्ञान से सर्वथा बचे रहना चाहिए ।३३-६६। ऋषियों के कहे
verses.wordMeaning: They call the Avyakta (the Unmanifest) by the term kfdra and Brahma (or Brahman) is called Ksetrajha. Their union is bcginningless but is caused by Sadharmya (similarity of characteristics) and Vaidharmya (dissimilarity of charac¬ teristics).
verses.commentary: Sense: They call the Avyakta (the Unmanifest) by the term kfdra and Brahma (or Brahman) is called Ksetrajha. Their union is bcginningless but is caused by Sadharmya (similarity of characteristics) and Vaidharmya (dissimilarity of charac¬ teristics).

verses.sanskrit: शिवरात्रिस्तिथिः पुण्या कार्त्तिकी च विशेषतः । रेवाया उत्तरं कूलं तीरं भारेश्वरेति च
verses.transliteration: śivarātristithiḥ puṇyā kārttikī ca viśeṣataḥ / revāyā uttaraṃ kūlaṃ tīraṃ bhāreśvareti ca
verses.translation: OBrahmanas, it is thus that one should know with regard to all Sargas (creations) and Ksetrajnas. By the knowledge of the Ksetras separately and severally, a Brahmavid (man with the knowledge of Brahman) should be known.
verses.hindi: ग़ये मत एवं शिष्टजनों द्वारा आचरित कर्म समूह उक्त अज्ञान के अनुकूल नहीं है, यह अज्ञान वास्तव में
verses.wordMeaning: OBrahmanas, it is thus that one should know with regard to all Sargas (creations) and Ksetrajnas. By the knowledge of the Ksetras separately and severally, a Brahmavid (man with the knowledge of Brahman) should be known.
verses.commentary: Sense: OBrahmanas, it is thus that one should know with regard to all Sargas (creations) and Ksetrajnas. By the knowledge of the Ksetras separately and severally, a Brahmavid (man with the knowledge of Brahman) should be known.

verses.sanskrit: जागृतश् चातिदुःखेन कथं पापं न हास्यति । इत्थंस जागरं कृत्वा शिवरात्र्यां नरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: jāgṛtaś cātiduḥkhena kathaṃ pāpaṃ na hāsyati / itthaṃsa jāgaraṃ kṛtvā śivarātryāṃ nareśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The state of being the object of knowledge (Visayaiva) and of not being so ( Avisayatva ) are proclaimed (as the characteris¬ tics) of Ksetra and Kfetrajna. Brahma should be known as Aoisaya (not object of knowledge, the knower) and Ksetra is called Visaya (object of knowledge)*.
verses.hindi: एप सार्गो हि निरधितियंग्योनो च॒ कारणम् । तियंग्योनिगतं चेव कारणं स निरुच्यते १७ १ तेन बद्धस्य वे बन्धों मोक्षों मुक्तस्य तेन च। संसारे विनिवृत्ते तु मुक्तो लिड्डोन मुच्यते ७६
verses.wordMeaning: The state of being the object of knowledge (Visayaiva) and of not being so ( Avisayatva ) are proclaimed (as the characteris¬ tics) of Ksetra and Kfetrajna. Brahma should be known as Aoisaya (not object of knowledge, the knower) and Ksetra is called Visaya (object of knowledge)*.
verses.commentary: Sense: The state of being the object of knowledge (Visayaiva) and of not being so ( Avisayatva ) are proclaimed (as the characteris¬ tics) of Ksetra and Kfetrajna. Brahma should be known as Aoisaya (not object of knowledge, the knower) and Ksetra is called Visaya (object of knowledge)*.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभाते विमले गत्वा नर्मदातीरमुत्तमम् । स्नापितास् तेन ते सर्वे वाहनानि गजादयः
verses.transliteration: prabhāte vimale gatvā narmadātīramuttamam / snāpitās tena te sarve vāhanāni gajādayaḥ
verses.translation: Ksetra is presided over by Ksetrajna and so is said to be for his sake. Since the bodies are many, the Sarlrin (the embo¬ died soul) is remembered as many.
verses.hindi: इत्येतल्‍लक्षण प्रोक्त समासाज्ज्ञानमोक्षयो: ॥ स चापि त्रिविधः प्रोक्तो मोक्षों बे तत्त्वदशिभिः:
verses.wordMeaning: Ksetra is presided over by Ksetrajna and so is said to be for his sake. Since the bodies are many, the Sarlrin (the embo¬ died soul) is remembered as many.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksetra is presided over by Ksetrajna and so is said to be for his sake. Since the bodies are many, the Sarlrin (the embo¬ died soul) is remembered as many.

verses.sanskrit: यैस्तु वाहैर्गतस् तीर्थं स्नातो ऽहं स्नापयामि तान् । तत्र मध्यस्थितः स्नातस् तिर्यक्त्वान्निर्गतो वणिक्
verses.transliteration: yaistu vāhairgatas tīrthaṃ snāto 'haṃ snāpayāmi tān / tatra madhyasthitaḥ snātas tiryaktvānnirgato vaṇik
verses.translation: These souls are stationed without any arrangement (avyuhat) and are unmixed (a-sahkardt) like luminaries. Since there is the perception of happiness and sorrow severally in the
verses.hindi: निरज्जनत्वाच्छुद्धस्तु ततो नेता न विद्यते । तृष्णाक्षयात्ततीयस्तु व्याख्यातं मोक्षकारणमू. ,अमनन-+अमकनानन- उन (या नन+पम उवानकात कक “का अं. न अकिध्माजरा ता ५. परत मंकषन्ममआ पक हू भ्ल्ल जा 5 न बन पक आन पट पपाणण ० पा 7 हि अियभ-लण 5

verses.commentary: Sense: These souls are stationed without any arrangement (avyuhat) and are unmixed (a-sahkardt) like luminaries. Since there is the perception of happiness and sorrow severally in the

verses.sanskrit: दानं ददौ तानुद्दिश्य किंचिच्छक्त्यनुरूपतः । तेन वाहकृताद्दोषान्मुक्तो भवति मानवः
verses.transliteration: dānaṃ dadau tānuddiśya kiṃcicchaktyanurūpataḥ / tena vāhakṛtāddoṣānmukto bhavati mānavaḥ
verses.translation: When the withdrawal of those different beings sets in, that is brought about naturally after the lapse of a great deal of period.
verses.hindi: वर्णाश्रमधर्म विरोधी एवं शिष्टानुमोदित ज्ास्त्रों से विपरीत है। यह एक भज्ञान पथ भस्थिर एवं तिथंक योनि में जन्म देने का कारण है। तियंकू योनिगत कारण यह कहा जाता है। उस तियंक् योनि में जन्म लेने से जो यातनाएं अनुभव करनो पड़ती हैं, उससे भी अधिक विविध प्रकार का कष्ट इस अज्ञान से मिलता है। छः प्रकार के कारणों एवं विषय में तथा तज्ञियंक् योनियों में जो भी यातनाएँ जीवों को अनुभव करनी पड़ी हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: When the withdrawal of those different beings sets in, that is brought about naturally after the lapse of a great deal of period.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the withdrawal of those different beings sets in, that is brought about naturally after the lapse of a great deal of period.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथासौ कृतो लाभः कृतो व्रजति तान् प्रति । संस्नाप्य तं ततो राजा स्वयं स्नात्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: anyathāsau kṛto lābhaḥ kṛto vrajati tān prati / saṃsnāpya taṃ tato rājā svayaṃ snātvā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: At that time the passion for sustenance of the worlds of the self-born god Brahma recedes, along with all the residents of Brahma's heaven.
verses.hindi: ने कामनाओं के प्रतिघात से उत्पन्त होती हैं। वह सारी असफलता एवं ऐड्बयय की न्यूनता इच्छाओं के प्रतिघात होने से ही उत्पन्न कही जाती द्वै। भृतादिकों की ये चार प्रकार की तामसी वृत्तियाँ कही गई हैं । सात्विक भावनानों के प्रदर्शन होने से चित्त को सत्व प्रधान माना जा सकता है, तत्त्वों के यथावत् अनु- दर्दोन एवं विचार से तत्त्वों के रहस्य ज्ञान से, सत्त्व ओर क्षेत्रज्ञ का नाचात्व ज्ञान ही वास्तविक ज्ञान कहा जाता है। ज्ञान से ही योगोत्पत्ति होती हैं--ऐसा लोगों का कहना है ।७०-७५। उसी (संसार) से बंधे रहने पर वास्तव बन्धन एवं उसी से मुक्त रहने पर वास्तविक मुक्ति होती है। संसार से विनिवृत्त हो जाने पर जब मुक्ति की प्राप्ति हो जाती है तब प्राणी लिज्ञ शरीर से भी मुक्त हो जाता है। उस मुक्तावस्था में जीव का किसी से भी कुछ सम्बन्ध नहीं रहता । उसकी एक अचतन्यावस्था रहती है, केवल आत्मनिष्ठ वह रहता है । जीव को इस
verses.wordMeaning: At that time the passion for sustenance of the worlds of the self-born god Brahma recedes, along with all the residents of Brahma's heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time the passion for sustenance of the worlds of the self-born god Brahma recedes, along with all the residents of Brahma's heaven.

verses.sanskrit: संतर्प्य पितृदेवांश्च कृत्वा श्राद्धं यथाविधि । कृत्वा पिण्डान्पितृभ्यश्च वृषमुत्सृज्य लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ yathāvidhi / kṛtvā piṇḍānpitṛbhyaśca vṛṣamutsṛjya lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Then the attachment for the sustenance of those resi¬ ding (in meditation) in Atman recedes and they begin to see defects therein of their contemporaries.
verses.hindi: विशेष अवस्था को, जब वह केवल आत्मस्थ रहता है, विरूप कहा जाता है। संक्षेप में मैंने ज्ञान एवं मोक्ष का परिचय भाप लोगों को कराया है, तत्व द्रष्टा लोग इस मोक्ष को तीन प्रकार का बतलाते हैं ।७६-७८।॥ उनमें प्रथम मोक्ष ज्ञान बल से सांसारिक विषय वासनाओं से वियोग होना कहा जाता है। दूसरा मोक्ष, राग हें षादि का निम लन होना है, जिससे लिगाभाव दशा में जीव को कैवल्य की प्राप्ति होती है, कंवल्य से निरणज्जनत्व
verses.wordMeaning: Then the attachment for the sustenance of those resi¬ ding (in meditation) in Atman recedes and they begin to see defects therein of their contemporaries.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the attachment for the sustenance of those resi¬ ding (in meditation) in Atman recedes and they begin to see defects therein of their contemporaries.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा देवालयं पश्चाद्देवं तीर्थोदकेन च । संस्नाप्य पञ्चगव्येन ततः पञ्चामृतेन च
verses.transliteration: gatvā devālayaṃ paścāddevaṃ tīrthodakena ca / saṃsnāpya pañcagavyena tataḥ pañcāmṛtena ca
verses.translation: Then their (sense of) detachment is aroused and it dispels their Atma-vada (egotism). Bhoj'ya (object of
verses.hindi: १०४० बायुपुराणम् क्षेत्रशेष्ववसज्यन्ते गुणमात्रात्मकानि तु । अत ऊध्वं प्रवक्ष्याम्ति बेराग्यं दोषदर्शनात् ८२ दिव्ये च मानुषे चव विषये पच्लक्षणे। अप्रद्वेषोष्नभिष्व ड्भरः कतंव्यो दोषदर्शनात्
verses.wordMeaning: Then their (sense of) detachment is aroused and it dispels their Atma-vada (egotism). Bhoj'ya (object of
verses.commentary: Sense: Then their (sense of) detachment is aroused and it dispels their Atma-vada (egotism). Bhoj'ya (object of

verses.sanskrit: सर्वौषधिजलेनैव ततः शुद्धोदकेन च । चन्दनेन सुगन्धेन समालभ्य च शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: sarvauṣadhijalenaiva tataḥ śuddhodakena ca / candanena sugandhena samālabhya ca śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Now they dwell in the Atman alone. They arc quiescent and endowed with (true) vision. All of them are pure, free from blemish and in conscious or unconscious stage.
verses.hindi: तापप्रीतिविषादानां कार्य तु परिवर्जनम् । एवं वराग्यमास्थाय शरीरी निर्ममो भवेत् ८४ अनित्यमशिवं दुःखसिति बुद्ध्वाइनुचिन्त्य च । विशुद्धं कार्यकरणं सत्त्वाभ्येति चरान्तुय (2?)
verses.wordMeaning: Now they dwell in the Atman alone. They arc quiescent and endowed with (true) vision. All of them are pure, free from blemish and in conscious or unconscious stage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now they dwell in the Atman alone. They arc quiescent and endowed with (true) vision. All of them are pure, free from blemish and in conscious or unconscious stage.

verses.sanskrit: कुङ्कुमैश्च सकर्पूरैर्गन्धैश्च विविधैस्तथा । पुष्पौघैश्च सुगन्धाढ्यैश्चतुर्थं लिङ्गपूरणम्
verses.transliteration: kuṅkumaiśca sakarpūrairgandhaiśca vividhaistathā / puṣpaughaiśca sugandhāḍhyaiścaturthaṃ liṅgapūraṇam
verses.translation: It is proclaimed that they attain complete absolution there itself and they do not return to Sarhsara since they are devoid of Gunas (state of nirgunatva ) and the sense of identity with the body (niratmatva).
verses.hindi: परिपक्वकषायो हि कृत्स्तान्रोषान्प्रपश्यति । ततः प्रयाणकाले हि दोषेनेंमित्तिकस्तथा ऊष्मा प्रकुपितः काये तीब्रवायुसमी रितः । स शरीरमुपाश्रित्य कृत्स्तान्दोषान्रणद्धि बे
verses.wordMeaning: It is proclaimed that they attain complete absolution there itself and they do not return to Sarhsara since they are devoid of Gunas (state of nirgunatva ) and the sense of identity with the body (niratmatva).
verses.commentary: Sense: It is proclaimed that they attain complete absolution there itself and they do not return to Sarhsara since they are devoid of Gunas (state of nirgunatva ) and the sense of identity with the body (niratmatva).

verses.sanskrit: कृतं नृपवरेणात्र कुर्वता पूर्वकं विधिम् । गोदानं च कृतं पश्चाद् विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ nṛpavareṇātra kurvatā pūrvakaṃ vidhim / godānaṃ ca kṛtaṃ paścād vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
verses.translation: Thus the process of dissolution by the Self-born Brahma through Prakrti has been recounted. In this Prasarhyama (final curbing and restraint) the Karanas (organs of activity) of all living beings differ. Thus is the curbing of the Tattvas (Principles) along with that of the Karanas. This Tattvaprasamyama is remembered as capable of repetition.
verses.hindi: प्राणस्थानानि भिन्‍्दन्हि चिछन्दत्ममाण्यतीत्य च। शत्यात्प्रकुषितों वायुरूध्च॑ तु क्रमते ततः .
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the process of dissolution by the Self-born Brahma through Prakrti has been recounted. In this Prasarhyama (final curbing and restraint) the Karanas (organs of activity) of all living beings differ.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the process of dissolution by the Self-born Brahma through Prakrti has been recounted. In this Prasarhyama (final curbing and restraint) the Karanas (organs of activity) of all living beings differ.…

verses.sanskrit: धेनुके रुद्ररूपासि रुद्रेण परिनिर्मिता । अस्मिन्नगाधे संसारे पतन्तं मां समुद्धर
verses.transliteration: dhenuke rudrarūpāsi rudreṇa parinirmitā / asminnagādhe saṃsāre patantaṃ māṃ samuddhara
verses.translation: Dharma and Adharma, penance, perfect knowledge, the auspicious, the inauspicious, truth, falsehood, superiority, inferiority, happiness, sorrow, likes, dislikes—all these are mere attributes of one who has gone* (i.e. who has attained salvation).
verses.hindi: स चाय॑ सर्वभुतानां प्राणस्थानेष्ववस्थित: । समासात्संब॒ुते ज्ञाने संवतेषु च कर्मसु ८६ एवं निरण्जनत्व से परम शुद्धत्व की प्राप्ति होती है, उस विशेष मोक्षावस्था में जीब को किसी मार्ग प्रदर्शक की आवश्यकता नहीं रहती  तृतीय मोक्ष तृष्णा का स्वंतोभावेन अभाव होंनता है, तृष्णा का यह सबंधा विनाश मोक्ष का मूल कारण है। अभिमत शब्दादिकों में प्रतिघातजन्य दुःखानुभूति मुक्तात्माओं को नहीं होती, ये आठ प्रकृति जन्य रूप, जो ग्रुण मात्रात्मक कहे जाते हैं, क्षेत्रज्ञों में क्रमानुरूप अवसक्त होते हैं। अब उसके
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma and Adharma, penance, perfect knowledge, the auspicious, the inauspicious, truth, falsehood, superiority, inferiority, happiness, sorrow, likes, dislikes—all these are mere attributes of one who has gone* (i.e. who has attained salvation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma and Adharma, penance, perfect knowledge, the auspicious, the inauspicious, truth, falsehood, superiority, inferiority, happiness, sorrow, likes, dislikes—all these are mere attributes of one who has gone* (i.e. who has attained salvation).

verses.sanskrit: धेनुं स्वलंकृतां दद्याद् अनेन विधिना ततः । क्षमाप्य देवदेवेशं ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेद् बहून्
verses.transliteration: dhenuṃ svalaṃkṛtāṃ dadyād anena vidhinā tataḥ / kṣamāpya devadeveśaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayed bahūn
verses.translation: The merits and demerits of living beings that have been stabilised in Prakrti, are declared to lie unmanifested. The same merits and demerits (in different situations) join this body or the next.
verses.hindi: उपरान्त दोष दहन के कारण वराग्य का लक्षण बतला रहा हूँ । पाँच प्रकार के दिव्य एवं मानुष विषयादिकों में अनासक्ति एवं द्वेषाभाव का व्यवहार करना चाहिए, क्योंकि इनमें दोष के दर्शन होते हैं। सब्ताष, प्रीति एवं विषाद को वर्जित करना चाहिए  इस प्रकार इन्हें छोड़ देने पर शरीरी सांसारिक पदार्थों में ममत्व रहित हो जाता है ।७६-८५४। यह संसार अनित्य है, अमंगलकारी है, दुखदायी है, ऐसा सोचकर कार्यें
verses.wordMeaning: The merits and demerits of living beings that have been stabilised in Prakrti, are declared to lie unmanifested. The same merits and demerits (in different situations) join this body or the next.
verses.commentary: Sense: The merits and demerits of living beings that have been stabilised in Prakrti, are declared to lie unmanifested. The same merits and demerits (in different situations) join this body or the next.

verses.sanskrit: षड्विधैर् भोजनैर् भक्ष्यैर् वासोभिस् तान् समर्चयेत् । दक्षिणाभिर्विचित्राभिः पूजयित्वा क्षमापयेत्
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍvidhair bhojanair bhakṣyair vāsobhis tān samarcayet / dakṣiṇābhirvicitrābhiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet
verses.translation: Dharma and Adharma (virtue and sin) are merely two qualities of creatures. They flourish in the form of the body along with the organs of sense ( Karam ) of creatures.
verses.hindi: एवं कारणों के विशुद्ध तत्त्वको जानकर ही विज्ञों को चित्त के कषाय की तरह परिपक्व हो जाने पर समस्त दोषों का दर्शन होता है। जिससे महाप्रयाण काल में नैमित्तिक दोषों के कारण शरीर में तीज्न वायु से प्रेरित ऊष्मा का प्रकोप होता है । और वह शरीर में रहनेवाले समस्त दोषों को रोकता है प्राणों के स्थानों का भेदन एवं मर्म स्थलों का छेंदन करता हुआ शीतलता से अधिक प्रव॒द्ध वायु ऊध्वैगामी होता है ।5५-५८। समस्त जीवधारियों के प्राण-स्थलों में अवस्थित वायू की यही दशा अन्त समय में होती है । संक्षेप में समस्त चेतना एवं कृतकर्मों के संकुचित हो जाने पर वह जीव स्वक्ृत पूर्व कर्मों के साथ शरीर से अपनी स्थिति विच्छिन्न कर लेता है। आठो अज्ों से प्राण की समस्त वृत्तियाँ छट जाती हैं। इस प्रकार शरीर छोड़ता हुआ जीवात्मो इबवास रहित दशा में हो जाता है। और समस्त प्राणों से बविहीन होकर वह
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma and Adharma (virtue and sin) are merely two qualities of creatures. They flourish in the form of the body along with the organs of sense ( Karam ) of creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma and Adharma (virtue and sin) are merely two qualities of creatures. They flourish in the form of the body along with the organs of sense ( Karam ) of creatures.

verses.sanskrit: स स्वयं बुभुजे पश्चात् परिवारसमन्वितः । तामेव रजनीं तत्र न्यवसज्जगतीपतिः
verses.transliteration: sa svayaṃ bubhuje paścāt parivārasamanvitaḥ / tāmeva rajanīṃ tatra nyavasajjagatīpatiḥ
verses.translation: The sentient Gunas (i.e. Sattva etc.) presided over by Ksetrajfia get dissolved during the primary creation and secondary creation in the world. The creatures come into con¬ tact or get separated from their Karanas (organs of activity) and they move about (i.e. undergo worldly existence and suffer¬ ing)-
verses.hindi: यथेह लोके खद्योते नीयमानमितस्ततः । रज्जनं तद्वभे यत्तु नेता नेता न बिद्यते १६२ तृष्णा श्षयस्तृतोयस्तु व्याख्यातं मोक्षलक्षणम् । शब्दाय विषये दोषविषये पञचलक्षणे
verses.wordMeaning: The sentient Gunas (i.e. Sattva etc.) presided over by Ksetrajfia get dissolved during the primary creation and secondary creation in the world. The creatures come into con¬ tact or get separated from their Karanas (organs of activity) and they move about (i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तत्रोषितस्यैवं निशीथे ऽथ नरेश्वर । आकाशे सो ऽति शुश्राव दिव्यवाणीसमीरितम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tatroṣitasyaivaṃ niśīthe 'tha nareśvara / ākāśe so 'ti śuśrāva divyavāṇīsamīritam
verses.translation: The Vrttis (proclivities, causes of activities) are three¬ fold according as they are of the nature of Sattva, Rajas or
verses.hindi: अप्रद्वेषो5नभिष्वद्ध : प्रीतितापविवर्जनम् । वेराग्यकारणं होतत्मकृतीनां लयस्य च ६४ वर्णाश्रमाचा रयुक्ता: शिष्टाः शास्त्रविरोधिनः । वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्मोड्यं देवस्थानेषु कारणमु
verses.wordMeaning: The Vrttis (proclivities, causes of activities) are three¬ fold according as they are of the nature of Sattva, Rajas or
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vrttis (proclivities, causes of activities) are three¬ fold according as they are of the nature of Sattva, Rajas or

verses.sanskrit: वागुवाच: राजन्समं ततो लोके फलं भवति साम्प्रतम् । संसारसागरे ह्यत्र पतितानां दुरात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: vāguvāca: rājansamaṃ tato loke phalaṃ bhavati sāmpratam / saṃsārasāgare hyatra patitānāṃ durātmanām
verses.translation: The (attribute) Sattva of the divine nature is conducive to attain the upper part (heaven) and Tamas is of the nature of (falling off) to the lower part (hell). The activiser
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मादीनि विशाचान्तान्यष्टो स्थानानि देवता: । ऐश्वरयेंमणिमायं हि कारणं ह्मष्ठलक्षणमू
verses.wordMeaning: The (attribute) Sattva of the divine nature is conducive to attain the upper part (heaven) and Tamas is of the nature of (falling off) to the lower part (hell). The activiser
verses.commentary: Sense: The (attribute) Sattva of the divine nature is conducive to attain the upper part (heaven) and Tamas is of the nature of (falling off) to the lower part (hell). The activiser

verses.sanskrit: यदि संनिधिमात्रेण फलं तत्रोच्यते कथम् । यदि शंतनुवंशस्य तत्रोन्मादकरं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yadi saṃnidhimātreṇa phalaṃ tatrocyate katham / yadi śaṃtanuvaṃśasya tatronmādakaraṃ bhavet
verses.translation: In all the worlds, within all the living beings these
verses.hindi: क्षेत्रज्ञप्वनुषज्यन्ते गुणमात्रात्मकानि तु। प्राबुटकाले पृथक्त्वेन पश्यन्तीह न चक्षुषा ६६ शरीर अन्त में मृतक नाम से पुकारा जाता है। जैसे इस लोक में खद्योत को इधर-उधर ले जाने वाला भी प्रकाशमान होता है ओर खद्योत के मर जाने पर वह भौ नहीं दिखाई पड़ता वही दशा प्राणों की ओर शरीर की है। तृष्णा का विनाद्य होना ही तीसरा मोक्ष का लक्षण कहा गया है  ब्नब्दादिक पाँच दोषादि
verses.wordMeaning: In all the worlds, within all the living beings these
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the worlds, within all the living beings these

verses.sanskrit: य एष त्वद्गृहे वोढा ह्यतिभारधुरंधरः । अनेन मित्रहननं पापं विश्वासघातनम्
verses.transliteration: ya eṣa tvadgṛhe voḍhā hyatibhāradhuraṃdharaḥ / anena mitrahananaṃ pāpaṃ viśvāsaghātanam
verses.translation: All living creatures do not understand the reality due to their being overwhelmed by Tamas. But not realising the Tattva (Reality), they are fettered in three ways.
verses.hindi: के विलय का कारण कहा गया है ।८६-६४। पूर्व कथित आठों प्रकृतियों को यथा क्रम जानना चाहिए, जो अव्यक्त से लेकर पाँचों महाभूतों तक कही जाती हैं, यही आठ प्रकृति के लय हैं) शास्त्र स्रे विरोध (न) करनेवाले वर्णाश्रम व्यवस्था के अनुयायी शिष्ट कहे जाते हैं, ब्णश्रम-ठ्यवस्था के धर्मशासन देवस्थानों की प्राप्ति के कारण भूत हैं । ब्रह्म से लेकर पिशाचों तक आठ देवयोनियाँ कही जाती हैं, अणिमा आदि ऐव्वयंदायिनी
verses.wordMeaning: All living creatures do not understand the reality due to their being overwhelmed by Tamas. But not realising the Tattva (Reality), they are fettered in three ways.
verses.commentary: Sense: All living creatures do not understand the reality due to their being overwhelmed by Tamas. But not realising the Tattva (Reality), they are fettered in three ways.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं जन्मसहस्राणामतीते परिजन्मनि । गतेन पाप्मनात्मानं नरकेषु च संस्थितिः
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ janmasahasrāṇāmatīte parijanmani / gatena pāpmanātmānaṃ narakeṣu ca saṃsthitiḥ
verses.translation: He is bound by three types of bondages: These are the three types of bondage due to ignora¬ nce. The following are the usual defects (due to them)—Seeing permanence in what is transcient; perception of happiness in what actually is the cause of misery; feeling of possessiveness in what does not belong to one; and decisive knowledge of purity in what is impure. Those who have these mental defects have the defects of knowledge through misapprehension.
verses.hindi: सिद्धियाँ भी आठ हैं। अभिमत शब्दादिक पदार्थों में प्रतिघात जन्य दुःखानुभूति उन स्थानों में रहने वालों को नहीं होती । वे प्रकृति जन्य गुगमात्रात्मक आठ प्रकार के स्वरूप क्षेत्रज्ञों में क्रमानुसछार अवसक्त होते हैं। वर्षाकाल में जिस प्रकार आकाश मण्डल में अवस्थित मेघों में तद्मत जलादि पदार्थों को लोग चमंचक्षु से नहीं देख सकते केवल अनुमानादि द्वारा ही उसका ज्ञान प्राप्त करते हैं, उसी प्रकार सिद्ध लोग जीवात्मा को अपने दिव्य नेन्नों से देखते हैं, सामान्य लोग जीव को नहीं देख सकते। वह जीवात्मा द्विजाति उच्च योनियों से लेकर रवबानों को बाँधनेवाले चाण्डालों तक की योतियों में प्रवेश करता हैं, इस प्रकार ऊध्बं, अधः, तियंक, समस्त योनियों में वह यथाक्रम अपने कर्मों के अनुसार धावन करता रहता है। जीव,
verses.wordMeaning: He is bound by three types of bondages: These are the three types of bondage due to ignora¬ nce. The following are the usual defects (due to them)—Seeing permanence in what is transcient; perception of happiness in what actually is the cause of misery;…
verses.commentary: Sense: He is bound by three types of bondages: These are the three types of bondage due to ignora¬ nce. The following are the usual defects (due to them)—Seeing permanence in what is transcient; perception of happiness in what actually is the cause of misery;…

verses.sanskrit: ततो योनिसहस्रेषु गतिस्तिर्यक्षु चैव हि । गोयोनिं समनुप्राप्तस्त्वद्गृहे स सुदुर्मतिः
verses.transliteration: tato yonisahasreṣu gatistiryakṣu caiva hi / goyoniṃ samanuprāptastvadgṛhe sa sudurmatiḥ
verses.translation: The cessation of attachment (. Raga ) and hatred ( Dvesa ) is called knowledge. Ignorance is the root-cause of Tamas. Rajas has two-fold Karman (the auspicious and inauspicious) as its result. The resumption of the physical body once again is the result of Karmas. Thus great misery begins to function.
verses.hindi: तियंगूध्वंभधस्ताच्च धावतो5पि यथाक्रमम् । जीवमाणास्तथा लिज्ठे कारण च चतुष्टयमू
verses.wordMeaning: The cessation of attachment (. Raga ) and hatred ( Dvesa ) is called knowledge. Ignorance is the root-cause of Tamas. Rajas has two-fold Karman (the auspicious and inauspicious) as its result. The resumption of the physical body once again is the result of Karmas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The cessation of attachment (. Raga ) and hatred ( Dvesa ) is called knowledge. Ignorance is the root-cause of Tamas. Rajas has two-fold Karman (the auspicious and inauspicious) as its result. The resumption of the physical body once again is the result of Karmas.…

verses.sanskrit: स्नापितश्च त्वया तीर्थे ह्यस्मिन् पर्वसमागमे । दृष्ट्वा पूजां त्वया कॢप्तां कृता जागरणक्रिया
verses.transliteration: snāpitaśca tvayā tīrthe hyasmin parvasamāgame / dṛṣṭvā pūjāṃ tvayā kḷptāṃ kṛtā jāgaraṇakriyā
verses.translation: The various sins committed by ears, eyes, skin, tongue and nose are the causes of the rebirth and misery. A man with a craving is said to be a Bala (an imma¬ ture or ignorant person). As a result of actions committed by himself, the individual soul goes round and round there only (in the Samsara) like the bull yoked to the oil-pressing machine.
verses.hindi: पर्यायवाचक: शब्देरेकार्थें: सोडभिलिख्यते । व्यक्ताध्यक्ते अ्रभाणो5्यं स व रूप॑ तु कृत्सनशः. भिद्यते करणं चापि अव्यक्ताज्ञानिनस्तथा । मुक्तो ग्रणशरीरेण प्राणाद्यन तु सबंशः १०५
verses.wordMeaning: The various sins committed by ears, eyes, skin, tongue and nose are the causes of the rebirth and misery. A man with a craving is said to be a Bala (an imma¬ ture or ignorant person). As a result of actions committed by himself,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The various sins committed by ears, eyes, skin, tongue and nose are the causes of the rebirth and misery. A man with a craving is said to be a Bala (an imma¬ ture or ignorant person). As a result of actions committed by himself,…

verses.sanskrit: तेन निष्कल्मषो जातो मुक्त्वा देहं तवाग्रतः । स्वर्गं प्रति विमानस्थः सोऽद्य राजन्गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: tena niṣkalmaṣo jāto muktvā dehaṃ tavāgrataḥ / svargaṃ prati vimānasthaḥ so'dya rājangamiṣyati
verses.translation: Hence it is taught that gross ignorance is the cause of all miseries. Realising that it is the sole enemy one shall endea¬ vour to acquire knowledge.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानाच्चतुदंशाच्छुड्ध: प्रकृति सोनुवर्तंते । प्रकृति सत्यमित्याहुविकारोनृतमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Hence it is taught that gross ignorance is the cause of all miseries. Realising that it is the sole enemy one shall endea¬ vour to acquire knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence it is taught that gross ignorance is the cause of all miseries. Realising that it is the sole enemy one shall endea¬ vour to acquire knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: एवमुक्ते निपतितो धुर्यः प्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत । विमानवरमारूढस्तत्क्षणात्समदृश्यत
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evamukte nipatito dhuryaḥ prāṇairvyayujyata / vimānavaramārūḍhastatkṣaṇātsamadṛśyata
verses.translation: One renounces {tyajate*) everything by perfect know¬ ledge. As a result of renunciation the intellect becomes detached, one becomes pure as a result of detachment; the pure one be¬ comes liberated by means of Sattva Guna. Henceforth I shall explain Raga (passion and attach¬ ment) that overwhelms living beings. Due to this attachment,
verses.hindi: क्षयणात्करणाच्चव क्षतत्राणात्तथेव च्। भाज्यत्वाहिषयत्वाच्च क्षेत्र क्षेत्रविदों विदुः ७१११ प्राण, लिज़ कारण प्रभृति पर्यायवाची शब्दों द्वारा जो सब एक ही अर्थ के द्योतक हैं, वह उल्लिखित होता है। व्यक्त अव्यक्त सवंत्र जगत् में वह प्रमाण स्वरूप है। क्षेत्रज्ञ ढ्वारा अधिष्ठित अव्यक्तान्तः पाति समस्त जगत के इन समस्त कारणों को भली भाँति अवगत कर लेने पर प्राणी प्रवित्र हो जाता है और उसे लोग विप्र की उपाधि देते हैं ।६५-१०३। जगत के इन समस्त कारणों एवं तत्त्वों को भलो भाँति देख लेने पर जीवात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: One renounces {tyajate*) everything by perfect know¬ ledge. As a result of renunciation the intellect becomes detached, one becomes pure as a result of detachment; the pure one be¬ comes liberated by means of Sattva Guna.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One renounces {tyajate*) everything by perfect know¬ ledge. As a result of renunciation the intellect becomes detached, one becomes pure as a result of detachment; the pure one be¬ comes liberated by means of Sattva Guna.…

verses.sanskrit: स तं प्रणम्य राजेन्द्रम् उवाच प्रहसन्निव
verses.transliteration: sa taṃ praṇamya rājendram uvāca prahasanniva
verses.translation: It is the attachment to worldly pleasures that is declar¬ er as the cause of births. In all the physical worlds beginning with 3-aimi and ending with the immobile beings, this attach¬ ment ahne is the cause of birth and that is the result of ignorance. Hence one shall avoid ignorance.
verses.hindi: ययेष्ट रूप से सुखपुवंक शरीर छोड़ने पर बहिगंत होता है । भव्यक्तादि के ज्ञान होने के कारण प्राणी के अन्य जम्मादि के कारणों का विनाश हो जाता है, गुणों के परिणामों से वह मुक्त हो जाता है, और इस प्रकार शान्तिपू्वक प्राणादि के परित्यामग के अनस्तर वह शरीर एवं मानस कर्म सूत्रों के सवंथा विनष्ठ हो जाने पर अन्य शरीर भी नहीं घारण करता, ठीक उसी तरह ज॑से बोज के भस्म हो जाने के बाद अड्कुर का उद्गम नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: It is the attachment to worldly pleasures that is declar¬ er as the cause of births. In all the physical worlds beginning with 3-aimi and ending with the immobile beings, this attach¬ ment ahne is the cause of birth and that is the result of ignorance.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the attachment to worldly pleasures that is declar¬ er as the cause of births. In all the physical worlds beginning with 3-aimi and ending with the immobile beings, this attach¬ ment ahne is the cause of birth and that is the result of ignorance.…

verses.sanskrit: वृष उवाच: भोभो नृपवरश्रेष्ठ तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । यत्र चास्मद्विधस्तीर्थे मुच्यते पातकैर्नरः । मया ज्ञातमशेषेण मत्समो नास्ति पातकी
verses.transliteration: vṛṣa uvāca: bhobho nṛpavaraśreṣṭha tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam / yatra cāsmadvidhastīrthe mucyate pātakairnaraḥ / mayā jñātamaśeṣeṇa matsamo nāsti pātakī
verses.translation: If one does not accept the words of sages as authority nor has regard for good manners as practised by virtuous and respectable men: if one is opposed to the discipline of (four) castes and stages in life; and if a man is antagonistic to wise men and scriptural injunctions—that is the cause of rebirth in lower species. There are various kinds of tortures in remaining (or taking birth) among the six kinds of lower animals. There is complete obstruction in the matter of cause and object of knowledge (?).
verses.hindi: होता । चौदह प्रकार के ज्ञानों से सुपरिचित होकर वह शुद्धात्मा प्रकृति का अनुवर्तत करता है। विद्वान् लोग बेवल प्रकृति को ही सत्य बतलाते हैं, विकारों का उनकी दृष्टि में मिथ्यात्व सिद्ध हो चुका है। जिसका कोई अस्तित्व नहीं है, वह असक्ष्य अथवा मिथ्या है, सद्भात्र सत्य कहा जाता है, क्षेत्र॥ नाम एवं रूप से रहित है किन्तु नाम और रूप की परम्परा उसी से चलती कही जाती है। क्षेत्र के जानने के कारण उसको क्षेत्रज्ञ को उपाधि है। उस क्षेत्र का भली भाँति प्रत्यय (अधिगम) कर लेने के कारण क्षेत्र्ञ मज्भलदायी कहा जाता है ।१०४-१०९। जीवगण इसलिये उस मंगलकारो क्षेत्रज्ञ का स्मरण करते हैं, क्षेत्र को भावना केवल क्षेत्रज्ञों द्वारा होती है । यह क्षेत्र प्रत्यय है, क्षेत्रज सवंदा उसका प्रत्यापी है। क्षय, करण, क्षतत्राण, भोज्य, एवं विषयत्व के
verses.wordMeaning: If one does not accept the words of sages as authority nor has regard for good manners as practised by virtuous and respectable men: if one is opposed to the discipline of (four) castes and stages in life;…
verses.commentary: Sense: If one does not accept the words of sages as authority nor has regard for good manners as practised by virtuous and respectable men: if one is opposed to the discipline of (four) castes and stages in life;…

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं किं तु कुर्यां परं तीर्थानुकीर्तनम् । भवान्माता भवन्भ्राता भवांश्चैव पितामहः
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ tu kuryāṃ paraṃ tīrthānukīrtanam / bhavānmātā bhavanbhrātā bhavāṃścaiva pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: The entire non-attainment of Ativarya (glory and pros- perity) is in the nature of Pratighata (obstacle) (to the desires). Thus the four types of Tamasa proclivities of the living beings etc. have been recounted.
verses.hindi: महदाद्य विशेषान्त सर्वेरूप्यं विलक्षणम् । विकारलक्षणं तद्े साक्षरक्षरमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: The entire non-attainment of Ativarya (glory and pros- perity) is in the nature of Pratighata (obstacle) (to the desires). Thus the four types of Tamasa proclivities of the living beings etc. have been recounted.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire non-attainment of Ativarya (glory and pros- perity) is in the nature of Pratighata (obstacle) (to the desires). Thus the four types of Tamasa proclivities of the living beings etc. have been recounted.

verses.sanskrit: क्षन्तव्यं प्रणतो ऽस्म्यद्य यस्मिंस्तीर्थे हि मादृशाः । गतिमीदृग्विधां यान्ति न जाने तव का गतिः
verses.transliteration: kṣantavyaṃ praṇato 'smyadya yasmiṃstīrthe hi mādṛśāḥ / gatimīdṛgvidhāṃ yānti na jāne tava kā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Bondage is for one who is fettered to it (the worldy Devoid of any Sarhbandha (contact) and in a state of
verses.hindi: तमेव च विकार तु यस्माद क्षरते पुनः । तस्माच्च कारणाच्चव क्षरमित्यभिधीयते +संसारनरकेभ्यश्र्व त्रायते पुरुष च यत् । दुःखत्राणात्पुनश्रापि क्षेत्रसित्यभिधोयते ११४ सुखदुःखमोहभावा:द्रोज्यमित्यभिधीयते । अचेतत्वाद्धि विषयस्तद्धि धर्मंविभुः स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Bondage is for one who is fettered to it (the worldy Devoid of any Sarhbandha (contact) and in a state of
verses.commentary: Sense: Bondage is for one who is fettered to it (the worldy Devoid of any Sarhbandha (contact) and in a state of

verses.sanskrit: समाराध्य महेशानं सम्पूज्य च यथाविधि । का गतिस्तव संभाष्या देह्यनुज्ञां मम प्रभो
verses.transliteration: samārādhya maheśānaṃ sampūjya ca yathāvidhi / kā gatistava saṃbhāṣyā dehyanujñāṃ mama prabho
verses.translation: Thus the characteristic features of perfect knowledge and liberation have been succinctly explained. That liberation is declared by those who see truth.
verses.hindi: न क्षीयते न क्षरति विकारप्रसुतं तु तत्। अक्षरं तेन चाप्युक्तमक्षीणत्वात्तथंव च
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristic features of perfect knowledge and liberation have been succinctly explained. That liberation is declared by those who see truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristic features of perfect knowledge and liberation have been succinctly explained. That liberation is declared by those who see truth.

verses.sanskrit: त्वरयन्ति च मां ह्येते दिविस्थाः प्रणयाद्गणाः । स्वस्त्यस्तु ते गमिष्यामीत्युक्त्वा सो ऽन्तर्दधे क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: tvarayanti ca māṃ hyete divisthāḥ praṇayādgaṇāḥ / svastyastu te gamiṣyāmītyuktvā so 'ntardadhe kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: The first one is the separation from worldly impres¬ sions, thanks to perfect knowledge. The second one is due to destruction of passion (passionate attachment) whereby the liberated soul attains Kaivalya, because even the Linga Sarira (the subtle inner body) is absent. Through Kaivalya he becomes Niranjana (unsullied). By not being sullied, he becomes Suddha (pure). In this state of liberation there is no guide or leader. The third type of cause of liberation is by the destruction of Tfsna (thirst) (for enjoyment). The liberated souls do not experience misery caused by the obstacle to the worldly objects of desired melody etc. These eight things caused by Prakfti adhere to the Ksetrajiias. They are called Gunas and Matras (the three Gunas and the five Tanmatras ).
verses.hindi: पस्मात्पुयनुशेते च तत्मात्पुरुष उच्यते । पुरप्रत्ययिको पस्मात्पुरुषे + व्यभिधीयत्ते ११७ अस्ति नास्तीति सोइन्यो वा बद्धों मुक्तो गतः स्थितः। नेहेतिकान्तनिर्देश्यसुक्तस्तस्मिन्न विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: The first one is the separation from worldly impres¬ sions, thanks to perfect knowledge. The second one is due to destruction of passion (passionate attachment) whereby the liberated soul attains Kaivalya, because even the Linga Sarira (the subtle inner body) is absent.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The first one is the separation from worldly impres¬ sions, thanks to perfect knowledge. The second one is due to destruction of passion (passionate attachment) whereby the liberated soul attains Kaivalya, because even the Linga Sarira (the subtle inner body) is absent.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: गते चादर्शनं तत्र स राजा विस्मयान्वितः । तीर्थमाहात्म्यमतुलं वर्णयन्स्वपुरं गतः
verses.transliteration: śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: gate cādarśanaṃ tatra sa rājā vismayānvitaḥ / tīrthamāhātmyamatulaṃ varṇayansvapuraṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: One should practice non-hatred and absence of attach¬ ment to the five Visayas (objects of sensual enjoyment) of both divine and human nature, after seeing the defects therein.
verses.hindi: शुद्धत्वान्न तु देश्यो वे हृष्टत्वात्समदशेनः । आत्मप्रत्ययकारी सारनूनं(? ) चापि हेतुकम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: One should practice non-hatred and absence of attach¬ ment to the five Visayas (objects of sensual enjoyment) of both divine and human nature, after seeing the defects therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should practice non-hatred and absence of attach¬ ment to the five Visayas (objects of sensual enjoyment) of both divine and human nature, after seeing the defects therein.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थंभूतं हि तत्तीर्थं नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम् । सर्वपापक्षयकरं सर्वदुःखघ्नमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃbhūtaṃ hi tattīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam / sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam
verses.translation: One should avoid heart-burn, pleasure and dejectedness. By having recourse to non-attachment the embodied soul be¬ comes free from Mamatva (the feeling of my-ness i.e. possessive¬ ness). He should decide in his mind (intellect) that (the worldly existence) is non-eternal, inauspicious and conducive to misery. Then with Sattvic traits he should perform pure activities.
verses.hindi: कारण क्षेत्रत लोग उसकी क्षेत्र संज्ञ। बतलाते हैं, सवरूप्य विलक्षण महत् से लेकर विशेष तक समस्त क्षराक्षर पदार्थ निचय विकार कहे जाते हैं । उन समस्त विकारों से पुनः क्षरण होता देखा जाता है इसीलिये उन्हें क्षर कहते हैं। संसार एवं नरकों से पुरुष की रक्षा करता है, अनेक दु:खों से उसे पुनः पुनः बचाता है, अतः उसको क्षेत्र कहते हैं। सुख, दुःख एवं मोह उत्पन्न करता है, अतः उसकी भोज्य नाम से भी प्रसिद्धि है, अचेतन यतः कभी क्षय नहीं होते, क्षीण नहीं होते, अतः अक्षर नाम से भी विख्यात हैं। पुर में सबेदा शयन करमे के कारण पुरुष नाम पड़ा, पुर“का प्रत्ययी होने से भी उसको पुरुष नाम से प्रसिद्धि है। पुरुष के लक्षण नया हैं? उसके जाननेबाले उसे किस रूप में जानते हैं--इसे अब बतला रहे हैं, सुनिये । वह पुरुष शुद्ध, निरञ्जन की तरह परम निर्मल, ज्ञान एवं अज्ञान दोनों से विवजित, अस्ति तथा नास्ति इन दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid heart-burn, pleasure and dejectedness. By having recourse to non-attachment the embodied soul be¬ comes free from Mamatva (the feeling of my-ness i.e. possessive¬ ness). He should decide in his mind (intellect) that (the worldly existence) is non-eternal,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid heart-burn, pleasure and dejectedness. By having recourse to non-attachment the embodied soul be¬ comes free from Mamatva (the feeling of my-ness i.e. possessive¬ ness). He should decide in his mind (intellect) that (the worldly existence) is non-eternal,…

verses.sanskrit: उपपापानि नश्यन्ति स्नानमात्रेण भारत । कार्त्तिकस्य चतुर्दश्याम् उपवासपरायणः
verses.transliteration: upapāpāni naśyanti snānamātreṇa bhārata / kārttikasya caturdaśyām upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: When the attachment to worldly objects of pleasure becomes firm, he becomes able to see defects and blemishes entirely.
verses.hindi: विशेषणों से रहित है। उसके लिए बढ्ध, मुक्त, गतिशील एवं स्थिर कोई भी विशेषण लागू नहीं होता। परम शुद्धता के कारण वह अनिद इय एवं आनन्द स्वरूप कहा जाता है। परम हृष्ट होने के कारण समदर्शी कहा जाता है। आत्मप्रत्यय कर्त्ता होने के कारण उनमें कोई हेतु वाद नहीं रहता । वह भावनाओं द्वारा ग्राह्म तथा अनुमानों एबं चिन्तनों द्वारा गम्य है। इन उपायों द्वारा उसे देखनेबाले मोह के वश नहीं होते ।(१६-१२०॥।
verses.wordMeaning: When the attachment to worldly objects of pleasure becomes firm, he becomes able to see defects and blemishes entirely.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the attachment to worldly objects of pleasure becomes firm, he becomes able to see defects and blemishes entirely.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्धा पूरयेल्लिङ्गं तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु । ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वङ्गनागमः
verses.transliteration: caturdhā pūrayelliṅgaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ
verses.translation: Verses 87-92 describe the process of death. Due to the chilliness, the virulently excited Vayu (life breath) pierces the centres of Pranas (vital airs), cuts off vulnerable parts of the body and rises up.
verses.hindi: इस दृश्य एवं अदृश्य बिदव प्रपच्च में एक मात्र निर्देश्य, परम श्रेष्ठ, ज्ञानमय, शान्तिमय सर्थेज्ञ पुरुष को जब  अय॑ एलोको न विद्यत क घ पस्तकयों: । + अत्न संधिराष॑:।
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 87-92 describe the process of death. Due to the chilliness, the virulently excited Vayu (life breath) pierces the centres of Pranas (vital airs), cuts off vulnerable parts of the body and rises up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 87-92 describe the process of death. Due to the chilliness, the virulently excited Vayu (life breath) pierces the centres of Pranas (vital airs), cuts off vulnerable parts of the body and rises up.

verses.sanskrit: महापापानि चत्वारि चतुर्भिर्यान्ति संक्षयम् । सो ऽश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य लभते फलमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: mahāpāpāni catvāri caturbhiryānti saṃkṣayam / so 'śvamedhasya yajñasya labhate phalamuttamam
verses.translation: It is the breath stationed in the abodes of vital airs of all living beings. By contraction, Jfiana (consciousness and knowledge) becomes covered up and the activities are enshroud¬ ed.
verses.hindi: १०४४ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is the breath stationed in the abodes of vital airs of all living beings. By contraction, Jfiana (consciousness and knowledge) becomes covered up and the activities are enshroud¬ ed.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the breath stationed in the abodes of vital airs of all living beings. By contraction, Jfiana (consciousness and knowledge) becomes covered up and the activities are enshroud¬ ed.

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तिके शुक्लपक्षस्य चतुर्दश्यामुपोषितः । स्वर्णदानाच्च तत्तीर्थे यज्ञस्य लभते फलम्
verses.transliteration: kārttike śuklapakṣasya caturdaśyāmupoṣitaḥ / svarṇadānācca tattīrthe yajñasya labhate phalam
verses.translation: The Jiva (the individual soul) being bereaved of the supporting body, is induced by its own actions committed be¬ fore. It then dislodges the Pranas from the eight limbs. (In the end) abandoning the body.it ceases to have breathing activity. Being abandoned by the vital airs thus, the person is called "Dead".
verses.hindi: एवं ज्ञात्वा स विज्ञाता ततः शान्ति नियच्छति । कार्ये च कारणे चेव बुद्धघादी भौतिके तदा स्वेनाउउत्मान तमात्मानं कारणात्मा नियच्छति । प्रकृती कारणे चव स्वात्मन्येवोपतिष्ठति
verses.wordMeaning: The Jiva (the individual soul) being bereaved of the supporting body, is induced by its own actions committed be¬ fore. It then dislodges the Pranas from the eight limbs. (In the end) abandoning the body.it ceases to have breathing activity.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Jiva (the individual soul) being bereaved of the supporting body, is induced by its own actions committed be¬ fore. It then dislodges the Pranas from the eight limbs. (In the end) abandoning the body.it ceases to have breathing activity.…

verses.sanskrit: अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां वैशाखे मासि पूर्ववत् । दीपं पिष्टमयं कृत्वा पित्ःन् सर्वान् विमोक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhe māsi pūrvavat / dīpaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā pitḥn sarvān vimokṣayet
verses.translation: This is something like this. When someone holds the glow-worm in his hand and goes about here and there he too is visible in its light. He who kills it, though a carrier (of the glow-worm) ceases to be a carrier (leader).
verses.hindi: आत्मवान्स निरात्मा वा चेतनोचेतनो5पि वा। कर्ता वा साअ्प्यकर्ता वा भोक्ता वा भोज्यमेव वा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: This is something like this. When someone holds the glow-worm in his hand and goes about here and there he too is visible in its light. He who kills it, though a carrier (of the glow-worm) ceases to be a carrier (leader).
verses.commentary: Sense: This is something like this. When someone holds the glow-worm in his hand and goes about here and there he too is visible in its light. He who kills it, though a carrier (of the glow-worm) ceases to be a carrier (leader).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यद्दीयते दानमपि वालाग्रमात्रकम् । तदक्षयफलं सर्वमेवमाह महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tatra yaddīyate dānamapi vālāgramātrakam / tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvamevamāha maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The third, viz. the elimination of thirst or covetous¬ ness is spoken as the characteristic of liberation. It is the (result of) observation of defects in five objects of sensual pleasure such as sound and others. Absence of hatred, absence of intense attachment, avoidance of pleasure and agony (about objects of pleasure)—these are the dissolutions of the eight Prakrtis (primary essences which evolved the whole Universe). All the eight Prakrtis mentioned before should be known in order, beginning with Avyakta (the Unmanifest) and endmg with BHUas (Elements). These are called the dissolution of the Prakrtis.
verses.hindi: निरात्मके पुनस्तस्मिस्वाच्यावाच्यो न विद्यते । एतो संहारविस्तारो व्यक्ताव्यक्तो ततः पुनः प्राणी देखता है तभी वह समस्त तस्वों का ज्ञान प्राप्त करता है और तभी उसे वास्तविक शाल्ति कौ उपलब्धि होती है । कार्य, कारण, भौतिक बुद्धि आदि पदार्थ समूह, संयुक्त अथवा बियुक्त, जीवित अथवा मृत इन सब में वह विज्ञाता प्रथकत्व का दहन नहीं करता। आत्मा द्वारा वह उस कारणात्मा से सयुक्त होता है, प्रकृति एवं कारण में वह सर्वत्र अपनी ही बात्मा में उपासना करता है। इस लोक अथवा पर लोक में वह
verses.wordMeaning: The third, viz. the elimination of thirst or covetous¬ ness is spoken as the characteristic of liberation. It is the (result of) observation of defects in five objects of sensual pleasure such as sound and others. Absence of hatred, absence of intense attachment,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The third, viz. the elimination of thirst or covetous¬ ness is spoken as the characteristic of liberation. It is the (result of) observation of defects in five objects of sensual pleasure such as sound and others. Absence of hatred, absence of intense attachment,…

verses.sanskrit: भारभूत्यां मृतानां तु नराणां भावितात्मनाम् । अनिवर्तिका गती राजञ्छिवलोकान् निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: bhārabhūtyāṃ mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām / anivartikā gatī rājañchivalokān nirantaram
verses.translation: Those who follow the rigorous discipline of the four castes and stages of life and those who do not go contrary to
verses.hindi: विद्यमान रहता है और नहीं भी रहता है। वह एक है अथवा अनेक है, क्षेत्रत्ष है अथवा पुरुष है, आत्मवान् है, अथवा निरात्मा है, चेतन है, अथवा अचेतन है, कर्ता है वा अकर्त्ता है, भोक्ता है वा भोज्य है इन किल्हीं भी विशेषणों से विशिष्ट एवं अविशिष्ट है ।!२१-१२५॥ उस निरञ्जन क्षेत्रश्ञ को जानने के बाद संसार में पुनरावत्ति नहीं होती, उसकौ कोई संज्ञा नहीं होती इसी कारण से वह अवाच्य कहा जाता है। उसके कोई
verses.wordMeaning: Those who follow the rigorous discipline of the four castes and stages of life and those who do not go contrary to
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who follow the rigorous discipline of the four castes and stages of life and those who do not go contrary to

verses.sanskrit: अथवा लोकवृत्त्यर्थं मर्त्यलोकं जिगीषति । साङ्गवेदज्ञविप्राणां जायते विमले कुले
verses.transliteration: athavā lokavṛttyarthaṃ martyalokaṃ jigīṣati / sāṅgavedajñaviprāṇāṃ jāyate vimale kule
verses.translation: The eight groups of Devas (and their abodes) are those Those who stay in those abodes do not experience the misery due to the obstacle to the achievement of such desired objects as sweet melody etc. These are the eight Prak r ta forms in ord-.r. They come into contact with the Ksetrajnas They are of the nature of the three Gunas and five Tanmatras People do not see with their eyes the clouds distinct from the water therein in the course of the rainy season. (Similarly ordinary people do not see the individual soul. They can only infer.) y
verses.hindi: हेतु नहीं हैं, अतः वह अग्राह्म है। चिन्तन से परे एवं सर्वत्र प्राप्य (व्याप्त) होने के कारण वह अप्रतकये है । मन के साथ उसे प्राप्त करने के उपराब्त अन्य विषयों में आसक्त नहीं होना पड़ता। क्षेत्रज्ञ के गुण रहित शुद्ध, शान्त, क्षीण, मल रहित, सुख दुःख से विहीत, परम शास्ति प्राप्त कर लेने; एवं निरात्मक हो जाने पर वाच्य एवं अवाच्य का अस्तित्व नहीं रह जाता  व्यक्त एवं अव्यक्त सृष्टि का संसार एवं विस्तार उसी परम पुरुष से प्रतिष्ठित होता है। क्षेत्रज्ञ द्वारा अधिष्ठित इस समस्त जगत् की वह पुरुष सृष्टि करता है, और लय काल में वहीं ग्रस लेता है ।(२६-१३०। बुद्धि पूर्वक जगत् को सृष्टि एवं लय उसी के अधिष्ठान भूत होते हैं। उन दोनों के (प्रकृति एवं पुरुष के) संयोग साधम्ये वधम्य॑ घटित होते हैं। उसका संयोग कब हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: The eight groups of Devas (and their abodes) are those Those who stay in those abodes do not experience the misery due to the obstacle to the achievement of such desired objects as sweet melody etc. These are the eight Prak r ta forms in ord-.r.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight groups of Devas (and their abodes) are those Those who stay in those abodes do not experience the misery due to the obstacle to the achievement of such desired objects as sweet melody etc. These are the eight Prak r ta forms in ord-.r.…

verses.sanskrit: धनधान्यसमायुक्तो वेदविद्यासमन्वितः । सर्वव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम्
verses.transliteration: dhanadhānyasamāyukto vedavidyāsamanvitaḥ / sarvavyādhivinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam
verses.translation: After realising categories ending with Avjakta (the Unmanifest) and what is presided over by the Kselrajna, he be¬ comes pure and becomes liberated through knowledge.
verses.hindi: यावच्च सर्गप्रतिसर्गकालस्तावच्च तिष्ठति सुसंनिरुध्य ।
verses.wordMeaning: After realising categories ending with Avjakta (the Unmanifest) and what is presided over by the Kselrajna, he be¬ comes pure and becomes liberated through knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: After realising categories ending with Avjakta (the Unmanifest) and what is presided over by the Kselrajna, he be¬ comes pure and becomes liberated through knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: पुनस्तत्तीर्थमासाद्य ह्यक्षयं पदमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: punastattīrthamāsādya hyakṣayaṃ padamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: When the truth is realized, the principle that was obscure comes out. But in different bodies that have completely ceased to exist, the Karana (the individual soul) differs from the Avyakta and the Jrianin. One who is completely liberated from the body in the form of Gunas as well as Prana etc. does not take up another body, just as sprout never comes out when seed is burnt. Due to knowledge he becomes enlightened and pure of the four DaSas (conditions). He follows the Prakrti. They say that Prakrti is the reality, while Vikaras (its evolutes) are unreal.
verses.hindi: एथा निसर्गप्रतिसगंपूर्व प्र (प्रा) धानिको चेश्वरकारिता च् । इत्येष प्राकृतः सर्गस्तृतीयो हेतुलक्षण: । उक्तो ह्यस्मिस्तदाःत्यन्तं करयस्तत्प्रमुच्यते (? ) इत्येष प्रतिसर्गों वस्त्रिविधः कीतितो मया । विस्तरेणाउप्नृपुर्व्या च भुयः कि वर्तेयाम्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: When the truth is realized, the principle that was obscure comes out. But in different bodies that have completely ceased to exist, the Karana (the individual soul) differs from the Avyakta and the Jrianin.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the truth is realized, the principle that was obscure comes out. But in different bodies that have completely ceased to exist, the Karana (the individual soul) differs from the Avyakta and the Jrianin.…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं कथितं ते नृपोत्तम । भारतेदं महाख्यानं शृणु चैव ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ kathitaṃ te nṛpottama / bhāratedaṃ mahākhyānaṃ śṛṇu caiva tataḥ param
verses.translation: Its Sad-bhava (apparent? existence) should be known as Anria (unreal). Sadbhava (State of being existent) is called Salya (Reality). Satya (Brahman) is without name and form. x They called Ksetrajna" as possessing name and form.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते प्रतिसगंवर्णनं नाम दृचंधिकशततमोध्ष्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Its Sad-bhava (apparent? existence) should be known as Anria (unreal). Sadbhava (State of being existent) is called Salya (Reality). Satya (Brahman) is without name and form. x They called Ksetrajna" as possessing name and form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its Sad-bhava (apparent? existence) should be known as Anria (unreal). Sadbhava (State of being existent) is called Salya (Reality). Satya (Brahman) is without name and form. x They called Ksetrajna" as possessing name and form.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भारभूतितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम नवाधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २१० श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: तस्यैवानन्तरं तात पुङ्खिलं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । तत्र तीर्थे पुरा पुङ्खः पार्थ सिद्धिमुपागतः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhārabhūtitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navādhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 210 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tasyaivānantaraṃ tāta puṅkhilaṃ tīrthamuttamam / tatra tīrthe purā puṅkhaḥ pārtha siddhimupāgataḥ
verses.translation: Because he knows (thoroughly) the Ksetra (the field i.e. the body) he is called Ksetrajna. Ksetrajna is auspicious because of the perception of Ksetra.
verses.hindi: इसका आदि काल नहीं है, चिरकाल से वह है। सृष्टि के आदिमकाल से लेकर विनाशकाल तक प्रकृति उस परमपुरुष को सन्निरुद्ध करके रखती है, उस अवस्था में पुरुष से अबुद्धिपूर्वक यह सृष्टि प्रवरतित होती है (१) उसे पुरुष का पुरुषाथ ही मानते हैं। जगत् की इस सृष्टि एबं संहार की इस प्रक्रिया को कोई तो ईश्वरकृत मानते हैं और कोई प्राधानिक अर्थात् प्रकृतिकृत । परन्तु सृष्टि का यह व्यापार अनादि एवं अनन्त है । जगत् को अभिमान पूर्वक वित्रासित करती हुईं वह प्रकृति प्राप्त होती है  प्रकृति जन्‍्य सृष्टि का यह तृत्तीय हेतु कहा जा चुका, इनमैं अत्यन्त निष्ठा रखने वाला मुक्ति प्राप्त करता है। (१) आप लोगों से इस प्रकार तीन प्रतिसर्गों की चर्चा मैं विस्तार पूर्वक क्रमशः कर चुका, अब आगे के लिये बतलाइये, मैं क्‍या
verses.wordMeaning: Because he knows (thoroughly) the Ksetra (the field i.e. the body) he is called Ksetrajna. Ksetrajna is auspicious because of the perception of Ksetra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because he knows (thoroughly) the Ksetra (the field i.e. the body) he is called Ksetrajna. Ksetrajna is auspicious because of the perception of Ksetra.

verses.sanskrit: जामदग्न्यो महातेजाः क्षत्रियान्तकरः प्रभुः । तपः कृत्वा सुविपुलं नर्मदोत्तरतीरभाक्
verses.transliteration: jāmadagnyo mahātejāḥ kṣatriyāntakaraḥ prabhuḥ / tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ narmadottaratīrabhāk
verses.translation: Ksetrajna is remembered. Hence it is mentioned as Ksetra by those who know it. Ksetra is seen to be without intelli¬ gence but Ksetrajna is always endowed with intelligence.
verses.hindi: श्री वायुपुराण में प्रतिसर्गंवर्णन नामक एक सौ दो अध्याय समाप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Ksetrajna is remembered. Hence it is mentioned as Ksetra by those who know it. Ksetra is seen to be without intelli¬ gence but Ksetrajna is always endowed with intelligence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ksetrajna is remembered. Hence it is mentioned as Ksetra by those who know it. Ksetra is seen to be without intelli¬ gence but Ksetrajna is always endowed with intelligence.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति विख्यातं पुङ्खतीर्थं नरेश्वर । तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा ह्याराध्य परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti vikhyātaṃ puṅkhatīrthaṃ nareśvara / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā hyārādhya parameśvaram
verses.translation: Those who know Ksetra call it so because of its Ksayana (destruction), Karana (being created), Ksalatrdna (protection from wound), Bhojyalva (state of being what is eaten or enjoyed) and Visayalva (state of being the object).
verses.hindi: १०४६ वायुपुराणम् सत सुमह॒दाख्यानं भवता परिकीतितम् । प्रजानां सनुभिः साथ देवानामूषितिः सह १ पितृगन्धवे भूतानां पिशाचोरगरक्षसाम् । देत्यानां दानवानां च यक्षाणामेव पक्षिणाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Those who know Ksetra call it so because of its Ksayana (destruction), Karana (being created), Ksalatrdna (protection from wound), Bhojyalva (state of being what is eaten or enjoyed) and Visayalva (state of being the object).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who know Ksetra call it so because of its Ksayana (destruction), Karana (being created), Ksalatrdna (protection from wound), Bhojyalva (state of being what is eaten or enjoyed) and Visayalva (state of being the object).

verses.sanskrit: इहलोके बलैर्युक्तः परे मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् । देवान्पित्ःन् समभ्यर्च्य पित्ःणाम् अनृणी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ihaloke balairyuktaḥ pare mokṣamavāpnuyāt / devānpitḥn samabhyarcya pitḥṇām anṛṇī bhavet
verses.translation: All categories beginning with Mahat, ending with VtSesa possess variety of forms and they are characterised as Vikara (an evolute, change). Hence they arc peculiar (Vila- ksana). Hence verily Aksara (imperishable) approaches the / Kfara (perishable) I. * 3.
verses.hindi: अत्यद्भुतानि कर्माणि विधिसान्धरंनिश्चयः । विचित्राश्न कथायोगा जन्म चाग्रयमनुत्तमम् ३ तत्कथ्यमानमस्माक भवता श्लक्ष्ण्या गिरा। मनःकर्णसु्ख॑ सोते प्रीणात्याभुतसंभवम् ४
verses.wordMeaning: All categories beginning with Mahat, ending with VtSesa possess variety of forms and they are characterised as Vikara (an evolute, change). Hence they arc peculiar (Vila- ksana). Hence verily Aksara (imperishable) approaches the / Kfara (perishable) I. * 3.
verses.commentary: Sense: All categories beginning with Mahat, ending with VtSesa possess variety of forms and they are characterised as Vikara (an evolute, change). Hence they arc peculiar (Vila- ksana). Hence verily Aksara (imperishable) approaches the / Kfara (perishable) I. * 3.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरो यस्तु प्राणत्यागं करोति वै । अनिवर्तिका गतिस् तस्य रुद्रलोकाद् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naro yastu prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti vai / anivartikā gatis tasya rudralokād asaṃśayam
verses.translation: That evolute ( Vikara ) is called Ksara as it wastes away and perishes. 4
verses.hindi: करथ्थ सुत महाप्राज्ञ पुनः सगे: प्रपत्स्यते । बन्धेषु संप्रलीनेषु गुणसाम्ये तमोमये ३६ विकारेष्वविसुष्टेषु अव्यक्ते चा55त्मनि स्थिते । + अभ्रवत्ते ब्राह्मणानु महासायो(यु)ज्यगैस्तदा ॥ ऋषियों ने कहा--सूत जी ! आप ने एक महान् आखू्यान हम लोगों से कहा  मनु समेत समस्त प्रजाओं, ऋषियों समेत समस्त देवज्षाओं, पितरों, गन्धवाँ, भूतों, पिचाशों, उरगों, राक्षसों, हैत्यों, दानवों, यक्षों एवं पक्षियों के भति अद्भूत कर्म, उनके धर्म निश्चय, उनके जन्म की विचित्र एवं श्रेष्ठ कथाएँ, जो मन को एवं कान को सुख देने वाली थीं आपने हम लोगों को अपनी परभ मनोहर वाणी में सुनाया ।
verses.wordMeaning: That evolute ( Vikara ) is called Ksara as it wastes away and perishes. 4
verses.commentary: Sense: That evolute ( Vikara ) is called Ksara as it wastes away and perishes. 4

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा हयमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Happiness, misery, delusion are called Bhojya (that which is to be experienced). It is Visaya (object of enjoyment) as it is insentient. That which has the opposite quality 5 * * * * is remem¬ bered as Vibhu.
verses.hindi: सूत पुत्र वे कथाएँ सचमुच मनुष्य को महाप्रलय पयेस्त प्रसन्न रखनेवाली हैं। इस प्रकार उन सब यज्ञकर्त्ता महर्षियों ने सृत जी का सत्कार एवं समादर करते हुए पुनः सृष्टि प्रवर्तन की आख्या पूछा
verses.wordMeaning: Happiness, misery, delusion are called Bhojya (that which is to be experienced). It is Visaya (object of enjoyment) as it is insentient. That which has the opposite quality 5 * * * * is remem¬ bered as Vibhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Happiness, misery, delusion are called Bhojya (that which is to be experienced). It is Visaya (object of enjoyment) as it is insentient. That which has the opposite quality 5 * * * * is remem¬ bered as Vibhu.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे नरो यस्तु ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेन् नृप । एकस्मिन् भोजिते विप्रे कोटिर्भवति भोजिता
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe naro yastu brāhmaṇān bhojayen nṛpa / ekasmin bhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā
verses.translation: It is called Aksara (imperishable) for the following reasons: It does not waste away (na ksiyate). It does not perish ( na ksarati). Evolutes spread from it. It is not diminished.
verses.hindi: महाप्राज्ञ सृत जी  जब क्षेत्र समस्त प्राकृत गुण बन्धनों से विमुक्त हो जाता है, प्रकृति के सत्त्व, रजस्, तमस् ये तीनों गुण साम्यावस्था में परिणत हो जाते हैं, समस्त ब्रह्माण्ड घोर अन्धकार मय हो जाता है, विकार समूह निष्क्रिय एवं प्रवृत्ति रहित हो जाते हैं, जीव समूह ब्रह्मा के साथ ही महाव् साम्राज्य में  धनुदिचिल्वान्तगंतग्रन्थः ख. पुस्तके नास्ति । + नास्त्यधंमिदं घ. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Aksara (imperishable) for the following reasons: It does not waste away (na ksiyate). It does not perish ( na ksarati). Evolutes spread from it. It is not diminished.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Aksara (imperishable) for the following reasons: It does not waste away (na ksiyate). It does not perish ( na ksarati). Evolutes spread from it. It is not diminished.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित् पूजयेद् वृषभध्वजम् । वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścit pūjayed vṛṣabhadhvajam / vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: Since it lies in Pur (puri anuSele ) it is called Purusa. The term Purusa is derived also as follows: Since it is Purafira- tynyika that is the Pratyayi (the knower) of the Pura (Body), it is cailed so.
verses.hindi: व्यधिकरशंततमोष्यायः १०४७
verses.wordMeaning: Since it lies in Pur (puri anuSele ) it is called Purusa. The term Purusa is derived also as follows: Since it is Purafira- tynyika that is the Pratyayi (the knower) of the Pura (Body), it is cailed so.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since it lies in Pur (puri anuSele ) it is called Purusa. The term Purusa is derived also as follows: Since it is Purafira- tynyika that is the Pratyayi (the knower) of the Pura (Body), it is cailed so.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पुङ्खिलतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम दशोत्तरद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २११ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: आश्चर्यभूतं लोकस्य देवदेवेन यत्कृतम् । तत्ते सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि नर्मदातटवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe puṅkhilatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma daśottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 211 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: āścaryabhūtaṃ lokasya devadevena yatkṛtam / tatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi narmadātaṭavāsinām
verses.translation: He is other than what can be called existent, non¬ existent, bound, liberated, mobile, stable. As he is devoid of any cause, he cannot be specified (by any of these terms). 1
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तस्ततः सूतस्तदाइसौ लोमहषंणः। व्याख्यातुमुपचक्राम पुन: सर्मप्रवतंनम्  ८ अव्यक्तवत्परोक्षत्वादृप्रहणं तद्दुरासदम् । विकारेः प्रतिसंदृष्टे गुणसास्ये निवतंते ११ प्रधान पुरुषाणां च साधम्येंणेव तिष्ठति । धर्माधर्मों प्रलीयेते अव्यक्तो प्राणिनां सदा ११२ सत्त्वसात्रात्मको धर्मो गुणसत्त्वे प्रतिष्ठितः  तमोमात्रात्मको5धर्मो गुणे तमसि तिष्ठति ३१३ अविभागवन्तावेतो गुणसाम्यस्थिताबुभौ । सबका बुद्धिपुर्व प्रधानस्य प्रपत्स्यते
verses.wordMeaning: He is other than what can be called existent, non¬ existent, bound, liberated, mobile, stable. As he is devoid of any cause, he cannot be specified (by any of these terms). 1
verses.commentary: Sense: He is other than what can be called existent, non¬ existent, bound, liberated, mobile, stable. As he is devoid of any cause, he cannot be specified (by any of these terms). 1

verses.sanskrit: द्विजान् सुकृत्पणान् देवः कुष्ठी भूत्वा ययाच ह । श्राद्धकाले तु सम्प्राप्ते रक्तगन्धानुलेपनः
verses.transliteration: dvijān sukṛtpaṇān devaḥ kuṣṭhī bhūtvā yayāca ha / śrāddhakāle tu samprāpte raktagandhānulepanaḥ
verses.translation: Since he is very pure, he cannot be indicated specifi¬ cally. Since he is full of bliss, it is of equal vision. Since he is the cause (Karin) of Atmapralyaya (the knowledge of Atman), no causal expression applies to it 2 (?) It can be imagined or in¬ ferred. Those who perceive thus are not deluded.
verses.hindi: तस्माच्छरणमव्यक्त साम्ये स्थित्वा गुणात्मकानु। क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं तच्च बेषभ्यं भजते तु तत्ू
verses.wordMeaning: Since he is very pure, he cannot be indicated specifi¬ cally. Since he is full of bliss, it is of equal vision. Since he is the cause (Karin) of Atmapralyaya (the knowledge of Atman), no causal expression applies to it 2 (?) It can be imagined or in¬ ferred.…
