verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा ने कहा--महाभाग गयासुर ! समस्त पृथ्वी भर में भ्रमण करके मैंने जिन-जिन तीर्थों को देखा है, वे तुम्हारे शरीर की पवित्रता के कारण यज्ञ के लिए पवित्र नहीं रह सके  भगवान् विष्णु की अनुकम्पा से हुमने अपने शरीर में परम पवित्रता का लाभ किया है, अतः मैं चाहता हूँ कि यज्ञ के लिये तुम अपने पवित्र शरीर का मुझे दान करो गयासुर खबोला--हे देव-देवेश  आप हमारे शरीर के लिए प्राथना कर रहे हैं, यह हमारा घन्य भाग्य है। यदि आप हमारे शरोर में यज्ञ क्रिया सम्पन्न करेगे तो हमारा पितृ कुल कृतक्ृत्य हो जायगा। हे देव  इस नश्वर शरीर की रचना आप ही ने की है, तुम्हीं ने इसे इतनी अपूर्ब पवित्रता प्रदान की है, सभी जीव धारियों के लाभाथ होनेवाला वह याग अवश्य सम्पन्न होगा  श्वेत कल्प में ऐसो बातें कर गयासुर
verses.wordMeaning: On being eulogised thus, Vasudeva granted vision unto the Suras (i.e. manifested himself in front of them). O Devas, wherefore have you all come?" On being asked thus by Visnu the Devas said to him:
verses.commentary: Sense: On being eulogised thus, Vasudeva granted vision unto the Suras (i.e. manifested himself in front of them). O Devas, wherefore have you all come?" On being asked thus by Visnu the Devas said to him:

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघ्नो वा सुरापो वा स्वर्णहृद् गुरुतल्पगः । रेवातीरे शिवं स्थाप्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: brahmaghno vā surāpo vā svarṇahṛd gurutalpagaḥ / revātīre śivaṃ sthāpya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: "O Lord, save us from the danger of demon Gaya". Hari said, "May Brahma and others go near that Daitya. I shall also come there".
verses.hindi: नैऋत दिशा की और धराशायी हो गया, उस समय पर्वत प्रान्त में सवंत्र कोलाहल मच गया। देत्य ने अपने शिर को उत्तर दिज्ञा में और दोनों पैरों को दक्षिण दिशा में किया। यज्ञ की समस्त सामग्रियों एवं साधनों समेत ब्रह्मा ने उक्त यज्ञ को सर्वाद्भतः सम्पन्न करने के लिये मांनस पुरोहितों की सृष्टि की ।३०-३३॥। उनके नाम थे, अग्निशर्मा, अमृत, शौनक, जाउजलि, मृदु, कुमुथि, वेद कौण्डिल्य, हारोत, काश्यप, कप, गर्ग,
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord, save us from the danger of demon Gaya". Hari said, "May Brahma and others go near that Daitya. I shall also come there".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, save us from the danger of demon Gaya". Hari said, "May Brahma and others go near that Daitya. I shall also come there".

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्भर्गसरित्तीरे स्थापयित्वा त्रियम्बकम् । वियुक्तः सर्वदोषैस्त्वं यास्यसे पदमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādbhargasarittīre sthāpayitvā triyambakam / viyuktaḥ sarvadoṣaistvaṃ yāsyase padamuttamam
verses.translation: Seated on Garuda, Kesava started in order to grant a boon to Gayasura. All the Devas seated themselves on their respective excellent vehicles and proceeded.
verses.hindi: कौशिक वाद्िष्ठ, परम तपोनिष्ठ भागंव, वृद्ध पाराशर, कण्व, माण्डब्य, श्रुति केवल, इवेत, सुताल, दमन, १०७८ क्‍ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Seated on Garuda, Kesava started in order to grant a boon to Gayasura. All the Devas seated themselves on their respective excellent vehicles and proceeded.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seated on Garuda, Kesava started in order to grant a boon to Gayasura. All the Devas seated themselves on their respective excellent vehicles and proceeded.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः स विधिना हृष्टतुष्टः खगोत्तमः । तथेत्युक्त्वा जगामाशु नर्मदातीरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ sa vidhinā hṛṣṭatuṣṭaḥ khagottamaḥ / tathetyuktvā jagāmāśu narmadātīramuttamam
verses.translation: Vasudeva and others spoke to him: "O demon Gaya, what for is this penance being performed by you? We have all arrived here fully satisfied (with your penance). Mention the boon (you wish to have)
verses.hindi: गर्ग कोशिकवासिष्ठो सुनि भागंवसव्ययम् । बद्धं पाराशरं कण्वं साण्डव्यं भुतिकेवलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Vasudeva and others spoke to him: "O demon Gaya, what for is this penance being performed by you? We have all arrived here fully satisfied (with your penance). Mention the boon (you wish to have)
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasudeva and others spoke to him: "O demon Gaya, what for is this penance being performed by you? We have all arrived here fully satisfied (with your penance). Mention the boon (you wish to have)

verses.sanskrit: तपस्तप्त्वा कियत्कालं स्थापयामास शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: tapastaptvā kiyatkālaṃ sthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaram
verses.translation: O Devas, Brahma, Visnu and Mahcsvara, if you are pleased, may I be ever holier than these: than all the Devas, and Brahmanas, than all the Yajfias, holy rivers and mountains; than all the Devas; than all the sages; than even the unchanging Siva; than all the Mantras; than all the lords of Devas; than all the Yogins; than all the renouncers; than all the Karmins (the performers of holy rites); than all the Dharmins (pious ones); than all the holy Jhdnins (wise ones and knowers).
verses.hindi: श्वेत सुमालं दमन सुहोत्र कड्ध.मेव घ । लौकाक्षि च महाबाहूं जेगीषव्यं तयेब च ३३६ दधिपसुखं विप्रमृष्भ ककंमेव च् । कात्यायनं गोभिलं च मुनिमुग्रमहातन्रतम् (३७ +आत्रेयं चाप्यद्धिरसमोपमन्य महान्रतम् । गोकर्ण च गुहावास शिखण्डिनमुमान्नतम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Devas, Brahma, Visnu and Mahcsvara, if you are pleased, may I be ever holier than these: than all the Devas, and Brahmanas, than all the Yajfias, holy rivers and mountains; than all the Devas; than all the sages; than even the unchanging Siva; than all the Mantras;…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Devas, Brahma, Visnu and Mahcsvara, if you are pleased, may I be ever holier than these: than all the Devas, and Brahmanas, than all the Yajfias, holy rivers and mountains; than all the Devas; than all the sages; than even the unchanging Siva; than all the Mantras;…

verses.sanskrit: स्वनाम्ना भरतश्रेष्ठ हंसेश्वरमनुत्तमम् । पूजयित्वा परं स्थानं प्राप्तवान्खगसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: svanāmnā bharataśreṣṭha haṃseśvaramanuttamam / pūjayitvā paraṃ sthānaṃ prāptavānkhagasattamaḥ
verses.translation: "May you be pure and holy". After saying this to the Daitya, the Devas went to heaven. After seeing and touching the Daitya, all people went to Hari's city (i.e. Vaikuntha). All the three worlds became vacant. The whole of the city of Yama became void. Thereafter, Yama went to Brahma- loka along with Indra and others.
verses.hindi: एतानन्यांश्व विप्रेद्धान्वेधा लोकपितामहः । परिकल्प्याक रोद्यागं गयासुरशरीरके -
verses.wordMeaning: "May you be pure and holy". After saying this to the Daitya, the Devas went to heaven. After seeing and touching the Daitya, all people went to Hari's city (i.e. Vaikuntha). All the three worlds became vacant. The whole of the city of Yama became void. Thereafter,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "May you be pure and holy". After saying this to the Daitya, the Devas went to heaven. After seeing and touching the Daitya, all people went to Hari's city (i.e. Vaikuntha). All the three worlds became vacant. The whole of the city of Yama became void. Thereafter,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र हंसेश्वरे तीर्थे गत्वा स्नात्वा युधिष्ठिर । पूजयेत्परमेशानं स पापैः परिमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra haṃseśvare tīrthe gatvā snātvā yudhiṣṭhira / pūjayetparameśānaṃ sa pāpaiḥ parimucyate
verses.translation: All the Devas displaced by Gayasura spoke to Brahma: "O Pitamaha, please take back the authority which has been given by you (to us)."
verses.hindi: सभ्यावसथ्यो देवषें तेषु यज्ञा: प्रतिष्ठिता:  यज्ञस्थ च प्रतिष्ठार्थे विप्रेभ्यो दक्षिणां ददो ४२ हुत्वा पूर्णाहुति ब्रह्मा स्नात्वा चावभथेन तु । यज्ञयूपं सुरेः साथ समानीय व्यरोपयत् ॥४ ३ ब्रह्मण: सरसः श्रेष्ठ सरस्येवा5उश्रितं शुभम् । चलितशभ्रकितो ब्रह्मा धर्मराजमभाषत ४४ जाता ग॒हे तव शिला समानीयाविचारयन् । देत्यस्थ शीक्र शिरसि ता धारय ममाइकज्ञया .
verses.wordMeaning: All the Devas displaced by Gayasura spoke to Brahma: "O Pitamaha, please take back the authority which has been given by you (to us)."
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Devas displaced by Gayasura spoke to Brahma: "O Pitamaha, please take back the authority which has been given by you (to us)."

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवन्नेकमना देवं न दैन्यं प्राप्नुयात् क्वचित् । श्राद्धं दीपप्रदानं च ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनम् । दत्त्वा शक्त्या नृपश्रेष्ठ स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: stuvannekamanā devaṃ na dainyaṃ prāpnuyāt kvacit / śrāddhaṃ dīpapradānaṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam / dattvā śaktyā nṛpaśreṣṭha svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Then Brahma spoke to the Devas: "We shall go to the immutable Visnu". Brahma and others said to Visnu: "Since the Asura has been granted the boon by you, all the people have been going to heaven by merely looking at him. All the three worlds have become void." On being informed thus by the Devas, Vasudeva spoke thus to god Brahma: Go and request the demon thus, 'Give your body for the purpose of YajnaV* Urged by Visnu, Brahma went there accompanied by the Suras and saw the great Asura.
verses.hindi: निश्चलार्थ यमः भ्रुत्वाईधारयस्मस्तके शिलाम् । शिलायां धारितायां तु सशिलश्रासुरोइ्चलत्ू
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma spoke to the Devas: "We shall go to the immutable Visnu". Brahma and others said to Visnu: "Since the Asura has been granted the boon by you, all the people have been going to heaven by merely looking at him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma spoke to the Devas: "We shall go to the immutable Visnu". Brahma and others said to Visnu: "Since the Asura has been granted the boon by you, all the people have been going to heaven by merely looking at him.…

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकालम् एककालं वा यो भक्त्या पूजयेच्छिवम् । नवप्रसूतां धेनुं च दत्त्वा पार्थ द्विजोत्तमे । षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि शिवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: trikālam ekakālaṃ vā yo bhaktyā pūjayecchivam / navaprasūtāṃ dhenuṃ ca dattvā pārtha dvijottame / ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: On seeing Brahma along with the Devas, the demon Gaya stood up and duly and devoutly worshipped them.
verses.hindi: सुहोत्र, कद्भू, लोकाक्षि, महाबाहु जगीषव्य, दधिपटुचमुख, विप्रवर ऋषभ, कके कात्यायन, गोभिल, महांब्रवशाली मुनिवर उग्र, सुपालक, गौतम, वेदशिरोब्रत अव्यग्रचित्त जयमाली चाट्हास, दारुण, आज्रेय, अज़िरस, ओपमम्यु महाव्रतशील गोकर्ण, गृहावास, शिरवण्डी, उमाव्रत,--इन सब मुनियों के अतिरिक्त अन्यान्य बहुतेरे विप्रों की लोक पितामह ब्रह्मा जो ने सृष्टि की और गयासुर के शरीर पर यज्ञ का काय प्रारम्भ किया ।३४-४०। इन उपर्यक्त पुरोहित ऋषियों में से अग्निद्यर्मा ने अपने मुख से दक्षिणारिन, गाहँपत्य, आवहनीय, सभ्य एवं अवसम्य नमक पाँच अग्नियों का निर्माण किया । है देव्धि ! इन्हीं पाँचों अग्नियों में यज्ञों की प्रतिष्ठा हुईं। यज्ञ की सम्यक प्रतिष्ठापना के लिये ब्राह्मणों को प्रचुर दक्षिणाएँ दी गई। यज्ञ के अस्त में भगवान् ब्रह्मा ने पूर्णा- हुति दान के उपशन्‍्त अवभूथ स्नान किया--और समस्त देवताओं के साथ यज्ञस्तम्भ को आरोपित किया ।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Brahma along with the Devas, the demon Gaya stood up and duly and devoutly worshipped them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Brahma along with the Devas, the demon Gaya stood up and duly and devoutly worshipped them.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे हंसेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकविंशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २२२ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततः क्रोशान्तरे गच्छेत्तिलादं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । तिलप्राशनकृद्यत्र जाबालिः शुद्धिमाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe haṃseśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 222 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ krośāntare gacchettilādaṃ tīrthamuttamam / tilaprāśanakṛdyatra jābāliḥ śuddhimāptavān
verses.translation: My birth has become fruitful today. My penance has
verses.hindi: उस मंगलमय स्तम्भ को ब्रह्मा के उत्तम सरोवर में बिमज्जित कर उसी में प्रतिष्ठित भी किया । यज्ञभूमि के चलायमान होने पर ब्रह्मा जी चकित होकर धर्मराज से बोले, यमराज तुम्हारे घर एक शिला है, उसे बिना किसी वितर्क के यहाँ लाओ और देत्य के शिर पर शीघ्र स्थापित करो-ऐसी मेरी आज्ञा है। असुरराज गय के शरीर को निशचल करने को अत्यावश्यक समझ कर यमराज ने शिला लाकर उसके मस्तक पर रखा,
verses.wordMeaning: My birth has become fruitful today. My penance has
verses.commentary: Sense: My birth has become fruitful today. My penance has

verses.sanskrit: पितृमातृपरित्यागी भ्रातुर्भार्याभिलाषकृत् । पुत्रविक्रयकृत्पापश्छलकृद्गुरुणा सह
verses.transliteration: pitṛmātṛparityāgī bhrāturbhāryābhilāṣakṛt / putravikrayakṛtpāpaśchalakṛdguruṇā saha
verses.translation: O Yogin, O knovver of all the ancillaries of Yoga, O master of all the worlds, O father, O preceptor, O Brahma, I shall carry out the work for which you have come.
verses.hindi: किन्तु उस शिला के रखने पर भी असुरराज शिला समेत विचलित हो गया । तब ब्रह्मा ने रुद्रादि देवताओं से इदमर्ध॑ नारित ख. पुस्तके । + अभय इलोको न विद्यते ख- पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: O Yogin, O knovver of all the ancillaries of Yoga, O master of all the worlds, O father, O preceptor, O Brahma, I shall carry out the work for which you have come.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Yogin, O knovver of all the ancillaries of Yoga, O master of all the worlds, O father, O preceptor, O Brahma, I shall carry out the work for which you have come.

verses.sanskrit: एवं दोषसमाविष्टो यत्र यत्रापि गच्छति । तत्र तत्रापि धिक्कारं लभते सत्सु भारत । न कोऽपि संगतिं धत्ते तेन सार्द्धं सभास्वपि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ doṣasamāviṣṭo yatra yatrāpi gacchati / tatra tatrāpi dhikkāraṃ labhate satsu bhārata / na ko'pi saṃgatiṃ dhatte tena sārddhaṃ sabhāsvapi
verses.translation: All the holy centres of the earth seen by me while wandering over it, are not as pure as your body, for the purpose of Yajna.
verses.hindi: देवानचे5थ रुद्रादीडि्शिलायां निश्चलाः किल 4 तिष्ठन्तु देवा: सकलास्तथेत्युक्त्वा च॒ ते स्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: All the holy centres of the earth seen by me while wandering over it, are not as pure as your body, for the purpose of Yajna.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the holy centres of the earth seen by me while wandering over it, are not as pure as your body, for the purpose of Yajna.

verses.sanskrit: इति लज्जान्वितो विप्रः काले न महता नृप । चिन्तामवाप महतीम् अगतिज्ञो हि पावने
verses.transliteration: iti lajjānvito vipraḥ kāle na mahatā nṛpa / cintāmavāpa mahatīm agatijño hi pāvane
verses.translation: Holiness of the body has been attained by you, thanks to the grace of Visnu. Hence, O Asura, give unto me your pure body for the purpose of Yajna.
verses.hindi: देवाः पादलेक्षयित्वा तथाइपि कलितो5सुर:ः । ब्रह्माइथ व्याकुलो विष्णुं गतः क्षीराब्धिशायिनम् ॥। ब्रह्मणण्डस्य पते नाथ नमामि जगतां पतिम् । गति कौतिमतां न॒णां भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Holiness of the body has been attained by you, thanks to the grace of Visnu. Hence, O Asura, give unto me your pure body for the purpose of Yajna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Holiness of the body has been attained by you, thanks to the grace of Visnu. Hence, O Asura, give unto me your pure body for the purpose of Yajna.

verses.sanskrit: चकार सर्वतीर्थानि रेवां चाप्यवगाहयत्
verses.transliteration: cakāra sarvatīrthāni revāṃ cāpyavagāhayat
verses.translation: O lordofDevas, I am blessed since my body is being asked for by you. If you perform Yaga (sacrifice) over my body the Pitrs in my family shall be contented.
verses.hindi: विष्वक्सेनो5ब्रवीद्विष्णुं देव त्वां स्तौति पद्मजः । हरिराहा;नय स्वं ते विष्णृक्तः स तमानयत् ॥ अजमूचे हरि: कस्मादागतोइसि वदस्व तत् ५०
verses.wordMeaning: O lordofDevas, I am blessed since my body is being asked for by you. If you perform Yaga (sacrifice) over my body the Pitrs in my family shall be contented.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lordofDevas, I am blessed since my body is being asked for by you. If you perform Yaga (sacrifice) over my body the Pitrs in my family shall be contented.

verses.sanskrit: अणिवापान्तम् आसाद्य दक्षिणे नर्मदातटे । तस्थौ यत्र व्रती पार्थ जाबालिः प्राशयंस्तिलान्
verses.transliteration: aṇivāpāntam āsādya dakṣiṇe narmadātaṭe / tasthau yatra vratī pārtha jābāliḥ prāśayaṃstilān
verses.translation: After saying thus, during the Sveta Kalpa, the demon Gaya fell on the ground in a south-western direction on the mountain Kolahala. 1
verses.hindi: देवदेव कृते यागे प्रचचाल गयासुरः । शिलायां देवरूपिण्यां न्यस्तायां तस्य मस्तके ५१ रद्रादिषु च॒ देवषु संस्थितेष्वसु रोइ्चलत् । इदानीं निश्चलार्थ हि प्रसाद कुरु माधव ब्रह्मणो वचन श्रुत्वा ह्याकृष्य स्वशरीरतः । घुतिं ददो निश्चलार्थ ब्रह्मणे भगवान्हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, during the Sveta Kalpa, the demon Gaya fell on the ground in a south-western direction on the mountain Kolahala. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, during the Sveta Kalpa, the demon Gaya fell on the ground in a south-western direction on the mountain Kolahala. 1

verses.sanskrit: तिलैरेकाशनं कुर्वंस् तथैवैकान्तराशनम् । त्र्यहषड्द्वादशाहाशी पक्षमासाशनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tilairekāśanaṃ kurvaṃs tathaivaikāntarāśanam / tryahaṣaḍdvādaśāhāśī pakṣamāsāśanastathā
verses.translation: Keeping his head in the north and the feet in the south, the Daitya (lay there). After collecting together all the requisi¬ tes, Brahma mentally created the Rtviks.
verses.hindi: कहा कि आप लोग इस शिला को निदचल करने के लिये इस पर अवस्थित हो जायें। देवगण ने 'बहुत अच्छा” कहकर उसी दिला पर अवस्थित हो गये । देवताओं के पैरों से आक्रान्त होने पर भी वह महा असुर चंचल ही बना रहा । तब व्याकुल होकर ब्रह्मा क्षीरसागरशायी भगवान् विष्णु के पास गये ओर वहाँ बिनस्रभाव से आदर पूर्वक प्रभु की इस प्रकार प्राथंना की
verses.wordMeaning: Keeping his head in the north and the feet in the south, the Daitya (lay there). After collecting together all the requisi¬ tes, Brahma mentally created the Rtviks.
verses.commentary: Sense: Keeping his head in the north and the feet in the south, the Daitya (lay there). After collecting together all the requisi¬ tes, Brahma mentally created the Rtviks.

verses.sanskrit: कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादीनि व्रतानि च तिलैरपि । तिलादत्वमनुप्राप्तो ह्यब्दद्वासप्ततिं क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādīni vratāni ca tilairapi / tilādatvamanuprāpto hyabdadvāsaptatiṃ kramāt
verses.translation: They were: Agnis'arman, Ampta, Saunaka, Yan- jali, Mrdu, Kumuthi, VedakaundBya, Harita, Kasyapa, Krpa, Garga, Kausika, Vasistha, the unchanging sage Bhargava, Vrddha Parasara, Kanva, Mandavya, Srutikevala, Sveta, Sutala, Damana, Suhotra, Kanka, Laukaksi of huge mighty arms, Jaiglsavya, the Brahmana Dadhipaficamukha, Rsabha, Karka, Katyayana, Go- bhila the sage of great fierce rites, Supalaka, Gautama, Vedasi- rovrata, Jatamalin, Avyagra, Catuhasa the terrible, Atreya,
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा बोले--हे निशखिल ब्रह्माण्ड के स्वामिन् ! जगदीश्वर आप को हमारा नमस्कार है, आप मनुष्यों फो यश देने वाले, उनकी भुक्ति एवं मुक्ति के प्रदाता आप हो हैं । ब्रह्मा की प्रार्थना सुनकर विष्वकसेन ने भगवान् विष्णु के समीप जाकर कहा, देव ! पद्म सम्भव भगवान् ब्रह्मा आप की स्वुृति कर रहे हैं। हरि ने कहा जाओ, उन्हें लिवा लाओ । भगवान् विष्णु के आदेशानुसार विष्कसेन ने ब्रह्मा को भगवान् के सम्मुख उपस्थित किया । हरि ने अजन्मा ब्रह्मासे कहा, देव किस कारण वश आपका यहाँ पदापंण हुआ है, बतलाइये
verses.wordMeaning: They were: Agnis'arman, Ampta, Saunaka, Yan- jali, Mrdu, Kumuthi, VedakaundBya, Harita, Kasyapa, Krpa, Garga, Kausika, Vasistha, the unchanging sage Bhargava, Vrddha Parasara, Kanva, Mandavya, Srutikevala, Sveta, Sutala, Damana, Suhotra, Kanka, Laukaksi of huge mighty arms,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were: Agnis'arman, Ampta, Saunaka, Yan- jali, Mrdu, Kumuthi, VedakaundBya, Harita, Kasyapa, Krpa, Garga, Kausika, Vasistha, the unchanging sage Bhargava, Vrddha Parasara, Kanva, Mandavya, Srutikevala, Sveta, Sutala, Damana, Suhotra, Kanka, Laukaksi of huge mighty arms,…

verses.sanskrit: कालेन गच्छता तस्य प्रसन्नो ऽभवदीश्वरः । प्रादाद् इहामुत्रिकीं तु शुद्धिं सालोक्यमात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: kālena gacchatā tasya prasanno 'bhavadīśvaraḥ / prādād ihāmutrikīṃ tu śuddhiṃ sālokyamātmakam
verses.translation: The Brahmayoni hill in Gaya, including the hill called Mup<?apr?tha which contains the impressions of Gadadhara's feet De 20 i.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्चा ने कहा- भगवन् ! आप के निर्दशानुसार यज्ञ सम्पन्न तो हो गया पर गयासुर अभी तक चर्चल बना हुआ है। हम सबों ने उसके मस्तक पर यद्यपि देवरूपिणी घिला लाकर रखी है, फिर भी वह चलायमान है। यही नहीं रुद्र प्रभति देवगणों के पैरों से आक्रास्त होने पर भी वह महान् असुर निशचल नहीं हुआ । माधव ! अब वह जिस प्रकार विश्चल हो, आप उसके लिये कृपा करें। ब्रह्मा की भात॑ वाणी
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmayoni hill in Gaya, including the hill called Mup<?apr?tha which contains the impressions of Gadadhara's feet De 20 i.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmayoni hill in Gaya, including the hill called Mup<?apr?tha which contains the impressions of Gadadhara's feet De 20 i.

verses.sanskrit: तेन स स्थापितो देवः स्वनाम्ना भरतर्षभ । तिलादेश्वरसंज्ञां च प्राप लोकादपि प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tena sa sthāpito devaḥ svanāmnā bharatarṣabha / tilādeśvarasaṃjñāṃ ca prāpa lokādapi prabhuḥ
verses.translation: After creating these and other leading Brahmanas, god Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, performed the Yaga on the body of Gayasura.
verses.hindi: १७८० वायुपुराणम् अनीय मुर्ति ब्रह्माईपि शिलायां समधारयत् । तथा5पि चलित॑ वीक्ष्य पुनर्देबमथा55छ्व यत्
verses.wordMeaning: After creating these and other leading Brahmanas, god Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, performed the Yaga on the body of Gayasura.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating these and other leading Brahmanas, god Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, performed the Yaga on the body of Gayasura.

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्रभृति विख्यातं तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् । तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च
verses.transliteration: tadā prabhṛti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca
verses.translation: AgniSarma, without wasting his penance, created these five fires from his mouth: Daksinagni, Garhapatya, Ahavanlya, Satya and Avasathya. O celestial sage, the Yajnas are founded on these. To stabilise the Yajna, he gave Daksina to the Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: आगत्य विष्णु: क्षीराब्धे: शिलायां संस्थितोह्भवत् । जनादंनाभिधानेन पुण्डरीकेतिनामतः ।॥
verses.wordMeaning: AgniSarma, without wasting his penance, created these five fires from his mouth: Daksinagni, Garhapatya, Ahavanlya, Satya and Avasathya. O celestial sage, the Yajnas are founded on these. To stabilise the Yajna, he gave Daksina to the Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: AgniSarma, without wasting his penance, created these five fires from his mouth: Daksinagni, Garhapatya, Ahavanlya, Satya and Avasathya. O celestial sage, the Yajnas are founded on these. To stabilise the Yajna, he gave Daksina to the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: उपवासपरः पार्थ तथैव हरिवासरे । तिलहोमी तिलोद्वर्ती तिलस्नायी तिलोदकी
verses.transliteration: upavāsaparaḥ pārtha tathaiva harivāsare / tilahomī tilodvartī tilasnāyī tilodakī
verses.translation: After performing the Purnahuti and taking the ablution of Avabhrtha, Brahma caused the sacrificial post to be brought along with the Suras and fixed it.
verses.hindi: निश्चयार्थ पत्चधा5पसीच्छिलायां प्रपितामहः । फितामहो5थ फल्ग्वीशः कैदारः कनकेश्वरः ब्रह्मा स्थित: स्वयं तत्र गजरूपी विनायकः । गयादित्यश्रोत्तराकों दक्षिणाकंस्त्रिधा रविः ५७ लक्ष्मी: सीताभिधानेन गौरी च मड्भलाह्या । गायत्री चेव सावित्री त्रिसंध्या च सरस्वती.
verses.wordMeaning: After performing the Purnahuti and taking the ablution of Avabhrtha, Brahma caused the sacrificial post to be brought along with the Suras and fixed it.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Purnahuti and taking the ablution of Avabhrtha, Brahma caused the sacrificial post to be brought along with the Suras and fixed it.

verses.sanskrit: तिलदाता च भोक्ता च नानापापैः प्रमुच्यते । तिलैरापूरयेल्लिङ्गं तिलतैलेन दीपदः । रुद्रलोकम् अवाप्नोति पुनात्य् आ सप्तमं कुलम्
verses.transliteration: tiladātā ca bhoktā ca nānāpāpaiḥ pramucyate / tilairāpūrayelliṅgaṃ tilatailena dīpadaḥ / rudralokam avāpnoti punāty ā saptamaṃ kulam
verses.translation: The auspicious post was fixed in the Brahmasaras which is the most excellent of all lakes. Shaken and surprised, Brahma spoke to Dharmaraja:
verses.hindi: इन्द्रो ब्रहस्पतिः पुषा वसवो5ष्टो महाबलाः। विश्व देवाश्रा5श्विनेयो  मारुतो विश्वतायकः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The auspicious post was fixed in the Brahmasaras which is the most excellent of all lakes. Shaken and surprised, Brahma spoke to Dharmaraja:
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspicious post was fixed in the Brahmasaras which is the most excellent of all lakes. Shaken and surprised, Brahma spoke to Dharmaraja:

verses.sanskrit: तिलपिण्डप्रदानेन श्राद्धे नृपतिसत्तम । विकर्मस्थाश्च गच्छन्ति गतिमिष्टां हि पूर्वजाः
verses.transliteration: tilapiṇḍapradānena śrāddhe nṛpatisattama / vikarmasthāśca gacchanti gatimiṣṭāṃ hi pūrvajāḥ
verses.translation: "There is a slab of stone in your house. Without hesita¬ tion bring it here at my behest and fix it on the head of the Daitya."
verses.hindi: ऊचे गयासुरो देवान्किमर्थ वच्चितो छ्ाहम् । यज्ञार्थ ब्रह्मणे दत्त शरीरसलयं मया ॥ सुनकर भगवान् हरि ने अपने शरीर से खींचकर एक मूर्ति ब्रह्मा को गयाधुर के शरीर को निदचल करने के लिए दिया  ब्रह्मा ने उक्त मूवि को लाकर गयाधुर के मस्तक पद स्थापित शिला के ऊपर स्थापित किया । किस्तु उस पर भी जब शिला को चलायमान देखा तो पुनः हरि का आवाहन किया। ब्रह्मा के आवाहन करने पर भगवान् क्षीरतागर से आकर छशिला के ऊपर स्वयमेव अवस्थित हुए ।५१-५५। स्वयम् भगवान् जनादंन
verses.wordMeaning: "There is a slab of stone in your house. Without hesita¬ tion bring it here at my behest and fix it on the head of the Daitya."
verses.commentary: Sense: "There is a slab of stone in your house. Without hesita¬ tion bring it here at my behest and fix it on the head of the Daitya."

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गलोकस्थिताः श्राद्धैर् ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनैः । अक्षयां तृप्तिमासाद्य मोदन्ते शाश्वतीः समाः
verses.transliteration: svargalokasthitāḥ śrāddhair brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaiḥ / akṣayāṃ tṛptimāsādya modante śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing it, Yama placed the slab on the head of the demon to keep him steady. Even when the slab was placed, the demon shook along with the slab. He spoke to Rudra and other Devas, "O Devas, you all stand steady on the slab". They said "Yes" and stood there (on it).
verses.hindi: पुण्डरोकाक्ष ने गदा धारण कर उक्त शिला को नि३ंचल करने के लिए उस पर अपना अवस्थान किया। उसी छिला को अधिकाधिक निहचल करने के लिये अ्रपितामह मे अपने को पांच भागों विभक्त कर अवस्थान किया  वे पाँचों वहाँ प्रपितामह, पितामह फल्गवीश, केदार ओर कनकेश्वर के नाम से विख्यात थे । उसी शिलापर गज रूपधारी विनायक भी स्थित हुए । यूय॑ गयादित्य, उत्तराक॑ और दक्षिणाक॑ इन तीन नामों से
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing it, Yama placed the slab on the head of the demon to keep him steady. Even when the slab was placed, the demon shook along with the slab. He spoke to Rudra and other Devas, "O Devas, you all stand steady on the slab". They said "Yes" and stood there (on it).
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it, Yama placed the slab on the head of the demon to keep him steady. Even when the slab was placed, the demon shook along with the slab. He spoke to Rudra and other Devas, "O Devas, you all stand steady on the slab". They said "Yes" and stood there (on it).

verses.sanskrit: पितुः कुलं मातृकुलं तथा भार्याकुलं नृप । कुलत्रयं समुद्धृत्य स्वर्गं नयति वै नरः
verses.transliteration: pituḥ kulaṃ mātṛkulaṃ tathā bhāryākulaṃ nṛpa / kulatrayaṃ samuddhṛtya svargaṃ nayati vai naraḥ
verses.translation: The Devas pressed the slab with their feet (?) and noted that still the demon quaked. Then the distressed Brahma went to Visnu who was lying down in the ocean of milk. Bowing down and honouring the lord, he eulogised him.
verses.hindi: अवस्थित हुए  लक्ष्मी सीता के नाम से तथा गोरी मज्जुला के नाम से उस शिलाखण्ड पर अवस्थित हुई। सरस्वती गायत्री, सावित्रो और त्रिसन्ध्या इन तीनों स्वरूपों में स्थित हुई । इनके अतिरिक्त इन्द्र, बृहस्पति पृषा महाबलशाली आठों वसुगण, विश्वेदेवगण, दोनों अश्विनी कुमार विश्व नामक मात यज्ञ गन्धवं, उरगा- दिकों के साथ अपनी अपनी शक्तियों समेत उस शिलाखण्ड पर विराजमान हुए ।२६-५९। यतः भगवान् हरि की आदि गदा से वह असुरराज गय स्थिर किया गया था, अतः भगवान् आदि गदाधर के नाम से बिख्यात हुए । उक्त अवसर पर गयासुर ने उपस्थित देवगणों से कहा, सुरवुन्द  आप लोगों ने किस कारण से हमें वंचित
verses.wordMeaning: The Devas pressed the slab with their feet (?) and noted that still the demon quaked. Then the distressed Brahma went to Visnu who was lying down in the ocean of milk. Bowing down and honouring the lord, he eulogised him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Devas pressed the slab with their feet (?) and noted that still the demon quaked. Then the distressed Brahma went to Visnu who was lying down in the ocean of milk. Bowing down and honouring the lord, he eulogised him.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे तिलादेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्वाविंशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २२३ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततः क्रोशान्तरे पार्थ वासवं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । वसुभिः स्थापितं तत्र स्थित्वा वै द्वादशाब्दकम्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tilādeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 223 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ krośāntare pārtha vāsavaṃ tīrthamuttamam / vasubhiḥ sthāpitaṃ tatra sthitvā vai dvādaśābdakam
verses.translation: O Lord, O sovereign of the cosmic egg, I bow down to the lord of the worlds, the goal of persons possessing glory, the granter of worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.hindi: धनुदिचि ह्वास्तगंतग्रन्थः: ख« पुस्तके नात्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord, O sovereign of the cosmic egg, I bow down to the lord of the worlds, the goal of persons possessing glory, the granter of worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord, O sovereign of the cosmic egg, I bow down to the lord of the worlds, the goal of persons possessing glory, the granter of worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.sanskrit: धरो ध्रुवश्च सोमश्च आपश्चैवानिलो ऽनलः । प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवो ऽष्टाविमे पुरा
verses.transliteration: dharo dhruvaśca somaśca āpaścaivānilo 'nalaḥ / pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo 'ṣṭāvime purā
verses.translation: Visvaksena spoke to Visnu,"O Lord, the lotus-born deity eulogises you". Hari said, "You bring him". Urged by Visnu, he brought him. Hari spoke to Aja (Brahma), "Tell me why you have come?"
verses.hindi: यत्सुरं: पीडितोध्त्यर्थ गदया हरिणा तथा  पोडितो यद्यहं देवा: प्रसन्ना: सन्तु सबंदा १६२ गदाधरादयस्तुष्टाः प्रोचुः साथ गयासुरम् । वरं ब्रृहि प्रसन्नाः स्मो देवानूचे गयासुरः ३६३ यावत्पृथ्वी पर्वताश्र यावच्चर््राकंता रका: । तावच्छिलायां तिप्ठन्तु ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः ॥ अन्ये च सकला देवा मन्नास्ना क्षेत्रमस्तु वे ६४ पञ्चक्रोशं गयाक्षेत्र क्रोशभेकं गयाशिरः । तन्मध्ये सर्वंतीर्थानि प्रयच्छन्ति हित नुणाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Visvaksena spoke to Visnu,"O Lord, the lotus-born deity eulogises you". Hari said, "You bring him". Urged by Visnu, he brought him. Hari spoke to Aja (Brahma), "Tell me why you have come?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvaksena spoke to Visnu,"O Lord, the lotus-born deity eulogises you". Hari said, "You bring him". Urged by Visnu, he brought him. Hari spoke to Aja (Brahma), "Tell me why you have come?"

verses.sanskrit: पितृशापपरिक्लिष्टा गर्भवासाय भारत । नार्मदं तीर्थमासाद्य तपश्चक्रुर्यतेन्द्रियाः
verses.transliteration: pitṛśāpaparikliṣṭā garbhavāsāya bhārata / nārmadaṃ tīrthamāsādya tapaścakruryatendriyāḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of Devas, when the Yaga was performed the demon Gaya moved even when the slab of stone of the form of the Devas was placed on his head. Even when Rudra and other Devas were stationed (over it) there, the demon quaked, O Madhava, be pleased to make it steady now.
verses.hindi: व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपेण येयं तिष्ठत सवंदा । गदाधरः स्वयं लोकादुभुयात्सर्वाघनाशनात् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord of Devas, when the Yaga was performed the demon Gaya moved even when the slab of stone of the form of the Devas was placed on his head. Even when Rudra and other Devas were stationed (over it) there, the demon quaked, O Madhava, be pleased to make it steady now.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord of Devas, when the Yaga was performed the demon Gaya moved even when the slab of stone of the form of the Devas was placed on his head. Even when Rudra and other Devas were stationed (over it) there, the demon quaked, O Madhava, be pleased to make it steady now.

verses.sanskrit: आराधयन्तः परमं भवानीपतिम् अव्यम् । द्वादशाब्दानि राजेन्द्र ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ārādhayantaḥ paramaṃ bhavānīpatim avyam / dvādaśābdāni rājendra tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma, lord Hari pulled out a Murti (physical body/idol) from his person and gave it to Brahma to stop the restless quaking (of the demon).
verses.hindi: श्राद्धं सपिण्डक येषां ब्रह्मलोक॑ प्रयान्तु ते । ब्रह्मह॒त्यादिकं पाप॑ विनश्यतु च सेविनाम् ६८ नेमिषं पुष्करं गड़ा प्रयागश्वाविमुक्तिकम् । एतान्यन्यानि तीर्थानि दिवि भुव्यन्तरिक्षतः ॥ किया मैंने यज्ञ के लिये अपने शरीर को ब्रह्म को समपित किया था । कया मैं भगवान् विष्णु के वचन मात्र से निकचचल न हो जाता ? देवताओं तथा भगवान् विष्णु की गदा द्वारा मैं पीडित हो चुका हूं। आप देवगण सदा असन्न रहें ६०-६२। समस्त देवताओं के साथ गदाधारियों महान् देवताओं को गयासुर की इन बातों से बड़ी प्रसन्नता हुई, वे बोले, गयासुर ! हम लोग तुमसे बहुत प्रसन्न हैं, जो वरदान चाहो, माँग लो।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Brahma, lord Hari pulled out a Murti (physical body/idol) from his person and gave it to Brahma to stop the restless quaking (of the demon).
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Brahma, lord Hari pulled out a Murti (physical body/idol) from his person and gave it to Brahma to stop the restless quaking (of the demon).

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षः प्रददौ तेभ्यस्त्वभीष्टं वरमुत्तमम् । ततः स्वनाम्ना संस्थाप्य वसवस्तं महेश्वरम् । जग्मुराकाशमाविश्य प्रसन्ने सति शङ्करे
verses.transliteration: pratyakṣaḥ pradadau tebhyastvabhīṣṭaṃ varamuttamam / tataḥ svanāmnā saṃsthāpya vasavastaṃ maheśvaram / jagmurākāśamāviśya prasanne sati śaṅkare
verses.translation: Bringing the idol with him, Brahma placed it on the slab of stone. Still the demon quaked, on seeing which, he (Brahma) invoked the lord again.
verses.hindi: गयासुर ने देवताओं से कहा--देवगण ! जब तक पृथ्वी का अस्तित्व है, जब तक पवंतगण, चरुद्रमा, ताराएँ विद्यमान रहें तव तक इस शिला पर ब्रह्मा, विष्णु एवं महेश्वर का तिवास बना रहे, अन्यास्य समस्त देवप्रण भी बने रहें, इस क्षेत्र की प्रतिष्ठा मेरे नाम से हो। गयाक्षेत्र की मर्यादा पाँच कोस को तथा गया शिर को मर्यादा एक कोस की है । इन दोनों के मध्य भाग में मानव हितकारी समस्त तोर्थोंका निवास हो-ऐसा
verses.wordMeaning: Bringing the idol with him, Brahma placed it on the slab of stone. Still the demon quaked, on seeing which, he (Brahma) invoked the lord again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bringing the idol with him, Brahma placed it on the slab of stone. Still the demon quaked, on seeing which, he (Brahma) invoked the lord again.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति विख्यातं तीर्थं तद्वासवाह्वयम् । तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महाराज यो भक्त्या पूजयेच्छिवम् । यथालब्धोपहारैश्च दीपं दद्यात् प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ tadvāsavāhvayam / tasmiṃstīrthe mahārāja yo bhaktyā pūjayecchivam / yathālabdhopahāraiśca dīpaṃ dadyāt prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Visnu came from the ocean of milk and stationed him¬ self on the slab, with the name of Janardana and Pundartka. The primordial Gadadhara (wielder of mace) himself stood there to steady the slab, for stabilising (Gaya or his body).
verses.hindi: आप लोग वरद्दान करें । इस बीच में स्तानादिकर तपंण एवं पिण्डदान से महान् फल की प्राष्ति हो इस महान् प्रभावशाली क्षेत्र में पिण्डदानादि सम्पन्न करनेवाला मनुष्य अपने सहझ्नों कुलों का उद्धार करे ।६३-९६। आप लोग व्यक्त एवं अव्यक्त शरीर धारण कर इस शिला पर सवंदा विद्यमान् रहें। भगवान् गदाधर यहाँ स्थित रहकर समस्त लोक के पाप पुज्जों का विनाश करें। जो लोग यहाँ सपिण्ड श्राद्ध दान करें वे ब्रह्मतोक को प्राप्त करें । इस पविश्र क्षेत्र के सेवन करनेवालों के ब्रह्महत्या आदि घोर पाप विनष्ट हो जायें । वेमिष, पुष्कर गड्भा, प्रयाग, अबिमुक्त प्रभूति जितने उत्तमोत्तम तीर्थ हैं, तथा उनके अतिरिक्त जो अन्यान्य तोथ्थ स्वर्ग, अन्तरिक्ष एवं भूमण्डल में हैं, वे सभी हमारे इस पवित्र तीर्थ में आकर मानव मात्र का कल्याण सम्पादित करें--ऐसा वरदान आप लोग हमें दीजिए । देवगण ! बहुत्त अधिक मैं क्‍या कहूँ । आप लोगों में से यदि एक
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu came from the ocean of milk and stationed him¬ self on the slab, with the name of Janardana and Pundartka. The primordial Gadadhara (wielder of mace) himself stood there to steady the slab, for stabilising (Gaya or his body).
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu came from the ocean of milk and stationed him¬ self on the slab, with the name of Janardana and Pundartka. The primordial Gadadhara (wielder of mace) himself stood there to steady the slab, for stabilising (Gaya or his body).

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लपक्षे तदाष्टम्यां प्रत्यहं वापि शक्तितः । अष्टौ वर्षसहस्राणि स वसेच्छिवसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: śuklapakṣe tadāṣṭamyāṃ pratyahaṃ vāpi śaktitaḥ / aṣṭau varṣasahasrāṇi sa vasecchivasaṃnidhau
verses.translation: For stabilising (Gaya or his body), Brahma divided himself into five, viz. Prapitamaha (Great-grandfather), Pitamaha (Grandfather), the master of Phalgu, Kedara and Kanakd- vara. Brahma as Vinayaka stood therein the form of an elephant. The Sun divided himself into three: Gayaditya, Uttararka and Daksinarka.
verses.hindi: १०5३ वायुपुराणभ्
verses.wordMeaning: For stabilising (Gaya or his body), Brahma divided himself into five, viz. Prapitamaha (Great-grandfather), Pitamaha (Grandfather), the master of Phalgu, Kedara and Kanakd- vara. Brahma as Vinayaka stood therein the form of an elephant.…
verses.commentary: Sense: For stabilising (Gaya or his body), Brahma divided himself into five, viz. Prapitamaha (Great-grandfather), Pitamaha (Grandfather), the master of Phalgu, Kedara and Kanakd- vara. Brahma as Vinayaka stood therein the form of an elephant.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिवालयं याति गर्भवासं न पश्यति । पुष्पैर्वा पल्लवैर्वापि फलैर्धान्यैस् तथापि वा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śivālayaṃ yāti garbhavāsaṃ na paśyati / puṣpairvā pallavairvāpi phalairdhānyais tathāpi vā
verses.translation: Laksmi stood there in the name of Sita, Gauti in the name of Mangala and Sarasvatl stationed herself in the forms of the three, viz. Gayatii, Savitrl, and Trisandhya.
verses.hindi: + कि बहुक्‍्त्या सुरगणा युष्मास्वेकापि देवता । चेन्न तिष्ठेंद्हं चापि सभयः प्रतिपाल्यतामू स्थितेषु चेव देवेषु ब्राह्मणेभ्यों ददावजः। ग्रामांश्र पञचपणञूचाशत्पड-चक्रोशीं गयां तथा।॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Laksmi stood there in the name of Sita, Gauti in the name of Mangala and Sarasvatl stationed herself in the forms of the three, viz. Gayatii, Savitrl, and Trisandhya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Laksmi stood there in the name of Sita, Gauti in the name of Mangala and Sarasvatl stationed herself in the forms of the three, viz. Gayatii, Savitrl, and Trisandhya.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेद्देवमीशानं स दैन्यं नाप्नुयात् क्वचित् । सर्वशोकविनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ sa dainyaṃ nāpnuyāt kvacit / sarvaśokavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Indra, Brhaspati, Pusan, the eight Vasus of great strength, Visvcdevas. thetwoAsvini Devas, Marnts, the leader of the universe and Devas along with the Yaksas, serpents, and Gandharvas remained there accompanied by their respective Saktis (powers).
verses.hindi: गहान्कृत्वा ददो दिव्यान्सवोपस्करसंयुतान्
verses.wordMeaning: Indra, Brhaspati, Pusan, the eight Vasus of great strength, Visvcdevas. thetwoAsvini Devas, Marnts, the leader of the universe and Devas along with the Yaksas, serpents, and Gandharvas remained there accompanied by their respective Saktis (powers).
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra, Brhaspati, Pusan, the eight Vasus of great strength, Visvcdevas. thetwoAsvini Devas, Marnts, the leader of the universe and Devas along with the Yaksas, serpents, and Gandharvas remained there accompanied by their respective Saktis (powers).

verses.sanskrit: एकाहमपि कौन्तेय यो वसेद्वासवेश्वरे । पापराशिं विनिर्धूय भानुवद्दिवि मोदते
verses.transliteration: ekāhamapi kaunteya yo vasedvāsaveśvare / pāparāśiṃ vinirdhūya bhānuvaddivi modate
verses.translation: Since the Daitya was made steady by the primordial club and Hari stood there, he is famous as Adi-Gadadhara. 1 Gayasura spoke to the Devas, "Why have I been dece¬ ived? The pure body was given unto Brahma by me for the pur¬ pose of Yajiia. Would not have I been steady at the sheer ins¬ tance of Visnu?
verses.hindi: कामधेनुं कल्पवृक्षं पारिजातादिकांस्तरूनू । महानदों क्षोरवहां घृतकुल्यास्तथेव च (७४ मधुस्नवां मधुकुल्यां दिव्याज्याद्यसरांसि च। सुबर्णदीधिकां चेव बहुनन्नादिपवेतान् भद्ष्यभोज्यफलादों श्र सर्व ब्रह्म सुजन्ददों । न याचध्वंहि विप्रेन्द्रा अन्यानुक्त्वा ददावज: ७६ दत्त्वा ययौ ब्रह्मलोक॑ नत्वां ह्यादिगदाधरम्। धर्मारिण्ये तत्र धर्म थाजयित्वा ययाच्रे ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since the Daitya was made steady by the primordial club and Hari stood there, he is famous as Adi-Gadadhara. 1 Gayasura spoke to the Devas, "Why have I been dece¬ ived? The pure body was given unto Brahma by me for the pur¬ pose of Yajiia.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the Daitya was made steady by the primordial club and Hari stood there, he is famous as Adi-Gadadhara. 1 Gayasura spoke to the Devas, "Why have I been dece¬ ived? The pure body was given unto Brahma by me for the pur¬ pose of Yajiia.…

verses.sanskrit: विप्रांश्च भोजयेद्भक्त्या दद्याद् वासांसि दक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: viprāṃśca bhojayedbhaktyā dadyād vāsāṃsi dakṣiṇām
verses.translation: Etymology quoted in TSS ( Trislhalisetu ),
verses.hindi: धर्मयागे च लोभाहं प्रतिगृद्य धनादिकम् । ततो ब्रह्मा समागत्य ब्राह्मणांस्ताञउशशाप ह् ७८
verses.wordMeaning: Etymology quoted in TSS ( Trislhalisetu ),
verses.commentary: Sense: Etymology quoted in TSS ( Trislhalisetu ),

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे वासवेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रयोविंशत्यधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २२४ मार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततः क्रोशान्तरे पार्थ तीर्थं कोटीश्वरं परम् । यत्र स्नानं च दानं च जपहोमार्चनादिकम् । भक्त्या कृतं नरैस्तत्र सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vāsaveśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 224 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ krośāntare pārtha tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ param / yatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca japahomārcanādikam / bhaktyā kṛtaṃ naraistatra sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Why have I been harassed by Suras and Hari by means of the club? May Devas be delighted for ever now that I have been tortured."
verses.hindi: कृतबन्तो यतो लोभं महृत्तेष्वखिलेष्वपि । तस्मादुणाधिका यूयें भविष्यन्ति (थ) सदा द्विजाः भी देवता इस शिला पर न रहेंगे तो मैं भी स्थित न रह सकगा। यही प्रतिज्ञा है, इसका प्रतिपालन करते जाइयेगा ।६७-७०। गयासुर के वचन सुनकर विष्णु प्रभृति देवताओं ने कहा, गयासुर ! तुमने जो कुछ कहा है; वह सव सम्पन्न होगा इसमें सन्देह नहीं है । इस पवित्र तीर्थ में आनेवाले मनुष्य गण हम लोगों की पूजा करके परम गति प्राप्त करेंगे । देवगणों के इस प्रकार वरदान देने पर देत्य परम हर्षित हौकर सिश्चलता को प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Why have I been harassed by Suras and Hari by means of the club? May Devas be delighted for ever now that I have been tortured."
verses.commentary: Sense: Why have I been harassed by Suras and Hari by means of the club? May Devas be delighted for ever now that I have been tortured."

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वा ऋषयः सिद्धचारणाः । जलधिं प्रतिगच्छन्ति नर्मदां वीक्षितुं किल
verses.transliteration: tatra devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ / jaladhiṃ pratigacchanti narmadāṃ vīkṣituṃ kila
verses.translation: Gadadhara and others were pleased. They all simul¬ taneously spoke to Gayasura, "Speak out (choose) a boon. We are all very delighted". Gayasura then spoke to Devas:
verses.hindi: हुआ । उक्त शिला पर उपर्युक्त देवगणों के अवस्थित हो जाने पर ब्रह्मा ने यज्ञकर्ता ब्राह्मणों को पचपन ग्राम प्रदान किये । पत्च॒कोशी गया पुरी को भी उन्हें उत्सगं कर दिया । गृहस्थी के सभी साधनों एवं सामग्रियों से समन्वित दिव्य गृहों का निर्माण कर उन्हें समपित किया  इसके अतिरिक्त कामधेनु गो, कल्पव॒ुक्ष, पारिजात प्रभति देवतर क्षीरवाहिनी महानदी घृत पूर्ण छोटी बावलियाँ, मधुल्नाविणी मनोहर नदी, मधपूरित छोटी-छोटी
verses.wordMeaning: Gadadhara and others were pleased. They all simul¬ taneously spoke to Gayasura, "Speak out (choose) a boon. We are all very delighted". Gayasura then spoke to Devas:
verses.commentary: Sense: Gadadhara and others were pleased. They all simul¬ taneously spoke to Gayasura, "Speak out (choose) a boon. We are all very delighted". Gayasura then spoke to Devas:

verses.sanskrit: मिलिताः कोटिशो राजन्रेवासागरसङ्गमे । विनोदमतुलं दृष्ट्वा रेवार्णवसमागमे
verses.transliteration: militāḥ koṭiśo rājanrevāsāgarasaṅgame / vinodamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā revārṇavasamāgame
verses.translation: "As long as the earth lasts, as long as the mountains, the Moon, the Sun and the stars remain, may Visnu, Brahma and Mahesvara stand on the slab along with all other Devas. Let the holy centre be named after me.
verses.hindi: गड़हियाँ, दिव्यगुण सम्पन्न घ॒तों से परिपूर्ण सरोवर, सुवर्णनिर्मित बावली, अनेक अन्नादिकों से बने हुए पंत, विविध प्रकार के भक्ष्य, भाज्य फलादि सामग्री भी उन्हें निर्माण करके समर्पित किया। दान करते समय अयोनिज ब्रह्मा जी ने ब्राह्मणों से कहा कि विप्रेन्द्रवुन्द!/ आप लोग अंब किसी दूसरे से याचना न करेंगे ।७१०७६। इस प्रकार ब्राह्मणों को दान देने के उपरान्त भगवान् भमदाधर को नमस्कार कर ब्रह्मा अपने लोक को चले गये । धर्मारण्य में घर्म ने एक यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान किया, उस यज्ञ में उन्हीं गयापुरीस्थ ब्रह्मणों ने लोभ वश धनादि की याचना की और अंगीकार किया । उनके इस निषिद्ध कम से अप्रसन्न होकर ब्रह्मा ने उन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: "As long as the earth lasts, as long as the mountains, the Moon, the Sun and the stars remain, may Visnu, Brahma and Mahesvara stand on the slab along with all other Devas. Let the holy centre be named after me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "As long as the earth lasts, as long as the mountains, the Moon, the Sun and the stars remain, may Visnu, Brahma and Mahesvara stand on the slab along with all other Devas. Let the holy centre be named after me.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा शिवं च संस्थाप्य पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् । कोटीश्वराभिधानं तु स्वस्वभक्त्या विधानतः
verses.transliteration: snātvā śivaṃ ca saṃsthāpya pūjayitvā maheśvaram / koṭīśvarābhidhānaṃ tu svasvabhaktyā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: The holy centre of Gaya shall extend to five krosas and Gayasiras to one krosa. Amidst them may all the holy centres grant welfare unto all men.
verses.hindi: + अय॑ इलोकः ख पुस्तके ते ।
verses.wordMeaning: The holy centre of Gaya shall extend to five krosas and Gayasiras to one krosa. Amidst them may all the holy centres grant welfare unto all men.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy centre of Gaya shall extend to five krosas and Gayasiras to one krosa. Amidst them may all the holy centres grant welfare unto all men.

verses.sanskrit: कोटीतीर्थे परां सिद्धिं सम्प्राप्ताः सर्वतोषणात् । तेन तत्पुण्यमतुलं सर्वतीर्थेषु चोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: koṭītīrthe parāṃ siddhiṃ samprāptāḥ sarvatoṣaṇāt / tena tatpuṇyamatulaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu cottamam
verses.translation: By taking ablution etc. and performing Tarpana one should offer balls of rice. Then it is more fruitful. That man becomes a great soul and. uplifts a thousand members of his family.
verses.hindi: युष्माक स्पाह्वारिवहा नदी पाषाणपवता । नद्यादयों वारिवहा मृन्मयाश्र तथा गृहाः (८० कामधेनुः कल्पवक्षों मल्‍लोकमुपतिष्ठताम्। एवं शप्ता ब्रह्मणा ते प्रार्थयन्तोबुवन्नजम् ॥८ १ तच्छ त्वा ब्राह्मणान्त्रह्मा प्रोवाचेदं दयान्वितः। तीर्थोषजीविका यूयमाचस्द्राक भविष्यथ ॥८रे लोकाः पुण्या गयायां ये श्राद्धिनो ब्ह्मलोकगा:ः । युष्मान्ये पुजयिष्यन्ति तरह पृजितः सदा हे आक्रान्तं देत्यजठरं धर्मण विरजादिणा  नाभिकूपसमोपे तु देवी या विरजा स्थिता (८५
verses.wordMeaning: By taking ablution etc. and performing Tarpana one should offer balls of rice. Then it is more fruitful. That man becomes a great soul and. uplifts a thousand members of his family.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking ablution etc. and performing Tarpana one should offer balls of rice. Then it is more fruitful. That man becomes a great soul and. uplifts a thousand members of his family.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु यत्किंचिच्छुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् । क्रियते नृपशार्दूल सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yatkiṃcicchubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham / kriyate nṛpaśārdūla sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: All of you, slay (here) for ever in manifest and un- manifest forms. May Gadadhara himself be the destroyer of all sins.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते गयामाहात्म्यं नाम षडधिकशततंमोण्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: All of you, slay (here) for ever in manifest and un- manifest forms. May Gadadhara himself be the destroyer of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of you, slay (here) for ever in manifest and un- manifest forms. May Gadadhara himself be the destroyer of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु मार्गस्था ये केचिदृषिसत्तमाः । सिद्धामृतपदं यान्ति पितृलोकं तथोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu mārgasthā ye kecidṛṣisattamāḥ / siddhāmṛtapadaṃ yānti pitṛlokaṃ tathottamam
verses.translation: May those on whose behalf the Sraddha has been perlormed and Pindas offered, go to lirahmaloka. May the sins due to p.rahmana slaughter etc. of those who report to this holy centre perish,
verses.hindi: शाप दिया कि तुम लोबों ने मेरे निखिल दिव्य सम्पत्ति के दान देने पर भी यतः लोभ नहीं छोड़ा अतः सर्वेदा अधिक ऋणग्रस्त बने रहोमे  वे नदियाँ, मधु एवं क्षीरादि पदार्थों की वहन करनेवाली थों, अब केवल जल बाहिनी रहेगी, पर्वत पाषाणमय हो जायेंगे  वे दिव्य सामग्रियों वाले सुन्दर गृह अब मृत्तिकामय हो जायेंगे ७७-८०। कामधेनू् एवं कल्पवक्षादि हमारे लोक में चले जायेंगे । अजन्मा ब्रह्मा जी से इस प्रकार अभिशप्त होने पर ब्राह्मणों ने निवेदन किया, देव ! आप ने कृपा पूर्वक जो वस्तुएँ हम लोगों को समर्पित की थीं, वे तुम्हारे ज्ञाप के कारण नाश को प्राप्त हो गईं। भगवन् ! हम लोगों की जो विका किस प्रकार चलेगी इसके लिये तो कृपा करें । ब्राह्मणों के इस आर्त्त निवेदन पर भगवान् ब्रह्मा को दया आ गई। वे बोले, अच्छा, अब से जब तक चन्द्रमा, सूथं एवं ताराओं का अस्तित्व रहेगा तब तक तुम लोग तीथों द्वारा जीविका निर्वाह
verses.wordMeaning: May those on whose behalf the Sraddha has been perlormed and Pindas offered, go to lirahmaloka. May the sins due to p.rahmana slaughter etc. of those who report to this holy centre perish,
verses.commentary: Sense: May those on whose behalf the Sraddha has been perlormed and Pindas offered, go to lirahmaloka. May the sins due to p.rahmana slaughter etc. of those who report to this holy centre perish,

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे नर्मदातीरे दक्षिणे चाश्रिताश्च ये । देवलोकं गतास् तत्र इति मे निश्चिता मतिः
verses.transliteration: uttare narmadātīre dakṣiṇe cāśritāśca ye / devalokaṃ gatās tatra iti me niścitā matiḥ
verses.translation: May all the holy centres in heaven, firm?vinent and the earth such as Naimisa, Puskara, Ganga, Pravaga, Avimuktaka and others come here regularly, O Suras, and yield welfare unto all men.
verses.hindi: करोगे । जो पुण्यकर्मी लोग इस गयापुरी में आकर श्राद्ध कर्म सम्पन्न करंगे वे ब्रह्मलोकगामी होंगे । जो तुम लोगों की पूजा अर्चा करेंगे, वे मानों हमारी ही पूजा अर्चा करेगे, तुम्हारी पूजा से हम सवंदा सन्तुष्ट होंगे । इस गयापुरी में पवित्र विरज नामक गिरि से देत्य का उदर भाग आकान्त है, इसके नाभि कूप के समीप विरजानामक देवी का निवास है, उस पवित्र स्थान पर पिण्डदानादि करके मनुष्य अपने इंक्कीस कुलों का उद्धार
verses.wordMeaning: May all the holy centres in heaven, firm?vinent and the earth such as Naimisa, Puskara, Ganga, Pravaga, Avimuktaka and others come here regularly, O Suras, and yield welfare unto all men.
verses.commentary: Sense: May all the holy centres in heaven, firm?vinent and the earth such as Naimisa, Puskara, Ganga, Pravaga, Avimuktaka and others come here regularly, O Suras, and yield welfare unto all men.

verses.sanskrit: बिल्वार्कपुष्पैर् धत्तूरकुशकाशप्रसूनकैः । ऋतूद्भवैस्तथान्यैश्च पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: bilvārkapuṣpair dhattūrakuśakāśaprasūnakaiḥ / ṛtūdbhavaistathānyaiśca pūjayitvā maheśvaram
verses.translation: O hosts of Devas, of what avail is much talk. Unless one of you Devas stand (on this slab), I too will not be steady. This is the condition. Let it be strictly observed."
verses.hindi: करता है, महेन्द्र नामक गिरि ने देत्य के दोनों चरणों को सुनिश्वल किया है, उस पवित्र स्थान पर पिण्डदानादि क्रनेवाला मनुष्य अपने सात कुलों का उद्धार करता है श्री वायु महापुराण का गयामाहात्म्य नामक एक सो छठवाँ अध्याय समाप्त ॥!०३॥
verses.wordMeaning: O hosts of Devas, of what avail is much talk. Unless one of you Devas stand (on this slab), I too will not be steady. This is the condition. Let it be strictly observed."
verses.commentary: Sense: O hosts of Devas, of what avail is much talk. Unless one of you Devas stand (on this slab), I too will not be steady. This is the condition. Let it be strictly observed."

verses.sanskrit: नानोपचारैर् विधिवन् मन्त्रपूर्वं युधिष्ठिर । धूपदीपार्धनैवेद्यैस्तोषयित्वा च धूर्जटिम्
verses.transliteration: nānopacārair vidhivan mantrapūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / dhūpadīpārdhanaivedyaistoṣayitvā ca dhūrjaṭim
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Gayasura, Visnu and other Suras spoke, "All that you have requested for shall undoubt¬ edly be granted.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Gayasura, Visnu and other Suras spoke, "All that you have requested for shall undoubt¬ edly be granted.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Gayasura, Visnu and other Suras spoke, "All that you have requested for shall undoubt¬ edly be granted.

verses.sanskrit: शिवलोकमवाप्नोति यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश । पौषकृष्णाष्टमीयोगे विशेषः पूजने स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śivalokamavāpnoti yāvadindrāścaturdaśa / pauṣakṛṣṇāṣṭamīyoge viśeṣaḥ pūjane smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping our feet (all the devotees) will attain the great goal." When the boons were granted to him by Devas, the Daitya became delighted and remained steady. When Devas stood steady, the urborn deity (Brahma) gave unto Brahmanas fifty-five villages and the
verses.hindi: कर्थ शिला समुत्पज्ना यथा55क्रान्‍्तो गयासुरः। कि रूपं कि च माहात्म्यं तस्था कि वद नास व ३१ आतीद्धर्मों महातेजा: सर्वविज्ञानपारगः । विश्वरूपा च तत्पत्नी भतृ ब्रतपरायणा ३२
verses.wordMeaning: After worshipping our feet (all the devotees) will attain the great goal." When the boons were granted to him by Devas, the Daitya became delighted and remained steady. When Devas stood steady, the urborn deity (Brahma) gave unto Brahmanas fifty-five villages and the
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping our feet (all the devotees) will attain the great goal." When the boons were granted to him by Devas, the Daitya became delighted and remained steady. When Devas stood steady, the urborn deity (Brahma) gave unto Brahmanas fifty-five villages and the

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं च नृपतिश्रेष्ठ चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च । शिवमभ्यर्च्य विप्रांश्च भोजयेद् भक्तितो वरान्
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ ca nṛpatiśreṣṭha caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca / śivamabhyarcya viprāṃśca bhojayed bhaktito varān
verses.translation: After giving away all these things and bowing to Adigadadhara Brahma went to Brahmaloka. The Brahmanas of Gaya officiated as priests of Dharma in his sacrifice at Dharmaranya and later begged him (for D'aksina). Out of covetousness they took monetary and other gifts at the sacrifice of Dharma. Brahma came there and cursed the Brahmanas. 1
verses.hindi: तस्यां धर्मात्समुत्पन्ना कन्या धर्मत्रता सती । रूपयोवनसंपन्ना लक्ष्मीरिष शुणाधिका
verses.wordMeaning: After giving away all these things and bowing to Adigadadhara Brahma went to Brahmaloka. The Brahmanas of Gaya officiated as priests of Dharma in his sacrifice at Dharmaranya and later begged him (for D'aksina).…
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving away all these things and bowing to Adigadadhara Brahma went to Brahmaloka. The Brahmanas of Gaya officiated as priests of Dharma in his sacrifice at Dharmaranya and later begged him (for D'aksina).…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कोटीश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुर्विंशत्यधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २२५ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: ततः क्रोशान्तरे गच्छेद् अलिकातीर्थमुत्तमम् । अलिका नाम गान्धर्वी कुशीला कुटिलाशया
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭīśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 225 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tataḥ krośāntare gacched alikātīrthamuttamam / alikā nāma gāndharvī kuśīlā kuṭilāśayā
verses.translation: "O Brahmanas even when everything had been given by me, you coveted for more. Hence you will always be burdened with debts. The river shall flow with water only (and not milk). The mountains of foodstuffs will turn into those of rocks. All the rivers shall flow with water and your houses will be of mud. Kamadhenu and the Kalpa-tree will come back to my own region." Cursed thus by Brahma all those Brahmanas imploringly said to the Unborn deity:
verses.hindi: तस्यां ये तु गुणा ह्यासंस्ते तिष्ठन्ति जगत्त्रये । धर्मो धर्मत्रतायास्तु त्रिषु लोकेषु सार्गयन् नानुरूप वर लेभे धर्मोड्थ चरसिद्धये । तपः कुर वरार्थ त्वं तथेत्युकल्वा वनं ययौ ..
verses.wordMeaning: "O Brahmanas even when everything had been given by me, you coveted for more. Hence you will always be burdened with debts. The river shall flow with water only (and not milk). The mountains of foodstuffs will turn into those of rocks.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Brahmanas even when everything had been given by me, you coveted for more. Hence you will always be burdened with debts. The river shall flow with water only (and not milk). The mountains of foodstuffs will turn into those of rocks.…

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेनस्य दौहित्री विद्यानन्दमृषिं गता । वव्रे ते स्वीकृता तेन दशवर्षाणि तं श्रिता
verses.transliteration: citrasenasya dauhitrī vidyānandamṛṣiṃ gatā / vavre te svīkṛtā tena daśavarṣāṇi taṃ śritā
verses.translation: "O lord, everything that had been given by you has gone off due to your curse. May you be kind enough to assign something for our livelihood".
verses.hindi: कन्या सा च तपस्तेपे सर्वेषां दुष्करं व यत् । वायुभक्षा श्वेतकल्पे युगानामयुत॑ं पुरा ३६
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, everything that had been given by you has gone off due to your curse. May you be kind enough to assign something for our livelihood".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, everything that had been given by you has gone off due to your curse. May you be kind enough to assign something for our livelihood".

verses.sanskrit: पतिं जघान तं सुप्तं कस्मिंश्चित् कारणान्तरे । गत्वा निवेदयामास पितरं रत्नवल्लभम्
verses.transliteration: patiṃ jaghāna taṃ suptaṃ kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare / gatvā nivedayāmāsa pitaraṃ ratnavallabham
verses.translation: On hearing those words, the sympathetic Brahma spoke tjius to the Brahmanas: "As long as the Moon and the Sun shine, you will be maintaining your livelihood by means of (the earning at the) holy centres.
verses.hindi: नारद बोले- ब्रह्मत् ! वह प्रसिद्ध शिला किस प्रकार उत्पन्न हुई जिससे गयासुर का दरोर दबाया गया था । उसका स्वरूप एवं माहात्म्य क्या है ? उसका बाम क्या है ? बतलाइये सनत्कुमार बोले - प्राचीमकाल में महान् तेजस्वी, समस्त विज्ञान विज्ञानतत्त्व वेत्ता धर्म मामक महानुभाव हुए । उनको पतिम्नत परायण विश्वरूपा नामक पत्नी थी । उस पत्नी में धर्म के संयोग से धर्मंब्रता नामक एक सती कन्या उत्पन्न हुई जो स्वरूप एवं यौवन से सम्पन्न एवं लक्ष्मी के समान परम गुणवती थी । उसमें जितने गुण उपलब्ध थे वे तीनों जग्रत् के प्राणियों में उपलब्ध थे। धर्मश्रता के लिये धर्म ने तीनों
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing those words, the sympathetic Brahma spoke tjius to the Brahmanas: "As long as the Moon and the Sun shine, you will be maintaining your livelihood by means of (the earning at the) holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words, the sympathetic Brahma spoke tjius to the Brahmanas: "As long as the Moon and the Sun shine, you will be maintaining your livelihood by means of (the earning at the) holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: पित्रा मात्रा च संत्यक्ता बहुभिर्भर्त्सिता नृप । गर्भघ्नी त्वं पतिघ्नी त्वमिति दर्शय मा मुखम्
verses.transliteration: pitrā mātrā ca saṃtyaktā bahubhirbhartsitā nṛpa / garbhaghnī tvaṃ patighnī tvamiti darśaya mā mukham
verses.translation: Those meritorious persons who perform Sraddhas in Gaya will attain Brahmaloka. I will also always be considered worshipped by those who worship you."
verses.hindi: लोकों में अनुरूप वर ढूंढ़ा किन्तु कहीं भी कोई उपयुक्त पात्र नहीं दिखाई पड़ा । तम धर्म ने बरदान से सिद्धि प्राप्त करने के लिए पुत्री से कहा--बेटी, अनुरूप पति प्राप्ति के लिए तपस्था करो। कन्या ने पिता की आज्ञा स्वीकार कर बन को गरमन किया और वहाँ जाकर परम कठोर तपस्या प्रारम्भ किया
verses.wordMeaning: Those meritorious persons who perform Sraddhas in Gaya will attain Brahmaloka. I will also always be considered worshipped by those who worship you."
verses.commentary: Sense: Those meritorious persons who perform Sraddhas in Gaya will attain Brahmaloka. I will also always be considered worshipped by those who worship you."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघ्नी याहि पापिष्ठे परित्यक्ता गृहाद्व्रज
verses.transliteration: brahmaghnī yāhi pāpiṣṭhe parityaktā gṛhādvraja
verses.translation: The stomach of the Daitya is overlapped by the mountain Viraja, the righteous. Near the well that forms its
verses.hindi: स्वेतकल्प में धर्मत्रता ने उक्त तपस्या के सद्भ में दस सहस्न युगों तक केवल वायु का आहार किया । ब्रह्मा के मानस पृत्र भरीचि परम विख्यात ऋषि थे । वे पृथ्वी का पय्यंटन करते हुए वहाँ आये और उक्त कन्या- ब्रह्मणो मानसः पुत्रों मरौचिर्नाम विश्रुतः । पर्यंटन्पूथिवीं सर्वा कन्यारत्नं ददर्श सः
verses.wordMeaning: The stomach of the Daitya is overlapped by the mountain Viraja, the righteous. Near the well that forms its
verses.commentary: Sense: The stomach of the Daitya is overlapped by the mountain Viraja, the righteous. Near the well that forms its

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: इति दुःखान्विता मूढा ताभ्यां निर्भर्त्सिता सती । तनुं त्यक्तुं मनश्चक्रे प्राप्य तीर्थान्तरं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: iti duḥkhānvitā mūḍhā tābhyāṃ nirbhartsitā satī / tanuṃ tyaktuṃ manaścakre prāpya tīrthāntaraṃ kvacit
verses.translation: The story is repeated in N 44.16-18, A 36-38.
verses.hindi: रूपयौवनसंपन्ना परमे तपसि स्थिताम् । पप्रच्छाथ मरीचिस्तां का त्वं कस्यासि तह॒द ८ रूपेणानेन मां भीरु विमोहयसि सुत्रते । ब्रह्मात्मजो5हं विख्यातों मरीचिबेंदपरागः ९ मरीचेव॑चन श्रुत्वा कन्या प्रोवाच तं सुनिम् । अहं धर्मत्रता नाम धमंपुत्नी तपोन्बिता
verses.wordMeaning: The story is repeated in N 44.16-18, A 36-38.
verses.commentary: Sense: The story is repeated in N 44.16-18, A 36-38.

verses.sanskrit: संपृच्छ्यमाना तीर्थानि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो युधिष्ठिर । श्रुत्वा पापहरं तीर्थं रेवासागरसङ्गमे
verses.transliteration: saṃpṛcchyamānā tīrthāni brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira / śrutvā pāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ revāsāgarasaṅgame
verses.translation: What is the origin of that slab whereby Gayasura was kept steady and submissive? What is its form? What is its greatness? Please mention its name.
verses.hindi: पतिब्रतार्थ विप्रेन्द चरामि परम तपः। धर्मब्रतां मरीचिस्तामुवाच प्रीतिपुर्वकम् ३११ पतिब्रता वर्शनान्से भविष्यसि शुभव्रते । पतिग्रतेक्षया पृथ्वीं विचरासि ह्यह॒निशम् त्वं चेत्पतिब्रता जाता भजे त्वां भज माँ वरम् । लोके न त्वादृशी क्या मम तुल्यों न ते वरः
verses.wordMeaning: What is the origin of that slab whereby Gayasura was kept steady and submissive? What is its form? What is its greatness? Please mention its name.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is the origin of that slab whereby Gayasura was kept steady and submissive? What is its form? What is its greatness? Please mention its name.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पार्थ तपश्चक्रे निराहारा जितव्रता । कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रपाराकमहासांतपनादिभिः
verses.transliteration: tatra pārtha tapaścakre nirāhārā jitavratā / kṛcchrātikṛcchrapārākamahāsāṃtapanādibhiḥ
verses.translation: There was once a highly refulgent person named Dharma. He had mastered all sacred lore. His wife Visvarupa was devoted to the service of her husband.
verses.hindi: धर्मश्नते धर्मपत्नी तस्मात्त्वं भव मेष्धुना । धर्मब्नता मुनि प्राह धर्म याचय सुत्नत
verses.wordMeaning: There was once a highly refulgent person named Dharma. He had mastered all sacred lore. His wife Visvarupa was devoted to the service of her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: There was once a highly refulgent person named Dharma. He had mastered all sacred lore. His wife Visvarupa was devoted to the service of her husband.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणैर्ब्रह्मकूर्चैः कर्शयामास वै तनुम् । एवं वर्षशतं सार्द्धं व्यतीतं तपसा नृप
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇairbrahmakūrcaiḥ karśayāmāsa vai tanum / evaṃ varṣaśataṃ sārddhaṃ vyatītaṃ tapasā nṛpa
verses.translation: A daughter of great qualities and endowed with all the auspicious characteristics like LaksmI was born of her to Dharma. She was the chaste girl named Dharmavrata.
verses.hindi: तच्छ त्वा धर्ममगमन्मुनि धर्मो ददर्श ह। तेज:पुञ्ज वर नत्वा आसनार्ध्यादिना5चेंपत् १५ फिमर्थमागतः पृष्ठो मरीचिर्धममब्रवीत् । कन्यार्थ श्रमता पृथ्वीं दृष्टा ते कस्यका वबरा ॥ रतन का दर्शन किया  उन्होंने देखा कि वह परम रूपबती एवं पूर्ण यौवना होते हुए भी घोर तपस्या में लीन है। ऋषिवर मरीचि ने कस्या से जिज्ञासा प्रकट की कि है कल्याणि ! तुम कौन हो ? किसकी पुत्री हो ?
verses.wordMeaning: A daughter of great qualities and endowed with all the auspicious characteristics like LaksmI was born of her to Dharma. She was the chaste girl named Dharmavrata.
verses.commentary: Sense: A daughter of great qualities and endowed with all the auspicious characteristics like LaksmI was born of her to Dharma. She was the chaste girl named Dharmavrata.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या विशुद्धिम् इच्छन्त्याः शिवध्यानार्चनादिभिः । ततः कतिपयाहोभिस् तस्या ज्ञात्वा हठं परम् । परितुष्टः शिवः प्राह पार्वत्या परिचोदितः
verses.transliteration: tasyā viśuddhim icchantyāḥ śivadhyānārcanādibhiḥ / tataḥ katipayāhobhis tasyā jñātvā haṭhaṃ param / parituṣṭaḥ śivaḥ prāha pārvatyā paricoditaḥ
verses.translation: Whatever good qualities there are in the three worlds, were present in her. Dharma searched for a befitting bride¬ groom to Dharmavrata in all the three worlds, but in vain. Then he told her, "Perform a penance for the sake of attaining a bridegroom". She said, "So be it", and went to the forest.
verses.hindi: सद्श्नवतपरायणे ! तुम अपनी मोंहक रूपराशि से हमारे चित्त को मुग्ष कर रही हो  भीरू ! तुम डरो मत । मैं ब्रह्मा का पुत्र है, समस्त वेदों का सम्यक् अध्ययन एवं परिशीलत कर चुका हुँ, सारे संसार में लोग मुझे मरीचि नाम से जानते हैं। मरौचि के वचन को सुनकर कन्या ने कहा, मुनिवर ! मैं धर्म की पृत्री हूँ, मेया माम धर्मत्रता है। अनुरूप पति एवं पतिब्रतधर्म की प्राप्ति के लिये मैं यह कठोश तपस्या कर रही है ।
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever good qualities there are in the three worlds, were present in her. Dharma searched for a befitting bride¬ groom to Dharmavrata in all the three worlds, but in vain. Then he told her, "Perform a penance for the sake of attaining a bridegroom". She said, "So be it",…
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever good qualities there are in the three worlds, were present in her. Dharma searched for a befitting bride¬ groom to Dharmavrata in all the three worlds, but in vain. Then he told her, "Perform a penance for the sake of attaining a bridegroom". She said, "So be it",…

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: पुत्रि मा साहसं कार्षीः शुद्धदेहासि साम्प्रतम् । तुष्टो ऽहं तपसा ते ऽद्य वरं वरय वाञ्छितम्
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: putri mā sāhasaṃ kārṣīḥ śuddhadehāsi sāmpratam / tuṣṭo 'haṃ tapasā te 'dya varaṃ varaya vāñchitam
verses.translation: That girl performed a very severe penance which could not be performed by anyone. She subsisted only on the air and spent ten thousand Yugas in that Sveta Kalpa.
verses.hindi: धमंत्रता की बातें सुनकर मुनिवर मरीचिं ने प्रेम पूवंक कहा, शुभन्नते ! मेरे दश्शन मात्र से तुम पतिब्रता हो । ओगी । केवल पतिकब्रता नारियों के देखने की इच्छा ही से मैं रात दिन प्रृथ्वी का पर्यटन करता हूँ ।६-१२। यदि तुम पवित्रता हो तो मुझे पतिरूप में अज्भी कार करो, मैं तुम्हें पत्नीडप में स्वीकार करता हँँ। इस लोक में न तो तुम्हारे समान कोई कम्या है और न मेरे समान कोई वर है घर्मत्रते! अब तुम हमारी धर्मंपत्नी हो जाओ । मुनिवर मरीचि की बातें सुनकर घमंत्रता ने कहा, सुत्रत  आप इस विषय में हमारे पिता से याचना करें । धर्मत्रता के कथनानुस।र मरीचि धर्म के पास गये । धर्म ने परम तेजस्वी मरीचि मुति को देखकर आसन एवं अर्ध्यादि समपित कर मरीचि की पूजा की और पूछा कि मुनिवर्य ! आपका शुभागमन किस प्रयोजन द्वारा यहाँ हुआ ? मरीचि बोले, महानुभाव ! योग्य पत्नी के अन्वेषण के लिये समस्त भूमण्डल विचरण की
verses.wordMeaning: That girl performed a very severe penance which could not be performed by anyone. She subsisted only on the air and spent ten thousand Yugas in that Sveta Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: That girl performed a very severe penance which could not be performed by anyone. She subsisted only on the air and spent ten thousand Yugas in that Sveta Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: अलिकोवाच: यदि तुष्टो ऽसि देवेश वरार्हा यद्यहं मता । नानापापाग्नितप्ताया देहि शुद्धिं परां मम
verses.transliteration: alikovāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa varārhā yadyahaṃ matā / nānāpāpāgnitaptāyā dehi śuddhiṃ parāṃ mama
verses.translation: During the course of his wandering over the earth, the mental son of Brahma, well known by the name of Marici, saw that jewel of a girl.
verses.hindi: कामना से मैं घूम रहा था कि तुम्हारी परम सुन्दरी एवं धर्मेशोल कन्या धर्मत्रता दृष्टिगत हुई, तुम अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: During the course of his wandering over the earth, the mental son of Brahma, well known by the name of Marici, saw that jewel of a girl.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the course of his wandering over the earth, the mental son of Brahma, well known by the name of Marici, saw that jewel of a girl.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं मे नाथो ह्यनाथायास्त्वमेव जगतां गुरुः । दीनानाथसमुद्धर्ता शरण्यः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ me nātho hyanāthāyāstvameva jagatāṃ guruḥ / dīnānāthasamuddhartā śaraṇyaḥ sarvadehinām
verses.translation: To that girl who was endowed with beauty and youth and who was engaged in the greatest penance, Marici asked, "Tell me who you are and to whom you belong.
verses.hindi: १०५६ वायुपुराणम् अर्ध्यादिना समभ्यच्य धर्म: प्रोचे तथेति तम् । धर्मंत्रतां समानीय दत्तवांस्तां मरीचये १७ रेमे मुनिस्तया साथे यथा विष्णु: श्षिया सह । पार्वेत्या च यथा शंभुः सरस्वत्या यथा हाजः
verses.wordMeaning: To that girl who was endowed with beauty and youth and who was engaged in the greatest penance, Marici asked, "Tell me who you are and to whom you belong.
verses.commentary: Sense: To that girl who was endowed with beauty and youth and who was engaged in the greatest penance, Marici asked, "Tell me who you are and to whom you belong.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच: त्वं भद्रे शुद्धदेहासि मा किंचिद् अनुशोचिथाः । स्वनाम्ना स्थापयित्वेह मां ततः स्वर्गमेष्यसि
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca: tvaṃ bhadre śuddhadehāsi mā kiṃcid anuśocithāḥ / svanāmnā sthāpayitveha māṃ tataḥ svargameṣyasi
verses.translation: O timid lady, of excellent vows, you are a fascinating one by this beauty of yours. I am the son of Brahma, well- known as Marici. I have mastered the Vedas."
verses.hindi: जज्ञे पुत्रशतं तस्यां मरीचेविष्णुनोपमस् । मरीचिः फलपुष्पार्थ बन गत्वा समागतः (१२० +श्आान्तः कदाचित्ता पत्नीमुवाचेति पतिन्नताम् । भुकत्वा तु शयनस्थस्य पादसंबाहत कुद.
verses.wordMeaning: O timid lady, of excellent vows, you are a fascinating one by this beauty of yours. I am the son of Brahma, well- known as Marici. I have mastered the Vedas."
verses.commentary: Sense: O timid lady, of excellent vows, you are a fascinating one by this beauty of yours. I am the son of Brahma, well- known as Marici. I have mastered the Vedas."

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा देवदेवेशस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । अलिकापि ततो भक्त्या स्नात्वा संस्थाप्य शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā devadeveśastatraivāntaradhīyata / alikāpi tato bhaktyā snātvā saṃsthāpya śaṅkaram
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Marici, the girl replied to the sage, "I am the daughter of Dharma. My name is Dharma¬ vrata. I am endowed with penance.
verses.hindi: धर्मत्रता तथेत्युक्त्वा शयनस्थस्य सा सुने: । पादसंबाहनं चक्रे घृतेनाभ्यज्य तत्परा निद्रायमाणे5थ मुनौ ब्रह्मा तं देशमागतः ।  इयेष दृष्द्वा ब्रह्माणं मनसा5चंयितु प्रभुम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Marici, the girl replied to the sage, "I am the daughter of Dharma. My name is Dharma¬ vrata. I am endowed with penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Marici, the girl replied to the sage, "I am the daughter of Dharma. My name is Dharma¬ vrata. I am endowed with penance.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा दानं च विप्रेभ्यो लोकमाप महोत्कटम् । पितरं च समासाद्य मातरं च युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: dattvā dānaṃ ca viprebhyo lokamāpa mahotkaṭam / pitaraṃ ca samāsādya mātaraṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: O leading Brahmana, I am performing this great penance for the wooing of a good husband". Marici thereupon spoke to Dharmavrata lovingly:
verses.hindi: कन्या मुझे दे दो. तुम्हारा परम कल्याण होगा ।१३-१६। मुनि की बातें सुन धर्म ने अर्ध्यादि से पुनः पूजन किया और उनके प्रस्ताव का अनुमोदन किया । वन प्रान्त से धमंत्रता को अपने निवास पर लाकर विधिपूर्वक विवाह कर्म सम्पन्न करके मरीचि को समपित किया । उस मद्भुल काये के उपलक्ष्य में ब्राह्मणों को घन रत्नादि भी समर्पित किये । मरीचि के कथनातुसार सब काये धर्म ने सम्पादित कर दिया, इसके लिये उन्होंने वरदान
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmana, I am performing this great penance for the wooing of a good husband". Marici thereupon spoke to Dharmavrata lovingly:
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmana, I am performing this great penance for the wooing of a good husband". Marici thereupon spoke to Dharmavrata lovingly:

verses.sanskrit: तैश्च संमानिता प्रीत्या बन्धुभिः सालिका ततः । विमानवरमारूढा दिव्यमालान्विता नृप
verses.transliteration: taiśca saṃmānitā prītyā bandhubhiḥ sālikā tataḥ / vimānavaramārūḍhā divyamālānvitā nṛpa
verses.translation: "O woman of auspicious rites, by merely looking at me, you will become a great chaste lady. I am roaming day and night on the earth, only with a desire to meet with a chaste lady.
verses.hindi: दिया । तदन्‍्तर मरीचि अपनी नव विवाहिता धर्म पत्नीं घमंत्रता को अग्निहोत्रादि वेवाहिक धामिक विधियों का विधिवत् अनुष्ठान कर अपने आश्रम में ले गये और वहाँ उसके साथ इस प्रकार आनन्दोपभोग किया जिस प्रकार भगवान् विष्णु लक्ष्मी के साथ, शम्भु पावंती के साथ तथा अजन्मा ब्रह्मा सरस्बती के साथ करते हैं  धर्मत्रता के संयोग से मरीचि के भगवान् विष्णु के समान परम तेजस्वी एवं प्रभावशाली सौ पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए । एक बःर कभी फलपुष्पादि लासे के लिये मुनिवर वन को गये थे ओर बहाँ से लोटकर बहुत थक गये थे, भोजनोपरान्त अपनी पतित्रता पत्नी घमंब्रता से उन्होंने कहा कि प्रिये ! मैं शय्या पर लेट गया हें, मेरा पर दबा दो । धर्मत्रता ने आज्ञा अज्भीकार कर दाय्या पर लेटे हुए मुनिवर मरीबि का पाद संवाहन प्रारम्भ कर दिया । सर्वप्रथम घत लगाकर वह तन्मयता पूवंक पैर दबाने लगी, थोड़ी हो देर में जब मुनि
verses.wordMeaning: "O woman of auspicious rites, by merely looking at me, you will become a great chaste lady. I am roaming day and night on the earth, only with a desire to meet with a chaste lady.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O woman of auspicious rites, by merely looking at me, you will become a great chaste lady. I am roaming day and night on the earth, only with a desire to meet with a chaste lady.

verses.sanskrit: गौरीलोकमनुप्राप्तसखित्वे ऽद्यापि मोदते । ततः प्रभृति तत्पार्थ विख्यातम् अलिकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: gaurīlokamanuprāptasakhitve 'dyāpi modate / tataḥ prabhṛti tatpārtha vikhyātam alikeśvaram
verses.translation: If you have become a Pativrata, I shall resort to you Come unto me.as your bridegroom. There is no other girl in the world like you, and you will never have another bride- groom equal to me.
verses.hindi: को नींद लग गई, पितामह ब्रह्मा जी उस स्थान पर पधारे ।!७-२२३। समुपस्थित ब्रह्मा को देखकर साध्वी धमंत्रता ने मन में प्रभुव्थ की अचंना करने का संकल्प किया, किन्तु उसके मन में वितक हुआ कि ऐसी अवस्था में जब कि पतिदेव बहुत ही थके हुये हैं, मुझे क्या उचित है, में पतिदेव का पाद संवाहन करती रहें !
verses.wordMeaning: If you have become a Pativrata, I shall resort to you Come unto me.as your bridegroom. There is no other girl in the world like you, and you will never have another bride- groom equal to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you have become a Pativrata, I shall resort to you Come unto me.as your bridegroom. There is no other girl in the world like you, and you will never have another bride- groom equal to me.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु या नारी पुरुषो वा युधिष्ठिर । स्नात्वा सम्पूजयेद्भक्त्या महादेवमुमायुतम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu yā nārī puruṣo vā yudhiṣṭhira / snātvā sampūjayedbhaktyā mahādevamumāyutam
verses.translation: Hence O Dharmavrata, be my lawfully wedded wife now". Dharmavrata thereupon told the sage, "O sage of good rites, request Dharma (for my hand)."
verses.hindi: +इदमध नास्ति क. पुस्तके । +-इत आरभ्य मुनेरित्यन्तं नास्ति ख, पुस्तके । » नास्तीदमर्ध ख. पृस्तके । अध्यंपाद्यादिक दत्तवा ब्रह्माणं समपुजयत् । सत्कृतायां तु शब्यायां (वश्चाममकरोदजः २५ एतस्मिन्नन्तरे भर्ता समुत्तस्थो स्वतल्पतः । धर्मत्रतामपश्यन्स विध्रः क़ुद्ध/ शशाप ताम् २६ पादसंवाहन त्यक्त्वा यस्मादाज्ञां विहाय मे । गताउन्यन्न ततः पापाच्छापदर्धा शिला भव.
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Dharmavrata, be my lawfully wedded wife now". Dharmavrata thereupon told the sage, "O sage of good rites, request Dharma (for my hand)."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O Dharmavrata, be my lawfully wedded wife now". Dharmavrata thereupon told the sage, "O sage of good rites, request Dharma (for my hand)."

verses.sanskrit: स पापैर्विविधैर्मुक्तो लोकमाप्नोति शांकरम् । मानसं वाचिकं पापं कायिकं यत्पुरा कृतम्
verses.transliteration: sa pāpairvividhairmukto lokamāpnoti śāṃkaram / mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ kāyikaṃ yatpurā kṛtam
verses.translation: On hearing those words, he went to Dharma. Dhanna saw the (prospective) bridegroom like a mass of refulgence. He bowed to him and honoured him with the offer of seat and materials of worship.
verses.hindi: भर्ता धमंत्रता शप्ता मरीचि प्राह सा रुषा। शयाने त्वयि संप्राप्ते ब्रह्मा त्वज्जनको गुरुः २८ त्वयोत्थाय हि कतंव्यं स्वगुरो: पूजन सदा । सया तु ध्म चारिण्या तब कार्य कते मुने ॥२ ६
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing those words, he went to Dharma. Dhanna saw the (prospective) bridegroom like a mass of refulgence. He bowed to him and honoured him with the offer of seat and materials of worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words, he went to Dharma. Dhanna saw the (prospective) bridegroom like a mass of refulgence. He bowed to him and honoured him with the offer of seat and materials of worship.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तद्विलयं याति भोजयित्वा द्विजान्सदा । दीपं दत्त्वा च देवाग्रे न रोगैः परिभूयते
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ tadvilayaṃ yāti bhojayitvā dvijānsadā / dīpaṃ dattvā ca devāgre na rogaiḥ paribhūyate
verses.translation: On being asked "Why have you come?" Marici replied to Dharma, "While roaming over the whole earth for the sake of a (marriageable) girl, your excellent daughter has been seen by me. Give that daughter unto me. You will have welfare resulting therefrom." After honouring him with Arghya etc., Dharma said to him, "So be it". He brought Dharmavrata there and gave her to Marici.
verses.hindi: अदोषा5हं यतः शप्ता तस्माच्छापं ददामि ते। त्वं च शापं महादेवाउदूतें: प्राप्स्थस्यसंशयमू +व्याकुलं त॑ं पति दुष्ट्वा व्याकुला5गात्प्रजापतिम् । नत्वा शयान ब्रह्माणमग्नि प्रज्ञाल्य चेन्धनः ॥ गाहेपत्ये स्थिता चक्के तपः परमदुष्करम् ।॥ तथा शप्तो मरीचिश््व तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् ॥३ २
verses.wordMeaning: On being asked "Why have you come?" Marici replied to Dharma, "While roaming over the whole earth for the sake of a (marriageable) girl, your excellent daughter has been seen by me. Give that daughter unto me.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked "Why have you come?" Marici replied to Dharma, "While roaming over the whole earth for the sake of a (marriageable) girl, your excellent daughter has been seen by me. Give that daughter unto me.…

verses.sanskrit: धूपपात्रं विमानं च घण्टां कलशमेव च । दत्त्वा देवाय राजेन्द्र शाक्रं लोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: dhūpapātraṃ vimānaṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ kalaśameva ca / dattvā devāya rājendra śākraṃ lokamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: He granted him boons as well. He fulfilled the promise made. The Brahmana (Marici) took her to his hermitage along with Agnihotra (sacred fire).
