verses.commentary: Sense: This mountain is established. One who offers Piriqlas there leads Pitfs to the city of god Brahma. Kunda and Udyan¬ taka were created by him by means of his penance. Brahma stayed there along with Savitri and Kumara (i.e. Sanatkumara).

verses.sanskrit: रेवासेवासमाचारः संयुक्तः शुद्धबुद्धिमान् । दम्भाहङ्काररहितः शुद्ध्यर्थं स विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: revāsevāsamācāraḥ saṃyuktaḥ śuddhabuddhimān / dambhāhaṅkārarahitaḥ śuddhyarthaṃ sa vimucyate
verses.translation: Haha and Huhu and the others made the sound of music. The mountains Kunda and Udyantaka were full of songs and the sound of musical instruments.
verses.hindi: पनुद्चिह्लास्तर्गतग्रल्थ: सं, पुस्तके नास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: Haha and Huhu and the others made the sound of music. The mountains Kunda and Udyantaka were full of songs and the sound of musical instruments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Haha and Huhu and the others made the sound of music. The mountains Kunda and Udyantaka were full of songs and the sound of musical instruments.

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं पार्थ प्रायश्चित्तार्थलक्षणम् । रेवायात्राविधानं च गुह्यमेतद् युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ pārtha prāyaścittārthalakṣaṇam / revāyātrāvidhānaṃ ca guhyametad yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: It is here that the holy sage Agastya performed an austere penance. From Brahma, he received the boon of great¬ ness rarely achieved on the earth. He secured Lopamudra as his wife and the great goal (Mok?a) to his Pitrs.
verses.hindi: १०४८८ वायुपुराणम् अतः स पव॑तो देव: सेव्यतेज्यापि नित्यश: । धर्मजास्तन्न देवेशो हरो भपष्माड्भररागवान्
verses.wordMeaning: It is here that the holy sage Agastya performed an austere penance. From Brahma, he received the boon of great¬ ness rarely achieved on the earth. He secured Lopamudra as his wife and the great goal (Mok?a) to his Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is here that the holy sage Agastya performed an austere penance. From Brahma, he received the boon of great¬ ness rarely achieved on the earth. He secured Lopamudra as his wife and the great goal (Mok?a) to his Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच: योजनस्य प्रमाणं मे वद त्वं मुनिसत्तम । यज्ज्ञात्वा निश्चितं मे स्यान् मनःशुद्धेस्तु कारणम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: yojanasya pramāṇaṃ me vada tvaṃ munisattama / yajjñātvā niścitaṃ me syān manaḥśuddhestu kāraṇam
verses.translation: At midday the devotees should take their bath and worship Savitn. The Brahmana will become a master of the Vedas and very rich for a crore of births (?)
verses.hindi: शिलाया दक्षिण हस्ते भस्मक्टो गिरिधु तः। धर्म राजेन तत्रा55स्ते अगस्त्यः सह भाय॑ंया
verses.wordMeaning: At midday the devotees should take their bath and worship Savitn. The Brahmana will become a master of the Vedas and very rich for a crore of births (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: At midday the devotees should take their bath and worship Savitn. The Brahmana will become a master of the Vedas and very rich for a crore of births (?)

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: शृणु पाण्डव वक्ष्यामि प्रमाणं योजनस्य यत् । तथा यात्राविशेषेण विशेषं कृच्छ्रसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu pāṇḍava vakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ yojanasya yat / tathā yātrāviśeṣeṇa viśeṣaṃ kṛcchrasambhavam
verses.translation: By taking ablution in the Agastya Pada and by offering Pindas there, one becomes a pious soul and attains Brahmaloka along with the Pitrs. He is worshipped even by the heaven- dwellers.
verses.hindi: सभी गन्धवों समेत चित्ररथ भी वहाँ स्थित रहता है। वे सब गन्धवंगण इस पुनीत पर्वत शिखर पर मनोहर गीत गा गा कर महान् उत्सव करते हैं। यही कारण है कि वह पुनीत पर्वत राज आज भी देवताओं द्वारा सेवित है गीतों एवं धाजनों से मिनादित इस पवित्र पर्वत शिखर पर देवेश महादेवजी अज्ों में विभूति लगाये हुए पावेती के साथ आनन्द का अनुभव करते हैं। इनकी पूजा करने से पितरगण परम गति प्राप्त करते हैं, उन शिवजी का ध्यान वहाँ अवश्यमेब करना चाट्टिये । इस गया क्षेत्र में परमात्मा गदाधारी अथवा गोपालक भगवान् विराजमान रहते हैं। मुने ! रुद्र की पूजा करने से मनुष्य वंष्णवी माया से मुक्त हो जाता है। शिला के दाहिने हाथ में भस्मकूट नामक गिरि धारण किया गया है, उस पर अपनी स्त्रो समेत मह॒षि
verses.wordMeaning: By taking ablution in the Agastya Pada and by offering Pindas there, one becomes a pious soul and attains Brahmaloka along with the Pitrs. He is worshipped even by the heaven- dwellers.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking ablution in the Agastya Pada and by offering Pindas there, one becomes a pious soul and attains Brahmaloka along with the Pitrs. He is worshipped even by the heaven- dwellers.

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यग्यवोदराण्यष्टावूर्ध्वा वा व्रीहयस्त्रयः । प्रमाणमङ्गुलस्याहुर्वितस्तिर् द्वादशांगुला
verses.transliteration: tiryagyavodarāṇyaṣṭāvūrdhvā vā vrīhayastrayaḥ / pramāṇamaṅgulasyāhurvitastir dvādaśāṃgulā
verses.translation: A man who enters Brahmayoni and comes out attains the greatest Brahman. He is liberated from the miseries of wombs (i.e. rebirth).
verses.hindi: कीकटेषु गया पुण्या पुण्य राजवनं गृहम् । च्यवनस्था55श्रमः पुण्यों नदी पुण्या पुन पुन्रा । बेकुण्ठ हेमदण्डेइ्च हेमकटो गिरिस्तथा । श्राद्धपिण्डा दिकृत्तत्र पितन्ब्रह्मपुरं नयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: A man who enters Brahmayoni and comes out attains the greatest Brahman. He is liberated from the miseries of wombs (i.e. rebirth).
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who enters Brahmayoni and comes out attains the greatest Brahman. He is liberated from the miseries of wombs (i.e. rebirth).

verses.sanskrit: वितस्तिद्वितयं हस्तश्चतुर्हस्तं धनुः स्मृतम् । स एव दण्डो गदितो विशेषज्ञैर् युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: vitastidvitayaṃ hastaścaturhastaṃ dhanuḥ smṛtam / sa eva daṇḍo gadito viśeṣajñair yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: A man who bows to Gayakumara attains Brahmana-
verses.hindi: शिलादक्षिणपादे तु गृप्रकूटो गरिरिध् तः । धर्म राजेन सुस्थेयेंकरणाय सुपावनः तन्न गृप्न श्वरं दृष्ट्वा यान्ति छांभुप्रदं नराः। तन्न गृधवर्ट नत्वा प्राप्तकामों दिवं ब्जेतू
verses.wordMeaning: A man who bows to Gayakumara attains Brahmana-
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who bows to Gayakumara attains Brahmana-

verses.sanskrit: धनुःसहस्रे द्वे क्रोशश् चतुःक्रोशं च योजनम् । एतद्योजनमानं ते कथितं भरतर्षभ
verses.transliteration: dhanuḥsahasre dve krośaś catuḥkrośaṃ ca yojanam / etadyojanamānaṃ te kathitaṃ bharatarṣabha
verses.translation: One who offers Pindas at Vyomaganga becomes free from impurities and leads the Pitrs to heaven. There is a heap of Bhasma at the right-hand side of the Sila. O Narada, the devotee should take bath with this Bhasma from the mountain called Bhasmakutadri.
verses.hindi: तत्र गृध्रगुहायां च पिण्डदः शिवलोकभाक् । तत्र माहेश्वरी धारा पिण्डद: स्वनंयगेत्पितृन् ॥३३॥॥ मूलक्षेत्र सरस्तत्र पिण्डदो ब्रह्मतोकभाक  ऋणमोक्षं पापमोक्ष शिवं दुष्ट्वा क्षिवं ब्जेत्
verses.wordMeaning: One who offers Pindas at Vyomaganga becomes free from impurities and leads the Pitrs to heaven. There is a heap of Bhasma at the right-hand side of the Sila. O Narada, the devotee should take bath with this Bhasma from the mountain called Bhasmakutadri.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who offers Pindas at Vyomaganga becomes free from impurities and leads the Pitrs to heaven. There is a heap of Bhasma at the right-hand side of the Sila. O Narada, the devotee should take bath with this Bhasma from the mountain called Bhasmakutadri.

verses.sanskrit: येन यात्रां व्रजन् वेत्ति फलमानं निजार्जितम् । उक्तं कृच्छ्रफलं तीर्थे जलरूपे नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: yena yātrāṃ vrajan vetti phalamānaṃ nijārjitam / uktaṃ kṛcchraphalaṃ tīrthe jalarūpe nṛpottama
verses.translation: Prapitamaha (Brahma) is stationed on the Vafa as Vatesvara (Lord of the holy banyan tree). One who offers Pindas at the holy Mat'angapada leads the Pitrs to heaven.
verses.hindi: नाभो थ॒ पिण्डदों यस्तु पितृन्ब्रह्मपुरं नयेत् ॥३४५॥। नितम्बे मृण्डपृष्ठस्य देवदास्वनं त्वभूल  मुण्डपृष्ठे5रविश्द्राद्ि दुष्ट्वा पापं विनाशयेत् ॥३६॥। कोउचरूपेण संविष्टो मुनिस्तन्र तपोकरोत् । तस्य पादाद्धितो यस्मात्कौज्चपादः प्रकीतितः
verses.wordMeaning: Prapitamaha (Brahma) is stationed on the Vafa as Vatesvara (Lord of the holy banyan tree). One who offers Pindas at the holy Mat'angapada leads the Pitrs to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prapitamaha (Brahma) is stationed on the Vafa as Vatesvara (Lord of the holy banyan tree). One who offers Pindas at the holy Mat'angapada leads the Pitrs to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यथाविशेषं ते वच्मि पूर्वोक्ते तत्र तत्र च । तन्मे शृणु महीपाल श्रद्दधानाय कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: yathāviśeṣaṃ te vacmi pūrvokte tatra tatra ca / tanme śṛṇu mahīpāla śraddadhānāya kathyate
verses.translation: Ahead of it is Rukmini Kunda and to the west is the river Kapila. Kapilesa is on the banks of the river. On the new moon day, one should take bath in Kapila and worship Kapilesa. If he performs Sraddha in MaheSikunda, he shall attain heaven.
verses.hindi: लक्ष्मीशों विबुधे: साध॑ तस्माद्देवमयी शिला (इति) ॥३८॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Ahead of it is Rukmini Kunda and to the west is the river Kapila. Kapilesa is on the banks of the river. On the new moon day, one should take bath in Kapila and worship Kapilesa. If he performs Sraddha in MaheSikunda, he shall attain heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ahead of it is Rukmini Kunda and to the west is the river Kapila. Kapilesa is on the banks of the river. On the new moon day, one should take bath in Kapila and worship Kapilesa. If he performs Sraddha in MaheSikunda, he shall attain heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिंस्तीर्थे हि यत्प्रोक्तं फलं कृच्छ्रादिकं नृप । तत्राप्युपोषणात् कृच्छ्रफलं प्राप्नोत्यथाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: yasmiṃstīrthe hi yatproktaṃ phalaṃ kṛcchrādikaṃ nṛpa / tatrāpyupoṣaṇāt kṛcchraphalaṃ prāpnotyathādhikam
verses.translation: Gauri, under the name of Mahgala there, grants all types of prosperity and glory. Janardana is near the Bhasmakufa. One who offers Pindas in his hand, with mantras, if for oneself and without gingelly seeds, in the left hand, if for others and mixed with curds for those who are alive—all these attain Visnu- loka. O Janardana, obeisance unto you. Hail to you of the form of the Pitrs. O Lord of Pitrs* obeisance to } ou. bow to you, O cause of salvation, O Janardana, O lord a f™ 1 * you assume the form of the Pitrs at Gaya yourself. Obeisance be to you, O bestower of salvation on the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: -+एतच्चिह्वान्तगंतग्रन्थः ख. पुस्तके न विद्यते  ह्वान्तगंततग्रग्थः ख. पुस्तके मास्ति । अगस्त्यस्य पदे स्नातः पिण्डदो ब्रह्मलोकगः । (+ ब्रह्मणस्तु वरं लेमे माहात्म्यं भुवि दुलंभम् (५४ लोपामुद्रां तथा भार्या पितृणां परमां गतिम् ।) तत्रागस्त्येश्वर दृष्ट्वा मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया.
verses.wordMeaning: Gauri, under the name of Mahgala there, grants all types of prosperity and glory. Janardana is near the Bhasmakufa. One who offers Pindas in his hand, with mantras, if for oneself and without gingelly seeds, in the left hand,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Gauri, under the name of Mahgala there, grants all types of prosperity and glory. Janardana is near the Bhasmakufa. One who offers Pindas in his hand, with mantras, if for oneself and without gingelly seeds, in the left hand,…

verses.sanskrit: दिनजाप्याच्च लभते फलं कृच्छ्रस्य शक्तितः । तत्र विख्यातदेवेशं स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वाभिपूज्य च
verses.transliteration: dinajāpyācca labhate phalaṃ kṛcchrasya śaktitaḥ / tatra vikhyātadeveśaṃ snātvā dṛṣṭvābhipūjya ca
verses.translation: After meditating on Pundarikaksa (Vi»u) one becomes released from the three forms of indebtedness, ertam y peop Wain heaven after worshipping Pund ar tkaksa.
verses.hindi: कपिलायां नरः स्नात्वा कपिलेशं समच्य च्  कृते श्राद्धे पिण्डदाने पितरो मोक्षमाप्नुयुः
verses.wordMeaning: After meditating on Pundarikaksa (Vi»u) one becomes released from the three forms of indebtedness, ertam y peop Wain heaven after worshipping Pund ar tkaksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating on Pundarikaksa (Vi»u) one becomes released from the three forms of indebtedness, ertam y peop Wain heaven after worshipping Pund ar tkaksa.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य लभते पार्थ फलं कृच्छ्रभवं सुधीः । तीर्थे मुख्यफलं स्नानाद् द्वितीयं चाप्युपोषणात्
verses.transliteration: praṇamya labhate pārtha phalaṃ kṛcchrabhavaṃ sudhīḥ / tīrthe mukhyaphalaṃ snānād dvitīyaṃ cāpyupoṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Bhima knelt on his left knee and bowed to Janardana. After performing Sraddha along with the offerings of Pintfa, he attained Visnuloka along with his brothers. On the right foot of the Sila, the mountain Preta- kuta 1 is held by Dharmaraja with both of his feet. He kicked it off with his feet on account of the weight of sins. In the forest of Kara-grahana, many have stayed behind (unliberated) in the form of departed souls (ghosts). They are the cause of obstacles. The Tirtha confers salvation on the Pitrs through the perfor¬ mance of Sraddha etc.
verses.hindi: अग्निधारा गिरिवरादागताइ्न्तकादनु ।  ८ तत्र सारस्वतं कुण्ड सरस्वत्या प्रकल्पितम् ५६ शुक्रस्तत्र सुतेः साथ॑ स(ष)ण्डामर्कादिभिः प्रभु: । तन्न तत्न सुनरद्रोणां पदेषु मुनिसत्तम ॥। अगस्त्य तथा धर्मराज विद्यमान् हैं ।॥४६-५३। अगस्त्य के चरण प्रान्त में स्तानकर पिण्डदान करने वाला मनुष्य ब्रहलोकगामी होता है । पृथ्वी भर में दुलंभ वरदान को तथा लोपामुद्रा को मह॒षि भगस्त्य ने ब्रह्माजी से यहां प्राप्त किया था  यह परम पुनीत स्थल पितरों को परमगति देने वाला है। बहाँ अगस्त्येश्वर का दर्शन करने वाला मनुष्य ब्रह्महत्या से मुक्त हो जाता है। स्त्री समेत महर्षि अगस्त की पूजा करने वाला मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: Bhima knelt on his left knee and bowed to Janardana. After performing Sraddha along with the offerings of Pintfa, he attained Visnuloka along with his brothers. On the right foot of the Sila, the mountain Preta- kuta 1 is held by Dharmaraja with both of his feet.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhima knelt on his left knee and bowed to Janardana. After performing Sraddha along with the offerings of Pintfa, he attained Visnuloka along with his brothers. On the right foot of the Sila, the mountain Preta- kuta 1 is held by Dharmaraja with both of his feet.…

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं ख्यातदेवस्य दर्शनाभ्यर्चनादिभिः । चतुर्थं जाप्ययोगेन देहशक्त्या त्वहर्निशम्
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaṃ khyātadevasya darśanābhyarcanādibhiḥ / caturthaṃ jāpyayogena dehaśaktyā tvaharniśam
verses.translation: Pretakufa attained sacredness due to the contact of the Sila. Devas are stationed in the form of footprints on Pretakufa. After performing Sraddha etc. there, one should get the Pitrs released from ghost-hood.
verses.hindi: अपने पितरों को ब्रह्मलोक पहुँचाता है । सीताचल के दाहिने भाग में जो पर्वत है, उस पर दण्डी ने तपस्या की थी । वहाँ वटेश्वर नामक वट वक्ष है, जिसके नीचे पितामह ब्रह्मा का निवास स्थान हैं। उसके आगे रुकिमिणीकुण्ड नामक तीर्थ है, पश्चिम में कपिला नामक नदी है। उस नदी के तट पर कपिलेश का स्थान है । सोमवती अमावास्या के संयोग पर कपिला नदी में स्नानकर कपिलेश की विधिवत् पूजाकर पिण्डदान एवं
verses.wordMeaning: Pretakufa attained sacredness due to the contact of the Sila. Devas are stationed in the form of footprints on Pretakufa. After performing Sraddha etc. there, one should get the Pitrs released from ghost-hood.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pretakufa attained sacredness due to the contact of the Sila. Devas are stationed in the form of footprints on Pretakufa. After performing Sraddha etc. there, one should get the Pitrs released from ghost-hood.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमं सर्वतीर्थेषु कल्पनीयं हि दूरतः । तीरस्थो योजनादर्वाग्दशांशं लभते फलम्
verses.transliteration: pañcamaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu kalpanīyaṃ hi dūrataḥ / tīrastho yojanādarvāgdaśāṃśaṃ labhate phalam
verses.translation: O Brahmana, those who have the terrible forms of a ghost near the Sila wander over the earth and in Yama's world. On the holy head of Gayasura which is devoid of ghosts etc., Brahma and other Devas are stationed and he attains sacredness.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धांदि करने से पितरगण मोक्ष की प्राप्ति करते हैं ।५४-५८। गिरिवर उद्य्तक के साथ लगी हुई एक अग्निघारा प्रवाहित होती है। वहीं पर एक सरस्वती द्वारा प्रतिष्ठापित सारस्वत नामक कुण्ड है। परमऐश्वयंशाली षण्डामर्क प्रभृति पुरोहितों के साथ शुक्राचायं वहाँ स्थित हैं। मुनिसत्तम  उस पवित्र स्थानपर उन मुनिवरों की पूजा एवं श्राद्ध पिण्ड दानदि करनेवाला मनुष्य अपने पितरों का उद्धार करता है ।५९-६०। शिला के बाएँ हाथ में एक अन्य गधभ-कूट नामक गिरि धारण किया गया है, अनेक महान् ऋषियों ने गृश्न का स्वरूप घारणकर
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmana, those who have the terrible forms of a ghost near the Sila wander over the earth and in Yama's world. On the holy head of Gayasura which is devoid of ghosts etc., Brahma and other Devas are stationed and he attains sacredness.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmana, those who have the terrible forms of a ghost near the Sila wander over the earth and in Yama's world. On the holy head of Gayasura which is devoid of ghosts etc., Brahma and other Devas are stationed and he attains sacredness.

verses.sanskrit: उक्ततीर्थफलात्पार्थ नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: uktatīrthaphalātpārtha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Among Kikatas (southern Magadha) Gaya is the holiest. Rajavana and Rajagrha are holy. The hermitage of Gyavanais holy. The river is many times holy (than the rest).
verses.hindi: बहाँ पर तपस्या कर परम सिद्धि प्राप्त की थी  इसी से उस पर्वत का नाम गुप्नरकूट पड़ गया, वहीं पक
verses.wordMeaning: Among Kikatas (southern Magadha) Gaya is the holiest. Rajavana and Rajagrha are holy. The hermitage of Gyavanais holy. The river is many times holy (than the rest).
verses.commentary: Sense: Among Kikatas (southern Magadha) Gaya is the holiest. Rajavana and Rajagrha are holy. The hermitage of Gyavanais holy. The river is many times holy (than the rest).

verses.sanskrit: उपवासेन सहितं महानद्यां हि मज्जनम् । अप्यर्वाग्योजनात्पार्थ दद्यात्कृच्छ्रफलं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: upavāsena sahitaṃ mahānadyāṃ hi majjanam / apyarvāgyojanātpārtha dadyātkṛcchraphalaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: Hemadanqia and the mountain Hemakuta are in Vaikuntha. One who performs Sraddha and offers Pinzas etc. there leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura. On the right foot of the Sila, the mountain Grdhrakufa is held by Dharmaraja in order to stabilise (Gaya). It is very holy.
verses.hindi: + धनुश्चिह्ास्तगंतग्रम्यः ख. पुस्तके न विद्यत । 2 घनुश्चि ह्वास्तगंतग्रन्थः ख. पुस्तके न विद्यते । ११०० वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hemadanqia and the mountain Hemakuta are in Vaikuntha. One who performs Sraddha and offers Pinzas etc. there leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura. On the right foot of the Sila, the mountain Grdhrakufa is held by Dharmaraja in order to stabilise (Gaya). It is very holy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hemadanqia and the mountain Hemakuta are in Vaikuntha. One who performs Sraddha and offers Pinzas etc. there leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura. On the right foot of the Sila, the mountain Grdhrakufa is held by Dharmaraja in order to stabilise (Gaya). It is very holy.

verses.sanskrit: षड्योजनवहा कुल्य नद्यो ऽल्पा द्वादशैव च । चतुर्विंशतिगा नद्यो महानद्यस् ततो ऽधिकाः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍyojanavahā kulya nadyo 'lpā dvādaśaiva ca / caturviṃśatigā nadyo mahānadyas tato 'dhikāḥ
verses.translation: Sages performed their penance there in the form of Grdhras (vultures) and attained liberation. Hence this is called Grdhrakufa. GrdhreSvara is stationed there. A man who sees Grdhresvara attains Sambhu's region. After bowing down to Grdhravata one shall achieve one's desire and attain heaven.
verses.hindi: तत्र गृप्न गुहायां घर पिण्डदः शिवलोकभाक । तत्न गृश्ने बट नत्वा प्राप्तकामों दिवं ब्रजेत् ६३
verses.wordMeaning: Sages performed their penance there in the form of Grdhras (vultures) and attained liberation. Hence this is called Grdhrakufa. GrdhreSvara is stationed there. A man who sees Grdhresvara attains Sambhu's region.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages performed their penance there in the form of Grdhras (vultures) and attained liberation. Hence this is called Grdhrakufa. GrdhreSvara is stationed there. A man who sees Grdhresvara attains Sambhu's region.…

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे तीर्थयात्रादिविधानविशेषकथनं नाम सप्तविंशत्यधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २२८ युधिष्ठिर उवाच: परार्थं तीर्थयात्रायां गच्छतः कस्य किं फलम् । कियन्मात्रं मुनिश्रेष्ठ तन्मे ब्रूहि कृपानिधे
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tīrthayātrādividhānaviśeṣakathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 228 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: parārthaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ gacchataḥ kasya kiṃ phalam / kiyanmātraṃ muniśreṣṭha tanme brūhi kṛpānidhe
verses.translation: Pretak&ta, G r dhrakuta, Bhasmakuta etc. are the tops of hillocks near Gaya.
verses.hindi: ऋणमोक्ष पापमोक्ष शिव दृष्ट्वा शिवं ब्रजेत् । शुलक्षेत्र च तत्रास्‍ते पिण्डदः स्वनंयेत्पितुनू नितम्बे मुण्डपृष्ठस्य देचदारुवन त्वभुत् । मुण्डपृष्ठारविन्दादी दृष्ट्वा पापं विनाशयेत् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Pretak&ta, G r dhrakuta, Bhasmakuta etc. are the tops of hillocks near Gaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pretak&ta, G r dhrakuta, Bhasmakuta etc. are the tops of hillocks near Gaya.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच: परार्थं गच्छतस्तन्मे वदतः शृणु पार्थिव । यथा यावत्फलं तस्य यात्रादिविहितं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: parārthaṃ gacchatastanme vadataḥ śṛṇu pārthiva / yathā yāvatphalaṃ tasya yātrādivihitaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: He who offers Pintfas in the G r dhraguha (vulture-cave) attains Sivaloka. There is the Mahesvari Dhara (the current of Mahesvara). He who offers Pinzas there, leads the Pitj-s to heaven.
verses.hindi: शिलाया वामपादे तु स्थापितः प्रेतपर्बतः । धर्मराजेन पापेभ्यो गिरिः प्रेतशिलाह्नयः ६७
verses.wordMeaning: He who offers Pintfas in the G r dhraguha (vulture-cave) attains Sivaloka. There is the Mahesvari Dhara (the current of Mahesvara). He who offers Pinzas there, leads the Pitj-s to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who offers Pintfas in the G r dhraguha (vulture-cave) attains Sivaloka. There is the Mahesvari Dhara (the current of Mahesvara). He who offers Pinzas there, leads the Pitj-s to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमेनेह वर्णेन द्रव्यलोभादिना नृप । नाधमस्य क्वचित् कार्यं तीर्थयात्रादिसेवनम्
verses.transliteration: uttameneha varṇena dravyalobhādinā nṛpa / nādhamasya kvacit kāryaṃ tīrthayātrādisevanam
verses.translation: There is a lake called Mulaksetra. He who offers Pinzas there, attains Brahmaloka. After visiting Siva he attains freedom from indebtedness and salvation from sins. He attains Siva himself after visualizing Siva.
verses.hindi: प्रेतकुण्ड च तत्रा5पस्ते देवास्तत्र पदे स्थिताः । तत्र कुण्डादिक कृत्वा प्रेतत्वास्मोचयेत्पितुन ६९ जाभिलिथिणण ह5 ०५ ०५ जल -+ पता हल नाक +-पक कक "रिक्षछ- “का "निकाय शनानान नी जीत अन पगीिबन-फनन--ानभ मान नर 2७,
verses.wordMeaning: There is a lake called Mulaksetra. He who offers Pinzas there, attains Brahmaloka. After visiting Siva he attains freedom from indebtedness and salvation from sins. He attains Siva himself after visualizing Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a lake called Mulaksetra. He who offers Pinzas there, attains Brahmaloka. After visiting Siva he attains freedom from indebtedness and salvation from sins. He attains Siva himself after visualizing Siva.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मकर्म महाराज स्वयं विद्वान्समाचरेत् । शरीरस्याथवा शक्त्या अन्यद्वा कार्ययोगतः
verses.transliteration: dharmakarma mahārāja svayaṃ vidvānsamācaret / śarīrasyāthavā śaktyā anyadvā kāryayogataḥ
verses.translation: The middle of the Sila (the belly portion) is over¬ lapped (covered) by the mountain Adipala. It is here that Vighnesa, the destroyer of obstacles, stands in the form of an elephant. He who offers Pinzas at t h e umbilical region (of the god) leads his Pitjrs to Brahmapura.
verses.hindi: गृप्न दवर का निवास स्थान है। मनुष्य वहाँ गृप्नेइवर का दशन पूजनादि कर शम्भू का लोक प्राप्त करता है। खास बचन्च गिरि की गुफा में पिण्डदान करनेवाला भी शिवलोकगामी होता है । उसी गृप्रकूढ पर वट को धमस्कार करनैवाला मनुष्य अपनी समस्त अभिलाषाओं की पूर्तिकर स्व प्राप्त करता है। वहाँ पर स्थित भगवान् छांक्षर का दह्वंन कर प्राणी ऋण एवं पाप से मुक्ति प्राप्त कर शिवलोकगामी होता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: The middle of the Sila (the belly portion) is over¬ lapped (covered) by the mountain Adipala. It is here that Vighnesa, the destroyer of obstacles, stands in the form of an elephant. He who offers Pinzas at t h e umbilical region (of the god) leads his Pitjrs to Brahmapura.
verses.commentary: Sense: The middle of the Sila (the belly portion) is over¬ lapped (covered) by the mountain Adipala. It is here that Vighnesa, the destroyer of obstacles, stands in the form of an elephant. He who offers Pinzas at t h e umbilical region (of the god) leads his Pitjrs to Brahmapura.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मकर्म सदा प्रायः सवर्णेनैव कारयेत् । पुत्रपौत्रादिकैर्वापि ज्ञातिभिर् गोत्रसम्भवैः
verses.transliteration: dharmakarma sadā prāyaḥ savarṇenaiva kārayet / putrapautrādikairvāpi jñātibhir gotrasambhavaiḥ
verses.translation: On the hips (i.e. ridges) of the mountain Mundapr$tha, there was a big forest of Devadaru trees. One shall destroy one's sins by seeing the mountain Aravinda on Muntfaprstha.
verses.hindi: उसी गृप्नकूठ पर एक शुलक्षेत्र नामक तीथ है, वहाँ पिण्डदान करनेवाला अपने पितरों को स्वर्ग पहुंचाता है । उस गयासुर के ऊषर रखी गई शिला का उदर देश आदिपाल नामक गिरि से आक्रान्ध है, उस पर विध्नों के विनाशक विध्तेश्वर गणेश गजरूप धारण कर अबस्थित हैं। उनका दर्शन करनेवाला विध्तों से मुक्त होकर अपने पितरों को स्वर्ग पहुंचाता है ।६१-६५। मृण्डपृष्ठ के नितम्ब प्रदेश में देवदारू का वन था, मुण्डपृष्ठ एवं अरविल्दादि का दर्शन करनेवाला अपने पाप कर्मों को विनष्ट करता है। गयापुरी की नाभिस्थलो, में जो सुषुम्ना नाम से विख्यात है, पिण्ड प्रदान करनेवाला अपने पितरों को स्व प्राप्त कराता है। जिला के बाएँ चरण पर प्रेतगिशि नामक एक पर्वत धर्मराज ने स्थापित किया था, यह प्रेतगिरि पहले पापों के कारण अति- शय मलिन था, इसी कारण इसका नाम प्रेतशिला कहा जाता था। धर्मेराज ने अपने परों से इसे उठाकर
verses.wordMeaning: On the hips (i.e. ridges) of the mountain Mundapr$tha, there was a big forest of Devadaru trees. One shall destroy one's sins by seeing the mountain Aravinda on Muntfaprstha.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the hips (i.e. ridges) of the mountain Mundapr$tha, there was a big forest of Devadaru trees. One shall destroy one's sins by seeing the mountain Aravinda on Muntfaprstha.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं हि विहितं प्राहुर्धर्मकर्म युधिष्ठिर । तैरेव कारयेत्तस्मान्नोत्तमैर्नाधमैरपि
verses.transliteration: śreṣṭhaṃ hi vihitaṃ prāhurdharmakarma yudhiṣṭhira / taireva kārayettasmānnottamairnādhamairapi
verses.translation: A certain sage performed penance here in the form of a Kraunca (heron). The mountain was marked by his feet. Hence it is called Krauncapada.
verses.hindi: फेंक दिया । उक्तशिला के संसर्ग के कारण यह पवित्रता को प्राप्त हुआ। वहीं पर एक प्रेतकुण्ड नामक कुण्ड है, जिसके कारण प्रान्त में देवताओं का निवास है, वहाँ पिण्डदानादि करनेवाला प्राणी अपने पितरों को प्रेतयोनि से मुक्ति दिलाता है। इस गयातीथ॑ में पितरों की मुक्ति के लिये श्राद्धादि सम्पन्न करनेवाले प्राणियों
verses.wordMeaning: A certain sage performed penance here in the form of a Kraunca (heron). The mountain was marked by his feet. Hence it is called Krauncapada.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain sage performed penance here in the form of a Kraunca (heron). The mountain was marked by his feet. Hence it is called Krauncapada.

verses.sanskrit: अधमेन कृतं सम्यङ् न भवेदिति मे मतिः । उत्तमश्चाधमार्थे वै कुर्वन्दुर्गतिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: adhamena kṛtaṃ samyaṅ na bhavediti me matiḥ / uttamaścādhamārthe vai kurvandurgatimāpnuyāt
verses.translation: One who takes bath there in the water reservoir, leads three generations to heaven. Lak$mlsa (Visnu) is stationed on the Sila in the manifest and unmanifest forms along with Devas. Hence the Sila is full of Devas.
verses.hindi: इत: परमय॑ इलोको5घिकरः ख. पुस्तके--भआ्रार््ध सपिण्डक क्ृत्वा पितृन्त्रह्मपुरं नयेत् ॥ जनादंनाय मेषाय प्थबिस्थताश्न बहवो विध्नकारिण एवं ते । श्राद्धादिकारिणां नृणां तोर्थे पितृविषुक्तये 0
verses.wordMeaning: One who takes bath there in the water reservoir, leads three generations to heaven. Lak$mlsa (Visnu) is stationed on the Sila in the manifest and unmanifest forms along with Devas. Hence the Sila is full of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who takes bath there in the water reservoir, leads three generations to heaven. Lak$mlsa (Visnu) is stationed on the Sila in the manifest and unmanifest forms along with Devas. Hence the Sila is full of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: न शूद्राय मतिं दद्यान्नोच्छिष्टं न हविष्कृतम् । न चास्योपदिशेद्धर्मं न चास्य व्रतमादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyānnocchiṣṭaṃ na haviṣkṛtam / na cāsyopadiśeddharmaṃ na cāsya vratamādiśet
verses.translation: That mountain was brought by the noble-souled Agastya. Brahma and Hara performed a fierce penance there.
verses.hindi: प्रेता धानुष्करूपेण करग्रहणकारकाः ७० पादाड्धूतां मुण्डपृष्ठां महादेवनिवासिनीम् । तां दुष्ट्वा स्वंलोकश्न मुक्तः पापोषपातक:..
verses.wordMeaning: That mountain was brought by the noble-souled Agastya. Brahma and Hara performed a fierce penance there.
verses.commentary: Sense: That mountain was brought by the noble-souled Agastya. Brahma and Hara performed a fierce penance there.

verses.sanskrit: जपस्तपस्तीर्थयात्रा प्रव्रज्या मन्त्रसाधनम् । देवताराधनं दीक्षा स्त्रीशूद्रपतनानि षट्
verses.transliteration: japastapastīrthayātrā pravrajyā mantrasādhanam / devatārādhanaṃ dīkṣā strīśūdrapatanāni ṣaṭ
verses.translation: There is the excellent Kunqla (Pool) of Agastya which is of a very rare excellence in the three worlds. It was here that the eight sages achieved Siddhi after performing penance.. They attained final beatitude. After bowing to the eight sages in the Kunda, the pilgrim will be able to lead the Pitrs to Brahma's city.
verses.hindi: गयाशिरसि पुण्ये च सर्वंपापविवर्जिते । प्रेतादिवर्जितं यस्मात्ततोइतिपावरन वरमस् १७२ कीकटेषु गया पुण्या पुण्य राजगुह वनम् । चउ्यवनस्या55श्रमं पुण्यं नदी पुण्या पुनः पुना क्रौड'चरूपेण हि मुनिर्म ण्डपृष्ठे तपोषकरोत् । तस्य पादाद्धितो यस्मात्कोज्चपादस्ततः स्पृतः
verses.wordMeaning: There is the excellent Kunqla (Pool) of Agastya which is of a very rare excellence in the three worlds. It was here that the eight sages achieved Siddhi after performing penance.. They attained final beatitude. After bowing to the eight sages in the Kunda,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is the excellent Kunqla (Pool) of Agastya which is of a very rare excellence in the three worlds. It was here that the eight sages achieved Siddhi after performing penance.. They attained final beatitude. After bowing to the eight sages in the Kunda,…

verses.sanskrit: पतिवत्नी पतत्येव विधवा सर्वमाचरेत् । सभर्तृकाशके पत्यौ सर्वं कुर्याद् अनुज्ञया
verses.transliteration: pativatnī patatyeva vidhavā sarvamācaret / sabhartṛkāśake patyau sarvaṃ kuryād anujñayā
verses.translation: O celestial sage, an auspicious prominent mountain was established on the left hand of the Sila. It is always re¬ sounding with the sounds of musical instruments and divine symphony. It is called mountain Vaditraka.
verses.hindi: स्‍्नातो जलाशये तत्र नयेत्स्वर्ग स्वक॑ कुलम् । बलि: फाकशिलायां च काकेभ्य ऋणमोक्षदः
verses.wordMeaning: O celestial sage, an auspicious prominent mountain was established on the left hand of the Sila. It is always re¬ sounding with the sounds of musical instruments and divine symphony. It is called mountain Vaditraka.
verses.commentary: Sense: O celestial sage, an auspicious prominent mountain was established on the left hand of the Sila. It is always re¬ sounding with the sounds of musical instruments and divine symphony. It is called mountain Vaditraka.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा परार्थं तीर्थादौ षोडशांशफलं लभेत् । गच्छतश्च प्रसङ्गेन तीर्थमर्द्धफलं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā parārthaṃ tīrthādau ṣoḍaśāṃśaphalaṃ labhet / gacchataśca prasaṅgena tīrthamarddhaphalaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Even today Vidyadharas, accompanied by hosts of Gandharvas and Apsaras-s sing divine songs in chorus.
verses.hindi: फावेरी सिन्‍्धुवीरा च चन्दना च सरिद्वरा। वासिष्ठी सरयुर्गड्गा पमुना गण्डकीन्दिरा महाबेतरणी नास्‍्ता निक्षरा च दिवोकसः । सावव्यलकनन्दा (? ) च उदीची कनकाछूया.
verses.wordMeaning: Even today Vidyadharas, accompanied by hosts of Gandharvas and Apsaras-s sing divine songs in chorus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even today Vidyadharas, accompanied by hosts of Gandharvas and Apsaras-s sing divine songs in chorus.

verses.sanskrit: अनुसङ्गेन तीर्थस्य स्नाने स्नानफलं विदुः । नैव यात्राफलं तज्ज्ञाः शास्त्रोक्तं कल्मषापहम्
verses.transliteration: anusaṅgena tīrthasya snāne snānaphalaṃ viduḥ / naiva yātrāphalaṃ tajjñāḥ śāstroktaṃ kalmaṣāpaham
verses.translation: Mohana, Sunitha, Sailuja, Mohanottama, Parvata>
verses.hindi: के कार्यों में विध्व डालनेवाले बहुत से प्रेत धनुष धारण कर अलग स्थित रहते हैं, और उनका हाथ पकड़ लेते हैं, अर्थात् बहुतेरा विष्न डालते हैं ।६९:७०। महादेव की निवासस्थली मुण्डपृष्ठा नामक एक छिला हैं, जो उनके चरण चिन्हों से अद्धित है । उसका दर्शन कर समस्त लोक पापों एवं उषपापों से मुक्त हो जाता है । समस्त पापों से विस्जित, पुण्यप्रद गयाशिर यतः प्रेतादि से रहित है, अतः उसे सवपिक्षा परम पुनीत एवं सुन्दर,
verses.wordMeaning: Mohana, Sunitha, Sailuja, Mohanottama, Parvata>
verses.commentary: Sense: Mohana, Sunitha, Sailuja, Mohanottama, Parvata>

verses.sanskrit: पित्रर्थं च पितृव्यस्य मातुर्मातामहस्य च । मातुलस्य तथा भ्रातुः श्वशुरस्य सुतस्य च
verses.transliteration: pitrarthaṃ ca pitṛvyasya māturmātāmahasya ca / mātulasya tathā bhrātuḥ śvaśurasya sutasya ca
verses.translation: Similarly the Gandharva named Citraratha surrounded by all the Gandharvas, sings sweet songs of great festivities on the mountain.
verses.hindi: कहा जाता है। सारे मगध प्रदेश के ती्थों में बया नगरी सर्वाधिक पुण्य प्रदायनी है, राजगृह नामक वन सभी वनों में अधिक पुण्य प्रद है, आश्रमों में व्यवत का आश्रय अधिक पुण्य प्रद है, नदियों में पुनपुना नदी सबसे अधिक पृण्यदायिनी है। इसी प्रकार वेकुण्ठ, लोह॒दण्ड, गृप्नकूट और शोणक भी पुण्य प्रद हैं, इन स्थानों पर श्राद्धादि द्वारा मनुष्य अपने सभी पितरों को ब्रह्मपुर पहुँचाता है ॥७१-७४। मुण्ड पृष्ठ पर मुनि ने ऋर-च पक्षी का रूप धारण कर तपस्था की थी, उनके चरणों के चिह्नों से यह चिह्नित भी है, इसी कारण से इसका क्रौद्धपाद नाम स्मरण किया जाता है। वहाँ जाकर जलाशय में स्नान करनेवाला प्राणी अपने कुल को स्वर्ग को पुरी में पहुँचाता है। काकशिलां पर कौआ का बलि कम ऋण से मुक्ति दिलाने वाला है। मुण्डपृष्ठ की उपत्यका में लोमहर्षण और लोमश इन दोनों ने परम कठोर तपस्या करके परम सिद्धि की प्राप्ति की थी ।
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly the Gandharva named Citraratha surrounded by all the Gandharvas, sings sweet songs of great festivities on the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly the Gandharva named Citraratha surrounded by all the Gandharvas, sings sweet songs of great festivities on the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: पोषकार्थादयोश्चापि मातामह्या गुरोस्तथा । स्वसुर्मातृष्वसुः पैत्र्या आचार्याध्यापकस्य च
verses.transliteration: poṣakārthādayoścāpi mātāmahyā gurostathā / svasurmātṛṣvasuḥ paitryā ācāryādhyāpakasya ca
verses.translation: Hence that mountain is resorted to by Devas for ever even today. Hara, the lord of Devas, is desirous of applying Bhasma all over the body like an unguent.
verses.hindi: लोमझ्न ने इस स्थान पर, नदियों में श्रेष्ठ महानदी, शरावती, होत्र॒वती, चन्द्रभागा, सरस्वती, कावेरी सिन्धुवीरा, चम्दना, वाशिष्ठी, सरयू, गंगा, यमुना, गण्डकी, इल्दिरा, स्वर्ंवासियों की निक्षरा महाबंतरणी, अलकनन्दा,
verses.wordMeaning: Hence that mountain is resorted to by Devas for ever even today. Hara, the lord of Devas, is desirous of applying Bhasma all over the body like an unguent.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence that mountain is resorted to by Devas for ever even today. Hara, the lord of Devas, is desirous of applying Bhasma all over the body like an unguent.

verses.sanskrit: इत्याद्यर्थे नरः स्नात्वा स्वयमष्टांशमाप्नुयात् । साक्षात्पित्रोः प्रकुर्वाणश्चतुर्थांशमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ityādyarthe naraḥ snātvā svayamaṣṭāṃśamāpnuyāt / sākṣātpitroḥ prakurvāṇaścaturthāṃśamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Rudra accompanied by Parvatl rejoices on that moun¬ tain resonant with music. He is worshipped as he is the greatest goal of the Pitrs. He should be meditated upon.
verses.hindi: १९०२ वायुपुराणम् कौशिकी ब्रह्मदा ज्येष्ठा स्वस्याधविमोचिनी । कृष्णवेण्या चमंबती दे नद्यों मुक्तितायिके..
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra accompanied by Parvatl rejoices on that moun¬ tain resonant with music. He is worshipped as he is the greatest goal of the Pitrs. He should be meditated upon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra accompanied by Parvatl rejoices on that moun¬ tain resonant with music. He is worshipped as he is the greatest goal of the Pitrs. He should be meditated upon.

verses.sanskrit: पतिपत्न्योर्मिथश्चार्द्धं फलं प्राहुर्मनीषिणः । भागिनेयस्य शिष्यस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य सुतस्य च । षट्त्रिपञ्चचतुर्भागान्फलमाप्नोति वै नरः
verses.transliteration: patipatnyormithaścārddhaṃ phalaṃ prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ / bhāgineyasya śiṣyasya bhrātṛvyasya sutasya ca / ṣaṭtripañcacaturbhāgānphalamāpnoti vai naraḥ
verses.translation: The greatest Atman (Deity) in Gaya is either the lord of the cows or Gadadhara (the wielder of the mace). O sage, t hanks t0 the worship of Rudra, the Maya pertaining to Vi?nu becomes quelled.
verses.hindi: आहते सरितां श्रेष्ठ लोमहषेंण साहसात् । तपसस्तु प्रभावेण नमंदा मुनिपुद्धव ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The greatest Atman (Deity) in Gaya is either the lord of the cows or Gadadhara (the wielder of the mace). O sage, t hanks t0 the worship of Rudra, the Maya pertaining to Vi?nu becomes quelled.
verses.commentary: Sense: The greatest Atman (Deity) in Gaya is either the lord of the cows or Gadadhara (the wielder of the mace). O sage, t hanks t0 the worship of Rudra, the Maya pertaining to Vi?nu becomes quelled.

verses.sanskrit: इति ते कथितं पार्थ पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् । कर्तव्यं ज्ञातिवर्गस्य परार्थे धर्मसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ pārtha pāramparyakramāgatam / kartavyaṃ jñātivargasya parārthe dharmasādhanam
verses.translation: On the right-hand side of the Sila, the mountain Bhasmakua is held by Dharmaraja. Agastya stays there with his wife. One who takes bath at the spot of Agastya and offers Pindas, goes to Brahmaloka. It was from Brahma that he secured the excellent boon of greatness in the world, Lopamudra as wife and the highest goal (liberation) to his forefathers. There, on seeing Agastyesvara, one is absolved of the sin of Brahmana-slaughter.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मयोनि प्रविश्याथ नि्गच्छेद्वस्तु मानवः । परं ब्रह्म स यातीह विमुक्तो योनिसंकटात् निक्षरायां पुष्करिण्यां स्‍्नातः श्राद्धादिक नरः । कुर्यात्कोज्चपदे दिव्ये नियमाह्ासरत्रयम् + ॥। सर्वान्पितन्नयेत्स्वर्ग पञुच पापिन एब च दंड
verses.wordMeaning: On the right-hand side of the Sila, the mountain Bhasmakua is held by Dharmaraja. Agastya stays there with his wife. One who takes bath at the spot of Agastya and offers Pindas, goes to Brahmaloka. It was from Brahma that he secured the excellent boon of greatness in the world,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the right-hand side of the Sila, the mountain Bhasmakua is held by Dharmaraja. Agastya stays there with his wife. One who takes bath at the spot of Agastya and offers Pindas, goes to Brahmaloka. It was from Brahma that he secured the excellent boon of greatness in the world,…

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाऋतुसमायोगे सर्वा नद्यो रजस्वलाः । मुक्त्वा सरस्वतीं गङ्गां नर्मदां यमुनानदीम्
verses.transliteration: varṣāṛtusamāyoge sarvā nadyo rajasvalāḥ / muktvā sarasvatīṃ gaṅgāṃ narmadāṃ yamunānadīm
verses.translation: On seeing Agastya along with his wife, one leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura. Dandin performed a penance on the mountain south of Sitadri.
verses.hindi: जौवतां दधिसंमिश्र॑ सर्वे ते विष्णुलोकगाः ८५ यस्‍्तु पिण्डो मया दत्तस्तव हस्ते जनादंन।  यदुद्दिश्य त्वया देवस्तस्मिस्पिण्डो सृते प्रभो.
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Agastya along with his wife, one leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura. Dandin performed a penance on the mountain south of Sitadri.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Agastya along with his wife, one leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura. Dandin performed a penance on the mountain south of Sitadri.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे परार्थतीर्थयात्राफलकथनं नामाष्टविंशत्यधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २२९ श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच: एवं ते कथितं राजन्पुराणं धर्मसंहितम् । शिवप्रीत्या यथा प्रोक्तं वायुना देवसंसदि
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe parārthatīrthayātrāphalakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 229 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanpurāṇaṃ dharmasaṃhitam / śivaprītyā yathā proktaṃ vāyunā devasaṃsadi
verses.translation: There is a Vafa (banyan tree) called Vatesvara. Prapitamaha (god Brahma) is stationed there. Beyond that is Rukminikunda. To the west of it is the river Kapila. Kapilesa is on the banks of the river. When the New Moon and Monday coincide with each other, a devout man must take bath in Kapila and worship the lord of Kapila. If after that, Sraddha is performed and Pindas are offered the Pitrs shall attain salvation.
verses.hindi: एष पिण्डो मया दत्तस्तव हस्ते जनादंन । अन्तकाले गते मह्म॑ त्वया देयो गयाशिरे ८७ उदीची, कनका, कौछिकौ, ब्रह्मदा, जो सभी नदियों में श्रेष्ठ एवं सभी के पापों को विनष्ट करने. वाली है, इन सब सदियों का आवाहन किया था । मुक्तिदायिनी कृष्णा, वेणीं और चमंवती--इन दोनों नदियों को जो सर्व श्रेष्ठ मानी जाती हैं, लोमहषंण ने अपने तपोबल से आवाहित किया था । मुनिपुज़्व ! अपने तपस्या के प्रभाव से नमंदा का भी आवाहन लोमहषंण ने किया था, इन सभी नदियों
verses.wordMeaning: There is a Vafa (banyan tree) called Vatesvara. Prapitamaha (god Brahma) is stationed there. Beyond that is Rukminikunda. To the west of it is the river Kapila. Kapilesa is on the banks of the river. When the New Moon and Monday coincide with each other,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a Vafa (banyan tree) called Vatesvara. Prapitamaha (god Brahma) is stationed there. Beyond that is Rukminikunda. To the west of it is the river Kapila. Kapilesa is on the banks of the river. When the New Moon and Monday coincide with each other,…

verses.sanskrit: षष्टितीर्थसहस्राणि षष्टिकोटिस्तथैव च । आदिमध्यावसानेषु नर्मदायां पदे पदे
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭistathaiva ca / ādimadhyāvasāneṣu narmadāyāṃ pade pade
verses.translation: There is a current of fire coming from the excellent mountain. There is the pool called Sarasvata Kunda. It has been created by Sarasvati.
verses.hindi: में स्तानकर पिण्डदान करनेवाला मनुष्य अपने पितरों को स्वर्ग पहुंचाता है ७५-८२! इस गयातीथ में अवस्थित ब्रहययोनि नामक तोथे में प्रवेश कर जो मनुष्य बाहर निकल आता है, वह ब्रह्म को प्राप्त करता है और योनि सड्भुटों से सर्वदा के लिये मुक्त हो जाता है। निक्षरा नामक पोंखरी में स्नान कर श्राद्धादि सम्पन्न करनेंवाला मनुष्य दिव्य फ्रोध्वपद पर नियम पूवेक तीन दिनों तकः निवास करे, ऐसा करनेवाला व्यक्ति पाँच प्रकार के
verses.wordMeaning: There is a current of fire coming from the excellent mountain. There is the pool called Sarasvata Kunda. It has been created by Sarasvati.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a current of fire coming from the excellent mountain. There is the pool called Sarasvata Kunda. It has been created by Sarasvati.

verses.sanskrit: मया द्वादशसाहस्री संहिता या श्रुता पुरा । देवदेवस्य गदतः साम्प्रतं कथिता तव
verses.transliteration: mayā dvādaśasāhasrī saṃhitā yā śrutā purā / devadevasya gadataḥ sāmprataṃ kathitā tava
verses.translation: Lord Sukra stayed there with his sons Sanda, Amarka and others. O excellent sage, a man who performs Sraddha and offers Pinda etc. in the various spots at the feet of the eminent sages, enables the Pitrs to cross (the ocean of worldly existence)
verses.hindi: पापों के करने वाले समस्त पितरों को स्वर्ग पहुँचाता है। भस्मकूट पर जनादेन का निवास स्थल है, उनके हाथ में अपने लिये तथा अन्यान्य लोगों के लिये तिलों के पिण्ड अपसव्य हो दान करना चाहिए, जीवित व्यक्तियों के लिये दघिमिश्रित पिण्डदान करना चाहिए ।जो इस तरह करते हैं वे सभी विष्णलोकगामी होते हैं । पिण्डदान करते समय यह मंत्र उच्चारण करना चाहिए। प्रभो! जनादंन ! जो पिण्ड मैं जिस के उद्देश्य से आप के हाथों में समपित कर रहा हूं, उसके मर जाने पर वह पिण्ड आप उसके लिए पहुँचा देंगे। जनादन यह पिण्ड मैं अपने लिये आपके हाथों में समर्पित कर रहा हूँ, मेरा अन्तकाल जब हो जाय तब उसे आप गयाशिर में हमें प्रदान करेंगे । जनादन ! आप पितरों को मुक्ति प्रदान करनेवाले हैं। आप
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Sukra stayed there with his sons Sanda, Amarka and others. O excellent sage, a man who performs Sraddha and offers Pinda etc. in the various spots at the feet of the eminent sages, enables the Pitrs to cross (the ocean of worldly existence)
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Sukra stayed there with his sons Sanda, Amarka and others. O excellent sage, a man who performs Sraddha and offers Pinda etc. in the various spots at the feet of the eminent sages, enables the Pitrs to cross (the ocean of worldly existence)

verses.sanskrit: पृष्टस्त्वयाहं भूपाल पर्वते ऽमरकण्टके । स्थितः संक्षेपतः सर्वं मया तत्कथितं तव
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭastvayāhaṃ bhūpāla parvate 'marakaṇṭake / sthitaḥ saṃkṣepataḥ sarvaṃ mayā tatkathitaṃ tava
verses.translation: On the left-hand side of the Sila there stands the moun¬ tain Grdhrakuta. The great sages assuming the form of cranes performed penance there and became Siddhas.
verses.hindi: जनादंन नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्ते पितृमोक्षर । पितृपते नमस्ते तु नमस्ते पितरूषिण
verses.wordMeaning: On the left-hand side of the Sila there stands the moun¬ tain Grdhrakuta. The great sages assuming the form of cranes performed penance there and became Siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the left-hand side of the Sila there stands the moun¬ tain Grdhrakuta. The great sages assuming the form of cranes performed penance there and became Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदाचरितं पुण्यं शृणु तस्यास्ति यत्फलम् । यत्फलं सर्ववेदैः स्यात् सषडङ्गपदक्रमैः
verses.transliteration: narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu tasyāsti yatphalam / yatphalaṃ sarvavedaiḥ syāt saṣaḍaṅgapadakramaiḥ
verses.translation: Hence the mountain is called Grdhrakuta. The deity Grdhresvara is stationed there. A man who visits and bows to Grdhresvara shall achieve the region of Sambhu.
verses.hindi: गयायां पितृरूपेण स्वयमेव जनादंन: । त॑ दृष्ट्वा पुण्डरोकाक्ष मुच्यते च ऋणत्रयात् . ८६ + नमस्ते पुण्डरोकाक्ष ऋणत्रयविमोचक । लक्ष्मीकान्त नमस्ते तु पितुणां मोक्षदों भव ६० वामजान सुसंपात्य नत्वा भीमो जनादंनम् । भ्राद्धं सपिण्डक कृत्वा अतृभिन्नेह्मलोकभाक् ॥॥ पितृभिः सह धर्मात्मा कुलानां च शतेन च ॥६ १
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the mountain is called Grdhrakuta. The deity Grdhresvara is stationed there. A man who visits and bows to Grdhresvara shall achieve the region of Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the mountain is called Grdhrakuta. The deity Grdhresvara is stationed there. A man who visits and bows to Grdhresvara shall achieve the region of Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: पठितैश्च श्रुतैर् वापि तस्माद् बहुतरं भवेत् । सत्रयाजी फलं यत्र लभते द्वादशाब्दिकम्
verses.transliteration: paṭhitaiśca śrutair vāpi tasmād bahutaraṃ bhavet / satrayājī phalaṃ yatra labhate dvādaśābdikam
verses.translation: Pie who offers Pindas on Grdhrakuta and in the cave, attains Sivaloka. One who bows to the Vata (the banyan tree) on Grdhrakuta attains all his desires and goes to heaven.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते गयामाहात्म्यं नामाष्टाधिकशततमो5ःषध्याय: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Pie who offers Pindas on Grdhrakuta and in the cave, attains Sivaloka. One who bows to the Vata (the banyan tree) on Grdhrakuta attains all his desires and goes to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pie who offers Pindas on Grdhrakuta and in the cave, attains Sivaloka. One who bows to the Vata (the banyan tree) on Grdhrakuta attains all his desires and goes to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: चरिते तु श्रुते देव्या लभते तादृशं फलम् । सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्पुण्यं स्नात्वा सागरमादितः
verses.transliteration: carite tu śrute devyā labhate tādṛśaṃ phalam / sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ snātvā sāgaramāditaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Siva, one attains freedom from indebtedness release from sins, and goes unto Siva. There is a Sulaksetra (shrine of the trident) there. One who offers Pindas there, leads the Pitrs to heaven.
verses.hindi: को हम नमस्कार करते हैं, आप पितरों के स्वामी हैं, स्वयं पितृस्वरूप हैं, आप को हम नमस्कार करते हैं। गया क्षैत्र में भगवान् जतादंत स्वयमेष पितृरूप से विराजमान रहते हैं, उन पुण्डरीकाक्ष भगवान् का दर्शन कर मानव अपने तीनों ऋणों से छुटकारा पाता है ॥५३-८६। तीनों ऋणों से मुक्ति देने बाले पुण्डरीकाक्ष, आप लक्ष्मी के कान्त हैं हमारे पितरों को मोक्ष प्रदान करें आपको हमारा नमस्कार है। भीम ने अपने बाएँ घटने को मोड़कर भगवान् जनादंनत को नमस्कार एवं पितरों के लिए पिण्डदान आदि करके भाइयों समेत ब्रह्मतोक की प्राप्ति की । यही नहीं उस धर्मात्मा ने पितरों समेत अपने सौ कुलों का भी उद्धार किया। उस पुनीत शिला के ऊपर लक्ष्मी पति भगवान् विष्णु अपने व्यक्ताव्यक्त स्वरूप से देवगणों के साथ स्वयमेब विराजमान रहते हैं, यही कारण है कि वह शिला देवमयी कही जाती है ।६ ०-६२।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Siva, one attains freedom from indebtedness release from sins, and goes unto Siva. There is a Sulaksetra (shrine of the trident) there. One who offers Pindas there, leads the Pitrs to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Siva, one attains freedom from indebtedness release from sins, and goes unto Siva. There is a Sulaksetra (shrine of the trident) there. One who offers Pindas there, leads the Pitrs to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: सकृत्स्नात्वा तथा श्रुत्वा नर्मदायां फलं हि तत् । आदिमध्यावसानेन नर्मदाचरितं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: sakṛtsnātvā tathā śrutvā narmadāyāṃ phalaṃ hi tat / ādimadhyāvasānena narmadācaritaṃ śubham
verses.translation: The centre of the Si la is overlapped by the ' mountain Adipala. Vighnesa, the destroyer of obstacles, stays there is the form of an elephant. On visiting him a devotee is freed from obstacles. He leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura.
verses.hindi: + एतच्छलोकस्थाने5्यं इलोकः क. पुस्तके स यथा--नमभसस्‍्ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष नमस्ते विश्वभावन लक्ष्मीकान्त
verses.wordMeaning: The centre of the Si la is overlapped by the ' mountain Adipala. Vighnesa, the destroyer of obstacles, stays there is the form of an elephant. On visiting him a devotee is freed from obstacles. He leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura.
verses.commentary: Sense: The centre of the Si la is overlapped by the ' mountain Adipala. Vighnesa, the destroyer of obstacles, stays there is the form of an elephant. On visiting him a devotee is freed from obstacles. He leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura.

verses.sanskrit: यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु । स प्राप्य शिवसंस्थानं रुद्रकन्यासमावृतः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / sa prāpya śivasaṃsthānaṃ rudrakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: There was a forest of Devadaru trees on the ridge of the mountain Mundaprstha. After visiting the mountains Mun- daprstha and Aravindadri, one quells all sins. He who offers Pindas in the umbilical region of Gaya called Susumna (like the nerve Susumna in human body) leads his Pitrs to heaven.
verses.hindi: ११०४ वायुपुराणम् कर्थ व्यक्तस्वरूपेण स्थितश्चा5:5दिगदाधर: । कथं व्यक्तस्वरूपेण व्यक्ताव्यक्तात्मना स्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: There was a forest of Devadaru trees on the ridge of the mountain Mundaprstha. After visiting the mountains Mun- daprstha and Aravindadri, one quells all sins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There was a forest of Devadaru trees on the ridge of the mountain Mundaprstha. After visiting the mountains Mun- daprstha and Aravindadri, one quells all sins.…

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रस्यानुचरो भूत्वा तेनैव सह मोदते । एतद् धर्ममुपाख्यानं सर्वशास्त्रेषु सत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate / etad dharmamupākhyānaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu sattamam
verses.translation: On the left leg of the Sila, the mountain Pretaparvata was established by Dharmaraja. The mountain is called Preta- sila because of its impurity due to sins.
verses.hindi: कथं गदा समापन्ना यथा ह्यादिगदाधरः । यदालोलं कथ्थं चा5इसीत्सवंपापक्षयंकरम् ३२
verses.wordMeaning: On the left leg of the Sila, the mountain Pretaparvata was established by Dharmaraja. The mountain is called Preta- sila because of its impurity due to sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the left leg of the Sila, the mountain Pretaparvata was established by Dharmaraja. The mountain is called Preta- sila because of its impurity due to sins.

verses.sanskrit: देशे वा मण्डले वापि वा ग्रामे नगरे ऽपि वा । गृहे वा तिष्ठते यस्य चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य भारत
verses.transliteration: deśe vā maṇḍale vāpi vā grāme nagare 'pi vā / gṛhe vā tiṣṭhate yasya cāturvarṇyasya bhārata
verses.translation: The mountain was kicked off to a great distance. Pretakuta was freed from sins and attained sanctity due to the contact with the Sila.
verses.hindi: गदो नामासुरो हासीदज्ञाद्वत्वतरो दृढः । प्राथितो ब्रह्मणे प्रादात्स्वशरीरास्थि दुस्त्यजम् ३ ब्रह्मोक्तो विश्कर्माईपि गदां चक्रेइदुभुतां तदा । तदस्थि वज्ञनिष्पेषः कुन्देः स्वगें ह्मधारयत् ४ अथ कालेन मह॒ता मनौ स्वायंभूवे क्वचित् । हेती रक्षो ब्रह्मपुत्रस्तपस्तेपे सदारुणम् विव्यवर्षसहल्राणां शतं वायुमभक्षयत् । उन्मुखश्रोध्वंबाहुश्व पादाइग्रुष्ठभरेण ह्
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain was kicked off to a great distance. Pretakuta was freed from sins and attained sanctity due to the contact with the Sila.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain was kicked off to a great distance. Pretakuta was freed from sins and attained sanctity due to the contact with the Sila.

verses.sanskrit: स ब्रह्मा स शिवः साक्षात्स च देवो जनार्दनः । त्रिविधं कारणं लोके धर्मपन्थानमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sa brahmā sa śivaḥ sākṣātsa ca devo janārdanaḥ / trividhaṃ kāraṇaṃ loke dharmapanthānamuttamam
verses.translation: There is a pool called Pretakunda there. Devas are stationed at its foot. Performing Sraddha etc. in the Kunda, one shall relieve the Pitrs of goblinhood.
verses.hindi: नारद बोले--सनत्कुमार जी ! आदि गदाधर भगवान् किस प्रकार व्यक्त रूप में अवस्थित हैं? व्यक्ताग्यक्त स्वरूप से वे व्यक्त स्वरूप में किस प्रकार अवस्थित हैं ? वह गदा किस प्रकार उत्पन्न हुई जिससे उनकी भादि गदाधर उपाधि हुई ? सभी पापों को विनष्ट करनेवाली उस ग्रदा की चड्चलक्ा क्षिस प्रकार हुई
verses.wordMeaning: There is a pool called Pretakunda there. Devas are stationed at its foot. Performing Sraddha etc. in the Kunda, one shall relieve the Pitrs of goblinhood.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a pool called Pretakunda there. Devas are stationed at its foot. Performing Sraddha etc. in the Kunda, one shall relieve the Pitrs of goblinhood.

verses.sanskrit: देवतानां गुरुं शास्त्रं परमं सिद्धिकारणम् । श्रुत्वेश्वरमुखात्पार्थ मयापि तव कीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: devatānāṃ guruṃ śāstraṃ paramaṃ siddhikāraṇam / śrutveśvaramukhātpārtha mayāpi tava kīrtitam
verses.translation: There are many of the ghosts staying separately and causing obstacles to those men who perform Sraddha etc. for the sake of the liberation of Pitrs. The ghosts assume the form of archers and catch hold of the hands (of the pilgrims).
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमार बोले--प्राचीनकाल में वजञ्नर से भी परमकठोर गद नामक एक घोर असुर था, ब्रह्मा के प्राथंना करने पर उसने अपनी हडिडयाँ ब्रह्म को समर्पित की थीं, जिनका देना परम कठिन कार्य था  ब्रह्मा के कहने पर विश्वकर्मा ने उस हेडिडियों को एक अद्भुत गंदा बनाई उस अस्थिखण्ड की वज्म भेदन करने वाले यन्त्रों से गदां बनाकर स्वर्ग लोक में विश्वकर्मा ने स्थापित किया था ।३-४ बहुत दिच बीत जाने के बाद की बात है एक बार स्वायम्भुव भश्वन्तर में ब्रह्मनन्दन हेतलि नामक राक्षस ने परम कठोर तपस्या को, एक सास दिव्य वर्षो तक उसने केवल वायु का आहाए किया, एक पर के अंग्रूठों पर खड़े रहकर मुख
verses.wordMeaning: There are many of the ghosts staying separately and causing obstacles to those men who perform Sraddha etc. for the sake of the liberation of Pitrs. The ghosts assume the form of archers and catch hold of the hands (of the pilgrims).
verses.commentary: Sense: There are many of the ghosts staying separately and causing obstacles to those men who perform Sraddha etc. for the sake of the liberation of Pitrs. The ghosts assume the form of archers and catch hold of the hands (of the pilgrims).

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणे चोत्तरे कूले यानि तीर्थानि कानिचित् । प्रधानतः सुपुण्यानि कथितानि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇe cottare kūle yāni tīrthāni kānicit / pradhānataḥ supuṇyāni kathitāni viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: There is a rock on Muntfaprstha where Mahadeva stays. On seeing it all people become relieved of heinous and
verses.hindi: एकेनातिष्ठदव्यग्र: शोणपर्णानिलाशन: । ब्रह्मदीस्तपसा तुष्टान्वरं वश्ने बरप्रदान्
verses.wordMeaning: There is a rock on Muntfaprstha where Mahadeva stays. On seeing it all people become relieved of heinous and
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a rock on Muntfaprstha where Mahadeva stays. On seeing it all people become relieved of heinous and

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्शनाद् दर्शनात् तेषां कीर्तनाच्छ्रवणात् तथा । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: sparśanād darśanāt teṣāṃ kīrtanācchravaṇāt tathā / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Gayasiras is holy and devoid of all sms. It is devoid
verses.hindi: देवदेत्यश्व शस्त्रास्त्रविविधमंनुजादिभिः । कृष्णेशानादिचक्राद्य रवध्यः स्यां महाबलः ८ तथेत्युक्त्वाइन्तहितास्ते हेतिदेंवानथाजयत् । इन्द्रत्वमकरोद्धेतिर्भोता ब्रह्म हरादयः ३६ हरि ते शरणं जम्मुरूचुहेँति जहीति तान् । ऊचे हरिरवध्यो5यं हेतिदेवासुरं: सुराः १० महास्त्रं मे प्रयच्छध्वं हेति हन्मि हि येन तम्  इत्पुक्तास्ते ततो देवा गदां तां हरये दढ़ुः ३११ दधार तां गदामादों देवरुक्तो गदाधर:  गदया हेतिमाहत्य देव: स त्रिदिव ययौ ११२
verses.wordMeaning: Gayasiras is holy and devoid of all sms. It is devoid
verses.commentary: Sense: Gayasiras is holy and devoid of all sms. It is devoid

verses.sanskrit: इदं यः शृणुयान् नित्यं पुराणं शिवभाषितम् । ब्राह्मणो वेदविद्यावान् क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ purāṇaṃ śivabhāṣitam / brāhmaṇo vedavidyāvān kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet
verses.translation: In the Kikata land (i. e. the territories comprising southern Bihar) Gaya is the holiest centre. TheRajagrha forest is also holy. The hermitage of Gyavana is another holy spot. The river Punahpuna (?) is also holy.
verses.hindi: पश्चलोकः सप्तलोको बेकुण्ठो लोहदण्डक: । क़ौचपादोक्षयवटः फल्गुतीर्थ मधुभं (त्र) वा
verses.wordMeaning: In the Kikata land (i. e. the territories comprising southern Bihar) Gaya is the holiest centre. TheRajagrha forest is also holy. The hermitage of Gyavana is another holy spot. The river Punahpuna (?) is also holy.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Kikata land (i. e. the territories comprising southern Bihar) Gaya is the holiest centre. TheRajagrha forest is also holy. The hermitage of Gyavana is another holy spot. The river Punahpuna (?) is also holy.

verses.sanskrit: धनभागी भवेद् वैश्यः शूद्रो वै धर्मभाग्भवेत् । सौभाग्यं सन्ततिं स्वर्गं नारी श्रुत्वाप्नुयाद्धनम्
verses.transliteration: dhanabhāgī bhaved vaiśyaḥ śūdro vai dharmabhāgbhavet / saubhāgyaṃ santatiṃ svargaṃ nārī śrutvāpnuyāddhanam
verses.translation: There are other holy spots, viz. Vaikuntha, Lohadanda, Grdhrakuta and Sonaka. By performing Sraddha etc. here, a pilgrim leads all the Pitrs to Brahmapura.
verses.hindi: भोर दोनों बाहुओं को ऊपर कर शान्‍्त चित्त से वह तपस्या में लीन था। इस अवधि में पुराने, गिरे हुए पत्तो एबं वायु का आहार करता था ।५-६४। इस परम कठोर तपस्या से सुप्रसन्न वरदायक ब्रह्मा प्रभति देवगणों से उसने वरदान की याचना की कि मैं समस्त देव, हैत्य विविध प्रकार के शस्त्र, अस्त्र, मनुष्य, कृष्ण, ब्िव, सुदर्शन चक्रादि से न मारा जाऊं, मेरे समान महाबलवान् कोई दूसरा न हो । देवगण हेति की प्रार्थना स्वी- कार कर अन्तहित हो गये ।७-८४॥ तदुपरान्त उसने देवताओं को पराजित कर इन्द्रका पदछीन लिया, ब्रह्मा महादेव-सभी उसके इस प्रचण्ड कर्म से भयभीत होकर विष्णु भगवान् की शरण में गये ओर बोले, भगवन् । हैति का संहार कौजिये। हरि ने देवगणों से कहा, सुरवृन्द ! हेति समस्त देवताओों एवं असुरों ढ्वारा भी नही मारा जा सकता । मुझे कोई महान अस्त्र दीजिये जिससे हेति का वध कर सकूं । भगवान् विष्णु के इस प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: There are other holy spots, viz. Vaikuntha, Lohadanda, Grdhrakuta and Sonaka. By performing Sraddha etc. here, a pilgrim leads all the Pitrs to Brahmapura.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other holy spots, viz. Vaikuntha, Lohadanda, Grdhrakuta and Sonaka. By performing Sraddha etc. here, a pilgrim leads all the Pitrs to Brahmapura.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापश्च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः । माहात्म्यं नर्मदायास्तु श्रुत्वा पापबहिष्कृताः
verses.transliteration: brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ / māhātmyaṃ narmadāyāstu śrutvā pāpabahiṣkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Assuming the form of a heron, a sage performed pena¬ nce on the ridge of Mundaprstha. Since the mountain is marked by the foot-prints of the heron, it is remembered as Krauncapada.
verses.hindi: कहने पर देवताओं ने बही गदा उन्हें समपित की । ।६-११। देवताओं के अनुरोध पर हरि ने स्र॒व॑ प्रथम उस गदा को धारण किया, और उसी से हेति का विनाश कर सुरगणों के साथ स्वर्ग लोक को प्रस्थान किया। गया पुर के निशचचलता करने के लिये ऊपर रखी गई शिला पर भगवान् ने उसी गदा को स्थापित किया था, इसी लिये उसका नाम बादि गदाधर पड़ा ।१२-१३। शिलापवंत स्वरूप से भगवान् आदि गदाघर उस गया क्षेत्र में व्यक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Assuming the form of a heron, a sage performed pena¬ nce on the ridge of Mundaprstha. Since the mountain is marked by the foot-prints of the heron, it is remembered as Krauncapada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming the form of a heron, a sage performed pena¬ nce on the ridge of Mundaprstha. Since the mountain is marked by the foot-prints of the heron, it is remembered as Krauncapada.

verses.sanskrit: पापभेदी कृतघ्नश्च स्वामिविश्वासघातकः । गोघ्नश्च गरदश्चैव कन्याविक्रयकारकः
verses.transliteration: pāpabhedī kṛtaghnaśca svāmiviśvāsaghātakaḥ / goghnaśca garadaścaiva kanyāvikrayakārakaḥ
verses.translation: One who takes bath in the water reservoir there, shall lead the entire family to heaven. An oblation offered to crows on the rock Kakasila, is conducive to relief from indebted¬ ness.
verses.hindi: हुए शिला के अतिरिक्त मुण्डपृष्ठाद्रि, प्रभास, उद्यन्त, गीतनाद, भस्मकूट नामक महागिरि, गृप्नकूट, प्रेतक्ट, आदिपाल, अरविन्दक, पञचलोक, सप्तन्ोक, बेकुण्ठ, लोहदण्डक, क्रौडचपाद, अक्षयवट, फल्गुतीथे, मधुश्रवा
verses.wordMeaning: One who takes bath in the water reservoir there, shall lead the entire family to heaven. An oblation offered to crows on the rock Kakasila, is conducive to relief from indebted¬ ness.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who takes bath in the water reservoir there, shall lead the entire family to heaven. An oblation offered to crows on the rock Kakasila, is conducive to relief from indebted¬ ness.

verses.sanskrit: एते श्रुत्वैव पापेभ्यो मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः । ये पुनर्भावितात्मानः शृण्वन्ति सततं नृप
verses.transliteration: ete śrutvaiva pāpebhyo mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ / ye punarbhāvitātmānaḥ śṛṇvanti satataṃ nṛpa
verses.translation: The two sages Lomasa and Lomaharsana performed a great penance on the ridge of Mundaprstha. Both of them attained Siddhi of the highest magnitude.
verses.hindi: ११०६ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: The two sages Lomasa and Lomaharsana performed a great penance on the ridge of Mundaprstha. Both of them attained Siddhi of the highest magnitude.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two sages Lomasa and Lomaharsana performed a great penance on the ridge of Mundaprstha. Both of them attained Siddhi of the highest magnitude.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयन्त इदं देवाः पूजिता गुरवश्च तैः । नर्मदा पूजिता तेन भगवांश्च महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: pūjayanta idaṃ devāḥ pūjitā guravaśca taiḥ / narmadā pūjitā tena bhagavāṃśca maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Like other Sthala-purana?, this text claims all important rivers in India to be present at Gaya. Small streams and streamlets are supposed to represent big rivets like Ganga, Yamuna, Kaveri etc.
verses.hindi: द्धिकुल्या मधुकुल्या देविका च महानदी । वेतरण्यादिरूपेण व्यक्त आदिगदाधरः विष्णो: पद रुद्रप् ब्रह्मण: पदमुत्तमस् । कश्यपस्थ पद दिव्य द्वो हस्तो यत्र निर्गंतो
verses.wordMeaning: Like other Sthala-purana?, this text claims all important rivers in India to be present at Gaya. Small streams and streamlets are supposed to represent big rivets like Ganga, Yamuna, Kaveri etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like other Sthala-purana?, this text claims all important rivers in India to be present at Gaya. Small streams and streamlets are supposed to represent big rivets like Ganga, Yamuna, Kaveri etc.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन गन्धपुष्पविभूषणैः । पूजितं परया भक्त्या शास्त्रमेतत्फलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprayatnena gandhapuṣpavibhūṣaṇaiḥ / pūjitaṃ parayā bhaktyā śāstrametatphalapradam
verses.translation: A man who enters the holy spot Brahmayoni and comes out of it, attains the greatest Brahman freed from the distress of wombs (i.e. re-birth).
verses.hindi: पञ्चानीनां ददान्यत्र इन्द्रागस्त्यपदे परे । रवेश्व कातिकेयस्थ कौञजचमातड्रयोरपि...
verses.wordMeaning: A man who enters the holy spot Brahmayoni and comes out of it, attains the greatest Brahman freed from the distress of wombs (i.e. re-birth).
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who enters the holy spot Brahmayoni and comes out of it, attains the greatest Brahman freed from the distress of wombs (i.e. re-birth).

verses.sanskrit: लेखापयित्वा सकलं नर्मदाचरितं शुभम् । उत्तमं सर्वशास्त्रेभ्यो यो ददाति द्विजन्मने
verses.transliteration: lekhāpayitvā sakalaṃ narmadācaritaṃ śubham / uttamaṃ sarvaśāstrebhyo yo dadāti dvijanmane
verses.translation: Janardana stays in Bhasmakufa. He who offers Pindas m his hands whether for himself or for others-if it is for one's own self it must be without gingelly seeds (and be offered) with the sacred thread in the Savya (hanging from the left shoulder) position; and if for those who are alive, it must be mixed with curds all these go to Visnuloka (Vaikuntha).
verses.hindi: गायत्रो चेव सावित्नी संध्या चेब सरस्वती। नयादित्यश्रोत्तराकों दक्षिणाकोंपि नेमिषः २१ श्वेतायों गणनाथश्व वसवो5ष्टो घुनीश्वराः। रुद्राश्नेकादशवाथ तथा सप्तर्षयोपरे मार्कण्डेयेशः कोटीशो हाड़्िरिशः पितामहः । जनादनो मड्भला च॒ पुण्डरीकाक्ष उत्तसः
verses.wordMeaning: Janardana stays in Bhasmakufa. He who offers Pindas m his hands whether for himself or for others-if it is for one's own self it must be without gingelly seeds (and be offered) with the sacred thread in the Savya (hanging from the left shoulder) position;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Janardana stays in Bhasmakufa. He who offers Pindas m his hands whether for himself or for others-if it is for one's own self it must be without gingelly seeds (and be offered) with the sacred thread in the Savya (hanging from the left shoulder) position;…

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदासर्वतीर्थेषु स्नाने दाने च यत्फलम् । तत्फलं समवाप्नोति स नरो नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: narmadāsarvatīrtheṣu snāne dāne ca yatphalam / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Mantra: "O Janardana, the Pinda that I offer in your hand, may please be given by you to that person for whom I have given it to thee now. It be given to him after he is dead, O lord."
verses.hindi: दृत्यादिव्यक्तरूपेण स्थितश्रा5४दिगदाधर: । हेतियों राक्षसस्तस्मिन्हतो विष्णुपुरं गतः २५ ब्रहमणा सह रुद्रा्रः कारिते निश्चलेड्सुरे । तुष्टाबाइप्यगदापाणि बेधा हर्षण निव तः
verses.wordMeaning: Mantra: "O Janardana, the Pinda that I offer in your hand, may please be given by you to that person for whom I have given it to thee now. It be given to him after he is dead, O lord."
verses.commentary: Sense: Mantra: "O Janardana, the Pinda that I offer in your hand, may please be given by you to that person for whom I have given it to thee now. It be given to him after he is dead, O lord."

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पुराणं रुद्रोक्तं महापुण्यफलप्रदम् । स्वर्गदं पुत्रदं धन्यं यशस्यं कीर्तिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: etatpurāṇaṃ rudroktaṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradam / svargadaṃ putradaṃ dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ kīrtivardhanam
verses.translation: Mantra. "O Janardana, this Pinda is given into your hand by me. When I reach the end of my time (when I am dead) this must be given to me at Gayasiras. 1 O Janardana, obeisance to you. Bow to you, granter of liberation to the Pitrs. O lord of Pitrs, obeisance to you. Hail toyou in the form of Pitrs."
verses.hindi: गदाधरं व्यपगतकालकल्मषं गयागतं विदितगुणं गुणातिगम् । गुहागतं गिरिवरगौरगेहगं गर्णाच्तं वरदमहं नमामि द्षिकुल्या, मधुकुल्या, देविका, महानदी, वंतरणी प्रभूति के रूप में आदि गदाधर भगवान् व्यक्त हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Mantra. "O Janardana, this Pinda is given into your hand by me. When I reach the end of my time (when I am dead) this must be given to me at Gayasiras. 1 O Janardana, obeisance to you. Bow to you, granter of liberation to the Pitrs. O lord of Pitrs, obeisance to you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Mantra. "O Janardana, this Pinda is given into your hand by me. When I reach the end of my time (when I am dead) this must be given to me at Gayasiras. 1 O Janardana, obeisance to you. Bow to you, granter of liberation to the Pitrs. O lord of Pitrs, obeisance to you.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापहरं पार्थ दुःखदुःस्वप्ननाशनम् । पठतां शृण्वतां राजन् सर्वकामार्थसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpaharaṃ pārtha duḥkhaduḥsvapnanāśanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ rājan sarvakāmārthasiddhidam
verses.translation: In Gaya, Janardana assumed the form of Pitrs himself. On visiting that Pundarikaksa (lotus-eyed god Visnu) one is released from three-fold indebtedness.
verses.hindi: विष्णुपद, रुव्रपद, उत्तम ब्रह्म पददिव्य ग्रुण युक्त कब्यप पद जहाँ पर दो हाथ निकले हुए हैं, पंचाग्नियों के पद, इन्द्र एवं अगस्त्य के पद, सूर्य, कार्तिकेय ऋरच, मातजू, एवं अन्यान्य प्रमुख लिज्भध--ये सभी वहाँ ब्यक्ताव्यक्त स्वरूप में उपस्थित हैं, आदि गदाधर भगवान् स्वयमेव इन स्वरूपों से व्यक्तरूप में विराजमान हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In Gaya, Janardana assumed the form of Pitrs himself. On visiting that Pundarikaksa (lotus-eyed god Visnu) one is released from three-fold indebtedness.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Gaya, Janardana assumed the form of Pitrs himself. On visiting that Pundarikaksa (lotus-eyed god Visnu) one is released from three-fold indebtedness.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तिरस्तु शिवं चास्तु लोकाः सन्तु निरामयाः । गोब्राह्मणेभ्यः स्वस्त्यस्तु धर्मं धर्मात्मजाश्रयः
verses.transliteration: śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu lokāḥ santu nirāmayāḥ / gobrāhmaṇebhyaḥ svastyastu dharmaṃ dharmātmajāśrayaḥ
verses.translation: O Pundarikaksa, obeisance to you, O releaser from the three-fold indebtedness. O Laksmlkanta (Lord of LaksmI), obeisance to you, be the granter of liberation to the Pitrs." Kneeling on his left knee, Bhlma bowed to Janardana. After performing the Sraddha along with the offerings of Pindas, he attained Brahmaloka in the company of his brothers. He became a pious soul and uplifted a hundred forefathers in his family.
verses.hindi: वसुगण, मुनीन्‍्द्रगण, ग्यारह रुद्रगण, सातों ऋषिगण, सोमनाथ, सिद्धेश, कपर्दीश, विनायक, नारायण, महालक्ष्मी, ब्रह्मा, श्री पुरषोत्तम, मांकण्डेयेश कोटीश, अज्धिरेश, पितामह, जनारदन, मज्ूला, पुण्डरीकाक्ष, इटैया दि स्वरूप से आदि गदाधर भगवात् विराजमान हैं। वह हेति नामक राक्षस, जिसको कथा ऊपर कही जा चुकी है, मृत्यु के उपरान्त भगवान विष्णु के लोक में पहुंचा । गयासुर के निईंचल कर देने पर ब्रह्म समेत रुद्रादि देवगण परम हर्षित हुए ओर आदि गदाधर की इस प्रकार सब लोगों ने मिलकर स्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: O Pundarikaksa, obeisance to you, O releaser from the three-fold indebtedness. O Laksmlkanta (Lord of LaksmI), obeisance to you, be the granter of liberation to the Pitrs." Kneeling on his left knee, Bhlma bowed to Janardana.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Pundarikaksa, obeisance to you, O releaser from the three-fold indebtedness. O Laksmlkanta (Lord of LaksmI), obeisance to you, be the granter of liberation to the Pitrs." Kneeling on his left knee, Bhlma bowed to Janardana.…

verses.sanskrit: नरकान्तकरी रेवा सतीर्था विश्वपावनी । नर्मदा धर्मदा चास्तु शर्मदा पार्थ ते सदा
verses.transliteration: narakāntakarī revā satīrthā viśvapāvanī / narmadā dharmadā cāstu śarmadā pārtha te sadā
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा बोले--गया क्षेत्र में विराजमान, सभी गुणों से परे, प्रशस्त गुणशाली समस्त काल चक्रों एवं पापों से विद्ीन, गुणों द्वारा सुपूजित, गदा धारण करने वाले, गिरिराज की हिमाच्छादित गुहा में विराजमान
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. NP. II.47.63b-65.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मार्कण्डेययुधिष्ठिरसंवादे रेवाखण्डपठनश्रवणदानादिफलश्रुतिवर्णनं नामैकोनत्रिंशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २३० सूत उवाच: इत्युक्त्वोपररामथ पाण्डोः पुत्राय वै मुनिः । मृकण्डतनयो धीमान्सप्तकल्पस्मरः पुरः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde revākhaṇḍapaṭhanaśravaṇadānādiphalaśrutivarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 230 sūta uvāca: ityuktvopararāmatha pāṇḍoḥ putrāya vai muniḥ / mṛkaṇḍatanayo dhīmānsaptakalpasmaraḥ puraḥ
verses.translation: How did the primordial Gadadhara (wielder of the mace) stay in the manifest form? How did he stay both as manifest and unmanifest?
verses.hindi: दृढाद॒ढ परिवुदगादसंस्तुतं कामादुभूतं सुदुढमरूढिरिढिगम् । विदेहक॑ करणकलाविवर्जितं विजन्मकं दिनकरवेदिभृषितमस् ।
verses.wordMeaning: How did the primordial Gadadhara (wielder of the mace) stay in the manifest form? How did he stay both as manifest and unmanifest?
verses.commentary: Sense: How did the primordial Gadadhara (wielder of the mace) stay in the manifest form? How did he stay both as manifest and unmanifest?

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डमुनिना प्रोक्तं यथा पार्थाय सत्तमाः । तथा वः कथितं सर्वं रेवामाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍamuninā proktaṃ yathā pārthāya sattamāḥ / tathā vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ revāmāhātmyamuttamam
verses.translation: How did the mace (Gada) originate and how did he come to be known as Adigadadhara? How did the Gadalola spot become so (sanctifying) as to wipe off all sins.
verses.hindi: गदाधरं ध्वनिमुखर्वाजितं परं नमाम्यहं सततमनादिसीश्चरम्
verses.wordMeaning: How did the mace (Gada) originate and how did he come to be known as Adigadadhara? How did the Gadalola spot become so (sanctifying) as to wipe off all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: How did the mace (Gada) originate and how did he come to be known as Adigadadhara? How did the Gadalola spot become so (sanctifying) as to wipe off all sins.

verses.sanskrit: इयं पुण्या सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा रेवा विश्वैकपावनी । रुद्रदेहसमुद्भूता सर्वभूताभयप्रदा
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ puṇyā saricchreṣṭhā revā viśvaikapāvanī / rudradehasamudbhūtā sarvabhūtābhayapradā
verses.translation: There was an Asura named Gada whose body was very hard and adamantine. By performing a very terrible penance he secured boons from Brahma. When he was requested, he gave up to Brahma the bones of his body which is very difficult to part with.
verses.hindi: चिदात्मकं कलिगतकारणातिगं गदाधरं हृदयगतं नमामि तम् ३३ १ देवेः साथ ब्रह्मणेवं स्तुतश्रा5दिगदाधरः । ऊचे बरं वुणीष्व त्वं वरं ब्रह्मा तमब्रवोत्
verses.wordMeaning: There was an Asura named Gada whose body was very hard and adamantine. By performing a very terrible penance he secured boons from Brahma. When he was requested, he gave up to Brahma the bones of his body which is very difficult to part with.
verses.commentary: Sense: There was an Asura named Gada whose body was very hard and adamantine. By performing a very terrible penance he secured boons from Brahma. When he was requested, he gave up to Brahma the bones of his body which is very difficult to part with.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारजलधिं यावद् उवाच भृगुनन्दनः । तीर्थसङ्गमभेदान्वै धर्मपुत्राय पृच्छते
verses.transliteration: oṅkārajaladhiṃ yāvad uvāca bhṛgunandanaḥ / tīrthasaṅgamabhedānvai dharmaputrāya pṛcchate
verses.translation: Urged by Brahma, Visvakarma made the wonderful club (out of it). He turned the bone of the demon in the lathe that could crush even Vajra (thunderbolt) and kept it in the heaven itself.
verses.hindi: वरदायक देव को मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ ।२७। दिन की शोभा, देवबणों को विजय श्री प्रदान करने वाले, महादेव जी को यश प्रदान करने वाले, हैत्यों का विनाश कर सुर गुणों को प्रसन्न करने बाले, कलि के घोर पापों को विनष्ट कर यश उपाजित करने वाले, कलियुग में भी परम शोभा सम्पन्न, शरणागत रक्षक भगवान् गदाधर को नमस्कार करता हूँ ।२८। परम पुष्टि भक्ति रखने वाले भक्त जन जिसकी गाढ़ी भक्ति से
verses.wordMeaning: Urged by Brahma, Visvakarma made the wonderful club (out of it). He turned the bone of the demon in the lathe that could crush even Vajra (thunderbolt) and kept it in the heaven itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by Brahma, Visvakarma made the wonderful club (out of it). He turned the bone of the demon in the lathe that could crush even Vajra (thunderbolt) and kept it in the heaven itself.

verses.sanskrit: समासेनैव मुनयस्तथाहं कथयामि वः । सप्तषष्टिसहस्राणि षष्टिकोट्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: samāsenaiva munayastathāhaṃ kathayāmi vaḥ / saptaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathaiva ca
verses.translation: After a great deal of time, in the Svayambhuva Mau- vantara, the demon Heti, the son of Brahma, performed a very terrible penance.*
verses.hindi: स्तुति करते हैं, ऐसे परम कठोर से भी कठोर, अद्भुतकर्मशील, परम विक्रमक्कील, अजन्मा होकर भी द्वारीर धारण करनेवाले, कठोर पाप कर्मों को नष्ठ करने वाले, पृज्यों में भी अग्रणी, पापियों को न प्राप्त होने वाले, भगवान् की हमारा नमस्कार है, जो वाक्य एवं मन से अगोचर होकर भी सह्गंशों में उत्पन्न होने वाले हैं, शरीर रहित, करण एवं कलाओं से विहीन, अजस्मा, सूर्य की भाँति परम कास्तिमान्, ध्वनि एवं मुख से विहीन, अनादि परम ऐड्वर्यंशाली भगवान् को सवेदा नमस्कार करते हैं ।३६-३०। मन से भी परे, बुद्धि की गति से भी अगम्य, परात्पर, देतरहित, जिस भगवान् की पण्डित जन सर्वंदा स्तुति करते हैं, उस चित्स्वरूप कलिकाल गत कारण समूहों से परे हृदय में विराजमान, उस भगवान् गदाधर को नमस्कार करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After a great deal of time, in the Svayambhuva Mau- vantara, the demon Heti, the son of Brahma, performed a very terrible penance.*
verses.commentary: Sense: After a great deal of time, in the Svayambhuva Mau- vantara, the demon Heti, the son of Brahma, performed a very terrible penance.*

verses.sanskrit: कथं केनात्र शक्यन्ते वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि । तथाप्यत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठाः प्रोक्तं पार्थाय वै यथा
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ kenātra śakyante vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi / tathāpyatra muniśreṣṭhāḥ proktaṃ pārthāya vai yathā
verses.translation: For a hundred thousand divine years he subsisted only on the air. Then looking up, he stood on his toes with hands raised up. Then he stood on a single foot for a long time taking in only air or dry leaves. Brahma and others were pleased by
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमार बोलेः--देवताओं समेत ब्रह्मा द्वारा इस प्रकार स्तुति किये जाने के उपराम्त विष्णू ने कहा, वरदान माँगिये । तब ब्रह्मा ने वरदाम की याचना की कि देव  इस देव" स्वरूपिणी शिला पर आपके विना हम लोग नहीं हहेंगे, व्यक्तादिस्वरूप सम्पन्न आपके साथ ही हम
verses.wordMeaning: For a hundred thousand divine years he subsisted only on the air. Then looking up, he stood on his toes with hands raised up. Then he stood on a single foot for a long time taking in only air or dry leaves. Brahma and others were pleased by
verses.commentary: Sense: For a hundred thousand divine years he subsisted only on the air. Then looking up, he stood on his toes with hands raised up. Then he stood on a single foot for a long time taking in only air or dry leaves. Brahma and others were pleased by

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थम्ॐकारमारभ्य वक्ष्ये तीर्थावलिं शुभाम् । प्रोच्यमानां समासेन तां शृणुध्वं महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: tīrthamoṃkāramārabhya vakṣye tīrthāvaliṃ śubhām / procyamānāṃ samāsena tāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Saying "So be it", they vanished. Heti conquered Devas and began to rule as Indra. Brahma, Hara and others became afraid (of him).
verses.hindi: (१०५ वायूपुराणम् शिलायां देवरूपिण्यां न तिष्ठामस्त्वया विना । स्थास्थामो5न्न त्वया साध॑ नित्य॑ व्यक्तादिरूपिणा
verses.wordMeaning: Saying "So be it", they vanished. Heti conquered Devas and began to rule as Indra. Brahma, Hara and others became afraid (of him).
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying "So be it", they vanished. Heti conquered Devas and began to rule as Indra. Brahma, Hara and others became afraid (of him).

verses.sanskrit: नत्वा सोमं महेशानं नत्वा ब्रह्माच्युतावुभौ । सरस्वतीं गणेशानं देव्यासाङ्घ्रिपञ्कजम्
verses.transliteration: natvā somaṃ maheśānaṃ natvā brahmācyutāvubhau / sarasvatīṃ gaṇeśānaṃ devyāsāṅghripañkajam
verses.translation: They sought refuge in Hari. They told him, "Kill Heti. Hari said to them, "O Suras, this Heti cannot be killed by Devas or Asuras.
