verses.hindi: एवमस्तु श्षिया सार्थ स्थितश्रा3+दिगदाधरः । “लोकानां रक्षणार्थाय जगतां मुक्तिहेतवे ॥
verses.wordMeaning: They sought refuge in Hari. They told him, "Kill Heti. Hari said to them, "O Suras, this Heti cannot be killed by Devas or Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: They sought refuge in Hari. They told him, "Kill Heti. Hari said to them, "O Suras, this Heti cannot be killed by Devas or Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वाचार्यांस् तथा सर्वान्दृष्ट्वादृष्टार्थवेदिनः । प्रणम्य नर्मदां देवीं वक्ष्ये तीर्थावलिं त्विमाम्
verses.transliteration: pūrvācāryāṃs tathā sarvāndṛṣṭvādṛṣṭārthavedinaḥ / praṇamya narmadāṃ devīṃ vakṣye tīrthāvaliṃ tvimām
verses.translation: At the outset he held that (bone) club, so he was call¬ ed, 'Gadadhara" by Devas. After striking Heti with his (bone) club, he went to heaven along with Devas.
verses.hindi: सुव्यक्तः पुण्डरीकाक्षो जनादंन इति श्रुतः संतारणाय लोकानां देवानां रक्षणाय च । गयाशिरसि सुब्यक्तो भविष्यति न संशयः ३६
verses.wordMeaning: At the outset he held that (bone) club, so he was call¬ ed, 'Gadadhara" by Devas. After striking Heti with his (bone) club, he went to heaven along with Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the outset he held that (bone) club, so he was call¬ ed, 'Gadadhara" by Devas. After striking Heti with his (bone) club, he went to heaven along with Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमो विश्वरूपाय ओङ्कारायाखिलात्मने । यमारभ्ये प्रवक्ष्यामि रेवातीर्थावलिं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namo viśvarūpāya oṅkārāyākhilātmane / yamārabhye pravakṣyāmi revātīrthāvaliṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: In order to steady the rocky slab of Gayasuraiiras, he went there armed with this Gada to stabilise the Sila. Hence he is called Adigadadhara. 1
verses.hindi: ये द्रक्यन्ति सदा भक्त्या देवमादिगदाधरम् । (+कुष्ठरोगादिनिर्मुक्ता यास्यन्ति हरिसन्दिरम्
verses.wordMeaning: In order to steady the rocky slab of Gayasuraiiras, he went there armed with this Gada to stabilise the Sila. Hence he is called Adigadadhara. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to steady the rocky slab of Gayasuraiiras, he went there armed with this Gada to stabilise the Sila. Hence he is called Adigadadhara. 1

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन् मार्कण्डगदिते रेवातीर्थक्रमे शुभे । पुराणसंहिताध्याया मार्कण्डाश्रमवर्णनम्
verses.transliteration: asmin mārkaṇḍagadite revātīrthakrame śubhe / purāṇasaṃhitādhyāyā mārkaṇḍāśramavarṇanam
verses.translation: Adigadadhara is manifest in the form of Silas 2 (rocky slabs and mountains). Through Mundaprstha mountain, Prabhasa mountain, the mountains Udyanta, Gitanada, Bhas- makuta, Gfdhrakuta, Pretakuta, Adipala and Aravindaka, Pancaloka, Saptaloka, Vaikuntha, Lohadandaka, Krauncapada, Aksayavata, Phalgutlrtha, Madhus'rava, Dadhikulya, Madhu- kulya, the great river Devika and VaitaranI etc. Adigadadhara becomes manifest.
verses.hindi: ये द्रक्ष्यन्ति सदा भकत्या देवमादिगदाधरम् ) । ते प्राप्स्यन्ति धन धान्यमायुरारोग्यमेव च ३८ कलत्रपुत्रपौन्नादिगुणकी तिसुखानि च् । श्रद्धया ये नमस्यन्ति राज्य ब्रह्मपुरं तथा ॥ लोग यहाँ पर सर्वदा स्थिर रह सकेंगे ! आदि गदाधघर ऐसा ही हों--कहकर लक्ष्मी के साथ वहाँ विराजमान हुए । समस्त लोकों की रक्षा एवं जगत् के जीबों को भुक्ति प्रदान करने के लिये भगवान् आदि गदाधर पुण्डरीकाक्ष जनादंन नाम से वहाँ व्यक्त स्वरूप धारणकर स्थित हुए--ऐसा सुना जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Adigadadhara is manifest in the form of Silas 2 (rocky slabs and mountains). Through Mundaprstha mountain, Prabhasa mountain, the mountains Udyanta, Gitanada, Bhas- makuta, Gfdhrakuta, Pretakuta, Adipala and Aravindaka, Pancaloka, Saptaloka, Vaikuntha, Lohadandaka, Krauncapada,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Adigadadhara is manifest in the form of Silas 2 (rocky slabs and mountains). Through Mundaprstha mountain, Prabhasa mountain, the mountains Udyanta, Gitanada, Bhas- makuta, Gfdhrakuta, Pretakuta, Adipala and Aravindaka, Pancaloka, Saptaloka, Vaikuntha, Lohadandaka, Krauncapada,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रश्नाधिकारश्च प्रशंसा नर्मदोद्भवा । तथा पञ्चदशानां च प्रवाहानां प्रकीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praśnādhikāraśca praśaṃsā narmadodbhavā / tathā pañcadaśānāṃ ca pravāhānāṃ prakīrtanam
verses.translation: This etymology does not explain the term 'Adi' in Adigadadhara.
verses.hindi: श्वेत कल्प में वेदों द्वारा अगम्य जो आदि भूत, सनातन, भगवान् की व्यक्त मूति थी, वही भविष्य में वाराह कल्प के आने पर अव्यक्त हो जाती है। प्राचीनकाल में वही व्यक्तता को प्राप्त हुईं। लोक का उद्धार एवं
verses.wordMeaning: This etymology does not explain the term 'Adi' in Adigadadhara.
verses.commentary: Sense: This etymology does not explain the term 'Adi' in Adigadadhara.

verses.sanskrit: नामनिर्वचनं तद्वत्तथा कल्पसमुद्भवाः । एकविंशतिकल्पानां तद्वन्नामानुकीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: nāmanirvacanaṃ tadvattathā kalpasamudbhavāḥ / ekaviṃśatikalpānāṃ tadvannāmānukīrtanam
verses.translation: Near Gaya there is a chain of sacred but rocky hillocks and their tops are called Bhasmakuta, Gfdhrakuia etc. Gayasiras consists of this chain of hillocks extending to about two miles.
verses.hindi: लोग सवंदा भक्तिपूवक भगवान् आद्रि गदाधर का दशन करेंगे, वे कुष्ठ जेसे महान् असाध्य रोगों से मुक्त होकर भगवान् विष्णु के लोक को जायेंगे । जो आदि गदाधर भगवान् का भक्ति पूर्वक सबंदा दर्शन करेंगे वे विपुलधन, घान्य, आयु एवं आरोग्य की प्राप्ति करेंगे ।३७-३८। कलज्न, पुत्र, पौन्नादि, गुण, कीरति एवं सुख को उन्हें प्राप्ति होगी । जो लोग भगवान् आदि गदांधर को श्रद्धापुवंक नमस्कार करेंगे, वे राज्य तथा ब्रह्मपुर की प्राप्ति करेंगे । बे मनुष्य अपने निखिल पुण्यकर्मों का विपुल फल भोगकर अत्त में ब्रह्मपुर को प्राप्त होंगे ।३९। सुगन्धित द्रव्यों के दान से विपुल सुगन्धित द्रव्यों को प्राप्ति होगी, पुष्प के दान से सौभाग्य की वृद्धि होगी । धृप-दान से राज्य-प्राप्ति होगी, दीग दान से विपुल कान्ति मिलेगी। ध्वजा के दात से पाप का विनाश होगा, जो यात्रा
verses.wordMeaning: Near Gaya there is a chain of sacred but rocky hillocks and their tops are called Bhasmakuta, Gfdhrakuia etc. Gayasiras consists of this chain of hillocks extending to about two miles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near Gaya there is a chain of sacred but rocky hillocks and their tops are called Bhasmakuta, Gfdhrakuia etc. Gayasiras consists of this chain of hillocks extending to about two miles.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयानुभूतानां सप्तानां लक्षणानि च । माहात्म्यं चैव रेवायाः शिवविष्ण्वोस् तथैव च
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyānubhūtānāṃ saptānāṃ lakṣaṇāni ca / māhātmyaṃ caiva revāyāḥ śivaviṣṇvos tathaiva ca
verses.translation: The following are manifest-cum-unmanifest 1. Visnu s Pada (footprint), Rudrapada, the excellent Pada of Brahman, Kasyapa's Pada, which is divine as well as wherein two hands have come out, the Pada? of the five fires, the prominent Padas of Indra and Agastya and the Pada? of Ravi, Kartikeya, Kraunca and Matanga. In all the Lingas the primordial Gada- dhara, the glorious and manifest Gadadhara, abides in manifest- cum-unmanifest form.
verses.hindi: अय॑ इलोकः स. पुस्तके न विद्या । +पधनुद्चित्वान्तर्गंतग्रन्थः ख. पुस्तके तास्ति ।
verses.wordMeaning: The following are manifest-cum-unmanifest 1. Visnu s Pada (footprint), Rudrapada, the excellent Pada of Brahman, Kasyapa's Pada, which is divine as well as wherein two hands have come out, the Pada? of the five fires,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are manifest-cum-unmanifest 1. Visnu s Pada (footprint), Rudrapada, the excellent Pada of Brahman, Kasyapa's Pada, which is divine as well as wherein two hands have come out, the Pada? of the five fires,…

verses.sanskrit: संहारलक्षणं तद्वद् ओङ्कारस्य च सम्भवः । तथैवौंकारमाहात्म्यम् अमरकण्टकीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: saṃhāralakṣaṇaṃ tadvad oṅkārasya ca sambhavaḥ / tathaivauṃkāramāhātmyam amarakaṇṭakīrtanam
verses.translation: The primordial Gadadhara is stationed 2 as Gayatrl, Savitrl, Sandhya, Sarasvatl, Gayaditya, Uttararka, Daksinarka, Naimisa, Svetarka, Gananatha, the eight Vasus, the leading sages, the eleven Rudras, the Seven Sages, Soma- natha, Siddhesa, Kapardisa, Vinayaka, Narayana, MahalaksmI,, Brahma, Sripurusottama, Markandeycsa, Kautlsa, Angircsa; Pitamaha, Janardana, Mangala, the excellent Pundarlkaksa etc. (these are the various shrines and deities in Gaya). When the Raksasa Heti was killed Visnu went back to his city.
verses.hindi: ध्वजदानात्पापहानिर्यात्राकृदूब्रह्मलोकभाक् । श्राद्धपिण्डप्रदो यस्तु विष्णु नेष्यन्ति वें पितुन शिवो5पि परया प्रीत्या तुष्ठाव755दिगदाधरम् ४२
verses.wordMeaning: The primordial Gadadhara is stationed 2 as Gayatrl, Savitrl, Sandhya, Sarasvatl, Gayaditya, Uttararka, Daksinarka, Naimisa, Svetarka, Gananatha, the eight Vasus, the leading sages, the eleven Rudras, the Seven Sages, Soma- natha, Siddhesa, Kapardisa, Vinayaka, Narayana,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The primordial Gadadhara is stationed 2 as Gayatrl, Savitrl, Sandhya, Sarasvatl, Gayaditya, Uttararka, Daksinarka, Naimisa, Svetarka, Gananatha, the eight Vasus, the leading sages, the eleven Rudras, the Seven Sages, Soma- natha, Siddhesa, Kapardisa, Vinayaka, Narayana,…

verses.sanskrit: अमरेश्वरतीर्थं च तथा दारुवनं महत् । दारुकेश्वरतीर्थं च तीर्थं वै चरुकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: amareśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā dāruvanaṃ mahat / dārukeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ vai carukeśvaram
verses.translation: When the Asura was rendered motionless by Brahma in the company of Rudra and others, Vedhas (god Brahma) who was overjoyed eulogised Adyagadapani (the primordial wielder of the club) (as follows):
verses.hindi: अव्यक्तरुपों यो देवो मुण्डपृष्ठादिरूपतः । फल्गुतीर्थादिख्पेण नमाम्यादिगदाधरम्
verses.wordMeaning: When the Asura was rendered motionless by Brahma in the company of Rudra and others, Vedhas (god Brahma) who was overjoyed eulogised Adyagadapani (the primordial wielder of the club) (as follows):
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Asura was rendered motionless by Brahma in the company of Rudra and others, Vedhas (god Brahma) who was overjoyed eulogised Adyagadapani (the primordial wielder of the club) (as follows):

verses.sanskrit: चरुकासङ्गमस् तद्व्यद्वतीपातेश्वरं तथा । पातालेश्वरतीर्थं च कोटियज्ञाह्वयं तथा
verses.transliteration: carukāsaṅgamas tadvyadvatīpāteśvaraṃ tathā / pātāleśvaratīrthaṃ ca koṭiyajñāhvayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: I bow unto Gadadhara who is the bestower of boons, from whom Times (Death's) blemishes have receded, who is stationed in Gaya, whose attributes are well known, who poss¬ esses many attributes, who is present in the cavity (of the heart), who is in the white-coloured house of the excellent mountain and who is worshipped by all the Ganas (groups).
verses.hindi: अव्यक्तरुपो यो देवो जनादंनस्वरूपतः । मुण्डपृष्ठे स्वयं जातो नमास्थादिगदाधरम् ४४ शिलायां देवरूपिण्यां स्थितं ब्रह्मादिभिः सुरेः । पुजितं सत्कृतं देवस्तं नमामि गदाधरम् य॑ं च दृष्दूवा ततः पृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा प्रणम्य च। श्राद्धादों ब्रह्मलोकाप्तिनेमास्थादिगदाधरम्ू
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto Gadadhara who is the bestower of boons, from whom Times (Death's) blemishes have receded, who is stationed in Gaya, whose attributes are well known, who poss¬ esses many attributes, who is present in the cavity (of the heart),…
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto Gadadhara who is the bestower of boons, from whom Times (Death's) blemishes have receded, who is stationed in Gaya, whose attributes are well known, who poss¬ esses many attributes, who is present in the cavity (of the heart),…

verses.sanskrit: वरुणेश्वरतीर्थं च लिङ्गान्यष्टोत्तरं शतम् । सिद्धेश्वरं यमेशं च ब्रह्मेश्वरमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: varuṇeśvaratīrthaṃ ca liṅgānyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam / siddheśvaraṃ yameśaṃ ca brahmeśvaramataḥ param
verses.translation: I bow unto Gadadhara, who bestows prosperity on the day, who grants prosperity on the hosts of Devas, who grants royal glory even to Bhava (Siva), whose glory tears down Daityas, who bestows glory in the Kali age and whose glory
verses.hindi: सह॒दादेश्व जगतो व्यक्तस्थेकं हि कारणम् । अव्यक्तज्ञानरूपं तं नमास्यादिगदाधरम् ४ंद
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto Gadadhara, who bestows prosperity on the day, who grants prosperity on the hosts of Devas, who grants royal glory even to Bhava (Siva), whose glory tears down Daityas, who bestows glory in the Kali age and whose glory
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto Gadadhara, who bestows prosperity on the day, who grants prosperity on the hosts of Devas, who grants royal glory even to Bhava (Siva), whose glory tears down Daityas, who bestows glory in the Kali age and whose glory

verses.sanskrit: सारस्वतं चाष्टरुद्रं सावित्रं सोमसंज्ञितम् । शिवखातं महातीर्थं रुद्रावर्तं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sārasvataṃ cāṣṭarudraṃ sāvitraṃ somasaṃjñitam / śivakhātaṃ mahātīrthaṃ rudrāvartaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The various Padas (footprints) of gods and sages at which Pivd 33 are to be offered are the manifest-cum-unmanifest forms of Adigadadhara. The idols are the manifest forms, unmanifest in Phalgu (TSS 365).
verses.hindi: करेगा बह अह्यालोक का अधिकारी होगा । जो श्राद्ध एवं पिडदान करेगा वह अपने पितरों को विष्णुलोक में पहुँचाएगा ।४०-४१। जो व्यक्ति ऊपर के स्तोत्र द्वारा स्तुतिकर आदि गदाघर को श्रद्धापृवंक प्रणाम करेगा, पूजन करेगा, वह अपने पितरों को माधव के समीप पहुँचायेगा । छ्लिव ने भी परम भक्तिबंक आदि गदाधर कौ स्तुति की थी ।४२॥। शिव ने कहा-जो अव्यक्त स्वरूपघारण कर मुण्डपृष्ठपवंत एवं फल्युतोर्थ प्रभूति अन्याध्य
verses.wordMeaning: The various Padas (footprints) of gods and sages at which Pivd 33 are to be offered are the manifest-cum-unmanifest forms of Adigadadhara. The idols are the manifest forms, unmanifest in Phalgu (TSS 365).
verses.commentary: Sense: The various Padas (footprints) of gods and sages at which Pivd 33 are to be offered are the manifest-cum-unmanifest forms of Adigadadhara. The idols are the manifest forms, unmanifest in Phalgu (TSS 365).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मावर्तं परं तीर्थं सूर्यावर्तमतः परम् । पिप्पलावर्ततीर्थं च पिप्पल्याश्चैव सङ्गमः
verses.transliteration: brahmāvartaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ sūryāvartamataḥ param / pippalāvartatīrthaṃ ca pippalyāścaiva saṅgamaḥ
verses.translation: These are various deities and shrines at Gaya. The presence of Gadadhara is thus claimed everywhere in Gaya.
verses.hindi: तीर्थों के स्वरूप में विराजमान है, उस परमदेव आदि गदाघर को हम नभस्कार करते हैं। जो व्यक्ताव्यक्त स्वरूप घारणकर पद, मुखादि चिह्नों के रूप में विराजमान है, उस आदि गदाधरदेव को हम नमस्कार करते हैं । जो भअव्यक्त स्वरूप धारण करनेवाला देव मुण्डपृष्ठ पर जनादंन का स्वरूप धारणकर विराजमान है, उस आदि गदाधर देव को हम नमस्कार करते हैं ।४३-४५। जो देवस्वरूपिणी शिला पर ब्रह्मा प्रभृति देवगणों
verses.wordMeaning: These are various deities and shrines at Gaya. The presence of Gadadhara is thus claimed everywhere in Gaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are various deities and shrines at Gaya. The presence of Gadadhara is thus claimed everywhere in Gaya.

verses.sanskrit: अमरकण्टमाहात्म्यं कपिलासङ्गमस् तथा । विशल्यासम्भवश्चापि भृगुतुङ्गाद्रिकीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: amarakaṇṭamāhātmyaṃ kapilāsaṅgamas tathā / viśalyāsambhavaścāpi bhṛgutuṅgādrikīrtanam
verses.translation: I bow unto him who is both steady and unsteady who
verses.hindi: द्वारा पूृजित एवं सत्कृत होकर अवस्थित है, उस गदाघर देव को हम नमस्कार करते हैं। श्राद्धादि में जिसका दर्शन, स्पर्श पूजन एवं प्रणाम करके प्राणी ब्रह्मलोक को प्राप्त करता है, उस आदि गदाधर देव को हम नमस्कार करते हैं। मह॒दादि व्यक्त जगत् का जो एकमात्र कारण स्वरूप है, अव्यक्त एवं ज्ञानस्वरूप हैं, उस आदि गदाधर देव को हम नमस्कार करते हैं ॥४६-४८। जो शरीर, इन्द्रिय, मन, बुद्धि, प्राण एवं अहद्भार से » नाय॑ इलोकः ख. पुस्तके । “इतः प्रभृति जातो नमाम्यादिग्रदाधरमित्यन्त ग्रन्थव्यत्यासः ख. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto him who is both steady and unsteady who
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto him who is both steady and unsteady who

verses.sanskrit: विशल्यासङ्गमः पुण्यः करमर्दासमागमः । करमर्देश्वरं तीर्थं चक्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: viśalyāsaṅgamaḥ puṇyaḥ karamardāsamāgamaḥ / karamardeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam
verses.translation: I perpetually bow to the supreme eternal Lord Hari, w-ho is incorporeal, who has no sense organs, who has no birth, who is decorated on Suryavedi 1 (altar of the Sun), to Gadadhara who is devoid of sound and face.
verses.hindi: १११० वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: I perpetually bow to the supreme eternal Lord Hari, w-ho is incorporeal, who has no sense organs, who has no birth, who is decorated on Suryavedi 1 (altar of the Sun), to Gadadhara who is devoid of sound and face.
verses.commentary: Sense: I perpetually bow to the supreme eternal Lord Hari, w-ho is incorporeal, who has no sense organs, who has no birth, who is decorated on Suryavedi 1 (altar of the Sun), to Gadadhara who is devoid of sound and face.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गमो नीलगङ्गायाः विध्वंसस्त्रिपुरस्य च । कीर्तनं तीर्थदानानां मधुकतृतीयाव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: saṅgamo nīlagaṅgāyāḥ vidhvaṃsastripurasya ca / kīrtanaṃ tīrthadānānāṃ madhukatṛtīyāvratam
verses.translation: I bow unto Gadadhara who is present in the heart, who is faster than the mind, who is beyond the reach of the mind, who is always without a second, who is eulogised by learned men in the Vedantas, who is Cidatmaka (pure consciousness) and who is beyond the causes present in Kali.
verses.hindi: देहेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिप्राणाहंकारवर्जितम् । जाग्रत्स्वप्तविनिमु क्त नमास्थादिगदाधरम् ४६ नित्यानित्यविनिर्मुक्तं सत्यमानन्दमव्ययम् । तुरीयं ज्योतिरात्मानं नमास्यादिगदाधरम् एवं स्तुतो महेशेन प्रीतो ह्यादिगदाधर:ः । स्थितो देवः शिलायां स ब्रह्माद्रर्देवतें: सह .
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto Gadadhara who is present in the heart, who is faster than the mind, who is beyond the reach of the mind, who is always without a second, who is eulogised by learned men in the Vedantas, who is Cidatmaka (pure consciousness) and who is beyond the causes present in Kali.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto Gadadhara who is present in the heart, who is faster than the mind, who is beyond the reach of the mind, who is always without a second, who is eulogised by learned men in the Vedantas, who is Cidatmaka (pure consciousness) and who is beyond the causes present in Kali.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरेश्वरतीर्थं च देहक्षेपे विधिस्ततः । तीर्थं ज्वालेश्वरं नाम ज्वालायाः सङ्गमस्तथा
verses.transliteration: apsareśvaratīrthaṃ ca dehakṣepe vidhistataḥ / tīrthaṃ jvāleśvaraṃ nāma jvālāyāḥ saṅgamastathā
verses.translation: The primordial wielder of the club, on being eulogised thus by Brahma along with Devas said, "You choose the boon 5 ' and Brahma spoke to him:
verses.hindi: संस्थितं मुण्डपृष्ठादो देवमादिगदाधरम् । स्तुवन्ति पुजयन्तीह ब्रह्मलोक प्रयान्तु ते
verses.wordMeaning: The primordial wielder of the club, on being eulogised thus by Brahma along with Devas said, "You choose the boon 5 ' and Brahma spoke to him:
verses.commentary: Sense: The primordial wielder of the club, on being eulogised thus by Brahma along with Devas said, "You choose the boon 5 ' and Brahma spoke to him:

verses.sanskrit: शक्रतीर्थं कुशावर्तं हंसतीर्थं तथैव च । अम्बरीषस्य तीर्थं च महाकालेश्वरं तथा
verses.transliteration: śakratīrthaṃ kuśāvartaṃ haṃsatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca / ambarīṣasya tīrthaṃ ca mahākāleśvaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: €< We will not stay on the rock of divine nature and features without you. We will stay here for ever along with you who have the manifest form. 55
verses.hindi: धर्मार्थी प्राप्तुयाद्धर्म मर्थार्थोी चार्यमाप्नुयात् । फामानवाप्नुयात्कामी मोक्षार्थों मोक्षमाप्तुयात् +बन्ध्या च लभते पुत्र वेदवेदाज्रपारगम् । राजा विजयमाप्नोति शुद्र॒श्व सुखमाप्नुयात् ३५४
verses.wordMeaning: €< We will not stay on the rock of divine nature and features without you. We will stay here for ever along with you who have the manifest form. 55
verses.commentary: Sense: €< We will not stay on the rock of divine nature and features without you. We will stay here for ever along with you who have the manifest form. 55

verses.sanskrit: मातृकेश्वरतीर्थं च भृगुतुङ्गानुवर्णनम् । तत्र भैरवमाहात्म्यं चपलेश्वरकीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: mātṛkeśvaratīrthaṃ ca bhṛgutuṅgānuvarṇanam / tatra bhairavamāhātmyaṃ capaleśvarakīrtanam
verses.translation: "So be it", said Gadadhara and stayed there along with Sri for the protection of the worlds and for the salvation of the people. The manifest form Pundarxkaksa (Visnu) is well known as Janardana.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते गयामाहात्म्यं नाम नवाधिकशततमोअध्यायः ।॥१०४॥।
verses.wordMeaning: "So be it", said Gadadhara and stayed there along with Sri for the protection of the worlds and for the salvation of the people. The manifest form Pundarxkaksa (Visnu) is well known as Janardana.
verses.commentary: Sense: "So be it", said Gadadhara and stayed there along with Sri for the protection of the worlds and for the salvation of the people. The manifest form Pundarxkaksa (Visnu) is well known as Janardana.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डपाणेश्च माहात्म्यं कावेरीसङ्गमस्तथा । कुबेरेश्वरतीर्थं च वाराहीसङ्गमस् तथा
verses.transliteration: caṇḍapāṇeśca māhātmyaṃ kāverīsaṅgamastathā / kubereśvaratīrthaṃ ca vārāhīsaṅgamas tathā
verses.translation: The primordial and eternal form that is incomprehen¬ sible even to the Vedas, is very clear and manifest in the Sveta- kalpa, will become unmanifest in the Varahakalpa although it had become manifest before.
verses.hindi: विवर्जित, एवं जागरण, तथा स्वप्न से विहीन है उस आदि गदाधर देव को हम नमस्कार करते हैं। जो नित्य एवं अनित्य के पचड़ों से रहित है, सत्स्वरूप आनन्दस्वरूप एवं अव्यय है, तुरीय आत्मा एवं ज्योति कहा जाता है उस आदि गदाधर को हम नमस्कार करते हैं सनत्कुमार बोले--नारद जी ! महेश्वर द्वारा इस प्रकार स्तुति किये जाने के उपरान्त भगवान् आदि गदाघर ब्रह्मा प्रभृति देवगर्णों के साथ उस शिला के ऊपर स्थित हुए। मृण्डपृष्ठ गिरि पर अवस्थित आदि गदाधर देव की जो लोग स्तुति एबं पूजा करते हैं, वे ब्रह्मलोक को प्राप्त करते हैं ।११-५२। धर्म का अभिलाषी धर्म प्राप्त करता है। अर्थ का अभिलाषी अथ प्राप्त करता है, काम का अभिलाषी काम प्राप्त करता
verses.wordMeaning: The primordial and eternal form that is incomprehen¬ sible even to the Vedas, is very clear and manifest in the Sveta- kalpa, will become unmanifest in the Varahakalpa although it had become manifest before.
verses.commentary: Sense: The primordial and eternal form that is incomprehen¬ sible even to the Vedas, is very clear and manifest in the Sveta- kalpa, will become unmanifest in the Varahakalpa although it had become manifest before.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गमश्चण्डवेगायास्तीर्थं चण्डेश्वरं तथा । एरण्डीसङ्गमः पुण्य एरण्डेश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: saṅgamaścaṇḍavegāyāstīrthaṃ caṇḍeśvaraṃ tathā / eraṇḍīsaṅgamaḥ puṇya eraṇḍeśvaramuttamam
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that he will be clearly manifest in Gayasiras for the emancipation of the worlds and the pro¬ tection of the Devas.
verses.hindi: है, मोक्ष का अभिलाषी मोक्ष की प्राष्ति करता है, वन्ध्या वेद वेदाज़भपारगामी पुत्र प्राप्त करती है. राजा विजय की प्राप्त करता है, शृद्र सुख की प्राप्ति करता है। आदि गदाधर की विधिवत् पूजा कर पुत्र को चाहने वाला अनेक पुत्र प्राप्त करता है। भगवान् विष्ण की पूजा आदि से मनुष्य अपने सभी मानसिक अभिलाषाओं को प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that he will be clearly manifest in Gayasiras for the emancipation of the worlds and the pro¬ tection of the Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that he will be clearly manifest in Gayasiras for the emancipation of the worlds and the pro¬ tection of the Devas.

verses.sanskrit: पितृतीर्थं च तत्रैव ओङ्कारस्य च सम्भवम् । माहात्म्यं पञ्चलिङ्गानाम् ओङ्कारस्य मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: pitṛtīrthaṃ ca tatraiva oṅkārasya ca sambhavam / māhātmyaṃ pañcaliṅgānām oṅkārasya munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Refers to the sacred cluster of the Surya temple—Vidyarthi
verses.hindi: श्री वायु महापुराण में गयामाहात्म्य नामक एक सौ नर्वाँ अध्याय समाप्त ॥!०६।। -+न विद्यतेई्यं इलोकः ख. पुस्तके । गृहाज्चलितमात्रेण गयायां गमन प्रति । स्वर्गा रोहणसोपानं पित्॒णां च पदे पदे
verses.wordMeaning: Refers to the sacred cluster of the Surya temple—Vidyarthi
verses.commentary: Sense: Refers to the sacred cluster of the Surya temple—Vidyarthi

verses.sanskrit: कोटितीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं तीर्थं काकह्रदं तथा । जम्बुकेश्वरतीर्थं च सारस्वतम् अतः परम्
verses.transliteration: koṭitīrthasya māhātmyaṃ tīrthaṃ kākahradaṃ tathā / jambukeśvaratīrthaṃ ca sārasvatam ataḥ param
verses.translation: Those who regularly and devoutly visit lord Adigada¬ dhara will attain wealth, foodgrain, longevity and good health.
verses.hindi: गयायात्रां प्रवक््यासि शुणु नारद मुक्तिदाम्। निष्कृतिः श्राद्धकत णां ब्रह्मणा गोयते पुरा १
verses.wordMeaning: Those who regularly and devoutly visit lord Adigada¬ dhara will attain wealth, foodgrain, longevity and good health.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who regularly and devoutly visit lord Adigada¬ dhara will attain wealth, foodgrain, longevity and good health.

verses.sanskrit: कपिलासङ्गमस्तद्वत्तीर्थं च कपिलेश्वरम् । दैत्यसूदनतीर्थं च चक्रतीर्थं च वामनम्
verses.transliteration: kapilāsaṅgamastadvattīrthaṃ ca kapileśvaram / daityasūdanatīrthaṃ ca cakratīrthaṃ ca vāmanam
verses.translation: Men who bow unto Adigadadhara with great devotion and faith achieve good qualities, fame and happiness, wives, sons and grandsons. They attain Brahmapura. They will enjoy the fruits of a heap of meritorious action.
verses.hindi: उद्यतश्रेद्गयां गन्तुं श्राद्ध कृत्वा विधानतः  विधाय कापंटीवेषं कृत्वा ग्रामप्रदक्षिणमू प्रतिग्रहादुपावत्तः संतुष्टो नियतः शुचिः । अहंकारविमुक्तो यः स तीर्थेंफलमश्नुते + ४
verses.wordMeaning: Men who bow unto Adigadadhara with great devotion and faith achieve good qualities, fame and happiness, wives, sons and grandsons. They attain Brahmapura. They will enjoy the fruits of a heap of meritorious action.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who bow unto Adigadadhara with great devotion and faith achieve good qualities, fame and happiness, wives, sons and grandsons. They attain Brahmapura. They will enjoy the fruits of a heap of meritorious action.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थलक्षं विदुः पूर्वे कपिलायास्तु सङ्गमे । स्वर्गस्य नरकस्यापि लक्षणं मुनिभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthalakṣaṃ viduḥ pūrve kapilāyāstu saṅgame / svargasya narakasyāpi lakṣaṇaṃ munibhāṣitam
verses.translation: By offering scents, one will be rich in fragrance; by offer¬ ing flowers, he attains good fortune; by offering sweet incense, he attains a kingdom and illumination through lamps.
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमार बोले :--नारद जी ! गया यात्रा की विधि बतला रहा हूँ, जो मृक्ति कौ देनेवाली है, सुनिये। प्राचीनकाल में ब्रह्मा जी ने यह बतलाया था कि गया में श्राद्ध करनेवालों का इस भवबन्धन से निस्तार हो जाता है। विधिपूर्वक श्राद्धकर्म सम्पन्न कर जो ब्यक्ति गया यात्रा के लिए उद्यत हो, उसे चाहिए कि सबंप्रथम श्रा्धकर कौपीन धारणकर अपने ग्राम की प्रदक्षिणा करे, फिर दूसरे ग्राम में जाकर
verses.wordMeaning: By offering scents, one will be rich in fragrance; by offer¬ ing flowers, he attains good fortune; by offering sweet incense, he attains a kingdom and illumination through lamps.
verses.commentary: Sense: By offering scents, one will be rich in fragrance; by offer¬ ing flowers, he attains good fortune; by offering sweet incense, he attains a kingdom and illumination through lamps.

verses.sanskrit: व्यवस्थानं शरीरस्य गोप्रदानानुवर्णनम् । अशोकवनिकातीर्थं मतङ्गाश्रमवर्णनम्
verses.transliteration: vyavasthānaṃ śarīrasya gopradānānuvarṇanam / aśokavanikātīrthaṃ mataṅgāśramavarṇanam
verses.translation: By gifting flags, he becomes free from sins; by under¬ taking pilgrimage, he attains Brahmaloka. He who performs a Sraddha and offers Pindas, leads his Pitj-s to Visnu.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध से शेष अन्न का भक्षण करे, फिर दानादि न लेते हुए प्रतिदिन यात्रा करे। प्रतिग्रह से बचते हुए, सन्तुष्ट चित्त, इन्द्रियों को बस में कर पवित्र मन एवं शरीर से अहंकारादि को छोड़कर जो गया की यात्रा करता है वह तीथ का वास्तविक फल प्राप्त करता है ।१-४॥ जिसके हाथ, पैर एवं मन संयत रहते हैं, विद्या, तप एवं कीति की बहुलता रहती' है, वह वास्तविक तीथे फल का उपभोग करता है। गया क्षेत्र में प्रविष्ट होने पर पूर्व दिशा से महा नदी पड़ती है, उसमें जल हिलोर कर निर्मल जल में स्नान करना चाहिए। फिर
verses.wordMeaning: By gifting flags, he becomes free from sins; by under¬ taking pilgrimage, he attains Brahmaloka. He who performs a Sraddha and offers Pindas, leads his Pitj-s to Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: By gifting flags, he becomes free from sins; by under¬ taking pilgrimage, he attains Brahmaloka. He who performs a Sraddha and offers Pindas, leads his Pitj-s to Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: अशोकेश्वरतीर्थं च मतङ्गेश्वरमुत्तमम् । तथा मृगवनं पुण्यं तत्र तीर्थं मनोरथम्
verses.transliteration: aśokeśvaratīrthaṃ ca mataṅgeśvaramuttamam / tathā mṛgavanaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ manoratham
verses.translation: Those who bow to Adigadadhara with great faith and eulogise him and worship him, lead their Pitrs to Madhava, Even Siva eulogised Adigadadhara with great pleasure.
verses.hindi: “ इत उत्तरमधिका: श्लोका मुद्वितपुस्तकटिपण्यामुपलभ्यन्ते ते च यथा---
verses.wordMeaning: Those who bow to Adigadadhara with great faith and eulogise him and worship him, lead their Pitrs to Madhava, Even Siva eulogised Adigadadhara with great pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who bow to Adigadadhara with great faith and eulogise him and worship him, lead their Pitrs to Madhava, Even Siva eulogised Adigadadhara with great pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गमो ऽङ्गारगर्ताया अङ्गारेश्वरमुत्तमम् । तथा मेघवनं तीर्थं देव्या नामानुकीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: saṅgamo 'ṅgāragartāyā aṅgāreśvaramuttamam / tathā meghavanaṃ tīrthaṃ devyā nāmānukīrtanam
verses.translation: I bow to Adigadadhara who though unmanifest, be¬ comes manifest in the form of Munqlaprstha etc. and the holy centre Phalgutlrtha etc.
verses.hindi: देवादीस्तपंयित्वाइथ श्राद्ध कृत्वा यथाविधि । +स्ववेदशाखागदितमर्ध्यावाहनवर्जितम् 0७ अपरे5ह्नि शुचिभूत्वा गच्छेद्दे प्रतपवते । ब्रह्मकुण्ड ततः स्नात्वा देवादोंस्तर्पयेत्सुधीः ८ कव्यवाहो5नलः सोमो यमश्रेवायंमा तथा । अग्निष्वात्ता बहिषदः सोमपाः पितृदेवताः १०
verses.wordMeaning: I bow to Adigadadhara who though unmanifest, be¬ comes manifest in the form of Munqlaprstha etc. and the holy centre Phalgutlrtha etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow to Adigadadhara who though unmanifest, be¬ comes manifest in the form of Munqlaprstha etc. and the holy centre Phalgutlrtha etc.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गमश्चापि कुब्जायास्तीर्थं कुब्जेश्वरं तथा । बिल्वाम्रकं तथा तीर्थं पूर्णद्वीपमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: saṅgamaścāpi kubjāyāstīrthaṃ kubjeśvaraṃ tathā / bilvāmrakaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ pūrṇadvīpamataḥ param
verses.translation: I bow down to Adigadadhara whc is both manifest and unmanifest in the forms of Padas and Mukhalingas etc.
verses.hindi: आगच्छन्तु महाभागा युष्माभी रक्षितास्त्विह। मदीयाः पितरो ये च कुले जाता; सनाभयः
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Adigadadhara whc is both manifest and unmanifest in the forms of Padas and Mukhalingas etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Adigadadhara whc is both manifest and unmanifest in the forms of Padas and Mukhalingas etc.

verses.sanskrit: तथा हिरण्यगर्भायाः सङ्गमः पुण्यकीर्तनः । द्वीपेश्वरं नाम तीर्थं पुण्यं यज्ञेश्वरं तथा
verses.transliteration: tathā hiraṇyagarbhāyāḥ saṅgamaḥ puṇyakīrtanaḥ / dvīpeśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ yajñeśvaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is born naturally on Mundaprstha and who is of unmanifest nature in the form of Janardana.
verses.hindi: आचसम्योकत्वा च पच्चाज्ुं प्राणायाम प्रयत्वनतः । पुनरावृत्तिरहितब्रह्मलोकाप्तिहेतवे 0१३ एवं च विधिवच्छाद्ध छृत्वा पुर्व यथाक्रमस् । पित॒नावाह्म चाभ्यच्ये मन्त्र: पिण्डप्रदों भवेतू. तेम॑स्त्ररथ संपुज्य पस्चगव्यश्र देवताम्
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is born naturally on Mundaprstha and who is of unmanifest nature in the form of Janardana.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is born naturally on Mundaprstha and who is of unmanifest nature in the form of Janardana.

verses.sanskrit: माण्डव्याश्रमतीर्थं च विशोकासङ्गमस्तथा । वागीश्वरं नाम तीर्थं पुण्यो वै वागुसङ्गमः
verses.transliteration: māṇḍavyāśramatīrthaṃ ca viśokāsaṅgamastathā / vāgīśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ puṇyo vai vāgusaṅgamaḥ
verses.translation: I bow down to Gadadhara who is stationed in the Sila of divine features, who is worshipped by Brahma and other Suras and who is honoured by Devas.
verses.hindi: बिधिपूवंक देवादिकों का दर्पण एवं श्राद्ध कर अपनी कुल परम्परा में प्रचलित वेदशास्ताका उच्चारण करना चाहिए । इसक्राद्धकर्मं को अध्यं एवं आवाहन के बिना ही सम्पन्न करना चाहिए १-७। फिर दुसरे दिन पवित्र होकर प्रेतपंतकी यात्रा करनी चाहिए, फिर ब्रह्म कुण्ड में स्नानकर बुद्धिमान् पुरुष को देवादिकों का तपंण करना चाहिए। प्रेतपवंत पर संयत मन हो सपिंडों का श्राद्धकर्म सम्पन्न करना चाहिए। इस कर्म में बुद्धिमान्
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Gadadhara who is stationed in the Sila of divine features, who is worshipped by Brahma and other Suras and who is honoured by Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Gadadhara who is stationed in the Sila of divine features, who is worshipped by Brahma and other Suras and who is honoured by Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रावर्तकं तत्र तीर्थं सौगन्धिकं तथा । सङ्गमश्च सरस्वत्या ईशानं तीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sahasrāvartakaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ saugandhikaṃ tathā / saṅgamaśca sarasvatyā īśānaṃ tīrthamuttamam
verses.translation: I bow down to Adigadadhara on seeing, touching, wor¬ shipping and bowing down to whom people attain Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: पुरुष प्राचीना १ बीती और दक्षिणाभिमुखः होना चाहिए ।८५-९। 'कब्यवाह, अग्नि, चन्द्रमा, यम, अथंमा, झग्निष्वात्त, बहिंषद और सोमपान करनेवाले पितृदेवगण ! महाभाग्यशालियो ! आप लोग यहाँ पधारें । इस तीर्थ में आप लागों की कृपा से सुरक्षित जो हमारे पितरगण तथा हमारे कुल में उत्पन्न होनेवाले अन्यान्य पितरगण हैं, उन्हीं को पिंडदान करने के लिए मैं गयापुरी में आया हूं । हमारे इस श्राद्धकर्म से वे चिरल्तन तृप्ति लाभ करें ।१०-१२। ऐसी प्रार्थना करने के उपरान्त आचमन करके प्रमत्नपृर्वक पाँचों अज्ञों समेत प्राणायाम करके, पुनरागमन से बिरहित ब्रह्मलोक की प्राप्ति के लिए विधिपुरवंक क्रमानुसार श्राद्ध कर्म सम्पन्न करना चाहिए। उस समय पितरों का आवाहनकर उनकी विधिपूर्वेक पूजा और मन्‍्त्रों का उच्चारण कर पिंडदान करना चाहिए। प्रेत शिला आदि तीथथे स्थानों में घृत समेत चरु से पिडदान करना चाहिए। पश्चगब्यों द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Adigadadhara on seeing, touching, wor¬ shipping and bowing down to whom people attain Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Adigadadhara on seeing, touching, wor¬ shipping and bowing down to whom people attain Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: देवतात्रयतीर्थं च शूलखातं ततः परम् । ब्रह्मोदं शाङ्करं सौम्यं सारस्वतमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: devatātrayatīrthaṃ ca śūlakhātaṃ tataḥ param / brahmodaṃ śāṅkaraṃ saumyaṃ sārasvatamataḥ param
verses.translation: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is the sole cause of Mahat etc. that is manifest and who is of the unmanifest form.
verses.hindi: उनके मस्त्रों से भलो प्रकार उस स्थान को पविन्नकर मन्त्रों द्वारा देवताओं का पुजन करना चाहिए ।१३-१ 8!
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is the sole cause of Mahat etc. that is manifest and who is of the unmanifest form.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is the sole cause of Mahat etc. that is manifest and who is of the unmanifest form.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रयज्ञतीर्थं च कपालमोचनं तथा । आग्नेयम् अदितीशं च वाराहं तीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sahasrayajñatīrthaṃ ca kapālamocanaṃ tathā / āgneyam aditīśaṃ ca vārāhaṃ tīrthamuttamam
verses.translation: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is devoid of physical body, sense organs, mind, intellect, vital airs and ego and who is free from wakeful and dreaming states.
verses.hindi: “ नास्त्यर्घमिदं सर. पुस्तके । १. यज्ञोपवीत को दाहिने कंधे पर रखकर बाएँ हाथ को बाहर निकालने की विधि । पित॒कर्मों में इसका प्राय) प्रयोग होता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is devoid of physical body, sense organs, mind, intellect, vital airs and ego and who is free from wakeful and dreaming states.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is devoid of physical body, sense organs, mind, intellect, vital airs and ego and who is free from wakeful and dreaming states.

verses.sanskrit: तथा देवपथं तीर्थं तीर्थं यज्ञसहस्रकम् । शुक्लतीर्थं दीप्तिकेशं विष्णुतीर्थं च योधनम्
verses.transliteration: tathā devapathaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ yajñasahasrakam / śuklatīrthaṃ dīptikeśaṃ viṣṇutīrthaṃ ca yodhanam
verses.translation: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is free from the eter¬ nal and the non-eternal (state), who is truth, bliss and the un¬ changing state, the fourth one, the luminous Atman.
verses.hindi: अष्दकासु च व॒द्धों च गयायां च भुते5हनि । मातुः भाऊं पृथवकुर्यादन्‍्यत्र + पतिना सह
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is free from the eter¬ nal and the non-eternal (state), who is truth, bliss and the un¬ changing state, the fourth one, the luminous Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Adigadadhara who is free from the eter¬ nal and the non-eternal (state), who is truth, bliss and the un¬ changing state, the fourth one, the luminous Atman.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदेश्वरतीर्थं च वरुणेशं च मारुतम् । योगेशं रोहिणीतीर्थं दारुतीर्थं च सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: narmadeśvaratīrthaṃ ca varuṇeśaṃ ca mārutam / yogeśaṃ rohiṇītīrthaṃ dārutīrthaṃ ca sattamāḥ
verses.translation: Eulogised thus by Mahesa, Adigadadhara became delighted. That lord stationed himself on the slab along with Brahma and other Devas.
verses.hindi: पित॒कर्मों में मनुष्य जितने तिलों को ग्रहण करते हैं, उतने असुरगण सिंह से भयभीत मृग़ों की भाँति वहाँ से दूर चले जाते हैं ।१६। सभी अष्टकाओं में, बृद्धि-श्राद्ध में, गया तीथ्थ में तथा मृत्यु के दिन माता का श्राद्ध अलम से करना चाहिए, अच्यत्र पति (पिता) के साथ ही करना चाहिए । वृद्धि श्राद्ध में सब प्रथम माता का श्राद्ध करके गया में पिता के श्राद्ध को पहले करना चाहिए। दक्षिणाभिमुख होकर क्रमशः कुशों को बिछाकर पिता भादि के लिए पाद्यादि नित्रेदन करना चाहिए । शेष विधान अपने-अपने गृह्य सूत्रों के अनुसार करना चाहिए ।१७-१८। विधिवत् कुशों को बिछाकर एक बार तिल समेत जल दान करने के उपरान्त दक्षिण दिल्ला से प्रारम्भ कर सपिण्डों को श्राद्ध प्रदान करना चाहिए। अंजलि में पितृतो्थों का जल लेकर यत्न पूर्वक उन्हें जल दान करना चाहिए। एक मुट्ठी सत्तू लेकर अक्षेय पिण्ड दान करना चाहिए । अन्य
verses.wordMeaning: Eulogised thus by Mahesa, Adigadadhara became delighted. That lord stationed himself on the slab along with Brahma and other Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eulogised thus by Mahesa, Adigadadhara became delighted. That lord stationed himself on the slab along with Brahma and other Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मावर्तं च पत्त्रेशं वाह्नं सौरं च कीर्त्यते । मेघनादं दारुतीर्थं देवतीर्थं गुहाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: brahmāvartaṃ ca pattreśaṃ vāhnaṃ sauraṃ ca kīrtyate / meghanādaṃ dārutīrthaṃ devatīrthaṃ guhāśrayam
verses.translation: Those who eulogise and worship Lord Adigadadhara who is stationed on the mountain Mun<Japrstha shall attain Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: सम्बन्धियों को भी आवाहन करके तिल मिश्रित जल का दान कुशों पर करना चाहिए ।१९-२०। “ब्रह्मा से
verses.wordMeaning: Those who eulogise and worship Lord Adigadadhara who is stationed on the mountain Mun<Japrstha shall attain Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who eulogise and worship Lord Adigadadhara who is stationed on the mountain Mun<Japrstha shall attain Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदेश्वरसंज्ञं तत्कपिलातीर्थमुत्तमम् । करञ्जेशं कुण्डलेशं पिप्पलादमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: narmadeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tatkapilātīrthamuttamam / karañjeśaṃ kuṇḍaleśaṃ pippalādamataḥ param
verses.translation: He who seeks piety shall attain piety; he who seeks love shall secure love and he who seeks salvation shall get salvation.
verses.hindi: आपषंश्राय प्रयोग: । +-क पुस्तकठिप्पण्यामेतेडधिका: श्लोका एतदग्रे दृश्यन्ते ते च॑ यथा-- पायसेनापि चरुणा सक्तुना पिष्टकेन च  गुडेन तण्डुलाद्र्वा पिण्डदान विधीयते उद्धरेत्सप्त गोत्राणि कुलमेकोत्तरं शतम  माता पिता च भार्या च भगिनी दुहितुः पति: । ३॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who seeks piety shall attain piety; he who seeks love shall secure love and he who seeks salvation shall get salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who seeks piety shall attain piety; he who seeks love shall secure love and he who seeks salvation shall get salvation.

verses.sanskrit: विमलेश्वरतीर्थं च पुष्करिण्याश्च सङ्गमः । प्रशंसा शूलभेदस्य तत्रैवान्धकविक्रमः
verses.transliteration: vimaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca puṣkariṇyāśca saṅgamaḥ / praśaṃsā śūlabhedasya tatraivāndhakavikramaḥ
verses.translation: Even a barren lady gets a son who will be a master of Vedas and their Angas (ancillaries). A king attains victory; a Sudra too shall attain happiness.
verses.hindi: पितृष्वसा मातृष्वसा सप्त गोत्राः प्रकीतिता:  विशतिविद्यतिः पिन्नोरष्टेन्द्रा: घोडश क्रमातू
verses.wordMeaning: Even a barren lady gets a son who will be a master of Vedas and their Angas (ancillaries). A king attains victory; a Sudra too shall attain happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a barren lady gets a son who will be a master of Vedas and their Angas (ancillaries). A king attains victory; a Sudra too shall attain happiness.

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्वासनदानं च तथैवान्धकनिग्रहः । शूलभेदस्य चोत्पत्तिस्तथा पात्रपरीक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: devāśvāsanadānaṃ ca tathaivāndhakanigrahaḥ / śūlabhedasya cotpattistathā pātraparīkṣaṇam
verses.translation: o Narada, listen. I shall recount the (procedure of) pilgrimage to Gaya which yields salvation. Redemption for those who perform Sraddha has been sung by Brahma earlier.
verses.hindi: एकादश द्वादश्ाथ कुलान्येकोत्तरं शतम् । पिता पितामहइ्चेब तथैब प्रपितामहः माता पितामही चेव तथंव प्रपितामही । मातामहस्तत्पिता च प्रमातामहकादयः ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: o Narada, listen. I shall recount the (procedure of) pilgrimage to Gaya which yields salvation. Redemption for those who perform Sraddha has been sung by Brahma earlier.
verses.commentary: Sense: o Narada, listen. I shall recount the (procedure of) pilgrimage to Gaya which yields salvation. Redemption for those who perform Sraddha has been sung by Brahma earlier.

verses.sanskrit: प्रशंसा दानधर्मस्य ऋषिशृङ्गानुभावनम् । स्वर्गतिं दीर्घतपसो भानुमत्यास्तथेङ्गितम्
verses.transliteration: praśaṃsā dānadharmasya ṛṣiśṛṅgānubhāvanam / svargatiṃ dīrghatapaso bhānumatyāstatheṅgitam
verses.translation: If one makes preparations for going to Gaya, 1 one should duly perform Sraddha and circumambulate the vil¬ lage, dressed only in loin cloth like a pilgrim. He shou t en go to the next village and partake of the remainder of the Srad-
verses.hindi: इत उत्तरमेतदर्ध ख. पुस्तके  तद्यथा--तिला ज्यम्रधुदध्यादि पिण्डद्रब्येषु योजयेत ।
verses.wordMeaning: If one makes preparations for going to Gaya, 1 one should duly perform Sraddha and circumambulate the vil¬ lage, dressed only in loin cloth like a pilgrim. He shou t en go to the next village and partake of the remainder of the Srad-
verses.commentary: Sense: If one makes preparations for going to Gaya, 1 one should duly perform Sraddha and circumambulate the vil¬ lage, dressed only in loin cloth like a pilgrim. He shou t en go to the next village and partake of the remainder of the Srad-

verses.sanskrit: शबरस्वर्गगमनं माहात्म्यं शूलभेदजम् । कपिलेश्वरतीर्थं च मोक्षतीर्थमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: śabarasvargagamanaṃ māhātmyaṃ śūlabhedajam / kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca mokṣatīrthamataḥ param
verses.translation: Verses 2-5 deal with preliminaries before starting onpilgrimage to Gaya.
verses.hindi: ( अब्रह्मस्तम्बपयन्तं देवषिपितृमानवा: । तृप्यन्तु पितरः सबवे मातृमातामहादय: )२१ अतीतकुलकोटीनां सप्तद्वीपनिवासिनाम् । आन्रह्मभुवनाल्‍लोकादिंदमस्तु तिलोदकम् मातामहस्तत्पिता च॒ प्रमातामहकादय: । तेषां पिण्डो मया दत्तो द्यक्षय्यमुपतिष्ठताम् (३२४
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 2-5 deal with preliminaries before starting onpilgrimage to Gaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 2-5 deal with preliminaries before starting onpilgrimage to Gaya.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गमो मोक्षनद्याश्च तीर्थं च विमलेश्वरम् । तथैवोलूकतीर्थं च पुष्करिण्याश्च सङ्गमः
verses.transliteration: saṅgamo mokṣanadyāśca tīrthaṃ ca vimaleśvaram / tathaivolūkatīrthaṃ ca puṣkariṇyāśca saṅgamaḥ
verses.translation: He whose hands and feet are controlled, the mind is restraiiied and who possesses learning, penance and fame, attains the fruit of the pilgrimage to the holy centre.
verses.hindi: पितुर्भातुः स्वभार्याया भगिन्या दुहितुस्तथा । पितृष्वसुर्मातृष्वसुः सप्त गोत्राः प्रकोतिता १२६ चतुविशतिविशश्न षोडश दहादशव हि। रुद्रादिवसवश्रव कुलान्येकोत्तरं शतम् १२७ ना5पवाहन न दिग्बन्धों न दोषों दृष्टिसंभवः । न कारुण्येन कतंव्यं तीर्थेक्राद्धं विचक्षण:..
verses.wordMeaning: He whose hands and feet are controlled, the mind is restraiiied and who possesses learning, penance and fame, attains the fruit of the pilgrimage to the holy centre.
verses.commentary: Sense: He whose hands and feet are controlled, the mind is restraiiied and who possesses learning, penance and fame, attains the fruit of the pilgrimage to the holy centre.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्येश्वरतीर्थं च तीर्थं वै सङ्गमेश्वरम् । सङ्गमो भीमकुल्यायास्तीर्थं भीमेश्वरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: ādityeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ vai saṅgameśvaram / saṅgamo bhīmakulyāyāstīrthaṃ bhīmeśvaraṃ śubham
verses.translation: After performing the Tarpana of Devas and others and after performing the Sraddha in accordance with the injunc¬ tions, one should recite the Vedic passage belonging to one's own branch but need not perform Arghyapradana (offering of Arghya) and Avahana (invocation).
verses.hindi: लेकर स्तम्ब तक जो भौ देव, ऋषि, पितर एवं मानव गण हैं, माता मातामह प्रभृति हमारे पितरण गण हैं, वे इस जल दान से संतुष्ट हों। सांतों द्वीपों में निवास करने वाले, करोड़ों से भी अधिक कुलों में उत्पन्न होने वाले ब्रह्द लोक से इस लोक तक सत्र विद्यमान उन्हीं लोगों की तृप्ति के लिए यह तिल मिश्रित जलाञ्जलि है ।२१-२२। पिता, पितामह, प्रपितामह, माता, मातामही, तथा प्रपितामही, मातामह तथा उनके पिता, प्रमातामह प्रभति-- जो भौ हमारे पूर्व पुरुष हैं, उन्हीं लोगों के लिए में यह पिण्डदान कर रहा हूँ, यह अक्षय रूप में उन्हें सन्तुष्ट करे।' अपनी मुट्ठी भर का अथवा हरे आँवले भर का अथवा शमी के पत्ते जितना बड़ा पिण्ड गयाशिर पर प्रदान करना चाहिए । ऐसे पिण्डों को जो व्यक्ति प्रदान करता है वह अपने सात गोत्रों एवं सौ कुल पुरुषों का उद्धार करता है ।२३०२५। पिता, माता, अपनी स्त्री, बहिन, पुत्री, फूआ और
verses.wordMeaning: After performing the Tarpana of Devas and others and after performing the Sraddha in accordance with the injunc¬ tions, one should recite the Vedic passage belonging to one's own branch but need not perform Arghyapradana (offering of Arghya) and Avahana (invocation).
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Tarpana of Devas and others and after performing the Sraddha in accordance with the injunc¬ tions, one should recite the Vedic passage belonging to one's own branch but need not perform Arghyapradana (offering of Arghya) and Avahana (invocation).

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेश्वरतीर्थं च तथा वै पिप्पलेश्वरम् । करोटीश्वरतीर्थं च तीर्थमिन्द्रेश्वरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā vai pippaleśvaram / karoṭīśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthamindreśvaraṃ śubham
verses.translation: With all purity, he should perform the Sraddha for those who are Sapindas (haying the similar Pindas i.e. near kinsmen) on the Pretaparvata. The intelligent pilgrim should face the southern direction and wear the sacred thread as Pra- cinaviti (from the right shoulder across the chest and passed un¬ der the left arm.)
verses.hindi: मोसी--- ये सात गोत्र कहें जाते हैं। चौबीस, बीस, सोलह, बारह, ग्यारह, सात और आठ --- इतने पिण्ड दान क्रमशः करने चाहिए। इनके करने से एक सौ एक कुलों का उद्धार होता है । बुद्धिमान् पुरुषों को तीर्थ श्राद्ध में बावाहुन, परदा, शूद्रादिकों के देखने से उत्पन्त होने वाले दोष कोन मानना चाहिए, इसी प्रकार किसी प्रकार की कातरता अथवा करुणा भी न करनी चाहिए ।२६-२३०। तोथ श्राद्धों में मुख्यतया इन्हीं विधियों
verses.wordMeaning: With all purity, he should perform the Sraddha for those who are Sapindas (haying the similar Pindas i.e. near kinsmen) on the Pretaparvata.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With all purity, he should perform the Sraddha for those who are Sapindas (haying the similar Pindas i.e. near kinsmen) on the Pretaparvata.…

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्येशं कुमारेशं व्यासेश्वरमनुत्तमम् । वैद्यनाथं च केदारम् आनन्देश्वरसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: agastyeśaṃ kumāreśaṃ vyāseśvaramanuttamam / vaidyanāthaṃ ca kedāram ānandeśvarasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: "The fire with Kavyabala (?), Soma, Yama, Aryama, the Pitf-god, like Agnisvattas, the Barhisads and the Somapas may (please) come; you are the deities of the Pitrs. O blessed deities, my Pitrs are protected by you. Those kindred relations born in the family are to be offered the ball of rice. I
verses.hindi: का पालन होना चाहिए, पिण्ड का आसन, पिण्डदान, प्रत्यवनेजन दक्षिणा तथा अन्न सद्धूल्प । पिण्डदान के पूर्व ऐसा सद्भूल्प करना चाहिए कि अपने कुल में उन सभी मृतकों को, जिनकी कहीं भी गति नहीं हुई, इस कुशासन पर तिलमिश्रित जलदान के द्वारा में आवाहित कर रहा हूं, अपने नाता के कुल में मरे हुए उन सभी लोगों को
verses.wordMeaning: "The fire with Kavyabala (?), Soma, Yama, Aryama, the Pitf-god, like Agnisvattas, the Barhisads and the Somapas may (please) come; you are the deities of the Pitrs. O blessed deities, my Pitrs are protected by you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "The fire with Kavyabala (?), Soma, Yama, Aryama, the Pitf-god, like Agnisvattas, the Barhisads and the Somapas may (please) come; you are the deities of the Pitrs. O blessed deities, my Pitrs are protected by you.…

verses.sanskrit: मातृतीर्थं च मुण्डेशं चौरं कामेश्वरं तथा । सङ्गमश्चानुदुह्या वै तीर्थे भीमार्जुनाह्वये । तीर्थं धर्मेश्वरं नाम लुङ्केश्वरम् अतः परम्
verses.transliteration: mātṛtīrthaṃ ca muṇḍeśaṃ cauraṃ kāmeśvaraṃ tathā / saṅgamaścānuduhyā vai tīrthe bhīmārjunāhvaye / tīrthaṃ dharmeśvaraṃ nāma luṅkeśvaram ataḥ param
verses.translation: Verses6-7 deal with the 1st dayof the Yatra. Va.P.prescribcs only bath in Phalgu, Sraddha and recitation of one's Veda. TSS. ( ) prescribes visit to Pretasila and Sraddha on that very day after Sraddha at Phalgu.
verses.hindi: + इत आरम्य--आर्द्रामलकमात्रकमित्यस्त॑ प्रस्थव्यत्यास: ख. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Verses6-7 deal with the 1st dayof the Yatra. Va.P.prescribcs only bath in Phalgu, Sraddha and recitation of one's Veda. TSS. ( ) prescribes visit to Pretasila and Sraddha on that very day after Sraddha at Phalgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses6-7 deal with the 1st dayof the Yatra. Va.P.prescribcs only bath in Phalgu, Sraddha and recitation of one's Veda. TSS. ( ) prescribes visit to Pretasila and Sraddha on that very day after Sraddha at Phalgu.

verses.sanskrit: ततो धनदतीर्थं च जटेशं मङ्गलेश्वरम् । कपिलेश्वरतीर्थं च गोपारेश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tato dhanadatīrthaṃ ca jaṭeśaṃ maṅgaleśvaram / kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca gopāreśvaramuttamam
verses.translation: The rites on the 2nd day: Visit to Pretaparvata, bath in Brahma- kuytfa Sraddha, offering of Piitfas first to one's paternal anscetors ( w. 23-
verses.hindi: अस्मत्कूले मृता ये च गतियेंषां न विद्यते । तेषामुद्धरणार्थाय इस पिण्डं ददाम्यहम् बन्धुवर्ंकुले ये च गतियेंषां न विद्यते । तेषामुद्धरणार्थाय इस पिण्ड ददाम्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: The rites on the 2nd day: Visit to Pretaparvata, bath in Brahma- kuytfa Sraddha, offering of Piitfas first to one's paternal anscetors ( w. 23-
verses.commentary: Sense: The rites on the 2nd day: Visit to Pretaparvata, bath in Brahma- kuytfa Sraddha, offering of Piitfas first to one's paternal anscetors ( w. 23-

verses.sanskrit: मणिनागेश्वरं नाम मणिनद्याश्च सङ्गमः । तिलकेश्वरतीर्थं च गौतमेशमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: maṇināgeśvaraṃ nāma maṇinadyāśca saṅgamaḥ / tilakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca gautameśamataḥ param
verses.translation: After saying this and performing Acamana, the pil¬ grim should perform Pranayama with effort, in order to obtain Brahmaloka which is devoid of Pmaravrtti (a return to Sam- sara'again). After performing the Sraddha duly in this manner, he, should invoke the Pitrs and worship them with the mantras. Then he should offer the balls of rice.
verses.hindi: अजातदन्ता ये केचियये च गर्भे प्रपीडिता: । तेषामुद्धरणार्थाय इमं पिण्ड ददास्थहम्
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and performing Acamana, the pil¬ grim should perform Pranayama with effort, in order to obtain Brahmaloka which is devoid of Pmaravrtti (a return to Sam- sara'again). After performing the Sraddha duly in this manner, he,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and performing Acamana, the pil¬ grim should perform Pranayama with effort, in order to obtain Brahmaloka which is devoid of Pmaravrtti (a return to Sam- sara'again). After performing the Sraddha duly in this manner, he,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव मातृतीर्थं च मुनिनोक्तं मुनीश्वराः । शङ्खचूडं च केदारं पाराशरमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: tatraiva mātṛtīrthaṃ ca muninoktaṃ munīśvarāḥ / śaṅkhacūḍaṃ ca kedāraṃ pārāśaramataḥ param
verses.translation: In the holy centre, on the Pretas'ila etc. the place must first be washed with Pancagavya separately while their mantras are being recited. Then the deities must be worshipped with offerings of Caru soaked in ghee. So long as the gingelly seeds are taken by the pilgrim in the holy rites of the Pitrs, Asuras run off from the place of holy rites like deer afraid of lion.
verses.hindi: अग्निदग्धाश्न ये केचिब्नाग्निदग्धास्तथा5परे। विद्युच्चौ रहता ये च॒ तेभ्यः पिण्ड ददाभ्यम् ३८ दावदाहे मृता ये च सिह॒व्याप्रहताश्च ये । दंष्टर्भिः श॒द्धिभिर्वा5पि तेम्यः पिण्ड ददाम्यहम् ॥ उद्बस्धनभृता ये च विषशस्त्रहताभ्र ये। आत्मापघातिनो च ये तेभ्यः पिण्ड ददाम्यहम् ४० अरण्ये वत्मंनि वने क्षुधया तृषया म्ृताः । भुतप्रेतपिशाचाय्यस्तेम्यः पिण्ड ददाम्यहम् ॥४ १
verses.wordMeaning: In the holy centre, on the Pretas'ila etc. the place must first be washed with Pancagavya separately while their mantras are being recited. Then the deities must be worshipped with offerings of Caru soaked in ghee.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the holy centre, on the Pretas'ila etc. the place must first be washed with Pancagavya separately while their mantras are being recited. Then the deities must be worshipped with offerings of Caru soaked in ghee.…

verses.sanskrit: भीमेश्वरं च चन्द्रेशम् अश्ववत्याश्च सङ्गमः । बह्वीश्वरं नारदेशं वैद्यनाथं कपीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: bhīmeśvaraṃ ca candreśam aśvavatyāśca saṅgamaḥ / bahvīśvaraṃ nāradeśaṃ vaidyanāthaṃ kapīśvaram
verses.translation: The Sraddha of the mother 1 should be performed sep¬ arately during the Astakas (i.e. the 8th day of the three months on which the Pitrs are to be propitiated), during the Vrddhi (increase) days and on the day of the death at Gaya. On other occasions the Sraddha should be performed along with that of her husband (i.e. one's father).
verses.hindi: भी में इसी कुशासन पर तिलमिश्रित जल द्वारा आवाहित कर रहा हैँ, जिनकी कहीं भी गति नहीं हुईं  इसी प्रकार बच्चुवर्गों के कुलों में भी उन मरे हुए लोगों को इस कुशासन पर तिलमिश्रित जलदान के द्वारा आवाहित कर रहा हूँ जिनकी कहीं गति नहीं है ।२९-३२। इन उपर्यक्त मन्त्रों द्वारा तिलमिश्रित जल से कुशों पर उन सभी मृतकों का ध्यान करना चाहिए। आवाहन के उपरान्त भली भाँति पूजन कर उत्हें ऋमानुसार पिण्डदान
verses.wordMeaning: The Sraddha of the mother 1 should be performed sep¬ arately during the Astakas (i.e. the 8th day of the three months on which the Pitrs are to be propitiated), during the Vrddhi (increase) days and on the day of the death at Gaya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sraddha of the mother 1 should be performed sep¬ arately during the Astakas (i.e. the 8th day of the three months on which the Pitrs are to be propitiated), during the Vrddhi (increase) days and on the day of the death at Gaya.…

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भेश्वरं च मार्कण्डं रामेशं लक्ष्मणेश्वरम् । मेघेश्वरं मत्स्यकेशम् अप्सराह्रदसंज्ञकम्
verses.transliteration: kumbheśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ rāmeśaṃ lakṣmaṇeśvaram / megheśvaraṃ matsyakeśam apsarāhradasaṃjñakam
verses.translation: During Vrddhi Sraddha, that of the mother should be performed first. But at Gaya that of the father should be performed first. The Sraddha is begun with the offerings of Padya at the outset and the proper laying of the Kusa grass with the tips pointing to the south to the father etc. The remaining part of the Sraddha is to be performed as mentioned in the res¬ pective Grhya Sutras.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए । अपने कुल में उन मरे हुए लोगों को, जिनकौ कहीं भी गति नहीं हैं, उबारने के लिए में यह पिण्डदान कर रहा हूँ, मातामह के कुल में मरे हुए उन लोगों को उदारने के लिए, जिनकौ कहीं भी गति नहीं है, मैं यह पिण्डदान कर रहा हूँ। बन्धुवर्भों के कुल में मरे हुए उन लोगों को उबारने के लिए में यह पिण्डदान कर रहा हूँ, जिनको कहीं भी गति नहीं मिली ।३३-३६। जो बिना दाँत जमे ही मर गये थे, गर्भ में ही जिनकी मृत्यु हो गई थी, ऐसे लोगों को उबारने के लिए मैं यह पिण्डदान कर रहा हूँ । अग्नि में जल कर मरे हुए जो कोई हों, अग्नि में बिना जलाये गये, जो कोई हों ऐसे लोगों के लिये मैं यह पिण्डदान कर रहा हूँ। बनाग्नि में जो मर गये थे, सिंहों एवं व्याप्नोंसे जिनकी मृत्यु हुई, अथवा अन्याय दाढ़ों वाले, सींगों वाले, हिल जानवरों से जितकी मृत्यु हुई, उनके उद्धार के
verses.wordMeaning: During Vrddhi Sraddha, that of the mother should be performed first. But at Gaya that of the father should be performed first.…
verses.commentary: Sense: During Vrddhi Sraddha, that of the mother should be performed first. But at Gaya that of the father should be performed first.…

verses.sanskrit: दधिस्कन्दं मधुस्कन्दं नन्दिकेशं च वारुणम् । पावकेश्वरतीर्थं च तथैव कपिलेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dadhiskandaṃ madhuskandaṃ nandikeśaṃ ca vāruṇam / pāvakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathaiva kapileśvaram
verses.translation: In the case of Sapindas, the Darbha grass is duly spread and the water with gingelly seeds is offered once and the Sraddha is performed on their southern side.
verses.hindi: लिए मैं यह पिण्ड प्रदान कर रहा हूँ  स्वयं फाँसी के लगाने से जिनकी मृत्यु हुई, विषों एवं शस्त्रों मे जिन्होंने आत्महत्या करके अपने प्राण गँवा दिये, ऐसे आत्महत्यारों के उद्धार के लिये में यह पिण्डदान कर रहा हूँ ।३७-४०। घोर जंगली मार्गों में जो विवश होकर क्षुधा एवं प्यास से मर गये थे, भूतों प्रेतों एवं + एतच्चिद्नान्तर्गतग्रत्थो नास्ति ल, पुस्तके ।  ने विद्यते5्यं इलोकः क. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: In the case of Sapindas, the Darbha grass is duly spread and the water with gingelly seeds is offered once and the Sraddha is performed on their southern side.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the case of Sapindas, the Darbha grass is duly spread and the water with gingelly seeds is offered once and the Sraddha is performed on their southern side.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणाह्वयं तीर्थं चक्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । चण्डादित्यं परं तीर्थं चण्डिकातीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam / caṇḍādityaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ caṇḍikātīrthamuttamam
verses.translation: The water libation is offered with the sacred water of the Pitrs holding it in the hollow of one's palms. He should then offer the Aksayya (inexhaustible) Pinda with a fistful of powdered fried grain. The other kinsmen are then to be invoked in the Ku£a grass by means of the waters with gingelly seeds.
verses.hindi: १११६ वायुपुराणम् रोरव्ये चान्धतामिश्रे (स्रे) कालसूत्रे च ये गताः। तेषासुद्धरणार्थाय इस पिण्ड तदाम्यहम्.
verses.wordMeaning: The water libation is offered with the sacred water of the Pitrs holding it in the hollow of one's palms. He should then offer the Aksayya (inexhaustible) Pinda with a fistful of powdered fried grain.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The water libation is offered with the sacred water of the Pitrs holding it in the hollow of one's palms. He should then offer the Aksayya (inexhaustible) Pinda with a fistful of powdered fried grain.…

verses.sanskrit: यमहासाह्वयं तीर्थं तथा गङ्गेश्वरं शुभम् । नन्दिकेश्वरसंज्ञं च नरनारायणाह्वयम्
verses.transliteration: yamahāsāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā gaṅgeśvaraṃ śubham / nandikeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca naranārāyaṇāhvayam
verses.translation: The special Sraddha for one's mother is prescribed during the A?takas and in Vrddhi Sraddha.
verses.hindi: असिपत्रबने घोरे कुम्भीपाकेषु ये गताः । तेषामुद्ध रणार्थाय इस पिण्ड ददाम्यहम् ६४३ अनेकयातनासंस्थाः प्रेतलोक॑ व ये गताः । तेषामुद्ध रणार्याय इस पिण्ड ददास्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: The special Sraddha for one's mother is prescribed during the A?takas and in Vrddhi Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The special Sraddha for one's mother is prescribed during the A?takas and in Vrddhi Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: नलेश्वरं च मार्कण्डं शुक्लतीर्थमतः परम् । व्यासेश्वरं परं तीर्थं तत्र सिद्धेश्वरं तथा
verses.transliteration: naleśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ śuklatīrthamataḥ param / vyāseśvaraṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tatra siddheśvaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: May all those Devas, sages. Pi tj-s and human beings, mothers and maternal grandfathers and others beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass, be propitiated by this water libation.
verses.hindi: अनेकयातनासंस्था: ये नीता यमकिकर: । तेषामुद्धरणार्थाय इमं पिण्ड ददास्यहम् नरकेषु समस्तेषु यातनासु च ये स्थिताः । तेषासुद्धरणार्थाय इमं पिण्ड ददाम्यहम् ४६ पशुयोनिगता ये च पक्षिकीटसरीसृपा: । अथवा वृक्षयोनिस्थास्तेभ्य: पिण्ड ददाभ्यहम् . ४७
verses.wordMeaning: May all those Devas, sages. Pi tj-s and human beings, mothers and maternal grandfathers and others beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass, be propitiated by this water libation.
verses.commentary: Sense: May all those Devas, sages. Pi tj-s and human beings, mothers and maternal grandfathers and others beginning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass, be propitiated by this water libation.

verses.sanskrit: कोटितीर्थं प्रभातीर्थं वासुकीश्वरम् उत्तमम् । सङ्गमश्च करञ्जाया मार्कण्डेश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: koṭitīrthaṃ prabhātīrthaṃ vāsukīśvaram uttamam / saṅgamaśca karañjāyā mārkaṇḍeśvaramuttamam
verses.translation: May this be the water libation along withgingelly seeds to all those crores of past (members of) families, residing in the seven continents beginning with Brahma and ending with the earth.
verses.hindi: दिव्यन्तरीक्षभूमिष्ठाः पितरो बान्धवादयः  मृता असंस्कृता ये च तेम्यः पिण्ड ददास्यहमू
verses.wordMeaning: May this be the water libation along withgingelly seeds to all those crores of past (members of) families, residing in the seven continents beginning with Brahma and ending with the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: May this be the water libation along withgingelly seeds to all those crores of past (members of) families, residing in the seven continents beginning with Brahma and ending with the earth.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं कोटीश्वरं नाम तथा संकर्षणाह्वयम् । कनकेशं मन्मथेशं तीर्थं चैवानसूयकम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ nāma tathā saṃkarṣaṇāhvayam / kanakeśaṃ manmatheśaṃ tīrthaṃ caivānasūyakam
verses.translation: A ball of rice has been offered by me to all these: father, grandfather, great-grandfather, mother, grandmother, great-grandmother, maternal grandfather, his father and his grandfather. May that Pinda be of everlasting benefit,
verses.hindi: ये केचित्प्रेतरूपेण बतेन्ते पितरों मम । ते स्व तृप्तिमायान्तु पिण्डदानेन सर्वदा (५० पिशाचों से ग्रस्त होने के कारण जिनकी मृत्यु हुई थी, ऐसे लोगों को उबारने के लिए में यह पिण्डप्रदान कर रहा हैँ। अपने घोर पाप कर्मों के कारण जो रोरव, अन्धतामिस्र, एवं कालसूत्र जेसे नरकों में घोर बातनाएँ झेल रहे हैं, उतको उबारने के लिए में यह पिण्ड प्रदान कर रहा हूं ।४१-४२। घोर असिपत्र वन तथा कुम्भीपाक जेसे नरकों में जो अपने पाप कर्मों के फल भोग रहे हैं, उनके उद्धार के लिए में यह पिण्डदान कर रहा हूँ ।
verses.wordMeaning: A ball of rice has been offered by me to all these: father, grandfather, great-grandfather, mother, grandmother, great-grandmother, maternal grandfather, his father and his grandfather. May that Pinda be of everlasting benefit,
verses.commentary: Sense: A ball of rice has been offered by me to all these: father, grandfather, great-grandfather, mother, grandmother, great-grandmother, maternal grandfather, his father and his grandfather. May that Pinda be of everlasting benefit,

verses.sanskrit: एरण्डीसङ्गमः पुण्यो मातृतीर्थं च शोभनम् । तीर्थं स्वर्णशलाकाख्यं तथा चैवाम्बिकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: eraṇḍīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyo mātṛtīrthaṃ ca śobhanam / tīrthaṃ svarṇaśalākākhyaṃ tathā caivāmbikeśvaram
verses.translation: At Gayasiras the Pinda offered is of the size of a first or that of the green emblic myrobalan fruit or that of the leaf of the Sami tree. The devotee shall uplift seven Gotras and a hundred families. The Gotras—seven in number—are those of the father, mother, one's wife (before marriage), one's sister (after marriage), one's daughter (after marriage), and those of the father's sisters and mother's sisters. The hundred and one families are as follows: father and his twentyfour ancestors, mother and her twenty ancestors, wife and her sixteen ancestors, twelve ancestors of the sister's husband, eleven an¬ cestors of the son-in-law, seven ancestors of the husband of the sister of one's father and eight ancestors of the husband of mother's sister.
verses.hindi: प्रेततोक में जाकर अन्याग्य यातनाओं से सताये जाने वालों को उबारतने के लिए में यह पिण्ड प्रदान कर रहा हूँ । यम दूलों द्वारा अनेक यातनाओं में जो पीसे जा रहे हैं, ऐसे लोगों को उबारने के लिए में यह पिंड प्रदान कर रहा हूँ । समस्त नरकों एवं सभी प्रकार को यातनाओं में अपने पाप कर्मों के कारण दुःख भोगने वालों को उबारने के लिए में यह पिंड प्रदान कर रहा हूं ।४३-४६। पथ्ु की योनि में उत्पन्न हो चुके हैं, नीच पक्षी, कौट
verses.wordMeaning: At Gayasiras the Pinda offered is of the size of a first or that of the green emblic myrobalan fruit or that of the leaf of the Sami tree. The devotee shall uplift seven Gotras and a hundred families. The Gotras—seven in number—are those of the father, mother,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At Gayasiras the Pinda offered is of the size of a first or that of the green emblic myrobalan fruit or that of the leaf of the Sami tree. The devotee shall uplift seven Gotras and a hundred families. The Gotras—seven in number—are those of the father, mother,…

verses.sanskrit: करञ्जेशं भारतेशं नागेशं मुकुटेश्वरम् । सौभाग्यसुन्दरी तीर्थं धनदेश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: karañjeśaṃ bhārateśaṃ nāgeśaṃ mukuṭeśvaram / saubhāgyasundarī tīrthaṃ dhanadeśvaramuttamam
verses.translation: There is no invocation in a TirthaSraddha nor is screen erected shutting off the quarters. There is no defect due to the viewing of others. Clever people should not perform the Tirtha- iraddha out of pity.
verses.hindi: एवं सरकने वाले सपं आदि योतियों में जितका जन्म हो चुका है, अथवा वृक्षों को योनि में जो उत्पन्न हो चुके हैं-उन सब को उबारने के लिए में यह पिंड दान कर रहा हूँ । अपने कर्मों के अनुसार अनेक सहस्र जातियों में उत्पन्न हो होकर जो दुःख भोग रहे हैं, जिन्हें मानवयोनि अब दुलंभ हो चुकी है, ऐसे लोगों को उबारने के लिए में यह पिड प्रदान कर रहा हूँ ।॥४७-४८। दिव्य लोक, अन्तरिक्षलोक, एवं भूमिलोक, में उपस्थित अपने बन्धुवर्गों एवं अपने पितरों को उबारने के लिए, जो कभी मृत्यु को प्राप्त हुए परन्तु संस्कार नहीं हुए, में यह पिंड दान कर रहा हूँ । जो हमारे पितरगण इस समय प्रेत रूप में वरतंमान हैं, वे हमारे इस पिडदान से सबंदा के लिए तृप्ति लाभ करें ।४९-५०। जो हमारे इस जन्म के बान्धव अथवा अबान्धव हैं, जो हमारे अन्य
verses.wordMeaning: There is no invocation in a TirthaSraddha nor is screen erected shutting off the quarters. There is no defect due to the viewing of others. Clever people should not perform the Tirtha- iraddha out of pity.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no invocation in a TirthaSraddha nor is screen erected shutting off the quarters. There is no defect due to the viewing of others. Clever people should not perform the Tirtha- iraddha out of pity.

verses.sanskrit: रोहिण्यं चक्रतीर्थं च उत्तरेश्वरसंज्ञितम् । भोगेश्वरं च केदारं निष्कलङ्कमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: rohiṇyaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca uttareśvarasaṃjñitam / bhogeśvaraṃ ca kedāraṃ niṣkalaṅkamataḥ param
verses.translation: This following is the procedure in the Tirtha Sraddhas'. providing seat of the Pintfas, offering of the Pintfas, Avane- jaria (ritualistic sprinkling with the Darbha grass), monetary gifts and the Annasarhkalpa (ritualistic expression of one's inten¬ tion in preparing food).
verses.hindi: 2 एतदग्रेईय॑ पाठ: ख. पुस्तके ।स यथा--आब्रह्मस्तस्वपवं त॑ यरत्किचित्सचाइचरम् । मया दत्तेन तोयेन तृप्यन्त भवनत्रयम् ।। इति । “अय॑ इलोको नास्ति ख, पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: This following is the procedure in the Tirtha Sraddhas'. providing seat of the Pintfas, offering of the Pintfas, Avane- jaria (ritualistic sprinkling with the Darbha grass), monetary gifts and the Annasarhkalpa (ritualistic expression of one's inten¬ tion in preparing food).
verses.commentary: Sense: This following is the procedure in the Tirtha Sraddhas'. providing seat of the Pintfas, offering of the Pintfas, Avane- jaria (ritualistic sprinkling with the Darbha grass), monetary gifts and the Annasarhkalpa (ritualistic expression of one's inten¬ tion in preparing food).

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डं धौतपापं च तीर्थमाङ्गिरसेश्वरम् । कोटवीसङ्गमः पुण्यं कोटितीर्थं च तत्र वै
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍaṃ dhautapāpaṃ ca tīrthamāṅgiraseśvaram / koṭavīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ ca tatra vai
verses.translation: Mantra: "I invoke all those members of our family who are dead and who have no other way of salvation. I shall
verses.hindi: आ ब्रह्मणो ये पितृबंशजाता मातुस्तथा वंशभवा सदीयाः । कुलद्ये ये मम दासभूता भृत्यास्तथवा55श्रितसेवका श्र ३५४
verses.wordMeaning: Mantra: "I invoke all those members of our family who are dead and who have no other way of salvation. I shall
verses.commentary: Sense: Mantra: "I invoke all those members of our family who are dead and who have no other way of salvation. I shall

verses.sanskrit: अयोनिजं परं तीर्थम् अङ्गारेश्वरमुत्तमम् । स्कान्दं च नार्मदं ब्राह्मं वाल्मीकेश्वरसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: ayonijaṃ paraṃ tīrtham aṅgāreśvaramuttamam / skāndaṃ ca nārmadaṃ brāhmaṃ vālmīkeśvarasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: I invoke all those persons in the family of our kinsmen who are dead and who have no other way of salvation. I shall invoke them on the Darbha grass with water libations along with gingelly seeds".
verses.hindi: सिन्राणि शिष्या: पशवश्च वक्षा दृष्टा ह्यदृष्टाश्र कृतोपकारा:।
verses.wordMeaning: I invoke all those persons in the family of our kinsmen who are dead and who have no other way of salvation. I shall invoke them on the Darbha grass with water libations along with gingelly seeds".
verses.commentary: Sense: I invoke all those persons in the family of our kinsmen who are dead and who have no other way of salvation. I shall invoke them on the Darbha grass with water libations along with gingelly seeds".

verses.sanskrit: कोटितीर्थं कपालेशं पाण्डुतीर्थं त्रिलोचनम् । कपिलेशं कम्बुकेशं प्रभासं कोहनेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: koṭitīrthaṃ kapāleśaṃ pāṇḍutīrthaṃ trilocanam / kapileśaṃ kambukeśaṃ prabhāsaṃ kohaneśvaram
verses.translation: Thus the pilgrim should meditate on the Darbhas, repeat these mantras with the offering of water libations along with gingelly seeds, invoke and worship the Pitrs and offer the Pindas in due order.
verses.hindi: एतेश्व सर्वमन्त्रस्तु स्त्रीलिज्भान्तं समुझ्य च् । पिण्डान्द्शाद्यथा पूर्व ज्लीणां मात्नादिकाक़मात् जन्मों के वान्धव हैं, उन सबको हमारा दिया हुआ यह पिंड अक्षय तृप्ति करने वाला हो । पिता के वंश में जो मर चके हैं, माता के वंश में जो मर चुके हैं, हमारे गुरु, श्वशुर एवं बन्धुवर्गों के बंश में जिनकी मृत्यु हो चकी है, जो कोई अन्य बन्धु बान्धव मृत्यु को प्राप्त हुए हों, हमारे कुल में उत्पन्न होने वाले ऐसे लोग, जिनको पिंडदान करने वाला कोइ नहीं है, पुत्र स्त्री आदि से जो रहित रहे, जिनकी क्रिया लुप्त हो गई,
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the pilgrim should meditate on the Darbhas, repeat these mantras with the offering of water libations along with gingelly seeds, invoke and worship the Pitrs and offer the Pindas in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the pilgrim should meditate on the Darbhas, repeat these mantras with the offering of water libations along with gingelly seeds, invoke and worship the Pitrs and offer the Pindas in due order.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रेशं वालुकेशं च देवेशं शक्रमेव च । नागेश्वरं गौतमेशम् अहल्यातीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: indreśaṃ vālukeśaṃ ca deveśaṃ śakrameva ca / nāgeśvaraṃ gautameśam ahalyātīrthamuttamam
verses.translation: f< I am offering this Pinda in order to uplift those per¬ sons of our family who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.
verses.hindi: जन्म से ही जो अच्धे थे, पंगु थे, कुहप थे, गभावस्था में ही जिनकी पृश्यु हो गईं जिन्हें कोई जानता है कोई नहीं जानता, उन सबको हमारा दिया हुआ यह पिंड अक्षय तृप्ति प्रदान करने वाला हो ।५१ ५ । ब्रह्मा से लैकर हमारे पिता के वंश में जों कोई उत्पन्न हुए हों, तथा मेरी माता के वंश में जो उत्पन्न हुए हों, इन दोनों कुलों को, जो दासता एवं भ्रृत्यता के बन्धन में बंधे हुये थे, आश्वित एवं सेवकों में जिनकी गणना की जाती थी,
verses.wordMeaning: f< I am offering this Pinda in order to uplift those per¬ sons of our family who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: f< I am offering this Pinda in order to uplift those per¬ sons of our family who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.

verses.sanskrit: रामेश्वरं मोक्षतीर्थं तथा कुशलवेश्वरौ । नर्मदेशं कपर्दीशं सागरेशमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: rāmeśvaraṃ mokṣatīrthaṃ tathā kuśalaveśvarau / narmadeśaṃ kapardīśaṃ sāgareśamataḥ param
verses.translation: I am offering this Pinda in order to emancipate those persons of our maternal grandfather's family who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.
verses.hindi: मित्र थे, शिष्य, थे पशु, वृक्ष दष्ट एवं अदुष्ट रूप से उपकारक थे, अन्य जन्म में जिनके साथ हमारी सद्भतति थी, उन सबको उबारने के लिये मैं यह पिण्ड प्रदान कर रहा हुं” ।५४-५५॥ इन सभी उपयुक्त मंत्रों का उच्चारण कर माताओं के लिये क्रमानुसार स्त्रीलिंग विशेषण लगाकर पिण्ड प्रदान करना चाहिए । अपने गोत्र के हों अथवा अन्य गोत्र के हों, स्त्री पुरुष के लिये पिण्डदान को विधि पृथक पृथक विहित है, जो प्रथक रूप में नहीं करता उसका श्राद्ध पिण्डदान एवं तपंण सभी निरथंक है। पिण्ड रखने के पात्र में तिल छोड़कर फिर उस को पविन्न जल से पूर्णंकर इन मन्त्रों का उच्चारण करते हुए क्रमानुसार प्रदक्षिणा पूर्वक पिण्डदान करना
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering this Pinda in order to emancipate those persons of our maternal grandfather's family who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering this Pinda in order to emancipate those persons of our maternal grandfather's family who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.

verses.sanskrit: धौरादित्यं परं तीर्थं तीर्थं चापरयोनिजम् । पिङ्गलेश्वरतीर्थ च भृग्वीश्वरमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: dhaurādityaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ cāparayonijam / piṅgaleśvaratīrtha ca bhṛgvīśvaramanuttamam
verses.translation: I am offering this Pinda for the uplift of those persons belonging to the family of our kinsmen who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.
verses.hindi: १११५ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering this Pinda for the uplift of those persons belonging to the family of our kinsmen who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering this Pinda for the uplift of those persons belonging to the family of our kinsmen who are dead and who have no other means of salvation.

verses.sanskrit: दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थं कोटितीर्थं च सत्तमाः । मार्कण्डं ब्रह्मतीर्थं च आदिवाराहमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ ca sattamāḥ / mārkaṇḍaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ ca ādivārāhamuttamam
verses.translation: I am offering this Pinda for the uplift of those persons who (died) before cutting teeth and those who were afflicted even while in the womb.
verses.hindi: पित्स्विसुज्य चा5४चाम्य साक्षिणः श्रावयेत्सुरान् । साक्षिण: सन्तु मे देवा ब्रह्मशानादयस्तथा ॥ मया गयां समासाद्य पितणां निष्कृतिः कृता .. आगतो5स्मि गयां देव पितुकायें गदाधर । त्वमेव साक्षी भगवन्ननुणो5हसृणत्रयात् ३६० सर्वस्थानेषु चेव॑ स्थात्पिण्डदानं तु नारद। प्रेतपबंतसारभ्य कुर्यात्तीथेंषु च क्रमात्
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering this Pinda for the uplift of those persons who (died) before cutting teeth and those who were afflicted even while in the womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering this Pinda for the uplift of those persons who (died) before cutting teeth and those who were afflicted even while in the womb.

verses.sanskrit: आशापूराभिधं तीर्थं कौबेरं मारुतं तथा । वरुणेशं यमेशं च रामेशं कर्कटेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: āśāpūrābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ kauberaṃ mārutaṃ tathā / varuṇeśaṃ yameśaṃ ca rāmeśaṃ karkaṭeśvaram
verses.translation: I am offering this Pinda to those persons who were duly cremated and who were not those who were struck dead by lightning or by robbers.
verses.hindi: तिलमिश्नांस्ततः सक्त॒न्निक्षिपेत्प्रेतपबंते । + अपसब्येन देवर्ष दक्षिणाभिमुखेन च ३६२ ये केचित्प्रेतरूपेण बतेन्ते पितरों मम । ते सर्वे तृप्तिमायान्तु सक्तुभिस्तिलमिश्चितेः
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering this Pinda to those persons who were duly cremated and who were not those who were struck dead by lightning or by robbers.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering this Pinda to those persons who were duly cremated and who were not those who were struck dead by lightning or by robbers.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रेशं सोमतीर्थं च नन्दाह्रदमनुत्तमम् । वैष्णवं चक्रतीर्थं च रामकेशवसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: śakreśaṃ somatīrthaṃ ca nandāhradamanuttamam / vaiṣṇavaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca rāmakeśavasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: I am offering this Pinda to those who died in the forest fire, to those who were killed by lions and tigers and those who were slain by horned and fanged (beasts of prey).
verses.hindi: साहिये तीत बार सिचन करने के उपरान्त सब को प्रणाम कराके पिण्डदान की विधि को समाप्त करना चाहिए ।५६-५८। पितरों को विससजित कर आचमन करके साक्षी रूप में उपस्थित देवताओं को यह सुनाना चाहिए । ब्रह्मा, शिव प्रभूृति देवगण ! आप लोग हमारे इस काये के साक्षी रहें कि में गया में आकर अपने पितरों के उद्धार का कार्ये सम्पन्न कर चुका  देव ! गदाधर ! केवल पितृकार्य के लिये में गया आया हुआ था, भगवन् ! आप ही इसके साक्षी हैं, में अब अपने तीनों ऋणों से मुक्त हूँ ।१६-६०। देवषि नारद जी ! प्रायः सभी तीथे स्थानों में पिण्डदान की यही विधि है, सर्व प्रथम प्रेत प्बंत पर आरम्भ कर क्रमानुसार सभी स्थानों में उक्त क्रम से श्राद्ध करना चाहिए प्रेत पव॑ंत पर तिलमिश्रित सत्त् दक्षिणाभिमुख एवं अपसब्य होकर छोड़ना क्‍ चाहिए ।६१०६२॥ जो कोई हमारे पितरगण प्रेत रूप में कहीं विद्यमान हों, वे इस तिलमिश्रित सत्तु के दान से
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering this Pinda to those who died in the forest fire, to those who were killed by lions and tigers and those who were slain by horned and fanged (beasts of prey).
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering this Pinda to those who died in the forest fire, to those who were killed by lions and tigers and those who were slain by horned and fanged (beasts of prey).

verses.sanskrit: तथैव रुक्मिणीतीर्थं शिवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । जयवाराहर्तीर्थं च तीर्थमस्माहकाह्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva rukmiṇītīrthaṃ śivatīrthamanuttamam / jayavārāhartīrthaṃ ca tīrthamasmāhakāhvayam
verses.translation: I am offering to those who died by getting hanged, who were killed by poison or by weapons and those who have committed suicide.
verses.hindi: तृष्ति लाभ करें। ब्रह्मा से लेकर स्तम्ब पर्यन्‍न्त इन चराचर जीव-योनियों में जो भी हमारे पितरयण हों, वे मेरे दिये इस जलदान से सर्वाशतः तृष्ति लाभ करें ।६३-६४। नारद जी ! इस विधि से श्राद्ध करनेवाले प्राणियों के पितरगण निश्चय ही प्रेत योनि से छुटकारा पा जाते हैं। यही नहीं प्रत्युत उसके इस जणुभ कर्म के माहात्म्य से
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering to those who died by getting hanged, who were killed by poison or by weapons and those who have committed suicide.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering to those who died by getting hanged, who were killed by poison or by weapons and those who have committed suicide.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गारेशं च सिद्धेशं तपेश्वरमतः परम् । पुनः सिद्धेश्वरं नामतीर्थं च वरुणेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: aṅgāreśaṃ ca siddheśaṃ tapeśvaramataḥ param / punaḥ siddheśvaraṃ nāmatīrthaṃ ca varuṇeśvaram
verses.translation: Iam offering this Pinda for the upliftment of those persons who have fallen into the hells called Raurava, Andha- tamisra and Kalasutra.
verses.hindi: “तास्त्यधंमिदं क. पुस्तके । + नास्त्यधंमिर्द ख. पुस्तके  एकादशाधिकशवतमोष्यायः ११५
verses.wordMeaning: Iam offering this Pinda for the upliftment of those persons who have fallen into the hells called Raurava, Andha- tamisra and Kalasutra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Iam offering this Pinda for the upliftment of those persons who have fallen into the hells called Raurava, Andha- tamisra and Kalasutra.

verses.sanskrit: पराशरेश्वरं पुण्यं कुसुमेशमनुत्तमम् । कुण्डलेश्वरतीर्थं च तथा कलकलेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: parāśareśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ kusumeśamanuttamam / kuṇḍaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā kalakaleśvaram
verses.translation: Iam offering this Pinda for the emancipation of those
