verses.hindi: इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते गयामाहात्म्यं नाम दशाधिकशततमोःध्याय: ॥११०॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: Iam offering this Pinda for the emancipation of those
verses.commentary: Sense: Iam offering this Pinda for the emancipation of those

verses.sanskrit: न्यङ्कुवाराहसंज्ञं च अङ्कोलं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । श्वेतवाराहतीर्थं च भार्गलं सौरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nyaṅkuvārāhasaṃjñaṃ ca aṅkolaṃ tīrthamuttamam / śvetavārāhatīrthaṃ ca bhārgalaṃ sauramuttamam
verses.translation: I am offering this Pinda to those who are born in the animal wombs or as birds, worms, insects or reptiles or even as
verses.hindi: अथेकादशाधिकशततमो ध्याय: आदो तु पञचताोथेषु चोत्तरे मानसे विधि:  आचस्य कुशहस्तेन शिरश्राभ्युक्ष्य वारिणा
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering this Pinda to those who are born in the animal wombs or as birds, worms, insects or reptiles or even as
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering this Pinda to those who are born in the animal wombs or as birds, worms, insects or reptiles or even as

verses.sanskrit: हुङ्कारस्वामितीर्थं च शुक्लतीर्थं च शोभनम् । सङ्गमो मधुमत्याश्च तीर्थं वै सङ्गमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: huṅkārasvāmitīrthaṃ ca śuklatīrthaṃ ca śobhanam / saṅgamo madhumatyāśca tīrthaṃ vai saṅgameśvaram
verses.translation: I am offering the Pinda to those Pitrs who are stationed in heaven, firmament or on the earth and to those kinsmen etc. who have not been cremated duly after death.
verses.hindi: उत्तरं मानस गच्छेन्मन्त्रेण स्नानमाचरेत् । उत्तरे मानसे स्नान करोम्यात्मविशुद्धये
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering the Pinda to those Pitrs who are stationed in heaven, firmament or on the earth and to those kinsmen etc. who have not been cremated duly after death.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering the Pinda to those Pitrs who are stationed in heaven, firmament or on the earth and to those kinsmen etc. who have not been cremated duly after death.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदेश्वरसंज्ञं च नदीत्रितयसङ्गमः । अनेकेश्वरतीर्थं च शर्भेशं मोक्षसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: narmadeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca nadītritayasaṅgamaḥ / anekeśvaratīrthaṃ ca śarbheśaṃ mokṣasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated through this Pinda for ever, those Pitrs who exist in the form of ghosts.
verses.hindi: सुर्यंलोकादिसंसिद्धिसिद्धये पितृमुक्तये । »स्नानार्थ तपंणं कृत्वा श्राद्ध कुर्यात्सपिण्डकम् 0३ उसके कुल में कोई प्रेतयोनि में नहीं जाता। गया शिर में वह प्रेत-शिला केवल प्रेतों की विमुक्ति के लिये है, तीथ॑ मंत्रादि के रूप में आदि गदाधर देव भी वहाँ इसी सदाशय से विराजमान हैं ।६५-६६॥।
verses.wordMeaning: May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated through this Pinda for ever, those Pitrs who exist in the form of ghosts.
verses.commentary: Sense: May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated through this Pinda for ever, those Pitrs who exist in the form of ghosts.

verses.sanskrit: कावेरीसङ्गमः पुण्यस्तीर्थं गोपेश्वराह्वयम् । मार्कण्डेशं च नागेशम् उदम्बर्याश्च सङ्गमः
verses.transliteration: kāverīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyastīrthaṃ gopeśvarāhvayam / mārkaṇḍeśaṃ ca nāgeśam udambaryāśca saṅgamaḥ
verses.translation: This Pinda has been offered by me to those who may or may not have been my kinsmen in this birth but who were my kinsmen in the other births. May it be of everlasting benefit
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमार बोले--नारद जी ! सब प्रथम उत्तर मानस में स्थित पाँचो ती्थों में किस श्रकार श्राद्धादिकायं सम्पन्न करने चाहिए, इसकी विधि बतला रहा हूँ । आचमन कर हाथ में कुज्ा लेकर छ्षिर पर जल द्वारा सिचन करे। फिर उत्तर मानस की यात्रा करे और वहाँ जाकर इस मंत्र का उच्चारण करते हुए स्नान करे कि आत्मविशुद्धि के लिये मैं उत्तर मानस में स्नान कर रहा हूँ ।१-९। सूर्य लोक प्रभूतिलोकों
verses.wordMeaning: This Pinda has been offered by me to those who may or may not have been my kinsmen in this birth but who were my kinsmen in the other births. May it be of everlasting benefit
verses.commentary: Sense: This Pinda has been offered by me to those who may or may not have been my kinsmen in this birth but who were my kinsmen in the other births. May it be of everlasting benefit

verses.sanskrit: साम्बादित्याह्वयं तीर्थम् उदम्बर्याश्च सङ्गमः । सिद्धेश्वरं च मार्कण्डं तथा सिद्धेश्वरीकृतम्
verses.transliteration: sāmbādityāhvayaṃ tīrtham udambaryāśca saṅgamaḥ / siddheśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ tathā siddheśvarīkṛtam
verses.translation: This Pinda has been offered by me to all those who are dead in my father's family, to those who are dead in my mother's family, to those kinsmen, elders, fathers-in-law or other relatives who are dead, to such of those in my family as had neither sons nor wives and hence had been deprived of Pinda offerings, to those who had been defaulters in the holy rites, to those who were born blind, to those who had been lame, to those who had hideous forms, to those who had been prema¬ turely born, to all persons of my family known and unknown. To all those the Pinda has been offered by me. May it be of everlasting benefit in reaching unto them.
verses.hindi: में प्राप्त होने वाली सिद्धियों को प्राप्त करने के लिए तथा अपने पितरों की मुक्ति के लिए यह स्नान ( पाठ:--एतदध॑ स्थानेज्यं देवादींस्तपंयित्वा5य श्रार््ध कृत्वा सपिण्ठकम्  इति ख. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: This Pinda has been offered by me to all those who are dead in my father's family, to those who are dead in my mother's family, to those kinsmen, elders, fathers-in-law or other relatives who are dead,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This Pinda has been offered by me to all those who are dead in my father's family, to those who are dead in my mother's family, to those kinsmen, elders, fathers-in-law or other relatives who are dead,…

verses.sanskrit: गोपेशं कपिलेशं च वैद्यनाथमनुत्तमम् । पिङ्गलेश्वरतीर्थं च सैन्धवायतनं महत्
verses.transliteration: gopeśaṃ kapileśaṃ ca vaidyanāthamanuttamam / piṅgaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca saindhavāyatanaṃ mahat
verses.translation: I am offering this Pinda with Svadha to all these: Those who are born in my father's family ever since the days of god Brahma; those who are born in my mother's family; those who had been my servants in both these families; to those attendants and dependents, to the friends, disciples, animals, trees, birds seen or not seen, those who had rendered help unto me; those who had been in contact with me in my previous births".
verses.hindi: ११२० वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: I am offering this Pinda with Svadha to all these: Those who are born in my father's family ever since the days of god Brahma; those who are born in my mother's family; those who had been my servants in both these families; to those attendants and dependents, to the friends,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I am offering this Pinda with Svadha to all these: Those who are born in my father's family ever since the days of god Brahma; those who are born in my mother's family; those who had been my servants in both these families; to those attendants and dependents, to the friends,…

verses.sanskrit: भूतीश्वराह्वयं तीर्थं गङ्गावाहमतः परम् । गौतमेश्वरतीर्थं च दशाश्वमेधिकं तथा
verses.transliteration: bhūtīśvarāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ gaṅgāvāhamataḥ param / gautameśvaratīrthaṃ ca daśāśvamedhikaṃ tathā
verses.translation: With these Mantras the pilgrim should offer the Pindas to the women too, beginning with mother. In that case he should make necessary changes in the substantives and adjec¬ tives making them conform to the feminine gender.
verses.hindi: मानसं हि सरो हात्र तस्मादुत्तरमानसम् । सूर्य नत्वाध्चेयित्वाइथ सुर्यलोक नयेत्पितृन् ३४ मध्ये कनखलं तीर्थ त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्वुतम् । स्नातः कनकव-्भाति नरो याति पवित्रताम् ७ तस्य दक्षिणभागे च तोर्थ दक्षिणमानसम् । दक्षिणे मानसे चव तीथ्थ॑त्रयमुदाहतम् ८ स्‍्नात्वा तेषु विधानेन कुर्याच्छादं प्रथक्पृथक् । दक्षिण मानसे स्तानं करोम्यात्मविशुद्धये ६ सुयेलोकादिसंसिद्धिसिद्धये पितृमुक्तये । ब्रह्महत्यादिषापौधयातनाया विमुक्तये ३१०
verses.wordMeaning: With these Mantras the pilgrim should offer the Pindas to the women too, beginning with mother. In that case he should make necessary changes in the substantives and adjec¬ tives making them conform to the feminine gender.
verses.commentary: Sense: With these Mantras the pilgrim should offer the Pindas to the women too, beginning with mother. In that case he should make necessary changes in the substantives and adjec¬ tives making them conform to the feminine gender.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुतीर्थं तथा पुण्यं ख्याता सौभाग्यसुन्दरी । वृषखातं च तत्रैव केदारं धूतपातकम्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgutīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ khyātā saubhāgyasundarī / vṛṣakhātaṃ ca tatraiva kedāraṃ dhūtapātakam
verses.translation: Whether in one's own Gotra or in the other man's Gotra, the offering of the Pindas, the performance of Sraddhas and the water libation is futile if done separately.
verses.hindi: दिवाकर करोमीह स्नान दक्षिणमानसे । सूर्य नत्वाध्चेयित्वा च सुयेलोक॑ नयेत्पितुन्
verses.wordMeaning: Whether in one's own Gotra or in the other man's Gotra, the offering of the Pindas, the performance of Sraddhas and the water libation is futile if done separately.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether in one's own Gotra or in the other man's Gotra, the offering of the Pindas, the performance of Sraddhas and the water libation is futile if done separately.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं धूतेश्वरीसङ्गमेरण्डीसंज्ञकं तथा । तीर्थं च कनकेश्वर्या ज्वालेश्वरं ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ dhūteśvarīsaṅgameraṇḍīsaṃjñakaṃ tathā / tīrthaṃ ca kanakeśvaryā jvāleśvaraṃ tataḥ param
verses.translation: He should put the gingelly seeds in the vessel of Pindas and fill it with holy water. He should perform the Parisecana rite thrice for all the Pindas and conclude the rite by prostra¬ ting himself (before them).
verses.hindi: कर रहा हूं । स्तान के लिए तर्पण करने के उपरान्त पिण्ड श्राद्ध करे । मानस नामक सरोवर यहाँ वर्तमान है अत: उसका उत्तर मानस नाम पड़ा है। वहाँ सूर्य कों नमस्कार एवं पूजन करने वाला अपने पितरों को सूयों लोक पहुंचाता है ।३-४ परम ऐश्वयंशाली, पालक, चन्द्रमा, मज्भल, बुध, बुहस्पति शुक्र, शनि, राहु एवं केतु स्वरूप सूर्य देव को हमारा नमस्कार है ।” इस प्रकार सूर्य को नमस्कार करने के उपरान्त मौन घारण कर उत्तर मानस से दक्षिण मानस की यात्रा करनी चाहिए । वह उदीचीो का तीर्थ कहा जाता है, वह ओदीच्य तीथे विमुक्ति देनेवाला है; इस तीर्थ में स्नान करनेवाला मनुष्य अपने शरीर से स्वर लोक को प्राप्त करता है ।५-९। तीनों लोकों में विश्यात कनखल नामक तीर्थ मध्यभाग में अव- स्थित है, वहाँ स्नाव करने वाला मनुष्य सुबर्ण की तरह कान्तिशाली एवं परम पुनीत होता है। उसके
verses.wordMeaning: He should put the gingelly seeds in the vessel of Pindas and fill it with holy water. He should perform the Parisecana rite thrice for all the Pindas and conclude the rite by prostra¬ ting himself (before them).
verses.commentary: Sense: He should put the gingelly seeds in the vessel of Pindas and fill it with holy water. He should perform the Parisecana rite thrice for all the Pindas and conclude the rite by prostra¬ ting himself (before them).

verses.sanskrit: शालग्रामाह्वयं तीर्थं सोमनाथमनुत्तमम् । तथैवोदीर्णवाराहं तीर्थं चन्द्रप्रभासकम्
verses.transliteration: śālagrāmāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ somanāthamanuttamam / tathaivodīrṇavārāhaṃ tīrthaṃ candraprabhāsakam
verses.translation: After ritualistically dismissing the Pitrs, he should per¬ form Acamana and express these words to Suras as witnesses.
verses.hindi: दक्षिगभाग में दक्षिण मानस नामक तीर्थ है, दक्षिण मानस में तोन तो्थ कहे जाते हैं । इन तीनों तोर्थों में विधिपूर्वंक स्नान पृथक पृथक श्राद्ध कर्मे सम्पन्न करना चाहिए ! आत्म विशुद्धि के लिये दक्षिण मानस में स्नान कर रहा हूँ ।७-६। सूर्य लोक प्रभृति लोकों में प्राप्त होने वालो सिद्धियों की प्राप्ति के लिये पितरों की मुक्ति के लिये, ब्रह्मह॒त्या, घोर पाप कर्मों एवं यातनाओं से छटकारा प्राप्त करने के लिये, है दिवाकर देव ! में
verses.wordMeaning: After ritualistically dismissing the Pitrs, he should per¬ form Acamana and express these words to Suras as witnesses.
verses.commentary: Sense: After ritualistically dismissing the Pitrs, he should per¬ form Acamana and express these words to Suras as witnesses.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशादित्यतीर्थं च तथा सिद्धेश्वराभिधम् । कपिलेश्वरतीर्थं च तथा त्रैविक्रमं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśādityatīrthaṃ ca tathā siddheśvarābhidham / kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā traivikramaṃ śubham
verses.translation: O Lord Gadadhara, I have come to Gaya for the performance of the rites of the Pitrs. 1 O Lord, you alone are the witness thereof. I have become free from the threefold indebtedness".
verses.hindi: इस दक्षिण मानस तीर्थ में स्तान कर रहा हूँ, इस प्रकाश सू्यं को नमस्कार एवं पूजित कर मनुष्य अपने पितरों को स्वर लोक पहुंचाता है ।०-११। है सूय्य देव ! मैं आप को तृप्ति एवं पितरों को तारने के लिये नमस्कार कर  इदमर्ध न क. पुस्तके । + एतदग्रेई्यं इलोक: क. पुस्तके टिप्पण्याम्ू-अनेन स्नानदानादि कृत्वा श्राद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord Gadadhara, I have come to Gaya for the performance of the rites of the Pitrs. 1 O Lord, you alone are the witness thereof. I have become free from the threefold indebtedness".
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord Gadadhara, I have come to Gaya for the performance of the rites of the Pitrs. 1 O Lord, you alone are the witness thereof. I have become free from the threefold indebtedness".

verses.sanskrit: विश्वरूपाह्वयं तीर्थं नारायणकृतं तथा । मूलश्रीपतितीर्थं च चौलश्रीपतिसंज्ञकम्
verses.transliteration: viśvarūpāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇakṛtaṃ tathā / mūlaśrīpatitīrthaṃ ca caulaśrīpatisaṃjñakam
verses.translation: O Narada, the offering of Pindas in all the places should be like this alone. Beginning with the Preta mountain, he should do it in all the holy spots in due order.
verses.hindi: बरेत्  इति खर. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: O Narada, the offering of Pindas in all the places should be like this alone. Beginning with the Preta mountain, he should do it in all the holy spots in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Narada, the offering of Pindas in all the places should be like this alone. Beginning with the Preta mountain, he should do it in all the holy spots in due order.

verses.sanskrit: देवतीर्थं हंसतीर्थ प्रभासं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । मूलस्थानं च कण्ठेशमट्टहासमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: devatīrthaṃ haṃsatīrtha prabhāsaṃ tīrthamuttamam / mūlasthānaṃ ca kaṇṭheśamaṭṭahāsamataḥ param
verses.translation: Thereafter, O celestial sage, he should throw powdered fried grains mixed with gingelly seeds on the Pretaparvata, anticlockwise and facing the south.
verses.hindi: एकादशाधिकशततमोः्ध्याय: ११२१ ब्रह्मणा प्राथितो विष्णुः फल्गुको हाभवत्पुरा। दक्षिणाग्नौ हुतं तत्न तद्रजः फल्गुतीर्थथषम् 0.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, O celestial sage, he should throw powdered fried grains mixed with gingelly seeds on the Pretaparvata, anticlockwise and facing the south.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O celestial sage, he should throw powdered fried grains mixed with gingelly seeds on the Pretaparvata, anticlockwise and facing the south.

verses.sanskrit: भूर्भुवेश्वरतीर्थं च ख्याता शूलेश्वरी तथा । सारस्वतं दारुकेशमश्विनोस्तीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: bhūrbhuveśvaratīrthaṃ ca khyātā śūleśvarī tathā / sārasvataṃ dārukeśamaśvinostīrthamuttamam
verses.translation: To request the supreme deity of Gaya to stand witness to one's visit may appear funny to some, but that denotes the living faith of the pilgrim in Gadadhara.
verses.hindi: नमः शिवाय देवाय ईशाय पुरुषाय वे । अघोरवामदेवाय सद्योजाताय शंभवे द
verses.wordMeaning: To request the supreme deity of Gaya to stand witness to one's visit may appear funny to some, but that denotes the living faith of the pilgrim in Gadadhara.
verses.commentary: Sense: To request the supreme deity of Gaya to stand witness to one's visit may appear funny to some, but that denotes the living faith of the pilgrim in Gadadhara.

verses.sanskrit: सावित्रीतीर्थमतुलं वालखिल्येश्वरं तथा । नर्मदेशं मातृतीर्थं देवतीर्थमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sāvitrītīrthamatulaṃ vālakhilyeśvaraṃ tathā / narmadeśaṃ mātṛtīrthaṃ devatīrthamanuttamam
verses.translation: Mantra: "May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated by means of these powdered fried grains mixed with gingelly seeds, those Pitrs who exist in the form of ghosts.
verses.hindi: फल्गुतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वा देव॑ गदाधरम् ॥ आत्मान तारयेत्सथो दश पूुर्वानच्दशापरानू रहा हूं, पुत्र, पौत्र, घन, ऐश्वयं, आयु एवं आरोग्य की वृद्धि के लिये नमस्कार कर रहा हूं। तदननन्‍्तर सभी तीथों में श्रेष्ठ फल्गुतीर्थ की यात्रा करनी चाहिए, वहाँ पर श्राद्ध करने से करने वालों की एबं उनके पितरों की सवंदा मुक्ति होती है । ब्रह्मा की प्राथंता पर प्राचीन काल में भगवान् विष्णु स्वयं फल्गु रूप में प्रतिष्ठित हुए । यज्ञ की दक्षिणारिनि में आहुति रूप में पड़ा हुआ रज फल्गुती्थ के रूप में प्रसिद्ध हुआ ।१२-१४॥ निखिल
verses.wordMeaning: Mantra: "May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated by means of these powdered fried grains mixed with gingelly seeds, those Pitrs who exist in the form of ghosts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mantra: "May all those Pitrs of mine be propitiated by means of these powdered fried grains mixed with gingelly seeds, those Pitrs who exist in the form of ghosts.

verses.sanskrit: मच्छकेश्वरतीर्थं च शिखितीर्थं च शोभनम् । कोटितीर्थं मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तत्र कोटीश्वरी मृडा
verses.transliteration: macchakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca śikhitīrthaṃ ca śobhanam / koṭitīrthaṃ muniśreṣṭhāstatra koṭīśvarī mṛḍā
verses.translation: May all the mobile and immobile beings begin¬ ning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass be propitia¬ ted by means of the libation offered by me. O Narada, his Pitrs shall be released from ghosthood. Thanks to his great¬ ness, this ghosthood will never recur in his family.
verses.hindi: भवन मण्डल में जितने भी दीर्थ समूह हैं वे देवताओं के साथ इस फल्युतीर्थ में स्नान करने के लिये आते हूँ गड्भा भगवान् विष्णु की पादोदक स्वरूप हैं, किन्तु फल्गु तो स्वयं आदि भदाधर स्वरूप है स्वयं द्रव रूप में वे आदि गदाधर की मूर्ति हैं, यही कारण है कि गज्भा से अधिक उनका माहात््म्य लोग बतलाते हैं ।(५-१६। जो व्यक्ति एक लाख अश्बमेघ यज्ञ करता है, वह भी इतना फल बहीं प्राप्त करता, जितना फल्यु में स्नान
verses.wordMeaning: May all the mobile and immobile beings begin¬ ning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass be propitia¬ ted by means of the libation offered by me. O Narada, his Pitrs shall be released from ghosthood. Thanks to his great¬ ness, this ghosthood will never recur in his family.
verses.commentary: Sense: May all the mobile and immobile beings begin¬ ning with Brahma and ending with a blade of grass be propitia¬ ted by means of the libation offered by me. O Narada, his Pitrs shall be released from ghosthood. Thanks to his great¬ ness, this ghosthood will never recur in his family.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं पैतामहं नाम माण्डव्ये श्वरसंज्ञितम् । तत्र नारायणेशं च अक्रूरेशमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ paitāmahaṃ nāma māṇḍavye śvarasaṃjñitam / tatra nārāyaṇeśaṃ ca akrūreśamataḥ param
verses.translation: At the outset, I shall mention the procedure for holy rites in the five holy centres 1 in the Uttara (Northern) Manasa. 2 The pilgrim should perform Acamana and sprinkle water over his head. Then he should go to the Uttaramanasa and perform

verses.translation: As I stated elsewhere, these Sthala Puranas claim ail the sacr ed spots in the three worlds as being present in their locality. The real Uttara Manasa is a twin-lake of Payoda and Pundarika. It is modern Karakul in northern Pamirs (AG ), while Southern Manasa is the twin take Manasa-sarovara and Raksasa Tala of the Kailasa range. But this Purana claims two ponds at Gaya as representing those two magnificent lakes.
verses.hindi: ११२२ वायुपुराणमे नत्वा गवाधरं मन्‍्त्रेणानेन पुजयेत् । ओं नमो वासुदेवाय नमः संकर्षणाय च ॥।

verses.translation: The holy centre Kanakhala which is well known in the three worlds is there. One taking bath there, shines like gold. The man attains sanctity.

verses.commentary: Sense: O Divakara (Sun), I am taking my holy bath here in Daksinamanasa for the sake of freedom from the torture of the sins of Brahmana-slaughter etc.

verses.transliteration: daritadhvāntaśamanīdhāryā dharmārthibhiḥ sadā / ahorātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sakṛjjaptvāśu nāśayet
verses.translation: Phalgutirtha is Gayasiras and its boundaries as given in w. 28-2 > from Nagakuta to Grdhrakuta, from there to Yupa and upto Uttara-manasa. It is beneath the mountain Mundaprsfha-A -25-26 and G.P. • differ.
verses.hindi: यागं कृत्वोत्यितो यूपो ब्रह्मणा यूप इत्यसो । कृत्वा ब्रह्मसरःश्राद्धं सर्वास्तारयते पित॒न् ३३३ यूपं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य वाजपेयफल लमभेत् । ब्रह्माणं च नमस्कृत्य ब्रह्मलोक नयेत्पित॒न् नमोषस्तु बरह्मणेडजाय जगज्जन्मादिरूपिणे। भक्तानां च पित॒णां च तारकाय नमो नमः
verses.wordMeaning: Phalgutirtha is Gayasiras and its boundaries as given in w. 28-2 > from Nagakuta to Grdhrakuta, from there to Yupa and upto Uttara-manasa. It is beneath the mountain Mundaprsfha-A -25-26 and G.P. • differ.
verses.commentary: Sense: Phalgutirtha is Gayasiras and its boundaries as given in w. 28-2 > from Nagakuta to Grdhrakuta, from there to Yupa and upto Uttara-manasa. It is beneath the mountain Mundaprsfha-A -25-26 and G.P. • differ.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकालं जप्त्वा मासोत्थं शिवाग्रे च त्रिमासिकम् । मासं जप्त्वाथ वर्षोत्थं वर्षं जप्त्वा शताब्दिकम्
verses.transliteration: trikālaṃ japtvā māsotthaṃ śivāgre ca trimāsikam / māsaṃ japtvātha varṣotthaṃ varṣaṃ japtvā śatābdikam
verses.translation: After taking bath in Phalgutlrtha and visiting lord Gadadhara, the man (the pilgrim) shall redeem his own soul, ten generations of the past and ten generations of the future. After bowing to Lord Gadadhara, one should wor¬ ship by means of this Mantra: "Om, obeisance to Vasudeva. Obeisance to Sarikarsana, to Pradyumna, to Aniruddha, to Srldhara, to Visnu". After performing the ablution in the "five holy centres", the pilgrim shall lead the Pitrs to Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: गोप्रचारसमीपस्था आम्रा ब्रह्मप्रकल्पिताः । तेषां सेचनमात्रेण पितरो मोक्षगामिनः (णा)
verses.wordMeaning: After taking bath in Phalgutlrtha and visiting lord Gadadhara, the man (the pilgrim) shall redeem his own soul, ten generations of the past and ten generations of the future. After bowing to Lord Gadadhara, one should wor¬ ship by means of this Mantra: "Om,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After taking bath in Phalgutlrtha and visiting lord Gadadhara, the man (the pilgrim) shall redeem his own soul, ten generations of the past and ten generations of the future. After bowing to Lord Gadadhara, one should wor¬ ship by means of this Mantra: "Om,…

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धकाले च विप्राणां भुञ्जतां पुरतः स्थितः । पठंस्तीर्थावलिं पुण्यां गयाश्राद्धप्रदो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhakāle ca viprāṇāṃ bhuñjatāṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ / paṭhaṃstīrthāvaliṃ puṇyāṃ gayāśrāddhaprado bhavet
verses.translation: Futile indeed is the Sraddha of that person who does not bathe the mace-bearing deity by means of Pancamrta nor embellishes it with flowers, garments etc.
verses.hindi: यूप के मध्यभाग में श्राद्धादि सम्पन्न करनेवाला मनुष्य अपने समस्त पितरों का उद्धार करता है। वहाँ पर धर्म धर्मेशंवर को नमस्कार कर महाबोधि वक्ष को नमस्कार करना चाहिए ।२४-२७। ब्रह्मा, विष्णु एवं शिवस्वरूप ! अव्वत्यथ राज ! बोधि वक्ष ! आपको हमारा नमस्कार है। यहाँ पर श्राद्धादि सम्पन्न करनेवाले एवं उसके पितरों के तारने के लिये मैं यह क्रिया कर रहा हूँ । हमारे पिता के तथा माता के वंश में उत्पन्न होकर जो बान्धवगण दुर्गंति भोग रहे हैं, वे तुम्हारे दशंन एवं स्पश्न के करने से सबंदा के लिए स्वगलोक की प्राप्ति करें। वृक्षराज ! इस गयापुरी में आकर मैं अपने तीनों ऋणों से मक्त हो गया हूँ, तुम्हारी कृपा से मैं महान् पापों से विमुक्त हो गया हें ।३८-३०। तीसरे दिन ब्रह्मससरोवर में स्नान कर सभी प्रकार की विधियों से संयुक्त, मन्त्रोच्चारण करके सपिण्ड श्राद्ध करे। तीनों ऋणों की मुक्ति प्राप्त करने
verses.wordMeaning: Futile indeed is the Sraddha of that person who does not bathe the mace-bearing deity by means of Pancamrta nor embellishes it with flowers, garments etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Futile indeed is the Sraddha of that person who does not bathe the mace-bearing deity by means of Pancamrta nor embellishes it with flowers, garments etc.

verses.sanskrit: पूजाकाले च देवानां श्रद्धया पुरतः पठन् । प्रीणयेत्सर्वदेवांश्च पुनाति सकलं कुलम्
verses.transliteration: pūjākāle ca devānāṃ śraddhayā purataḥ paṭhan / prīṇayetsarvadevāṃśca punāti sakalaṃ kulam
verses.translation: From the Nagakuta mountain to Gfdhrakuta, from there to Tupa and from there upto Uttaramanasa—This is men¬ tioned as Gayasiras. It is otherwise called Phalgutlrtha. The excellent Phalgutlrtha is beneath the mountain Mundaprstha. All the Pitrs shall attain salvation by means of the performance of Sraddha etc.
verses.hindi: की कामना से मैं इस तोथे में स्नान कर रहा हूं, इस प्रकार उस कूप ओर यूप के मध्य में श्राद्ध सम्पन्न करने वाला व्यक्ति अपने पितरों को ब्रह्मलोक पहुँचाता है। ब्रह्मा ने यज्ञ समाप्ति के बाद उक्त यूप (यज्ञ समस्त) की प्रतिष्ठा की थी, तभी से उसकी प्रसिद्धि है, ब्रह्म सरोवर में श्राद्ध करके मनुष्य अपने सभी पितरों को तारता है ।३१-३३। उक्त यूप की प्रदक्षिणा करके वाजपेय यज्ञ की फल-प्राप्ति होती है। ब्रह्मा को नमस्कार करने
verses.wordMeaning: From the Nagakuta mountain to Gfdhrakuta, from there to Tupa and from there upto Uttaramanasa—This is men¬ tioned as Gayasiras. It is otherwise called Phalgutlrtha. The excellent Phalgutlrtha is beneath the mountain Mundaprstha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: From the Nagakuta mountain to Gfdhrakuta, from there to Tupa and from there upto Uttaramanasa—This is men¬ tioned as Gayasiras. It is otherwise called Phalgutlrtha. The excellent Phalgutlrtha is beneath the mountain Mundaprstha.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं तीर्थावलिः पुण्या रेवातीरद्वयाश्रिता । मया प्रोक्ता मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तथैवशृणुतानघाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tīrthāvaliḥ puṇyā revātīradvayāśritā / mayā proktā muniśreṣṭhāstathaivaśṛṇutānaghāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the procedure of the first day has been explained. The Second Day:
verses.hindi: वाला अपने पितरों को ब्रह्मलोक की प्राप्ति कराता है। अजन्मा, निखिल चराचर जगत् के आदि कर्ता भगवान् ब्रह्मा को हमारा नमस्कार है, अपने भक्तों एवं पितरों के उद्धारक ब्रह्माजी को बारम्बार हमारा नमस्कार है ।३४-३४। गोत्रचार के समीप में ब्रह्मा द्वारा लग्राये गये आमम्र के वक्ष हैं, उनके सोंचने मात्र से पितरगण मोक्ष के अधिकारी हो जाते हैं ब्रह्मसरोवर में उत्पन्न होनेवाले आम्र के बक्ष ब्रह्मदेव मय हैं, स्वयं + नास्त्यधें मिंदं ख. पुस्तके ।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the procedure of the first day has been explained. The Second Day:
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the procedure of the first day has been explained. The Second Day:

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे तीर्थावलिकथनं त्रिंशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २३१ श्रीसूत उवाच: तथैव तीर्थस्तबकान् वक्ष्येऽहम् ऋषिसत्तमाः । यैस्तु तीर्थावलीगुम्फः पूर्वोक्तैरेकतः कृतः
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tīrthāvalikathanaṃ triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 231 śrīsūta uvāca: tathaiva tīrthastabakān vakṣye'ham ṛṣisattamāḥ / yaistu tīrthāvalīgumphaḥ pūrvoktairekataḥ kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O Narada, he who performs ablutions, Tarpana and Sraddha in the MatangavapI (the tank of Matanga) obtains Brahmaloka by going to Dharmaranya.
verses.hindi: ११२३ जायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Narada, he who performs ablutions, Tarpana and Sraddha in the MatangavapI (the tank of Matanga) obtains Brahmaloka by going to Dharmaranya.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Narada, he who performs ablutions, Tarpana and Sraddha in the MatangavapI (the tank of Matanga) obtains Brahmaloka by going to Dharmaranya.

verses.sanskrit: विभक्तो भक्तलोकानामानन्दप्रथनः शुभः । मृकण्डतनयः पूर्वं प्राह पार्थाय पृच्छते
verses.transliteration: vibhakto bhaktalokānāmānandaprathanaḥ śubhaḥ / mṛkaṇḍatanayaḥ pūrvaṃ prāha pārthāya pṛcchate
verses.translation: After going to MatangavapI the pilgrim should bow down to Matangesa and repeat this Mantras: "May the deities be the authority and may the guardians of the quarters be the witnesses (to the fact that) I had come to this MatangavapI and the redemption of the Pitrs has been effected by me".
verses.hindi: आम्र ब्रह्मसरोद्भूतं ब्रह्मदेवमयं तरुम् । विष्णुरूपं प्रसिआअचामि पितणां मुक्तिहेतवे  एको मुनिः कुम्भकुशाग्रहस्त आम्रस्य मुले सलिलं ददानः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After going to MatangavapI the pilgrim should bow down to Matangesa and repeat this Mantras: "May the deities be the authority and may the guardians of the quarters be the witnesses (to the fact that) I had come to this MatangavapI and the redemption of the Pitrs has been effect…
verses.commentary: Sense: After going to MatangavapI the pilgrim should bow down to Matangesa and repeat this Mantras: "May the deities be the authority and may the guardians of the quarters be the witnesses (to the fact that) I had come to this MatangavapI and the redemption of the Pitrs has been effect…

verses.sanskrit: यथा तथाहं वक्ष्यामि तीर्थानां स्तबकानिह । शिवाम्बुपानजा पुण्या रेवा कल्पलता किल
verses.transliteration: yathā tathāhaṃ vakṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ stabakāniha / śivāmbupānajā puṇyā revā kalpalatā kila
verses.translation: The second day of Fanca TIrthI Yatra is the 4th day from entrance at Gaya. NP.II.45.103-104, A 34-37 mention these very Tirthas on the 'second day*.
verses.hindi: आम्रश्न सिक्तः पितरश्न तृप्ता एका किया द्वयर्थंकरी प्रसिद्धा  ॥रे८ ततो यमबलि दद्यान्मस्श्रेणानेन संयतः । यमराजधर्म राजो निश्चलार्थं व्यवस्थितो '
verses.wordMeaning: The second day of Fanca TIrthI Yatra is the 4th day from entrance at Gaya. NP.II.45.103-104, A 34-37 mention these very Tirthas on the 'second day*.
verses.commentary: Sense: The second day of Fanca TIrthI Yatra is the 4th day from entrance at Gaya. NP.II.45.103-104, A 34-37 mention these very Tirthas on the 'second day*.

verses.sanskrit: तीरद्वयोद्भूततीर्थप्रसूनैः पुष्पिता शुभा । यत्पुण्यगन्धलक्ष्म्या वै त्रैलोक्यं सुरभीकृतम्
verses.transliteration: tīradvayodbhūtatīrthaprasūnaiḥ puṣpitā śubhā / yatpuṇyagandhalakṣmyā vai trailokyaṃ surabhīkṛtam
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you the king of ASvatthas (holy fig trees), of the form of Brahma, Visnu and Siva, the tree of enlightenment (. Bodhidruma] ) J for the performers (of Sraddha etc.) and the redeemer of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: ततः काकर्बाल दह्यान्मन्त्रेणानेन नारद । ऐन्द्रवारणवायव्ययाम्या वे नऋतास्तथा ॥ विष्णु के स्वरूप हैं, पितरों की झृक्ति की कामना से मैं इतका सिज्चन कर रहा हूँ । अपने हाथों में घड़ा और कुश लेकर एक मूनि आम्र के मूल में जल देते हुये आम्र को सींचते हैं, और अपने पितरगणों की भी तृप्ति करते हैं, उनकी एक ही क्रिया दो प्रयोजनों की सिद्धि करने में प्रसिद्धि हुईं। तदनन्तर इस मन्त्र से स्वस्थ चित्त होकर यमराज को बलि प्रदान करना चाहिए। यमराज और धर्मंशज-ये दोनों गयासुर को
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance to you the king of ASvatthas (holy fig trees), of the form of Brahma, Visnu and Siva, the tree of enlightenment (. Bodhidruma] ) J for the performers (of Sraddha etc.) and the redeemer of the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance to you the king of ASvatthas (holy fig trees), of the form of Brahma, Visnu and Siva, the tree of enlightenment (. Bodhidruma] ) J for the performers (of Sraddha etc.) and the redeemer of the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पुष्पमकरन्दस्य रसास्वादविदुत्तमः । भ्रमरः खलु मार्कण्डो मुनिर्मतिमतां वरः
verses.transliteration: tatpuṣpamakarandasya rasāsvādaviduttamaḥ / bhramaraḥ khalu mārkaṇḍo munirmatimatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Repeated obeisance to the Asvattha (the holy fig tree), the tree with tremulous leaves, the cause of permanent stabilisa¬ tion. Obeisance toYajna, the Bodhisattva.
verses.hindi: निशचल करने के लिये यहाँ विशेष रूप से स्थित हैं। अपने पितरों की मृक्ति की कामना से मैं उन दोनों को बलि प्रदान कर रहा हूँ ।३६-३९। नारदजो ! तदनन्तर इवानों के लिये बलि प्रदान करना चाहिए, वैवस्वत के कुल में उत्पन्न होनेवाले जो दोनों इ्यामल और चितकबरे हवान हैं, उन्हें, मैं बलि दे रहा हूँ, वे माद्थ में सर्वदा हमारी रक्षा करें ।४० नारद जी ! तदनन्तर काकों के लिये बलि प्रदान करना चाहिए । पूर्व, पश्चिम, वायव्य,
verses.wordMeaning: Repeated obeisance to the Asvattha (the holy fig tree), the tree with tremulous leaves, the cause of permanent stabilisa¬ tion. Obeisance toYajna, the Bodhisattva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeated obeisance to the Asvattha (the holy fig tree), the tree with tremulous leaves, the cause of permanent stabilisa¬ tion. Obeisance toYajna, the Bodhisattva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पुष्पमालां हृदये तीर्थस्तबकचित्रिताम् । दधाति सततं पुण्यां मुनिर्भृगुकुलोद्वहः । तस्याः स्तबकसंस्थानं वक्ष्ये ऽहम् ऋषिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tatpuṣpamālāṃ hṛdaye tīrthastabakacitritām / dadhāti satataṃ puṇyāṃ munirbhṛgukulodvahaḥ / tasyāḥ stabakasaṃsthānaṃ vakṣye 'ham ṛṣisattamāḥ
verses.translation: O Pippala, you are the eleventh among Rudras. You are the fire among Vasus; you are Narayana among Devas. You are the king of trees.
verses.hindi: दक्षिण, नेऋत कोण एवं दिशाओं में रहनेवाले वायस गण ! मैंने आप लोगों के लिये पृथ्वी पर इस पिण्ड को समर्पित किया है, इसे ग्रहण कीजिये । तदनन्तर चौथे दिन फल्गुतीर्थ में स्नानादि करना चाहिए। फिर गयाशिर पर स्थित विष्णु पद पर सपिण्ड श्राद्ध कर्म सम्पन्न करना चाहिए। वहीं पर गयासुर का साक्षात् शिरोभाग़ है, यह फल्गुतीर्थ उसी के शिरोभाग पर अवस्थित है ।४१-४२। नाग, जनाद॑न ब्रह्यूप और उत्तर ८ इत उत्तरमेतदर्ध विद्यते ख. पुस्तके तथभा--यूप॑ प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य वाजपेयफलं लभेत ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Pippala, you are the eleventh among Rudras. You are the fire among Vasus; you are Narayana among Devas. You are the king of trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Pippala, you are the eleventh among Rudras. You are the fire among Vasus; you are Narayana among Devas. You are the king of trees.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारतीर्थमारभ्य यावत्पश्चिमसागरम् । संगमाः पञ्चत्रिंशद्वै नदीनां पापनाशनाः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāratīrthamārabhya yāvatpaścimasāgaram / saṃgamāḥ pañcatriṃśadvai nadīnāṃ pāpanāśanāḥ
verses.translation: O Asvattha, king of trees since Narayana stays in you perpetually, you are the most auspicious of all trees; you are blessed for ever; you are the destroyer of evil dreams.
verses.hindi: एकादशाधिकशततमो5्ष्याथा... द १९२५
verses.wordMeaning: O Asvattha, king of trees since Narayana stays in you perpetually, you are the most auspicious of all trees; you are blessed for ever; you are the destroyer of evil dreams.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Asvattha, king of trees since Narayana stays in you perpetually, you are the most auspicious of all trees; you are blessed for ever; you are the destroyer of evil dreams.

verses.sanskrit: दशैकमुत्तरे तीरे सत्रिविंशति दक्षिणे । पञ्चत्रिंशत्तमः श्रेष्ठो रेवासागरसङ्गमः
verses.transliteration: daśaikamuttare tīre satriviṃśati dakṣiṇe / pañcatriṃśattamaḥ śreṣṭho revāsāgarasaṅgamaḥ
verses.translation: I bow down to Hari who has assumed the form of a tree, who is in the form of the Asvattha tree, who is the lord Pundarlkaksa (Visnu) wielding Sankha, Cakra and Gada.
verses.hindi: पितामहूं समासाद्य यावद्ुत्तरमानसम् । फल्गुतोर्थ तु विज्ञेयं देवानामपि देवानामपि दुलंभभू ॥(४४ मुण्डपृष्ठान्गाधस्तात्साक्षात्तफल्गुतीर्थकम् । आद्यो गदाधरो देवो व्यक्ताव्यक्तात्मना स्थितः ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to Hari who has assumed the form of a tree, who is in the form of the Asvattha tree, who is the lord Pundarlkaksa (Visnu) wielding Sankha, Cakra and Gada.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to Hari who has assumed the form of a tree, who is in the form of the Asvattha tree, who is the lord Pundarlkaksa (Visnu) wielding Sankha, Cakra and Gada.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गमः सहितान्येवं रेवातीरद्वये ऽपि च । चतुःशतानि तीर्थानि प्रसिद्धानि द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: saṅgamaḥ sahitānyevaṃ revātīradvaye 'pi ca / catuḥśatāni tīrthāni prasiddhāni dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: As a result of seeing and touching you, may our kins¬ men, of our family or our mother's family who have been in distress, attain perpetual stay in heaven.
verses.hindi: एतद्विष्णुप्द दिव्य॑ दर्शनात्पापनाशनम् । स्पशेनात्पूजनाद्ाईपि पित॒णां दत्तमक्षयम् (४७ श्राढं सपिण्डक कृत्वा कुलसाहल्रमात्मना। नयेद्विष्णुपदं दिव्यमनस्तं शिवमव्ययम् ४८ श्राद्ध कृत्वा रुद्रपदे नयेत्कुलश्त नरः । सहा5प्त्मना शिवपुरं तथा ब्रह्मपदे नरः ४६ ब्रह्मलोक॑ कुलशतं समुद्धत्य नयेत्पितुन्। कश्यपस्य पदे श्राद्धी ब्रह्मलोक नयेत्पितन् ५०
verses.wordMeaning: As a result of seeing and touching you, may our kins¬ men, of our family or our mother's family who have been in distress, attain perpetual stay in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: As a result of seeing and touching you, may our kins¬ men, of our family or our mother's family who have been in distress, attain perpetual stay in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशतं शिवतीर्थानि त्रयीस्त्रिंशत्समन्वितम् । तत्रापि व्यक्तितो वक्ष्ये शृणुध्वं तानि सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: triśataṃ śivatīrthāni trayīstriṃśatsamanvitam / tatrāpi vyaktito vakṣye śṛṇudhvaṃ tāni sattamāḥ
verses.translation: O king of trees! After coming to Gaya, the three debts have been repaid by me. Thanks to your grace, I have been relieved from the great sin. I have been released from the ocean of worldly existence."
verses.hindi: ... ॒ चऔशन्‍पपप/ज्/ ््ज्््््चञ््ज्अ्आअचिचिचियाआाओओ्मग्ं।ऊएयणय।फफिंओग्तक्त्च्च्टगगका मानस तक यह गया शिर कहा जाता है, उसी को फल्गुतीर्थ भी कहते हैं । ब्रह्मा के स्थान से लेकर उत्तर मानस हक विस्तृत फल्गुतीर्थ को देवताओं के लिये भी दुलंभ समझना चाहिए। क्रौज्चपाद से लेकर गयाशिर तक जो फल्गुतौर्थ है, वह गयासुर का मुख भाग है, इसी कारण से वहाँ पर किया गया श्राद्ध अक्षय फलदाथी है ।४३-४५॥। मृण्ड पृष्ठ गिरि का निम्न प्रदेश भी फल्गुतीं है, वहाँ पर आद्य गदाधर भगवान् अपने व्यक्ता-
verses.wordMeaning: O king of trees! After coming to Gaya, the three debts have been repaid by me. Thanks to your grace, I have been relieved from the great sin. I have been released from the ocean of worldly existence."
verses.commentary: Sense: O king of trees! After coming to Gaya, the three debts have been repaid by me. Thanks to your grace, I have been relieved from the great sin. I have been released from the ocean of worldly existence."

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेश्वरतीर्थानि दश तेषु मुनीश्वराः । दशादित्यभवान्यत्र नवैव कपिलेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthāni daśa teṣu munīśvarāḥ / daśādityabhavānyatra navaiva kapileśvarāḥ
verses.translation: On the third day 1 2 the pilgrim—the son should duly take bath in Brahmasaras and perform Sraddha with the offering of Pindas repeating the Mantra thereof.
verses.hindi: व्यक्त स्वरूप में अवस्थित हैं। पितरों को मुक्ति प्रदान करने के लिये वहाँ भगवान् विष्णु आदि देवताओं के चरण चिह्न विद्यमान हैं ।४६। वह दिव्य विष्णु पद केवल दर्शन करने से घोर पापों को नाश करने वाला है, स्पश एवं पूजत करने से भी पाषों का नाश होता है, वहाँ पर पितरों को दिया गया दान अक्षय फल कारक होता है । सपिण्ड श्राद्ध कम करनेवाला मनुष्य अपने साथ अपने सहखत्र कुल वालों को भी दिव्य, अव्यय,
verses.wordMeaning: On the third day 1 2 the pilgrim—the son should duly take bath in Brahmasaras and perform Sraddha with the offering of Pindas repeating the Mantra thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the third day 1 2 the pilgrim—the son should duly take bath in Brahmasaras and perform Sraddha with the offering of Pindas repeating the Mantra thereof.

verses.sanskrit: सोमसंस्थापितान्यष्टौ तावन्तो नर्मदेश्वराः । कोटितीर्थान्यथाष्टौ च सप्त सिद्धेश्वरास्तथा
verses.transliteration: somasaṃsthāpitānyaṣṭau tāvanto narmadeśvarāḥ / koṭitīrthānyathāṣṭau ca sapta siddheśvarāstathā
verses.translation: The Bodhidruma where the Buddha evolved Pralityasamutpada, be¬
verses.hindi: कल्याणप्रद, अनन्त विष्ण पद को पहुँचाता है ।४७-४५। रुद्र के चरण प्रदेश में श्राद्ध करनेवाला मनुष्य अपने सो कुलों का उद्धार करके उन्हें शिवपुर पहुंचाता है। इसी प्रकार ब्रह्म के चरण प्रदेश में श्राद्ध कम सम्पन्न करनेवाला अपने सौ कुल के पितरगणों का उद्धार कर उन्हें ब्रहमलोक को पहुँचाता है! कश्यप के चरण प्रान्त में श्राद्ध करनेवाला पितरों को ब्रह्यलोक पहुँचाता है, दक्षिणाग्नि पद प्रदेश में श्राद्ध कर्म करनेवाला मनुष्य पितरों को ब्रह्मपुर पहुँचाता है! गाहंपत्य के चरण प्रदेश में श्राद्ध करनमेवाला बाजपेय यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त करता है ।४६-५१॥ आहवनीय अग्नि प्रदेश में श्रा्उड करनेवाला अश्वमेध् यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त करता है।
verses.wordMeaning: The Bodhidruma where the Buddha evolved Pralityasamutpada, be¬
verses.commentary: Sense: The Bodhidruma where the Buddha evolved Pralityasamutpada, be¬

verses.sanskrit: नागेश्वराश्च सप्तैव रेवातीरद्वये ऽपि तु । सप्तैव वह्निविहितान्यथाप्यावर्तसप्तकम्
verses.transliteration: nāgeśvarāśca saptaiva revātīradvaye 'pi tu / saptaiva vahnivihitānyathāpyāvartasaptakam
verses.translation: The 3rd day of Pancatirthi is the 5th day from entering Gaya. Some of the rites mentioned here are found in A 35-40 and NP* II* 4
verses.hindi: इृदम्घ न विद्यते ख. पुस्तके।
verses.wordMeaning: The 3rd day of Pancatirthi is the 5th day from entering Gaya. Some of the rites mentioned here are found in A 35-40 and NP* II* 4
verses.commentary: Sense: The 3rd day of Pancatirthi is the 5th day from entering Gaya. Some of the rites mentioned here are found in A 35-40 and NP* II* 4

verses.sanskrit: केदारेश्वरतीर्थानि पञ्च पञ्चेन्द्रजानि च । वरुणेशाश्च पञ्चैव पञ्चैव धनदेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: kedāreśvaratīrthāni pañca pañcendrajāni ca / varuṇeśāśca pañcaiva pañcaiva dhanadeśvarāḥ
verses.translation: "I am performing.the ablution in this holy Tirtha for the relief from the three debts". (Sraddha performed) in the middle of Kupa (well) and Yupa (the sacrificial post) shall lead the Pitrs to Brahmaloka"
verses.hindi: ११२६ वायुपुराणम् आवसब्यपदे श्राद्धी पितन्ब्रह्मपुरं नयेत् । श्राद्ध कृत्वा शक्नपदे इन्द्रलोक॑ नयेत्पित न्
verses.wordMeaning: "I am performing.the ablution in this holy Tirtha for the relief from the three debts". (Sraddha performed) in the middle of Kupa (well) and Yupa (the sacrificial post) shall lead the Pitrs to Brahmaloka"
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am performing.the ablution in this holy Tirtha for the relief from the three debts". (Sraddha performed) in the middle of Kupa (well) and Yupa (the sacrificial post) shall lead the Pitrs to Brahmaloka"

verses.sanskrit: देवतीर्थानि पञ्चैव चत्वारो वै यमेश्वराः । वैद्यनाथाश्च चत्वारश्चत्वारो वानरेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: devatīrthāni pañcaiva catvāro vai yameśvarāḥ / vaidyanāthāśca catvāraścatvāro vānareśvarāḥ
verses.translation: This Yupa (sacrificial post) was raised by Brahma after performing the sacrifice. After performing this Sraddha in Brahmasaras, he redeems all the Phi's.
verses.hindi: अगस्त्यस्य पदे श्राद्धी पितुन्ब्रह्मपुरं नयेत् । क्रोअचमातडूगयोः श्राद्धी ब्रह्मलोक॑ नयेत्पितूनू
verses.wordMeaning: This Yupa (sacrificial post) was raised by Brahma after performing the sacrifice. After performing this Sraddha in Brahmasaras, he redeems all the Phi's.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Yupa (sacrificial post) was raised by Brahma after performing the sacrifice. After performing this Sraddha in Brahmasaras, he redeems all the Phi's.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गारेश्वरतीर्थानि तावन्त्येव मुनीश्वराः । सारस्वतानि चत्वारि चत्वारो दारुकेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: aṅgāreśvaratīrthāni tāvantyeva munīśvarāḥ / sārasvatāni catvāri catvāro dārukeśvarāḥ
verses.translation: After circumambulating the Yupa, one attains the fruit ofVajapeya sacrifice. After bowing down to Brahma, he will lead the Pitrs to Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धी सूयंपदे पठझच पापिनो3र्कपुरं नयेत् । कातिकेयपदे श्राद्धी शिवलोक॑ नयेत्पित॒न् गणेशस्य पदे श्राद्धी रुद्रलोक नयेत्पितुन  गजकर्णतर्पणक्रन्निमंलं स्वनयेत्पित॒न् ' १५६ अन्येषां च पदे श्राद्धी पित॒न्त्रह्म पुर नयेत् । सर्वेषां काश्यपं श्रेष्ठ विष्णों रुद्रस्थ बे पदम ॥।
verses.wordMeaning: After circumambulating the Yupa, one attains the fruit ofVajapeya sacrifice. After bowing down to Brahma, he will lead the Pitrs to Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: After circumambulating the Yupa, one attains the fruit ofVajapeya sacrifice. After bowing down to Brahma, he will lead the Pitrs to Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमेश्वरतीर्थानि त्रीणि रामेश्वरास्त्रयः । कपालेश्वरतीर्थानि त्रीणि हंसकृतानि च
verses.transliteration: gautameśvaratīrthāni trīṇi rāmeśvarāstrayaḥ / kapāleśvaratīrthāni trīṇi haṃsakṛtāni ca
verses.translation: "Obeisance be to Brahma, the unborn, the causal form of the birth etc. of this universe. Repeated bows to the re¬ deemer of the devotees and the Pitrs."
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणश्च पद चापि श्रेष्ठ तन्न प्रकीतितम्
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance be to Brahma, the unborn, the causal form of the birth etc. of this universe. Repeated bows to the re¬ deemer of the devotees and the Pitrs."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance be to Brahma, the unborn, the causal form of the birth etc. of this universe. Repeated bows to the re¬ deemer of the devotees and the Pitrs."

verses.sanskrit: त्रीण्येव मोक्षतीर्थानि त्रयो वै विमलेश्वराः । सहस्रयज्ञतीर्थानि त्रीण्येव मुनिरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: trīṇyeva mokṣatīrthāni trayo vai vimaleśvarāḥ / sahasrayajñatīrthāni trīṇyeva munirabravīt
verses.translation: The Mango trees growing near the place called Gopra - cara were planted by Brahma. Merely by watering them, one shall enable the Pitrs to attain salvation.
verses.hindi: प्रारस्‍्भे च समाप्तो च तेषामन्यतरम स्मृतम् । श्रेयस्करं भवेत्तत्र श्राद्धकतुश्व नारद . ४८ कश्यपस्य पदे दिव्ये भारद्वाजों मुनिः पुरा। श्राद्ध कृत्वोद्यतों दातुं पिन्रादिभ्यश्व पिण्डक्म इसी प्रकार सम्याग्वि चरण प्रदेश में श्राद्ध सम्पन्न करनेवाला व्यक्ति ज्योतिष्टोम नामक यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त करता है, आवसध्य के चरण प्रदेश में श्राद्ध करनेवाला अपने पितरों को ब्रह्मलोक पहुँचाता है । शक्त के चरण प्रदेश में श्राद्ध करनेवाला पितरों को इन्द्रलोक पहुँचाता है। अगस्त्य के चरण प्रान्त में श्राद्ध करनेवाला अपने पितरों को ब्रह्मलोक में पहुचाता है। क्रौज्च मातज्ज के चरणों में श्राद्ध करनेवाला अपने पितरों को ब्रह्मलोक
verses.wordMeaning: The Mango trees growing near the place called Gopra - cara were planted by Brahma. Merely by watering them, one shall enable the Pitrs to attain salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Mango trees growing near the place called Gopra - cara were planted by Brahma. Merely by watering them, one shall enable the Pitrs to attain salvation.

verses.sanskrit: भीमेश्वरास्त्रयः ख्याताः स्वर्णतीर्थानि त्रीणि च । धौतपापद्वयं प्रोक्तं करञ्जेशद्वयं तथा
verses.transliteration: bhīmeśvarāstrayaḥ khyātāḥ svarṇatīrthāni trīṇi ca / dhautapāpadvayaṃ proktaṃ karañjeśadvayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Mantra: "For the cause of the salvation of the Pitrs, I am watering the mango tree that has come up from the Brahma¬ saras and which is of the forms of Brahma and Visnu".
verses.hindi: पहुँचाता है। सूर्य के चरण प्रान्त में श्राद्ध करनेवाला अपने पाँच पापों के करतेवाले पितरों को सूर्यपु र को पहुँचाता है, कातिकेय के चरणों में श्राद्ध सम्पन्न करमेवाला अपने पितरों को शिवलोक पहुँचाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Mantra: "For the cause of the salvation of the Pitrs, I am watering the mango tree that has come up from the Brahma¬ saras and which is of the forms of Brahma and Visnu".
verses.commentary: Sense: Mantra: "For the cause of the salvation of the Pitrs, I am watering the mango tree that has come up from the Brahma¬ saras and which is of the forms of Brahma and Visnu".

verses.sanskrit: ऋणमोचनतीर्थे द्वे तथा स्कन्देश्वरद्वयम् । दशाश्वमेधतीर्थे द्वे नन्दीतीर्थद्वयं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ṛṇamocanatīrthe dve tathā skandeśvaradvayam / daśāśvamedhatīrthe dve nandītīrthadvayaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: " (Like a Sage) I with the tips of my hands am touching the water pot and the Kusa grass. I am offering water at the root of the Mango tree. The Mango tree is watered and the Pitrs are propitiated. One action alone has become famous as serving two purposes."
verses.hindi: गणेश के चरणों में श्राद्ध करनेवाला अपने पितरों को शिवलोक पहुंचाता है। गजकर्ण नामक तीर्थ में तपंण करने वाला मनुष्य अपने पितरों को स्वर्गलोक पहुंचाता है । इसी प्रकार आन्यान्य देवताओं के चरणों में श्राद्धकर्म सम्पन्न करनेवाला अपने पितरों को ब्रह्मलोक पहुंचाता है। किन्तु सभी चरण प्रान्तों में भगवान् विष्णु, रुद्र, ब्रह्मा एवं कश्यप के चरण प्रान्त श्रेष्ठ कहे जाते हैं ।(६-५७। नारद जी ! गया यात्रा के प्रारम्भ एवं अवसान काल में इन सबों में किसी एक में श्राद्ध करने का विधान कहा जाता है, वहाँ पर श्राद्ध करनेवाले को विशेषतया
verses.wordMeaning: " (Like a Sage) I with the tips of my hands am touching the water pot and the Kusa grass. I am offering water at the root of the Mango tree. The Mango tree is watered and the Pitrs are propitiated. One action alone has become famous as serving two purposes."
verses.commentary: Sense: " (Like a Sage) I with the tips of my hands am touching the water pot and the Kusa grass. I am offering water at the root of the Mango tree. The Mango tree is watered and the Pitrs are propitiated. One action alone has become famous as serving two purposes."

verses.sanskrit: मन्मथेशद्वयं चैव भृगुतीर्थद्वयं तथा । पराशरेश्वरौ द्वौ च अयोनीसंभवद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: manmatheśadvayaṃ caiva bhṛgutīrthadvayaṃ tathā / parāśareśvarau dvau ca ayonīsaṃbhavadvayam
verses.translation: Then, with a controlled mind, the pilgrim should offer the oblation 1 to Yama with the Mantra: "Yamaraja and Dharmaraja have been engaged in the work of stabilising (demon Gaya). I am offering oblation to both of them for the cause of the liberation of the Pitrs"
verses.hindi: कल्याण-प्राप्ति होती है। प्राचीनकाल में कश्यप जी के दिव्य चरण प्रान्त में भारद्वाज मुनि पितरों के लिये श्राद्ध कमें कर रहे थे, उसी समय जब कि वे पिण्डदान करने को उद्यत हुए थे, चरणों को फोड़कर श्यामल और गौर वर्ण के दो हाथ बाहर निकल पड़े  दोनों हाथों को इस प्रकार एकाएक बाहर निकला देख कर भारद्वाज मुनि बड़े सन्देह में पड़ गये । और अपनी माता शान्‍्ता से उन्होंने पूछा, जननि  कश्यप के
verses.wordMeaning: Then, with a controlled mind, the pilgrim should offer the oblation 1 to Yama with the Mantra: "Yamaraja and Dharmaraja have been engaged in the work of stabilising (demon Gaya). I am offering oblation to both of them for the cause of the liberation of the Pitrs"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, with a controlled mind, the pilgrim should offer the oblation 1 to Yama with the Mantra: "Yamaraja and Dharmaraja have been engaged in the work of stabilising (demon Gaya). I am offering oblation to both of them for the cause of the liberation of the Pitrs"

verses.sanskrit: व्यासेश्वरद्वयं प्रोक्तं पितृतीर्थद्वयं तथा । नन्दिकेश्वरतीर्थे द्वे द्वौ च गोपेश्वरौ स्मृतौ
verses.transliteration: vyāseśvaradvayaṃ proktaṃ pitṛtīrthadvayaṃ tathā / nandikeśvaratīrthe dve dvau ca gopeśvarau smṛtau
verses.translation: "There are two dogs born of the family of Vaivasvata (Yama). They are dark and variegated in colour. I am offering oblation to them. May they protect me for ever, on the path".
verses.hindi: एंकादशाधिकशततमोष्ध्याय: ११२७ ततः स्वमातरं शान्तां पप्रच्छ स महासुनि: । कश्यपश्य पदे दिव्ये शुक्ले कृष्णेषय वा करे ॥
verses.wordMeaning: "There are two dogs born of the family of Vaivasvata (Yama). They are dark and variegated in colour. I am offering oblation to them. May they protect me for ever, on the path".
verses.commentary: Sense: "There are two dogs born of the family of Vaivasvata (Yama). They are dark and variegated in colour. I am offering oblation to them. May they protect me for ever, on the path".

verses.sanskrit: मारुतेशद्वयं तद्वद् द्वौ च ज्वालेश्वरौ स्मृतौ । शुक्लतीर्थद्वयं पुण्यम् अप्सरेशद्वयं तथा
verses.transliteration: māruteśadvayaṃ tadvad dvau ca jvāleśvarau smṛtau / śuklatīrthadvayaṃ puṇyam apsareśadvayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: V. 45 is the Mantra for Yamabaii, v. 46 for £va-bali (Bali to Dogs) and v. 47 is for Kakabali (Bali to Grows). The pilgrim is to take a bath (in Brahmasaras thereof)— TSS 362-363.
verses.hindi: + हंसयुक्तविमानेन ब्रह्मतोकमुभो गतो
verses.wordMeaning: V. 45 is the Mantra for Yamabaii, v. 46 for £va-bali (Bali to Dogs) and v. 47 is for Kakabali (Bali to Grows). The pilgrim is to take a bath (in Brahmasaras thereof)— TSS 362-363.
verses.commentary: Sense: V. 45 is the Mantra for Yamabaii, v. 46 for £va-bali (Bali to Dogs) and v. 47 is for Kakabali (Bali to Grows). The pilgrim is to take a bath (in Brahmasaras thereof)— TSS 362-363.

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलेश्वरतीर्थे द्वे माण्डव्येश्वरसंज्ञिते । द्वीपेश्वरद्वयं चैव प्राह तद्वद्भृगूद्वहः । उत्तरेश्वरतीर्थे द्वे अशोकेशद्वयी तथा
verses.transliteration: pippaleśvaratīrthe dve māṇḍavyeśvarasaṃjñite / dvīpeśvaradvayaṃ caiva prāha tadvadbhṛgūdvahaḥ / uttareśvaratīrthe dve aśokeśadvayī tathā
verses.translation: Then the pilgrim should perform Sraddha at the foot (of Visnu) in Gayasiras along with the offering of Pindas. The real Gayasiras is within the limit of Phalgutlrtha.
verses.hindi: रामो रुद्रपदे श्राद्धे पिण्डदानाय चोह्य तः। पिता दशरथ: स्वर्गात्प्रसायं करमागतः ६५ नादात्पिष्ड करे रामो ददौ रुद्रपदे ततः । शास्त्रार्थातिक्षमास्रीतं राम॑ दशरथोब्रवीत् तारितोहं त्वया पुत्र र॒द्लोकमवाप्तुयाम् । हस्ते पिण्डप्रदानेन स्वरंतिन हि में भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the pilgrim should perform Sraddha at the foot (of Visnu) in Gayasiras along with the offering of Pindas. The real Gayasiras is within the limit of Phalgutlrtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the pilgrim should perform Sraddha at the foot (of Visnu) in Gayasiras along with the offering of Pindas. The real Gayasiras is within the limit of Phalgutlrtha.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे योधनपुरे चैव रोहिणीतीर्थकद्वयम् । लुङ्केश्वरद्वयं ख्यातमाख्यानं मुनिना तथा
verses.transliteration: dve yodhanapure caiva rohiṇītīrthakadvayam / luṅkeśvaradvayaṃ khyātamākhyānaṃ muninā tathā
verses.translation: Naga, Janardana, Brahmayupa and Uttaramanasa— these delimit the holy spot called Gayasiras. It is also called Phalgutlrtha.
verses.hindi: दिव्य चरणों में थे शुक्ल एवं कृष्ण वर्ण के जो दो हाथ निकले हुये हैं, उनमें से मुझे किस हाथ में पिण्डदान करना चाहिए । तू पितरों के कार्यों को भली-भाँति जानती हो, अतः मेरा संशय दूर करो
verses.wordMeaning: Naga, Janardana, Brahmayupa and Uttaramanasa— these delimit the holy spot called Gayasiras. It is also called Phalgutlrtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Naga, Janardana, Brahmayupa and Uttaramanasa— these delimit the holy spot called Gayasiras. It is also called Phalgutlrtha.

verses.sanskrit: सैकोनविंशतिशतं तीर्थान्येकैकशो द्विजाः । स्तबकेषु कृतं तीर्थं द्विशतं सचतुर्दशम्
verses.transliteration: saikonaviṃśatiśataṃ tīrthānyekaikaśo dvijāḥ / stabakeṣu kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ dviśataṃ sacaturdaśam
verses.translation: That area of Phalgutlrtha extending from the seat of Pitamaha upto Uttaramanasa should be known as difficult of access, rare even to Devas.
verses.hindi: शान्तः बोली-- भारद्वाज ! तुम परम बुद्धिमान् हो, श्यामल हाथ में पिण्डदान करो । माता के आदेशानुसार भारद्वाज श्यामत्र हाथ में जब पिण्डदान करने को उद्यत हुए तो ध्वेत हाथ अदृश्य हो गया, और बोला कि तू तो मेरा औरस पुत्र है। अतः मुझे पिण्डप्रदान करो । कृष्ण हाथ ने कहा, मेरा क्षेत्र है, इस लिए मुझे पिण्ड प्रदान करो । तब स्वैरिणी माता ने कहा पुत्र ! क्षेत्राधिकारी एवं बीजाधिकारी दोनों को पिण्ड प्रदान करो  तब भारंद्वाज ने कश्यप के चरणों में पिण्ड प्रदान किया । जिसके महात्म्य से वे दोनों ब्रह्मलोक को प्राप्त हुए ।६२-६४। इसी प्रकार रुद्र के चरणों में रामचन्द्र जी पिण्डदान के लिए जब समुय्यत हुये तो उनके पिता दशरथ स्‍्वगं लोक से हाथ फैलाये हुये आ गये । किल्तु राम ने हाथ में पिण्डदान न करके रुद्रपद में ही पिण्डदान किया। झास्त्रीय मर्यादा भजन होने के भय से भीत राम से दशरथ ने कहा,
verses.wordMeaning: That area of Phalgutlrtha extending from the seat of Pitamaha upto Uttaramanasa should be known as difficult of access, rare even to Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: That area of Phalgutlrtha extending from the seat of Pitamaha upto Uttaramanasa should be known as difficult of access, rare even to Devas.

verses.sanskrit: शैवान्येतानि तीर्थानि वैष्णवानि च सत्तमाः । शृणुध्वं प्रोच्यमानानि ब्राह्मशाक्तानि च क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: śaivānyetāni tīrthāni vaiṣṇavāni ca sattamāḥ / śṛṇudhvaṃ procyamānāni brāhmaśāktāni ca kramāt
verses.translation: The real Gayasiras extends from Krauncapada up to Phalgutlrtha. Since this is the face of Gayasura, the Sraddha performed here is of everlasting benefit.
verses.hindi: पुत्र  मैं तार दिया गया, अब शक्भूर के लोक को जा रहा हूँ । सचमुच हाथ में पिण्डदान करने से हमें स्वगं- प्राप्ति न होती ।६५-६७। तुम भी चिरकाल तक राज्य करके, समस्त प्रजावग्ग एवं ब्राह्मणों का विधिवत् पालन
verses.wordMeaning: The real Gayasiras extends from Krauncapada up to Phalgutlrtha. Since this is the face of Gayasura, the Sraddha performed here is of everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The real Gayasiras extends from Krauncapada up to Phalgutlrtha. Since this is the face of Gayasura, the Sraddha performed here is of everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टविंशतितीर्थानि वैष्णवान्यब्रवीन्मुनिः । तेषु वाराहतीर्थानि षडेव मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭaviṃśatitīrthāni vaiṣṇavānyabravīnmuniḥ / teṣu vārāhatīrthāni ṣaḍeva munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: The region below the mountain Mundaprstha too con¬ stitutes Phalgutlrtha. It is here that the primordial Gadadhara is stationed in both manifest and unmanifest forms.
verses.hindi: -- अन्राध्यायसमाप्तिद् श्यते शव. पुस्तके । पाठो नास्ति ख. पुस्तके । त्वं च राज्य चिरं कृत्वा पालयित्वा द्विजान्धजा: । यज्ञान्सदक्षिणान्कृत्वा विष्णुलोक ब्रजिष्पसि
verses.wordMeaning: The region below the mountain Mundaprstha too con¬ stitutes Phalgutlrtha. It is here that the primordial Gadadhara is stationed in both manifest and unmanifest forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: The region below the mountain Mundaprstha too con¬ stitutes Phalgutlrtha. It is here that the primordial Gadadhara is stationed in both manifest and unmanifest forms.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारि चक्रतीर्थानि शेषाण्यष्टादशैव हि । विष्णुनाधिष्ठितान्य् एव प्राह पूर्वं मृकण्डजः
verses.transliteration: catvāri cakratīrthāni śeṣāṇyaṣṭādaśaiva hi / viṣṇunādhiṣṭhitāny eva prāha pūrvaṃ mṛkaṇḍajaḥ
verses.translation: The foot-prints of Visnu and others are there conducive to the liberation of the Pitrs. This Visnupada (the foot-print of Visnu) is divine and destructive of sins at its very sight.
verses.hindi: पुरयंपोध्याजन: साथ कृमिकीटादिभिः सह । इत्युक्त्वाइसों दशरथो रुद्रलोक॑ परं ययौ ६६ भीष्मों विष्णुपदे श्रेष्ठ आहुय पितरं स्वकम्। श्राद्ध क्ृत्वोद्यतो दातुं पिन्नादिभ्यश्र पिण्डकम्ू
verses.wordMeaning: The foot-prints of Visnu and others are there conducive to the liberation of the Pitrs. This Visnupada (the foot-print of Visnu) is divine and destructive of sins at its very sight.
verses.commentary: Sense: The foot-prints of Visnu and others are there conducive to the liberation of the Pitrs. This Visnupada (the foot-print of Visnu) is divine and destructive of sins at its very sight.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव ब्रह्मणा सिद्ध्यै सप्ततीर्थान्यवीवदत् । त्रिषु च ब्रह्मणः पूजा ब्रह्मेशाश्चतुरो ऽपरे । अष्टाविंशन्मया ख्याता यथासङ्ख्यं यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva brahmaṇā siddhyai saptatīrthānyavīvadat / triṣu ca brahmaṇaḥ pūjā brahmeśāścaturo 'pare / aṣṭāviṃśanmayā khyātā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathākramam
verses.translation: By touching and worshipping it sins are dispelled. Whatever is given unto the Pitfs becomes Ak$aya (of inexhaus¬ tible benefit). By performing the Sraddha along with the Pina offerings one leads a thousand members of one's family to the divine foot of Visnu which is auspicious and infinite. By perfor¬ ming Srdddha at the foot of Rudra, a man takes a hundred
verses.hindi: पितुविनिर्गंतो हस्तो गयाशिरसि शंतनो: । नादात्पिण्ड करे भीष्सो ददो विष्णुपदे ततः शंतनुः प्राह संतुष्ट: शास्त्रार्थ निश्चलो भवान्  त्रिकालदृष्टिभवतु चान्ते विष्णुश्न ते गतिः.
verses.wordMeaning: By touching and worshipping it sins are dispelled. Whatever is given unto the Pitfs becomes Ak$aya (of inexhaus¬ tible benefit).…
verses.commentary: Sense: By touching and worshipping it sins are dispelled. Whatever is given unto the Pitfs becomes Ak$aya (of inexhaus¬ tible benefit).…

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पवित्रमतुलं ह्येतत् पापहरं परम् । नर्मदाचरितं पुण्यं माहात्म्यं मुनिभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: etatpavitramatulaṃ hyetat pāpaharaṃ param / narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ munibhāṣitam
verses.translation: The 4th day of Pancatirthi is the 6th day from entry into Gaya. TSS. 366 tells us that there is no separate Sraddha on Gayasiras apart from the Sraddhas at Vi§nupada and other Padas. Gayasiras is the holiest spot at Gaya. It* extends from Krauncapada to Phalgu Tirtha (v. 53).
verses.hindi: स्वेच्छया मरणं चास्तु इत्युकत्वा मुक्तिमागत: । कनकेशं च केदारं नारसिहं च॒ वामनम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The 4th day of Pancatirthi is the 6th day from entry into Gaya. TSS. 366 tells us that there is no separate Sraddha on Gayasiras apart from the Sraddhas at Vi§nupada and other Padas. Gayasiras is the holiest spot at Gaya. It* extends from Krauncapada to Phalgu Tirtha (v. 53).
verses.commentary: Sense: The 4th day of Pancatirthi is the 6th day from entry into Gaya. TSS. 366 tells us that there is no separate Sraddha on Gayasiras apart from the Sraddhas at Vi§nupada and other Padas. Gayasiras is the holiest spot at Gaya. It* extends from Krauncapada to Phalgu Tirtha (v. 53).

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच: एवमुद्देशतः प्रोक्तो रेवातीर्थक्रमो मया । यथा पार्थाय संक्षेपान् मार्कण्डो मुनिरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca: evamuddeśataḥ prokto revātīrthakramo mayā / yathā pārthāya saṃkṣepān mārkaṇḍo munirabravīt
verses.translation: One who performs Sraddha at the foot (print) of Garhapatya attains the fruit of Vajapeya. After performing Sraddha at Ahavanlya, one attains the benefit of a horse- sacrifice.
verses.hindi: स्वेत्र मुण्डपृष्ठाद्रि: पदेरेभिः सुलक्षितः । प्रयान्ति पितरः सर्वे ब्रह्मतोकमनामयम् (७५ करके प्रचर दक्षिणा युक्त अनेक यज्ञों का अनुष्ठान करके विष्णु लोक को प्राप्त करोगे । अयोध्या पुरी में निवास करने वाले लोगों के तथा कुमिकीटादिकों के साथ तुम्हें विष्णुलोक की प्राप्ति होगी । ऐसा कहकर राजा दशरथ परमश्रेष्ठ र॒द्रलोक को चले गये ।६८-६६। इसी प्रकार भीष्म ने परमश्रेष्ठ विष्णपद पर अपने पितरों का आवाहन कर श्राद्ध करते समय पिण्डदान के लिए उद्यत हुए तो गया शिर पर उनके पिता राजा हान्तनु के दोनों हाथ
verses.wordMeaning: One who performs Sraddha at the foot (print) of Garhapatya attains the fruit of Vajapeya. After performing Sraddha at Ahavanlya, one attains the benefit of a horse- sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who performs Sraddha at the foot (print) of Garhapatya attains the fruit of Vajapeya. After performing Sraddha at Ahavanlya, one attains the benefit of a horse- sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अवान्तराणि तीर्थानि तेषु गुप्तान्यनेकशः । यत्र यावत्प्रमाणानि तान्याकर्णयतानघाः
verses.transliteration: avāntarāṇi tīrthāni teṣu guptānyanekaśaḥ / yatra yāvatpramāṇāni tānyākarṇayatānaghāḥ
verses.translation: By performing Sraddha at the foot of (fire called) Sabhya one attains the benefit of Jyotistonia. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Avasathya leads Pitrs to Brahmapura.
verses.hindi: बाहर निकल आये  किल्तु उन्होंने हाथों में पिण्डदान न देकर विष्णुपद पर ही पिण्डदान किया। उनके इस निदचय से शन्‍्तनु को बड़ा सस्तोष हुआ, वे बोले कि आप श्लास्त्रीय मर्यादा के पालन में निश्चल विचार रखते हैं, आपकी दुष्टि त्रिकाल-दशेनी हो, अन्तकाल में भगवान् विष्णु को गति प्राप्त हो  इच्छा करने पर मृत्यु की प्राप्ति हो, ऐसा कहकुर शब्तनु मुक्ति को प्राप्त हुए। उत्तर मार्ग में कनकेश, केदार, नारसिंह
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Sraddha at the foot of (fire called) Sabhya one attains the benefit of Jyotistonia. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Avasathya leads Pitrs to Brahmapura.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Sraddha at the foot of (fire called) Sabhya one attains the benefit of Jyotistonia. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Avasathya leads Pitrs to Brahmapura.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारतीर्थपरितः पर्वताद् अमरकण्टात् । क्रोशद्वये सर्वदिक्षु सार्धकोटीत्रयी मता
verses.transliteration: oṅkāratīrthaparitaḥ parvatād amarakaṇṭāt / krośadvaye sarvadikṣu sārdhakoṭītrayī matā
verses.translation: Performing Sraddha at Sakra's foot leads Pitrs to Indraloka. One who performs Sraddha at Agastya's foot leads Pitrs to Brahmapura,
verses.hindi: और वामन की भली-भाँति पूजा करके मनुष्य अपने समस्त पितरों का उद्धार करता है ।७०-७३। गयाशिर में जाकर जिन जिनके नाम से मनुष्य पिडदान करता है, यदि नरक में हैं तो स्वर्ग पहुंच जाते हैं, स्व में हैं तो मुक्ति प्राप्त करते हैं । देवताओं के चरणों से मुण्डपृष्ठादि सवंत्र चिह्नित है, वहाँ पर श्राद्धादि करने से पितरगण विविध ब्रह्मलोक को प्राप्त करते हैं। असुरुराज हेति का जो शिर था, वह उक्त बदासे दो स्वगेस्था मोक्षमाप्नुयुरित्यस्मात्परतः क. पुस्तकटिप्पष्यां श्लोकह्ृबमधिक बर्तते तद्यथा---
verses.wordMeaning: Performing Sraddha at Sakra's foot leads Pitrs to Indraloka. One who performs Sraddha at Agastya's foot leads Pitrs to Brahmapura,
verses.commentary: Sense: Performing Sraddha at Sakra's foot leads Pitrs to Indraloka. One who performs Sraddha at Agastya's foot leads Pitrs to Brahmapura,

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानां संख्यया गुप्तप्रकटानां द्विजोत्तमाः । कोटिरेका तु तीर्थानां कपिलासङ्गमे पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tīrthānāṃ saṃkhyayā guptaprakaṭānāṃ dvijottamāḥ / koṭirekā tu tīrthānāṃ kapilāsaṅgame pṛthak
verses.translation: He who performs Sraddha at Krauncapada and Matangapada leads Pitrs to Brahmaloka. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of the Sun-god leads even the perpetrators of five great sins to the city of Arka.
verses.hindi: पदालि यन्र दुश्यन्ते विष्ण्यादीवां तदग्रतः  श्राद्ध कृत्वा सपिण्डं च तेषां लोकाप्नयेत्पितु ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs Sraddha at Krauncapada and Matangapada leads Pitrs to Brahmaloka. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of the Sun-god leads even the perpetrators of five great sins to the city of Arka.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs Sraddha at Krauncapada and Matangapada leads Pitrs to Brahmaloka. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of the Sun-god leads even the perpetrators of five great sins to the city of Arka.

verses.sanskrit: अशोकवनिकायाश्च तीर्थं लक्षं प्रतिष्ठितम् । शतमं गारगर्तायाः सङ्गमे मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: aśokavanikāyāśca tīrthaṃ lakṣaṃ pratiṣṭhitam / śatamaṃ gāragartāyāḥ saṅgame munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Kartikeya leads the Pitrs to Sivaloka. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Ganesa leads the Pitrs to Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: एकादेशाधिकशंततमोः्ष्यायः क्‍ ११२६ हैत्यसुरस्य यच्छीर्ष गदया तद्द्विधा कृतम् । ततः प्रक्षालिता यस्मात्तीर्थ तच्च विमुक्तये ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Kartikeya leads the Pitrs to Sivaloka. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Ganesa leads the Pitrs to Rudraloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Kartikeya leads the Pitrs to Sivaloka. He who performs Sraddha at the foot of Ganesa leads the Pitrs to Rudraloka.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानामयुतं तद्वत्कुब्जायाः सङ्गमे स्थितम् । शतं हिरण्यगर्भायाः सङ्गमे समवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthānāmayutaṃ tadvatkubjāyāḥ saṅgame sthitam / śataṃ hiraṇyagarbhāyāḥ saṅgame samavasthitam
verses.translation: One who performs Tarpana rites in the holy spot Gajakarna leads his Pitrs to the resplendent heaven. One who performs Sraddha at the feet of other deities leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura.
verses.hindi: गदालोले महातीयथें गदाप्रक्षालनाद्धरे:  स्नान करोसि सिद्धअर्थंमक्षयं पदमाप्नुयास् १७७ पश्चमे5त्षि गदालोले स्नात्वा कुर्यात्सपिण्डकम् । भ्राद्ध पितृन्त्रह्मलोक नयेदात्मानसेव च ७८ ब्रह्मप्रकल्पितान्विप्रान्हव्यकव्यादिना + चंयेत् । तंस्तुष्टेस्तोषिताः सर्वा: पितृभिः सह देवताः ७४७६ कृते भ्राद्धेकक्षयवटटे अन्ननेव प्रयत्नतः । पितुन्नयेद्ब्रह्मलोकमक्षय तु सनातनम् ८०
verses.wordMeaning: One who performs Tarpana rites in the holy spot Gajakarna leads his Pitrs to the resplendent heaven. One who performs Sraddha at the feet of other deities leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who performs Tarpana rites in the holy spot Gajakarna leads his Pitrs to the resplendent heaven. One who performs Sraddha at the feet of other deities leads the Pitrs to Brahmapura.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानामष्टषष्टिश्च विशोकासङ्गमे स्थिता । तथा सहस्रं तीर्थानां संस्थितं वागुसङ्गमे
verses.transliteration: tīrthānāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭiśca viśokāsaṅgame sthitā / tathā sahasraṃ tīrthānāṃ saṃsthitaṃ vāgusaṅgame
verses.translation: At the beginning and at the conclusion one of them is remembered. O Narada, it is conducive to the welfare of the performer of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: वटवक्षसमापे तु शेकेनाप्युदकेन वा । एकस्मिन्भोजिते विप्रे कोटिभवन्ति भोजिता: देयं दानं षघोडशक गयातीर्थ॑पुरोधसे । वस्त्र गन्धादिभिः पुत्रः सम्पकक्‍्संपुज्य यत्नतः +- ८२
verses.wordMeaning: At the beginning and at the conclusion one of them is remembered. O Narada, it is conducive to the welfare of the performer of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the beginning and at the conclusion one of them is remembered. O Narada, it is conducive to the welfare of the performer of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: शतं सरस्वतीसङ्गे शुक्लतीर्थे शतद्वयम् । सहस्रं विष्णुतीर्थेषु महिष्मत्यामथायुतम्
verses.transliteration: śataṃ sarasvatīsaṅge śuklatīrthe śatadvayam / sahasraṃ viṣṇutīrtheṣu mahiṣmatyāmathāyutam
verses.translation: In order to emphasize that Piij<Jas are to be offered at the foot¬ prints and not in the hands of the dead ancestor even if he come in person.
verses.hindi: भागों में विभभवत हो गया था, वहीं पर विष्ण ने गदा को घोया था, यही कारण है कि बह तीथे पितरों को मुक्ति के लिए विशेष ख्यात है । सभो उत्तम तीर्थों में भी वह उत्तम है, उसका नाम गदा लोल का जाता है ।७४-७६। उस गदालोल नामक महातीय में भगवान् विष्णु की गदा धोमे से ही यह माहात्म्य है । वहाँ पर स्नान करते समय यह संकल्प करे--इस परम पुनीत गदालोल तीर्थ में मैं श्लिद्धि प्राप्ति की कामना से
verses.wordMeaning: In order to emphasize that Piij<Jas are to be offered at the foot¬ prints and not in the hands of the dead ancestor even if he come in person.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to emphasize that Piij<Jas are to be offered at the foot¬ prints and not in the hands of the dead ancestor even if he come in person.

verses.sanskrit: शूलभेदे च तीर्थानां साग्रं लक्षं स्थितं द्विजाः । देवग्रामे सहस्रं च तीर्थानां मुनिरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: śūlabhede ca tīrthānāṃ sāgraṃ lakṣaṃ sthitaṃ dvijāḥ / devagrāme sahasraṃ ca tīrthānāṃ munirabravīt
verses.translation: Two hands, one white and the other black, came out jutting out of the foot (of Kasyapa). On seeing the two (projec¬ ted) hands, the sage was overwhelmed with doubts.
verses.hindi: स्नान कर रहा हूँ, मुझे अक्षय पद की प्राप्ति हो । इस प्रकार पाँचवे दिन गदालोल नामक तीर्थ में स्तान कर सपिण्ड आद्ध करनेवाला अपने साथ अपने समस्त पितरों को भी ब्रह्मलोक पहुंचाता है। श्राद्ध के उपरान्त ब्रह्मकल्पित श्राह्मणों को हृव्य कव्यादि सामग्रियों से सन्तुष्ट करे । क्योंकि उनके सस्तुष्ठ होने से ही सब वितर एवं देवगण सन्तुष्ट होते हैं ॥9७-७९॥ अक्षयवट तीथे में अन्न द्वारा विधिपूर्वक श्राद्ध करने वाला अपने फ्तिर गणों को भ्रक्षय एवं सनातन ब्रह्मलोक को पहुंचाता है । वटबव॒क्ष के समीप- शाक, अथवा जल द्वारा भी यदि एक विप्र को भोजत करा दिया जाय तो उससे कोटि ब्राह्मणों को भोजन किया हुआ समझना चाहिए । गयातीर्थे के पुरोहितों को सोलह प्रकार का दान देना चाहिए, वल्न एवं सुगर्ध आदि सामग्रियों द्वारा पुत्रों समेत विधिपूर्वक उनकी पूजा करके दान देना चाहिए ।६०-८५२। इस चराचर जगत् के एक महासमुद्र के रूप में
verses.wordMeaning: Two hands, one white and the other black, came out jutting out of the foot (of Kasyapa). On seeing the two (projec¬ ted) hands, the sage was overwhelmed with doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two hands, one white and the other black, came out jutting out of the foot (of Kasyapa). On seeing the two (projec¬ ted) hands, the sage was overwhelmed with doubts.

verses.sanskrit: लुङ्केश्वरे च तीर्थानां साग्रा सप्तशती स्थिता । तीर्थान्यष्टोत्तरशतं मणिनद्याश्च सङ्गमे । वैद्यनाथे च तीर्थानां शतमष्टाधिकं विदुः
verses.transliteration: luṅkeśvare ca tīrthānāṃ sāgrā saptaśatī sthitā / tīrthānyaṣṭottaraśataṃ maṇinadyāśca saṅgame / vaidyanāthe ca tīrthānāṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: Then the great sage asked his mother Santa: "O mother, is the Pinda to be offered to the white hand or to the black hand, at the divine foot-print of Kasyapa? you know father (hence) say."
verses.hindi: + इत उत्तरं क पुस्तकटिपण्यामधिक श्लोकद्ठ यमस्ति तद्य थ्---
verses.wordMeaning: Then the great sage asked his mother Santa: "O mother, is the Pinda to be offered to the white hand or to the black hand, at the divine foot-print of Kasyapa? you know father (hence) say."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the great sage asked his mother Santa: "O mother, is the Pinda to be offered to the white hand or to the black hand, at the divine foot-print of Kasyapa? you know father (hence) say."

verses.sanskrit: एवं तावत्प्रमाणानि तीर्थे कुम्भेश्वरे द्विजाः । साग्रं लक्षं च तीर्थानां स्थितं रेवोरसङ्गमे
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tāvatpramāṇāni tīrthe kumbheśvare dvijāḥ / sāgraṃ lakṣaṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sthitaṃ revorasaṅgame
verses.translation: Then Bharadvaja attempted to give the Pinda to the black one. Then the white one, remaining invisible said, "You are my legitimate bosom son."
verses.hindi: पितुन्नयेद्ब्रह्मलोकमक्षयं तु सनातनम् गयाया धर्मपृष्ठे च सरसि ब्रह्मणस्तथा । गयाश्यार्षे बठे चेंव पिदुर्णा दत्तमक्षबम् ॥।इति॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then Bharadvaja attempted to give the Pinda to the black one. Then the white one, remaining invisible said, "You are my legitimate bosom son."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Bharadvaja attempted to give the Pinda to the black one. Then the white one, remaining invisible said, "You are my legitimate bosom son."

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चाप्यधिकानि स्युरिति मार्कण्डभाषितम् । अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि व्यासद्वीपाश्रितानि च
verses.transliteration: tataścāpyadhikāni syuriti mārkaṇḍabhāṣitam / aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi vyāsadvīpāśritāni ca
verses.translation: The black one said, "The field is mine (i.e. the wife). Hence give the Pinda to me." Then the Svairini (wanton woman) said that the Pindas are to be given both to Ksetrin (the husband) and the Bijin (the procreator).
verses.wordMeaning: The black one said, "The field is mine (i.e. the wife). Hence give the Pinda to me." Then the Svairini (wanton woman) said that the Pindas are to be given both to Ksetrin (the husband) and the Bijin (the procreator).
verses.commentary: Sense: The black one said, "The field is mine (i.e. the wife). Hence give the Pinda to me." Then the Svairini (wanton woman) said that the Pindas are to be given both to Ksetrin (the husband) and the Bijin (the procreator).

verses.sanskrit: सङ्गमे च करञ्जायाः स्थितमष्टोत्तरायुतम् । एरण्डीसङ्गमे तद्वत्तीर्थान्यष्टाधिकं शतम्
verses.transliteration: saṅgame ca karañjāyāḥ sthitamaṣṭottarāyutam / eraṇḍīsaṅgame tadvattīrthānyaṣṭādhikaṃ śatam
verses.translation: Bharadvaja thereupon placed the Pinda at the foot of Kasyapa. Both of them went to Brahmaloka by means of an aerial chariot to which a swan was yoked.
verses.hindi: एकाणंवे बटस्याग्रे यः शेते योगनिद्रया । बालरूपधरस्तस्मे नमस्ते योगशायिने ८३ संसारवक्षशस्त्रायाशेषपापहराय च। अक्षयब्रह्मदात्रे च नमोक्षयवटाय वे ८ कलो माहेश्वरा लोका येन तस्मादृगदाधर: । लिडइ्गरूपो5भवत्त चर बन्दे श्रीप्रपितामहम् इति श्रीमहापुराणे वायुप्रोक्‍्ते गयामाहात्म्यं नामकादशाधिकशततमो्ध्याय: ॥१११॥।
verses.wordMeaning: Bharadvaja thereupon placed the Pinda at the foot of Kasyapa. Both of them went to Brahmaloka by means of an aerial chariot to which a swan was yoked.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bharadvaja thereupon placed the Pinda at the foot of Kasyapa. Both of them went to Brahmaloka by means of an aerial chariot to which a swan was yoked.

verses.sanskrit: धूतपापे च तीर्थानां षष्टिरष्टाधिका स्थिता । स्कन्दतीर्थे शतं पुण्यं तीर्थानां मुनिरुक्तवान्
verses.transliteration: dhūtapāpe ca tīrthānāṃ ṣaṣṭiraṣṭādhikā sthitā / skandatīrthe śataṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthānāṃ muniruktavān
verses.translation: Rama attempted to offer the Pindas at the sacrifice at the foot of Rudra. His father Dasaratha came there from heaven stretching his hand.
verses.hindi: यज्ञ चक्रे गयो राजा बह्धन्नं बहुदक्षिणम्। यत्र व्रव्यसमूहानां संख्या कतुं' व शक्‍यते + १३१
verses.wordMeaning: Rama attempted to offer the Pindas at the sacrifice at the foot of Rudra. His father Dasaratha came there from heaven stretching his hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama attempted to offer the Pindas at the sacrifice at the foot of Rudra. His father Dasaratha came there from heaven stretching his hand.

verses.sanskrit: कोहनेश च तीर्थानां षष्टिरष्टाधिका स्थिता । सार्धकोटी च तीर्थानां स्थिता वै कोरिलापुरे
verses.transliteration: kohaneśa ca tīrthānāṃ ṣaṣṭiraṣṭādhikā sthitā / sārdhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ sthitā vai korilāpure
verses.translation: Rama did not offer the Pinda unto the hand. Then he placed the Pinda at the foot of Rudra. Dasaratha spoke to Rama who was afraid of transgressing the injunctions of the sacred texts:
verses.hindi: परिणत हो जाने पर जो बालरूप धारी भगवान् बटवृक्ष के पत्ते पर योग निद्रा घारण कण दायन करते हैं, उन योग शायी को हमारा नमस्कार है । संसार रूपी ब॒क्ष के लिए दास्त्र स्वरूप, निखिल पापों के हरने वाले, अक्षय ब्रह्मा पद प्रदान करने वाले अक्षयवट को हमारा नमस्कार है। कलियुग में लोग शिव के शिव के भक्त हैं, उन्हीं के लिए गदाधर देव सर्वत्र लि रूप घारण कर विराजमान हैं, उन परम पितामह को हमारा श्री बायुमहापुराण में गयामाहात्म्य नामक एक सौ ग्यारहवाँ अध्याय समाप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Rama did not offer the Pinda unto the hand. Then he placed the Pinda at the foot of Rudra. Dasaratha spoke to Rama who was afraid of transgressing the injunctions of the sacred texts:
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama did not offer the Pinda unto the hand. Then he placed the Pinda at the foot of Rudra. Dasaratha spoke to Rama who was afraid of transgressing the injunctions of the sacred texts:

verses.sanskrit: रामकेशवतीर्थे च सहस्रं साग्रमुक्तवान् । अस्माहके सहस्रं च तीर्थानि निवसन्ति हि
verses.transliteration: rāmakeśavatīrthe ca sahasraṃ sāgramuktavān / asmāhake sahasraṃ ca tīrthāni nivasanti hi
verses.translation: "O Son, I have been redeemed by you. I shall attain Rudraloka. If the Pinda had been given (deposited) unto the hand, I would not have attained heaven.
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमार बोले--नारदजी ! राजा गय ने अपने राजत्व-काल में प्रचुर भन्नों एवं दक्षिणाओं वाले यज्ञों का अनुष्ठान किया था, उनमें व्यय किये गये द्वव्यों की संख्या बतलाना कठिन है।
verses.wordMeaning: "O Son, I have been redeemed by you. I shall attain Rudraloka. If the Pinda had been given (deposited) unto the hand, I would not have attained heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Son, I have been redeemed by you. I shall attain Rudraloka. If the Pinda had been given (deposited) unto the hand, I would not have attained heaven.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षाष्टकं सहस्रे द्वे शुक्लतीर्थे द्विजोत्तमाः । तीर्थानि कथयामास पुरा पार्थाय भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: lakṣāṣṭakaṃ sahasre dve śuklatīrthe dvijottamāḥ / tīrthāni kathayāmāsa purā pārthāya bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: You will rule over the kingdom for a long time and protect Brahmanas and other subjects. After performing Yajfias with due Daksina, you will go to Visnuloka along with all the citizens of Ayodhya and (including) even germs and insects."
verses.hindi: न-संस्या कतु न शकयत इश्यस्मात्परतः श्र. पुस्तकेधिको भ्रन्थो5स्त्रि स यथा--- सिकता वा यथा लोके यथा च् दिवि तारकाः । तथा रत्नसुवर्णाद्यरसंख्यातास्तु दक्षिणाः
verses.wordMeaning: You will rule over the kingdom for a long time and protect Brahmanas and other subjects. After performing Yajfias with due Daksina, you will go to Visnuloka along with all the citizens of Ayodhya and (including) even germs and insects."
verses.commentary: Sense: You will rule over the kingdom for a long time and protect Brahmanas and other subjects. After performing Yajfias with due Daksina, you will go to Visnuloka along with all the citizens of Ayodhya and (including) even germs and insects."

verses.sanskrit: शतमष्टाधिकं प्राह प्रत्येकं सङ्गमेषु च । नदीनामवशिष्टानां कावेरीसङ्गमं विना
verses.transliteration: śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ prāha pratyekaṃ saṅgameṣu ca / nadīnāmavaśiṣṭānāṃ kāverīsaṅgamaṃ vinā
verses.translation: Bhisma invoked his Pitr (father) at the excellent Visnupada and performed the Sraddha. When he attempted to offer the Pinzas to the Pitrs, both the hands of his father Santanu came out of GayaSiras. Bh!§ma did not offer the Pindas into the hands. He placed them at the foot-print of Visnu. The delighted Santanu said: "You are definite about the meaning of the sacred text. May you have the vision extend¬ ing to the three times (past, present and future). In the end, may Visnu be your goal.
verses.hindi: नेवेह पूर्व ये केचिन्न फरिष्यन्ति चापरे  प्रशंसन्ति द्िजास्तृप्ता देशे देशे सुपुजिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Bhisma invoked his Pitr (father) at the excellent Visnupada and performed the Sraddha. When he attempted to offer the Pinzas to the Pitrs, both the hands of his father Santanu came out of GayaSiras. Bh!§ma did not offer the Pindas into the hands.…
