verses.commentary: Sense: Bhisma invoked his Pitr (father) at the excellent Visnupada and performed the Sraddha. When he attempted to offer the Pinzas to the Pitrs, both the hands of his father Santanu came out of GayaSiras. Bh!§ma did not offer the Pindas into the hands.…

verses.sanskrit: कावेर्याः सङ्गमे विप्राः स्थिता पञ्चशती तथा । तीर्थानां पर्वसु तथा विशेषो मुनिनोदितः
verses.transliteration: kāveryāḥ saṅgame viprāḥ sthitā pañcaśatī tathā / tīrthānāṃ parvasu tathā viśeṣo muninoditaḥ
verses.translation: Since the Gada of Hari was washed in that great Tirtha, it was called Gadalola. "I am taking my bath for the realisation of Siddhis. I shall attain the imperishable Pada (station)."
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणा तें द्विजा: पुता भवन्तु क्तुपूजिता:  + गयापुरीति मन्नास्ना खुयाता ब्रह्मपुरी यथा एवमस्तु बरं दत््वा ततश्रवास्तद्ंधुः सुराः। गयश्न भोगान्संभुज्य विष्णुलोक पर ययो
verses.wordMeaning: Since the Gada of Hari was washed in that great Tirtha, it was called Gadalola. "I am taking my bath for the realisation of Siddhis. I shall attain the imperishable Pada (station)."
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the Gada of Hari was washed in that great Tirtha, it was called Gadalola. "I am taking my bath for the realisation of Siddhis. I shall attain the imperishable Pada (station)."

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षतीर्थं हि सत्प्राहुः पुराणपुरुषाश्रितम् । भृगोः क्षेत्रे च तीर्थानां कोटिरेका समाश्रिता
verses.transliteration: mokṣatīrthaṃ hi satprāhuḥ purāṇapuruṣāśritam / bhṛgoḥ kṣetre ca tīrthānāṃ koṭirekā samāśritā
verses.translation: On the fifth day 2 the pilgrim shall take his bath in the The 5th day of Pancatirthi is the 7th day from entering Gaya. On this day one should perform Bath and Sraddha at Ak$ayavata, honour
verses.hindi: विशालायां विशालो5मुद्राजाःपुत्नोडश्रवीद्दिजान् । कर्थ पुत्रादयों से स्युविशालं चात्रवन्द्रिजाः
verses.wordMeaning: On the fifth day 2 the pilgrim shall take his bath in the The 5th day of Pancatirthi is the 7th day from entering Gaya. On this day one should perform Bath and Sraddha at Ak$ayavata, honour
verses.commentary: Sense: On the fifth day 2 the pilgrim shall take his bath in the The 5th day of Pancatirthi is the 7th day from entering Gaya. On this day one should perform Bath and Sraddha at Ak$ayavata, honour

verses.sanskrit: साधिकानामृषिश्रेष्ठा वक्तुं शक्तो हि को भवेत् । सर्वामराश्रयं प्रोक्तं सर्वतीर्थाश्रयं तथा
verses.transliteration: sādhikānāmṛṣiśreṣṭhā vaktuṃ śakto hi ko bhavet / sarvāmarāśrayaṃ proktaṃ sarvatīrthāśrayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The devotee shall propitiate the Brahmanas who had been originally assigned the duties at Gaya by god Brahma. He should propitiate them by means of Havyas, Kavyas etc. If they are satisfied, all the deities along with the Pitrs are propitiated
verses.hindi: लोक में बितने जितने धूल कण हैं, अथवा आकाश में जितने तारे हैं, उतने रत्नों एवं सुवर्ण की मुद्राओं की उन यज्ञों में दक्षिणा दी गई थी तो भला उनकी संख्या कौन निश्चित कर सकता है। इस लोक में वैसे यज्ञ न तो हुए हैं और न भविष्य में कभी होंगे । सभी देशों के रहने वाले द्विजगण सस्तुष्ट होकर उसकी यशोगाथा का गान करते हैं। उसके इस महान कार्य से सल्तुष्ट होकश विष्णुप्रभृति देवताओं ने अनुरोध किया कि गय ! तुम वरदान माँगों  गय ने उन देवताओं से कहा, सुरगण यदि आप लोग सचमुच प्रसन्न हैं तो हमें यह वरदान दें कि प्राचीन काल में भगवान् ब्रह्मा ने जिन द्विजों को अभिशाप दे दिया था, वे आज से यज्ञों में पृजित होकर पवित्र हो जायें। यह पुरी मेरे नाम पर ब्रह्म पुरी की तरह पवित्र एवं विश्यात हो जाय ।२-५। देवगण ऐसा ही हो, कहकर उसकौ प्रार्थता को स्वीकार कर अन्तहित हो
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall propitiate the Brahmanas who had been originally assigned the duties at Gaya by god Brahma. He should propitiate them by means of Havyas, Kavyas etc. If they are satisfied, all the deities along with the Pitrs are propitiated
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall propitiate the Brahmanas who had been originally assigned the duties at Gaya by god Brahma. He should propitiate them by means of Havyas, Kavyas etc. If they are satisfied, all the deities along with the Pitrs are propitiated

verses.sanskrit: त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातं पूजितं सिद्धिसाधनम् । भारभूत्यां च तीर्थानां स्थितमष्टोत्तरं शतम्
verses.transliteration: triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ pūjitaṃ siddhisādhanam / bhārabhūtyāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sthitamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam
verses.translation: If the Sraddha at Aksayavata is performed with great care and effort, with cooked rice alone, the pilgrim will lead the Pitrs to the indestructible and eternal Brahmaloka. If a single Brahmana is fed near that Vatavrksa (banyan tree) with vegetables or even with water, it is as fruitful as feeding a crore (of Brahmanas).
verses.hindi: गये  गय विविध भोगों का उपभोग कर विष्णुलोक को प्राप्त हुआ। कालान्तर में विजशञाला नगरी में विज्ञाल नाम से एक राजा हुआ  उसे कोई सच्तान नहीं थी । ब्राह्मणों से पूछा कि मुझे पुत्रादि की प्राप्ति किस प्रकार होगी ? ब्राह्मणों ने कहा--राजन् ! गया में पिण्डदान करने से आपको सन्तति की प्राप्ति होगी । राजा विशाल भी गयाशिर में पिण्डदान करके पृत्रवान् हुआ ।६-८। आकाश में उसने रक्तवर्ण, ब्वेतवर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: If the Sraddha at Aksayavata is performed with great care and effort, with cooked rice alone, the pilgrim will lead the Pitrs to the indestructible and eternal Brahmaloka. If a single Brahmana is fed near that Vatavrksa (banyan tree) with vegetables or even with water,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the Sraddha at Aksayavata is performed with great care and effort, with cooked rice alone, the pilgrim will lead the Pitrs to the indestructible and eternal Brahmaloka. If a single Brahmana is fed near that Vatavrksa (banyan tree) with vegetables or even with water,…

verses.sanskrit: अक्रूरेश्वरतीर्थे च सार्धं तीर्थशतं स्थितम् । विमलेश्वरतीर्थे तु रेवासागरसङ्गमे । दशायुतानि तीर्थानां साधिकान्यब्रवीन्मुनिः
verses.transliteration: akrūreśvaratīrthe ca sārdhaṃ tīrthaśataṃ sthitam / vimaleśvaratīrthe tu revāsāgarasaṅgame / daśāyutāni tīrthānāṃ sādhikānyabravīnmuniḥ
verses.translation: Sixteen types of gifts should be made to the priest at Gayatlrtha after honouring him and offering him clothes, scents etc. in the company of one's sons.
verses.hindi: दानातिशयमालोक्य सर्वे विष्ण्वादयः सुरा: । संतुष्टा गयराजान॑ वरान्ब्रहीति चाब्रवन् । मैव पूर्व केउप्पकुबन्न करिष्यन्ति चापरे  इति । भवन्तु ऋतुपूजिता इत्यनन्तरं ख पुस्तकेअतिरिक्ताः कतिपयहलो का: सन्ति ते यथा-- गयाश्राद्धविधानाय ढिजा मूर्ताश्नतुदंश । तेषां वाक्य प्रकुर्वीत यदि ब्रह्मा स्वयं भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Sixteen types of gifts should be made to the priest at Gayatlrtha after honouring him and offering him clothes, scents etc. in the company of one's sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixteen types of gifts should be made to the priest at Gayatlrtha after honouring him and offering him clothes, scents etc. in the company of one's sons.

verses.sanskrit: ॥ इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे तीर्थसंख्यापरिगणनवर्णनं नामैकत्रिंशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ॥ र्क्व् अध्याय २३२ सूत उवाच: इति वः कथितं विप्रा रेवामाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । यथोपदिष्टं पार्थाय मार्कण्डेयेन वै पुरा
verses.transliteration: || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tīrthasaṃkhyāparigaṇanavarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rkv adhyāya 232 sūta uvāca: iti vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā revāmāhātmyamuttamam / yathopadiṣṭaṃ pārthāya mārkaṇḍeyena vai purā
verses.translation: Whatever is given at the Vata tree at Gayatlrtha to the Pity's will be Aksaya (indestructible). By seeing, bowing to and worshipping Vatesa with calm and composed mind, the pilgrim will lead his Pitrs to the indestructible and eternal Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: गौतम॑ काश्यपं कौत्सं कौशिक कण्वमेव च । भारद्वाज ह्यौशनसं वात्स्यं पाराशरं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever is given at the Vata tree at Gayatlrtha to the Pity's will be Aksaya (indestructible). By seeing, bowing to and worshipping Vatesa with calm and composed mind, the pilgrim will lead his Pitrs to the indestructible and eternal Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever is given at the Vata tree at Gayatlrtha to the Pity's will be Aksaya (indestructible). By seeing, bowing to and worshipping Vatesa with calm and composed mind, the pilgrim will lead his Pitrs to the indestructible and eternal Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तीर्थकदम्बाश्च तेषु तीर्थविशेषतः । प्राधान्येन मया ख्याता यथासङ्ख्यं यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tathā tīrthakadambāśca teṣu tīrthaviśeṣataḥ / prādhānyena mayā khyātā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathākramam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the Aksayavata which is a weapon severing the tree of worldly existence, which removes all the sins and which gives the imperishable Brahman.
verses.hindi: हरित्कुमारमाण्डव्यं लोकाक्षि लोकसंमहत् । वाशिष्ठं च तथा5घ्नेयं गोत्राण्येषां चतुर्देश । ।इति । +इंदमर्थ वास्ति ख. पुस्तके । द ह ११३९ वायुपुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the Aksayavata which is a weapon severing the tree of worldly existence, which removes all the sins and which gives the imperishable Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the Aksayavata which is a weapon severing the tree of worldly existence, which removes all the sins and which gives the imperishable Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्पवित्रमतुलं ह्येतत्पापहरं परम् । नर्मदाचरितं पुण्यं माहात्म्यं मुनिभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: etatpavitramatulaṃ hyetatpāpaharaṃ param / narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ munibhāṣitam
verses.translation: The king Gaya, performed a Yajna 1 wherein Daksina was offered and much food was cooked. It is impossible to calculate the number of articles made use of in it.
verses.hindi: दृष्टवापकाशे सित॑ रक्त कृष्णं पुरुषमब्रवीत् । के यूय॑ तेषु चवेकः सितः प्रोचे विशालकम् 0९ अहूं सितस्ते जनक इन्द्रलोकादिहा55गतः । मम पुत्र पिता रक्तो ब्रह्मह! पापकृत्तमः १०
verses.wordMeaning: The king Gaya, performed a Yajna 1 wherein Daksina was offered and much food was cooked. It is impossible to calculate the number of articles made use of in it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king Gaya, performed a Yajna 1 wherein Daksina was offered and much food was cooked. It is impossible to calculate the number of articles made use of in it.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तकल्पानुगो विप्रो नर्मदायां मुनीश्वराः । मृकण्डतनयो धीमान्परमार्थविदुत्तमः
verses.transliteration: saptakalpānugo vipro narmadāyāṃ munīśvarāḥ / mṛkaṇḍatanayo dhīmānparamārthaviduttamaḥ
verses.translation: The Brahmanas who were well propitiated and honoured well in the different lands, praised it. Visnu and others (gods) who were pleased spoke to Gaya, "Mention the boon you wish to choose."
verses.hindi: एवं पुत्र: पित॒णां च कर्तंव्या मुक्तिरुत्तमा १३ त्वं च राज्यं चिरं कृत्वा भत्तवा भोगांश्व दुलंभान् । यज्ञान्सदक्षिणान्कृत्वा याया विष्णुपुरं ततः एवं लब्घवरो राजा राज्य कृत्वा दिवं गतः। प्रेतराजः सह प्रेतगंयाभाद्धाहिवं गतः
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmanas who were well propitiated and honoured well in the different lands, praised it. Visnu and others (gods) who were pleased spoke to Gaya, "Mention the boon you wish to choose."
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmanas who were well propitiated and honoured well in the different lands, praised it. Visnu and others (gods) who were pleased spoke to Gaya, "Mention the boon you wish to choose."

verses.sanskrit: संसेव्य सर्वतीर्थानि नदीः सर्वाश्च वै पुरा । बहुकल्पस्मरां रेवामालक्ष्य शिवदेहजाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsevya sarvatīrthāni nadīḥ sarvāśca vai purā / bahukalpasmarāṃ revāmālakṣya śivadehajām
verses.translation: For the performance of Gayasraddha there were Brahmanas of fourteen Gotras. Even Brahma himself has to carry
verses.hindi: एवं कुष्णवर्ण के तीन पुरुषों को देखकर उनसे कहा, आपलोग कौन हैं ! उनमें से सर्वप्रथम एवेत पुरुष ने विशाल से कहा, मैं दवेत पुरुष तुम्हारा पिता हूँ, इस्द्रलोक से यहाँ आया हुआ हूँ, पत्र ! यह रक्त वर्ण बाले हमारे पिता हैं, जो ब्रह्महत्या के कारण महान पापी माने गये हैं ।8-१०। ये कृष्णवर्ण वाले हमारे पितामह हैं, जिन्होंने बहुतेरे ऋषियों का हनन किया है, ये दोनों अवीची नामक नरक में दुःख भोग रहे थे, किस्तु
verses.wordMeaning: For the performance of Gayasraddha there were Brahmanas of fourteen Gotras. Even Brahma himself has to carry
verses.commentary: Sense: For the performance of Gayasraddha there were Brahmanas of fourteen Gotras. Even Brahma himself has to carry

verses.sanskrit: मे कलेति च शर्वोक्तां शरणं शर्वजां ययौ । अजराममरां देवीं दैत्यध्वंसकरीं पराम्
verses.transliteration: me kaleti ca śarvoktāṃ śaraṇaṃ śarvajāṃ yayau / ajarāmamarāṃ devīṃ daityadhvaṃsakarīṃ parām
verses.translation: May this city be known as Gaya after my name. Let it be as renowned as the city of god Brahma." The Suras said, "May this be so". After granting the boon they vanished.
verses.hindi: तुम्हारे पिण्डदान से ये बोनों मुक्त हो गये । शत्रुकुल नाशक ! तुमने 'मैं अपने पिता, पितामह, एवं प्रपितामह लोगों को सस्तुष्ट कर रहा हूँ, ऐसा संकल्प कर जो जल दान किया था उसी के प्रभाव से हम तीनों एक साथ ही मुक्त हो गये । मेरे योज्य पुत्र ! तुमने हम सबों को दुःख सागर से उबार लिया, अब हम लोग परम सस्तुष्ट होकर उत्तम स्वर्मबलोक को जा रहे हैं। सभी पुत्रों को अपने पितरों की इसी प्रकार उत्तम मुक्ति के उपाय करने चाहिए ।११-१३। तुम भी चिरकाल तक राज्य सुख का अनुभव करके परम दुलभ भोगों का  उपभोग कर, विषुल दक्षिणा वाले अनेक यज्ञों का सदनुष्ठान कर विष्णुषुर को प्राप्त होगे। इस प्रकार अपने पितरों द्वारा वरदान प्राप्त कर राजा विशाल ने चिरकाल तक राज्य सुख का अनुभव करने के उपराश्त स्वग- प्राप्ति की । प्रेतराज अन्याग्य प्रेतों के साथ गयाश्राद्ध के महात्म्य से स्वर्ग को प्राप्त हुए । किसी प्रेत वें अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: May this city be known as Gaya after my name. Let it be as renowned as the city of god Brahma." The Suras said, "May this be so". After granting the boon they vanished.
verses.commentary: Sense: May this city be known as Gaya after my name. Let it be as renowned as the city of god Brahma." The Suras said, "May this be so". After granting the boon they vanished.

verses.sanskrit: महाविभवसंयुक्तां भवघ्नीं भवजाह्नवीम् । तस्यामाबध्य सत्प्रेम जातः सो ऽप्यजरामरः
verses.transliteration: mahāvibhavasaṃyuktāṃ bhavaghnīṃ bhavajāhnavīm / tasyāmābadhya satprema jātaḥ so 'pyajarāmaraḥ
verses.translation: "How can I beget sons etc.?" The Brahmanas said to Visala, "You will have everything by offering Pinqlas at Gaya."
verses.hindi: मुक्ति के लिए एक बनिये से कहा था कि तुम मेरे नाम से गयाशिर पर पिण्डदान करो ॥१४-१६। इससे हमारी प्रेत योनि छठ जायगी, मेरे धन को तुम ले लो  मेरे सब धत को तुम लेकर गया श्राद्ध करने
verses.wordMeaning: "How can I beget sons etc.?" The Brahmanas said to Visala, "You will have everything by offering Pinqlas at Gaya."
verses.commentary: Sense: "How can I beget sons etc.?" The Brahmanas said to Visala, "You will have everything by offering Pinqlas at Gaya."

verses.sanskrit: षष्टितीर्थसहस्राणि षष्टिकोट्यश्च सत्तमाः । व्यवस्थितानि रेवायास्तीरयुग्मे पदे पदे
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyaśca sattamāḥ / vyavasthitāni revāyāstīrayugme pade pade
verses.translation: Viiala offered Pindas at Gayaslrsa and begot sons. He saw in the sky three persons white, red and black in colour. He then asked, "Who are you?" One of them, the white one, said to Visala, "I, the white-one, am your father. I have come here from Indra's world.
verses.hindi: ८इृदमध न विद्यते ख. पुस्तके ! गत्वा गयां गयाशीषें प्रेतराजाय पिण्डकम् । समदादूबन्धुभिः सार्थ स्वपितृम्यस्ततों ददो ॥ १ ६ प्रेत: प्रेतत्वनिर्मक्तो वणिवस्वग॒हसागतः । एवं गयस्य शंभोश्र क्षेत्र विष्णो रवेस्तथा..
verses.wordMeaning: Viiala offered Pindas at Gayaslrsa and begot sons. He saw in the sky three persons white, red and black in colour. He then asked, "Who are you?" One of them, the white one, said to Visala, "I, the white-one, am your father. I have come here from Indra's world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Viiala offered Pindas at Gayaslrsa and begot sons. He saw in the sky three persons white, red and black in colour. He then asked, "Who are you?" One of them, the white one, said to Visala, "I, the white-one, am your father. I have come here from Indra's world.

verses.sanskrit: सारितः परितः सन्ति सतीर्थास्तु सहस्रशः । न तुलां यान्ति रेवायास्ताश्च मन्ये मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: sāritaḥ paritaḥ santi satīrthāstu sahasraśaḥ / na tulāṃ yānti revāyāstāśca manye munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: O Son, my father is this red one. He had slain a Brahmana. He was a sinner. This black one is your grandfather by whom many sages had been killed.
verses.hindi: पिण्डदानं ततः कुर्यात्पित॒र्णां मुक्तिकास्यया
verses.wordMeaning: O Son, my father is this red one. He had slain a Brahmana. He was a sinner. This black one is your grandfather by whom many sages had been killed.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Son, my father is this red one. He had slain a Brahmana. He was a sinner. This black one is your grandfather by whom many sages had been killed.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं यत्पृष्टमखिलं द्विजाः । यन्महेशमुखाच्छ्रुत्वा वायुराह ऋषीन्प्रति
verses.transliteration: etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭamakhilaṃ dvijāḥ / yanmaheśamukhācchrutvā vāyurāha ṛṣīnprati
verses.translation: They had fallen into the hell called Avici. They have been liberated by your offer of Pindas. O destroyer of enemies, you offered the water libation saying, "I shall propi¬ tiate my Pitps, Pitamahas and Prapitamahas". O excellent one, as a result thereof and in view of your above statement, we have come here simultaneously.
verses.hindi: प्राचोसरस्वतीतीर्थे स्नाव्वा चापि यथाविधि । संध्यामुपास्य सायाह्न॑ विष्णुलोक नयेत्पितन् ॥ बहजन्मकृतात्संध्यालोपास्मुक्तस्त्रिसंध्यकृत् में व्यय करो  सारी संपत्ति का छठा अंश मैं तुम्हें पारिश्रमिक के रूप में दे रहा हैँ । अपने नाम गोत्रादि भी यथाक्रम तुम्हें बतला रहा हूँ। प्रेत के अनुरोध पर बणिक ने अपने बन्धुवर्गों के साथ गया की यात्रा की और गया शिर में जाकर प्रेतराज के लिए पिण्ड प्रदान किया, और उसके बाद अपने पितरों का भी पिण्डदान किया । प्रेत प्रेत-योनि से मुक्त हो गया और पिण्डदान विधिवत् सम्पन्न करके वणिक अपने घर
verses.wordMeaning: They had fallen into the hell called Avici. They have been liberated by your offer of Pindas. O destroyer of enemies, you offered the water libation saying, "I shall propi¬ tiate my Pitps, Pitamahas and Prapitamahas". O excellent one,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They had fallen into the hell called Avici. They have been liberated by your offer of Pindas. O destroyer of enemies, you offered the water libation saying, "I shall propi¬ tiate my Pitps, Pitamahas and Prapitamahas". O excellent one,…

verses.sanskrit: तद्वन्मृकण्डतनयो ऽप्यनुभूयाखिलां नदीम् । सतीर्थां पदशः प्राह पाण्डुपुत्राय पावनीम्
verses.transliteration: tadvanmṛkaṇḍatanayo 'pyanubhūyākhilāṃ nadīm / satīrthāṃ padaśaḥ prāha pāṇḍuputrāya pāvanīm
verses.translation: All of us have been liberated by you. We shall go to the imperishable heavenly abode. Accompanied by you, the good son, all of us shall go to Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: आया । गय, शम्भू, विष्णु एवं रवि के क्षेत्रों का माहात्य इस श्रकार का है ।!3-२०॥ महानदी के तट पर अवस्थित गायत्री ती्थ में उपवास कर गायत्री के सामने स्नान कर प्रातः कालीन सन्ध्या का अनुष्ठान करना चाहिए  फिर सपिण्ड श्राद्ध कर्म सम्पन्न करना चाहिए। जो व्यक्ति ऐसा करता है वह अपने कुल को ब्रह्म पद की प्राप्ति कराता है। तदुपरानत समुदित तीर्थ में गायत्री के सम्मुख स्नान करने वाला मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: All of us have been liberated by you. We shall go to the imperishable heavenly abode. Accompanied by you, the good son, all of us shall go to Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of us have been liberated by you. We shall go to the imperishable heavenly abode. Accompanied by you, the good son, all of us shall go to Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्च कथितं सर्वं संक्षेपेण द्विजोत्तमाः । नर्मदाचरितं पुण्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: etacca kathitaṃ sarvaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa dvijottamāḥ / narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham
verses.translation: Verses 1 lb-20a give the story of the childless King Visala, how by pen- forming Sraddha and Piijdadana at Gaya he got a son and promoted his father, grandfather and great-grandfather (though sinners) to Brahmaloka. Story repeated in A 54-59 and NP.II-44.26-42; GP.I.84-34-39.
verses.hindi: मध्याक्न की संध्या करके अपने सौ कुलों को स्वर्ग प्राप्त कराता है। मध्याह्न सन्ध्या के बाद पितरों की मुक्ति की कामना से वहाँ पर भी पितरों के लिये पिण्ड प्रदान करना चाहिए ।३१-२२। फिर प्राचीसरस्वद्ी नामक तौथे में विधि पूर्वक स्तान कर सायद्भालीन सब्ध्या करने वाला अपने पितरों को विष्णु लोक प्राप्त कराता है । अनेक जन्म में सन्ध्या न करने के कारण संचित पापों से उक्त तौनों सन्ध्याओं का करने बाला पुक्त हो जाता है  तदनन्तर मुण्ड पृष्ठ पंत पर गदाघर के समीप में उनके चरणों से चिह्नित विशालक्षेत्र में स्थित लेलिहान नामक पवित्र तीथं है, जहाँ भरत का आश्रम था, यहीं पर आकाश गज्ञा का प्रवाह
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 1 lb-20a give the story of the childless King Visala, how by pen- forming Sraddha and Piijdadana at Gaya he got a son and promoted his father, grandfather and great-grandfather (though sinners) to Brahmaloka. Story repeated in A 54-59 and NP.II-44.26-42; GP.I.84-34-39.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 1 lb-20a give the story of the childless King Visala, how by pen- forming Sraddha and Piijdadana at Gaya he got a son and promoted his father, grandfather and great-grandfather (though sinners) to Brahmaloka. Story repeated in A 54-59 and NP.II-44.26-42; GP.I.84-34-39.

verses.sanskrit: किमन्यैः सरितां तोयैः सेवितैस् तु सहस्रशः । यदि संसेव्यते तोयं रेवायाः पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: kimanyaiḥ saritāṃ toyaiḥ sevitais tu sahasraśaḥ / yadi saṃsevyate toyaṃ revāyāḥ pāpanāśanam
verses.translation: (Addl. verses)-2—50.18*28
verses.hindi: इत: परमेकः इलोको5घिकः ख. पुस्तके--:
verses.wordMeaning: (Addl. verses)-2—50.18*28
verses.commentary: Sense: (Addl. verses)-2—50.18*28

verses.sanskrit: मेकलाजलसंसेवी मुक्तिमाप्नोति शाश्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: mekalājalasaṃsevī muktimāpnoti śāśvatīm
verses.translation: You shall be endowed with sons and grandsons. You will rule over the kingdom and then go to heaven. Becoming satiated with the pleasures thereof, you shall attain salvation.
verses.hindi: १९१४ वायुपुराणब् तौर्थे चाउप्फाशगड्भायां गिरिकर्णमुखेषु च  स्नातो5थ पिण्डदो ब्रह्मलोक॑ कुलशतं नयेत्ृ. ७२५
verses.wordMeaning: You shall be endowed with sons and grandsons. You will rule over the kingdom and then go to heaven. Becoming satiated with the pleasures thereof, you shall attain salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: You shall be endowed with sons and grandsons. You will rule over the kingdom and then go to heaven. Becoming satiated with the pleasures thereof, you shall attain salvation.

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा भजेन्मर्त्यो यद्यदिच्छति तीर्थगः । तत्तदाप्नोति नियतं श्रद्धयाश्रद्धयापि च
verses.transliteration: yathā yathā bhajenmartyo yadyadicchati tīrthagaḥ / tattadāpnoti niyataṃ śraddhayāśraddhayāpi ca
verses.translation: O son, liberation has been effected by you. We shall go to the excellent heaven. In this manner the excellent liber¬ ation of the Pitrs must be effected by all sons.
verses.hindi: देवनब्यां वेतरण्यां स्नातः स्वर्ग नयेत्पित॒न् । स्नातो गोदो बेतरण्यां त्रिःसप्तकुलमुद्ध रेत् २६
verses.wordMeaning: O son, liberation has been effected by you. We shall go to the excellent heaven. In this manner the excellent liber¬ ation of the Pitrs must be effected by all sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son, liberation has been effected by you. We shall go to the excellent heaven. In this manner the excellent liber¬ ation of the Pitrs must be effected by all sons.

verses.sanskrit: इदं ब्रह्मा हरिरिदमिदं साक्षात्परो हरः । इदं ब्रह्म निराकारं कैवल्यं नर्मदाजलम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ brahmā hariridamidaṃ sākṣātparo haraḥ / idaṃ brahma nirākāraṃ kaivalyaṃ narmadājalam
verses.translation: You will rule over the kingdom for a long time. You will enjoy the rarest of pleasures. You will perform Yajnas with suitable Daksinas and go to Visnu's city (Vaikuntha) thereafter."
verses.hindi: + या सा बेतरणी नाम नदी ज्रैलोक्यविश्वुता । सावतीर्णा गयाक्षेत्रे पित॒णां तारणाय वे » त्रिराज्रोपोषणेनेव तोर्थाभिगमनेन च। अदत्त्वा काञचनं गाश्च दरिद्रो जायते नरः+.
verses.wordMeaning: You will rule over the kingdom for a long time. You will enjoy the rarest of pleasures. You will perform Yajnas with suitable Daksinas and go to Visnu's city (Vaikuntha) thereafter."
verses.commentary: Sense: You will rule over the kingdom for a long time. You will enjoy the rarest of pleasures. You will perform Yajnas with suitable Daksinas and go to Visnu's city (Vaikuntha) thereafter."

verses.sanskrit: तावद्गर्जन्ति तीर्थानि नद्यो हृदयफलप्रदाः । यावन्न स्मर्यते रेवा सेवाहेवा कलौ नरैः
verses.transliteration: tāvadgarjanti tīrthāni nadyo hṛdayaphalapradāḥ / yāvanna smaryate revā sevāhevā kalau naraiḥ
verses.translation: In order to secure his liberation, a certain ghost spoke thus to a certain merchant: "Please offer Pinda in my name at Gayasiras in order to secure for me release from my ghosthood. Take (all) my wealth. Taking all the wealth to meet theexpenses connected with the Gayasraddha. I have given you five-sixteenth part of my wealth (as your remuneration). I have mentioned my name (etc.) in the proper manner."
verses.hindi: प्रवाहित होता है, गिरिकर्ण मुख नामक कई पवित्र तीर्थ भी वहीं पर हैं, वहाँ पर स्तान कर पिण्डदान करने वाला अपने सो कुलों को ब्रह्मलोक प्राप्त कराता है ।२३-२४। देवनदी वेतरुणी में स्नान करने वाला अपने पितरों को स्वर्गलोक प्राप्त कराता है एवं उसी वैतरणी में स्नान कर गौ दान करने वाला व्यक्ति अपने इक्कीस कुलों का उद्धार करता है  नारदजी ! बेतरणौ में स्नान करने वालों के लिए जो फल मैं बतला रहा
verses.wordMeaning: In order to secure his liberation, a certain ghost spoke thus to a certain merchant: "Please offer Pinda in my name at Gayasiras in order to secure for me release from my ghosthood. Take (all) my wealth. Taking all the wealth to meet theexpenses connected with the Gayasraddha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to secure his liberation, a certain ghost spoke thus to a certain merchant: "Please offer Pinda in my name at Gayasiras in order to secure for me release from my ghosthood. Take (all) my wealth. Taking all the wealth to meet theexpenses connected with the Gayasraddha.…

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवं लोके हितार्थाय शिवेन स्वशरीरतः । शक्तिः कापि सरिद्रूपा रेवेयमवतारिता
verses.transliteration: dhruvaṃ loke hitārthāya śivena svaśarīrataḥ / śaktiḥ kāpi saridrūpā reveyamavatāritā
verses.translation: The man went to Gaya along with his kinsmen and offered Pindas to the king of ghosts at Gayasirsa. It was only after that, that he offered the Pinclas to his own Pitrs.
verses.hindi: हूँ, वह सत्य है, सत्य है और सत्य है। ऐसा कहा जाता है कि वेतरणी में स्ताव करने गोदान करने वाला निस्सभ्देह् अपने दहृक्‍कीस कुलों का उद्धार करता है ।२६-२७। तीनों लोकों में अपने अनृपभ माहात्म्य के कारण जो परम पघिख्यात है वह वेतरणी नदी गबयाक्षेत्र में पितरों को तारने के लिये अवतरित हुई है। इस पुनीत क्षेत्र की यात्रा करके तीन रात का उपवास करना चाहिए, किन्तु यहाँ आकर सुवर्ण और गो का जो मनुष्य दाम नहीं करता वह दरिद्र होता है ।२८-२९॥ घ्तकुल्या, मधुकुल्या, देविका, महानदी तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The man went to Gaya along with his kinsmen and offered Pindas to the king of ghosts at Gayasirsa. It was only after that, that he offered the Pinclas to his own Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man went to Gaya along with his kinsmen and offered Pindas to the king of ghosts at Gayasirsa. It was only after that, that he offered the Pinclas to his own Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: तावद्गर्जन्ति यज्ञाश्च वनक्षेत्रादयो भृशम् । यावन्न नर्मदानामकीर्तनं क्रियते कलौ
verses.transliteration: tāvadgarjanti yajñāśca vanakṣetrādayo bhṛśam / yāvanna narmadānāmakīrtanaṃ kriyate kalau
verses.translation: The ghost was liberated from ghosthood. The merchant came back to his house. Thus is the holy centre of Gaya, of Sambhu, Visnu and Ravi.
verses.hindi: संशय इत्यनन्तरं क. पुस्तकटिध्पण्यामधिक इलोकद्यमस्ति तद्यथा-- यमद्वारे महाषोरे या सा वंतरणी नदी । तामह तत्मिच्छामि कृष्णां गां प्रददन्निमाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The ghost was liberated from ghosthood. The merchant came back to his house. Thus is the holy centre of Gaya, of Sambhu, Visnu and Ravi.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ghost was liberated from ghosthood. The merchant came back to his house. Thus is the holy centre of Gaya, of Sambhu, Visnu and Ravi.

verses.sanskrit: गरिमा गाण्यते तावत्तपोदानव्रतादिषु । नरैर्वा प्राप्यते यावद्भुवि भर्गभवा धुनी
verses.transliteration: garimā gāṇyate tāvattapodānavratādiṣu / narairvā prāpyate yāvadbhuvi bhargabhavā dhunī
verses.translation: The pilgrim should observe fast in the holy centre of Gayatrl, on the banks of the great river Phalgu (Mahanadi). After taking bath, in front of Gayatrl, one should perform Prataht-Sandhya (Sandhya prayer to be perfromed at dawn).
verses.hindi: अशक्तो यदि वा शक्तों गोप्रदान॑ करोति यः । देवनयां गोप्रदाने श्राद्धदः स्वनेयेत्पितृन् ॥इति + अय॑ श्लोको नाए्ति ख. पुस्तके ।. » त्रिरात्रोपोषणेनेति इलोकात्प्राक क. पुस्तकेडधिक इलोकद्वयमस्ति
verses.wordMeaning: The pilgrim should observe fast in the holy centre of Gayatrl, on the banks of the great river Phalgu (Mahanadi). After taking bath, in front of Gayatrl, one should perform Prataht-Sandhya (Sandhya prayer to be perfromed at dawn).
verses.commentary: Sense: The pilgrim should observe fast in the holy centre of Gayatrl, on the banks of the great river Phalgu (Mahanadi). After taking bath, in front of Gayatrl, one should perform Prataht-Sandhya (Sandhya prayer to be perfromed at dawn).

verses.sanskrit: ये वसन्त्युत्तरे कूले रुद्रस्यानुचरा हि ते । वसन्ति याम्यतीरे ये लोकं ते यान्ति वैष्णवम्
verses.transliteration: ye vasantyuttare kūle rudrasyānucarā hi te / vasanti yāmyatīre ye lokaṃ te yānti vaiṣṇavam
verses.translation: By performing the Sraddha along with the offering of the Pindas, the pilgrim shall lead his family to the state of being favourabler to the Brahmanas. After taking the holy dip
verses.hindi: गोदावर्या वैतरण्यां यमुनायां तथेव च । देवनयां गोप्रचारे श्राद्धदः स्वनंयेपितृ न्
verses.wordMeaning: By performing the Sraddha along with the offering of the Pindas, the pilgrim shall lead his family to the state of being favourabler to the Brahmanas. After taking the holy dip
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing the Sraddha along with the offering of the Pindas, the pilgrim shall lead his family to the state of being favourabler to the Brahmanas. After taking the holy dip

verses.sanskrit: धन्यास्ते देशवर्यास्ते येषु देशेषु नर्मदा । नरकान्तकरी शश्वत्संश्रिता शर्वनिर्मिता
verses.transliteration: dhanyāste deśavaryāste yeṣu deśeṣu narmadā / narakāntakarī śaśvatsaṃśritā śarvanirmitā
verses.translation: Verses 20b-25 tell how a ghost attained heaven when at his request (and for consideration of some property) an unrelated merchant offered pindas at Gaya.
verses.hindi: पुष्करिण्यां घृतकुल्यां मधुकुल्यां तथेव च । कोटितीर्थे रुक्मिणीये पिण्डदः स्वनंयेत्पितृन् ॥इति + इत: परमेते इलोकाः ख. पुस्तकेषधिका उपलम्यस्ते ते यथा-- श्राद्धी कुमारधारायामश्वभेघफल लभेत् । कुमारममिगम्याथ नत्वा मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 20b-25 tell how a ghost attained heaven when at his request (and for consideration of some property) an unrelated merchant offered pindas at Gaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 20b-25 tell how a ghost attained heaven when at his request (and for consideration of some property) an unrelated merchant offered pindas at Gaya.

verses.sanskrit: कृतपुण्याश्च ते लोकाः शोकाय न भवन्ति ते । ये पिबन्ति जलं पुण्यं पार्वतीपतिसिन्धुजम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtapuṇyāśca te lokāḥ śokāya na bhavanti te / ye pibanti jalaṃ puṇyaṃ pārvatīpatisindhujam
verses.translation: After taking bath duly in the holy water called Praci- sarasvati and performing the Sandhya-prayer in the evening the pilgrim shall lead the Pitrs to Visnuloka.
verses.hindi: स्तात्वा च सोमधघारायां सोमलोक च गच्छति । सस्वने कृच्नरो वाप्य॑ स्वर्ग: स्वर्ग नयेत्पित॒न्
verses.wordMeaning: After taking bath duly in the holy water called Praci- sarasvati and performing the Sandhya-prayer in the evening the pilgrim shall lead the Pitrs to Visnuloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: After taking bath duly in the holy water called Praci- sarasvati and performing the Sandhya-prayer in the evening the pilgrim shall lead the Pitrs to Visnuloka.

verses.sanskrit: इदं पवित्रमतुलं रेवायाश्चरितं द्विजाः । शृणोति यः कीर्तयते मुच्यते सर्वपातकः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ pavitramatulaṃ revāyāścaritaṃ dvijāḥ / śṛṇoti yaḥ kīrtayate mucyate sarvapātakaḥ
verses.translation: A person who has incurred sin due to negligence of performing Sandhya (prayer to beperformed during the twilight period e.g. dawn and dusk) in many births becomes libera¬ ted by performing Sandhya on three occasions in the holy centre Lelihana, in Visala as well as in the hermitage of Bharata.
verses.hindi: घ॒तकुल्या मधुकुल्या देविका च महानदी । शिलायाः संगमो यत्र तत्र प्रोक्ता सधुस्नवा १३० कुलानां शतमुद्धत्य विष्णुलोक॑ नयेपितुन्  0३ १ दशाश्वमे घिके हंंसतीर्थे चामरकण्टके । कोटितीथें रुक्‍्मकुण्डे पिण्डदः स्वनंयेत्पितुन्
verses.wordMeaning: A person who has incurred sin due to negligence of performing Sandhya (prayer to beperformed during the twilight period e.g. dawn and dusk) in many births becomes libera¬ ted by performing Sandhya on three occasions in the holy centre Lelihana,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who has incurred sin due to negligence of performing Sandhya (prayer to beperformed during the twilight period e.g. dawn and dusk) in many births becomes libera¬ ted by performing Sandhya on three occasions in the holy centre Lelihana,…

verses.sanskrit: यत्फलं सर्ववेदैश्च सषडङ्गपदक्रमैः । श्रुतैश्च पठितैस्तस्मात्फलमष्टगुणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yatphalaṃ sarvavedaiśca saṣaḍaṅgapadakramaiḥ / śrutaiśca paṭhitaistasmātphalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: A person who takes bath and makes gifts of cows in Vaitaranl, uplifts twentyone generations. O Narada (I repeat it three times to emphasize that it is true) it is true that he who takes bath in Vaitaranl redeems twentyone generations; they say so; there is no doubt in this. The river Vaitarani which is well known in the three worlds has descended down into Gayaksetra for the redemption of Pitrs. A person who performs Sraddha in (on the bank of) the Godavari, Vaitaranl, Yamuna and in the celestial river (i.e. Gariga) in the holy centre Gopracara; leads his Pitrs to heaven. A person who offers Pindas in Puskarinl, in Ghrtakulya and Madhukulya, in the Kotitlrtha pertaining to RukminI leads his Pitrs to heaven by observing fast for.three nights and visiting the sacred waters.
verses.hindi: / बेतरण्यां घृतकुल्यां मधुकुल्यां तथेव च। कोटीतोर्थे नरः स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वा कोटीश्वेर व यः
verses.wordMeaning: A person who takes bath and makes gifts of cows in Vaitaranl, uplifts twentyone generations. O Narada (I repeat it three times to emphasize that it is true) it is true that he who takes bath in Vaitaranl redeems twentyone generations; they say so; there is no doubt in this.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who takes bath and makes gifts of cows in Vaitaranl, uplifts twentyone generations. O Narada (I repeat it three times to emphasize that it is true) it is true that he who takes bath in Vaitaranl redeems twentyone generations; they say so; there is no doubt in this.…

verses.sanskrit: सत्रयाजी फलं यच्च लभते द्वादशाब्दिकम् । श्रुत्वा सकृच्च रेवायाश्चरितं तत्फलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: satrayājī phalaṃ yacca labhate dvādaśābdikam / śrutvā sakṛcca revāyāścaritaṃ tatphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: By not giving gold or kine, a man becomes indigent. A man who takes ablutions in Ghrtakulya, Madhukulya, Devika, Mahanadi (Phalgu) and in the celebrated place of
verses.hindi: कोटिजन्म भवेद्रिप्रो धनाढयो वेदपारगः । मार्कण्डयेशकोटीशो नत्वा स्थात्पितृतारकः रुक्मपारिजातवने पावंत्या सह शंकरः । रहस्ये संस्थितो रेमे युगानामयुत पुरा
verses.wordMeaning: By not giving gold or kine, a man becomes indigent. A man who takes ablutions in Ghrtakulya, Madhukulya, Devika, Mahanadi (Phalgu) and in the celebrated place of
verses.commentary: Sense: By not giving gold or kine, a man becomes indigent. A man who takes ablutions in Ghrtakulya, Madhukulya, Devika, Mahanadi (Phalgu) and in the celebrated place of

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थावगाहाच्च यत्फलं सागरादिषु । सकृच्छ्रुत्वा च माहात्म्यं रेवायास् तत्फलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthāvagāhācca yatphalaṃ sāgarādiṣu / sakṛcchrutvā ca māhātmyaṃ revāyās tatphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: After performing the Sraddha along with the offering of Pinzas, the man uplifts a hundred generations in his family and leads them to Visnuloka.
verses.hindi: शिला के संगम पर स्थित मधुश्रवा--इन सब में स्नान करने वाला दस सहक्त अह्वभेध यज्ञ का फल प्राप्त करता है  सविण्डक श्राद्ध एवं पिण्डदान करके मनुष्य अपने सो कुलों को एवं समस्त पितरयणों को नरकयातना से उबार कर विष्णुलोक प्राप्त कराता है ।३०-३१॥ दक्षाबवमेध, हँसतीरथं, अमरकण्टक, कोटितीय तथा रुक्‍मकुण्ड में पिण्डदान करनेवाला अपने पितरों को स्वर्ग प्राप्त कराता है। बेतरणी,
verses.wordMeaning: After performing the Sraddha along with the offering of Pinzas, the man uplifts a hundred generations in his family and leads them to Visnuloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Sraddha along with the offering of Pinzas, the man uplifts a hundred generations in his family and leads them to Visnuloka.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्धर्म्यमुपाख्यानं सर्वशास्त्रेष्वनुत्तमम् । देशे वा मण्डले वापि नगरे ग्राममध्यतः
verses.transliteration: etaddharmyamupākhyānaṃ sarvaśāstreṣvanuttamam / deśe vā maṇḍale vāpi nagare grāmamadhyataḥ
verses.translation: One who offers Pindas in Dasasvamedha, Hamsatirtha, Amarakantaka, Kotitirtha and Rukmakunda leads his Pitrs to heaven.
verses.hindi: धृतकुल्या, मधुकुल्या, तथा कोटितीर्थ में स्तानकर जो मनुष्य कोटीइवर का दर्शन करता है, वह एक कोटि जन्म तक वेदपारगामी धनयुक्त ब्राह्मण होता है। मार्कण्डेय एवं कोटीहवर को नमस्कार करके लोग अपने पितरों के उद्धारक होते हैं 4१२-३४। एक बार ख्वमपारिजात नामक बन में बहुत प्राचीनकाल में नारायणं न वाराहूं संपृज्य स्वर्गभाग्भवेत् । क्षेत्रपालं समभ्यच्य ग्रहैऋ क्षैनें बाध्यते
verses.wordMeaning: One who offers Pindas in Dasasvamedha, Hamsatirtha, Amarakantaka, Kotitirtha and Rukmakunda leads his Pitrs to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who offers Pindas in Dasasvamedha, Hamsatirtha, Amarakantaka, Kotitirtha and Rukmakunda leads his Pitrs to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: गृहे वा तिष्ठते यस्य लिखितं सार्ववार्णिकम् । स ब्रह्मा स शिवः साक्षात्स च देवो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: gṛhe vā tiṣṭhate yasya likhitaṃ sārvavārṇikam / sa brahmā sa śivaḥ sākṣātsa ca devo janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: By taking bath in Vaitaram, Ghrtakulya, Madhu- kulya and Kotitlrtha and visiting Kotisvara, the pilgrim be¬ comes a rich Brahmana and a master of all the Vedas fora crore of births. Bowing to Markanqleyesa and Kotisa he shall be the redeemer of his Pitrs.
verses.hindi: गरुड च समभ्यच्यं विषवृक्षात्रमुच्यते  सिद्धेदवर च कालेश सोमनाथमहेश्वरम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: By taking bath in Vaitaram, Ghrtakulya, Madhu- kulya and Kotitlrtha and visiting Kotisvara, the pilgrim be¬ comes a rich Brahmana and a master of all the Vedas fora crore of births. Bowing to Markanqleyesa and Kotisa he shall be the redeemer of his Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking bath in Vaitaram, Ghrtakulya, Madhu- kulya and Kotitlrtha and visiting Kotisvara, the pilgrim be¬ comes a rich Brahmana and a master of all the Vedas fora crore of births. Bowing to Markanqleyesa and Kotisa he shall be the redeemer of his Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां मार्गे ऽयं देवसेवितः । गुरूणां च गुरुः शास्त्रं परमं सिद्धिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ mārge 'yaṃ devasevitaḥ / gurūṇāṃ ca guruḥ śāstraṃ paramaṃ siddhikāraṇam
verses.translation: Formerly Sankara sported secretly with Parvati 2 in the forest called Rukmaparijatavana for ten thousand Yugas.
verses.hindi: रुद्रेइवर्य लोकनाथं ब्रह्म शं॑ व कपेंदिनम् । भ्रष्टो लिड्भानि गुह्मानि संपृज्याथ शिव नयेत् पिण्डद्आ्वम्पकारण्ये चम्पकेशं प्रणम्य च  वथव जम्बुकारण्ये ब्रह्मलोंक नयेप्पितृ न्
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly Sankara sported secretly with Parvati 2 in the forest called Rukmaparijatavana for ten thousand Yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly Sankara sported secretly with Parvati 2 in the forest called Rukmaparijatavana for ten thousand Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं पुराणं देवभाषितम् । ब्राह्मणो वेदवान्भूयात्क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ purāṇaṃ devabhāṣitam / brāhmaṇo vedavānbhūyātkṣatriyo vijayī bhavet
verses.translation: Marici went to this Parijatavana for gathering fruits and flowers. He was seen by Mahesa. Since he had become the cause of the obstruction of his (Siva's) pleasure he was curs¬ ed by Mahesa.
verses.hindi: गोकर्णे वायुतीर्थे च तृतीयास्ये जलाशये । श्राद्धी च पृष्करिण्यां तु ब्रह्मलोक॑ नयेत्पितृन्
verses.wordMeaning: Marici went to this Parijatavana for gathering fruits and flowers. He was seen by Mahesa. Since he had become the cause of the obstruction of his (Siva's) pleasure he was curs¬ ed by Mahesa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Marici went to this Parijatavana for gathering fruits and flowers. He was seen by Mahesa. Since he had become the cause of the obstruction of his (Siva's) pleasure he was curs¬ ed by Mahesa.

verses.sanskrit: धनाढ्यो जायते वैश्यः शूद्रो वै धर्मभाग् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: dhanāḍhyo jāyate vaiśyaḥ śūdro vai dharmabhāg bhavet
verses.translation: "You shall become miserable." This was the curse. Afraid of him, Marici eulogised Siva. The delighted Sambhu spoke to him, "Choose an excellent boon".
verses.hindi: ८ इत उत्तरमविस्पष्टदलोकः ख« पुस्तके वर्तते स यथा--गदाघरादुक्षिनों यावती्थंमधुश्रवा: । मद्दानदिद्धून च मृत्रानां स्वगेंकारकमू । . एतबिद्ञलान्तर्गतग्रथस्थानेश्यं इलोकः ख. पुस्तके स दुःखी भवेति तःद्भीतो मरीचिस्तुष्टुवे शिवम् । तुष्टः प्रोवाच त॑ं शंभुव॒ णीष्व वरमृत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: "You shall become miserable." This was the curse. Afraid of him, Marici eulogised Siva. The delighted Sambhu spoke to him, "Choose an excellent boon".
verses.commentary: Sense: "You shall become miserable." This was the curse. Afraid of him, Marici eulogised Siva. The delighted Sambhu spoke to him, "Choose an excellent boon".

verses.sanskrit: सौभाग्यसन्ततिं नारी श्रुत्वैतत्समवाप्नुयात् । श्रियं सौख्यं स्वर्गवासं जन्म चैवोत्तमे कुले
verses.transliteration: saubhāgyasantatiṃ nārī śrutvaitatsamavāpnuyāt / śriyaṃ saukhyaṃ svargavāsaṃ janma caivottame kule
verses.translation: Marici spoke to Sankara, "May I have the absolu¬ tion from the curse". "At Gaya you will have the liberation", spoken thus by Siva, he went to Gaya.
verses.hindi: शापाजूब॒तु मुक्तिम मरीचिः प्राहु शंकरम् । भवेद्गयायां मुक्तिस्ते शिषोक्तः प्रययों गयामू ३४८ शिलास्थितस्तपस्तेपे सर्वेषां दुष्करं च यत् । मरीचिरीश्वराच्छप्त: कृष्णत्वमगमत्पुरा ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Marici spoke to Sankara, "May I have the absolu¬ tion from the curse". "At Gaya you will have the liberation", spoken thus by Siva, he went to Gaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Marici spoke to Sankara, "May I have the absolu¬ tion from the curse". "At Gaya you will have the liberation", spoken thus by Siva, he went to Gaya.

verses.sanskrit: रसभेदी कृतघ्नश्च स्वामिध्रुङ् मित्रवञ्चकः । गोघ्नश्च गरदश्चैव कन्याविक्रयकारकः
verses.transliteration: rasabhedī kṛtaghnaśca svāmidhruṅ mitravañcakaḥ / goghnaśca garadaścaiva kanyāvikrayakārakaḥ
verses.translation: Marici who had been cursed by Isvara formerly attain¬ ed Krfnatva (blackness of complexion). Seated on a rock, he performed a penance very difficult for anyone else to perform.
verses.hindi: हरशापाद्विमुक्तोडह शिला भवतु पावनों । पितृमुक्तिकरी च स्यात्तथेत्युकत्वा दिवं गतः ३४ १ दिवोकसां पुष्करिणों समासाद्य नरः शुचिः ॥ यत्र दत्त पितृभ्यस्तु भवत्यक्षयमित्युतः तन्न स्नातो दिवं याति स्वशरीरेण मानवः । पाप्सानं प्रजहात्येष जोणेत्वचसियोंरगः ॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: Marici who had been cursed by Isvara formerly attain¬ ed Krfnatva (blackness of complexion). Seated on a rock, he performed a penance very difficult for anyone else to perform.
verses.commentary: Sense: Marici who had been cursed by Isvara formerly attain¬ ed Krfnatva (blackness of complexion). Seated on a rock, he performed a penance very difficult for anyone else to perform.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापी च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः । नर्मदाचरितं शृण्वंस्तामब्दं यो ऽभिषेवते
verses.transliteration: brahmaghnaśca surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ / narmadācaritaṃ śṛṇvaṃstāmabdaṃ yo 'bhiṣevate
verses.translation: By means of a terrible penance, that Brahmana attain¬ ed Suklata (whiteness of complexion). Hari spoke to Marici, "O son, choose a boon".
verses.hindi: महादेव जी पव॑ती के साथ दस सहख्र युगों तक रहस्यक्रीडा कर रहे थे । संयोगतः फलपुष्पादि चुनने के लिये मरीचि ऋषि उसी पारिजात वन में गये  अपने सुख में विधातक होने के कारण भहेश ने मरीचि को शाप दे दिया कि तुम दुःख का अनुभव करो  शापभय से भीत होकर मरीचि ने शद्भूर को स्तुति से सस्तुष्ट होकर झ्षिवजी ने कहा कि कोई उत्तम बरदान माँगो ।३५-३७। मरोचि ने छिव से निवेदत किया कि भगवन् ।
verses.wordMeaning: By means of a terrible penance, that Brahmana attain¬ ed Suklata (whiteness of complexion). Hari spoke to Marici, "O son, choose a boon".
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of a terrible penance, that Brahmana attain¬ ed Suklata (whiteness of complexion). Hari spoke to Marici, "O son, choose a boon".

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो जायते नात्र संशयः । पाकभेदी वृथापाकी देवब्राह्मणनिन्दकः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmukto jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / pākabhedī vṛthāpākī devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ
verses.translation: Marici said to Madhava, "When you are satisfied, what is inaccessible? I have been relieved from the curse of Hara. May this rock be sacred.
verses.hindi: इस ज्ञाप से मेरी मुक्ति हो --यही प्रार्थना है । शिव बे कहा कि जाओ तुम्हारी मुक्ति गयातीथ में जाने से होगी । शिव के आदेशानुसाश मरीचि गया को प्रस्थित हो गये । और वहाँ जाकर शिला पर स्थित होकर परम कठोर तपस्या करनी शुरू की । उसे सभी लोग कठिनता से कर सकते थे । महादेव के शाप से जो मरीचि पूर्वकाल में क्ृष्णवर्ण के हो गये थे वे ही अपने इस कठोर तप के माहात्म्य से शुक्लवर्ण हो गये ।३८-३६॥ हरि ने मरीचि से कहा, पुत्र ! कोई वरदान माँयों, मरीचि ने माघव से निवेदन किया, भगवन्  आप के सन्तुष्ठ हो आने पर संसार में कौन-सी बस्तु ऐसी है, जो अलम्य हो मैं जिस शिला पर तपकरा शिव शाप से विमुक्त हुआ हूँ, वह शिला परम पुनीत हो जाय, पितरों की मुक्तितायनी बन जाय। मरीचि की प्रार्थना को अज्भीकार कर भगवान् स्वर्ग को चले गये । स्वर्ग निवासी देवगणों की पुष्करिणी के पास पहुँच कर मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: Marici said to Madhava, "When you are satisfied, what is inaccessible? I have been relieved from the curse of Hara. May this rock be sacred.
verses.commentary: Sense: Marici said to Madhava, "When you are satisfied, what is inaccessible? I have been relieved from the curse of Hara. May this rock be sacred.

verses.sanskrit: परीवादी गुरोः पित्रोः साधूनां नृपतेस्तथा । ते ऽपि श्रुत्वा च पापेभ्यो मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: parīvādī guroḥ pitroḥ sādhūnāṃ nṛpatestathā / te 'pi śrutvā ca pāpebhyo mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Verses 26-43 describe other sacred spots at Gaya such as Gayatri- tlrtha, Praci-Sarasvatl Tfrth, Visala, Lelihana and Bharata's hermitage (30- 32), Mutujaprsiha, Akas'aganga (26-32), Vaitararii (33-37)and others.
verses.hindi: परम पवित्र हो जाता है। वहाँ पर दान देने से पितरों को अक्षयफल की प्राप्ति होती है वहाँ पर स्नान करनेवाला प्राणी सदेह स्व प्राप्त करता है, अपने समस्त पापकर्मों को वह सर्प के केंचुल की भाँति छोड़ देशा दे । वहां मचोहर पंकजवन पृण्यशील जनों से सुसेवित है ।४००४३। घद्दीं पर पुनीत पाण्डुशिन्रा भी है; जिस
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 26-43 describe other sacred spots at Gaya such as Gayatri- tlrtha, Praci-Sarasvatl Tfrth, Visala, Lelihana and Bharata's hermitage (30- 32), Mutujaprsiha, Akas'aganga (26-32), Vaitararii (33-37)and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 26-43 describe other sacred spots at Gaya such as Gayatri- tlrtha, Praci-Sarasvatl Tfrth, Visala, Lelihana and Bharata's hermitage (30- 32), Mutujaprsiha, Akas'aganga (26-32), Vaitararii (33-37)and others.

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनर्भावितात्मानः शस्त्रं शृण्वन्ति नित्यशः । पूजयन्ति च तच्छास्त्रं नार्मदं वस्त्रभूषणैः
verses.transliteration: ye punarbhāvitātmānaḥ śastraṃ śṛṇvanti nityaśaḥ / pūjayanti ca tacchāstraṃ nārmadaṃ vastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Verses 44-51 tell how Marici was absolved of the curse of Siva by performing penance at Gaya.
verses.hindi: तत्न काले पाण्डुनोक्त मद्धस्ते देहि पिण्डकम् । हस्त त्यकत्वा शिलायां व् पिण्डदानं चकार सः इत्युक्त्वा प्रययो पाण्डु: शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्। मतड्भास्य पदे भ्राद्धी ब्रह्मलोक॑ नयेत्पित न् ४६९
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 44-51 tell how Marici was absolved of the curse of Siva by performing penance at Gaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 44-51 tell how Marici was absolved of the curse of Siva by performing penance at Gaya.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पैः फलैश् चन्दनाद्यैर् भोजनैर् विविधैर् अपि । शास्त्रे ऽस्मिन्पूजिते देवाः पूजिता गुरवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: puṣpaiḥ phalaiś candanādyair bhojanair vividhair api / śāstre 'sminpūjite devāḥ pūjitā guravastathā
verses.translation: By the offer of the Pind a ° n the rock, Vyasa s son
verses.hindi: निर्मथ्याग्नि शमीगर्भे विधिविष्ण्वादिभिः सह । लेभे तीर्थ तु यज्ञार्थ त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्ुतम्॒
verses.wordMeaning: By the offer of the Pind a ° n the rock, Vyasa s son
verses.commentary: Sense: By the offer of the Pind a ° n the rock, Vyasa s son

verses.sanskrit: इह लोके परे चैव नात्र कार्या विचारणा । तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन गन्धवस्त्रादिभूषणैः
verses.transliteration: iha loke pare caiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā / tasmātsarvaprayatnena gandhavastrādibhūṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: All the four typeso.fi'jiving beings, viz. Udbhijjas (plants), Svedajas (sweat-born germs), Anfajas (egg-born birds) and Jarayujas ' (womb-born animals) who approach Madhu- srava shall go to the city of heaven after death.
verses.hindi: पित॒नन्‍्स्वर्ग नयेन्नत्वा संगमे5ड्भा रकेश्वरो । गयाकूटे पिण्डदानादश्वमेधफलं लभेत् (५२ पर किया गया श्राद्धक्म अक्षयफलदायी होता है। मुनि नारद जी! प्राचीनकाल में उस शिला पर जब युधिष्ठिर श्राद्ध करने के लिये बये थे उस समय स्वयं पाण्ड ने आकर कहा कि पुत्र ! मेरे हाथों पर पिण्ड प्रदान करो । किन्तु उन्होंने हाथ को छोड़कर शिला पर ही पर पिण्ड प्रदान किया । शिला पर पिण्ड प्रदान करने से व्यासनन्दन पाण्डु को परम ह॒ष॑ प्राप्त हुआ। उन्होंने अपने पुत्र को वरदान दिया कि पुत्र ! इस
verses.wordMeaning: All the four typeso.fi'jiving beings, viz. Udbhijjas (plants), Svedajas (sweat-born germs), Anfajas (egg-born birds) and Jarayujas ' (womb-born animals) who approach Madhu- srava shall go to the city of heaven after death.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the four typeso.fi'jiving beings, viz. Udbhijjas (plants), Svedajas (sweat-born germs), Anfajas (egg-born birds) and Jarayujas ' (womb-born animals) who approach Madhu- srava shall go to the city of heaven after death.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या वाचकं शास्त्रमेव च । वेदपाठैश्च यत्पुण्यमग्निहोत्रैश्च पालितैः
verses.transliteration: pūjayetparayā bhaktyā vācakaṃ śāstrameva ca / vedapāṭhaiśca yatpuṇyamagnihotraiśca pālitaiḥ
verses.translation: By performing Sraddha in Dasasvamedhika and Hamsatirtha one goes to heaven. By bowing to Dasasvamedha and Hamsa, one goes to Sivapura.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीतल पर तुम निष्कण्टक राज्य करो, तुम मेरे उद्धारक हो ।॥४४-४७। अपने भाइयों के साथ तुम सदेह स्वर्ग जाओ और अपनी दृष्टि मात्र से नरक निवासियों को पवित्र कर स्वर्ग प्राप्त कराओ ।” ऐसा कहकर पाण्ड मव्यय शाश्वत पद को चले गये । मतद्भु के चरणों पर श्राद्ध करनेबाला अपने पितरों को स्वर्ग लोक प्राप्त कराता है। विष्णुप्रभृति प्रमुख देवगणों के साथ ब्रह्मा जी ने शमी के गर्भ से मथकर यज्ञ के लिये अग्नि
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Sraddha in Dasasvamedhika and Hamsatirtha one goes to heaven. By bowing to Dasasvamedha and Hamsa, one goes to Sivapura.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Sraddha in Dasasvamedhika and Hamsatirtha one goes to heaven. By bowing to Dasasvamedha and Hamsa, one goes to Sivapura.

verses.sanskrit: तत्फलं समवाप्नोति नर्मदाचरिते शुभे । कुरुक्षेत्रे च यत्पुण्यं प्रभासे पुष्करे तथा
verses.transliteration: tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti narmadācarite śubhe / kurukṣetre ca yatpuṇyaṃ prabhāse puṣkare tathā
verses.translation: By performing Sraddha in the hermitage of Bharata one leads the Pitrs to the abode of Brahma. One who per¬ forms Sraddha at the footprint of Matanga leads the Pitrs to Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: प्रकट की, इसी लिये वह तीथ तीनों लोकों में परम विख्यात हुआ। पितरों को मुक्ति प्रदान करनेवाला बह पुनीत तीर्थ मश्नतोथे के नाम से ख्यात हुआ, वहाँ पर स्तान कर पिण्डदान करनेवाला मनुष्य मुक्ति प्राप्त करता है ।४८-४१। संगम पर स्थित अद्भारक एवं महादेव को नमस्कार कर मनुष्य अपने पितरों को स्वर्ग प्राप्त कराता है। गया कूट में पिण्डदान करने से अश्वमेधयज्ञ का फल प्राप्त होता है। भस्मकूट में भस्मनाथ को नमस्कार कर मनुष्य अपने पितरों का उद्धार करता है। संगम में स्नान करनेवाला अपने पापों से रहित होकर मुक्त हो जाता है मुनिवर वशिष्ठ ने वहाँ पंर एक अश्वमेध यज्ञ किया था, उस यज्ञ से शम्भु उत्पन्न होकर वशिष्ठ से बोले कि वरदान मांगों  वशिष्ठ ने कहा, शम्भु देव  यदि आप सचमुच हमारे ऊपर प्रसन्न हैं, तो आप यहीं पर निवास करें। 'ऐसा ही होगा' कह कर शिव वहाँ विराजमान हो गये ।५२-५५। घेनुका रण्य में
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Sraddha in the hermitage of Bharata one leads the Pitrs to the abode of Brahma. One who per¬ forms Sraddha at the footprint of Matanga leads the Pitrs to Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Sraddha in the hermitage of Bharata one leads the Pitrs to the abode of Brahma. One who per¬ forms Sraddha at the footprint of Matanga leads the Pitrs to Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रावर्ते गयायां च वाराणस्यां विशेषतः । गङ्गाद्वारे प्रयागे च गङ्गासागरसङ्गमे
verses.transliteration: rudrāvarte gayāyāṃ ca vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / gaṅgādvāre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame

verses.hindi: ११३८ ह वायुपुराणम्

verses.sanskrit: एवमादिषु तीर्थेषु यत्पुण्यं जायते नृणाम् । नर्मदाचरितं श्रुत्वा तत्पुण्यं सकलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: evamādiṣu tīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ jāyate nṛṇām / narmadācaritaṃ śrutvā tatpuṇyaṃ sakalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: After churning the fire within the Sami tree in the company of Visnu and others, Vidhi (Brahma) secured the Tirtha for the purpose of Yajfia. It is well known in the three worlds. That Tirtha named Makha (sacrifice) yields salva¬ tion unto the Pitrs. One who takes bath, performs the Tarpana rites and offers Pindas shall attain salvation.
verses.hindi: भस्मकटे भस्मनाथं नत्वा च तारयेत्पितु न । त्यक्तपापो भवेन्मुक्तः संगमे स्नानमाचरेत् ५३ दृष्टि चक्रेडश्वमेधारुयां वशिष्ठो मुनिसत्तम:। इष्टितो निर्गतः शंभुवेरं वुणु वशिष्ठकम् ५४ प्राहेति तं वबशिष्ठोषपि शिव तुष्टोइसि मे यदि । वस्तव्यं चात्र देवेश तथेत्युक्वा शिव: स्थितः पिण्डदों धेनुकारण्ये कामधेनृपदेषु च्। स्नात्वा नत्वाइथ संपुज्य ब्रहलोक॑ नयेत्पितूनू .

verses.sanskrit: आदिमध्यावसानेषु नर्मदाचरितं शुभम् । यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या शृणुध्वं तत्फलं महत्
verses.transliteration: ādimadhyāvasāneṣu narmadācaritaṃ śubham / yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā śṛṇudhvaṃ tatphalaṃ mahat
verses.translation: After bowing to Angaraka (Mars) and Isvara (Siva) at the Sangama (confluence), the pilgrim leads the Pitrs to heaven. By offering Pindas at Gayakuta one derives the benefit of Asvamedha.
verses.hindi: कर्देमाले गयानाभो मुण्डपृष्ठसमीपत: । स्नात्वा क्राद्धादिक कृत्वा पितुणामनुणो भवेत्  ५७
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing to Angaraka (Mars) and Isvara (Siva) at the Sangama (confluence), the pilgrim leads the Pitrs to heaven. By offering Pindas at Gayakuta one derives the benefit of Asvamedha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to Angaraka (Mars) and Isvara (Siva) at the Sangama (confluence), the pilgrim leads the Pitrs to heaven. By offering Pindas at Gayakuta one derives the benefit of Asvamedha.

verses.sanskrit: समाप्य शिवसंस्थानं देवकन्यासमावृतः । रुद्रस्यानुचरो भूत्वा शिवेन सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: samāpya śivasaṃsthānaṃ devakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ / rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā śivena saha modate
verses.translation: After bowing to Bhasmanatha at Bhasmakuta, one shall redeem and uplift the Pitrs. One who performs ablutions at Sangama, shall be relieved of sins and he becomes liberated.
verses.hindi: यत्र यत्र स्थिता देवा ऋषयो5पषि जितेन्द्रिया:.. ५८ आये गदाघरं ध्यायञु्श्नाद्धपिण्डादिदानतः । कुलानां शतमुद्धत्य ब्रह्मलोक॑ नयेत्पित॒न् ५६ गयागयो गयादित्यों गया गायन्नी च गदाधरः: । गया गयासुरश्चव षड्गया मुक्तितायिकाः:. कामधेनु के पद चित्नों पर पिण्डदान करनेवाला वहाँ पर स्वान एवं नमस्कार करके अपने पितरों को ब्रह्मलोक प्राप्त कराता है। मुण्डपृष्ठ के समोष गयासुर के नाभिप्रदेश में कदंमाल नामक तीर्थ है, वहाँ पर स्नान करने तथा श्राद्धादि सम्पन्न करनेवाला अपने पितरों के ऋण से मुक्त हो जाता है।५६-५७। वहाँ पर विराजमान फल्गु, चण्डी, इमश्षानाक्षी एवं मज़ूला आदि देवियों की पूजा करनी चाहिए । गया में वधोत्सगं करनेवाला इक्कीस कुलों
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing to Bhasmanatha at Bhasmakuta, one shall redeem and uplift the Pitrs. One who performs ablutions at Sangama, shall be relieved of sins and he becomes liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to Bhasmanatha at Bhasmakuta, one shall redeem and uplift the Pitrs. One who performs ablutions at Sangama, shall be relieved of sins and he becomes liberated.

verses.sanskrit: धर्माख्यानमिदं पुण्यं सर्वाख्यानेष्वनुत्तमम् । गृहे ऽपि पठ्यते यस्य चतुर्वर्णस्य सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: dharmākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvākhyāneṣvanuttamam / gṛhe 'pi paṭhyate yasya caturvarṇasya sattamāḥ
verses.translation: The excellent sage Vasistha performed the sacrifice called ASvamedha. Sambhu who came out of the Isfi (sacrifice) said to Vasistha, "Choose a boon". Vasistha too then replied, "O Siva, if you are pleased with me, O lord of Devas, you stay here (alone)." Saying "So be it", Siva stayed there.
verses.hindi: का उद्धार करता है। इस पुनीत गया तीथे में जहाँ देवताओं का निवास है, वहीं पर जितेन्द्रिय ऋषिगण भी विराजमान रहते हैं ।(८। आदि गदाधर देव का ध्यान करते हुए श्राद्ध एवं पिण्डादि का दान करनेवाला अपने सो कुलों का उद्धार कर समस्त पितरगणों को ब्रह्मलोक प्राप्त कराता है। गयागय, गयादित्य, गायत्रो, गदाघर, गया, एवं गयासुर--ये छः गया मुक्ति प्रदान करनेवाली हैं । जो मनुष्य इस पृण्यप्रद गयाख्यान

verses.sanskrit: धन्यं तस्य गृहं मन्ये गृहस्थं चापि तत्कुलम् । पुस्तकं पूजयेद्यस्तु नर्मदाचरितस्य तु
verses.transliteration: dhanyaṃ tasya gṛhaṃ manye gṛhasthaṃ cāpi tatkulam / pustakaṃ pūjayedyastu narmadācaritasya tu
verses.translation: By taking bath and performing Sraddha etc. at Karda- mala, holy centre in Gayanabhi, near the ridge of the mountain Muijdaprstha, one is absolved of debts to his Pitrs. One shall worship (the deities) Phalgu, Gandi, SmaSa- naksi, Mahgala and others. By means of Vrsotsarga (letting loose a bull calf) one shall uplift tvventyone generations of his family.
verses.hindi: को सवेदा पढ़ता है, अथवा जो श्रद्धापूर्वक इसका श्रवण करता है, वह परम गति को प्राप्त होता है  जो पुण्यशाली मनुष्य ब्राह्मणों द्वारा इस पुण्यप्रद गयार्यान का पाठ करवाता है, वह निश्चित रूप से गया श्राद्ध करता है। जो मनुष्य समहित चित्त होकर गया की अनृपमेय महिमाओं का चिन्तन करता है, नारद जी ! कामपीठि च कामाक्षां (क्षी) पूजयेत्कामरूपिणीम् । सब प्तौं भाग्यकामो हि देवीं विन्ध्यनिवासिनीम् ॥इति
verses.wordMeaning: By taking bath and performing Sraddha etc. at Karda- mala, holy centre in Gayanabhi, near the ridge of the mountain Muijdaprstha, one is absolved of debts to his Pitrs. One shall worship (the deities) Phalgu, Gandi, SmaSa- naksi, Mahgala and others.…

verses.transliteration: lekhayitvā ca sakalaṃ revācaritamuttamam / bhūṣaṇaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ yo dadāti dvijanmane
verses.translation: This enumerates the Six Gayas where worship and Pin<ja-dana lead to mukti. Gayagaya may be Gayagaja. Certainly it is done. He who studies the glory of Gaya with purity of mind

verses.transliteration: narmadāsarvatīrtheṣu snānadānena yatphalam / tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Sanatkumara thus narrated the holy story with devo¬ tion to the leading sage. He then bade farewell to the:preceptor in music (i.e. to Narada) and went to his own hermitage surrounded by holy forests.
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमारों मुनिपुद्धावाय पुण्यां कथां चाथ निवेद्य भकत्या ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Sanatkumara thus narrated the holy story with devo¬ tion to the leading sage. He then bade farewell to the:preceptor in music (i.e. to Narada) and went to his own hermitage surrounded by holy forests.
